verses.sanskrit: शिवं शान्तं तमजरं अमरं विश्वपूजितम् | सदाशिवं नमस्यामि भक्त्याऽहं शरणं गतः ||
verses.transliteration: śivaṃ śāntaṃ tamajaram amaraṃ viśvapūjitam | sadāśivaṃ namasyāmi bhaktyāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||
verses.translation: The Auspicious, the Peaceful, the Undying, the Immortal, worshipped by all — I bow to Sadashiva with devotion, seeking his refuge.
verses.hindi: शिव — जो शांत हैं, अजर हैं, अमर हैं, समस्त विश्व द्वारा पूजित हैं — उन सदाशिव को मैं भक्तिपूर्वक नमस्कार करता हूँ और उनकी शरण लेता हूँ।
verses.commentary: Shiva's name means "the auspicious one" — not as euphemism but as metaphysics. Shiva is the one in whom dissolution (which appears terrible) is ultimately auspicious — because it clears the ground for renewal. "Shanta" (peaceful) — Shiva is the stillness that underlies all movement. "Ajara" (undying) — consciousness cannot age. The highest identity one can inhabit is Sadashiva — the ever-auspicious awareness itself.

verses.sanskrit: एको देवः केशवो वा शिवो वा हंसो वा सूर्यो वा सर्वश्रेष्ठः | अर्चन्त्येनं विप्रा होतारश्च याजमानाश्च सर्वे ||
verses.transliteration: eko devaḥ keśavo vā śivo vā haṃso vā sūryo vā sarvaśreṣṭhaḥ | arcantyenaṃ viprā hotāraśca yājanānāśca sarve ||
verses.translation: The one God — whether called Keshava (Vishnu) or Shiva or Hamsa (the Swan) or Surya (Sun) — is supreme. All Brahmins, priests, and sacrificers worship that one.
verses.hindi: एक ही देव — चाहे केशव हो, शिव हो, हंस हो या सूर्य हो — सर्वश्रेष्ठ है। सभी विप्र, होता और यजमान उसी की पूजा करते हैं।
verses.commentary: Remarkably, the Shiva Purana — a text devoted to Shiva — declares that Shiva, Vishnu, Surya, and Hamsa are all the same one God. This Vedantic inclusivism is characteristic of the great Puranas: each glorifies its own deity as supreme while simultaneously acknowledging the non-difference of all divine names. The wise worshipper does not fight over names — they see through the many names to the one reality.

verses.sanskrit: मृत्पिण्ड इव तैलाभं शिवज्ञानं प्रदीपवत् | तेनाऽऽदर्शो हृदयो मे भस्मीभूतं विलोकयेत् ||
verses.transliteration: mṛtpiṇḍa iva tailābhaṃ śivajñānaṃ pradīpavat | tenā''darśo hṛdayo me bhasmībhūtaṃ vilokayet ||
verses.translation: The knowledge of Shiva is like a lamp to a clay pot soaked in oil — my heart, becoming a mirror through it, beholds the universe as ash.
verses.hindi: शिवज्ञान तेल से तर मृत्पिण्ड (मिट्टी के बर्तन) के लिए दीपक के समान है — उससे मेरा हृदय आदर्श बनकर विश्व को भस्म रूप में देखता है।
verses.commentary: From the Shiva Purana's Vayaviya Samhita: the knowledge of Shiva is compared to a lamp placed inside an oil-soaked clay pot — the pot (the heart) becomes translucent, and through it one sees everything as ash (bhasma). This is the Shaiva teaching on vairagya (dispassion): not that the world is destroyed, but that one's attachment to it is burned away. "Bhasmibhutam" — turned to ash — means the world is seen in its true nature: impermanent, insubstantial, and ultimately sacred as the play of Shiva.
verses.wordMeaning: From the Shiva Purana's Vayaviya Samhita: the knowledge of Shiva is compared to a lamp placed inside an oil-soaked clay pot — the pot (the heart) becomes translucent, and through it one sees everything as ash (bhasma). verses.sanskrit: शिवः शक्त्या युक्तो यदि भवति शक्तः प्रभवितुं न चेदेवं देवो न खलु कुशलः स्पन्दितुमपि | अतस्त्वामाराध्यां हरिहरविरिञ्चादिभिरपि प्रणन्तुं स्तोतुं वा कथमकृतपुण्यः प्रभवति ||
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ śaktyā yukto yadi bhavati śaktaḥ prabhavituṃ na cedevaṃ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spanditumapi | atastvāmārādhyāṃ hariharaviriñcādibhirapi praṇantuṃ stotuṃ vā kathamakṛtapuṇyaḥ prabhavati ||
verses.translation: Shiva, joined with Shakti, has the power to create. Without her, the god cannot even stir. Therefore, how can one without merit worship you — praised even by Hari, Hara, and Brahma — or even address you?
verses.hindi: शिव, शक्ति से युक्त होने पर ही सृजन करने में सक्षम होते हैं। उसके बिना देव हिल भी नहीं सकते। इसलिए हरि, हर और ब्रह्मा द्वारा भी स्तुत तुम्हारी — पुण्यहीन व्यक्ति पूजा कैसे कर सकता है?
verses.commentary: This verse from the Soundarya Lahari (attributed to Shankaracharya, rooted in the Shiva Purana's Shakta theology) makes the most radical statement in all of Shaiva-Shakta philosophy: Shiva without Shakti cannot even stir. Pure awareness without power is absolutely inert. The divine as pure consciousness (Shiva alone) has no capacity — zero — for any act, including creation. Shakti is not subordinate to Shiva; she is the capacity of Shiva. This is the Kashmiri Shaivism position: Shakti is Shiva's very nature, his power of self-expression. To worship Shakti is to worship what makes Shiva himself real.
verses.wordMeaning: This verse from the Soundarya Lahari (attributed to Shankaracharya, rooted in the Shiva Purana's Shakta theology) makes the most radical statement in all of Shaiva-Shakta philosophy: Shiva without Shakti cannot even stir. verses.sanskrit: नकारो भूमिरित्याहुर्मकारं वारि गीयते | शिकारस्तेज इत्याहुर्वकारो वायुरेव च | यकारोऽकाश इत्याहुः पञ्चाक्षरमिदं परम् ||
verses.transliteration: nakāro bhūmirityāhurmakāraṃ vāri gīyate | śikārasteja ityāhurvakāro vāyureva ca | yakāro'kāśa ityāhuḥ pañcākṣaramidaṃ param ||
verses.translation: Na is earth, Ma is water, Shi is fire, Va is air, Ya is space — this five-syllable mantra is the supreme.
verses.hindi: न = पृथ्वी; म = जल; शि = अग्नि; व = वायु; य = आकाश — यह पाँच अक्षरों वाला पञ्चाक्षर मन्त्र परम है।
verses.commentary: The Panchakshara mantra "Namah Shivaya" is decoded as a cosmic map: each of its five syllables corresponds to one of the five elements (pancha bhuta) that compose physical reality. To chant this mantra is to acknowledge all five elements as Shiva — to see the divine in the ground under your feet (Na), the water you drink (Ma), the fire of your body (Shi), the breath (Va), and the space in which everything exists (Ya). It is a complete ecology of devotion.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टिः स्थितिः संहारस्तिरोधानमनुग्रहः | पञ्चकृत्यमिति प्रोक्तं नटराजस्य नर्तने ||
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiḥ saṃhārastirodhānamanugrahaḥ | pañcakṛtyamiti proktaṃ naṭarājasya nartane ||
verses.translation: Creation, preservation, dissolution, concealment, and grace — these are the five actions performed in the dance of Nataraja.
verses.hindi: सृष्टि, स्थिति, संहार, तिरोधान (आच्छादन), और अनुग्रह — ये पाँच कृत्य नटराज के नृत्य में किए जाते हैं।
verses.commentary: Shiva as Nataraja — the king of dancers — performs five simultaneous actions in his cosmic dance. The usual three (creation, preservation, dissolution) are joined by two more profound ones: tirodhana (concealment, the cosmic forgetting that makes the play possible) and anugraha (grace, the cosmic remembering that makes liberation possible). These five together are reality. The dance never stops; the dancer is everywhere.

verses.transliteration: vāmārdhaṃ pārvatīrūpaṃ dakṣiṇārdhaṃ maheśvaraḥ | ardhanārīśvaro devaḥ strīpuṃsayoḥ samanvayaḥ ||
verses.translation: The left half is the form of Parvati; the right half is Maheshvara. The Ardhanarishvara deity — the harmonious union of the feminine and masculine.
verses.hindi: बायाँ अर्ध पार्वती का रूप है; दायाँ अर्ध महेश्वर का। अर्धनारीश्वर देव — स्त्री और पुरुष का समन्वय।
verses.commentary: The Ardhanarishvara form encodes the Shiva Purana's deepest non-dual teaching. The division into left (Shakti, feminine, dynamic) and right (Shiva, masculine, static) is not a claim about gender roles but about two fundamental principles of existence. Shakti is the power of becoming, transformation, manifestation — without her, nothing moves. Shiva is the ground of being, the unchanging awareness — without him, there is no witness of the movement. The world requires both. The human being requires both. Psychological health requires the integration of both the receptive-aware (Shiva) and the active-creative (Shakti) in each individual. "Samanvayaḥ" — harmonious union, not domination of one by the other.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः शक्त्या युक्तो यदि भवति शक्तः प्रभवितुं न चेदेवं देवो न खलु कुशलः स्पन्दितुमपि | अतस्त्वामाराध्यां हरिहरविरिञ्चादिभिरपि प्रणन्तुं स्तोतुं वा कथमकृतपुण्यः प्रभवति ||
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ śaktyā yukto yadi bhavati śaktaḥ prabhavituṃ na cedevaṃ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spanditumapi | atastvāmārādhyāṃ hariharaviriñcādibhirapi praṇantuṃ stotuṃ vā kathamakṛtapuṇyaḥ prabhavati ||
verses.translation: Shiva, joined with Shakti, has the power to create. Without her, the god cannot even stir. Therefore, how can one without merit worship you — praised even by Hari, Hara, and Brahma — or even address you?

Pure awareness without power is absolutely inert. The divine as pure consciousness (Shiva alone) has no capacity — zero — for any act, including creation. Shakti is not subordinate to Shiva; she is the capacity of Shiva. This is the Kashmiri Shaivism position: Shakti is Shiva's very nature, his power of self-expression. To worship Shakti is to worship what makes Shiva himself real.

verses.sanskrit: मृत्पिण्ड इव तैलाभं शिवज्ञानं प्रदीपवत् | तेनाऽऽदर्शो हृदयो मे भस्मीभूतं विलोकयेत् ||
verses.transliteration: mṛtpiṇḍa iva tailābhaṃ śivajñānaṃ pradīpavat | tenā''darśo hṛdayo me bhasmībhūtaṃ vilokayet ||
verses.translation: The knowledge of Shiva is like a lamp to a clay pot soaked in oil — my heart, becoming a mirror through it, beholds the universe as ash.
verses.hindi: शिवज्ञान तेल से तर मृत्पिण्ड (मिट्टी के बर्तन) के लिए दीपक के समान है — उससे मेरा हृदय आदर्श बनकर विश्व को भस्म रूप में देखता है।
verses.commentary: From the Shiva Purana's Vayaviya Samhita: the knowledge of Shiva is compared to a lamp placed inside an oil-soaked clay pot — the pot (the heart) becomes translucent, and through it one sees everything as ash (bhasma). This is the Shaiva teaching on vairagya (dispassion): not that the world is destroyed, but that one's attachment to it is burned away. "Bhasmibhutam" — turned to ash — means the world is seen in its true nature: impermanent, insubstantial, and ultimately sacred as the play of Shiva.

verses.sanskrit: सौराष्ट्रे सोमनाथं च श्रीशैले मल्लिकार्जुनम् | उज्जयिन्यां महाकालमोङ्कारममलेश्वरम् | परल्यां वैद्यनाथं च डाकिन्यां भीमशङ्करम् | सेतुबन्धे तु रामेशं नागेशं दारुकावने | वाराणस्यां तु विश्वेशं त्र्यम्बकं गौतमीतटे | हिमालये तु केदारं घुश्मेशं च शिवालये | एतानि ज्योतिर्लिङ्गानि सायं प्रातः पठेन्नरः | सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं स्मरणेन विनश्यति ||
verses.transliteration: saurāṣṭre somanāthaṃ ca śrīśaile mallikārjunam | ujjayinyāṃ mahākālamomkāramamalreśvaram | paralyāṃ vaidyanāthaṃ ca ḍākinyāṃ bhīmaśaṃkaram | setubaṃdhe tu rāmeśaṃ nāgeśaṃ dārukāvane | vārāṇasyāṃ tu viśveśaṃ tryambakaṃ gautamītaṭe | himālaye tu kedāraṃ ghuśmeśaṃ ca śivālaye | etāni jyotirliṃgāni sāyaṃ prātaḥ paṭhennraḥ | saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ smaraṇena vinaśyati ||
verses.translation: Somnath in Saurashtra, Mallikarjuna at Shrishailam, Mahakala at Ujjain, Omkareshvara, Vaidyanath at Parali, Bhimashankara at Dakini, Rameshvara at Setubandha, Nageshvara at Darukavana, Vishveshvara at Varanasi, Tryambaka at the Gautami bank, Kedara in the Himalayas, Ghushmesha at Shivalaya. One who recites these jyotirlingas at morning and evening — the sins of seven births perish by this remembrance.
verses.hindi: सौराष्ट्र में सोमनाथ, श्रीशैल में मल्लिकार्जुन, उज्जैन में महाकाल, ओंकारेश्वर, परलि में वैद्यनाथ, डाकिनी में भीमशंकर, सेतुबंध में रामेश, दारुकावन में नागेश, वाराणसी में विश्वेश, गौतमी तट पर त्र्यम्बक, हिमालय में केदार, शिवालय में घुश्मेश। जो मनुष्य इन ज्योतिर्लिङ्गों का प्रातः-सायं पाठ करता है — स्मरण से सात जन्मों के पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.commentary: The dvadasha jyotirlinga stotram — one of the most practically used verses in the entire Shaiva tradition. The twelve jyotirlingas form a sacred geography of the entire Indian subcontinent: from Somnath on the western coast of Gujarat to Rameshvara at the southern tip, from Kedarnath in the Himalayas to Shrishailam in Andhra Pradesh. They are not merely pilgrimage destinations — they are twelve nodes of a continent-wide sacred grid. The stotram is designed to be recited at dawn and dusk: by holding all twelve in consciousness twice daily, the practitioner ritually inhabits the full sacred space of the subcontinent, regardless of physical location. "Saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ" — the sins of seven births: the depth of the purification corresponds to the depth of the sacred geography invoked.

verses.sanskrit: एको देवः केशवो वा शिवो वा हंसो वा सूर्यो वा सर्वश्रेष्ठः | अर्चन्त्येनं विप्रा होतारश्च याजमानाश्च सर्वे ||
verses.transliteration: eko devaḥ keśavo vā śivo vā haṃso vā sūryo vā sarvaśreṣṭhaḥ | arcantyenaṃ viprā hotāraśca yājanānāśca sarve ||
verses.translation: The one God — whether called Keshava (Vishnu) or Shiva or Hamsa (the Swan) or Surya (Sun) — is supreme. All Brahmins, priests, and sacrificers worship that one.
verses.hindi: एक ही देव — चाहे केशव हो, शिव हो, हंस हो या सूर्य हो — सर्वश्रेष्ठ है। सभी विप्र, होता और यजमान उसी की पूजा करते हैं।
verses.commentary: Remarkably, the Shiva Purana — a text devoted to Shiva — declares that Shiva, Vishnu, Surya, and Hamsa are all the same one God. This Vedantic inclusivism is characteristic of the great Puranas: each glorifies its own deity as supreme while simultaneously acknowledging the non-difference of all divine names. The wise worshipper does not fight over names — they see through the many names to the one reality.

verses.sanskrit: शिवो भूत्वा शिवं यजेत् | न शिवाद्भिन्नो यजेत् ||
verses.transliteration: śivo bhūtvā śivaṃ yajet | na śivādbhinno yajet ||
verses.translation: Having become Shiva, worship Shiva. Do not worship Shiva as one separate from Shiva.
verses.hindi: शिव बनकर शिव की पूजा करो। शिव से अलग होकर शिव की पूजा मत करो।
verses.commentary: The most concentrated expression of the Vayaviya Samhita's non-dual Shaiva philosophy — and one of the most radical statements about worship in any tradition. "Śivo bhūtvā śivaṃ yajet" — having become Shiva, worship Shiva. The quality of worship is determined by the identity of the worshipper. If you worship from the position of a small, separate, deficient self — you are projecting a powerful, complete Shiva external to yourself, which reinforces the distance. True worship begins from identity: I am already Shiva. From that recognition, the act of worship is the divine worshipping itself — which is its own deepest delight. "Na śivādbhinno yajet" — do not worship as one separate from Shiva. Separation is the fundamental error; worship from separation deepens the error rather than correcting it.

verses.sanskrit: यो वेद निहितं गुहायां परमे व्योमन् | सोऽश्नुते सर्वान्कामान्सह ब्रह्मणा विपश्चिता ||
verses.transliteration: yo veda nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ parame vyoman | so'śnute sarvānkāmānsaha brahmaṇā vipaścitā ||
verses.translation: One who knows what is hidden in the cave, in the supreme ether — that one enjoys all desires together with the all-knowing Brahman.
verses.hindi: जो उस गुहा में, परम व्योम में स्थित को जानता है — वह सर्वज्ञ ब्रह्म के साथ सभी कामनाओं का भोग करता है।
verses.commentary: The Vayaviya Samhita quotes the Taittiriya Upanishad's "guha" (cave of the heart) teaching in its Shaiva key. The Shiva who is "nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ" — hidden in the cave — is not Shiva the external deity in a temple but Shiva as the innermost awareness, the "space" of consciousness at the centre of the human being. "Parame vyoman" — in the supreme ether: the innermost space that is simultaneously the largest — the space of pure awareness that contains all experience. This is the convergence of the Shaiva and Vedantic traditions: the external jyotirlinga (infinite column of light outside) and the inner jyotirlinga (the light of awareness in the cave of the heart) are the same light.

verses.hindi: शिव, शक्ति से युक्त होने पर ही सृजन करने में सक्षम होते हैं। उसके बिना देव हिल भी नहीं सकते। इसलिए हरि, हर और ब्रह्मा द्वारा भी स्तुत तुम्हारी — पुण्यहीन व्यक्ति पूजा कैसे कर सकता है?
verses.commentary: This verse from the Soundarya Lahari (attributed to Shankaracharya, rooted in the Shiva Purana's Shakta theology) makes the most radical statement in all of Shaiva-Shakta philosophy: Shiva without Shakti cannot even stir. Pure awareness without power is absolutely inert. The divine as pure consciousness (Shiva alone) has no capacity — zero — for any act, including creation. Shakti is not subordinate to Shiva; she is the capacity of Shiva. This is the Kashmiri Shaivism position: Shakti is Shiva's very nature, his power of self-expression. To worship Shakti is to worship what makes Shiva himself real.
verses.wordMeaning: This verse from the Soundarya Lahari (attributed to Shankaracharya, rooted in the Shiva Purana's Shakta theology) makes the most radical statement in all of Shaiva-Shakta philosophy: Shiva without Shakti cannot even stir. Pure awareness without power is absolutely inert. The divine as pure consciousness (Shiva alone) has no capacity — zero — for any act, including creation. Shakti is not subordinate to Shiva; she is the capacity of Shiva. This is the Kashmiri Shaivism position: Shakti is Shiva's very nature, his power of self-expression. To worship Shakti is to worship what makes Shiva himself real.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१. प्रथमोऽध्यायः । शिवस्य पञ्चब्रह्मावतारवर्णनम् । वन्दे महानन्दमनन्तलीलम्महेश्वरं सर्वविभुं महान्तम् । गौरीप्रियं कार्तिकविघ्नराजसमुद्भवं शङ्करमादिदेवम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.1\. prathamo.adhyAyaH | shivasya pa~nchabrahmAvatAravarNanam | vande mahAnandamanantalIlammaheshvaraM sarvavibhuM mahAntam | gaurIpriyaM kArtikavighnarAjasamudbhavaM sha~NkaramAdidevam
verses.translation: The concept of Rudrasr$ti can be traced as far back as the Vcdic Literature. According to Yv i6- 4 one Rudra created many Rudras out of his own body. The PurSnas too have recorded the tradition of many Rudras evolved out of a single Rudra. The present Saiiihita desct ibes one hundred incarnations (T Siva and is therefore called fSatarudra.

verses.sanskrit: शौनक उवाच । व्यासशिष्य महाभाग सूत ज्ञानदयानिधे । वद शम्भ्ववतारांश्च यैरकार्षीत्सतां शिवम्
verses.transliteration: shaunaka uvAcha | vyAsashiShya mahAbhAga sUta j~nAnadayAnidhe | vada shambhvavatArAMshcha yairakArShItsatAM shivam
verses.translation: The concept of Rudrasr$ti can be traced as far back as the Vcdic Literature. According to Yv i6- 4 one Rudra created many Rudras out of his own body. The PurSnas too have recorded the tradition of many Rudras evolved out of a single Rudra. The present Saiiihita desct ibes one hundred incarnations (T Siva and is therefore called fSatarudra.
verses.hindi: यहाँपर उनका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: सुनन्दो नन्दनश्चैव विश्वनन्दोपनन्दनौ । शिष्यास्तस्य महात्मानो यैस्तद्ब्रह्म समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: sunando nandanashchaiva vishvanandopanandanau | shiShyAstasya mahAtmAno yaistadbrahma samAvR^itam
verses.translation: The incarnations of the omnipresent lord Siva are countless in the different aeons.* Yet I shall narrate them as far as I know.
verses.hindi: और लोहित वर्णवाला एक कुमार उत्पन्न हुआ

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातश्च वै शम्भुर्ददौ ज्ञानं च वेधसे । सर्गशक्तिमपि प्रीत्या प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sadyojAtashcha vai shambhurdadau j~nAnaM cha vedhase | sargashaktimapi prItyA prasannaH parameshvaraH
verses.translation: In that Kalpa, Svetalohita, endowed with a tuft, was born as the son of Biahma as he meditated upon the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विंशतिमः कल्पो रक्तो नाम प्रकीर्तितः । ब्रह्मा यत्र महातेजा रक्तवर्णमधारयत्
verses.transliteration: tato viMshatimaH kalpo rakto nAma prakIrtitaH | brahmA yatra mahAtejA raktavarNamadhArayat
verses.translation: On seeing that Being in the form of Brahman and realising that to be Ivara, Brahma meditated on him in his heart and saluted him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: परमतत्त्वरूप उन पुरुषका चिन्तन करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतः पुत्रकामस्य प्रादुर्भूतो विधेः सुतः । रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरो रक्ताक्षो रक्तभूषणः
verses.transliteration: dhyAyataH putrakAmasya prAdurbhUto vidheH sutaH | raktamAlyAmbaradharo raktAkSho raktabhUShaNaH
verses.translation: Knowing that Sadyojata to be Siva, Brahma, the lord of the worlds became delighted. With pure intelligence he pondered over that great Being again and again.
verses.hindi: द्वारा यह सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्मलोक समावृत है

verses.sanskrit: स तं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं कुमारं ध्यानमाश्रितः । वामदेवं शिवं ज्ञात्वा प्रणनाम कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: sa taM dR^iShTvA mahAtmAnaM kumAraM dhyAnamAshritaH | vAmadevaM shivaM j~nAtvA praNanAma kR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: As he thus meditated, sons white in colour and famous for valour, were born to him. They were of great wisdom and had the form of the Supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: सृष्टि उत्पन्न करनेका सामर्थ्य भी प्रदान किया

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्य सुता ह्यासंश्चत्वारो रक्तवाससः । विरजाश्च विवाहश्च विशोको विश्वभावनः
verses.transliteration: tatastasya sutA hyAsaMshchatvAro raktavAsasaH | virajAshcha vivAhashcha vishoko vishvabhAvanaH
verses.translation: They were Sunanda, Nandana, ViSvananda and Upanandana. They were the disciples of that noble soul. By them the Brahman was encircled.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवः स वै शम्भुर्ददौ ज्ञानं च वेधसे । सर्गशक्तिमपि प्रीत्या प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vAmadevaH sa vai shambhurdadau j~nAnaM cha vedhase | sargashaktimapi prItyA prasannaH parameshvaraH
verses.translation: The delighted great lord, the Sadyojata incarna¬ tion of Siva, lovingly bestowed on Brahma the perfect wisdom and the power of creation.

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशतिमः कल्पः पीतवासा इति स्मृतः । ब्रह्मा यत्र महाभागः पीतवासा बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: ekaviMshatimaH kalpaH pItavAsA iti smR^itaH | brahmA yatra mahAbhAgaH pItavAsA babhUva ha
verses.translation: As Brahma desirous of sons meditated, a son ap¬ peared in front of him wearing red garments and garlands. His eyes were red and his ornaments too were red.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतः पुत्रकामस्य विधेर्जातः कुमारकः । पीतवस्त्रादिकप्रौढो महातेजा महाभुजः
verses.transliteration: dhyAyataH putrakAmasya vidherjAtaH kumArakaH | pItavastrAdikaprauDho mahAtejA mahAbhujaH
verses.translation: On seeing that noble-souled son, he resorting to meditation knew him as the Vamadeva incarnation of Siva and so bowed to him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न करनेकी शक्ति भी प्रदान की

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा ध्यानसंयुक्तं ज्ञात्वा तत्पुरुषं शिवम् । प्रणनाम ततो बुद्ध्या गायत्रीं शाङ्करीं विधिः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA dhyAnasaMyuktaM j~nAtvA tatpuruShaM shivam | praNanAma tato buddhyA gAyatrIM shA~NkarIM vidhiH
verses.translation: Your sons wearing red garments were bom of him Viz, Virajas, VivSha, Vioka and Vivabhfivana.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । मुने शौनक सद्भक्त्या दत्तचित्तो जितेन्द्रियः । अवताराञ्छिवस्याहं वच्मि ते मुनये शृणु
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | mune shaunaka sadbhaktyA dattachitto jitendriyaH | avatArA~nChivasyAhaM vachmi te munaye shR^iNu
verses.translation: The delighted ParameSvara, the Vamadeva incar¬ nation of Siva bestowed on Brahma lovingly, the power of creation and perfect wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: जपित्वा तु महादेवीं सर्वलोकनमस्कृताम् । प्रसन्नस्तु महादेवो ध्यानयुक्तेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: japitvA tu mahAdevIM sarvalokanamaskR^itAm | prasannastu mahAdevo dhyAnayuktena chetasA
verses.translation: As Brahma desirous of sons meditated, a son was born unto him mature, of great arms and great splendour and wearing yellow garments.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽस्य पार्श्वतो दिव्याः प्रादुर्भूताः कुमारकाः । पीतवस्त्रा हि सकला योगमार्गप्रवर्तकाः
verses.transliteration: tato.asya pArshvato divyAH prAdurbhUtAH kumArakAH | pItavastrA hi sakalA yogamArgapravartakAH
verses.translation: On seeing him engrossed in meditation and realising that Being as Siva, the Creator bowed to him after performing the Japa of Siva-Gayatri, who is the great god¬ dess, bowed to by all the worlds. The gpreat god was delighted with the mind in contemplation.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मिन्गते कल्पे पीतवर्णे स्वयम्भुवः । पुनरन्यः प्रवृत्तस्तु कल्पो नाम्ना शिवस्तु स
verses.transliteration: tatastasmingate kalpe pItavarNe svayambhuvaH | punaranyaH pravR^ittastu kalpo nAmnA shivastu sa
verses.translation: Then from his sides sons of divine features issued forth. All of them had yellow garments and they were the instigators of the Yogic path.

verses.sanskrit: एकार्णवे संव्यतीते दिव्यवर्षसहस्रके । स्रष्टुकामः प्रजा ब्रह्मा चिन्तयामास दुःखितः
verses.transliteration: ekArNave saMvyatIte divyavarShasahasrake | sraShTukAmaH prajA brahmA chintayAmAsa duHkhitaH
verses.translation: When that Kalpa of yellow colour of the selfborn lord elapsed, another Kalpa set in and it was named Siva.
verses.hindi: चन्दनका अनुलेप धारण किये हुए था

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽपश्यन्महातेजाः प्रादुर्भूतं कुमारकम् । कृष्णवर्णं महावीर्यं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा
verses.transliteration: tato.apashyanmahAtejAH prAdurbhUtaM kumArakam | kR^iShNavarNaM mahAvIryaM dIpyamAnaM svatejasA
verses.translation: After a thousand divine years had elapsed and the entire universe had become one vast ocean,* Brahma desirous of creating subjects thought in sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: धृतकृष्णाम्बरोष्णीषं कृष्णयज्ञोपवीतिनम् । कृष्णेन मौलिनायुक्तं कृष्णस्नानानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: dhR^itakR^iShNAmbaroShNIShaM kR^iShNayaj~nopavItinam | kR^iShNena maulinAyuktaM kR^iShNasnAnAnulepanam
verses.translation: That lord of great splendour saw a son coming into view. He was black in colour, possessed of great strength. He was shining in his own splendour.

verses.sanskrit: स तं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानमघोरं घोरविक्रमम् । ववन्दे देवदेवेशमद्भुतं कृष्णपिङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration: sa taM dR^iShTvA mahAtmAnamaghoraM ghoravikramam | vavande devadeveshamadbhutaM kR^iShNapi~Ngalam
verses.translation: On seeing that noble soul of terrible exploits, (named) Aghora (non-terrible), he worshipped him—the lord of god, of wonderful black and tawny colour.
verses.hindi: कि तो नाभतः परमादत: अद्भुत कल्प प्रारम्भ हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अघोरं तु ततो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मरूपं व्यचिन्तयत् । तुष्टाव वाग्भिरिष्टाभिर्भक्तवत्सलमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: aghoraM tu tato brahmA brahmarUpaM vyachintayat | tuShTAva vAgbhiriShTAbhirbhaktavatsalamavyayam
verses.translation: Brahma then contemplated on Aghora in the form of Brahman. He eulogised that unperishing Being favourably disposed towards his devotees, by means of pleasing words.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिव ईशानके रूपमें प्रकट हुए

verses.sanskrit: अथास्य पार्श्वतः कृष्णाः कृष्णस्नानानुलेपनाः । चत्वारस्तु महात्मानः सम्बभूवुः कुमारकाः
verses.transliteration: athAsya pArshvataH kR^iShNAH kR^iShNasnAnAnulepanAH | chatvArastu mahAtmAnaH sambabhUvuH kumArakAH
verses.translation: Then from his sides sprang up four noble-souled sons all of whom were black in colour and had black toilet and unguent articles.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्ण कृष्णशिखश्चैव कृष्णास्यः कृष्णकण्ठधृक् । इति तेऽव्यक्तनामानः शिवरूपाः सुतेजसः
verses.transliteration: kR^iShNa kR^iShNashikhashchaiva kR^iShNAsyaH kR^iShNakaNThadhR^ik | iti te.avyaktanAmAnaH shivarUpAH sutejasaH
verses.translation: These brilliant beings in the form of iSiva had the

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पृष्टः पुरा नन्दी शिवमूर्तिस्सतां गतिः । सनत्कुमारेण मुने तमुवाच शिवं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: etatpR^iShTaH purA nandI shivamUrtissatAM gatiH | sanatkumAreNa mune tamuvAcha shivaM smaran
verses.translation: EkSrnava symbolises the state of the universe during the period of dissolution when the divided units are drawn together forming a single watery mass. For details sec MP—A Study Pp 9'io*
verses.hindi: सद्धर्म करके योग-गतिको प्राप्त हो गये

verses.sanskrit: एवम्भूता महात्मानो ब्रह्मणः सृष्टिहेतवे । योगं प्रवर्तयामासुर्घोराख्यं महदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: evambhUtA mahAtmAno brahmaNaH sR^iShTihetave | yogaM pravartayAmAsurghorAkhyaM mahadadbhutam
verses.translation: The noble-souled beings of this nature initiated the great and wonderful Yoga called Ghora for the purpose of Brahma's creation.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यो ब्रह्मणः कल्पः प्रावर्तत मुनीश्वराः । विश्वरूप इति ख्यातो नामतः परमाद्भुतः
verses.transliteration: athAnyo brahmaNaH kalpaH prAvartata munIshvarAH | vishvarUpa iti khyAto nAmataH paramAdbhutaH
verses.translation: O great sages, then another extremely wonderful Kalpa of Brahma, named ViSvarupa began to function.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणः पुत्रकामस्य ध्यायतो मनसा शिवम् । प्रादुर्भूता महानादा विश्वरूपा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: brahmaNaH putrakAmasya dhyAyato manasA shivam | prAdurbhUtA mahAnAdA vishvarUpA sarasvatI
verses.translation: As Brahma, desirous of sons, meditated on Siva mentally, Sarasvati (Goddess of speech) of great sound mani¬ fested herself. She was Vi pa (Universe-formed).
verses.hindi: प्रकारके कार्योंको सर्वदा सम्पादित करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: तथाविधः स भगवानीशानः परमेश्वरः । शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशः सर्वाभरणभूषितः
verses.transliteration: tathAvidhaH sa bhagavAnIshAnaH parameshvaraH | shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshaH sarvAbharaNabhUShitaH
verses.translation: Isanu of such renowned features, supreme lord of crystal-like pure brilliance and bedecked in all ornaments manifested himself.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणनामासौ ब्रह्मेशानमजं विभुम् । सर्वगं सर्वदं सर्वं सुरूपं रूपवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA praNanAmAsau brahmeshAnamajaM vibhum | sarvagaM sarvadaM sarvaM surUpaM rUpavarjitam
verses.translation: On seeing the unborn lord, an pervading,

verses.sanskrit: ईशानोऽपि तथादिश्य सन्मार्गं ब्रह्मणे विभुः । सशक्तिः कल्पयाञ्चक्रे स बालांश्चतुरः शुभान्
verses.transliteration: IshAno.api tathAdishya sanmArgaM brahmaNe vibhuH | sashaktiH kalpayA~nchakre sa bAlAMshchaturaH shubhAn
verses.translation: Lord liana after instructing the path of the good to Brahma, created four auspicious sons in collaboration with his Energy.

verses.sanskrit: जटी मुण्डी शिखण्डी च अर्धमुण्डश्च जज्ञिरे । योगेनादिश्य सद्धर्मं कृत्वा योगगतिं गताः
verses.transliteration: jaTI muNDI shikhaNDI cha ardhamuNDashcha jaj~nire | yogenAdishya saddharmaM kR^itvA yogagatiM gatAH
verses.translation: There were born Jatin, Mundin, Sikhandin and Ardhamunda. By means of Yoga they imparted good virtue and attained the goal of Yoga.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शिवस्य पश्चब्रह्मावतारवर्णन॑ नाम प्रथमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: एवं सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तः सद्यादीनां समुद्भवः । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: evaM sa~NkShepataH proktaH sadyAdInAM samudbhavaH | sanatkumAra sarvaj~na lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
verses.translation: Thus I have succinctly narrated the origin of Sadyojata and others, O Sanatkumara, O omniscient one, being desirous of the welfare of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तेषां महाप्राज्ञ व्यवहारं यथायथम् । त्रिलोकहितकारं हि सर्वं ब्रह्माण्डसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: atha teShAM mahAprAj~na vyavahAraM yathAyatham | trilokahitakAraM hi sarvaM brahmANDasaMsthitam
verses.translation: Then, O intelligent one, their dealings arc bene¬ ficial to the three worlds and everything that is existent in the universe.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः पुरुषोऽघोरो वामसंज्ञस्तथैव च । ब्रह्मसंज्ञा महेशस्य मूर्तयः पञ्च विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: IshAnaH puruSho.aghoro vAmasa.nj~nastathaiva cha | brahmasa.nj~nA maheshasya mUrtayaH pa~ncha vishrutAH
verses.translation: The five famous forms of Mahela* are thus named
verses.hindi: तस्मिन्व्याप्य स्थितं विश्वं सूत्रे मणिगणा इब॥ २  मणियाँ

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । असङ्ख्याता हि कल्पेषु विभोः सर्वेश्वरस्य वै । अवतारास्तथापीह वच्म्यहं तान्यथामति
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | asa~NkhyAtA hi kalpeShu vibhoH sarveshvarasya vai | avatArAstathApIha vachmyahaM tAnyathAmati
verses.translation: Intelligent and wise persons call Tatpurusa as the lord of Tvac (orgin of touch perception), hand, sense of touch and the wind element.
verses.hindi: महादेव--ये शंकरकी आठ मूर्तियाँ विख्यात हैं

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः शिवरूपश्च गरीयान्प्रथमः स्मृतः । भोक्तारं प्रकृतेः साक्षात्क्षेत्रज्ञमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: IshAnaH shivarUpashcha garIyAnprathamaH smR^itaH | bhoktAraM prakR^iteH sAkShAtkShetraj~namadhitiShThati
verses.translation: Intelligent persons call the form Aghor, the sup¬ port of the physical body, the sense of taste, of colour and of fire as well.

verses.sanskrit: शैवस्तत्पुरुषाख्यश्च स्वरूपो हि द्वितीयकः । गुणाश्रयात्मकं भोग्यं सर्वज्ञमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: shaivastatpuruShAkhyashcha svarUpo hi dvitIyakaH | guNAshrayAtmakaM bhogyaM sarvaj~namadhitiShThati
verses.translation: They know the form of Sadyojata as the lord of the organ of smell, of smell itself, of the earth and of the generative organ.
verses.hindi: शिवका भव नामक रूप कहा जाता है

verses.sanskrit: धर्माय स्वाङ्गसंयुक्तं बुद्धितत्त्वं पिनाकिनः । अघोराख्यस्वरूपो यस्तिष्ठत्यन्तस्तृतीयकः
verses.transliteration: dharmAya svA~NgasaMyuktaM buddhitattvaM pinAkinaH | aghorAkhyasvarUpo yastiShThatyantastR^itIyakaH
verses.translation: These forms of Siva, the source of all glory shall be honoured and bowed to strenuously by those who seek glory.
verses.hindi: परमात्मा शिवका उग्र रूप कहा जाता है

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवाह्वयो रूपश्चतुर्थः शङ्करस्य हि । अहङ्कृतेरधिष्ठानो बहुकार्यकरः सदा
verses.transliteration: vAmadevAhvayo rUpashchaturthaH sha~Nkarasya hi | aha~NkR^iteradhiShThAno bahukAryakaraH sadA
verses.translation: He who reads and listens to the origin of Sadyojata and others, enjoys all desires and attains the ultimate goal.
verses.hindi: गया है, वह महाभूतोंका भेदन करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: ईशानाह्वस्वरूपो हि शङ्करस्येश्वरः सदा । श्रोत्रस्य वचसश्चापि विभोर्व्योम्नस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: IshAnAhvasvarUpo hi sha~NkarasyeshvaraH sadA | shrotrasya vachasashchApi vibhorvyomnastathaiva cha
verses.translation: O dear sage, listen to the great incarnations of lord l§iva that carry out all worldly activities and bestow happiness on all.
verses.hindi: पशुपतिका पशुपति नामक रूप जानना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: त्वक्पाणिस्पर्शवायूनामीश्वरं रूपमैश्वरम् । पुरुषाख्यं विचारज्ञा मतिमन्तः प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: tvakpANisparshavAyUnAmIshvaraM rUpamaishvaram | puruShAkhyaM vichAraj~nA matimantaH prachakShate
verses.translation: The 'iniverse consists of the eight forms of lord Siva.® Pervading that the universe subsists like the pearls in the string.
verses.hindi: वह महेशका ईशान नामक रूप है

verses.sanskrit: वपुषश्च रसस्यापि रूपस्याग्नेस्तथैव च । अघोराख्यमधिष्ठानं रूपं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: vapuShashcha rasasyApi rUpasyAgnestathaiva cha | aghorAkhyamadhiShThAnaM rUpaM prAhurmanIShiNaH
verses.translation: The eight presiding deities are Sarva, Bhava, Rudra, Ugra, Bhima, Paupati, liana and Mahadeva. They are well known.
verses.hindi: वह रूप महादेव नामसे विख्यात है

verses.sanskrit: रशनायाश्च पायोश्च रसस्यापां तथैव च । ईश्वरं वामदेवाख्यं स्वरूपं शाङ्करं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: rashanAyAshcha pAyoshcha rasasyApAM tathaiva cha | IshvaraM vAmadevAkhyaM svarUpaM shA~NkaraM smR^itam
verses.translation: By these eight forms of Siva, viz. Sarva etc, the earth, the waters, the fire, the wind, the sky, the individual soul, the sun and the moon are presided over.
verses.hindi: शरीरभूत संसार शिवार्चनसे पुष्ट होता है

verses.sanskrit: घ्राणस्य चैवोपस्थस्य गन्धस्य च भुवस्तथा । सद्योजाताह्वयं रूपमीश्वरं शाङ्करं विदुः
verses.transliteration: ghrANasya chaivopasthasya gandhasya cha bhuvastathA | sadyojAtAhvayaM rUpamIshvaraM shA~NkaraM viduH
verses.translation: The form of the Supreme Soul, consisting of water that enlivens the entire world, is called Bhava.
verses.hindi: संसारके प्रसन्‍न होनेसे शिवजी प्रसन्न रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: इमे स्वरूपाः शम्भोर्हि वन्दनीयाः प्रयत्नतः । श्रेयोऽर्थिभिर्नरैर्नित्यं श्रेयसामेकहेतवः
verses.transliteration: ime svarUpAH shambhorhi vandanIyAH prayatnataH | shreyo.arthibhirnarairnityaM shreyasAmekahetavaH
verses.translation: The form of the great lord Siva that holds the outer and inner universe and throbs by itself is called Ugra by the noble.
verses.hindi: अनिष्ट किया गया है, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: एकोनविंशकः कल्पो विज्ञेयः श्वेतलोहितः । सद्योजातावतारस्तु प्रथमः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: ekonaviMshakaH kalpo vij~neyaH shvetalohitaH | sadyojAtAvatArastu prathamaH parikIrtitaH
verses.translation: That form of lord Siva consisting of the firmament that pervades everything and affords space to all is called Bhima and it splits and differentiates the group of elements.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तत्परमं ब्रह्म ध्यायतो ब्रह्मणस्तथा । उत्पन्नस्तु शिखायुक्तः कुमारः श्वेतलोहितः
verses.transliteration: tasmiMstatparamaM brahma dhyAyato brahmaNastathA | utpannastu shikhAyuktaH kumAraH shvetalohitaH
verses.translation: That form of Siva shall be known as Paifupati which is the support of individual souls, and abiding therein splits the bondage that encircles them.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शिवाष्टू्त्तिवर्णन॑ नाम द्वितीयोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पुरुषं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मरूपिणमीश्वरम् । ज्ञात्वा ध्यात्वा स हृदये ववन्दे प्रयताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA puruShaM brahmA brahmarUpiNamIshvaram | j~nAtvA dhyAtvA sa hR^idaye vavande prayatA~njaliH
verses.translation: Brightening the entire universe in the form of the sun, the form of Siva, IiSana, moves about in the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातं शिवं बुद्ध्वा जहर्ष भुवनेश्वरः । मुहुर्मुहुश्च सद्बुद्ध्या परं तं समचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: sadyojAtaM shivaM buddhvA jaharSha bhuvaneshvaraH | muhurmuhushcha sadbuddhyA paraM taM samachintayat
verses.translation: The eight forms of lord Siva constitute the five gross material elements, the soul, the sun and the moon. Each form stands is relation to iu constituents as follows t—
verses.hindi: अर्धनारीनरका रूप धारणकर ब्रह्माके पास गये

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽस्य ध्यायतः श्वेताः प्रादुर्भूता यशस्विनः । कुमाराः परविज्ञानपरब्रह्मस्वरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: tato.asya dhyAyataH shvetAH prAdurbhUtA yashasvinaH | kumArAH paravij~nAnaparabrahmasvarUpiNaH
verses.translation: The moon of ncctarlike rays that strengthens and fattens the universe to satiety, is the form of lord iSiva called Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Should the slaughter or captivity of a person be carried out, undoubtedly it is an offence committed against the eight-formed lord Siva.
verses.hindi: तुम्हें इच्छित वरदान दे रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Should the slaughter or captivity of a person be carried out, undoubtedly it is an offence committed against the eight-formed lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२. द्वितीयोऽध्यायः । शिवाष्टमूर्त्तिवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात महेशस्यावतारान्परमान्प्रभो । सर्वकार्यकराँल्लोके सर्वस्य सुखदां मुने
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.2\. dvitIyo.adhyAyaH | shivAShTamUrttivarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | shR^iNu tAta maheshasyAvatArAnparamAnprabho | sarvakAryakarA.Nlloke sarvasya sukhadAM mune
verses.translation: Worship Siva who presides over the universe in the eightfold forms with all devotion. Worship Rudra, the great cause.

verses.sanskrit: सन्दीपयञ्जगत्सर्वं दिवाकरसमाह्वयम् । ईशानाख्यं महेशस्य रूपं दिवि विसर्पति
verses.transliteration: sandIpaya~njagatsarvaM divAkarasamAhvayam | IshAnAkhyaM maheshasya rUpaM divi visarpati
verses.translation: O son of Brahma, thus the well known eight forms have been explained to you. These forms engaged in helping everyone shall be resorted to by those who seek glory.
verses.hindi: परमात्मा शिवने सभी प्रजाओंको नियुक्त किया है

verses.sanskrit: आप्याययति यो विश्वममृतांशुर्निशाकरः । महादेवस्य तद्रूपं महादेवस्य चाह्वयम्
verses.transliteration: ApyAyayati yo vishvamamR^itAMshurnishAkaraH | mahAdevasya tadrUpaM mahAdevasya chAhvayam
verses.translation: O dear one of great intellect, please listen to the description of Siva's form half-male and half-female,* than which there is nothing more excellent and which completes the work of the Creator.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा तस्याष्टमं रूपं शिवस्य परमात्मनः । व्यापिकेतरमूर्तीनां विश्वं तस्माच्छिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: AtmA tasyAShTamaM rUpaM shivasya paramAtmanaH | vyApiketaramUrtInAM vishvaM tasmAchChivAtmakam
verses.translation: When the subjects created by the Creator did not multiply, he was very much distressed and worried.
verses.hindi: आप अखिलेश्वरीसे प्रार्थना कर रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: शाखाः पुष्यन्ति वृक्षस्य वृक्षमूलस्य सेचनात् । तद्वदस्य वपुर्विश्वं पुष्यते च शिवार्चनात्
verses.transliteration: shAkhAH puShyanti vR^ikShasya vR^ikShamUlasya sechanAt | tadvadasya vapurvishvaM puShyate cha shivArchanAt
verses.translation: Then a celestial voice said—''Carry on the creation produced by couples.*' On hearing it, Brahma pondered over the creation produced by couples in order to carry it out.

verses.sanskrit: यथेह पुत्रपौत्रादेः प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवेत्पिता । तथा विश्वस्य सम्प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: yatheha putrapautrAdeH prItyA prIto bhavetpitA | tathA vishvasya samprItyA prIto bhavati sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: Since no generation of women had formerly come out of Isana, the lotus-born deity (Brahma) was unable to produce the creation by means of copulation.

verses.sanskrit: क्रियते यस्य कस्यापि देहिनो यदि निग्रहः । अष्टमूर्तेरनिष्टं तत्कृतमेव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: kriyate yasya kasyApi dehino yadi nigrahaH | aShTamUrteraniShTaM tatkR^itameva na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Brahma then began to perform penance thinking "Without the power of 6iva, the subjects will not be born."

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमूर्त्यात्मना विश्वमधिष्ठायास्थितं शिवम् । भजस्व सर्वभावेन रुद्रं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: aShTamUrtyAtmanA vishvamadhiShThAyAsthitaM shivam | bhajasva sarvabhAvena rudraM paramakAraNam
verses.translation: Within his heart he pondered lovingly over lord Siva united with the great Sakti called Siva. He then per¬ formed great penance.

verses.sanskrit: इति प्रोक्ताः स्वरूपास्ते विधिपुत्राष्टविश्रुताः । सर्वोपकारनिरताः सेव्याः श्रेयोऽर्थिभिर्नरैः
verses.transliteration: iti proktAH svarUpAste vidhiputrAShTavishrutAH | sarvopakAraniratAH sevyAH shreyo.arthibhirnaraiH
verses.translation: Ere long Siva became satisfied with the severe penance of the self-born lord Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य शम्भोः परेशस्य मूर्त्यष्टकमयं जगत् । तस्मिन्व्याप्य स्थितं विश्वं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
verses.transliteration: tasya shambhoH pareshasya mUrtyaShTakamayaM jagat | tasminvyApya sthitaM vishvaM sUtre maNigaNA iva
verses.translation: Then assuming the wish-yielding form of Isana—the perfect consciousness, and in the guise of half-male and half- female form Siva approached Brahma.
verses.hindi: और प्रभु शिव भी अन्तर्धान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: शर्वो भवस्तथा रुद्र उग्रो भीमः पशोः पतिः । ईशानश्च महादेवो मूर्तयश्चाष्ट विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: sharvo bhavastathA rudra ugro bhImaH pashoH patiH | IshAnashcha mahAdevo mUrtayashchAShTa vishrutAH
verses.translation: On seeing lord Siva united with great Sakti and bowing to him prostrate, Brahma eulogised him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: भूम्यम्भोऽग्निमरुद्व्योमक्षेत्रज्ञार्कनिशाकराः । अधिष्ठिताश्च शर्वाद्यैरष्टरूपैः शिवस्य हि
verses.transliteration: bhUmyambho.agnimarudvyomakShetraj~nArkanishAkarAH | adhiShThitAshcha sharvAdyairaShTarUpaiH shivasya hi
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord Siva, ihc creator of the universe, spoke in words majestic in sound like that of rumb¬ ling cloud.
verses.hindi: स भुक्त्वा सकलान्भोगान्प्रयाति परमां गतिम्॥ ३१  प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: धत्ते चराचरं विश्वं रूपं विश्वम्भरात्मकम् । शङ्करस्य महेशस्य शास्त्रस्यैवेति निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: dhatte charAcharaM vishvaM rUpaM vishvambharAtmakam | sha~Nkarasya maheshasya shAstrasyaiveti nishchayaH
verses.translation: "O dear son of great fortune, O grandfather, I have understood correctly all that you have cherished in your mind.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शिवस्याद्धनारीश्वरावतारवर्णन॑ नाम तृतीयो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: सञ्जीवनं समस्तस्य जगतः सलिलात्मकम् । भव इत्युच्यते रूपं भवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sa~njIvanaM samastasya jagataH salilAtmakam | bhava ityuchyate rUpaM bhavasya paramAtmanaH
verses.translation: After saying these naturally sweet and magnani¬ mous words, lord Siva detached Siva from his body.
verses.hindi: अवतारका वर्णन नामक तीसरा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: बहिरन्तर्जगद्विश्वं बिभर्ति स्पन्दते स्वयम् । उग्र इत्युच्यते सद्भी रूपमुग्रस्य सत्प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: bahirantarjagadvishvaM bibharti spandate svayam | ugra ityuchyate sadbhI rUpamugrasya satprabhoH
verses.translation: On seeing that great Sakti, detached separately from Siva, Brahma bowed to her politely and requested her.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वावकाशदं सर्वव्यापकं गगनात्मकम् । रूपं भीमस्य भीमाख्यं भूपवृन्दस्व भेदकम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAvakAshadaM sarvavyApakaM gaganAtmakam | rUpaM bhImasya bhImAkhyaM bhUpavR^indasva bhedakam
verses.translation: *'0 Siy3, I cfcafcil' at first your husband

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मनामधिष्ठानं सर्वक्षेत्रनिवासकम् । रूपं पशुपतेर्ज्ञेयं पशुपाशनिकृन्तनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAtmanAmadhiShThAnaM sarvakShetranivAsakam | rUpaM pashupaterj~neyaM pashupAshanikR^intanam
verses.translation: O Siva, the gods and others were mentally created by me. But they do not multiply themselves. Hence they are being created again and again.
verses.hindi: द्वापर युगके अन्तमें अवतार ग्रहण करूँगा

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The unchanging generation of women has not come out of you before. Hence I do not have the power to create women.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The unchanging generation of women has not come out of you before. Hence I do not have the power to create women.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.३. तृतीयोऽध्यायः । शिवस्यार्द्धनारीश्वरावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात महाप्राज्ञ विधिकामप्रपूरकम् । अर्द्धनारीनराख्यं हि शिवरूपमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.3\. tR^itIyo.adhyAyaH | shivasyArddhanArIshvarAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | shR^iNu tAta mahAprAj~na vidhikAmaprapUrakam | arddhanArInarAkhyaM hi shivarUpamanuttamam
verses.translation: All Saktis spring up from you. Hence I request you the great Sakti, the goddess of all.

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवो महादेवो वाचा मेघगभीरया । सम्भवाय सुसम्प्रीतो विश्वकर्ता महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: atha devo mahAdevo vAchA meghagabhIrayA | sambhavAya susamprIto vishvakartA maheshvaraH
verses.translation: O Siva, O mother, O beloved of Siva, for the in¬ crease of the mobile and immobile beings of the universe, give me the pov/er to create women. Obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: दुन्दुभि: शतरूपश्च हृषीकः केतुमांस्तथा॥ १२ केतुमान् नामक वेदज्ञ ब्राह्मण मेरे शिष्य होंगे

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । वत्स वत्स महाभाग मम पुत्र पितामह । ज्ञातवानस्मि सर्वं तत्तत्त्वतस्ते मनोरथम्
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | vatsa vatsa mahAbhAga mama putra pitAmaha | j~nAtavAnasmi sarvaM tattattvataste manoratham
verses.translation: O goddess bestowing boons, I request for another boon from you. O mother of the universe, take pity on me and grant that too unto me. Obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: पापनाशन नामक मेरे चार पुत्र (शिष्य) होंगे

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानामेव वृद्ध्यर्थं तपस्तप्तं त्वयाधुना । तपसा तेन तुष्टोऽस्मि ददामि च तवेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: prajAnAmeva vR^iddhyarthaM tapastaptaM tvayAdhunA | tapasA tena tuShTo.asmi dadAmi cha tavepsitam
verses.translation: O omnipresent mother, be born as the daughter of Daka, my son, for the increase of the mobile and im¬ mobile beings through only I5a."
verses.hindi: त्याग दिया था, पुन: जीवित कर दिया था

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा परमोदारं स्वभावमधुरं वचः । पृथक्चकार वपुषो भागाद्देवीं शिवां शिवः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA paramodAraM svabhAvamadhuraM vachaH | pR^ithakchakAra vapuSho bhAgAddevIM shivAM shivaH
verses.translation: Thus implored by the Creator, the Supreme goddess consented and bestowed that power upon the Creator.
verses.hindi: अंशसे उत्पन्न ऋषभ पुन: सहसा उसके घर गये

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा परमां शक्तिं पृथग्भूतां शिवागताम् । प्रणिपत्य विनीतात्मा प्रार्थयामास तां विधिः
verses.transliteration: tAM dR^iShTvA paramAM shaktiM pR^ithagbhUtAM shivAgatAm | praNipatya vinItAtmA prArthayAmAsa tAM vidhiH
verses.translation: Hence that goddess Siva, the Sakti of Siva consti¬ tuting the universe, created a Sakti equal in lustre unto her self, from the middle of her eyebrows.
verses.hindi: किया, जो शत्रुओंके विनाशमें समर्थ था

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । देवदेवेन सृष्टोऽहमादौ त्वत्पतिना शिवे । प्रजाः सर्वा नियुक्ताश्च शम्भुना परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | devadevena sR^iShTo.ahamAdau tvatpatinA shive | prajAH sarvA niyuktAshcha shambhunA paramAtmanA
verses.translation: Siva, the foremost among gods, the ocean of mercy, the great Iana indulging in divine sports saw that Sakti and laughingly spoke to her.
verses.hindi: हाथियोंका बल भी उसे प्रदान किया

verses.sanskrit: मनसा निर्मिताः सर्वे शिवे देवादयो मया । न वृद्धिमुपगच्छन्ति सृज्यमानाः पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: manasA nirmitAH sarve shive devAdayo mayA | na vR^iddhimupagachChanti sR^ijyamAnAH punaHpunaH
verses.translation: "O goddess, yon have been propitiated by Brahma, through his penance. Lovingly become pleased with him and fulfil his desires."

verses.sanskrit: मिथुनप्रभवामेव कृत्वा सृष्टिमतः परम् । संवर्द्धयितुमिच्छामि सर्वा एव मम प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: mithunaprabhavAmeva kR^itvA sR^iShTimataH param | saMvarddhayitumichChAmi sarvA eva mama prajAH
verses.translation: Receiving that behest of lord Siva with her bent head, the goddess became the daughter of Daka on the im¬ portunity of Brahma.
verses.hindi: स्वर्ग्य यशस्यमायुष्यं श्रोतव्यं च प्रयत्नत: ॥ ४८  बढ़ानेवाला है, इसे यत्लपूर्वक सुनना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: न निर्गतं पुरा त्वत्तो नारीणां कुलमव्ययम् । तेन नारीकुलं स्रष्टुं मम शक्तिर्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: na nirgataM purA tvatto nArINAM kulamavyayam | tena nArIkulaM sraShTuM mama shaktirna vidyate
verses.translation: O sage, after giving the unequalled power to Brahma, the goddess Siva entered the body of Siva. And lord Siva vanished from the scene.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठृ्तीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायाग॒षभचरित्रवर्णन॑ नाम चतुर्थोड ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासामेव शक्तीनां त्वत्तः खलु समुद्भवः । तस्मात्त्वां परमां शक्तिं प्रार्थयाम्यखिलेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAsAmeva shaktInAM tvattaH khalu samudbhavaH | tasmAttvAM paramAM shaktiM prArthayAmyakhileshvarIm
verses.translation: Thus O dear, the excellent form of iSiva, half¬ male and half-female that bestows auspiciousness upon the good has been told.

verses.sanskrit: यदा सृष्टाः प्रजाः सर्वाः न व्यवर्द्धन्त वेधसा । तदा चिन्ताकुलोऽभूत्स तेन दुःखेन दुखितः
verses.transliteration: yadA sR^iShTAH prajAH sarvAH na vyavarddhanta vedhasA | tadA chintAkulo.abhUtsa tena duHkhena dukhitaH
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this pious narrative enjoys all pleasures and attains to the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: शिवे नारीकुलं स्रष्टुं शक्तिं देहि नमोऽस्तु ते । चराचरजगद्वृद्धिहेतोर्मातः शिवप्रिये
verses.transliteration: shive nArIkulaM sraShTuM shaktiM dehi namo.astu te | charAcharajagadvR^iddhihetormAtaH shivapriye
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, the story of!§iva that ever confers happiness, was gladly and lovingly narrated by Siva to Brahma.
verses.hindi: प्रलम्बक नामक चार दृढ़ब्ती मेरे शिष्य होंगे

verses.sanskrit: अन्यं त्वत्तः प्रार्थयामि वरं च वरदेश्वरि । देहि मे तं कृपां कृत्वा जगन्मातर्नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: anyaM tvattaH prArthayAmi varaM cha varadeshvari | dehi me taM kR^ipAM kR^itvA jaganmAtarnamo.astu te
verses.translation: In the seventh Varaha Kalpa, in the Vaivasvata Manvantara, the lord Kalpeivara who illuminates all the worlds will be bom as your great grandson and son of Vaivasvata Manu. O Creator, in that Manvantara all the four Yugas will take place.

verses.sanskrit: चराचरविवृद्ध्यर्थमीशेनैकेन सर्वगे । दक्षस्य मम पुत्रस्य पुत्री भव भवाम्बिके
verses.transliteration: charAcharavivR^iddhyarthamIshenaikena sarvage | dakShasya mama putrasya putrI bhava bhavAmbike
verses.translation: For the welfare of the worlds and for the benefit of the brahmins O Creator, whatever will take place in the Yuga called Dvapara, 1 foresee now.
verses.hindi: एवं शर्व नामक मेरे परम योगी चार पुत्र होंगे

verses.sanskrit: एवं संयाचिता देवी ब्रह्मणा परमेश्वरी । तथास्त्विति वचः प्रोच्य तच्छक्तिं विधये ददौ
verses.transliteration: evaM saMyAchitA devI brahmaNA parameshvarI | tathAstviti vachaH prochya tachChaktiM vidhaye dadau
verses.translation: In that first Yuga, towards the close of Dvipara and the beginning of Kali when Vyfisa is Svayamprabhu I %vill be bora as the great sage named Sveta, with a tuft, fix* the welfare of Brahmins.
verses.hindi: विरजा नामक मेरे चार श्रेष्ठ पुत्र होंगे

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्धि सा शिवा देवी शिवशक्तिर्जगन्मयी । शक्तिमेकां भ्रुवोर्मध्यात्ससर्जात्मसमप्रभाम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAddhi sA shivA devI shivashaktirjaganmayI | shaktimekAM bhruvormadhyAtsasarjAtmasamaprabhAm
verses.translation: Then O Brahmfi, on the mountain Chfigala—the beautiful summit of Himavat, will be bora my disciples en¬ dowed with tuft.
verses.hindi: और श्रविष्कट नामक मेरे चार पुत्र होंगे

verses.sanskrit: तामाह प्रहसन्प्रेक्ष्य शक्तिं देववरो हरः । कृपासिन्धुर्महेशानो लीलाकारी भवाम्बिकाम्
verses.transliteration: tAmAha prahasanprekShya shaktiM devavaro haraH | kR^ipAsindhurmaheshAno lIlAkArI bhavAmbikAm
verses.translation: Ghigala, one of file peaks of the Hitnilayai, hat aot been identified 10 far.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । तपसाराधिता देवि ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना । प्रसन्ना भव सुप्रीत्या कुरु तस्याखिलेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | tapasArAdhitA devi brahmaNA parameShThinA | prasannA bhava suprItyA kuru tasyAkhilepsitam
verses.translation: Those four disciples Sveta, Sveta4iklia, Svetava, and Svetalohita will come to my city by the Yoga of meditation.
verses.hindi: तथा प्रधिमि नामक मेरे चार पुत्र होंगे

verses.sanskrit: तामाज्ञां परमेशस्य शिरसा प्रतिगृह्य सा । ब्रह्मणो वचनाद्देवी दक्षस्य दुहिताऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tAmAj~nAM parameshasya shirasA pratigR^ihya sA | brahmaNo vachanAddevI dakShasya duhitA.abhavat
verses.translation: Realising my unchanging real form, the devotees will become devoid of birth, death and old age and will meditate on the Supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: कवि नामक मेरे चार तपस्वी पुत्र होंगे

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वैवमतुलां शक्तिं ब्रह्मणे सा शिवा मुने ।` विवेश देहं शम्भोर्हि शम्भुश्चान्तर्दधे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dattvaivamatulAM shaktiM brahmaNe sA shivA mune |` vivesha dehaM shambhorhi shambhushchAntardadhe prabhuH
verses.translation: O dear Pitamaha, except through meditation I can¬ not be seen by men by resorting to charitable gifts and sacred rites that bring about the bondage of Karman.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन्स्त्रिया भागः प्रकल्पितः । आनन्दं प्राप स विधिः सृष्टिर्जाता च मैथुनी
verses.transliteration: tadAprabhR^iti loke.asminstriyA bhAgaH prakalpitaH | AnandaM prApa sa vidhiH sR^iShTirjAtA cha maithunI
verses.translation: In the second aeon of Dvapara when the patriarch Satya becomes Vyasa I will be bom as SutSra and continue to live in Kali age.
verses.hindi: नामक मेरे चार तपस्वी शिष्य होंगे

verses.sanskrit: नभोवाणी तदाभूद्वै सृष्टिं मिथुनजां कुरु । तच्छ्रुत्वा मैथुनीं सृष्टिं ब्रह्मा कर्तुममन्यत
verses.transliteration: nabhovANI tadAbhUdvai sR^iShTiM mithunajAM kuru | tachChrutvA maithunIM sR^iShTiM brahmA kartumamanyata
verses.translation: There too my disciples will be the four Brahmins well-versed in the Vedic lore viz. Dimdubhi, Satarupa, Hfika and Ketuman.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं तात शिवरूपं महोत्तमम् । अर्द्धनारीनरार्द्धं हि महामङ्गलदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaM tAta shivarUpaM mahottamam | arddhanArInarArddhaM hi mahAma~NgaladaM satAm
verses.translation: By resorting to the Yoga of meditation all the four will go to my city and then realising my unchanging real form they will become liberated.

verses.sanskrit: एतदाख्यानमनघं यः पठेच्छृणुयादपि । स भुक्त्वा सकलान्भोगान्प्रयाति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: etadAkhyAnamanaghaM yaH paThechChR^iNuyAdapi | sa bhuktvA sakalAnbhogAnprayAti paramAM gatim
verses.translation: In the third aeon of Dvapara in the age of Bhargava Vyksa I will be bom as Damana at the outskirts of the dty.

verses.sanskrit: नारीणां कुलमीशानान्निर्गतं न पुरा यतः । ततो मैथुनजां सृष्टिं कर्तुं शेके न पद्मभूः
verses.transliteration: nArINAM kulamIshAnAnnirgataM na purA yataH | tato maithunajAM sR^iShTiM kartuM sheke na padmabhUH
verses.translation: Foul* sons will be bom of me there viz—Viiloka, Viiesa, Vipkpa and Papana<ana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभावेण विना शम्भोर्न जायेरन्निमाः प्रजाः । एवं सञ्चिन्तयन्ब्रह्मा तपः कर्त्तुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: prabhAveNa vinA shambhorna jAyerannimAH prajAH | evaM sa~nchintayanbrahmA tapaH karttuM prachakrame
verses.translation: O four-faced deity, I will help Vyasa and will propagate firmly the path of renunciation in the Kali age.

verses.sanskrit: शिवया परया शक्त्या संयुक्तं परमेश्वरम् । सञ्चिन्त्य हृदये प्रीत्या तेपे स परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: shivayA parayA shaktyA saMyuktaM parameshvaram | sa~nchintya hR^idaye prItyA tepe sa paramaM tapaH
verses.translation: In the fourth aeon of Dvkpara in the age of Angi- ras Vyasa, I shall be bora as Suhotra.
verses.hindi: उन्‍नीस अवतारोंका वर्णन नामक पाँचवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तीव्रेण तपसा तस्य संयुक्तस्य स्वयम्भुवः । अचिरेणैव कालेन तुतोष स शिवो द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tIvreNa tapasA tasya saMyuktasya svayambhuvaH | achireNaiva kAlena tutoSha sa shivo drutam
verses.translation: There also four sons will be bom of me all aspiring after the Yogic path and noble-souled. O Brahmfi, 1 shall mention their names.
verses.hindi: चाहता हूँ, अत: आप मुझे बतानेकी कृपा करें

verses.sanskrit: ततः पूर्णचिदीशस्य मूर्तिमाविश्य कामदाम् । अर्द्धनारीनरो भूत्वा ततो ब्रह्मान्तिकं हरः
verses.transliteration: tataH pUrNachidIshasya mUrtimAvishya kAmadAm | arddhanArInaro bhUtvA tato brahmAntikaM haraH
verses.translation: They are Sumukha, Durmukha, Durdarbha and Duratikrama. O Brahma, I shall then render help to Vyksa through the disciples.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा शङ्करं देवं शक्त्या परमयान्वितम् । प्रणम्य दण्डवद्ब्रह्मा स तुष्टाव कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA sha~NkaraM devaM shaktyA paramayAnvitam | praNamya daNDavadbrahmA sa tuShTAva kR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: In die fiflh aeon of Dvkpara there will be Savitf Vyksa. I shall be born as a Yogin of great penance and called Kafika.
verses.hindi: हूँ। अत: है मुनिशार्दूल! आप वर माँगें

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: They are Sanaka, Sanktana, Sanandana and Sanat- kumkra freed from sin and egotism.
verses.hindi: अमर तथा उत्तम ब्रतवाले पुत्रकी कामना करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: They are Sanaka, Sanktana, Sanandana and Sanat- kumkra freed from sin and egotism.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.४. चतुर्थोऽध्यायः । ऋषभचरित्रवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ चरितं शाङ्करं मुदा । रुद्रेण कथितं प्रीत्या ब्रह्मणे सुखदं सदा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.4\. chaturtho.adhyAyaH | R^iShabhacharitravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | sanatkumAra sarvaj~na charitaM shA~NkaraM mudA | rudreNa kathitaM prItyA brahmaNe sukhadaM sadA
verses.translation: There also O Brahma, I, named Kahka, enhancing the path of renunciation shall render help to Vyasa in the form of Savitr.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टुं शक्यो नरैर्नाहमृते ध्यानात्पितामह । दानधर्मादिभिर्वत्स साधनैः कर्महेतुभिः
verses.transliteration: draShTuM shakyo narairnAhamR^ite dhyAnAtpitAmaha | dAnadharmAdibhirvatsa sAdhanaiH karmahetubhiH
verses.translation: When the sixth aeon of Dvapara takes place there will be Mrtyu Vyasa who will classify the Vedas.
verses.hindi: अयोनिज पुत्र प्राप्त हो सकता है

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीये द्वापरे व्यासः सत्यो नाम प्रजापतिः । यदा तदा भविष्यामि सुतारो नामतः कलौ
verses.transliteration: dvitIye dvApare vyAsaH satyo nAma prajApatiH | yadA tadA bhaviShyAmi sutAro nAmataH kalau
verses.translation: Then I will be born as Lokaksi, making the path of renunciation flourish and helping Vyasa.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मे भविष्यन्ति शिष्या वेदविदो द्विजाः । दुन्दुभिः शतरूपश्च हृषीकः केतुमांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tatrApi me bhaviShyanti shiShyA vedavido dvijAH | dundubhiH shatarUpashcha hR^iShIkaH ketumAMstathA
verses.translation: Four disciples of steady rites viz. Sudhama, Virajas, Sahjaya and Vijaya will be born then.
verses.hindi: करके देवताओंके साथ अपने लोकको चले गये

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारो ध्यानयोगात्ते गमिष्यन्ति पुरं मम । ततो मुक्ता भविष्यन्ति ज्ञात्वा मां तत्त्वतोऽव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: chatvAro dhyAnayogAtte gamiShyanti puraM mama | tato muktA bhaviShyanti j~nAtvA mAM tattvato.avyayam
verses.translation: O Brahma, in the seventh aeon of Satakratu Vyasa I shall be born as the lord Jaigi§avya.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीये द्वापरे चैव यदा व्यासस्तु भार्गवः । तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि दमनस्तु युगान्तिके
verses.transliteration: tR^itIye dvApare chaiva yadA vyAsastu bhArgavaH | tadApyahaM bhaviShyAmi damanastu yugAntike
verses.translation: Seated on a Kusa mat in a divine spot in the middle of a mountain-cavern in Kai, I, an expert in the great Yoga, will stabilise the path of Yoga.
verses.hindi: क्षणके समान बीत गये, यह आश्चर्यजनक था

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि च भविष्यन्ति चत्वारो मम पुत्रकाः । विशोकश्च विशेषश्च विपापः पापनाशनः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi cha bhaviShyanti chatvAro mama putrakAH | vishokashcha visheShashcha vipApaH pApanAshanaH
verses.translation: O Brahma, I shall render help to latakratu Vyasa I shall lift up the devotees from the fear of worldly existence.
verses.hindi: शिलादकी हड्डियाँ ही बची रह गयी थीं

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यैः साहायं व्यासस्य करिष्ये चतुरानन । निवृत्तिमार्गं सुदृढं वर्त्तयिष्ये कलाविह
verses.transliteration: shiShyaiH sAhAyaM vyAsasya kariShye chaturAnana | nivR^ittimArgaM sudR^iDhaM varttayiShye kalAviha
verses.translation: There also in that aeon, four sons will be born of me viz. Sarasvata, Yogisa, Meghavaha and Suvahana.
verses.hindi: रखनेवाले नहीं प्राप्त कर सकते हैं

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थे द्वापरे चैव यदा व्यासोंऽगिरा स्मृतः । तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि सुहोत्रो नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: chaturthe dvApare chaiva yadA vyAsoM.agirA smR^itaH | tadApyahaM bhaviShyAmi suhotro nAma nAmataH
verses.translation: In the eighth aeon there will be Vasisfha Veda- vyasa—the excellent sage who will classify thfc Vedas.
verses.hindi: किया, तब मुनिश्रेष्ठ शिलादने तपस्या छोड़ी

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते पुत्राश्चत्वारो योगसाधकाः । भविष्यन्ति महात्मानस्तन्नामानि ब्रुवे विधे
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te putrAshchatvAro yogasAdhakAH | bhaviShyanti mahAtmAnastannAmAni bruve vidhe
verses.translation: There I will be born as Dadhivahana by name. As the foremost among those who know Yoga I will render help to Vyasa.
verses.hindi: करके शिलादमुनि उनके चरणोंपर गिर पड़े

verses.sanskrit: सुमुखो दुर्मुखश्चैव दुर्दमो दुरतिक्रमः । शिष्यैः साहायं व्यासस्य करिष्येऽहं तदा विधे
verses.transliteration: sumukho durmukhashchaiva durdamo duratikramaH | shiShyaiH sAhAyaM vyAsasya kariShye.ahaM tadA vidhe
verses.translation: Four sons, all Yogins on a par with me, viz— Kapila, Asuri, Salvala and Pancaikha will be born of me.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । सप्तमे चैव वाराहे कल्पे मन्वन्तराभिधे । कल्पेश्वरोऽथ भगवान्सर्वलोकप्रकाशनः
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | saptame chaiva vArAhe kalpe manvantarAbhidhe | kalpeshvaro.atha bhagavAnsarvalokaprakAshanaH
verses.translation: O Brahma, in the ninth aeon of the same Yuga, there will be Sarasvata Vyasa, the excellent sage.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमे द्वापरे चैव व्यासस्तु सविता स्मृतः । तदा योगी भविष्यामि कङ्को नाम महातपाः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchame dvApare chaiva vyAsastu savitA smR^itaH | tadA yogI bhaviShyAmi ka~Nko nAma mahAtapAH
verses.translation: As Vyasa sits in meditation for the flourish of the path of renunciation, I will be born as Rbha.
verses.hindi: ही अयोनिज और मृत्युहीन पुत्र चाहता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते पुत्राश्चत्वारो योगसाधकाः । भविष्यन्ति महात्मानस्तन्नामानि शृणुष्व मे
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te putrAshchatvAro yogasAdhakAH | bhaviShyanti mahAtmAnastannAmAni shR^iNuShva me
verses.translation: There, Parasara, Garga, Bhargava and GiriSa, all good Yogins, will be my four disciples.

verses.sanskrit: सनकः सनातनश्चैव प्रभुर्यश्च सनन्दनः । विभुः सनत्कुमारश्च निर्मलो निरहङ्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: sanakaH sanAtanashchaiva prabhuryashcha sanandanaH | vibhuH sanatkumArashcha nirmalo niraha~NkR^itiH
verses.translation: O Patriarch, with them I will stabilise the path of Yoga. O good sage, I will render help to Vedavyasa.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि कङ्कनामाहं साहाय्यं सवितुर्विधे । व्यासस्य हि करिष्यामि निवृत्तिपथवर्द्धकः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi ka~NkanAmAhaM sAhAyyaM saviturvidhe | vyAsasya hi kariShyAmi nivR^ittipathavarddhakaH
verses.translation: O Brahma, in that form, 1, the merciful, will cause the uplift of many distressed devotees, from the worldly existence.
verses.hindi: दयालु शिव वहीं अन्तर्हित हो गये

verses.sanskrit: परिवर्त्ते पुनः षष्ठे द्वापरे लोककारकः । कर्ता वेदविभागस्य मृत्युर्व्यासो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: parivartte punaH ShaShThe dvApare lokakArakaH | kartA vedavibhAgasya mR^ityurvyAso bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Bhadrayu a prince who had been abandoned by his father and who had died of poison infection, was resus¬ citated by me in that incarnation.

verses.sanskrit: तदाऽप्यहं भविष्यामि लोकाक्षिर्नाम नामतः । व्यासस्य सुसहायार्थं निवृत्तिपथवर्द्धनः
verses.transliteration: tadA.apyahaM bhaviShyAmi lokAkShirnAma nAmataH | vyAsasya susahAyArthaM nivR^ittipathavarddhanaH
verses.translation: When that prince reached his sixteenth year I as Rsabha, went to his mansion suddenly.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि शिष्याश्चत्वारो भविष्यन्ति दृढव्रताः । सुधामा विरजाश्चैव सञ्जयो विजयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tatrApi shiShyAshchatvAro bhaviShyanti dR^iDhavratAH | sudhAmA virajAshchaiva sa~njayo vijayastathA
verses.translation: O patriarch, being duly worshipped by him, that sage, of good form, the store-house of mercy instructed him in virtues in connection with the administration of his kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तमे परिवर्त्ते तु यदा व्यासः शतक्रतुः । तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि जैगीषव्यो विभुर्विधे
verses.transliteration: saptame parivartte tu yadA vyAsaH shatakratuH | tadApyahaM bhaviShyAmi jaigIShavyo vibhurvidhe
verses.translation: Becoming excessively delighted, he gave him a divine conch and a lustruous sword that could destroy his enemies.

verses.sanskrit: योगं सन्द्रढयिष्यामि महायोगविचक्षणः । काश्यां गुहान्तरे संस्थो दिव्यदेशे कुशास्तरिः
verses.transliteration: yogaM sandraDhayiShyAmi mahAyogavichakShaNaH | kAshyAM guhAntare saMstho divyadeshe kushAstariH
verses.translation: The lord, favourably disposed to the indigent, smeared his body with the ashes from his own body and gave him the strength of twelve thousand elephants.

verses.sanskrit: साहाय्यं च करिष्यामि व्यासस्य हि शतक्रतोः । उद्धरिष्यामि भक्तांश्च संसारभयतो विधे
verses.transliteration: sAhAyyaM cha kariShyAmi vyAsasya hi shatakratoH | uddhariShyAmi bhaktAMshcha saMsArabhayato vidhe
verses.translation: After consoling Bhadrayus and his mother very well, lord R$abha after being duly worshipped by them went as he pleased.
verses.hindi: मुझे देखनेके लिये उनके आश्रमपर आये

verses.sanskrit: मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यैव ते प्रपुत्रो भविष्यति । तदा चतुर्युगाश्चैव तस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे विधे
verses.transliteration: manorvaivasvatasyaiva te praputro bhaviShyati | tadA chaturyugAshchaiva tasminmanvantare vidhe
verses.translation: O Brahma, the saintly king Bhadrayus conquered all his enemies, married Kirtimalini and virtuously ruled the kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम चत्वारो भविष्यन्ति सुता युगे । सारस्वतश्च योगीशो मेघवाहः सुवाहनः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama chatvAro bhaviShyanti sutA yuge | sArasvatashcha yogIsho meghavAhaH suvAhanaH
verses.translation: Thus the ninth Rsabha incarnation of!§iva has been narrated to you. He is the goal of the good and kinsman of the indigent.
verses.hindi: आयु हमलोग देख नहीं पा रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमे परिवर्त्ते हि वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः । कर्त्ता वेदविभागस्य वेदव्यासो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: aShTame parivartte hi vasiShTho munisattamaH | karttA vedavibhAgasya vedavyAso bhaviShyati
verses.translation: In the tenth aeon of Dvapara there will be Tridhama Vyasa on the excellent Bhfgutunga peak of Himavat.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राप्यहं भविष्यामि नामतो दधिवाहनः । व्यासस्य हि करिष्यामि साहाय्यं योगवित्तम
verses.transliteration: tatrApyahaM bhaviShyAmi nAmato dadhivAhanaH | vyAsasya hi kariShyAmi sAhAyyaM yogavittama
verses.translation: There my sons weU>versed in the Vedic lore are Bhniiga and others i.e. Balabandhu, Nara, Mitra and Jhe sage Keturg*

verses.sanskrit: कपिलश्चासुरिः पञ्चशिखः शाल्वलपूर्वकः । चत्वारो योगिनः पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति समा मम
verses.transliteration: kapilashchAsuriH pa~nchashikhaH shAlvalapUrvakaH | chatvAro yoginaH putrA bhaviShyanti samA mama
verses.translation: In the eleventh aeon of Dvapara when there will be Trivfta VySsa I shall be born as Kali at GaAgIdvara.*
verses.hindi: कौन दूर करेगा, मैं उसकी शरणमें जाऊँ

verses.sanskrit: नवमे परिवर्त्ते तु तस्मिन्नेव युगे विधे । भविष्यति मुनिश्रेष्ठो व्यासः सारस्वताह्वयः
verses.transliteration: navame parivartte tu tasminneva yuge vidhe | bhaviShyati munishreShTho vyAsaH sArasvatAhvayaH
verses.translation: There also the four sons of steady rites viz. Lambo- dara, Lambaka, KeiSalamba and Pralambaka will be bom.
verses.hindi: हूं, यह सच कह रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: व्यासस्य ध्यायतस्तस्य निवृत्तिपथवृद्धये । तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि ऋषभो नामतः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: vyAsasya dhyAyatastasya nivR^ittipathavR^iddhaye | tadApyahaM bhaviShyAmi R^iShabho nAmataH smR^itaH
verses.translation: O great sage, these four sons of good yogic skill will be born as my sons viz. Sarvajfta, Samabuddhi, Sadhya and Sarva.
verses.hindi: जिससे तुम मेरे इस दारुण दुःखको दूर करोगे 2

verses.sanskrit: पराशरश्च गर्गश्च भार्गवो गिरिशस्तथा । चत्वारस्तत्र शिष्या मे भविष्यन्ति सुयोगिनः
verses.transliteration: parAsharashcha gargashcha bhArgavo girishastathA | chatvArastatra shiShyA me bhaviShyanti suyoginaH
verses.translation: In the thirteenth aeon, there will be Narayana Vyasa. Then I shall be born as the great sage Bali.
verses.hindi: प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य॒ च तमगच्छ॑ बनमुत्तमम्॥ ६२  करके उत्तम वनकी ओर चला गया

verses.sanskrit: तैः साकं द्रढयिष्यामि योगमार्गं प्रजापते । करिष्यामि सहायं वै वेदव्यासस्य सन्मुने
verses.transliteration: taiH sAkaM draDhayiShyAmi yogamArgaM prajApate | kariShyAmi sahAyaM vai vedavyAsasya sanmune
verses.translation: In the hermitage of Balakhilyas on the excellent mountain of Gandhamadana,*' the auspicious sons will be Sudhama, KaiSyapa, Varsi$tha and Virajas.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिक्महाएुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां नन्दिकेशावतारवर्णन॑ नाम षष्ठो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तेन रूपेण भक्तानां बहूनां दुःखिनां विधे । उद्धारं भवतोऽहं वै करिष्यामि दयाकरः
verses.transliteration: tena rUpeNa bhaktAnAM bahUnAM duHkhinAM vidhe | uddhAraM bhavato.ahaM vai kariShyAmi dayAkaraH
verses.translation: In the fourteenth aeon, there will be Raksa Vyasa, I shall be born as Gautama, in the family of Angiras.
verses.hindi: ॥ इस प्रकार शिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत तृतीय शतरुद्रसंहितामें नन्दिकेशावतारवर्णन नामक छठा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: सोऽवतारो विधे मे हि ऋषभाख्यः सुयोगकृत् । सारस्वतव्यासमनःकर्त्ता नानोतिकारकः
verses.transliteration: so.avatAro vidhe me hi R^iShabhAkhyaH suyogakR^it | sArasvatavyAsamanaHkarttA nAnotikArakaH
verses.translation: In the Kali age my sons will be Atri, Devasada, Sravaria and I§ravi 9 kata.
verses.hindi: करने लगा, जो मुनिजनोंके लिये भी असाध्य है

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहार्थं लोकानां ब्राह्मणानां हिताय च । उत्पत्स्यामि विधे ब्रह्मन्द्वापराख्ययुगान्तिके
verses.transliteration: anugrahArthaM lokAnAM brAhmaNAnAM hitAya cha | utpatsyAmi vidhe brahmandvAparAkhyayugAntike
verses.translation: In the fifteenth aeon of Dvapara, there will be Trayyarum Vyasa. I shall be bom as Vedsdiras with a power¬ ful weapon. Vedaira is a mountain on the top of Himavat on the northern bank of Sarasvad.

verses.sanskrit: अवतारेण मे येन भद्रायुर्नृपबालकः । जीवितो हि मृतः क्ष्वेडदोषतो जनकोज्झितः
verses.transliteration: avatAreNa me yena bhadrAyurnR^ipabAlakaH | jIvito hi mR^itaH kShveDadoShato janakojjhitaH
verses.translation: There the four viz. Kuni, Kunibahu, Kuarira and Kunetraka will be my sturdy sons.
verses.hindi: विनाश करनेवाले उन परमेश्वरकी स्तुति की

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तेऽथ षोडशे वर्षे तस्य राजशिशोः पुनः । ययौ तद्वेश्म सहसा ऋषभः स मदात्मकः
verses.transliteration: prApte.atha ShoDashe varShe tasya rAjashishoH punaH | yayau tadveshma sahasA R^iShabhaH sa madAtmakaH
verses.translation: In the sixteenth aeon, there will be Deva Vyasa; I shall be born as Gokara for imparting instructions in Yoga.
verses.hindi: हो जाओ'--ऐसा कहा और उसे छिड़क दिया

verses.sanskrit: पूजितस्तेन स मुनिः सद्रूपश्च कृपानिधिः । उपादिदेश तद्धर्मान् राजयोगान्प्रजापते
verses.transliteration: pUjitastena sa muniH sadrUpashcha kR^ipAnidhiH | upAdidesha taddharmAn rAjayogAnprajApate
verses.translation: They are KSyapa, Uanas, Gyavana and Brhaspati. They too will go to the abode of iSiva through the same path.
verses.hindi: जम्बुनदी--ये पाँच नदियाँ कही गयी हैं

verses.sanskrit: ततः स कवचं दिव्यं शङ्खं खङ्गं च भास्वरम् । ददौ तस्मै प्रसन्नात्मा सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa kavachaM divyaM sha~NkhaM kha~NgaM cha bhAsvaram | dadau tasmai prasannAtmA sarvashatruvinAshanam
verses.translation: In the seventeenth aeon, there will be Devakftah- jaya Vylsa. I shall be bom in the name of Guhavasin. There is a snow-covered Siva temple on the lofty summit*® of Himavat. The sons are Utathya, Vamadeva, Mahayoga and MahSbala.
verses.hindi: प्राप्ति होती है, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: तदङ्ग भस्मनामृश्य कृपया दीनवत्सलः । स द्वादशसहस्रस्य गजानां च बलं ददौ
verses.transliteration: tada~Nga bhasmanAmR^ishya kR^ipayA dInavatsalaH | sa dvAdashasahasrasya gajAnAM cha balaM dadau
verses.translation: In the eighteenth aeon, there will be Rtafijaya Vyasa. I will be bom as Sikhandin on the auspicious sum¬ mit of Himavat.
verses.hindi: यह शिलादपुत्र  आजसे मेरा परम प्रिय पुत्र है

verses.sanskrit: इति भद्रायुषं सम्यगनुश्वास्य समातृकम् । ययौ स्वैरगतिस्ताभ्यां पूजितस्त्वृषभः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: iti bhadrAyuShaM samyaganushvAsya samAtR^ikam | yayau svairagatistAbhyAM pUjitastvR^iShabhaH prabhuH
verses.translation: In the very sacred holy centre of achievements there is the mountain Sikhandin, where the forest is resorted to by the Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुरपि राजर्षिर्जित्वा रिपुगणान्विधे । राज्यं चकार धर्मेण विवाह्य कीर्त्तिमालिनीम्
verses.transliteration: bhadrAyurapi rAjarShirjitvA ripugaNAnvidhe | rAjyaM chakAra dharmeNa vivAhya kIrttimAlinIm
verses.translation: These four will be born as the sons, the sages VacaSravas, Rucika, Syavasya and Yatisvara.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थम्प्रभावं ऋषभोऽवतारः शङ्करस्य मे । सतां गतिर्दीनबन्धुर्नवमः कथितस्तव
verses.transliteration: itthamprabhAvaM R^iShabho.avatAraH sha~Nkarasya me | satAM gatirdInabandhurnavamaH kathitastava
verses.translation: In the nineteenth aeon, there will be Bharadvaja Vyasa. Then I shall be born as Jatt and Malin. On the summit of Himavat, my sons will be four in number named Hiranyanama, Kaualya, Lokakin and Praghima.
verses.hindi: गणाध्यक्षोंका ईश्वर बनाओ, यह मेरी आज्ञा है

verses.sanskrit: ऋषभस्य चरित्रं हि परमं पावनं महत् । स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं श्रोतव्यं च प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: R^iShabhasya charitraM hi paramaM pAvanaM mahat | svargyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM shrotavyaM cha prayatnataH
verses.translation: In the twentieth aeon, there will be Vyasa Gautama. My name will be Att&hSsa. Men are fond of Attahasa (loud boisterous laughter).
verses.hindi: कहकर  अभिषेककी  सामग्री एकत्र करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: युगप्रवृत्त्या च तदा तस्मिंश्च प्रथमे युगे । द्वापरे प्रथमे ब्रह्मन्यदा व्यासः स्वयम्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: yugapravR^ittyA cha tadA tasmiMshcha prathame yuge | dvApare prathame brahmanyadA vyAsaH svayamprabhuH
verses.translation: On the tops of Himavat, Attahasa a great moun¬ tain which is resorted to by Gods, men, Yakas, Indra, Siddhas and Garanas.
verses.hindi: एवं अन्य सभी लोग वहाँ उपस्थित हुए

verses.sanskrit: तदाहं ब्राह्मणार्थाय कलौ तस्मिन्युगान्तिके । भविष्यामि शिवायुक्तः श्वेतो नाम महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: tadAhaM brAhmaNArthAya kalau tasminyugAntike | bhaviShyAmi shivAyuktaH shveto nAma mahAmuniH
verses.translation: There will be born of me sons, who will be experts in Yoga and will be called Sumantu, Varvari, Kabandha and Kukikandhara.
verses.hindi: दिव्य सुयशा नामक मरुत्कन्या मेरी पत्नी हुई

verses.sanskrit: हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये छागले पर्वतोत्तमे । तदा शिष्याः शिखायुक्ता भविष्यन्ति विधे मम
verses.transliteration: himavachChikhare ramye ChAgale parvatottame | tadA shiShyAH shikhAyuktA bhaviShyanti vidhe mama
verses.translation: In the twenty-first aeon when Vaca.ravas becomes Vyasa, I shall be bom as Daruka.* Hence the forest Darfivana is auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतः श्वेतशिखश्चैव श्वेताश्वः श्वेतलोहितः । चत्वारो ध्यानयोगात्ते गमिष्यन्ति पुरं मम
verses.transliteration: shvetaH shvetashikhashchaiva shvetAshvaH shvetalohitaH | chatvAro dhyAnayogAtte gamiShyanti puraM mama
verses.translation: There too, experts in Yoga, will be my sons viz. Plaka, Darbhayarii, Ketuman and Gautama.
verses.hindi: हार और अन्यान्य वस्तुएँ भी प्राप्त हुईं

verses.sanskrit: ततो भक्ता भविष्यन्ति ज्ञात्वा मां तत्त्वतोऽव्ययम् । जन्ममृत्युजराहीनाः परब्रह्मसमाधयः
verses.transliteration: tato bhaktA bhaviShyanti j~nAtvA mAM tattvato.avyayam | janmamR^ityujarAhInAH parabrahmasamAdhayaH
verses.translation: This peak of the Him&Iayas has not been identified so far.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: I shall be known as Lahgali Bhima (having plough¬ share) wheie the gods including Indra will see me in the Kali age as Bhava and Halayudha.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: I shall be known as Lahgali Bhima (having plough¬ share) wheie the gods including Indra will see me in the Kali age as Bhava and Halayudha.
verses.hindi: अभिलाषा है, उसे मैं प्रेमपूर्वक तुम्हें प्रदान करूँगा

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.५. पञ्चमोऽध्यायः । एकोनविंशतिशिवावतारवर्णनम् । शिव उवाच । दशमे द्वापरे व्यासस्त्रिधामा नामतो मुनिः । हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये भृगुतुङ्गे नगोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.5\. pa~nchamo.adhyAyaH | ekonaviMshatishivAvatAravarNanam | shiva uvAcha | dashame dvApare vyAsastridhAmA nAmato muniH | himavachChikhare ramye bhR^igutu~Nge nagottame
verses.translation: There too my sons will be virtuous viz. Bhallava, Madhu, Pihga and i§vetaketu.
verses.hindi: महाबली, मेरे भक्त एवं गणोंके अध्यक्ष होंगे

verses.sanskrit: यदा व्यासस्तु रक्षाख्यः पर्याये तु चतुर्दशे । वंश आङ्गिरसे तत्र भविताहं च गौतमः
verses.transliteration: yadA vyAsastu rakShAkhyaH paryAye tu chaturdashe | vaMsha A~Ngirase tatra bhavitAhaM cha gautamaH
