verses.translation: In the twenty-third aeon, there will be the Trna- bindu Vyasa. I shall be born as Sveta in the auspicious Kalafijara** mountain.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करेंगे। तुम्हारे लिये मैंने यह वरदान दिया

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति कलौ तदा । अत्रिर्दवशदश्चैव श्रवणोऽथ श्रविष्कटः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te putrA bhaviShyanti kalau tadA | atrirdavashadashchaiva shravaNo.atha shraviShkaTaH
verses.translation: There too my sons will be the sages—Ulika, Brha- dasva, Devala and Kavi.
verses.hindi: पुत्र। तुम मुझसे सभी अभिलषित वर माँगो

verses.sanskrit: व्यासः पञ्चदशे त्रय्यारुणिर्वै द्वापरे यदा । तदाऽहं भविता वेदशिरा वेदशिरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vyAsaH pa~nchadashe trayyAruNirvai dvApare yadA | tadA.ahaM bhavitA vedashirA vedashirastathA
verses.translation: In the twenty-fourth aeon, there will be Yak$a Vypsa. I shall be born as Sulin a great Yogin in the same Yuga in Naimia.'

verses.sanskrit: महावीर्यं तदस्त्रं च वेदशीर्षश्च पर्वतः । हिमवत्पृष्ठमासाद्य सरस्वत्यास्तथोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: mahAvIryaM tadastraM cha vedashIrShashcha parvataH | himavatpR^iShThamAsAdya sarasvatyAstathottare
verses.translation: There too my disciples will be the sages Salihotra, Agnivesa, Yuvanava and Saradvasu.
verses.hindi: और अपने पतिमें निरन्तर बनी रहेगी

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम चत्वारो भविष्यन्ति सुता दृढाः । कुणिश्च कुणिबाहुश्च कुशरीरः कुनेत्रकः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama chatvAro bhaviShyanti sutA dR^iDhAH | kuNishcha kuNibAhushcha kusharIraH kunetrakaH
verses.translation: In the twenty-fifth aeon, there will be Sakti Vyasa. I shall be the great Yogin, lord Mundivara armed with a staff.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासो युगे षोडशे तु यदा देवो भविष्यति । तदा योगप्रदानाय गोकर्णो भविता ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration: vyAso yuge ShoDashe tu yadA devo bhaviShyati | tadA yogapradAnAya gokarNo bhavitA hyaham
verses.translation: There too my disciples will be the sages Chagala, Kundakarna, Kumbhanda and Pravahaka.
verses.hindi: बैलपर सवार होकर अपने धामको गये

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव च सुपुण्यं च गोकर्णं नाम तद्वनम् । तत्रापि योगिनः पुत्र भविष्यन्त्यम्बुसम्मिताः
verses.transliteration: tatraiva cha supuNyaM cha gokarNaM nAma tadvanam | tatrApi yoginaH putra bhaviShyantyambusammitAH
verses.translation: In the twenty-sixth aeon, when Paraara, becomes Vyasa I will be bom as Sahinu after reaching the city Bhadravata.®
verses.hindi: देनेवाला एवं शिवजीमें भक्ति बढ़ानेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: काश्यपोऽप्युशनाश्चैव च्यवनोऽथ बृहस्पतिः । तेऽपि तेनैव मार्गेण गमिष्यन्ति शिवालयम्
verses.transliteration: kAshyapo.apyushanAshchaiva chyavano.atha bR^ihaspatiH | te.api tenaiva mArgeNa gamiShyanti shivAlayam
verses.translation: There too my disciples will be the sages Uluka, Vidyuta, iSambuka and Alvalayana.
verses.hindi: इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा परत्र लभते गतिम्॥ ६३  भोगकर परलोकमें मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: परिवर्त्ते सप्तदशे व्यासो देवकृतञ्जयः । गुहावासीति नाम्नाहं हिमवच्छिखरे शुभे
verses.transliteration: parivartte saptadashe vyAso devakR^ita~njayaH | guhAvAsIti nAmnAhaM himavachChikhare shubhe
verses.translation: In the twenty-seventh aeon, there will be Jatukarpya Vyasa. I shall be bom as Somaarman after resorting to the holy centre Prabhasa.'*
verses.hindi: किक... एवं विवाहवर्णन नामक सातवबाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: महालये महोत्तुङ्गे शिवक्षेत्रं हिमालयम् । उतथ्यो वामदेवश्च महायोगो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: mahAlaye mahottu~Nge shivakShetraM himAlayam | utathyo vAmadevashcha mahAyogo mahAbalaH
verses.translation: There too my disciples will be the sages Akaplda, Kumara, Uluka and Vatsa.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम पुत्राश्च भृग्वाद्याः श्रुतिसम्मिताः । बलबन्धुर्नरामित्रः केतुशृङ्गस्तपोधनः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama putrAshcha bhR^igvAdyAH shrutisammitAH | balabandhurnarAmitraH ketushR^i~NgastapodhanaH
verses.translation: See P. 266 note.
verses.hindi: मायासे मोहित मूर्खलोग उन्हें नहीं जान पाते

verses.sanskrit: परिवर्त्तेऽष्टादशे तु यदा व्यास ऋतञ्जयः । शिखण्डीनामतोऽहं तद्धिमवच्छिखरे शुभे
verses.transliteration: parivartte.aShTAdashe tu yadA vyAsa R^ita~njayaH | shikhaNDInAmato.ahaM taddhimavachChikhare shubhe
verses.translation: It has not been possible to identify this mountain.
verses.hindi: चतुर्भुजोउपि विष्णुवै चतुर्वकत्रोडपि वै विधि: ॥ ३ भी महेश्वरकी महिमाको नहीं कक पाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धक्षेत्रे महापुण्ये शिखण्डी नाम पर्वतः । शिखण्डिनो वनं वापि यत्र सिद्धनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: siddhakShetre mahApuNye shikhaNDI nAma parvataH | shikhaNDino vanaM vApi yatra siddhaniShevitam
verses.translation: Sec P. 76 note.
verses.hindi: संसारी लोग उन परमेश्वरकी पूजा नहीं करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: वाचःश्रवा रुचीकश्च श्यावास्यश्च यतीश्वरः । एते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति तत्रापि च तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: vAchaHshravA ruchIkashcha shyAvAsyashcha yatIshvaraH | ete putrA bhaviShyanti tatrApi cha tapodhanAH
verses.translation: The town has not been identified.
verses.hindi: कोई भी उन्हें नहीं जान पाता है

verses.sanskrit: एकोनविंशे व्यासस्तु भरद्वाजो महामुनिः । तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि जटी माली च नामतः
verses.transliteration: ekonaviMshe vyAsastu bharadvAjo mahAmuniH | tadApyahaM bhaviShyAmi jaTI mAlI cha nAmataH
verses.translation: In the twenty-eighth aeon of Dvapara, there will be Dvaipayana Vyasa, the son of Paraiara, and the most excellent of Puni$as shall be born as Kr$na with his one sixth part, as the foremost of the sons of Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: हिल उन्हें लोग मात्र देवता ही समझते हैं

verses.sanskrit: हिमवच्छिखरे तत्र पुत्रा मेऽम्बुधिसंहिताः । हिरण्यनामा कौशल्यो लोकाक्षी प्रधिमिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: himavachChikhare tatra putrA me.ambudhisaMhitAH | hiraNyanAmA kaushalyo lokAkShI pradhimistathA
verses.translation: 'Fhen I too shall be born with the body of a Brahmacarin and the soul of a Yogin by means of Yogic Maya to the great surprise of the worlds.
verses.hindi: न परमोत्तम और ज्ञानका कारण है

verses.sanskrit: परिवर्त्ते विंशतिमे भविता व्यास गौतमः । तत्राट्टहासनामाहमट्टहासप्रिया नराः
verses.transliteration: parivartte viMshatime bhavitA vyAsa gautamaH | tatrATTahAsanAmAhamaTTahAsapriyA narAH
verses.translation: On seeing a dead body forsaken in the crema¬ tion ground I shall enter into it and make it free from ailments by means of Yogic Maya for the welfare of the brahmins. Then I will enter the holy divine cavern of Mcru*® along with you and Visnu. O Brahma, I shall then be known as Lakulin.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव हिमवत्पृष्ठे अट्टहासो महागिरिः । देवमानुषयक्षेन्द्रसिद्धचारणसेवितः
verses.transliteration: tatraiva himavatpR^iShThe aTTahAso mahAgiriH | devamAnuShayakShendrasiddhachAraNasevitaH
verses.translation: The physical incarnation thus and the holy Siddha centre will be greatly renowned as long as the earth lasts.
verses.hindi: यथार्थ रूपसे अव्यय परम तत्त्वको बता रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति सुयोगिनः । सुमन्तुर्बर्बरिर्विद्वान् कबन्धः कुशिकन्धरः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te putrA bhaviShyanti suyoginaH | sumanturbarbarirvidvAn kabandhaH kushikandharaH
verses.translation: There too my disciples will be the sages Kuiika, Garga, Mitra and Taurusya.

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशे युगे तस्मिन् व्यासो वाचः श्रवा यदा । तदाहं दारुको नाम तस्माद्दारुवनं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: ekaviMshe yuge tasmin vyAso vAchaH shravA yadA | tadAhaM dAruko nAma tasmAddAruvanaM shubham
verses.translation: The Yogic brahmins well-versed in the Vedas, and of sublimated power will attain the Yoga of MaheSvara and reach the auspicious city.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति सुयोगिनः । प्लक्षो दार्भायणिश्चैव केतुमान् गौतमस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te putrA bhaviShyanti suyoginaH | plakSho dArbhAyaNishchaiva ketumAn gautamastathA
verses.translation: In the Vaivasvata manvantara, during all its recur¬ ring aeons, the Yogevara incarnations of the great Atman of virtuous deeds have been explained to you.
verses.hindi: किसी भी प्रकार जीवित नहीं रह सकता

verses.sanskrit: एकादशे द्वापरे तु व्यासश्च त्रिवृतो यदा । गङ्गाद्वारे कलौ नाम्ना तपोऽहं भविता तदा
verses.transliteration: ekAdashe dvApare tu vyAsashcha trivR^ito yadA | ga~NgAdvAre kalau nAmnA tapo.ahaM bhavitA tadA
verses.translation: O great lord, the Vyasas in every recurring Dvapara are twenty-eight in number. The YogeSvara incarnations at the beginning of every recurring Kali age are also so many.
verses.hindi: चारों वेदोंके पास जाकर पूछने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: द्वाविंशे परिवर्ते तु व्यासः शुष्मायणो यदा । तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि वाराणस्यां महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: dvAviMshe parivarte tu vyAsaH shuShmAyaNo yadA | tadApyahaM bhaviShyAmi vArANasyAM mahAmuniH
verses.translation: In each of the incarnations of YogeSvara, there are four disciples who make the path of Yoga flourish and who are eternal as well as great devotees of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना वै लाङ्गली भीमो यत्र देवाः सवासवाः । द्रक्ष्यन्ति मां कलौ तस्मिन्भवं चैव हलायुधम्
verses.transliteration: nAmnA vai lA~NgalI bhImo yatra devAH savAsavAH | drakShyanti mAM kalau tasminbhavaM chaiva halAyudham
verses.translation: These disciples of $iva smear their bodies with holy ashes, use the necklaces of Rudrak$a beads as their ornaments and mark their foreheads with Tripundra.
verses.hindi: पर ध कं अत: तत्त्व क्या है, इसे भलीभाति कहें

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति सुधार्मिकाः । भल्लवी मधुपिङ्गश्च श्वेतकेतुस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te putrA bhaviShyanti sudhArmikAH | bhallavI madhupi~Ngashcha shvetaketustathaiva cha
verses.translation: All the disciples arc pious and well-versed in the Vedas and Vedangas; they arc devoted both externally and internally to the worship of the phallic image of 8iva.
verses.hindi: परम तत्त्व कहते हैं, वे एकमात्र रुद्र ही हैं

verses.sanskrit: परिवर्त्ते त्रयोविंशे तृणबिन्दुर्यदा मुनिः । श्वेतो नाम तदाऽहं वै गिरौ कालञ्जरे शुभे
verses.transliteration: parivartte trayoviMshe tR^iNabinduryadA muniH | shveto nAma tadA.ahaM vai girau kAla~njare shubhe
verses.translation: By their devotion to me and by means of Yoga they arc engaged in meditation; they h»vc perfect control

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति तपस्विनः । उशिको बृहदश्वश्च देवलः कविरेव च
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te putrA bhaviShyanti tapasvinaH | ushiko bR^ihadashvashcha devalaH kavireva cha
verses.translation: Thus I have mentioned the characteristic features of
verses.hindi: एकमात्र त्यम्बक शिव ही परमतत्त्व हैं

verses.sanskrit: परिवर्त्ते चतुर्विंशे व्यासो यक्षो यदा विभुः । शूली नाम महायोगी तद्युगे नैमिषे तदा
verses.transliteration: parivartte chaturviMshe vyAso yakSho yadA vibhuH | shUlI nAma mahAyogI tadyuge naimiShe tadA
verses.translation: After saying this and blessing Brahma, the great lord of the gods glanced at him again and vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: सारा श्रेष्ठ ज्ञान नष्ट हो गया है

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते शिष्या भविष्यन्ति तपस्विनः । शालिहोत्रोऽग्निवेशश्च युवनाश्वः शरद्वसुः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te shiShyA bhaviShyanti tapasvinaH | shAlihotro.agniveshashcha yuvanAshvaH sharadvasuH
verses.translation: O lord, how did you happen to be bom of Maha- deva and gain access to 8iva I wish to hear. Please narrate everything in detail.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशे यदा व्यासः शक्तिर्नाम्ना भविष्यति । तदाप्यहं महायोगी दण्डी मुण्डीश्वरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchaviMshe yadA vyAsaH shaktirnAmnA bhaviShyati | tadApyahaM mahAyogI daNDI muNDIshvaraH prabhuH
verses.translation: O sage Sanatkumara, O omniscient one, listen with attention as to how I was bom of Mahadeva and how I gained access to 8iva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते शिष्या भविष्यन्ति तपस्विनः । छगलः कुण्डकर्णश्च कुम्भाण्डश्च प्रवाहकः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te shiShyA bhaviShyanti tapasvinaH | ChagalaH kuNDakarNashcha kumbhANDashcha pravAhakaH
verses.translation: Urged eagerly by the manes who desired their uplift 8ilada piously thought of. raising them up. He was therefore desirous of a progeny. For that he of great poten¬ tiality performed a penance with his drooping eyes. He had the same activities as the slopes. He went to Sivaloka.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासः पराशरो यर्हि षड्विंशे भविताप्यहम् । पुरं भद्रवटं प्राप्य सहिष्णुर्नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: vyAsaH parAsharo yarhi ShaDviMshe bhavitApyaham | puraM bhadravaTaM prApya sahiShNurnAma nAmataH
verses.translation: That sage iSilada performed a severe penance with Indra in view, for a long time. His mind was steady and he was stead-fast in his activities.

verses.sanskrit: लम्बोदरश्च लम्बाक्षः केशलम्बः प्रलम्बकः । तत्रापि पुत्राश्चत्वारो भविष्यन्ति दृढव्रताः
verses.transliteration: lambodarashcha lambAkShaH keshalambaH pralambakaH | tatrApi putrAshchatvAro bhaviShyanti dR^iDhavratAH
verses.translation: Indra lovingly spoke to 8illda—excellent sage, O sinless one, I am delighted with you. Therefore choose your boons.'*

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते शिष्या भविष्यन्ति तपस्विनः । उलूको विद्युतश्चैव शम्बूको ह्याश्वलायनः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te shiShyA bhaviShyanti tapasvinaH | ulUko vidyutashchaiva shambUko hyAshvalAyanaH
verses.translation: Bowing to the lord of the gods and eulogising him with holy hymns, 8iUda, the most excellent sage, told him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तविंशे यदा व्यासो जातूकर्ण्यो भविष्यति । प्रभासतीर्थमाश्रित्य सोमशर्मा तदाप्यहम्
verses.transliteration: saptaviMshe yadA vyAso jAtUkarNyo bhaviShyati | prabhAsatIrthamAshritya somasharmA tadApyaham
verses.translation: O lord of gods, O Indra, if you are pleased with me, I wish to have a son of holy rites free of death and not bom of a womb.
verses.hindi: उत्पन करके प्रेमपूर्वक उससे कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते शिष्या भविष्यन्ति तपस्विनः । अक्षपादः कुमारश्चोलूको वत्सस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te shiShyA bhaviShyanti tapasvinaH | akShapAdaH kumArashcholUko vatsastathaiva cha
verses.translation: O desirer of a son, I can give you only a son bom of a womb and sure to die. I cannot give it to you otherwise. There are no persons who can escape death.
verses.hindi: भी डरेगा। अतः तुम कालभेरव कहे जाओगे

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाविंशे द्वापरे तु पराशरसुतो हरिः । यदा भविष्यामि व्यासो नाम्ना द्वैपायनः प्रमुः
verses.transliteration: aShTAviMshe dvApare tu parAsharasuto hariH | yadA bhaviShyAmi vyAso nAmnA dvaipAyanaH pramuH
verses.translation: I shall not give you a son devoid of death and not bora of a womb. O great sage, even lord Vifu and Brahmi die. Not to speak of others then?
verses.hindi: इसलिये सर्वत्र आमर्दक नामसे विख्यात होओगे

verses.sanskrit: तदा षष्ठेन चांशेन कृष्णः पुरुषसत्तमः । वसुदेवसुतः श्रेष्ठो वासुदेवो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tadA ShaShThena chAMshena kR^iShNaH puruShasattamaH | vasudevasutaH shreShTho vAsudevo bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Even these two, bora of l§iva, the destroyer of the Tripuras, die. The extent of their longevity has been mentioned separately in the sacred lore.
verses.hindi: इसलिये तुम्हारा नाम पापभक्षण भी होगा

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि योगात्मा योगमायया । लोकविस्मापनार्थाय ब्रह्मचारिशरीरकः
verses.transliteration: tadApyahaM bhaviShyAmi yogAtmA yogamAyayA | lokavismApanArthAya brahmachArisharIrakaH
verses.translation: Hence O great brahmin, abandon your desire of deathless son who is not born of a womb. Accept a son befit¬ ting your mortal nature.

verses.sanskrit: श्मशाने मृतमुत्सृज्य दृष्ट्वा कायमनामयम् । ब्राह्मणानां हितार्थाय प्रविष्टो योगमायया
verses.transliteration: shmashAne mR^itamutsR^ijya dR^iShTvA kAyamanAmayam | brAhmaNAnAM hitArthAya praviShTo yogamAyayA
verses.translation: But if Siva, the lord of the gods, becomes delighted, even an immortal son not born of a womb, though hard to get, may be obtained.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यां मेरुगुहां पुण्यां त्वया सार्धं च विष्णुना । भविष्यामि तदा ब्रह्मन् लङ्कुली नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: divyAM meruguhAM puNyAM tvayA sArdhaM cha viShNunA | bhaviShyAmi tadA brahman la~NkulI nAma nAmataH
verses.translation: Neither I, nor lord Visnu, nor Brahmi, O, great sage, can give an immortal son not born of a womb.

verses.sanskrit: कायावतार इत्येवं सिद्धक्षेत्रं परं तदा । भविष्यति सुविख्यातं यावद् भूमिर्धरिष्यति
verses.transliteration: kAyAvatAra ityevaM siddhakShetraM paraM tadA | bhaviShyati suvikhyAtaM yAvad bhUmirdhariShyati
verses.translation: Propitiate lord l§iva therefore, for the fulfilment of yoiu* desire for such a son. The great lord of all is very powerful. He will give you a son.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मम ते शिष्या भविष्यन्ति तपस्विनः । कुशिकश्चैव गर्गश्च मित्रः कौरुष्य एव च
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mama te shiShyA bhaviShyanti tapasvinaH | kushikashchaiva gargashcha mitraH kauruShya eva cha
verses.translation: O sage, after speaking thus to the great brahmin and blessing him, the compassionate lord of the gods returned to his region surrounded by the gods.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशे परिवर्त्ते तु शततेजाश्च वेदकृत् । तत्राप्यहं भविष्यामि द्वापरान्ते कलाविह
verses.transliteration: dvAdashe parivartte tu shatatejAshcha vedakR^it | tatrApyahaM bhaviShyAmi dvAparAnte kalAviha
verses.translation: When the granter of boons, the thousand-eyed lord Indra had gone away, Silada propitiated lord Siva. He de¬ lighted Siva by means of his penance.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनो ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगा ऊर्द्ध्वरेतसः । प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं गमिष्यन्ति शिवं पुरम्
verses.transliteration: yogino brAhmaNA vedapAragA UrddhvaretasaH | prApya mAheshvaraM yogaM gamiShyanti shivaM puram
verses.translation: His body was covered with anthill. He was sur¬ rounded by a hundred thousand worms, with pointed beaks, as hard as adamant and other types of blood-sucking insects all round. He remained in the cavity with his flesh and blood drained up. He was left with a bare skeleton. The excellent sage 8ilada was reduced to such a state.
verses.hindi: प्रभुने उन दोनोंको भयरहित कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे सम्यक् प्रोक्ता हि परमात्मना । योगेश्वरावताराश्च सर्वावर्तेषु सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvate.antare samyak proktA hi paramAtmanA | yogeshvarAvatArAshcha sarvAvarteShu suvratAH
verses.translation: The delighted lord showed him his divine body endowed with all divine qualities and inaccessible to people of crooked intellect.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासाश्चैवाष्टविंशत्का द्वापरे द्वापरे विभो । योगेश्वरावताराश्च प्रारम्भे च कलौ कलौ
verses.transliteration: vyAsAshchaivAShTaviMshatkA dvApare dvApare vibho | yogeshvarAvatArAshcha prArambhe cha kalau kalau
verses.translation: As he continued the penance for a thousand divine years, the trident-bearing lord of all the gods spoke to him **1 am here, the gpranter of boons.**

verses.sanskrit: योगेश्वरावताराणां योगमार्गप्रवर्द्धकाः । महाशैवाश्च चत्वारः शिष्याः प्रत्येकमव्ययाः
verses.transliteration: yogeshvarAvatArANAM yogamArgapravarddhakAH | mahAshaivAshcha chatvAraH shiShyAH pratyekamavyayAH
verses.translation: The great sage 8ilada engrossed in the great trance did not hear those words of 8iva who is subservient to the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: एते पाशुपताः शिष्या भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः । रुद्राक्षमालाभरणास्त्रिपुण्ड्राङ्कितमस्तकाः
verses.transliteration: ete pAshupatAH shiShyA bhasmoddhUlitavigrahAH | rudrAkShamAlAbharaNAstripuNDrA~NkitamastakAH
verses.translation: O sage, on seeing Siva accompanied by Parvati after opening his eyes, he immediately bowed to him and fell at his feet with joy.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्या धर्मरताः सर्वे वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः । लिङ्गार्चनरता नित्यं बाह्याभ्यन्तरतः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: shiShyA dharmaratAH sarve vedavedA~NgapAragAH | li~NgArchanaratA nityaM bAhyAbhyantarataH sthitAH
verses.translation: The delighted Silada, drooping down his shoulders, with palms joined in reverence eulogised lord Siva with words choked with pleasure.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां भैरवावतारवर्णन॑ नामाष्टमोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या मयि च योगेन ध्याननिष्ठा जितेन्द्रियाः । सङ्ख्यया द्वादशाधिक्यशतं च गणिता बुधैः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyA mayi cha yogena dhyAnaniShThA jitendriyAH | sa~NkhyayA dvAdashAdhikyashataM cha gaNitA budhaiH
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord of gods, the three-eyed deity told the great sage **I am the granter of boons,**

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतद्वै मया प्रोक्तमवतारेषु लक्षणम् । मन्वादिकृष्णपर्यन्तमष्टाविंशद्युगक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ityetadvai mayA proktamavatAreShu lakShaNam | manvAdikR^iShNaparyantamaShTAviMshadyugakramAt
verses.translation: O intelligent one, what shall be done with this penance? I shall give you a son who will be omniscient and a master of all sacred lore.
verses.hindi: श्रुणु प्रीत्या महादोषसंहरत्री भक्तिवर्द्धनीम्॥ १  बढ़ानेवाली दूसरी भेरवी कथाको प्रेमपूर्वक सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र श्रुतिसमूहानां विधानं ब्रह्मलक्षणम् । भविष्यति तदा कल्पे कृष्णद्वैपायनो यदा
verses.transliteration: tatra shrutisamUhAnAM vidhAnaM brahmalakShaNam | bhaviShyati tadA kalpe kR^iShNadvaipAyano yadA
verses.translation: On hearing that, the sage SiJada bowed to die moon-crested lord and spoke in word* choked with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा ब्रह्माणमनुगृह्य महेश्वरः । पुनः सम्प्रेक्ष्य देवेशस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktvA brahmANamanugR^ihya maheshvaraH | punaH samprekShya deveshastatraivAntaradhIyata
verses.translation: O lord Siva, if you are delighted, if you are ready to grant boons, I wish for a son equal to you, devoid of death and not bom of a womb.

verses.sanskrit: हेमकञ्चुकमासाद्य नाम्ना ह्यत्रिः परिप्लुतः । व्यासस्यैव सहायार्थं निवृत्तिपथरोपणः
verses.transliteration: hemaka~nchukamAsAdya nAmnA hyatriH pariplutaH | vyAsasyaiva sahAyArthaM nivR^ittipatharopaNaH
verses.translation: When thus requested by him, the three-eyed lord Siva delightedly replied to the occellcnt sage SilSda.
verses.hindi: हुए अपनी इच्छासे विष्णुके निवासस्थानपर पहुँचे

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञः समबुद्धिश्च साध्यः शर्वः सुयोगिनः । तत्रेति पुत्राश्चत्वारो भविष्यन्ति महामुने
verses.transliteration: sarvaj~naH samabuddhishcha sAdhyaH sharvaH suyoginaH | tatreti putrAshchatvAro bhaviShyanti mahAmune
verses.translation: O brahmin, O sage, formerly I have been propi¬ tiated by means of penance by Brahma, by sages and by leading gods and urged to take an incarnation.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदशे युगे तस्मिन्धर्मो नारायणः सदा । व्यासस्तदाहं भविता बलिर्नाम महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: trayodashe yuge tasmindharmo nArAyaNaH sadA | vyAsastadAhaM bhavitA balirnAma mahAmuniH
verses.translation: O sage, I shall become your son by the name of Nandin. I shall not be born of a womb. Thus you shall be my father, of me who am the father of the worlds.
verses.hindi: जगत्पति शिव-का साक्षात् दर्शन कर रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: वालखिल्याश्रमे गन्धमादने पर्वतोत्तमे । सुधामा काश्यपश्चैव वसिष्ठो विरजाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: vAlakhilyAshrame gandhamAdane parvatottame | sudhAmA kAshyapashchaiva vasiShTho virajAH shubhAH
verses.translation: After addressing these words to the sage who stood waiting after bowing, the merciful lord Siva gave him his directions and vanished there itself along with PSlrvatl.
verses.hindi: तत्त्वोंके रूपमें भी ये ही अभिव्यक्त हो रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: After a short while, my father, the foremost among those who knew the sacrificial rites, ordered for the construc¬ tion of the sacrificial altar for the performance of sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: After a short while, my father, the foremost among those who knew the sacrificial rites, ordered for the construc¬ tion of the sacrificial altar for the performance of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: द्वारा हृदयमें देखते हैं, वे ये ही हैं, आप उनको देखें

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । नन्दिकेशावतारवर्णनम् । अथ नन्दीश्वरावतारमाह । सनत्कुमार उवाच । भवान्कथमनुप्राप्तो महादेवांशजः शिवम् । श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि मे प्रभो
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.6\. ShaShTho.adhyAyaH | nandikeshAvatAravarNanam | atha nandIshvarAvatAramAha | sanatkumAra uvAcha | bhavAnkathamanuprApto mahAdevAMshajaH shivam | shrotumichChAmi tatsarvaM vaktumarhasi me prabho
verses.translation: Then Pukaravartaka*' and other clouds showered. When I was born as the son of Silada, the Kinnaras, Siddhas, Sadhyas and other beings walked through the sky and the great sages made showers of flowers all round.
verses.hindi: स्वरूप धारणकर यहाँ आ रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच । पुत्रं दास्यामि पुत्रार्थिन्योनिजं मृत्युसंयुतम् । अन्यथा ते न दास्यामि मृत्युहीना न सन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: shakra uvAcha | putraM dAsyAmi putrArthinyonijaM mR^ityusaMyutam | anyathA te na dAsyAmi mR^ityuhInA na santi vai
verses.translation: Then Brahma and other gods together with their wives, Vi?nu, Siva and Parvati came there lovingly.
verses.hindi: महादेवका दर्शन किया जा रहा है

verses.sanskrit: न दास्यामि सुतं तेऽहं मृत्युहीनमयोनिजम् । हरिर्विधिश्च भगवान्किमुतान्यो महामुने
verses.transliteration: na dAsyAmi sutaM te.ahaM mR^ityuhInamayonijam | harirvidhishcha bhagavAnkimutAnyo mahAmune
verses.translation: After praising Silada and eulogising Siva and Par¬ vati by reciting good hymns all of them returned to their respective abodes. Siva and Siva, the lord and goddess of all, went away too.

verses.sanskrit: तावपि त्रिपुरार्यङ्गसम्भवौ मरणान्वितौ । तयोरप्यायुषां मानं कथितं निगमे पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tAvapi tripurArya~Ngasambhavau maraNAnvitau | tayorapyAyuShAM mAnaM kathitaM nigame pR^ithak
verses.translation: On seeing me the boy with three eyes, four arms and lustre like that of Yama, sun and fire and clad in matted hair and coronet, Silida was highly delighted. I was
verses.hindi: और कुछ भी अशुभ बात नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादयोनिजे पुत्रे मृत्युहीने प्रयत्नतः । परित्यजाशां विप्रेन्द्र गृहाणात्मक्षमं सुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAdayonije putre mR^ityuhIne prayatnataH | parityajAshAM viprendra gR^ihANAtmakShamaM sutam
verses.translation: ForPufkara, Avartaka etc. see P. 365. note.

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु देवेश्वरो रुद्रः प्रसीदति महेश्वरः । सुदुर्लभो मृत्युहीनस्तव पुत्रो ह्ययोनिजः
verses.transliteration: kintu deveshvaro rudraH prasIdati maheshvaraH | sudurlabho mR^ityuhInastava putro hyayonijaH
verses.translation: O lord of gods, since I have been delighted by you, you will be named Nandin. Hence I bow to you, bliss (incarnate), the lord of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: अहं च विष्णुर्भगवान् द्रुहिणश्च महामुने । अयोनिजं मृत्युहीनं पुत्रं दातुं न शक्नुमः
verses.transliteration: ahaM cha viShNurbhagavAn druhiNashcha mahAmune | ayonijaM mR^ityuhInaM putraM dAtuM na shaknumaH
verses.translation: My delighted father after bowing to the gpreat lord returned to his hut with me, as pleased as an indigent person who had struck a treasure-trove.
verses.hindi: राज्य देनेवाले ! मुझे यह सन्देह हो रहा है

verses.sanskrit: आराधय महादेवं तत्पुत्रविनिकाम्यया । सर्वेश्वरो महाशक्तः स ते पुत्रं प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: ArAdhaya mahAdevaM tatputravinikAmyayA | sarveshvaro mahAshaktaH sa te putraM pradAsyati
verses.translation: O great sage, when I reached the hut I cast off my divine form and assumed the human one.
verses.hindi: उन प्रभुने विष्णुजीसे हँसते हुए कहा--

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवं व्याहृत्य विप्रेन्द्रमनुगृह्य च तं घृणी । देवैर्वृतः सुरेशानः स्वलोकं समगान्मुने
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evaM vyAhR^itya viprendramanugR^ihya cha taM ghR^iNI | devairvR^itaH sureshAnaH svalokaM samagAnmune
verses.translation: After seeing me assuming human form, my father, honoured by the world, was distressed and so lamented sur¬ rounded by his own people.
verses.hindi: निमित्त इस शुभ ब्रतका अनुष्ठान कर रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: गते तस्मिंश्च वरदे सहस्राक्षे शिलाशनः । आराधयन्महादेवं तपसाऽतोषयद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: gate tasmiMshcha varade sahasrAkShe shilAshanaH | ArAdhayanmahAdevaM tapasA.atoShayadbhavam
verses.translation: The son of jlahk&yana SilSda fond of his son performed all the post-natal** rites for me.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्यैवमनिशं तत्परस्य द्विजस्त वै । दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु गतं क्षणमिवाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: atha tasyaivamanishaM tatparasya dvijasta vai | divyaM varShasahasraM tu gataM kShaNamivAdbhutam
verses.translation: Within 6ve years my father taught me all the Vedas with their Ahgas and Upahgas as well as other sacred texts.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म आदि भी मोहित हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ सावधानतया शृणु । यथाऽहं च शिवं प्राप्तो महादेवांशजो मुने
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | sanatkumAra sarvaj~na sAvadhAnatayA shR^iNu | yathA.ahaM cha shivaM prApto mahAdevAMshajo mune
verses.translation: When I completed the age of seven, the two sages Mitra and Varuna came to the hermitage at the bidding of the lord in order to see me.

verses.sanskrit: वल्मीकेन वृताङ्गश्च लक्षकोटगणैर्मुनिः । वज्रसूचीमुखैश्चान्यै रक्तभुग्भिश्च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: valmIkena vR^itA~Ngashcha lakShakoTagaNairmuniH | vajrasUchImukhaishchAnyai raktabhugbhishcha sarvataH
verses.translation: Duly welcomed by the sage and seated on their seats, the great sag of noble soul looked at me again and again and said.
verses.hindi: आप स्वतन्त्र होकर क्रीड़ा करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: निर्मांसरुधिरत्वग्वै बिले तस्मिन्नवस्थितः । अस्थिशेषोऽभवत्पश्चाच्छिलादो मुनिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: nirmAMsarudhiratvagvai bile tasminnavasthitaH | asthisheSho.abhavatpashchAchChilAdo munisattamaH
verses.translation: O dear sage, although he has mastered the sacred lore, your son Nandin will be short-live I do not his life for more thsm a year from now.
verses.hindi: निष्पाप शिव! आपके पीछे ब्रह्महत्या लगी है

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टः प्रभुस्तदा तस्मै दर्शयामास स्वां तनुम् । दिव्यां दिव्यगुणैर्युक्तामलभ्यां वामबुद्धिभिः
verses.transliteration: tuShTaH prabhustadA tasmai darshayAmAsa svAM tanum | divyAM divyaguNairyuktAmalabhyAM vAmabuddhibhiH
verses.translation: When the brahmins said this, SilSda fond of his swi was much distressed. He lamented loudly after embracing me.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यवर्षसहस्रेण तप्यमानाय शूलधृक् । सर्वदेवाधिपस्तस्मै वरदोऽस्मीत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: divyavarShasahasreNa tapyamAnAya shUladhR^ik | sarvadevAdhipastasmai varado.asmItyabhAShata
verses.translation: On seeing my father and grand-father fallen like
verses.hindi: पाप भी उसे बाधित नहीं कर सकता है

verses.sanskrit: महासमाधिसंलीनः स शिलादो महामुनिः । नाशृणोत्तद्गिरं शम्भोर्भक्त्यधीनतरस्य वै
verses.transliteration: mahAsamAdhisaMlInaH sa shilAdo mahAmuniH | nAshR^iNottadgiraM shambhorbhaktyadhInatarasya vai
verses.translation: **0 father, what is your distress for which you

verses.sanskrit: यदा स्पृष्टो मुनिस्तेन करेण त्रिपुरारिणा । तदैव मुनिशार्दूल उत्ससर्ज तपःक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: yadA spR^iShTo munistena kareNa tripurAriNA | tadaiva munishArdUla utsasarja tapaHkramam
verses.translation: O son, I am much distressed at the thought of
verses.hindi: परमेश्वरका मैं दर्शन कर रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: अथोन्मील्य मुनिर्नेत्रे सोमं शम्भुं विलोकयन् । द्रुतं प्रणम्य समुदा पादयोर्न्यपतन्मुने
verses.transliteration: athonmIlya munirnetre somaM shambhuM vilokayan | drutaM praNamya samudA pAdayornyapatanmune
verses.translation: O father, I shall deceive death by means of my penance, not learning. By worshipping great god, I will con¬ quer death, not otherwise.
verses.hindi: तृणके समान ज्ञात हो रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: हर्षगद्गदया वाचा नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः । प्रसन्नात्मा शिलादः स तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: harShagadgadayA vAchA nataskandhaH kR^itA~njaliH | prasannAtmA shilAdaH sa tuShTAva parameshvaram
verses.translation: O sage, after saying this and bowing at his feet And circumambulating my father I went to the excellent forest.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान्देवदेवस्त्रिलोचनः । वरदोऽस्मीति तं प्राह शिलादं मुनिपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration: tataH prasanno bhagavAndevadevastrilochanaH | varado.asmIti taM prAha shilAdaM munipu~Ngavam
verses.translation: O sage, after going there and staying in an isolated place with a steady mind I performed a severe penance very difficult even for good sages.

verses.sanskrit: तपसानेन किं कार्यं भवते हि महामते । ददामि पुत्रं सर्वज्ञं सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगम्
verses.transliteration: tapasAnena kiM kAryaM bhavate hi mahAmate | dadAmi putraM sarvaj~naM sarvashAstrArthapAragam
verses.translation: Meditating in the lotus-like cavity of the heart the lord Tryambaka, Sadaiva wtih five faces,** ten arms and three eyes and quiet in features I performed the repetition of Rudra Japa. I was in great meditation on the northern bank of the river. My mind was concentrated and I had pure thoughts.
verses.hindi: इस बहानेसे मैं भी अपनेको पवित्र कर लूँगी

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाकामः शिलादोऽभूदुक्तः पितृभिरादरात् । तदुद्धर्तुमना भक्त्या समुद्धारमभीप्सुभिः
verses.transliteration: prajAkAmaH shilAdo.abhUduktaH pitR^ibhirAdarAt | taduddhartumanA bhaktyA samuddhAramabhIpsubhiH
verses.translation: Delighted with that Japa, lord Siva, accompanied by Parvati and bedecked with the crescent moon, said:—
verses.hindi: शम्भुने मुसकराकर हरिसे यह वचन कहा--

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं तच्छ्रुत्वा च शिलाशनः । हर्षगद्गदया वाचोवाच सोमविभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: tataH praNamya deveshaM tachChrutvA cha shilAshanaH | harShagadgadayA vAchovAcha somavibhUShaNam
verses.translation: "O Sailadi (son of Silada) I have been pleased by this penance of yours. O intelligent one, you have performed the penance very well. Tell me what you desire. I am here the granter of boons."
verses.hindi: स्वभावके अनुरूप ही आप वचन बोल रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: शिलाद उवाच । महेश यदि तुष्टोऽसि यदि वा वरदश्च मे । इच्छामि त्वत्समं पुत्रं मृत्युहीनमयोनिजम्
verses.transliteration: shilAda uvAcha | mahesha yadi tuShTo.asi yadi vA varadashcha me | ichChAmi tvatsamaM putraM mR^ityuhInamayonijam
verses.translation: When thus addressed by the lord I bowed to his feet with my head and eulogised lord Siva, the destroyer of the sorrow of old age.
verses.hindi: अतिसंस्कृत भिक्षाओंसे भी नहीं प्राप्त करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्तस्ततो देवस्त्र्यम्बकस्तेन शङ्करः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा शिलादं मुनिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamuktastato devastryambakastena sha~NkaraH | pratyuvAcha prasannAtmA shilAdaM munisattamam
verses.translation: I was endowed with great devotion. My eyes were filled with tears. I fell prostrate at his feet with my head resting there. Lord Siva, the destroyer of great distress, lifted me up and stroked me with his hands. The bull-ban¬ nered lord clasped me with his hands and stood face to face with me.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ शिव उवाच । पूर्वमाराधितो विप्र ब्रह्मणाऽहं तपोधन । तपसा चावतारार्थं मुनिभिश्च सुरोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: || shiva uvAcha | pUrvamArAdhito vipra brahmaNA.ahaM tapodhana | tapasA chAvatArArthaM munibhishcha surottamaiH
verses.translation: Glancing at the leaders of the Gaas and the god¬ dess, the daughter of Himavat, the lord of the worlds, looked at me with sympathy and spoke.
verses.hindi: आपका दर्शन बिना यलके प्राप्त निधिके समान है

verses.sanskrit: तव पुत्रो भविष्यामि नन्दी नाम्ना त्वयोनिजः । पिता भविष्यसि मम पितुर्वै जगतां मुने
verses.transliteration: tava putro bhaviShyAmi nandI nAmnA tvayonijaH | pitA bhaviShyasi mama piturvai jagatAM mune
verses.translation: "Dear Nandin, O intelligent one, wherefore can you be afraid of death? The two brahmins were sent by me alone. There is no doubt. You are equal to me.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा मुनिं प्रेक्ष्य प्रणिपत्यास्थितं घृणी । सोमस्तूर्णं तमादिश्य तत्रैवान्तर्दधे हरः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamuktvA muniM prekShya praNipatyAsthitaM ghR^iNI | somastUrNaM tamAdishya tatraivAntardadhe haraH
verses.translation: You will be free from death and old age. You

verses.sanskrit: गते तस्मिन्महादेवे स शिलादो महामुनिः । स्वमाश्रममुपागम्य ऋषिभ्योऽकथयत्ततः
verses.transliteration: gate tasminmahAdeve sa shilAdo mahAmuniH | svamAshramamupAgamya R^iShibhyo.akathayattataH
verses.translation: On the five*faced form of iSiva see P. 34 note

verses.sanskrit: कियता चैव कालेन तदासौ जनकः स मे । यज्ञाङ्गणं चकर्षाशु यज्ञार्थं यज्ञवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: kiyatA chaiva kAlena tadAsau janakaH sa me | yaj~nA~NgaNaM chakarShAshu yaj~nArthaM yaj~navittamaH
verses.translation: You will gain strength from me. You will always be at my sides. You will be for ever my favourite. Due to my favour you will have neither birth, nor death, nor old age.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षणादहं शम्भोस्तनुजस्तस्य चाज्ञया । स जातः पूर्वमेवाहं युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: tataH kShaNAdahaM shambhostanujastasya chAj~nayA | sa jAtaH pUrvamevAhaM yugAntAgnisamaprabhaH
verses.translation: After saying thus, the store*house of mercy took off his own lotus>garland round his head and tied it round my neck immediately.
verses.hindi: देखकर रुद्र सबके सामने परमानन्दसे नाचने लगे

verses.sanskrit: अवर्षंस्तदा पुष्करावर्तकाद्या जगुः खेचराः किन्नराः सिद्धसाध्याः । शिलादात्मजत्वं गते मय्यृषीन्द्राः समन्ताच्च वृष्टिं व्यधुः कौसुमीं ते
verses.transliteration: avarShaMstadA puShkarAvartakAdyA jaguH khecharAH kinnarAH siddhasAdhyAH | shilAdAtmajatvaM gate mayyR^iShIndrAH samantAchcha vR^iShTiM vyadhuH kausumIM te
verses.translation: O brahmin, as soon as that garland adorned my neck I became three-eyed and ten-armed like a second liva.
verses.hindi: इसलिये काशीका ही सेवन करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: अधोदृष्टिः सुधर्मात्मा शिलादो नाम वीर्यवान् । तस्यासीन्मुनिकैर्वृत्तिः शिवलोके च सोऽगमत्
verses.transliteration: adhodR^iShTiH sudharmAtmA shilAdo nAma vIryavAn | tasyAsInmunikairvR^ittiH shivaloke cha so.agamat
verses.translation: Then, taking me by the hand, lord liva said— "Tell me, what excellent boon shall I grant you?**

verses.sanskrit: अथ ब्रह्मादयो देवा देवपत्न्यश्च सर्वशः । तत्राजग्मुश्च सुप्रीत्या हरिश्चैव शिवोऽम्बिका
verses.transliteration: atha brahmAdayo devA devapatnyashcha sarvashaH | tatrAjagmushcha suprItyA harishchaiva shivo.ambikA
verses.translation: Then he took the water from his matted hair, water as pure as necklace, and said "Be Nandin.** Then the bull-bannered lord let off the water.

verses.sanskrit: तदोत्सवो महानासीन्ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः । आदृत्य मां तथालिङ्ग्य तुष्टुवुर्हर्षिताश्च ते
verses.transliteration: tadotsavo mahAnAsInnanR^itushchApsarogaNAH | AdR^itya mAM tathAli~Ngya tuShTuvurharShitAshcha te
verses.translation: Then five auspicious rivers flowed. They had pure water. They were very rapid. They were beautiful and dmne in form.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रशस्य शिलादं तं स्तुत्वा च सुस्तवैः शिवौ । सर्वे जग्मुश्च धामानि शिवावप्यखिलेश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: suprashasya shilAdaM taM stutvA cha sustavaiH shivau | sarve jagmushcha dhAmAni shivAvapyakhileshvarau
verses.translation: The five rivers** are glorified thus—Jafodaka, Tris- rotas, Vradhvani, Svarnodaka and Jambunadi.

verses.sanskrit: शिलादोऽपि च मां दृष्ट्वा कालसूर्यानलप्रभम् । त्र्यक्षं चतुर्भुजं बालं जटामुकुटधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: shilAdo.api cha mAM dR^iShTvA kAlasUryAnalaprabham | tryakShaM chaturbhujaM bAlaM jaTAmukuTadhAriNam
verses.translation: He who goes to the holy centre of Paficanada, takes his bath there, performs the Japa of the lord of lords and worships him, certainly attains the Sayujya of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलाद्यायुधं दीप्तं सर्वथा रुद्ररूपिणम् । महानन्दभरः प्रीत्या प्रणम्यं प्रणनाम च
verses.transliteration: trishUlAdyAyudhaM dIptaM sarvathA rudrarUpiNam | mahAnandabharaH prItyA praNamyaM praNanAma cha
verses.translation: Then Siva said to Parvati "I am going to coro¬ nate Nandin and proclaim him as the lord of Ganas. O unchanging goddess, what do you think?"
verses.hindi: कृष्णपक्षके चन्द्रमाके समान क्षीण हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: शिलाद उवाच । त्वयाहं नन्दितो यस्मान्नन्दी नाम्ना सुरेश्वर । तस्मात्त्वां देवमानन्दं नमामि जगदीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: shilAda uvAcha | tvayAhaM nandito yasmAnnandI nAmnA sureshvara | tasmAttvAM devamAnandaM namAmi jagadIshvaram
verses.translation: O lord of gods, it behoves you to give that to Nandin. O lord, Sailadi is my most beloved son. *

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । मया सह पिता हृष्टः सुप्रणम्य महेश्वरम् । उटजं स्वं जगामाशु निधिं लब्ध्वेव निर्धनः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | mayA saha pitA hR^iShTaH supraNamya maheshvaram | uTajaM svaM jagAmAshu nidhiM labdhveva nirdhanaH
verses.translation: Then Siva the independent lord, the Supreme deity, the bestower of everything and favourably disposed towards his devotees remembered his excellent leaders of Ganas.
verses.hindi: प्रादुर्भावं भैरवस्य श्रुत्वा मुच्येत सड्डूटात्॥ ७२  को सुनकर संकटसे छूट जाता है

verses.sanskrit: यदा गतोऽहमुटजं शिलादस्य महामुने । तदाहं तादृशं रूपं त्यक्त्वा मानुष्यमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: yadA gato.ahamuTajaM shilAdasya mahAmune | tadAhaM tAdR^ishaM rUpaM tyaktvA mAnuShyamAsthitaH
verses.translation: Even as they were remembered, all the leading Ganas of Rudra came there. They were countless. They had the shape of Siva. They were highly delighted.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां भरवावतारलीलावर्णन॑ नाम नवमो ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: मानुष्यमास्थितं दृष्ट्वा पिता मे लोकपूजितः । विललापातिदुःखार्त्तः स्वजनैश्च समावृतः
verses.transliteration: mAnuShyamAsthitaM dR^iShTvA pitA me lokapUjitaH | vilalApAtiduHkhArttaH svajanaishcha samAvR^itaH
verses.translation: Those leading Gaas bowed to lord Siva and the goddess Parvati with joined palms and drooping shoulders. The powerful Ganas spoke.

verses.sanskrit: जातकर्मादिकान्येव सर्वाण्यपि चकार मे । शालङ्कायनपुत्रो वै शिलादः पुत्रवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: jAtakarmAdikAnyeva sarvANyapi chakAra me | shAla~NkAyanaputro vai shilAdaH putravatsalaH
verses.translation: O great lord, the destroyer of Tripuras, why are we called? Please command us, O bestower of wishes. We arc your servants and we have come here.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रमुद्दिश्य स मुनिस्तपस्तेपे सुदुःसहम् । निश्चलात्मा शिलादाख्यो बहुकालं दृढव्रतः
verses.transliteration: shakramuddishya sa munistapastepe suduHsaham | nishchalAtmA shilAdAkhyo bahukAlaM dR^iDhavrataH
verses.translation: Shall we dry up the oceans? Shall we kill Yama with his servants? Shall we slay great death or the aged Brahma especially?

verses.sanskrit: वेदानध्यापयामास साङ्गोपाङ्गानशेषतः । शास्त्राण्यन्यान्यपि तथा पञ्चवर्षे पिता च माम्
verses.transliteration: vedAnadhyApayAmAsa sA~NgopA~NgAnasheShataH | shAstrANyanyAnyapi tathA pa~nchavarShe pitA cha mAm
verses.translation: Shall we bind Indra with all the gods or Visnu vi*ith all his Parsadas and bring diem here? Or the Daityas and Danavas?
verses.hindi: द्वारा दितिके गर्भसे पुत्ररूपमें उत्पन्न हुए

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूर्णे सप्तमे वर्षे मित्रावरुणसंज्ञकौ । मुनी तस्याश्रमं प्राप्तौ द्रष्टुं मां चाज्ञया विभोः
verses.transliteration: sampUrNe saptame varShe mitrAvaruNasa.nj~nakau | munI tasyAshramaM prAptau draShTuM mAM chAj~nayA vibhoH
verses.translation: To whom shall we cause great and terrible distress at your behest? O lord, who is to be extremely jubilant to-day for the increase of all cherished desires?

verses.sanskrit: सत्कृतौ मुनिना तेन सूपविष्टो महामुनी । ऊचतुश्च महात्मानौ मां निरीक्ष्य मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: satkR^itau muninA tena sUpaviShTo mahAmunI | Uchatushcha mahAtmAnau mAM nirIkShya muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: On hearing these heroic words of the Ganas the great lord spoke after praising them.

verses.sanskrit: मित्रावरुणावूचतुः । तात नन्दी तवाल्पायुः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः । न दृष्टमेव चापश्यं ह्यायुर्वर्षादतः परम्
verses.transliteration: mitrAvaruNAvUchatuH | tAta nandI tavAlpAyuH sarvashAstrArthapAragaH | na dR^iShTameva chApashyaM hyAyurvarShAdataH param
verses.translation: All of you, crown him lovingly as your leader and resort of all my Ganas. From today onwards, Nandivara is your lord.
verses.hindi: कि आपकी सृष्टिमें कोई भी मुझे न मार सके

verses.sanskrit: विप्रयोरित्युक्तवतोः शिलादः पुत्रवत्सलः । तमालिङ्ग्य च दुःखार्तो रुरोदातीव विस्वरम्
verses.transliteration: viprayorityuktavatoH shilAdaH putravatsalaH | tamAli~Ngya cha duHkhArto rurodAtIva visvaram
verses.translation: Thus ordered by Siva, the leading Gaas *>aid **LeC
verses.hindi: वशमें करके निष्कण्टक राज्य करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: मृतवत्पतितं दृष्ट्वा पितरं च पितामहम् । प्रत्यवोचत्प्रसन्नात्मा स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: mR^itavatpatitaM dR^iShTvA pitaraM cha pitAmaham | pratyavochatprasannAtmA smR^itvA shivapadAmbujam
verses.translation: Then Narayana and other gods including Indra, and die sages came from all the worlds with pleased faces.

verses.sanskrit: केन त्वं तात दुःखेन वेपमानश्च रोदिषि । दुःखं ते कुत उत्पन्नं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: kena tvaM tAta duHkhena vepamAnashcha rodiShi | duHkhaM te kuta utpannaM j~nAtumichChAmi tattvataH
verses.translation: At the behest of iSiva, the holy Brahma performed the coronation of Nandin w th care and attention.
verses.hindi: करता हुआ अग्निके समान जाज्वल्यमान हो उठा

verses.sanskrit: पितोवाच । तवाल्पमृत्युदुःखेन दुःखितोऽतीव पुत्रक । को मे दुःखं हरतु वै शरणं तं प्रयामि हि
verses.transliteration: pitovAcha | tavAlpamR^ityuduHkhena duHkhito.atIva putraka | ko me duHkhaM haratu vai sharaNaM taM prayAmi hi
verses.translation: Then Vi$nu, Indra, the guardians of the quarters, Brahma and the sages eulogised me.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच । देवो वा दानवो वापि यमः कालोऽथवापि हि । ऋध्येयुर्यद्यपि ह्येते मामन्येऽपि जनास्तथा
verses.transliteration: putra uvAcha | devo vA dAnavo vApi yamaH kAlo.athavApi hi | R^idhyeyuryadyapi hyete mAmanye.api janAstathA
verses.translation: While they were eulogising, Visnu, the lord of the universe, eulogised me with devotion with palms joined to¬ gether over the head.

verses.sanskrit: अथापि चाल्पमृत्युर्मे न भविष्यति मा तुदः । सत्यं ब्रवीमि जनक शपथं ते करोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: athApi chAlpamR^ityurme na bhaviShyati mA tudaH | satyaM bravImi janaka shapathaM te karomyaham
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence he bowed to me and cried shouts of victory. Then all the leading Ganas, the gods and the Asuras did likewise in order.

verses.sanskrit: तपतस्तस्य तपसा सन्तुष्टोऽभूच्छतक्रतुः । जगाम च वरं दातुं सर्वदेवप्रभुस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tapatastasya tapasA santuShTo.abhUchChatakratuH | jagAma cha varaM dAtuM sarvadevaprabhustadA
verses.translation: O great brahmin, thus at the instance of the great lord, I, Nandilvara was coronated and eulogised by the gods including Brahma.
verses.hindi: देखकर लक्ष्मीजी भी अत्यन्त विस्मित हो गयीं

verses.sanskrit: पितोवाच । किं तपः किं परिज्ञानं को योगश्च प्रभुश्च ते । येन त्वं दारुणं दुःखं वञ्चयिष्यसि पुत्र मे
verses.transliteration: pitovAcha | kiM tapaH kiM parij~nAnaM ko yogashcha prabhushcha te | yena tvaM dAruNaM duHkhaM va~nchayiShyasi putra me
verses.translation: The daughter of the Maruts, the gentle and beauti¬ ful lady Suyaa became my divine wife pleasing to my eyes and mind.-
verses.hindi: देवताओंको उत्तम सुख प्राप्त नहीं हो रहा था

verses.sanskrit: ॥ पुत्र उवाच । न तात तपसा मृत्युं वञ्चयिष्ये न विद्यया । महादेवस्य भजनान्मृत्युं जेष्यामि नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: || putra uvAcha | na tAta tapasA mR^ityuM va~nchayiShye na vidyayA | mahAdevasya bhajanAnmR^ityuM jeShyAmi nAnyathA
verses.translation: A well-decorated umbrella shedding moonlike lusixe was held above her in the company of women holding the chowries in their hands.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वाहं पितुः पादौ प्रणम्य शिरसा मुने । प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य च तमगच्छं वनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvAhaM pituH pAdau praNamya shirasA mune | pradakShiNIkR^itya cha tamagachChaM vanamuttamam
verses.translation: A fine necklace worn by the goddess round her neck was given to me. I got a fine bull, a white elephant, a lion, the lion-banner, a chariot, gold necklace, like the disc of the moon and many other auspicious articles, O sage.

verses.sanskrit: शिलादमाह सुप्रीत्या शक्रस्तुष्टोऽस्मि तेऽनघ । तेन त्वं मुनिशार्दूल वरयस्व वरानिति
verses.transliteration: shilAdamAha suprItyA shakrastuShTo.asmi te.anagha | tena tvaM munishArdUla varayasva varAniti
verses.translation: O great sage, the marriage having been celebrated thus I, in the company of my wife, saluted the feet of l3iva, BrahmS and Vinu for the sake of welfare.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं स्तुत्वा स्तुतिभिरादरात् । शिलादो मुनिशार्दूलस्तमाह सुकृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: tataH praNamya deveshaM stutvA stutibhirAdarAt | shilAdo munishArdUlastamAha sukR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: Siva, lord of the three worlds, favourably disposed towards his devotees spoke these words with great love and pleasure to me accompanied by my wife.
verses.hindi: स्मरणसे ही उसका समस्त दुःख दूर हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: शिलाद उवाच । शतक्रतो सुरेशान सन्तुष्टो यदि मे प्रभो । अयोनिजं मुत्युहीनं पुत्रमिच्छामि सुव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: shilAda uvAcha | shatakrato sureshAna santuShTo yadi me prabho | ayonijaM mutyuhInaM putramichChAmi suvratam
verses.translation: O Nandiia, O lord of Ganas, I am always pleased with you in the company of the goddess. O dear boy, listen to my weighty words.
verses.hindi: शान्त करनेमें समर्थ हैं--यह पूर्णरूपसे निश्चित है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O son, your father will be endowed with all pros¬ perity. He will become a presiding officer of the Ganas, a great devotee of mine and very powerful.
verses.hindi: प्रदान करके प्रसन्‍नचित्त होकर कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O son, your father will be endowed with all pros¬ perity. He will become a presiding officer of the Ganas, a great devotee of mine and very powerful.
verses.hindi: अधिक प्रिय हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । नन्दिकेश्वरावताराभिषेक विवाहवर्णनम् । ॥ नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच । तत्र गत्वा मुनेऽहं वै स्थित्वैकान्तस्थले सुधीः । अतपं तप उग्रं सन्मुनीनामपि दुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.7\. saptamo.adhyAyaH | nandikeshvarAvatArAbhiSheka vivAhavarNanam | || nandikeshvara uvAcha | tatra gatvA mune.ahaM vai sthitvaikAntasthale sudhIH | atapaM tapa ugraM sanmunInAmapi duShkaram
verses.translation: O dear son, your grandfather too shall be like-wise. This is my rule that whoever approaches me is certainly endowed with a boon.
verses.hindi: शिवजीका स्मरण करते हुए वैसे ही चले गये

verses.sanskrit: वत्स नन्दिन् महाप्राज्ञ मृत्योर्भीतिः कुतस्तव । मयैव प्रेषितौ विप्रौ मत्समस्त्वं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vatsa nandin mahAprAj~na mR^ityorbhItiH kutastava | mayaiva preShitau viprau matsamastvaM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Then the goddess, the granter of the boon and of great fortune told me—"Speak out what your desire is. Tell me all your wishes."
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शार्दूलावतारे नृरसिंहचरितवर्णन॑ नाम दशमोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: अमरो जरया त्यक्तोऽदुःखी गणपतिः सदा । अव्ययश्चाक्षयश्चेष्टः सपिता ससुहृज्जनः
verses.transliteration: amaro jarayA tyakto.aduHkhI gaNapatiH sadA | avyayashchAkShayashcheShTaH sapitA sasuhR^ijjanaH
verses.translation: On hearing those words of the goddess, I spoke with palms joined in reverence "O gc ldess, let my excellent devotion be always towards your feet."

verses.sanskrit: मद्बलः पार्श्वगो नित्यं ममेष्टो भवितानिशम् । न जरा जन्म मृत्युर्वै मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: madbalaH pArshvago nityaM mameShTo bhavitAnisham | na jarA janma mR^ityurvai matprasAdAdbhaviShyati
verses.translation: On hearing my words the goddess said **Let it be so." With great pleasure Siva spoke to SuyatSa, the beloved wife of Nandin.
verses.hindi: उनकी ओर देखकर प्रीतिपूर्वक कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा शिरोमालां कुशेशयमयीं निजाम् । समुन्मुच्य बबन्धाशु मम कण्ठे कृपानिधिः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamuktvA shiromAlAM kusheshayamayIM nijAm | samunmuchya babandhAshu mama kaNThe kR^ipAnidhiH
verses.translation: Dear daughter, as you desire I grant you the-boon that you will be enciowed with three eyes. You will be devoid of future births. You will have devotion to me along with your husband, sons and grandsons.

verses.sanskrit: तयाहं मालया विप्र शुभया कण्ठसक्तया । त्र्यक्षो दशभुजश्चासं द्वितीय इव शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: tayAhaM mAlayA vipra shubhayA kaNThasaktayA | tryakSho dashabhujashchAsaM dvitIya iva sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: Then the delighted Brahmfi, Viftu, all the gods
verses.hindi: न हों तो तुम मेरे परम भेरवरूपको दिखाओ

verses.sanskrit: तत एव समादाय हस्तेन परमेश्वरः । उवाच ब्रूहि किं तेऽद्य ददामि वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tata eva samAdAya hastena parameshvaraH | uvAcha brUhi kiM te.adya dadAmi varamuttamam
verses.translation: Taking me along with all the members of the family, kinsmen and relatives, lord l9iva mounted his bull }*nd went to the abode of the goddess.
verses.hindi: और जहाँ नृसिंह थे, वहाँ वे अतिशीघ्र जा पहुँचे

verses.sanskrit: ततो जटाश्रितं वारि गृहीत्वा हारनिर्मलम् । उक्त्वा नदी भवेतीह विससर्ज वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: tato jaTAshritaM vAri gR^ihItvA hAranirmalam | uktvA nadI bhavetIha visasarja vR^iShadhvajaH
verses.translation: Vinu and all other gods praising these and eu« logising Siva and Siva lovingly returned to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: जैसे पिता अपने औरस पुत्रसे बात करता है

verses.sanskrit: ततः पञ्चमिता नद्यः प्रावर्तन्त शुभावहाः । सुतोयाश्च महावेगा दिव्यरूपा च सुन्दरीः
verses.transliteration: tataH pa~nchamitA nadyaH prAvartanta shubhAvahAH | sutoyAshcha mahAvegA divyarUpA cha sundarIH
verses.translation: O great sage, O dear one, thus my own incarna¬ tion has been narrated to you. It is always pleasing and heightening the power of Siva.
verses.hindi: आप परमेश्वरको पालनके लिये नियुक्त किया है

verses.sanskrit: जटोदका त्रिस्रोताश्च वृषध्वनिरितीव हि । स्वर्णोदका जम्बुनदी पञ्च नद्यः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: jaTodakA trisrotAshcha vR^iShadhvaniritIva hi | svarNodakA jambunadI pa~ncha nadyaH prakIrtitAH
verses.translation: He who listens to or narrates, reads or teaches the incarnation of Nandin, the granting of the boons, the coronation and the nuptial ceremony with faith and devotion enjoys all pleasures here and attains great goal hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पञ्चनदं नाम शिवपृष्ठतमं शुभम् । जपेश्वरसमीपे तु पवित्रं परमं मुने
verses.transliteration: etatpa~nchanadaM nAma shivapR^iShThatamaM shubham | japeshvarasamIpe tu pavitraM paramaM mune
verses.translation: O Sanatkumara, O omniscient one, listen to the story of Bhairava by listening to which alone, devotion to Siva becomes 6rm and steady.
verses.hindi: नृसिंहरूपको मेरे समक्ष ही उपसंहत कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: हृत्पुण्डरीकसुषिरे ध्यात्वा देवं त्रियम्बकम् । त्र्यक्षं दशभुजं शान्तं पञ्चवक्त्रं सदाशिवम्
verses.transliteration: hR^itpuNDarIkasuShire dhyAtvA devaM triyambakam | tryakShaM dashabhujaM shAntaM pa~nchavaktraM sadAshivam
verses.translation: O Sanatkumara, neither Vinu of four arms nor Brahma of four faces knows the greatness of lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: यः पञ्चनदमासाद्य स्नात्वा जप्त्वेश्वरेश्वरम् । पूजयेच्छिवसायुज्यं प्रयात्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yaH pa~nchanadamAsAdya snAtvA japtveshvareshvaram | pUjayechChivasAyujyaM prayAtyeva na saMshayaH
verses.translation: If any one knows him the supreme soul, he alone is lord Siva. But then, none of these people know him out of their own will.
verses.hindi: ऊपर शासन करनेवाला कोई भी नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: अथ शम्भुरुवाचोमामभिषिञ्चामि नन्दिनम् । गणेन्द्रं व्याहरिष्यामि किं वा त्वं मन्यसेऽव्यये
verses.transliteration: atha shambhuruvAchomAmabhiShi~nchAmi nandinam | gaNendraM vyAhariShyAmi kiM vA tvaM manyase.avyaye
verses.translation: O great sage, in this connection I shall narrate an
verses.hindi: सभी शक्तियोंका प्रवर्तक एवं निवर्तक हूँ

verses.sanskrit: उमोवाच । दातुमर्हसि देवेश नन्दिने परमेश्वर । महाप्रियतमो नाथ शैलादिस्तनयो मम
verses.transliteration: umovAcha | dAtumarhasi devesha nandine parameshvara | mahApriyatamo nAtha shailAdistanayo mama
verses.translation: All the great sages with palms joined in reverence and shoulders drooping down came there and bowed to Brahma. They asked him respectfully.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । ततः स शङ्करः स्वीयान्सस्मार गणपान्वरान् । स्वतन्त्रः परमेशानः सर्वदो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tataH sa sha~NkaraH svIyAnsasmAra gaNapAnvarAn | svatantraH parameshAnaH sarvado bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: O lord of gods, O lord of subjects, O Creator, O leader of the worlds tell us the real fact. What is that sole unchanging entity?

verses.sanskrit: स्मरणादेव रुद्रस्य सम्प्राप्ताश्च गणेश्वराः । असङ्ख्याता महामोदाः शङ्कराकृतयोऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: smaraNAdeva rudrasya samprAptAshcha gaNeshvarAH | asa~NkhyAtA mahAmodAH sha~NkarAkR^itayo.akhilAH
verses.translation: Deluded by the Maya of gpreat lord and net know¬ ing the great fact the lotus-born Brahma replied haughtily.
verses.hindi: मेरी शरणमें आकर निर्भय होकर तुम चले जाओ

verses.sanskrit: ते गणेशाः शिवं देवीं प्रणम्याहुः शुभं वचः । ते प्रणम्य करौ बद्ध्वा नतस्कन्धा महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: te gaNeshAH shivaM devIM praNamyAhuH shubhaM vachaH | te praNamya karau baddhvA nataskandhA mahAbalAH
verses.translation: O gods, O sages, all of you listen with attention and intelligence I shall describe the great unchanging entity as it really is.
verses.hindi: मनुष्योंसे युक्त यह सारा विश्व मेरा है

verses.sanskrit: गणेशा ऊचुः । किमर्थं च स्मृता देव ह्याज्ञापय महाप्रभो । किङ्करान्नः समायातांस्त्रिपुरार्दन कामद
verses.transliteration: gaNeshA UchuH | kimarthaM cha smR^itA deva hyAj~nApaya mahAprabho | ki~NkarAnnaH samAyAtAMstripurArdana kAmada
verses.translation: I am the womb (material cause) of the universe, the creator, the self-born, the unborn, the lord, the primor¬ dial being, the Brahman, the sole unsullied soul.
verses.hindi: मेरी ही कृपासे जीवन धारण करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: किं सागरान् शोषयामो यमं वा सह किङ्करैः । हन्मो मृत्युं महामृत्युं विशेषं वृद्धपद्मजम्
verses.transliteration: kiM sAgarAn shoShayAmo yamaM vA saha ki~NkaraiH | hanmo mR^ityuM mahAmR^ityuM visheShaM vR^iddhapadmajam
verses.translation: O excellent gods, I am the instigator of the worlds, and the deterrent too. There is none greater than I or any other who causes their revoludon.

verses.sanskrit: बद्ध्वेन्द्रं सह देवैश्च विष्णुं वा पार्षदैः सह । आनयामः सुसङ्क्रुद्धान्दैत्यान्वा दानवैः सह
verses.transliteration: baddhvendraM saha devaishcha viShNuM vA pArShadaiH saha | AnayAmaH susa~NkruddhAndaityAnvA dAnavaiH saha
verses.translation: I am the Creator of ail the worlds, the great Atman, the greatest Purusa, the sacrifice, the lord Nfir&yaa, the master of M2yfi and the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: कस्याद्य व्यसनं घोरं करिष्यामस्तवाज्ञया । कस्य वाद्योत्सवो देव सर्वकामसमृद्धये
verses.transliteration: kasyAdya vyasanaM ghoraM kariShyAmastavAj~nayA | kasya vAdyotsavo deva sarvakAmasamR^iddhaye
verses.translation: O sage, thus starting a mutual clash due to delu¬ sion and desiring to conquer each other they asked the Vedas about truth.
verses.hindi: आप कथामात्र ही शेष न रह जायँ

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रजाप्यमकार्षं वै परमध्यानमास्थितः । सरितश्चोत्तरे पुण्ये ह्येकचित्तः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: rudrajApyamakArShaM vai paramadhyAnamAsthitaH | saritashchottare puNye hyekachittaH samAhitaH
verses.translation: The Vedas were there in embodied form. They shall be specifically asked. With this idea in mind they asked the four Vedas about the truth.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां गणानां वीरवादिनाम् । उवाच तान्स प्रशंस्य गणेशान्परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAkarNya vachasteShAM gaNAnAM vIravAdinAm | uvAcha tAnsa prashaMsya gaNeshAnparameshvaraH
verses.translation: Vedas are the authorities everywhere. They have been honoured everywhere. Hence you please say un¬ reservedly. What is the sole unchanging entity?
verses.hindi: नहीं हैं, आप परतन्त्र एवं विमूढ़ चित्तवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । नन्दीश्वरोऽयं पुत्रो मे सर्वेषामीश्वरेश्वरः । प्रियो गणाग्रणीः सर्वैः क्रियतां वचनं मम
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | nandIshvaro.ayaM putro me sarveShAmIshvareshvaraH | priyo gaNAgraNIH sarvaiH kriyatAM vachanaM mama
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the Vedas spoke in reality after remembering the lord.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे प्रीत्याभिषिञ्चध्वं मद्गणानां गतिं पतिम् । अद्यप्रभृति युष्माकमयं नन्दीश्वरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sarve prItyAbhiShi~nchadhvaM madgaNAnAM gatiM patim | adyaprabhR^iti yuShmAkamayaM nandIshvaraH prabhuH
verses.translation: Tf we are honoured, O deities as the causes of creation and maintenance, we shall cite authorities that will dispel your doubts.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्ताः शङ्करेण गणपाः सर्व एव ते । एवमस्त्विति सम्प्रोच्य सम्भारानाहरँस्ततः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamuktAH sha~NkareNa gaNapAH sarva eva te | evamastviti samprochya sambhArAnAhara.NstataH
verses.translation: On hearing the conditions mentioned by the Vedas the two deities told the Vedas—"What is mentioned by you is acceptable to us as authority. What is that entity? Please tell us that.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवाश्च सेन्द्राश्च नारायणमुखास्तथा । मुनयः सर्वतो लोका आजग्मुर्मुदिताननाः
verses.transliteration: tato devAshcha sendrAshcha nArAyaNamukhAstathA | munayaH sarvato lokA AjagmurmuditAnanAH
verses.translation: That in which the Bhutas stay, that from which everything comes out, what they call as the greatest entity— that is Rudra alone.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहोऽपि भगवन्नियोगाच्छङ्करस्य वै । चकार नन्दिनः सर्वमभिषेकं समाहितः
verses.transliteration: pitAmaho.api bhagavanniyogAchCha~Nkarasya vai | chakAra nandinaH sarvamabhiShekaM samAhitaH
verses.translation: That by which this universe whirls, that which is
verses.hindi: हो, ऐसी स्थितिमें तुम सात्त्विक कैसे हो ?2

verses.sanskrit: ततो विष्णुस्ततः शक्रो लोकपालास्तथैव च । ऋषयस्तुष्टुवुश्चैव पितामहपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: tato viShNustataH shakro lokapAlAstathaiva cha | R^iShayastuShTuvushchaiva pitAmahapurogamAH
verses.translation: The lord of Pramathas incessantly sports with Siva. He is naked and of yellow colour and tawny due to dust. His dress and features are ugly. He has matted hair and moves about on his bull. He weani serpents as his ornaments. How can he be the supreme Brahman? Where is that Brahman free from any attachment?'*

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतिमत्सु ततस्तेषु विष्णुः सर्वजगत्पतिः । शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय तुष्टाव च समाहितः
verses.transliteration: stutimatsu tatasteShu viShNuH sarvajagatpatiH | shirasya~njalimAdhAya tuShTAva cha samAhitaH
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the all-pervasive Pranava who though unembodied assumed an embodied, extensive form told them thus.

verses.sanskrit: प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा जयशब्दं चकार च । ततो गणाधिपाः सर्व ततो देवास्ततोऽसुराः
verses.transliteration: prA~njaliH praNato bhUtvA jayashabdaM chakAra cha | tato gaNAdhipAH sarva tato devAstato.asurAH
verses.translation: Lord 14a, Rudra, Siva indulging in sports and assu¬ ming various forms never sports about with the Sakti different from him.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुतश्चाभिषिक्तो देवैः सब्रह्मकैस्तदा । नन्दीश्वरोहं विप्रेन्द्र नियोगात्प रमेशितुः
verses.transliteration: evaM stutashchAbhiShikto devaiH sabrahmakaistadA | nandIshvarohaM viprendra niyogAtpa rameshituH
verses.translation: Even after this explanation the ignorance of Brahma and Viu was not quelled. It was due to the Maya of Siva alone.
verses.hindi: इति अ्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शरभावतारवर्णन॑ नामैकादशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिञ्जाप्येऽथ सम्प्रीतः स्थितं मां परमेश्वरः । तुष्टोऽब्रवीन्महादेवः सोमः सोमार्द्धभूषणः
verses.transliteration: tasmi~njApye.atha samprItaH sthitaM mAM parameshvaraH | tuShTo.abravInmahAdevaH somaH somArddhabhUShaNaH
verses.translation: Then a great flame menifested itself in their

verses.sanskrit: उद्वाहश्च कृतस्तत्र नियोगात्परमेष्ठिनः । महोत्सवयुतः प्रीत्या विष्णुब्रह्मादिभिर्मम
verses.transliteration: udvAhashcha kR^itastatra niyogAtparameShThinaH | mahotsavayutaH prItyA viShNubrahmAdibhirmama
verses.translation: O sage, then Brahma and Vinu saw a shape in the form of a man in the middle of the mass of flame. Its body was huge and wonderful.
verses.hindi: करके उस वृत्तान्तको इस समय प्रीतिपूर्वक कहिये

verses.sanskrit: मरुतां च सुता देवी सुयशास्तु मनोहरा । पत्नी सा मेऽभवद्दिव्या मनोनयननन्दिनी
verses.transliteration: marutAM cha sutA devI suyashAstu manoharA | patnI sA me.abhavaddivyA manonayananandinI
verses.translation: The fifth head of Brahma burnt with rage (as. though saying) "who is this bearing a man's outline and features in our midst?"
verses.hindi: बड़े वेगसे उन्हें पकड़नेके लिये उद्यत हुए

verses.sanskrit: लब्धं शशिप्रभं छत्रं तया तत्र विभूषितम् । चामरैश्चामरासक्तहस्ताग्रैः स्त्रीगणैर्युतम्
verses.transliteration: labdhaM shashiprabhaM ChatraM tayA tatra vibhUShitam | chAmaraishchAmarAsaktahastAgraiH strIgaNairyutam
verses.translation: By the time Brahma could reflect properly, the great Being was seen immediately as the three-eyed Nilalohita with the trident in his hand and an eye in the forehead. Serpents and crescent moon constituted his orna¬ ments. The deluded Brahma on seeing him said laughingly.
verses.hindi: तेजसे तिरस्कृत जुगनू विश्रान्त हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: सिंहासनं च परमं तया चाधिष्ठितं मया । अलङ्कृतो महालक्ष्म्या मुकुटाद्यैः सुभूषणैः
verses.transliteration: siMhAsanaM cha paramaM tayA chAdhiShThitaM mayA | ala~NkR^ito mahAlakShmyA mukuTAdyaiH subhUShaNaiH
verses.translation: *'0 Nilalohita, I know you. Do not be afraid; O moon-crested one. You, Rudra, came out formerly from my forehead. Since you cried, the name Rudra was also assigned to you by me formerly. O son, seek refuge in me alone. I shall save you."
verses.hindi: लेकर वृषभपर सवार हो चल पड़े

verses.sanskrit: लब्धो हारश्च परमो देव्याः कण्ठगतस्तथा । वृषेन्द्रश्च शितो नागस्सिंहः सिंहध्वजस्तथा
verses.transliteration: labdho hArashcha paramo devyAH kaNThagatastathA | vR^iShendrashcha shito nAgassiMhaH siMhadhvajastathA
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing the haughty words of the lotus-born Brahma, Siva became angry as if out for destruc¬ tion.
verses.hindi: लोग 'नमः ' शब्दसे उनकी स्तुति करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: रथश्च हेमहारश्च चन्द्रबिम्बसमः शुभः । अन्यान्यपि च वस्तूनि लब्धानि हि मया मुने
verses.transliteration: rathashcha hemahArashcha chandrabimbasamaH shubhaH | anyAnyapi cha vastUni labdhAni hi mayA mune
verses.translation: Angrily, he created a Puru$a Bhairava blazing in great brilliance. Then he spoke lovingly.
verses.hindi: कल्याणकारी भगवान् शंकरकी स्तुति करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृतविवाहोऽहं तया पत्न्या महामुने । पादौ ववन्दे शम्भोश्च शिवाया ब्रह्मणो हरेः
verses.transliteration: evaM kR^itavivAho.ahaM tayA patnyA mahAmune | pAdau vavande shambhoshcha shivAyA brahmaNo hareH
verses.translation: O Kalabhairava, at the outset this lotus-born Brahma shall be chastised by you. You shine like god of death, hence you are Kalarija.
verses.hindi: सबके सब आपसे ही उत्पन्न हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: तथाविधं त्रिलोकेशः सपत्नीकं च मां प्रभुः । प्रोवाच परया प्रीत्या स शिवो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: tathAvidhaM trilokeshaH sapatnIkaM cha mAM prabhuH | provAcha parayA prItyA sa shivo bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: You are called Bhairava because you are of terrifying features and you are capable of supporting the universe. Since even K§la is afraid of you, you are called Kalabhairava.
verses.hindi: करते हैं, आप ही सबके स्वामी हैं

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । शृणु सत्पुत्र तातस्त्वं सुयशेयं तव प्रिया । ददामि ते वरं प्रीत्या यत्ते मनसि वाञ्छितम्
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | shR^iNu satputra tAtastvaM suyasheyaM tava priyA | dadAmi te varaM prItyA yatte manasi vA~nChitam
verses.translation: When you are angry you will be suppressing the wicked souls. Hence you will be known everywhere as the suppressor of the wicked.

verses.sanskrit: सदाऽहं तव नन्दीश सन्तुष्टोऽस्मि गणेश्वर । देव्या च सहितो वत्स शृणु मे परमं वचः
verses.transliteration: sadA.ahaM tava nandIsha santuShTo.asmi gaNeshvara | devyA cha sahito vatsa shR^iNu me paramaM vachaH
verses.translation: Since you will be devouring the sins of devotees in a trice your name will be famous as sin-eater.
verses.hindi: हो गये हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । शैलादे वरदोऽहं ते तपसानेन तोषितः । साधु तप्तं त्वया धीमन् ब्रूहि यत्ते मनोगतम्
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | shailAde varado.ahaM te tapasAnena toShitaH | sAdhu taptaM tvayA dhIman brUhi yatte manogatam
verses.translation: O Kalaraja, you will have forever the suaerainty over my city Kali, the city of liberation, which is greater than all other cities.
verses.hindi: सर्वश्रेष्ठ हैं और मेरे भक्तोंको वर देनेवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: सदेष्टश्च विशिष्टश्च परमैश्वर्यसंयुतः । महायोगी महेष्वासः सपिता सपितामहः
verses.transliteration: sadeShTashcha vishiShTashcha paramaishvaryasaMyutaH | mahAyogI maheShvAsaH sapitA sapitAmahaH
verses.translation: You alone will be the chastiser of those who commit sins there. Gitragupta will write down their auspi¬ cious and inauspicious activities.

verses.sanskrit: अजेयः सर्वजेता च सदा पूज्यो महाबलः । अहं यत्र भवांस्तत्र यत्र त्वं तत्र चाप्यहम्
verses.transliteration: ajeyaH sarvajetA cha sadA pUjyo mahAbalaH | ahaM yatra bhavAMstatra yatra tvaM tatra chApyaham
verses.translation: After receiving all these boons. K&la-Bhairava, in a trice, cut off Brahma's head with the tip of the nails of the fingers of his left hand.**

verses.sanskrit: अयं च ते पिता पुत्र परमैश्वर्यसंयुतः । भविष्यति गणाध्यक्षो मम भक्तो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: ayaM cha te pitA putra paramaishvaryasaMyutaH | bhaviShyati gaNAdhyakSho mama bhakto mahAbalaH
verses.translation: The limb that commits offence shall be chestised. Hence the fifth head that censured was cut off.
verses.hindi: पढनेसे शिवजीका सांनिध्य प्राप्त होता है

verses.sanskrit: पितामहोऽपि ते वत्स तथास्तु नियमा इमे । मत्समीपं गमिष्यन्ति मया दत्तवरास्तथा
verses.transliteration: pitAmaho.api te vatsa tathAstu niyamA ime | matsamIpaM gamiShyanti mayA dattavarAstathA
verses.translation: On seeing Brahma's head cut off, Vipu became terribly afraid. Devotedly he repeated the Satarudriya mantras and eulogised §iva.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ततीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां शरभावतारवर्णन॑ नाम द्वादशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । ततो देवी महाभागा नन्दिनं वरदाब्रवीत् । वरं ब्रूहीति मां पुत्र सर्वान्कामान्यथेप्सितान्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tato devI mahAbhAgA nandinaM varadAbravIt | varaM brUhIti mAM putra sarvAnkAmAnyathepsitAn
verses.translation: The frightened golden-wombea dranma too per¬ formed the Japa of iSatarudriya. O sage, thus, in an instant, both of them were divested of their pride.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं देव्याः प्रावोचत्साञ्जलिस्तदा । भक्तिर्भवतु मे देवि पादयोस्ते सदा वरा
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA vachanaM devyAH prAvochatsA~njalistadA | bhaktirbhavatu me devi pAdayoste sadA varA
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, listen to my extremely auspicious advice. As long as there is pride, perfect know¬ ledge lies excessively hidden.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा मम वचो देवी ह्येवमस्त्विति साब्रवीत् । सुयशां तां च सुप्रीत्या नन्दिप्रियतमां शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: shrutvA mama vacho devI hyevamastviti sAbravIt | suyashAM tAM cha suprItyA nandipriyatamAM shivAm
verses.translation: Eschewing false prestige and pride, a man realises lord Siva. Lord Siva quells the arrogant because he is the destroyer of arrogance.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । वत्से वरं यथेष्टं हि त्रिनेत्रा जन्मवर्जिता । पुत्रपौत्रैस्तु भक्तिर्मे तथा च भर्तुरेव हि
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | vatse varaM yatheShTaM hi trinetrA janmavarjitA | putrapautraistu bhaktirme tathA cha bhartureva hi
verses.translation: Coming to know that Brahma and Vijpu had been deprived of their pride, lord Siva the geat god became delighted and the lord assured them of his protection.

verses.sanskrit: नन्द्युवाच । तदा ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च सर्वे देवगणाश्च वै । ताभ्यां वरान्ददुः प्रीत्या सुप्रसन्नाः शिवाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: nandyuvAcha | tadA brahmA cha viShNushcha sarve devagaNAshcha vai | tAbhyAM varAndaduH prItyA suprasannAH shivAj~nayA
verses.translation: Vs(Ch 8) speaks of Bhairava's attempt to cut off the fifth head of BrahmS at the instance of Siva and also of the cancellation of that attempt by the intervention of Siva at the behest of Vifnu. The present account of Satarudra SaifahitA is somewhat different flrom the above account. Here Kilabhairava is mentioned to have severed the fifth head of BrahmS with the nails of his left finger. This account is substantiated by similar accounts in the other PurS|.
verses.hindi: हो दोनों हाथ जोड़कर कहने लगी--

verses.sanskrit: सान्वयं मां गृहीत्वेशस्ततः सम्बन्धिबान्धवैः । आरुह्य वृषमीशानो गतो देव्या निजं गृहम्
verses.transliteration: sAnvayaM mAM gR^ihItveshastataH sambandhibAndhavaiH | Aruhya vR^iShamIshAno gato devyA nijaM gR^iham
verses.translation: After consoling both of thenii the delighted i§iva» favourably disposed towards his devotees, spoke to Bhairava- his own other form.

verses.sanskrit: स एवमुक्तो देवेन शिरसा पादयोर्नतः । अस्तवं परमेशानं जराशोकविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: sa evamukto devena shirasA pAdayornataH | astavaM parameshAnaM jarAshokavinAshanam
verses.translation: This Vi$nu shall be honoured by you as well as by Brahma, O Nilalohita, hold the skull of Brahma as an atonement.
verses.hindi: उसे अन्यथा करनेमें कौन समर्थ हो सकता है !

verses.sanskrit: विष्ण्वादयः सुराः सर्वे प्रशंसन्तो ह्यमी तदा । स्वधामानि ययुः प्रीत्या संस्तुवन्तः शिवं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: viShNvAdayaH surAH sarve prashaMsanto hyamI tadA | svadhAmAni yayuH prItyA saMstuvantaH shivaM shivam
verses.translation: Show to the world the rite of expiation foi removing the sin of slaying brahmin. You beg for alms by resorting to "the rite of skull."

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितो वत्स स्वावतारो महामुने । सदानन्दकरः पुंसां शिवभक्तिप्रवर्द्धनः
verses.transliteration: iti te kathito vatsa svAvatAro mahAmune | sadAnandakaraH puMsAM shivabhaktipravarddhanaH
verses.translation: After saying this and creating a virgin renowned as **Brahmahatya" even as he was watching, Siva, in the form of mass of flame, spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं नन्दिनो जन्म वरदानं तथा मम । अभिषेकं विवाहं च शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेत्तथा
verses.transliteration: ya idaM nandino janma varadAnaM tathA mama | abhiShekaM vivAhaM cha shR^iNuyAchChrAvayettathA
verses.translation: Until she goes to the divine city of Varapasi you too shall follow her for a terribly long period.
verses.hindi: पुन: एक मासतक निराहार रहकर तप किया

verses.sanskrit: पठेद्वा पाठयेद्वापि श्रद्धावान्भक्तिसंयुतः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा परत्र लभते गतिम्
verses.transliteration: paThedvA pAThayedvApi shraddhAvAnbhaktisaMyutaH | iha sarvasukhaM bhuktvA paratra labhate gatim
verses.translation: You will have free access to everywhere except the city of Varanasi. When she goes to VarlasT you can be fr#*ed of her in a trice.
verses.hindi: खाकर और एक महीने पानी पीकर रहे

verses.sanskrit: अथ मां नन्दिनं शम्भुर्भक्त्या परामया युतम् । अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणं सम्यक् पादयोः शिरसा नतम्
verses.transliteration: atha mAM nandinaM shambhurbhaktyA parAmayA yutam | ashrupUrNekShaNaM samyak pAdayoH shirasA natam
verses.translation: Thus directing the Brahmahatya, the wonderful lord Siva, vanished from the scene.
verses.hindi: पुनः एक महीने वायु भक्षणकर रहने लगे

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाप्य परमेशानः पस्पर्श परमार्तिहा । कराभ्यां सम्मुखाभ्यां तु सङ्गृह्य वृषभध्वजः
verses.transliteration: utthApya parameshAnaH pasparsha paramArtihA | karAbhyAM sammukhAbhyAM tu sa~NgR^ihya vR^iShabhadhvajaH
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumira, listen lovingly to an¬ other story of Bhairava that destroys all defects and enhances devotion.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उन्होंने एक वर्षतक अद्भुत तप किया

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य गणपांश्चैव देवीं हिमवतः सुताम् । उवाच मां कृपादृष्ट्या समीक्ष्य जगतां पतिः
verses.transliteration: nirIkShya gaNapAMshchaiva devIM himavataH sutAm | uvAcha mAM kR^ipAdR^iShTyA samIkShya jagatAM patiH
verses.translation: Due to Brahmahatyk's presence Bhairava began to calculate the time for release. At the words of the lord of gods, he kept on the rite of K&pika.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Although he went to every holy centre, he was
verses.hindi: आप महेश्वरकी शरण प्राप्त करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Although he went to every holy centre, he was

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.८. अष्टमोऽध्यायः । भैरवावतारवर्णनम् । अथ भैरवावतारमाह । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ शृणु त्वं भैरवीं कथाम् । यस्याः श्रवणमात्रेण शैवी भक्तिर्दृढा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.8\. aShTamo.adhyAyaH | bhairavAvatAravarNanam | atha bhairavAvatAramAha | nandIshvara uvAcha | sanatkumAra sarvaj~na shR^iNu tvaM bhairavIM kathAm | yasyAH shravaNamAtreNa shaivI bhaktirdR^iDhA bhavet
verses.translation: Once, while sporting about, being attended upon by Pramathas, Bhairava went as he pleased, to the abode of Vi?nu.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षय ऊचुः । देवदेव प्रजानाथ सृष्टिकृल्लोकनायक । तत्त्वतो वद चास्मभ्यं किमेकं तत्त्वमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: devarShaya UchuH | devadeva prajAnAtha sR^iShTikR^illokanAyaka | tattvato vada chAsmabhyaM kimekaM tattvamavyayam
verses.translation: On seeing the three-eyed Bhairava of full size, born partially of lord Siva, with serpents for his ear-rings the Garuda-bannered Visnu fell prostrate on the ground like a staff. The gods, the sages and the womenfolk of the gods too did the same.
verses.hindi: प्रकार मैं आपकी शरण प्राप्त करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । स मायया महेशस्य मोहितः पद्मसम्भवः । अविज्ञाय परं भावं सम्भावं प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | sa mAyayA maheshasya mohitaH padmasambhavaH | avij~nAya paraM bhAvaM sambhAvaM pratyuvAcha ha
verses.translation: Afler bowing to him, pure in mind, and keeping the joined palms on his head, Visnu, the consort of LaksmI, eulogised him with various hymns.
verses.hindi: है, अत: मैं आपकी शरण प्राप्त करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । हे सुरा ऋषयः सर्वे सुमत्या शृणुतादरात् । वच्म्यहं परमं तत्त्वमव्ययं वै यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | he surA R^iShayaH sarve sumatyA shR^iNutAdarAt | vachmyahaM paramaM tattvamavyayaM vai yathArthataH
verses.translation: The delighted Visnu being highly pleased in his mind, O great sage, joyously spoke to LaksmI, born at the time of the churning of the milky ocean*® and residing in the lotus.

verses.sanskrit: जगद्योनिरहं धाता स्वयम्भूरज ईश्वरः । अनादिभागहं ब्रह्म ह्येक आत्मा निरञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: jagadyonirahaM dhAtA svayambhUraja IshvaraH | anAdibhAgahaM brahma hyeka AtmA nira~njanaH
verses.translation: "O lotus-eyed beloved, you are blessed, O comely sinless lady. O gentle lady of beautiful hips, I am blessed, since we both see the lord of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तको हि जगतामहमेव निवर्त्तकः । संवर्तको मदधिको नान्यः कश्चित्सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: pravartako hi jagatAmahameva nivarttakaH | saMvartako madadhiko nAnyaH kashchitsurottamAH
verses.translation: See P. 224 note
verses.hindi: अत: आप प्रसनन्‍नचित्त होकर उत्तम वर माँगिये

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तस्यैवं वदतो धातुर्विष्णुस्तत्र स्थितो मुने । प्रोवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं सङ्क्रुद्धो मोहितोऽजया
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tasyaivaM vadato dhAturviShNustatra sthito mune | provAcha prahasanvAkyaM sa~Nkruddho mohito.ajayA
verses.translation: On seeing him men do not obtain a rebirth in the world. Such a lord the moon-crested Tryambaka comes here.
verses.hindi: हो उठकर बालकरूपी शिवजीसे कहने लगे
