verses.sanskrit: न चैतदुचिता ब्रह्मन्योगयुक्तस्य मूर्खता । अविज्ञाय परं तत्त्वं वृथैतत्ते निगद्यते
verses.transliteration: na chaitaduchitA brahmanyogayuktasya mUrkhatA | avij~nAya paraM tattvaM vR^ithaitatte nigadyate
verses.translation: Fie upon the position of the gods where emancipa¬ tion is not obtained, but on seeing Siva it is obtained and it puts an end to all miseries.
verses.hindi: तथा सब कुछ प्रदान करनेवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: कर्ताऽहं सर्वलोकानां परमात्मा परः पुमान् । यज्ञो नारायणो देवो मायाधीशः परागतिः
verses.transliteration: kartA.ahaM sarvalokAnAM paramAtmA paraH pumAn | yaj~no nArAyaNo devo mAyAdhIshaH parAgatiH
verses.translation: After saying this, Visnu bowed to the great lord with the thrill of delight through pleasure and spoke this to the bull-bannered deity?
verses.hindi: ऐसा जानकर आप जैसा चाहते हैं, वैसा करें

verses.sanskrit: ममाज्ञया त्वया ब्रह्मन् सृष्टिरेषा विधीयते । जगतां जीवनं नैव मामनादृत्य चेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: mamAj~nayA tvayA brahman sR^iShTireShA vidhIyate | jagatAM jIvanaM naiva mAmanAdR^itya cheshvaram
verses.translation: O lord, O unchanging one, O queller of all sins, what is this being done by you the omniscient lord of the gods and the creator of the worlds?
verses.hindi: है, वह थोड़े ही दिनोंमें नि:सन्देह पूर्ण हो जायगी

verses.sanskrit: एवं विप्रकृतौ मोहात्परस्परजयैषिणौ । प्रोचतुर्निगमांश्चात्र प्रमाणे सर्वथा तनौ
verses.transliteration: evaM viprakR^itau mohAtparasparajayaiShiNau | prochaturnigamAMshchAtra pramANe sarvathA tanau
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, O three-eyed intelligent one this is only your sport. O Virupak?a, O suppressor of Kama, what is this activity of yours motivated by?
verses.hindi: प्रिय मैं गृहपति नामसे प्रसिद्ध होऊँगा

verses.sanskrit: भैरवः पूर्णरूपो हि शङ्करस्य परात्मनः । मूढास्तं वै न जानन्ति मोहिताः शिवमायया
verses.transliteration: bhairavaH pUrNarUpo hi sha~Nkarasya parAtmanaH | mUDhAstaM vai na jAnanti mohitAH shivamAyayA
verses.translation: O lord Siva, O lord of Sakti, why do you go a- begging? O lord of the universe, this is my doubt, O bes- tower of the kingdom of the three worlds!

verses.sanskrit: प्रष्टव्यास्ते विशेषेण स्थिता मूर्तिधराश्च ते । पप्रच्छतुः प्रमाणज्ञानित्युक्त्वा चतुरोऽपि तान्
verses.transliteration: praShTavyAste visheSheNa sthitA mUrtidharAshcha te | paprachChatuH pramANaj~nAnityuktvA chaturo.api tAn
verses.translation: Thus addressed by Vi§ 9 u, lord Siva, the destroyer of the worlds of ferocious form of wonderful sports, laughingly said to Vi? 9 U.
verses.hindi: सो5पि विश्वानरो विप्रो हृष्टात्मा स्वगृहं ययो॥ ६४  अपने घर चले गये

verses.sanskrit: विधिविष्णू ऊचतुः । वेदाः प्रमाणं सर्वत्र प्रतिष्ठां परमामिताः । यूयं वदत विश्रब्धं किमेकं तत्त्वमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: vidhiviShNU UchatuH | vedAH pramANaM sarvatra pratiShThAM paramAmitAH | yUyaM vadata vishrabdhaM kimekaM tattvamavyayam
verses.translation: Thus addressed by lva, Bhairava, the lord of Lakfmi remembered something and bent down his hfad. He spoke again.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य तयोर्वाचं पुनस्ते हि ऋगादयः । अवदंस्तत्त्वतः सर्वे परेशं संस्मरतो प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAkarNya tayorvAchaM punaste hi R^igAdayaH | avadaMstattvataH sarve pareshaM saMsmarato prabhum
verses.translation: **0 great god, O remover of all obstacles, sport about as you please. But it dors not behove you to envelop me with your Maya.
verses.hindi: प्रियाये कथयामास तदवृत्तान्तमशेषत:॥ ९  सारा वृत्तान्त कह सुनाया

verses.sanskrit: यदि मान्या वयं देवौ सृष्टिस्थितिकरौ विभू । तदा प्रमाणं वक्ष्यामो भवत्सन्देहभेदकम्
verses.transliteration: yadi mAnyA vayaM devau sR^iShTisthitikarau vibhU | tadA pramANaM vakShyAmo bhavatsandehabhedakam
verses.translation: O lord, please eschew this Maya very difficult to be crossed by those who have no control over themselves. Brahma and others are deluded by your Maya.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । श्रुत्युक्तविधिमाकर्ण्य प्रोचतुस्तौ सुरौ श्रुतीः । युष्मदुक्तं प्रमाणं नौ किं तत्त्वं सम्यगुच्यताम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | shrutyuktavidhimAkarNya prochatustau surau shrutIH | yuShmaduktaM pramANaM nau kiM tattvaM samyaguchyatAm
verses.translation: O Siva, O lord of all, O goal of the good, O lord of Siva, it is due to your own blessing that I am able to follow your activity.

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्वेद उवाच । यदन्तः स्थानि भूतानि यतः सर्वं प्रवर्त्तते । यदाहुः परमं तत्त्वं स रुद्रस्त्वेक एव हि
verses.transliteration: R^igveda uvAcha | yadantaH sthAni bhUtAni yataH sarvaM pravarttate | yadAhuH paramaM tattvaM sa rudrastveka eva hi
verses.translation: When the time of dissolution comes, O destroyer of the world, you annihilate all the gods, sages and people of all castes and stages of life. O great god, then, the sin of slaying brahmins and others docs not affect you. You are not bound by these and arc quite independent. You sport as you please.
verses.hindi: सम्यक् कृत पुंस्त्वविवृद्धये॥ ४  पहले ही भलीभाँति पुंसबन संस्कार किया

verses.sanskrit: यजुर्वेद उवाच । यो यज्ञैरखिलैरीशो योगेन च समिज्यते । येन प्रमाणं खलु नः स एकः सर्वदृक् शिवः
verses.transliteration: yajurveda uvAcha | yo yaj~nairakhilairIsho yogena cha samijyate | yena pramANaM khalu naH sa ekaH sarvadR^ik shivaH
verses.translation: O Siva, the garland of the bones of BrahmS shines around your neck. Similarly, O Siva, O sinless one, the primordial Brahmahatya has followed you.

verses.sanskrit: सामवेद उवाच । येनेदं भ्रम्यते विश्वं योगिभिर्यो विचिन्त्यते । यद्भासा भासते विश्वं स एकस्त्र्यम्बकः परः
verses.transliteration: sAmaveda uvAcha | yenedaM bhramyate vishvaM yogibhiryo vichintyate | yadbhAsA bhAsate vishvaM sa ekastryambakaH paraH
verses.translation: Even after conunitting a great sin, if a person, remembers you who are the lord and support of the worlds, his sin is quelled.
verses.hindi: पुत्र उस शुचिष्मतीके गर्भसे उत्पन्न हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अथर्वणवेद उवाच । यं प्रपश्यन्ति देवेशं भक्त्यनुग्रहिणो जनाः । तमाहुरेकं कैवल्यं शङ्करं दुःखतः परम्
verses.transliteration: atharvaNaveda uvAcha | yaM prapashyanti deveshaM bhaktyanugrahiNo janAH | tamAhurekaM kaivalyaM sha~NkaraM duHkhataH param
verses.translation: Just as darkness does not stand in the presence of the sun, similarly the sin of your devotee does not stand but is wasted away.
verses.hindi: द्वारा अचित रुद्र स्वयं प्रकट हो गये

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । श्रुत्युक्तमिदमाकर्ण्यातीव मायाविमोहितौ । स्मित्वाहतुर्विधिहरी निगमांस्तान्विचेतनौ
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | shrutyuktamidamAkarNyAtIva mAyAvimohitau | smitvAhaturvidhiharI nigamAMstAnvichetanau
verses.translation: If a pious soul contemplates on the lotus-like pair
verses.hindi: आये थे, उसी प्रकार चले गये

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार नो वेत्ति महिमानं महेशितुः । चतुर्भुजोऽपि विष्णुर्वै चतुर्वक्त्रोऽपि वै विधिः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra no vetti mahimAnaM maheshituH | chaturbhujo.api viShNurvai chaturvaktro.api vai vidhiH
verses.translation: O great soul, O ultimate abode, O god that as- sumest a body at your own sweet will, this is only a fancy of yours, this miserliness and dependence.

verses.sanskrit: विधिहरी ऊचतुः । हे वेदाः किमिदं यूयं भाषन्ते गतचेतनाः । किं जातं वोऽद्य सर्वं हि नष्टं सुवयुनं परम्
verses.transliteration: vidhiharI UchatuH | he vedAH kimidaM yUyaM bhAShante gatachetanAH | kiM jAtaM vo.adya sarvaM hi naShTaM suvayunaM param
verses.translation: O lord of gods, I am blessed. I am seeing the eternal supreme god of cosmic form whom even Yogins do not see.
verses.hindi: है, वह कभी पवित्र नहीं होता

verses.sanskrit: कथं प्रमथनाथोऽसौ रममाणो निरन्तरम् । दिगम्बरः पीतवर्णो शिवया धूलिधूसरः
verses.transliteration: kathaM pramathanAtho.asau ramamANo nirantaram | digambaraH pItavarNo shivayA dhUlidhUsaraH
verses.translation: I have the greatest of gains today. I have the most auspicious of signs today. Even heaven and emanci¬ pation are as insignificant as a blade of grass to me who am contented with the nectar of seeing him."
verses.hindi: परलोककमें पुत्रसे बढ़कर कोई परम मित्र नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: विरूपवेषो जटिलो वृषगो व्यालभूषणः । परं ब्रह्मत्वमापन्नः क्व च तत्सङ्गवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: virUpaveSho jaTilo vR^iShago vyAlabhUShaNaH | paraM brahmatvamApannaH kva cha tatsa~Ngavarjitam
verses.translation: Lord l§iva, who had assumed the body of Lord Bhairava, left the place joyously for begging elsewhere.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युदीरितमाकर्ण्य प्रणवः सर्वगस्तयोः । अमूर्तो मूर्तिमान्प्रीत्या जृम्भमाण उवाच तौ
verses.transliteration: ityudIritamAkarNya praNavaH sarvagastayoH | amUrto mUrtimAnprItyA jR^imbhamANa uvAcha tau
verses.translation: On seeing Brahmahatya following him, Visnu called ner and requested her "Please stop pursuing the Trident- bearing deity."

verses.sanskrit: प्रणव उवाच । न हीशो भगवान् शक्त्या ह्यात्मनो व्यतिरिक्तया । कदाचिद्रमते रुद्रो लीलारूपधरो हरः
verses.transliteration: praNava uvAcha | na hIsho bhagavAn shaktyA hyAtmano vyatiriktayA | kadAchidramate rudro lIlArUpadharo haraH
verses.translation: Under this pretext, I am waiting upon the bull- bannered deity. Thus 1 shall sanctify myself for the annihi¬ lation of a rebirth.
verses.hindi: करते हुए मात्र साक्षिभावसे ग्रहण कर लिया

verses.sanskrit: असौ हि परमेशानः स्वयञ्ज्योतिः सनातनः । आनन्दरूपा तस्यैषा शक्तिर्नागन्तुकी शिवा
verses.transliteration: asau hi parameshAnaH svaya~njyotiH sanAtanaH | AnandarUpA tasyaiShA shaktirnAgantukI shivA
verses.translation: Though urged by Vinu she did not leave his side. The smiling l§iva of Bhairava form, spoke these words to Vi?nu.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्येवमुक्तोऽपि तदा विधेर्विष्णोश्च वै तदा । नाज्ञानमगमन्नाशं श्रीकण्ठस्यैव मायया
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityevamukto.api tadA vidherviShNoshcha vai tadA | nAj~nAnamagamannAshaM shrIkaNThasyaiva mAyayA
verses.translation: O lord of Lak|mi, O bestower of honour, I am satisfied by dri nkin g the nectar of your words. Whatever you say is natural to good-natured persons.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुरासीत्ततो ज्योतिरुभयोरन्तरे महत् । पूरयन्निजया भासा द्यावाभूम्योर्यदन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: prAdurAsIttato jyotirubhayorantare mahat | pUrayannijayA bhAsA dyAvAbhUmyoryadantaram
verses.translation: O Viu, choose your boon, O sinless one, I am the granter of boons. O Vi 9 ?u, you are free from aber¬ rations and ar& the foremost among my devotees.
verses.hindi: भक्तिपूर्वक उनको नग्रतासे प्रणमकर बैठ गया

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्मण्डलमध्यस्थो ददृशे पुरुषाकृतिः । विधिक्रतुभ्यां तत्रैव महाद्भुततनुर्मुने
verses.transliteration: jyotirmaNDalamadhyastho dadR^ishe puruShAkR^itiH | vidhikratubhyAM tatraiva mahAdbhutatanurmune
verses.translation: Mendicants suffering from the fever of begging alms do not turn mad with the good articles of alms so much as by the drinking in of the nectar of honour.*

verses.sanskrit: प्रजज्वालाथ कोपेन ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः । आवयोरन्तरे कोऽसौ बिभृयात्पुरुषाकृतिम्
verses.transliteration: prajajvAlAtha kopena brahmaNaH pa~nchamaM shiraH | Avayorantare ko.asau bibhR^iyAtpuruShAkR^itim
verses.translation: On hearing the words of high-souled Bhairava, Visiu became delighted and spoke to him.
verses.hindi: इ॒ति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां ग़तर्संहितायां गहपत्यवतारोपाख्याने गृहपत्यवतारवर्णन नाम चतुर्दशोः ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: चित्रमत्र न किञ्चिद्वै दुर्ज्ञेया खलु शाम्भवी । तया सम्मोहिताः सर्वे नार्चयन्त्यपि तं परम्
verses.transliteration: chitramatra na ki~nchidvai durj~neyA khalu shAmbhavI | tayA sammohitAH sarve nArchayantyapi taM param
verses.translation: O lord l§iva, let me never be detached from your feet; this is the favour I seek, nothing else.

verses.sanskrit: विधिः सम्भावयेद्यावत्तावत्स त्रिविलोचनः । दृष्टः क्षणेन च महापुरुषो नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: vidhiH sambhAvayedyAvattAvatsa trivilochanaH | dR^iShTaH kShaNena cha mahApuruSho nIlalohitaH
verses.translation: *'0 dear, O intelligent one, let what you have said occur. You will be the gpranter of boons to all the gods.**
verses.hindi: तदेव॑ मन्यमानो5भूद्ृज़पात॑ सुदारुणम्॥ १  वज्रपातके समान समझा

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलपाणिर्भालाक्षो नागोडुपविभूषणः । हिरण्यगर्भस्तं दृष्ट्वा विहसन्प्राह मोहितः
verses.transliteration: trishUlapANirbhAlAkSho nAgoDupavibhUShaNaH | hiraNyagarbhastaM dR^iShTvA vihasanprAha mohitaH
verses.translation: Blessing Vi 9 ntJ moving in the central mountain Meru*® and the world, the lord went to the city of the libera¬ ted, Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । नीललोहित जाने त्वां मा भैषीश्चन्द्रशेखर । भालस्थलान्मम पुरा रुद्रः प्रादुरभूद्भवान्
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | nIlalohita jAne tvAM mA bhaiShIshchandrashekhara | bhAlasthalAnmama purA rudraH prAdurabhUdbhavAn
verses.translation: As soon as Bhairava of terrible features entered the holy centre, Brahmahatya felt aggrieved and entered the nether worlds.
verses.hindi: अल्प बिजली मेरा कर ही क्‍या सकती है ?

verses.sanskrit: रोदनाद् रुद्रनामापि योजितोऽसि मया पुरा । मामेव शरणं याहि पुत्र रक्षां करोमि ते
verses.transliteration: rodanAd rudranAmApi yojito.asi mayA purA | mAmeva sharaNaM yAhi putra rakShAM karomi te
verses.translation: The skull of Brahma fell on the ground suddenly from the lotus*like hand of Bhairava. The holy centre then became Kapalamocana.
verses.hindi: लूँगा, यह मैं सत्य कह रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: ॥ नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथेश्वरः पद्मयोनेः श्रुत्वा गर्ववतीं गिरम् । चुकोपातीव च तदा कुर्वन्निव लयम्मुने
verses.transliteration: || nandIshvara uvAcha | atheshvaraH padmayoneH shrutvA garvavatIM giram | chukopAtIva cha tadA kurvanniva layammune
verses.translation: The unbearable skull of Brahma did not leave his hand as he was roaming elsewhere but it fell down in a trice at Kai.
verses.hindi: सघन वृष्टिके समान दुःखरहित होकर कहने लगे

verses.sanskrit: स कोपतः समुत्पाद्य पुरुषं भैरवं क्वचित् । प्रज्वलन्तं सुमहसा प्रीत्या च परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa kopataH samutpAdya puruShaM bhairavaM kvachit | prajvalantaM sumahasA prItyA cha parameshvaraH
verses.translation: Brahmahatya which did not leave iSiva at any other place vanished in a moment at Kai. Hence KaiSi shall be resorted to for shedding off evil.
verses.hindi: समाराधनरूप उपाय उचित ही कहा है

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । प्राक् च पङ्कजजन्मासौ शास्यस्ते कालभैरव । कालवद्राजसे साक्षात्कालराजस्ततो भवान्
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | prAk cha pa~NkajajanmAsau shAsyaste kAlabhairava | kAlavadrAjase sAkShAtkAlarAjastato bhavAn
verses.translation: If a person remembers the excellent holy centre Kapalamocana at Ka<i, his sin committed here and elsewhere becomes quelled immediately.
verses.hindi: मनोरथमार्गसे भी परे कामनाको पूर्ण करनेवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: विश्वं भर्त्तुं समर्थोऽसि भीषणाद्भैरवः स्मृतः । त्वत्तो भेष्यति कालोऽपि ततस्त्वं कालभैरवः
verses.transliteration: vishvaM bharttuM samartho.asi bhIShaNAdbhairavaH smR^itaH | tvatto bheShyati kAlo.api tatastvaM kAlabhairavaH
verses.translation: After coming to the foremost ot holy centres, performing the ablution in accordance with the rules and by making the water-offering to the manes one is rid of Brahma¬ hatya.
verses.hindi: ही तीनों लोकोंकी रक्षा की थी

verses.sanskrit: आमर्दयिष्यति भवान्रुष्टो दुष्टात्मनो यतः । आमर्दक इति ख्यातिं ततः सर्वत्र यास्यसि
verses.transliteration: AmardayiShyati bhavAnruShTo duShTAtmano yataH | Amardaka iti khyAtiM tataH sarvatra yAsyasi
verses.translation: Bhairava stood facing the holy centre of Kapala¬ mocana, devouring the series of sins of devotees.

verses.sanskrit: यतः पापानि भक्तानां भक्षयिष्यसि तत्क्षणात् । पापभक्षण इत्येव तव नाम भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: yataH pApAni bhaktAnAM bhakShayiShyasi tatkShaNAt | pApabhakShaNa ityeva tava nAma bhaviShyati
verses.translation: The person who observes fast on the eighth day of the dark half of the month of Margair$a in front of Kala- bhairava and also keeps awake at night is freed from great sins.
verses.hindi: विश्वेश्वर्का दर्शन प्राप्तकर कृतकृत्य हो गया

verses.sanskrit: वेदयेद्यदि वात्मानं स एव परमेश्वरः । तदा विदन्ति ते सर्वे स्वेच्छया न हि केऽपि तम्
verses.transliteration: vedayedyadi vAtmAnaM sa eva parameshvaraH | tadA vidanti te sarve svechChayA na hi ke.api tam
verses.translation: He who performs that rite with devo'tion even else¬ where and also keeps awake is rid of great sins and attains the goal of the good.

verses.sanskrit: या मे मुक्तिपुरी काशी सर्वाभ्योऽपि गरीयसी । आधिपत्यं च तस्यास्ते कालराज सदैव हि
verses.transliteration: yA me muktipurI kAshI sarvAbhyo.api garIyasI | AdhipatyaM cha tasyAste kAlarAja sadaiva hi
verses.translation: The sin conunitted by persons in the course of coimtless millions of births is quelled entirely on seeing Kala- bhairava.
verses.hindi: बूँद जल पीकर तपस्या करनेमें लगा रहा

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ये पातकिनरास्तेषां शास्ता त्वमेव हि । शुभाशुभं च तत्कर्म चित्रगुप्तो लिखिष्यति
verses.transliteration: tatra ye pAtakinarAsteShAM shAstA tvameva hi | shubhAshubhaM cha tatkarma chitragupto likhiShyati
verses.translation: He who commits offence against the devotees of Kalabhairava is deluded and becomes miserable. He will attain the distress of the wicked people.
verses.hindi: माँगता, मुझे वर देनेवाले तो शिवजी हैं

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एतान्वरान्प्रगृह्याथ तत्क्षणात्कालभैरवः । वामाङ्गुलिनखाग्रेण चकर्त च विधेश्शिरः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | etAnvarAnpragR^ihyAtha tatkShaNAtkAlabhairavaH | vAmA~NgulinakhAgreNa chakarta cha vidheshshiraH
verses.translation: The devotees of lord l§iva, who do not show devo¬ tion for Kalabhairava, attain great sorrow and especially so at Kaii.

verses.sanskrit: यदङ्गमपराध्नोति कार्यं तस्यैव शासनम् । अतो येन कृता निन्दा तच्छिन्नं पञ्चमं शिरः
verses.transliteration: yada~NgamaparAdhnoti kAryaM tasyaiva shAsanam | ato yena kR^itA nindA tachChinnaM pa~nchamaM shiraH
verses.translation: The man who, while staying at Varanasi, neglects the worship of Bhairava acquires sins that multiply like the moon in the bright half.

verses.sanskrit: अथ छिन्नं विधिशिरो दृष्ट्वा भीततरो हरिः । शातरुद्रियमन्त्रैश्च भक्त्या तुष्टाव शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: atha ChinnaM vidhishiro dR^iShTvA bhItataro hariH | shAtarudriyamantraishcha bhaktyA tuShTAva sha~Nkaram
verses.translation: If a person neglects the worship of Kalaraja at KfUi on every Tuesday and Bhut&ftem day, his merit de¬ creases like the moon in the dark half.

verses.sanskrit: भीतो हिरण्यगर्भोऽपि जजाप शतरुद्रियम् । इत्थं तौ गतगर्वौ हि सञ्जातौ तत्क्षणान्मुने
verses.transliteration: bhIto hiraNyagarbho.api jajApa shatarudriyam | itthaM tau gatagarvau hi sa~njAtau tatkShaNAnmune
verses.translation: Even a person put in a prison, or involved in adversity is freed from distress on hearing of the narrative of Bhairava.

verses.sanskrit: परब्रह्म शिवः साक्षात्सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणः । परमात्मा गुणातीत इति ज्ञानमवापतुः
verses.transliteration: parabrahma shivaH sAkShAtsachchidAnandalakShaNaH | paramAtmA guNAtIta iti j~nAnamavApatuH
verses.translation: The destroyer of Dak;a*s sacrihce Virabhadra shall be known as an incarnation of lord Siva, the great soul.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ शृणु मे परमं शुभम् । यावद्गर्वो भवेत्तावज्ज्ञानगुप्तिर्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra sarvaj~na shR^iNu me paramaM shubham | yAvadgarvo bhavettAvajj~nAnaguptirvisheShataH
verses.translation: His narrative has been mentioned in the episode of Sad. You too have heard it several times. Hence it is not mentioned in detail.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वाभिमानं पुरुषो जानाति परमेश्वरम् । गर्विणं हन्ति विश्वेशो जातो गर्वापहारकः
verses.transliteration: tyaktvAbhimAnaM puruSho jAnAti parameshvaram | garviNaM hanti vishvesho jAto garvApahArakaH
verses.translation: O excellent sage, now by my affection to you I shall narrate the lardula incarnation of lord Siva, Listen.
verses.hindi: वे सभी अग्निके समान तेजस्वी होते हैं

verses.sanskrit: अथ विष्णुविधी ज्ञात्वा विगर्वौ परमेश्वरः । प्रसन्नोऽभून्महादेवोऽकरोत्तावभयौ प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: atha viShNuvidhI j~nAtvA vigarvau parameshvaraH | prasanno.abhUnmahAdevo.akarottAvabhayau prabhuH
verses.translation: For the benefit of the gods, the wonderfully divine form of a arabha (the mythological animal with eight legs and capacity of killing lions) of blazing fire-like lustre was assumed by lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगोऽपि महेशानो नेक्ष्यते मूढबुद्धिभिः । देववद् बुध्यते लोके योऽतीतो मनसां गिराम्
verses.transliteration: sarvago.api maheshAno nekShyate mUDhabuddhibhiH | devavad budhyate loke yo.atIto manasAM girAm
verses.translation: O excellent sages, $iva*s incarnations are countless and conducive to the benefit of good devotees. Their number cannot be counted or specified.

verses.sanskrit: आश्वास्य तौ महादेवः प्रीतः प्रणतवत्सलः । प्राह स्वां मूर्तिमपरां भैरवन्तं कपर्द्दिनम्
verses.transliteration: AshvAsya tau mahAdevaH prItaH praNatavatsalaH | prAha svAM mUrtimaparAM bhairavantaM kaparddinam
verses.translation: The number of the stars in the sky, of the sand particles on the earth and of the bursting showers of heavy rain can be specified by intelligent persons at some time in the course of many births over many Kalpas; but not of the incarnations of liva; know my words to be true.

verses.sanskrit: महादेव उवाच । त्वया मान्यो विष्णुरसौ तथा शतधृतिः स्वयम् । कपालं वैधसं वापि नीललोहित धारय
verses.transliteration: mahAdeva uvAcha | tvayA mAnyo viShNurasau tathA shatadhR^itiH svayam | kapAlaM vaidhasaM vApi nIlalohita dhAraya
verses.translation: Still in accordance with my intelligence I shall mention, exactly as I had heard, the divine story of the Sarabha, portending great prosperity.
verses.hindi: बिना कुछ नहीं दिखायी पड़ता है

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यापनोदाय व्रतं लोकाय दर्शय । चर त्वं सततं भिक्षां कपालव्रतमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyApanodAya vrataM lokAya darshaya | chara tvaM satataM bhikShAM kapAlavratamAshritaH
verses.translation: O sage, when Jaya and Vijaya were cursed by you, they became the sons of Diti and Kalyapa.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा पश्यतस्तस्य तेजोरूपः शिवोऽब्रवीत् । उत्पाद्य चैकां कन्यां तु ब्रह्महत्याभिविश्रुताम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA pashyatastasya tejorUpaH shivo.abravIt | utpAdya chaikAM kanyAM tu brahmahatyAbhivishrutAm
verses.translation: Those, two attendants,* the celestial sages were bom as Diti's sons. The elder was Hiranyakatipu and the younger was Hiranylkfa the very poweiilsl.
verses.hindi: एतद्भुक्त निषेवन्ते सर्वे दिवि दिवोकसः॥ ६९  देवगण उसे प्राप्त करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: यावद्वाराणसीं दिव्यां पुरीमेषां गमिष्यति । तावत्त्वं भीषणं कालमनुगच्छोग्ररूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: yAvadvArANasIM divyAM purImeShAM gamiShyati | tAvattvaM bhIShaNaM kAlamanugachChograrUpiNam
verses.translation: .Formerly lor4 Vifu was requested by Brahma to
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे त॒तीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां गृहपत्यवतारवर्णन॑ नाम पञ्चदशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र ते प्रवेशोऽस्ति त्यक्त्वा वाराणसीं पुरीम् । वाराणसीं यदा गच्छेत्तन्मुक्तो भव तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: sarvatra te pravesho.asti tyaktvA vArANasIM purIm | vArANasIM yadA gachChettanmukto bhava tatkShaNAt
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing that his heroic brother, as dear to him as his very vital breath, was killed, HirayakaSipu became furious with Vinu.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । नियोज्य तामिति तदा ब्रह्महत्यां च तां प्रभुः । महाद्भुतश्च स शिवोऽप्यन्तर्धानमगात्ततः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | niyojya tAmiti tadA brahmahatyAM cha tAM prabhuH | mahAdbhutashcha sa shivo.apyantardhAnamagAttataH
verses.translation: He performed penance for ten thousand years and propitiated BrahmS from whom he obtained the desired boon. "None of your creations shall kill me."

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेतिहासं वक्ष्येऽहं परमर्षे पुरातनम् । शृणु तं श्रद्धया तात परमं ज्ञानकारणम्
verses.transliteration: atretihAsaM vakShye.ahaM paramarShe purAtanam | shR^iNu taM shraddhayA tAta paramaM j~nAnakAraNam
verses.translation: He left for Sonita.** He challenged the gods every¬ where. He put the three worlds iu his control and had an unrivalled rule over it.
verses.hindi: पूर्व प्राप्त करनेके लिये क्षीरसागरका मन्थन किया था

verses.sanskrit: मेरुशृङ्गेऽद्भुते रम्ये स्थितं ब्रह्माणमीश्वरम् । जग्मुर्देवर्षयः सर्वे सुतत्त्वं ज्ञातुमिच्छया
verses.transliteration: merushR^i~Nge.adbhute ramye sthitaM brahmANamIshvaram | jagmurdevarShayaH sarve sutattvaM j~nAtumichChayA
verses.translation: O sage, Hiranyakaipu harassed the gods and the sages. He violated all virtuous rites. He oppressed brahmins and became a sinner.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागत्य विधिं नत्वा पप्रच्छुस्ते महादरात् । कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे नतस्कन्धा मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tatrAgatya vidhiM natvA paprachChuste mahAdarAt | kR^itA~njalipuTAH sarve nataskandhA munIshvarAH
verses.translation: When the king rf the Daityas hated his own son Prahlada, Visnu became h:s particular enemy.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The Daityas were killed in a trice by the man-lion. HiranyakalSipu fought a terrible battle.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The Daityas were killed in a trice by the man-lion. HiranyakalSipu fought a terrible battle.
verses.hindi: सुशोभित हुए और नीलकण्ठ नामवाले हो गये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.९. नवमोऽध्यायः । भैरवावतारलीलावर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ भैरवीमपरां कथाम् । शृणु प्रीत्या महादोषसंहर्त्रीं भक्तिवर्द्धिनीम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.9\. navamo.adhyAyaH | bhairavAvatAralIlAvarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | sanatkumAra sarvaj~na bhairavImaparAM kathAm | shR^iNu prItyA mahAdoShasaMhartrIM bhaktivarddhinIm
verses.translation: O excellent sages, a great fight ensued between them for some time. It was terrifying, frightening and caused horripilation to every one.
verses.hindi: रत उनके बीच द्वेषका कारण बन गया

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । प्रिये पश्याब्जनयने धन्यासि सुभगेऽनघे । धन्योऽहं देवि सुश्रोणि यत्पश्यावो जगत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: viShNuruvAcha | priye pashyAbjanayane dhanyAsi subhage.anaghe | dhanyo.ahaM devi sushroNi yatpashyAvo jagatpatim
verses.translation: The lord of gods, lord of Lak§mi, the man-lion dragged the leading Daitya to the threshold even as the gods were watching in the sky.
verses.hindi: प्रकार कहते हुए उनकी स्तुति करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: अयं धाता विधाता च लोकानां प्रभुरीश्वरः । अनादिः शरणः शान्तः पुरः षड्विंशसम्मितः
verses.transliteration: ayaM dhAtA vidhAtA cha lokAnAM prabhurIshvaraH | anAdiH sharaNaH shAntaH puraH ShaDviMshasammitaH
verses.translation: While the gods were watching he placed the daitya on his lap and immediately tore open his stomach with his claws and killed him.
verses.hindi: हुए चन्द्रमाको अपने मस्तकपर धारण कर लिया

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञः सर्वयोगीशः सर्वभूतैकनायकः । सर्वभूतान्तरात्माऽयं सर्वेषां सर्वदः सदा
verses.transliteration: sarvaj~naH sarvayogIshaH sarvabhUtaikanAyakaH | sarvabhUtAntarAtmA.ayaM sarveShAM sarvadaH sadA
verses.translation: The celestial drums were sounded. On seeing the wonderful form of Vijriu, Prahlada was surprised, T.nlf «ynt was in a state of suspense.
verses.hindi: मुण्डमालामें पिरोकर गलेमें धारण कर लिया

verses.sanskrit: ये विनिद्रा विनिःश्वासाः शान्ताः ध्यानपरायणाः । धिया पश्यन्ति हृदये सोऽयं पद्मे समीक्षताम्
verses.transliteration: ye vinidrA viniHshvAsAH shAntAH dhyAnaparAyaNAH | dhiyA pashyanti hR^idaye so.ayaM padme samIkShatAm
verses.translation: The entire universe was again excited by that fiery splendour. The gods were miserable. Saying "What will happen now?" they kept themselves at a safe distance from fear. The lotus-born deity and others were excited by the fiery fury of the man-lion.

verses.sanskrit: यं विदुर्वेदतत्त्वज्ञा योगिनो यतमानसाः । अरूपो रूपवान्भूत्वा सोऽयमायाति सर्वगः
verses.transliteration: yaM vidurvedatattvaj~nA yogino yatamAnasAH | arUpo rUpavAnbhUtvA so.ayamAyAti sarvagaH
verses.translation: They sent Prahlada near Visnu in order to subside his anger. At the behest of all in a body Prahlada approa¬ ched the man-lion.
verses.hindi: जहाँ देवगण स्थित थे, वहाँ शीघ्र गये

verses.sanskrit: अहो विचित्रं देवस्य चेष्टितं परमेष्ठिनः । यस्याख्यां ब्रुवतो नित्यं न देहः सोऽपि देहभृत्
verses.transliteration: aho vichitraM devasya cheShTitaM parameShThinaH | yasyAkhyAM bruvato nityaM na dehaH so.api dehabhR^it
verses.translation: The man-lion, the store-house of mercy, embraced him. The heart became cool, still the flame of fury did not subside.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा न पुनर्जन्म लभ्यते मानवैर्भुवि । सोऽयमायाति भगवांस्त्र्यम्बकः शशिभूषणः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA na punarjanma labhyate mAnavairbhuvi | so.ayamAyAti bhagavAMstryambakaH shashibhUShaNaH
verses.translation: When it did not subside, the afflicted and miserable gods sought refuge in Siva.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीकदलायामे धन्ये मेऽद्य विलोचने । यद् दृश्यते महादेवो ह्याभ्यां लक्ष्मि महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: puNDarIkadalAyAme dhanye me.adya vilochane | yad dR^ishyate mahAdevo hyAbhyAM lakShmi maheshvaraH
verses.translation: Going there, Brahma, other gods and the sages eulo¬ gised i§iva for the happiness of all the worlds.
verses.hindi: हैत्य भला किस प्रकार टिक सकते हैं 2

verses.sanskrit: धिग्धिक्पदं तु देवानां परं दृष्ट्वा न शङ्करम् । लभ्यते यत्र निर्वाणं सर्वदुःखान्तकृत्तु यत्
verses.transliteration: dhigdhikpadaM tu devAnAM paraM dR^iShTvA na sha~Nkaram | labhyate yatra nirvANaM sarvaduHkhAntakR^ittu yat
verses.translation: O great lord of gods, favourably disposed cowards those who seek refuge, save us the gods who have sought refuge in you as well as all the worlds.
verses.hindi: भी अपने बलका वृथा घमण्ड करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: देवत्वादशुभं किञ्चिद्देवलोके न विद्यते । दृष्ट्वापि सर्वे देवेशं यन्मुक्तिं न लभामहे
verses.transliteration: devatvAdashubhaM ki~nchiddevaloke na vidyate | dR^iShTvApi sarve deveshaM yanmuktiM na labhAmahe
verses.translation: Obeisance be to you, O Sadasiva. Whenever there had been misery formerly, it was you that saved us.
verses.hindi: रखे गये इस तिनकेको अपने उन शस्त्रोंसे काटें

verses.sanskrit: तत्सान्निध्यं भैरवोऽपि कालोऽभूत्कालकालनः । स देवदेववाक्येन बिभ्रत्कापालिकं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: tatsAnnidhyaM bhairavo.api kAlo.abhUtkAlakAlanaH | sa devadevavAkyena bibhratkApAlikaM vratam
verses.translation: We were saved by you, O lord and you became famous as Nilakantha (Blue-necked). If you had not drunk the poison then, every thing would have been reduced to ashes.
verses.hindi: सभी देवताओंका मद दूर कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशः सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः । प्रणिपत्य महादेवमिदमाह वृषध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamuktvA hR^iShIkeshaH samprahR^iShTatanUruhaH | praNipatya mahAdevamidamAha vR^iShadhvajam
verses.translation: O Sadasiva, we are now afflicted by the fiery fury of the man-lion; O lord, it is certain that you are com¬ petent to quell it.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । किमिदं देवदेवेन सर्वज्ञेन त्वया विभो । क्रियते जगतां धात्रा सर्वपापहराव्यय
verses.transliteration: viShNuruvAcha | kimidaM devadevena sarvaj~nena tvayA vibho | kriyate jagatAM dhAtrA sarvapApaharAvyaya
verses.translation: The incident relates to the legend of Siva's swallowing poison that emerged at the churning of the ocean as a result of which Siva became blue-throated and was called Nllakan(ha.
verses.hindi: अहंकारका अपहरण करनेवाले सदाशिव ही हैं

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडेयं तव देवेश त्रिलोचन महामते । किं कारणं विरूपाक्ष चेष्टितं ते स्मरार्दन
verses.transliteration: krIDeyaM tava devesha trilochana mahAmate | kiM kAraNaM virUpAkSha cheShTitaM te smarArdana
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by the gods, lord Siva, favourably disposed to the devotees, assured them of protection and spoke delightedly.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिवको अभीतक पहचान नहीं सके !

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं भगवञ्छम्भो भिक्षां चरसि शक्तिप । संशयो मे जगन्नाथ एष त्रैलोक्यराज्यद
verses.transliteration: kimarthaM bhagava~nChambho bhikShAM charasi shaktipa | saMshayo me jagannAtha eSha trailokyarAjyada
verses.translation: Siva said:—O ye Brahma and other gods, Return to your abodes fearlessly. My rite quells misery in every respect:
verses.hindi: प्रणाम किया तथा उनकी स्तुति की

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्तस्ततः शम्भुर्विष्णुना भैरवो हरः । प्रत्युवाचाद्भुतोतिः स विष्णुं हि विहसन्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamuktastataH shambhurviShNunA bhairavo haraH | pratyuvAchAdbhutotiH sa viShNuM hi vihasanprabhuH
verses.translation: The misery of the person who seeks refuge in me vanishes. Undoubtedly the seeker of refuge is dearer to me than life.
verses.hindi: कलेवाले है प्रभो! आपकी माया अत्यन्त अद्भुत है

verses.sanskrit: भैरव उवाच । ब्रह्मणस्तु शिरश्छिन्नमङ्गुल्याग्रनखेन ह । तदघं प्रतिहन्तुं हि चराम्येतद् व्रतं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: bhairava uvAcha | brahmaNastu shirashChinnama~NgulyAgranakhena ha | tadaghaM pratihantuM hi charAmyetad vrataM shubham
verses.translation: On hearing this, the gods were delighted much. Remembering Siva joyously they returned.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्तो महेशेन भैरवेण रमापतिः । स्मृत्वा किञ्चिन्नतशिराः पुनरेवमजिज्ञपत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamukto maheshena bhairaveNa ramApatiH | smR^itvA ki~nchinnatashirAH punarevamajij~napat
verses.translation: Thus implored by the gods, lord Siva, the abode ol mercy, decided to quell that great fiery fury of man-lion.
verses.hindi: द्वारा किया गया परम अनुग्रह मानते हैं

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । यथेच्छसि तथा क्रीड सर्वविघ्नापनोदक । मायया मां महादेव नाच्छादयितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: viShNuruvAcha | yathechChasi tathA krIDa sarvavighnApanodaka | mAyayA mAM mahAdeva nAchChAdayitumarhasi
verses.translation: Thereafter Rudra remembered the powerful Vira- bhadra, the cause of dissolution and addressed Bhairava, hi« own form.
verses.hindi: सर्वकामानवाणोति ततश्च लभते गतिम्॥४२  बाद परमगतिको प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: नाभीकमलकोशात्तु कोटिशः कमलासनाः । कल्पे कल्पे पुरा ह्यान्सस्त्वन्नियोगबलाद्विभो
verses.transliteration: nAbhIkamalakoshAttu koTishaH kamalAsanAH | kalpe kalpe purA hyAnsastvanniyogabalAdvibho
verses.translation: Then suddenly there came the leader of the Ganas laughing loudly and accompanied by the leading Ganas laughing boisterously and jumping about here and there. He was surrounded by crores of fierce manlion-formed Ganas, madly dancing heroes joyously leaping about. The warlike heroes Brahma and others were playing about as if with balls; the leader of the Ganas was surrounded by others too who had remained unseen. He was respected by the heroes.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां यक्षेश्व॒रावतारवर्णन॑ नाम षोडशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: त्यज मायामिमां देव दुस्तरामकृतात्मभिः । ब्रह्मादयो महादेव मायया तव मोहिताः
verses.transliteration: tyaja mAyAmimAM deva dustarAmakR^itAtmabhiH | brahmAdayo mahAdeva mAyayA tava mohitAH
verses.translation: He had a fiery splendour as fierce as the fire at the end of Kalpa. His three eyes shone splendidly. He had no weapon. He had matted hair. He was bedecked by the refulgent crescent moon.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक सोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: कपालपाणिर्विश्वात्मा चचार भुवनत्रयम् । नात्याक्षीच्चापि तं देवं ब्रह्महत्यापि दारुणा
verses.transliteration: kapAlapANirvishvAtmA chachAra bhuvanatrayam | nAtyAkShIchchApi taM devaM brahmahatyApi dAruNA
verses.translation: He had two sharp fangs curved like the crescent

verses.sanskrit: यथावदनुगच्छामि चेष्टितं ते शिवापते । तवैवानुग्रहाच्छम्भो सर्वेश्वर सताङ्गते
verses.transliteration: yathAvadanugachChAmi cheShTitaM te shivApate | tavaivAnugrahAchChambho sarveshvara satA~Ngate
verses.translation: With his fierce hissing whooping sound be deafened the faces of the quarters. He was as dark as the blue cloud and collyrium He was terrible and wondrous with full grown moustaches and beards.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले एवं भोग तथा मोक्ष देनेवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: संहारकाले सम्प्राप्ते सदेवान्निखिलान्मुनीन् । लोकान्वर्णाश्रमवतो हरिष्यसि यदा हर
verses.transliteration: saMhArakAle samprApte sadevAnnikhilAnmunIn | lokAnvarNAshramavato hariShyasi yadA hara
verses.translation: He said to Siva—**0 lord of the universe, why I have been remembered by you? Please do me a favour and command me.**

verses.sanskrit: तदा कृते महादेव पापं ब्रह्मवधादिकम् । पारतन्त्र्यं न ते शम्भो स्वैरं क्रीडत्यतो भवान्
verses.transliteration: tadA kR^ite mahAdeva pApaM brahmavadhAdikam | pAratantryaM na te shambho svairaM krIDatyato bhavAn
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Virabhadra, and glancing at his face respectfully lord Siva, the chastiser of the wicked, said lovingly.
verses.hindi: सज्जनों एवं उपासकोंकी कामनाएँ पूर्ण करती हैं

verses.sanskrit: अतीत ब्रह्मणां ह्यस्थ्नां स्रक्कण्ठे तव भासते । तथाप्यनुगता शम्भो ब्रह्महत्या तवानघ
verses.transliteration: atIta brahmaNAM hyasthnAM srakkaNThe tava bhAsate | tathApyanugatA shambho brahmahatyA tavAnagha
verses.translation: An untimely terrible fear has cropped up tor the gods. The fire of that man-lion is blazing You shall quell this inaccessible one.
verses.hindi: जो अपने भक्तोंका मनोरथ पूर्ण करनेवाली हैं

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं यस्त्वां स्मरति मानवः । आधारं जगतामीश तस्य पापं विलीयते
verses.transliteration: kR^itvApi sumahatpApaM yastvAM smarati mAnavaH | AdhAraM jagatAmIsha tasya pApaM vilIyate
verses.translation: At the outset convince him in a consoling manner. If he does not subside thereby, show my great terrible form.

verses.sanskrit: यथा तमो न तिष्ठेत सन्निधावंशुमालिनः । तथैव तव यो भक्तः पापं तस्य व्रजेत्क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: yathA tamo na tiShTheta sannidhAvaMshumAlinaH | tathaiva tava yo bhaktaH pApaM tasya vrajetkShayam
verses.translation: O Virabhadra, at my behest, bring me his head and hide after quelling his subtle fury with your subde one and his gross splendour with your gross one.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चिन्तयति पुण्यात्मा तव पादाम्बुजद्वयम् । ब्रह्महत्याकृतमपि पापं तस्य व्रजेत्क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: yashchintayati puNyAtmA tava pAdAmbujadvayam | brahmahatyAkR^itamapi pApaM tasya vrajetkShayam
verses.translation: Urged thus, the leader of the Ganas, assumed a calm body and features and hastened to the place where the man-lion was sitting.
verses.hindi: समस्त कामनाओंका फल प्रदान करती हैं

verses.sanskrit: तव नामानुरक्ता वाग्यस्य पुंसो जगत्पते । अप्यद्रिकूटतुलितं नैनस्तमनुबाधते
verses.transliteration: tava nAmAnuraktA vAgyasya puMso jagatpate | apyadrikUTatulitaM nainastamanubAdhate
verses.translation: Then Virabhadra, the destroyer addressed Vinu. Siva, then spoke to him as a father speaks to his own son.

verses.sanskrit: परमात्मन्परं धाम स्वेच्छाभिधृतविग्रह । कुतूहलं तवेशेदं कृपणाधीनतेश्वर
verses.transliteration: paramAtmanparaM dhAma svechChAbhidhR^itavigraha | kutUhalaM taveshedaM kR^ipaNAdhInateshvara
verses.translation: O lord Vi$ 9 u, you have taken the incamauon for the happiness of the universe. You, the great lord, have been entrusted with the task of maintaining the universe by Siva.
verses.hindi: शास्त्रोंमें निगूढ़ है, ऐसा जानना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: अद्य धन्योऽस्मि देवेश यन्न पश्यन्ति योगिनः । पश्यामि तं जगन्मूर्त्तिं परमेश्वरमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: adya dhanyo.asmi devesha yanna pashyanti yoginaH | pashyAmi taM jaganmUrttiM parameshvaramavyayam
verses.translation: Formerly, multitudes of creatures moving about in the one vast ocean have been split by your lordship in the form of a fish by binding them with your tail.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतितीर्थं भ्रमन् नापि विमुक्तो ब्रह्महत्यया । अतः कामारिमहिमा सर्वोऽपि ह्यवगम्यताम्
verses.transliteration: pratitIrthaM bhraman nApi vimukto brahmahatyayA | ataH kAmArimahimA sarvo.api hyavagamyatAm
verses.translation: You support the earth in the form of a tortoise. You lifted it up in the form of a boar. In the form of a lion HiranyakaiSipu has been killed.
verses.hindi: सशक्तिका दशमिता महाकालमुखा: शुभा:॥ ९ वर्णन किया

verses.sanskrit: अद्य मे परमो लाभस्त्वद्य मे मङ्गलं परम् । तं दृष्ट्वामृततृप्तस्य तृणं स्वर्गापवर्गकम्
verses.transliteration: adya me paramo lAbhastvadya me ma~NgalaM param | taM dR^iShTvAmR^itatR^iptasya tR^iNaM svargApavargakam
verses.translation: Again in the form of a dwarf, you had bound Bali. You are the origin of all living beings. You are the eternal lord.
verses.hindi: धनाधिपो हि वैश्य: स्थाच्छूद्र: सुखमवाणुयात्॥ १९  है एवं शूद्र सुख व्रात है है

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं वदति गोविन्दे विमला पद्मया तया । मनोरथवती नाम भिक्षा पात्रे समर्पिता
verses.transliteration: itthaM vadati govinde vimalA padmayA tayA | manorathavatI nAma bhikShA pAtre samarpitA
verses.translation: Whenever any misery torments the world you incarnate yourself and make it free from distress and ailment.
verses.hindi: सुखिनः स्पुर्विशेषण शिवभक्ता भवन्तु च॥ २०  भक्त हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षाटनाय देवोऽपि निरगात्परया मुदा । अन्यत्रापि महादेवो भैरवश्चात्तविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: bhikShATanAya devo.api niragAtparayA mudA | anyatrApi mahAdevo bhairavashchAttavigrahaH
verses.translation: That Danava Hiranyakaipu has been killed for which purpose you have taken this incarnation. Prahlada too has been saved.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठृतीयायां शतरद्रसंहितायां जिवदशावतारवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तदेशोठ5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वानुयायिनीं तां तु समाहूय जनार्दनः । सम्प्रार्थयद् ब्रह्महत्यां विमुञ्च त्वं त्रिशूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvAnuyAyinIM tAM tu samAhUya janArdanaH | samprArthayad brahmahatyAM vimu~ncha tvaM trishUlinam
verses.translation: O lord Narasiihha, O soul of the universe, subdue this extremely terrible body youiself in my presence.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्योवाच । अनेनापि मिषेणाहं संसेव्यामुं वृषध्वजम् । आत्मानं पावयिष्यामि त्वपुनर्भवदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyovAcha | anenApi miSheNAhaM saMsevyAmuM vR^iShadhvajam | AtmAnaM pAvayiShyAmi tvapunarbhavadarshanam
verses.translation: Urged thus with quiet peaceful words of Vira- bhadra, the arrogant man-lion assumed a more terrible anger.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सा तत्याज न तत्पार्श्वं व्याहृतापि मुरारिणा । तमूचेऽथ हरिं शम्भुः स्मेरास्यो भैरवो वचः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | sA tatyAja na tatpArshvaM vyAhR^itApi murAriNA | tamUche.atha hariM shambhuH smerAsyo bhairavo vachaH
verses.translation: O sage, threatening the heroic Vlrabhadra with his curved fangs he spoke harsh and terrible words.

verses.sanskrit: भैरव उवाच । त्वद्वाक्पीयूषपानेन तृप्तोऽस्मि बहुमानद । स्वभावोऽयं हि साधूनां यत्त्वं वदसि मापते
verses.transliteration: bhairava uvAcha | tvadvAkpIyUShapAnena tR^ipto.asmi bahumAnada | svabhAvo.ayaM hi sAdhUnAM yattvaM vadasi mApate
verses.translation: Go back the way you have come from. Uo not speak offending words. 1 am now going to annihilate the universe of the mobile and immobile being.

verses.sanskrit: वरं वृणीष्व गोविन्द वरदोऽस्मि तवानघ । अग्रणीर्मम भक्तानां त्वं हरे निर्विकारवान्
verses.transliteration: varaM vR^iNIShva govinda varado.asmi tavAnagha | agraNIrmama bhaktAnAM tvaM hare nirvikAravAn
verses.translation: Everything functions fearlessly by my favour. I am the instigator as well as the restrainer of all powers.
verses.hindi: ऋषिको वर देनेके लिये प्रकट हुए

verses.sanskrit: नो माद्यन्ति तथा भैक्ष्यैर्भिक्षवोऽप्यतिसंस्कृतैः । यथा मानसुधापानैर्ननु भिक्षाटनज्वराः
verses.transliteration: no mAdyanti tathA bhaikShyairbhikShavo.apyatisaMskR^itaiH | yathA mAnasudhApAnairnanu bhikShATanajvarAH
verses.translation: They know me, the knower of the reality of the

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचः शम्भोर्भैरवस्य परात्मनः । सुप्रसन्नतरो भूत्वा समवोचन्महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAkarNya vachaH shambhorbhairavasya parAtmanaH | suprasannataro bhUtvA samavochanmaheshvaram
verses.translation: Brahma, the creator of the universe wfio was tormerly born of my umbilical lotus* is greater than all, being independent, maker, remover and the lord of all.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमथैः सेव्यमानोऽपि ह्येकदा विहरन्हरः । कापालिको ययौ स्वैरी नारायणनिकेतनम्
verses.transliteration: pramathaiH sevyamAno.api hyekadA viharanharaH | kApAliko yayau svairI nArAyaNaniketanam
verses.translation: O lord of Ganas, know that the entire universt! of this nature, is my own; this universe including the gods, Asuras and human beings is the manifestation of my greatness.
verses.hindi: भक्तोंकी रक्षा करनेमें दक्ष बुद्धिवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । एष एव वरः श्लाघ्यो यदहं देवताधिपम् । पश्यामि त्वान्देवदेव मनोवाणीपथातिगम्
verses.transliteration: viShNuruvAcha | eSha eva varaH shlAghyo yadahaM devatAdhipam | pashyAmi tvAndevadeva manovANIpathAtigam
verses.translation: I am Kala, the cause of destroying the worlds. I am engaged in annihilating the worlds. O Virabhadra, know me to be the Death of Death. These gods are alive by my very favour.
verses.hindi: हैं, अत: आप इन दु:खियोंकी रक्षा कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: अदभ्रेयं सुधादृष्टिरनया मे महोत्सवः । अयत्त्ननिधिलाभोऽयं वीक्षणं हर ते सताम्
verses.transliteration: adabhreyaM sudhAdR^iShTiranayA me mahotsavaH | ayattnanidhilAbho.ayaM vIkShaNaM hara te satAm
verses.translation: On hearing the arrogant words of Visnu, Vira¬ bhadra of immeasurable exploits laughed and said contem¬ ptuously with throbbing lips.

verses.sanskrit: अवियोगोऽस्तु मे देव त्वदङ्घ्रियुगलेन वै । एष एव वरः शम्भो नान्यं कश्चिद् वृणे वरम्
verses.transliteration: aviyogo.astu me deva tvada~Nghriyugalena vai | eSha eva varaH shambho nAnyaM kashchid vR^iNe varam
verses.translation: Don't you know the Pinaka-bearing lord of the universe as the annihilator? Baseless argument and disputa¬ tion will end in death for you.
verses.hindi: आकर आपके लिये तपस्या कर रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीभैरव उवाच । एवं भवतु ते तात यत्त्वयोक्तं महामते । सर्वेषामपि देवानां वरदस्त्वं भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: shrIbhairava uvAcha | evaM bhavatu te tAta yattvayoktaM mahAmate | sarveShAmapi devAnAM varadastvaM bhaviShyasi
verses.translation: Tell me the defect which has led you to this plight. With that lord capable of annihilation you will get the balance of Dakina.
verses.hindi: कीजिये और देवताओंके दुःखको दूर कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अनुगृह्येति दैत्यारिं केन्द्राद्रिभुवने चरन् । भेजेऽविमुक्तनगरीं नाम्ना वाराणसीं पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | anugR^ihyeti daityAriM kendrAdribhuvane charan | bheje.avimuktanagarIM nAmnA vArANasIM purIm
verses.translation: The Ckintents of the verses ai, 29, 30 and 35 in this chapter are reminiscent of similar ideas expressed in the Bhagavad'-giti.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रे प्रविष्टमात्रेऽथ भैरवे भीषणाकृतौ । हाहेत्युक्त्वा ब्रह्महत्या पातालं चाविशत्तदा
verses.transliteration: kShetre praviShTamAtre.atha bhairave bhIShaNAkR^itau | hAhetyuktvA brahmahatyA pAtAlaM chAvishattadA
verses.translation: Remaining in a severe penance, he contemplated on Siva, the blue-necked, in his forehead for the creation of the three worlds.
verses.hindi: प्रकार आप सदा सभी देवताओंके सहायक बनें

verses.sanskrit: कपालं ब्राह्मणः सद्यो भैरवस्य कराम्बुजात् । पपात भुवि तत्तीर्थमभूत्कापालमोचनम्
verses.transliteration: kapAlaM brAhmaNaH sadyo bhairavasya karAmbujAt | papAta bhuvi tattIrthamabhUtkApAlamochanam
verses.translation: Siva came out of his forehead. 1 am the ornament of the lord of gods in the form of Bhairava in the matter of creation.
verses.hindi: कहकर उनके देखते-देखते वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: कपालं ब्रह्मणो रुद्रः सर्वेषामेव पश्यताम् । हस्तात्पतन्तमालोक्य ननर्त परया मुदा
verses.transliteration: kapAlaM brahmaNo rudraH sarveShAmeva pashyatAm | hastAtpatantamAlokya nanarta parayA mudA
verses.translation: O Visnu, I have been engaged in subduing you either through humility or through force, by Rudra the lord of gods, the lord of all.

verses.sanskrit: विधेः कपालं नामुञ्चत्करमत्यन्तदुस्सहम् । परस्य भ्रमतः क्वापि तत्काश्यां क्षणतोऽपतत्
verses.transliteration: vidheH kapAlaM nAmu~nchatkaramatyantadussaham | parasya bhramataH kvApi tatkAshyAM kShaNato.apatat
verses.translation: After tearing to pieces a single demon you roar by your arrogance. Actually you are free from slumber only because you are endowed with a digit of his power.
verses.hindi: सुरभि नामक पलीके गर्भसे अवतार ग्रहण किया

verses.sanskrit: शूलिनो ब्रह्मणो हत्या नापैति स्म च या क्वचित् । सा काश्यां क्षणतो नष्टा तस्मात्सेव्या हि काशिका
verses.transliteration: shUlino brahmaNo hatyA nApaiti sma cha yA kvachit | sA kAshyAM kShaNato naShTA tasmAtsevyA hi kAshikA
verses.translation: O Nrsiriiha, if you consider lord Siva as a mere living being you are ignorant, very arrogant and full of aberrations in every respect.

verses.sanskrit: अथायान्तं महाकालं त्रिनेत्रं सर्पकुण्डलम् । महादेवांशसम्भूतं पूर्णाकारं च भैरवम्
verses.transliteration: athAyAntaM mahAkAlaM trinetraM sarpakuNDalam | mahAdevAMshasambhUtaM pUrNAkAraM cha bhairavam
verses.translation: O base Nrsiriiha, you arc neither creator nor sustainer, nor annihilator. You are subservient and deluded in mind. You are not independent anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: कपालमोचनं काश्यां यः स्मरेत्तीर्थमुत्तमम् । इहान्यत्रापि यत्पापं क्षिप्रं तस्य प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: kapAlamochanaM kAshyAM yaH smarettIrthamuttamam | ihAnyatrApi yatpApaM kShipraM tasya praNashyati
verses.translation: O Visnu, like the potter's wheel you are forcibly induced by Siva when you take the different incarnations. You are always dependent on him.
verses.hindi: रक्षाके लिये सदा स्वर्गमें विराजमान हैं

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य तीर्थप्रवरे स्नानं कृत्वा विधानतः । तर्पयित्वा पितॄन्देवान्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: Agatya tIrthapravare snAnaM kR^itvA vidhAnataH | tarpayitvA pitR^IndevAnmuchyate brahmahatyayA
verses.translation: Your skull, left by you in the midst of the necklace of Siva, while you.had assumed the form of a tortoise, is still there. None who is burnt is bound. Is it your partial forgetfulness that in your body as a Boar your fangs were felled by the slayer of Taraka

verses.sanskrit: कपालमोचनं तीर्थं पुरस्कृत्वा तु भैरवः । तत्रैव तस्थौ भक्तानां भक्षयन्नघसन्ततिम्
verses.transliteration: kapAlamochanaM tIrthaM puraskR^itvA tu bhairavaH | tatraiva tasthau bhaktAnAM bhakShayannaghasantatim
verses.translation: You were burnt by the fire of the Trident, O Visvaksena. At the time of Daksa's sacrifice your head was cut off by me brilliant in form.
verses.hindi: लोकोंमें विभक्त होकर चारों ओर सर्वत्र स्थित हैं

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाष्टम्यां तु मार्गस्य मासस्य परमेश्वरः । आविर्बभूव सल्लीलो भैरवात्मा सतां प्रियः
verses.transliteration: kR^iShNAShTamyAM tu mArgasya mAsasya parameshvaraH | AvirbabhUva sallIlo bhairavAtmA satAM priyaH
verses.translation: O Vi?nu, the fifth head of Brahma your son, which was cut, has not been set right even now. It is for¬ gotten by you.

verses.sanskrit: मार्गशीर्षासिताष्टम्यां कालभैरवसन्निधौ । उपोष्य जागरं कुर्वन्महापापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: mArgashIrShAsitAShTamyAM kAlabhairavasannidhau | upoShya jAgaraM kurvanmahApApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: This versf as well as the fourth foot of the previous verse is defective.
verses.hindi: तथा सम्पूर्ण मनोरथोंको पूर्ण करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्रापि नरो भक्त्या तद् व्रतं यः करिष्यति । सजागरं महापापैर्मुक्तो यास्यति सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: anyatrApi naro bhaktyA tad vrataM yaH kariShyati | sajAgaraM mahApApairmukto yAsyati sadgatim
verses.translation: In a battle you were defeated by Dadhica along with the gods.** How can it be forgotten by you while scratching your head?
verses.hindi: भोगकर अन्तमें मुक्ति प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: अनेकजन्मनियुतैर्यत्कृतं जन्तुभिस्त्वघम् । तत्सर्वं विलयं याति कालभैरवदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: anekajanmaniyutairyatkR^itaM jantubhistvagham | tatsarvaM vilayaM yAti kAlabhairavadarshanAt
verses.translation: O discus-armed one, you are fond of your discus but you have forgotten whence you got it and by whom it was made.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां एकादशावतारवर्णन॑ नामाष्टादशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: कालभैरवभक्तानां पातकानि करोति यः । स मूढो दुःखितो भूत्वा पुनर्दुर्गतिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: kAlabhairavabhaktAnAM pAtakAni karoti yaH | sa mUDho duHkhito bhUtvA punardurgatimApnuyAt
verses.translation: Whatever worlds I have seized, in them, you lie down in the ocean, overcome by sleep. How can you then be a Sattvika?
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेश्वरेऽपि ये भक्ता नो भक्ताः कालभैरवे । ते लभन्ते महादुःखं काश्यां चैव विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: vishveshvare.api ye bhaktA no bhaktAH kAlabhairave | te labhante mahAduHkhaM kAshyAM chaiva visheShataH
verses.translation: From you to a blade of grass, every thing expands and develops only through Rudra's power. Professing to possess power you have been deluded by the fire all round.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणस्यामुषित्वा यो भैरवं न भजेन्नरः । तस्य पापानि वर्द्धन्ते शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी
verses.transliteration: vArANasyAmuShitvA yo bhairavaM na bhajennaraH | tasya pApAni varddhante shuklapakShe yathA shashI
verses.translation: Lord Siva manifests himself in between heaven and earth, Indra and Agni, Yama and Varuna, in the heart of darkness and in the light of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: पपात दण्डवद्भूमौ तं दृष्ट्वा गरुडध्वजः । देवाश्च मुनयश्चैव देवनार्य्यः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: papAta daNDavadbhUmau taM dR^iShTvA garuDadhvajaH | devAshcha munayashchaiva devanAryyaH samantataH
verses.translation: You and the four-faced Brahma arc not the rulers of the world. Nor any one else is the ruler. Siva is certainly the ruler of all.
verses.hindi: पवित्र और बहुत बड़ी अग्निज्वाला प्रकट हुई

verses.sanskrit: कालराजं न यः काश्यां प्रतिभूताष्टमीकुजम् । भजेत्तस्य क्षयं पुण्यं कृष्णपक्षे यथा शशी
verses.transliteration: kAlarAjaM na yaH kAshyAM pratibhUtAShTamIkujam | bhajettasya kShayaM puNyaM kR^iShNapakShe yathA shashI
verses.translation: Thus taking everything in consideration you sub¬ due yourself by yourself. O Man-lion, O wise one, keep your¬ self safe.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वाख्यानमिदं पुण्यं ब्रह्महत्यापनोदकम् । भैरवोत्पत्तिसंज्ञं च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: shrutvAkhyAnamidaM puNyaM brahmahatyApanodakam | bhairavotpattisa.nj~naM cha sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: Otherwise death will befall you like a thunderbolt on a stump due to the fury of the lord in the form of Bhairava.

verses.sanskrit: बन्धनागारसंस्थोऽपि प्राप्तोऽपि विपदं पराम् । प्रादुर्भावं भैरवस्य श्रुत्वा मुच्येत सङ्कटात्
verses.transliteration: bandhanAgArasaMstho.api prApto.api vipadaM parAm | prAdurbhAvaM bhairavasya shrutvA muchyeta sa~NkaTAt
verses.translation: After saying this and observing the view of the Man-lion, Virabhadra the furious form of Siva, stopped. He was not afraid of anyone.
verses.hindi: शिवजीको प्रणाम करके उनकी स्तुति कौ

verses.sanskrit: अथ विष्णुः प्रणम्यैनं प्रयातः कमलापतिः । शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय तुष्टाव विविधैः स्तवैः
verses.transliteration: atha viShNuH praNamyainaM prayAtaH kamalApatiH | shirasya~njalimAdhAya tuShTAva vividhaiH stavaiH
verses.translation: For details see RS. Satikharda. cji. 39-
verses.hindi: अत्रिके तपसे एक ज्वाला उत्पन्न हुई है

verses.sanskrit: सानन्दोऽथ हरिः प्राह प्रसन्नात्मा महामुने । क्षीरोदमथनोद्भूतां पद्मां पद्मालयां मुदा
verses.transliteration: sAnando.atha hariH prAha prasannAtmA mahAmune | kShIrodamathanodbhUtAM padmAM padmAlayAM mudA
verses.translation: Thus admonished by Virabhadra, the Man-lion be came furious. He roared and began to seize him with force.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Then in a trice the form of Virabhadra became invisible. The splendour of Lord Siva was neither golden nor fiery, neither lunar nor solar. It resembled neither the lightning nor the moon. It was beyond comparison. The forms of brilliance were merged in Siva.
verses.hindi: स्थिति तथा प्रलय करनेवाले माने गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Then in a trice the form of Virabhadra became invisible. The splendour of Lord Siva was neither golden nor fiery, neither lunar nor solar. It resembled neither the lightning nor the moon. It was beyond comparison. The forms of brilliance were merged in Siva.
verses.hindi: संशयको दूरकर मुझे अभीष्ट वर दीजिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । नृसिंहचरितवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । विध्वंसी दक्षयज्ञस्य वीरभद्राह्वयः प्रभोः । अवतारश्च विज्ञेयः शिवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.10\. dashamo.adhyAyaH | nR^isiMhacharitavarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | vidhvaMsI dakShayaj~nasya vIrabhadrAhvayaH prabhoH | avatArashcha vij~neyaH shivasya paramAtmanaH
verses.translation: Even as all the gods stood watching with the auspi¬ cious shouts of victory. Lord Siva became manifest in the form the Annihilator.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुश्चाद्यो हिरण्याक्षोऽनुजो बली । देवर्षिपार्षदौ जातौ तौ द्वावपि दितेः सुतौ
verses.transliteration: hiraNyakashipushchAdyo hiraNyAkSho.anujo balI | devarShipArShadau jAtau tau dvAvapi diteH sutau
verses.translation: He had a thousand hands and wore matted hair. His head was adorned by the crescent moon. He appeared like a bird with wings and beak. His body was fierce and fully developed.

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्व्युद्धारे विधात्रा व प्रार्थितो हि पुरा प्रभुः । हिरण्याक्षं जघानासौ विष्णुर्वाराहरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: pR^ithvyuddhAre vidhAtrA va prArthito hi purA prabhuH | hiraNyAkShaM jaghAnAsau viShNurvArAharUpadhR^ik
verses.translation: His fangs were very sharp. Adamantine claws were his weapons. His neck was black in colour. He had huge arms and four legs. He was blazing like fire.

verses.sanskrit: तं श्रुत्वा भ्रातरं वीरं निहतं प्राणसन्निभम् । चुकोप हरयेऽतीव हिरण्यकशिपुर्मुने
verses.transliteration: taM shrutvA bhrAtaraM vIraM nihataM prANasannibham | chukopa haraye.atIva hiraNyakashipurmune
verses.translation: His fangs and lips were clearly visible. He was pro¬ ducing a hissing sound of Hurhkara. Siva of such a form appeared in sight.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाणामयुतं तप्त्वा ब्रह्मणो वरमाप सः । न कश्चिन्मारयेन्मां वै त्वत्सृष्टाविति तुष्टतः
verses.transliteration: varShANAmayutaM taptvA brahmaNo varamApa saH | na kashchinmArayenmAM vai tvatsR^iShTAviti tuShTataH
verses.translation: At his very vision Visnu lost his strength and exploit. He assumed a lustre of the flickering glow-worm beneath the sun. *

verses.sanskrit: शोणिताख्यपुरं गत्वा देवानाहूय सर्वतः । त्रिलोकीं स्ववशे कृत्वा चक्रे राज्यमकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: shoNitAkhyapuraM gatvA devAnAhUya sarvataH | trilokIM svavashe kR^itvA chakre rAjyamakaNTakam
verses.translation: Like a vulture seizing a serpent he fearlessly caught hold of Visnu, lifted him up and fell him to the ground. At the time of flight he was excessively oppressed,

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षिकदनं चक्रे सर्वधर्मविलोपकः । द्विजपीडाकरः पापी हिरण्यकशिपुर्मुने
verses.transliteration: devarShikadanaM chakre sarvadharmavilopakaH | dvijapIDAkaraH pApI hiraNyakashipurmune
verses.translation: All the gods followed him eulogising him with the words of obeisance. Brahma and other sages bowed to him with reverence and love.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्लादेन स्वपुत्रेण हरिभक्तेन दैत्यराट् । यदा विद्वेषमकरोद्धरिर्वैरी विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: prahlAdena svaputreNa haribhaktena daityarAT | yadA vidveShamakaroddharirvairI visheShataH
verses.translation: After eulogising Mrda with the hundred and eight names of the lord, Nrsirhha requested lord larabha again.
verses.hindi: लिये उन्होंने वहाँ बहुत विलम्ब कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: सभास्तम्भात्तदा विष्णुरभूदाविर्द्रुतं मने । सन्ध्यायां क्रोधमापन्नो नृसिंहवपुषा ततः
verses.transliteration: sabhAstambhAttadA viShNurabhUdAvirdrutaM mane | sandhyAyAM krodhamApanno nR^isiMhavapuShA tataH
verses.translation: "O great lord, whenever my ignorant mind be¬ comes defiled by arrogance, it shall be removed by you alone.**

verses.sanskrit: सर्वथा मुनिशार्दूल करालं नृहरेर्वपुः । प्रजज्वालातिभयदं त्रासयन्दैत्यसत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: sarvathA munishArdUla karAlaM nR^iharervapuH | prajajvAlAtibhayadaM trAsayandaityasattamAn
verses.translation: Within a trice Virabhadra made his powerful body powerless and dead.

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंहेन तदा दैत्या निहताश्चैव तत्क्षणम् । हिरण्यकशिपुश्चाथ युद्धं चक्रे सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: nR^isiMhena tadA daityA nihatAshchaiva tatkShaNam | hiraNyakashipushchAtha yuddhaM chakre sudAruNam
verses.translation: Then Brahma and other gods eulogised lord Siva who had assumed the form of a Sarabha and who was the sole benefactor of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सतीचरित्रे कथितं चरितं तस्य कृत्स्नशः । श्रुतं त्वयापि बहुधा नातः प्रोक्तं सुविस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: satIcharitre kathitaM charitaM tasya kR^itsnashaH | shrutaM tvayApi bahudhA nAtaH proktaM suvistarAt
verses.translation: O lord Siva, Brahma, Vi?nu, Indra, the Moon, the gods, the sages, and the Daityas are born of you.
verses.hindi: उन्हें शिवांश जानकर पूर्ण रूपसे शान्त हो गया

verses.sanskrit: महायुद्धं तयोरासीन्मुहूर्त्तं मुनिसत्तमाः । विकरालं च भयदं सर्वेषां रोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: mahAyuddhaM tayorAsInmuhUrttaM munisattamAH | vikarAlaM cha bhayadaM sarveShAM romaharShaNam
verses.translation: O lord of all, you alone create and protect Brahma

verses.sanskrit: सायं चकर्ष देवेशो देहल्यां दैत्यपुङ्गवम् । व्योम्नि देवेषु पश्यत्सु नृसिंहश्च रमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sAyaM chakarSha devesho dehalyAM daityapu~Ngavam | vyomni deveShu pashyatsu nR^isiMhashcha rameshvaraH
verses.translation: Since you annihilate the world, you are called Hara by the learned. Since Visnu was curbed and caught hold of by you, you are called Hara by the learned.

verses.sanskrit: अथोत्सङ्गे च तं कृत्वा नखैस्तदुदरं द्रुतम् । विदार्य मारयामास पश्यतां त्रिदिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: athotsa~Nge cha taM kR^itvA nakhaistadudaraM drutam | vidArya mArayAmAsa pashyatAM tridivaukasAm
verses.translation: Vou are the great Purusa, Siva, lord of all, leader of the gods, the soul of the indigent, of a mind without aberrations. You are the great Brahman, the goal of the good.

verses.sanskrit: हते हिरण्यकशिपौ नृसिंहेनैव विष्णुना । जगत्स्वास्थ्यं तदा लेभे न वै देवा विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: hate hiraNyakashipau nR^isiMhenaiva viShNunA | jagatsvAsthyaM tadA lebhe na vai devA visheShataH
verses.translation: You are the kinsman of the distressed, the ocean of mercy, of wonderful sports, the vision of the great soul, the intelligent, the Immense Cosmic Being, the all-pervasive, the truth, the Existence, knowledge and Bliss as the charac¬ teristics.
verses.hindi: इच्छासे वे (दुर्वासा) मुनि कृष्णके पास पहुँचे

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः प्रह्लादो विस्मयं गतः । लक्ष्मीश्च विस्मयं प्राप्ता रूपं दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं हरेः
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayo neduH prahlAdo vismayaM gataH | lakShmIshcha vismayaM prAptA rUpaM dR^iShTvA.adbhutaM hareH
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the gods, iva, the great God, spoke to the gods and the great ancient sages.

verses.sanskrit: हतो यद्यपि दैत्येन्द्रस्तथापि न परं सुखम् । ययुर्देवा नृसिंहस्य ज्वाला सा न निवर्तिता
verses.transliteration: hato yadyapi daityendrastathApi na paraM sukham | yayurdevA nR^isiMhasya jvAlA sA na nivartitA
verses.translation: Just as water poured into water, or milk poured into milk, or ghee poured into ghee becomes one with those
verses.hindi: वज्र्के समान अंगवाला होनेका वर दिया

verses.sanskrit: तया च व्याकुलं जातं सर्वं चैव जगत्पुनः । देवाश्च दुःखमापन्नाः किं भविष्यति वा पुनः
verses.transliteration: tayA cha vyAkulaM jAtaM sarvaM chaiva jagatpunaH | devAshcha duHkhamApannAH kiM bhaviShyati vA punaH
verses.translation: He shall be prayed and bowed by my devotees aspiring achievements. He is the foremost of my devotees and the granter of boons.
verses.hindi: प्रदान करके उनकी लज्जाको ढँक दिया था

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं च वदन्तस्ते भयादू दूरमुपस्थिताः । नृसिंहक्रोधजज्वालाव्याकुलाः पद्मभूमुखाः
verses.transliteration: ityevaM cha vadantaste bhayAdU dUramupasthitAH | nR^isiMhakrodhajajvAlAvyAkulAH padmabhUmukhAH
verses.translation: After saying this, the lordly king of birds of great strength, vanished there itself even as all the gods were watching.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्रादं प्रेषयामासुस्तच्छान्त्यै निकटं हरेः । सर्वान्मिलित्वा प्रह्लादः प्रार्थितो गतवांस्तदा
verses.transliteration: prahrAdaM preShayAmAsustachChAntyai nikaTaM hareH | sarvAnmilitvA prahlAdaH prArthito gatavAMstadA
verses.translation: Lord Virabhadra, the leader of the Ganas, of great strength, peeled off the hide of the Man-lion and went to the mountain taking it with him.
verses.hindi: श्रीकृष्णको सन्देश देकर उनका नाश करवाया

verses.sanskrit: उरसाऽऽलिङ्गयामास तं नृसिंहः कृपानिधिः । हृदयं शीतलं जातं रुड्ज्वाला न निवर्त्तिता
verses.transliteration: urasA.a.ali~NgayAmAsa taM nR^isiMhaH kR^ipAnidhiH | hR^idayaM shItalaM jAtaM ruDjvAlA na nivarttitA
verses.translation: From that time Siva began to wear the hide of

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं मुनिश्रेष्ठ भवत्स्नेहाद् ब्रवीमि तत् । शार्दूलाख्यावतारं च शङ्करस्य प्रभोः शृणु
verses.transliteration: ataH paraM munishreShTha bhavatsnehAd bravImi tat | shArdUlAkhyAvatAraM cha sha~Nkarasya prabhoH shR^iNu
verses.translation: Then the gods freed from their distress began to sing the glory of this story. With their eyes blooming with wonder they returned the way they came.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि न निवृता रुड्ज्वाला नरहरेर्यदा । दुःखं प्राप्तास्ततो देवाः शङ्कर शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: tathApi na nivR^itA ruDjvAlA narahareryadA | duHkhaM prAptAstato devAH sha~Nkara sharaNaM yayuH
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to the great narrative, which being sacred has the flavour of the Vedas, will realise all hk desires

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्माद्या मुनयस्तथा । शङ्करं स्तवयामासुर्लोकानां सुखहेतवे
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvA surAH sarve brahmAdyA munayastathA | sha~NkaraM stavayAmAsurlokAnAM sukhahetave
verses.translation: It subdues misery, yields the fruits of desires and is the abode of auspicious features. It removes premature death, confers intelligence and destroys enemies.
verses.hindi: लोकमें एवं परलोकमें सुखी रहता है

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । देवदेव महादेव शरणागतवत्सल । पाहि नः शरणापन्नान्सर्वान्देवाञ्जगन्ति च
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH | devadeva mahAdeva sharaNAgatavatsala | pAhi naH sharaNApannAnsarvAndevA~njaganti cha
verses.translation: This great form of Siva in the form of Sarabha shall be made public only among the leading devotees of Siva.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरद्रसंहितायां दुर्वासश्नर्तवर्णन॑ नामैकोनविंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु सदाशिव । पूर्वं दुःखं यदा जातं तदा ते रक्षिता वयम्
verses.transliteration: namaste.astu namaste.astu namaste.astu sadAshiva | pUrvaM duHkhaM yadA jAtaM tadA te rakShitA vayam
verses.translation: This shall be read and listened to only by them with their soul dedicated to Siva. It then confers the nine¬ fold devotion. It is divine. It purifies the inner mind and sense.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक उन्‍नीसवाँ अध्याय पूरा हुआ

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रो मथितश्चैव रत्नानां च विभागशः । कृते देवैस्तदा शम्भो गृहीतं गरलं त्वया
verses.transliteration: samudro mathitashchaiva ratnAnAM cha vibhAgashaH | kR^ite devaistadA shambho gR^ihItaM garalaM tvayA
verses.translation: This shall be read during the festivals of Siva, during the eighth and fourteenth Tithis, and at the instal¬ lation of the idol. It then causes the presence of Siva.
verses.hindi: तत्सर्व चरितं विप्र श्रुणु सर्वसुखावहम्॥ २  उस सम्पूर्ण चरित्रका श्रवण कौजिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्षिताः स्म तदा नाथ नीलकण्ठ इति श्रुतः । विषं पास्यसि नो चेत्त्वं भस्मीभूतास्तदाखिलाः
verses.transliteration: rakShitAH sma tadA nAtha nIlakaNTha iti shrutaH | viShaM pAsyasi no chettvaM bhasmIbhUtAstadAkhilAH
verses.translation: When there is danger from thieves, tigers, lions, one's own or enemy kings, during commotions earth¬ quakes and robberies, dust storms, when there is the fall of meteors, when there is draught or too much of rain—during all these occasions he who reads this with purity becomes a great devotee of Siva steady in his rites and very learned.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसिद्धं च यदा यस्य दुःखं च जायते प्रभो । तदा त्वन्नाममात्रेण सर्वं दुःखं विलीयते
verses.transliteration: prasiddhaM cha yadA yasya duHkhaM cha jAyate prabho | tadA tvannAmamAtreNa sarvaM duHkhaM vilIyate
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this without any spe¬ cific desire and performs the rites of Siva attains Rudra's region and becomes a follower of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं नृहरिज्वालापीडितान्नः सदाशिव । तां त्वं शमयितुं देव शक्तोऽसीति सुनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: idAnIM nR^iharijvAlApIDitAnnaH sadAshiva | tAM tvaM shamayituM deva shakto.asIti sunishchitam
verses.translation: O sage, after attaining Rudra's region he rejoices with Rudra. Then he becomes one with Rudra by the mercy of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति स्तुतस्तदा देवैः शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्माऽभयं दत्त्वा परं प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti stutastadA devaiH sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH | pratyuvAcha prasannAtmA.abhayaM dattvA paraM prabhuH
verses.translation: O son of Brahma, listen lovingly to the narrative of the moon-crestcd lord $iva how he was bom willingly in tlie house ofVivanara.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । स्वस्थानं गच्छत सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्मादयोऽभयाः । शमयिष्यामि यद्दुःखं सर्वथा हि व्रतं मम
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | svasthAnaM gachChata surAH sarve brahmAdayo.abhayAH | shamayiShyAmi yadduHkhaM sarvathA hi vrataM mama
verses.translation: On the beautiful banks of Narmada in the city of Dharmapura, formerly there lived a devotee of Siva, a soul, the sage Vivanara.
verses.hindi: छोटा फल जानकर निगल गये थे

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवेन देवानां हितार्थं रूपमद्भुतम् । शारभं च धृतं दिव्यं ज्वलज्ज्वालासमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: sadAshivena devAnAM hitArthaM rUpamadbhutam | shArabhaM cha dhR^itaM divyaM jvalajjvAlAsamaprabham
verses.translation: He understood the real meaning of sacred lord. He followed the conduct of the virtuous. He was highly skilled in Siva ethics. He was the foremost among the knowers of worldly conventions.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंके द्वारा प्रदत्त वरोंको उन्होंने प्राप्त किया

verses.sanskrit: गतो मच्छरणं यस्तु तस्य दुःखं क्षयं गतम् । मत्प्रियः शरणापन्नः प्राणेभ्योऽपि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: gato machCharaNaM yastu tasya duHkhaM kShayaM gatam | matpriyaH sharaNApannaH prANebhyo.api na saMshayaH
verses.translation: After pondering over the good qualities of an ideal housewife, Viivanara married with due rites the daughter of Kala who was really worthy of him.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा तदा देवा ह्यानन्दम्परमं गताः । यथागतं तथा जग्मुः स्मरन्तः शङ्करं मुदा
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti shrutvA tadA devA hyAnandamparamaM gatAH | yathAgataM tathA jagmuH smarantaH sha~NkaraM mudA
verses.translation: The five daily sacrifices to be performed by a householder

verses.sanskrit: शिवावतारा अमिताः सद्भक्तहितकारकाः । सङ्ख्या न शक्यते कर्तुं तेषां च मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: shivAvatArA amitAH sadbhaktahitakArakAH | sa~NkhyA na shakyate kartuM teShAM cha munisattamAH
verses.translation: The six acts enjoined on a Brihmana are mentioned in MS lo. 75:

verses.sanskrit: आकाशस्य च ताराणां रेणुकानां क्षितेस्तथा । आसाराणां च वृद्धेन बहुकल्पैः कदापि हि
verses.transliteration: AkAshasya cha tArANAM reNukAnAM kShitestathA | AsArANAM cha vR^iddhena bahukalpaiH kadApi hi
verses.translation: When a long time elapsed in that manner lucismati the wife of that Brahmana who observed all rites spoje to her husband.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्ख्या विशक्यते कर्तुं सुप्राज्ञैर्बहुजन्मभिः । न वै शिवावताराणां सत्यं जानीहि मद्वचः
verses.transliteration: sa~NkhyA vishakyate kartuM suprAj~nairbahujanmabhiH | na vai shivAvatArANAM satyaM jAnIhi madvachaH
verses.translation: "O Lord, by your favour, all pleasures which women could expect have been enjoyed by me in your company.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि च यथाबुद्ध्या कथयामि यथाश्रुतम् । चरित्रं शारभं दिव्यं परमैश्वर्यसूचकम्
verses.transliteration: tathApi cha yathAbuddhyA kathayAmi yathAshrutam | charitraM shArabhaM divyaM paramaishvaryasUchakam
verses.translation: O Lord, still a desire has been lurking in my heart for a long time.!♦ is proper to all householders. You shall grant it to me.

verses.sanskrit: जयश्च विजयश्चैव भवद्भिः शापितौ यदा । तदा दितिसुतौ द्वौ तावभूतां कश्यपान्मुने
verses.transliteration: jayashcha vijayashchaiva bhavadbhiH shApitau yadA | tadA ditisutau dvau tAvabhUtAM kashyapAnmune
verses.translation: O gentle lady of beautiful hips ever desirous of my welfare, what is there that cannot be granted to you? O lucky one, you may ask for it. I shall grant it to you with¬ out ielay.
verses.hindi: शीघ्र ही उनके शोकको दूर कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: On hearing these words of her husband she who thought her husband to be a deity was delighted. Joining her palms in reverence she humbly said.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: On hearing these words of her husband she who thought her husband to be a deity was delighted. Joining her palms in reverence she humbly said.
verses.hindi: मारकर वहाँ लंकामें महान् उपद्रव किया

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.११. एकादशोऽध्यायः । शरभावतारवर्णनम् १ । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमभ्यर्थितो देवैर्मतिं चक्रे कृपालयः । महातेजो नृसिंहाख्यं संहर्त्तुं परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.11\. ekAdasho.adhyAyaH | sharabhAvatAravarNanam 1 | nandIshvara uvAcha | evamabhyarthito devairmatiM chakre kR^ipAlayaH | mahAtejo nR^isiMhAkhyaM saMharttuM parameshvaraH
verses.translation: On hearing her words that Brahmin of pure rites entered into mystic trance for a short while and thought in his heart thus.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं विज्ञापयामास किमत्र स्मृतिकारणम् । आज्ञापय जगत्स्वामिन् प्रसादः क्रियतां मयि
verses.transliteration: svayaM vij~nApayAmAsa kimatra smR^itikAraNam | Aj~nApaya jagatsvAmin prasAdaH kriyatAM mayi
verses.translation: After thinking like this, the sage Visvanara of liberal heart who strictly adhered to the principle of mono¬ gamy spoke to her.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य महेशानो वीरभद्रोक्तमादरात् । विलोक्य वचनं प्रीत्या प्रोवाच खलदण्डधृक्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAkarNya maheshAno vIrabhadroktamAdarAt | vilokya vachanaM prItyA provAcha khaladaNDadhR^ik
verses.translation: After consoling his wife, the sage set out for pen¬ ance to the city of Varana- • where Lord Jiva himself is stationed.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । अकाले भयमुत्पन्नं देवानामपि भैरवम् । ज्वलितः स नृसिंहाग्निः शमयैनं दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | akAle bhayamutpannaM devAnAmapi bhairavam | jvalitaH sa nR^isiMhAgniH shamayainaM durAsadam
verses.translation: Reaching Varanasi immediately and seeing Mani- karnika"®, he was freed from three distresses acquired in the course of hundreds of births.

verses.sanskrit: सान्त्वयन् बोधयादौ तं तेन किन्नोपशाम्यति । ततो मत्परमं भावं भैरवं सम्प्रदर्शय
verses.transliteration: sAntvayan bodhayAdau taM tena kinnopashAmyati | tato matparamaM bhAvaM bhairavaM sampradarshaya
verses.translation: He saw Visvevara and other phallic images. He performed ablutions in all holy ditches, wells, tanks and lakes.

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मं संहृत्य सूक्ष्मेण स्थूलं स्थूलेन तेजसा । वशमानय वन्हिं त्वं वीरभद्र ममाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: sUkShmaM saMhR^itya sUkShmeNa sthUlaM sthUlena tejasA | vashamAnaya vanhiM tvaM vIrabhadra mamAj~nayA
verses.translation: He bDwed to all Vinayakas and Sarva Gauri. He worshipped Kalaraja Bhairava who devours sins.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्यादिष्टो गणाध्यक्षो प्रशान्तं वपुरास्थितः । जगाम रंहसा तत्र यत्रास्ते नरकेसरी
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAdiShTo gaNAdhyakSho prashAntaM vapurAsthitaH | jagAma raMhasA tatra yatrAste narakesarI
verses.translation: Strenuously he eulogised Dandanayaka and other Ganas, Adikeava and others. He propitiated Ke.-iava.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सम्बोधयामास वीरभद्रो हरो हरिम् । उवाच वाक्यमीशानः पितापुत्रमिवौरसम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sambodhayAmAsa vIrabhadro haro harim | uvAcha vAkyamIshAnaH pitAputramivaurasam
verses.translation: He bowed to Lolarka and other suns again and again. Without lethargy he offered balls of rice in all the holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्र उवाच । जगत्सुखाय भगवन्नवतीर्णोऽसि माधव । स्थित्यर्थं त्वं प्रयुक्तोऽसि परेशः परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: vIrabhadra uvAcha | jagatsukhAya bhagavannavatIrNo.asi mAdhava | sthityarthaM tvaM prayukto.asi pareshaH parameShThinA
verses.translation: He satiated sages and brahmins by means of *-'feed- ing thousand" and other rites. With devotion he propitiated the phallic images of Siva by means of great worship and service.

verses.sanskrit: जन्तुचक्रं भगवता प्रच्छन्नं मत्स्यरूपिणा । पुच्छेनैव समाबध्य भ्रमन्नेकार्णवे पुरा
verses.transliteration: jantuchakraM bhagavatA prachChannaM matsyarUpiNA | puchChenaiva samAbadhya bhramannekArNave purA
verses.translation: Thinking thus for a moment, the intelligent sage Visvanara praised the VireSa form of Siva which confers the blessings of a son immediately.

verses.sanskrit: बिभर्षि कूर्मरूपेण वाराहेणोद्धृता मही । अनेन हरिरूपेण हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः
verses.transliteration: bibharShi kUrmarUpeNa vArAheNoddhR^itA mahI | anena harirUpeNa hiraNyakashipurhataH
verses.translation: Innumerable thousands of Siddhas have derived the fulfilment of their desire from the worship of Siva. Hence Virea is famous as the fruit-yielding phallic image.

verses.sanskrit: तदूर्ध्वं स्मृतवान् रुद्रो वीरभद्रं महाबलम् । आत्मनो भैरवं रूपं प्राह प्रलयकारकम्
verses.transliteration: tadUrdhvaM smR^itavAn rudro vIrabhadraM mahAbalam | Atmano bhairavaM rUpaM prAha pralayakArakam
verses.translation: If any one worships the Viresvara phallic image for a year with great devotion he obtains longevity, cherished desires, sons and other things.
verses.hindi: भोगकर अन्‍्तमें परम मोक्षको प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: वामनेन बलिर्बद्धस्त्वया विक्रमता पुनः । त्वमेव सर्वभूतानां प्रभवः प्रभुरव्ययः
verses.transliteration: vAmanena balirbaddhastvayA vikramatA punaH | tvameva sarvabhUtAnAM prabhavaH prabhuravyayaH
verses.translation: T too shall worship Virea here thrice a day and shall ere long acquire a son as desired by my wife.
verses.hindi: झ््ति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां हनुमदवतारचरित्रवर्णन॑ नाम विंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि लोकस्य दुःखं किञ्चित्प्रजायते । तदा तदावतीर्णस्त्वं करिष्यसि निरामयम्
verses.transliteration: yadA yadA hi lokasya duHkhaM ki~nchitprajAyate | tadA tadAvatIrNastvaM kariShyasi nirAmayam
verses.translation: After thinking like this, the intelligent brahmin,
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: नाधिकस्त्वत्समोऽप्यस्ति हरे शिवपरायणः । त्वया वेदाश्च धर्माश्च शुभमार्गे प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: nAdhikastvatsamo.apyasti hare shivaparAyaNaH | tvayA vedAshcha dharmAshcha shubhamArge pratiShThitAH
verses.translation: For a month he lived on a single meal *a day. For another month he took only the night-meal. He spent another month taking only the food he got without begging. He spent another month without any food. For another month he took only milk. For another month he took only fruits and vegetables. For another month he ate only a handful of gingelly seeds. For another month he took liquid diet. For another month he took only Pailcagavya. For another month he performed the Gandrayana rite. For an¬ other month he drank water from the tip of Kua grass and for another month he had air alone as his food.

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थमवतारोऽयं निहतः स हि दानवः । हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव प्रह्लादोऽपि सुरक्षितः
