verses.transliteration: yadarthamavatAro.ayaM nihataH sa hi dAnavaH | hiraNyakashipushchaiva prahlAdo.api surakShitaH
verses.translation: Thus for a full year he performed the wonderful penance. He worshipped the excellent VireSa thrice a day.
verses.hindi: दोनों ही परमेश्वर परम प्रसन्‍न हुए

verses.sanskrit: अतीव घोरं भगवन्नरसिंहवपुस्तव । उपसंहर विश्वात्मंस्त्वमेव मम सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: atIva ghoraM bhagavannarasiMhavapustava | upasaMhara vishvAtmaMstvameva mama sannidhau
verses.translation: On the thirteenth month while he was going to Virea after taking bath in the Gahga river very early in the morning, the sage saw a child of eight years smeared with ashes all over the body, in the middle of the phallic image.
verses.hindi: उन्मत्त वेषमें शिवजीकी आज्ञासे द्वारपर आयीं

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः शान्तया गिरा । ततोऽधिकं महाघोरं कोपं चक्रे महामदः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityukto vIrabhadreNa nR^isiMhaH shAntayA girA | tato.adhikaM mahAghoraM kopaM chakre mahAmadaH
verses.translation: The child had eyes as long as his ears. He had ruddy lips. He had matted hair of beautiful tawny colour. He was naked and had a smiling face.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच च महाघोरं कठिनं वचनं तदा । वीरभद्रं महावीरं दंष्ट्राभिर्भीषयन्मुने
verses.transliteration: uvAcha cha mahAghoraM kaThinaM vachanaM tadA | vIrabhadraM mahAvIraM daMShTrAbhirbhIShayanmune
verses.translation: He had all the dress and features proper to child¬ hood. He seemed intelligent. He was reciting hymns from the Vedas. He was laughing sp>ortively.
verses.hindi: गयीं और उन अम्बिकाने उन्हें शाप दे दिया

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंह उवाच । आगतोऽसि यतस्तत्र गच्छ त्वं मा हितं वद । इदानीं संहरिष्यामि जगदेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: nR^isiMha uvAcha | Agato.asi yatastatra gachCha tvaM mA hitaM vada | idAnIM saMhariShyAmi jagadetachcharAcharam
verses.translation: The contented Vaivanara eulogised iSiva, the great bliss in the form of child by means of eight verses that gave expression to his desire.

verses.sanskrit: संहर्तुर्न हि संहारः स्वतो वा परतोऽपि वा । शासिनं मम सर्वत्र शास्ता कोऽपि न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: saMharturna hi saMhAraH svato vA parato.api vA | shAsinaM mama sarvatra shAstA ko.api na vidyate
verses.translation: O Siva, you alone are the creator and annihilator of every thing. In the different forms you are of single form and formless. Just as the inner virtue is only one though it may seem to be many. Hence I do not resort to any one except you.
verses.hindi: पार्वतीकी इस लीलासे भेरव अत्यन्त दुखी हुए

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रसादेन सकलमभयं हि प्रवर्तते । अहं हि सर्वशक्तीनां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: matprasAdena sakalamabhayaM hi pravartate | ahaM hi sarvashaktInAM pravartakanivartakaH
verses.translation: The snake in the rope, the silver in the oyster shell, the water in the mirage —like that when he is known, the whole world vanishes and Sat alone remains. I resort to that great lod.

verses.sanskrit: आजगाम ततः सद्यो गणानामग्रणीर्हसन् । साट्टहासैर्गणवरैरुत्पतद्भिरितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: AjagAma tataH sadyo gaNAnAmagraNIrhasan | sATTahAsairgaNavarairutpatadbhiritastataH
verses.translation: Coolness in the water, heat in the fire, the scor¬ ching nature in the sun and the pleasing gentleness in the moon, fragrance in the flower and the ghee in the milk— just, in that manner, O Siva, you are the essense in the world. Hence I resort to you.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा । तत्तद्विद्धि गणाध्यक्ष मम तेजोविजृम्भितम्
verses.transliteration: yadyadvibhUtimatsattvaM shrImadUrjitameva vA | tattadviddhi gaNAdhyakSha mama tejovijR^imbhitam
verses.translation: You the earless perceive sound; you the noseless perceive fragrance; you the footless come from far; you the eyeless see; you the tongueless perceive the taste. Who knows you really? Hence I seek refuge in you.
verses.hindi: भोगकर अन्तमें मुक्तिको प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: देवताः परमार्थज्ञं मामेव परमं विदुः । मदंशाः शक्तिसम्पन्ना ब्रह्मशक्रादयः सुराः
verses.transliteration: devatAH paramArthaj~naM mAmeva paramaM viduH | madaMshAH shaktisampannA brahmashakrAdayaH surAH
verses.translation: O lord, even the Vedas do not know you directly, nor Visnu, nor the Creator of every thing, nor the leading Yogins, nor Indra and other gods. Only a devotee knows. Hence I seek refuge in you.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां महेशावतारवर्णन॑ नामैकविंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: मन्नाभिकमलाज्जातः पुरा ब्रह्मा जगत्करः । सर्वाधिकः स्वतन्त्रश्च कर्ता हर्ताखिलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: mannAbhikamalAjjAtaH purA brahmA jagatkaraH | sarvAdhikaH svatantrashcha kartA hartAkhileshvaraH
verses.translation: You have no spiritual lineage; you are unborn; you arc immortal, formless without any prescribed conduct or native land. Still you are the lord of three worlds and you fulfil all our desires. I worship you.

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु मत्परं तेजः किं पुनः श्रोतुमिच्छसि । अतो मां शरणं प्राप्य गच्छ त्वं विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration: idaM tu matparaM tejaH kiM punaH shrotumichChasi | ato mAM sharaNaM prApya gachCha tvaM vigatajvaraH
verses.translation: Everything originates from you. You are all-in-all, O enemy of Kama, you are the lord of Gauri; you are naked and quiescent; you are old, youthful and the child. Whatever is, you arc that. There is no source of your origin. I bow to you.

verses.sanskrit: अवेहि परमं भावमिदम्भूतं गणेश्वर । मामकं सकलं विश्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम्
verses.transliteration: avehi paramaM bhAvamidambhUtaM gaNeshvara | mAmakaM sakalaM vishvaM sadevAsuramAnuSham
verses.translation: After eulogising thus, when the brahmin fell on the ground with the joined hands, the boy became the aged of the aged and spoke delightedly to the brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: कालोऽस्म्यहं लोकविनाशहेतु- र्लोकान्समाहर्तुमहं प्रवृत्तः । मृत्योर्मृत्युं विद्धि मां वीरभद्र जीवन्त्येते मत्प्रसादेन देवाः
verses.transliteration: kAlo.asmyahaM lokavinAshahetu\- rlokAnsamAhartumahaM pravR^ittaH | mR^ityormR^ityuM viddhi mAM vIrabhadra jIvantyete matprasAdena devAH
verses.translation: O ViSvanara, O excellent sage, O brahmin, pro-
verses.hindi: किस उपायसे उस क्षीरसागरका मन्थन किया जाय

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । साहङ्कारं वचः श्रुत्वा हरेरमितविक्रमः । विहस्योवाच सावज्ञं ततो विस्फुरिताधरः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | sAha~NkAraM vachaH shrutvA hareramitavikramaH | vihasyovAcha sAvaj~naM tato visphuritAdharaH
verses.translation: Then the delighted and contented sage Vivanara stood up and replied to iva who had assumed the form of a boy.
verses.hindi: असुरोंको आश्वस्त करती हुई कहने लगी--

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्र उवाच । किन्न जानासि विश्वेशं संहर्तारं पिनाकिनम् । असद्वादो विवादश्च विनाशस्त्वयि केवलः
verses.transliteration: vIrabhadra uvAcha | kinna jAnAsi vishveshaM saMhartAraM pinAkinam | asadvAdo vivAdashcha vinAshastvayi kevalaH
verses.translation: Why do you speak forcing me in the pity-provok¬ ing task of imploration? O lord Siva, after knowing this, please do as you wish.

verses.sanskrit: तवान्योन्यावताराणि कानि शेषाणि साम्प्रतम् । कृतानि येन केनैव कथाशेषो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tavAnyonyAvatArANi kAni sheShANi sAmpratam | kR^itAni yena kenaiva kathAsheSho bhaviShyati
verses.translation: On hearing the upright words of Viivanara of pure rites, the lord in the form of a child, spoke smilingly.

verses.sanskrit: दोषं तं वद येन त्वमवस्थामीदृशीं गतः । तेन संहारदक्षेण दक्षिणाशेषमेष्यसि
verses.transliteration: doShaM taM vada yena tvamavasthAmIdR^ishIM gataH | tena saMhAradakSheNa dakShiNAsheShameShyasi
verses.translation: O pious one, the desire that you have cherished in your heart regarding lucismati will be certainly realised ere long.
verses.hindi: असुर ऐसा करनेके लिये प्रयत्न करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंहरूपैरत्युग्रैः कोटिभिः परिवारितः । माद्यद्भिरभितो वीरैर्नृत्यद्भिश्च मुदान्वितैः
verses.transliteration: nR^isiMharUpairatyugraiH koTibhiH parivAritaH | mAdyadbhirabhito vIrairnR^ityadbhishcha mudAnvitaiH
verses.translation: O intelligent one, I shall become your son in Sucimati. I shall be known as Grhapati, pure and loved by all gods.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिस्त्वं पुमान्रुद्रस्त्वयि वीर्यं समाहितम् । त्वन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पञ्चवक्त्रः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: prakR^itistvaM pumAnrudrastvayi vIryaM samAhitam | tvannAbhipa~NkajAjjAtaH pa~nchavaktraH pitAmahaH
verses.translation: The hymn of eight verses of desire—Abhilasastaka —that you recited now, when recited thrice a day for a year in the vicinity of i§iva will yield all desires.
verses.hindi: तथा असुरोंने बलपूर्वक उसे उखाड़ लिया

verses.sanskrit: जगत्त्रयीसर्जनार्थं शङ्करं नीललोहितम् । ललाटेऽचिन्तयत्सोऽयं तपस्युग्रे च संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: jagattrayIsarjanArthaM sha~NkaraM nIlalohitam | lalATe.achintayatso.ayaM tapasyugre cha saMsthitaH
verses.translation: The recitation of this hymn yields sons, grandsons and wealth. It is conducive to the mollification of everything and quells all mishaps.
verses.hindi: क्षीण बलवाले वे उसे ले जानेमें असमर्थ हो गये

verses.sanskrit: तल्ललाटादभूच्छम्भुः सृष्ट्यर्थे तेन भूषणम् । अतोऽहं देवदेवस्य तस्य भैरवरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: tallalATAdabhUchChambhuH sR^iShTyarthe tena bhUShaNam | ato.ahaM devadevasya tasya bhairavarUpiNaH
verses.translation: If an issueless man gets up early in the morning, takes his bath, worships $iva*s phallic image, recites this hymn and continues the practice for a year, he will surely secure a son.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्संहारे नियुक्तोऽस्मि विनयेन बलेन च । देवदेवेन रुद्रेण सकलप्रभुणा हरे
verses.transliteration: tvatsaMhAre niyukto.asmi vinayena balena cha | devadevena rudreNa sakalaprabhuNA hare
verses.translation: The Abhilasastaka hymn shall not be taught to common people. It shall be preserved carefully as a secret mantra. It makes the most barren lady deliver of a child.
verses.hindi: तटपर ले जाकर जलमें डाल दिया

verses.sanskrit: एकं रक्षो विदार्यैव तच्छक्तिकलया युतः । अहङ्कारावलेपेन गर्जसि त्वमतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: ekaM rakSho vidAryaiva tachChaktikalayA yutaH | aha~NkArAvalepena garjasi tvamatandritaH
verses.translation: This hymn recited by a woman or a m.'in with

verses.sanskrit: उपकारो हि साधूनां सुखाय किल सम्मतः । उपकारो ह्यसाधूनामपकाराय केवलम्
verses.transliteration: upakAro hi sAdhUnAM sukhAya kila sammataH | upakAro hyasAdhUnAmapakArAya kevalam
verses.translation: With great delight the brahmin returned home and told his beloved wife all thos: details.

verses.sanskrit: यन्नृसिंह महेशानं पुनर्भूतं तु मन्यसे । तर्ह्यज्ञानी महागर्वी विकारी सर्वथा भवान्
verses.transliteration: yannR^isiMha maheshAnaM punarbhUtaM tu manyase | tarhyaj~nAnI mahAgarvI vikArI sarvathA bhavAn
verses.translation: On hearing it, Sucimati, the wife of the brahmin, rejoiced much and being full of love she praised her good fortune.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वं स्रष्टा न संहर्ता भर्तापि न नृसिंहक । परतन्त्रो विमूढात्मा न स्वतन्त्रो हि कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: na tvaM sraShTA na saMhartA bhartApi na nR^isiMhaka | paratantro vimUDhAtmA na svatantro hi kutrachit
verses.translation: She became pregnant in due course. The brahmin performed the rite of impregnation® duly.
verses.hindi: सभी मनुष्योंने धन्वन्तरि बैद्यको ग्रहण किया

verses.sanskrit: कुलालचक्रवच्छक्त्या प्रेरितोऽसि पिनाकिना । नानावतारकर्ता त्वं तदधीनः सदा हरे
verses.transliteration: kulAlachakravachChaktyA prerito.asi pinAkinA | nAnAvatArakartA tvaM tadadhInaH sadA hare
verses.translation: Before the stir and throb of the child in the womb was felt, the learned Brahmin performed the holy rite of Puihsavana* in the manner prescribed in the Grhyasutras for the growth of embryo's manliness.
verses.hindi: देवगणोंको जीतकर उनसे अमृत छीन लिया

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि तव निक्षिप्तं कपालं कूर्मरूपिणः । हरहारलतामध्ये दग्धं कश्चिन्न बध्यते
verses.transliteration: adyApi tava nikShiptaM kapAlaM kUrmarUpiNaH | harahAralatAmadhye dagdhaM kashchinna badhyate
verses.translation: Then in the eighth month he performed the holy rite of Simanta® which is conducive to the growth of the embryo and which facilitates easy delivery of the child.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडद्भिश्च महावीरैर्ब्रह्माद्यैः कन्दुकैरिव । अदृष्टपूर्वैरन्यैश्च वेष्टितो वीरवन्दितः
verses.transliteration: krIDadbhishcha mahAvIrairbrahmAdyaiH kandukairiva | adR^iShTapUrvairanyaishcha veShTito vIravanditaH
verses.translation: Then at the conjunction of stars when Jupiter was in the centre, when the Lagna was auspicious, when the good planets stood in pairs, Siva, the giver of happiness to all, was born as the son of Sucimatl. His face resembled the moon. The lamps in the lying-in-chamber were dim¬ med by his bodily lustre. The lord, the destroyer of mis¬ fortunes and the bestower of happiness to the dwellers of the Earth, the nether worlds and the heaven was born as the son. The smoke exuding therefrom became the perfume to sweeten the breath of the quarters. The immense clouds showered flowers of pleasing fragrance. The divine drums were sounded and the quarters were brightened up.
verses.hindi: देखकर उन्हें सुखपूर्वक यथास्थान ले गये

verses.sanskrit: विस्मृतिः किं तदंशेन दंष्ट्रोत्पातनपीडितम् । वाराहविघ्नहस्तेऽद्य याक्रोशन्तारकारिणा
verses.transliteration: vismR^itiH kiM tadaMshena daMShTrotpAtanapIDitam | vArAhavighnahaste.adya yAkroshantArakAriNA
verses.translation: The rivers became transparent as also the minds of living beings. The darkness of evil dwindled and the Rajas was stripped of its quality or of its dust.

verses.sanskrit: दग्धोऽसि पश्य शूलाग्नेर्विष्वक्सेनच्छलाद्भवान् । दक्षयज्ञे शिरश्छिन्नं मया तेजःस्वरूपिणा
verses.transliteration: dagdho.asi pashya shUlAgnerviShvaksenachChalAdbhavAn | dakShayaj~ne shirashChinnaM mayA tejaHsvarUpiNA
verses.translation: The living creatures were endowed with Sattva quality. There was a shower of nectar. People began to talk sweet and pleasant words.
verses.hindi: एवं पृथ्वीके विवरोंमें प्रवेश कर गये

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि तव पुत्रस्य ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः । छिन्नं न सज्जितं भूयो हरे तद्विस्मृतं त्वया
verses.transliteration: adyApi tava putrasya brahmaNaH pa~nchamaM shiraH | ChinnaM na sajjitaM bhUyo hare tadvismR^itaM tvayA
verses.translation: Rambha and other celestial damsels arrived with auspicious articles in their hands. Thousands of Vidyadharis, Kinnaris, Goddesses, the womenfolk of Gan- dharvas, serpents and Yaksas of sweet voice flocked singing auspicious songs.

verses.sanskrit: निर्जितस्त्वं दधीचेन सङ्ग्रामे समरुद्गणः । कण्डूयमाने शिरसि कथं तद्विस्मृतं त्वया
verses.transliteration: nirjitastvaM dadhIchena sa~NgrAme samarudgaNaH | kaNDUyamAne shirasi kathaM tadvismR^itaM tvayA
verses.translation: The following sages came there—Marici, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Kratu, Angiras, Vasitha, KaiSyapa, Agastya, Vibhanda sou of Mantjavi, Lomasa, Romacaraa, Bharadvaja, Gautama, Bhrgu, Galava, Garga, Jatukarna, Paraara, Apastamba, Yajftavalkya, Daka, Valmtki, Mud- gala, Satatapa Likhita, Silada, Sahkha, Uficchabhuk, Jama- dagni, Sarhvarta, Matahga, Bharata, ArhSuman, Vyasa Katyayana, Kutsa, Saunaka, Susruta, Suka, Ryaifnga, Dur- vasas, Suci, Narada, Tumburu, Uttaiika, Vamadeva, Pavana, Asita, Devala, Salankayana, Harita, Visvamitra, Bhargava, Mfkundu with his son, Parvata, Daruka, Dhaumya, Upa* manyu Vatsa and others came to the happy hermitage of Vi.svanara for the auspicious Santi ceremony. The daugh¬ ters of the sages too came there.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं विक्रमतो यस्य चक्रपाणे तव प्रियम् । कुतः प्राप्तं कृतं केन त्वया तदपि विस्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: chakraM vikramato yasya chakrapANe tava priyam | kutaH prAptaM kR^itaM kena tvayA tadapi vismR^itam
verses.translation: Brahma came there with Bfhaspati. Lord Viriu came riding on Ganida as vehicle. The bull-bannered lord came there with Gauri, Nandin, Bhrngi and others.

verses.sanskrit: ये मया सकला लोका गृहीतास्त्वं पयोनिधौ । निद्रापरवशः शेषे स कथं सात्त्विको भवान्
verses.transliteration: ye mayA sakalA lokA gR^ihItAstvaM payonidhau | nidrAparavashaH sheShe sa kathaM sAttviko bhavAn
verses.translation: Mahendra and other gods the Nagas residing in the nether regions came there. Taking gems with them many great oceans and rivers came there.

verses.sanskrit: त्वदादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं रुद्रशक्तिविजृम्भितम् । शक्तिमानभितस्त्वं च ह्यनलात्त्वं विमोहितः
verses.transliteration: tvadAdistambaparyantaM rudrashaktivijR^imbhitam | shaktimAnabhitastvaM cha hyanalAttvaM vimohitaH
verses.translation: Thousands of immobile beings came there in the forms of the mobile beings. During the great festivities then there was an untimely flood of moonlight.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तेजसो हि माहात्म्यं पुमान्द्रष्टुं न हि क्षमः । अस्थूला ये प्रपश्यन्ति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tattejaso hi mAhAtmyaM pumAndraShTuM na hi kShamaH | asthUlA ye prapashyanti tadviShNoH paramaM padam
verses.translation: Brahma himself performed the postnatal rite* after bowing to the infant. In consonance with his form and beauty he gave him the nae** of Grhapati on the eleventh day in accordance with injunctions, repeating the Vedic mantras.

verses.sanskrit: द्यावापृथिव्या इन्द्राग्नेर्यमस्य वरुणस्य च । ध्वान्तोदरे शशाङ्के च जनित्वा परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: dyAvApR^ithivyA indrAgneryamasya varuNasya cha | dhvAntodare shashA~Nke cha janitvA parameshvaraH
verses.translation: After conlerring blessings on everyone by reciting the mantras from the four Vedas, Brahma left the place while riding on the swan.
verses.hindi: स्थित हैं और उनके साथ स्थित हैं

verses.sanskrit: कालोऽसि त्वं महाकालः कालकालो महेश्वरः । अतस्त्वमुग्रकलया मृत्योर्मृत्युर्भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: kAlo.asi tvaM mahAkAlaH kAlakAlo maheshvaraH | atastvamugrakalayA mR^ityormR^ityurbhaviShyasi
verses.translation: After affording proper safeguards for the child in accordance with worldly conventions Siva returned to his abode on his vehicle along with Visnu.
verses.hindi: देवताओं तथा ब्रह्माने शिवजीकी बहुत स्तुति की

verses.sanskrit: कल्पान्तज्वलनज्वालो विलसल्लोचनत्रयः । अशस्त्रो हि जटाजूटी ज्वलद् बालेन्दुमण्डितः
verses.transliteration: kalpAntajvalanajvAlo vilasallochanatrayaH | ashastro hi jaTAjUTI jvalad bAlendumaNDitaH
verses.translation: The visitors praised the infant. They were at the height of their joy. They spoke in unison "O what a beauty! What a splendour! All the characteristic signs are there in all the limbs. How fortunate is Sucimati! Siva himself is born. What is surprising in this? Siva has in¬ carnated in all devotees. Siva has been worshipped by her." Then they took leave of Visvanara and departed.

verses.sanskrit: स्थिरोऽद्य त्वक्षरो वीरो वीरो विश्वावकः प्रभुः । उपहन्ता ज्वरं भीमो मृगः पक्षी हिरण्मयः
verses.transliteration: sthiro.adya tvakSharo vIro vIro vishvAvakaH prabhuH | upahantA jvaraM bhImo mR^igaH pakShI hiraNmayaH
verses.translation: The eternal Veda says—' A person conquers the worlds through a son '. Hence all householders wish for a son.

verses.sanskrit: शास्ता शेषस्य जगतस्तत्त्वं नैव चतुर्मुखः । नान्ये च केवलं शम्भुः सर्वशास्ता न संशयः
verses.transliteration: shAstA sheShasya jagatastattvaM naiva chaturmukhaH | nAnye cha kevalaM shambhuH sarvashAstA na saMshayaH
verses.translation: In the fourth month the rite of "crossing the
verses.hindi: प्रविष्टो बिवरं तत्र रवान्॥ १  उस पातालके विवरमें प्रवेश किया

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं सर्वं समालोक्य संहारात्मानमात्मना । न विनष्टं त्वमात्मानं कुरु हे नृहरेऽबुध
verses.transliteration: itthaM sarvaM samAlokya saMhArAtmAnamAtmanA | na vinaShTaM tvamAtmAnaM kuru he nR^ihare.abudha
verses.translation: The knower rites performed the Karnavedha rite*® under the constellation of Srav<ina. In order to enhance his brahminical splendour he made him perform an auspicious Vrata*® in his fifth year.
verses.hindi: प्रकम्पो हि बभूवाथ सर्वेषां पुरवासिनाम्॥ २  एज सभी नगरवासियोंको कैँंपकँपी होने लगी

verses.sanskrit: नो चेदिदानीं क्रोधस्य महाभैरवरूपिणः । वज्राशनिरिव स्थाणौ त्वयि मृत्युः पतिष्यति
verses.transliteration: no chedidAnIM krodhasya mahAbhairavarUpiNaH | vajrAshaniriva sthANau tvayi mR^ityuH patiShyati
verses.translation: After celebrating theUpakarma rite,®® the intelligent sage taught him the Vedas. The boy learned the Vedas for a year with their ancillaries. He learnt the Padapaha and Kramapatha of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा वीरभद्रोऽपि विररामाकुतोभयः । दृष्ट्वा नृसिंहाभिप्रायं क्रोधमूर्त्तिश्शिवस्य सः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA vIrabhadro.api virarAmAkutobhayaH | dR^iShTvA nR^isiMhAbhiprAyaM krodhamUrttishshivasya saH
verses.translation: Evincing his humility and other qualities, the competent youth grasped the lore almost by himself but for¬ mally through the preceptor just as a medium.
verses.hindi: गर्जना करके शिवजीके निकट जा पहुँचे

verses.sanskrit: बालेन्दुवलयाकारतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राङ्कुरद्वयः । आखण्डलधनुःखण्डसन्निभभ्रूलतान्वितः
verses.transliteration: bAlenduvalayAkAratIkShNadaMShTrA~NkuradvayaH | AkhaNDaladhanuHkhaNDasannibhabhrUlatAnvitaH
verses.translation: In his ninth year, Narada came there to see Grhapati, son of Visvanari, and found him engaged in ser¬ ving his parents.

verses.sanskrit: महाप्रचण्डहुङ्कारबधिरीकृतदिङ्मुखः । नीलमेघाञ्जनश्यामो भीषणः श्मश्रुलोऽद्भुतः
verses.transliteration: mahAprachaNDahu~NkArabadhirIkR^itadi~NmukhaH | nIlameghA~njanashyAmo bhIShaNaH shmashrulo.adbhutaH
verses.translation: The divine sage reached the hut of Visvanara, received due hospitality and seated himself. Eagerly he enquired of his health.

verses.sanskrit: वाद्यखण्डमखण्डाभ्यां भ्रामयंस्त्रिशिखं मुहुः । वीरभद्रोऽपि भगवान्वीरशक्तिविजृम्भितः
verses.transliteration: vAdyakhaNDamakhaNDAbhyAM bhrAmayaMstrishikhaM muhuH | vIrabhadro.api bhagavAnvIrashaktivijR^imbhitaH
verses.translation: He remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and mentioned to Visvanara the future fortune and activities of his son.
verses.hindi: जिसके कारण आज आपने मेरे साथ युद्ध किया 2

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The rite of feeding the child for the first time is performed in the sixth, eighth, ninth, tenth or even at the expiry of a year. But the right occasion is when the child's teeth come out

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The rite of feeding the child for the first time is performed in the sixth, eighth, ninth, tenth or even at the expiry of a year. But the right occasion is when the child's teeth come out
verses.hindi: आपका स्मरण तो विश्वका तारण करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१२. द्वादशोऽध्यायः । शरभावतारवर्णनम् २ । सनत्कुमार उवाच । नन्दीश्वर महाप्राज्ञ विज्ञातं तदनन्तरम् । ममोपरि कृपां कृत्वा प्रीत्या त्वं तद्वदाधुना
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.12\. dvAdasho.adhyAyaH | sharabhAvatAravarNanam 2 | sanatkumAra uvAcha | nandIshvara mahAprAj~na vij~nAtaM tadanantaram | mamopari kR^ipAM kR^itvA prItyA tvaM tadvadAdhunA
verses.translation: The rite of shaving, cutting the hair and nails is peifoimed to remove the impurities and impart g'od health. This is done at the end of first year or before the expiry of the third >ear.

verses.sanskrit: युगान्तोद्यतजीमूतभीमगम्भीरनिःस्वनः । महाकुपितकृत्याग्निव्यावृत्तनयनत्रयः
verses.transliteration: yugAntodyatajImUtabhImagambhIraniHsvanaH | mahAkupitakR^ityAgnivyAvR^ittanayanatrayaH
verses.translation: The ceremony of boring the cars of the child is performed as precaution against hydrocele and hernia. Cp Susruia, CikitsA 19. ai.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला मैं  अब अपने लोकको जाऊँगा

verses.sanskrit: स्पष्टदंष्ट्राधरोष्ठश्च हुङ्कारैः संयुतो हरः । ईदृग्विधस्वरूपश्च ह्युग्र आविर्बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: spaShTadaMShTrAdharoShThashcha hu~NkAraiH saMyuto haraH | IdR^igvidhasvarUpashcha hyugra AvirbabhUva ha
verses.translation: Examining closely the palate, tongue etc. (of the boy) the intelligent Narada spoke to Visvanara, urged by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: हरिस्तद्दर्शनादेव विनष्टबलविक्रमः । बिभ्रद्धामसहस्रांशोरधः खद्योतविभ्रमम्
verses.transliteration: haristaddarshanAdeva vinaShTabalavikramaH | bibhraddhAmasahasrAMshoradhaH khadyotavibhramam
verses.translation: "O sage Visvanara, listen. I shall mention the detailed characteristic marks of your son. Your son Jbears good marks on every limb. He possesses all good signs.

verses.sanskrit: अथ विभ्रम्य पक्षाभ्यां नाभिपादान्विदारयन् । पादान्बबन्ध पुच्छेन बाहुभ्यां बाहुमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: atha vibhramya pakShAbhyAM nAbhipAdAnvidArayan | pAdAnbabandha puchChena bAhubhyAM bAhumaNDalam
verses.translation: But fate alone must guard this boy duly, this boy who has all good qualities, who is characterised by all good features and who is possessed of all pure digits in their entirety.

verses.sanskrit: भिन्दन्नुरसि बाहुभ्यां निजग्राह हरो हरिम् । ततो जगाम गगनं देवैस्सह महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: bhindannurasi bAhubhyAM nijagrAha haro harim | tato jagAma gaganaM devaissaha maharShibhiH
verses.translation: This child should be protected with all effort?. When the fate is adverse, even good qualities assume the state of defects.

verses.sanskrit: सहसैवाभयाद्विष्णुं स हि श्येन इवोरगम् । उत्क्षिप्योत्क्षिप्य सङ्गृह्य निपात्य च निपात्य च
verses.transliteration: sahasaivAbhayAdviShNuM sa hi shyena ivoragam | utkShipyotkShipya sa~NgR^ihya nipAtya cha nipAtya cha
verses.translation: In the twelfth month from now 1 suspect a great danger to him from lightning and fire." After saying this Narada returned to heaven the way he had come.

verses.sanskrit: उड्डीयोड्डीय भगवान्पक्षघातविमोहितम् । हरीं हरस्तं वृषभं विवेशानन्त ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: uDDIyoDDIya bhagavAnpakShaghAtavimohitam | harIM harastaM vR^iShabhaM viveshAnanta IshvaraH
verses.translation: On hearing the revelation of Narada, Visvanara and his wife considered it a terrible bolt from the blue.

verses.sanskrit: अनुयान्तं सुराः सर्वे नमोवाक्येन तुष्टुवुः । प्रणेमुः सादरं प्रीत्या ब्रह्माद्याश्च मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: anuyAntaM surAH sarve namovAkyena tuShTuvuH | praNemuH sAdaraM prItyA brahmAdyAshcha munIshvarAH
verses.translation: He shouted "O I am doomed!" He beat his chest. Excited by the grief about his son he fell into a great swoon.
verses.hindi: गये तथा संसार सुखी हो गया

verses.sanskrit: नीयमानः परवशो दीनवक्त्रः कृताञ्जलिः । तुष्टाव परमेशानं हरिस्तं ललिताक्षरैः
verses.transliteration: nIyamAnaH paravasho dInavaktraH kR^itA~njaliH | tuShTAva parameshAnaM haristaM lalitAkSharaiH
verses.translation: The grief-stricken Suci§mati too lamented much. Her senses were benumbed and she. lamented aloud.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्नामष्टशतेनैव स्तुत्वा तं मृडमेव च । पुनश्च प्रार्थयामास नृसिंहः शरभेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nAmnAmaShTashatenaiva stutvA taM mR^iDameva cha | punashcha prArthayAmAsa nR^isiMhaH sharabheshvaram
verses.translation: On hearing her loud lamentation, Visvanara woke up from his swoon. He cried aloud "What is this? What is this? Where is Gfhapati my vital breath who stands
verses.hindi: शिवावतारवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः क्रोधविह्वलः । निनदन्ननुवेगेन तं ग्रहीतुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityukto vIrabhadreNa nR^isiMhaH krodhavihvalaH | ninadannanuvegena taM grahItuM prachakrame
verses.translation: On seeing his parents excessively grieved, <hc boy Gfhapati, a part of Siva, smiled and said.
verses.hindi: श्रृणु प्राज्ञ महाप्रीत्या भक्तिवर्धनमुत्तमम॥ १  प्रसन्‍नतासे सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: यदा यदा ममाज्ञेयं मतिः स्याद्गर्वदूषिता । तदा तदाऽपनेतव्या त्वयैव परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: yadA yadA mamAj~neyaM matiH syAdgarvadUShitA | tadA tadA.apanetavyA tvayaiva parameshvara
verses.translation: Time and pitiable fickle existence cannot affect me, whose body is guarded by the dust-particles of your feet.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवं विज्ञापयन्प्रीत्या शङ्करं नरकेसरी । नत्वाशक्तोऽभवद्विष्णुर्जीवितान्तपराजितः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evaM vij~nApayanprItyA sha~NkaraM narakesarI | natvAshakto.abhavadviShNurjIvitAntaparAjitaH
verses.translation: O my parents, please listen to my vow. If I am your true son, I will do that whereby death itself will be terrified.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वक्त्रं शेषगात्रान्तं कृत्वा सर्वस्वविग्रहम् । शक्तियुक्तं तदीयाङ्गं वीरभद्रः क्षणात्ततः
verses.transliteration: tadvaktraM sheShagAtrAntaM kR^itvA sarvasvavigraham | shaktiyuktaM tadIyA~NgaM vIrabhadraH kShaNAttataH
verses.translation: I shall propitiate lord Siva, the conqueror of death, the omniscient and the bestower of all to the good. I shall perform the Japa of Mahakala. O parents, I am telling you the truth.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथ ब्रह्मादयो देवाः शारभं रूपमास्थितम् । तुष्टुवुः शङ्करं देवं सर्वलोकैकशङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | atha brahmAdayo devAH shArabhaM rUpamAsthitam | tuShTuvuH sha~NkaraM devaM sarvalokaikasha~Nkaram
verses.translation: On hearing his words the aged branmin couple were freed of their distress by the untimely showers of nectar. They then spoke.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ देवा ऊचुः । ब्रह्मविष्ण्विन्द्रचन्द्रादिसुराः सर्वे महर्षयः । दितिजाद्याः सम्प्रसूताः त्वत्तः सर्वे महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: || devA UchuH | brahmaviShNvindrachandrAdisurAH sarve maharShayaH | ditijAdyAH samprasUtAH tvattaH sarve maheshvara
verses.translation: A great means has oeen suggested by you to dis¬ pel our distress, that of the propitiation of lord Siva, the conqueror of death.
verses.hindi: तथा अपना वह दुःख निवेदित किया

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेन्द्रांश्च सूर्याद्यानसुरान्सुरान् । त्वं वै सृजसि पास्यत्सि त्वमेव सकलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviShNumahendrAMshcha sUryAdyAnasurAnsurAn | tvaM vai sR^ijasi pAsyatsi tvameva sakaleshvaraH
verses.translation: O dear, haven't you heard that the slayer of the Tripuras protected, in days of yore, Svetaketu who was bound by the noose of Kala?

verses.sanskrit: यतो हरसि संसारं हर इत्युच्यते बुधैः । निगृहीतो हरिर्यस्माद्धर इत्युच्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration: yato harasi saMsAraM hara ityuchyate budhaiH | nigR^ihIto hariryasmAddhara ityuchyate budhaiH
verses.translation: He protected the three worlds by drinking ofT the

verses.sanskrit: यतो बिभर्षि सकलं विभज्य तनुमष्टधा । अतोऽस्मान्पाहि भगवन् सुरान् दानैरभीप्सितैः
verses.transliteration: yato bibharShi sakalaM vibhajya tanumaShTadhA | ato.asmAnpAhi bhagavan surAn dAnairabhIpsitaiH
verses.translation: With the wheel raised up by the line drawn with his beautiful toe he killed the haughty Jalandhara who had deprived the three worlds of their pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं महापुरुषः शम्भुः सर्वेशः सुरनायकः । निःस्वात्मा निर्विकारात्मा परब्रह्म सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: tvaM mahApuruShaH shambhuH sarveshaH suranAyakaH | niHsvAtmA nirvikArAtmA parabrahma satAM gatiH
verses.translation: He burnt the Tripuras, who were haughty and
verses.hindi: ध्यान करके अपना शरीर छोड़ दिया

verses.sanskrit: दीनबन्धुर्दयासिन्धुरद्भुतोतिः परात्मदृक् । प्राज्ञो विराट् विभुः सत्यः सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: dInabandhurdayAsindhuradbhutotiH parAtmadR^ik | prAj~no virAT vibhuH satyaH sachchidAnandalakShaNaH
verses.translation: Even as Brahma and others were watching, he
verses.hindi: होने लगी और सभी लोग आश्चर्यचकित हो गये

verses.sanskrit: अत्रान्तरे महाघोरं प्रत्यक्षभयकारणम् । गगनव्यापि दुर्धर्षं शैवतेजः समुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: atrAntare mahAghoraM pratyakShabhayakAraNam | gaganavyApi durdharShaM shaivatejaH samudbhavam
verses.translation: O son, seek refuge in that Siva, the amulet of protection of the universe, the sole creator of Indra, Acyuta, Brahma and others.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचः शम्भुर्देवानां परमेश्वरः । उवाच तान् सुरान्देवामहर्षींश्च पुरातनान्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAkarNya vachaH shambhurdevAnAM parameshvaraH | uvAcha tAn surAndevAmaharShIMshcha purAtanAn
verses.translation: Thus he secured the permission of his parents. He bowed at their feet and circumambulated them. He then pacified them and started.

verses.sanskrit: यथा जलं जले क्षिप्तं क्षीरे क्षीरं घृते घृतम् । एक एव तदा विष्णुः शिवे लीनो न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: yathA jalaM jale kShiptaM kShIre kShIraM ghR^ite ghR^itam | eka eva tadA viShNuH shive lIno na chAnyathA
verses.translation: He reached Kali inaccessible even to Brahma, Visnu and others. He reached Kail that dispels all recur¬ ring distress, that is protected by Vilvcia, that shines with the celestial river Gaiiga as with a necklace round its neck, that shines splendidly by the presence of Parvati, the consorl of Siva and of wonderful qualities. After reaching Kali he went to Manikarika at the outset. After taking bath in accordance with the injunctions of the Sastras he saw Lord Vilvelvara** with palms joined and head bent in reverence. The intelligent brahmin was greatly delighted. He bowed to lord Siva who instils life into and protects the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एको विष्णुर्नृसिंहात्मा सदर्पश्च महाबलः । जगत्संहारकरणे प्रवृत्तो नरकेसरी
verses.transliteration: eko viShNurnR^isiMhAtmA sadarpashcha mahAbalaH | jagatsaMhArakaraNe pravR^itto narakesarI
verses.translation: Seeing that phallic image of Siva again and again he was delighted in his heart and thought—'Undoubtedly this is possessed of great bliss."

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थनीयो नमस्तस्मै मद्भक्तैः सिद्धिकारिभिः । मद्भक्तप्रवरश्चैव मद्भक्तवरदायकः
verses.transliteration: prArthanIyo namastasmai madbhaktaiH siddhikAribhiH | madbhaktapravarashchaiva madbhaktavaradAyakaH
verses.translation: By the nectarine juice of bliss he concluded the sacred rite. Then on an auspicious day he installed the phallic image, the bestower of all benefits. He adopted austere rites difficult to be performed by those who have no control over themselves. He filled pots with the water of the Ganga strained and purified by means of a cloth. Every day he bathed the phallic image with hundred and eight potfulls of water. Then he put a garland of blue lotus round the deity.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् पक्षिराजो महाबलः । पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | etAvaduktvA bhagavAn pakShirAjo mahAbalaH | pashyatAM sarvadevAnAM tatraivAntaradhIyata
verses.translation: He wreathed the garlands with a thousand and eight flowers. He ate fruits, roots and bulbous roots once in a fortnight or a month.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रसहित उन सभी देवताओंको शाप दे दिया

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्रोऽपि भगवान्गणाध्यक्षो महाबलः । नृसिंहकृत्तिं निष्कृष्य समादाय ययौ गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: vIrabhadro.api bhagavAngaNAdhyakSho mahAbalaH | nR^isiMhakR^ittiM niShkR^iShya samAdAya yayau girim
verses.translation: The courageous devotee spent six months by eat¬ ing withered leaves. The remaining six months he spent drinking drops of water or simply breathing.

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंहकृत्तिवसनस्तदाप्रभृति शङ्करः । तद्वक्त्रं मुण्डमालायां नायकत्वेन कल्पितम्
verses.transliteration: nR^isiMhakR^ittivasanastadAprabhR^iti sha~NkaraH | tadvaktraM muNDamAlAyAM nAyakatvena kalpitam
verses.translation: O Brahmins, thus a year in the life of that noble soul passed by, performing the penance with the devoted mind resting only in Siva.
verses.hindi: मुनिकी पत्नी क्षणभरके लिये विस्मित हो गयीं

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवा निरातङ्काः कीर्तयन्तः कथामिमाम् । विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: tato devA nirAta~NkAH kIrtayantaH kathAmimAm | vismayotphullanayanA jagmuH sarve yathAgatam
verses.translation: In the twelfth year of his life, the thunderbolt- armed Indra approached him as if fulfilling the utterance of Narada.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं परमाख्यानं पुण्यं वेदरसान्वितम् । पठति शृणुयाच्चैव सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM paramAkhyAnaM puNyaM vedarasAnvitam | paThati shR^iNuyAchchaiva sarvAnkAmAnavApnuyAt
verses.translation: He said—brahmin, I am Indra, I am delighted at your holy rites. Ask for the boon you wish to have. I shall give you whatever desire you have in your mind.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यमारोग्यम्पुष्टिवर्द्धनम् । सर्वविघ्नप्रशमनं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyamArogyampuShTivarddhanam | sarvavighnaprashamanaM sarvavyAdhivinAshanam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of lord Indra, the son of the sage spoke these words boldly and sweetly.

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्रस्य तद्रूमदृश्यं तु ततः क्षणात् । तद्वै हिरण्मयं सौम्यं न सौरं नाग्निसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: vIrabhadrasya tadrUmadR^ishyaM tu tataH kShaNAt | tadvai hiraNmayaM saumyaM na sauraM nAgnisambhavam
verses.translation: "O Indra, O enemy of Vrtra, I know you as armed with the thunderbolt. I do not want a boon from you. Siva is the grantor of boon to me."

verses.sanskrit: दुःखप्रशमनं वाञ्छासिद्धिदं मङ्गलालयम् । अपमृत्युहरं बुद्धिप्रदं शत्रुविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: duHkhaprashamanaM vA~nChAsiddhidaM ma~NgalAlayam | apamR^ityuharaM buddhipradaM shatruvinAshanam
verses.translation: O Paramour of Ahalya® O wicked one, O enemy of mountains, O chastiser of Paka, it is quite clear that I shall not ask any other god except Siva for a boon.
verses.hindi: और आनन्दपूर्वक शिवजीकी सेवा करने लगीं

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु शरभाकारं परं रूपं पिनाकिनः । प्रकाशनीयं भक्तेषु शङ्करस्य चरेषु वै
verses.transliteration: idaM tu sharabhAkAraM paraM rUpaM pinAkinaH | prakAshanIyaM bhakteShu sha~Nkarasya chareShu vai
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Indra's eyes turned red with fury. He raised his terrible thunderbolt and threatened the boy with dire consequences.

verses.sanskrit: तैरेव पठितव्यं च श्रोतव्यं च शिवात्मभिः । नवधाभक्तिदं दिव्यमन्तःकरणबुद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: taireva paThitavyaM cha shrotavyaM cha shivAtmabhiH | navadhAbhaktidaM divyamantaHkaraNabuddhidam
verses.translation: On seeing the thunderbolt with the flames of light¬ ning, the boy remembered the words of Narad a. He became frightened and fell into a swoon.

verses.sanskrit: शिवोत्सवेषु सर्वेषु चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च । पठेत्प्रतिष्ठाकाले तु शिवसन्निधिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: shivotsaveShu sarveShu chaturdashyaShTamIShu cha | paThetpratiShThAkAle tu shivasannidhikAraNam
verses.translation: Then Siva, the lord of Parvati, the dispeller of darkness appeared in front. As though enlivening him with gentle strokings he said:—"Stand up. Stand up. May good come up to you."

verses.sanskrit: चौरव्याघ्रनृसिंहात्मकृतराजभयेषु च । अन्येषूत्पातभूकम्पदस्य्वादिपांसुवृष्टिषु
verses.transliteration: chauravyAghranR^isiMhAtmakR^itarAjabhayeShu cha | anyeShUtpAtabhUkampadasyvAdipAMsuvR^iShTiShu
verses.translation: Opening his eyes resembling the lotus that had gone to sleep at the end of the day and getting up, he saw Siva shining more brilliantly than hundred suns.

verses.sanskrit: उल्कापाते महावाते विनावृष्ट्यतिवृष्टिषु । पठेद्यः प्रयतो विद्वान् शिवभक्तो दृढव्रतः
verses.transliteration: ulkApAte mahAvAte vinAvR^iShTyativR^iShTiShu | paThedyaH prayato vidvAn shivabhakto dR^iDhavrataH
verses.translation: Seeing the lord with the eyes in the fore-head, blue-necked, bull-bannered, moon-crested, with Parvati oc¬ cupying the left side, shining with matted hair, armed with the trident and Ajagava bow, possessed of limbs shining white like camphor, clad in the elephant's hide, he recognised the lord as the great God described in the Agamas and statements of his preceptor. He w'as delighted and he evinced the thrill of hair. For a moment he stood motionless like the mount¬ ain Gitrakuta.* He forgot himself like a man suddenly becoming rich. He was unable to eulogise or bow down or plead for anything. Then Siva smiled and said.

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि निष्कामो व्रतमैश्वरम् । रुद्रलोकं समासाद्य रुद्रस्यानुचरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yaH paThechChR^iNuyAdvApi niShkAmo vratamaishvaram | rudralokaM samAsAdya rudrasyAnucharo bhavet
verses.translation: O child Grhapati, 1 know that you are frightened
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृर्तीयायां शतरद्रसंहितायां पिप्पलादावतारवर्णन॑ नाम चदुर्विशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोकमनुप्राप्य रुद्रेण सह मोदते । ततः सायुज्यमाप्नोति शिवस्य कृपया मुने
verses.transliteration: rudralokamanuprApya rudreNa saha modate | tataH sAyujyamApnoti shivasya kR^ipayA mune
verses.translation: The epithet speaks contemptuously of Indra. He is called the seducer of Ahalya—the wife of the sage Gauiama. for which he' was cursed by the sage. As a result of Gautama's imprecation Indra boie a thousand marks resembling a female organ which afterwards that.rd to eyes.

verses.sanskrit: न तडिच्चन्द्रसदृशमनौपम्यं महेश्वरम् । तदा तेजांसि सर्वाणि तस्मिंल्लीनानि शङ्करे
verses.transliteration: na taDichchandrasadR^ishamanaupamyaM maheshvaram | tadA tejAMsi sarvANi tasmiMllInAni sha~Nkare
verses.translation: Neither Indra, nor the thunderbolt, nor even the god of death is powerful to molest my devotee. You have been terrified by me alone in the form of Indra.
verses.hindi: महान् लीला की; है सन्मुने! उसे आप सुनें

verses.sanskrit: न तद्व्योमं महत्तेजो व्यक्तान्तश्चाभवत्ततः । रुद्रसाधारणं चैव चिह्नितं विकृताकृति
verses.transliteration: na tadvyomaM mahattejo vyaktAntashchAbhavattataH | rudrasAdhAraNaM chaiva chihnitaM vikR^itAkR^iti
verses.translation: O gentle one, I shall grant you the boon. I confer the title of Agni on you. I authorise you to grant boons to whatever deity you think fit.
verses.hindi: हुई पद्मा नामक अति मनोहर युवतीको देखा

verses.sanskrit: ततस्संहाररूपेण सुव्यक्तं परमेश्वरः । पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः
verses.transliteration: tatassaMhArarUpeNa suvyaktaM parameshvaraH | pashyatAM sarvadevAnAM jayashabdAdima~NgalaiH
verses.translation: O Agni, you will be moving in the midst of all mortals. Acquire kingship as the guardian of the quarter in the south-east.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रबाहुर्जटिलश्चन्द्रार्द्धकृतशेखरः । समृद्धोग्रशरीरेण पक्षाभ्यां चञ्चुना द्विजः
verses.transliteration: sahasrabAhurjaTilashchandrArddhakR^itashekharaH | samR^iddhograsharIreNa pakShAbhyAM cha~nchunA dvijaH
verses.translation: The phallic image installed by you will be known by your name. It will be known as Agnisvara and it will be conducive to the enhancement of all splendour.
verses.hindi: मधुपर्क आदि प्रदानकर भक्तिपूर्वक उनकी पूजा की

verses.sanskrit: अतितीक्ष्णो महादंष्ट्रो वज्रतुल्यनखायुधः । कण्ठे कालो महाबाहुश्चतुष्पाद्वह्निसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: atitIkShNo mahAdaMShTro vajratulyanakhAyudhaH | kaNThe kAlo mahAbAhushchatuShpAdvahnisannibhaH
verses.translation: The devotees of Agnisvara need not fear lightning and fire. They will never suffer from impaired digestion or premature death.
verses.hindi: राजा मौन हो गये और कुछ बोल न सके

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: After saying this and fetching his kinsmen 8iva crowned him as the guardian of the quarter. Even as the parents watched it, l§iva entered his phallic image

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: After saying this and fetching his kinsmen 8iva crowned him as the guardian of the quarter. Even as the parents watched it, l§iva entered his phallic image

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । गृहपत्यवतारवर्णनम् १ । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु ब्रह्मसुत प्रीत्या चरितं शशिमौलिनः । सोऽवतीर्णो यथा प्रीत्या विश्वानरगृहे शिवः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.13\. trayodasho.adhyAyaH | gR^ihapatyavatAravarNanam 1 | nandIshvara uvAcha | shR^iNu brahmasuta prItyA charitaM shashimaulinaH | so.avatIrNo yathA prItyA vishvAnaragR^ihe shivaH
verses.translation: Thus, O dear, the incarnation of 8iva as fire has been explained to you. This incarnation of liva, the great soul, is famous as Gfhapati also.
verses.hindi: मुनिवर उस नारीके साथ निवास करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: एवं मे प्रार्थितं नाथ चिराय हृदि संस्थितम् । गृहस्थानां समुचितं त्वमेतद्दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: evaM me prArthitaM nAtha chirAya hR^idi saMsthitam | gR^ihasthAnAM samuchitaM tvametaddAtumarhasi
verses.translation: People of steady Sattvika quality and control over their sense-organs, who enter fire, or women endowed with Sattva quality become as lustrous as fire.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानर उवाच । किमदेयं हि सुश्रोणि तव प्रियहितैषिणी । तत्प्रार्थय महाभागे प्रयच्छाम्यविलम्बितम्
verses.transliteration: vishvAnara uvAcha | kimadeyaM hi sushroNi tava priyahitaiShiNI | tatprArthaya mahAbhAge prayachChAmyavilambitam
verses.translation: Brahmins performing Agnihotra regularly, Brahma- carins maintaining sacrificial fires, and those who stay amidst five fires become as splendrous as fire in the region of fire.

verses.sanskrit: महेशितुः प्रसादेन मम किञ्चिन्न दुर्लभम् । इहामुत्र च कल्याणि सर्वकल्याणकारिणः
verses.transliteration: maheshituH prasAdena mama ki~nchinna durlabham | ihAmutra cha kalyANi sarvakalyANakAriNaH
verses.translation: He who makes gifts of bundles of fuel during winter for alleviating chillness or he who makes fire-bricks (of cow-dung) stays with fire.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचः पत्युस्तस्य सा पतिदेवता । उवाच हृष्टवदना करौ बद्ध्वा विनीतिका
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAkarNya vachaH patyustasya sA patidevatA | uvAcha hR^iShTavadanA karau baddhvA vinItikA
verses.translation: He who faithfully f>erforms the rites ol' cremation for the unclaimed bodies or he who urges others to do so, himself being incapable, is honoured in the region of fire.

verses.sanskrit: शुचिष्मत्युवाच । वरयोग्यास्मि चेन्नाथ यदि देयो वरो मम । महेशसदृशं पुत्रं देहि नान्यं वरं वृणे
verses.transliteration: shuchiShmatyuvAcha | varayogyAsmi chennAtha yadi deyo varo mama | maheshasadR^ishaM putraM dehi nAnyaM varaM vR^iNe
verses.translation: All unholy things become pure the moment they come into contact with lire. Therefore fire is called Purifier.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणः स शुचिव्रतः । क्षणं समाधिमाधाय हृद्येतत्समचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti tasyA vachaH shrutvA brAhmaNaH sa shuchivrataH | kShaNaM samAdhimAdhAya hR^idyetatsamachintayat
verses.translation: The incense, the lights, the food offerings, milk, curd, ghee and sugarcane juice—all these go unto the dwel¬ lers of heaven when offered into the fire here.
verses.hindi: पिप्पलादके रूपमें साक्षात् शिवजी अवतरित हुए

verses.sanskrit: अहो किं मे तया तन्व्या प्रार्थितं ह्यतिदुर्लभम् । मनोरथपथाद्दूरमस्तु वा स हि सर्वकृत्
verses.transliteration: aho kiM me tayA tanvyA prArthitaM hyatidurlabham | manorathapathAddUramastu vA sa hi sarvakR^it
verses.translation: O great sage, listen to the Yakevara incarnation of iSiva, that dispels the arrogance of the arrogant and lets the devotion of e good flourish.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण करनेवाला तथा शिवभक्तिको बढ़ानेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: तेनैवास्या मुखे स्थित्वा वाक्स्वरूपेण शम्भुना । व्याहृतं कोऽन्यथा कर्तुमुत्सहेत भवेदिदम्
verses.transliteration: tenaivAsyA mukhe sthitvA vAksvarUpeNa shambhunA | vyAhR^itaM ko.anyathA kartumutsaheta bhavedidam
verses.translation: Formerly, the powerful gods and the Daityas moti¬ vated by the desire to gain their selfish ends churned the milk ocean for achieving nectar.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शवर्रसंहितायां पिप्पलादाववार-चरितवर्णन॑ नाम पदञ्चविंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: इति सञ्चिन्त्य स मुनिर्विश्वानर उदारधीः । ततः प्रोवाच तां पत्नीमेकपत्नीव्रते स्थितः
verses.transliteration: iti sa~nchintya sa munirvishvAnara udAradhIH | tataH provAcha tAM patnImekapatnIvrate sthitaH
verses.translation: When the churning of the milk ocean started as the gods and demons wanted nectar, poison blazing as the fire of dissolution came out at first.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थमाश्वास्य तां पत्नीं जगाम तपसे मुनिः । यत्र विश्वेश्वरः साक्षात्काशीनाथोऽधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | itthamAshvAsya tAM patnIM jagAma tapase muniH | yatra vishveshvaraH sAkShAtkAshInAtho.adhitiShThati
verses.translation: O dear, at the sight of it, the gods and the daityas
verses.hindi: नामक अवतारका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ; आप सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना गृहपतिः सोऽभूदग्निलोकपतिर्मुने । अग्निरूपस्तैजसश्च सर्वात्मा परमः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nAmnA gR^ihapatiH so.abhUdagnilokapatirmune | agnirUpastaijasashcha sarvAtmA paramaH prabhuH
verses.translation: After seeing Siva» the crestjewel of all the gods, all of them including Vi$nu devoutly bent their heads and bowed to Visnu with devotion.
verses.hindi: प्रसिद्ध शिवभक्ता महासुन्दरी वेश्या रहती थी

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्य वाराणसीं तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा तां मणिकर्णिकाम् । तत्याज तापत्रितयमपि जन्मशतार्जितम्
verses.transliteration: prApya vArANasIM tUrNaM dR^iShTvA tAM maNikarNikAm | tatyAja tApatritayamapi janmashatArjitam
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord Siva favourably disposed to the devotees, quaffed off the terrible poison afflicting gods and Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि लिङ्गानि विश्वेशप्रमुखानि च । स्नात्वा सर्वेषु कुण्डेषु वापीकूपसरस्सु च
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA sarvANi li~NgAni vishveshapramukhAni cha | snAtvA sarveShu kuNDeShu vApIkUpasarassu cha
verses.translation: The lord retained obliquely the acute poison that he drank, in his neck. He shone much thereby and became Blue-necked.
verses.hindi: तथा भस्म एवं रुद्राक्ष धारण करती थी

verses.sanskrit: नत्वा विनायकान्सर्वान्गौरीं शर्वां प्रणम्य च । सम्पूज्य कालराजं च भैरवं पापभक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: natvA vinAyakAnsarvAngaurIM sharvAM praNamya cha | sampUjya kAlarAjaM cha bhairavaM pApabhakShaNam
verses.translation: Released from the burning sensation of the poison thanks to the blessings of Siva, the gods and the Asuras began to churn again.
verses.hindi: यशका गान करती हुई नृत्य करती थी

verses.sanskrit: दण्डनायकमुख्यांश्च गणान्स्तुत्वा प्रयत्नतः । आदिकेशवमुख्यांश्च केशवं परितोष्य च
verses.transliteration: daNDanAyakamukhyAMshcha gaNAnstutvA prayatnataH | AdikeshavamukhyAMshcha keshavaM paritoShya cha
verses.translation: O sage, many gems came out of it, but O sage, it was the nectar that the gods and the Danavas prized much.

verses.sanskrit: लोलार्कमुखसूर्यांश्च प्रणम्य स पुनः पुनः । कृत्वा च पिण्डदानानि सर्वतीर्थेष्वतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: lolArkamukhasUryAMshcha praNamya sa punaH punaH | kR^itvA cha piNDadAnAni sarvatIrtheShvatandritaH
verses.translation: Not the Asuras, but the gods drank the nectar, thanks to the favour of Visnu. Then a great battle ensued between them inflicting pain on both.
verses.hindi: उस वानरके साथ सदा नृत्य किया करता था

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रभोजनाद्यैश्च मुनीन्विप्रान्प्रतर्प्य च । महापूजोपचारैश्च लिङ्गान्यभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: sahasrabhojanAdyaishcha munInviprAnpratarpya cha | mahApUjopachAraishcha li~NgAnyabhyarchya bhaktitaH
verses.translation: A mutual clash occurred between the gods and the Danavas, O sage. The moon was eclipsed by Rahu and fled in terror of Rahu.

verses.sanskrit: असकृच्चिन्तयामास किं लिङ्गं क्षिप्रसिद्धिदम् । यत्र निश्चलतामेति तपस्तनयकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: asakR^ichchintayAmAsa kiM li~NgaM kShiprasiddhidam | yatra nishchalatAmeti tapastanayakAmyayA
verses.translation: He went to the abode of Siva extremely agitated by fe-»r and sought Siva's protection. Saying "Protect me O Lord, protect me" he bowed to the lord and eulogised him.
verses.hindi: आसक्त, जययुक्त तथा शैव वेश धारण किये हुए थे

verses.sanskrit: क्षणं विचार्य स मुनिरिति विश्वानरः सुधीः । क्षिप्रं पुत्रप्रदं लिङ्गं वीरेशं प्रशशंस ह
verses.transliteration: kShaNaM vichArya sa muniriti vishvAnaraH sudhIH | kShipraM putrapradaM li~NgaM vIreshaM prashashaMsa ha
verses.translation: Lord Siva, the bestower of protection to the good, and favourably disposed to his devotees, wore the moon on his head as the latter had sought refuge.

verses.sanskrit: असङ्ख्याताः सहस्राणि सिद्धाः सिद्धिं गतास्ततः । सिद्धलिङ्गमिति ख्यातं तस्माद्वीरेश्वरं परम्
verses.transliteration: asa~NkhyAtAH sahasrANi siddhAH siddhiM gatAstataH | siddhali~Ngamiti khyAtaM tasmAdvIreshvaraM param
verses.translation: Then Rahu too, came there. He bowed to and eulogised lord Siva with reverence by means of sweet v/ords.
verses.hindi: वह वेश्या चकित होकर उनसे कहने लगी

verses.sanskrit: वीरेश्वरं महालिङ्गमब्दमभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः । आयुर्मनोरथं सर्वं पुत्रादिकमनेकशः
verses.transliteration: vIreshvaraM mahAli~Ngamabdamabhyarchya bhaktitaH | AyurmanorathaM sarvaM putrAdikamanekashaH
verses.translation: Realising his desire, Siva fixed on to his neck his head that had been formerly cut off by Vi|nu, and that was known as Ketu.
verses.hindi: रहा है; यह तो दिव्य स्त्रियोंके योग्य आभूषण है

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायास्तटे रम्ये पुरे नर्मपुरे पुरा । पुरारिभक्तः पुण्यात्माभवद्विश्वानरो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: narmadAyAstaTe ramye pure narmapure purA | purAribhaktaH puNyAtmAbhavadvishvAnaro muniH
verses.translation: Then the Asuras were defeated by the gods in the battle. By drinking nectar the gods had become powerful and gained victory.

verses.sanskrit: अहमप्यत्र वीरेशं समाराध्य त्रिकालतः । आशु पुत्रमवाप्स्यामि यथाभिलषितं स्त्रिया
verses.transliteration: ahamapyatra vIreshaM samArAdhya trikAlataH | Ashu putramavApsyAmi yathAbhilaShitaM striyA
verses.translation: The text of the fourth frot ol this vrrse is corrupt.
verses.hindi: इसको धारण करो; किंतु इसका क्या मूल्य दोगी 2

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति कृत्वा मतिं धिरो विप्रो विश्वानरः कृती । चन्द्रकूपजले स्नात्वा जग्राह नियमं व्रती
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti kR^itvA matiM dhiro vipro vishvAnaraH kR^itI | chandrakUpajale snAtvA jagrAha niyamaM vratI
verses.translation: Deluded by Siva's Maya, Viu and others became very haughty. Their strength began to take root and sprout within them.

verses.sanskrit: एकाहारोऽभवन्मासं मासं नक्ताशनोऽभवत् । अयाचिताशनो मासं मासं त्यक्ताशनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: ekAhAro.abhavanmAsaM mAsaM naktAshano.abhavat | ayAchitAshano mAsaM mAsaM tyaktAshanaH punaH
verses.translation: O sage, then Lord Siva, the suppressor of arro¬ gance, became a Yaka. He hastened to the place, O sage, where the gods were stationed.

verses.sanskrit: पयोव्रतोऽभवन्मासं मासं शाकफलाशनः । मासं मुष्टितिलाहारो मासं पानीयभोजनः
verses.transliteration: payovrato.abhavanmAsaM mAsaM shAkaphalAshanaH | mAsaM muShTitilAhAro mAsaM pAnIyabhojanaH
verses.translation: On seeing Vinu and all other gods arrogant in their minds, lord Siva, the lord of Yaksas and the suppressor of arrogance spoke.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चगव्याशनो मासं मासं चान्द्रायणव्रती । मासं कुशाग्रजलभुग्मासं श्वसनभक्षणः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchagavyAshano mAsaM mAsaM chAndrAyaNavratI | mAsaM kushAgrajalabhugmAsaM shvasanabhakShaNaH
verses.translation: O ye gods, why have you all assembled here. What is your goal? Tell me the reason as I ask unto you.
verses.hindi: रक्षा करना और यलपूर्वक इसे छिपाकर रखना

verses.sanskrit: एवमब्दमितं कालं तताप स तपोऽद्भुतम् । त्रिकालमर्चयद्भक्त्या वीरेशं लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: evamabdamitaM kAlaM tatApa sa tapo.adbhutam | trikAlamarchayadbhaktyA vIreshaM li~Ngamuttamam
verses.translation: O lord, a terrible battle took place here wherein all the Asuras were killed. The few that remained fled away.
verses.hindi: नाट्यशालाके मध्यमें रखकर घरमें प्रवेश किया

verses.sanskrit: अथ त्रयोदशे मासि स्नात्वा त्रिपथगाम्भसि । प्रत्यूष एव वीरेशं यावदायाति स द्विजः
verses.transliteration: atha trayodashe mAsi snAtvA tripathagAmbhasi | pratyUSha eva vIreshaM yAvadAyAti sa dvijaH
verses.translation: We are great heroes and powerful slayers of the Daityas. How insignificant in strength are those Daityas in front of us!

verses.sanskrit: तावद्विलोकयाञ्चक्रे मध्ये लिङ्गं तपोधनः । विभूतिभूषणं बालमष्टवर्षाकृतिं शिशुम्
verses.transliteration: tAvadvilokayA~nchakre madhye li~NgaM tapodhanaH | vibhUtibhUShaNaM bAlamaShTavarShAkR^itiM shishum
verses.translation: On hearing the arrogant words of those gods, lord Siva, the suppressor of arrogance, in the form of Yaka said.
verses.hindi: व्याकुलतासे उठकर बन्दरको बन्धनमुक्त कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: आकर्णायतनेत्रं च सुरक्तदशनच्छदम् । चारुपिङ्गजटामौलिं नग्न प्रहसिताननम्
verses.transliteration: AkarNAyatanetraM cha suraktadashanachChadam | chArupi~NgajaTAmauliM nagna prahasitAnanam
verses.translation: O ye gods, you listen to my words with attention. I shall tell you the truth that will dispel arrogance.

verses.sanskrit: शैशवोचितनेपथ्यधारिणं चितिधारिणम् । पठन्तं श्रुतिसूक्तानि हसन्तं च स्वलीलया
verses.transliteration: shaishavochitanepathyadhAriNaM chitidhAriNam | paThantaM shrutisUktAni hasantaM cha svalIlayA
verses.translation: If you are proud and think that you know your strength to be great, O gods, split this blade of grass placed by me, with your own weapons.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमे निष्ठो ब्रह्मयज्ञरतः सदा । शाण्डिल्यगोत्रः शुचिमान्ब्रह्मतेजोनिधिर्वशी
verses.transliteration: brahmacharyAshrame niShTho brahmayaj~narataH sadA | shANDilyagotraH shuchimAnbrahmatejonidhirvashI
verses.translation: Saying this, Siva in the form of Yakfa, the goal of the good, placed a blade of grass before them and dispel¬ led their arrogance.
verses.hindi: सेवकोंसे अपने भवनके बाहर चिता बनवायी

verses.sanskrit: तमालोक्य मुदं प्राप्य रोमकञ्चुकितो मुनिः । प्रोच्चचार हृदालापान्नमोऽस्त्विति पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tamAlokya mudaM prApya romaka~nchukito muniH | prochchachAra hR^idAlApAnnamo.astviti punaH punaH
verses.translation: Then Visnu and other gods professing to be heroic exerted their manliness and hurled their respective weapons.

verses.sanskrit: अभिलाषप्रदैः पद्यैरष्टभिर्बालरूपिणम् । तुष्टाव परमानन्दं शम्भुं विश्वानरः कृती
verses.transliteration: abhilAShapradaiH padyairaShTabhirbAlarUpiNam | tuShTAva paramAnandaM shambhuM vishvAnaraH kR^itI
verses.translation: But the weapons of the gods, were rendered fruitless before the power of Siva, the destroyer of the arrogance of the deluded.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानर उवाच । एकं ब्रह्मैवाद्वितीयं समस्तं सत्यं सत्यं नेह नानास्ति किञ्चित् । एको रुद्रो न द्वितीयोऽवतस्थे तस्मादेकं त्वां प्रपद्ये महेशम्
verses.transliteration: vishvAnara uvAcha | ekaM brahmaivAdvitIyaM samastaM satyaM satyaM neha nAnAsti ki~nchit | eko rudro na dvitIyo.avatasthe tasmAdekaM tvAM prapadye mahesham
verses.translation: Then a celestial voice arose that dispelled the surprise of the gods—"O gods this Yaksa is Siva who removes the arrogance of the arrogant.

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता हर्त्ता त्वं हि सर्वस्य शम्भो नानारूपेष्वेकरूपोऽप्यरूपः । यद्वत्प्रत्यग्धर्म एकोऽप्यनेक- स्तस्मान्नान्यं त्वां विनेशं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: kartA harttA tvaM hi sarvasya shambho nAnArUpeShvekarUpo.apyarUpaH | yadvatpratyagdharma eko.apyaneka\- stasmAnnAnyaM tvAM vineshaM prapadye
verses.translation: Deluded by the power of his illusion you have become arrogant and have not realised lord Siva, who is the very knowledge embodied.

verses.sanskrit: रज्जौ सर्पः शुक्तिकायां च रौप्यं नैरः पूरस्तन्मृगाख्ये मरीचौ । यद्यत्सद्वद्विष्वगेव प्रपञ्चो यस्मिन् ज्ञाते तं प्रपद्ये महेशम्
verses.transliteration: rajjau sarpaH shuktikAyAM cha raupyaM nairaH pUrastanmR^igAkhye marIchau | yadyatsadvadviShvageva prapa~ncho yasmin j~nAte taM prapadye mahesham
verses.translation: O hearing the celestial voice they became divested of their arrogance. They had realised Yaksevara. They bowed to and eulogised him.

verses.sanskrit: तोये शैत्यं दाहकत्वं च वह्नौ तापो भानौ शीतभानौ प्रसादः । पुष्पे गन्धो दुग्धमध्येऽपि सर्पि- र्यत्तच्छम्भो त्वं ततस्त्वां प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: toye shaityaM dAhakatvaM cha vahnau tApo bhAnau shItabhAnau prasAdaH | puShpe gandho dugdhamadhye.api sarpi\- ryattachChambho tvaM tatastvAM prapadye
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, the dispeller of arrogance, O Yaksevara of great sports, O lord, your Maya is wonderful.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दं गृह्णास्यश्रवास्त्वं हि जिघ्र- स्यघ्राणस्त्वं व्यङ्घ्रिरायासि दूरात् । व्यक्षः पश्येस्त्वं रसज्ञोऽप्यजिह्वः कस्त्वां सम्यग्वेत्त्यतस्त्वां प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: shabdaM gR^ihNAsyashravAstvaM hi jighra\- syaghrANastvaM vya~NghrirAyAsi dUrAt | vyakShaH pashyestvaM rasaj~no.apyajihvaH kastvAM samyagvettyatastvAM prapadye
verses.translation: Even now we are deluded by this Maya of yours in the form of Yaksa. Hence, separated from you we began to speak arrogantly before you.
verses.hindi: हुईके समान उसी प्रकार खड़ी रह गयी

verses.sanskrit: नो वेद त्वामीश साक्षाद्धि वेदो नो वा विष्णुर्नो विधाताखिलस्य । नो योगीन्द्रा नेन्द्रमुख्याश्च देवा भक्तो वेद त्वामतस्त्वां प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: no veda tvAmIsha sAkShAddhi vedo no vA viShNurno vidhAtAkhilasya | no yogIndrA nendramukhyAshcha devA bhakto veda tvAmatastvAM prapadye
verses.translation: O lord, thanks to your grace, alone, knowledge has dawned on us. O Siva, you alone are the creator, sustainer and annihilator, none else.
verses.hindi: निमित्त मैं वैश्य बनकर तुम्हारे पास आया था

verses.sanskrit: नो ते गोत्रं नेश जन्मापि नाख्या नो वा रूपं नैव शीलं न देशः । इत्थम्भूतोऽपीश्वरस्त्वं त्रिलोक्याः सर्वान्कामान्पूरयेस्त्वं भजे त्वाम्
verses.transliteration: no te gotraM nesha janmApi nAkhyA no vA rUpaM naiva shIlaM na deshaH | itthambhUto.apIshvarastvaM trilokyAH sarvAnkAmAnpUrayestvaM bhaje tvAm
verses.translation: You alone arc the initiator and the withdrawer of all powers. You are lord of all, the threat soul, the unchanging, the unrivalled.
verses.hindi: करके मैं अग्निमें प्रविष्ट हुआ हूँ

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तः सर्वं त्वं हि सर्वं स्मरारे त्वं गौरीशस्त्वं च नग्नोऽतिशान्तः । त्वं वै वृद्धस्त्वं युवा त्वं च बाल- स्तत्त्वं यत्किं नान्यतस्त्वां नतोऽहम्
verses.transliteration: tvattaH sarvaM tvaM hi sarvaM smarAre tvaM gaurIshastvaM cha nagno.atishAntaH | tvaM vai vR^iddhastvaM yuvA tvaM cha bAla\- stattvaM yatkiM nAnyatastvAM nato.aham
verses.translation: In the form of YakeSvara you have removed our arrogance. With sympathy and kindness we think we have been blessed by you.
verses.hindi: स्पर्शके अतिरिक्त अन्य कुछ नहीं चाहती हूँ

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाताखिलशास्त्रार्थः सदाचाररतः सदा । शैवाचारप्रवीणोऽति लौकिकाचारविद्वरः
verses.transliteration: vij~nAtAkhilashAstrArthaH sadAchArarataH sadA | shaivAchArapravINo.ati laukikAchAravidvaraH
verses.translation: Then the Yaksanitha blessed the gods enlightened them with various instructions and vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: घोर भयसे छुड़ाइये, आपको नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । स्तुत्वेति विप्रो निपपात भूमौ सम्बद्धपाणिर्भवतीह यावत् । तावत्स बालोऽखिलवृद्धवृद्धः प्रोवाच भूदेवमतीव हृष्टः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | stutveti vipro nipapAta bhUmau sambaddhapANirbhavatIha yAvat | tAvatsa bAlo.akhilavR^iddhavR^iddhaH provAcha bhUdevamatIva hR^iShTaH
verses.translation: Thus has been described the pleasant incarnation of Siva called Yakelvara that bestows pleasure, satisfaction and protection of the good.
verses.hindi: ताः सर्वाश्च तया सार्थ निनाय स्व॑ परं पदम्॥ ६२  सबको अपने परम पदकी प्राप्ति करायी

verses.sanskrit: बाल उवाच । विश्वानर मुनिश्रेष्ठ भूदेवाहं त्वयाद्य वै । तोषितः सुप्रसन्नात्मा वृणीष्व वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bAla uvAcha | vishvAnara munishreShTha bhUdevAhaM tvayAdya vai | toShitaH suprasannAtmA vR^iNIShva varamuttamam
verses.translation: The intelligent man who listens to or narrates this with devotion attains all desires. Then he attains salvation.

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्थाय हृष्टात्मा मुनिर्विश्वानरः कृती । प्रत्यब्रवीन्मुनिश्रेष्ठः शङ्करं बालरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: tata utthAya hR^iShTAtmA munirvishvAnaraH kR^itI | pratyabravInmunishreShThaH sha~NkaraM bAlarUpiNam
verses.translation: Now listen to the first ten incarnations of Siva beginning with that of Mahakala. They are resorted to with devotion and explained in Upasanakanda.
verses.hindi: महानन्दाको परम सुख देनेवाला तथा अद्भुत है

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानर उवाच । महेश्वर किमज्ञातं सर्वज्ञस्य तव प्रभो । सर्वान्तरात्मा भगवान् शर्वः सर्वप्रदो भवान्
verses.transliteration: vishvAnara uvAcha | maheshvara kimaj~nAtaM sarvaj~nasya tava prabho | sarvAntarAtmA bhagavAn sharvaH sarvaprado bhavAn
verses.translation: The concept of god (in the male form) and his Energy (in the female form) is not pecnliar to Siva-cult alone. It belongs to almost every god—Vifnu, firahmft, Indra and others. It is found in pairs—Siva-lSivl, ViOu-Vaistiav!, Brahmi-BrahmSpi, Indra-IndifiiiT. The Present chapter mentions the eluent incarnations of $iva and their re- pective lergies.
verses.hindi: च्यवते न स्वधर्मात्स परत्र लभते गतिम्॥ ६५  और परलोकमें उत्तम गति प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: याच्ञां प्रति नियुक्तं मां किं ब्रूषे दैन्यकारिणीम् । इति ज्ञात्वा महेशान यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: yAch~nAM prati niyuktaM mAM kiM brUShe dainyakAriNIm | iti j~nAtvA maheshAna yathechChasi tathA kuru
verses.translation: The ten incarnations of Siva are pleasing as they confer worldly pleasures and salvation. They bestow every¬ thing on good devotees.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां वैश्यनाथाह्यय-शिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम षड़्विंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवो विश्वानरस्य हि । शुचिः शुचिव्रतस्याथ शुचिं स्मित्वाब्रवीच्छिशुः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasya devo vishvAnarasya hi | shuchiH shuchivratasyAtha shuchiM smitvAbravIchChishuH
verses.translation: These ten incarnations of Siva the great soul bestow different kinds of pleasures on those who always resort to them without aberrations.
verses.hindi: शिवावतारका वर्णन नामक छब्बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: त्वया शुचे शुचिष्मत्यां योऽभिलाषः कृतो हृदि । अचिरेणैव कालेन स भविष्यत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tvayA shuche shuchiShmatyAM yo.abhilAShaH kR^ito hR^idi | achireNaiva kAlena sa bhaviShyatyasaMshayam
verses.translation: O sage, the glory of the ten in:amations of Siva has thus been described. It bestows all desires as explained in the Tantraiastra and other treatises.
verses.hindi: द्विजेश्वरावतारका वर्णन करता हूँ, उसे सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: तव पुत्रत्वमेष्यामि शुचिष्मत्यां महामते । ख्यातो गृहपतिर्नाम्ना शुचिः सर्वामरप्रियः
verses.transliteration: tava putratvameShyAmi shuchiShmatyAM mahAmate | khyAto gR^ihapatirnAmnA shuchiH sarvAmarapriyaH
verses.translation: The different Saktis are considered in such activi¬ ties as destroying enemies etc. They punish the wicked and enhance brahminical splendour.
verses.hindi: उसी वृत्तान्तको मैं कह रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: अभिलाषाष्टकं पुण्यं स्तोत्रमेतत्त्वयेरितम् । अब्दत्रिकालपठनात्कामदं शिवसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: abhilAShAShTakaM puNyaM stotrametattvayeritam | abdatrikAlapaThanAtkAmadaM shivasannidhau
verses.translation: O Brahmin, thus I have explained to you the ten incarnations of Siva along with his Sakti, beginning with Mahakala. They are all auspicious.
verses.hindi: परम साध्वी कीर्तिमालिनी उनकी पत्नी हुई

verses.sanskrit: एतत्स्तोत्रप्रपठनं पुत्रपौत्रधनप्रदम् । सर्वशान्तिकरं चापि सर्वापत्तिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: etatstotraprapaThanaM putrapautradhanapradam | sarvashAntikaraM chApi sarvApattivinAshanam
verses.translation: He who reads this sacred narrative during the festivals of Siva, with great devotion becomes a great favou¬ rite of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: चित्ते विचार्य गृहिणीगुणान्विश्वानरः शुभान् । उदुवाह विधानेन स्वोचितां कुलकन्यकाम्
verses.transliteration: chitte vichArya gR^ihiNIguNAnvishvAnaraH shubhAn | uduvAha vidhAnena svochitAM kulakanyakAm
verses.translation: A brahmin attains the sacred splendour of Brahman; Katriya becomes victorious; a Vaiiya becomes lord of wealth and a Sudra attains happiness.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गापवर्गसम्पत्तिकारकं नात्र संशयः । सर्वस्तोत्रसमं ह्येतत्सर्वकामप्रदं सदा
verses.transliteration: svargApavargasampattikArakaM nAtra saMshayaH | sarvastotrasamaM hyetatsarvakAmapradaM sadA
verses.translation: The devotees of Siva maintaining their respective duties and listening to this narrative become especially happy and devoted to Siva.
verses.hindi: तात!' चिल्लाते हुए उन दोनोंको देखा

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरुत्थाय सुस्नातो लिङ्गमभ्यर्च्य शाम्भवम् । वर्षं जपन्निदं स्तोत्रमपुत्रः पुत्रवान्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: prAtarutthAya susnAto li~Ngamabhyarchya shAmbhavam | varShaM japannidaM stotramaputraH putravAnbhavet
verses.translation: Listen to the eleven excellent incarnations of liva on hearing which obstacles due to intimate contact with worldly objects etc. do not torment.

verses.sanskrit: अभिलाषाष्टकमिदं न देयं यस्य कस्यचित् । गोपनीयं प्रयत्नेन महावन्ध्याप्रसूतिकृत्
verses.transliteration: abhilAShAShTakamidaM na deyaM yasya kasyachit | gopanIyaM prayatnena mahAvandhyAprasUtikR^it
verses.translation: Formerly Indra and other gods defeated by the Asuras left their capital Amaravati* due to fear.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेणापि नियमाल्लिङ्गसन्निधौ । अब्दं जप्तमिदं स्तोत्रं पुत्रदं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: striyA vA puruSheNApi niyamAlli~Ngasannidhau | abdaM japtamidaM stotraM putradaM nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: The gods harrassed by the Daityas went to Kayapa. Highly agitated, they bowed down to him with palms joined and shoulders drooping.
verses.hindi: लेकर बड़ी शीघ्रताके साथ वहाँसे भाग गया

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे शम्भुर्बालरूपः सतां गतिः । सोऽपि विश्वानरो विप्रो हृष्टात्मा स्वगृहं ययौ
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvAntardadhe shambhurbAlarUpaH satAM gatiH | so.api vishvAnaro vipro hR^iShTAtmA svagR^ihaM yayau
verses.translation: After eulogising well, the gods made tbe submission respectfully. They intimated to him their misery due to that defeat.
verses.hindi: गतिका आश्रय लेकर बारंबार रोने लगा

verses.sanskrit: अग्निशुश्रूषणरतः पञ्चयज्ञपरायणः । षट्कर्मनिरतो नित्यं देवपित्रतिथिप्रियः
verses.transliteration: agnishushrUShaNarataH pa~nchayaj~naparAyaNaH | ShaTkarmanirato nityaM devapitratithipriyaH
verses.translation: O dear, on hearing the misery of the gods their father Kasyapa whose mind was attached to Siva, was much distressed.

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुतिथे काले गते तस्याग्रजन्मनः । भार्या शुचिष्मती नाम भर्तारं प्राह सुव्रता
verses.transliteration: evaM bahutithe kAle gate tasyAgrajanmanaH | bhAryA shuchiShmatI nAma bhartAraM prAha suvratA
verses.translation: O sage, tne sage consoled and encouraged them. With his mind regaining calmness he joyously went to Kali presided over by lord Vilvesvara.

verses.sanskrit: नाथ भोगा मया सर्वे भुक्ता वै त्वत्प्रसादतः । स्त्रीणां समुचिता ये स्युः त्वां समेत्य मुदावहाः
verses.transliteration: nAtha bhogA mayA sarve bhuktA vai tvatprasAdataH | strINAM samuchitA ye syuH tvAM sametya mudAvahAH
verses.translation: Taking his ceremonial bath in the waters of the Gahga and performing due rites, he worshipped Lord Vil> velvara, lord of the universe, accompanied by Parvatl.
verses.hindi: आक्रमणको भी रोकनेमें सक्षम न हो सके

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: A long time elapsed, O sage, as he boldly per¬ formed penance with his mind attached to the lotus-like feet of Siva

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: A long time elapsed, O sage, as he boldly per¬ formed penance with his mind attached to the lotus-like feet of Siva
verses.hindi: वे ऐसा नहीं करते तो मृतकके समान हैं

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१४. चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः । गृहपत्यवतारवर्णनम् २ । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । स विप्रो गृहमागत्य महाहर्षसमन्वितः । प्रियायै कथयामास तद्वृत्तान्तमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.14\. chaturdasho.adhyAyaH | gR^ihapatyavatAravarNanam 2 | nandIshvara uvAcha | sa vipro gR^ihamAgatya mahAharShasamanvitaH | priyAyai kathayAmAsa tadvR^ittAntamasheShataH
verses.translation: In order to grant the boon to that sage whose mind was devoted to his feet, Siva, kinsman of the distressed and goal of the good, appeared in front of him.
verses.hindi: भिखारी होना कहीं अधिक श्रेष्ठ है

verses.sanskrit: परितः सरितः स्वच्छा भूतानां मानसैः सह । तमोऽताम्यत्तु नितरां रजोऽपि विरजोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: paritaH saritaH svachChA bhUtAnAM mAnasaiH saha | tamo.atAmyattu nitarAM rajo.api virajo.abhavat
verses.translation: On seeing lord Siva, the delighted Kayapa bowed to him with palms joined in reverence. Kayapa, the pro¬ genitor of the gods, eulogised him with contentment in his mind.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वाः सत्त्वसमायुक्ताः सुधावृष्टिर्बभूव वै । कल्याणी सर्वथा वाणी प्राणिनः प्रियवत्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: sattvAH sattvasamAyuktAH sudhAvR^iShTirbabhUva vai | kalyANI sarvathA vANI prANinaH priyavatyabhUt
verses.translation: O lord Siva, lord of the gods, favourably disposed towards those who seek refuge in you, you are the lord of all, the great soul, achievable only through meditation, the un¬ equalled and unchanging.

verses.sanskrit: रम्भामुख्या अप्सरसो मङ्गलद्रव्यपाणयः । विद्याधर्यश्च किन्नर्यस्तथामर्यः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: rambhAmukhyA apsaraso ma~NgaladravyapANayaH | vidyAdharyashcha kinnaryastathAmaryaH sahasrashaH
verses.translation: O lord Siva, you are the restrainer of evil forces. You are the goal of the good, kinsman of the distressed, ocean of mercy and intellectually efficient in protecting your devotees.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वोरगयक्षाणां सुमानियः शुभस्वराः । गायन्त्यो मङ्गलं गीतं तत्राजग्मुरनेकशः
verses.transliteration: gandharvoragayakShANAM sumAniyaH shubhasvarAH | gAyantyo ma~NgalaM gItaM tatrAjagmuranekashaH
verses.translation: O lord, these gods are your own. They are espe¬ cially devoted to you. Now they are defeated by the Asuras. Save them from distress.
verses.hindi: चाहता हूँ, इसे मुझे दे दीजिये

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिरत्रिः पुलहः पुलस्त्यः क्रतुरङ्गिराः । वसिष्ठः कश्यपोऽगस्त्यो विभाण्डो माण्डवीसुतः
verses.transliteration: marIchiratriH pulahaH pulastyaH kratura~NgirAH | vasiShThaH kashyapo.agastyo vibhANDo mANDavIsutaH
verses.translation: Even Visnu cannot move in this matter. He has frequently pressed you for this job. The gods have sought refuge in me intimating their misfortune.
verses.hindi: दान करनेवाला तो कहीं नहीं होता

verses.sanskrit: लोमशो रोमचरणो भरद्वाजोऽथ गौतमः । भृगुस्तु गालवो गर्गो जातूकर्ण्यः पराशरः
verses.transliteration: lomasho romacharaNo bharadvAjo.atha gautamaH | bhR^igustu gAlavo gargo jAtUkarNyaH parAsharaH
verses.translation: O lord of the chiefs of the gods, O destroyer of the miseries of the gods, it is for this that I have performed this penance and resorted to you. My purpose has now been fulfilled by you since you are pleased.
verses.hindi: दूर नहीं किया जा सकता है

verses.sanskrit: आपस्तम्बो याज्ञवल्क्यो दक्षवाल्मीकिमुद्गलाः । शातातपश्च लिखितः शिलादः शङ्ख उञ्छभुक्
verses.transliteration: Apastambo yAj~navalkyo dakShavAlmIkimudgalAH | shAtAtapashcha likhitaH shilAdaH sha~Nkha u~nChabhuk
verses.translation: O lord, I have sought refuge in you by all means O lord, please fulfill my desire. Please dispel the misery of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निश्च संवर्तो मतङ्गो भरतोंऽशुमान् । व्यासः कात्यायनः कुत्सः शौनकः सुश्रुतः शुकः
verses.transliteration: jamadagnishcha saMvarto mata~Ngo bharatoM.ashumAn | vyAsaH kAtyAyanaH kutsaH shaunakaH sushrutaH shukaH
verses.translation: O lord of gods, I too am much distressed at the misfortune of my sons. O lord, make me happy. You are the source of succour to the heaven-dwellers.
verses.hindi: ऐसा करनेसे मेरी कीर्ति भी बढ़ेगी

verses.sanskrit: ऋष्यशृङ्गोऽथ दुर्वासाः शुचिर्नारदतुम्बुरु । उत्तङ्को वामदेवश्च पवनोऽसितदेवलौ
verses.transliteration: R^iShyashR^i~Ngo.atha durvAsAH shuchirnAradatumburu | utta~Nko vAmadevashcha pavano.asitadevalau
verses.translation: O lord l§iva, do help the gods always lest the harassment by the Asuras should afflict them.
verses.hindi: साथ अपनी पत्नीका दान कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: सालङ्कायनहारीतौ विश्वामित्रोऽथ भार्गवः । मृकण्डः सह पुत्रेण पर्वतो दारुकस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sAla~NkAyanahArItau vishvAmitro.atha bhArgavaH | mR^ikaNDaH saha putreNa parvato dArukastathA
verses.translation: On being thus requested, lord, 6iva said "So be it'* and even as he was watching he vanished' there.
verses.hindi: गिरनेको उद्यत हुए उन राजाकों रोक दिया

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा विप्रपत्नी सा मुदं प्राप शुचिष्मती । अतीव प्रेमसंयुक्ता प्रशशंस विधिं निजम्
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA viprapatnI sA mudaM prApa shuchiShmatI | atIva premasaMyuktA prashashaMsa vidhiM nijam
verses.translation: These are the eleven Rudras born of Surabh! (I) Kapalin (2) Pingala (3) Bhima (4) Virupaka (5) Vi- lohita (6) Sastj* (7) Ajapad (8) Ahirbudhnya (9) Siva (10) Ganda and (11) Bhava. They were born for the aid to the gods. They are identical with Siva and the cause of happiness.

verses.sanskrit: धौम्योपमन्युवत्साद्या मुनयो मुनिकन्यकाः । तच्छान्त्यर्थं समाजग्मुर्धन्यं विश्वानराश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: dhaumyopamanyuvatsAdyA munayo munikanyakAH | tachChAntyarthaM samAjagmurdhanyaM vishvAnarAshramam
verses.translation: Those Rudras, born of Kayapa, rendering help to the gods, slew the Daityas in the battle. They were heroes of great strength and exploit.
verses.hindi: अन्य मुनिगण भी स्तुति करते हुए वहाँ आ पहुँचे

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा बृहस्पतियुतो देवो गरुडवाहनः । नन्दिभृङ्गिसमायुक्तो गौर्या सह वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: brahmA bR^ihaspatiyuto devo garuDavAhanaH | nandibhR^i~NgisamAyukto gauryA saha vR^iShadhvajaH
verses.translation: By the grace of those Rudras, the gods conquered the Asuras and were rid of fear. Indra and other gods had peace of mind and ruled over their own kingdom.
verses.hindi: गद्गद वाणीसे शिवजीकी स्तुति करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रमुख्या गीर्वाणा नागाः पातालवासिनः । रत्नान्यादाय बहुशः ससरित्का महाब्धयः
verses.transliteration: mahendramukhyA gIrvANA nAgAH pAtAlavAsinaH | ratnAnyAdAya bahushaH sasaritkA mahAbdhayaH
verses.translation: Those Rudras favourably disposed towards their devotees took up their residence in the north-eastern city of Isana. Experts in different kinds of sports they sport about there always.

verses.sanskrit: स्थावरा जङ्गमं रूपं धृत्वायाताः सहस्रशः । महामहोत्सवे तस्मिन् बभूवाकालकौमुदी
verses.transliteration: sthAvarA ja~NgamaM rUpaM dhR^itvAyAtAH sahasrashaH | mahAmahotsave tasmin babhUvAkAlakaumudI
verses.translation: The Rudras glorified as their followers and retainers are crores in number. They are stationed everywhere in the three worlds, undividedly.
verses.hindi: आपके समीप निवासकी याचना करती हूँ

verses.sanskrit: जातकर्म स्वयं तस्य कृतवान्विधिरानतः । श्रुतिं विचार्य तद्रूपं नाम्ना गृहपतिस्त्वयम्
verses.transliteration: jAtakarma svayaM tasya kR^itavAnvidhirAnataH | shrutiM vichArya tadrUpaM nAmnA gR^ihapatistvayam
verses.translation: O dear, thus the eleven Rudra incarnations of Siva, pleasing to all the worlds have been described to you.
verses.hindi: इच्छित वर देकर क्षणभरमें अन्तर्धान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: इति नाम ददौ तस्मै देयमेकादशेऽहनि । नामकर्मविधानेन तदर्थं श्रुतिमुच्चरन्
verses.transliteration: iti nAma dadau tasmai deyamekAdashe.ahani | nAmakarmavidhAnena tadarthaM shrutimuchcharan
verses.translation: He who listens to or reads this with pious heart enjoys all pleasures here and attains liberation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्निगममन्त्रोक्तैराशीर्भिरभिनन्द्य च । समयाद्धं समारुह्य सर्वेषां च पितामहः
verses.transliteration: chaturnigamamantroktairAshIrbhirabhinandya cha | samayAddhaM samAruhya sarveShAM cha pitAmahaH
verses.translation: The names of eleven Rudras differ in different Pur&as. Born of Surabhi from Kaiypa, residing in the North eastern regions, these were directed to protect the gods against the Asuras. The Pur&nas speak of Rudras emanated from these and stationed in the three worlds for carrying out the task of protecting the good against the wicked.
verses.hindi: राजा भद्रायुको परम सुख प्राप्त हुआ

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा बालोचितां रक्षां लौकिकीं गतिमाश्रितः । आरुह्य यानं स्वं धाम हरोऽपि हरिणा ययौ
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA bAlochitAM rakShAM laukikIM gatimAshritaH | Aruhya yAnaM svaM dhAma haro.api hariNA yayau
verses.translation: O great sage, now listen lovingly to another story of 8iva, how Siva was born as Durvasas for the maintenance of virtue.
