verses.sanskrit: अहो रूपमहो तेजस्त्वहो सर्वाङ्गलक्षणम् । अहो शुचिष्मतीभाग्यमाविरासीत्स्वयं हरः
verses.transliteration: aho rUpamaho tejastvaho sarvA~NgalakShaNam | aho shuchiShmatIbhAgyamAvirAsItsvayaM haraH
verses.translation: At the direction of Brahma he went to the moun¬ tain Rksakula accompanied by his wife in order to per¬ form penance there, with the desire to get son.
verses.hindi: है और परलोकमें उत्तम गति प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: अथवा किमिदं चित्रं शर्वभक्तजनेष्वहो । स्वयमाविरभूद् रुद्रो यतो रुद्रस्तदर्चितः
verses.transliteration: athavA kimidaM chitraM sharvabhaktajaneShvaho | svayamAvirabhUd rudro yato rudrastadarchitaH
verses.translation: On the banks of the river Nirvindhya,*® the sage who had controlled his breath and had freed himself from mutually clashing emotions performed a great penance for a hundred years.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां द्विजेशाख्य-शिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तर्विशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: अथ कालेन तद्योषिदन्तर्वत्नी बभूव ह । विधिवद् विहिते तेन गर्भाधानाख्यकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: atha kAlena tadyoShidantarvatnI babhUva ha | vidhivad vihite tena garbhAdhAnAkhyakarmaNi
verses.translation: He decided in his mind thus—, **let that sole great lord, whoever he is, who is free from aberrations, grant me the boon of a son.**

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुवन्तस्तेऽन्योऽन्यं सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः । विश्वानरं समापृच्छ्य जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: iti stuvantaste.anyo.anyaM samprahR^iShTatanUruhaH | vishvAnaraM samApR^ichChya jagmuH sarve yathAgatam
verses.translation: A long time elapsed while he performed the holy penance. A holy flame of fire came out of him.

verses.sanskrit: अतः पुत्रं समीहन्ते गृहस्थाश्रमवासिनः । पुत्रेण लोकाञ्जयति श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी
verses.transliteration: ataH putraM samIhante gR^ihasthAshramavAsinaH | putreNa lokA~njayati shrutireShA sanAtanI
verses.translation: O great sage, the worlds were almost burnt by that flame. Indra and other gods and the celestial sages too were afflicted by it.
verses.hindi: पूजा करते थे। वे दोनों महाशिवभक्त थे

verses.sanskrit: अपुत्रस्य गृहं शून्यमपुत्रस्यार्जनं वृथा । अपुत्रस्य तपश्छिन्नं नो पवित्रत्यपुत्रतः
verses.transliteration: aputrasya gR^ihaM shUnyamaputrasyArjanaM vR^ithA | aputrasya tapashChinnaM no pavitratyaputrataH
verses.translation: Then, highly distressed by that flame, O sage, Indra and other gods and the sages hastened to the abode of Bra¬ hma.

verses.sanskrit: न पुत्रात्परमो लाभो न पुत्रात्परमं सुखम् । न पुत्रात्परमं मित्रं परत्रेह च कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: na putrAtparamo lAbho na putrAtparamaM sukham | na putrAtparamaM mitraM paratreha cha kutrachit
verses.translation: After bowing to and eulogising Brahma the gods mentioned to him their grief. O dear, Brahma immediately went to Vi9nu*s region along with the god.

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रमोऽथ चतुर्थेऽस्य मासि पित्रा कृतो गृहात् । अन्नप्राशनमब्दार्द्धे चूडाब्दे चार्थवत्कृता
verses.transliteration: niShkramo.atha chaturthe.asya mAsi pitrA kR^ito gR^ihAt | annaprAshanamabdArddhe chUDAbde chArthavatkR^itA
verses.translation: O sage, after reaching there along with the gods Brahma bowed to and eulogised Viu and mentioned his endless grief to him.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णवेधं ततः कृत्वा श्रवणर्क्षे स कर्मवित् । ब्रह्मतेजोभिवृद्ध्यर्थं पञ्चमेऽब्दे व्रतं ददौ
verses.transliteration: karNavedhaM tataH kR^itvA shravaNarkShe sa karmavit | brahmatejobhivR^iddhyarthaM pa~nchame.abde vrataM dadau
verses.translation: Vifou too, accompanied by Brahma and the gods hastened to Rudra's abode. After reaching it he bowed to and eulogised lord iSiva.
verses.hindi: सर्वथा चला जाऊँगा, तुम्हारा सर्वदा कल्याण हो

verses.sanskrit: उपाकर्म ततः कृत्वा वेदानध्यापयत्सुधीः । त्र्यब्दं वेदान्स विधिनाध्यैष्ट साङ्गपदक्रमान्
verses.transliteration: upAkarma tataH kR^itvA vedAnadhyApayatsudhIH | tryabdaM vedAnsa vidhinAdhyaiShTa sA~NgapadakramAn
verses.translation: After eulogising him Vifnu mentioned to Siva his grief caused by the flame due to the penance of Atri.
verses.hindi: फिर यहाँ आपका निवास किस प्रकार सम्भव है 2

verses.sanskrit: विद्याजातं समस्तं च साक्षिमात्रं गुरोर्मुखात् । विनयादिगुणानाविष्कुर्वञ्जग्राह शक्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: vidyAjAtaM samastaM cha sAkShimAtraM gurormukhAt | vinayAdiguNAnAviShkurva~njagrAha shaktimAn
verses.translation: O sage, thus gathering there, together, Brahma, Viiu and Siva consulted one another about the welfare of the worlds.
verses.hindi: मत कीजिये। अन्यथा आपके धर्मका क्षय होगा

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽथ नवमे वर्षे पित्रोः शुश्रूषणे रतम् । वैश्वानरं गृहपतिं द्रष्टुमायाच्च नारदः
verses.transliteration: tato.atha navame varShe pitroH shushrUShaNe ratam | vaishvAnaraM gR^ihapatiM draShTumAyAchcha nAradaH
verses.translation: The three deities Brahma and others, foremost among the bestowers of boons, went to the hermitage of Atri immediately to grant him the boon.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानरोटजं प्राप्य देवर्षिस्तं तु कौतुकी । अपृच्छत्कुशलं तत्र गृहीतार्घासनः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vishvAnaroTajaM prApya devarShistaM tu kautukI | apR^ichChatkushalaM tatra gR^ihItArghAsanaH kramAt
verses.translation: On seeing them marked by their respective charac¬ teristic signs, the excellent sage Atri bowed to and eulogised them respectfully by uttering pleasing words.
verses.hindi: जगह गमन भी अपने अधर्मका कारण होगा

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुंसवनं तेन स्पन्दनात्प्राग्विपश्चिता । गृह्योक्तविधिना सम्यक् कृतं पुंस्त्वविवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: tataH puMsavanaM tena spandanAtprAgvipashchitA | gR^ihyoktavidhinA samyak kR^itaM puMstvavivR^iddhaye
verses.translation: The surprised brahmin, the humble son of Brah¬ ma spoke to those deities Brahma, Visnu and Siva, with palms.joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: है, वह हो, मैं घरके बाहर ही रहूँगा

verses.sanskrit: ततः सर्वं च तद्भाग्यं पुत्रधर्मं च सम्मुखे । विश्वानरं समवदत्स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sarvaM cha tadbhAgyaM putradharmaM cha sammukhe | vishvAnaraM samavadatsmR^itvA shivapadAmbujam
verses.translation: O Brahma, O Vinu, O Siva, you are worthy of being worshipped by the three worlds. You are lords and masters and the cause of creation, maintenance and annihi¬ lation.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तो मुनिना बालः पित्रोराज्ञामवाप्य सः । प्रणम्य नारदं श्रीमान् भक्त्या प्रह्व उपाविशत
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityukto muninA bAlaH pitrorAj~nAmavApya saH | praNamya nAradaM shrImAn bhaktyA prahva upAvishata
verses.translation: Accompanied by my wife, I meditated only on a single lord for obtaining a son, that lord whoever he may be, who is famous as Ivara.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । वैश्वानर समभ्येहि ममोत्सङ्गे निषीद भोः । लक्षणानि परीक्षेऽहं पाणिं दर्शय दक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: nArada uvAcha | vaishvAnara samabhyehi mamotsa~Nge niShIda bhoH | lakShaNAni parIkShe.ahaM pANiM darshaya dakShiNam
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the three deities replied "O great sage, what has occurred is in accordance with what you have conceived.
verses.hindi: उस वनेचर भीलको देखकर बड़ा दुखी हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ततो दृष्ट्वा तु सर्वं हि तालुजिह्वादि नारदः । विश्वानरं समवदच्छिवप्रेरणया सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tato dR^iShTvA tu sarvaM hi tAlujihvAdi nAradaH | vishvAnaraM samavadachChivapreraNayA sudhIH
verses.translation: We three are great lords and equally leading among the granters of boons. Hence three sons originating from our parts will be born to you.
verses.hindi: कृतकृत्य हो गये। जो इस प्रकार इनकी मृत्यु हुई

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । विश्वानर मुने वच्मि शृणु पुत्राङ्कमादरात् । सर्वाङ्गस्वङ्कवान्पुत्रो महालक्षणवानयम्
verses.transliteration: nArada uvAcha | vishvAnara mune vachmi shR^iNu putrA~NkamAdarAt | sarvA~Ngasva~NkavAnputro mahAlakShaNavAnayam
verses.translation: They will be known in the world as enhancers of
verses.hindi: कराइये; क्योंकि यही स्त्रियोंका सनातनधर्म है

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु सर्वगुणोपेतं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् । सम्पूर्णनिर्मलकलं पालयेद्विधुवद्विधिः
verses.transliteration: kintu sarvaguNopetaM sarvalakShaNalakShitam | sampUrNanirmalakalaM pAlayedvidhuvadvidhiH
verses.translation: After securing the boon, the sage joyously returned to his hermitage accompanied by Anasuya. O sage, he was delighted and he experienced the bliss of the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन रक्षणीयस्त्वसौ शिशुः । गुणोऽपि दोषतां याति वक्रीभूते विधातरि
verses.transliteration: tasmAtsarvaprayatnena rakShaNIyastvasau shishuH | guNo.api doShatAM yAti vakrIbhUte vidhAtari
verses.translation: Then Brahma, Visnu and Siva, the delighted ex¬ ponents of different kinds of sports, took their incarnations as the sons of his wife.
verses.hindi: करते हुए शिवजी उस भीलनी से कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: शङ्केऽस्य द्वादशे वर्षे प्रत्यूहो विद्युदग्नितः । इत्युक्त्वा नारदोऽगच्छद्देवलोकं यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: sha~Nke.asya dvAdashe varShe pratyUho vidyudagnitaH | ityuktvA nArado.agachChaddevalokaM yathAgatam
verses.translation: Siva by becoming Durvasas, the enhancer of Brah- minical splendour, tested the piety of many people. He was merciful.
verses.hindi: उसको कुछ भी स्मरण नहीं रहा

verses.sanskrit: सीमन्तोऽथाष्टमे मासे गर्भरूपसमृद्धिकृत् । सुखप्रसवसिद्धौ च तेनाकरि क्रियाविदा
verses.transliteration: sImanto.athAShTame mAse garbharUpasamR^iddhikR^it | sukhaprasavasiddhau cha tenAkari kriyAvidA
verses.translation: The king Ambarisa, a scion of the solar dynasty, was tested by him. O great sage, listen to that story.

verses.sanskrit: अथातः शुभतारासु ताराधिपवराननः । केन्द्रे गुरौ शुभे लग्ने सुग्रहेषु युगेषु च
verses.transliteration: athAtaH shubhatArAsu tArAdhipavarAnanaH | kendre gurau shubhe lagne sugraheShu yugeShu cha
verses.translation: The king had the firm resolve that he would per¬ form the rite of breaking fast on the Dvadai day.
verses.hindi: वह लिंग अचलेश--इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टदीपनिर्वाणः सर्वारिष्टविनाशकृत् । तनयो नाम तस्यां तु शुचिष्मत्यां बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: ariShTadIpanirvANaH sarvAriShTavinAshakR^it | tanayo nAma tasyAM tu shuchiShmatyAM babhUva ha
verses.translation: Coming to know of his regular observance the excellent sage Durvasas, born of Siva's part approached him writh many disciples.

verses.sanskrit: शर्वः समस्तसुखदो भूर्भुवःस्वर्न्निवासिनाम् । गन्धवाहनवाहाश्च दिग्वधूर्मुखवाससः
verses.transliteration: sharvaH samastasukhado bhUrbhuvaHsvarnnivAsinAm | gandhavAhanavAhAshcha digvadhUrmukhavAsasaH
verses.translation: Then the sage Durvasas went away for his cere¬ monial ablution, accompanied by his disciples In order to test the king, the sage purposely delayed there.
verses.hindi: अद्भुत तथा निश्चय ही मुक्तिदायक है

verses.sanskrit: इष्टगन्धप्रसूनौघैर्ववृषुस्ते घनाघनाः । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः प्रसेदुः सर्वतो दिशः
verses.transliteration: iShTagandhaprasUnaughairvavR^iShuste ghanAghanAH | devadundubhayo neduH praseduH sarvato dishaH
verses.translation: Realising that there would be violation of sacred injunction otherwise, the king took in a small quantity of water and waited for the arrival of the sage.
verses.hindi: इृह् सर्वसु्ं भुकत्वा सो5न्ते शिवपुरं ब्रजेत्॥ ४१  शिवलोकको प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: () base king, after inviting but without feeding me you ha''e taken in water. I shall show you the fruit thereof, her I am the chastiser of the wicked.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: () base king, after inviting but without feeding me you ha''e taken in water. I shall show you the fruit thereof, her I am the chastiser of the wicked.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१५. पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः । गृहपत्यवतारवर्णनम् ३ । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । विश्वानरः सपत्नीकः तच्छ्रुत्वा नारदेरितम् । तदेवं मन्यमानोऽभूद्वज्रपातं सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.15\. pa~nchadasho.adhyAyaH | gR^ihapatyavatAravarNanam 3 | nandIshvara uvAcha | vishvAnaraH sapatnIkaH tachChrutvA nAraderitam | tadevaM manyamAno.abhUdvajrapAtaM sudAruNam
verses.translation: In the meantime an unembodied celestial voice spoke to Amljarisa, the noble soul, the devotee of Brahma and Visi i

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य जारितौ द्विजदम्पती । अकालामृतवर्षौघैर्गततापौ तदोचतुः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasya jAritau dvijadampatI | akAlAmR^itavarShaughairgatatApau tadochatuH
verses.translation: O king, this discus had been given to Visnu by Si\a. It is low blazing against Durvasas. Quieten it.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजदम्पती ऊचतुः । पुनर्ब्रूहि पुनर्ब्रूहि कीदृक् कीदृक् पुनर्वद । कालः कलयितुं नालं वराकी चञ्चलास्ति का
verses.transliteration: dvijadampatI UchatuH | punarbrUhi punarbrUhi kIdR^ik kIdR^ik punarvada | kAlaH kalayituM nAlaM varAkI cha~nchalAsti kA
verses.translation: O great sage, after saying thus, the celestial voice stopped. Ambarisa too eulogised the sage who was the part of iva himself.

verses.sanskrit: आवयोस्तापनाशाय महोपायस्त्वयेरितः । मृत्युञ्जयाख्यदेवस्य समाराधनलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: AvayostApanAshAya mahopAyastvayeritaH | mR^ityu~njayAkhyadevasya samArAdhanalakShaNaH
verses.translation: If I possess the merit of charity and sacrifice, if my spiritual duty has been well performed by me, and if our family considers brahmins godly, let the weapon of Vi$nu turn calni.
verses.hindi: उन्हींको ग्रहण करो, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: तद्वच्च शरणं शम्भोर्नातः परतरं हि तत् । मनोरथपथातीतकारिणः पापहारिणः
verses.transliteration: tadvachcha sharaNaM shambhornAtaH parataraM hi tat | manorathapathAtItakAriNaH pApahAriNaH
verses.translation: If our lord, favourably disposed to his devotees, is delighted with my devotion let this missile SudarSana become quite calm.
verses.hindi: भाइयोंने मुझे छोड़कर सारा राज्य बाँट लिया

verses.sanskrit: किं न श्रुतं त्वया तात श्वेतकेतुं यथा पुरा । पाशितं कालपाशेन ररक्ष त्रिपुरान्तकः
verses.transliteration: kiM na shrutaM tvayA tAta shvetaketuM yathA purA | pAshitaM kAlapAshena rarakSha tripurAntakaH
verses.translation: While be eulogised in front of Durvasas, the discus Sudarana that originally belonged to Siva became calm in all respects. Knowing him to be biva's part, the king Ambaiisa, who had regained the composure of mind bowed to the sage whom he realised as Siva's incarnation come there to test his vow.

verses.sanskrit: शिलादतनयं मृत्युग्रस्तमष्टाब्दमात्रकम् । शिवो निजजनं चक्रे नन्दिनं विश्वनन्दिनम्
verses.transliteration: shilAdatanayaM mR^ityugrastamaShTAbdamAtrakam | shivo nijajanaM chakre nandinaM vishvanandinam
verses.translation: O sage, I;have narrated the story of Durvasas in the course of his test of Ambarlia. O great sage, listen to another story of his.
verses.hindi: ठीक उपाय बताता हूँ, तुम श्रवण करो

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदमथनोद्भूतं प्रलयानलसन्निभम् । पीत्वा हालाहलं घोरमरक्षद्भुवनत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: kShIrodamathanodbhUtaM pralayAnalasannibham | pItvA hAlAhalaM ghoramarakShadbhuvanatrayam
verses.translation: O sage, through the condition stipulated by Kala in the form of a sage he conducted the test of Rama, son of Daaratha.
verses.hindi: बतलाओ, जिससे वह यज्ञ शुद्ध हो सके

verses.sanskrit: जलन्धरं महादर्पं हृतत्रैलोक्यसम्पदम् । रुचिराङ्गुष्ठरेखोत्थचक्रेण निजघान यः
verses.transliteration: jalandharaM mahAdarpaM hR^itatrailokyasampadam | ruchirA~NguShTharekhotthachakreNa nijaghAna yaH
verses.translation: The story has been diversely narrated and spread in the world by the sages. It is known by all means to the scholars. Hence it is not mentioned in detail by me.
verses.hindi: बचा हुआ धन तुम्हें दे देंगे

verses.sanskrit: य एकेषुनिपातोत्थज्वलनैस्त्रिपुरम्पुरा । त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यसम्मूढं शोषयामास भानुना
verses.transliteration: ya ekeShunipAtotthajvalanaistripurampurA | trailokyaishvaryasammUDhaM shoShayAmAsa bhAnunA
verses.translation: Knowing his promise steady and resolute, the sage was highly delighted. The delighted sage Durvasas granted him the desired boons.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान देनेके लिये वे प्रकट हुए थे

verses.sanskrit: कामं दृष्टिनिपातेन त्रैलोक्यविजयोर्जितम् । निनायानङ्गपदवीं वीक्ष्यमाणेष्वजादिषु
verses.transliteration: kAmaM dR^iShTinipAtena trailokyavijayorjitam | ninAyAna~NgapadavIM vIkShyamANeShvajAdiShu
verses.translation: He had tested the resoluteness of lord Krfna too. O excellent sage, listen to that also. I shall tell you that story also.

verses.sanskrit: हा हतोऽस्मीति वचसा हृदयं समताडयत् । मूर्च्छामवाप महतीं पुत्रशोकसमाकुलः
verses.transliteration: hA hato.asmIti vachasA hR^idayaM samatADayat | mUrchChAmavApa mahatIM putrashokasamAkulaH
verses.translation: Lord Kfna slew the wicked, the great sinners, those who harassed the brahmins and the knaves. He pro* tected all good men and brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: तं ब्रह्माद्यैककर्तारं मेघवाहनमच्युतम् । प्रयाहि पुत्र शरणं विश्वरक्षामणिं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: taM brahmAdyaikakartAraM meghavAhanamachyutam | prayAhi putra sharaNaM vishvarakShAmaNiM shivam
verses.translation: Krna, son of Vasudcva, showed great devotion to Brahmins. Everyday he fed many br ahmin s with many juicy articles.
verses.hindi: तब आप इसे लेनेसे मुझे क्यों मना करते हैं 2

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । पित्रोरनुज्ञां प्राप्येति प्रणम्य चरणौ तयोः । प्रादक्षिण्यमुपावृत्य बह्वाश्वास्य विनिर्ययौ
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | pitroranuj~nAM prApyeti praNamya charaNau tayoH | prAdakShiNyamupAvR^itya bahvAshvAsya viniryayau
verses.translation: He tied Kfna and his consort Rukmini to the chariot and sat hiinself in the chariot. Kfna bore the chariot delightfully.

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्राप्य काशीं दुष्प्रापां ब्रह्मनारायणादिभिः । महासंवर्त्तसन्तापहन्त्रीं विश्वेशपालिताम्
verses.transliteration: samprApya kAshIM duShprApAM brahmanArAyaNAdibhiH | mahAsaMvarttasantApahantrIM vishveshapAlitAm
verses.translation: As the piece of cloth reached him being carried by the current, the sage covered his private parts with it. He was therefore pleased with her.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्धुन्या हारयष्ट्येव राजितां कण्ठभूमिषु । विचित्रगुणशालिन्या हरपत्न्या विराजिताम्
verses.transliteration: svardhunyA hArayaShTyeva rAjitAM kaNThabhUmiShu | vichitraguNashAlinyA harapatnyA virAjitAm
verses.translation: He granted her the boon of ever increasing folds of cloth. Later, Draupadi made the Pa 9 <jlavas happy due to that boon.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र प्राप्य स विप्रेशः प्राग्ययौ मणिकर्णिकाम् । तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन दृष्ट्वा विश्वेश्वरं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tatra prApya sa vipreshaH prAgyayau maNikarNikAm | tatra snAtvA vidhAnena dR^iShTvA vishveshvaraM prabhum
verses.translation: That holy sage gave directive to Vi?nu and des¬ troyed two wicked kings who had insulted him in the form of two young ones of swans.
verses.hindi: विषयमें कहना ही क्या--ऐसा मेरे पिताने कहा है

verses.sanskrit: साञ्जलिर्नतशीर्षोऽसौ महानन्दान्वितः सुधीः । त्रैलोक्यप्राणसन्त्राणकारिणं प्रणनाम ह
verses.transliteration: sA~njalirnatashIrSho.asau mahAnandAnvitaH sudhIH | trailokyaprANasantrANakAriNaM praNanAma ha
verses.translation: By his excellent brahminical splendour he estab¬ lished the path of renunciation in the world in accordance with the order and injunctions of the sacred lore.

verses.sanskrit: आलोक्यालोक्य तल्लिङ्गं तुतोष हृदये मुहुः । परमानन्दकन्दाढ्यं स्फुटमेतन्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: AlokyAlokya talli~NgaM tutoSha hR^idaye muhuH | paramAnandakandADhyaM sphuTametanna saMshayaH
verses.translation: By instructions and enlightenment he uplifted many. By imparting knowledge he made many liberated.

verses.sanskrit: अहो न मत्तो धन्योऽस्ति त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे । यदद्राक्षिषमद्याहं श्रीमद्विश्वेश्वरं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: aho na matto dhanyo.asti trailokye sacharAchare | yadadrAkShiShamadyAhaM shrImadvishveshvaraM vibhum
verses.translation: Thus the sage Durvasas had a variegated and

verses.sanskrit: मम भाग्योदयायैव नारदेन महर्षिणा । पुरागत्य तथोक्तं यत्कृतकृत्योऽस्म्यहं ततः
verses.transliteration: mama bhAgyodayAyaiva nAradena maharShiNA | purAgatya tathoktaM yatkR^itakR^ityo.asmyahaM tataH
verses.translation: He who hears or reads the story of Durvasas with devotion and joy will be happy here and hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्यानन्दामृतरसैर्विधाय स हि पारणम् । ततः शुभेऽह्नि संस्थाप्य लिङ्गं सर्वहितप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAnandAmR^itarasairvidhAya sa hi pAraNam | tataH shubhe.ahni saMsthApya li~NgaM sarvahitapradam
verses.translation: O sage, henceforth listen lovingly to the story of Hanumat, how!§iva performed excellent sports in that form.
verses.hindi: यज्ञशेष सामग्रीको तुम मेरी कृपासे ग्रहण करो

verses.sanskrit: शुचिष्मत्यपि दुःखार्ता रुरोदातीव दुस्सहम् । अतिस्वरेण हारावैरत्यन्तं व्याकुलेन्द्रिया
verses.transliteration: shuchiShmatyapi duHkhArtA rurodAtIva dussaham | atisvareNa hArAvairatyantaM vyAkulendriyA
verses.translation: Out of love. Lord Siva rendered great help to Rama. O brahmin, listen to the whole of that story which is pleasing to all.

verses.sanskrit: जग्राह नियमान्घोरान् दुष्करानकृतात्मभिः । अष्टोत्तरशतैः कुम्भैः पूर्णैर्गङ्गाऽम्भसा शुभैः
verses.transliteration: jagrAha niyamAnghorAn duShkarAnakR^itAtmabhiH | aShTottarashataiH kumbhaiH pUrNairga~NgA.ambhasA shubhaiH
verses.translation: Once lord Siva of wonderful sports saw Visnu in the form of an enchantress with glittering qualities.

verses.sanskrit: संस्नाप्य वाससा पूतैः पूतात्मा प्रत्यहं शिवम् । नीलोत्पलमयीं मालां समर्पयति सोऽन्वहम्
verses.transliteration: saMsnApya vAsasA pUtaiH pUtAtmA pratyahaM shivam | nIlotpalamayIM mAlAM samarpayati so.anvaham
verses.translation: As if hit by the arrows of Cupid, Siva let fall his semen dislodged from its seat, for Rama's work.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाधिकसहस्रैस्तु सुमनोभिर्विनिर्मिताम् । स पक्षे वाथ वा मासे कन्दमूलफलाशनः
verses.transliteration: aShTAdhikasahasraistu sumanobhirvinirmitAm | sa pakShe vAtha vA mAse kandamUlaphalAshanaH
verses.translation: Eagerly urged by him mentally for Rama's work, the seven celestial sages retained that semen in a leaf.
verses.hindi: कविर्भवति मन्त्रज्ञो गतिमन्ते लभेत्पराम्॥ ५९  जाता है और अन्तमें परमगति प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: शीर्णपर्णाशनैर्धीरः षण्मासं सम्बभूव सः । षण्मासं वायुभक्षोऽभूत्षण्मासं जलबिन्दुभुक्
verses.transliteration: shIrNaparNAshanairdhIraH ShaNmAsaM sambabhUva saH | ShaNmAsaM vAyubhakSho.abhUtShaNmAsaM jalabindubhuk
verses.translation: At the request of the gods he left it. Knowing him to be an incarnation of Siva of great power the gods and the sages granted him boons.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वर्षद्वयं तस्य व्यतिक्रान्तं महात्मनः । शिवैकमनसो विप्रास्तप्यमानस्य नारद
verses.transliteration: evaM varShadvayaM tasya vyatikrAntaM mahAtmanaH | shivaikamanaso viprAstapyamAnasya nArada
verses.translation: Highly delighted he approached his mother and eagerly told her everything in detail.
verses.hindi: कृष्णदर्शन जिवावतारवर्णन नामक उनतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: जन्मतो द्वादशे वर्षे तद्वचो नारदेरितम् । सत्यं करिष्यन्निव तमभ्यगात्कुलिशायुधः
verses.transliteration: janmato dvAdashe varShe tadvacho nAraderitam | satyaM kariShyanniva tamabhyagAtkulishAyudhaH
verses.translation: At her behest the bold monkey went to the sun
verses.hindi: जो इन्द्रके घमण्डको नष्ट करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: उवाच च वरं ब्रूहि दद्मि त्वन्मनसि स्थितम् । अहं शतक्रतुर्विप्र प्रसन्नोऽस्मि शुभव्रतैः
verses.transliteration: uvAcha cha varaM brUhi dadmi tvanmanasi sthitam | ahaM shatakraturvipra prasanno.asmi shubhavrataiH
verses.translation: The excellent monkey, a part of Siva approached Sugriva, a part of the sun, at his behest, after getting the permission of his mother.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य महेन्द्रस्य वाक्यं मुनिकुमारकः । उवाच मधुरं धीरः कीर्तयन्मधुराक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAkarNya mahendrasya vAkyaM munikumArakaH | uvAcha madhuraM dhIraH kIrtayanmadhurAkSharam
verses.translation: Sugriva who had been exiled by his elder brother Bali who enjoyed his (Sugriva's) wife, stayed on the mountain Rsyamuka® along with Hanumat.

verses.sanskrit: गृहपतिरुवाच । मघवन् वृत्रशत्रो त्वां जाने कुलिशपाणिनम् । नाहं वृणे वरं त्वत्तः शङ्करो वरदोऽस्ति मे
verses.transliteration: gR^ihapatiruvAcha | maghavan vR^itrashatro tvAM jAne kulishapANinam | nAhaM vR^iNe varaM tvattaH sha~Nkaro varado.asti me
verses.translation: The intelligent monkey born of a part of Siva became Sugriva's minister and did everything beneficial to him in every respect.
verses.hindi: क्या नाम है ? तुम मुझे ठीक-ठीक शीघ्र बताओ

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच । न मत्तः शङ्करस्त्वन्यो देवदेवोऽस्म्यहं शिशो । विहाय बालिशत्वं त्वं वरं याचस्व मा चिरम्
verses.transliteration: indra uvAcha | na mattaH sha~Nkarastvanyo devadevo.asmyahaM shisho | vihAya bAlishatvaM tvaM varaM yAchasva mA chiram
verses.translation: He made him enter into a pleasing alliance with Rama who came there along with his brother and who was sad because his wife had been abducted by Ravana.
verses.hindi: साथ लेकर उनके दर्शनहेतु जा रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वार्तनादमिति विश्वनरोऽपि मोहं हित्वोत्थितः किमिति किं त्विति किं किमेतत् । उच्चैर्वदन् गृहपतिः क्व स मे बहिस्थः प्राणोऽन्तरात्मनिलयस्सकलेन्द्रियेशः
verses.transliteration: shrutvArtanAdamiti vishvanaro.api mohaM hitvotthitaH kimiti kiM tviti kiM kimetat | uchchairvadan gR^ihapatiH kva sa me bahisthaH prANo.antarAtmanilayassakalendriyeshaH
verses.translation: Then at the behest of Rama, O dear, the intel¬ ligent and leading monkey Hanumat went out in search of
verses.hindi: प्रभु शिवने कुछ भी उत्तर नहीं दिया

verses.sanskrit: गृहपतिरुवाच । गच्छाहल्यापतेऽसाधो गोत्रारे पाकशासन । न प्रार्थये पशुपतेरन्यं देवान्तरं स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: gR^ihapatiruvAcha | gachChAhalyApate.asAdho gotrAre pAkashAsana | na prArthaye pashupateranyaM devAntaraM sphuTam
verses.translation: There he performed wonderful exploits and handed over the excellent token of recognition of his lord Rama to Sita.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः । उद्यम्य कुलिशं घोरं भीषयामास बालकम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti tasya vachaH shrutvA krodhasaMraktalochanaH | udyamya kulishaM ghoraM bhIShayAmAsa bAlakam
verses.translation: Narrating the endeavours of Rama for the pro¬ tection of her life, the heroic leader of monkeys dispelled the

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा बालको वज्रं विद्युज्ज्वालासमाकुलम् । स्मरन्नारदवाक्यं च मुमूर्च्छ भयविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: sa dR^iShTvA bAlako vajraM vidyujjvAlAsamAkulam | smarannAradavAkyaM cha mumUrchCha bhayavihvalaH
verses.translation: Taking a token from her he turned back to go towards Rama. On the way he broke Ravaija's park and killed many Rak?asas.
verses.hindi: देखकर शीघ्र ही उनका स्तम्भन कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: अथ गौरीपतिः शम्भुराविरासीत्तमोनुदः । उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते स्पर्शैः सञ्जीवयन्निव
verses.transliteration: atha gaurIpatiH shambhurAvirAsIttamonudaH | uttiShThottiShTha bhadraM te sparshaiH sa~njIvayanniva
verses.translation: At the same time he killed Ravana s son also along with many Rakfasas. That fearless monkey of great exploits wrought a havoc there.
verses.hindi: जलाते हुए शीघ्र ही प्रज्बलित हो उठे

verses.sanskrit: उन्मील्य नेत्रकमले सुप्ते इव दिनक्षये । अपश्यदग्रे चोत्थाय शम्भुमर्कशताधिकम्
verses.transliteration: unmIlya netrakamale supte iva dinakShaye | apashyadagre chotthAya shambhumarkashatAdhikam
verses.translation: R?yamukagiri, associated with the life of RSma, is placed in the

verses.sanskrit: भाले लोचनमालोक्य कण्ठेकालं वृषध्वजम् । वामाङ्गसन्निविष्टाद्रितनयं चन्द्रशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: bhAle lochanamAlokya kaNThekAlaM vR^iShadhvajam | vAmA~NgasanniviShTAdritanayaM chandrashekharam
verses.translation: The identification of LahkS b controversial. Acco present context. Laftka, the capital
verses.hindi: कीजिये; क्रोध नहीं, बल्कि प्रेम कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: कपर्देन विराजन्तं त्रिशूलाजगवायुधम् । स्फुरत्कर्पूरगौराङ्गं परिणद्धगजाजिनम्
verses.transliteration: kapardena virAjantaM trishUlAjagavAyudham | sphuratkarpUragaurA~NgaM pariNaddhagajAjinam
verses.translation: O sage, when the powerful Ravana bound him with oil-dripping cloths and set fire to them, the mon¬ key, a part of l$iva himself, jumped about and marking that a pretext burnt the city of Lanka.

verses.sanskrit: परिज्ञाय महादेवं गुरुवाक्यत आगमात् । हर्षबाष्पाकुलासन्नकण्ठरोमाञ्चकञ्चुकः
verses.transliteration: parij~nAya mahAdevaM guruvAkyata AgamAt | harShabAShpAkulAsannakaNTharomA~nchaka~nchukaH
verses.translation: After burning Lanka except the mansion of Bi- bhiana, the heroic leader of monkeys jumped into the ocean.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले उन प्रभुने हँसते हुए कहा--

verses.sanskrit: क्षणं च गिरिवत्तस्थौ चित्रकृत्रिमपुत्रकः । यथा तथा सुसम्पन्नो विस्मृत्यात्मानमेव च
verses.transliteration: kShaNaM cha girivattasthau chitrakR^itrimaputrakaH | yathA tathA susampanno vismR^ityAtmAnameva cha
verses.translation: Thereby extinguishing the 6re from his tail he reached the other shore. Not at all tired or grieved the monkey born of a part of Siva approached Rama.

verses.sanskrit: न स्तोतुं न नमस्कर्तुं किञ्चिद्विज्ञप्तुमेव च । यदा स न शशाकालं तदा स्मित्वाह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: na stotuM na namaskartuM ki~nchidvij~naptumeva cha | yadA sa na shashAkAlaM tadA smitvAha sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: The rapid and excellent monkey Hanumat reached Rama's side without delay and handed over the crest-jewel of Sita.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दृष्ट्वा स पितरौ बहुशोकसमावृतौ । स्मित्वोवाच गृहपतिः सबालः शङ्करांशजः
verses.transliteration: tato dR^iShTvA sa pitarau bahushokasamAvR^itau | smitvovAcha gR^ihapatiH sabAlaH sha~NkarAMshajaH
verses.translation: At his behest, the powerful hero, gathered many mountains through the hosts of monkeys and built a bridge in the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । शिशो गृहपते शक्राद्वज्रोद्यतकरादहो । ज्ञातं भीतोऽसि मा भैषीर्जिज्ञासा ते मया कृता
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | shisho gR^ihapate shakrAdvajrodyatakarAdaho | j~nAtaM bhIto.asi mA bhaiShIrjij~nAsA te mayA kR^itA
verses.translation: Securing his boon of victory, he crossed the ocean, surrounded Lanka with the monkeyL and fought against the Rakasas.

verses.sanskrit: मम भक्तस्य नो शक्रो न वज्रं चान्तकोऽपि च । प्रभवेदिन्द्ररूपेण मयैव त्वं बिभीषितः
verses.transliteration: mama bhaktasya no shakro na vajraM chAntako.api cha | prabhavedindrarUpeNa mayaiva tvaM bibhIShitaH
verses.translation: The heroic Hanumat slew many Asuras and pro tected Rama's army. He enlivened Laksmana by the medici¬ nal herb Sahjlvani when he was wounded by Meghanada's javelin.
verses.hindi: नामक अवतारका वर्णन आपसे कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: वरं ददामि ते भद्र त्वमग्निपदभाग्भव । सर्वेषामेव देवानां वरदस्त्वं भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: varaM dadAmi te bhadra tvamagnipadabhAgbhava | sarveShAmeva devAnAM varadastvaM bhaviShyasi
verses.translation: The lordly son of Siva made Rama and Lak$mana happy in every respect. He protected the entire army.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां त्वमग्नेऽन्तश्चरो भव । धर्मराजेन्द्रयोर्मध्ये दिगीशो राज्यमाप्नुहि
verses.transliteration: sarveShAmeva bhUtAnAM tvamagne.antashcharo bhava | dharmarAjendrayormadhye digIsho rAjyamApnuhi
verses.translation: The untiring monkey destroyed Ravana, his family and his followers. The monkey, the storehouse of great strength made the gods happy.
verses.hindi: अवधूतेश्वरशिवावतारचरित्रवर्णन नामक तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: त्वयेदं स्थापितं लिङ्गं तव नाम्ना भविष्यति । अग्नीश्वर इति ख्यातं सर्वतेजोविबृंहणम्
verses.transliteration: tvayedaM sthApitaM li~NgaM tava nAmnA bhaviShyati | agnIshvara iti khyAtaM sarvatejovibR^iMhaNam
verses.translation: He slew the demon Mahiravana and brought Raina and Laksmana Brom his place to their own after guar¬ ding them well.
verses.hindi: प्रेम करनेवाला सत्यरथ नामक एक राजा था

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीश्वरस्य भक्तानां न भयं विद्युदग्निभिः । अग्निमान्द्यभयं नैव नाकालमरणं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: agnIshvarasya bhaktAnAM na bhayaM vidyudagnibhiH | agnimAndyabhayaM naiva nAkAlamaraNaM kvachit
verses.translation: The leading monkey quickly carried out the tasks of Rama by all means, made the Asuras bow down and submit and performed various sports.
verses.hindi: क्षत्रिय वीरोंके साथ उस राजाका घोर युद्ध हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीश्वरं समभ्यर्च्य काश्यां सर्वसमृद्धिदम् । अन्यत्रापि मृतो दैवाद्वह्निलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: agnIshvaraM samabhyarchya kAshyAM sarvasamR^iddhidam | anyatrApi mR^ito daivAdvahniloke mahIyate
verses.translation: Himself a leader of devotees, he made Sita and Rama happy. He, the lord of monkeys, established the cult of devotion to Rama in the world.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वानीय तद्बन्धून्पित्रोश्च परिपश्यतोः । दिक्पतित्वेऽभिषिच्याग्निं तत्र लिङ्गे शिवोऽविशत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvAnIya tadbandhUnpitroshcha paripashyatoH | dikpatitve.abhiShichyAgniM tatra li~Nge shivo.avishat
verses.translation: Thus O dear, the excellent story of Hanumat has been narrated to you. It is conducive to wealth, fame and longevity. It yields the fruits of all desires.
verses.hindi: समय वहाँपर एक स्वच्छ सरोवरको देखा

verses.sanskrit: इत्थमग्न्यवतारस्ते वर्णितो मे जनार्दनः । नाम्ना गृहपतिस्तात शङ्करस्य परात्मनः
verses.transliteration: itthamagnyavatAraste varNito me janArdanaH | nAmnA gR^ihapatistAta sha~Nkarasya parAtmanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this or narrates this with devotion and purity of mind enjoys all desires here and attains liberation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रहोत्रपुरी रम्या सुखदार्चिष्मती वरा । जातवेदसि ये भक्ता ते तत्र निवसन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: chitrahotrapurI ramyA sukhadArchiShmatI varA | jAtavedasi ye bhaktA te tatra nivasanti vai
verses.translation: O sage, O son of the self-born Brahma, listen to the great incarnation of lord l§iva, which yields all desires to the hearer.

verses.sanskrit: गृहपतिरुवाच । हे मातस्तात किं जातं कारणं तद्वदाधुना । किमर्थं रुदितोऽत्यर्थं त्रासस्तादृक् कुतो हि वाम्
verses.transliteration: gR^ihapatiruvAcha | he mAtastAta kiM jAtaM kAraNaM tadvadAdhunA | kimarthaM rudito.atyarthaM trAsastAdR^ik kuto hi vAm
verses.translation: O great sage, once the supreme god Siva and the great goddess Parvati became desirous of indulging in sports.
verses.hindi: सर्वरक्षक वे महेश्वर दयाद्र हो उठे

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रवेशं ये कुर्युर्दृढसत्त्वा जितेन्द्रियाः । स्त्रियो वा सत्त्वसम्पन्नास्ते सर्वेऽप्यग्नितेजसः
verses.transliteration: agnipraveshaM ye kuryurdR^iDhasattvA jitendriyAH | striyo vA sattvasampannAste sarve.apyagnitejasaH
verses.translation: Keeping Bhairava as the watch-man they went in¬ side. Acting like human beings they were lovingly served by many attendants.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्ररता विप्राः स्थापिता ब्रह्मचारिणः । पश्चाग्निवर्त्तिनोऽप्येवमग्निलोकेऽग्निवर्चसः
verses.transliteration: agnihotraratA viprAH sthApitA brahmachAriNaH | pashchAgnivarttino.apyevamagniloke.agnivarchasaH
verses.translation: O sage, indulging in different sports of their choice for a long time, the lordly deities were highly delighted.
verses.hindi: है, अहो, हैवबल बड़ा प्रबल है ।

verses.sanskrit: शीते शीतापनुत्त्यै यस्त्वेधोभारान्प्रयच्छति । कुर्यादग्नीष्टिकां वाथ स वसेदग्निसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: shIte shItApanuttyai yastvedhobhArAnprayachChati | kuryAdagnIShTikAM vAtha sa vasedagnisannidhau
verses.translation: The independent goddess Parvati sportively assumed the form of a mad woman and with the permission of her lord came near to the door in that form itself.
verses.hindi: पूछूँ। मुझे तो इसपर बहुत ही दया आ रही है

verses.sanskrit: अनाथस्याग्निसंस्कारं यः कुर्याच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः । अशक्तः प्रेरयेदन्यं सोऽग्निलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: anAthasyAgnisaMskAraM yaH kuryAchChraddhayAnvitaH | ashaktaH prerayedanyaM so.agniloke mahIyate
verses.translation: Fascinated by her charming form Bhairava glanced at her as at a woman and prevented her from going out.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरेको द्विजातीनां निःश्रेयसकरः परः । गुरुर्देवो व्रतं तीर्थं सर्वमग्निर्विनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: agnireko dvijAtInAM niHshreyasakaraH paraH | gururdevo vrataM tIrthaM sarvamagnirvinishchitam
verses.translation: O sage, viewed at very closely by Bhairava, the goddess Parvati became furious and cursed him.
verses.hindi: उस समय भिक्षुकका रूप धारण कर लिया

verses.sanskrit: अपावनानि सर्वाणि वह्निसंसर्गतः क्षणात् । पावनानि भवन्त्येव तस्माद्यः पावकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: apAvanAni sarvANi vahnisaMsargataH kShaNAt | pAvanAni bhavantyeva tasmAdyaH pAvakaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: O base man, since you glanced at me as at a woman, O Bhairava, be born as a human being on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरात्मा ह्ययं साक्षान्निश्चयो ह्याशुशुक्षणिः । मांसग्रासान्पचेत्कुक्षौ स्त्रीणां नो मांसपेशिकाम्
verses.transliteration: antarAtmA hyayaM sAkShAnnishchayo hyAshushukShaNiH | mAMsagrAsAnpachetkukShau strINAM no mAMsapeshikAm
verses.translation: O great sage, hastening to that place, Siva con¬ soled Bhairava. Indeed, the lord is very expert in the various forms of consolation.

verses.sanskrit: तैजसी शाम्भवी मूर्तिः प्रत्यक्षा दहनात्मिका । कर्त्री हर्त्री पालयित्री विनैतां किं विलोक्यते
verses.transliteration: taijasI shAmbhavI mUrtiH pratyakShA dahanAtmikA | kartrI hartrI pAlayitrI vinaitAM kiM vilokyate
verses.translation: Due to her curse, and as a result of Siva's will, O sage, Bhairava descended to the earth in human birth under the name of Vaitala.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रभानुरयं साक्षान्नेत्रं त्रिभुवनेशितुः । अन्धे तमोमये लोके विनैनं कः प्रकाशनः
verses.transliteration: chitrabhAnurayaM sAkShAnnetraM tribhuvaneshituH | andhe tamomaye loke vinainaM kaH prakAshanaH
verses.translation: Urged by his friendship lord Siva also incarnated on the earth along with Siva. He indulged in good sports and followed worldly conventions.
verses.hindi: और यहाँ आये हुए आप कौन हैं 2

verses.sanskrit: धूपप्रदीपनैवेद्यपयोदधिघृतैक्षवम् । एतद्भुक्तं निषेवन्ते सर्वे दिवि दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: dhUpapradIpanaivedyapayodadhighR^itaikShavam | etadbhuktaM niShevante sarve divi divaukasaH
verses.translation: O dear, thus the story of Mahesa has been narrated to you. It is excellent, conducive to wealth, fame and longevity and yields all desires.

verses.sanskrit: न मां कृतवपुस्त्राणं भवच्चरणरेणुभिः । कालः कलयितुं शक्तो वराकी चञ्चलाल्पिका
verses.transliteration: na mAM kR^itavapustrANaM bhavachcharaNareNubhiH | kAlaH kalayituM shakto varAkI cha~nchalAlpikA
verses.translation: He who listens to and narrates this story with devotion and purity of mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिज्ञां शृणुतां तातौ यदि वां तनयो ह्यहम् । करिष्येऽहं तथा येन मृत्युस्त्रस्तो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: pratij~nAM shR^iNutAM tAtau yadi vAM tanayo hyaham | kariShye.ahaM tathA yena mR^ityustrasto bhaviShyati
verses.translation: O great sage, O intelligent son of Brahml, listen to the excellent Vreia incarnation of l§iva that perfonned pood sports and that destroyed the {*rrogance of Vi?9u.
verses.hindi: करनेके लिये आपने ही मुझे यहाँ भेजा है

verses.sanskrit: मृत्युञ्जयं समाराध्य सर्वज्ञं सर्वदं सताम् । जपिष्यामि महाकालं सत्यं तातौ वदाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: mR^ityu~njayaM samArAdhya sarvaj~naM sarvadaM satAm | japiShyAmi mahAkAlaM satyaM tAtau vadAmyaham
verses.translation: Formerly all the gods and Asuras, distressed by the fear of old age and death made alliance with each other and became desirous of taking gems from the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: "With what shall the churning be carried out lor the attainment of our object?" thus the gods and the Asuras were quite dismayed.
verses.hindi: कह रहा हूँ। है अनघे ! तुम प्रेमपूर्वक इसे सुनो

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: "With what shall the churning be carried out lor the attainment of our object?" thus the gods and the Asuras were quite dismayed.
verses.hindi: उसकी माताकी मृत्युके विषयमें उससे कहा

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१६. षोडशोऽध्यायः । यक्षेश्वरावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । यक्षेश्वरावतारं च शृणु शम्भोर्मुनीश्वर । गर्विणं गर्वहन्तारं सतां भक्तिविवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.16\. ShoDasho.adhyAyaH | yakSheshvarAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | yakSheshvarAvatAraM cha shR^iNu shambhormunIshvara | garviNaM garvahantAraM satAM bhaktivivarddhanam
verses.translation: Then a celestial voice with the rumbling sound of clouds spoke to the gods and the daityas as a result of diva's wish and consoled them.
verses.hindi: जन्मसे अनाथ एवं बन्धुरहित हो गया है 2

verses.sanskrit: तं पपुः केवलं देवा नासुराः कृपया हरेः । ततो बभूव सुमहद्रत्नं तेषां मिथोऽकदम्
verses.transliteration: taM papuH kevalaM devA nAsurAH kR^ipayA hareH | tato babhUva sumahadratnaM teShAM mitho.akadam
verses.translation: O gods, O Asuras, churn the milk*ocean. Undoubted¬ ly a factual test of your strength will take place.

verses.sanskrit: द्वन्द्वयुद्धं बभूवाथ देवदानवयोर्मुने । तत्र राहुभयाच्चन्द्रो विदुद्राव तदर्दितः
verses.transliteration: dvandvayuddhaM babhUvAtha devadAnavayormune | tatra rAhubhayAchchandro vidudrAva tadarditaH
verses.translation: Make Mandara your churning rod and Vasuki your churning rope. Unitedly you carry on the churning with firm devotion.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम सदनं शम्भोः शरण भयविह्वलः । सुप्रणम्य च तुष्टाव पाहि पाहीति संवदन्
verses.transliteration: jagAma sadanaM shambhoH sharaNa bhayavihvalaH | supraNamya cha tuShTAva pAhi pAhIti saMvadan
verses.translation: O excellent sage, on hearing the celestial voice the gods and the Asuras exerted themselves in carrying out the plan.
verses.hindi: होकर इस उत्तम चरित्रका श्रवण करो

verses.sanskrit: ततः सतामभयदः शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । दध्रे शिरसि चन्द्रं स विभुः शरणमागतम्
verses.transliteration: tataH satAmabhayadaH sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH | dadhre shirasi chandraM sa vibhuH sharaNamAgatam
verses.translation: Allying together they went straight to the excellent mountain Mandara of golden splendour and of diverse lustre.
verses.hindi: वह पूर्वजन्ममें पाण्ड्य देशका श्रेष्ठ राजा था

verses.sanskrit: अथागतस्तदा राहुस्तुष्टाव सुप्रणम्य तम् । शङ्करं सकलाधीशं वाग्भिरिष्टाभिरादरात्
verses.transliteration: athAgatastadA rAhustuShTAva supraNamya tam | sha~NkaraM sakalAdhIshaM vAgbhiriShTAbhirAdarAt
verses.translation: After propitiating l3iva and after obtaining his consent they tried to uproot the Mandara in their desire to take it to the milk-ocean.

verses.sanskrit: शम्भुस्तन्मतमाज्ञाय तच्छिरांस्यच्युतेन ह । पुरा छिन्नानि वै केतुसंज्ञानि निदधे गले
verses.transliteration: shambhustanmatamAj~nAya tachChirAMsyachyutena ha | purA ChinnAni vai ketusa.nj~nAni nidadhe gale
verses.translation: O sage, uprooting and lifting it by means of their arms they went to the milk-ocean. Their strength failing they became incapable of taking it up to the sea.
verses.hindi: तभी नगरमें बड़ा भयानक शब्द हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ततो युद्धेऽसुराः सर्वे देवैश्चैव पराजिताः । पीत्वामृतं सुराः सर्वे जय प्रापुर्महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: tato yuddhe.asurAH sarve devaishchaiva parAjitAH | pItvAmR^itaM surAH sarve jaya prApurmahAbalAH
verses.translation: Slipping from their arms the Mandara became very heavy suddenly and fell over the gods and the Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुप्रभृतयः सर्वे बभूवुश्चातिगर्विताः । बलानि चाङ्कुरन्तोऽन्तः शिवमायाविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: viShNuprabhR^itayaH sarve babhUvushchAtigarvitAH | balAni chA~Nkuranto.antaH shivamAyAvimohitAH
verses.translation: Failing in their effort the gods and the Asuras broke down. After regaining consciousness they eulogised the lord of the universe.
verses.hindi: निर्दयताके साथ उसका सिर कटवा दिया

verses.sanskrit: ततः स शङ्करो देवः सर्वाधीशोऽथ गर्वहा । यक्षो भूत्वा जगामाशु यत्र देवाः स्थिता मुने
verses.transliteration: tataH sa sha~Nkaro devaH sarvAdhIsho.atha garvahA | yakSho bhUtvA jagAmAshu yatra devAH sthitA mune
verses.translation: At his wish in their next attempt' they lifted up the mountain. They took it to the northern shore of the ocean and hurled it into the waters.
verses.hindi: किया, जिससे वह मंगलहीन हो गया

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् दृष्ट्वाच्युतमुखान्देवान्यक्षपतिः स वै । महागर्वाढ्यमनसा महेशः प्राह गर्वहा
verses.transliteration: sarvAn dR^iShTvAchyutamukhAndevAnyakShapatiH sa vai | mahAgarvADhyamanasA maheshaH prAha garvahA
verses.translation: Then both the gods and the Asuras made Vasuld the churning rope. Desirous of taking the excellent articles they churned the milk-ocean.
verses.hindi: समय ही उसका वध कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: पुरा देवाश्च दैत्याश्च पीयूषार्थं महाबलाः । क्षीरोदधिं ममन्थुस्ते सुकृतस्वार्थसन्धयः
verses.transliteration: purA devAshcha daityAshcha pIyUShArthaM mahAbalAH | kShIrodadhiM mamanthuste sukR^itasvArthasandhayaH
verses.translation: There also emerged—Dhanvantari the m.oon> the Parijata tree, the horse Uccairavas, the elephant AirS- vata, wine, the bow of Visnu, the conch, the cow Kamadhenu, the jewel Kaustubha and the nectar.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षेश्वर उवाच । किमर्थं संस्थिता यूयमत्र सर्वे सुरा मिथः । किमु काष्ठाखिलं ब्रुत कारणं मेऽनु पृच्छते
verses.transliteration: yakSheshvara uvAcha | kimarthaM saMsthitA yUyamatra sarve surA mithaH | kimu kAShThAkhilaM bruta kAraNaM me.anu pR^ichChate
verses.translation: From the sprays and drops that sprang up at the outcome of nectar, many damsels of wonderful beauty were born.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले मनुष्य दरिद्र हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । अभूदत्र महान्देव रणः परमदारुणः । असुरा नाशिताः सर्वेऽवशिष्टा विद्रुता गताः
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH | abhUdatra mahAndeva raNaH paramadAruNaH | asurA nAshitAH sarve.avashiShTA vidrutA gatAH
verses.translation: Their faces resembled the full moon in the Autumn; their lustre was as glittering and dazzling as fire, lightning or the sun and they were bedecked in divine Jewels, necklaces, bracelets and bangles.

verses.sanskrit: वयं सर्वे महावीरा दैत्यघ्ना बलवत्तराः । अग्रेऽस्माकं कियन्तस्ते दैत्याः क्षुद्रबलाः सदा
verses.transliteration: vayaM sarve mahAvIrA daityaghnA balavattarAH | agre.asmAkaM kiyantaste daityAH kShudrabalAH sadA
verses.translation: Sprinkling the ten quarters by the water of necta¬ rine beauty they seemed to madden the world by their beauteous glances.
verses.hindi: गदगद वाणीमें उन प्रभुकी स्तुति करने लगी

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां सुराणां गर्वगर्भितम् । गर्वहासौ महादेवो यक्षरूपो वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachasteShAM surANAM garvagarbhitam | garvahAsau mahAdevo yakSharUpo vacho.abravIt
verses.translation: They emerged in crores from the nectar sprays. Then the nectar that wards off old age and death came out.
verses.hindi: वे भगवान् शिव शीघ्र ही वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षेश्वर उवाच । हे सुरा निखिला यूयं मद्वचः शृणुतादरात् । यथार्थं वच्मि नासत्यं सर्वगर्वापहारकम्
verses.transliteration: yakSheshvara uvAcha | he surA nikhilA yUyaM madvachaH shR^iNutAdarAt | yathArthaM vachmi nAsatyaM sarvagarvApahArakam
verses.translation: Visiju kept for himself Lak§ml, the conch, Kaus¬ tubha and the sword; the Sun chose the divine horse Uccail- 4ravas for himself.

verses.sanskrit: गर्वमेनं न कुरुत कर्ता हर्तापरः प्रभुः । विस्मृताश्च महेशानं कथयध्वं वृथा बलाः
verses.transliteration: garvamenaM na kuruta kartA hartAparaH prabhuH | vismR^itAshcha maheshAnaM kathayadhvaM vR^ithA balAH
verses.translation: With great eagerness the husband of Saci, the lord of the gods, took Parijata the excellent tree and AirSvata the lordly eleohant.

verses.sanskrit: युष्माकं चेत्स हि मदो जानतां स्वबलं महत् । मत्स्थापितं तृणमिदं छिन्त स्वास्त्रैश्च तैः सुराः
verses.transliteration: yuShmAkaM chetsa hi mado jAnatAM svabalaM mahat | matsthApitaM tR^iNamidaM Chinta svAstraishcha taiH surAH
verses.translation: For the protection of the gods, Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, voluntarily retained the Kala- kuta in his neck and held the moon on his forehead.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वैकं तृणं तेषां निचिक्षेप पुरस्ततः । जह्रे सर्वमदं यक्षरूप ईशः सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvaikaM tR^iNaM teShAM nichikShepa purastataH | jahre sarvamadaM yakSharUpa IshaH satAM gatiH
verses.translation: O Vyasa, deluded by the illusion of Siva, the Daityas accepted Sura (wine) and the common people took Dhanvantari (the physician).

verses.sanskrit: अथ सर्वे सुरा विष्णुप्रमुखा वीरमानिनः । कृत्वा स्वपौरुषं तत्र स्वायुधानि विचिक्षिपुः
verses.transliteration: atha sarve surA viShNupramukhA vIramAninaH | kR^itvA svapauruShaM tatra svAyudhAni vichikShipuH
verses.translation: The great sages took the cow Kamadhenu. The damsels, the enchantresses became common to all.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासन् विफलान्याशु तान्यस्त्राणि दिवौकसाम् । शिवप्रभावतस्तेषां मूढगर्वापहारिणः
verses.transliteration: tatrAsan viphalAnyAshu tAnyastrANi divaukasAm | shivaprabhAvatasteShAM mUDhagarvApahAriNaH
verses.translation: A great battle for the possession of Amfta ensued between the gods and the Asuras who desired to conquer each other and who were agitated in their minds.

verses.sanskrit: मथ्यमानेऽमृते पूर्वं क्षीराब्धेः सुरदानवैः । अग्नेः समुत्थितं तस्माद्विषं कालानलप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: mathyamAne.amR^ite pUrvaM kShIrAbdheH suradAnavaiH | agneH samutthitaM tasmAdviShaM kAlAnalaprabham
verses.translation: Indra and other gods, O dear, overwhelmed by 2§iva*s illusion and harassed by the Daityas sought refuge in Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अथासीत्तु नभोवाणी देवविस्मयहारिणी । यक्षोऽयं शङ्करो देवाः सर्वगर्वापहारकः
verses.transliteration: athAsIttu nabhovANI devavismayahAriNI | yakSho.ayaM sha~Nkaro devAH sarvagarvApahArakaH
verses.translation: Visnu, the most excellent of those who wield Maya assuming the form of a woman Mohini deluded the Asuras and made the gods drink it.

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता हर्ता तथा भर्तायमेव परमेश्वरः । एतद्बलेन बलिनो जीवाः सर्वेऽन्यथा न हि
verses.transliteration: kartA hartA tathA bhartAyameva parameshvaraH | etadbalena balino jIvAH sarve.anyathA na hi
verses.translation: The leading Daityas approached her and said— "Make us drink this nectar. Let there be no break in the lines.**
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां भिक्षुवर्याह्शिवावतारचरित्रवर्णन॑ नामैकत्रिंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: अस्य मायाप्रभावाद् वै मोहिताः स्वप्रभुं शिवम् । मदतो बुबुधुर्नैवाद्यापि बोधतनुं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: asya mAyAprabhAvAd vai mohitAH svaprabhuM shivam | madato bubudhurnaivAdyApi bodhatanuM prabhum
verses.translation: Ail those Daityas and Danavas deluded by Siva*s Maya said thus and gave the nectar to Visnu in disguise.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा नभोवाणीं बुबुधुस्ते गतस्मयाः । यक्षेश्वरं प्रणेमुश्च तुष्टुवुश्च तमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti shrutvA nabhovANIM bubudhuste gatasmayAH | yakSheshvaraM praNemushcha tuShTuvushcha tamIshvaram
verses.translation: In the meantime on seeing the damsels bom of Amrta, the leading Danavas took them to their abodes ac¬ cording to their convenience.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । देवदेव महादेव सर्वगर्वापहारक । यक्षेश्वर महालील माया तेऽत्यद्भुता प्रभो
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH | devadeva mahAdeva sarvagarvApahAraka | yakSheshvara mahAlIla mAyA te.atyadbhutA prabho
verses.translation: The cities built by the architect Maya for those women were divine, hundred times more beautiful than heaven. They were well fortified by terrible machines.

verses.sanskrit: मोहिता माययाद्यापि तव यक्षस्वरूपिणः । सगर्वमभिभाषन्तस्त्वत्पुरो हि पृथङ्मयाः
verses.transliteration: mohitA mAyayAdyApi tava yakShasvarUpiNaH | sagarvamabhibhAShantastvatpuro hi pR^itha~NmayAH
verses.translation: The daityas made those cities well guarded and set off for fighting after taking this pledge touching their chests. *

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं ज्ञानमायातं तवैव कृपया प्रभो । कर्ता हर्ता च भर्ता च त्वमेवान्यो न शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: idAnIM j~nAnamAyAtaM tavaiva kR^ipayA prabho | kartA hartA cha bhartA cha tvamevAnyo na sha~Nkara
verses.translation: "We will never touch these women if we were to be defeated by the gods.** After saying this, the heroic Daityas became eager to fight.
verses.hindi: गयी और मातासे बारंबार दूध माँगने लगा

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव सर्वशक्तीनां सर्वेषां हि प्रवर्तकः । निवर्तकश्च सर्वेशः परमात्माव्ययोऽद्वयः
verses.transliteration: tvameva sarvashaktInAM sarveShAM hi pravartakaH | nivartakashcha sarveshaH paramAtmAvyayo.advayaH
verses.translation: They roared like lions. Severally they blew their conches as if filling the sky and propitiating the clouds.
verses.hindi: फुसलाकर वह कृत्रिम दूध उसे दे दिया

verses.sanskrit: यक्षेश्वरस्वरूपेण सर्वेषां नो मदो हृतः । कृतो मन्यामहे तत्तेऽनुग्रहो हि कृपालुना
verses.transliteration: yakSheshvarasvarUpeNa sarveShAM no mado hR^itaH | kR^ito manyAmahe tatte.anugraho hi kR^ipAlunA
verses.translation: A terrible fight ensued between the gods and the Asuras. The unrivalled battle between the gods and Asuras is famous in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अथो स यक्षनाथोऽनुगृह्य वै सकलान् सुरान् । विबोध्य विविधैर्वाक्यैस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: atho sa yakShanAtho.anugR^ihya vai sakalAn surAn | vibodhya vividhairvAkyaistatraivAntaradhIyata
verses.translation: Protected by Vinu, the gods gained victory. The Daityas fled and those who remained were killed by Vifu and his associate gods.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा निखिला देवा दैत्याश्च भयविह्वलाः । विद्रुत्य तरसा तात शम्भोस्ते शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA nikhilA devA daityAshcha bhayavihvalAH | vidrutya tarasA tAta shambhoste sharaNaM yayuH
verses.translation: The Daityas were deluded by the gods and Vi|nu the great soul. Those that survived entered the nethjbr regions.
verses.hindi: उनसे क्षीरका समुद्र प्राप्त कर लूँगा

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स वर्णितः शम्भोरवतारः सुखावहः । यक्षेश्वराख्यः सुखदः सतां तुष्टोऽभयङ्करः
verses.transliteration: itthaM sa varNitaH shambhoravatAraH sukhAvahaH | yakSheshvarAkhyaH sukhadaH satAM tuShTo.abhaya~NkaraH
verses.translation: The powerful Vinu armed with his diseus chased them even after they had gone to the ultimate end of Patala* excessively frightened.
verses.hindi: उससे विदा ले तप करनेके लिये चल पड़ा

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानममलं सर्वगर्वापहारकम् । सतां सुशान्तिदं नित्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: idamAkhyAnamamalaM sarvagarvApahArakam | satAM sushAntidaM nityaM bhuktimuktipradaM nR^iNAm
verses.translation: In the meantime Viiiu saw those damsels bom of nectar sprays who were haughty due to their divine beauty and whose faces resembled the full moon.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा सुधीः पुमान् । सर्वकामानवाप्नोति ततश्च लभते गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM shR^iNuyAdbhaktyA shrAvayedvA sudhIH pumAn | sarvakAmAnavApnoti tatashcha labhate gatim
verses.translation: Fascinated by the Cupid's arrows Vi 9 i;iu attained highest pleasure only there. He began to indulge in sexual dalliance with those women of exquisite beauty.
verses.hindi: हुए उसने बहुत कालपर्यन्त घोर तप किया

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तं शङ्करं सर्वे सर्वदेवशिखामणिम् । प्रणम्य तुष्टुवुर्भक्त्या साच्युता नतमस्तकाः
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA taM sha~NkaraM sarve sarvadevashikhAmaNim | praNamya tuShTuvurbhaktyA sAchyutA natamastakAH
verses.translation: Vinu begot of them sons of great exploits and valour, experts in various kinds of warfare, shaking 'file entire earth.
verses.hindi: सारा चराचर लोक प्रज्वलित हो उठा

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । पपौ विषं महाघोरं सुरासुरगणार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: tataH prasanno bhagavAn sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH | papau viShaM mahAghoraM surAsuragaNArdanam
verses.translation: Those sons ofViu of great strength and valour wrought great havoc both in heaven and earth causing misery to all.
verses.hindi: सारा अभीष्ट प्रदान करूँगा, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: पतिं तं विषमं कण्ठे निदधे विषमुल्बणम् । रेजे तेनाति स विभुर्नीलकण्ठो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: patiM taM viShamaM kaNThe nidadhe viShamulbaNam | reje tenAti sa vibhurnIlakaNTho babhUva ha
verses.translation: On seeing the great harm done to the worlds the gods and the sages approached Brahma and informed him of this after bowing to him.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरासुरगणा ममन्थुः पुनरेव तम् । विषदाहविनिर्मुक्ताः शिवानुग्रहतोऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: tataH surAsuragaNA mamanthuH punareva tam | viShadAhavinirmuktAH shivAnugrahato.akhilAH
verses.translation: On hearing it Brahma took them to the mountain Kailasa. On seeing Siva there he bowed to him again and again along with the gods.
verses.hindi: कल्याण करूँगा। तुम गुणरहित शिवको छोड़ो

verses.sanskrit: ततो बहूनि रत्नानि निस्सृतानि ततो मुने । अमृतं च पदार्थं हि सुरदानवयोर्मुने
verses.transliteration: tato bahUni ratnAni nissR^itAni tato mune | amR^itaM cha padArthaM hi suradAnavayormune
verses.translation: Saying *'0 lord Siva, be victorious, O Lord of all**, he eulogised him with various hymns with palms joined in reverence and shoulders drooping down.
verses.hindi: भी ईश्वर उन रुद्रको नहीं जानते

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: For the protection of the worlds and for the redemption of Vi?riu, Siva was eulogised thus by Brahma, the gods and the sages.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: For the protection of the worlds and for the redemption of Vi?riu, Siva was eulogised thus by Brahma, the gods and the sages.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१७. सप्तदशोऽध्यायः । शिवदशावतारवर्णनम् । शृण्वथो गिरिशस्याद्यावतारान् दशसङ्ख्यकान् । महाकालमुखान् भक्त्योपासनाकाण्डसेवितान्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.17\. saptadasho.adhyAyaH | shivadashAvatAravarNanam | shR^iNvatho girishasyAdyAvatArAn dashasa~NkhyakAn | mahAkAlamukhAn bhaktyopAsanAkANDasevitAn
verses.translation: Then lord Siva, the ocean of mercy, realising the havoc caused by the sons of Vinu assumed the form of a bull.

verses.sanskrit: शिवावतारो मातङ्गो नवमः परिकीर्तितः । मातङ्गी तत्र शर्वाणी सर्वकामफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: shivAvatAro mAta~Ngo navamaH parikIrtitaH | mAta~NgI tatra sharvANI sarvakAmaphalapradA
verses.translation: Then bellowing in the form of a Bull, the PinSka- bearing lord entered the crevice and shouted terribly.
verses.hindi: शरीर छोड़ देता है, वह शिवलोकको जाता है

verses.sanskrit: दशमः कमलः शम्भुर्भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः । कमला गिरिजा तत्र स्वभक्तपरिपालिनी
verses.transliteration: dashamaH kamalaH shambhurbhuktimuktiphalapradaH | kamalA girijA tatra svabhaktaparipAlinI
verses.translation: At his bellowing sound, cities and towns crumbled down and all the citizens trembled.

verses.sanskrit: एते दशमिताः शैवा अवताराः सुखप्रदाः । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदाश्चैव भक्तानां सर्वदा सताम्
verses.transliteration: ete dashamitAH shaivA avatArAH sukhapradAH | bhuktimuktipradAshchaiva bhaktAnAM sarvadA satAm
verses.translation: Then the bull attacked Vi?nu's sons wielding their bows for fighting, deluded by Siva's Maya and proud of their great strength and exploit.
verses.hindi: त्यागकर इन्द्रको मारनेके लिये उद्यत हो गये

verses.sanskrit: एते दशावतारा हि शङ्करस्य महात्मनः । नानासुखप्रदा नित्यं सेवतां निर्विकारतः
verses.transliteration: ete dashAvatArA hi sha~Nkarasya mahAtmanaH | nAnAsukhapradA nityaM sevatAM nirvikArataH
verses.translation: O excellent sage, the sons of Vinu became furious. Those heroes roared loudly and rushed against Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दशावताराणां माहात्म्यं वर्णितं मुने । सर्वकामप्रदं ज्ञेयं तन्त्रशास्त्रादिगर्भितम्
verses.transliteration: etaddashAvatArANAM mAhAtmyaM varNitaM mune | sarvakAmapradaM j~neyaM tantrashAstrAdigarbhitam
verses.translation: When their limbs were split by Rudra, they swoon* ed and lost their lives. They were immediately destroyed.
verses.hindi: करते हुए उपमन्यु स्थित हो गये

verses.sanskrit: एतासामादिशक्तीनामद्भुतो महिमा मुने । सर्वकामप्रदो ज्ञेयस्तत्रंशास्त्रादिगर्भितः
verses.transliteration: etAsAmAdishaktInAmadbhuto mahimA mune | sarvakAmaprado j~neyastatraMshAstrAdigarbhitaH
verses.translation: When they were killed Visnu the foremost of the strong came out shouting loudly and hastened towards Siva.

verses.sanskrit: शत्रुमारणकार्यादौ तत्तच्छक्तिः परा मता । खलदण्डकरी नित्यं ब्रह्मतेजोविवर्द्धिनी
verses.transliteration: shatrumAraNakAryAdau tattachChaktiH parA matA | khaladaNDakarI nityaM brahmatejovivarddhinI
verses.translation: On seeing Siva in the form of the bull going along
verses.hindi: शिवजीके आदेशसे नन्दीने बीचमें ही पकड़ लिया

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तास्ते मया ब्रह्मन्नवतारा महेशितुः । सशक्तिका दशमिता महाकालमुखाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: ityuktAste mayA brahmannavatArA maheshituH | sashaktikA dashamitA mahAkAlamukhAH shubhAH
verses.translation: Then the infuriated Siva, the highly powerful one in the form of a bull stood like a mountain and caught hold of all those missiles of Viu.

verses.sanskrit: शैवपर्वेसु सर्वेषु योऽधीते भक्तितत्परः । एतदाख्यानममलं सोऽतिशम्भुप्रियो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: shaivaparvesu sarveShu yo.adhIte bhaktitatparaH | etadAkhyAnamamalaM so.atishambhupriyo bhavet
verses.translation: O sage, shouting furiously, lord Siva in the form of a bull shook the three worlds terribly.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चस्वी क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् । धनाधिपो हि वैश्यः स्याच्छूद्रः सुखमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNo brahmavarchasvI kShatriyo vijayI bhavet | dhanAdhipo hi vaishyaH syAchChUdraH sukhamavApnuyAt
verses.translation: The lord leaped up suddenly and kicked the in¬ furiated Visnu who was deluded and could not realise him. The lord then tore him with his horns.
verses.hindi: मैंने परीक्षा कर ली कि तुम हमारे दृढ़ भक्त हो

verses.sanskrit: तत्राद्यो हि महाकालो भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदः सताम् । शक्तिस्तत्र महाकाली भक्तेप्सितफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: tatrAdyo hi mahAkAlo bhuktimuktipradaH satAm | shaktistatra mahAkAlI bhaktepsitaphalapradA
verses.translation: Unable to bear the onslaught, Vi$nu deluded by Maya was exhausted and utterly shattered.

verses.sanskrit: शाङ्करा निजधर्मस्थाः शृण्वन्तश्चरितं त्विदम् । सुखिनः स्युर्विशेषेण शिवभक्ता भवन्तु च
verses.transliteration: shA~NkarA nijadharmasthAH shR^iNvantashcharitaM tvidam | sukhinaH syurvisheSheNa shivabhaktA bhavantu cha
verses.translation: 'JThen on realising that Siva himself had come in the form of a Bull, Vinu spoke in a shrill voice with droop¬ ing shoulders and palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: तारनामा द्वितीयश्च ताराशक्तिस्तथैव सा । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदौ चोभौ स्वसेवकसुखप्रदौ
verses.transliteration: tAranAmA dvitIyashcha tArAshaktistathaiva sA | bhuktimuktipradau chobhau svasevakasukhapradau
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, O ocean of mercy, O lord Siva, I had been deluded by your Maya and my mind had been confused.

verses.sanskrit: भुवनेशो हि बालाह्वस्तृतीयः परिकीर्तितः । भुवनेशी शिवा तत्र बालाह्वा सुखदा सताम्
verses.transliteration: bhuvanesho hi bAlAhvastR^itIyaH parikIrtitaH | bhuvaneshI shivA tatra bAlAhvA sukhadA satAm
verses.translation: O lord, I fought with you, Siva. Taking pity on me, O lord, let this offence be excu.sed.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीविद्येशः षोडशाह्वः श्रीर्विद्या षोडशी शिवा । चतुर्थो भक्तसुखदो भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: shrIvidyeshaH ShoDashAhvaH shrIrvidyA ShoDashI shivA | chaturtho bhaktasukhado bhuktimuktiphalapradaH
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing those piteous words of Vi 9 ]?iu, lord Siva favourably disposed to his devotees spoke to Vinu.
verses.hindi: तेजस्वी, दिव्यज्ञानी तथा महाप्रभु हो जाओ

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमो भैरवः ख्यातः सर्वदा भक्तकामदः । भैरवी गिरिजा तत्र सदुपासककामदा
verses.transliteration: pa~nchamo bhairavaH khyAtaH sarvadA bhaktakAmadaH | bhairavI girijA tatra sadupAsakakAmadA
verses.translation: Why don't you realise yourself as one whose ex¬ ploit is dependent on me. You should not have indulged in sexual dalliance there. You should have refrained from all misdeeds.
verses.hindi: दक्षता तथा अपना पद भी प्रदान किया

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नमस्तकनामासौ शिवः षष्ठः प्रकीर्तितः । भक्तकामप्रदा चैव गिरिजा छिन्नमस्तका
verses.transliteration: ChinnamastakanAmAsau shivaH ShaShThaH prakIrtitaH | bhaktakAmapradA chaiva girijA ChinnamastakA
verses.translation: Why should your intellect be subservient to lust? That you should indulge in dalliance with women does not behove you, O lord of gods. Remember the task of uplifting the universe.

verses.sanskrit: धूमवान् सप्तमः शम्भुः सर्वकामफलप्रदः । धूमवती शिवा तत्र सदुपासककामदा
verses.transliteration: dhUmavAn saptamaH shambhuH sarvakAmaphalapradaH | dhUmavatI shivA tatra sadupAsakakAmadA
verses.translation: On hearing those words of Siva that imparted knowledge Vi$nu was ashamed of himself and then he spoke to lord Siva respectfully.

verses.sanskrit: शिवावतारः सुखदो ह्यष्टमो बगलामुखः । शक्तिस्तत्र महानन्दा विख्याता बगलामुखी
verses.transliteration: shivAvatAraH sukhado hyaShTamo bagalAmukhaH | shaktistatra mahAnandA vikhyAtA bagalAmukhI
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vi?nu, lord Siva the protector of virtue in the guise of a bull, replied to Vi??u again.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: I shall give you a discus more terrible than the sun at the time of dissolution and more efficacious than the words of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: I shall give you a discus more terrible than the sun at the time of dissolution and more efficacious than the words of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१८. अष्टादशोऽध्यायः । एकादशावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एकादशवतारान्वै शृण्वथो शाङ्करान्वरान् । यान् श्रुत्वा न हि बाध्येत बाधासत्यादिसम्भवा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.18\. aShTAdasho.adhyAyaH | ekAdashAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | ekAdashavatArAnvai shR^iNvatho shA~NkarAnvarAn | yAn shrutvA na hi bAdhyeta bAdhAsatyAdisambhavA
verses.translation: After saying this Siva created another blazing dis¬ cus, as lustrous as the Kala hre, for the destruction of the wicked.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रादुरभूच्छम्भुर्वरं दातुं तदर्षये । स्वपदासक्तमनसे दीनबन्धुः सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: atha prAdurabhUchChambhurvaraM dAtuM tadarShaye | svapadAsaktamanase dInabandhuH satAM gatiH
verses.translation: He gave the discus, as lustruous as ten thousand fierce suns, to Vi§nu, the great Atman, the protector of the gods and the leading sages.

verses.sanskrit: वरं ब्रूहीति चोवाच सुप्रसन्नो महेश्वरः । कश्यपं मुनिशार्दूलं स्वभक्तं भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: varaM brUhIti chovAcha suprasanno maheshvaraH | kashyapaM munishArdUlaM svabhaktaM bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: After securing another SudarSana discus of more brilliance, Vinu the foremost of intelligent gods spoke to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वाथ तं महेशानं स प्रणम्य कृताञ्जलिः । तुष्टाव कश्यपो हृष्टो देवतातः प्रसन्नधीः
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvAtha taM maheshAnaM sa praNamya kR^itA~njaliH | tuShTAva kashyapo hR^iShTo devatAtaH prasannadhIH
verses.translation: "O ye gods, you listen to my statement eagerly. You must act accordingly and immediately. It will be to your advantage.
verses.hindi: इ॒ति श्रीशिव की शतरुद्रसंहितायां सुरेश्वराख्यशिवावतारचरितवर्णन नाम द्वात्रिशो3 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: कश्यप उवाच । देवदेव महेशान शरणागतवत्सल । सर्वेश्वः परमात्मा त्वं ध्यानगम्योऽद्वयोऽव्ययः
verses.transliteration: kashyapa uvAcha | devadeva maheshAna sharaNAgatavatsala | sarveshvaH paramAtmA tvaM dhyAnagamyo.advayo.avyayaH
verses.translation: There are many youthful maidens in the nether regions exquisitely dressed. Any one of you can go and in¬ dulge in sexual dalliance with them.**

verses.sanskrit: बलनिग्रहकर्ता त्वं महेश्वर सतां गतिः । दीनबन्धुर्दयासिन्धुर्भक्तरक्षणदक्षधीः
verses.transliteration: balanigrahakartA tvaM maheshvara satAM gatiH | dInabandhurdayAsindhurbhaktarakShaNadakShadhIH
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Visnu the valorous gods

verses.sanskrit: एते सुरास्त्वदीया हि त्वद्भक्ताश्च विशेषतः । दैत्यैः पराजिताश्चाथ पाहि तान्दुःखितान् प्रभो
verses.transliteration: ete surAstvadIyA hi tvadbhaktAshcha visheShataH | daityaiH parAjitAshchAtha pAhi tAnduHkhitAn prabho
verses.translation: Knowing their intention then, lord Siva angrily cursed all the eight** types of the gods.
verses.hindi: हिमालयद्ठारा मेनाके गर्भसे पार्वती नामसे उत्पन्न हुईं

verses.sanskrit: असमर्थो रमेशोऽपि दुःखदस्ते मुहुर्मुहुः । अतः सुरा मच्छरणा वेदयन्तोऽसुखं च तत्
verses.transliteration: asamartho ramesho.api duHkhadaste muhurmuhuH | ataH surA machCharaNA vedayanto.asukhaM cha tat
verses.translation: ''Excepting a quiescent sage and the Danavas born of my parts whoever enters this place shall die in a trice.

verses.sanskrit: तदर्थं देवदेवेश देवदुःखविनाशक । तत्पूरितुं तपोनिष्ठां प्रसन्नार्थं तवासदम्
verses.transliteration: tadarthaM devadevesha devaduHkhavinAshaka | tatpUrituM taponiShThAM prasannArthaM tavAsadam
verses.translation: After hearing these terrible words which are con¬ ducive to the increase of the benefit of human beings, the gods thus restrained by Rudra returned to their own abodes.

verses.sanskrit: शरणं ते प्रपन्नोऽस्मि सर्वथाहं महेश्वर । कामं मे पूरय स्वामिन्देवदुःखं विनाशय
verses.transliteration: sharaNaM te prapanno.asmi sarvathAhaM maheshvara | kAmaM me pUraya svAmindevaduHkhaM vinAshaya
verses.translation: Lord Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, returned to his mountain after carrying out the task of the gods in the guise of a bull.
verses.hindi: उनके तपकी परीक्षा की, किंतु वे सफल नहीं हुए

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रदुःखैश्च देवेश दुःखितोऽहं विशेषतः । सुखिनं कुरु मामीश सहायस्त्वं दिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: putraduHkhaishcha devesha duHkhito.ahaM visheShataH | sukhinaM kuru mAmIsha sahAyastvaM divaukasAm
verses.translation: Thus the bull incarnation of Siva that dispelled Vinu's delusion and caused happiness to the three worlds, has been narrated.
verses.hindi: तथा उनकी आज्ञा लेकर स्वर्गलोक चले गये

verses.sanskrit: पुरा सर्वे सुराः शक्रमुखा दैत्यपराजिताः । त्यक्त्वामरावतीं भीत्यापलायन्त निजां पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: purA sarve surAH shakramukhA daityaparAjitAH | tyaktvAmarAvatIM bhItyApalAyanta nijAM purIm
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with purity enjoys all pleasures here and attains salva¬ tion hereafter. So also is the case with him who reads or teaches this to intelligent men.

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा मम सुतो नाथ देवा यक्षाः पराजिताः । दैत्यैर्महाबलैः शम्भो सुरानन्दप्रदो भव
verses.transliteration: bhUtvA mama suto nAtha devA yakShAH parAjitAH | daityairmahAbalaiH shambho surAnandaprado bhava
verses.translation: O intelligent one, listen with very great pleasure to the Pippalada incarnation of Siva that is excellent and that inspires devotion.

verses.sanskrit: सदैवास्तु महेशान सर्वलेखसहायकः । यथा दैत्यकृता बाधा न बाधेत सुरान्प्रभो
verses.transliteration: sadaivAstu maheshAna sarvalekhasahAyakaH | yathA daityakR^itA bAdhA na bAdheta surAnprabho
verses.translation: In the fight with Kuva, Viu and other gods were defeated by this sage who had the support of Siva and they were cursed.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त प्रीतियुक्त होकर गिरिजाके वनमें गये

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तस्य तु सर्वेशस्तथेति प्रोच्य शङ्करः । पश्यतस्तस्य भगवांस्तत्रैवान्तर्दधे हरः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktasya tu sarveshastatheti prochya sha~NkaraH | pashyatastasya bhagavAMstatraivAntardadhe haraH
verses.translation: The great lord, an expert in different kinds of sports and extremely brilliant was born of her in the name of Pippalada.

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपोऽपि महाहृष्टः स्वस्थानमगमद् द्रुतम् । देवेभ्यः कथयामास सर्ववृत्तान्तमादरात्
verses.transliteration: kashyapo.api mahAhR^iShTaH svasthAnamagamad drutam | devebhyaH kathayAmAsa sarvavR^ittAntamAdarAt
verses.translation: On hearing these wonderful words of Nandiivara, the excellent sage Sanatkumara spoke with palms joined in reverence and shoulders drooping down.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स शङ्करः शर्वः सत्यं कर्तुं स्वकं वचः । सुरभ्यां कश्यपाज्जज्ञे एकादशस्वरूपवान्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa sha~NkaraH sharvaH satyaM kartuM svakaM vachaH | surabhyAM kashyapAjjaj~ne ekAdashasvarUpavAn
verses.translation: O Nandiivara, O intelligent one, you are blessed in that you have assumed the form of Rudra himself. O dear, you are my excellent preceptor. This wonderful story has been narrated by you.

verses.sanskrit: महोत्सवस्तदासीद् वै सर्वं शिवमयं त्वभूत् । आसन्हृष्टाः सुराश्चाथ मुनिना कश्यपेन च
verses.transliteration: mahotsavastadAsId vai sarvaM shivamayaM tvabhUt | AsanhR^iShTAH surAshchAtha muninA kashyapena cha
verses.translation: O son of Silida, from my father Brahma, the acc¬ ount of the battle with Kuva and the defeat of Viu has already been heard by me. So also the curse has been heard by me.
verses.hindi: और अत्यन्त अशेभनीय कार्य दिखायी पड़ रहा है

verses.sanskrit: कपाली पिङ्गलो भीमो विरूपाक्षो विलोहितः । शास्ताजपादहिर्बुध्न्यश्शम्भुश्चण्डो भवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kapAlI pi~Ngalo bhImo virUpAkSho vilohitaH | shAstAjapAdahirbudhnyashshambhushchaNDo bhavastathA
verses.translation: On hearing these auspicious words of the son of
verses.hindi: जन्म भारतवर्षमें हिमालयके घरमें हुआ है

verses.sanskrit: एकादशैते रुद्रास्तु सुरभीतनयाः स्मृताः । देवकार्यार्थमुत्पन्नाः शिवरूपाः सुखास्पदम्
verses.transliteration: ekAdashaite rudrAstu surabhItanayAH smR^itAH | devakAryArthamutpannAH shivarUpAH sukhAspadam
verses.translation: O great sage, once Indra and other gods were defeated by the Daityas who had the support of the demon Vrtra.
verses.hindi: मैंने योगके द्वारा अपना शरीर त्याग दिया था

verses.sanskrit: ते रुद्राः काश्यपा वीरा महाबलपराक्रमाः । दैत्यान् जघ्नुश्च सङ्ग्रामे देवसाहाय्यकारिणः
verses.transliteration: te rudrAH kAshyapA vIrA mahAbalaparAkramAH | daityAn jaghnushcha sa~NgrAme devasAhAyyakAriNaH
verses.translation: All the gods had formerly kept their respective weapons in the hermitage of Dadhica. Hence they were immediately defeated.

verses.sanskrit: तद्रुद्रकृपया देवा दैत्यान् जित्वा च निर्भयाः । चक्रुः स्वराज्यं सर्वे ते शक्राद्याः स्वस्थमानसाः
verses.transliteration: tadrudrakR^ipayA devA daityAn jitvA cha nirbhayAH | chakruH svarAjyaM sarve te shakrAdyAH svasthamAnasAH
verses.translation: Then the harassed gods and the sages along with Indra immediately went to Brahma's region and narrated their distress to him.
verses.hindi: संयत होकर तप करनेके लिये यहाँ आयी हूँ

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यप्रपीडिता देवा जग्मुस्ते कश्यपान्तिकम् । बध्वा करान्नतस्कन्धाः प्रणेमुस्तं सुविह्वलम्
verses.transliteration: daityaprapIDitA devA jagmuste kashyapAntikam | badhvA karAnnataskandhAH praNemustaM suvihvalam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the gods Brahma, the grand¬ father of the worlds, mentioned the details of what Tvatr was desirous of doing.
verses.hindi: कहती हूँ, इसमें किंचिन्मात्र भी असत्य नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि ते महारुद्राः सर्वे शिवस्वरूपकाः । देवानां रक्षणार्थाय विराजन्ते सदा दिवि
verses.transliteration: adyApi te mahArudrAH sarve shivasvarUpakAH | devAnAM rakShaNArthAya virAjante sadA divi
verses.translation: This Asura has been created by Tvastr by means of his penance in order to kill you. The name of that Asura is Vrtra. He is of great brilliance and the leader of all Daityas.
verses.hindi: मनकी उत्सुकतासे इस समय तपमें प्रवृत्त हूँ

verses.sanskrit: ऐशान्यां पुरि ते वासं चक्रिरे भक्तवत्सलाः । विरमन्ते सदा तत्र नानालीलाविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: aishAnyAM puri te vAsaM chakrire bhaktavatsalAH | viramante sadA tatra nAnAlIlAvishAradAH
verses.translation: You shall make such efforts as would ensure his death. O intelligent one, listen to the means thereof. For the sake of virtue I shall tell you the same.
verses.hindi: वस्तुतः पतिरूपमें प्राप्त करना चाहती हूँ

verses.sanskrit: तेषामनुचरा रुद्राः कोटिशः परिकीर्तिताः । सर्वत्र संस्थितास्तत्र त्रिलोकेष्वभिभागशः
verses.transliteration: teShAmanucharA rudrAH koTishaH parikIrtitAH | sarvatra saMsthitAstatra trilokeShvabhibhAgashaH
verses.translation: You all request for his bones. He will undoubtedly give them to you. Make the thunderbolt staff therewith and kill Vrtra without hesitation.

verses.sanskrit: इति ते वर्णितास्तातावताराः शङ्करस्य वै । एकादशमिता रुद्राः सर्वलोकसुखावहाः
verses.transliteration: iti te varNitAstAtAvatArAH sha~Nkarasya vai | ekAdashamitA rudrAH sarvalokasukhAvahAH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma, Indra accompa¬ nied by his preceptor and other gods went immediately to the excellent hermitage of Dadhici.
verses.hindi: लगाना तुम्हारे लिये उचित नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानममलं सर्वपापप्रणाशकम् । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वकामप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: idamAkhyAnamamalaM sarvapApapraNAshakam | dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM sarvakAmapradAyakam
verses.translation: There Indra saw the sage in the company of Suvarca. Along with the preceptor and other gods he humbly and respectfully bowed to him with palms joined in reverence,
verses.hindi: आगे पुनः अनेक प्रकारसे अपनी निन्‍्दा की

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयात्तात श्रावयेद्वै समाहितः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा ततो मुक्तिं लभेत सः
verses.transliteration: ya idaM shR^iNuyAttAta shrAvayedvai samAhitaH | iha sarvasukhaM bhuktvA tato muktiM labheta saH
verses.translation: On realising his intention the sage, the most ex¬ cellent of scholars sent his wife Suvarca to the inner apart¬ ments of the hermitage.
verses.hindi: आपका वध नहीं कर रही हूँ

verses.sanskrit: सुनुत्वा तं सुराः सर्वे कृत्वा विज्ञप्तिमादरात् । सर्वं निवेदयामासुः स्वदुःखं तत्पराजयम्
verses.transliteration: sunutvA taM surAH sarve kR^itvA vij~naptimAdarAt | sarvaM nivedayAmAsuH svaduHkhaM tatparAjayam
verses.translation: Then the king of gods, accompanied by the gods bent upon achieving his own object, and most efficient in polity spoke to the great sage.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स कश्यपस्तात तत्पिता शिवसक्तधीः । तदाकर्ण्यामराकं वै दुःखितोऽभून्न चाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa kashyapastAta tatpitA shivasaktadhIH | tadAkarNyAmarAkaM vai duHkhito.abhUnna chAdhikam
verses.translation: All of us, the gods and the sages are oppressed by Tvastr. We seek refuge in you, worthy of refuge, a great devotee of Siva and a liberal donor.

verses.sanskrit: तानाश्वास्य मुनिः सोऽथ धैर्यमाधाय शान्तधीः । काशीं जगाम सुप्रीत्या विश्वेश्वरपुरीं मुने
verses.transliteration: tAnAshvAsya muniH so.atha dhairyamAdhAya shAntadhIH | kAshIM jagAma suprItyA vishveshvarapurIM mune
verses.translation: O brahmin, give us your bones of adamanatine strength. I shall make my thunderbolt with your love and kill the demon.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाम्भसि ततः स्नात्वा कृत्वा तं विधिमादरात् । विश्वेश्वरं समानर्च साम्बं सर्वेश्वरं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAmbhasi tataH snAtvA kR^itvA taM vidhimAdarAt | vishveshvaraM samAnarcha sAmbaM sarveshvaraM prabhum
verses.translation: Thus requested, the sage fond of helping others meditated on lord Siva and abandoned his body.
verses.hindi: शिव ब्रह्मके रूपमें निर्गुण एवं अव्यय कहे जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: शिवलिङ्गं सुसंस्थाप्य चकार विपुलं तपः । शम्भुमुद्दिश्य सुप्रीत्या देवानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: shivali~NgaM susaMsthApya chakAra vipulaM tapaH | shambhumuddishya suprItyA devAnAM hitakAmyayA
verses.translation: Immediately he reached Brahma's region with his bondage of actions quashed. There was a shower of flowers and the people were agreeably surprised.
verses.hindi: साथ पुनः सम्भाषण न हो सके

verses.sanskrit: महान्कालो व्यतीयाय तपतस्तस्य वै मुने । शिवपादाम्बुजासक्तमनसो धैर्यशालिनः
verses.transliteration: mahAnkAlo vyatIyAya tapatastasya vai mune | shivapAdAmbujAsaktamanaso dhairyashAlinaH
verses.translation: Indra then called the divine cow Surabhi to lick up the marrow etc. He directed Visvakarman to make the weapon with the bones.
verses.hindi: नीचेकी ओर मुख की हुई उनसे कहा--

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
