verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: With his backbone he made the thunderbolt, arrow and the missile called Brahmasiras. With the other bones he made many other weapons.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: With his backbone he made the thunderbolt, arrow and the missile called Brahmasiras. With the other bones he made many other weapons.
verses.hindi: लिये कोई भी वस्तु मुझे अदेय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.१९. एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः । दुर्वासश्चरितवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथान्यच्चरितं शम्भोः शृणु प्रीत्या महामुने । यथा बभूव दुर्वासाः शङ्करो धर्महेतवे
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.19\. ekonaviMsho.adhyAyaH | durvAsashcharitavarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | athAnyachcharitaM shambhoH shR^iNu prItyA mahAmune | yathA babhUva durvAsAH sha~Nkaro dharmahetave
verses.translation: O sage, flourishing with Siva's brilliance, the in¬ furiated Indra lifted the thunderbolt and rushed against Vrtra like Rudra rushing against the.god of death.
verses.hindi: देखे मेरा एक-एक क्षण युगके समान बीत रहा है

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा रमानाथं नत्वा नुत्वा विधिः सुरैः । स्वदुःखं तत्समाचख्यौ विष्णवेऽनन्तकं मुने
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvA ramAnAthaM natvA nutvA vidhiH suraiH | svaduHkhaM tatsamAchakhyau viShNave.anantakaM mune
verses.translation: O dear, thus this story of Vftra's slaughter is related to you as arising from the context. Now listen respect¬ fully to the incarnation of Siva as Pippalada.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुश्च विधिना देवै रुद्रस्थानं ययौ द्रुतम् । हरं प्रणम्य तत्रैत्य तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: viShNushcha vidhinA devai rudrasthAnaM yayau drutam | haraM praNamya tatraitya tuShTAva parameshvaram
verses.translation: At the behest of her lord Suvarca the chaste wife of the sage Dadhici the noble soul went to the inner apart¬ ments of the hermitage.
verses.hindi: आप मेरे पति हों--ऐसा पार्वतीने शिवसे कहा

verses.sanskrit: स्तुत्वा बहुतया विष्णुः स्वदुःखं च न्यवेदयत् । शर्वं ज्वालासमुद्भूतमत्रेश्च तपसः परम्
verses.transliteration: stutvA bahutayA viShNuH svaduHkhaM cha nyavedayat | sharvaM jvAlAsamudbhUtamatreshcha tapasaH param
verses.translation: At the behest of her husband she finished her household duties and came there, 'fhe pitiable lady could n(}t see her lord there.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तत्र समेतास्तु ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । मुने सम्मन्त्रयाञ्चक्रुरन्योऽन्यं जगतां हितम्
verses.transliteration: atha tatra sametAstu brahmaviShNumaheshvarAH | mune sammantrayA~nchakruranyo.anyaM jagatAM hitam
verses.translation: Afler ccaning there and seeing the most inauspicious occurrence there, O excellent sage, the surprised Suvarca spoke to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: तदा ब्रह्मादयो देवास्त्रयस्ते वरदर्षभाः । जग्मुस्तदाश्रमं शीघ्रं वरं दातुं तदर्षये
verses.transliteration: tadA brahmAdayo devAstrayaste varadarShabhAH | jagmustadAshramaM shIghraM varaM dAtuM tadarShaye
verses.translation: The chaste lady, on realising that all this was the action of the gods, became angry. The infuriated wife of the excellent sage, Suvarca, cursed them.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ब्रह्मचारिशिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयस्त्रिशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: स्वचिह्नचिह्नितांस्तान्स दृष्ट्वात्रिर्मुनिसत्तमः । प्रणनाम च तुष्टाव वाग्भिरिष्टाभिरादरात्
verses.transliteration: svachihnachihnitAMstAnsa dR^iShTvAtrirmunisattamaH | praNanAma cha tuShTAva vAgbhiriShTAbhirAdarAt
verses.translation: **Ah! the gods are very wicked. They are covetous, stupid but very skiful in manipulating their own affairs. Let them all, inclusive of Indra, become beasts from today.**

verses.sanskrit: ततः स विस्मितो विप्रस्तानुवाच कृताञ्जलिः । ब्रह्मपुत्रो विनीतात्मा ब्रह्मविष्णुहराभिधान्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa vismito viprastAnuvAcha kR^itA~njaliH | brahmaputro vinItAtmA brahmaviShNuharAbhidhAn
verses.translation: Suvarca, a woman saint and the beloved wife of the sage cursed the gods inclusive of Indra thus.
verses.hindi: उन्हें भलीभाँति प्रणमकर वे कहने लगीं--

verses.sanskrit: अत्रिरुवाच । हे ब्रह्मन् हे हरे रुद्र पूज्यास्त्रिजगतां मताः । प्रभवश्चेश्वराः सृष्टिरक्षासंहारकारकाः
verses.transliteration: atriruvAcha | he brahman he hare rudra pUjyAstrijagatAM matAH | prabhavashcheshvarAH sR^iShTirakShAsaMhArakArakAH
verses.translation: That chaste lady desired to go to the worlds of her husband. With the sacred twigs, the noble lady prepared the funeral pyre.
verses.hindi: तो मेरे पति बनें और मेरे ऊपर कृपा करें

verses.sanskrit: एक एव मया ध्यात ईश्वरः पुत्रहेतवे । यः कश्चिदीश्वरः ख्यातो जगतां स्वस्त्रिया सह
verses.transliteration: eka eva mayA dhyAta IshvaraH putrahetave | yaH kashchidIshvaraH khyAto jagatAM svastriyA saha
verses.translation: Then a pleasant celestial voice urged by liva spoke to Suvarcfi, consoling her.

verses.sanskrit: यूयं त्रयस्सुराः कस्मादागता वरदर्षभाः । एतन्मे संशयं छित्त्वा ततो दत्तेप्सितं वरम्
verses.transliteration: yUyaM trayassurAH kasmAdAgatA varadarShabhAH | etanme saMshayaM ChittvA tato dattepsitaM varam
verses.translation: O intelligent lady, do not carry out this calami¬ tous task. Listen to my weighty words, llie semen of the sage is in your womb. Develop it carefully.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मपुत्रो बभूवातितपस्वी ब्रह्मवित्प्रभुः । अनसूयापतिर्धीमान्ब्रह्माज्ञाप्रतिपालकः
verses.transliteration: brahmaputro babhUvAtitapasvI brahmavitprabhuH | anasUyApatirdhImAnbrahmAj~nApratipAlakaH
verses.translation: O gentle lady, later on, you may do as you please. It is the command of Brahmfi that a pregnant woman should not bum herself.
verses.hindi: हैं और मैं सर्वदा आपकी भक्त हूँ

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य प्रत्यूचुस्ते सुरास्त्रयः । यादृक्कृतस्ते सङ्कल्पस्तथैवाभून्मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: iti shrutvA vachastasya pratyUchuste surAstrayaH | yAdR^ikkR^itaste sa~NkalpastathaivAbhUnmunIshvara
verses.translation: O great sage, after saying this the celestial voice stopped. On bearing that voice the wife of the sage was surprised for a moment.

verses.sanskrit: वयं त्रयो भवेशानाः समाना वरदर्षभाः । अस्मदंशभवास्तस्माद्भविष्यन्ति सुतास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: vayaM trayo bhaveshAnAH samAnA varadarShabhAH | asmadaMshabhavAstasmAdbhaviShyanti sutAstrayaH
verses.translation: That great chaste lady, Suvarcfi, desirous of attain¬ ing the world of her husband sat down and broke open her belly with a stone.

verses.sanskrit: विदिता भुवने सर्वे पित्रोः कीर्तिविवर्द्धनाः । इत्युक्त्वा त्रयो देवाः स्वधामानि ययुर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: viditA bhuvane sarve pitroH kIrtivivarddhanAH | ityuktvA trayo devAH svadhAmAni yayurmudA
verses.translation: The foetus of the child of the great sage, ofbril-

verses.sanskrit: वरं लब्ध्वा मुनिः सोऽथ जगाम स्वाश्रमं मुदा । युतोऽनुसूयया प्रीतो ब्रह्मानन्दप्रदो मुने
verses.transliteration: varaM labdhvA muniH so.atha jagAma svAshramaM mudA | yuto.anusUyayA prIto brahmAnandaprado mune
verses.translation: On seeing her son of divine form, the beloved wife of the sage Suvarca realised in her mind that it was the incarnation of Rudra himself. The geat chaste lady became delighted, bowed to him and eulogised him. O great sage, that form of the child was impressed on her heart.
verses.hindi: हो गये और मेना भी मोहित हो उठीं

verses.sanskrit: अथ ब्रह्मा हरिः शम्भुरवतेरुः स्त्रियां ततः । पुत्ररूपैः प्रसन्नास्ते नानालीलाप्रकाशकाः
verses.transliteration: atha brahmA hariH shambhuravateruH striyAM tataH | putrarUpaiH prasannAste nAnAlIlAprakAshakAH
verses.translation: Suvarca of pure vision, the mother, desirous of going to her husband's region, smilingly and lovingly spoke to her son.

verses.sanskrit: विधेरंशाद्विधुर्जज्ञेऽनसूयायां मुनीश्वरात् । आविर्बभूवोदधितः क्षिप्तो देवैः स एव हि
verses.transliteration: vidheraMshAdvidhurjaj~ne.anasUyAyAM munIshvarAt | AvirbabhUvodadhitaH kShipto devaiH sa eva hi
verses.translation: O dear, O lord Siva, O fortunate one, stay near this holy fig tree for a long time. Be the bestower of hap¬ piness to all.
verses.hindi: उत्तम नृत्य तथा गान करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोरंशात् स्त्रियां तस्यामत्रेर्दत्तो व्यजायत । संन्यासपद्धतिर्येन वर्द्धिता परमा मुने
verses.transliteration: viShNoraMshAt striyAM tasyAmatrerdatto vyajAyata | sa.nnyAsapaddhatiryena varddhitA paramA mune
verses.translation: Out of affection allow me to go to the region of my husband. Staying there along with my husband I shall meditate on you in the form of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वासा मुनिशार्दूलः शिवांशान्मुनिसत्तम । जज्ञे तस्यां स्त्रियामत्रेर्वरधर्मप्रवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: durvAsA munishArdUlaH shivAMshAnmunisattama | jaj~ne tasyAM striyAmatrervaradharmapravartakaH
verses.translation: After speaking thus to her son that chaste lady Suvarca followed her husband by means of the great trans¬ cendental meditation.
verses.hindi: उस भिक्षुकको सामने आँगनमें स्थित देखा

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा रुद्रश्च दुर्वासा ब्रह्मतेजोविवर्द्धनः । चक्रे धर्मपरीक्षां च बहूनां स दयापरः
verses.transliteration: bhUtvA rudrashcha durvAsA brahmatejovivarddhanaH | chakre dharmaparIkShAM cha bahUnAM sa dayAparaH
verses.translation: In the meantime the delighted gods inclusive of Indra, hurriedly came there along with the sages as though invited there.
verses.hindi: निकालनेके लिये अपने सेवकोंको आज्ञा दी

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यवंशे समुत्पन्नो योऽम्बरीषो नृपोऽभवत् । तत्परीक्षामकार्षीत्स तां शृणु त्वं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: sUryavaMshe samutpanno yo.ambarISho nR^ipo.abhavat | tatparIkShAmakArShItsa tAM shR^iNu tvaM munIshvara
verses.translation: Vinu and Brahmi too, accompanied by their attendants came over there to see Siva who had taken in¬ carnation in the world through SuvarcS and Dadhici.

verses.sanskrit: सुनिर्देशाद् ब्रह्मणो हि सस्त्रीकः पुत्रकाम्यया । स त्र्यक्षकुलनामानं ययौ च तपसे गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: sunirdeshAd brahmaNo hi sastrIkaH putrakAmyayA | sa tryakShakulanAmAnaM yayau cha tapase girim
verses.translation: On seeing him there, incarnated as the sage's son, they bowed to him with palms joined in reverence and made obeisances.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽम्बरीषो नृपवरः सप्तद्वीपरसापतिः । नियमं हि चकारासावेकादश्यां व्रते दृढम्
verses.transliteration: so.ambarISho nR^ipavaraH saptadvIparasApatiH | niyamaM hi chakArAsAvekAdashyAM vrate dR^iDham
verses.translation: The sons of Gandharvas sang. Kinnaras and other players played on instruments. The gods showered flowers.
verses.hindi: और अन्य कुछ भी ग्रहण नहीं किया

verses.sanskrit: एकादश्या व्रतं कृत्वा द्वादश्यां चैव पारणाम् । करिष्यामीति सुदृढसङ्कल्पस्तु नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: ekAdashyA vrataM kR^itvA dvAdashyAM chaiva pAraNAm | kariShyAmIti sudR^iDhasa~Nkalpastu narAdhipaH
verses.translation: After consecrating the refulgent child and the fig tree who became tlie father of Rudra, Vi§nu and other gods eulogised him again.
verses.hindi: शीघ्र ही अपने स्थानको चले गये

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा तन्नियमं तस्य दुर्वासा मुनिसत्तमः । तदन्तिकं गतः शिष्यैर्बहुभिः शङ्करांशजः
verses.transliteration: j~nAtvA tanniyamaM tasya durvAsA munisattamaH | tadantikaM gataH shiShyairbahubhiH sha~NkarAMshajaH
verses.translation: The delighted Brahma named him Pippalada. Visu and the gods said "O lord of the gods be pleased'*.
verses.hindi: शिवजीमें उन दोनोंकी उत्कट भक्ति हो गयी

verses.sanskrit: पारणे द्वादशीं स्वल्पां ज्ञात्वा यावत्स भोजनम् । कर्त्तुं व्यवसितस्तावदागतं स न्यमन्त्रयत्
verses.transliteration: pAraNe dvAdashIM svalpAM j~nAtvA yAvatsa bhojanam | karttuM vyavasitastAvadAgataM sa nyamantrayat
verses.translation: After saying this and making great jubilation, Brahma, Visnu and the gods went to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्नानार्थमगमद्दुर्वासाः शिष्यसंयुतः । विलम्बं कृतवांस्तत्र परीक्षार्थं मुनिर्बहु
verses.transliteration: tataH snAnArthamagamaddurvAsAH shiShyasaMyutaH | vilambaM kR^itavAMstatra parIkShArthaM munirbahu
verses.translation: Then Rudra, the great lord in the form of Pippalada, performed a penance for a long time at the foot of the fig tree, with a desire to bestow benefit on the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मविघ्नं तदा ज्ञात्वा स नृपः शास्त्रशासनात् । जलं प्राश्यास्थितस्तत्र तदागमनकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration: dharmavighnaM tadA j~nAtvA sa nR^ipaH shAstrashAsanAt | jalaM prAshyAsthitastatra tadAgamanakA~NkShayA
verses.translation: As Pippalada, following the convention of the world, performed the penance, a long time passed by.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र दुर्वासा मुनिरागतः । कृताशनं नृपं ज्ञात्वा परीक्षार्थं धृताकृतिः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra durvAsA munirAgataH | kR^itAshanaM nR^ipaM j~nAtvA parIkShArthaM dhR^itAkR^itiH
verses.translation: After arranging and establishing Dharma with a desire for its good foundation, lord Siva performed great sports. O good sage, listen to that.

verses.sanskrit: चुक्रोधाति नृपे तस्मिन्परीक्षार्थं वृषस्य सः । प्रोवाच वचनं तूग्रं स मुनिः शङ्करांशजः
verses.transliteration: chukrodhAti nR^ipe tasminparIkShArthaM vR^iShasya saH | provAcha vachanaM tUgraM sa muniH sha~NkarAMshajaH
verses.translation: Once while going to the river Pu?pabhadra*' for his ablution, the great sage saw the beautiful youthful maiden Padma, a part of Siva herself.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वासा उवाच । मां निमन्त्र्य नृपाभोज्य जलं पीतं त्वयाधम । दर्शयामि फलं तस्य दुष्टदण्डधरो ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration: durvAsA uvAcha | mAM nimantrya nR^ipAbhojya jalaM pItaM tvayAdhama | darshayAmi phalaM tasya duShTadaNDadharo hyaham
verses.translation: Desirous of getting her, the sage traversing the world and an expert in following the established conventions went to the abode of king Anaranya, her father.
verses.hindi: भोगोंको भोगकर बादमें मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेंगे

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा क्रोधताम्राक्षो नृपं दग्धुं समुद्यतः । समुत्तस्थौ द्रुतं चक्रं तत्स्थं रक्षार्थमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA krodhatAmrAkSho nR^ipaM dagdhuM samudyataH | samuttasthau drutaM chakraM tatsthaM rakShArthamaishvaram
verses.translation: On seeing him, the awe-struck king of men bowed to him. Offering him Madhuparka* he worshipped him devotedly.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणानायम्य विधिवन्निर्विन्ध्यातटिनीतटे । तपश्चचार सुमहद् अद्वन्द्वोऽब्दशतं मुनिः
verses.transliteration: prANAnAyamya vidhivannirvindhyAtaTinItaTe | tapashchachAra sumahad advandvo.abdashataM muniH
verses.translation: Not identified, tiff. See F. 600 note.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजज्वालाति तं चक्रं मुनिं दग्धुं सुदर्शनम् । शिवरूपं तमज्ञात्वा शिवमायाविमोहितम्
verses.transliteration: prajajvAlAti taM chakraM muniM dagdhuM sudarshanam | shivarUpaM tamaj~nAtvA shivamAyAvimohitam
verses.translation: The sage accepted everything with regard and requested for the hand his daughter. Thereupon the king was unable to say anything. He was silent.
verses.hindi: सर्व निवेदयामासुस्तद्वृत्तं पुरतो विधे:॥ १३  लोगोंने ब्रह्मके आगे सारा वृत्तान्त निवेदन किया

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे व्योमवाण्युवाचाशरीरिणी । अम्बरीषं महात्मानं ब्रह्मभक्तं च वैष्णवम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vyomavANyuvAchAsharIriNI | ambarIShaM mahAtmAnaM brahmabhaktaM cha vaiShNavam
verses.translation: The sage repeated the request, saying "Give me your daughter devoutly. Otherwise I will reduce everything to ashes along with you."
verses.hindi: प्रणामकर उन लोगोंने सारा वृत्तान्त निवेदन किया

verses.sanskrit: व्योमवाण्युवाच । सुदर्शनमिदं चक्रं हरये शम्भुनार्पितम् । शान्तं कुरु प्रज्वलितमद्य दुर्वाससे नृप
verses.transliteration: vyomavANyuvAcha | sudarshanamidaM chakraM haraye shambhunArpitam | shAntaM kuru prajvalitamadya durvAsase nR^ipa
verses.translation: O great sage, then all the people of the king were enveloped by the brilliance of Pippalada, son of Dadhici.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वासायं शिवः साक्षात्स चक्रं हरयेऽर्पितम् । एवं साधारणमुनिं न जानीहि नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: durvAsAyaM shivaH sAkShAtsa chakraM haraye.arpitam | evaM sAdhAraNamuniM na jAnIhi nR^ipottama
verses.translation: After marrying Padma, the daughter of the king and a part of Siva, the sage Pippalada joyously took her to his hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: तव धर्मपरीक्षार्थमागतोऽयं मुनीश्वरः । शरणं याहि तस्याशु भविष्यत्यन्यथा लयः
verses.transliteration: tava dharmaparIkShArthamAgato.ayaM munIshvaraH | sharaNaM yAhi tasyAshu bhaviShyatyanyathA layaH
verses.translation: After going to the hermitage the aged excellent sage stayed there with that woman. The sage was not too indulgent.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा च नभोवाणी विरराम मुनीश्वर । अस्तावीत्स हरांशं तमम्बरीषोऽपि चादरात्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA cha nabhovANI virarAma munIshvara | astAvItsa harAMshaM tamambarISho.api chAdarAt
verses.translation: Then the daughter of Anaranya served the sage with devotion, in mind, word and deed, like LaksmI serving Vi?nu.

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीष उवाच । यद्यस्ति दत्तमिष्टं च स्वधर्मो वा स्वनुष्ठितः । कुलं नो विप्रदैवं चेद्धरेरस्त्रं प्रशाम्यतु
verses.transliteration: ambarISha uvAcha | yadyasti dattamiShTaM cha svadharmo vA svanuShThitaH | kulaM no vipradaivaM cheddharerastraM prashAmyatu
verses.translation: Then the excellent sage Pippalada, a part of Siva, became a young man by means of his divine sport and sported with that young lady.
verses.hindi: कहकर शीघ्र ही अपने स्थानको चले गये

verses.sanskrit: यदि नो भगवान्प्रीतो मद्भक्तो भक्तवत्सलः । सुदर्शनमिदं चास्त्रं प्रशाम्यतु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yadi no bhagavAnprIto madbhakto bhaktavatsalaH | sudarshanamidaM chAstraM prashAmyatu visheShataH
verses.translation: Ten noble sons, all of them great sons, were born to the sage. They were equal to their father and increased the pleasure of Padma.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति स्तुवति रुद्राग्रे शैवं चक्रं सुदर्शनम् । अशाम्यत्सर्वथा ज्ञात्वा तं शिवांशं सुलब्धधीः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti stuvati rudrAgre shaivaM chakraM sudarshanam | ashAmyatsarvathA j~nAtvA taM shivAMshaM sulabdhadhIH
verses.translation: On seeing the harassment by the planet Saturn of every one irremediably, the sympathetic lord lovingly granted a boon to all the world.

verses.sanskrit: अथाम्बरीषः स नृपः प्रणनाम च तं मुनिम् । शिवावतारं संज्ञाय स्वपरीक्षार्थमागतम्
verses.transliteration: athAmbarIShaH sa nR^ipaH praNanAma cha taM munim | shivAvatAraM sa.nj~nAya svaparIkShArthamAgatam
verses.translation: "For sixteen years from birth no man will have that affliction. Similarly to the devotees of Siva too. This word of mine is true.

verses.sanskrit: य एक ईश्वरः कश्चिदविकारी महाप्रभुः । स मे पुत्रवरं दद्यादिति निश्चितमानसः
verses.transliteration: ya eka IshvaraH kashchidavikArI mahAprabhuH | sa me putravaraM dadyAditi nishchitamAnasaH
verses.translation: If Saturn were to disregard my instruction and harass men, he will undoubtedly be reduced to ashes."

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसन्नो बभूवाथ स मुनिः शङ्करांशजः । भुक्त्वा तस्मै वरं दत्त्वा स्वाभीष्टं स्वालयं ययौ
verses.transliteration: suprasanno babhUvAtha sa muniH sha~NkarAMshajaH | bhuktvA tasmai varaM dattvA svAbhIShTaM svAlayaM yayau
verses.translation: O dear, thus, afraid of him the excellent planet Saturn, though in aberration, does not afflict men at anytime.
verses.hindi: ह्ति मा हक शतरुद्रसंहितायां साधुद्विजशिवावतारवर्णन॑ नाम पश्ञत्रिशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषपरीक्षायां दुर्वासश्चरितं मुने । प्रोक्तामन्यच्चरित्रं त्वं शृणु तस्य मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: ambarIShaparIkShAyAM durvAsashcharitaM mune | proktAmanyachcharitraM tvaM shR^iNu tasya munIshvara
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated to you the good story of the great sage Pippal&da who had assumed the form of p human being in the course of his divine sports. Hie story yields the fruit of all desires.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्दाशरथेश्चक्रे परीक्षां नियमेन वै । मुनिरूपेण कालेन यः कृतो नियमो मुने
verses.transliteration: punardAsharatheshchakre parIkShAM niyamena vai | munirUpeNa kAlena yaH kR^ito niyamo mune
verses.translation: These three—Gidhi, Kauiika and die great sie Pippal&da quell the affliction of 9ani on being remembered.

verses.sanskrit: तदैव मुनिना तेन सौमित्रिः प्रेषितो हठात् । तं तत्याज द्रुतं रामो बन्धुं पणवशान्मुने
verses.transliteration: tadaiva muninA tena saumitriH preShito haThAt | taM tatyAja drutaM rAmo bandhuM paNavashAnmune
verses.translation: For the dissolution of the affliction of Saturn, the man who reads or Ustens devoutly to the story of Pippal&da along with that of Padml attains all desires in diis world.

verses.sanskrit: सा कथा विदिता लोके मुनिभिर्बहुधोदिता । नातो मे विस्तरात्प्रोक्ता ज्ञाता यत्सर्वथा बुधैः
verses.transliteration: sA kathA viditA loke munibhirbahudhoditA | nAto me vistarAtproktA j~nAtA yatsarvathA budhaiH
verses.translation: O dear sage, listen to me. 1 shall tell you about Vaiiyan&tha, the incarnation of Siva, the supreme soul that yields great bliss.

verses.sanskrit: नियमं सुदृढं दृष्ट्वा सुप्रसन्नोऽभवन्मुनिः । दुर्वासाः सप्रसन्नात्मा वरं तस्मै प्रदत्तवान्
verses.transliteration: niyamaM sudR^iDhaM dR^iShTvA suprasanno.abhavanmuniH | durvAsAH saprasannAtmA varaM tasmai pradattavAn
verses.translation: She always worshipped Siva and Pihrvad with great joy. She was interested in recounting the names of Siva. She used to wear ashes and Rudrak.
verses.hindi: प्रभु शंकरने द्रोणाचार्यसे ' वर माँगो '--ऐसा कहा

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्णनियमस्यापि परीक्षां स चकार ह । तां शृणु त्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठ कथयामि कथां च ताम्
verses.transliteration: shrIkR^iShNaniyamasyApi parIkShAM sa chakAra ha | tAM shR^iNu tvaM munishreShTha kathayAmi kathAM cha tAm
verses.translation: After worshipping Siva, the lord of the universe she used to dance with great devotion and sing the great glory of Siva.
verses.hindi: अपने अंशसे उत्पन्न एक पुत्र दीजिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मप्रार्थनया विष्णुर्वसुदेवसुतोऽभवत् । धराभारावतारार्थं साधूनां रक्षणाय च
verses.transliteration: brahmaprArthanayA viShNurvasudevasuto.abhavat | dharAbhArAvatArArthaM sAdhUnAM rakShaNAya cha
verses.translation: She kept a monkey and a cock which she decorated with Rudrikas. She made them dance singing herself and clapping her hands.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा दुष्टान्महापापान् ब्रह्मद्रोहकरान्खलान् । ररक्ष निखिलान्साधून्ब्राह्मणान्कृष्णनामभाक्
verses.transliteration: hatvA duShTAnmahApApAn brahmadrohakarAnkhalAn | rarakSha nikhilAnsAdhUnbrAhmaNAnkR^iShNanAmabhAk
verses.translation: On seeing them dance, she, engrossed in devotion to Siva, used to laugh lovingly along with her friends and attendants.
verses.hindi: थीं और वे शत्रुपक्षका विनाश करनेवाले थे

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभक्तिं चकाराति स कृष्णो वसुदेवजः । नित्यं हि भोजयामास सुरसान्ब्राह्मणान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: brahmabhaktiM chakArAti sa kR^iShNo vasudevajaH | nityaM hi bhojayAmAsa surasAnbrAhmaNAnbahUn
verses.translation: The monkey, as a result of her instruction, danced before her, like a boy bedecked in Rudrik$as as ear-rings, and shoulderlets.
verses.hindi: करके उन कौरवोंपर विजय प्राप्त की

verses.sanskrit: बहुकालो व्यतीयाय तस्मिंस्तपति सत्तपः । आविर्बभूव तस्मात्तु शुचिर्ज्वाला महीयसी
verses.transliteration: bahukAlo vyatIyAya tasmiMstapati sattapaH | AvirbabhUva tasmAttu shuchirjvAlA mahIyasI
verses.translation: Thus that prostitute indulging in these delighthil pranks and pursuing devotional service* to Siva was very happy always.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभक्तो विशेषेण कृष्णश्चेति प्रथामगात् । सन्द्रष्टुकामः स मुनिः कृष्णान्तिकमगान्मुने
verses.transliteration: brahmabhakto visheSheNa kR^iShNashcheti prathAmagAt | sandraShTukAmaH sa muniH kR^iShNAntikamagAnmune
verses.translation: O excellent sage, a long time thus elapsed when she was quite happy performing her devotional service to Siva.
verses.hindi: रहा है, मैं इसे नहीं जान पा रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: रुक्मिणीसहितं कृष्णं सन्नं कृत्वा रथे स्वयम् । संयोज्य संस्थितो वाहं सुप्रसन्न उवाह तम्
verses.transliteration: rukmiNIsahitaM kR^iShNaM sannaM kR^itvA rathe svayam | saMyojya saMsthito vAhaM suprasanna uvAha tam
verses.translation: Once Siva assumed the form of a merchant and vidted her house to test her. He had assumed the auspi¬ cious form of a devotee.

verses.sanskrit: मुनी रथात्समुत्तीर्य दृष्ट्वा तां दृढतां पराम् । तस्मै भूत्वा सुप्रसन्नो वज्राङ्गत्ववरं ददौ
verses.transliteration: munI rathAtsamuttIrya dR^iShTvA tAM dR^iDhatAM parAm | tasmai bhUtvA suprasanno vajrA~NgatvavaraM dadau
verses.translation: He had smeared ashes all over his body. Round his wrist was tied an excellent bangle set wiUi gems.

verses.sanskrit: द्युनद्यामेकदा स्नानं कुर्वन्नग्नो बभूव ह । लज्जितोऽभून्मुनिश्रेष्ठो दुर्वासाः कौतुकी मुने
verses.transliteration: dyunadyAmekadA snAnaM kurvannagno babhUva ha | lajjito.abhUnmunishreShTho durvAsAH kautukI mune
verses.translation: The beautiful prostitute worshipped and welcomed the visitor with great joy. She made him sit with great respect.
verses.hindi: तेजसे उसी क्षण शान्त हो गया

verses.sanskrit: तज्ज्ञात्वा द्रौपदी स्नानं कुर्वती तत्र चादरात् । तल्लज्जां छादयामास भिन्नस्वाञ्चलदानतः
verses.transliteration: tajj~nAtvA draupadI snAnaM kurvatI tatra chAdarAt | tallajjAM ChAdayAmAsa bhinnasvA~nchaladAnataH
verses.translation: On seeing the excellent bangle round his wrist she coveted the same. In great surprise she said.
verses.hindi: करते हैं तथा संहार करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: तदादाय प्रवाहेनागतं स्वनिकटं मुनिः । तेनाच्छाद्य स्वगुह्यं च तस्यै तुष्टो बभूव सः
verses.transliteration: tadAdAya pravAhenAgataM svanikaTaM muniH | tenAchChAdya svaguhyaM cha tasyai tuShTo babhUva saH
verses.translation: This bangle set with great gems arouncf your arm captivates my mind. It is worthy of being an ornament of a celestial damsel.

verses.sanskrit: द्रौपद्यै च वरं प्रादात्तदञ्चलविवर्द्धनम् । पाण्डवान्सुखिनश्चक्रे द्रौपदी तद्वरात्पुनः
verses.transliteration: draupadyai cha varaM prAdAttada~nchalavivarddhanam | pANDavAnsukhinashchakre draupadI tadvarAtpunaH
verses.translation: On seeing that she wished for the bangle set with nine gems, the liberal-minded merchant spoke smilingly.

verses.sanskrit: हंसडिम्भौ नृपौ कौचित्स्वावमानकरौ खलौ । दत्त्वा निदेशं च हरेर्नाशयामास स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: haMsaDimbhau nR^ipau kauchitsvAvamAnakarau khalau | dattvA nideshaM cha harernAshayAmAsa sa prabhuH
verses.translation: If your mind wishes for this excellent gemset ornament you can have it with pleasure. But what is the price you are willing to pay?

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मतेजो विशेषेण स्थापयामास भूतले । संन्यासपद्धतिं चैव यथाशास्त्रविधिक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: brahmatejo visheSheNa sthApayAmAsa bhUtale | sa.nnyAsapaddhatiM chaiva yathAshAstravidhikramam
verses.translation: We are prostitutes flirting here and there and not chaste ladies. Undoubtedly the regular practice observed in our family is harlotry.

verses.sanskrit: बहूनुद्धारयामास सूपदेशं विबोध्य च । ज्ञानं दत्त्वा विशेषेण बहून्मुक्तांश्चकार सः
verses.transliteration: bahUnuddhArayAmAsa sUpadeshaM vibodhya cha | j~nAnaM dattvA visheSheNa bahUnmuktAMshchakAra saH
verses.translation: If I take the bangle from you I shall be your wife for three full days and nights.

verses.sanskrit: तयासन्निखिला लोका दग्धप्राया मुनीश्वराः । तथा सुरर्षयः सर्वे पीडिता वासवादयः
verses.transliteration: tayAsannikhilA lokA dagdhaprAyA munIshvarAH | tathA surarShayaH sarve pIDitA vAsavAdayaH
verses.translation: O beloved harlot, if your words are true, let it be as you say. I shall give you the gemset bangle. Be my wife for three days and nights.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं चक्रे स दुर्वासा विचित्रं चरितं बहु । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं शृण्वतः सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: itthaM chakre sa durvAsA vichitraM charitaM bahu | dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM shR^iNvataH sarvakAmadam
verses.translation: In this deal the witnesses arc the moon and the sun. Repeat three times "True" and touch my heart, O beloved.
verses.hindi: स सिद्धि प्राणुयादिष्टामन्ते शिवपुरं ब्रजेत्॥ ४४  जाता है

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या दुर्वासश्चरितं मुदा । श्रावयेद्वा परान् यश्च स सुखीह परत्र च
verses.transliteration: ya idaM shR^iNuyAdbhaktyA durvAsashcharitaM mudA | shrAvayedvA parAn yashcha sa sukhIha paratra cha
verses.translation: O lord, I shall be your wife for three days and carry out all wifely duties. This is true. This is undoubtedly true.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सर्वे वासवाद्या सुराश्च मुनयो मुने । ब्रह्मस्थानं ययुः शीघ्रं तज्ज्वालातिप्रपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: atha sarve vAsavAdyA surAshcha munayo mune | brahmasthAnaM yayuH shIghraM tajjvAlAtiprapIDitAH
verses.translation: After repeating this for three times, with the moon and the sun as witnesses, MahSnandS touched his heart with pleasure.
verses.hindi: लेकर सुखपूर्वक अपना समय बिताने लगे

verses.sanskrit: नत्वा नुत्वा विधिं देवाः तत्स्वदुःखं न्यवेदयन् । ब्रह्मा सह सुरैस्तात विष्णुलोकं ययावरम्
verses.transliteration: natvA nutvA vidhiM devAH tatsvaduHkhaM nyavedayan | brahmA saha suraistAta viShNulokaM yayAvaram
verses.translation: After giving her the gemset bangle that merchant handed to her a gemset phallic image and spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: During the night she had her sexual union with the merchant who behaved like a libertine. She then went to sleep on the couch brilliant with a soH; bed.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: During the night she had her sexual union with the merchant who behaved like a libertine. She then went to sleep on the couch brilliant with a soH; bed.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२०. विंशोऽध्यायः । हनुमदवतारचरित्रवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अतः परं शृणु प्रीत्या हनुमच्चरितं मुने । यथा चकाराशु हरो लीलास्तद्रूपतो वराः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.20\. viMsho.adhyAyaH | hanumadavatAracharitravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | ataH paraM shR^iNu prItyA hanumachcharitaM mune | yathA chakArAshu haro lIlAstadrUpato varAH
verses.translation: O sage, then at midnight, at the will of the lordly merchant, suddenly there arose a fire'® in the middle of the dancing platform.

verses.sanskrit: स्वजनन्यन्तिकं प्रागादथ सोऽतिप्रहर्षितः । हनूमान्सर्वमाचख्यौ तस्यै तद् वृत्तमादरात्
verses.transliteration: svajananyantikaM prAgAdatha so.atipraharShitaH | hanUmAnsarvamAchakhyau tasyai tad vR^ittamAdarAt
verses.translation: The blazing fire helped by a forceful wind envel¬ oped the dancing platform all of a sudden.
verses.hindi: कमलोंका स्मरण करके पाण्डवोंसे यह कहा--

verses.sanskrit: तदाज्ञया ततो धीरः सर्वविद्यामयत्नतः । सूर्यात्पपाठ स कपिर्गत्वा नित्यं तदन्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: tadAj~nayA tato dhIraH sarvavidyAmayatnataH | sUryAtpapATha sa kapirgatvA nityaM tadantikam
verses.translation: Freed from the bondage the monkey in its fear ran here and there along with the cock and scattered sparks of fire.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याज्ञया तदंशत्य सुग्रीवस्यान्तिकं ययौ । मातुराज्ञामनुप्राप्य रुद्रांशः कपिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sUryAj~nayA tadaMshatya sugrIvasyAntikaM yayau | mAturAj~nAmanuprApya rudrAMshaH kapisattamaH
verses.translation: On seeing the phallic image burnt along with the pillar and smashed utterly, the prostitute and the mer¬ chant felt endless distress.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठभ्रात्रा वालिना हि स्वस्त्रीभोक्त्रा तिरस्कृतः । ऋष्यमूकगिरौ तेन न्यवसत्स हनूमता
verses.transliteration: jyeShThabhrAtrA vAlinA hi svastrIbhoktrA tiraskR^itaH | R^iShyamUkagirau tena nyavasatsa hanUmatA
verses.translation: On seeing the phallic image as it were his very soul burnt, the lordly merchant desired to end his life in order to know her mentality.
verses.hindi: और कहा कि हम धन्य हो गये

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभूत्स सुकण्ठस्य मन्त्री कपिवरः सुधीः । सर्वथा सुहितं चक्रे सुग्रीवस्य हरांशजः
verses.transliteration: tato.abhUtsa sukaNThasya mantrI kapivaraH sudhIH | sarvathA suhitaM chakre sugrIvasya harAMshajaH
verses.translation: In great despair and sorrow the merchant told her in grief. Lord l§iva who had assumed a human body just for pleasure indulged in different sports.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागतेन सभ्रात्रा हृतभार्येण दुःखिना । कारयामास रामेण तस्य सख्यं सुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: tatrAgatena sabhrAtrA hR^itabhAryeNa duHkhinA | kArayAmAsa rAmeNa tasya sakhyaM sukhAvaham
verses.translation: "O my beloved, when the phallic image is smashed and burnt I do not desire to live. I am telling you the truth. There is no doubt in this.

verses.sanskrit: घातयामास रामश्च वालिनं कपिकुञ्जरम् । भ्रातृपत्न्याश्च भोक्तारं पापिनं वीरमानिनम्
verses.transliteration: ghAtayAmAsa rAmashcha vAlinaM kapiku~njaram | bhrAtR^ipatnyAshcha bhoktAraM pApinaM vIramAninam
verses.translation: O gentle lady, prepare a pyre for me immediately through your servants. With my mind fixed in Siva, I shall enter the fire.

verses.sanskrit: ततो रामाज्ञया तात हनूमान्वानरेश्वरः । स सीतान्वेषणं चक्रे बहुभिर्वानरैः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tato rAmAj~nayA tAta hanUmAnvAnareshvaraH | sa sItAnveShaNaM chakre bahubhirvAnaraiH sudhIH
verses.translation: Read for in the printed Skt. text.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा लङ्कागतां सीतां गतस्तत्र कपीश्वरः । द्रुतमुल्लङ्घ्य सिन्धुं तमनिस्तीर्यं परैः स वै
verses.transliteration: j~nAtvA la~NkAgatAM sItAM gatastatra kapIshvaraH | drutamulla~Nghya sindhuM tamanistIryaM paraiH sa vai
verses.translation: Even if Brahma, Indra, Viu and others were to

verses.sanskrit: चक्रेऽद्भुतचरित्रं स तत्र विक्रमसंयुतम् । अभिज्ञानं ददौ प्रीत्या सीतायै स्वप्रभोर्वरम्
verses.transliteration: chakre.adbhutacharitraM sa tatra vikramasaMyutam | abhij~nAnaM dadau prItyA sItAyai svaprabhorvaram
verses.translation: On realising his tenacious decision the harlot was much distressed. Outside her house she caused the pyre to be made through her servants.
verses.hindi: प्रति पक्षपात उचित कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: चकार सुहितं प्रीत्या रामस्य परमेश्वरः । तत्सर्वं चरितं विप्र शृणु सर्वसुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: chakAra suhitaM prItyA rAmasya parameshvaraH | tatsarvaM charitaM vipra shR^iNu sarvasukhAvaham
verses.translation: O excellent sage, on seeing him enter die pyre, the harlot was dismayed. The youthful maiden sympathised with him.

verses.sanskrit: सीताशोकं जहाराशु स वीरः कपिनायकः । श्रावयित्वा रामवृत्तं तत्प्राणावनकारकम्
verses.transliteration: sItAshokaM jahArAshu sa vIraH kapinAyakaH | shrAvayitvA rAmavR^ittaM tatprANAvanakArakam
verses.translation: The miserable harlot remembered the sacred vow and said piteously glancing at all her kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: तदभिज्ञानमादाय निवृत्तो रामसन्निधिम् । रावणाराममाहत्य जघान बहुराक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: tadabhij~nAnamAdAya nivR^itto rAmasannidhim | rAvaNArAmamAhatya jaghAna bahurAkShasAn
verses.translation: Taking the gemset bangle I had taken the pledge that I shall be the avowed wife of this merchant for three days.
verses.hindi: शुभ होगा, इसमें सन्देहकी आवश्यकता नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: तदैव रावणसुतं हत्वा सबहुराक्षसम् । स महोपद्रवं चक्रे महोतिस्तत्र निर्भयः
verses.transliteration: tadaiva rAvaNasutaM hatvA sabahurAkShasam | sa mahopadravaM chakre mahotistatra nirbhayaH
verses.translation: Truthful preceptors have ordained that a wife shall observe her duty. If I do likewise my truthfulness will not be marred.
verses.hindi: बार निरन्तर दुःख ही दे रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: यदा दग्धो रावणेनावगुण्ठ्य वसनानि च । तैलाभ्यक्तानि सुदृढं महाबलवता मुने
verses.transliteration: yadA dagdho rAvaNenAvaguNThya vasanAni cha | tailAbhyaktAni sudR^iDhaM mahAbalavatA mune
verses.translation: Although prevented by her kinsmen the harlot was obstinate in her resolve. The woman eager in the attainment of Satyaloka decided on giving up her life.

verses.sanskrit: उत्प्लुत्योत्प्लुत्य च तदा महादेवांशजः कपिः । ददाह लङ्कां निखिलां कृत्वा व्याजं तमेव हि
verses.transliteration: utplutyotplutya cha tadA mahAdevAMshajaH kapiH | dadAha la~NkAM nikhilAM kR^itvA vyAjaM tameva hi
verses.translation: She gifted away her property to leading brahmins. She meditated on Sadiiiva. She circumambulated the fire thrice and stood ready to enter it.
verses.hindi: ध्यान करके पाण्डवोंसे प्रेमपूर्वक कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: दग्ध्वा लङ्कां वञ्चयित्वा विभीषणगृहं ततः । अपतद्वारिधौ वीरस्ततः स कपिकुञ्जरः
verses.transliteration: dagdhvA la~NkAM va~nchayitvA vibhIShaNagR^ihaM tataH | apatadvAridhau vIrastataH sa kapiku~njaraH
verses.translation: On seeing the three-eyed lord of the gods, deco¬ rated by the moon's digit, and as brilliant as crores of moons, suns and fires she stood as if stimned and firightened.
verses.hindi: मैं भी सदाशिवकी उपासना करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: स्वपुच्छं तत्र निर्वाप्य प्राप तस्य परन्तटम् । अखिन्नः स ययौ रामसन्निधिं गिरिशांशजः
verses.transliteration: svapuchChaM tatra nirvApya prApa tasya parantaTam | akhinnaH sa yayau rAmasannidhiM girishAMshajaH
verses.translation: The lord caught hold of the hands of the frigh¬ tened and agitated lady, stunned, trembling and shedding tears. He consoled her and spoke.
verses.hindi: सेवा न करनेके कारण ही सारा दुःख होता है

verses.sanskrit: अविलम्बेन सुजवो हनूमान् कपिसत्तमः । रामोपकण्ठमागत्य ददौ सीताशिरोमणिम्
verses.transliteration: avilambena sujavo hanUmAn kapisattamaH | rAmopakaNThamAgatya dadau sItAshiromaNim
verses.translation: With my magic 1 produced the blazing fire and burnt your dancing platform. After burning the gemset phallic image I entered fire myself.
verses.hindi: रक्षक सर्वोत्कृष्ट परब्रह्म शिवका दर्शन प्राप्त करो

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तदाज्ञया वीरः सिन्धौ सेतुमबन्धयत् । वानरैः स समानीय बहून् गिरिवरान् बली
verses.transliteration: tatastadAj~nayA vIraH sindhau setumabandhayat | vAnaraiH sa samAnIya bahUn girivarAn balI
verses.translation: But you remembered the promise and entered the fire along with me. Hence I shall give you such pleasures as are inaccessible to gods.
verses.hindi: वह पूजा तथा ध्यान करनेयोग्य है

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र ततो रामस्तर्तुकामो यथा ततः । शिवलिङ्गं समानर्च प्रतिष्ठाप्य जयेप्सया
verses.transliteration: gatvA tatra tato rAmastartukAmo yathA tataH | shivali~NgaM samAnarcha pratiShThApya jayepsayA
verses.translation: O beaudiiil lady of good hips, whatever you wish I shsdl give you. I am delighted by your devotion. There is nothing which cannot be given to you.

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्समये शम्भुरद्भुतोतिकरः प्रभुः । ददर्श मोहिनीरूपं विष्णोः स हि वसेद्गुणः
verses.transliteration: ekasminsamaye shambhuradbhutotikaraH prabhuH | dadarsha mohinIrUpaM viShNoH sa hi vasedguNaH
verses.translation: When Siva, lord of Parvad, favourably disposedto his devotees said thus, the harlot Mahananda replied to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वरात्स जयं प्राप्य वरं तीर्त्वोदधिं ततः । लङ्कामावृत्य कपिभी रणं चक्रे स राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration: tadvarAtsa jayaM prApya varaM tIrtvodadhiM tataH | la~NkAmAvR^itya kapibhI raNaM chakre sa rAkShasaiH
verses.translation: I have no desire for enjoyment on die earth, in the heaven or in the nether worlds. I do not desire any¬ thing except the touch of your lotus-like feet.
verses.hindi: स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं व्यासश्षान्तर्दथे क्षणात्॥ ६८  व्यास क्षणभरमें अन्तर्धान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: जघानाथासुरान्वीरो रामसैन्यं ररक्ष सः । शक्तिक्षतं लक्ष्मणं च सञ्जीविन्या ह्यजीवयत्
verses.transliteration: jaghAnAthAsurAnvIro rAmasainyaM rarakSha saH | shaktikShataM lakShmaNaM cha sa~njIvinyA hyajIvayat
verses.translation: My servants, my maids and my kinsmen are in¬ terested in seeing you. They have dedicated everything to you.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वथा सुखिनं चक्रे सरामं लक्ष्मणं हि सः । सर्वसैन्यं ररक्षासौ महादेवात्मजः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sarvathA sukhinaM chakre sarAmaM lakShmaNaM hi saH | sarvasainyaM rarakShAsau mahAdevAtmajaH prabhuH
verses.translation: Take them all along with me to your great region and quash the terrible fear of rebirth. Obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: अर्जुनको व्यासका उपदेशवर्णन नामक सैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: रावणं परिवाराढ्यं नाशयामास विश्रमः । सुखीचकार देवान्स महाबलग्रहः कपिः
verses.transliteration: rAvaNaM parivArADhyaM nAshayAmAsa vishramaH | sukhIchakAra devAnsa mahAbalagrahaH kapiH
verses.translation: Appreciating her words, the great Siva cook all of them to his great region.

verses.sanskrit: महीरावणसंज्ञं स हत्वा रामं सलक्ष्मणम् । तत्स्थानादानयामास स्वस्थानं परिपाल्य च
verses.transliteration: mahIrAvaNasa.nj~naM sa hatvA rAmaM salakShmaNam | tatsthAnAdAnayAmAsa svasthAnaM paripAlya cha
verses.translation: Thus I have described to you the great incarna*
verses.hindi: होंगे; क्योंकि अर्जुनका तेज बढ़ा हुआ है

verses.sanskrit: रामकार्यं चकाराशु सर्वथा कपिपुङ्गवः । असुरान्नमयामास नानालीलां चकार च
verses.transliteration: rAmakAryaM chakArAshu sarvathA kapipu~NgavaH | asurAnnamayAmAsa nAnAlIlAM chakAra cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this story with devotion and narrates it with purity never swerves from his duties. He attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयामास भूलोके रामभक्तिं कपीश्वरः । स्वयं भक्तवरो भूत्वा सीतारामसुखप्रदः
verses.transliteration: sthApayAmAsa bhUloke rAmabhaktiM kapIshvaraH | svayaM bhaktavaro bhUtvA sItArAmasukhapradaH
verses.translation: O dear, listen, I shall expound to you the incarna¬ tion of Siva the great soul as Dvijevara (a leading Brah¬ min) along with liva. It is pleasing to the good.

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मणप्राणदाता च सर्वदेवमदापहः । रुद्रावतारो भगवान्भक्तोद्धारकरः स वै
verses.transliteration: lakShmaNaprANadAtA cha sarvadevamadApahaH | rudrAvatAro bhagavAnbhaktoddhArakaraH sa vai
verses.translation: O dear, I have already described to you the excellent king Bhadrayu whom liva blessed in the form of a bull. In order to test his steadfastness and piety the lord manifested himself again in the form of a leading brahmin. I shall mention that same story.
verses.hindi: और भगवान् शंकरजी आपका कल्याण करें

verses.sanskrit: हनुमान्स महावीरो रामकार्यकरः सदा । रामदूताभिधो लोके दैत्यघ्नो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: hanumAnsa mahAvIro rAmakAryakaraH sadA | rAmadUtAbhidho loke daityaghno bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: Conquering the enemies through the power of  9 - abha in battle, Bhadrayu attained the throne,- O dear.
verses.hindi: हुए परस्पर मिलकर वहाँ निवास करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं तात हनुमच्चरितं वरम् । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaM tAta hanumachcharitaM varam | dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM sarvakAmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O brahmin, the chaste lady Kirtimalini, daughter of Gandrahgada and Simantini, became his wife.
verses.hindi: भी धीरज कैसे रह सकता है

verses.sanskrit: चक्रे स्वं क्षुभितं शम्भुः कामबाणहतो यथा । स्वं वीर्यं पातयामास रामकार्यार्थमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: chakre svaM kShubhitaM shambhuH kAmabANahato yathA | svaM vIryaM pAtayAmAsa rAmakAryArthamIshvaraH
verses.translation: In that beautiful forest, the king sported about along with his beloved who protected those who sought refuge in her.
verses.hindi: दर्शन प्राप्तकर हमलोग आनन्दित रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्कामान् अन्ते मोक्षं लभेत्परम्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM shR^iNuyAdbhaktyA shrAvayedvA samAhitaH | sa bhuktvehAkhilAnkAmAn ante mokShaM labhetparam
verses.translation: This Ghaptrr has a close resemblance with the second canto of K&Udasa's Raghuvaihia.
verses.hindi: आपके दर्शनमात्रसे सारा दुःख नष्ट हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: तद्वीर्यं स्थापयामासुः पत्रे सप्तर्षयश्च ते । प्रेरिता मनसा तेन रामकार्यार्थमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tadvIryaM sthApayAmAsuH patre saptarShayashcha te | preritA manasA tena rAmakAryArthamAdarAt
verses.translation: Then, in order to test his steadfastness* and pety, lord iSiva carried out his'sports there itself along with Sivi*

verses.sanskrit: तैर्गौतमसुतायां तद्वीर्यं शम्भोर्महर्षिभिः । कर्णद्वारा तथाञ्जन्यां रामकार्यार्थमाहितम्
verses.transliteration: tairgautamasutAyAM tadvIryaM shambhormaharShibhiH | karNadvArA tathA~njanyAM rAmakAryArthamAhitam
verses.translation: Siva and Siva in their own divine sports assumed the form of a brahmin couple and created an illu8(Hy tm* with their M3yi.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! मैं आपसे जो पूछता हूँ, उसे बताइये

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च समये तस्माद्धनूमानिति नामभाक् । शम्भुर्जज्ञे कपितनुर्महाबलपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tatashcha samaye tasmAddhanUmAniti nAmabhAk | shambhurjaj~ne kapitanurmahAbalaparAkramaH
verses.translation: Not far from the place where the king stood diey beg<in running in great fright on being pursued by the tier. They cried and shouted too.

verses.sanskrit: हनूमान्स कपीशानः शिशुरेव महाबलः । रविबिम्बं बभक्षाशु ज्ञात्वा लघुफलं प्रगे
verses.transliteration: hanUmAnsa kapIshAnaH shishureva mahAbalaH | ravibimbaM babhakShAshu j~nAtvA laghuphalaM prage
verses.translation: O dear, the king Bhadriyu, the leading Kfatriya worthy of being sought refuge in, saw both of them highly distressed and lamenting.

verses.sanskrit: देवप्रार्थनया तं सोऽत्यजज्ज्ञात्वा महाबलम् । शिवावतारं च प्राप वरान्दत्तान् सुरर्षभिः
verses.transliteration: devaprArthanayA taM so.atyajajj~nAtvA mahAbalam | shivAvatAraM cha prApa varAndattAn surarShabhiH
verses.translation: O leading sage, the illusory brahmin couple, ex¬ tremely terrified, spoke to the king Bhadrfiyu.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: After hearing the lamentation of the pair, the great king of great heroism immediately took up his bow, but the rushing tiger of Mayic origin, Seized the brahmin's wife.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: After hearing the lamentation of the pair, the great king of great heroism immediately took up his bow, but the rushing tiger of Mayic origin, Seized the brahmin's wife.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२१. एकविंशोऽध्यायः । महेशावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथ प्रीत्या शृणु मुनेऽवतारं परमं प्रभोः । शङ्करस्यात्मभूपुत्र शृण्वतां सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.21\. ekaviMsho.adhyAyaH | maheshAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | atha prItyA shR^iNu mune.avatAraM paramaM prabhoH | sha~NkarasyAtmabhUputra shR^iNvatAM sarvakAmadam
verses.translation: The terrible tiger grasped the woman even as she was lamenting—"O lord, O husband, O Siva, O, preceptor of the universe."

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च शङ्करः शीघ्रं तमागत्य मुनीश्वर । आश्वासयद्भैरवं हि नानानुनयकोविदः
verses.transliteration: tatashcha sha~NkaraH shIghraM tamAgatya munIshvara | AshvAsayadbhairavaM hi nAnAnunayakovidaH
verses.translation: The king struck the tiger with sharp arrows; but it was not at all affected by them. It stood like a lofty moun¬ tain, which is not affected by showers.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छापाद्भैरवः सोऽथ क्षिताववतरन्मुने । मनुष्ययोन्यां वैतालसंज्ञकः शङ्ककरेच्छया
verses.transliteration: tachChApAdbhairavaH so.atha kShitAvavataranmune | manuShyayonyAM vaitAlasa.nj~nakaH sha~NkakarechChayA
verses.translation: The powerful tiger, not at all pained by the mis¬ siles of the king, seized the woman forcibly and ran away in a hurry.

verses.sanskrit: तत्स्नेहतः शिवः सोऽपि क्षिताववतरद्विभुः । शिवया सह सल्लीलो लौकिकीं गतिमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: tatsnehataH shivaH so.api kShitAvavataradvibhuH | shivayA saha sallIlo laukikIM gatimAshritaH
verses.translation: On seeing his wife seized by the tiger, the brahmin was much bewildered and following the way of the world cried again and again.
verses.hindi: कहकर वे शीघ्र ही इन्द्रके समीप गये

verses.sanskrit: महेशाह्वः शिवश्चासीच्छारदा गिरिजा मुने । सुलीलां चक्रतुः प्रीत्या नानालीलाविशारदौ
verses.transliteration: maheshAhvaH shivashchAsIchChAradA girijA mune | sulIlAM chakratuH prItyA nAnAlIlAvishAradau
verses.translation: After crying for some time that btahmin who was
verses.hindi: अब जैसा उचित हो, आप वैसा कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं तात महेशचरितं वरम् । धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaM tAta maheshacharitaM varam | dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM sarvakAmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O king, where are your great weapons? Where is your great bow diat professes to protect? Where is your strength of ten or twelve thousand great elephants?
verses.hindi: विदाकर स्वयं वहाँ जानेका विचार किया

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्भोगानन्ते मोक्षमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM shR^iNuyAdbhaktyA shrAvayedvA samAhitaH | sa bhuktvehAkhilAnbhogAnante mokShamavApnuyAt
verses.translation: All these have become futile, for you are incom¬ petent to meet the onslaught of wild animals.

verses.sanskrit: एकदा मुनिशार्दूल गिरिजाशङ्करावुभौ । विहर्तुकामौ सञ्जातौ स्वेच्छया परमेश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: ekadA munishArdUla girijAsha~NkarAvubhau | vihartukAmau sa~njAtau svechChayA parameshvarau
verses.translation: Kings protect the distressed people who seek refuge in them with their very lives and assets. They are the knowers of virtue. Without that they are like a dead body.

verses.sanskrit: भैरवं द्वारपालं च कृत्वाभ्यन्तरमागतौ । नानासखिगणैः प्रीत्या सेवितौ नरशीलितौ
verses.transliteration: bhairavaM dvArapAlaM cha kR^itvAbhyantaramAgatau | nAnAsakhigaNaiH prItyA sevitau narashIlitau
verses.translation: Better death than life that does nbt protect the distressed. A mendicant is better than a rich householder who does not pcMsess charitable nature.

verses.sanskrit: चिरं विहृत्य तत्र द्वौ स्वतन्त्रौ परमेश्वरौ । बभूवतुः प्रसन्नौ तौ नानालीलाकरौ मुने
verses.transliteration: chiraM vihR^itya tatra dvau svatantrau parameshvarau | babhUvatuH prasannau tau nAnAlIlAkarau mune
verses.translation: Better to swallow poison or enter fire than cease to protect the oppressed, the helpless and the poor.
verses.hindi: शत्रुओंसे पीड़ित मुझे विजय प्रदान करें

verses.sanskrit: अथोन्मत्ताकृतिर्देवी स्वतन्त्रा लीलया शिवा । आगता द्वारि तद्रूपा प्रभोराज्ञामवाप सा
verses.transliteration: athonmattAkR^itirdevI svatantrA lIlayA shivA | AgatA dvAri tadrUpA prabhorAj~nAmavApa sA
verses.translation: On hearing his lamentation and the decrial of his prowess, the king thought within himself thus—
verses.hindi: ये सब निश्चय ही युद्धमें दुर्जय हैं

verses.sanskrit: तां देवीं भैरवः सोऽथ नारीदृष्ट्या विलोक्य च । निषिषेध बहिर्गन्तुं तद्रूपेण विमोहितः
verses.transliteration: tAM devIM bhairavaH so.atha nArIdR^iShTyA vilokya cha | niShiShedha bahirgantuM tadrUpeNa vimohitaH
verses.translation: "Alas, my manliness is lost today due to the adverse fate. Today my fame has been quashed. Great sin has been acquired.
verses.hindi: असाध्य हैं; तो भी अपने हितकी बात सुनो

verses.sanskrit: नारीदृष्ट्या सुदृष्टा सा भैरवेण यदा मुने । क्रुद्धाभवच्छिवा देवी तं शशाप तदाऽम्बिका
verses.transliteration: nArIdR^iShTyA sudR^iShTA sA bhairaveNa yadA mune | kruddhAbhavachChivA devI taM shashApa tadA.ambikA
verses.translation: The hereditary virtue has been smothered. I am unfortunate and confused in mind. Certainly my riches, my kingdom, my longevity will dwindle.
verses.hindi: हैं, इसलिये अब तुम शिव-मन्त्रका जप करो

verses.sanskrit: शिवोवाच । नारीदृष्ट्या पश्यसि त्वं यतो मां पुरुषाधम । अतो भव धरायां हि मानुषस्त्वं च भैरव
verses.transliteration: shivovAcha | nArIdR^iShTyA pashyasi tvaM yato mAM puruShAdhama | ato bhava dharAyAM hi mAnuShastvaM cha bhairava
verses.translation: By surrendering my own life,, lovable though it is,

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थं यदाभवच्छप्तो भैरवः शिवया मुने । हाहाकारो महानासीद्दुःखमाप स लीलया
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | itthaM yadAbhavachChapto bhairavaH shivayA mune | hAhAkAro mahAnAsIdduHkhamApa sa lIlayA
verses.translation: ComiNire Ragbu. II. 53.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O Brahmin, I am a base KLatriya bereft of strengdi. You take pity on me. O intelligent one, do not grieve. 1 shall give you what you desire.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O Brahmin, I am a base KLatriya bereft of strengdi. You take pity on me. O intelligent one, do not grieve. 1 shall give you what you desire.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२२. द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः । विष्णूपद्रववृषावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु ब्रह्मसुत प्राज्ञ वृषेशाख्यं मुनीश्वर । शिवावतारं सल्लीलं हरिगर्वहरं वरम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.22\. dvAviMsho.adhyAyaH | viShNUpadravavR^iShAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | shR^iNu brahmasuta prAj~na vR^iSheshAkhyaM munIshvara | shivAvatAraM sallIlaM harigarvaharaM varam
verses.translation: This kingdom, this queen, this body d* mine, every¬ thing is subservient to you. What is die greatest thing that you desire?
verses.hindi: तपस्तेपे संयतात्मा शिवमुद्दिश्य तद्विधम्॥ ६५ करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसाद्य गिरीशं तं तदाज्ञप्ताः सुरासुराः । बलादुत्पाटयामासुर्नेतुकामाः पयोऽर्णवम्
verses.transliteration: suprasAdya girIshaM taM tadAj~naptAH surAsurAH | balAdutpATayAmAsurnetukAmAH payo.arNavam
verses.translation: What can a blind man do with a mirror? Of what avail is a house to him who lives on alms? WThat can a fool do with a book? Of what avail is wealth to him who is bereft of his wife?
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे ठ॒ृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां किराताववारवर्णनप्रसंगेठ जुनितपोवर्णन नामाष्यविंशेठ ध्यायः

verses.sanskrit: भुजैरुत्पाट्य ते सर्वे जग्मुः क्षीरार्णवं मुने । अशक्ता अभवंस्तत्र तमानेतुं हतौजसः
verses.transliteration: bhujairutpATya te sarve jagmuH kShIrArNavaM mune | ashaktA abhavaMstatra tamAnetuM hataujasaH
verses.translation: Hence 1 who am not satiated with the enjoyment of pleasures but I whose wife is snatched away desire your crowned queen. Let her be given to me.
verses.hindi: अर्जुनका तपवर्णन नामक अड़तीसवो अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तद्भुजैः स परिभ्रष्टः पतितो मन्दरो गिरिः । सहसातिगुरुः सद्यो देवदैत्योपरि ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tadbhujaiH sa paribhraShTaH patito mandaro giriH | sahasAtiguruH sadyo devadaityopari dhruvam
verses.translation: I can give all my assets to the extent of the earth, my kingdom, horses and elephants and even my body to any¬ one but never can I give away my wife.
verses.hindi: करके उत्तम भक्तिसे शिवका ध्यान करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: एवं भग्नोद्यमा भग्नाः सम्बभूवुः सुरासुराः । चेतनाः प्राप्य च ततस्तुष्टुवुर्जगदीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evaM bhagnodyamA bhagnAH sambabhUvuH surAsurAH | chetanAH prApya cha tatastuShTuvurjagadIshvaram
verses.translation: Let it be the terrible sin of the slaughter of a brahmin; let it be the sin of sipping wine, I shall quell it with my power of penance. What then the sin of enjoying another man's wife?

verses.sanskrit: तदिच्छयोद्यताः सर्वे पुनरुत्थाप्य तं गिरिम् । निचिक्षिपुर्जले नीत्वा क्षीरोदस्योत्तरे तटे
verses.transliteration: tadichChayodyatAH sarve punarutthApya taM girim | nichikShipurjale nItvA kShIrodasyottare taTe
verses.translation: Hence give me your wife. I have no otfier desire. Certainly you will go to hell by your inability to protect the oppressed.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरासुरगणा रज्जुं कृत्वा च वासुकिम् । रत्नान्यादातुकामास्ते ममन्थुः क्षीरसागरम्
verses.transliteration: tataH surAsuragaNA rajjuM kR^itvA cha vAsukim | ratnAnyAdAtukAmAste mamanthuH kShIrasAgaram
verses.translation: At the words of the brahmin, the frightened king
verses.hindi: लौटकर वे अपने-अपने स्थानको चले गये

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदे मथ्यमाने तु श्रीः स्वर्लोकमहेश्वरी । समुद्भूता समुद्राच्च भृगुपुत्री हरिप्रिया
verses.transliteration: kShIrode mathyamAne tu shrIH svarlokamaheshvarI | samudbhUtA samudrAchcha bhR^iguputrI haripriyA
verses.translation: Hence I shall give my wife to this deserving brail* min and escape sin. Immediately thereafter I shall enter fire. My fame then shall be known."

verses.sanskrit: धन्वन्तरिः शशाङ्कश्च पारिजातो महाद्रुमः । उच्चैःश्रवाश्च तुरगो गज ऐरावतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: dhanvantariH shashA~Nkashcha pArijAto mahAdrumaH | uchchaiHshravAshcha turago gaja airAvatastathA
verses.translation: After deciding mentally like this, he kindled a blaz¬ ing fire. He called the brahmin and gifted away his Wifb with water.

verses.sanskrit: सुरा हरिधनुः शङ्खो गावः कामदुघास्ततः । कौस्तुभाख्यो मणिश्चैव तथा पीयूषमेव च
verses.transliteration: surA haridhanuH sha~Nkho gAvaH kAmadughAstataH | kaustubhAkhyo maNishchaiva tathA pIyUShameva cha
verses.translation: He took the ceremonial bath and became pure. He bowed to gods went round die fire thrice and meditated on iSiva with pure mind.

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च मथ्यमाने तु कालकूटं महाविषम् । युगान्तानलभं जातं सुरासुरभयावहम्
verses.transliteration: punashcha mathyamAne tu kAlakUTaM mahAviSham | yugAntAnalabhaM jAtaM surAsurabhayAvaham
verses.translation: The king saw in front of him the five-faced, the three-eyed lord with die Pinaka in his hand, bedecked by the digit of the moon, with hanging matted hair shed¬ ding tawny lustre, having the brilliance of a crore of mid¬ day blazing suns, white as the lotus stalk fibre, wearing the hide of the elephant, with his head drenched by the waves of Ganga, having the necklaces of great serpents, bedecked in coronet, waistband, shoulderlet and shining bangles, holding in his hands, the trident, the sword, the missile Khatvanga, the dagger, the shield, the deer, the mystic sign of protection, the eight articles of worship and the Pinaka, seated on his bull and blue-necked.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा देवासुराः सर्वे जरामृत्युभयार्दिताः । परस्परं च सन्धाय रत्नान्यादित्सवोऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: purA devAsurAH sarve jarAmR^ityubhayArditAH | parasparaM cha sandhAya ratnAnyAditsavo.abhavan
verses.translation: Then from the sky divine showers of flowers fell. The divine instruments were played. The celestial damsels sang and danced.

verses.sanskrit: पीयूषजन्मकाले तु बिन्दवो ये बहिर्गताः । तेभ्यः कान्ताः समुद्भूता बह्वयो ह्यद्भुतदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: pIyUShajanmakAle tu bindavo ye bahirgatAH | tebhyaH kAntAH samudbhUtA bahvayo hyadbhutadarshanAH
verses.translation: Vinu, Brahma, Indra and other gods excluding Nfirada and other sages too came there eulogising.
verses.hindi: वे सभी उन शब्दोंसे व्याकुल हो उठे

verses.sanskrit: शरत्पूर्णेन्दुवदनास्तडित्सूर्यानलप्रभाः । हारकेयूरकटकैर्दिव्यरत्नैरलङ्कृताः
verses.transliteration: sharatpUrNenduvadanAstaDitsUryAnalaprabhAH | hArakeyUrakaTakairdivyaratnairala~NkR^itAH
verses.translation: The vision of the lord increased his pleasure. The incessant tear-drops smeared his body. He had horripilation and choked throat. With palms joined in reverence, he eulo¬ gised the lord.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले तथा सुख देनेवाले कहे गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: लावण्यामृततोयेन ताः सिञ्चन्त्यो दिशो दश । जगदुन्मादयन्त्येव भ्रूभङ्गायतवीक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: lAvaNyAmR^itatoyena tAH si~nchantyo disho dasha | jagadunmAdayantyeva bhrUbha~NgAyatavIkShaNAH
verses.translation: The supreme lord, the storehouse of mercy and

verses.sanskrit: कोटिशस्ताः समुत्पन्नास्त्वमृतात्कामनिस्सृताः । ततोऽमृतं समुत्पन्नं जरामृत्युनिवारणम्
verses.transliteration: koTishastAH samutpannAstvamR^itAtkAmanissR^itAH | tato.amR^itaM samutpannaM jarAmR^ityunivAraNam
verses.translation: **0 king, I am satisfied with your devotion more than your piety. Mention the boon that you as well as your wife wbh to choose. I shall undoubtedly give it to you.

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीं शङ्खं कौस्तुभं च खड्गं जग्राह केशवः । जग्राहार्को हयं दिव्यमुच्चैःश्रवसमादरात्
verses.transliteration: lakShmIM sha~NkhaM kaustubhaM cha khaDgaM jagrAha keshavaH | jagrAhArko hayaM divyamuchchaiHshravasamAdarAt
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the lord> the king Bhadrayu eulogised and bowed to the lord with bent head.
verses.hindi: प्रणनाम शिवं भूयस्तुष्टाव च पुनः पुनः॥ ५३  बार-बार उनकी स्तुति की

verses.sanskrit: पारिजातं तरुवरमैरावतमिभेश्वरम् । शचीपतिश्च जग्राह निर्जरेशो महादरात्
verses.transliteration: pArijAtaM taruvaramairAvatamibheshvaram | shachIpatishcha jagrAha nirjaresho mahAdarAt
verses.translation: O lord, since out of pity you wbh to accord me a boon, I choose it as a great devotee'* does from his lord, the granter of boons.

verses.sanskrit: कालकूटं शशाङ्कं च देवत्राणाय शङ्करः । स्वकण्ठे धृतवान् शम्भुः स्वेच्छया भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: kAlakUTaM shashA~NkaM cha devatrANAya sha~NkaraH | svakaNThe dhR^itavAn shambhuH svechChayA bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: O great god, my fiither Vajrabfihu with his wife, O lord, 1 a servant at your feet, along with my wife, the VaiSya Padmikara and his son Sanaya, O great lord, make all of us residents near you.
verses.hindi: मूकहैत्यवध नामक उनतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: दैत्याः सुराख्यां रमणीमीश्वराजविमोहिताः । जगृहुः सकला व्यास सर्वे धन्वन्तरिं जनाः
verses.transliteration: daityAH surAkhyAM ramaNImIshvarAjavimohitAH | jagR^ihuH sakalA vyAsa sarve dhanvantariM janAH
verses.translation: Then the queen, his wife, Kirtimalini propitiated Siva with devotion and requested for an excellent boon.
verses.hindi: उनकी दृढ़ भक्तिसे भरी हुई लीला सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: जगृहुर्मुनयः सर्वे कामधेनुं मुनीश्वराः । सामान्यतस्त्रियस्ताश्च स्थिता आसन्विमोहिकाः
verses.transliteration: jagR^ihurmunayaH sarve kAmadhenuM munIshvarAH | sAmAnyatastriyastAshcha sthitA AsanvimohikAH
verses.translation: O supreme God, Gandrahgada my father and Simantini my mother, I request the two to be joyously staying near you for ever.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतार्थं महायुद्धं सम्बभूव जयैषिणाम् । सुराणामसुराणां च मिथः सङ्क्षुब्धचेतसाम्
verses.transliteration: amR^itArthaM mahAyuddhaM sambabhUva jayaiShiNAm | surANAmasurANAM cha mithaH sa~NkShubdhachetasAm
verses.translation: The delighted lord of Gauri, favourably disposed to his devotees said—**Let it be so'* and granted them the boon they desired and then vanished in a moment.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरासुराः सर्वे क्षीरोदं सागरोत्तमम् । उद्यता मथितुं तं च बभूवुर्मुनिनन्दन
verses.transliteration: tataH surAsurAH sarve kShIrodaM sAgarottamam | udyatA mathituM taM cha babhUvurmuninandana
verses.translation: Read ITRff for i** die printed Skt. text.
verses.hindi: है ? तुम मुझ सेनापतिको यहाँ अकेला मत समझो

verses.sanskrit: हृतं सोमं च दैतेयैर्बलाद्देवान्विजित्य च । बलिप्रभृतिभिर्व्यास युगान्ताग्न्यर्कसुप्रभैः
verses.transliteration: hR^itaM somaM cha daiteyairbalAddevAnvijitya cha | baliprabhR^itibhirvyAsa yugAntAgnyarkasuprabhaiH
verses.translation: Acquiring the grace of the trident-bearing lord, BhadrSyu, enjoyed several pleasures lovingly in the company of Kirtim&lin!.
verses.hindi: तुम्हें इस तपस्याका फल कैसे मिलेगा 2

verses.sanskrit: देवाः शङ्करमापन्ना विह्वलाः शिवमायया । सर्वे शक्रादयस्तात दैतेयैरर्दिता बलात्
verses.transliteration: devAH sha~NkaramApannA vihvalAH shivamAyayA | sarve shakrAdayastAta daiteyairarditA balAt
verses.translation: Unimpeded in the exercise of his power he ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years. Then he entrusted his son with the kingdom and went to l§iva*s presence.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारी यह तपस्या अशुभ करनेवाली है

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तदमृतं यत्नात्स्त्रीस्वरूपेण मायया । शिवाज्ञया रमेशेन दैत्येभ्यश्च हृतं मुने
verses.transliteration: tatastadamR^itaM yatnAtstrIsvarUpeNa mAyayA | shivAj~nayA rameshena daityebhyashcha hR^itaM mune
verses.translation: The king GandrShgada and the queen Simantinl devoutly worshipped liva and attained his feet.

verses.sanskrit: अपाययत्सुरांस्तांश्च मोहिनी स्त्रीस्वरूपधृक् । मोहयित्वासुरान्सर्वान्हरिर्मायाविनां वरः
verses.transliteration: apAyayatsurAMstAMshcha mohinI strIsvarUpadhR^ik | mohayitvAsurAnsarvAnharirmAyAvinAM varaH
verses.translation: ' Thus the great incarnation of lord Siva as Dvi- jelvara has been described by me. It was the bestower of great bliss on Bhadrayu.
verses.hindi: करते हुए मर्यादित वाक्य कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा निकटमेतस्या ऊचिरे दैत्यपुङ्गवाः । पाययस्व सुधामेतां माभूद्भेदोऽत्र पङ्क्तिषु
verses.transliteration: gatvA nikaTametasyA Uchire daityapu~NgavAH | pAyayasva sudhAmetAM mAbhUdbhedo.atra pa~NktiShu
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this holy narrative of Dvijea incarnation of Siva of pious fame, goes to Siva's region.
verses.hindi: तुम हो, मैं उसे अच्छी तरह जानता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: एतदुक्त्वा ददुस्तस्मै विष्णवे छलरूपिणे । ते दैत्या दानवाः सर्वे शिवमायाविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: etaduktvA dadustasmai viShNave ChalarUpiNe | te daityA dAnavAH sarve shivamAyAvimohitAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this every day or narrates this with attentive mind does not swerve from his duty and attains salvation hereafter.
verses.hindi: करे अथवा माँगनेपर न दे, तो कैसा राजा 2

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दृष्ट्वा स्त्रियो दानवपुङ्गवाः । अनयन्नमृतोद्भूता यथास्थानं यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare dR^iShTvA striyo dAnavapu~NgavAH | anayannamR^itodbhUtA yathAsthAnaM yathAsukham
verses.translation: O intelligent sage, listen. 1 shall explain the in¬ carnation of great bliss named YatinStha, of Siva the supreme soul.
verses.hindi: अपेक्षा है तो वह आकर मुझसे क्यों नहीं माँगता ?

verses.sanskrit: तासां पुराणि दिव्यानि स्वर्गाच्छतगुणान्यपि । घोरैर्यन्त्रैः सुगुप्तानि मयमायाकृतानि च
verses.transliteration: tAsAM purANi divyAni svargAchChataguNAnyapi | ghorairyantraiH suguptAni mayamAyAkR^itAni cha
verses.translation: O great sage, on the mountain Arbuda* there lived a hunter Ahuka of BhUla tribe.

verses.sanskrit: सुरक्षितानि सर्वाणि कृत्वा युद्धाय निर्ययुः । अस्पृष्टवक्षसो दैत्याः कृत्वा समयमेव हि
verses.transliteration: surakShitAni sarvANi kR^itvA yuddhAya niryayuH | aspR^iShTavakShaso daityAH kR^itvA samayameva hi
verses.translation: His wife Ahuki observed some good rites. Both of them were great devotees of Siva and worshipped Siva.
verses.hindi: है नन्‍्दी-श्चर कक ॥ ३०  सुखपूर्वक रहो, अन्यथा कष्ट प्राप्त करोगे

verses.sanskrit: न स्पृशामः स्त्रियश्चेमा यदि देवैर्विनिर्जिताः । इत्युक्त्वा ते महावीरा दैत्याः सर्वे युयुत्सवः
verses.transliteration: na spR^ishAmaH striyashchemA yadi devairvinirjitAH | ityuktvA te mahAvIrA daityAH sarve yuyutsavaH
verses.translation: In. the meantime towards the evening, Siva assumed the ((uise of an ascetic and came to his house to test hiy"
verses.hindi: गणेन पाण्डवस्तं हि है च शहड्डूरम्॥ ३१  स्मरण करते हुए उस भीलसे कहा--

verses.sanskrit: आसन् शुचिस्मिताः सर्वे केनेदं मन्थनं भवेत् । स्वकार्यसिद्धये तस्य ब्रह्मन्निति सुरासुराः
verses.transliteration: Asan shuchismitAH sarve kenedaM manthanaM bhavet | svakAryasiddhaye tasya brahmanniti surAsurAH
verses.translation: It can be identified with the ))resent Abu, a lacred hill of the Western India, lying in the Sirohi state of Rajijutana.
verses.hindi: आयेगा, तब मैं उसको इसका फल दिखाऊँगा

verses.sanskrit: सिंहनादं ततश्चक्रुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक् । पूरयन्त इवाकाशं तर्पयन्तो बलाहकान्
verses.transliteration: siMhanAdaM tatashchakruH sha~NkhAndadhmuH pR^ithakpR^ithak | pUrayanta ivAkAshaM tarpayanto balAhakAn
verses.translation: The lord of the house that intelligent man too came back then and lovingly worshipped the leading stscetic.
verses.hindi: और गीदड़का युद्ध उपहासास्पद होता है

verses.sanskrit: युद्धं बभूव देवानामसुरैः सह भीकरम् । देवासुराख्यमतुलं प्रसिद्धं भुवनत्रये
verses.transliteration: yuddhaM babhUva devAnAmasuraiH saha bhIkaram | devAsurAkhyamatulaM prasiddhaM bhuvanatraye
verses.translation: In order to test his feelings, 8iva in the guise of an ascetic, indulging in great sports lovingly said to him in a piteous tone.
verses.hindi: जाओ और जैसी तुम्हारी इच्छा हो, वैसा करो

verses.sanskrit: जयं प्रापुः सुराः सर्वे विष्णुना परिरक्षिताः । दैत्याः पलायितास्तत्र हताः सामरविष्णुना
verses.transliteration: jayaM prApuH surAH sarve viShNunA parirakShitAH | daityAH palAyitAstatra hatAH sAmaraviShNunA
verses.translation: O Bhilla, give me some place here to stay today. I shall by all means leave in the next morning, you will be blessed for ever.
verses.hindi: साथ जहाँ अर्जुन थे, वहाँ आये

verses.sanskrit: दैत्याः सम्मोहिता देवैर्विष्णुना च महात्मना । हतावशिष्टाः पातालं विविशुर्विवराणि च
verses.transliteration: daityAH sammohitA devairviShNunA cha mahAtmanA | hatAvashiShTAH pAtAlaM vivishurvivarANi cha
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the ascetic wanted to leave. By that time, considering the trend of thought of her husband the Bhilli said.
verses.hindi: देखकर धनुष-बाण लेकर सामने आ गये

verses.sanskrit: अनुवव्राज तान्विष्णुश्चक्रपाणिर्महाबलः । पातालं परमं गत्वा संस्थितान्भीतभीतवत्
verses.transliteration: anuvavrAja tAnviShNushchakrapANirmahAbalaH | pAtAlaM paramaM gatvA saMsthitAnbhItabhItavat
verses.translation: O lord, give him room to stay. Do not turn out a guest. Consider the duty of a householder or virtue will be affected.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुर्ददर्शामृतसम्भवाः । कान्ताः पूर्णेन्दुवदना दिव्यलावण्यगर्विताः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare viShNurdadarshAmR^itasambhavAH | kAntAH pUrNenduvadanA divyalAvaNyagarvitAH
verses.translation: You stay in the house along with the ascetic. I shall remain outside with immense weapons.
verses.hindi: कार्यके लिये इस समय क्यों मरना चाहते हो 2

verses.sanskrit: सम्मोहितः कामबाणैर्लेभे तत्रैव निर्वृतिम् । ताभिश्च वरनारीभिः क्रीडमानो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: sammohitaH kAmabANairlebhe tatraiva nirvR^itim | tAbhishcha varanArIbhiH krIDamAno babhUva ha
verses.translation: On hearing the virtuous and auspicious words of his wife, the Bhilla thought thus.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारे हाथसे आज पृथ्वी भी चली जायगी

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यः पुत्रानजनयद्विष्णुर्वरपराक्रमान् । महीं सर्वां कम्पयन्तो नानायुद्धविशारदान्
verses.transliteration: tAbhyaH putrAnajanayadviShNurvaraparAkramAn | mahIM sarvAM kampayanto nAnAyuddhavishAradAn
verses.translation: *'How can I stay in the house after keeping my wife out. It will be sinful on my part if the ascetic goes elsewhere.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वै हरिपुत्रास्ते महाबलपराक्रमाः । महोपद्रवमाचेरुः स्वर्गे भुवि च दुःखदम्
verses.transliteration: tato vai hariputrAste mahAbalaparAkramAH | mahopadravamAcheruH svarge bhuvi cha duHkhadam
verses.translation: After thinking thus and insisting on it, he kept both of them within the house joyously, himself stayed out¬ side the house keeping all the weapons beside him.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीजिवमहाएुराणे ततीयायां शतर्रसंहितायां किरातावतारवर्णने भिल्‍्लाजुनसंवादों नाम चत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: लोकोपद्रवमालक्ष्य निर्जरा मुनयोऽथ वै । चक्रुर्निवेदननं तेषां ब्रह्मणे प्रणिपत्य च
verses.transliteration: lokopadravamAlakShya nirjarA munayo.atha vai | chakrurnivedananaM teShAM brahmaNe praNipatya cha
verses.translation: During the night the cruel beasts of prey tormen¬ ted him- He too strenuously withstood them to the extent of his ability.
verses.hindi: भील-अर्जुन-संवाद नामक चालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तदा नभोगता वाणी मेघगम्भीरनिःस्वना । उवाच देवान्दैत्यांश्चश्वासयन्तीश्वराज्ञया
verses.transliteration: tadA nabhogatA vANI meghagambhIraniHsvanA | uvAcha devAndaityAMshchashvAsayantIshvarAj~nayA
verses.translation: Thus fighting strenuously and although very strox, the Bhilla was devoured the bts of prey wfaioh seized him forcibly, as dioiigh indted by his own adverse fate.
verses.hindi: कर दिया; केवल उनका शरीर शेष रह गया

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वादाय तान्ब्रह्मा ययौ कैलासपर्वतम् । तत्र दृष्ट्वा शिवं देवं प्रणनाम पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvAdAya tAnbrahmA yayau kailAsaparvatam | tatra dR^iShTvA shivaM devaM praNanAma punaH punaH
verses.translation: Getting up in the morning the ascetic saw the Bhilla of the forest devoured by the beasts of prey. He fislt much dejected at it.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टाव विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः । जय देव महादेव सर्वस्वामिन्निति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tuShTAva vividhaiH stotrairnataskandhaH kR^itA~njaliH | jaya deva mahAdeva sarvasvAminniti bruvan
verses.translation: O ascetic, why are you sorry? What has happened is for good. Blessed and contented is he since the death has happened in this manner.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । देवदेव महादेव लोकान् रक्षाखिलान्प्रभो । उपद्रुतान्विष्णुपुत्रैः पातालस्थैर्विकारिभिः
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | devadeva mahAdeva lokAn rakShAkhilAnprabho | upadrutAnviShNuputraiH pAtAlasthairvikAribhiH
verses.translation: O ascetic, reducing myself to ashes, I too shall follow him. Be pleased to arrange for the pyre. This is the eternal duty of women.

verses.sanskrit: नारीष्वमृतभूतासु संसक्तात्मा हरिर्विभो । पाताले तिष्ठतीदानीं रमते हि विकारवान्
verses.transliteration: nArIShvamR^itabhUtAsu saMsaktAtmA harirvibho | pAtAle tiShThatIdAnIM ramate hi vikAravAn
verses.translation: On hearing her words which he thought to be proper, the ascetic arranged the pyre. She entered the pyre dutifully.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थं बहुस्तुतः शम्भुर्ब्रह्मणा सर्षिनिर्जरैः । लोकसंरक्षणार्थाय विष्णोरानयनाय च
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | itthaM bahustutaH shambhurbrahmaNA sarShinirjaraiH | lokasaMrakShaNArthAya viShNorAnayanAya cha
verses.translation: In the meantime 8iva himself appeared before her and >oke praising her lovingly blessed lady, O blessed lady.'*

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् शम्भुः कृपासिन्धुर्महेश्वरः । तदुपद्रवमाज्ञाय वृषरूपो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: tataH sa bhagavAn shambhuH kR^ipAsindhurmaheshvaraH | tadupadravamAj~nAya vR^iSharUpo babhUva ha
verses.translation: O sinless lady, mention the boon you wish to have. I am pleased with your conduct. There is nothing which cannot be granted to you. 1 am utterly subservient to you.

verses.sanskrit: नभोवाण्युवाच । हे देवा असुराश्चैव मन्थध्वं क्षीरसागरम् । भवतां बलबुद्धिर्हि भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: nabhovANyuvAcha | he devA asurAshchaiva manthadhvaM kShIrasAgaram | bhavatAM balabuddhirhi bhaviShyati na saMshayaH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Siva yielding the greatest bliss she felt the highest pleasure. She did not remember any¬ thing.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दरं चैव मन्थानं रज्जुं कुरुत वासुकिम् । मिथः सर्वे मिलित्वा तु मन्थनं कुरुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: mandaraM chaiva manthAnaM rajjuM kuruta vAsukim | mithaH sarve militvA tu manthanaM kurutAdarAt
verses.translation: This Bhilla will be born as Nala, the son of Vira- sena> in the excellent city of Niadha.* There is no doubt in this.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । नभोगतां तदा वाणीं निशम्याथ सुरासुराः । उद्योगं चक्रिरे सर्वे तत्कर्तुं मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | nabhogatAM tadA vANIM nishamyAtha surAsurAH | udyogaM chakrire sarve tatkartuM munisattama
verses.translation: you will be born in the illustrious city of Vidarbha'* as the daughter of king Bhima. You will be famous as Dama- yanti endowed with all good qualities.

verses.sanskrit: सुसन्धायाखिलास्ते वै मन्दरं पर्वतोत्तमम् । कनकाभं च सरलं नानाशोभार्चितं ययुः
verses.transliteration: susandhAyAkhilAste vai mandaraM parvatottamam | kanakAbhaM cha saralaM nAnAshobhArchitaM yayuH
verses.translation: After coming together you will enjoy royal plea¬ sures. You will attain salvation too, inaccessible even to leading Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The incarnation of Siva as the swan adept in the art of intelligence, was the bestower of great bliss to Dama¬ yanti as well as to Nala.
verses.hindi: माँगो, मैं तुम्हें वह सब कुछ दूँगा

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The incarnation of Siva as the swan adept in the art of intelligence, was the bestower of great bliss to Dama¬ yanti as well as to Nala.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२३. त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः । वृषेश्वरसंज्ञकशिवावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । ततो वृषभरूपेण गर्जमानः पिनाकधृक् । प्रविष्टो विवरं तत्र निनदन्भैरवान् रवान्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.23\. trayoviMsho.adhyAyaH | vR^iSheshvarasa.nj~nakashivAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | tato vR^iShabharUpeNa garjamAnaH pinAkadhR^ik | praviShTo vivaraM tatra ninadanbhairavAn ravAn
verses.translation: This great and holy narrative of Siva's incarnation of illustrious fame as swan is wonderful and indeed the bes¬ tower of sidvation

verses.sanskrit: अथ कृत्वा महाकोपं वृषात्मा स महेश्वरः । विननाद महाघोरं कम्पयंस्त्रिजगन्मुने
verses.transliteration: atha kR^itvA mahAkopaM vR^iShAtmA sa maheshvaraH | vinanAda mahAghoraM kampayaMstrijaganmune
verses.translation: He who narrates or listens to the auspicious story of incarnation of Yatinatha hariisa, attains the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: स बै ममात्मभूतश्र मद्धक्त: कार्यकारक:॥ ५७  हैं

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्प्लुत्य तरसा खुरैः शृङ्गैर्व्यदारयत् । विष्णुं क्रोधाकुलं मूढमजानन्तं निजं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: tata utplutya tarasA khuraiH shR^i~NgairvyadArayat | viShNuM krodhAkulaM mUDhamajAnantaM nijaM harim
verses.translation: The city of Nidha or Naiadha associated with King Nala can be identified with Nalapura, modern Narwar situated on the river KSlisindhu to the south-west of Gwalior.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स शिथिलात्मा हि व्यथिताङ्गो बभूव ह । तत्प्रहारमसह्याशु हरिर्मायाविमोहितः
verses.transliteration: tataH sa shithilAtmA hi vyathitA~Ngo babhUva ha | tatprahAramasahyAshu harirmAyAvimohitaH
verses.translation: After hearing this narrative of Siva in the forms of an ascetic and a swan, the hearer enjoys all pleasures here and goes to Siva*» abode hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: गतगर्वो हरिश्चैव विचेता गतचेतनः । ज्ञातवान् परमेशानं विहरन्तं वृषात्मना
verses.transliteration: gatagarvo harishchaiva vichetA gatachetanaH | j~nAtavAn parameshAnaM viharantaM vR^iShAtmanA
verses.translation: O Sanatkumara, listen lo the description of the great incarnation of Siva, the excellent Krsnadarana who gave perfect wisdom to Nabhaga.

verses.sanskrit: अथ विज्ञाय गौरीशमागतं वृषरूपतः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: atha vij~nAya gaurIshamAgataM vR^iSharUpataH | prAha gambhIrayA vAchA nataskandhaH kR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: Iksvaku and others were the sons of Sraddhadeva' of whom Nabhaga, was the ninth. His son was Nabhaga.
verses.hindi: भी उस वृत्तान्त-श्रवणसे तृप्त नहीं हुए

verses.sanskrit: हरिरुवाच । देवदेव महादेव करुणासागर प्रभो । मायया ते महेशान मोहितोऽहं विमूढधीः
verses.transliteration: hariruvAcha | devadeva mahAdeva karuNAsAgara prabho | mAyayA te maheshAna mohito.ahaM vimUDhadhIH
verses.translation: Nabhaga the son of Manu, highly intelligent, and with perfect control of his sense-organs stayed in the abode of his preceptors for studies for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं युद्धं त्वयेशेन स्वनाथेन मया प्रभो । कृपां कृत्वा मयि स्वामिन्सोऽपराधो हि सह्यताम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itaM yuddhaM tvayeshena svanAthena mayA prabho | kR^ipAM kR^itvA mayi svAminso.aparAdho hi sahyatAm
verses.translation: During this interval Iksvaku and other sons had their due shares in the property without leaving any share for Nabhaga.
verses.hindi: जानकर हर्षित हुए और कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हरेर्दीनतया मुने । भगवान् शङ्करः प्राह रमेशं भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA harerdInatayA mune | bhagavAn sha~NkaraH prAha rameshaM bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: At the behest of their father, the shrewd sons took their shares and enjoyed the kingdom with out any misery. They were fortunate.

verses.sanskrit: हे विष्णो हे महाबुद्धे कथं मां ज्ञातवान्न हि । युद्धं कृतं कृतस्तेऽद्य ज्ञानं सर्वं च विस्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: he viShNo he mahAbuddhe kathaM mAM j~nAtavAnna hi | yuddhaM kR^itaM kR^itaste.adya j~nAnaM sarvaM cha vismR^itam
verses.translation: According to this PurSoa, Sraddhadeva had several sons, Ik|v&ku and others, of whom Nabhaga was the ninth. Nabhaga had a son named Nabhaga. The latter had a son named Ambarifa. Pargiter omits Sr&dd- badeva and Nabhaga and mentions NabhSga instead of Nftbhaga as the father of Ambarifa.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं किन्न जानासि मदधीनपराक्रमम् । त्वया नात्र रतिः कार्या निवर्तस्व कुचारतः
verses.transliteration: AtmAnaM kinna jAnAsi madadhInaparAkramam | tvayA nAtra ratiH kAryA nivartasva kuchArataH
verses.translation: After learning the Vedas with their sections and sub-sections, in due course, the Brahmacarin Nabhga returned.
verses.hindi: दर्शन तथा स्पर्शसे पुरुषोंका कल्याण करनेवाले हैं
