verses.sanskrit: निपेतुस्तस्य निनदैः पुराणि नगराणि च । प्रकम्पो हि बभूवाथ सर्वेषां पुरवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: nipetustasya ninadaiH purANi nagarANi cha | prakampo hi babhUvAtha sarveShAM puravAsinAm
verses.translation: O sage, on seeing his brothers Ik$vaku and others having taken their shares, Nabhaga desirous of his share told them affectionately.

verses.sanskrit: कामाधीनं कथं ज्ञानं स्त्रीषु सक्तो विहारकृत् । नोचितं तव देवेश स्मरणं विश्वतारणम्
verses.transliteration: kAmAdhInaM kathaM j~nAnaM strIShu sakto vihArakR^it | nochitaM tava devesha smaraNaM vishvatAraNam
verses.translation: O my brothers you have taken your shares duly without leaving anything for me. I have now come for my share. Please give me mine.
verses.hindi: सभी प्रकारके रोगोंसे छुटकारा पा जाता है

verses.sanskrit: तच्छुत्वा शम्भुवचनं विज्ञानप्रदमादरात् । व्रीड्यन्स्वमनसा विष्णुः प्राह वाचं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tachChutvA shambhuvachanaM vij~nAnapradamAdarAt | vrIDyansvamanasA viShNuH prAha vAchaM maheshvaram
verses.translation: Then we had forgotten to allow your share. We shall certainly do it now. Our father is your share. Take him.
verses.hindi: भोग तथा मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । ममात्र विद्यते चक्रं तद् गृहीत्वेतदादरात् । गमिष्यामि स्वलोकं तं त्वदाज्ञापरिपालकः
verses.transliteration: viShNuruvAcha | mamAtra vidyate chakraM tad gR^ihItvetadAdarAt | gamiShyAmi svalokaM taM tvadAj~nAparipAlakaH
verses.translation: On bearing the words of his brothers Nabhaga was surprised. He approached his father and said.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य महेशानो वचनं वैष्णवं हरः । प्रत्युवाच वृषात्मा हि वृषरक्षः पुनर्हरिम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tadAkarNya maheshAno vachanaM vaiShNavaM haraH | pratyuvAcha vR^iShAtmA hi vR^iSharakShaH punarharim
verses.translation: O father, my brothers have taken their shares leaving me out. I had been to the preceptor's abode for study as a student.

verses.sanskrit: न विलम्बः प्रकर्त्तव्यो गन्तव्यमित आशु ते । मच्छासनाद्धरे लोके चक्रमत्रैव तिष्ठताम्
verses.transliteration: na vilambaH prakarttavyo gantavyamita Ashu te | machChAsanAddhare loke chakramatraiva tiShThatAm
verses.translation: When I returned I asked them to allot my share; they replied that you are my share. I have now come for that purpose.
verses.hindi: है, जो भक्तोंको इच्छित फल देनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: सन्तानादित्यसंस्थानाच्छिवत्ववचनादपि । अहं घोरतरं तस्माच्चक्रमन्यद्ददामि ते
verses.transliteration: santAnAdityasaMsthAnAchChivatvavachanAdapi | ahaM ghorataraM tasmAchchakramanyaddadAmi te
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing his words, his father 8raddha- deva was surprised. He consoled his son who was devoted to truth and virtue.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण करनेवाले वे महादेव आविर्भूत हुए

verses.sanskrit: एतदुक्त्वा हरोऽलेखीद्दिव्यं कालानलप्रभम् । परं चक्रं प्रदीप्तं हि सर्वदुष्टविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: etaduktvA haro.alekhIddivyaM kAlAnalaprabham | paraM chakraM pradIptaM hi sarvaduShTavinAshanam
verses.translation: O dear, do not pay heed to what they said. It was only to deceive you. I am not a share by any means, an instrument Of enjoyment.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णवे प्रददौ चक्रं घोरार्कायुतसुप्रभम् । सर्वामरमुनीन्द्राणां रक्षकाय महात्मने
verses.transliteration: viShNave pradadau chakraM ghorArkAyutasuprabham | sarvAmaramunIndrANAM rakShakAya mahAtmane
verses.translation: Still since I have been given as a share by the deceitful persons I shall tell you the means of livelihood. Hear attentively.

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा सुदर्शनं चान्यञ्चक्रं परमदीप्तिमत् । उवाच विबुधांस्तत्र विष्णुर्बुद्धिमतां वरः
verses.transliteration: labdhvA sudarshanaM chAnya~nchakraM paramadIptimat | uvAcha vibudhAMstatra viShNurbuddhimatAM varaH
verses.translation: The intelligent Ahgirasa brahmins are performing a sacrifice. Every sixth day the rites are marred.
verses.hindi: अर्चनसे भक्तोंके मनोरथोंको पूर्ण करनेवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेववरा यूयं मद्वाक्यं शृणुतादरात् । कर्तव्यं तत्तथा शीघ्रं ततः शं वो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: sarvadevavarA yUyaM madvAkyaM shR^iNutAdarAt | kartavyaM tattathA shIghraM tataH shaM vo bhaviShyati
verses.translation: O wise Nabhaga, you go there and praise them.
verses.hindi: सुदक्षिण नामक भक्त राजाकी रक्षा की थी

verses.sanskrit: ततो वृषो हरेः पुत्रान्सङ्ग्रामोद्यतकार्मुकान् । शिवमायाविमूढात्ममहाबलपराक्रमान्
verses.transliteration: tato vR^iSho hareH putrAnsa~NgrAmodyatakArmukAn | shivamAyAvimUDhAtmamahAbalaparAkramAn
verses.translation: On hearing the words of his father, Nabhaga who considered truth as virtue went eagerly where the excellent sacrifice was on.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्या वराङ्गनास्सन्ति पाताले यौवनान्विताः । ताभिः सार्द्धं महाक्रीडां यः करोतु करोतु सः
verses.transliteration: divyA varA~NganAssanti pAtAle yauvanAnvitAH | tAbhiH sArddhaM mahAkrIDAM yaH karotu karotu saH
verses.translation: O sage, in that sacrifice during the diurnal rites the intelligent son of Manu recited two Vaivadeva suktas clearly.
verses.hindi: है एवं भोग तथा मोक्षको देनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: तच्छुत्वा केशवाद्वाक्यं शूरास्त्रिदशयोनयः । प्रवेष्टुकामाः पातालं बभूवुर्विष्णुना सह
verses.transliteration: tachChutvA keshavAdvAkyaM shUrAstridashayonayaH | praveShTukAmAH pAtAlaM babhUvurviShNunA saha
verses.translation: Lord Siva desirous of testing Nabhaga the son of Manu approached from north and said.
verses.hindi: इनकी नित्य ही पूजा करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: विचारमथ विज्ञाय तं तदा भगवान्हरः । क्रोधाच्छापं ददौ घोरं देवयोन्यष्टकस्य च
verses.transliteration: vichAramatha vij~nAya taM tadA bhagavAnharaH | krodhAchChApaM dadau ghoraM devayonyaShTakasya cha
verses.translation: O man, who are you that take away my assets and wealth? Who has sent you here? Tell me the whole truth.
verses.hindi: मुमुक्षुओंको वहाँपर मुक्ति प्रदान कर रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: हर उवाच । वर्जयित्वा मुनिं शान्तं दानवान्वा मदंशजम् । इदं यः प्रविशेत्स्थानं तस्य स्यान्निधनं क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: hara uvAcha | varjayitvA muniM shAntaM dAnavAnvA madaMshajam | idaM yaH pravishetsthAnaM tasya syAnnidhanaM kShaNAt
verses.translation: On heaving his words, O dear, the poet Nabhaga, son of Manu humbly replied to the Puru§a Kr§nadarana.
verses.hindi: निर्लिप्त रहकर कैवल्यपदके भागी होते हैं

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाक्यमिदं घोरं मनुष्यहितवर्धनम् । प्रत्याख्यातास्तु रुद्रेण देवाः स्वगृहमाययुः
verses.transliteration: shrutvA vAkyamidaM ghoraM manuShyahitavardhanam | pratyAkhyAtAstu rudreNa devAH svagR^ihamAyayuH
verses.translation: This wealth of the sacrifice has been given to me by the sages. Why do you, O Kr...adarsana prevent me from taking it.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्त्रीलः परो विष्णुः शिवेन प्रतिशासितः । स्वर्लोकमगमद् व्यास स्वास्थ्यं प्राप जगच्च तत्
verses.transliteration: evaM strIlaH paro viShNuH shivena pratishAsitaH | svarlokamagamad vyAsa svAsthyaM prApa jagachcha tat
verses.translation: On hearing these truthful words uttered by Nabhaga, the delighted purusa KrnadarSana spoke.
verses.hindi: निश्चय ही यह भोग तथा मोक्ष देनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: वृषेश्वरोऽपि भगवान् शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । इत्थं कृत्वा देवकार्यं जगाम स्वगिरीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vR^iSheshvaro.api bhagavAn sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH | itthaM kR^itvA devakAryaM jagAma svagirIshvaram
verses.translation: O dear, in our dispute the ultimate authority is yoitf father. Go to him and ask him. What he says will be true and final.

verses.sanskrit: वृषेश्वरावतारस्तु वर्णितः शङ्करस्य च । विष्णुमोहहरः शर्वः त्रैलोक्यसुखकारकः
verses.transliteration: vR^iSheshvarAvatArastu varNitaH sha~Nkarasya cha | viShNumohaharaH sharvaH trailokyasukhakArakaH
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the wise Nabhaga son of Manu, approached his father anxiously, O sage, and asked him about what he said.
verses.hindi: यह रामचन्द्रके द्वारा स्थापित किया गया है

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रमिदमाख्यानं शत्रुबाधाहरं परम् । स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: pavitramidamAkhyAnaM shatrubAdhAharaM param | svargyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM bhuktimuktipradaM satAm
verses.translation: On hearing what his son said, Manu iSraddha- deva remembered the lotus-like fbet of Siva and afler re¬ collecting spoke to him.
verses.hindi: जानेपर उनको विजयका वरदान दिया था

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वै समाहितः । तथा पठिति यो हीदं पाठयेत् सुधियो नरान् । स भुक्त्वा सकलान् कामान् अन्ते मोक्षमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM shR^iNuyAdbhaktyA shrAvayedvai samAhitaH | tathA paThiti yo hIdaM pAThayet sudhiyo narAn | sa bhuktvA sakalAn kAmAn ante mokShamavApnuyAt
verses.translation: Undoubtedly lord Siva deserves everything. What then of the wealth left over in a sacrifice? More depends on the lord's wish.

verses.sanskrit: हरिपुत्रास्ततस्तेऽथ प्राकुप्यन्मुनिसत्तम । प्रदुद्रुवुः प्रगर्ज्योच्चैर्वीराः शङ्करसम्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: hariputrAstataste.atha prAkupyanmunisattama | pradudruvuH pragarjyochchairvIrAH sha~Nkarasammukham
verses.translation: O Nabhaga, the lord has come in that form in order to bless you. Go there. Propitiate him properly,

verses.sanskrit: आयातांस्तान्हरेः पुत्रान् रुद्रो वृषभरूपधृक् । प्राकुप्यद्विष्णुपुत्रांश्च खुरैः शृङ्गैर्व्यदारयत्
verses.transliteration: AyAtAMstAnhareH putrAn rudro vR^iShabharUpadhR^ik | prAkupyadviShNuputrAMshcha khuraiH shR^i~NgairvyadArayat
verses.translation: Request him to forgive your fault. Bow to him well and eulogise him. That Siva alone is the lord of all, the lord of sacrifice, the lord of everything.
verses.hindi: कराता है, वह जीवन्मुक्त हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: विदारिताङ्गा रुद्रेण सर्वे हरिसुताश्च ते । नष्टा द्रुतं सन्बभूवुर्गतप्राणा विचेतसः
verses.transliteration: vidAritA~NgA rudreNa sarve harisutAshcha te | naShTA drutaM sanbabhUvurgataprANA vichetasaH
verses.translation: Vinu, Brahma and other gods, Siddhas and the sages, O dear, arc competent in their respective duties only due to his blessings.

verses.sanskrit: हतेषु तेषु पुत्रेषु विष्णुर्बलवतां वरः । निष्क्रम्याथ प्रगर्ज्योच्चैर्ययौ शीघ्रं हरान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: hateShu teShu putreShu viShNurbalavatAM varaH | niShkramyAtha pragarjyochchairyayau shIghraM harAntikam
verses.translation: O foremost of my sons, go there quickly. Do not delay. Propitiate the great god, the lord of all by every means.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला तथा घुश्माको आनन्द देनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा रुद्रं प्रव्रजन्तं हतविष्णुसुतं वृषम् । शरैः सन्ताडयामास दिव्यैरस्त्रैश्च केशवः
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA rudraM pravrajantaM hataviShNusutaM vR^iSham | sharaiH santADayAmAsa divyairastraishcha keshavaH
verses.translation: After saying this, Manu Sraddhadeva, sent his son immediately to Siva. After approaching him and bowing to him with palms joined in reverence and head bent down, the delighted Nabhaga of great intellect spoke to him humbly.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रुद्धो महादेवो वृषरूपी मदाबलः । अस्त्राणि तानि विष्णोश्च जग्रास गिरिगोचरः
verses.transliteration: tataH kruddho mahAdevo vR^iSharUpI madAbalaH | astrANi tAni viShNoshcha jagrAsa girigocharaH
verses.translation: O lord, my father says that whatever there is in the three worlds is yours to be sure. What then, about the wealth left over in a sacrifice?
verses.hindi: भोगकर अन्तमें मुक्ति प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The pure-souled Sraddhadeva too with head bent
verses.hindi: और भोग तथा मोक्षको प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The pure-souled Sraddhadeva too with head bent

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२४. चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः । पिप्पलादावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । पिप्पलादाख्यमपरमवतारं महेशितुः । शृणु प्राज्ञ महाप्रीत्या भक्तिवर्धनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.24\. chaturviMsho.adhyAyaH | pippalAdAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | pippalAdAkhyamaparamavatAraM maheshituH | shR^iNu prAj~na mahAprItyA bhaktivardhanamuttamam
verses.translation: In the meantime, Visnu, Brahma, Indra and the gods, Siddhas and the sages came there.
verses.hindi: उसके बाद वह मुक्तिको प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वाथ शैलादिर्विधिपुत्रवचः शुभम् । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvAtha shailAdirvidhiputravachaH shubham | pratyuvAcha prasannAtmA smR^itvA shivapadAmbujam
verses.translation: They were jubilant. They joined their palms In reverence. With great devotion they severally bowed down and eulogised.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एकदा निर्जराः सर्वे वासवाद्या मुनीश्वर । वृत्रासुरसहायैश्च दैत्यैरासन्पराजिताः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ekadA nirjarAH sarve vAsavAdyA munIshvara | vR^itrAsurasahAyaishcha daityairAsanparAjitAH
verses.translation: Then the delighted Rudra, Krnadarana glanced at them with sympathetic eyes and smilingly spoke to Nabhaga.
verses.hindi: द्वादशज्योतिर्लिगावतारवर्णन नामक बयालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: स्वानि स्वानि वरास्त्राणि दधीचस्याश्रमेऽखिलाः । निःक्षिप्य सहसा सद्योऽभवन् देवाः पराजिताः
verses.transliteration: svAni svAni varAstrANi dadhIchasyAshrame.akhilAH | niHkShipya sahasA sadyo.abhavan devAH parAjitAH
verses.translation: Hence I am delighted with your holy rites. Sympathetically I ata conferring on you the eternal Brahman, the perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तदा सर्वे सुराः सेन्द्रा वध्यमानास्तथर्षयः । ब्रह्मलोकं गताः शीघ्रं प्रोचुः स्वं व्यसनं च तत्
verses.transliteration: tadA sarve surAH sendrA vadhyamAnAstatharShayaH | brahmalokaM gatAH shIghraM prochuH svaM vyasanaM cha tat
verses.translation: Be great aiifi wise, O Nabhaga, along with the brahmins immediately.'; Take all this wealth granted by me out of compassion.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा देववचनं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । सर्वं शशंस तत्त्वेन त्वष्टुश्चैव चिकीर्षितम्
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA devavachanaM brahmA lokapitAmahaH | sarvaM shashaMsa tattvena tvaShTushchaiva chikIrShitam
verses.translation: O intelligent one, enjoy all pleasures without any aberration. By my grace you will attain the good goal along with the brahmin sacrificers.

verses.sanskrit: भवद्वधार्थं जनितस्त्वष्ट्रायं तपसा सुराः । वृत्रो नाम महातेजाः सर्वदैत्याधिपो महान्
verses.transliteration: bhavadvadhArthaM janitastvaShTrAyaM tapasA surAH | vR^itro nAma mahAtejAH sarvadaityAdhipo mahAn
verses.translation: ' O dear, after saying this, lord $iva, favourably disposed to truth, vanished there itself even as all were watching.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रयत्नः क्रियतां भवेदस्य वधो यथा । तत्रोपायं शृणु प्राज्ञ धर्महेतोर्वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: atha prayatnaH kriyatAM bhavedasya vadho yathA | tatropAyaM shR^iNu prAj~na dharmahetorvadAmi te
verses.translation: Vijnu, Brahma, the gods and all others, O ex¬ cellent sage, went to their respective abodes after joyously bowing to that direction.

verses.sanskrit: महामुनिर्दधीचिर्यः स तपस्वी जितेन्द्रियः । लेभे शिवं समाराध्य वज्रास्थित्ववरं पुरा
verses.transliteration: mahAmunirdadhIchiryaH sa tapasvI jitendriyaH | lebhe shivaM samArAdhya vajrAsthitvavaraM purA
verses.translation: iSraddhadeva too, accompanied by his son, went joyously to his abode. After enjoying extensive pleasures he went to Siva's city in the end.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्थीन्येव याचध्वं स दास्यति न संशयः । निर्माय तैर्दण्डवज्रं वृत्रं जहि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tasyAsthInyeva yAchadhvaM sa dAsyati na saMshayaH | nirmAya tairdaNDavajraM vR^itraM jahi na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Thus, O Brahmin, the incarnation of Siva, named Kr$nadarlana, bestower of bliss on Nabhaga, has been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा ब्रह्मवचनं शक्रो गुरुसमन्वितः । आगच्छत्सामरः सद्यो दधीच्याश्रममुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tachChrutvA brahmavachanaM shakro gurusamanvitaH | AgachChatsAmaraH sadyo dadhIchyAshramamuttamam
verses.translation: The intelligent man who remembers this narrative both in the morning and in the evening becomes wise and knower of mantras. He attains the greatest goal in the end.

verses.sanskrit: यः पुरा गदितो विप्रो दधीचिर्मुनिसत्तमः । महाशैवः सुप्रतापी च्यावनिर्भृगुवंशजः
verses.transliteration: yaH purA gadito vipro dadhIchirmunisattamaH | mahAshaivaH supratApI chyAvanirbhR^iguvaMshajaH
verses.translation: O son of Brahma, listen to the first incarnation of the great lord, named Avadhutevara, who dispelled the ar¬ rogance of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तत्र मुनिं शक्रः सुवर्चान्वितमादरात् । ननाम साञ्जलिर्नम्रः सगुरुः सामरश्च तम्
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA tatra muniM shakraH suvarchAnvitamAdarAt | nanAma sA~njalirnamraH saguruH sAmarashcha tam
verses.translation: O sage, formerly Indra accompanied by Bfhaspati and the other gods went to Kailasa in order to see Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तदभिप्रायमाज्ञाय स मुनिर्बुधसत्तमः । स्वपत्नीं प्रेषयामास सुवर्चां स्वाश्रमान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tadabhiprAyamAj~nAya sa munirbudhasattamaH | svapatnIM preShayAmAsa suvarchAM svAshramAntaram
verses.translation: On knowing that Brhaspati and Indra wer6 coming and in order to test their mind in their eagerness to see him, the lord indulging in different kinds of sports as¬ sumed the form of an Avadhuta. He was naked. He looked fierce and had the lustre of blazing fire.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्स देवराजश्च सामरः स्वार्थसाधकः । अर्थशास्त्रपरो भूत्वा मुनीशं वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatassa devarAjashcha sAmaraH svArthasAdhakaH | arthashAstraparo bhUtvA munIshaM vAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: The Avadhuta, the goal of the good, blocked their way. He stood there with matted hair hanging loosely, and the whole feature shining brilliantly.

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच । त्वष्ट्रा विप्रकृताः सर्वे वयं देवास्तथर्षयः । शरण्यं त्वां महाशैवं दातारं शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: shakra uvAcha | tvaShTrA viprakR^itAH sarve vayaM devAstatharShayaH | sharaNyaM tvAM mahAshaivaM dAtAraM sharaNaM gatAH
verses.translation: Passing that way towards Siva, Bfhaspati and Indra saw the gigantic figure of wonderful features on the way.

verses.sanskrit: स्वास्थीनि देहि नो विप्र महावज्रमयानि हि । अस्थ्ना ते स्वपविं कृत्वा हनिष्यामि सुरद्रुहम्
verses.transliteration: svAsthIni dehi no vipra mahAvajramayAni hi | asthnA te svapaviM kR^itvA haniShyAmi suradruham
verses.translation: Who are you? Whence have you come in this form of a naked Avadhuta? What is your true name? Tell me quickly and factually.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तेन स मुनिः परोपकरणे रतः । ध्यात्वा शिवं स्वनाथं हि विससर्ज कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktastena sa muniH paropakaraNe rataH | dhyAtvA shivaM svanAthaM hi visasarja kalevaram
verses.translation: Is iSiva in his abode? Or has he gone out? I am now going to see him along with my preceptor and the gods.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मलोकं गतः सद्यः स मुनिर्ध्वस्तबन्धनः । पुष्पवृष्टिरभूत्तत्र सर्वे विस्मयमागताः
verses.transliteration: brahmalokaM gataH sadyaH sa munirdhvastabandhanaH | puShpavR^iShTirabhUttatra sarve vismayamAgatAH
verses.translation: Indra asked him again; but Siva whose ways are unknown, who was in the naked form and who was the creator of fanciful things did not say anything.

verses.sanskrit: अथ गां सुरभिं शक्र आहूयाशु ह्यलेहयत् । अस्त्रनिर्मितये त्वाष्ट्रं निर्दिदेश तदस्थिभिः
verses.transliteration: atha gAM surabhiM shakra AhUyAshu hyalehayat | astranirmitaye tvAShTraM nirdidesha tadasthibhiH
verses.translation: Again Indra, the lord of heaven and the master of the three worlds, asked him. The great Yogn of great sports remained silent.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मा तदाज्ञप्तश्चक्लृपेऽस्त्राणि कृत्स्नशः । तदस्थिभिर्वज्रमयैः सुदृढैः शिववर्चसा
verses.transliteration: vishvakarmA tadAj~naptashchaklR^ipe.astrANi kR^itsnashaH | tadasthibhirvajramayaiH sudR^iDhaiH shivavarchasA
verses.translation: Though asked by Indra again and again thus, lord Siva remained silent desirous of quelling the arrogance of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वंशोद्भवैर्वज्रं शरो ब्रह्मशिरस्तथा । अन्यास्थिभिर्बहूनि स्वपराण्यस्त्राणि निर्ममे
verses.transliteration: tasya vaMshodbhavairvajraM sharo brahmashirastathA | anyAsthibhirbahUni svaparANyastrANi nirmame
verses.translation: Then the lord of the gods proud of his suzerainty over the three worlds became furious and said rebuking the lord having matted hair.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुवेण सह सङ्ग्रामे येन विष्णुः पराजितः । सनिर्जरोऽथ संशप्तो महेश्वरसहायिना
verses.transliteration: kShuveNa saha sa~NgrAme yena viShNuH parAjitaH | sanirjaro.atha saMshapto maheshvarasahAyinA
verses.translation: O you fool, even though I am asking, you are not giving me any answer. Hence I am going so kill you with' my thunderbolt. O wicked fellow, who is there to protect you?

verses.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रो वज्रमुद्यम्य वर्द्धितः शिववर्चसा । वृत्रमभ्यद्रवत्क्रुद्धो मुने रुद्र इवान्तकम्
verses.transliteration: tamindro vajramudyamya varddhitaH shivavarchasA | vR^itramabhyadravatkruddho mune rudra ivAntakam
verses.translation: Afler saying this and staring at him in fury Indra raised his thunderbolt in order to kill the naked persori.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शक्रः सुसन्नद्धस्तेन वज्रेण स द्रुतम् । उच्चकर्त शिरो वार्त्रं गिरिशृङ्गमिवौजसा
verses.transliteration: tataH shakraH susannaddhastena vajreNa sa drutam | uchchakarta shiro vArtraM girishR^i~NgamivaujasA
verses.translation: On seeing Indra lifting up the thunderbolt, Siva made his hand stunned.

verses.sanskrit: तदा समुत्सवस्तात बभूव त्रिदिवौकसाम् । तुष्टुवुर्निर्जराः शक्रं पेतुः कुसुमवृष्टयः
verses.transliteration: tadA samutsavastAta babhUva tridivaukasAm | tuShTuvurnirjarAH shakraM petuH kusumavR^iShTayaH
verses.translation: Then that Puru$a, furious and terrific, with terrible eyes, blazed with his brilliance as though he would burn everything.

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं तात प्रसङ्गाच्चरितं त्विदम् । पिप्पलादावतारं मे शृणु शम्भोर्महादरात्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaM tAta prasa~NgAchcharitaM tvidam | pippalAdAvatAraM me shR^iNu shambhormahAdarAt
verses.translation: The lord of iSaci burnt within himself due to the anger resulting from the benumbed state of his hand like a serpent whose fury had been curbed by a magical formula.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चा सा मुनेः पत्नी दधीचस्य महात्मनः । ययौ स्वमाश्रमाभ्यन्तस्तदाज्ञप्ता पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: suvarchA sA muneH patnI dadhIchasya mahAtmanaH | yayau svamAshramAbhyantastadAj~naptA pativratA
verses.translation: On seeing the Purusa blazing thus in his own brilliance Brhaspati knew him to be Siva and bowed to him soon.

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य तत्र सा दृष्ट्वा न पतिं स्वं तपस्विनी । गृहकार्यं च सा कृत्वाखिलं पतिनिदेशतः
verses.transliteration: Agatya tatra sA dR^iShTvA na patiM svaM tapasvinI | gR^ihakAryaM cha sA kR^itvAkhilaM patinideshataH
verses.translation: Brhaspati of liberal mind kept his palms joined together and prostrated on the ground like a staff and eu¬ logised him with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: आजगाम पुनस्तत्र पश्यन्ती बह्वशोभनम् । देवांश्च तान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ सुवर्चा विस्मिताभवत्
verses.transliteration: AjagAma punastatra pashyantI bahvashobhanam | devAMshcha tAnmunishreShTha suvarchA vismitAbhavat
verses.translation: O great god, lord of the gods, favourably disposed towards those who seek refuge in you, O lord of Gaurl, be pleased. O lord of all, obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा च तत्सर्वमिदं सुराणां कृत्यं तदानीं च चुकोप साध्वी । ददौ तदा शापमतीव रुष्टा तेषां सुवर्चा ऋषिवर्यभार्या
verses.transliteration: j~nAtvA cha tatsarvamidaM surANAM kR^ityaM tadAnIM cha chukopa sAdhvI | dadau tadA shApamatIva ruShTA teShAM suvarchA R^iShivaryabhAryA
verses.translation: Even Brahma, Visnu and others are all deluded by your Maya, They do not know you really. If at all they know, it is only by your blessings.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चोवाच । अहो सुरा द्रुष्टतराश्च सर्वे स्वकार्यदक्षा ह्यबुधाश्च लुब्धाः । तस्माच्च सर्वे पशवो भवन्तु सेन्द्राश्च मेऽद्यप्रभृतीत्युवाच
verses.transliteration: suvarchovAcha | aho surA druShTatarAshcha sarve svakAryadakShA hyabudhAshcha lubdhAH | tasmAchcha sarve pashavo bhavantu sendrAshcha me.adyaprabhR^itItyuvAcha
verses.translation: After eulogising lord Siva, Brhaspati made Indra fill at his feet.

verses.sanskrit: एवं शापं ददौ तेषां सुराणां सा तपस्विनी । सशक्राणां च सर्वेषां सुवर्चा मुनिकामिनी
verses.transliteration: evaM shApaM dadau teShAM surANAM sA tapasvinI | sashakrANAM cha sarveShAM suvarchA munikAminI
verses.translation: O dear, then the liberal-minded preceptor of the gods, Brhaspati, the intelligent one, bowed humbly and spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पत्नी महाभागा सुवर्चा नाम नामतः । महापतिव्रता साध्वी यया शप्ता दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: tasya patnI mahAbhAgA suvarchA nAma nAmataH | mahApativratA sAdhvI yayA shaptA divaukasaH
verses.translation: O great god, lord of the distressed, please raise me up, who have fallen at your feet. Do not be furious. Be kind and loving.

verses.sanskrit: अनुगन्तुं पतेर्लोकमथेच्छत्सा पतिव्रता । चितां चक्रे समेधोभिः सुपवित्रैर्मनस्विनी
verses.transliteration: anugantuM paterlokamathechChatsA pativratA | chitAM chakre samedhobhiH supavitrairmanasvinI
verses.translation: O great god, be satisfied. Save Indra who has sought refuge in you. Fire originating from your eye in the forehead i.s coming out.

verses.sanskrit: ततो नभोगिरा प्राह सुवर्चां तां मुनिप्रियाम् । आश्वासयन्ती गिरिशप्रेरिता सुखदायिनी
verses.transliteration: tato nabhogirA prAha suvarchAM tAM munipriyAm | AshvAsayantI girishapreritA sukhadAyinI
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brhaspati, the lord in the form of Avadhuta, the ocean of mercy, indulging in good sports, laughingly said.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशवाण्युवाच । साहसं न कुरु प्राज्ञे शृणु मे परमं वचः । मुनितेजस्त्वदुदरे तदुत्पादय यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: AkAshavANyuvAcha | sAhasaM na kuru prAj~ne shR^iNu me paramaM vachaH | munitejastvadudare tadutpAdaya yatnataH
verses.translation: How can I withhold the fiic that has come out of

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वाभीष्टचरणं देवि कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि । सगर्भा न दहेद् गात्रमिति ब्रह्मनिदेशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataH svAbhIShTacharaNaM devi kartuM tvamarhasi | sagarbhA na dahed gAtramiti brahmanideshanam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of 8iva, Bfhaspati with his mind agitated due to fright spoke again with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा सा नभोवाणी विरराम मुनीश्वर । तां श्रुत्वा सा मुनेः पत्नी विस्मिताभूत्क्षणं च सा
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA sA nabhovANI virarAma munIshvara | tAM shrutvA sA muneH patnI vismitAbhUtkShaNaM cha sA
verses.translation: O lord, devotees are always to be pitied. O Siva, thus make your name Bhaktavatsala true.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चा सा महासाध्वी पतिलोकमभीप्सती । उपविश्याश्मना भूयः सोदरं विददार ह
verses.transliteration: suvarchA sA mahAsAdhvI patilokamabhIpsatI | upavishyAshmanA bhUyaH sodaraM vidadAra ha
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, it behoves you to cast off this fire elsewhere. Please lift up Indra since you arc the up- lifter of all devotees.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गतो जठरात्तस्या गर्भो मुनिवरस्य सः । महादिव्यतनुर्दीप्तो भासयंश्च दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: nirgato jaTharAttasyA garbho munivarasya saH | mahAdivyatanurdIpto bhAsayaMshcha disho dasha
verses.translation: Thus requested by Brhaspati, Siva who bore the name of Bhaktavatsala, the delighted soul and the dispcller of the distress of those who bow down, replied.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षाद् रुद्रावतारोऽसौ दधीचिवरतेजसः । प्रादुर्भूतः स्वयं तात स्वलीलाकरणे क्षमः
verses.transliteration: sAkShAd rudrAvatAro.asau dadhIchivaratejasaH | prAdurbhUtaH svayaM tAta svalIlAkaraNe kShamaH
verses.translation: O preceptor of the gods, I am pleased with you.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा स्वसुतं दिव्यं स्वरूपं मुनिकामिनी । सुवर्चाज्ञाय मनसा साक्षाद् रुद्रावतारकम्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA svasutaM divyaM svarUpaM munikAminI | suvarchAj~nAya manasA sAkShAd rudrAvatArakam
verses.translation: I shall cast off this fire which has cofne out of the eye in my forehead, and which is unbearable to the gods, so that it will not afflict Indra.

verses.sanskrit: प्रहृष्टाभून्महासाध्वी प्रणम्याशु नुनाव सा । स्वहृदि स्थापयामास तत्स्वरूपं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: prahR^iShTAbhUnmahAsAdhvI praNamyAshu nunAva sA | svahR^idi sthApayAmAsa tatsvarUpaM munIshvara
verses.translation: After saying this he took the wonderful fire, origi¬ nating from his eye in the forehead in his hand and cast it off into the briny sea.®

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तस्यां महादेवो नानालीलाविशारदः । प्रादुर्बभूव तेजस्वी पिप्पलादेति नामतः
verses.transliteration: tasmAttasyAM mahAdevo nAnAlIlAvishAradaH | prAdurbabhUva tejasvI pippalAdeti nAmataH
verses.translation: Then that fire originating from the eye in the forehead of Siva and cast off into the briny sea became a boy immediately.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चा तनयं तं च प्रहस्य विमलेक्षणा । जननी प्राह सुप्रीत्या पतिलोकमभीप्सती
verses.transliteration: suvarchA tanayaM taM cha prahasya vimalekShaNA | jananI prAha suprItyA patilokamabhIpsatI
verses.translation: He became tbc lord of Asuras known as Jalandhara and Sindhuputra (Son of the Sea). At the request of the gods, lord Siva slew him.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चोवाच । हे तात परमेशान चिरं तिष्ठास्य सन्निधौ । अश्वत्थस्य महाभाग सर्वेषां सुखदो भवेः
verses.transliteration: suvarchovAcha | he tAta parameshAna chiraM tiShThAsya sannidhau | ashvatthasya mahAbhAga sarveShAM sukhado bhaveH
verses.translation: It refers to the briny ocean lying to the west of Bhfirata.

verses.sanskrit: मामाज्ञापय सुप्रीत्या पतिलोकाय चाधुना । तत्रस्थाहं च पतिना त्वां ध्याये रुद्ररूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: mAmAj~nApaya suprItyA patilokAya chAdhunA | tatrasthAhaM cha patinA tvAM dhyAye rudrarUpiNam
verses.translation: After carrying out this task §iva, the benefactor of the worlds in the form of Avadhuta, vanished from there.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्येवं सा बभाषेऽथ सुवर्चा तनयं प्रति । पतिमन्वगमत्साध्वी परमेण समाधिना
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityevaM sA babhAShe.atha suvarchA tanayaM prati | patimanvagamatsAdhvI parameNa samAdhinA
verses.translation: The gods became happy and fearless. Bfhaspati and Indra became free from terror and attained supreme happiness.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दधीचपत्नी सा पतिना सङ्गता मुने । शिवलोकं समासाद्य सिषेवे शङ्करं मुदा
verses.transliteration: evaM dadhIchapatnI sA patinA sa~NgatA mune | shivalokaM samAsAdya siSheve sha~NkaraM mudA
verses.translation: After seeing the lord for which they had come there, Brhaspati and Indra returned to their respective abodes joyous and contented.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः सेन्द्राश्च मुनिभिः सह । तत्राजग्मुस्त्वरा तात आहूता इव हर्षिताः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare devAH sendrAshcha munibhiH saha | tatrAjagmustvarA tAta AhUtA iva harShitAH
verses.translation: Thus the incarnation Avadhute§vara of lord Siva has been narrated by me. It yields the highest bliss and punishes the wicked.

verses.sanskrit: हरिर्ब्रह्मा च सुप्रीत्यावतीर्णं शङ्करं भुवि । सुवर्चायां दधीचाद्वा ययतुः स्वगणैः सह
verses.transliteration: harirbrahmA cha suprItyAvatIrNaM sha~NkaraM bhuvi | suvarchAyAM dadhIchAdvA yayatuH svagaNaiH saha
verses.translation: He who listens to this or narrates this with atten¬ tive mind enjoys all pleasures and attains the goal of Siva in the end.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दृष्ट्वावतीर्णं तं मुनिपुत्रत्वमागतम् । रुद्रं सर्वे प्रणेमुश्च तुष्टुवुर्बद्धपाणयः
verses.transliteration: tatra dR^iShTvAvatIrNaM taM muniputratvamAgatam | rudraM sarve praNemushcha tuShTuvurbaddhapANayaH
verses.translation: O excellent sage, I shall now narrate the incarna¬ tion of Siva in which he dispelled the suspicion of a brahmin woman.

verses.sanskrit: तदोत्सवो महानासीद्देवानां मुनिसत्तम । नेदुर्दुन्दुभयस्तत्र नर्तक्यो ननृतुर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: tadotsavo mahAnAsIddevAnAM munisattama | nedurdundubhayastatra nartakyo nanR^iturmudA
verses.translation: O sage, as the king ruled over the kingdom virtuously observing piety to Siva, a long time elapsed very happily.

verses.sanskrit: जगुर्गन्धर्वपुत्राश्च किन्नरा वाद्यवादकाः । वादयामासुरमराः पुष्पवृष्टिं च चक्रिरे
verses.transliteration: jagurgandharvaputrAshcha kinnarA vAdyavAdakAH | vAdayAmAsuramarAH puShpavR^iShTiM cha chakrire
verses.translation: Once a great fight ensued between that king and the Salvas who laid siege to his city with many armies puffed up with their strength.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य मुनिश्रेष्ठो नन्दीश्वरवचोऽद्भुतम् । सनत्कुमारः प्रोवाच नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityAkarNya munishreShTho nandIshvaravacho.adbhutam | sanatkumAraH provAcha nataskandhaH kR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: The king of Vidarbha had a terrible fight with them. But his armies were destroyed and he was killed by Salvas due to adverse fate.

verses.sanskrit: दधीचेः पिप्पलपितुर्विलसन्तं सुतं च तम् । संस्कृत्य विधिवत्सर्वे विष्ण्वाद्यास्तुष्टुवुः पुनः
verses.transliteration: dadhIcheH pippalapiturvilasantaM sutaM cha tam | saMskR^itya vidhivatsarve viShNvAdyAstuShTuvuH punaH
verses.translation: When the king was. kiJied in the battle by the $alvas, the terrihed soldiers who survived death ded along with the ministers.

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलादेति तन्नाम चक्रे ब्रह्मा प्रसन्नधीः । प्रसन्नो भव देवेश इत्यूचे हरिणा सुरैः
verses.transliteration: pippalAdeti tannAma chakre brahmA prasannadhIH | prasanno bhava devesha ityUche hariNA suraiH
verses.translation: Coming out of the city the grief-stricken crowned queen slowly went very far in the eastern direction with her heart set on the lotus-like feet of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा तमनुज्ञाय ब्रह्मा विष्णुः सुरास्तथा । स्वं स्वं धाम ययुः सर्वे विधाय च महोत्सवम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA tamanuj~nAya brahmA viShNuH surAstathA | svaM svaM dhAma yayuH sarve vidhAya cha mahotsavam
verses.translation: Early in the morning next day after she had traversed a long way, the queen saw a pure lake, thanks to the mercy of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अथ रुद्रः पिप्पलादोऽश्वत्थमूले महाप्रभुः । तताप सुचिरं कालं लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: atha rudraH pippalAdo.ashvatthamUle mahAprabhuH | tatApa suchiraM kAlaM lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
verses.translation: After reaching the banks of the lake the distressed beloved of the king, of tender body, resorted to a shady tree for rest and stay.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं सुतपतस्तस्य पिप्पलादस्य सम्मुखे । महाकालो व्यतीयाय लोकचर्यानुसारिणः
verses.transliteration: itthaM sutapatastasya pippalAdasya sammukhe | mahAkAlo vyatIyAya lokacharyAnusAriNaH
verses.translation: Fortunately in an auspicious and meritorious hour the queen gave birth to a son endowed with all divine characteristics.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । नन्दीश्वर महाप्राज्ञ साक्षाद् रुद्रस्वरूपधृक् । धन्यस्त्वं सद्गुरुस्तात श्रावितेयं कथाद्भुता
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | nandIshvara mahAprAj~na sAkShAd rudrasvarUpadhR^ik | dhanyastvaM sadgurustAta shrAviteyaM kathAdbhutA
verses.translation: The thirsty mother, the wife of the king, entered the lake for drinking water but as willed by fate she was devoured by a crocodile in the water.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुवेण सह सङ्ग्रामे श्रुतो विष्णुपराजयः । ब्रह्मणा मे पुरा तात तच्छापश्च शिलादज
verses.transliteration: kShuveNa saha sa~NgrAme shruto viShNuparAjayaH | brahmaNA me purA tAta tachChApashcha shilAdaja
verses.translation: The son bereft of father and mother, distressed by hunger and thirst at the time of birth, cried out.

verses.sanskrit: अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि देवशापं सुवर्चया । दत्तं पश्चात् पिप्पलादचरितं मङ्गलायनम्
verses.transliteration: adhunA shrotumichChAmi devashApaM suvarchayA | dattaM pashchAt pippalAdacharitaM ma~NgalAyanam
verses.translation: A wandering beggar woman came there acciden¬ tally, urged mentally by Siva, the dispeller of fear.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: "An extremely wonderful thing has been seen by me now. It cannot be conceived by the mind or explained in words.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: "An extremely wonderful thing has been seen by me now. It cannot be conceived by the mind or explained in words.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२५. पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः । पिप्पलादावतारचरितवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथ लोके व्यवस्थाय धर्मस्य स्थापनेच्छया । महालीलां चकारेशस्तामहो सन्मुने शृणु
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.25\. pa~nchaviMsho.adhyAyaH | pippalAdAvatAracharitavarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | atha loke vyavasthAya dharmasya sthApanechChayA | mahAlIlAM chakAreshastAmaho sanmune shR^iNu
verses.translation: This infant who.se umbilical cord has not been cut lies on the bare ground. He has no mnther. He is weeping but he is very brilliant

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा मुनिवरो वयसा जर्जरोऽधिकः । उवास नार्या स तया तपस्वी नातिलम्पटः
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvA munivaro vayasA jarjaro.adhikaH | uvAsa nAryA sa tayA tapasvI nAtilampaTaH
verses.translation: He has no parents or persons to help him. What might have caused this? A/as, haw strong is power of fate!

verses.sanskrit: अथोऽनरण्यकन्या सा सिषेवे भक्तितो मुनिम् । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा लक्ष्मीर्नारायणं यथा
verses.transliteration: atho.anaraNyakanyA sA siSheve bhaktito munim | karmaNA manasA vAchA lakShmIrnArAyaNaM yathA
verses.translation: Without knowing his birth and parentage I shall not touch him'" although I wish to nourish him and bring him up as a child born of me."

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स पिप्पलादो हि शिवांशो मुनिसत्तमः । रेमे तया युवत्या च युवाभूय स्वलीलया
verses.transliteration: itthaM sa pippalAdo hi shivAMsho munisattamaH | reme tayA yuvatyA cha yuvAbhUya svalIlayA
verses.translation: Lord Siva of great sports, bestower of happiness on devotees in every respect, unconditionally for ever, by himself assumed the form of a mendicant.

verses.sanskrit: दश पुत्रा महात्मानो बभूवुः सुतपस्विनः । मुनेः पितुः समाः सर्वे पद्मायाः सुखवर्द्धनाः
verses.transliteration: dasha putrA mahAtmAno babhUvuH sutapasvinaH | muneH pituH samAH sarve padmAyAH sukhavarddhanAH
verses.translation: O brahmin lady, do not entertain any doubt in your mind. Do not be sorry. Protect this pure boy, your adopted son, lovingly.

verses.sanskrit: एवं लीलावतारो हि शङ्करस्य महाप्रभोः । पिप्पलादो मुनिवरो नानालीलाकरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: evaM lIlAvatAro hi sha~Nkarasya mahAprabhoH | pippalAdo munivaro nAnAlIlAkaraH prabhuH
verses.translation: Ere long you will attain a great glory through this infant. Nourish this extremely brilliant infant by all means.

verses.sanskrit: येन दत्तो वरः प्रीत्या लोकेभ्यो हि दयालुना । दृष्ट्वा लोके शनेः पीडां सर्वेषामनिवारिणीम्
verses.transliteration: yena datto varaH prItyA lokebhyo hi dayAlunA | dR^iShTvA loke shaneH pIDAM sarveShAmanivAriNIm
verses.translation: That brahmin lady respectfully and lovingly asked Siva, the storehouse of mercy, in the form of a mendicant who spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: षोडशाब्दावधि नृणां जन्मतो न भवेच्च सा । तथा च शिवभक्तानां सत्यमेतद्धि मे वचः
verses.transliteration: ShoDashAbdAvadhi nR^iNAM janmato na bhavechcha sA | tathA cha shivabhaktAnAM satyametaddhi me vachaH
verses.translation: At your behest I shall nourish and bring up this boy as though he is my own son. There shall be no; doubt in this. You have come here by my good fortune.

verses.sanskrit: अथानादृत्य मद्वाक्यं कुर्यात्पीडां शनिः क्वचित् । तेषां नृणां तदा स स्याद्भस्मसान्न हि संशयः
verses.transliteration: athAnAdR^itya madvAkyaM kuryAtpIDAM shaniH kvachit | teShAM nR^iNAM tadA sa syAdbhasmasAnna hi saMshayaH
verses.translation: Read »TfSrCI for of tho printed Ski. text.

verses.sanskrit: इति तद्भयतस्तात विकृतोऽपि शनैश्चरः । तेषां न कुरुते पीडां कदाचिद् ग्रहसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: iti tadbhayatastAta vikR^ito.api shanaishcharaH | teShAM na kurute pIDAM kadAchid grahasattamaH
verses.translation: O lord, O excellent mendicant, again and again the thought occurs to me that you are Siva, the ocean of mercy and this infant had been your devotee formerly.

verses.sanskrit: इति लीलामनुष्यस्य पिप्पलादस्य सन्मुने । कथितं सुचरित्रं ते सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti lIlAmanuShyasya pippalAdasya sanmune | kathitaM sucharitraM te sarvakAmaphalapradam
verses.translation: Through some defect in his past actions he has attained this plight. After experiencing it he will surely attain glory, thanks to your bliss.

verses.sanskrit: एकदा पुष्पभद्रायां स्नातुं गच्छन्मुनीश्वरः । ददर्श पद्मां युवतीं शिवांशां सुमनोहराम्
verses.transliteration: ekadA puShpabhadrAyAM snAtuM gachChanmunIshvaraH | dadarsha padmAM yuvatIM shivAMshAM sumanoharAm
verses.translation: Siva in the guise of a mendicant spoke to the brahmin lady who had attained perfect knowledge by seeing him and who evinced the desire to know the details.

verses.sanskrit: गाधिश्च कौशिकश्चैव पिप्पलादो महामुनिः । शनैश्चरकृतां पीडां नाशयन्ति स्मृतास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: gAdhishcha kaushikashchaiva pippalAdo mahAmuniH | shanaishcharakR^itAM pIDAM nAshayanti smR^itAstrayaH
verses.translation: O brahmin lady, listen with pleasure to the an¬ tecedents of this boy. O sinless one, I shall mention all the details to you.

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलादस्य चरितं पद्माचरितसंयुतम् । यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि सुभक्त्या भुवि मानवः
verses.transliteration: pippalAdasya charitaM padmAcharitasaMyutam | yaH paThechChR^iNuyAdvApi subhaktyA bhuvi mAnavaH
verses.translation: She came here in the morning and gave birth to this boy. Due to thirst she got into the lake and as fate would have it, was seized by the crocodile.

verses.sanskrit: शनिपीडाविनाशार्थमेतच्चरितमुत्तमम् । यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: shanipIDAvinAshArthametachcharitamuttamam | yaH paThechChR^iNuyAdvApi sarvAnkAmAnavApnuyAt
verses.translation: Thus he narrated to her all the details, the manner of his birth, the death of his father in the battle and that of his mother due to the crocodile.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो मुनिवरो ज्ञानी महाशैवः सतां प्रियः । अस्य पुत्रो महेशानः पिप्पलादाख्य आत्मवान्
verses.transliteration: dhanyo munivaro j~nAnI mahAshaivaH satAM priyaH | asya putro maheshAnaH pippalAdAkhya AtmavAn
verses.translation: O great sage, then the brahmin lady who was surprised asked the mendicant of perfect knowledge in the form of a Siddha, again.

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानमनघं स्वर्ग्यं कुग्रहदोषहृत् । सर्वकामप्रदं तात शिवभक्तिविवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: idamAkhyAnamanaghaM svargyaM kugrahadoShahR^it | sarvakAmapradaM tAta shivabhaktivivarddhanam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the brahmin wife, the delighted mendicant, lord Siva himself, said laughingly.

verses.sanskrit: तल्लिप्सुस्तत्पितुः स्थानमनरण्यस्य भूपतेः । जगाम भुवनाचारी लोकतत्त्वविचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: tallipsustatpituH sthAnamanaraNyasya bhUpateH | jagAma bhuvanAchArI lokatattvavichakShaNaH
verses.translation: O brahmin lady, I shall answer all questions in detail. Listen with attention to this excellent narrative.

verses.sanskrit: राजा नराणां तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणम्य च भयाकुलः । मधुपर्कादिकं दत्त्वा पूजयामास भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: rAjA narANAM taM dR^iShTvA praNamya cha bhayAkulaH | madhuparkAdikaM dattvA pUjayAmAsa bhaktitaH
verses.translation: The father of this boy, the king of Vidarbha, was the excellent king Pandya®® in his previous birth.

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहात्सर्वं गृहीत्वा स ययाचे कन्यकां मुनिः । मौनी बभूव नृपतिः किञ्चिन्निर्वक्तुमक्षमः
verses.transliteration: snehAtsarvaM gR^ihItvA sa yayAche kanyakAM muniH | maunI babhUva nR^ipatiH ki~nchinnirvaktumakShamaH
verses.translation: Observing fast and other rites in the day and night on a Trayodali (thirteenth) day, once he worshipped Siva, the lord of all, at dusk.

verses.sanskrit: मुनिः प्रोवाच नृपतिं कन्यां मे देहि भक्तितः । अन्यथा भस्मसात्सर्वं करिष्येऽहं त्वया सह
verses.transliteration: muniH provAcha nR^ipatiM kanyAM me dehi bhaktitaH | anyathA bhasmasAtsarvaM kariShye.ahaM tvayA saha
verses.translation: On hearing that noise, the king left the worship of Siva unfinished and went out of his palace suspecting the arrival of enemies.

verses.sanskrit: अथो बभूवुराच्छन्नाः सर्वे राजजनास्तदा । तेजसा पिप्पलादस्य दाधीचस्य महामुने
verses.transliteration: atho babhUvurAchChannAH sarve rAjajanAstadA | tejasA pippalAdasya dAdhIchasya mahAmune
verses.translation: In the meantime his powerful minister came near the king catching hold of the enemy king.*'

verses.sanskrit: अथ राजा महाभीतो विलप्य च मुहुर्मुहुः । कन्यामलङ्कृतां पद्मां वृद्धाय मुनये ददौ
verses.transliteration: atha rAjA mahAbhIto vilapya cha muhurmuhuH | kanyAmala~NkR^itAM padmAM vR^iddhAya munaye dadau
verses.translation: The Purarjia docs not motion the P 4 ndya king by name.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मां विवाह्य स मुनिः शिवांशाम्भूपतेः सुताम् । पिप्पलादो गृहीत्वा तां मुदितः स्वाश्रमं ययौ
verses.transliteration: padmAM vivAhya sa muniH shivAMshAmbhUpateH sutAm | pippalAdo gR^ihItvA tAM muditaH svAshramaM yayau
verses.translation: Without concluding the worship ofl&iva, the*defiled king, confused in mind and bereft of auspiciousness, took his food at night with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Thus their activities have been narrated to you. People having no devotion to Siva and not worshipping him attain poverty,

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Thus their activities have been narrated to you. People having no devotion to Siva and not worshipping him attain poverty,

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२६. षड्विंशोऽध्यायः । वैश्यनाथाह्वयशिवावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । अवतारं परानन्दं वैश्यनाथाह्वयं मुने
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.26\. ShaDviMsho.adhyAyaH | vaishyanAthAhvayashivAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | shR^iNu tAta pravakShyAmi shivasya paramAtmanaH | avatAraM parAnandaM vaishyanAthAhvayaM mune
verses.translation: O brahmin lady, hence your son has incurred poverty. Seek refuge in S'va in order to ward off that sin.

verses.sanskrit: शिखासम्बद्धरुद्राक्षः कुक्कुटः कपिना सह । नित्यं ननर्त नृत्यज्ञः पश्यतां हितमावहन्
verses.transliteration: shikhAsambaddharudrAkShaH kukkuTaH kapinA saha | nityaM nanarta nR^ityaj~naH pashyatAM hitamAvahan
verses.translation: Let the worship of Siva be performed by these two sons. Only after the investiture with the sacred *'read will Siva bestow glory.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सा कुर्वती वेश्या कौतुकं परमादरात् । शिवभक्तिरता नित्यं महानन्दभराभवत्
verses.transliteration: evaM sA kurvatI veshyA kautukaM paramAdarAt | shivabhaktiratA nityaM mahAnandabharAbhavat
verses.translation: After instructing her thus, Siva in the form of a mendicant, favourably disposed towards his devotees, revealed his real self to her.

verses.sanskrit: शिवभक्तिं प्रकुर्वन्त्या वेश्याया मुनिसत्तम । बहुकालो व्यतीयाय तस्याः परमसौख्यतः
verses.transliteration: shivabhaktiM prakurvantyA veshyAyA munisattama | bahukAlo vyatIyAya tasyAH paramasaukhyataH
verses.translation: Even as the brahmin lady stood watching, Siva who had taken the form of a mendicant vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: एकदा च गृहे तस्या वैश्यो भूत्वा शिवः स्वयम् । परीक्षितुं च तद्भावमाजगाम शुभो व्रती
verses.transliteration: ekadA cha gR^ihe tasyA vaishyo bhUtvA shivaH svayam | parIkShituM cha tadbhAvamAjagAma shubho vratI
verses.translation: When the mendicant disappeared, the care-free brahmin woman took that boy and her son home.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपुण्ड्रविलसद्भालो रुद्राक्षाभरणः कृती । शिवनामजपासक्तो जटिलः शैववेषभृत्
verses.transliteration: tripuNDravilasadbhAlo rudrAkShAbharaNaH kR^itI | shivanAmajapAsakto jaTilaH shaivaveShabhR^it
verses.translation: She took up residence in the beautiful city Eka- cakra®** and nourished the prince and her own son with excellent food.

verses.sanskrit: स बिभ्रद्भस्मनिचयं प्रकोष्ठे वरकङ्कणम् । महारत्नपरिस्तीर्णं राजते परकौतुकी
verses.transliteration: sa bibhradbhasmanichayaM prakoShThe varaka~NkaNam | mahAratnaparistIrNaM rAjate parakautukI
verses.translation: Their sacred rites and the investiture with the sacred thread were performed by the brahmins. They grew up thus devoted to the worship of Siva in their own house.

verses.sanskrit: तमागतं सुसम्पूज्य सा वेश्या परया मुदा । स्वस्थाने सादरं वैश्यं सुन्दरी हि न्यवेशयत्
verses.transliteration: tamAgataM susampUjya sA veshyA parayA mudA | svasthAne sAdaraM vaishyaM sundarI hi nyaveshayat
verses.translation: O dear, at the behest of the sage Sandilya they observed vows and restraints and performed the worship of Siva during dusk.

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रकोष्ठे वरं वीक्ष्य कङ्कणं सुमनोहरम् । तस्मिञ्जातस्पृहा सा च तं प्रोवाच सुविस्मिता
verses.transliteration: tatprakoShThe varaM vIkShya ka~NkaNaM sumanoharam | tasmi~njAtaspR^ihA sA cha taM provAcha suvismitA
verses.translation: Once when the prince went to the river for his bath without the brahmin boy, he found an excellent pot of treasure.

verses.sanskrit: महानन्दोवाच । महारत्नमयश्चायं कङ्कणस्त्वत्करे स्थितः । मनो हरति मे सद्यो दिव्यस्त्रीभूषणोचितः
verses.transliteration: mahAnandovAcha | mahAratnamayashchAyaM ka~NkaNastvatkare sthitaH | mano harati me sadyo divyastrIbhUShaNochitaH
verses.translation: Thus four months elapsed as the two boys con¬ tinued their worship of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तां नवरत्नाढ्ये सस्पृहां करभूषणे । वीक्ष्योदारमतिर्वैश्यः सस्मितं समभाषत
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti tAM navaratnADhye saspR^ihAM karabhUShaNe | vIkShyodAramatirvaishyaH sasmitaM samabhAShata
verses.translation: As they continued the worship of Siva again with great joy, a year elapsed in the very same house.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दिग्रामे पुरा काचिन्महानन्देति विश्रुता । बभूव वारवनिता शिवभक्ता सुसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: nandigrAme purA kAchinmahAnandeti vishrutA | babhUva vAravanitA shivabhaktA susundarI
verses.translation: O sage, after a year had elapsed, the prince once went to a forest along with the brahmin boy. There a Gandharva came by chance and gave his daughter in mar¬ riage to the prince. The prince ruled over the kingdom without any check or hindrance.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यनाथ उवाच । अस्मिन् रत्नवरे दिव्ये सस्पृहं यदि ते मनः । त्वमेवाधत्स्व सुप्रीत्या मौल्यमस्य ददासि किम्
verses.transliteration: vaishyanAtha uvAcha | asmin ratnavare divye saspR^ihaM yadi te manaH | tvamevAdhatsva suprItyA maulyamasya dadAsi kim
verses.translation: He considered the brahman lady who brought him up as his mother and the brahmin boy as his brother.

verses.sanskrit: वेश्योवाच । वयं हि स्वैरचारिण्यो वेश्यास्तु न पतिव्रताः । अस्मत्कुलोचितो धर्मो व्यभिचारो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: veshyovAcha | vayaM hi svairachAriNyo veshyAstu na pativratAH | asmatkulochito dharmo vyabhichAro na saMshayaH
verses.translation: In name of Dharmagupta he continued to propi¬ tiate the lord of gods and enjoyed pleasures along with the princess in the kingdom of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: यद्येतदखिलं चित्तं गृह्णाति करभूषणम् । दिनत्रयमहोरात्रं पत्नी तव भवाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: yadyetadakhilaM chittaM gR^ihNAti karabhUShaNam | dinatrayamahorAtraM patnI tava bhavAmyaham
verses.translation: Thus the incarnation of Siva as the Bhik§uvarya bestowing happiness on the prince Dharmagupta has been narrated by me now-

verses.sanskrit: वैश्य उवाच । तथास्तु यदि ते सत्यं वचनं वीरवल्लभे । ददामि रत्नवलयं त्रिरात्रं भव मे वधूः
verses.transliteration: vaishya uvAcha | tathAstu yadi te satyaM vachanaM vIravallabhe | dadAmi ratnavalayaM trirAtraM bhava me vadhUH
verses.translation: He who listens to this talc or narrates this to others with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and goes to the region of Siva hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्व्यवहारे तु प्रमाणं शशिभास्करौ । त्रिवारं सत्यमित्युक्त्वा हृदयं मे स्पृश प्रिये
verses.transliteration: etasminvyavahAre tu pramANaM shashibhAskarau | trivAraM satyamityuktvA hR^idayaM me spR^isha priye
verses.translation: O dear, listen, I shall narrate the incarnation of Siva, the great soul, as Indra in which he was beneScial to Dhaumya's elder brother.

verses.sanskrit: वेश्योवाच । दिनत्रयमहोरात्रं पत्नी भूत्वा तव प्रभो । सहधर्मं चरामीति सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: veshyovAcha | dinatrayamahorAtraM patnI bhUtvA tava prabho | sahadharmaM charAmIti satyaM satyaM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: The intelligent son of Vyaghrapada, Upamanyu, the beloved of the good, became the son of a sage in another birth. He achieved great attainments then.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा हि महानन्दा त्रिवारं शशिभास्करौ । प्रमाणीकृत्य सुप्रीत्या सा तद् हृदयमस्पृशत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA hi mahAnandA trivAraM shashibhAskarau | pramANIkR^itya suprItyA sA tad hR^idayamaspR^ishat
verses.translation: Upamanyu, the son of Vyaghrapada, while yet a small child stayed in his uncle's house along with his mother. Due to adverse fate he was very poor.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्यै स वैश्यस्तु प्रदत्त्वा रत्नकङ्कणम् । लिङ्गं रत्नमयं तस्य हस्ते दत्त्वेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: atha tasyai sa vaishyastu pradattvA ratnaka~NkaNam | li~NgaM ratnamayaM tasya haste dattvedamabravIt
verses.translation: Once he tasted a little milk in his uncle's hermitage. Approaching his mother he implored for milk, yearning for it.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यनाथ उवाच । इदं रत्नमयं लिङ्गं शैवं मत्प्राणदवल्लभम् । रक्षणीयं त्वया कान्ते गोपनीयं प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: vaishyanAtha uvAcha | idaM ratnamayaM li~NgaM shaivaM matprANadavallabham | rakShaNIyaM tvayA kAnte gopanIyaM prayatnataH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her son the pitiable mother went in and thought of a proper means to satisfy the child.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमस्त्विति सा प्रोच्य लिङ्गमादाय रत्नजम् । नाट्यमण्डपिकामध्ये निधाय प्राविशद् गृहम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamastviti sA prochya li~NgamAdAya ratnajam | nATyamaNDapikAmadhye nidhAya prAvishad gR^iham
verses.translation: She ground some seeds and grains she got by gleaning, into a paste with water. She gave this artificial milk to her son after fondling and coaxing him.

verses.sanskrit: महाविभवसम्पन्ना सुधनाढ्या महोज्ज्वला । नानारत्नपरिच्छिन्नशृङ्गाररसनिर्भरा
verses.transliteration: mahAvibhavasampannA sudhanADhyA mahojjvalA | nAnAratnaparichChinnashR^i~NgArarasanirbharA
verses.translation: After drinking the artificial milk given by his mother the boy said "O, this is not milk" and cried again.

verses.sanskrit: सा तेन सङ्गता रात्रौ वैश्येन विटधर्मिणा । सुखं सुष्वाप पर्यङ्के मृदुतल्पोपशोभिते
verses.transliteration: sA tena sa~NgatA rAtrau vaishyena viTadharmiNA | sukhaM suShvApa parya~Nke mR^idutalpopashobhite
verses.translation: On hearing the cry of her son, she wiped off his lotus-like eyes and said in grief.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निशीथसमये मुने वैश्यपतीच्छया । अकस्मादुत्थिता वाणी नृत्यमण्डपिकान्तरे
verses.transliteration: tato nishIthasamaye mune vaishyapatIchChayA | akasmAdutthitA vANI nR^ityamaNDapikAntare
verses.translation: How can we the dwellers of the forest for ever have milk? Without the grace of Siva we can never have milk.

verses.sanskrit: महाप्रज्वलितो वह्निः सुसमीरसहायवान् । नाट्यमण्डपिकां तात तामेव सहसावृणोत्
verses.transliteration: mahAprajvalito vahniH susamIrasahAyavAn | nATyamaNDapikAM tAta tAmeva sahasAvR^iNot
verses.translation: O son, only that can be attained what we had dedicated to Siva in our previous birth. We need not worry in this matter.

verses.sanskrit: मण्डपे दह्यमाने तु सहसोत्थाय सम्भ्रमात् । मर्कटं मोचयामास सा वेश्या तत्र बन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: maNDape dahyamAne tu sahasotthAya sambhramAt | markaTaM mochayAmAsa sA veshyA tatra bandhanAt
verses.translation: On hearing the words of his mother, the son of Vyaghrapada excessively fond of his mother, freed of his grief, replied to her.

verses.sanskrit: स मर्कटो मुक्तबन्धः कुक्कुटेन सहामुना । भिया दूरं हि दुद्राव विधूयाग्निकणान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: sa markaTo muktabandhaH kukkuTena sahAmunA | bhiyA dUraM hi dudrAva vidhUyAgnikaNAnbahUn
verses.translation: "O blessed mother, do not grieve. Cast off this sorrow. If Siva is the benefactor, everything will result in welfare.

verses.sanskrit: स्तम्भेन सह निर्दग्धं तल्लिङ्गं शकलीकृतम् । दृष्ट्वा वेश्या स वैश्यश्च दुरन्तं दुःखमापतुः
verses.transliteration: stambhena saha nirdagdhaM talli~NgaM shakalIkR^itam | dR^iShTvA veshyA sa vaishyashcha durantaM duHkhamApatuH
verses.translation: After saying thus with pleasure and repeating "Let there be a welfare*', he bowed to his mother and left her. He began to perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा ह्यात्मसमं लिङ्गं दग्धं वैश्यपतिस्तदा । ज्ञातुं तद्भावमन्तःस्थं मरणाय मतिं दधे
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA hyAtmasamaM li~NgaM dagdhaM vaishyapatistadA | j~nAtuM tadbhAvamantaHsthaM maraNAya matiM dadhe
verses.translation: It was on the mountain Himavat that he went to perform his penance with pure mind taking nothing in except air. He installed!§iva's phallic image of clay after making a pedestal for it with eight bricks. He invoked Siva along with Parvati into the phallic image with devotion. He repeated the five-syllabled mantra.® The boy worshipped Siva with leaves, flowers and other things.

verses.sanskrit: निविश्येऽतितरां खेदाद्वैश्यस्तामाह दुःखिताम् । नानालीलो महेशानः कौतुकान्नरदेहवान्
verses.transliteration: nivishye.atitarAM khedAdvaishyastAmAha duHkhitAm | nAnAlIlo maheshAnaH kautukAnnaradehavAn
verses.translation: He meditated on Siva along with Parvati repeating the five-syllabled mantra. Worshipping thus he performed great penance for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यपतिरुवाच । शिवलिङ्गे तु निर्भिन्ने दग्धे महत्प्राणवल्लभे । सत्यं वच्मि न सन्देहो नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration: vaishyapatiruvAcha | shivali~Nge tu nirbhinne dagdhe mahatprANavallabhe | satyaM vachmi na sandeho nAhaM jIvitumutsahe
verses.translation: O sage, due to the penance of the boy Upamanyu, the great soul, the whole world consisting of the mobile and immobile beings blazed as it were.

verses.sanskrit: चितां कारय मे भद्रे स्वभृत्यैस्त्वं वरैर्लघु । शिवे मनः समावेश्य प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: chitAM kAraya me bhadre svabhR^ityaistvaM varairlaghu | shive manaH samAveshya pravekShyAmi hutAshanam
verses.translation: In the meantime, requested by Visnu aud others, Siva assumed the form of Indra in order to test his devotion.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसङ्गीतविद्यासु निपुणातिमनोहरा । तस्या गेयेन हृष्यन्ति राज्ञ्यो राजान एव च
verses.transliteration: sarvasa~NgItavidyAsu nipuNAtimanoharA | tasyA geyena hR^iShyanti rAj~nyo rAjAna eva cha
verses.translation: Parvati took the form of Saci. The Ganas became the gods, Nandin became the elephant Airavata. Everything belonging to Siva became that of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: यदि ब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्ण्वाद्या वारयेयुः समेत्य माम् । तथाप्यस्मिन् क्षणे भद्रे प्रविशामि त्यजाम्यसून्
verses.transliteration: yadi brahmendraviShNvAdyA vArayeyuH sametya mAm | tathApyasmin kShaNe bhadre pravishAmi tyajAmyasUn
verses.translation: Then Siva accompanied by Parvati and the Ganas, and assuming the form of Indra went to the hermitage of Upamanyu in order to bless him.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तमेवं दृढनिर्बन्धं सा विज्ञाय सुदुःखिता । स्वभृत्यैः कारयामास चितां स्वभवनाद् बहिः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tamevaM dR^iDhanirbandhaM sA vij~nAya suduHkhitA | svabhR^ityaiH kArayAmAsa chitAM svabhavanAd bahiH
verses.translation: O great sage, in order to test his devotion, Siva in the form of India, spoke to the boy in a grave tone.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स वैश्यः शिव एक एव प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य समिद्धमग्निम् । विवेश पश्यत्सु नरेषु धीरः सुकौतुकी सङ्गतिभावमिच्छुः
verses.transliteration: tataH sa vaishyaH shiva eka eva pradakShiNIkR^itya samiddhamagnim | vivesha pashyatsu nareShu dhIraH sukautukI sa~NgatibhAvamichChuH
verses.translation: **0 boy of good rites,,1 am pleased with you and your penance. Mention the boon you wish to have. I shall give you whatever you desire. There is no doubt about this."

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सा तद्गतिं वेश्या महानन्दातिविस्मिता । अनुतापं च युवती प्रपेदे मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA sA tadgatiM veshyA mahAnandAtivismitA | anutApaM cha yuvatI prapede munisattama
verses.translation: On hearing it Indra said—"You do not know me

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा दुःखिता वेश्या स्मृत्वा धर्म सुनिर्मलम् । सर्वान्बन्धुजनान्वीक्ष्य बभाषे करुणं वचः
verses.transliteration: atha sA duHkhitA veshyA smR^itvA dharma sunirmalam | sarvAnbandhujanAnvIkShya babhAShe karuNaM vachaH
verses.translation: O brahmin sage, be my devotee. Worship me alone on every occasion. I shall grant you every benefit. Leave off Rudra devoid of attributes.

verses.sanskrit: महानन्दोवाच । रत्नकङ्कणमादाय मया सत्यमुदाहृतम् । दिनत्रयमहं पत्नी वैश्यस्यामुष्य सम्मता
verses.transliteration: mahAnandovAcha | ratnaka~NkaNamAdAya mayA satyamudAhR^itam | dinatrayamahaM patnI vaishyasyAmuShya sammatA
verses.translation: Enough of Rudra devoid of attributes. What pur¬ pose of yourg can be achieved by his worship? He is out of the caste of ihe gods. He has become a Pisaca.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा मत्कृतेनायं मृतो वैश्यः शिवव्रती । तस्मादहं प्रवेक्ष्यामि सहानेन हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: karmaNA matkR^itenAyaM mR^ito vaishyaH shivavratI | tasmAdahaM pravekShyAmi sahAnena hutAshanam
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the son of the sage con¬ sidered them an obstacle to his austerities. Repeating the five-s' llabled mantra he told him who had come to create obs'acles.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मचारिणीत्युक्तमाचार्यैः सत्यवादिभिः । एवं कृते मम प्रीत्या सत्यं मयि न नश्यतु
verses.transliteration: svadharmachAriNItyuktamAchAryaiH satyavAdibhiH | evaM kR^ite mama prItyA satyaM mayi na nashyatu
verses.translation: All this has been mentioned by you indulging in insult of Siva. Incidentally you have mentioned that Siva, the lord of the gods, is attributeless as well as Pisaca.

verses.sanskrit: सत्याश्रयः परो धर्मः सत्येन परमा गतिः । सत्येन स्वर्गमोक्षौ च सत्ये सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: satyAshrayaH paro dharmaH satyena paramA gatiH | satyena svargamokShau cha satye sarvaM pratiShThitam
verses.translation: You do not know Siva, lord of the chiefs of gods, the father and progenitor of Brahma, Vtsnu and Mahe!5a and greater than Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति सा दृढनिर्बन्धा वार्यमाणापि बन्धुभिः । सत्यलोपभिया नारी प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं मनो दधे
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti sA dR^iDhanirbandhA vAryamANApi bandhubhiH | satyalopabhiyA nArI prANAMstyaktuM mano dadhe
verses.translation: I choose the boon from that deity, whom the philo¬ sophers call eternal, the single, the multitude, separate from the existent and non-existent and the unmanifest.

verses.sanskrit: समानर्च सदा साम्बं सा वेश्या शङ्करं मुदा । शिवनामजपासक्ता भस्मरुद्राक्षभूषणा
verses.transliteration: samAnarcha sadA sAmbaM sA veshyA sha~NkaraM mudA | shivanAmajapAsaktA bhasmarudrAkShabhUShaNA
verses.translation: I choose the boon from that deity whom the knowers of reality consider free from causations, disputes and the bestower of the principles of Sahkhya and Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्वं द्विजमुख्येभ्यो दत्त्वा ध्यात्वा सदाशिवम् । तमग्निं त्रिःपरिक्रम्य प्रवेशाभिमुखी ह्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: sarvasvaM dvijamukhyebhyo dattvA dhyAtvA sadAshivam | tamagniM triHparikramya praveshAbhimukhI hyabhUt
verses.translation: I do not wish to take a boon from you or Bra¬ hma or Visnu. Nor do I want any boon from any other god. Let Siva be the bestower of boons on me.

verses.sanskrit: तां पतन्तीं समिद्धेऽग्नौ स्वपदार्पितमानसाम् । वारयामास विश्वात्मा प्रादुर्भूतः स वै शिवः
verses.transliteration: tAM patantIM samiddhe.agnau svapadArpitamAnasAm | vArayAmAsa vishvAtmA prAdurbhUtaH sa vai shivaH
verses.translation: O enemy of mountains, listen to my feeling in

verses.sanskrit: सा तं विलोक्याखिलदेवदेवं त्रिलोचनं चन्द्रकलावतंसम् । शशाङ्कसूर्यानलकोटिभासं स्तब्धेव भीतेव तथैव तस्थौ
verses.transliteration: sA taM vilokyAkhiladevadevaM trilochanaM chandrakalAvataMsam | shashA~NkasUryAnalakoTibhAsaM stabdheva bhIteva tathaiva tasthau
verses.translation: O base god, let it be that I had yearned for milk. I shall kill you by Siva's missile and then leave off my mortal frame,

verses.sanskrit: तां विह्वलां सुवित्रस्तां वेपमानां जडीकृताम् । समाश्वास्य गलद्बाष्पां करौ धृत्वाब्रवीद्वचः
verses.transliteration: tAM vihvalAM suvitrastAM vepamAnAM jaDIkR^itAm | samAshvAsya galadbAShpAM karau dhR^itvAbravIdvachaH
verses.translation: He took some ashes from the receptacle and in¬ voked it with the mantra Aghorastra, The sage, thereafter discharged it against Indra and roared.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । सत्यं धर्मं च धैर्यं च भक्तिं च मयि निश्चलाम् । परीक्षितुं त्वत्सकाशं वैश्यो भूत्वाहमागतः
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | satyaM dharmaM cha dhairyaM cha bhaktiM cha mayi nishchalAm | parIkShituM tvatsakAshaM vaishyo bhUtvAhamAgataH
verses.translation: Remembering the feet of Siva, his favourite deity, he got ready to burn himself. He stood there bearing the fiery pose.

verses.sanskrit: माययाग्निं समुद्दीप्य दग्धं ते नाट्यमण्डपम् । दग्धं कृत्वा रत्नलिङ्गं प्रविष्टोऽहं हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: mAyayAgniM samuddIpya dagdhaM te nATyamaNDapam | dagdhaM kR^itvA ratnali~NgaM praviShTo.ahaM hutAshanam
verses.translation: At the behest of Siva, Nandin the favourite of Siva delightedly caught hold of the Aghorastra discharged by him, in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: सा त्वं सत्यमनुस्मृत्य प्रविष्टाग्निं मया सहा । अतस्ते सम्प्रदास्यामि भोगांस्त्रिदशदुर्लभान्
verses.transliteration: sA tvaM satyamanusmR^itya praviShTAgniM mayA sahA | ataste sampradAsyAmi bhogAMstridashadurlabhAn
verses.translation: Assuming his own form with the moon for his crest, lord Siva revealed it to the brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यदिच्छसि सुश्रोणि तदेव हि ददामि ते । त्वद्भक्त्याहं प्रसन्नोऽस्मि तवादेयं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: yadyadichChasi sushroNi tadeva hi dadAmi te | tvadbhaktyAhaM prasanno.asmi tavAdeyaM na vidyate
verses.translation: The lord then showed him a thousand milk oceans, the ocean of curds and the ocean of different food¬ stuffs.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति ब्रुवति गौरीशे शङ्करे भक्तवत्सले । महानन्दा च सा वेश्या शङ्करं प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti bruvati gaurIshe sha~Nkare bhaktavatsale | mahAnandA cha sA veshyA sha~NkaraM pratyabhAShata
verses.translation: The drums were sounded in the heaven. There was a shower of flowers. All the ten quarters were covered by Brahma, Visnu and other gods.

verses.sanskrit: वेश्योवाच । न मे वाञ्छास्ति भोगेषु भूमौ स्वर्गे रसातले । तव पादाम्बुजस्पर्शादन्यत्किञ्चिन्न कामये
verses.transliteration: veshyovAcha | na me vA~nChAsti bhogeShu bhUmau svarge rasAtale | tava pAdAmbujasparshAdanyatki~nchinna kAmaye
verses.translation: In the meantime the smiling lord Siva called him

verses.sanskrit: शिवं सम्पूज्य सा नित्यं सेवन्ती जगदीश्वरम् । ननर्त परया भक्त्या गायन्ती शिवसद्यशः
verses.transliteration: shivaM sampUjya sA nityaM sevantI jagadIshvaram | nanarta parayA bhaktyA gAyantI shivasadyashaH
verses.translation: "Dear Upamanyu, I am pleased with your ex¬ cellent behaviour. O brahmin sage, you are very firm in your devotion. I just desired to know you thoroughly.

verses.sanskrit: ये मे भृत्याश्च दास्यश्च ये चान्ये मम बान्धवाः । सर्वे त्वद्दर्शनपरास्त्वयि सन्न्यस्तवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: ye me bhR^ityAshcha dAsyashcha ye chAnye mama bAndhavAH | sarve tvaddarshanaparAstvayi sannyastavR^ittayaH
verses.translation: Enjoy the pleasure of eating sumptuously for¬ ever along with your kinsmen. Be ever happy and free from misery. Be devoted to me.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वानेतान्मया सार्धं निनीयात्मपरं पदम् । पुनर्जन्मभयं घोरं विमोचय नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: sarvAnetAnmayA sArdhaM ninIyAtmaparaM padam | punarjanmabhayaM ghoraM vimochaya namo.astu te
verses.translation: O fortunate Upamanyu, you have been made eternally my son today. Parvati, here, is your mother.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । ततः स तस्या वचनं प्रतिनन्द्य महेश्वरः । ताः सर्वाश्च तया सार्धं निनाय स्वं परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tataH sa tasyA vachanaM pratinandya maheshvaraH | tAH sarvAshcha tayA sArdhaM ninAya svaM paraM padam
verses.translation: O great sage, thousands of oceans of milk, curd, ghee and honey, and of different foodstuffs I grant you lovingly. Accept them. I confer on you the state of a god and the eternal chieftainship of Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यनाथावतारस्ते वर्णितः परमो मया । महानन्दासुखकरो भक्तानन्दप्रदः सदा
verses.transliteration: vaishyanAthAvatAraste varNitaH paramo mayA | mahAnandAsukhakaro bhaktAnandapradaH sadA
verses.translation: I, l§iva, am your father and she, Parvati, is your mother. Choose your boons whatever you desire.

verses.sanskrit: इदं चरित्रं परमं पवित्रं सतां च सर्वप्रदमाशु दिव्यम् । शिवावतारस्य विशाम्पतेर्महा- नन्दामहासौख्यकरं विचित्रम्
verses.transliteration: idaM charitraM paramaM pavitraM satAM cha sarvapradamAshu divyam | shivAvatArasya vishAmpatermahA\- nandAmahAsaukhyakaraM vichitram
verses.translation: Be unaging and undying and free from misery. You will be famous, brilliant and endowed with divine knowledge. You will be a great lord."

verses.sanskrit: इदं यः शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । च्यवते न स्वधर्मात्स परत्र लभते गतिम्
verses.transliteration: idaM yaH shR^iNuyAdbhaktyA shrAvayedvA samAhitaH | chyavate na svadharmAtsa paratra labhate gatim
verses.translation: Then considering his great penance, the de¬ lighted!§iva gave ten boons to the sage Upamanyu. He bestowed on him the knowledge of Siva and his rites. He instructed him in the vows of Siva. He gave him fluency of speech and efficiency. He bestowed his own region on him.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राक्षैर्भूषयित्वैकं मर्कटं चैव कुक्कुटम् । करतालैश्च गीतैश्च सदा नर्तयति स्म सा
verses.transliteration: rudrAkShairbhUShayitvaikaM markaTaM chaiva kukkuTam | karatAlaishcha gItaishcha sadA nartayati sma sA
verses.translation: After granting him the boons, lord Siva took him with both the hands, sniffed at his head and showed him to the goodess saying: "This is your son."

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यमानौ च तौ दृष्ट्वा शिवभक्तिरता च सा । वेश्या स्म विहसत्युच्चैः प्रेम्णा सर्वसखीयुता
verses.transliteration: nR^ityamAnau cha tau dR^iShTvA shivabhaktiratA cha sA | veshyA sma vihasatyuchchaiH premNA sarvasakhIyutA
verses.translation: Listening with pleasure and placing her hands on his head she granted him the everlasting status of a son.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राक्षैः कृतकेयूरकर्णाभरणमण्डना । मर्कटः शिक्षया तस्याः पुरो नृत्यति बालवत्
verses.transliteration: rudrAkShaiH kR^itakeyUrakarNAbharaNamaNDanA | markaTaH shikShayA tasyAH puro nR^ityati bAlavat
verses.translation: She gave him undecaying, compressed ocean of milk, the prosperity and power of yoga, the undying knowledge of Brahman and the great assets.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Then the delighted sage requested the lord of the gods affer bowing to him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Then the delighted sage requested the lord of the gods affer bowing to him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२७. सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः । द्विजेशाख्यशिवावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । द्विजेश्वरावतारं च सशिवं सुखदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.27\. saptaviMsho.adhyAyaH | dvijeshAkhyashivAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | shR^iNu tAta pravakShyAmi shivasya paramAtmanaH | dvijeshvarAvatAraM cha sashivaM sukhadaM satAm
verses.translation: O lord of gods, be pleased. O supreme lord, be pleased. Grant me the greatest devotion unto you, divine and unswerving.

verses.sanskrit: अथाविदूरे तस्यैव द्रवन्तौ भयविह्वलौ । अन्वीयमानौ व्याघ्रेण रुदन्तौ तौ बभूवतुः
verses.transliteration: athAvidUre tasyaiva dravantau bhayavihvalau | anvIyamAnau vyAghreNa rudantau tau babhUvatuH
verses.translation: O great god, give me great faith in persons de¬ voted to you, the state of being your servant, your great affection and your constant presence.

verses.sanskrit: अथ विद्धौ च तौ तात भद्रायुः स महीपतिः । ददर्श क्रन्दमानौ हि शरण्यः क्षत्रियर्षभः
verses.transliteration: atha viddhau cha tau tAta bhadrAyuH sa mahIpatiH | dadarsha krandamAnau hi sharaNyaH kShatriyarShabhaH
verses.translation: After saying this, the delighted excellent brahmin Upamanyu eulogised great lord with words choked in de¬ light.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तौ मुनिशार्दूल स्वमायाद्विजदम्पती । भद्रायुषं महाराजमूचतुर्भयविह्वलौ
verses.transliteration: atha tau munishArdUla svamAyAdvijadampatI | bhadrAyuShaM mahArAjamUchaturbhayavihvalau
verses.translation: Thus requested,!§iva, the lord of all, replied

verses.sanskrit: द्विजदम्पती ऊचतुः । पाहि पाहि महाराज नावुभौ धर्मवित्तम । एष आयाति शार्दूलो जग्धुमावां महाप्रभो
verses.transliteration: dvijadampatI UchatuH | pAhi pAhi mahArAja nAvubhau dharmavittama | eSha AyAti shArdUlo jagdhumAvAM mahAprabho
verses.translation: O dear Upamanyu, O sinless one, you are blessed. You are especially my devotee. Whatever has been chosen by you has been given to you.

verses.sanskrit: एष हिंस्रः कालसमः सर्वप्राणिभयङ्करः । यावन्न खादति प्राप्य तावन्नौ रक्ष धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: eSha hiMsraH kAlasamaH sarvaprANibhaya~NkaraH | yAvanna khAdati prApya tAvannau rakSha dharmavit
verses.translation: Be unaging and undying and free from misery. Be respectable to all, free from aberrations and the foremost among devotees.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थमाक्रन्दितं श्रुत्वा तयोश्च नृपतीश्वरः । अति शीघ्रं महावीरः स यावद्धनुराददे
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | itthamAkranditaM shrutvA tayoshcha nR^ipatIshvaraH | ati shIghraM mahAvIraH sa yAvaddhanurAdade
verses.translation: O excellent brahmin, yon will have undwindling kinsmen, family and race. Your devotion to me will be permanent.

verses.sanskrit: तावदभ्येत्य शार्दूलः त्वरमाणोऽतिमायिकः । स तस्य द्विजवर्यस्य मध्ये जग्राह तां वधूम्
verses.transliteration: tAvadabhyetya shArdUlaH tvaramANo.atimAyikaH | sa tasya dvijavaryasya madhye jagrAha tAM vadhUm
verses.translation: O sage, I shall be ever present in your hermitage. Stay at ease. Do not be anxious.

verses.sanskrit: हे नाथ नाथ हे कान्त हा शम्भो हा जगद्गुरो । इति रोरूयमानां तां व्याघ्रो जग्रास भीषणः
verses.transliteration: he nAtha nAtha he kAnta hA shambho hA jagadguro | iti rorUyamAnAM tAM vyAghro jagrAsa bhIShaNaH
verses.translation: After saying this and granting him all excellent boons, the lord vanished from there, accompanied by Parvatl and the Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: तावत्स राजा निशितैर्भल्लैर्व्याघ्रमताडयत् । न स तैर्विव्यथे किञ्चिद्गिरीन्द्र इव वृष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration: tAvatsa rAjA nishitairbhallairvyAghramatADayat | na sa tairvivyathe ki~nchidgirIndra iva vR^iShTibhiH
verses.translation: After receiving excellent boons, the delighted Upamanyu went to the abode of his mother and described everything to her.

verses.sanskrit: स शार्दूलो महासत्त्वो राज्ञः स्वैरकृतव्यथः । बलादाकृष्य तां नारीमपाक्रमत सत्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa shArdUlo mahAsattvo rAj~naH svairakR^itavyathaH | balAdAkR^iShya tAM nArImapAkramata satvaraH
verses.translation: O dear, thus, the incarnation of Siva the great

verses.sanskrit: यः पूर्वं वर्णितस्तात भद्रायुर्नृपसत्तमः । यस्मिन्नृषभरूपेणानुग्रहं कृतवाञ्छिवः
verses.transliteration: yaH pUrvaM varNitastAta bhadrAyurnR^ipasattamaH | yasminnR^iShabharUpeNAnugrahaM kR^itavA~nChivaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with purity of mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains Siva's goal hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रेणापहृतां नारीं वीक्ष्य विप्रोऽतिविस्मितः । लौकिकीं गतिमाश्रित्य रुरोदाति मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: vyAghreNApahR^itAM nArIM vIkShya vipro.ativismitaH | laukikIM gatimAshritya rurodAti muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: O Sanatkumara, listen to the incarnation of Siva the great soul. It is named Jatila and is very sanctifying.

verses.sanskrit: रुदित्वा चिरकालं च स विप्रो माययेश्वरः । भद्रायुषं महीपालं प्रोवाच मदहारकः
verses.transliteration: ruditvA chirakAlaM cha sa vipro mAyayeshvaraH | bhadrAyuShaM mahIpAlaM provAcha madahArakaH
verses.translation: Desiring to attain Siva as her husband, she went to the dense forest and performed a pure penance. She was attended upon by two of her friends.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजेश्वर उवाच । राजन् क्व ते महास्त्राणि क्व ते त्राणं महद्धनुः । क्व ते द्वादशसाहस्रमहानागयुतं बलम्
verses.transliteration: dvijeshvara uvAcha | rAjan kva te mahAstrANi kva te trANaM mahaddhanuH | kva te dvAdashasAhasramahAnAgayutaM balam
verses.translation: In order to test her penance, Siva an expert in various kinds of sports sent the seven sages®® to the penance grove of Parvati.

verses.sanskrit: किं ते खड्गेन शङ्खेन किं ते मन्त्रास्त्रविद्यया । किं सत्त्वेन महास्त्राणां किं प्रभावेण भूयसा
verses.transliteration: kiM te khaDgena sha~Nkhena kiM te mantrAstravidyayA | kiM sattvena mahAstrANAM kiM prabhAveNa bhUyasA
verses.translation: The sages went there and thoroughly tested her. As she was strenuous in her effort they could not dissuade her from her penance.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं विफलं जातं यच्चान्यत्त्वयि तिष्ठति । यस्त्वं वनौकसां घातं न निवारयितुं क्षमः
verses.transliteration: tatsarvaM viphalaM jAtaM yachchAnyattvayi tiShThati | yastvaM vanaukasAM ghAtaM na nivArayituM kShamaH
verses.translation: They returned and bowed to Siva. After mention¬ ing all the details to him and obtaining his permission they returned to heaven eagerly.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रस्यायं परो धर्मो क्षताच्च परिरक्षणम् । तस्मिन्कुलोचिते धर्मे नष्टे त्वज्जीवितेन किम्
verses.transliteration: kShatrasyAyaM paro dharmo kShatAchcha parirakShaNam | tasminkulochite dharme naShTe tvajjIvitena kim
verses.translation: When they had gone to their abodes, lord Siva, the cause of excellent sports, desired to test Siva's activity himself.

verses.sanskrit: आर्तानां शरणाप्तानां त्राणं कुर्वन्ति पार्थिवाः । प्राणैरर्थैश्च धर्मज्ञास्तद्विना च मृतोपमाः
verses.transliteration: ArtAnAM sharaNAptAnAM trANaM kurvanti pArthivAH | prANairarthaishcha dharmaj~nAstadvinA cha mR^itopamAH
verses.translation: The seven sages are: Marici, Atri, AAgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, K.ratu and Vasitha. See P. 163 note.

verses.sanskrit: आर्तत्राणविहीनानां जीवितान्मरणं वरम् । धनिनां दानहीनानां गार्हस्थ्याद्भिक्षुता वरम्
verses.transliteration: ArtatrANavihInAnAM jIvitAnmaraNaM varam | dhaninAM dAnahInAnAM gArhasthyAdbhikShutA varam
verses.translation: Then the lord assumed the pleasant, self-controlled and wonderful form of a student-ascetic.

verses.sanskrit: वरं विषाशनं प्राज्ञैर्वरमग्निप्रवेशनम् । कृपणानामनाथानां दीनानामपरक्षणात्
verses.transliteration: varaM viShAshanaM prAj~nairvaramagnipraveshanam | kR^ipaNAnAmanAthAnAM dInAnAmaparakShaNAt
verses.translation: He looked very old and had assumed the body of a brahmin. He was shining with brilliance. He had a staff and an umbrella. He was mentally delighted.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्थं विलपितं तस्य स्ववीर्यस्य च गर्हणम् । निशम्य नृपतिः शोकादात्मन्येवमचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | itthaM vilapitaM tasya svavIryasya cha garhaNam | nishamya nR^ipatiH shokAdAtmanyevamachintayat
verses.translation: Assuming this form of a Jaila (one with matted hair), the delighted Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees went to the penance-grove of Parvati.

verses.sanskrit: तद्धर्मस्य परीक्षार्थं पुनराविर्बभूव सः । द्विजेश्वरस्वरूपेण तदेव कथयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: taddharmasya parIkShArthaM punarAvirbabhUva saH | dvijeshvarasvarUpeNa tadeva kathayAmyaham
