verses.translation: There he saw the goddess Parvati, seated on the dais surrounded by her friends. She appeared like the pure digit of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: अहो मे पौरुषं नष्टमद्य दैवविपर्ययात् । अद्य कीर्तिश्च मे नष्टा पातकं प्राप्तमुत्कटम्
verses.transliteration: aho me pauruShaM naShTamadya daivaviparyayAt | adya kIrtishcha me naShTA pAtakaM prAptamutkaTam
verses.translation: On seeing the brahmin visitor of wonderful splendour, quiet with hairy limbs, bearing the staff and hide of deer, the aged bachelor with matted hair and the water-pot, she welcomed and worshipped him with all the articles of worship.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मः कुलोचितो नष्टो मन्दभाग्यस्य दुर्मतेः । नूनं मे सम्पदो राज्यमायुष्यं क्षयमेष्यति
verses.transliteration: dharmaH kulochito naShTo mandabhAgyasya durmateH | nUnaM me sampado rAjyamAyuShyaM kShayameShyati
verses.translation: The goddess Parvati enquired after the health of that aged bachelor respectfully after worshipping him with great joy.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य चैनं द्विजन्मानं हतदारं शुचार्दितम् । हतशोकं करिष्यामि दत्त्वा प्राणानतिप्रियान्
verses.transliteration: adya chainaM dvijanmAnaM hatadAraM shuchArditam | hatashokaM kariShyAmi dattvA prANAnatipriyAn
verses.translation: "O most excellent one among the knowers of the Vedas, who are you, please, in the guise of a student-ascetic and whence have you come illuminating this forest?

verses.sanskrit: इति निश्चित्य मनसा स भद्रायुर्नृपोत्तमः । पतित्वा पादयोस्तस्य बभाषे परिसान्त्वयन्
verses.transliteration: iti nishchitya manasA sa bhadrAyurnR^ipottamaH | patitvA pAdayostasya babhAShe parisAntvayan
verses.translation: On being asked thus by Parvati, that brahmin replied immediately with great pleasure in order to test the feelings of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुरुवाच । कृपां कृत्वा मयि ब्रह्मन् क्षत्रबन्धौ हतौजसि । शोकन्त्यज महाप्राज्ञ दास्याम्यद्य तु वाञ्छितम्
verses.transliteration: bhadrAyuruvAcha | kR^ipAM kR^itvA mayi brahman kShatrabandhau hataujasi | shokantyaja mahAprAj~na dAsyAmyadya tu vA~nChitam
verses.translation: I am a brahmin bachelor going about here and there as I please. I am a saint pleasing and helping others undoubtedly.

verses.sanskrit: इदं राज्यमियं राज्ञी ममेदं च कलेवरम् । त्वदधीनमिदं सर्वं किन्तेऽभिलषितं वरम्
verses.transliteration: idaM rAjyamiyaM rAj~nI mamedaM cha kalevaram | tvadadhInamidaM sarvaM kinte.abhilaShitaM varam
verses.translation: In your fresh youth, the means of good enjoyment and the cause of happiness through all requisite articles of pleasure, you are performing this penance in vain.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच । किमादर्शेन चान्धस्य किं गृहेर्भैक्ष्यजीविनः । किं पुस्तकेन मूढस्य निस्त्रीकस्य धनेन किम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNa uvAcha | kimAdarshena chAndhasya kiM gR^iherbhaikShyajIvinaH | kiM pustakena mUDhasya nistrIkasya dhanena kim
verses.translation: Who are you? Whose daughter are you? Why are you performing a penance in this desolate forest? Your penance is such as cannot be outdone even by sages of elevated souls.

verses.sanskrit: अतोऽहं हतपत्नीको भुक्तभोगो न कर्हिचित् । इमान्तवाग्रमहिषीं कामये दीयतामिति
verses.transliteration: ato.ahaM hatapatnIko bhuktabhogo na karhichit | imAntavAgramahiShIM kAmaye dIyatAmiti
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Parvati laughed and spoke to the excellent student ascetic with reverence.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुरुवाच दाता रसान्तवित्तस्य राज्यस्य गजवाजिनाम् । आत्मदेहस्य कस्यापि कलत्रस्य न कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: bhadrAyuruvAcha dAtA rasAntavittasya rAjyasya gajavAjinAm | Atmadehasya kasyApi kalatrasya na karhichit
verses.translation: O sage, O brahmin bachelor, listen to the details of my wife. I am born in Bharata in the house of Himavat.

verses.sanskrit: परदारोपभोगेन यत्पापं समुपार्जितम् । न तत्क्षालयितुं शक्यं प्रायश्चित्तशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: paradAropabhogena yatpApaM samupArjitam | na tatkShAlayituM shakyaM prAyashchittashatairapi
verses.translation: O brahmin, in this birth too, Siva came my way due to merit but he reduced Kama to ashes, abandoned me and went away.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषभस्य प्रभावेण शत्रूञ्जित्वा रणे प्रभुः । प्राप्तसिंहासनस्तात भद्रायुः सम्बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: R^iShabhasya prabhAveNa shatrU~njitvA raNe prabhuH | prAptasiMhAsanastAta bhadrAyuH sambabhUva ha
verses.translation: Mentally, verbally and through activities too, Siva has been chosen by me as my husband. I am telling you the truth and not falsehood.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच । आस्तां ब्रह्मवधं घोरमपि मद्यनिषेवणम् । तपसा विधमिष्यामि किं पुनः पारदारिकम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNa uvAcha | AstAM brahmavadhaM ghoramapi madyaniShevaNam | tapasA vidhamiShyAmi kiM punaH pAradArikam
verses.translation: For the close similarity of ideas and verbal expressions in verses 20 to 61, see Kalidasa's Kumira V., also RudrasamhitS, Ffirvati- kharjda, Cbs 26, 27.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रयच्छ भार्यां स्वामियां कामो न मेऽपरः । अरक्षणाद्भयार्तानां गन्तासि निरयं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAtprayachCha bhAryAM svAmiyAM kAmo na me.aparaH | arakShaNAdbhayArtAnAM gantAsi nirayaM dhruvam
verses.translation: Leaving off Indra and other gods, Vi?nu and Brahma I wish to obtain iSiva as my husband really.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति विप्रगिरा भीतश्चिन्तयामास पार्थिवः । अरक्षणान्महापापं पत्नीदानं ततो वरम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti vipragirA bhItashchintayAmAsa pArthivaH | arakShaNAnmahApApaM patnIdAnaM tato varam
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing these firm words of Parvat! that Jatila Rudra laughingly spoke again.

verses.sanskrit: अतः पत्नीं द्विजाग्र्याय दत्त्वा निर्मुक्तकिल्बिषः । सद्यो वह्निं प्रवेक्ष्यामि कीर्तिश्च विदिता भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ataH patnIM dvijAgryAya dattvA nirmuktakilbiShaH | sadyo vahniM pravekShyAmi kIrtishcha viditA bhavet
verses.translation: O gentle lady, O daughter of Himavat, what is this idea that has struck you? You are performing this great penance for obtaining Iiva after leaving off all the gods.

verses.sanskrit: इति निश्चित्य मनसा समुज्ज्वाल्य हुताशनम् । तमाहूय द्विजं चक्रे पत्नीदानं सहोदकम्
verses.transliteration: iti nishchitya manasA samujjvAlya hutAshanam | tamAhUya dvijaM chakre patnIdAnaM sahodakam
verses.translation: I know that iSiva. Listen. I shall tell you that bull-bannered Siva wears matted hair and is ill-mannered.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं स्नातः शुचिर्भूत्वा प्रणम्य विबुधेश्वरान् । तमग्निं त्रिः परिक्रम्य शिवं दध्यौ समाहितः
verses.transliteration: svayaM snAtaH shuchirbhUtvA praNamya vibudheshvarAn | tamagniM triH parikramya shivaM dadhyau samAhitaH
verses.translation: O gentle lady, your features etc. and those of Siva are ill-matched. I do not like this. But do as you please.

verses.sanskrit: तमथाग्निं पतिष्यन्तं स्वपदासक्तचेतसम् । प्रत्यषेधत विश्वेशः प्रादुर्भूतो द्विजेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tamathAgniM patiShyantaM svapadAsaktachetasam | pratyaShedhata vishveshaH prAdurbhUto dvijeshvaraH
verses.translation: After saying this, Siva in the guise of a student- ascetic rebuked himself in her presence in order to test her.

verses.sanskrit: तमीश्वरं पञ्चमुखं त्रिनेत्रं पिनाकिनं चन्द्रकलावतंसम् । प्रलम्बपिङ्गांशुजटाकलापं मध्याह्नसद्भास्करकोटितेजसम्
verses.transliteration: tamIshvaraM pa~nchamukhaM trinetraM pinAkinaM chandrakalAvataMsam | pralambapi~NgAMshujaTAkalApaM madhyAhnasadbhAskarakoTitejasam
verses.translation: On hearing his intolerable words, Parvati replied extremely infuriated at him who was engrossed in insulting liva.

verses.sanskrit: मृणालगौरं गजचर्मवाससं गङ्गातरङ्गोक्षितमौलिदेशकम् । नागेन्द्रहारावलिकण्ठभूषणं किरीटकाञ्च्यङ्गदकङ्कणोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: mR^iNAlagauraM gajacharmavAsasaM ga~NgAtara~NgokShitamaulideshakam | nAgendrahArAvalikaNThabhUShaNaM kirITakA~nchya~Ngadaka~NkaNojjvalam
verses.translation: Till now I thought that you would be some one fit to be killed. But now it is quite clear that you are not to be killed.

verses.sanskrit: शूलासिखट्वाङ्गकुठारचर्म- मृगाभयाष्टाङ्गपिनाकहस्तम् । वृषोपरिस्थं शितिकण्ठभूषणं प्रोद्भूतमग्रे स नृपो ददर्श
verses.transliteration: shUlAsikhaTvA~NgakuThAracharma\- mR^igAbhayAShTA~NgapinAkahastam | vR^iShoparisthaM shitikaNThabhUShaNaM prodbhUtamagre sa nR^ipo dadarsha
verses.translation: You are some foolish knave in the guise of a student-ascetic. O fool, l§iva has been insulted by you. Hence, I am infuriated.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्राङ्गदस्य तनया सीमन्तिन्याः शुभाङ्गजा । पत्नी तस्याभवद् ब्रह्मन्सुसाध्वी कीर्तिमालिनी
verses.transliteration: chandrA~Ngadasya tanayA sImantinyAH shubhA~NgajA | patnI tasyAbhavad brahmansusAdhvI kIrtimAlinI
verses.translation: You do not know Siva, You are averse to Siva. Since I had already welcomed and honoured you I am now distressed.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽम्बराद् द्रुतं पेतुर्दिव्याः कुसुमवृष्टयः । प्रणेदुर्देवतूर्य्याणि देव्यश्च ननृतुर्जगुः
verses.transliteration: tato.ambarAd drutaM peturdivyAH kusumavR^iShTayaH | praNedurdevatUryyANi devyashcha nanR^iturjaguH
verses.translation: The accumulated merits of the person who insults Siva without knowing reality are reduced to ashes.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राजग्मुः स्तूयमाना हरिर्ब्रह्मा तथासुराः । इन्द्रादयो नारदाद्या मुनयश्चापरेऽपि च
verses.transliteration: tatrAjagmuH stUyamAnA harirbrahmA tathAsurAH | indrAdayo nAradAdyA munayashchApare.api cha
verses.translation: One should perform, expiation after touching a Siva-hater.

verses.sanskrit: तदोत्सवो महानासीत्तत्र भक्तिप्रवर्धनः । सति पश्यति भूपाले भक्तिनम्रीकृताञ्जलौ
verses.transliteration: tadotsavo mahAnAsIttatra bhaktipravardhanaH | sati pashyati bhUpAle bhaktinamrIkR^itA~njalau
verses.translation: O wicked fellow, you said I know Siva. Certainly he is not known to you. Siva alone is the great lord.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दर्शनानन्दविजृम्भिताशयः प्रवृद्धबाष्पाम्बुविलिप्तगात्रः । प्रहृष्टरोमा स हि गद्गदाक्षरस्तुष्टाव गीर्भिर्मुकुलीकृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: taddarshanAnandavijR^imbhitAshayaH pravR^iddhabAShpAmbuviliptagAtraH | prahR^iShTaromA sa hi gadgadAkSharastuShTAva gIrbhirmukulIkR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: Assuming many guises through his Maya,*Rudra may appear in any form. But the beloved of the good, having no aberrations, lavishly bestows all desired things on me.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्स भगवान् राज्ञा संस्तुतः परमेश्वरः । प्रसन्नः सह पार्वत्या तमुवाच दयानिधिः
verses.transliteration: tatassa bhagavAn rAj~nA saMstutaH parameshvaraH | prasannaH saha pArvatyA tamuvAcha dayAnidhiH
verses.translation: After saying this, Parvati expatiated on Siva's principle, where Siva was explained as attributeless and un> changing performing the penance of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: राजंस्ते परितुष्टोऽहं भक्त्या त्वद्धर्मतोऽधिकम् । वरं ब्रूहि सपत्नीकम्प्रयच्छामि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: rAjaMste parituShTo.ahaM bhaktyA tvaddharmato.adhikam | varaM brUhi sapatnIkamprayachChAmi na saMshayaH
verses.translation: On hearing her words, the brahmin began to say something; but by that time, Parvati whose mind was attached to Siva and who was averse to Siva being insulted, immediately spoke to her friend Vijaya.

verses.sanskrit: तव भावपरीक्षार्थं द्विजो भूत्वाहमागतः । व्याघ्रेण या परिग्रस्ता साक्षाद्देवी शिवा हि सा
verses.transliteration: tava bhAvaparIkShArthaM dvijo bhUtvAhamAgataH | vyAghreNa yA parigrastA sAkShAddevI shivA hi sA
verses.translation: Friend, this base brahmin must be prevented. He is going to speak again. He is sure to insult Siva.

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रो मायामयो यस्ते शरैरक्षत विग्रहः । धीरतान् द्रष्टुकामस्ते पत्नीं याचितवानहम्
verses.transliteration: vyAghro mAyAmayo yaste sharairakShata vigrahaH | dhIratAn draShTukAmaste patnIM yAchitavAnaham
verses.translation: A rebuker of Siva shall be slain by all means by Siva's attendants. If he happens to be a brahmin he shall be abandoned. He shall go away from that place imme¬ diately.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य प्रभोर्वाक्यं स भद्रायुर्महीपतिः । पुनः प्रणम्य संस्तूय स्वामिनं नतकोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAkarNya prabhorvAkyaM sa bhadrAyurmahIpatiH | punaH praNamya saMstUya svAminaM natako.abravIt
verses.translation: This wicked fellow will insult Siva again. Being a brahmin he cannot be killed. He shall be abandoned. He should not even be looked at.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुरुवाच । एक एव वरो नाथ यद्भवान्परमेश्वरः । भवतापप्रतप्तस्य मम प्रत्यक्षतां गतः
verses.transliteration: bhadrAyuruvAcha | eka eva varo nAtha yadbhavAnparameshvaraH | bhavatApaprataptasya mama pratyakShatAM gataH
verses.translation: Let us leave this place and go elsewhere. Do not delay, lest there should be any further talk with this igno¬ rant man.

verses.sanskrit: स भद्रायुः कदाचित्स्वप्रियया गहनं वनम् । प्राविशत्संविहारार्थं वसन्तसमये मुने
verses.transliteration: sa bhadrAyuH kadAchitsvapriyayA gahanaM vanam | prAvishatsaMvihArArthaM vasantasamaye mune
verses.translation: After assuming that divine form which Parvati was meditating upon, Siva spoke to her as she stood face downwards.

verses.sanskrit: यद्ददासि पुनर्नाथ वरं स्वकृपया प्रभो । वृणेऽहं परमं त्वत्तो वरं हि वरदर्षभात्
verses.transliteration: yaddadAsi punarnAtha varaM svakR^ipayA prabho | vR^iNe.ahaM paramaM tvatto varaM hi varadarShabhAt
verses.translation: ''O Parvati, where are you going, leaving me? You cannot be forsaken by me. You have been tested by me O faultless one, you are really steady in your devotion to me.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रबाहुः पिता मे हि सपत्नीको महेश्वर । सपत्नीकस्त्वहं नाथ सदा त्वत्पादसेवकः
verses.transliteration: vajrabAhuH pitA me hi sapatnIko maheshvara | sapatnIkastvahaM nAtha sadA tvatpAdasevakaH
verses.translation: Desirous of knowing your feelings I have ap¬ proached you in the guise of a student-asectic and spoke these diverse words.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यः पद्माकरो नाम तत्पुत्रः सनयाभिधः । सर्वानेतान्महेशान सदा त्वं पार्श्वगान्कुरु
verses.transliteration: vaishyaH padmAkaro nAma tatputraH sanayAbhidhaH | sarvAnetAnmaheshAna sadA tvaM pArshvagAnkuru
verses.translation: O Parvati, I am delighted at your steady devotion. Mention the boon that you have cherished in your mind. There is nothing that cannot be given to you.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथ राज्ञी च तत्पत्नी प्रमत्ता कीर्तिमालिनी । भक्त्या प्रसाद्य गिरिशं ययाचे वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | atha rAj~nI cha tatpatnI pramattA kIrtimAlinI | bhaktyA prasAdya girishaM yayAche varamuttamam
verses.translation: O loving lady, I have been made your slave from now onwards by means of your penance. Due to your beauty, even a moment seems to expand into a Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञ्युवाच । चन्द्राङ्गदो मम पिता माता सीमन्तिनी च मे । तयोर्याचे महादेव त्वत्पाश्वे सन्निधिं मुदा
verses.transliteration: rAj~nyuvAcha | chandrA~Ngado mama pitA mAtA sImantinI cha me | tayoryAche mahAdeva tvatpAshve sannidhiM mudA
verses.translation: Leave off your bashfulness. You are my eternal wife. O beloved, come on, I shall go to my hilly abode along with you.**

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमस्त्विति गौरीशः प्रसन्नो भक्तवत्सलः । तयोः कामवरान्दत्त्वा क्षणादन्तर्हितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamastviti gaurIshaH prasanno bhaktavatsalaH | tayoH kAmavarAndattvA kShaNAdantarhito.abhavat
verses.translation: When the lord of gods said thus, Parvati rejoiced much. Whatever misery she experienced in performing the penance, she cast off immediately.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायुरपि सुप्रीत्या प्रसादं प्राप्य शूलिनः । सहितः कीर्तिमालिन्या बुभुजे विषयान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: bhadrAyurapi suprItyA prasAdaM prApya shUlinaH | sahitaH kIrtimAlinyA bubhuje viShayAnbahUn
verses.translation: On seeing that divine form of Siva, Parvati replied to the lord with face lowered due to bashfulness.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा वर्षायुतं राज्यमव्याहतपराक्रमः । राज्यं विक्षिप्य तनये जगाम शिवसन्निधिम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA varShAyutaM rAjyamavyAhataparAkramaH | rAjyaM vikShipya tanaye jagAma shivasannidhim
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if you have pity on me, be my lord and husband."

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्राङ्गदोऽपि राजेन्द्रो राज्ञी सीमन्तिनी च सा । भक्त्या सम्पूज्य गिरिशं जग्मतुः शाम्भवं पदम्
verses.transliteration: chandrA~Ngado.api rAjendro rAj~nI sImantinI cha sA | bhaktyA sampUjya girishaM jagmatuH shAmbhavaM padam
verses.translation: O dear, thus the incarnation of Siva in the form of a student-ascctic wherein he tested the feelings of Parvati has been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजेश्वरावतारस्ते वर्णितः परमो मया । महेश्वरस्य भद्रायुपरमानन्ददः प्रभो
verses.transliteration: dvijeshvarAvatAraste varNitaH paramo mayA | maheshvarasya bhadrAyuparamAnandadaH prabho
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, listen to the incarna* tion of lord Siva, the great soul, as Sunartaka nata.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्मिन्वने रम्ये विजहार स भूपतिः । शरणागतपालिन्या तया स्वप्रियया सह
verses.transliteration: atha tasminvane ramye vijahAra sa bhUpatiH | sharaNAgatapAlinyA tayA svapriyayA saha
verses.translation: O sage, when goddess Parvatl, daughter of Him- avat, performed the pious penance in order to attain Siva, after going to the forest, Siva was much delighted at her austerity. He approached to test her conduct and out of pleasure to grant her the desired boon.

verses.sanskrit: इदं चरित्रं परमं पवित्रं शिवावतारस्य पवित्रकीर्त्तेः । द्विजेशसंज्ञस्य महाद्भुतं हि शृण्वन्पठन् शम्भुपदं प्रयाति
verses.transliteration: idaM charitraM paramaM pavitraM shivAvatArasya pavitrakIrtteH | dvijeshasa.nj~nasya mahAdbhutaM hi shR^iNvanpaThan shambhupadaM prayAti
verses.translation: O sage, the delighted Siva revealed his real form to her and told Parvatl, "Mention the boon you wish to have."

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । न श्चोतति स्वधर्मात्स परत्र लभते गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM shR^iNuyAnnityaM shrAvayedvA samAhitaH | na shchotati svadharmAtsa paratra labhate gatim
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Siva and on seeing his excellent form, Parvati was delighted. She spoke to him after paying her homage.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तद्धर्मदृढतां प्रतीक्षन्परमेश्वरः । लीलां चकार तत्रैव शिवया सह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: atha taddharmadR^iDhatAM pratIkShanparameshvaraH | lIlAM chakAra tatraiva shivayA saha sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if a boon shall be granted to me, O Siva, you be my lord and husband. Please take pity on me.

verses.sanskrit: शिवा शिवश्च भूत्वोभौ तद्वने द्विजदम्पती । व्याघ्रं मायामयं कृत्वाविर्भूतौ निजलीलया
verses.transliteration: shivA shivashcha bhUtvobhau tadvane dvijadampatI | vyAghraM mAyAmayaM kR^itvAvirbhUtau nijalIlayA
verses.translation: With your permission I shall go to my father's abode. O lord, you shall approach my father.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O lord Siva, it behoves to marry me with due rites for the fulfilment of the task of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O lord Siva, it behoves to marry me with due rites for the fulfilment of the task of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२८. अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः । यतिनाथब्रह्महंसाह्वयशिवावतारचरितवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु प्राज्ञ प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । अवतारं परानन्दं यतिनाथाह्वयं मुने
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.28\. aShTAviMsho.adhyAyaH | yatinAthabrahmahaMsAhvayashivAvatAracharitavarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | shR^iNu prAj~na pravakShyAmi shivasya paramAtmanaH | avatAraM parAnandaM yatinAthAhvayaM mune
verses.translation: O lord, you are without aberrations. Please fulfil my desires. You are favourably disposed to the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तः स यतिस्तेन गमनाय मतिं दधे । तावद्भिल्ल्या वचः प्रोक्तं स्वामिनं संविचार्य वै
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktaH sa yatistena gamanAya matiM dadhe | tAvadbhillyA vachaH proktaM svAminaM saMvichArya vai
verses.translation: After making her beauty fruitful, Parvatl returned

verses.sanskrit: भिल्ल्युवाच । स्वामिन्देहि यतेः स्थानं विमुखं कुरु मातिथिम् । गृहधर्मं विचार्य त्वमन्यथा धर्मसङ्क्षयः
verses.transliteration: bhillyuvAcha | svAmindehi yateH sthAnaM vimukhaM kuru mAtithim | gR^ihadharmaM vichArya tvamanyathA dharmasa~NkShayaH
verses.translation: On hearing Parvati's return, Himavat accompanied by his attendants and his wife Mena joyously came to see his daughter.

verses.sanskrit: स्थीयतां ते गृहाभ्यन्तः सुखेन यतिना सह । अहं बहिः स्थितिं कुर्यामायुधानि बृहन्त्यपि
verses.transliteration: sthIyatAM te gR^ihAbhyantaH sukhena yatinA saha | ahaM bahiH sthitiM kuryAmAyudhAni bR^ihantyapi
verses.translation: On seeing her delighted, both of them received her suitably wiihin the house and glad at heart celebrated the event with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भिल्ल्या धर्मान्वितं शिवम् । स्वपत्न्या मनसा तेन भिल्लेन च विचारितम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tasyAstadvachanaM shrutvA bhillyA dharmAnvitaM shivam | svapatnyA manasA tena bhillena cha vichAritam
verses.translation: Then Mena joyously stayed for a while in the yard with her daughter and Himavat went to the Ganges for a bath.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियं बहिश्च निष्कास्य कथं स्थेयं मया गृहे । यतेरन्यत्र गमनमधर्मकरमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: striyaM bahishcha niShkAsya kathaM stheyaM mayA gR^ihe | yateranyatra gamanamadharmakaramAtmanaH
verses.translation: In the meantime Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees and indulging in good sports, assumed the form of a dancer and approached Menaka.

verses.sanskrit: द्वयमप्युचितं नैव सर्वथा गृहमेधिनः । यद्भावि तद्भवेदेव मया स्थेयं गृहाद् बहिः
verses.transliteration: dvayamapyuchitaM naiva sarvathA gR^ihamedhinaH | yadbhAvi tadbhavedeva mayA stheyaM gR^ihAd bahiH
verses.translation: He held the horn in his left hand and the small drum in his right. He carried a bundle of patched garments on his back. He wore a red cloth. He appeared to be an expert in dance and music.

verses.sanskrit: इत्याग्रहं तदा कृत्वा गृहान्तः स्थाप्य तौ मुदा । स्वायुधानि च संस्थाप्य भिल्लोऽतिष्ठद् गृहाद् बहिः
verses.transliteration: ityAgrahaM tadA kR^itvA gR^ihAntaH sthApya tau mudA | svAyudhAni cha saMsthApya bhillo.atiShThad gR^ihAd bahiH
verses.translation: Then the lord in the form of a dancer performed various dances joyously in the yard of Menaka and sang sweetly.

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ तं पशवः क्रूराः हिंसकाः समपीडयन् । तेनापि च यथाशक्ति कृतो यत्नो महांस्तदा
verses.transliteration: rAtrau taM pashavaH krUrAH hiMsakAH samapIDayan | tenApi cha yathAshakti kR^ito yatno mahAMstadA
verses.translation: He blew on the horn and played on Damaru pro¬ ducing sweet notes. With great pleasure he exhibited a variety of splendid sports.

verses.sanskrit: एवं यत्नं प्रकुर्वाणः स भिल्लो बलवानपि । प्रारब्धात्प्रेरितैर्हिंस्रैर्बलादासीच्च भक्षितः
verses.transliteration: evaM yatnaM prakurvANaH sa bhillo balavAnapi | prArabdhAtpreritairhiMsrairbalAdAsIchcha bhakShitaH
verses.translation: The citizens including men, women, children and old women gathered there suddenly to see him.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरुत्थाय स यतिर्दृष्ट्वा हिंस्रैश्च भक्षितम् । भिल्लं वनेचरं तं वै दुःखितोऽभूदतीव हि
verses.transliteration: prAtarutthAya sa yatirdR^iShTvA hiMsraishcha bhakShitam | bhillaM vanecharaM taM vai duHkhito.abhUdatIva hi
verses.translation: O sage, hearing the sweet song and witnessing the splendid dance, the people were fascinated and Mena too was highly delighted.

verses.sanskrit: अर्बुदाचलसंज्ञे तु पर्वते भिल्लवंशजः । आहुकश्च तदभ्याशे वसति स्म मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: arbudAchalasa.nj~ne tu parvate bhillavaMshajaH | Ahukashcha tadabhyAshe vasati sma munIshvara
verses.translation: He did not accept those gems. He wished to have Parvati for his alms. Eagerly he began to dance and sing again.

verses.sanskrit: दुखितं तं यतिं दृष्ट्वा भिल्ली सा दुःखितापि हि । धैर्यात्स्वदुःखं संहृत्य वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: dukhitaM taM yatiM dR^iShTvA bhillI sA duHkhitApi hi | dhairyAtsvaduHkhaM saMhR^itya vachanaM chedamabravIt
verses.translation: In the meantime the lord of the mountains re¬ turned from the Ganges. He saw the mendicant in the form of a man standing before him in the yard.

verses.sanskrit: भिल्ल्युवाच । किमर्थं क्रियते दुःखं भद्रं जातं यतेऽधुना । धन्योऽयं कृतकृत्यश्च यज्जातो मृत्युरीदृशः
verses.transliteration: bhillyuvAcha | kimarthaM kriyate duHkhaM bhadraM jAtaM yate.adhunA | dhanyo.ayaM kR^itakR^ityashcha yajjAto mR^ityurIdR^ishaH
verses.translation: On hearing from Mena all the details he too was infuriated. He ordered his attendants to drive out the mendicant.

verses.sanskrit: अहं चैनं गमिष्यामि भस्म भूत्वानले यते । चितां कारय सुप्रीत्या स्त्रीणां धर्मः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: ahaM chainaM gamiShyAmi bhasma bhUtvAnale yate | chitAM kAraya suprItyA strINAM dharmaH sanAtanaH
verses.translation: O excellent sage, no one could drive him out. He was blazing and brilliant like a big fire and could not be touched.

verses.sanskrit: इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हितं मत्वा स्वयं यतिः । चितां व्यरचयत्सा हि प्रविवेश स्वधर्मतः
verses.transliteration: iti tadvachanaM shrutvA hitaM matvA svayaM yatiH | chitAM vyarachayatsA hi pravivesha svadharmataH
verses.translation: O dear, then that mendicant, an expert in differ¬ ent sports, exhibited his infinite power to the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे साक्षात्पुरः प्रादुरभूच्छिवः । धन्ये धन्ये इति प्रीत्या प्रशंसस्तां हरोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare sAkShAtpuraH prAdurabhUchChivaH | dhanye dhanye iti prItyA prashaMsastAM haro.abravIt
verses.translation: Immediately the mountain saw him assuming the form of Visnu, then the form of Brahma and in a trice that of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: हर उवाच । वरं ब्रूहि प्रसन्नोऽस्मि त्वदाचरणतोऽनघे । तवादेयं न वै किञ्चिद् वश्योऽहं ते विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: hara uvAcha | varaM brUhi prasanno.asmi tvadAcharaNato.anaghe | tavAdeyaM na vai ki~nchid vashyo.ahaM te visheShataH
verses.translation: O dear, then he saw him in the excessively wonderful form of Siva accompanied by Parvatl. He was exquisitely handsome and brilliant. He was laughing.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तच्छुत्वा शम्भुवचनं परमानन्ददायकम् । सुखं प्राप्तं विशेषेण न किञ्चित्स्मरणं ययौ
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tachChutvA shambhuvachanaM paramAnandadAyakam | sukhaM prAptaM visheSheNa na ki~nchitsmaraNaM yayau
verses.translation: Thus he saw him in various forms. He was much surprised and extremely delighted.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तद्गतिमालक्ष्य सुप्रसन्नो हरोऽभवत् । उवाच च पुनः शम्भुर्वरं ब्रूहीति तां प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tasyAstadgatimAlakShya suprasanno haro.abhavat | uvAcha cha punaH shambhurvaraM brUhIti tAM prabhuH
verses.translation: Then the leading mendicant of good sports beg¬ ged for Durga as his alms, of her (Mena) and of him (the mountain). He did not accept anything else.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । अयं यतिश्च मद्रूपो हंसरूपो भविष्यति । परजन्मनि वां प्रीत्या संयोगं कारयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | ayaM yatishcha madrUpo haMsarUpo bhaviShyati | parajanmani vAM prItyA saMyogaM kArayiShyati
verses.translation: Then lord Siva in the form of the mendicant, urged by Durga's words vanished and went away to his abode suddenly.

verses.sanskrit: भिल्लश्च वीरसेनस्य नैषधे नगरे वरे । महान्पुत्रो नलो नाम भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhillashcha vIrasenasya naiShadhe nagare vare | mahAnputro nalo nAma bhaviShyati na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Perfect knowledge then dawned on Mena and the lord of mountains. They thought: "The lord Siva has deceived us and returned to his abode.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पत्नी ह्याहुका नाम बभूव किल सुव्रता । उभावपि महाशैवावास्तां तौ शिवपूजकौ
verses.transliteration: tatpatnI hyAhukA nAma babhUva kila suvratA | ubhAvapi mahAshaivAvAstAM tau shivapUjakau
verses.translation: Our Parvatl who has performed a hard penance shall be given to him", thinking thus they became extreme¬ ly devoted to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सुता भीमराजस्य वैदर्भे नगरेऽनघे । दमयन्ती च विख्याता भविष्यसि गुणान्विता
verses.transliteration: tvaM sutA bhImarAjasya vaidarbhe nagare.anaghe | damayantI cha vikhyAtA bhaviShyasi guNAnvitA
verses.translation: Thence after performing great sports, Siva per¬ formed the marriage rites duly with Parvati delighting all devotees.

verses.sanskrit: युवां चोभौ मिलित्वा च राजभोगं सुविस्तरम् । भुक्त्वा मुक्तिं च योगीन्द्रैर्लप्स्येथे दुर्लभां ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: yuvAM chobhau militvA cha rAjabhogaM suvistaram | bhuktvA muktiM cha yogIndrairlapsyethe durlabhAM dhruvam
verses.translation: O dear, thus the incarnation of Siva as Sunart- aka nata in which the desire of Parvati was fulfilled has been explained to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा च स्वयं शम्भुर्लिङ्गरूपोऽभवत्तदा । तस्मान्न चलितो धर्मादचलेश इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA cha svayaM shambhurli~NgarUpo.abhavattadA | tasmAnna chalito dharmAdachalesha iti smR^itaH
verses.translation: Thus the pious narrative of great value has been

verses.sanskrit: स भिल्ल आहुकश्चापि वीरसेनसुतोऽभवत् । नैषधे नगरे तात नलनामा महानृपः
verses.transliteration: sa bhilla AhukashchApi vIrasenasuto.abhavat | naiShadhe nagare tAta nalanAmA mahAnR^ipaH
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatlcumara, listen to the incarnation of Siva, the supreme soul, as Brahmin in the garb of a saint.

verses.sanskrit: आहुका सा महाभिल्ली भीमस्य तनयाभवत् । वैदर्भे नगरे राज्ञो दमयन्तीति विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: AhukA sA mahAbhillI bhImasya tanayAbhavat | vaidarbhe nagare rAj~no damayantIti vishrutA
verses.translation: On realising the excellent devotion of Mena and Himavat towards Siva, the gods became worried and they consulted one another eagerly.

verses.sanskrit: यतिनाथाह्वयः सोऽपि हंसरूपोऽभवच्छिवः । विवाहं कारयामास दमयन्त्या नलेन वै
verses.transliteration: yatinAthAhvayaH so.api haMsarUpo.abhavachChivaH | vivAhaM kArayAmAsa damayantyA nalena vai
verses.translation: If the mountain were to give his daughter to Siva with undiluted devotion, certainly he will attain salvation immediately.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वसत्काररूपेण महापुण्येन शङ्करः । हंसरूपं विधायैव ताभ्यां सुखमदात्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: pUrvasatkArarUpeNa mahApuNyena sha~NkaraH | haMsarUpaM vidhAyaiva tAbhyAM sukhamadAtprabhuH
verses.translation: He will cast off the stationary state of a mountain and assume a divine form. After giving his daughter in marriage to the trident-bearing lord he will go to Siva's region.

verses.sanskrit: शिवो हंसावतारो हि नानावार्ताविचक्षणः । दमयन्त्या नलस्यापि परमानन्ददायकः
verses.transliteration: shivo haMsAvatAro hi nAnAvArtAvichakShaNaH | damayantyA nalasyApi paramAnandadAyakaH
verses.translation: With the blessings of Siva he will attain identity in form with the great god. He will enjoy all great plea¬ sures there and then attain liberation.

verses.sanskrit: इदं चरितं परमं पवित्रं शिवावतारस्य पवित्रकीर्तेः । यतीशसंज्ञस्य महाद्भुतं हि हंसाह्वयस्यापि विमुक्तिदं हि
verses.transliteration: idaM charitaM paramaM pavitraM shivAvatArasya pavitrakIrteH | yatIshasa.nj~nasya mahAdbhutaM hi haMsAhvayasyApi vimuktidaM hi
verses.translation: O sage, after discussing like this, the gods went to the abode of their preceptor. In order to achieve their self-interest they submitted to the preceptor thus.

verses.sanskrit: यतीशब्रह्महंसाख्यावतारचरितं शुभम् । शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेद्यो हि स लभेत परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yatIshabrahmahaMsAkhyAvatAracharitaM shubham | shR^iNuyAchChrAvayedyo hi sa labheta parAM gatim
verses.translation: O preceptor, please go to the abode of Himavat for the accomplishment of our task. Reproach lord Siva and try to prevent the mountain's excessive devotion to him.

verses.sanskrit: कस्मिंश्चित्समये भिल्लः शिवभक्तिरतः सदा । आहारार्थं स्वपत्न्याश्च सुदूरं स गतो मुने
verses.transliteration: kasmiMshchitsamaye bhillaH shivabhaktirataH sadA | AhArArthaM svapatnyAshcha sudUraM sa gato mune
verses.translation: O preceptor, if the mountain gives his daughter to Siva 'with great faith he will attain salvation. Lei him stay on the Earth itself.

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानमनघं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् । स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं भक्तिवर्धनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: idamAkhyAnamanaghaM sarvakAmaphalapradam | svargyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM bhaktivardhanamuttamam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the gods, he thought over that and spoke to them.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वैतच्चरितं शम्भोर्यतिहंसस्वरूपयोः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा सोऽन्ते शिवपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: shrutvaitachcharitaM shambhoryatihaMsasvarUpayoH | iha sarvasukhaM bhuktvA so.ante shivapuraM vrajet
verses.translation: O gods, one of you shall go to the mountain for achieving the end. I am incapable of doing it.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र गेहे भिल्लस्य शङ्करः । भूत्वा यतिवपुः सायं परीक्षार्थं समाययौ
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra gehe bhillasya sha~NkaraH | bhUtvA yativapuH sAyaM parIkShArthaM samAyayau
verses.translation: Or you all, including Indra, go to Brahma's region. Tell him all your details. He will carry out your work.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवसरे तत्राजगाम स गृहाधिपः । पूजनं च यतीशस्य चकार प्रेमतः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tasminnavasare tatrAjagAma sa gR^ihAdhipaH | pUjanaM cha yatIshasya chakAra premataH sudhIH
verses.translation: On hearing these words and reflecting thereon, the gods went to Brahma's assembly. They submitted all the details to Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तद्भावस्य परीक्षार्थं यतिरूपः स शङ्करः । महालीलातरः प्रीत्या भीतः प्रोवाच दीनगीः
verses.transliteration: tadbhAvasya parIkShArthaM yatirUpaH sa sha~NkaraH | mahAlIlAtaraH prItyA bhItaH provAcha dInagIH
verses.translation: On hearing their words and reflecting deeply Brahma told them—''I shall not censure him, for that will yield misery to us and dispel out happiness for ever.

verses.sanskrit: यतिनाथ उवाच । अद्य स्थलं निवासार्थं देहि मे प्रातरेव हि । यास्यामि सर्वथा भिल्ल स्वस्ति स्यात्तव सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: yatinAtha uvAcha | adya sthalaM nivAsArthaM dehi me prAtareva hi | yAsyAmi sarvathA bhilla svasti syAttava sarvadA
verses.translation: O gods, you go to Kailasa and propitiate Siva. Reques! that lord to go to the abode of Himavat.

verses.sanskrit: भिल्ल उवाच । सत्यं प्रोक्तं त्वया स्वामिन् शृणु मद्वचनं च ते । अति स्वल्पं स्थलं मे हि स्यान्निवासः कथं तव
verses.transliteration: bhilla uvAcha | satyaM proktaM tvayA svAmin shR^iNu madvachanaM cha te | ati svalpaM sthalaM me hi syAnnivAsaH kathaM tava
verses.translation: Let him approach the lord of mountains and cen¬ sure himself. Censuring others is conducive to destruction and censuring oneself is conducive to glory.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the gods, lord l§iva ac¬ cepted their proposal. He laughingly consoled the gods and made them return without worry.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the gods, lord l§iva ac¬ cepted their proposal. He laughingly consoled the gods and made them return without worry.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.२९. एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । कृष्णदर्शनशिवावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सनत्कुमार शम्भोस्त्ववतारं परमं शृणु । नभगज्ञानदं कृष्णदर्शनाह्वयमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.29\. ekonatriMsho.adhyAyaH | kR^iShNadarshanashivAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | sanatkumAra shambhostvavatAraM paramaM shR^iNu | nabhagaj~nAnadaM kR^iShNadarshanAhvayamuttamam
verses.translation: He assumed the form of a brahmin Saint. He held a staff and an umbrella. He wore divine garments. A brilliant caste mark shone on his forehead. He had tied a lalagrama stone round his neck and held a string of crystal beads in his hand. He frequently repeated the names of

verses.sanskrit: नभग उवाच । भ्रातरोऽभक्तकं मह्यं दायं कृत्वा यथातथम् । सर्वे विभक्ताः सुप्रीत्या स्वदायार्थागताय च
verses.transliteration: nabhaga uvAcha | bhrAtaro.abhaktakaM mahyaM dAyaM kR^itvA yathAtatham | sarve vibhaktAH suprItyA svadAyArthAgatAya cha
verses.translation: S«*f P. 54 note; 941 note.

verses.sanskrit: तदा विस्मृतमस्माभिरिदानीं पितरं तव । विभजामो वयं भागं तं गृहाण न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tadA vismR^itamasmAbhiridAnIM pitaraM tava | vibhajAmo vayaM bhAgaM taM gR^ihANa na saMshayaH
verses.translation: On seeing him, Himavai and his attendants stood up and then prostrated before him. They performed A§tahga salvation on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छुत्वा भ्रातृवचनं नभगः परविस्मृतः । तदोपकण्ठमागत्य पितरं समभाषत
verses.transliteration: tachChutvA bhrAtR^ivachanaM nabhagaH paravismR^itaH | tadopakaNThamAgatya pitaraM samabhAShata
verses.translation: Then the lord of mountains asked him "Who are you please?" The brahmin Yogin replied immediately with reverence.

verses.sanskrit: नभग उवाच । हे तात भ्रातरः सर्वे त्यक्त्वा मां न्यभजंश्च ते । पठनार्थं गतश्चाहं ब्रह्मचारी गुरोः कुले
verses.transliteration: nabhaga uvAcha | he tAta bhrAtaraH sarve tyaktvA mAM nyabhajaMshcha te | paThanArthaM gatashchAhaM brahmachArI guroH kule
verses.translation: O niouniain, I am a devotee of Visnu known as Sadhudvija. I possess true vision. I am omniscient and I assist others. By the power of the preceptor I can go everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: तत आगत्य मे पृष्टा दायदानार्थमादरात् । ते त्वामूचुर्विभागं मे तदर्थमहमागतः
verses.transliteration: tata Agatya me pR^iShTA dAyadAnArthamAdarAt | te tvAmUchurvibhAgaM me tadarthamahamAgataH
verses.translation: O excellent mountain, by my divine knowledge, I have known something while I was in my abode. Listen. I shall mention the same with pleasure to you without any arrogance.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य पिता तं प्राह विस्मितः । आश्वास्य श्राद्धदेवः स सत्यधर्मरतं मुने
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tadAkarNya vachastasya pitA taM prAha vismitaH | AshvAsya shrAddhadevaH sa satyadharmarataM mune
verses.translation: O lord of mountains, see for yourself. He has no single relative. You can verify your relatives and your beloved.

verses.sanskrit: मनुरुवाच । तदुक्तं मादृथास्तात प्रतारणकरं हि तत् । न ह्यहं परमं दायं सर्वथा भोगसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: manuruvAcha | taduktaM mAdR^ithAstAta pratAraNakaraM hi tat | na hyahaM paramaM dAyaM sarvathA bhogasAdhanam
verses.translation: Ask Mena and others excluding Parvati. O mount¬ ain, the patient never likes *he medicine but relishes undesir¬ able diet.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि दायभावेन दत्तोऽहं तैः प्रतारिभिः । तव वै जीवनोपायं वदामि शृणु तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: tathApi dAyabhAvena datto.ahaM taiH pratAribhiH | tava vai jIvanopAyaM vadAmi shR^iNu tattvataH
verses.translation: He is without support. He is unattached. He is ugly, devoid of attributes and unchanging. He is hideous. He resides in the cremation ground. He is naked and handles serpents He smears ashes as decoration. Serpents twine round his head. He has fallen from all stages of life. His ways are ever unknown.

verses.sanskrit: सत्रमाङ्गिरसा विप्राः कुर्वन्त्यद्य सुमेधसः । तत्र कर्मणि मुह्यन्ति षष्ठं षष्ठमहः प्रति
verses.transliteration: satramA~NgirasA viprAH kurvantyadya sumedhasaH | tatra karmaNi muhyanti ShaShThaM ShaShThamahaH prati
verses.translation: After saying these factual statements insulting to Siva, Siva of diverse sports, quickly returned to his 5bode.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र त्वं गच्छ नभग तान् सुशंस महाकवे । सूक्ते द्वे वैश्वदेवे हि सत्रं शुद्धं हि तद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tvaM gachCha nabhaga tAn sushaMsa mahAkave | sUkte dve vaishvadeve hi satraM shuddhaM hi tadbhavet
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the brahmin, they thought thus—"What can we do with regard to him who is engrossed in adverse things?"

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखा आसन् श्राद्धदेवसुताश्च ये । नभगस्तत्र नवमो नाभागस्तत्सुतः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ikShvAkupramukhA Asan shrAddhadevasutAshcha ye | nabhagastatra navamo nAbhAgastatsutaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Then Siva performed great sports delighting the devotees. He married Parvati aud carried out the task of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्मणि समाप्ते हि स्वर्यान्तो ब्राह्मणाश्च ते । धनं दास्यन्ति ते तुष्टाः स्वसत्रपरिशेषितम्
verses.transliteration: tatkarmaNi samApte hi svaryAnto brAhmaNAshcha te | dhanaM dAsyanti te tuShTAH svasatraparisheShitam
verses.translation: O dear, thus the incarnation of lord Siva as Sadhu- vesadvija, that carried out the task of the gods has been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य पितुर्वाक्यं नभगः सत्यसारवान् । जगाम तत्र सुप्रीत्या यत्र तत्सत्रमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tadAkarNya piturvAkyaM nabhagaH satyasAravAn | jagAma tatra suprItyA yatra tatsatramuttamam
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this pious narrative, conducive to heaven and longevity, becomes happy and attains salvation.

verses.sanskrit: तदाहः कर्मणि मुने सत्रे तस्मिन्स मानवः । सूक्ते द्वे वैश्वदेवे हि प्रोवाच स्पष्टतः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tadAhaH karmaNi mune satre tasminsa mAnavaH | sUkte dve vaishvadeve hi provAcha spaShTataH sudhIH
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, listen to the incarnation of lord Siva, the great soul Asvatthaman.

verses.sanskrit: समाप्ते कर्मणि ततो विप्रा आङ्गिरसाश्च ते । तस्मै दत्त्वा ययुः स्वर्गं स्वं स्वं सत्रावशेषितम्
verses.transliteration: samApte karmaNi tato viprA A~NgirasAshcha te | tasmai dattvA yayuH svargaM svaM svaM satrAvasheShitam
verses.translation: O sage, though a part of the celestial sage of great intellect Brhaspati, the self-possessed and prudent Drona was born of Bharadvaja but not of any womb.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तदा स्वीकरिष्यन्तं सुसत्रपरिशेषितम् । विज्ञाय गिरिशः सद्य आविर्भूतः सदूतिकृत्
verses.transliteration: tattadA svIkariShyantaM susatraparisheShitam | vij~nAya girishaH sadya AvirbhUtaH sadUtikR^it
verses.translation: Learned men knew Drona as the most excellent, skilful in the lore of archery as well as the Vedas, of varie¬ gated activities, and as one who made his race flourish.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरः श्रीमान्पुरुषः कृष्णदर्शनः । भावं समीक्षितुं भागं दातुं ज्ञानं परं च तत्
verses.transliteration: sarvA~NgasundaraH shrImAnpuruShaH kR^iShNadarshanaH | bhAvaM samIkShituM bhAgaM dAtuM j~nAnaM paraM cha tat
verses.translation: The most excellent brahmin Drona performed an elaborate penance with Siva in view for obtaining a son in order to help the Kauravas.

verses.sanskrit: अथो स शङ्करः शम्भुः परीक्षाकर ईश्वरः । उवाचोत्तरतोऽभ्येत्य नभगं तं हि मानवम्
verses.transliteration: atho sa sha~NkaraH shambhuH parIkShAkara IshvaraH | uvAchottarato.abhyetya nabhagaM taM hi mAnavam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, then the delighted lord Siva, favourably dispensed lo his devotees, appeared in front of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । कस्त्वं गृह्णासि पुरुष ममेदं वास्तुकं वसु । प्रेषितः केन तत्सर्वं सत्यं वद ममाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | kastvaM gR^ihNAsi puruSha mamedaM vAstukaM vasu | preShitaH kena tatsarvaM satyaM vada mamAgrataH
verses.translation: On seeing him, the brahmin Drona whose heart was highly delighted bow'ed to him with palms joined in reverence and eulogised him.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा तद्वचस्तात मानवो नभगः कविः । प्रत्युवाच विनीतात्मा पुरुषं कृष्णदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tachChrutvA tadvachastAta mAnavo nabhagaH kaviH | pratyuvAcha vinItAtmA puruShaM kR^iShNadarshanam
verses.translation: Satisfied and pleased with his eulogy and penance, lord Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees told Drona—-"Mention the boon you wish to choose".

verses.sanskrit: नभग उवाच । ममेदमृषिभिर्दत्तं वसु यज्ञगतं खलु । कथं वारयसे मां त्वं गृह्णतं कृष्णदर्शन
verses.transliteration: nabhaga uvAcha | mamedamR^iShibhirdattaM vasu yaj~nagataM khalu | kathaM vArayase mAM tvaM gR^ihNataM kR^iShNadarshana
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Siva, Drona bowed low and said—"Please give me a son born of your part who will be invincible to every one and who will be very power¬ ful.

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषः सुतस्तस्य विष्णुभक्तो बभूव सः । यस्योपरि प्रसन्नोऽभूद्दुर्वासा ब्रह्मभक्तितः
verses.transliteration: ambarIShaH sutastasya viShNubhakto babhUva saH | yasyopari prasanno.abhUddurvAsA brahmabhaktitaH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Drona, Siva said, "So be it." O dear sage, the lord who bestows happiness, theii vanished.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । आकर्ण्य नाभगं वाक्यमिदं सत्यमुदीरितम् । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा पुरुषः कृष्णदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | AkarNya nAbhagaM vAkyamidaM satyamudIritam | pratyuvAcha prasannAtmA puruShaH kR^iShNadarshanaH
verses.translation: Drona returned to his abode highly delighted and free from illusion. He joyously narrated all the details to his wife.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णदर्शन उवाच । विवादेऽस्मिन्हि नौ तात प्रमाणं जनकस्तव । याहि तं पृच्छ स ब्रूयात्तत्प्रमाणं तु सत्यतः
verses.transliteration: kR^iShNadarshana uvAcha | vivAde.asminhi nau tAta pramANaM janakastava | yAhi taM pR^ichCha sa brUyAttatpramANaM tu satyataH
verses.translation: Taking the due opportunity, lord Siva, the anmhi- lator of all and very powerful was born as Drona's son through a part of himself.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य नभगो मानवः कविः । आगच्छत्पितरं प्रीत्या तदुक्तं पृष्टवान्मुने
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tadAkarNya vachastasya nabhago mAnavaH kaviH | AgachChatpitaraM prItyA taduktaM pR^iShTavAnmune
verses.translation: O sage, he became well known as A-Vatthaman on the earth. He was heroic, had lotus-like eyes and he could reduce the strength of his enemy.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रोदितं समाकर्ण्य श्राद्धदेवः स वै मनुः । स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं प्राप्तस्मृतिरुवाच तम्
verses.transliteration: putroditaM samAkarNya shrAddhadevaH sa vai manuH | smR^itvA shivapadAmbhojaM prAptasmR^itiruvAcha tam
verses.translation: Securing the permission and behest of his father that famous hero helped the Kauravas in the Mahabharata war.

verses.sanskrit: मनुरुवाच । हे तात शृणु मद्वाक्यं स देवः पुरुषः शिवः । तस्यैव सकलं वस्तु यज्ञप्राप्तं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: manuruvAcha | he tAta shR^iNu madvAkyaM sa devaH puruShaH shivaH | tasyaiva sakalaM vastu yaj~naprAptaM visheShataH
verses.translation: By resorting to that powerful hero, Bhisma and other Kauravas became invincible even to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: अध्वरोर्वरितं वस्तु रुद्रभागः प्रकीर्तितः । इत्यपि प्राज्ञवादो हि क्वचिज्जातस्तदिच्छया
verses.transliteration: adhvarorvaritaM vastu rudrabhAgaH prakIrtitaH | ityapi prAj~navAdo hi kvachijjAtastadichChayA
verses.translation: Fearing him, the Pandavas, though they were gieat heroes and very skilful, became incapable of conquering the Kauravas.

verses.sanskrit: स देव ईश्वरः सर्वं वस्त्वर्हति न संशयः । यज्ञावशिष्टं किमुत परे तस्येच्छया विभोः
verses.transliteration: sa deva IshvaraH sarvaM vastvarhati na saMshayaH | yaj~nAvashiShTaM kimuta pare tasyechChayA vibhoH
verses.translation: At the instance of Krsna, Arjuna perfoimed the severe penance of Siva and obtained a dicine missile due to Siva's boon. He then conquered the Kauiavas.

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहार्थमायातस्तव तद्रूपतः प्रभुः । तत्र त्वं गच्छ नभग प्रसन्नं कुरु सत्यतः
verses.transliteration: anugrahArthamAyAtastava tadrUpataH prabhuH | tatra tvaM gachCha nabhaga prasannaM kuru satyataH
verses.translation: O sage, although the great hero Avatthaman was

verses.sanskrit: क्षमापय स्वापराधं सुप्रणम्य स्तुतिं कुरु । सर्वप्रभुः स एवेशो यज्ञाधीशोऽखिलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kShamApaya svAparAdhaM supraNamya stutiM kuru | sarvaprabhuH sa evesho yaj~nAdhIsho.akhileshvaraH
verses.translation: He destroyed the sons of Pandavas though they were trained in warfare by Krsna and other great heroes. He had the strength that could not be withstood bv the enemy.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुब्रह्मादयो देवाः सिद्धाः सर्वर्षयोऽपि हि । तदनुग्रहतस्तात समर्थाः सर्वकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: viShNubrahmAdayo devAH siddhAH sarvarShayo.api hi | tadanugrahatastAta samarthAH sarvakarmaNi
verses.translation: On seeing Arjuna dejected by the death of his son but rushing on him along with Krsna he fled away from the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहोऽम्बरीषस्य नभगो यः प्रकीर्तितः । तच्चरितं शृणु मुने यस्मै ज्ञानमदाच्छिवः
verses.transliteration: pitAmaho.ambarIShasya nabhago yaH prakIrtitaH | tachcharitaM shR^iNu mune yasmai j~nAnamadAchChivaH
verses.translation: He discharged the divine missile Brahmairas on Arjuna. Then a fierce splendour enveloping all the quarters manifested itself.

verses.sanskrit: किम्बहूक्त्यात्मजश्रेष्ठ गच्छ तत्राशु माचिरम् । प्रसादय महादेवं सर्वथा सकलेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kimbahUktyAtmajashreShTha gachCha tatrAshu mAchiram | prasAdaya mahAdevaM sarvathA sakaleshvaram
verses.translation: Know this to be the most powerful Brfihma missile of Asvatthaman. There is no other missile to counteract this.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा स मनुः श्राद्धदेवश्च तनयं द्रुतम् । प्रेषयामास निकटं शम्भोः सोऽपि समेत्य तम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA sa manuH shrAddhadevashcha tanayaM drutam | preShayAmAsa nikaTaM shambhoH so.api sametya tam
verses.translation: Immediately think of Siva, your loul, the protector of the devotees who liad given you a weapon capable of every action.

verses.sanskrit: नभगश्च प्रणम्याशु साञ्जलिर्नतमस्तकः । प्रोवाच सुप्रसन्नात्मा विनयेन महामतिः
verses.transliteration: nabhagashcha praNamyAshu sA~njalirnatamastakaH | provAcha suprasannAtmA vinayena mahAmatiH
verses.translation: Counteract the fiery splendour of the Brahma missile with your Saiva missile. After saying this Krsna himself meditated on Siva for that purpose.

verses.sanskrit: नभग उवाच । इदं तवेश सर्वं हि वस्तु त्रिभुवने हि यत् । इत्याह मे पिता नूनं किमुताध्वरशेषितम्
verses.transliteration: nabhaga uvAcha | idaM tavesha sarvaM hi vastu tribhuvane hi yat | ityAha me pitA nUnaM kimutAdhvarasheShitam
verses.translation: O sage, on hearing the words of Krsna. Aijuna remembered Siva, touched water, bowed to Siva and dis¬ charged the Saiva missile.

verses.sanskrit: अजानता मया नाथ यदुक्तं तद्वचो भ्रमात् । अपराधं त्वं क्षमस्व शिरसा त्वां प्रसादये
verses.transliteration: ajAnatA mayA nAtha yaduktaM tadvacho bhramAt | aparAdhaM tvaM kShamasva shirasA tvAM prasAdaye
verses.translation: O great sage, although the Brahmasiras missile

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा नभगः सोऽतिदीनधीस्तु कृताञ्जलिः । तुष्टाव तं महेशानं कृष्णदर्शनमानतः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA nabhagaH so.atidInadhIstu kR^itA~njaliH | tuShTAva taM maheshAnaM kR^iShNadarshanamAnataH
verses.translation: Do not consider this very surprising in Siva who is full of wondrous things and who, the unborn, creates, protects and annihilates the entire universe by his own power.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धदेवोऽपि शुद्धात्मा नतकः साञ्जलिः सुधीः । तुष्टाव तं प्रभुं नत्वा स्वापराधं क्षमापयन्
verses.transliteration: shrAddhadevo.api shuddhAtmA natakaH sA~njaliH sudhIH | tuShTAva taM prabhuM natvA svAparAdhaM kShamApayan
verses.translation: O sage, knowing that this happened by the in¬ fluence of Siva, Avatthaman, born of Siva's part and delighted in heart at Siva's wish, was not at all sorry.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र विष्णुब्रह्मादयः सुराः । वासवाद्याः समाजग्मुः सिद्धाश्च मुनयोऽपि हि
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra viShNubrahmAdayaH surAH | vAsavAdyAH samAjagmuH siddhAshcha munayo.api hi
verses.translation: Then the son of Drona wishing the world to be rid of Pandava lineage desired to kill the child in the womb of Uttara.

verses.sanskrit: महोत्सवं प्रकुर्वन्तः सुकृताञ्जलयोऽखिलाः । तुष्टुवुर्नतका भक्त्या सुप्रणम्य पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: mahotsavaM prakurvantaH sukR^itA~njalayo.akhilAH | tuShTuvurnatakA bhaktyA supraNamya pR^ithakpR^ithak
verses.translation: The powerful A4vatthaman hurled the excessively lustrous Brahma-missile that could not be countermanded by any other missile, aiming it at the womb of Uttara.

verses.sanskrit: अथ रुद्रः प्रसन्नात्मा कृपादृष्ट्या विलोक्य तान् । उवाच नभगं प्रीत्या सस्मितं कृष्णदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: atha rudraH prasannAtmA kR^ipAdR^iShTyA vilokya tAn | uvAcha nabhagaM prItyA sasmitaM kR^iShNadarshanaH
verses.translation: Then Uttara the daughter-in-law of Arjuna, burning within due to that missile and agitated in the mind eu¬ logised Krsna, the lord of Laksmi.

verses.sanskrit: नभगो मनुपुत्रस्तु पठनार्थं सुबुद्धिमान् । चक्रे गुरुकुले वासं बहुकालं जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: nabhago manuputrastu paThanArthaM subuddhimAn | chakre gurukule vAsaM bahukAlaM jitendriyaH
verses.translation: Then meditating on Siva mentally, bowing to and eulogising him, Krsna understood that to be the missile of the son of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णदर्शन उवाच । यत्ते पितावदद्धर्म्यं वाक्यं तत्तु तथैव हि । त्वयापि सत्यमुक्तं तत् साधुस्त्वं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: kR^iShNadarshana uvAcha | yatte pitAvadaddharmyaM vAkyaM tattu tathaiva hi | tvayApi satyamuktaM tat sAdhustvaM nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: By means of his missile—the brilliant Sudari5ana, bestowed on him by Siva for his protection, he saved her at the behest of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अतोऽहं सुप्रसन्नोऽस्मि सर्वथा सुव्रतेन ते । ददामि कृपया ते हि ज्ञानं ब्रह्म सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: ato.ahaM suprasanno.asmi sarvathA suvratena te | dadAmi kR^ipayA te hi j~nAnaM brahma sanAtanam
verses.translation: Avatthaman then knew that Krsna had assumed his form at the behest of Siva and did it as he was the fore¬ most among the devotees of Siva, slowly refrained from the thought of destroying Uttara.

verses.sanskrit: महाज्ञानी भव त्वं हि सविप्रो नभगं द्रुतम् । गृहाण वस्त्विदं सर्वं मद्दत्तं कृपयाधुना
verses.transliteration: mahAj~nAnI bhava tvaM hi savipro nabhagaM drutam | gR^ihANa vastvidaM sarvaM maddattaM kR^ipayAdhunA
verses.translation: Then the leading devotee of Siva, the delighted Krsna, made all the Panavas fall at the feet of Asvat- thaman for pleasing him.

verses.sanskrit: इह सर्वसुखं भुङ्क्ष्व निर्विकारं महामते । सुगतिं प्राप्स्यसि त्वं हि सविप्रः कृपया मम
verses.transliteration: iha sarvasukhaM bhu~NkShva nirvikAraM mahAmate | sugatiM prApsyasi tvaM hi savipraH kR^ipayA mama
verses.translation: Then Aiivatthaman, son of Drona, highly delighted in the mind, blessed the Panclavas and Krsna with various boons.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा तात भगवान्स रुद्रः सत्यवत्सलः । सर्वेषां पश्यतां तेषां तत्रैवान्तर्दधे हरः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA tAta bhagavAnsa rudraH satyavatsalaH | sarveShAM pashyatAM teShAM tatraivAntardadhe haraH
verses.translation: O e.xccllent sage, incarnating thus on the earth in the form of Drona's son, lord Siva performed various sports.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुर्ब्रह्मापि देवाद्याः सर्वे ते मुनिसत्तम । स्वं स्वं धाम ययुः प्रीत्या तस्यै नत्वा दिशे मुदा
verses.transliteration: viShNurbrahmApi devAdyAH sarve te munisattama | svaM svaM dhAma yayuH prItyA tasyai natvA dishe mudA
verses.translation: The incarnation of Siva Afvatthaman of great

verses.sanskrit: सपुत्रः श्राद्धदेवोऽपि स्वस्थानमगमन्मुदा । भुक्त्वा भोगान्सुविपुलान्सोऽन्ते शिवपुरं ययौ
verses.transliteration: saputraH shrAddhadevo.api svasthAnamagamanmudA | bhuktvA bhogAnsuvipulAnso.ante shivapuraM yayau
verses.translation: The incarnation in the form of AiSvatthSman of lord Siva has been explained to you. It is the cause of all Siddhis and it fulfils all desires of the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं ते कीर्तितो ब्रह्मन्नवतारः शिवस्य हि । कृष्णदर्शननामा वै नभगानन्ददायकः
verses.transliteration: itthaM te kIrtito brahmannavatAraH shivasya hi | kR^iShNadarshananAmA vai nabhagAnandadAyakaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion or narrates it with pure mind attains all Siddhis here and attains Siya's abode hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानमनघं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सताम् । पठतां शृण्वतां वापि सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: idamAkhyAnamanaghaM bhuktimuktipradaM satAm | paThatAM shR^iNvatAM vApi sarvakAmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O intelligent one, listen to the incarnation of the Pinaka-bearing lord Siva as Kirata who killed Muka and delightedly granted the boon to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: य एतच्चरितं प्रातः सायं च स्मरते सुधीः । कविर्भवति मन्त्रज्ञो गतिमन्ते लभेत्पराम्
verses.transliteration: ya etachcharitaM prAtaH sAyaM cha smarate sudhIH | kavirbhavati mantraj~no gatimante labhetparAm
verses.translation: Defeated by Suyodhana, the excellent Pandavas went to the forest Dvaita*® accompanied by their chaste wife Draupadi.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये ते वै इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखाः सुताः । तस्मै भागमकल्प्यैव भेजुर्भागान्निजान्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye te vai ikShvAkupramukhAH sutAH | tasmai bhAgamakalpyaiva bhejurbhAgAnnijAnkramAt
verses.translation: Depending upon the cooking-pot given by the sun, the Pandavas spent their time happily.

verses.sanskrit: स्वं स्वं भागं गृहीत्वा ते बुभुजू राज्यमुत्तमम् । अविषादं महाभागाः पित्रादेशात्सुबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: svaM svaM bhAgaM gR^ihItvA te bubhujU rAjyamuttamam | aviShAdaM mahAbhAgAH pitrAdeshAtsubuddhayaH
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, Durvasas the leading sage was induced by Suyodhana to go to the Paijdavas in order to deceive them.

verses.sanskrit: स पश्चादागतस्तत्र ब्रह्मचारी गुरुस्थलात् । नभगोऽधीत्य सर्वाश्च साङ्गोपाङ्गाः श्रुतीः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sa pashchAdAgatastatra brahmachArI gurusthalAt | nabhago.adhItya sarvAshcha sA~NgopA~NgAH shrutIH kramAt
verses.translation: Accompanied by his ten thousand disciples he ap¬ proached them and asked for foodstuffs and other things for his disciples.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातृन्विलोक्य नभगो विभक्तान्सकलान्निजान् । दायार्थी प्राह तान्स्नेहादिक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखान्मुने
verses.transliteration: bhrAtR^invilokya nabhago vibhaktAnsakalAnnijAn | dAyArthI prAha tAnsnehAdikShvAkupramukhAnmune
verses.translation: After accepting it, Durvisas and other sages and saints were sent by the Pandavas for their ablution.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Kr$9a appeared on being remembered by Draupadi

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Kr$9a appeared on being remembered by Draupadi

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.३०. त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । अवधूतेश्वरशिवावतारचरित्रवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु त्वं ब्रह्मपुत्राद्यावतारं परमेशितुः । अवधूतेश्वराह्वं वै शक्रगर्वापहारकम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.30\. triMsho.adhyAyaH | avadhUteshvarashivAvatAracharitravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | shR^iNu tvaM brahmaputrAdyAvatAraM parameshituH | avadhUteshvarAhvaM vai shakragarvApahArakam
verses.translation: According to the Mah&bhSrata (III. 24. 13) it was a sacred forest where Yudhisthira retired with his brothers after the loss of his kingdom at the gambling table. It has been identified with Devabandh or Deoband in the Saharanpur district Uttara, Pradesh.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शक्रेणेत्थं स पृष्टश्च किञ्चिन्नोवाच पूरुषः । लीलागृहीतदेहः स शङ्करो मदहा प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | shakreNetthaM sa pR^iShTashcha ki~nchinnovAcha pUruShaH | lIlAgR^ihItadehaH sa sha~Nkaro madahA prabhuH
verses.translation: On coming to know that the disciples were fully satisfied Durvasas went away. By the grace of Krna, the Pandavas were freed from a difficult situation.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रः पुनरपृच्छत्तं नोवाच स दिगम्बरः । अविज्ञातगतिः शम्भुर्महाकौतुककारकः
verses.transliteration: shakraH punarapR^ichChattaM novAcha sa digambaraH | avij~nAtagatiH shambhurmahAkautukakArakaH
verses.translation: Then they asked Krsna "O lord, what will happen now? A very powerful enemy has arisen. What shall be done at this moment.'*

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पुरन्दरोऽपृच्छ्त् त्रैलोक्याधिपतिः स्वराट् । तूष्णीमास महायोगी महालीलाकरः स वै
verses.transliteration: punaH purandaro.apR^ichCht trailokyAdhipatiH svarAT | tUShNImAsa mahAyogI mahAlIlAkaraH sa vai
verses.translation: O sage, on being asked thus by the Pancja- vas, lord Krsna remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and spoke to them.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं पुनः पुनः पृष्टः शक्रेण स दिगम्बरः । नोवाच किञ्चिद्भगवान् शक्रदर्पजिघांसया
verses.transliteration: itthaM punaH punaH pR^iShTaH shakreNa sa digambaraH | novAcha ki~nchidbhagavAn shakradarpajighAMsayA
verses.translation: O excellent Pandavas, now listen to the details of my experience involving service to Siva. After hearing you shall act accordingly.

verses.sanskrit: अथ चुक्रोध देवेशस्त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यगर्वितः । उवाच वचनं क्रोधात्तं निर्भर्त्स्य जटाधरम्
verses.transliteration: atha chukrodha deveshastrailokyaishvaryagarvitaH | uvAcha vachanaM krodhAttaM nirbhartsya jaTAdharam
verses.translation: I went to Dvaraka to conquer my enemies. After obeying the instructions of noble Upamanyu I pro¬ pitiated lord Siva. I propitiated him for seven months in the excellent mountain Batuka.*® Thus Siva was pleased with me.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच । पृच्छमानोऽपि रे मूढ नोत्तरं दत्तवानसि । अतस्त्वां हन्मि वज्रेण कस्ते त्रातास्ति दुर्मते
verses.transliteration: indra uvAcha | pR^ichChamAno.api re mUDha nottaraM dattavAnasi | atastvAM hanmi vajreNa kaste trAtAsti durmate
verses.translation: Standing there himself he fulfilled all my desires. By his power I acquired excellent efficiency in everything.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युदीर्य ततो वज्री सन्निरीक्ष्य क्रुधा हि तम् । हन्तुं दिगम्बरं वज्रमुद्यतं स चकार ह
verses.transliteration: ityudIrya tato vajrI sannirIkShya krudhA hi tam | hantuM digambaraM vajramudyataM sa chakAra ha
verses.translation: The lord, the bestower of worldly pleasures and salvation is propitiated by me even now. You too serve Siv:. who is the bestower of happiness to all.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रहस्तं च तं दृष्ट्वा शक्रं शीघ्रं सदाशिवः । चकार स्तम्भनं तस्य वज्रपातस्य शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: vajrahastaM cha taM dR^iShTvA shakraM shIghraM sadAshivaH | chakAra stambhanaM tasya vajrapAtasya sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: After saying thus and cheering the Pandavas, Kr?na vanished from there and remembering the lotus:cet of Siva he hastened to Dvaraka.*®

verses.sanskrit: ततः स पुरुषः क्रुद्धः करालाक्षो भयङ्करः । द्रुतमेव प्रजज्वाल तेजसा प्रदहन्निव
verses.transliteration: tataH sa puruShaH kruddhaH karAlAkSho bhaya~NkaraH | drutameva prajajvAla tejasA pradahanniva
verses.translation: Pandavas then sent a Bhilla to test the virtues and the strength of Duryodhana.

verses.sanskrit: बाहुप्रतिष्टम्भभुवा मन्युनान्तः शचीपतिः । समदह्यत भोगीव मन्त्ररुद्धपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: bAhupratiShTambhabhuvA manyunAntaH shachIpatiH | samadahyata bhogIva mantraruddhaparAkramaH
verses.translation: He understood the prosperity, rise and the virtues of Duryodhana and returned to the Pancjlavas again.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रः पुरा हि सगुरुः सर्वदेवसमन्वितः । दर्शनं कर्तुमीशस्य कैलासमगमन्मुने
verses.transliteration: shakraH purA hi saguruH sarvadevasamanvitaH | darshanaM kartumIshasya kailAsamagamanmune
verses.translation: On hearing what he had said, O great sflge, the Pantavas were very sad and in their distress spoke to one another.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा बृहस्पतिस्त्वेनं प्रज्वलन्तं स्वतेजसा । पुरुषं तं धियामास प्रणनाम हरं द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA bR^ihaspatistvenaM prajvalantaM svatejasA | puruShaM taM dhiyAmAsa praNanAma haraM drutam
verses.translation: What shall be done now? Where shall we go? Though we can fight now we have been restrained by the bonds of truth.

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा ततो गुरुरुदारधीः । दण्डवत्कौ पुनर्नत्वा प्रभुं तुष्टाव भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: kR^itA~njalipuTo bhUtvA tato gururudAradhIH | daNDavatkau punarnatvA prabhuM tuShTAva bhaktitaH
verses.translation: In the meantime Vyasa came there with the ashes decorating his forehead, with Rudraksa as an orna¬ ment and well bedecked in matted hair.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुरुवाच । देवदेव महादेव शरणागतवत्सल । प्रसन्नो भव गौरीश सर्वेश्वर नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: gururuvAcha | devadeva mahAdeva sharaNAgatavatsala | prasanno bhava gaurIsha sarveshvara namo.astu te
verses.translation: When they saw him they were delighted and they stood up to welcome him. Offering him a seat of deer-hide brightened by Kusa grass they waited in front of him.

verses.sanskrit: मायया मोहिताः सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादयोऽपि ते । त्वां न जानन्ति तत्त्वेन जानन्ति त्वदनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: mAyayA mohitAH sarve brahmaviShNvAdayo.api te | tvAM na jAnanti tattvena jAnanti tvadanugrahAt
verses.translation: *'0 holy lord, by seeing you, we are all satisfied. We have attained the fruits of our austerities and our diverse charitable gifts.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । बृहस्पतिरिति स्तुत्वा स तदा शङ्करं प्रभुम् । पादयोः पातयामास तस्येशस्य पुरन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | bR^ihaspatiriti stutvA sa tadA sha~NkaraM prabhum | pAdayoH pAtayAmAsa tasyeshasya purandaram
verses.translation: O grandfather, by seeing you, all our misery has disappeared, the misery that had been inflicted on us by the wicked people of ruthless activities.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तात सुराचार्यः कृताञ्जलिरुदारधीः । बृहस्पतिरुवाचेदं प्रश्रयावनतः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tatastAta surAchAryaH kR^itA~njalirudAradhIH | bR^ihaspatiruvAchedaM prashrayAvanataH sudhIH
verses.translation: Misery disappears at your sight. Was there ever a time when it did not disappear? We know it truly.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच । दीनानाथ महादेव प्रणतं तव पादयोः । समुद्धर च मां तत्त्वं क्रोधं न प्रणयं कुरु
verses.transliteration: bR^ihaspatiruvAcha | dInAnAtha mahAdeva praNataM tava pAdayoH | samuddhara cha mAM tattvaM krodhaM na praNayaM kuru
verses.translation: When a person reaches the hermitage of a sage

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो भव महादेव पाहीन्द्रं शरणागतम् । वह्निरेष समायाति भालनेत्रसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tuShTo bhava mahAdeva pAhIndraM sharaNAgatam | vahnireSha samAyAti bhAlanetrasamudbhavaH
verses.translation: Poverty, the cause of misery, will surely be dis¬ pelled. Such is the nature of great men. In the fulfilment of desires they are equal to the wish-yielding Kalpa tree.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य गुरोर्वाक्यमवधूताकृतिः प्रभुः । उवाच करुणासिन्धुर्विहसन् स सदूतिकृत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityAkarNya gurorvAkyamavadhUtAkR^itiH prabhuH | uvAcha karuNAsindhurvihasan sa sadUtikR^it
verses.translation: Thus the qualities of the great shall be observed

verses.sanskrit: अवधूत उवाच । क्रोधाच्च निस्सृतं तेजो धारयामि स्वनेत्रतः । कथं हि कञ्चुकीं सर्पः सन्धत्ते चोज्झितां पुनः
verses.transliteration: avadhUta uvAcha | krodhAchcha nissR^itaM tejo dhArayAmi svanetrataH | kathaM hi ka~nchukIM sarpaH sandhatte chojjhitAM punaH
verses.translation: The difference between the small and the great

verses.sanskrit: अथ गुर्विन्द्रयोर्ज्ञात्वागमनं शङ्करस्तयोः । परीक्षितुं च तद्भावं स्वदर्शनरतात्मनोः
verses.transliteration: atha gurvindrayorj~nAtvAgamanaM sha~NkarastayoH | parIkShituM cha tadbhAvaM svadarshanaratAtmanoH
verses.translation: The characteristics of the wretched and the misera¬ ble are conducive to his glory, for there lies before him an opportunity for strenuous efforts and for serving the good people.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य शङ्करस्य बृहस्पतिः । उवाच साञ्जलिर्भूयो भयव्याकुलमानसः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasya sha~Nkarasya bR^ihaspatiH | uvAcha sA~njalirbhUyo bhayavyAkulamAnasaH
verses.translation: By your mere arrival our minds are satisfied. Give us instructions whereby our misery can be dispelled.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच । हे देव भगवन्भक्ता अनुकम्प्याः सदैव हि । भक्तवत्सलनामेति स्वं सत्यं कुरु शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: bR^ihaspatiruvAcha | he deva bhagavanbhaktA anukampyAH sadaiva hi | bhaktavatsalanAmeti svaM satyaM kuru sha~Nkara
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the Pandavas the great sage Vyasa was delighted in the mind and said thus.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेप्तुमन्यत्र देवेश स्वतेजोऽत्युग्रमर्हसि । उद्धर्ता सर्वभक्तानां समुद्धर पुरन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: kSheptumanyatra devesha svatejo.atyugramarhasi | uddhartA sarvabhaktAnAM samuddhara purandaram
verses.translation: O Pandavas, you need not be over-anxious. You are all blessed and contented. You have not let truth slip by.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तो गुरुणा रुद्रो भक्तवत्सलनामभाक् । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा सुरेज्यं प्रणतार्तिहा
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityukto guruNA rudro bhaktavatsalanAmabhAk | pratyuvAcha prasannAtmA surejyaM praNatArtihA
verses.translation: The noble nature of the good remains unchanged even at death. They do not forsake virtue. They fruitfully resort to Truth.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्र उवाच । प्रीतस्तेऽहं सुराचार्य ददामि वरमुत्तमम् । इन्द्रस्य जीवदानेन जीवेति त्वं प्रथां व्रज
verses.transliteration: rudra uvAcha | prItaste.ahaM surAchArya dadAmi varamuttamam | indrasya jIvadAnena jIveti tvaM prathAM vraja
verses.translation: As far as we are concerned, you and the Kauravas ought to be equal. Still our partiality is towards the virtuous. This partiality is approved by the learned.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्भूतोऽनलो योऽयं भालनेत्रात्सुरासहः । एनं त्यक्ष्याम्यहं दूरे यथेन्द्रं नैव पीडयेत्
verses.transliteration: samudbhUto.analo yo.ayaM bhAlanetrAtsurAsahaH | enaM tyakShyAmyahaM dUre yathendraM naiva pIDayet
verses.translation: Undoubtedly you and they arc his sons when your real father is dead. You are noble souls and hence you deserve to be viewed sympathetically.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा स करे धृत्वा स्वतेजोऽनलमद्भुतम् । भालनेत्रसमुद्भूतं प्राक्षिपल्लवणाम्भसि
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA sa kare dhR^itvA svatejo.analamadbhutam | bhAlanetrasamudbhUtaM prAkShipallavaNAmbhasi
verses.translation: Whatever has happened cannot be otherwise. He is wicked while all of you are virtuous and truthful.

verses.sanskrit: अथो शिवस्य तत्तेजो भालनेत्रसमुद्भवम् । क्षिप्तं च लवणाम्भोधौ सद्यो बालो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: atho shivasya tattejo bhAlanetrasamudbhavam | kShiptaM cha lavaNAmbhodhau sadyo bAlo babhUva ha
verses.translation: Hence evil will befall only him in the end, to be sure. The seed that has been sown will germinate into a sprout.

verses.sanskrit: स जलन्धरनामाभूत्सिन्धुपुत्रोऽसुरेश्वरः । तं जघान महेशानो देवप्रार्थनया प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sa jalandharanAmAbhUtsindhuputro.asureshvaraH | taM jaghAna maheshAno devaprArthanayA prabhuH
verses.translation: Hence you need not feel distressed at all. Welfare will dawn on you. You need not entertain any doubt.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं कृत्वा सुचरितं शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः । अवधूतस्वरूपेण ततश्चान्तर्हितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: itthaM kR^itvA sucharitaM sha~Nkaro lokasha~NkaraH | avadhUtasvarUpeNa tatashchAntarhito.abhavat
verses.translation: Thus the paQ(javas were consoled and cheered by Vyasa. Yudhi$thira and others then spoke these woitls.

verses.sanskrit: अवधूतस्वरूपोऽभून्नानालीलाकरः प्रभुः । दिगम्बरो महाभीमो ज्वलदग्निसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: avadhUtasvarUpo.abhUnnAnAlIlAkaraH prabhuH | digambaro mahAbhImo jvaladagnisamaprabhaH
verses.translation: O lord, I have mentioned the truth. Even in the forest misery is being inflicted on us incessantly by the wicked and the evil-minded Kauravas again and again.

verses.sanskrit: बभूवुः सकला देवाः सुखिनश्चातिनिर्भयाः । गुरुशक्रौ भयान्मुक्तौ जग्मतुः सुखमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: babhUvuH sakalA devAH sukhinashchAtinirbhayAH | gurushakrau bhayAnmuktau jagmatuH sukhamuttamam
verses.translation: O holy lord, please dispel our distress. Something auspicious shall be bestowed upon us. We have been advised by Kfsna that Siva shall be propitiated always.

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थे गमनोद्युक्तौ दर्शनं प्राप्य तस्य तौ । कृतार्थौ गुरुशक्रौ हि स्वस्थानं जग्मतुर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: yadarthe gamanodyuktau darshanaM prApya tasya tau | kR^itArthau gurushakrau hi svasthAnaM jagmaturmudA
verses.translation: We have committed a blunder in not following his advice. May divine lead be given to us again now.

verses.sanskrit: अवधूतेश्वराह्वोऽवतारस्ते कथितो मया । परमेशस्य परमानन्ददः खलदण्डदः
verses.transliteration: avadhUteshvarAhvo.avatAraste kathito mayA | parameshasya paramAnandadaH khaladaNDadaH
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the delighted Vyasa, remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and spoke to the Pandavas with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानमनघं यशस्यं स्वर्ग्यमेव च । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं दिव्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: idamAkhyAnamanaghaM yashasyaM svargyameva cha | bhuktimuktipradaM divyaM sarvakAmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O Pandavas, of virtuous mind, listen to my words. It has been truly stated by Kr$na. Siva is being served by me too.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा सोऽन्ते शिवगतिं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM shR^iNuyAnnityaM shrAvayedvA samAhitaH | iha sarvasukhaM bhuktvA so.ante shivagatiM labhet
verses.translation: Let him be served by you with pleasure. Un¬ equalled happiness shall always follow. It is only by not serving Siva that miseries crop up.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽवधूतस्वरूपो हि मार्गमारुद्ध्य सद्गतिः । लम्बमानपटः शम्भुरतिष्ठच्छोभिताकृतिः
verses.transliteration: so.avadhUtasvarUpo hi mArgamAruddhya sadgatiH | lambamAnapaTaH shambhuratiShThachChobhitAkR^itiH
verses.translation: O Padvas, all of you hear. I shall tell you, what is ever good and wholesome. Siva shall be viewed as the great Brahman and the goal of the good. Beginning with Brahma and ending with infinity whatever is seen in the

verses.sanskrit: अथ तौ गुरुशक्रौ च गच्छन्तौ शिव सन्निधिम् । अद्राष्टां पुरुषं भीमं मार्गमध्येऽद्भुताकृतिम्
verses.transliteration: atha tau gurushakrau cha gachChantau shiva sannidhim | adrAShTAM puruShaM bhImaM mArgamadhye.adbhutAkR^itim
verses.translation: Siva, the dispeller of all misery shall be served by all. Due to devotion, Siva becomes pleased in a short time.

verses.sanskrit: अथ शक्रो मुनेऽपृच्छत्स्वाधिकारेण दुर्मदः । पुरुषं तं स्वमार्गान्तः स्थितमज्ञाय शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: atha shakro mune.apR^ichChatsvAdhikAreNa durmadaH | puruShaM taM svamArgAntaH sthitamaj~nAya sha~Nkaram
verses.translation: Hence Siva shall be always served by those who desire the fruits of worldly pleasures here and salvation here¬ after. Siva, the divine Purusa himself, is the slayer of the wicked and the goal of the good.

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच । कस्त्वं दिगम्बराकारावधूतः कुत आगतः । किन्नाम तव विख्यातं तत्त्वतो वद मेऽचिरम्
verses.transliteration: shakra uvAcha | kastvaM digambarAkArAvadhUtaH kuta AgataH | kinnAma tava vikhyAtaM tattvato vada me.achiram
verses.translation: But one shall repeat the lore of Indra at the out¬ set with steady mind. For a Ksatriya of great lustre this alone is conducive to welfare.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्थाने संस्थितः शम्भुः किं वान्यत्र गतोऽधुना । दर्शनार्थं हि तस्याहं गच्छामि सगुरुः सुरैः
verses.transliteration: svasthAne saMsthitaH shambhuH kiM vAnyatra gato.adhunA | darshanArthaM hi tasyAhaM gachChAmi saguruH suraiH
verses.translation: Hence let Atjuna repeat the lore of Indra at first, steadily. In the beginning the lord will test him and will like to be satisfied with the test.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The great sage gave him the rules of procedure for a king. The liberal-minded Vyasa thus spoke to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The great sage gave him the rules of procedure for a king. The liberal-minded Vyasa thus spoke to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.३१. एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । भिक्षुवर्याह्वशिवावतार चरित्रवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । अथ वक्ष्ये मुनिश्रेष्ठ शम्भोः शृण्ववतारकम् । स्वभक्तदयया विप्र नारीसन्देहभञ्जकम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.31\. ekatriMsho.adhyAyaH | bhikShuvaryAhvashivAvatAra charitravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | atha vakShye munishreShTha shambhoH shR^iNvavatArakam | svabhaktadayayA vipra nArIsandehabha~njakam
verses.translation: O Arjuna, start from here and go this way to the beautiful mountain Indrakila.* There standing beside the river Ganga perform the penance well.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागत्य प्रिया राज्ञः सन्तप्ता सुकुमारिणी । निवासार्थं सरस्तीरे छायावृक्षमुपाश्रयत्
verses.transliteration: tatrAgatya priyA rAj~naH santaptA sukumAriNI | nivAsArthaM sarastIre ChAyAvR^ikShamupAshrayat
verses.translation: The invisible lore will be beneficial to you. He gave him the blessings thus. The sage then spoke to all.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दैववशाद्राज्ञी मुहूर्त्ते सद्गुणान्विते । असूत तनयं दिव्यं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra daivavashAdrAj~nI muhUrtte sadguNAnvite | asUta tanayaM divyaM sarvalakShaNalakShitam
verses.translation: May all the excellent kings stand by virtue. The

verses.sanskrit: अथ तज्जननी दैवात्तृषिताति नृपाङ्गना । सरोऽवतीर्णा पानार्थं ग्रस्ता ग्राहेण पाथसि
verses.transliteration: atha tajjananI daivAttR^iShitAti nR^ipA~NganA | saro.avatIrNA pAnArthaM grastA grAheNa pAthasi
verses.translation: Blessing the Pandavas thus and remembering the lotus-like feet of Siva, the great sage Vyasa vanished in a moment.

verses.sanskrit: स सुतो जातमात्रस्तु क्षुत्पिपासार्दितो भृशम् । रुरोद च सरस्तीरे विनष्टपितृमातृकः
verses.transliteration: sa suto jAtamAtrastu kShutpipAsArdito bhR^isham | ruroda cha sarastIre vinaShTapitR^imAtR^ikaH
verses.translation: Arjuna then appeared very brilliant and lustrous assuming unequalled splendour by means of Siva mantra.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्वने क्रन्दमाने जातमात्रे सुते मुने । कृपान्वितो महेशोऽभूदन्तर्यामी स रक्षकः
verses.transliteration: tasminvane krandamAne jAtamAtre sute mune | kR^ipAnvito mahesho.abhUdantaryAmI sa rakShakaH
verses.translation: On seeing Arjuna the Pandavas were convinced. "Surely success will be ours, since Arjuna has achieved an extensive splendour.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेरिता मनसा काचिदीशेन त्रासहारिणा । अकस्मादागता तत्र भ्रमन्ती भैक्ष्यजीविनी
verses.transliteration: preritA manasA kAchidIshena trAsahAriNA | akasmAdAgatA tatra bhramantI bhaikShyajIvinI
verses.translation: The task can be achieved only by you and not by anyone else. It appears so through the words of Vyasa. Make your life fruitful."

verses.sanskrit: सा त्वेकहायनं बालं वहन्ती विधवा निजम् । अनाथमेकं क्रन्दन्तं शिशुं तत्र ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: sA tvekahAyanaM bAlaM vahantI vidhavA nijam | anAthamekaM krandantaM shishuM tatra dadarsha ha
verses.translation: After saying this, all of them, dejected by the im¬ pending separation, reluctantly bade farewell to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: सा दृष्ट्वा तत्र तं बालं वने निर्मनुजे मुने । विस्मिताति द्विजस्त्री सा चिचिन्त हृदये बहु
verses.transliteration: sA dR^iShTvA tatra taM bAlaM vane nirmanuje mune | vismitAti dvijastrI sA chichinta hR^idaye bahu
verses.translation: The grief-stricken, chaste DraupadI, controlling her tears, bade farewell to Arjuna and said.

verses.sanskrit: अहो सुमहदाश्चर्यमिदं दृष्टं मयाधुना । असम्भाव्यमकथ्यं च सर्वथा मनसा गिरा
verses.transliteration: aho sumahadAshcharyamidaM dR^iShTaM mayAdhunA | asambhAvyamakathyaM cha sarvathA manasA girA
verses.translation: O king, you shall strenuously act according to the instructions of Vyasa. May your path be auspicious. May iiva be the benefactor.

verses.sanskrit: अच्छिन्ननाभिनालोऽयं रसायां केवलं शिशुः । शेते मातृविहीनश्च क्रन्दंस्तेजस्विनां वरः
verses.transliteration: achChinnanAbhinAlo.ayaM rasAyAM kevalaM shishuH | shete mAtR^ivihInashcha krandaMstejasvinAM varaH
