verses.translation: After bidding farewell to Arjuna lovingly all those five, remained there, highly distressed.

verses.sanskrit: आसीत्सत्यरथो नाम्ना विदर्भविषये नृपः । धर्मात्मा सत्यशीलश्च महाशैवजनप्रियः
verses.transliteration: AsItsatyaratho nAmnA vidarbhaviShaye nR^ipaH | dharmAtmA satyashIlashcha mahAshaivajanapriyaH
verses.translation: O excellent sage, remaining there they spoke to one another. Listen. "Even in misery, if there is a meeting with beloved persons it lessens sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य पित्रादयः केऽपि न सन्तीह सहायिनः । कारणं किं बभूवाथ ह्यहो दैवबलं महत्
verses.transliteration: asya pitrAdayaH ke.api na santIha sahAyinaH | kAraNaM kiM babhUvAtha hyaho daivabalaM mahat
verses.translation: O great sage, while the Pandavas were thus in grief, the excellent sage Vyasa, the ocean of mercy, arrived there.

verses.sanskrit: न जाने कस्य पुत्रोऽयमस्य ज्ञातात्र कोऽपि न । यतः पृच्छाम्यस्य जन्म जाता च करुणा मयि
verses.transliteration: na jAne kasya putro.ayamasya j~nAtAtra ko.api na | yataH pR^ichChAmyasya janma jAtA cha karuNA mayi
verses.translation: The Pandavas honoured and bowed to him with respect after offering him a seat. In their misery they joined their palms in reverence and spoke.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छाम्येनं पोषितुं हि बालमौरसपुत्रवत् । संस्प्रष्टुं नोत्सहेऽज्ञात्वा कुलजन्मादि चास्य वै
verses.transliteration: ichChAmyenaM poShituM hi bAlamaurasaputravat | saMspraShTuM notsahe.aj~nAtvA kulajanmAdi chAsya vai
verses.translation: O holy lord, O excellent sage, we are burning in grief but on seeing you we derive consolation and pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति सञ्चिन्त्यमानायां तस्यां विप्रवरस्त्रियाम् । कृपां चकार महतीं शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti sa~nchintyamAnAyAM tasyAM vipravarastriyAm | kR^ipAM chakAra mahatIM sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: O lord, O brahmin sage, please stay here for sometime and dispel our grief. By your very sight our miseries are dispelled.

verses.sanskrit: दध्रे भिक्षुस्वरूपं हि महालीलो महेश्वरः । सर्वथा भक्तसुखदो निरुपाधिः स्वयं सदा
verses.transliteration: dadhre bhikShusvarUpaM hi mahAlIlo maheshvaraH | sarvathA bhaktasukhado nirupAdhiH svayaM sadA
verses.translation: Thus requested, the excellent sage stayed there for their happiness, dispelling their grief by narrating various legends.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राजगाम सहसा स भिक्षुः परमेश्वरः । यत्रास्ति सन्देहवती द्विजस्त्री ज्ञातुमिच्छती
verses.transliteration: tatrAjagAma sahasA sa bhikShuH parameshvaraH | yatrAsti sandehavatI dvijastrI j~nAtumichChatI
verses.translation: O good sage, in the course of conversation pursued w'ith Vyasa, Yudhisthira bowed to him humbly and spoke.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्यस्वरूपोऽसावविज्ञातगतिः प्रभुः । तामाह विप्रवनितां विहस्य करुणानिधिः
verses.transliteration: bhikShuvaryasvarUpo.asAvavij~nAtagatiH prabhuH | tAmAha vipravanitAM vihasya karuNAnidhiH
verses.translation: O excellent sage, listen. I seek for the alleviation of our grief. O intelligent one, 1 am putting this humble * question. O lord, you shall kindly explain.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्य उवाच । सन्देहं कुरु नो चित्ते विप्रभामिनि मा खिद । रक्षैनं बालकं प्रीत्या सुपवित्रं स्वपुत्रकम्
verses.transliteration: bhikShuvarya uvAcha | sandehaM kuru no chitte viprabhAmini mA khida | rakShainaM bAlakaM prItyA supavitraM svaputrakam
verses.translation: Has anyone formerly suffered this sort of grief? Verily we alone have had it. None else.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन शिशुना श्रेयः प्राप्स्यसे न चिरात्परम् । पुष्णीहि सर्वथा ह्येनं महातेजस्विनं शिशुम्
verses.transliteration: anena shishunA shreyaH prApsyase na chirAtparam | puShNIhi sarvathA hyenaM mahAtejasvinaM shishum
verses.translation: Formerly, Nala,®* the king of Ni?adha, the noble soul, had experienced a misery more than yours.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्तवन्तं तं भिक्षुस्वरूपं करुणानिधिम् । सा विप्रवनिता शम्भुं प्रीत्या पप्रच्छ सादरम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktavantaM taM bhikShusvarUpaM karuNAnidhim | sA vipravanitA shambhuM prItyA paprachCha sAdaram
verses.translation: A great calamity and distress befell king Harican- dra.*3 It cannot be adequately described. It makes others too distressed.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य राज्ञः सुधर्मेण महीं पालयतो मुने । महान्कालो व्यतीयाय सुखेन शिवधर्मतः
verses.transliteration: tasya rAj~naH sudharmeNa mahIM pAlayato mune | mahAnkAlo vyatIyAya sukhena shivadharmataH
verses.translation: Harilcandra, son of Trisahku and ki of the solar race, had to suffer at the hands of the relentless sage VisvUmitra to whom he gave away his kingdom, son, wife, life and everything as the sacrificial gift.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रवनितोवाच । त्वदाज्ञयैनं बालं हि रक्षिष्यामि स्वपुत्रवत् । पोक्ष्यामि नात्र सन्देहो मद्भाग्यात्त्वमिहागतः
verses.transliteration: vipravanitovAcha | tvadAj~nayainaM bAlaM hi rakShiShyAmi svaputravat | pokShyAmi nAtra sandeho madbhAgyAttvamihAgataH
verses.translation: O Panglavas, even Rama** had to suffer that misery on hearing which men and women would be greatly affected.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि ज्ञातुमिच्छामि विशेषेण तु तत्त्वतः । कोऽयं कस्य सुतश्चायं कस्त्वमत्र समागतः
verses.transliteration: tathApi j~nAtumichChAmi visheSheNa tu tattvataH | ko.ayaM kasya sutashchAyaM kastvamatra samAgataH
verses.translation: When days come and go, when burdens of tasks are born in plenty, the life nears its end everyday. But man does not realize it.

verses.sanskrit: मुहुर्मम समायाति ज्ञानं भिक्षुवर प्रभो । त्वं शिवः करुणासिन्धुस्त्वद्भक्तोऽयं शिशुः पुरा
verses.transliteration: muhurmama samAyAti j~nAnaM bhikShuvara prabho | tvaM shivaH karuNAsindhustvadbhakto.ayaM shishuH purA
verses.translation: Thus the brothers spent their time by various talks, discussions and schemes of all sorts.

verses.sanskrit: केनचित्कर्मदोषेण सम्प्राप्तोऽयं दशामिमाम् । तद्भुक्त्वा परमं श्रेयः प्राप्स्यते त्वदनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: kenachitkarmadoSheNa samprApto.ayaM dashAmimAm | tadbhuktvA paramaM shreyaH prApsyate tvadanugrahAt
verses.translation: He assumed dress and features according to his instructions. He curbed his sense organs and the mind and stood steady.

verses.sanskrit: त्वन्माययैव साहं वै मार्गभ्रष्टा विमोहिता । आगता प्रेषिता त्वत्तो ह्यस्य रक्षणहेतुतः
verses.transliteration: tvanmAyayaiva sAhaM vai mArgabhraShTA vimohitA | AgatA preShitA tvatto hyasya rakShaNahetutaH
verses.translation: RSma, son of Daiaratha, had to roam into the lorest for fourteen years owing to the jealousy of Kaikcyi who urged her husband Dasaratha to install her son Bharata and to send Rama into exile.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तद्दर्शनप्राप्तविज्ञानां विप्रकामिनीम् । ज्ञातुकामां विशेषेण प्रोचे भिक्षुतनुः शिवः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti taddarshanaprAptavij~nAnAM viprakAminIm | j~nAtukAmAM visheSheNa proche bhikShutanuH shivaH
verses.translation: In the Vedas Dasyus are represented as the aboriginal tribes¬ men who contended with the immigrant Aryans and were overpowered by the latter. In the Pur&nas the term Dasyu means a barbarian, a robber or an outcaste.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्य उवाच । शृणु प्रीत्या विप्रपत्नि बालस्यास्य पुरेहितम् । सर्वमन्यस्य सुप्रीत्या वक्ष्यते तत्त्वतोऽनघे
verses.transliteration: bhikShuvarya uvAcha | shR^iNu prItyA viprapatni bAlasyAsya purehitam | sarvamanyasya suprItyA vakShyate tattvato.anaghe
verses.translation: He made a clay idol of Siva even and beautiful. In front of it he stood in meditation on the excellent heap of splendour.

verses.sanskrit: सुतो विदर्भराजस्य शिवभक्तस्य धीमतः । अयं सत्यरथस्यैव स्वधर्मनिरतस्य हि
verses.transliteration: suto vidarbharAjasya shivabhaktasya dhImataH | ayaM satyarathasyaiva svadharmaniratasya hi
verses.translation: He took baths thrice a day. He performed various sorts of worship. He performed the Upasti form of worship of Siva again and again.

verses.sanskrit: शृणु सत्यरथो राजा हतः शाल्वे रणे परैः । तत्पत्नी निशि सुव्यग्रा निर्ययौ स्वगृहाद् द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: shR^iNu satyaratho rAjA hataH shAlve raNe paraiH | tatpatnI nishi suvyagrA niryayau svagR^ihAd drutam
verses.translation: Indra's spies saw the splendour-column coming out of his head. They were frightened by it. They thought within themselves—"When did he come in? Indra must be informed." Saying so they went to Indra.

verses.sanskrit: असूत तनयं चैनं समायाता प्रगेऽत्र हि । सरोऽवतीर्णा तृषया ग्रस्ता ग्राहेण दैवतः
verses.transliteration: asUta tanayaM chainaM samAyAtA prage.atra hi | saro.avatIrNA tR^iShayA grastA grAheNa daivataH
verses.translation: O lord of gods, we do not know who it is. Some one is performing a penance in the forest, a god, a sage, the sun or the fire.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्तस्य राज्ञस्तु शाल्वैश्च पुररोधिभिः । महान् रणो बभूवाथ बहुसैन्यैर्बलोद्धतैः
verses.transliteration: kadAchittasya rAj~nastu shAlvaishcha purarodhibhiH | mahAn raNo babhUvAtha bahusainyairbaloddhataiH
verses.translation: We are scorched by his splendour and have come near you. We have told you the details. Please do what is proper.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तस्य समुत्पत्तिं तत्पितुः सङ्गरे मृतिम् । तन्मातृमरणं ग्राहात्सर्वं तस्यै न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti tasya samutpattiM tatpituH sa~Ngare mR^itim | tanmAtR^imaraNaM grAhAtsarvaM tasyai nyavedayat
verses.translation: Thus informed by the spies, Indra, the enemy of mountains, understood whatever his son Arjuna desired to do. He dismissed them and decided to go there to test him.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा ब्राह्मणी चैव विस्मिताति मुनीश्वर । पुनः पप्रच्छ तं भिक्षुं ज्ञानिनं सिद्धरूपकम्
verses.transliteration: atha sA brAhmaNI chaiva vismitAti munIshvara | punaH paprachCha taM bhikShuM j~nAninaM siddharUpakam
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, Indra, the lord of!§aci, as¬ sumed the form of an elderly brahmin bachelor and went there to test him.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण्युवाच । स राजोऽस्य पिता भिक्षो वरभोगान्तरैव हि । कस्माच्छाल्वैः स्वरिपुभिः स्वल्पेहैश्च विघातितः
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNyuvAcha | sa rAjo.asya pitA bhikSho varabhogAntaraiva hi | kasmAchChAlvaiH svaripubhiH svalpehaishcha vighAtitaH
verses.translation: On seeing him come, Arjuna worshipped him. After eulogising him he stood in front of him and said— "Whence do you come now? Please tell me"

verses.sanskrit: कस्मादस्य शिशोर्माता ग्राहेणाशु सुभक्षिता । यस्मादनाथोऽयं जातो विबन्धुश्चैव जन्मतः
verses.transliteration: kasmAdasya shishormAtA grAheNAshu subhakShitA | yasmAdanAtho.ayaM jAto vibandhushchaiva janmataH
verses.translation: The lord of gods thus requested by him spoke with a hint at testing his courage, out of love.

verses.sanskrit: कस्मात्सुतो ममापीह सुदरिद्रो हि भिक्षुकः । भवेत्कथं सुखं भिक्षो पुत्रयोरनयोर्वद
verses.transliteration: kasmAtsuto mamApIha sudaridro hi bhikShukaH | bhavetkathaM sukhaM bhikSho putrayoranayorvada
verses.translation: O dear, why do you perform the penance in your prime of youth? Is it for salvation or for victory? In every respect this penance of yours is useless.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा स भिक्षुः परमेश्वरः । विप्रपत्न्याः प्रसन्नात्मा प्रोवाच विहसँश्च ताम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti tasyA vachaH shrutvA sa bhikShuH parameshvaraH | viprapatnyAH prasannAtmA provAcha vihasa.Nshcha tAm
verses.translation: Thus questioned by him he informed him of every¬ thing. On hearing that the brahmin spoke again.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्य उवाच । विप्रपत्नि विशेषेण सर्वप्रश्नान्वदामि ते । शृणु त्वं सावधानेन चरित्रमिदमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bhikShuvarya uvAcha | viprapatni visheSheNa sarvaprashnAnvadAmi te | shR^iNu tvaM sAvadhAnena charitramidamuttamam
verses.translation: O bachelor, go hence. Do you wish to cause my downfall? Of what use is this to you a bachelor?

verses.sanskrit: अमुष्य बालस्य पिता स विदर्भमहीपतिः । पूर्वजन्मनि पाण्ड्योऽसौ बभूव नृपसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: amuShya bAlasya pitA sa vidarbhamahIpatiH | pUrvajanmani pANDyo.asau babhUva nR^ipasattamaH
verses.translation: *'0 dear, O Arjuna of great intellect, choose your boon, whatever you wish in your mind. There is nothing which cannot be given to you.'*

verses.sanskrit: स शैवनृपतिर्धर्मात्पालयन्निखिलां महीम् । स्वप्रजां रञ्जयामास सर्वोपद्रवनाशनः
verses.transliteration: sa shaivanR^ipatirdharmAtpAlayannikhilAM mahIm | svaprajAM ra~njayAmAsa sarvopadravanAshanaH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Indra, Arjuna replied "O father, bless me with victory. I am afflicted by enemies in every respect."

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्स हि सर्वेशं प्रदोषे पर्यपूजयत् । त्रयोदश्यां निराहारो दिवानक्तव्रती शिवम्
verses.transliteration: kadAchitsa hi sarveshaM pradoShe paryapUjayat | trayodashyAM nirAhAro divAnaktavratI shivam
verses.translation: Your enemies, Duryodhana and others arc very powerful. Drona, Bhlma, Kara and others arc certainly invincible.

verses.sanskrit: स विदर्भनृपः कृत्वा सार्धं तैर्दारुणं रणम् । प्रनष्टोरुबलः शाल्वैर्निहतो दैवयोगतः
verses.transliteration: sa vidarbhanR^ipaH kR^itvA sArdhaM tairdAruNaM raNam | pranaShTorubalaH shAlvairnihato daivayogataH
verses.translation: Avatthaman, son of Droria and a part of Rudra, is extremely invincible. But they can be withstood through me. Listen to what is wholesome to you.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पूजयतः शम्भुं प्रदोषे गिरिशं रते । महान् शब्दो बभूवाथ विकटः सर्वथा पुरे
verses.transliteration: tasya pUjayataH shambhuM pradoShe girishaM rate | mahAn shabdo babhUvAtha vikaTaH sarvathA pure
verses.translation: I, Brahma and others, Vinu the bestower of boons and those who crave for victory are the devotees of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तमाकर्ण्य रवं सोऽथ राजा त्यक्तशिवार्चनः । रिप्वागमनशङ्कातो निर्ययौ भवनाद् बहिः
verses.transliteration: tamAkarNya ravaM so.atha rAjA tyaktashivArchanaH | ripvAgamanasha~NkAto niryayau bhavanAd bahiH
verses.translation: Now onwards leave that mantra and worship Siva with devotion through the rules laid down for the worship of his clay phallic image and by contemplating on him.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु तस्यामात्यो महाबली । गृहीतशत्रुसामन्तो राजान्तिकमुपाययौ
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kAle tu tasyAmAtyo mahAbalI | gR^ihItashatrusAmanto rAjAntikamupAyayau
verses.translation: O Bharata, by your devotional feelings and modes of service, you worship Siva. Your achievement will be unshakable. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुसामन्तं महाक्रोधेन विह्वलः । अविचार्य वृषन्तस्य शिरश्छेदमकारयत्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA shatrusAmantaM mahAkrodhena vihvalaH | avichArya vR^iShantasya shirashChedamakArayat
verses.translation: After saying this he called out his spies and said— "All of you shall be cautious and attentive in protecting him always. "

verses.sanskrit: असमाप्येशपूजां तामशुचिर्नष्टधीर्नृपः । रात्रौ चकार सुप्रीत्या भोजनं नष्टमङ्गलः
verses.transliteration: asamApyeshapUjAM tAmashuchirnaShTadhIrnR^ipaH | rAtrau chakAra suprItyA bhojanaM naShTama~NgalaH
verses.translation: Thus alerting his spies for the protection to be accorded to Arjuna, Indra spoke again to Arjuna with his.'eart full of fondness and afl'ection.

verses.sanskrit: विदर्भे सोऽभवद्राजा जन्मनीह शिवव्रती । शिवार्चनान्तरायेण परैर्भोगान्तरे हतः
verses.transliteration: vidarbhe so.abhavadrAjA janmanIha shivavratI | shivArchanAntarAyeNa parairbhogAntare hataH
verses.translation: O Gentle one, O terrifier of enemies, you shall not commit blunders in the administration of your kingdom. This mantra will be conducive to your glory.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पिता यः पूर्वभवे सोऽस्मिञ्जन्मनि तत्सुतः । अयमेव हतैश्वर्यः शिवपूजाव्यतिक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tatpitA yaH pUrvabhave so.asmi~njanmani tatsutaH | ayameva hataishvaryaH shivapUjAvyatikramAt
verses.translation: Always courage shall be maintained by an aspirant. Siva the protector will give you riches and the fruits of your desire. This is undoubtedly true.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य माता पूर्वभवे सपत्नीं छद्मनाहरत् । भक्षिता तेन पापेन ग्राहेणास्मिन् भवे हि सा
verses.transliteration: asya mAtA pUrvabhave sapatnIM ChadmanAharat | bhakShitA tena pApena grAheNAsmin bhave hi sA
verses.translation: After giving the boon to Arjuna, the lord of gods remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and went to his abode.

verses.sanskrit: एषा प्रवृत्तिरेतेषां भवत्यै परिकीर्तिता । अनर्चितशिवा भक्त्या प्राप्नुवन्ति दरिद्रताम्
verses.transliteration: eShA pravR^ittireteShAM bhavatyai parikIrtitA | anarchitashivA bhaktyA prApnuvanti daridratAm
verses.translation: The heroic Arjuna bowing to the lord of gods, performed the penance with controlled mind with Siva as his goal.

verses.sanskrit: एष ते तनयः पूर्वजन्मनि ब्राह्मणोत्तमः । प्रतिग्रहैर्वयो निन्ये न यज्ञाद्यैः सुकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: eSha te tanayaH pUrvajanmani brAhmaNottamaH | pratigrahairvayo ninye na yaj~nAdyaiH sukarmabhiH
verses.translation: He performed the ablution duly, and the Nyasa (the mystic placing of fingers etc.) in accordance with the Gastric injunctions. He performed the meditation of Siva with great devotion in the manner explained by Vyasa.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नृपे हते युद्धे शाल्वैस्तु भयविह्वलाः । सैनिका हतशेषाश्च मन्त्रिभिः सह दुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration: tasminnR^ipe hate yuddhe shAlvaistu bhayavihvalAH | sainikA hatasheShAshcha mantribhiH saha dudruvuH
verses.translation: Like a great sage, he stood on the sole of a single foot. He fixed one of his eyes at the sun and stood repeating the mantra.

verses.sanskrit: अतो दारिद्र्यमापन्नः पुत्रस्ते द्विजभामिनि । तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं शरणं शङ्करं व्रज
verses.transliteration: ato dAridryamApannaH putraste dvijabhAmini | taddoShaparihArArthaM sharaNaM sha~NkaraM vraja
verses.translation: Repeating the five-syllabled mantra of Siva the most excellent of all the mantras and mentally remembering Siva with pleasure he performed the penance.

verses.sanskrit: एताभ्यां खलु बालाभ्यां शिवपूजा विधीयताम् । उपवीतानन्तरं हि शिवः श्रेयः करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: etAbhyAM khalu bAlAbhyAM shivapUjA vidhIyatAm | upavItAnantaraM hi shivaH shreyaH kariShyati
verses.translation: After saying this the gods eulogised him in different ways. Fixing their eyes to his feet they stood there in agony.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तामुपदिश्याथ भिक्षुवर्यतनुः शिवः । स्वरूपं दर्शयामास परमं भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti tAmupadishyAtha bhikShuvaryatanuH shivaH | svarUpaM darshayAmAsa paramaM bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: On hearing their words the lord of benevolent mind, the delighted Siva laughingly spoke thus to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा विप्रवनिता ज्ञात्वा तं शङ्करं प्रभुम् । सुप्रणम्य हि तुष्टाव प्रेम्णा गद्गदया गिरा
verses.transliteration: atha sA vipravanitA j~nAtvA taM sha~NkaraM prabhum | supraNamya hi tuShTAva premNA gadgadayA girA
verses.translation: O gods, you go to your abodcj. Undoubtedly I shall carry out your task in every respect.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् शम्भुर्धृतभिक्षुतनुर्द्रुतम् । पश्यन्त्या विप्रपन्त्यास्तु तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tataH sa bhagavAn shambhurdhR^itabhikShutanurdrutam | pashyantyA viprapantyAstu tatraivAntaradhIyata
verses.translation: On hearing those words of Siva, they became as¬ sured. They therefore returned to their abodes.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्मिन् गते भिक्षौ विश्रब्धा ब्राह्मणी च सा । तमर्भकं समादाय सस्वपुत्रा गृहं ययौ
verses.transliteration: atha tasmin gate bhikShau vishrabdhA brAhmaNI cha sA | tamarbhakaM samAdAya sasvaputrA gR^ihaM yayau
verses.translation: He may be one of those come here to wreak ven¬ geance. Or he may be some friend of Duryodhana acting for his welfare.

verses.sanskrit: एकचक्राह्वये रम्ये ग्राम्ये कृतनिकेतना । स्वपुत्रं राजपुत्रं च वरान्नैश्च व्यवर्धयत्
verses.transliteration: ekachakrAhvaye ramye grAmye kR^itaniketanA | svaputraM rAjaputraM cha varAnnaishcha vyavardhayat
verses.translation: The conduct declares the family, the body declares the diet, the mode of speech declares the amount of learning and the eye indicates the affection.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैः कृतसंस्कारौ कृतोपनयनौ च तौ । ववृधाते स्वगेहे च शिवपूजनतत्परौ
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNaiH kR^itasaMskArau kR^itopanayanau cha tau | vavR^idhAte svagehe cha shivapUjanatatparau
verses.translation: The battle between Arjuna and.iva disguised as Kirata over the possession of an arrow that killed the t)oar, as described in Chs, 39, 40, 41 here, forms the main theme of Bharavi's Kiiatarjunlya.

verses.sanskrit: तौ शाण्डिल्यमुनेस्तात निदेशान्नियमस्थितौ । प्रदोषे चक्रतुः शम्भोः पूजां कृत्वा व्रतं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tau shANDilyamunestAta nideshAnniyamasthitau | pradoShe chakratuH shambhoH pUjAM kR^itvA vrataM shubham
verses.translation: Cp. Pafleatantra I. 44.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिद् द्विजपुत्रेण विनासौ राजनन्दनः । नद्यां स्नातुं गतः प्राप निधानकलशं वरम्
verses.transliteration: kadAchid dvijaputreNa vinAsau rAjanandanaH | nadyAM snAtuM gataH prApa nidhAnakalashaM varam
verses.translation: In regard to him my sense-organs are excited. He must be an enemy. Undoubtedly he shall be killed.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्य महाराज्ञी रात्रौ स्वपुरतो मुने । संरुद्धा रिपुभिर्यत्नादन्तर्वत्नी बहिर्ययौ
verses.transliteration: atha tasya mahArAj~nI rAtrau svapurato mune | saMruddhA ripubhiryatnAdantarvatnI bahiryayau
verses.translation: I remember the words of my preceptor now—"O king, a person causing misery shall be killed by • you by all means. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पूजयतोः शम्भुं राजद्विजकुमारयोः । सुखेनैव व्यतीयाय तयोर्मासचतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: evaM pUjayatoH shambhuM rAjadvijakumArayoH | sukhenaiva vyatIyAya tayormAsachatuShTayam
verses.translation: In the meantime, Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees, assumed the wonderful form of an efficient hunter and came there along with his Ganas in order to slay that Daitya, to protect Arjuna as well as to test his devotion.

verses.sanskrit: एवमर्चयतोः शम्भुं भूयोऽपि परया मुदा । सम्वत्सरो व्यतीयाय तस्मिन्नेव तयोर्गृहे
verses.transliteration: evamarchayatoH shambhuM bhUyo.api parayA mudA | samvatsaro vyatIyAya tasminneva tayorgR^ihe
verses.translation: The hunter had tucked up his lion-cloth and folded up I§iva*s banner. His body was lined with the white ash. He held a bow and arrows.

verses.sanskrit: सम्वत्सरे व्यतिक्रान्ते स राजतनयो मुने । गत्वा वनान्ते विप्रेण शिवस्यानुग्रहाद्विभोः
verses.transliteration: samvatsare vyatikrAnte sa rAjatanayo mune | gatvA vanAnte vipreNa shivasyAnugrahAdvibhoH
verses.translation: He carried the quiver suspended over his back. The Ganas too assumed the form of hunters. Siva too became the chief of Bhillas.

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मादागतां तत्र दत्तां तज्जनकेन ह । विवाह्य गन्धर्वसुतां चक्रे राज्यमकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: akasmAdAgatAM tatra dattAM tajjanakena ha | vivAhya gandharvasutAM chakre rAjyamakaNTakam
verses.translation: The Commander-in-Ghief started various sounds. The grunting sound of the boar too spread over the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: या विप्रवनिता पूर्वं तमपुष्णात्स्वपुत्रवत् । सैव माताभवत्तस्य स भ्राता द्विजनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: yA vipravanitA pUrvaM tamapuShNAtsvaputravat | saiva mAtAbhavattasya sa bhrAtA dvijanandanaH
verses.translation: Vya too has mentioned and the gods too. Siva is mentioned as the benefactor. Siva is the cause of happiness.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थमाराध्य देवेशं धर्मगुप्ताह्वयः स वै । विदर्भविषये राज्ञ्या तया भोगं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: itthamArAdhya deveshaM dharmaguptAhvayaH sa vai | vidarbhaviShaye rAj~nyA tayA bhogaM chakAra ha
verses.translation: Vya too has mentioned and the gods too. Siva is mentioned as the benefactor. Siva is the cause of happiness.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुवर्यावतारस्ते वर्णितश्च मयाधुना । शिवस्य धर्मगुप्ताह्वनृपबालसुखप्रदः
verses.transliteration: bhikShuvaryAvatAraste varNitashcha mayAdhunA | shivasya dharmaguptAhvanR^ipabAlasukhapradaH
verses.translation: Even in dreams, misery does not befall those who worship him with devotion. If it happens at all, it is due to their previous activities.

verses.sanskrit: एतदाख्यानमनघं पवित्रं पावनं महत् । धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां साधनं सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: etadAkhyAnamanaghaM pavitraM pAvanaM mahat | dharmArthakAmamokShANAM sAdhanaM sarvakAmadam
verses.translation: That must happen whether big or small. The fault is particularly that of the action that has begun to fructify.

verses.sanskrit: य एतच्छृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्कामान् सोऽन्ते शिवपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: ya etachChR^iNuyAnnityaM shrAvayedvA samAhitaH | sa bhuktvehAkhilAnkAmAn so.ante shivapuraM vrajet
verses.translation: Or iva may dispel the misery by his will, after one has experienced the fruits of one's action big or small.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गता शोकसन्तप्ता सा राजमहिषी शनैः । प्राचीं दिशं ययौ दूरं स्मरन्तीशपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: nirgatA shokasantaptA sA rAjamahiShI shanaiH | prAchIM dishaM yayau dUraM smarantIshapadAmbujam
verses.translation: He can convert poison into nectar and nectar

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रभाते सा राज्ञी ददर्श विमलं सरः । अतीता दूरमध्वानं दयया शङ्करस्य हि
verses.transliteration: atha prabhAte sA rAj~nI dadarsha vimalaM saraH | atItA dUramadhvAnaM dayayA sha~Nkarasya hi
verses.translation: Devotees of yore and future devotees must keep their mind steady after considering all those aspects whether one is in affluent circumstances or not, whether death is imminent or not or whether people praise or censure. Misery is quelled. 8iva is always the bestower of happiness through the merit and sin of individuals. Sometimes 8iva makes us miserable in order to test us.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: In order to protect Arjuna, Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, came there closely pursuing the boar. Between the two the animal rushed on and then halted. A wonderful horn was seen.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: In order to protect Arjuna, Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, came there closely pursuing the boar. Between the two the animal rushed on and then halted. A wonderful horn was seen.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.३२. द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । शृणु तात प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । सुरेश्वरावतारस्ते धौम्याग्रजहितावहम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.32\. dvAtriMsho.adhyAyaH | nandIshvara uvAcha | shR^iNu tAta pravakShyAmi shivasya paramAtmanaH | sureshvarAvatAraste dhaumyAgrajahitAvaham
verses.translation: Then both of them discharged the arrow. Siva's arrow hit the tail, Arjuna's arrow hit the snout.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजन्मनि यत्कृत्यं शिवमुद्दिश्य हे सुत । तदेव लभ्यते नूनं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: pUrvajanmani yatkR^ityaM shivamuddishya he suta | tadeva labhyate nUnaM nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: Siva's arrow hit the tail and stopped at the snout. It struck the ground and entered it. Arjuna's arrow pierced through the body. It came out of the tail and fell at its side. The boar who was a Daitya fell dead on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: इति मातृवचः श्रुत्वा व्याघ्रपादिः स बालकः । प्रत्युवाच विशोकात्मा मातरं मातृवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: iti mAtR^ivachaH shrutvA vyAghrapAdiH sa bAlakaH | pratyuvAcha vishokAtmA mAtaraM mAtR^ivatsalaH
verses.translation: The gods were much delighted. They showered flowers. Bowing down and eulogising they cried shouts of victory.

verses.sanskrit: शोकेनालमिमं मातः शम्भुर्यद्यस्ति शङ्करः । त्यज शोकं महाभागे सर्वं भद्रं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: shokenAlamimaM mAtaH shambhuryadyasti sha~NkaraH | tyaja shokaM mahAbhAge sarvaM bhadraM bhaviShyati
verses.translation: On seeing the cruel form of the Daitya, Siva was glad and Arjuna was happy.

verses.sanskrit: शृणु मातर्वचो मेऽद्य महादेवोऽस्ति चेत्क्वचित् । चिराद्वा ह्यचिराद्वापि क्षीरोदं साधयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: shR^iNu mAtarvacho me.adya mahAdevo.asti chetkvachit | chirAdvA hyachirAdvApi kShIrodaM sAdhayAmyaham
verses.translation: With an excessively happy mind Arjuna said— ''O this is a huge Daitya. He had assumed this wonderful form and had come here to kill me. But I have been saved by Siva. Lord Siva has given me keen intelligence. There is no doubt in this."

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा स शिशुः प्रीत्या शिवं मेऽस्त्वित्युदीर्य च । विसृज्य तां सुप्रणम्य तपः कर्तुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA sa shishuH prItyA shivaM me.astvityudIrya cha | visR^ijya tAM supraNamya tapaH kartuM prachakrame
verses.translation: After thinking thus Arjuna repeated Siva's name. He bowed to Siva and eulogised him again and again.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवत्पर्वतगतः वायुभक्षः समाहितः । अष्टेष्टकाभिः प्रासादं कृत्वा लिङ्गं च मृन्मयम्
verses.transliteration: himavatparvatagataH vAyubhakShaH samAhitaH | aShTeShTakAbhiH prAsAdaM kR^itvA li~NgaM cha mR^inmayam
verses.translation: O omni*'cient Sanatkumara, listen to the sport of the great soul Siva full of affection for the devotee and to the test of its stability.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रावाह्य शिवं साम्बं भक्त्या पञ्चाक्षरेण ह । पत्रपुष्पादिभिर्वन्यैः समानर्च शिशुः स वै
verses.transliteration: tatrAvAhya shivaM sAmbaM bhaktyA pa~nchAkShareNa ha | patrapuShpAdibhirvanyaiH samAnarcha shishuH sa vai
verses.translation: Siva immediately sent his attendant to fetch the arrow. The Arjuna too came there.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा शिवं च तं साम्बं जपन्पञ्चाक्षरं मनुम् । समभ्यर्च्य चिरं कालं चचार परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: dhyAtvA shivaM cha taM sAmbaM japanpa~nchAkSharaM manum | samabhyarchya chiraM kAlaM chachAra paramaM tapaH
verses.translation: The Gana and Arjuna reached the place simultane¬ ously for the arrow. Arjuna rebuked him and took up his arrow.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा तस्य बालस्य ह्युपमन्योर्महात्मनः । चराचरं च भुवनं प्रदीपितमभून्मुने
verses.transliteration: tapasA tasya bAlasya hyupamanyormahAtmanaH | charAcharaM cha bhuvanaM pradIpitamabhUnmune
verses.translation: The Gaa said—excellent sage, why do you take this arrow? The arrow is mine. Leave it off."

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शम्भुर्विष्ण्वाद्यैः प्रार्थितः प्रभुः । परीक्षितुं च तद्भक्तिं शक्ररूपोऽभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare shambhurviShNvAdyaiH prArthitaH prabhuH | parIkShituM cha tadbhaktiM shakrarUpo.abhavattadA
verses.translation: O excellent sage, thus addressed by the Gana of the Bhilla, Arjuna remembered Siva and spoke.

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रपादसुतो धीमानुपमन्युः सतां प्रियः । जन्मान्तरेण संसिद्धः प्राप्तो मुनिकुमारताम्
verses.transliteration: vyAghrapAdasuto dhImAnupamanyuH satAM priyaH | janmAntareNa saMsiddhaH prApto munikumAratAm
verses.translation: O forest-roamer, what do you say without under¬ standing? You are a fool. This arrow had been discharged by me just now. How can it be yours?

verses.sanskrit: शिवा शचीस्वरूपाभूद्गणाः सर्वेऽभवन्सुराः । ऐरावतगजो नन्दी सर्वमेव च तन्मयम्
verses.transliteration: shivA shachIsvarUpAbhUdgaNAH sarve.abhavansurAH | airAvatagajo nandI sarvameva cha tanmayam
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the leader of the Ganas laughed and spoke to Arjuna who was in the garb of a sage.

verses.sanskrit: ततः साम्बः शिवः शक्रस्वरूपः सगणो द्रुतम् । जगामानुग्रहं कर्तुमुपमन्योस्तदाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sAmbaH shivaH shakrasvarUpaH sagaNo drutam | jagAmAnugrahaM kartumupamanyostadAshramam
verses.translation: O sage, listen. You arc a sage in disguise. You are not a true sage. You do not perform penance. People are being deceived by you.

verses.sanskrit: परीक्षितुं च तद्भक्तिं शक्ररूपधरो हरः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा बालकं तं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: parIkShituM cha tadbhaktiM shakrarUpadharo haraH | prAha gambhIrayA vAchA bAlakaM taM munIshvara
verses.translation: How can a saint utter a lie? Do not take me to be single-handed. Know me to be the commander-in-chief.

verses.sanskrit: सुरेश्वर उवाच । तुष्टोऽस्मि ते वरं ब्रूहि तपसानेन सुव्रत । ददामि चेच्छितान्कामान् सर्वान्नात्रास्ति संशयः
verses.transliteration: sureshvara uvAcha | tuShTo.asmi te varaM brUhi tapasAnena suvrata | dadAmi chechChitAnkAmAn sarvAnnAtrAsti saMshayaH
verses.translation: O sage, why do you wish to lose the fruit of your penance? Truly have I heard that penance is marrfcd

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः स वै तेन शक्ररूपेण शम्भुना । वरयामि शिवे भक्तिमित्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: evamuktaH sa vai tena shakrarUpeNa shambhunA | varayAmi shive bhaktimityuvAcha kR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: If you do not give up this arrow you will be an ungrateful fellow. It was certainly to save you that my master discharged this arrow.

verses.sanskrit: तन्निशम्य हरिः प्राह मां न जानासि लेखपम् । त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं शक्रं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tannishamya hariH prAha mAM na jAnAsi lekhapam | trailokyAdhipatiM shakraM sarvadevanamaskR^itam
verses.translation: Your enemy has been killed by him and you have kept the arrow to yourself. Very ungrateful indeed arc you. You are making your own penance fruitless.

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तो भव विप्रर्षे मामेवार्चय सर्वदा । ददामि सर्वं भद्रं ते त्यज रुद्रं च निर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: madbhakto bhava viprarShe mAmevArchaya sarvadA | dadAmi sarvaM bhadraM te tyaja rudraM cha nirguNam
verses.translation: You do not speak the truth. What you wish to gfain thereby? If you have any need for the arrow, you may approach my master and request him.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रेण निर्गुणेनालं किं ते कार्यं भविष्यति । देवजातिबहिर्भूतो यः पिशाचत्वमागतः
verses.transliteration: rudreNa nirguNenAlaM kiM te kAryaM bhaviShyati | devajAtibahirbhUto yaH pishAchatvamAgataH
verses.translation: He can give you many similar arrows. My master is here. Why don't you request him?

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा स मुनेः पुत्रो जपन्पञ्चाक्षरं मनुम् । मन्यमानो धर्मविघ्नं प्राह तं कर्तुमागतम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | tachChrutvA sa muneH putro japanpa~nchAkSharaM manum | manyamAno dharmavighnaM prAha taM kartumAgatam
verses.translation: Unmindful of his hc'p to you, you wish him harm. This does not behove you. Eschew this fickleness.'

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । त्वयैवं कथितं सर्वं भवनिन्दारतेन वै । प्रसङ्गाद्देवदेवस्य निर्गुणत्वं पिशाचता
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | tvayaivaM kathitaM sarvaM bhavanindAratena vai | prasa~NgAddevadevasya nirguNatvaM pishAchatA
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Arjuna, son of Pftha, was angry. After remembering Iiva, he spoke these measured words.

verses.sanskrit: उवास मातुलगृहे स मात्रा शिशुरेव हि । उपमन्युर्व्याघ्रपादिः स्याद्दरिद्रश्च दैवतः
verses.transliteration: uvAsa mAtulagR^ihe sa mAtrA shishureva hi | upamanyurvyAghrapAdiH syAddaridrashcha daivataH
verses.translation: O hunter, listen. I shall explain. Your words are not true. O forest*wanderer, I know you. You are true to the caste in which you are born.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न जानासि वै रुद्रं सर्वदेवेश्वरेश्वरम् । ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां जनकं प्रकृतेः परम्
verses.transliteration: tvaM na jAnAsi vai rudraM sarvadeveshvareshvaram | brahmaviShNumaheshAnAM janakaM prakR^iteH param
verses.translation: I am a king. You are a thief. How can a war be pursued? I must fight with people equal in strength to me, never with base people.

verses.sanskrit: सदसद् वयक्तमव्यक्तं यमाहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः । नित्यमेकमनेकं च वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: sadasad vayaktamavyaktaM yamAhurbrahmavAdinaH | nityamekamanekaM cha varaM tasmAd vR^iNomyaham
verses.translation: Your master will be only like you. We are the benevolent donors and you the forest-dwellers, thieves.

verses.sanskrit: हेतुवादविनिर्मुक्तं साङ्ख्ययोगार्थदं परम् । यमुशन्ति हि तत्त्वज्ञा वरं तस्माद् वृणोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: hetuvAdavinirmuktaM sA~NkhyayogArthadaM param | yamushanti hi tattvaj~nA varaM tasmAd vR^iNomyaham
verses.translation: How can the king of foresters be requested by me now? O forest-wanderer, why don't you beg the arrow of me?

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति शम्भोः परं तत्त्वं सर्वकारणकारणत् । ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिदेवानां श्रेष्ठो गुणपराद्विभोः
verses.transliteration: nAsti shambhoH paraM tattvaM sarvakAraNakAraNat | brahmaviShNvAdidevAnAM shreShTho guNaparAdvibhoH
verses.translation: I shall readily give you the arrows. Certainly I have many. If a king docs not give what is taken, your objection may come up.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं वृणे वरं त्वत्तो न विष्णोर्ब्रह्मणोऽपि वा । नान्यस्मादमराद्वापि शङ्करो वरदोऽस्तु मे
verses.transliteration: nAhaM vR^iNe varaM tvatto na viShNorbrahmaNo.api vA | nAnyasmAdamarAdvApi sha~Nkaro varado.astu me
verses.translation: Why should there be a long talk? Let your master come and fight with me. Defeating me in the battle,

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन वच्मि तत्त्वं मतं स्वकम् । न प्रार्थये पशुपतेरन्यं देवादिकं स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: bahunAtra kimuktena vachmi tattvaM mataM svakam | na prArthaye pashupateranyaM devAdikaM sphuTam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Arjuna who derived his strength from the mercy of lord Siva the forester spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: मद्भावं शृणु गोत्रारे मयाद्यानुमितं त्विदम् । भवान्तरे कृतं पापं श्रुता निन्दा भवस्य चेत्
verses.transliteration: madbhAvaM shR^iNu gotrAre mayAdyAnumitaM tvidam | bhavAntare kR^itaM pApaM shrutA nindA bhavasya chet
verses.translation: You are ignorant. You are not a sage. Why do you invite death? Give up the arrow and stay here happily or you will come ito grief.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा निन्दां भवस्याथ तत्क्षणादेव सन्त्यजेत् । स्वदेहं तन्निहत्याशु शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: shrutvA nindAM bhavasyAtha tatkShaNAdeva santyajet | svadehaM tannihatyAshu shivalokaM sa gachChati
verses.translation: Thus challenged by the forester who derived his strength from Siva and who was a Gana, Arjuna, son of Pandu remembered!§iva and said.

verses.sanskrit: आस्तां तावन्ममेच्छेयं क्षीरं प्रति सुराधम । निहत्य त्वां शिवास्त्रेण त्यजाम्येतत्कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: AstAM tAvanmamechCheyaM kShIraM prati surAdhama | nihatya tvAM shivAstreNa tyajAmyetatkalevaram
verses.translation: O forester, listen attentively to my words. If your master comes here I shall show my strength.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वोपमन्युस्तं मर्तुं व्यवसितः स्वयम् । क्षीरे वाच्छामपि त्यक्त्वा निहन्तुं शक्रमुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamuktvopamanyustaM martuM vyavasitaH svayam | kShIre vAchChAmapi tyaktvA nihantuM shakramudyataH
verses.translation: It does not behove me to fight with you. I shall fight with your master. The fight between a lion and a jackal is very ridiculous.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्क्षीरमत्यल्पं पीतवान्मातुलाश्रमे । ययाचे मातरं प्रीत्या बहुशो दुग्धलालसः
verses.transliteration: kadAchitkShIramatyalpaM pItavAnmAtulAshrame | yayAche mAtaraM prItyA bahusho dugdhalAlasaH
verses.translation: You have heard my words. You shall see my strength now. O Bhilla, return to your master. Do as vou pleas#*.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मादाय तदाधारादघोस्त्राभिमन्त्रितम् । विसृज्य शक्रमुद्दिश्य ननाद स मुनिस्तदा
verses.transliteration: bhasmAdAya tadAdhArAdaghostrAbhimantritam | visR^ijya shakramuddishya nanAda sa munistadA
verses.translation: O sage, thus addressed by Arjuna, the Bhilla returned to the place where the general Kirata, the incarnation of l§iva, stood.

verses.sanskrit: स्मृत्वा स्वेष्टपदद्वन्द्वं स्वदेहं दग्धुमुद्यतः । आग्नेयीं धारणां बिभ्रदुपमन्युरवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: smR^itvA sveShTapadadvandvaM svadehaM dagdhumudyataH | AgneyIM dhAraNAM bibhradupamanyuravasthitaH
verses.translation: He mentioned Arjunas talk in detail to lord Siva, the great soul in the form of Bhilla.

verses.sanskrit: एवं व्यवसिते विप्रे भगवान् शक्ररूपवान् । वारयामास सौम्येन धारणां तस्य योगिनः
verses.transliteration: evaM vyavasite vipre bhagavAn shakrarUpavAn | vArayAmAsa saumyena dhAraNAM tasya yoginaH
verses.translation: On seeing Kirata with his army, Arjuna, son of Pandu, look up his bow and arrows and faced him.

verses.sanskrit: तद्विसृष्टमघोरास्त्रं नन्दीश्वरनियोगतः । जगृहे मध्यतः क्षिप्तं नन्दी शङ्करवल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: tadvisR^iShTamaghorAstraM nandIshvaraniyogataH | jagR^ihe madhyataH kShiptaM nandI sha~Nkaravallabham
verses.translation: Then Kirata sent the messenger again and

verses.sanskrit: स्वरूपमेव भगवानास्थाय परमेश्वरः । दर्शयामास विप्राय बालेन्दुकृतशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: svarUpameva bhagavAnAsthAya parameshvaraH | darshayAmAsa viprAya bAlendukR^itashekharam
verses.translation: O sage, sec this army coming. Give up the arrow and go away. Why do you seek death for a trifle.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरार्णवसहस्रं च दध्यादेरर्णवं तथा । भक्ष्यभोज्यार्णवं तस्मै दर्शयामास स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kShIrArNavasahasraM cha dadhyAderarNavaM tathA | bhakShyabhojyArNavaM tasmai darshayAmAsa sa prabhuH
verses.translation: What the lord said, the Gana of Siva mentioned that to Arjuna in detail after approaching him.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स ददृशे शम्भुर्देव्या सार्धं वृषोपरि । गणेश्वरैस्त्रिशूलाद्यैर्दिव्यास्त्रैरपि संवृतः
verses.transliteration: evaM sa dadR^ishe shambhurdevyA sArdhaM vR^iShopari | gaNeshvaraistrishUlAdyairdivyAstrairapi saMvR^itaH
verses.translation: On hearing that, Arjuna replied to the messenger "You shall tell your general that the reverse of what he says will happen to him.

verses.sanskrit: दिवि दुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात ह । विष्णुब्रह्मेन्द्रप्रमुखैर्देवैश्छन्ना दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: divi dundubhayo neduH puShpavR^iShTiH papAta ha | viShNubrahmendrapramukhairdevaishChannA disho dasha
verses.translation: If I were to give up the arrow that belongs to me I shall be the cause of ignominy to my family.

verses.sanskrit: अथोपमन्युरानन्दसमुद्रोर्मिभिरावृतः । पपात दण्डवद्भूमौ भक्तिनम्रेण चेतसा
verses.transliteration: athopamanyurAnandasamudrormibhirAvR^itaH | papAta daNDavadbhUmau bhaktinamreNa chetasA
verses.translation: Well may my brothers be distressed. Let all my knowledge be fruitless. So, come on to fight with me.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये तत्र सस्मितो भगवान्भवः । एह्येहीति समाहूय मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय ददौ वरान्
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye tatra sasmito bhagavAnbhavaH | ehyehIti samAhUya mUrdhnyAghrAya dadau varAn
verses.translation: Thus replied by Arjuna the Bhilla returned to his master and conveyed all that Arjuna had said.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा पुत्रवचनं तन्माता च तपस्विनी । सान्तः प्रविश्याथ तदा शुभोपायमरीरचत्
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA putravachanaM tanmAtA cha tapasvinI | sAntaH pravishyAtha tadA shubhopAyamarIrachat
verses.translation: Lord f>iva, a Kirata, heard the message and approached Arjuna along with his army.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । वत्सोपमन्यो तुष्टोऽस्मि त्वदाचरणतो वरात् । दृढभक्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे मया जिज्ञासितोऽधुना
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | vatsopamanyo tuShTo.asmi tvadAcharaNato varAt | dR^iDhabhakto.asi viprarShe mayA jij~nAsito.adhunA
verses.translation: On seeing him comci Arjuna meditated on Siva and fought with him a terrible battle.

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोगान्यथाकामं बान्धवैर्भुङ्क्ष्व सर्वदा । सुखी भव सदा दुःखनिर्मुक्तो भक्तिमान्मम
verses.transliteration: bhakShyabhogAnyathAkAmaM bAndhavairbhu~NkShva sarvadA | sukhI bhava sadA duHkhanirmukto bhaktimAnmama
verses.translation: Arjuna split the arrows discharged by Kirata and his ganas. Then he thought upon Siva.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्यो महाभाग तवाम्बैषा हि पार्वती । मया पुत्रीकृतो ह्यद्य कुमारत्वं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyo mahAbhAga tavAmbaiShA hi pArvatI | mayA putrIkR^ito hyadya kumAratvaM sanAtanam
verses.translation: When distressed by him, the Ganas fled to the quarters. Then Siva summoned the chief Ganas. But they did not respond to his call.

verses.sanskrit: दुग्धदध्याज्यमधुनामर्णवाश्च सहस्रशः । भक्ष्यभोज्यादिवस्तूनामर्णवाश्चाखिलास्तथा
verses.transliteration: dugdhadadhyAjyamadhunAmarNavAshcha sahasrashaH | bhakShyabhojyAdivastUnAmarNavAshchAkhilAstathA
verses.translation: Siva and Arjuna of great strength and exploit fought each other with various weapons of war.

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं दत्ता मया प्रीत्या त्वं गृह्णीष्व महामुने । अमरत्वं तथा दत्तं गाणपत्यं च शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: tubhyaM dattA mayA prItyA tvaM gR^ihNIShva mahAmune | amaratvaM tathA dattaM gANapatyaM cha shAshvatam
verses.translation: Taking pity on him Siva approached Arjuna, but Arjuna hit him heavily.

verses.sanskrit: पिताहं ते महादेवो माता ते जगदम्बिका । वरान्वरय सुप्रीत्या मनोऽभिलषितान्परान्
verses.transliteration: pitAhaM te mahAdevo mAtA te jagadambikA | varAnvaraya suprItyA mano.abhilaShitAnparAn
verses.translation: Siva split the weapons of Arjuna as well as his armour. Aijuna stood in his bare body.

verses.sanskrit: अजरश्चामरश्चैव भव त्वं दुःखवर्जितः । यशस्वी वरतेजस्वी दिव्यज्ञानी महाप्रभुः
verses.transliteration: ajarashchAmarashchaiva bhava tvaM duHkhavarjitaH | yashasvI varatejasvI divyaj~nAnI mahAprabhuH
verses.translation: Although afflicted by fear, Arjuna remembered Siva and fought a duel with the general spiritedly.

verses.sanskrit: अथ शम्भुः प्रसन्नात्मा स्मृत्वा तस्य तपो महत् । पुनर्दश वरान्दिव्यान्मुनये ह्यूपमन्यवे
verses.transliteration: atha shambhuH prasannAtmA smR^itvA tasya tapo mahat | punardasha varAndivyAnmunaye hyUpamanyave
verses.translation: The earth along with the oceans shook due to their fight. "What will happen now?" Thinking thus, the gods were distressed.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतं पाशुपतं ज्ञानं व्रतयोगं च तत्त्वतः । ददौ तस्मै प्रवक्तृत्वं पाटवं च निजं पदम्म्
verses.transliteration: vrataM pAshupataM j~nAnaM vratayogaM cha tattvataH | dadau tasmai pravaktR^itvaM pATavaM cha nijaM padamm
verses.translation: In the meantime, lord Siva stood in mid-air and fought. Arjuna too did likewise.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दत्त्वा महादेवः कराभ्यामुपगृह्य तम् । मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय सुतस्तेऽयमिति देव्यै न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: evaM dattvA mahAdevaH karAbhyAmupagR^ihya tam | mUrdhnyAghrAya sutaste.ayamiti devyai nyavedayat
verses.translation: Flying at each other, lord Siva and the earthly king Arjuna fought with each other. On seeing that wonder¬ ful battle the gods were surprised.

verses.sanskrit: उञ्छवृत्त्यर्जितान्बीजान्पिष्ट्वालोड्य जलेन तान् । उपलाल्य सुतं तस्मै सा ददौ कृत्रिमं पयः
verses.transliteration: u~nChavR^ittyarjitAnbIjAnpiShTvAloDya jalena tAn | upalAlya sutaM tasmai sA dadau kR^itrimaM payaH
verses.translation: Then Arjuna came to the ground, remembered the lous-like feet of Siva and caught hold of his feet deriving sufficient strength, thanks to his meditation on Siva.

verses.sanskrit: देवी च शृण्वती प्रीत्या मूर्ध्नि देशे कराम्बुजम् । विन्यस्य प्रददौ तस्मै कुमारपदमक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: devI cha shR^iNvatI prItyA mUrdhni deshe karAmbujam | vinyasya pradadau tasmai kumArapadamakShayam
verses.translation: Catching hold of his feet, Arjuna whirled him. Lord Siva, favourably disposed towards his disciples, laughed indulging in divine sports.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीराब्धिमपि साकारं क्षीरस्वादुकरोदधिः । उपास्थाय ददौ तस्मै पिण्डीभूतमनश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kShIrAbdhimapi sAkAraM kShIrasvAdukarodadhiH | upAsthAya dadau tasmai piNDIbhUtamanashvaram
verses.translation: Then Siva smiled and revealed his wonderful auspicious form as he is always well disposed to his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: योगैश्वर्यं सदा तुष्टं ब्रह्मविद्यामनश्वराम् । समृद्धिं परमां तस्मै ददौ सन्तुष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: yogaishvaryaM sadA tuShTaM brahmavidyAmanashvarAm | samR^iddhiM paramAM tasmai dadau santuShTamAnasaH
verses.translation: On seeing that beautiful form, the form of the excellent supreme being as mentioned in the Vedas, Sastras and Puranas, the form which Vyasa had advised him to meditate upon, the form which bestows all Siddhis, the form of Siva, Arjuna was abashed and surprised much.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि लब्ध्वा वरान्दिव्यान्कुमारत्वं च सर्वदा । तस्माच्छिवाच्च तस्याश्च शिवाया मुदितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: so.api labdhvA varAndivyAnkumAratvaM cha sarvadA | tasmAchChivAchcha tasyAshcha shivAyA mudito.abhavat
verses.translation: "Ha, this is Siva, this is Siva who has been chosen by me as my lord, the lord of the three worlds him¬ self. O what a thing have I committed now!

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नचेतस्कः सुप्रणम्य कृताञ्जलिः । ययाचे स वरं प्रीत्या देवदेवान्महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: tataH prasannachetaskaH supraNamya kR^itA~njaliH | yayAche sa varaM prItyA devadevAnmaheshvarAt
verses.translation: After thinking thus within himself he joined his palms in reverence and bending his head he bowed to the lord with pleasure. Then he spoke in a delighted manner.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । प्रसीद देवदेवेश प्रसीद परमेश्वर । स्वभक्तिं देहि परमां दिव्यामव्यभिचारिणीम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | prasIda devadevesha prasIda parameshvara | svabhaktiM dehi paramAM divyAmavyabhichAriNIm
verses.translation: O great god, O lord of gods, O Siva the merciful, O lord of all, my fault shall be forgiven by you.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धां देहि महादेव स्वसम्बन्धिषु मे सदा । स्वदास्यं परमं स्नेहं स्वसान्निध्यं च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: shraddhAM dehi mahAdeva svasambandhiShu me sadA | svadAsyaM paramaM snehaM svasAnnidhyaM cha sarvadA
verses.translation: What you have done? By concealing your own form you have deceived me now. Fie on me who fought with you, my master, O lord.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा प्रसन्नात्मा हर्षगद्गदया गिरा । तुष्टाव स महादेवमुपमन्युर्द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamuktvA prasannAtmA harShagadgadayA girA | tuShTAva sa mahAdevamupamanyurdvijottamaH
verses.translation: Thus Arjuna, son of Panqlu, repented. He fell at the feet of lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः शिवस्तेन सर्वेषां शृण्वतां प्रभुः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मोपमन्युं सकलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evamuktaH shivastena sarveShAM shR^iNvatAM prabhuH | pratyuvAcha prasannAtmopamanyuM sakaleshvaraH
verses.translation: Cheering up in various ways the delighted lord Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees, replied to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । वत्सोपमन्यो धन्यस्त्वं मम भक्तो विशेषतः । सर्वं दत्तं मया ते हि यद् वृतं भवतानघ
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | vatsopamanyo dhanyastvaM mama bhakto visheShataH | sarvaM dattaM mayA te hi yad vR^itaM bhavatAnagha
verses.translation: O Arjuna, do not worry yourself. You are a great devotee of mine. I have done this just to test you. Give up your sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा च कृत्रिमं दुग्धं मात्रा दत्तं स बालकः । नैतत्क्षीरमिति प्राह मातरं चारुदत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: pItvA cha kR^itrimaM dugdhaM mAtrA dattaM sa bAlakaH | naitatkShIramiti prAha mAtaraM chArudatpunaH
verses.translation: After saying this and lifting Arjuna with his own hands, the lord rid him of his bashfulness through his own lordly qualities.

verses.sanskrit: अजरश्चामरश्च त्वं सर्वदा दुःखवर्जितः । सर्वपूज्यो निर्विकारी भक्तानां प्रवरो भव
verses.transliteration: ajarashchAmarashcha tvaM sarvadA duHkhavarjitaH | sarvapUjyo nirvikArI bhaktAnAM pravaro bhava
verses.translation: Delighting Arjuna, son of Pandu, honoured by

verses.sanskrit: अक्षया बान्धवाश्चैव कुलं गोत्रं च ते सदा । भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ मयि भक्तिश्च शाश्वती
verses.transliteration: akShayA bAndhavAshchaiva kulaM gotraM cha te sadA | bhaviShyati dvijashreShTha mayi bhaktishcha shAshvatI
verses.translation: O Arjuna, foremost among the sons of Pandu, 1 am delighted. Choose your boon. By your hits and blows I have been worshipped by you. I consider it so.

verses.sanskrit: सान्निध्यं चाश्रये नित्यं करिष्यामि मुने तव । तिष्ठ वत्स यथाकामं नोत्कण्ठां च करिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: sAnnidhyaM chAshraye nityaM kariShyAmi mune tava | tiShTha vatsa yathAkAmaM notkaNThAM cha kariShyasi
verses.translation: This has been done by my own will. I'he fault is not yours. There is nothing which cannot be given to you. Choose whatever you desire.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तस्मै दत्त्वा वरान्वरान् । साम्बश्च सगणः सद्यस्तत्रैवान्तर्दधे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | evamuktvA sa bhagavAMstasmai dattvA varAnvarAn | sAmbashcha sagaNaH sadyastatraivAntardadhe prabhuH
verses.translation: In order to establish the rule of your fame among your enemies what you have done is auspicious. You shall not be struck with grief. Eschew all your feebleness.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युः प्रसन्नात्मा प्राप्य शम्भोर्वरान्वरान् । जगाम जननीस्थानं मात्रे सर्वमवर्णयत्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuH prasannAtmA prApya shambhorvarAnvarAn | jagAma jananIsthAnaM mAtre sarvamavarNayat
verses.translation: Thus addressed by lord Siva, Arjuna stood care¬ fully and spoke to Siva with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य जननी महाहर्षमवाप सा । सर्वपूज्योऽभवत्सोऽपि सुखं प्रापाधिकं सदा
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA tasya jananI mahAharShamavApa sA | sarvapUjyo.abhavatso.api sukhaM prApAdhikaM sadA
verses.translation: After saying this, the son of Pandu eulogised Siva the great lord, devotedly, in the manner approved of by the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं ते वर्णितस्तात शिवस्य परमात्मनः । सुरेश्वरावतारो हि सर्वदा सुखदः सताम्
verses.transliteration: itthaM te varNitastAta shivasya paramAtmanaH | sureshvarAvatAro hi sarvadA sukhadaH satAm
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you the lord of gods. Obeisance to you the resident of Kailasa. O Sadaiva, obeisance to you. Obeisance to you, the five-faced®* one.

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानमनघं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् । स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: idamAkhyAnamanaghaM sarvakAmaphalapradam | svargyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM bhuktimuktipradaM satAm
verses.translation: Obeisance to Kapardin (one with matted hair), obeisance to you, the three-eyed. Obeisance to the delighted one, obeisance to the thousand-faced.

verses.sanskrit: य एतच्छृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा सोऽन्ते शिवगतिं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: ya etachChR^iNuyAdbhaktyA shrAvayedvA samAhitaH | iha sarvasukhaM bhuktvA so.ante shivagatiM labhet
verses.translation: O blue-necked one, obeisance to you. Obeisance to Sadyojata. O bull-bannered one, obeisance to you with Parvati as your left half.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा सुतस्य रुदितं प्राह सा दुःखिता सुतम् । सम्मार्ज्य नेत्रे पुत्रस्य कराभ्यां कमलाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: shrutvA sutasya ruditaM prAha sA duHkhitA sutam | sammArjya netre putrasya karAbhyAM kamalAkR^itiH
verses.translation: O ten-armed one, Obeisance to you the great soul. Obeisance to you holding the drum and the skull in your hands. Obeisance to you, the one wearing a garland of skulls.

verses.sanskrit: मातोवाच । क्षीरमत्र कुतोऽस्माकं वने निवसतां सदा । प्रसादेन विना शम्भोः पयः प्राप्तिर्भवेन्न हि
verses.transliteration: mAtovAcha | kShIramatra kuto.asmAkaM vane nivasatAM sadA | prasAdena vinA shambhoH payaH prAptirbhavenna hi
verses.translation: Obeisance to you with the body refulgent like pure crystal and pure camphpr, obeisance to you with the Pinaka in your hand, obeisance to the bearer of the excellent Trident.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to you of splendid, reddish feet, worthy to be served by Nandin and other Ganas. Obeisance to you, the chief of Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to you of splendid, reddish feet, worthy to be served by Nandin and other Ganas. Obeisance to you, the chief of Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां ३.३३. त्रयोत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । ब्रह्मचारिशिवावतारवर्णनम् । नन्दीश्वर उवाच । सनत्कुमार सुप्रीत्या शिवस्य परमात्मनः । अवतारं शृणु विभोर्जटिलाह्वं सुपावनम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || tR^itIyAyAM shatarudrasaMhitAyAM 3\.33\. trayotriMsho.adhyAyaH | brahmachArishivAvatAravarNanam | nandIshvara uvAcha | sanatkumAra suprItyA shivasya paramAtmanaH | avatAraM shR^iNu vibhorjaTilAhvaM supAvanam
verses.translation: Obeisance to one in the form of Ganea, followed by Karttikeya. Obeisance to the bestower of devotion and salvation to the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: धृत्वैवं जाटिलं रूपं जगाम गिरिजावनम् । अतिप्रीतियुतः शम्भुः शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: dhR^itvaivaM jATilaM rUpaM jagAma girijAvanam | atiprItiyutaH shambhuH sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to you devoid of attributes. Obeisance to you possessed of attributes. Obeisance to one with and without forms, having digits and devoid of digits.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापश्यत् स्थितां देवीं सखीभिः परिवारिताम् । वेदिकोपरि शुद्धान्तां शिवामिव विधोः कलाम्
verses.transliteration: tatrApashyat sthitAM devIM sakhIbhiH parivAritAm | vedikopari shuddhAntAM shivAmiva vidhoH kalAm
verses.translation: Obeisance to the one who blessed me in the form

verses.sanskrit: शम्भुर्निरीक्ष्य तां देवीं ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपवान् । उपकण्ठं ययौ प्रीत्या चोत्सुकी भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: shambhurnirIkShya tAM devIM brahmachArisvarUpavAn | upakaNThaM yayau prItyA chotsukI bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: Even the Vedas cannot enumerate your good

verses.sanskrit: आगतं सा तदा दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणं तेजसाद्भुतम् । अङ्गेषु लोमशं शान्तं दण्डचर्मसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: AgataM sA tadA dR^iShTvA brAhmaNaM tejasAdbhutam | a~NgeShu lomashaM shAntaM daNDacharmasamanvitam
verses.translation: Whatever be your nature, obeisance be to you. It behoves you to take pity. O lord, I am your slave. O lord liva, you are my master.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यधरं वृद्धं जटिलं सकमण्डलुम् । अपूजयत्परप्रीत्या सर्वपूजोपहारकैः
verses.transliteration: brahmacharyadharaM vR^iddhaM jaTilaM sakamaNDalum | apUjayatparaprItyA sarvapUjopahArakaiH
verses.translation: Thus urged by him, Arjuna bowed to Sadaiva with palms joined in reverence and with head bending down. He s|>oke with words choked with devotion

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा पार्वती देवी पूजितं परया मुदा । कुशलं पर्यपृच्छत्तं ब्रह्मचारिणमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tataH sA pArvatI devI pUjitaM parayA mudA | kushalaM paryapR^ichChattaM brahmachAriNamAdarAt
verses.translation: What shall I say? You are the immanent Soul of all. Still let my detailed explanation be heard by you, O lord.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपेण कस्त्वं हि कुत आगतः । इद्ं वनं भासयसि वद वेदविदां वर
verses.transliteration: brahmachArisvarUpeNa kastvaM hi kuta AgataH | idM vanaM bhAsayasi vada vedavidAM vara
verses.translation: Whatever danger I had from enemies has vanished at your sight. Please do that which may confer worldly Siddhis on me.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति पृष्टस्तु पार्वत्या ब्रह्मचारी स वै द्विजः । प्रत्युवाच द्रुतं प्रीत्या शिवाभावपरीक्षया
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti pR^iShTastu pArvatyA brahmachArI sa vai dvijaH | pratyuvAcha drutaM prItyA shivAbhAvaparIkShayA
verses.translation: Seeing Arjuna, son of Pandu, the foremost of his devotees, lord iva was extremely glad and satisfied.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचार्युवाच । अहमिच्छाभिगामी च ब्रह्मचारी द्विजोऽस्मि वै । तपस्वी सुखदोऽन्येषामुपकारी न संशयः
verses.transliteration: brahmachAryuvAcha | ahamichChAbhigAmI cha brahmachArI dvijo.asmi vai | tapasvI sukhado.anyeShAmupakArI na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Lord Siva gave him Pasupata missile that could not be thwarted by anyone at any time and spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा ब्रह्मचारी स शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । तस्थिवानुपकण्ठं स गोपायन् रूपमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA brahmachArI sa sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH | tasthivAnupakaNThaM sa gopAyan rUpamAtmanaH
verses.translation: I have given you my own great missile. You will become invincible thereby. You will reap success over your enemies through this.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा सती दक्षकन्या त्यक्त्वा देहं पितुर्मखे । स्वपित्रानादृता जज्ञे मेनायां हिमभूधरात्
verses.transliteration: purA satI dakShakanyA tyaktvA dehaM piturmakhe | svapitrAnAdR^itA jaj~ne menAyAM himabhUdharAt
verses.translation: I shall tell K]:sna also. He will help you. He is my own soul, my devotee and he carries out my task.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचार्युवाच । किं ब्रवीमि महादेवि कथनीयं न विद्यते । महानर्थकरं वृत्तं दृश्यते विकृतं महत्
verses.transliteration: brahmachAryuvAcha | kiM bravImi mahAdevi kathanIyaM na vidyate | mahAnarthakaraM vR^ittaM dR^ishyate vikR^itaM mahat
verses.translation: O Bharata, due to my power, you will rule over your kingdom unhindered. You shall perform righteous deeds of various kinds always along with your brother.

verses.sanskrit: नवे वयसि सद्भोगसाधने सुखकारणे । महोपचारसद्भोगैर्वृथैव त्वं तपस्यसि
verses.transliteration: nave vayasi sadbhogasAdhane sukhakAraNe | mahopachArasadbhogairvR^ithaiva tvaM tapasyasi
verses.translation: After saying this and placing his hand over his head, Siva vanished after being duly worshipped by Aijuna.

verses.sanskrit: का त्वं कस्यासि तनया किमर्थं विजने वने । तपश्चरसि दुर्धर्षं मुनिभिः प्रयतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: kA tvaM kasyAsi tanayA kimarthaM vijane vane | tapashcharasi durdharShaM munibhiH prayatAtmabhiH
verses.translation: The delighted Arjuna, after obtaining the excellent missile from the lord, returned to his hermitage remembering devotedly his chief preceptor and Siva,

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य परमेश्वरी । उवाच वचनं प्रीत्या ब्रह्मचारिणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | iti tadvachanaM shrutvA prahasya parameshvarI | uvAcha vachanaM prItyA brahmachAriNamuttamam
verses.translation: When he arrived, his brother felt fully revived as the body with vital airs. They felt happy at his sight. Draupadi of good rites was also delighted.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्युवाच । शृणु विप्र ब्रह्मचारिन् मद्वृत्तमखिलं मुने । जन्म मे भारते वर्षे साम्प्रतं हिमवद्गृहे
verses.transliteration: pArvatyuvAcha | shR^iNu vipra brahmachArin madvR^ittamakhilaM mune | janma me bhArate varShe sAmprataM himavadgR^ihe
verses.translation: The delighted Panavas were not satiated by hear.> ing the.details from Arjuna and knowing that Siva was satisfied,

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं दक्षगृहे जन्म सती शङ्करकामिनी । योगेन त्यक्तदेहाहं तातेन पतिनिन्दिना
verses.transliteration: pUrvaM dakShagR^ihe janma satI sha~NkarakAminI | yogena tyaktadehAhaM tAtena patinindinA
verses.translation: By bowing to Siva joyously and realising that the time-limit had arrived, they knew that success was at hand.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र जन्मनि सम्प्राप्तः सुपुण्येन शिवो द्विज । मां त्यक्त्वा भस्मसात्कृत्वा मन्मथं स जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: atra janmani samprAptaH supuNyena shivo dvija | mAM tyaktvA bhasmasAtkR^itvA manmathaM sa jagAma ha
verses.translation: In the meantime, on hearing that Arjuna had returned, Kfsna came there to see him. He was very happy.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयाते शङ्करे तापाद् व्रीडिताहं पितुर्गृहात् । आगच्छमत्र तपसे गुरुवाक्येन संयता
verses.transliteration: prayAte sha~Nkare tApAd vrIDitAhaM piturgR^ihAt | AgachChamatra tapase guruvAkyena saMyatA
verses.translation: Thus the incarnation of Siva as Kirata has been explained to you. He who hears and narrates this obtains all desires.

verses.sanskrit: मनसा वचसा साक्षात्कर्मणा पतिभावतः । सत्यं ब्रवीमि नोऽसत्यं संवृतः शङ्करो मया
verses.transliteration: manasA vachasA sAkShAtkarmaNA patibhAvataH | satyaM bravImi no.asatyaM saMvR^itaH sha~Nkaro mayA
verses.translation: O sage, now listen to the twelve incarnations of the lord in the form of jyotirlifigas, the cause of diverse sports.

verses.sanskrit: जानामि दुर्लभं वस्तु कथं प्राप्यं मया भवेत् । तथापि मनसौत्सुक्यात्तप्यते मे तपोऽधुना
verses.transliteration: jAnAmi durlabhaM vastu kathaM prApyaM mayA bhavet | tathApi manasautsukyAttapyate me tapo.adhunA
verses.translation: The jyotirlingas'®* are—Somanatha in the Saurastra®* territory; Mallikarjuna on the mountain Srilaila'®*; Mahakala in Ujjayinli®*; Amaresvara in Omkarai®® Mandhata; Itedara®* on the Himalaya; Bhimasahkara in the city of Dakini;*® Vivesvara in the city of VaranasP®*; Tryambaka on the banks ofGautamP®®; Vaidyanatha in the cremation ground®; Nageia in the forest ofDarukai; Ramevara in the Setubandha'* Ghusmesvara in the iSiva temple.

verses.sanskrit: सा गत्वा गहनेऽरण्ये तेपे सुविमलं तपः । शङ्करं पतिमिच्छन्ती सखीभ्यां संयुता शिवा
verses.transliteration: sA gatvA gahane.araNye tepe suvimalaM tapaH | sha~NkaraM patimichChantI sakhIbhyAM saMyutA shivA
verses.translation: O sage, the twelve incarnations of the supreme soul are wholly delightful to all men for seeing and touching.

verses.sanskrit: हित्वेन्द्रप्रमुखान्देवान्विष्णुं ब्रह्माणमप्यहम् । पतिं पिनाकपाणिं वै प्राप्तुमिच्छामि सत्यतः
verses.transliteration: hitvendrapramukhAndevAnviShNuM brahmANamapyaham | patiM pinAkapANiM vai prAptumichChAmi satyataH
verses.translation: There, the first one, Somanatha, annihilated the distress of the moon. O sage, by wor<ihipping, it diSpels the ailments of consumption, leprosy etc.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा पार्वत्या हि सुनिश्चितम् । मुने स जटिलो रुद्रो विहसन्वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityevaM vachanaM shrutvA pArvatyA hi sunishchitam | mune sa jaTilo rudro vihasanvAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: A holy place of pilgiimage on the bank of the Bhima river, north-west of Poona.

verses.sanskrit: जटिल उवाच । हिमाचलसुते देवि का बुद्धिः स्वीकृता त्वया । रुद्रार्थं विबुधान्हित्वा करोषि विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: jaTila uvAcha | himAchalasute devi kA buddhiH svIkR^itA tvayA | rudrArthaM vibudhAnhitvA karoShi vipulaM tapaH
verses.translation: On seeing Somesvara, the great phallic image of 5iva, people arc freed from sin. They attain worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: जानाम्यहं च तं रुद्रं शृणु त्वं प्रवदामि ते । वृषध्वजः स रुद्रो हि विकृतात्मा जटाधरः
verses.transliteration: jAnAmyahaM cha taM rudraM shR^iNu tvaM pravadAmi te | vR^iShadhvajaH sa rudro hi vikR^itAtmA jaTAdharaH
verses.translation: O dear, the second incarnation of Siva Mallikarjuna, on the mountain, Srisaila, is the bestower of the desires of devotees.

verses.sanskrit: एकाकी च सदा नित्यं विरागी च विशेषतः । तस्मात्त्वं तेन रुद्रेण मनो योक्तुं न चार्हसि
verses.transliteration: ekAkI cha sadA nityaM virAgI cha visheShataH | tasmAttvaM tena rudreNa mano yoktuM na chArhasi
verses.translation: O sage, Siva went there from his mountain, with great pleasure in order to see his son Karttikeya. It is station¬ ed there in the form of the phallic image.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं विरुद्धं रूपादि तव देवि हरस्य च । मह्यं न रोचते ह्येतद्यदीच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: sarvaM viruddhaM rUpAdi tava devi harasya cha | mahyaM na rochate hyetadyadIchChasi tathA kuru
verses.translation: O dear, Siva incarnated himself as Mahakala in the city of Ujjayini for the protection of his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा च पुना रुद्रो ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपवान् । निनिन्द बहुधात्मानं तदग्रे तां परीक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA cha punA rudro brahmachArisvarUpavAn | nininda bahudhAtmAnaM tadagre tAM parIkShitum
verses.translation: The demon Dusana, a resident of Ratnamala,'® was a defiler of Vedic rites, a hater of brahmins and des¬ troyer of everyone. When he reached Ujjayini, the lord was meditated upon by the sons of the Vedic brahmins. He redu¬ ced the demon to ashes by a mere Hurfikara.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्वती देवी विप्रवाक्यं दुरासदम् । प्रत्युवाच महाक्रुद्धा शिवनिन्दापरं च तम्
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA pArvatI devI vipravAkyaM durAsadam | pratyuvAcha mahAkruddhA shivanindAparaM cha tam
verses.translation: After killing him, on being requested by the gods; lord Mahakala stayed there in the form of a Jyotirlihga. He continues to protect his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: एतावद्धि मया ज्ञातं कश्चिद् धन्यो भविष्यति । परन्तु सकलं ज्ञातमवध्यो दृश्यतेऽधुना
verses.transliteration: etAvaddhi mayA j~nAtaM kashchid dhanyo bhaviShyati | parantu sakalaM j~nAtamavadhyo dR^ishyate.adhunA
verses.translation: By seeing and strenuously worshipping the phallic image of Mahakala, the devotee attains his desires and the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपेण कश्चित्त्वं धूर्त आगतः । शिवनिन्दा कृता मूढ त्वया मन्युरभून्मम
verses.transliteration: brahmachArisvarUpeNa kashchittvaM dhUrta AgataH | shivanindA kR^itA mUDha tvayA manyurabhUnmama
verses.translation: The fourth incarnation of Siva the supreme soul, the great lord in Omkara Mandhata is a bestower of the desires of his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तपः सुपरीक्षार्थं सप्तर्षीन्प्रैषयच्छिवः । तपःस्थानं तु पार्वत्या नानालीलाविशारदः
verses.transliteration: tattapaH suparIkShArthaM saptarShInpraiShayachChivaH | tapaHsthAnaM tu pArvatyA nAnAlIlAvishAradaH
verses.translation: O sage, lord Siva manifested himself from his earthen phallic image devoutly installed by Brahma and he fulfilled the desires of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: शिवं त्वं च न जानासि शिवात्त्वं हि बहिर्मुखः । त्वत्पूजा च कृता यन्मे तस्मात्तापयुताभवम्
verses.transliteration: shivaM tvaM cha na jAnAsi shivAttvaM hi bahirmukhaH | tvatpUjA cha kR^itA yanme tasmAttApayutAbhavam
verses.translation: On being requested by the gods the lord in the form of his phallic image stayed there two-fold, bestowing worldly pleasures and salvation and being favourably disposed towards his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: शिवनिन्दां करोतीह तत्त्वमज्ञाय यः पुमान् । आजन्मसञ्चितं पुण्यं तस्य भस्मीभवत्युत
verses.transliteration: shivanindAM karotIha tattvamaj~nAya yaH pumAn | Ajanmasa~nchitaM puNyaM tasya bhasmIbhavatyuta
verses.translation: The excellent phallic image abides in the syllable Omkara. O great sage, it also abides in the earthen phallic image in Oihkara Mandhat5.

verses.sanskrit: शिवविद्वेषिणं स्पृष्ट्वा प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: shivavidveShiNaM spR^iShTvA prAyashchittaM samAcharet
verses.translation: Not identified.

verses.sanskrit: रे रे दुष्ट त्वया प्रोक्तमहं जानामि शङ्करम् । निश्चयेन न विज्ञातः शिव एव परः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: re re duShTa tvayA proktamahaM jAnAmi sha~Nkaram | nishchayena na vij~nAtaH shiva eva paraH prabhuH
verses.translation: The sixth incarnation of Siva, the great lord named Bhimaiankara, performed great sports. He destroyed the demon Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: यथा तथा भवेद्रुद्रो मायया बहुरूपवान् । ममाभीष्टप्रदोऽत्यन्तं निर्विकारः सतां प्रियः
verses.transliteration: yathA tathA bhavedrudro mAyayA bahurUpavAn | mamAbhIShTaprado.atyantaM nirvikAraH satAM priyaH
verses.translation: After killing this wonderfully lusty demon who caused misery to the devotees, the lord saved the devotee Sudakina who was the king of Kamarupa.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा तं शिवा देवी शिवतत्त्वं जगाद सा । यत्र ब्रह्मतया रुद्रः कथ्यते निर्गुणोऽव्ययः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA taM shivA devI shivatattvaM jagAda sA | yatra brahmatayA rudraH kathyate nirguNo.avyayaH
verses.translation: Requested by him Siva himself in the name of Bhimaankara stayed in Dakini in the form of Jyotirlinga.

verses.sanskrit: तदाकर्ण्य वचो देव्या ब्रह्मचारी स वै द्विजः । पुनर्वचनमादातुं यावदेव प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: tadAkarNya vacho devyA brahmachArI sa vai dvijaH | punarvachanamAdAtuM yAvadeva prachakrame
verses.translation: O sage, the seventh incarnation as Viivegvara at KaSi is in the form of the entire cosmic egg. It yields worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच गिरिजा तावत्स्वसखीं विजयां द्रुतम् । शिवासक्तमनोवृत्तिः शिवनिन्दापराङ्मुखी
verses.transliteration: provAcha girijA tAvatsvasakhIM vijayAM drutam | shivAsaktamanovR^ittiH shivanindAparA~NmukhI
verses.translation: Those who repeat the names of KaSi and VMvea and perform their Japa with devotion become unaffected by actions and reach the state of Kaivalya.

verses.sanskrit: गिरिजोवाच । वारणीयः प्रयत्नेन सख्ययं हि द्विजाधमः । पुनर्वक्तुमनाश्चायं शिवनिन्दां करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: girijovAcha | vAraNIyaH prayatnena sakhyayaM hi dvijAdhamaH | punarvaktumanAshchAyaM shivanindAM kariShyati
verses.translation: The eighth incarnation Tryambaka of the moon- crested lord iSiva made its appearance on the banks of the river Gautam! on being requested by the sage Gautama.

verses.sanskrit: न केवलं भवेत्पापं निन्दाकर्तुः शिवस्य हि । यो वै शृणोति तन्निन्दां पापभाक्स भवेदिह
verses.transliteration: na kevalaM bhavetpApaM nindAkartuH shivasya hi | yo vai shR^iNoti tannindAM pApabhAksa bhavediha
verses.translation: At the request of Gautama and with a desire to delight that sage, the lord stood there motionless in the form of Jyotirlinga,

verses.sanskrit: ते गत्वा तत्र मुनयः परीक्षां चक्रुरादरात् । तस्याः सुयत्नतो नैव समर्था ह्यभवंश्च ते
verses.transliteration: te gatvA tatra munayaH parIkShAM chakrurAdarAt | tasyAH suyatnato naiva samarthA hyabhavaMshcha te
verses.translation: All desires fructify at the sight and touch of the great lord. Thereafter salvation too is attained.

verses.sanskrit: शिवनिन्दाकरो वध्यः सर्वथा शिवकिङ्करैः । ब्राह्मणश्चेत्स वै त्याज्यो गन्तव्यं तत्स्थलाद्द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: shivanindAkaro vadhyaH sarvathA shivaki~NkaraiH | brAhmaNashchetsa vai tyAjyo gantavyaM tatsthalAddrutam
verses.translation: With the blessings of i§iva, and pleased with Gautama, the holy river Gahga, the beloved of Siva, stayed there in the name of Gautami.

verses.sanskrit: अयं दुष्टः पुनर्निन्दां करिष्यति शिवस्य हि । ब्राह्मणत्वादवध्यश्च त्याज्योऽदृश्यश्च सर्वथा
verses.transliteration: ayaM duShTaH punarnindAM kariShyati shivasya hi | brAhmaNatvAdavadhyashcha tyAjyo.adR^ishyashcha sarvathA
verses.translation: Under the pretext of fetching him, lord Siva was installed in the cremation ground in the form of Jyotirliriga.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा चोमया यावत्पदमुत्क्षिप्यते मुने । असौ तावच्छिवः साक्षादाललम्बे पटं स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha | ityuktvA chomayA yAvatpadamutkShipyate mune | asau tAvachChivaH sAkShAdAlalambe paTaM svayam
verses.translation: The lord in the name of Vaidyanatha became famous in the three worlds. Seeing and worshipping him with devotion yields worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा स्वरूपं दिव्यं च शिवाध्यानं यथा तथा । दर्शयित्वा शिवायै तामुवाचावाङ्मुखीं शिवः
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA svarUpaM divyaM cha shivAdhyAnaM yathA tathA | darshayitvA shivAyai tAmuvAchAvA~NmukhIM shivaH
verses.translation: O sage, this benedictory passage referring to the greatness of Siva in the name of Vaidyanathesvara yields worldly pleasures and salvation to those who read and listen.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । कुत्र त्वं यासि मां हित्वा न त्वं त्याज्या मया शिवे । मया परीक्षितासि त्वं दृढभक्तासि मेऽनघे
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | kutra tvaM yAsi mAM hitvA na tvaM tyAjyA mayA shive | mayA parIkShitAsi tvaM dR^iDhabhaktAsi me.anaghe
verses.translation: He killed the Rakasa Daruka, a violator of virtue. He saved his devotee Supriya who was a merchant king.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपेण भावमिच्छुस्त्वदीयकम् । तवोपकण्ठमागत्य प्रावोचं विविधं वचः
verses.transliteration: brahmachArisvarUpeNa bhAvamichChustvadIyakam | tavopakaNThamAgatya prAvochaM vividhaM vachaH
verses.translation: In order to help all the worlds, Siva, the great indulgent in sports, remained there assuming the form of Jyotirlinga, accompanied by Parvati.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नोऽस्मि दृढं भक्त्या शिवे तव विशेषतः । चित्तेप्सितं वरं ब्रूहि नादेयं विद्यते तव
verses.transliteration: prasanno.asmi dR^iDhaM bhaktyA shive tava visheShataH | chittepsitaM varaM brUhi nAdeyaM vidyate tava
verses.translation: O sage, at the sight of Siva's phallic image named Nagesvara and thanks to its worship, heaps of great sins perish immediately.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति ते दासस्तपोभिः प्रेमनिर्भरे । कृतोऽस्मि तव सौन्दर्यात्क्षण एको युगायते
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhR^iti te dAsastapobhiH premanirbhare | kR^ito.asmi tava saundaryAtkShaNa eko yugAyate
verses.translation: O sage, the lord, implored ardently by Rama and propitiated by Rama stayed at Setubandha in the form of Jyotirlinga.

verses.sanskrit: त्यज्यतां च त्वया लज्जा मम पत्नी सनातनी । एहि प्रिये त्वया साकं द्रुतं यामि स्वकं गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: tyajyatAM cha tvayA lajjA mama patnI sanAtanI | ehi priye tvayA sAkaM drutaM yAmi svakaM girim
verses.translation: The grandeur of Rame'vara in the world was wonderful and incomparable, yielding worldly pleasures and salvation and bestowing the desires of the devotees ever.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागत्य शिवं नत्वा वृत्तान्तं च निवेद्य तत् । तदाज्ञां समनुप्राप्य स्वर्लोकं जग्मुरादरात्
verses.transliteration: tatrAgatya shivaM natvA vR^ittAntaM cha nivedya tat | tadAj~nAM samanuprApya svarlokaM jagmurAdarAt
verses.translation: The man who performs the ablution of

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तवति देवेशे शिवातिमुदमाप सा । तपोदुःखं तु यत्सर्वं तज्जहौ द्रुतमेव हि
verses.transliteration: ityuktavati deveshe shivAtimudamApa sA | tapoduHkhaM tu yatsarvaM tajjahau drutameva hi
verses.translation: After enjoying all worldly pleasures here, and then getting perfect knowledge, he shall obtain salvation here¬ after.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टा सा दृष्ट्वा दिव्यरूपं शिवस्य तत् । प्रत्युवाच प्रभुं प्रीत्या लज्जयाधोमुखी शिवा
verses.transliteration: tataH prahR^iShTA sA dR^iShTvA divyarUpaM shivasya tat | pratyuvAcha prabhuM prItyA lajjayAdhomukhI shivA
verses.translation: O sage, the lord manifested himself in a lake near the Devasaila* in the southern quarter acting favourably to Ghuma.

verses.sanskrit: शिवोवाच । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश करोषि च कृपां मयि । पतिर्मे भव देवेश इत्युक्तः शिवया शिवः
verses.transliteration: shivovAcha | yadi prasanno devesha karoShi cha kR^ipAM mayi | patirme bhava devesha ityuktaH shivayA shivaH
verses.translation: At her request, Siva stayed in the lake in the form of Jyotirlihga GhumeSvara conferring desires to the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच गृहीत्वा विधिवत्पाणिं कैलासं स तया ययौ । पतिं तं गिरिजा प्राप्य देवकार्यं चकार सा
verses.transliteration: nandIshvara uvAcha gR^ihItvA vidhivatpANiM kailAsaM sa tayA yayau | patiM taM girijA prApya devakAryaM chakAra sA
verses.translation: The man who sees that phallic image and worships it with devotion enjoys happiness here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इति प्रोक्तस्तु ते तात ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपकः । शिवावतारो हि मया शिवाभावपरीक्षकः
verses.transliteration: iti proktastu te tAta brahmachArisvarUpakaH | shivAvatAro hi mayA shivAbhAvaparIkShakaH
verses.translation: Thus I have explained to you the series of divine Jyotirlihgas twelve in number yielding both worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: इदमाख्यानमनघं परमं व्याहृतं मया । य एतच्छृणुयात्प्रीत्या स सुखी गतिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: idamAkhyAnamanaghaM paramaM vyAhR^itaM mayA | ya etachChR^iNuyAtprItyA sa sukhI gatimApnuyAt
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this narrative of Jyotirlihgas becomes freed of all sins and derives worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: गतेषु तेषु मुनिषु स्वस्थानं शङ्करः स्वयम् । परीक्षितुं शिवावृत्तमैच्छत्सूतिकरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: gateShu teShu muniShu svasthAnaM sha~NkaraH svayam | parIkShituM shivAvR^ittamaichChatsUtikaraH prabhuH
verses.translation: Thus I have described the compendium 8atarudra by name which glorifies the hundred incarnations of Siva and yields the fruits of desires.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसन्नस्तपस्वीच्छाशमनादयमीश्वरः । ब्रह्मचर्यस्वरूपोऽभूत्तदाद्भुततरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: suprasannastapasvIchChAshamanAdayamIshvaraH | brahmacharyasvarUpo.abhUttadAdbhutataraH prabhuH
verses.translation: He who reads this always or listens to it devotedly attains all desires and then becomes liberated, to be sure.

verses.sanskrit: अतीव स्थविरो विप्रदेहधारी स्वतेजसा । प्रज्वलन्मनसा हृष्टो दण्डी छत्री महोज्जलः
verses.transliteration: atIva sthaviro vipradehadhArI svatejasA | prajvalanmanasA hR^iShTo daNDI ChatrI mahojjalaH
verses.translation: According to thr present chapter V. it in situated on the Deva mountain in the south. For the identification of Devagiri see GEAMI P. 107

verses.sanskrit: स्थलमेतद् द्रुतं हित्वा यास्यामोऽन्यत्र मा चिरम् । यथा सम्भाषणं न स्यादनेनाविदुषा पुनः
