verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्भूतः स्वयं देवो ह्यनावृष्ट्यामजीवयत् । स एव शङ्करः साक्षादंशेन स्वयमेव हि
verses.transliteration: prAdurbhUtaH svayaM devo hyanAvR^iShTyAmajIvayat | sa eva sha~NkaraH sAkShAdaMshena svayameva hi
verses.translation: The Mbh. (III. 85. associates Kaiahiara with Citrakuta. According to this reference KSlahjara lies in the Madhya BhSrata formerly known as Bundel Khaida. Oinningham (A. G. see map at the end) places it to the east of Mahoba, below Citraki'Ma.
verses.hindi: इस ब्रह्महत्याका फल किस प्रकार भोगोगी 2

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सूत महाभाग कथमत्रीश्वरो हरः । उत्पन्नः परमो दिव्यस्तत्त्वं कथय सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | sUta sUta mahAbhAga kathamatrIshvaro haraH | utpannaH paramo divyastattvaM kathaya suvrata
verses.translation: Re\i identical with the Narmt da river is'urs firm the Rk?a mountain and is associated with $iva. It is known by various (•thci names.
verses.hindi: दोनोंके नष्ट होनेपर मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । साधु पृष्टमृषिश्रेष्ठाः कथयामि कथां शुभाम् । यां कथां सततं श्रुत्वा पातकैर्मुच्यते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | sAdhu pR^iShTamR^iShishreShThAH kathayAmi kathAM shubhAm | yAM kathAM satataM shrutvA pAtakairmuchyate dhruvam
verses.translation: O great sages, still I shall enumerate and explain the important phallic forms that yield worldly pleasures here and salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणस्यां दिशि महत् कामदं नाम यद्वनम् । चित्रकूटसमीपेऽस्ति तपसां हितदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: dakShiNasyAM dishi mahat kAmadaM nAma yadvanam | chitrakUTasamIpe.asti tapasAM hitadaM satAm
verses.translation: Sarmea, KumareSvara, Pundarikevara and
verses.hindi: इसके आगे कुछ भी नहीं कह सका

verses.sanskrit: तत्र च ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो ह्यत्रिनामा ऋषिः स्वयम् । तपस्तेपेऽतिकठिनमनसूयासमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: tatra cha brahmaNaH putro hyatrinAmA R^iShiH svayam | tapastepe.atikaThinamanasUyAsamanvitaH
verses.translation: I§ulevara, Kumbhevara, Kuberesvara and

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं कदाचित्तत्रैव ह्यनावृष्टिरभून्मुने । दुःखदा प्राणिनां दैवाद्विकटा शतवार्षिकी
verses.transliteration: pUrvaM kadAchittatraiva hyanAvR^iShTirabhUnmune | duHkhadA prANinAM daivAdvikaTA shatavArShikI
verses.translation: Lord Nandika prevents the sins of a crore of murders. He is glorified as the bestower of the fruits of desire and salvation too.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O excellent sages, he who takes bath in the Reva or on its banks, realises all desires and gets rid of sins.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O excellent sages, he who takes bath in the Reva or on its banks, realises all desires and gets rid of sins.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.४. चतुर्थोऽध्यायः । अत्रीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । कदाचित्स ऋषिश्रेष्ठो ह्यत्रिर्ब्रह्मविदां वरः । जागृतश्च जलं देहि प्रत्युवाच प्रियामिति
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.4\. chaturtho.adhyAyaH | atrIshvaramAhAtmyavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | kadAchitsa R^iShishreShTho hyatrirbrahmavidAM varaH | jAgR^itashcha jalaM dehi pratyuvAcha priyAmiti
verses.translation: O sages, aunaka and others, you have well put the question. I shall narrate in the manner I have heard. Listen respectfully.
verses.hindi: गायको मारकर उसका बन्धन खोल दिया

verses.sanskrit: अहं गङ्गा समायाता भजनात्ते शुचिस्मिते । वशीभूता ह्यहं जाता यदिच्छसि वृणीष्व तत्
verses.transliteration: ahaM ga~NgA samAyAtA bhajanAtte shuchismite | vashIbhUtA hyahaM jAtA yadichChasi vR^iNIShva tat
verses.translation: The city named Karniki'®® of great splendour shines
verses.hindi: कहने लगे-देखिये, यह कैसा आश्चर्य है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्ते गङ्गया साध्वी नमस्कृत्य पुरः स्थिता । उवाचेति जलं देहि चेत्प्रसन्ना ममाधुना
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityukte ga~NgayA sAdhvI namaskR^itya puraH sthitA | uvAcheti jalaM dehi chetprasannA mamAdhunA
verses.translation: Not identified.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा गर्तं कुर्विति साब्रवीत् । शीघ्रं चायाच्च तत्कृत्वा स्थिता तत्क्षणमात्रतः
verses.transliteration: ityetadvachanaM shrutvA gartaM kurviti sAbravIt | shIghraM chAyAchcha tatkR^itvA sthitA tatkShaNamAtrataH
verses.translation: A certain noble brahmin there, born of the family of Utta, entrusted his wife to the care of his two sons and went to Kai.
verses.hindi: शंकरस्य प्रसादेन गता सा हयुत्तमां गतिम्॥ ६७  भोगकर शिवकृपासे उन्होंने श्रेष्ठ गति प्राप्त की

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सा च प्रविष्टा च जलरूपमभूत्तदा । आश्चर्यं परमं गत्वा गृहीतं च जलं तया
verses.transliteration: tatra sA cha praviShTA cha jalarUpamabhUttadA | AshcharyaM paramaM gatvA gR^ihItaM cha jalaM tayA
verses.translation: The brahmin died there itself. On getting the news the two sons performed the obsequies.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नमानसो5 भूत्स शुद्धात्मा स्वगृहं गतः॥ ६६  हो अपने घर चला गया

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं चैतल्लोकानां सुखहेतवे । अनसूया मुनेः पत्नी दिव्यरूपां सरिद्वराम्
verses.transliteration: uvAcha vachanaM chaitallokAnAM sukhahetave | anasUyA muneH patnI divyarUpAM saridvarAm
verses.translation: The wife looked after the sons, seeking their welfare. After bringing up the sons she divided the assets.

verses.sanskrit: अनसूयोवाच । यदि त्वं सुप्रसन्ना मे वर्तसे च कृपा मयि । स्थातव्यं च त्वया तावत् मत्स्वामी यावदाव्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: anasUyovAcha | yadi tvaM suprasannA me vartase cha kR^ipA mayi | sthAtavyaM cha tvayA tAvat matsvAmI yAvadAvrajet
verses.translation: She reserved some amount for her funeral expenses. After sometime when she was'going to die, she made pious gifts of various sorts. O brahmins, providentially she did not die.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणीस्वर्गतिवर्णण नामक छठवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वानसूयाया वचनं सुखदं सताम् । गङ्गोवाच प्रसन्नाति ह्यत्रेर्दास्यसि मेऽनघे
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvAnasUyAyA vachanaM sukhadaM satAm | ga~NgovAcha prasannAti hyatrerdAsyasi me.anaghe
verses.translation: When she did not die providentially, the son observing her ailments said.
verses.hindi: वृत्तं तदपि सुप्रीत्या कथय त्वं महामते॥ २  प्रीतिपूर्वक कहिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते च तया तत्र ह्यनयापि कृतं तथा । स्वामिने तज्जलं दिव्यं दत्त्वा तत्पुरतः स्थिता
verses.transliteration: ityukte cha tayA tatra hyanayApi kR^itaM tathA | svAmine tajjalaM divyaM dattvA tatpurataH sthitA
verses.translation: The elder son replied—"Please do mention. I shall do the same." She then replied.
verses.hindi: पार्थिवार्चनपूर्व हि. तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्॥ ६  हो, पार्थिवपूजनपूर्वक कठोर तप करने लगी

verses.sanskrit: स ऋषिश्चापि सुप्रीत्या स्वाचम्य विधिपूर्वकम् । पपौ दिव्यं जलं तच्च पीत्वा सुखमवाप ह
verses.transliteration: sa R^iShishchApi suprItyA svAchamya vidhipUrvakam | papau divyaM jalaM tachcha pItvA sukhamavApa ha
verses.translation: O son, hear with attention. I had a great desire to go to Kaii. That was not to be. Now I am dying here.

verses.sanskrit: अहो नित्यं जलं यच्च पीयते तज्जलं न हि । विचार्येति च तेनाशु परितश्चावलोकितम्
verses.transliteration: aho nityaM jalaM yachcha pIyate tajjalaM na hi | vichAryeti cha tenAshu paritashchAvalokitam
verses.translation: Dear son, my bones shall be cast off into the waters of the Gahga assiduously. That pious act will bless you, to be sure.

verses.sanskrit: सापि साध्वी त्ववश्यं च गृहीत्वाथ कमण्डलुम् । जगाम विपिने तत्र जलं मे नीयते कुतः
verses.transliteration: sApi sAdhvI tvavashyaM cha gR^ihItvAtha kamaNDalum | jagAma vipine tatra jalaM me nIyate kutaH
verses.translation: When she of good rites and on the verge of death, said thus, the affectionate elder son replied to her.

verses.sanskrit: शुष्कान्वृक्षान्समालोक्य दिशो रूक्षतरास्तथा । उवाच तामृषिश्रेष्ठो न जातं वर्षणं पुनः
verses.transliteration: shuShkAnvR^ikShAnsamAlokya disho rUkShatarAstathA | uvAcha tAmR^iShishreShTho na jAtaM varShaNaM punaH
verses.translation: "O mother, you shall die peacefully and with confidence. I shall carry out youi* task first and then attend to mine."

verses.sanskrit: तदुक्तं तत् समाकर्ण्य नेति नेति प्रियां तदा । तामुवाच पुनः सोऽपि जलं नीतं कुतस्त्वया
verses.transliteration: taduktaM tat samAkarNya neti neti priyAM tadA | tAmuvAcha punaH so.api jalaM nItaM kutastvayA
verses.translation: After saying this, he handed water to her and went to his house. Remembering Siva, she died in the meantime.
verses.hindi: मूढ नामक हैत्यको उसी समय भस्म कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते तु तदा तेन विस्मयं परमं गता । अनसूया स्वमनसि सचिन्ता तु मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: ityukte tu tadA tena vismayaM paramaM gatA | anasUyA svamanasi sachintA tu munIshvarAH
verses.translation: After performing her obsequies and the monthly Sraddha he started on his journey.
verses.hindi: तथा सर्वदा भक्तोंकी रक्षा करनेवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: निवेद्यते मया चेद्वै तदोत्कर्षो भवेन्मम । निवेद्यते यदा नैव व्रतभङ्गो भवेन्मम
verses.transliteration: nivedyate mayA chedvai tadotkarSho bhavenmama | nivedyate yadA naiva vratabha~Ngo bhavenmama
verses.translation: He engaged a servant to accompany him. He consoled his wife and sons. He performed Sraddha, Dana and other pious rites. He then set out from his houre after Mahgala Smarana accompanied by the servant.

verses.sanskrit: नोभयं च तथा स्याद्वै निवेद्यं तत्तथा मम । इति यावद्विचार्येत तावत्पृष्टा पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: nobhayaM cha tathA syAdvai nivedyaM tattathA mama | iti yAvadvichAryeta tAvatpR^iShTA punaH punaH
verses.translation: He walked about twelve kilometres that day and when the sun set, he halted at the house of a certain Brahmin in the auspicious village of ViihSatigrama.
verses.hindi: जोड़कर प्रसन्‍न चित्तसे उनकी स्तुति की

verses.sanskrit: अथानुग्रहतः शम्भोः प्राप्तबुद्धिः पतिव्रता । उवाच श्रूयतां स्वामिन्यज्जातं कथयामि ते
verses.transliteration: athAnugrahataH shambhoH prAptabuddhiH pativratA | uvAcha shrUyatAM svAminyajjAtaM kathayAmi te
verses.translation: He performed Sandhya and other rites duly. He recited the hymns of prayer to Siva of wonderful activities.

verses.sanskrit: अनसूयोवाच । शङ्करस्य प्रतापाच्च तवैव सुकृतैस्तथा । गङ्गा समागतात्रैव तदीयं सलिलं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: anasUyovAcha | sha~Nkarasya pratApAchcha tavaiva sukR^itaistathA | ga~NgA samAgatAtraiva tadIyaM salilaM tvidam
verses.translation: The brahmin stayed there accompanied by the servant. The night had passed by two muhurtas when something surprising happened. O sages, listen attentively.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रिरुवाच । प्रिये सुन्दरि त्वं सत्यमथ वाचं व्यलीककाम् । ब्रवीषि च यथार्थं त्वं न मन्ये दुर्लभं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: atriruvAcha | priye sundari tvaM satyamatha vAchaM vyalIkakAm | bravIShi cha yathArthaM tvaM na manye durlabhaM tvidam
verses.translation: O great sages, on seeing the cow, tethered in the courtyard, not yet milked, the distressed brahmin desirous of milking it told his wife.

verses.sanskrit: असाध्यं योगिभिर्यच्च देवैरपि सदा शुभे । तच्चैवाद्य कथं जातं विस्मयः परमो मम
verses.transliteration: asAdhyaM yogibhiryachcha devairapi sadA shubhe | tachchaivAdya kathaM jAtaM vismayaH paramo mama
verses.translation: In order to milk the cow he called his wife quickly and said *'0 beloved, the cow is not yet milked." Thus urged she brought the calf.

verses.sanskrit: किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि कुतो नीयेत वै जलम् । इति विस्मयमापन्ना तां गङ्गां हि ददर्श सा
verses.transliteration: kiM karomi kva gachChAmi kuto nIyeta vai jalam | iti vismayamApannA tAM ga~NgAM hi dadarsha sA
verses.translation: Not identified.

verses.sanskrit: यद्येवं दृश्यते चेद्वै तन्मन्येऽहं न चान्यथा । इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच पतिं प्रिया
verses.transliteration: yadyevaM dR^ishyate chedvai tanmanye.ahaM na chAnyathA | iti tadvachanaM shrutvA pratyuvAcha patiM priyA
verses.translation: O sages, the owner of the house, the brahmin, desirous of milk tried to tie up the calf to the peg.
verses.hindi: धोनेके लिये प्रत्येक वर्ष इस दिन यहाँ आती हैं

verses.sanskrit: अनसूयोवाच । आगम्यतां मया सार्धं त्वया नाथ महामुने । सरिद्वराया गङ्गाया द्रष्टुमिच्छा भवेद्यदि
verses.transliteration: anasUyovAcha | AgamyatAM mayA sArdhaM tvayA nAtha mahAmune | saridvarAyA ga~NgAyA draShTumichChA bhavedyadi
verses.translation: Dragged by the leg the calf kicked. O great one of good rites, the brahmin was put to pain.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्यादिभि: पापपर्मुच्यते हाखिलैरपि॥ ३५ छूट जाता है

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा तु समादाय पतिं तं सा पतिव्रता । गता द्रुतं शिवं स्मृत्वा यत्र गङ्गा सरिद्वरा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA tu samAdAya patiM taM sA pativratA | gatA drutaM shivaM smR^itvA yatra ga~NgA saridvarA
verses.translation: Infuriated by the kick of the calf, he hit the calf severely with the pieces of firewood.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे च॒तुर्थ्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां नन्दिकेश्वरशिवलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तमोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: दर्शयामास तां तत्र गङ्गां पत्ये पतिव्रता । गर्ते च संस्थितां तत्र स्वयं दिव्यस्वरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: darshayAmAsa tAM tatra ga~NgAM patye pativratA | garte cha saMsthitAM tatra svayaM divyasvarUpiNIm
verses.translation: Hit by him the calf became utterly exhausted. Due to anger neither the cow was milked nor the calf was untied by the brahmin.
verses.hindi: माहात्यवर्णन नामक सातवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा ऋषिश्रेष्ठो गर्तं च जलपूरितम् । आकण्ठं सुन्दरं दृष्ट्वा धन्येयमिति चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvA R^iShishreShTho gartaM cha jalapUritam | AkaNThaM sundaraM dR^iShTvA dhanyeyamiti chAbravIt
verses.translation: For the pleasure of getting milked, the cow mooed loudly. On hearing the mooing sound of the cow, the calf said.

verses.sanskrit: किं मदीयं तपश्चैव किमन्येषां पुनस्तदा । इत्युक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलो भक्त्या तुष्टाव तां तदा
verses.transliteration: kiM madIyaM tapashchaiva kimanyeShAM punastadA | ityuktvA munishArdUlo bhaktyA tuShTAva tAM tadA
verses.translation: *'0 mother, why do you cry? What is the misery that has befallen you? Please tell me lovingly.** On hear¬ ing this, the cow said.

verses.sanskrit: ततो हि स मुनिस्तत्र सुस्नातः सुभगे जले । आचम्य पुनरेवात्र स्तुतिं चक्रे पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tato hi sa munistatra susnAtaH subhage jale | Achamya punarevAtra stutiM chakre punaH punaH
verses.translation: *'0 son, listen to me. Although I am unable to express my grief adequately, you have been hit by the wicked man. Hence I am distressed.**

verses.sanskrit: अनसूयापि संस्नाता सुन्दरे तज्जले तदा । नित्यं चक्रे मुनिः कर्म सानसूयापि सुव्रता
verses.transliteration: anasUyApi saMsnAtA sundare tajjale tadA | nityaM chakre muniH karma sAnasUyApi suvratA
verses.translation: On hearing his mother's words, the calf taking his stand by the principle of previous action replied enlightening his mother.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सोवाच तां गङ्गा गम्यते स्वस्थलं मया । इत्युक्ते च पुनः साध्वी तामुवाच सरिद्वराम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sovAcha tAM ga~NgA gamyate svasthalaM mayA | ityukte cha punaH sAdhvI tAmuvAcha saridvarAm
verses.translation: "What should be done? Where should we go? Since the results are bound by previous actions, we experience joy or sorrow accordingly.
verses.hindi: क्‍ नामसे सदा निवास करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: अनसूयोवाच । यदि प्रसन्ना देवेशि यद्यस्ति च कृपा मयि । त्वया स्थेयं निश्चलत्वादस्मिन्देवि तपोवने
verses.transliteration: anasUyovAcha | yadi prasannA deveshi yadyasti cha kR^ipA mayi | tvayA stheyaM nishchalatvAdasmindevi tapovane
verses.translation: Activities are pursued with pleasure and fruits are derived sorrowfully. There is none who gives misery and none who gives happiness.

verses.sanskrit: तामनुव्रजती यावत् साब्रवीच्च तदा हि ताम् । गङ्गा सरिद्वरा देवी बिभ्रती सुन्दरां तनुम्
verses.transliteration: tAmanuvrajatI yAvat sAbravIchcha tadA hi tAm | ga~NgA saridvarA devI bibhratI sundarAM tanum
verses.translation: Misery or happiness results from our own actions. Hence action is prominent and everything is founded on action.

verses.sanskrit: महतां च स्वभावश्च नाङ्गीकृत्य परित्यजेत् । इत्युक्त्वा च करौ बद्ध्वा तां तुष्टाव पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: mahatAM cha svabhAvashcha nA~NgIkR^itya parityajet | ityuktvA cha karau baddhvA tAM tuShTAva punaH punaH
verses.translation: You the mother, I the child and all the Hiring beings are bound by action. They are not to be bewailed by you.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे च॒तुर्थ्या कोटिरुद्रसंहितायां महाबलयाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नामाष्टमोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिश्चापि तथोवाच त्वया स्थेयं सरिद्वरे । सानुकूला भव त्वं हि सनाथान्देवि नः कुरु
verses.transliteration: R^iShishchApi tathovAcha tvayA stheyaM saridvare | sAnukUlA bhava tvaM hi sanAthAndevi naH kuru
verses.translation: On hearing these words of her calf full of wisdom, the distressed cow sorrowing for her calf, said thus.

verses.sanskrit: तदीयं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा रम्यं गङ्गा सरिद्वरा । प्रसन्नमानसा गङ्गानसूयां वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tadIyaM tadvachaH shrutvA ramyaM ga~NgA saridvarA | prasannamAnasA ga~NgAnasUyAM vAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: '*0 dear son, I know fully well that all the people are subservient to their actions. Still, seized by Maya I feel much distressed.
verses.hindi: चाण्डाली कौन थी, उसकी कथा कहिये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच । शङ्करार्चनसम्भूतफलं वर्षस्य यच्छसि । स्वामिनश्च तदा स्थास्ये देवानामुपकारणात्
verses.transliteration: ga~NgovAcha | sha~NkarArchanasambhUtaphalaM varShasya yachChasi | svAminashcha tadA sthAsye devAnAmupakAraNAt
verses.translation: I have cried a lot but the sorrow has not sub¬ sided.** On hearing these words, the calf spoke to her again.

verses.sanskrit: तथा दानैर्न मे तुष्टिस्तीर्थस्नानैस्तथा च वै । यज्ञैस्तथाथवा योगैर्यथा पातिव्रतेन च
verses.transliteration: tathA dAnairna me tuShTistIrthasnAnaistathA cha vai | yaj~naistathAthavA yogairyathA pAtivratena cha
verses.translation: If you know thus, can anything be gained by crying? Hence leave off your sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रतां यथा दृष्ट्वा मनसः प्रीणनं भवेत् । तथा नान्यैरुपायैश्च सत्यं मे व्याहृतं सति
verses.transliteration: pativratAM yathA dR^iShTvA manasaH prINanaM bhavet | tathA nAnyairupAyaishcha satyaM me vyAhR^itaM sati
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her son, the distressed cow heaved a deep sigh and spoke to the calf.
verses.hindi: और कालयोगसे मृत्युको प्राप्त हो गया

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रतां स्त्रियं दृष्ट्वा पापनाशो भवेन्मम । शुद्धा जाता विशेषेण गौरीतुल्या पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: pativratAM striyaM dR^iShTvA pApanAsho bhavenmama | shuddhA jAtA visheSheNa gaurItulyA pativratA
verses.translation: My distress will disappear only when a similar misery befalls the brahmin. I am telling you the truth.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्च यदि लोकस्य हिताय तत्प्रयच्छसि । तर्ह्यहं स्थिरतां यास्ये यदि कल्याणमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: tasmAchcha yadi lokasya hitAya tatprayachChasi | tarhyahaM sthiratAM yAsye yadi kalyANamichChasi
verses.translation: Tomorrow morning I shall hit him by my horns. No doubt, when hit he will lose his life.
verses.hindi: शूद्रके सम्बन्धसे उसने एक कन्याको जन्म दिया

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वानसूया सा पतिव्रता । गङ्गायै प्रददौ पुण्यं सर्वं तद्वर्षसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM vachanaM shrutvAnasUyA sA pativratA | ga~NgAyai pradadau puNyaM sarvaM tadvarShasambhavam
verses.translation: The fruit of previous actions we experience now. What is the fruit you are goiug to reap as a result of this brahmin-slaughter?

verses.sanskrit: महतां च स्वभावो हि परेषां हितमावहेत् । सुवर्णं चन्दनं चेक्षुरसस्तत्र निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: mahatAM cha svabhAvo hi pareShAM hitamAvahet | suvarNaM chandanaM chekShurasastatra nidarshanam
verses.translation: When merits and demerits are on a par one takes birth in Bharata. O mother, when they are wiped off by enjoyment or suffering, liberation is achieved.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच । प्रसन्नास्मि च ते देवि कुत्र यासि वदाधुना । धन्या त्वं सुभगे सत्यं तवाज्ञां च करोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: ga~NgovAcha | prasannAsmi cha te devi kutra yAsi vadAdhunA | dhanyA tvaM subhage satyaM tavAj~nAM cha karomyaham
verses.translation: Whence am I your son? Whence are you my mother? This fond consciousness of sonhood and mother¬ hood is futile. Ponder.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् दृष्ट्वानसूयं तत्कर्म पातिव्रतं महत् । प्रसन्नोऽभून्महादेवः पार्थिवादाविराशु वै
verses.transliteration: etad dR^iShTvAnasUyaM tatkarma pAtivrataM mahat | prasanno.abhUnmahAdevaH pArthivAdAvirAshu vai
verses.translation: O mother, knowing thus you cast off your misery strenuously. If there is a desire for pleasure hereafter you shall do good deeds here.
verses.hindi: दुष्टासे किसीने विवाह भी नहीं किया

verses.sanskrit: शम्भुरुवाच । दृष्ट्वा ते कर्म साध्व्येतत् प्रसन्नोऽस्मि पतिव्रते । वरं ब्रूहि प्रिये मत्तो यतः प्रियतरासि मे
verses.transliteration: shambhuruvAcha | dR^iShTvA te karma sAdhvyetat prasanno.asmi pativrate | varaM brUhi priye matto yataH priyatarAsi me
verses.translation: O son, I know this but delusion does not forsake me. I am much distressed by your misery. I shall return tit for tat.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तौ दम्पती शम्भुमभूतां सुन्दराकृतिम् । पञ्चवक्त्रादिसंयुक्तं हरं प्रेक्ष्य सुविस्मितौ
verses.transliteration: atha tau dampatI shambhumabhUtAM sundarAkR^itim | pa~nchavaktrAdisaMyuktaM haraM prekShya suvismitau
verses.translation: I know the place that dispels the sin of brahmin- slaughter. Going there I can get rid of the sin of Brahmin- slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: नत्वा स्तुत्वा करौ बद्ध्वा महाभक्तिसमन्वितौ । अवोचेतां समभ्यर्च्य शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: natvA stutvA karau baddhvA mahAbhaktisamanvitau | avochetAM samabhyarchya sha~NkaraM lokasha~Nkaram
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on hearing these words of the mother cow, the calf observed silence. It did not say anything more.

verses.sanskrit: दम्पती ऊचतुः । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश प्रसन्ना जगदम्बिका । अस्मिंस्तपोवने तिष्ठ लोकानां सुखदो भव
verses.transliteration: dampatI UchatuH | yadi prasanno devesha prasannA jagadambikA | asmiMstapovane tiShTha lokAnAM sukhado bhava
verses.translation: O great sages, on hearing this wonderful dialogue between the two, the pilgrim brahmin was surprised and he thought within himself.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ना च तदा गङ्गा प्रसन्नश्च शिवस्तदा । उभौ तौ च स्थितौ तत्र यत्रासीदृषिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: prasannA cha tadA ga~NgA prasannashcha shivastadA | ubhau tau cha sthitau tatra yatrAsIdR^iShisattamaH
verses.translation: "I shall leave in the morning only after seeing the wonderful sequel. I shall go to that holy spot myself."

verses.sanskrit: अत्रीश्वरश्च नाम्नासीदीश्वरः परदुःखहा । गङ्गा सापि स्थिता तत्र तदा गर्तेऽथ मायया
verses.transliteration: atrIshvarashcha nAmnAsIdIshvaraH paraduHkhahA | ga~NgA sApi sthitA tatra tadA garte.atha mAyayA
verses.translation: O brahmins, after thinking thus the pilgrim- brahmin, devoted to his mother, became surprised. He and his servant went to sleep.
verses.hindi: जति क्रीशिवमहाएुराणे च॒तुर्थ्या कोटिर्रसंहितायां चाण्डालीसद्वतिवर्णं नाम नवगो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तद्दिनं हि समारभ्य तत्राक्षय्यजलं सदा । हस्तमात्रे हि तद्गर्ते गङ्गा मन्दाकिनी ह्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: taddinaM hi samArabhya tatrAkShayyajalaM sadA | hastamAtre hi tadgarte ga~NgA mandAkinI hyabhUt
verses.translation: When the day dawned, the owner of the house got up. Awakening the traveller he spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव ऋषयो दिव्याः समाजग्मुः सहाङ्गनाः । तीर्थात्तीर्थाच्च ते सर्वे ये पुरा निर्गता द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tatraiva R^iShayo divyAH samAjagmuH sahA~NganAH | tIrthAttIrthAchcha te sarve ye purA nirgatA dvijAH
verses.translation: "Why do you sleep? It is already day-break. Go on your journey to the place where you desire to go."

verses.sanskrit: यवाश्च व्रीहयश्चैव यज्ञयागपरायणाः । युक्ता ऋषिवरैस्तैश्च होमं चक्रुश्च ते जनाः
verses.transliteration: yavAshcha vrIhayashchaiva yaj~nayAgaparAyaNAH | yuktA R^iShivaraistaishcha homaM chakrushcha te janAH
verses.translation: He replied—"Please listen, O brahmin, there is an acute pain in the stomach of my servant. We will stay a little longer and go thereafter."
verses.hindi: बार विशाल सेनाको साथ लेकर घने वनमें गया

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तद्वचश्च तदा श्रुत्वा ऋषिपत्नी तपस्विनी । प्रत्युवाच वचः प्रीत्या स्वयं सुचकिता द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tadvachashcha tadA shrutvA R^iShipatnI tapasvinI | pratyuvAcha vachaH prItyA svayaM suchakitA dvijAH
verses.translation: Creating such a pretext the man continued to sleep, desiring to know the details of the wonderful incident that had surprised him much.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मभिस्तैश्च सन्तुष्टा वृष्टिं चक्रुर्घनास्तदा । आनन्दः परमो लोके बभूवाति मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: karmabhistaishcha santuShTA vR^iShTiM chakrurghanAstadA | AnandaH paramo loke babhUvAti munIshvarAH
verses.translation: At the time of milking, the brahmin who wanted to go somewhere on some business spoke to his son.
verses.hindi: समझे ही उसे रसोईका अध्यक्ष बना दिया

verses.sanskrit: अत्रीश्वरस्य माहात्म्यमित्युक्तं वः सुखावहम् । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सर्वकामदं भक्तिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: atrIshvarasya mAhAtmyamityuktaM vaH sukhAvaham | bhuktimuktipradaM sarvakAmadaM bhaktivardhanam
verses.translation: O son, I am going out on some business. Dear, you shall carefully milk our cow.
verses.hindi: छोड़कर आनन्दपूर्वक अपने नगरको लौट आया

verses.sanskrit: अनसूयोवाच । का त्वं कमलपत्राक्षि कुतो वा त्वं समागता । तथ्यं ब्रूहि कृपां कृत्वा साध्वी सुप्रवदा सती
verses.transliteration: anasUyovAcha | kA tvaM kamalapatrAkShi kuto vA tvaM samAgatA | tathyaM brUhi kR^ipAM kR^itvA sAdhvI supravadA satI
verses.translation: The cow approached him herself for being milked. The brahmin's son, eager for milk, took the dis¬ tressed calf hit by his father near the cow in order to tie it up. The infuriated cow hit him with her horn.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं वचस्तदा श्रुत्वा मुनिर्विस्मयमानसः । प्रियामुवाच सुप्रीत्या शङ्करं मनसा स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM vachastadA shrutvA munirvismayamAnasaH | priyAmuvAcha suprItyA sha~NkaraM manasA smaran
verses.translation: The cow approached him herself for being milked. The brahmin's son, eager for milk, took the dis¬ tressed calf hit by his father near the cow in order to tie it up. The infuriated cow hit him with her horn.
verses.hindi: परोसा; तब गुरु इसे देखकर कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्ते च तया तत्र मुनिपत्न्या मुनीश्वराः । सरिद्वरा दिव्यरूपा गङ्गा वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityukte cha tayA tatra munipatnyA munIshvarAH | saridvarA divyarUpA ga~NgA vAkyamathAbravIt
verses.translation: The boy, hit in a vulnerable pointy fell uncon¬ scious. People gathered there, saying—>"0, the boy is struck by the cow. Fetch water? fetch water?" By the time they attempted to do something, the boy died.
verses.hindi: शापकी अवधि बारह वर्षपर्यन्त कर दी

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच । स्वामिनः सेवनं दृष्ट्वा शिवस्य च परात्मनः । साध्वि धर्मं च ते दृष्ट्वा स्थितास्मि तव सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: ga~NgovAcha | svAminaH sevanaM dR^iShTvA shivasya cha parAtmanaH | sAdhvi dharmaM cha te dR^iShTvA sthitAsmi tava sannidhau
verses.translation: *'What shall I do? Where shall I go? Who can remove my grief?** After lamenting thus she struck the cow and let it off.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: On seeing this surprising event the brahmin travel¬ ler set out and followed the cow as it ran away.
verses.hindi: गिरा दिया, जिससे उसके चरण काले पड़ गये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: On seeing this surprising event the brahmin travel¬ ler set out and followed the cow as it ran away.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.५. पञ्चमोऽध्यायः । ब्राह्मणीमरणवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । कालञ्जरे गिरौ दिव्ये नीलकण्ठो महेश्वरः । लिङ्गरूपः सदा चैव भक्तानन्दप्रदः सदा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.5\. pa~nchamo.adhyAyaH | brAhmaNImaraNavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | kAla~njare girau divye nIlakaNTho maheshvaraH | li~NgarUpaH sadA chaiva bhaktAnandapradaH sadA
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the brahmin narrated everything truthfully. The brahmin was again addressed by the women, ''Stay here'*.

verses.sanskrit: नीलकण्ठो मङ्गलेशो मङ्गलायतनो महान् । महाकपीश्वरो देवः स्थापितो हि हनूमता
verses.transliteration: nIlakaNTho ma~Ngalesho ma~NgalAyatano mahAn | mahAkapIshvaro devaH sthApito hi hanUmatA
verses.translation: After the holy dip they started on their journey praising the river. On the way they met a beautiful maiden fully bedecked in ornaments
verses.hindi: वचन बोलती हुई उससे प्रार्थना करने लगी

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीकेशं च यश्चैव पूजयेत्परया मुदा । नित्यं तस्याखिला सिद्धिर्भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: nandIkeshaM cha yashchaiva pUjayetparayA mudA | nityaM tasyAkhilA siddhirbhaviShyati na saMshayaH
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the brahmin narrated everything truthfully. The brahmin was again addressed by the women, ''Stay here'*.
verses.hindi: राक्षस ब्राह्मणपुत्रका सिर नोचकर खा गया

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च नन्दिको देवो हत्याकोटिनिवारकः । सर्वकामार्थदश्चैव मोक्षदो हि प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: tatashcha nandiko devo hatyAkoTinivArakaH | sarvakAmArthadashchaiva mokShado hi prakIrtitaH
verses.translation: On hearing her words, the brahmin stopped and replied humbly—"Speak out what you desire to say.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीरे च यः स्नाति रेवायां मुनिसत्तमाः । तस्य कामाश्च सिध्यन्ति सर्वं पापं विनश्यति
verses.transliteration: tatra tIre cha yaH snAti revAyAM munisattamAH | tasya kAmAshcha sidhyanti sarvaM pApaM vinashyati
verses.translation: She said again "In the holy spot that you have just seen, cast oif the bones of your mother. Why shall you go elsewhere?
verses.hindi: प्रसन्‍नन होकर अपने घर चला गया

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । एवं तस्य च माहात्म्यं कथं तत्र महामते । नन्दिकेशस्य कृपया कथ्यतां च त्वयाधुना
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | evaM tasya cha mAhAtmyaM kathaM tatra mahAmate | nandikeshasya kR^ipayA kathyatAM cha tvayAdhunA
verses.translation: O excellent traveller, your mother will assume a divine form and will immediately attain the good goal of Siva.
verses.hindi: होकर सम्पूर्ण राज्यको छोड़कर वनमें ही चला गया

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । सम्यक् पृष्टं भवद्भिश्च कथयामि यथाश्रुतम् । शौनकाद्याश्च मुनयः सर्वे हि शृणुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | samyak pR^iShTaM bhavadbhishcha kathayAmi yathAshrutam | shaunakAdyAshcha munayaH sarve hi shR^iNutAdarAt
verses.translation: O excellent brahmin, in the month of Vaiakha on the auspicious seventh day in the bright half, Gahga comes here always.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा युधिष्ठिरेणैवं पृष्टश्च ऋषिसत्तमः । यथोवाच तथा वच्मि भवत्स्नेहानुसारतः
verses.transliteration: purA yudhiShThireNaivaM pR^iShTashcha R^iShisattamaH | yathovAcha tathA vachmi bhavatsnehAnusArataH
verses.translation: The brahmin returned. As soon as he cast off half the bones of his mother from his bundle into the holy river, a wanderful incident happened.
verses.hindi: धमकी देती हुई मुझे बहुत दुःख दे रही है

verses.sanskrit: रेवायाः पश्चिमे तीरे कर्णिकी नाम वै पुरी । विराजते सुशोभाढ्या चतुर्वर्णसमाकुला
verses.transliteration: revAyAH pashchime tIre karNikI nAma vai purI | virAjate sushobhADhyA chaturvarNasamAkulA
verses.translation: He saw his mother endowed with a divine form. She said—"You are blessed. You have fulfilled your duty. The family has been sanctified by you. May your wealth, food-grains, longevity and line flourish." Blessing her son frequently, she went to heaven.
verses.hindi: करनेपर भी नहीं हो पा रही है

verses.sanskrit: तत्र द्विजवरः कश्चिदुतथ्यकुलसम्भवः । काश्यां गतश्च पुत्राभ्यामर्पयित्वा स्वपत्निकाम्
verses.transliteration: tatra dvijavaraH kashchidutathyakulasambhavaH | kAshyAM gatashcha putrAbhyAmarpayitvA svapatnikAm
verses.translation: After enjoying excellent happiness there for a long time, she attained the excellent goal, thanks to the grace of iSiva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव स मृतो विप्रः पुत्राभ्यां च श्रुतं तदा । तदीयं चैव तत्कृत्यं चक्राते पुत्रकावुभौ
verses.transliteration: tatraiva sa mR^ito vipraH putrAbhyAM cha shrutaM tadA | tadIyaM chaiva tatkR^ityaM chakrAte putrakAvubhau
verses.translation: Her son, tne brahmin, cast off the remaining bones too. He was much delighted in his mind. With con¬ tented soul he returned to his abode.

verses.sanskrit: महिमा तस्य दिव्योऽस्ति श्रुतिस्मृतिप्रकीर्तितः । तीर्थं तदाख्यया तत्र स्नानात्पातकनाशकृत्
verses.transliteration: mahimA tasya divyo.asti shrutismR^itiprakIrtitaH | tIrthaM tadAkhyayA tatra snAnAtpAtakanAshakR^it
verses.translation: O holy lord, Suta, narrate in detail how Gahga came to Narmada on the seventh day in Vaiakha.
verses.hindi: जिससे मैं सुख प्राप्त कर सकूँ

verses.sanskrit: पत्नी च पालयामास पुत्रौ पुत्रहितैषिणी । किञ्चिच्च वर्जयित्वा च विभक्तं वै धनं तया
verses.transliteration: patnI cha pAlayAmAsa putrau putrahitaiShiNI | ki~nchichcha varjayitvA cha vibhaktaM vai dhanaM tayA
verses.translation: How did the lord come to be known by the name Nandikea? O intelligent one, narrate that too with pleasure.
verses.hindi: और सभी प्रकारके पापोंको विनष्ट करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: स्वीयं च रक्षितं किञ्चिद्धनं मरणहेतवे । ततश्च द्विजपत्नी हि कियत्काले गते च सा
verses.transliteration: svIyaM cha rakShitaM ki~nchiddhanaM maraNahetave | tatashcha dvijapatnI hi kiyatkAle gate cha sA
verses.translation: O excellent sages, you have put a very good question concerning Nandikea. 1 shall narrate it as it enhances merit.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिन्म्रियमाणा सा विविधं पुण्यमाचरत् । न मृता दैवयोगेन द्विजपत्नी च सा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: kadAchinmriyamANA sA vividhaM puNyamAcharat | na mR^itA daivayogena dvijapatnI cha sA dvijAH
verses.translation: A brahmin lady Rsika, the daughter of a certain brahmin, was duly married to a certain brahmin youth.

verses.sanskrit: यदा प्राणान्न मुमुचे माता दैवात्तयोश्च सा । तद् द्रुष्टवा जननीकष्टं पुत्रकावूचतुस्तदा
verses.transliteration: yadA prANAnna mumuche mAtA daivAttayoshcha sA | tad druShTavA jananIkaShTaM putrakAvUchatustadA
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, although she observed holy rites, the brahmin lady became a widow at an early age as a result of previous actions.
verses.hindi: निर्धूताशेषपापौधोउलभच्छंभो: पर॑ पदम्॥ ४९ शिवके परम पदको प्राप्त किया

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रावूचतुः । किं न्यूनं विद्यते मातः कष्टं यद्विद्यते महत् । व्रियतां तद् द्रुतं प्रीत्या तदावां करवावहे
verses.transliteration: putrAvUchatuH | kiM nyUnaM vidyate mAtaH kaShTaM yadvidyate mahat | vriyatAM tad drutaM prItyA tadAvAM karavAvahe
verses.translation: Then the brahmin widow, observing the rite of celibacy performed a severe penance by worshipping Siva's earthen phallic image.
verses.hindi: महाबलस्य गिरिशलिंगस्य निखिलाघहतू॥ ५१ अदुत माहात्म्यका वर्णन किया

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्ते च तया मात्रा स ज्येष्ठतनयोऽब्रवीत् । मातरं मातृभक्त्तस्तु सुव्रतां मरणोन्मुखीम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityukte cha tayA mAtrA sa jyeShThatanayo.abravIt | mAtaraM mAtR^ibhakttastu suvratAM maraNonmukhIm
verses.translation: In the meantime, a wicked and very powerful Asura named Muha came there. He, the wielder of great Maya, was struck by the arrows of the cupid.

verses.sanskrit: रेवातीरे यानि सन्ति शिवलिङ्गानि सुव्रताः । सर्वसौख्यकराणीह तेषां सङ्ख्या न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: revAtIre yAni santi shivali~NgAni suvratAH | sarvasaukhyakarANIha teShAM sa~NkhyA na vidyate
verses.translation: She did not honour him. Engaged in penance she remained meditating upon Siva and strictly continued her penance.
verses.hindi: वर्णन कर रहा हूँ; आपलोग आदरपूर्वक सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच । मातस्त्वया सुखेनैव प्राणास्त्याज्या न संशयः । तव कार्यं पुरा कृत्वा पश्चात्कार्यं मदीयकम्
verses.transliteration: putra uvAcha | mAtastvayA sukhenaiva prANAstyAjyA na saMshayaH | tava kAryaM purA kR^itvA pashchAtkAryaM madIyakam
verses.translation: O great sages, the lady obeserving holy rites and engrossed in 8iva's meditation did not cast a loving glance at him,
verses.hindi: वहाँपर एक पवित्र तथा अति विस्तृत महावन है

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्चैव तु यत्कृत्यं तत्सर्वं संविधाय सः । मासिकं कर्म कृत्वा तु गमनाय प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: tasyAshchaiva tu yatkR^ityaM tatsarvaM saMvidhAya saH | mAsikaM karma kR^itvA tu gamanAya prachakrame
verses.translation: She did not honour him. Engaged in penance she remained meditating upon Siva and strictly continued her penance.

verses.sanskrit: इति हस्ते जलं दत्त्वा यावत्पुत्रो गृहं गतः । तावत्सा च मृता तत्र हरस्मरणतत्परा
verses.transliteration: iti haste jalaM dattvA yAvatputro gR^ihaM gataH | tAvatsA cha mR^itA tatra harasmaraNatatparA
verses.translation: That leading Daitya, Muha, when slighted by that lady, became angry and showed his hideous form.
verses.hindi: पूर्वक पूजन अवश्य ही करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: द्वयोः श्रेष्ठतरो यो वै सुवादो नाम विश्रुतः । तदस्थीनि समादाय निःसृतस्तीर्थकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: dvayoH shreShThataro yo vai suvAdo nAma vishrutaH | tadasthIni samAdAya niHsR^itastIrthakAmyayA
verses.translation: The wicked-minded demon spoke harsh words ter¬ rifying her. He threatened the brahmin lady in many ways.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गृह्य सेवकं कञ्चित्तेनैव सहितस्तदा । आश्वास्य भार्यां पुत्राँश्च मातुः प्रियचिकीर्षया
verses.transliteration: sa~NgR^ihya sevakaM ka~nchittenaiva sahitastadA | AshvAsya bhAryAM putrA.Nshcha mAtuH priyachikIrShayA
verses.translation: Then the frightened brahmin lady, lovingly resort¬ ing to liva, repeated the name 8iva many times.
verses.hindi: तथा परलोकमें मोक्ष प्राप्त होता है

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धदानादिकं भोज्यं कृत्वा विधिमनुत्तमम् । मङ्गलस्मरणं कृत्वा निर्जगाम गृहाद् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: shrAddhadAnAdikaM bhojyaM kR^itvA vidhimanuttamam | ma~NgalasmaraNaM kR^itvA nirjagAma gR^ihAd dvijaH
verses.translation: The agitated lady repeated the names of 8iva, sought refuge in him for the protection of her sacred virtue.
verses.hindi: उसकी विशेष रूपसे पूजा करनी चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: तद्दिने योजनं गत्वा विंशति ग्रामके शुभे । उवासास्तं गते भानौ गृहे विप्रस्य कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: taddine yojanaM gatvA viMshati grAmake shubhe | uvAsAstaM gate bhAnau gR^ihe viprasya kasyachit
verses.translation: To protect one who sought refuge in him and to uphold good conduct, Siva manifested himself, as well as to delight her.
verses.hindi: प्रकारके पाप दूर हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: चक्रे सन्ध्यादि सत्कर्म स द्विजो विधिपूर्वकम् । स्तवादि कृतवांस्तत्र शम्भोरद्भुतकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: chakre sandhyAdi satkarma sa dvijo vidhipUrvakam | stavAdi kR^itavAMstatra shambhoradbhutakarmaNaH
verses.translation: Siva, favourably disposed towards his devotees, immediately reduced to ashes that lusty leading demon named Muha.

verses.sanskrit: सेवकेन तदा युक्तो ब्राह्मणः संस्थितस्तदा । यामिनी च गता तत्र मुहूर्तद्वयसम्मिता
verses.transliteration: sevakena tadA yukto brAhmaNaH saMsthitastadA | yAminI cha gatA tatra muhUrtadvayasammitA
verses.translation: Looking at her with a compassionate look, lord Siva efficient in and mindful of protecting the devotees told her, "Mention the boon you wish to have**.
verses.hindi: अब आपलोग और क्‍या सुनना चाहते हैं 2

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्रैकमाश्चर्यमभूत्तदा । शृणुतादरतस्तच्च मुनयो वो वदाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatraikamAshcharyamabhUttadA | shR^iNutAdaratastachcha munayo vo vadAmyaham
verses.translation: On hearing the words of lord Siva that chaste lady the wife of the brahmin, saw the auspicious and delight¬ ful form of Siva.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीजिवमहाएुरापे चुर्थ्या कोटिरखसंहितायां चत्रभालपट्टुपतिनाथलिंगमाहात्य्यवर्षन॑ नामैकादशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: सा च रुद्रस्वरूपा हि दर्शनात्पापहारिका । तस्यां स्थिताश्च ये केचित्पाषाणाः शिवरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: sA cha rudrasvarUpA hi darshanAtpApahArikA | tasyAM sthitAshcha ye kechitpAShANAH shivarUpiNaH
verses.translation: Then bowing to Siva the beautiful supreme lord, the chaste lady of pure mind eulogised him with palms joined together and shoulders drooping down.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक ग्यारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तथापि च प्रवक्ष्यामि यथान्यानि मुनीश्वराः । प्रधानशिवलिङ्गानि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानि च
verses.transliteration: tathApi cha pravakShyAmi yathAnyAni munIshvarAH | pradhAnashivali~NgAni bhuktimuktipradAni cha
verses.translation: My virtue has been saved by you from the Asura Mudha. By killing that wicked person the whole universe has been saved by you.
verses.hindi: है, इसीलिये हमलोग आपसे पूछते हैं

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वोक्तं तया तत्र न्यूनं मे विद्यते बहु । तदेव क्रियते चेद्वै सुखेन मरणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tachChrutvoktaM tayA tatra nyUnaM me vidyate bahu | tadeva kriyate chedvai sukhena maraNaM bhavet
verses.translation: My virtue has been saved by you from the Asura Mudha. By killing that wicked person the whole universe has been saved by you.
verses.hindi: ही पूजित है अथवा अन्य कोई कारण है 2

verses.sanskrit: आर्तेश्वरसुनामा हि वर्तते पापहारकः । परमेश्वर इति ख्यातः सिंहेश्वर इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ArteshvarasunAmA hi vartate pApahArakaH | parameshvara iti khyAtaH siMheshvara iti smR^itaH
verses.translation: O great lord, please listen to another request of mine. Please stay here permanently for the benefit of the |>eople.
verses.hindi: सूत उवाच आपने जैसा सुना है, वैसा कहिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठपुत्रश्च यस्तस्यास्तेनोक्तं कथ्यतां त्वया । करिष्यामि तदेतद्धि तया च कथितं तदा
verses.transliteration: jyeShThaputrashcha yastasyAstenoktaM kathyatAM tvayA | kariShyAmi tadetaddhi tayA cha kathitaM tadA
verses.translation: O great lord, please listen to another request of mine. Please stay here permanently for the benefit of the |>eople.
verses.hindi: आज वर्णन कर रहा हूँ, आपलोग सुनें

verses.sanskrit: शर्मेशश्च तथा चात्र कुमारेश्वर एव च । पुण्डरीकेश्वरः ख्यातो मण्डपेश्वर एव च
verses.transliteration: sharmeshashcha tathA chAtra kumAreshvara eva cha | puNDarIkeshvaraH khyAto maNDapeshvara eva cha
verses.translation: O fikk, you are well-behaved. You are a special devotee of mine. Whatever boons you have asked for have been granted to you.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजपत्न्युवाच । शृणु पुत्र वचः प्रीत्या पुरासीन्मे मनःस्पृहा । काश्यां गन्तुं तथा नासीदिदानीं म्रियते पुनः
verses.transliteration: dvijapatnyuvAcha | shR^iNu putra vachaH prItyA purAsInme manaHspR^ihA | kAshyAM gantuM tathA nAsIdidAnIM mriyate punaH
verses.translation: O fikk, you are well-behaved. You are a special devotee of mine. Whatever boons you have asked for have been granted to you.

verses.sanskrit: तीक्ष्णेशनामा तत्रासीद्दर्शनात्पापहारकः । धुन्धुरेश्वरनामासीत्पापहा नर्मदातटे
verses.transliteration: tIkShNeshanAmA tatrAsIddarshanAtpApahArakaH | dhundhureshvaranAmAsItpApahA narmadAtaTe
verses.translation: O brahmins, bowing down with great pleasure to Siva they all worshipped him. Joining their palms and bend¬ ing down they eulogised him attentively.

verses.sanskrit: ममास्थीनि त्वया पुत्र क्षेपणीयान्यतन्द्रितम् । गङ्गाजले शुभं तेऽद्य भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: mamAsthIni tvayA putra kShepaNIyAnyatandritam | ga~NgAjale shubhaM te.adya bhaviShyati na saMshayaH
verses.translation: O brahmins, bowing down with great pleasure to Siva they all worshipped him. Joining their palms and bend¬ ing down they eulogised him attentively.
verses.hindi: वह चिन्मय लिंग शीघ्र ही पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़ा

verses.sanskrit: शूलेश्वर इति ख्यातस्तथा कुम्भेश्वरः स्मृतः । कुबेरेश्वरनामापि तथा सोमेश्वरः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: shUleshvara iti khyAtastathA kumbheshvaraH smR^itaH | kubereshvaranAmApi tathA someshvaraH smR^itaH
verses.translation: In the meantime, Gahga the celestial river, with delighted mind, praised her rites and spoke to that chaste lady lka.
verses.hindi: और कहीं भी स्थिर न रहा

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Gahga, the chaste lady of good rices consented with pleasure for the benefit of the world.
verses.hindi: किसीको भी अपना कल्याण दिखायी न पड़ा

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Gahga, the chaste lady of good rices consented with pleasure for the benefit of the world.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । ब्राह्मणीस्वर्गतिवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । गौश्चैकाप्यभवत्तत्र ह्यङ्गणे बन्धिता शुभा । तदैव ब्राह्मणो रात्रावाजगाम बहिर्गतः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.6\. ShaShTho.adhyAyaH | brAhmaNIsvargativarNanam | sUta uvAcha | gaushchaikApyabhavattatra hya~NgaNe bandhitA shubhA | tadaiva brAhmaNo rAtrAvAjagAma bahirgataH
verses.translation: For her bliss, the delighted Siva, vanished into that earthen phallic image along with her.
verses.hindi: लोग ऐसा करें, तो फिर क्या कहा जाय !

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयतां पुत्र मे दुःखं वक्तुं शक्नोम्यहं न हि । दुष्टेन ताडितस्त्वं च तेन दुःखं ममाप्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: shrUyatAM putra me duHkhaM vaktuM shaknomyahaM na hi | duShTena tADitastvaM cha tena duHkhaM mamApyabhUt
verses.translation: Praising Siva and the brahmin lady, the delighted Brahma, Vinu and other gods and the celestial river Gahga returned to their abodes.
verses.hindi: शिवजीके विषयमें तो कहना ही क्या!

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । स्वमातुर्वचनं श्रुत्वा स वत्सः प्रत्यबोधयत् । प्रत्युवाच स्वजननीं प्रारब्धपरिनिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | svamAturvachanaM shrutvA sa vatsaH pratyabodhayat | pratyuvAcha svajananIM prArabdhapariniShThitaH
verses.translation: From that day onwards this became a holy and excellent centre. Siva became famous as Nandikeia, the destroyer of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: किं कर्त्तव्यं क्व गन्तव्यं कर्मबद्धा वयं यतः । कृतं चैव यथा पूर्वं भुज्यते च तथाधुना
verses.transliteration: kiM karttavyaM kva gantavyaM karmabaddhA vayaM yataH | kR^itaM chaiva yathA pUrvaM bhujyate cha tathAdhunA
verses.translation: O brahmin, in order to wipe off her sins which she takes from others, Gahga comes here on that day every year out of her own good will.

verses.sanskrit: हसता क्रियते कर्म रुदता परिभुज्यते । दुःखदाता न कोऽप्यस्ति सुखदाता न कश्चन
verses.transliteration: hasatA kriyate karma rudatA paribhujyate | duHkhadAtA na ko.apyasti sukhadAtA na kashchana
verses.translation: The man who takes bath there and worships NandikeiSa with devotion becomes freed from all sins such as the slaughter of a Brahmin etc.
verses.hindi: सम्पादन कीजिये; वे  अवश्य प्रसन्‍न होंगी

verses.sanskrit: सुखदुःखे परो दत्त इत्येषा कुमतिर्मता । अहं चापि करोम्यत्र मिथ्याज्ञानं तदोच्यते
verses.transliteration: sukhaduHkhe paro datta ityeShA kumatirmatA | ahaM chApi karomyatra mithyAj~nAnaM tadochyate
verses.translation: O brahmins, listen with devotion to the phallic forms of 3iva that exist in the western quarter on this earth.
verses.hindi: तया धृत॑ च मल्लिगं द्वुतं शान्तिं गमिष्यति॥ ४६  प्रशान्त हो जायगा

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मणा भवेद्दुःखं सुखं तेनैव कर्मणा । तस्माच्च पूज्यते कर्म सर्वं कर्मणि संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: svakarmaNA bhavedduHkhaM sukhaM tenaiva karmaNA | tasmAchcha pUjyate karma sarvaM karmaNi saMsthitam
verses.translation: In the city of Kapilas* are the two divine phallic images of liva named Kala and Ramesvara. By their very sight they dispel sins.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं चैवाहं च जननी इमे जीवादयश्च ये । ते सर्वे कर्मणा बद्धा न शोच्याः कर्हिचित्त्वया
verses.transliteration: tvaM chaivAhaM cha jananI ime jIvAdayashcha ye | te sarve karmaNA baddhA na shochyAH karhichittvayA
verses.translation: Gokarna'*® the excellent shrine, situated on the shore of the western ocean, destroys the sin of brahmin's slaughter and other sins and yields the fruits of ail desires.
verses.hindi: परत्र परमा मुक्तिनात्र कार्या विचारणा॥ ५४  है; इसमें कोई विचार नहीं करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं श्रुत्वा स्वपुत्रस्य वचनं ज्ञानगर्भितम् । पुत्रशोकान्विता दीना सा च गौरब्रवीदिदम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM shrutvA svaputrasya vachanaM j~nAnagarbhitam | putrashokAnvitA dInA sA cha gaurabravIdidam
verses.translation: At Gokarna there are crores and crores of l§iva*s phallic images. At every step there are innumerable holy centres.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे च॒दुर्ध्या कोटिर्द्रसंहितायां लिंगस्वरूपकारणवर्णन॑ नाम द्वादशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: गौरुवाच । वत्स सर्वं विजानासि कर्माधीनाः प्रजा इति । तथापि मायया ग्रस्ता दुःखं प्राप्नोम्यहं पुनः
verses.transliteration: gauruvAcha | vatsa sarvaM vijAnAsi karmAdhInAH prajA iti | tathApi mAyayA grastA duHkhaM prApnomyahaM punaH
verses.translation: O dear, the greatness of liva's holy images and the Tirthas at Gokarna is explained and described in the Puranas by great sages.

verses.sanskrit: रोदनं च कृतं भूरि दुःखशान्तिर्भवेन्न हि । इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रसूं वत्सोऽब्रवीदिदम्
verses.transliteration: rodanaM cha kR^itaM bhUri duHkhashAntirbhavenna hi | ityetadvachanaM shrutvA prasUM vatso.abravIdidam
verses.translation: Mahabala, though it has pervaded the regions as far below as the seven nether worlds, will become soft when the terrible age of Kali arrives.

verses.sanskrit: स उवाच प्रियां स्वीयां दृष्ट्वा गामङ्गणे स्थिताम् । अदुग्धां खेदनिर्विण्णो दोग्धुकामो मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sa uvAcha priyAM svIyAM dR^iShTvA gAma~NgaNe sthitAm | adugdhAM khedanirviNNo dogdhukAmo munIshvarAH
verses.translation: Persons committing great sins have attained diva's region after worshipping Mahabala, the phallic image of iSiva at Gokarna.
verses.hindi: अन्य शिवलिंगोंकी महिमा भी प्रीतिपूर्वक कहिये

verses.sanskrit: वत्स उवाच । यद्येवं च विजानासि पुनश्च रुदनं कुतः । कृत्वा च साध्यते किञ्चित्तस्माद्दुःखं त्यजाधुना
verses.transliteration: vatsa uvAcha | yadyevaM cha vijAnAsi punashcha rudanaM kutaH | kR^itvA cha sAdhyate ki~nchittasmAdduHkhaM tyajAdhunA
verses.translation: The present text locates the town Kapilfi, famous for the shrines of KAleivara and R&meivara, in the west of Bharata.
verses.hindi: नामक हैत्यने त्रैलोक्यको अपने वशमें कर लिया था

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं पुत्रवचः श्रुत्वा तन्माता दुःखसंयुता । निःश्वस्याति तदा धेनुर्वत्सं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM putravachaH shrutvA tanmAtA duHkhasaMyutA | niHshvasyAti tadA dhenurvatsaM vachanamabravIt
verses.translation: O sages, those who worship the lord with devotion
verses.hindi: हुए उनसे अपना सारा दुःख निवेदन किया

verses.sanskrit: गौरुवाच । मम दुःखं तदा गच्छेद्यदा दुःखं तथाविधम् । भवेद्धि ब्राह्मणस्यापि सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: gauruvAcha | mama duHkhaM tadA gachChedyadA duHkhaM tathAvidham | bhaveddhi brAhmaNasyApi satyametadbravImyaham
verses.translation: A devotee worshipping Siva's image at any time in Gokarna attains the region of Brahma.
verses.hindi: शरणदाता परमेश्वर प्रसन्‍न होकर कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: प्रातश्चैव मया पुत्र शृङ्गाभ्यां हि हनिष्यते । हतस्य जीवितं सद्यो यास्यत्यस्य न संशयः
verses.transliteration: prAtashchaiva mayA putra shR^i~NgAbhyAM hi haniShyate | hatasya jIvitaM sadyo yAsyatyasya na saMshayaH
verses.translation: With a desire for the welfare of Brahma, Visnu and other gods, the lord is always present there in the name of Mahabala.
verses.hindi: लोग उस गर्तमें प्रवेश कर गये

verses.sanskrit: वत्स उवाच । प्रथमं यत्कृतं कर्म तत्फलं भुज्यतेऽधुना । अस्याश्च ब्रह्महत्याया मातः किं फलमाप्स्यसे
verses.transliteration: vatsa uvAcha | prathamaM yatkR^itaM karma tatphalaM bhujyate.adhunA | asyAshcha brahmahatyAyA mAtaH kiM phalamApsyase
verses.translation: That phallic image secured by the Rakasa Ravana as a result of severe penance was installed by Gananayaka at Gokarna.

verses.sanskrit: समाभ्यां पुण्यपापाभ्यां भवेज्जन्म च भारते । तयोः क्षये च भोगेन मातर्मुक्तिरवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: samAbhyAM puNyapApAbhyAM bhavejjanma cha bhArate | tayoH kShaye cha bhogena mAtarmuktiravApyate
verses.translation: The following deities resort to its eastern gate out of devotion for it—Visnu, Brahma, Mahendra, ViSve- devas, Marudganas, Adityas, Vasus, Dasras, the moon with the stars and the gods with their attendants. They go there in their aerial chariots.
verses.hindi: कृपां कृत्वा विशेषेण संस्थितो भव चेह वै॥ १४  विशेष कृपा करके यहींपर निवास कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: कदापि कर्मणो नाशः कदा भोगः प्रजायते । तस्माच्च पुनरेवं त्वं कर्म मा कर्तुमुद्यता
verses.transliteration: kadApi karmaNo nAshaH kadA bhogaH prajAyate | tasmAchcha punarevaM tvaM karma mA kartumudyatA
verses.translation: Yama, the god of death himself, Gitragupta, the firegod, the manes and the Rudras resort to the southern gate.

verses.sanskrit: अहं कुतस्ते पुत्रोऽद्य त्वं माता कुत एव च । वृथाभिमानः पुत्रत्वे मातृत्वे च विचार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: ahaM kutaste putro.adya tvaM mAtA kuta eva cha | vR^ithAbhimAnaH putratve mAtR^itve cha vichAryatAm
verses.translation: Varuna, the lord of all rivers, along with the rivers Gahga etc. resort to the western gate and serve Mahabala.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण हो जाती हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: क्व माता क्व पिता विद्धि क्व स्वामी क्व कलत्रकम् । न कोऽपि कस्य चास्तीह सर्वेऽपि स्वकृतम्भुजः
verses.transliteration: kva mAtA kva pitA viddhi kva svAmI kva kalatrakam | na ko.api kasya chAstIha sarve.api svakR^itambhujaH
verses.translation: Similarly the wind god, Kubera, Bhadrakalika, the goddess of the gods and Candika and other Mothers resort to the northern gate.
verses.hindi: द्विजत्वके अधिकारसे वंचित हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: गौः प्रिये नैव दुग्धा ते सेत्युक्ता वत्समानयत् । दोहनार्थं समाहूय स्त्रियं शीघ्रतरं तदा
verses.transliteration: gauH priye naiva dugdhA te setyuktA vatsamAnayat | dohanArthaM samAhUya striyaM shIghrataraM tadA
verses.translation: O brahmins, the Mahabala image of Siva at Gokarna worshipped and eulogised is the doorway to salvation.

verses.sanskrit: गौरुवाच । एवं जानाम्यहं पुत्र माया मां न जहात्यसौ । त्वद्दुःखेन समं दुःखं तस्मै दास्ये तदेव हि
verses.transliteration: gauruvAcha | evaM jAnAmyahaM putra mAyA mAM na jahAtyasau | tvadduHkhena samaM duHkhaM tasmai dAsye tadeva hi
verses.translation: Good penance has been performed by many after worshipping the lord. Great achievements pleasing here and hereafter have been secured by them.
verses.hindi: पत्नी थी, जो दुष्टकुलमें उत्पन्न हुई थी

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स्वमातुर्गोर्द्विजोत्तमाः । मौनत्वं स्वीकृतं तत्र वत्सेनोक्तं न किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityetadvachanaM shrutvA svamAturgordvijottamAH | maunatvaM svIkR^itaM tatra vatsenoktaM na ki~nchana
verses.translation: O brahmins, the Mahabala image of Siva at Gokarna worshipped and eulogised is the doorway to salvation.

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च ब्रह्महत्याया नाशो यत्र भवेदिह । तत्स्थलं च मया दृष्टं हत्या मे हि गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: punashcha brahmahatyAyA nAsho yatra bhavediha | tatsthalaM cha mayA dR^iShTaM hatyA me hi gamiShyati
verses.translation: The worship of Mahabala on the fourteenth day in the dark half of the month of Magha yields salvation particularly even to the sinners.

verses.sanskrit: तयोस्तदद्भुतं वृत्तं श्रुत्वा पान्थो द्विजस्तदा । हृदा विचारयामास विस्मितो हि मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tayostadadbhutaM vR^ittaM shrutvA pAntho dvijastadA | hR^idA vichArayAmAsa vismito hi munIshvarAH
verses.translation: On this festive day of Siva, people of all the four castes come here from all countries, desirous of witnessing the great festivals.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार बहुत समय बीत गया

verses.sanskrit: इदमत्यद्भुतं वृत्तं दृष्ट्वा प्रातर्मया खलु । गन्तव्यं पुनरेवातो गन्तव्यं तत्स्थलं पुनः
verses.transliteration: idamatyadbhutaM vR^ittaM dR^iShTvA prAtarmayA khalu | gantavyaM punarevAto gantavyaM tatsthalaM punaH
verses.translation: Women, old men, children and people of the four stages of life come there, see the lord of gods and obtain
verses.hindi: शिवरसात्रिमें सत्रीसंग करके पुन: वहाँ आ गया

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । विचार्येति हृदा विप्रः स द्विजाः सेवकेन च । सुष्वाप तत्र जननीभक्तः परमविस्मितः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | vichAryeti hR^idA vipraH sa dvijAH sevakena cha | suShvApa tatra jananIbhaktaH paramavismitaH
verses.translation: O Siita, O fortunate Suta, you are blessed, you are the most excellent among the devotees of Siva. O holy lord, please narrate the story of the outcaste woman you just referred to.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातःकाले तदा जाते गृहस्वामी समुत्थितः । बोधयामास तं पान्थं वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: prAtaHkAle tadA jAte gR^ihasvAmI samutthitaH | bodhayAmAsa taM pAnthaM vachanaM chedamabravIt
verses.translation: O brahmins, listen with great devotion to that wonderful story illustrative of Siva's power. It enhances the devotional feelings of the listeners.
verses.hindi: कारण मेरा यह उत्तम कुल नष्ट हो गया

verses.sanskrit: द्विज उवाच । स्वपिषि त्वं किमर्थं हि प्रातःकालो भवत्यलम् । स्वयात्रां कुरु तं देशं गमनेच्छा च यत्र ह
verses.transliteration: dvija uvAcha | svapiShi tvaM kimarthaM hi prAtaHkAlo bhavatyalam | svayAtrAM kuru taM deshaM gamanechChA cha yatra ha
verses.translation: O brahmins, that youthful maiden Sauminl was married to a certain brahmin boy duly by her father.
verses.hindi: सुबल्नतोी महाभक्त्या स्वपुत्रसुखहेतवे॥ ३६  ,मभक्ति भावसे पार्वतीका पूजन किया

verses.sanskrit: तेनोक्तं श्रूयतां ब्रह्मन् शरीरे सेवकस्य मे । वर्तते हि व्यथा स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं गम्यते ततः
verses.transliteration: tenoktaM shrUyatAM brahman sharIre sevakasya me | vartate hi vyathA sthitvA muhUrtaM gamyate tataH
verses.translation: After getting a husband, O great brahmins, she in her fresh blooming youth indulged in sexual dalliance with him and maintained her auspicious rites.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं च मिषं कृत्वा सुष्वाप पुरुषस्तदा । तद्वृत्तमखिलं ज्ञातुमद्भुतं विस्मयावहम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM cha miShaM kR^itvA suShvApa puruShastadA | tadvR^ittamakhilaM j~nAtumadbhutaM vismayAvaham
verses.translation: O brahmins, then her youthful husband, the brah¬ min boy became distressed with a great ailment. Due to the misfortune of Saumini he died.
verses.hindi: हुई चण्डिकाने सुदर्शनको अपना पुत्र मान लिया

verses.sanskrit: वत्सं कीले स्वयं बद्धुं यत्नं चैवाकरोत्तदा । ब्राह्मणः स गृहस्वामी मुनयो दुग्धलालसः
verses.transliteration: vatsaM kIle svayaM baddhuM yatnaM chaivAkarottadA | brAhmaNaH sa gR^ihasvAmI munayo dugdhalAlasaH
verses.translation: When the husband passed away, the woman was much distressed, dejected and despondent. For some time
verses.hindi: ही उस सुदर्शनको उनकी गोदमें बैठा दिया

verses.sanskrit: दोहनस्य तदा काले ब्राह्मणः स्वसुतं प्रति । उवाच गन्तुकामश्च कार्यार्थं कुत्रचिच्च सः
verses.transliteration: dohanasya tadA kAle brAhmaNaH svasutaM prati | uvAcha gantukAmashcha kAryArthaM kutrachichcha saH
verses.translation: Thereafter, though a widow, her heart il>ecame defiled by lustful feelings because she was still in her prime of youth. She then transgressed the limits of decency.

verses.sanskrit: पितोवाच । मया तु गम्यते पुत्र कार्यार्थं कुत्रचित्पुनः । धेनुर्दोह्या त्वया वत्स सावधानादियं निजा
verses.transliteration: pitovAcha | mayA tu gamyate putra kAryArthaM kutrachitpunaH | dhenurdohyA tvayA vatsa sAvadhAnAdiyaM nijA
verses.translation: Coming to know of her misdeeds defiling the family her kinsmen gathered together, caught hold of her hair, took her far off and abandoned her.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा ब्राह्मणवरः स जगाम च कुत्रचित् । पुत्रः समुत्थितस्तत्र वत्सं च मुक्तवांस्तदा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA brAhmaNavaraH sa jagAma cha kutrachit | putraH samutthitastatra vatsaM cha muktavAMstadA
verses.translation: A leading Sudra saw her roaming about in the
verses.hindi: अपना कर्म सदा करते रहना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: माता च तस्य दोहार्थमाजगाम स्वयं तदा । द्विजपुत्रस्तदा वत्सं खिन्नं कीलेन ताडितम्
verses.transliteration: mAtA cha tasya dohArthamAjagAma svayaM tadA | dvijaputrastadA vatsaM khinnaM kIlena tADitam
verses.translation: She then became very fond of sexual intercourse, began to take in meat and indulged in drinking wine. She bore that Sudra a daughter too.

verses.sanskrit: बन्धनार्थं हि गोः पार्श्वमनयद्दुग्धलालसः । पुनर्गौश्च तदा क्रुद्धा शृङ्गेनाताडयच्च तम्
verses.transliteration: bandhanArthaM hi goH pArshvamanayaddugdhalAlasaH | punargaushcha tadA kruddhA shR^i~NgenAtADayachcha tam
verses.translation: Once while the husband had gone somewhere, Saumini the erring woman drank wine and badly wanted meat.

verses.sanskrit: पपात मूर्च्छां सम्प्राप्य सोऽपि मर्मणि ताडितः । लोकाश्च मिलितास्तत्र गवा बालो विहिंसितः
verses.transliteration: papAta mUrchChAM samprApya so.api marmaNi tADitaH | lokAshcha militAstatra gavA bAlo vihiMsitaH
verses.translation: In her cattleshed outside, goats and sheep had been tethered along with cows. It was dusk when nothing could be visible due to darkness. She then took a sword and went out.
verses.hindi: मैं जैसा कहता हूँ, उसे आप सुनें

verses.sanskrit: जलं जलं वदन्तस्ते पित्राद्या यत्र संस्थिताः । यत्नश्च क्रियते यावत्तावद् बालो मृतस्तदा
verses.transliteration: jalaM jalaM vadantaste pitrAdyA yatra saMsthitAH | yatnashcha kriyate yAvattAvad bAlo mR^itastadA
verses.translation: Inebriated that she was, the foul woman fond of flesh diet killed a calf taking it to be a goat without much consideration.

verses.sanskrit: मृते च बालके तत्र हाहाकारो महानभूत् । तन्माता दुःखिता ह्यासीद् रुरोद च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: mR^ite cha bAlake tatra hAhAkAro mahAnabhUt | tanmAtA duHkhitA hyAsId ruroda cha punaH punaH
verses.translation: After taking it within she realised that it was a calf. The terrified woman blurted out "Siva, Siva", thanks to some previous merit.
verses.hindi: पूजा पहले हो गयी और वह ध्वजा गिर पड़ी

verses.sanskrit: किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि को मे दुःखं व्यपोहयेत् । रुदित्वेति तदा गां च ताडयित्वा व्यमोचयत्
verses.transliteration: kiM karomi kva gachChAmi ko me duHkhaM vyapohayet | ruditveti tadA gAM cha tADayitvA vyamochayat
verses.translation: She meditated on Siva for a short while. But the desire for meat overwhelmed her. She minced the meat of the calf and ate it up with great relish.
verses.hindi: चकित हो उठे और प्रशंसा करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतवर्णा तदा सा गौर्द्रुतं श्यामा व्यदृश्यत । अहो च दृश्यतां लोकाश्चुक्रुशुश्च परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: shvetavarNA tadA sA gaurdrutaM shyAmA vyadR^ishyata | aho cha dR^ishyatAM lokAshchukrushushcha parasparam
verses.translation: O brahmins, when a long time elapsed thus, Saumini died and went to Yama*s abode.
verses.hindi: शिवपूजा तु तैः पूर्वमुत्तार्या नान्यथा पुनः। ष्ठ कहा है

verses.sanskrit: वत्सोऽपि कर्षमाणश्च पादे वै पादपीडनम् । चकार ब्राह्मणश्चैव कष्टं प्राप्तश्च सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: vatso.api karShamANashcha pAde vai pAdapIDanam | chakAra brAhmaNashchaiva kaShTaM prAptashcha suvratAH
verses.translation: Yama went through her antecedents and taking into consideration her merits and demerits he sent her back from hell to be born in an outcaste family.
verses.hindi: यच्छुत्वा शिवपूजाया: फल प्राप्नोति वै नर: ॥ ७७  प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणश्च तदा पान्थो दृष्ट्वाश्चर्यं विनिर्गतः । यत्र गौश्च गता तत्र तामनु ब्राह्मणो गतः
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNashcha tadA pAntho dR^iShTvAshcharyaM vinirgataH | yatra gaushcha gatA tatra tAmanu brAhmaNo gataH
verses.translation: Emaciated and distressed with hunger, blind and moving about with a staff in her hand, she somehow subdued her gastric fire by the leavings of food of the Caridalas nearby.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे च॒ुर्थ्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां बूटुकोत्पत्तिवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयोदशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वपुच्छं तदा कृत्वा शीघ्रं गौर्नर्मदां प्रति । आगत्य नन्दिकस्यास्य समीपे नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: UrdhvapuchChaM tadA kR^itvA shIghraM gaurnarmadAM prati | Agatya nandikasyAsya samIpe narmadAjale
verses.translation: With great difficulty and sufferings she passed a major portion of her life. When old age affected her limbs she was subjected to unending grief and distress.

verses.sanskrit: सन्निमज्य त्रिवारं तु श्वेतत्वं च गता हि सा । यथागतं गता सा च ब्राह्मणो विस्मयं गतः
verses.transliteration: sannimajya trivAraM tu shvetatvaM cha gatA hi sA | yathAgataM gatA sA cha brAhmaNo vismayaM gataH
verses.translation: Once she came to know of travellers going to visit Mahabala and Gokarna on the Siva festival day.
verses.hindi: उत्पत्ति च् तथा तेषां ब्रृहि सर्व यथाश्रुतम्॥ ९  कीजिये; जैसा आपने सुना है, वह सब बताइये

verses.sanskrit: अहो धन्यतमं तीर्थं ब्रह्महत्यानिवारणम् । स्वयं ममज्ज तत्रासौ ब्राह्मणः सेवकस्तथा
verses.transliteration: aho dhanyatamaM tIrthaM brahmahatyAnivAraNam | svayaM mamajja tatrAsau brAhmaNaH sevakastathA
verses.translation: Then prompted by a desire for clothes and meals she walked slowly to beg of the general public.
verses.hindi: संक्षेपतत यथाबुद्धि सदगुरोश्व मया श्रुतम्॥ २  कहता हूँ; आपलोग श्रवण करें

verses.sanskrit: निमज्ज्य हि गतौ तौ च प्रशंसन्तौ नदीं च ताम् । मार्गे च मिलिता काचित्सुन्दरी भूषणान्विता
verses.transliteration: nimajjya hi gatau tau cha prashaMsantau nadIM cha tAm | mArge cha militA kAchitsundarI bhUShaNAnvitA
verses.translation: She moved about here and there begging of the people imploring them with piteous words and outstretched hands after arriving at that place.

verses.sanskrit: तयोक्तं तं च भोः पान्थ कुतो यासि सुविस्मितः । सत्यं ब्रूहि च्छलं त्यक्त्वा विप्रवर्य ममाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: tayoktaM taM cha bhoH pAntha kuto yAsi suvismitaH | satyaM brUhi chChalaM tyaktvA vipravarya mamAgrataH
verses.translation: In the outstretched hands of the suppliant woman, a meritorious traveller hurled a bunch of Bilva leaves.
verses.hindi: तन्माहात्म्य॑ श्रुणु मुने प्रथमं सावधानतः॥ ४  सबसे पहले उन्हींका माहात्म्य सावधानीसे सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं वचस्तदा श्रुत्वा द्विजेनोक्तं यथातथम् । पुनश्चायं द्विजस्तत्र स्त्रियोक्तः स्थीयतां त्वया
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM vachastadA shrutvA dvijenoktaM yathAtatham | punashchAyaM dvijastatra striyoktaH sthIyatAM tvayA
verses.translation: When that bunch fell into her hands she felt it again and again and realising that it was not edible she cast it off dejectedly.
verses.hindi: मुनीएवरा:॥ ५  सत्ताईस कन्याओंका विवाह चन्द्रमासे कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: तयोक्तं च समाकर्ण्य स्थितः स ब्राह्मणस्ततः । प्रत्युवाच विनीतात्मा कथ्यते किं वदेति च
verses.transliteration: tayoktaM cha samAkarNya sthitaH sa brAhmaNastataH | pratyuvAcha vinItAtmA kathyate kiM vadeti cha
verses.translation: That bunch of Bilva leaves cast off from her hands during the night, fortunately fell on the top of a Siva's phallic image.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रो5पि चैव ता: प्राप्य शोभते सम निरन्तरम्॥ ६  होती है और मणिसे सुवर्ण सुशोभित होता है

verses.sanskrit: सा चाह पुनरेवात्र त्वया दृष्टं स्थलं च यत् । तत्राधुना क्षिपास्थीनि मातुः किं गम्यतेऽन्यतः
verses.transliteration: sA chAha punarevAtra tvayA dR^iShTaM sthalaM cha yat | tatrAdhunA kShipAsthIni mAtuH kiM gamyate.anyataH
verses.translation: Thus on the Siva Gaturdai night though she begged of the travellers again and again she did not get any* thing through the intercession of fate.
verses.hindi: थी, उतना अन्य कोई भी नहीं थी

verses.sanskrit: तव माता पान्थवर्य साक्षाद्दिव्यमयं वरम् । देहं धृत्वा द्रुतं साक्षाच्छम्भोर्यास्यति सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tava mAtA pAnthavarya sAkShAddivyamayaM varam | dehaM dhR^itvA drutaM sAkShAchChambhoryAsyati sadgatim
verses.translation: Thus, unwittingly she observed the rites of Sivacaturdai and kept awake during the night and obtained great bliss.

verses.sanskrit: तेन पादप्रहारेण स द्विजः क्रोधमूर्छितः । वत्सं च ताडयामास कूपैर्दृढतरं तदा
verses.transliteration: tena pAdaprahAreNa sa dvijaH krodhamUrChitaH | vatsaM cha tADayAmAsa kUpairdR^iDhataraM tadA
verses.translation: Then in the next morning, overcome with great grief the dejected woman returned to her native place alone slowly.
verses.hindi: व्यवहार नरक देनेवाला कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: वैशाखे चैव सम्प्राप्ते सप्तम्याश्च दिने शुभे । सिते पक्षे सदा गङ्गा ह्यायाति द्विजसत्तम
verses.transliteration: vaishAkhe chaiva samprApte saptamyAshcha dine shubhe | site pakShe sadA ga~NgA hyAyAti dvijasattama
verses.translation: Exhausted by long starvation and faltering and staggering at every step she somehow covered the long dis¬ tance but fell down unconscious.
verses.hindi: शुभ किस प्रकार हो सकता है।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यैव सप्तमी या सा गन्गाऽहं यामि तत्र वै । इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवी सा गङ्गा मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: adyaiva saptamI yA sA gangA.ahaM yAmi tatra vai | ityuktvAntardadhe devI sA ga~NgA munisattamAH
verses.translation: Seated in an aerial chariot brought immediately by Siva's GaQas, thanks to Siva's mercy, she went to Siva's region.

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तश्च द्विजः सोऽपि मात्रस्थ्यर्द्धं स्ववस्त्रतः । क्षिपेद्यावत्तत्र तीर्थे तावच्चित्रमभूत्तदा
verses.transliteration: nivR^ittashcha dvijaH so.api mAtrasthyarddhaM svavastrataH | kShipedyAvattatra tIrthe tAvachchitramabhUttadA
verses.translation: O brahmins, since at the outset the unchaste woman had cried out Siva's name unwittingly, she acquired a great merit whereby she reached the divine abode of Mahabala.
verses.hindi: अतः आप क्षयरोगसे ग्रस्त हो जायँ

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यदेहत्वमापन्ना स्वमाता च व्यदृश्यत । धन्योऽसि कृतकृत्योऽसि पवित्रं च कुलं त्वया
verses.transliteration: divyadehatvamApannA svamAtA cha vyadR^ishyata | dhanyo.asi kR^itakR^ityo.asi pavitraM cha kulaM tvayA
verses.translation: At Gokarna on Siva's Tithi during the night she had keept awake and observed fast. She had performed the worship of Siva's image with Bilva bunch.
verses.hindi: हुए दु:खित तथा व्याकुल हो गये

verses.sanskrit: धनं धान्यं तथा चायुर्वंशो वै वर्धतां तव । इत्याशिषं मुहुर्दत्त्वा स्वपुत्राय दिवं गता
verses.transliteration: dhanaM dhAnyaM tathA chAyurvaMsho vai vardhatAM tava | ityAshiShaM muhurdattvA svaputrAya divaM gatA
verses.translation: O brahmins thus the greatness of the excellent Siva image Mahabala has been mentioned to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भुक्त्वा सुखं भूरि चिरकालं महोत्तमम् । शङ्करस्य प्रसादेन गता सा ह्युत्तमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvA sukhaM bhUri chirakAlaM mahottamam | sha~Nkarasya prasAdena gatA sA hyuttamAM gatim
verses.translation: I shall now mention another wonderful glory of the same. By merely listening to it, the devotion for Siva is generated.
verses.hindi: किया, तब उसने ताराको उन्हें लौटा दिया

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणश्च सुतस्तस्याः क्षिप्त्वास्थीनि पुनस्ततः । प्रसन्नमानसोऽभूत्स शुद्धात्मा स्वगृहं गतः
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNashcha sutastasyAH kShiptvAsthIni punastataH | prasannamAnaso.abhUtsa shuddhAtmA svagR^ihaM gataH
verses.translation: The virtuous and auspicious-natured lady Madayanti was his beloved wife, like DamayantI of Nala. She was known as a chaste lady.

verses.sanskrit: वत्सोऽपि पीडितस्तेन श्रान्तश्चैवाभवत्तदा । दुग्धा गौर्मोचितो वत्सो न क्रोधेन द्विजन्मना
verses.transliteration: vatso.api pIDitastena shrAntashchaivAbhavattadA | dugdhA gaurmochito vatso na krodhena dvijanmanA
verses.translation: Fond of hunting, once that king Mitrasaha went to a thick forest accompanied by a huge army.

verses.sanskrit: गौर्दोग्धुं च महत्प्रीत्या रोदनं चाकरोत्तदा । दृष्ट्वा च रोदनं तस्या वत्सो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: gaurdogdhuM cha mahatprItyA rodanaM chAkarottadA | dR^iShTvA cha rodanaM tasyA vatso vAkyamathAbravIt
verses.translation: Sporting about there, the king killed a wicked demon Kamatha who used to harass good men.

verses.sanskrit: वत्स उवाच । कथं च रुद्यते मातः किं ते दुःखमुपस्थितम् । तन्निवेदय मे प्रीत्या तच्छ्रुत्वा गौरवोचत
verses.transliteration: vatsa uvAcha | kathaM cha rudyate mAtaH kiM te duHkhamupasthitam | tannivedaya me prItyA tachChrutvA gauravochata
verses.translation: After indulging in hunting sports for sometime in the forest, the king abandoned the game and joyously returned to his capital.
verses.hindi: आये, जहाँ दक्ष तथा चन्द्रमा स्थित थे

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा त्वया मातर्दुःखं त्याज्यं सुयत्नतः । सुभगाचरणं कार्यं परलोकसुखेप्सया
verses.transliteration: evaM j~nAtvA tvayA mAtarduHkhaM tyAjyaM suyatnataH | subhagAcharaNaM kAryaM paralokasukhepsayA
verses.translation: After indulging in hunting sports for sometime in the forest, the king abandoned the game and joyously returned to his capital.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: On seeing the vegetarian and non-vegetarian dish in which the demon in the guise of a cook had mixed human flesh, the preceptor said.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: On seeing the vegetarian and non-vegetarian dish in which the demon in the guise of a cook had mixed human flesh, the preceptor said.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । नन्दिकेश्वरशिवलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । कथं गङ्गा समायाता वैशाखे सप्तमीदिने । नर्मदायां विशेषेण सूतैतद्वर्णय प्रभो
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.7\. saptamo.adhyAyaH | nandikeshvarashivali~NgamAhAtmyavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | kathaM ga~NgA samAyAtA vaishAkhe saptamIdine | narmadAyAM visheSheNa sUtaitadvarNaya prabho
verses.translation: O wicked king, fie upon you. Human flesh has been deceitfully offered to me by you. Hence you will become a demon.
verses.hindi: मृत्युंजयका ध्यान करते हुए वहाँ स्थित रहे

verses.sanskrit: न मानितवती तं च ब्राह्मणी सा तपोरता । अतीव हि तपोनिष्ठासीच्छिवध्यानमाश्रिता
verses.transliteration: na mAnitavatI taM cha brAhmaNI sA taporatA | atIva hi taponiShThAsIchChivadhyAnamAshritA
verses.translation: On realising that it had been perpetrated by the demon, the preceptor pondered over and prescribed a time¬ limit of twelve years for the curse.
verses.hindi: दूसरे पक्षमें क्रमश: वह कला निरन्तर बढ़ेगी

verses.sanskrit: अथ मूढः स दैत्येन्द्रः तया तन्व्या तिरस्कृतः । चुक्रोध विकटं तस्यै पश्चाद्रूपमदर्शयत्
verses.transliteration: atha mUDhaH sa daityendraH tayA tanvyA tiraskR^itaH | chukrodha vikaTaM tasyai pashchAdrUpamadarshayat
verses.translation: Then the chaste and virtuous queen Madayanti fell at his feet and entreated him to spare the curse.
verses.hindi: और ऋषि वहाँ शीघ्र ही आये

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रोवाच दुष्टात्मा दुर्वचो भयकारकम् । त्रासयामास बहुशस्तां च पत्नीं द्विजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: atha provAcha duShTAtmA durvacho bhayakArakam | trAsayAmAsa bahushastAM cha patnIM dvijanmanaH
verses.translation: Out of deference for her entreaties the king desisted from cursing, but dropped the handful of water on his own feet which became deformed.

verses.sanskrit: तदा सा भयसन्त्रस्ता बहुवारं शिवेति च । बभाषे स्नेहतस्तन्वी द्विजपत्नी शिवाश्रया
verses.transliteration: tadA sA bhayasantrastA bahuvAraM shiveti cha | babhAShe snehatastanvI dvijapatnI shivAshrayA
verses.translation: O great sages, from that day onwards the king became famous in the world as Kalmaahghri by the virtue of that water.
verses.hindi: पार्वतीसहित आप यहाँ स्थिर हो जाइये

verses.sanskrit: विह्वलातीव सा नारी शिवनामप्रभाषिणी । जगाम शरणं शम्भोः स्वधर्मावनहेतवे
verses.transliteration: vihvalAtIva sA nArI shivanAmaprabhAShiNI | jagAma sharaNaM shambhoH svadharmAvanahetave
verses.translation: By the curse of his preceptor the leading sage, the king Mitrasaha became a terrible violent Raksasa, roaming in the forest.

verses.sanskrit: शरणागतरक्षार्थं कर्तुं सद्वृत्तमाहितम् । आनन्दार्थं हि तस्यास्तु शिव आविर्बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: sharaNAgatarakShArthaM kartuM sadvR^ittamAhitam | AnandArthaM hi tasyAstu shiva AvirbabhUva ha
verses.translation: Transformed as Rak§asa and resembling Yama, the destroyer of the world, he roamed about in the forest devouring various living beings, men and others.
verses.hindi: क्षय, कुष्ठ आदि रोगोंका विनाश करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: अथ तं मूढनामानं दैत्येन्द्रं कामविह्वलम् । चकार भस्मसात्सद्यः शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: atha taM mUDhanAmAnaM daityendraM kAmavihvalam | chakAra bhasmasAtsadyaH sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: Once, somewhere in the forest, the king who was as hideous as the god of death saw a newly married couple—a young sage and his young wife indulging in sexual dalliance.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च परमेशानो कृपादृष्ट्या विलोक्य ताम् । वरं ब्रूहीति चोवाच भक्तरक्षणदक्षधीः
verses.transliteration: tatashcha parameshAno kR^ipAdR^iShTyA vilokya tAm | varaM brUhIti chovAcha bhaktarakShaNadakShadhIH
verses.translation: The demon habituated to eat human flesh in his distressed state due to the curse caught hold of the young sage in order to eat him like a tiger seizing a fawnt
verses.hindi: असाध्य रोग हैं, वे सभी नष्ट हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा महेशवचनं सा साध्वी द्विजकामिनी । ददर्श शाङ्करं रूपमानन्दजनकं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: shrutvA maheshavachanaM sA sAdhvI dvijakAminI | dadarsha shA~NkaraM rUpamAnandajanakaM shubham
verses.translation: The young woman, on seeing her husband seized by the demon, was much frightened and implored him with piteous cries.
verses.hindi: है और मरनेपर स्वर्गमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य तं शम्भुं परमेशं सुखावहम् । तुष्टाव साञ्जलिः साध्वी नतस्कन्धा शुभाशया
verses.transliteration: tataH praNamya taM shambhuM parameshaM sukhAvaham | tuShTAva sA~njaliH sAdhvI nataskandhA shubhAshayA
verses.translation: In spite of repeated importunities the man-eating ruthless wicked demon cut off the head of the brahmin sage and devoured it.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरश्च कथं जातो नन्दिकेशो हि नामतः । वृत्तं तदपि सुप्रीत्या कथय त्वं महामते
verses.transliteration: Ishvarashcha kathaM jAto nandikesho hi nAmataH | vR^ittaM tadapi suprItyA kathaya tvaM mahAmate
verses.translation: The distressed, grief-stricken chaste lady lamented much. She gathered the bones of her husband and lighted a funeral pyre.
verses.hindi: अवश्य प्राप्त करता है; इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिकोवाच । देवदेव महादेव शरणागतवत्सल । दीनबन्धुस्त्वमीशानो भक्तरक्षाकरः सदा
verses.transliteration: R^iShikovAcha | devadeva mahAdeva sharaNAgatavatsala | dInabandhustvamIshAno bhaktarakShAkaraH sadA
verses.translation: The brahmin lady desirous of entering the pyre in order to follow her husband cursed the Rakasa king.
verses.hindi: सर्वान्कामानवाष्नोति सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥ ६२  पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: त्वया मे रक्षितो धर्मो मूढनाम्नोऽसुरादिह । यदयं निहतो दुष्टो जगद्रक्षा कृता त्वया
verses.transliteration: tvayA me rakShito dharmo mUDhanAmno.asurAdiha | yadayaM nihato duShTo jagadrakShA kR^itA tvayA
verses.translation: The chaste lady entered fire after proclaiming **From now onwards if you become united with any woman in sexual embrace you will die."
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे च॒दुर्ध्या कोटिरखसंहितायां सोगनाथज्योतिलिंगोत्पत्तिवर्णन॑ नाम चतुर्दशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: स्वपादयोः परां भक्तिं देहि मे ह्यनपायिनीम् । अयमेव वरो नाथ किमन्यदधिकं ह्यतः
verses.transliteration: svapAdayoH parAM bhaktiM dehi me hyanapAyinIm | ayameva varo nAtha kimanyadadhikaM hyataH
verses.translation: After undergoing the results of his preceptor's curse to which there was a time-limit, the king regained his original form and joyously returned to his palace.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यदाकर्णय विभो प्रार्थनां मे महेश्वर । लोकानामुपकारार्थमिह त्वं संस्थितो भव
verses.transliteration: anyadAkarNaya vibho prArthanAM me maheshvara | lokAnAmupakArArthamiha tvaM saMsthito bhava
verses.translation: MadayantI who knew of the curse of the chaste brahmin lady prevented her husband who evinced a desire for sexual embrace. She was much frightened of widow¬ hood.
verses.hindi: य॑ श्रुत्वा भक्तिमान्धीमान्सर्वपापै: प्रमुच्यते॥ १ । बुद्धिमान् भक्त सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति स्तुत्वा महादेवमृषिका सा शुभव्रता । तूष्णीमासाथ गिरिशः प्रोवाच करुणाकरः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti stutvA mahAdevamR^iShikA sA shubhavratA | tUShNImAsAtha girishaH provAcha karuNAkaraH
verses.translation: The issueless king became disgusted with kingly pleasures. Eschewing all riches he went to the forest.
verses.hindi: जद शा पुनः वर्णन करता हूँ
