verses.sanskrit: गिरिश उवाच । ऋषिके सुचरित्रा त्वं मम भक्ता विशेषतः । दत्ता वराश्च ते सर्वे तुभ्यं ये ये हि याचिताः
verses.transliteration: girisha uvAcha | R^iShike sucharitrA tvaM mama bhaktA visheShataH | dattA varAshcha te sarve tubhyaM ye ye hi yAchitAH
verses.translation: He saw the hideous form of Brahmahatya closely following him, threatening him again and again and tormenting him.
verses.hindi: जज ब्द्वत:॥ ४  आदिका सारा वृत्तान्त कहा

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र हरिब्रह्मादयः सुराः । शिवाविर्भावमाज्ञाय ययुर्हर्षसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra haribrahmAdayaH surAH | shivAvirbhAvamAj~nAya yayurharShasamanvitAH
verses.translation: Dejected in mind the king wanted to get rid of Brahmahatya. He tried japas, holy rites, sacrifices and various other means.
verses.hindi: वृभ्यां वारितोडपि हि॥। ५  बे कुमार उनको प्रणामकर क्रौंचपर्वतपर चले गये

verses.sanskrit: शिवं प्रणम्य सुप्रीत्या समानर्चुश्च तेऽखिलाः । तुष्टुवुर्नतका विप्राः करौ बद्ध्वा सुचेतसः
verses.transliteration: shivaM praNamya suprItyA samAnarchushcha te.akhilAH | tuShTuvurnatakA viprAH karau baddhvA suchetasaH
verses.translation: O brahmins, when BrahmahatyH did not leave him inspite of the means like the ceremonial ablution in holy centres, the king went to Mithila.
verses.hindi: सु यु सुभ्रूस्त्यज्यता दुःखमुत्कटम् ॥ ७ आयेगा; तुम इस महान् दुःख़का त्याग करो

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये गङ्गा साध्वीं तां स्वर्धुनी जगौ । ऋषिकां सुप्रसन्नात्मा प्रशंसन्ती च तद्विधिम्
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye ga~NgA sAdhvIM tAM svardhunI jagau | R^iShikAM suprasannAtmA prashaMsantI cha tadvidhim
verses.translation: Distressed and worried by anxiety the king reached a park at the outskirts of the city. There he saw the sage Gautama approaching him.
verses.hindi: होकर कुमारको लानेके लिये वहाँ गये

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच । ममार्थं चैव वैशाखे मासि देयं त्वया वचः । स्थित्यर्थं दिनमेकं मे सामीप्यं कार्यमेव हि
verses.transliteration: ga~NgovAcha | mamArthaM chaiva vaishAkhe mAsi deyaM tvayA vachaH | sthityarthaM dinamekaM me sAmIpyaM kAryameva hi
verses.translation: The king advanced towards that sage of pure

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । साधु पृष्टमृषिश्रेष्ठा नन्दिकेशाश्रितं वचः । तदहं कथयाम्यद्य श्रवणात्पुण्यवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | sAdhu pR^iShTamR^iShishreShThA nandikeshAshritaM vachaH | tadahaM kathayAmyadya shravaNAtpuNyavardhanam
verses.translation: When the sage enquired of his welfare, the king heaved a sigh of grief and distress. Viewed mercifully by him the king felt pleased and contented. He said thus.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । गङ्गावचनमाकर्ण्य सा साध्वी प्राह सुव्रता । तथास्त्विति वचः प्रीत्या लोकानां हितहेतवे
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ga~NgAvachanamAkarNya sA sAdhvI prAha suvratA | tathAstviti vachaH prItyA lokAnAM hitahetave
verses.translation: O sage, this endless Brahmahatya harasses me. O dear, it is imperceptible to others but it threatens me at every step.
verses.hindi: गये, जहाँ उनके पुत्र कार्तिकेय रहते थे

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दार्थं शिवस्तस्याः सुप्रसन्नश्च पार्थिवे । तस्मिँल्लिङ्गे लयं यातः पूर्णांशेन तया हरः
verses.transliteration: AnandArthaM shivastasyAH suprasannashcha pArthive | tasmi.Nlli~Nge layaM yAtaH pUrNAMshena tayA haraH
verses.translation: A brahmin boy had been devoured by me in the clutches of a curse. That sin cannot be suppressed even by thousands of expiatory rites.
verses.hindi: स्नेहरहित हो उस पर्वतसे तीन योजन दूर चले गये

verses.sanskrit: देवाः सर्वे सुप्रसन्नाः प्रशंसन्ति शिवं च ताम् । स्वं स्वं धाम ययुर्विष्णुर्ब्रह्माद्या अपि स्वर्णदी
verses.transliteration: devAH sarve suprasannAH prashaMsanti shivaM cha tAm | svaM svaM dhAma yayurviShNurbrahmAdyA api svarNadI
verses.translation: O sage, I roamed here and there and tried various means to quell it. But it did not leave me off. Is it not due to my being a sinning soul?
verses.hindi: धारणकर वहीं क्रौंचपर्वतपर विराजमान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: तद्दिनात्पावनं तीर्थमासीदीदृशमुत्तमम् । नन्दिकेशः शिवः ख्यातः सर्वपापविनाशनः
verses.transliteration: taddinAtpAvanaM tIrthamAsIdIdR^ishamuttamam | nandikeshaH shivaH khyAtaH sarvapApavinAshanaH
verses.translation: Now it seems to me that I have attained the fruits of my birth because merely by your sight my heart is filled with bliss.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गापि प्रतिवर्षं तद्दिने याति शुभेच्छया । क्षालनार्थं स्वपापस्य यद् गृहीतं नृणां द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ga~NgApi prativarShaM taddine yAti shubhechChayA | kShAlanArthaM svapApasya yad gR^ihItaM nR^iNAM dvijAH
verses.translation: O fortunate one, I, the sinner, seek refuge in your lotus-like feet. Grant me peace, whereby I can be happy.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यङ् नन्दिकेशं समर्च्य च । ब्रह्महत्यादिभिः पापैर्मुच्यते ह्यखिलैरपि
verses.transliteration: tatra snAto naraH samya~N nandikeshaM samarchya cha | brahmahatyAdibhiH pApairmuchyate hyakhilairapi
verses.translation: Implored thus by the king, the kind-hearted Gautama instructed him in the expiatory means for terrible sins.
verses.hindi: दर्शनात्सर्वसुखद॑ कथित॑ लोकहेतवे॥ २३  है; मैंने लोककल्याणके लिये इसका वर्णन किया

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणी ऋषिका नाम्नी कस्यचिच्च द्विजन्मनः । सुता विवाहिता कस्मैचिद् द्विजाय विधानतः
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNI R^iShikA nAmnI kasyachichcha dvijanmanaH | sutA vivAhitA kasmaichid dvijAya vidhAnataH
verses.translation: O excellent king, well done You are blessed. Eschew all fear from sins. As long as Siva is the ruler, there can be no terror to devotees who seek refuge in him.
verses.hindi: द्वितीय ज्योतिर्लिंगका वर्णन नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वकर्मप्रभावेण पत्नी सा हि द्विजन्मनः । सुव्रतापि च विप्रेन्द्रा बालवैधव्यमागता
verses.transliteration: pUrvakarmaprabhAveNa patnI sA hi dvijanmanaH | suvratApi cha viprendrA bAlavaidhavyamAgatA
verses.translation: Sins greater than the greatest cannot stay there. Siva himself is present there in the name of Mahabala.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा द्विजपत्नी हि ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतान्विता । पार्थिवार्चनपूर्वं हि तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: atha sA dvijapatnI hi brahmacharyavratAnvitA | pArthivArchanapUrvaM hi tapastepe sudAruNam
verses.translation: Great sinners go there, take their ceremonial
verses.hindi: मनोहर अवन्ती नामक एक प्रसिद्ध नगरी है

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवसरे दुष्टो मूढनामासुरो बली । ययौ तत्र महामायी कामबाणेन ताडितः
verses.transliteration: tasminnavasare duShTo mUDhanAmAsuro balI | yayau tatra mahAmAyI kAmabANena tADitaH
verses.translation: O king, you also go to Gokarna, the temple of

verses.sanskrit: तपन्तीं तां समालोक्य सुन्दरीमतिकामिनीम् । तया भोगं ययाचे स नानालोभं प्रदर्शयन्
verses.transliteration: tapantIM tAM samAlokya sundarImatikAminIm | tayA bhogaM yayAche sa nAnAlobhaM pradarshayan
verses.translation: Take your holy dip in the sacred waters there.
verses.hindi: तथा क्षेत्रसे धर्मको दूर हटा दिया

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा सुव्रता नारी शिवध्यानपरायणा । तस्मिन्दृष्टिं दधौ नैव कामदृष्ट्या मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: atha sA suvratA nArI shivadhyAnaparAyaNA | tasmindR^iShTiM dadhau naiva kAmadR^iShTyA munIshvarAH
verses.translation: Advised thus by the noble-souled Gautama, the king highly delighted in the mind reached Gokarna.
verses.hindi: विचारकर उसने जो किया, उसे आप लोग सुनें

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this pleasing narrative of
verses.hindi: बेदधर्ममें तत्पर ये सब दण्डके योग्य हैं

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this pleasing narrative of
verses.hindi: वशमें नहीं किया जा सकता है ?

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.८. अष्टमोऽध्यायः । महाबलमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । द्विजाः शृणुत सद्भक्त्या शिवलिङ्गानि तानि च । पश्चिमायां दिशायां वै यानि ख्यातानि भूतले
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.8\. aShTamo.adhyAyaH | mahAbalamAhAtmyavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | dvijAH shR^iNuta sadbhaktyA shivali~NgAni tAni cha | pashchimAyAM dishAyAM vai yAni khyAtAni bhUtale
verses.translation: Thus the extremely wonderful glory of Mahabala, the phallic image of Siva, has been narrated to you. It dispels all sins.

verses.sanskrit: महापातकिनश्चात्र समभ्यर्च्य महाबलम् । शिवलिङ्गं च गोकर्णे प्रयाताः शाङ्करं पदम्
verses.transliteration: mahApAtakinashchAtra samabhyarchya mahAbalam | shivali~NgaM cha gokarNe prayAtAH shA~NkaraM padam
verses.translation: O Suta, O fortunate Suta, you are blessed with your mind attached to Siva. This wonderful story of Mahabala has been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: ही हैं, जिससे हम उन्हें पराजित कर सकें

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णे तत्र मुनयो गत्वा पुण्यर्क्षवासरे । येऽर्चयन्ति च तं भक्त्या ते रुद्राः स्युर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: gokarNe tatra munayo gatvA puNyarkShavAsare | ye.archayanti cha taM bhaktyA te rudrAH syurna saMshayaH
verses.translation: Please narrate the sacred glory of the sin-destroying phallic images that arc in the northern quarter.

verses.sanskrit: यदा कदाचिद्गोकर्णे यो वा को वापि मानवः । पूजयेच्छिवलिङ्गं तत्स गच्छेद् ब्रह्मणः पदम्
verses.transliteration: yadA kadAchidgokarNe yo vA ko vApi mAnavaH | pUjayechChivali~NgaM tatsa gachChed brahmaNaH padam
verses.translation: O brahmins, listen with respect. I shall succinctly ex¬ plain the particular glory of the northern phallic images of Siva.
verses.hindi: अब हमें कोई शरण देनेवाला नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिदेवानां शङ्करो हितकाम्यया । महाबलाभिधानेन देवः सन्निहितः सदा
verses.transliteration: brahmaviShNvAdidevAnAM sha~Nkaro hitakAmyayA | mahAbalAbhidhAnena devaH sannihitaH sadA
verses.translation: The moon-crested Siva's phallic image, excellent of all, is situated there. It was installed by Ravana with great devotion and it confers all accomplishments.

verses.sanskrit: घोरेण तपसा लब्धं रावणाख्येन रक्षसा । तल्लिङ्गं स्थापयामास गोकर्णे गणनायकः
verses.transliteration: ghoreNa tapasA labdhaM rAvaNAkhyena rakShasA | talli~NgaM sthApayAmAsa gokarNe gaNanAyakaH
verses.translation: Taking the ceremonial ablution in Gokarna and worshipping the moon-crested Siva, the devotee attains Sivaloka. True. It is true undoubtedly.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा महेन्द्रश्च विश्वेदेवा मरुद्गणाः । आदित्या वसवो दस्रौ शशाङ्कश्च सतारकः
verses.transliteration: viShNurbrahmA mahendrashcha vishvedevA marudgaNAH | AdityA vasavo dasrau shashA~Nkashcha satArakaH
verses.translation: Somehow the extreme grandeur of the phallic Siva has been explained to you. Now listen to that of the other phallic image.

verses.sanskrit: एते विमानगतयो देवाश्च सह पार्षदैः । पूर्वद्वारं निषेवन्ते तस्य वै प्रीतिकारणात्
verses.transliteration: ete vimAnagatayo devAshcha saha pArShadaiH | pUrvadvAraM niShevante tasya vai prItikAraNAt
verses.translation: In the excellent holy centreof the sage Mira, the phallic image of Siva had been installed by the great sage Dadhici.
verses.hindi: देखकर उसकी सेना विनष्ट हो गयी

verses.sanskrit: यमो मृत्युः स्वयं साक्षाच्चित्रगुप्तश्च पावकः । पितृभिः सह रुद्रैश्च दक्षिणद्वारमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: yamo mR^ityuH svayaM sAkShAchchitraguptashcha pAvakaH | pitR^ibhiH saha rudraishcha dakShiNadvAramAshritaH
verses.translation: After going there and tajking the due ceremonial ablution in the sacred pond, the devotee shall worship this image reverentially.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणः सरितां नाथो गङ्गादिसरितां गणैः । महाबलं च सेवन्ते पश्चिमद्वारमाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: varuNaH saritAM nAtho ga~NgAdisaritAM gaNaiH | mahAbalaM cha sevante pashchimadvAramAshritAH
verses.translation: The idol of Dadhica should be duly worshipped for the propitiation of Siva by those who seek the fruit of the pilgrimage.

verses.sanskrit: तथा वायुः कुबेरश्च देवेशी भद्रकालिका । मातृभिश्चण्डिकाद्याभिरुत्तरद्वारमाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: tathA vAyuH kuberashcha deveshI bhadrakAlikA | mAtR^ibhishchaNDikAdyAbhiruttaradvAramAshritAH
verses.translation: The phallic image of Siva known as Rsisvara in¬ stalled by the sages in the holy centre of Naimisa'®® forest, yields happiness.

verses.sanskrit: कपिलायां नगर्यां तु कालरामेश्वराभिधे । शिवलिङ्गे महादिव्ये दर्शनात्पापहारके
verses.transliteration: kapilAyAM nagaryAM tu kAlarAmeshvarAbhidhe | shivali~Nge mahAdivye darshanAtpApahArake
verses.translation: O great sages, enjoyment of worldly pleasures and salvation he 'c and hereafter will fall to the lot of even sinful persons who visit and worship it,
verses.hindi: लिंगरूपी शिवजीका कल्याणमय क्षेत्र हो गया

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे देवाः सगन्धर्वाः पितरः सिद्धचारणाः । विद्याधराः किम्पुरुषाः किन्नरा गुह्यकाः खगाः
verses.transliteration: sarve devAH sagandharvAH pitaraH siddhachAraNAH | vidyAdharAH kimpuruShAH kinnarA guhyakAH khagAH
verses.translation: See P. 432 note.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीजशिवमहाएुराणे चतुर्थ्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां महाकालज्योतिरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम षरोडशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: नानापिशाचा वेताला दैतेयाश्च महाबलाः । नागाः शेषादयः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च मुनयोऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: nAnApishAchA vetAlA daiteyAshcha mahAbalAH | nAgAH sheShAdayaH sarve siddhAshcha munayo.akhilAH
verses.translation: The phallic image destructive of sins, in the holy
verses.hindi: माहात्य्यवर्णण नामक सोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: प्रणुवन्ति च तं देवं प्रणमन्ति महाबलम् । लभन्त ईप्सितान्कामान् रमन्ते च यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: praNuvanti cha taM devaM praNamanti mahAbalam | labhanta IpsitAnkAmAn ramante cha yathAsukham
verses.translation: Lalitesvara, the phallic image of:§iva in the holy centre Devaprayaga should be worshipped by men. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: बहुभिस्तत्र सुतपस्तप्तं सम्पूज्य तं विभुम् । लब्धा हि परमा सिद्धिरिहामुत्रापि सौख्यदा
verses.transliteration: bahubhistatra sutapastaptaM sampUjya taM vibhum | labdhA hi paramA siddhirihAmutrApi saukhyadA
verses.translation: The phallic image Pasupatisa in the Nayapala'®' town famous on the earth is the bestower of the fruits of all desires.
verses.hindi: नामक गण था; वह समस्त लोगोंद्वारा नमस्कृत था

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णे शिवलिङ्गं तु मोक्षद्वार उदाहृतः । महाबलाभिधानोऽसौ पूजितः संस्तुतो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: gokarNe shivali~NgaM tu mokShadvAra udAhR^itaH | mahAbalAbhidhAno.asau pUjitaH saMstuto dvijAH
verses.translation: Close to it lies the wonderful phallic image Mukti- natha. Its very sight and worship bestows worldly enjoyment here and liberation hereafter.
verses.hindi: देवगणोंके बीच सूर्य शोभित होते हैं

verses.sanskrit: माघासितचतुर्दश्यां महाबलसमर्चनम् । विमुक्तिदं विशेषेण सर्वेषां पापिनामपि
verses.transliteration: mAghAsitachaturdashyAM mahAbalasamarchanam | vimuktidaM visheSheNa sarveShAM pApinAmapi
verses.translation: O great sages, the excellent phallic images in the four quarters have been thus described to you all. What else do you wish to hear.
verses.hindi: लेनेके लिये आतुर मनवाले हो गये

verses.sanskrit: अस्यां शिवतिथौ सर्वे महोत्सवदिदृक्षवः । आयान्ति सर्वदेशेभ्यश्चातुर्वर्ण्यमहाजनाः
verses.transliteration: asyAM shivatithau sarve mahotsavadidR^ikShavaH | AyAnti sarvadeshebhyashchAturvarNyamahAjanAH
verses.translation: O Suta, you know every thing by the grace of Vyasa. There is nothing not known to you. Hence we ap¬ proach you with a query.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियो वृद्धाश्च बालाश्च चतुराश्रमवासिनः । दृष्ट्वा तत्रैत्य देवेशं लेभिरे कृतकृत्यताम्
verses.transliteration: striyo vR^iddhAshcha bAlAshcha chaturAshramavAsinaH | dR^iShTvA tatraitya deveshaM lebhire kR^itakR^ityatAm
verses.translation: O brahmins, the story of a different Kalpa was heard from Vyasa by me. O excellent sages, I shall narrate the same. Please listen.

verses.sanskrit: महाबलप्रभावात्ते तच्च लिङ्गं शिवस्य तु । सम्पूज्यैकाथ चाण्डाली शिवलोकं गता द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: mahAbalaprabhAvAtte tachcha li~NgaM shivasya tu | sampUjyaikAtha chANDAlI shivalokaM gatA drutam
verses.translation: What happened formerly among the brahmins in the Daruvana®® forest may kindly be heard. I shall narrate the same in the manner I have heard.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे सागरे चैव महासिद्धेश्वरः स्मृतः । धर्मार्थकामदश्चैव तथा मोक्षप्रदोऽपि हि
verses.transliteration: pashchime sAgare chaiva mahAsiddheshvaraH smR^itaH | dharmArthakAmadashchaiva tathA mokShaprado.api hi
verses.translation: O great sages, they performed the worship of Siva incessantly thrice a day. They eulogised Siva with different devotional hymns.
verses.hindi: तब उसकी माता स्वयं वहाँ गयी

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमाम्बुधितीरस्थं गोकर्णं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् । ब्रह्महत्यादिपापघ्नं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: pashchimAmbudhitIrasthaM gokarNaM kShetramuttamam | brahmahatyAdipApaghnaM sarvakAmaphalapradam
verses.translation: In the mezintime Siva himself assuming a very hideous form came there in order to test their devotion.
verses.hindi: फेंककर उसकी यूजाको नष्ट कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णे शिवलिङ्गानि विद्यन्ते कोटिकोटिशः । असङ्ख्यातानि तीर्थानि तिष्ठन्ति च पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: gokarNe shivali~NgAni vidyante koTikoTishaH | asa~NkhyAtAni tIrthAni tiShThanti cha pade pade
verses.translation: In the mezintime Siva himself assuming a very hideous form came there in order to test their devotion.
verses.hindi: चीखने लगा और पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़ा

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन गोकर्णस्थानि सर्वशः । शिवप्रत्यक्षलिङ्गानि तीर्थान्यम्भांसि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: bahunAtra kimuktena gokarNasthAni sarvashaH | shivapratyakShali~NgAni tIrthAnyambhAMsi sarvashaH
verses.translation: The wives of the sages were extremely frightened at this sight. The other women excited and surprised approa¬ ched the lord.
verses.hindi: बन गया, जिसे उस बालकने देखा

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णे शिवलिङ्गानां तीर्थानामपि सर्वशः । वर्ण्यते महिमा तात पुराणेषु महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: gokarNe shivali~NgAnAM tIrthAnAmapi sarvashaH | varNyate mahimA tAta purANeShu maharShibhiH
verses.translation: Some embraced him. Others held his hands. The women were engrossed in struggling with one another.

verses.sanskrit: कृते युगे स हि श्वेतस्त्रेतायां सोऽतिलोहितः । द्वापरे पीतवर्णश्च कलौ श्यामो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: kR^ite yuge sa hi shvetastretAyAM so.atilohitaH | dvApare pItavarNashcha kalau shyAmo bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Meanwhile the great sages came there. On seeing him engaged in perverse activities they were pained and infuriated.
verses.hindi: उठकर आनन्दसागरमें मानो निमग्न हो गया

verses.sanskrit: आक्रान्तसप्तपातालकुहरोऽपि महाबलः । प्राप्ते कलियुगे घोरे मृदुतामुपयास्यति
verses.transliteration: AkrAntasaptapAtAlakuharo.api mahAbalaH | prApte kaliyuge ghore mR^idutAmupayAsyati
verses.translation: The sages, deluded by Siva's Maya and plunged in grief, began to say—"Who is this? Who is this?"

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Sec P. io 8 j note.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Sec P. io 8 j note.
verses.hindi: यह सब देखकर परमानन्दसागरमें डूब गया

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.९. नवमोऽध्यायः । चाण्डालीसद्गतिवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सूत महाभाग धन्यस्त्वं शैवसत्तमः । चाण्डाली का समाख्याता तत्कथां कथय प्रभो
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.9\. navamo.adhyAyaH | chANDAlIsadgativarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | sUta sUta mahAbhAga dhanyastvaM shaivasattamaH | chANDAlI kA samAkhyAtA tatkathAM kathaya prabho
verses.translation: "You are acting pervertedly. This violates the Vcdic path. Hence let your penis fall on the ground."
verses.hindi: और एकत्रित हो आपसमें कहने लगे

verses.sanskrit: कश्चिच्छूद्रवरस्तां वै विचरन्तीं निजेच्छया । दृष्ट्वा वने स्त्रियं चक्रे निनाय स्वगृहं ततः
verses.transliteration: kashchichChUdravarastAM vai vicharantIM nijechChayA | dR^iShTvA vane striyaM chakre ninAya svagR^ihaM tataH
verses.translation: When they said thus, the penis of that Avadhuta, who was Siva of wonderful form, fell down instantly,

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा पिशिताहारा नित्यमापीतवारुणी । अजीजनत्सुतां तेन शूद्रेण सुरतप्रिया
verses.transliteration: atha sA pishitAhArA nityamApItavAruNI | ajIjanatsutAM tena shUdreNa suratapriyA
verses.translation: That penis burnt everything in front; wherever it went it began to burn everything there.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिद्भर्तरि क्वापि याते पीतसुराथ सा । इयेष पिशिताहारं सौमिनी व्यभिचारिणी
verses.transliteration: kadAchidbhartari kvApi yAte pItasurAtha sA | iyeSha pishitAhAraM sauminI vyabhichAriNI
verses.translation: It went to Patala; it went to heaven; it went all over the earth; it never remained steady anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मेषेषु बद्धेषु गोभिः सह बहिर्व्रजे । निशामुखे तमोऽन्धे हि खड्गमादाय सा ययौ
verses.transliteration: tato meSheShu baddheShu gobhiH saha bahirvraje | nishAmukhe tamo.andhe hi khaDgamAdAya sA yayau
verses.translation: All the worlds and the people were distressed. The sages became grief-stricken. Whether gods or sages no one had any peace or joy.

verses.sanskrit: अविमृश्य मदावेशान्मेषबुद्ध्यामिषप्रिया । एकं जघान गोवत्सं क्रोशन्तमतिदुर्भगा
verses.transliteration: avimR^ishya madAveshAnmeShabuddhyAmiShapriyA | ekaM jaghAna govatsaM kroshantamatidurbhagA
verses.translation: All the gods and sages who did not recognize Siva became sad. They assembled together and hastened to Brahma and sought refuge in him.
verses.hindi: समन्वित हो उन्हें प्रणाम करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: हतं तं गृहमानीय ज्ञात्वा गोवत्समङ्गना । भीता शिव शिवेत्याह केनचित्पुण्यकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: hataM taM gR^ihamAnIya j~nAtvA govatsama~NganA | bhItA shiva shivetyAha kenachitpuNyakarmaNA
verses.translation: O brahmins, after going there, they bowed to and eulogised Brahma. They narrated what had happened to Brahma the Creator.
verses.hindi: ओर देख करके यह कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: सा मुहूर्तं शिवं ध्यात्वामिषभोजनलालसा । छित्त्वा तमेव गोवत्सं चकाराहारमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: sA muhUrtaM shivaM dhyAtvAmiShabhojanalAlasA | ChittvA tameva govatsaM chakArAhAramIpsitam
verses.translation: O brahmins, you though wise do such despicable things. Then why complain against the ignorant who act likewise?
verses.hindi: शिवका पूजनकर उन्हें प्राप्त कर लिया

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुतिथे काले गते सा सौमिनी द्विजाः । कालस्य वशमापन्ना जगाम यमसङ्क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: evaM bahutithe kAle gate sA sauminI dvijAH | kAlasya vashamApannA jagAma yamasa~NkShayam
verses.translation: Who can wish for happiness after offending and antagonising Siva thus? If a person does not welcome and serve a guest at midday, his virtue is taken away by the guest who in return deposits his sin in him. What then of Siva himself as a guest?

verses.sanskrit: यमोऽपि धर्ममालोक्य तस्याः कर्म च पौर्विकम् । निवर्त्य निरयावासाच्चक्रे चाण्डालजातिकाम्
verses.transliteration: yamo.api dharmamAlokya tasyAH karma cha paurvikam | nivartya nirayAvAsAchchakre chANDAlajAtikAm
verses.translation: As long as the penis does not become stationary there cannot be anything good in the three worlds. I am telling you the truth.
verses.hindi: नामसे साक्षात् नारायण ही अवतीर्ण होंगे

verses.sanskrit: साथ भ्रष्टा यमपुराच्चाण्डालीगर्भमाश्रिता । ततो बभूव जन्मान्धा प्रशान्ताङ्गारमेचका
verses.transliteration: sAtha bhraShTA yamapurAchchANDAlIgarbhamAshritA | tato babhUva janmAndhA prashAntA~NgAramechakA
verses.translation: O sages, you must do such things as will make the penis of 8iva steady. Please ponder over this in your minds.
verses.hindi: ' श्रीकर' नामसे महती लोकप्रसिद्धि प्राप्त करेगा

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । द्विजाः शृणुत सद्भक्त्या तां कथां परमाद्भुताम् । शिवप्रभावसम्मिश्रां शृण्वतां भक्तिवर्धिनीम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | dvijAH shR^iNuta sadbhaktyA tAM kathAM paramAdbhutAm | shivaprabhAvasammishrAM shR^iNvatAM bhaktivardhinIm
verses.translation: Thus urged, the sages bowed to Brahma and said—*'0 Brahma, what shall be done by us? Please guide us in that task."

verses.sanskrit: जन्मान्धा साथ बाल्येऽपि विध्वस्तपितृमातृका । ऊढा न केनचिद्दुष्टा महाकुष्ठरुजार्दिता
verses.transliteration: janmAndhA sAtha bAlye.api vidhvastapitR^imAtR^ikA | UDhA na kenachidduShTA mahAkuShTharujArditA
verses.translation: When the great sages asked him thus, Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, spoke to them.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षुधार्दिता दीना यष्टिपाणिर्गतेक्षणा । चाण्डालोच्छिष्टपिण्डेन जठराग्निमतर्पयत्
verses.transliteration: tataH kShudhArditA dInA yaShTipANirgatekShaNA | chANDAlochChiShTapiNDena jaTharAgnimatarpayat
verses.translation: Let the gods propitiate goddess Parvati and pray. If she can assume the form of the vaginal passage that penis will become steady-
verses.hindi: आख्यानं कथित स्वर्ग्य शिवभक्तिविवर्धनम्॥ ७८  आख्यानका वर्णन किया

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृच्छ्रेण महता नीत्वा स्वविपुलं वयः । जरया ग्रस्तसर्वाङ्गी दुःखमाप दुरत्ययम्
verses.transliteration: evaM kR^ichChreNa mahatA nItvA svavipulaM vayaH | jarayA grastasarvA~NgI duHkhamApa duratyayam
verses.translation: O excellent sages, listen. I shall tell you the mode of procedure. Act accordingly with love and devotion. She will be thus pleased.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे चतुर्थ्या कोटिरखसंहितायां महाकालज्योविर्लिंगमाहात्य्यवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तदशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्साथ चाण्डाली गोकर्णं तं महाजनान् । आयास्यन्त्यां शिवतिथौ गच्छतो बुबुधेऽध्वगान्
verses.transliteration: kadAchitsAtha chANDAlI gokarNaM taM mahAjanAn | AyAsyantyAM shivatithau gachChato bubudhe.adhvagAn
verses.translation: Make an eight-petalled mystic diagram of lotus and place a pot over it. Water from holy centres shall be poured into the pot along with the sprouts of Durva and barley.

verses.sanskrit: अथासावपि चाण्डाली वसनाशनतृष्णया । महाजनान् याचयितुं सञ्चचार शनैः शनैः
verses.transliteration: athAsAvapi chANDAlI vasanAshanatR^iShNayA | mahAjanAn yAchayituM sa~nchachAra shanaiH shanaiH
verses.translation: The pot shall be invoked with Vedic mantras. It shall be worshipped according to the Vedic rituals after remembering Siva.
verses.hindi: महाकालाख्यलिंगस्थ निजभक्तसुरक्षिण:॥ १  ज्योतिर्लिगकी अद्भुत कथा सुनायी

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्राथ चाण्डाली प्रार्थयन्ती महाजनान् । यत्र तत्र चचारासौ दीनवाक्प्रसृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: gatvA tatrAtha chANDAlI prArthayantI mahAjanAn | yatra tatra chachArAsau dInavAkprasR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: The penis shall be drenched with that water, O great sges. When the sprinkling is made with Satarudriya mantras it will become stable.

verses.sanskrit: एवमभ्यर्थयन्त्यास्तु चाण्डाल्याः प्रसृताञ्जलौ । एकः पुण्यतमः पान्थः प्राक्षिपद्विल्वमञ्जरीम्
verses.transliteration: evamabhyarthayantyAstu chANDAlyAH prasR^itA~njalau | ekaH puNyatamaH pAnthaH prAkShipadvilvama~njarIm
verses.translation: Parvati in the form of the Vaginal passage and an auspicious arrow shall form as the pedestal wherein the phallus shall be installed in accompaniment of the Vedic mantras.'*®

verses.sanskrit: तामञ्जलौ निपतितां सा विमृश्य पुनः पुनः । अभक्ष्यमिति मत्वाथ दूरे प्राक्षिपदातुरा
verses.transliteration: tAma~njalau nipatitAM sA vimR^ishya punaH punaH | abhakShyamiti matvAtha dUre prAkShipadAturA
verses.translation: Lord Siva shall be propitiated with the offerings of sweet scents, sandal paste, fragrant flowers, incense and other things as well as by food offerings and other forms of worship.
verses.hindi: इति भाव समास्थाय संस्थितो नारदाग्रत:॥ ६  नारदजीके समक्ष खड़ा हो गया

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः कराद्विनिर्मुक्ता रात्रौ सा बिल्वमञ्जरी । पपात कस्यचिद्दिष्ट्या शिवलिङ्गस्य मस्तके
verses.transliteration: tasyAH karAdvinirmuktA rAtrau sA bilvama~njarI | papAta kasyachiddiShTyA shivali~Ngasya mastake
verses.translation: With prostrations, holy hymns, musical instruments and songs he shall be propitiated further. Svastyayana mantras shall be repeated and the devotees shall proclaim the victory of the lord.
verses.hindi: स्थिर रहे; तब विन्ध्यने यह कहा--

verses.sanskrit: सैवं शिवचतुर्दश्यां रात्रौ पान्थजनान् मुहुः । याचमानापि यत्किञ्चिन्न लेभे दैवयोगतः
verses.transliteration: saivaM shivachaturdashyAM rAtrau pAnthajanAn muhuH | yAchamAnApi yatki~nchinna lebhe daivayogataH
verses.translation: The following prayer shall be recited—"O lord of

verses.sanskrit: चाण्डाली सा पूर्वभवेऽभवद् ब्राह्मणकन्यका । सौमिनी नाम चन्द्रास्या सर्वलक्षणसंयुता
verses.transliteration: chANDAlI sA pUrvabhave.abhavad brAhmaNakanyakA | sauminI nAma chandrAsyA sarvalakShaNasaMyutA
verses.translation: The pedestal shaped as the vagina and the phallus fixed therein are symbolical of the eternal creative forces personified as SivS and iSiva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं शिवचतुर्दश्या व्रतं जातं च निर्मलम् । अज्ञानतो जागरणं परमानन्ददायकम्
verses.transliteration: evaM shivachaturdashyA vrataM jAtaM cha nirmalam | aj~nAnato jAgaraNaM paramAnandadAyakam
verses.translation: You are the beginning of the universe, the origin

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभाते सा नारी शोकेन महतावृता । शनैर्निववृते दीना स्वदेशायैव केवलम्
verses.transliteration: tataH prabhAte sA nArI shokena mahatAvR^itA | shanairnivavR^ite dInA svadeshAyaiva kevalam
verses.translation: O brahmins, thus advised, the gods bow"d to Brahma and then sought refuge in iSiva with a desire for the happiness of the worlds.
verses.hindi: हूँ; मैं भक्तोंका मनोरथ पूर्ण करनेवाला हूँ

verses.sanskrit: श्रान्ता चिरोपवासेन निपतन्ती पदे पदे । अतीत्य तावतीं भूमिं निपपात विचेतना
verses.transliteration: shrAntA chiropavAsena nipatantI pade pade | atItya tAvatIM bhUmiM nipapAta vichetanA
verses.translation: When worshipped with great devotion and im¬

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा शम्भुकृपया जगाम परमं पदम् । आरुह्य सुविमानं च नीतं शिवगणैर्द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: atha sA shambhukR^ipayA jagAma paramaM padam | Aruhya suvimAnaM cha nItaM shivagaNairdrutam
verses.translation: O gods, O sages, you listen to my words with reverence. If my penis is supported in a vaginal passage there will be happiness.

verses.sanskrit: आदौ यदेषा शिवनाम नारी प्रमादतो वाप्यसती जगाद । तेनेह भूयः सुकृतेन विप्रा महाबलस्थानमवाप दिव्यम्
verses.transliteration: Adau yadeShA shivanAma nArI pramAdato vApyasatI jagAda | teneha bhUyaH sukR^itena viprA mahAbalasthAnamavApa divyam
verses.translation: Except Parvati, no other woman can hold my penis. Held by her my penis will immediately become quiet.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! आप यहीं स्थित रहें

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगोकर्णे शिवतिथावुपोष्य शिवमस्तके । कृत्वा जागरणं सा हि चक्रे बिल्वार्चनं निशि
verses.transliteration: shrIgokarNe shivatithAvupoShya shivamastake | kR^itvA jAgaraNaM sA hi chakre bilvArchanaM nishi
verses.translation: O great sages, on hearing those words the delighted sages and the gods took Brahma with them and prayed to Parvatl.
verses.hindi: लोककल्याणके लिये प्रेमपूर्वक वैसा ही किया

verses.sanskrit: अकामतः कृतस्यास्य पुण्यस्यैव च तत्फलम् । भुनक्त्यद्यापि सा चैव महाबलप्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: akAmataH kR^itasyAsya puNyasyaiva cha tatphalam | bhunaktyadyApi sA chaiva mahAbalaprasAdataH
verses.translation: After propitiating Parvati and the bull-bannered lord and performing the rites mentioned before, the excellent penis became static.

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधं महालिङ्गं शङ्करस्य महाबलम् । सर्वपापहरं सद्यः परमानन्ददायकम्
verses.transliteration: evaMvidhaM mahAli~NgaM sha~Nkarasya mahAbalam | sarvapApaharaM sadyaH paramAnandadAyakam
verses.translation: The gods and the sages propitiated Parvati and Siva by the mode of procedure laid down in the Vedas for the sake of virtue.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वः कथितं विप्रा माहात्म्यं परमं मया । महाबलाभिधानस्य शिवलिङ्गवरस्य हि
verses.transliteration: evaM vaH kathitaM viprA mAhAtmyaM paramaM mayA | mahAbalAbhidhAnasya shivali~Ngavarasya hi
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and oiher gods, sages and the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings worshipped l§iva particularly.
verses.hindi: अतः पर्र प्रवक्ष्यामि केदारं लिंगमुत्तमम्॥ २७  करूँगा

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यदपि वक्ष्यामि माहात्म्यं तस्य चाद्भुतम् । श्रुतमात्रेण येनाशु शिवे भक्तिः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: athAnyadapi vakShyAmi mAhAtmyaM tasya chAdbhutam | shrutamAtreNa yenAshu shive bhaktiH prajAyate
verses.translation: Siva became delighted and so also Parvati, the mother of the universe. That phallus was held by her in that form then.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा समये कन्या युवतिः सौमिनी द्विजाः । पित्रा दत्ता च कस्मैचिद्विधिना द्विजसूनवे
verses.transliteration: atha sA samaye kanyA yuvatiH sauminI dvijAH | pitrA dattA cha kasmaichidvidhinA dvijasUnave
verses.translation: Here everything will flourish in plenty conferring supreme happiness and bliss. Hereafter it will bestow final liberatiovi. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: सा भर्तारमनुप्राप्य किञ्चित्कालं शुभव्रता । रेमे तेन द्विजश्रेष्ठा नवयौवनशालिनी
verses.transliteration: sA bhartAramanuprApya ki~nchitkAlaM shubhavratA | reme tena dvijashreShThA navayauvanashAlinI
verses.translation: O brahmins, it has been narrated to you how Siva came to be worshipped in the three worlds in the form of a phallic image. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्याः पतिर्विप्रस्तरुणः सुरुजार्दितः । सौमिन्याः कालयोगात्तु पञ्चत्वमगमद् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: atha tasyAH patirviprastaruNaH surujArditaH | sauminyAH kAlayogAttu pa~nchatvamagamad dvijAH
verses.translation: O holy lord, please narrate the glory of the phallic image known as AndhakeSvara. Similarly it behoves you to mention the glory of other phallic images willingly.
verses.hindi: महेश्वर सदाशिव ज्योतिरूपसे विराजमान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: मृते भर्तरि सा नारी दुःखितातिविषण्णधीः । किञ्चित्कालं शुभाचारा सुशीलोवास सद्मनि
verses.transliteration: mR^ite bhartari sA nArI duHkhitAtiviShaNNadhIH | ki~nchitkAlaM shubhAchArA sushIlovAsa sadmani
verses.translation: Formerly the Asura Andhaka resorted to the deep ditch of the ocean and kept the three worlds under his con¬ trol. He harrassed the gods.
verses.hindi: अपने भक्तोंका मनोरथ पूर्ण करनेवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा मन्मथाविष्टहृदया विधवापि च । युवावस्थाविशेषेण बभूव व्यभिचारिणी
verses.transliteration: tataH sA manmathAviShTahR^idayA vidhavApi cha | yuvAvasthAvisheSheNa babhUva vyabhichAriNI
verses.translation: He used to come out of the ditch and harrass the people. Then he of great exploit re-entered the ditch.
verses.hindi: भगवान्  शंकरकी नित्य पूजा को जाती है

verses.sanskrit: तज्ज्ञात्वा गोत्रिणस्तस्या दुष्कर्म कुलदूषणम् । समेतास्तत्यजुर्दूरं नीत्वा तां सकचग्रहाम्
verses.transliteration: tajj~nAtvA gotriNastasyA duShkarma kuladUShaNam | sametAstatyajurdUraM nItvA tAM sakachagrahAm
verses.translation: O great sages, the gods were grief-stricken. Implor¬ ing Siva again and again, they mentioned their miseries to him.
verses.hindi: पीकर मनुष्य पुनर्जन्म नहीं पाता है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: I shall slay that Asura Andhaka, the murderer of the gods. O gods, proceed with the army. I too sh&Il come along with the Gaas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: I shall slay that Asura Andhaka, the murderer of the gods. O gods, proceed with the army. I too sh&Il come along with the Gaas.
verses.hindi: दा वतलात्य कया उतरा आपलोग आदरपूर्वक सुनिये; मैं कह रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । महाबलाह्वशिवलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । श्रीमतीक्ष्वाकुवंशे हि राजा परमधार्मिकः । आसीन्मित्रसहो नाम श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.10\. dashamo.adhyAyaH | mahAbalAhvashivali~NgamAhAtmyavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | shrImatIkShvAkuvaMshe hi rAjA paramadhArmikaH | AsInmitrasaho nAma shreShThaH sarvadhanuShmatAm
verses.translation: Attacked and tormented by the gods, the Asura returned to the ditch when he was pierced through with the trident by Siva, the supreme soul.
verses.hindi: नामका एक बड़ा बलवान राक्षस हुआ था

verses.sanskrit: गुरुरुवाच । धिक् त्वां नरामिषं राजंस्त्वयैतच्छद्मकारिणा । खलेनोपहृतं मह्यं ततो रक्षो भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: gururuvAcha | dhik tvAM narAmiShaM rAjaMstvayaitachChadmakAriNA | khalenopahR^itaM mahyaM tato rakSho bhaviShyasi
verses.translation: The Asuras and the gods fought a terrible battle. By the blessings of Siva, the gods became very strong.
verses.hindi: साथ सह्य पर्वतपर निवास करता था

verses.sanskrit: स राजानुचितं शापं विज्ञाय क्रोधमूर्छितः । जलाञ्जलिं समादाय गुरुं शप्तुं समुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: sa rAjAnuchitaM shApaM vij~nAya krodhamUrChitaH | jalA~njaliM samAdAya guruM shaptuM samudyataH
verses.translation: Attacked and tormented by the gods, the Asura returned to the ditch when he was pierced through with the trident by Siva, the supreme soul.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षःकृतं च विज्ञाय तदैवं स गुरुस्तदा । पुनर्विमृश्य तं शापं चकार द्वादशाब्दिकम्
verses.transliteration: rakShaHkR^itaM cha vij~nAya tadaivaM sa gurustadA | punarvimR^ishya taM shApaM chakAra dvAdashAbdikam
verses.translation: Remaining there he meditated on Siva and prayed —*'On seeing you at the hour of death, one becomes identi> cal with you instantaneously.*'
verses.hindi: ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तत्सर्व यथार्थ त्वं बदाधुना॥ ८  ठीक-ठीक बताओ

verses.sanskrit: तदा च तत्प्रिया साध्वी मदयन्ती सुधर्मिणी । पतित्वा पादयोस्तस्य शापं तं हि न्यवारयत्
verses.transliteration: tadA cha tatpriyA sAdhvI madayantI sudharmiNI | patitvA pAdayostasya shApaM taM hi nyavArayat
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted Siva spoke to him— "Mention the boon you wish to have. I shall grant it to you."
verses.hindi: हाथ ऊपर उठाकर एक पैरपर स्थित रहा

verses.sanskrit: ततो निवृत्तशापस्तु तस्या वचनगौरवात् । तत्याज पादयोरम्भः पादौ कल्मषतां गतौ
verses.transliteration: tato nivR^ittashApastu tasyA vachanagauravAt | tatyAja pAdayorambhaH pAdau kalmaShatAM gatau
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the Asura said again after bowing to and eulogising Siva with pious feelings.
verses.hindi: जलते हुए देवता ब्रह्माजीकी शरणमें गये

verses.sanskrit: ततःप्रभृति राजा भूत्स लोकेऽस्मिन्मुनीश्वराः । कल्मषाङ्घ्रिरिति ख्यातः प्रभावात्तज्जलस्य हि
verses.transliteration: tataHprabhR^iti rAjA bhUtsa loke.asminmunIshvarAH | kalmaShA~Nghririti khyAtaH prabhAvAttajjalasya hi
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted grant me the auspicious devotion to you. Taking unusual compassion on me, be stationed here.
verses.hindi: उसके अनन्तर वे ब्रह्माजीसे अपना दु:ख कहने लगे

verses.sanskrit: राजा मित्रसहः शापाद् गुरोरॄषिवरस्य हि । बभूव राक्षसो घोरो हिंसको वनगोचरः
verses.transliteration: rAjA mitrasahaH shApAd gurorR^IShivarasya hi | babhUva rAkShaso ghoro hiMsako vanagocharaH
verses.translation: Requested thus, Siva hurled that Asura into that ditch. He himself stood there in the form of a phallic image with a desire to help the world.

verses.sanskrit: स बिभ्रद्राक्षसं रूपं कालान्तकयमोपमम् । चखाद विविधाञ्जन्तून् मानुषादीन्वनेचरः
verses.transliteration: sa bibhradrAkShasaM rUpaM kAlAntakayamopamam | chakhAda vividhA~njantUn mAnuShAdInvanecharaH
verses.translation: If a man worships AndhakeSa every day, his desires are fulfilled within six months.

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचिद्वने क्वापि रममाणौ किशोरकौ । अपश्यदन्तकाकारो नवोढौ मुनिदम्पती
verses.transliteration: sa kadAchidvane kvApi ramamANau kishorakau | apashyadantakAkAro navoDhau munidampatI
verses.translation: The brahmin who worships the beneficent phal¬ lic image for his livelihood for six months becomes a Devalaka, the worshipper of idol for subsistence. He is not authorised in ordinary rites of brahmins.
verses.hindi: यह वचन सुनकर उस राक्षसने कहा--

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसः स नराहारः किशोरं मुनिनन्दनम् । जग्धुं जग्राह शापार्त्तो व्याघ्रो मृगशिशुं यथा
verses.transliteration: rAkShasaH sa narAhAraH kishoraM muninandanam | jagdhuM jagrAha shApArtto vyAghro mR^igashishuM yathA
verses.translation: Then it happened that Dadhici had to go and live in another village along with his kinsmen. The kinsmen did not let him go back.
verses.hindi: देना चाहते हैं, तो आज मुझे अप्रतिम बल दीजिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य राज्ञः सुधर्मिष्ठा मदयन्ती प्रिया शुभा । दमयन्ती नलस्येव बभूव विदिता सती
verses.transliteration: tasya rAj~naH sudharmiShThA madayantI priyA shubhA | damayantI nalasyeva babhUva viditA satI
verses.translation: While leaving home, Dadhici, the excellent devotee, had already instructed his son, "Be devoted to Siva."

verses.sanskrit: कक्षे गृहीतं भर्तारं दृष्ट्वा भीता च तत्प्रिया । सा चक्रे प्रार्थनां तस्मै वदती करुणं वचः
verses.transliteration: kakShe gR^ihItaM bhartAraM dR^iShTvA bhItA cha tatpriyA | sA chakre prArthanAM tasmai vadatI karuNaM vachaH
verses.translation: Sudarsana's son also worshipped Siva. O great sages, thus a long time elapsed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थ्यमानोऽपि बहुशः पुरुषादः स निर्घृणः । चखाद शिर उत्कृत्य विप्रसूनोर्दुराशयः
verses.transliteration: prArthyamAno.api bahushaH puruShAdaH sa nirghR^iNaH | chakhAda shira utkR^itya viprasUnordurAshayaH
verses.translation: So, once it happened that on a Sivaratri occa¬ sion when all observed fast, Sudarana had his sexual inter¬ course with his wife and then performed the worship. But before he performed the worship he abstained from taking bath. For this misdeed Siva was infuriated and said.

verses.sanskrit: अथ साध्वी च सा दीना विलप्य भृशदुःखिता । आहृत्य भर्तुरस्थीनि चितां चक्रे किलोल्बणाम्
verses.transliteration: atha sAdhvI cha sA dInA vilapya bhR^ishaduHkhitA | AhR^itya bharturasthIni chitAM chakre kilolbaNAm
verses.translation: O knave, you had sexual intercourse with your wife on the occasion of Sivaratri. Without taking bath you performed the worship. You are an indiscreet fellow.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा और विष्णुको आगेकर शंकरकी शरणमें गये

verses.sanskrit: भर्तारमनुगच्छन्ती संविशन्ती हुताशनम् । राजानं राक्षसाकारं सा शशाप द्विजाङ्गना
verses.transliteration: bhartAramanugachChantI saMvishantI hutAshanam | rAjAnaM rAkShasAkAraM sA shashApa dvijA~NganA
verses.translation: Because you have done this consciously, be sluggish and insensible. You are an untouchable person for me. Avoid touching me.
verses.hindi: माँगिये; मैं आपलोगोंका कौन-सा कार्य करूँ ?

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति नारीषु यदा त्वं सङ्गतो भवेः । तदा मृतिस्तवेत्युक्त्वा विवेश ज्वलनं सती
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhR^iti nArIShu yadA tvaM sa~Ngato bhaveH | tadA mR^itistavetyuktvA vivesha jvalanaM satI
verses.translation: Cursed thus by lord Siva, Sudariana, the son of Dadhici, attained insensibility immediately, deluded by Siva's. Maya.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि राजा गुरोः शापमनुभूय कृतावधिम् । पुनः स्वरूपमास्थाय स्वगृहं मुदितो ययौ
verses.transliteration: so.api rAjA guroH shApamanubhUya kR^itAvadhim | punaH svarUpamAsthAya svagR^ihaM mudito yayau
verses.translation: O brahmins, meanwhile Dadhici, the excellent devotee of Siva, returned from the other village and heard the details.
verses.hindi: होकर देवताओंको निरन्तर पीड़ा पहुँचा रहा है

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा विप्रसतीशापं मदयन्ती रतिप्रियम् । पतिं निवारयामास वैधव्यादतिबिभ्यती
verses.transliteration: j~nAtvA viprasatIshApaM madayantI ratipriyam | patiM nivArayAmAsa vaidhavyAdatibibhyatI
verses.translation: Dadhici, honoured amongst the good, grumbled

verses.sanskrit: अनपत्यो विनिर्विण्णो राज्यभोगेषु पार्थिवः । विसृज्य सकलां लक्ष्मीं वनमेव जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: anapatyo vinirviNNo rAjyabhogeShu pArthivaH | visR^ijya sakalAM lakShmIM vanameva jagAma ha
verses.translation: The father then worshipped Parvati with excellent rites, sincere devotion and perseverance for the happiness of his son.
verses.hindi: महर्षयश्च ते सर्वे ययु: शीघ्र निजाभ्रमान्॥ ६७  ही अपने-अपने आश्रमोंको चले गये

verses.sanskrit: स्वपृष्ठतः समायान्तीं ब्रह्महत्यां सुदुःखदाम् । ददर्श विकटाकारां तर्जयन्तीं मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: svapR^iShThataH samAyAntIM brahmahatyAM suduHkhadAm | dadarsha vikaTAkArAM tarjayantIM muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: Sudarana himself performed the worship of Parvati with great devotion adopting the path of Gao(jll worship and with auspicious hymns.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या निर्भद्रमन्विच्छन् राजा निर्विण्णमानसः । चकार नानोपायान्स जपव्रतमखादिकान्
verses.transliteration: tasyA nirbhadramanvichChan rAjA nirviNNamAnasaH | chakAra nAnopAyAnsa japavratamakhAdikAn
verses.translation: Thus by various means and with sincere devotion the father and the son propitiated the goddess Parvati who is favourably disposed towards her devotees.
verses.hindi: भीयासुरकृतोपद्रववर्णन नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: स एकदा हि मृगयास्नेही मित्रसहो नृपः । महद्बलेन संयुक्तो जगाम गहनं वनम्
verses.transliteration: sa ekadA hi mR^igayAsnehI mitrasaho nR^ipaH | mahadbalena saMyukto jagAma gahanaM vanam
verses.translation: Then realising that lord l3iva the bull-bannered deity was delighted, she bowed to him herself and placed the son on his lap.
verses.hindi: लिंगके आगे गहन ध्यान करना प्रारम्भ किया

verses.sanskrit: नानोपायैर्यदा राज्ञस्तीर्थस्नानादिभिर्द्विजाः । न निवृत्ता ब्रह्महत्या मिथिलां स ययौ तदा
verses.transliteration: nAnopAyairyadA rAj~nastIrthasnAnAdibhirdvijAH | na nivR^ittA brahmahatyA mithilAM sa yayau tadA
verses.translation: For the sake of her adopted son she herself implored iva. iva who was angry had become quite calm. The son also was delighted.
verses.hindi: राजा ह्ाभिचारिकम्॥ ३  राजा आपके निमित्त कुछ अभिचारकर्म कर रहा है

verses.sanskrit: अभिसृत्य स राजेन्द्रो गौतमं विमलाशयम् । तद्दर्शनाप्तकिञ्चित्कः प्रणनाम मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: abhisR^itya sa rAjendro gautamaM vimalAshayam | taddarshanAptaki~nchitkaH praNanAma muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: Then realising that lord l3iva the bull-bannered deity was delighted, she bowed to him herself and placed the son on his lap.
verses.hindi: गृहीत्वा करवालं च जगाम नृपतिं प्रति॥ ४ राजाके समीप गया

verses.sanskrit: बाह्योद्यानगतस्तस्याश्चिन्तया परयार्दितः । ददर्श मुनिमायान्तं गौतमं पार्थिवश्च सः
verses.transliteration: bAhyodyAnagatastasyAshchintayA parayArditaH | dadarsha munimAyAntaM gautamaM pArthivashcha saH
verses.translation: Making the ablution of the son with ghee, Parvati handed over to her son Sudarana the three-stringed sacred thiead with a single knot and imparted instruction in SivagayatrP consisting of sixteen syllables.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तत्पृष्टकुशलो दीर्घमुष्णं च निःश्वसन् । तत्कृपादृष्टिसम्प्राप्तसुखः प्रोवाच तं नृपः
verses.transliteration: atha tatpR^iShTakushalo dIrghamuShNaM cha niHshvasan | tatkR^ipAdR^iShTisamprAptasukhaH provAcha taM nR^ipaH
verses.translation: Then the brahmin boy performed the Sarhkal- papuja (worship by mental conception) sixteen times with the five-syllabled mantra with the word Sri prefixed to!iva.
verses.hindi: हूँ कि आप मेरा कल्याण कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच । मुने मां बाधते ह्येषा ब्रह्महत्या दुरत्यया । अलक्षिता परैस्तात तर्जयन्ती पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: rAjovAcha | mune mAM bAdhate hyeShA brahmahatyA duratyayA | alakShitA paraistAta tarjayantI pade pade
verses.translation: Beginning with ceremonial ablution and ending with the concluding obeisance he worshipped the bull-ban¬ nered deity by means of devotional mantras, musical instruments and adorations in the presence of the sages. He recited various names of Siva. Then the delighted Siva and
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिवका भजन कर रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: यन्मया शापदग्धेन विप्रपुत्रश्च भक्षितः । तत्पापस्य न शान्तिर्हि प्रायश्चित्तसहस्रकैः
verses.transliteration: yanmayA shApadagdhena vipraputrashcha bhakShitaH | tatpApasya na shAntirhi prAyashchittasahasrakaiH
verses.translation: "Wealth, foodgrain etc. whatever is offered to me shall be taken by you. There is no sin in this action.
verses.hindi: रावण-ने दासकी भाँति स्थापित किया था

verses.sanskrit: नानोपायाः कृता मे हि तच्छान्त्यै भ्रमता मुने । न निवृत्ता ब्रह्महत्या मम पापात्मनः किमु
verses.transliteration: nAnopAyAH kR^itA me hi tachChAntyai bhramatA mune | na nivR^ittA brahmahatyA mama pApAtmanaH kimu
verses.translation: In the rites concerning me you will officiate as the chief, especially so in the rites concerning the goddess. Ghee, oil etc., everything offered to me shall be taken by you.
verses.hindi: रहो, अन्यथा कभी नहीं कर सकोगे

verses.sanskrit: अद्य मे जन्मसाफल्यं सम्प्राप्तमिव लक्षये । यतस्त्वद्दर्शनादेव ममानन्दभरोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: adya me janmasAphalyaM samprAptamiva lakShaye | yatastvaddarshanAdeva mamAnandabharo.abhavat
verses.translation: The Tilaka must be made round. Then you shall take bath. Sandhya prayers to liva shall be offered and his Gayatri repeated.
verses.hindi: मैं तुम्हारे स्वामीको तीक्ष्ण चपेटा मारूँगा

verses.sanskrit: अद्य मे तव पादाब्जशरणस्य कृतैनसः । शान्तिं कुरु महाभाग येनाहं सुखमाप्नुयाम्
verses.transliteration: adya me tava pAdAbjasharaNasya kR^itainasaH | shAntiM kuru mahAbhAga yenAhaM sukhamApnuyAm
verses.translation: After rendering service to me at the outset, the other rites shall be performed according to the family tradition. When everything is thus performed there shall be welfare. Your blemishes have been excused by me.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति राज्ञा समादिष्टो गौतमः करुणार्द्रधीः । समादिदेश घोराणामघानां साधु निष्कृतिम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti rAj~nA samAdiShTo gautamaH karuNArdradhIH | samAdidesha ghorANAmaghAnAM sAdhu niShkR^itim
verses.translation: After saying this, the supreme soul 2§iva consecrated his four sons as Vatukas in the four quarters.
verses.hindi: मैं और तुम्हारा वह स्वामी परस्पर युद्ध करेंगे

verses.sanskrit: विहरंस्तत्र स नृपः कमठाह्वं निशाचरम् । निजघान महादुष्टं साधुपीडाकरं खलम्
verses.transliteration: viharaMstatra sa nR^ipaH kamaThAhvaM nishAcharam | nijaghAna mahAduShTaM sAdhupIDAkaraM khalam
verses.translation: After keeping Sudarsana as her son with herself she granted boons to his sons and blessed them in several ways.
verses.hindi: हो, उसमें तुम समर्थ कहाँसे हुए हो ?

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । साधु राजेन्द्र धन्योऽसि महाघेभ्यो भयं त्यज । शिवे शास्तरि भक्तानां क्व भयं शरणैषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | sAdhu rAjendra dhanyo.asi mahAghebhyo bhayaM tyaja | shive shAstari bhaktAnAM kva bhayaM sharaNaiShiNAm
verses.translation: Between you two whoever becomes my Vafuka shall be victorious. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: शृणु राजन्महाभाग क्षेत्रमन्यत्प्रतिष्ठितम् । महापातकसंहारि गोकर्णाख्यं शिवालयम्
verses.transliteration: shR^iNu rAjanmahAbhAga kShetramanyatpratiShThitam | mahApAtakasaMhAri gokarNAkhyaM shivAlayam
verses.translation: He who worships you has worshipped me too. You shall perform your duties always, O son.
verses.hindi: उसकी तलवारके दो टुकड़े कर दिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थितिर्न पापानां महद्भ्यो महतामपि । महाबलाभिधानेन शिवः सन्निहितः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra sthitirna pApAnAM mahadbhyo mahatAmapi | mahAbalAbhidhAnena shivaH sannihitaH svayam
verses.translation: Thus boons were granted to the noble Sudarsana and his sons by Siva and Siva out of pity for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.hindi: बाणोंसे उसके भी लाखों टुकड़े कर दिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां शिवलिङ्गानां सार्वभौमो महाबलः । चतुर्युगे चतुर्वर्णः सर्वपापापहारकः
verses.transliteration: sarveShAM shivali~NgAnAM sArvabhaumo mahAbalaH | chaturyuge chaturvarNaH sarvapApApahArakaH
verses.translation: Because they had been established by Siva and Siva they are known as Vatukas. Those who neglect penance are known s Tapodhamas.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमाम्बुधितीरस्थं गोकर्णं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । तत्रास्ति शिवलिङ्गं तन्महापातकनाशकम्
verses.transliteration: pashchimAmbudhitIrasthaM gokarNaM tIrthamuttamam | tatrAsti shivali~NgaM tanmahApAtakanAshakam
verses.translation: Thanks to the mercy of Siva and Siva they

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा महापापाः स्नात्वा तीर्थेषु भूरिशः । महाबलं च सम्पूज्य प्रयाताः शाङ्करं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvA mahApApAH snAtvA tIrtheShu bhUrishaH | mahAbalaM cha sampUjya prayAtAH shA~NkaraM padam
verses.translation: No worship shall be performed by any person as long as he has not performed Siva's worship. If it is performed it does not turn out to be auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: तथा त्वमपि राजेन्द्र गोकर्णं गिरिशालयम् । गत्वा सम्पूज्य तल्लिङ्गं कृतकृत्यत्वमाप्नुयाः
verses.transliteration: tathA tvamapi rAjendra gokarNaM girishAlayam | gatvA sampUjya talli~NgaM kR^itakR^ityatvamApnuyAH
verses.translation: Whether auspicious or inauspicious, the Vatuka is not to be eschewed. In the Prajapatya rite and at the feast a single Vatu is considered excellent.
verses.hindi: है ? अत: आप शीघ्र ही इसका वध कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सर्वेषु तीर्थेषु स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य महाबलम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोकं त्वमाप्नुयाः
verses.transliteration: tatra sarveShu tIrtheShu snAtvAbhyarchya mahAbalam | sarvapApavinirmuktaH shivalokaM tvamApnuyAH
verses.translation: In the rites of Siva and Siva this difference is marked. O intelligent one, hear the same. O faultless one, I shall explain it now.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्यादिष्टः स मुनिना गौतमेन महात्मना । महाहृष्टमना राजा गोकर्णं प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityAdiShTaH sa muninA gautamena mahAtmanA | mahAhR^iShTamanA rAjA gokarNaM pratyapadyata
verses.translation: I shall explain in the manner I have heard, the event that happened in the city of king Bhadra near the shrine of AndhakeSa during the daily rite of feasting in the Prajapatya rite.
verses.hindi: तथा शिवेन क्रुद्धेन राक्षसानां बल॑ क्षणात्॥ ४५  शक्षस्रोंकी सेनाको क्षणभरमें जला डाला

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थेषु सुस्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य महाबलम् । निर्धूताशेषपापौघोऽलभच्छम्भोः परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tIrtheShu susnAtvA samabhyarchya mahAbalam | nirdhUtAsheShapApaugho.alabhachChambhoH paraM padam
verses.translation: The banner will be raised and bound in the morning. It will fall down in the night. This will happen when the Prajapatya rite is full and complete. Otherwise this banner will remain steady even during the night. After saying this to the king, the delighted Siva, the storehouse of mercy, vanished.
verses.hindi: कप ; उसका नाम भी कहीं सुनायी नहीं पड़ता था

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्यानुजः पापी जयेयं छद्मनैव तम् । मत्वा जगाम नृपतेरन्तिकं छद्मकारकः
verses.transliteration: atha tasyAnujaH pApI jayeyaM Chadmanaiva tam | matvA jagAma nR^ipaterantikaM ChadmakArakaH
verses.translation: O great sage, the king adopted the procedure accordingly. The Prajapatya rite was performed every day in accordance with the rules of Siva-worship.
verses.hindi: और सारा जगत् स्वस्थ हो गया

verses.sanskrit: य इमां शृणुयान्नित्यं महाबलकथां प्रियाम् । त्रिसप्तकुलजैः सार्धं शिवलोके व्रजत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: ya imAM shR^iNuyAnnityaM mahAbalakathAM priyAm | trisaptakulajaiH sArdhaM shivaloke vrajatyasau
verses.translation: If the rites became full and complete, the banner rose up itself in the morning and fell down during the night.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण भस्म वनमें सभी जगह व्याप्त हो गयी

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्यातं माहात्म्यं परमाद्भुतम् । महाबलस्य गिरिशलिङ्गस्य निखिलाघहृत्
verses.transliteration: iti vashcha samAkhyAtaM mAhAtmyaM paramAdbhutam | mahAbalasya girishali~Ngasya nikhilAghahR^it
verses.translation: On one occasion the function of the Vatu took place in the beginning. The banner then fell even before the feast.
verses.hindi: तथा वेष भिन्‍न-भिन्‍न रूपमें बदल जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: तं विनम्राकृतिं दृष्ट्वा भृत्यतां कर्तुमागतम् । चक्रे महानसाध्यक्षमज्ञानात्स महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: taM vinamrAkR^itiM dR^iShTvA bhR^ityatAM kartumAgatam | chakre mahAnasAdhyakShamaj~nAnAtsa mahIpatiH
verses.translation: On seeing it there, the learned men were asked by the king. The brahmins are at their feast. Why is the banner not flying?
verses.hindi: है, जो उन औषधियोंसे न होता हो

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्मिन्वने राजा कियत्कालं विहृत्य सः । निवृत्तो मृगयां हित्वा स्वपुरीमाययौ मुदा
verses.transliteration: atha tasminvane rAjA kiyatkAlaM vihR^itya saH | nivR^itto mR^igayAM hitvA svapurImAyayau mudA
verses.translation: How did it fall down? O brahmins, tell me the truth. Thus asked the brahmins, the excellent scholars, said.
verses.hindi: तत्रैवास्थितवान्द्रीत्या स्वतन्त्रो भक्तवत्सल:॥ ५४  शिवजी प्रेमपूर्वक वहींपर स्थित हो गये

verses.sanskrit: पितुः क्षयाहे सम्प्राप्ते निमन्त्र्य स्वगुरुं नृपः । वसिष्ठं गृहमानिन्ये भोजयामास भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: pituH kShayAhe samprApte nimantrya svaguruM nR^ipaH | vasiShThaM gR^ihamAninye bhojayAmAsa bhaktitaH
verses.translation: "O great king, while feasting the brahmins
verses.hindi: उप्तके माहात्यका वर्णन नायक इक्कीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: रक्षसा सूदरूपेण सम्मिश्रितनरामिषम् । शाकामिषं पुरः क्षिप्तं दृष्ट्वा गुरुरथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: rakShasA sUdarUpeNa sammishritanarAmiSham | shAkAmiShaM puraH kShiptaM dR^iShTvA gururathAbravIt
verses.translation: On hearing it, the king and the people were surprised. They praised them.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: .They shall conclude the worship with the remarks, "Let the worship be complete." This alone is their work. Nothing else.
verses.hindi: नगरको शिवजीने पुरुषके समीप भेज दिया

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: .They shall conclude the worship with the remarks, "Let the worship be complete." This alone is their work. Nothing else.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.११. एकादशोऽध्यायः । चन्द्रभालपशुपतिनाथलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सूत महाभाग धन्यस्त्वं शिवसक्तधीः । महाबलस्य लिङ्गस्य श्रावितेयं कथाद्भुता
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.11\. ekAdasho.adhyAyaH | chandrabhAlapashupatinAthali~NgamAhAtmyavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | sUta sUta mahAbhAga dhanyastvaM shivasaktadhIH | mahAbalasya li~Ngasya shrAviteyaM kathAdbhutA
verses.translation: O great sages, the greatness of Jyotirlingas cannot be adequately described even in hundreds of years. Still I shall tell you.
verses.hindi: समय कुछ भी दिखायी नहीं पड़ता था

verses.sanskrit: दाधीचं शिवलिङ्गं तु मिश्रर्षिवरतीर्थके । दधीचिना मुनीशेन सुप्रीत्या च प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: dAdhIchaM shivali~NgaM tu mishrarShivaratIrthake | dadhIchinA munIshena suprItyA cha pratiShThitam
verses.translation: O brahmins, please listen, I shall narrate its great¬ ness and origin succinctly in the manner I have heard from my good preceptor, to the extent of my intellect.

verses.sanskrit: दधीचमूर्तिस्तत्रैव समर्च्या विधिपूर्वकम् । शिवप्रीत्यर्थमेवाशु तीर्थयात्राफलार्थिभिः
verses.transliteration: dadhIchamUrtistatraiva samarchyA vidhipUrvakam | shivaprItyarthamevAshu tIrthayAtrAphalArthibhiH
verses.translation: O great sages, the greatness of Jyotirlingas cannot be adequately described even in hundreds of years. Still I shall tell you.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा च तत्तीर्थे स्नात्वा सम्यग्विधानतः । शिवलिङ्गं समर्चेद्वै दाधीचेश्वरमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvA cha tattIrthe snAtvA samyagvidhAnataH | shivali~NgaM samarchedvai dAdhIcheshvaramAdarAt
verses.translation: O great sages, his daughters, twenty-seven in number, Avini and others, were given in marriage to the moon by Daka, the great soul.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कृतकृत्यो भवेन्नरः । इह सर्वसुखं भुक्त्वा परत्र गतिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: evaM kR^ite munishreShThAH kR^itakR^ityo bhavennaraH | iha sarvasukhaM bhuktvA paratra gatimApnuyAt
verses.translation: On securing the moon as their lord, those daughters shone extraordinarily. The moon too, on securing them shone incessantly.

verses.sanskrit: नैमिषारण्यतीर्थे तु निखिलर्षिप्रतिष्ठितम् । ऋषीश्वरमिति ख्यातं शिवलिङ्गं सुखप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: naimiShAraNyatIrthe tu nikhilarShipratiShThitam | R^iShIshvaramiti khyAtaM shivali~NgaM sukhapradam
verses.translation: The jewel shines with gold and the gold shines with the jewel. Now listen to what happened in due course.
verses.hindi: शिवजी उसे अपने त्रिशूलपर धारण करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: तद्दर्शनात्पूजनाच्च जनानां पापिनामपि । भुक्तिर्मुक्तिश्च तेषां तु परत्रेह मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: taddarshanAtpUjanAchcha janAnAM pApinAmapi | bhuktirmuktishcha teShAM tu paratreha munIshvarAH
verses.translation: Out of his twenty-seven wives he did not love any one so much at anytime as he loved Rohinl.
verses.hindi: सर्वोत्तम सायुज्य मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है

verses.sanskrit: हत्याहरणतीर्थे तु शिवलिङ्गमघापहम् । पूजनीयं विशेषेण हत्याकोटिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: hatyAharaNatIrthe tu shivali~NgamaghApaham | pUjanIyaM visheSheNa hatyAkoTivinAshanam
verses.translation: The others became distressed and sought refuge in their father. After going to him they mentioned their misery to him.

verses.sanskrit: देवप्रयागतीर्थे तु ललितेश्वरनामकम् । शिवलिङ्गं सदा पूज्यं नरैः सर्वाघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: devaprayAgatIrthe tu laliteshvaranAmakam | shivali~NgaM sadA pUjyaM naraiH sarvAghanAshanam
verses.translation: O storehouse of digits, you are born of a noble family. How can you cherish oddity in your affection towards your dependents?
verses.hindi: यह नगरी सर्वदा भोग एवं मोक्षको देनेवाली है

verses.sanskrit: नयपालाख्यपुर्यां तु प्रसिद्धायां महीतले । लिङ्गं पशुपतीशाख्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: nayapAlAkhyapuryAM tu prasiddhAyAM mahItale | li~NgaM pashupatIshAkhyaM sarvakAmaphalapradam
verses.translation: After requesting the moon, his son-in-law, thus, Daksa returned to his abode fully assured.

verses.sanskrit: शिरोभागस्वरूपेण शिवलिङ्गं तदस्ति हि । तत्कथां वर्णयिष्यामि केदारेश्वरवर्णने
verses.transliteration: shirobhAgasvarUpeNa shivali~NgaM tadasti hi | tatkathAM varNayiShyAmi kedAreshvaravarNane
verses.translation: The moon did not act according to his advice being deluded by Siva's Maya which deludes the universe.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरस्यां दिशायां च शिवलिङ्गानि यानि च । तेषां माहात्म्यमनघं वद त्वं पापनाशकम्
verses.transliteration: uttarasyAM dishAyAM cha shivali~NgAni yAni cha | teShAM mAhAtmyamanaghaM vada tvaM pApanAshakam
verses.translation: Being subjected to the force of destiny the moon did not accept his advice. Infatuated of Rohini he neglected others.

verses.sanskrit: तदारान्मुक्तिनाथाख्यं शिवलिङ्गं महाद्भुतम् । दर्शनादर्चनात्तस्य भुक्तिर्मुक्तिश्च लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: tadArAnmuktinAthAkhyaM shivali~NgaM mahAdbhutam | darshanAdarchanAttasya bhuktirmuktishcha labhyate
verses.translation: On hearing it the skilful Daka returned to the moon excessively distressed. He politely asked the moon to mend his ways.
verses.hindi: हैं और ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णु आदिके द्वारा सेवनीय हैं

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्यातं लिङ्गवर्णनमुत्तमम् । चतुर्दिक्षु मुनिश्रेष्ठाः किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: iti vashcha samAkhyAtaM li~NgavarNanamuttamam | chaturdikShu munishreShThAH kimanyachChrotumichChatha
verses.translation: O moon, listen. Although requested repeatedly you did not pay heed to my rntreatics. Hence, fall a prey to the wasting disease.
verses.hindi: आपका ध्यान करता हुआ यहीं निवास करूँगा

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । शृणुतादरतो विप्रा औत्तराणां विशेषतः । माहात्म्यं शिवलिङ्गानां प्रवदामि समासतः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | shR^iNutAdarato viprA auttarANAM visheShataH | mAhAtmyaM shivali~NgAnAM pravadAmi samAsataH
verses.translation: Just as he cursed him, the moon contracted consumption within a trice. When he was wasted away there was a great hue and cry.
verses.hindi: लोकानामुपकारार्थ तस्थौ तत्रापि सर्वराट्॥ ३९  लोकोपकारार्थ वहाँ भी निवास करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णं क्षेत्रमपरं महापातकनाशनम् । महावनं च तत्रास्ति पवित्रमतिविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: gokarNaM kShetramaparaM mahApAtakanAshanam | mahAvanaM cha tatrAsti pavitramativistaram
verses.translation: O sage, the gods and the sages became extremely agitated and felt miserable—"What shall be done? What will happen now?*'
verses.hindi: तदारभ्य च सा काशी सर्वश्रेष्ठठटराभवत्॥ ४०  काशी सर्वश्रेष्ठ हो गयी

verses.sanskrit: तत्रास्ति चन्द्रभालाख्यं शिवलिङ्गमनुत्तमम् । रावणेन समानीतं सद्भक्त्या सर्वसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: tatrAsti chandrabhAlAkhyaM shivali~Ngamanuttamam | rAvaNena samAnItaM sadbhaktyA sarvasiddhidam
verses.translation: Informed and implored by the moon, Indra and other gods, Vasistha and other sages sought refuge in Brahma.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे चूदुर्ध्या कोरिरसंहितायां विश्वेश्वरमाहात्म्ये कार्यों खागमनवर्णन॑ नाम द्वार्विश्ो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तत्र स्थितिर्वैद्यनाथस्येव मुनीश्वराः । सर्वलोकहितार्थाय करुणासागरस्य च
verses.transliteration: tasya tatra sthitirvaidyanAthasyeva munIshvarAH | sarvalokahitArthAya karuNAsAgarasya cha
verses.translation: O sage, after approaching him in their great agitation they bowed to and eulogised Brahma and mentioned everything to him.
verses.hindi: आगमनवर्णन नामक बाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं कृत्वा तु गोकर्णे चन्द्रभालं समर्च्य च । शिवलोकमवाप्नोति सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: snAnaM kR^itvA tu gokarNe chandrabhAlaM samarchya cha | shivalokamavApnoti satyaM satyaM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Many unholy deeds have been committed by the wicked moon. O sages, O gods, may the early misdeeds of the moon be heard.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रभालस्य लिङ्गस्य महिमा परमाद्भुतः । न शक्यो वर्णितुं व्यासाद्भक्तिस्नेहरतस्य हि
verses.transliteration: chandrabhAlasya li~Ngasya mahimA paramAdbhutaH | na shakyo varNituM vyAsAdbhaktisneharatasya hi
verses.translation: The wicked fellow went to Brhaspati's house and abducted his w'ife Tara. He then allied himself with the Daityas.
verses.hindi: माहात्म्यका वर्णन करता हूँ, आपलोग सुनें

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रभालमहादेवलिङ्गस्य महिमा महान् । यथाकथञ्चित्सम्प्रोक्तः परलिङ्गस्य वै शृणु
verses.transliteration: chandrabhAlamahAdevali~Ngasya mahimA mahAn | yathAkatha~nchitsamproktaH parali~Ngasya vai shR^iNu
verses.translation: Having sought refuge in the Daityas he fought against the god though forbidden by me and Atri. Then the moon restored Tara to Brhaspati.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: But he said, "If she casts off the foetus I shall accept her." When they asked her whose child she bore in the womb, she replied that the foetus grew out of the seed of the moon. O excellent sages, I then removed the foetus and urged by me, she was accepted by him.
verses.hindi: ब्रत धारणकर सर्वदा यहाँ निवास करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: But he said, "If she casts off the foetus I shall accept her." When they asked her whose child she bore in the womb, she replied that the foetus grew out of the seed of the moon. O excellent sages, I then removed the foetus and urged by me, she was accepted by him.
verses.hindi: मोक्ष देनेवाले श्रेष्ठ पाशुपतव्रतका आचरण करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१२. द्वादशोऽध्यायः । लिङ्गस्वरूपकारणवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत जानासि सकलं वस्तु व्यासप्रसादतः । तवाज्ञातं न विद्येत तस्मात्पृच्छामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.12\. dvAdasho.adhyAyaH | li~NgasvarUpakAraNavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | sUta jAnAsi sakalaM vastu vyAsaprasAdataH | tavAj~nAtaM na vidyeta tasmAtpR^ichChAmahe vayam
verses.translation: Let the moon go to the auspicious serine at Prabhasa along with the gods. Let him propitiate Siva there according to Nlftyufijaya rites.

verses.sanskrit: दिगम्बरोऽतितेजस्वी भूतिभूषणभूषितः । स चेष्टामकरोद्दुष्टां हस्ते लिङ्गं विधारयन्
verses.transliteration: digambaro.atitejasvI bhUtibhUShaNabhUShitaH | sa cheShTAmakarodduShTAM haste li~NgaM vidhArayan
verses.translation: What has happened cannot be reversed. I shall tell you the means to be adopted now. Listen attentively.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा ऋषिपत्न्यस्ताः परं त्रासमुपागताः । विह्वला विस्मिताश्चान्याः समाजग्मुस्तथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA R^iShipatnyastAH paraM trAsamupAgatAH | vihvalA vismitAshchAnyAH samAjagmustathA punaH
verses.translation: Let the moon go to the auspicious serine at Prabhasa along with the gods. Let him propitiate Siva there according to Nlftyufijaya rites.
verses.hindi: जो विशेषता है, उसे तुम ध्यानसे सुनो

verses.sanskrit: मनसा च प्रियं तेषां कर्तुं वै वनवासिनाम् । जगाम तद्वनं प्रीत्या भक्तप्रीतो हरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: manasA cha priyaM teShAM kartuM vai vanavAsinAm | jagAma tadvanaM prItyA bhaktaprIto haraH svayam
verses.translation: Let him perform the penance incessantly sitting before the lord. The delighted Siva will cure him from consumption afterwards.
verses.hindi: अवश्य मुक्त हो जाते हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: आलिलिङ्गुस्तथा चान्याः करं धृत्वा तथापराः । परस्परं तु सङ्घर्षात्सम्मग्नास्ताः स्त्रियस्तदा
verses.transliteration: Alili~NgustathA chAnyAH karaM dhR^itvA tathAparAH | parasparaM tu sa~NgharShAtsammagnAstAH striyastadA
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma, the gods and sages returned to the place where Daksa and the moon were present.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव समये ऋषिवर्याः समागमन् । विरुद्धं तं च ते दृष्ट्वा दुःखिताः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva samaye R^iShivaryAH samAgaman | viruddhaM taM cha te dR^iShTvA duHkhitAH krodhamUrchChitAH
verses.translation: The gods and the sages consoled Daksa and took the moon to Prabhasa.They invoked the sacred waters of Saiasvati and other rivers and performed the worship of the earthen phallic image in accordance with the Mrtyufljaya rites.

verses.sanskrit: तदा दुःखमनुप्राप्ताः कोऽयं कोऽयं तथाब्रुवन् । समस्ता ऋषयस्ते वै शिवमायाविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: tadA duHkhamanuprAptAH ko.ayaM ko.ayaM tathAbruvan | samastA R^iShayaste vai shivamAyAvimohitAH
verses.translation: The gods and the sages of pious mind left the moon at Prabhasa and joyously returned to their abodes.

verses.sanskrit: यदा च नोक्तवान् किञ्चित्सोऽवधूतो दिगम्बरः । ऊचुस्तं पुरुषं भीमं तदा ते परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration: yadA cha noktavAn ki~nchitso.avadhUto digambaraH | UchustaM puruShaM bhImaM tadA te paramarShayaH
verses.translation: The moon performed the penance incessantly for six months. He worshipped the bull-bannered deity with the Mrtyufijaya mantra.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया विरुद्धं क्रियते वेदमार्गविलोपि यत् । ततस्त्वदीयं तल्लिङ्गं पततां पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration: tvayA viruddhaM kriyate vedamArgavilopi yat | tatastvadIyaM talli~NgaM patatAM pR^ithivItale
verses.translation: The moon repeated the Mytyufljaya** mantra a hundred million times. He meditated on the lord Mj-tyufljaya with his mind unruffled.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्ते तु तदा तैश्च लिङ्गं च पतितं क्षणात् । अवधूतस्य तस्याशु शिवस्याद्भुतरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityukte tu tadA taishcha li~NgaM cha patitaM kShaNAt | avadhUtasya tasyAshu shivasyAdbhutarUpiNaH
verses.translation: O moon, may there be welfare to you. Choose your boon, whatever you desire in your mind. I am pleased with you. I shall grant you an excellent boon.

verses.sanskrit: तल्लिङ्गं चाग्निवत्सर्वं यद्ददाह पुरा स्थितम् । यत्र यत्र च तद्याति तत्र तत्र दहेत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: talli~NgaM chAgnivatsarvaM yaddadAha purA sthitam | yatra yatra cha tadyAti tatra tatra dahetpunaH
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, what is not

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गं च पूज्यते लोके तत्त्वया कथितं च यत् । तत्तथैव न चान्यद्वा कारणं विद्यते त्विह
verses.transliteration: li~NgaM cha pUjyate loke tattvayA kathitaM cha yat | tattathaiva na chAnyadvA kAraNaM vidyate tviha
verses.hindi: मर जानेपर प्राणीको अमृतत्वकी प्राप्ति होती है

verses.sanskrit: पाताले च गतं तच्च स्वर्गे चापि तथैव च । भूमौ सर्वत्र तद्यातं न कुत्रापि स्थिरं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: pAtAle cha gataM tachcha svarge chApi tathaiva cha | bhUmau sarvatra tadyAtaM na kutrApi sthiraM hi tat
verses.translation: Pardon my faults. Remain benevolent to me always. When he had said thus Siva spbke lo him again.
verses.hindi: दोनों कर्मोसे मनुष्यलोकमें जन्म कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: लोकाश्च व्याकुला जाता ऋषयस्तेऽतिदुःखिताः । न शर्म लेभिरे केचिद्देवाश्च ऋषयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: lokAshcha vyAkulA jAtA R^iShayaste.atiduHkhitAH | na sharma lebhire kechiddevAshcha R^iShayastathA
verses.translation: O moon, let your digit decline day by day in one fortnight and increase steadily in another.
verses.hindi: हो जाता है, तब मुक्ति होती है, यह सत्य है

verses.sanskrit: न ज्ञातस्तु शिवो यैस्तु ते सर्वे च सुरर्षयः । दुःखिता मिलिताः शीघ्रं ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: na j~nAtastu shivo yaistu te sarve cha surarShayaH | duHkhitA militAH shIghraM brahmANaM sharaNaM yayuH
verses.translation: O brahmins, when this happened the delighted gods and the sages came there quickly.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा च ते सर्वे नत्वा स्तुत्वा विधिं द्विजाः । तत्सर्वमवदन् वृत्तं ब्रह्मणे सृष्टिकारिणे
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvA cha te sarve natvA stutvA vidhiM dvijAH | tatsarvamavadan vR^ittaM brahmaNe sR^iShTikAriNe
verses.translation: After coming there they offered benedictory bless¬ ings to the moon. They joined their palms in reverence and bowed to Siva. They prayed to him devotionally.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शिवमायाविमोहितान् । ज्ञात्वा तान् शङ्करं नत्वा प्रोवाच ऋषिसत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: brahmA tadvachanaM shrutvA shivamAyAvimohitAn | j~nAtvA tAn sha~NkaraM natvA provAcha R^iShisattamAn
verses.translation: O great god, O lord of gods, obeisance be to you. O Siva, O lord, be stable here along with Uma.
verses.hindi: क्रियमाण कर्मका नाश हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । ज्ञातारश्च भवन्तो वै कुर्वते गर्हितं द्विजाः । अज्ञातारो यदा कुर्युः किं पुनः कथ्यते पुनः
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | j~nAtArashcha bhavanto vai kurvate garhitaM dvijAH | aj~nAtAro yadA kuryuH kiM punaH kathyate punaH
verses.translation: Then the moon eulogised the lord with good devo¬ tion first in the Nirguna and then in the Saguna form.
verses.hindi: हृति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे चतुर्थ्या कोटिरुद्रसंहितायां काशीविश्वेश्वरज्योतिर्लिड़माहात््यवर्णन॑ नाम त्रयोविंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: विरुद्ध्यैवं शिवं देवं कुशलं कः समीहते । मध्याह्नसमये यो वै नातिथिं च परामृशेत्
verses.transliteration: viruddhyaivaM shivaM devaM kushalaM kaH samIhate | madhyAhnasamaye yo vai nAtithiM cha parAmR^ishet
verses.translation: Siva was delighted with the gods. For increas¬ ing the glory and greatness of the region and the moon, Siva stayed there in the name, of Somesvara. He became famous in the three worlds. O brahmins, by worship Siva becomes the destroyer of ailments such as consumption, leprosy etc.
verses.hindi: माहात्यवर्णन नामक तेईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव सुकृतं नीत्वा स्वीयं च दुष्कृतं पुनः । संस्थाप्य चातिथिर्याति किं पुनः शिवमेव वा
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva sukR^itaM nItvA svIyaM cha duShkR^itaM punaH | saMsthApya chAtithiryAti kiM punaH shivameva vA
verses.translation: Incurable diseases like consumption arc entirely eradicated if a person takes ablutions there for six months.
verses.hindi: उनकी परम धार्मिक अहल्या नामकी पत्नी थी

verses.sanskrit: यावल्लिङ्गं स्थिरं नैव जगतां त्रितये शुभम् । जायते न तदा क्वापि सत्यमेतद्वदाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: yAvalli~NgaM sthiraM naiva jagatAM tritaye shubham | jAyate na tadA kvApi satyametadvadAmyaham
verses.translation: A pious man attains the fruit of circumambulating
verses.hindi: वहाँ उन्होंने दस हजार वर्षतक तप किया

verses.sanskrit: भवद्भिश्च तथा कार्यं यथा स्वास्थ्यं भवेदिह । शिवलिङ्गस्य ऋषयो मनसा संविचार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: bhavadbhishcha tathA kAryaM yathA svAsthyaM bhavediha | shivali~Ngasya R^iShayo manasA saMvichAryatAm
verses.translation: He who makes pilgrimage to this place attains the fruits of whatever he miglil have had in view. There is no doubt about this.
verses.hindi: पानी कहाँसे दिखायी दे सकता था!

verses.sanskrit: बाणरूपा श्रुता लोके पार्वती शिववल्लभा । एतत्किं कारणं सूत कथय त्वं यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: bANarUpA shrutA loke pArvatI shivavallabhA | etatkiM kAraNaM sUta kathaya tvaM yathAshrutam
verses.translation: Thus seeing the fruit of that high order, the sages and the gods joyously bowed to Jiva and took the moon now freed from wastage. Circumambulating and praising that holy centre they returned to their abodes. The moon resumed his former activity.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तास्ते प्रणम्योचुर्ब्रह्माणमृषयश्च वै । किमस्माभिर्विधे कार्यं तत्कार्यं त्वं समादिश
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktAste praNamyochurbrahmANamR^iShayashcha vai | kimasmAbhirvidhe kAryaM tatkAryaM tvaM samAdisha
verses.translation: O great sages, thus the details of the origin of Soinesa have been narrated to you. Somesvara has originated thus.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तश्च मुनीशैस्तैः सर्वलोकपितामहः । मुनीशांस्तांस्तदा ब्रह्मा स्वयं प्रोवाच वै तदा
verses.transliteration: ityuktashcha munIshaistaiH sarvalokapitAmahaH | munIshAMstAMstadA brahmA svayaM provAcha vai tadA
verses.translation: He w'ho listens to this origin or narrates it to others attains all desires and becomes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: हूँ, वर माँगो, मैं तुम्हें बर दूँगा

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । आराध्य गिरिजां देवीं प्रार्थयन्तु सुराः शिवाम् । योनिरूपा भवेच्चेद्वै तदा तत्स्थिरतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | ArAdhya girijAM devIM prArthayantu surAH shivAm | yonirUpA bhavechchedvai tadA tatsthiratAM vrajet
verses.translation: Hereafter 1 shall explain the origin of Mallikarjuna on hearing which the devotee becomes intelligent and rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! इसपर उन वरुणने मुनिसे कहा--

verses.sanskrit: तद्विधिं प्रवदाम्यद्य सर्वे शृणुत सत्तमाः । तामेव कुरुत प्रेम्णा प्रसन्ना सा भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tadvidhiM pravadAmyadya sarve shR^iNuta sattamAH | tAmeva kuruta premNA prasannA sA bhaviShyati
verses.translation: The story of Kumara has already been mentioned by me. I.shall e.xplain it again. It is divine and destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: मैं आपके लिये प्रदान कर सकूँ

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भमेकं च संस्थाप्य कृत्वाष्टदलमुत्तमम् । दूर्वायवाङ्कुरैस्तीर्थोदकमापूरयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: kumbhamekaM cha saMsthApya kR^itvAShTadalamuttamam | dUrvAyavA~NkuraistIrthodakamApUrayettataH
verses.translation: On hearing it, Kumfira bowed to his parents and went to the mountain KrauHca*'*' though forbidden by his parents.

verses.sanskrit: वेदमन्त्रैस्ततस्तं वै कुम्भं चैवाभिमन्त्रयेत् । श्रुत्युक्तविधिना तस्य पूजां कृत्वा शिवं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: vedamantraistatastaM vai kumbhaM chaivAbhimantrayet | shrutyuktavidhinA tasya pUjAM kR^itvA shivaM smaran
verses.translation: O beloved, why are you distressed O Parvati, do not be grieved. O beautiful lady, our son will certainly return. Let not your excessive grief overpower you.

verses.sanskrit: तल्लिङ्गं तज्जलेनाभिषेचयेत्परमर्षयः । शतरुद्रियमन्त्रैस्तु प्रोक्षितं शान्तिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: talli~NgaM tajjalenAbhiShechayetparamarShayaH | shatarudriyamantraistu prokShitaM shAntimApnuyAt
verses.translation: When the distressed Parvati did not pay heed to his advic:e, the celestial sages were sent to Karttika by iva.
verses.hindi: भी दूसरोंका उपकारकर सुख प्राप्त किया

verses.sanskrit: गिरिजायोनिरूपं च बाणं स्थाप्य शुभं पुनः । तत्र लिङ्गं च तत्स्थाप्यं पुनश्चैवाभिमन्त्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: girijAyonirUpaM cha bANaM sthApya shubhaM punaH | tatra li~NgaM cha tatsthApyaM punashchaivAbhimantrayet
verses.translation: The gods and the sages, accompanied by their at¬ tendants went there joyously to bring back Kumara.

verses.sanskrit: सुगन्धैश्चन्दनैश्चैव पुष्पधूपादिभिस्तथा । नैवेद्यादिकपूजाभिस्तोषयेत्परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sugandhaishchandanaishchaiva puShpadhUpAdibhistathA | naivedyAdikapUjAbhistoShayetparameshvaram
verses.translation: They went there and bowed to Kuinara, implored him in many ways and requested him humbly and respect¬ fully.
verses.hindi: तथा छोटोंकी सेवासे लघुता प्राप्त होती है

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपातैः स्तवैः पुण्यैर्वाद्यैर्गानैस्तथा पुनः । ततः स्वस्त्ययनं कृत्वा जयेति व्याहरेत्तथा
verses.transliteration: praNipAtaiH stavaiH puNyairvAdyairgAnaistathA punaH | tataH svastyayanaM kR^itvA jayeti vyAharettathA
verses.translation: Agitated by great pride Kumara did not care for the importunities of the gods and sages, intermingled with Siva's behest.
verses.hindi: रहना अस्थिलाभ करानेवाला कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । कल्पभेदकथा चैव श्रुता व्यासान्मया द्विजाः । तामेव कथयाम्यद्य श्रूयतामृषिसत्तमाः
