verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | kalpabhedakathA chaiva shrutA vyAsAnmayA dvijAH | tAmeva kathayAmyadya shrUyatAmR^iShisattamAH
verses.translation: Then they returned again to Jiva. After bowing to him and taking leave of him they returned to their abodes.
verses.hindi: सह लेते हैं, किंतु दूसरोंके दु:खको दूर करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नो भव देवेश जगदाह्लादकारक । कर्ता पालयिता त्वं च संहर्ता त्वं निरक्षरः
verses.transliteration: prasanno bhava devesha jagadAhlAdakAraka | kartA pAlayitA tvaM cha saMhartA tvaM nirakSharaH
verses.translation: When he did not return, goddess Parvati felt severely the pangs of separation from her son. Siva too was extremely miserable.
verses.hindi: उपकारमें कुशल होते हैं, ऐसे अन्य कोई नहीं हैं

verses.sanskrit: जगदादिर्जगद्योनिर्जगदन्तर्गतोऽपि च । शान्तो भव महेशान सर्वांल्लोकांश्च पालय
verses.transliteration: jagadAdirjagadyonirjagadantargato.api cha | shAnto bhava maheshAna sarvAMllokAMshcha pAlaya
verses.translation: Coming to know of the arrival of his parents, from the top of the mountain Kumara went thirtysix kilo¬ metres further out of disregard for their love.
verses.hindi: इन चार पुण्यस्तम्भोंने पृथ्वीको धारण किया है

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते विधौ स्वास्थ्यं भविष्यति न संशयः । विकारो न त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन्भविष्यति सुखं सदा
verses.transliteration: evaM kR^ite vidhau svAsthyaM bhaviShyati na saMshayaH | vikAro na triloke.asminbhaviShyati sukhaM sadA
verses.translation: When he went further on the Krauiica hill, iva and Parvati stayed behind assuming the fiery form.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तास्ते द्विजा देवाः प्रणिपत्य पितामहम् । शिवं तं शरणं प्राप्ताः सर्वलोकसुखेप्सया
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktAste dvijA devAH praNipatya pitAmaham | shivaM taM sharaNaM prAptAH sarvalokasukhepsayA
verses.translation: Out of filial affection they used to visit Kumara on the concluding day of every fortnight.
verses.hindi: अनेक पशु-पक्षी एवं बहुत-से जीव भी पहुँच गये

verses.sanskrit: पूजितः परया भक्त्या प्रार्थितः शङ्करस्तदा । सुप्रसन्नस्ततो भूत्वा तानुवाच महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pUjitaH parayA bhaktyA prArthitaH sha~NkarastadA | suprasannastato bhUtvA tAnuvAcha maheshvaraH
verses.translation: Siva goes there on Amavasya day and Parvati on the Full Moon day.
verses.hindi: वहाँ दुःख देनेवाली अनावृष्टि नहीं रह गयी

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वर उवाच । हे देवा ऋषयः सर्वे मद्वचः शृणुतादरात् । योनिरूपेण मल्लिङ्गं धृतं चेत्स्यात्तदा सुखम्
verses.transliteration: maheshvara uvAcha | he devA R^iShayaH sarve madvachaH shR^iNutAdarAt | yonirUpeNa malli~NgaM dhR^itaM chetsyAttadA sukham
verses.translation: From that day onwards: that phallic image of Siva born of Mallikarjima became famous in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वतीं च विना नान्या लिङ्गं धारयितुं क्षमा । तया धृतं च मल्लिङ्गं द्रुतं शान्तिं गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: pArvatIM cha vinA nAnyA li~NgaM dhArayituM kShamA | tayA dhR^itaM cha malli~NgaM drutaM shAntiM gamiShyati
verses.translation: He who sees that phallic image becomes rid of all sins and attains all desires. There is no doubt about it.
verses.hindi: उस वनमें पूर्ण आनन्द व्याप्त हो गया

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषिभिर्देवैः सुप्रसन्नैर्मुनीश्वराः । गृहीत्वा चैव ब्रह्माणं गिरिजा प्रार्थिता तदा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tachChrutvA R^iShibhirdevaiH suprasannairmunIshvarAH | gR^ihItvA chaiva brahmANaM girijA prArthitA tadA
verses.translation: His misery disappears. He obtains supreme hap¬ piness. He never suffers from the distress of rebirth in the mother's womb.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नां गिरिजां कृत्वा वृषभध्वजमेव च । पूर्वोक्तं च विधिं कृत्वा स्थापितं लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prasannAM girijAM kR^itvA vR^iShabhadhvajameva cha | pUrvoktaM cha vidhiM kR^itvA sthApitaM li~Ngamuttamam
verses.translation: Thus the second Jyotirlihga Mallika has been narrated. It is the bestower of happiness and the welfare to the world.
verses.hindi: गौतमप्रभाववर्णन नामक चौबीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रोक्तेन विधानेन देवाश्च ऋषयस्तथा । चक्रुः प्रसन्नां गिरिजां शिवं च धर्महेतवे
verses.transliteration: mantroktena vidhAnena devAshcha R^iShayastathA | chakruH prasannAM girijAM shivaM cha dharmahetave
verses.translation: O Suta, you know everything by Vyasa's favour. We are never satiated by hearing about the Jyotirlihgas.
verses.hindi: हाथमें कमण्डलु लेकर भक्तिपूर्वक वहाँ पहुँचे

verses.sanskrit: पुरा दारुवने जातं यद् वृत्तं तु द्विजन्मनाम् । तदेव श्रूयतां सम्यक् कथयामि यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: purA dAruvane jAtaM yad vR^ittaM tu dvijanmanAm | tadeva shrUyatAM samyak kathayAmi yathAshrutam
verses.translation: Hence O holy lord, be kind to us and narrate the third Jyotirlihga to us now.

verses.sanskrit: समानर्चुर्विशेषेण सर्वे देवर्षयः शिवम् । ब्रह्मा विष्णुः परे चैव त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: samAnarchurvisheSheNa sarve devarShayaH shivam | brahmA viShNuH pare chaiva trailokyaM sacharAcharam
verses.translation: O brahmins, if 1 remain in the company of you all, the glorious ones, I am blessed and contented. Blessed indeed is the association of saintly men.
verses.hindi: उलटे-सीधे वह सारा समाचार निवेदन किया

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसन्नः शिवो जातः शिवा च जगदम्बिका । धृतं तया च तल्लिङ्गं तेन रूपेण वै तदा
verses.transliteration: suprasannaH shivo jAtaH shivA cha jagadambikA | dhR^itaM tayA cha talli~NgaM tena rUpeNa vai tadA
verses.translation: Hence, considering it my good fortune, I shall nar¬ rate the sanctifying sin-destroying divine story. Please listen to this story respectfully.
verses.hindi: महर्षिगण गौतमके ऊपर क्रुद्ध हो गये

verses.sanskrit: लोकानां स्थापिते लिङ्गे कल्याणं चाभवत्तदा । प्रसिद्धं चैव तल्लिङ्गं त्रिलोक्यामभवद् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: lokAnAM sthApite li~Nge kalyANaM chAbhavattadA | prasiddhaM chaiva talli~NgaM trilokyAmabhavad dvijAH
verses.translation: An excellent brahmin engrossed in the performance of auspicious rites lived there. He studied the Vedas and performed the Vedic rites.
verses.hindi: पूजन एवं उपहारोंद्वारा गणेशनीकी आराधना की

verses.sanskrit: हाटकेशमिति ख्यातं तच्छिवाशिवमित्यपि । पूजनात्तस्य लोकानां सुखं भवति सर्वथा
verses.transliteration: hATakeshamiti khyAtaM tachChivAshivamityapi | pUjanAttasya lokAnAM sukhaM bhavati sarvathA
verses.translation: The brahmin maintained sacrificial fires. He was the devotee of Siva. Everyday he worshipped the idol of Siva.
verses.hindi: गये और यह वचन कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: इह सर्वसमृद्धिः स्यान्नानासुखवहाधिका । परत्र परमा मुक्तिर्नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: iha sarvasamR^iddhiH syAnnAnAsukhavahAdhikA | paratra paramA muktirnAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: O excellent sages, he had four sons like him. They were not inferior to their parents and they were ever en¬ gaged in the worship of Siva,

verses.sanskrit: दारुनाम वनं श्रेष्ठं तत्रासन् ऋषिसत्तमाः । शिवभक्ताः सदा नित्यं शिवध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: dArunAma vanaM shreShThaM tatrAsan R^iShisattamAH | shivabhaktAH sadA nityaM shivadhyAnaparAyaNAH
verses.translation: Thanks to the power of their merit, happiness in¬ creased on the earth even as the moon waxes incessantly in the bright half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकालं शिवपूजां च कुर्वन्ति स्म निरन्तरम् । नानाविधैः स्तवैर्दिव्यैस्तुष्टुवुस्ते मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: trikAlaM shivapUjAM cha kurvanti sma nirantaram | nAnAvidhaiH stavairdivyaistuShTuvuste munIshvarAH
verses.translation: Their good qualities too flourished delighting and pleasing all. That city was enveloped in the brahminical splendour.
verses.hindi: अहितकारक फलको नहीं ग्रहण किया जाता

verses.sanskrit: ते कदाचिद्वने याताः समिधाहरणाय च । सर्वे द्विजर्षभाः शैवाः शिवध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: te kadAchidvane yAtAH samidhAharaNAya cha | sarve dvijarShabhAH shaivAH shivadhyAnaparAyaNAH
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, let the excellent event that happened in the meantime be heard. I shall narrate it in the manner I have heard.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे साक्षाच्छङ्करो नीललोहितः । विरूपं च समास्थाय परीक्षार्थं समागतः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare sAkShAchCha~Nkaro nIlalohitaH | virUpaM cha samAsthAya parIkShArthaM samAgataH
verses.translation: Thanks to the grant of boons by Brahma he con¬ sidered the whole univcr.se insignificant. The gods were defeated by him and ousted from their places and positions.
verses.hindi: परम हितकर ही होगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Whatever Vcdic rites were there in the shrines and holy centres were stopped by him. Dharma was exiled to a distant place.
verses.hindi: नहीं है, आप लोग दूसरा वरदान माँगिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Whatever Vcdic rites were there in the shrines and holy centres were stopped by him. Dharma was exiled to a distant place.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । बटुकोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । यथाभवल्लिङ्गरूपः सम्पूज्यस्त्रिभवे शिवः । तथोक्तं वा द्विजाः प्रीत्या किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.13\. trayodasho.adhyAyaH | baTukotpattivarNanam | sUta uvAcha | yathAbhavalli~NgarUpaH sampUjyastribhave shivaH | tathoktaM vA dvijAH prItyA kimanyachChrotumichChatha
verses.translation: "There is a beautiful city.Vvanti." Thinking that what the Asura did, hear.
verses.hindi: हुई वह गाय यव तथा धान चरने लगी

verses.sanskrit: देवैश्च पीडितः सोऽपि यावद्गर्तमुपागतः । तावच्छूलेन सम्प्रोतः शिवेन परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: devaishcha pIDitaH so.api yAvadgartamupAgataH | tAvachChUlena samprotaH shivena paramAtmanA
verses.translation: Accompanied by a vast army, the great Asura
verses.hindi: क्षण उन ऋषिके देखते-देखते मर गयी

verses.sanskrit: तत्रत्यश्च तदा शम्भुं ध्यात्वा सम्प्रार्थयत्तदा । अन्तकाले च त्वां दृष्ट्वा तादृशो भवति क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: tatratyashcha tadA shambhuM dhyAtvA samprArthayattadA | antakAle cha tvAM dR^iShTvA tAdR^isho bhavati kShaNAt
verses.translation: After reaching the place, that great knave, that hater of brahmins called four hefty Daityas to him and said these words.
verses.hindi: कहाँ जाऊँ? मुझे गोवधका पाप लग गया

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं संस्तुतः सोऽपि प्रसन्नः शङ्करस्तदा । उवाच वचनं तत्र वरं ब्रूहि ददामि ते
verses.transliteration: ityevaM saMstutaH so.api prasannaH sha~NkarastadA | uvAcha vachanaM tatra varaM brUhi dadAmi te
verses.translation: Why don't the wicked brahmins do as I say? Ali these, engaged in Vedic rites and rituals are worthy of being punished by me.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा स दैत्यः पुनरब्रवीत् । सुप्रणम्य शिवं स्तुत्वा सत्त्वभावमुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: ityevaM vachanaM shrutvA sa daityaH punarabravIt | supraNamya shivaM stutvA sattvabhAvamupAshritaH
verses.translation: O excellent Daityas, the gods and the kings in the world have been defeated by me. Why should not the brahmins be kept in my control?
verses.hindi: निन्‍दा करके बार-बार उन्हें धिक्कारने लगे

verses.sanskrit: अन्धक उवाच । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश स्वभक्तिं देहि मे शुभाम् । कृपां कृत्वा विशेषेण संस्थितो भव चेह वै
verses.transliteration: andhaka uvAcha | yadi prasanno devesha svabhaktiM dehi me shubhAm | kR^ipAM kR^itvA visheSheNa saMsthito bhava cheha vai
verses.translation: If they wish to live happily let them abandon the rites of Siva and the rituals of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तस्तेन दैत्यं तं तद्गर्ते चाक्षिपद्धरः । स्वयं तत्र स्थितो लिङ्गरूपोऽसौ लोककाम्यया
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktastena daityaM taM tadgarte chAkShipaddharaH | svayaM tatra sthito li~NgarUpo.asau lokakAmyayA
verses.translation: On hearing this and receiving the instruction the four Daityas besieged the four quarters of the city like the fires of dissolution.
verses.hindi: विलम्बं कुरु नैव त्वं धेनुहन्पापकारक ॥ ४०  करो

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकेशं च तल्लिङ्गं नित्यं यः पूजयेन्नरः । षण्मासाज्जायते तस्य वाञ्छासिद्धिर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: andhakeshaM cha talli~NgaM nityaM yaH pUjayennaraH | ShaNmAsAjjAyate tasya vA~nChAsiddhirna saMshayaH
verses.translation: On coming to know of the intent of the Daityas, the brahmins were not at all distressed because they were engaged in meditating on Siva.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्त्यर्थं पूजयेल्लिङ्गं लोकस्य हितकारकम् । षण्मासं यो द्विजश्चैव स वै देवलकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: vR^ittyarthaM pUjayelli~NgaM lokasya hitakArakam | ShaNmAsaM yo dvijashchaiva sa vai devalakaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Resorting to courage, the brahmins did not move even a line's breadth from meditation. With liva to help who can remain in distress?

verses.sanskrit: यथा देवलकश्चैव स भवेदिह वै तदा । देवलकश्च यः प्रोक्तो नाधिकारो द्विजस्य हि
verses.transliteration: yathA devalakashchaiva sa bhavediha vai tadA | devalakashcha yaH prokto nAdhikAro dvijasya hi
verses.translation: In the meantime, the whole of that auspicious city was overrun by them. The people were harassed and they rushed against the brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ देवलकश्च कः प्रोक्तः किं कार्यं तस्य विद्यते । तत्त्वं वद महाप्राज्ञ लोकानां हितहेतवे
verses.transliteration: || R^iShaya UchuH || devalakashcha kaH proktaH kiM kAryaM tasya vidyate | tattvaM vada mahAprAj~na lokAnAM hitahetave
verses.translation: O holy lords, what shall be done? The wicked Asuras have come. People are tortured. They have come very near.
verses.hindi: हो सके, वह उपाय आपलोग बतायें

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । अन्धकेश्वरलिङ्गस्य महिमानं वद प्रभो । तथान्यच्छिवलिङ्गानां प्रीत्या वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | andhakeshvarali~Ngasya mahimAnaM vada prabho | tathAnyachChivali~NgAnAM prItyA vaktumihArhasi
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the brahmins, the sons of

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । दधीचिर्नाम विप्रो यो धर्मिष्ठो वेदपारगः । शिवभक्तिरतो नित्यं शिवशास्त्रपरायणः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | dadhIchirnAma vipro yo dharmiShTho vedapAragaH | shivabhaktirato nityaM shivashAstraparAyaNaH
verses.translation: ; Listen, wc do not have an army to frighten the wicked Asuras. We do not have weapons to drive them back.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रस्तथा ह्यासीत्स्मृतो नाम्ना सुदर्शनः । तस्य भार्या दुकूला च नाम्ना दुष्टकुलोद्भवा
verses.transliteration: tasya putrastathA hyAsItsmR^ito nAmnA sudarshanaH | tasya bhAryA dukUlA cha nAmnA duShTakulodbhavA
verses.translation: The general dishonour and insult reflect.s on him who supports us. Moreover, what can happen to Siva who is omnipotent?
verses.hindi: झति श्रीजशिवमहापुराणे च॒दुर्ध्या कोटिरसंहितायां गौतमव्यवस्थावर्णं नाम पञ्जविंशो5 ध्यायः

verses.sanskrit: तद्वशे स च भर्तासीत्तस्य पुत्रचतुष्टयम् । सोऽपि नित्यं शिवस्यैव पूजां च स्म करोत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: tadvashe sa cha bhartAsIttasya putrachatuShTayam | so.api nityaM shivasyaiva pUjAM cha sma karotyasau
verses.translation: Let lord Siva protect us from the terror of the Asuras. Except Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees there is no other refuge.

verses.sanskrit: दधीचेस्तु तदा ह्यासीद् ग्रामान्तरनिवेशनम् । ज्ञातिसंयोगतश्चैव ज्ञातिभिर्न स मोचितः
verses.transliteration: dadhIchestu tadA hyAsId grAmAntaraniveshanam | j~nAtisaMyogatashchaiva j~nAtibhirna sa mochitaH
verses.translation: Emboldened thus they performed the worship of Siva's earthern idol. They sat firmly engaged in meditation. On seeing them thus the mighty Dusana shouted "Let them be killed. Let them be bound." But the brahmins, the sons of Vedapriya engrossed in meditation on Siva did not hear the shouts.

verses.sanskrit: कथयित्वा च पुत्रं स शिवभक्तिरतो भव । इत्युक्त्वा स गतो मुक्तो दधीचिः शैवसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kathayitvA cha putraM sa shivabhaktirato bhava | ityuktvA sa gato mukto dadhIchiH shaivasattamaH
verses.translation: When the wicked Daitya desired to kill the brahmins, the spot near the Parthiva idol caved in with a loud report.,

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्शनस्तत्पुत्रोऽपि शिवपूजां चकार ह । एवं चिरतरः कालो व्यतीयाय मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sudarshanastatputro.api shivapUjAM chakAra ha | evaM chirataraH kAlo vyatIyAya munIshvarAH
verses.translation: From the chasm thus created, Siva rose up assuming a hideous form. He became famous as Mahakala, the slayer of the wicked and the goal of the good.
verses.hindi: लगे--हे देव! आप मुझे पापरहित करें

verses.sanskrit: एवं च शिवरात्रिश्च समायाता कदाचन । तस्यां चोपोषिताः सर्वे स्वयं संयोगतस्तदा
verses.transliteration: evaM cha shivarAtrishcha samAyAtA kadAchana | tasyAM chopoShitAH sarve svayaM saMyogatastadA
verses.translation: "I am Mahakala (the great god of death) risen up against the wicked like you. O sinful one, go away, leave the presence of these brahmins."
verses.hindi: निश्चय ही आपके साथ छल किया है

verses.sanskrit: पूजां कृत्वा गतः सोऽपि सुदर्शन इति स्मृतः । स्त्रीसङ्गं शिवरात्रौ तु कृत्वा पुनरिहागतः
verses.transliteration: pUjAM kR^itvA gataH so.api sudarshana iti smR^itaH | strIsa~NgaM shivarAtrau tu kR^itvA punarihAgataH
verses.translation: After saying this Siva reduced Dusana and his army, to ashes immediately with a mere sound of Hum.

verses.sanskrit: न स्नानं तेन च कृतं तद्रात्र्यां शिवपूजनम् । तेन तत्कर्मपाकेन क्रुद्धः प्रोवाच शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: na snAnaM tena cha kR^itaM tadrAtryAM shivapUjanam | tena tatkarmapAkena kruddhaH provAcha sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: Dusana and a portion of his army too were killed by Siva the great soul. A part of the army fled.
verses.hindi: हैं, इनका कोई प्रायश्चित्त नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वर उवाच । शिवरात्र्यां त्वया दुष्ट सेवनं च स्त्रियाः कृतम् । अस्नातेन मदीया च कृता पूजाविवेकिना
verses.transliteration: maheshvara uvAcha | shivarAtryAM tvayA duShTa sevanaM cha striyAH kR^itam | asnAtena madIyA cha kR^itA pUjAvivekinA
verses.translation: Divine drums were sounded. Shower of flowers fell. Viu, Brahma and other gods came there.
verses.hindi: उनसे ऋषियोंके बहुतसे दुश्चरित्रोंका वर्णन किया

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । पुराब्धिगर्तमाश्रित्य वसन् दैत्योऽन्धकासुरः । स्ववशं कारयामास त्रैलोक्यं सुरसूदनः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | purAbdhigartamAshritya vasan daityo.andhakAsuraH | svavashaM kArayAmAsa trailokyaM surasUdanaH
verses.translation: After bowing to the benefactor of the worlds, the

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा चैवं कृतं यस्मात्तस्मात्त्वं जडतां व्रज । ममास्पृश्यो भव त्वं च दूरतो दर्शनं कुरु
verses.transliteration: j~nAtvA chaivaM kR^itaM yasmAttasmAttvaM jaDatAM vraja | mamAspR^ishyo bhava tvaM cha dUrato darshanaM kuru
verses.translation: After consoling the brahmins the delighted Siva asked the Brahmins to choose the boon they wished to have.
verses.hindi: ही मेरा बहुत बड़ा स्वार्थ सिद्ध हुआ है

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति शप्तो महेशेन दाधीचिः स सुदर्शनः । जडत्वं प्राप्तवान्सद्यः शिवमायाविमोहितः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shapto maheshena dAdhIchiH sa sudarshanaH | jaDatvaM prAptavAnsadyaH shivamAyAvimohitaH
verses.translation: On hearing it, the devout brahmins with palms joined in reverence and heads bent down bowed to Siva and said.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये विप्रा दधीचिः शैवसत्तमः । ग्रामान्तरात्समायातो वृत्तान्तं श्रुतवाँश्च सः
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye viprA dadhIchiH shaivasattamaH | grAmAntarAtsamAyAto vR^ittAntaM shrutavA.Nshcha saH
verses.translation: O lord, the chastiser of the wicked, O Siva, grant us liberation from the ocean of worldly existence. O Siva.

verses.sanskrit: शिवेन भर्त्सितः सोऽपि दुःखितोऽभूदतीव हि । रुरोद हा हतोऽस्मीति दुःखेन सुतकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: shivena bhartsitaH so.api duHkhito.abhUdatIva hi | ruroda hA hato.asmIti duHkhena sutakarmaNA
verses.translation: O Siva, you shall stay here itself for the protection of the people. O lord Siva, save those who see you.

verses.sanskrit: पुनःपुनरुवाचेति स दधीचिः सतां मतः । अनेनेदं कुपुत्रेण हतं मे कुलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: punaHpunaruvAcheti sa dadhIchiH satAM mataH | anenedaM kuputreNa hataM me kulamuttamam
verses.translation: Requested thus, Siva remained in that auspicious chasm for the protection of his devotees after granting them the goal of the good.
verses.hindi: जैसा उन लोगोंने निर्णय दिया है, वही होने दीजिये

verses.sanskrit: स पुत्रोऽपि हतो भार्यां पुंश्चलीमुक्तवान्द्रुतम् । पश्चात्तापमनुप्राप्य स्वपित्रा परिभर्त्सितः
verses.transliteration: sa putro.api hato bhAryAM puMshchalImuktavAndrutam | pashchAttApamanuprApya svapitrA paribhartsitaH
verses.translation: The brahmins attained salvation. The supporting base of Siva in the form of Lihga extended to 3 kilometres in each of the four directions.
verses.hindi: नरकमें गिरते हुए मुझे भी आप पवित्र कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्पित्रा गिरिजा तत्र पूजिता विधिभिर्वरैः । सुयत्नतो महाभक्त्या स्वपुत्रसुखहेतवे
verses.transliteration: tatpitrA girijA tatra pUjitA vidhibhirvaraiH | suyatnato mahAbhaktyA svaputrasukhahetave
verses.translation: O brahmins, Siva became famous as Mahakales- vara. On seeing this image no one will have misery even in dreams.

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्शनोऽपि गिरिजां पूजयामास च स्वयम् । चण्डीपूजनमार्गेण महाभक्त्या शुभैः स्तवैः
verses.transliteration: sudarshano.api girijAM pUjayAmAsa cha svayam | chaNDIpUjanamArgeNa mahAbhaktyA shubhaiH stavaiH
verses.translation: A man worshipping this image with a cherished desire in his mind will attain the same here and salvation hereafter.
verses.hindi: शिव उवाच पुनः: यह वचन कहा--

verses.sanskrit: एवं तौ पितृपुत्रौ हि नानोपायैः सुभक्तितः । प्रसन्नां चक्रतुर्देवीं गिरिजां भक्तवत्सलाम्
verses.transliteration: evaM tau pitR^iputrau hi nAnopAyaiH subhaktitaH | prasannAM chakraturdevIM girijAM bhaktavatsalAm
verses.translation: O great ones with good rites, the origin and the greatness of Afahakala has thus been narrated to you. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: बैवस्वतो मनुर्देवि ह्ष्टाविंशत्तमो भवेत्॥ २९  अट्टाईसवें कलियुगतक तुम यहीं निवास करो

verses.sanskrit: तयोः सेवाप्रभावेण प्रसन्ना चण्डिका तदा । सुदर्शनं च पुत्रत्वे चकार गिरिजा मुने
verses.transliteration: tayoH sevAprabhAveNa prasannA chaNDikA tadA | sudarshanaM cha putratve chakAra girijA mune
verses.translation: O most intelligent one, please mention again the greatness of the Jyotirlihga Mahakala, the protector of his devotees.
verses.hindi: रहेगा, तभी मैं पृथ्वीपर निवास करूँगी

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्गर्ताच्च निःसृत्य पीडयित्वा पुनः प्रजाः । प्राविशच्च तदा दैत्यस्तं गर्तं सुपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdgartAchcha niHsR^itya pIDayitvA punaH prajAH | prAvishachcha tadA daityastaM gartaM suparAkramaH
verses.translation: O brahmins, listen with interest to the devotion enhancing greatness of Mahakala, the protector of the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: शिवं प्रसादयामास पुत्रार्थे चण्डिका स्वयम् । क्रुद्धाक्रुद्धा पुनश्चण्डी तत्पुत्रस्य प्रसन्नधीः
verses.transliteration: shivaM prasAdayAmAsa putrArthe chaNDikA svayam | kruddhAkruddhA punashchaNDI tatputrasya prasannadhIH
verses.translation: O brahmins, the Gana Manibhadra, honoured by the people, the chief of the Ganas of Siva, was a friend of that king.

verses.sanskrit: अथाज्ञाय प्रसन्नं तं महेशं वृषभध्वजम् ॥ नमस्कृत्य स्वयं तस्य ह्युत्सङ्गे तं न्यवेशयत्
verses.transliteration: athAj~nAya prasannaM taM maheshaM vR^iShabhadhvajam || namaskR^itya svayaM tasya hyutsa~Nge taM nyaveshayat
verses.translation: Once the liberal-minded Gana-chief Manibhadra, gave him the great jewel Cintamani, out of pleasure.
verses.hindi: हूँ और तुम भी निवास करो

verses.sanskrit: घृतस्नानं तश्चक्रे पुत्रस्य गिरिजा स्वयम् । त्रिरावृत्तोपवीतं च ग्रन्थिनैकेन संयुतम्
verses.transliteration: ghR^itasnAnaM tashchakre putrasya girijA svayam | trirAvR^ittopavItaM cha granthinaikena saMyutam
verses.translation: Any thing made of bell-metal, copper, tin or stone touched with its brilliant surface turned into gold.

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्शनाय पुत्राय ददौ प्रीत्या तदाम्बिका । उद्दिश्य शिवगायत्रीं षोडशाक्षरसंयुताम्
verses.transliteration: sudarshanAya putrAya dadau prItyA tadAmbikA | uddishya shivagAyatrIM ShoDashAkSharasaMyutAm
verses.translation: Wearing that gem round his neck the king Candrasena, dependent on Siva shone well like the sun in the midst of gods.

verses.sanskrit: तदों नमः शिवायेति श्रीशब्दपूर्वकाय च । वारान्षोडश सङ्कल्पपूजां कुर्यादयं बटुः
verses.transliteration: tadoM namaH shivAyeti shrIshabdapUrvakAya cha | vArAnShoDasha sa~NkalpapUjAM kuryAdayaM baTuH
verses.translation: On hearing that the excellent king Candrasena had the Cintamani round his neck, the kings on the earth were agitated in their hearts due to greed.

verses.sanskrit: आस्नानादिप्रणामान्तं पूजयन्वृषभध्वजम् । मन्त्रवादित्रपूजाभिः सर्षीणां सन्निधौ तथा
verses.transliteration: AsnAnAdipraNAmAntaM pUjayanvR^iShabhadhvajam | mantravAditrapUjAbhiH sarShINAM sannidhau tathA
verses.translation: The kings ignorantly trying to rival with him, begged of Candrasena, that jewel secured from the god. They used various means to get the jewel.
verses.hindi: जो महापातकका भी नाश करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: नाममन्त्राननेकांश्च पाठयामास वै तदा । उवाच सुप्रसन्नात्मा चण्डिका च शिवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nAmamantrAnanekAMshcha pAThayAmAsa vai tadA | uvAcha suprasannAtmA chaNDikA cha shivastathA
verses.translation: O brahmins, the importunity of the kings was rendered futile by Cindrasena, a staunch devotee of Siva.
verses.hindi: उनकी उपासनाका फल प्राप्त होता है

verses.sanskrit: मदर्पितं च यत्किञ्चिद्धनधान्यादिकं तथा । तत्सर्वं च त्वया ग्राह्यं न दोषाय भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: madarpitaM cha yatki~nchiddhanadhAnyAdikaM tathA | tatsarvaM cha tvayA grAhyaM na doShAya bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Disappointed and offended thus by him the kings of all the lands became wrathful against him.
verses.hindi: प्रकारके पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: मम कृत्ये भवान्मुख्यो देवीकृत्ये विशेषतः । घृततैलादिकं सर्वं त्वया ग्राह्यं मदर्पितम्
verses.transliteration: mama kR^itye bhavAnmukhyo devIkR^itye visheShataH | ghR^itatailAdikaM sarvaM tvayA grAhyaM madarpitam
verses.translation: Then the kings fully equipped with the four
verses.hindi: तथा परलोकमें उत्तम मुक्ति प्रदान करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्यं भवेद्यर्हिं तर्ह्येको हि भवान्भवेत् । तदा पूजा च सम्पूर्णान्यथा सर्वा च निष्फला
verses.transliteration: prAjApatyaM bhavedyarhiM tarhyeko hi bhavAnbhavet | tadA pUjA cha sampUrNAnyathA sarvA cha niShphalA
verses.translation: They joined together, consulted and conspired with one another. With a vast army they laid siege to the four main gates of Ujjayinl.
verses.hindi: चाहते हैं ? उसे मैं कहूँगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च दुःखिताः सर्वे शिवं प्रार्थ्य पुनःपुनः । सर्वं निवेदयामासुः स्वदुःखं च मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: devAshcha duHkhitAH sarve shivaM prArthya punaHpunaH | sarvaM nivedayAmAsuH svaduHkhaM cha munIshvarAH
verses.translation: On seeing his city thus attacked by the kings, the king Candrasena sought refuge in Mahakalesvara.
verses.hindi: ड्र्ति जड़ 22 को मिकक कोटिरद्रसंहितायां त्यंबकेश्वरमाहात्प्यवर्णन॑ नाम बड्विंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तिलकं वर्तुलं कार्यं स्नानं कार्यं सदा त्वया । शिवसन्ध्या च कर्तव्या गायत्री च तदीयका
verses.transliteration: tilakaM vartulaM kAryaM snAnaM kAryaM sadA tvayA | shivasandhyA cha kartavyA gAyatrI cha tadIyakA
verses.translation: Without doubts and hesitations, without taking in any food that king of steady resolve worshipped Mahakala day and night without turning his mind to anything else.

verses.sanskrit: मत्सेवां प्रथमं कृत्वा कार्यमन्यत्कुलोचितम् । एवं कृतेऽखिले भद्रं दोषाः क्षान्ता मया तव
verses.transliteration: matsevAM prathamaM kR^itvA kAryamanyatkulochitam | evaM kR^ite.akhile bhadraM doShAH kShAntA mayA tava
verses.translation: Then the lord Siva, delighted in his mind, concocted a means in order to save him. Listen to that with attention.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा तस्य पुत्राश्च चत्वारो बटुकास्तदा । अभिषिक्ताश्चतुर्दिक्षु शिवेन परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA tasya putrAshcha chatvAro baTukAstadA | abhiShiktAshchaturdikShu shivena paramAtmanA
verses.translation: O brahmins, at that very time a certain cowherdess roaming here and there in that excellent city accompanied by her child came near Mahakala.
verses.hindi: सुप्रसिद्ध मुनि गौतमने आनन्दसे उसमें स्नान किया

verses.sanskrit: चण्डी चैवात्मनिकटे पुत्रं स्थाप्य सुदर्शनम् । तत्पुत्रान्प्रेरयामास वरान्दत्त्वा ह्यनेकशः
verses.transliteration: chaNDI chaivAtmanikaTe putraM sthApya sudarshanam | tatputrAnprerayAmAsa varAndattvA hyanekashaH
verses.translation: She had lost her husband. She carried her babe five years old. With great devotion she watched the Mahakala worship performed by the monarch.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण पापोंका अपहरण हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । उभयोर्व्यूहयोर्मध्ये बटुको यो भवेन्मम । तस्य स्याद्विजयो नित्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | ubhayorvyUhayormadhye baTuko yo bhavenmama | tasya syAdvijayo nityaM nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: After witnessing the wonderful $iva-worship performed by him and bowing down she returned to her camp.
verses.hindi: उन्हें देखकर वे गंगाजी शीघ्रतासे अन्तर्धान हो गयीं

verses.sanskrit: भवांश्च पूजितो येन तेनैवाहं प्रपूजिता । कर्तव्यं हि भवद्भिश्च स्वीयं कर्म सदा सुत
verses.transliteration: bhavAMshcha pUjito yena tenaivAhaM prapUjitA | kartavyaM hi bhavadbhishcha svIyaM karma sadA suta
verses.translation: The son of that cowherdess who had watched everything out of curiosity, thought of performing Siva's worship similarly.
verses.hindi: ऐसा मत कीजिये, ऐसा मत कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं तस्मै वरा दत्ताः सपुत्राय महात्मने । सुदर्शनाय कृपया शिवाभ्यां जगतां कृते
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM tasmai varA dattAH saputrAya mahAtmane | sudarshanAya kR^ipayA shivAbhyAM jagatAM kR^ite
verses.translation: He brought a fine pebble from somewhere and considered it his Sivalihga. He placed it in a vacant place not far from his camp. Various articles were conceived by him as sweet scents, ornaments, cloth, incense, lamp, rice grains and foodgrains in the course of his worship.
verses.hindi: इस पुण्यके प्रभावसे आप इन्हें दर्शन दीजिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवाभ्यां स्थापिता यस्मात्तस्मात्ते बटुकाः स्मृताः । तपोभ्रष्टा यतो जाताः स्मृतास्तस्मात्तपोऽधमाः
verses.transliteration: shivAbhyAM sthApitA yasmAttasmAtte baTukAH smR^itAH | tapobhraShTA yato jAtAH smR^itAstasmAttapo.adhamAH
verses.translation: Worshipping again and again with delightful leaves and flowers he danced in various ways and made obeisance again and again.

verses.sanskrit: शिवयोः कृपया सर्वे विस्तारं बहुधा गताः । तेषां च प्रथमा पूजा महापूजा महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: shivayoH kR^ipayA sarve vistAraM bahudhA gatAH | teShAM cha prathamA pUjA mahApUjA mahAtmanaH
verses.translation: When the son engrossed in the worship did not like to take meals though called many times, the mother went there.

verses.sanskrit: तेन यावत्कृता नैव पूजा वै शङ्करस्य च । तावत्पूजा न कर्त्तव्या कृता चेन्न शुभापि सा
verses.transliteration: tena yAvatkR^itA naiva pUjA vai sha~Nkarasya cha | tAvatpUjA na karttavyA kR^itA chenna shubhApi sA
verses.translation: On seeing him seated in front of Siva with eyes closed she angrily caught hold of his hand, dragged him and beat him.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां देवानां परमेश्वरः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा दुष्टहन्ता सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tadAkarNya vachasteShAM devAnAM parameshvaraH | pratyuvAcha prasannAtmA duShTahantA satAM gatiH
verses.translation: When the son did not come away even after being dragged and struck she threw the image far off and spoiled his worship.

verses.sanskrit: शुभं वाप्यशुभं वापि बटुकं न परित्यजेत् । प्राजापत्ये च भोज्ये वै बटुरेको विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: shubhaM vApyashubhaM vApi baTukaM na parityajet | prAjApatye cha bhojye vai baTureko vishiShyate
verses.translation: On seeing his worship spoilt by his mother, the boy fell down and lamented, "O lord, O lord."
verses.hindi: ही मोक्षका अधिकारी हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: शिवयोश्च तथा कार्ये विशेषोऽत्र प्रदृश्यते । तदेव शृणु सुप्राज्ञ यथाहं वच्मि तेऽनघ
verses.transliteration: shivayoshcha tathA kArye visheSho.atra pradR^ishyate | tadeva shR^iNu suprAj~na yathAhaM vachmi te.anagha
verses.translation: In his excessive grief he became unconscious su Idenly. Regaining consciousness after a while he opened his eyes.
verses.hindi: थी, वे लोग लज्जित हो गये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव नगरे राज्ञो भद्रस्य नित्यभोजने । प्राजापत्यस्य नियमे ह्यन्धकेशसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva nagare rAj~no bhadrasya nityabhojane | prAjApatyasya niyame hyandhakeshasamIpataH
verses.translation: Immediately the camp became a beautiful temple of Mahakala. Thanks to the blessings of Siva, that child saw all these.
verses.hindi: क्रद्ध होकर उन्हें शाप दिया था--आप ऐसा जानिये

verses.sanskrit: यज्जातमद्भुतं वृत्तं शिवानुग्रहकारणात् । श्रूयतां तच्च सुप्रीत्या कथयामि यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: yajjAtamadbhutaM vR^ittaM shivAnugrahakAraNAt | shrUyatAM tachcha suprItyA kathayAmi yathAshrutam
verses.translation: In the midst, the cowherd's son saw a jewel- ' bedecked linga of Siva, the storehouse of mercy, along with the articles he used for worshipping.

verses.sanskrit: ध्वज एकश्च तद्राज्ञे दत्तस्तुष्टेन शम्भुना । प्रोक्तश्च कृपया राजा देवदेवेन तेन सः
verses.transliteration: dhvaja ekashcha tadrAj~ne dattastuShTena shambhunA | proktashcha kR^ipayA rAjA devadevena tena saH
verses.translation: He eulogised and bowed to §iva again and again. When the sun set the boy came out of the $iva temple.
verses.hindi: उनकी फसलको चरनेके लिये छोड़ दिया

verses.sanskrit: प्रातश्च बध्यतां राजन्ध्वजो रात्रौ पतिष्यति । मम त्वेवं च सम्पूर्णे प्राजापत्ये तथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: prAtashcha badhyatAM rAjandhvajo rAtrau patiShyati | mama tvevaM cha sampUrNe prAjApatye tathA punaH
verses.translation: Then he saw his own camp as beautiful as the city of Indra. It had been suddenly transformed into one of gold, of variegated nature and shining much.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथायं ध्वजो मे हि रात्रावपि स्थिरो भवेत् । इत्युक्त्वान्तर्हितः शम्भू राज्ञे तुष्टः कृपानिधिः
verses.transliteration: anyathAyaM dhvajo me hi rAtrAvapi sthiro bhavet | ityuktvAntarhitaH shambhU rAj~ne tuShTaH kR^ipAnidhiH
verses.translation: He entered the house equipped with everything brilliant and glittering in the night. Jewels and gold pieces were scattered everywhere. He was joyous.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति नियमश्चासीत्तस्य राज्ञो महामुने । प्राजापत्यं कृतं नित्यं शिवपूजाविधानतः
verses.transliteration: tatheti niyamashchAsIttasya rAj~no mahAmune | prAjApatyaM kR^itaM nityaM shivapUjAvidhAnataH
verses.translation: O brahmins, then that son, the special object of

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं प्रातर्विवर्धेत ध्वजः सायं पतेदिति । यदि कार्यं च सम्पूर्णं जातं चैव भवेदिह
verses.transliteration: svayaM prAtarvivardheta dhvajaH sAyaM patediti | yadi kAryaM cha sampUrNaM jAtaM chaiva bhavediha
verses.translation: Getting up and seeing everything unprecedentedly wonderful, she was as it were immersed in great bliss. She embraced her son.
verses.hindi: यच्छुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशय: ॥ ४९ सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्समये चात्र बटोः कार्यं पुरा ह्यभूत् । ध्वजः स पतितो वै हि ब्रह्मभोजं विनापि हि
verses.transliteration: ekasminsamaye chAtra baToH kAryaM purA hyabhUt | dhvajaH sa patito vai hi brahmabhojaM vinApi hi
verses.translation: Hearing everything of the benign favour of the lord of ParvatT from her son she sent word of it to the monarch who was worshipping Siva constantly.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । घातयिष्यामि तं दैत्यमन्धकं सुरसूदनम् । सैन्यं च नीयतान्देवा ह्यायामि च गणैः सह
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | ghAtayiShyAmi taM daityamandhakaM surasUdanam | sainyaM cha nIyatAndevA hyAyAmi cha gaNaiH saha
verses.translation: The king who had concluded the observance of rites during the night came there immediately and saw the refulgence of the cowherd's son in propitiating Siva.
verses.hindi: लिये उसने दूसरे प्रकारका तप करना प्रारम्भ किया

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तच्च तदा तत्र पृष्टा राज्ञा च पण्डिताः । भुञ्जते ब्राह्मणा ह्यत्र नोत्थितो वै ध्वजस्त्विति
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA tachcha tadA tatra pR^iShTA rAj~nA cha paNDitAH | bhu~njate brAhmaNA hyatra notthito vai dhvajastviti
verses.translation: On seeing everything in the company of his ministers and chief priest the king was immersed in the ocean of great bliss and emboldened.

verses.sanskrit: कथं च पतितः सोऽत्र ब्राह्मणा ब्रूत सत्यतः । ते पृष्टाश्च तदा प्रोचुर्ब्राह्मणाः पण्डितोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kathaM cha patitaH so.atra brAhmaNA brUta satyataH | te pR^iShTAshcha tadA prochurbrAhmaNAH paNDitottamAH
verses.translation: Shedding tears of love and repeating the names of Siva with pleasure, the king Candrasena embraced the boy.
verses.hindi: सिर काटकर शिवका पूजन प्रारम्भ किया

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभोजे महाराज बटुको भोजितः पुरा । चण्डीपुत्रः शिवस्तुष्टस्तस्माच्च पतितो ध्वजः
verses.transliteration: brahmabhoje mahArAja baTuko bhojitaH purA | chaNDIputraH shivastuShTastasmAchcha patito dhvajaH
verses.translation: On account of this wonderful event, this mani¬ festation of the greatness of Siva and the flutter in the midst of the citizens, the night elapsed as though it was only a moment.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा नृपतिः सोऽथ जनाश्चान्येऽपि सर्वशः । अभवन्विस्मितास्तत्र प्रशंसां चक्रिरे ततः
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA nR^ipatiH so.atha janAshchAnye.api sarvashaH | abhavanvismitAstatra prashaMsAM chakrire tataH
verses.translation: The Jcings who had besieged the city for an attack heard of this event in the morning through their spies.
verses.hindi: इच्छाको पूर्ण कीजिये, मैं आपकी शरणमें हूँ

verses.sanskrit: एवं च महिमा तेषां वर्धितः शङ्करेण हि । तस्माच्च बटुकाः श्रेष्ठाः पुराविद्भिः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: evaM cha mahimA teShAM vardhitaH sha~NkareNa hi | tasmAchcha baTukAH shreShThAH purAvidbhiH prakIrtitAH
verses.translation: Extremely surprised on hearing it the kings who had come there met together and consulted one another.

verses.sanskrit: शिवपूजा तु तैः पूर्वमुत्तार्या नान्यथा पुनः । अन्येषां नाधिकारोऽस्ति शिवस्य वचनादिह
verses.transliteration: shivapUjA tu taiH pUrvamuttAryA nAnyathA punaH | anyeShAM nAdhikAro.asti shivasya vachanAdiha
verses.translation: Certainly Siva will be furious if we offend him. We will be doomed if Siva is furious.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तारणं च कार्यं वै पूजा पूर्णा भवत्विति । एतावदेव तेषां तु कार्यं नान्यत्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: uttAraNaM cha kAryaM vai pUjA pUrNA bhavatviti | etAvadeva teShAM tu kAryaM nAnyattathaiva cha
verses.translation: Thus deciding, the kings abandoned their enmity. They regained purity of mind. They were pleased. They abandoned their weapons and missiles.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं समाख्यातं यत्पृष्टं च मुनीश्वराः । यच्छ्रुत्वा शिवपूजायाः फलं प्राप्नोति वै नरः
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaM samAkhyAtaM yatpR^iShTaM cha munIshvarAH | yachChrutvA shivapUjAyAH phalaM prApnoti vai naraH
verses.translation: Permitted and encouraged by Gandrasena they entered Ujjayini, the beautiful city of Mahakala and worshipped him.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्गर्तादन्धके हि देवर्षिद्रुहि भीकरे । निःसृते च तदा तस्मिन्देवा गर्तमुपाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdgartAdandhake hi devarShidruhi bhIkare | niHsR^ite cha tadA tasmindevA gartamupAshritAH
verses.translation: Then they went to the house of the cowherdess. They praised her good fortune with divine blessings.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्याश्च देवताश्चैव युद्धं चक्रुः सुदारुणम् । शिवानुग्रहतो देवाः प्रबलाश्चाभवँस्तदा
verses.transliteration: daityAshcha devatAshchaiva yuddhaM chakruH sudAruNam | shivAnugrahato devAH prabalAshchAbhava.NstadA
verses.translation: They were welcomed and honoured by Gandrasena there. Seated on a very worthy seat they congratulated him and were surprised.
verses.hindi: पत्नीसे कहा और वह बहुत आनन्दित हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The delighted kings, sought the sympathy of Siva and presented several valuable things to the cowherd boy.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The delighted kings, sought the sympathy of Siva and presented several valuable things to the cowherd boy.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१४. चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः । सोमनाथज्योतिर्लिङ्गोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । ज्योतिषां चैव लिङ्गानां माहात्म्यं कथयाधुना । उत्पत्तिं च तथा तेषां ब्रूहि सर्वं यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.14\. chaturdasho.adhyAyaH | somanAthajyotirli~NgotpattivarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | jyotiShAM chaiva li~NgAnAM mAhAtmyaM kathayAdhunA | utpattiM cha tathA teShAM brUhi sarvaM yathAshrutam
verses.translation: The kings made him the chieftain of cowherds in all their different lands.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षः स च तथा श्रुत्वा दुःखं च प्राप्तावांस्तदा । समागत्य द्विजाश्चन्द्रं शान्त्यावोचद् वचस्तदा
verses.transliteration: dakShaH sa cha tathA shrutvA duHkhaM cha prAptAvAMstadA | samAgatya dvijAshchandraM shAntyAvochad vachastadA
verses.translation: In the meantime Hanumat, the brilliant lord of monkeys, worshipped by the gods manifested himself there.

verses.sanskrit: दक्ष उवाच । विमले च कुले त्वं हि समुत्पन्नः कलानिधे । आश्रितेषु च सर्वेषु न्यूनाधिक्यं कथं तव
verses.transliteration: dakSha uvAcha | vimale cha kule tvaM hi samutpannaH kalAnidhe | AshriteShu cha sarveShu nyUnAdhikyaM kathaM tava
verses.translation: The kings were bewildered at his arrival. They rose up in reverence and made obeisance to him perfectly humble in their devotion.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं चेत्तत्कृतं तच्च न कर्तव्यं त्वया पुनः । वर्तनं विषमत्वेन नरकप्रदमीरितम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itaM chettatkR^itaM tachcha na kartavyaM tvayA punaH | vartanaM viShamatvena narakapradamIritam
verses.translation: Worshipped by them and seated in their midst the lord of monkeys embraced the cowherd boy and glanced at the kings and said.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । दक्षश्चैवं च सम्प्रार्थ्य चन्द्रं जामातरं स्वयम् । जगाम मन्दिरं स्वं वै निश्चयं परमं गतः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | dakShashchaivaM cha samprArthya chandraM jAmAtaraM svayam | jagAma mandiraM svaM vai nishchayaM paramaM gataH
verses.translation: Weal unto ye all, O kings and all the souls here, listen. Except iSiva there is no other goal to human beings.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रोऽपि वचनं तस्य न चकार विमोहितः । शिवमायाप्रभावेण यया सम्मोहितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: chandro.api vachanaM tasya na chakAra vimohitaH | shivamAyAprabhAveNa yayA sammohitaM jagat
verses.translation: This cowherd boy fortunately saw the worship of Siva. Without the use of mantras he worshipped Siva and attained happiness.

verses.sanskrit: शुभं भावि यदा यस्य शुभं भवति तस्य वै । अशुभं च यदा भावि कथं तस्य शुभं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: shubhaM bhAvi yadA yasya shubhaM bhavati tasya vai | ashubhaM cha yadA bhAvi kathaM tasya shubhaM bhavet
verses.translation: This boy, the most excellent devotee of Siva, the enhancer of the glory of cowherds, shall enjoy all pleasures here and attain salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रोऽपि बलवद्भाविवशान्मेने न तद्वचः । रोहिण्यां च समासक्तो नान्यां मेने कदाचन
verses.transliteration: chandro.api balavadbhAvivashAnmene na tadvachaH | rohiNyAM cha samAsakto nAnyAM mene kadAchana
verses.translation: In his race, in the eighth generation, there will be a famous cowherd Nanda. Vi§nu himself will be born as his son, Kfna.
verses.hindi: उन्हें प्रणाम किया तथा उनकी स्तुति की

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा पुनरागत्य स्वयं दुःखसमन्वितः । प्रार्थयामास चन्द्रं स दक्षो दक्षः सुनीतितः
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA punarAgatya svayaM duHkhasamanvitaH | prArthayAmAsa chandraM sa dakSho dakShaH sunItitaH
verses.translation: Henceforth this cowherd boy will attain glory all over the world in the name of iSrIkara.
verses.hindi: लिये क्या दुर्लभ हो सकता है !

verses.sanskrit: दक्ष उवाच । श्रूयतां चन्द्र यत्पूर्वं प्रार्थितो बहुधा मया । न मानितं त्वया यस्मात्तस्मात्त्वं च क्षयी भव
verses.transliteration: dakSha uvAcha | shrUyatAM chandra yatpUrvaM prArthito bahudhA mayA | na mAnitaM tvayA yasmAttasmAttvaM cha kShayI bhava
verses.translation: After saying this, the son of Aujana*' the lord of monkeys in the form of Siva mercifully glanced at the kings and Candrasena.
verses.hindi: कहकर मेरा सारा मनोवांछित पूर्ण कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्ते तेन चन्द्रो वै क्षयी जातः क्षणादिह । हाहाकारो महानासीत्तदेन्दौ क्षीणतां गते
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityukte tena chandro vai kShayI jAtaH kShaNAdiha | hAhAkAro mahAnAsIttadendau kShINatAM gate
verses.translation: He then initiated the intelligent cowherd child Srikara with pleasure in the rites of Siva pleasing to the lord.
verses.hindi: नामसे तीनों लोकोंमें प्रसिद्ध हो गये

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । शृण्वन्तु विप्रा वक्ष्यामि तन्माहात्म्यं जनिं तथा । सङ्क्षेपतो यथाबुद्धि सद्गुरोश्च मया श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | shR^iNvantu viprA vakShyAmi tanmAhAtmyaM janiM tathA | sa~NkShepato yathAbuddhi sadguroshcha mayA shrutam
verses.translation: O brahmins even as all of them were glancing at Candrasena and Srikara, the delighted Hanumat vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षयस्तदा सर्वे किं कार्यं हा कथं भवेत् । इति दुःखं समापन्ना विह्वला ह्यभवन्मुने
verses.transliteration: devarShayastadA sarve kiM kAryaM hA kathaM bhavet | iti duHkhaM samApannA vihvalA hyabhavanmune
verses.translation: The delighted kings who were duly honoured took leave of Candrasena and returned the way they had come.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञापिताश्च चन्द्रेण सर्वे शक्रादयः सुराः । ऋषयश्च वसिष्ठाद्या ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: vij~nApitAshcha chandreNa sarve shakrAdayaH surAH | R^iShayashcha vasiShThAdyA brahmANaM sharaNaM yayuH
verses.translation: The brilliant Srikara, initiated by Hanumat, propitiated Siva along with brahmins well-versed in sacred rites.
verses.hindi: है, उसे तुम कदापि सत्य मत मानना

verses.sanskrit: गत्वापि तु तदा प्रोचुस्तद् वृत्तं निखिलं मुने । ब्रह्मणे ऋषयो देवा नत्वा नुत्वातिविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: gatvApi tu tadA prochustad vR^ittaM nikhilaM mune | brahmaNe R^iShayo devA natvA nutvAtivihvalAH
verses.translation: The king Candrasena and Srikara, the cowherd boy, worshipped Mahakala with great devotion and pleasure.
verses.hindi: बूझकर तुम जैसा चाहो, वैसा करो

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मापि तद्वचः श्रुत्वा विस्मयं परमं ययौ । शिवमायां सुप्रशस्य श्रावयंस्तानुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: brahmApi tadvachaH shrutvA vismayaM paramaM yayau | shivamAyAM suprashasya shrAvayaMstAnuvAcha ha
verses.translation: In due course, Srikara and Candrasena propitiat¬ ing Mahakala attained the great region of lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । अहो कष्टं महज्जातं सर्वलोकस्य दुःखदम् । चन्द्रस्तु सर्वदा दुष्टो दक्षश्च शप्तवानमुम्
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | aho kaShTaM mahajjAtaM sarvalokasya duHkhadam | chandrastu sarvadA duShTo dakShashcha shaptavAnamum
verses.translation: Thus the great secret, the sanctifying narrative that bestows all happiness, conducive to heaven and enhancing devotion to Siva has been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: घमण्डको दूर करनेवाला यहाँ कोई उत्पन्न होगा

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं दुष्टेन चन्द्रेण कृतं कर्माप्यनेकशः । श्रूयतामृषयो देवाश्चन्द्रकृत्यं पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaM duShTena chandreNa kR^itaM karmApyanekashaH | shrUyatAmR^iShayo devAshchandrakR^ityaM purAtanam
verses.translation: O Suta, O fortunate Suta, a wonderful story has been narrated of Mahakala, the phallic image of Siva that protects his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेर्गृहं गत्वा तारा दुष्टेन वै हृता । तस्य भार्या पुनश्चैव स दैत्यान्समुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: bR^ihaspatergR^ihaM gatvA tArA duShTena vai hR^itA | tasya bhAryA punashchaiva sa daityAnsamupasthitaH
verses.translation: O foremost of the wise, please describe the fourth Jyotirlinga of the great lord, the destroyer of all sins, in Omkara.
verses.hindi: कोई भी शत्रु उस समय नहीं रहा

verses.sanskrit: समाश्रितस्तदा दैत्यान्युद्धं देवैश्चकार ह । मयात्रिणा निषिद्धश्च तस्मै तारां ददौ शशी
verses.transliteration: samAshritastadA daityAnyuddhaM devaishchakAra ha | mayAtriNA niShiddhashcha tasmai tArAM dadau shashI
verses.translation: O brahmins, O great sages, I shall describe to you with pleasure how the phallic image of lord Siva named Paramela manifested from Omkara. Let it be heard.
verses.hindi: माहात्यं श्रृण्वतां पाप॑ नृणां भवति भस्मसात्॥ ७६  पाप विनष्ट हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: तां च गर्भवतीं दृष्ट्वा न गृह्णामीति सोऽब्रवीत् । अस्माभिर्वारितो जीवः कृच्छ्राज्जग्राह तां तदा
verses.transliteration: tAM cha garbhavatIM dR^iShTvA na gR^ihNAmIti so.abravIt | asmAbhirvArito jIvaH kR^ichChrAjjagrAha tAM tadA
verses.translation: Once, the holy sage Narada served with great devo¬ tion the phallic form of Siva named Gokarna after going there.
verses.hindi: हति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे चदुर्थ्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां वेद्यनाथेश्चरज्योतिरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नामाष्टाविंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: यदि गर्भं जहातीह गृह्णामीत्यब्रवीत्पुनः । गर्भे मया पुनस्तत्र त्याजिते मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yadi garbhaM jahAtIha gR^ihNAmItyabravItpunaH | garbhe mayA punastatra tyAjite munisattamAH
verses.translation: From there the excellent sage came to Vindhya,*® the lord of mountains. He was duly worshipped by the mountain with great honour.
verses.hindi: माहात्म्यवर्णन नामक अट्डाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां चैव माहात्म्यं वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि । शक्यते न मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तथापि कथयामि वः
verses.transliteration: eteShAM chaiva mAhAtmyaM vaktuM varShashatairapi | shakyate na munishreShThAstathApi kathayAmi vaH
verses.translation: "Every thing is present in me. I am not deficient in anything." It was with this obsession that he sat in front of Narada.
verses.hindi: प्रकार उत्पत्ति हुई, उसे कह रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: कस्यायं च पुनर्गर्भः सोमस्येति च साब्रवीत् । पश्चात्तेन गृहीता सा मया च वारितेन वै
verses.transliteration: kasyAyaM cha punargarbhaH somasyeti cha sAbravIt | pashchAttena gR^ihItA sA mayA cha vAritena vai
verses.translation: On knowing his arrogance, Narada the dispeller of pride heaved a sigh and stayed there. On hearing that Vindhya spoke again.
verses.hindi: तथा लोगोंके धर्मका ध्वंस किया करता था

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधानि चन्द्रस्य दुश्चरित्राण्यनेकशः । वर्ण्यन्ते किं पुनस्तानि सोऽद्यापि कुरुते कथम्
verses.transliteration: evaMvidhAni chandrasya dushcharitrANyanekashaH | varNyante kiM punastAni so.adyApi kurute katham
verses.translation: "What deficiency do you observe in me that you heave this deep breath?" On hearing these words, the great sage Narada spoke again.
verses.hindi: साथ वहाँ निवासकर सभीको भय देने लगा

verses.sanskrit: यज्जातं तत् सुसञ्जातं नान्यथा भवति ध्रुवम् । अतः परमुपायं वो वक्ष्यामि शृणुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: yajjAtaM tat susa~njAtaM nAnyathA bhavati dhruvam | ataH paramupAyaM vo vakShyAmi shR^iNutAdarAt
verses.translation: After saying this Narada left the place and went in the manner he had come. Vindhya was distressed. "O fie upon my life", he exclaimed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभासके शुभे क्षेत्रे व्रजेश्चन्द्रः सदैवतैः । शिवमाराधयेत्तत्र मृत्युञ्जयविधानतः
verses.transliteration: prabhAsake shubhe kShetre vrajeshchandraH sadaivataiH | shivamArAdhayettatra mR^ityu~njayavidhAnataH
verses.translation: "I shall propitiate Siva, the lord of the universe and perform penance." Deciding thus in his mind he sought refuge in Siva.
verses.hindi: यामो यस्य समीपे तु स्थित्वा सुखमवाप्नुम: ॥ १० और वहाँ रहकर सुख प्राप्त करें

verses.sanskrit: निधायेशं पुरस्तत्र चन्द्रस्तपतु नित्यशः । प्रसन्नश्च शिवः पश्चादक्षयं तं करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: nidhAyeshaM purastatra chandrastapatu nityashaH | prasannashcha shivaH pashchAdakShayaM taM kariShyati
verses.translation: With great pleasure he went to the place where Omkara himself was present. There he made an earthen idol of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य ब्रह्मणस्ते सुरर्षयः । सन्निवृत्याययुः सर्वे यत्र दक्षविधू ततः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasya brahmaNaste surarShayaH | sannivR^ityAyayuH sarve yatra dakShavidhU tataH
verses.translation: Continuously for six months he propitiated Siva. Engaged in meditation on Siva he never moved from the place of penance.
verses.hindi: साथ युद्धके लिये वहाँ उपस्थित हुए

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा ते ततश्चन्द्रं दक्षं चाश्वास्य निर्जराः । प्रभासे ऋषयश्चक्रुस्तत्र गत्वाखिलाश्च वै
verses.transliteration: gR^ihItvA te tatashchandraM dakShaM chAshvAsya nirjarAH | prabhAse R^iShayashchakrustatra gatvAkhilAshcha vai
verses.translation: On seeing the penance of Vindhya, Siva, the de¬ lighted consort of Parvati, revealed to him his real form inaccessible even to the Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: आवाह्य तीर्थवर्याणि सरस्वत्यादिकानि च । पार्थिवेन तदा पूजां मृत्युञ्जयविधानतः
verses.transliteration: AvAhya tIrthavaryANi sarasvatyAdikAni cha | pArthivena tadA pUjAM mR^ityu~njayavidhAnataH
verses.translation: Delightedly he said—"Tell me what you wish in your mind. I am delighted with your penance. I fulfil the desires of my devotees."

verses.sanskrit: ते देवाश्च तदा सर्वे ऋषयो निर्मलाशयाः । स्थाप्य चन्द्रं प्रभासे च स्वं स्वं धाम ययुर्मुदा
verses.transliteration: te devAshcha tadA sarve R^iShayo nirmalAshayAH | sthApya chandraM prabhAse cha svaM svaM dhAma yayurmudA
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, give m< such intellect as I may achieve my object. O Siva, you an always favourably disposed towards your devotees.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रेण च तपस्तप्तं षण्मासं च निरन्तरम् । मृत्युञ्जयेन मन्त्रेण पूजितो वृषभध्वजः
verses.transliteration: chandreNa cha tapastaptaM ShaNmAsaM cha nirantaram | mR^ityu~njayena mantreNa pUjito vR^iShabhadhvajaH
verses.translation: On hearing that, lord Siva thought within him¬ self—"This Vindhya of deluded intellect desires for a boon capable of harassing others.

verses.sanskrit: सोमनाथश्च तेषां वै प्रथमः परिकीर्तितः । तन्माहात्म्यं शृणु मुने प्रथमं सावधानतः
verses.transliteration: somanAthashcha teShAM vai prathamaH parikIrtitaH | tanmAhAtmyaM shR^iNu mune prathamaM sAvadhAnataH
verses.translation: What shall I do? I shall grant him that boor which being auspicious for him may not harass others?"
verses.hindi: जानेका मार्ग रोककर स्थित हो गयी

verses.sanskrit: दशकोटिमितं मन्त्रं समावृत्य शशी च तम् । ध्यात्वा मृत्युञ्जयं मन्त्रं तस्थौ निश्चलमानसः
verses.transliteration: dashakoTimitaM mantraM samAvR^itya shashI cha tam | dhyAtvA mR^ityu~njayaM mantraM tasthau nishchalamAnasaH
verses.translation: Still Siva granted him that excellent boon ''O Vindhya, king of mountains, do as you please."

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा शङ्करो देवः प्रसन्नोऽभूत्ततः प्रभुः । आविर्भूय विधुं प्राह स्वभक्तं भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA sha~Nkaro devaH prasanno.abhUttataH prabhuH | AvirbhUya vidhuM prAha svabhaktaM bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: At this time the gods and the sages worshipped Siva and said—"You must stay here."

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते मनसा यत्समीप्सितम् । प्रसन्नोऽहं शशिन्सर्वं दास्ये वरमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | varaM vR^iNIShva bhadraM te manasA yatsamIpsitam | prasanno.ahaM shashinsarvaM dAsye varamanuttamam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the gods, the delighted lord Siva did so with pleasure for the happiness of the worlds.
verses.hindi: दृढ़ बेड़ियोंसे बाँधकर कारागारमें डाल दिया

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्र उवाच । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश किमसाध्यं भवेन्मम । तथापि मे शरीरस्य क्षयं वारय शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: chandra uvAcha | yadi prasanno devesha kimasAdhyaM bhavenmama | tathApi me sharIrasya kShayaM vAraya sha~Nkara
verses.translation: Tha phallus image of!§iva known as Oriikara is twofold. In the Pranava, Sadaiva came to be known as Oihkara.
verses.hindi: जिसके कारण वे अत्यधिक दु:ख पा रहे थे

verses.sanskrit: क्षन्तव्यो मेऽपराधश्च कल्याणं कुरु सर्वदा । इत्युक्ते च तदा तेन शिवो वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: kShantavyo me.aparAdhashcha kalyANaM kuru sarvadA | ityukte cha tadA tena shivo vachanamabravIt
verses.translation: The gods and the sages performed his worship then. After propitiating the bull-bannered deity they attained many boons.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । पक्षे च क्षीयतां चन्द्र कला ते च दिने दिने । पुनश्च वर्धतां पक्षे सा कला च निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | pakShe cha kShIyatAM chandra kalA te cha dine dine | punashcha vardhatAM pakShe sA kalA cha nirantaram
verses.translation: O brahmins, the gods returned to their abodes. Vindhya was much delighted. He realised his object and eschewed his despair.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं सति तदा देवा हर्षनिर्भरमानसाः । ऋषयश्च तथा सर्वे समाजग्मुर्द्रुतं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM sati tadA devA harShanirbharamAnasAH | R^iShayashcha tathA sarve samAjagmurdrutaM dvijAH
verses.translation: He who worships Siva in this manner will not stay in the mother's womb. He will obtain all the fruits desired. There is no doubt in this.

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य च तदा सर्वे चन्द्रायाशिषमब्रुवन् । शिवं नत्वा करौ बद्ध्वा प्रार्थयामासुरादरात्
verses.transliteration: Agatya cha tadA sarve chandrAyAshiShamabruvan | shivaM natvA karau baddhvA prArthayAmAsurAdarAt
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated to you the fruit of worship¬ ping Oihkara. Hereafter I shall mention the glory of Kedara, the excellent phallic form of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: देवाः ऊचुः । देवदेव महादेव परमेश नमोऽस्तु ते । उमया सहितः शम्भो स्वामिन्नत्र स्थिरो भव
verses.transliteration: devAH UchuH | devadeva mahAdeva paramesha namo.astu te | umayA sahitaH shambho svAminnatra sthiro bhava
verses.translation: O brahmins, the incirnations of Vi?nu—Nara and Narayana performed their penance in the Bharata Khanda in the hermitage of Badarikarama.'*®
verses.hindi: हुआ, उसे आपलोग सावधान मनसे सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । ततश्चन्द्रेण सद्भक्त्या संस्तुतः शङ्करः पुरा । निराकारश्च साकारः पुनश्चैवाभवत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tatashchandreNa sadbhaktyA saMstutaH sha~NkaraH purA | nirAkArashcha sAkAraH punashchaivAbhavatprabhuH
verses.translation: Requested by them for their worship, Siva, being subservient to the devotees comes every day to that earthen phallic image of Siva.
verses.hindi: गति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे चतु॒र्ध्या कोटिरखसंहितायां नागेश्रण्योविरलिंगमाहात््ये दारकावनराक्षसोपद्रववर्णन॑ नामेकोनत्रिंशो5 ध्यायः

verses.sanskrit: सप्तविंशन्मिताः कन्या दक्षेण च महात्मना । तेन चन्द्रमसे दत्ता अश्विन्याद्या मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: saptaviMshanmitAH kanyA dakSheNa cha mahAtmanA | tena chandramase dattA ashvinyAdyA munIshvarAH
verses.translation: A long time elapsed while these two incarnations of Vistiu, the spiritual sons of Siva, performed the worship of Siva.
verses.hindi: राक्षसोपद्रवरवर्णन नामक उनतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नश्च स देवानां क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यहेतवे । चन्द्रस्य यशसे तत्र नाम्ना चन्द्रस्य शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: prasannashcha sa devAnAM kShetramAhAtmyahetave | chandrasya yashase tatra nAmnA chandrasya sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: On one occasion the delighted Siva told them—**I am delighted. Choose your boon from me."
verses.hindi: समक्ष स्थित हुए शिवजीका सुन्दर रूप देखा

verses.sanskrit: सोमेश्वरश्च नाम्नासीद्विख्यातो भुवनत्रये । क्षयकुष्ठादिरोगाणां नाशकः पूजनाद् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: someshvarashcha nAmnAsIdvikhyAto bhuvanatraye | kShayakuShThAdirogANAM nAshakaH pUjanAd dvijAH
verses.translation: When he said this, Nara and Narayana spoke these words keeping in mind the welfare of the world.
verses.hindi: वहाँ आकर शिवके विषयमें उससे पूछा--

verses.sanskrit: धन्योऽयं कृतकृत्योऽयं यन्नाम्ना शङ्करः स्वयम् । स्थितश्च जगतां नाथः पावयञ्जगतीतलम्
verses.transliteration: dhanyo.ayaM kR^itakR^ityo.ayaM yannAmnA sha~NkaraH svayam | sthitashcha jagatAM nAthaH pAvaya~njagatItalam
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if the boon is to be granted by you, O Siva, stay here in your own form and accept the devotion of your devotees.
verses.hindi: मारे जाओगे, मेरी बात कभी झूठी नहीं होती

verses.sanskrit: तत्कुण्डं तैश्च तत्रैव सर्वैर्देवैः प्रतिष्ठितम् । शिवेन ब्रह्मणा तत्र ह्यविभक्तं तु तत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: tatkuNDaM taishcha tatraiva sarvairdevaiH pratiShThitam | shivena brahmaNA tatra hyavibhaktaM tu tatpunaH
verses.translation: Thus requested, lord Siva himself stayed in Kcdara on the Himavat in the form of Jyotirlihga.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रकुण्डं प्रसिद्धं च पृथिव्यां पापनाशनम् । तत्र स्नाति नरो यः स सर्वैः पापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: chandrakuNDaM prasiddhaM cha pR^ithivyAM pApanAshanam | tatra snAti naro yaH sa sarvaiH pApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: Then Siva himself stayed there in the name of Kedaresvara. By his sight and worship he bestows the desires of the devotees.
verses.hindi: इस दुष्टसे रक्षा कीजिये, रक्षा कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: रोगाः सर्वे क्षयाद्याश्च ह्यसाध्या ये भवन्ति वै । ते सर्वे च क्षयं यान्ति षण्मासं स्नानमात्रतः
verses.transliteration: rogAH sarve kShayAdyAshcha hyasAdhyA ye bhavanti vai | te sarve cha kShayaM yAnti ShaNmAsaM snAnamAtrataH
verses.translation: The gods and the sages of yore worship here. They get the fruit of their desire from the delighted lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभासं च परिक्रम्य पृथिवीक्रमसम्भवम् । फलं प्राप्नोति शुद्धात्मा मृतः स्वर्गे महीयते
verses.transliteration: prabhAsaM cha parikramya pR^ithivIkramasambhavam | phalaM prApnoti shuddhAtmA mR^itaH svarge mahIyate
verses.translation: Since the residents of Badarikasrama derive their desires every day by worshipping him, he is called the bes- tower of the desires of his devotees ever.
verses.hindi: मन्दिरके सहित शिवजी उस विवरसे प्रकट हुए

verses.sanskrit: सोमलिङ्गं नरो दृष्ट्वा सर्वपापात्प्रमुच्यते । लब्ध्वा फलं मनोऽभीष्टं मृतः स्वर्गं समीहते
verses.transliteration: somali~NgaM naro dR^iShTvA sarvapApAtpramuchyate | labdhvA phalaM mano.abhIShTaM mR^itaH svargaM samIhate
verses.translation: From that day onwards, if anyone worships Kedaresvara with devotion he will not suffer distress even in dreams.
verses.hindi: अद्भुत शिवका रूप देखकर उसने पूजन किया

verses.sanskrit: यद्यत्फलं समुद्दिश्य कुरुते तीर्थमुत्तमम् । तत्तत्फलमवाप्नोति सर्वथा नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: yadyatphalaM samuddishya kurute tIrthamuttamam | tattatphalamavApnoti sarvathA nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: He remained in that form in the name of Bhakta- vatsala. His head portion went and remained fixed in the city of Nayapala.*®® The lord stood in that form there.

verses.sanskrit: इति ते ऋषयो देवाः फलं दृष्ट्वा तथाविधम् । मुदा शिवं नमस्कृत्य गृहीत्वा चन्द्रमक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: iti te R^iShayo devAH phalaM dR^iShTvA tathAvidham | mudA shivaM namaskR^itya gR^ihItvA chandramakShayam
verses.translation: He asked them to worship him in that trunkless form. Worshipped by them, Siva remained there and granted boons.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रं च स्वामिनं प्राप्य शोभमाना विशेषतः । चन्द्रोऽपि चैव ताः प्राप्य शोभते स्म निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: chandraM cha svAminaM prApya shobhamAnA visheShataH | chandro.api chaiva tAH prApya shobhate sma nirantaram
verses.translation: The Pandavas went away with joy after worship-
verses.hindi: मुनि ही होंगे, तमोगुणी लोग कभी नहीं होंगे

verses.sanskrit: परिक्रम्य च तत्तीर्थं प्रशंसन्तश्च ते ययुः । चन्द्रश्चापि स्वकीयं च कार्यं चक्रे पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: parikramya cha tattIrthaM prashaMsantashcha te yayuH | chandrashchApi svakIyaM cha kAryaM chakre purAtanam
verses.translation: Sec P. 1296 note.

verses.sanskrit: इति सर्वः समाख्यातः सोमेशस्य समुद्भवः । एवं सोमेश्वरं लिङ्गं समुत्पन्नं मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: iti sarvaH samAkhyAtaH someshasya samudbhavaH | evaM someshvaraM li~NgaM samutpannaM munIshvarAH
verses.translation: lie who makes a gift of a ring or a bracelet after going there becomes a beloved of Siva. He comes very near the form of Siva. He is endowed with the form of Siva. On seeing that form of Siva, a person gets rid of sins. By going to Badari forest he becomes a living liberated soul.

verses.sanskrit: यः शृणोति तदुत्पत्तिं श्रावयेद्वा परान्नरः । सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yaH shR^iNoti tadutpattiM shrAvayedvA parAnnaraH | sarvAnkAmAnavApnoti sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: On seeing the forms of Nara, Narayana and Keda- resvara, undoubtedly he can achieve liberation.
verses.hindi: लिये इस बनमें प्रीतिपूर्वक निवास करूँगा

verses.sanskrit: हेम्ना चैव मणिर्भाति मणिना हेम चैव हि । एवं च समये तस्य यज्जातं श्रूयतामिति
verses.transliteration: hemnA chaiva maNirbhAti maNinA hema chaiva hi | evaM cha samaye tasya yajjAtaM shrUyatAmiti
verses.translation: The devotees of Kedaresa who die on the way are released from rebirth. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वास्वपि च पत्नीषु रोहिणी नाम या स्मृता । यथैका सा प्रिया चासीत्तथान्या न कदाचन
verses.transliteration: sarvAsvapi cha patnIShu rohiNI nAma yA smR^itA | yathaikA sA priyA chAsIttathAnyA na kadAchana
verses.translation: Going there, with pleasure, worshipping Kedaresa and drinking the water there a person is released from re-birth.

verses.sanskrit: अन्याश्च दुःखमापन्नाः पितरं शरणं ययुः । गत्वा तस्मै च यद्दुःखं तथा ताभिर्निवेदितम्
verses.transliteration: anyAshcha duHkhamApannAH pitaraM sharaNaM yayuH | gatvA tasmai cha yadduHkhaM tathA tAbhirniveditam
verses.translation: O brahmins, in this Bharata country people should worship with devotion Nara-Niirayanesvara and Kedaresa.
verses.hindi: हुआ, जो शिवका अत्यन्त प्रिय था

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: With a desire to bless the worlds Siva himself, the receptacle of welfare and happiness, took his incarnation in Kamarupa.**
verses.hindi: बारह वर्षपर्यन्त अत्यन्त कठिन तप किया

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: With a desire to bless the worlds Siva himself, the receptacle of welfare and happiness, took his incarnation in Kamarupa.**

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१५. पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः । मल्लिकार्जुननामकद्वितीयज्योतिर्लिङ्गवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि मल्लिकार्जुनसम्भवम् । यं श्रुत्वा भक्तिमान्धीमान्सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.15\. pa~nchadasho.adhyAyaH | mallikArjunanAmakadvitIyajyotirli~NgavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | ataH paraM pravakShyAmi mallikArjunasambhavam | yaM shrutvA bhaktimAndhImAnsarvapApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall tell you why Siva, the bene¬ factor of the people, took the incarnation. Please listen with respect.
verses.hindi: हति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे च॒ुर्थ्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां नागेक्षज्योतिर्लियोद्धवमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम त्रिंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा च ते सर्वे कुमारं सुप्रणम्य च । विज्ञाप्य बहुधाप्येनं प्रार्थनां चक्रुरादरात्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvA cha te sarve kumAraM supraNamya cha | vij~nApya bahudhApyenaM prArthanAM chakrurAdarAt
verses.translation: When Kumbhakarna, the terror of the worlds, was killed by Rama, the ogress remained on the Sahya alone in the company of her son.
verses.hindi: ज्योतिर्लियोद्धवमाहात्य्यवर्णन नामक तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: देवादिप्रार्थनां तां च शिवाज्ञासङ्कुलां गुरुः । न मेने स कुमारो हि महाहङ्कारविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: devAdiprArthanAM tAM cha shivAj~nAsa~NkulAM guruH | na mene sa kumAro hi mahAha~NkAravihvalaH
verses.translation: O brahmins, once Bhima, the wicked tormentor of the worlds, of terrible exploits, while yet a boy asked his mother Karkati.
verses.hindi: प्राप्तकर वे रामचन्द्रजी बहुत प्रसन्‍न हुए

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च पुनरावृत्य सर्वे ते हि शिवान्तिकम् । स्वं स्वं स्थानं गता नत्वा प्राप्य शङ्करशासनम्
verses.transliteration: tatashcha punarAvR^itya sarve te hi shivAntikam | svaM svaM sthAnaM gatA natvA prApya sha~NkarashAsanam
verses.translation: Asked thus by her son the defiled ogress spoke to her son. Listen, I shall tell you.
verses.hindi: कुछ वानरोंको भेजकर शीघ्र जल मँगाओ

verses.sanskrit: तदा च गिरिजा देवी विरहं पुत्रसम्भवम् । शम्भुश्च परमं दुःखं प्राप तस्मिन्ननागते
verses.transliteration: tadA cha girijA devI virahaM putrasambhavam | shambhushcha paramaM duHkhaM prApa tasminnanAgate
verses.translation: Once that powerful demon Kumbhakarna had been here. He caught me forcefully and enjoyed me.
verses.hindi: आगे खड़े हो प्रणामकर उन सबने कहा--

verses.sanskrit: अथो सुदुःखितौ दीनौ लोकाचारकरौ तदा । जग्मतुस्तत्र सुस्नेहात्स्वपुत्रो यत्र संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: atho suduHkhitau dInau lokAchArakarau tadA | jagmatustatra susnehAtsvaputro yatra saMsthitaH
verses.translation: That powerful demon left me here itself and rc-
verses.hindi: कृपादृष्टिसे देखकर स्वयं वह जल ग्रहण किया

verses.sanskrit: स पुत्रश्च कुमाराख्यः पित्रोरागमनं गिरेः । ज्ञात्वा दूरं गतोऽस्नेहाद्योजनत्रयमेव च
verses.transliteration: sa putrashcha kumArAkhyaH pitrorAgamanaM gireH | j~nAtvA dUraM gato.asnehAdyojanatrayameva cha
verses.translation: It stands in the northern position of the Western Ghats exclud¬ ing the Travancore hills. It is the source of Kaveri, Krwia, Nirvindhya and other rivers.
verses.hindi: चित्तवाले मुझ अपने भक्तकी रक्षा कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रौञ्चे च पर्वते दूरं गते तस्मिन्स्वपुत्रके । तौ च तत्र समासीनौ ज्योतीरूपं समाश्रितौ
verses.transliteration: krau~nche cha parvate dUraM gate tasminsvaputrake | tau cha tatra samAsInau jyotIrUpaM samAshritau
verses.translation: When they had been there for food, the infuriated disciple of Agastya, the noble Sutiksnaof good penance re¬ duced them to ashes.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रस्नेहातुरौ तौ वै शिवौ पर्वणि पर्वणि । दर्शनार्थं कुमारस्य स्वपुत्रस्य हि गच्छतः
verses.transliteration: putrasnehAturau tau vai shivau parvaNi parvaNi | darshanArthaM kumArasya svaputrasya hi gachChataH
verses.translation: You were born after that. You have great strength and exploit. Depending on you I spend my days here.

verses.sanskrit: अमावास्यादिने शम्भुः स्वयं गच्छति तत्र ह । पौर्णमासीदिने तत्र पार्वती गच्छति ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: amAvAsyAdine shambhuH svayaM gachChati tatra ha | paurNamAsIdine tatra pArvatI gachChati dhruvam
verses.translation: On hearing this, Bhima of terrible exploits was angry and thought "What am I to do against Vi§nu?
verses.hindi: भगवान् शंकर अत्यन्त प्रसन्‍न हो उठे

verses.sanskrit: तद्दिनं हि समारभ्य मल्लिकार्जुनसम्भवम् । लिङ्गं चैव शिवस्यैकं प्रसिद्धं भुवनत्रये
verses.transliteration: taddinaM hi samArabhya mallikArjunasambhavam | li~NgaM chaiva shivasyaikaM prasiddhaM bhuvanatraye
verses.translation: If I am the true son of my mother I shall surely harass Visnu. Thinking thus Bhima went to perform a great penance.
verses.hindi: राम! तुम्हारा कल्याण हो, वर माँगो

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं च कथितं यच्च तत्पुनः कथयाम्यहम् । कुमारचरितं दिव्यं सर्वपापविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: pUrvaM cha kathitaM yachcha tatpunaH kathayAmyaham | kumAracharitaM divyaM sarvapApavinAshanam
verses.translation: With Brahma as the goal of his meditation he performed a great penance for a thousand years.
verses.hindi: युद्धमें अपनी विजयके लिये प्रार्थना की

verses.sanskrit: तल्लिङ्गं यः समीक्षेत स सर्वैः किल्बिषैरपि । मुच्यते नात्र सन्देहः सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: talli~NgaM yaH samIkSheta sa sarvaiH kilbiShairapi | muchyate nAtra sandehaH sarvAnkAmAnavApnuyAt
verses.translation: He kept his arms lifted up; he stood on a single foot. He fixed his vision at the sun. Bhima the son of

verses.sanskrit: दुःखं च दूरतो याति सुखमात्यन्तिकं लभेत् । जननीगर्भसम्भूतं कष्टं नाप्नोति वै पुनः
verses.transliteration: duHkhaM cha dUrato yAti sukhamAtyantikaM labhet | jananIgarbhasambhUtaM kaShTaM nApnoti vai punaH
verses.translation: A terrible fiery splendour arose from his head.
verses.hindi: उपकार करनेके लिये आप यहीं निवास करें

verses.sanskrit: धनधान्यसमृद्धिश्च प्रतिष्ठारोग्यमेव च । अभीष्टफलसिद्धिश्च जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: dhanadhAnyasamR^iddhishcha pratiShThArogyameva cha | abhIShTaphalasiddhishcha jAyate nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: The gods including Indra bowed to Brahma with devotion and eulogised him with different hymns. They men¬ tioned their miserable plight to him.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गं द्वितीयं च प्रोक्तं मल्लिकसंज्ञितम् । दर्शनात्सर्वसुखदं कथितं लोकहेतवे
verses.transliteration: jyotirli~NgaM dvitIyaM cha proktaM mallikasa.nj~nitam | darshanAtsarvasukhadaM kathitaM lokahetave
verses.translation: O Brahma, the fiery splendour of the demon has
verses.hindi: मारकर अपनी उन प्रिया सीताको प्राप्त किया

verses.sanskrit: यदा पृथ्वीं समाक्रम्य कैलासं पुनरागतः । कुमारः स शिवापुत्रस्तारकारिर्महाबलः
verses.transliteration: yadA pR^ithvIM samAkramya kailAsaM punarAgataH | kumAraH sa shivAputrastArakArirmahAbalaH
verses.translation: If not, we shall be scorched by his terrible fiery splendour and court ruin. Hence grant him his prayer.

verses.sanskrit: तदा सुरर्षिरागत्य सर्वं वृत्तं जगाद ह । गणेश्वरविवाहादि भ्रामयंस्तं स्वबुद्धितः
verses.transliteration: tadA surarShirAgatya sarvaM vR^ittaM jagAda ha | gaNeshvaravivAhAdi bhrAmayaMstaM svabuddhitaH
verses.translation: On hearing their words, Brahma the grandfather of the universe went there to grant him the boon and spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा स कुमारो हि प्रणम्य पितरौ च तौ । जगाम पर्वतं क्रौञ्चं पितृभ्यां वारितोऽपि हि
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA sa kumAro hi praNamya pitarau cha tau | jagAma parvataM krau~nchaM pitR^ibhyAM vArito.api hi
verses.translation: "I am delighted with you. Mention the boon you de.sire in your mind." On hearing the words of Brahma the Raksasa said.
verses.hindi: ज्ति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे च॒दुर्थ्या कोटिर्रसंहितायां रामेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नामैकत्रिंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: कुमारस्य वियोगेन तन्माता गिरिजा यदा । दुःखितासीत्तदा शम्भुस्तामुवाच सुबोधकृत्
verses.transliteration: kumArasya viyogena tanmAtA girijA yadA | duHkhitAsIttadA shambhustAmuvAcha subodhakR^it
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if a boon is to be granted by you, O Lotus-seated one, grant me un¬ equalled strength.

verses.sanskrit: कथं प्रिये दुःखितासि न दुःखं कुरु पार्वति । आयास्यति सुतः सुभ्रूस्त्यज्यतां दुःखमुत्कटम्
verses.transliteration: kathaM priye duHkhitAsi na duHkhaM kuru pArvati | AyAsyati sutaH subhrUstyajyatAM duHkhamutkaTam
verses.translation: After saying this, the Raksasa made obeisance to Brahma. After granting him the boon, Brahma returned to his abode.
verses.hindi: तस्यैव च सुमाहात्म्यं श्रूयतामृषिसत्तमा:॥ १  माहात्म्य सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: सा यदा च न तं मेने पार्वती दुःखिता भृशम् । तदा च प्रेषितास्तत्र शङ्करेण सुरर्षयः
verses.transliteration: sA yadA cha na taM mene pArvatI duHkhitA bhR^isham | tadA cha preShitAstatra sha~NkareNa surarShayaH
verses.translation: The Raksasa Bhima who acquired great strength from Brahma returned to his house puffed up with pride. After bowing to his mother he said.
verses.hindi: वेदवेत्ता सुधर्मा नामका कोई ब्राह्मण रहता था

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च ऋषयः सर्वे सगणा हि मुदान्विताः । कुमारानयनार्थं वै तत्र जग्मुः सुबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: devAshcha R^iShayaH sarve sagaNA hi mudAnvitAH | kumArAnayanArthaM vai tatra jagmuH subuddhayaH
verses.translation: O mother, observe my strength. I shall work up a havoc among the gods including their chief Indra and also Visnu who goes to help them.
verses.hindi: तथा अग्निहोत्रमें नित्य तत्पर रहनेवाला था

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Then in a battle he conquered Vi§ 9 u respected even by the gods. Then joyou.sly the Raksasa began to con¬ quer the earth.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Then in a battle he conquered Vi§ 9 u respected even by the gods. Then joyou.sly the Raksasa began to con¬ quer the earth.
verses.hindi: नित्य इसके लिये मत कहा करो

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१६. षोडशोऽध्यायः । महाकालज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् १ । ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सर्वं विजानासि वस्तु व्यासप्रसादतः । ज्योतिषां च कथां श्रुत्वा तृप्तिर्नैव प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.16\. ShoDasho.adhyAyaH | mahAkAlajyotirli~NgamAhAtmyavarNanam 1 | R^iShaya UchuH | sUta sarvaM vijAnAsi vastu vyAsaprasAdataH | jyotiShAM cha kathAM shrutvA tR^iptirnaiva prajAyate
verses.translation: At first he went to conquer Sudaksina, the king of Kamarupa. Then he fought a terrible battle with him.
verses.hindi: पतिसे आदरपूर्वक उनकी सारी बात कही

verses.sanskrit: देवप्रियश्च तज्ज्येष्ठः प्रियमेधास्ततः परम् । तृतीयः सुकृतो नाम धर्मवाही च सुव्रतः
verses.transliteration: devapriyashcha tajjyeShThaH priyamedhAstataH param | tR^itIyaH sukR^ito nAma dharmavAhI cha suvrataH
verses.translation: Thanks to the powers of Brahma and that of the
verses.hindi: जो होनहार है, वही होता है

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुण्यप्रतापाच्च पृथिव्यां सुखमैधत । शुक्लपक्षे यथा चन्द्रो वर्धते च निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: teShAM puNyapratApAchcha pR^ithivyAM sukhamaidhata | shuklapakShe yathA chandro vardhate cha nirantaram
verses.translation: After conquering the lord of Kamarupa, Bhima of terrible exploit bound him and struck him.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तेषां गुणास्तत्र वर्धन्ते स्म सुखावहाः । ब्रह्मतेजोमयी सा वै नगरी चाभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration: tathA teShAM guNAstatra vardhante sma sukhAvahAH | brahmatejomayI sA vai nagarI chAbhavattadA
verses.translation: O brahmins, all that belonged to that king who was a servant of Siva, including his kingdom and its adjuncts was seized by that wicked Bhima.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न करें, अन्यथा मैं अपना शरीर त्याग दूँगी

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र यज्जातं वृत्तमुत्तमम् । श्रूयतां तद् द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कथयामि यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra yajjAtaM vR^ittamuttamam | shrUyatAM tad dvijashreShThAH kathayAmi yathAshrutam
verses.translation: The virtuous king, fond of sacred rites, a favou¬ rite of Siva, was bound with fetters and imprisoned in an isolated cell.
verses.hindi: सुधमने चित्तमें भगवान् शिवका स्मरण किया

verses.sanskrit: पर्वते रत्नमाले च दूषणाख्यो महासुरः । बलवान्दैत्यराजश्च धर्मद्वेषी निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: parvate ratnamAle cha dUShaNAkhyo mahAsuraH | balavAndaityarAjashcha dharmadveShI nirantaram
verses.translation: There the captive monarch made an excellent earthen idol of Siva and started its worship with a desire for pleasant results.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो वरदानाच्च जगत्तुच्छीचकार ह । देवाः पराजितास्तेन स्थानान्निःसारितास्तथा
verses.transliteration: brahmaNo varadAnAchcha jagattuchChIchakAra ha | devAH parAjitAstena sthAnAnniHsAritAstathA
verses.translation: He eulogised Gahga in various ways. He per¬ formed the rites of ablutions and the worship of Siva.
verses.hindi: पुष्पको सोचा है, वही मेरे हाथमें आये

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां वेदधर्माश्च स्मृतिधर्माश्च सर्वशः । स्फोटितास्तेन दुष्टेन सिंहेनेव शशाः खलु
verses.transliteration: pR^ithivyAM vedadharmAshcha smR^itidharmAshcha sarvashaH | sphoTitAstena duShTena siMheneva shashAH khalu
verses.translation: Ho performed meditation duly in accordance with the rules prescribed for the worship of earthen idols.
verses.hindi: हे फुष्प ॥ २८ उनकी प्रार्थनाकर एक पुष्प उठा लिया

verses.sanskrit: यावन्तो वेदधर्माश्च तावन्तो दूरतः कृताः । तीर्थे तीर्थे तथा क्षेत्रे धर्मो नीतश्च दूरतः
verses.transliteration: yAvanto vedadharmAshcha tAvanto dUrataH kR^itAH | tIrthe tIrthe tathA kShetre dharmo nItashcha dUrataH
verses.translation: He joyously worshipped Siva after performing ob¬ eisances, prayers and the like with the mystic signs and poses.
verses.hindi: पुत्रकी आशा छोड़ो और शिवकी परिचर्या करो

verses.sanskrit: अवन्ती नगरी रम्या तत्रैका दृश्यते पुनः । इत्थं विचार्य तेनैव यत्कृतं श्रूयतां हि तत्
verses.transliteration: avantI nagarI ramyA tatraikA dR^ishyate punaH | itthaM vichArya tenaiva yatkR^itaM shrUyatAM hi tat
verses.translation: He repeated the japas of the five-syllabled mantra with the Pranava prefixed. He did not get any leisure to do any thing else.
