verses.sanskrit: बहुसैन्यसमायुक्तो दूषणः स महासुरः । तत्रस्थान्ब्राह्मणान्सर्वानुद्दिश्य समुपाययौ
verses.transliteration: bahusainyasamAyukto dUShaNaH sa mahAsuraH | tatrasthAnbrAhmaNAnsarvAnuddishya samupAyayau
verses.translation: The king's beloved wife, the chaste lady, famous as Daksina performed the worship of the earthen idol with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वं हि विशेषेण कृपां कृत्वातुलां प्रभो । ज्योतिर्लिङ्गं तृतीयं च कथय त्वं हि नोऽधुना
verses.transliteration: tasmAttvaM hi visheSheNa kR^ipAM kR^itvAtulAM prabho | jyotirli~NgaM tR^itIyaM cha kathaya tvaM hi no.adhunA
verses.translation: The couple, devoutly engaged in the propitiation of Siva worshipped the deity, the benefactor of the devotees with single-mindedness.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणणे अपनी पत्नी उस सुदेहासे कहा--

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागत्य स दैत्येन्द्रश्चतुरो दैत्यसत्तमान् । प्रोवाचाहूय वचनं विप्रद्रोही महाखलः
verses.transliteration: tatrAgatya sa daityendrashchaturo daityasattamAn | provAchAhUya vachanaM vipradrohI mahAkhalaH
verses.translation: But the Raksasa deluded by the arrogance due to the boon spoiled all sacrificial rites saying, "Let the offerings be made to me."
verses.hindi: तुम अब मेरे धर्ममें विघ्म मत करो

verses.sanskrit: दैत्य उवाच । किमेते ब्राह्मणा दुष्टा न कुर्वन्ति वचो मम । वेदधर्मरता एते सर्वे दण्ड्या मते मम
verses.transliteration: daitya uvAcha | kimete brAhmaNA duShTA na kurvanti vacho mama | vedadharmaratA ete sarve daNDyA mate mama
verses.translation: O excellent sages, with a huge army of wicked Raksasas he put the entire earth under his control.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे देवा मया लोके राजानश्च पराजिताः । वशे किं ब्राह्मणाः शक्या न कर्तुं दैत्यसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sarve devA mayA loke rAjAnashcha parAjitAH | vashe kiM brAhmaNAH shakyA na kartuM daityasattamAH
verses.translation: Defiling the Vedic rites and the sacred rituals of Sastras, Smrtis and Puriinas, the powerful demon enjoyed everything himself.
verses.hindi: लेगी, तब तुम इससे ईर्ष्या करने लगोगी

verses.sanskrit: यदि जीवितुमिच्छा स्यात्तदा धर्मं शिवस्य च । वेदानां परमं धर्मं त्यक्त्वा सुखसुभागिनः
verses.transliteration: yadi jIvitumichChA syAttadA dharmaM shivasya cha | vedAnAM paramaM dharmaM tyaktvA sukhasubhAginaH
verses.translation: The gods including Indra were harassed by him. The sages were subjected to misery, Brahmins were ousted from the world.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा जीवने तेषां संशयश्च भविष्यति । इति सत्यं मया प्रोक्तं तत्कुरुध्वं विशङ्किताः
verses.transliteration: anyathA jIvane teShAM saMshayashcha bhaviShyati | iti satyaM mayA proktaM tatkurudhvaM visha~NkitAH
verses.translation: Then the dejected gods and sages including Indra, with Brahma and Vi§nu at their head, sought refuge in iSiva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति निश्चित्य ते दैत्याश्चत्वारः पावका इव । चतुर्दिक्षु तदा जाताः प्रलये च यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti nishchitya te daityAshchatvAraH pAvakA iva | chaturdikShu tadA jAtAH pralaye cha yathA purA
verses.translation: On the auspicious banks of the Mahakosi they delighted iSiva, the benefactor of the worlds after eulogising him with various prayers.

verses.sanskrit: ते ब्राह्मणास्तदा श्रुत्वा दैत्यानामुद्यमं तदा । न दुःखं लेभिरे तत्र शिवध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: te brAhmaNAstadA shrutvA daityAnAmudyamaM tadA | na duHkhaM lebhire tatra shivadhyAnaparAyaNAH
verses.translation: They made the earthen idol and performed worship in accordance with the rules and eulogised him with different prayers and obeisances duly.
verses.hindi: सुधर्मा यधायोग्य अपने धर्मका पालन करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: धैर्यं समाश्रितास्ते च रेखामात्रं तदा द्विजाः । न चेलुः परमध्यानाद्वराकाः के शिवाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: dhairyaM samAshritAste cha rekhAmAtraM tadA dvijAH | na cheluH paramadhyAnAdvarAkAH ke shivAgrataH
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by means of prayers, by the gods, Siva was much delighted and spoke to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तैस्तु व्याप्तासीन्नगरी शुभा । लोकाश्च पीडितास्तैस्तु ब्राह्मणान्समुपाययुः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare taistu vyAptAsInnagarI shubhA | lokAshcha pIDitAstaistu brAhmaNAnsamupAyayuH
verses.translation: O Visnu, O Brahma, O gods, O sages, I am delighted, mention the boon you wish to have. What shall I do for you?

verses.sanskrit: लोका ऊचुः । स्वामिनः किं च कर्तव्यं दुष्टाश्च समुपागताः । हिंसिता बहवो लोका आगताश्च समीपतः
verses.transliteration: lokA UchuH | svAminaH kiM cha kartavyaM duShTAshcha samupAgatAH | hiMsitA bahavo lokA AgatAshcha samIpataH
verses.translation: O brahmins, when these words were mentioned by l§iva, the gods spoke to Siva after bowing to him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । धन्योऽहं कृतकृत्योऽहं श्रीमतां भवतां यदि । गतश्च सङ्गमं विप्रा धन्या वै साधुसङ्गतिः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | dhanyo.ahaM kR^itakR^ityo.ahaM shrImatAM bhavatAM yadi | gatashcha sa~NgamaM viprA dhanyA vai sAdhusa~NgatiH
verses.translation: O lord of gods, you know everything in the mind of others. You are the immanent soul. There is nothing unknown to you.'
verses.hindi: आसक्तिरहित होकर सुखका उपभोग करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तेषामिति वचः श्रुत्वा वेदप्रियसुताश्च ते । समूचुर्ब्राह्मणाँस्तान्वै विश्वस्ताः शङ्करे सदा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | teShAmiti vachaH shrutvA vedapriyasutAshcha te | samUchurbrAhmaNA.NstAnvai vishvastAH sha~Nkare sadA
verses.translation: Still at your behest, O lord, we shall mention our grief. Be pleased to hear. O lord, look at us with your merciful eye.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः । श्रूयतां विद्यते नैव बलं दुष्टभयावहम् । न शस्त्राणि तथा सन्ति यच्च ते विमुखाः पुनः
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNA UchuH | shrUyatAM vidyate naiva balaM duShTabhayAvaham | na shastrANi tathA santi yachcha te vimukhAH punaH
verses.translation: The Rakasa, the powerful son of Karkatt, begot by Kumbhakarna, harasses the gods always, with his strength enhanced by the boon granted by Brahma.
verses.hindi: ह्ति । 2 ऑफकला पुश्मेश्वरमाहात्पे सुदेहासुधर्माचरितवर्णन नाम द्वात्रिंशोउ ध्यायः

verses.sanskrit: सामान्यस्यापमानो नो ह्याश्रयस्य भवेदिह । पुनश्च किं समर्थस्य शिवस्येह भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: sAmAnyasyApamAno no hyAshrayasya bhavediha | punashcha kiM samarthasya shivasyeha bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Please kill this Rak$asa who causes much misery. O great lord, be merciful. O lord, do not delay.

verses.sanskrit: शिवो रक्षां करोत्वद्यासुराणां भयतः प्रभुः । नान्यथा शरणं लोके भक्तवत्सलतः शिवात्
verses.transliteration: shivo rakShAM karotvadyAsurANAM bhayataH prabhuH | nAnyathA sharaNaM loke bhaktavatsalataH shivAt
verses.translation: Thus requested by the gods, Siva favourably dis¬ posed to his devotees said—*'I shall slay him.** He then spoke to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति धैर्यं समास्थाय समर्चां पार्थिवस्य च । कृत्वा ते च द्विजाः सम्यक् स्थिता ध्यानपरायणाः । दृष्टा दैत्येन तावच्च ते विप्राः सबलेन हि
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti dhairyaM samAsthAya samarchAM pArthivasya cha | kR^itvA te cha dvijAH samyak sthitA dhyAnaparAyaNAH | dR^iShTA daityena tAvachcha te viprAH sabalena hi
verses.translation: The great king Sudaksina, lord of Kamarupa, is a special devotee of mine. Let him continue my worship interestedly,

verses.sanskrit: दूषणेन वचः प्रोक्तं हन्यतां वध्यतामिति । तच्छ्रुतं तैस्तदा नैव दैत्यप्रोक्तं वचो द्विजैः । वेदप्रियसुतैः शम्भोर्ध्यानमार्गपरायणैः
verses.transliteration: dUShaNena vachaH proktaM hanyatAM vadhyatAmiti | tachChrutaM taistadA naiva daityaproktaM vacho dvijaiH | vedapriyasutaiH shambhordhyAnamArgaparAyaNaiH
verses.translation: . 1 shall kill Bhima who is wicked, whose power is enhanced by the boon granted by Brahma and who has insulted you.

verses.sanskrit: अथ यावत्स दुष्टात्मा हन्तुमैच्छद् द्विजांश्च तान् । तावच्च प्रार्थिवस्थाने गर्त आसीत्सशब्दकः
verses.transliteration: atha yAvatsa duShTAtmA hantumaichChad dvijAMshcha tAn | tAvachcha prArthivasthAne garta AsItsashabdakaH
verses.translation: Then the gods went there. The delighted gods in¬ formed the great king what lord Siva had said.
verses.hindi: होते हुए उत्साह प्रदर्शित करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: गर्तात्ततः समुत्पन्नः शिवो विकटरूपधृक् । महाकाल इति ख्यातो दुष्टहन्ता सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: gartAttataH samutpannaH shivo vikaTarUpadhR^ik | mahAkAla iti khyAto duShTahantA satAM gatiH
verses.translation: After informing him thus, the gods were highly delighted. The sages then returned to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: हुई दुखी हो पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़ी

verses.sanskrit: महाकालः समुत्पन्नो दुष्टानां त्वादृशामहम् । खल त्वं ब्राह्मणानां हि समीपाद् दूरतो व्रज
verses.transliteration: mahAkAlaH samutpanno duShTAnAM tvAdR^ishAmaham | khala tvaM brAhmaNAnAM hi samIpAd dUrato vraja
verses.translation: With a desire to accord benefit to him Siva stayed with his devotee along with his Ganas. In order to protect him he remained concealed there.
verses.hindi: अपनी माता तथा सास ही मानते थे

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा हुङ्कृतेनैव भस्मसात्कृतवांस्तदा । दूषणं च महाकालः शङ्करः सबलं द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA hu~NkR^itenaiva bhasmasAtkR^itavAMstadA | dUShaNaM cha mahAkAlaH sha~NkaraH sabalaM drutam
verses.translation: Then somebody informed the Raksasa, "The king is performing a black magic against you.**
verses.hindi: अन्य किसी प्रकार नहीं, यह निश्चित है

verses.sanskrit: अतो मत्वा स्वभाग्यं हि कथयिष्यामि पावनीम् । पापप्रणाशिनीं दिव्यां कथां च शृणुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: ato matvA svabhAgyaM hi kathayiShyAmi pAvanIm | pApapraNAshinIM divyAM kathAM cha shR^iNutAdarAt
verses.translation: On seeing the earthen idol of iSiva, the Raksasa
verses.hindi: आगे जो होनहार होगा, वह तो होकर ही रहेगा

verses.sanskrit: कियत्सैन्यं हतं तेन किञ्चित्सैन्यं पलायितम् । दूषणश्च हतस्तेन शिवेनेह परात्मना
verses.transliteration: kiyatsainyaM hataM tena ki~nchitsainyaM palAyitam | dUShaNashcha hatastena shiveneha parAtmanA
verses.translation: O wicked king, what are you doing here? Tell me the truth. I shall not kill you then. Otherwise I will certainly kill you.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यं दृष्ट्वा यथा याति सङ्क्षयं सर्वशस्तमः । तथैव च शिवं दृष्ट्वा तत्सैन्यं विननाश ह
verses.transliteration: sUryaM dR^iShTvA yathA yAti sa~NkShayaM sarvashastamaH | tathaiva cha shivaM dR^iShTvA tatsainyaM vinanAsha ha
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the lord of Kamarupa full of faith in Siva thought within his mind thus.
verses.hindi: नित्य पार्थिवपूजनरूप व्रतसे विचलित नहीं हुई

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात ह । देवः समाययुः सर्वे हरिब्रह्मादयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayo neduH puShpavR^iShTiH papAta ha | devaH samAyayuH sarve haribrahmAdayastathA
verses.translation: Thus emboldened and meditating on lord 3iva the king reminded him of the promise, mentally and devotedly.
verses.hindi: समाप्त नहीं हुई, तबतक वैसा ही रहा

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या प्रणम्य तं देवं शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम् । तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैः कृताञ्जलिपुटा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyA praNamya taM devaM sha~NkaraM lokasha~Nkaram | tuShTuvurvividhaiH stotraiH kR^itA~njalipuTA dvijAH
verses.translation: "O lord, I am yours. Do as you wish. I will tell him the truth. Do what is beneficial to me,"

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणांश्च समाश्वास्य सुप्रसन्नः शिवः स्वयम् । वरं ब्रूतेति चोवाच महाकालो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNAMshcha samAshvAsya suprasannaH shivaH svayam | varaM brUteti chovAcha mahAkAlo maheshvaraH
verses.translation: Thus meditating in his mind, the king bound by the noose of truth spoke the truth slighting the Rakasa.
verses.hindi: पुनः उन्हें अलग भी कर देते हैं

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा ते द्विजाः सर्वे कृताञ्जलिपुटास्तदा । सुप्रणम्य शिवं भक्त्या प्रोचुः सन्नतमस्तकाः
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA te dvijAH sarve kR^itA~njalipuTAstadA | supraNamya shivaM bhaktyA prochuH sannatamastakAH
verses.translation: I am worshipping lord Siva who protects his devotees, who is the lord of all beings—mobile or immobile and who is free from aberrations.
verses.hindi: शिवजीका ध्यानकर धैर्य धारण किये रही

verses.sanskrit: द्विजा ऊचुः । महाकाल महादेव दुष्टदण्डकर प्रभो । मुक्तिं प्रयच्छ नः शम्भो संसाराम्बुधितः शिव
verses.transliteration: dvijA UchuH | mahAkAla mahAdeva duShTadaNDakara prabho | muktiM prayachCha naH shambho saMsArAmbudhitaH shiva
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the king of Kamarupa, Bhima spoke thunderingly, his body shaking with rage.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रैव लोकरक्षार्थं स्थातव्यं हि त्वया शिव । स्वदर्शकान्नरान् शम्भो तारय त्वं सदा प्रभो
verses.transliteration: atraiva lokarakShArthaM sthAtavyaM hi tvayA shiva | svadarshakAnnarAn shambho tAraya tvaM sadA prabho
verses.translation: You wish to conquer me depending on his strength. Then you have conquered everything, indeed. No need for any hesitation.
verses.hindi: शंकरजीकी कृपासे अब जीवित हो गया हूँ

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तस्तैः शिवस्तत्र तस्थौ गर्ते सुशोभने । भक्तानां चैव रक्षार्थं दत्त्वा तेभ्यश्च सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktastaiH shivastatra tasthau garte sushobhane | bhaktAnAM chaiva rakShArthaM dattvA tebhyashcha sadgatim
verses.translation: Otherwise great terror will befall you. There is

verses.sanskrit: द्विजास्ते मुक्तिमापन्नाश्चतुर्द्दिक्षु शिवास्पदम् । क्रोशमात्रं तदा जातं लिङ्गरूपिण एव च
verses.transliteration: dvijAste muktimApannAshchaturddikShu shivAspadam | kroshamAtraM tadA jAtaM li~NgarUpiNa eva cha
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the king of Kamarupa who had steady faith in Siva immediately spoke to the Rak$asa.
verses.hindi: ज्योतीरूपो महेशश् संतुष्टः प्रत्युवाच ह॥ शीघ्र प्रकट हो गये और उस रह लगे--

verses.sanskrit: अवन्ती नगरी रम्या मुक्तिदा सर्वदेहिनाम् । शिवप्रिया महापुण्या वर्तते लोकपावनी
verses.transliteration: avantI nagarI ramyA muktidA sarvadehinAm | shivapriyA mahApuNyA vartate lokapAvanI
verses.translation: I am a wicked ignorant brute in your eyes but I shall never forsake Siva. My lord who is the most excellent of all will never forsake me.
verses.hindi: एनां चर मारयिष्यामि त्रिशूलेन वरानने॥ ३५  त्रिशूलसे उसे मारूंगा

verses.sanskrit: महाकालेश्वरो नाम शिवः ख्यातश्च भूतले । तं दृष्ट्वा न भवेत्स्वप्ने किञ्चिद्दुःखमपि द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: mahAkAleshvaro nAma shivaH khyAtashcha bhUtale | taM dR^iShTvA na bhavetsvapne ki~nchidduHkhamapi dvijAH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the king with his soul dedicated to Siva, the Raksasa laughed and spoke to the king immediately.
verses.hindi: रक्षणीया त्वया नाथ सुदेहेयं स्वसा मम॥ ३६  बहन सुदेहाकी रक्षा कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: यं यं काममपेक्ष्यैव तल्लिङ्गं भजते तु यः । तं तं काममवाप्नोति लभेन्मोक्षं परत्र च
verses.transliteration: yaM yaM kAmamapekShyaiva talli~NgaM bhajate tu yaH | taM taM kAmamavApnoti labhenmokShaM paratra cha
verses.translation: "He is intoxicated. He begs everyday. What does he know about his features? What steadfastness can a Yogi have in affording protection to his devotees V* Think thus and keep aloof in every respect. Your lord and I shall proceed with our tight.
verses.hindi: क्रियते हननीया च सुदेहा दुष्टकारिणी॥ ३७  दुष्टकर्म करनेवाली सुदेहा तो वधके योग्य है

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं समाख्यातं महाकालस्य सुव्रताः । समुद्भवश्च माहात्म्यं किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaM samAkhyAtaM mahAkAlasya suvratAH | samudbhavashcha mAhAtmyaM kimanyachChrotumichChatha
verses.translation: Thus ridiculed, the excellent king, a devotee of Siva, steadfast in his rites, spoke fearlessly to Bhima who caused misery to the people.
verses.hindi: तस्माच्चैवं कृतं येन क्रियतां च सदाशिव॥ ४०  वैसा करे

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासीद् ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठः शुभकर्मपरायणः । वेदाध्ययनकर्ता च वेदकर्मरतः सदा
verses.transliteration: tatrAsId brAhmaNashreShThaH shubhakarmaparAyaNaH | vedAdhyayanakartA cha vedakarmarataH sadA
verses.translation: O wicked Raksasa, listen. I shall not comply with your threats. If you go astray wherefore arc you powerful?
verses.hindi: महेश्वरः कृपासिंधु: तामूचे भक्तवत्सल:॥ ४१  हो गये और उन्होंने पुन: कहा--

verses.sanskrit: अग्न्याधानसमायुक्तः शिवपूजारतः सदा । पार्थिवीं प्रत्यहं मूर्तिं पूजयामास वै द्विजः
verses.transliteration: agnyAdhAnasamAyuktaH shivapUjArataH sadA | pArthivIM pratyahaM mUrtiM pUjayAmAsa vai dvijaH
verses.translation: Thus addressed by the king, the demon rebuked him and hurled his terrible sword at the earthen idol.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकर्मफलं प्राप्य द्विजो वेदप्रियः सदा । सतां गतिं समालेभे सम्यज्ज्ञानपरायणः
verses.transliteration: sarvakarmaphalaM prApya dvijo vedapriyaH sadA | satAM gatiM samAlebhe samyajj~nAnaparAyaNaH
verses.translation: "See now itself your lord's strength pleasing to the devotees." Saying this, the powerful demon laughed in the company of the Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पुत्रास्तादृशाश्चासंश्चत्वारो मुनिसत्तमाः । शिवपूजारता नित्यं पित्रोरनवमाः सदा
verses.transliteration: tatputrAstAdR^ishAshchAsaMshchatvAro munisattamAH | shivapUjAratA nityaM pitroranavamAH sadA
verses.translation: O brahmins, no sooner did the sword touch the earthen idol than 8iva manifested himself from the earthen idol.
verses.hindi: अपने पापोंको दूर करनेवाले ब्रतका आचरण किया

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: From this alone see soon my strength that is pleasing to the devotees." After saying this he split the sword into two with his Pinaka.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: From this alone see soon my strength that is pleasing to the devotees." After saying this he split the sword into two with his Pinaka.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१७. सप्तदशोऽध्यायः । महाकालज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् २ । ऋषय ऊचुः । महाकालसमाह्वस्थज्योतिर्लिङ्गस्य रक्षिणः । भक्तानां महिमानं च पुनर्ब्रूहि महामते
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.17\. saptadasho.adhyAyaH | mahAkAlajyotirli~NgamAhAtmyavarNanam 2 | R^iShaya UchuH | mahAkAlasamAhvasthajyotirli~Ngasya rakShiNaH | bhaktAnAM mahimAnaM cha punarbrUhi mahAmate
verses.translation: Then a terrible fight ensued between the attendants of Siva and the Raksasa. It frightened all the onlookers with distress.

verses.sanskrit: नृपा मत्सरिणः सर्वे तं मणिं चन्द्रसेनतः । नानोपायैरयाचन्त देवलब्धमबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: nR^ipA matsariNaH sarve taM maNiM chandrasenataH | nAnopAyairayAchanta devalabdhamabuddhayaH
verses.translation: Within a trice, the entire earth became agitated. The oceans and the mountains became excited.
verses.hindi: माहात्य्यवर्णन नामक तैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां भूभृतां याञ्चा चन्द्रसेनेन तेन वै । व्यर्थीकृता महाकालदृढभक्तेन भूसुराः
verses.transliteration: sarveShAM bhUbhR^itAM yA~nchA chandrasenena tena vai | vyarthIkR^itA mahAkAladR^iDhabhaktena bhUsurAH
verses.translation: The god and the sages were much distressed. They said to one another. "In vain did we beseech Siva."

verses.sanskrit: ते कदर्थीकृताः सर्वे चन्द्रसेनेन भूभृता । राजानः सर्वदेशानां संरम्भं चक्रिरे तदा
verses.transliteration: te kadarthIkR^itAH sarve chandrasenena bhUbhR^itA | rAjAnaH sarvadeshAnAM saMrambhaM chakrire tadA
verses.translation: Narada came there and requested Siva, the destroyer of miseries with palms joined in reverence and head bent down.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ते सर्वराजानश्चतुरङ्गबलान्विताः । चन्द्रसेनं रणे जेतुं सम्बभूवुः किलोद्यताः
verses.transliteration: atha te sarvarAjAnashchatura~NgabalAnvitAH | chandrasenaM raNe jetuM sambabhUvuH kilodyatAH
verses.translation: O lord, forgive, O cause of fierce agitation. Why shall a dagger be thrust to cut a blade of grass, Let the demon be killed soon.
verses.hindi: बलवान हैं, इन्हें प्रयत्नपूर्वक जीतना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: ते तु सर्वे समेता वै कृतसङ्केतसंविदः । उज्जयिन्याश्चतुर्द्वारं रुरुधुर्बहुसैनिकाः
verses.transliteration: te tu sarve sametA vai kR^itasa~NketasaMvidaH | ujjayinyAshchaturdvAraM rurudhurbahusainikAH
verses.translation: Thus requested, lord Siva reduced the Rakasa to ashes with only a Huiii sound for his weapon.

verses.sanskrit: संरुध्यमानां स्वपुरीं दृष्ट्वा निखिलराजभिः । तमेव शरणं राजा महाकालेश्वरं ययौ
verses.transliteration: saMrudhyamAnAM svapurIM dR^iShTvA nikhilarAjabhiH | tameva sharaNaM rAjA mahAkAleshvaraM yayau
verses.translation: Even as all the gods were watching, O sage, the Raksasas were burnt down by Siva in a trice.

verses.sanskrit: निर्विकल्पो निराहारः स नृपो दृढनिश्चयः । समानर्च महाकालं दिवानक्तमनन्यधीः
verses.transliteration: nirvikalpo nirAhAraH sa nR^ipo dR^iDhanishchayaH | samAnarcha mahAkAlaM divAnaktamananyadhIH
verses.translation: Just as the conflagration consumes the forest so did the fury of Siva destroy the army of the Raksasas in a trice.
verses.hindi: कम जानकर ससे ढूँढ़नेमें तत्पर हो गये

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवाञ्छम्भुर्महाकालः प्रसन्नधीः । तं रक्षितुमुपायं वै चक्रे तं शृणुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa bhagavA~nChambhurmahAkAlaH prasannadhIH | taM rakShitumupAyaM vai chakre taM shR^iNutAdarAt
verses.translation: None could see even the ashes of Bhima. He was burnt down along with his followers. There was no trace of him to be seen.

verses.sanskrit: तदैव समये गोपी काचित्तत्र पुरोत्तमे । चरन्ती सशिशुर्विप्रा महाकालान्तिकं ययौ
verses.transliteration: tadaiva samaye gopI kAchittatra purottame | charantI sashishurviprA mahAkAlAntikaM yayau
verses.translation: The flame of the fury of Siva spread from forest to forest. The ashes of the Raksasas spread everywhere in the forest.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाब्दवयसं बालं वहन्ती गतभर्तृका । राज्ञा कृतां महाकालपूजां सापश्यदादरात्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAbdavayasaM bAlaM vahantI gatabhartR^ikA | rAj~nA kR^itAM mahAkAlapUjAM sApashyadAdarAt
verses.translation: The fiery flame of the anger of the great lord Siva came out and spread from forest to forest. The ashes of the Raksasas spread throughout the forest.
verses.hindi: स्थितश्चैवाग्रत: शंभो: स्वयं च पुरुपीडित: ॥ २९  शवजीके आगे खड़े हो गये

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । शृणुतादरतो विप्रा भक्तरक्षाविधायिनः । महाकालस्य लिङ्गस्य माहात्म्यं भक्तिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | shR^iNutAdarato viprA bhaktarakShAvidhAyinaH | mahAkAlasya li~Ngasya mAhAtmyaM bhaktivardhanam
verses.translation: From the ashes different herbs cropped up effec¬ tively in various ways. Men could assume different forms and features through the ashes.
verses.hindi: ददौ तस्मे स्वकं चक्र तेजोराशिं सुदर्शनम्॥ ३०  उन्हें अपना महातेजस्वी सुदर्शनचक्र प्रदान किया

verses.sanskrit: सा दृष्ट्वा सुमहाश्चर्यां शिवपूजां च तत्कृताम् । प्रणिपत्य स्वशिविरं पुनरेवाभ्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sA dR^iShTvA sumahAshcharyAM shivapUjAM cha tatkR^itAm | praNipatya svashiviraM punarevAbhyapadyata
verses.translation: Evil spirits, ghosts are removed far by the ashes O brahmins, there is no task which cannot be carried out through it.
verses.hindi: सुप्रीतः स्वायुथं प्राप्प हरिरासीन्‍्महासुखी॥ ३२  अतिप्रसन्‍न विष्णु भी परम सुखी हो गये

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वमशेषेण स दृष्ट्वा वल्लवीसुतः । कुतूहलेन तां कर्तुं शिवपूजां मनो दधे
verses.transliteration: etatsarvamasheSheNa sa dR^iShTvA vallavIsutaH | kutUhalena tAM kartuM shivapUjAM mano dadhe
verses.translation: This despicable land causing distress to the people of Ayodhya will yield welfare to the people at your very sight.
verses.hindi: कृपालुत्व॑ च॒ शंभोहिं विष्णूपरि यथातथम्॥ ३४ हुए

verses.sanskrit: आनीय हृद्यं पाषाणं शून्ये तु शिविरान्तरे । अविदूरे स्वशिविराच्छिवलिङ्गं स भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: AnIya hR^idyaM pAShANaM shUnye tu shivirAntare | avidUre svashivirAchChivali~NgaM sa bhaktitaH
verses.translation: You will be known as Bhimaaiikara—a phallic image which shall be worshipped always. It will avert mishaps and be conducive to the attainment of all desires.
verses.hindi: स्मृत्वा शिवपदांभोजं सूतो वचनमन्रवीत्॥ ३५  करके सूतजी यह वचन कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: गन्धालङ्कारवासोभिर्धूपदीपाक्षतादिभिः । विधाय कृत्रिमैर्द्रव्यैर्नैवेद्यं चाप्यकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: gandhAla~NkAravAsobhirdhUpadIpAkShatAdibhiH | vidhAya kR^itrimairdravyairnaivedyaM chApyakalpayat
verses.translation: Thus requested. Siva the benefactor of the worlds, the lord favourably disposed towards his devotees remained there itself.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीज्षिवमहापुराणे चतुर्ध्या कोटिर्संहितायां विष्युसुदर्शचक्रलाभवर्णन॑ नाम चतुस्त्रिशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: भूयो भूयः समभ्यर्च्य पत्रैः पुष्पैर्मनोरमैः । नृत्यं च विविधं कृत्वा प्रणनाम पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: bhUyo bhUyaH samabhyarchya patraiH puShpairmanoramaiH | nR^ityaM cha vividhaM kR^itvA praNanAma punaH punaH
verses.translation: O excellent sages, hereafter I shall narrate the greatness of Visvesvara, destructive of great sins. May it be heard.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये पुत्रं शिवासक्तसुचेतसम् । प्रणयाद्गोपिका सा तं भोजनाय समाह्वयत्
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye putraM shivAsaktasuchetasam | praNayAdgopikA sA taM bhojanAya samAhvayat
verses.translation: That which is seen as the substantive, as an entity in the form of knowledge and bliss, eternal and free from aberration, desired for a second. That second, of the tree of salvation, was possessed of attributes. It is named Siva.
verses.hindi: तदह॑ कथयाम्यद्य शैब॑ नामसहस्रकम्॥ ९   कह रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: यदाहूतोऽपि बहुश; शिवपूजाक्तमानसः । बालश्च भोजनं नैच्छत्तदा तत्र ययौ प्रसूः
verses.transliteration: yadAhUto.api bahusha; shivapUjAktamAnasaH | bAlashcha bhojanaM naichChattadA tatra yayau prasUH
verses.translation: That split itself into two in the male and the female forms. The male is famous as Siva and the female is known as Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: तं विलोक्य शिवस्याग्रे निषण्णं मीलितेक्षणम् । चकर्ष पाणिं सङ्गृह्य कोपेन समताडयत्
verses.transliteration: taM vilokya shivasyAgre niShaNNaM mIlitekShaNam | chakarSha pANiM sa~NgR^ihya kopena samatADayat
verses.translation: O great sages, the unseen Cit and Ananda created Prakrii and Purusa. O brahmins, on seeing their parents, Prakrti and Purusa were plunged in doubt.

verses.sanskrit: आकृष्टस्ताडितश्चापि नागच्छत् स्वसुतो यदा । तां पूजां नाशयामास क्षिप्त्वा लिङ्गं च दूरतः
verses.transliteration: AkR^iShTastADitashchApi nAgachChat svasuto yadA | tAM pUjAM nAshayAmAsa kShiptvA li~NgaM cha dUrataH
verses.translation: Then a voice arose from the great attributeless Atman—"Penance shall be pursued by you for the generation of excellent creation."

verses.sanskrit: हाहेति दूयमानं तं निर्भर्त्स्य स्वसुतं च सा । पुनर्विवेश स्वगृहं गोपी क्रोधसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: hAheti dUyamAnaM taM nirbhartsya svasutaM cha sA | punarvivesha svagR^ihaM gopI krodhasamanvitA
verses.translation: Then a beautiful city endowed with the requisite articles, the auspicious essence of brilliance extending to five Kronas was created and established by Siva devoid of attributes, in the firmament near the Purusa.
verses.hindi: सर्वप्रमाणसंवादी वृषाड्रो वृषवाहनः॥ ६  वृषवाहन:-दपेस वा धर्मको वाहन बनानेवाले

verses.sanskrit: उज्जयिन्यामभूद्राजा चन्द्रसेनाह्वयो महान् । सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञः शिवभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: ujjayinyAmabhUdrAjA chandrasenAhvayo mahAn | sarvashAstrArthatattvaj~naH shivabhakto jitendriyaH
verses.translation: Occupying it with a desire for creation and medi¬ tating, Visnu performed penance for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: मात्रा विनाशितां पूजां दृष्ट्वा देवस्य शूलिनः । देवदेवेति चुक्रोश निपपात स बालकः
verses.transliteration: mAtrA vinAshitAM pUjAM dR^iShTvA devasya shUlinaH | devadeveti chukrosha nipapAta sa bAlakaH
verses.translation: Due to his exertion various currents of water began to flow. The void was pervaded by the water-currents. Nothing else was seen.

verses.sanskrit: प्रनष्टसंज्ञः सहसा स बभूव शुचाकुलः । लब्धसंज्ञो मुहूर्तेन चक्षुषी उदमीलयत्
verses.transliteration: pranaShTasa.nj~naH sahasA sa babhUva shuchAkulaH | labdhasa.nj~no muhUrtena chakShuShI udamIlayat
verses.translation: Then a jewel fell in front from the ear of the lord. It became the great holy centre named Manikarika.

verses.sanskrit: तदैव जातं शिविरं महाकालस्य सुन्दरम् । ददर्श स शिशुस्तत्र शिवानुग्रहतोऽचिरात्
verses.transliteration: tadaiva jAtaM shiviraM mahAkAlasya sundaram | dadarsha sa shishustatra shivAnugrahato.achirAt
verses.translation: When the holy centre extending to five Kronas

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्मयबृहद् द्वारं कपाटवरतोरणम् । महार्हनीलविमलवज्रवेदीविराजितम्
verses.transliteration: hiraNmayabR^ihad dvAraM kapATavaratoraNam | mahArhanIlavimalavajravedIvirAjitam
verses.translation: Visnu slept there itself along with his consort Pra- krti. At the behest of Siva, Brahma was born of his umbilical lotus.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तप्तहेमकलशैर्विचित्रैर्बहुभिर्युतम् । प्रोद्भासितमणिस्तम्भैर्बद्धस्फटिकभूतलैः
verses.transliteration: santaptahemakalashairvichitrairbahubhiryutam | prodbhAsitamaNistambhairbaddhasphaTikabhUtalaiH
verses.translation: At the behest of Siva, he evolved a wonderful creation. The fourteen worlds were created in the Cosmic

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्ये रत्नलिङ्गं हि शङ्करस्य कृपानिधेः । स्वकृतार्चनसंयुक्तमपश्यद्गोपिकासुतः
verses.transliteration: tanmadhye ratnali~NgaM hi sha~Nkarasya kR^ipAnidheH | svakR^itArchanasaMyuktamapashyadgopikAsutaH
verses.translation: "How will the beings in the Cosmic Egg bound by action attain me otherwise?", the holy centre of Paflca- kroiSi was released by him after thinking like this.
verses.hindi: नीति: सुनीतिः शुद्धात्मा सोम: सोमरतः सुखी ॥ १४ परिपूर्ण

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्थाय शिशुर्विस्मितमानसः । सन्निमग्न इवासीद्वै परमानन्दसागरे
verses.transliteration: sa dR^iShTvA sahasotthAya shishurvismitamAnasaH | sannimagna ivAsIdvai paramAnandasAgare
verses.translation: "This Kai is the bestower of auspiciousness in the world. It is destructive of action. It illuminates salvation. It is the bestower of knowledge. It is my great favourite.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्तुत्वा स गिरिशं भूयो भूयः प्रणम्य च । सूर्ये चास्तङ्गते बालो निर्जगाम शिवालयात्
verses.transliteration: tataH stutvA sa girishaM bhUyo bhUyaH praNamya cha | sUrye chAsta~Ngate bAlo nirjagAma shivAlayAt
verses.translation: After saying this, l§iva himself brought Kaika from his Trident and released it in the mortal world.

verses.sanskrit: अथापश्यत्स्वशिविरं पुरन्दरपुरोपमम् । सद्यो हिरण्मयीभूतं विचित्रं परमोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: athApashyatsvashiviraM purandarapuropamam | sadyo hiraNmayIbhUtaM vichitraM paramojjvalam
verses.translation: At the close of the day of Brahma (when all other objects perish) it certainly does not perish. Then, O sages, l3iva upholds it by means of his Trident.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽन्तर्विवेश भवनं सर्वशोभासमन्वितम् । मणिहेमगणाकीर्णं मोदमानो निशामुखे
verses.transliteration: so.antarvivesha bhavanaM sarvashobhAsamanvitam | maNihemagaNAkIrNaM modamAno nishAmukhe
verses.translation: The phallic image Avimuktesvara stays in K&i always, yielding salvation to the people including even the great sinners.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याभवत्सखा राज्ञो मणिभद्रो गणो द्विजाः । गिरीशगणमुख्यश्च सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: tasyAbhavatsakhA rAj~no maNibhadro gaNo dvijAH | girIshagaNamukhyashcha sarvalokanamaskR^itaH
verses.translation: O great sages, the Sarupya*®* and other types of

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापश्यत्स्वजननीं स्वपन्तीं दिव्यलक्षणाम् । रत्नालङ्कारदीप्ताङ्गीं साक्षात्सुरवधूमिव
verses.transliteration: tatrApashyatsvajananIM svapantIM divyalakShaNAm | ratnAla~NkAradIptA~NgIM sAkShAtsuravadhUmiva
verses.translation: The PurSas outline four states of beatitude viz, (i) residence in the same heaven with the deity (tffWlflT ), (ii) proximity with the deity (hi)assimilation to the deity, smd (iv)complcte abiorp-

verses.sanskrit: अथो स तनयो विप्राः शिवानुग्रहभाजनम् । जवेनोत्थापयामास मातरं सुखविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: atho sa tanayo viprAH shivAnugrahabhAjanam | javenotthApayAmAsa mAtaraM sukhavihvalaH
verses.translation: Of those who do not attain salvation*elsewhere, the city of Varanasi is the resort. The meritorious holy centre Paficakroi is destructive of sins of crorcs of slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: सोत्थिताद्भुतमालक्ष्यापूर्वं सर्वमिवाभवत् । महानन्दसुमग्ना हि सस्वजे स्वसुतं च तम्
verses.transliteration: sotthitAdbhutamAlakShyApUrvaM sarvamivAbhavat | mahAnandasumagnA hi sasvaje svasutaM cha tam
verses.translation: The immortal gods too desire death here. What then of others? Thus holy centre yields worldly pleasures and salvation always. It is a favourite resort of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा पुत्रमुखात्सर्वं प्रसादं गिरिजापतेः । प्रभुं विज्ञापयामास यो भजत्यनिशं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: shrutvA putramukhAtsarvaM prasAdaM girijApateH | prabhuM vij~nApayAmAsa yo bhajatyanishaM shivam
verses.translation: Brahma praises this city. So also do the Siddhas, Yogins, sages and other people in the three worlds and Vinu too.

verses.sanskrit: स राजा सहसागत्य समाप्तनियमो निशि । ददर्श गोपिकासूनोः प्रभावं शिवतोषणम्
verses.transliteration: sa rAjA sahasAgatya samAptaniyamo nishi | dadarsha gopikAsUnoH prabhAvaM shivatoShaNam
verses.translation: I cannot describe adequately and entirely the greatness of Kaf even in hundreds of years. I shall explain to the extent I can.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा महीपतिः सर्वं तत्सामात्यपुरोहितः । आसीन्निमग्नो विधृतिः परमानन्दसागरे
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA mahIpatiH sarvaM tatsAmAtyapurohitaH | AsInnimagno vidhR^itiH paramAnandasAgare
verses.translation: O lord of the universe, O great lord, I belong to you undoubtedly. O great god, be merciful to me, your son, O lord, accompanied by mother Parvatl.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेम्णा बाष्पजलं मुञ्चन् चन्द्रसेनो नृपो हि सः । शिवनामोच्चरन्प्रीत्या परिरेभे तमर्भकम्
verses.transliteration: premNA bAShpajalaM mu~nchan chandraseno nR^ipo hi saH | shivanAmochcharanprItyA parirebhe tamarbhakam
verses.translation: O lord of the universe, you shall stay here for the benefit of the worlds. I request you, O ruler of the universe to save the universe.

verses.sanskrit: महामहोत्सवस्तत्र प्रबभूवाद्भुतो द्विजाः । महेशकीर्तनं चक्रुः सर्वे च सुखविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: mahAmahotsavastatra prababhUvAdbhuto dvijAH | maheshakIrtanaM chakruH sarve cha sukhavihvalAH
verses.translation: Avimukta, of suppressed and controlled soul, shed tears from his eyes and imploring him again and again spoke to l§iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवमत्यद्भुताचाराच्छिवमाहात्म्यदर्शनात् । पौराणां सम्भ्रमाच्चैव सा रात्रिः क्षणतामगात्
verses.transliteration: evamatyadbhutAchArAchChivamAhAtmyadarshanAt | paurANAM sambhramAchchaiva sA rAtriH kShaNatAmagAt
verses.translation: O geat lord, O lord of gods, O good panacea for all the evils of time, you are in truth the lord of the three worlds. You arc worthy of being served by Brahm&, Vipju and others.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रभाते युद्धाय पुरं संरुध्य संस्थिताः । राजानश्चारवक्त्रेभ्यः शुश्रुवुश्चरितं च तत्
verses.transliteration: atha prabhAte yuddhAya puraM saMrudhya saMsthitAH | rAjAnashchAravaktrebhyaH shushruvushcharitaM cha tat
verses.translation: O lord, may you establirii your capital in the city of Ka£i. For the sake of inconceivable pleasure I shall stay in meditation.

verses.sanskrit: एकदा स गणेन्द्रो हि प्रसन्नास्यो महामणिम् । मणिभद्रो ददौ तस्मै चिन्तामणिमुदारधीः
verses.transliteration: ekadA sa gaNendro hi prasannAsyo mahAmaNim | maNibhadro dadau tasmai chintAmaNimudAradhIH
verses.translation: You alone are the bestower of liberation and world¬ ly desires. For rendering help to the people you stay here always along with Uma.

verses.sanskrit: ते समेताश्च राजानः सर्वे ये ये समागताः । परस्परमिति प्रोचुस्तच्छ्रुत्वा चकित अति
verses.transliteration: te sametAshcha rAjAnaH sarve ye ye samAgatAH | parasparamiti prochustachChrutvA chakita ati
verses.translation: O Sadaiva, save the living beings from the ocean of world!/ existence. O Siva, carry out the task of your devotees. I request you again and again.

verses.sanskrit: राजान ऊचुः । अयं राजा चन्द्रसेनः शिवभक्तोऽतिदुर्जयः । उज्जयिन्या महाकालपुर्याः पतिरनाकुलः
verses.transliteration: rAjAna UchuH | ayaM rAjA chandrasenaH shivabhakto.atidurjayaH | ujjayinyA mahAkAlapuryAH patiranAkulaH
verses.translation: Thus requested by ViSvanatha, Siva the sovereign ruler of all, stayed there for rendering help to the people.

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशाः शिशवो यस्य पुर्यां सन्ति शिवव्रताः । स राजा चन्द्रसेनस्तु महाशङ्करसेवकः
verses.transliteration: IdR^ishAH shishavo yasya puryAM santi shivavratAH | sa rAjA chandrasenastu mahAsha~NkarasevakaH
verses.translation: KaSi became the most excellent centre for all since Siva came to Kai.

verses.sanskrit: नूनमस्य विरोधेन शिवः क्रोधं करिष्यति । तत्क्रोधाद्धि वयं सर्वे भविष्यामो विनष्टकाः
verses.transliteration: nUnamasya virodhena shivaH krodhaM kariShyati | tatkrodhAddhi vayaM sarve bhaviShyAmo vinaShTakAH
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall explain neatly and succinctly the splendid greatness of Varanasi and Vi5ve5vara. May it be listened to.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनेन राज्ञा वै मिलापः कार्य एव हि । एवं सति महेशानः करिष्यति कृपां पराम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAdanena rAj~nA vai milApaH kArya eva hi | evaM sati maheshAnaH kariShyati kR^ipAM parAm
verses.translation: Once goddess Parvati asked Siva with great joy about the greatness of the two Avimuktas—Kasi and VHve4- vara, out of desire for the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति निश्चित्य ते भूपास्त्यक्तवैराः सदाशयाः । सर्वे बभूवुः सुप्रीता न्यस्तशस्त्रास्त्रपाणयः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti nishchitya te bhUpAstyaktavairAH sadAshayAH | sarve babhUvuH suprItA nyastashastrAstrapANayaH
verses.translation: It behoves you to explain the greatness of this shrine entirely | taking pity on me and desiring the benefit of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: विविशुस्ते पुरीं रम्यां महाकालस्य भूभृतः । महाकालं समानर्चुश्चन्द्रसेनानुमोदिताः
verses.transliteration: vivishuste purIM ramyAM mahAkAlasya bhUbhR^itaH | mahAkAlaM samAnarchushchandrasenAnumoditAH
verses.translation: On hearing the words oi the goddess, the lord of the gods, the lord of the universe, replied to hei* for the pleasure of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते गोपवनितागेहं जग्मुर्महीभृतः । प्रशंसन्तश्च तद्भाग्यं सर्वे दिव्यमहोदयम्
verses.transliteration: tataste gopavanitAgehaM jagmurmahIbhR^itaH | prashaMsantashcha tadbhAgyaM sarve divyamahodayam
verses.translation: What, gentle lady, has been asked by you is splendid. It is auspicious and pleasing to the people. I shall explain as a matter of fact the greatness of the two Avimuktas.

verses.sanskrit: ते तत्र चन्द्रसेनेन प्रत्युद्गम्याभिपूजिताः । महार्हविष्टरगताः प्रत्यनन्दन् सुविस्मिताः
verses.transliteration: te tatra chandrasenena pratyudgamyAbhipUjitAH | mahArhaviShTaragatAH pratyanandan suvismitAH
verses.translation: In this holy centre, the Siddhas have always taken to my holy rites. They hold different phallic images. They yearn to attain my world.

verses.sanskrit: गोपसूनोः प्रसादात्तत्प्रादुर्भूतं शिवालयम् । संवीक्ष्य शिवलिङ्गं च शिवे चक्रुः परां मतिम्
verses.transliteration: gopasUnoH prasAdAttatprAdurbhUtaM shivAlayam | saMvIkShya shivali~NgaM cha shive chakruH parAM matim
verses.translation: Those who have conquered themselves and controlled their sense>organs pursue the great Paupata Yoga which is explained in the Vedas, yielding worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: स वै मणिः कौस्तुभवद् द्योतमानोऽर्कसन्निभः । ध्यातो दृष्टः श्रुतो वापि मङ्गलं यच्छति ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: sa vai maNiH kaustubhavad dyotamAno.arkasannibhaH | dhyAto dR^iShTaH shruto vApi ma~NgalaM yachChati dhruvam
verses.translation: O great goddess, the residence in Varanasi is always appealing to me. Forsaking everything listen to the cause of its greatness.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते गोपशिशवे प्रीता निखिलभूभुजः । ददुर्बहूनि वस्तूनि तस्मै शिवकृपार्थिनः
verses.transliteration: tataste gopashishave prItA nikhilabhUbhujaH | dadurbahUni vastUni tasmai shivakR^ipArthinaH
verses.translation: They must be known as liberated souls, no matter where they die. They are sure to attain salvation. This decisive word has been uttered by me.

verses.sanskrit: ये ये सर्वेषु देशेषु गोपास्तिष्ठन्ति भूरिशः । तेषां तमेव राजानं चक्रिरे सर्वपार्थिवाः
verses.transliteration: ye ye sarveShu desheShu gopAstiShThanti bhUrishaH | teShAM tameva rAjAnaM chakrire sarvapArthivAH
verses.translation: Here in this excellent holy centre Avimukta, there is one special thing to be noted. O goddess, O great Sakti, Iease listen attentively.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्मिन्नन्तरे सर्वैस्त्रिदशैरभिपूजितः । प्रादुर्बभूव तेजस्वी हनूमान् वानरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: athAsminnantare sarvaistridashairabhipUjitaH | prAdurbabhUva tejasvI hanUmAn vAnareshvaraH
verses.translation: People of all castes, of all stages of life, whether childin, youths or the aged, if they die in this city, are undoubtedly liberated.

verses.sanskrit: ते तस्याभिगमादेव राजानो जातसम्भ्रमाः । प्रत्युत्थाय नमश्चकुर्भक्तिनम्रात्ममूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: te tasyAbhigamAdeva rAjAno jAtasambhramAH | pratyutthAya namashchakurbhaktinamrAtmamUrtayaH
verses.translation: O bra hmin s, whether pure or impure, whether virgin or married, whether widow or barren, whether suffering from menstrual disorders or defects or whether recently delivered of a child, of whatever nature she may be, if she

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मध्ये समासीनः पूजितः प्लवगेश्वरः । गोपात्मजं तमालिङ्ग्य राज्ञो वीक्ष्येदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: teShAM madhye samAsInaH pUjitaH plavageshvaraH | gopAtmajaM tamAli~Ngya rAj~no vIkShyedamabravIt
verses.translation: The sweat-born, (lice, bugs etc.) the egg-born (birds), the germinating ones (plants and trees) and the embryo-born (mammals) these living beings do not attain salvation elsewhere as they do at this place.

verses.sanskrit: हनूमानुवाच । सर्वे शृण्वन्तु भद्रं वो राजानो ये च देहिनः । ऋते शिवं नान्यतमो गतिरस्ति शरीरिणाम्
verses.transliteration: hanUmAnuvAcha | sarve shR^iNvantu bhadraM vo rAjAno ye cha dehinaH | R^ite shivaM nAnyatamo gatirasti sharIriNAm
verses.translation: There is no dependence on culture, nor that on meditation at anytime, nor that on repetition of names, nor that on adoration, nor that even on noble nativity.

verses.sanskrit: एवं गोपसुतो दिष्ट्या शिवपूजां विलोक्य च । अमन्त्रेणापि सम्पूज्य शिवं शिवमवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: evaM gopasuto diShTyA shivapUjAM vilokya cha | amantreNApi sampUjya shivaM shivamavAptavAn
verses.translation: Whoever may be the man staying in my holy centre, whatever may be the manner of his death, if he dies here, he certainly attains salvation.

verses.sanskrit: एष भक्तवरः शम्भोर्गोपानां कीर्तिवर्धनः । इह भुक्त्वाखिलान्भोगानन्ते मोक्षमवाप्स्यति
verses.transliteration: eSha bhaktavaraH shambhorgopAnAM kIrtivardhanaH | iha bhuktvAkhilAnbhogAnante mokShamavApsyati
verses.translation: Any being, enjoying pleasures at his will, sleeping, sporting or performing different activities, attains salvation if he casts off his life at Avimukta.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य वंशेऽष्टमो भावी नन्दो नाम महायशाः । प्राप्स्यते तस्य पुत्रत्वं कृष्णो नारायणः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: asya vaMshe.aShTamo bhAvI nando nAma mahAyashAH | prApsyate tasya putratvaM kR^iShNo nArAyaNaH svayam
verses.translation: Hence the people resort to Kai with every strenuous effort. The sages meditate on Sadariva in the form of his phallic image.
verses.hindi: ही जिनका दर्शन होता है, ऐसे

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन्नेष गोपकुमारकः । नाम्ना श्रीकर इत्युच्चैर्लोकख्यातिं गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhR^iti loke.asminneSha gopakumArakaH | nAmnA shrIkara ityuchchairlokakhyAtiM gamiShyati
verses.translation: O beloved, I distribute the different fruits among different men who perform penance with those ends in view.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य कान्तितलस्पृष्टं कांस्यं ताम्रमयस्त्रपु । पाषाणादिकमन्यद्वा द्रुतं भवति हाटकम्
verses.transliteration: tasya kAntitalaspR^iShTaM kAMsyaM tAmramayastrapu | pAShANAdikamanyadvA drutaM bhavati hATakam
verses.translation: No entanglement of actions binds those who

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवमुक्त्वाञ्जनीसूनुः शिवरूपो हरीश्वरः । सर्वान् राज्ञश्चन्द्रसेनं कृपादृष्ट्या ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evamuktvA~njanIsUnuH shivarUpo harIshvaraH | sarvAn rAj~nashchandrasenaM kR^ipAdR^iShTyA dadarsha ha
verses.translation: Brahma along with the gods and the sages, Vi$nu, the sun, and all other noble souls perform my worship.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्मै श्रीकराय गोपपुत्राय धीमते । उपादिदेश सुप्रीत्या शिवाचारं शिवप्रियम्
verses.transliteration: atha tasmai shrIkarAya gopaputrAya dhImate | upAdidesha suprItyA shivAchAraM shivapriyam
verses.translation: He who dies in this holy centre does not get rebirth even if he happens to be a person whose mind is drawn towards sensual pleasures or who has eschewed interest in virtue.

verses.sanskrit: हनूमानथ सुप्रीतः सर्वेषां पश्यतां द्विजाः । चन्द्रसेनं श्रीकरं च तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: hanUmAnatha suprItaH sarveShAM pashyatAM dvijAH | chandrasenaM shrIkaraM cha tatraivAntaradhIyata
verses.translation: What then, if they aie free from attachment, devoid of arrogance, possessd of Sattvaic nature, blessed ones devoted to me and not initiating evil activities.

verses.sanskrit: तं सर्वे च महीपालाः संहृष्टाः प्रतिपूजिताः । चन्द्रसेनं समामन्त्र्य प्रतिजग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: taM sarve cha mahIpAlAH saMhR^iShTAH pratipUjitAH | chandrasenaM samAmantrya pratijagmuryathAgatam
verses.translation: O Parvati, there are many phallic forms installed by my devotees. They yield all desires and bestow salvation too.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकरोऽपि महातेजा उपदिष्टो हनूमता । ब्राह्मणैः सह धर्मज्ञैश्चक्रे शम्भोः समर्हणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIkaro.api mahAtejA upadiShTo hanUmatA | brAhmaNaiH saha dharmaj~naishchakre shambhoH samarhaNam
verses.translation: If a sinless man dies, he attains salvation immediately. If a sinner dies here he assumes multitudes of births.
verses.hindi: निदाधस्तपनो मेघः स्वक्षः परपुरक्षयः॥८०  त्रिपुररूप शत्रुनगरीपर विजय पानेवाले

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रसेनो महाराजः श्रीकरो गोपबालकः । उभावपि परप्रीत्या महाकालं च भेजतुः
verses.transliteration: chandraseno mahArAjaH shrIkaro gopabAlakaH | ubhAvapi paraprItyA mahAkAlaM cha bhejatuH
verses.translation: He attains salvation only after experiencing tortures. He who commits sins in the holy centre of Avimukta, experiences tortures at the hands of Bhairava for ten thousand years and then attains salvation, O beauti¬ ful lady.

verses.sanskrit: कालेन श्रीकरः सोऽपि चन्द्रसेनश्च भूपतिः । समाराध्य महाकालं भेजतुः परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: kAlena shrIkaraH so.api chandrasenashcha bhUpatiH | samArAdhya mahAkAlaM bhejatuH paramaM padam
verses.translation: Thus the course of events in regard to one who commits sins has been narrated to you. A man should realise this and worship Avimukta properly.

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधो महाकालः शिवलिङ्गः सतां गतिः । सर्वथा दुष्टहन्ता च शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: evaMvidho mahAkAlaH shivali~NgaH satAM gatiH | sarvathA duShTahantA cha sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: The birth will be good or evil in accordance widi the predominance or deficiency of the one or the other.

verses.sanskrit: इदं पवित्रं परमं रहस्यं सर्वसौख्यदम् । आख्यानं कथितं स्वर्ग्यं शिवभक्तिविवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: idaM pavitraM paramaM rahasyaM sarvasaukhyadam | AkhyAnaM kathitaM svargyaM shivabhaktivivardhanam
verses.translation: O great goddess, the action that causes bondage is said to be threefold as mentioned in the Karmakd section of the Vedas. It is (1) hoarded (Saficita) (2) the current (Kriyamana) and (3) that which has started yielding results (Prarabdha).

verses.sanskrit: स तु चिन्तामणिं कण्ठे बिभ्रद् राजा शिवाश्रयः । चन्द्रसेनो रराजाति देवमध्येव भानुमान्
verses.transliteration: sa tu chintAmaNiM kaNThe bibhrad rAjA shivAshrayaH | chandraseno rarAjAti devamadhyeva bhAnumAn
verses.translation: The actions of the previous births are classified as hoarded. The action the fruit of which is being experienced in the present birth is Prarabdha. O goddess, whether good or bad the action performed in this birth is known as Kriyamana.*®*

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा चिन्तामणिग्रीवं चन्द्रसेनं नृपोत्तमम् । निखिलाः क्षितिराजानस्तृष्णाक्षुब्धहृदोऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: shrutvA chintAmaNigrIvaM chandrasenaM nR^ipottamam | nikhilAH kShitirAjAnastR^iShNAkShubdhahR^ido.abhavan
verses.translation: The annihilation of the Prarabdha Karman is only through enjoyment and not otherwise. The destruction of the other two types of action is possible through worship alone.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: If Kai had been visited with devotion in the pre¬ vious birth, the person in the present birth reaches Ka5i and dies there and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: If Kai had been visited with devotion in the pre¬ vious birth, the person in the present birth reaches Ka5i and dies there and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१८. अष्टादशोऽध्यायः । ओङ्कारेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सूत महाभाग श्राविता ह्यद्भुता कथा । महाकालाख्यलिङ्गस्य निजभक्तसुरक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.18\. aShTAdasho.adhyAyaH | o~NkAreshvarajyotirli~NgamAhAtmyavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | sUta sUta mahAbhAga shrAvitA hyadbhutA kathA | mahAkAlAkhyali~Ngasya nijabhaktasurakShiNaH
verses.translation: If after reaching Ka§i a man takes his ceremonial bath in the Ganges, the two types of actions viz. the current and the hoarded are destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा नारदस्तस्माज्जगाम च यथागतम् । विन्ध्यश्च परितप्तो वै धिग्वै मे जीवितादिकम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA nAradastasmAjjagAma cha yathAgatam | vindhyashcha paritapto vai dhigvai me jIvitAdikam
verses.translation: Then his sins are reduced to ashes. Hence a man shall resort to K&li. That certainly debars Karmans to fructify.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेश्वरं तथा शम्भुमाराध्य च तपाम्यहम् । इति निश्चित्य मनसा शङ्करं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: vishveshvaraM tathA shambhumArAdhya cha tapAmyaham | iti nishchitya manasA sha~NkaraM sharaNaM gataH
verses.translation: Man's actions are classified into three categories, viz. (i) past actions still unfructified, (ii) past actions beginning to fructify

verses.sanskrit: जगाम तत्र सुप्रीत्या ह्योङ्कारो यत्र वै स्वयम् । चकार च पुनस्तत्र शिवमूर्तिं च पार्थिवीम्
verses.transliteration: jagAma tatra suprItyA hyo~NkAro yatra vai svayam | chakAra cha punastatra shivamUrtiM cha pArthivIm
verses.translation: If both the desire for worldly enjoyment and salvation are fulfilled at Prayaga, the fruit of salvation derived from residence in Kaii is likely to be in vain. If only the fruit of salvation is the goal, the fruits of Prayaga are likely to be in vain.***

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य च तदा शम्भुं षण्मासं स निरन्तरम् । न चचाल तपःस्थानाच्छिवध्यानपरायणः
verses.transliteration: ArAdhya cha tadA shambhuM ShaNmAsaM sa nirantaram | na chachAla tapaHsthAnAchChivadhyAnaparAyaNaH
verses.translation: Hence at my behest, Vinu creates something afresh and accords him the fruit as mentally conceived by him.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विन्ध्यतपो दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्नः पार्वतीपतिः । स्वरूपं दर्शयामास दुर्लभं योगिनामपि
verses.transliteration: evaM vindhyatapo dR^iShTvA prasannaH pArvatIpatiH | svarUpaM darshayAmAsa durlabhaM yoginAmapi
verses.translation: O excellent sages, such things constitute the great* ness of KaI and VisveSvara yielding worldly pleasures and salvation to the good.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नः स तदोवाच ब्रूहि त्वं मनसेप्सितम् । तपसा ते प्रसन्नोऽस्मि भक्तानामीप्सितप्रदः
verses.transliteration: prasannaH sa tadovAcha brUhi tvaM manasepsitam | tapasA te prasanno.asmi bhaktAnAmIpsitapradaH
verses.translation: Hereafter I shall explain the greatness of Tryaih* baka on hearing which a man gets rid of his sins altogether.

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्य उवाच । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश बुद्धिं देहि यथेप्सिताम् । स्वकार्यसाधिनीं शम्भो त्वं सदा भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: vindhya uvAcha | yadi prasanno devesha buddhiM dehi yathepsitAm | svakAryasAdhinIM shambho tvaM sadA bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: The holy Prayiga yields worldly desiret as well as emanci* uation; the holy KSlI grants emancipation only. For him who desires Doth the worldly enjoyment and emancipation, Kfili is useless, for he can get these at PraySsa. For him wno desires emancipation alone prayiga is of no avail, for he can get the same at KSI.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान् शम्भुश्चिचेत हृदये चिरम् । परोपतापदं विन्ध्यो वरमिच्छति मूढधीः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tachChrutvA bhagavAn shambhushchicheta hR^idaye chiram | paropatApadaM vindhyo varamichChati mUDhadhIH
verses.translation: A penance extending to ten thousand years was performed by him on the Brahmagiri'*® mountain in the southern quarter.

verses.sanskrit: किं करोमि यदेतस्मै वरदानं भवेच्छुभम् । मद्दत्तं परदुःखाय वरदानं यथा न हि
verses.transliteration: kiM karomi yadetasmai varadAnaM bhavechChubham | maddattaM paraduHkhAya varadAnaM yathA na hi
verses.translation: O great ones of good rites, once a terrible drought lasting for a hundred years occurred there. All the people were put to great distress.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तथापि दत्तवान् शम्भुस्तस्मै तद्वरमुत्तमम् । विन्ध्य पर्वतराज त्वं यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tathApi dattavAn shambhustasmai tadvaramuttamam | vindhya parvatarAja tvaM yathechChasi tathA kuru
verses.translation: Then the sages and other men, the beasts, birds and the deer of the forest went to the different quarters.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गं चतुर्थं च कृपया वद वित्तम । ओंङ्कारे परमेशस्य सर्वपातकहारिणः
verses.transliteration: jyotirli~NgaM chaturthaM cha kR^ipayA vada vittama | oM~NkAre parameshasya sarvapAtakahAriNaH
verses.translation: On seeing the drought, the sages and the brahmins spent the horrible time in meditation and performing Pranayamas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं च समये देवा ऋषयश्चामलाशयाः । सम्पूज्य शङ्करं तत्र स्थातव्यमिति चाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: evaM cha samaye devA R^iShayashchAmalAshayAH | sampUjya sha~NkaraM tatra sthAtavyamiti chAbruvan
verses.translation: Gautama himself performed an auspicions penance of Varuna for six months engrossed in Pranayama.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा देववचनं प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः । तथैव कृतवान्प्रीत्या लोकानां सुखहेतवे
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA devavachanaM prasannaH parameshvaraH | tathaiva kR^itavAnprItyA lokAnAM sukhahetave
verses.translation: Then Varuna came there to grant him the boon. He said —'T am delighted. Mention the boon you wish to have. I shall grant it.'*

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारं चैव यल्लिङ्गमेकं तच्च द्विधा गतम् । प्रणवे चैव ओङ्कारनामासीत्स सदाशिवः
verses.transliteration: o~NkAraM chaiva yalli~NgamekaM tachcha dvidhA gatam | praNave chaiva o~NkAranAmAsItsa sadAshivaH
verses.translation: O brahmins, then Gautama requested him for rain. Then Varuna replied to the sage.
verses.hindi: अनेकरूप होकर अनेक प्रकारके कर्म करनेवाले

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवे चैव यज्जातं तदासीत्परमेश्वरः । भक्ताभीष्टप्रदौ चोभौ भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदौ द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: pArthive chaiva yajjAtaM tadAsItparameshvaraH | bhaktAbhIShTapradau chobhau bhuktimuktipradau dvijAH
verses.translation: How can I countermand the behest of the gods? Please ask for something else. You are a wise man. I shall grant it.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पूजां च तदा चक्रुर्देवाश्च ऋषयस्तथा । प्रापुर्वराननेकांश्च सन्तोष्य वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: tatpUjAM cha tadA chakrurdevAshcha R^iShayastathA | prApurvarAnanekAMshcha santoShya vR^iShabhadhvajam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Varuna the great Atman, Gautama, eager to help others spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्वस्थानं ययुर्देवा विन्ध्योऽपि मुदितोऽधिकम् । कार्यं साधितवान्स्वीयं परितापं जहौ द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: svasvasthAnaM yayurdevA vindhyo.api mudito.adhikam | kAryaM sAdhitavAnsvIyaM paritApaM jahau dvijAH
verses.translation: O lord of gods, if you are delighted, if a boon is to be granted to me, you shall grant it according to my desire.

verses.sanskrit: य एवं पूजयेच्छम्भुं मातृगर्भं वसेन्न हि । यदभीष्टं फलं तच्च प्राप्नुयान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: ya evaM pUjayechChambhuM mAtR^igarbhaM vasenna hi | yadabhIShTaM phalaM tachcha prApnuyAnnAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: Since you are the lord of waters, you shall give

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातमोङ्कारप्रभवे फलम् । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि केदारं लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | etatte sarvamAkhyAtamo~NkAraprabhave phalam | ataH paraM pravakShyAmi kedAraM li~Ngamuttamam
verses.translation: Requested thus by Gautama, Varuna said—"Please dig a ditch here".

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । ओंङ्कारे परमेशाख्यं लिङ्गमासीद्यथा द्विजाः । तथा वक्ष्यामि वः प्रीत्या श्रूयतां परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | oM~NkAre parameshAkhyaM li~NgamAsIdyathA dvijAH | tathA vakShyAmi vaH prItyA shrUyatAM paramarShayaH
verses.translation: Then lord Varuna the king of waters spoke to Gautama, the excellent sage, eager to help others.

verses.sanskrit: कस्मिंश्चित्समये चात्र नारदो भगवान्मुनिः । गोकर्णाख्यं शिवं गत्वा सिषेवे परभक्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: kasmiMshchitsamaye chAtra nArado bhagavAnmuniH | gokarNAkhyaM shivaM gatvA siSheve parabhaktimAn
verses.translation: O great sage, let there be a perennial supply of water in this ditch that has become sacred. This will be¬ come famous on the earth by your name.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स आगतो विन्ध्यं नगेशं मुनिसत्तमः । तत्रैव पूजितस्तेन बहुमानपुरःसरम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa Agato vindhyaM nageshaM munisattamaH | tatraiva pUjitastena bahumAnapuraHsaram
verses.translation: Charitable gifts made here, rites performed here, penance pursued here, the sacrifices done here for the gods and the raddha offered to the manes, everything will be imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: मयि सर्वं विद्यते च न न्यूनं हि कदाचन । इति भावं समास्थाय संस्थितो नारदाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: mayi sarvaM vidyate cha na nyUnaM hi kadAchana | iti bhAvaM samAsthAya saMsthito nAradAgrataH
verses.translation: After saying this, the lord eulogised by that sage vanished. After rendering help to others, the sage Gautama too was happy.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मानं तत्तदा श्रुत्वा नारदो मानहा ततः । निःश्वस्य संस्थितस्तत्र श्रुत्वा विन्ध्योऽब्रवीदिदम्
verses.transliteration: tanmAnaM tattadA shrutvA nArado mAnahA tataH | niHshvasya saMsthitastatra shrutvA vindhyo.abravIdidam
verses.translation: Man attains fruits in accordance with the nature of the man one serves. Loftiness is achieved by serving the great and meanness by serving the mean.

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्य उवाच । किं न्यूनं च त्वया दृष्टं मयि निः श्वासकारणम् । तच्छ्रुत्वा नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्स महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: vindhya uvAcha | kiM nyUnaM cha tvayA dR^iShTaM mayi niH shvAsakAraNam | tachChrutvA nArado vAkyamabravItsa mahAmuniH
verses.translation: Trees, gold, sandal paste and the sugarcane exist for the enjoyment of the people. Men similarly competoit arc very rare in the world.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । विद्यते त्वयि सर्वं हि मेरुरुच्चतरः पुनः । देवेष्वपि विभागोऽस्य न तवास्ति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: nArada uvAcha | vidyate tvayi sarvaM hi meruruchchataraH punaH | deveShvapi vibhAgo.asya na tavAsti kadAchana
verses.translation: A kind man, a man unpufied by arrogance a person habitually helping others and a person with peri*.;ct control over his sense-organs, these are the four holy pillars that support the earth.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Thereafter he sowed different food-grains and bar¬ leys there itself for the performance of his sacrifice.
verses.hindi: महर्भधुत॑ सुखकरं तदेव थ्रृणुतादरात्॥ १३४  किया, उसे आदरसे सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Thereafter he sowed different food-grains and bar¬ leys there itself for the performance of his sacrifice.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे चुर्थ्या कोटिर्ंसंहितायां शिवसहस्ननामवर्णन॑ नाम पञ्ञत्रिंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.१९. एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः । केदारेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । नरनारायणाख्यौ याववतारौ हरेर्द्विजाः । तेपाते भारते खण्डे बदर्याश्रम एव हि
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.19\. ekonaviMsho.adhyAyaH | kedAreshvarajyotirli~NgamAhAtmyavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | naranArAyaNAkhyau yAvavatArau harerdvijAH | tepAte bhArate khaNDe badaryAshrama eva hi
verses.translation: Different kinds of food-grains, trees, flowers and fruits were produced in plenty there.

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च पूजयन्तीह ऋषयश्च पुरातनाः । मनोऽभीष्टफलं ते ते सुप्रसन्नान्महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: devAshcha pUjayantIha R^iShayashcha purAtanAH | mano.abhIShTaphalaM te te suprasannAnmaheshvarAt
verses.translation: On hearing of it, the sages came there in thousands. Many beasts, birds and other living beings flocked there.
verses.hindi: मेरा नेत्र कमलके समान नहीं है ?

verses.sanskrit: भवस्य पूजनान्नित्यं बदर्याश्रमवासिनः । प्राप्नुवन्ति यतः सो हि भक्ताभीष्टप्रदः सदा
verses.transliteration: bhavasya pUjanAnnityaM badaryAshramavAsinaH | prApnuvanti yataH so hi bhaktAbhIShTapradaH sadA
verses.translation: The forest became very beautiful, the most excellent on the surface of the world. In view of this imperishable contact the drought was not distressing.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दिनं हि समारभ्य केदारेश्वर एव च । पूजितो येन भक्त्या वै दुःखं स्वप्नेऽपि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: taddinaM hi samArabhya kedAreshvara eva cha | pUjito yena bhaktyA vai duHkhaM svapne.api durlabham
verses.translation: The sages in the forest were engaged in auspicious rites. They stayed there along with their disciples, children and womenfolk.

verses.sanskrit: यो वै हि पाण्डवान्दृष्ट्वा माहिषं रूपमास्थितः । मायामास्थाय तत्रैव पलायनपरोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: yo vai hi pANDavAndR^iShTvA mAhiShaM rUpamAsthitaH | mAyAmAsthAya tatraiva palAyanaparo.abhavat
verses.translation: They sowed food-grains for their livelihood. There was great joy and bliss in that forest, thanks to the power of Gautama.
verses.hindi: क्‍ नामक उत्तम चक्र देता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: धृतश्च पाण्डवैस्तत्र ह्यवाङ्मुखतया स्थितः । पुच्छं चैव धृतं तैस्तु प्रार्थितश्च पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: dhR^itashcha pANDavaistatra hyavA~NmukhatayA sthitaH | puchChaM chaiva dhR^itaM taistu prArthitashcha punaHpunaH
verses.translation: O brahmins, once Gautama sent his disdples there for water. Carrying out his orders they reached the spot with the water-pots in their hands.

verses.sanskrit: तद्रूपेण स्थितस्तत्र भक्तवत्सलनामभाक् । नयपाले शिरोभागो गतस्तद्रूपतः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tadrUpeNa sthitastatra bhaktavatsalanAmabhAk | nayapAle shirobhAgo gatastadrUpataH sthitaH
verses.translation: Many of the womenfolk who had assembled there for water saw the disciples of Gautama who had come for water. They prevented them from taking water.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव पूजनान्नित्यमाज्ञां चैवाप्यदात्तथा । पूजितश्च स्वयं शम्भुस्तत्र तस्थौ वरानदात्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva pUjanAnnityamAj~nAM chaivApyadAttathA | pUjitashcha svayaM shambhustatra tasthau varAnadAt
verses.translation: **We are the wives of the sages. We shall take water first. You stand far off. You can take water after¬ wards.'* Thus they rebuked them.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयित्वा गतास्ते तु पाण्डवा मुदितास्तदा । लब्ध्वा चित्तेप्सितं सर्वं विमुक्ताः सर्वदुःखतः
verses.transliteration: pUjayitvA gatAste tu pANDavA muditAstadA | labdhvA chittepsitaM sarvaM vimuktAH sarvaduHkhataH
verses.translation: The disciples returned and informed- the wife of

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नित्यं हरः साक्षात्क्षेत्रे केदारसंज्ञके । भारतीभिः प्रजाभिश्च तथैव परिपूज्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra nityaM haraH sAkShAtkShetre kedArasa.nj~nake | bhAratIbhiH prajAbhishcha tathaiva paripUjyate
verses.translation: The other women, the wives of the sages, became infuriated and rebuked her. They returned to their huts with evil intentions lurking in their minds.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रत्यं वलयं यो वै ददाति हरवल्लभः । हररूपान्तिकं तच्च हररूपसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tatratyaM valayaM yo vai dadAti haravallabhaH | hararUpAntikaM tachcha hararUpasamanvitam
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the great sages became furious with Gautama as it was destined to be.
verses.hindi: भी दुःख नहीं होगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां सम्प्रार्थितः शम्भुः पार्थिवे पूजनाय वै । आयाति नित्यं तल्लिङ्गे भक्ताधीनतया शिवः
verses.transliteration: tAbhyAM samprArthitaH shambhuH pArthive pUjanAya vai | AyAti nityaM talli~Nge bhaktAdhInatayA shivaH
verses.translation: The infuriated sages of crooked intellect worshipped Ganeiia with various articles of worship in order to put ob¬ stacle in the activity of Gautama.
verses.hindi: करे, तो वह कल्याणको प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: तथैव रूपं दृष्ट्वा च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते । जीवन्मुक्तो भवेत्सोऽपि यो गतो बदरीवने
verses.transliteration: tathaiva rUpaM dR^iShTvA cha sarvapApaiH pramuchyate | jIvanmukto bhavetso.api yo gato badarIvane
verses.translation: *T am pleased with you. Mention the boon you wish to choose. What shall I do?'* On hearing his words the sages said then.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा रूपं नरस्यैव तथा नारायणस्य हि । केदारेश्वरशम्भोश्च मुक्तिभागी न संशयः
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA rUpaM narasyaiva tathA nArAyaNasya hi | kedAreshvarashambhoshcha muktibhAgI na saMshayaH
verses.translation: On being requested thus, the elephant-faced deity,'** the goal of the good, laughed and said gently enlightening them.
verses.hindi: निश्चित रूपसे वशमें कर लिया है

verses.sanskrit: केदारेशस्य भक्ता ये मार्गस्थास्तस्य वै मृताः । तेऽपि मुक्ता भवन्त्येव नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: kedAreshasya bhaktA ye mArgasthAstasya vai mR^itAH | te.api muktA bhavantyeva nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: According misery to the people who had rendered

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र प्रीतियुक्तः केदारेशं प्रपूज्य च । तत्रत्यमुदकं पीत्वा पुनर्जन्म न विन्दति
verses.transliteration: gatvA tatra prItiyuktaH kedAreshaM prapUjya cha | tatratyamudakaM pItvA punarjanma na vindati
verses.translation: On the elephant'faced Gane 4 a, see 5 P. Rudra. Kuznfira. ch 17.

verses.sanskrit: खण्डेऽस्मिन् भारते विप्रा नरनारायणेश्वरः । केदारेशः प्रपूज्यश्च सर्वैर्जीवैः सुभक्तितः
verses.transliteration: khaNDe.asmin bhArate viprA naranArAyaNeshvaraH | kedAreshaH prapUjyashcha sarvairjIvaiH subhaktitaH
verses.translation: Excellent results arc sought after performing. penance. No harm is sought after voluntarily eschewing
verses.hindi: न हो, मैं अन्य और कुछ नहीं चाहता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: अस्य खण्डस्य स स्वामी सर्वेशोऽपि विशेषतः । सर्वकामप्रदः शम्भुः केदाराख्यो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: asya khaNDasya sa svAmI sarvesho.api visheShataH | sarvakAmapradaH shambhuH kedArAkhyo na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Even after hearing these words, the excellent sages, still deluded in their intellect, spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वचः समाख्यातं यत्पृष्टमृषिसत्तमाः । श्रुत्वा पापं हरेत्सर्वं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: etadvachaH samAkhyAtaM yatpR^iShTamR^iShisattamAH | shrutvA pApaM haretsarvaM nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: ''O lord, this must be done by you. Not other¬ wise.'* Gancia who was thus implored spoke.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला होगा, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: एवं पूजयतोः शम्भुं तयोर्विष्ण्ववतारयोः । चिरकालो व्यतीयाय शैवयोर्धर्मपुत्रयोः
verses.transliteration: evaM pUjayatoH shambhuM tayorviShNvavatArayoH | chirakAlo vyatIyAya shaivayordharmaputrayoH
verses.translation: This has been decisively said by Brahma—"A wicked man never attains saintly nature nor does a saintly man assume perversion at any time."

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्समये तत्र प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरो मे व्रियतामिति
verses.transliteration: ekasminsamaye tatra prasannaH parameshvaraH | pratyuvAcha prasanno.asmi varo me vriyatAmiti
verses.translation: Formerly when you were distressed by starvation, the sage Gautama afforded you happiness.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते च तदा तेन नरो नारायणः स्वयम् । ऊचतुर्वचनं तत्र लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: ityukte cha tadA tena naro nArAyaNaH svayam | UchaturvachanaM tatra lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
verses.translation: Now you intend to inflict misery on him. This is not proper. Please think over this in all aspects.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद आपलोग और क्‍या पूछना चाहते हैं 2

verses.sanskrit: नरनारायणावूचतुः । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश यदि देयो वरस्त्वया । स्थीयतां स्वेन रूपेण पूजार्थं शङ्कर स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: naranArAyaNAvUchatuH | yadi prasanno devesha yadi deyo varastvayA | sthIyatAM svena rUpeNa pUjArthaM sha~Nkara svayam
verses.translation: Deluded by your women-folk you never cared to act by my advice. There is no doubt that mv advice will be beneficial to him at the end.
verses.hindi: हति श्रीशिक्महापुराणे चतुर्ध्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां शिवसहस्रनामस्तोत्रफलवर्णन॑ नाम पट्त्रिंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तस्तु तदा ताभ्यां केदारे हिमसंश्रये । स्वयं च शङ्करस्तस्थौ ज्योतीरूपो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktastu tadA tAbhyAM kedAre himasaMshraye | svayaM cha sha~Nkarastasthau jyotIrUpo maheshvaraH
verses.translation: Certainly the excellent sage will render happiness unto you. Deception is not proper. Please choose anothei boon.

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां च पूजितश्चैव सर्वदुःखभयापहः । लोकानामुपकारार्थं भक्तानां दर्शनाय वै
verses.transliteration: tAbhyAM cha pUjitashchaiva sarvaduHkhabhayApahaH | lokAnAmupakArArthaM bhaktAnAM darshanAya vai
verses.translation: Gautaima did not know the evil intention of the
verses.hindi: सुननेवालोंको भोग तथा मोक्ष प्रदान करता है

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं स्थितस्तदा शम्भुः केदारेश्वरसंज्ञकः । भक्ताभीष्टप्रदो नित्यं दर्शनादर्चनादपि
verses.transliteration: svayaM sthitastadA shambhuH kedAreshvarasa.nj~nakaH | bhaktAbhIShTaprado nityaM darshanAdarchanAdapi
verses.translation: O great sages, hear what happened in the mean¬ time as a result of the influence of those wicked sages by the granting of the boon.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O excellent sages, staggering and faltering, the cow, as a result of the boon began to eat the food-grains and barleys.
verses.hindi: उन्हींकी कृपासे सदा विश्वको सृष्टि करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O excellent sages, staggering and faltering, the cow, as a result of the boon began to eat the food-grains and barleys.
verses.hindi: अहल्या भी शिवकी पूजा करनेवाली हैं

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२०. विंशोऽध्यायः । भीमासुरकृतोपद्रववर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि माहात्म्यं भैमशङ्करम् । यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण सर्वाभीष्टं लभेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.20\. viMsho.adhyAyaH | bhImAsurakR^itopadravavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | ataH paraM pravakShyAmi mAhAtmyaM bhaimasha~Nkaram | yasya shravaNamAtreNa sarvAbhIShTaM labhennaraH
verses.translation: In the meantime Gautama happened to come there casually. Compassionate by nature, he warded off the cow with a bunch of grass blades.
verses.hindi: याज्ञवल्क्य, जैमिनि एवं गर्ग भी महाशैब हैं

verses.sanskrit: कर्कट्युवाच । पिता ते कुम्भकर्णश्च रावणानुज एव च । रामेण मारितः सोऽयं भ्रात्रा सह महाबलः
verses.transliteration: karkaTyuvAcha | pitA te kumbhakarNashcha rAvaNAnuja eva cha | rAmeNa mAritaH so.ayaM bhrAtrA saha mahAbalaH
verses.translation: The sages and their wicked wives who were hiding there began to shout, '*0 see, what is done by Gautama."

verses.sanskrit: अत्रागतः कदाचिद्वै कुम्भकर्णः स राक्षसः । मद्भोगं कृतवांस्तात प्रसह्य बलवान्पुरा
verses.transliteration: atrAgataH kadAchidvai kumbhakarNaH sa rAkShasaH | madbhogaM kR^itavAMstAta prasahya balavAnpurA
verses.translation: O brahmins, the bewildered Gautama called Ahalya and spoke with a dejected, distressed mind.

verses.sanskrit: लङ्कां स गतवान् मां च त्यक्त्वात्रैव महाबलः । मया न दृष्टा सा लङ्का ह्यत्रैव निवसाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: la~NkAM sa gatavAn mAM cha tyaktvAtraiva mahAbalaH | mayA na dR^iShTA sA la~NkA hyatraiva nivasAmyaham
verses.translation: O gentle lady, what has happened? How did it happen? Certainly lord Siva is angry. What should be dene? Where shall we go? The sin of slaughter has befallen me.
verses.hindi: गरुड़ आदि पक्षी भी शिवभक्त हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: पिता मे कर्कटो नाम माता मे पुष्कसी मता । भर्ता मम विराधो हि रामेण निहतः पुरा
verses.transliteration: pitA me karkaTo nAma mAtA me puShkasI matA | bhartA mama virAdho hi rAmeNa nihataH purA
verses.translation: In the meantime the brahmins reproached Gautama. The wives of the brahmins tormented Ahalya with threats.
verses.hindi: सहित नित्य शिवपूजामें निरत रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: पित्रोः पार्श्वे स्थिता चाहं निहते स्वामिनि प्रिये । पितरौ मे मृतौ चात्र ऋषिणा भस्मसात्कृतौ
verses.transliteration: pitroH pArshve sthitA chAhaM nihate svAmini priye | pitarau me mR^itau chAtra R^iShiNA bhasmasAtkR^itau
verses.translation: The evil-minded disciples and sons of the brah¬ mins reviled at Gautama repeating the words, "Fie on you."
verses.hindi: धारणकर विशेष रूपसे शिवपूजन करते थे

verses.sanskrit: भक्षणार्थं गतौ तत्र क्रुद्धेन सुमहात्मना । सुतीक्ष्णेन सुतपसागस्त्यशिष्येण वै तदा
verses.transliteration: bhakShaNArthaM gatau tatra kruddhena sumahAtmanA | sutIkShNena sutapasAgastyashiShyeNa vai tadA
verses.translation: As long as you stay in the midst of the hermitage, the sacrificial fires and the manes will not accept our gifts.

verses.sanskrit: साहमेकाकिनी जाता दुःखिता पर्वते पुरा । निवसामि स्म दुःखार्ता निरालम्बा निराश्रया
verses.transliteration: sAhamekAkinI jAtA duHkhitA parvate purA | nivasAmi sma duHkhArtA nirAlambA nirAshrayA
verses.translation: Hence, O sinner, O slayer of a cow, go somewhere else along with your followers. Do not delay.
verses.hindi: निरन्तर सुखका भोग करनेवाले हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये ह्यत्र राक्षसो रावणानुजः । आगत्य कृतवान् सङ्गं मां विहाय गतो हि सः
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye hyatra rAkShaso rAvaNAnujaH | Agatya kR^itavAn sa~NgaM mAM vihAya gato hi saH
verses.translation: Beaten and reproachad by the wicked persons Gautama spoke these words—sages, I am going away from here. I shall stay somewhere else.
verses.hindi: जो प्रीतिसे शिवका पूजन करते थे

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वं च समुत्पन्नो महाबलपराक्रमः । अवलम्ब्य पुनस्त्वां च कालक्षेपं करोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: tatastvaM cha samutpanno mahAbalaparAkramaH | avalambya punastvAM cha kAlakShepaM karomyaham
verses.translation: Beaten and reproachad by the wicked persons Gautama spoke these words—sages, I am going away from here. I shall stay somewhere else.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या भीमो भीमपराक्रमः । क्रुद्धश्च चिन्तयामास किं करोमि हरिं प्रति
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasyA bhImo bhImaparAkramaH | kruddhashcha chintayAmAsa kiM karomi hariM prati
verses.translation: After saying this, Gautama went out of that place. Going a kroSa he made his hermitage there with their per¬ mission.

verses.sanskrit: कामरूपाभिधे देशे शङ्करो लोककाम्यया । अवतीर्णः स्वयं साक्षात्कल्याणसुखभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: kAmarUpAbhidhe deshe sha~Nkaro lokakAmyayA | avatIrNaH svayaM sAkShAtkalyANasukhabhAjanam
verses.translation: The excellent sage Gautama excessively distressed by this regrettable incident spent half of month thus and then requested.

verses.sanskrit: पितानेन हतो मे हि तथा मातामहा अपि । विराधश्च हतोऽनेन दुःखं बहुतरं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: pitAnena hato me hi tathA mAtAmahA api | virAdhashcha hato.anena duHkhaM bahutaraM kR^itam
verses.translation: I am to be pitied by you. Please tell me how my sin can be wiped off. I shall do as you bid me.
verses.hindi: ये उत्तम ब्रतवाले पुत्र उत्पन्न हुएु

verses.sanskrit: तत्पुत्रोऽहं भवेयं चेद्धरिं तं पीडयाम्यहम् । इति कृत्वा मतिं भीमस्तपस्तप्तुं महद्ययौ
verses.transliteration: tatputro.ahaM bhaveyaM cheddhariM taM pIDayAmyaham | iti kR^itvA matiM bhImastapastaptuM mahadyayau
verses.translation: Thus requested the brahmins did not say anything. When they were implored humbly they met separately and remained aloof.
verses.hindi: भाइयोंसहित नित्य पार्थिवपूजन किया करते थे

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं च समुद्दिश्य वर्षाणां च सहस्रकम् । मनसा ध्यानमाश्रित्य तपश्चक्रे महत्तदा
verses.transliteration: brahmANaM cha samuddishya varShANAM cha sahasrakam | manasA dhyAnamAshritya tapashchakre mahattadA
verses.translation: Gautama stood far off. Bowing down to the sages he humbly asked them what he should do.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वबाहुश्चैकपादः सूर्ये दृष्टिं दधत्पुरा । संस्थितः स बभूवाथ भीमो राक्षसपुत्रकः
verses.transliteration: UrdhvabAhushchaikapAdaH sUrye dR^iShTiM dadhatpurA | saMsthitaH sa babhUvAtha bhImo rAkShasaputrakaH
verses.translation: "Without expiation purity cannot be attained. Hence, for the sake of purification you shall perform the rites of atonement.

verses.sanskrit: शिरसस्तस्य सञ्जातं तेजः परमदारुणम् । तेन दग्धास्तदा देवा ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: shirasastasya sa~njAtaM tejaH paramadAruNam | tena dagdhAstadA devA brahmANaM sharaNaM yayuH
verses.translation: Go round the earth three times announcing your sin. After returning to this place perform the holy Vrata for a month.
verses.hindi: नहुषश्च महाशैव: शिवपूजारतो ह्ाभूतू॥ ४४ पूजामें तत्पर रहते थे

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य वेधसं भक्त्या तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तवैः । दुःखं निवेदयाञ्चक्रुर्ब्रह्मणे ते सवासवाः
verses.transliteration: praNamya vedhasaM bhaktyA tuShTuvurvividhaiH stavaiH | duHkhaM nivedayA~nchakrurbrahmaNe te savAsavAH
verses.translation: If you go round this mountain Brahmagiri hundred and one times you can attain purity.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । ब्रह्मन्वै रक्षसस्तेजो लोकान्पीडितुमुद्यतम् । यत्प्रार्थ्यते च दुष्टेन तत्त्वं देहि वरं विधे
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH | brahmanvai rakShasastejo lokAnpIDitumudyatam | yatprArthyate cha duShTena tattvaM dehi varaM vidhe
verses.translation: Or you fetch water from Ganga and perform the ceremonial ablution. Propitiate lord l§iva making a crore of his phallic images.

verses.sanskrit: नो चेदद्य वयं दग्धास्तीव्रतत्तेजसा पुनः । यास्यामः सङ्क्षयं सर्वे तस्मात्तं देहि प्रार्थितम्
verses.transliteration: no chedadya vayaM dagdhAstIvratattejasA punaH | yAsyAmaH sa~NkShayaM sarve tasmAttaM dehi prArthitam
verses.translation: At the outset, you circumambulate this mountain eleven times. Taking bath in Ganga you will become pure thereafter.
verses.hindi: शाड्डरं चरितं दिव्यं क्रिमन्यत्प्रष्टुमिच्छसि॥ ५५  क्या पूछना चाहते हैं ?

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । जगाम च वरं दातुं वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti teShAM vachaH shrutvA brahmA lokapitAmahaH | jagAma cha varaM dAtuM vachanaM chedamabravIt
verses.translation: Performing the ablution of the earthen phallic image of Siva with a hundred potful of water, the expiatory rite will be completed." When he was thus urged by the sages he said in the affirmative.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे च॒दुर्थ्या कोटिरद्रसंहितायां देवरर्षिनृपशैवत्ववर्णन॑ नाम सप्तत्रिंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरं ब्रूहि यत्ते मनसि वर्तते । इति श्रुत्वा विधेर्वाक्यमब्रवीद्राक्षसो हि सः
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | prasanno.asmi varaM brUhi yatte manasi vartate | iti shrutvA vidhervAkyamabravIdrAkShaso hi saH
verses.translation: O excellent sages, at the behest of your honours I shall worship the earthen phallic image of Siva and also circumambulate the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थमवतीर्णोऽसौ शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः । शृणुतादरतस्तच्च कथयामि मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: yadarthamavatIrNo.asau sha~Nkaro lokasha~NkaraH | shR^iNutAdaratastachcha kathayAmi munIshvarAH
verses.translation: After saying this and circumambulating the mountain, the excellent sage made earthen phallic images of Siva and worshipped them.
