verses.translation: O Siva, save me. O lord of gods, save me. O Siva, save me now froir. this wicked Raksasa. O lord of the three worlds, O slayer of the wicked, O one favourably disposed towards his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O Siva, save me. O lord of gods, save me. O Siva, save me now froir. this wicked Raksasa. O lord of the three worlds, O slayer of the wicked, O one favourably disposed towards his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२४. चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः । गौतमप्रभाववर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । श्रूयतामृषयः श्रेष्ठाः कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् । कथयामि यथा व्यासात्सद्गुरोश्च श्रुता मया
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.24\. chaturviMsho.adhyAyaH | gautamaprabhAvavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | shrUyatAmR^iShayaH shreShThAH kathAM pApapraNAshinIm | kathayAmi yathA vyAsAtsadguroshcha shrutA mayA
verses.translation: O lord, you alone are my entire possession. I belong to you. I am subservient to you. O lord, my very life is always in you.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च गौतमस्तं वै वृष्टिं च प्रार्थयत्तदा । ततः स वरुणस्तं वै प्रत्युवाच मुनिं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tatashcha gautamastaM vai vR^iShTiM cha prArthayattadA | tataH sa varuNastaM vai pratyuvAcha muniM dvijAH
verses.translation: Thus implored, Siva appeared out of the crevice with an excellent temple with four doors.

verses.sanskrit: वरुण उवाच । देवाज्ञां च समुल्लङ्घ्य कथं कुर्यामहं च ताम् । अन्यत्प्रार्थय सुज्ञोऽसि यदहं करवाणि ते
verses.transliteration: varuNa uvAcha | devAj~nAM cha samulla~Nghya kathaM kuryAmahaM cha tAm | anyatprArthaya suj~no.asi yadahaM karavANi te
verses.translation: Seeing in its midst the wonderfully brilliant form f)f Siva along with his attendants he worshipped him.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येतद्वचनं तस्य वरुणस्य महात्मनः । परोपकारी तच्छ्रुत्वा गौतमो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityetadvachanaM tasya varuNasya mahAtmanaH | paropakArI tachChrutvA gautamo vAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: On being worshipped, Siva became delighted. He gave him the Pa<upata missile. He immediately slew all the Raksasas with all their attendants and adjuncts. He saved thus his devotee. Indeed 8iva is the slayer of the wicked.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम । यदहं प्रार्थयाम्यद्य कर्तव्यं हि त्वया तथा
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | yadi prasanno devesha yadi deyo varo mama | yadahaM prArthayAmyadya kartavyaM hi tvayA tathA
verses.translation: After killing all of them, Siva the creator of his Oracles and who assumes bodies in the course of sports granted a boon to the forest.

verses.sanskrit: यतस्त्वं जलराशीशस्तस्माद्देयं जलं मम । अक्षयं सर्वदेवेश दिव्यं नित्यफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: yatastvaM jalarAshIshastasmAddeyaM jalaM mama | akShayaM sarvadevesha divyaM nityaphalapradam
verses.translation: Let there never be people of the Tamasaic quali¬ ties. Let there be excellent sages, the propounders and the followers of the iaiva cult.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति सम्प्रार्थितस्तेन वरुणो गौतमेन वै । उवाच वचनं तस्मै गर्तश्च क्रियतां त्वया
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti samprArthitastena varuNo gautamena vai | uvAcha vachanaM tasmai gartashcha kriyatAM tvayA
verses.translation: In the meantime the RaksasT Dfiruka dejected in her mind, eulogised Parvati.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते च कृतस्तेन गर्तो हस्तप्रमाणतः । जलेन पूरितस्तेन दिव्येन वरुणेन सः
verses.transliteration: ityukte cha kR^itastena garto hastapramANataH | jalena pUritastena divyena varuNena saH
verses.translation: 'I'hc goddess being pleased said "What shall 1 do?" She replied-"Let my race be protected by you".

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच मुनिं देवो वरुणो हि जलाधिपः । गौतमं मुनिशार्दूलं परोपकृतिशालिनम्
verses.transliteration: athovAcha muniM devo varuNo hi jalAdhipaH | gautamaM munishArdUlaM paropakR^itishAlinam
verses.translation: "I shall protect your race. I say this truth to you." Saying this the Goddess quairelied with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: वरुण उवाच । अक्षयं च जलं तेऽस्तु तीर्थभूतं महामुने । तव नाम्ना च विख्यातं क्षितावेतद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: varuNa uvAcha | akShayaM cha jalaM te.astu tIrthabhUtaM mahAmune | tava nAmnA cha vikhyAtaM kShitAvetadbhaviShyati
verses.translation: On seeing the goddess furious, the lord, bound by the boon granted by him, replied with pleasure. "Do as you please".

verses.sanskrit: अत्र दत्तं हुतं तप्तं सुराणां यजनं कृतम् । पितॄणां च कृतं श्राद्धं सर्वमेवाक्षयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: atra dattaM hutaM taptaM surANAM yajanaM kR^itam | pitR^INAM cha kR^itaM shrAddhaM sarvamevAkShayaM bhavet
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her husband Siva, the delighted Parvati laughed and spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा ऋषिवरश्चासीद्गौतमो नाम विश्रुतः । अहल्या नाम तस्यासीत्पत्नी परमधार्मिकी
verses.transliteration: purA R^iShivarashchAsIdgautamo nAma vishrutaH | ahalyA nAma tasyAsItpatnI paramadhArmikI
verses.translation: "Your words will be true at the end of this Yuga. Till then, I think, there can be the Tamasaic crea¬ tions as well.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तान्तर्दधे देवः स्तुतस्तेन महर्षिणा । गौतमोऽपि सुखं प्राप कृत्वान्योपकृतिं मुनिः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktAntardadhe devaH stutastena maharShiNA | gautamo.api sukhaM prApa kR^itvAnyopakR^itiM muniH
verses.translation: Otherwise the dissolution will lake place even now. O Siva, let the words uttered by me be proved true. O lord, I belong to you. I depend on you.

verses.sanskrit: महतो ह्याश्रयः पुंसां महत्त्वायोपजायते । महान्तस्तत्स्वरूपं च पश्यन्ति नेतरेऽशुभाः
verses.transliteration: mahato hyAshrayaH puMsAM mahattvAyopajAyate | mahAntastatsvarUpaM cha pashyanti netare.ashubhAH
verses.translation: These wives of the Raksasas will give birth to sons. I have permitted all of them to live jointly in the forest.

verses.sanskrit: यादृङ्नरं च सेवेत तादृशं फलमश्नुते । महतः सेवयोच्चत्वं क्षुद्रस्य क्षुद्रतां तथा
verses.transliteration: yAdR^i~NnaraM cha seveta tAdR^ishaM phalamashnute | mahataH sevayochchatvaM kShudrasya kShudratAM tathA
verses.translation: O beloved, if you say so, please listen to my words. I will stay in this forest with pleasure for protecting the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहस्य मन्दिरे सेवा मुक्ताफलकरी मता । शृगालमन्दिरे सेवा त्वस्थिलाभकरी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: siMhasya mandire sevA muktAphalakarI matA | shR^igAlamandire sevA tvasthilAbhakarI smR^itA
verses.translation: He who maintains the discipline of rites and activities prescribed for different castes and has a sight of me with pleasure here will become an emperor.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमानां स्वभावोऽयं परदुःखासहिष्णुता । स्वयं दुःखं च सम्प्राप्तं मन्यतेऽन्यस्य वार्यते
verses.transliteration: uttamAnAM svabhAvo.ayaM paraduHkhAsahiShNutA | svayaM duHkhaM cha samprAptaM manyate.anyasya vAryate
verses.translation: Or, at the end of the recurring cycle qf Kali or in the beginning of Kfta Age, the leading king equipped with a vast army, famous in the name of Virasena son of Mahasena, will have a sight of me. He will be a very

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षाश्च हाटकं चैव चन्दनं चेक्षुकस्तथा । एते भुवि परार्थे च दक्षा एवं न केचन
verses.transliteration: vR^ikShAshcha hATakaM chaiva chandanaM chekShukastathA | ete bhuvi parArthe cha dakShA evaM na kechana
verses.translation: Exchanging pleasantries thus, the couple, O brah¬ mins, indulging in great sports remained there.

verses.sanskrit: दयालुरमदस्पर्श उपकारी जितेन्द्रियः । एतैश्च पुण्यस्तम्भैस्तु चतुर्भिर्धार्यते मही
verses.transliteration: dayAluramadasparsha upakArI jitendriyaH | etaishcha puNyastambhaistu chaturbhirdhAryate mahI
verses.translation: The Jyotirlihga form of Siva came to be known as Nagesvara. Goddess Siva became Nagesvarl. Both of them are favourites of the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च गौतमस्तत्र जलं प्राप्य सुदुर्लभम् । नित्यनैमित्तिकं कर्म चकार विधिवत्तदा
verses.transliteration: tatashcha gautamastatra jalaM prApya sudurlabham | nityanaimittikaM karma chakAra vidhivattadA
verses.translation: O intelligent one, how will VIrasena go to Daruka vana and worship Siva? Please narrate it.

verses.sanskrit: ततो व्रीहीन् यवांश्चैव नीवारानप्यनेकधा । वापयामास तत्रैव हवनार्थं मुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tato vrIhIn yavAMshchaiva nIvArAnapyanekadhA | vApayAmAsa tatraiva havanArthaM munIshvaraH
verses.translation: Worshipping the earthen image of the lord, Virasena performed a severe penance, lasting for twelve years.

verses.sanskrit: धान्यानि विविधानीह वृक्षाश्च विविधास्तथा । पुष्पाणि च फलान्येव ह्यासंस्तत्राप्यनेकशः
verses.transliteration: dhAnyAni vividhAnIha vR^ikShAshcha vividhAstathA | puShpANi cha phalAnyeva hyAsaMstatrApyanekashaH
verses.translation: Then Siva, the delighted lord of the gods, became visible to him and said:—Make a fish-like canoe of wood. Coat it with tin and other metals. O Virasena, I shall create Yogamaya and give it to you. Enter the canoe accompanied by Yogamaya and your men. Proceed to the island in the Western ocean.'® Enter the crevice made by me. Perform the worship of Nagevara. Thereafter secure the missile PaiSupata and slay the Raksasi and others. When I appear before you; you will not remain deficient in anything.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणस्यां दिशि हि यो गिरिर्ब्रह्मेति संज्ञकः । तत्र तेन तपस्तप्तं वर्षाणामयुतं तथा
verses.transliteration: dakShiNasyAM dishi hi yo girirbrahmeti sa.nj~nakaH | tatra tena tapastaptaM varShANAmayutaM tathA
verses.translation: Parvati's strength will grow to be complete. The Mlecchas of the forest will become pious and auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषयश्चान्ये तत्रायाताः सहस्रशः । पशवः पक्षिणश्चान्ये जीवाश्च बहवोऽगमन्
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA R^iShayashchAnye tatrAyAtAH sahasrashaH | pashavaH pakShiNashchAnye jIvAshcha bahavo.agaman
verses.translation: After saying this to Virasena and bestowing his mercy on everyone lord Siva, the destroyer of miseries, vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वनं सुन्दरं ह्यासीत्पृथिव्यां मण्डले परम् । तदक्षयजलायोगादनावृष्टिर्न दुःखदा
verses.transliteration: tadvanaM sundaraM hyAsItpR^ithivyAM maNDale param | tadakShayajalAyogAdanAvR^iShTirna duHkhadA
verses.translation: Having received the boon form Siva the supreme soul, Virasena became competent to do everything, of course.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयोऽपि वने तत्र शुभकर्मपरायणाः । वासं चक्रुरनेके च शिष्यभार्यासुतान्विताः
verses.transliteration: R^iShayo.api vane tatra shubhakarmaparAyaNAH | vAsaM chakruraneke cha shiShyabhAryAsutAnvitAH
verses.translation: Sfc P. ij7;j note.

verses.sanskrit: धान्यानि वापयामासुः कालक्रमणहेतवे । आनन्दस्तद्वने ह्यासीत्प्रभावाद्गौतमस्य च
verses.transliteration: dhAnyAni vApayAmAsuH kAlakramaNahetave | Anandastadvane hyAsItprabhAvAdgautamasya cha
verses.translation: He who listens to the origin of Nagcsa respect¬ fully attains all desires. He becomes intelligent. And his sins are destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिच्च ह्यनावृष्टिरभवत्तत्र सुव्रताः । वर्षाणां च शतं रौद्री लोका दुःखमुपागताः
verses.transliteration: kadAchichcha hyanAvR^iShTirabhavattatra suvratAH | varShANAM cha shataM raudrI lokA duHkhamupAgatAH
verses.translation: Hereafter I shall explain how the phallic image Ramevara originated formerly. O sages, listen to it respect¬ fully.

verses.sanskrit: आर्द्रं च पल्लवं न स्म दृश्यते पृथिवीतले । कुतो जलं विदृश्येत जीवानां प्राणधारकम्
verses.transliteration: ArdraM cha pallavaM na sma dR^ishyate pR^ithivItale | kuto jalaM vidR^ishyeta jIvAnAM prANadhArakam
verses.translation: Formerly, Visnu the favourite of the good, took his incarnation as Rama on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: तदा ते मुनयश्चैव मनुष्याः पशवस्तथा । पक्षिणश्च मृगास्तत्र गताश्चैव दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: tadA te munayashchaiva manuShyAH pashavastathA | pakShiNashcha mR^igAstatra gatAshchaiva disho dasha
verses.translation: O brahmins, Rama's wife Sita, the daughter of Janaka, was kidnapped by Ravana the wielder of great Maya and taken to his abode in Lanka.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा चर्षयो विप्राः प्राणायामपरायणाः । ध्यानेन च तदा केचित्कालं निन्युः सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: tAM dR^iShTvA charShayo viprAH prANAyAmaparAyaNAH | dhyAnena cha tadA kechitkAlaM ninyuH sudAruNam
verses.translation: Searching for her, Rama went to the city called Kikindha.' Having alliance with Sugriva for his benefit he killed Bali.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमोऽपि स्वयं तत्र वरुणार्थे तपः शुभम् । चकार चैव षण्मासं प्राणायामपरायणः
verses.transliteration: gautamo.api svayaM tatra varuNArthe tapaH shubham | chakAra chaiva ShaNmAsaM prANAyAmaparAyaNaH
verses.translation: After staying there for sometime, he held consul¬ tations with Laksmana, Sugriva and others eager to find her out.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च वरुणस्तस्मै वरं दातुं समागतः । प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरं ब्रूहि ददामि च वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatashcha varuNastasmai varaM dAtuM samAgataH | prasanno.asmi varaM brUhi dadAmi cha vacho.abravIt
verses.translation: The prince Rama sent the monkeys, the chief of whom was Hanumat, to various directions in order to find her out.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O brahmins, accompanied by Hanuman the chief of monkeys, Laksmana, Sugriva and other monkey chiefs of

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O brahmins, accompanied by Hanuman the chief of monkeys, Laksmana, Sugriva and other monkey chiefs of

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२५. पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः । गौतमव्यवस्थावर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । कदाचिद्गौतमेनैव जलार्थं प्रेषिता निजाः । शिष्यास्तत्र गता भक्त्या कमण्डलुकरा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.25\. pa~nchaviMsho.adhyAyaH | gautamavyavasthAvarNanam | sUta uvAcha | kadAchidgautamenaiva jalArthaM preShitA nijAH | shiShyAstatra gatA bhaktyA kamaNDalukarA dvijAH
verses.translation: Reaching there, Rama the favourite of Siva stationed himself on the shore, being served by the monkeys and his brother Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit: आविर्बभूव च तदा प्रसन्नो हि गणेश्वरः । उवाच वचनं तत्र भक्ताधीनः फलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: AvirbabhUva cha tadA prasanno hi gaNeshvaraH | uvAcha vachanaM tatra bhaktAdhInaH phalapradaH
verses.translation: "Alas where has Janaki gone? When will she meet me. The ocean is very deep. The army of the monkeys is to be taken across. The Raksasa of great strength and valour, the uplifter of the mountain Kailasa has resorted to his stronghold Lanka. His son is Indrajit, the conqueror of Indra. Thus thought Rama in the company of Laksmana standing on the shore itself. He was appeased by Ahgada and other monkeys.

verses.sanskrit: गणेश उवाच । प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरं ब्रूत यूयं किं करवाण्यहम् । तदीयं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा ऋषयस्तेऽब्रुवंस्तदा
verses.transliteration: gaNesha uvAcha | prasanno.asmi varaM brUta yUyaM kiM karavANyaham | tadIyaM tadvachaH shrutvA R^iShayaste.abruvaMstadA
verses.translation: Then Rama the excellent devotee of Siva, desirous of water, lovingly spoke to his brother Laksmana.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । त्वया यदि वरो देयो गौतमः स्वाश्रमाद बहिः । निष्काश्यमानो ऋषिभिः परिभर्त्स्य तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | tvayA yadi varo deyo gautamaH svAshramAda bahiH | niShkAshyamAno R^iShibhiH paribhartsya tathA kuru
verses.translation: O brother Laksmana, lord of heroes, I am thirsty. I desire water. You get some water quickly through some monkey.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । स एवं प्रार्थितस्तैस्तु विहस्य वचनं पुनः । प्रोवाचेभमुखः प्रीत्या बोधयंस्तान्सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | sa evaM prArthitastaistu vihasya vachanaM punaH | provAchebhamukhaH prItyA bodhayaMstAnsatAM gatiH
verses.translation: On hearing it the monkeys ran in all directions. They brought water, bowed to Rama and standing before him said.

verses.sanskrit: गणेश उवाच । श्रूयतामृषयः सर्वे युक्तं न क्रियतेऽधुना । अपराधं विना तस्मै क्रुध्यतां हानिरेव च
verses.transliteration: gaNesha uvAcha | shrUyatAmR^iShayaH sarve yuktaM na kriyate.adhunA | aparAdhaM vinA tasmai krudhyatAM hAnireva cha
verses.translation: O lord, at your behest we have brought excellent water, sweet, cool and refreshing. Please take it.

verses.sanskrit: उपस्कृतं पुरा यैस्तु तेभ्यो दुःखं हितं न हि । यदा च दीयते दुःखं तदा नाशो भवेदिह
verses.transliteration: upaskR^itaM purA yaistu tebhyo duHkhaM hitaM na hi | yadA cha dIyate duHkhaM tadA nAsho bhavediha
verses.translation: When Rama, the devotee of Siva, took the water and was about to drink it, it occurred to him at the will of l§iva.

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशं च तपः कृत्वा साध्यते फलमुत्तमम् । शुभं फलं स्वयं हित्वा साध्यते नाहितं पुनः
verses.transliteration: IdR^ishaM cha tapaH kR^itvA sAdhyate phalamuttamam | shubhaM phalaM svayaM hitvA sAdhyate nAhitaM punaH
verses.translation: "1 have not yet had the sight of Siva, the great lord, the bestower of all bliss. How can the water be taken in?'*

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा तस्य ते मुनिसत्तमाः । बुद्धिमोहं तदा प्राप्ता इदमेव वचोऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM vachanaM shrutvA tasya te munisattamAH | buddhimohaM tadA prAptA idameva vacho.abruvan
verses.translation: After saying this, he drank water and then

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ कर्तव्यं हि त्वया स्वामिन्निदमेव न चान्यथा । इत्युक्तस्तु तदा देवो गणेशो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH || kartavyaM hi tvayA svAminnidameva na chAnyathA | ityuktastu tadA devo gaNesho vAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: He worshipped Siva performing all the sixteen ancillary services like invocation etc. with devotion according to the rules obtaining.

verses.sanskrit: गणेश उवाच । असाधुः साधुतां चैव साधुश्चासाधुतां तथा । कदाचिदपि नाप्नोति ब्रह्मोक्तमिति निश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: gaNesha uvAcha | asAdhuH sAdhutAM chaiva sAdhushchAsAdhutAM tathA | kadAchidapi nApnoti brahmoktamiti nishchitam
verses.translation: After propitiating him with obeisances, divine

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यान् जलसमीपे तु गतान्दृष्ट्वा न्यषेधयन् । जलार्थमागतास्तत्र चर्षिपत्न्योऽप्यनेकशः
verses.transliteration: shiShyAn jalasamIpe tu gatAndR^iShTvA nyaShedhayan | jalArthamAgatAstatra charShipatnyo.apyanekashaH
verses.translation: O lord Siva, O great lord, always favourably

verses.sanskrit: यदा च भवतां दुःखं जातं चानशनात्पुरा । तदा सुखं प्रदत्तं वै गौतमेन महर्षिणा
verses.transliteration: yadA cha bhavatAM duHkhaM jAtaM chAnashanAtpurA | tadA sukhaM pradattaM vai gautamena maharShiNA
verses.translation: O Bhavatarana (one who takes devotees across the ocan of worldly existence), this ocean is very deep. The Raksasa Ravana is heroic and mighty.

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं वै भवद्भिश्च तस्मै दुःखं प्रदीयते । नैतद्युक्ततमं लोके सर्वथा सुविचार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: idAnIM vai bhavadbhishcha tasmai duHkhaM pradIyate | naitadyuktatamaM loke sarvathA suvichAryatAm
verses.translation: In that, O lord of good rites, help must be rendered to me. O lord, without your help my purpose is difficult to be achieved.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीबलान्मोहिता यूयं न मे वाक्यं करिष्यथ । एतद्धिततमं तस्य भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: strIbalAnmohitA yUyaM na me vAkyaM kariShyatha | etaddhitatamaM tasya bhaviShyati na saMshayaH
verses.translation: O Sadasiva, I too am your slave, in every respect subservient to you. Considering this, you shall be partial to me.

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्चायमृषिश्रेष्ठो दास्यते वः सुखं ध्रुवम् । तारणं न च युक्तं स्याद्वरमन्यं वृणीत वै
verses.transliteration: punashchAyamR^iShishreShTho dAsyate vaH sukhaM dhruvam | tAraNaM na cha yuktaM syAdvaramanyaM vR^iNIta vai
verses.translation: After praying and bowing to the lord again and again, he repeated loudly, "O Siva, be victorious, be victorious" and eulogised Siva. Repealing the mantras and meditating, he performed the worship again and danced before the lord.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं तेन गणेशेन महात्मना । यद्यप्युक्तमृषिभ्यश्च तदप्येते न मेनिरे
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM vachanaM tena gaNeshena mahAtmanA | yadyapyuktamR^iShibhyashcha tadapyete na menire
verses.translation: With the heart drenched with devotional love he produced the throat-sound. Lord l§iva was much delighted.

verses.sanskrit: भक्ताधीनतया सोऽथ शिवपुत्रोऽब्रवीत्तदा । उदासीनेन मनसा तानृषीन्दुष्टशेमुषीन्
verses.transliteration: bhaktAdhInatayA so.atha shivaputro.abravIttadA | udAsInena manasA tAnR^iShInduShTashemuShIn
verses.translation: Assuming the pure form as mentioned and

verses.sanskrit: गणेश उवाच । भवद्भिः प्रार्थ्यते यच्च करिष्येऽहं तथा खलु । पश्चाद्भावि भवेदेव इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे पुनः
verses.transliteration: gaNesha uvAcha | bhavadbhiH prArthyate yachcha kariShye.ahaM tathA khalu | pashchAdbhAvi bhavedeva ityuktvAntardadhe punaH
verses.translation: Then, satisfied in his heart with Rama's devotion lord Siva said—"O Rama, may there be welfare to you. Mention the boon you wish to have."

verses.sanskrit: गौतमः स न जानाति मुनीनां वै दुराशयम् । आनन्दमनसा नित्यं पत्न्या कर्म चकार तत्
verses.transliteration: gautamaH sa na jAnAti munInAM vai durAshayam | AnandamanasA nityaM patnyA karma chakAra tat
verses.translation: On seeing that form, they became sanctified. Rama himself, interested in Saiva cult, performed the worship.

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे च यज्जातं चरित्रं वरयोगतः । तद्दुष्टर्षिप्रभावात्तु श्रूयतां तन्मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tadantare cha yajjAtaM charitraM varayogataH | tadduShTarShiprabhAvAttu shrUyatAM tanmunIshvarAH
verses.translation: Eulogising in diverse ways and bowing to Siva joyously he requested for his victory in the imminent fight with Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमस्य च केदारे तत्रासन्व्रीहयो यवाः । गणेशस्तत्र गौर्भूत्वा जगाम किल दुर्बला
verses.transliteration: gautamasya cha kedAre tatrAsanvrIhayo yavAH | gaNeshastatra gaurbhUtvA jagAma kila durbalA
verses.translation: Delighted in his heart at Ram's devotion, lord Siva said lovingly—"O great king, may you be victorious".

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिपत्न्यो वयं पूर्वं ग्रहीष्यामो विदूरतः । पश्चाच्चैव जलं ग्राह्यमित्येवं पर्यभर्त्सयन्
verses.transliteration: R^iShipatnyo vayaM pUrvaM grahIShyAmo vidUrataH | pashchAchchaiva jalaM grAhyamityevaM paryabhartsayan
verses.translation: Securing the blessing of victory granted by Siva and receiving the permission of the lord he prayed again with palms joined in reverence and head bent down.

verses.sanskrit: कम्पमाना च सा गत्वा तत्र तद्वरयोगतः । व्रीहीन्सम्भक्षयामास यवांश्च मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kampamAnA cha sA gatvA tatra tadvarayogataH | vrIhInsambhakShayAmAsa yavAMshcha munisattamAH
verses.translation: O Siva, if you arc pleased, you shall stay here, O lord, to sanctify the worlds and to render help to the people.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दैवाद् गौतमस्तत्र चागतः । स दयालुस्तृणस्तम्बैर्वारयामास तां तदा
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare daivAd gautamastatra chAgataH | sa dayAlustR^iNastambairvArayAmAsa tAM tadA
verses.translation: Thus implored Siva took up the phallic image named RameSvara. It is now famous on the surface of the world.

verses.sanskrit: तृणस्तम्बेन सा स्पृष्टा पपात पृथिवीतले । मृता च तत्क्षणादेव तदृषेः पश्यतस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tR^iNastambena sA spR^iShTA papAta pR^ithivItale | mR^itA cha tatkShaNAdeva tadR^iSheH pashyatastadA
verses.translation: He who performs the ablution of Siva with the waters of the divine Gahga and worships Ramcsvara with great devotion becomes a living liberated soul indeed.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयश्छन्नरूपास्ते ऋषिपत्न्यस्तथाशुभाः । ऊचुस्तत्र तदा सर्वे किं कृतं गौतमेन च
verses.transliteration: R^iShayashChannarUpAste R^iShipatnyastathAshubhAH | Uchustatra tadA sarve kiM kR^itaM gautamena cha
verses.translation: O excellent sages, the next Jyotirlinga to be mentioned is 6hu4mela. May its greatness be listened to.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमोऽपि तथाहल्यामाहूयासीत्सुविस्मितः । उवाच दुःखतो विप्रा दूयमानेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: gautamo.api tathAhalyAmAhUyAsItsuvismitaH | uvAcha duHkhato viprA dUyamAnena chetasA
verses.translation: The excellent brahmin Sudharma worshipped gods and guests. He was devotedly attached to the Vedic path and scrupulously maintained the sacrificial fires.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । किं जातं च कथं देवि कुपितः परमेश्वरः । किं कर्तव्यं क्व गन्तव्यं हत्या च समुपस्थिता
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | kiM jAtaM cha kathaM devi kupitaH parameshvaraH | kiM kartavyaM kva gantavyaM hatyA cha samupasthitA
verses.translation: He had the brilliance of the Sun. He performed Sandhya prayers thrice a day. He taught disciples and was an expert in the Vedas and Sastras both.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्रा गौतमं पर्यभर्त्सयन् । विप्रपत्न्यस्तथाहल्यां दुर्वचोभिर्व्यथां ददुः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | etasminnantare viprA gautamaM paryabhartsayan | viprapatnyastathAhalyAM durvachobhirvyathAM daduH
verses.translation: A long period in his life thus passed when he continued his religious rites but no son was born to him. His wife's menstrual periods were fruitless. She did not conceive.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्बुद्धयश्च तच्छिष्याः सुतास्तेषां तथैव च । गौतमं परिभर्त्स्यैव प्रत्यूचुर्धिग्वचो मुहुः
verses.transliteration: durbuddhayashcha tachChiShyAH sutAsteShAM tathaiva cha | gautamaM paribhartsyaiva pratyUchurdhigvacho muhuH
verses.translation: He did not grieve over this because he realised the*reality of different things. He knew that the soul is the uplifter of the soul and the soul is the sanctifier of the soul.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । मुखं न दर्शनीयं ते गम्यतां गम्यतामिति । दृष्ट्वा गोघ्नमुखं सद्यः सचैलं स्नानमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | mukhaM na darshanIyaM te gamyatAM gamyatAmiti | dR^iShTvA goghnamukhaM sadyaH sachailaM snAnamAcharet
verses.translation: Thinking thus he did not feel aggrieved even mentally. But Sudeha was distressed for not having a son.

verses.sanskrit: यावदाश्रममध्ये त्वं तावदेव हविर्भुजः । पितरश्च न गृह्णन्ति ह्यस्मद्दत्तं हि किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: yAvadAshramamadhye tvaM tAvadeva havirbhujaH | pitarashcha na gR^ihNanti hyasmaddattaM hi ki~nchana
verses.translation: Everyday she implored her learned husband to strive for the acquisition of a son.

verses.sanskrit: परावृत्य तदा तैश्च ऋषिपत्न्यै निवेदितम् । सा चापि तान्समादाय समाश्वास्य च तैः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: parAvR^itya tadA taishcha R^iShipatnyai niveditam | sA chApi tAnsamAdAya samAshvAsya cha taiH svayam
verses.translation: He used to reproach her saying, *'0 gentle lady, there is no son, no mother, no father, no lor. Every one is selfishly inclined in the world, there is no doubt about this. Know this particularly with a keen intellect. Do not be aggrieved. O gentle lady, misery shall be eschewed by you, certainly. O one of auspicious rites, you shall not pester me like this everyday." After enlightening her, he became intciested in the worship of the lord. He was perfectly contented. He did not feel the misery or joy of mutually contrary interests.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्गच्छान्यतस्त्वं च परिवारसमन्वितः । विलम्बं कुरु नैव त्वं धेनुहन्पापकारक
verses.transliteration: tasmAdgachChAnyatastvaM cha parivArasamanvitaH | vilambaM kuru naiva tvaM dhenuhanpApakAraka
verses.translation: Once Sudeha went to the neighbour's house for a friendly chat but a quarrel arose there.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा ते च तं सर्वे पाषाणैः समताडयन् । व्यथां ददुरतीवास्मै त्वहल्यां च दुरुक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA te cha taM sarve pAShANaiH samatADayan | vyathAM daduratIvAsmai tvahalyAM cha duruktibhiH
verses.translation: O sonless woman, why are you arrogant? I have i son who will inherit my wealth. But there is none to inherit your property.

verses.sanskrit: ताडितो भर्त्सितो दुष्टैर्गौतमो गिरमब्रवीत् । इतो गच्छामि मुनयो ह्यन्यत्र निवसाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: tADito bhartsito duShTairgautamo giramabravIt | ito gachChAmi munayo hyanyatra nivasAmyaham
verses.translation: Undoubtedly the king will confiscate your estate. O barren woman, fie upon you, upon your wealth, upon your honour and prestige.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा गौतमस्तस्मात्स्थानाच्च निर्गतस्तदा । गत्वा क्रोशं तदा चक्रे ह्याश्रमं तदनुज्ञया
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA gautamastasmAtsthAnAchcha nirgatastadA | gatvA kroshaM tadA chakre hyAshramaM tadanuj~nayA
verses.translation: Thus reproached by her she returned home depressed. She narrated to her husband all what her neigh¬ bour had said to her.

verses.sanskrit: यावच्चैवाभिशापो वै तावत्कार्यं न किञ्चन । न कर्मण्यधिकारोऽस्ति दैवे पित्र्येऽथ वैदिके
verses.transliteration: yAvachchaivAbhishApo vai tAvatkAryaM na ki~nchana | na karmaNyadhikAro.asti daive pitrye.atha vaidike
verses.translation: Thus pacified and consoled again and again by her husband she did not stop worrying. She again pleaded.

verses.sanskrit: मासार्धं च ततो नीत्वा मुनीन्सम्प्रार्थयत्तदा । गौतमो मुनिवर्यः स तेन दुःखेन दुखितः
verses.transliteration: mAsArdhaM cha tato nItvA munInsamprArthayattadA | gautamo munivaryaH sa tena duHkhena dukhitaH
verses.translation: You are my husband. Somehow you shall beget a son. O excellent among men, otherwise I.shall cast off this body.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । अनुकम्प्यो भवद्भिश्च कथ्यतां क्रियते मया । यथा मदीयं पापं च गच्छत्विति निवेद्यताम्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | anukampyo bhavadbhishcha kathyatAM kriyate mayA | yathA madIyaM pApaM cha gachChatviti nivedyatAm
verses.translation: On hearing what she said, Sudharma the excellent brahmin, harassed by her importunities, mentally remembered Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तास्ते तदा विप्रा नोचुश्चैव परस्परम् । अत्यन्तं सेवया पृष्टा मिलिता ह्येकतः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktAste tadA viprA nochushchaiva parasparam | atyantaM sevayA pR^iShTA militA hyekataH sthitAH
verses.translation: The alert brahmin offered two flowers to the sacrificial lire. He thought in his mind that the right side flower would yield a son.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमो दूरतः स्थित्वा नत्वा तानृषिसत्तमान् । पप्रच्छ विनयाविष्टः किं कार्यं हि मयाधुना
verses.transliteration: gautamo dUrataH sthitvA natvA tAnR^iShisattamAn | paprachCha vinayAviShTaH kiM kAryaM hi mayAdhunA
verses.translation: Making this as a condition the brahmin told his wife. '-You shall lake one of these* two flowers to decide about the acquisition of a son"

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते मुनिना तेन गौतमेन महात्मना । मिलिताः सकलास्ते वै मुनयो वाक्यमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: ityukte muninA tena gautamena mahAtmanA | militAH sakalAste vai munayo vAkyamabruvan
verses.translation: She thought "I will surely have a son. Let (he insignia flower come to me." Then she bowed to Siva and the sacrificial fire." After praying again she picked up one of the flowers.

verses.sanskrit: जलं नीत्वा ददौ तस्मै गौतमाय तपस्विनी । नित्यं निर्वाहयामास जलेन ऋषिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: jalaM nItvA dadau tasmai gautamAya tapasvinI | nityaM nirvAhayAmAsa jalena R^iShisattamaH
verses.translation: On seeing it the husband sighed deeply. Remember¬ ing the lotus-like feet of Siva he spoke to his beloved.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । निष्कृतिं हि विना शुद्धिर्जायते न कदाचन । तस्मात्त्वं देहशुद्ध्यर्थं प्रायश्चित्तं समाचर
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | niShkR^itiM hi vinA shuddhirjAyate na kadAchana | tasmAttvaM dehashuddhyarthaM prAyashchittaM samAchara
verses.translation: After saying so and giving up hope himself, the brahmin became engaged in sacred rites and meditation on Siva.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवारं पृथिवीं सर्वां क्रम पापं प्रकाशयन् । पुनरागत्य चात्रैव चर मासव्रतं तथा
verses.transliteration: trivAraM pR^ithivIM sarvAM krama pApaM prakAshayan | punarAgatya chAtraiva chara mAsavrataM tathA
verses.translation: Yearning for a son Sudeha did not leave off her pleadings. With palms joined in reverence and bending her head she lovingly said to her husband.

verses.sanskrit: शतमेकोत्तरं चैव ब्रह्मणोऽस्य गिरेस्तथा । प्रक्रमणं विधायैवं शुद्धिस्ते च भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: shatamekottaraM chaiva brahmaNo.asya girestathA | prakramaNaM vidhAyaivaM shuddhiste cha bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Let there be no son born of me. With my consent you shall take another wife. Undoubtedly she will bear you a son.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा त्वं समानीय गङ्गास्नानं समाचर । पार्थिवानां तथा कोटिं कृत्वा देवं निषेवय
verses.transliteration: athavA tvaM samAnIya ga~NgAsnAnaM samAchara | pArthivAnAM tathA koTiM kR^itvA devaM niShevaya
verses.translation: Requested thus by his beloved wife, that brahmin the most excellent of the devotees of Siva and fond of sacred rites spoke to hcf.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायां च ततः स्नात्वा पुतश्चैव भविष्यसि । पुरा दश तथा चैकं गिरेस्त्वं क्रमणं कुरु
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAyAM cha tataH snAtvA putashchaiva bhaviShyasi | purA dasha tathA chaikaM girestvaM kramaNaM kuru
verses.translation: Our miseries have gone ofT, O beloved, do not

verses.sanskrit: शतकुम्म्भैस्तथा स्नात्वा पार्थिवं निष्कृतिर्भवेत् । इति तैरॄषिभिः प्रोक्तस्तथेत्योमिति तद्वचः
verses.transliteration: shatakummbhaistathA snAtvA pArthivaM niShkR^itirbhavet | iti tairR^IShibhiH proktastathetyomiti tadvachaH
verses.translation: Although prevented thus, she brought her mother's younger daughter to her house and said to her husband "Take her."

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवानां तथा पूजां गिरेः प्रक्रमणं तथा । करिष्यामि मुनिश्रेष्ठा आज्ञया श्रीमतामिह
verses.transliteration: pArthivAnAM tathA pUjAM gireH prakramaNaM tathA | kariShyAmi munishreShThA Aj~nayA shrImatAmiha
verses.translation: Now you say that she must be my beloved wife. But should she give birth to a son you will begin to be jealous of her.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा सर्षिवर्यश्च कृत्वा प्रक्रमणं गिरेः । पूजयामास निर्माय पार्थिवान्मुनिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA sarShivaryashcha kR^itvA prakramaNaM gireH | pUjayAmAsa nirmAya pArthivAnmunisattamaH
verses.translation: O brahmins, when thus warned by her husband, Sudeha joined her palms in reverence and spoke to him.

verses.sanskrit: अहल्या च ततः साध्वी तच्च सर्वं चकार सा । शिष्याश्च प्रतिशिष्याश्च चक्रुः सेवां तयोस्तदा
verses.transliteration: ahalyA cha tataH sAdhvI tachcha sarvaM chakAra sA | shiShyAshcha pratishiShyAshcha chakruH sevAM tayostadA
verses.translation: "O excellent brahmin, I will not be jealous of my own sister. Please marry her and beget a son. I urge upon you."

verses.sanskrit: ताश्चैवमृषिपत्न्यस्तु क्रुद्धास्तां पर्यभर्त्सयन् । परावृत्य गताः सर्वास्तूटजान्कुटिलाशयाः
verses.transliteration: tAshchaivamR^iShipatnyastu kruddhAstAM paryabhartsayan | parAvR^itya gatAH sarvAstUTajAnkuTilAshayAH
verses.translation: Thus implored by her, Sudharma married that lady Ghuma with due ceremonies.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाम्यग्रे विपरीतं च तद्वृत्तं निखिलं ततः । दुष्टाशयाभिः स्त्रीभिश्च ताभिर्वै विनिवेदितम्
verses.transliteration: svAmyagre viparItaM cha tadvR^ittaM nikhilaM tataH | duShTAshayAbhiH strIbhishcha tAbhirvai viniveditam
verses.translation: After marrying her he requested Sudeha, "O my pious beloved, this is your younger sister. You must bring her up."

verses.sanskrit: अथ तासां वचः श्रुत्वा भाविकर्मवशात्तदा । गौतमाय च सङ्क्रुद्धाश्चासंस्ते परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration: atha tAsAM vachaH shrutvA bhAvikarmavashAttadA | gautamAya cha sa~NkruddhAshchAsaMste paramarShayaH
verses.translation: After saying this, Sudharma, the most excellent devotee of Siva, pursued his sacred rites to the utmost with his mind leaning towards virtue.

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नार्थं गौतमस्यैव नानापूजोपहारकैः । गणेशं पूजयामासुः सङ्क्रुद्धास्ते कुबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: vighnArthaM gautamasyaiva nAnApUjopahArakaiH | gaNeshaM pUjayAmAsuH sa~NkruddhAste kubuddhayaH
verses.translation: Sudeha served her sister like a hired wench eschewing all opposition and lovingly nurtured her.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: According to the sacred rules Ghusma rendered devotional services to these images and threw them in the neighbouring lake.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: According to the sacred rules Ghusma rendered devotional services to these images and threw them in the neighbouring lake.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२६. षड्विंशोऽध्यायः । त्र्यम्बकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । एवं कृते तु ऋषिणा सस्त्रीकेन द्विजाः शिवः । आविर्बभूव सशिवः प्रसन्नः सगणस्तदा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.26\. ShaDviMsho.adhyAyaH | tryambakeshvaramAhAtmyavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | evaM kR^ite tu R^iShiNA sastrIkena dvijAH shivaH | AvirbabhUva sashivaH prasannaH sagaNastadA
verses.translation: Thus she performed the wish-yielding worship of Siva every day leaving them off and invoking them again in accordance with the rules of devotional service.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करस्तस्मै तेषां दुश्चरितं तदा । बहूवाच प्रभुर्विप्राः सत्कदोऽसत्सु दण्डदः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA sha~Nkarastasmai teShAM dushcharitaM tadA | bahUvAcha prabhurviprAH satkado.asatsu daNDadaH
verses.translation: Performing the worship of Siva thus regularly

verses.sanskrit: शर्वोक्तमिति स श्रुत्वा सुविस्मितमना ऋषिः । सुप्रणम्य शिवं भक्त्या साञ्जलिः पुनरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sharvoktamiti sa shrutvA suvismitamanA R^iShiH | supraNamya shivaM bhaktyA sA~njaliH punarabravIt
verses.translation: Then Sudeha grew fiercely jealous of her. Her heart which was cool and quiet before began to blaze like fire now.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । ऋषिभिस्तैर्महेशान ह्युपकारः कृतो महान् । यद्येवं न कृतं तैस्तु दर्शनं ते कुतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | R^iShibhistairmaheshAna hyupakAraH kR^ito mahAn | yadyevaM na kR^itaM taistu darshanaM te kuto bhavet
verses.translation: O great sages, may the despicable event that followed, causing misery, be heard with attention.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यास्ते ऋषयो यैस्तु मह्यं शुभतरं कृतम् । तद्दुराचरणादेव मम स्वार्थो महानभूत्
verses.transliteration: dhanyAste R^iShayo yaistu mahyaM shubhataraM kR^itam | taddurAcharaNAdeva mama svArtho mahAnabhUt
verses.translation: On seeing the son of the younger sister, the elder sister was much distressed. Unable to see her pleasure she became inimical.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा सुप्रसन्नो महेश्वरः । गौतमं प्रत्युवाचाशु कृपादृष्ट्या विलोक्य च
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM tadvachaH shrutvA suprasanno maheshvaraH | gautamaM pratyuvAchAshu kR^ipAdR^iShTyA vilokya cha
verses.translation: Her people celebrated the birth of a son continual¬ ly. But she could not bear the sight of the beautiful child.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । ऋषिर्धन्योऽसि विप्रेन्द्र ऋषिश्रेष्ठतरोऽसि वै । ज्ञात्वा मां सुप्रसन्नं हि वृणु त्वं वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | R^iShirdhanyo.asi viprendra R^iShishreShThataro.asi vai | j~nAtvA mAM suprasannaM hi vR^iNu tvaM varamuttamam
verses.translation: On seeing the son, a great favourite of the parents and endowed with all good qualities, her heart began to blaze like fire.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । गौतमोऽपि विचार्यैवं लोके विश्रुतमित्युत । अन्यथा न भवेदेव तस्मादुक्तं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | gautamo.api vichAryaivaM loke vishrutamityuta | anyathA na bhavedeva tasmAduktaM samAcharet
verses.translation: In the meantime many brahmins came there offer¬ ing their daughters in marriage. Sudharma celebrated the marriage of his son*duly.

verses.sanskrit: निश्चित्यैवं मुनिश्रेष्ठो गौतमः शिवभक्तिमान् । साञ्जलिर्नतशीर्षो हि शङ्करं वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: nishchityaivaM munishreShTho gautamaH shivabhaktimAn | sA~njalirnatashIrSho hi sha~NkaraM vAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: On seeing that, Sudeha blazed furiously in her mind- Extremely distressed she began to lament, "O I am doomed."

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । सत्यं नाथ ब्रवीषि त्वं तथापि पञ्चभिः कृतम् । नान्यथा भवतीत्यत्र यज्जातं जायतां तु तत्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | satyaM nAtha bravIShi tvaM tathApi pa~nchabhiH kR^itam | nAnyathA bhavatItyatra yajjAtaM jAyatAM tu tat
verses.translation: When the daughter-in-law came to the house and

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश गङ्गा च दीयतां मम । कुरु लोकोपकारं हि नमस्तेऽस्तु नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: yadi prasanno devesha ga~NgA cha dIyatAM mama | kuru lokopakAraM hi namaste.astu namo.astu te
verses.translation: "These are your own son and daughter-in-law not mine.** But the daughter-in-law considered Sudeha her mother-in-law and the son considered her his mother.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रसन्नः सशिवो वरं ब्रूहि महामुने । प्रसन्नोऽहं सुभक्त्या त इत्युवाच कृपानिधिः
verses.transliteration: atha prasannaH sashivo varaM brUhi mahAmune | prasanno.ahaM subhaktyA ta ityuvAcha kR^ipAnidhiH
verses.translation: The husband too loved the elder more than he loved the younger. Still the elder wife retained dirt in her mind.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा वचनं तस्य धृत्वा वै पादपङ्कजम् । नमश्चकार देवेशं गौतमो लोककाम्यया
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA vachanaM tasya dhR^itvA vai pAdapa~Nkajam | namashchakAra deveshaM gautamo lokakAmyayA
verses.translation: One day the senior wife Sudeha, extremely dis¬ tressed in her heart, thought how she could subdue her misery.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु शङ्करो देवः पृथिव्याश्च दिवश्च सः । सारं चैव समुद्धृत्य रक्षितं पूर्वमेव तत्
verses.transliteration: tatastu sha~Nkaro devaH pR^ithivyAshcha divashcha saH | sAraM chaiva samuddhR^itya rakShitaM pUrvameva tat
verses.translation: Certainly the fire in my heart can be tranqullised only through the tears of Ghusma caused by her misery and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: विवाहे ब्रह्मणा दत्तमवशिष्टं च किञ्चन । तत्तस्मै दत्तवान् शम्भुर्मुनये भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: vivAhe brahmaNA dattamavashiShTaM cha ki~nchana | tattasmai dattavAn shambhurmunaye bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: So I shall kill her son today, the son that speaks pleasing words to her. What is destined to happen shall happen. This is my final decision.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाजलं तदा तत्र स्त्रीरूपमभवत्परम् । तस्याश्चैव ऋषिश्रेष्ठः स्तुतिं कृत्वा नतिं व्यधात्
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAjalaM tadA tatra strIrUpamabhavatparam | tasyAshchaiva R^iShishreShThaH stutiM kR^itvA natiM vyadhAt
verses.translation: O brahmins, the inimical nature among co-wives is extremely ruthless and suicidal. The wicked and the mean do not ponder what shall be done or not done.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । धन्यासि कृतकृत्यासि पावितं भुवनं त्वया । मां च पावय गङ्गे त्वं पतन्तं निरये ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | dhanyAsi kR^itakR^ityAsi pAvitaM bhuvanaM tvayA | mAM cha pAvaya ga~Nge tvaM patantaM niraye dhruvam
verses.translation: The senior wife cut off the limbs of Ghusma's son at night. Strong that she was shc,took them to the lake where the earthen images of Siva were usually, hurled by Ghuiima. After casting off the limbs into the lake she returned and slept.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । शम्भुश्चापि तदोवाच सर्वेषां हितकृच्छृणु । गङ्गे गौतममेनं त्वं पावयस्व मदाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | shambhushchApi tadovAcha sarveShAM hitakR^ichChR^iNu | ga~Nge gautamamenaM tvaM pAvayasva madAj~nayA
verses.translation: In the morning Ghusma got up and performed her. daily household duties- Sudharma too performed his daily sacred rites.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य शम्भोश्च गौतमस्य च । उवाचैव शिवं गङ्गा शिवशक्तिर्हि पावनी
verses.transliteration: iti shrutvA vachastasya shambhoshcha gautamasya cha | uvAchaiva shivaM ga~NgA shivashaktirhi pAvanI
verses.translation: In the meantime the senior wife too got up and performed her duties with great pleasure, now that the fire in her heart had been tranquillised.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच । ऋषिं तु पावयित्वाहं परिवारयुतं प्रभो । गमिष्यामि निजस्थानं वचः सत्यं ब्रवीमि ह
verses.transliteration: ga~NgovAcha | R^iShiM tu pAvayitvAhaM parivArayutaM prabho | gamiShyAmi nijasthAnaM vachaH satyaM bravImi ha
verses.translation: Getting up in the morning, the daughter-in-law saw to her horror the bed wet with blood and a few scattered pieces of the body,

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तं गङ्गया तत्र महेशो भक्तवत्सलः । लोकोपकरणार्थाय पुनर्गङ्गां वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktaM ga~NgayA tatra mahesho bhaktavatsalaH | lokopakaraNArthAya punarga~NgAM vacho.abravIt
verses.translation: She told her mother-in-law, "where has your son gone? The bed is wet with blood. Pieces of the body arc also seen."

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । त्वया स्थातव्यमत्रैवाव्रजेद्यावत्कलिर्युगः । वैवस्वतो मनुर्देवि ह्यष्टाविंशत्तमो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | tvayA sthAtavyamatraivAvrajedyAvatkaliryugaH | vaivasvato manurdevi hyaShTAviMshattamo bhavet
verses.translation: The daughter-in-law fond of her husband began to lament—"O I am doomed. O my mother of holy rites, who has perpetrated this wicked deed?"

verses.sanskrit: तदा तत्सुन्दरं रूपं दृष्ट्वा शम्भोर्महात्मनः । प्रणम्य शङ्करं भक्त्या स्तुतिं चक्रे मुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: tadA tatsundaraM rUpaM dR^iShTvA shambhormahAtmanaH | praNamya sha~NkaraM bhaktyA stutiM chakre mudAnvitaH
verses.translation: The senior wife, though delighted inwardly, showed great distress outwardly saying "O I am doomed!"

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य स्वामिनः शङ्करस्य तत् । प्रत्युवाच पुनर्गङ्गा पावनी सा सरिद्वरा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasya svAminaH sha~Nkarasya tat | pratyuvAcha punarga~NgA pAvanI sA saridvarA
verses.translation: Ghusma heard the pitiable lamentation of her daughter-in-law but did not leave off her sacred rite, the daily worship of Siva's earthen image.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच । माहात्म्यमधिकं चेत्स्यान्मम स्वामिन्महेश्वर । सर्वेभ्यश्च तदा स्थास्ये धरायां त्रिपुरान्तक
verses.transliteration: ga~NgovAcha | mAhAtmyamadhikaM chetsyAnmama svAminmaheshvara | sarvebhyashcha tadA sthAsye dharAyAM tripurAntaka
verses.translation: Her mind did not exhibit any agitation. The husband too remained calm till the completion of the sacred rite.

verses.sanskrit: किञ्चान्यच्च शृणु स्वामिन्वपुषा सुन्दरेण ह । तिष्ठ त्वं मत्समीपे वै सगणः साम्बिकः प्रभो
verses.transliteration: ki~nchAnyachcha shR^iNu svAminvapuShA sundareNa ha | tiShTha tvaM matsamIpe vai sagaNaH sAmbikaH prabho
verses.translation: "He who has given this boy will protect him too. The annihilator of Kala, the goal of the good, is famous as a favourite of his devotee. Our protector, the sole lord, iSiva is like a gardener. He separates those whom he has united. What can I gain by worrying over it?" Realising this truth, being emboldened in dedicating herself to Siva she did not grieve much.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । लोकोपकरणार्थाय पुनर्गङ्गां वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM tasyA vachaH shrutvA sha~Nkaro bhaktavatsalaH | lokopakaraNArthAya punarga~NgAM vacho.abravIt
verses.translation: Taking the day's earthly phallic images she went towards the bank of the lake repeating the names of Siva, maintaining the normalcy of her mind as afore.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । धन्यासि श्रूयतां गङ्गे ह्यहं भिन्नस्त्वया न हि । तथापि स्थीयते ह्यत्र स्थीयतां च त्वयापि हि
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | dhanyAsi shrUyatAM ga~Nge hyahaM bhinnastvayA na hi | tathApi sthIyate hyatra sthIyatAM cha tvayApi hi
verses.translation: When she cast off the earthen phallic images and returned she saw her son standing on the bank of the lake.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा स्वामिनः परमेशितुः । प्रसन्नमानसा भूत्वा गङ्गा च प्रत्यपूजयत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM vachanaM shrutvA svAminaH parameshituH | prasannamAnasA bhUtvA ga~NgA cha pratyapUjayat
verses.translation: I shall meet my mother. After dying I have been

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवा ऋषयश्च पुरातनाः । सुतीर्थान्यप्यनेकानि क्षेत्राणि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare devA R^iShayashcha purAtanAH | sutIrthAnyapyanekAni kShetrANi vividhAni cha
verses.translation: O brahmins, on seeing her son restored to life the mother was not delighted as she was not distressed before.

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य गौतमं सर्वे गङ्गां च गिरिशं तथा । जय जयेति भाषन्तः पूजयामासुरादरात्
verses.transliteration: Agatya gautamaM sarve ga~NgAM cha girishaM tathA | jaya jayeti bhAShantaH pUjayAmAsurAdarAt
verses.translation: At that time, lord Siva, appeared before her immediately in the form of a mass of splendour. He said delightedly.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते निर्जराः सर्वे तेषां चक्रुः स्तुतिं मुदा । करान् बध्वा नतस्कन्धा हरिब्रह्मादयस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tataste nirjarAH sarve teShAM chakruH stutiM mudA | karAn badhvA nataskandhA haribrahmAdayastadA
verses.translation: O excellent-faced lady, I am delighted. Mention the boon you wish to have This boy had been killed by that wicked lady. I shall kill her with my trident.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गा प्रसन्ना तेभ्यश्च गिरिशश्चोचतुस्तदा । वरं ब्रूत सुरश्रेष्ठा दद्वो वः प्रियकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: ga~NgA prasannA tebhyashcha girishashchochatustadA | varaM brUta surashreShThA dadvo vaH priyakAmyayA
verses.translation: Bowing down to Siva she requested for the boon "O lord, Sudeha, my sister, must be protected by you.*'

verses.sanskrit: स्तुत्वा बहु प्रणम्येशं बद्धाञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः । निष्पापं कुरु मां देवाब्रवीदिति स गौतमः
verses.transliteration: stutvA bahu praNamyeshaM baddhA~njalipuTaH sthitaH | niShpApaM kuru mAM devAbravIditi sa gautamaH
verses.translation: Harm has been done by her. Why should you render help to her? Sudeha the perpetrator of wicked deeds must be killed.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश प्रसन्ना त्वं सरिद्वरे । स्थातव्यमत्र कृपया नः प्रियार्थं तथा नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH | yadi prasanno devesha prasannA tvaM saridvare | sthAtavyamatra kR^ipayA naH priyArthaM tathA nR^iNAm
verses.translation: No sin stays, the moment you aic seen. Now, on seeing you her sin will be reduced to ashes.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच । यूयं सर्वप्रियार्थं च तिष्ठथात्र न किं पुनः । गौतमं क्षालयित्वाहं गमिष्यामि यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: ga~NgovAcha | yUyaM sarvapriyArthaM cha tiShThathAtra na kiM punaH | gautamaM kShAlayitvAhaM gamiShyAmi yathAgatam
verses.translation: 'Sin is far removed at the mere sight of the person who renders help to those who harm him.

verses.sanskrit: भवत्सु मे विशेषोऽत्र ज्ञेयश्चैव कथं सुराः । तत्प्रमाणं कृतं चेत्स्यात्तदा तिष्ठाम्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: bhavatsu me visheSho.atra j~neyashchaiva kathaM surAH | tatpramANaM kR^itaM chetsyAttadA tiShThAmyasaMshayam
verses.translation: These wonderful words of the lord have been heard by me O lord. Hence, O Sadasiva let it not be done otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ऊचुः । सिंहराशौ यदा स्याद्वै गुरुः सर्वसुहृत्तमः । तदा वयं च सर्वे त्वागमिष्यामो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: sarve UchuH | siMharAshau yadA syAdvai guruH sarvasuhR^ittamaH | tadA vayaM cha sarve tvAgamiShyAmo na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Thus requested by her, lord Siva the ocean of mercy, favourably disposed towards his devotees was delighted and spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: एकादश च वर्षाणि लोकानां पातकं त्विह । क्षालितं यद्भवेदेवं मलिनाः स्मः सरिद्वरे
verses.transliteration: ekAdasha cha varShANi lokAnAM pAtakaM tviha | kShAlitaM yadbhavedevaM malinAH smaH saridvare
verses.translation: O Ghusma, request for another boon. I shall grant you what.is beneficial to you. I am delighted at your devotion and your nature of h*ing free from aberrations.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव क्षालनाय त्वायास्यामः सर्वथा प्रिये । त्वत्सकाशं महादेवि प्रोच्यते सत्यमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva kShAlanAya tvAyAsyAmaH sarvathA priye | tvatsakAshaM mahAdevi prochyate satyamAdarAt
verses.translation: She said after hearing his words "If a boon is to be given by you, you shall stay here in my name for protect¬ ing the worlds.*'

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहाय लोकानामस्माकं प्रियकाम्यया । स्थातव्यं शङ्करेणापि त्वया चैव सरिद्वरे
verses.transliteration: anugrahAya lokAnAmasmAkaM priyakAmyayA | sthAtavyaM sha~NkareNApi tvayA chaiva saridvare
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord Siva said—"I shall stay here in your name. I shall be named GhuSmesa and 1 shall confer hafppiness.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्सिंहे गुरुश्चैव स्थास्यामस्तावदेव हि । त्वयि स्नानं त्रिकालं च शङ्करस्य च दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: yAvatsiMhe gurushchaiva sthAsyAmastAvadeva hi | tvayi snAnaM trikAlaM cha sha~Nkarasya cha darshanam
verses.translation: May my phallic image named GhusmeSa be auspicious and famous. Let this lake be the storehouse of phallic images always.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा स्वपापं निखिलं विमोक्ष्यामो न संशयः । स्वदेशांश्च गमिष्यामो भवच्छासनतो वयम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA svapApaM nikhilaM vimokShyAmo na saMshayaH | svadeshAMshcha gamiShyAmo bhavachChAsanato vayam
verses.translation: Hence it will be famous in the three worlds in the name of "Sivalaya.'''- This lake shall always yield desires by its mere sight,

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं प्रार्थितस्तैस्तु गौतमेन महर्षिणा । स्थितोऽसौ शङ्करः प्रीत्या स्थिता सा च सरिद्वरा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM prArthitastaistu gautamena maharShiNA | sthito.asau sha~NkaraH prItyA sthitA sA cha saridvarA
verses.translation: O lady of good rites, upto a hundred and one generations in your family sons of great excellence like this will be born undoubtedly.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य गौतमस्य महात्मनः । सुप्रसन्नतरो भूत्वा शिवो वाक्यमुपाददे
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityAkarNya vachastasya gautamasya mahAtmanaH | suprasannataro bhUtvA shivo vAkyamupAdade
verses.translation: They will have good wives, plenty of wealth, longevity and skill in everything. They will be learned and liberal. They will attain worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: सा गङ्गा गौतमी नाम्ना लिङ्गं त्र्यम्बकमीरितम् । ख्याताख्यातं बभूवाथ महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: sA ga~NgA gautamI nAmnA li~NgaM tryambakamIritam | khyAtAkhyAtaM babhUvAtha mahApAtakanAshanam
verses.translation: They will be hundred and one endowed with many qualities. Your family will expand like this splendidly.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दिनं हि समारभ्य सिंहस्थे च बृहस्पतौ । आयान्ति सर्वतीर्थानि क्षेत्राणि दैवतानि च
verses.transliteration: taddinaM hi samArabhya siMhasthe cha bR^ihaspatau | AyAnti sarvatIrthAni kShetrANi daivatAni cha
verses.translation: After saying this:§iva assumed the form of a phallic image named Ghumesa. He became famous. The lake was called livalaya.'®

verses.sanskrit: सरांसि पुष्करादीनि गङ्गाद्याः सरितस्तथा । वासुदेवादयो देवाः सन्ति वै गौतमीतटे
verses.transliteration: sarAMsi puShkarAdIni ga~NgAdyAH saritastathA | vAsudevAdayo devAH santi vai gautamItaTe
verses.translation: Sudharma, Ghusma and Sudeha came there and circumambulated Siva hundred and one times.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्तत्र स्थितानीह तावत्तेषां फलं न हि । स्वप्रदेशे समायातास्तर्ह्येतेषां फलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yAvattatra sthitAnIha tAvatteShAM phalaM na hi | svapradeshe samAyAtAstarhyeteShAM phalaM bhavet
verses.translation: After performing the worship of lord Siva, fondly meeting one another and eschewing the dirt of the mind they attained great happiness.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गमिदं प्रोक्तं त्र्यम्बकं नाम विश्रुतम् । स्थितं तटे हि गौतम्या महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: jyotirli~NgamidaM proktaM tryambakaM nAma vishrutam | sthitaM taTe hi gautamyA mahApAtakanAshanam
verses.translation: On seeing the son regained to life, Sudeha was ashamed. O brahmins, she performed the expiatory rite for her sins and requested for forgiveness.

verses.sanskrit: यः पश्येद्भक्तितो ज्योतिर्लिङ्गं त्र्यम्बकनामकम् । पूजयेत्प्रणमेत्स्तुत्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yaH pashyedbhaktito jyotirli~NgaM tryambakanAmakam | pUjayetpraNametstutvA sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: Sivilaya lake, the abode of Ghuxine.wara phallic image is placed near Devagiri in the Aurangabad district of the erstwhile Hydera¬ bad State.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गं त्र्यम्बकं हि पूजितं गौतमेन ह । सर्वकामप्रदं चात्र परत्र परमुक्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: jyotirli~NgaM tryambakaM hi pUjitaM gautamena ha | sarvakAmapradaM chAtra paratra paramuktidam
verses.translation: O great sages, the phallic image named Ghulmea

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽहं मुनीश्वराः । किमन्यदिच्छथ श्रोतुं तद् ब्रूयां वो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: iti vashcha samAkhyAtaM yatpR^iShTo.ahaM munIshvarAH | kimanyadichChatha shrotuM tad brUyAM vo na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated to you the twelve Jyotir- lihgas which yield all desires, worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । धन्योऽसि कृतकृत्योऽसि निष्पापोऽसि सदा मुने । एतैर्दुष्टैः किल त्वं च छलितोऽसि खलात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | dhanyo.asi kR^itakR^ityo.asi niShpApo.asi sadA mune | etairduShTaiH kila tvaM cha Chalito.asi khalAtmabhiH
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this narrative of Jyotirlihgas gets rid of sins and attains worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: त्वदीयदर्शनाल्लोका निष्पापाश्च भवन्ति हि । किं पुनस्त्वं सपापोऽसि मद्भक्तिनिरतः सदा
verses.transliteration: tvadIyadarshanAllokA niShpApAshcha bhavanti hi | kiM punastvaM sapApo.asi madbhaktinirataH sadA
verses.translation: O great sages, on hearing the words of Suta the sages praised him and spoke desiring the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: उपद्रवस्त्वयि मुने यैः कृतस्तु दुरात्मभिः । ते पापाश्च दुराचारा हत्यावन्तस्त एव हि
verses.transliteration: upadravastvayi mune yaiH kR^itastu durAtmabhiH | te pApAshcha durAchArA hatyAvantasta eva hi
verses.translation: O Suta, you know everything. Hence we ask you. O holy lord, please narrate the greatness of the phallic image Harisvara.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां दर्शनादन्ये पापिष्ठाः सम्भवन्तु च । कृतघ्नाश्च तथा जाता नैतेषां निष्कृतिः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: eteShAM darshanAdanye pApiShThAH sambhavantu cha | kR^itaghnAshcha tathA jAtA naiteShAM niShkR^itiH kvachit
verses.translation: O great sages, may the auspicious story of Hari- £vara be heard, how SudarSana was acquired by Viu formerly from Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Tormented by the Daityas of great strength and exploit, the gods narrated their misery to Viu, their saviour.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Tormented by the Daityas of great strength and exploit, the gods narrated their misery to Viu, their saviour.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२७. सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः । त्र्यम्बकेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । गङ्गा च जलरूपेण कुतो जाता वद प्रभो । तन्माहात्म्यं विशेषेण कुतो जातं वद प्रभो
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.27\. saptaviMsho.adhyAyaH | tryambakeshvarajyotirli~NgamAhAtmyavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | ga~NgA cha jalarUpeNa kuto jAtA vada prabho | tanmAhAtmyaM visheSheNa kuto jAtaM vada prabho
verses.translation: O lord, be merciful. We are very much afflicted by the Daityas. Where shall we go? What shall we do? We have resorted to you, for you are worthy of seeking refuge by us.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । ततो वाणी समुत्पन्ना गङ्गाया व्योममण्डलात् । तच्छृणुध्वमृषिश्रेष्ठा गङ्गावचनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tato vANI samutpannA ga~NgAyA vyomamaNDalAt | tachChR^iNudhvamR^iShishreShThA ga~NgAvachanamuttamam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the gods distressed in mind, Visnu remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and said.

verses.sanskrit: एते दुष्टतमाश्चैव कृतघ्नाः स्वामिद्रोहिणः । जाल्माः पाखण्डिनश्चैव द्रष्टुं वर्ज्याश्च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: ete duShTatamAshchaiva kR^itaghnAH svAmidrohiNaH | jAlmAH pAkhaNDinashchaiva draShTuM varjyAshcha sarvadA
verses.translation: O gods, I shall carry out your task after propitiating Siva. These powerful enemies shall be conquered with great effort.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । मातश्च श्रूयतामेतन्महतां गिर एव च । तस्मात्त्वया च कर्त्तव्यं सत्यं च भगवद् वचः
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | mAtashcha shrUyatAmetanmahatAM gira eva cha | tasmAttvayA cha karttavyaM satyaM cha bhagavad vachaH
verses.translation: Thus consoled by lord Visnu, the gods thought that the Daityas would be surely killed. They then went to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: अपकारिषु यो लोक उपकारं करोति वै । तेन पूतो भवाम्यत्र भगवद्वचनं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: apakAriShu yo loka upakAraM karoti vai | tena pUto bhavAmyatra bhagavadvachanaM tvidam
verses.translation: For the victory of the gods, Visnu worshipped Siva, the lord of all the gods, the imperishable and the cosmic witness of all.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा मुनेर्वाक्यं गौतमस्य महात्मनः । पुनर्वाणी समुत्पन्ना गङ्गाया व्योममण्डलात्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvA munervAkyaM gautamasya mahAtmanaH | punarvANI samutpannA ga~NgAyA vyomamaNDalAt
verses.translation: He went to Kailasa and dug a pit there wherein he kindled fire and performed penance.

verses.sanskrit: कथ्यते हि त्वया सत्यं गौतमर्षे शिवं वचः । तथापि सङ्ग्रहार्थं च प्रायश्चित्तं चरन्तु वै
verses.transliteration: kathyate hi tvayA satyaM gautamarShe shivaM vachaH | tathApi sa~NgrahArthaM cha prAyashchittaM charantu vai
verses.translation: He worshipped Siva joyously with various mantras and hymns prescribed for the worship of earthen image.

verses.sanskrit: शतमेकोत्तरं चात्र कार्यं प्रक्रमणं गिरेः । भवच्छासनतस्त्वेतैस्त्वदधीनैर्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: shatamekottaraM chAtra kAryaM prakramaNaM gireH | bhavachChAsanatastvetaistvadadhInairvisheShataH
verses.translation: O great sages, he worshipped with the lotus-

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चैवाधिकारश्च जायते दुष्टकारिणाम् । मद्दर्शने विशेषेण सत्यमुक्तं मया मुने
verses.transliteration: tatashchaivAdhikArashcha jAyate duShTakAriNAm | maddarshane visheSheNa satyamuktaM mayA mune
verses.translation: Thinking decisively—"By all means I shall stay

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्याश्चक्रुर्वै ते तथाखिलाः । सम्प्रार्थ्य गौतमं दीनाः क्षन्तव्यो नोऽपराधकः
verses.transliteration: iti shrutvA vachastasyAshchakrurvai te tathAkhilAH | samprArthya gautamaM dInAH kShantavyo no.aparAdhakaH
verses.translation: Afrer thinking thus he rendered him various

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते तदा तेन गौतमेन तदाज्ञया । कुशावर्तं नाम चक्रे गङ्गाद्वारादधोगतम्
verses.transliteration: evaM kR^ite tadA tena gautamena tadAj~nayA | kushAvartaM nAma chakre ga~NgAdvArAdadhogatam
verses.translation: Surprised much at this, Visu, endowed with

verses.sanskrit: यैर्विप्रैर्गौतमायैव दुःखं दत्तं दुरात्मभिः । तेषां किं च ततो जातमुच्यतां व्याससद्गुरो
verses.transliteration: yairviprairgautamAyaiva duHkhaM dattaM durAtmabhiH | teShAM kiM cha tato jAtamuchyatAM vyAsasadguro
verses.translation: Re[>cating every name, he worshipped Siva, favour¬ ably disposed towards those who seek refuge in himt with a lotus flower.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रादुरभूत्तत्र सा तस्य प्रीतये पुनः । कुशावर्तं च विख्यातं तीर्थमासीदनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tataH prAdurabhUttatra sA tasya prItaye punaH | kushAvartaM cha vikhyAtaM tIrthamAsIdanuttamam
verses.translation: In order to test the piety of Visnu, one of the thousand lotus-flowcrs was taken away by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नातो नरो यस्तु मोक्षाय परिकल्पते । त्यक्त्वा सर्वानघान्सद्यो विज्ञानं प्राप्य दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snAto naro yastu mokShAya parikalpate | tyaktvA sarvAnaghAnsadyo vij~nAnaM prApya durlabham
verses.translation: In order to And it out he roamed over the world, steadily maintaining his sacred rite. But not finding the same, the pious Visnu offered one of his eyes (instead of the lotus).

verses.sanskrit: गौतमो ऋषयश्चान्ये मिलिताश्च परस्परम् । लज्जितास्ते तदा ये च कृतघ्ना ह्यभवन्पुरा
verses.transliteration: gautamo R^iShayashchAnye militAshcha parasparam | lajjitAste tadA ye cha kR^itaghnA hyabhavanpurA
verses.translation: On seeing it Siva who destroys all miseries was delighted and appeared before him. He spoke these words to Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ अस्माभिरन्यथा सूत श्रुतं तद्वर्णयामहे । गौतमस्तान्द्विजान् क्रुद्धः शशापेति प्रबुध्यताम्
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH || asmAbhiranyathA sUta shrutaM tadvarNayAmahe | gautamastAndvijAn kruddhaH shashApeti prabudhyatAm
verses.translation: O Visnu, I am delighted with you. Mention the

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । द्विजास्तदपि सत्यं वै कल्पभेदसमाश्रयात् । वर्णयामि विशेषेण तां कथामपि सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | dvijAstadapi satyaM vai kalpabhedasamAshrayAt | varNayAmi visheSheNa tAM kathAmapi suvratAH
verses.translation: After saying this he stood in affliction and bowed to Siva, the supreme soul.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमोऽपि ऋषीन्दृष्ट्वा तदा दुर्भिक्षपीडितान् । तपश्चकार सुमहद्वरुणस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: gautamo.api R^iShIndR^iShTvA tadA durbhikShapIDitAn | tapashchakAra sumahadvaruNasya mahAtmanaH
verses.translation: On ]icaring these words of Visiiu, Siva, the lord of gods, gave him his discus Sudariana shining with the mass of splendour.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षय्यं कल्पयामास जलं वरुणदायया । ततो व्रीहीन् यवांश्चैव वापयामास भूरिशः
verses.transliteration: akShayyaM kalpayAmAsa jalaM varuNadAyayA | tato vrIhIn yavAMshchaiva vApayAmAsa bhUrishaH
verses.translation: On receiving it Visnu slew the powerful demons immediately with the discus without any strain.

verses.sanskrit: एवं परोपकारी स गौतमो मुनिसत्तमः । आहारं कल्पयामास तेभ्यः स्वतपसो बलात्
verses.transliteration: evaM paropakArI sa gautamo munisattamaH | AhAraM kalpayAmAsa tebhyaH svatapaso balAt
verses.translation: Tliereupon the universe derived normalcy, the gods became happy. After receiving the Sudarsana missile Visnu was greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्तत्स्त्रियो दुष्टा जलार्थमपमानिताः । ऊचुः पतिभ्यस्ताः क्रुद्धा गौतमेर्ष्याकरं वचः
verses.transliteration: kadAchittatstriyo duShTA jalArthamapamAnitAH | UchuH patibhyastAH kruddhA gautamerShyAkaraM vachaH
verses.translation: Please expound the glory of this hymn to us and narrate the dialogue between Siva and Visnu. The merciful nature of Siva towards Vi.snu may also be narrated to ns.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते भिन्नमतयो गां कृत्वा कृत्रिमां द्विजाः । तद्धान्यभक्षणासक्तां चक्रुस्तां कुटिलाशयाः
verses.transliteration: tataste bhinnamatayo gAM kR^itvA kR^itrimAM dvijAH | taddhAnyabhakShaNAsaktAM chakrustAM kuTilAshayAH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the pious sages, Suta spoke after remembering the lotus-likc feet of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं सम्प्रार्थिता गङ्गा गौतमेन तदा स्वयम् । ब्रह्मणश्च गिरेर्विप्रा द्रुतं तस्मादवातरत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM samprArthitA ga~NgA gautamena tadA svayam | brahmaNashcha girerviprA drutaM tasmAdavAtarat
verses.translation: May this be heard, O great sages. I shall now re¬ count the hymn of thousand names of Siva, whereby Siva was satisfied.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधान्यभक्षणासक्तां गां दृष्ट्वा गौतमस्तदा । तृणेन ताडयामास शनैस्तां सन्निवारयन्
verses.transliteration: svadhAnyabhakShaNAsaktAM gAM dR^iShTvA gautamastadA | tR^iNena tADayAmAsa shanaistAM sannivArayan
verses.translation: The eight foiras of Siva, represented by earth, water, fire, wind, ether, sun, moon and mind are known lespcciively as Sarva, Bhava, Pa. 4 upati, I 4 ana, Btilma, Rudra, Mah&deva and Ugra. I'hese symbolise the five gross material elements, two opposite principles (»f heal and cold and the principle of mind which is the eighth.

verses.sanskrit: तृणसंस्पर्शमात्रेण सा भूमौ पतिता च गौः । मृता ह्यभूत्क्षणं विप्रा भाविकर्मवशात्तदा
verses.transliteration: tR^iNasaMsparshamAtreNa sA bhUmau patitA cha gauH | mR^itA hyabhUtkShaNaM viprA bhAvikarmavashAttadA
verses.translation: For the origin of this name sec SP. RS- Yuddha. ch. 57.

verses.sanskrit: गौर्हता गौतमेनेति तदा ते कुटिलाशयाः । एकत्रीभूय तत्रत्याः सकला ऋषयोऽवदन्
verses.transliteration: gaurhatA gautameneti tadA te kuTilAshayAH | ekatrIbhUya tatratyAH sakalA R^iShayo.avadan
verses.translation: According to a legend Siva swallowed poison churned out of the ocean and obtained thi« name. For the symbolical interpretation ol this name see MP. A Study pp

verses.sanskrit: ततः स गौतमो भीतो गौर्हतेति बभूव ह । चकार विस्मयं नार्यहल्याशिष्यैः शिवानुगः
verses.transliteration: tataH sa gautamo bhIto gaurhateti babhUva ha | chakAra vismayaM nAryahalyAshiShyaiH shivAnugaH
verses.translation: Siva named Tryambaka represents the Various Triads on

verses.sanskrit: ततः स गौतमो ज्ञात्वा तां गां क्रोधसमाकुलः । शशाप तानृषीन् सर्वान् गौतमो मुनिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tataH sa gautamo j~nAtvA tAM gAM krodhasamAkulaH | shashApa tAnR^iShIn sarvAn gautamo munisattamaH
verses.translation: For the origin of this name see.P. RS. Yuddha Ch. 57.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । यूयं सर्वे दुरात्मानो दुःखदा मे विशेषतः । शिवभक्तस्य सततं स्युर्वेदविमुखाः सदा
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | yUyaM sarve durAtmAno duHkhadA me visheShataH | shivabhaktasya satataM syurvedavimukhAH sadA
verses.translation: Thus Viou eulogised Siva with the thousand names. Siva was prayed to and worshipped with lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति वेदोक्ते सत्कर्मणि विशेषतः । मा भूयाद्भवतां श्रद्धा शैवमार्गे विमुक्तिदे
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhR^iti vedokte satkarmaNi visheShataH | mA bhUyAdbhavatAM shraddhA shaivamArge vimuktide
verses.translation: O brahmins, then the enthusiastic Siva performed something wonderful and pleasing. Listen to that attentively.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति दुर्मार्गे तत्र श्रद्धा भवेत्तु वः । मोक्षमार्गविहीने हि सदा श्रुतिबहिर्मुखे
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhR^iti durmArge tatra shraddhA bhavettu vaH | mokShamArgavihIne hi sadA shrutibahirmukhe
verses.translation: On hearing the eulogy made by Vinu consisting of the hymn of his thousand divine names lord Siva became delighted*

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति भालानि मृल्लिप्तानि भवन्तु वः । स्रंसध्वं नरके यूयं भालमृल्लेपना द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhR^iti bhAlAni mR^illiptAni bhavantu vaH | sraMsadhvaM narake yUyaM bhAlamR^illepanA dvijAH
verses.translation: In order to test Vi?nu, Siva, the lord of the worlds concealed one of the lotus-flowers.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तो मा भविष्यन्तु शिवैकपरदैवताः । अन्यदेव समत्वेन जानन्तु शिवमद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: bhavanto mA bhaviShyantu shivaikaparadaivatAH | anyadeva samatvena jAnantu shivamadvayam
verses.translation: He thought within himself "Where could the lotus- flower have gone? If it has gone, let it go for good. Is not my own eye a lotus?

verses.sanskrit: औदुम्बरस्य शाखायास्तत्प्रवाहो विनिःसृतः । तत्र स्नानं मुदा चक्रे गौतमो विश्रुतो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: audumbarasya shAkhAyAstatpravAho viniHsR^itaH | tatra snAnaM mudA chakre gautamo vishruto muniH
verses.translation: After thinking thus, he plucked out his eye and repeated the last name Sarvasattvavalambana. Full of emotion he worshipped and eulogised Siva.

verses.sanskrit: मा भूयाद्भवतां प्रीतिः शिवपूजादिकर्मणि । शिवनिष्ठेषु भक्तेषु शिवपर्वसु सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: mA bhUyAdbhavatAM prItiH shivapUjAdikarmaNi | shivaniShTheShu bhakteShu shivaparvasu sarvadA
verses.translation: On seeing Vi§nu in that attitude, Visnu the preceptor of the universe appeared before him and forbade him do that.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य दत्ता मया शापा यावन्तो दुःखदायकाः । तावन्तः सन्तु भवतां सन्ततावपि सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: adya dattA mayA shApA yAvanto duHkhadAyakAH | tAvantaH santu bhavatAM santatAvapi sarvadA
verses.translation: Lord Siva descended from the pedestal of that earthern phallic image installed by Viinu.

verses.sanskrit: अशैवाः सन्तु भवतां पुत्रपौत्रादयो द्विजाः । पुत्रैः सहैव तिष्ठन्तु भवन्तो नरके ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: ashaivAH santu bhavatAM putrapautrAdayo dvijAH | putraiH sahaiva tiShThantu bhavanto narake dhruvam
verses.translation: Bowing to Siva, rising up in the form of a mass of splendour as mentioned before, Visnu stood in front of him and eulogised him particularly.

verses.sanskrit: ततो भवन्तु चाण्डाला दुःखदारिद्र्यपीडिताः । शठा निन्दाकराः सर्वे तप्तमुद्राङ्किताः सदा
verses.transliteration: tato bhavantu chANDAlA duHkhadAridryapIDitAH | shaThA nindAkarAH sarve taptamudrA~NkitAH sadA
verses.translation: Looking mercifully at Visnu, who stood before him with palms joined in reverence, the delighted lord Siva laughingly said then.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति शप्त्वा मुनीन् सर्वान् गौतमः स्वाश्रमं ययौ । शिवभक्तिं चकाराति स बभूव सुपावनः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shaptvA munIn sarvAn gautamaH svAshramaM yayau | shivabhaktiM chakArAti sa babhUva supAvanaH
verses.translation: O Vinu, all the desires in your mind, particularly the task of the gods have been understood by me. Indeed you are engaged in the task of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तैः खिन्नहृदया ऋषयस्तेऽखिला द्विजाः । काञ्च्यां चक्रुर्निवासं हि शैवधर्मबहिष्कृताः
verses.transliteration: tatastaiH khinnahR^idayA R^iShayaste.akhilA dvijAH | kA~nchyAM chakrurnivAsaM hi shaivadharmabahiShkR^itAH
verses.translation: In the list of one thovisand names of iSiva, this name stands at the end. There beinR no lotus left for the propitiation of 8iva in this name (one lotus having been coijccaled by lord Siva himself for the test) ViijQU plucked off his own eye and offered the.'same to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पुत्राश्चाभवन्सर्वे शैवधर्मबहिष्कृताः । अग्रे तद्वद्भविष्यन्ति कलौ बहुजनाः खलाः
verses.transliteration: tatputrAshchAbhavansarve shaivadharmabahiShkR^itAH | agre tadvadbhaviShyanti kalau bahujanAH khalAH
verses.translation: For the achievement of the task of the gods and for the destruction of the Daityas without strain, I shall give the auspicious discus Sudar4ana to you.

verses.sanskrit: इति प्रोक्तमशेषेण तद्वृत्तं मुनिसत्तमाः । पूर्ववृत्तमपि प्राज्ञाः श्रुतं सर्वैस्तु चादरात्
verses.transliteration: iti proktamasheSheNa tadvR^ittaM munisattamAH | pUrvavR^ittamapi prAj~nAH shrutaM sarvaistu chAdarAt
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, for your benefit ponder over this form, pleasing to all the worlds, which has seen by you (now ).

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्यातो गौतम्याश्च समुद्भवः । माहात्म्यमुत्तमं चैव सर्वपापहरं परम्
verses.transliteration: iti vashcha samAkhyAto gautamyAshcha samudbhavaH | mAhAtmyamuttamaM chaiva sarvapApaharaM param
verses.translation: If this discus, this form and this hymn of thousand names is remembered in the battlefield it will quell the misery of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकस्य च माहात्म्यं ज्योतिर्लिङ्गस्य कीर्तितम् । यच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tryambakasya cha mAhAtmyaM jyotirli~Ngasya kIrtitam | yachChrutvA sarvapApebhyo muchyate nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: O one of good rites, thanks to my blessings, all those who listen to this will achieve their desires without serious dangers.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमस्य च ये शिष्या अन्ये चैव महर्षयः । समागताश्च ते तत्र स्नानं चक्रुर्मुदान्विताः
verses.transliteration: gautamasya cha ye shiShyA anye chaiva maharShayaH | samAgatAshcha te tatra snAnaM chakrurmudAnvitAH
verses.translation: After saying this, the lord gave the discus of the brilliance of ten thousand suns, born of his own feet and destructive of all enemies, to Vi§nu.

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि वैद्यनाथेश्वरस्य हि । ज्योतिर्लिङ्गस्य माहात्म्यं श्रूयतां पापहारकम्
verses.transliteration: ataH paraM pravakShyAmi vaidyanAtheshvarasya hi | jyotirli~Ngasya mAhAtmyaM shrUyatAM pApahArakam
verses.translation: Vi?nu purified himself and accepted it facing the north. After making obeisance to lord Siva, Vi?nu spoke these words to him.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाद्वारं च तन्नाम प्रसिद्धमभवत्तदा । सर्वपापहरं रम्यं दर्शनान्मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAdvAraM cha tannAma prasiddhamabhavattadA | sarvapApaharaM ramyaM darshanAnmunisattamAH
verses.translation: O lord, O benefactor of the worlds, listen. Please tell me what I shall meditate upon and what I shall recite for the destruction of the distress.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमस्पर्द्धिनस्ते च ऋषयस्तत्र चागताः । स्नानार्थं तांश्च सा दृष्ट्वा ह्यन्तर्धानं गता द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: gautamasparddhinaste cha R^iShayastatra chAgatAH | snAnArthaM tAMshcha sA dR^iShTvA hyantardhAnaM gatA drutam
verses.translation: On being thus asked by him,!§iva becoming t satisfied and delighted in his mind spoke to Vinu who helped the gods.

verses.sanskrit: मा मेति गौतमस्तत्र व्याजहार वचो द्रुतम् । मुहुर्मुहुः स्तुवन् गङ्गां साञ्जलिर्नतमस्तकः
verses.transliteration: mA meti gautamastatra vyAjahAra vacho drutam | muhurmuhuH stuvan ga~NgAM sA~njalirnatamastakaH
verses.translation: For the attainment of your desires you shall hold this discus always. O Visnu this is the best of all discuses.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच । इमे च श्रीमदान्धाश्च साधवो वाप्यसाधवः । एतत्पुण्यप्रभावेण दर्शनं दीयतां त्वया
verses.transliteration: gautama uvAcha | ime cha shrImadAndhAshcha sAdhavo vApyasAdhavaH | etatpuNyaprabhAveNa darshanaM dIyatAM tvayA
verses.translation: When kings are in distress this worship with

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Delighted in his mind, §iva spoke thus to Vi?rui and touched him with his hands. Iiva then told him again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Delighted in his mind, §iva spoke thus to Vi?rui and touched him with his hands. Iiva then told him again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२८. अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः । वैद्यनाथेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णम् । सूत उवाच । रावणो राक्षसश्रेष्ठो मानी मानपरायणः । आरराध हरं भक्त्या कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.28\. aShTAviMsho.adhyAyaH | vaidyanAtheshvarajyotirli~NgamAhAtmyavarNam | sUta uvAcha | rAvaNo rAkShasashreShTho mAnI mAnaparAyaNaH | ArarAdha haraM bhaktyA kailAse parvatottame
verses.translation: O most excellent of gods, I am the granier of the boons. Choose the boons you desire to have. O one of good rites, I am attracted by your devotion and by this hymn as well.

verses.sanskrit: शिरांसि पूर्ववत्कृत्वा नीरुजानि तथा प्रभुः । मनोरथं ददौ तस्मै चातुलं बलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shirAMsi pUrvavatkR^itvA nIrujAni tathA prabhuH | manorathaM dadau tasmai chAtulaM balamuttamam
verses.translation: Urged thus the delighted Visriu bowed to the lord of gods and spoke with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादं तस्य सम्प्राप्य रावणः स च राक्षसः । प्रत्युवाच शिवं शम्भुं नतस्कन्धः कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: prasAdaM tasya samprApya rAvaNaH sa cha rAkShasaH | pratyuvAcha shivaM shambhuM nataskandhaH kR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: O lord, you shall be equally merciful to others as well just as you are merciful to me now.

verses.sanskrit: रावण उवाच । प्रसन्नो भव देवेश लङ्कां च त्वां नयाम्यहम् । सफलं कुरु मे कामं त्वामहं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: rAvaNa uvAcha | prasanno bhava devesha la~NkAM cha tvAM nayAmyaham | saphalaM kuru me kAmaM tvAmahaM sharaNaM gataH
verses.translation: On hearing these words, the extremely sympathetic lord touched him. Then the moon-crested deity spoke.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तश्च तदा तेन शम्भुर्वै रावणेन सः । प्रत्युवाच विचेतस्कः सङ्कटं परमं गतः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktashcha tadA tena shambhurvai rAvaNena saH | pratyuvAcha vichetaskaH sa~NkaTaM paramaM gataH
verses.translation: O Vi?nu, your devotion to me will always remain firm. Be worthy of the reverence and worship of all gods in the world.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । श्रूयतां राक्षसश्रेष्ठ वचो मे सारवत्तया । नीयतां स्वगृहे मे हि सद्भक्त्या लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | shrUyatAM rAkShasashreShTha vacho me sAravattayA | nIyatAM svagR^ihe me hi sadbhaktyA li~Ngamuttamam
