verses.translation: O great sages, after saying this, lord Siva, the lord of the gods, vanished there itself even as Visnu was watching.

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ लिङ्गं यदा त्वं च स्थापयिष्यसि यत्र वै । स्थास्यत्यत्र न सन्देहो यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: bhUmau li~NgaM yadA tvaM cha sthApayiShyasi yatra vai | sthAsyatyatra na sandeho yathechChasi tathA kuru
verses.translation: After securing the auspicious discus and hearing the words of Siva, lord Vi§nu was extremely delighted in his mind.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तः शम्भुना तेन रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । तथेति तत्समादाय जगाम भवनं निजम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktaH shambhunA tena rAvaNo rAkShaseshvaraH | tatheti tatsamAdAya jagAma bhavanaM nijam
verses.translation: Meditating on Siva, he repeated the hymn incessantly and instructed the devotees too in this.

verses.sanskrit: आसीन्मूत्रोत्सर्गकामो मार्गे हि शिवमायया । तत्स्तम्भितुं न शक्तोऽभूत्पौलस्त्यो रावणः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: AsInmUtrotsargakAmo mArge hi shivamAyayA | tatstambhituM na shakto.abhUtpaulastyo rAvaNaH prabhuH
verses.translation: O excellent ones, thus I have narrated the story in accordance with your enquiry. It destroys the sins of those who listen to it. What then do you wish to ask?

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैकं तत्र वै गोपं प्रार्थ्य लिङ्गं ददौ च तत् । मुहूर्तके ह्यतिक्रान्ते गोपोऽभूद्विकलस्तदा
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvaikaM tatra vai gopaM prArthya li~NgaM dadau cha tat | muhUrtake hyatikrAnte gopo.abhUdvikalastadA
verses.translation: O Suta, O fortunate Suta, you are endowed with knowledge, O one of good rites. Please narrate the story of Siva again in detail.

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ संस्थापयामास तद्भारेणातिपीडितः । तत्रैव तत्स्थितं लिङ्गं वज्रसारसमुद्भवम् । सर्वकामप्रदं चैव दर्शनात्पापहारकम्
verses.transliteration: bhUmau saMsthApayAmAsa tadbhAreNAtipIDitaH | tatraiva tatsthitaM li~NgaM vajrasArasamudbhavam | sarvakAmapradaM chaiva darshanAtpApahArakam
verses.translation: The ancient kings, sages and gods propitiated that excellent deity Siva alone.

verses.sanskrit: आराधितः कियत्कालं न प्रसन्नो हरो यदा । तदा चान्यत्तपश्चक्रे प्रसादार्थं शिवस्य सः
verses.transliteration: ArAdhitaH kiyatkAlaM na prasanno haro yadA | tadA chAnyattapashchakre prasAdArthaM shivasya saH
verses.translation: O great sages, you have put the question properly. I shall narrate the charming story of l§iva. It is eonducive to the attainment of worldly pleasures and salvation by those who listen to it. May it be heard.

verses.sanskrit: वैद्यनाथेश्वरं नाम्ना तल्लिङ्गमभवन्मुने । प्रसिद्धं त्रिषु लोकेषु भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सताम्
verses.transliteration: vaidyanAtheshvaraM nAmnA talli~Ngamabhavanmune | prasiddhaM triShu lokeShu bhuktimuktipradaM satAm
verses.translation: O Narada, listen. I shall narrate the excellent story of Siva with pleasure out of affection to you. It des¬ troys great sins

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गमिदं श्रेष्ठं दर्शनात्पूजनादपि । सर्वपापहरं दिव्यं मुक्तिवर्धनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: jyotirli~NgamidaM shreShThaM darshanAtpUjanAdapi | sarvapApaharaM divyaM muktivardhanamuttamam
verses.translation: Visnu, accompanied by Laksmi, performed the worship of Siva. Thanks to the mercy of lord Siva, he attained all desires.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिँलिङ्गे स्थिते तत्र सर्वलोकहिताय वै । रावणः स्वगृहं गत्वा वरं प्राप्य महोत्तमम् । प्रियायै सर्वमाचख्यौ सुखेनाति महासुरः
verses.transliteration: tasmi.Nli~Nge sthite tatra sarvalokahitAya vai | rAvaNaH svagR^ihaM gatvA varaM prApya mahottamam | priyAyai sarvamAchakhyau sukhenAti mahAsuraH
verses.translation: I, the grandfather of the worlds, am a worshipper of Siva. Thanks to his mercy that I create the worlds always.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा सकला देवाः शक्राद्या मुनयस्तथा । परस्परं समामन्त्र्य शिवासक्तधियोऽमलाः
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA sakalA devAH shakrAdyA munayastathA | parasparaM samAmantrya shivAsaktadhiyo.amalAH
verses.translation: My sons, the great sages, always worship Siva. Many other sages also do so.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्काले सुराः सर्वे हरिब्रह्मादयो मुने । आजग्मुस्तत्र सुप्रीत्या पूजां चक्रुर्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tasminkAle surAH sarve haribrahmAdayo mune | Ajagmustatra suprItyA pUjAM chakrurvisheShataH
verses.translation: O Narada, particularly you are a worshipper of Siva. The seven sages, * Vasita and others too are the wor¬ shippers of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं तं तदा दृष्ट्वा प्रतिष्ठाप्य च ते सुराः । वैद्यनाथेति सम्प्रोच्य नत्वा नुत्वा दिवं ययुः
verses.transliteration: pratyakShaM taM tadA dR^iShTvA pratiShThApya cha te surAH | vaidyanAtheti samprochya natvA nutvA divaM yayuH
verses.translation: The great chaste lady Arundhati, Lopamudra, and Ahalya the wife of Gautama, do also worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । तस्मिँल्लिङ्गे स्थिते तत्र रावणे च गृहं गते । किं चरित्रमभूत्तात ततस्तद्वद विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | tasmi.Nlli~Nge sthite tatra rAvaNe cha gR^ihaM gate | kiM charitramabhUttAta tatastadvada vistarAt
verses.translation: These sages, viz.—Durvasas, KauiSika, Sakti, Dadhici, Gautama, Kanada, JIva, Bhargava, Vaiampayana, ParaSara and Vyasa are the worshippers of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । रावणोऽपि गृहं गत्वा वरं प्राप्य महोत्तमम् । प्रियायै सर्वमाचख्यौ मुमोदाति महासुरः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | rAvaNo.api gR^ihaM gatvA varaM prApya mahottamam | priyAyai sarvamAchakhyau mumodAti mahAsuraH
verses.translation: Sukra, Saunaka and others are the worshippers of Siva. There are many other sages, excellent sages, who worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा सकलं देवाः शक्राद्या मुनयस्तथा । परस्परं समूचुस्ते समुद्विग्ना मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA sakalaM devAH shakrAdyA munayastathA | parasparaM samUchuste samudvignA munIshvarAH
verses.translation: Aditi, the mother of the gods, performed the worship of Siva in earthen phallic idols every day. She is a lady engaged in Siva's devotion.

verses.sanskrit: देवादय ऊचुः ॥ रावणोऽयं दुरात्मा हि देवद्रोही खलः कुधीः । शिवाद् वरं च सम्प्राप्य दुःखं दास्यति नोऽति सः
verses.transliteration: devAdaya UchuH || rAvaNo.ayaM durAtmA hi devadrohI khalaH kudhIH | shivAd varaM cha samprApya duHkhaM dAsyati no.ati saH
verses.translation: Indra and other guardians of the quarters, Vasus,** Maharajika gods, Sadhyas are the worshippers of Jiva.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चायं हिमवतः सिद्धिस्थानस्य वै गिरेः । पौलस्त्यो रावणः श्रीमान् दक्षिणे वृक्षखण्डके
verses.transliteration: tatashchAyaM himavataH siddhisthAnasya vai gireH | paulastyo rAvaNaH shrImAn dakShiNe vR^ikShakhaNDake
verses.translation: The subordinate gods, Gandharvas, Kinnaras and others are worshippers of Siva. Similarly the Asuras of noble minds are the worshippers of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: किं कुर्मः क्व च गच्छामः किं भविष्यति वा पुनः । दुष्टश्च दक्षतां प्राप्तः किं किं नो साधयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: kiM kurmaH kva cha gachChAmaH kiM bhaviShyati vA punaH | duShTashcha dakShatAM prAptaH kiM kiM no sAdhayiShyati
verses.translation: O sage, the Daitya Hiranyakaipu, his ' sons and younger brother, as well as Virocana and Bali worship Siva every day,

verses.sanskrit: इति दुःखं समापन्नाः शक्राद्या मुनयः सुराः । नारदं च समाहूय पप्रच्छुर्विकलास्तदा
verses.transliteration: iti duHkhaM samApannAH shakrAdyA munayaH surAH | nAradaM cha samAhUya paprachChurvikalAstadA
verses.translation: O great sage, the two gods, the Sun and the Moon who started two lines of kings on the earth are devoted to the service of Siva always along with their descendants.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । सर्वं कार्यं समर्थोऽसि कर्तुं त्वं मुनिसत्तम । उपायं कुरु देवर्षे देवानां दुःखनाशने
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH | sarvaM kAryaM samartho.asi kartuM tvaM munisattama | upAyaM kuru devarShe devAnAM duHkhanAshane
verses.translation: O sage, the self-born Brahma and other Manus performed the worship of Siva and they were in the guise of Siva too.

verses.sanskrit: रावणोऽयं महादुष्टः किं किं नैव करिष्यति । क्व यास्यामो वयं चात्र दुष्टेनापीडिता वयम्
verses.transliteration: rAvaNo.ayaM mahAduShTaH kiM kiM naiva kariShyati | kva yAsyAmo vayaM chAtra duShTenApIDitA vayam
verses.translation: Priyavrata, his son Uttanapada, and his son and successors, were kings worshipping Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । दुःखं त्यजत भो देवा युक्तिं कृत्वा च याम्यहम् । देवकार्यं करिष्यामि कृपया शङ्करस्य वै
verses.transliteration: nArada uvAcha | duHkhaM tyajata bho devA yuktiM kR^itvA cha yAmyaham | devakAryaM kariShyAmi kR^ipayA sha~Nkarasya vai
verses.translation: Dhruva, R.sabha, Bharata, his brothers the nine Yogins and others too were worshippers of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा स तु देवर्षिरगमद्रावणालयम् । सत्कारं समनुप्राप्य प्रीत्योवाचाखिलं च तत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA sa tu devarShiragamadrAvaNAlayam | satkAraM samanuprApya prItyovAchAkhilaM cha tat
verses.translation: Vaivasvata's sons, Tarkjya, Iksvaku and other kings, were always devoted to the worship of Siva and enjoyed happiness.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । राक्षसोत्तम धन्यस्त्वं शैववर्यस्तपोधन । त्वां दृष्ट्वा च मनो मेऽद्य प्रसन्नमति रावण
verses.transliteration: nArada uvAcha | rAkShasottama dhanyastvaM shaivavaryastapodhana | tvAM dR^iShTvA cha mano me.adya prasannamati rAvaNa
verses.translation: Kakutstha, Mandhata, Sagara, Mucukunda, Hari- candra and Kalma$anghri were all excellent devotees of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: स्ववृत्तं ब्रूह्यशेषेण शिवाराधनसम्भवम् । इति पृष्टस्तदा तेन रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: svavR^ittaM brUhyasheSheNa shivArAdhanasambhavam | iti pR^iShTastadA tena rAvaNo vAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: Bhagiratha and other kings, many excellent kings are known as worshippers of Siva assuming the guise of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: रावण उवाच । गत्वा मया तु कैलासे तपोऽर्थं च महामुने । तत्रैव बहुकालं वै तपस्तप्तं सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: rAvaNa uvAcha | gatvA mayA tu kailAse tapo.arthaM cha mahAmune | tatraiva bahukAlaM vai tapastaptaM sudAruNam
verses.translation: The great king Khatvanga, who helped the gods, worshipped the earthen idol of Siva always.

verses.sanskrit: यदा न शङ्करस्तुष्टस्ततश्च परिवर्तितम् । आगत्य वृक्षखण्डे वै पुनस्तप्तं मया मुने
verses.transliteration: yadA na sha~NkarastuShTastatashcha parivartitam | Agatya vR^ikShakhaNDe vai punastaptaM mayA mune
verses.translation: At the behest of the sage Vasistha, Dasaratha particularly worshipped the earthen idol of Siva for obtain¬ ing sons.

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ गर्तं वरं कृत्वा तत्राग्निं स्थाप्य स द्विजाः । तत्सन्निधौ शिवं स्थाप्य हवनं स चकार ह
verses.transliteration: bhUmau gartaM varaM kR^itvA tatrAgniM sthApya sa dvijAH | tatsannidhau shivaM sthApya havanaM sa chakAra ha
verses.translation: As directed by Rsyasrhga this excellent king, devoted to Siva performed the sacrifice called Putrc?ti*

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मे पञ्चाग्निमध्ये तु वर्षासु स्थण्डिलेशयः । शीते जलान्तरस्थो हि कृतं चैव त्रिधा तपः
verses.transliteration: grIShme pa~nchAgnimadhye tu varShAsu sthaNDileshayaH | shIte jalAntarastho hi kR^itaM chaiva tridhA tapaH
verses.translation: Urged by Rsyasrnga, Kausalya, the beloved queen of Dasaratha joyously performed the worship of the earthen idol of Siva for the acquisition of a son.

verses.sanskrit: एवं मया कृतं तत्र तपोऽत्युग्रं मुनीश्वर । तथापि शङ्करो मह्यं न प्रसन्नोऽभवन्मनाक्
verses.transliteration: evaM mayA kR^itaM tatra tapo.atyugraM munIshvara | tathApi sha~Nkaro mahyaM na prasanno.abhavanmanAk
verses.translation: O excellent sage, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi the beloved queens, performed the worship of Siva with pleasure for the acquisition of good sons.

verses.sanskrit: तदा मया तु क्रुद्धेन भूमौ गर्तं विधाय च । तत्राग्निं च समाधाय पार्थिवं च प्रकल्प्य च
verses.transliteration: tadA mayA tu kruddhena bhUmau gartaM vidhAya cha | tatrAgniM cha samAdhAya pArthivaM cha prakalpya cha
verses.translation: O sage, they obtained auspicious sons of great valour and prowess who followed the path of the good. It was due to the favour of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धैश्च चन्दनैश्चैव धूपैश्च विविधैस्तदा । नैवेद्यैः पूजितः शम्भुरारार्तिकविधानतः
verses.transliteration: gandhaishcha chandanaishchaiva dhUpaishcha vividhaistadA | naivedyaiH pUjitaH shambhurArArtikavidhAnataH
verses.translation: Then at the behest of Siva, Visnu himself was born of the ladies in four different forms.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपातैः स्तवैः पुण्यैस्तोषितः शङ्करो मया । गीतैर्नृत्यैश्च वाद्यैश्च मुखाङ्गुलिसमर्पणैः
verses.transliteration: praNipAtaiH stavaiH puNyaistoShitaH sha~Nkaro mayA | gItairnR^ityaishcha vAdyaishcha mukhA~NgulisamarpaNaiH
verses.translation: Rama performed the worship of the earthen idol every day in the company of his brothers. He wore Bhasma and Rudraksa and followed the Siva-cult.

verses.sanskrit: एतैश्च विविधैश्चान्यैरुपायैर्भूरिभिर्मुने । शास्त्रोक्तेन विधानेन पूजितो भगवान् हरः
verses.transliteration: etaishcha vividhaishchAnyairupAyairbhUribhirmune | shAstroktena vidhAnena pUjito bhagavAn haraH
verses.translation: O sage, the kings born of his family worshipped the earthen idol of Siva along with their followers.

verses.sanskrit: न तुष्टः सम्मुखो जातो यदा च भगवान् हरः । तदाहं दुःखितोऽभूवं तपसोऽप्राप्य सत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: na tuShTaH sammukho jAto yadA cha bhagavAn haraH | tadAhaM duHkhito.abhUvaM tapaso.aprApya satphalam
verses.translation: O sage, the great king Sudyumna, the son of a sage, became a woman along with his attendants as a result of Siva's curse for the sake of his beloved.

verses.sanskrit: धिक् शरीरं बलं चैव धिक् तपःकरणं मम । इत्युक्त्वा तु मया तत्र स्थापितेऽग्नौ हुतं बहु
verses.transliteration: dhik sharIraM balaM chaiva dhik tapaHkaraNaM mama | ityuktvA tu mayA tatra sthApite.agnau hutaM bahu
verses.translation: Thanks to the worship of the earthen image of Siva, he became an excellent man again. By remaining a

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्चेति विचार्यैव त्यक्षाम्यग्नौ निजां तनुम् । सञ्छिन्नानि शिरांस्येव तस्मिन् प्रज्वलिते शुचौ
verses.transliteration: punashcheti vichAryaiva tyakShAmyagnau nijAM tanum | sa~nChinnAni shirAMsyeva tasmin prajvalite shuchau
verses.translation: Then he forsook the kingdom and engaged himself in the Siva-cult assuming the guise of $iva. By virtue of devotion he attained salvation inaccessible to others.

verses.sanskrit: सुच्छित्वैकैकशस्तानि कृत्वा शुद्धानि सर्वशः । शङ्करायार्पितान्येव नवसङ्ख्यानि वै मया
verses.transliteration: suchChitvaikaikashastAni kR^itvA shuddhAni sarvashaH | sha~NkarAyArpitAnyeva navasa~NkhyAni vai mayA
verses.translation: His son Pururavas, a great king, was a worship¬ per of lord 3iva. His son Bharata performed the great worship of Siva always. Nahusa, a great devotee was interested in the worship of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मे पञ्चाग्निमध्यस्थो वर्षासु स्थण्डिलेशयः । शीते जलान्तरस्थो हि त्रिधा चक्रे तपश्च सः
verses.transliteration: grIShme pa~nchAgnimadhyastho varShAsu sthaNDileshayaH | shIte jalAntarastho hi tridhA chakre tapashcha saH
verses.translation: Yayati realised his desires due to Siva's worship. He begot five sons all interested in Siva cult.

verses.sanskrit: यावच्च दशमं छेत्तुं प्रारब्धमृषिसत्तम । तावदाविरभूत्तत्र ज्योतीरूपो हरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: yAvachcha dashamaM ChettuM prArabdhamR^iShisattama | tAvadAvirabhUttatra jyotIrUpo haraH svayam
verses.translation: Yadu and others, the five sons of Yayati were the worshippers of Siva. Thanks to the power of the worship of Siva, they realised all their desires.

verses.sanskrit: मा मेति व्याहरत् प्रीत्या द्रुतं वै भक्तवत्सलः । प्रसन्नश्च वरं ब्रूहि ददामि मनसेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: mA meti vyAharat prItyA drutaM vai bhaktavatsalaH | prasannashcha varaM brUhi dadAmi manasepsitam
verses.translation: Other fortunate persons of his race and of other races, O sage, worshipped Siva and obtained worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते च तदा तेन मया दृष्टो महेश्वरः । प्रणतः संस्तुतश्चैव करौ बध्वा सुभक्तितः
verses.transliteration: ityukte cha tadA tena mayA dR^iShTo maheshvaraH | praNataH saMstutashchaiva karau badhvA subhaktitaH
verses.translation: After securing several divine boons from Siva who was delighted, lord Krsna brought the entire universe under his control.

verses.sanskrit: तदा वृतं मयैतच्च देहि मे ह्यतुलं बलम् । यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश दुर्लभं किं भवेन्मम
verses.transliteration: tadA vR^itaM mayaitachcha dehi me hyatulaM balam | yadi prasanno devesha durlabhaM kiM bhavenmama
verses.translation: Thanks to that merit, the forester became Nala. He became a great emperor and the husband of Damayanti.

verses.sanskrit: शिवेन परितुष्टेन सर्वं दत्तं कृपालुना । मह्यं मनोऽभिलषितं गिरा प्रोच्य तथास्त्विति
verses.transliteration: shivena parituShTena sarvaM dattaM kR^ipAlunA | mahyaM mano.abhilaShitaM girA prochya tathAstviti
verses.translation: O dear, thus I have narrated the divine story of Siva as.asked by you. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: अमोघया सुदृष्ट्या वै वैद्यवद्योजितानि मे । शिरांसि सन्धयित्वा तु दृष्टानि परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: amoghayA sudR^iShTyA vai vaidyavadyojitAni me | shirAMsi sandhayitvA tu dR^iShTAni paramAtmanA
verses.translation: O dear, you are blessed and contented. Your

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते तदा तत्र शरीरं पूर्ववन्मम । जातं तस्य प्रसादाच्च सर्वं प्राप्तं फलं मया
verses.transliteration: evaM kR^ite tadA tatra sharIraM pUrvavanmama | jAtaM tasya prasAdAchcha sarvaM prAptaM phalaM mayA
verses.translation: O Suta, although this matter has been heard

verses.sanskrit: तदा च प्रार्थितो मे संस्थितोऽसौ वृषभध्वजः । वैद्यनाथेश्वरो नाम्ना प्रसिद्धोऽभूज्जगत्त्रये
verses.transliteration: tadA cha prArthito me saMsthito.asau vR^iShabhadhvajaH | vaidyanAtheshvaro nAmnA prasiddho.abhUjjagattraye
verses.translation: O disciple of Vyasa, obeisance be to you. Please

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनात्पूजनाज्ज्योतिर्लिङ्गरूपो महेश्वरः । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदो लोके सर्वेषां हितकारकः
verses.transliteration: darshanAtpUjanAjjyotirli~NgarUpo maheshvaraH | bhuktimuktiprado loke sarveShAM hitakArakaH
verses.translation: The same question had been put by Brahma, Vi§nu and Siva before Siva in the manner in which you are asking me now.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गमहं तद्वै पूजयित्वा विशेषतः । प्रणिपत्यागतश्चात्र विजेतुं भुवनत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: jyotirli~NgamahaM tadvai pUjayitvA visheShataH | praNipatyAgatashchAtra vijetuM bhuvanatrayam
verses.translation: On a certain occasion they asked Siva, the great soul. ''What rite satisfies you to bestow worldly pleasures and salvation?"

verses.sanskrit: चकारैवं बहु तपो न प्रसन्नस्तदापि हि । परमात्मा महेशानो दुराराध्यो दुरात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: chakAraivaM bahu tapo na prasannastadApi hi | paramAtmA maheshAno durArAdhyo durAtmabhiH
verses.translation: There arc many rites yielding worldly pleasures and salvation. The most important among them are ten in number.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तदीयं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा देवर्षिर्जातसम्भ्रमः । विहस्य च मनस्येव रावणं नारदोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tadIyaM tadvachaH shrutvA devarShirjAtasambhramaH | vihasya cha manasyeva rAvaNaM nArado.abravIt
verses.translation: Those who have mastered the text *'Jabalasruti** have mentioned ten sacred rites of Siva. These rites shall

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । श्रूयतां राक्षसश्रेष्ठ कथयामि हितं तव । त्वया तदेव कर्त्तव्यं मदुक्तं नान्यथा क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: nArada uvAcha | shrUyatAM rAkShasashreShTha kathayAmi hitaM tava | tvayA tadeva karttavyaM maduktaM nAnyathA kvachit
verses.translation: On Atami days (the eighth day in the lunar fortnight) meals shall be taken only at night. O Visnu, on Kalastami day food shall be eschewed altogether.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयोक्तं यच्छिवेनैव हितं दत्तं ममाधुना । तत्सर्वं च त्वया सत्यं न मन्तव्यं कदाचन
verses.transliteration: tvayoktaM yachChivenaiva hitaM dattaM mamAdhunA | tatsarvaM cha tvayA satyaM na mantavyaM kadAchana
verses.translation: O Vinu, on the eleventh day in the bright lunar fortnight, food during the day is forbidden. O Vi?nu, on the eleventh day in the dark half food shall be taken at night after my worship.

verses.sanskrit: अयं वै विकृतिं प्राप्तः किं किं नैव ब्रवीति च । सत्यं नैव भवेत्तद्वै कथं ज्ञेयं प्रियोऽसि मे
verses.transliteration: ayaM vai vikR^itiM prAptaH kiM kiM naiva bravIti cha | satyaM naiva bhavettadvai kathaM j~neyaM priyo.asi me
verses.translation: On the thirteenth day in the bright half, food shall be taken at night, In the dark half, it is forbidden to those who follow Siva's rites.

verses.sanskrit: इति गत्वा पुनः कार्यं कुरु त्वं ह्यहिताय वै । कैलासोद्धरणे यत्नः कर्तव्यश्च त्वया पुनः
verses.transliteration: iti gatvA punaH kAryaM kuru tvaM hyahitAya vai | kailAsoddharaNe yatnaH kartavyashcha tvayA punaH
verses.translation: O Visrm, in both the halves on every Monday, food shall be taken only during the night bv the followers of Siva-cult.

verses.sanskrit: यदि चैवोद्धृतश्चायं कैलासो हि भविष्यति । तदैव सफलं सर्वं भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yadi chaivoddhR^itashchAyaM kailAso hi bhaviShyati | tadaiva saphalaM sarvaM bhaviShyati na saMshayaH
verses.translation: In all these rites, excellent brahmin devotees of Siva shall be fed according to one's ability for the completion of the sacred rites.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववत्स्थापयित्वा त्वं पुनरागच्छ वै सुखम् । निश्चयं परमं गत्वा यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: pUrvavatsthApayitvA tvaM punarAgachCha vai sukham | nishchayaM paramaM gatvA yathechChasi tathA kuru
verses.translation: The sacred rites shall always be performed regularly by the brahmins. By abandoning these Vratas, brahmins become robbers.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तः स हितं मेने रावणो विधिमोहितः । सत्यं मत्वा मुनेर्वाक्यं कैलासमगमत्तदा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktaH sa hitaM mene rAvaNo vidhimohitaH | satyaM matvA munervAkyaM kailAsamagamattadA
verses.translation: The rites shall be performed regularly by the persons who are adepts in the path of salvation. The four vratas that bring about salvation are the worship of Siva, the repetition of Rudra Mantra by way of Japa, observance of fast in Siva's temple and death in Varanasi. That salvation is eternal.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र समुद्धारं चक्रे तस्य गिरेः स च । तत्रस्थं चैव तत्सर्वं विपर्यस्तं परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: gatvA tatra samuddhAraM chakre tasya gireH sa cha | tatrasthaM chaiva tatsarvaM viparyastaM parasparam
verses.translation: Astami that falls on Monday, and Caturdai in the dark half are sure to bring about the propitiation of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: गिरीशोऽपि तदा दृष्ट्वा किं जातमिति सोऽब्रवीत् । गिरिजा च तदा शम्भुं प्रत्युवाच विहस्य तम्
verses.transliteration: girIsho.api tadA dR^iShTvA kiM jAtamiti so.abravIt | girijA cha tadA shambhuM pratyuvAcha vihasya tam
verses.translation: O Vi§nu, among the four the most powerful is the rite of Sivaratri.® Hence that alone shall be performed by those who desire the fruits of worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिरांसि छित्त्वा च पूजनं शङ्करस्य वै । प्रारब्धं दैत्यपतिना रावणेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration: tataH shirAMsi ChittvA cha pUjanaM sha~Nkarasya vai | prArabdhaM daityapatinA rAvaNena mahAtmanA
verses.translation: In the dark half of the month of Magha, Sivaratri is specifically glorified. The lite of Sivaratri is performed when the Caturdasi extends up-to mid-night. The observance of the rite on that Tithi quells the sin of even a crore of human slaughters.

verses.sanskrit: गिरिजोवाच । सच्छिष्यस्य फलं जातं सम्यग्जातं तु शिष्यतः । शान्तात्मने सुवीराय दत्तं यदतुलं बलम्
verses.transliteration: girijovAcha | sachChiShyasya phalaM jAtaM samyagjAtaM tu shiShyataH | shAntAtmane suvIrAya dattaM yadatulaM balam
verses.translation: To men and women slaves, to gods aijd others and to all embodied souls this excellent rite is most beneficial.

verses.sanskrit: महादेव उवाच । रे रे रावण दुर्भक्त मा गर्वं वह दुर्मते । शीघ्रं च तव हस्तानां दर्पघ्नश्च भवेदिह
verses.transliteration: mahAdeva uvAcha | re re rAvaNa durbhakta mA garvaM vaha durmate | shIghraM cha tava hastAnAM darpaghnashcha bhavediha
verses.translation: In the dark half of the month of Magha, Sivaratri is specifically glorified. The lite of Sivaratri is performed when the Caturdasi extends up-to mid-night. The observance of the rite on that Tithi quells the sin of even a crore of human slaughters.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । गिरिजायाश्च साकूतं वचः श्रुत्वा महेश्वरः । कृतघ्नं रावणं मत्वा शशाप बलदर्पितम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | girijAyAshcha sAkUtaM vachaH shrutvA maheshvaraH | kR^itaghnaM rAvaNaM matvA shashApa baladarpitam
verses.translation: O Visnu, what shall be done on that day from morning onwards you hear with attention. I shall explain it to you with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाव । इति तत्र च यज्जातं नारदः श्रुतवांस्तदा । रावणोऽपि प्रसन्नात्मागात्स्वधाम यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAva | iti tatra cha yajjAtaM nAradaH shrutavAMstadA | rAvaNo.api prasannAtmAgAtsvadhAma yathAgatam
verses.translation: Rising in the morning, the intelligent man with great delight, shall perform his daily routine of bath with care.

verses.sanskrit: निश्चयं परमं कृत्वा बली बलविमोहितः । जगद्वशं हि कृतवान् रावणः परदर्पहा
verses.transliteration: nishchayaM paramaM kR^itvA balI balavimohitaH | jagadvashaM hi kR^itavAn rAvaNaH paradarpahA
verses.translation: He shall then go to the temple of Siva for worship. After making obeisance to Siva, he shall observe the Ritualistic affirmation of his performance according to the prescribed course.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाज्ञया च प्राप्तेन दिव्यास्त्रेण महौजसा । रावणस्य प्रतिभटो नालं कश्चिदभूत्तदा
verses.transliteration: shivAj~nayA cha prAptena divyAstreNa mahaujasA | rAvaNasya pratibhaTo nAlaM kashchidabhUttadA
verses.translation: *'0 lord of gods, "O blue-necked, obeisance be to

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतच्च समाख्यातं वैद्यनाथेश्वरस्य च । माहात्म्यं शृणवतां पापं नृणां भवति भस्मसात्
verses.transliteration: ityetachcha samAkhyAtaM vaidyanAtheshvarasya cha | mAhAtmyaM shR^iNavatAM pApaM nR^iNAM bhavati bhasmasAt
verses.translation: O lord of gods, thanks to your power, let it conclude peacefully. Let not passion and other enemies afflict me."

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं च शिरश्छिन्नं विधिना शिवपूजने । एवं सत्क्रमतस्तेन छिन्नानि नव वै यदा
verses.transliteration: ekaikaM cha shirashChinnaM vidhinA shivapUjane | evaM satkramatastena ChinnAni nava vai yadA
verses.translation: After this affirmation the devotee shall collect the articles of worship. The phallic image shall be taken from a good place by the devotee himself at night by going there. The phallic image shall be that which is prescribed in the Agamas. The materials of worship shall be placed on a good spot near Siva either to the South or to the West. Then the devotee shall take bath again duly.

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्नवशिष्टे तु प्रसन्नः शङ्करस्तदा । आविर्बभूव तत्रैव सन्तुष्टो भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: ekasminnavashiShTe tu prasannaH sha~NkarastadA | AvirbabhUva tatraiva santuShTo bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: The undercloth and the usual cloth shall be pure. 'I'hc devotee shall perform the Acamana thrice and begin worship.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee shall repeat the mantras

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee shall repeat the mantras

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.२९. एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । दारुकावनराक्षसोपद्रववर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । अथातः सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि नागेशाख्यं परात्मनः । ज्योतीरूपं यथा जातं परमं लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.29\. ekonatriMsho.adhyAyaH | dArukAvanarAkShasopadravavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | athAtaH sampravakShyAmi nAgeshAkhyaM parAtmanaH | jyotIrUpaM yathA jAtaM paramaM li~Ngamuttamam
verses.translation: If he knows the sacred verses, he shall make earthen images of excellent type. After performing the daily routine he shall worship the earthen image.

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्व्यां न वर्तते कश्चित्त्वां विना शरणं च नः । यामो यस्य समीपे तु स्थित्वा सुखमवाप्नुमः
verses.transliteration: pR^ithvyAM na vartate kashchittvAM vinA sharaNaM cha naH | yAmo yasya samIpe tu sthitvA sukhamavApnumaH
verses.translation: Al.er making the earthen image, he shall install it thereafter. The devotee shall propitiate the bull-bannered lord, with several hymns.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां दृष्ट्वा राक्षसाः सर्वे पलायन्ते विदूरतः । त्वयि शैवं सदा तेजो विभाति ज्वलनो यथा
verses.transliteration: tvAM dR^iShTvA rAkShasAH sarve palAyante vidUrataH | tvayi shaivaM sadA tejo vibhAti jvalano yathA
verses.translation: The glory of the Vrata shall be proclaimed by the intelligent devotee. It shall be heard by the devotee desiring the completion of the Vrata.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं प्रार्थितो लोकैरौर्वो हि मुनिसत्तमः । शोचमानः शरण्यश्च रक्षायै हि वचोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM prArthito lokairaurvo hi munisattamaH | shochamAnaH sharaNyashcha rakShAyai hi vacho.abravIt
verses.translation: Thus four different idols shall be made for the four 3-hour periods. They shall be duly invoked and duly dismissed. All the intermediary rites.shall also be performed. He shall keep awake with pleasure and jubilation. In the morning he shall take bath again. After installing the idol, he shall perform the worship.

verses.sanskrit: और्व उवाच । पृथिव्यां यदि रक्षांसि हिंस्युर्वै प्राणिनस्तदा । स्वयं प्राणैर्वियुज्येयू राक्षसा बलवत्तराः
verses.transliteration: aurva uvAcha | pR^ithivyAM yadi rakShAMsi hiMsyurvai prANinastadA | svayaM prANairviyujyeyU rAkShasA balavattarAH
verses.translation: After concluding the rites and bowing to Siva again and again he shall pray to him with p.ilms joined in devotion and shoulders drooping down.

verses.sanskrit: यदा यज्ञाश्च हन्येरंस्तदा प्राणैर्वियोजिताः । भवन्तु राक्षसाः सर्वे सत्यमेतन्मयोच्यते
verses.transliteration: yadA yaj~nAshcha hanyeraMstadA prANairviyojitAH | bhavantu rAkShasAH sarve satyametanmayochyate
verses.translation: "O great God, the rite I have started at your behest has been performed and concluded. It has become excellent. O lord, the idol is being ritualistically dismissed now. O lord of gods O Siva, be satisfied with the Vrata that I have performed strenuously. Please be merciful to me.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा वचनं तेभ्यः समाश्वास्य प्रजाः पुनः । तपश्चकार विविधमौर्वो लोकसुखावहः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA vachanaM tebhyaH samAshvAsya prajAH punaH | tapashchakAra vividhamaurvo lokasukhAvahaH
verses.translation: The devotee shall offer a handful of flowers to Siva and make charitable gifts. After making obeisance to Siva formally he shall conclude the rites.

verses.sanskrit: देवास्तदा ते विज्ञाय शापस्य कारणं हि तत् । युद्धाय च समुद्योगं चक्रुर्देवारिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: devAstadA te vij~nAya shApasya kAraNaM hi tat | yuddhAya cha samudyogaM chakrurdevAribhiH saha
verses.translation: O Vi?nu, during the first 3-hour period the devotee shall worship with great devotion the earthen phallic image duly installed by way of good devotional services.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैश्चैव प्रयत्नैश्च नानायुधधराः सुराः । सर्वे शक्रादयस्तत्र युद्धार्थं समुपागताः
verses.transliteration: sarvaishchaiva prayatnaishcha nAnAyudhadharAH surAH | sarve shakrAdayastatra yuddhArthaM samupAgatAH
verses.translation: Siva shall always be worshipped with the five

verses.sanskrit: तान्दृष्ट्वा राक्षसास्तत्र विचारे तत्पराः पुनः । बभूवुस्तेऽखिला दुष्टा मिथो ये यत्र संस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tAndR^iShTvA rAkShasAstatra vichAre tatparAH punaH | babhUvuste.akhilA duShTA mitho ye yatra saMsthitAH
verses.translation: After offering the materials the steady water-pouring shall be made. The intelligent devotee shall consecrate the materials of worship with the steady pouring of water.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसा ऊचुः । किं कर्तव्यं क्व गन्तव्यं सङ्कटं समुपागताः । युद्ध्यते म्रियते चैव युद्ध्यते न विहन्यते
verses.transliteration: rAkShasA UchuH | kiM kartavyaM kva gantavyaM sa~NkaTaM samupAgatAH | yuddhyate mriyate chaiva yuddhyate na vihanyate
verses.translation: He shall worship Siva, both Nirguna and Saguna, by the steady pouring of water, reciting the 108 mantras.

verses.sanskrit: दारुका राक्षसी काचित्पार्वतीवरदर्पिता । दारुकश्च पतिस्तस्या बभूव बलवत्तरः
verses.transliteration: dArukA rAkShasI kAchitpArvatIvaradarpitA | dArukashcha patistasyA babhUva balavattaraH
verses.translation: He shall worship the bull-bannered deity by reciting the mantra imparted by the preceptor. Or he shall worship Sadasiva by means of Namamantras.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव स्थीयते चेद्वै भक्ष्यते किं परस्परम् । दुःखं हि सर्वथा जातं क एनं विनिवारयेत्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva sthIyate chedvai bhakShyate kiM parasparam | duHkhaM hi sarvathA jAtaM ka enaM vinivArayet
verses.translation: The worship of Siva the supreme soul shall be performed with sandal-paste, unbroken rice-grains and black gingelly seeds.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । विचार्येति च ते तत्र दारुकाद्याश्च राक्षसाः । उपायं न विजानन्तो दुःखं प्राप्ताः सदा हि वै
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | vichAryeti cha te tatra dArukAdyAshcha rAkShasAH | upAyaM na vijAnanto duHkhaM prAptAH sadA hi vai
verses.translation: Again Siva shall be worshipped with lotus and and Karavira flowers. The devotee shall offer the flowers with the eight Namamantras to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: दारुका राक्षसी चापि ज्ञात्वा दुःखं समागतम् । भवान्याश्च वरं तं च कथयामास सा तदा
verses.transliteration: dArukA rAkShasI chApi j~nAtvA duHkhaM samAgatam | bhavAnyAshcha varaM taM cha kathayAmAsa sA tadA
verses.translation: They are Bhava, Sarva, Rudra, Pasupati, Ugra, Mahat, Bhima and Hana.

verses.sanskrit: दारुकोवाच । मया ह्याराधिता पूर्वं भवपत्नी वरं ददौ । वनं गच्छ निजैः सार्धं यत्र गन्तुं त्वमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: dArukovAcha | mayA hyArAdhitA pUrvaM bhavapatnI varaM dadau | vanaM gachCha nijaiH sArdhaM yatra gantuM tvamichChasi
verses.translation: When the names are used for worship they shall be prefixed with,"Om" and then the names shall be put in the Dative case. The incense and the lamps shall be used. The food-offering shall be made thereafter.]

verses.sanskrit: तद्वरश्च मया प्राप्तः कथं दुःखं विषह्यते । जले वनं च नीत्वा वै सुखं स्थेयं तु राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration: tadvarashcha mayA prAptaH kathaM duHkhaM viShahyate | jale vanaM cha nItvA vai sukhaM stheyaM tu rAkShasaiH
verses.translation: In the first 3-hour period the intelligent devotee shall make cooked rice as food-offering. Half a cocoanut, and Tambula shall be offered afterwards.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्या हर्षमागताः । ऊचुः सर्वे मिथस्ते हि राक्षसा निर्भयास्तदा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tasyAstadvachanaM shrutvA rAkShasyA harShamAgatAH | UchuH sarve mithaste hi rAkShasA nirbhayAstadA
verses.translation: Obeisance and meditation shall follow and the mantra taught by the preceptor shall be used for Japa. Or the devotee shall propitiate Siva by means of the five-syllabled mantra.

verses.sanskrit: धन्येयं कृतकृत्येयं राज्ञ्या वै जीविताः स्वयम् । नत्वा तस्यै च तत्सर्वं कथयामासुरादरात्
verses.transliteration: dhanyeyaM kR^itakR^ityeyaM rAj~nyA vai jIvitAH svayam | natvA tasyai cha tatsarvaM kathayAmAsurAdarAt
verses.translation: The devotee shall exhibit the mystic gesture of cow and offer Tarpana with pure water. He shall then feed five Brahmins or more in accordance with his capacity.

verses.sanskrit: यदि गन्तुं भवेच्छक्तिर्गम्यतां किं विचार्यते । तत्र गत्वा जले देवि सुखं स्थास्याम नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: yadi gantuM bhavechChaktirgamyatAM kiM vichAryate | tatra gatvA jale devi sukhaM sthAsyAma nityashaH
verses.translation: Then till the end of that 3-hour period festivities shall be observed. After dedicating the fruit of the worship to the deity himself, the ritualistic dismissal shall be performed.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे लोका देवैः सार्धं समागताः । युद्धाय विविधैर्दुःखैः पीडिता राक्षसैः पुरा
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare lokA devaiH sArdhaM samAgatAH | yuddhAya vividhairduHkhaiH pIDitA rAkShasaiH purA
verses.translation: Then in the second 3-hour period Samkalpa rites shall be performed duly as before. Or the Samkalpa rite

verses.sanskrit: पीडिताश्च तदा तस्या भवान्या बलमाश्रिताः । समग्रं नगरं नीत्वा जलस्थलसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: pIDitAshcha tadA tasyA bhavAnyA balamAshritAH | samagraM nagaraM nItvA jalasthalasamanvitam
verses.translation: After performing the worship with the materials as before, the Jaladhara shall be offered. Then the devotee shall worship!§iva with gingelly seeds, barley grains and lotii«' flowers.

verses.sanskrit: बहुभी राक्षसैस्तत्र चकार कदनं सताम् । यज्ञध्वंसं च लोकानां धर्मध्वंसं तदाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: bahubhI rAkShasaistatra chakAra kadanaM satAm | yaj~nadhvaMsaM cha lokAnAM dharmadhvaMsaM tadAkarot
verses.translation: The devotee shall worship lord Siva particular!) with the leaves of the Bilva tree.

verses.sanskrit: जय जयेति देव्यास्तु स्तुतिमुच्चार्य राक्षसी । तत उड्डीयनं कृत्वा सपक्षो गिरिराड्यथा
verses.transliteration: jaya jayeti devyAstu stutimuchchArya rAkShasI | tata uDDIyanaM kR^itvA sapakSho girirADyathA
verses.translation: The Arghya shall be offered with citron fruit. The Naivedya shall consist of milk pudding. O Vinu, the repetition of the mantra shall be twice as that of the previous one.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रस्य च मध्ये सा संस्थिता निर्भया तदा । सकलैः परिवारैश्च मुमुदेति शिवानुगा
verses.transliteration: samudrasya cha madhye sA saMsthitA nirbhayA tadA | sakalaiH parivAraishcha mumudeti shivAnugA
verses.translation: Then the brahmins shall be fed sumptuously. Other rites shall be performd as before till the end of the second 3-hour period,of time.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सिन्धौ च ते स्थित्वा नगरे च विलासिनः । राक्षसाश्च सुखं प्रापुर्निर्भयाश्च विजह्रिरे
verses.transliteration: tatra sindhau cha te sthitvA nagare cha vilAsinaH | rAkShasAshcha sukhaM prApurnirbhayAshcha vijahrire
verses.translation: In the third 3-hour period the worship shall be done as before. But instead of barley, wheat grains shall be used and the flowers of the sun-plant shall be offered.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसाश्च पृथिव्यां वै नाजग्मुश्च कदाचन । मुनेः शापभयादेव बभ्रमुस्ते चले तदा
verses.transliteration: rAkShasAshcha pR^ithivyAM vai nAjagmushcha kadAchana | muneH shApabhayAdeva babhramuste chale tadA
verses.translation: The waving of light, as part of worship, shall be per¬ formed with camphor. The Arghya shall consist of the pome¬ granate. The Japa repetition shall be thrice that of the pre¬ vious.

verses.sanskrit: नौषु स्थितान् जनान्नीत्वा नगरे तत्र तांस्तदा । चिक्षिपुर्बन्धनागारे कांश्चिज्जघ्नुस्तदा हि ते
verses.transliteration: nauShu sthitAn janAnnItvA nagare tatra tAMstadA | chikShipurbandhanAgAre kAMshchijjaghnustadA hi te
verses.translation: When the fourth 3-hour period arrives the ritualistic dismissal of the previous worship shall be performed. The worship shall be performed duly with due ritualistic ges¬ tures.

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा पुनः पीडां चक्रुस्ते राक्षसास्तदा । तत्र स्थिता भवान्याश्च वरदानाच्च निर्भयाः
verses.transliteration: yathA yathA punaH pIDAM chakruste rAkShasAstadA | tatra sthitA bhavAnyAshcha varadAnAchcha nirbhayAH
verses.translation: The devotee shall worship lord Siva with black gram, green gram, Priyahgu grains or any of the seven cereals, the flowers of Sahkhi and the leaves of Bilva.

verses.sanskrit: यथा पूर्वं स्थले लोके भयं चासीन्निरन्तरम् । तथा भयं जले तेषामासीन्नित्यं मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: yathA pUrvaM sthale loke bhayaM chAsInnirantaram | tathA bhayaM jale teShAmAsInnityaM munIshvarAH
verses.translation: The Naivedya shall be offered with different sweets or cooked black gram and rice in order to propitiate Sada- Siva.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिद्राक्षसी सा च निःसृता नगराज्जले । रुद्ध्वा मार्गं स्थिता लोकपीडार्थं धरणौ च हि
verses.transliteration: kadAchidrAkShasI sA cha niHsR^itA nagarAjjale | ruddhvA mArgaM sthitA lokapIDArthaM dharaNau cha hi
verses.translation: O Vijou, Arghya shall be offered to Siva with the plantain fruit or with different types of fruits.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र नावो बहुतराः शुभाः । आगता बहुधा तत्र सर्वतो लोकसंवृताः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra nAvo bahutarAH shubhAH | AgatA bahudhA tatra sarvato lokasaMvR^itAH
verses.translation: The exclient man shall perform the mantra japa twice in number of that on the previous occasion. The intelli¬ gent devotee shall decide on the number of brahmins to be fed.

verses.sanskrit: ता नावश्च तदा दृष्ट्वा हर्षं सम्प्राप्य राक्षसाः । द्रुतं गत्वा हि तत्रस्थान्वेगात्सन्दध्रिरे खलाः
verses.transliteration: tA nAvashcha tadA dR^iShTvA harShaM samprApya rAkShasAH | drutaM gatvA hi tatrasthAnvegAtsandadhrire khalAH
verses.translation: Till day-break the devotee shall pass time in songs of prayer, musical instruments, devotional dances and other festivities along with his fellow devotees.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे सागरे तस्य वनं सर्वसमृद्धिमत् । योजनानां षोडशभिर्विस्तृतं सर्वतो दिशम्
verses.transliteration: pashchime sAgare tasya vanaM sarvasamR^iddhimat | yojanAnAM ShoDashabhirvistR^itaM sarvato disham
verses.translation: When the sun rises he shall take his bath and then worship Siva. The ablution of the deity shall be performed with devout services and adorations.

verses.sanskrit: आजग्मुर्नगरं ते च तानादाय महाबलाः । चिक्षिपुर्बन्धनागारे बद्ध्वा हि निगडैर्दृढैः
verses.transliteration: AjagmurnagaraM te cha tAnAdAya mahAbalAH | chikShipurbandhanAgAre baddhvA hi nigaDairdR^iDhaiH
verses.translation: Charitable gifts shall be offered, brahmins and ascetics shall be fed with different dishes, their number

verses.sanskrit: बद्धास्ते निगडैर्लोकाः संस्थिता बन्धनालये । अतीव दुःखमाजग्मुर्भर्त्सितास्ते मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: baddhAste nigaDairlokAH saMsthitA bandhanAlaye | atIva duHkhamAjagmurbhartsitAste muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: After making obeisance to Siva, handful of flowers shall be offered. The skilful devotee shall then pray after eulogising the lord with the mantras:—

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मध्ये च योऽधीशः स वैश्यः सुप्रियाभिधः । शिवप्रियः शुभाचारः शैवश्चासीत्सदातनः
verses.transliteration: teShAM madhye cha yo.adhIshaH sa vaishyaH supriyAbhidhaH | shivapriyaH shubhAchAraH shaivashchAsItsadAtanaH
verses.translation: "O Mrda, the storehouse of mercy, knowing that I belong to you, my very life is embedded in you and my mind is dedicated to you, please do what is proper.

verses.sanskrit: विना च शिवपूजां वै न तिष्ठति कदाचन । सर्वथा शिवधर्मा हि भस्मरुद्राक्षभूषणः
verses.transliteration: vinA cha shivapUjAM vai na tiShThati kadAchana | sarvathA shivadharmA hi bhasmarudrAkShabhUShaNaH
verses.translation: O lord of living beings, be favourable to me viewing sympathetically at the Japa and worship conducted by me with the requisite knowledge or in ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: यदि पूजा न जाता चेन्न भुनक्ति तदा तु सः । अतस्तत्रापि वैश्योऽसौ चकार शिवपूजनम्
verses.transliteration: yadi pUjA na jAtA chenna bhunakti tadA tu saH | atastatrApi vaishyo.asau chakAra shivapUjanam
verses.translation: May lord 8iva the bestower of happiness be pleased with the fruit arising out of this fast and other rites.

verses.sanskrit: कारागृहगतः सोऽपि बहूंश्चाशिक्षयत्तदा । शिवमन्त्रं च पूजां च पार्थिवीमृषिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kArAgR^ihagataH so.api bahUMshchAshikShayattadA | shivamantraM cha pUjAM cha pArthivImR^iShisattamAH
verses.translation: O lord Siva, may your worship flourish in my family always. Let me not be born in the family where you arc not a deity."

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे च तदा तत्र शिवपूजां स्वकामदाम् । चक्रिरे विधिवत्तत्र यथादृष्टं यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: te sarve cha tadA tatra shivapUjAM svakAmadAm | chakrire vidhivattatra yathAdR^iShTaM yathAshrutam
verses.translation: After offering Puspafijali and accepting the Tilakas and blessings from the brahmins, the devotee shall ritualis- tically dismiss the deity.

verses.sanskrit: केचित्तत्र स्थिता ध्याने बद्ध्वासनमनुत्तमम् । मानसीं शिवपूजां च केचिच्चक्रुर्मुदान्विताः
verses.transliteration: kechittatra sthitA dhyAne baddhvAsanamanuttamam | mAnasIM shivapUjAM cha kechichchakrurmudAnvitAH
verses.translation: This Vrata shall be performed with great devotion every month. After performing the concluding rite, the devotee shall reap the fruit with subsidiary benefits.

verses.sanskrit: तदाधीशेन तत्रैव प्रत्यक्षं शिवपूजनम् । कृतं च पार्थिवस्यैव विधानेन मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tadAdhIshena tatraiva pratyakShaM shivapUjanam | kR^itaM cha pArthivasyaiva vidhAnena munIshvarAH
verses.translation: After hearing these beneficial and wonderful words of Siva, Visnu returned to his abode. Thereafter this excellent rite became popular among the people desiring welfare of their sou

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च ये न जानन्ति विधानं स्मरणं परम् । नमः शिवाय मन्त्रेण ध्यायन्तः शङ्करं स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: anye cha ye na jAnanti vidhAnaM smaraNaM param | namaH shivAya mantreNa dhyAyantaH sha~NkaraM sthitAH
verses.translation: Please narrate the Udyapana (formal concluding) of the rite of Sivaralri as a result of which Siva himself becomes delighted.

verses.sanskrit: दारुका स्वविलासार्थं यत्र गच्छति तद्वनम् । भूम्या च तरुभिस्तत्र सर्वोपकरणैर्युतम्
verses.transliteration: dArukA svavilAsArthaM yatra gachChati tadvanam | bhUmyA cha tarubhistatra sarvopakaraNairyutam
verses.translation: O sages, may the concluding rite be heard with devotion and respect. By performing it, the Vrata certainly becomes complete.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रियो नाम यश्चासीद्वैश्यवर्यः शिवप्रियः । ध्यायँश्च मनसा तत्र चकार शिवपूजनम्
verses.transliteration: supriyo nAma yashchAsIdvaishyavaryaH shivapriyaH | dhyAya.Nshcha manasA tatra chakAra shivapUjanam
verses.translation: The auspicious Sivaratrivrata shall be performed for fourteen years. On the TrayodaSi day only one meal shall be taken and a complete fast shall be observed on the Gaturdasi day.

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तरूपी शम्भुश्च प्रत्यक्षं सर्वमाददे । सोऽपि स्वयं न जानाति गृह्यते न शिवेन वै
verses.transliteration: yathoktarUpI shambhushcha pratyakShaM sarvamAdade | so.api svayaM na jAnAti gR^ihyate na shivena vai
verses.translation: On the Sivaratri day after performing the routine, the devotee shall go to the temple of Siva and peribrm worship. He shall make the mystical diagram famous in the three worlds by the name of Gaurltilaka.**®

verses.sanskrit: एवं च क्रियमाणस्य वैश्यस्य शिवपूजनम् । व्यतीयुस्तत्र षण्मासा निर्विघ्नेन मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: evaM cha kriyamANasya vaishyasya shivapUjanam | vyatIyustatra ShaNmAsA nirvighnena munIshvarAH
verses.translation: Gauritilaka, Liftgatobhadra and Sarvatobhadra (Verses 5 and 6) are the circular diagrams of particular type depicting the positions of the deities to lie Invoked therein for oficring worsltip, propitiation, eulogy etc,

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं च यज्जातं चरितं शशिमौलिनः । तच्छृणुध्वमृषिश्रेष्ठाः सावधानेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: ataH paraM cha yajjAtaM charitaM shashimaulinaH | tachChR^iNudhvamR^iShishreShThAH sAvadhAnena chetasA
verses.translation: As in the Prajapatya rite, auspicious water-pots shall be placed wrapped in cloth, with a cocoanut above and the Daksina in.

verses.sanskrit: दारुकायै ददौ देवी तद्वनस्यावलोकनम् । प्रयाति तद्वनं सा हि पत्या सह यदृच्छया
verses.transliteration: dArukAyai dadau devI tadvanasyAvalokanam | prayAti tadvanaM sA hi patyA saha yadR^ichChayA
verses.translation: The devotee shall make an idol of Siva accoin- panied by Uma, of gold a pala in weight. According to his capacity the weight may be reduced to half of a pala. Siva shall be on the left side and Siva on the right. The devotee shall worship the idol at night.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थित्वा तदा सोऽपि सर्वेषां च भयं ददौ । दारुको राक्षसः पत्न्या तया दारुकया सह
verses.transliteration: tatra sthitvA tadA so.api sarveShAM cha bhayaM dadau | dAruko rAkShasaH patnyA tayA dArukayA saha
verses.translation: He shall keep awake during the night performing worship in the different 3-hour periods and singing songs of prayer or devoutly dancing.

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे पीडिता लोका और्वस्य शरणं ययुः । नत्वा प्रीत्या विशेषेण तमूचुर्नतमस्तकाः
verses.transliteration: te sarve pIDitA lokA aurvasya sharaNaM yayuH | natvA prItyA visheSheNa tamUchurnatamastakAH
verses.translation: After performing the worship thus in accordance with the injunctions he shall propitiate the lord. He shall worship again in the morning and perform Homa duly.

verses.sanskrit: लोका ऊचुः । महर्षे शरणं देहि नो चेद्दुष्टैश्च मारिताः । सर्वं कर्तुं समर्थोऽसि तेजसा दीप्तिमानसि
verses.transliteration: lokA UchuH | maharShe sharaNaM dehi no chedduShTaishcha mAritAH | sarvaM kartuM samartho.asi tejasA dIptimAnasi
verses.translation: He shall perform the Prajapatya rites according to his ability. With pleasure he shall feed brahmJ is and with devotion he shall make charitable gifts.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Saying "May Siva be pleased**, he shall make the gift of a cow and a calf together with the essential requisites to the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Saying "May Siva be pleased**, he shall make the gift of a cow and a calf together with the essential requisites to the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३०. त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । नागेश्वरज्योतिर्लिङ्गोद्भवमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । कदाचित्सेवकस्तस्य राक्षसस्य दुरात्मनः । तदग्रे सुन्दरं रूपं शङ्करस्य ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.30\. triMsho.adhyAyaH | nAgeshvarajyotirli~NgodbhavamAhAtmyavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | kadAchitsevakastasya rAkShasasya durAtmanaH | tadagre sundaraM rUpaM sha~Nkarasya dadarsha ha
verses.translation: He shall offer to him the waterpot and the Siva idol with all ornaments, placing them on a' bullock.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति सम्प्रार्थितः शम्भुर्विवरान्निर्गतस्तदा । भवनेनोत्तमेनाथ चतुर्द्वारयुतेन च
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti samprArthitaH shambhurvivarAnnirgatastadA | bhavanenottamenAtha chaturdvArayutena cha
verses.translation: He shall pray to lord Siva the great lord with great pleasure, with palms joined in reverence, with shoulders drooping and words choked with emotion.

verses.sanskrit: मध्य ज्योतिःस्वरूपं च शिवरूपं तदद्भुतम् । परिवारसमायुक्तं दृष्ट्वा चापूजयत्स वै
verses.transliteration: madhya jyotiHsvarUpaM cha shivarUpaM tadadbhutam | parivArasamAyuktaM dR^iShTvA chApUjayatsa vai
verses.translation: "O great lord, lord of the gods, favourably dis¬ posed to the devotees, be merciful to me, thanks to this Vrata.

verses.sanskrit: पूजितश्च तदा शम्भुः प्रसन्नो ह्यभवत्स्वयम् । अस्त्रं पाशुपतं नाम दत्त्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवान्
verses.transliteration: pUjitashcha tadA shambhuH prasanno hyabhavatsvayam | astraM pAshupataM nAma dattvA rAkShasapu~NgavAn
verses.translation: Japa and worship and other things have been performed partly in ignorance and partly with knowledge by me. May these be fruitful, O Siva, by your mercy."

verses.sanskrit: जघान सोपकरणांस्तान्सर्वान्सगणान्द्रुतम् । अरक्षच्च स्वभक्तं वै दुष्टहा स हि शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: jaghAna sopakaraNAMstAnsarvAnsagaNAndrutam | arakShachcha svabhaktaM vai duShTahA sa hi sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: After saying this the flower-offering shall be made to Siva the great soul. He shall make obeisance and pray again.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वांस्तांश्च तदा हत्वा वरं प्रादाद्वनस्य च । अत्यद्भुतकरः शम्भुः स्वलीलात्तसुविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: sarvAMstAMshcha tadA hatvA varaM prAdAdvanasya cha | atyadbhutakaraH shambhuH svalIlAttasuvigrahaH
verses.translation: O Suta, we are extremely delighted on hearing your words. Please narrate the excellent Vrata in detail.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्वने सदा वर्णधर्मा वै सम्भवन्तु च । ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां हि तथैव च
verses.transliteration: asminvane sadA varNadharmA vai sambhavantu cha | brAhmaNakShatriyavishAM shUdrANAM hi tathaiva cha
verses.translation: May this be heard, O sages. I shall narrate the ancient story of the hunter*® which destroys all sins.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्त्वत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तामसा न कदाचन । शिवधर्मप्रवक्तारः शिवधर्मप्रवर्तकाः
verses.transliteration: bhavantvatra munishreShThAstAmasA na kadAchana | shivadharmapravaktAraH shivadharmapravartakAH
verses.translation: Everyday he used to go to the forest incessantly and kill deer. There in the forest he committed thefts also in various ways.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एतस्मिन्समये सा वै राक्षसी दारुकाह्वया । देव्याः स्तुतिं चकारासौ पार्वत्या दीनमानसा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | etasminsamaye sA vai rAkShasI dArukAhvayA | devyAH stutiM chakArAsau pArvatyA dInamAnasA
verses.translation: Thr slory of the cruel hunter and his change of heart for the better is found with minor variations in details in the PadmapuiSta also.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ना च तदा देवी किं करोमीत्युवाच हि । साप्युवाच पुनस्तत्र वंशो मे रक्ष्यतां त्वया
verses.transliteration: prasannA cha tadA devI kiM karomItyuvAcha hi | sApyuvAcha punastatra vaMsho me rakShyatAM tvayA
verses.translation: Thus requested he took up his bow and started im¬ mediately for hunting deer. He roamed here and there in the forest.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षयिष्यामि ते वंशं सत्यं च कथ्यते मया । इत्युक्त्वा च शिवेनैव विग्रहं सा चकार ह
verses.transliteration: rakShayiShyAmi te vaMshaM satyaM cha kathyate mayA | ityuktvA cha shivenaiva vigrahaM sA chakAra ha
verses.translation: "What shall I do? Where shall I go? Nothing has been obtained by me. What will happen to my parents and my children at home? Then there is my wife too. What will happen to her? I must go home only with something in my hand. It is impossible to face them empty-handed."

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै निवेदितं राज्ञे राक्षसानां यथार्थकम् । सर्वं तच्चरितं तेन सकौतुकमथाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmai niveditaM rAj~ne rAkShasAnAM yathArthakam | sarvaM tachcharitaM tena sakautukamathAdbhutam
verses.translation: Thinking thus, the hunter went near a pond. He stood near the path leading to water.

verses.sanskrit: शिवोऽपि कुपितां देवीं दृष्ट्वा वरवशः प्रभुः । प्रत्युवाचेति सुप्रीत्या यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: shivo.api kupitAM devIM dR^iShTvA varavashaH prabhuH | pratyuvAcheti suprItyA yathechChasi tathA kuru
verses.translation: "Some animal is sure to come here. I shall kill it and go home with pleasure. My purpose will be served fully.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य स्वपतेः शङ्करस्य वै । सुप्रसन्ना विहस्याशु पार्वती वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasya svapateH sha~Nkarasya vai | suprasannA vihasyAshu pArvatI vAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: Thinking thus the hunter climbed up a Bilva tree, taking some water with him. He sat on its branch.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्युवाच । भवदीयं वचस्तथ्यं युगान्ते सम्भविष्यति । तावच्च तामसी सृष्टिर्भवत्विति मतं मम
verses.transliteration: pArvatyuvAcha | bhavadIyaM vachastathyaM yugAnte sambhaviShyati | tAvachcha tAmasI sR^iShTirbhavatviti mataM mama
verses.translation: With hunger and thirst oppressing him he waited and thought. "When will some animal come here? When shall I kill it?"

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा प्रलयः स्याद्वै सत्यं मे व्याहृतं शिव । प्रमाणीक्रियतां नाथ त्वदीयास्मि त्वदाश्रया
verses.transliteration: anyathA pralayaH syAdvai satyaM me vyAhR^itaM shiva | pramANIkriyatAM nAtha tvadIyAsmi tvadAshrayA
verses.translation: During the first part of the night a thirsty hind came there springing and jumping timidly.

verses.sanskrit: इयं च दारुका देवी राक्षसी शक्तिका मम । बलिष्ठा राक्षसीनां च रक्षोराज्यं प्रशास्तु च
verses.transliteration: iyaM cha dArukA devI rAkShasI shaktikA mama | baliShThA rAkShasInAM cha rakShorAjyaM prashAstu cha
verses.translation: When he did this, some water (that he had with him) got spilt and a few leaves of the Bilva tree fell down. There was a phallic idol of Siva beneath the tree. Hence this became his worship for the first part of the night. As a result of this his sin was dissolved.

verses.sanskrit: इमा राक्षसपत्न्यस्तु प्रसविष्यन्ति पुत्रकान् । ते सर्वे मिलिताश्चैव वने वासाय मे मताः
verses.transliteration: imA rAkShasapatnyastu prasaviShyanti putrakAn | te sarve militAshchaiva vane vAsAya me matAH
verses.translation: On hearing the noise, the hind became frightened. It was much distressed on seeing the hunter. It spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा पार्वत्याः स्वस्त्रियाः प्रभुः । प्रसन्नमानसो भूत्वा शङ्करो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM vachanaM shrutvA pArvatyAH svastriyAH prabhuH | prasannamAnaso bhUtvA sha~Nkaro vAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: "O hunter, what is it that you jjropose to do?

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । इति ब्रवीषि त्वं वै चेच्छृणु मद्वचनं प्रिये । स्थास्याम्यस्मिन्वने प्रीत्या भक्तानां पालनाय च
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | iti bravIShi tvaM vai chechChR^iNu madvachanaM priye | sthAsyAmyasminvane prItyA bhaktAnAM pAlanAya cha
verses.translation: "My family is starving today. I shall satisfy their hunger by killing you." On hearing these terrible words and seeing that ruthless knave, the hind thought "What shall I do? Where shall I go? Well, I shall use a trick, " thinking thus the hind spoke.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र मे वर्णधर्मस्थो दर्शनं प्रीतिसंयुतम् । करिष्यति च यो वै स चक्रवर्ती भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: atra me varNadharmastho darshanaM prItisaMyutam | kariShyati cha yo vai sa chakravartI bhaviShyati
verses.translation: But all my infant fawns are in the hermitage. I shall intrust them to the care of my sister or husband and return.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा कलिपर्याये सत्यस्यादौ नृपेश्वरः । महासेनयुतो यो वै वीरसेनेति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: anyathA kaliparyAye satyasyAdau nR^ipeshvaraH | mahAsenayuto yo vai vIraseneti vishrutaH
verses.translation: O forest-roamer, do not take my words to be lies. Undoubtedly I will come again to you.

verses.sanskrit: राजापि तत्र चागत्य राक्षसानां स दारुकः । विह्वलः सबलः शीघ्रं पर्यपृच्छच्च तं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: rAjApi tatra chAgatya rAkShasAnAM sa dArukaH | vihvalaH sabalaH shIghraM paryapR^ichChachcha taM shivam
verses.translation: The earth stays steady through truth. The ocean is steady through truth. The water flows steadily through truth. Everything is founded on truth.

verses.sanskrit: स मे भक्त्यातिविक्रान्तो दर्शनं मे करिष्यति । दर्शनं मे स कृत्वैव चक्रवर्ती भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: sa me bhaktyAtivikrAnto darshanaM me kariShyati | darshanaM me sa kR^itvaiva chakravartI bhaviShyati
verses.translation: When the hunter did not accept its proposal even after being implored thus, the bewildered and frightened hind spoke again:—

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं दम्पती तौ च कृत्वा हास्यं परस्परम् । स्थितौ तत्र स्वयं साक्षान्महोतीकारकौ द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM dampatI tau cha kR^itvA hAsyaM parasparam | sthitau tatra svayaM sAkShAnmahotIkArakau dvijAH
verses.translation: O hunter, listen. I shall explain. I take this vow. After going home if I do not return to you let me be smeared with the sin that these people have viz—A brahmin who sells the Vedas, one who docs not offer Sandhya prayers, women who transgress the commands of their husbands and do various rites, an undgrateful person, a person who is averse to fviva. a person w'ho illtreats others, who violates Virtue, a person committing breach (if trust, and a person who deceives others.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्लिङ्गस्वरूपो हि नाम्ना नागेश्वरः शिवः । नागेश्वरी शिवा देवी बभूव च सतां प्रियौ
verses.transliteration: jyotirli~NgasvarUpo hi nAmnA nAgeshvaraH shivaH | nAgeshvarI shivA devI babhUva cha satAM priyau
verses.translation: When the hind made these promises the hunter believed it and said "Go home'*.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । वीरसेनः कथं तत्र यास्यते दारुकावने । कथमर्चिष्यति शिवं त्वं तद्वद महामते
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | vIrasenaH kathaM tatra yAsyate dArukAvane | kathamarchiShyati shivaM tvaM tadvada mahAmate
verses.translation: The delighted hind drank water and wnt to its hermitage. By that time the first part of the night came to a close and the hunter did not have a wink of sleep.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । निषधे सुन्दरे देशे क्षत्रियाणां कुले च सः । महासेनसुतो वीरसेनश्चैव शिवप्रियः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | niShadhe sundare deshe kShatriyANAM kule cha saH | mahAsenasuto vIrasenashchaiva shivapriyaH
verses.translation: The sister of the hind, not able to see it and so distressed came there in search of that hind. It too was thirsty.

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवेशार्चनं कृत्वा तपः परमदुष्करम् । चकार वीरसेनो वै वर्षाणां द्वादशावधिः
verses.transliteration: pArthiveshArchanaM kR^itvA tapaH paramaduShkaram | chakAra vIraseno vai varShANAM dvAdashAvadhiH
verses.translation: On seeing the hind, the Bhilla drew the bow and was about to shoot the arrow. As before, water and Bilva leaves fell on Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो देवेशः प्रत्यक्षं प्राह शङ्करः । काष्ठस्य मत्स्यिकां कृत्वा त्रपुधातुविलेपनाम्
verses.transliteration: tataH prasanno deveshaH pratyakShaM prAha sha~NkaraH | kAShThasya matsyikAM kR^itvA trapudhAtuvilepanAm
verses.translation: Incidentally it became the worship of the second part of the night. It was pleasing to the hunter.

verses.sanskrit: विधाय योगमायां च दास्यामि वीरसेनक । तां गृहीत्वा प्रविश्यैनं नौभिः सह व्रजाधुना
verses.transliteration: vidhAya yogamAyAM cha dAsyAmi vIrasenaka | tAM gR^ihItvA pravishyainaM naubhiH saha vrajAdhunA
verses.translation: The hind asked "O forest-roamer what are you doing?" After seeing him, the hunter replied as before. On hearing it, the hind said again.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वं तत्र गत्वा च विवरे च कृते मया । प्रविश्य च तदा पूजां कृत्वा नागेश्वरस्य च
verses.transliteration: tatastvaM tatra gatvA cha vivare cha kR^ite mayA | pravishya cha tadA pUjAM kR^itvA nAgeshvarasya cha
verses.translation: "O hunter, listen. I am blessed. My life is fruitful. A service can be rendered through this evanescent body. But my fawns, young ones, are in the house. I shall entrust them to the care of my husband and come again."

verses.sanskrit: ततः पाशुपतं प्राप्य हत्वा च राक्षसीमुखान् । मयि दृष्टे तदा किञ्चिन्न्यूनं ते न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tataH pAshupataM prApya hatvA cha rAkShasImukhAn | mayi dR^iShTe tadA ki~nchinnyUnaM te na bhaviShyati
verses.translation: "I do not agree to what you say. Undoubtedly I am going to kill you." On hearing that the hind said on the oath of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: दारुक उवाच । किं ध्यायसि हि वैश्य त्वं सत्यं वद ममाग्रतः । एवं सति न मृत्युस्ते मम वाक्यं च नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: dAruka uvAcha | kiM dhyAyasi hi vaishya tvaM satyaM vada mamAgrataH | evaM sati na mR^ityuste mama vAkyaM cha nAnyathA
verses.translation: "O hunter, listen. I shall explain. If a person breaks his words he forfeits his merits. If I do not return let me be smeared with the sin that accrues to such people who forsake their legally wedded wife and cohabit with another, who transgress the Vcdic virtue and follow an imaginary and fictitious cult; who profess to be devoted to Visnu and censure Siva, who perform the K$ayaha rites of their parents on a Sunyatithi day and who add insult to injury."

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्याश्च बलं चैव सम्पूर्णं वै भविष्यति । अन्ये च म्लेच्छरूपा ये भविष्यन्ति वने शुभाः
verses.transliteration: pArvatyAshcha balaM chaiva sampUrNaM vai bhaviShyati | anye cha mlechCharUpA ye bhaviShyanti vane shubhAH
verses.translation: Implored by the hind, the hunter said to the hind, "go." It drank water and delightedly went away to its hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करस्तत्र वीरसेनं हि दुःखहा । कृत्वा कृपां च महतीं तत्रैवान्तर्दधे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA sha~Nkarastatra vIrasenaM hi duHkhahA | kR^itvA kR^ipAM cha mahatIM tatraivAntardadhe prabhuH
verses.translation: By that time the second part of the night too came to a close without a winlc of sleep to the hunter. When the third part arrived, the stag who was bewildered by the delay caused by the hind came there in search of it. The hunter saw it standing on the path leading to water.

verses.sanskrit: इति दत्तवरः सोऽपि शिवेन परमात्मना । शक्तः सर्वं तदा कर्तुं सम्बभूव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: iti dattavaraH so.api shivena paramAtmanA | shaktaH sarvaM tadA kartuM sambabhUva na saMshayaH
verses.translation: O dear, while he attempted to do this, a few Biiva leaves fell on Siva as a result of his Prarabdha.

verses.sanskrit: एवं नागेश्वरो देव उत्पन्नो ज्योतिषां पतिः । लिङ्गरूपस्त्रिलोकस्य सर्वकामप्रदः सदा
verses.transliteration: evaM nAgeshvaro deva utpanno jyotiShAM patiH | li~NgarUpastrilokasya sarvakAmapradaH sadA
verses.translation: In view of this, the worship of the third part of that night became realised due to his good fortune. Siva's merciful nature was evident in this.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्यः शृणुयान्नित्यं नागेशोद्भवमादरात् । सर्वान्कामानियाद्धीमान्महापातकनाशनान्
verses.transliteration: etadyaH shR^iNuyAnnityaM nAgeshodbhavamAdarAt | sarvAnkAmAniyAddhImAnmahApAtakanAshanAn
verses.translation: On hearing the noise the stag asked, "what are you doing?" The hunter replied "I am going to kill you for the sake of my family."

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तेनोक्तं च न जानामि तच्छ्रुत्वा कुपितः स वै । राक्षसान्प्रेरयामास हन्यतां राक्षसा अयम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tenoktaM cha na jAnAmi tachChrutvA kupitaH sa vai | rAkShasAnprerayAmAsa hanyatAM rAkShasA ayam
verses.translation: I am blessed that I am well-nourished and enough to satisfy your needs. Of a person everything is useless if his body is of no avail.

verses.sanskrit: तदुक्तास्ते तदा हन्तुं नानायुधधरा गताः । द्रुतं तं वैश्यशार्दूलं शङ्करासक्तचेतसम्
verses.transliteration: taduktAste tadA hantuM nAnAyudhadharA gatAH | drutaM taM vaishyashArdUlaM sha~NkarAsaktachetasam
verses.translation: If a person does not help others though he is capable of it, all his efficiency is vain. He will fall into hell after death.

verses.sanskrit: तानागतांस्तदा दृष्ट्वा भयवित्रस्तलोचनः । शिवं सस्मार सुप्रीत्या तन्नामानि जगौ मुहुः
verses.transliteration: tAnAgatAMstadA dR^iShTvA bhayavitrastalochanaH | shivaM sasmAra suprItyA tannAmAni jagau muhuH
verses.translation: But I must entrust my young ones to the care of their mother. I shall console them and return again."

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यपतिरुवाच । पाहि शङ्कर देवेश पाहि शम्भो शिवेति च । दुष्टादस्मात्त्रिलोकेश खलहन् भक्तवत्सल
verses.transliteration: vaishyapatiruvAcha | pAhi sha~Nkara devesha pAhi shambho shiveti cha | duShTAdasmAttrilokesha khalahan bhaktavatsala
verses.translation: O stag, every animal that came here has gone after promising in the manner that you have done nov,. They have not yet come. You too are in distress now and want to go under a false pretext. How, then, will I have my livelihood?

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्वं च भवानद्य मम देव त्वमेव हि । त्वदधीनस्त्वदीयोऽहं त्वत्प्राणः सर्वदा प्रभो
verses.transliteration: sarvasvaM cha bhavAnadya mama deva tvameva hi | tvadadhInastvadIyo.ahaM tvatprANaH sarvadA prabho
verses.translation: O hunter, listen, I shall explain. I do not utter

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: If I do not come again, let me have the sin of these activities viz:—in having sexual intercourse at dusk, in taking food on Sivaratri day, in perjury, in misap¬ propriation of Trust funds, in neglecting Sandhya prayers, in not uttering Siva's name with the mouth, in not helping despite the ability, in breaking cocoanut on Parvan days, in taking forbidden food, in taking food before worshipping Siva or without applying Bhasma.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: If I do not come again, let me have the sin of these activities viz:—in having sexual intercourse at dusk, in taking food on Sivaratri day, in perjury, in misap¬ propriation of Trust funds, in neglecting Sandhya prayers, in not uttering Siva's name with the mouth, in not helping despite the ability, in breaking cocoanut on Parvan days, in taking forbidden food, in taking food before worshipping Siva or without applying Bhasma.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३१. एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । रामेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि लिङ्गं रामेश्वराभिधम् । उत्पन्नं च यथा पूर्वमृषयः शृणुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.31\. ekatriMsho.adhyAyaH | rAmeshvaramAhAtmyavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | ataH paraM pravakShyAmi li~NgaM rAmeshvarAbhidham | utpannaM cha yathA pUrvamR^iShayaH shR^iNutAdarAt
verses.translation: On hearing these words the hunter said "Gk) and return quickly." Thus permitted by the hunter, the hunter drank water and went away.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागत्य स्वयं रामो वेलायां संस्थितो हि सः । वानरैः सेव्यमानस्तु लक्ष्मणेन शिवप्रियः
verses.transliteration: tatrAgatya svayaM rAmo velAyAM saMsthito hi saH | vAnaraiH sevyamAnastu lakShmaNena shivapriyaH
verses.translation: All these animals who had promised in good faith, met at the hermitage. Hearing the news of one another in its entirety they decided that they should go because they were bound by the promise. They consoled the fawns and became eager to go back.

verses.sanskrit: हा जानकि कुतो याता कदा चेयं मिलिष्यति । अगाधः सागरश्चैवातार्या सेना च वानरी
verses.transliteration: hA jAnaki kuto yAtA kadA cheyaM miliShyati | agAdhaH sAgarashchaivAtAryA senA cha vAnarI
verses.translation: The senior hind spoke to its mate "O stag, without you, how can the young fawns stay here? O lord, it was I who promised at the outset. So I shall go. Both of you stay here."

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसो गिरिधर्ता च महाबलपराक्रमः । लङ्काख्यो दुर्गमो दुर्ग इन्द्रजित्तनयोऽस्य वै
verses.transliteration: rAkShaso giridhartA cha mahAbalaparAkramaH | la~NkAkhyo durgamo durga indrajittanayo.asya vai
verses.translation: On hearing those words the junior hind spoke "1 am your servant. Hence I go. You shall stay here."

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं स विचार्यैव तटे स्थित्वा सलक्ष्मणः । आश्वासितो वनौकोभिरङ्गदादिपुरः सरैः
verses.transliteration: ityevaM sa vichAryaiva taTe sthitvA salakShmaNaH | AshvAsito vanaukobhira~NgadAdipuraH saraiH
verses.translation: On hearing it, the stag said—"I am going there. Both of you stay here. Infants are guarded and looked after by their mothers."

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र राघवः शैवसत्तमः । उवाच भ्रातरं प्रीत्या जलार्थी लक्ष्मणाभिधम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra rAghavaH shaivasattamaH | uvAcha bhrAtaraM prItyA jalArthI lakShmaNAbhidham
verses.translation: On hearing the words of their husband the two hinds did not consider it righteous. They lovingly told their husband, "Fie upon that life in widowhood."

verses.sanskrit: श्रीराम उवाच । भ्रातर्लक्ष्मण वीरेशाहं जलार्थी पिपासितः । तदानय द्रुतं पाथो वानरैः कैश्चिदेव हि
verses.transliteration: shrIrAma uvAcha | bhrAtarlakShmaNa vIreshAhaM jalArthI pipAsitaH | tadAnaya drutaM pAtho vAnaraiH kaishchideva hi
verses.translation: Then all of them consoled their fawns and en¬ trusted them to the care of their neighbours. They went to the place where the hunter was waiting-

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा वानरास्तत्र ह्यधावन्त दिशो दश । नीत्वा जलं च ते प्रोचुः प्रणिपत्य पुरः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tachChrutvA vAnarAstatra hyadhAvanta disho dasha | nItvA jalaM cha te prochuH praNipatya puraH sthitAH
verses.translation: The fawns too seeing all these followed them thinking. ''Let what befalls them happen to us as well."

verses.sanskrit: वानरा ऊचुः । जलं च गृह्यतां स्वामिन्नानीतं तत्त्वदाज्ञया । महोत्तमं च सुस्वादु शीतलं प्राणतर्पणम्
verses.transliteration: vAnarA UchuH | jalaM cha gR^ihyatAM svAminnAnItaM tattvadAj~nayA | mahottamaM cha susvAdu shItalaM prANatarpaNam
verses.translation: On seeing them, the delighted hunter fitted the

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । सुप्रसन्नतरो भूत्वा कृपादृष्ट्या विलोक्य तान् । तच्छ्रुत्वा रामचन्द्रोऽसौ स्वयं जग्राह तज्जलम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | suprasannataro bhUtvA kR^ipAdR^iShTyA vilokya tAn | tachChrutvA rAmachandro.asau svayaM jagrAha tajjalam
verses.translation: Tbanks to that, the worship of the fourth part of the night too became auspiciously performed. Thereafter his sins were reduced to ashes in a trice.

verses.sanskrit: स शैवस्तज्जलं नीत्वा पातुमारब्धवान्यदा । तदा च स्मरणं जातमित्थमस्य शिवेच्छया
verses.transliteration: sa shaivastajjalaM nItvA pAtumArabdhavAnyadA | tadA cha smaraNaM jAtamitthamasya shivechChayA
verses.translation: The senior hind, the junior hind and the stag said—**0 excellent hunter, make our body purposeful. Be merciful to us.**

verses.sanskrit: पुरा विष्णुः पृथिव्यां चावततार सतां प्रियः
verses.transliteration: purA viShNuH pR^ithivyAM chAvatatAra satAM priyaH
verses.translation: The deer are blessed. Though devoid of know¬ ledge, they are ready to help others by offering their own bodies.

verses.sanskrit: न कृतं दर्शनं शम्भोर्गृह्यते च जलं कथम् । स्वस्वामिनः परेशस्य सर्वानन्दप्रदस्य वै
verses.transliteration: na kR^itaM darshanaM shambhorgR^ihyate cha jalaM katham | svasvAminaH pareshasya sarvAnandapradasya vai
verses.translation: What have I achieved despite being born as a human being? I have nourished my body by torturing others.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा च जलं मुक्तं तदा रघुवरेण च । पश्चाच्च पार्थिवीं पूजां चकार रघुनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA cha jalaM muktaM tadA raghuvareNa cha | pashchAchcha pArthivIM pUjAM chakAra raghunandanaH
verses.translation: I reared my family by committing many sins every day. Alas! what will be my fate after committing all these sins?

verses.sanskrit: आवाहनादिकांश्चैव ह्युपचारान्प्रकल्प्य वै । विधिवत्षोडशं प्रीत्या देवमानर्च शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: AvAhanAdikAMshchaiva hyupachArAnprakalpya vai | vidhivatShoDashaM prItyA devamAnarcha sha~Nkaram
verses.translation: Sins have been committed by me ever since my birth. What goal shall I attain? "Fie, Fic upon my life!**

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपातैः स्तवैर्दिव्यैः शिवं सन्तोष्य यत्नतः । प्रार्थयामास सद्भक्त्या स रामः शङ्करं मुदा
verses.transliteration: praNipAtaiH stavairdivyaiH shivaM santoShya yatnataH | prArthayAmAsa sadbhaktyA sa rAmaH sha~NkaraM mudA
verses.translation: Acquiring perfect knowledge thus, he withdrew the arrow and explained—'*0 excellent deer! you are all blessed. You can safely go back.**

verses.sanskrit: श्रीराम उवाच । स्वामिन् शम्भो महादेव सर्वदा भक्तवत्सल । पाहि मां शरणापन्नं त्वद्भक्तं दीनमानसम्
verses.transliteration: shrIrAma uvAcha | svAmin shambho mahAdeva sarvadA bhaktavatsala | pAhi mAM sharaNApannaM tvadbhaktaM dInamAnasam
verses.translation: When he said this, Siva became delighted. He revealed his form that is worshipped and honoured by the good.

verses.sanskrit: एतज्जलमगाधं च वारिधेर्भवतारण । रावणाख्यो महावीरो राक्षसो बलवत्तरः
verses.transliteration: etajjalamagAdhaM cha vAridherbhavatAraNa | rAvaNAkhyo mahAvIro rAkShaso balavattaraH
verses.translation: Touching him mercifully Siva spoke lovingly to the hunter, hunter, I am delighted at this Vrata. Ask for the boon you wish to have.**

verses.sanskrit: वानराणां बलं ह्येतच्चञ्चलं युद्धसाधनम् । मम कार्यं कथं सिद्धं भविष्यति प्रियाप्तये
verses.transliteration: vAnarANAM balaM hyetachcha~nchalaM yuddhasAdhanam | mama kAryaM kathaM siddhaM bhaviShyati priyAptaye
verses.translation: On seeing 8iva*s form, the hunter became liberated in a trice. He fell at l§iva*s feet saying, 'Everything has been attained by me now.**

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्देव त्वया कार्यं साहाय्यं मम सुव्रत । साहाय्यं ते विना नाथ मम कार्यं हि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: tasmindeva tvayA kAryaM sAhAyyaM mama suvrata | sAhAyyaM te vinA nAtha mama kAryaM hi durlabham
verses.translation: 8iva, delighted in his mind, gave him the name Guha. Glancing at him mercifully he gave him a divine boon.

verses.sanskrit: त्वदीयो रावणोऽपीह दुर्जयः सर्वथाखिलैः । त्वद्दत्तवरदृप्तश्च महावीरस्त्रिलोकजित्
verses.transliteration: tvadIyo rAvaNo.apIha durjayaH sarvathAkhilaiH | tvaddattavaradR^iptashcha mahAvIrastrilokajit
verses.translation: O hunter, listen. Have your capital at Srhgavera- pura®* and enjoy divine pleasures at your will. •

verses.sanskrit: अप्यहं तव दासोऽस्मि त्वदधीनश्च सर्वथा । विचार्येति त्वया कार्यः पक्षपातः सदाशिव
verses.transliteration: apyahaM tava dAso.asmi tvadadhInashcha sarvathA | vichAryeti tvayA kAryaH pakShapAtaH sadAshiva
verses.translation: Your race will flourish without any calamity. O hunter, certainly lord Rama praised even by the gods will come to your house.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सीता हृता विप्रा रावणेनोरुमायिना । प्रापिता स्वगृहं सा हि लङ्कायां जनकात्मजा
verses.transliteration: tatra sItA hR^itA viprA rAvaNenorumAyinA | prApitA svagR^ihaM sA hi la~NkAyAM janakAtmajA
verses.translation: He will make alliance with you. Go-operating with my devotee your mind indulged in rendering service to me, you will attain salvation rare to others.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं स च सम्प्रार्थ्य नमस्कृत्य पुनः पुनः । तदा जय जयेत्युच्चैरुद्घोषैः शङ्करेति च
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM sa cha samprArthya namaskR^itya punaH punaH | tadA jaya jayetyuchchairudghoShaiH sha~Nkareti cha
verses.translation: In the meantime, having viewed §iva, the deer bowed to him and attained liberation from their birth as deer.

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुत्वा शिवं तत्र मन्त्रध्यानपरायणः । पुनः पूजां ततः कृत्वा स्वाम्यग्रे स ननर्त ह
verses.transliteration: iti stutvA shivaM tatra mantradhyAnaparAyaNaH | punaH pUjAM tataH kR^itvA svAmyagre sa nanarta ha
verses.translation: They attained divine bodies, ascended the aerial chariot and went away. Released from curse at the very sight of Siva they attained heaven.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेमविक्लिन्नहृदयो गल्लनादं यदाकरोत् । तदा च शङ्करो देवः सुप्रसन्नो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: premaviklinnahR^idayo gallanAdaM yadAkarot | tadA cha sha~Nkaro devaH suprasanno babhUva ha
verses.translation: Siva became Vyadhesvara on the Arbuda'®® mount¬ ain. Viewing and worshipping this phallic idol bestows worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: साङ्गः सपरिवारश्च ज्योतीरूपो महेश्वरः । यथोक्तरूपममलं कृत्वाविरभवद् द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sA~NgaH saparivArashcha jyotIrUpo maheshvaraH | yathoktarUpamamalaM kR^itvAvirabhavad drutam
verses.translation: From that day onwards the hunter attained godly pleasures and being favoured by the god attained Sayujya*® salvation with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सन्तुष्टहृदयो रामभक्त्या महेश्वरः । शिवमस्तु वरं ब्रूहि रामेति स तदाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tataH santuShTahR^idayo rAmabhaktyA maheshvaraH | shivamastu varaM brUhi rAmeti sa tadAbravIt
verses.translation: Even after performing this rite in utter ignorance he attained Sayujya; what about those who are endowed with devotion? They will surely attain complete identity with the lord.

verses.sanskrit: तद्रूपं च तदा दृष्टवा सर्वे पूतास्ततः स्वयम् । कृतवान् राघवः पूजां शिवधर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: tadrUpaM cha tadA dR^iShTavA sarve pUtAstataH svayam | kR^itavAn rAghavaH pUjAM shivadharmaparAyaNaH
verses.translation: After considering all Sastras, and the sacred rites enjoined by these Sivaratrivrata, has been glorified as the most excellent.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतिं च विविधां कृत्वा प्रणिपत्य शिवं मुदा । जयं च प्रार्थयामास रावणाजौ तदात्मनः
verses.transliteration: stutiM cha vividhAM kR^itvA praNipatya shivaM mudA | jayaM cha prArthayAmAsa rAvaNAjau tadAtmanaH
verses.translation: Different Vratas, various holy centres, gifts of variegated nature, diverse sacrifices, different austerities and many forms of Japas, are not equal to Sivaratrivrata.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नहृदयो रामभक्त्या महेश्वरः । जयोऽस्तु ते महाराज प्रीत्या स पुनरब्रवीत्
