verses.transliteration: tataH prasannahR^idayo rAmabhaktyA maheshvaraH | jayo.astu te mahArAja prItyA sa punarabravIt
verses.translation: Hence this auspicious Vrata shall be performed

verses.sanskrit: शिवदत्तं जयं प्राप्य ह्यनुज्ञां समवाप्य च । पुनश्च प्रार्थयामास साञ्जलिर्नतमस्तकः
verses.transliteration: shivadattaM jayaM prApya hyanuj~nAM samavApya cha | punashcha prArthayAmAsa sA~njalirnatamastakaH
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated the auspicious §ivai'atri Vrata entirely. It is famous as the chief of sacred rites. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: श्रीराम उवाच । त्वया स्थेयमिह स्वामिंल्लोकानां पावनाय च । परेषामुपकारार्थं यदि तुष्टोऽसि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: shrIrAma uvAcha | tvayA stheyamiha svAmiMllokAnAM pAvanAya cha | pareShAmupakArArthaM yadi tuShTo.asi sha~Nkara
verses.translation: O great sages, only Siva can bestow liberation. Brahma and others cannot do that. They shall be known as bestowers of virtue, wealth and love.

verses.sanskrit: अन्वेषणपरस्तस्याः किष्किन्धाख्यां पुरीमगात् । सुग्रीवहितकृद्भूत्वा वालिनं सञ्जघान ह
verses.transliteration: anveShaNaparastasyAH kiShkindhAkhyAM purImagAt | sugrIvahitakR^idbhUtvA vAlinaM sa~njaghAna ha
verses.translation: Brahma and others are dependent on the attributes. Siva is beyond the attributes. He is free from aberrations. He is the great Brahman, the fourth deity, greater than Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तस्तु शिवस्तत्र लिङ्गरूपोऽभवत्तदा । रामेश्वरश्च नाम्ना वै प्रसिद्धो जगतीतले
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktastu shivastatra li~NgarUpo.abhavattadA | rAmeshvarashcha nAmnA vai prasiddho jagatItale
verses.translation: O great sages, Siva's form is twofold: Saguna and Nirguna as explained in the Vedas. It is that from which the entire universe originates, by which it is protected and in which it merges and by whom all this has been pervaded.

verses.sanskrit: रामस्तु तत्प्रभावाद्वै सिन्धुमुत्तीर्य चाञ्जसा । रावणादीन्निहत्याशु राक्षसान्प्राप तां प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: rAmastu tatprabhAvAdvai sindhumuttIrya chA~njasA | rAvaNAdInnihatyAshu rAkShasAnprApa tAM priyAm
verses.translation: O brahmins, good people attain it when knowledge of Siva rises up or when they worship him with deep devotion.

verses.sanskrit: रामेश्वरस्य महिमाद्भुतोऽभूद्भुवि चातुलः । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदश्चैव सर्वदा भक्तकामदः
verses.transliteration: rAmeshvarasya mahimAdbhuto.abhUdbhuvi chAtulaH | bhuktimuktipradashchaiva sarvadA bhaktakAmadaH
verses.translation: Devotion to Siva, characterised by sprouting pure love, is the mother of perfect knowledge. It is easy of access by means of his benevolence. It yields worldly pleasures and salvation too.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यगङ्गाजलेनैव स्नापयिष्यति यः शिवम् । रामेश्वरं च सद्भक्त्या स जीवन्मुक्त एव हि
verses.transliteration: divyaga~NgAjalenaiva snApayiShyati yaH shivam | rAmeshvaraM cha sadbhaktyA sa jIvanmukta eva hi
verses.translation: Devotion is of various types. O brahmins, it is both Sagupa and Nirguna Whatever is legitimate and

verses.sanskrit: इह भुक्त्वाखिलान्भोगान्देवानां दुर्लभानपि । अन्ते प्राप्य परं ज्ञानं कैवल्यं प्राप्नुयाद् ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: iha bhuktvAkhilAnbhogAndevAnAM durlabhAnapi | ante prApya paraM j~nAnaM kaivalyaM prApnuyAd dhruvam
verses.translation: Learned men consider devotion to be of different sorts, such as ordained and non-ordained. Since they are of various types they are not explained in detail.

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्यातं ज्योतिर्लिगं शिवस्य तु । रामेश्वराभिधं दिव्यं शृण्वतां पापहारकम्
verses.transliteration: iti vashcha samAkhyAtaM jyotirligaM shivasya tu | rAmeshvarAbhidhaM divyaM shR^iNvatAM pApahArakam
verses.translation: Differentiated by the differences in those who observe ravana (listening) etc. both these are of nine sub¬ divisions each. Without his favour they are difficult of performance and with His favour they can easily be performed.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थित्वा कियत्कालं तदन्वेषणतत्परः । सुग्रीवाद्यैर्लक्ष्मणेन विचारं कृतवान्स वै
verses.transliteration: tatra sthitvA kiyatkAlaM tadanveShaNatatparaH | sugrIvAdyairlakShmaNena vichAraM kR^itavAnsa vai
verses.translation: O brahmins, devotion and knowledge®* are essentially non-different from each other as explained by Siva. Hence, they should not be differentiated. Happiness befalls him who observes them always.

verses.sanskrit: कपीन् सम्प्रेषयामास चतुर्दिक्षु नृपात्मजः । हनुमत्प्रमुखान् रामस्तदन्वेषणहेतवे
verses.transliteration: kapIn sampreShayAmAsa chaturdikShu nR^ipAtmajaH | hanumatpramukhAn rAmastadanveShaNahetave
verses.translation: Hence, O great sages, devotion to lord Siva shall be practised. There is no doubt in this that everything is realisable solely through devotion.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ज्ञात्वा गतां लङ्कां सीतां कपिवराननात् । सीताचूडामणिं प्राप्य मुमुदे सोऽति राघवः
verses.transliteration: atha j~nAtvA gatAM la~NkAM sItAM kapivarAnanAt | sItAchUDAmaNiM prApya mumude so.ati rAghavaH
verses.translation: Thus, what has been asked by you has been explained. There is no doubt in this that on hearing this, one is rid of his sin completely.

verses.sanskrit: सकपीशस्तदा रामो लक्ष्मणेन युतो द्विजाः । सुग्रीवप्रमुखैः पुण्यैर्वानरैर्बलवत्तरैः
verses.transliteration: sakapIshastadA rAmo lakShmaNena yuto dvijAH | sugrIvapramukhaiH puNyairvAnarairbalavattaraiH
verses.translation: Devotion and realization are separate (41.17) but not con* tradictory terms. The two paths leading to the goal of liberation are complementary, running parallel to each other.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मैरष्टादशाख्यैश्च ययौ तीरं पयोनिधेः । दक्षिणे सागरे यो वै दृश्यते लवणाकरः
verses.transliteration: padmairaShTAdashAkhyaishcha yayau tIraM payonidheH | dakShiNe sAgare yo vai dR^ishyate lavaNAkaraH
verses.translation: Masters of the Vedas and Vedanta know that which originates from the Nirguna great soul as tlfe one termed Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Visnu famous as Narayana slept there enveloped by Maya. The Prakrti is known as Narayani (belonging to Narayana.)

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Visnu famous as Narayana slept there enveloped by Maya. The Prakrti is known as Narayani (belonging to Narayana.)

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३२. द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः । सुदेहासुधर्माचरितवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । अतः परं च घुश्मेशं ज्योतिर्लिङ्गमुदाहृतम् । तस्यैव च सुमाहात्म्यं श्रूयतामृषिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.32\. dvAtriMsho.adhyAyaH | sudehAsudharmAcharitavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | ataH paraM cha ghushmeshaM jyotirli~NgamudAhR^itam | tasyaiva cha sumAhAtmyaM shrUyatAmR^iShisattamAH
verses.translation: The formless one became one with forms in order to facilitate meditation. He alone is 8iva himself, favourably disposed towards his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं मानसं धृत्वा दुःखं न कृतवान्स्तदा । सुदेहा च तदा दुःखं चकारापुत्रसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: ityevaM mAnasaM dhR^itvA duHkhaM na kR^itavAnstadA | sudehA cha tadA duHkhaM chakArAputrasambhavam
verses.translation: Their forms and activities are the same; they bestow good goal on the devotees equally; they are equally worthy of being served by all and they indulge in various divine sports.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं च स्वामिनं सा वै प्रार्थयद्यत्नसाधने । पुत्रोत्पादनहेतोश्च सर्वविद्याविशारदम्
verses.transliteration: nityaM cha svAminaM sA vai prArthayadyatnasAdhane | putrotpAdanahetoshcha sarvavidyAvishAradam
verses.translation: Rudra of terrible exploits has the form of Siva in every respect. He was born for carrying out the tasks of the devotees. He helps Visnu and Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि स्त्रियं तदाभर्त्स्य किं पुत्रश्च करिष्यति । का माता कः पिता पुत्रः को बन्धुश्च प्रियश्च कः
verses.transliteration: so.api striyaM tadAbhartsya kiM putrashcha kariShyati | kA mAtA kaH pitA putraH ko bandhushcha priyashcha kaH
verses.translation: Other beings and gods who are born get dissolved in due order but not so Rudra. Rudra gets merged in 8iva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं स्वार्थपरं देवि त्रिलोक्यां नात्र संशयः । जानीहि त्वं विशेषेण बुद्ध्या शोकं न वै कुरु
verses.transliteration: sarvaM svArthaparaM devi trilokyAM nAtra saMshayaH | jAnIhi tvaM visheSheNa buddhyA shokaM na vai kuru
verses.translation: All worship Rudra but Rudra does not worship any one. Yet due to his favourable attitude to his devotees sometimes he worships himself.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्देवि त्वया दुःखं त्यजनीयं सुनिश्चितम् । नित्यं मह्यं त्वया नैव कथनीयं शुभव्रते
verses.transliteration: tasmAddevi tvayA duHkhaM tyajanIyaM sunishchitam | nityaM mahyaM tvayA naiva kathanIyaM shubhavrate
verses.translation: Those who worship others get dissolved in them. That is why they attain Rudra in due course, O learned ones.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तां सन्निवार्यैव भगवद्धर्मतत्परः । आसीत्परमसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वदुःखं समत्यजत्
verses.transliteration: evaM tAM sannivAryaiva bhagavaddharmatatparaH | AsItparamasantuShTo dvandvaduHkhaM samatyajat
verses.translation: Tho'C who are Rudra's devotees attain the state of Siva in a trice. They need not depend on any one else. This is the eternal statement in the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिच्च सुदेहा वै गेहे च सहवासिनः । जगाम प्रियगोष्ठ्यर्थं विवादस्तत्र सङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: kadAchichcha sudehA vai gehe cha sahavAsinaH | jagAma priyagoShThyarthaM vivAdastatra sa~NgataH
verses.translation: The eternal Sruli says—"Isanah Sarvavidyanam". Hence Siva is the creator of the Vedas and the lord of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पत्नी स्त्रीस्वभावाच्च भर्त्सिता सा तया तदा । उक्ता चेति दुरुक्त्या वै सुदेहा विप्रकामिनी
verses.transliteration: tatpatnI strIsvabhAvAchcha bhartsitA sA tayA tadA | uktA cheti duruktyA vai sudehA viprakAminI
verses.translation: He has no progenitor, no sustainer and no anni¬ hilator. He himself is the cause of all Visnu and others are his creations.

verses.sanskrit: पत्न्युवाच । अपुत्रिणि कथं गर्वं कुरुषे पुत्रिणी ह्यहम् । मद्धनं भोक्ष्यते पुत्रो धनं ते कश्च भोक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: patnyuvAcha | aputriNi kathaM garvaM kuruShe putriNI hyaham | maddhanaM bhokShyate putro dhanaM te kashcha bhokShyate
verses.translation: A single seed grows into a tree and produces many seeds. Even in their multiplicity they are of one tree. MaheSvara in the form of Siva is verily like this.

verses.sanskrit: नूनं हरिष्यते राजा त्वद्धनं नात्र संशयः । धिग्धिक्त्वां ते धनं धिक्च धिक् ते मानं हि वन्ध्यके
verses.transliteration: nUnaM hariShyate rAjA tvaddhanaM nAtra saMshayaH | dhigdhiktvAM te dhanaM dhikcha dhik te mAnaM hi vandhyake
verses.translation: Please explain that knowledge with all its chara¬ cteristics realising which one attains the state of Siva. How is Siva all and how is all Siva?

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणस्यां दिशि श्रेष्ठो गिरिर्देवेति संज्ञकः । महाशोभान्वितो नित्यं राजतेऽद्भुतदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: dakShiNasyAM dishi shreShTho girirdeveti sa.nj~nakaH | mahAshobhAnvito nityaM rAjate.adbhutadarshanaH
verses.translation: On hearing these words, Suta the excellent pro¬ pounder of the Puranas remembered the lotus-like feet of Siva and spoke these words to the sages.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । भर्त्सिता ताभिरिति सा गृहमागत्य दुःखिता । स्वामिने कथयामास तदुक्तं सर्वमादरात्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | bhartsitA tAbhiriti sA gR^ihamAgatya duHkhitA | svAmine kathayAmAsa taduktaM sarvamAdarAt
verses.translation: O ye sages, may this be heard. I shall explain the perfect knowledge of Siva in the manner I have heard. It is a great secret as it is the form of the highest salvation.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणोऽपि तदा दुःखं न चकार सुबुद्धिमान् । कथितं कथ्यतामेव यद्भावि तद्भवेत्प्रिये
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNo.api tadA duHkhaM na chakAra subuddhimAn | kathitaM kathyatAmeva yadbhAvi tadbhavetpriye
verses.translation: In the assembly of Brahma, Narada, Kumara, Vyasa and Kapila they had discussed this and come to this conclusion.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं च तदा तेन ह्याश्वस्तापि पुनः पुनः । न तदा सात्यजद्दुःखं ह्याग्रहं कृतवत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: ityevaM cha tadA tena hyAshvastApi punaH punaH | na tadA sAtyajadduHkhaM hyAgrahaM kR^itavatyasau
verses.translation: It shall be known that the entire universe is wholly Siva. That Siva is in everything must be known by the learned scholar.

verses.sanskrit: सुदेहोवाच ॥ यथा तथा त्वया पुत्रः समुत्पाद्यः प्रियोऽसि मे । त्यक्षयामि ह्यन्यथाहं च देहं देहभृतां वर
verses.transliteration: sudehovAcha || yathA tathA tvayA putraH samutpAdyaH priyo.asi me | tyakShayAmi hyanyathAhaM cha dehaM dehabhR^itAM vara
verses.translation: Beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass whatever is seen as constituting the universe is Siva himself. That deity is called Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवमुक्तं तया श्रुत्वा सुधर्मा ब्राह्मणोत्तमः । शिवं सस्मार मनसा तदाग्रहनिपीडितः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evamuktaM tayA shrutvA sudharmA brAhmaNottamaH | shivaM sasmAra manasA tadAgrahanipIDitaH
verses.translation: He himself creates it and enters it but stands far

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेरग्रेऽक्षिपत्पुष्पद्वयं विप्रो ह्यतन्द्रितः । मनसा दक्षिणं पुष्पं तन्मेने पुत्रकामदम्
verses.transliteration: agneragre.akShipatpuShpadvayaM vipro hyatandritaH | manasA dakShiNaM puShpaM tanmene putrakAmadam
verses.translation: Luminary beings are reflected in water etc. They do not actually enter them. Similarly Siva too appears ente¬ ring other things.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा पणं पत्नीमुवाच ब्राह्मणः स च । अनयोर्ग्राह्यमेकं ते पुष्पं पुत्रफलाप्तये
verses.transliteration: evaM kR^itvA paNaM patnImuvAcha brAhmaNaH sa cha | anayorgrAhyamekaM te puShpaM putraphalAptaye
verses.translation: Really Siva alone, the auspicious being, manifests himself. The ignorance of the same is a defect of the mind. In fact there is no second entity.

verses.sanskrit: तया च मनसा धृत्वा पुत्रश्चैव भवेन्मम । तदा च स्वामिना यच्च धृतं पुष्पं समेतु माम्
verses.transliteration: tayA cha manasA dhR^itvA putrashchaiva bhavenmama | tadA cha svAminA yachcha dhR^itaM puShpaM sametu mAm
verses.translation: In all philosophical systems the concept of duality is evident. But the Vedantins call him eternal and non- dualistic.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा च तया तत्र नमस्कृत्य शिवं तदा । नत्वा चाग्निं पुनः प्रार्थ्य गृहीतं पुष्पमेककम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA cha tayA tatra namaskR^itya shivaM tadA | natvA chAgniM punaH prArthya gR^ihItaM puShpamekakam
verses.translation: He who cleverly tries means of realising him after resorting to the Vedantic path attains the fruit of hi.s sight.

verses.sanskrit: स्वामिना चिन्तितं यच्च तद् गृहीतं तया न हि । सुदेहया विमोहेन शिवेच्छासम्भवेन वै
verses.transliteration: svAminA chintitaM yachcha tad gR^ihItaM tayA na hi | sudehayA vimohena shivechChAsambhavena vai
verses.translation: So also, the clever devotee who makes use of the expedients of devotion etc. certainly reaches Siva. This is undoubtedly true.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव निकटे कश्चिद्भारद्वाजकुलोद्भवः । सुधर्मा नाम विप्रश्च न्यवसद् ब्रह्मवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva nikaTe kashchidbhAradvAjakulodbhavaH | sudharmA nAma viprashcha nyavasad brahmavittamaH
verses.translation: The ocean or the lump of clay or the piece of gold attains different shapes due to delimiting conditions. Siva too is so.

verses.sanskrit: तद् दृष्ट्वा पुरुषश्चैव निःश्वासं पर्यमोचयत् । स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजमुवाच निजकामिनीम्
verses.transliteration: tad dR^iShTvA puruShashchaiva niHshvAsaM paryamochayat | smR^itvA shivapadAmbhojamuvAcha nijakAminIm
verses.translation: The shooting sprout from a seed may exhibit multi¬ plicity but ultimately it becomes the seed and the shoot perishes.

verses.sanskrit: सुधर्मोवाच । निर्मितं चेश्वरेणैव कथं चैवान्यथा भवेत् । आशां त्यज प्रिये त्वं च परिचर्यां कुरु प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: sudharmovAcha | nirmitaM cheshvareNaiva kathaM chaivAnyathA bhavet | AshAM tyaja priye tvaM cha paricharyAM kuru prabhoH
verses.translation: Gold mixed with silver or other base metal de¬ preciates in value. So also is the individual soul in its associa¬ tion with the ego.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा तु स्वयं विप्र आशां परिविहाय च । धर्मकार्यरतः सोऽभूच्छङ्करध्यानतत्परः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA tu svayaM vipra AshAM parivihAya cha | dharmakAryarataH so.abhUchCha~NkaradhyAnatatparaH
verses.translation: The devotee at the outset shall go to a com¬ petent preceptor with devout and reverential feelings. He shall worship and serve him considering him Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सा सुदेहाग्रहं नैव मुमोचात्मजकाम्यया । प्रत्युवाच पतिं प्रेम्णा साञ्जलिर्नतमस्तका
verses.transliteration: sA sudehAgrahaM naiva mumochAtmajakAmyayA | pratyuvAcha patiM premNA sA~njalirnatamastakA
verses.translation: Thanks to this conception, all sins and dirts are removed from the body. When he gains knowledge his ignorance disappears.

verses.sanskrit: सुदेहोवाच । मयि पुत्रो न चास्त्वन्यां पत्नीं कुरु मदाज्ञया । तस्यां नूनं सुतश्चैव भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: sudehovAcha | mayi putro na chAstvanyAM patnIM kuru madAj~nayA | tasyAM nUnaM sutashchaiva bhaviShyati na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Freed from the ego, the individual soul attains pure intellect. Thanks to Siva's grace he attains the state of!§iva again.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तदैव प्रर्थितो वै स ब्रह्मणः शैवसत्तमः । उवाच स्वप्रियां तां च सुदेहां धर्मतत्परः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tadaiva prarthito vai sa brahmaNaH shaivasattamaH | uvAcha svapriyAM tAM cha sudehAM dharmatatparaH
verses.translation: Just as one sees one's own form in the mirror so also the pure soul sees the all-pervading Siva, certainly.

verses.sanskrit: सुधर्मोवाच । त्वदीयं च मदीयं च सर्वं दुःखं गतं ध्रुवम् । तस्मात्त्वं धर्मविघ्नं च प्रिये मा कुरु साम्प्रतम्
verses.transliteration: sudharmovAcha | tvadIyaM cha madIyaM cha sarvaM duHkhaM gataM dhruvam | tasmAttvaM dharmavighnaM cha priye mA kuru sAmpratam
verses.translation: He becomes the living liberated soul. When the body perishes he merges into Siva. The body is begot by the Prarabdha karman. The perfectly wise is considered different from it.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वारिता सा च स्वमातुः पुत्रिकां तदा । गृहमानीय भर्तारं वृणु त्वेनामिदं जगौ
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM vAritA sA cha svamAtuH putrikAM tadA | gR^ihamAnIya bhartAraM vR^iNu tvenAmidaM jagau
verses.translation: By the practice of Yoga, discrimination between the different principles is generated. Then there is a desire

verses.sanskrit: सुधर्मोवाच । इदानीं वदसि त्वं च मत्प्रियेयं ततः पुनः । पुत्रसूश्च यदा स्याद्वै तदा स्पर्धां करिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: sudharmovAcha | idAnIM vadasi tvaM cha matpriyeyaM tataH punaH | putrasUshcha yadA syAdvai tadA spardhAM kariShyasi
verses.translation: From devotion there arises love; from love, the desire to hear about the lord; from this desire, association with the good and from this association a competent preceptor is attained.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्ता तेन पतिना सा सुदेहा च तत्प्रिया । पुनः प्राह करौ बद्ध्वा सुधर्माणं पतिं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktA tena patinA sA sudehA cha tatpriyA | punaH prAha karau baddhvA sudharmANaM patiM dvijAH
verses.translation: He shall worship iSiva with unflinching and exclusive devotion. Salvation is the result. There is nothing to be doubtful about this.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रिया सुदेहा च शिवधर्मपरायणा । पतिसेवापरा नित्यं गृहकर्मविचक्षणा
verses.transliteration: tasya priyA sudehA cha shivadharmaparAyaNA | patisevAparA nityaM gR^ihakarmavichakShaNA
verses.translation: O brahmins, these words have been uttered by me after considering the statement of sages. You shall retain these strenuously in your minds.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं स्पर्धां भगिन्या वै करिष्ये द्विजसत्तम । उपयच्छस्व पुत्रार्थमिमामाज्ञापयामि च
verses.transliteration: nAhaM spardhAM bhaginyA vai kariShye dvijasattama | upayachChasva putrArthamimAmAj~nApayAmi cha
verses.translation: I have now communicated it to you. For the welfare of the world you shall establish this in the world strenuously. It is conducive to the attainment of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं प्रार्थितः सोऽपि सुधर्मा प्रियया तया । घुश्मां तां समुपायंस्त विवाहविधिना द्विजः
verses.transliteration: ityevaM prArthitaH so.api sudharmA priyayA tayA | ghushmAM tAM samupAyaMsta vivAhavidhinA dvijaH
verses.translation: O great sages; thus, what I have been asked has been narrated by me. You shall preserve this carefully. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तां परिणीयाथ प्रार्थयामास तां द्विजः । त्वदीयेयं कनिष्ठा हि सदा पोष्याऽनघे प्रिये
verses.transliteration: tatastAM pariNIyAtha prArthayAmAsa tAM dvijaH | tvadIyeyaM kaniShThA hi sadA poShyA.anaghe priye
verses.translation: On hearing this, the sages attained great bliss. After bowing to him they eulogised him again and again with words choked with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: उक्त्वैवं स च धर्मात्मा सुधर्मा शैवसत्तमः । यथायोग्यं चकाराशु धर्मसङ्ग्रहमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: uktvaivaM sa cha dharmAtmA sudharmA shaivasattamaH | yathAyogyaM chakArAshu dharmasa~NgrahamAtmanaH
verses.translation: O disciple of Vyasa, obeisance be to yi>u. You are blessed. You are the most excellent of the devotees of Siva. The highest thing, the excellent knowledge of Siva has been imparted to us.

verses.sanskrit: सा चापि मातृपुत्रीं तां सखीवत्पर्यवर्त्तत । परित्यज्य विरोधं हि पुपोषाहर्निशं प्रिया
verses.transliteration: sA chApi mAtR^iputrIM tAM sakhIvatparyavarttata | parityajya virodhaM hi pupoShAharnishaM priyA
verses.translation: Thanks to your mercy, our mental delusion has vanished. Securing the excellent knowledge of Siva from you we are satisfied. This knowledge yields salvation.

verses.sanskrit: कनिष्ठा चैव या पत्नी स्वस्रनुज्ञामवाप्य च । पार्थिवान्सा चकाराशु नित्यमेकोत्तरं शतम्
verses.transliteration: kaniShThA chaiva yA patnI svasranuj~nAmavApya cha | pArthivAnsA chakArAshu nityamekottaraM shatam
verses.translation: O brahmins, this shall not be mentioned to an atheist or an unfaithful man or a rogue. Nor shall it be mentioned to one who has no devotion to Siva or who does not wish to hear.

verses.sanskrit: विधानपूर्वकं घुश्मा सोपचारसमन्वितम् । कृत्वा तान्प्राक्षिपत्तत्र तडागे निकटस्थिते
verses.transliteration: vidhAnapUrvakaM ghushmA sopachArasamanvitam | kR^itvA tAnprAkShipattatra taDAge nikaTasthite
verses.translation: On hearing this once, all sins are reduced to ashes. A non-devotee becomes a devotee. This enhances the devotion of the devotee.

verses.sanskrit: एवं नित्यं सा चकार शिवपूजां स्वकामदाम् । विसृज्य पुनरावाह्य तत्सपर्य्याविधानतः
verses.transliteration: evaM nityaM sA chakAra shivapUjAM svakAmadAm | visR^ijya punarAvAhya tatsaparyyAvidhAnataH
verses.translation: With the expectation of the greatest benefit it shall be repeated five, times. There is no doubt. He will attain it. Vyasa has said so.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वन्त्या नित्यमेवं हि तस्याः शङ्करपूजनम् । लक्षसङ्ख्याभवत्पूर्णा सर्वकामफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: kurvantyA nityamevaM hi tasyAH sha~NkarapUjanam | lakShasa~NkhyAbhavatpUrNA sarvakAmaphalapradA
verses.translation: Ancient kings, brahmins and excellent Vaiyas have attained great Siddhis by listening to this with attention, five times.

verses.sanskrit: कृपया शङ्करस्यैव तस्याः पुत्रो व्यजायत । सुन्दरः सुभगश्चैव कल्याणगुणभाजनः
verses.transliteration: kR^ipayA sha~Nkarasyaiva tasyAH putro vyajAyata | sundaraH subhagashchaiva kalyANaguNabhAjanaH
verses.translation: Even now if a man listens to this with devotion he will attain perfect knowledge of 8iva, worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: सुधर्मा च द्विजश्रेष्ठो देवतातिथिपूजकः । वेदमार्गपरो नित्यमग्निसेवापरायणः
verses.transliteration: sudharmA cha dvijashreShTho devatAtithipUjakaH | vedamArgaparo nityamagnisevAparAyaNaH
verses.translation: On hearing his words the sages were extremely

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतः स विप्रो धर्मवित्तमः । अनासक्तः सुखं भेजे ज्ञानधर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA paramaprItaH sa vipro dharmavittamaH | anAsaktaH sukhaM bheje j~nAnadharmaparAyaNaH
verses.translation: Satisfied and cleared of their doubts they bowed to him, eulogised him, hailed him. and blessed him.

verses.sanskrit: सुदेहा तावदस्यास्तु स्पर्धामुग्रां चकार सा । प्रथमं शीतलं तस्या हृदयं ह्यसिवत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: sudehA tAvadasyAstu spardhAmugrAM chakAra sA | prathamaM shItalaM tasyA hR^idayaM hyasivatpunaH
verses.translation: Considering Suta to be the great lord Siva they worshipped him and bowed to him. With good intellect they praised him speaking to one another,

verses.sanskrit: ततः परं च यज्जातं कुत्सितं कर्म दुःखदम् । सावधानेन मनसा श्रूयतां तन्मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tataH paraM cha yajjAtaM kutsitaM karma duHkhadam | sAvadhAnena manasA shrUyatAM tanmunIshvarAH
verses.translation: Thus the fourth meritorious and pleasing compendium of Sivapuraa named Kotirudra has been narrated.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकालसन्ध्यया युक्तः सूर्यरूपसमद्युतिः । शिष्याणां पाठकश्चैव वेदशास्त्रविचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: trikAlasandhyayA yuktaH sUryarUpasamadyutiH | shiShyANAM pAThakashchaiva vedashAstravichakShaNaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: धनवांश्च परो दाता सौजन्यगुणभाजनः । शिवकर्मरतो नित्यं शैवः शैवजनप्रियः
verses.transliteration: dhanavAMshcha paro dAtA saujanyaguNabhAjanaH | shivakarmarato nityaM shaivaH shaivajanapriyaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्बहु व्यतीयाय तस्य धर्मं प्रकुर्वतः । पुत्रश्च नाभवत्तस्य ऋतुः स्यादफलः स्त्रियाः
verses.transliteration: Ayurbahu vyatIyAya tasya dharmaM prakurvataH | putrashcha nAbhavattasya R^ituH syAdaphalaH striyAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तेन दुःखं कृतं नैव वस्तुज्ञानपरेण हि । आत्मनस्तारकश्चात्मा ह्यात्मनः पावनश्च सः
verses.transliteration: tena duHkhaM kR^itaM naiva vastuj~nAnapareNa hi | AtmanastArakashchAtmA hyAtmanaH pAvanashcha saH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३३. त्रयस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । धुश्मेशज्योतिर्लिङ्गोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । पुत्रं दृष्ट्वा कनिष्ठाया ज्येष्ठा दुःखमुपागता । विरोधं सा चकाराशु न सहन्ती च तत्सुखम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.33\. trayastriMsho.adhyAyaH | dhushmeshajyotirli~NgotpattimAhAtmyavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | putraM dR^iShTvA kaniShThAyA jyeShThA duHkhamupAgatA | virodhaM sA chakArAshu na sahantI cha tatsukham
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: भर्ता प्रियां तां ज्येष्ठां च मेने नैव कनिष्ठिकाम् । तथापि सा तदा ज्येष्ठा स्वान्तर्मलवती ह्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: bhartA priyAM tAM jyeShThAM cha mene naiva kaniShThikAm | tathApi sA tadA jyeShThA svAntarmalavatI hyabhUt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्दिवसे ज्येष्ठा सा सुदेहा च दुःखिनी । हृदये सञ्चिचिन्तेति दुःखशान्तिः कथं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ekasmindivase jyeShThA sA sudehA cha duHkhinI | hR^idaye sa~nchichinteti duHkhashAntiH kathaM bhavet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुदेहोवाच । मदीयो हृदयाग्निश्च घुश्मानेत्रजलेन वै । भविष्यति ध्रुवं शान्तो नान्यथा दुःखजेन हि
verses.transliteration: sudehovAcha | madIyo hR^idayAgnishcha ghushmAnetrajalena vai | bhaviShyati dhruvaM shAnto nAnyathA duHkhajena hi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अतोऽहं मारयाम्यद्य तत्पुत्रं प्रियवादिनम् । अग्रे भावि भवेदेवं निश्चयः परमो मम
verses.transliteration: ato.ahaM mArayAmyadya tatputraM priyavAdinam | agre bhAvi bhavedevaM nishchayaH paramo mama
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । कदर्याणां विचारश्च कृत्याकृत्ये भवेन्नहि । कठोरः प्रायशो विप्राः सापत्नो भाव आत्महा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | kadaryANAM vichArashcha kR^ityAkR^itye bhavennahi | kaThoraH prAyasho viprAH sApatno bhAva AtmahA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्दिवसे ज्येष्ठा सुप्तं पुत्रं वधूयुतम् । चिच्छिदे निशि चाङ्गेषु गृहीत्वा छुरिकां च सा
verses.transliteration: ekasmindivase jyeShThA suptaM putraM vadhUyutam | chichChide nishi chA~NgeShu gR^ihItvA ChurikAM cha sA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गं खण्डयामास रात्रौ घुश्मासुतस्य सा । नीत्वा सरसि तत्रैवाक्षिपद् दृप्ता महाबला
verses.transliteration: sarvA~NgaM khaNDayAmAsa rAtrau ghushmAsutasya sA | nItvA sarasi tatraivAkShipad dR^iptA mahAbalA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र क्षिप्तानि लिङ्गानि घुश्मया नित्यमेव हि । तत्र क्षिप्त्वा समायाता सुष्वाप सुखमागता
verses.transliteration: yatra kShiptAni li~NgAni ghushmayA nityameva hi | tatra kShiptvA samAyAtA suShvApa sukhamAgatA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातश्चैव समुत्थाय घुश्मा नित्यं तथाकरोत् । सुधर्मा च स्वयं श्रेष्ठो नित्यकर्म समाचरत्
verses.transliteration: prAtashchaiva samutthAya ghushmA nityaM tathAkarot | sudharmA cha svayaM shreShTho nityakarma samAcharat
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे सा च ज्येष्ठा कार्यं गृहस्य वै । चकारानन्दसंयुक्ता सुशान्तहृदयानला
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare sA cha jyeShThA kAryaM gR^ihasya vai | chakArAnandasaMyuktA sushAntahR^idayAnalA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे पुत्रप्रसूतिं तां प्रशसंसुर्निरन्तरम् । तया तत्सह्यते न स्म शिशो रूपादिकं तथा
verses.transliteration: sarve putraprasUtiM tAM prashasaMsurnirantaram | tayA tatsahyate na sma shisho rUpAdikaM tathA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातःकाले समुत्थाय वधूः शय्यां विलोक्य सा । रुधिरार्द्रां देहखण्डैर्युक्तां दुःखमुपागता
verses.transliteration: prAtaHkAle samutthAya vadhUH shayyAM vilokya sA | rudhirArdrAM dehakhaNDairyuktAM duHkhamupAgatA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्वश्रूं निवेदयामास पुत्रस्ते च कुतो गतः । शय्या च रुधिरार्द्रा वै दृश्यन्ते देहखण्डकाः
verses.transliteration: shvashrUM nivedayAmAsa putraste cha kuto gataH | shayyA cha rudhirArdrA vai dR^ishyante dehakhaNDakAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: हा हतास्मि कृतं केन दुष्टं कर्म शुचिव्रते । इत्युच्चार्य रुरोदाति विविधं तत्प्रिया च सा
verses.transliteration: hA hatAsmi kR^itaM kena duShTaM karma shuchivrate | ityuchchArya rurodAti vividhaM tatpriyA cha sA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठा दुःखं तदापन्ना हा हतास्मि किलेति च । बहिर्दुःखं चकारासौ मनसा हर्षसंयुता
verses.transliteration: jyeShThA duHkhaM tadApannA hA hatAsmi kileti cha | bahirduHkhaM chakArAsau manasA harShasaMyutA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: घुश्मा चापि तदा तस्या वध्वा दुःखं निशम्य सा । न चचाल व्रतात्तस्मान्नित्यपार्थिवपूजनात्
verses.transliteration: ghushmA chApi tadA tasyA vadhvA duHkhaM nishamya sA | na chachAla vratAttasmAnnityapArthivapUjanAt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मनश्चैवोत्सुकं नैव जातं तस्या मनागपि । भर्तापि च तथैवासीद्यावद् व्रतविधिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: manashchaivotsukaM naiva jAtaM tasyA manAgapi | bhartApi cha tathaivAsIdyAvad vratavidhirbhavet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मध्याह्ने पूजनान्ते च दृष्ट्वा शय्यां भयावहाम् । तथापि न तदा किञ्चित्कृतं दुःखं हि घुश्मया
verses.transliteration: madhyAhne pUjanAnte cha dR^iShTvA shayyAM bhayAvahAm | tathApi na tadA ki~nchitkR^itaM duHkhaM hi ghushmayA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: येनैव चार्पितश्चायं स वै रक्षां करिष्यति । भक्तप्रियः स विख्यातः कालकालः सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: yenaiva chArpitashchAyaM sa vai rakShAM kariShyati | bhaktapriyaH sa vikhyAtaH kAlakAlaH satAM gatiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यदि नो रक्षिता शम्भुरीश्वरः प्रभुरेकलः । मालाकार इवासौ यान्युङ्क्ते तान्वियुनक्ति च
verses.transliteration: yadi no rakShitA shambhurIshvaraH prabhurekalaH | mAlAkAra ivAsau yAnyu~Nkte tAnviyunakti cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य मे चिन्तया किं स्यादिति तत्त्वं विचार्य सा । न चकार तदा दुःखं शिवे धैर्यं समागता
verses.transliteration: adya me chintayA kiM syAditi tattvaM vichArya sA | na chakAra tadA duHkhaM shive dhairyaM samAgatA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रियं तनयं तं च पित्रोः सद्गुणभाजनम् । दृष्ट्वाभवत्तदा तस्या हृदयं तप्तमग्निवत्
verses.transliteration: supriyaM tanayaM taM cha pitroH sadguNabhAjanam | dR^iShTvAbhavattadA tasyA hR^idayaM taptamagnivat
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवांश्च गृहीत्वा सा पूर्ववत्स्वस्थमानसा । शम्भोर्नामान्युच्चरन्ती जगाम सरसस्तटे
verses.transliteration: pArthivAMshcha gR^ihItvA sA pUrvavatsvasthamAnasA | shambhornAmAnyuchcharantI jagAma sarasastaTe
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्त्वा च पार्थिवांस्तत्र परावर्तत सा यदा । तदा पुत्रस्तडागस्थो दृश्यते स्म तटे तया
verses.transliteration: kShiptvA cha pArthivAMstatra parAvartata sA yadA | tadA putrastaDAgastho dR^ishyate sma taTe tayA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र उवाच । मातरेहि मिलिष्यामि मृतोऽहं जीवितोऽधुना । तव पुण्यप्रभावाद्धि कृपया शङ्करस्य वै
verses.transliteration: putra uvAcha | mAtarehi miliShyAmi mR^ito.ahaM jIvito.adhunA | tava puNyaprabhAvAddhi kR^ipayA sha~Nkarasya vai
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । जीवितं तं सुतं दृष्ट्वा घुश्मा सा तत्प्रसूर्द्विजाः । प्रहृष्टा नाभवत्तत्र दुःखिता न यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | jIvitaM taM sutaM dR^iShTvA ghushmA sA tatprasUrdvijAH | prahR^iShTA nAbhavattatra duHkhitA na yathA purA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्समये तत्र स्वाविरासीच्छिवो द्रुतम् । ज्योतीरूपो महेशश्च सन्तुष्टः प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: etasminsamaye tatra svAvirAsIchChivo drutam | jyotIrUpo maheshashcha santuShTaH pratyuvAcha ha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरं ब्रूहि दुष्टया मारितो ह्ययम् । एनां च मारयिष्यामि त्रिशूलेन वरानने
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | prasanno.asmi varaM brUhi duShTayA mArito hyayam | enAM cha mArayiShyAmi trishUlena varAnane
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । घुश्मा तदा वरं वव्रे सुप्रणम्य शिवं नता । रक्षणीया त्वया नाथ सुदेहेयं स्वसा मम
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ghushmA tadA varaM vavre supraNamya shivaM natA | rakShaNIyA tvayA nAtha sudeheyaM svasA mama
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । अपकारः कृतस्तस्यामुपकारः कथं त्वया । क्रियते हननीया च सुदेहा दुष्टकारिणी
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | apakAraH kR^itastasyAmupakAraH kathaM tvayA | kriyate hananIyA cha sudehA duShTakAriNI
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: घुश्मोवाच ॥ तव दर्शनमात्रेण पातकं नैव तिष्ठति । इदानीं त्वां च वै दृष्ट्वा तत्पापं भस्मतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: ghushmovAcha || tava darshanamAtreNa pAtakaM naiva tiShThati | idAnIM tvAM cha vai dR^iShTvA tatpApaM bhasmatAM vrajet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अपकारेषु यश्चैव ह्युपकारं करोति च । तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण पापं दूरतरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: apakAreShu yashchaiva hyupakAraM karoti cha | tasya darshanamAtreNa pApaM dUrataraM vrajet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्राः कन्यां दातुं समागताः । विवाहं तस्य तत्रैव चकार विधिवच्च सः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare viprAH kanyAM dAtuM samAgatAH | vivAhaM tasya tatraiva chakAra vidhivachcha saH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुतं मया देव भगवद्वाक्यमद्भुतम् । तस्माच्चैवं कृतं येन क्रियतां च सदाशिव
verses.transliteration: iti shrutaM mayA deva bhagavadvAkyamadbhutam | tasmAchchaivaM kR^itaM yena kriyatAM cha sadAshiva
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तस्तु तया तत्र प्रसन्नोऽत्यभवत्पुनः । महेश्वरः कृपासिन्धुः तामूचे भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktastu tayA tatra prasanno.atyabhavatpunaH | maheshvaraH kR^ipAsindhuH tAmUche bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । अन्यद्वरं ब्रूहि घुश्मे ददामि च हितं तव । त्वद्भक्त्या सुप्रसन्नोऽस्मि निर्विकारस्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | anyadvaraM brUhi ghushme dadAmi cha hitaM tava | tvadbhaktyA suprasanno.asmi nirvikArasvabhAvataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । सोवाच तद्वचः श्रुत्वा यदि देवो वरस्त्वया । लोकानां चैव रक्षार्थमत्र स्थेयं मदाख्यया
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | sovAcha tadvachaH shrutvA yadi devo varastvayA | lokAnAM chaiva rakShArthamatra stheyaM madAkhyayA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तदोवाच शिवस्तत्र सुप्रसन्नो महेश्वरः । स्थास्येऽत्र तव नाम्नाहं घुश्मेशाख्यः सुखप्रदः
verses.transliteration: tadovAcha shivastatra suprasanno maheshvaraH | sthAsye.atra tava nAmnAhaM ghushmeshAkhyaH sukhapradaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: घुश्मेशाख्यं सुप्रसिद्धं लिङ्गं मे जायतां शुभम् । इदं सरस्तु लिङ्गानामालयं जायतां सदा
verses.transliteration: ghushmeshAkhyaM suprasiddhaM li~NgaM me jAyatAM shubham | idaM sarastu li~NgAnAmAlayaM jAyatAM sadA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छिवालयं नाम प्रसिद्धं भुवनत्रये । सर्वकामप्रदं ह्येतद्दर्शनात्स्यात्सदा सरः
verses.transliteration: tasmAchChivAlayaM nAma prasiddhaM bhuvanatraye | sarvakAmapradaM hyetaddarshanAtsyAtsadA saraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तव वंशे शतं चैकं पुरुषावधि सुव्रते । ईदृशाः पुत्रकाः श्रेष्ठा भविष्यन्ति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tava vaMshe shataM chaikaM puruShAvadhi suvrate | IdR^ishAH putrakAH shreShThA bhaviShyanti na saMshayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुस्त्रीकाः सुधनाश्चैव स्वायुष्याश्च विचक्षणाः । विद्यावन्तो ह्युदाराश्च भुक्तिमुक्तिफलाप्तये
verses.transliteration: sustrIkAH sudhanAshchaiva svAyuShyAshcha vichakShaNAH | vidyAvanto hyudArAshcha bhuktimuktiphalAptaye
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शतमेकोत्तरं चैव भविष्यन्ति गुणाधिकाः । ईदृशो वंशविस्तारो भविष्यति सुशोभनः
verses.transliteration: shatamekottaraM chaiva bhaviShyanti guNAdhikAH | IdR^isho vaMshavistAro bhaviShyati sushobhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुधर्मा घुश्मया सार्धमानन्दं परं गतः । सर्वे सम्बन्धिनस्तस्यां घुश्मायां मानमादधुः
verses.transliteration: sudharmA ghushmayA sArdhamAnandaM paraM gataH | sarve sambandhinastasyAM ghushmAyAM mAnamAdadhuH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा च शिवस्तत्र लिङ्गरूपोऽभवत्तदा । घुश्मेशो नाम विख्यातः सरश्चैव शिवालयम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA cha shivastatra li~NgarUpo.abhavattadA | ghushmesho nAma vikhyAtaH sarashchaiva shivAlayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुधर्मा स च घुश्मा च सुदेहा च समागताः । प्रदक्षिणं शिवस्याशु शतमेकोत्तरं दधुः
verses.transliteration: sudharmA sa cha ghushmA cha sudehA cha samAgatAH | pradakShiNaM shivasyAshu shatamekottaraM dadhuH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पूजां कृत्वा महेशस्य मिलित्वा च परस्परम् । हित्वा चान्तर्मलं तत्र लेभिरे परमं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: pUjAM kR^itvA maheshasya militvA cha parasparam | hitvA chAntarmalaM tatra lebhire paramaM sukham
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं दृष्ट्वा सुदेहा सा जीवितं लज्जिताभवत् । तौ क्षमाप्याचरद्विप्रा निजपापापहं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: putraM dR^iShTvA sudehA sA jIvitaM lajjitAbhavat | tau kShamApyAcharadviprA nijapApApahaM vratam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: घुश्मेशाख्यमिदं लिङ्गमित्थं जातं मुनीश्वराः । तद् दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा हि सुखं संवर्धते सदा
verses.transliteration: ghushmeshAkhyamidaM li~NgamitthaM jAtaM munIshvarAH | tad dR^iShTvA pUjayitvA hi sukhaM saMvardhate sadA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्याता ज्योतिर्लिङ्गावली मया । द्वादशप्रमिता सर्वकामदा भुक्तिमुक्तिदा
verses.transliteration: iti vashcha samAkhyAtA jyotirli~NgAvalI mayA | dvAdashapramitA sarvakAmadA bhuktimuktidA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतज्ज्योतिर्लिङ्गकथां यः पठेच्छृणुयादपि । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो भुक्तिं मुक्तिं च विन्दति
verses.transliteration: etajjyotirli~NgakathAM yaH paThechChR^iNuyAdapi | muchyate sarvapApebhyo bhuktiM muktiM cha vindati
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा सा सुदेहा हि मनसि ज्वलिता तदा । अत्यन्तं दुःखमापन्ना हा हतास्मीति वादिनी
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA sA sudehA hi manasi jvalitA tadA | atyantaM duHkhamApannA hA hatAsmIti vAdinI
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुधर्मा गृहमागत्य वधूं पुत्रं विवाहितम् । उत्साहं दर्शयामास प्रियाभ्यां हर्षयन्निव
verses.transliteration: sudharmA gR^ihamAgatya vadhUM putraM vivAhitam | utsAhaM darshayAmAsa priyAbhyAM harShayanniva
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अभवद् हर्षिता घुश्मा सुदेहा दुःखमागता । न सहन्ती सुखं तच्च दुःखं कृत्वापतद्भुवि
verses.transliteration: abhavad harShitA ghushmA sudehA duHkhamAgatA | na sahantI sukhaM tachcha duHkhaM kR^itvApatadbhuvi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: घुश्मावदद्वधूपुत्रौ त्वदीयौ न मदीयकौ । वधूः पुत्रश्च तां प्रीत्या प्रसूं श्वश्रूममन्यत
verses.transliteration: ghushmAvadadvadhUputrau tvadIyau na madIyakau | vadhUH putrashcha tAM prItyA prasUM shvashrUmamanyata
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३४. चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । विष्णुसुदर्शनचक्रलाभवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य सूतस्य च मुनीश्वराः । समूचुस्तं सुप्रशस्य लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.34\. chatustriMsho.adhyAyaH | viShNusudarshanachakralAbhavarNanam | vyAsa uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasya sUtasya cha munIshvarAH | samUchustaM suprashasya lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तास्ते सुराः सर्वे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना । मत्वा दैत्यान्हतान्दुष्टान्ययुर्धाम स्वकं स्वकम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktAste surAH sarve viShNunA prabhaviShNunA | matvA daityAnhatAnduShTAnyayurdhAma svakaM svakam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरप्यमराणां तु जयार्थमभजच्छिवम् । सर्वामराणामधिपं सर्वसाक्षिणमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: viShNurapyamarANAM tu jayArthamabhajachChivam | sarvAmarANAmadhipaM sarvasAkShiNamavyayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा कैलासनिकटे तपस्तेपे हरिः स्वयम् । कृत्वा कुण्डं च संस्थाप्य जातवेदसमग्रतः
verses.transliteration: gatvA kailAsanikaTe tapastepe hariH svayam | kR^itvA kuNDaM cha saMsthApya jAtavedasamagrataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवेन विधानेन मन्त्रैर्नानाविधैरपि । स्तोत्रैश्चैवाप्यनेकैश्च गिरिशं चाभजन्मुदा
verses.transliteration: pArthivena vidhAnena mantrairnAnAvidhairapi | stotraishchaivApyanekaishcha girishaM chAbhajanmudA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कमलैः सरसो जातैर्मानसाख्यान्मुनीश्वराः । बद्ध्वा चैवासनं तत्र न चचाल हरिः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kamalaiH saraso jAtairmAnasAkhyAnmunIshvarAH | baddhvA chaivAsanaM tatra na chachAla hariH svayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादावधि चैवात्र स्थेयं वै सर्वथा मया । इत्येवं निश्चयं कृत्वा समानर्च शिवं हरिः
verses.transliteration: prasAdAvadhi chaivAtra stheyaM vai sarvathA mayA | ityevaM nishchayaM kR^itvA samAnarcha shivaM hariH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यदा नैव हरस्तुष्टो बभूव हरये द्विजाः । तदा स भगवान्विष्णुर्विचारे तत्परोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: yadA naiva harastuShTo babhUva haraye dvijAH | tadA sa bhagavAnviShNurvichAre tatparo.abhavat
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विचार्यैवं स्वमनसि सेवनं बहुधा कृतम् । तथापि न हरस्तुष्टो बभूवोतिकरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: vichAryaivaM svamanasi sevanaM bahudhA kR^itam | tathApi na harastuShTo babhUvotikaraH prabhuH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुविस्मितो विष्णुर्भक्त्या परमयान्वितः । सहस्रैर्नामभिः प्रीत्या तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tataH suvismito viShNurbhaktyA paramayAnvitaH | sahasrairnAmabhiH prItyA tuShTAva parameshvaram
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्येकं कमलं तस्मै नाममन्त्रमुदीर्य च । पूजयामास वै शम्भुं शरणागतवत्सलम्
verses.transliteration: pratyekaM kamalaM tasmai nAmamantramudIrya cha | pUjayAmAsa vai shambhuM sharaNAgatavatsalam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सर्वं विजानासि ततः पृच्छामहे वयम् । हरीश्वरस्य लिङ्गस्य महिमानं वद प्रभो
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | sUta sarvaM vijAnAsi tataH pR^ichChAmahe vayam | harIshvarasya li~Ngasya mahimAnaM vada prabho
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: परीक्षार्थं विष्णुभक्तेस्तदा वै शङ्करेण ह । कमलानां सहस्रात्तु हृतमेकं च नीरजम्
verses.transliteration: parIkShArthaM viShNubhaktestadA vai sha~NkareNa ha | kamalAnAM sahasrAttu hR^itamekaM cha nIrajam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: न ज्ञातं विष्णुना तच्च मायाकारणमद्भुतम् । न्यूनं तच्चापि संज्ञाय तदन्वेषणतत्परः
verses.transliteration: na j~nAtaM viShNunA tachcha mAyAkAraNamadbhutam | nyUnaM tachchApi sa.nj~nAya tadanveShaNatatparaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: बभ्राम सकलां पृथ्वीं तत्प्रीत्यै सुदृढव्रतः । तदप्राप्य विशुद्धात्मा नेत्रमेकमुदाहरत्
verses.transliteration: babhrAma sakalAM pR^ithvIM tatprItyai sudR^iDhavrataH | tadaprApya vishuddhAtmA netramekamudAharat
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा स प्रसन्नोऽभूच्छङ्करः सर्वदुःखहा । आविर्बभूव तत्रैव जगाद वचनं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA sa prasanno.abhUchCha~NkaraH sarvaduHkhahA | AvirbabhUva tatraiva jagAda vachanaM harim
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । प्रसन्नोऽस्मि हरे तुभ्यं वरं ब्रूहि यथेप्सितम् । मनोऽभिलषितं दद्मि नादेयं विद्यते तव
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | prasanno.asmi hare tubhyaM varaM brUhi yathepsitam | mano.abhilaShitaM dadmi nAdeyaM vidyate tava
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा शम्भुवचनं केशवः प्रीतमानसः । महाहर्षसमापन्नो ह्यब्रवीत्साञ्जलिः शिवम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tachChrutvA shambhuvachanaM keshavaH prItamAnasaH | mahAharShasamApanno hyabravItsA~njaliH shivam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । वाच्यं किं मे त्वदग्रे वै ह्यन्तर्यामी त्वमास्थितः । तथापि कथ्यते नाथ तव शासनगौरवात्
verses.transliteration: viShNuruvAcha | vAchyaM kiM me tvadagre vai hyantaryAmI tvamAsthitaH | tathApi kathyate nAtha tava shAsanagauravAt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यैश्च पीडितं विश्वं सुखं नो नः सदाशिव । दैत्यान् हन्तुं मम स्वामिन्स्वायुधं न प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: daityaishcha pIDitaM vishvaM sukhaM no naH sadAshiva | daityAn hantuM mama svAminsvAyudhaM na pravartate
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि नान्यो मे रक्षकः परः । अतोऽहं परमेशान शरणं त्वां समागतः
verses.transliteration: kiM karomi kva gachChAmi nAnyo me rakShakaH paraH | ato.ahaM parameshAna sharaNaM tvAM samAgataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा च नमस्कृत्य शिवाय परमात्मने । स्थितश्चैवाग्रतः शम्भोः स्वयं च पुरुपीडितः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA cha namaskR^itya shivAya paramAtmane | sthitashchaivAgrataH shambhoH svayaM cha purupIDitaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं सुदर्शनं प्राप्तं विष्णुनेति श्रुतं पुरा । तदाराधनतस्तात तत्कथां च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: chakraM sudarshanaM prAptaM viShNuneti shrutaM purA | tadArAdhanatastAta tatkathAM cha visheShataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचो विष्णोर्देवदेवो महेश्वरः । ददौ तस्मै स्वकं चक्रं तेजोराशिं सुदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvA vacho viShNordevadevo maheshvaraH | dadau tasmai svakaM chakraM tejorAshiM sudarshanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्राप्य भगवान्विष्णुर्दैत्यांस्तान्बलवत्तरान् । जघान तेन चक्रेण द्रुतं सर्वान्विना श्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tatprApya bhagavAnviShNurdaityAMstAnbalavattarAn | jaghAna tena chakreNa drutaM sarvAnvinA shramam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: जगत्स्वास्थ्यं परं लेभे बभूवुः सुखिनः सुराः । सुप्रीतः स्वायुधं प्राप्य हरिरासीन्महासुखी
verses.transliteration: jagatsvAsthyaM paraM lebhe babhUvuH sukhinaH surAH | suprItaH svAyudhaM prApya harirAsInmahAsukhI
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ किं तन्नामसहस्रं वै कथय त्वं हि शाङ्करम् । येन तुष्टो ददौ चक्रं हरये स महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH || kiM tannAmasahasraM vai kathaya tvaM hi shA~Nkaram | yena tuShTo dadau chakraM haraye sa maheshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तन्माहात्म्यं मम ब्रूहि शिवसंवादपूर्वकम् । कृपालुत्वं च शम्भोर्हि विष्णूपरि यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: tanmAhAtmyaM mama brUhi shivasaMvAdapUrvakam | kR^ipAlutvaM cha shambhorhi viShNUpari yathAtatham
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् । स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं सूतो वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | iti teShAM vachaH shrutvA munInAM bhAvitAtmanAm | smR^itvA shivapadAmbhojaM sUto vachanamabravIt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । श्रूयतां च ऋषिश्रेष्ठा हरीश्वरकथा शुभा । यतः सुदर्शनं लब्धं विष्णुना शङ्करात्पुरा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | shrUyatAM cha R^iShishreShThA harIshvarakathA shubhA | yataH sudarshanaM labdhaM viShNunA sha~NkarAtpurA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कस्मिंश्चित्समये दैत्याः सञ्जाता बलवत्तराः । लोकांस्ते पीडयामासुर्धर्मलोपं च चक्रिरे
verses.transliteration: kasmiMshchitsamaye daityAH sa~njAtA balavattarAH | lokAMste pIDayAmAsurdharmalopaM cha chakrire
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ते देवाः पीडिता दैत्यैर्महाबलपराक्रमैः । स्वं दुःखं कथयामासुर्विष्णुं निर्जररक्षकम्
verses.transliteration: te devAH pIDitA daityairmahAbalaparAkramaiH | svaM duHkhaM kathayAmAsurviShNuM nirjararakShakam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । कृपां कुरु प्रभो त्वं च दैत्यैः सम्पीडिता भृशम् । कुत्र यामश्च किं कुर्मः शरण्यं त्वां समाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH | kR^ipAM kuru prabho tvaM cha daityaiH sampIDitA bhR^isham | kutra yAmashcha kiM kurmaH sharaNyaM tvAM samAshritAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा देवानां दुःखितात्मनाम् । स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं विष्णुर्वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityevaM vachanaM shrutvA devAnAM duHkhitAtmanAm | smR^itvA shivapadAmbhojaM viShNurvachanamabravIt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । करिष्यामि च वः कार्यमाराध्य गिरिशं सुराः । बलिष्ठाः शत्रवो ह्येते विजेतव्याः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: viShNuruvAcha | kariShyAmi cha vaH kAryamArAdhya girishaM surAH | baliShThAH shatravo hyete vijetavyAH prayatnataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३५. पञ्चत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । शिवसहस्रनामवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । श्रूयतां भो ऋषिश्रेष्ठा येन तुष्टो महेश्वरः । तदहं कथयाम्यद्य शैवं नामसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.35\. pa~nchatriMsho.adhyAyaH | shivasahasranAmavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | shrUyatAM bho R^iShishreShThA yena tuShTo maheshvaraH | tadahaM kathayAmyadya shaivaM nAmasahasrakam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कुबेरबन्धुः श्रीकण्ठो लोकवर्णोत्तमो मृदुः । समाधिवेद्यः कोदण्डी नीलकण्ठः परश्वधी
verses.transliteration: kuberabandhuH shrIkaNTho lokavarNottamo mR^iduH | samAdhivedyaH kodaNDI nIlakaNThaH parashvadhI
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: धूर्जटिः खण्डपरशुः सकलो निष्कलोऽनघः । अकालः सकलाधारः पाण्डुराभो मृडो नटः
verses.transliteration: dhUrjaTiH khaNDaparashuH sakalo niShkalo.anaghaH | akAlaH sakalAdhAraH pANDurAbho mR^iDo naTaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णः पूरयिता पुण्यः सुकुमारः सुलोचनः । सामगेयप्रियोऽक्रूरः पुण्यकीर्तिरनामयः
verses.transliteration: pUrNaH pUrayitA puNyaH sukumAraH sulochanaH | sAmageyapriyo.akrUraH puNyakIrtiranAmayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मनोजवस्तीर्थकरो जटिलो जीवितेश्वरः । जीवितान्तकरो नित्यो वसुरेता वसुप्रदः
verses.transliteration: manojavastIrthakaro jaTilo jIviteshvaraH | jIvitAntakaro nityo vasuretA vasupradaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सद्गतिः सत्कृतिः सिद्धिः सज्जातिः खलकण्टकः । कलाधरो महाकालभूतः सत्यपरायणः
verses.transliteration: sadgatiH satkR^itiH siddhiH sajjAtiH khalakaNTakaH | kalAdharo mahAkAlabhUtaH satyaparAyaNaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: लोककल्याणकर्ता च लोकोत्तरसुखालयः । चन्द्रसञ्जीवनः शास्ता लोकगूढो महाधिपः
verses.transliteration: lokakalyANakartA cha lokottarasukhAlayaH | chandrasa~njIvanaH shAstA lokagUDho mahAdhipaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: लोकबन्धुर्लोकनाथः कृतज्ञः कीर्तिभूषणः । अनपायोऽक्षरः कान्तः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः
verses.transliteration: lokabandhurlokanAthaH kR^itaj~naH kIrtibhUShaNaH | anapAyo.akSharaH kAntaH sarvashastrabhR^itAM varaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तेजोमयो द्युतिधरो लोकानामग्रणीरणुः । शुचिस्मितः प्रसन्नात्मा दुर्जेयो दुरतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tejomayo dyutidharo lokAnAmagraNIraNuH | shuchismitaH prasannAtmA durjeyo duratikramaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्मयो जगन्नाथो निराकारो जलेश्वरः । तुम्बवीणो महाकोपो विशोकः शोकनाशनः
verses.transliteration: jyotirmayo jagannAtho nirAkAro jaleshvaraH | tumbavINo mahAkopo vishokaH shokanAshanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिलोकपस्त्रिलोकेशः सर्वशुद्धिरधोक्षजः । अव्यक्तलक्षणो देवो व्यक्ताव्यक्तो विशाम्पतिः
verses.transliteration: trilokapastrilokeshaH sarvashuddhiradhokShajaH | avyaktalakShaNo devo vyaktAvyakto vishAmpatiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: वरशीलो वरगुणः सारो मानधनो मयः । ब्रह्मा विष्णुः प्रजापालो हंसो हंसगतिर्वयः
verses.transliteration: varashIlo varaguNaH sAro mAnadhano mayaH | brahmA viShNuH prajApAlo haMso haMsagatirvayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विशालाक्षो मृगव्याधः सुरेशः सूर्यतापनः । धर्मधाम क्षमाक्षेत्रं भगवान् भगनेत्रभित्
verses.transliteration: vishAlAkSho mR^igavyAdhaH sureshaH sUryatApanaH | dharmadhAma kShamAkShetraM bhagavAn bhaganetrabhit
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: वेधा विधाता धाता च स्रष्टा हर्ता चतुर्मुखः । कैलासशिखरावासी सर्वावासी सदागतिः
verses.transliteration: vedhA vidhAtA dhAtA cha sraShTA hartA chaturmukhaH | kailAsashikharAvAsI sarvAvAsI sadAgatiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भो द्रुहिणो भूतपालोऽथ भूपतिः । सद्योगी योगविद्योगी वरदो ब्राह्मणप्रियः
verses.transliteration: hiraNyagarbho druhiNo bhUtapAlo.atha bhUpatiH | sadyogI yogavidyogI varado brAhmaNapriyaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: देवप्रियो देवनाथो देवज्ञो देवचिन्तकः । विषमाक्षो विशालाक्षो वृषदो वृषवर्धनः
verses.transliteration: devapriyo devanAtho devaj~no devachintakaH | viShamAkSho vishAlAkSho vR^iShado vR^iShavardhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो निर्मोहो निरुपद्रवः । दर्पहा दर्पदो दृप्तः सर्वर्तुपरिवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: nirmamo niraha~NkAro nirmoho nirupadravaH | darpahA darpado dR^iptaH sarvartuparivartakaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रजित् सहस्रार्चिः स्निग्धप्रकृतिदक्षिणः । भूतभव्यभवन्नाथः प्रभवो भूतिनाशनः
verses.transliteration: sahasrajit sahasrArchiH snigdhaprakR^itidakShiNaH | bhUtabhavyabhavannAthaH prabhavo bhUtinAshanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अर्थोऽनर्थो महाकोशः परकार्यैकपण्डितः । निष्कण्टकः कृतानन्दो निर्व्याजो व्याजमर्दनः
verses.transliteration: artho.anartho mahAkoshaH parakAryaikapaNDitaH | niShkaNTakaH kR^itAnando nirvyAjo vyAjamardanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्ववान्सात्त्विकः सत्यकीर्तिः स्नेहकृतागमः । अकम्पितो गुणग्राही नैकात्मा नैककर्मकृत्
verses.transliteration: sattvavAnsAttvikaH satyakIrtiH snehakR^itAgamaH | akampito guNagrAhI naikAtmA naikakarmakR^it
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रीतः सुमुखः सूक्ष्मः सुकरो दक्षिणानिलः । नन्दिस्कन्धधरो धुर्यः प्रकटः प्रीतिवर्धनः
verses.transliteration: suprItaH sumukhaH sUkShmaH sukaro dakShiNAnilaH | nandiskandhadharo dhuryaH prakaTaH prItivardhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अपराजितः सर्वसत्त्वो गोविन्दः सत्त्ववाहनः । अधृतः स्वधृतः सिद्धः पूतमूर्तिर्यशोधनः
verses.transliteration: aparAjitaH sarvasattvo govindaH sattvavAhanaH | adhR^itaH svadhR^itaH siddhaH pUtamUrtiryashodhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: वाराहशृङ्गधृक्छृङ्गी बलवानेकनायकः । श्रुतिप्रकाशः श्रुतिमानेकबन्धुरनेककृत्
verses.transliteration: vArAhashR^i~NgadhR^ikChR^i~NgI balavAnekanAyakaH | shrutiprakAshaH shrutimAnekabandhuranekakR^it
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रः पशुपतिस्तार्क्ष्यः प्रियभक्तः परन्तपः । दाता दयाकरो दक्षः कपर्दी कामशासनः
verses.transliteration: ugraH pashupatistArkShyaH priyabhaktaH parantapaH | dAtA dayAkaro dakShaH kapardI kAmashAsanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीवत्सलशिवारम्भः शान्तभद्रः समो यशः । भूशयो भूषणो भूतिर्भूतकृद् भूतभावनः
verses.transliteration: shrIvatsalashivArambhaH shAntabhadraH samo yashaH | bhUshayo bhUShaNo bhUtirbhUtakR^id bhUtabhAvanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अकम्पो भक्तिकायस्तु कालहा नीललोहितः । सत्यव्रतमहात्यागी नित्यशान्तिपरायणः
verses.transliteration: akampo bhaktikAyastu kAlahA nIlalohitaH | satyavratamahAtyAgI nityashAntiparAyaNaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: परार्थवृत्तिर्वरदो विरक्तस्तु विशारदः । शुभदः शुभकर्ता च शुभनामा शुभः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: parArthavR^ittirvarado viraktastu vishAradaH | shubhadaH shubhakartA cha shubhanAmA shubhaH svayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अनर्थितोऽगुणः साक्षी ह्यकर्ता कनकप्रभः । स्वभावभद्रो मध्यस्थः शत्रुघ्नो विघ्ननाशनः
verses.transliteration: anarthito.aguNaH sAkShI hyakartA kanakaprabhaH | svabhAvabhadro madhyasthaH shatrughno vighnanAshanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डी कवची शूली जटी मुण्डी च कुण्डली । अमृत्युः सर्वदृक्सिंहस्तेजोराशिर्महामणिः
verses.transliteration: shikhaNDI kavachI shUlI jaTI muNDI cha kuNDalI | amR^ityuH sarvadR^iksiMhastejorAshirmahAmaNiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: असङ्ख्येयोऽप्रमेयात्मा वीर्यवान् वीर्यकोविदः । वेद्यश्चैव वियोगात्मा परावरमुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: asa~Nkhyeyo.aprameyAtmA vIryavAn vIryakovidaH | vedyashchaiva viyogAtmA parAvaramunIshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अनुत्तमो दुराधर्षो मधुरप्रियदर्शनः । सुरेशः शरणं सर्वः शब्दब्रह्म सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: anuttamo durAdharSho madhurapriyadarshanaH | sureshaH sharaNaM sarvaH shabdabrahma satAM gatiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कालपक्षः कालकालः कङ्कणीकृतवासुकिः । महेष्वासो महीभर्ता निष्कलङ्को विशृङ्खलः
verses.transliteration: kAlapakShaH kAlakAlaH ka~NkaNIkR^itavAsukiH | maheShvAso mahIbhartA niShkala~Nko vishR^i~NkhalaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: द्युमणिस्तरणिर्धन्यः सिद्धिदः सिद्धिसाधनः । विश्वतः संवृतः स्तुत्यो व्यूढोरस्को महाभुजः
verses.transliteration: dyumaNistaraNirdhanyaH siddhidaH siddhisAdhanaH | vishvataH saMvR^itaH stutyo vyUDhorasko mahAbhujaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वयोनिर्निरातङ्को नरनारायणप्रियः । निर्लेपो निष्प्रपञ्चात्मा निर्व्यङ्गो व्यङ्गनाशनः
verses.transliteration: sarvayonirnirAta~Nko naranArAyaNapriyaH | nirlepo niShprapa~nchAtmA nirvya~Ngo vya~NganAshanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्मशाननिलयः सूक्ष्मः श्मशानस्थो महेश्वरः । लोककर्ता मृगपतिर्महाकर्ता महौषधिः
verses.transliteration: shmashAnanilayaH sUkShmaH shmashAnastho maheshvaraH | lokakartA mR^igapatirmahAkartA mahauShadhiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: स्तव्यः स्तवप्रियः स्तोता व्यासमूर्तिर्निरङ्कुशः । निरवद्यमयोपायो विद्याराशी रसप्रियः
verses.transliteration: stavyaH stavapriyaH stotA vyAsamUrtirnira~NkushaH | niravadyamayopAyo vidyArAshI rasapriyaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रशान्तबुद्धिरक्षुण्णः सङ्ग्रही नित्यसुन्दरः । वैयाघ्रधुर्यो धात्रीशः शाकल्यः शर्वरीपतिः
verses.transliteration: prashAntabuddhirakShuNNaH sa~NgrahI nityasundaraH | vaiyAghradhuryo dhAtrIshaH shAkalyaH sharvarIpatiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: परमार्थगुरुर्दत्तः सूरिराश्रितवत्सलः । सोमो रसज्ञो रसदः सर्वसत्त्वावलम्बनः
verses.transliteration: paramArthagururdattaH sUrirAshritavatsalaH | somo rasaj~no rasadaH sarvasattvAvalambanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एवं नाम्नां सहस्रेण तुष्टाव हि हरं हरिः । प्रार्थयामास शम्भुं वै पूजयामास पङ्कजैः
verses.transliteration: evaM nAmnAM sahasreNa tuShTAva hi haraM hariH | prArthayAmAsa shambhuM vai pUjayAmAsa pa~NkajaiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स कौतुकी शम्भुश्चकार चरितं द्विजाः । महद्भुतं सुखकरं तदेव शृणुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa kautukI shambhushchakAra charitaM dvijAH | mahadbhutaM sukhakaraM tadeva shR^iNutAdarAt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरो गोपतिर्गोप्ता ज्ञानगम्यः पुरातनः । नीतिः सुनीतिः शुद्धात्मा सोमः सोमरतः सुखी
verses.transliteration: uttaro gopatirgoptA j~nAnagamyaH purAtanaH | nItiH sunItiH shuddhAtmA somaH somarataH sukhI
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सोमपोऽमृतपः सौम्यो महातेजा महाद्युतिः । तेजोमयोऽमृतमयोऽन्नमयश्च सुधापतिः
verses.transliteration: somapo.amR^itapaH saumyo mahAtejA mahAdyutiH | tejomayo.amR^itamayo.annamayashcha sudhApatiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अजातशत्रुरालोकः सम्भाव्यो हव्यवाहनः । लोककरो वेदकरः सूत्रकारः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: ajAtashatrurAlokaH sambhAvyo havyavAhanaH | lokakaro vedakaraH sUtrakAraH sanAtanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: महर्षिकपिलाचार्यो विश्वदीप्तिस्त्रिलोचनः । पिनाकपाणिर्भूदेवः स्वस्तिदः स्वस्तिकृत्सुधीः
verses.transliteration: maharShikapilAchAryo vishvadIptistrilochanaH | pinAkapANirbhUdevaH svastidaH svastikR^itsudhIH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: धातृधामा धामकरः सर्वगः सर्वगोचरः । ब्रह्मसृग्विश्वसृक्सर्गः कर्णिकारप्रियः कविः
verses.transliteration: dhAtR^idhAmA dhAmakaraH sarvagaH sarvagocharaH | brahmasR^igvishvasR^iksargaH karNikArapriyaH kaviH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शाखो विशाखो गोशाखः शिवो भिषगनुत्तमः । गङ्गाप्लवोदको भव्यः पुष्कलः स्थपतिः स्थिरः
verses.transliteration: shAkho vishAkho goshAkhaH shivo bhiShaganuttamaH | ga~NgAplavodako bhavyaH puShkalaH sthapatiH sthiraH
