verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीविष्णुरुवाच । शिवो हरो मृडो रुद्रः पुष्करः पुष्पलोचनः । अर्थिगम्यः सदाचारः शर्वः शम्भुर्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: shrIviShNuruvAcha | shivo haro mR^iDo rudraH puShkaraH puShpalochanaH | arthigamyaH sadAchAraH sharvaH shambhurmaheshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विजितात्मा विधेयात्मा भूतवाहनसारथिः । सगणो गणकायश्च सुकीर्तिशिछन्नसंशयः
verses.transliteration: vijitAtmA vidheyAtmA bhUtavAhanasArathiH | sagaNo gaNakAyashcha sukIrtishiChannasaMshayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कामदेवः कामपालो भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहः । भस्मप्रियो भस्मशायी कामी कान्तः कृतागमः
verses.transliteration: kAmadevaH kAmapAlo bhasmoddhUlitavigrahaH | bhasmapriyo bhasmashAyI kAmI kAntaH kR^itAgamaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: समावर्तोऽनिवृत्तात्मा धर्मपुञ्जः सदाशिवः । अकल्मषश्चतुर्बाहुर्दुरावासो दुरासदः
verses.transliteration: samAvarto.anivR^ittAtmA dharmapu~njaH sadAshivaH | akalmaShashchaturbAhurdurAvAso durAsadaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभो दुर्गमो दुर्गः सर्वायुधविशारदः । अध्यात्मयोगनिलयः सुतन्तुस्तन्तुवर्धनः
verses.transliteration: durlabho durgamo durgaH sarvAyudhavishAradaH | adhyAtmayoganilayaH sutantustantuvardhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शुभाङ्गो लोकसारङ्गो जगदीशो जनार्दनः । भस्मशुद्धिकरो मेरुरोजस्वी शुद्धविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: shubhA~Ngo lokasAra~Ngo jagadIsho janArdanaH | bhasmashuddhikaro merurojasvI shuddhavigrahaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: असाध्यः साधुसाध्यश्च भृत्यमर्कटरूपधृक् । हिरण्यरेताः पौराणो रिपुजीवहरो बली
verses.transliteration: asAdhyaH sAdhusAdhyashcha bhR^ityamarkaTarUpadhR^ik | hiraNyaretAH paurANo ripujIvaharo balI
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: महाह्रदो महागर्तः सिद्धवृन्दारवन्दितः । व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरो व्याली महाभूतो महानिधिः
verses.transliteration: mahAhrado mahAgartaH siddhavR^indAravanditaH | vyAghracharmAmbaro vyAlI mahAbhUto mahAnidhiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अमृताशोऽमृतवपुः पाञ्चजन्यः प्रभञ्जनः । पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वस्थः पारिजातः परावरः
verses.transliteration: amR^itAsho.amR^itavapuH pA~nchajanyaH prabha~njanaH | pa~nchaviMshatitattvasthaH pArijAtaH parAvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुलभः सुव्रतः शूरो ब्रह्मवेदनिधिर्निधिः । वर्णाश्रमगुरुर्वर्णी शत्रुजिच्छत्रुतापनः
verses.transliteration: sulabhaH suvrataH shUro brahmavedanidhirnidhiH | varNAshramagururvarNI shatrujichChatrutApanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमः क्षपणः क्षामो ज्ञानवानचलेश्वरः । प्रमाणभूतो दुर्ज्ञेयः सुपर्णो वायुवाहनः
verses.transliteration: AshramaH kShapaNaH kShAmo j~nAnavAnachaleshvaraH | pramANabhUto durj~neyaH suparNo vAyuvAhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रापीडश्चन्द्रमौलिर्विश्वं विश्वम्भरेश्वरः । वेदान्तसारसन्दोहः कपाली नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: chandrApIDashchandramaulirvishvaM vishvambhareshvaraH | vedAntasArasandohaH kapAlI nIlalohitaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: धनुर्धरो धनुर्वेदो गुणराशिर्गुणाकरः । सत्यः सत्यपरोऽदीनो धर्माङ्गो धर्मसाधनः
verses.transliteration: dhanurdharo dhanurvedo guNarAshirguNAkaraH | satyaH satyaparo.adIno dharmA~Ngo dharmasAdhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तदृष्टिरानन्दो दण्डो दमयिता दमः । अभिवाद्यो महामायो विश्वकर्मविशारदः
verses.transliteration: anantadR^iShTirAnando daNDo damayitA damaH | abhivAdyo mahAmAyo vishvakarmavishAradaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: वीतरागो विनीतात्मा तपस्वी भूतभावनः । उन्मत्तवेषः प्रच्छन्नो जितकामोऽजितप्रियः
verses.transliteration: vItarAgo vinItAtmA tapasvI bhUtabhAvanaH | unmattaveShaH prachChanno jitakAmo.ajitapriyaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कल्याणप्रकृतिः कल्पः सर्वलोकप्रजापतिः । तरस्वी तारको धीमान् प्रधानः प्रभुरव्ययः
verses.transliteration: kalyANaprakR^itiH kalpaH sarvalokaprajApatiH | tarasvI tArako dhImAn pradhAnaH prabhuravyayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: लोकपालोऽन्तर्हितात्मा कल्पादिः कमलेक्षणः । वेदशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञोऽनियमो नियताश्रयः
verses.transliteration: lokapAlo.antarhitAtmA kalpAdiH kamalekShaNaH | vedashAstrArthatattvaj~no.aniyamo niyatAshrayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रः सूर्यः शनिः केतुर्वराङ्गो विद्रुमच्छविः । भक्तिवश्यः परब्रह्म मृगबाणार्पणोऽनघः
verses.transliteration: chandraH sUryaH shaniH keturvarA~Ngo vidrumachChaviH | bhaktivashyaH parabrahma mR^igabANArpaNo.anaghaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अद्रिरद्र्यालयः कान्तः परमात्मा जगद्गुरुः । सर्वकर्मालयस्तुष्टो मङ्गल्यो मङ्गलावृतः
verses.transliteration: adriradryAlayaH kAntaH paramAtmA jagadguruH | sarvakarmAlayastuShTo ma~Ngalyo ma~NgalAvR^itaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: महातपा दीर्घतपाः स्थविष्ठः स्थविरो ध्रुवः । अहः संवत्सरो व्याप्तिः प्रमाणं परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: mahAtapA dIrghatapAH sthaviShThaH sthaviro dhruvaH | ahaH saMvatsaro vyAptiH pramANaM paramaM tapaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरकरो मन्त्रप्रत्ययः सर्वदर्शनः । अजः सर्वेश्वरः सिद्धो महारेता महाबलः
verses.transliteration: saMvatsarakaro mantrapratyayaH sarvadarshanaH | ajaH sarveshvaraH siddho mahAretA mahAbalaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: योगी योग्यो महातेजाः सिद्धिः सर्वादिरग्रहः । वसुर्वसुमनाः सत्यः सर्वपापहरो हरः
verses.transliteration: yogI yogyo mahAtejAH siddhiH sarvAdiragrahaH | vasurvasumanAH satyaH sarvapApaharo haraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानाधारोऽपरिच्छेद्यो गौरीभर्ता गणेश्वरः । अष्टमूर्तिर्विश्वमूर्तिस्त्रिवर्गस्वर्गसाधनः
verses.transliteration: dhyAnAdhAro.aparichChedyo gaurIbhartA gaNeshvaraH | aShTamUrtirvishvamUrtistrivargasvargasAdhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुकीर्तिशोभनः श्रीमान् वेदाङ्गो वेदविन्मुनिः । भ्राजिष्णुर्भोजनं भोक्ता लोकनाथो दुराधरः
verses.transliteration: sukIrtishobhanaH shrImAn vedA~Ngo vedavinmuniH | bhrAjiShNurbhojanaM bhoktA lokanAtho durAdharaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतः शाश्वतः शान्तो बाणहस्तः प्रतापवान् । कमण्डलुधरो धन्वी अवाङ्मनसगोचरः
verses.transliteration: amR^itaH shAshvataH shAnto bANahastaH pratApavAn | kamaNDaludharo dhanvI avA~NmanasagocharaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अतीन्द्रियो महामायः सर्वावासश्चतुष्पथः । कालयोगी महानादो महोत्साहो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: atIndriyo mahAmAyaH sarvAvAsashchatuShpathaH | kAlayogI mahAnAdo mahotsAho mahAbalaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: महाबुद्धिर्महावीर्यो भूतचारी पुरन्दरः । निशाचरः प्रेतचारी महाशक्तिर्महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: mahAbuddhirmahAvIryo bhUtachArI purandaraH | nishAcharaH pretachArI mahAshaktirmahAdyutiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अनिर्देश्यवपुः श्रीमान् सर्वाचार्यो मनोगतिः । बहुश्रुतोऽमहामायो नियतात्मा ध्रुवोऽध्रुवः
verses.transliteration: anirdeshyavapuH shrImAn sarvAchAryo manogatiH | bahushruto.amahAmAyo niyatAtmA dhruvo.adhruvaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ओजस्तेजोद्युतिधरो जनकः सर्वशासनः । नृत्यप्रियो नित्यनृत्यः प्रकाशात्मा प्रकाशकः
verses.transliteration: ojastejodyutidharo janakaH sarvashAsanaH | nR^ityapriyo nityanR^ityaH prakAshAtmA prakAshakaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: स्पष्टाक्षरो बुधो मन्त्रः समानः सारसम्प्लवः । युगादिकृद्युगावर्तो गम्भीरो वृषवाहनः
verses.transliteration: spaShTAkSharo budho mantraH samAnaH sArasamplavaH | yugAdikR^idyugAvarto gambhIro vR^iShavAhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इष्टोऽविशिष्टः शिष्टेष्टः सुलभः सारशोधनः । तीर्थरूपस्तीर्थनामा तीर्थदृश्यस्तु तीर्थदः
verses.transliteration: iShTo.avishiShTaH shiShTeShTaH sulabhaH sArashodhanaH | tIrtharUpastIrthanAmA tIrthadR^ishyastu tIrthadaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अपान्निधिरधिष्ठानं दुर्जयो जयकालवित् । प्रतिष्ठितः प्रमाणज्ञो हिरण्यकवचो हरिः
verses.transliteration: apAnnidhiradhiShThAnaM durjayo jayakAlavit | pratiShThitaH pramANaj~no hiraNyakavacho hariH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विमोचनः सुरगणो विद्येशो बिन्दुसंश्रयः । बालरूपोऽबलोन्मत्तोऽविकर्ता गहनो गुहः
verses.transliteration: vimochanaH suragaNo vidyesho bindusaMshrayaH | bAlarUpo.abalonmatto.avikartA gahano guhaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानगम्यो दृढप्रज्ञो देवदेवस्त्रिलोचनः । वामदेवो महादेवः पटुः परिवृढो दृढः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnagamyo dR^iDhapraj~no devadevastrilochanaH | vAmadevo mahAdevaH paTuH parivR^iDho dR^iDhaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: करणं कारणं कर्ता सर्वबन्धविमोचनः । व्यवसायो व्यवस्थानः स्थानदो जगदादिजः
verses.transliteration: karaNaM kAraNaM kartA sarvabandhavimochanaH | vyavasAyo vyavasthAnaH sthAnado jagadAdijaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुदो ललितोऽभेदो भावात्मात्मनि संस्थितः । वीरेश्वरो वीरभद्रो वीरासनविधिर्विराट्
verses.transliteration: gurudo lalito.abhedo bhAvAtmAtmani saMsthitaH | vIreshvaro vIrabhadro vIrAsanavidhirvirAT
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: वीरचूडामणिर्वेत्ता चिदानन्दो नदीधरः । आज्ञाधारस्त्रिशूली च शिपिविष्टः शिवालयः
verses.transliteration: vIrachUDAmaNirvettA chidAnando nadIdharaH | Aj~nAdhArastrishUlI cha shipiviShTaH shivAlayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: बालखिल्यो महाचापस्तिग्मांशुर्बधिरः खगः । अभिरामः सुशरणः सुब्रह्मण्यः सुधापतिः
verses.transliteration: bAlakhilyo mahAchApastigmAMshurbadhiraH khagaH | abhirAmaH susharaNaH subrahmaNyaH sudhApatiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मघवान्कौशिको गोमान्विरामः सर्वसाधनः । ललाटाक्षो विश्वदेहः सारः संसारचक्रभृत्
verses.transliteration: maghavAnkaushiko gomAnvirAmaH sarvasAdhanaH | lalATAkSho vishvadehaH sAraH saMsArachakrabhR^it
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अमोघदण्डो मध्यस्थो हिरण्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसी । परमार्थः परो मायी शम्बरो व्याघ्रलोचनः
verses.transliteration: amoghadaNDo madhyastho hiraNyo brahmavarchasI | paramArthaH paro mAyI shambaro vyAghralochanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: रुचिर्विरञ्चिः स्वर्बन्धुर्वाचस्पतिरहर्पतिः । रविर्विरोचनः स्कन्दः शास्ता वैवस्वतो यमः
verses.transliteration: ruchirvira~nchiH svarbandhurvAchaspatiraharpatiH | ravirvirochanaH skandaH shAstA vaivasvato yamaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: युक्तिरुन्नतकीर्तिश्च सानुरागः परञ्जयः । कैलासाधिपतिः कान्तः सविता रविलोचनः
verses.transliteration: yuktirunnatakIrtishcha sAnurAgaH para~njayaH | kailAsAdhipatiH kAntaH savitA ravilochanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विद्वत्तमो वीतभयो विश्वभर्त्तानिवारितः । नित्यो नियतकल्याणः पुण्यश्रवणकीर्तनः
verses.transliteration: vidvattamo vItabhayo vishvabharttAnivAritaH | nityo niyatakalyANaH puNyashravaNakIrtanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: दूरश्रवा विश्वसहो ध्येयो दुःस्वप्ननाशनः । उत्तारणो दुष्कृतिहा विज्ञेयो दुःसहोऽभवः
verses.transliteration: dUrashravA vishvasaho dhyeyo duHsvapnanAshanaH | uttAraNo duShkR^itihA vij~neyo duHsaho.abhavaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपो विरूपाक्षो वागीशः शुचिसत्तमः । सर्वप्रमाणसंवादी वृषाङ्को वृषवाहनः
verses.transliteration: vishvarUpo virUpAkSho vAgIshaH shuchisattamaH | sarvapramANasaMvAdI vR^iShA~Nko vR^iShavAhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अनादिर्भूर्भुवो लक्ष्मीः किरीटी त्रिदशाधिपः । विश्वगोप्ता विश्वकर्ता सुवीरो रुचिराङ्गदः
verses.transliteration: anAdirbhUrbhuvo lakShmIH kirITI tridashAdhipaH | vishvagoptA vishvakartA suvIro ruchirA~NgadaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: जननो जनजन्मादिः प्रीतिमान्नीतिमान्धवः । वसिष्ठः कश्यपो भानुर्भीमो भीमपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: janano janajanmAdiH prItimAnnItimAndhavaH | vasiShThaH kashyapo bhAnurbhImo bhImaparAkramaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवः सत्पथाचारो महाकोशो महाधनः । जन्माधिपो महादेवः सकलागमपारगः
verses.transliteration: praNavaH satpathAchAro mahAkosho mahAdhanaH | janmAdhipo mahAdevaH sakalAgamapAragaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वं तत्त्वविदेकात्मा विभुर्विश्वविभूषणः । ऋषिर्ब्राह्मण ऐश्वर्यजन्ममृत्युजरातिगः
verses.transliteration: tattvaM tattvavidekAtmA vibhurvishvavibhUShaNaH | R^iShirbrAhmaNa aishvaryajanmamR^ityujarAtigaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चयज्ञसमुत्पत्तिर्विश्वेशो विमलोदयः । आत्मयोनिरनाद्यन्तो वत्सलो भक्तलोकधृक्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchayaj~nasamutpattirvishvesho vimalodayaH | AtmayoniranAdyanto vatsalo bhaktalokadhR^ik
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीवल्लभः प्रांशुर्विश्वावासः प्रभाकरः । शिशुर्गिरिरतः सम्राट् सुषेणः सुरशत्रुहा
verses.transliteration: gAyatrIvallabhaH prAMshurvishvAvAsaH prabhAkaraH | shishurgirirataH samrAT suSheNaH surashatruhA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अमोघोऽरिष्टनेमिश्च कुमुदो विगतज्वरः । स्वयञ्ज्योतिस्तनुज्योतिरात्मज्योतिरचञ्चलः
verses.transliteration: amogho.ariShTanemishcha kumudo vigatajvaraH | svaya~njyotistanujyotirAtmajyotiracha~nchalaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पिङ्गलः कपिलश्मश्रुर्भालनेत्रस्त्रयीतनुः । ज्ञानस्कन्दो महानीतिर्विश्वोत्पत्तिरुपप्लवः
verses.transliteration: pi~NgalaH kapilashmashrurbhAlanetrastrayItanuH | j~nAnaskando mahAnItirvishvotpattirupaplavaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: भगो विवस्वानादित्यो योगपारो दिवस्पतिः । कल्याणगुणनामा च पापहा पुण्यदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: bhago vivasvAnAdityo yogapAro divaspatiH | kalyANaguNanAmA cha pApahA puNyadarshanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: उदारकीर्तिरुद्योगी सद्योगी सदसन्मयः । नक्षत्रमाली नाकेशः स्वाधिष्ठानपदाश्रयः
verses.transliteration: udArakIrtirudyogI sadyogI sadasanmayaH | nakShatramAlI nAkeshaH svAdhiShThAnapadAshrayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ईशः पिनाकी खट्वाङ्गी चित्रवेषश्चिरन्तनः । तमोहरो महायोगी गोप्ता ब्रह्मा च धूर्जटिः
verses.transliteration: IshaH pinAkI khaTvA~NgI chitraveShashchirantanaH | tamoharo mahAyogI goptA brahmA cha dhUrjaTiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रः पापहारी च मणिपूरो नभोगतिः । हृत्पुण्डरीकमासीनः शक्रः शान्तो वृषाकपिः
verses.transliteration: pavitraH pApahArI cha maNipUro nabhogatiH | hR^itpuNDarIkamAsInaH shakraH shAnto vR^iShAkapiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: उष्णो गृहपतिः कृष्णः समर्थोऽनर्थनाशनः । अधर्मशत्रुरज्ञेयः पुरुहूतः पुरुश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: uShNo gR^ihapatiH kR^iShNaH samartho.anarthanAshanaH | adharmashatruraj~neyaH puruhUtaH purushrutaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मगर्भो बृहद्गर्भो धर्मधेनुर्धनागमः । जगद्धितैषी सुगतः कुमारः कुशलागमः
verses.transliteration: brahmagarbho bR^ihadgarbho dharmadhenurdhanAgamaH | jagaddhitaiShI sugataH kumAraH kushalAgamaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यवर्णो ज्योतिष्मान्नानाभूतरतो ध्वनिः । अरागो नयनाध्यक्षो विश्वामित्रो धनेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: hiraNyavarNo jyotiShmAnnAnAbhUtarato dhvaniH | arAgo nayanAdhyakSho vishvAmitro dhaneshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मज्योतिर्वसुधामा महाज्योतिरनुत्तमः । मातामहो मातरिश्वा नभस्वान्नागहारधृक्
verses.transliteration: brahmajyotirvasudhAmA mahAjyotiranuttamaH | mAtAmaho mAtarishvA nabhasvAnnAgahAradhR^ik
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यः पुलहोऽगस्त्यो जातूकर्ण्यः पराशरः । निरावरणनिर्वारो वैरञ्च्यो विष्टरश्रवाः
verses.transliteration: pulastyaH pulaho.agastyo jAtUkarNyaH parAsharaH | nirAvaraNanirvAro vaira~nchyo viShTarashravAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मभूरनिरुद्धोऽत्रिर्ज्ञानमूर्तिर्महायशाः । लोकवीराग्रणीर्वीरश्चण्डः सत्यपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: AtmabhUraniruddho.atrirj~nAnamUrtirmahAyashAH | lokavIrAgraNIrvIrashchaNDaH satyaparAkramaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: व्यालकल्पो महाकल्पः कल्पवृक्षः कलाधरः । अलङ्करिष्णुरचलो रोचिष्णुर्विक्रमोन्नतः
verses.transliteration: vyAlakalpo mahAkalpaH kalpavR^ikShaH kalAdharaH | ala~NkariShNurachalo rochiShNurvikramonnataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: आयुःशब्दपतिर्वेगी प्लवनः शिखिसारथिः । असंसृष्टोऽतिथिः शक्रप्रमाथी पादपासनः
verses.transliteration: AyuHshabdapatirvegI plavanaH shikhisArathiH | asaMsR^iShTo.atithiH shakrapramAthI pAdapAsanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: वसुश्रवा हव्यवाहः प्रतप्तो विश्वभोजनः । जप्यो जरादिशमनो लोहितात्मा तनूनपात्
verses.transliteration: vasushravA havyavAhaH pratapto vishvabhojanaH | japyo jarAdishamano lohitAtmA tanUnapAt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कालकालः कृत्तिवासाः सुभगः प्रणवात्मकः । उन्नध्रः पुरुषो जुष्यो दुर्वासाः पुरशासनः
verses.transliteration: kAlakAlaH kR^ittivAsAH subhagaH praNavAtmakaH | unnadhraH puruSho juShyo durvAsAH purashAsanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: बृहदश्वो नभोयोनिः सुप्रतीकस्तमिस्रहा । निदाघस्तपनो मेघः स्वक्षः परपुरञ्जयः
verses.transliteration: bR^ihadashvo nabhoyoniH supratIkastamisrahA | nidAghastapano meghaH svakShaH parapura~njayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुखानिलः सुनिष्पन्नः सुरभिः शिशिरात्मकः । वसन्तो माधवो ग्रीष्मो नभस्यो बीजवाहनः
verses.transliteration: sukhAnilaH suniShpannaH surabhiH shishirAtmakaH | vasanto mAdhavo grIShmo nabhasyo bIjavAhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिरा गुरुरात्रेयो विमलो विश्ववाहनः । पावनः सुमतिर्विद्वांस्त्रैविद्यो वरवाहनः
verses.transliteration: a~NgirA gururAtreyo vimalo vishvavAhanaH | pAvanaH sumatirvidvAMstraividyo varavAhanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मनोबुद्धिरहङ्कारः क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्रपालकः । जमदग्निर्बलनिधिर्विगालो विश्वगालवः
verses.transliteration: manobuddhiraha~NkAraH kShetraj~naH kShetrapAlakaH | jamadagnirbalanidhirvigAlo vishvagAlavaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अघोरोऽनुत्तरो यज्ञः श्रेष्ठो निःश्रेयसप्रदः । शैलो गगनकुन्दाभो दानवारिररिन्दमः
verses.transliteration: aghoro.anuttaro yaj~naH shreShTho niHshreyasapradaH | shailo gaganakundAbho dAnavArirarindamaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: रजनीजनकश्चारुर्निःशल्यो लोकशल्यधृक् । चतुर्वेदश्चतुर्भावश्चतुरश्चतुरप्रियः
verses.transliteration: rajanIjanakashchArurniHshalyo lokashalyadhR^ik | chaturvedashchaturbhAvashchaturashchaturapriyaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: आम्नायोऽथ समाम्नायस्तीर्थदेवशिवालयः । बहुरूपो महारूपः सर्वरूपश्चराचरः
verses.transliteration: AmnAyo.atha samAmnAyastIrthadevashivAlayaH | bahurUpo mahArUpaH sarvarUpashcharAcharaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: न्यायनिर्मायको न्यायी न्यायगम्यो निरञ्जनः । सहस्रमूर्धा देवेन्द्रः सर्वशस्त्रप्रभञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: nyAyanirmAyako nyAyI nyAyagamyo nira~njanaH | sahasramUrdhA devendraH sarvashastraprabha~njanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मुण्डो विरूपो विक्रान्तो दण्डी दान्तो गुणोत्तमः । पिङ्गलाक्षो जनाध्यक्षो नीलग्रीवो निरामयः
verses.transliteration: muNDo virUpo vikrAnto daNDI dAnto guNottamaH | pi~NgalAkSho janAdhyakSho nIlagrIvo nirAmayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रबाहुः सर्वेशः शरण्यः सर्वलोकधृक् । पद्मासनः परं ज्योतिः पारम्पर्यफलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: sahasrabAhuH sarveshaH sharaNyaH sarvalokadhR^ik | padmAsanaH paraM jyotiH pAramparyaphalapradaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यायुधः स्कन्दगुरुः परमेष्ठी परात्परः । अनादिमध्यनिधनो गिरीशो गिरिजाधवः
verses.transliteration: divyAyudhaH skandaguruH parameShThI parAtparaH | anAdimadhyanidhano girIsho girijAdhavaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मगर्भो महागर्भो विश्वगर्भो विचक्षणः । परावरज्ञो वरदो वरेण्यश्च महास्वनः
verses.transliteration: padmagarbho mahAgarbho vishvagarbho vichakShaNaH | parAvaraj~no varado vareNyashcha mahAsvanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: देवासुरगुरुर्देवो देवासुरनमस्कृतः । देवासुरमहामित्रो देवासुरमहेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: devAsuragururdevo devAsuranamaskR^itaH | devAsuramahAmitro devAsuramaheshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: देवासुरेश्वरो दिव्यो देवासुरमहाश्रयः । देवदेवमयोऽचिन्त्यो देवदेवात्मसम्भवः
verses.transliteration: devAsureshvaro divyo devAsuramahAshrayaH | devadevamayo.achintyo devadevAtmasambhavaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सद्योनिरसुरव्याघ्रो देवसिंहो दिवाकरः । विबुधाग्रचरश्रेष्ठः सर्वदेवोत्तमोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sadyonirasuravyAghro devasiMho divAkaraH | vibudhAgracharashreShThaH sarvadevottamottamaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिवज्ञानरतः श्रीमान् शिखिश्रीपर्वतप्रियः । वज्रहस्तः सिद्धखङ्गो नरसिंहनिपातनः
verses.transliteration: shivaj~nAnarataH shrImAn shikhishrIparvatapriyaH | vajrahastaH siddhakha~Ngo narasiMhanipAtanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी लोकचारी धर्मचारी धनाधिपः । नन्दी नन्दीश्वरोऽनन्तो नग्नव्रतधरः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: brahmachArI lokachArI dharmachArI dhanAdhipaH | nandI nandIshvaro.ananto nagnavratadharaH shuchiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गाध्यक्षः सुराध्यक्षो योगाध्यक्षो युगावहः । स्वधर्मा स्वर्गतः स्वर्गस्वरः स्वरमयस्वनः
verses.transliteration: li~NgAdhyakShaH surAdhyakSho yogAdhyakSho yugAvahaH | svadharmA svargataH svargasvaraH svaramayasvanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: बाणाध्यक्षो बीजकर्ता धर्मकृद्धर्मसम्भवः । दम्भो लोभोऽर्थविच्छम्भुः सर्वभूतमहेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bANAdhyakSho bIjakartA dharmakR^iddharmasambhavaH | dambho lobho.arthavichChambhuH sarvabhUtamaheshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्मशाननिलयस्त्र्यक्षः सेतुरप्रतिमाकृतिः । लोकोत्तरस्फुटालोकस्त्र्यम्बको नागभूषणः
verses.transliteration: shmashAnanilayastryakShaH seturapratimAkR^itiH | lokottarasphuTAlokastryambako nAgabhUShaNaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकारिर्मखद्वेषी विष्णुकन्धरपातनः । हीनदोषोऽक्षयगुणो दक्षारिः पूषदन्तभित्
verses.transliteration: andhakArirmakhadveShI viShNukandharapAtanaH | hInadoSho.akShayaguNo dakShAriH pUShadantabhit
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३६. षट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । शिवसहस्रनामस्तोत्रफलवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । श्रुत्वा विष्णुकृतं दिव्यं परनामविभूषितम् । सहस्रनाम स्वस्तोत्रं प्रसन्नोऽभून्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.36\. ShaTtriMsho.adhyAyaH | shivasahasranAmastotraphalavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | shrutvA viShNukR^itaM divyaM paranAmavibhUShitam | sahasranAma svastotraM prasanno.abhUnmaheshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । ज्ञातं मयेदं सकलं तव चित्तेप्सितं हरे । देवकार्यं विशेषेण देवकार्यरतात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | j~nAtaM mayedaM sakalaM tava chittepsitaM hare | devakAryaM visheSheNa devakAryaratAtmanaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: देवकार्यस्य सिद्ध्यर्थं दैत्यनाशाय चाश्रमम् । सुदर्शनाख्यं चक्रं च ददामि तव शोभनम्
verses.transliteration: devakAryasya siddhyarthaM daityanAshAya chAshramam | sudarshanAkhyaM chakraM cha dadAmi tava shobhanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यद्रूपं भवता दृष्टं सर्वलोकसुखावहम् । हिताय तव देवेश धृतं भावय तद्ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: yadrUpaM bhavatA dR^iShTaM sarvalokasukhAvaham | hitAya tava devesha dhR^itaM bhAvaya taddhruvam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: रणाजिरे स्मृतं तद्वै देवानां दुःखनाशनम् । इदं चक्रमिदं रूपमिदं नामसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: raNAjire smR^itaM tadvai devAnAM duHkhanAshanam | idaM chakramidaM rUpamidaM nAmasahasrakam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ये शृण्वन्ति सदा भक्त्या सिद्धिः स्यादनपायिनी । कामानां सकलानां च प्रसादान्मम सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: ye shR^iNvanti sadA bhaktyA siddhiH syAdanapAyinI | kAmAnAM sakalAnAM cha prasAdAnmama suvrata
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा ददौ चक्रं सूर्यायुतसमप्रभम् । सुदर्शनं स्वपादोत्थं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evamuktvA dadau chakraM sUryAyutasamaprabham | sudarshanaM svapAdotthaM sarvashatruvinAshanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुश्चापि सुसंस्कृत्य जग्राहोदङ्मुखस्तदा । नमस्कृत्य महादेवं विष्णुर्वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: viShNushchApi susaMskR^itya jagrAhoda~NmukhastadA | namaskR^itya mahAdevaM viShNurvachanamabravIt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । शृणु देव मया ध्येयं पठनीयं च किं प्रभो । दुःखानां नाशनार्थं हि वद त्वं लोकशङ्कर
verses.transliteration: viShNuruvAcha | shR^iNu deva mayA dhyeyaM paThanIyaM cha kiM prabho | duHkhAnAM nAshanArthaM hi vada tvaM lokasha~Nkara
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति पृष्टस्तदा तेन सन्तुष्टस्तु शिवोऽब्रवीत् । प्रसन्नमानसो भूत्वा विष्णुं देवसहायकम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti pR^iShTastadA tena santuShTastu shivo.abravIt | prasannamAnaso bhUtvA viShNuM devasahAyakam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । रूपं ध्येयं हरे मे हि सर्वानर्थप्रशान्तये । अनेकदुःखनाशार्थं पठ नामसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | rUpaM dhyeyaM hare me hi sarvAnarthaprashAntaye | anekaduHkhanAshArthaM paTha nAmasahasrakam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: परीक्षार्थं हरेरीशः कमलेषु महेश्वरः । गोपयामास कमलं तदैकं भुवनेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: parIkShArthaM harerIshaH kamaleShu maheshvaraH | gopayAmAsa kamalaM tadaikaM bhuvaneshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: धार्यं चक्रं सदा मे हि सर्वाभीष्टस्य सिद्धये । त्वया विष्णो प्रयत्नेन सर्वचक्रवरं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: dhAryaM chakraM sadA me hi sarvAbhIShTasya siddhaye | tvayA viShNo prayatnena sarvachakravaraM tvidam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च ये पठिष्यन्ति पाठयिष्यन्ति नित्यशः । तेषां दुःखं न स्वप्नेऽपि जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: anye cha ye paThiShyanti pAThayiShyanti nityashaH | teShAM duHkhaM na svapne.api jAyate nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञां च सङ्कटे प्राप्ते शतावृत्तिं चरेद्यदा । साङ्गं च विधिसंयुक्तं कल्याणं लभते नरः
verses.transliteration: rAj~nAM cha sa~NkaTe prApte shatAvR^ittiM charedyadA | sA~NgaM cha vidhisaMyuktaM kalyANaM labhate naraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: रोगनाशकरं ह्येतद्विद्यावित्तदमुत्तमम् । सर्वकामप्रदं पुण्यं शिवभक्तिप्रदं सदा
verses.transliteration: roganAshakaraM hyetadvidyAvittadamuttamam | sarvakAmapradaM puNyaM shivabhaktipradaM sadA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यदुद्दिश्य फलं श्रेष्ठं पठिष्यन्ति नरास्त्विह । लप्स्यन्ते नात्र सन्देहः फलं तत्सत्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yaduddishya phalaM shreShThaM paThiShyanti narAstviha | lapsyante nAtra sandehaH phalaM tatsatyamuttamam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यश्च प्रातः समुत्थाय पूजां कृत्वा मदीयिकाम् । पठते मत्समक्षं वै नित्यं सिद्धिर्न दूरतः
verses.transliteration: yashcha prAtaH samutthAya pUjAM kR^itvA madIyikAm | paThate matsamakShaM vai nityaM siddhirna dUrataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ऐहिकीं सिद्धिमाप्नोति निखिलां सर्वकामिकाम् । अन्ते सायुज्यमुक्तिं वै प्राप्नोत्यत्र न संशयः
verses.transliteration: aihikIM siddhimApnoti nikhilAM sarvakAmikAm | ante sAyujyamuktiM vai prApnotyatra na saMshayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा तदा विष्णुं शङ्करः प्रीतमानसः । उपस्पृश्य कराभ्यां तमुवाच गिरिशः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evamuktvA tadA viShNuM sha~NkaraH prItamAnasaH | upaspR^ishya karAbhyAM tamuvAcha girishaH punaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । वरदोऽस्मि सुरश्रेष्ठ वरान्वृणु यथेप्सितान् । भक्त्या वशीकृतो नूनं स्तवेनानेन सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | varado.asmi surashreShTha varAnvR^iNu yathepsitAn | bhaktyA vashIkR^ito nUnaM stavenAnena suvrata
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्तो देवदेवेन देवदेवं प्रणम्य तम् । सुप्रसन्नतरो विष्णुः साञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityukto devadevena devadevaM praNamya tam | suprasannataro viShNuH sA~njalirvAkyamabravIt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पङ्कजेषु तदा तेषु सहस्रेषु बभूव च । न्यूनमेकं तदा विष्णुर्विह्वलः शिवपूजने
verses.transliteration: pa~NkajeShu tadA teShu sahasreShu babhUva cha | nyUnamekaM tadA viShNurvihvalaH shivapUjane
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच । यथेदानीं कृपा नाथ क्रियते चान्यतः परा । कार्या चैव विशेषेण कृपालुत्वात्त्वया प्रभो
verses.transliteration: viShNuruvAcha | yathedAnIM kR^ipA nAtha kriyate chAnyataH parA | kAryA chaiva visheSheNa kR^ipAlutvAttvayA prabho
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि भक्तिर्महादेव प्रसीद वरमुत्तमम् । नान्यमिच्छामि भक्तानामार्त्तयो नैव यत्प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tvayi bhaktirmahAdeva prasIda varamuttamam | nAnyamichChAmi bhaktAnAmArttayo naiva yatprabho
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य दयावान्सुतरां भवः । पस्पर्श च तदङ्गं वै प्राह शीतांशुशेखरः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tachChrutvA vachanaM tasya dayAvAnsutarAM bhavaH | pasparsha cha tada~NgaM vai prAha shItAMshushekharaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिव उवाच । मयि भक्तिः सदा ते तु हरे स्यादनपायिनी । सदा वन्द्यश्च पूज्यश्च लोके भव सुरैरपि
verses.transliteration: shiva uvAcha | mayi bhaktiH sadA te tu hare syAdanapAyinI | sadA vandyashcha pUjyashcha loke bhava surairapi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वम्भरेति ते नाम सर्वपापहरं परम् । भविष्यति न सन्देहो मत्प्रसादात्सुरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: vishvambhareti te nAma sarvapApaharaM param | bhaviShyati na sandeho matprasAdAtsurottama
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे रुद्रः सर्वदेवेश्वरः प्रभुः । पश्यतस्तस्य विष्णोस्तु तत्रैव च मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvAntardadhe rudraH sarvadeveshvaraH prabhuH | pashyatastasya viShNostu tatraiva cha munIshvarAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: जनार्दनोऽपि भगवान् वचनाच्छङ्करस्य च । प्राप्य चक्रं शुभं तद्वै जहर्षाति स्वचेतसि
verses.transliteration: janArdano.api bhagavAn vachanAchCha~Nkarasya cha | prApya chakraM shubhaM tadvai jaharShAti svachetasi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा ध्यानं च तच्छम्भोः स्तोत्रमेतन्निरन्तरम् । पपाठाध्यापयामास भक्तेभ्यस्तदुपादिशत्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA dhyAnaM cha tachChambhoH stotrametannirantaram | papAThAdhyApayAmAsa bhaktebhyastadupAdishat
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इति पृष्टं मयाख्यातं शृण्वतां पापहारकम् । अतः परं च किं श्रेष्ठाः प्रष्टुमिच्छथ वै पुनः
verses.transliteration: iti pR^iShTaM mayAkhyAtaM shR^iNvatAM pApahArakam | ataH paraM cha kiM shreShThAH praShTumichChatha vai punaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: हृदा विचारितं तेन कुतो वै कमलं गतम् । यातं यातु सुखेनैव मन्नेत्रं कमलं न किम्
verses.transliteration: hR^idA vichAritaM tena kuto vai kamalaM gatam | yAtaM yAtu sukhenaiva mannetraM kamalaM na kim
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वेति नेत्रमुद्धृत्य सर्वसत्त्वावलम्बनात् । पूजयामास भावेन स्तवयामास तेन च
verses.transliteration: j~nAtveti netramuddhR^itya sarvasattvAvalambanAt | pUjayAmAsa bhAvena stavayAmAsa tena cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुतमथो दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतं हरो हरिम् । मा मेति व्याहरन्नेव प्रादुरासीज्जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: tatastutamatho dR^iShTvA tathAbhUtaM haro harim | mA meti vyAharanneva prAdurAsIjjagadguruH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादवतताराशु मण्डलात्पार्थिवस्य च । प्रतिष्ठितस्य हरिणा स्वलिङ्गस्य महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdavatatArAshu maNDalAtpArthivasya cha | pratiShThitasya hariNA svali~Ngasya maheshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तरूपिणं शम्भुं तेजोराशिसमुत्थितम् । नमस्कृत्य पुरः स्थित्वा स तुष्टाव विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yathoktarUpiNaM shambhuM tejorAshisamutthitam | namaskR^itya puraH sthitvA sa tuShTAva visheShataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्राह महादेवः प्रसन्नः प्रहसन्निव । सम्प्रेक्ष्य कृपया विष्णुं कृताञ्जलिपुटं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tadA prAha mahAdevaH prasannaH prahasanniva | samprekShya kR^ipayA viShNuM kR^itA~njalipuTaM sthitam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३७. सप्तत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । देवर्षिनृपशैवत्ववर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सूत महाभाग ज्ञानवानसि सुव्रत । पुनरेव शिवस्यैव चरितं ब्रूहि विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.37\. saptatriMsho.adhyAyaH | devarShinR^ipashaivatvavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | sUta sUta mahAbhAga j~nAnavAnasi suvrata | punareva shivasyaiva charitaM brUhi vistarAt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धती महासाध्वी लोपामुद्रा तथैव च । अहल्या गौतमस्त्री च शिवपूजनकारिकाः
verses.transliteration: arundhatI mahAsAdhvI lopAmudrA tathaiva cha | ahalyA gautamastrI cha shivapUjanakArikAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वासाः कौशिकः शक्तिर्दधीचो गौतमस्तथा । कणादो भार्गवो जीवो वैशम्पायन एव च
verses.transliteration: durvAsAH kaushikaH shaktirdadhIcho gautamastathA | kaNAdo bhArgavo jIvo vaishampAyana eva cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एते च मुनयः सर्वे शिवपूजाकरा मताः । तथा पराशरो व्यासः शिवपूजारतः सदा
verses.transliteration: ete cha munayaH sarve shivapUjAkarA matAH | tathA parAsharo vyAsaH shivapUjArataH sadA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युर्महाभक्तः शिवस्य परमात्मनः । याज्ञवल्क्यो महाशैवो जैमिनिर्गर्ग एव च
verses.transliteration: upamanyurmahAbhaktaH shivasya paramAtmanaH | yAj~navalkyo mahAshaivo jaiminirgarga eva cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शुकश्च शौनकाद्याश्च शङ्करस्य प्रपूजकाः । अन्येऽपि बहवः सन्ति मुनयो मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: shukashcha shaunakAdyAshcha sha~Nkarasya prapUjakAH | anye.api bahavaH santi munayo munisattamAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अदितिर्देवमाता च नित्यं प्रीत्या चकार ह । पार्थिवीं शैवपूजां वै सवधूः प्रेमतत्परा
verses.transliteration: aditirdevamAtA cha nityaM prItyA chakAra ha | pArthivIM shaivapUjAM vai savadhUH prematatparA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रादयो लोकपाला वसवश्च सुरास्तथा । महाराजिकदेवाश्च साध्याश्च शिवपूजकाः
verses.transliteration: shakrAdayo lokapAlA vasavashcha surAstathA | mahArAjikadevAshcha sAdhyAshcha shivapUjakAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाः किन्नराद्याश्चोपसुराः शिवपूजकाः । तथासुरा महात्मानः शिवपूजाकरा मताः
verses.transliteration: gandharvAH kinnarAdyAshchopasurAH shivapUjakAH | tathAsurA mahAtmAnaH shivapUjAkarA matAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यः सानुजः ससुतो मुने । शिवपूजाकरो नित्यं विरोचनबली तथा
verses.transliteration: hiraNyakashipurdaityaH sAnujaH sasuto mune | shivapUjAkaro nityaM virochanabalI tathA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: महाशैवः स्मृतो बाणो हिरण्याक्षसुतास्तथा । वृषपर्वा दनुस्तात दानवाः शिवपूजकाः
verses.transliteration: mahAshaivaH smR^ito bANo hiraNyAkShasutAstathA | vR^iShaparvA danustAta dAnavAH shivapUjakAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पुरातनाश्च राजान ऋषयो देवतास्तथा । आराधनं च तस्यैव चक्रुर्देववरस्य हि
verses.transliteration: purAtanAshcha rAjAna R^iShayo devatAstathA | ArAdhanaM cha tasyaiva chakrurdevavarasya hi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शेषश्च वासुकिश्चैव तक्षकश्च तथाऽपरे । शिवभक्ता महानागा गरुडाद्याश्च पक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: sheShashcha vAsukishchaiva takShakashcha tathA.apare | shivabhaktA mahAnAgA garuDAdyAshcha pakShiNaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यचन्द्रावुभौ देवौ पृथ्व्यां वंशप्रवर्तकौ । शिवसेवारतौ नित्यं सवश्यौ तौ मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: sUryachandrAvubhau devau pR^ithvyAM vaMshapravartakau | shivasevAratau nityaM savashyau tau munIshvara
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मनवश्च तथा चक्रुः स्वायम्भुवपुरः सराः । शिवपूजां विशेषेण शिववेषधरा मुने
verses.transliteration: manavashcha tathA chakruH svAyambhuvapuraH sarAH | shivapUjAM visheSheNa shivaveShadharA mune
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियव्रतश्च तत्पुत्रास्तथा चोत्तानपात्सुतः । तद्वंशाश्चैव राजानः शिवपूजनकारकाः
verses.transliteration: priyavratashcha tatputrAstathA chottAnapAtsutaH | tadvaMshAshchaiva rAjAnaH shivapUjanakArakAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवश्च ऋषभश्चैव भरतो नवयोगिनः । तद्भ्रातरः परे चापि शिवपूजनकारकाः
verses.transliteration: dhruvashcha R^iShabhashchaiva bharato navayoginaH | tadbhrAtaraH pare chApi shivapUjanakArakAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतसुतास्तार्क्ष्य इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखा नृपाः । शिवपूजारतात्मानः सर्वदा सुखभोगिनः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatasutAstArkShya ikShvAkupramukhA nR^ipAH | shivapUjAratAtmAnaH sarvadA sukhabhoginaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ककुत्स्थश्चापि मान्धाता सगरः शैवसत्तमः । मुचुकुन्दो हरिश्चन्द्रः कल्माषाङ्घ्रिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kakutsthashchApi mAndhAtA sagaraH shaivasattamaH | muchukundo harishchandraH kalmAShA~Nghristathaiva cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथादयो भूपा बहवो नृपसत्तमाः । शिवपूजाकरा ज्ञेयाः शिववेषविधायिनः
verses.transliteration: bhagIrathAdayo bhUpA bahavo nR^ipasattamAH | shivapUjAkarA j~neyAH shivaveShavidhAyinaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: खट्वाङ्गश्च महाराजो देवसाहाय्यकारकः । विधितः पार्थिवीं मूर्तिं शिवस्यापूजयत्सदा
verses.transliteration: khaTvA~Ngashcha mahArAjo devasAhAyyakArakaH | vidhitaH pArthivIM mUrtiM shivasyApUjayatsadA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पुत्रो हि दिलीपश्च शिवपूजनकृत् सदा । रघुस्तत्तनयः शैवः सुप्रीत्या शिवपूजकः
verses.transliteration: tatputro hi dilIpashcha shivapUjanakR^it sadA | raghustattanayaH shaivaH suprItyA shivapUjakaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । साधु पृष्टमृषिश्रेष्ठाः श्रूयतां कथयामि वः । चरित्रं शाङ्करं रम्यं शृण्वतां भुक्तिमुक्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | sAdhu pR^iShTamR^iShishreShThAH shrUyatAM kathayAmi vaH | charitraM shA~NkaraM ramyaM shR^iNvatAM bhuktimuktidam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अजः शिवार्चकस्तस्य तनयो धर्मयुद्धकृत् । जातो दशरथो भूयो महाराजो विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: ajaH shivArchakastasya tanayo dharmayuddhakR^it | jAto dasharatho bhUyo mahArAjo visheShataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थे पार्थिवीं मूर्त्तिं शैवीं दशरथो हि सः । समानर्च विशेषेण वसिष्ठस्याज्ञया मुनेः
verses.transliteration: putrArthe pArthivIM mUrttiM shaivIM dasharatho hi saH | samAnarcha visheSheNa vasiShThasyAj~nayA muneH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रेष्टिं च चकारासौ पार्थिवो भवभक्तिमान् । ऋष्यशृङ्गमुनेराज्ञां सम्प्राप्य नृपसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: putreShTiM cha chakArAsau pArthivo bhavabhaktimAn | R^iShyashR^i~NgamunerAj~nAM samprApya nR^ipasattamaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कौसल्या तत्प्रिया मूर्त्तिं पार्थिवीं शाङ्करीं मुदा । ऋष्यशृङ्गसमादिष्टा समानर्च सुताप्तये
verses.transliteration: kausalyA tatpriyA mUrttiM pArthivIM shA~NkarIM mudA | R^iShyashR^i~NgasamAdiShTA samAnarcha sutAptaye
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुमित्रा च शिवं प्रीत्या कैकेयी नृपवल्लभा । पूजयामास सत्पुत्रप्राप्तये मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: sumitrA cha shivaM prItyA kaikeyI nR^ipavallabhA | pUjayAmAsa satputraprAptaye munisattama
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिवप्रसादतस्ता वै पुत्रान्प्रापुः शुभङ्करान् । महाप्रतापिनो वीरान् सन्मार्गनिरतान्मुने
verses.transliteration: shivaprasAdatastA vai putrAnprApuH shubha~NkarAn | mahApratApino vIrAn sanmArganiratAnmune
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिवाज्ञया तस्मात्तासु राज्ञः स्वयं हरिः । चतुर्भिश्चैव रूपैश्चाविर्बभूव नृपात्मजः
verses.transliteration: tataH shivAj~nayA tasmAttAsu rAj~naH svayaM hariH | chaturbhishchaiva rUpaishchAvirbabhUva nR^ipAtmajaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कौसल्यायाः सुतो रामः सुमित्रायाश्च लक्ष्मणः । शत्रुघ्नश्चैव कैकेय्या भरतश्चेति सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: kausalyAyAH suto rAmaH sumitrAyAshcha lakShmaNaH | shatrughnashchaiva kaikeyyA bharatashcheti suvratAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: रामः स सहजो नित्यं पार्थिवं समपूजयत् । भस्मरुद्राक्षधारी च विरजागममास्थितः
verses.transliteration: rAmaH sa sahajo nityaM pArthivaM samapUjayat | bhasmarudrAkShadhArI cha virajAgamamAsthitaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वंशे ये समुत्पन्ना राजानः सानुगा मुने । ते सर्वे पार्थिवं लिङ्गं शिवस्य समपूजयन्
verses.transliteration: tadvaMshe ye samutpannA rAjAnaH sAnugA mune | te sarve pArthivaM li~NgaM shivasya samapUjayan
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव पुरा पृष्टो नारदेन पितामहः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा नारदं मुनिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: etadeva purA pR^iShTo nAradena pitAmahaH | pratyuvAcha prasannAtmA nAradaM munisattamam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सुद्युम्नश्च महाराजः शैवो मनुसुतो मुने । शिवशापात्प्रियाहेतोरभून्नारी ससवेकः
verses.transliteration: sudyumnashcha mahArAjaH shaivo manusuto mune | shivashApAtpriyAhetorabhUnnArI sasavekaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवेशसमर्चातः पुनः सोऽभूत्पुमान्वरः । मासं स्त्री पुरुषो मासमेवं स्त्रीत्वं न्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration: pArthiveshasamarchAtaH punaH so.abhUtpumAnvaraH | mAsaM strI puruSho mAsamevaM strItvaM nyavartata
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ततो राज्यं परित्यज्य शिवधर्मपरायणः । शिववेषधरो भक्त्या दुर्लभं मोक्षमाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: tato rAjyaM parityajya shivadharmaparAyaNaH | shivaveShadharo bhaktyA durlabhaM mokShamAptavAn
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पुरूरवाश्च तत्पुत्रो महाराजः सुपूजकः । शिवस्य देवदेवस्य तत्सुतः शिवपूजकः
verses.transliteration: purUravAshcha tatputro mahArAjaH supUjakaH | shivasya devadevasya tatsutaH shivapUjakaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: भरतस्तु महापूजां शिवस्यैव सदाऽकरोत् । नहुषश्च महाशैवः शिवपूजारतो ह्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: bharatastu mahApUjAM shivasyaiva sadA.akarot | nahuShashcha mahAshaivaH shivapUjArato hyabhUt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ययातिः शिवपूजातः सर्वान्कामानवाप्तवान् । अजीजनत्सुतान्पञ्च शिवधर्मपरायणान्
verses.transliteration: yayAtiH shivapUjAtaH sarvAnkAmAnavAptavAn | ajIjanatsutAnpa~ncha shivadharmaparAyaNAn
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सुता यदुमुख्याश्च पञ्चापि शिवपूजकाः । शिवपूजाप्रभावेण सर्वान्कामांश्च लेभिरे
verses.transliteration: tatsutA yadumukhyAshcha pa~nchApi shivapUjakAH | shivapUjAprabhAveNa sarvAnkAmAMshcha lebhire
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अन्येऽपि ये महाभागाः समानर्चुः शिवं हि ते । तद्वंश्या अन्यवंश्याश्च भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं मुने
verses.transliteration: anye.api ye mahAbhAgAH samAnarchuH shivaM hi te | tadvaMshyA anyavaMshyAshcha bhuktimuktipradaM mune
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णेन च कृतं नित्यं बदरीपर्वतोत्तमे । पूजनं तु शिवस्यैव सप्तमासावधि स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kR^iShNena cha kR^itaM nityaM badarIparvatottame | pUjanaM tu shivasyaiva saptamAsAvadhi svayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नाद्भगवांस्तस्माद्वरान्दिव्याननेकशः । सम्प्राप्य च जगत्सर्वं वशेऽनयत शङ्करात्
verses.transliteration: prasannAdbhagavAMstasmAdvarAndivyAnanekashaH | samprApya cha jagatsarvaM vashe.anayata sha~NkarAt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । शृणु नारद सुप्रीत्या शाङ्करं चरितं वरम् । प्रवक्ष्यामि भवत्स्नेहान्महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | shR^iNu nArada suprItyA shA~NkaraM charitaM varam | pravakShyAmi bhavatsnehAnmahApAtakanAshanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रद्युम्नः तत्सुतस्तात शिवपूजाकरः सदा । अन्ये च कार्ष्णिप्रवराः साम्बाद्याः शिवपूजकाः
verses.transliteration: pradyumnaH tatsutastAta shivapUjAkaraH sadA | anye cha kArShNipravarAH sAmbAdyAH shivapUjakAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: जरासन्धो महाशैवस्तद्वंश्याश्च नृपास्तथा । निमिः शैवश्च जनकः तत्पुत्राः शिवपूजकाः
verses.transliteration: jarAsandho mahAshaivastadvaMshyAshcha nR^ipAstathA | nimiH shaivashcha janakaH tatputrAH shivapUjakAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: नलेन च कृता पूजा वीरसेनसुतेन वै । पूर्वजन्मनि यो भिल्लो वने पान्थसुरक्षकः
verses.transliteration: nalena cha kR^itA pUjA vIrasenasutena vai | pUrvajanmani yo bhillo vane pAnthasurakShakaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यतिश्च रक्षितस्तेन पुरा हरसमीपतः । स्वयं व्याघ्रादिभी रात्रौ भक्षितश्च मृतो वृषात्
verses.transliteration: yatishcha rakShitastena purA harasamIpataH | svayaM vyAghrAdibhI rAtrau bhakShitashcha mR^ito vR^iShAt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तेन पुण्यप्रभावेण स भिल्लो हि नलोऽभवत् । चक्रवर्ती महाराजो दमयन्तीप्रियोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tena puNyaprabhAveNa sa bhillo hi nalo.abhavat | chakravartI mahArAjo damayantIpriyo.abhavat
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं तात यत्पृष्टं भवतानघ । शाङ्करं चरितं दिव्यं किमन्यत्प्रष्टुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaM tAta yatpR^iShTaM bhavatAnagha | shA~NkaraM charitaM divyaM kimanyatpraShTumichChasi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: रमया सहितो विष्णुः शिवपूजां चकार ह । कृपया परमेशस्य सर्वान्कामानवाप हि
verses.transliteration: ramayA sahito viShNuH shivapUjAM chakAra ha | kR^ipayA parameshasya sarvAnkAmAnavApa hi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अहं पितामहश्चापि शिवपूजनकारकः । तस्यैव कृपया तात विश्वसृष्टिकरः सदा
verses.transliteration: ahaM pitAmahashchApi shivapUjanakArakaH | tasyaiva kR^ipayA tAta vishvasR^iShTikaraH sadA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिवपूजाकरा नित्यं मत्पुत्राः परमर्षयः । अन्ये च ऋषयो ये ते शिवपूजनकारकाः
verses.transliteration: shivapUjAkarA nityaM matputrAH paramarShayaH | anye cha R^iShayo ye te shivapUjanakArakAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: नारद त्वं विशेषेण शिवपूजनकारकः । सप्तर्षयो वसिष्ठाद्याः शिवपूजनकारकाः
verses.transliteration: nArada tvaM visheSheNa shivapUjanakArakaH | saptarShayo vasiShThAdyAH shivapUjanakArakAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.३८. अष्टत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । शिवरात्रिव्रतमहिमनिरूपणम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । धन्योऽसि कृतकृत्योऽसि जीवितं सफलं तव । यच्छ्रावयसि नस्तात महेश्वरकथां शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.38\. aShTatriMsho.adhyAyaH | shivarAtrivratamahimanirUpaNam | R^iShaya UchuH | dhanyo.asi kR^itakR^ityo.asi jIvitaM saphalaM tava | yachChrAvayasi nastAta maheshvarakathAM shubhAm
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: दश शैवव्रतान्याहुर्जाबालश्रुतिपारगाः । तानि व्रतानि यत्नेन कार्याण्येव द्विजैः सदा
verses.transliteration: dasha shaivavratAnyAhurjAbAlashrutipAragAH | tAni vratAni yatnena kAryANyeva dvijaiH sadA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यष्टम्यां प्रयत्नेन कर्तव्यं नक्तभोजनम् । कालाष्टम्यां विशेषेण हरे त्याज्यंऽह्निभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: pratyaShTamyAM prayatnena kartavyaM naktabhojanam | kAlAShTamyAM visheSheNa hare tyAjyaM.ahnibhojanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एकादश्यां सितायां तु त्याज्यं विष्णोऽह्निभोजनम् । असितायां तु भोक्तव्यं नक्तमभ्यर्च्य मां हरे
verses.transliteration: ekAdashyAM sitAyAM tu tyAjyaM viShNo.ahnibhojanam | asitAyAM tu bhoktavyaM naktamabhyarchya mAM hare
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदश्यां सितायां तु कर्तव्यं निशि भोजनम् । असितायां तु भूतायां तन्न कार्यं शिवव्रतैः
verses.transliteration: trayodashyAM sitAyAM tu kartavyaM nishi bhojanam | asitAyAM tu bhUtAyAM tanna kAryaM shivavrataiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: निशि यत्नेन कर्तव्यं भोजनं सोमवासरे । उभयोः पक्षयोर्विष्णो सर्वस्मिञ्छिवतत्परैः
verses.transliteration: nishi yatnena kartavyaM bhojanaM somavAsare | ubhayoH pakShayorviShNo sarvasmi~nChivatatparaiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतेष्वेतेषु सर्वेषु शैवा भोज्याः प्रयत्नतः । यथाशक्ति द्विजश्रेष्ठा व्रतसम्पूर्तिहेतवे
verses.transliteration: vrateShveteShu sarveShu shaivA bhojyAH prayatnataH | yathAshakti dvijashreShThA vratasampUrtihetave
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतान्येतानि नियमात्कर्तव्यानि द्विजन्मभिः । व्रतान्येतानि तु त्यक्त्वा जायन्ते तस्करा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: vratAnyetAni niyamAtkartavyAni dvijanmabhiH | vratAnyetAni tu tyaktvA jAyante taskarA dvijAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तिमार्गप्रवीणैश्च कर्तव्यं नियमादिति । मुक्तेस्तु प्रापकं चैव चतुष्टयमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: muktimArgapravINaishcha kartavyaM niyamAditi | muktestu prApakaM chaiva chatuShTayamudAhR^itam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिवार्चनं रुद्रजप उपवासः शिवालये । वाराणस्यां च मरणं मुक्तिरेषा सनातनी
verses.transliteration: shivArchanaM rudrajapa upavAsaH shivAlaye | vArANasyAM cha maraNaM muktireShA sanAtanI
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमी सोमवारे च कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी । शिवतुष्टिकरं चैतन्नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: aShTamI somavAre cha kR^iShNapakShe chaturdashI | shivatuShTikaraM chaitannAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: बहुभिश्चर्षिभिः सूत श्रुतं यद्यपि वस्तु सत् । सन्देहो न गतोऽस्माकं तदेतत्कथयामि ते
verses.transliteration: bahubhishcharShibhiH sUta shrutaM yadyapi vastu sat | sandeho na gato.asmAkaM tadetatkathayAmi te
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्ष्वपि बलिष्ठं हि शिवरात्रिव्रतं हरे । तस्मात्तदेव कर्तव्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिफलेप्सुभिः
verses.transliteration: chaturShvapi baliShThaM hi shivarAtrivrataM hare | tasmAttadeva kartavyaM bhuktimuktiphalepsubhiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्माच्च व्रतादन्यन्नास्ति नृणां हितावहम् । एतद् व्रतं तु सर्वेषां धर्मसाधनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: etasmAchcha vratAdanyannAsti nR^iNAM hitAvaham | etad vrataM tu sarveShAM dharmasAdhanamuttamam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: निष्कामानां सकामानां सर्वेषां च नृणां तथा । वर्णानामाश्रमाणां च स्त्रीबालानां तथा हरे
verses.transliteration: niShkAmAnAM sakAmAnAM sarveShAM cha nR^iNAM tathA | varNAnAmAshramANAM cha strIbAlAnAM tathA hare
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: दासानां दासिकानां च देवादीनां तथैव च । शरीरिणां च सर्वेषां हितमेतद् व्रतं वरम्
verses.transliteration: dAsAnAM dAsikAnAM cha devAdInAM tathaiva cha | sharIriNAM cha sarveShAM hitametad vrataM varam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: माघस्य ह्यसिते पक्षे विशिष्टा साति कीर्तिता । निशीथव्यापिनी ग्राह्या हत्याकोटिविनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: mAghasya hyasite pakShe vishiShTA sAti kIrtitA | nishIthavyApinI grAhyA hatyAkoTivinAshinI
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दिने चैव यत्कार्यं प्रातरारभ्य केशव । श्रूयतां तन्मनो दत्त्वा सुप्रीत्या कथयामि ते
verses.transliteration: taddine chaiva yatkAryaM prAtarArabhya keshava | shrUyatAM tanmano dattvA suprItyA kathayAmi te
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरुत्थाय मेधावी परमानन्दसंयुतः । समाचरेन्नित्यकृत्यं स्नानादिकमतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: prAtarutthAya medhAvI paramAnandasaMyutaH | samAcharennityakR^ityaM snAnAdikamatandritaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिवालये ततो गत्वा पूजयित्वा यथाविधि । नमस्कृत्य शिवं पश्चात्सङ्कल्पं सम्यगाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: shivAlaye tato gatvA pUjayitvA yathAvidhi | namaskR^itya shivaM pashchAtsa~NkalpaM samyagAcharet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव महादेव नीलकण्ठ नमोऽस्तु ते । कर्तुमिच्छाम्यहं देव शिवरात्रिव्रतं तव
verses.transliteration: devadeva mahAdeva nIlakaNTha namo.astu te | kartumichChAmyahaM deva shivarAtrivrataM tava
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तव प्रभावाद्देवेश निर्विघ्नेन भवेदिति । कामाद्याः शत्रवो मां वै पीडां कुर्वन्तु नैव हि
verses.transliteration: tava prabhAvAddevesha nirvighnena bhavediti | kAmAdyAH shatravo mAM vai pIDAM kurvantu naiva hi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: केन व्रतेन सन्तुष्टः शिवो यच्छति सत्सुखम् । कुशलः शिवकृत्ये त्वं तस्मात्पृच्छामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: kena vratena santuShTaH shivo yachChati satsukham | kushalaH shivakR^itye tvaM tasmAtpR^ichChAmahe vayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सङ्कल्पमास्थाय पूजाद्रव्यं समाहरेत् । सुस्थले चैव यल्लिङ्गं प्रसिद्धं चागमेषु वै
verses.transliteration: evaM sa~NkalpamAsthAya pUjAdravyaM samAharet | susthale chaiva yalli~NgaM prasiddhaM chAgameShu vai
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ तत्र स्वयं गत्वा सम्पाद्य विधिमुत्तमम् ॥ शिवस्य दक्षिणे भागे पश्चिमे वा स्थले शुभे
verses.transliteration: rAtrau tatra svayaM gatvA sampAdya vidhimuttamam || shivasya dakShiNe bhAge pashchime vA sthale shubhe
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: निधाय चैव तद द्रव्यं पूजार्थं शिवसन्निधौ । पुनः स्नायात्तदा तत्र विधिपूर्वं नरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: nidhAya chaiva tada dravyaM pUjArthaM shivasannidhau | punaH snAyAttadA tatra vidhipUrvaM narottamaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: परिधाय शुभं वस्त्रमन्तर्वासः शुभं तथा । आचम्य च त्रिवारं हि पूजारम्भं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: paridhAya shubhaM vastramantarvAsaH shubhaM tathA | Achamya cha trivAraM hi pUjArambhaM samAcharet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य मन्त्रस्य यद द्रव्यं तेन पूजां समाचरेत् । अमन्त्रकं न कर्तव्यं पूजनं तु हरस्य च
verses.transliteration: yasya mantrasya yada dravyaM tena pUjAM samAcharet | amantrakaM na kartavyaM pUjanaM tu harasya cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: गीतैर्वाद्यैस्तथा नृत्यैर्भक्तिभावसमन्वितैः । पूजनं प्रथमे यामे कृत्वा मन्त्रं जपेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: gItairvAdyaistathA nR^ityairbhaktibhAvasamanvitaiH | pUjanaM prathame yAme kR^itvA mantraM japed budhaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवं च तदा श्रेष्ठं विदध्यान्मन्त्रवान्यदि । कृतनित्यक्रियः पश्चात्पार्थिवं च समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: pArthivaM cha tadA shreShThaM vidadhyAnmantravAnyadi | kR^itanityakriyaH pashchAtpArthivaM cha samarchayet
