verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानरूपोऽव्ययः साक्षी ज्ञानगम्योऽद्वयः स्वयम् । कैवल्यमुक्तिदः सोऽत्र त्रिवर्गस्य प्रदोऽपि हि
verses.transliteration: j~nAnarUpo.avyayaH sAkShI j~nAnagamyo.advayaH svayam | kaivalyamuktidaH so.atra trivargasya prado.api hi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कैवल्याख्या पञ्चमी च दुर्लभा सर्वथा नृणाम् । तल्लक्षणं प्रवक्ष्यामि श्रूयतामृषिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kaivalyAkhyA pa~nchamI cha durlabhA sarvathA nR^iNAm | tallakShaNaM pravakShyAmi shrUyatAmR^iShisattamAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पद्यते यतः सर्वं येनैतत्पाल्यते जगत् । यस्मिंश्च लीयते तद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.transliteration: utpadyate yataH sarvaM yenaitatpAlyate jagat | yasmiMshcha lIyate taddhi yena sarvamidaM tatam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तदेव शिवरूपं हि पठ्यते च मुनीश्वराः । सकलं निष्कलं चेति द्विविधं वेदवर्णितम्
verses.transliteration: tadeva shivarUpaM hi paThyate cha munIshvarAH | sakalaM niShkalaM cheti dvividhaM vedavarNitam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.४२. द्विचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । सगुणनिर्गुणभेदवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । शिवः को वा हरिः को वा रुद्रः को वा विधिश्च कः । एतेषु निर्गुणः को वा ह्येतं नश्छिन्धि संशयम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.42\. dvichatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | saguNanirguNabhedavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | shivaH ko vA hariH ko vA rudraH ko vA vidhishcha kaH | eteShu nirguNaH ko vA hyetaM nashChindhi saMshayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिवे त्रिगुणसम्भिन्ने रुद्रे तु गुणधामनि । वस्तुतो न हि भेदोऽस्ति स्वर्णे तद्भूषणे यथा
verses.transliteration: shive triguNasambhinne rudre tu guNadhAmani | vastuto na hi bhedo.asti svarNe tadbhUShaNe yathA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: समानरूपकर्माणौ समभक्तगतिप्रदौ । समानाखिलसंसेव्यौ नानालीलाविहारिणौ
verses.transliteration: samAnarUpakarmANau samabhaktagatipradau | samAnAkhilasaMsevyau nAnAlIlAvihAriNau
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वथा शिवरूपो हि रुद्रो रौद्रपराक्रमः । उत्पन्नो भक्तकार्यार्थं हरिब्रह्मसहायकृत्
verses.transliteration: sarvathA shivarUpo hi rudro raudraparAkramaH | utpanno bhaktakAryArthaM haribrahmasahAyakR^it
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ते वै रुद्रं मिलित्वा तु प्रयान्ति प्रकृता इमे । इमान् रुद्रो मिलित्वा तु न याति श्रुतिशासनम्
verses.transliteration: te vai rudraM militvA tu prayAnti prakR^itA ime | imAn rudro militvA tu na yAti shrutishAsanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे रुद्रं भजन्त्येव रुद्रः कञ्चिद्भजेन्न हि । स्वात्मना भक्तवात्सल्याद्भजत्येव कदाचन
verses.transliteration: sarve rudraM bhajantyeva rudraH ka~nchidbhajenna hi | svAtmanA bhaktavAtsalyAdbhajatyeva kadAchana
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यं भजन्ति ये नित्यं तस्मिंस्ते लीनतां गताः । तेनैव रुद्रं ते प्राप्ताः कालेन महता बुधाः
verses.transliteration: anyaM bhajanti ye nityaM tasmiMste lInatAM gatAH | tenaiva rudraM te prAptAH kAlena mahatA budhAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रभक्तास्तु ये केचित्तत्क्षणं शिवतां गताः । अन्यापेक्षा न वै तेषां श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी
verses.transliteration: rudrabhaktAstu ye kechittatkShaNaM shivatAM gatAH | anyApekShA na vai teShAM shrutireShA sanAtanI
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानं विविधं ह्येतद्विज्ञानं विविधं न हि । तत्प्रकारमहं वक्ष्ये शृणुतादरतो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: aj~nAnaM vividhaM hyetadvij~nAnaM vividhaM na hi | tatprakAramahaM vakShye shR^iNutAdarato dvijAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादितृणपर्यन्तं यत्किञ्चिद् दृश्यते त्विह । तत्सर्वं शिव एवास्ति मिथ्या नानात्वकल्पना
verses.transliteration: brahmAditR^iNaparyantaM yatki~nchid dR^ishyate tviha | tatsarvaM shiva evAsti mithyA nAnAtvakalpanA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । यच्चादौ हि समुत्पन्नं निर्गुणात्परमात्मनः । तदेव शिवसंज्ञं हि वेदवेदान्तिनो विदुः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | yachchAdau hi samutpannaM nirguNAtparamAtmanaH | tadeva shivasa.nj~naM hi vedavedAntino viduH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टेः पूर्वं शिवः प्रोक्तः सृष्टेर्मध्ये शिवस्तथा । सृष्टेरन्ते शिवः प्रोक्तः सर्वशून्ये सदाशिवः
verses.transliteration: sR^iShTeH pUrvaM shivaH proktaH sR^iShTermadhye shivastathA | sR^iShTerante shivaH proktaH sarvashUnye sadAshivaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्चतुर्गुणः प्रोक्तः शिव एव मुनीश्वराः । स एव सगुणो ज्ञेयः शक्तिमत्त्वाद् द्विधापि सः
verses.transliteration: tasmAchchaturguNaH proktaH shiva eva munIshvarAH | sa eva saguNo j~neyaH shaktimattvAd dvidhApi saH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: येनैव विष्णवे दत्ताः सर्वे वेदाः सनातनाः । वर्णा मात्रा ह्यनेकाश्च ध्यानं स्वस्य च पूजनम्
verses.transliteration: yenaiva viShNave dattAH sarve vedAH sanAtanAH | varNA mAtrA hyanekAshcha dhyAnaM svasya cha pUjanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः सर्वविद्यानां श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी । वेदकर्ता वेदपतिस्तस्माच्छम्भुरुदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: IshAnaH sarvavidyAnAM shrutireShA sanAtanI | vedakartA vedapatistasmAchChambhurudAhR^itaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: स एव शङ्करः साक्षात्सर्वानुग्रहकारकः । कर्ता भर्ता च हर्ता च साक्षी निर्गुण एव सः
verses.transliteration: sa eva sha~NkaraH sAkShAtsarvAnugrahakArakaH | kartA bhartA cha hartA cha sAkShI nirguNa eva saH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अन्येषां कालमानं च कालस्य कलना न हि । महाकालः स्वयं साक्षान्महाकालीसमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: anyeShAM kAlamAnaM cha kAlasya kalanA na hi | mahAkAlaH svayaM sAkShAnmahAkAlIsamAshritaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तथा च ब्राह्मणा रुद्रं तथा कालीं प्रचक्षते । सर्वं ताभ्यां ततः प्राप्तमिच्छया सत्यलीलया
verses.transliteration: tathA cha brAhmaNA rudraM tathA kAlIM prachakShate | sarvaM tAbhyAM tataH prAptamichChayA satyalIlayA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्योत्पादकः कश्चिद्भर्ता हर्ता न तस्य हि । स्वयं सर्वस्य हेतुस्ते कार्यभूताच्युतादयः
verses.transliteration: na tasyotpAdakaH kashchidbhartA hartA na tasya hi | svayaM sarvasya hetuste kAryabhUtAchyutAdayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं च कारणं कार्यं स्वस्य नैव कदाचन । एकोऽप्यनेकतां यातोऽप्यनेकोऽप्येकतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: svayaM cha kAraNaM kAryaM svasya naiva kadAchana | eko.apyanekatAM yAto.apyaneko.apyekatAM vrajet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एकं बीजं बहिर्भूत्वा पुनर्बीजं च जायते । बहुत्वे च स्वयं सर्वं शिवरूपी महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ekaM bIjaM bahirbhUtvA punarbIjaM cha jAyate | bahutve cha svayaM sarvaM shivarUpI maheshvaraH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रकृतिरुत्पन्ना पुरुषेण समन्विता । ताभ्यां तपः कृतं तत्र मूलस्थे च जले सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tasmAtprakR^itirutpannA puruSheNa samanvitA | tAbhyAM tapaH kR^itaM tatra mUlasthe cha jale sudhIH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्परं शिवज्ञानं तत्त्वतस्तदुदाहृतम् । जानाति ज्ञानवानेव नान्यः कश्चिदृषीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: etatparaM shivaj~nAnaM tattvatastadudAhR^itam | jAnAti j~nAnavAneva nAnyaH kashchidR^iShIshvarAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । ज्ञानं सलक्षणं ब्रूहि यज्ज्ञात्वा शिवतां व्रजेत् । कथं शिवश्च तत्सर्वं सर्वं वा शिव एव च
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | j~nAnaM salakShaNaM brUhi yajj~nAtvA shivatAM vrajet | kathaM shivashcha tatsarvaM sarvaM vA shiva eva cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । एतदाकर्ण्य वचनं सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः । स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं मुनींस्तानब्रवीद्वचः
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | etadAkarNya vachanaM sUtaH paurANikottamaH | smR^itvA shivapadAmbhojaM munIMstAnabravIdvachaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चक्रोशीति विख्याता काशी सर्वातिवल्लभा । व्याप्तं च सकलं ह्येतत्तज्जलं विश्वतो गतम्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchakroshIti vikhyAtA kAshI sarvAtivallabhA | vyAptaM cha sakalaM hyetattajjalaM vishvato gatam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च ये समुत्पन्ना यथानुक्रमतो लयम् । यान्ति नैव तथा रुद्रः शिवे रुद्रो विलीयते
verses.transliteration: anye cha ye samutpannA yathAnukramato layam | yAnti naiva tathA rudraH shive rudro vilIyate
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सम्भाव्य मायया युक्तस्तत्र सुप्तो हरिः स वै । नारायणेति विख्यातो माया नारायणी मता
verses.transliteration: sambhAvya mAyayA yuktastatra supto hariH sa vai | nArAyaNeti vikhyAto mAyA nArAyaNI matA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तन्नाभिकमले यो वै जातः स च पितामहः । तेनैव तपसा दृष्टः स वै विष्णुरुदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: tannAbhikamale yo vai jAtaH sa cha pitAmahaH | tenaiva tapasA dR^iShTaH sa vai viShNurudAhR^itaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: उभयोर्वादशमने यद्रूपं स दर्शितं बुधाः । महादेवेति विख्यातं निर्गुणेन शिवेन हि
verses.transliteration: ubhayorvAdashamane yadrUpaM sa darshitaM budhAH | mahAdeveti vikhyAtaM nirguNena shivena hi
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तेन प्रोक्तमहं शम्भुर्भविष्यामि कभालतः । रुद्रो नाम स विख्यातो लोकानुग्रहकारकः
verses.transliteration: tena proktamahaM shambhurbhaviShyAmi kabhAlataH | rudro nAma sa vikhyAto lokAnugrahakArakaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानार्थं चैव सर्वेषामरूपो रूपवानभूत् । स एव च शिवः साक्षाद्भक्तवात्सल्यकारकः
verses.transliteration: dhyAnArthaM chaiva sarveShAmarUpo rUpavAnabhUt | sa eva cha shivaH sAkShAdbhaktavAtsalyakArakaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्रसंहिता ४.४३. त्रिचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । ज्ञाननिरूपणम् । सूत उवाच । श्रूयतामृषयः सर्वे शिवज्ञानं यथा श्रुतम् । कथयामि महागुह्यं परमुक्तिस्वरूपकम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || chaturthI koTirudrasaMhitA 4\.43\. trichatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | j~nAnanirUpaNam | sUta uvAcha | shrUyatAmR^iShayaH sarve shivaj~nAnaM yathA shrutam | kathayAmi mahAguhyaM paramuktisvarUpakam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्याप्यंशस्य जीवांऽशो ह्यविद्यामोहितोऽवशः । अन्योऽहमिति जानाति तया मुक्तो भवेच्छिवः
verses.transliteration: svasyApyaMshasya jIvAM.asho hyavidyAmohito.avashaH | anyo.ahamiti jAnAti tayA mukto bhavechChivaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं व्याप्य शिवः साक्षाद् व्यापकः सर्वजन्तुषु । चेतनाचेतनेशोऽपि सर्वत्र शङ्करः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaM vyApya shivaH sAkShAd vyApakaH sarvajantuShu | chetanAchetanesho.api sarvatra sha~NkaraH svayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: उपायं यः करोत्यस्य दर्शनार्थं विचक्षणः । वेदान्तमार्गमाश्रित्य तद्दर्शनफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: upAyaM yaH karotyasya darshanArthaM vichakShaNaH | vedAntamArgamAshritya taddarshanaphalaM labhet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यथाग्निर्व्यापकश्चैव काष्ठे काष्ठे च तिष्ठति । यो वै मन्थति तत्काष्ठं स वै पश्यत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: yathAgnirvyApakashchaiva kAShThe kAShThe cha tiShThati | yo vai manthati tatkAShThaM sa vai pashyatyasaMshayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्यादिसाधनानीह यः करोति विचक्षणः । स वै पश्यत्यवश्यं हि तं शिवं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyAdisAdhanAnIha yaH karoti vichakShaNaH | sa vai pashyatyavashyaM hi taM shivaM nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शिवःशिवःशिवश्चैव नान्यदस्तीति किञ्चन । भ्रान्त्या नानास्वरूपो हि भासते शङ्करः सदा
verses.transliteration: shivaHshivaHshivashchaiva nAnyadastIti ki~nchana | bhrAntyA nAnAsvarUpo hi bhAsate sha~NkaraH sadA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यथा समुद्रो मृच्चैव सुवर्णमथवा पुनः । उपाधितो हि नानात्वं लभते शङ्करस्तथा
verses.transliteration: yathA samudro mR^ichchaiva suvarNamathavA punaH | upAdhito hi nAnAtvaM labhate sha~NkarastathA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कार्यकारणयोर्भेदो वस्तुतो न प्रवर्तते । केवलं भ्रान्तिबुद्ध्यैव तदभावे स नश्यति
verses.transliteration: kAryakAraNayorbhedo vastuto na pravartate | kevalaM bhrAntibuddhyaiva tadabhAve sa nashyati
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यदा बीजात्प्ररोहश्च नानात्वं हि प्रकाशयेत् । अन्ते च बीजमेव स्यात्तत्प्ररोहश्च नश्यति
verses.transliteration: yadA bIjAtprarohashcha nAnAtvaM hi prakAshayet | ante cha bIjameva syAttatprarohashcha nashyati
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानी च बीजमेव स्यात्प्ररोहो विकृतीर्मता । तन्निवृत्तौ पुनर्ज्ञानी नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: j~nAnI cha bIjameva syAtpraroho vikR^itIrmatA | tannivR^ittau punarj~nAnI nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: कनारदकुमाराणां व्यासस्य कपिलस्य च । एतेषां च समाजे तैर्निश्चित्य समुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: kanAradakumArANAM vyAsasya kapilasya cha | eteShAM cha samAje tairnishchitya samudAhR^itam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं शिवः शिवः सर्वो नास्ति भेदश्च कश्चन । कथं च विविधं पश्यत्येकत्वं च कथं पुनः
verses.transliteration: sarvaM shivaH shivaH sarvo nAsti bhedashcha kashchana | kathaM cha vividhaM pashyatyekatvaM cha kathaM punaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यथैकं चैव सूर्याख्यं ज्योतिर्नानाविधं जनैः । जलादौ च विशेषेण दृश्यते तत्तथैव सः
verses.transliteration: yathaikaM chaiva sUryAkhyaM jyotirnAnAvidhaM janaiH | jalAdau cha visheSheNa dR^ishyate tattathaiva saH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र व्यापकश्चैव स्पर्शत्वं न विबध्यते । तथैव व्यापको देवो बध्यते न क्वचित्स वै
verses.transliteration: sarvatra vyApakashchaiva sparshatvaM na vibadhyate | tathaiva vyApako devo badhyate na kvachitsa vai
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: साहङ्कारस्तथा जीवस्तन्मुक्तः शङ्करः स्वयम् । जीवस्तुच्छः कर्मभोगी निर्लिप्तः शङ्करो महान्
verses.transliteration: sAha~NkArastathA jIvastanmuktaH sha~NkaraH svayam | jIvastuchChaH karmabhogI nirliptaH sha~Nkaro mahAn
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यथैकं च सुवर्णादि मिलितं रजतादिना । अल्पमूल्यं प्रजायेत तथा जीवोऽप्यहंयुतः
verses.transliteration: yathaikaM cha suvarNAdi militaM rajatAdinA | alpamUlyaM prajAyeta tathA jIvo.apyahaMyutaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यथैव हि सुवर्णादि क्षारादेः शोधितं शुभम् । पूर्ववन्मूल्यतां याति तथा जीवोऽपि संस्कृतेः
verses.transliteration: yathaiva hi suvarNAdi kShArAdeH shodhitaM shubham | pUrvavanmUlyatAM yAti tathA jIvo.api saMskR^iteH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं सद्गुरुं प्राप्य भक्तिभावसमन्वितः । शिवबुद्ध्या करोत्युच्चैः पूजनं स्मरणादिकम्
verses.transliteration: prathamaM sadguruM prApya bhaktibhAvasamanvitaH | shivabuddhyA karotyuchchaiH pUjanaM smaraNAdikam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तद्बुध्या देहतो याति सर्वपापादिको मलः । तदाज्ञानं च नश्येत ज्ञानवाञ्जायते यदा
verses.transliteration: tadbudhyA dehato yAti sarvapApAdiko malaH | tadAj~nAnaM cha nashyeta j~nAnavA~njAyate yadA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तदाहङ्कारनिर्मुक्तो जीवो निर्मलबुद्धिमान् । शङ्करस्य प्रसादेन याति शङ्करतां पुनः
verses.transliteration: tadAha~NkAranirmukto jIvo nirmalabuddhimAn | sha~Nkarasya prasAdena yAti sha~NkaratAM punaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यथादर्शस्वरूपे च स्वीयरूपं प्रदृश्यते । तथा सर्वत्रगं शम्भुं पश्यतीति सुनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: yathAdarshasvarUpe cha svIyarUpaM pradR^ishyate | tathA sarvatragaM shambhuM pashyatIti sunishchitam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इति ज्ञानं सदा ज्ञेयं सर्वं शिवमयं जगत् । शिवः सर्वमयो ज्ञेयः सर्वज्ञेन विपश्चिता
verses.transliteration: iti j~nAnaM sadA j~neyaM sarvaM shivamayaM jagat | shivaH sarvamayo j~neyaH sarvaj~nena vipashchitA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: जीवन्मुक्तः स एवासौ देहः शिर्णः शिवे मिलेत् । प्रारब्धवशगो देहस्तद्भिन्नो ज्ञानवान् मतः
verses.transliteration: jIvanmuktaH sa evAsau dehaH shirNaH shive milet | prArabdhavashago dehastadbhinno j~nAnavAn mataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शुभं लब्ध्वा न हृष्येत कुप्येल्लब्ध्वाशुभं न हि । द्वन्द्वेषु समता यस्य ज्ञानवानुच्यते हि सः
verses.transliteration: shubhaM labdhvA na hR^iShyeta kupyellabdhvAshubhaM na hi | dvandveShu samatA yasya j~nAnavAnuchyate hi saH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मयोगेन तत्त्वानामथवा च विवेकतः । यथा शरीरतो यायाच्छरीरं मुक्तिमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: Atmayogena tattvAnAmathavA cha vivekataH | yathA sharIrato yAyAchCharIraM muktimichChatA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवो विलीयेत मुक्तो विरहमेव च । ज्ञानमूलं तथाध्यात्म्यं तस्य भक्तिः शिवस्य च
verses.transliteration: sadAshivo vilIyeta mukto virahameva cha | j~nAnamUlaM tathAdhyAtmyaM tasya bhaktiH shivasya cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तेश्च प्रेम सम्प्रोक्तं प्रेम्णश्च श्रवणं तथा । श्रवणाच्चापि सत्सङ्गः सत्सङ्गाच्च गुरुर्बुधः
verses.transliteration: bhakteshcha prema samproktaM premNashcha shravaNaM tathA | shravaNAchchApi satsa~NgaH satsa~NgAchcha gururbudhaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पन्ने च तथा ज्ञाने मुक्तो भवति निश्चितम् । इति चेज्ज्ञानवान्यो वै शम्भुमेव सदा भजेत्
verses.transliteration: sampanne cha tathA j~nAne mukto bhavati nishchitam | iti chejj~nAnavAnyo vai shambhumeva sadA bhajet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्यया च भक्त्या वै युक्तः शम्भुं भजेत्पुनः । अन्ते च मुक्तिमायाति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: ananyayA cha bhaktyA vai yuktaH shambhuM bhajetpunaH | ante cha muktimAyAti nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अतोऽधिको न देवोऽस्ति मुक्तिप्राप्त्यै च शङ्करात् । शरणं प्राप्य यं चैव संसाराद्विनिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: ato.adhiko na devo.asti muktiprAptyai cha sha~NkarAt | sharaNaM prApya yaM chaiva saMsArAdvinivartate
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इति मे विविधं वाक्यमृषीणां च समागतैः । निश्चित्य कथितं विप्रा धिया धार्यं प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: iti me vividhaM vAkyamR^iShINAM cha samAgataiH | nishchitya kathitaM viprA dhiyA dhAryaM prayatnataH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं विष्णवे दत्तं शम्भुना लिङ्गसम्मुखे । विष्णुना ब्रह्मणे दत्तं ब्रह्मणा सनकादिषु
verses.transliteration: prathamaM viShNave dattaM shambhunA li~Ngasammukhe | viShNunA brahmaNe dattaM brahmaNA sanakAdiShu
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: आब्रह्मतृणपर्यन्तं यत्किञ्चिद् दृश्यते जगत् । तत्सर्वं शिव एवास्ति स देवः शिव उच्यते
verses.transliteration: AbrahmatR^iNaparyantaM yatki~nchid dR^ishyate jagat | tatsarvaM shiva evAsti sa devaH shiva uchyate
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: नारदाय ततः प्रोक्तं तज्ज्ञानं सनकादिभिः । व्यासाय नारदेनोक्तं तेन मह्यं कृपालुना
verses.transliteration: nAradAya tataH proktaM tajj~nAnaM sanakAdibhiH | vyAsAya nAradenoktaM tena mahyaM kR^ipAlunA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मया चैव भवद्भ्यश्च भवद्भिर्लोकहेतवे । स्थापनीयं प्रयत्नेन शिवप्राप्तिकरं च तत्
verses.transliteration: mayA chaiva bhavadbhyashcha bhavadbhirlokahetave | sthApanIyaM prayatnena shivaprAptikaraM cha tat
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इति वश्च समाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽहं मुनीश्वराः । गोपनीयं प्रयत्नेन किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: iti vashcha samAkhyAtaM yatpR^iShTo.ahaM munIshvarAH | gopanIyaM prayatnena kimanyachChrotumichChatha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । एतचछ्रुत्वा तु ऋषय आनन्दं परमं गताः । हर्षगद्गदया वाचा नत्वा ते तुष्टुवुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | etachaChrutvA tu R^iShaya AnandaM paramaM gatAH | harShagadgadayA vAchA natvA te tuShTuvurmuhuH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । व्यासशिष्य नमस्तेऽस्तु धन्यस्त्वं शैवसत्तम । श्रावितं नः परं वस्तु शैवं ज्ञानमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | vyAsashiShya namaste.astu dhanyastvaM shaivasattama | shrAvitaM naH paraM vastu shaivaM j~nAnamanuttamam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं चेतसो भ्रान्तिर्गता हि कृपया तव । सन्तुष्टाः शिवसज्ज्ञानं प्राप्य त्वत्तो विमुक्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: asmAkaM chetaso bhrAntirgatA hi kR^ipayA tava | santuShTAH shivasajj~nAnaM prApya tvatto vimuktidam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । नास्तिकाय न वक्तव्यमश्रद्धाय शठाय च । अभक्ताय महेशस्य न चाशुश्रुषवे द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | nAstikAya na vaktavyamashraddhAya shaThAya cha | abhaktAya maheshasya na chAshushruShave dvijAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणानि वेदाच्छास्त्राणि चासकृत् । विचार्य्योद्धृत्य तत्सारं मह्यं व्यासेन भाषितम्
verses.transliteration: itihAsapurANAni vedAchChAstrANi chAsakR^it | vichAryyoddhR^itya tatsAraM mahyaM vyAsena bhAShitam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा ह्येकवारं भवेत्पापं हि भस्मसात् । अभक्तो भक्तिमाप्नोति भक्तस्य भक्तिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: etachChrutvA hyekavAraM bhavetpApaM hi bhasmasAt | abhakto bhaktimApnoti bhaktasya bhaktivardhanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः श्रुते च सद्भक्तिर्मुक्तिः स्याच्च श्रुतेः पुनः । तस्मात्पुनः पुनः श्राव्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिफलेप्सुभिः
verses.transliteration: punaH shrute cha sadbhaktirmuktiH syAchcha shruteH punaH | tasmAtpunaH punaH shrAvyaM bhuktimuktiphalepsubhiH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यदेच्छा तस्य जायेत तदा च क्रियते त्विदम् । सर्वं स एव जानाति तं न जानाति कश्चन
verses.transliteration: yadechChA tasya jAyeta tadA cha kriyate tvidam | sarvaM sa eva jAnAti taM na jAnAti kashchana
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: आवृत्तयः पञ्च कार्याः समुद्दिश्य फलं परम् । तत्प्राप्नोति न सन्देहो व्यासस्य वचनं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: AvR^ittayaH pa~ncha kAryAH samuddishya phalaM param | tatprApnoti na sandeho vyAsasya vachanaM tvidam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: न दुर्लभं हि तस्यैव येनेदं श्रुतमुत्तमम् । पञ्चकृत्वस्तदावृत्त्या लभ्यते शिवदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: na durlabhaM hi tasyaiva yenedaM shrutamuttamam | pa~nchakR^itvastadAvR^ittyA labhyate shivadarshanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: पुरातनाश्च राजानो विप्रा वैश्याश्च सत्तमाः । इदं श्रुत्वा पञ्चकृत्वो धिया सिद्धिं परां गताः
verses.transliteration: purAtanAshcha rAjAno viprA vaishyAshcha sattamAH | idaM shrutvA pa~nchakR^itvo dhiyA siddhiM parAM gatAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोष्यत्यद्यापि यश्चेदं मानवो भक्तितत्परः । विज्ञानं शिवसंज्ञं वै भुक्तिं मुक्तिं लभेच्च सः
verses.transliteration: shroShyatyadyApi yashchedaM mAnavo bhaktitatparaH | vij~nAnaM shivasa.nj~naM vai bhuktiM muktiM labhechcha saH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा परमानन्दमागताः । समानर्चुश्च ते सूतं नानावस्तुभिरादरात्
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | iti tadvachanaM shrutvA paramAnandamAgatAH | samAnarchushcha te sUtaM nAnAvastubhirAdarAt
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कारैः स्तवैश्चैव स्वस्तिवाचनपूर्वकम् । आशीर्भिर्वर्धयामासुः सन्तुष्टाश्छिन्नसंशयाः
verses.transliteration: namaskAraiH stavaishchaiva svastivAchanapUrvakam | AshIrbhirvardhayAmAsuH santuShTAshChinnasaMshayAH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परं च सन्तुष्टाः सूतस्ते च सुबुद्धयः । शम्भुं देवं परं मत्वा नमन्ति स्म भजन्ति च
verses.transliteration: parasparaM cha santuShTAH sUtaste cha subuddhayaH | shambhuM devaM paraM matvA namanti sma bhajanti cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छिवसुविज्ञानं शिवस्यातिप्रियं महत् । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं दिव्यं शिवभक्तिविवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: etachChivasuvij~nAnaM shivasyAtipriyaM mahat | bhuktimuktipradaM divyaM shivabhaktivivardhanam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: इयं हि संहिता पुण्या कोटिरुद्राह्वया परा । चतुर्थी शिवपुराणस्य कथिता मे मुदावहा
verses.transliteration: iyaM hi saMhitA puNyA koTirudrAhvayA parA | chaturthI shivapurANasya kathitA me mudAvahA
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एतां यः शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । स भुक्त्वेहाखिलान्भोगानन्ते परगतिं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: etAM yaH shR^iNuyAdbhaktyA shrAvayedvA samAhitaH | sa bhuktvehAkhilAnbhogAnante paragatiM labhet
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: रचयित्वा स्वयं तच्च प्रविश्य दूरतः स्थितः । न तत्र च प्रविष्टोऽसौ निर्लिप्तश्चित्स्वरूपवान्
verses.transliteration: rachayitvA svayaM tachcha pravishya dUrataH sthitaH | na tatra cha praviShTo.asau nirliptashchitsvarUpavAn
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यथा च ज्योतिषश्चैव जलादौ प्रतिबिम्बता । वस्तुतो न प्रवेशो वै तथैव च शिवः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: yathA cha jyotiShashchaiva jalAdau pratibimbatA | vastuto na pravesho vai tathaiva cha shivaH svayam
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: वस्तुतस्तु स्वयं सर्वं क्रमो हि भासते शुभः । अज्ञानं च मतेर्भेदो नास्त्यन्यच्च द्वयं पुनः
verses.transliteration: vastutastu svayaM sarvaM kramo hi bhAsate shubhaH | aj~nAnaM cha materbhedo nAstyanyachcha dvayaM punaH
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनेषु च सर्वेषु मतिभेदः प्रदर्श्यते । परं वेदान्तिनो नित्यमद्वैतं प्रतिचक्षते
verses.transliteration: darshaneShu cha sarveShu matibhedaH pradarshyate | paraM vedAntino nityamadvaitaM pratichakShate
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion and narrates this with pure mind enjoys all pleasures here and attains salvation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ पञ्चमी उमासंहिता ५.१. प्रथमोऽध्यायः । ऋष्णोपमन्युसंवादे स्वगतिवर्णनम् । यो धत्ते भुवनानि सत्त्वगुणवान्स्रष्टा रजःसंश्रयः संहर्त्ता तमसान्वितो गुणवतीं मायामतीत्य स्थितः । सत्यानन्दमनन्तबोधममलं ब्रह्मादिसंज्ञास्पदं नित्यं सत्त्वसमन्वयादधिगतं पूर्णं शिवं धीमहि
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || pa~nchamI umAsaMhitA 5\.1\. prathamo.adhyAyaH | R^iShNopamanyusaMvAde svagativarNanam | yo dhatte bhuvanAni sattvaguNavAnsraShTA rajaHsaMshrayaH saMharttA tamasAnvito guNavatIM mAyAmatItya sthitaH | satyAnandamanantabodhamamalaM brahmAdisa.nj~nAspadaM nityaM sattvasamanvayAdadhigataM pUrNaM shivaM dhImahi
verses.translation: Now please narrate the story of Siva, the supreme soul, accompanied by Uma—Parvati—the story that is full of incidental anecdotes.
verses.hindi: एवं उत्तम शिवके चरित्रको प्रेमपूर्वक सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूहि शङ्करमाहात्म्यं सदानन्दकरं मुने । यच्छ्रुत्वा भक्तितः कुर्यां तप ऐश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: brUhi sha~NkaramAhAtmyaM sadAnandakaraM mune | yachChrutvA bhaktitaH kuryAM tapa aishvaramuttamam
verses.translation: O Saunaka®* and other sages, please listen with devotion to the divinely auspicious story of Siva, that yields worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.hindi: शिवजीके सुन्दर चरित्रका वर्णन किया था

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य वासुदेवस्य धीमतः । प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा ह्युपमन्युः स्मरन् शिवम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasya vAsudevasya dhImataH | pratyuvAcha prasannAtmA hyupamanyuH smaran shivam
verses.translation: See P I note.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । शृणु कृष्ण महाशैव महिमानं महेशितुः । यमद्राक्षमहं शम्भोर्भक्तिवर्धनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | shR^iNu kR^iShNa mahAshaiva mahimAnaM maheshituH | yamadrAkShamahaM shambhorbhaktivardhanamuttamam
verses.translation: 'Formerly Krsna, son of Vasudeva went to Kailasa*®* the abode of Siva in order to perform the penance to propi¬ tiate Siva for obtaining a son.

verses.sanskrit: तपःस्थोऽहं समद्राक्षं शङ्करं च तदायुधान् । परिवारं समस्तं च विष्ण्वादीनमरादिकान्
verses.transliteration: tapaHstho.ahaM samadrAkShaM sha~NkaraM cha tadAyudhAn | parivAraM samastaM cha viShNvAdInamarAdikAn
verses.translation: On seeing the sage Upamanyu performing the penance on the excellent summit he bowed to him with devotion and asked him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: शिवजीका स्मरण करते हुए कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिरंशैः शोभमानमजस्रसुखमव्ययम् । एकपादं महादंष्ट्रं सज्वालकवलैर्मुखैः
verses.transliteration: tribhiraMshaiH shobhamAnamajasrasukhamavyayam | ekapAdaM mahAdaMShTraM sajvAlakavalairmukhaiH
verses.translation: O Upamanyu of great intellect, O foren-ost of the devotees of Siva with good intellect. I have come here to perform the panance of Siva for obtaining a son.

verses.sanskrit: द्विसहस्रमयूखानां ज्योतिषातिविराजितम् । सर्वास्त्रप्रवराबाधमनेकाक्षं सहस्रपात्
verses.transliteration: dvisahasramayUkhAnAM jyotiShAtivirAjitam | sarvAstrapravarAbAdhamanekAkShaM sahasrapAt
verses.translation: O sage, please narrate the greatness of Siva, de¬ lightful to the good, on hearing which I shall perform the penance of Siva with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: यश्च कल्पान्तसमये विश्वं संहरति ध्रुवम् । नावध्यो यस्य च भवेत्त्रैलौक्ये सचराचरे
verses.transliteration: yashcha kalpAntasamaye vishvaM saMharati dhruvam | nAvadhyo yasya cha bhavettrailaukye sacharAchare
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the intelligent Krna, Upamanyu was delighted in his mind. Remembering Siva, he replied.

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरभुजोत्सृष्टं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । निर्ददाह द्रुतं कृत्स्नं निमेषार्द्धान्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: maheshvarabhujotsR^iShTaM trailokyaM sacharAcharam | nirdadAha drutaM kR^itsnaM nimeShArddhAnna saMshayaH
verses.translation: O Krsna, great devotee of Siva, listen to the glory of Siva which I have witnessed myself. It is excellent story that enhances devotion to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तपःस्थो रुद्रपार्श्वस्थं दृष्टवानहमव्ययम् । गुह्यमस्त्रं परं चास्य न तुल्यमधिकं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: tapaHstho rudrapArshvasthaM dR^iShTavAnahamavyayam | guhyamastraM paraM chAsya na tulyamadhikaM kvachit
verses.translation: While performing penance, I saw Siva, his weapons, his followers and Vi§nu and other gods.
verses.hindi: स्तोत्रोंद्वारा उनकी स्तुति कर रहे थे

verses.sanskrit: यत्तच्छूलमिति ख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु शूलिनः । विजयाभिधमत्युग्रं सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रनाशकम्
verses.transliteration: yattachChUlamiti khyAtaM sarvalokeShu shUlinaH | vijayAbhidhamatyugraM sarvashastrAstranAshakam
verses.translation: He who decisively annihilates the universe at the end of a kalpa and for whom there was none to be spared from death in the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings which being cast away from his hands burnt instantaneously and entirely, certainly within half a moment.
verses.hindi: देखकर मैं अत्यधिक आश्चर्यचकित हो गया

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । सूत सूत महाप्राज्ञ व्यासशिष्य नमोऽस्तु ते । चतुर्थी कोटिरुद्राख्या श्राविता संहिता त्वया
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | sUta sUta mahAprAj~na vyAsashiShya namo.astu te | chaturthI koTirudrAkhyA shrAvitA saMhitA tvayA
verses.translation: While performing penance, I saw at the side of Rudra the imperishable highly secret weapon which had no other missile superior or equal to it.
verses.hindi: हुए प्रेमपूर्वक मधुर वाणीमें मुझसे कहा--

verses.sanskrit: दारयेद्यन्महीं कृत्स्नां शोषयेद्यन्महोदधिम् । पातयेदखिलं ज्योतिश्चक्रं यन्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: dArayedyanmahIM kR^itsnAM shoShayedyanmahodadhim | pAtayedakhilaM jyotishchakraM yannAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: It WM the weapon with which Yauvanava*®* the emperor of great refulgence and Mandhatr the powerful king who conquered the three worlds were killed formerly.
verses.hindi: सत्यसे मुझे त्रिकालज्ञता प्राप्त हो जाय

verses.sanskrit: यौवनाश्वो हतो येन मान्धाता सबलः पुरा । चक्रवर्ती महातेजास्त्रैलोक्यविजयो नृपः
verses.transliteration: yauvanAshvo hato yena mAndhAtA sabalaH purA | chakravartI mahAtejAstrailokyavijayo nR^ipaH
verses.translation: It stood as if threatening all with the three spikes for its knit eyebrows. It was like a blazing smokeless fire and the rising sun.

verses.sanskrit: दर्पाविष्टो हैहयश्च निःक्षिप्तो लवणासुरः । शत्रुघ्नं नृपतिं युद्धे समाहूय समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: darpAviShTo haihayashcha niHkShipto lavaNAsuraH | shatrughnaM nR^ipatiM yuddhe samAhUya samantataH
verses.translation: I saw his sharp-edged axe decorated with serpents etc. It was as terrible as the god of death holding
verses.hindi: बनी रहे तथा अन्य लोगोंके प्रति उदासीनता रहे

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्दैत्ये विनष्टे तु रुद्रहस्ते गतं तु यत् । तच्छूलमिति तीक्ष्णाग्रं सन्त्रासजननं महत्
verses.transliteration: tasmindaitye vinaShTe tu rudrahaste gataM tu yat | tachChUlamiti tIkShNAgraM santrAsajananaM mahat
verses.translation: The epithet identifies Siva uith the thousand-footed Puiu;a mentioned in the Purusasiikta of the 8gveda.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशिखां भृकुटीं कृत्वा तर्जयन्तमिव स्थितम् । विधूम्रानलसङ्काशं बालसूर्यमिवोदितम्
verses.transliteration: trishikhAM bhR^ikuTIM kR^itvA tarjayantamiva sthitam | vidhUmrAnalasa~NkAshaM bAlasUryamivoditam
verses.translation: Most probably it refers to tlie Plaihaya king Arjuna K&rttavirya, of a thousand arms who was clefrated and had his arms cut off by Paraurama.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पहस्तमनिर्देश्यं पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम् । परशुं तीक्ष्णधारं च सर्पाद्यैश्च विभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: sarpahastamanirdeshyaM pAshahastamivAntakam | parashuM tIkShNadhAraM cha sarpAdyaishcha vibhUShitam
verses.translation: I saw the discus Sudarsana in the shape of a human being with a thousand faces and two thousand hands. It was divine and lordly.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पान्तदहनाकारं तथा पुरुषविग्रहम् । यत्तद्भार्गवरामस्य क्षत्रियान्तकरं रणे
verses.transliteration: kalpAntadahanAkAraM tathA puruShavigraham | yattadbhArgavarAmasya kShatriyAntakaraM raNe
verses.translation: It had two thousand eyes of fiery brilliance, and one thousand legs. It shone like a crore suns. It was capable of burning the three worlds.
verses.hindi: रहूँगा, है वत्स! आप सब प्रकारसे मेरे प्रिय हैं

verses.sanskrit: रामो यद्बलमाश्रित्य शिवदत्तश्च वै पुरा । त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो स क्षत्रं ददाह हृषितो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: rAmo yadbalamAshritya shivadattashcha vai purA | triHsaptakR^itvo sa kShatraM dadAha hR^iShito muniH
verses.translation: I saw the sharp and refulgent thunderbolt of hundred spikes of extreme excellence. I saw the great bow Pinaka of excessive brilliance and its quiver of arrows.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण हो जायँगे, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्शनं तथा चक्रं सहस्रवदनं विभुम् । द्विसहस्रभुजं देवमद्राक्षं पुरुषाकृतिम्
verses.transliteration: sudarshanaM tathA chakraM sahasravadanaM vibhum | dvisahasrabhujaM devamadrAkShaM puruShAkR^itim
verses.translation: I saw the Sakti, the sword, the noose of great brilliance and a goad, the great divine iron club, and many other weapons.

verses.sanskrit: द्विसहस्रेक्षणं दीप्तं सहस्रचरणाकुलम् । कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशं त्रैलोक्यदहनक्षमम्
verses.transliteration: dvisahasrekShaNaM dIptaM sahasracharaNAkulam | koTisUryapratIkAshaM trailokyadahanakShamam
verses.translation: On either side of Lord Rudra, I saw the weapons of the guardians of the quarters.
verses.hindi: सब उनके ध्यानके द्वारा मैंने प्राप्त किया

verses.sanskrit: अथोमासंहितान्तःस्थनानाख्यानसमन्वितम् । ब्रूहि शम्भोश्चरित्रं वै साम्बस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: athomAsaMhitAntaHsthanAnAkhyAnasamanvitam | brUhi shambhoshcharitraM vai sAmbasya paramAtmanaH
verses.translation: Narayana, holding conch, discus and mace, stood on his left, seated on the Garuda.
verses.hindi: ऋषीन्विद्याधरांश्चैव पश्य सिद्धान्व्यवस्थितान् ॥ ०  ऋषियों हा न सिद्धोंको देखिये

verses.sanskrit: वज्रं महोज्ज्वलं तीक्ष्णं शतपर्वमनुत्तमम् । महाधनुः पिनाकं च सतूणीरं महाद्युतिम्
verses.transliteration: vajraM mahojjvalaM tIkShNaM shataparvamanuttamam | mahAdhanuH pinAkaM cha satUNIraM mahAdyutim
verses.translation: Brahma and other Manus, Bhrgu and other sages, Indra and other gods, all were there.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिं खङ्गं च पाशं च महादीप्तं समाङ्कुशम् । गदां च महतीं दिव्यामन्यान्यस्त्राणि दृष्टवान्
verses.transliteration: shaktiM kha~NgaM cha pAshaM cha mahAdIptaM samA~Nkusham | gadAM cha mahatIM divyAmanyAnyastrANi dR^iShTavAn
verses.translation: Holding his l§akti and a bell and seated on his peacock, Skanda stood near the goddess like another firegod.
verses.hindi: अर्थोके द्रष्टा और प्रधान पुरुषेश्वर हैं

verses.sanskrit: तथा च लोकपालानामस्त्राण्येतानि यानि च । अद्राक्षं तानि सर्वाणि भगवद्रुद्रपार्श्वतः
verses.transliteration: tathA cha lokapAlAnAmastrANyetAni yAni cha | adrAkShaM tAni sarvANi bhagavadrudrapArshvataH
verses.translation: Nandin stood in front of Siva holding the trident. All the goblins, Gan as and the mothers were pre¬ sent there.

verses.sanskrit: सव्यदेशे तु देवस्य ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । विमानं दिव्यमास्थाय हंसयुक्तं मनोऽनुगम्
verses.transliteration: savyadeshe tu devasya brahmA lokapitAmahaH | vimAnaM divyamAsthAya haMsayuktaM mano.anugam
verses.translation: Bowing to lord Siva and surrounding him on all sides, the gods eulogised the lord: with different kinds of hymns.
verses.hindi: शीघ्र प्रसन्‍नो भविता शिवस्ते भक्तवत्सल: ॥ ७१  शीघ्र ही प्रसन्‍न होंगे

verses.sanskrit: वामपार्श्वे तु तस्यैव शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । वैनतेयं समास्थाय तथा नारायणः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: vAmapArshve tu tasyaiva sha~NkhachakragadAdharaH | vainateyaM samAsthAya tathA nArAyaNaH sthitaH
verses.translation: With the axe received from lord Siva, ParasurSma cleared the earth of the Katriyas tlirirr seven limes and gave the earth to the 3 rahmins.
verses.hindi: शति श्रीजिकमहाएुराणे पश्चम्याम॒मासंहितायां कृष्णोपमन्युसंवादे स्वग॒तिवर्णन॑ नाम प्रथमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवाद्या मनवो भृग्वाद्या ऋषयस्तथा । शक्राद्या देवताश्चैव सर्व एव समं ययुः
verses.transliteration: svAyambhuvAdyA manavo bhR^igvAdyA R^iShayastathA | shakrAdyA devatAshchaiva sarva eva samaM yayuH
verses.translation: O Krsna, it appeared as though somtf sacrifice was going on there. In that sacrifice I became immersed in great delight. I was bold to a great extent on sensing Siva in front. With palms joined in reverence and words choked with tears of joy I worshipped him duly with various kinds of hymns.
verses.hindi: स्वगतिवर्णन नामक पहला अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दः शक्तिं समादाय मयूरस्थः सघण्टकः । देव्याः समीपे सन्तस्थौ द्वितीय इव पावकः
verses.transliteration: skandaH shaktiM samAdAya mayUrasthaH saghaNTakaH | devyAH samIpe santasthau dvitIya iva pAvakaH
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord Siva spoke to me laugh¬ ingly in sweet words with great pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दी शूलं समादाय भवाग्रे समवस्थितः । सर्वभूतगणाश्चैव मातरो विविधाः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: nandI shUlaM samAdAya bhavAgre samavasthitaH | sarvabhUtagaNAshchaiva mAtaro vividhAH sthitAH
verses.translation: "O brahmin, you cannot be shaken by me though I try again and again. You have been tested by me. Wel¬ fare be to you You are steadily endowed with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: तेऽभिवाद्य महेशानं परिवार्य समन्ततः । अस्तुवन्विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्महादेवं तदा सुराः
verses.transliteration: te.abhivAdya maheshAnaM parivArya samantataH | astuvanvividhaiH stotrairmahAdevaM tadA surAH
verses.translation: O one of good rites, I am delighted. Choose the boon. There is nothing which cannot be given to you even if it happens to be something rare and inaccessible to all the gods."

verses.sanskrit: यत्किञ्चित्तु जगत्यस्मिन्दृश्यते श्रूयतेऽथवा । तत्सर्वं भगवत्पार्श्वे निरीक्ष्याहं सुविस्मितः
verses.transliteration: yatki~nchittu jagatyasmindR^ishyate shrUyate.athavA | tatsarvaM bhagavatpArshve nirIkShyAhaM suvismitaH
verses.translation: On hearing the loving words of Siva I spoke to the lord sympathetic with the devotees with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण की, उन-उन भक्तोंका वर्णन करूँगा, आप सुनें

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । महर्षयः शौनकाद्याः शृणुत प्रेमतः शुभम् । शाङ्करं चरितं दिव्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं परम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | maharShayaH shaunakAdyAH shR^iNuta premataH shubham | shA~NkaraM charitaM divyaM bhuktimuktipradaM param
verses.translation: "O lord, if you are satisfied and if my devotion is firm and steady, may, in virtue of that truth, my knowledge comprehend the past, present and future.

verses.sanskrit: सुमहद्धैर्यमालम्ब्य प्राञ्जलिर्विविधैः स्तवैः । परमानन्दसम्मग्नोऽभूवं कृष्णाहमध्वरे
verses.transliteration: sumahaddhairyamAlambya prA~njalirvividhaiH stavaiH | paramAnandasammagno.abhUvaM kR^iShNAhamadhvare
verses.translation: Grant me infinite devotion never swerving or straying from you. Let me and my family have milk pudding every day.
verses.hindi: उसके अंगोंमें लगकर चूर-चूर हो गये थे

verses.sanskrit: सम्मुखे शङ्करं दृष्ट्वा बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा । अपूजयं सुविधिवदहं श्रद्धासमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: sammukhe sha~NkaraM dR^iShTvA bAShpagadgadayA girA | apUjayaM suvidhivadahaM shraddhAsamanvitaH
verses.translation: O lord, may you be present in my hermitage every day. Let my mutual friendship with your other devo¬ tees flourish for ever."

verses.sanskrit: भगवानथ सुप्रीतः शङ्करः परमेश्वरः । वाण्या मधुरया प्रीत्या मामाह प्रहसन्निव
verses.transliteration: bhagavAnatha suprItaH sha~NkaraH parameshvaraH | vANyA madhurayA prItyA mAmAha prahasanniva
verses.translation: O leading scion of the family of Yadus, thus requested by me, lord Siva laughed and glanced at me with his merciful eyes. He said to me.

verses.sanskrit: न विचालयितुं शक्यो मया विप्र पुनः पुनः । परीक्षितोऽसि भद्रं ते भवान्भक्त्यान्वितो दृढः
verses.transliteration: na vichAlayituM shakyo mayA vipra punaH punaH | parIkShito.asi bhadraM te bhavAnbhaktyAnvito dR^iDhaH
verses.translation: O Upamanyu, O dear, O sage, you will be free from the defects of old age and death. Achieve all desires.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्ते परितुष्टोऽस्मि वरं वरय सुव्रत । दुर्लभं सर्वदेवेषु नादेयं विद्यते तव
verses.transliteration: tasmAtte parituShTo.asmi varaM varaya suvrata | durlabhaM sarvadeveShu nAdeyaM vidyate tava
verses.translation: You will deserve the worship of the sages. You

verses.sanskrit: स चाहं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा शम्भोः सत्प्रेमसंयुतम् । देवं तं प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वाब्रुवं भक्तानुकम्पिनम्
verses.transliteration: sa chAhaM tadvachaH shrutvA shambhoH satpremasaMyutam | devaM taM prA~njalirbhUtvAbruvaM bhaktAnukampinam
verses.translation: O sage, wherever you wish it to be, the milk ocean*® will flow to and be present there.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । भगवन्यदि तुष्टोऽसि यदि भक्तिः स्थिरा मयि । तेन सत्येन मे ज्ञानं त्रिकालविषयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | bhagavanyadi tuShTo.asi yadi bhaktiH sthirA mayi | tena satyena me j~nAnaM trikAlaviShayaM bhavet
verses.translation: O great sage, may your family be never-ending due to my grace. I shall be always present in your her¬ mitage.
verses.hindi: पुंश्चली दुष्टा गोकर्णे कारण उसके प्रभावसे स्त्रीत्वको प्राप्त कर लिया

verses.sanskrit: प्रयच्छ भक्तिं विपुलां त्वयि चाव्यभिचारिणीम् । सान्वयस्यापि नित्यं मे भूरि क्षीरौदनं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: prayachCha bhaktiM vipulAM tvayi chAvyabhichAriNIm | sAnvayasyApi nityaM me bhUri kShIraudanaM bhavet
verses.translation: Be happy realising all your desires. Do not get anxious or worried. There is no doubt that everything you think ofwill be fulfilled.

verses.sanskrit: ममास्तु तव सान्निध्यं नित्यं चैवाश्रमे विभो । तव भक्तेषु सख्यं स्यादन्योऽन्येषु सदा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mamAstu tava sAnnidhyaM nityaM chaivAshrame vibho | tava bhakteShu sakhyaM syAdanyo.anyeShu sadA bhavet
verses.translation: After granting me the boons and saying this, lord Siva of the brilliance of a crore suns vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो मया शम्भुर्विहस्य परमेश्वरः । कृपादृष्ट्या निरीक्ष्याशु मां स प्राह यदूद्वह
verses.transliteration: evamukto mayA shambhurvihasya parameshvaraH | kR^ipAdR^iShTyA nirIkShyAshu mAM sa prAha yadUdvaha
verses.translation: O Krsna, Siva, the supreme lord the bestower of worldly pleasures and salvation, was thus ''een by me accom¬ panied by his followers.
verses.hindi: ब्रत धारण करनेसे परम सुख प्राप्त किया

verses.sanskrit: इतीदृशं पुण्यप्रश्नं पृष्टवान् मुनिसत्तमः । व्यासः सनत्कुमारं वै शैवं सच्चरितं जगौ
verses.transliteration: itIdR^ishaM puNyaprashnaM pR^iShTavAn munisattamaH | vyAsaH sanatkumAraM vai shaivaM sachcharitaM jagau
verses.translation: See for yourself the Gandharvas, Apsaras, sage.s, Vidyadharas and the well arranged Siddhas.
verses.hindi: शिवके अनुग्रहसे श्रेष्ठ गति प्राप्त की

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिव उवाच । उपमन्यो मुने तात वर्जितस्त्वं भविष्यसि । जरामरणजैर्दोषैः सर्वकामान्वितो भव
verses.transliteration: shrIshiva uvAcha | upamanyo mune tAta varjitastvaM bhaviShyasi | jarAmaraNajairdoShaiH sarvakAmAnvito bhava
verses.translation: See the beautiful trees endowed with glossy leaves, fragrant with seasonal flowers and bearing fiuits and flowers.

verses.sanskrit: मुनीनां पूजनीयश्च यशोधनसमन्वितः । शीलरूपगुणैश्वर्यं मत्प्रसादात्पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: munInAM pUjanIyashcha yashodhanasamanvitaH | shIlarUpaguNaishvaryaM matprasAdAtpade pade
verses.translation: O mighty hero, all these arc the results of the grace of Siva the great soul, the lord of gods. The universe is emotionally agreeable.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदसागरस्यैव सान्निध्यं पयसां निधेः । तत्र ते भविता नित्यं यत्र यत्रेच्छसे मुने
verses.transliteration: kShIrodasAgarasyaiva sAnnidhyaM payasAM nidheH | tatra te bhavitA nityaM yatra yatrechChase mune
verses.translation: I have the perfect knowledge of everything, thanks to the grace of the Trident-bearing lord. I know factually the past, present and the future, everything.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतात्मकं तत्क्षीरं यावत्संयाम्यते ततः । इमं वैवस्वतं कल्पं पश्यसे बन्धुभिः सह
verses.transliteration: amR^itAtmakaM tatkShIraM yAvatsaMyAmyate tataH | imaM vaivasvataM kalpaM pashyase bandhubhiH saha
verses.translation: I have seen the lord whom even the great gods
verses.hindi: प्राप्त किया तथा दूसरे ब्रह्मके समान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्गोत्रं चाक्षयं चास्तु मत्प्रसादात्सदैव हि । सान्निध्यमाश्रमे तेऽहं करिष्यामि महामुने
verses.transliteration: tvadgotraM chAkShayaM chAstu matprasAdAtsadaiva hi | sAnnidhyamAshrame te.ahaM kariShyAmi mahAmune
verses.translation: The eternal principles arc known as twentysix.*** Learned men meditate on the great and imperishable thus.
verses.hindi: उत्तम भक्तिसे शिवकी पूजाकर सृष्टिकर्ता बन गये

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तिः सुस्थिरा चास्तु सदा दास्यामि दर्शनम् । स्मृतश्च भवता वत्स प्रियस्त्वं सर्वथा मम
verses.transliteration: madbhaktiH susthirA chAstu sadA dAsyAmi darshanam | smR^itashcha bhavatA vatsa priyastvaM sarvathA mama
verses.translation: When the Kalpa came to an end, the lord created Rudra from his heart. Then he annihilated the universe in¬ cluding the mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: यथाकामसुखं तिष्ठ नोत्कण्ठां कर्तुमर्हसि । सर्वं प्रपूर्णतां यातु चिन्तितं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: yathAkAmasukhaM tiShTha notkaNThAM kartumarhasi | sarvaM prapUrNatAM yAtu chintitaM nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: At the end of Yugas, lord Siva becomes Kala and stands devouring all the living beings, like the fire of dissolution Sarhvartaka.
verses.hindi: एवं श्रीराम भी शिवके अनुग्रहसे महाशैव हुए

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् सुर्यकोटिसमप्रभः । महेशानो वरान् दत्त्वा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | evamuktvA sa bhagavAn suryakoTisamaprabhaH | maheshAno varAn dattvA tatraivAntaradhIyata
verses.translation: Hence, propitiate him for the acquisition of a soli. 6iva, favourably disposed to his devotees will become delighted with you, soon.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दृष्टो मया कृष्ण परिवारसमन्वितः । शङ्करः परमेशानो भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकः
verses.transliteration: evaM dR^iShTo mayA kR^iShNa parivArasamanvitaH | sha~NkaraH parameshAno bhuktimuktipradAyakaH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of sage CJpamanyu the great soul, devotion to lord Siva was generated in Kr9na and he spoke to the sage.
verses.hindi: तो सैकड़ों वर्षोंमें भी नहीं कर सकता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: शम्भुना परमेशेन यदुक्तं तेन धीमता । तदवाप्तं च मे सर्वं देवदेव समाधिना
verses.transliteration: shambhunA parameshena yaduktaM tena dhImatA | tadavAptaM cha me sarvaM devadeva samAdhinA
verses.translation: O dear, O Upamanyu, be merciful to me. Please

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । वासुदेवाय यत्प्रोक्तमुपमन्युमहर्षिणा । तदुच्यते मया व्यास चरितं हि महेशितुः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | vAsudevAya yatproktamupamanyumaharShiNA | taduchyate mayA vyAsa charitaM hi maheshituH
verses.translation: S«e P. 1104 nolr.
verses.hindi: उपमन्यूपदेश नामक दूसरा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं चैव तै जातान् गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा । ऋषीन्विद्याधरांश्चैव पश्य सिद्धान्व्यवस्थितान्
verses.transliteration: pratyakShaM chaiva tai jAtAn gandharvApsarasastathA | R^iShInvidyAdharAMshchaiva pashya siddhAnvyavasthitAn
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Krsna, that sage Upamanyu, tlie great devotee of Siva, the storehouse of mercy praised him and said.
verses.hindi: विस्मयं परम गत्वोपमन्युं शान्तमानसम्॥ ९  महामुनिसे कहा--

verses.sanskrit: पश्य वृक्षान्मनोरम्यान् स्निग्धपत्रान्सुगन्धिनः । सर्वर्तुकुसुमैर्युक्तान्सदापुष्पफलान्वितान्
verses.transliteration: pashya vR^ikShAnmanoramyAn snigdhapatrAnsugandhinaH | sarvartukusumairyuktAnsadApuShpaphalAnvitAn
verses.translation: O leading scion of the family of Yadus, I shall enumerate the various devotees, by whom the cherished desires of their hearts have been realised through the propitiation of Siva. Please listen.
verses.hindi: अपि तावन्ममाप्येवं प्रसादं वा करोत्वसीौ॥ ३  आप ऐसा उपाय बतायें

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमेतन्महाबाहो शङ्करस्य महात्मनः । प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य विश्वं भावसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvametanmahAbAho sha~Nkarasya mahAtmanaH | prasAdAddevadevasya vishvaM bhAvasamanvitam
verses.translation: Formerly Hiranyakasipu attained he glory of the suzerainty over all the gods for a period of a million years from the moon-crested lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ममास्ति त्वखिलं ज्ञानं प्रसादात् शूलपाणिनः । भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च सर्वं जानामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: mamAsti tvakhilaM j~nAnaM prasAdAt shUlapANinaH | bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyaM cha sarvaM jAnAmi tattvataH
verses.translation: O Krsna, the terrible discus of Visnu and the thunderbolt of Indra became shattered against his person during a great battle.

verses.sanskrit: तमहं दृष्टवान्देवमपि देवाः सुरेश्वराः । यं न पश्यन्त्यनाराध्य कोऽन्यो धन्यतरो मया
verses.transliteration: tamahaM dR^iShTavAndevamapi devAH sureshvarAH | yaM na pashyantyanArAdhya ko.anyo dhanyataro mayA
verses.translation: The weapons, missiles, discus, thunderbolt never became effective in the body of Graha of great might during battles, thanks to the Dharma of that intelligent one.

verses.sanskrit: षड्विंशकमिति ख्यातं परं तत्त्वं सनातनम् । एवं ध्यायन्ति विद्वांसो महत्परममक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: ShaDviMshakamiti khyAtaM paraM tattvaM sanAtanam | evaM dhyAyanti vidvAMso mahatparamamakSharam
verses.translation: The gods were harassed by Graha the mighty one. Leading Asuras to whom the lord had granted boons killed gods with impunity.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तत्त्वविधानज्ञः सर्वतत्त्वार्थदर्शनः । स एव भगवान् देवः प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sarvaM tattvavidhAnaj~naH sarvatattvArthadarshanaH | sa eva bhagavAn devaH pradhAnapuruSheshvaraH
verses.translation: Siva, the lord of all worlds, when satisfied granted the lordship over the three worlds to Vidyutprabha for a period of a hundred thousand years.
verses.hindi: के आठ दिन एक मुहूर्तके समान बीत गये

verses.sanskrit: यो निजाद्दक्षिणात्पार्श्वाद् ब्रह्माणं लोककारणम् । वामादप्यसृजद्विष्णुं लोकरक्षार्थमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yo nijAddakShiNAtpArshvAd brahmANaM lokakAraNam | vAmAdapyasR^ijadviShNuM lokarakShArthamIshvaraH
verses.translation: Siva blessed him with ten million sons also and said "You will become my follower for ever."

verses.sanskrit: कल्पान्ते चैव सम्प्राप्तेऽसृजद् रुद्रं हृदः प्रभुः । ततः समहरत्कृत्स्नं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: kalpAnte chaiva samprApte.asR^ijad rudraM hR^idaH prabhuH | tataH samaharatkR^itsnaM jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam
verses.translation: O Krsna, the delighted lord Siva, lovingly gave him an auspicious kingdom in Kua Dvipa.-**
verses.hindi: अँगूठेपर खड़े होकर तप करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि संवर्तक इवानलः । कालो भूत्वा महादेवो ग्रसमानः स तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: yugAnte sarvabhUtAni saMvartaka ivAnalaH | kAlo bhUtvA mahAdevo grasamAnaH sa tiShThati
verses.translation: The Daitya Satamukha created by Brahma,

verses.sanskrit: पुरा पुत्रार्थमगमत्कैलासं शङ्करालयम् । वसुदेवसुतः कृष्णस्तपस्तप्तुं शिवस्य हि
verses.transliteration: purA putrArthamagamatkailAsaM sha~NkarAlayam | vasudevasutaH kR^iShNastapastaptuM shivasya hi
verses.translation: WiUbid A&iaiic Rescart\ ol. \ lll. P. idcniifies
verses.hindi: दुर्लभ एवं पवित्र वरोंको मुझसे माँग लीजिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञः सर्वभूतात्मा सवर्भूतभवोद्भवः । आस्ते सर्वगतो देवो दृश्यः सर्वैश्च दैवतैः
verses.transliteration: sarvaj~naH sarvabhUtAtmA savarbhUtabhavodbhavaH | Aste sarvagato devo dR^ishyaH sarvaishcha daivataiH
verses.translation: The iamous sage Yajnavalkya glorified * in the Vedas, propitiated him and acquired excellent knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अतस्त्वं पुत्रलाभाय समाराधय शङ्करम् । शीघ्रं प्रसन्नो भविता शिवस्ते भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: atastvaM putralAbhAya samArAdhaya sha~Nkaram | shIghraM prasanno bhavitA shivaste bhaktavatsalaH
verses.translation: The sage Vedavyasa who had acquired unequalled glory propitiated him and attained knowledge of the three times—past, present and future.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रोपमन्युं सन्दृष्ट्वा तपन्तं शृङ्ग उत्तमे । प्रणम्य भक्त्या स मुनिं पर्यपृच्छत्कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: atropamanyuM sandR^iShTvA tapantaM shR^i~Nga uttame | praNamya bhaktyA sa muniM paryapR^ichChatkR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: The Balakhilyas harassed by Indra secured from Siva the invincible Garuda who brought them Soma juice.
verses.hindi: भी माँगा है,बह सब आपको प्राप्त हो

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । उपमन्यो महाप्राज्ञ शैवप्रवर सन्मते । पुत्रार्थमगमं तप्तुं तपोऽत्र गिरिशस्य हि
verses.transliteration: shrIkR^iShNa uvAcha | upamanyo mahAprAj~na shaivapravara sanmate | putrArthamagamaM taptuM tapo.atra girishasya hi
verses.translation: When all the waters became dried up and lost by the prior fury of Siva they were worshipped and made to flow again by the gods through the skull.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O Madhusudana, after pleasing Mahadeva the bestower of happiness to the devotees, Vikarna obtained great Siddhi.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O Madhusudana, after pleasing Mahadeva the bestower of happiness to the devotees, Vikarna obtained great Siddhi.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२. द्वितीयोऽध्यायः । सनत्कुमारव्याससंवादे उपमन्यूपदेशः । सनत्कुमार उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य मुनेर्वाक्यमुपमन्योर्महात्मनः । जातभक्तिर्महादेवे कृष्णः प्रोवाच तं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.2\. dvitIyo.adhyAyaH | sanatkumAravyAsasaMvAde upamanyUpadeshaH | sanatkumAra uvAcha | ityAkarNya munervAkyamupamanyormahAtmanaH | jAtabhaktirmahAdeve kR^iShNaH provAcha taM munim
verses.translation: King Citrasena of steady devotion delighted Siva and attained freedom from the terror of all other kings and unequalled pleasure as well.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो विद्युत्प्रभस्यापि त्रैलोक्येश्वरतामदात् । शतवर्षसहस्राणि सर्वलोकेश्वरो भवः
verses.transliteration: tuShTo vidyutprabhasyApi trailokyeshvaratAmadAt | shatavarShasahasrANi sarvalokeshvaro bhavaH
verses.translation: Srikara, the son of a cowherdess, became his devotee on seeing the worship of Siva performed by the king and attained great Siddhi.
verses.hindi: करनेमें अतिशय दुःसह कौन हो सकता है 2

verses.sanskrit: तथा पुत्रसहस्राणामयुतं च ददौ शिवः । मम चानुचरो नित्यं भविष्यस्यब्रवीदिति
verses.transliteration: tathA putrasahasrANAmayutaM cha dadau shivaH | mama chAnucharo nityaM bhaviShyasyabravIditi
verses.translation: O Krsna, prince Citrahgada, the husband of Simantini, was drowned in Yamuna but was saved by Siva's blessings
verses.hindi: पूछने लगे। तब मुनीश्वरने उनसे कहा--

verses.sanskrit: कुशद्वीपे शुभं राज्यमददाद्भगवान् भवः । स तस्मै शङ्करः प्रीत्या वासुदेव प्रहृष्टधीः
verses.transliteration: kushadvIpe shubhaM rAjyamadadAdbhagavAn bhavaH | sa tasmai sha~NkaraH prItyA vAsudeva prahR^iShTadhIH
verses.translation: He went to the abode of Taksaka*' and gained his friendship. The delighted prince of good rites then returned to his house with diverse riches.

verses.sanskrit: धात्रा सृष्टः शतमखो दैत्यो वर्षशतं पुरा । तपः कृत्वा सहस्रं तु पुत्राणामलभद्भवात्
verses.transliteration: dhAtrA sR^iShTaH shatamakho daityo varShashataM purA | tapaH kR^itvA sahasraM tu putrANAmalabhadbhavAt
verses.translation: O Krsna, his beloved wife Simantini who regularly
verses.hindi: स्मरण करते हुए द्वारका चले गये

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञवल्क्य इति ख्यातो गीतो वेदेषु वै मुनिः । आराध्य स महादेवं प्राप्तवान् ज्ञानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yAj~navalkya iti khyAto gIto vedeShu vai muniH | ArAdhya sa mahAdevaM prAptavAn j~nAnamuttamam
verses.translation: The mythical abode of Taka or Taksaka, the serpent chief is placed in (he nether region.
verses.hindi: श्रीकृष्ण कृतार्थ हुए और सभीसे अजेय हो गये

verses.sanskrit: वेदव्यासस्तु यो नाम्ना प्राप्तवानतुलं यशः । सोऽपि शङ्करमाराध्य त्रिकालज्ञानमाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: vedavyAsastu yo nAmnA prAptavAnatulaM yashaH | so.api sha~NkaramArAdhya trikAlaj~nAnamAptavAn
verses.translation: Cahcula, a vicious harlot, heard a virtuous story from a brahmin at Grokarna and became a devotee of Siva. She attained the great goal.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रेण वालखिल्यास्ते परिभूतास्तु शङ्करात् । लेभिरे सोमहर्तारं गरुडं सर्वदुर्जयम्
verses.transliteration: indreNa vAlakhilyAste paribhUtAstu sha~NkarAt | lebhire somahartAraM garuDaM sarvadurjayam
verses.translation: Binduga*® the sinning husband of Gahcula heard Sivapurana through the good offices of his wife and attained the good goal of Siva.
verses.hindi: और सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीका शासन करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: आपः प्रनष्टाः सर्वाश्च पूर्वरोषात्कपर्दिनः । शर्वं समकपालेन देवैरिष्ट्वाः प्रवर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: ApaH pranaShTAH sarvAshcha pUrvaroShAtkapardinaH | sharvaM samakapAlena devairiShTvAH pravartitAH
verses.translation: Pihgala a notorious prostitute and the base brahmin Mandara worshipped the bull of Siva and attained the supreme goal.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेर्भार्या चानसूया त्रीणि वर्षशतानि च । मुशलेषु निराहारा सुप्त्वा शर्वात्ततः सुतान्
verses.transliteration: atrerbhAryA chAnasUyA trINi varShashatAni cha | mushaleShu nirAhArA suptvA sharvAttataH sutAn
verses.translation: A certain prostitute Mahananda devoted to Siva, dedicating herself at the feet of Siva delighted him and attained good goal.
verses.hindi: पूजन करते हुए देखे जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: दत्तात्रेयं मुनिं लेभे चन्द्रं दुर्वाससं तथा । गङ्गां प्रवर्तयामास चित्रकूटे पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: dattAtreyaM muniM lebhe chandraM durvAsasaM tathA | ga~NgAM pravartayAmAsa chitrakUTe pativratA
verses.translation: Kaikeyi, a brahmin girl, respectfully performing Siva's Vratas attained great happiness, thanks to the regular performance of Siva's vrata.
verses.hindi: बाद दुखी होकर शिवकी आराधना की थी

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । उपमन्यो मुने तात कृपां कुरु ममोपरि । ये ये शिवं समाराध्य कामानापुश्च तान्वद
verses.transliteration: shrIkR^iShNa uvAcha | upamanyo mune tAta kR^ipAM kuru mamopari | ye ye shivaM samArAdhya kAmAnApushcha tAnvada
verses.translation: O Krsna, king Vimarsana adopting Siva's devotion attained great goal formerly, thanks to Siva's blessings.
verses.hindi: आराधना करके सुस्थिर धर्मकी प्राप्ति की थी

verses.sanskrit: विकर्णश्च महादेवं तथा भक्तसुखावहम् । प्रसाद्य महतीं सिद्धिमाप्तवान् मधुसूदन
verses.transliteration: vikarNashcha mahAdevaM tathA bhaktasukhAvaham | prasAdya mahatIM siddhimAptavAn madhusUdana
verses.translation: Durjana, a sinful knavish king running after women attained Siva, thanks to devotion to Siva. He was unaffected by all actions.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेनो नृपः शम्भुं प्रसाद्य दृढभक्तिमान् । समस्तनृपभीतिभ्योऽभयं प्रापातुलं च कम्
verses.transliteration: chitraseno nR^ipaH shambhuM prasAdya dR^iDhabhaktimAn | samastanR^ipabhItibhyo.abhayaM prApAtulaM cha kam
verses.translation: A hunter Sankara performing Sivavrata along with his wife and attached to the Bhasma from the funeral pyre attained the great goal by his devotion.
verses.hindi: ही वह ब्राह्मण वहींपर मर गया

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकरो गोपिकासूनुर्नृपपूजाविलोकनात् । जातभक्तिर्महादेवे परमां सिद्धिमाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: shrIkaro gopikAsUnurnR^ipapUjAvilokanAt | jAtabhaktirmahAdeve paramAM siddhimAptavAn
verses.translation: O Kfsna, a canqlala woman Saumini performed the worship by ignorance and attained the goal of Siva by the blessings of the lord.
verses.hindi: गुणोंका वर्णन करनेमें समर्थ नहीं हैं

verses.sanskrit: चित्राङ्गदो नृपसुतः सीमन्तिन्याः पतिर्हरे । शिवानुग्रहतो मग्नो यमुनायां मृतो न हि
verses.transliteration: chitrA~Ngado nR^ipasutaH sImantinyAH patirhare | shivAnugrahato magno yamunAyAM mR^ito na hi
verses.translation: A hunter Mahakala, a wild Kirata habitually injuring others, worshipped Siva with devotion and attained the goal of the good.

verses.sanskrit: स च तक्षालयं गत्वा तन्मैत्रीं प्राप्य सुव्रतः । आयातः स्वगृहं प्रीतो नानाधनसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: sa cha takShAlayaM gatvA tanmaitrIM prApya suvrataH | AyAtaH svagR^ihaM prIto nAnAdhanasamanvitaH
verses.translation: Durvasas a leading sage popularised his cult in the world, thanks to the bles.sings of Siva. He spread Siva's cult of devotion that yields salvation to the devotee.
verses.hindi: शिवमाहात्य्यवर्णन नामक तीसरा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: सीमन्तिनी प्रिया तस्य सोमव्रतपरायणा । शिवानुग्रहतः कृष्ण लेभे सौभाग्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sImantinI priyA tasya somavrataparAyaNA | shivAnugrahataH kR^iShNa lebhe saubhAgyamuttamam
verses.translation: Propitiating Siva, the benefector of the worlds,
verses.hindi: प्रदान करनेवाली यह अद्भुत शिवकथा सुनायी है

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रभावाद् व्रते तस्मिन्नेको द्विजसुतः पुरा । कश्चित्स्त्रीत्वं गतो लोभात्कृतदाराकृतिश्छलात्
verses.transliteration: tatprabhAvAd vrate tasminneko dvijasutaH purA | kashchitstrItvaM gato lobhAtkR^itadArAkR^itishChalAt
verses.translation: O Kfsna, by worshipping Siva with devotion Brahma, the most excellent devotee of Siva, became the creator and grandfather of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: चञ्चुका पुंश्चली दुष्टा गोकर्णे द्विजतः पुरा । श्रुत्वा धर्मकथां शम्भोर्भक्त्या प्राप परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: cha~nchukA puMshchalI duShTA gokarNe dvijataH purA | shrutvA dharmakathAM shambhorbhaktyA prApa parAM gatim
verses.translation: O Kfsna, thanks to Siva's blessings, Devendra, a great devotee of Siva, enjoyed the three worlds formerly. He became the lord of all the gods.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्त्र्यनुग्रहतः पापी बिन्दुगो चञ्चुकापतिः । श्रुत्वा शिवपुराणं स सद्गतिं प्राप शाङ्करीम्
verses.transliteration: svastryanugrahataH pApI bindugo cha~nchukApatiH | shrutvA shivapurANaM sa sadgatiM prApa shA~NkarIm
verses.translation: O Krsna, Sakalya, the praiseworthy soul propi¬ tiated Siva for nine hundred years by means of mental sacrifice.
verses.hindi: अधिक श्रद्धा उसे सुननेके लिये बढ़ रही है

verses.sanskrit: पिङ्गला गणिका ख्याता मदराह्वो द्विजाधमः । शैवमृषभमभ्यर्च्य लेभाते सद्गतिं च तौ
verses.transliteration: pi~NgalA gaNikA khyAtA madarAhvo dvijAdhamaH | shaivamR^iShabhamabhyarchya lebhAte sadgatiM cha tau
verses.translation: Your family will never be extinct. It will be adorned by the sages. O excellent sage, you will be the composer of Aphorisms later on."

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्योपमन्युः स मुनिः शैववरो महान् । कृष्णवाक्यं सुप्रशस्य प्रत्युवाच कृपानिधिः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | ityAkarNyopamanyuH sa muniH shaivavaro mahAn | kR^iShNavAkyaM suprashasya pratyuvAcha kR^ipAnidhiH
verses.translation: O descendant of Yadu, thus the great sage secured boons from Siva and became well known and honoured in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: शिवजीके प्रति भक्ति उत्पन्न हो जाती है

verses.sanskrit: महानन्दाभिधा कश्चिद्वेश्या शिवपदारता । दृढात्पणात्सुप्रसाद्य शिवं लेभे च सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: mahAnandAbhidhA kashchidveshyA shivapadAratA | dR^iDhAtpaNAtsuprasAdya shivaM lebhe cha sadgatim
verses.translation: Lord Rudra spoke to him directly—''O faultless one, I am satisfied with you. You will become the writer
verses.hindi: द्रष्टा हैं, उनकी महिमासे सम्पूर्ण जगत् व्याप्त है

verses.sanskrit: कैकेयी द्विजबाला च सादराह्वा शिवव्रता । परमं हि सुखं प्राप शिवेशव्रतधारणात्
verses.transliteration: kaikeyI dvijabAlA cha sAdarAhvA shivavratA | paramaM hi sukhaM prApa shiveshavratadhAraNAt
verses.translation: I am incompetent to describe with a single mouth the qualities that exist in the lord even in hundreds of years.

verses.sanskrit: विमर्षणश्च नृपतिः शिवभक्तिं विधाय वै । गतिं लेभे परां कृष्ण शिवानुग्रहतः पुरा
verses.transliteration: vimarShaNashcha nR^ipatiH shivabhaktiM vidhAya vai | gatiM lebhe parAM kR^iShNa shivAnugrahataH purA
verses.translation: O great brahmin, you arc blessed. Who can ade¬ quately eulogise you and be contented. In your hermitage the lord of the gods himself is ever present.
verses.hindi: अन्तमें शिवमें ही विलीन हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: दुर्जनश्च नृपः पापी बहुस्त्रीलम्पटः खलः । शिवभक्त्या शिवं प्राप निर्लिप्तः सर्वकर्मसु
verses.transliteration: durjanashcha nR^ipaH pApI bahustrIlampaTaH khalaH | shivabhaktyA shivaM prApa nirliptaH sarvakarmasu
verses.translation: O leading sage, will the lord Siva grant me his vision? Will he do me this favour?
verses.hindi: कल्पद्मो5थ वा भ्राता पिता माता शिवो मत: ॥ १३  शिवजी ही माने गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: सस्त्रीकः शम्बरो नाम्ना शङ्करश्च शिवव्रती । चिताभस्मरतो भक्त्या लेभे तद्गतिमुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: sastrIkaH shambaro nAmnA sha~Nkarashcha shivavratI | chitAbhasmarato bhaktyA lebhe tadgatimuttamAm
verses.translation: In the sixteenth month you will get good boons from lord Siva and his wife. O Kr$na, why should not the lord grant you the boons?
verses.hindi: वीर देवताओंको भी अपने अधीन कर लिया है

verses.sanskrit: सौमिनी नाम चाण्डाली सम्पूज्याज्ञानतो हि सा । लेभे शैवीं गतिं कृष्ण शङ्करानुग्रहात्परात्
verses.transliteration: sauminI nAma chANDAlI sampUjyAj~nAnato hi sA | lebhe shaivIM gatiM kR^iShNa sha~NkarAnugrahAtparAt
verses.translation: O Visnu, thanks to your good qualities, you deserve worship of the gods. You are always praiseworthy. 1 shall explain a mantra if you have faith enough.
verses.hindi: हुए, तब उनको मुनिने शाप दे दिया

verses.sanskrit: महाकालाभिधो व्याधः किरातः परहिंसकः । समभ्यर्च्य शिवं भक्त्या लेभे सद्गतिमुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: mahAkAlAbhidho vyAdhaH kirAtaH parahiMsakaH | samabhyarchya shivaM bhaktyA lebhe sadgatimuttamAm
verses.translation: By the virtue of that mantra yon will see l§iva. You will acquire a son, equal in strength to you, by the favour of lord Siva.
verses.hindi: बादमें उन शिवजी -ने ही उनका उद्धार किया

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वासा मुनिशार्दूलः शिवानुग्रहतः पुरा । तस्तार स्वमतं लोके शिवभक्तिं विमुक्तिदाम्
verses.transliteration: durvAsA munishArdUlaH shivAnugrahataH purA | tastAra svamataM loke shivabhaktiM vimuktidAm
verses.translation: O Krna, perform the Japa of this most eilicacious

verses.sanskrit: कौशिकश्च समाराध्य शङ्करं लोक शङ्करम् । ब्राह्मणोऽभूत्क्षत्रियश्च द्वितीय इव पद्मभूः
verses.transliteration: kaushikashcha samArAdhya sha~NkaraM loka sha~Nkaram | brAhmaNo.abhUtkShatriyashcha dvitIya iva padmabhUH
verses.translation: Immediately he grew matted hair and then clean¬ shaven. With great purity of mind he began to perform penance standing on the big toes of the feet and lifting up the hands.

verses.sanskrit: शिवमभ्यर्च्य सद्भक्त्या विरञ्चिः शैवसत्तमः । अभूत्सर्गकरः कृष्ण सर्वलोकपितामहः
verses.transliteration: shivamabhyarchya sadbhaktyA vira~nchiH shaivasattamaH | abhUtsargakaraH kR^iShNa sarvalokapitAmahaH
verses.translation: When the sixteenth month arrived lord Siva was satisfied. Accompanied by Parvati, Siva granted his vision to Krsna.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । यैर्यैर्भवाराधनतः प्राप्तो हृत्काम एव हि । तांस्तान् भक्तान् प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु त्वं वै यदूद्वह
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | yairyairbhavArAdhanataH prApto hR^itkAma eva hi | tAMstAn bhaktAn pravakShyAmi shR^iNu tvaM vai yadUdvaha
verses.translation: Lord Kr?na saw Siva thus:—He was accom¬ panied by Parvati. The moon-crested lord had three eyes. He was being eulogised by Brahma and others and worship¬ ped by crores of Siddhas.
