verses.translation: Yama tells them—"You are noble souls duly blessed, since you have performed what is ordained in the Vedas. Good deeds that are conducive to divine happiness have been performed by you.
verses.hindi: कृपणतासे रहित होकर दान करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । पापभेदवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । द्विजद्रव्यापहरणमपि दायव्यतिक्रमः । अतिमानोऽतिकोपश्च दाम्भिकत्वं कृतघ्नता
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.6\. ShaShTho.adhyAyaH | pApabhedavarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | dvijadravyApaharaNamapi dAyavyatikramaH | atimAno.atikopashcha dAmbhikatvaM kR^itaghnatA
verses.translation: Ascend the celestial aerial chariot and go to heaven to enjoy the pleasures in the company of celestial damsels and fulfil your cherished desires.

verses.sanskrit: जिह्वाकामोपभोगार्थं यस्यारम्भः सुकर्मसु । मूलेनाध्यापको नित्यं वेदज्ञानादिकं च यत्
verses.transliteration: jihvAkAmopabhogArthaM yasyArambhaH sukarmasu | mUlenAdhyApako nityaM vedaj~nAnAdikaM cha yat
verses.translation: After enjoying pleasures there, in the end when the merit is exhausted return to this place for reaping the fruit of what little evil you may have committed."
verses.hindi: उसके समान नहीं बताया गया है

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्म्यादिव्रतसन्त्यागश्चान्याचारनिषेवणम् । असच्छास्त्राधिगमनं शुष्कतर्कावलम्बनम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmyAdivratasantyAgashchAnyAchAraniShevaNam | asachChAstrAdhigamanaM shuShkatarkAvalambanam
verses.translation: Men who have been virtuous are treated as friends by Yama. They see Yama with a gentle face,
verses.hindi: बनकर उस दाताके पास उपस्थित होती है

verses.sanskrit: देवाग्निगुरुसाधूनां निन्दा या ब्राह्मणस्य च । प्रत्यक्षं वा परोक्षं वा राज्ञां मण्डलिनामपि
verses.transliteration: devAgnigurusAdhUnAM nindA yA brAhmaNasya cha | pratyakShaM vA parokShaM vA rAj~nAM maNDalinAmapi
verses.translation: Men who have been guilty of cruelties sec him in a terrible form. His face is terrible with curved fangs. His eyes are cruel with knit eyebrows. The hair on his head stand lifted up. He has a big moustache. His lips arc pouted and they throb. He has eighteen hands* He is furious. He resembles black collyrium. His uplifted hands hold all w'capons. He threatens with punishment. He is seated on a great buffalo. His eyes resemble blazing fire. He wears red garlands and garments. He is as tali as

verses.sanskrit: उत्सन्नपितृदेवेज्याः स्वकर्मत्यागिनश्च ये । दुःशीला नास्तिकाः पापाः सदा वासत्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: utsannapitR^idevejyAH svakarmatyAginashcha ye | duHshIlA nAstikAH pApAH sadA vAsatyavAdinaH
verses.translation: He appears ready to swallow even great mountains. He appears to vomit fire. Very near him is Mftyu, whose lustre is like that of black fire.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वकाले दिवा वाप्सु वियोनौ पशुयोनिषु । रजस्वलाया योनौ च मैथुनं यः समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: parvakAle divA vApsu viyonau pashuyoniShu | rajasvalAyA yonau cha maithunaM yaH samAcharet
verses.translation: AH of them are heroic and terrible. They have curved snouts. They bear shafts, quivers and bows and weapons of various sorts.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुत्रमित्रसम्प्राप्ते आशाच्छेदकराश्च ये । जनस्याप्रियवक्तारः क्रूराः समयभेदिनः
verses.transliteration: strIputramitrasamprApte AshAchChedakarAshcha ye | janasyApriyavaktAraH krUrAH samayabhedinaH
verses.translation: The attendants of Yama are innumerable. They arc great heroes. They have complexions like the black collyrium. They appear terrifying with weapons lifted up.
verses.hindi: कृताकृतं॑ यत्सुकृतं समेतु॥ ३०  पुण्यरूप हो जाय

verses.sanskrit: भेत्ता तडागकूपानां विक्रतारो रसस्य च । एकपङ्क्तिस्थितानां च पाकभेदं करोति यः
verses.transliteration: bhettA taDAgakUpAnAM vikratAro rasasya cha | ekapa~NktisthitAnAM cha pAkabhedaM karoti yaH
verses.translation: The sinners see Yama terrific to behold, surround¬ ed by his attendants and they see Citragupta too equally terrible.
verses.hindi: प्रदान न करे, ऐसा करनेसे उद्धार नहीं होता

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतैः स्त्रीनराः पापैरुपपातकिनः स्मृताः । युक्ता एभिस्तथान्येऽपि शृणु तांस्तु ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration: ityetaiH strInarAH pApairupapAtakinaH smR^itAH | yuktA ebhistathAnye.api shR^iNu tAMstu bravImi te
verses.translation: Yama rebukes and reproaches the sinners. Lord Citragupta enlightens them with statements on virtue.
verses.hindi: हत्वा पापं दिवं तिष्ठेद्यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दशश ॥ ३२  कालतक स्वर्गलोकमें वास करता है

verses.sanskrit: ये गोब्राह्मणकन्यानां स्वामिमित्रतपस्विनाम् । विनाशयन्ति कार्याणि ते नरा नारकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ye gobrAhmaNakanyAnAM svAmimitratapasvinAm | vinAshayanti kAryANi te narA nArakAH smR^itAH
verses.translation: O ye sinners, of evil actions, stealers of other man's riches, outragers of the modesty of other's wives, arrogant by your comeliness and might, why was sin
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्ञम्यागुमासंहितायां सामान्यदानवर्णन॑ नाम चरर्दशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: परस्त्रियाभितप्यन्ते ये परद्रव्यसूचकाः । परद्रव्यहरा नित्यं तौलमिथ्यानुसारकाः
verses.transliteration: parastriyAbhitapyante ye paradravyasUchakAH | paradravyaharA nityaM taulamithyAnusArakAH
verses.translation: Why do you lament now? You are being tortured by your own actions. Reap the fruits thereof. This is not the fault of anyone else.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तविषयासक्तिः कार्पण्यं साधुमत्सरम् । परदाराभिगमनं साधुकन्यासु दूषणम्
verses.transliteration: atyantaviShayAsaktiH kArpaNyaM sAdhumatsaram | paradArAbhigamanaM sAdhukanyAsu dUShaNam
verses.translation: Similarly, the infuriated great lord Gitragupta, the knower of virtuousness, at the behest and instruction of Yamaraja imparts the following advice to the kings who proud of their might had committed many misdeeds and had been brought near him ultimately.
verses.hindi: दानानां तन्ममाख्याहि मानुषाणां हितार्थतः॥ 2९  मनुष्योंक हितके लिये उस दानको आप मुझसे कहें

verses.sanskrit: द्विजदुःखकरा ये च प्रहारं चोद्धरन्ति ये । सेवन्ते तु द्विजाः शूद्रां सुरां बध्नन्ति कामतः
verses.transliteration: dvijaduHkhakarA ye cha prahAraM choddharanti ye | sevante tu dvijAH shUdrAM surAM badhnanti kAmataH
verses.translation: O ye wicked kings, who had tyrannised over and repressed your subjects, why were misdeeds committed for your rule of a very short duration?
verses.hindi: एकस्मादपि सर्वेषां दानानां तद्ददामि ते॥ २  लेता है, उसे मैं आपसे कहता हूँ, आप सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: ये पापनिरताः क्रूराः येऽपि हिंसाप्रिया नराः । वृत्त्यर्थं येऽपि कुर्वन्ति दानयज्ञादिकाः क्रियाः
verses.transliteration: ye pApaniratAH krUrAH ye.api hiMsApriyA narAH | vR^ittyarthaM ye.api kurvanti dAnayaj~nAdikAH kriyAH
verses.translation: O kings, let the fruits be reaped now (of the evil actions) in having punished your subjects unjusticiably due to vour fascination for kingly pleasures. You have misused your might.
verses.hindi: होनेके लिये यह दान अवश्य करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: गोष्ठाग्निजलरथ्यासु तरुच्छायानगेषु च । त्यजन्ति ये पुरीषाद्यानारामायतनेषु च
verses.transliteration: goShThAgnijalarathyAsu taruchChAyAnageShu cha | tyajanti ye purIShAdyAnArAmAyataneShu cha
verses.translation: I see that might quelled, the might that suppressed the subjects. How will you fare when you too are subjected to the same treatment by the emissaries of Yama?
verses.hindi: देवैमुंदे माधवम् ॥ विष्णुपदको प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: लज्जाश्रमप्रासादेषु मद्यपानरताश्च ये । कृतकेलिभुजङ्गाश्च रन्ध्रान्वेषणतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: lajjAshramaprAsAdeShu madyapAnaratAshcha ye | kR^itakelibhuja~NgAshcha randhrAnveShaNatatparAH
verses.translation: The kings who are treated with these and other similar taunts by Yama bewail their own lot and stand silent.
verses.hindi: इसे सुनकर व्यक्ति पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: वंशेष्टकाशिलाकाष्ठैः शृङ्गैः शङ्कुभिरेव च । ये मार्गमनुरुन्धन्ति परसीमां हरन्ति ये
verses.transliteration: vaMsheShTakAshilAkAShThaiH shR^i~NgaiH sha~Nkubhireva cha | ye mArgamanurundhanti parasImAM haranti ye
verses.translation: After having proclaimed their evil actions, Yama, Dharmaraja speaks to the messengers thus, for wiping off the sins of those kings.

verses.sanskrit: कूटशासनकर्तारः कूटकर्मक्रियारताः । कूटपाकान्नवस्त्राणां कूटसंव्यवहारिणः
verses.transliteration: kUTashAsanakartAraH kUTakarmakriyAratAH | kUTapAkAnnavastrANAM kUTasaMvyavahAriNaH
verses.translation: O Canda, O Mnhacanda, seize these kings forci¬ bly and purify them giadu;»lly in the fires of hell.
verses.hindi: ऊँचाई क्रमश: एककी अपेक्षा दुगुनी है

verses.sanskrit: धनुषः शस्त्रशल्यानां कर्ता यः क्रयविक्रयी । निर्दयोऽतीव भृत्येषु पशूनां दमनश्च यः
verses.transliteration: dhanuShaH shastrashalyAnAM kartA yaH krayavikrayI | nirdayo.atIva bhR^ityeShu pashUnAM damanashcha yaH
verses.translation: Then they immediately catch hold of |hc kings by their feet, whirl them with great velocity, throw them up and when they fall they catch them again and dash them against a heated rock. They are thus felled like great trees smitten with the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: मिथ्या प्रवदतो वाच आकर्णयति यः शनैः । स्वामिमित्रगुरुद्रोही मायावी चपलः शठः
verses.transliteration: mithyA pravadato vAcha AkarNayati yaH shanaiH | svAmimitragurudrohI mAyAvI chapalaH shaThaH
verses.translation: Then the man sheds blood through his ears. He is wholly shattered. He becomes unconscious and motionless.
verses.hindi: सिद्ध, देवता तथा ऋषिगण उनकी पूजा करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ये भार्यापुत्रमित्राणि बालवृद्धकृशातुरान् । भृत्यानतिथिबन्धूंश्च त्यक्त्वाश्नन्ति बुभुक्षितान्
verses.transliteration: ye bhAryAputramitrANi bAlavR^iddhakR^ishAturAn | bhR^ityAnatithibandhUMshcha tyaktvAshnanti bubhukShitAn
verses.translation: At the end of the seventh nether-world Tala, there are twentyeight Narakakotis situated in terrible darkness.

verses.sanskrit: यः स्वयं मिष्टमश्नाति विप्रेभ्यो न प्रयच्छति । वृथापाकः स विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मवादिषु गर्हितः
verses.transliteration: yaH svayaM miShTamashnAti viprebhyo na prayachChati | vR^ithApAkaH sa vij~neyo brahmavAdiShu garhitaH
verses.translation: The tenth beneath the previous is Cana. Mahacanta is lower still. Candakolahala is another. Pracanda, Gandanayika, Padma, Padmavatl, Bhita, Bhima, Bhlsana- nayika and Vajra arc terrible, very terrible.

verses.sanskrit: परिवित्तिः परिवेत्ता यया च परिविद्यते । तयोर्दानं च कन्यायास्तयोरेव च याजनम्
verses.transliteration: parivittiH parivettA yayA cha parividyate | tayordAnaM cha kanyAyAstayoreva cha yAjanam
verses.translation: The next eight cells are Trikona, Paficakona, Sudirgha, Akhilartida, Sama, Bhimabala, Atyugra and the eighth Diptapraya.

verses.sanskrit: नियमान् स्वयमादाय ये त्यजन्त्यजितेन्द्रियाः । प्रव्रज्यावासिता ये च हरस्यास्यप्रभेदकाः
verses.transliteration: niyamAn svayamAdAya ye tyajantyajitendriyAH | pravrajyAvAsitA ye cha harasyAsyaprabhedakAH
verses.translation: For each of these cells there are five officers-in charge. Now I shall mention the names of the hells of each of these ceils. Understand them well.

verses.sanskrit: ये ताडयन्ति गां क्रूरा दमयन्ते मुहुर्मुहुः । दुर्बलान्ये न पुष्णन्ति सततं ये त्यजन्ति च
verses.transliteration: ye tADayanti gAM krUrA damayante muhurmuhuH | durbalAnye na puShNanti satataM ye tyajanti cha
verses.translation: There are cool and hot hells. The first five are the leading hells. The hells are named thus: Sughora $umah3tik:.fAa, Sahjivana, Mahatamas, Viloma, Vilopa

verses.sanskrit: पीडयन्त्यतिभारेणासहन्तं वाहयन्ति च । योजयन्त्यकृताहारान्न विमुञ्चन्ति संयतान्
verses.transliteration: pIDayantyatibhAreNAsahantaM vAhayanti cha | yojayantyakR^itAhArAnna vimu~nchanti saMyatAn
verses.translation: Thus for twentyeight cells there are five officers in charge of each. Raurava and other hells are thus hundred and more. The great zones of hell are forty hundreds. Thus O Vyasa, I have described the hells to you. The enumeration arotincs detachment from the sin. Now listen to the pangs of sinners.

verses.sanskrit: ये भारक्षतरोगार्तान् गोवृषांश्च क्षुधातुरान् । न पालयन्ति यत्नेन गोघ्नास्ते नारकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ye bhArakShatarogArtAn govR^iShAMshcha kShudhAturAn | na pAlayanti yatnena goghnAste nArakAH smR^itAH
verses.translation: In the hellish hres, the sinners are roasted and dried up by diverse tortures till their action is exhausted completely.

verses.sanskrit: वृषाणां वृषणान्ये च पापिष्ठा गालयन्ति च । वाहयन्ति च गां वन्ध्यां महानारकिनो नराः
verses.transliteration: vR^iShANAM vR^iShaNAnye cha pApiShThA gAlayanti cha | vAhayanti cha gAM vandhyAM mahAnArakino narAH
verses.translation: Just as metals are melted in fire to remove their impurities so also sinners are put in hells in order to remove their sins.
verses.hindi: रहता है, यहाँ केवल मणियोंके तेज विद्यमान हैं

verses.sanskrit: आशया समनुप्राप्तान् क्षुत्तृष्णाश्रमकर्शितान् । अतिथींश्च तथानाथान् स्वतन्त्रान् गृहमागतान्
verses.transliteration: AshayA samanuprAptAn kShuttR^iShNAshramakarshitAn | atithIMshcha tathAnAthAn svatantrAn gR^ihamAgatAn
verses.translation: The hands are tightly tied and the men are battered. Then they are suspended from the branches of tall trees by the attendants ofYama.
verses.hindi: ४ समयका ज्ञान भी नहीं रहता है

verses.sanskrit: अन्नाभिलाषान् दीनान्वा बालवृद्धकृशातुरान् । नानुकम्पन्ति ये मूढास्ते यान्ति नरकार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: annAbhilAShAn dInAnvA bAlavR^iddhakR^ishAturAn | nAnukampanti ye mUDhAste yAnti narakArNavam
verses.translation: Then they are pushed by the servants till they begin to oscillate a Yojana unconscious by their rapidity.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्चम्यामुगासंहितायां ब्रह्माण्डकथने पाताललोकवर्णनं॑ नाम पञ्चदशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: गृहेष्वर्था निवर्तन्ते श्मशानादपि बान्धवाः । सुकृतं दुष्कृतं चैव गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति
verses.transliteration: gR^iheShvarthA nivartante shmashAnAdapi bAndhavAH | sukR^itaM duShkR^itaM chaiva gachChantamanugachChati
verses.translation: Even as they are suspended in mid air, iron hundred Bharas in weight is tied to their feet by the emissaries of Yama.
verses.hindi: पाताललोकवर्णन नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अजाविको माहिषिकः सामुद्रो वृषलीपतिः । शूद्रवत्क्षत्रवृत्तिश्च नारकी स्याद् द्विजाधमः
verses.transliteration: ajAviko mAhiShikaH sAmudro vR^iShalIpatiH | shUdravatkShatravR^ittishcha nArakI syAd dvijAdhamaH
verses.translation: Afflicted by such a heavy weight the sinners begin to think about their evil actions and keep quiet and motion¬ less.
verses.hindi: मत्तो मुनिवरश्रेष्ठ पच्यन्ते यत्र पापिन:॥ ९  दु:ख भोगते हैं

verses.sanskrit: शिल्पिनः कारवो वैद्या हेमकारा नृपध्वजाः । भृतकाः कूटसंयुक्ताः सर्वे ते नारकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: shilpinaH kAravo vaidyA hemakArA nR^ipadhvajAH | bhR^itakAH kUTasaMyuktAH sarve te nArakAH smR^itAH
verses.translation: Then the sinners are beaten with goads of fiery colour and terrible iron rods by the terrible servants of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाश्रमतरूणां च पुष्पारामविनाशनम् । यः पीडामाश्रमस्थानामाचरेदल्पिकामपि
verses.transliteration: shivAshramatarUNAM cha puShpArAmavinAshanam | yaH pIDAmAshramasthAnAmAcharedalpikAmapi
verses.translation: Then they are again smeared with glowing acid more unbearable than fire.
verses.hindi: सदानृतं वर्देद्स्तु स नरो याति रौरवम्॥ ७  है

verses.sanskrit: यश्चोचितमतिक्रम्य स्वेच्छयैवाहरेत्करम् । नरके पच्यते सोऽपि योऽपि दण्डरुचिर्नरः
verses.transliteration: yashchochitamatikramya svechChayaivAharetkaram | narake pachyate so.api yo.api daNDaruchirnaraH
verses.translation: Their limbs are cut and smothered, gradually torn and severed and smeared with molten metal. They are then roasted like brinjal in red-hot iron cauldrons. They are then cast into wells full of filth, swarms of worms or in tanks full of putrid fat and blood. They are eaten by worm and crows with beaks strong as iron.
verses.hindi: ता तप्तकुम्भ नामक नरकमें जाता है

verses.sanskrit: उत्कोचकै रुचिक्रीतैस्तस्करैश्च प्रपीड्यते । यस्य राज्ञः प्रजा राष्ट्रे पच्यते नरकेषु सः
verses.transliteration: utkochakai ruchikrItaistaskaraishcha prapIDyate | yasya rAj~naH prajA rAShTre pachyate narakeShu saH
verses.translation: Dogs, mosquitoes, wolves and tigers of terrible and hideous faces too devour them. They are roasted like fish over glowing heaps of coal.
verses.hindi: तप्तलोह नामक नरकमें दुःख भोगते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ये द्विजाः परिगृह्णन्ति नृपस्यान्यायवर्तिनः । ते प्रयान्ति तु घोरेषु नरकेषु न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ye dvijAH parigR^ihNanti nR^ipasyAnyAyavartinaH | te prayAnti tu ghoreShu narakeShu na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Due to their sinful actions men are pierced through with sharp spears. They are put in oil extracting machines called Cakra and crushed like gingelly seeds and beaten into pulp. They are fried in iron cauldrons red hot in the blazing sunlight.
verses.hindi: मूर्ख लालाभक्ष नामक नरकमें जाता है

verses.sanskrit: अन्यायात्समुपादाय द्विजेभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति । प्रजाभ्यः पच्यते सोऽपि नरकेषु नृपो यथा
verses.transliteration: anyAyAtsamupAdAya dvijebhyo yaH prayachChati | prajAbhyaH pachyate so.api narakeShu nR^ipo yathA
verses.translation: They are fried in boiling oil in cauldrons again and again. Their tongues, chests and feet are struck in many ways.
verses.hindi: चलाते हैं, वे कृमि नामक नरकमें जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: पारदारिकचौराणां चण्डानां विद्यते त्वघम् । परदाररतस्यापि राज्ञो भवति नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: pAradArikachaurANAM chaNDAnAM vidyate tvagham | paradAraratasyApi rAj~no bhavati nityashaH
verses.translation: Here the tortures to the body are very severe. Men thus go from one hell to another and are tortured in all the hells.

verses.sanskrit: अचौरं चौरवत्पश्येच्चौरं वाचौररूपिणम् । अविचार्य नृपस्तस्माद् घातयन्नरकं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: achauraM chauravatpashyechchauraM vAchaurarUpiNam | avichArya nR^ipastasmAd ghAtayannarakaM vrajet
verses.translation: O vyasa, terrible tortures are inflicted in diverse ways in all the hells by Yama's emissaries. They are grievous and painful to every part of the body.

verses.sanskrit: घृततैलान्नपानानि मधुमांससुरासवम् । गुडेक्षुशाकदुग्धानि दधिमूलफलानि च
verses.transliteration: ghR^itatailAnnapAnAni madhumAMsasurAsavam | guDekShushAkadugdhAni dadhimUlaphalAni cha
verses.translation: Their mouths are filled with the burning coals and again with acid red hot, copper hot clarified butter and oil and they are beaten afterwards.
verses.hindi: यातना भोगते हुए पड़े रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: तृणं काष्ठं पत्रपुष्पमौषधं चात्मभोजनम् । उपानत्छत्रशकटमासनं च कमण्डलुम्
verses.transliteration: tR^iNaM kAShThaM patrapuShpamauShadhaM chAtmabhojanam | upAnatChatrashakaTamAsanaM cha kamaNDalum
verses.translation: They are filled with faeces and worms and arc forced to embrace the red hot fierce iron-silk cotton tree.
verses.hindi: नीचेकी ओर मुख किये हुए देखते रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ताम्रसीसत्रपुः शस्त्रं शङ्खाद्यं च जलोद्भवम् । वाद्यं च वैणवं चान्यद्गृहोपस्करणानि च
verses.transliteration: tAmrasIsatrapuH shastraM sha~NkhAdyaM cha jalodbhavam | vAdyaM cha vaiNavaM chAnyadgR^ihopaskaraNAni cha
verses.translation: They are then beaten on the back with heated hammer. Their heads and their limbs are crushed with too blunt tooth-edged strong scissors. They are thus tortured by their own actions. Their flesh is eaten and their blood is drunk by them.

verses.sanskrit: और्ण्णकार्पासकौशेयपट्टसूत्रोद्भवानि च । स्थूलसूक्ष्माणि वस्त्राणि ये लोभाद्धि हरन्ति च
verses.transliteration: aurNNakArpAsakausheyapaTTasUtrodbhavAni cha | sthUlasUkShmANi vastrANi ye lobhAddhi haranti cha
verses.translation: Those who fed and nurtured only themselves and never made any gift of food or drink are crushed with iron rods like sugarcane.

verses.sanskrit: सभृत्यपरिवारस्य पशुधान्यधनस्य च । कुप्यधान्यपशुस्तेयमपां व्यापावनं तथा
verses.transliteration: sabhR^ityaparivArasya pashudhAnyadhanasya cha | kupyadhAnyapashusteyamapAM vyApAvanaM tathA
verses.translation: In the terrible hell Asitalavana they arc cut into pieces. Their limbs are pierced through with needles. They are staked on to heated spearheads.
verses.hindi: चित्तमें पाप -का संक्रमण भी नहीं होता

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीनि चान्यानि द्रव्याणि विविधानि च । नरकेषु ध्रुवं यान्ति चापहृत्याल्पकानि च
verses.transliteration: evamAdIni chAnyAni dravyANi vividhAni cha | narakeShu dhruvaM yAnti chApahR^ityAlpakAni cha
verses.translation: Tossed about many times their bodies do not perish but are severely pained. They become u.sed to bear the pleasure or pain.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वा यद्वा परद्रव्यमपि सर्षपमात्रकम् । अपहृत्य नरा यान्ति नरकं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tadvA yadvA paradravyamapi sarShapamAtrakam | apahR^itya narA yAnti narakaM nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: In the hell Nirucchvasa they are forced to stand without breathing, for a long time. In the hell Ucchvasa they are hit and thrashed in a house of sand.
verses.hindi: स्वर्ग सुख तथा समृद्धिके लिये होता है

verses.sanskrit: एवमाद्यैर्नरः पापैरुत्क्रान्तिसमनन्तरम् । शरीरयातनार्थाय सर्वाकारमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: evamAdyairnaraH pApairutkrAntisamanantaram | sharIrayAtanArthAya sarvAkAramavApnuyAt
verses.translation: In the hell Raurava they arc made to cry and inflicted pain by various tortures. Due to the tortures in the hell, Maharaurava, even great men cry.
verses.hindi: न दुःख देनेवाली है और न सुख देनेवाली

verses.sanskrit: यमलोकं व्रजन्त्येते शरीरेण यमाज्ञया । यमदूतैर्महाघोरैर्नीयमानाः सुदुःखिताः
verses.transliteration: yamalokaM vrajantyete sharIreNa yamAj~nayA | yamadUtairmahAghorairnIyamAnAH suduHkhitAH
verses.translation: They arc beaten on the faces, feet anus, skull,

verses.sanskrit: देवतिर्यङ्मनुष्याणामधर्मनिरतात्मनाम् । धर्मराजः स्मृतः शास्ता सुघोरैर्विविधैर्वधैः
verses.transliteration: devatirya~NmanuShyANAmadharmaniratAtmanAm | dharmarAjaH smR^itaH shAstA sughorairvividhairvadhaiH
verses.translation: They are again and again rolled on hot sand. Cast into boiling marsh of creatures they make harsh shrie¬ king sounds.

verses.sanskrit: नियमाचारयुक्तानां प्रमादात्स्खलितात्मनाम् । प्रायश्चित्तैर्गुरुः शास्ता न बुधैरिष्यते यमः
verses.transliteration: niyamAchArayuktAnAM pramAdAtskhalitAtmanAm | prAyashchittairguruH shAstA na budhairiShyate yamaH
verses.translation: O sage, in the hell kumbhipaka sinners of ruthless misdeeds are fried in unbearable boiling oil.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीश्िवमहाएुराणे पश्मम्याग॒मासंहितायां ब्रह्माण्डवर्णने नरकोद्वारवर्ण॑ नाम ब्रोडशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: पारदारिकचौराणामन्यायव्यवहारिणाम् । नृपतिः शासकः प्रोक्तः प्रच्छन्नानां स धर्म्मराट्
verses.transliteration: pAradArikachaurANAmanyAyavyavahAriNAm | nR^ipatiH shAsakaH proktaH prachChannAnAM sa dharmmarAT
verses.translation: The sinners are felled and dragged along various torturing places again and again in the hell named Lalabhaka.
verses.hindi: वरकोद्धारवर्णन नामक स्रोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् कृतस्य पापस्य प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् । नाभुक्तस्यान्यथा नाशः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: tasmAt kR^itasya pApasya prAyashchittaM samAcharet | nAbhuktasyAnyathA nAshaH kalpakoTishatairapi
verses.translation: Sinners devoid of merit are beaten by Yama*s servants. They are hurled into the torturous hell Sucimukha.
verses.hindi: मण्डलं च भुवः सम्यक् सप्तद्वीपादिसंयुतम्॥ ९  वर्णन करते हुए मुझसे भलीभाँति सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: यः करोति स्वयं कर्म कारयेच्चानुमोदयेत् । कायेन मनसा वाचा तस्य पापगतिः फलम्
verses.transliteration: yaH karoti svayaM karma kArayechchAnumodayet | kAyena manasA vAchA tasya pApagatiH phalam
verses.translation: They are put into iron pots. They breathe hard and slow. They are scorched by great fire, as if by their own sins.
verses.hindi: है-ये सभी द्वीप सात समुद्रोंसे घिरे हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञारामतडागानां दारापत्यस्य विक्रयम् । तीर्थयात्रोपवासानां व्रतोपनयकर्मिणाम्
verses.transliteration: yaj~nArAmataDAgAnAM dArApatyasya vikrayam | tIrthayAtropavAsAnAM vratopanayakarmiNAm
verses.translation: They are tied tightly with ropes and arc rolled on rocks and harassed. They are cast into deep gloomy wells. They are subjected to bee-bites.
verses.hindi: समुद्र हैं, इन सभीके मध्यमें जम्बूद्वीप स्थित है

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीधनान्युपजीवन्ति स्त्रीभिरत्यन्तनिर्जिताः । अरक्षणं च नारीणां मायया स्त्रीनिषेवणम्
verses.transliteration: strIdhanAnyupajIvanti strIbhiratyantanirjitAH | arakShaNaM cha nArINAM mAyayA strIniShevaNam
verses.translation: When their bodies are cut, bitten and gnawed by worms in a hundred places, they are hurled into wells of pun¬ gent acid.

verses.sanskrit: कालागताप्रदानं च धान्यवृद्ध्युपसेवनम् । निन्दिताच्च धनादानं पण्यानां कूटजीवनम्
verses.transliteration: kAlAgatApradAnaM cha dhAnyavR^iddhyupasevanam | ninditAchcha dhanAdAnaM paNyAnAM kUTajIvanam
verses.translation: In the blazing hell the distressed sinners, shriek and run about here and there scorched by its flames.
verses.hindi: और उत्तरमें सुपाश््व नामक पर्वत स्थित हैं

verses.sanskrit: विषमारणमन्त्राणां सततं वृषवाहनम् । उच्चाटनाभिचारं च धान्यादानं भिषक्क्रिया
verses.transliteration: viShamAraNamantrANAM satataM vR^iShavAhanam | uchchATanAbhichAraM cha dhAnyAdAnaM bhiShakkriyA
verses.translation: People are clubbed and tied together with mouths resting on shoulders and hands brought through the hollow and tied with nooses and ropes to the back. Such bundles of bodies are seen in the Mahajvala undergoing tortures.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Dragged and rolled through rough and coarse rocks, beaten and burnt like straw, the sinners of ruthless conduct, are tortured.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Dragged and rolled through rough and coarse rocks, beaten and burnt like straw, the sinners of ruthless conduct, are tortured.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । नरकलोकमार्गयमदूतस्वरूपवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । अथ पापैर्नरा यान्ति यमलोकं चतुर्विधैः । सन्त्रासजननं घोरं विवशाः सर्वदेहिनः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.7\. saptamo.adhyAyaH | narakalokamArgayamadUtasvarUpavarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | atha pApairnarA yAnti yamalokaM chaturvidhaiH | santrAsajananaM ghoraM vivashAH sarvadehinaH
verses.translation: The worms eat through their bodies with their sharp mouths and teeth. With their bodies gradually hurled over swarms of worms, heaps of putrid flesh and bones they stay there distressed, dejected and crushed between two mountains
verses.hindi: आदि पर्वत दक्षिणमें केसराचलके रूपमें स्थित हैं

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित्पङ्केन महता जलौकाभिश्च सङ्कुलैः । लोहसूचीनिभैर्दर्भैः सम्पन्नेन पथा क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: kvachitpa~Nkena mahatA jalaukAbhishcha sa~NkulaiH | lohasUchInibhairdarbhaiH sampannena pathA kvachit
verses.translation: They are kept with face down and legs up and
verses.hindi: पर्वत पश्चिम भागमें केसराचलके रूपमें स्थित हैं

verses.sanskrit: तटप्रायातिविषमैः पर्वतैर्वृक्षसङ्कुलैः । प्रतप्ताङ्गारयुक्तेन यान्ति मार्गेण दुःखिताः
verses.transliteration: taTaprAyAtiviShamaiH parvatairvR^ikShasa~NkulaiH | prataptA~NgArayuktena yAnti mArgeNa duHkhitAH
verses.translation: Red hot iron clubs are thrust into their mouths. They are helplessly forced to gnaw at it. They arc then beaten with iron threshing rods.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्विषमगर्तैश्च क्वचिल्लोष्ठैः सुदुष्करैः । सुतप्तबालुकाभिश्च तथा तीक्ष्णैश्च शङ्कुभिः
verses.transliteration: kvachidviShamagartaishcha kvachilloShThaiH suduShkaraiH | sutaptabAlukAbhishcha tathA tIkShNaishcha sha~NkubhiH
verses.translation: O Vyasa, thus the sinners of misdeeds are cooked and scorched in hells. I shall now describe their various modes of undergoing the tortures of hell.
verses.hindi: पश्चिममें चश्षु और उत्तरमें भद्रा नदी बहती है

verses.sanskrit: अनेकशाखाविततैर्व्याप्तं वंशवनैः क्वचित् । कष्टेन तमसा मार्गेणानालम्बेन कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: anekashAkhAvitatairvyAptaM vaMshavanaiH kvachit | kaShTena tamasA mArgeNAnAlambena kutrachit
verses.translation: He who follows false scriptures goes to the hell Dvijihva. He is tortured by the tongue-like ploughshares extending to one and a half kilometres.

verses.sanskrit: अयः शृङ्गाटकैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्वचिद्दावाग्निना पुनः । क्वचित्तप्तशिलाभिश्च क्वचिद्व्याप्तं हिमेन च
verses.transliteration: ayaH shR^i~NgATakaistIkShNaiH kvachiddAvAgninA punaH | kvachittaptashilAbhishcha kvachidvyAptaM himena cha
verses.translation: The mouth of the man who had been cruel to his parents and had reproached them is filled with faeces and worms and he is beaten.
verses.hindi: मनोहर केसर पर्वत भलीभाँति अवस्थित हैं

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्वालुकया व्याप्तमाकण्ठान्तः प्रवेशया । क्वचिद्दुष्टाम्बुना व्याप्तं क्वचिच्च करिषाग्निना
verses.transliteration: kvachidvAlukayA vyAptamAkaNThAntaH praveshayA | kvachidduShTAmbunA vyAptaM kvachichcha kariShAgninA
verses.translation: Men who defile the temple of Siva, the park surrounding it and the wells, tanks and lakes therein, in various ways such as playing there, applying oil and unguents over the body, drinking bouts, taking food, indulgence in sexual inter¬ course, game of dice etc. are tortured by being crushed in the sugercane-cruohing machine and other mechanical contrivances. They are scorched in hellish fire till the final day of dissolution.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित् सिहैर्वृकैर्व्याघ्रैर्मशकैश्च सुदारुणैः । क्वचिन्महाजलौकाभिः क्वचिच्चाजगरैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kvachit sihairvR^ikairvyAghrairmashakaishcha sudAruNaiH | kvachinmahAjalaukAbhiH kvachichchAjagaraistathA
verses.translation: Sinners who indulge in illicit union with other's wives are forced to embrace red-hot iron images of those women with whom they had illicit relation and struck in various ways.

verses.sanskrit: मक्षिकाभिश्च रौद्राभिः क्वचित् सर्पैर्विषोल्बणैः । मत्तमातङ्गयूथैश्च बलोन्मत्तैः प्रमाथिभिः
verses.transliteration: makShikAbhishcha raudrAbhiH kvachit sarpairviSholbaNaiH | mattamAta~NgayUthaishcha balonmattaiH pramAthibhiH
verses.translation: Images of those men are made of red hot iron and the erring women are forced to embrace those images. They cry and shriek.
verses.hindi: शतशः सन्त क्षुद्राश्न तासु क्रीडेच्छुभो जन: ॥ ४४  उत्तम लोग विहार करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: पन्थानमुल्लिखद्भिश्च सूकरैस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रिभिः । तीक्ष्णशृङ्गैश्च महिषैः सर्वभूतैश्च श्वापदैः
verses.transliteration: panthAnamullikhadbhishcha sUkaraistIkShNadaMShTribhiH | tIkShNashR^i~Ngaishcha mahiShaiH sarvabhUtaishcha shvApadaiH
verses.translation: Those who listen to the censure of good people are punished thus: ears filled with red hot pins of
verses.hindi: जम्बूद्वीपवर्षवर्णन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: डाकिनीभिश्च रौद्राभिर्विकरालैश्च राक्षसैः । व्याधिभिश्च महाघोरैः पीड्यमाना व्रजन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: DAkinIbhishcha raudrAbhirvikarAlaishcha rAkShasaiH | vyAdhibhishcha mahAghoraiH pIDyamAnA vrajanti hi
verses.translation: The hands of those sinners who touch other's wives are filled with red hot fillings.
verses.hindi: उत्तरे तु समुद्रस्थ भारती यत्र संसृति:॥ भारतवर्षका वर्णन करूँगा, जहाँ भारती सृष्टि है

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थैर्जायमानैश्च बालैस्तरुणमध्यमैः । स्त्रीपुन्नपुंसकैर्जीवैर्ज्ञातव्यं सर्वजन्तुषु
verses.transliteration: garbhasthairjAyamAnaishcha bAlaistaruNamadhyamaiH | strIpunnapuMsakairjIvairj~nAtavyaM sarvajantuShu
verses.translation: Their bodies are smeared with corrosive substances such as acid etc. Tortures are acute and grievous in all the hells.
verses.hindi: विंध्यश्च पारियात्रशच सप्तात्र कुलपर्वता:॥ ८ एवं पारियात्र-ये सात कुलपर्वत हैं

verses.sanskrit: महाधूलिविमिश्रेण महाचण्डेन वायुना । महापाषाणवर्षेण हन्यमाना निराश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: mahAdhUlivimishreNa mahAchaNDena vAyunA | mahApAShANavarSheNa hanyamAnA nirAshrayAH
verses.translation: The faces of men who show wry faces with knit eye-brows to their parents are scratched from end to end with sharp pikes.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्विद्युत्प्रपातेन दह्यमाना व्रजन्ति च । महता बाणवर्षेण विध्यमानाश्च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: kvachidvidyutprapAtena dahyamAnA vrajanti cha | mahatA bANavarSheNa vidhyamAnAshcha sarvataH
verses.translation: The organs wherewith men defile or harass women are respectively tortured.
verses.hindi: विन्ध्योद्धवा महानद्य: सर्वपापहरा: शुभाः॥ १०  जो सम्पूर्ण पापोंका हरण करती हैं

verses.sanskrit: पतद्भिर्वज्रपातैश्च उल्कापातैश्च दारुणैः । प्रदीप्ताङ्गारवर्षेण दह्यमानाश्च सन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: patadbhirvajrapAtaishcha ulkApAtaishcha dAruNaiH | pradIptA~NgAravarSheNa dahyamAnAshcha santi hi
verses.translation: If people take food without first offering it to the gods, firegod, preceptors and brahmins, their tongues and mouths are pierced through and filled with hundreds of red- hot nails of iron.

verses.sanskrit: महता पांसुवर्षेण पूर्यमाणा रुदन्ति च । महामेघरवैर्घोरैस्त्रस्यन्ते च मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: mahatA pAMsuvarSheNa pUryamANA rudanti cha | mahAmegharavairghoraistrasyante cha muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: If men, out of greed, pluck and sniff at flowers of the temple parks, or wear them on their heads,*®* their heads arc covered with iron spikes and their noses are filled with plenty of acid and other things.

verses.sanskrit: निशितायुधवर्षेण भिद्यमानाश्च सर्वतः । महाक्षाराम्बुधाराभिः सिच्यमाना व्रजन्ति च
verses.transliteration: nishitAyudhavarSheNa bhidyamAnAshcha sarvataH | mahAkShArAmbudhArAbhiH sichyamAnA vrajanti cha
verses.translation: Red-hot three-pointed iron rods are thrust and pushed through the chest, neck, tongue, tooth-joints, palate, lips, nostrils and all the limb-joints of those persons who slander and censure the noble-preacher of virtue, devotees of the gods, fire-god and preceptor as well as the eternal scriptural texts.

verses.sanskrit: महीशीतेन मरुता रूक्षेण परुषेण च । समन्ताद् बाध्यमानाश्च शुष्यन्ते सङ्कुचन्ति च
verses.transliteration: mahIshItena marutA rUkSheNa paruSheNa cha | samantAd bAdhyamAnAshcha shuShyante sa~Nkuchanti cha
verses.translation: The crevices of the body are filled with corrosive acid. Severe tortures are inflicted all over the body.
verses.hindi: इन नदियों तथा अन्य सरोवरोंका जल पीते हैं

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं मार्गेण रौद्रेण पाथेयरहितेन च । निरालम्बेन दुर्गेण निर्जलेन समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: itthaM mArgeNa raudreNa pAtheyarahitena cha | nirAlambena durgeNa nirjalena samantataH
verses.translation: In all hells various tortures of grievous nature are inflicted on hands and feet.
verses.hindi: चारों युग होते हैं, अन्य द्वीपोंमें ये नहीं होते

verses.sanskrit: विषमेणैव महता निर्जनापाश्रयेण च । तमोरूपेण कष्टेन सर्वदुष्टाश्रयेण च
verses.transliteration: viShameNaiva mahatA nirjanApAshrayeNa cha | tamorUpeNa kaShTena sarvaduShTAshrayeNa cha
verses.translation: As a result of the previous tortures their minds and all sense-organs are put to great misery. Those who, despite being rich do not make monetary gifts due to greed, and those who dishonour guests visiting their houses at the proper time, commit sins and fall into dirty hell.

verses.sanskrit: नीयन्ते देहिनः सर्वे ये मूढाः पापकर्मिणः । यमदूतैर्महाघोरैस्तदाज्ञाकारिभिर्बलात्
verses.transliteration: nIyante dehinaH sarve ye mUDhAH pApakarmiNaH | yamadUtairmahAghoraistadAj~nAkAribhirbalAt
verses.translation: He who is dark and he who is multi-coloured— these two are the obstacles to the path of Yama. To these two dogs®** I am offering this oblation. Let them take this oblation. Let the pious crows in the direction of Vanina (west), of Vayu (north-west), of Yama (south) and of Nairrti (south-west), accept this oblation of mine". Those who offer this Bali with Siva's mantras, after worshipping Siva with devotion and performing Homa duly* do not face Yama. They go straight to heaven. Hence this oblation shall be offered daily. A square mystic diagram is made and sweet

verses.sanskrit: एकाकिनः पराधीना मित्रबन्धुविवर्जिताः । शोचन्तः स्वानि कर्माणि रुदन्तश्च मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: ekAkinaH parAdhInA mitrabandhuvivarjitAH | shochantaH svAni karmANi rudantashcha muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: The text mentions the two dogs and crows to whom the offer- irigs shall be made in favour of the departed spirit. It inentions the cow that takes the spirits across Vaitaraal.

verses.sanskrit: शुभाशुभफलं चात्र देहिनां संविचार्यते । चित्रगुप्तादिभिः सर्वैः वसिष्ठप्रमुखैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: shubhAshubhaphalaM chAtra dehinAM saMvichAryate | chitraguptAdibhiH sarvaiH vasiShThapramukhaistathA
verses.translation: He who serves the cow thus with faith and reverence deserves to maintain the sacrificial fires. He who forsakes it is drowned in the hell Tamisra. Hence after offering Bali to these at the door, the householder shall medi¬ tate for a short while.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्‍न होकर इन नदियोंका जल पीते हैं

verses.sanskrit: प्रेता भूत्वा विवस्त्राश्च शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुकाः । असौम्या भयभीताश्च दह्यमानाः क्षुधान्विताः
verses.transliteration: pretA bhUtvA vivastrAshcha shuShkakaNThauShThatAlukAH | asaumyA bhayabhItAshcha dahyamAnAH kShudhAnvitAH
verses.translation: One shall feed the hungry guest staying in the same village with auspicious food, in accordance with his ability and with the same dishes as he partakes of himself.

verses.sanskrit: बद्धाः शृङ्खलया केचिदुत्ता नपादका नराः । कृष्यन्ते कृष्यमाणाश्च यमदूतैर्बलोत्कटैः
verses.transliteration: baddhAH shR^i~NkhalayA kechiduttA napAdakA narAH | kR^iShyante kR^iShyamANAshcha yamadUtairbalotkaTaiH
verses.translation: If a guest turns back from a house disappointed he takes away all the merits of the householder and leaves his own sins behind.
verses.hindi: वे सब पवित्र तथा शीतल जलवाली हैं

verses.sanskrit: उरसाधोमुखाश्चान्ये घृष्यमाणाः सुदुःखिताः । केशपाशनिबन्धेन सङ्कृष्यन्ते च रज्जुना
verses.transliteration: urasAdhomukhAshchAnye ghR^iShyamANAH suduHkhitAH | keshapAshanibandhena sa~NkR^iShyante cha rajjunA
verses.translation: A man eating delicious food by himself stays in the hdl for a long time fettered in the body and pierced in the tongue with force.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोंसे सदा भगवान् शिवका यजन करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ललाटे चाङ्कुशेनान्ये भिन्ना दुष्यन्ति देहिनः । उत्तानाः कण्टकपथा क्वचिदङ्गारवर्त्मना
verses.transliteration: lalATe chA~NkushenAnye bhinnA duShyanti dehinaH | uttAnAH kaNTakapathA kvachida~NgAravartmanA
verses.translation: Bits of his own flesh, of the size of a small gingelly seed, arc cut off from his body and are given to him for eating. Blood is similarly taken and given for drinking. He is then beaten with whips. Thus he is tor¬ mented with hunger and thirst.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चाद् बाहुनिबद्धाश्च जठरेण प्रपीडिताः । पूरिताः शृङ्खलाभिश्च हस्तयोश्च सुकीलिताः
verses.transliteration: pashchAd bAhunibaddhAshcha jaThareNa prapIDitAH | pUritAH shR^i~NkhalAbhishcha hastayoshcha sukIlitAH
verses.translation: These and similar things constitute the terrible

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीवापाशेन कृष्यन्ते प्रयान्त्यन्ये सुदुःखिताः । जिह्वाङ्कुशप्रवेशेन रज्ज्वाकृष्यन्त एव ते
verses.transliteration: grIvApAshena kR^iShyante prayAntyanye suduHkhitAH | jihvA~Nkushapraveshena rajjvAkR^iShyanta eva te
verses.translation: The gifts offered to the principal gods, manes, subsidiary gods, and human beings with the utterance of words PTSandrT

verses.sanskrit: नासाभेदेन रज्ज्वा च त्वाकृष्यन्ते तथापरे । भिन्नाः कपोलयो रज्ज्वा कृष्यन्तेऽन्ये तथौष्ठयोः
verses.transliteration: nAsAbhedena rajjvA cha tvAkR^iShyante tathApare | bhinnAH kapolayo rajjvA kR^iShyante.anye tathauShThayoH
verses.translation: There may be a person who has done more sin than good or a person who has done more good than evil. Now listen to the result of their actions.

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नाग्रपादहस्ताश्च छिन्नकर्णोष्ठनासिकाः । सञ्छिन्नशिश्नवृषणाः छिन्नभिन्नाङ्गसन्धयः
verses.transliteration: ChinnAgrapAdahastAshcha ChinnakarNoShThanAsikAH | sa~nChinnashishnavR^iShaNAH ChinnabhinnA~NgasandhayaH
verses.translation: On the other hand a man of more good actions is not distressed by a few sufferings due to small sins just as a rich householder is not distressed by hunger when he fasts for a day.
verses.hindi: तथा शुक्लपक्षमें न्‍्यूनाधिक्य होता रहता है

verses.sanskrit: आभिद्यमानाः कुन्तैश्च भिद्यमानाश्च सायकैः । इतश्चेतश्च धावन्तः क्रन्दमाना निराश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: AbhidyamAnAH kuntaishcha bhidyamAnAshcha sAyakaiH | itashchetashcha dhAvantaH krandamAnA nirAshrayAH
verses.translation: There are great sins in the world which shatter a man into hundreds of pieces like a mountain struck down by thunderbolt.
verses.hindi: यह सभी प्रकारके प्राणियोंसे रहित है

verses.sanskrit: मुद्गरैर्लोहदण्डैश्च हन्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः । कण्टकैर्विविधैर्घोरैर्ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभैः
verses.transliteration: mudgarairlohadaNDaishcha hanyamAnA muhurmuhuH | kaNTakairvividhairghorairjvalanArkasamaprabhaiH
verses.translation: Those who commit sins go along (he path to Yama with great misery. O holy lord, now narrate the righteous deeds which render pleasure in the path of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: न केचित्प्राणिनः सन्ति ये न यान्ति यमक्षयम् । अवश्यं हि कृतं कर्म भोक्तव्यं तद्विचार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: na kechitprANinaH santi ye na yAnti yamakShayam | avashyaM hi kR^itaM karma bhoktavyaM tadvichAryatAm
verses.translation: Auspicious or inauspicious, one has of necessity to reap the fruit of actions committed by him without thinking. I shall now mention those sacred rites that yield happiness.

verses.sanskrit: भिन्दिपालैर्विभिद्यन्ते स्रवतः पूयशोणितम् । शकृता कृमिदिग्धाश्च नीयन्ते विवशा नराः
verses.transliteration: bhindipAlairvibhidyante sravataH pUyashoNitam | shakR^itA kR^imidigdhAshcha nIyante vivashA narAH
verses.translation: Men who perform auspicious rites here, whose minds are gentle and who are merciful pass through the terrible path of Yama happily.

verses.sanskrit: याचमानाश्च सलिलमन्नं वापि बुभुक्षिताः । छायां प्रार्थयमानाश्च शीतार्ताश्चानलं पुनः
verses.transliteration: yAchamAnAshcha salilamannaM vApi bubhukShitAH | ChAyAM prArthayamAnAshcha shItArtAshchAnalaM punaH
verses.translation: He who makes gifts of sandals of leather or wood to leading brahmins goes happily to the abode of Yama on a great horse.
verses.hindi: सप्तद्वीपर्णन नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: दानहीनाः प्रयान्त्येवं प्रार्थयन्तः सुखं नराः । गृहीतदानपाथेयाः सुखं यान्ति यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: dAnahInAH prayAntyevaM prArthayantaH sukhaM narAH | gR^ihItadAnapAtheyAH sukhaM yAnti yamAlayam
verses.translation: By making gifts of umbrella they go holding an umbrella. By making gifts of palanquin he goes by means of a chariot.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वी है, उसीको भूलोक कहा जाता है

verses.sanskrit: एवं न्यायेन कष्टेन प्राप्ताः प्रेतपुरं यदा । प्रज्ञापितास्ततो दूतैर्निवेश्यन्ते यमाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: evaM nyAyena kaShTena prAptAH pretapuraM yadA | praj~nApitAstato dUtairniveshyante yamAgrataH
verses.translation: By making giBs of beds tind seats he goes with ample rest. Those who make shady parks or those who plant trees on the wayside go without wearine.ss even in the hottest region.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ये शुभकर्माणस्तांस्तु सम्मानयेद्यमः । स्वागतासनदानेन पाद्यार्घ्येण प्रियेण च
verses.transliteration: tatra ye shubhakarmANastAMstu sammAnayedyamaH | svAgatAsanadAnena pAdyArghyeNa priyeNa cha
verses.translation: Men making flower gardens go by the aerial chariot Puspaka. Makers of temples feel at home on the way.

verses.sanskrit: धन्या यूयं महात्मानो निगमोदितकारिणः । यैश्च दिव्यसुखार्थाय भवद्भिः सुकृतं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: dhanyA yUyaM mahAtmAno nigamoditakAriNaH | yaishcha divyasukhArthAya bhavadbhiH sukR^itaM kR^itam
verses.translation: The founders of hermitages of ascetics and Rest houses for the orphans feel as if they play in the house.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य दिव्यस्त्रीभोगभूषितम् । स्वर्गं गच्छध्वममलं सर्वकामसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: divyaM vimAnamAruhya divyastrIbhogabhUShitam | svargaM gachChadhvamamalaM sarvakAmasamanvitam
verses.translation: Worshippers of the gods, fire-god brahmins and their parents go along that path as they please. They are honoured on the way.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगानन्ते पुण्यस्य सङ्क्षयात् । यत्किञ्चिदल्पमशुभं पुनस्तदिह भोक्ष्यथ
verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvA mahAbhogAnante puNyasya sa~NkShayAt | yatki~nchidalpamashubhaM punastadiha bhokShyatha
verses.translation: Those who gift lamps, go brightly illuminating all the ten quarters. By giving dwellings and asylums they go without ailments on the way.
verses.hindi: ऊपर अन्य कोई लोक हैं अथवा नहीं

verses.sanskrit: धर्मात्मानो नरा ये च मित्रभूता इवात्मनः । सौम्यं मुखं प्रपश्यन्ति धर्मराजनमेव च
verses.transliteration: dharmAtmAno narA ye cha mitrabhUtA ivAtmanaH | saumyaM mukhaM prapashyanti dharmarAjanameva cha
verses.translation: Those who habitually serve their preceptors go without difficulty. They get ample rest on the way. Those who gift musical instruments to brahmins go happily feeling at home on the way.
verses.hindi: आया हुआ मैं आपसे उनका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनः क्रूरकर्माणस्ते पश्यन्ति भयानकम् । दंष्ट्राकरालवदनं भृकुटीकुटिलेक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: ye punaH krUrakarmANaste pashyanti bhayAnakam | daMShTrAkarAlavadanaM bhR^ikuTIkuTilekShaNam
verses.translation: Givers of cows go along the path flourishing with all their desires. They get those food-stuflfs and drinks which they give away here, on that path also.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ये शुभकर्माणः सौम्यचित्ता दयान्विताः । ते नरा यान्ति सौम्येन पूर्वं यमनिकेतनम्
verses.transliteration: tatra ye shubhakarmANaH saumyachittA dayAnvitAH | te narA yAnti saumyena pUrvaM yamaniketanam
verses.translation: By giving water for washing the feet one goes along the path full of water. He who gifts oils for massaging the feet goes on horseback along that way.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वकेशं महाश्मश्रुमूर्ध्वप्रस्फुरिताधरम् । अष्टादशभुजं क्रुद्धं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम्
verses.transliteration: UrdhvakeshaM mahAshmashrumUrdhvaprasphuritAdharam | aShTAdashabhujaM kruddhaM nIlA~njanachayopamam
verses.translation: O Vyasa, Yama never comes near the man who always makes gifts of water for washing the feet, oil for massa¬ ging, lamps, foodstufls and dwellings.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वायुधोद्धृतकरं सर्वदण्डेन तर्जयन् । महामहिषमारूढं दीप्ताग्निसमलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAyudhoddhR^itakaraM sarvadaNDena tarjayan | mahAmahiShamArUDhaM dIptAgnisamalochanam
verses.translation: By making gifts of gold and gems he crosses all impassable hurdles. By gifting silver and oxen he goes to Yamaloka happily.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरं महामेरुमिवोच्छ्रितम् । प्रलयाम्बुदनिर्घोषं पिबन्निव महोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: raktamAlyAmbaradharaM mahAmerumivochChritam | pralayAmbudanirghoShaM pibanniva mahodadhim
verses.translation: By these and similar charitable gifts people go happily to Yama's abode. They attain different pleasures in the heaven.
verses.hindi: जहाँ जाकर शिवभक्त मनुष्य फिर नहीं लौटते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ग्रसन्तमिव शैलेन्द्रमुद्गिरन्तमिवानलम् । मृत्युश्चैव समीपस्थः कालानलसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: grasantamiva shailendramudgirantamivAnalam | mR^ityushchaiva samIpasthaH kAlAnalasamaprabhaH
verses.translation: Food gives blood, flesh, fat and semen and out of semen living beings are born. Hence the universe is identical with food.

verses.sanskrit: कालश्चाञ्जनसङ्काशः कृतान्तश्च भयानकः । मारी चोग्रमहामारी कालरात्रिश्च दारुणा
verses.transliteration: kAlashchA~njanasa~NkAshaH kR^itAntashcha bhayAnakaH | mArI chogramahAmArI kAlarAtrishcha dAruNA
verses.translation: Hungry men are not delighted even if they possess these things viz—gold, gems, horses, elephants, women, garlands, sandal paste and the like.

verses.sanskrit: विविधा व्याधयः कुष्ठा नानारूपा भयावहाः । शक्तिशूलाङ्कुशधराः पाशचक्रासिपाणयः
verses.transliteration: vividhA vyAdhayaH kuShThA nAnArUpA bhayAvahAH | shaktishUlA~NkushadharAH pAshachakrAsipANayaH
verses.translation: All persons, the child in the womb, the new born babe, the child, the middle aged man, the old man, the gods, the danavas or Raksasas desire food.
verses.hindi: हैं, मेरे इस वचनको सत्य जानिये

verses.sanskrit: वज्रतुण्डधरा रौद्राः क्षुरतूणधनुर्द्धराः । नानायुधधराः सर्वे महावीरा भयङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: vajratuNDadharA raudrAH kShuratUNadhanurddharAH | nAnAyudhadharAH sarve mahAvIrA bhaya~NkarAH
verses.translation: All embodied beings die when scorched by the fire of hunger. That is why it is glorified that there is great merit in the charitable gift of food.

verses.sanskrit: असङ्ख्याता महावीराः कालाञ्जनसमप्रभाः । सर्वायुधोद्यतकरा यमदूता भयानकाः
verses.transliteration: asa~NkhyAtA mahAvIrAH kAlA~njanasamaprabhAH | sarvAyudhodyatakarA yamadUtA bhayAnakAH
verses.translation: If a man performs holy and sacred rites after being nourished with the food gifted by someone, the merit of the sacred rites is shared half and half by the two—namely by the giver of food and the performer of the rites. There is no doubt in this.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन परिचारेण वृतं तं घोरदर्शनम् । यमं पश्यन्ति पापिष्ठाश्चित्रगुप्तं च भीषणम्
verses.transliteration: anena parichAreNa vR^itaM taM ghoradarshanam | yamaM pashyanti pApiShThAshchitraguptaM cha bhIShaNam
verses.translation: The giver of charitable gift of food obtains here and hereafter whatever means of pleasure there are in the three worlds such as gems, women and vehicles.

verses.sanskrit: निर्भर्त्सयति चात्यन्तं यमस्तान्पापकर्मणः । चित्रगुप्तश्च भगवान् धर्मवाक्यैः प्रबोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: nirbhartsayati chAtyantaM yamastAnpApakarmaNaH | chitraguptashcha bhagavAn dharmavAkyaiH prabodhayet
verses.translation: Even by putting one's family to inconvenience and trouble one should give food to a mendicant brahmin of noble soul, if one wishes for one's prosperity.
verses.hindi: माया उसे अज्ञानसे मोहित कर लेती है

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनः पापकर्माणः पापा दानविवर्जिताः । ते घोरेण पथा यान्ति दक्षिणेन यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: ye punaH pApakarmANaH pApA dAnavivarjitAH | te ghoreNa pathA yAnti dakShiNena yamAlayam
verses.translation: He who gives food to a suppliant brahmin in distress actually makes an excellent deposit facilititing his benefit in the other world.
verses.hindi: चाहिए, जिससे नरकमें न जाना पड़े

verses.sanskrit: षडशीतिसहस्राणि योजनानामतीत्य तत् । वैवस्वतपुरं ज्ञेयं नानारूपमवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: ShaDashItisahasrANi yojanAnAmatItya tat | vaivasvatapuraM j~neyaM nAnArUpamavasthitam
verses.translation: A householder, desirous of prosperity shall worship a brahmin who has approached him at the proper time for his livelihood, or who is travel-weary and comes to his house as a guest.

verses.sanskrit: समीपस्थमिवाभाति नराणां पुण्यकर्मणाम् । पापिनामतिदूरस्थं यथा रौद्रेण गच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: samIpasthamivAbhAti narANAM puNyakarmaNAm | pApinAmatidUrasthaM yathA raudreNa gachChatAm
verses.translation: O Vyasa, a giver of food, of good conduct and free from malice, is honoured. A gift of food never goes in- vain be it to a dog or a person who cooks dogs. If a person eschews anger that surges up he derives happiness here and hereafter. He should not encourage it even if it is natural. One shall try to eschew it somehow.

verses.sanskrit: तीक्ष्णकण्टकयुक्तेन शर्कराविचितेन च । क्षुरधारानिभैस्तीक्ष्णैः पाषाणै रचितेन च
verses.transliteration: tIkShNakaNTakayuktena sharkarAvichitena cha | kShuradhArAnibhaistIkShNaiH pAShANai rachitena cha
verses.translation: He who gives food to a weary, unknown traveller, without feeling distressed for the same will derive prosperity.
verses.hindi: यह अध्रुव शरीर तो नष्ट होनेवाला ही है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Gift of food and drink whether to a 8udra or to a brahmin is equally excellent. One should not ask the spiritual lineage,*®* branch of the Vedas*® or the country of the recipient.
verses.hindi: होनेपर कौन धेर्य धारण कर सकता है 2

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Gift of food and drink whether to a 8udra or to a brahmin is equally excellent. One should not ask the spiritual lineage,*®* branch of the Vedas*® or the country of the recipient.
verses.hindi: खर्चके लिये इस धनका दान क्यों नहीं करता ?

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.८. अष्टमोऽध्यायः । नरकलोकवर्णनम् । चित्रगुप्त उवाच । भो भो दुष्कृतकर्माणः परद्रव्यापहारकाः । गर्विता रूपवीर्येण परदारावमर्दकाः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.8\. aShTamo.adhyAyaH | narakalokavarNanam | chitragupta uvAcha | bho bho duShkR^itakarmANaH paradravyApahArakAH | garvitA rUpavIryeNa paradArAvamardakAH
verses.translation: He who gives food when begged by a brahmin, goes to the highest heaven and remains there till the final

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैरुपलब्धा यमेन ते । स्वानि कर्माणि शोचन्ति तूष्णीं तिष्ठन्ति पार्थिवाः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | evaM bahuvidhairvAkyairupalabdhA yamena te | svAni karmANi shochanti tUShNIM tiShThanti pArthivAH
verses.translation: The garden of a food-giver acquires the fruits of his cherished desire as the brahmins do in the highest heaven.

verses.sanskrit: इति कर्म समुद्दिश्य नृपाणां धर्मराड् यमः । तत्पापपङ्कशुद्ध्यर्थमिदं दूतान् ब्रवीति च
verses.transliteration: iti karma samuddishya nR^ipANAM dharmarAD yamaH | tatpApapa~NkashuddhyarthamidaM dUtAn bravIti cha
verses.translation: O sage, O great sage, listen to the divine regions which are created in the heaven by the gifts of food, for the givor of food.
verses.hindi: मोक्ष-साधन एवं पुण्यसमूहका एकमात्र स्थान हैं

verses.sanskrit: यमराज उवाच । भो भोश्चण्ड महाचण्ड गृहीत्वा नृपतीन्बलात् । नियमेन विशुद्यध्वं क्रमेण नरकाग्निषु
verses.transliteration: yamarAja uvAcha | bho bhoshchaNDa mahAchaNDa gR^ihItvA nR^ipatInbalAt | niyamena vishudyadhvaM krameNa narakAgniShu
verses.translation: The abodes of those noble souls in the heaven shine in various shapes and arc equipped with every desirable object.
verses.hindi: अन्य कोई उपाय नहीं दिखायी देता है

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । ततः शीघ्रं समादाय नृपान् सङ्गृह्य पादयोः । भ्रामयित्वा तु वेगेन निक्षिप्योर्ध्वं प्रगृह्य च
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | tataH shIghraM samAdAya nR^ipAn sa~NgR^ihya pAdayoH | bhrAmayitvA tu vegena nikShipyordhvaM pragR^ihya cha
verses.translation: The trees bear the fruits of all desires. The golden lakes in the mansions, the auspicious wells and tanks are all excellent.
verses.hindi: शजिवभकत्या महाप्राज्ञ भुक्तिं मुक्ति च विन्दति॥ ५४  तथा मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: सर्वप्रायेण महतातीव तप्ते शिलातले । आस्फालयन्ति तरसा वज्रेणेव महाद्रुमान्
verses.transliteration: sarvaprAyeNa mahatAtIva tapte shilAtale | AsphAlayanti tarasA vajreNeva mahAdrumAn
verses.translation: The auspicious drinks of various varieties are proclaimed. There are huge mountains of food-stuffs, gar¬ ments and ornaments.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां मनुविशेषकथनं नाम विंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: ततः स रक्तं श्रोत्रेण स्रवते जर्जरीकृतः । निःसंज्ञः स तदा देही निश्चेष्टः सम्प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: tataH sa raktaM shrotreNa sravate jarjarIkR^itaH | niHsa.nj~naH sa tadA dehI nishcheShTaH samprajAyate
verses.translation: Milk flows in rivers there. There are huge mountains of ghee. The palaces are white in colour. Beds are brilliant like gold.
verses.hindi: ॥इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत पाँचवीं उमासंहितामें मन॒विशेषकथन नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ततः स वायुना स्पृष्टः स तैरुज्जीवितः पुनः । ततः पापविशुद्ध्यर्थं क्षिपन्ति नरकार्णवे
verses.transliteration: tataH sa vAyunA spR^iShTaH sa tairujjIvitaH punaH | tataH pApavishuddhyarthaM kShipanti narakArNave
verses.translation: The giver of food goes to these regions. One should be a giver of food if one wishes for one's own good in this or in the other world.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाविंशतिसङ्ख्याभिः क्षित्यधः सप्तकोटयः । सप्तमस्य तलस्यान्ते घोरे तमसि संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: aShTAviMshatisa~NkhyAbhiH kShityadhaH saptakoTayaH | saptamasya talasyAnte ghore tamasi saMsthitaH
verses.translation: These regions of the meritorious givers of food are very brilliant. Hence food shall be given as gift by the people.
verses.hindi: ४  भ्रष्ट होकर क्षत्रियत्वका सेवन करता है

verses.sanskrit: घोराख्या प्रथमा कोटिः सुघोरा तदधः स्थिता । अतिघोरा महाघोरा घोररूपा च पञ्चमी
verses.transliteration: ghorAkhyA prathamA koTiH sughorA tadadhaH sthitA | atighorA mahAghorA ghorarUpA cha pa~nchamI
verses.translation: Even after committing a great sin if a man gives food to the needy he becomes rid of all sins. He goes to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठी तलातलाख्या च सप्तमी च भयानका । अष्टमी कालरात्रिश्च नवमी च भयोत्कटा
verses.transliteration: ShaShThI talAtalAkhyA cha saptamI cha bhayAnakA | aShTamI kAlarAtrishcha navamI cha bhayotkaTA
verses.translation: The eight gifts are honoured most in the land of the dead viz food, drink, horse, cow, garments, bed, umbrella and seat.
verses.hindi: है, वह पुन: क्षत्रिय हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: यत् स्वयं क्रियते कर्म तदिदं भुज्यते पुनः । तत्किमात्मोपघातार्थं भवद्भिर्दुष्कृतं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yat svayaM kriyate karma tadidaM bhujyate punaH | tatkimAtmopaghAtArthaM bhavadbhirduShkR^itaM kR^itam
verses.translation: If a man wishes to go to the city of Yama in the aerial chariot, he shall necessarily make these special gifts.
verses.hindi: करता है, मैं वह सब आपसे कहता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: दशमी तदधश्चण्डा महाचण्डा ततोऽप्यधः । चण्डकोलाहला चान्या प्रचण्डा चण्डनायिका
verses.transliteration: dashamI tadadhashchaNDA mahAchaNDA tato.apyadhaH | chaNDakolAhalA chAnyA prachaNDA chaNDanAyikA
verses.translation: This sacred narrative gives instances of the virtue of gifts of foodstuflTs; whoever reads this or teaches this to others flourishes indeed.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मा पद्मावती भीता भीमा भीषणनायिका । कराला विकराला च वज्रा विंशतिमा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: padmA padmAvatI bhItA bhImA bhIShaNanAyikA | karAlA vikarAlA cha vajrA viMshatimA smR^itA
verses.translation: O great sage, if a person listens to this or nar¬ rates this at the performance of Sraddha to brahmins, it results in a never-ending gift of food to the Pitri.
verses.hindi: वक्ताओंमें श्रेष् आप उसका वर्णन कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकोणा पञ्चकोणा च सुदीर्घा चाखिलार्तिदा । समा भीमबलाभोग्रा दीप्तप्रायेति चाष्टमी
verses.transliteration: trikoNA pa~nchakoNA cha sudIrghA chAkhilArtidA | samA bhImabalAbhogrA dIptaprAyeti chAShTamI
verses.translation: Hence one should make gifts of drinking water¬ sheds lovingly and unrestrictedly. Making of water bases, tanks etc. is the cause of great bliss.
verses.hindi: उसका वर्णन मैं आपसे करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: इति ते नामतः प्रोक्ता घोरा नरककोटयः । अष्टाविंशतिरेवैताः पापानां यातनात्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: iti te nAmataH proktA ghorA narakakoTayaH | aShTAviMshatirevaitAH pApAnAM yAtanAtmikAH
verses.translation: A well that abounds in water removes half of the sin of the man who causes it to be dug.
verses.hindi: गये यज्ञका फल प्राप्त होता है

verses.sanskrit: तासां क्रमेण विज्ञेयाः पञ्च पञ्चैव नायकाः । प्रत्येकं सर्वकोटीनां नामतः सन्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: tAsAM krameNa vij~neyAH pa~ncha pa~nchaiva nAyakAH | pratyekaM sarvakoTInAM nAmataH sannibodhata
verses.translation: If cows drink and good men and brahmins make use of the water in a water-base dug by a man, the whole family is redeemed.
verses.hindi: देता है, वह वीर स्वर्गसे नहीं लौटता है

verses.sanskrit: रौरवः प्रथमस्तेषां रुदन्ते यत्र देहिनः । महारौरवपीडाभिर्महान्तोऽपि रुदन्ति च
verses.transliteration: rauravaH prathamasteShAM rudante yatra dehinaH | mahArauravapIDAbhirmahAnto.api rudanti cha
verses.translation: He who dig a lake attains an endless merit. The wise say that it is the fruit of virtue, wealth and love.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शीतं तथा चोष्णं पञ्चाद्या नायकाः स्मृताः । सुघोरः सुमहातीक्ष्णस्तथा सञ्जीवनः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tataH shItaM tathA choShNaM pa~nchAdyA nAyakAH smR^itAH | sughoraH sumahAtIkShNastathA sa~njIvanaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: The gods, human beings, Gandharvas, Pitfs, ser¬ pents, Rakasas and the immobile beings depend upon water bases.

verses.sanskrit: महातमो विलोमश्च विलोपश्चापि कण्टकः । तीव्रवेगः करालश्च विकरालः प्रकम्पनः
verses.transliteration: mahAtamo vilomashcha vilopashchApi kaNTakaH | tIvravegaH karAlashcha vikarAlaH prakampanaH
verses.translation: Brahma says that the benefit of the sacred rite Agnihotra is derived by a man in the lake dug by whom there is plenty of water in the rainy season.
verses.hindi: चाहिए और जिसे छोड़ देना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: महावक्रश्च कालश्च कालसूत्रः प्रगर्जनः । सूचीमुखः सुनेतिश्च खादकः सुप्रपीडनः
verses.transliteration: mahAvakrashcha kAlashcha kAlasUtraH pragarjanaH | sUchImukhaH sunetishcha khAdakaH suprapIDanaH
verses.translation: O sage Vyasa, the merit accruing from the dig¬ ging of water bases, excellent and pleasing to all living beings, has been narrated to you. Now listen to the merits of planting trees.
verses.hindi: - जृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्चम्यागुमासंहितायां रणफ़लवर्णन॑ नामैकविंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भीपाकसुपाकौ च क्रकचश्चातिदारुणः । अङ्गारराशिभवनं मेदोऽसृक्प्रहितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: kumbhIpAkasupAkau cha krakachashchAtidAruNaH | a~NgArarAshibhavanaM medo.asR^ikprahitastataH
verses.translation: If a man plants trees in the forests, he enables his ancestors and the successors of his family, to gain redemption. Hence one should plant trees.

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं किं प्रलप्यध्वं पीड्यमानाः स्वकर्मभिः । भुज्यन्तां स्वानि कर्माणि नास्ति दोषो हि कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: idAnIM kiM pralapyadhvaM pIDyamAnAH svakarmabhiH | bhujyantAM svAni karmANi nAsti doSho hi kasyachit
verses.translation: Trees honour and worship the gods through flowers, the Pitfs through fruits, and the guests through shade.
verses.hindi: तथा गर्भमें उसकी स्थितिका वर्णन कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: तीक्ष्णतुण्डश्च शकुनिर्महासंवर्तकः क्रतुः । तप्तजन्तुः पङ्कलेपः प्रतिमांसस्त्रपूद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tIkShNatuNDashcha shakunirmahAsaMvartakaH kratuH | taptajantuH pa~NkalepaH pratimAMsastrapUdbhavaH
verses.translation: The Kinnaras, the serpents, the Raksasas, the gods, the Gandharvas, the human beings and the sages depend upon trees.
verses.hindi: जो मुमुक्षुजनके संसाररूप बन्धनको काटनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: उच्छ्वासः सुनिरुच्छ्वासो सुदीर्घः कूटशाल्मलिः । दुरिष्टः सुमहावादः प्रवाहः सुप्रतापनः
verses.transliteration: uchChvAsaH suniruchChvAso sudIrghaH kUTashAlmaliH | duriShTaH sumahAvAdaH pravAhaH supratApanaH
verses.translation: While in bloom or when they bear fruits, the trees delight human beings. They are as sons by way of virtue in this world and hereafter.
verses.hindi: प्रेरित हुई अग्नि जलको उष्ण करती है

verses.sanskrit: ततो मेघो वृषः शाल्मः सिंहव्याघ्रगजाननाः । श्वसूकराजमहिषघूककोकवृकाननाः
verses.transliteration: tato megho vR^iShaH shAlmaH siMhavyAghragajAnanAH | shvasUkarAjamahiShaghUkakokavR^ikAnanAH
verses.translation: These people never fail to attain heaven—viz. the digger of lakes, the planter of trees, the brahmin who performs sacrifices and those who speak truth.
verses.hindi: प्राण रससे उन नाड़ियोंको सन्तृप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: ग्राहकुम्भीननक्राख्याः सर्पकूर्माख्यवायसाः । गृध्रोलूकहलौकाख्याः शार्दूलक्रथकर्कटाः
verses.transliteration: grAhakumbhInanakrAkhyAH sarpakUrmAkhyavAyasAH | gR^idhrolUkahalaukAkhyAH shArdUlakrathakarkaTAH
verses.translation: Penance, sacrifice, merit, the worship of the gods, sages and the Pitys, the Waters, theVidyas—all these things are established in truth.
verses.hindi: सभी अंकुरसन्धियाँ जोड़ बन जाती हैं

verses.sanskrit: मण्डूकः पूतिवक्त्राश्च रक्ताक्षः पूतिमृत्तिकाः । कणधूम्रस्तथाग्निश्च कृमिगन्धिवपुस्तथा
verses.transliteration: maNDUkaH pUtivaktrAshcha raktAkShaH pUtimR^ittikAH | kaNadhUmrastathAgnishcha kR^imigandhivapustathA
verses.translation: By upholding truth the people can attain the benefits of keeping up the traditions of all the Vedas and taking the ceremonial ablutions in all holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीध्रश्चाप्रतिष्ठश्च रुधिराभः श्वभोजनः । लालाभक्षान्त्रभक्षौ च सर्वभक्षः सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration: agnIdhrashchApratiShThashcha rudhirAbhaH shvabhojanaH | lAlAbhakShAntrabhakShau cha sarvabhakShaH sudAruNaH
verses.translation: When weighed against truth in a balance, a thou¬ sand hdrse-sacrifices and a hundred thousand other sacrifices do not equal it. Truth alone excels.
verses.hindi: अंगोंमें जो सन्धियाँ हैं--ये सब उत्पन्न हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: कण्टकः सुविशालश्च विकटः कटपूतनः । अम्बरीषः कटाहश्च कष्टा वैतरणी नदी
verses.transliteration: kaNTakaH suvishAlashcha vikaTaH kaTapUtanaH | ambarIShaH kaTAhashcha kaShTA vaitaraNI nadI
verses.translation: The gods, the Pitrs, the human beings, the serpents, the Rakasas and the worlds including the mobile and immobile beings are delighted by Truth.

verses.sanskrit: सुतप्तलोहशयन एकपादः प्रपूरणः । असितालवनं घोरमस्थिभङ्गः सुपूरणः
verses.transliteration: sutaptalohashayana ekapAdaH prapUraNaH | asitAlavanaM ghoramasthibha~NgaH supUraNaH
verses.translation: After performing very difficult penance, it is by depending solely on Truth, by maintaining truthful virtue that the sages have attained Siddhis and reached heaven.
verses.hindi: सुख, दुःख, निद्रा एवं स्वप्नको जानने लगता है

verses.sanskrit: विलातसोऽसुयन्त्रोपि कूटपाशः प्रमर्दनः । महाचूरर्णोऽसुचूर्णोऽपि तप्तलोहमयं तथा
verses.transliteration: vilAtaso.asuyantropi kUTapAshaH pramardanaH | mahAchUrarNo.asuchUrNo.api taptalohamayaM tathA
verses.translation: The sages have attained heaven travelling in aerial chariots along with the celestial damsels. Truth shall be ever spoken, for there is nothing greater than Truth.
verses.hindi: हुआ जीव भी बड़े दु:ःखसे स्थित रहता है

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतः क्षुरधारा च तथा यमलपर्वतः । मूत्रविष्ठाश्रुकूपश्च क्षारकूपश्च शीतलः
verses.transliteration: parvataH kShuradhArA cha tathA yamalaparvataH | mUtraviShThAshrukUpashcha kShArakUpashcha shItalaH
verses.translation: In the deep, extensive and pure eddy, the holy centre of Truth, one shall mentally take one*s ceremonial ablution. That i$ said to be the highest bliss.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एवं ते पृथिवीपालाः सम्प्राप्तास्तत्समीपतः । स्वकीयैः कर्मभिघौरैर्दुष्कर्मबलदर्पिणः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | evaM te pR^ithivIpAlAH samprAptAstatsamIpataH | svakIyaiH karmabhighaurairduShkarmabaladarpiNaH
verses.translation: Men who never utter a lie whether for their own sake, or for other's sake, or even for their own son's sake, do go to heaven.
verses.hindi: स्थित जीव भी जठराग्निसे पकाया जाता है

verses.sanskrit: मुसलोलूखलं यन्त्रं शिलाशकटलाङ्गलम् । तालपत्रासिगहनं महाशकटमण्डपम्
verses.transliteration: musalolUkhalaM yantraM shilAshakaTalA~Ngalam | tAlapatrAsigahanaM mahAshakaTamaNDapam
verses.translation: The Veda's, the sacrifices and the Mantras exist in
verses.hindi: तथा बहुत संकट देनेवाला होता है

verses.sanskrit: सम्मोहमस्थिभङ्गश्च तप्तश्चलमयोगुडम् । बहुदुःखं महाक्लेशः कश्मलं समलं मलात्
verses.transliteration: sammohamasthibha~Ngashcha taptashchalamayoguDam | bahuduHkhaM mahAkleshaH kashmalaM samalaM malAt
verses.translation: O ascetic, please explain again with special em¬ phasis on the fruit of penance for the brahmins as well as other castes.
verses.hindi: प्रहार होनेसे उन पापियोंको दुःख होता है

verses.sanskrit: हालाहलो विरूपश्च स्वरूपश्च यमानुगः । एकपादस्त्रिपादश्च तीव्रश्चाचीवरं तमः
verses.transliteration: hAlAhalo virUpashcha svarUpashcha yamAnugaH | ekapAdastripAdashcha tIvrashchAchIvaraM tamaH
verses.translation: I shall explain the section on penance which is the means of achieving all the objects of desire, very difficult to be performed even by brahmins. Please listen even as I explain.
verses.hindi: अपवित्र शरीररूपी घर कर्मबन्धनसे विनिर्मित है

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाविंशतिरित्येते क्रमशः पञ्चपञ्चकम् । कोटीनामानुपूर्व्येण पञ्च पञ्चैव नायकाः
verses.transliteration: aShTAviMshatirityete kramashaH pa~nchapa~nchakam | koTInAmAnupUrvyeNa pa~ncha pa~nchaiva nAyakAH
verses.translation: Heaven, fame and love arc achieved through penance. Penance is the means of achievement for all objects.
verses.hindi: डति श्रीशिवमहाएरणे पदश्चम्याम॒मासंहितायां देहोत्पत्तिवर्ण॑ नाम द्वार्विशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: रौरवाय प्रबोध्यन्ते नरकाणां शतं स्मृतम् । चत्वारिंशच्च तत्प्रोक्तं महानरकमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: rauravAya prabodhyante narakANAM shataM smR^itam | chatvAriMshachcha tatproktaM mahAnarakamaNDalam
verses.translation: One achieves great things through penance. One attains salvation, knowledge, perfect wisdom, good fortune and beauty by penance.
verses.hindi: है, इसलिये इसे अपवित्र कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: इति ते व्यास सम्प्रोक्ता नरकस्य स्थितिर्मया । प्रसङ्ख्यानाच्च वैराग्यं शृणु पापगतिं च ताम्
verses.transliteration: iti te vyAsa samproktA narakasya sthitirmayA | prasa~NkhyAnAchcha vairAgyaM shR^iNu pApagatiM cha tAm
verses.translation: Man obtains different things through penance; he gets everything, whatever he wishes in his mind through penance.
verses.hindi: अधिक अपवित्र और क्या हो सकता है ?

verses.sanskrit: तानपि क्रोधसंयुक्तश्चित्रगुप्तो महाप्रभुः । संशिक्षयति धर्मज्ञो यमराजानुशिक्षया
verses.transliteration: tAnapi krodhasaMyuktashchitragupto mahAprabhuH | saMshikShayati dharmaj~no yamarAjAnushikShayA
verses.translation: Those who have never performed penance do not attain Brahmaloka; lord iSiva is not accessible to those who have never performed penance.
verses.hindi: किस प्रकार शुद्ध हो सकता है 2

verses.sanskrit: चित्रगुप्त उवाच । भो भो नृपा दुराचाराः प्रजाविध्वंसकारिणः । अल्पकालस्य राज्यस्य कृते किं दुष्कृतं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: chitragupta uvAcha | bho bho nR^ipA durAchArAH prajAvidhvaMsakAriNaH | alpakAlasya rAjyasya kR^ite kiM duShkR^itaM kR^itam
verses.translation: After deciding on a particular thing, if a man performs penance he attains it here as well as hereafter.
verses.hindi: शरीर भला शुद्ध किस प्रकार हो सकता है 2

verses.sanskrit: राज्यभोगेन मोहेन बलादन्यायतः प्रजाः । यद्दण्डिताः फलं तस्य भुज्यतामधुना नृपाः
verses.transliteration: rAjyabhogena mohena balAdanyAyataH prajAH | yaddaNDitAH phalaM tasya bhujyatAmadhunA nR^ipAH
verses.translation: The wine-addict, the defiler of other women, the brahmin-slayer, the defiler of teacher's bed overcome all sins through penance and get rid of them.
verses.hindi: हाथ किस प्रकार पवित्र रह सकता है ?2

verses.sanskrit: क्व तद्राज्यं कलत्रं च यदर्थमशुभं कृतम् । तत्सर्वं सम्परित्यज्य यूयमेकाकिनः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: kva tadrAjyaM kalatraM cha yadarthamashubhaM kR^itam | tatsarvaM samparityajya yUyamekAkinaH sthitAH
verses.translation: iSiva, the lord of all, the eternal Vifiu, Brahmfi, fire god, Indra and others are endowed with penance. The eighty-eight thousand sages of sublimated semen rejoice in heaven through penance, along with the gods.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यामि तद्बलं नष्टं येन विध्वंसिताः प्रजाः । यमदूतैर्योज्यमाना अधुना कीदृशं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: pashyAmi tadbalaM naShTaM yena vidhvaMsitAH prajAH | yamadUtairyojyamAnA adhunA kIdR^ishaM bhavet
verses.translation: Kingdoms are achieved through penance. Indra,
verses.hindi: संसार इससे विरक्त नहीं होता है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Knowledge, perfect wisdom, health, beauty, good fortune and perpetual happiness are the offshoots of penance.
verses.hindi: कौन-सा कारण बताया जा सकता है ?

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Knowledge, perfect wisdom, health, beauty, good fortune and perpetual happiness are the offshoots of penance.
verses.hindi: भावदुष्ट होनेपर वह शुद्ध नहीं होता है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.९. नवमोऽध्यायः । नरकगतिवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । एषु पापाः प्रपच्यन्ते शोष्यन्ते नरकाग्निषु । यातनाभिर्विचित्राभिरास्वकर्मक्षयाद् भृशम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.9\. navamo.adhyAyaH | narakagativarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | eShu pApAH prapachyante shoShyante narakAgniShu | yAtanAbhirvichitrAbhirAsvakarmakShayAd bhR^isham
verses.translation: O great sage, the Ksatriya king Visvamitra,*®* the son of Gadhi, became a brahmin through penance. This is well known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: खाल कभी शुद्ध हो सकती है ?

verses.sanskrit: वृन्ताकवत्प्रपच्यन्ते तप्तलोहकटाहकैः । विष्ठापूर्णे तथा कूपे कृमीणां निचये पुनः
verses.transliteration: vR^intAkavatprapachyante taptalohakaTAhakaiH | viShThApUrNe tathA kUpe kR^imINAM nichaye punaH
verses.translation: O intelligent one, thus the excellent glory of penance has been mentioned to you. Now listen to the glory of the study of the Vedas which is far more excellent than penance itself.

verses.sanskrit: मेदोऽसृक्पूयपूर्णायां वाप्यां क्षिप्यन्ति ते पुनः । भक्ष्यन्ते कृमिभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्लोहतुण्डैश्च वायसैः
verses.transliteration: medo.asR^ikpUyapUrNAyAM vApyAM kShipyanti te punaH | bhakShyante kR^imibhistIkShNairlohatuNDaishcha vAyasaiH
verses.translation: The sage V'Uvamitra vvas the son of Gathln or G&dhi of the Kusika race descended from Kusika. He is called Gdhi'ja and Oidhi- nandana. He was born a ksatriya but by intense austerities raised him¬ self to the Bruhniaia caste and became one of the seven great sages.

verses.sanskrit: श्वभिर्देंशैर्वृकैर्व्याघ्रै रौद्रैश्च विकृताननैः । पच्यन्ते मत्स्यवच्चापि प्रदीप्ताङ्गारराशिषु
verses.transliteration: shvabhirdeMshairvR^ikairvyAghrai raudraishcha vikR^itAnanaiH | pachyante matsyavachchApi pradIptA~NgArarAshiShu
verses.translation: By teaching the Veda, an excellent brahmin attains twice the merit that he attains by studying it.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य रुचिपूर्वक नहीं खा सकता है

verses.sanskrit: भिन्नाः शूलैः सुतीक्ष्णैश्च नराः पापेन कर्मणा । तैलयन्त्रेषु चाक्रम्य घोरैः कर्मभिरात्मनः
verses.transliteration: bhinnAH shUlaiH sutIkShNaishcha narAH pApena karmaNA | tailayantreShu chAkramya ghoraiH karmabhirAtmanaH
verses.translation: The universe will go without light if the moon and the sun were not present. The same will happen if the Puraias too, O sage, were not.

verses.sanskrit: तिला इव प्रपीड्यन्ते चक्राख्ये जनपिण्डकाः । भ्रज्यन्ते चातपे तप्तलोहभाण्डेष्वनेकधा
verses.transliteration: tilA iva prapIDyante chakrAkhye janapiNDakAH | bhrajyante chAtape taptalohabhANDeShvanekadhA
verses.translation: A Puranist enlightens the people through iSastras, the people who are in distress in the hell due to ignorance. Hence he shall be worshipped.
verses.hindi: ऐसे केलेके वृक्षकी भाँति यह नि:सार है

verses.sanskrit: तैलपूर्णकटाहेषु सुतप्तेषु पुनःपुनः । बहुधा पच्यते जिह्वा प्रपीड्योरसि पादयोः
verses.transliteration: tailapUrNakaTAheShu sutapteShu punaHpunaH | bahudhA pachyate jihvA prapIDyorasi pAdayoH
verses.translation: Among all the deserving men the knower of Purana is the most excellent. He is considered worthy because he saves people from fall
verses.hindi: निर्मल बुद्धिसे युक्त हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: यातनाश्च महत्योऽत्र शरीरस्याति सर्वतः । निःशेषनरकेष्वेवं क्रमन्ति क्रमशो नराः
verses.transliteration: yAtanAshcha mahatyo.atra sharIrasyAti sarvataH | niHsheShanarakeShvevaM kramanti kramasho narAH
verses.translation: Never shall a Puranist be considered an ordinary man. A preceptor proficient in Purana is omniscient. He is Brahma, Vi$nu and Siva.
verses.hindi: मानकर इसे दृढ़तासे पकड़े रहता है

verses.sanskrit: नरकेषु च सर्वेषु विचित्रा यमयातनाः । याम्यैश्च दीयते व्यास सर्वाङ्गेषु सुकष्टदाः
verses.transliteration: narakeShu cha sarveShu vichitrA yamayAtanAH | yAmyaishcha dIyate vyAsa sarvA~NgeShu sukaShTadAH
verses.translation: For the welfare here and hereafter, wealth food- grain, gold, different clothes etc. shall be given to a Puranist as gift.
verses.hindi: महाकष्टदायक जन्म-दु:खका वर्णन मैंने कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलदङ्गारमादाय मुखमापूर्य ताड्यते । ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन ताम्रेण च पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: jvalada~NgAramAdAya mukhamApUrya tADyate | tataH kShAreNa dIptena tAmreNa cha punaHpunaH
verses.translation: The good man who out of pleasure gives auspicious things to a Purai;iist who is a deserving person, attains the greatest salvation.
verses.hindi: ममतावश लाखों लोग इसमें बँधे रह गये

verses.sanskrit: घृतेनात्यन्ततप्तेन तदा तैलेन तन्मुखम् । इतस्ततः पीडयित्वा भृशमापूर्य हन्यते
verses.transliteration: ghR^itenAtyantataptena tadA tailena tanmukham | itastataH pIDayitvA bhR^ishamApUrya hanyate
verses.translation: Listen to the merit that a person derives from lands, cows, chariots, elephants and good horses to a deserving person.
verses.hindi: कर देनेवाले दुःखसे नष्ट हो जाती है

verses.sanskrit: स्वमलप्रक्षयाद्यद्वदग्नौ धास्यन्ति धातवः । तत्र पापक्षयात्पापा नराः कर्मानुरूपतः
verses.transliteration: svamalaprakShayAdyadvadagnau dhAsyanti dhAtavaH | tatra pApakShayAtpApA narAH karmAnurUpataH
verses.translation: That man derives the fruit of horse-sacrifice, and realises all his cherished desires without wastage, both here and hereafter.
verses.hindi: अपना परम कल्याण नहीं देखता है

verses.sanskrit: विष्ठाभिः कृमिभिश्चापि पूर्यमाणाः क्वचित् क्वचित् । परिष्वजन्ति चात्युग्रां प्रदीप्तां लोहशाल्मलीम्
verses.transliteration: viShThAbhiH kR^imibhishchApi pUryamANAH kvachit kvachit | pariShvajanti chAtyugrAM pradIptAM lohashAlmalIm
verses.translation: He who gives him a good fertile and well ploughed land facilitates the redemption of the members of his family upto ten generations before him and after him.

verses.sanskrit: हन्यन्ते पृष्ठदेशे च पुनर्दीप्तैर्महाघनैः । दन्तुरेणादिकुण्ठेन क्रकचेन बलीसया
verses.transliteration: hanyante pR^iShThadeshe cha punardIptairmahAghanaiH | dantureNAdikuNThena krakachena balIsayA
verses.translation: After enjoying all the pleasures here, he becomes endowed with a divine body on death and goes to iSivaloka, by a divine aerial chariot.
verses.hindi: नहीं कर पाते, यह तो महान् आश्चर्य है!

verses.sanskrit: शिरःप्रभृति पीड्यन्ते घोरैः कर्मभिरात्मजैः । खाद्यन्ते च स्वमांसानि पीयते शोणितं स्वकम्
verses.transliteration: shiraHprabhR^iti pIDyante ghoraiH karmabhirAtmajaiH | khAdyante cha svamAMsAni pIyate shoNitaM svakam
verses.translation: The gods are not satisfied so much with sacrifices, Prokaakas (immolations of animals at the sacrifices), oblations and floral worships as with the recitation of book.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं पानं न दत्तं यैः सर्वदा स्वात्मपोषकैः । इक्षुवत्ते प्रपीड्यन्ते जर्जरीकृत्य मुद्गरैः
verses.transliteration: annaM pAnaM na dattaM yaiH sarvadA svAtmapoShakaiH | ikShuvatte prapIDyante jarjarIkR^itya mudgaraiH
verses.translation: Listen to the meritorious benefits of that man who
verses.hindi: नहीं करता, यह तो महान् आश्चर्य है!

verses.sanskrit: असितालवने घोरे छिद्यन्ते खण्डशस्ततः । सूचीभिर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गाः तप्तशूलाग्ररोपिताः
verses.transliteration: asitAlavane ghore Chidyante khaNDashastataH | sUchIbhirbhinnasarvA~NgAH taptashUlAgraropitAH
verses.translation: The man derives the benefit of Rajasuyae®** and Avamedhas. Piercing through the sun's sphere he goes to to the Brahmaloka
verses.hindi: बादमें उसके निरन्तर प्राप्त न होनेपर सुख कहाँ 2

verses.sanskrit: सञ्चाल्यमाना बहुशः क्लिश्यन्ते न म्रियन्ति च । तथा च तच्छरीराणि सुखदुःखसहानि च
verses.transliteration: sa~nchAlyamAnA bahushaH klishyante na mriyanti cha | tathA cha tachCharIrANi sukhaduHkhasahAni cha
verses.translation: After remaining there for hundreds of Kalpas he becomes a king on the earth. He enjoys the pleasures without pinpricks. No hesitation need be entertained in this regard.
verses.hindi: मनमें आने ही न दिया जाय)

verses.sanskrit: देहादुत्पाट्य मांसानि भिद्यन्ते स्वैश्च मुद्गरैः । दन्तुराकृतिभिर्घोरैर्यमदूतैर्बलोत्कटैः
verses.transliteration: dehAdutpATya mAMsAni bhidyante svaishcha mudgaraiH | danturAkR^itibhirghorairyamadUtairbalotkaTaiH
verses.translation: He who performs Japas in front of the deity obtains that benefit which is mentioned as the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices.
verses.hindi: व्यक्तिको भी होता है, ऐसा विद्वजन कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: निरुच्छ्वासे निरुच्छ्वासास्तिष्ठन्ति नरके चिरम् । उत्ताड्यन्ते तथोच्छ्वासे वालुकासदने नराः
verses.transliteration: niruchChvAse niruchChvAsAstiShThanti narake chiram | uttADyante tathochChvAse vAlukAsadane narAH
verses.translation: Hence arrangements shall be assiduously made for the reciting of the book. Listening to it with devotion and love yields the fruit of all cherished desires.
verses.hindi: मानना चाहिए, उनमें उससे अधिक सुख नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: रौरवे रोदमानाश्च पीड्यन्ते विविधैर्वधैः । महारौरवपीडाभिर्महान्तोऽपि रुदन्ति च
