verses.transliteration: raurave rodamAnAshcha pIDyante vividhairvadhaiH | mahArauravapIDAbhirmahAnto.api rudanti cha
verses.translation: Man becomes free from sins on listening to Siva- purana. After enjoying immense pleasures he attains the world of Siva.
verses.hindi: सुख नहीं है--ऐसा पंचचूडाने कहा था

verses.sanskrit: पत्सु वक्त्रे गुदे मुण्डे नेत्रयोश्चैव मस्तके । निहन्यन्ते घनैस्तीक्ष्णैः सुतप्तैर्लोहशङ्कुभिः
verses.transliteration: patsu vaktre gude muNDe netrayoshchaiva mastake | nihanyante ghanaistIkShNaiH sutaptairlohasha~NkubhiH
verses.translation: Merely by listening to the story of Siva one derives the merit similar to that resulting from Rajasuya and a hundred Agnitoma rites.

verses.sanskrit: सुगाढं हस्तयोर्बद्ध्वा ततः शृङ्खलया नराः । महावृक्षाग्रशाखासु लम्ब्यन्ते यमकिङ्करैः
verses.transliteration: sugADhaM hastayorbaddhvA tataH shR^i~NkhalayA narAH | mahAvR^ikShAgrashAkhAsu lambyante yamaki~NkaraiH
verses.translation: O sage, by listening to the story of Siva one derives the benefit and merit derived from ablution in the sacred rivers and from gifting away a crore of cows.

verses.sanskrit: सुतप्तवालुकायां तु प्रयोज्यन्ते मुहुर्मुहुः । जन्तुपङ्के भृशं तप्ते क्षिप्ताः क्रन्दन्ति विस्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sutaptavAlukAyAM tu prayojyante muhurmuhuH | jantupa~Nke bhR^ishaM tapte kShiptAH krandanti visvaram
verses.translation: Those who constantly listen to Siva's story that sanctifies the worlds are not mere human beings, they are Rudras. There is no doubt in this.
verses.hindi: अशक्तः साधितु तस्माद्मुवा धर्म समाचरेत्॥ ६५  यौवनावस्थामें ही धर्माचरण कर लेना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भीपाकेषु पच्यन्ते तप्ततैलेषु वै मुने । पापिनः क्रूरकर्माणोऽसह्येषु सर्वथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: kumbhIpAkeShu pachyante taptataileShu vai mune | pApinaH krUrakarmANo.asahyeShu sarvathA punaH
verses.translation: Sages consider the dust in the lotus-feet of those

verses.sanskrit: लालाभक्षेषु पापास्ते पात्यन्ते दुःखदेषु वै । नानास्थानेषु च तथा नरकेषु पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: lAlAbhakSheShu pApAste pAtyante duHkhadeShu vai | nAnAsthAneShu cha tathA narakeShu punaHpunaH
verses.translation: Let those embodied beings who desire to attain salvation listen always the Puranic story of Siva with devotion.
verses.hindi: बाल्याद्यवस्थादु:खवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: सूचीमुखे महाक्लेशे नरके पात्यते नरः । पापी पुण्यविहीनश्च ताड्यते यमकिङ्करैः
verses.transliteration: sUchImukhe mahAkleshe narake pAtyate naraH | pApI puNyavihInashcha tADyate yamaki~NkaraiH
verses.translation: O great sage, he who regularly listens to Siva*s story crosses the ocean of worldly existence after burning away the great forest of Karman.
verses.hindi: तन्मे ब्रृहे समासेन यदि तुष्टोउसि में मुने॥ १  कहा है, उसे संक्षेपमें मुझसे कहिये

verses.sanskrit: लोहकुम्भे विनिःक्षिप्ताः श्वसन्तश्च शनैः शनैः । महाग्निना प्रपच्यन्ते स्वपापैरेव मानवाः
verses.transliteration: lohakumbhe viniHkShiptAH shvasantashcha shanaiH shanaiH | mahAgninA prapachyante svapApaireva mAnavAH
verses.translation: No mishap befalls those men who listen to Siva*s story even for a Muhurta, or half that time or even for a moment with devotion.
verses.hindi: अस्थ श्रवणमात्रेण भरवेद्वैराग्यमुत्तमम्॥ २ सुनने-मात्रसे उत्तम वैराग्य हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: दृढं रज्ज्वादिभिर्बद्ध्वा प्रपीड्यन्ते शिलासु च । क्षिप्यन्ते चान्धकूपेषु दश्यन्ते भ्रमरैर्भृशम्
verses.transliteration: dR^iDhaM rajjvAdibhirbaddhvA prapIDyante shilAsu cha | kShipyante chAndhakUpeShu dashyante bhramarairbhR^isham
verses.translation: O sage, certainly the fruit derived from listening to Sivapurana is the same as that derived from making all charitable gifts or from performing all sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: कृमिभिर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गाः शतशो जर्जरीकृताः । सुतीक्ष्णक्षारकूपेषु क्षिप्यन्ते तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: kR^imibhirbhinnasarvA~NgAH shatasho jarjarIkR^itAH | sutIkShNakShArakUpeShu kShipyante tadanantaram
verses.translation: O Vyasa, especially in the age of Kali there is no greater virtue aimed at salvation and meditation than listening to the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: महाज्वालेऽत्र नरके पापाः क्रन्दन्ति दुःखिताः । इतश्चेतश्च धावन्ति दह्यमानास्तदर्चिषा
verses.transliteration: mahAjvAle.atra narake pApAH krandanti duHkhitAH | itashchetashcha dhAvanti dahyamAnAstadarchiShA
verses.translation: Siva has created the nectarine juice in the form of Pur&a for the benefit of men of poor intellect in the Kali age who have eschewed virtue and good conduct.

verses.sanskrit: पृष्ठे चानीय तुण्डाभ्यां विन्यस्तस्कन्धयोजिते । तयोर्मध्येन वाकृष्य बाहुपृष्ठेन गाढतः
verses.transliteration: pR^iShThe chAnIya tuNDAbhyAM vinyastaskandhayojite | tayormadhyena vAkR^iShya bAhupR^iShThena gADhataH
verses.translation: Only one person becomes free from old age and death by drinking the nectar Amfta. But by drinking the nectarine story of Siva the entire family becomes free from death and old age.

verses.sanskrit: बद्धाः परस्परं सर्वे सुभृशं पाशरज्जुभिः । बद्धपिण्डास्तु दृश्यन्ते महाज्वाले तु यातनाः
verses.transliteration: baddhAH parasparaM sarve subhR^ishaM pAsharajjubhiH | baddhapiNDAstu dR^ishyante mahAjvAle tu yAtanAH
verses.translation: O dear, one instantaneously attains by listening to the Puriiias that salvation which mentonoua ascetics and performers of sacrifices derive.
verses.hindi: अतः है सुमध्यमे ! तुम उसे बताओ

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते सर्वयत्नेन क्षिप्ता दोलन्ति किङ्करैः । दोम्यन्तश्चातिवेगेन विसंज्ञा यान्ति योजनम्
verses.transliteration: tataste sarvayatnena kShiptA dolanti ki~NkaraiH | domyantashchAtivegena visa.nj~nA yAnti yojanam
verses.translation: Hence indeed, the Puranas shall be assiduously listened to for the achievement of virtue, wealth, love and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: रज्जुभिर्वेष्टिताश्चैव प्रलिप्ताः कर्दमेन च । करीषतुषवह्नौ च पच्यन्ते न म्रियन्ति च
verses.transliteration: rajjubhirveShTitAshchaiva praliptAH kardamena cha | karIShatuShavahnau cha pachyante na mriyanti cha
verses.translation: Man attains, thanks to listening to the Puranas, that benefit which is attained by sacrifices, charitable gifts, penances and pilgrimages.

verses.sanskrit: सुतीक्ष्णचरितास्ते हि कर्कशासु शिलासु च । आस्फाल्य शतशः पापाः पच्यन्ते तृणवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: sutIkShNacharitAste hi karkashAsu shilAsu cha | AsphAlya shatashaH pApAH pachyante tR^iNavattataH
verses.translation: If there be no purana showing the path of Dharma, there will be no person observing Vrata or interested in the life hereafter.
verses.hindi: ऐसी स्त्रियोंक लिये अगम्य नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: शरीराभ्यन्तरगतैः प्रभूतैः कृमिभिर्नराः । भक्ष्यन्ते तीक्ष्णवदनैरात्मदेहक्षयाद् भृशम्
verses.transliteration: sharIrAbhyantaragataiH prabhUtaiH kR^imibhirnarAH | bhakShyante tIkShNavadanairAtmadehakShayAd bhR^isham
verses.translation: He who listens to at least one among the thirty six Puranas*® or reads it with devotion is liberated. There is no doubt in this.
verses.hindi: संयोगसे ही अनुकूल हो सकती हैं

verses.sanskrit: कृमीणां निचये क्षिप्ताः पूयमांसास्थिराशिषु । तिष्ठन्त्युद्विग्नहृदयाः पर्वताभ्यां निपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: kR^imINAM nichaye kShiptAH pUyamAMsAsthirAshiShu | tiShThantyudvignahR^idayAH parvatAbhyAM nipIDitAH
verses.translation: Ten charitable gifts are called great gifts and are praiseworthy. They shall be given to deserving persons every day. They enable the soul to cross the ocean of worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: तप्तेन वज्रलेपेन शरीरमनुलिप्यते । अधोमुखोर्ध्वपादश्च तातप्यन्ते स्म वह्निना
verses.transliteration: taptena vajralepena sharIramanulipyate | adhomukhordhvapAdashcha tAtapyante sma vahninA
verses.translation: The charitable gifts of gold, cow and land, O excellent brahmin, arc very holy. Those who make them redeem themselves.
verses.hindi: प्रिय स्वामीके भी वशमें नहीं रहती हैं

verses.sanskrit: वदनान्तःप्रविन्यस्तां सुप्रतप्तामयोगदाम् । ते खादन्ति पराधीनास्तैस्ताड्यन्ते च मुद्गरैः
verses.transliteration: vadanAntaHpravinyastAM suprataptAmayogadAm | te khAdanti parAdhInAstaistADyante cha mudgaraiH
verses.translation: There arc gifts of gold, cows and land, by making these excellent gifts one is liberated from sins.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं व्यास कुकर्माणो नरकेषु पचन्ति हि । वर्णयामि विवर्णत्वं तेषां तत्त्वाय कर्मिणाम्
verses.transliteration: itthaM vyAsa kukarmANo narakeShu pachanti hi | varNayAmi vivarNatvaM teShAM tattvAya karmiNAm
verses.translation: Tuladanas are highly praised like the gifts of cows.
verses.hindi: अर्थात् स्त्रियोंके ये दोष स्वाभाविक हैं

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षस्थितानां च लोहभारशतं पुनः । पादयोर्बध्यते तेषां यमदूतैर्महाबलैः
verses.transliteration: antarikShasthitAnAM cha lohabhArashataM punaH | pAdayorbadhyate teShAM yamadUtairmahAbalaiH
verses.translation: These things shall be given everyday to those who beg for them—viz. oxen, cows, umbrella, cloth, pairs of shoes, drink and food.

verses.sanskrit: तेन भारेण महता प्रभृशं ताडिता नराः । ध्यायन्ति स्वानि कर्माणि तूष्णीं तिष्ठन्ति निश्चलाः
verses.transliteration: tena bhAreNa mahatA prabhR^ishaM tADitA narAH | dhyAyanti svAni karmANi tUShNIM tiShThanti nishchalAH
verses.translation: There are ten great gifts—viz. gold, gingelly seeds, elephants, virgins, servant-maid, house, chariot, jewels, the tawny coloured cow and ordinary cows.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्ञम्यागुमासंहितायां स्त्रीस्वभाववर्णन॑ नाग चदुर्विशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽङ्कुशैरग्निवर्णैर्लोहदण्डैश्च दारुणैः । हन्यन्ते किङ्करैघोरैः समन्तात्पापकर्मिणः
verses.transliteration: tato.a~NkushairagnivarNairlohadaNDaishcha dAruNaiH | hanyante ki~NkaraighoraiH samantAtpApakarmiNaH
verses.translation: After taking all these a brahmin of great wisdom enables the donee to cross the ocean of worldly existence as well as himself.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन वह्नेरपि विशेषतः । समन्ततः प्रलिप्यन्ते तीव्रेण तु पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tataH kShAreNa dIptena vahnerapi visheShataH | samantataH pralipyante tIvreNa tu punaH punaH
verses.translation: If men make gifts of gold with pious mind, the gods bestow the same on him. Thus I have heard.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा नानाकथां दिव्यां प्रसन्‍ना सुप्रणम्य तम्॥ २  भी शंकरको प्रणामकर उनसे यही पूछा था

verses.sanskrit: द्रुतेनात्यन्तलिप्तेन कृत्ताङ्गा जर्जरीकृताः । पुनर्विदार्य चाङ्गानि शिरसः प्रभृति क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: drutenAtyantaliptena kR^ittA~NgA jarjarIkR^itAH | punarvidArya chA~NgAni shirasaH prabhR^iti kramAt
verses.translation: If plots of lands are given along with gold it is praiseworthy. They become liberated from all sins and attain the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: तो छ: मासके भीतर मृत्युको जानना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: One shall make the charitable gift of forest with due observance of rules and pious mind. The wealth shall be earned by justiciable means. The donee shall be devoid of stinginess associated with affluence.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: One shall make the charitable gift of forest with due observance of rules and pious mind. The wealth shall be earned by justiciable means. The donee shall be devoid of stinginess associated with affluence.
verses.hindi: मासके भीतर मृत्यु जान लेना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । नरकगतिभोगवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । मिथ्यागमं प्रवृत्तस्तु द्विजिह्वाख्यं च गच्छति । जिह्वार्धकोशविस्तीर्णहलैस्तीक्ष्णैः प्रपीड्यते
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.10\. dashamo.adhyAyaH | narakagatibhogavarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | mithyAgamaM pravR^ittastu dvijihvAkhyaM cha gachChati | jihvArdhakoshavistIrNahalaistIkShNaiH prapIDyate
verses.translation: With a Prastha measure of gingelly seeds an image of a cow endowed with all qualities shall be made. The calf shall be made of gold. It shall be divine in shape and it shall possess all characteristics. The mystic diagram of the eight-petalled lotus shall be made with auspicious Vermillion and raw rice grains. The devotee shall worship Hudra an d all other gods there with great devotion. After the worship the cow and the calf shall be given to a brahmin along with
verses.hindi: उसका जीवन छ: मासतक ही रहता है

verses.sanskrit: क्रमादापूर्य कर्णांस्तु नरकेषु च यातनाः । अनुक्रमेण सर्वेषु भवन्त्येताः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: kramAdApUrya karNAMstu narakeShu cha yAtanAH | anukrameNa sarveShu bhavantyetAH samantataH
verses.translation: O Vyasa, even after committing sins, the man enjoys in the heaven along with his kinsmen and friends as long as fourteen Indras rule over it
verses.hindi: रहता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियाणामप्येवं क्रमात्पापेन यातनाः । भवन्ति घोराः प्रत्येकं शरीरेण कृतेन च
verses.transliteration: sarvendriyANAmapyevaM kramAtpApena yAtanAH | bhavanti ghorAH pratyekaM sharIreNa kR^itena cha
verses.translation: If any one makes the gift of a tawny cow along with its calf adorning the horns with gold, the hoofs with silver and endowed with other characteristics and also gives a bell metal vessel, that cow returns to him in the form of the wish-yielding celestial cow. O Vyasa, the donee is thus blessed both here and hereafer.

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्शदोषेण ये मूढाः स्पृशन्ति च परस्त्रियम् । तेषां करोऽग्निवर्णाभिः पांसुभिः पूर्यते भृशम्
verses.transliteration: sparshadoSheNa ye mUDhAH spR^ishanti cha parastriyam | teShAM karo.agnivarNAbhiH pAMsubhiH pUryate bhR^isham
verses.translation: One shall make gifts of such things to a man of good qualities, such thing as he likes most in the world, as are very dear to him in the house and as are wished for by him to be his permanent possessions.
verses.hindi: चाहिए कि छ: मासमें उसकी मृत्यु हो जायगी

verses.sanskrit: तेषां क्षारादिभिः सर्वैः शरीरमनुलिप्यते । यातनाश्च महाकष्टाः सर्वेषु नरकेषु च
verses.transliteration: teShAM kShArAdibhiH sarvaiH sharIramanulipyate | yAtanAshcha mahAkaShTAH sarveShu narakeShu cha
verses.translation: Gift" of anything equal in weight to the giver is the most excellent of all gifts. If he wishes for his prosperity he shall ascend the weighing balance.
verses.hindi: चिह्लोंको कह रहा हूँ, तुम सुनो

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वन्ति पित्रोर्भृकुटिं करनेत्राणि ये नराः । वक्त्राणि तेषां सान्तानि कीर्यन्ते शङ्कुभिर्दृढम्
verses.transliteration: kurvanti pitrorbhR^ikuTiM karanetrANi ye narAH | vaktrANi teShAM sAntAni kIryante sha~NkubhirdR^iDham
verses.translation: Even after committing sins if a man makes the gi)'t of weighing balance he becomes free from all sins and goes to heaven.
verses.hindi: पड़े, तब वह  व्यक्ति आधे महीनेमें मर जाता है

verses.sanskrit: यैरिन्द्रियैर्नरा ये च विकुर्वन्ति परस्त्रियम् । इन्द्रियाणि च तेषां वै विकुर्वन्ति तथैव च
verses.transliteration: yairindriyairnarA ye cha vikurvanti parastriyam | indriyANi cha teShAM vai vikurvanti tathaiva cha
verses.translation: (The following shall be recited before making the gift). **May the presiding deity of the weighing balance remove the sin committed by me physically, mentally or verbally during the day. night, the twilights, midday, the close of the night or in any of the three times. May the presiding deity of the balance, lord Siva, enemy of the cupid, remove all the sins done by me, whether as a boy or a

verses.sanskrit: परदारांश्च पश्यन्ति लुब्धाः स्तब्धेन चक्षुषा । सूचीभिश्चाग्निवर्णाभिस्तेषां नेत्रप्रपूरणम्
verses.transliteration: paradArAMshcha pashyanti lubdhAH stabdhena chakShuShA | sUchIbhishchAgnivarNAbhisteShAM netraprapUraNam
verses.translation: The presiding deity shall be made after reciting the above formula It shall not be given to a single person. There is no benefit in it. It shall be distributed among many brahmins.
verses.hindi: कालतवेत्ता पुरुष उसे छ: मासकी आयुवाला समझें

verses.sanskrit: क्षाराद्यैश्च क्रमात्सर्वा इहैव यमयातनाः । भवन्ति मुनिशार्दूल सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: kShArAdyaishcha kramAtsarvA ihaiva yamayAtanAH | bhavanti munishArdUla satyaM satyaM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: O Vyasa, he who makes this excellent gift of the presiding deity of the balance destroys his sins and attains heaven He stays there as long as the fourteen Indras rule over ii.

verses.sanskrit: देवाग्निगुरुविप्रेभ्यश्चानिवेद्य प्रभुञ्जते । लोहकीलशतैस्तप्तैस्तज्जिह्वास्यं च पूर्यते
verses.transliteration: devAgniguruviprebhyashchAnivedya prabhu~njate | lohakIlashataistaptaistajjihvAsyaM cha pUryate
verses.translation: For the benefit of human beings tell me that which when given as gift makes it possible to derive the benefit of all gifts.

verses.sanskrit: ये देवारामपुष्पाणि लोभात्सङ्गृह्य पाणिना । जिघ्रन्ति च नरा भूयः शिरसा धारयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: ye devArAmapuShpANi lobhAtsa~NgR^ihya pANinA | jighranti cha narA bhUyaH shirasA dhArayanti cha
verses.translation: Listen. I shall mention that gift on giving which, at the proper time, men obtain the benefit of all the gifts
verses.hindi: अष्टादश दिनान्यत्र कथितं साधकेश्वरि॥ ६४ अठारह दिनतक जीवन शेष कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: निर्भर्त्सयति यः क्रूरो मातरं पितरं गुरुम् । विष्ठाभिः कृमिमिश्राभिर्मुखमापूर्य हन्यते
verses.transliteration: nirbhartsayati yaH krUro mAtaraM pitaraM gurum | viShThAbhiH kR^imimishrAbhirmukhamApUrya hanyate
verses.translation: A man becomes the lord of the seven worlds, with a fraction of the benefit that he obtains when the whole uni¬ verse is given as a gift.
verses.hindi: लोकानां च हितार्थाय किमन्यच्छोतुमिच्छसि ॥ ७५  अब और क्या सुनना चाहती हो ?

verses.sanskrit: आपूर्यते शिरस्तेषां तप्तैर्लोहस्य शङ्कुभिः । नासिका चातिबहुलैस्ततः क्षारादिभिर्भृशम्
verses.transliteration: ApUryate shirasteShAM taptairlohasya sha~NkubhiH | nAsikA chAtibahulaistataH kShArAdibhirbhR^isham
verses.translation: The man who gifts away the universe sports in the abode of the gods along with his kinsmen as long as the moon and the sun are in the sky or the earth is steady or every one in the abode of the heaven-dwellers is favourable. Afterwards, for rejoicing, he attains the region of Vifu which is difficult of access even to the gods.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्चम्यामुमासंहितायां कालज्ञानवर्णन॑ नाम पद्जविंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: ये निन्दन्ति महात्मानं वाचकं धर्मदेशिकम् । देवाग्निगुरुभक्तांश्च धर्मशास्त्रं च शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: ye nindanti mahAtmAnaM vAchakaM dharmadeshikam | devAgnigurubhaktAMshcha dharmashAstraM cha shAshvatam
verses.translation: O holy lord, please explain the universe, its extent,

verses.sanskrit: तेषामुरसि कण्ठे च जिह्वायां दन्तसन्धिषु । तालुन्योष्ठे नासिकायां मूर्ध्नि सर्वाङ्गसन्धिषु
verses.transliteration: teShAmurasi kaNThe cha jihvAyAM dantasandhiShu | tAlunyoShThe nAsikAyAM mUrdhni sarvA~NgasandhiShu
verses.translation: O sage, listen. 1 shall explain how high and..fapw extensive is the universe. On hearing it succinctly one gets rid of sins.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निवर्णास्तु तप्ताश्च त्रिशाखा लोहशङ्कवः । आखिद्यन्ते च बहुशः स्थानेष्वेतेषु मुद्गरैः
verses.transliteration: agnivarNAstu taptAshcha trishAkhA lohasha~NkavaH | Akhidyante cha bahushaH sthAneShveteShu mudgaraiH
verses.translation: Brahma creates the universe consisting of the four> teen** worlds. O dear, I shall succinctly explain that in proper order. Listen to it assiduously.
verses.hindi: और परोपकारके लिये शरीर धारण किये हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षारेण दीप्तेन पूर्यते हि समन्ततः । यातनाश्च महत्यो वै शरीरस्याति सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: tataH kShAreNa dIptena pUryate hi samantataH | yAtanAshcha mahatyo vai sharIrasyAti sarvataH
verses.translation: The nether worlds are seven only. The upper worlds are also seven. The height of the universe is twice as such and it stands in the middle of water.
verses.hindi: सर्पको शीघ्र ही नष्ट कर देते हैं, उसे तुम सुनो

verses.sanskrit: अशेषनरकेष्वेव क्रमन्ति क्रमशः पुनः । ये गृह्णन्ति परद्रव्यं पद्भ्यां विप्रं स्पृशन्ति च
verses.transliteration: asheShanarakeShveva kramanti kramashaH punaH | ye gR^ihNanti paradravyaM padbhyAM vipraM spR^ishanti cha
verses.translation: Even the gods and the Asuras are incompetent to describe the attributes of Sesa who is worshipped by the gods, sages and the Ganas and who is called as Ananib by the Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: शिवोपकरणं गां च ज्ञानादिलिखितं च यत् । हस्तपादादिभिस्तेषामापूर्यन्ते समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: shivopakaraNaM gAM cha j~nAnAdilikhitaM cha yat | hastapAdAdibhisteShAmApUryante samantataH
verses.translation: He has a thousand hoods. By means of the thousand jewels on his hoods, he illuminates all the quarters. He has the brilliant ornament Svastika.

verses.sanskrit: नरकेषु च सर्वेषु विचित्रा बहुयातनाः । भवन्ति बहुशः कष्टाः पाणिपादसमुद्भवाः
verses.transliteration: narakeShu cha sarveShu vichitrA bahuyAtanAH | bhavanti bahushaH kaShTAH pANipAdasamudbhavAH
verses.translation: He has only a single ear>ring. He has a crown and wears garlands. His eyes are rolling due to inebriation. He shines like a white fiery mountain.

verses.sanskrit: शिवायतनपर्यन्ते देवारामेषु कुत्रचित् । समुत्सृजन्ति ये पापाः पुरीषं मूत्रमेव च
verses.transliteration: shivAyatanaparyante devArAmeShu kutrachit | samutsR^ijanti ye pApAH purIShaM mUtrameva cha
verses.translation: He is worshipped by the gold-complexioned
verses.hindi: जीतते हैं, वह सब मुझसे कहिये 2

verses.sanskrit: तेषां शिश्नं सवृषणं चूर्ण्यते लोहमुद्गरैः । सूचीभिरग्निवर्णाभिस्तथा त्वापूर्यते पुनः
verses.transliteration: teShAM shishnaM savR^iShaNaM chUrNyate lohamudgaraiH | sUchIbhiragnivarNAbhistathA tvApUryate punaH
verses.translation: Holding the sphere ol' the earth on his back, Sea, the lord of Bhutas stands at the root of Pa tala. He is wor¬ shipped for his endless attributes.

verses.sanskrit: ये शिवायतनारामवापीकूपतडागकान् । विद्रवन्ति द्विजस्थानं नरास्तत्र रमन्ति च
verses.transliteration: ye shivAyatanArAmavApIkUpataDAgakAn | vidravanti dvijasthAnaM narAstatra ramanti cha
verses.translation: The power of his virility cannot be adequately described even by the ambitious gods nor can his form be known.
verses.hindi: अग्निप्रेरित शब्द सुनायी पड़ने लगता है

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षारेण महता तीव्रेण च पुनः पुनः । द्रुतेन पूर्यते गाढं गुदे शिश्ने च देहिनः
verses.transliteration: tataH kShAreNa mahatA tIvreNa cha punaH punaH | drutena pUryate gADhaM gude shishne cha dehinaH
verses.translation: Who will adequately express his prowess? The series of his hoods, pink with the jewels go round the entire earth like a garland of flowers.

verses.sanskrit: मनः सर्वेन्द्रियाणां च यस्माद्दुःखं प्रजायते । धने सत्यपि ये दानं न प्रयच्छन्ति तृष्णया
verses.transliteration: manaH sarvendriyANAM cha yasmAdduHkhaM prajAyate | dhane satyapi ye dAnaM na prayachChanti tR^iShNayA
verses.translation: With his eyes rolling due to inebriation when Sesa stretches himself, the earth quakes along with all its mountains, oceans and forests.

verses.sanskrit: अतिथिं चावमन्यन्ते काले प्राप्ते गृहाश्रमे । तस्मात्ते दुष्कृतं प्राप्य गच्छन्ति निरयेऽशुचौ
verses.transliteration: atithiM chAvamanyante kAle prApte gR^ihAshrame | tasmAtte duShkR^itaM prApya gachChanti niraye.ashuchau
verses.translation: O excellent sage, each of the nether worlds extends to ten thousand Yojanas. The seven nether worlds are Atala, Vitala, Sutala, Rasatala, Tala, Talatala and the Patala. The seven worlds are beneath the earth. So say the learned people.

verses.sanskrit: येऽन्नं दत्त्वा हि भुञ्जन्ति न श्वभ्यः सह वायसैः । तेषां च विवृतं वक्त्रं कीलकद्वयताडितम्
verses.transliteration: ye.annaM dattvA hi bhu~njanti na shvabhyaH saha vAyasaiH | teShAM cha vivR^itaM vaktraM kIlakadvayatADitam
verses.translation: Danavas, Daiteyas, Serpents, and Rak$asas of the Daitya origin reside there.

verses.sanskrit: कृमिभिः प्राणिभिश्चोग्रैर्लोहतुण्डैश्च वायसैः । उपद्रवैर्बहुविधैरुग्रैरन्तः प्रपीड्यते
verses.transliteration: kR^imibhiH prANibhishchograirlohatuNDaishcha vAyasaiH | upadravairbahuvidhairugrairantaH prapIDyate
verses.translation: Narada who came to heaven from the nether region announced in the middle of the celestial assembly that the nether worlds are more beautiful than heaven.
verses.hindi: तथा मारणमें वह प्रयोग करनेयोग्य है

verses.sanskrit: श्यामश्च शबलश्चैव यममार्गानुरोधकौ । यौ स्तस्ताभ्यां प्रयच्छामि तौ गृह्णीतामिमं बलिम्
verses.transliteration: shyAmashcha shabalashchaiva yamamArgAnurodhakau | yau stastAbhyAM prayachChAmi tau gR^ihNItAmimaM balim
verses.translation: There, in all sorts of ornaments, lustrous jewels are present. They are white and delightful. What is there equal to it?

verses.sanskrit: ये वा वरुणवायव्या याम्या नैरृत्यवायसाः । वायसाः पुण्यकर्माणस्ते प्रगृह्णन्तु मे बलिम्
verses.transliteration: ye vA varuNavAyavyA yAmyA nairR^ityavAyasAH | vAyasAH puNyakarmANaste pragR^ihNantu me balim
verses.translation: There during the daytime there are no sun's

verses.sanskrit: शिवामभ्यर्च्य यत्नेन हुत्वाग्नौ विधिपूर्वकम् । शैवैर्मन्त्रैर्बलिं ये च ददन्ते न च ते यमम्
verses.transliteration: shivAmabhyarchya yatnena hutvAgnau vidhipUrvakam | shaivairmantrairbaliM ye cha dadante na cha te yamam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, all sorts of foodstuffs and drinks are consumed there by extremely joyous persons. The time that passes by is not known there at all.
verses.hindi: तुमसे कहा, अब और कया सुनना चाहती हो ?2

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्ति त्रिदिवं यान्ति तस्माद्दद्याद्दिनेदिने । मण्डलं चतुरस्रं तु कृत्वा गन्धादिवासितम्
verses.transliteration: pashyanti tridivaM yAnti tasmAddadyAddinedine | maNDalaM chaturasraM tu kR^itvA gandhAdivAsitam
verses.translation: The cooings of the male cuckoo are there. Lotuses are there. There are lotus-ponds. There are rivers and lakes. Each of them is more excellent than the other.
verses.hindi: शति श्रीश्षिवमहाएुराणे पश्चम्याम॒मासंहितायां कालवञ्नवर्णन॑ नाम बड्विंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: धन्वन्तर्यर्थमीशान्यां प्राच्यामिन्द्राय निःक्षिपेत् । याम्यां यमाय वारुण्यां सुदक्षोमाय दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: dhanvantaryarthamIshAnyAM prAchyAmindrAya niHkShipet | yAmyAM yamAya vAruNyAM sudakShomAya dakShiNe
verses.translation: There the ornaments are very brilliant. The un¬ guents are sweet-smelling. O brahmin, the sound of Vinas, flutes and Mrdahgas can be heard there. There arc scmg everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: कामायोद्वर्तनाभ्यङ्ग स्नानपानाम्बुभोजनम् । क्रीडनं मैथुनं द्यूतमाचरन्ति मदोद्धताः
verses.transliteration: kAmAyodvartanAbhya~Nga snAnapAnAmbubhojanam | krIDanaM maithunaM dyUtamAcharanti madoddhatAH
verses.translation: There the Daityas and serpents rejoice and enjoy pleasures. It is by performing penances that Danavas and Siddha beings attain the same.
verses.hindi: हैं, तो यह सब मुझे बताइये

verses.sanskrit: पितृभ्यस्तु विनिःक्षिप्य प्राच्यामर्यमणं ततः । धातुश्चैव विधातुश्च द्वारदेशे विनिःक्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: pitR^ibhyastu viniHkShipya prAchyAmaryamaNaM tataH | dhAtushchaiva vidhAtushcha dvAradeshe viniHkShipet
verses.translation: O excellent sage, above the nether regions, are the hells where the sinners are scorched. Listen to their descrip¬ tion from me.
verses.hindi: वायुस्वरूप हो जाता है, उसको सुनो

verses.sanskrit: श्वभ्यश्च श्वपतिभ्यश्च वयोभ्यो विक्षिपेद्भुवि । देवैः पितृमनुष्यैश्च प्रेतैर्भूतैः सगुह्यकैः
verses.transliteration: shvabhyashcha shvapatibhyashcha vayobhyo vikShipedbhuvi | devaiH pitR^imanuShyaishcha pretairbhUtaiH saguhyakaiH
verses.translation: They are—Raurava, Sukara, Radha, Tala, Vivas- vat, Mahajvala, Taptakumbha, Lavana, Vilohita.
verses.hindi: ही आये हुए कालको जीत लेता है

verses.sanskrit: वयोभिः कृमिकीटैश्च गृहस्थश्चोपजीव्यते । स्वाहाकारः स्वधाकारो वषट्कारस्तृतीयकः
verses.transliteration: vayobhiH kR^imikITaishcha gR^ihasthashchopajIvyate | svAhAkAraH svadhAkAro vaShaTkArastR^itIyakaH
verses.translation: The river Vaitarai consists of putrid stuff flow¬ ing in it, Kpnipa. Kpnibhojana, Asipatravana and Lalabhakfa are the terrible hells;

verses.sanskrit: हन्तकारस्तथैवान्यो धेन्वाः स्तनचतुष्टयम् । स्वाहाकारं स्तनं देवाः स्वधां च पितरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: hantakArastathaivAnyo dhenvAH stanachatuShTayam | svAhAkAraM stanaM devAH svadhAM cha pitarastathA
verses.translation: Puyavaha has usually flames of fire outside and is topsyturvy. Sandaiha, Kalasutra, Tamas, Avicirodhana

verses.sanskrit: वषट्कारं तथैवान्ये देवा भूतेश्वरास्तथा । हन्तकारं मनुष्याश्च पिबन्ति सततं स्तनम्
verses.transliteration: vaShaTkAraM tathaivAnye devA bhUteshvarAstathA | hantakAraM manuShyAshcha pibanti satataM stanam
verses.translation: Svabhojana, Rutf Maharaurava and iSfilmali—these and other bells are there; all of these are very grievous.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वेतां मानवो धेनुं श्रद्धया ह्यनुपूर्विकाम् । करोति सततं काले साग्नित्वायोपकल्प्यते
verses.transliteration: yastvetAM mAnavo dhenuM shraddhayA hyanupUrvikAm | karoti satataM kAle sAgnitvAyopakalpyate
verses.translation: Men who are indulgent in sins are scorched there. O Vyasa, I shall mention them in order. Listen attentively.
verses.hindi: सहित जप करे, उसे प्राणायाम कहा जाता है

verses.sanskrit: यस्तां जहाति वास्वस्थस्तामिस्रे स तु मज्जति । तस्माद्दत्त्वा बलिं तेभ्यो द्वारस्थश्चिन्तयेत्क्षणम्
verses.transliteration: yastAM jahAti vAsvasthastAmisre sa tu majjati | tasmAddattvA baliM tebhyo dvArasthashchintayetkShaNam
verses.translation: He who commits peijury except for the brahmins, gods and cows and he who utters a lie always goes to Raurava.
verses.hindi: नहीं लौटे अर्थात् कैवल्यको प्राप्त हो गये

verses.sanskrit: क्षुधार्तमतिथिं सम्यगेकग्रामनिवासिनम् । भोजयेत्तं शुभान्नेन यथाशक्त्यात्मभोजनात्
verses.transliteration: kShudhArtamatithiM samyagekagrAmanivAsinam | bhojayettaM shubhAnnena yathAshaktyAtmabhojanAt
verses.translation: The following sinners viz:—the destroyer of the child in the womb, the stealer of gold, of cows, one who commits the breach of trust, the wine-addict, the brahmin slayer, the stealer of other's wealth and he who associates with these—go to the hell Kumbha, O Vyasa. He who kills his preceptor, sister, mother, daughter or a cow too goes there. He who Sells his chaste wife, he who is addicted to usury, he who sells tresses of hair and he who forsakes a devotee—all these are scorched in redhot iron.

verses.sanskrit: अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो गृहात्प्रतिनिवर्तते । स तस्मै दुष्कृतं दत्त्वा पुण्यमादाय गच्छति
verses.transliteration: atithiryasya bhagnAsho gR^ihAtpratinivartate | sa tasmai duShkR^itaM dattvA puNyamAdAya gachChati
verses.translation: He who insults preceptors, he who dismisses visitors and then dines, he who commits blasphemy, he who sells idols and he who cohabits with forbidden women—all these, O brahmin, go to Saptabala hell. A thief, a slayer of cows, a fallen man, a defiler of boundaries, the hater of gods, brahmins and Pitrs and the defiler of gems go to Krmibhaka hell. They eat worms and other displeasing things.
verses.hindi: सौख्य तथा परम सुख प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽन्नं प्रियमेवाश्नन्नरः शृङ्खलवान् पुनः । जिह्वावेगेन विद्धोऽत्र चिरं कालं स तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: tato.annaM priyamevAshnannaraH shR^i~NkhalavAn punaH | jihvAvegena viddho.atra chiraM kAlaM sa tiShThati
verses.translation: The base man who eats before Pitfs, deities and gods and he who ignorantly or deceitfully misquotes sacred texts—these go to Lalabhak$a hell. The brahmin who associates with evil men and is surrounded by outcastes, the brahmin who officiates as priest in the sacrifice of undeserving persons, and eats forbidden food, and he who sells Soma juice—these fall into Rudhiraugha hell. He who spoils honey and creates disturbances in the village falls in the ruthless river Vaitarai.

verses.sanskrit: पेचिरे विविधैर्धोरैरिक्षुयन्त्रादिपीडनैः । निरयाग्निषु पच्यन्ते यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: pechire vividhairdhorairikShuyantrAdipIDanaiH | nirayAgniShu pachyante yAvadAbhUtasamplavam
verses.translation: Those who are arrogant in the freshness of youth, who transgress the bounds of decency, who are unclean and who maintain themselves on the earnings of unchaste women go to Kymya hell.

verses.sanskrit: यतस्तम्मांसमुद्धृत्य तिलमात्रप्रमाणतः । खादितुं दीयते तेषां भित्त्वा चैव तु शोणितम्
verses.transliteration: yatastammAMsamuddhR^itya tilamAtrapramANataH | khAdituM dIyate teShAM bhittvA chaiva tu shoNitam
verses.translation: He who cues off trees without purpose goes to Asipatravana hell. Those who hunt deer with Kfuraprakas (arrows with horse-shoe-shaped heads) fall into Vahnijvala hell.

verses.sanskrit: निःशेषतः कशाभिस्तु पीड्यते क्रमशः पुनः । बुभुक्षयातिकष्टं हि तथाचातिपिपासया
verses.transliteration: niHsheShataH kashAbhistu pIDyate kramashaH punaH | bubhukShayAtikaShTaM hi tathAchAtipipAsayA
verses.translation: O brahmin, the brahmin, the Katriya or the
verses.hindi: होकर मनोवांछित शरीरसे क्रीडा करता है

verses.sanskrit: एवमाद्या महाघोराः यातनाः पापकर्मणाम् । अन्ते यत्प्रतिपन्नं हि तत्सङ्क्षेपेण संशृणु
verses.transliteration: evamAdyA mahAghorAH yAtanAH pApakarmaNAm | ante yatpratipannaM hi tatsa~NkShepeNa saMshR^iNu
verses.translation: Those who drop sacred rites in the middle and those who are fallen off from their duties in accordance with the stages of their life fall into the hell Sandama where the tortures are very terrible.

verses.sanskrit: यः करोति महापापं धर्मं चरति वै लघु । धर्मं गुरुतरं वापि तथावस्थे तयोः शृणु
verses.transliteration: yaH karoti mahApApaM dharmaM charati vai laghu | dharmaM gurutaraM vApi tathAvasthe tayoH shR^iNu
verses.translation: The students who are guilty of nocturnal emission of their semen and the fathers who do not properly educate their sons fall into the Svabhojana hell.

verses.sanskrit: सुकृतस्य फलं नोक्तं गुरुपापप्रभावतः । न मिनोति सुखं तत्र भोगैर्बहुभिरन्वितः
verses.transliteration: sukR^itasya phalaM noktaM gurupApaprabhAvataH | na minoti sukhaM tatra bhogairbahubhiranvitaH
verses.translation: There are hundreds and thousands of these and other hells where thousands of sinners undergo tortures and are scorched.
verses.hindi: इसके अतिरिक्त अन्य उपाय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: तथोद्विग्नोऽतिसन्तप्तो न भक्ष्यैर्मन्यते सुखम् । अभावादग्रतोऽन्यस्य प्रतिकल्यं दिने दिने
verses.transliteration: tathodvigno.atisantapto na bhakShyairmanyate sukham | abhAvAdagrato.anyasya pratikalyaM dine dine
verses.translation: These,sins and others are thousands in number similarly, which the beings in the hells experience and try to wipe off.

verses.sanskrit: पुमान्यो गुरुधर्मापि सोपवासो यथा गृही । वित्तवान्न विजानाति पीडां नियमसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: pumAnyo gurudharmApi sopavAso yathA gR^ihI | vittavAnna vijAnAti pIDAM niyamasaMsthitaH
verses.translation: Those who perpetrate misdeeds contrary to the injunctions of caste and stages of life whether physically, mentally or verbally fall into hell.

verses.sanskrit: तानि पापानि घोराणि सन्ति यैश्च नरो भुवि । शतधा भेदमाप्नोति गिरिर्वज्रहतो यथा
verses.transliteration: tAni pApAni ghorANi santi yaishcha naro bhuvi | shatadhA bhedamApnoti girirvajrahato yathA
verses.translation: The beings in the hells are seen standing upside down by the gods in the heaven. These beings see the gods also similarly with heads down, beneath them.
verses.hindi: प्याससे रहित होकर अमर हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: तेन तेनैव रूपेण ताड्यन्ते पारदारिकाः । गाढमालिङ्ग्य ते नारीं सुतप्तां लोहनिर्मिताम्
verses.transliteration: tena tenaiva rUpeNa tADyante pAradArikAH | gADhamAli~Ngya te nArIM sutaptAM lohanirmitAm
verses.translation: Immovable beings—plants etc. and movable beings worms, insects, birds, beasts, righteous men, gods and liberated beings, all these are equal in number in heaven as also in hell. A sinner who is averse to the performance of expiatory rites goes to hell.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वाकाराश्च पुरुषाः प्रज्वलन्ति समन्ततः । दुश्चारिणीं स्त्रियं गाढमालिङ्गन्ति रुदन्ति च
verses.transliteration: pUrvAkArAshcha puruShAH prajvalanti samantataH | dushchAriNIM striyaM gADhamAli~Nganti rudanti cha
verses.translation: Svayambhuva Manu has ordained expiatory rites for great sins and small expiatory rites for small sins in the Kali age

verses.sanskrit: ये शृण्वन्ति सतां निन्दां तेषां कर्णप्रपूरणम् । अग्निवर्णैरयःकीलैस्तप्तैस्ताम्रादिनिर्मितैः
verses.transliteration: ye shR^iNvanti satAM nindAM teShAM karNaprapUraNam | agnivarNairayaHkIlaistaptaistAmrAdinirmitaiH
verses.translation: Of the many rites mentioned by way of expiation the remembrance of iSiva is the greatest.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीजिक्महाएराणे पञ्ञम्याय॒मासंहितायां कालवच्जनशिवप्राप्तिवर्ण॑ नाम सप्तविशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: त्रपुसीसारकूटाद्भिः क्षीरेण च पुनःपुनः । सुतप्ततीक्ष्णतैलेन वज्रलेपेन वा पुनः
verses.transliteration: trapusIsArakUTAdbhiH kShIreNa cha punaHpunaH | sutaptatIkShNatailena vajralepena vA punaH
verses.translation: If a person commits a sin but repents after com¬ mitting it, it is also an expiation. There also the remem¬ brance of Siva is the greatest expiation.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, Japas, Homas, worship etc. are obstacles in the path of sins. O excellent sage, they do not occur anywhere in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, Japas, Homas, worship etc. are obstacles in the path of sins. O excellent sage, they do not occur anywhere in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.११. एकादशोऽध्यायः । अन्नदानमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । कृतपापा नरा यान्ति दुःखेन महतान्विताः । यममार्गे सुखं यैश्च तान्धर्मान्वद मे प्रभो
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.11\. ekAdasho.adhyAyaH | annadAnamAhAtmyavarNanam | vyAsa uvAcha | kR^itapApA narA yAnti duHkhena mahatAnvitAH | yamamArge sukhaM yaishcha tAndharmAnvada me prabho
verses.translation: The attainment of the status of Indra, lord of the gods, is the fruit of the merit attained in Japa, Homa, wor¬ ship etc- performed by the man whose mind is in lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: द्योतयन्तो दिशः सर्वा यान्ति दीपप्रदायिनः । प्रतिश्रयप्रदानेन सुखं यान्ति निरामयाः
verses.transliteration: dyotayanto dishaH sarvA yAnti dIpapradAyinaH | pratishrayapradAnena sukhaM yAnti nirAmayAH
verses.translation: O sage, he who devoutly remembers Siva day and night never goes to hell since his sins are eliminated without any vestige.
verses.hindi: कि साक्षात् मेरा हृदय ही है

verses.sanskrit: विश्राम्यमाणा गच्छन्ति गुरुशुश्रूषका नराः । आतोद्यविप्रदातारः सुखं यान्ति स्वके गृहे
verses.transliteration: vishrAmyamANA gachChanti gurushushrUShakA narAH | AtodyavipradAtAraH sukhaM yAnti svake gR^ihe
verses.translation: O excellent brahmin, sin and merit indicate hell and heaven. One is conducive to misery and the other to pleasure and rebirth.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धेन यथा गच्छन्ति गोप्रदाः । अत्र दत्तान्नपानानि तान्याप्नोति नरः पथि
verses.transliteration: sarvakAmasamR^iddhena yathA gachChanti gopradAH | atra dattAnnapAnAni tAnyApnoti naraH pathi
verses.translation: Happiness and misery constitute only a temporary transformation of the mind. But knowledge is the greatest Brahman. Knowledge is conducive to the understanding of reality.
verses.hindi: भाँति प्रत्यक्ष दिखायी पड़ने लगता है

verses.sanskrit: पादशौचप्रदानेन सजलेन पथा व्रजेत् । पादाभ्यङ्गं च यः कुर्यादश्वपृष्ठेन गच्छति
verses.transliteration: pAdashauchapradAnena sajalena pathA vrajet | pAdAbhya~NgaM cha yaH kuryAdashvapR^iShThena gachChati
verses.translation: The entire universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings has knowledge as its soul. O sage, there is nothing greater than the perfect knowledge of the greatest being.
verses.hindi: मात्रा केवल दिखती है, किंतु पढ़ी नहीं जाती

verses.sanskrit: पादशौचं तथाभ्यङ्गं दीपमन्नं प्रतिश्रयम् । यो ददाति सदा व्यास नोपसर्पति तं यमः
verses.transliteration: pAdashauchaM tathAbhya~NgaM dIpamannaM pratishrayam | yo dadAti sadA vyAsa nopasarpati taM yamaH
verses.translation: Thus the entire sphere of the hell has been ex¬ plained by me. Hereafter I shall explain the sphere of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: हेमरत्नप्रदानेन याति दुर्गाणि निस्तरन् । रौप्यानडुत्प्रदानेन यमलोकं सुखेन सः
verses.transliteration: hemaratnapradAnena yAti durgANi nistaran | raupyAnaDutpradAnena yamalokaM sukhena saH
verses.translation: O son of Parasara, listen succinctly to what I ex¬ plain, the sphere of the earth consisting of seven Dvipas (continents).
verses.hindi: है, उसे तुम बताओ, मैं तुम्हें सत्य-सत्य बताऊँगा

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमादिभिर्दानैः सुखं यान्ति यमालयम् । स्वर्गे तु विविधान्भोगान् प्राप्नुवन्ति सदा नराः
verses.transliteration: ityevamAdibhirdAnaiH sukhaM yAnti yamAlayam | svarge tu vividhAnbhogAn prApnuvanti sadA narAH
verses.translation: The seven*** continents are Jambu, Plaksa, Salmali, Kua, KrauAca, §aka, Pu$kara. These seven are sur¬ rounded by seven oceans.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव दानानामन्नदानं परं स्मृतम् । सद्यः प्रीतिकरं हृद्यं बलबुद्धिविवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: sarveShAmeva dAnAnAmannadAnaM paraM smR^itam | sadyaH prItikaraM hR^idyaM balabuddhivivardhanam
verses.translation: The seven oceans are salt sea, sugarcane juice sea, wine sea, ghee sea, curd sea, milk sea and pure water sea. Jambu Dvipa is situated in the middle of all these.

verses.sanskrit: नान्नदानसमं दानं विद्यते मुनिसत्तम । अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि तदभावे म्रियन्ति च
verses.transliteration: nAnnadAnasamaM dAnaM vidyate munisattama | annAdbhavanti bhUtAni tadabhAve mriyanti cha
verses.translation: In the middle of it is the golden mountain Meru, O Kaleya. It extends below to sixteen Yojanas and its height is eightyfour Yojanas. Its expanse on the top is thirtytwo Yojanas. This mountain is situated on the back of the earth and expands on all sides. It is sixteen thousand Yojanas at the base. It has the shape of a pericarp. The mountains Himavat,*** Hemakuta*** and Nisadha**® are to its south.
verses.hindi: तृष्णीं बभूव सुप्रीतः परमानंदनिर्भर:॥ २९  मग्न होकर मौन हो गये

verses.sanskrit: रक्तं मांसं वसा शुक्रं क्रमादन्नात्प्रवर्धते । शुक्राद्भवन्ति भूतानि तस्मादन्नमयं जगत्
verses.transliteration: raktaM mAMsaM vasA shukraM kramAdannAtpravardhate | shukrAdbhavanti bhUtAni tasmAdannamayaM jagat
verses.translation: The Varsa mountains in the north are Nila, Sveta and Srhgin.*** The extent of these is ten thousand Yojanas. They are full of gems and have pinky lustre.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । अवश्यं हि कृतं कर्म भोक्तव्यमविचारतः । शुभाशुभमथो वक्ष्ये तान्धर्मान् सुखदायकान्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | avashyaM hi kR^itaM karma bhoktavyamavichArataH | shubhAshubhamatho vakShye tAndharmAn sukhadAyakAn
verses.translation: $P. mentions seven continents. Their indentihcation is uncer¬
verses.hindi: ज्ञानवर्धन:॥ ३१  तथा ज्ञानवर्धक संवाद आपलोगोंसे कहा

verses.sanskrit: हेमरत्नाश्वनागेन्द्रैर्नारीस्रक्चन्दनादिभिः । समस्तैरपि सम्प्राप्तैर्न रमन्ति बुभुक्षिताः
verses.transliteration: hemaratnAshvanAgendrairnArIsrakchandanAdibhiH | samastairapi samprAptairna ramanti bubhukShitAH
verses.translation: This most celebrated mountain forms the northern boundary
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्धम्यागुमासंहितायां छायापुरुषवर्णन॑ नामाष्टाविंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्था जायमानाश्च बालवृद्धाश्च मध्यमाः । आहारमभिकाङ्क्षन्ति देवदानवराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: garbhasthA jAyamAnAshcha bAlavR^iddhAshcha madhyamAH | AhAramabhikA~NkShanti devadAnavarAkShasAH
verses.translation: iSP. places it to the south of the Mens, along with the Himavat and HemakGta.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुधा निःशेषरोगाणां व्याधिः श्रेष्ठतमः स्मृतः । स चान्नौषधिलेपेन नश्यतीह न संशयः
verses.transliteration: kShudhA niHsheSharogANAM vyAdhiH shreShThatamaH smR^itaH | sa chAnnauShadhilepena nashyatIha na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Nila, Sveta and Sp&gin stand to the north of the Meru. Cp Sk. P. 1. II. 37. 4?.
verses.hindi: समुत्पन्नं तु मे ब्रूहि यथा व्यासाच्च ते श्रुतम्॥ २  कहिये

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति क्षुधासमं दुःखं नास्ति रोगः क्षुधासमः । नास्त्यरोगसमं सौख्यं नास्ति क्रोधसमो रिपुः
verses.transliteration: nAsti kShudhAsamaM duHkhaM nAsti rogaH kShudhAsamaH | nAstyarogasamaM saukhyaM nAsti krodhasamo ripuH
verses.translation: In the north are the Kurus as well. O excellent sage, the extent of each of these, as in the case of Bharata, is nine thousand Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्त एव महत्पुण्यमन्नदाने प्रकीर्तितम् । तथा क्षुधाग्निना तप्ता म्रियन्ते सर्वदेहिनः
verses.transliteration: anta eva mahatpuNyamannadAne prakIrtitam | tathA kShudhAgninA taptA mriyante sarvadehinaH
verses.translation: Trees acting as the flagstaff of the mountain are Kadamba, Jambu, Pippala and Vata. Their height b eleven hundred Yojanas.
verses.hindi: प्रकृतिके माध्यमसे सृष्टि की गयी है

verses.sanskrit: अन्नदः प्राणदः प्रोक्तः प्राणदश्चापि सर्वदः । तस्मादन्नप्रदानेन सर्वदानफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: annadaH prANadaH proktaH prANadashchApi sarvadaH | tasmAdannapradAnena sarvadAnaphalaM labhet
verses.translation: O great sage, listen to the* origin of the name Jambudpa. There are great trees shining here. I shall explain their nature to you.
verses.hindi: हुआ था, अत: वे नारायण कहे गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: यस्यान्नपानपुष्टाङ्गः कुरुते पुण्यसञ्चयम् । अन्नप्रदातुस्तस्यार्धं कर्तुश्चार्धं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yasyAnnapAnapuShTA~NgaH kurute puNyasa~nchayam | annapradAtustasyArdhaM kartushchArdhaM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Fruits of the Jambu tree are of the size of a huge elephant. They fall on the top of the mountain and become shattered and scattered everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्ये यानि रत्नानि भोगस्त्रीवाहनानि च । अन्नदानप्रदः सर्वमिहामुत्र च तल्लभेत्
verses.transliteration: trailokye yAni ratnAni bhogastrIvAhanAni cha | annadAnapradaH sarvamihAmutra cha tallabhet
verses.translation: People staying on its banks do not perspire. They do not emit bad odour and they do not want in the exercise of their sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां देहः परमसाधनम् । तस्मादन्नेन पानेन पालयेद्देहमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: dharmArthakAmamokShANAM dehaH paramasAdhanam | tasmAdannena pAnena pAlayeddehamAtmanaH
verses.translation: The mud of the stream dried by blowing with
verses.hindi: यथेष्ट गतिको प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: अन्नमेव प्रशंसन्ति सर्वमन्ने प्रतिष्ठितम् । अन्नेन सदृशं दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: annameva prashaMsanti sarvamanne pratiShThitam | annena sadR^ishaM dAnaM na bhUtaM na bhaviShyati
verses.translation: The mountains Msuidara, Gandhamidana. Vipula and Sup&riva are placed to the east, south, west and north of the Meru rectively.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पञ्चम्यामुमासंहितायां आदिसर्गवर्णन॑ नामेकोनत्रिंशो3 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: अत्र ये शुभकर्माणः सौम्यचित्ता दयान्विताः । सुखेन ते नरा यान्ति यममार्गं भयावहम्
verses.transliteration: atra ye shubhakarmANaH saumyachittA dayAnvitAH | sukhena te narA yAnti yamamArgaM bhayAvaham
verses.translation: Its identification with the Btrram of that name near the mount Abu is uncertain.'

verses.sanskrit: अन्नेन धार्यते सर्वं विश्वं जगदिदं मुने । अन्नमूर्जस्करं लोके प्राणा ह्यन्ने प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: annena dhAryate sarvaM vishvaM jagadidaM mune | annamUrjaskaraM loke prANA hyanne pratiShThitAH
verses.translation: There are four lakes viz. Arunoda,**® Mahabhadra,**® Sitoda*®® and Manasa.*®® These four lakes are worthy of being enjoyed by all the gods.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्ना चापि धर्मेण ध्रुवस्थ जननी तथा॥ ८ थी, यही धर्मकन्या सुनीति ध्रुवकी माता थी

verses.sanskrit: दातव्यं भिक्षवे चान्नं ब्राह्मणाय महात्मने । कुटुम्बं पीडयित्वापि ह्यात्मनो भूतिमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: dAtavyaM bhikShave chAnnaM brAhmaNAya mahAtmane | kuTumbaM pIDayitvApi hyAtmano bhUtimichChatA
verses.translation: The filamenNmountains of Mem on its east are Sata- fijana, Kumhga, Kurara and Malyavat. Every one of them is important.

verses.sanskrit: विददाति निधिश्रेष्ठं यो दद्यादन्नमर्थिने । ब्राह्मणायार्तरूपाय पारलौकिकमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: vidadAti nidhishreShThaM yo dadyAdannamarthine | brAhmaNAyArtarUpAya pAralaukikamAtmanaH
verses.translation: The filament-mountains on the south are Trikuta, Sia, Patanga, Rucaka, Niyadha, Kapila and others.
verses.hindi: उत्पन हुए थे तथा सूर्यके समान तेजस्वी थे

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयेद्भूतिमन्विच्छन्काले द्विजमुपस्थितम् । श्रान्तमध्वनि वृत्त्यर्थं गृहस्थो गृहमागतम्
verses.transliteration: archayedbhUtimanvichChankAle dvijamupasthitam | shrAntamadhvani vR^ittyarthaM gR^ihastho gR^ihamAgatam
verses.translation: The filament-mountains on the west are Sinivisa, Kusumbha, Kapila, N5rada, Naga and other mountains.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नदः पूजयेद् व्यास सुशीलस्तु विमत्सरः । क्रोधमुत्पतितं हित्वा दिवि चेह महत्सुखम्
verses.transliteration: annadaH pUjayed vyAsa sushIlastu vimatsaraH | krodhamutpatitaM hitvA divi cheha mahatsukham
verses.translation: The filament-mountains on the north are nkha* cuda, yabha, the mountain named Hamsa, Kdlaftjara and others.

verses.sanskrit: नाभिनिन्देदधिगतं न प्रणुद्यात्कथञ्चन । अपि श्वपाके शुनि वा नान्नदानं प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: nAbhinindedadhigataM na praNudyAtkatha~nchana | api shvapAke shuni vA nAnnadAnaM praNashyati
verses.translation: All round that city are the eight cities of the eight guardians of the quarters, which have been assigned to them according to their quarters and forms.
verses.hindi: प्राचीनबर्हिने दिव्य दस पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया

verses.sanskrit: श्रान्तायादृष्टपूर्वाय ह्यन्नमध्वनि वर्तते । यो दद्यादपरिक्लिष्टः स समृद्धिमवाप्नुयात
verses.transliteration: shrAntAyAdR^iShTapUrvAya hyannamadhvani vartate | yo dadyAdaparikliShTaH sa samR^iddhimavApnuyAta
verses.translation: Issuing from Viynu's feet, the river Gangl,falls in that city of Brahma flowing through the sphere of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄन् देवांस्तथा विप्रानतिथींश्च महामुने । यो नरः प्रीणयत्यन्नैः तस्य पुण्यफलं महत्
verses.transliteration: pitR^In devAMstathA viprAnatithIMshcha mahAmune | yo naraH prINayatyannaiH tasya puNyaphalaM mahat
verses.translation: Falling in four directions the river Gahga flows into four streams viz. Sita,* Alakananda,*** Gakfu*** and Bhadra.*"
verses.hindi: और सारी पृथ्वीपर पेड़-ही-पेड़ हो गये

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं पानं च शूद्रेऽपि ब्राह्मणे च विशिष्यते । न पृच्छेद्गोत्रचरणं स्वाध्यायं देशमेव च
verses.transliteration: annaM pAnaM cha shUdre.api brAhmaNe cha vishiShyate | na pR^ichChedgotracharaNaM svAdhyAyaM deshameva cha
verses.translation: Sita flows to the east of the mountain, Alaka- Nanda flows to the south, the Gak9us flows to the west and the Bhadra flows to the north.
verses.hindi: डाला और अग्निने भस्म कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षितो ब्राह्मणेनेह दद्यादन्नं च यः पुमान् । स याति परमं स्वर्गं यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: bhikShito brAhmaNeneha dadyAdannaM cha yaH pumAn | sa yAti paramaM svargaM yAvadAbhUtasamplavam
verses.translation: Thus the holy river Ganga flowing along three paths, flows into the great ocean in the four quarters after crossing all the mountains.
verses.hindi: सोमके भी अंशसे उत्पन्न हुए थे

verses.sanskrit: यः प्रदद्याद् द्विजेन्द्राणामुपानत्काष्ठपादुके । स नरोऽश्वेन महता सुखं याति यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: yaH pradadyAd dvijendrANAmupAnatkAShThapAduke | sa naro.ashvena mahatA sukhaM yAti yamAlayam
verses.translation: The four Vardas Bharata, Ketumida, Bhadr5fva and the Kurus are the petals of the world>lotus. The Lokaparvatas constitute the boundary.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नदस्य च वृक्षाश्च सर्वकामफलान्विताः । भवन्तीह यथा विप्रा हर्षयुक्तास्त्रिविष्टपे
verses.transliteration: annadasya cha vR^ikShAshcha sarvakAmaphalAnvitAH | bhavantIha yathA viprA harShayuktAstriviShTape
verses.translation: The Devakuta constitutes its belly. Its extent is from south to north. Gandhamadana and Kailasa extend from east to west.
verses.hindi: कहीं भी स्थिरता प्राप्त नहीं करोगे

verses.sanskrit: अन्नदानेन ये लोकाः स्वर्गे विरचिता मुने । अन्नदातुर्महादिव्यास्तान् शृणुष्व महामुने
verses.transliteration: annadAnena ye lokAH svarge virachitA mune | annadAturmahAdivyAstAn shR^iNuShva mahAmune
verses.translation: The Nifadha and the Nila mountains issue> from the east and the west of Meru, curl down to south and north and terminate within the pericarp.

verses.sanskrit: भवनानि प्रकाशन्ते दिवि तेषां महात्मनाम् । नानासंस्थानरूपाणि नानाकामान्वितानि च
verses.transliteration: bhavanAni prakAshante divi teShAM mahAtmanAm | nAnAsaMsthAnarUpANi nAnAkAmAnvitAni cha
verses.translation: Tliese Kesara moimtains Sveta and others, consti¬ tuting the belly of Meru in twos, are very beautiful.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामफलाश्चापि वृक्षा भवनसंस्थिताः । हेमवाप्यः शुभाः कूपा दीर्घिकाश्चैव सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: sarvakAmaphalAshchApi vR^ikShA bhavanasaMsthitAH | hemavApyaH shubhAH kUpA dIrghikAshchaiva sarvashaH
verses.translation: To the north of the mountains are watertroughs resorted to by the Siddhas and Garanas. The forests and the cities beside them are very fascinating.
verses.hindi: ये दक्ष आदि उत्पन्न होते रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: घोषयन्ति च पानानि शुभान्यथ सहस्रशः । भक्ष्यभोज्यमयाः शैला वासांस्याभरणानि च
verses.transliteration: ghoShayanti cha pAnAni shubhAnyatha sahasrashaH | bhakShyabhojyamayAH shailA vAsAMsyAbharaNAni cha
verses.translation: The cities are of the gods, Yakas, Gandharvas and Rakasas. The gods and the Daityas sport about on the mountains day and night.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरं स्रवन्त्यः सरितस्तथैवाज्यस्य पर्वताः । प्रासादाः पाण्डुराभासाः शय्याश्च कनकोज्ज्वलाः
verses.transliteration: kShIraM sravantyaH saritastathaivAjyasya parvatAH | prAsAdAH pANDurAbhAsAH shayyAshcha kanakojjvalAH
verses.translation: Sita, one of the seven currents of the Ganm risin| from Bindusara, a Himalayan lake, flows towards the west. For details see Studies in Skandapurina PP. 149. 150, under Sita-Caku group.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिक्महापुराणे पश्चम्यागुमासंहितायां सर्गवर्णन॑ नाम त्रिंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तानन्नदाश्च गच्छन्ति तस्मादन्नप्रदो भवेत् । यदीच्छेदात्मनो भव्यमिह लोके परत्र च
verses.transliteration: tAnannadAshcha gachChanti tasmAdannaprado bhavet | yadIchChedAtmano bhavyamiha loke paratra cha
verses.translation: It flows through Garhwal and Shrinagar, the cafutal of Garhwal is situated on it.

verses.sanskrit: एते लोकाः पुण्यकृतामन्नदानां महाप्रभाः । तस्मादन्नं विशेषेण दातव्यं मानवैर्ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: ete lokAH puNyakR^itAmannadAnAM mahAprabhAH | tasmAdannaM visheSheNa dAtavyaM mAnavairdhruvam
verses.translation: These are the abodes of righteous men.. They are glorified as heavens on the earth. Sinners can never go there. They cannot be seen in their vicinity.
verses.hindi: सृष्टिं तु विस्तरेणेमां सूतपुत्र बदाशु मे॥ १  विस्तारपूर्वक करें

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं प्रजापतिः साक्षादन्नं विष्णुः स्वयं हरः । तस्मादन्नसमं दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: annaM prajApatiH sAkShAdannaM viShNuH svayaM haraH | tasmAdannasamaM dAnaM na bhUtaM na bhaviShyati
verses.translation: O great sage, in the eight Vardas beginning with the Kimpurua etc. there is no sorrow, danger, agony, hunger or fear.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं यः पश्चादन्नदो भवेत् । विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः स्वर्गलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: kR^itvApi sumahatpApaM yaH pashchAdannado bhavet | vimuktaH sarvapApebhyaH svargalokaM sa gachChati
verses.translation: The people are healthy, without terror and devoid of miseries. They have the longevity of ten to twelve thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: छत्रदानेन गच्छन्ति यथा छत्रेण देहिनः । शिबिकायाः प्रदानेन तद्रथेन सुखं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: ChatradAnena gachChanti yathA ChatreNa dehinaH | shibikAyAH pradAnena tadrathena sukhaM vrajet
verses.translation: In all these seven Vardas, the rivers are well arranged. They have sands of gold. There are hundreds of small rivers too. Auspicious men sport in them.
verses.hindi: समुद्रको प्राप्तकर नदियाँ पुन: नहीं लौटती हैं

verses.sanskrit: अन्नपानाश्वगोवस्त्रशय्याच्छत्रासनानि च । प्रेतलोके प्रशस्तानि दानान्यष्टौ विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: annapAnAshvagovastrashayyAchChatrAsanAni cha | pretaloke prashastAni dAnAnyaShTau visheShataH
verses.translation: I shall explain the Bharatavar$a. South of the Himalaya mountain and north of the ocean is the land of Bharata. O great sage, its extent is nine thousand Yojanas. This is the land of sacred rites for attaining heaven and salvation. So say the wise people.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दानविशेषेण धर्मराजपुरं नरः । यस्माद्याति विमानेन तस्माद्दानं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM dAnavisheSheNa dharmarAjapuraM naraH | yasmAdyAti vimAnena tasmAddAnaM samAcharet
verses.translation: Heaven and hell are attained by men from here only. I shall mention nine subdivisions of the Bharata Vara to you.

verses.sanskrit: एतदाख्यानमनघमन्नदानप्रभावतः । यः पठेत्पाठयेदन्यान्स समृद्धः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: etadAkhyAnamanaghamannadAnaprabhAvataH | yaH paThetpAThayedanyAnsa samR^iddhaH prajAyate
verses.translation: Indradyumna, Kaseru, Tamravarna Gabhastimat, Nfigadvipa, Saumya, Gandharva, Varua and the ninth is the sub-condnent Sagarasambhrta. This sub-continent lies North to South extending to a thousand Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे ब्राह्मणान्यो महामुने । अक्षय्यमन्नदानं च पितॄणामुपतिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: shR^iNuyAchChrAvayechChrAddhe brAhmaNAnyo mahAmune | akShayyamannadAnaM cha pitR^INAmupatiShThati
verses.translation: To the east of Bharata live the Kir&tas,*** to the south the Yavanas; to the west Khafas and to the north the ascetics.
verses.hindi: श्रूणु कश्यपपत्नीनां नामानि मुनिसत्तम॥ ३९  श्रवण कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: शय्यासनप्रदानेन सुखं याति सुविश्रमम् । आरामच्छायाकर्तारो मार्गे वा वृक्षरोपकाः । व्रजन्ति यमलोकं च आतपेऽति गतक्लमाः
verses.transliteration: shayyAsanapradAnena sukhaM yAti suvishramam | ArAmachChAyAkartAro mArge vA vR^ikSharopakAH | vrajanti yamalokaM cha Atape.ati gataklamAH
verses.translation: KiriU, a Himalayan tribe. Is placed in the east. Yavanas, identified with the IndoGreeks, never lived in the south but they are
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे पद्चम्याम॒मासंहितायां सर्गवर्णन॑ नामैकत्रिंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: यान्ति पुष्पकयानेन पुष्पारामकरा नराः । देवायतनकर्तारः क्रीडन्ति च गृहोदरे
verses.transliteration: yAnti puShpakayAnena puShpArAmakarA narAH | devAyatanakartAraH krIDanti cha gR^ihodare
verses.translation: In the middle live the Brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vailyas

verses.sanskrit: कर्तारश्च तथा ये च यतीनामाश्रमस्य च । अनाथमण्डपानां तु क्रीडन्ति च गृहोदरे
verses.transliteration: kartArashcha tathA ye cha yatInAmAshramasya cha | anAthamaNDapAnAM tu krIDanti cha gR^ihodare
verses.translation: There are seven Kulaparvatas viz Mahendra,**' Malaya,*®® Sahya,*®* Sudama,*®® ksaparvata,*®* Vindhya*®* and Pariyatra.*®®
verses.hindi: स्त्रियाँ थीं, उनसे अत्यन्त तेजस्वी सन्तानें हुईं

verses.sanskrit: देवाग्निगुरुविप्राणां मातापित्रोश्च पूजकाः । पूज्यमाना नरा यान्ति कामुकेन यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: devAgniguruviprANAM mAtApitroshcha pUjakAH | pUjyamAnA narA yAnti kAmukena yathAsukham
verses.translation: O sage, Vedas, Smrtis, Puranas and other things issue from Pariyatra. They dispel all sins, it should be known, by their very sight or touch.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Godavari,*®® Bhimarathi,*®* Tapi,*®® and other im¬ portant riv.rs issue from the mountain Rksa. They dispel fear of sins immediately.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Godavari,*®® Bhimarathi,*®* Tapi,*®® and other im¬ portant riv.rs issue from the mountain Rksa. They dispel fear of sins immediately.
verses.hindi: पुत्रियोंका वर्णन करता हूँ, उसे सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१२. द्वादशोऽध्यायः । तपोमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । पानीयदानं परमं दानानामुत्तमं सदा । सर्वेषां जीवपुञ्जानां तर्पणं जीवनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.12\. dvAdasho.adhyAyaH | tapomAhAtmyavarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | pAnIyadAnaM paramaM dAnAnAmuttamaM sadA | sarveShAM jIvapu~njAnAM tarpaNaM jIvanaM smR^itam
verses.translation: The rivers Kr?na Veni*®* and others issue from Sahya Kftamala,**® Tamraparni® and others issue from Malaya.
verses.hindi: येषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्य शतशो5थ सहस््रशः ॥ ५२  और पौत्र हुए

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विधानां भूतानां तडागः परमाश्रयः । तडागादीनि सर्वाणि दिशन्ति श्रियमुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: chaturvidhAnAM bhUtAnAM taDAgaH paramAshrayaH | taDAgAdIni sarvANi dishanti shriyamuttamAm
verses.translation: See P. 628 note 76.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे पद्चस्वामुमासंहितायां कश्यपर्वशवर्णन नाम द्वात्रिशो3 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: देवा मनुष्या गन्धर्वाः पितरो नागराक्षसाः । स्थावराणि च भूतानि संश्रयन्ति जलाशयम्
verses.transliteration: devA manuShyA gandharvAH pitaro nAgarAkShasAH | sthAvarANi cha bhUtAni saMshrayanti jalAshayam
verses.translation: See P. 164 note 166; p 628 note 72.

verses.sanskrit: प्रावृडृतौ तडागे तु सलिलं यस्य तिष्ठति । अग्निहोत्रफलं तस्य भवतीत्याह चात्मभूः
verses.transliteration: prAvR^iDR^itau taDAge tu salilaM yasya tiShThati | agnihotraphalaM tasya bhavatItyAha chAtmabhUH
verses.translation: See P. 164 note 16), p 56 > note 28, p 623 no*e 6j.

verses.sanskrit: शरत्काले तु सलिलं तडागे यस्य तिष्ठति । गोसहस्रफलं तस्य भवेन्नैवात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: sharatkAle tu salilaM taDAge yasya tiShThati | gosahasraphalaM tasya bhavennaivAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: See P, 623 note 69.
verses.hindi: क्यों करते हैं, हम आपके भाई मरुत हैं

verses.sanskrit: हेमन्ते शिशिरे चैव सलिलं यस्य तिष्ठति । स वै बहुसुवर्णस्य यज्ञस्य लभते फलम्
verses.transliteration: hemante shishire chaiva salilaM yasya tiShThati | sa vai bahusuvarNasya yaj~nasya labhate phalam
verses.translation: See P. 629 note 77.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ते च तथा ग्रीष्मे सलिलं यस्य तिष्ठति । अतिरात्राश्वमेधानां फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: vasante cha tathA grIShme salilaM yasya tiShThati | atirAtrAshvamedhAnAM phalamAhurmanIShiNaH
verses.translation: See P. 75 note 55.

verses.sanskrit: मुने व्यासाथ वृक्षाणां रोपणे च गुणान् शृणु । प्रोक्तं जलाशयफलं जीवप्रीणनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: mune vyAsAtha vR^ikShANAM ropaNe cha guNAn shR^iNu | proktaM jalAshayaphalaM jIvaprINanamuttamam
verses.translation: The source of the Surasi, a river of the Narmadft group is actually the Rkpivat and not the Vindhya, Sircar, Op. cit, P. 47 note 3.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागतान् सर्वान् पितृवंशांस्तु तारयेत् । कान्तारे वृक्षरोपी यस्तस्माद् वृक्षांस्तु रोपयेत्
verses.transliteration: atItAnAgatAn sarvAn pitR^ivaMshAMstu tArayet | kAntAre vR^ikSharopI yastasmAd vR^ikShAMstu ropayet
verses.translation: See P. 75 note 56.
verses.hindi: महध्य॑ तदथधिष्ठानं॑ पुराणं परिकीर्तितम्॥ ३१  समृद्धिका साक्षात् अधिष्ठान कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पुत्रा भवन्त्येते पादपा नात्र संशयः । परं लोकं गतः सोऽपि लोकानाप्नोति चाक्षयान्
verses.transliteration: tatra putrA bhavantyete pAdapA nAtra saMshayaH | paraM lokaM gataH so.api lokAnApnoti chAkShayAn
verses.translation: Triyama,** 9"?*k'*ly*** others issue from

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैः सुरगणान् सर्वान् फलैश्चापि तथा पितॄन् । छायया चातिथीन् सर्वान् पूजयन्ति महीरुहाः
verses.transliteration: puShpaiH suragaNAn sarvAn phalaishchApi tathA pitR^In | ChAyayA chAtithIn sarvAn pUjayanti mahIruhAH
verses.translation: Many territories, countries are situated in their basins. People drink from these rivers as well as from other lakes.

verses.sanskrit: प्रपादानमतः कुर्यात् सुस्नेहादनिवारितम् । जलाश्रयविनिर्माणं महानन्दकरं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: prapAdAnamataH kuryAt susnehAdanivAritam | jalAshrayavinirmANaM mahAnandakaraM bhavet
verses.translation: O great sage, all the four Yugas Kfta and others are followed in Bharata and not in the other Dvipas.
verses.hindi: हुए हैं, उनका वर्णन मैं सुनना चाहता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: किन्नरोरगरक्षांसि देवगन्धर्वमानवाः । तथैवर्षिगणाश्चैव संश्रयन्ति महीरुहान्
verses.transliteration: kinnaroragarakShAMsi devagandharvamAnavAH | tathaivarShigaNAshchaiva saMshrayanti mahIruhAn
verses.translation: Charitable gifts are offered here by meritorious sacrificers. Ascetics perform penances strenuously for the attainment of better worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पिताः फलवन्तश्च तर्पयन्तीह मानवान् । इह लोके परे चैव पुत्रास्ते धर्मतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: puShpitAH phalavantashcha tarpayantIha mAnavAn | iha loke pare chaiva putrAste dharmataH smR^itAH
verses.translation: O excellent sage, after a thousand births rarely does a man get birth as a human being here and that too due to hoarded merits.

verses.sanskrit: तडागकृद् वृक्षरोपी चेष्टयज्ञश्च यो द्विजः । एते स्वर्गान्न हीयन्ते ये चान्ये सत्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: taDAgakR^id vR^ikSharopI cheShTayaj~nashcha yo dvijaH | ete svargAnna hIyante ye chAnye satyavAdinaH
verses.translation: After getting human birth once in a way, and sporting about in the great soul form of 8iva I shall attain the fruits of all sacred rites in that form.
verses.hindi: चौदह मनुओंको कहा, जैसा कि मैंने सुना है

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमेव परं ब्रह्म सत्यमेव परं तपः । सत्यमेव परो यज्ञः सत्यमेव परं श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: satyameva paraM brahma satyameva paraM tapaH | satyameva paro yaj~naH satyameva paraM shrutam
verses.translation: Only blessed human beings derive this pleasure. They are happy and their minds are interested in sacred

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं सुप्तेषु जागर्ति सत्यं च परमं पदम् । सत्येनैव धृता पृथ्वी सत्ये सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: satyaM supteShu jAgarti satyaM cha paramaM padam | satyenaiva dhR^itA pR^ithvI satye sarvaM pratiShThitam
verses.translation: Triyama or Tris&mi not identified.
verses.hindi: उस समय यज्ञ नामक इन्द्र कहे गये

verses.sanskrit: तपो यज्ञश्च पुण्यं च देवर्षिपितृपूजने । आपो विद्या च ते सर्वे सर्वं सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: tapo yaj~nashcha puNyaM cha devarShipitR^ipUjane | Apo vidyA cha te sarve sarvaM satye pratiShThitam
verses.translation: still bearing its ancient name flows into the Bay of Bengal near Berhampur on the SB Railway in the Ganjam district of Orissa.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं यज्ञस्तपो दानं मन्त्रा देवी सरस्वती । ब्रह्मचर्यं तथा सत्यमोङ्कारः सत्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: satyaM yaj~nastapo dAnaM mantrA devI sarasvatI | brahmacharyaM tathA satyamo~NkAraH satyameva cha
verses.translation: Raychaudhuri identifies KumUri with the river of the tame name in the MfinbhQm district in south Bihar. The identification is quite probable in view of the plausibility of his identification of the Kula parvata called Suktimat with the hUls of Eastern India extending from Ghhatisgarh to the Santal Parganas.

verses.sanskrit: सत्येन वायुरभ्येति सत्येन तपते रविः । सत्येनाग्निर्निर्दहति स्वर्गः सत्येन तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: satyena vAyurabhyeti satyena tapate raviH | satyenAgnirnirdahati svargaH satyena tiShThati
verses.translation: This Jambudvipa extends to a hundred thousand Yojanas including all its internal zones. It is well surrounded by the salt ocean.®"

verses.sanskrit: पालनं सर्ववेदानां सर्वतीर्थावगाहनम् । सत्येन वहते लोके सर्वमाप्नोत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: pAlanaM sarvavedAnAM sarvatIrthAvagAhanam | satyena vahate loke sarvamApnotyasaMshayam
verses.translation: The seven Var§a mountains are Gomanta, Gandra. Narada, Dardura, Somaka, Sumanas and Vaibhraja.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधसहस्रं च सत्यं च तुलया धृतम् । लक्षाणि क्रतवश्चैव सत्यमेव विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: ashvamedhasahasraM cha satyaM cha tulayA dhR^itam | lakShANi kratavashchaiva satyameva vishiShyate
verses.translation: On these beautiful Varsa mountains) all the subjects) gods, Gandharvas etc. live together for ever.

verses.sanskrit: इह लोके परे वापि सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः । तस्माद्वापीश्च कूपांश्च तडागान् कारयेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: iha loke pare vApi satyaM satyaM na saMshayaH | tasmAdvApIshcha kUpAMshcha taDAgAn kArayennaraH
verses.translation: The seven holy rivers here are Anutaptfi) likhl) Papaghni, Tridiva, Krpa, Amrta and Sukrta.

verses.sanskrit: सत्येन देवाः पितरो मानवोरगराक्षसाः । प्रीयन्ते सत्यतः सर्वे लोकाश्च सचराचराः
verses.transliteration: satyena devAH pitaro mAnavoragarAkShasAH | prIyante satyataH sarve lokAshcha sacharAcharAH
verses.translation: Insignificant rivers and mountains are there in thousands. The people in the countries are delighted in drinking the waters of these rivers.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमाहुः परं धर्मं सत्यमाहुः परं पदम् । सत्यमाहुः परं ब्रह्म तस्मात्सत्यं सदा वदेत्
verses.transliteration: satyamAhuH paraM dharmaM satyamAhuH paraM padam | satyamAhuH paraM brahma tasmAtsatyaM sadA vadet
verses.translation: O excellent sage, there are brahmins, Katriyas, VaiSyas and iSudras there. In its middle there is a big tree like the celestial Kalpa tree.

verses.sanskrit: मुनयः सत्यनिरतास्तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुश्चरम् । सत्यधर्मरताः सिद्धाः ततः स्वर्गं च ते गताः
verses.transliteration: munayaH satyaniratAstapastaptvA sudushcharam | satyadharmaratAH siddhAH tataH svargaM cha te gatAH
verses.translation: Lord Vi§ 9 U and Brahmfi too perform worships here with Vedic mantras aad Tantras. Now listen again to the description of iSahnali in brief.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां सर्वमन्वन्तरानुकीरवनं नाम च॒ुस्त्रिशो3 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोगणसंविष्टैर्विमानैः परिमातृभिः । वक्तव्यं च सदा सत्यं न सत्याद्विद्यते परम्
verses.transliteration: apsarogaNasaMviShTairvimAnaiH parimAtR^ibhiH | vaktavyaM cha sadA satyaM na satyAdvidyate param
verses.translation: It refers to the silt sea placed in the west of Bhftrata. Sec P. iigS note.

verses.sanskrit: अगाधे विपुले सिद्धे सत्यतीर्थे शुचिह्रदे । स्नातव्यं मनसा युक्तं स्थानं तत्परमं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: agAdhe vipule siddhe satyatIrthe shuchihrade | snAtavyaM manasA yuktaM sthAnaM tatparamaM smR^itam
verses.translation: It has been identified with the basin of the mediterranean. It derives its name from the fig trees growing abundantly on its toil. See
verses.hindi: सूर्यसे संज्ञामें तीन सन्‍्तानें उत्पन्न हुईं

verses.sanskrit: आत्मार्थे वा परार्थे वा पुत्रार्थे वापि मानवाः । अनृतं ये न भाषन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः
verses.transliteration: AtmArthe vA parArthe vA putrArthe vApi mAnavAH | anR^itaM ye na bhAShante te narAH svargagAminaH
verses.translation: There are seven Up-Varsas (sub-continents) there too. Please listen to their names. They are 6veta, Harita, Jimuta Rohita, Vaikala, Manasa and uprabha the seventh one. The continent is called Salmali'* because of the Salmala tree.

verses.sanskrit: वेदा यज्ञास्तथा मन्त्राः सन्ति विप्रेषु नित्यशः । नौ भान्त्यपि ह्यसत्येषु तस्मात्सत्यं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: vedA yaj~nAstathA mantrAH santi vipreShu nityashaH | nau bhAntyapi hyasatyeShu tasmAtsatyaM samAcharet
verses.translation: It is always surrounded by the ocean, twice extensive as it. The rivers indicate the Vardas significantly. Listen to their names. They are 3ukla, Rakia, Hiranyfi, Gandra, 6ubhra, Vimocana and the Nivrtti. All these have cool sacred waters.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । तपसो मे फलं ब्रूहि पुनरेव विशेषतः । सर्वेषां चैव वर्णानां ब्राह्मणानां तपोधन
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | tapaso me phalaM brUhi punareva visheShataH | sarveShAM chaiva varNAnAM brAhmaNAnAM tapodhana
verses.translation: All the seven Var§as contain people of the four castes. They worship lord $iva always with various kinds of sacrifices.
verses.hindi: पालनीया: सुखेनैब मम चेदिच्छसि प्रियम्॥ ९ कन्याका सुखपूर्वक पालन करना

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । प्रवक्ष्यामि तपोऽध्यायं सर्वकामार्थसाधकम् । सुदुश्चरं द्विजातीनां तन्मे निगदतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | pravakShyAmi tapo.adhyAyaM sarvakAmArthasAdhakam | sudushcharaM dvijAtInAM tanme nigadataH shR^iNu
verses.translation: In this beautiful place the gods are always pre¬ sent. This Dvipa is surrounded by the ocean of wine.
verses.hindi: रहस्य सूर्यसे नहीं कहूँगी, आप सुखपूर्वक जाइये

verses.sanskrit: तपो हि परमं प्रोक्तं तपसा विद्यते फलम् । तपोरता हि ये नित्यं मोदन्ते सह दैवतैः
verses.transliteration: tapo hi paramaM proktaM tapasA vidyate phalam | taporatA hi ye nityaM modante saha daivataiH
verses.translation: The ocean of wine is twice as much as the 6almali Dvipa. Kua Dvipa is all round it externally. Daityas and Danavas live there along with human beings. So also the gods, the Gandharvas, the Yakas, the Kim- puruas and others too. There abo the castes are devoted to their respective duties and conduct.
verses.hindi: संज्ञापुत्रोंसे उतना स्नेह नहीं करती थी

verses.sanskrit: अर्धं पापस्य हरति पुरुषस्य विकर्मणः । कूपः प्रवृत्तपानीयः सुप्रवृत्तस्य नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: ardhaM pApasya harati puruShasya vikarmaNaH | kUpaH pravR^ittapAnIyaH supravR^ittasya nityashaH
verses.translation: People in Kua Dvipa worship Brahma, Vifnu and 3iva, the bestower of the fruits of all desires.
verses.hindi: स्नेह क्‍यों करती हो, इसे मुझको बताओ

verses.sanskrit: तपसा प्राप्यते स्वर्गस्तपसा प्राप्यते यशः । तपसा प्राप्यते कामस्तपः सर्वार्थसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: tapasA prApyate svargastapasA prApyate yashaH | tapasA prApyate kAmastapaH sarvArthasAdhanam
verses.translation: The seven mountains are Kueiaya, Hari, Dyuti- mat, Pupavat, Mapidruma, Hemaiaila and Mandaracala.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा मोक्षमाप्नोति तपसा विन्दते महत् । ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पत्तिः सौभाग्यं रूपमेव च
verses.transliteration: tapasA mokShamApnoti tapasA vindate mahat | j~nAnavij~nAnasampattiH saubhAgyaM rUpameva cha
verses.translation: The rivers are seven. Listen to their names factually. Dhutapfipi, Sivfi, the holy Sammid, Vidyfi, Dambha, Mah! and Alpa. These quell all sins. There are thousands of other rivers of auspicious waters and golden sands.

verses.sanskrit: नानाविधानि वस्तूनि तपसा लभते नरः । तपसा लभते सर्वं मनसा यद्यदिच्छति
verses.transliteration: nAnAvidhAni vastUni tapasA labhate naraH | tapasA labhate sarvaM manasA yadyadichChati
verses.translation: It correxmds to Iran, Iraq and the flinging lands of the hot desert. Ibid P 40.
verses.hindi: वह नदियोंमें श्रेष्ठ लोकपावनी यमुना हुई

verses.sanskrit: नातप्ततपसो यान्ति ब्रह्मलोकं कदाचन । नातप्ततपसां प्राप्यः शङ्करः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: nAtaptatapaso yAnti brahmalokaM kadAchana | nAtaptatapasAM prApyaH sha~NkaraH parameshvaraH
verses.translation: They are Kraufica, Vamana, Andhakaraka, Diva- vrli, Manas, Pundarika and Dundubhi.

verses.sanskrit: यत्कार्यं किञ्चिदास्थाय पुरुषस्तपते तपः । तत्सर्वं समवाप्नोति परत्रेह च मानवः
verses.transliteration: yatkAryaM ki~nchidAsthAya puruShastapate tapaH | tatsarvaM samavApnoti paratreha cha mAnavaH
verses.translation: The subjects live on these Varija mountains which are very beautiful and golden. Free from terror, they are accompanied by their friends and the gods.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पश्चम्याग॒मासंहितायां मन्वन्तरकीर्तने वैवस्वतवर्णनं नाम पद्ञत्रिशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: सुरापः परदारी च ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः । तपसा तरते सर्वं सर्वतश्च विमुञ्चति
verses.transliteration: surApaH paradArI cha brahmahA gurutalpagaH | tapasA tarate sarvaM sarvatashcha vimu~nchati
verses.translation: Brahmins, Katriyas, VaUyas and iSudras live there in their due order. There are seven great rivers and thousands of other small rivers there.
verses.hindi: वैवस्वतवर्णन नायक पैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अपि सर्वेश्वरः स्थाणुर्विष्णुश्चैव सनातनः । ब्रह्मा हुताशनः शक्रो ये चान्ये तपसान्विताः
verses.transliteration: api sarveshvaraH sthANurviShNushchaiva sanAtanaH | brahmA hutAshanaH shakro ye chAnye tapasAnvitAH
verses.translation: They are Gauri, Kumudvati, Sandhya, RaiSi, Mano* java, Santi and Pudsi'ika and they make others drink their holy water.
verses.hindi: विशालकाय, धेर्यशाली एवं क्षत्रिय धर्ममें तत्पर थे

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् । तपसा दिवि मोदन्ते समेता दैवतैः सह
verses.transliteration: aShTAshItisahasrANi munInAmUrdhvaretasAm | tapasA divi modante sametA daivataiH saha
verses.translation: The lord in the form of Yogarudra is worship¬ ped there. The ocean of curds and whey is surrounded by l§akadvipa'* twice as large. The mountains are seven. Listen to their names from me. In the east is the mountain Udaya- giri. In the south is the mountain Jaladhara. The Astagiri is in the west and Avikea in the north. The great tree is Sa there, worshipped by Siddhas and Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा लभ्यते राज्यं स च शक्रः सुरेश्वरः । तपसापालयत्सर्वमहन्यहनि वृत्रहा
verses.transliteration: tapasA labhyate rAjyaM sa cha shakraH sureshvaraH | tapasApAlayatsarvamahanyahani vR^itrahA
verses.translation: The countries are very sacred populated by the people of all the four castes. The rivers too are very holy, dispelling all terror due to sins.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ देवौ सर्वलोकहिते रतौ । तपसैव प्रकाशन्ते नक्षत्राणि ग्रहास्तथा
verses.transliteration: sUryAchandramasau devau sarvalokahite ratau | tapasaiva prakAshante nakShatrANi grahAstathA
verses.translation: They are Sukumari, Kumari, Nalini, Veouka, Ikfu, Reuka and Gabhasti.
verses.hindi: उन प्रजापति मनुसे यह धर्मसम्मत बात कही--

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तारयते वंशं यस्य खाते जलाशये । गावः पिबन्ति विप्राश्च साधवश्च नराः सदा
verses.transliteration: sarvaM tArayate vaMshaM yasya khAte jalAshaye | gAvaH pibanti viprAshcha sAdhavashcha narAH sadA
verses.translation: O great sage, there are thousands of small rivers there. The mountains too are in hundreds and thousands.
verses.hindi: मित्रावरणनामाना मुनी ऊचतुरादरात्॥ १०  दोनों मुनियोंने आदरपूर्वक कहा--

verses.sanskrit: न चास्ति तत्सुखं लोके यद्विना तपसा किल । तपसैव सुखं सर्वमिति वेदविदो विदुः
verses.transliteration: na chAsti tatsukhaM loke yadvinA tapasA kila | tapasaiva sukhaM sarvamiti vedavido viduH
verses.translation: It is surrounded on all sides by the milk-ocean

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं विज्ञानमारोग्यं रूपवत्त्वं तथैव च । सौभाग्यं चैव तपसा प्राप्यते सर्वदा सुखम्
verses.transliteration: j~nAnaM vij~nAnamArogyaM rUpavattvaM tathaiva cha | saubhAgyaM chaiva tapasA prApyate sarvadA sukham
verses.translation: The Dvipa and the Varsas are of similar shapes namely gyrated. Men live there up to ten thousand years.
verses.hindi: बुधने उसे संगके लिये आमन्त्रित किया

verses.sanskrit: तपसा सृज्यते विश्वं ब्रह्मा विश्वं विना श्रमम् । पाति विष्णुर्हरोऽप्यत्ति धत्ते शेषोऽखिलां महीम्
verses.transliteration: tapasA sR^ijyate vishvaM brahmA vishvaM vinA shramam | pAti viShNurharo.apyatti dhatte sheSho.akhilAM mahIm
verses.translation: They are free from ailment. They are not un- happy. They are devoid of passion and hatred. Evil is never approved of by them. O sage, nor do they imprison or kill anyone.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो गाधिसुतस्तपसैव महामुने । क्षत्रियोऽथाभवद्विप्रः प्रसिद्धं त्रिभवे त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: vishvAmitro gAdhisutastapasaiva mahAmune | kShatriyo.athAbhavadvipraH prasiddhaM tribhave tvidam
verses.translation: O great sage, in the Dhatakikhana and the Maha- vita in the Puskaradvipa, the holy fig tree is the excellent abode of Brahma.
verses.hindi: इसका कुछ भी पता न लगा

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तं ते महाप्राज्ञ तपोमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । शृण्वध्ययनमाहात्म्यं तपसोऽधिकमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktaM te mahAprAj~na tapomAhAtmyamuttamam | shR^iNvadhyayanamAhAtmyaM tapaso.adhikamuttamam
verses.translation: Brahma resides there, worshipped by gods and Asuras. Pukara is surrounded by the ocean of sweet water.

verses.sanskrit: निदाघकाले पानीयं यस्य तिष्ठत्यवारितम् । सुदुर्गं विषमं कृच्छ्रं न कदाचिदवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: nidAghakAle pAnIyaM yasya tiShThatyavAritam | sudurgaM viShamaM kR^ichChraM na kadAchidavApyate
verses.translation: Thus the seven continents are surrounded by seven oceans each twice as large as the one within.

verses.sanskrit: तडागानां च वक्ष्यामि कृतानां ये गुणाः स्मृता । त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वत्र पूजितो यस्तडागवान्
verses.transliteration: taDAgAnAM cha vakShyAmi kR^itAnAM ye guNAH smR^itA | triShu lokeShu sarvatra pUjito yastaDAgavAn
verses.translation: O excellent sage, if the water kept in a pot is heated it goes up. Similarly when the moon rises the water of the ocean rises up.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा मित्रसदने मैत्रं मित्रार्तिवर्जितम् । कीर्तिसञ्जननं श्रेष्ठं तडागानां निवेशनम्
verses.transliteration: athavA mitrasadane maitraM mitrArtivarjitam | kIrtisa~njananaM shreShThaM taDAgAnAM niveshanam
verses.translation: At the time of rising and setting of the moon waters flow and ebb. Hence in the bright and dark halves the waters vary in quantity; they increase and decrease.
