verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्यार्थस्य कामस्य फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः । तडागः सुकृतो येन तस्य पुण्यमनन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: dharmasyArthasya kAmasya phalamAhurmanIShiNaH | taDAgaH sukR^ito yena tasya puNyamanantakam
verses.translation: O great sage, the increase and decrease of the waters of the oceans are seen hundred and thousands of times. This has been mentioned to you.
verses.hindi: एवं अकालमृत्यु आदि कुछ नहीं होता है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O great sage, therefore, along with this universe the earth is fifty crores of Yojanas in extent inclusive of all the continents and mountains.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O great sage, therefore, along with this universe the earth is fifty crores of Yojanas in extent inclusive of all the continents and mountains.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । पुराणमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । तपस्तपति योऽरण्ये वन्यमूलफलाशनः । योऽधीते ऋचमेकां हि फलं स्यात्तत्समं मुने
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.13\. trayodasho.adhyAyaH | purANamAhAtmyavarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | tapastapati yo.araNye vanyamUlaphalAshanaH | yo.adhIte R^ichamekAM hi phalaM syAttatsamaM mune
verses.translation: The extent to which the rays of the sun and the moon shine and illuminate is the size of the earth. It is called Bhuloka.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयान्सर्वकामांश्च परत्रेह च जन्मनि । अश्वमेधमखस्यापि स फलं लभते पुमान्
verses.transliteration: akShayAnsarvakAmAMshcha paratreha cha janmani | ashvamedhamakhasyApi sa phalaM labhate pumAn
verses.translation: The sun's sphere is situated a hundred thousand Yojanas from the earth. The moon is situated thousands of Yojanas from this earth and a hundred thousand Yojanas from the sun.

verses.sanskrit: महीं ददाति यस्तस्मै कृष्टां फलवतीं शुभाम् । स तारयति वै वंश्यान्दश पूर्वान् दशापरान्
verses.transliteration: mahIM dadAti yastasmai kR^iShTAM phalavatIM shubhAm | sa tArayati vai vaMshyAndasha pUrvAn dashAparAn
verses.translation: The spheres of the planets are entirely situated above the moon along with the stars about ten thousand Yojanas one above the other.
verses.hindi: जो सुना था, उसे संक्षेपमें कह दिया

verses.sanskrit: इह भुक्त्वाखिलान् कामानन्ते दिव्यशरीरवान् । विमानेन च दिव्येन शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: iha bhuktvAkhilAn kAmAnante divyasharIravAn | vimAnena cha divyena shivalokaM sa gachChati
verses.translation: The sphere of the seven sages (The Ursa Major) is situated a hundred thousand Yojanas above it. The Pole Star (Dhruva) is situated a hundred thousand Yojanas above the sages.
verses.hindi: बलशाली वृषध्न हाथमें तलवार लेकर दौड़े

verses.sanskrit: न यज्ञैस्तुष्टिमायान्ति देवाः प्रोक्षणकैरपि । बलिभिः पुष्पपूजाभिर्यथा पुस्तकवाचनैः
verses.transliteration: na yaj~naistuShTimAyAnti devAH prokShaNakairapi | balibhiH puShpapUjAbhiryathA pustakavAchanaiH
verses.translation: The seven sons are—Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatana, Kapila, Asuri, Vohu and PaficaSikha.
verses.hindi: राजाको देखकर भयभीत हो भाग गया

verses.sanskrit: शम्भोरायतने यस्तु कारयेद्धर्मपुस्तकम् । विष्णोरर्कस्य कस्यापि शृणु तस्यापि तत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: shambhorAyatane yastu kArayeddharmapustakam | viShNorarkasya kasyApi shR^iNu tasyApi tatphalam
verses.translation: Two hundred thousand Yojanas above Jupiter, Saturn is stationed. These are the seven planets that stay in their respective zodiacs.
verses.hindi: व्याप्रको मरा जानकर अपने स्थानको लौट गये

verses.sanskrit: राजसूयाश्वमेधानां फलमाप्नोति मानवः । सूर्यलोकं च भित्त्वाशु ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: rAjasUyAshvamedhAnAM phalamApnoti mAnavaH | sUryalokaM cha bhittvAshu brahmalokaM sa gachChati
verses.translation: The seven sages (Ursa Major) are stationed eleven hundred thousand Yojanas above the planet Saturn. The Dhruva star is said to be stationed fourteen hundred thousand Yojanas above the great star.
verses.hindi: मरा हुआ देखा, तब वे बड़े दुखी हुए

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वा कल्पशतान्यत्र राजा भवति भूतले । भुङ्क्ते निष्कण्टकं भोगान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: sthitvA kalpashatAnyatra rAjA bhavati bhUtale | bhu~Nkte niShkaNTakaM bhogAnnAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: Eighty four thousand Yojanas from Tapoloka is stationed the Satyaloka. It is known as Brahmaloka where the pure-minded, perfectly wise Brahmacarins engaged in truthful virtue stay. Men who go there from the earth also stay there.
verses.hindi: इृह भुक्त्वा सुखं दिव्यं मुक्ति पाप सुदुर्लभाम्॥ ६१  सुख भोगकर परम दुर्लभ मुक्ति प्राप्त की

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य यत्फलं समुदाहृतम् । तत्फलं समावाप्नोति देवाग्रे यो जपं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: ashvamedhasahasrasya yatphalaM samudAhR^itam | tatphalaM samAvApnoti devAgre yo japaM charet
verses.translation: See P. 88 note.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीशिवयहाएुराणे पश्ञम्यायुमासंहितायां मनुनवपुत्रवशवर्णनं॑ नाम षट्ब्रिंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां शम्भोरायतने शुभे । नान्यत्प्रीतिकरं शम्भोस्तथान्येषां दिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: itihAsapurANAbhyAM shambhorAyatane shubhe | nAnyatprItikaraM shambhostathAnyeShAM divaukasAm
verses.translation: la the Bhuvarloka, the sages of great Siddhis stay in the form of gods. In the Svargaloka, the gods, the Adityas, the Maruts, the Vasus, the twin Alvins, Viivedevas, Rudras, Sadhyas, Nagas, Khagas etc. stay. Above that are the nine planets and above them are the seven sages free from sins.
verses.hindi: वशवर्णन नामक छत्तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कार्यं पुस्तकवाचनम् । तथास्य श्रवणं प्रेम्णा सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAtsarvaprayatnena kAryaM pustakavAchanam | tathAsya shravaNaM premNA sarvakAmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O sage, thus the seven worlds have been mentioned to you. The Patalas too are also seven. Thus the universe has been explained to you.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतेरध्ययनात्पुण्यं यदाप्नोति द्विजोत्तमः । तदध्यापनतश्चापि द्विगुणं फलमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: shruteradhyayanAtpuNyaM yadApnoti dvijottamaH | tadadhyApanatashchApi dviguNaM phalamashnute
verses.translation: It is surrounded by water ten times as large all round the fire, wind, ether and darkness. It is encom¬ passed by the elements and the principle of Mahat, eight times as large. There surrounded by the Mahat and Fra- dhana is stationed the Purusa. The supreme soul is infinite. He is therefore called eternal since he has no limitation.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणश्रवणात् शम्भोर्निष्पापो जायते नरः । भुक्त्वा भोगान् सुविपुलान् शिवलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: purANashravaNAt shambhorniShpApo jAyate naraH | bhuktvA bhogAn suvipulAn shivalokamavApnuyAt
verses.translation: This eternal is the cause of all. O sage, it is the great Prakrti. From that infinite of unmanifest origin thousands and hundreds of thousands of cosmic eggs are born. The self-known great soul contains everything just as the wood contains latent fire, the gingelly seed the latent oil and the milk the latent ghee. From this primor¬ dial seed emerge all those beginning with Mahat and ending with Vilena. Then the gods and others are born. Then are born birds, their progenies and the seeds of others.
verses.hindi: पुत्रा: पद्चद्श स्मृता:॥ ५  उसके पन्द्रह पुत्र कहे गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: राजसूयेन यत्पुण्यमग्निष्टोमशतेन च । तत्पुण्यं लभते शम्भोः कथाश्रवणमात्रतः
verses.transliteration: rAjasUyena yatpuNyamagniShTomashatena cha | tatpuNyaM labhate shambhoH kathAshravaNamAtrataH
verses.translation: When the tree comes out of seed it does not suffer any depreciation or diminution. Just as fire appears from the solar stone coming in contact of the sun so also the creation takes place. I§iva has no desire for it. As a result of the contact of Siva with Sakti, the gods and others are born naturally.
verses.hindi: लिये उसीमें शयन कर रहा है

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थावगाहेन गवां कोटिप्रदानतः । तत् फलं लभते शम्भोः कथाश्रवणतो मुने
verses.transliteration: sarvatIrthAvagAhena gavAM koTipradAnataH | tat phalaM labhate shambhoH kathAshravaNato mune
verses.translation: They spring up through their own action. Siva manifests himself as Branna, Vifu and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: ये शृण्वन्ति कथां शम्भोः सदा भुवनपावनीम् । ते मनुष्या न मन्तव्या रुद्रा एव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ye shR^iNvanti kathAM shambhoH sadA bhuvanapAvanIm | te manuShyA na mantavyA rudrA eva na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Every thing springs up from him and finally merges in him. Siva is sung as the performer of all activities.

verses.sanskrit: शृण्वतां शिवसत्कीर्तिं सतां कीर्तयतां च ताम् । पादाम्बुजरजांस्येव तीर्थानि मुनयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: shR^iNvatAM shivasatkIrtiM satAM kIrtayatAM cha tAm | pAdAmbujarajAMsyeva tIrthAni munayo viduH
verses.translation: O sage Sanatkumara, O omniscient, please clear my doubts. Are there worlds above this universe?

verses.sanskrit: गन्तुं निःश्रेयसं स्थानं येऽभिवाञ्छन्ति देहिनः । कथां पौराणिकीं शैवीं भक्त्या शृण्वन्तु ते सदा
verses.transliteration: gantuM niHshreyasaM sthAnaM ye.abhivA~nChanti dehinaH | kathAM paurANikIM shaivIM bhaktyA shR^iNvantu te sadA
verses.translation: O great sage, there are worlds above the universe. Please listen. I shall explain them clearly but briefly.
verses.hindi: कहते हुए उसकी प्रशंसा करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: कथां पौराणिकीं श्रोतुं यद्यशक्तः सदा भवेत् । नियतात्मा प्रतिदिनं शृणुयाद्वा मुहूर्तकम्
verses.transliteration: kathAM paurANikIM shrotuM yadyashaktaH sadA bhavet | niyatAtmA pratidinaM shR^iNuyAdvA muhUrtakam
verses.translation: Beyond that shines the excessively divine world of Uma, where l§akti—2§iva, the mother of the three deities shines.
verses.hindi: समसुद्रका जल भी ऊपर उठने लगता है

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रतिदिनं श्रोतुमशक्तो मानवो भवेत् । पुण्यमासादिषु मुने शृणुयाच्छाङ्करीं कथाम्
verses.transliteration: yadi pratidinaM shrotumashakto mAnavo bhavet | puNyamAsAdiShu mune shR^iNuyAchChA~NkarIM kathAm
verses.translation: The eternal Sivaloka is above that. Here lord Siva, the great Brahman, shines. He is indestructible, exces¬ sively divine and endowed with great brilliance. He is the lord of all, greater than the three attributes. He is the proge¬ nitor of the three deities.
verses.hindi: उस धुन्धु राक्षषके समीप पहुँच गया

verses.sanskrit: शैवीं कथां हि शृण्वानः पुरुषो हि मुनीश्वर । स निस्तरति संसारं दग्ध्वा कर्ममहाटवीम्
verses.transliteration: shaivIM kathAM hi shR^iNvAnaH puruSho hi munIshvara | sa nistarati saMsAraM dagdhvA karmamahATavIm
verses.translation: O dear, thus the situation of the entire universe is narrated to you. What more do you wish to hear about the position of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: कथां शैवीं मुहूर्तं वा तदर्धं वा क्षणं च वा । ये शृण्वन्ति नरा भक्त्या न तेषां दुर्गतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: kathAM shaivIM muhUrtaM vA tadardhaM vA kShaNaM cha vA | ye shR^iNvanti narA bhaktyA na teShAM durgatirbhavet
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, O the most excellent of the good, explain the acquisition of that by attaining which men endowed with devotion to Siva do not return again.
verses.hindi: हुआ, जो सदा धर्ममें संलग्न रहता था

verses.sanskrit: जगद्यथा निरालोकं जायतेऽशशिभास्करम् । विना तथा पुराणं ह्यध्येयमस्मान्मुने सदा
verses.transliteration: jagadyathA nirAlokaM jAyate.ashashibhAskaram | vinA tathA purANaM hyadhyeyamasmAnmune sadA
verses.translation: O Vyasa, son of Paraara, listen with pleasure to the auspicious salvation and the holy rite of pious devotees and the sacred rite of ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: यत्पुण्यं सर्वदानेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु वा मुने । शम्भोः पुराणश्रवणात्तत्फलं निश्चलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yatpuNyaM sarvadAneShu sarvayaj~neShu vA mune | shambhoH purANashravaNAttatphalaM nishchalaM bhavet
verses.translation: Those who perform holy rites, who are endowed with very pious penance and who always worship Siva should be honoured in every way always.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषतः कलौ व्यास पुराणश्रवणादृते । परो धर्मो न पुंसां हि मुक्तिध्यानपरः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: visheShataH kalau vyAsa purANashravaNAdR^ite | paro dharmo na puMsAM hi muktidhyAnaparaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Those who have not performed austerities do not go to Siva's region which is free from ailments. O great sage, penance alone leads to Siva's blessings.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणश्रवणं शम्भोर्नामसङ्कीर्तनं तथा । कल्पद्रुमफलं रम्यं मनुष्याणां न संशयः
verses.transliteration: purANashravaNaM shambhornAmasa~NkIrtanaM tathA | kalpadrumaphalaM ramyaM manuShyANAM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: The gods and Ganas rejoice in heaven due to penance. So also the sages and the ascetics. Know my statement to be true.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीश्षिकमहापुराणे अ्यम्यायुमासहितायां मनुवंशवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तत्रिशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: कलौ दुर्मेधसां पुंसां धर्माचारोज्झितात्मनाम् । हिताय विदधे शम्भुः पुराणाख्यं सुधारसम्
verses.transliteration: kalau durmedhasAM puMsAM dharmAchArojjhitAtmanAm | hitAya vidadhe shambhuH purANAkhyaM sudhArasam
verses.translation: Every thing can be achieved through penance, whether it is difficult to be sustained, or propitiated or is burdensome or difficult to be transgressed. Penance cannot be transgressed.

verses.sanskrit: एकोऽजरामरः स्याद्वै पिबन्नेवामृतं पुमान् । शम्भोः कथामृतापानात् कुलमेवाजरामरम्
verses.transliteration: eko.ajarAmaraH syAdvai pibannevAmR^itaM pumAn | shambhoH kathAmR^itApAnAt kulamevAjarAmaram
verses.translation: Brahma stays steady in his penance. So aNo Vi|nu and Siva. All the gods and the goddesses have attained rare benefits through penance.

verses.sanskrit: या गतिः पुण्यशीलानां यज्विनां च तपस्विनाम् । सा गतिः सहसा तात पुराणश्रवणात्खलु
verses.transliteration: yA gatiH puNyashIlAnAM yajvinAM cha tapasvinAm | sA gatiH sahasA tAta purANashravaNAtkhalu
verses.translation: Their result too is threefold, achievable by the

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानावाप्तिर्यदा न स्याद्योगशास्त्राणि यत्नतः । अध्येतव्यानि पौराणं शास्त्रं श्रोतव्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: j~nAnAvAptiryadA na syAdyogashAstrANi yatnataH | adhyetavyAni paurANaM shAstraM shrotavyameva cha
verses.translation: The Sattvika penance is the most excellent. It makes righteous intellect firm and steady. It has following characteristics—performance of ceremonial ablution, worship, Japa, sacrifice, scrupulous purity and cleanliness, non-violence, sacred rites, observance of fasts, silence, control of the sense- organs, pure intelligence, learning, truthfulness, refraining from anger, charitable gifts, forgiveness, suppression of the sense-organs, mercifulness, digging of wells, tanks and lakes, building of mansions for public cause observing Kfcchra, Candrayana and other rites, Yajrias, pilgrimages, hermitages, holy places and other acts pleasing to sensible persons. O Vyasa, good virtue is the cause of Siva's devotion. Cele¬ bration of the day of sun's transit, the conjunction of equinoxes the Nadamukta, Dhyana or meditation shall be in all the three occasions. It is the retention of the mind in the bril¬ liance. Pranayama is three-fold viz. Recaka, Puraka and Kumbhaka. This along with the knowledge of the course of the veins, withdrawal or obstruction of senses are the means of perfect knowledge and the achievement of the eight siddhis, Anima, etc.
verses.hindi: राज्य तथा अन्तःपुरकी रक्षा करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: पापं सङ्क्षीयते नित्यं धर्मश्चैव विवर्धते । पुराणश्रवणाज्ज्ञानी न संसारं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: pApaM sa~NkShIyate nityaM dharmashchaiva vivardhate | purANashravaNAjj~nAnI na saMsAraM prapadyate
verses.translation: In the state of trance there are various stages such as the stage of the log of wood, the stage of the dead and the stage of Harita. All these are destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: जानेपर भी मुनि वसिष्ठने मना नहीं किया था

verses.sanskrit: अतएव पुराणानि श्रोतव्यानि प्रयत्नतः । धर्मार्थकामलाभाय मोक्षमार्गाप्तये तथा
verses.transliteration: ataeva purANAni shrotavyAni prayatnataH | dharmArthakAmalAbhAya mokShamArgAptaye tathA
verses.translation: These five are the prosperities of royal glory- women, bed, drink, good garments unguents and incense, and the chewing of betel leaves.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञैर्दानैस्तपोभिस्तु यत्फलं तीर्थसेवया । तत्फलं समवाप्नोति पुराणश्रवणान्नरः
verses.transliteration: yaj~nairdAnaistapobhistu yatphalaM tIrthasevayA | tatphalaM samavApnoti purANashravaNAnnaraH
verses.translation: The forms of various pleasures arc—blocks of gold, copper, houses, gems, cows, scholarship in the Vedas and Sastras, ornaments, ability to sing and dance, conches, Vii;>as, Mrdangas, lordly elephants, umbrellas and chowrira. Man yearning for these takes delight in these.
verses.hindi: होकर उस त्रिशंकुको वर प्रदान किया

verses.sanskrit: तप्यमानं सदाज्ञानान्निरये योऽपि शास्त्रतः । सम्बोधयति लोकं तं तस्मात् पूज्यः पुराणगः
verses.transliteration: tapyamAnaM sadAj~nAnAnniraye yo.api shAstrataH | sambodhayati lokaM taM tasmAt pUjyaH purANagaH
verses.translation: O sage, but he does not know that these are only reflections in a mirror, not real substances. Just as the gingelly seeds are crushed to yield oil he gets himself crushed to yield things of pleasure. He madly rushes after them deluded by false knowledge. Some one seems to tell him, *'Go on quickly."

verses.sanskrit: न भवेयुः पुराणानि धर्ममार्गेक्षणानि तु । यद्यत्र यद् व्रती स्थाता कोऽत्र पारत्रिकीं कथाम्
verses.transliteration: na bhaveyuH purANAni dharmamArgekShaNAni tu | yadyatra yad vratI sthAtA ko.atra pAratrikIM kathAm
verses.translation: In spite of realising this he moves up and down in the world like the water-raising wheel. He takes various births in the mobile and immobile forms of life. He is distressed throughout.

verses.sanskrit: षड्विंशति पुराणानां मध्येऽप्येकं शृणोति यः । पठेद्वा भक्तियुक्तस्तु स मुक्तो नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: ShaDviMshati purANAnAM madhye.apyekaM shR^iNoti yaH | paThedvA bhaktiyuktastu sa mukto nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: After the transmigration through various forms of life ultimately he attains the rare human birth.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यो न दृष्टः सुखदो हि मार्गः पुराणमार्गो हि सदा वरिष्ठः । शास्त्रं विना सर्वमिदं न भाति सूर्येण हीना इव जीवलोकाः
verses.transliteration: anyo na dR^iShTaH sukhado hi mArgaH purANamArgo hi sadA variShThaH | shAstraM vinA sarvamidaM na bhAti sUryeNa hInA iva jIvalokAH
verses.translation: If anyone does not strive for salvation even after obtaining human birth which is capable of achieving heaven and salvation, surely he bemoans his lot for a long time, when dead.
verses.hindi: रहा हूँ, आप एकाग्रचित्त होकर सुनें

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां चैव पात्राणां मध्ये श्रेष्ठः पुराणवित् । पतनात् त्रायते यस्मात् तस्मात्पात्रमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarveShAM chaiva pAtrANAM madhye shreShThaH purANavit | patanAt trAyate yasmAt tasmAtpAtramudAhR^itam
verses.translation: Even to the god and the Asuras the birth as human being is very rare to be achieved. After attaining the same he should do such things as would prevent his fall in the hell.

verses.sanskrit: मर्त्यबुद्धिर्न कर्तव्या पुराणज्ञे कदाचन । पुराणज्ञः सर्ववेत्ता ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्हरो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: martyabuddhirna kartavyA purANaj~ne kadAchana | purANaj~naH sarvavettA brahmA viShNurharo guruH
verses.translation: Human birth has virtue as its root. It shall achieve all objects. Even if there is no endeavour to achieve any special aim after getting human birth at least one should preserve the root.

verses.sanskrit: धनं धान्यं हिरण्यं च वासांसि विविधानि च । देयं पुराणविज्ञाय परत्रेह च शर्मणे
verses.transliteration: dhanaM dhAnyaM hiraNyaM cha vAsAMsi vividhAni cha | deyaM purANavij~nAya paratreha cha sharmaNe
verses.translation: Who can be a more senseless man than one who does not strive for the welfare of the soul after attaining the rare birth as a brahmin in the course of human birth?

verses.sanskrit: यो ददाति महाप्रीत्या पुराणज्ञाय सज्जनः । पात्राय शुभवस्तूनि स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yo dadAti mahAprItyA purANaj~nAya sajjanaH | pAtrAya shubhavastUni sa yAti paramAM gatim
verses.translation: One should continue to perform virtuous rites as long as the health and normalcy of the body is maintained. A sick man is not eager to perform anything even when urged by others.

verses.sanskrit: महीं गां वा स्यन्दनांश्च गजानश्वांश्च शोभनान् । यः प्रयच्छति पात्राय तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: mahIM gAM vA syandanAMshcha gajAnashvAMshcha shobhanAn | yaH prayachChati pAtrAya tasya puNyaphalaM shR^iNu
verses.translation: If anyone does not try to achieve the permanent through the non-permanent body, the p>ermanent is lost for him and the non-permanent has already perished.'

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: A man who has taken the packet of fooding with him by virtue of giving charitable gifts, goes to Yama's abode without difficulty. Otherwise the creature suffers on the way without the packet of food.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: A man who has taken the packet of fooding with him by virtue of giving charitable gifts, goes to Yama's abode without difficulty. Otherwise the creature suffers on the way without the packet of food.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१४. चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः । सामान्यदानवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । शस्तानि घोरदानानि महादानानि नित्यशः । पात्रेभ्यस्तु प्रदेयानि आत्मानं तारयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.14\. chaturdasho.adhyAyaH | sAmAnyadAnavarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | shastAni ghoradAnAni mahAdAnAni nityashaH | pAtrebhyastu pradeyAni AtmAnaM tArayanti cha
verses.translation: O Kaleya, they gain at every step whose merits are full and perfect and who go to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्हि देवताः सर्वाः सुवर्णं च हुताशनः । तस्मात् सुवर्णं दत्त्वा च दत्ताः स्युः सर्वदेवताः
verses.transliteration: agnirhi devatAH sarvAH suvarNaM cha hutAshanaH | tasmAt suvarNaM dattvA cha dattAH syuH sarvadevatAH
verses.translation: Realising this, man should perform meritorious rites and avoid sinful activities. Thanks to the merit one attains godhood. A person devoid of merit goes to hell.
verses.hindi: काम्बोजोंका सारा सिर मुंडवाकर उन्हें छोड़ दिया

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्वीदानं महाश्रेष्ठं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् । सौवर्णं च विशेषेण यत्कृतं पृथुना पुरा
verses.transliteration: pR^ithvIdAnaM mahAshreShThaM sarvakAmaphalapradam | sauvarNaM cha visheSheNa yatkR^itaM pR^ithunA purA
verses.translation: They who take.refuge in Siva, lord of the gods, even slightly, do not see the terrible Yama nor the terrible hell.
verses.hindi: स्वाध्याय एवं वषट्कारसे रहित कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: दीयमानां प्रपश्यन्ति पृथ्वीं रुक्मसमन्विताम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: dIyamAnAM prapashyanti pR^ithvIM rukmasamanvitAm | sarvapApavinirmuktAste yAnti paramAM gatim
verses.translation: But at the behest of Siva, due to sins and great delusions, those men stay there for sometime and then go to the region of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यच्च प्रवक्ष्यामि दानं सर्वोत्तमं मुने । कान्तारं यन्न पश्यन्ति यमस्य बहुदुःखदम्
verses.transliteration: athAnyachcha pravakShyAmi dAnaM sarvottamaM mune | kAntAraM yanna pashyanti yamasya bahuduHkhadam
verses.translation: The verse with slight variations occurs in Pane. MitraprApti (Verse 141).
verses.hindi: दति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पद्चम्यायुमासंहितायां सत्यव्रतादिसगरपर्यन्तवंशवर्णन॑ नामाष्टात्रिशों5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात् कान्तारदानं हि विधिना शुद्धमानसः । न्यायार्जितेन द्रव्येण वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: kuryAt kAntAradAnaM hi vidhinA shuddhamAnasaH | nyAyArjitena dravyeNa vittashAThyavivarjitaH
verses.translation: But those who have taken refuge in lord Siva wholly are not smeared with sin like the leaf of the lotus with water.

verses.sanskrit: तिलप्रस्थमयीं कृत्वा धेनुं सर्वगुणान्विताम् । धेनुवत्सं सुवर्णं च सुदिव्यं सर्वलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tilaprasthamayIM kR^itvA dhenuM sarvaguNAnvitAm | dhenuvatsaM suvarNaM cha sudivyaM sarvalakShaNam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, they who repeat the names of Siva need not be afraid of hell or Yama.

verses.sanskrit: पद्ममष्टदलं कृत्वा कुङ्कुमाक्ताक्षतैः शुभैः । पूजयेत्तत्र रुद्रादीन्सर्वान्देवान्सुभक्तितः
verses.transliteration: padmamaShTadalaM kR^itvA ku~NkumAktAkShataiH shubhaiH | pUjayettatra rudrAdInsarvAndevAnsubhaktitaH
verses.translation: The two syllables **Siva** constitute the packet of fooding for the journey to the other world; it is the means of salvation, free from worries and is the abode of all merits.
verses.hindi: अलग सभी बालक बीजरूपसे वर्तमान थे

verses.sanskrit: एवं सम्पूज्य तां दद्याद् ब्राह्मणाय स्वशक्तितः । सरत्नां सहिरण्यां च सर्वाभरणभूषिताम्
verses.transliteration: evaM sampUjya tAM dadyAd brAhmaNAya svashaktitaH | saratnAM sahiraNyAM cha sarvAbharaNabhUShitAm
verses.translation: Formerly Pulkaa committed thousands of murders of Brahmins but on hearing the sacred name Siva, he attained salvation.
verses.hindi: पंचजन नामक पुत्र बादमें राजा हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ततो नक्तं समश्नीयाद्दीपान् दद्यात्तु विस्तरात् । कार्तिक्यामिति कर्तव्यं पूर्णिमायां प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tato naktaM samashnIyAddIpAn dadyAttu vistarAt | kArtikyAmiti kartavyaM pUrNimAyAM prayatnataH
verses.translation: Hence a sensible man shall enhance his devotion to Siva incessantly. O intelligent one, one attains worldly pleasures and salvation due to the devotion to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं यः कुरुते सम्यग्विधानेन स्वशक्तितः । यममार्गभयं घोरं नरकं च न पश्यति
verses.transliteration: evaM yaH kurute samyagvidhAnena svashaktitaH | yamamArgabhayaM ghoraM narakaM cha na pashyati
verses.translation: O Kaleya, men fall off their status due to evil deeds. Hence, after attaining the high status, the learned man shall preserve it.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यदानं गोदानं भूमिदानं द्विजोत्तम । गृह्णन्तो वै पवित्राणि तारयन्ति स्वमेव तम्
verses.transliteration: hiraNyadAnaM godAnaM bhUmidAnaM dvijottama | gR^ihNanto vai pavitrANi tArayanti svameva tam
verses.translation: Cp. Rv. X. QO. I8

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पापान्यशेषाणि सबन्धुः ससुहृज्जनः । दिवि सङ्क्रीडते व्यास यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA pApAnyasheShANi sabandhuH sasuhR^ijjanaH | divi sa~NkrIDate vyAsa yAvadindrAshchaturdasha
verses.translation: Due to his resorting to evil, the foolish fellow goes

verses.sanskrit: विधितो गोश्च दानं वै सर्वोत्तममिह स्मृतम् । न तेन सदृशं व्यास परं दानं प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: vidhito goshcha dAnaM vai sarvottamamiha smR^itam | na tena sadR^ishaM vyAsa paraM dAnaM prakIrtitam
verses.translation: Hence after attaining the highest status one should not err or destroy it. Even in the face of adversity one shall always preserve his status.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयच्छते यः कपिलां सवत्सां स्वर्णशृङ्गिकाम् । कांस्यपात्रां रौप्यखुरां सर्वलक्षणलक्षिताम्
verses.transliteration: prayachChate yaH kapilAM savatsAM svarNashR^i~NgikAm | kAMsyapAtrAM raupyakhurAM sarvalakShaNalakShitAm
verses.translation: After attaining the auspicious brahminhood if a person disrespects brahminhood and does not differentiate between what could be eaten and what could not be eaten he becomes a Katriya.
verses.hindi: पुण्डरीक और उनके पुत्र क्षेमधन्वा कहे गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तैर्गुणैः कामदुघा भूत्वा सा गौरुपैति तम् । प्रदातारं नरं व्यास परत्रेह च जन्मनि
verses.transliteration: taistairguNaiH kAmadughA bhUtvA sA gaurupaiti tam | pradAtAraM naraM vyAsa paratreha cha janmani
verses.translation: I shall explain to you entirely that which gives a higher caste whereby an intelligent 8udra becomes a Vaiya.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यदिष्टतमं लोके तदस्ति दयितं गृहे । तत्तद् गुणवते देयं तदेवाक्षयमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: yadyadiShTatamaM loke tadasti dayitaM gR^ihe | tattad guNavate deyaM tadevAkShayamichChatA
verses.translation: Being born a 8udra, one shall take up the duties of 8udra as ordained, viz, the due service to the people of the other three castes.
verses.hindi: हुआ। बलके पुत्रका नाम स्थल था

verses.sanskrit: तुलापुरुषदानं हि दानानां दानमुत्तमम् । तुलासंरोहणं कार्यं यदीच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः
verses.transliteration: tulApuruShadAnaM hi dAnAnAM dAnamuttamam | tulAsaMrohaNaM kAryaM yadIchChechChreya AtmanaH
verses.translation: Strictly observing his rites, speaking truth and controlling the sense-organs he derives vast pleasures of heaven. He becomes a favourite of the gods.
verses.hindi: जायगा और पुन: ब्राह्म सत्ययुगमें बढ़ेगा

verses.sanskrit: यत्कृत्वा मुच्यते पापैर्वधबन्धकृतोद्भवैः । तुलादानं महत्पुण्यं सर्वपापक्षयङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: yatkR^itvA muchyate pApairvadhabandhakR^itodbhavaiH | tulAdAnaM mahatpuNyaM sarvapApakShaya~Nkaram
verses.translation: O great sage, brahminhood is very difiicult to achieve. It is attained by men who undergo hardships.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पापान्यशेषाणि तुलादानं करोति यः । सर्वैस्तु पातकैर्मुक्तः स दिवं यात्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA pApAnyasheShANi tulAdAnaM karoti yaH | sarvaistu pAtakairmuktaH sa divaM yAtyasaMshayam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, you have mentioned about the glory. O foremost among the eloquent, I wish to hear this. Please men don.
verses.hindi: प्रजावानेति सायुज्यमिह भुक्त्वा सुखं परम्॥ ४६  करता है

verses.sanskrit: पापं कृतं यद्दिवसे निशायां द्विसन्ध्ययोर्मध्यदिने निशान्ते । कालत्रये कायमनोवचोभिः तुलापुमान्वै तदपाकरोति
verses.transliteration: pApaM kR^itaM yaddivase nishAyAM dvisandhyayormadhyadine nishAnte | kAlatraye kAyamanovachobhiH tulApumAnvai tadapAkaroti
verses.translation: The hero who offers battle subduing the army of the enemy attains virtue, wealth and fame. He achieves the fruit of a sacrifice with due gifts and the three aims of life, virtue, wealth and love. He who faces the enemy, kills him and gets on to the enemy's chariot goes to Vinuloka. He who is not defeated in war, nor killed in it attains the fruit of four horse-sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: बालेन वृद्धेन मया हि यूना विजानता ज्ञानपरेण पापम् । तत्सर्वमेवाशु कृतं मदीयं तुलापुमान् वै हरतु स्मरारिः
verses.transliteration: bAlena vR^iddhena mayA hi yUnA vijAnatA j~nAnapareNa pApam | tatsarvamevAshu kR^itaM madIyaM tulApumAn vai haratu smarAriH
verses.translation: He who dies in the war-front without surrender¬ ing his weapons attains heaven from which there is no return.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णदानं गोदानं पृथिवीदानमेव च । एतानि श्रेष्ठदानानि कृत्वा पापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: suvarNadAnaM godAnaM pR^ithivIdAnameva cha | etAni shreShThadAnAni kR^itvA pApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: The king, or prince or the general who heroically fights and is killed by Katriya attains everlasting regions.
verses.hindi: एक सन्देह है, उसे मैं आपके समक्ष कहता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: पात्रे प्रयुक्तं द्रविणं मयाद्य प्रमाणपूर्णं निहितं तुलायाम् । तेनैव सार्धं तु ममावशेषं कृताकृतं यत्सुकृतं समेतु
verses.transliteration: pAtre prayuktaM draviNaM mayAdya pramANapUrNaM nihitaM tulAyAm | tenaiva sArdhaM tu mamAvasheShaM kR^itAkR^itaM yatsukR^itaM sametu
verses.translation: He attains as many worlds as the number of his hairs split by arrows in the battle. All of these will be wish-yielding and eternal.
verses.hindi: अपने वंशजका निरन्तर कल्याण करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एवमुच्चार्य तं दद्यात् द्विजेभ्यः सर्वदा हितः । नैकस्यापि प्रदातव्यं न निस्तारस्ततो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | evamuchchArya taM dadyAt dvijebhyaH sarvadA hitaH | naikasyApi pradAtavyaM na nistArastato bhavet
verses.translation: O Vyasa, both here and hereafter he will have heroic seat, heroic bed, heroic status and heroic stability always.
verses.hindi: यह सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: ददात्येवं तु यो व्यास तुलापुरुषमुत्तमम् । हत्वा पापं दिव्यं तिष्ठेद्यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: dadAtyevaM tu yo vyAsa tulApuruShamuttamam | hatvA pApaM divyaM tiShThedyAvadindrAshchaturdasha
verses.translation: Those who die for the protection of cows, brah¬ mins, status and the master go happily to the other woild like virtuous persons.*
verses.hindi: नहीं होता, इसे मैं सुनना चाहता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: तुलादानानि शस्तानि गावः पृथ्वी सरस्वती । द्वे तु तुल्यबले शस्ते ह्यधिका च सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: tulAdAnAni shastAni gAvaH pR^ithvI sarasvatI | dve tu tulyabale shaste hyadhikA cha sarasvatI
verses.translation: Even a slayer of a brahmin fighting for his master
verses.hindi: सुनाते हुए प्रेमपूर्वक्क्‍ यह वचन कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: नित्य ह्यनुडुहो गावच्छत्रं वस्त्रमुपानहौ । देयानि याचमानेभ्यः पानमन्नं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: nitya hyanuDuho gAvachChatraM vastramupAnahau | deyAni yAchamAnebhyaH pAnamannaM tathaiva cha
verses.translation: The goal realised by the person who dies for the brahmins, cows and his master, being killed by carnivorous beasts or tusked beasts is excellent. It yields him extensive and never>ending benefits.
verses.hindi: मुझसे कहा है, उसे आपसे मैं कह रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्पविहितो योऽर्थो ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदीयते । अर्थिभ्योऽपीडितेभ्यश्च मनस्वी तेन जायते
verses.transliteration: sa~Nkalpavihito yo.artho brAhmaNebhyaH pradIyate | arthibhyo.apIDitebhyashcha manasvI tena jAyate
verses.translation: A man may be competent to perform hundreds of sacrifices, but it is very difficult to renounce his own body in a righteous war.

verses.sanskrit: कनकं च तिला नागाः कन्या दासी गृहं रथः । मणयः कपिला गावो महादानानि वै दश
verses.transliteration: kanakaM cha tilA nAgAH kanyA dAsI gR^ihaM rathaH | maNayaH kapilA gAvo mahAdAnAni vai dasha
verses.translation: Now I shall explain clearly the eternal virtue concerning war, as to who can be attacked and hit and who shall be spared.
verses.hindi: उत्तम वर देता हूँ, तुम उसे ग्रहण करो

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वैतानि सर्वाणि ब्राह्मणो ज्ञानवित्सदा । वदान्यांस्तारयेत्सद्यो ह्यात्मानं च न संशयः
verses.transliteration: gR^ihItvaitAni sarvANi brAhmaNo j~nAnavitsadA | vadAnyAMstArayetsadyo hyAtmAnaM cha na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Even if a brahmin well-versed in Vedanta doctrine were to attack one violently with lethal weapons one can fight him in return. He will not become guilty of brahmini- cide thereby.®**
verses.hindi: तद् बूहि भरतश्रेष्ठ यत्ते मनसि वर्तते॥२८  उसे माँगो

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णं ये प्रयच्छन्ति नराः शुद्धेन चेतसा । देवतास्तं प्रयच्छन्ति समन्तादिति मे श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: suvarNaM ye prayachChanti narAH shuddhena chetasA | devatAstaM prayachChanti samantAditi me shrutam
verses.translation: Even a murderer shall not be attacked and killed if he is thirsty and begs for water. O Vyasa, by killing the sick and the distressed even in battle a man becomes guilty of brahminicide.
verses.hindi: पूछता हूँ, आप उसका उत्तर दें

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: After considering all this, an intelligent man shall strenuously indulge in battles. He will achieve the purpose of his life and rejoice here and hereafter.
verses.hindi: मैंने राजासे पूछा, तब वे उसे कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: After considering all this, an intelligent man shall strenuously indulge in battles. He will achieve the purpose of his life and rejoice here and hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१५. पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः । पाताललोकवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । येनैकेन हि दत्तेन सर्वेषां प्राप्यते फलम् । दानानां तन्ममाख्याहि मानुषाणां हितार्थतः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.15\. pa~nchadasho.adhyAyaH | pAtAlalokavarNanam | vyAsa uvAcha | yenaikena hi dattena sarveShAM prApyate phalam | dAnAnAM tanmamAkhyAhi mAnuShANAM hitArthataH
verses.translation: According to the laws of the caste as laid down in the DharmaSistras, the profession of hghting is assigned exclusively to the people of Katriya caste. But 3 P. probably following the contemporary practice allows it for all the castes.
verses.hindi: अन्दरसे आते हुए किसी विशाल विमानको देखा

verses.sanskrit: पातालानि तु सप्तैव भुवनानि तथोर्ध्वतः । उच्छ्रायो द्विगुणस्तस्य जलमध्ये स्थितस्य च
verses.transliteration: pAtAlAni tu saptaiva bhuvanAni tathordhvataH | uchChrAyo dviguNastasya jalamadhye sthitasya cha
verses.translation: Cp. Manu viii, 350, 35*.
verses.hindi: अग्निके समान तेजोमय प्रतीत हो रहा था

verses.sanskrit: तस्याधारः स्थितो नागः स च विष्णुः प्रकीर्तितः । ब्रह्मणो वचसां हेतोर्बिभर्ति सकलं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: tasyAdhAraH sthito nAgaH sa cha viShNuH prakIrtitaH | brahmaNo vachasAM hetorbibharti sakalaM tvidam
verses.translation: O dear, O great sage, for realizing the worldly detachment please mention the detailed mode of the birth of living beings and their stay in the womb.
verses.hindi: यह मेरा नाम कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: शेषस्यास्य गुणान् वक्तुं न शक्ता देवदानवाः । योऽनन्तः पठ्यते सिद्धैर्देवर्षिगणपूजितः
verses.transliteration: sheShasyAsya guNAn vaktuM na shaktA devadAnavAH | yo.anantaH paThyate siddhairdevarShigaNapUjitaH
verses.translation: O Vyasa, listen succinctly to the essence of the sacred lore. I shall explain the excellent mode of worldly detachment which removes the bondage with the world, of a man desirous of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: शिरः सहस्रयुक्तः स सर्वा विद्योतयन्दिशः । फणामणिसहस्रेण स्वस्तिकामलभूषणः
verses.transliteration: shiraH sahasrayuktaH sa sarvA vidyotayandishaH | phaNAmaNisahasreNa svastikAmalabhUShaNaH
verses.translation: When we cook rice the process is as follows. In the cooking vessel the rice and water remain separate. Water is above fire. The rice is above water. The wind slowly blows against the fire beneath the water. The fre kindled by the wind makes the water boil.

verses.sanskrit: मदाघूर्णितनेत्रोऽसौ साग्निः श्वेत इवाचलः । स्रग्वी किरीटी ह्याभाति यः सदैवैककुण्डलः
verses.transliteration: madAghUrNitanetro.asau sAgniH shveta ivAchalaH | sragvI kirITI hyAbhAti yaH sadaivaikakuNDalaH
verses.translation: The rice with hot-boiling water all round it be¬ comes cooked. When cooked it becomes separated into sediment and juice.
verses.hindi: तुमलोग पितर होओगे, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: साभ्रगङ्गाप्रवाहेण श्वेतशैलोपशोभितः । नीलवासा मदोद्रिक्तः कैलासाद्रिरिवापरः
verses.transliteration: sAbhraga~NgApravAheNa shvetashailopashobhitaH | nIlavAsA madodriktaH kailAsAdririvAparaH
verses.translation: (More or less a similar process takes place in the body.) The sediment in the body consists of twelve forms of waste matter. These are split and sent out of the body. The juice matter circulates in the body. Man gets nourished through it.

verses.sanskrit: लाङ्गलासक्तहस्ताग्रो बिभ्रन्मुसलमुत्तमम् । योऽर्च्यते नागकन्याभिः स्वर्णवर्णाभिरादरात्
verses.transliteration: lA~NgalAsaktahastAgro bibhranmusalamuttamam | yo.archyate nAgakanyAbhiH svarNavarNAbhirAdarAt
verses.translation: The ears, the eyes, the nose, the tongue, the teeth, the penis, the anus, and the nails are the receptacles of dirt secreted by them. The phlegm, the sweat, the fiateces and the urine—these together make up the twelve.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां श्राद्धकल्पे पितृप्रभाववर्णन॑ नाम चत्वारिशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कर्षणात्मको रुद्रो विषानलशिखोज्ज्वलः । कल्पान्ते निष्क्रमन्ते यद्वक्त्रेभ्योऽग्निशिखा मुहुः । दग्ध्वा जगत्त्रयं शान्ता भवन्तीत्यनुशुश्रुमः
verses.transliteration: sa~NkarShaNAtmako rudro viShAnalashikhojjvalaH | kalpAnte niShkramante yadvaktrebhyo.agnishikhA muhuH | dagdhvA jagattrayaM shAntA bhavantItyanushushrumaH
verses.translation: All the vessels scattered all over the body are joined centrally at the heart. These vessels shall be under¬ stood to convey Rasa. O sage, I shall mention their process of working.
verses.hindi: पितृप्रभाववर्णन नामक चालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते पातालमूलस्थः सशेषः क्षितिमण्डलम् । बिभ्रत्स्वपृष्ठे भूतेशः शेषोऽशेषगुणार्चितः
verses.transliteration: Aste pAtAlamUlasthaH sasheShaH kShitimaNDalam | bibhratsvapR^iShThe bhUteshaH sheSho.asheShaguNArchitaH
verses.translation: Praa (the vital air) places the subtle lymph at the mouths of the vessels, llien it fills the entire vessels with the lymph,

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वीर्यप्रभावश्च साकाङ्क्षैस्त्रिदशैरपि । न हि वर्णयितुं शक्यः स्वरूपं ज्ञातुमेव वा
verses.transliteration: tasya vIryaprabhAvashcha sAkA~NkShaistridashairapi | na hi varNayituM shakyaH svarUpaM j~nAtumeva vA
verses.translation: Thus filled, the vessels circulate all over the

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । शृणु काले प्रदत्ताद्वै फलं विन्दन्ति मानवाः । एकस्मादपि सर्वेषां दानानां तद्वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | shR^iNu kAle pradattAdvai phalaM vindanti mAnavAH | ekasmAdapi sarveShAM dAnAnAM tadvadAmi te
verses.translation: The hair of the body and flesh are produced from the blood. The hair on the head and the sinews arc produced from the flesh. From the sinews the bones are produced. The nails and marrow are produced from the bones.
verses.hindi: दृष्टि देकर शीघ्र ही योगगतिको प्राप्त हो गये

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते कुसुममालेव फणामणिशिखारुणा । यस्यैषा सकला पृथ्वी कस्तद्वीर्यं वदिष्यति
verses.transliteration: Aste kusumamAleva phaNAmaNishikhAruNA | yasyaiShA sakalA pR^ithvI kastadvIryaM vadiShyati
verses.translation: An alternative cause of marrow, the semen itself becomes progeny. Thus the twelvefold ihetabolism of bood is explained.
verses.hindi: अनुसार कार्य भी किया करते थे

verses.sanskrit: यदा विजृम्भतेऽनन्तो मदाघूर्णितलोचनः । तदा चलति भूरेषा साद्रितोयाधिकानना
verses.transliteration: yadA vijR^imbhate.ananto madAghUrNitalochanaH | tadA chalati bhUreShA sAdritoyAdhikAnanA
verses.translation: The semen is secreted from the food eaten From the semen, the birth of another body is made possible. When the semen unalloyed is deposited in the vaginal passage during the prescribed period of cohabitation after the monthly menses, then the semen blown by the vital wind mingles with the blood of the woman. At the time when the semen is discharged the individual soul with the causal body or unit of sense-organs etc. enters the vaginal passage fully covered and urged by its past actions. The semen and blood in the unified state become foetus in a day.
verses.hindi: चराते-चराते वे अन्यायमें प्रवत्त हो गये

verses.sanskrit: दशसाहस्रमेकैकं पातालं मुनिसत्तम । अतलं वितलं चैव सुतलं च रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: dashasAhasramekaikaM pAtAlaM munisattama | atalaM vitalaM chaiva sutalaM cha rasAtalam
verses.translation: In five nights the foetus assumes the shape cf bubbles and the bubbly mass becomes muscuiar mass in seven nights.
verses.hindi: बचानेमें भी वे दोनों समर्थ नहीं हो सके

verses.sanskrit: तलं तलातलं चाग्र्यं पातालं सप्तमं मतम् । भूमेरधः सप्तलोका इमे ज्ञेया विचक्षणैः
verses.transliteration: talaM talAtalaM chAgryaM pAtAlaM saptamaM matam | bhUmeradhaH saptalokA ime j~neyA vichakShaNaiH
verses.translation: Within two months the following parts oi the body are formulated in order Viz. the neck, the head the shoulders, the backbone, the belly, hands and feet, the sides the lips etc. Within three months all the joints are completed.
verses.hindi: प्रकुर्वन्तो हि श्राद्ध तु सर्व एवं समाहिता:॥ १७  करो

verses.sanskrit: उच्छ्रायो द्विगुणश्चैषां सर्वेषां रत्नभूमयः । रत्नवन्तोऽथ प्रासादा भूमयो हेमसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: uchChrAyo dviguNashchaiShAM sarveShAM ratnabhUmayaH | ratnavanto.atha prAsAdA bhUmayo hemasambhavAH
verses.translation: Within the fourth month the fingers are duly formed. The mouth, nose, and cars are ready within the fifth month.
verses.hindi: हमलोगोंको वधजन्य अधर्म भी नहीं होगा

verses.sanskrit: तेषु दानवदैतेया नागानां जातयस्तथा । निवसन्ति महानागा राक्षसा दैत्यसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: teShu dAnavadaiteyA nAgAnAM jAtayastathA | nivasanti mahAnAgA rAkShasA daityasambhavAH
verses.translation: Within six months the row of teeth, the private parts and the nails and the orifice of the cars take shape.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध किया और उसे उपयोगमें ले लिया

verses.sanskrit: प्राह स्वर्गसदोमध्ये पातालानीति नारदः । स्वर्लोकादति रम्याणि तेभ्योऽसावागतो दिवि
verses.transliteration: prAha svargasadomadhye pAtAlAnIti nAradaH | svarlokAdati ramyANi tebhyo.asAvAgato divi
verses.translation: The rectum, or the penis of the vaginal passage and the navel too arc formulated* Within the seventh

verses.sanskrit: नानाभूषणभूषाश्च मणयो यत्र सुप्रभाः । आह्लादकारिणः शुभ्राः पातालं केन तत्समम्
verses.transliteration: nAnAbhUShaNabhUShAshcha maNayo yatra suprabhAH | AhlAdakAriNaH shubhrAH pAtAlaM kena tatsamam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, thus the complete child with all the limbs stays in the womb covered by the embryonic skin.

verses.sanskrit: पाताले कस्य न प्रीतिरितश्चेतश्च शोभिते । देत्यदानवकन्याभिर्विमुक्तस्याभिजायते
verses.transliteration: pAtAle kasya na prItiritashchetashcha shobhite | detyadAnavakanyAbhirvimuktasyAbhijAyate
verses.translation: The child increases and develops day by day, stealthily taking in the food of the mother, of all the six tastes, through the umbilical cord.

verses.sanskrit: दिवार्करश्मयो यत्र न भवन्ति विधोर्निशि । न शीतमातपो यत्र मणितेजोऽत्र केवलम्
verses.transliteration: divArkarashmayo yatra na bhavanti vidhornishi | na shItamAtapo yatra maNitejo.atra kevalam
verses.translation: Then the soul complete in this body recollects all the pleasures and sorrows and every thing done by it former¬ ly as if in a dream.
verses.hindi: मनस्वी तथा धर्मप्रवीण सात पुत्र हुए्

verses.sanskrit: दानानामुत्तमं दानं ब्रह्माण्डं खलु मानवैः । दातव्यं मुक्तिकामैस्तु संसारोत्तारणाय वै
verses.transliteration: dAnAnAmuttamaM dAnaM brahmANDaM khalu mAnavaiH | dAtavyaM muktikAmaistu saMsArottAraNAya vai
verses.translation: "I am dead and born many times In these different births I have seen many types of wombs.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त होकर वहीं विहार करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोज्यान्नपानानि भुज्यन्ते मुदितैर्भृशम् । यत्र न ज्ञायते कालो गतोऽपि मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: bhakShyabhojyAnnapAnAni bhujyante muditairbhR^isham | yatra na j~nAyate kAlo gato.api munisattama
verses.translation: This time when I am born and consecrated I shall strive for welfare by means of this body so that I may not have to stay in another womb in future.
verses.hindi: तथा क्षमाशील हो वनमें विचरण करते थे

verses.sanskrit: पुंस्कोकिलरुतं यत्र पद्मानि कमलाकराः । नद्यः सरांसि रम्याणि मनोज्ञान्यम्बराणि च
verses.transliteration: puMskokilarutaM yatra padmAni kamalAkarAH | nadyaH sarAMsi ramyANi manoj~nAnyambarANi cha
verses.translation: So thinks the child in the womb "As soon as 1 am released from this womb I shall seek Siva's perfect knowledge that repels all worldly existence."
verses.hindi: होनेके लिये उसीको बुद्धिमें रखते थे

verses.sanskrit: भूषणान्यतिशुभ्राणि गन्धाढ्यं चानुलेपनम् । वीणावेणुमृदङ्गानां स्वना गेयानि च द्विज
verses.transliteration: bhUShaNAnyatishubhrANi gandhADhyaM chAnulepanam | vINAveNumR^ida~NgAnAM svanA geyAni cha dvija
verses.translation: Troubled and tormented by the distress in the womb as a result of his past actions the individual soul stays there pondering over the means of liberation.
verses.hindi: तथा अशुभ दोनोंसे मुक्त हो गये

verses.sanskrit: दैत्योरगैश्च भुज्यन्ते पाताले वै सुखानि च । तपसा समवाप्नोति दानवैः सिद्धमानवैः
verses.transliteration: daityoragaishcha bhujyante pAtAle vai sukhAni cha | tapasA samavApnoti dAnavaiH siddhamAnavaiH
verses.translation: Just as a traveller surrounded by huge impassable mountains on all sides stands helplessly in his distress, so also the creature in the womb enveloped by the embryonic skin stays miserably.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डे सकले दत्ते यत्फलं लभते नरः । तदेकभावादाप्नोति सप्तलोकाधिपो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmANDe sakale datte yatphalaM labhate naraH | tadekabhAvAdApnoti saptalokAdhipo bhavet
verses.translation: For him staying inside the womb the misery is equal to, nay, more than the misery of a person incessantly pierced by means of redhot needles.

verses.sanskrit: यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ नभसि वा यावत् स्थिरा मेदिनी तावत्सोऽपि नरः स्वबान्धवयुतः स्वर्गौकसामोकसि । सर्वेष्वेव मनोनुगेषु ककुभिर्ब्रह्माण्डदः क्रीडते पश्चाद्याति पदं सुदुर्लभतरं देवैर्मुदे माधवम्
verses.transliteration: yAvachchandradivAkarau nabhasi vA yAvat sthirA medinI tAvatso.api naraH svabAndhavayutaH svargaukasAmokasi | sarveShveva manonugeShu kakubhirbrahmANDadaH krIDate pashchAdyAti padaM sudurlabhataraM devairmude mAdhavam
verses.translation: Getting crushed in the vaginal passage as if with¬ in a machine is a misery more grievous than the stay within the womb. O VySsa, this takes place in regard to dic sinnen and not the virtuous.
verses.hindi: छिद्रदर्शक, स्वतन्त्र और सुयज्ञ नामवाले हुए

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । भगवन् ब्रहि ब्रह्माण्डं यत्प्रमाणं यदात्मकम् । यदाधारं यथाभूतं येन मे प्रत्ययो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | bhagavan brahi brahmANDaM yatpramANaM yadAtmakam | yadAdhAraM yathAbhUtaM yena me pratyayo bhavet
verses.translation: Just as the gingelly seeds pressed in the oil machine become a worthless residue, so also the body becomes a waste being crushed by the muscular walls of the vaginal passage.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । मुने शृणु प्रवक्ष्यामि यदुत्सेधं तु विस्तरम् । ब्रह्माण्डं तत्तु सङ्क्षेपाच्छ्रुत्वा पापात्प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | mune shR^iNu pravakShyAmi yadutsedhaM tu vistaram | brahmANDaM tattu sa~NkShepAchChrutvA pApAtpramuchyate
verses.translation: This body in the womb is in an unenviable position. The hands and legs are like suspended pillars. Sinews tie them up in various ways. The whole body is smeared with dirty blood and flesh. It is the receptacle of faeces and urine. It is covered with hairs and nails. It is sickly and an abode of ailments. The only great opening is the mouth. It has eight small apertures like windows. The two lips are like two doors. The tongue is the bolt for them. The body is sick due to its thirst for pleasures. It is subservient to passion and hatred and utterly deluded. The various limbs overlap one another. It is surrounded by the embryonic membrane. With very great pain and difficulty it has to come out of the vaginal passage. It is drenched with urine, blood and faeces. It comes out as from a sheath. It is a mass of skeleton.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारे प्रिय तथा हितैषी मन्त्री होवें

verses.sanskrit: यत्तत्कारणमव्यक्तं व्यक्तं शिवमनामयम् । तस्मात्सञ्जायते ब्रह्मा द्विधाभूताद्धि कालतः
verses.transliteration: yattatkAraNamavyaktaM vyaktaM shivamanAmayam | tasmAtsa~njAyate brahmA dvidhAbhUtAddhi kAlataH
verses.translation: The bones are three hundred and sixty in number. There are five hundred muscles. The body is covered with thirtyfive million hairs.
verses.hindi: मन्त्री होनेके लिये अपनी बात की थी

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डं सृजति ब्रह्मा चतुर्दशभवात्मकम् । तद्वच्मि क्रमतस्तात समासाच्छृणु यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: brahmANDaM sR^ijati brahmA chaturdashabhavAtmakam | tadvachmi kramatastAta samAsAchChR^iNu yatnataH
verses.translation: The hairs are subtle and gross, visible and in¬ visible. The veins and vessels within the body too are so many in number.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O Vyasa, O highly intelligent sage, listen to the impurity of the body and the greatness of good feelings. I shall explain briefly.
verses.hindi: तब उनमेंसे सुमना नामक पक्षी बोला--

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O Vyasa, O highly intelligent sage, listen to the impurity of the body and the greatness of good feelings. I shall explain briefly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१६. षोडशोऽध्यायः । नरकोद्धारवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । तेषां मूर्धोपरिष्टाद्वै नरकांस्तान् श्रुणुष्व च । मत्तो मुनिवरश्रेष्ठ पच्यन्ते यत्र पापिनः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.16\. ShoDasho.adhyAyaH | narakoddhAravarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | teShAM mUrdhopariShTAdvai narakAMstAn shruNuShva cha | matto munivarashreShTha pachyante yatra pApinaH
verses.translation: Just as a pot, full of faeces cannot become pure even when washed outside, so alsc the body washed outside cannot become pure. Hence it is impure.
verses.hindi: अब दूसरा क्‍या सुनना चाहते हैं 2

verses.sanskrit: साध्व्या विक्रयकृच्चाथ वार्द्धकी केशविक्रयी । तप्तलोहेषु पच्यन्ते यश्च भक्तं परित्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: sAdhvyA vikrayakR^ichchAtha vArddhakI keshavikrayI | taptaloheShu pachyante yashcha bhaktaM parityajet
verses.translation: Even after taking in the sanctifying Paficagavya, Havis (Ghee oblation) etc. the body becomes impure the next moment. What else is more impure than this body?

verses.sanskrit: अवमन्ता गुरूणां यः पश्चाद्भोक्ता नराधमः । देवदूषयिता चैव देवविक्रयिकश्च यः
verses.transliteration: avamantA gurUNAM yaH pashchAdbhoktA narAdhamaH | devadUShayitA chaiva devavikrayikashcha yaH
verses.translation: Even after taking in sweet, fragrant and delicious foodstuffs and drinks the body becomes impure quickly. What else is more impure than this.
verses.hindi: सप्तव्याधयतिवर्णन नामक इकतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अगम्यगामी यश्चान्ते याति सप्तबलं द्विज । चौरो गोघ्नो हि पतितो मर्यादादूषकस्तथा
verses.transliteration: agamyagAmI yashchAnte yAti saptabalaM dvija | chauro goghno hi patito maryAdAdUShakastathA
verses.translation: O men, don*t you see dirty and foetal matter coming out of your bodies day by day. How can the recq;>tacle of such matter be pure.?
verses.hindi: कि जात॑ तु ततो बूहि कृपया मुनिसत्तम॥ १  हुआ, कृपया आप बताइये 2

verses.sanskrit: देवद्विजपितृद्वेष्टा रत्नदूषयिता च यः । स याति कृमिभक्षं वै कृमीनत्ति दुरिष्टिकृत्
verses.transliteration: devadvijapitR^idveShTA ratnadUShayitA cha yaH | sa yAti kR^imibhakShaM vai kR^imInatti duriShTikR^it
verses.translation: Like the perennial flow' of the springs of a moun¬ tain the vessels of the body discharge phlegm, urine, faeces and other types of filth. How can that body become clean?
verses.hindi: वायुभक्षण करते हुए तप करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: पितृदेवसुरान् यस्तु पर्यश्नाति नराधमः । लालाभक्षं स यात्यज्ञो यः शास्त्रकूटकृन्नरः
verses.transliteration: pitR^idevasurAn yastu paryashnAti narAdhamaH | lAlAbhakShaM sa yAtyaj~no yaH shAstrakUTakR^innaraH
verses.translation: After touching the tips of the vessels of one's own body the hand is washed with sand and water. Still the persons who are slaves to this filthy body do not feel.
verses.hindi: प्रदायक वैज्राज नामसे विशेष प्रसिद्ध हुआ

verses.sanskrit: यश्चान्त्यजेन संसेव्यो ह्यसद्ग्राही तु यो द्विजः । अयाज्ययाजकश्चैव तथैवाभक्ष्यभक्षकः
verses.transliteration: yashchAntyajena saMsevyo hyasadgrAhI tu yo dvijaH | ayAjyayAjakashchaiva tathaivAbhakShyabhakShakaH
verses.translation: Inspite of being smeared and sanctified assiduously by sweet scents, incense and other things the body does not eschew its nature like the curved tail of a dog.

verses.sanskrit: रुधिरौघे पतन्त्येते सोमविक्रयिणश्च ये । मधुहा ग्रामहा याति क्रूरां वैतरणीं नदीम्
verses.transliteration: rudhiraughe patantyete somavikrayiNashcha ye | madhuhA grAmahA yAti krUrAM vaitaraNIM nadIm
verses.translation: Just as an object, naturally black, cannot become white by any means, so also the physical body does not be¬ come clean though it is scrubbed and cleaned.

verses.sanskrit: नवयौवनमत्ताश्च मर्यादाभेदिनश्च ये । ते कृम्यं यान्त्यशौचाश्च कुलटाजीविनश्च ये
verses.transliteration: navayauvanamattAshcha maryAdAbhedinashcha ye | te kR^imyaM yAntyashauchAshcha kulaTAjIvinashcha ye
verses.translation: Though he smells his own noxious odour, though he sees his own dirt, no man becomes detached and keeps his hand on his nose.

verses.sanskrit: असिपत्रवनं याति वृक्षच्छेदी वृथैव यः । क्षुरभ्रका मृगव्याधा वह्निज्वाले पतन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: asipatravanaM yAti vR^ikShachChedI vR^ithaiva yaH | kShurabhrakA mR^igavyAdhA vahnijvAle patanti te
verses.translation: In the midst of the entire universe, the body alone is the most unclean. By touching its filthy limbs even the pure becomes impure.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रष्टाचारो हि यो विप्रः क्षत्रियो वैश्य एव च । यात्यन्ते द्विज तत्रैव यः श्वपाकेषु वह्निदः
verses.transliteration: bhraShTAchAro hi yo vipraH kShatriyo vaishya eva cha | yAtyante dvija tatraiva yaH shvapAkeShu vahnidaH
verses.translation: But let him be cleaned with all the waters of the Ganga, with heaps of sand resembling a mountain or let him observe purificatory rites till death, if a man has wicked feelings and emotions he can never be purified.

verses.sanskrit: रौरवः शूकरो रोधस्तालो विवसनस्तथा । महाज्वालस्तप्तकुम्भो लवणोऽपि विलोहितः
verses.transliteration: rauravaH shUkaro rodhastAlo vivasanastathA | mahAjvAlastaptakumbho lavaNo.api vilohitaH
verses.translation: Neither heaven nor salvation can be attained by a man of vicious emotion even if he immolates himself in the holy fire. The only result will be that his body is entirely burnt off.

verses.sanskrit: वीर्यं स्वप्नेषु स्कन्देयुर्ये नरा ब्रह्मचारिणः । पुत्रा नाध्यापिता यैश्च ते पतन्ति श्वभोजने
verses.transliteration: vIryaM svapneShu skandeyurye narA brahmachAriNaH | putrA nAdhyApitA yaishcha te patanti shvabhojane
verses.translation: We assert that a man of vicious instinct and feeling never becomes pure though he may indulge in ablu> lions throughout his life with all the waters of the Gahgfi and a mountain of sand.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च नरकाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः । येषु दुष्कृतकर्माणः पच्यन्ते यातनागताः
verses.transliteration: ete chAnye cha narakAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH | yeShu duShkR^itakarmANaH pachyante yAtanAgatAH
verses.translation: If a man of defiled emotion gets himself burnt after entering a huge blazing fire kindled by sprinkling ghee and oil and with flames of circular motion he does not become pure.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव पापान्येतानि तथान्यानि सहस्रशः । भुज्यन्ते यानि पुरुषैर्नरकान्तरगोचरैः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva pApAnyetAni tathAnyAni sahasrashaH | bhujyante yAni puruShairnarakAntaragocharaiH
verses.translation: Fishes stay in the holy Ganga and other sacred rivers. Flocks of birds stay in the temple. They do not attain any special benefit from the ceremonial ablutions and charitable gifts since they are devoid of holy feelings.
verses.hindi: सुननेके बाद क्या करना चाहिए, यह भी बताइये 2

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमविरुद्धं च कर्म कुर्वन्ति ये नराः । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा निरये तु पतन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: varNAshramaviruddhaM cha karma kurvanti ye narAH | karmaNA manasA vAchA niraye tu patanti te
verses.translation: Feelings are different in the mind even if the objects are not different. The same woman is looked at in one way by the son and in another way by the husband.
verses.hindi: और असनतापूर्वक उन्हें दक्षिणा देनी चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: अधःशिरोभिर्दृश्यन्ते नारका दिवि दैवतैः । देवानधोमुखान् सर्वानधः पश्यन्ति नारकाः
verses.transliteration: adhaHshirobhirdR^ishyante nArakA divi daivataiH | devAnadhomukhAn sarvAnadhaH pashyanti nArakAH
verses.translation: O observe the great fortune in the difference of emotions. The man, though embraced, does not love the woman who is devoid of the feelings of love.
verses.hindi: पुराणं निगमार्थाढ्यं पुण्यदं हृदयं श्रुतेः॥ ८  सुनना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: स्थावराः कृमयोऽब्जाश्च पक्षिणः पशवो नराः । धार्मिकास्त्रिदशास्तद्वन्मोक्षिणश्च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: sthAvarAH kR^imayo.abjAshcha pakShiNaH pashavo narAH | dhArmikAstridashAstadvanmokShiNashcha yathAkramam
verses.translation: If the three emotions, passion etc. were to create worries in the mind no one would relish different delicious or fragrant stuffs.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिव्यहापुराणे पञ्चम्यागुमासंहितायां व्यासपजनप्रकारों नाम त्रिचत्वारिशो:ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: यावन्तो जन्तवः स्वर्गे तावन्तो नरकौकसः । पापकृद्याति नरकं प्रायश्चित्तपराङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: yAvanto jantavaH svarge tAvanto narakaukasaH | pApakR^idyAti narakaM prAyashchittaparA~NmukhaH
verses.translation: Performing Japas, sacrifices and eulogies after purifying the soul with pure emotions a man acquires perfect knowledge and after death he attains the worlds of persons who perform many sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: गुरूणि गुरुभिश्चैव लघूनि लघुभिस्तथा । प्रायश्चित्तानि कालेय मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: gurUNi gurubhishchaiva laghUni laghubhistathA | prAyashchittAni kAleya manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt
verses.translation: The purification and removal of the sliminess and bad odour of the faeces and urine of ignorance and passion of men is effected by the pure water of knowledgeand the clay of detachment from the world.

verses.sanskrit: यानि तेषामशेषाणां कर्माण्युक्तानि तेषु वै । प्रायश्चित्तमशेषेण हरानुस्मरणं परम्
verses.transliteration: yAni teShAmasheShANAM karmANyuktAni teShu vai | prAyashchittamasheSheNa harAnusmaraNaM param
verses.translation: An intelligent man shall understand that the body is defective and faulty. He shall be disinterested in such emotions as revolve round the pleasures of the body. With the mind in restraint and intellect delighted he sur¬ mounts the worldly existence and becomes a living liberated soul. He who firmly grasps the inner stump of the plantain tree of worldly existence is not liberated.
verses.hindi: सूत उवाच महान् सन्देह है, आप उसे दूर कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: वैतरणी पूयवहा कृमिशः कृमिभोजनः । असिपत्रवनं घोरं लालाभक्षश्च दारुणः
verses.transliteration: vaitaraNI pUyavahA kR^imishaH kR^imibhojanaH | asipatravanaM ghoraM lAlAbhakShashcha dAruNaH
verses.translation: Hundreds and thousands of mofiarchs who had been in bondage had attained the greatest world on reaching the Nirmamatva (not-my-ness) state.
verses.hindi: ही नावसे यमुनाके उस पार ले चलो

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं तु तस्यैकं यस्य पुंसः प्रजायते । कृते पापेऽनुतापोऽपि शिवसंस्मरणं परम्
verses.transliteration: prAyashchittaM tu tasyaikaM yasya puMsaH prajAyate | kR^ite pApe.anutApo.api shivasaMsmaraNaM param
verses.translation: What little recollection the child had while within the womb perishes when his misery develops further on being crushed by the muscular walls of the vaginal passage as if within a machine.
verses.hindi: इस समय यमुना पार करना चाहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरमवाप्नोति मध्याह्नादिषु संस्मरन् । प्रातर्निशि च सन्ध्यायां क्षीणपापो भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: mAheshvaramavApnoti madhyAhnAdiShu saMsmaran | prAtarnishi cha sandhyAyAM kShINapApo bhavennaraH
verses.translation: A great fever overtakes him as soon as the ex¬ ternal air touches him or delusion overwhelms him.
verses.hindi: आप ऐसा निन्दनीय कर्म क्‍यों कर रहे हैं 2

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तिं प्रयाति स्वर्गं वा समस्तक्लेशसङ्क्षयम् । शिवस्य स्मरणादेव तस्य शम्भोरुमापतेः
verses.transliteration: muktiM prayAti svargaM vA samastakleshasa~NkShayam | shivasya smaraNAdeva tasya shambhorumApateH
verses.translation: Due to that fever a great fascination overpowers him and deludes him. After being deluded he soon suffers from the loss of memory.

verses.sanskrit: पापन्तरायो विप्रेन्द्र जपहोमार्चनादि च । भवत्येव न कुत्रापि त्रैलोक्ये मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: pApantarAyo viprendra japahomArchanAdi cha | bhavatyeva na kutrApi trailokye munisattama
verses.translation: Loss of memory leads to forgetfulness of all pre¬ vious activities. The creature soon begins to love the present birth.
verses.hindi: गये, यह तो महान् आश्चर्य है।

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरे मतिर्यस्य जपहोमार्चनादिषु । यत्पुण्यं तत्कृतं तेन देवेन्द्रत्वादिकं फलम्
verses.transliteration: maheshvare matiryasya japahomArchanAdiShu | yatpuNyaM tatkR^itaM tena devendratvAdikaM phalam
verses.translation: The passionate and deluded world does not engage in activides beneficial to itself. It does not realise itself nor others nor even the deity.
verses.hindi: चलती, तबतक आप धैर्य धारण कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: पुमान्न नरकं याति यः स्मरेद् भक्तितो मुने । अहर्निशं शिवं तस्मात् स क्षीणाशेषपातकः
verses.transliteration: pumAnna narakaM yAti yaH smared bhaktito mune | aharnishaM shivaM tasmAt sa kShINAsheShapAtakaH
verses.translation: O good sage, though he has ears man does not

verses.sanskrit: नरकस्वर्गसंज्ञे वै पापपुण्ये द्विजोत्तम । ययोस्त्वेकं तु दुःखायान्यत्सुखायोद्भवाय च
verses.transliteration: narakasvargasa.nj~ne vai pApapuNye dvijottama | yayostvekaM tu duHkhAyAnyatsukhAyodbhavAya cha
verses.translation: Walking slowly on the level, even path he falters at every step. Even when he has intellect, even when he is enlightened by scholars he does not understand.

verses.sanskrit: तदेव प्रीतये भूत्वा पुनर्दुःखाय जायते । तत्स्माद्दुःखात्मकं नास्ति न च किञ्चित्सुखात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: tadeva prItaye bhUtvA punarduHkhAya jAyate | tatsmAdduHkhAtmakaM nAsti na cha ki~nchitsukhAtmakam
verses.translation: Thereby, urged and prompted by great greed he suffers pain and distress in the world. His intellect no longer remembers the sins he committed which he remembered in the womb.

verses.sanskrit: मनसः परिणामोऽयं सुखदुःखोपलक्षणः । ज्ञानमेव परं ब्रह्म ज्ञानं तत्त्वाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: manasaH pariNAmo.ayaM sukhaduHkhopalakShaNaH | j~nAnameva paraM brahma j~nAnaM tattvAya kalpate
verses.translation: This great divine Sastra has been narrated by Siva in the context of penance as a means to achieving heaven and salvation,

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानात्मकमिदं विश्वं सकलं सचराचरम् । परविज्ञानतः किञ्चित् विद्यते न परं मुने
verses.transliteration: j~nAnAtmakamidaM vishvaM sakalaM sacharAcharam | paravij~nAnataH ki~nchit vidyate na paraM mune
verses.translation: Even when the perfect knowledge of Siva that leads to the achievement of desire is available, it is really a great surprise if people do not strive for its attainment in their own interest.

verses.sanskrit: तथा पूयवहः प्रायो वन्हिज्वालो ह्यधःशिराः । सन्दंशः कालसूत्रश्च तमश्चावीचिरोधनः
verses.transliteration: tathA pUyavahaH prAyo vanhijvAlo hyadhaHshirAH | sandaMshaH kAlasUtrashcha tamashchAvIchirodhanaH
verses.translation: The infant boy may remain somewhere very hungry and thirsty, or lying somewhere he may be crying or he may be eating or drinking faeces and the urine due to delusion.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतन्मयाख्यातं सर्वं नरकमण्डलम् । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतं मण्डलं भुवः
verses.transliteration: evametanmayAkhyAtaM sarvaM narakamaNDalam | ata UrdhvaM pravakShyAmi sAmprataM maNDalaM bhuvaH
verses.translation: During childhood when the rite of earboring is performed or when the parents beat him or when he feels difficulty in learning the alphabet it is surprising that the stupid fellow does not strive for his welfare, even after seeing and somehow surmounting the miseries of boyhood.
verses.hindi: यत्रास्ते परम लिंग॑ मध्यमेश्वरसंज्ञकम्॥ ७७  मध्यमेश्वर नामक श्रेष्ठ लिंग है

verses.sanskrit: श्वभोजनोऽथ रुष्टश्च महारौरवशाल्मली । इत्याद्या बहवस्तत्र नरका दुःखदायकाः
verses.transliteration: shvabhojano.atha ruShTashcha mahArauravashAlmalI | ityAdyA bahavastatra narakA duHkhadAyakAH
verses.translation: Then, he feels misery from malice and rivalry.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतस्य लोपका ये च स्वाश्रमाद्विच्युताश्च ये । सन्दंशयातनामध्ये पतन्ति भृशदारुणे
verses.transliteration: vratasya lopakA ye cha svAshramAdvichyutAshcha ye | sandaMshayAtanAmadhye patanti bhR^ishadAruNe
verses.translation: During nights he does not get proper sleep be¬ cause he is scorched by the fire of lust. Where is pleasure even during the day because he is worried over the ways and means of earning wealth?

verses.sanskrit: पच्यन्ते तेषु पुरुषाः पापकर्मरतास्तु ये । क्रमाद्वक्ष्ये तु तान् व्यास सावधानतया शृणु
verses.transliteration: pachyante teShu puruShAH pApakarmaratAstu ye | kramAdvakShye tu tAn vyAsa sAvadhAnatayA shR^iNu
verses.translation: The drops of semen of a man whose mind is dwelling on women do not bring him pleasure. They arc like his own sweat drops, mere dirt.
verses.hindi: मध्यमेश्वरकी कृपासे विद्याओंमें पारंगत हो गये

verses.sanskrit: कूटसाक्ष्यं तु यो वक्ति विना विप्रान् सुरांश्च गाः । सदानृतं वदेद्यस्तु स नरो याति रौरवम्
verses.transliteration: kUTasAkShyaM tu yo vakti vinA viprAn surAMshcha gAH | sadAnR^itaM vadedyastu sa naro yAti rauravam
verses.translation: It has been mentioned by Paficacuda that there is not even a particle of pleasure in women who are the store¬ houses of all blemishes and who are creatures unsubstantial.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूणहा स्वर्णहर्ता च गोरोधी विश्वघातकः । सुरापो ब्रह्महन्ता च परद्रव्यापहारकः
verses.transliteration: bhrUNahA svarNahartA cha gorodhI vishvaghAtakaH | surApo brahmahantA cha paradravyApahArakaH
verses.translation: Due to honour and disrespect, due to union with and separation from the beloved people youth is soon devoured by old age. Where is pleasure without torment?

verses.sanskrit: यस्तत्सङ्गी स वै याति मृतो व्यास गुरोर्वधात् । तप्तकुम्भे स्वसुर्मातुर्गोश्चैव दुहितुस्तथा
verses.transliteration: yastatsa~NgI sa vai yAti mR^ito vyAsa gurorvadhAt | taptakumbhe svasurmAturgoshchaiva duhitustathA
verses.translation: The youth of women and men which had been mutually pleasurable formerly is not so now when it is over¬ whelmed by old age, when the body is rendered shattered and rickety by wrinkles, grey hairs and baldness and when the man is incompetent to perform any serious task.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O sage, if you are pleased with me you shall nar« rate succinctly what was mentioned by Paficacuda viz., that women are despicable.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O sage, if you are pleased with me you shall nar« rate succinctly what was mentioned by Paficacuda viz., that women are despicable.
verses.hindi: आपको मैं हृदयमें धारण करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.१७. सप्तदशोऽध्यायः । जम्बूद्वीपवर्षवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । पाराशर्य सुसङ्क्षेपाच्छृणु त्वं वदतो मम । मण्डलं च भुवः सम्यक् सप्तद्वीपादिसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.17\. saptadasho.adhyAyaH | jambUdvIpavarShavarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | pArAsharya susa~NkShepAchChR^iNu tvaM vadato mama | maNDalaM cha bhuvaH samyak saptadvIpAdisaMyutam
verses.translation: I shall explain the nature of women as it is. O dear, listen to it, merely by hearing which excellent detach* ment results.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे कुरवश्चैव यथा वै भारतं तथा । नवसाहस्रमेकैकमेतेषां मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: uttare kuravashchaiva yathA vai bhArataM tathA | navasAhasramekaikameteShAM munisattama
verses.translation: O sage, women are light-minded. They are at the root of all troubles. Attachment towards them should not be pursued by wakeful persons who desire liberation.

verses.sanskrit: इलावृतं तु तन्मध्ये तन्मध्ये मेरुरुच्छ्रितः । मेरोश्चतुर्दिशं तत्र नवसाहस्रमुच्छ्रितम्
verses.transliteration: ilAvR^itaM tu tanmadhye tanmadhye meruruchChritaH | meroshchaturdishaM tatra navasAhasramuchChritam
verses.translation: In this respect they quote an ancient tradition, the conversation of NSrada with the unchaste woman Paficacud*
verses.hindi: मुझे क्‍यों नियुक्त कर रहे हैं ?

verses.sanskrit: इलावृतमृषिश्रेष्ठ चत्वारश्चात्र पर्वताः । विष्कम्भा रचिता मेरोर्योजिताः पुनरुच्छ्रिताः
verses.transliteration: ilAvR^itamR^iShishreShTha chatvArashchAtra parvatAH | viShkambhA rachitA meroryojitAH punaruchChritAH
verses.translation: Formerly, while the intelligent celestial sage Nkrada was Meandering in the worlds he saw the beautiful celestial damsel Paficacud.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे हि मन्दरो नाम दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः । विपुलः पश्चिमे भागे सुपार्श्वश्चोत्तरे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: pUrve hi mandaro nAma dakShiNe gandhamAdanaH | vipulaH pashchime bhAge supArshvashchottare sthitaH
verses.translation: The excellent sage Narada asked the beautiful woman, the Apsaras—"O lady of beautiful waist, I have a certain doubt. Please explain it to me."
verses.hindi: रूपसे शीघ्र ही पूर्ण होगी, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: कदम्बो जम्बुवृक्षश्च पिप्पलो वट एव च । एकादशशतायामाः पादपा गिरिकेतवः
verses.transliteration: kadambo jambuvR^ikShashcha pippalo vaTa eva cha | ekAdashashatAyAmAH pAdapA giriketavaH
verses.translation: O brahmin, thus addressed the excellent celestial damsel replied—'*lf you consider me competent and if there is a proper subject, I shall explain."
verses.hindi: पाठ करनेसे सारी मनोकामनाएँ पूर्ण होंगी

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूद्वीपस्य नाम्नो वै हेतुं शृणु महामुने । विराजन्ते महावृक्षास्तत्स्वभावं वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: jambUdvIpasya nAmno vai hetuM shR^iNu mahAmune | virAjante mahAvR^ikShAstatsvabhAvaM vadAmi te
verses.translation: O gentle lady, I shall never engage you in a sub¬ ject beyond your scope. O lady of slender waist, I wish m hear from you the nature of women.

verses.sanskrit: महागजप्रमाणानि जम्ब्वास्तस्याः फलानि च । पतन्ति भूभृतः पृष्ठे शीर्यमाणानि सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: mahAgajapramANAni jambvAstasyAH phalAni cha | patanti bhUbhR^itaH pR^iShThe shIryamANAni sarvataH
verses.translation: On hearing these words of that celestial sage the excellent Apsaras replied to that lord of sages, Narada the excellent sage.
verses.hindi: वर्ष जप्तमिद स्तोत्र बुद्धिं विद्यां च वर्धयेत्॥ १९ उसकी विद्या एवं बुद्धिमें वृद्धि होगी

verses.sanskrit: रसेन तेषां विख्याता तत्र जम्बूनदीति वै । परितो वर्तते तत्र पीयते तन्निवासिभिः
verses.transliteration: rasena teShAM vikhyAtA tatra jambUnadIti vai | parito vartate tatra pIyate tannivAsibhiH
verses.translation: "O sage listen, being a woman I cannot censure women. You already know what women are and what their nature is.
verses.hindi: 5 -प- “ यश । करते हुए शिवप्रेममें निमग्न हो गये

verses.sanskrit: न स्वेदो न च दौर्गन्ध्यं न जरा चेन्द्रियग्रहः । तस्यास्तटे स्थितानां तु जनानां तन्न जायते
verses.transliteration: na svedo na cha daurgandhyaM na jarA chendriyagrahaH | tasyAstaTe sthitAnAM tu janAnAM tanna jAyate
verses.translation: O celestial sage, it does not behove you to urge me in such a question.'* After saying this the excellent Apsaras Paficacu<a kept quiet.
verses.hindi: कुरु निर्वचन॑ तेषामिदानीं वेदवित्तम॥ १२३  निर्वचन कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: तीरमृत्स्नां च सम्प्राप्य सुखवायुविशोषिताम् । जाम्बूनदाख्यं भवति सुवर्णं सिद्धभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: tIramR^itsnAM cha samprApya sukhavAyuvishoShitAm | jAmbUnadAkhyaM bhavati suvarNaM siddhabhUShaNam
verses.translation: On hearing her excellent statement the most excel¬ lent of the celestial sages replied to her with a desire for the benefit of the worlds.
verses.hindi: नन्दिकेश्वरमुद्दिश्य स यदाह ब्रवीमि ततू॥ १२४  दिया था, उसीको मैं कह रहा हूँ

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूः प्लक्षः शाल्मलिश्च कुशः क्रौञ्चश्च शाककः । पुष्करः सप्तमः सर्वे समुद्रैः सप्तभिर्वृताः
verses.transliteration: jambUH plakShaH shAlmalishcha kushaH krau~nchashcha shAkakaH | puShkaraH saptamaH sarve samudraiH saptabhirvR^itAH
verses.translation: It may be wrong to make a false statement. There is no defect in speaking the truth. Know this, O lady of good waist and speak the truth.
verses.hindi: तस्माद् ब्राह्मं समाख्यातं पुराणं प्रथम मुने॥ १२५ पुराणको इसीलिये ब्रह्मपुरण कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: भद्राश्वं पूर्वतो मेरोः केतुमालं च पश्चिमे । वर्षे द्वे तु मुनिश्रेष्ठ तयोर्मध्य इलावृतम्
verses.transliteration: bhadrAshvaM pUrvato meroH ketumAlaM cha pashchime | varShe dve tu munishreShTha tayormadhya ilAvR^itam
verses.translation: Thus prompted, the sweet-smiling lady, resolved and immediately began to explain truthfully the permanent defects of women.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्पादं समाख्यातं पुराणं च द्वितीयकम्॥ १२६ दूसरा पद्मपुराण कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: वनं चैत्ररथं पूर्वे दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः । विभ्राजं पश्चिमे तद्वदुत्तरे नन्दनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: vanaM chaitrarathaM pUrve dakShiNe gandhamAdanaH | vibhrAjaM pashchime tadvaduttare nandanaM smR^itam
verses.translation: They might have husbands of good knowledge, of ample wealth, of great comeliness and pleasing to them. But when they get opportunities for erring, they do not wait.

verses.sanskrit: अरुणोदं महाभद्रं शीतोदं मानसं स्मृतम् । सरांस्येतानि चत्वारि देवभोग्यानि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: aruNodaM mahAbhadraM shItodaM mAnasaM smR^itam | sarAMsyetAni chatvAri devabhogyAni sarvashaH
verses.translation: Women love only those persons who solicit their company, who approach them intimately aud who render them a little bit of service.**
verses.hindi: शैवमेतत्पुराणं हि पुराणज्ञा वदन्ति च॥ १२८  न्षरित्र है, उसे पुराणज्ञ शिवपुराण कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: शीताञ्जनः कुरुङ्गश्च कुररो माल्यवांस्तथा । एकैकप्रमुखा मेरोः पूर्वतः केसराचलाः
verses.transliteration: shItA~njanaH kuru~Ngashcha kuraro mAlyavAMstathA | ekaikapramukhA meroH pUrvataH kesarAchalAH
verses.translation: Paj&ca. Mitrabheda 143.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकूटः शिशिरश्चैव पतङ्गो रुचकस्तथा । निषधः कपिलाद्याश्च दक्षिणे केसराचलाः
verses.transliteration: trikUTaH shishirashchaiva pata~Ngo ruchakastathA | niShadhaH kapilAdyAshcha dakShiNe kesarAchalAH
verses.translation: Women usually do not observe the limitations of conventional decency. If at all they stand by them with their husbands it is because no man makes advances to them or because they are afraid of their husbands.*®*

verses.sanskrit: सिनीवासः कुसुम्भश्च कपिलो नारदस्तथा । नागादयश्च गिरयः पश्चिमे केसराचलाः
verses.transliteration: sinIvAsaH kusumbhashcha kapilo nAradastathA | nAgAdayashcha girayaH pashchime kesarAchalAH
verses.translation: Even women of noble families aspire for the life of lascivious women who in their prime of youth adorned with lovable ornaments and beautiful wearing garments move about frivolously.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचूडोऽथ ऋषभो हंसो नाम महीधरः । कालञ्जराद्याश्च तथा उत्तरे केसराचलाः
verses.transliteration: sha~NkhachUDo.atha R^iShabho haMso nAma mahIdharaH | kAla~njarAdyAshcha tathA uttare kesarAchalAH
verses.translation: Even the women who are honoured well, loved intimately and looked after with care become attached to hunchbacks, blind men, imbeciles and dwarfs.

verses.sanskrit: मेरोरुपरि मध्ये हि शातकौम्भं विधेः पुरम् । चतुर्दशसहस्राणि योजनानि च सङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: merorupari madhye hi shAtakaumbhaM vidheH puram | chaturdashasahasrANi yojanAni cha sa~NkhyayA
verses.translation: O celestial sage, they become attached to lame and even despicable persons. O great sage, there is none in the world who cannot be approached by women with solici¬ tations of lust.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टानां लोकपालानां परितस्तदनुक्रमात् । यथादिशं यथारूपं पुरोऽष्टावुपकल्पिताः
verses.transliteration: aShTAnAM lokapAlAnAM paritastadanukramAt | yathAdishaM yathArUpaM puro.aShTAvupakalpitAH
verses.translation: O brahmin, if women do not get men for their dalliance they begin to indulge in abnormal sexual activity with one another. They do not stand by their husbands.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां च ब्रह्मणः पुर्यां प्लावयित्वेन्दुमण्डलम् । विष्णुपादविनिष्क्रान्ता गङ्गा पतति वै नदी
verses.transliteration: tasyAM cha brahmaNaH puryAM plAvayitvendumaNDalam | viShNupAdaviniShkrAntA ga~NgA patati vai nadI
verses.translation: Women become desperate when they do not get men, when they are afraid of servants, when they arc frightened of being killed or imprisoned.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे पश्चम्यामुमासंहितायां व्यासोत्यत्तिवर्णन॑ नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: लवणेक्षुरसौ सर्पिर्दधिदुग्धजलाशयाः । जम्बुद्वीपः समस्तानामेतेषां मध्यतः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: lavaNekShurasau sarpirdadhidugdhajalAshayAH | jambudvIpaH samastAnAmeteShAM madhyataH sthitaH
verses.translation: Because they indulge in sexual intercourse as they please they are fickleminded, of evil deeds and emotionally incomprehensible even to an intelligent man.

verses.sanskrit: सीता चालकनन्दा च चक्षुर्भद्रा च वै क्रमात् । सा तत्र पतिता दिक्षु चतुर्धा प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sItA chAlakanandA cha chakShurbhadrA cha vai kramAt | sA tatra patitA dikShu chaturdhA pratyapadyata
verses.translation: Gp. Ibid. Mitrabhrda 144.

verses.sanskrit: सीता पूर्वेण शैलं हि नन्दा चैव तु दक्षिणे । सा चक्षुः पश्चिमे चैव भद्रा चोत्तरतो व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: sItA pUrveNa shailaM hi nandA chaiva tu dakShiNe | sA chakShuH pashchime chaiva bhadrA chottarato vrajet
verses.translation: Gp. Ibid. Mitrabheda 138.
verses.hindi: भाग्यहीन ही रहते हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: गिरीनतीत्य सकलांश्चतुर्दिक्षु महाम्बुधिम् । सा ययौ प्रयता भूता गङ्गा त्रिपथगामिनी
