verses.translation: Due to the misbehaviour of Vena the pious sages became very furious and killed him by very huhkara.

verses.sanskrit: येन येन हि भावेन स्थित्वा यत्क्रियते तपः । ततः सम्प्राप्यतेऽसौ तैरिह लोके न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yena yena hi bhAvena sthitvA yatkriyate tapaH | tataH samprApyate.asau tairiha loke na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Sarasvata Sages were requested by Sunitha for the birth of a son. They then churned and pressed his right hand.

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकं राजसं चैव तामसं त्रिविधं स्मृतम् । विज्ञेयं हि तपो व्यास सर्वसाधनसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: sAttvikaM rAjasaM chaiva tAmasaM trividhaM smR^itam | vij~neyaM hi tapo vyAsa sarvasAdhanasAdhanam
verses.translation: Prthu, son of Vena, the ancestor of all Ksatriyas protected the earth. He was the first lord of Earth, the first among those anointed in the Rajasuya sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Performing a hundred sacrifices he as a king be¬ come the provider of livelihood to all the gods, sages and Raksasas and to men in particular.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Performing a hundred sacrifices he as a king be¬ come the provider of livelihood to all the gods, sages and Raksasas and to men in particular.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२१. एकविंशोऽध्यायः । रणफलवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । ब्राह्मणत्वं हि दुष्प्राप्यं निसर्गाद् ब्राह्मणो भवेत् । ईश्वरस्य मुखात्क्षत्रं बाहुभ्यामूरुतो विशः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.21\. ekaviMsho.adhyAyaH | raNaphalavarNanam | vyAsa uvAcha | brAhmaNatvaM hi duShprApyaM nisargAd brAhmaNo bhavet | Ishvarasya mukhAtkShatraM bAhubhyAmUruto vishaH
verses.translation: Two virtuous princes, Vivitasva and Haryak$a were born to Prthu. They were great heroes who had become very famous.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुते कामयानस्तु शूद्रोऽपि वैश्यतां व्रजेत् । यो योजयेद्धनैर्वैश्यो जुह्वानश्च यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: kurute kAmayAnastu shUdro.api vaishyatAM vrajet | yo yojayeddhanairvaishyo juhvAnashcha yathAvidhi
verses.translation: Sikhandini gave birth to a son Pracinabarhis. While he roamed on the earth Kusa grasses had their tips towards the East.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्रमुपादाय शेषान्नकृतभोजनः । स वैश्यः क्षत्रियकुले जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: agnihotramupAdAya sheShAnnakR^itabhojanaH | sa vaishyaH kShatriyakule jAyate nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: The daughter of the lord of the Ocean was duly married by him. The great lord, shone all the more when he had a wife.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियो जायते यज्ञैः संस्कृतैरात्तदक्षिणैः । अधीते स्वर्गमन्विच्छंस्त्रेताग्निशरणं सदा
verses.transliteration: kShatriyo jAyate yaj~naiH saMskR^itairAttadakShiNaiH | adhIte svargamanvichChaMstretAgnisharaNaM sadA
verses.translation: Ten sons were born to Pracinabarhis the great sacrificer, of his wife Samudratanaya.

verses.sanskrit: आर्द्रहस्तपदो नित्यं क्षितिं धर्मेण पालयेत् । ऋतुकालाभिगामी च स्वभार्यां धर्मतत्परः
verses.transliteration: Ardrahastapado nityaM kShitiM dharmeNa pAlayet | R^itukAlAbhigAmI cha svabhAryAM dharmatatparaH
verses.translation: They were Pracetas by name. They had mastered the science of archery. Together they practised virtue and performed penance.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वातिथ्यं त्रिवर्गस्य भूतेभ्यो दीयतामिति । गोब्राह्मणात्मनोऽर्थं हि सङ्ग्रामाभिहतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvAtithyaM trivargasya bhUtebhyo dIyatAmiti | gobrAhmaNAtmano.arthaM hi sa~NgrAmAbhihato bhavet
verses.translation: They lay sunk in the waters of the ocean for ten thousand years, repeating the Japa of Rudragita and medita¬ ting on!§iva.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाग्निमन्त्रपूतात्मा क्षत्रियो ब्राह्मणो भवेत् । विधितो ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा याजकस्तु प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: tenAgnimantrapUtAtmA kShatriyo brAhmaNo bhavet | vidhito brAhmaNo bhUtvA yAjakastu prajAyate
verses.translation: While they were performing penance trees grew on the earth. When the Earth stood unprotectea there was a great destruction of subjects.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मनिरतो नित्यं सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः । प्राप्यते विपुलः स्वर्गो देवानामपि वल्लभः
verses.transliteration: svakarmanirato nityaM satyavAdI jitendriyaH | prApyate vipulaH svargo devAnAmapi vallabhaH
verses.translation: O great king, after attaining boons when, they returned they saw the trees. They were furious and wanted to burn them by the power of penance.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणत्वं हि दुष्प्राप्यं कृच्छ्रेण साध्यते नरैः । ब्राह्मण्यात्सकलं प्राप्य मोक्षं चापि मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNatvaM hi duShprApyaM kR^ichChreNa sAdhyate naraiH | brAhmaNyAtsakalaM prApya mokShaM chApi munIshvara
verses.translation: The Pracetasas created fire and wind from their mouths. The wind uprooted the trees and the fire burnt them.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणो धर्मतत्परः । साधनं सर्ववर्गस्य रक्षेद् ब्राह्मण्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAtsarvaprayatnena brAhmaNo dharmatatparaH | sAdhanaM sarvavargasya rakShed brAhmaNyamuttamam
verses.translation: On seeing the destruction of trees and observing that only a few trees were left, the valorous king Soma approached them and said.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । सङ्ग्रामस्येह माहात्म्यं त्वयोक्तं मुनिसत्तम । एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं ब्रूहि त्वं वदतां वर
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | sa~NgrAmasyeha mAhAtmyaM tvayoktaM munisattama | etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM brUhi tvaM vadatAM vara
verses.translation: O Pracinabarhisas, O kings, subdue your anger. This daughter of the trees, Anubhuta, is a woman of fair com¬ plexion.

verses.sanskrit: पद्भ्यां शूद्रः समुत्पन्न इति तस्य मुखात् श्रुतिः । किमु स्थितिमधःस्थानादाप्नुवन्ति ह्यतो वद
verses.transliteration: padbhyAM shUdraH samutpanna iti tasya mukhAt shrutiH | kimu sthitimadhaHsthAnAdApnuvanti hyato vada
verses.translation: The patriarch Daksa will be born of her. He, the ancient son of Brahma, will become a creator of great brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा विपुलदक्षिणैः । न तत्फलमवाप्नोति सङ्ग्रामे यदवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | agniShTomAdibhiryaj~nairiShTvA vipuladakShiNaiH | na tatphalamavApnoti sa~NgrAme yadavApnuyAt
verses.translation: With half your brilliance, and with half my brilli¬ ance this king full of Brahma's brilliance will make the sub¬ jects flourish.

verses.sanskrit: इति तत्त्वविदः प्राहुर्यज्ञकर्मविदः सदा । तस्मात्तत्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्फलं शस्त्रजीविनाम्
verses.transliteration: iti tattvavidaH prAhuryaj~nakarmavidaH sadA | tasmAttatte pravakShyAmi yatphalaM shastrajIvinAm
verses.translation: Then at the instance of Soma the Pracetasas lovingly took the fair-complexioned lady, daughter of trees, as their wife.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मलाभोऽर्थलाभश्च यशोलाभस्तथैव च । यः शूरो वाञ्छते युद्धं विमृदन् परवाहिनीम्
verses.transliteration: dharmalAbho.arthalAbhashcha yasholAbhastathaiva cha | yaH shUro vA~nChate yuddhaM vimR^idan paravAhinIm
verses.translation: After creating mentally the mobile and immobile beings, the bipeds and the quadrupeds, Daksa began creation though copulatory process.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य धर्मार्थकामाश्च यज्ञश्चैव सदक्षिणः । परं ह्यभिमुखं दत्त्वा तद्यानं योऽधिरोहति
verses.transliteration: tasya dharmArthakAmAshcha yaj~nashchaiva sadakShiNaH | paraM hyabhimukhaM dattvA tadyAnaM yo.adhirohati
verses.translation: In accordance with the Sastric injunctions, he virtuously married the daughter of Virana the partriarch, the chaste lady Virani.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुलोके स जायेत यश्च युद्धेऽपराजितः । अश्वमेधानवाप्नोति चतुरो न मृतः स चेत्
verses.transliteration: viShNuloke sa jAyeta yashcha yuddhe.aparAjitaH | ashvamedhAnavApnoti chaturo na mR^itaH sa chet
verses.translation: He begot of her ten thousand sons Haryasvas. At the instance of Narada they became detached from the world.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु शस्त्रमनुत्सृज्य म्रियते वाहिनीमुखे । सम्मुखो वर्तते शूरः स स्वर्गान्न निवर्तते
verses.transliteration: yastu shastramanutsR^ijya mriyate vAhinImukhe | sammukho vartate shUraH sa svargAnna nivartate
verses.translation: On hearing of it Daksa again begot of her a thousand sons SubalaSvas.

verses.sanskrit: राजा वा राजपुत्रो वा सेनापतिरथापि वा । हतः क्षात्रेण यः शूरस्तस्य लोकोऽक्षयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: rAjA vA rAjaputro vA senApatirathApi vA | hataH kShAtreNa yaH shUrastasya loko.akShayo bhavet
verses.translation: Thanks to the instructions of the same sage they too followed the footsteps of their brothers. Unattached and following the path of mendicants they never returned to their parents.

verses.sanskrit: यावन्ति तस्य रोमाणि भिद्यन्तेऽस्त्रैर्महाहवे । तावतो लभते लोकान् सर्वकामदुघाऽक्षयान्
verses.transliteration: yAvanti tasya romANi bhidyante.astrairmahAhave | tAvato labhate lokAn sarvakAmadughA.akShayAn
verses.translation: On hearing of it he became very furious and cursed the sage thus— O wretch, fond of quarrels, you will never stay permanently anywhere. *

verses.sanskrit: वीरासनं वीरशय्या वीरस्थानस्थितिः स्थिरा । सर्वदा भवति व्यास इह लोके परत्र च
verses.transliteration: vIrAsanaM vIrashayyA vIrasthAnasthitiH sthirA | sarvadA bhavati vyAsa iha loke paratra cha
verses.translation: Repeated. See Ch. 31. VefScs 14.13.

verses.sanskrit: गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे च स्थानस्वाम्यर्थमेव च । ये मृतास्ते सुखं यान्ति यथा सुकृतिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: gavArthe brAhmaNArthe cha sthAnasvAmyarthameva cha | ye mR^itAste sukhaM yAnti yathA sukR^itinastathA
verses.translation: Consoled by Brahma, O great sage he afterwards created women endowed with qualities and in the form of great flames.®

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । दुष्कृतेन तु कालेय स्थानाद् भ्रश्यन्ति मानवाः । श्रेष्ठं स्थानं समासाद्य तस्माद्रक्षेत पण्डितः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | duShkR^itena tu kAleya sthAnAd bhrashyanti mAnavAH | shreShThaM sthAnaM samAsAdya tasmAdrakSheta paNDitaH
verses.translation: Asuras and others were born of the daughters of Daksa and had become famous. The universe was filled with them.

verses.sanskrit: यः कश्चिद् ब्राह्मणं हत्वा पश्चात्प्राणान् परित्यजेत् । तत्रासौ स्वपतेर्युद्धे स स्वर्गान्न निवर्तते
verses.transliteration: yaH kashchid brAhmaNaM hatvA pashchAtprANAn parityajet | tatrAsau svapateryuddhe sa svargAnna nivartate
verses.translation: O great brahmin, the subjects thereafter were born of sexual union. The creation prior to this was through mental concepts, visualisation and touch.

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादैर्दन्तिभिश्चैव हतस्य गतिरुत्तमा । द्विजगोस्वामिनामर्थे भवेद्विपुलदाक्षया
verses.transliteration: kravyAdairdantibhishchaiva hatasya gatiruttamA | dvijagosvAminAmarthe bhavedvipuladAkShayA
verses.translation: O Suta, it behoves you to clear this doubt of mine. This is also surprising how he attained the status of of the father-in-law of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: शक्नोत्विह समर्थश्च यष्टुं क्रतुशतैरपि । आत्मदेहपरित्यागः कर्तुं युधि सुदुष्करः
verses.transliteration: shaknotviha samarthashcha yaShTuM kratushatairapi | AtmadehaparityAgaH kartuM yudhi suduShkaraH
verses.translation: Birth and destruction happen everyday among the mortals. O sage, in every Kalpa these, Daksa and others are born again.

verses.sanskrit: युद्धं पुण्यतमं स्वर्ग्यं रूपज्ञं सर्वतोमुखम् । सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां क्षत्रियस्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yuddhaM puNyatamaM svargyaM rUpaj~naM sarvatomukham | sarveShAmeva varNAnAM kShatriyasya visheShataH
verses.translation: He who knows this mode of creation of Daka of the mobile and immobile beings becomes endowed with pro¬ geny and longevity. After death he is honoured in the heavenly region.

verses.sanskrit: भृशं चैव प्रवक्ष्यामि युद्धधर्मं सनातनम् । यादृशाय प्रहर्तव्यं यादृशं परिवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: bhR^ishaM chaiva pravakShyAmi yuddhadharmaM sanAtanam | yAdR^ishAya prahartavyaM yAdR^ishaM parivarjayet
verses.translation: The Verses 47, 48 are repeatecL See Gh. 31. Verses 17, 18.

verses.sanskrit: आततायिनमायान्तमपि वेदान्तङ्गं द्विजम् । जिघांसन्तं जिघांसेत्तु न तेन ब्रह्महा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: AtatAyinamAyAntamapi vedAnta~NgaM dvijam | jighAMsantaM jighAMsettu na tena brahmahA bhavet
verses.translation: O son of Suta, tell me quickly about the details of the creation of the gods, Danavas, Gandharvas, serpents and Rakasas.

verses.sanskrit: हन्तव्योऽपि न हन्तव्यः पानीयं यश्च याचते । रणे हत्वातुरा व्यास स नरो ब्रह्महा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: hantavyo.api na hantavyaH pAnIyaM yashcha yAchate | raNe hatvAturA vyAsa sa naro brahmahA bhavet
verses.translation: When the creation did not multiply, the patriarch asked the daughter of Virana, endowed with penance, for the purpose of creation

verses.sanskrit: व्याधितं दुर्बलं बालं स्त्र्यनाथौ कृपणं ध्रुवम् । धनुर्भग्नं छिन्नगुणं हत्वा वै ब्रह्महा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vyAdhitaM durbalaM bAlaM stryanAthau kR^ipaNaM dhruvam | dhanurbhagnaM ChinnaguNaM hatvA vai brahmahA bhavet
verses.translation: He created different people by the process of copulation. O intelligent one, listen to them. I shall ex¬ plain in brief.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विचार्य सद्धीमान् भवेत्प्रीत्याः रणप्रियः । स जन्मनः फलं प्राप्य परत्रेह प्रमोदते
verses.transliteration: evaM vichArya saddhImAn bhavetprItyAH raNapriyaH | sa janmanaH phalaM prApya paratreha pramodate
verses.translation: Uniting with her, the powerful patriarch begot of Virini five thousand sons.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु विप्रत्वमुत्सृज्य क्षत्रयोन्यां प्रसूयते । ब्राह्मण्यात्स परिभ्रष्टः क्षत्रियत्वं निषेवते
verses.transliteration: yastu vipratvamutsR^ijya kShatrayonyAM prasUyate | brAhmaNyAtsa paribhraShTaH kShatriyatvaM niShevate
verses.translation: Narada, son of Brahma, had heard at the Satra that the creation can take place only through KaSyapa in the daughters of Daka. So, on seeing the created sons, the sage Narada addressed them thus.

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मसेवनान्मूढस्तथैव परिवर्तते । जन्मान्तरसहस्राणि तमस्याविशते यतः
verses.transliteration: adharmasevanAnmUDhastathaiva parivartate | janmAntarasahasrANi tamasyAvishate yataH
verses.translation: "You do not know any direction in the world. Without knowing that what can you create? You are very

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्राप्य परं स्थानं प्रमाद्येन्न तु नाशयेत् । स्वस्थानं सर्वदा रक्षेत्प्राप्यापि विपदो नरः
verses.transliteration: tasmAtprApya paraM sthAnaM pramAdyenna tu nAshayet | svasthAnaM sarvadA rakShetprApyApi vipado naraH
verses.translation: Thus addressed by him they all proceeded to know the direction by means of their power. Without being able to reach their end they never returned to their father*s house.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणत्वं शुभं प्राप्य ब्राह्मण्यं योऽवमन्यते । भोज्याभोज्यं न जानाति स पुमान् क्षत्रियो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNatvaM shubhaM prApya brAhmaNyaM yo.avamanyate | bhojyAbhojyaM na jAnAti sa pumAn kShatriyo bhavet
verses.translation: On knowing that he created five himdred sons, Narada, the visualiser of all, spoke to them also.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा येन मेधावी शूद्रो वैश्यो हि जायते । तत्ते वक्ष्यामि निखिलं येन वर्णोत्तमो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: karmaNA yena medhAvI shUdro vaishyo hi jAyate | tatte vakShyAmi nikhilaM yena varNottamo bhavet
verses.translation: How can you create without knowing the extent of the world? All of you are childish. What creation do you propose to make?

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रकर्म यथोद्दिष्टं शूद्रो भूत्वा समाचरेत् । यथावत्परिचर्यां तु त्रिषु वर्णेषु नित्यदा
verses.transliteration: shUdrakarma yathoddiShTaM shUdro bhUtvA samAcharet | yathAvatparicharyAM tu triShu varNeShu nityadA
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Subalilvas, sons of Daka,

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Ever since, O sage, if a brother goes in quest of a brother he perishes. That should not be done by any learned man.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Ever since, O sage, if a brother goes in quest of a brother he perishes. That should not be done by any learned man.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२२. द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः । देहोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । विधिं तात वदेदानीं जीवजन्म विधानतः । गर्भे स्थितिं च तस्यापि वैराग्यार्थं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.22\. dvAviMsho.adhyAyaH | dehotpattivarNanam | vyAsa uvAcha | vidhiM tAta vadedAnIM jIvajanma vidhAnataH | garbhe sthitiM cha tasyApi vairAgyArthaM munIshvara
verses.translation: Realising that his sons had perished, the patriarch Daksa cursed the noble soul Narada in anger.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रयान्ति सम्पूर्णाः ताश्च देहं समन्ततः । ततः स नाडीमध्यस्थः शरीरेणात्मना रसः
verses.transliteration: punaH prayAnti sampUrNAH tAshcha dehaM samantataH | tataH sa nADImadhyasthaH sharIreNAtmanA rasaH
verses.translation: "O wretch, fond of quarrels, you will never stay anywhere permanently. Qiiarrel will always occur among the people where you happen to be present."

verses.sanskrit: पच्यते पच्यमानाच्च भवेत्पाकद्वयं पुनः । त्वक् तया वेष्ट्यते पूर्वं रुधिरं च प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: pachyate pachyamAnAchcha bhavetpAkadvayaM punaH | tvak tayA veShTyate pUrvaM rudhiraM cha prajAyate
verses.translation: We have heard that Daksa the patriarch was consoled by Brahma afterwards and that he begot of Virini sixty daughters.'

verses.sanskrit: रक्ताल्लोमानि मांसं च केशाः स्नायुश्च मांसतः । स्नायुतश्च तथास्थीनि नखा मज्जास्थिसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: raktAllomAni mAMsaM cha keshAH snAyushcha mAMsataH | snAyutashcha tathAsthIni nakhA majjAsthisambhavAH
verses.translation: He gave ten of them to Dharma; thirteen to Kayapa; twentyseven to the moon and four to Aristanemi.

verses.sanskrit: मज्जाकारणवैकल्यं शुक्रं हि प्रसवात्मकम् । इति द्वादशधान्नस्य परिणामः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: majjAkAraNavaikalyaM shukraM hi prasavAtmakam | iti dvAdashadhAnnasya pariNAmaH prakIrtitAH
verses.translation: Two to the son of Brahma, two to Ahgiras and two to the learned Kr<ai5va. Now listen to their names.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रोऽन्नाज्जायते शुक्राद्दिव्यदेहस्य सम्भवः । ऋतुकाले यदा शुक्रं निर्दोषं योनिसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: shukro.annAjjAyate shukrAddivyadehasya sambhavaH | R^itukAle yadA shukraM nirdoShaM yonisaMsthitam
verses.translation: O sage, the wives of Dharma are Arundhati, Vasu, Yami, Lamba, Bhanu, Marutvati, Sahkalpa, Muhurta, Sadhya and Visva. Now listen to their children. Vive- devas are the sons of Visva, and Sadhya gave birth to Sadh/as.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तद् वायुसंस्पृष्टं स्त्रीरक्तेनैकतां व्रजेत् । विसर्गकाले शुक्रस्य जीवः कारणसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: tadA tad vAyusaMspR^iShTaM strIraktenaikatAM vrajet | visargakAle shukrasya jIvaH kAraNasaMyutaH
verses.translation: Marutvats were born of Marutvati, Vasus were born of Vasu; the suns were born of Bhanu and the Muhurtajas were born of Muhurta.

verses.sanskrit: संवृतः प्रविशेद्योनिं कर्मभिः स्वैर्नियोजितः । तच्छुक्ररक्तमेकस्थमेकाहात्कललं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: saMvR^itaH pravishedyoniM karmabhiH svairniyojitaH | tachChukraraktamekasthamekAhAtkalalaM bhavet
verses.translation: According to the present text Daksa had sixty daughters. Of these he gave 10 to Dharma, to Kasyapa, 27 to Soma, 4 to Ari;tane- min 2 to Brahmaputra, 2 to Ahgiras and 2 Krsasva. But the assignment is not uniform in all the Puranas. For instance MP (5. 13-14) assigns

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चरात्रेण कललं बुद्बुदाकारतां व्रजेत् । बुद्बुदः सप्तरात्रेण मांसपेशी भवेत् पुनः
verses.transliteration: pa~ncharAtreNa kalalaM budbudAkAratAM vrajet | budbudaH saptarAtreNa mAMsapeshI bhavet punaH
verses.translation: Aya, Dhruva, Soma, Dhara, Anila, Anala, Pratyusa and Prabhasa are the eight Vasus by name.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीवा शिरश्च स्कन्धौ च पृष्ठवंशस्तथोदरम् । पाणिपादं तथा पार्श्वे कटिर्गात्रं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: grIvA shirashcha skandhau cha pR^iShThavaMshastathodaram | pANipAdaM tathA pArshve kaTirgAtraM tathaiva cha
verses.translation: Aya's sons arc Vaitanda, Srama, Santa and Muni. Dhruva's son was lord Kala influencing the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: द्विमासाभ्यन्तरेणैव क्रमशः शम्भवेदिह । त्रिभिर्मासैः प्रजायन्ते सर्वे ह्यङ्कुरसन्धयः
verses.transliteration: dvimAsAbhyantareNaiva kramashaH shambhavediha | tribhirmAsaiH prajAyante sarve hya~NkurasandhayaH
verses.translation: Manohara's sons were Sasira, Prana and

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । शृणु व्यास समासेन शास्त्रसारमशेषतः । वदिष्यामि सुवैराग्यं मुमुक्षोर्भवबन्धकृत्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | shR^iNu vyAsa samAsena shAstrasAramasheShataH | vadiShyAmi suvairAgyaM mumukShorbhavabandhakR^it
verses.translation: His sons were Sakha, Visakha and Naigameya. The son of Krttikas was called Karttikeya,®

verses.sanskrit: दन्तपङ्क्तिस्तथा गुह्यं जायन्ते च नखाः पुनः । कर्णयोस्तु भवेच्छिद्रं षण्मासाभ्यन्तरेण तु
verses.transliteration: dantapa~NktistathA guhyaM jAyante cha nakhAH punaH | karNayostu bhavechChidraM ShaNmAsAbhyantareNa tu
verses.translation: Brhaspati's sister was a woman of excellence, well-versed in Yoga and she traversed the entire world maintaining celibacy. She became the wife ot Prabhasa the eighth of Vasus. O fortunate one, Viwakarman the patriarch was born of him.'

verses.sanskrit: पायुर्मेहमुपस्थं च नाभिश्चाभ्युपजायते । सन्धयो ये च गात्रेषु मासैर्जायन्ति सप्तभिः
verses.transliteration: pAyurmehamupasthaM cha nAbhishchAbhyupajAyate | sandhayo ye cha gAtreShu mAsairjAyanti saptabhiH
verses.translation: He built the aerial chariots of all god s. He is a great Atman whose craft is emulated and made use of by men too.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसम्पूर्णः परिपक्वः स तिष्ठति । उदरे मातुराच्छन्नो जरायौ मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: a~Ngapratya~NgasampUrNaH paripakvaH sa tiShThati | udare mAturAchChanno jarAyau munisattama
verses.translation: According to another version his wife Sarupa gave birth to crores of Rudras such as Raivata, Aja, Bhava, Bhima, Varna, Ugra, Vrsakapi, Ajaikapad, Ahirbudhnya, Bahurupa, Mahat etc. Eleven of them are important. O sage, listen to their names.

verses.sanskrit: मातुराहारचौर्येण षड्विधेन रसेन तु । नाभिनालनिबद्धेन वर्द्धते स दिने दिने
verses.transliteration: mAturAhArachauryeNa ShaDvidhena rasena tu | nAbhinAlanibaddhena varddhate sa dine dine
verses.translation: The patriarch Viivakarma, son of Vasu Prabhasa, was the craftsman of the gods ancl entrusted with the work of building chariots, ornaments, palac<'s etc. MP 5. 27-V8, Sec P. 389 note 295.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्मृतिं लभेज्जीवः सम्पूर्णेऽस्मिन् शरीरके । सुखं दुःखं विजानाति निद्रास्वप्नं पुराकृतम्
verses.transliteration: tataH smR^itiM labhejjIvaH sampUrNe.asmin sharIrake | sukhaM duHkhaM vijAnAti nidrAsvapnaM purAkR^itam
verses.translation: These eleven are the Rudras, lords of the three worlds viz: — Ajaikapad, Ahirbudhnya, Tvastr, the powerful Rudrahara of many forms, Tryambaka, Aparajita, Vr§akapi, ambhu, Kapardin and Raivata.®

verses.sanskrit: मृतश्चाहं पुनर्जातो जातश्चाहं पुनर्मृतः । नानायोनिसहस्राणि मया दृष्टानि जायता
verses.transliteration: mR^itashchAhaM punarjAto jAtashchAhaM punarmR^itaH | nAnAyonisahasrANi mayA dR^iShTAni jAyatA
verses.translation: Thus a hundred Rudras of immense prowess have been mentioned to you. Now listen to the names of Kayapa's wives, O excellent sage.

verses.sanskrit: अधुना जातमात्रोऽहं प्राप्तसंस्कार एव च । श्रेयोऽमुना करिष्यामि येन गर्भे न सम्भवः
verses.transliteration: adhunA jAtamAtro.ahaM prAptasaMskAra eva cha | shreyo.amunA kariShyAmi yena garbhe na sambhavaH
verses.translation: O brahmin, they are Aditi, Surasa, Aristela, Danti, Surabhi, Vinata, Ila, Tamra, Krodhavasa, Kadru and Muni. Now listen to the names of their sons. In the previous excellent Manvantara twelve excellent gods were born.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थश्चिन्तयन्नेवमहं गर्भाद्विनिःसृतः । अन्वेष्यामि शिवज्ञानं संसारविनिवर्तकम्
verses.transliteration: garbhasthashchintayannevamahaM garbhAdviniHsR^itaH | anveShyAmi shivaj~nAnaM saMsAravinivartakam
verses.translation: They are Tusitas. During the intervening period of the Vaivasvata and Gaksusa Manvantaras they consulted one another for the welfare of the worlds. After meeting together they spoke — "We will enter Aditi and be born. This will happen for the welfare of the gods." After con¬ ferring they were born of Aditi daughter of Daksa and Kasyapa son of Marici. Visnu and Indra were born again.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स गर्भदुःखेन महता परिपीडितः । जीवः कर्मवशादास्ते मोक्षोपायं विचिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration: evaM sa garbhaduHkhena mahatA paripIDitaH | jIvaH karmavashAdAste mokShopAyaM vichintayan
verses.translation: They along with Aryaman, Dhatr, Tvastr, Pusan, Vivasvat, Savitr, Mitravaruna, Arhsa, Bhaga and Atilejas are the twelve Adityas. Those who were born before as Tusitas were born again as the twelve Adityas in the Gaksusa Manvantara, O aunaka thus the names of Aditi's sons have been mentioned to you. •

verses.sanskrit: पाकपात्रस्य मध्ये तु पृथगन्नं पृथग्जलम् । अग्नेरूर्ध्वं जलं स्थाप्यं तदन्नं च जलोपरि
verses.transliteration: pAkapAtrasya madhye tu pR^ithagannaM pR^ithagjalam | agnerUrdhvaM jalaM sthApyaM tadannaM cha jalopari
verses.translation: Diptis of immeasurable splendour became the children of the twentyseven women of sacred rites and the wives of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: यथा गिरिवराक्रान्तः कश्चिद्दुःखेन तिष्ठति । तथा जरायुणा देही दुःखं तिष्ठति वेष्टितः
verses.transliteration: yathA girivarAkrAntaH kashchidduHkhena tiShThati | tathA jarAyuNA dehI duHkhaM tiShThati veShTitaH
verses.translation: The children of Aristanemi's wives were shcteen in number. "O celestial sage, the learned Krsava had many sons. Four of them are known as Devapraharana. O sage, in his wife Arcis, Dhumrakesa too was born.

verses.sanskrit: पतितः सागरे यद्वद्दुःखमास्ते समाकुलः । गर्भोदकेन सिक्ताङ्गः सर्वदाकुलितस्तदा
verses.transliteration: patitaH sAgare yadvadduHkhamAste samAkulaH | garbhodakena siktA~NgaH sarvadAkulitastadA
verses.translation: Two wives were Svadha and Sati of whom Svadha was the elder and Sati the younger. Svadha gave birth to the Pitrs and Sati to the Atharvarigirasaveda.

verses.sanskrit: लोहकुम्भे यथा न्यस्तः पच्यते कश्चिदग्निना । गर्भकुम्भे तथा क्षिप्तः पच्यते जठराग्निना
verses.transliteration: lohakumbhe yathA nyastaH pachyate kashchidagninA | garbhakumbhe tathA kShiptaH pachyate jaTharAgninA
verses.translation: At the end of a thousand Yugas these will be born again. All the groups of the gods are ihirtythree.

verses.sanskrit: सूचीभिरग्निवर्णाभिर्निर्भिन्नस्य निरन्तरम् । यद्दुःखं जायते तस्य तत्र संस्थस्य चाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: sUchIbhiragnivarNAbhirnirbhinnasya nirantaram | yadduHkhaM jAyate tasya tatra saMsthasya chAdhikam
verses.translation: Just as the sun rises and sets every day so also the groups of gods are born in every Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भावासात्परं दुःखं कष्टं नैवास्ति कुत्रचित् । देहिनां दुःखबहुलं सुघोरमतिसङ्कटम्
verses.transliteration: garbhAvAsAtparaM duHkhaM kaShTaM naivAsti kutrachit | dehinAM duHkhabahulaM sughoramatisa~NkaTam
verses.translation: We have heard that Hiranyakasipu and Hiranyaksa were born as the sons of Dili and Kasyapa.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत्सुमहद्दुःखं पापिनां परिकीर्तितम् । केवलं धर्मबुध्दीनां सप्तमासैर्भवः सदा
verses.transliteration: ityetatsumahadduHkhaM pApinAM parikIrtitam | kevalaM dharmabudhdInAM saptamAsairbhavaH sadA
verses.translation: Siihhika their daughter became the wife of Vipra- citti. The four sons of Hiranyakasipu were famous for their strength and prowess.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भात्सुदुर्लभं दुःखं योनियन्त्रनिपीडनात् । भवेत्पापात्मनां व्यास न हि धर्मयुतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: garbhAtsudurlabhaM duHkhaM yoniyantranipIDanAt | bhavetpApAtmanAM vyAsa na hi dharmayutAtmanAm
verses.translation: They are Anuhrada, Hrada, Sariihrada and Prahlada. The youngest Prahlada wai a devotee of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: इक्षुवत्पीड्यमानस्य यन्त्रेणैव समन्ततः । शिरसा ताड्यमानस्य पापमुद्गरकेण च
verses.transliteration: ikShuvatpIDyamAnasya yantreNaiva samantataH | shirasA tADyamAnasya pApamudgarakeNa cha
verses.translation: Puloman and Mahisa were the sons of Anuhrada born of Surya. Hrada's wife Dhamani gave birth to Vatapi and Ilvala.

verses.sanskrit: यन्त्रेण पीडिता यद्वन्निःसाराः स्स्युस्तिलाः क्षणात् । तथा शरीरं निस्सारं योनियन्त्रनिपीडनात्
verses.transliteration: yantreNa pIDitA yadvanniHsArAH ssyustilAH kShaNAt | tathA sharIraM nissAraM yoniyantranipIDanAt
verses.translation: Samhrada's wife Ryti gave birth to Paftcajana. Virocana was the son of Prahlada. Bali was born of his queen Devi.

verses.sanskrit: अस्थिपादतुलास्तम्भं स्नायुबन्धेन यन्त्रितम् । रक्तमांसमृदालिप्तं विण्मूत्रद्रव्यभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: asthipAdatulAstambhaM snAyubandhena yantritam | raktamAMsamR^idAliptaM viNmUtradravyabhAjanam
verses.translation: O great sage, Bali begot hundred sons of his wife Asana. He was a great devotee of Siva. He engaged himself in the activities of devotion to Siva. He was chari¬ tably inclined and liberal-minded. He attained meritorious fame and austerity. His son Bana was foremost among the devotees of Siva. By propititing Siva he attained the leader¬ ship of Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: जलस्याधः स चाग्निर्हि स्थितोऽग्निं धमते शनैः । वायुना धम्यमानोऽग्निरत्युष्णं कुरुते जलम्
verses.transliteration: jalasyAdhaH sa chAgnirhi sthito.agniM dhamate shanaiH | vAyunA dhamyamAno.agniratyuShNaM kurute jalam
verses.translation: The story of Bana has already been heard by you. In the battle Krna was delighted with him.

verses.sanskrit: केशरोमनखच्छन्नं रोगायतनमातुरम् । वदनैकमहाद्वारं गवाक्षाष्टकभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: kesharomanakhachChannaM rogAyatanamAturam | vadanaikamahAdvAraM gavAkShAShTakabhUShitam
verses.translation: Prabha was the daughter of Svarbhanu. Sad was the daughter of Puloman. So also Upadanavi, Hayasira and Sarmistha were daughters of Vrsaparvan. Puloma and Pulomika were the daughters of Vaisvanara. They were the wives of Kasyapa son of Marici and had many heroic sons.

verses.sanskrit: ओष्ठद्वयकपाटं च तथा जिह्वार्गलान्वितम् । भोगतृष्णातुरं मूढं रागद्वेषवशानुगम्
verses.transliteration: oShThadvayakapATaM cha tathA jihvArgalAnvitam | bhogatR^iShNAturaM mUDhaM rAgadveShavashAnugam
verses.translation: Kalakhanjas, the powerful sons of Puloma, lived in Hiranyapura.® They could not be killed either by the Danavas or by the gods.

verses.sanskrit: संवर्तिताङ्गप्रत्यङ्गं जरायुपरिवेष्टितम् । सङ्कटेनाविविक्तेन योनिमार्गेण निर्गतम्
verses.transliteration: saMvartitA~Ngapratya~NgaM jarAyupariveShTitam | sa~NkaTenAviviktena yonimArgeNa nirgatam
verses.translation: Vipracitti's sons, born of Sirhhika, were later killed by Arjuna by the grace of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: विण्मूत्ररक्तसिक्ताङ्गं विकोशिकसमुद्भवम् । अस्थिपञ्जरविख्यातमस्मिन् ज्ञेयं कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: viNmUtraraktasiktA~NgaM vikoshikasamudbhavam | asthipa~njaravikhyAtamasmin j~neyaM kalevaram
verses.translation: Due to the intermixture of Daityas and Danavas the.se sons became valorous and famous as Saimhikeyas. They arc thirteen in number.

verses.sanskrit: शतत्रयं षष्ट्यधिकं पञ्च पेशीशतानि च । सार्धाभिस्तिसृभिश्छन्नं समन्ताद्रोमकोटिभिः
verses.transliteration: shatatrayaM ShaShTyadhikaM pa~ncha peshIshatAni cha | sArdhAbhistisR^ibhishChannaM samantAdromakoTibhiH
verses.translation: They were the very powerful Rahu and Salya, Bala, Mahabala, Vatapi, Namuci, Ilvala, Svasrpa, Ajika, Naraka, Kalanabha, Saramana and Sarakalpa. These in¬ creased their races.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरं स्थूलसूक्ष्माभिर्दृश्यादृश्या हि ताः स्मृताः । एतावतीभिर्नाडीभिः कोटिभिस्तत्समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: sharIraM sthUlasUkShmAbhirdR^ishyAdR^ishyA hi tAH smR^itAH | etAvatIbhirnADIbhiH koTibhistatsamantataH
verses.translation: Many sons and grandsons were born of them increas¬ ing the race of Danu. Being innumerable they are not mentioned in detail.

verses.sanskrit: अस्वेदमधुभिर्याभिरन्तस्थः स्रवते बहिः । द्वात्रिंशद्दशनाः प्रोक्ता विंशतिश्च नखाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: asvedamadhubhiryAbhirantasthaH sravate bahiH | dvAtriMshaddashanAH proktA viMshatishcha nakhAH smR^itAH
verses.translation: In the family of Sarhhrada the Daiteyas Nivatakavacas and Maruts were born and they were purified by penance.

verses.sanskrit: पित्तस्य कुडवं ज्ञेयं कफस्याथाढकं स्मृतम् । वसायाश्च पलं विंशत्तदर्धं कपिलस्य च
verses.transliteration: pittasya kuDavaM j~neyaM kaphasyAthADhakaM smR^itam | vasAyAshcha palaM viMshattadardhaM kapilasya cha
verses.translation: Sanmukha and others are glorified as the sons of Tamra. Kaki, iSyeni, Bhasi, Sugrivi, Suki, Grdhrika, Asvi, and

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चार्द्धं तु तुला ज्ञेया पलानि दश मेदसः । पलत्रयं महारक्तं मज्जायाश्च चतुर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchArddhaM tu tulA j~neyA palAni dasha medasaH | palatrayaM mahAraktaM majjAyAshcha chaturguNam
verses.translation: This city of the Pauloina.s and Kalakhanjas (or Kalakeyas) as mentioned in the Mhabliarata (Vana P. GLXXIII. 13) and the Kathasaritsagara (XLV. 135) stood on the sca-routc leading to PalSla. Its exact locus remains still unidentified.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रोऽर्द्धं कुडवं ज्ञेयं तद्बीजं देहिनां बलम् । मांसस्य चैकपिण्डेन पलसाहस्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: shukro.arddhaM kuDavaM j~neyaM tadbIjaM dehinAM balam | mAMsasya chaikapiNDena palasAhasramuchyate
verses.translation: Syienl gave birth to vultures, Bhasi to Bhasas Grdhri to Grdhrakas. SukI gave birth to parrots and Sugrlvl to auspicious birds.

verses.sanskrit: तदन्नमुष्णतोयेन समन्तात्पच्यते पुनः । द्विधा भवति तत्पक्वं पृथक्किट्टं पृथग्रसः
verses.transliteration: tadannamuShNatoyena samantAtpachyate punaH | dvidhA bhavati tatpakvaM pR^ithakkiTTaM pR^ithagrasaH
verses.translation: Tamra the beloved of Kasyapa gave birth to horses, camels and donkeys. Thus the family of Tamra has been described to you.

verses.sanskrit: मासैश्चतुर्भिरङ्गुल्यः प्रजायन्ते यथाक्रमम् । मुखं नासा च कर्णौ मासैः पञ्चभिरेव च
verses.transliteration: mAsaishchaturbhira~NgulyaH prajAyante yathAkramam | mukhaM nAsA cha karNau mAsaiH pa~nchabhireva cha
verses.translation: Vinata had two sons Aruna and Garuda. The latter was the most excellent among birds. He was terrible by virtue of his activities.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तं पलशतं ज्ञेयं विण्मूत्रं यत्प्रमाणतः । अञ्जलयश्च चत्वारश्चत्वारो मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: raktaM palashataM j~neyaM viNmUtraM yatpramANataH | a~njalayashcha chatvArashchatvAro munisattama
verses.translation: Surasa gave birth to a thousand serpents of immeasurable power. They had many hoods. They were powerful enough to traverse the sky, the important among them were the kings Sesa, Vasuki and Taksaka, Airavata, Mahapadma, Kambala and Asvatara. The sons of Aila were Padma, Karkotaka, Dhanafijaya, Mahanila, Mahakarna, Dhrtarastra, Balahaka, Kuhara, Puspadanta, Durmukha, Sumukha, Khararoman, Kharapani and many others.

verses.sanskrit: इति देहगृहं ह्येतन्नित्यस्यानित्यमात्मनः । अविशुद्धं विशुद्धस्य कर्मबन्धाद्विनिर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: iti dehagR^ihaM hyetannityasyAnityamAtmanaH | avishuddhaM vishuddhasya karmabandhAdvinirmitam
verses.translation: Krodhavasa gave birth to many who. were the fanged animals and birds both of land and water. Vara's sons were animals.

verses.sanskrit: मलैर्द्वादशभिः किट्टं भिन्नं देहाद्बहिर्भवेत् । रसस्तु देहे सरति स पुष्टस्तेन जायते
verses.transliteration: malairdvAdashabhiH kiTTaM bhinnaM dehAdbahirbhavet | rasastu dehe sarati sa puShTastena jAyate
verses.translation: Anayusa's sons were fifty. They were very strong. The chief amongst them were Bala, Vrtta, Viksara and Brhan.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णाक्षिनासिका जिह्वा दन्ताः शिश्नो गुदं नखाः । मलाश्रयः कफः स्वेदो विण्मूत्रं द्वादश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: karNAkShinAsikA jihvA dantAH shishno gudaM nakhAH | malAshrayaH kaphaH svedo viNmUtraM dvAdasha smR^itAH
verses.translation: Surabhi gave birth to rabbits and buffaloes; Ila to trees, creepers, spreading vines and all kinds of grass; Khasa gave birth to Yaksa and Raksasas, Muni gave birth to the celestial damsels. Arista gave birth to serpents more ex¬ cellent than human beings in their power.

verses.sanskrit: हृत्पद्मे प्रतिबद्धाश्च सर्वनाड्यः समन्ततः । ज्ञेया रसप्रवाहिन्यस्तत्प्रकारं ब्रुवे मुने
verses.transliteration: hR^itpadme pratibaddhAshcha sarvanADyaH samantataH | j~neyA rasapravAhinyastatprakAraM bruve mune
verses.translation: O great sages, thus the descendants of Kasyapa have been explained to you. They had hundreds of sons and grandsons.

verses.sanskrit: तासां मुखेषु तं सूक्ष्मं प्राणः स्थापयेत् रसम् । रसेन तेन नाडीस्ताः प्राणं पूरयते पुनः
verses.transliteration: tAsAM mukheShu taM sUkShmaM prANaH sthApayet rasam | rasena tena nADIstAH prANaM pUrayate punaH
verses.translation: Such is the creation as mentioned in the Man- vantara, Svarocisa, O dear. Now I shall describe the creation as evolved by Brahman while oflering oblations in the ela¬ borate Varuna sacrifice in the great Vaivasvata Manvantara. All the Brahmarsis born in the beginning, Pitamaha made his mental sons. When a great fight ensued between the gods and the Danavas, Diti lost all her sons. She approached Kasyapa and propitiated him. The delighted Kasyapa asked her to choose a boon as she pleased. She chose the boon that she be favoured with a son of immeasurable power capable of slaying Indra.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The pious fair-comlexioned lady conceived. She began to observe celibacy and other restraints.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The pious fair-comlexioned lady conceived. She began to observe celibacy and other restraints.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२३. त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः । देहाशुचित्वबाल्याद्यवस्थादुःखवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । शृणु व्यास महाबुद्धे देहस्याशुचितां मुने । महत्त्वं च स्वभावस्य समासात्कथयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.23\. trayoviMsho.adhyAyaH | dehAshuchitvabAlyAdyavasthAduHkhavarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | shR^iNu vyAsa mahAbuddhe dehasyAshuchitAM mune | mahattvaM cha svabhAvasya samAsAtkathayAmyaham
verses.translation: \fter impregnating Diti, Kasyapa of noble sacred rites went away satisfied for the performance of penance.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्ट्वात्मदेहस्रोतांसि मृत्तोयैः शोध्यते करः । तथाप्यशुचिभाण्डस्य न विभ्रश्यति किं करः
verses.transliteration: sR^iShTvAtmadehasrotAMsi mR^ittoyaiH shodhyate karaH | tathApyashuchibhANDasya na vibhrashyati kiM karaH
verses.translation: Indra waited for finding out a weak point in her. He found one such when the period of hundred years was short by a year.

verses.sanskrit: कायः सुगन्धधूपाद्यैर्यत्नेनापि सुसंस्कृतः । न जहाति स्वभावं स श्वपुच्छमिव नामितम्
verses.transliteration: kAyaH sugandhadhUpAdyairyatnenApi susaMskR^itaH | na jahAti svabhAvaM sa shvapuchChamiva nAmitam
verses.translation: Due to the gravity of the event destined to happen, once Diti did not wash her feet. She went to sleep with head hanging down.

verses.sanskrit: यथा जात्यैव कृष्णोर्थः शुक्लः स्स्यान्नह्युपायतः । संशोद्ध्यमानापि तथा भवेन्मूर्तिर्न निर्मला
verses.transliteration: yathA jAtyaiva kR^iShNorthaH shuklaH ssyAnnahyupAyataH | saMshoddhyamAnApi tathA bhavenmUrtirna nirmalA
verses.translation: In the meantime Indra entered her belly with the thunderbolt. He cut off the foetus into seven pieces.

verses.sanskrit: जिघ्रन्नपि स्वदुर्गन्धं पश्यन्नपि स्वकं मलम् । न विरज्येत लोकोऽयं पीडयन्नपि नासिकाम्
verses.transliteration: jighrannapi svadurgandhaM pashyannapi svakaM malam | na virajyeta loko.ayaM pIDayannapi nAsikAm
verses.translation: While being split into seven the foetus began to cry in seven different tones. Indra told the foetus "Do not cry, Do not cry" repeatedly. He cut them again but they did not die.

verses.sanskrit: अहो मोहस्य माहात्म्यं येनेदं छादितं जगत् । शीघ्रं पश्यन् स्वकं दोषं कायस्य न विरज्यते
verses.transliteration: aho mohasya mAhAtmyaM yenedaM ChAditaM jagat | shIghraM pashyan svakaM doShaM kAyasya na virajyate
verses.translation: O sage, being felled down they told him with

verses.sanskrit: स्वदेहस्य विगन्धेन न विरज्येत यो नरः । विरागकारणं तस्य किमेतदुपदिश्यते
verses.transliteration: svadehasya vigandhena na virajyeta yo naraH | virAgakAraNaM tasya kimetadupadishyate
verses.translation: For full details of the legend see MP. Ch. 7.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्यैव जगन्मध्ये देह एवाशुचिर्भवेत् । तन्मलावयवस्पर्शाच्छुचिरप्यशुचिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvasyaiva jaganmadhye deha evAshuchirbhavet | tanmalAvayavasparshAchChuchirapyashuchirbhavet
verses.translation: O brahmin sage, at the will of Siva, they eschewed their Daitya nature. They were accepted by Indra with due fraternity.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धलेपापनोदार्थ शौचं देहस्य कीर्तितम् । द्वयस्यापगमाच्छुद्धिः शुद्धस्पर्शाद्विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: gandhalepApanodArtha shauchaM dehasya kIrtitam | dvayasyApagamAchChuddhiH shuddhasparshAdvishudhyati
verses.translation: In the name of Maruts they became gods of great prowess. Thus traversing the sky the fortynine Maruts be¬ came assistants of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गातोयेन सर्वेण मृद्भारैः पर्वतोपमैः । आमृत्योराचरेच्छौचं भावदुष्टो न शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAtoyena sarveNa mR^idbhAraiH parvatopamaiH | AmR^ityorAcharechChauchaM bhAvaduShTo na shudhyati
verses.translation: When they flourished, Visnu the patriarch, offered them kingdoms beginning with Prthu. Listen to that.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थस्नानैस्तपोभिर्वा दुष्टात्मा नैव शुध्यति । श्वदृतिः क्षालिता तीर्थे किं शुद्धिमधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: tIrthasnAnaistapobhirvA duShTAtmA naiva shudhyati | shvadR^itiH kShAlitA tIrthe kiM shuddhimadhigachChati
verses.translation: O great sage, I have explained the creation of living beings to you. Listen to the division of kingdoms. I shall explain that duly now.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रशोणितसंयोगाद्देहः सञ्जायते यतः । नित्यं विण्मूत्रसम्पूर्णस्तेनायमशुचिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: shukrashoNitasaMyogAddehaH sa~njAyate yataH | nityaM viNmUtrasampUrNastenAyamashuchiH smR^itaH
verses.translation: After crowning Prthu the son of Vena in the emperorship, Brahma began to assign the kingdoms in due order.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्भावप्रदुष्टस्य विशतोऽपि हुताशनम् । न स्वर्गो नापवर्गश्च देहनिर्दहनं परम्
verses.transliteration: antarbhAvapraduShTasya vishato.api hutAshanam | na svargo nApavargashcha dehanirdahanaM param
verses.translation: He crowned Soma in the kingdom of birds,

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेण गाङ्गेन जलेन सम्यङ् मृत्पर्वतेनाप्यथ भावदुष्टः । आजन्मनः स्नानपरो मनुष्यो न शुध्यतीत्येव वयं वदामः
verses.transliteration: sarveNa gA~Ngena jalena samya~N mR^itparvatenApyatha bhAvaduShTaH | AjanmanaH snAnaparo manuShyo na shudhyatItyeva vayaM vadAmaH
verses.translation: He crowned Varuna in the kingdom of waters; Vairavana as the lord of kings; Visnu as the lord of Aditvas and Pavaka as the lord of Vasus.

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्वाल्य वह्निं घृततैलसिक्तं प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखं महान्तम् । प्रविश्य दग्धस्त्वपि भावदुष्टो न धर्ममाप्नोति फलं न चान्यत्
verses.transliteration: prajvAlya vahniM ghR^itatailasiktaM pradakShiNAvartashikhaM mahAntam | pravishya dagdhastvapi bhAvaduShTo na dharmamApnoti phalaM na chAnyat
verses.translation: He crowned Daksa as the lord of patriarchs, Indra as the lord of Maruts, and Prahlada of great strength as the lord of Daityas and Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गादितीर्थेषु वसन्ति मत्स्या देवालये पक्षिगणाश्च नित्यम् । भावोज्झितास्ते न फलं लभन्ते तीर्थावगाहाच्च तथैव दानात्
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAditIrtheShu vasanti matsyA devAlaye pakShigaNAshcha nityam | bhAvojjhitAste na phalaM labhante tIrthAvagAhAchcha tathaiva dAnAt
verses.translation: He crowned Vaivasvata Yama in the kingdom of Pitrs, Matrs, Vratas, Mantras and cows.

verses.sanskrit: भावशुद्धिः परं शौचं प्रमाणे सर्वकर्मसु । अन्यथालिङ्ग्यते कान्ता भावेन दुहितान्यथा
verses.transliteration: bhAvashuddhiH paraM shauchaM pramANe sarvakarmasu | anyathAli~Ngyate kAntA bhAvena duhitAnyathA
verses.translation: He crowned the trident-bearing Siva, in the king¬ dom of Yaksas, Raksasas, kings, goblins and ghosts.

verses.sanskrit: मनसो भिद्यते वृत्तिरभिन्नेष्वपि वस्तुषु । अन्यथैव सुतं नारी चिन्तयत्यन्यथा पतिम्
verses.transliteration: manaso bhidyate vR^ittirabhinneShvapi vastuShu | anyathaiva sutaM nArI chintayatyanyathA patim
verses.translation: He crowned Himavat as the lord of mountains, the ocean of rivers, the tiger of deer and Bull as the 'lord of cows.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यध्वमस्य भावस्य महाभाग्यमशेषतः । परिष्वक्तोऽपि यन्नार्या भावहीनं न कामयेत्
verses.transliteration: pashyadhvamasya bhAvasya mahAbhAgyamasheShataH | pariShvakto.api yannAryA bhAvahInaM na kAmayet
verses.translation: He crowned the banyan tree in the kingdom of plants and trees. Thus the kingdom was assigned every¬ where by the lord of subjects.

verses.sanskrit: नाद्याद्विविधमन्नाद्यं भक्ष्याणि सुरभीणि च । यदि चिन्तां समाधत्ते चित्ते कामादिषु त्रिषु
verses.transliteration: nAdyAdvividhamannAdyaM bhakShyANi surabhINi cha | yadi chintAM samAdhatte chitte kAmAdiShu triShu
verses.translation: The lord of the universe, the soul of all, established the son of patriarch Vairaja in the kingdom in the east.

verses.sanskrit: गृह्यते तेन भावेन नरो भावाद्विमुच्यते । भावतः शुचि शुद्धात्मा स्वर्गं मोक्षं च विन्दति
verses.transliteration: gR^ihyate tena bhAvena naro bhAvAdvimuchyate | bhAvataH shuchi shuddhAtmA svargaM mokShaM cha vindati
verses.translation: Similarly, O great king, he established Sudhanvan, son of Kardama, the patriarch, in the kingdom in the south.

verses.sanskrit: भावेनैकात्मशुद्धात्मा दहन् जुह्वन् स्तुवन् मृतः । ज्ञानावाप्तेरवाप्याशु लोकान् सुबहुयाजिनाम्
verses.transliteration: bhAvenaikAtmashuddhAtmA dahan juhvan stuvan mR^itaH | j~nAnAvApteravApyAshu lokAn subahuyAjinAm
verses.translation: The lord directed and assigned the unfailing noble- minded son of Rajas, Ketumat as the king in the kingdom in the west.

verses.sanskrit: यथान्तर्विष्ठया पूर्णः शुचिमान्न बहिर्घटः । शोध्यमानो हि देहोऽयं तेनायमशुचिस्ततः
verses.transliteration: yathAntarviShThayA pUrNaH shuchimAnna bahirghaTaH | shodhyamAno hi deho.ayaM tenAyamashuchistataH
verses.translation: He crowned the indefatigable son of Parjanya the patriarch, Hiranyaroman, in the kingdom in the north.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानामलाम्भसा पुंसां सद्वैराग्यमृदा पुनः । अविद्यारागविण्मूत्रलेपगन्धविशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: j~nAnAmalAmbhasA puMsAM sadvairAgyamR^idA punaH | avidyArAgaviNmUtralepagandhavishodhanam
verses.translation: O great sage, six Manus have already been mentioned to you viz. Svayambhuva, Svarocisa, Uttama, Tamasa, Raivata and Gakua. The present Manu is called Vaivasvata, O great sage.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतच्छरीरं हि निसर्गादशुचि स्मृतम् । त्वङ्मात्रसारं निःसारं कदलीसारसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: evametachCharIraM hi nisargAdashuchi smR^itam | tva~NmAtrasAraM niHsAraM kadalIsArasannibham
verses.translation: The Manus of future are Savarni, Raucya, Brahmasavarni, Dharmasavarni, Rudrasavarni, Devasavarni and Indraasvarni. All these constitute the Manus of the past, present and future. These have been enumerated by me as I have heard.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वैवं दोषवद्देहं यः प्राज्ञः शिथिलो भवेत् । देहभोगोद्भवाद्भावाच्छमचित्तः प्रसन्नधीः
verses.transliteration: j~nAtvaivaM doShavaddehaM yaH prAj~naH shithilo bhavet | dehabhogodbhavAdbhAvAchChamachittaH prasannadhIH
verses.translation: O sage, these fourteen Manvantaras extending over the period past, present and the future have been mentioned to you. A Kalpa consisting of a thousand Yugas is constituted by these.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽतिक्रामति संसारं जीवन्मुक्तः प्रजायते । संसारङ्कदलीसारदृढग्राह्यवतिष्ठते
verses.transliteration: so.atikrAmati saMsAraM jIvanmuktaH prajAyate | saMsAra~NkadalIsAradR^iDhagrAhyavatiShThate
verses.translation: O Saunaka, listen. I shall explain the sages, their sons and the gods; all are famous. Listen with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतन्महाकष्टं जन्मदुःखं प्रकीर्तितम् । पुंसामज्ञानदोषेण नानाकर्मवशेन च
verses.transliteration: evametanmahAkaShTaM janmaduHkhaM prakIrtitam | puMsAmaj~nAnadoSheNa nAnAkarmavashena cha
verses.translation: Marici, Atri, the holy lord Ahgiras, Pulaha, Kratu, Pulastya and Vasistha — these seven are Brahma's sons.

verses.sanskrit: श्लोकार्धेन तु वक्ष्यामि यदुक्तं ग्रन्थकोटिभिः । ममेति परमं दुःखं न ममेति परं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: shlokArdhena tu vakShyAmi yaduktaM granthakoTibhiH | mameti paramaM duHkhaM na mameti paraM sukham
verses.translation: O sage, the seven sages are in the northern quarter. In the Svayambhuva Manvantara there were the gods named Yamas.

verses.sanskrit: बहवोऽपीह राजानः परं लोकमितो गताः । निर्ममत्वसमेतास्तु बद्धाः शतसहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: bahavo.apIha rAjAnaH paraM lokamito gatAH | nirmamatvasametAstu baddhAH shatasahasrashaH
verses.translation: The ten noble-souled sons of Svayambhuva Manu were — Agnidhra, Agnibahu, Medha, Medhatithi, Vasu, Jyoti§mat, Dhrtimat, Havya, Savana and Subhra. O great sage, the Indra there was Yajfia.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थस्य स्मृतिर्यासीत्सा च तस्य प्रणश्यति । सम्मूर्छितेन दुःखेन योनियन्त्रनिपीडनात्
verses.transliteration: garbhasthasya smR^itiryAsItsA cha tasya praNashyati | sammUrChitena duHkhena yoniyantranipIDanAt
verses.translation: Thus O dear, the first divine Manvantara has been mentioned to you. I shall explain the second one. Know as it is.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्येन वायुना वास्य मोहसङ्गेन देहिनः । स्पृष्टमात्रेण घोरेण ज्वरः समुपजायते
verses.transliteration: bAhyena vAyunA vAsya mohasa~Ngena dehinaH | spR^iShTamAtreNa ghoreNa jvaraH samupajAyate
verses.translation: In the second Svarocisa Manvantara these must be known as the great sages, viz-Orjastambha, Parastambha, Rsabha, Vasumat, Jyotismat, Dyutimat and the seventh Rocismat. Then the Indra was Rocana. The gods were known as Tusitas.

verses.sanskrit: तेन ज्वरेण महता सम्मोहश्च प्रजायते । सम्मूढस्य स्मृतिभ्रंशः शीघ्रं सञ्जायते पुनः
verses.transliteration: tena jvareNa mahatA sammohashcha prajAyate | sammUDhasya smR^itibhraMshaH shIghraM sa~njAyate punaH
verses.translation: O great sage, the ten noble-minded sons of Svarocisa Manu, all of great heroism and exploits were Harighna, Sukrti, Jyotis, Ayomurti, Ayasmaya, Prathita, Manasyu, Nabha and Surya.

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्राप्याति पवित्राणि पञ्चगव्यं हवींषि च । अशुचित्वं क्षणाद्यान्ति किमन्यदशुचिस्ततः
verses.transliteration: samprApyAti pavitrANi pa~nchagavyaM havIMShi cha | ashuchitvaM kShaNAdyAnti kimanyadashuchistataH
verses.translation: O sage, the second Manvantara has been men¬ tioned by me. I shall explain the third one. Know it factually.

verses.sanskrit: स्मृतिभ्रंशात्ततस्तस्य स्मृतिर्न्नो पूर्वकर्मणः । रतिः सञ्जायते तूर्णं जन्तोस्तत्रैव जन्मनि
verses.transliteration: smR^itibhraMshAttatastasya smR^itirnno pUrvakarmaNaH | ratiH sa~njAyate tUrNaM jantostatraiva janmani
verses.translation: Vasisjha's seven sons famous as Vasisthas and Hiranyagarbha's sons of great splendour known as Orjas are mentioned as the sages. Uttama the Manu had ten sons, O great sage.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तो मूढश्च लोकोऽयं न कार्ये सम्प्रवर्तते । न चात्मानं विजानाति न परं न च दैवतम्
verses.transliteration: rakto mUDhashcha loko.ayaM na kArye sampravartate | na chAtmAnaM vijAnAti na paraM na cha daivatam
verses.translation: They were Isa, Crjita, Crja, Madhu, Madhava Suci, Sukravaha, Nabhasa, Nabha and Rsabha. The gods were Satyavedaruta and others. O sage, the Indra then was Satyajit. He was the ruler of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: न शृणोति परं श्रेयः सति कर्णेऽपि सन्मुने । न पश्यति परं श्रेयः सति चक्षुषि तत्क्षमे
verses.transliteration: na shR^iNoti paraM shreyaH sati karNe.api sanmune | na pashyati paraM shreyaH sati chakShuShi tatkShame
verses.translation: The great third Manvantara has been explained. O sage, listen. I shall mention the fourth Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: समे पथि शनैर्गच्छन् स्खलतीव पदे पदे । सत्यां बुद्धौ न जानाति बोध्यमानो बुधैरपि
verses.transliteration: same pathi shanairgachChan skhalatIva pade pade | satyAM buddhau na jAnAti bodhyamAno budhairapi
verses.translation: The seven sages were Gargya, Prthu, Vagmin, Janya, Dhata, Kapinaka and the seventh Kapivat. The groups of gods were Satyas.

verses.sanskrit: संसारे क्लिश्यते तेन गर्भलोभवशानुगः । गर्भस्मृतेन पापेन समुज्झितमतिः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: saMsAre klishyate tena garbhalobhavashAnugaH | garbhasmR^itena pApena samujjhitamatiH pumAn
verses.translation: The Indra there was TriSikha. O sage, listen to the names of Manu's sons. The ten sons of great rites of the Mam' Tamasa were Dyutipota, Sautapasya, Tapahula, Tapana, Taporali, Akalmasa, Dhanvin, Khadgin, Mahat and Rsi.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं महत्परं दिव्यं शास्त्रमुक्तं शिवेन तु । तपसः कथनार्थाय स्वर्गमोक्षप्रसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: itthaM mahatparaM divyaM shAstramuktaM shivena tu | tapasaH kathanArthAya svargamokShaprasAdhanam
verses.translation: The fourth Manvantara of Tamasa Manu has been mentioned to you. O dear, now listen to the great fifth Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: ये सत्यस्मिन् शिवे ज्ञाने सर्वकामार्थसाधने । न कुर्वन्त्यात्मनः श्रेयस्तदेव महदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: ye satyasmin shive j~nAne sarvakAmArthasAdhane | na kurvantyAtmanaH shreyastadeva mahadadbhutam
verses.translation: Devabahu, Jaya, the sage VedaSiras, Hiran- yaroman, Parjanya, Drdhva Bahu, Somapa — Thcse and others constituted the seven sages. They were engaged in truth. The gods were Bhutarajasas of the nature of performing penance.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तेन्द्रियवृत्तित्वाद् बाल्ये दुःखं महत्पुनः । इच्छन्नपि न शक्नोति वक्तुं कर्तुं प्रतिक्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: avyaktendriyavR^ittitvAd bAlye duHkhaM mahatpunaH | ichChannapi na shaknoti vaktuM kartuM pratikriyAm
verses.translation: Osage, Arjuna, Pahktivindhya and others shall be known as his sons. They are endowed with great penance. They stay on the mountain Meru.

verses.sanskrit: दन्तोत्थाने महद्दुःखमल्पेन व्याधिना तथा । बालरोगैश्च विविधैः पीडा बालग्रहैरपि
verses.transliteration: dantotthAne mahadduHkhamalpena vyAdhinA tathA | bAlarogaishcha vividhaiH pIDA bAlagrahairapi
verses.translation: The future Manus in this Kalpa will be seven. The future great sages will also be seven in each Manvantara in the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित्क्षुत्तृट्परीताङ्गः क्वचित्तिष्ठति संरटन् । विण्मूत्रभक्षणाद्यं च मोहाद् बालः समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: kvachitkShuttR^iTparItA~NgaH kvachittiShThati saMraTan | viNmUtrabhakShaNAdyaM cha mohAd bAlaH samAcharet
verses.translation: Rama, Vyasa, Atrcya, Diptimat, SubahuSruta, Bharadvaja, and the lustrous Asvatthaman son of Drona will be seven sages in this Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: हृद्यान्यप्यन्नपानानि यं प्राप्य सुरभीणि च । अशुचित्वं प्रयान्त्याशु किमन्यदशुचिस्ततः
verses.transliteration: hR^idyAnyapyannapAnAni yaM prApya surabhINi cha | ashuchitvaM prayAntyAshu kimanyadashuchistataH
verses.translation: !§aradvat son of Gautama, Gautama, Krpa, Kauika, Galava, Ruru and Kayapa will be future seven sages. The future gods are three in number as mentioned by Svayambhu. They are the sons of the noble-souled KaSyapa the son of Marici. Bali the son of Virocana will become their Indra.

verses.sanskrit: कौमारे कर्णपीडायां मातापित्रोश्च साधनैः । अक्षराध्ययनाद्यैश्च नानादुःखं प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: kaumAre karNapIDAyAM mAtApitroshcha sAdhanaiH | akSharAdhyayanAdyaishcha nAnAduHkhaM pravartate
verses.translation: O iSaunaka, the future ten sons of Savarni the Manu will be Visahga, Avanivat, Sumanta, Dhrtimat, Vasu, Suri, Sura, Visnu, Raja and Sumati. Thus the eighth Manvantara has been mentioned. Now listen to the ninth Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: बाल्ये दुःखमतीत्यैव पश्यन्नपि विमूढधीः । न कुर्वीतात्मनः श्रेयस्तदत्र महदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: bAlye duHkhamatItyaiva pashyannapi vimUDhadhIH | na kurvItAtmanaH shreyastadatra mahadadbhutam
verses.translation: I shall mention Dakasavarni Manu at the out¬ set. Listen. Medhatithi, Paulastya, Vasu, Kasyapa, Jyoti§mat, Bhargava, Dhrtimat, Ahgiras, Savana son of Vasijha, Havya son of Atri, and Pulaha — these seven are the sages in the Rauhita Manvantara. O great sage, the groups of gods are three.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तेन्द्रियवृत्तित्वात्कामरोगप्रपीडनात् । तदप्राप्ते तु सततं कुतः सौख्यं तु यौवने
verses.transliteration: pravR^ittendriyavR^ittitvAtkAmarogaprapIDanAt | tadaprApte tu satataM kutaH saukhyaM tu yauvane
verses.translation: They are the sons of the patriarch Rohita, son

verses.sanskrit: ईर्ष्यया च महद्दुःखं मोहाद्रक्तस्य तस्य च । नेत्रस्य कुपितस्येव त्यागी दुःखाय केवलम्
verses.transliteration: IrShyayA cha mahadduHkhaM mohAdraktasya tasya cha | netrasya kupitasyeva tyAgI duHkhAya kevalam
verses.translation: In the tenth Manvantara of the second Savarni the following arc the sages, viz. Havi$mat, Pulaha, Prakfti, Bhargava, Aya, Mukti, Atreya and the imperishable Vasi$tha along with the seven great sages viz, ' Paulastya, Prayati, Bhamara, Kasyapa, Angira, Anenasa, and Satya. Those known as Dvi§imant are the groups of gods.

verses.sanskrit: न रात्रौ विन्दते निद्रां कामाग्निपरिवेदितः । दिवापि च कुतः सौख्यमर्थोपार्जनचिन्तया
verses.transliteration: na rAtrau vindate nidrAM kAmAgnipariveditaH | divApi cha kutaH saukhyamarthopArjanachintayA
verses.translation: Sambhu, MaheiSvara himself is as their Indra. The ten sons of the Maim are Aksatvat, Uttamaujas, Bhuriena the powerful, Satanika, Niramitra, Vrsasena, Jayadratha, Bhuridyumna, Suvarca and Arcis.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीष्वध्यासितचित्तस्य ये पुंसः शुक्रबिन्दवः । ते सुखाय न मन्यन्ते स्वेदजा इव ते तथा
verses.transliteration: strIShvadhyAsitachittasya ye puMsaH shukrabindavaH | te sukhAya na manyante svedajA iva te tathA
verses.translation: In the eleventh Manvantara of the third Savarni there arc seven sages. Understand them as they are glorified by me.

verses.sanskrit: कृमिभिस्तुद्यमानस्य कुष्ठिनो वानरस्य च । कण्डूयनाभितापेन यद्भवेत् स्त्रीषु तद्विदः
verses.transliteration: kR^imibhistudyamAnasya kuShThino vAnarasya cha | kaNDUyanAbhitApena yadbhavet strIShu tadvidaH
verses.translation: Havismat Kasyapa, Vapusmat Varuna, Atreya, Vasistha, Anaya, Angiras, Carudhrsya, Paulastya, Nihsvara, Taijasa Agni. The first seven are the sages and the last three groups are of gods.

verses.sanskrit: यादृशं मन्यते सौख्यं गण्डे पूतिविनिर्गमात् । तादृशं स्त्रीषु मन्तव्यं नाधिकं तासु विद्यते
verses.transliteration: yAdR^ishaM manyate saukhyaM gaNDe pUtivinirgamAt | tAdR^ishaM strIShu mantavyaM nAdhikaM tAsu vidyate
verses.translation: There are the sons of Brahma known as

verses.sanskrit: विण्मूत्रस्य समुत्सर्गात्सुखं भवति यादृशम् । तादृशं स्त्रीषु विज्ञेयं मूढैः कल्पितमन्यथा
verses.transliteration: viNmUtrasya samutsargAtsukhaM bhavati yAdR^isham | tAdR^ishaM strIShu vij~neyaM mUDhaiH kalpitamanyathA
verses.translation: Now know the seven sages of the fourth

verses.sanskrit: नारीष्ववस्तुभूतासु सर्वदोषाश्रयासु च । नाणुमात्रं सुखं तासु कथितं पञ्चचूडया
verses.transliteration: nArIShvavastubhUtAsu sarvadoShAshrayAsu cha | nANumAtraM sukhaM tAsu kathitaM pa~nchachUDayA
verses.translation: The Indra then is Rtadhamain. He is the

verses.sanskrit: हे जनाः किन्न पश्यन्ति यन्निर्याति दिने दिने । स्वदेहात्कश्मलं पूतिस्तदाधारः कथं शुचिः
verses.transliteration: he janAH kinna pashyanti yanniryAti dine dine | svadehAtkashmalaM pUtistadAdhAraH kathaM shuchiH
verses.translation: The groups of gods are three in number as

verses.sanskrit: सम्माननावमानाभ्यां वियोगेनेष्टसङ्गमात् । यौवनं जरया ग्रस्तं क्व सौख्यमनुपद्रवम्
verses.transliteration: sammAnanAvamAnAbhyAM viyogeneShTasa~NgamAt | yauvanaM jarayA grastaM kva saukhyamanupadravam
verses.translation: In the fourteenth Manvantara of Satya Manu the seven sages are Agnidhra Kayapa, Magadha, Paulastya Atibahya Bhargava, 3uci Angirasa, Yukta Atreya, *Ajita grandson of Vasitha* and Pulaha. They are the final seven sages. The gods are the holy Caksusas. 3uci will become In<;Jra.

verses.sanskrit: वलीपलितखालित्यैः शिथिलिकृतविग्रहम् । सर्वक्रियास्वशक्तिं च जरया जर्जरीकृतम्
verses.transliteration: valIpalitakhAlityaiH shithilikR^itavigraham | sarvakriyAsvashaktiM cha jarayA jarjarIkR^itam
verses.translation: Afier getting up early in the morning the repeti¬ tion of the names of these sages of the past and future increases the happiness of men.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुंसयौवनं हृद्यमन्योऽन्यस्य प्रियं पुरा । तदेव जरया ग्रस्तमनयोरपि न प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: strIpuMsayauvanaM hR^idyamanyo.anyasya priyaM purA | tadeva jarayA grastamanayorapi na priyam
verses.translation: O great sage, listen. The groups of gods are five. The sons of this Manu are — Tarangabhiru, Budhna, Tanugra, Anugra, Abhimanin Pravina, Viu, Sankrandana, Tejasvin, and Sabala.

verses.sanskrit: अपूर्ववत्स्वमात्मानं जरया परिवर्तितम् । यः पश्यन्नपि रज्येत कोऽन्यस्तस्मादचेतनः
verses.transliteration: apUrvavatsvamAtmAnaM jarayA parivartitam | yaH pashyannapi rajyeta ko.anyastasmAdachetanaH
verses.translation: These were mentioned to Vyasa by Sanatkumara of great splendour. When the thousand Yugas are complete they, of good penance, return to Brahmaloka when their task of protecting the people is over. Each Manvantara consists of seventy one Yugas with some period left over.

verses.sanskrit: जराभिभूतः पुरुषः पुत्रीपुत्रादिबान्धवैः । असक्तत्वाद्दुराधर्षैर्भृत्यैश्च परिभूयते
verses.transliteration: jarAbhibhUtaH puruShaH putrIputrAdibAndhavaiH | asaktatvAddurAdharShairbhR^ityaishcha paribhUyate
verses.translation: These fourteen Manus are glorified. In each Man¬ vantara there is re-creation after annihilation.

verses.sanskrit: धर्ममर्थं च कामं वा मोक्षं वातिजरातुरः । अशक्तः साधितुं तस्माद्युवा धर्मं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: dharmamarthaM cha kAmaM vA mokShaM vAtijarAturaH | ashaktaH sAdhituM tasmAdyuvA dharmaM samAcharet
verses.translation: There all the living beings are burnt by the sun's rays. O sage, all of them enter Visnu at the end of Kalpas along with the Adityas. Vinu then creates all living beings. This happens again and again.

verses.sanskrit: देहः सशोध्यमानोऽपि पञ्चगव्यकुशाम्बुभिः । घृष्यमाण इवाङ्गारो निर्मलत्वं न गच्छति
verses.transliteration: dehaH sashodhyamAno.api pa~nchagavyakushAmbubhiH | ghR^iShyamANa ivA~NgAro nirmalatvaM na gachChati
verses.translation: Lord Rudra annihilates them I shall explain it at the end of Vaivasvata Kalpa. Thus I have mentioned all about the Manvantaras to you. It is a,holy narrative condu- sive to wealth and increase of the family.

verses.sanskrit: स्रोतांसि यस्य सततं प्रभवन्ति गिरेरिव । कफमूत्रपुरीषाद्यैः स देहः शुध्यते कथम्
verses.transliteration: srotAMsi yasya satataM prabhavanti gireriva | kaphamUtrapurIShAdyaiH sa dehaH shudhyate katham
verses.translation: Due to the unbearable heat of her husband she in her prime of youth was dissatisfied.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाशुचिनिधानस्य शरीरस्य न विद्यते । शुचिरेकः प्रदेशोऽपि विण्मूत्रस्य दृतेरिव
verses.transliteration: sarvAshuchinidhAnasya sharIrasya na vidyate | shuchirekaH pradesho.api viNmUtrasya dR^iteriva
verses.translation: Being scorched and not being able to hear the brilliance of the lustrous sun, the fair-complexioned lady was excited and sorrowful.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: On seeing the brilliance of the sun as unbearable as the fire at the final dissolution she created Ghaya of herself.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: On seeing the brilliance of the sun as unbearable as the fire at the final dissolution she created Ghaya of herself.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२४. चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः । स्त्रीस्वभाववर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । कुत्सितं योषिदर्थं यत्सम्प्रोक्तं पञ्चचूडया । तन्मे ब्रूहि समासेन यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे मुने
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.24\. chaturviMsho.adhyAyaH | strIsvabhAvavarNanam | vyAsa uvAcha | kutsitaM yoShidarthaM yatsamproktaM pa~nchachUDayA | tanme brUhi samAsena yadi tuShTo.asi me mune
verses.translation: She of illusory form told Sarhjfia: "O sweet-smiled auspicious lady, what shall I do for you, please tell me".

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चचूडोवाच । मुने शृणु न शक्या स्त्री सती वै निन्दितुं स्त्रिया । विदितास्ते स्त्रियो याश्च यादृश्यश्च स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchachUDovAcha | mune shR^iNu na shakyA strI satI vai nindituM striyA | viditAste striyo yAshcha yAdR^ishyashcha svabhAvataH
verses.translation: "Welfare unto you. I go to my father's house alone. Indeed you have to stay in this house without aberration.

verses.sanskrit: न मामर्हसि देवर्षे नियोक्तुं प्रश्नमीदृशम् । इत्युक्त्वा साभवत्तूष्णीं पञ्चचूडाप्सरोवरा
verses.transliteration: na mAmarhasi devarShe niyoktuM prashnamIdR^isham | ityuktvA sAbhavattUShNIM pa~nchachUDApsarovarA
verses.translation: These two well-behaved sons and this pretty girl should be happily protected if you wish to please me."

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवर्षिवर्यो हि श्रुत्वा तद्वाक्यमुत्तमम् । प्रत्युवाच पुनस्तां वै लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: atha devarShivaryo hi shrutvA tadvAkyamuttamam | pratyuvAcha punastAM vai lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
verses.translation: "O lady, I shall brook their misdeeds even as much as pulling out my hair. I shall make no complaint to you. O goddess, you can go away happily."

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । मृषावादे भवेद्दोषः सत्ये दोषो न विद्यते । इति जानीहि सत्यं त्वं वदातस्तत्सुमध्यमे
verses.transliteration: nArada uvAcha | mR^iShAvAde bhaveddoShaH satye doSho na vidyate | iti jAnIhi satyaM tvaM vadAtastatsumadhyame
verses.translation: Ashamed on being addressed thus, the lady went to her father's house but was rebuked by him. He urged her again and again to return to her husband.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । इत्युक्ता सा कृतमती रभसा चारुहासिनी । स्त्रीदोषान् शाश्वतान्सत्यान् भाषितुं सम्प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | ityuktA sA kR^itamatI rabhasA chAruhAsinI | strIdoShAn shAshvatAnsatyAn bhAShituM samprachakrame
verses.translation: She assumed the form of a mare. Going to Northern Kurus she wandered among the people.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चचूडोवाच । कुलीना नाथवन्त्यश्च रूपवन्त्यश्च योषितः । मर्यादाषु न तिष्ठन्ति स दोषः स्त्रीषु नारद
verses.transliteration: pa~nchachUDovAcha | kulInA nAthavantyashcha rUpavantyashcha yoShitaH | maryAdAShu na tiShThanti sa doShaH strIShu nArada
verses.translation: Though requested by Sarfijfta, Ghaya did not love the elder children. She loved her own son more and fondled him always.

verses.sanskrit: न स्त्रीभ्यः किञ्चिदन्यद्वै पापीयस्तरमस्ति हि । स्त्रियो मूलं हि पापानां तथा त्वमपि वेत्थ ह
verses.transliteration: na strIbhyaH ki~nchidanyadvai pApIyastaramasti hi | striyo mUlaM hi pApAnAM tathA tvamapi vettha ha
verses.translation: The younger brother Yama could not hear that. He did not forgive. Ever since childhood he was furious and and ill-tempered due to the gravity of what was destined to happen later.

verses.sanskrit: समाज्ञातानर्थवतः प्रतिरूपान् यथेप्सितान् । पतीनन्तरमासाद्य नालं नार्यः प्रतीक्षितुम्
verses.transliteration: samAj~nAtAnarthavataH pratirUpAn yathepsitAn | patInantaramAsAdya nAlaM nAryaH pratIkShitum
verses.translation: Due to excessive anger she cursed — "Let your leg fall off". Yama approached his father with palms joined in reverence and said.

verses.sanskrit: असद्धर्मस्त्वयं स्त्रीणामस्माकं भवति प्रभो । पापीयसो नरान् यद्वै लज्जां त्यक्त्वा भजामहे
verses.transliteration: asaddharmastvayaM strINAmasmAkaM bhavati prabho | pApIyaso narAn yadvai lajjAM tyaktvA bhajAmahe
verses.translation: "I was agitated due to Chaya's words. I am sorry and frightened of the curse. I had only said that a mother shall have impartial and equal love for all her children. She has lost affection for us. She nurtures only the youngest one. Hence I raised my foot. It behoves you to forgive me. O lord of gods, O foremost among the refulgent ones, I have been cursed by my mother. O lord of rays, let not my leg fall off by your grace."

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियं च यः प्रार्थयते सन्निकर्षं च गच्छति । ईषच्च कुरुते सेवां तमेवेच्छन्ति योषितः
verses.transliteration: striyaM cha yaH prArthayate sannikarShaM cha gachChati | IShachcha kurute sevAM tamevechChanti yoShitaH
verses.translation: O son, there shall be a great cause for this. That was why you too who know virtue and speak the truth had been infuriated.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । स्त्रीणां स्वभावं वक्ष्यामि शृणु विप्र यथातथम् । यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण भवेद्वैराग्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | strINAM svabhAvaM vakShyAmi shR^iNu vipra yathAtatham | yasya shravaNamAtreNa bhavedvairAgyamuttamam
verses.translation: Her words will come up true and you will also be saved. Have no doubt, O deer, cheer up your mind, O lord.

verses.sanskrit: अनर्थित्वान्मनुष्याणां भयात्पतिजनस्य च । मर्यादायाममर्यादाः स्त्रियस्तिष्ठन्ति भर्तृषु
verses.transliteration: anarthitvAnmanuShyANAM bhayAtpatijanasya cha | maryAdAyAmamaryAdAH striyastiShThanti bhartR^iShu
verses.translation: O great sage, after saying thus to his son Yama, the sun angrily spoke to Chaya.

verses.sanskrit: नासां कश्चिदमान्योऽस्ति नासां वयसि निश्चयः । सुरूपं वा कुरूपं वा पुमांसमुपभुञ्जते
verses.transliteration: nAsAM kashchidamAnyo.asti nAsAM vayasi nishchayaH | surUpaM vA kurUpaM vA pumAMsamupabhu~njate
verses.translation: O beloved wife, O evil-minded angry lady, what it is that you have done? Why do you love one son more? You shall tell me.

verses.sanskrit: न भयादथ वाक्रोशान्नार्थहेतोः कथञ्चन । न ज्ञातिकुलसम्बन्धात् स्त्रियस्तिष्ठन्ति भर्तृषु
verses.transliteration: na bhayAdatha vAkroshAnnArthahetoH katha~nchana | na j~nAtikulasambandhAt striyastiShThanti bhartR^iShu
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the sun she told him the truth. Scorched by him she consoled him thus.

verses.sanskrit: यौवने वर्तमानानामिष्टाभरणवाससाम् । नारीणां स्वैरवृत्तीनां स्पृहयन्ति कुलस्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: yauvane vartamAnAnAmiShTAbharaNavAsasAm | nArINAM svairavR^ittInAM spR^ihayanti kulastriyaH
verses.translation: I shall change your form. I shall make it pleasingly brilliant.

verses.sanskrit: या हि शश्वद् बहुमता रक्ष्यन्ते दयिताः स्त्रियः । अपि ताः सम्प्रसज्जन्ते कुब्जान्धजडवामने
verses.transliteration: yA hi shashvad bahumatA rakShyante dayitAH striyaH | api tAH samprasajjante kubjAndhajaDavAmane
verses.translation: The sage Tvastr put him on the turner's lathe and sharpened him further. His blazing form was slightly redu¬ ced in brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: पङ्गुष्वपि च देवर्षे ये चान्ये कुत्सिता नराः । स्त्रीणामगम्यो लोकेषु नास्ति कश्चिन्महामुने
verses.transliteration: pa~NguShvapi cha devarShe ye chAnye kutsitA narAH | strINAmagamyo lokeShu nAsti kashchinmahAmune
verses.translation: He assumed the form of a horse and approached her for sexual indulgence with her who could not be overwhel¬ med by any living being due to her lustre and observance of restraint.

verses.sanskrit: यदि पुंसां गतिर्ब्रह्मन् कथञ्चिन्नोपपद्यते । अप्यन्योऽन्यं प्रवर्तन्ते न च तिष्ठन्ति भर्तृषु
verses.transliteration: yadi puMsAM gatirbrahman katha~nchinnopapadyate | apyanyo.anyaM pravartante na cha tiShThanti bhartR^iShu
verses.translation: O sage, in the course of the sexual activity she suspected him to be another man. Hence she received the semen through the mouth into the nostril.

verses.sanskrit: अलाभात्पुरुषाणां च भयात्परिजनस्य च । वधबन्धभयाच्चैव ता भग्नाशा हि योषितः
verses.transliteration: alAbhAtpuruShANAM cha bhayAtparijanasya cha | vadhabandhabhayAchchaiva tA bhagnAshA hi yoShitaH
verses.translation: Thence were born the twin gods ASvins, the fore¬ most among physicians. They are known as Nasatyas and Dasras.

verses.sanskrit: चलस्वभाव दुश्चेष्टा दुर्गाह्या भावतस्तथा । प्राज्ञस्य पुरुषस्येह यथा रतिपरिग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: chalasvabhAva dushcheShTA durgAhyA bhAvatastathA | prAj~nasya puruShasyeha yathA ratiparigrahAt
verses.translation: The sun showed his pleasingly splendid form to them. On seeing her husband she was extremely delighted.

verses.sanskrit: नाग्निस्तुष्यति काष्ठानां नापगानां महोदधि । नान्तकः सर्वभूतानां न पुंसां वामलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: nAgnistuShyati kAShThAnAM nApagAnAM mahodadhi | nAntakaH sarvabhUtAnAM na puMsAM vAmalochanAH
verses.translation: The chaste lady returned to the house with her husband with the face beaming with pleasure. The pair rejoiced more than before.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियो मूलं हि दोषाणां लघुचित्ताः सदा मुने । तदासक्तिर्न कर्तव्या मोक्षेप्सुभिरतन्द्रितैः
verses.transliteration: striyo mUlaM hi doShANAM laghuchittAH sadA mune | tadAsaktirna kartavyA mokShepsubhiratandritaiH
verses.translation: This incident distressed the mind of Yama. As pious king he gladdened the subjects virtuously.

verses.sanskrit: इदमन्यच्च देवर्षे रहस्यं सर्वयोषिताम् । दृष्ट्वैव पुरुषं सद्यो योनिः प्रक्लिद्यते स्त्रियाः
verses.transliteration: idamanyachcha devarShe rahasyaM sarvayoShitAm | dR^iShTvaiva puruShaM sadyo yoniH praklidyate striyAH
verses.translation: Yama of great lustre attained the lordship of the names and the guardianship of the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: सुस्नातं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा सुगन्धं मलवर्जितम् । योनिः प्रक्लिद्यते स्त्रीणां दृतेः पात्रादिवोदकम्
verses.transliteration: susnAtaM puruShaM dR^iShTvA sugandhaM malavarjitam | yoniH praklidyate strINAM dR^iteH pAtrAdivodakam
verses.translation: Savarni Manu became the patriarch. In the Savarnika Manvantara he will become the future Manu by virtue of his action.

verses.sanskrit: कायानामपि दातारं कर्त्तारं मानसान्त्वयोः । रक्षितारं न मृष्यन्ति भर्तारं परमं स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: kAyAnAmapi dAtAraM karttAraM mAnasAntvayoH | rakShitAraM na mR^iShyanti bhartAraM paramaM striyaH
verses.translation: The lord is performing penance even today on the top of Meru*i. Their younger sister, the famous Yami, became the most excellent river Yamuna, the sanctifier of all the worlds. He is called Savarni Manu in the world. He who listens to or retains in memory this origin of the gods attains great fame. Should he suffer from any adversity he will be rid of it.

verses.sanskrit: न कामभोगात्परमान्नालङ्कारार्थसञ्चयात् । तथा हितं न मन्यन्ते यथा रतिपरिग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: na kAmabhogAtparamAnnAla~NkArArthasa~nchayAt | tathA hitaM na manyante yathA ratiparigrahAt
verses.translation: Nine sons all equal to him were born of Vaivasvata Manu. Later they became very lofty, bold and devoted to the virtues of Ksatriyas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तकः शमनो मृत्युः पातालं वडवामुखम् । क्षुरधारा विषं सर्पो वह्निरित्येकतः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: antakaH shamano mR^ityuH pAtAlaM vaDavAmukham | kShuradhArA viShaM sarpo vahnirityekataH striyaH
verses.translation: They were Ik§vaku, Sibi, Nabhaga, Dhrsta, Saryati, Nariyanta, Nabhaga, Karusa and Priyavrata.**

verses.sanskrit: यतश्च भूतानि महान्ति पञ्च यतश्च लोको विहितो विधात्रा । यतः पुमांसः प्रमदाश्च निर्मिताः सदैव दोषः प्रमदासु नारद
verses.transliteration: yatashcha bhUtAni mahAnti pa~ncha yatashcha loko vihito vidhAtrA | yataH pumAMsaH pramadAshcha nirmitAH sadaiva doShaH pramadAsu nArada
verses.translation: Desirous of sons, Manu the patriarch performed a sacrifice. O great sage, when no sons were born as a result of the sacrifice, the famous Ila was born, wearing divine garments, bedecked in divine ornaments and with a

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या नारदस्तुष्टमानसः । तथ्यं मत्वा ततस्तद्वै विरक्तोऽभूद्धि तासु च
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasyA nAradastuShTamAnasaH | tathyaM matvA tatastadvai virakto.abhUddhi tAsu cha
verses.translation: See P. 310 not and P. 623 note.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः स्त्रीस्वभावस्ते पञ्चचूडोक्त आदरात् । वैराग्यकारणं व्यास किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: ityuktaH strIsvabhAvaste pa~nchachUDokta AdarAt | vairAgyakAraNaM vyAsa kimanyachChrotumarhasi
verses.translation: She spoke these words to the patriafch desirous of a son — "O foremost among the eloquent, I am born of the parts of Mitra and Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । नारदस्य च संवादं पुंश्चल्या पञ्चचूडया
verses.transliteration: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam | nAradasya cha saMvAdaM puMshchalyA pa~nchachUDayA
verses.translation: I am approaching them. I shall never be interested in sinful things.** After saying this, the chaste lady approached Mitra and Varuna and spoke with palms joined in reverence "O great sages, I am born in the sacri¬ fice of Manu through your parts. I have come to you. Please tell me. What I can do for you. O lord, create >ther sons so that your race may flourish."

verses.sanskrit: लोकान् परिचरन् धीमान् देवर्षिर्नारदः पुरा । ददर्शाप्सरसं बालां पञ्चचूडामनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: lokAn paricharan dhImAn devarShirnAradaH purA | dadarshApsarasaM bAlAM pa~nchachUDAmanuttamAm
verses.translation: When the chaste lady born in the sacrifice of Manu said, the sages Mitra and Varuna spoke thus respect¬ fully.

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छाप्सरसं सुभ्रूं नारदो मुनिसत्तमः । संशयो हृदि मे कश्चित्तन्मे ब्रूहि सुमध्यमे
verses.transliteration: paprachChApsarasaM subhrUM nArado munisattamaH | saMshayo hR^idi me kashchittanme brUhi sumadhyame
verses.translation: O virtuous beautiful lady of fair complexion, both of us are pleased with your self-control, humility and truth.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता तु सा विप्रं प्रत्युवाच वराप्सरा । विषये सति वक्ष्यामि समर्थां मन्यसेऽथ माम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktA tu sA vipraM pratyuvAcha varApsarA | viShaye sati vakShyAmi samarthAM manyase.atha mAm
verses.translation: O blessed lady, you will attain our fame. You alone will become the son establishing the family of Manu.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । न त्वामविषये भद्रे नियोक्ष्यामि कथञ्चन । स्त्रीणां स्वभावमिच्छामि त्वत्तः श्रोतुं सुमध्यमे
verses.transliteration: nArada uvAcha | na tvAmaviShaye bhadre niyokShyAmi katha~nchana | strINAM svabhAvamichChAmi tvattaH shrotuM sumadhyame
verses.translation: You will be famous in the three worlds as Sudyumna, beloved of the universe, virtuous in conduct and enhancer of the race of Manu.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवर्षेरप्सरोत्तमा । प्रत्युवाच मुनीशं तं देवर्षिं मुनिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | etachChrutvA vachastasya devarSherapsarottamA | pratyuvAcha munIshaM taM devarShiM munisattamam
verses.translation: After bearing the son Pururavas she became Sudyu- mna as a result of!§iva's grace.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O dear, when Manu passed away, the earth was divided into ten regions.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O dear, when Manu passed away, the earth was divided into ten regions.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२५. पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः । कालज्ञानवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ त्वत्सकाशान्मया मुने । स्त्रीस्वभावः श्रुतः प्रीत्या कालज्ञानं वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.25\. pa~nchaviMsho.adhyAyaH | kAlaj~nAnavarNanam | vyAsa uvAcha | sanatkumAra sarvaj~na tvatsakAshAnmayA mune | strIsvabhAvaH shrutaH prItyA kAlaj~nAnaM vadasva me
verses.translation: Iksvaku the eldest son got the central territory. At the instance of Vasistha, Sudyumna gave the virtuous territory Pratisthana'*** to Pururavas. O grart sages, Sudy¬ umna had the characteristics of both man and woman. The Sakas were the sons of Narisyanta. Nabhaga's son Ambari§a got the region Blaka* and so was known as Bahleya. Saryati had a son and a daughter. The son was known as Anarta and the daughter as Sukanya who later became the wife of Gyavana. Anarta's son was Raibhya known also as Raivata.

verses.sanskrit: मुखं कर्णौ तथा चक्षुर्जिह्वास्तम्भो यदा भवेत् । तदा मृत्युं विजानीयात्षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे प्रिये
verses.transliteration: mukhaM karNau tathA chakShurjihvAstambho yadA bhavet | tadA mR^ityuM vijAnIyAtShaNmAsAbhyantare priye
verses.translation: In the territory*® of Anarta he got the city KuSasthali which was extremely brilliant and was the seventh among seven cities.

verses.sanskrit: रौरवानुगतं भद्रे ध्वनिं नाकर्णयेद् द्रुतम् । षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे मृत्युर्ज्ञातव्यः कालवेदिभिः
