verses.transliteration: rauravAnugataM bhadre dhvaniM nAkarNayed drutam | ShaNmAsAbhyantare mR^ityurj~nAtavyaH kAlavedibhiH
verses.translation: He had a hundred sons of whom the eldest and the most excellent was Kakudmin. He was brilliant, strong, virtuous and a protector of brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: रविसोमाग्निसंयोगाद्यदोद्योतं न पश्यति । कृष्णं सर्वं समस्तं च षण्मासं जीवितं तथा
verses.transliteration: ravisomAgnisaMyogAdyadodyotaM na pashyati | kR^iShNaM sarvaM samastaM cha ShaNmAsaM jIvitaM tathA
verses.translation: The king Kakudmin the lord of all went to

verses.sanskrit: वामहस्तो यदा देवि सप्ताहं स्पन्दते प्रिये । जीवितं तु तदा तस्य मासमेकं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vAmahasto yadA devi saptAhaM spandate priye | jIvitaM tu tadA tasya mAsamekaM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Then he bowed to Brahma the great Atman, humbly and with palms joined in reverence told him about his mission.

verses.sanskrit: उन्मीलयन्ति गात्राणि तालुकं शुष्यते यदा । जीवितं तु तदा तस्य मासमेकं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: unmIlayanti gAtrANi tAlukaM shuShyate yadA | jIvitaM tu tadA tasya mAsamekaM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: On hearing his purpose the patriarch Brahma laughed. Addressing the great king Kakudmin, he said.

verses.sanskrit: नासा तु स्रवते यस्य त्रिदोषे पक्षजीवितम् । वक्त्रं कण्ठं च शुष्येत षण्मासान्ते गतायुषः
verses.transliteration: nAsA tu sravate yasya tridoShe pakShajIvitam | vaktraM kaNThaM cha shuShyeta ShaNmAsAnte gatAyuShaH
verses.translation: Listen, O King Kakudmin, O lord of the earth, son of Raibhya, to my words with attention. I shall tell you the truth particularly.

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलजिह्वा भवेद्यस्य द्विजाः क्लिद्यन्ति भामिनि । षण्मासाज्जायते मृत्युश्चिह्नैस्तैरुपलक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: sthUlajihvA bhavedyasya dvijAH klidyanti bhAmini | ShaNmAsAjjAyate mR^ityushchihnaistairupalakShayet
verses.translation: All those bridegrooms you had in view have been killed by the efflux of time. Even their family is extinct. Time is the devourer of everything.

verses.sanskrit: अम्बुतैलघृतस्थं तु दर्पणे वरवर्णिनि । न पश्यति यदात्मानं विकृतं पलमेव च
verses.transliteration: ambutailaghR^itasthaM tu darpaNe varavarNini | na pashyati yadAtmAnaM vikR^itaM palameva cha
verses.translation: O king, your city too has been destroyed by Punyajanas, the Rak$asas. It is now the twenty-eighth Dvapara Yuga and the city has been rebuilt by Krsna.

verses.sanskrit: षण्मासायुः स विज्ञेयः कालचक्रं विजानता । अन्यच्च शृणु देवेशि येन मृत्युर्विबुद्ध्यते
verses.transliteration: ShaNmAsAyuH sa vij~neyaH kAlachakraM vijAnatA | anyachcha shR^iNu deveshi yena mR^ityurvibuddhyate
verses.translation: In the name of Dvaravati because it has many entrances, it is very beautiful. It is protected by the Bhojas, Vrnis and Andhaka.s with Krsna as their leader.

verses.sanskrit: शिरोहीनां यदा छायां स्वकीयामुपलक्षयेत् । अथवा छायया हीनो मासमेकं न जीवति
verses.transliteration: shirohInAM yadA ChAyAM svakIyAmupalakShayet | athavA ChAyayA hIno mAsamekaM na jIvati
verses.translation: O king, now go there and give this daughter of yours to Baladeva the son of Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । इदमेव पुरापृच्छत् पार्वती परमेश्वरम् । श्रुत्वा नानाकथां दिव्यां प्रसन्ना सुप्रणम्य तम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | idameva purApR^ichChat pArvatI parameshvaram | shrutvA nAnAkathAM divyAM prasannA supraNamya tam
verses.translation: Thus commanded, the king bowed to him and went to that city. On realising that many Yugas had elapsed he was surprised along with his daughter.

verses.sanskrit: आङ्गिकानि मयोक्तानि मृत्युचिह्नानि पार्वति । बाह्यस्थानि ब्रुवे भद्रे चिह्नानि शृणु साम्प्रतम्
verses.transliteration: A~NgikAni mayoktAni mR^ityuchihnAni pArvati | bAhyasthAni bruve bhadre chihnAni shR^iNu sAmpratam
verses.translation: Then he gave his daughter, the youthful maiden, Revati to Bala the brother of Kfsna in conformity with the Slutric rituals.

verses.sanskrit: रश्मिहीनं यदा देवि भवेत्सोमार्कमण्डलम् । दृश्यते पाटलाकारं मासार्धेन विपद्यते
verses.transliteration: rashmihInaM yadA devi bhavetsomArkamaNDalam | dR^ishyate pATalAkAraM mAsArdhena vipadyate
verses.translation: Then he, the great lord, went to the celestial summit of Meru and propitiated Siva observing penance.

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धतीं महायानमिन्दुं लक्षणवर्जितम् । अदृष्टतारको योऽसौ मासमेकं स जीवति
verses.transliteration: arundhatIM mahAyAnaminduM lakShaNavarjitam | adR^iShTatArako yo.asau mAsamekaM sa jIvati
verses.translation: Raivata stayed in Brahma's region for many Yugas. He returned to the mortal world as a young man. This is my great doubt.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टे ग्रहे च दिङ्मोहः षण्मासाज्जायते ध्रुवम् । उतथ्यं न ध्रुवं पश्येद्यदि वा रविमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTe grahe cha di~NmohaH ShaNmAsAjjAyate dhruvam | utathyaM na dhruvaM pashyedyadi vA ravimaNDalam
verses.translation: Therefore the king did not attain old age or death, nor his daughter. After consulting Brahma about the bridegroom he returned still a young man.

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ धनुर्यदा पश्येन्मध्याह्ने चोल्कपातनम् । वेष्ट्यते गृध्रकाकैश्च षण्मासायुर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: rAtrau dhanuryadA pashyenmadhyAhne cholkapAtanam | veShTyate gR^idhrakAkaishcha ShaNmAsAyurna saMshayaH
verses.translation: Going to the divine city Dvaravati*' rebuilt by Krsna, he got his daughter married to Bala.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयः स्वर्गपन्थाश्च दृश्यन्ते नैव चाम्बरे । षण्मासायुर्विजनीयात्पुरुषैः कालवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: R^iShayaH svargapanthAshcha dR^ishyante naiva chAmbare | ShaNmAsAyurvijanIyAtpuruShaiH kAlavedibhiH
verses.translation: Hundred sons were born to that virtuous great lord. Through many wives Krsna too had innumerable sons.

verses.sanskrit: अकस्माद्राहुणा ग्रस्तं सूर्यं वा सोममेव च । दिक्चक्रं भ्रान्तवत्पश्येत्षण्मासान्म्रियते स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: akasmAdrAhuNA grastaM sUryaM vA somameva cha | dikchakraM bhrAntavatpashyetShaNmAsAnmriyate sphuTam
verses.translation: Thus the race of Saryati has been narrated to you. O brahmins, I shall succinctly mention the details of others too. Listen attentively.

verses.sanskrit: नीलाभिर्मक्षिकाभिश्च ह्यकस्माद् वेष्ट्यते पुमान् । मासमेकं हि तस्यायुर्ज्ञातव्यं परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: nIlAbhirmakShikAbhishcha hyakasmAd veShTyate pumAn | mAsamekaM hi tasyAyurj~nAtavyaM paramArthataH
verses.translation: Nabhaga had a son Dhrsfa. After establishing the Ksatriya race and performing the brahminical rites he attained brahminhood.

verses.sanskrit: गृध्रः काकः कपोतश्च शिरश्चाक्रम्य तिष्ठति । शीघ्रं तु म्रियते जन्तुर्मासैकेन न संशयः
verses.transliteration: gR^idhraH kAkaH kapotashcha shirashchAkramya tiShThati | shIghraM tu mriyate janturmAsaikena na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Dhrsta's race originally Ksatriya became brahmin family on the earth. Karusa's descendants the Karusas were Ksatriyas, insubjugable in war.

verses.sanskrit: एवं चारिष्टभेदस्तु बाह्यस्थः समुदाहृतः । मानुषाणां हितार्थाय सङ्क्षेपेण वदाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: evaM chAriShTabhedastu bAhyasthaH samudAhR^itaH | mAnuShANAM hitArthAya sa~NkShepeNa vadAmyaham
verses.translation: Once due to an error in his charitable gift of a cow, prompted by his own sins and crooked intellect, he became a chameleon.and was redeemed by Srikrsna.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्युवाच । भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन ज्ञातं मे सकलं मतम् । यथार्चनं तु ते देव यैर्मन्त्रैश्च यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: pArvatyuvAcha | bhagavaMstvatprasAdena j~nAtaM me sakalaM matam | yathArchanaM tu te deva yairmantraishcha yathAvidhi
verses.translation: See P. 1229 note yo.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तयोरुभयोर्देवि यथा कालं विजानते । वामदक्षिणयोर्मध्ये प्रत्यक्षं चेत्युदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: hastayorubhayordevi yathA kAlaM vijAnate | vAmadakShiNayormadhye pratyakShaM chetyudAhR^itam
verses.translation: Once a tiger entered the cowshed to attack the cows. On hearing the shrieks of the cows he woke up. Strong that he was he seized a sword to kill it and started.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पक्षौ स्थितौ द्वौ तु समासात्सुरसुन्दरि । शुचिर्भूत्वा स्मरन्देवं सुस्नातः संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: evaM pakShau sthitau dvau tu samAsAtsurasundari | shuchirbhUtvA smarandevaM susnAtaH saMyatendriyaH
verses.translation: On seeing the lord armed with a sword the frigh¬ tened tiger slipped away. Not knowing it and mistaking a reddish brown cow as the tiger he hit it with his sword on its head.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तौ प्रक्षाल्य दुग्धेनालक्तकेन विमर्दयेत् । गन्धैः पुष्पैः करौ कृत्वा मृगयेच्च शुभाशुभम्
verses.transliteration: hastau prakShAlya dugdhenAlaktakena vimardayet | gandhaiH puShpaiH karau kR^itvA mR^igayechcha shubhAshubham
verses.translation: Due to rain and gust of wind in the night he was deluded. Thinking, that the tiger had been killed he returned to his place.

verses.sanskrit: कनिष्ठामादितः कृत्वा यावदङ्गुष्ठकं प्रिये । पर्वत्रयक्रमेणैव हस्तयोरुभयोरपि
verses.transliteration: kaniShThAmAditaH kR^itvA yAvada~NguShThakaM priye | parvatrayakrameNaiva hastayorubhayorapi
verses.translation: When the night dawned into day he got up and went there. He saw only the cow killed and not the tiger. He felt dejected.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपदादि विन्यस्य तिथिं प्रतिपदादितः । सम्पुटाकारहस्तौ तु पूर्वदिङ्मुखसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: pratipadAdi vinyasya tithiM pratipadAditaH | sampuTAkArahastau tu pUrvadi~NmukhasaMsthitaH
verses.translation: On hearing about the incident and realising that he had committed a sin unconsciously and not wilfully, the preceptor cursed him — "Become a Sudra, not a Ksatriya."

verses.sanskrit: स्मरेन्नवात्मकं मन्त्रं यावदष्टोत्तरं शतम् । निरीक्षयेत्ततो हस्तौ प्रतिपर्वणि यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: smarennavAtmakaM mantraM yAvadaShTottaraM shatam | nirIkShayettato hastau pratiparvaNi yatnataH
verses.translation: On being cursed by his preceptor, the family priest out of anger, Prsadhra started from there and went to the great forest.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्पर्वणि सा रेखा दृश्यते भृङ्गसन्निभा । तत्तिथौ हि मृतिर्ज्ञेया कृष्णे शुक्ले तथा प्रिये
verses.transliteration: tasminparvaNi sA rekhA dR^ishyate bhR^i~NgasannibhA | tattithau hi mR^itirj~neyA kR^iShNe shukle tathA priye
verses.translation: Dejected by sufferings he became detached and practised Yoga. He burnt himself in conflagration and attained the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: अधुना नादजं वक्ष्ये सङ्क्षेपात्काललक्षणम् । गमागमं विदित्वा तु कर्म कुर्याञ्छृणु प्रिये
verses.transliteration: adhunA nAdajaM vakShye sa~NkShepAtkAlalakShaNam | gamAgamaM viditvA tu karma kuryA~nChR^iNu priye
verses.translation: Before them O brahmins, there were no kings in Aryavarta. Of them the eldest was Vikuksi. He became the king of Ayodhya.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मविज्ञानं सुश्रोणि चारं ज्ञात्वा तु यत्नतः । क्षणं त्रुटिर्लवं चैव निमेषं काष्ठकालिकम्
verses.transliteration: Atmavij~nAnaM sushroNi chAraM j~nAtvA tu yatnataH | kShaNaM truTirlavaM chaiva nimeShaM kAShThakAlikam
verses.translation: Listen to one of his misdeeds. He wanted to perform Sraddha but before performing the same he ate a rabbit and came to be known as 6asada. Abandoned by Ikfvaku, he entered a forest.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तकं त्वहोरात्रं पक्षमासर्तुवत्सरम् । अब्दं युगं तथा कल्पं महाकल्पं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: muhUrtakaM tvahorAtraM pakShamAsartuvatsaram | abdaM yugaM tathA kalpaM mahAkalpaM tathaiva cha
verses.translation: They all became kings and protectors of the northern country. Ayodha's son was the powerful king Kakutstha.

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि संशयस्त्वेकः कालचक्रं प्रति प्रभो । मृत्युचिह्नं यथा देव किं प्रमाणं यथायुषः
verses.transliteration: adyApi saMshayastvekaH kAlachakraM prati prabho | mR^ityuchihnaM yathA deva kiM pramANaM yathAyuShaH
verses.translation: Kuvalasva had hundred sons who were excellent archers. He was entrusted with the kingdom by his father. After transferring the royal glory to the son the king entered the forest. But Uttahka prevented him.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स हरते कालः परिपाट्या सदाशिवः । वामदक्षिणमध्ये तु पथि त्रयमिदं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: evaM sa harate kAlaH paripATyA sadAshivaH | vAmadakShiNamadhye tu pathi trayamidaM smR^itam
verses.translation: Listen. You shall protect the earth virtuously. O king, only when protected by you can the earth be relieved of excitement and sorrow. It does not behove you to go to the forest. There is a Danava, proud of his strength near my hermitage, in the snow-covered wilderness, full of sea-sand. He is indestructible even* to the gods. He has a huge body and is very strong.

verses.sanskrit: दिनानि पञ्च चारभ्य पञ्चविंशद्दिनावधि । वामाचारगतौ नादः प्रमाणं कथितं तव
verses.transliteration: dinAni pa~ncha chArabhya pa~nchaviMshaddinAvadhi | vAmAchAragatau nAdaH pramANaM kathitaM tava
verses.translation: He stays underground concealed by the sand. The terrible Raksasa son of the demon Madhu is Dhundhu by name.

verses.sanskrit: भूतरन्ध्रं दिशश्चैव ध्वजश्च वरवर्णिनि । वामचारगतौ नादः प्रमाणं कालवेदिनः
verses.transliteration: bhUtarandhraM dishashchaiva dhvajashcha varavarNini | vAmachAragatau nAdaH pramANaM kAlavedinaH
verses.translation: He stays there performing a terrible penance for the destruction of the worlds. At the end of every year he exhales terribly.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतोर्विकारभूताश्च गुणास्तत्रैव भामिनि । प्रमाणं दक्षिणं प्रोक्तं ज्ञातव्यं प्राणवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: R^itorvikArabhUtAshcha guNAstatraiva bhAmini | pramANaM dakShiNaM proktaM j~nAtavyaM prANavedibhiH
verses.translation: When he exhales, the whole world including mountains, forests and wilderness, quakes. Blazing flames with pink smoke smoulder everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: भूतसङ्ख्या यदा प्राणान्वहन्ते च इडादयः । वर्षस्याभ्यन्तरे तस्य जीवितं हि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhUtasa~NkhyA yadA prANAnvahante cha iDAdayaH | varShasyAbhyantare tasya jIvitaM hi na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Hence, O king, I cannot stay in my hermitage. O strong one with huge arms ward him off desiring the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: दशघस्रप्रवाहेण ह्यब्दमानं स जीवति । पञ्चदशप्रवाहेण ह्यब्दमेकं गतायुषम्
verses.transliteration: dashaghasrapravAheNa hyabdamAnaM sa jIvati | pa~nchadashapravAheNa hyabdamekaM gatAyuSham
verses.translation: Let the wordls become happy and peaceful after he had been killed by you. O lord of earth, you alone can slay him.

verses.sanskrit: विंशद्दिनप्रवाहेण षण्मासं लक्षयेत्तदा । पञ्चविंशद्दिनमितं वहते वामनाडिका
verses.transliteration: viMshaddinapravAheNa ShaNmAsaM lakShayettadA | pa~nchaviMshaddinamitaM vahate vAmanADikA
verses.translation: O sinless one, a great boon has been granted to you. Visnu will heighten your splendour by his own splendour.

verses.sanskrit: जीवितं तु तदा तस्य त्रिमासं हि गतायुषः । षड्विंशद्दिनमानेन मासद्वयमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: jIvitaM tu tadA tasya trimAsaM hi gatAyuShaH | ShaDviMshaddinamAnena mAsadvayamudAhR^itam
verses.translation: Great virtue accrues from the protection of the subjects. A similar opportunity is wanting in the forest. Let not your mind be directed that way.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तविंशद्दिनमितं वहते त्वत्यविश्रमा । मासमेकं समाख्यातं जीवितं वामगोचरे
verses.transliteration: saptaviMshaddinamitaM vahate tvatyavishramA | mAsamekaM samAkhyAtaM jIvitaM vAmagochare
verses.translation: O leading king, nowhere such a virtue exists as it does in the protection of the subjects. This has been pursued by the saintly kings of yore.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्प्रमाणं विज्ञेयं वामवायुप्रमाणतः । सव्येतरे दिनान्येव चत्वारश्चानुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: etatpramANaM vij~neyaM vAmavAyupramANataH | savyetare dinAnyeva chatvArashchAnupUrvashaH
verses.translation: Thus requested the saintly king entrusted his son Kuvalasva with the task of thwarting Dhundhu.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं कथय मे नाथ यद्यहं तव वल्लभा । इति पृष्टस्तया देव्या प्रत्युवाच महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sarvaM kathaya me nAtha yadyahaM tava vallabhA | iti pR^iShTastayA devyA pratyuvAcha maheshvaraH
verses.translation: "O holy lord, O excellent brahmin, I have already laid aside my weapons. Here is my son who will surely destroy Dhundhu."

verses.sanskrit: चतुस्स्थाने स्थिता देवि षोडशैताः प्रकीर्तिताः । तेषां प्रमाणं वक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतं हि यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: chatussthAne sthitA devi ShoDashaitAH prakIrtitAH | teShAM pramANaM vakShyAmi sAmprataM hi yathArthataH
verses.translation: Having said thus and instructed his son the king proceeded with penance. Kuvalasva accompanied by Uttahka went to fight with Dhundhu.

verses.sanskrit: षड्दिनान्यादितः कृत्वा सङ्ख्यायाश्च यथाविधि । एतदन्तर्गते चैव वामरन्ध्रे प्रकाशितम्
verses.transliteration: ShaDdinAnyAditaH kR^itvA sa~NkhyAyAshcha yathAvidhi | etadantargate chaiva vAmarandhre prakAshitam
verses.translation: At the approach of Uttahka and for the benefit of the worlds, lord Vi§nu entered him with his splendour.

verses.sanskrit: षड्दिनानि यदा रूढं द्विवर्षं च स जीवति । मासानष्टौ विजानीयाद्दिनान्यष्टौ च तानि तु
verses.transliteration: ShaDdinAni yadA rUDhaM dvivarShaM cha sa jIvati | mAsAnaShTau vijAnIyAddinAnyaShTau cha tAni tu
verses.translation: When the invincible Kuvalasva started there was a loud shout in the heaven. "This glorious prince v/ill slay Dhundhu."

verses.sanskrit: प्राणाः सप्तदशे चैव विद्धि वर्षं न संशयः । सप्तमासान्विजानीयाद्दिनैः षड्भिर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: prANAH saptadashe chaiva viddhi varShaM na saMshayaH | saptamAsAnvijAnIyAddinaiH ShaDbhirna saMshayaH
verses.translation: The gods surrounded him with garlands of flowers. They praised him saying "Be victorious. Be long-lived."

verses.sanskrit: अष्टघस्रप्रभेदेन द्विवर्षं हि स जीवति । चतुर्मासा हि विज्ञेयाश्चतुर्विंशद्दिनावधि
verses.transliteration: aShTaghasraprabhedena dvivarShaM hi sa jIvati | chaturmAsA hi vij~neyAshchaturviMshaddinAvadhi
verses.translation: The most excellent among the victorious, the king went there accompanied by his sons. He caused an ocean *o be dug in the midst of that vast expanse of sand.

verses.sanskrit: यदा नवदिनं प्राणा वहन्त्येव त्रिमासकम् । मासद्वयं च द्वे मासे दिना द्वादश कीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: yadA navadinaM prANA vahantyeva trimAsakam | mAsadvayaM cha dve mAse dinA dvAdasha kIrtitAH
verses.translation: O brahminical sage, heightened in strength by the splendour of Visu he became very brilliant and stronger.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववत्कथिता ये तु कालं तेषां तु पूर्वकम् । अवान्तरदिना ये तु तेन मासेन कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: pUrvavatkathitA ye tu kAlaM teShAM tu pUrvakam | avAntaradinA ye tu tena mAsena kathyate
verses.translation: He appeared to consume all the worlds out of fury in the fire emerging from his mouth. Water too gushed out from him as from the moon-stone at the moonrise.

verses.sanskrit: एकादशप्रवाहेण वर्षमेकं स जीवति । मासा नव तथा प्रोक्ता दिनान्यष्टमितान्यपि
verses.transliteration: ekAdashapravAheNa varShamekaM sa jIvati | mAsA nava tathA proktA dinAnyaShTamitAnyapi
verses.translation: The hundred sons were scorched and burnt in the fire. O great sage, among them only three survived.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशेन प्रवाहेण वर्षमेकं स जीवति । मासान् सप्त विजानीयात्षड्घस्रांश्चाप्युदाहरेत्
verses.transliteration: dvAdashena pravAheNa varShamekaM sa jIvati | mAsAn sapta vijAnIyAtShaDghasrAMshchApyudAharet
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, then the king of great splen¬ dour rushed at the very powerful Raksasa, the brahmin- slayer Dhundhu.

verses.sanskrit: नाडी यदा च वहति त्रयोदशदिनावधि । संवत्सरं भवेत्तस्य चतुर्मासाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: nADI yadA cha vahati trayodashadinAvadhi | saMvatsaraM bhavettasya chaturmAsAH prakIrtitAH
verses.translation: The king quaffed off the gushing water through fiery arrows and quelled the fire through water.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । सत्यं ते कथयिष्यामि शास्त्रं सर्वोत्तमं प्रिये । येन शास्त्रेण देवेशि नरैः कालः प्रबुध्यते
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | satyaM te kathayiShyAmi shAstraM sarvottamaM priye | yena shAstreNa deveshi naraiH kAlaH prabudhyate
verses.translation: After killing the aquatic demon of huge body

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विशद्दिनं शेषं जीवितं च न संशयः । प्राणवाहा यदा वामे चतुर्द्दशदिनानि तु
verses.transliteration: chaturvishaddinaM sheShaM jIvitaM cha na saMshayaH | prANavAhA yadA vAme chaturddashadinAni tu
verses.translation: O great sage, Uttanka granted him boons. He gave him never-ending wealth and invincibility to enemies.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरं भवेत्तस्य मासाः षट् च प्रकीर्तिताः । चतुर्विंशद्दिनान्येव जीवितं च न संशयः
verses.transliteration: saMvatsaraM bhavettasya mAsAH ShaT cha prakIrtitAH | chaturviMshaddinAnyeva jIvitaM cha na saMshayaH
verses.translation: He blessed him with interest in virtue, perpetual residence in the heaven and the imperishable world to his sons who were killed in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चदशप्रवाहेण नव मासान्स जीवति । चतुर्विशद्दिनान्येव कथितं कालवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchadashapravAheNa nava mAsAnsa jIvati | chaturvishaddinAnyeva kathitaM kAlavedibhiH
verses.translation: Three of his sons survived. The eldest of them

verses.sanskrit: षोडशाहप्रवाहेण दशमासान्स जीवति । चतुर्विशद्दिनाधिक्यं कथितं कालवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: ShoDashAhapravAheNa dashamAsAnsa jIvati | chaturvishaddinAdhikyaM kathitaM kAlavedibhiH
verses.translation: He had two daughters Haimavati and Dr$advati honoured by the good. She was famous in the three worlds. Her son was Prasenajit.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तदशप्रवाहेण नवमासैर्गतायुषम् । अष्टादश दिनान्यत्र कथितं साधकेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: saptadashapravAheNa navamAsairgatAyuSham | aShTAdasha dinAnyatra kathitaM sAdhakeshvari
verses.translation: Prasenajit had a chaste wife Gauri.®® She was cursed by her husband and turned into the river Bahuda.

verses.sanskrit: वामचारं यदा देवि ह्यष्टादशदिनावधिः । जीवितं चाष्टमासं तु घस्रा द्वादश कीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: vAmachAraM yadA devi hyaShTAdashadinAvadhiH | jIvitaM chAShTamAsaM tu ghasrA dvAdasha kIrtitAH
verses.translation: Salabindu's daughter the chaste Gaitrarathi was his wife. She was the eldest sister of ten thousand brothers. Mandhata begot of her two sons, Purukutsa, the knower of sacred rites and Mucukunda the righteous.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशद्दिनान्यत्र निश्चयेनावधारय । प्राणवाहो यदा देवि त्रयोविंशद्दिनावधिः
verses.transliteration: chaturviMshaddinAnyatra nishchayenAvadhAraya | prANavAho yadA devi trayoviMshaddinAvadhiH
verses.translation: He was evil-minded. Whenever sacred mantras were recited he put obstacles. After the marriage was cele¬ brated he abducted the brides of others with force, out of lust, delusion, fun or arrogance. He abducted the virgins to satisfy his lust. The king Trayyaruni forsook him for such evil practices. Infuriated he called him a disgraceful wretch.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारः कथिता मासाः षड्दिनानि तथोत्तरे । चतुर्विंशप्रवाहेण त्रीन्मासांश्च स जीवति
verses.transliteration: chatvAraH kathitA mAsAH ShaDdinAni tathottare | chaturviMshapravAheNa trInmAsAMshcha sa jIvati
verses.translation: When cast-off he asked his father where to go. The king asked him to stay with the outcastes.

verses.sanskrit: दिनान्यत्र दशाष्टौ स संहरन्त्येव चारतः । अवान्तरदिने यस्तु सङ्क्षेपात्ते प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: dinAnyatra dashAShTau sa saMharantyeva chArataH | avAntaradine yastu sa~NkShepAtte prakIrtitAH
verses.translation: Cast off by his father the righteous king and pro¬ tector, the heroic Satyavrata lived with the outcastes.

verses.sanskrit: वामचारः समाख्यातो दक्षिणं शृणु साम्प्रतम् । अष्टाविंशप्रवाहेण तिथिमानेन जीवति
verses.transliteration: vAmachAraH samAkhyAto dakShiNaM shR^iNu sAmpratam | aShTAviMshapravAheNa tithimAnena jIvati
verses.translation: Becoming detached due to the activities of his son, the king Trayyaruni forsook everything and went to the forest in order to perform penance to propitiate Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अहः पक्षं तथा मासमृतुं चायनवत्सरौ । स्थूलसूक्ष्मगतैश्चिह्नैर्बहिरन्तर्गतैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ahaH pakShaM tathA mAsamR^ituM chAyanavatsarau | sthUlasUkShmagataishchihnairbahirantargataistathA
verses.translation: O brahmin sage, due to that sinful misdeed Indra did not rain in his kingdom for twelve years.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवाहेण दशाहेन तत्संस्थेन विपद्यते । त्रिंशद्धस्रप्रवाहेन पञ्चाहेन विपद्यते
verses.transliteration: pravAheNa dashAhena tatsaMsthena vipadyate | triMshaddhasrapravAhena pa~nchAhena vipadyate
verses.translation: Vi4vamitra of great penance abandoned his wife in that land and performed extensive penance in the marshy foreshore of the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: एकत्रिंशद्यदा देवि वहते च निरन्तरम् । दिनत्रयं तदा तस्य जीवितं हि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ekatriMshadyadA devi vahate cha nirantaram | dinatrayaM tadA tasya jIvitaM hi na saMshayaH
verses.translation: His wife tied her middle son round her neck and offered him for sale in exchange for a hundred cows in order to sustain the other children.

verses.sanskrit: द्वात्रिंशत्प्राणसङ्ख्या च यदा हि वहते रविः । तदा तु जीवितं तस्य द्विदिनं हि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: dvAtriMshatprANasa~NkhyA cha yadA hi vahate raviH | tadA tu jIvitaM tasya dvidinaM hi na saMshayaH
verses.translation: On seeing her offering her own son, tied round her neck, for sale, Satyavrata released him.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणः कथितः प्राणो मध्यस्थं कथयामि ते । एकभागगतो वायुप्रवाहो मुखमण्डले
verses.transliteration: dakShiNaH kathitaH prANo madhyasthaM kathayAmi te | ekabhAgagato vAyupravAho mukhamaNDale
verses.translation: The mighty Satyabrata sustained him just to satisfy Visvamitra and out of human sympathy.

verses.sanskrit: धावमानप्रवाहेण दिनमेकं स जीवति । चक्रमेतत्परासोर्हि पुराविद्भिरुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: dhAvamAnapravAheNa dinamekaM sa jIvati | chakrametatparAsorhi purAvidbhirudAhR^itam
verses.translation: Ever since then, that son of sage Visvamitra came to be called Galava because he was tied round the neck. He too performed great penance.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं देवि कालचक्रं गतायुषः । लोकानां च हितार्थाय किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaM devi kAlachakraM gatAyuShaH | lokAnAM cha hitArthAya kimanyachChrotumichChasi
verses.translation: By his devotion to Visvamitra his compassionate nature and his vow, Satyavrata nurtured and looked after ViSvamitra's wife.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु तत्त्वेन सुन्दरि । लोकानामुपकारार्थं वैराग्यार्थमुमेऽधुना
verses.transliteration: tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi shR^iNu tattvena sundari | lokAnAmupakArArthaM vairAgyArthamume.adhunA
verses.translation: O sage, he killed deer, boars and buffaloes of the forest and he cast off their flesh near the hermitage of ViSvamitra.

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मात्पाण्डुरं देहमूर्ध्वरागं समन्ततः । तदा मृत्युं विजानीयात्षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे प्रिये
verses.transliteration: akasmAtpANDuraM dehamUrdhvarAgaM samantataH | tadA mR^ityuM vijAnIyAtShaNmAsAbhyantare priye
verses.translation: In virtue of his being the priest and the teacher the sage Vasistha looked after the holy centres, cows, clans and the harem.

verses.sanskrit: ५.२६ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.26 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Vasistha had not prevented the father from exiling the son from the kingdom because there was sufficient cause for the same.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Vasistha had not prevented the father from exiling the son from the kingdom because there was sufficient cause for the same.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२६. षड्विंशोऽध्यायः । कालवञ्चनवर्णनम् । देव्युवाच । कथितं तु त्वया देव कालज्ञानं यथार्थतः । कालस्य वञ्चनं ब्रूहि यथा तत्त्वेन योगिनः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.26\. ShaDviMsho.adhyAyaH | kAlava~nchanavarNanam | devyuvAcha | kathitaM tu tvayA deva kAlaj~nAnaM yathArthataH | kAlasya va~nchanaM brUhi yathA tattvena yoginaH
verses.translation: Only for the satisfaction of his father did he do the same thinking that the family customs should remain unviolated.

verses.sanskrit: तदद्य भोः काल इहास्थि किञ्चित् निहन्यते येन वदस्व तन्मे । त्वं योगिवर्यः प्रभुरात्मतन्त्रः परोपकारात्ततनुर्महेश
verses.transliteration: tadadya bhoH kAla ihAsthi ki~nchit nihanyate yena vadasva tanme | tvaM yogivaryaH prabhurAtmatantraH paropakArAttatanurmahesha
verses.translation: During the twelve years of famine and drought Satyavrata observed his vow. When there was no meat available the prince saw the wish-yielding cow of Vasistha. O sage, the king who observed the ten tenets®® of Dharma

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । न हन्यते देववरैस्तु दैत्यैः सयक्षरक्षोरगमानुषैश्च । ये योगिनो ध्यानपराः सदेहा भवन्ति ते घ्नन्ति सुखेन कालम्
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | na hanyate devavaraistu daityaiH sayakSharakShoragamAnuShaishcha | ye yogino dhyAnaparAH sadehA bhavanti te ghnanti sukhena kAlam
verses.translation: Cp. Manu. VI. 01

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । एतच्छ्रुत्वा त्रिभुवनगुरोः प्राह गौरी विहस्य सत्यं त्वं मे वद कथमसौ हन्यते येन कालः । शम्भुस्तामाह सद्यो हिमकरवदने योगिनो ये क्षिपन्ति कालव्यालं सकलमनघास्तच्छृणुष्वैकचित्ताः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | etachChrutvA tribhuvanaguroH prAha gaurI vihasya satyaM tvaM me vada kathamasau hanyate yena kAlaH | shambhustAmAha sadyo himakaravadane yogino ye kShipanti kAlavyAlaM sakalamanaghAstachChR^iNuShvaikachittAH
verses.translation: If the two iron stakes thrust by me fail I shall fix another cruel one.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । पञ्चभूतात्मको देहः सदा युक्तस्तु तद्गुणैः । उत्पाद्यते वरारोहे तद्विलीनो हि पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | pa~nchabhUtAtmako dehaH sadA yuktastu tadguNaiH | utpAdyate varArohe tadvilIno hi pArthivaH
verses.translation: He called him Trisanku and ever since he is known as Trisanku. When Visvamitra returned he was plea¬ sed with Trisanku for having maintained his family during his absence. When pressed to choose a boon the prince chose it.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशाज्जायते वायुर्वायोस्तेजश्च जायते । तेजसोऽम्बु विनिर्द्दिष्टं तस्माद्धि पृथिवी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: AkAshAjjAyate vAyurvAyostejashcha jAyate | tejaso.ambu vinirddiShTaM tasmAddhi pR^ithivI bhavet
verses.translation: Ever as the gods and Visistha were watching, the saintly lord Viivamitra made him ascend heaven in his physi¬ cal body.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यादीनि भूतानि गच्छन्ति क्रमशः परम् । धरा पञ्चगुणा प्रोक्ता ह्यापश्चैव चतुर्गुणाः
verses.transliteration: pR^ithivyAdIni bhUtAni gachChanti kramashaH param | dharA pa~nchaguNA proktA hyApashchaiva chaturguNAH
verses.translation: His wife Satyaratha, hailing from the family of Kekayas* bore him a son who was named Hari5candra.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिगुणं च तथा तेजो वायुर्द्विगुण एव च । शब्दैकगुणमाकाशं पृथिव्यादिषु कीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: triguNaM cha tathA tejo vAyurdviguNa eva cha | shabdaikaguNamAkAshaM pR^ithivyAdiShu kIrtitam
verses.translation: Haihayas and Talajanghas removed that king. O brahmin, he was very virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धश्च पञ्चमः । विजहाति गुणं स्वं स्वं तदा भूतं विपद्यते
verses.transliteration: shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha raso gandhashcha pa~nchamaH | vijahAti guNaM svaM svaM tadA bhUtaM vipadyate
verses.translation: Securing fiery missiles from Bhargava king Sagara

verses.sanskrit: तदा गुणं विगृह्णाति प्रादुर्भूतं तदुच्यते । एवं जानीहि देवेशि पञ्चभूतानि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: tadA guNaM vigR^ihNAti prAdurbhUtaM taduchyate | evaM jAnIhi deveshi pa~nchabhUtAni tattvataH
verses.translation: Kekayas lived between the Jhelum and the-Beas and had their capital at Glrivraja (Girijak or Jaiaipur) pn the Jhelum.

verses.sanskrit: कालस्तु सन्निकृष्टो हि वर्तते सर्वजन्तुषु । यथा चास्य न मृत्युश्च वञ्चते कालमागतम्
verses.transliteration: kAlastu sannikR^iShTo hi vartate sarvajantuShu | yathA chAsya na mR^ityushcha va~nchate kAlamAgatam
verses.translation: He defeated 6akas,' Bahudakas, Paradas'** taga:i|;ias* and Khaias. He established a good religious cult and ruled over the earth virtuously.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । कथं जेजीयते कालो योगिभिर्योगवित्प्रभो । ध्यानेन चाथ मन्त्रेण तत्सर्वं कथयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | kathaM jejIyate kAlo yogibhiryogavitprabho | dhyAnena chAtha mantreNa tatsarvaM kathayasva me
verses.translation: O sage, listen with attention. I shall narrate what Vaiampayana said on being asked by Janamejaya, son of PSriksita.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि योगिनां हितकाम्यया । परज्ञानप्रकथनं न देयं यस्य कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | shR^iNu devi pravakShyAmi yoginAM hitakAmyayA | paraj~nAnaprakathanaM na deyaM yasya kasyachit
verses.translation: O dear, O lord of the subjects, the kingdom of Bahu who indulged in vices was captured by Haihayas and Talajahghas and the iSakas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्दधानाय दातव्यं भक्तियुक्ताय धीमते । अनास्तिकाय शुद्धाय धर्मनित्याय भामिनि
verses.transliteration: shraddadhAnAya dAtavyaM bhaktiyuktAya dhImate | anAstikAya shuddhAya dharmanityAya bhAmini
verses.translation: Five groups of Rakasas are mentioned, viz. — Yavanas,*® Paradas,®* Kambojas,® Pahlavas*' and Bahudakas.**

verses.sanskrit: सुश्वासेन सुशय्यायां योगं युञ्जीत योगवित् । दीपं विनान्धकारे तु प्रजाः सुप्तेषु धारयेत्
verses.transliteration: sushvAsena sushayyAyAM yogaM yu~njIta yogavit | dIpaM vinAndhakAre tu prajAH supteShu dhArayet
verses.translation: These constituted one of the five clans of Haihayas, the other

verses.sanskrit: तर्जन्या पिहितौ कर्णौ पीडयित्वा मुहूर्त्तकम् । तस्मात्संश्रूयते शब्दस्तुदन्वह्निसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tarjanyA pihitau karNau pIDayitvA muhUrttakam | tasmAtsaMshrUyate shabdastudanvahnisamudbhavaH
verses.translation: Haihayas foimed a branch of the Yadavas who ruled at Mahistnati (Mod. Mandhita in the Nimar District, M.P.) on the Narmada river.

verses.sanskrit: सन्ध्यातो भुक्तमेवं हि चावसन्नं क्षणादपि । सर्वरोगान्निहत्याशु ज्वरोपद्रवकान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: sandhyAto bhuktamevaM hi chAvasannaM kShaNAdapi | sarvarogAnnihatyAshu jvaropadravakAnbahUn
verses.translation: Paradas are identical with the Parthians who lived in the Khorasam region.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चोपलक्षयेन्नित्यमाकारं घटिकाद्वयम् । जित्वा मृत्युं तथा कामं स्वेच्छया पर्यटेदिह
verses.transliteration: yashchopalakShayennityamAkAraM ghaTikAdvayam | jitvA mR^ityuM tathA kAmaM svechChayA paryaTediha
verses.translation: The Taganas or Tahganas had their headquarters at TafigaS- pura near jyotirmatha in Garhwal (Ep. Ind. Vol. XXXI. P. 286).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञः सर्वदर्शी च सर्वसिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् । यथा नदति खेऽब्दो हि प्रावृडद्भिः सुसंयतः
verses.transliteration: sarvaj~naH sarvadarshI cha sarvasiddhimavApnuyAt | yathA nadati khe.abdo hi prAvR^iDadbhiH susaMyataH
verses.translation: According to Al-Biruni, the Khasas were a Himalayan tribe now represented by the Khakkas of Kashmir.

verses.sanskrit: तं श्रुत्वा मुच्यते योगी सद्यः संसारबन्धनात् । ततः स योगिभिर्न्नित्यं सूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: taM shrutvA muchyate yogI sadyaH saMsArabandhanAt | tataH sa yogibhirnnityaM sUkShmAtsUkShmataro bhavet
verses.translation: Yavanas are identical with the Indo-Greeks who settled in the northwestern part of India and adjoining lands.

verses.sanskrit: तथा कथय मे देव प्रीतिं कृत्वा ममोपरि । योगिनां च हिताय त्वं ब्रूहि सर्वसुखप्रद
verses.transliteration: tathA kathaya me deva prItiM kR^itvA mamopari | yoginAM cha hitAya tvaM brUhi sarvasukhaprada
verses.translation: See No. 35 above.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दब्रह्म त्विदं प्राप्य ये केचिदन्यकाङ्क्षिणः । घ्नन्ति ते मुष्टिनाकाशं कामयन्ते क्षुधां तृषाम्
verses.transliteration: shabdabrahma tvidaM prApya ye kechidanyakA~NkShiNaH | ghnanti te muShTinAkAshaM kAmayante kShudhAM tR^iShAm
verses.translation: Kimbojas lived in the land between the Rajauri Valley in Kashmir and the Hindukush mountains. Some scholars locate the tri near Badakhshan beyond the Hindukush.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा परमिदं ब्रह्म सुखदं मुक्तिकारणम् । अबाह्यमक्षरं चैव सर्वोपाधिविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: j~nAtvA paramidaM brahma sukhadaM muktikAraNam | abAhyamakSharaM chaiva sarvopAdhivivarjitam
verses.translation: Bahudakas remain unidentified.

verses.sanskrit: मोहिताः कालपाशेन मृत्युपाशवशङ्गताः । शब्दब्रह्म न जानन्ति पापिनस्ते कुबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: mohitAH kAlapAshena mR^ityupAshavasha~NgatAH | shabdabrahma na jAnanti pApinaste kubuddhayaH
verses.translation: O king, these five groups of Rakasas pursuing activities of exploit on behalf of the Haihayas seized the kingdom of Bahu and gave it to the Haihayas.

verses.sanskrit: तावद् भ्रमन्ति संसारे यावद्धाम न विन्दते । विदिते तु परे तत्त्वे मुच्यते जन्मबन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: tAvad bhramanti saMsAre yAvaddhAma na vindate | vidite tu pare tattve muchyate janmabandhanAt
verses.translation: Having lost the kingdom, Bahu went to the forest along with his wife. Distressed that he was he abandoned his life.

verses.sanskrit: निद्रालस्यं महाविघ्नं जित्वा शत्रुं प्रयत्नतः । सुखासने स्थितो नित्यं शब्दब्रह्माभ्यसन्निति
verses.transliteration: nidrAlasyaM mahAvighnaM jitvA shatruM prayatnataH | sukhAsane sthito nityaM shabdabrahmAbhyasanniti
verses.translation: One of his wives belonging to the house ofYadu followed him in pregnancy. Due to jealousy as a result of her expected son before her, the co-wife administered poison to her.

verses.sanskrit: शतवृद्धः पुमांल्लब्ध्वा यावदायुः समभ्यसेत् । मृत्युञ्जयवपुस्तम्भ आरोग्यं वायुवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: shatavR^iddhaH pumAMllabdhvA yAvadAyuH samabhyaset | mR^ityu~njayavapustambha ArogyaM vAyuvarddhanam
verses.translation: She made the funeral pyre of her husband ready and was about to enter the fire, Aurva Bhargava mercifully prevented her.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्ययो दृश्यते वृद्धे किं पुनस्तरुणे जने । न चोङ्कारो न मन्त्रोऽपि नैव बीजं न चाक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: pratyayo dR^ishyate vR^iddhe kiM punastaruNe jane | na cho~NkAro na mantro.api naiva bIjaM na chAkSharam
verses.translation: The queen stayed in his hermitage for the sake of her child in the womb. She served the sage, mentally remem¬ bering Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अनाहतमनुच्चार्यं शब्दब्रह्म शिवं परम् । ध्यायन्ते देवि सततं सुधियो यत्नतः प्रिये
verses.transliteration: anAhatamanuchchAryaM shabdabrahma shivaM param | dhyAyante devi satataM sudhiyo yatnataH priye
verses.translation: Once when the Muhurta and the Lagna were good when the five planets were ascendant the child was born along with the poison administered to the queen.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छब्दा नव प्रोक्ताः प्राणविद्भिस्तु लक्षिताः । तान् प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्नेन नादसिद्धिमनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tasmAchChabdA nava proktAH prANavidbhistu lakShitAH | tAn pravakShyAmi yatnena nAdasiddhimanukramAt
verses.translation: In that auspicious Lagna, O excellent sage, the king Sagara, of mighty arms, was born.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि पृष्टोऽहं यत्त्वया शिवे । समासेन च सर्वेषां मानुषाणां हितार्थतः
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | shR^iNu devi pravakShyAmi pR^iShTo.ahaM yattvayA shive | samAsena cha sarveShAM mAnuShANAM hitArthataH
verses.translation: Aurva performed the postnatal rites of that prince. He taught him Vedas and Sastras and instructed him in the use of missiles.

verses.sanskrit: नव शब्दान् परित्यज्य तुङ्कारं तु समभ्यसेत् । ध्यायन्नेवं सदा योगी पुण्यैः पापैर्न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: nava shabdAn parityajya tu~NkAraM tu samabhyaset | dhyAyannevaM sadA yogI puNyaiH pApairna lipyate
verses.translation: The blessed Sagara, earnestly learnt the lore of the fiery missile, in accordance with the rules of procedure, the missile that is unbearable even to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: न शृणोति यदा शृण्वन्योगाभ्यासेन देविके । म्रियतेऽभ्यसमानस्तु योगी तिष्ठेद्दिवानिशम्
verses.transliteration: na shR^iNoti yadA shR^iNvanyogAbhyAsena devike | mriyate.abhyasamAnastu yogI tiShTheddivAnisham
verses.translation: The infuriated Sagaras, equipped with this mira¬ culous and other weapons and with his own natural strength, killed the Haihayas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादुत्पद्यते शब्दो मृत्युजित्सप्तभिर्दिनैः । स वै नवविधो देवि तं ब्रवीमि यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdutpadyate shabdo mR^ityujitsaptabhirdinaiH | sa vai navavidho devi taM bravImi yathArthataH
verses.translation: This Sagara became foremost among the famous, earned fame in all the worlds and established piety on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं नदते घोषमात्मशुद्धिकरं परम् । सर्वव्याधिहरं नादं वश्याकर्षणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prathamaM nadate ghoShamAtmashuddhikaraM param | sarvavyAdhiharaM nAdaM vashyAkarShaNamuttamam
verses.translation: Then the Sakas, Yavanas, Kambojas and Pahlavas, being destroyed sought refuge in Vasistha.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं नदते कांस्यं स्तम्भयेत् प्राणिनां गतिम् । विषं भूतग्रहान् सर्वान् बध्नीयान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: dvitIyaM nadate kAMsyaM stambhayet prANinAM gatim | viShaM bhUtagrahAn sarvAn badhnIyAnnAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: After deceitfully compelling them to enter into an agreement, Vasi?tha of great brilliance offered them freedom from fear and brought them to king Sagara.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं नदते शृङ्गमभिचारि नियोजयेत् । विद्विडुच्चाटने शत्रोर्मारणे च प्रयोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: tR^itIyaM nadate shR^i~NgamabhichAri niyojayet | vidviDuchchATane shatrormAraNe cha prayojayet
verses.translation: At the instance of his priest Sagara maintained

verses.sanskrit: घण्टानादं चतुर्थं तु वदते परमेश्वरः । आकर्षः सर्वदेवानां किं पुनर्मानुषा भुवि
verses.transliteration: ghaNTAnAdaM chaturthaM tu vadate parameshvaraH | AkarShaH sarvadevAnAM kiM punarmAnuShA bhuvi
verses.translation: He released the 6akas after shaving off half of their heads. Complete tonsure was assigned to Yavanas and Kambojas.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षगन्धर्वकन्याश्च तस्याकृष्टा ददन्ति हि । यथेप्सितां महासिद्धिं योगिने कामतोऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: yakShagandharvakanyAshcha tasyAkR^iShTA dadanti hi | yathepsitAM mahAsiddhiM yogine kAmato.api vA
verses.translation: Paradas were given close hair-cut and Pahlavas were asked to grow beard and moustache. All of them were deprived of the right of the Vedic study and the use of Vaitkara.

verses.sanskrit: वीणा तु पञ्चमो नादः श्रूयते योगिभिः सदा । तस्मादुत्पद्यते देवि दूरादर्शनमेव हि
verses.transliteration: vINA tu pa~nchamo nAdaH shrUyate yogibhiH sadA | tasmAdutpadyate devi dUrAdarshanameva hi
verses.translation: All those Ksatriyas who had been deprived of virtue were re-instated in piety. The entire earth was con¬ quered by him virtuously.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यापस्तथा तेजो वायुराकाशमेव च । एतेषां हि समायोगः शरीरं पाञ्चभौतिकम्
verses.transliteration: pR^ithivyApastathA tejo vAyurAkAshameva cha | eteShAM hi samAyogaH sharIraM pA~nchabhautikam
verses.translation: Thus conquering the earth virtuously the king instituted a horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया स चोक्तः कथया जनाना- मदृष्टरूपः प्रचरिष्यसीति । दृष्टस्त्वया तत्र महाप्रभावः प्रभोर्वरात्ते पुनरुत्थितश्च
verses.transliteration: tvayA sa choktaH kathayA janAnA\- madR^iShTarUpaH prachariShyasIti | dR^iShTastvayA tatra mahAprabhAvaH prabhorvarAtte punarutthitashcha
verses.translation: In order to search out the horse, king Sagara caused the country around dug up through his sons.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्धि योगिना नित्यं स्वस्वकालेंऽशजा गुणाः । चिन्तनीयाः प्रयत्नेन देवि कालजिगीषुणा
verses.transliteration: tasmAddhi yoginA nityaM svasvakAleM.ashajA guNAH | chintanIyAH prayatnena devi kAlajigIShuNA
verses.translation: As he woke up from trance all but four of the sixty thousand sons were burnt by the fire from his eyes.

verses.sanskrit: एष ते कथितो देवि शब्दब्रह्मविधिक्रमः । पलालमिव धान्यार्थी त्यजेद्बन्धमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: eSha te kathito devi shabdabrahmavidhikramaH | palAlamiva dhAnyArthI tyajedbandhamasheShataH
verses.translation: The four who were spared were Harsaketu, Suketu, Dharmaratha and Paficajana. They became the kings es¬ tablishing his line.

verses.sanskrit: घोषं कांस्यं तथा शृङ्गं घण्टां वीणादिवंशजान् । दुन्दुभिं शङ्खशब्दं तु नवमं मेघगर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: ghoShaM kAMsyaM tathA shR^i~NgaM ghaNTAM vINAdivaMshajAn | dundubhiM sha~NkhashabdaM tu navamaM meghagarjitam
verses.translation: Lord Visnu granted him five boons, viz. flourishing family, intelligence, fame, the ocean as son and wealth.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतो वंशनादं तु सर्वतत्त्वं प्रजायते । दुन्दुभिं ध्यायमानस्तु जरामृत्युविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: dhyAyato vaMshanAdaM tu sarvatattvaM prajAyate | dundubhiM dhyAyamAnastu jarAmR^ityuvivarjitaH
verses.translation: By that virtue he attained the fatherhood of ocean. He regained the sacrificial horse from the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खशब्देन देवेशि कामरूपं प्रपद्यते । योगिनो मेघनादेन न विपत्सङ्गमो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkhashabdena deveshi kAmarUpaM prapadyate | yogino meghanAdena na vipatsa~Ngamo bhavet
verses.translation: He performed a hundred horse-sacrifices and became famous. He acquired wealth bestowed by Siva. He propitiated the deities by performing the sacred rites.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैकमनसा नित्यं तुङ्कारं ब्रह्मरूपिणम् । किमसाध्यं न तस्यास्ति यथामति वरानने
verses.transliteration: yashchaikamanasA nityaM tu~NkAraM brahmarUpiNam | kimasAdhyaM na tasyAsti yathAmati varAnane
verses.translation: Sagara had two wives. They had wiped off their sins by penance. When Aurva the sage was propitiated by them he granted them a boon.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञः सर्वदर्शी च कामरूपी व्रजत्यसौ । न विकारैः प्रयुज्येत शिव एव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: sarvaj~naH sarvadarshI cha kAmarUpI vrajatyasau | na vikAraiH prayujyeta shiva eva na saMshayaH
verses.translation: One of them chose the boon of sixty thousand sons. The other chose one son who would maintain the line of succession in the race.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते परमेशानि शब्दब्रह्मस्वरूपकम् । नवधा सर्वमाख्यातं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: etatte parameshAni shabdabrahmasvarUpakam | navadhA sarvamAkhyAtaM kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi
verses.translation: Having received the boon of heroic sons she gave birth to a big gourd of seeds which were separated.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशस्तु ततो व्यापी सर्वेषां सर्वगः स्थितः । आकाशे तु विलीयन्ते सम्भवन्ति पुनस्ततः
verses.transliteration: AkAshastu tato vyApI sarveShAM sarvagaH sthitaH | AkAshe tu vilIyante sambhavanti punastataH
verses.translation: They were put in jars of ghee and nurtured by nursing maidens. They became princes and enhanced the delight of all.

verses.sanskrit: वियोगे तु सदा कस्य स्वं धाम प्रतिपेदिरे । तस्या न स्थिरता चास्ति सन्निपातस्य सुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: viyoge tu sadA kasya svaM dhAma pratipedire | tasyA na sthiratA chAsti sannipAtasya sundari
verses.translation: When they were burnt by Kapila one Paflcajana became king.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानिनोऽपि तथा तत्र तपोमन्त्रबलादपि । ते सर्वे सुविजानन्ति सर्वमेतन्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnino.api tathA tatra tapomantrabalAdapi | te sarve suvijAnanti sarvametanna saMshayaH
verses.translation: Paflcajana begot a son ArhSumat whose son was Dilipa. Dilipa*s son was Bharatha.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । खं तेन यन्नश्यति घोररूपः कालः करालस्त्रिदिवैकनाथः । दग्धस्त्वया त्वं पुनरेव तुष्टः स्तोत्रैः स्तुतः स्वां प्रकृतिं स लेभे
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | khaM tena yannashyati ghorarUpaH kAlaH karAlastridivaikanAthaH | dagdhastvayA tvaM punareva tuShTaH stotraiH stutaH svAM prakR^itiM sa lebhe
verses.translation: 'Rtuparna's on was Anuparna. His son was IVIitrasaha who was known as Kalmaiapada also.

verses.sanskrit: ५.२७ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.27 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: His story has been described in the Puranas. It is famous in the Ramayaina. It has not been mentioned here in detail.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: His story has been described in the Puranas. It is famous in the Ramayaina. It has not been mentioned here in detail.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२७. सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः । कालवञ्चनशिवप्राप्तिवर्णनम् । देव्युवाच । वायोस्तु पदमाप्नोति योगाकाशसमुद्भवम् । तन्मे सर्वं समाचक्ष्व प्रसन्नस्त्वं यदि प्रभो
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.27\. saptaviMsho.adhyAyaH | kAlava~nchanashivaprAptivarNanam | devyuvAcha | vAyostu padamApnoti yogAkAshasamudbhavam | tanme sarvaM samAchakShva prasannastvaM yadi prabho
verses.translation: At the end of Kali he will revive the extinct solar race along with the contemporary sages.

verses.sanskrit: शतमब्दं तपस्तप्त्वा कुशाग्रापः पिबेद् द्विजः । तदाप्नोति फलं देवि प्राणानां धारणैकया
verses.transliteration: shatamabdaM tapastaptvA kushAgrApaH pibed dvijaH | tadApnoti phalaM devi prANAnAM dhAraNaikayA
verses.translation: These are the kings of Iksvaku family who had gone before. Now listen to the future kings of this family, the most excellent of those who know sacred virtue.

verses.sanskrit: यो द्विजः कल्यमुत्थाय प्राणायामैकमाचरेत् । सर्वं पापं निहन्त्याशु ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: yo dvijaH kalyamutthAya prANAyAmaikamAcharet | sarvaM pApaM nihantyAshu brahmalokaM sa gachChati
verses.translation: Bfhadbala's son will be Brhadrana. Urukriya will be his son.

verses.sanskrit: योऽतन्द्रितः सदैकान्ते प्रणायामपरो भवेत् । जरां मृत्युं विनिर्जित्य वायुगः खेचरीति सः
verses.transliteration: yo.atandritaH sadaikAnte praNAyAmaparo bhavet | jarAM mR^ityuM vinirjitya vAyugaH khecharIti saH
verses.translation: His son will be Vatsavrddha. His son will be Prativyoman. Bhanu will be his son whose son will be Divarka, lord of a vast army.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धस्य भजते रूपं कान्तिं मेधां पराक्रमम् । शौर्यं वायुसमो गत्या सौख्यं श्लाघ्यं परं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: siddhasya bhajate rUpaM kAntiM medhAM parAkramam | shauryaM vAyusamo gatyA saukhyaM shlAghyaM paraM sukham
verses.translation: His son will be a great hero, Sahadeva. His son will be Brhadava. The powerful Bhanumat will be his son.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्कथितमशेषं वायोः सिद्धिं यदाप्नुते योगी । यत्तेजसोऽपि लभते तत्ते वक्ष्यामि देवेशि
verses.transliteration: etatkathitamasheShaM vAyoH siddhiM yadApnute yogI | yattejaso.api labhate tatte vakShyAmi deveshi
verses.translation: The powerful Pratikasva will be the son of Bhanumat. King Supratika will be his son.

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वा सुखासने स्वे शेते जनवचनहीने तु । शशिरवियुतया तेजः प्रकाशयन्मध्यमे देशे
verses.transliteration: sthitvA sukhAsane sve shete janavachanahIne tu | shashiraviyutayA tejaH prakAshayanmadhyame deshe
verses.translation: Marudeva born of an auspicious star will be his son; his son will be Puskara; his son Antariksa; his son Sutapas; his son the heroic Mitrajit; his son Brhadbhaja and his son Barhinaman; his son Krtafljaya; his son Ranaft- jaya; his son Saftjaya; Sakya his son, Suddhoda his son, Langala his son; his son Prasenajit; his son will be Sudraka; Runaka his son; Suratha his son and Sumitra his son. There¬ after the family becomes extinct.

verses.sanskrit: वह्निगतं भ्रूमध्ये प्रकाशते यस्त्वतन्द्रितो योगी । दीपैर्हीनध्वान्ते पश्येन्न्यूनमसंशयं लोके
verses.transliteration: vahnigataM bhrUmadhye prakAshate yastvatandrito yogI | dIpairhInadhvAnte pashyennyUnamasaMshayaM loke
verses.translation: The family of the Iksvakus will end with Sumitra, the family with kings of variegated exploits, sacred rites and virtuous practice.

verses.sanskrit: नेत्रे करशाखाभिः किञ्चित्सम्पीड्य यत्नतो योगी । तारं पश्यन्ध्यायेन्मुहूर्तमर्द्धं तमे९कभावोऽपि
verses.transliteration: netre karashAkhAbhiH ki~nchitsampIDya yatnato yogI | tAraM pashyandhyAyenmuhUrtamarddhaM tame9kabhAvo.api
verses.translation: Reaching upto Sumitra the king in the Kali age that auspicious race will become merged in outside families. It will flourish again in the Krta age.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु तमसि ध्यायन्पश्यति ज्योतिरैश्वरम् । श्वेतं रक्तं तथा पीतं कृष्णमिन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम्
verses.transliteration: tatastu tamasi dhyAyanpashyati jyotiraishvaram | shvetaM raktaM tathA pItaM kR^iShNamindradhanuShprabham
verses.translation: These are the kings in the solar race who made profuse monetary gifts. Those mainly mentioned belong to Ikvaku's family.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । पुरा मे सर्वमाख्यातं योगिनां हितकाम्यया । कालं जिगाय यः सम्यग्वायोर्लिङ्गं यथा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | purA me sarvamAkhyAtaM yoginAM hitakAmyayA | kAlaM jigAya yaH samyagvAyorli~NgaM yathA bhavet
verses.translation: Reading and listening to this creation of Vivasvat,

verses.sanskrit: कारणप्रशमावेशं परकायप्रवेशनम् । अणिमादिगुणावाप्तिर्मनसा चावलोकनम्
verses.transliteration: kAraNaprashamAveshaM parakAyapraveshanam | aNimAdiguNAvAptirmanasA chAvalokanam
verses.translation: On hearing about the excellent solar race of Sraddhadeva, the sage Saunaka respectfully asked Suta.

verses.sanskrit: दूरश्रवणविज्ञानमदृश्यं बहुरूपधृक् । सतताभ्यासयोगेन खेचरत्वं प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: dUrashravaNavij~nAnamadR^ishyaM bahurUpadhR^ik | satatAbhyAsayogena khecharatvaM prajAyate
verses.translation: O Suta, disciple of Vyasa, of long life, obeisance be to you. A divine and pious story has been narrated to us.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुताध्ययनसम्पन्ना नानाशास्त्रविशारदाः । ज्ञानिनोऽपि विमुह्यन्ते पूर्वकर्मवशानुगाः
verses.transliteration: shrutAdhyayanasampannA nAnAshAstravishAradAH | j~nAnino.api vimuhyante pUrvakarmavashAnugAH
verses.translation: It has been mentioned by you that Sraddhadeva is the progenitor of the solar race. I have a doubt therein which I shall mention before you.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्तोऽपि न पश्यन्ति शृण्वाना बधिरा यथा । यथान्धा मानुषा लोके मूढाः पापविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: pashyanto.api na pashyanti shR^iNvAnA badhirA yathA | yathAndhA mAnuShA loke mUDhAH pApavimohitAH
verses.translation: How did the sun become Sraddhadeva? 1 wish to hear this. Please clear this doubt with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्त- मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् । तमेव विदित्वातिमृत्युमेति नान्यः पन्था विद्यते प्रायणाय
verses.transliteration: vedAhametaM puruShaM mahAnta\- mAdityavarNaM tamasaH parastAt | tameva viditvAtimR^ityumeti nAnyaH panthA vidyate prAyaNAya
verses.translation: O holy lord, please mention the glory and the bene¬ fit of iSraddha rite whereby the manes are pleased and bless the performer with prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: एष ते कथितः सम्यक्तेजसो विधिरुत्तमः । कालं जित्वा यथा योगी चामरत्वं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: eSha te kathitaH samyaktejaso vidhiruttamaH | kAlaM jitvA yathA yogI chAmaratvaM prapadyate
verses.translation: I wish to hear this too, namely the creation par ex¬ cellence of the manes. O intelligent one, please mention this particularly. Have mercy on me.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः परतरं वक्ष्ये यथा मृत्युर्न जायते । सावधानतया देवि शृणुष्वैकाग्रमानसा
verses.transliteration: punaH parataraM vakShye yathA mR^ityurna jAyate | sAvadhAnatayA devi shR^iNuShvaikAgramAnasA
verses.translation: O Saunaka, I shall mention everything concerning the creation of the manes. This was narrated to the intelligent Markandeya by Sanatkumara. I shall mention it to you. It bestows the benefit of all cherished desires. Bhisma the fore¬ most of the virtuous lying on the beS of arrows was requested by Yudhisthira to whom he spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: तुरीया देवि भूतानां योगिनां ध्यानिनां तथा । सुखासने यथास्थानं योगी नियतमानसः
verses.transliteration: turIyA devi bhUtAnAM yoginAM dhyAninAM tathA | sukhAsane yathAsthAnaM yogI niyatamAnasaH
verses.translation: On hearing the question of Yudhisthira, Bhima the knower of Dharma spoke with pleasure even as every one was listening.

verses.sanskrit: समुन्नतशरीरोऽपि स बद्ध्वा करसम्पुटम् । चञ्च्वाकारेण वक्त्रेण पिबन्वायुं शनैः शनैः
verses.transliteration: samunnatasharIro.api sa baddhvA karasampuTam | cha~nchvAkAreNa vaktreNa pibanvAyuM shanaiH shanaiH
verses.translation: O Yudhisthira, those who perform Sraddha rites with pleasure delight everyone through them as a result of the favour of the manes.

verses.sanskrit: तेन ज्ञात्वा दिनं योगी प्राणायामपरः स्थितः । स जयत्यागतं कालं मासार्धेनैव सुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: tena j~nAtvA dinaM yogI prANAyAmaparaH sthitaH | sa jayatyAgataM kAlaM mAsArdhenaiva sundari
verses.translation: Men desirous of benefits perform 6raddhas, keeping in view, the father, the grandfather and the great¬ grandfather in three balls of rice. O Yudhi§thira, the manes bless the man desirous of piety with piety, desirous of progeny with progeny and desirous of nourishment with nourishment.

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्रवन्ति क्षणादापस्तालुस्था जीवदायिकाः । ता जिघ्रेद्वायुनादायामृतं तच्छीतलं जलम्
verses.transliteration: prasravanti kShaNAdApastAlusthA jIvadAyikAH | tA jighredvAyunAdAyAmR^itaM tachChItalaM jalam
verses.translation: How do the 6raddhas go to the manes? How those in the hell can derive the benefit?

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्ननुदिनं योगी न मृत्युवशगो भवेत् । दिव्यकायो महातेजाः पिपासाक्षुद्विवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: pibannanudinaM yogI na mR^ityuvashago bhavet | divyakAyo mahAtejAH pipAsAkShudvivarjitaH
verses.translation: I have heard that even the gods worship the manes. I wish to hear this. Please mention this in detail.

verses.sanskrit: बलेन नागस्तुरगो जवेन दृष्ट्या सुपर्णः सुश्रुतिस्तु दूरात् । आकुञ्चिताकुण्डलिकृष्णकेशो गन्धर्वविद्याधरतुल्यवर्णः
verses.transliteration: balena nAgasturago javena dR^iShTyA suparNaH sushrutistu dUrAt | Aku~nchitAkuNDalikR^iShNakesho gandharvavidyAdharatulyavarNaH
verses.translation: O suppressor of enemies, in this context, I shall narrate an event as I have heard from my father who had left this world.

verses.sanskrit: जीवेन्नरो वर्षशतं सुराणां सुमेधसा वाक्पतिना समत्वम् । एवं चरन् खेचरतां प्रयाति यथेष्टचारी सुखितः सदैव
verses.transliteration: jIvennaro varShashataM surANAM sumedhasA vAkpatinA samatvam | evaM charan khecharatAM prayAti yatheShTachArI sukhitaH sadaiva
verses.translation: At the time of 6raddha, the ball of rice for my father was kept ready by me. My father split the ground and requested me to offer the same into his hand.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि विधानं यत्सुरैरपि । गोपितं तु प्रयत्नेन तच्छृणुष्व वरानने
verses.transliteration: punaranyatpravakShyAmi vidhAnaM yatsurairapi | gopitaM tu prayatnena tachChR^iNuShva varAnane
verses.translation: "O sinless one, O most excellent of the descendants of Bharata, gladdened by me my father spoke in sweet words.

verses.sanskrit: समाकुञ्च्याभ्यसेद्योगी रसनां तालुकं प्रति । किञ्चित्कालान्तरेणैव क्रमात्प्राप्नोति लम्बिकाम्
verses.transliteration: samAku~nchyAbhyasedyogI rasanAM tAlukaM prati | ki~nchitkAlAntareNaiva kramAtprApnoti lambikAm
verses.translation: O most excellent of men, I only tested you. I have been redeemed by you the knower of sacred rites and a good scholar. I have been blessed with a real heir in you.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रस्रवते सा तु संस्पृष्टा शीतलां सुधाम् । पिबन्नेव सदा योगी सोऽमरत्वं हि गच्छति
verses.transliteration: tataH prasravate sA tu saMspR^iShTA shItalAM sudhAm | pibanneva sadA yogI so.amaratvaM hi gachChati
verses.translation: What the king does by virtuous or authoritative rites, the subjects too emulate, taking them to be backed by precedent.

verses.sanskrit: रेफाग्रं लम्बकाग्रं करतलघटनं शुभ्रपद्मस्य बिन्दो- स्तेनाकृष्टा सुधेयं पतति परपदे देवतानन्दकारी । सारं संसारतारं कृतकलुषतरं कालतारं सतारं येनेदं प्लाविताङ्गं स भवति न मृतः क्षुत्पिपासाविहीनः
verses.transliteration: rephAgraM lambakAgraM karatalaghaTanaM shubhrapadmasya bindo\- stenAkR^iShTA sudheyaM patati parapade devatAnandakArI | sAraM saMsAratAraM kR^itakaluShataraM kAlatAraM satAraM yenedaM plAvitA~NgaM sa bhavati na mR^itaH kShutpipAsAvihInaH
verses.translation: O most excellent of the descendants of Bharata, listen to the eternal virtues of the Vedas. Proof of the Vedic rite has been shown by you.

verses.sanskrit: एभिर्युक्ता चतुर्भिः क्षितिधरतनये योगिभिर्वै धरैषा धैर्यान्नित्यं कुतोऽन्तः सकलमपि जगद्यत्सुखप्रापणाय । स्वप्ने देही विधत्ते सकलमपि सदा मानयन्यच्च दुःखं स्वर्गे ह्येवं धरित्र्याः प्रभवति च ततो वा स किञ्चिच्चतुर्णाम्
verses.transliteration: ebhiryuktA chaturbhiH kShitidharatanaye yogibhirvai dharaiShA dhairyAnnityaM kuto.antaH sakalamapi jagadyatsukhaprApaNAya | svapne dehI vidhatte sakalamapi sadA mAnayanyachcha duHkhaM svarge hyevaM dharitryAH prabhavati cha tato vA sa ki~nchichchaturNAm
verses.translation: Being delighted I shall grant you excellent boons lovingly. Accept them. They are difficult to obtain in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मन्त्रैस्तपोभिर्व्रतनियमयुतैरौषधैर्योगयुक्ता धात्री रक्ता मनुष्यैर्नयविनययुतैर्धर्मविद्भिः क्रमेण । भूतानामादि देवो न हि भवति चलः संयुतो वै चतुर्णां तस्मादेवं प्रवक्ष्ये विधिमनुगदितं छायिकं यच्छिवाख्यम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAnmantraistapobhirvrataniyamayutairauShadhairyogayuktA dhAtrI raktA manuShyairnayavinayayutairdharmavidbhiH krameNa | bhUtAnAmAdi devo na hi bhavati chalaH saMyuto vai chaturNAM tasmAdevaM pravakShye vidhimanugaditaM ChAyikaM yachChivAkhyam
verses.translation: Death will have no hold on you as long as you wish to live. With your permission it may be effective again.

verses.sanskrit: हृत्स्थो वायुः सदा वह्नेर्दीपकः सोऽनुपावकः । स बाह्याभ्यन्तरो व्यापी वायुः सर्वगतो महान्
verses.transliteration: hR^itstho vAyuH sadA vahnerdIpakaH so.anupAvakaH | sa bAhyAbhyantaro vyApI vAyuH sarvagato mahAn
verses.translation: When he had said this, I saluted him with palms joined in reverence and said — "O bes tower of honour, if you are pleased, I am content. I ask you a question. Please answer it.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानविज्ञानमुत्साहः सर्वं वायोः प्रवर्तते । येनेह निर्जितो वायुस्तेन सर्वमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: j~nAnavij~nAnamutsAhaH sarvaM vAyoH pravartate | yeneha nirjito vAyustena sarvamidaM jagat
verses.translation: He said to me — "Tell me. If you wish I shall grant it to you". When I asked him again the king told me.

verses.sanskrit: गतागता निवर्तन्ते चन्द्रसूर्यादयो ग्रहाः । अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते योगध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: gatAgatA nivartante chandrasUryAdayo grahAH | adyApi na nivartante yogadhyAnaparAyaNAH
verses.translation: O dear, listen. I shall explain your question factually. The entire "Pitrkalpa" has been heard by me from Markandeya.

verses.sanskrit: भुवोर्मध्ये ललाटस्थं बालार्कसमतेजसम् । तं विदित्वा तु कामाङ्गी क्रीडते कामरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: bhuvormadhye lalATasthaM bAlArkasamatejasam | taM viditvA tu kAmA~NgI krIDate kAmarUpadhR^ik
verses.translation: O dear, what you ask me now I had asked the sage Markandeya. He, the knower of sacred rites, replied to me.

verses.sanskrit: धारणायां सदा तिष्ठेज्जरामृत्युजिघांसया । योगी योगरतः सम्यग्धारणाध्यानतत्परः
verses.transliteration: dhAraNAyAM sadA tiShThejjarAmR^ityujighAMsayA | yogI yogarataH samyagdhAraNAdhyAnatatparaH
verses.translation: O king listen. Once as I looked up into the sky, I saw a great aerial chariot coming over the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: लोहकारो यथा भस्त्रामापूर्यमुखतो मुने । साधयेद्वायुना कर्म तद्वद्योगी समभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: lohakAro yathA bhastrAmApUryamukhato mune | sAdhayedvAyunA karma tadvadyogI samabhyaset
verses.translation: I saw in the aerial chariot a great blazing mass of splendour as brilliant as glowing coal and very pleasing to the mind having nothing to excel, it. I saw a man of th size of a thumb lying therein. He was very brilliant as if fire had been placed over fire.

verses.sanskrit: देवः सहस्रको नेत्रपादहस्तसहस्रकः । पृथवीं हि सर्वमावृत्य सोऽग्रे तिष्ठेद्दशाङ्गुलम्
verses.transliteration: devaH sahasrako netrapAdahastasahasrakaH | pR^ithavIM hi sarvamAvR^itya so.agre tiShTheddashA~Ngulam
verses.translation: I bowed to him. With my head bent down, I asked the holy lord. "O holy lord, how may we know you?"

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीं शिरसा सार्द्धं जपेद् व्याहृतिपूर्विकाम् । त्रिवारमायतप्राणाः प्राणायामः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: gAyatrIM shirasA sArddhaM japed vyAhR^itipUrvikAm | trivAramAyataprANAH prANAyAmaH sa uchyate
verses.translation: The pious soul told me "you have not that penance

verses.sanskrit: ५.२८ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.28 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: My seven brothers are invincible and their families are established. But we pursue the rites of ascetics restraining the Atman in the Atman.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: My seven brothers are invincible and their families are established. But we pursue the rites of ascetics restraining the Atman in the Atman.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२८. अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः । छायापुरुषदर्शनवर्णनम् । देव्युवाच । देवदेव महादेव कथितं कालवञ्चनम् । शब्दब्रह्मस्वरूपं च योगलक्षणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.28\. aShTAviMsho.adhyAyaH | ChAyApuruShadarshanavarNanam | devyuvAcha | devadeva mahAdeva kathitaM kAlava~nchanam | shabdabrahmasvarUpaM cha yogalakShaNamuttamam
verses.translation: Since you have piously performed penance with a desire for my vision I have appeared before you. Welfare be to you. What wish of yours shall I carry out?"

verses.sanskrit: पादाभावे विदेशः स्यादित्येतत्कथितं मया । तद्विचार्यं प्रयत्त्नेन पुरुषेण महेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: pAdAbhAve videshaH syAdityetatkathitaM mayA | tadvichAryaM prayattnena puruSheNa maheshvari
verses.translation: When he said this I told him — *'0 holy lord, listen. Please narrate factually the original creation of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: सम्यक्तं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा सन्निवेश्यात्मनात्मनि । जपेन्नवात्मकं मन्त्रं हृदयं मे महेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: samyaktaM puruShaM dR^iShTvA sanniveshyAtmanAtmani | japennavAtmakaM mantraM hR^idayaM me maheshvari
verses.translation: When requested thus he said to me. Listen to everything factually. O dear one, I shall explain to you the auspicious creation of the Pitrs truthfully.

verses.sanskrit: वत्सरे विगते मन्त्री तन्नास्ति यन्न साधयेत् । अणिमादिगुणानष्टौ खेचरत्वं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: vatsare vigate mantrI tannAsti yanna sAdhayet | aNimAdiguNAnaShTau khecharatvaM prapadyate
verses.translation: Formerly Brahma created the gods and said to them, "Worship me". But they who sought benefits eschewed him and worshipped the Atman.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि शक्तिं ज्ञातुं दुरासदाम् । प्रत्यक्षं दृश्यते लोके ज्ञानिनामग्रतः स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: punaranyatpravakShyAmi shaktiM j~nAtuM durAsadAm | pratyakShaM dR^ishyate loke j~nAninAmagrataH sthitam
verses.translation: They were cursed by Brahma thus. You will be deluded and become senseless". Hence unable to know any thing and being insensible they bowed to Pitamaha and said "Please bless us." Being requested thus he said to them for the sake of expiation.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञेया लिख्यते लोके या सर्पीकृतकुण्डली । सा मात्रा यानसंस्थापि दृश्यते न च पठ्यते
verses.transliteration: aj~neyA likhyate loke yA sarpIkR^itakuNDalI | sA mAtrA yAnasaMsthApi dR^ishyate na cha paThyate
verses.translation: "Ask your sons. You will then attain perfect knowledge". Urged thus the senseless ones asked their sons boldly.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डमूर्ध्निगा या च स्तुता वेदैस्तु नित्यशः । जननी सर्वविद्यानां गुप्तविद्येति गीयते
verses.transliteration: brahmANDamUrdhnigA yA cha stutA vedaistu nityashaH | jananI sarvavidyAnAM guptavidyeti gIyate
verses.translation: They were asked to perform expiatory rites. O sinless one, the gods were thus addressed by the sons. "Let the sons be approached." The gods who had been cursed by Bnahma told him that the sons had gone away. Then Brahma told the gods thus "O gods, lUten, You are not Brahmavadins, the believers in Brahma's cult.

verses.sanskrit: खेचरा सा विनिर्दिष्टा सर्वप्राणिषु संस्थिता । दृश्यादृश्याचला नित्या व्यक्ताव्यक्ता सनातनी
verses.transliteration: khecharA sA vinirdiShTA sarvaprANiShu saMsthitA | dR^ishyAdR^ishyAchalA nityA vyaktAvyaktA sanAtanI
verses.translation: O dwellers of heaven, let the gods and the Pitfs worship one another with great delight. This will confer the cherished desires."

verses.sanskrit: अवर्णा वर्णसंयुक्ता प्रोच्यते बिन्दुमालिनी । तां पश्यन्सर्वदा योगी कृतकृत्योऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration: avarNA varNasaMyuktA prochyate bindumAlinI | tAM pashyansarvadA yogI kR^itakR^ityo.abhijAyate
verses.translation: Sanatkumara said: — O great sage, then their doubts were cleared. With delight they became the mutual bestowers of happiness at the instance of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थकृतस्नानाद्भवेद्दानस्य यत्फलम् । सर्वयज्ञफलं यच्च मालिन्या दर्शनात्तदा
verses.transliteration: sarvatIrthakR^itasnAnAdbhaveddAnasya yatphalam | sarvayaj~naphalaM yachcha mAlinyA darshanAttadA
verses.translation: Then the gods said ''Since you addressed us as sons you will undoubtedly become Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: कथितं ते समासेन छायिकं ज्ञानमुत्तमम् । विस्तरेण समाख्याहि योगिनां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: kathitaM te samAsena ChAyikaM j~nAnamuttamam | vistareNa samAkhyAhi yoginAM hitakAmyayA
verses.translation: In the Sraddha of the Pitrs, undoubtedly the per¬ former will propitiate Soma who being delighted and enhan¬ ced by the offering shall gladden the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां देवि यज्ञानां यत्फलं तल्लभेत्पुमान् । किं बहूक्त्या महेशानि सर्वान्कामान्समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: sarveShAM devi yaj~nAnAM yatphalaM tallabhetpumAn | kiM bahUktyA maheshAni sarvAnkAmAnsamashnute
verses.translation: They will delight the ocean, the mountain and the forest, all consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. Those who desire nourishment and perform Sraddha rites are given nourishment by the Pitrs who are propitiated. Those who give three Pinzas in the Sraddha mentioning the names and Gotras delight the Pitrs wherever they be and are looked after by them.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माज्ज्ञानं यथायोगमभ्यसेत्सततं बुधः । अभ्यासाज्जायते सिद्धिर्योगोऽभ्यासात्प्रवर्धते
verses.transliteration: tasmAjj~nAnaM yathAyogamabhyasetsatataM budhaH | abhyAsAjjAyate siddhiryogo.abhyAsAtpravardhate
verses.translation: Let these words be truthful. Whether gods or Pitrs we are father and sons successively. Thus the Pitrs who became sons virtuously were famous in the world as mutual beneficiaries.

verses.sanskrit: संवित्तिर्लभ्यतेऽभ्यासादभ्यासान्मोक्षमश्नुते । अभ्यासः सततं कार्यो धीमता मोक्षकारणम्
verses.transliteration: saMvittirlabhyate.abhyAsAdabhyAsAnmokShamashnute | abhyAsaH satataM kAryo dhImatA mokShakAraNam
verses.translation: O foremost among the performers of penance, the Pitfs in the heaven are seven in number. Four of them are embodied and three bodiless.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत्कथितं देवि भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम् । किमन्यत्पृच्छ्यते तत्त्वं वद सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration: ityetatkathitaM devi bhuktimuktiphalapradam | kimanyatpR^ichChyate tattvaM vada satyaM bravImi te
verses.translation: The primordial groups of gods, brahmins and others worship them. With the power of their Yoga they streng¬ then and gladden Soma.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मपुत्रवचनं परमार्थदम् । प्रसन्नोऽभूदति व्यासः पाराशर्यो मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvA brahmaputravachanaM paramArthadam | prasanno.abhUdati vyAsaH pArAsharyo munIshvarAH
verses.translation: Hence people shall offer Sraddhas especially to the Yogins. A silver vessel or a vessel with silver when offered with Svadha, delights the Pitrs. When the sun is in the northern transit he shall make offerings in the fire or in its absence in water. He shall propitiate fire-god. Soma or Yama. Those whq delight the Pitys with devotion are delighted by Pitrs. The Pitfs bestow nourishment, offspring, heaven, health and other desired objects.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारं सर्वज्ञं ब्रह्मपुत्रं कृपानिधिम् । व्यासः परमसन्तुष्टः प्रणनाम मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAraM sarvaj~naM brahmaputraM kR^ipAnidhim | vyAsaH paramasantuShTaH praNanAma muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: O sage, the rites of Pits are better than the rites of the gods. O brahmin sage, since you are a devotee of the Pitrs you shall be free from old age and death.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुष्टाव तं व्यासः कालेयः स मुनीश्वरः । सनत्कुमारं मुनयः सुरविज्ञानसागरम्
verses.transliteration: tatastuShTAva taM vyAsaH kAleyaH sa munIshvaraH | sanatkumAraM munayaH suravij~nAnasAgaram
verses.translation: O sage, the goal attained by devotion to the Pitrs is not attained by the practices of Yoga. O great sage, so devotion to the Pitrs shall be pursued with care.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । कृतार्थोऽहं मुनिश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्मत्वं मे त्वया कृतम् । नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु धन्यस्त्वं ब्रह्मवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | kR^itArtho.ahaM munishreShTha brahmatvaM me tvayA kR^itam | namaste.astu namaste.astu dhanyastvaM brahmavittamaH
verses.translation: After saying thus and immediately bestowing the vision of perfect knowledge the lord of the gods disappeared.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति स्तुत्वा स कालेयो ब्रह्मपुत्रं महामुनिम् । तूष्णीं बभूव सुप्रीतः परमानन्दनिर्भरः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti stutvA sa kAleyo brahmaputraM mahAmunim | tUShNIM babhUva suprItaH paramAnandanirbharaH
verses.translation: O Bhisma, listen again. Formerly, even after

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच । शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि छायापुरुषलक्षणम् । यज्ज्ञात्वा पुरुषः सम्यक्सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: sha~Nkara uvAcha | shR^iNu devi pravakShyAmi ChAyApuruShalakShaNam | yajj~nAtvA puruShaH samyaksarvapApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: Their names which indicate their activities are Vagdusta (defiled in speech), Krodhana (angry), Hirhsra (violent), Pisuna (backbiter), Kavi(poet), Svasrsa (self-creating) and Pitivartin (worshipping the pitrs)

verses.sanskrit: इति मे वर्णितो विप्राः सुखदः परमार्थयुक् । सनत्कुमारकालेयसंवादो ज्ञानवर्धनः
verses.transliteration: iti me varNito viprAH sukhadaH paramArthayuk | sanatkumArakAleyasaMvAdo j~nAnavardhanaH
verses.translation: O dear, the sons of Kaurika became the disciples of Garga. When their father had expired they went in exile.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यं हि पृष्ठतः कृत्वा सोमं वा वरवर्णिनि । शुक्लाम्बरधरः स्त्रग्वी गन्धधूपादिवासितः
verses.transliteration: sUryaM hi pR^iShThataH kR^itvA somaM vA varavarNini | shuklAmbaradharaH stragvI gandhadhUpAdivAsitaH
verses.translation: At the instance of their preceptor they looked

verses.sanskrit: संस्मरेन्मे महामन्त्रं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् । नवात्मकं पिण्डभूतं स्वां छायां सन्निरीक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: saMsmarenme mahAmantraM sarvakAmaphalapradam | navAtmakaM piNDabhUtaM svAM ChAyAM sannirIkShayet
verses.translation: O descendant of Bharata, once in their course of

verses.sanskrit: विवाहो बन्धुनाशः स्याद्द्वितुण्डे चैव क्षुद्भयम् । विकटौ नश्यते भार्या विजङ्घे धनमेव हि
verses.transliteration: vivAho bandhunAshaH syAddvituNDe chaiva kShudbhayam | vikaTau nashyate bhAryA vija~Nghe dhanameva hi
verses.translation: The brahmin Pitrvartin who performed Sraddha everyday with devotion to the Pitrs spoke to them angrily.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नोत्यत्र न सन्देहः सत्यं वै कथितं मया । सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्स्नात्वा दत्त्वा दानानि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: prApnotyatra na sandehaH satyaM vai kathitaM mayA | sarvatIrtheShu yatsnAtvA dattvA dAnAni sarvashaH
verses.translation: If performed thus, the cow will attain piety undoub¬ tedly. By worshipping Pitrs we shall not be affected by sin.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मपुत्रस्तमामन्त्र्य पूजितस्तेन शौनकः । ययौ स्वधाम सुप्रीतो व्यासोऽपि प्रीतमानसः
verses.transliteration: brahmaputrastamAmantrya pUjitastena shaunakaH | yayau svadhAma suprIto vyAso.api prItamAnasaH
verses.translation: O descendant of Bharata, on being advised thus, they all sprinkled the cow with sacred water, dedicated it to the Pitrs and used it as their food.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तां पुनराकाशे श्वेतवर्णस्वरूपिणीम् । स पश्यत्येकभावस्तु शिवं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA tAM punarAkAshe shvetavarNasvarUpiNIm | sa pashyatyekabhAvastu shivaM paramakAraNam
verses.translation: After eating the cow they said to the preceptor saying — "The cow is killed by a tiger. Let the calf be accepted.**

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मप्राप्तिर्भवेत्तस्य कालविद्भिरितीरितम् । ब्रह्महत्यादिकैः पापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: brahmaprAptirbhavettasya kAlavidbhiritIritam | brahmahatyAdikaiH pApairmuchyate nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: The sage akcepted the calf with great distress. The killers of the cow became sinful by their false reverence and service.

verses.sanskrit: शिरोहीनं यदा पश्येत्षड्भिर्मासैर्भवेत्क्षयः । समस्तं वाङ्मयं तस्य योगिनस्तु यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: shirohInaM yadA pashyetShaDbhirmAsairbhavetkShayaH | samastaM vA~NmayaM tasya yoginastu yathA tathA
verses.translation: O dear, in due course, when their term of life ex¬ pired the seven brothers passed away.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्ले धर्मं विजानीयात्कृष्णे पापं विनिर्दिशेत् । रक्ते बन्धं विजानीयात्पीते विद्विषमादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: shukle dharmaM vijAnIyAtkR^iShNe pApaM vinirdishet | rakte bandhaM vijAnIyAtpIte vidviShamAdishet
verses.translation: They were reborn as the sons of a hunter as a result of their cruelty, violence, being ignoble towards the preceptor and their over-indulgence in fierce violence. They were reborn in the country of Daarnas.** They were strong, intelligent and experts in piety.

verses.sanskrit: ५.२९ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.29 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Recollecting the event of their death the forcst- roamers became forbearers, free from Dvandvas and averse to taking gifts.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Recollecting the event of their death the forcst- roamers became forbearers, free from Dvandvas and averse to taking gifts.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.२९. एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । आदिसर्गवर्णनम् । शौनक उवाच । श्रुतं मे महदाख्यानं यत्त्वया परिकीर्तितम् । सनत्कुमारकालेयसंवादं परमार्थदम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.29\. ekonatriMsho.adhyAyaH | AdisargavarNanam | shaunaka uvAcha | shrutaM me mahadAkhyAnaM yattvayA parikIrtitam | sanatkumArakAleyasaMvAdaM paramArthadam
verses.translation: The hunters performed auspicious rites, and holy deeds, disassociating themselves from the wicked. They had the power of the memory of the previous birth.

verses.sanskrit: आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नरसूनवः । अयनं तस्य ताः पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: Apo nArA iti proktA Apo vai narasUnavaH | ayanaM tasya tAH pUrvaM tena nArAyaNaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Whatever sacred rites they had heard in the pre¬ ceptor's hermitage in the previous births were retained in their minds. So also the goal of non-return to this world.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यवर्णमभवत्तदण्डमुदकेशयम् । तत्र जज्ञे स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूरिति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: hiraNyavarNamabhavattadaNDamudakeshayam | tatra jaj~ne svayaM brahmA svayambhUriti vishrutaH
verses.translation: They performed their penance, had their food and finally cast off their lives on that mountain. O descen¬ dant of Bharata, O king, the different places where they fell dead arc still seen in the same manner on the mount Kalafijara.® Thanks to their activities neither auspi-

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भो भगवानुषित्वा परिवत्सरम् । तदण्डमकरोद् द्वैधं दिवं भूमिं च निर्ममे
verses.transliteration: hiraNyagarbho bhagavAnuShitvA parivatsaram | tadaNDamakarod dvaidhaM divaM bhUmiM cha nirmame
verses.translation: The Western Dasarr.a comprised the Eastern Malwa including the kingdom of Bhopal with its capital at Vidisa while the eastern Disirna formed a par< of Chattictjarh district in the Madhya Pradesh (B.H.D. Sec. III).

verses.sanskrit: अधोऽधोर्ध्वं प्रयुक्तानि भुवनानि चतुर्द्दश । तयोः शकलयोर्मध्य आकाशममृजत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: adho.adhordhvaM prayuktAni bhuvanAni chaturddasha | tayoH shakalayormadhya AkAshamamR^ijatprabhuH
verses.translation: Sec P. 1273 note 128.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु परिप्लवां पृथ्वीं दिशश्च दशधा दधे । तत्र काले मनो वाचं कामक्रोधावथो रतिम्
verses.transliteration: apsu pariplavAM pR^ithvIM dishashcha dashadhA dadhe | tatra kAle mano vAchaM kAmakrodhAvatho ratim
