verses.translation: On an island in an auspicious spot the seven be¬ came aquatic birds. They were reborn as Cakravaka birds in a life that is neither auspicious nor inauspicious.

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिमत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् । वसिष्ठं तु महातेजाः सोऽसृजत्सप्त मानसान्
verses.transliteration: marIchimatrya~Ngirasau pulastyaM pulahaM kratum | vasiShThaM tu mahAtejAH so.asR^ijatsapta mAnasAn
verses.translation: They abandoned the contact with their mates. They were like sages practising sacred rites, free from associations and Egotistic feelings. They remained calm. They did not accept gifts. They were free from Dvandvas.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त बह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः । ततोऽसृजत्पुनर्ब्रह्मा रुद्रान् क्रोधसमुद्भवान्
verses.transliteration: sapta bahmANa ityete purANe nishchayaM gatAH | tato.asR^ijatpunarbrahmA rudrAn krodhasamudbhavAn
verses.translation: They were birds only in name. They were holy bachelors delighted in renunciation. They were birds practising sacred rites.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारं च ऋषिं सर्वेषामपि पूर्वजम् । सप्त चैते प्रजायन्ते पश्चाद्रुद्राश्च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAraM cha R^iShiM sarveShAmapi pUrvajam | sapta chaite prajAyante pashchAdrudrAshcha sarvataH
verses.translation: They could remember their previous births. They grew old even as they were bachelors. They remained to¬ gether free from aberrations and performed good rites.

verses.sanskrit: अतः सनत्कुमारस्तु तेजः सङ्क्षिप्य तिष्ठति । तेषां सप्त महावंशा दिव्या देवर्षिपूजिताः
verses.transliteration: ataH sanatkumArastu tejaH sa~NkShipya tiShThati | teShAM sapta mahAvaMshA divyA devarShipUjitAH
verses.translation: When they were born as brahmins they acted falsely to their preceptor. Still in their birth as birds they attained knowledge as a result of the Sraddha they had performed.

verses.sanskrit: अतोऽहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि यथा सर्गस्तु ब्रह्मणः । समुत्पन्नं तु मे ब्रूहि यथा व्यासाच्च ते श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: ato.ahaM shrotumichChAmi yathA sargastu brahmaNaH | samutpannaM tu me brUhi yathA vyAsAchcha te shrutam
verses.translation: They had performed the!§raddha for the Pitrs with due rituals. They retained memory of previous noble birth.

verses.sanskrit: पयांसि च ससर्जादौ पर्जन्यं च ससर्ज ह । ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि निर्ममे यज्ञसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: payAMsi cha sasarjAdau parjanyaM cha sasarja ha | R^icho yajUMShi sAmAni nirmame yaj~nasiddhaye
verses.translation: The knowledge of Brahma practised by the ancients or found in the preceptors' families stands as of yore even today. One shall practise that knowledge there¬ fore.

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यांस्तैरयजन्देवानित्येवमनुशुश्रुम । मुखाद्देवानजनयत्पितॄंश्चैवाथ वक्षसः । प्रजनाच्च मनुष्यान्वै जघनान्निर्ममेऽसुरान्
verses.transliteration: pUjyAMstairayajandevAnityevamanushushruma | mukhAddevAnajanayatpitR^IMshchaivAtha vakShasaH | prajanAchcha manuShyAnvai jaghanAnnirmame.asurAn
verses.translation: They were of noble birth and were named Svatantra. Suyajfia, Sumanas, Suvak§uddha and the fifth one Ghidradaraka.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चावचानि भूतानि गात्रेभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे । आपवस्य प्रजासर्गं सृजतो हि प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: uchchAvachAni bhUtAni gAtrebhyastasya jaj~nire | Apavasya prajAsargaM sR^ijato hi prajApateH
verses.translation: While they were practising sacred rites an auspicious event happened there. O great sage, please listen to that.

verses.sanskrit: सृज्यमानाः प्रजाश्चैव नावर्धन्त यदा तदा । द्विधा कृत्वात्मनो देहं स्त्री चैव पुरुषोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: sR^ijyamAnAH prajAshchaiva nAvardhanta yadA tadA | dvidhA kR^itvAtmano dehaM strI chaiva puruSho.abhavat
verses.translation: The prosperous king of Nipas,** endowed with strength, and accompanied by his harem entered that forest.

verses.sanskrit: ससृजेऽथ प्रजाः सर्वा महिम्ना व्याप्य विश्वतः । विराजमसृजद्विष्णुः स सृष्टः पुरुषं विराट्
verses.transliteration: sasR^ije.atha prajAH sarvA mahimnA vyApya vishvataH | virAjamasR^ijadviShNuH sa sR^iShTaH puruShaM virAT
verses.translation: The Cakravaka Svatantra yearned much, on seeing the happy king endowed with the glory of the king¬ dom pass along.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं तं मनुं विद्धि मनोरन्तरमेव च । स वैराजः प्रजाः सर्वाः ससर्ज पुरुषः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dvitIyaM taM manuM viddhi manorantarameva cha | sa vairAjaH prajAH sarvAH sasarja puruShaH prabhuH
verses.translation: I have become weary with the observance of fasts and steady penance. If there is a merit accruing from penance or the observance of checks and restraints lei me become like him the abode of fortune and bliss.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणविसर्गस्य प्रजास्तस्याप्ययोनिजः । आयुष्मान् कीर्तिमान्धन्यः प्रजावांश्चाभवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: nArAyaNavisargasya prajAstasyApyayonijaH | AyuShmAn kIrtimAndhanyaH prajAvAMshchAbhavattataH
verses.translation: Then two of his comrades said. "We shall be your ministers, your delighters and well-wishers."

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमादिसर्गस्ते वर्णितो मुनिसत्तम । आदिसर्गं विदित्वैवं यथेष्टां प्राप्नुयाद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ityevamAdisargaste varNito munisattama | AdisargaM viditvaivaM yatheShTAM prApnuyAdgatim
verses.translation: After saying "So be it", the Yogic soul attained his goal. The two Cakravakas replied to him.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । मुने शृणु कथां दिव्यां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् । कथ्यमानां मया चित्रां बह्वर्थां श्रुतविस्तराम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | mune shR^iNu kathAM divyAM sarvapApapraNAshinIm | kathyamAnAM mayA chitrAM bahvarthAM shrutavistarAm
verses.translation: After renouncing action by the Yogic practices why do you long for such a boon? Hence hear my statement.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैनां पाठयेत्तां च शृणुयाद्वाप्यभीक्ष्णशः । स्ववंशधारणं कृत्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yashchainAM pAThayettAM cha shR^iNuyAdvApyabhIkShNashaH | svavaMshadhAraNaM kR^itvA svargaloke mahIyate
verses.translation: O dear, you will become a king in the excellent city of Kampilya.*' These too will be your ministers who will not go astray.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं पुरुषो यत्तन्नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् । प्रधानपुरुषो भूत्वा निर्ममे लोकभावनः
verses.transliteration: pradhAnaM puruSho yattannityaM sadasadAtmakam | pradhAnapuruSho bhUtvA nirmame lokabhAvanaH
verses.translation: The three did not speak about the kingdom to their four comrades. Being delighted Sumanas said again.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि स्वयम्भूर्भगवान् सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः । अप एव ससर्जादौ तासु वीर्यमवासृजत्
verses.transliteration: so.api svayambhUrbhagavAn sisR^ikShurvividhAH prajAH | apa eva sasarjAdau tAsu vIryamavAsR^ijat
verses.translation: Due to their favour you will attain merit. You have sprinkled the cow and offered it to the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजायन्ते क्रियावन्तो महर्षिभिरलङ्कृताः । विद्युतोऽशनिमेघांश्च रोहितेन्द्रधनूंषि च
verses.transliteration: prajAyante kriyAvanto maharShibhirala~NkR^itAH | vidyuto.ashanimeghAMshcha rohitendradhanUMShi cha
verses.translation: We shall acquire knowledge which shall work as the means of Yoga for all. This statement is bold and spirited and is quoted as a verse.

verses.sanskrit: स्रष्टारं सर्वभूतानां नारायणपरायणम् । तं वै विद्धि मुनिश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्माणममितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: sraShTAraM sarvabhUtAnAM nArAyaNaparAyaNam | taM vai viddhi munishreShTha brahmANamamitaujasam
verses.translation: After attaining human life you will attain "Yoga". After saying this the learned bird Sumanas became silent.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादकल्पयत्कल्पाः समग्राः शुचयो यतः । भवन्ति मुनिशार्दूल नमस्तस्मै स्वयम्भुवे
verses.transliteration: yasmAdakalpayatkalpAH samagrAH shuchayo yataH | bhavanti munishArdUla namastasmai svayambhuve
verses.translation: Thus I have menioned their story to you. What more do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै हिरण्यगर्भाय पुरुषायेश्वराय च । नमस्कृत्य प्रवक्ष्यामि भूयः सर्गमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmai hiraNyagarbhAya puruShAyeshvarAya cha | namaskR^itya pravakShyAmi bhUyaH sargamanuttamam
verses.translation: Markandeya of great intellect, O foremost among the devotees of the Pitrs what happened after that? O excel¬ lent sage, please tell me.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा स्रष्टा हरिः पाता संहर्ता च महेश्वरः । तस्य सर्गस्य नान्योऽस्ति काले काले तथा गते
verses.transliteration: brahmA sraShTA hariH pAtA saMhartA cha maheshvaraH | tasya sargasya nAnyo.asti kAle kAle tathA gate
verses.translation: Those seven traversers of the lake Manasa engaged in sacred rites and Yoga got their bodies withered up taking in only air and water.

verses.sanskrit: ५.३० ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.30 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Without taking in any food, breathing in only air he began to perform a great penance in the spot where those comrades were present.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Without taking in any food, breathing in only air he began to perform a great penance in the spot where those comrades were present.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३०. त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । सर्गवर्णनम् १ । सूत उवाच । संसृष्टासु प्रजास्वेव आपवोऽथ प्रजापतिः । लेभे वै पुरुषः पत्नीं शतरूपामयोनिजाम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.30\. triMsho.adhyAyaH | sargavarNanam 1 | sUta uvAcha | saMsR^iShTAsu prajAsveva Apavo.atha prajApatiH | lebhe vai puruShaH patnIM shatarUpAmayonijAm
verses.translation: Then that forest Vibhraja shone splendidly. It became very famous as the bestower of Yogic Siddhi.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् पुष्टिश्च धान्यश्च ध्रुवात्पुत्रौ व्यजायताम् । पुष्टिरेवं समुत्थायाः पञ्चपुत्रानकल्मषान्
verses.transliteration: tasmAt puShTishcha dhAnyashcha dhruvAtputrau vyajAyatAm | puShTirevaM samutthAyAH pa~nchaputrAnakalmaShAn
verses.translation: They were reborn in Kampilya as seven noble souls Brahmadatta and others. All of them were free from sins.

verses.sanskrit: रिपुं रिपुञ्जयं विप्रं वृकलं वृषतेजसम् । रिपोरेवं च महिषी चाक्षुषं सर्वतोदिशम्
verses.transliteration: ripuM ripu~njayaM vipraM vR^ikalaM vR^iShatejasam | riporevaM cha mahiShI chAkShuShaM sarvatodisham
verses.translation: Four of them had the memory of their previous births but three of them were deluded. That Svatantra of great Yogic power was now called Brahmadatta.

verses.sanskrit: अजीजनत्पुष्करिण्यां वरुणं चाक्षुषो मनुः । मनोरजायन्त दश नड्वलायां महौजसः
verses.transliteration: ajIjanatpuShkariNyAM varuNaM chAkShuSho manuH | manorajAyanta dasha naDvalAyAM mahaujasaH
verses.translation: Chidradarsin and Sunctra were the masters of the Vedas and Vedahgas. They were born as sons of brahmins well-versed in the Vedas. They had the memory of the previous births.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यायां हि मुनिश्रेष्ठ वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः । पुरुर्मासः शतद्युम्नस्तपस्वी सत्यवित्कविः
verses.transliteration: kanyAyAM hi munishreShTha vairAjasya prajApateH | pururmAsaH shatadyumnastapasvI satyavitkaviH
verses.translation: Pancala and Pundarlka established their sons in the house and went to forest. There they attained the great goal.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमोऽतिरात्रश्चातिमन्युः सुयशा दश । पूरोरजनयत्पुत्रान् षडाग्नेयी महाप्रभान्
verses.transliteration: agniShTomo.atirAtrashchAtimanyuH suyashA dasha | pUrorajanayatputrAn ShaDAgneyI mahAprabhAn
verses.translation: O descendant of Bharata, Brahmadatta's wife

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गं सुमनसं ख्यातिं सृतिमङ्गिरसं गयम् । अङ्गात्सुनीथा भार्या वै वेनमेकमसूयत
verses.transliteration: a~NgaM sumanasaM khyAtiM sR^itima~NgirasaM gayam | a~NgAtsunIthA bhAryA vai venamekamasUyata
verses.translation: The other three Gakravaka comrades were born as brahmin sons in the family of a poor man, O king.

verses.sanskrit: अपचारेण वेनस्य कोपस्तेषां महानभूत् । हुङ्कारेणैव तं जघ्नुर्मुनयो धर्मतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: apachAreNa venasya kopasteShAM mahAnabhUt | hu~NkAreNaiva taM jaghnurmunayo dharmatatparAH
verses.translation: They were engaged in Yogic practice. They took leave of one another, bowed at the lotus-like feet of Siva and set out.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रजार्थमृषयः प्रार्थिताश्च सुनीथया । सारस्वतास्तदा तस्य ममन्थुर्दक्षिणं करम्
verses.transliteration: atha prajArthamR^iShayaH prArthitAshcha sunIthayA | sArasvatAstadA tasya mamanthurdakShiNaM karam
verses.translation: The enthusiasts desiring freedom from rebirth resort to Siya's feet. May those feet of Siva destroy sins.

verses.sanskrit: वेनस्य पाणौ मथिते सम्बभूव ततः पृथुः । स धन्वी कवची जातस्तेजसादित्यसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: venasya pANau mathite sambabhUva tataH pR^ithuH | sa dhanvI kavachI jAtastejasAdityasannibhaH
verses.translation: O great sage, if any physical, mental or verbal sin is committed, one shall read this narrative with full devotion.

verses.sanskrit: आपवस्य महिम्ना तु दिवमावृत्य तिष्ठतः । धर्मेणैव महात्मा स शतरूपाप्यजायत
verses.transliteration: Apavasya mahimnA tu divamAvR^itya tiShThataH | dharmeNaiva mahAtmA sa shatarUpApyajAyata
verses.translation: By repeating the names of Siva, one gets rid ol all sins soon. As soon as the name Siva, the lord of the gods, is uttered sins are quelled like an unbaked pot in water, O great sage. In proportion to the sins committed and in order to quell them the Japa of Siva's names shall be per¬ formed by the faithful. In order to achieve the fruits of all desires too, this Japa shall be performed accordingly.

verses.sanskrit: पृथुर्वैन्यस्तदा पृथ्वीमरक्षत्क्षत्रपूर्वजः । राजसूयाभिषिक्तानामाद्यः स वसुधापतिः
verses.transliteration: pR^ithurvainyastadA pR^ithvImarakShatkShatrapUrvajaH | rAjasUyAbhiShiktAnAmAdyaH sa vasudhApatiH
verses.translation: He who reads or hears this for prosperity is liberated from sins and attains.salvation. There is no doubt in this.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्चैव समुत्पन्नौ निपुणौ सूतमागधौ । तेनेयं गौर्मुनिश्रेष्ठ दुग्धा सर्वहिताय वै
verses.transliteration: tasmAchchaiva samutpannau nipuNau sUtamAgadhau | teneyaM gaurmunishreShTha dugdhA sarvahitAya vai
verses.translation: O Suta having Vya as preceptor, please tell me now the mode of worshipping the preceptor. What shall be done at the end of listening to the holy book? Please mention that also.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां वृत्तिदश्चाभूद्देवर्षिसुररक्षसाम् । मनुष्याणां विशेषेण शतयज्ञकरो नृपः
verses.transliteration: sarveShAM vR^ittidashchAbhUddevarShisurarakShasAm | manuShyANAM visheSheNa shatayaj~nakaro nR^ipaH
verses.translation: After hearing the story the devotee shall worship the preceptor duly with devotion. Delighted in mind he shall make liberal gifts duly to the preceptor at the conclusion of the holy book.

verses.sanskrit: पृथोः पुत्रौ तु जज्ञाते धर्मज्ञौ भुवि पार्थिवौ । विजिताश्वश्च हर्यक्षो महावीरौ सुविश्रुतौ
verses.transliteration: pR^ithoH putrau tu jaj~nAte dharmaj~nau bhuvi pArthivau | vijitAshvashcha haryakSho mahAvIrau suvishrutau
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee shall bow to the propounder and worship him duly. Gifts of ornaments for hands and ears and fine garments shall be made.

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डिनी चाजनयत्पुत्रं प्राचीनबर्हिषम् । प्राचीनाग्राः कुशास्तस्य पृथिवीतलचारिणः
verses.transliteration: shikhaNDinI chAjanayatputraM prAchInabarhiSham | prAchInAgrAH kushAstasya pR^ithivItalachAriNaH
verses.translation: After the worship of Siva he shall present to the preceptor a cow and its calf. He shall make a book-seat with gold, a Pala in weight and cover it with a good doth. The manuscript of the holy book written in beautiful hand shall be placed on it and given to the preceptor. The in¬ telligent devotee will be liberated from worldly bondage.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रतनया तेन धर्मतः सुविवाहिता । रेजेऽधिकतरं राजा कृतदारो महाप्रभुः
verses.transliteration: samudratanayA tena dharmataH suvivAhitA | reje.adhikataraM rAjA kR^itadAro mahAprabhuH
verses.translation: O sage, a village, an elephant or a horse or other things shall be given as possible to the noble preceptor who

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रतनयायास्तु दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः । बभूवुस्तनया दिव्या बहुयज्ञकरस्य वै
verses.transliteration: samudratanayAyAstu dasha prAchInabarhiShaH | babhUvustanayA divyA bahuyaj~nakarasya vai
verses.translation: O sage, the Purana full of the meanings of the Vedas, the heart of the Vedas, the meritorious holy book shall be listened to with devotion and in accordance with the rules.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे प्राचेतसा नाम्ना धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः । अपृथग्धर्माचरणास्तेऽतप्यन्त महत्तपः
verses.transliteration: sarve prAchetasA nAmnA dhanurvedasya pAragAH | apR^ithagdharmAcharaNAste.atapyanta mahattapaH
verses.translation: O Suta of great intellect, O store-house of mercy, please narrate the birth of Vyasa. O holy lord, please satisfy our curiosity. Vyasa's mother is known as Satyavati. She was married to king Santanu. How was Vyasa the great Yogin born of her from Parasara? There is a great doubt in regard to that. It behoves you to remove that doubt.

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि समुद्रसलिलेशयाः । रुद्रगीतं जपन्तश्च शिवध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: dashavarShasahasrANi samudrasalileshayAH | rudragItaM japantashcha shivadhyAnaparAyaNAH
verses.translation: The righteous soul spoke to the ferryman who was taking his meals "Take me across the Yamuna quickly in your boat".

verses.sanskrit: सा तु वर्षशतं तप्त्वा तपः परमदुश्चरम् । भर्तारं दीप्ततपसं पुरुषं प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sA tu varShashataM taptvA tapaH paramadushcharam | bhartAraM dIptatapasaM puruShaM pratyapadyata
verses.translation: That great Yogin who had never been fascinated evei on seeing the beauty of the celestial damsels became ovffwhelmed by lust towards her, in the circumstances.

verses.sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा तु निवृत्तास्ते तपसो लब्धसद्वराः । चुक्रुधुर्मुनिशार्दूल दग्धुकामास्तपोबलाः
verses.transliteration: tAn dR^iShTvA tu nivR^ittAste tapaso labdhasadvarAH | chukrudhurmunishArdUla dagdhukAmAstapobalAH
verses.translation: Desirous of clasping the beautiful daughter of the

verses.sanskrit: प्राचेतसा मुखेभ्यस्ते प्रासृजन्नग्निमारुतौ । वृक्षानुन्मूल्य वायुस्तानदहद्धव्यवाहनः
verses.transliteration: prAchetasA mukhebhyaste prAsR^ijannagnimArutau | vR^ikShAnunmUlya vAyustAnadahaddhavyavAhanaH
verses.translation: The wide-eyed lass spoke to him smilingly — "O sage of controlled speech, why do you intend to perpetrate this despicable deed?

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षक्षयं ततो दृष्ट्वा किञ्चिच्छेषेषु शाखिषु । उपगम्याब्रवीदेतान् राजा सोमः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: vR^ikShakShayaM tato dR^iShTvA ki~nchichCheSheShu shAkhiShu | upagamyAbravIdetAn rAjA somaH pratApavAn
verses.translation: O most intelligent one, you are born of the beauti¬ ful family ofVasi§tha. O brahmin, I am the daughter of a Nijada. How can our union be proper?

verses.sanskrit: सोम उवाच । कोपं यच्छत राजानः सर्वे प्राचीनबर्हिषः । अनुभूतानुकन्येयं वृक्षाणां वरवर्णिनी
verses.transliteration: soma uvAcha | kopaM yachChata rAjAnaH sarve prAchInabarhiShaH | anubhUtAnukanyeyaM vR^ikShANAM varavarNinI
verses.translation: Then she thought within: *Tf this Yogin engages himself in the vicious act there is none in the world to prevent him due to his power of inflicting curse.**

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यं जानता सा तु धृता गर्भेण वै मया । भार्या वोऽस्तु महाभागाः सोमवंशविवर्धिनी
verses.transliteration: bhaviShyaM jAnatA sA tu dhR^itA garbheNa vai mayA | bhAryA vo.astu mahAbhAgAH somavaMshavivardhinI
verses.translation: After thinking in the mind thus she said to the great sage — "O holy lord, please forbear till I take you to the other bank."

verses.sanskrit: अस्यामुत्पत्स्यते विद्वान् दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः । सृष्टिकर्ता महातेजा ब्रह्मपुत्रः पुरातनः
verses.transliteration: asyAmutpatsyate vidvAn dakSho nAma prajApatiH | sR^iShTikartA mahAtejA brahmaputraH purAtanaH
verses.translation: On hearing her words the king of Yogins ParaiSara left off her hand. He reached the other shore.

verses.sanskrit: युष्माकं तेजसार्धेन मम चानेन तेजसा । ब्रह्मतेजोमयो भूपः प्रजाः संवर्धयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yuShmAkaM tejasArdhena mama chAnena tejasA | brahmatejomayo bhUpaH prajAH saMvardhayiShyati
verses.translation: Afflicted with lust the sage caught hold of the lass. Tremblingly the lass spoke to the merciful sage.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सोमस्य वचनाज्जगृहुस्ते प्रचेतसः । भार्यां धर्मेण तां प्रीत्या वृक्षजां वरवर्णिनीम्
verses.transliteration: tataH somasya vachanAjjagR^ihuste prachetasaH | bhAryAM dharmeNa tAM prItyA vR^ikShajAM varavarNinIm
verses.translation: "O great sage, I have foul smell and black com¬ plexion. I am the daughter of a Nida. You are the most excellent of Yogins of extremely liberal thoughts.

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यस्तस्यास्तु सञ्जज्ञे दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः । सोऽपि जज्ञे महातेजाः सोमस्यांशेन वै मुने
verses.transliteration: tebhyastasyAstu sa~njaj~ne dakSho nAma prajApatiH | so.api jaj~ne mahAtejAH somasyAMshena vai mune
verses.translation: As the sage addressed her thus, the damsd was instantly converted into Yojanagandha, (one whose fragrant odours spread to a Yojana), one of fine features and beauty.

verses.sanskrit: स वै स्वायम्भुवो जज्ञे पुरुषो मनुरुच्यते । तस्यैकसप्ततियुगं मन्वन्तरमिहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: sa vai svAyambhuvo jaj~ne puruSho manuruchyate | tasyaikasaptatiyugaM manvantaramihochyate
verses.translation: Afflicted by lust the sage caught hold of her again. On seeing him bent upon seizing her she said agun.

verses.sanskrit: वीरणस्य सुतां नाम्ना वीरणीं स प्रजापतेः । उपयेमे सुविधिना सुधर्मेण पतिव्रताम्
verses.transliteration: vIraNasya sutAM nAmnA vIraNIM sa prajApateH | upayeme suvidhinA sudharmeNa pativratAm
verses.translation: "It is mentioned in the Vedas that sexual intercourse shall be indulged in at night; not during the day. There is great harm in having sexual intercourse during the day time. It is censured.

verses.sanskrit: हर्यश्वानयुतं तस्यां सुतान् पुण्यानजीजनत् । ते विरक्ता बभूवुश्च नारदस्योपदेशतः
verses.transliteration: haryashvAnayutaM tasyAM sutAn puNyAnajIjanat | te viraktA babhUvushcha nAradasyopadeshataH
verses.translation: Hence please wait till the night falls. Now all the men will see us and so shall my father who stands at the other bank.*'

verses.sanskrit: तच्छुत्वा स पुनर्दक्षः सुबलाश्वानजीजनत् । नामतस्तनयांस्तस्यां सहस्रपरिसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: tachChutvA sa punardakShaH subalAshvAnajIjanat | nAmatastanayAMstasyAM sahasraparisa~NkhyayA
verses.translation: On hearing the words uttered by her, the leading sage immediately created a screen of snow, thanks to the strength of his merit.

verses.sanskrit: तेऽपि भ्रातृपथा यातास्तन्मुनेरुपदेशतः । नागमन् पितृसान्निध्यं विरक्ता भिक्षुमार्गिणः
verses.transliteration: te.api bhrAtR^ipathA yAtAstanmunerupadeshataH | nAgaman pitR^isAnnidhyaM viraktA bhikShumArgiNaH
verses.translation: When the sheet of mist.spread and it looked just

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा शापमाक्रुद्धो मुनये दुःसहं ददौ । कुत्रचिन्न लभस्वेति संस्थितिं कलहप्रिय
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA shApamAkruddho munaye duHsahaM dadau | kutrachinna labhasveti saMsthitiM kalahapriya
verses.translation: *'0 Yogin, your semen never fails. You may enjoy me and go away, O holy lord, I shall become pregnant, what will be my fate then?

verses.sanskrit: सान्त्वितोऽथ विधात्रा हि स पश्चादसृजत्स्त्रियः । महाज्वालास्वरूपेण गुणैश्चापि मुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sAntvito.atha vidhAtrA hi sa pashchAdasR^ijatstriyaH | mahAjvAlAsvarUpeNa guNaishchApi munIshvaraH
verses.translation: O intelligent sage, my virginity will be ruined. People will laugh at me. What will I tell my father?"

verses.sanskrit: ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश । द्वे चैवं ब्रह्मपुत्राय द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तदा
verses.transliteration: dadau sa dasha dharmAya kashyapAya trayodasha | dve chaivaM brahmaputrAya dve chaivA~Ngirase tadA
verses.translation: O maiden, O beloved girl, sport with me freely with loving emotion. You tell me what you desire. I shall fulfil it.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे कृशाश्वाय विदुषे मुनये मुनिसत्तम । शिष्टाः सोमाय दक्षोऽपि नक्षत्राख्या ददौ प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dve kR^ishAshvAya viduShe munaye munisattama | shiShTAH somAya dakSho.api nakShatrAkhyA dadau prabhuH
verses.translation: By making my advances fruitful you will be known as Satyavatl. You will deserve the respect of all Yogins and even the gods.

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यो दक्षस्य पुत्रीभ्यो जाता देवासुरादयः । बहवस्तनयाः ख्यातास्तैः सर्वैः पूरितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: tAbhyo dakShasya putrIbhyo jAtA devAsurAdayaH | bahavastanayAH khyAtAstaiH sarvaiH pUritaM jagat
verses.translation: If neither my father nor mother nor anyother person on the earth comes to know of this, if my virginity is not affected, O lord, if the son born of me attains won¬ derful power like you, if there be sweet odour in my body for ever and if there be fresh youth in me, accept me then,

verses.sanskrit: वैराजात्पुरुषाद्वीरा शतरूपा व्यजायत । प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ वीरकायामजायताम्
verses.transliteration: vairAjAtpuruShAdvIrA shatarUpA vyajAyata | priyavratottAnapAdau vIrakAyAmajAyatAm
verses.translation: Listen to me O beloved girl, all your desires will be fulfilled. A son of great fame of Visnu's part will be born to you.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै ब्रह्मा ददौ प्रीतः स्थानमात्मसमं प्रभुः । अचलं चैव पुरतः सप्तर्षीणां प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tasmai brahmA dadau prItaH sthAnamAtmasamaM prabhuH | achalaM chaiva purataH saptarShINAM prajApatiH
verses.translation: O comely lady, your son will be the author of the Puranas, the classifier of the Vedas and renowned in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अवतारः स विष्णोर्हि प्रजापालनहेतवे । धर्मसंरक्षणार्थाय दुष्टानां दण्डहेतवे
verses.transliteration: avatAraH sa viShNorhi prajApAlanahetave | dharmasaMrakShaNArthAya duShTAnAM daNDahetave
verses.translation: O great sage, after saying this and enjoying the beautiful lass, the sage, an expert in Yoga, took his bath in the Yamuna and went away quickly.

verses.sanskrit: तपश्चरत्सु पृथ्व्यामभवंश्च महीरुहाः । अरक्ष्यमाणायां पृथ्व्यां बभूवाथ प्रजाक्षयः
verses.transliteration: tapashcharatsu pR^ithvyAmabhavaMshcha mahIruhAH | arakShyamANAyAM pR^ithvyAM babhUvAtha prajAkShayaH
verses.translation: She conceived and immediately gave birth in an island on the Yamuna** to a son with the lustre of the sun and resembling Kamadeva.

verses.sanskrit: अचरांश्च चरांश्चैव द्विपदोऽथ चतुष्पदः । संसृज्य मनसा दक्षो मैथुनीं सृष्टिमारभत्
verses.transliteration: acharAMshcha charAMshchaiva dvipado.atha chatuShpadaH | saMsR^ijya manasA dakSho maithunIM sR^iShTimArabhat
verses.translation: Immediately after birth the brilliant sage spoke to his mother "O mother, go as you please and I also go at my will

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र प्रजा मैथुनसम्भवाः । सङ्कल्पाद्दर्शनात्स्पर्शात्पूर्वेषां सृष्टिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tataH prabhR^iti viprendra prajA maithunasambhavAH | sa~NkalpAddarshanAtsparshAtpUrveShAM sR^iShTiruchyate
verses.translation: O mother, whenever you have some work, whenever you desire in your mind, please remember me. Immediately I shall come to you to fulfil your desire."

verses.sanskrit: शौनक उवाच । अङ्गुष्ठाद् ब्रह्मणो जज्ञे दक्षश्चोक्तस्त्वया पुरा । कथं प्राचेतसत्वं हि पुनर्लेभे महातपाः
verses.transliteration: shaunaka uvAcha | a~NguShThAd brahmaNo jaj~ne dakShashchoktastvayA purA | kathaM prAchetasatvaM hi punarlebhe mahAtapAH
verses.translation: After saying this and worshipping his mother's feet the sage, a stoi'ehouse of penance, went away to perform penance to holy centres quelling sins.

verses.sanskrit: एतं मे संशयं सूत प्रत्याख्यातुं त्वमर्हसि । चित्रमेतत्स सोमस्य कथं श्वशुरतां गतः
verses.transliteration: etaM me saMshayaM sUta pratyAkhyAtuM tvamarhasi | chitrametatsa somasya kathaM shvashuratAM gataH
verses.translation: -She too returned to her father. The chaste lady was overwhelmed by her love for her son. She recollected his activities and described the event as her great fortune.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । उत्पत्तिश्च निरोधश्च नित्यं भूतेषु वर्तते । कल्पे कल्पे भवन्त्येते सर्वे दक्षादयो मुने
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | utpattishcha nirodhashcha nityaM bhUteShu vartate | kalpe kalpe bhavantyete sarve dakShAdayo mune
verses.translation: He went to tliese holy centres: — Tirtharaja®* at the outset, which bestows virtue, love, wealth and salvation, Naimisa,'* Kuruksetra,' Gahgadvara,® Avantika,®* Ayodhya,®*'* Mathura,®* Dvaraka,®' Amaravatl,®® Sarasvatl,®* Sindhusanga,*®

verses.sanskrit: इमां विसृष्टिं दक्षस्य यो विद्यात्सचराचराम् । प्रजावानायुषा पूर्णः स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: imAM visR^iShTiM dakShasya yo vidyAtsacharAcharAm | prajAvAnAyuShA pUrNaH svargaloke mahIyate
verses.translation: P. 76 note, P. 432 note.

verses.sanskrit: काम्या नाम महाभागा कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । काम्यापुत्रास्त्रयस्त्वासन्संराट्साक्षिरविट्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kAmyA nAma mahAbhAgA kardamasya prajApateH | kAmyAputrAstrayastvAsansaMrATsAkShiraviTprabhuH
verses.translation: P. 1082 note.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपादोऽजनयत्पुत्रान् शक्रसमान् प्रभुः । ध्रुवं च तनयं दिव्यमात्मानन्दसुवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: uttAnapAdo.ajanayatputrAn shakrasamAn prabhuH | dhruvaM cha tanayaM divyamAtmAnandasuvarchasam
verses.translation: p. 1314 note.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्य कन्या सुश्रोणी सुनीतिर्नाम विश्रुता । उत्पन्ना चापि धर्मेण ध्रुवस्य जननी तथा
verses.transliteration: dharmasya kanyA sushroNI sunItirnAma vishrutA | utpannA chApi dharmeNa dhruvasya jananI tathA
verses.translation: P. 1229 note.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवो वर्षसहस्राणि त्रीणि दिव्यानि कानने । तपस्तेपे स बालस्तु प्रार्थयन्स्थानमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: dhruvo varShasahasrANi trINi divyAni kAnane | tapastepe sa bAlastu prArthayansthAnamavyayam
verses.translation: After reaching the holy centre of Varanasi and visiting Manikarnika the great sage discarded the sin accu¬ mulated in crores of birth.

verses.sanskrit: ५.३१ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.31 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The Goda rises in the Western Ghats, flows through the Deccan into the Bay of Bengal. SP omits t<j mention the seven sacred places on

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The Goda rises in the Western Ghats, flows through the Deccan into the Bay of Bengal. SP omits t<j mention the seven sacred places on

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३१. एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । सर्गवर्णनम् २ । शौनक उवाच । देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । सृष्टिं तु विस्तरेणेमां सूतपुत्र वदाशु मे
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.31\. ekatriMsho.adhyAyaH | sargavarNanam 2 | shaunaka uvAcha | devAnAM dAnavAnAM cha gandharvoragarakShasAm | sR^iShTiM tu vistareNemAM sUtaputra vadAshu me

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तेऽपि तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा निर्याताः सर्वतोदिशम् । सुबलाश्वा दक्षसुता हर्यश्वा इव ते पुरा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | te.api tadvachanaM shrutvA niryAtAH sarvatodisham | subalAshvA dakShasutA haryashvA iva te purA
verses.translation: P. 1327 note,

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तं पुष्करं प्राप्य गतास्तेऽपि पराभवम् । अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते समुद्रेभ्य इवापगाः
verses.transliteration: anantaM puShkaraM prApya gatAste.api parAbhavam | adyApi na nivartante samudrebhya ivApagAH
verses.translation: This peak of the Himfdayas has not been identified so far.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति वै भ्राता भ्रातुरन्वेषणे रतः । प्रयातो नश्यति मुने तन्न कार्यं विपश्चिता
verses.transliteration: tadAprabhR^iti vai bhrAtA bhrAturanveShaNe rataH | prayAto nashyati mune tanna kAryaM vipashchitA
verses.translation: P. 1254 note.,

verses.sanskrit: तांश्चापि नष्टान् विज्ञाय पुत्रान्दक्षः प्रजापतिः । स च क्रोधाद्ददौ शापं नारदाय महात्मने
verses.transliteration: tAMshchApi naShTAn vij~nAya putrAndakShaH prajApatiH | sa cha krodhAddadau shApaM nAradAya mahAtmane

verses.sanskrit: कुत्रचिन्न लभस्वेति संस्थितिं कलहप्रिय । तव सान्निध्यतो लोके भवेच्च कलहः सदा
verses.transliteration: kutrachinna labhasveti saMsthitiM kalahapriya | tava sAnnidhyato loke bhavechcha kalahaH sadA

verses.sanskrit: सान्त्वितोऽथ विधात्रा हि स दक्षस्तु प्रजापतिः । कन्याः षष्ट्यसृजत्पश्चाद्वीरिण्यामिति नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sAntvito.atha vidhAtrA hi sa dakShastu prajApatiH | kanyAH ShaShTyasR^ijatpashchAdvIriNyAmiti naH shrutam

verses.sanskrit: ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश । सप्तविंशति सोमाय चतस्रोऽरिष्टनेमिने
verses.transliteration: dadau sa dasha dharmAya kashyapAya trayodasha | saptaviMshati somAya chatasro.ariShTanemine
verses.translation: P. 1081 note.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे चैवं ब्रह्मपुत्राय द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तदा । द्वे कृशाश्वाय विदुषे तासां नामानि मे शृणु
verses.transliteration: dve chaivaM brahmaputrAya dve chaivA~Ngirase tadA | dve kR^ishAshvAya viduShe tAsAM nAmAni me shR^iNu
verses.translation: A sacred place near Ajmer famous for the lake Puskara

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धती वसुर्यामिर्लम्बा भानुर्मरुत्वती । सङ्कल्पा च मुहूर्ता च सन्ध्या विश्वा च वै मुने
verses.transliteration: arundhatI vasuryAmirlambA bhAnurmarutvatI | sa~NkalpA cha muhUrtA cha sandhyA vishvA cha vai mune
verses.translation: P. 1 254 note

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । यदा न ववृधे सा तु वीरणस्य प्रजापतिः । सुतां सुतपसा युक्तामाह्वयत्सर्गकारणात्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | yadA na vavR^idhe sA tu vIraNasya prajApatiH | sutAM sutapasA yuktAmAhvayatsargakAraNAt
verses.translation: P. 266 note.

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्वत्यां मरुत्वन्तो वसोस्तु वसवस्तथा । भानोस्तु भानवः सर्वे मुहूर्तायां मुहूर्तजाः
verses.transliteration: marutvatyAM marutvanto vasostu vasavastathA | bhAnostu bhAnavaH sarve muhUrtAyAM muhUrtajAH
verses.translation: After worshipping devoutly Visvcsa and other Lihgas he began to think frequently— "What is that Lihga that bestows Siddhi instantaneously and worshipping whom the great god, we shall be able to attain all lores and by whose blessings I may have the power to compose the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: लम्बायाश्चैव घोषोऽथ नागवीथी च यामिजा । पृथिवीविषमस्तस्यामरुन्धत्यामजायत
verses.transliteration: lambAyAshchaiva ghoSho.atha nAgavIthI cha yAmijA | pR^ithivIviShamastasyAmarundhatyAmajAyata
verses.translation: There are crores of Lihgas; from the midst of these what shall I instal, what shall I resort so? Gan it be Ohkaranatha, or Krttivasevara or Kedarea, or KameSa, or Candresa, or Trilocana, or Kalesa, or Vrddhakalesa, or Kalae:%vara, or Jycstl\csa, or Jambukesa, or Jaigisavyesvara, or Dasasvamedhesana, or Drumacandesa, or Drkkesa or Garudesa or Ganesvara, or Prasannavadanesa, or Dharmesa, or Tarakesvara or Nandikesa or Nivasea, or Patrlsa, or Priti- kevara, or Parvatesa, or Pasupati, or Haakewara or Brhaspatisvara, or Tilabhandesa or Bharabhutesvara, or Mahaksmlsvara or Marutea, or Moksesa, or Ganges or Narmadesvara, or Krsnesa, or Paramesana, or Ratnesvara, or Yamunesa, or Lahgalisa, or Vifvesvara or AvimukteSvara, or or Vialakslia, or Vyaghrevara, or Varahesa, or Vidyevara or Varunea, or VidhiSa, or Har«kesesvara, or Bhavanisa, or Kapardisa, or Kandukea or AjeSvara or Visvakarmesvara, or Viresvara, or Nadea, or Kapilesa, or Bhuvanesvara, or Vaskulisa or Mahadeva, or SiddhHvara or VisvedeveSvara or Virabhadresa or Bhairavesvara, or Amrtesa; or Satina or ParvatiSvara or Siddhelvara,Matahgesa or Bhutisvara, or Asa- hisa, Prakaesa, or Kotirudresvara, or Madalase:5vara, or Tilaparnesvara, Hiranyagarbhesa or shall it be Madhyame4- vara?"

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्पायास्तु सत्यात्मा जज्ञे सङ्कल्प एव हि । अयादयो वसोः पुत्रा अष्टौ तान् शृणु शौनक
verses.transliteration: sa~NkalpAyAstu satyAtmA jaj~ne sa~Nkalpa eva hi | ayAdayo vasoH putrA aShTau tAn shR^iNu shaunaka
verses.translation: Pondering thus, Vyasa, devoted to Siva with his mind steady in meditation, thought for a short while.

verses.sanskrit: अयो धुवश्च सोमश्च धरश्चैवानिलोऽनलः । प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवाऽष्टौ च नामतः
verses.transliteration: ayo dhuvashcha somashcha dharashchaivAnilo.analaH | pratyUShashcha prabhAsashcha vasavA.aShTau cha nAmataH
verses.translation: '*0 I remember it now. I had forgotten it

verses.sanskrit: अयस्य पुत्रो वैतण्डः श्रमः शान्तो मुनिस्तथा । ध्रुवस्य पुत्रो भगवान् कालो लोकभावनः
verses.transliteration: ayasya putro vaitaNDaH shramaH shAnto munistathA | dhruvasya putro bhagavAn kAlo lokabhAvanaH
verses.translation: Hence lord Madhyamesvara shall be resorted to. Many brahmins have attained Siddhis by propitiating Him.

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्य भगवान् वर्चा वर्चस्वी येन जायते । धरस्य पुत्रो द्रविणो हुतहव्यवहस्तथा
verses.transliteration: somasya bhagavAn varchA varchasvI yena jAyate | dharasya putro draviNo hutahavyavahastathA
verses.translation: Kubera became the lord of wealth; Vamadeva the head of the devotees of Siva; the childless Khatvahga was blessed with children.

verses.sanskrit: मनोहरायाः शिशिरः प्राणोऽथ रमणस्तथा । अनिलस्य शिवा भार्या यस्याः पुत्राः पुरोजवः
verses.transliteration: manoharAyAH shishiraH prANo.atha ramaNastathA | anilasya shivA bhAryA yasyAH putrAH purojavaH
verses.translation: The celestial damsel Candrabhama of cuckoo¬ like sweet voice was merged into the Linga even as she was dancing emotionally.

verses.sanskrit: अविज्ञातगतिश्चैव द्वौ पुत्रावनिलस्य तु । अग्निपुत्रः कुमारस्तु शरस्तम्बे श्रियावृते
verses.transliteration: avij~nAtagatishchaiva dvau putrAvanilasya tu | agniputraH kumArastu sharastambe shriyAvR^ite
verses.translation: Srikara, son of the cowherdess, resorted to Madhyamesvara and attained the chieftainship of the Ganas of the benevolent Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य शाखो विशाखश्च नैगमेयश्च पृष्ठतः । अपत्यं कृत्तिकानां तु कार्तिकेय इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tasya shAkho vishAkhashcha naigameyashcha pR^iShThataH | apatyaM kR^ittikAnAM tu kArtikeya iti smR^itaH
verses.translation: Thanks to the favour of Madhyamesvara the two gods Sukra and Brhaspati honoured and respected by the Asuras and gods became the master of all lore.

verses.sanskrit: स मैथुनेन धर्मेण ससर्ज विविधाः प्रजाः । ताः शृणु त्वं महाप्राज्ञ कथयामि समासतः
verses.transliteration: sa maithunena dharmeNa sasarja vividhAH prajAH | tAH shR^iNu tvaM mahAprAj~na kathayAmi samAsataH
verses.translation: I too shall worship lord MadhyameiSvara and attain the power to compose the Puranas immediately.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेस्तु भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मचारिणी । योगसिद्धा जगत्कृत्स्नं समन्ताद्व्यचरत्तदा
verses.transliteration: bR^ihaspatestu bhaginI varastrI brahmachAriNI | yogasiddhA jagatkR^itsnaM samantAdvyacharattadA
verses.translation: After resolving thus the sage Vyasa, son of Satyavall, took his bath in the waters of the Ganga and performed the sacred rites and observances.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभासस्य तु सा भार्या वसूनामष्टमस्य च । विश्वकर्मा महाभाग तस्य जज्ञे प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: prabhAsasya tu sA bhAryA vasUnAmaShTamasya cha | vishvakarmA mahAbhAga tasya jaj~ne prajApatiH
verses.translation: Sometimes he took in only leaves, sometimes he lived on fruit and vegetable diet, sometimes on wind or water and sometimes he observed complete fast and performed the sacred rites.

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता शिल्पसहस्राणां त्रिदशानां च वार्धकिः । भूषणानां च सर्वेषां कर्ता शिल्पवतां वरः
verses.transliteration: kartA shilpasahasrANAM tridashAnAM cha vArdhakiH | bhUShaNAnAM cha sarveShAM kartA shilpavatAM varaH
verses.translation: Thus by these observances of restraints the holy

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वासां विमानानि देवतानां चकार ह । मनुष्याश्चोपजीवन्ति यस्य शिल्पं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yaH sarvAsAM vimAnAni devatAnAM chakAra ha | manuShyAshchopajIvanti yasya shilpaM mahAtmanaH
verses.translation: A long time elasped thus. One day early in the morning the sage was returning after his bath in the waters of the Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: रैवतोऽजो भवो भीमो वाम उग्रो वृषाकपिः । अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यो बहुरूपो महानिति
verses.transliteration: raivato.ajo bhavo bhImo vAma ugro vR^iShAkapiH | ajaikapAdahirbudhnyo bahurUpo mahAniti
verses.translation: The holy sage saw lord Madhyamesvara, the bestower of desires of the devotees, in the midst of the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: सरूपायां प्रसूतस्य स्त्रियां रुद्रश्च कोटिशः । तत्रैकादशमुख्यास्तु तन्नामानि मुने शृणु
verses.transliteration: sarUpAyAM prasUtasya striyAM rudrashcha koTishaH | tatraikAdashamukhyAstu tannAmAni mune shR^iNu
verses.translation: The moonlight of the autumnal crescent moon

verses.sanskrit: अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यस्त्वष्टा रुद्रश्च वीर्यवान् । हरश्च बहुरूपश्च त्र्यम्बकश्चापराजितः
verses.transliteration: ajaikapAdahirbudhnyastvaShTA rudrashcha vIryavAn | harashcha bahurUpashcha tryambakashchAparAjitaH
verses.translation: He had assumed the form of a five-year-old boy with eyes extending upto his ears. His lips were as red as the coral. He was wearing ornaments befitting a boy.

verses.sanskrit: वृषाकपिश्च शम्भुश्च कपर्दी रैवतस्तथा । एकादशैते कथिता रुद्रास्त्रिभुवनेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: vR^iShAkapishcha shambhushcha kapardI raivatastathA | ekAdashaite kathitA rudrAstribhuvaneshvarAH
verses.translation: The lustre of his body subdued the arrogance

verses.sanskrit: शतं त्वेवं समाख्यातं रुद्राणाममितौजसाम् । शृणु कश्यपपत्नीनां नामानि मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: shataM tvevaM samAkhyAtaM rudrANAmamitaujasAm | shR^iNu kashyapapatnInAM nAmAni munisattama
verses.translation: On seeing Siva, the lord of Uma, the shoreless ocean of mercy, known for his fondness of devotees and easily propitiated with delighted pleasing face, inaccessible even to the Yogins, the kinsman of the distressed and the Git-formed lord, the sage sang the song of prayer with words choked with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां पुत्रसहस्राणि वीरिण्यां पञ्च वीर्यवान् । आश्रित्य जनयामास दक्ष एव प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tasyAM putrasahasrANi vIriNyAM pa~ncha vIryavAn | Ashritya janayAmAsa dakSha eva prajApatiH
verses.translation: "O lord of gods, O fortunate one who are favour¬ ably disposed to the refugees, O lord inaccessible to words, mind and activities, and the one that are invisible even to the Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: एतान् सृष्टांस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा नारदः प्राह वै मुनिः । सत्रे स तु समुत्पन्नो नारदः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: etAn sR^iShTAMstu tAndR^iShTvA nAradaH prAha vai muniH | satre sa tu samutpanno nAradaH parameShThinaH
verses.translation: O lord of Uma, the Vedas too do not realise 'our greatness. You alone are the creator of the universe, itic sustainer and the annihilator too.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच । भुवो मानमजानन्तः कथं सृष्टिं करिष्यथ । सर्वे हि बालिशाः किं हि सृष्टिकर्तुं समुद्यताः
verses.transliteration: nArada uvAcha | bhuvo mAnamajAnantaH kathaM sR^iShTiM kariShyatha | sarve hi bAlishAH kiM hi sR^iShTikartuM samudyatAH
verses.translation: You are the first and foremost of all gods. You

verses.sanskrit: धर्मपत्न्यो मुने त्वेतास्तास्वपत्यानि मे शृणु । विश्वेदेवास्तु विश्वायाः साध्यान्साध्या व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: dharmapatnyo mune tvetAstAsvapatyAni me shR^iNu | vishvedevAstu vishvAyAH sAdhyAnsAdhyA vyajAyata
verses.translation: You alone are the great Brahman; the under of the knot of Maya, unsullied by the three attributes as the leaf of the lotus unaffected by water.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यूषस्य त्वभूत्पुत्र ऋषिर्नाम्ना तु देवलः । द्वौ पुत्रौ देवलस्यापि प्रजावन्तौ मनीषिणौ
verses.transliteration: pratyUShasya tvabhUtputra R^iShirnAmnA tu devalaH | dvau putrau devalasyApi prajAvantau manIShiNau
verses.translation: You have neither birth nor conduct of life. You have neither a native land nor a family. Even so you are the lord of the three worlds. You fulfil the desires of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतवान्वा कश्यपाद्वै पुंसां सृष्टिर्भविष्यति । दक्षस्यैव दुहितृषु तस्मात्तानब्रवीत्तु सः
verses.transliteration: shrutavAnvA kashyapAdvai puMsAM sR^iShTirbhaviShyati | dakShasyaiva duhitR^iShu tasmAttAnabravIttu saH
verses.translation: Neither Brahma nor Visnu nor the gods including Indra nor the leading Yogins know your reality. We worship you of such features.

verses.sanskrit: अजानन्तः कथं सृष्टिं बालिशा वै करिष्यथ । दिशं काञ्चिदजानन्तस्तस्माद्विज्ञाय तां भुवम्
verses.transliteration: ajAnantaH kathaM sR^iShTiM bAlishA vai kariShyatha | dishaM kA~nchidajAnantastasmAdvij~nAya tAM bhuvam
verses.translation: Everything originates from you. You are all — the lord of Gauri, the slayer of the Tripuras, a boy, a youth, an aged man. I unite you with my heart.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ताः प्रययुः सर्वे आशां विज्ञातुमोजसा । तदन्तं न हि सम्प्राप्य न निवृत्ताः पितुर्गृहम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktAH prayayuH sarve AshAM vij~nAtumojasA | tadantaM na hi samprApya na nivR^ittAH piturgR^iham
verses.translation: Obeisance to lord Siva, who deserves the worship of devotees, Obeisance to the Ancient Being; to Siva the great Atman,"

verses.sanskrit: तज्ज्ञात्वा जनयामास पुनः पञ्चशतान् सुतान् । तानुवाच पुनः सोऽपि नारदः सर्वदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: tajj~nAtvA janayAmAsa punaH pa~nchashatAn sutAn | tAnuvAcha punaH so.api nAradaH sarvadarshanaH
verses.translation: After eulogising thus when the sage Vyasa prostrated on the ground the delighted boy spoke to him.

verses.sanskrit: ५.३२ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.32 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Then the delighted sage Vyasa of great penance stood up and replied — "O lord what h hidden from you the omniscient?"

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Then the delighted sage Vyasa of great penance stood up and replied — "O lord what h hidden from you the omniscient?"

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३२. द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः । कश्यपवंशवर्णनम् १ । सूत उवाच । अदितिर्दितिश्च सुरसारिष्टेला दनुरेव च । सुरभिर्विनता चैव ताम्रा क्रोधवशा खशा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.32\. dvAtriMsho.adhyAyaH | kashyapavaMshavarNanam 1 | sUta uvAcha | aditirditishcha surasAriShTelA danureva cha | surabhirvinatA chaiva tAmrA krodhavashA khashA
verses.translation: You are the immanent Soul and bestower of everything. Why does the lord force me for begging which is the cause of misery?

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टनेमिपत्नीनामपत्यानीह षोडश । बहुपुत्रस्य विदुषश्चतस्रो विद्युतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ariShTanemipatnInAmapatyAnIha ShoDasha | bahuputrasya viduShashchatasro vidyutaH smR^itAH
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Vyaa of pious mind, lord Siva who had assumed the form of boy smiled 'no

verses.sanskrit: कृशाश्वस्य तु देवर्षे देवप्रहरणाः स्मृताः । भार्म्यायामर्चिषि मुने धूम्रकेशस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kR^ishAshvasya tu devarShe devapraharaNAH smR^itAH | bhArmyAyAmarchiShi mune dhUmrakeshastathaiva cha
verses.translation: O most excellent of those who know brahman, the desire you have cherished in your heart will undoubtedly be realised ere long.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधा सती च द्वे पत्न्यौ स्वधा ज्येष्ठा सती परा । स्वधासूत पितॄन् वेदमथर्वाङ्गिरसं सती
verses.transliteration: svadhA satI cha dve patnyau svadhA jyeShThA satI parA | svadhAsUta pitR^In vedamatharvA~NgirasaM satI
verses.translation: I the immanent lord shall station myself in your throat, O brahmin, and shall make you compose the Itihasa and the Puranas efficiently.

verses.sanskrit: एते युगसहस्रान्ते जायन्ते पुनरेव हि । सर्वदेवनिकायाश्च त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तु कामजाः
verses.transliteration: ete yugasahasrAnte jAyante punareva hi | sarvadevanikAyAshcha trayastriMshattu kAmajAH
verses.translation: The holy hymn "Abhila§a§taka" (Eight Verses

verses.sanskrit: यथा सूर्यस्य नित्यं हि उदयास्तमयाविह । एवं देवानिकास्ते च सम्भवन्ति युगे युगे
verses.transliteration: yathA sUryasya nityaM hi udayAstamayAviha | evaM devAnikAste cha sambhavanti yuge yuge
verses.translation: Even a fool, getting up early in the morning taking his bath, worshipping the linga of Siva and reciting this hymn for a year shall attain the status of Brhaspati ( preceptor of the gods. )

verses.sanskrit: दित्यां बभूवतुः पुत्रौ कश्यपादिति नः श्रुतम् । हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव हिरण्याक्षश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: dityAM babhUvatuH putrau kashyapAditi naH shrutam | hiraNyakashipushchaiva hiraNyAkShashcha vIryavAn
verses.translation: This hymn repeatedly recited for a year in the presence of the Linga whether by a woman or a man, duly observing restraints, shall increase the intellect and learning.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहिका ह्यभवत्कन्या विप्रचित्तेः परिग्रहः । हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्राश्चत्वारः प्रथितौजसः
verses.transliteration: siMhikA hyabhavatkanyA viprachitteH parigrahaH | hiraNyakashipoH putrAshchatvAraH prathitaujasaH
verses.translation: Vyasa who thus secured the boon from the great lord Madhyamesvara composed the eighteen Puranas spor¬ tively.

verses.sanskrit: अनुह्रादश्च ह्रादश्च संह्रादश्चैव वीर्यवान् । प्रह्रादश्चानुजस्तत्र विष्णुभक्तिविचारधीः
verses.transliteration: anuhrAdashcha hrAdashcha saMhrAdashchaiva vIryavAn | prahrAdashchAnujastatra viShNubhaktivichAradhIH
verses.translation: The eighteen Puranas Brahma, Padma. Vaisnava, 8aiva, Bhagavata, Bhavisya, Naradiya, Markandeya, Agneya, Brahmavaivarta, Lainga, Varaha, Vamana Kaurma, Matsya, Garuda, Skanda and Brahmanda are conducive to fame and merit to those who listen to the glory of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अनुह्रादस्य सूर्यायां पुलोमा महिषस्तथा । ह्रादस्य धमनिर्भार्यासूत वातापिमिल्वलम्
verses.transliteration: anuhrAdasya sUryAyAM pulomA mahiShastathA | hrAdasya dhamanirbhAryAsUta vAtApimilvalam
verses.translation: You have enumerated the eighteen Puranas. O foremost among the knowers of the Vedas please define them now.

verses.sanskrit: कद्रूर्मुनिश्च विप्रेन्द्र तास्वपत्यानि मे शृणु । पूर्वमन्वन्तरे श्रेष्ठे द्वादशासन्सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kadrUrmunishcha viprendra tAsvapatyAni me shR^iNu | pUrvamanvantare shreShThe dvAdashAsansurottamAH
verses.translation: Another Purana composed by ParaSara and en¬ lightening the details of Vi§nu is called Vaisnava Purana. It is said to be composed by Vyasa since there is no difference between father and son.

verses.sanskrit: बलेः पुत्रशतं त्वासीदशनायां मुनीश्वर । बलिरासीन्महाशैवः शिवभक्तिपरायणः
verses.transliteration: baleH putrashataM tvAsIdashanAyAM munIshvara | balirAsInmahAshaivaH shivabhaktiparAyaNaH
verses.translation: Those who know the Puraas speak that purana as Siva Purana wherein there are many stories of Siva in its earlier and later forms.

verses.sanskrit: दानशील उदारश्च पुण्यकीर्तितपाः स्मृतः । तत्पुत्रो बाणनामा यः सोऽपि शैववरः सुधीः । यः सन्तोष्य शिवं सम्यग्गाणपत्यमवाप ह
verses.transliteration: dAnashIla udArashcha puNyakIrtitapAH smR^itaH | tatputro bANanAmA yaH so.api shaivavaraH sudhIH | yaH santoShya shivaM samyaggANapatyamavApa ha
verses.translation: Where the stories of the goddess Durga are mentioned, it is said to be Bhagavata Purana as well as Devlpurana.'*

verses.sanskrit: सा कथा श्रुतपूर्वा ते बाणस्य हि महात्मनः । कृष्णं यः समरे वीरः सुप्रसन्नं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: sA kathA shrutapUrvA te bANasya hi mahAtmanaH | kR^iShNaM yaH samare vIraH suprasannaM chakAra ha
verses.translation: The Purana narrated by Narada is called Naradiya. The seventh Purapa is called, O Tancli, Markandeya because the great sage Markandeya is the speaker therein. Since it is related to the fire-god, the Purana is called Agneya. Since it recounts future events the Purana is called the Bhaviya Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्याक्षसुताः पञ्च पण्डिताः सुमहाबलाः । कुकुरः शकुनिश्चैव भूतसन्तापनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: hiraNyAkShasutAH pa~ncha paNDitAH sumahAbalAH | kukuraH shakunishchaiva bhUtasantApanastathA
verses.translation: O sage, the twelfth Purana Varaha is so called because it contains the story of Varaha, the great Boar. In the Skanda Purana the speaker is lord Siva himself and the listener is Skanda. In the Vamana Purana the story of Vamana (the Dwarf-god) is mentioned. The Kurma Purana contains the story of Kurma (the tortoise-god). The Matsya Purana is so called because it is expounded by Matsya. The Garuda Purana is so called because the speaker is Garuda himself. Since the story of the entire cosmic egg is mentioned, the last Purana is called Brahmanda Purana. SUta said: —

verses.sanskrit: महानादश्च विक्रान्तः कालनाभस्तथैव च । इत्युक्ता दितिपुत्राश्च दनोः पुत्रान् मुने शृणु
verses.transliteration: mahAnAdashcha vikrAntaH kAlanAbhastathaiva cha | ityuktA ditiputrAshcha danoH putrAn mune shR^iNu
verses.translation: Accordinp to §P., the Saiviie Purpna Devibhagavata, and not the Visi[iuite Purana 'Mahabhagavata' belongs to the eighteen Furipas See Winternitz H.I.L. Vol i Pt. IJ PP. 486-87.

verses.sanskrit: अभवन्दनुपुत्राश्च शतं तीव्रपराक्रमाः । अयोमुखः शम्बरश्च कपोलो वामनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: abhavandanuputrAshcha shataM tIvraparAkramAH | ayomukhaH shambarashcha kapolo vAmanastathA
verses.translation: O brahmin, you shall not entertain a doubt as to why Satyavati had sexual intercourse with Paraara and Santanu.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानरः पुलोमा च विद्रावणमहाशिरौ । स्वर्भानुर्वृषपर्वा च विप्रचित्तिश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: vaishvAnaraH pulomA cha vidrAvaNamahAshirau | svarbhAnurvR^iShaparvA cha viprachittishcha vIryavAn
verses.translation: This wondrous birth has sufficient reasons behind it. In the story of great men the good qualities shall be grasped by the intelligent people.

verses.sanskrit: एते सर्वे दनोः पुत्राः कश्यपादनुजज्ञिरे । एषां पुत्रीः शृणु मुने प्रसङ्गाद्वच्मि तेऽनघ
verses.transliteration: ete sarve danoH putrAH kashyapAdanujaj~nire | eShAM putrIH shR^iNu mune prasa~NgAdvachmi te.anagha
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this great secret is rid of all sins and is honoured in the world of sages.

verses.sanskrit: स्वभार्नोस्तु प्रभा कन्या पुलोम्नस्तु शची सुता । उपदानवी हयशिरा शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी
verses.transliteration: svabhArnostu prabhA kanyA pulomnastu shachI sutA | upadAnavI hayashirA sharmiShThA vArShaparvaNI
verses.translation: The beautiful episode of Siva with various in¬ cidental anecdotes and narratives of various incarnations, is heard. It yields both worldly pleasures and salvation to men.

verses.sanskrit: तुषिता नाम तेऽन्योन्यमूचुर्वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे । उपस्थिते सुयशसश्चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: tuShitA nAma te.anyonyamUchurvaivasvate.antare | upasthite suyashasashchAkShuShasyAntare manoH
verses.translation: O foremost among those who know Brahman, we wish to hear from you the beautiful story of the mother of the universe, the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः पुत्रसहस्राणि षष्टिर्दानवनन्दनाः । मरीचिर्जनयामास महता तपसान्विताः
verses.transliteration: tayoH putrasahasrANi ShaShTirdAnavanandanAH | marIchirjanayAmAsa mahatA tapasAnvitAH
verses.translation: The first primordial Sakti of Siva the great Brahman, who is called Uma, is the great mother of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पौलोमाः कालखञ्जाश्च दानवानां महाबलाः । अवध्या देवतानां च हिरण्यपुरवासिनः
verses.transliteration: paulomAH kAlakha~njAshcha dAnavAnAM mahAbalAH | avadhyA devatAnAM cha hiraNyapuravAsinaH
verses.translation: Her two incarnations — Sati and Haimavati, have been heard, O intelligent Suta. Please mention her other in¬ carnations too.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहप्रसादेन ये हताः सव्यसाचिना । सिंहिकायामथोत्पन्ना विप्रचित्तेः सुतास्तथा
verses.transliteration: pitAmahaprasAdena ye hatAH savyasAchinA | siMhikAyAmathotpannA viprachitteH sutAstathA
verses.translation: Which intelligent man will be reluctant to hear the good attributes of the glorious mother? Wise men never abandon them.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यदानवसंयोगाज्जातास्तीव्रपराक्रमाः । सैंहिकेया इति ख्यातास्त्रयोदश महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: daityadAnavasaMyogAjjAtAstIvraparAkramAH | saiMhikeyA iti khyAtAstrayodasha mahAbalAH
verses.translation: You are all blessed and contented noble souls in as

verses.sanskrit: राहुः शल्यो सुबलिनो बलश्चैव महाबलः । वातापिर्नमुचिश्चैवाथेल्वलः स्वसृपस्तथा
verses.transliteration: rAhuH shalyo subalino balashchaiva mahAbalaH | vAtApirnamuchishchaivAthelvalaH svasR^ipastathA
verses.translation: Sages consider the dust-particles of the feet of those who listen, narrate and inquire about it, on a par with holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: अजिको नरकश्चैव कालनाभस्तथैव च । शरमाणः शरः कल्प एते वंशविवर्धनाः
verses.transliteration: ajiko narakashchaiva kAlanAbhastathaiva cha | sharamANaH sharaH kalpa ete vaMshavivardhanAH
verses.translation: Blessed and contented are they, their parents and their family, whose mind is merged in the goddess, the great Knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: एषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च दनुवंशविवर्द्धनाः । बहवश्च समुद्भूता विस्तरत्वान्न वर्णिताः
verses.transliteration: eShAM putrAshcha pautrAshcha danuvaMshavivarddhanAH | bahavashcha samudbhUtA vistaratvAnna varNitAH
verses.translation: Those who do not eulogise the goddess of the gods, the cause of all causes are deluded by the attributes of Maya. They are unfortunate. There is no doubt in this.

verses.sanskrit: संह्रादस्य तु दैतेया निवातकवचाः कुले । उत्पन्ना मरुतस्तस्मिंस्तपसा भावितात्मनः
verses.transliteration: saMhrAdasya tu daiteyA nivAtakavachAH kule | utpannA marutastasmiMstapasA bhAvitAtmanaH
verses.translation: Those who do not worship the great goddess, the ocean of the juice of mercy, fall in the blind well in the form of the cruel worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: षण्मुखाद्या महासत्त्वास्ताम्रायाः परिकीर्तिताः । काकी श्येनी च भासी च सुग्रीवी च शुकी तथा
verses.transliteration: ShaNmukhAdyA mahAsattvAstAmrAyAH parikIrtitAH | kAkI shyenI cha bhAsI cha sugrIvI cha shukI tathA
verses.translation: Abandoning the goddess and resorting to another deity is as bad as abandoning the Gahga and resorting to water in the desert for the sake of satisfaction.

verses.sanskrit: हिताय सर्वलोकानां समागम्य परस्परम् । आगच्छत द्रुतं देवा अदितिं च प्रविश्य वै
verses.transliteration: hitAya sarvalokAnAM samAgamya parasparam | AgachChata drutaM devA aditiM cha pravishya vai
verses.translation: Which excellent man will abandon her whose very remembrance bestows all the four aims of life without any strain?

verses.sanskrit: श्येनी श्येनांस्तथा भासी भासान्गृद्धी तु गृध्रकान् । शुकी शुकानजनयत्सुग्रीवी शुभपक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: shyenI shyenAMstathA bhAsI bhAsAngR^iddhI tu gR^idhrakAn | shukI shukAnajanayatsugrIvI shubhapakShiNaH
verses.translation: Formerly in the Svarocisa Manvantara there was a king Viratha. Suratha his son was of great strength and exploit.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वानुष्ट्रान् गर्दभांश्च ताम्रा च कश्यपप्रिया । जनयामास चेत्येवं ताम्रावंशः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: ashvAnuShTrAn gardabhAMshcha tAmrA cha kashyapapriyA | janayAmAsa chetyevaM tAmrAvaMshaH prakIrtitaH
verses.translation: They laid siege to his capital Kola.'® The king had a terrible war with them.

verses.sanskrit: विनतायाश्च पुत्रौ द्वावरुणो गरुडस्तथा । सुपर्णः पततां श्रेष्ठो दारुणः स्वेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: vinatAyAshcha putrau dvAvaruNo garuDastathA | suparNaH patatAM shreShTho dAruNaH svena karmaNA
verses.translation: The king went to another city of his along with his ministers. There too he was defeated by his enemies who had a large following.

verses.sanskrit: सुरसायाः सहस्रं तु सर्पाणाममितौजसाम् । अनेकशिरसां तेषां खेचराणां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: surasAyAH sahasraM tu sarpANAmamitaujasAm | anekashirasAM teShAM khecharANAM mahAtmanAm
verses.translation: His ministers and officers became inimical to him due to adverse fate. They took away all the wealth from the treasury.

verses.sanskrit: येषां प्रधाना राजानः शेषवासुकितक्षकाः । ऐरावतो महापद्मः कम्बलाश्वतरावुभौ
verses.transliteration: yeShAM pradhAnA rAjAnaH sheShavAsukitakShakAH | airAvato mahApadmaH kambalAshvatarAvubhau
verses.translation: The king left his city pretending to go out for hunting. Alone he got up on a horse and went to the dense forest.

verses.sanskrit: ऐलापत्रस्तथा पद्मः कर्कोटकधनञ्जयौ । महानीलमहाकर्णौ धृतराष्ट्रो बलाहकः
verses.transliteration: ailApatrastathA padmaH karkoTakadhana~njayau | mahAnIlamahAkarNau dhR^itarAShTro balAhakaH
verses.translation: Going about here and there, the king saw the hermitage of a great sage. It was shining all round with flower gardens. Everywhere the sound of Vedic hymns was heard. All the animals there were quiet and peaceful. The disciples and the disciples of their disciples moved here and there.

verses.sanskrit: कुहरः पुष्पदन्तश्च दुर्मुखः सुमुखस्तथा । बहुशः खररोमा च पाणिरित्येवमादयः
verses.transliteration: kuharaH puShpadantashcha durmukhaH sumukhastathA | bahushaH khararomA cha pANirityevamAdayaH
verses.translation: O intelligent one, tigers and other ferocious and powerful animals did not harass the animals of less strength in that hermitage, thanks to the power of the leading brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: गणाः क्रोधवशायाश्च तस्याः सर्वे च दंष्ट्रिणः । अण्डजाः पक्षिणोऽब्जाश्च वराह्याः पशवो मताः
verses.transliteration: gaNAH krodhavashAyAshcha tasyAH sarve cha daMShTriNaH | aNDajAH pakShiNo.abjAshcha varAhyAH pashavo matAH
verses.translation: Once the king began to think anxiously — "Alas, my kingdom has been seized by my haughty enemies. I am unfortunate. My intellect is confounded. I have lost my splendour. The kingdom which had been well guarded by my ancestors is now enjoyed by my enemies.

verses.sanskrit: अनायुषायाः पुत्राश्च पञ्चाशच्च महाबलाः । अभवन्बलवृक्षौ च विक्षरोऽथ बृहंस्तथा
verses.transliteration: anAyuShAyAH putrAshcha pa~nchAshachcha mahAbalAH | abhavanbalavR^ikShau cha vikSharo.atha bR^ihaMstathA
verses.translation: My hereditary ministers and counsellors have left me. I do not know which king they serve now.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरे प्रसूयामः सतां श्रेयो भविष्यति । एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: manvantare prasUyAmaH satAM shreyo bhaviShyati | evamuktAstu te sarve chAkShuShasyAntare manoH
verses.translation: I do not know what plight they are in, after the ruination of the kingdom. My heroic soldiers, very enthusiastic in the battle, slayers of enemies, now serve another king. Huge elephants like mountains, horses fast as wind have gone away. Is the traditional treasury accu¬ mulated by my ancestors well guarded or not? Thus the very virtuous king became much deluded.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तविंशतिर्याः प्रोक्ताः सोमपत्न्योऽथ सुव्रताः । तासामपत्यान्यभवन्दीप्तयोऽमिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: saptaviMshatiryAH proktAH somapatnyo.atha suvratAH | tAsAmapatyAnyabhavandIptayo.amitatejasaH
verses.translation: In the meantime a certain VaiSya came there. The king asked him — "Sir, who are you? Why have you come here? Why do you appear to be very morose and dejected? Please tell me this, now."

verses.sanskrit: संह्रादस्य कृतिर्भार्यासूत पञ्चजनं ततः । विरोचनस्तु प्राह्रादिर्देव्यां तस्याभवद् बलिः
verses.transliteration: saMhrAdasya kR^itirbhAryAsUta pa~nchajanaM tataH | virochanastu prAhrAdirdevyAM tasyAbhavad baliH
verses.translation: "O king, I am a Vaiiya Samadhi, born of a rich family. Out of greed for my wealth I have been abandoned by my wife, sons and others. 1 am depressed by my past Karman. O king, I have come here to the forest. I am worried about my sons, grandsons, wife, brothers, their sons and friends. O lord, ocean of mercy, I am in dark about their welfare.

verses.sanskrit: पुलोमिका पुलोमा च वैश्वानरसुते उभे । बह्वपत्ये महावीर्ये मारीचेस्तु परिग्रहा त्
verses.transliteration: pulomikA pulomA cha vaishvAnarasute ubhe | bahvapatye mahAvIrye mArIchestu parigrahA t
verses.translation: O king, words pregnant with substantial sense have been uttered by you. Still my mind is deluded by the tie of love.

verses.sanskrit: गृध्रिकाश्वी ह्युलूकी च ताम्राकन्याः प्रकीर्तिताः । काकी काकानजनयदुलूकी प्रत्युलूककान्
verses.transliteration: gR^idhrikAshvI hyulUkI cha tAmrAkanyAH prakIrtitAH | kAkI kAkAnajanayadulUkI pratyulUkakAn
verses.translation: O excellent sage, the king and the VaiSya, both of them equally deluded then approached the sage Medhas.

verses.sanskrit: शशांस्तु जनयामास सुररभिर्महिषांस्तथा । इला वृक्षाँल्लता वल्लीस्तृणजातीस्तु सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: shashAMstu janayAmAsa surarabhirmahiShAMstathA | ilA vR^ikShA.NllatA vallIstR^iNajAtIstu sarvashaH
verses.translation: The valorous king accompanied by the chief of the Vaisyas bowed his head to the leading Yogin.

verses.sanskrit: खशा तु यक्षरक्षांसि मुनिरप्सरसस्तथा । अरिष्टासूत सर्पांश्च प्रभा वै मानवोत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: khashA tu yakSharakShAMsi munirapsarasastathA | ariShTAsUta sarpAMshcha prabhA vai mAnavottamAn
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence the king spoke to the sage: — "O holy lord, it behoves you now to dispel our delusion.

verses.sanskrit: एते कश्यपदायादाः कीर्तितास्ते मुनीश्वर । येषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: ete kashyapadAyAdAH kIrtitAste munIshvara | yeShAM putrAshcha pautrAshcha shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
verses.translation: Abandoned by the royal lory I have resorted to this dense forest. Still I am not content and happy since my kingdom has been taken away.

verses.sanskrit: मारीचात्कश्यपाज्जातास्तेऽदित्यां दक्षकन्यया । तत्र विष्णुश्च शक्रश्च जज्ञाते पुनरेव हि
verses.transliteration: mArIchAtkashyapAjjAtAste.adityAM dakShakanyayA | tatra viShNushcha shakrashcha jaj~nAte punareva hi
verses.translation: This Vaiiya has been expelled from his house by his people, wife and others. Still his sense of affinity and kinship with them does not go off.

verses.sanskrit: अर्यमा चैव धाता च त्वष्टा पूषा तथैव च । विवस्वान् सविता चैव मित्रावरुण एव च
verses.transliteration: aryamA chaiva dhAtA cha tvaShTA pUShA tathaiva cha | vivasvAn savitA chaiva mitrAvaruNa eva cha
verses.translation: The great Maya in the form of the eternal Sakti is the material cause of the universe. It is this that drags the minds of all and makes them deluded.

verses.sanskrit: अंशो भगश्चातितेजा आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः । चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वमासन्ये तुषिताः सुराः
verses.transliteration: aMsho bhagashchAtitejA AdityA dvAdasha smR^itAH | chAkShuShasyAntare pUrvamAsanye tuShitAH surAH
verses.translation: O lord, Brahma and other gods deluded by this Maya do not realise the truth. What then is the story of men?

verses.sanskrit: पुरैव तस्यान्तरे तु आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः । इति प्रोक्तानि क्रमशोऽदित्यपत्यानि शौनक
verses.transliteration: puraiva tasyAntare tu AdityA dvAdasha smR^itAH | iti proktAni kramasho.adityapatyAni shaunaka
verses.translation: That alone, Paramesvari of three attributes, creates the universe; she alone sustains it and she alone destroys it at the proper time.

verses.sanskrit: ५.३३ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.33 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: When the whole universe had been one great expanse of water,'® a vast sea, when Kesava, the king of Yogins, resorted to Yogic slumber and was sleeping on Sesa, two Asuras were born of the dirt in the ears of Visnu. They became notorious on the surface of the world in the names of Madhu and Kaitabha.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: When the whole universe had been one great expanse of water,'® a vast sea, when Kesava, the king of Yogins, resorted to Yogic slumber and was sleeping on Sesa, two Asuras were born of the dirt in the ears of Visnu. They became notorious on the surface of the world in the names of Madhu and Kaitabha.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३३. त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः । कश्यपवंशवर्णनम् २ । सूत उवाच । एष मन्वन्तरे तात सर्गः स्वारोचिषे स्मृतः । वैवस्वते तु महति वारुणे वित ते क्रतौ
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.33\. trayastriMshattamo.adhyAyaH | kashyapavaMshavarNanam 2 | sUta uvAcha | eSha manvantare tAta sargaH svArochiShe smR^itaH | vaivasvate tu mahati vAruNe vita te kratau
verses.translation: They were terrible with huge bodies. They had the dazzling brilliance of the sun at the time of dissolution They had huge jaw bones. Their faces were hideous with curved fangs. They seemed to devour all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शक्रस्तस्याः कुक्षिं प्रविश्य सः । वज्रपाणिस्तु तं गर्भं सप्तधा हि न्यकृन्तत
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare shakrastasyAH kukShiM pravishya saH | vajrapANistu taM garbhaM saptadhA hi nyakR^intata
verses.translation: P. 1071 note. For details see Agrawal. MP — A Study PP. 9. a66, 321. We find a rock-cut image of Ekaruava at Udayagirife 400 A. D.)

verses.sanskrit: स पाट्यमानो गर्भोऽथ वज्रेण प्ररुरोद ह । रुदन्तं सप्तधैकैकं मा रोदीरिति तान्पुनः । चकर्त वज्रपाणिस्तान्नेव मम्रुस्तथापि ते
verses.transliteration: sa pATyamAno garbho.atha vajreNa praruroda ha | rudantaM saptadhaikaikaM mA rodIriti tAnpunaH | chakarta vajrapANistAnneva mamrustathApi te
verses.translation: On seeing the lotus-seated deity in the umbilical lotus*® of the lord, the two Asuras® shouted "Hey, who arc you?** and attempted to kill him.

verses.sanskrit: ते तमूचुः पाट्यमानाः सर्वे प्राञ्जलयो मुने । नो जिघांससि किं शक्र भ्रातरो मरुतस्तव
verses.transliteration: te tamUchuH pATyamAnAH sarve prA~njalayo mune | no jighAMsasi kiM shakra bhrAtaro marutastava
verses.translation: On seeing the two Daityas and observing that Visnu was still lying in the vast milky ocean,** Brahma eulogised ParameSvari.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रेण स्वीकृतास्ते हि भ्रातृत्वे सर्व एव च । तत्यजुर्द्दैत्यभावं ते विप्रर्षे शङ्करेच्छया
verses.transliteration: indreNa svIkR^itAste hi bhrAtR^itve sarva eva cha | tatyajurddaityabhAvaM te viprarShe sha~NkarechChayA
verses.translation: O Mahamaya, save me, save me, O goddess favourably disposed to those who seek refuge in you, O mother of the universe, save me from these Daityas of hideous features.

verses.sanskrit: मरुतो नाम ते देवा बभूवुः सुमहाबलाः । खगा एकोनपञ्चाशत्सहाया वज्रपाणिनः
verses.transliteration: maruto nAma te devA babhUvuH sumahAbalAH | khagA ekonapa~nchAshatsahAyA vajrapANinaH
verses.translation: I bow to the great Maya, the Yogic slumber, Uma, Sati, Kalaratri, Maharatri, Moharatri, greater than the greatest, the mother of the three deities, the eternal, the bestowcr of the fruits of the cherished desires of the devotees, the protectress of the gods and the ocean of mercy.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामेव प्रवृद्धानां हरिः प्रादात्प्रजापतिः । क्रमशस्तानि राज्यानि पृथुपूर्वं शृणुष्व तत्
verses.transliteration: teShAmeva pravR^iddhAnAM hariH prAdAtprajApatiH | kramashastAni rAjyAni pR^ithupUrvaM shR^iNuShva tat
verses.translation: O Mother, you are Svaha, Svadha, Hri, the un¬ alloyed intellect, Tuti (satisfaction), Pusti nourishment), Sand (peace), Kanti (forbearance), Ksudha (hunger) and mercy itself.

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टः पुरुषो वीरः कृष्णो जिष्णुः प्रजापतिः । पर्जन्यस्तु धनाध्यक्षस्तस्य सर्वमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: ariShTaH puruSho vIraH kR^iShNo jiShNuH prajApatiH | parjanyastu dhanAdhyakShastasya sarvamidaM jagat
verses.translation: O mother, you are the Maya of Vi§nu, the very consciousness, the great Sakti, Lajja ( bashfulness ) and Tr?na ( thirst).

verses.sanskrit: भूतसर्गमिमं सम्यगवोचं ते महामुने । विभागं शृणु राज्यानां क्रमशस्तं ब्रुवेऽधुना
verses.transliteration: bhUtasargamimaM samyagavochaM te mahAmune | vibhAgaM shR^iNu rAjyAnAM kramashastaM bruve.adhunA
verses.translation: You arc Bhranti (Illusion). You appear in the form of Smrti (Memory): you stay assuming the form of mother. You are LaksmI in the house of those who engage themselves in meritorious activities.

verses.sanskrit: अभिषिच्याधिराज्ये तु पृथुं वैन्यं पितामहः । ततः क्रमेण राज्यानि व्यादेष्टुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: abhiShichyAdhirAjye tu pR^ithuM vainyaM pitAmahaH | tataH krameNa rAjyAni vyAdeShTumupachakrame
verses.translation: Sprung from the ears of Viriu while he was, asleep at the end of a Kalpa, Madhu and Kaitabha were about to kill Brahma but were killed by Vi;pu. Prof. Agrawal however offers a symbolical interpretation of Madhu and Kaitabha as Rajas and Tamas-

verses.sanskrit: जुह्वानस्य ब्रह्मणो वै प्रजासर्ग इहोच्यते । पूर्वं यानथ ब्रह्मर्षीनुत्पन्नान् सप्त मानसान्
verses.transliteration: juhvAnasya brahmaNo vai prajAsarga ihochyate | pUrvaM yAnatha brahmarShInutpannAn sapta mAnasAn
verses.translation: See P. 224 note.

verses.sanskrit: अपां तु वरुणं राज्ये राज्ञां वैश्रवणं प्रभुम् । आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनामथ पावकम्
verses.transliteration: apAM tu varuNaM rAjye rAj~nAM vaishravaNaM prabhum | AdityAnAM tathA viShNuM vasUnAmatha pAvakam
verses.translation: Youare Jati (Birth), Vytti (cause of activity) and VySpti (pervasiveness. ) You pervade everything in the form of intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतीनां दक्षं तु मरुतामथ वासवम् । दैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्लादममितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: prajApatInAM dakShaM tu marutAmatha vAsavam | daityAnAM dAnavAnAM cha prahlAdamamitaujasam
verses.translation: O Mother, please delude these unthwartable Asuras. O origin of the universe, please waken Vi§9u the unborn lord."

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतं पितॄणां च यमं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत् । मातॄणां च व्रतानां च मन्त्राणां च तथा गवाम्
verses.transliteration: vaivasvataM pitR^INAM cha yamaM rAjye.abhyaShechayat | mAtR^INAM cha vratAnAM cha mantrANAM cha tathA gavAm
verses.translation: O king, on being requested by Brahma for the destruction of Madhu and Kaifabha, the mother of the universe, the great Vidya, the presiding deity of all Vidyas, Sakti the enchantress of the three worlds manifested herself as Mahikali on the twelfth Tithi of the bright half of the month of Phalguna.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च पार्थिवानां तथैव च । सर्वभूतपिशाचानां गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्
verses.transliteration: yakShANAM rAkShasAnAM cha pArthivAnAM tathaiva cha | sarvabhUtapishAchAnAM girishaM shUlapANinam
verses.translation: Then a celestial voice arose: — "O lotus-seated one, do not be afraid. I shall remove the thorn after killing Madhu and Kaitabha in the battle."

verses.sanskrit: शैलानां हिमवन्तं च नदीनामथ सागरम् । मृगाणामथ शार्दूलं गोवृषं तु गवामपि
verses.transliteration: shailAnAM himavantaM cha nadInAmatha sAgaram | mR^igANAmatha shArdUlaM govR^iShaM tu gavAmapi
verses.translation: After saying this and coming out of the eyes, mouth etc. of Vijnu, the great Maya stood before Brahma of unmanifested birth.

verses.sanskrit: वनस्पतीनां वृक्षाणां वटं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत् । इति दत्तं प्रजेशेन राज्यं सर्वत्र वै क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vanaspatInAM vR^ikShANAM vaTaM rAjye.abhyaShechayat | iti dattaM prajeshena rAjyaM sarvatra vai kramAt
verses.translation: Vijnu, the lord of gods stood up and saw in front of him the Daityas Madhu and Kaitabha.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वस्यां दिशि पुत्रं तु वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः । स्थापयामास सर्वात्मा राज्ये विश्वपतिर्विभुः
verses.transliteration: pUrvasyAM dishi putraM tu vairAjasya prajApateH | sthApayAmAsa sarvAtmA rAjye vishvapatirvibhuH
verses.translation: A battle ensued between Visnu of unequalled splendour and the two Daityas lasting for five thousand years. Then there ensued a hand-to-hand fight.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव मुनिशार्दूल कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । दक्षिणस्यां तथा पुत्रं सुधन्वानमचीक्लृपत्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva munishArdUla kardamasya prajApateH | dakShiNasyAM tathA putraM sudhanvAnamachIklR^ipat
verses.translation: Deluded by the powerful great Maya, the excellent Danava spoke to the lord Vi?nu — "Ask for whatever boon you desire to choose."

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमायां दिशि तथा रजसः पुत्रमच्युतम् । केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं व्यादिशत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: pashchimAyAM dishi tathA rajasaH putramachyutam | ketumantaM mahAtmAnaM rAjAnaM vyAdishatprabhuH
verses.translation: If you are pleased with me grant me this boon that I may kill you. I do not request for any other boon.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रान्वै कल्पयामास स्वयमेव पितामहः । तेषां विरोधो देवानां दानवानां महाॠषे
verses.transliteration: putrAnvai kalpayAmAsa svayameva pitAmahaH | teShAM virodho devAnAM dAnavAnAM mahAR^IShe
verses.translation: On seeing the earth covered by a great expanse of ocean they spoke to Keiava: — *'Kill us in a spot where the earth is not covered with water."

verses.sanskrit: तस्य विस्तारमाख्यातं पृथोर्वैन्यस्य शौनक । महर्ध्यै तदधिष्ठानं पुराणं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: tasya vistAramAkhyAtaM pR^ithorvainyasya shaunaka | mahardhyai tadadhiShThAnaM purANaM parikIrtitam
verses.translation: After giving his consent the lord lifted up his dazzling discus, placed their heads on his loins and cut them off.

verses.sanskrit: दितिर्विनष्टपुत्रा तु कश्यपं समुपस्थिता । स कश्यपः प्रसन्नात्मा सम्गयगाराधितस्तया
verses.transliteration: ditirvinaShTaputrA tu kashyapaM samupasthitA | sa kashyapaH prasannAtmA samgayagArAdhitastayA
verses.translation: O king, thus I have told you about the origin of Kalika. O intelligent one, listen to the origin of Maha- lakfmi now.

verses.sanskrit: वरेणच्छन्दयामास सा च वव्रे वरं तदा । पुत्रमिन्द्रवधार्थाय समर्थममितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: vareNachChandayAmAsa sA cha vavre varaM tadA | putramindravadhArthAya samarthamamitaujasam
verses.translation: Although free from aberrations, and devoid of forms and features, goddess Uma manifested herself in different Yugas for the destruction of the distress of the gods, after assuming different forms and features.

verses.sanskrit: अकृत्वा पादयोः शौचं दितिरर्वाक्षिरास्तदा । निद्रामाहारयामास भाविनोऽर्थस्य गौरवात्
verses.transliteration: akR^itvA pAdayoH shauchaM ditirarvAkShirAstadA | nidrAmAhArayAmAsa bhAvino.arthasya gauravAt
verses.translation: Thus I have described to you her manifestation in bodily form whose wish alone manifests as everything efficaciously. Thus she conducts her sports in that way and thereby gives chance to her devotees to describe her attributes.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजानां वीरुधां चैव नक्षत्रग्रहयोस्तथा । यज्ञानां तपसां चैव सोमं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: dvijAnAM vIrudhAM chaiva nakShatragrahayostathA | yaj~nAnAM tapasAM chaiva somaM rAjye.abhyaShechayat
verses.translation: That king of Danavas defeated all the gods in battle and ruled over the kingdom of heaven seated on the throne of lord Indra.

verses.sanskrit: तथा हिरण्यरोमाणं पर्जन्यस्य प्रजापतेः । उदीच्यां दिशि राजानं दुर्धर्षं सोऽभ्यषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: tathA hiraNyaromANaM parjanyasya prajApateH | udIchyAM dishi rAjAnaM durdharShaM so.abhyaShechayat
verses.translation: The defeated gods sought refuge in Brahma. With them Brahma went to the place where Visnu and Siva* were present.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्यै च वरं प्रादात्प्रार्थितं सुमहातपाः । ब्रह्मचर्य्यादिनियमं प्राह चैव शतं समाः
verses.transliteration: sa tasyai cha varaM prAdAtprArthitaM sumahAtapAH | brahmacharyyAdiniyamaM prAha chaiva shataM samAH
verses.translation: After reaching there and bowing to l§iva and Vi|nu the gods narrated all their woeful tale in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: धारयामास गर्भं तु शुचिः सा वरवर्णिनी । ब्रह्मचर्य्यादिनियमं दितिर्दध्रे तथैव वै
verses.transliteration: dhArayAmAsa garbhaM tu shuchiH sA varavarNinI | brahmacharyyAdiniyamaM ditirdadhre tathaiva vai
verses.translation: O lords, we are harassed by the wicked Mahia, We have been ousted from heaven after our defeat in the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वाधाय सो दित्यां गर्भं तं शंसितव्रतः । जगाम कश्यपस्तप्तुं तपः संहृष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: tatastvAdhAya so dityAM garbhaM taM shaMsitavrataH | jagAma kashyapastaptuM tapaH saMhR^iShTamAnasaH
verses.translation: We are wandering in this world of mortals with-

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्चैवान्तरं प्रेप्सुः सोऽभवत्पाकशासनः । ऊनवर्षे शते चास्या ददर्शान्तरमेव सः
verses.transliteration: tasyAshchaivAntaraM prepsuH so.abhavatpAkashAsanaH | UnavarShe shate chAsyA dadarshAntarameva saH
verses.translation: The word 'Vrsakapi' in the dual form signifies Visnu and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ५.३४ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.34 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence it behoves you to save us the gods who have sought refuge in you. O lords, please think of the means of killing him immediately.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence it behoves you to save us the gods who have sought refuge in you. O lords, please think of the means of killing him immediately.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३४. चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । सर्वमन्वतरानुर्कार्तनम् । शौनक उवाच । मन्वन्तराणि सर्वाणि विस्तरेणानुकीर्तय । यावन्तो मनवश्चैव श्रोतुमिच्छामि तानहम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.34\. chatustriMsho.adhyAyaH | sarvamanvatarAnurkArtanam | shaunaka uvAcha | manvantarANi sarvANi vistareNAnukIrtaya | yAvanto manavashchaiva shrotumichChAmi tAnaham
verses.translation: On hearing the gods, Vi§nu and Siva were very angry. Their eyes rolled through anger.
