verses.sanskrit: आग्नीध्रश्चाग्निबाहुश्च मेधा मेधातिथिर्वसुः । ज्योतिष्मान्धृतिमान्हव्यः सवनः शुभ्र एव च
verses.transliteration: AgnIdhrashchAgnibAhushcha medhA medhAtithirvasuH | jyotiShmAndhR^itimAnhavyaH savanaH shubhra eva cha
verses.translation: Then a great splendour issued forth from the mouths of the infuriated Visnu and Siva and from the bodies of other gods.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवस्य पुत्रास्ते मनोर्दश महात्मनः । कीर्तिता मुनिशार्दूल तत्रेन्द्रो यज्ञ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: svAyambhuvasya putrAste manordasha mahAtmanaH | kIrtitA munishArdUla tatrendro yaj~na uchyate
verses.translation: The gods who were devoted to meditation on Durga saw the mass of splendour blazing in all the ten directions.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं कथितं तात दिव्यं मन्वतरं तथा । द्वितीयं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्निबोध यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: prathamaM kathitaM tAta divyaM manvataraM tathA | dvitIyaM te pravakShyAmi tannibodha yathAtatham
verses.translation: That highly terrible splendour issuing forth from the bodies of the gods joined together and became a woman Mahisamardini herself.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जस्तम्भः परस्तम्भ ऋषभो वसुमांस्तथा । ज्योतिष्मान् द्युतिमांश्चैव रोचिष्मान् सप्तमस्तथा
verses.transliteration: UrjastambhaH parastambha R^iShabho vasumAMstathA | jyotiShmAn dyutimAMshchaiva rochiShmAn saptamastathA
verses.translation: Her dazzlingly brilliant face constituted the splendour of Siva, the hairs the splendour of Yama and the arms the splendour of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: एते महर्षयो ज्ञेयास्तत्रेन्द्रो रोचनस्तथा । देवाश्च तुषिता नाम स्मृताः स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे
verses.transliteration: ete maharShayo j~neyAstatrendro rochanastathA | devAshcha tuShitA nAma smR^itAH svArochiSheM.atare
verses.translation: Her breasts were formulated by the splendour of the moon; the waist by that of Indra; the calves and thighs by that ol' Varuna; the hips by that of the earth; the feet by that of Brahma; the toes by that of the sun; the fingers by that of Indra; the nose by that of Kubera; the teeth by that of the patriarch; the eyes by that of fire; the eyebrows by that of the dusk; the ears by that of the wind, her other limbs by that of other heaven-dwellers. Thus the goddess manifested herself on the lotus-seat.

verses.sanskrit: हरिघ्नः सुकृतिर्ज्योतिरयोमूर्तिरयस्मयः । प्रथितश्च मनस्युश्च नभः सूर्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: harighnaH sukR^itirjyotirayomUrtirayasmayaH | prathitashcha manasyushcha nabhaH sUryastathaiva cha
verses.translation: On seeing her thus formulated by the mass of splendour of the gods, they attained great delight.

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषस्य पुत्रास्ते मनोर्दश महात्मनः । कीर्तिता मुनिशार्दूल महावीर्यपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: svArochiShasya putrAste manordasha mahAtmanaH | kIrtitA munishArdUla mahAvIryaparAkramAH
verses.translation: Observing that she had no weapons, Brahma and other gods decided to make her fully equipped with weapons.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयमेतत्कथितं मुने मन्वन्तरं मया । तृतीयं तव वक्ष्यामि तन्निबोध यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: dvitIyametatkathitaM mune manvantaraM mayA | tR^itIyaM tava vakShyAmi tannibodha yathAtatham
verses.translation: Then lord Siva offered her a spear; Lord Krpa gave her a discus; Varuna conch and noose.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठपुत्राः सप्तासन्वासिष्ठा इति विश्रुताः । हिरण्यगर्भस्य सुता ऊर्जा नाम महौजसः
verses.transliteration: vasiShThaputrAH saptAsanvAsiShThA iti vishrutAH | hiraNyagarbhasya sutA UrjA nAma mahaujasaH
verses.translation: The fire-god gave her Sakti; the wind-god a bow and a quiver full of arrows; Indra the thunderbolt and a bell; Yama a big staff; Prajapati a garland of beads; Brahma a water-pot and the sun the lustrous hair.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । स्वायम्भुवो मनुश्चैव ततः स्वारोचिषस्तथा । उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | svAyambhuvo manushchaiva tataH svArochiShastathA | uttamastAmasashchaiva raivatashchAkShuShastathA
verses.translation: Kala gave her a sword and a shining shield, the milk ocean a beautiful necklace, two fresh pieces of cloth, the crest-jewel, car-rings, bangles, crescent-shaped ornaments, beautiful anklets, shoulder-pieces, a necklace and finger-rings. Visvakarman gave her a beautiful axe and the ocean various weapons, an impenetrable armour, a beauti¬ ful garland and a lotus.

verses.sanskrit: इष ऊर्जित ऊर्जश्च मधुर्माधव एव च । शुचिः शुक्रवहश्चैव नभसो नभ एव च
verses.transliteration: iSha Urjita Urjashcha madhurmAdhava eva cha | shuchiH shukravahashchaiva nabhaso nabha eva cha
verses.translation: Himavat gave her a lion and gems of various sorts. Kubera a vessel filled with wine. Sesa a Nagahira of wonderful workmanship, studded with various precious gems.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषभस्तत्र देवाश्च सत्यवेदश्रुतादयः । तत्रेन्द्रः सत्यजिन्नाम त्रैलोक्याधिपतिर्मुने
verses.transliteration: R^iShabhastatra devAshcha satyavedashrutAdayaH | tatrendraH satyajinnAma trailokyAdhipatirmune
verses.translation: Thus honoured, the goddesss with these and other similar objects, ornaments, weapons etc. shouted loudly again and again.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयमेतत्परमं मन्वतरमुदाहृतम् । मन्वतरं चतुर्थं ते कथयामि मुने शृणु
verses.transliteration: tR^itIyametatparamaM manvataramudAhR^itam | manvataraM chaturthaM te kathayAmi mune shR^iNu
verses.translation: The four oceans shook and rolled. The earth quaked. Cries of victory were shouted by "the gods harassed by Mahisa.

verses.sanskrit: गार्ग्यः पृथुस्तथा वाग्मी जयो धाता कपीनकः । कपीवान् सप्त ऋषयः सत्या देवगणास्तथा
verses.transliteration: gArgyaH pR^ithustathA vAgmI jayo dhAtA kapInakaH | kapIvAn sapta R^iShayaH satyA devagaNAstathA
verses.translation: Then the gods eulogised the great Sakti, Ambika in the form of MahalaksmI with words choked with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेन्द्रस्त्रिशिखो ज्ञेयो मनुपुत्रान्मुने शृणु । द्यूतिपोतः सौतपस्यस्तपः शूलश्च तापनः
verses.transliteration: tatrendrastrishikho j~neyo manuputrAnmune shR^iNu | dyUtipotaH sautapasyastapaH shUlashcha tApanaH
verses.translation: On seeing the world agitated, the enemies of the gods got up with uplifted arms and with their armies ready for war.

verses.sanskrit: तपोरतिरकल्माषो धन्वी खड्गी महानृषिः । तामसस्य स्मृता एते दश पुत्रा महाव्रताः
verses.transliteration: taporatirakalmASho dhanvI khaDgI mahAnR^iShiH | tAmasasya smR^itA ete dasha putrA mahAvratAH
verses.translation: The infuriated Mahisa rushed at the direction of the sound and saw the goddess who had pervaded the three worlds with her beautiful lustre.

verses.sanskrit: तामसस्यान्तरं चैव मनोर्मे कथितं तव । चतुर्थं पञ्चमं तात शृणु मन्वन्तरं परम्
verses.transliteration: tAmasasyAntaraM chaiva manorme kathitaM tava | chaturthaM pa~nchamaM tAta shR^iNu manvantaraM param
verses.translation: In the meantime, crores of great heroes led by Mahisasura came there with weapons..

verses.sanskrit: देवबाहुर्जयश्चैव मुनिर्वेदशिरास्तथा । हिरण्यरोमा पर्जन्य ऊर्ध्वबाहुश्च सोमपाः
verses.transliteration: devabAhurjayashchaiva munirvedashirAstathA | hiraNyaromA parjanya UrdhvabAhushcha somapAH
verses.translation: Ciksura, Camara, Udagra, Karala, Uddhafa, Bakala; Tamra, Ugrasya, Ugravirya, Bidala, Andhaka, Durdhara, Durmukha, Trinetra Mahahanu — these and many others, heroic and efficient in battle, came there.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यनेत्ररताश्चान्ये एते सप्तर्षयोऽपरे । देवाश्च भूतरजसस्तपःप्रकृतयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: satyanetraratAshchAnye ete saptarShayo.apare | devAshcha bhUtarajasastapaHprakR^itayastathA
verses.translation: As they, the masters of weapons and missiles,

verses.sanskrit: एते च मनवः षट् ते सम्प्रोक्ता मुनिपुङ्गव । वैवस्वतो मुनिश्रेष्ठ साम्प्रतं मनुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ete cha manavaH ShaT te samproktA munipu~Ngava | vaivasvato munishreShTha sAmprataM manuruchyate
verses.translation: Different weapons and missiles hurled by the hosts of enemies were rendered futile instantaneously by the power of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनः पङ्क्तिविन्ध्यो वा दयायास्तनयामुने । महता तपसा युक्ता मेरुपृष्ठे वसन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: arjunaH pa~Nktivindhyo vA dayAyAstanayAmune | mahatA tapasA yuktA merupR^iShThe vasanti hi
verses.translation: Then the goddess hit and struck the hosts of enemies Gik$ura and others with her club, arrows, spear, iSakti and axe.

verses.sanskrit: रुचेः प्रजापतिः पुत्रो रौच्यो नाम मनुः स्मृतः । भूत्या चोत्पादितो देव्यां भौत्यो नामाभवत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: rucheH prajApatiH putro rauchyo nAma manuH smR^itaH | bhUtyA chotpAdito devyAM bhautyo nAmAbhavatsutaH
verses.translation: When his armies fell the demon Mahisa struggled with the hosts of soldiers that issued from the breath of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: अनागताश्च सप्तैते कल्पेऽस्मिन् मनवः स्मृताः । अनागताश्च सप्तैव स्मृता दिवि महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: anAgatAshcha saptaite kalpe.asmin manavaH smR^itAH | anAgatAshcha saptaiva smR^itA divi maharShayaH
verses.translation: He kicked some with the hoofs, hit some with the horns and others with his tail and snout.

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपोऽत्रिर्वसिष्टश्च विश्वामित्रोऽथ गौतमः । जमदग्नीभरद्वाजः सत्रैते ॠष्यः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: kashyapo.atrirvasiShTashcha vishvAmitro.atha gautamaH | jamadagnIbharadvAjaH satraite R^IShyaH smR^itAH
verses.translation: After slaying the Ganas the chief of Asuras rushed at the lion of the goddess in order to kill it. Then she be¬ came wrathful.

verses.sanskrit: रामो व्यासस्तथात्रेयो दीप्तिमान्सुबहुश्रुतः । भरद्वाजस्तथा द्रौणिरश्वत्थामा महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: rAmo vyAsastathAtreyo dIptimAnsubahushrutaH | bharadvAjastathA drauNirashvatthAmA mahAdyutiH
verses.translation: He of great virility thrashed the ground with his hoofs, uprooted a mountain with his horns, hurled it and shouted.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमस्यात्मजश्चैव शरद्वान् गौतमः कृपः । कौशिको गालवश्चैव रुरुः कश्यप एव च
verses.transliteration: gautamasyAtmajashchaiva sharadvAn gautamaH kR^ipaH | kaushiko gAlavashchaiva ruruH kashyapa eva cha
verses.translation: O excellent king, heavy mountains hurled by him as he rushed all round fell in the battle-ground from the sky.

verses.sanskrit: एते सप्त महात्मानो भविष्या मुनिसत्तमाः । देवाश्चानागतास्तत्र त्रयः प्रोक्ताः स्वयम्भुवा
verses.transliteration: ete sapta mahAtmAno bhaviShyA munisattamAH | devAshchAnAgatAstatra trayaH proktAH svayambhuvA
verses.translation: Clouds split by his horns were shattered to pieces. The ocean struck at with his tail throbbed and splashed water beyond the shores all round.

verses.sanskrit: मारीचेश्चैव पुत्रास्ते कश्यपस्य महात्मनः । तेषां विरोचनसुतो बलिरिन्द्रो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: mArIcheshchaiva putrAste kashyapasya mahAtmanaH | teShAM virochanasuto balirindro bhaviShyati
verses.translation: On seeing the demon Mahisa thus infuriated, Ambika, the protectress of the gods, became ready to kill him.

verses.sanskrit: विषांङ्गश्चावनीवांश्च सुमन्तो धृतिमान्वसुः । सूरिः सुराख्यो विष्णुश्च राजा सुमतिरेव च
verses.transliteration: viShAM~NgashchAvanIvAMshcha sumanto dhR^itimAnvasuH | sUriH surAkhyo viShNushcha rAjA sumatireva cha
verses.translation: She took up a noose and hurled it at him. She bound the Asura Mahisa. Then the demon abandoned his assumed guise.

verses.sanskrit: सावर्णिश्च मनुश्चैव ततो रौच्यस्तथा परः । तथैव ब्रह्मसावर्णिश्चत्वारो मनवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sAvarNishcha manushchaiva tato rauchyastathA paraH | tathaiva brahmasAvarNishchatvAro manavastathA
verses.translation: Wielding Maya, he became a lion. Soon as Ambika tried to cut off his head he became armed with a sword.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं दक्षसावर्णि प्रवक्ष्यामि मनुं शृणु । मेधातिथिश्च पौलस्त्यो वसुः कश्यप एव च
verses.transliteration: prathamaM dakShasAvarNi pravakShyAmi manuM shR^iNu | medhAtithishcha paulastyo vasuH kashyapa eva cha
verses.translation: She then struck him with the arrows, as he stood there with the sword and shield. He then became an elephant and struck at the lion with his trnk.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिष्मान् भार्गवश्चैव धृतिमानङ्गिरास्तथा । सवनश्चैव वासिष्ठ आत्रेयो हव्य एव च
verses.transliteration: jyotiShmAn bhArgavashchaiva dhR^itimAna~NgirAstathA | savanashchaiva vAsiShTha Atreyo havya eva cha
verses.translation: The goddess cut off his hand with her sword. The ucmon then assumed his original form.

verses.sanskrit: पुलहः सप्त इत्येते ऋषयो रौहितेऽन्तरे । देवतानां गणास्तत्र त्रय एव महामुने
verses.transliteration: pulahaH sapta ityete R^iShayo rauhite.antare | devatAnAM gaNAstatra traya eva mahAmune
verses.translation: He then agitated three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings. Then, Candika of great honour and exploit became infuriated.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षपुत्रस्य पुत्रास्ते रोहितस्य प्रजापतेः । धृष्टकेतुर्दीप्तकेतुः पञ्चहस्तो निराकृतिः
verses.transliteration: dakShaputrasya putrAste rohitasya prajApateH | dhR^iShTaketurdIptaketuH pa~nchahasto nirAkR^itiH
verses.translation: She drank the beverage again and again. With eyes rolliug she laughed aloud. The haughty Asura too, proud of his strength and exploit, roared.

verses.sanskrit: पृथुश्रवा भूरिद्युम्नो ऋचीको बृहतो गयः । प्रथमस्य तु सावर्णेर्नव पुत्रा महौजसः
verses.transliteration: pR^ithushravA bhUridyumno R^ichIko bR^ihato gayaH | prathamasya tu sAvarNernava putrA mahaujasaH
verses.translation: He uprooted the mountains and hurled them at her. She too reduced them to powder and struck them with arrows.

verses.sanskrit: दशमे त्वथ पर्याये द्वितीयस्यान्तरे मनोः । हविष्मान् पौलहश्चैव प्रकृतिश्चैव भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: dashame tvatha paryAye dvitIyasyAntare manoH | haviShmAn paulahashchaiva prakR^itishchaiva bhArgavaH
verses.translation: With her face reddened as a result of the inebria¬ tion after drinking wine, and with her scn-scs excited, she spoke in a tone as majestic as the rumbling of the clouds.

verses.sanskrit: आपोमुक्तिस्तथात्रेयो वासिष्ठश्चाव्ययः स्मृतः । पौलस्त्यः प्रयतिश्चैव भामारश्चैव काश्यपः
verses.transliteration: ApomuktistathAtreyo vAsiShThashchAvyayaH smR^itaH | paulastyaH prayatishchaiva bhAmArashchaiva kAshyapaH
verses.translation: "O stupid fellow, O demon of ruined intellect, why are you stubborn in vain? None of the Asuras in the three worlds can stand before me".

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिरानेनसः सत्यः सप्तैते परमर्षयः । देवतानां गणाश्चापि द्विषिमन्तश्च ये स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: a~NgirAnenasaH satyaH saptaite paramarShayaH | devatAnAM gaNAshchApi dviShimantashcha ye smR^itAH
verses.translation: Thus saying the goddess pounced on him, stamped on his neck and pierced him with her fierce spear.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामिन्द्रः स्मृतः शम्भुस्त्वयमेव महेश्वरः । अक्षत्वानुत्तमौजाश्च भूरिषेणश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: teShAmindraH smR^itaH shambhustvayameva maheshvaraH | akShatvAnuttamaujAshcha bhUriSheNashcha vIryavAn
verses.translation: Pressed with her foot and overwhelmed by her might the Asura seemed as good as half dead.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव धर्मसावर्णी रुद्रसावर्णिरेव च । देवसावर्णिराख्यात इन्द्रसावर्णिरेव च
verses.transliteration: tathaiva dharmasAvarNI rudrasAvarNireva cha | devasAvarNirAkhyAta indrasAvarNireva cha
verses.translation: Still he continued to fight. His head was cut off with the sword and he was felled down on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरस्यां दिशि तथा मुने सप्तर्षयस्तथा । यामा नाम तथा देवा आसन्स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: uttarasyAM dishi tathA mune saptarShayastathA | yAmA nAma tathA devA AsansvAyambhuve.antare
verses.translation: Crying "Alas! Alas" loudly, his followers, afraid of the battle fled from the scene shouting "Save us, O save us'.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयोऽत्र समाख्याताः कीर्त्यमानान्निबोध मे । औत्तमेया ऋषिश्रेष्ठ दश पुत्रा मनोः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: R^iShayo.atra samAkhyAtAH kIrtyamAnAnnibodha me | auttameyA R^iShishreShTha dasha putrA manoH smR^itAH
verses.translation: The god Indra and others, eulogised the goddess. The Gandharvas sang songs; the celestial damsels danced,

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेन्द्रो विभुनामा च त्रैलोक्याधिपतिस्तथा । रैवताख्यो मनुस्तत्र ज्ञेयस्तामससोदरः
verses.transliteration: tatrendro vibhunAmA cha trailokyAdhipatistathA | raivatAkhyo manustatra j~neyastAmasasodaraH
verses.translation: O king, thus the origin of MahalaksmI has been narrated to you. Now listen to the origin of Sarasvati with a calm mind.

verses.sanskrit: सावर्णेश्च मनोः पुत्रा भविष्या दश शौनक । इहाष्टमं हि कथितं नवमं चान्तरं शृणु
verses.transliteration: sAvarNeshcha manoH putrA bhaviShyA dasha shaunaka | ihAShTamaM hi kathitaM navamaM chAntaraM shR^iNu
verses.translation: The gods aflflicted and harassed by them went to Himalaya and saluted the mother of all living beings, the bestower of all desires.

verses.sanskrit: शतानीको निरामित्रो वृषसेनो जयद्रथः । भूरिद्युम्नः सुवर्चार्चिर्दश त्वेते मनोः सुताः
verses.transliteration: shatAnIko nirAmitro vR^iShaseno jayadrathaH | bhUridyumnaH suvarchArchirdasha tvete manoH sutAH
verses.translation: O goddess Durga, Victory be to you. O, beloved of your kinsmen, be victorious. Obeisance to you, the cause of the protection of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिराश्चैव धृतिमान् पौलस्त्यो हव्यवांस्तु यः । पौलहस्तत्त्वदर्शी च भार्गवश्च निरुत्सवः
verses.transliteration: a~NgirAshchaiva dhR^itimAn paulastyo havyavAMstu yaH | paulahastattvadarshI cha bhArgavashcha nirutsavaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the bestower of salvation, obeisance to the great mother, the cause of the creation, sustenance and annihilation of the world.

verses.sanskrit: देवतानां गणाः प्रोक्ताः शृणु पञ्च महामुने । तुरङ्गभीरुर्बुध्नश्च तनुग्रोऽनुग्र एव च
verses.transliteration: devatAnAM gaNAH proktAH shR^iNu pa~ncha mahAmune | tura~NgabhIrurbudhnashcha tanugro.anugra eva cha
verses.translation: O goddess of the form of Kalika, Tara. Ghinnamasta, Srividya, Obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं सर्वं मन्वन्तरसमुद्भवम् । विसर्गं पुण्यमाख्यानं धन्यं कुलविवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaM sarvaM manvantarasamudbhavam | visargaM puNyamAkhyAnaM dhanyaM kulavivarddhanam
verses.translation: O goddess of the worlds, of the form of Bhairava, obeisance to you. Obeisance to Bagalamukhi (s tork- faced ). Obeisance, to Dhumavati.

verses.sanskrit: एकादशे तु पर्याये तृतीयस्यान्तरे मनोः । तस्यापि सप्त ऋषयः कीर्त्यमानान्निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: ekAdashe tu paryAye tR^itIyasyAntare manoH | tasyApi sapta R^iShayaH kIrtyamAnAnnibodha me
verses.translation: Obeisance to Tripurasundari, to Matahgi, to Ajita (the unconquered) and to Vijaya.

verses.sanskrit: हविष्मान् कश्यपश्चापि वपुष्मांश्चैव वारुणः । आत्रेयोऽथ वसिष्ठश्च ह्यनयस्त्वङ्गिरास्तथा
verses.transliteration: haviShmAn kashyapashchApi vapuShmAMshchaiva vAruNaH | Atreyo.atha vasiShThashcha hyanayastva~NgirAstathA
verses.translation: Obeisance to Jaya, Mahgala Vilasini, to you of the form of milking maid and of terrible form.

verses.sanskrit: चारुधृष्यश्च पौलस्त्यो निःस्वरोऽग्निस्तु तैजसः । सप्तैते ऋषयः प्रोक्तास्त्रयो देवगणाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: chArudhR^iShyashcha paulastyo niHsvaro.agnistu taijasaH | saptaite R^iShayaH proktAstrayo devagaNAH smR^itAH
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, O goddess, of the form of the unconquered, of permanent form, the protectress of those who seek refuge in you.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्तु सुतास्ते हि त इमे वैधृताः स्मृताः । सर्वगश्च सुशर्मा च देवानीकस्तु क्षेमकः
verses.transliteration: brahmaNastu sutAste hi ta ime vaidhR^itAH smR^itAH | sarvagashcha susharmA cha devAnIkastu kShemakaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to the one knowable through Vedanta; obeisance to you the great soul, the heroine of infinite worlds of this universe.

verses.sanskrit: दृढेषुः खण्डको दर्शः कुहुर्बाहुर्मनोः स्मृताः । सावर्णस्य तु पुत्रा वै तृतीयस्य नव स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: dR^iDheShuH khaNDako darshaH kuhurbAhurmanoH smR^itAH | sAvarNasya tu putrA vai tR^itIyasya nava smR^itAH
verses.translation: Eulogised thus by the gods the delighted goddess the bestower of boons, spoke, to the gods — "Who is being eulogised by you here?*'

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थस्य तु सावर्णेरृषीन्सप्त निबोध मे । द्युतिर्वसिष्ठपुत्रश्च आत्रेयः सुतपास्तथा
verses.transliteration: chaturthasya tu sAvarNerR^iShInsapta nibodha me | dyutirvasiShThaputrashcha AtreyaH sutapAstathA
verses.translation: Then a virgin came out of the body of the goddess. Even as they were winking she spoke to the goddess with great reverence. '

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिरास्तपसो मूर्तिस्तपस्वी कश्यपस्तथा । तपोधनश्च पौलस्त्यः पुलहश्च तपोरतिः
verses.transliteration: a~NgirAstapaso mUrtistapasvI kashyapastathA | tapodhanashcha paulastyaH pulahashcha taporatiH
verses.translation: **0 mother, this eulogy is addressed to me by the heaven-dwellers harassed by the powerful Daityas!§umbha and Nisumbha."

verses.sanskrit: भार्गवः सप्तमस्तेषां विज्ञेयः तपसो निधिः । पञ्च देवगणाः प्रोक्ता मानसा ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: bhArgavaH saptamasteShAM vij~neyaH tapaso nidhiH | pa~ncha devagaNAH proktA mAnasA brahmaNaH sutAH
verses.translation: Since she emerged out of the inner vestures of her body she is called KauSikl. The destroyer of the Asura Sumbha is being sung in that name.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतधामा तदिन्द्रो हि त्रिलोकी राज्यकृत्सुखी । द्वादशे चैव पर्याये भाव्ये रौच्यान्तरे मुने
verses.transliteration: R^itadhAmA tadindro hi trilokI rAjyakR^itsukhI | dvAdashe chaiva paryAye bhAvye rauchyAntare mune
verses.translation: She addressed the gods — "All of you stay here fearlessly. I shall carry out your task without any strain.

verses.sanskrit: अतीता वर्तमानाश्च तथैवानागताश्च ये । कीर्तिता मनवश्चापि मयैवैते यथा श्रुताः
verses.transliteration: atItA vartamAnAshcha tathaivAnAgatAshcha ye | kIrtitA manavashchApi mayaivaite yathA shrutAH
verses.translation: After saying this, the goddess vanished. Ganda and Munda — the attendants of Sumbha and Nisumba saw the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: निष्प्रपञ्चस्तथात्रेयो निर्देहः कश्यपस्तथा । सुतपाश्चैव वासिष्ठः सप्तैवैते महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: niShprapa~nchastathAtreyo nirdehaH kashyapastathA | sutapAshchaiva vAsiShThaH saptaivaite maharShayaH
verses.translation: On seeing her beautiful form pleasing to the eyes they were fascinated. They lost their consciousness and fell on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: त्रय एव गणाः प्रोक्ता देवतानां स्वयम्भुवा । दिवस्पतिस्तमिन्द्रो वै विचित्रश्चित्र एव च
verses.transliteration: traya eva gaNAH proktA devatAnAM svayambhuvA | divaspatistamindro vai vichitrashchitra eva cha
verses.translation: Returning to their king they narrated the details to him "O king, a certain beautiful lady hitherto unseen has been seen by us.

verses.sanskrit: नयो धर्मो धृतोन्ध्रश्च सुनेत्रः क्षत्रवृद्धकः । निर्भयः सुतपा द्रोणो मनो रौच्यस्य ते सुताः
verses.transliteration: nayo dharmo dhR^itondhrashcha sunetraH kShatravR^iddhakaH | nirbhayaH sutapA droNo mano rauchyasya te sutAH
verses.translation: Seated on a lion, on the beautiful peak of the Himavat she was served by the virgins of the gods with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: मनुस्त्रयोदशो भाव्यो देवसावर्णिरात्मवान् चित्रसेनविचित्राद्या देवसावर्णिदेहजाः
verses.transliteration: manustrayodasho bhAvyo devasAvarNirAtmavAn chitrasenavichitrAdyA devasAvarNidehajAH
verses.translation: They massaged her feet and hands, decorated her tresses, and applied collyrium to her eyes.

verses.sanskrit: देवाः सुकर्मसुत्रामसंज्ञा इन्द्रो दिवस्पतिः निर्मोकतत्त्वदर्शाद्या भविष्यन्त्युषयस्तदा
verses.transliteration: devAH sukarmasutrAmasa.nj~nA indro divaspatiH nirmokatattvadarshAdyA bhaviShyantyuShayastadA
verses.translation: A certain damsel held out the mirror to her face. Another handed over the betel-leaf along with cloves and cardamom.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशे तु पर्याये भौत्यस्यैवान्तरे मनोः । आग्नीध्रः काश्यपश्चैव पौलस्त्यो मागधश्च यः
verses.transliteration: chaturdashe tu paryAye bhautyasyaivAntare manoH | AgnIdhraH kAshyapashchaiva paulastyo mAgadhashcha yaH
verses.translation: Some picked up the fallen dice and stood in front of her. Some bedecked her body with ornaments and clothes.

verses.sanskrit: भार्गवोऽप्यतिवाह्यश्च शुचिराङ्गिरसस्तथा । युक्तश्चैव तथात्रेयः शुक्रो वाशिष्ठ एव च
verses.transliteration: bhArgavo.apyativAhyashcha shuchirA~NgirasastathA | yuktashchaiva tathAtreyaH shukro vAshiShTha eva cha
verses.translation: Her calves and thighs are like the stem of the plantain tree. Her nose is like that of a parrot. Her arms are like serpents and creepers. She wears a beautiful girdle. The anklets round her feet are jingling.

verses.sanskrit: अजितः पुलहश्चैव ह्यन्त्याः सप्तर्षयश्च ते । पवित्राश्चाक्षुषा देवाः शुचिरिन्द्रो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: ajitaH pulahashchaiva hyantyAH saptarShayashcha te | pavitrAshchAkShuShA devAH shuchirindro bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Pearl necklaces heave over her breasts rendered fragrant with the musk. Necklaces shine round her neck. She was sporting about bedecked in chaplets.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां कल्य उत्थाय कीर्तनात्सुखमेधते । अतीतानागतानां वै महर्षीणां नरैः सदा
verses.transliteration: eteShAM kalya utthAya kIrtanAtsukhamedhate | atItAnAgatAnAM vai maharShINAM naraiH sadA
verses.translation: She has semi-circular marks on her forehead. She wears ear-rings set with gems. Her plaited hair arc pretty. The wide three eyes bedeck her face.

verses.sanskrit: मुने चतुर्दशैतानि त्रिकालानुगतानि ते । प्रोक्तानि निर्मितः कल्पो युगसाहस्रपर्ययः
verses.transliteration: mune chaturdashaitAni trikAlAnugatAni te | proktAni nirmitaH kalpo yugasAhasraparyayaH
verses.translation: She has the brilliance of lightning. She wears precious garments. Her breasts are elevated within her bodice. She holds excellent weapons with her eight uplifted arms.

verses.sanskrit: अतिमानी प्रवीणश्च विष्णुः सङ्क्रन्दनस्तथा । तेजस्वी सबलश्चैव भौत्यस्त्वेते मनोः सुता
verses.transliteration: atimAnI pravINashcha viShNuH sa~NkrandanastathA | tejasvI sabalashchaiva bhautyastvete manoH sutA
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Ganda and Munda that great demon Sumbha sent a messenger Sugriva to her.

verses.sanskrit: भूयोऽपि भगवान् रुद्रः संहर्ता काल एव हि । कल्पान्ते तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य वै
verses.transliteration: bhUyo.api bhagavAn rudraH saMhartA kAla eva hi | kalpAnte tatpravakShyAmi manorvaivasvatasya vai
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Ganda and Munda that great demon Sumbha sent a messenger Sugriva to her.

verses.sanskrit: भौमस्यैवाधिकारे वै पूर्णे कल्पस्तु पूर्यते । इत्येतेऽनागतातीता मनवः कीर्तिता मया
verses.transliteration: bhaumasyaivAdhikAre vai pUrNe kalpastu pUryate | ityete.anAgatAtItA manavaH kIrtitA mayA
verses.translation: "O messenger, there is a certain beautiful lady on the snow-capped mountain. Mentioning these words of mine she shall be strenuously brought here'*.

verses.sanskrit: उक्ताः सनत्कुमारेण व्यासायामिततेजसा । पूर्णे युगसहस्रान्ते परिपाल्य स्वधर्मतः
verses.transliteration: uktAH sanatkumAreNa vyAsAyAmitatejasA | pUrNe yugasahasrAnte paripAlya svadharmataH
verses.translation: Thus urged by him, the exccllant Danava Sugriva went to Himacala and spoke to the great goddess, the mother of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाभिस्तपसा युक्ता ब्रह्मलोकं व्रजन्ति ते । युगानि सप्रतिस्त्वेकं साग्राण्यन्तरमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: prajAbhistapasA yuktA brahmalokaM vrajanti te | yugAni sapratistvekaM sAgrANyantaramuchyate
verses.translation: O gentle lady, the Daitya Sumbha and his brother Nisumbha are very strong and valorous. They are famous in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशैते मनवः कीर्तिताः कीर्तिवर्धनाः । मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु संहारान्ते पुनर्भवः
verses.transliteration: chaturdashaite manavaH kIrtitAH kIrtivardhanAH | manvantareShu sarveShu saMhArAnte punarbhavaH
verses.translation: O goddess, I am a messenger of Kumbha. I have come with his message to which you will listen please.

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यमन्तरं तेषां वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि । पूर्णे शतसहस्रे तु कल्पो निःशेष उच्यते
verses.transliteration: na shakyamantaraM teShAM vaktuM varShashatairapi | pUrNe shatasahasre tu kalpo niHsheSha uchyate
verses.translation: "I have defeated Indra aud others in the battle and taken away their jewels. I enjoy the share of the gods offered to them in the sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सर्वाणि भूतानि दग्धान्यादित्यरश्मिभिः । ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा सदादित्यगणैर्मुने
verses.transliteration: tatra sarvANi bhUtAni dagdhAnyAdityarashmibhiH | brahmANamagrataH kR^itvA sadAdityagaNairmune
verses.translation: You are a jewel among women, more precious than ether jewels. Resort to me or to my younger brothet* exhibiting your loving emotion.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविशन्ति सुरश्रेष्ठ हरिं नारायणं परम् । स्रष्टारं सर्वभूतानां कल्पान्तेषु पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: pravishanti surashreShTha hariM nArAyaNaM param | sraShTAraM sarvabhUtAnAM kalpAnteShu punaHpunaH
verses.translation: On hearing the message of iSumbha conveyed by the messenger the Mahamaya, the beloved consort of Siva, spoke.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषींस्तेषां प्रवक्ष्यामि पुत्त्रान् देवगणांस्तथा । शृणु शौनक सुप्रीत्या क्रमशस्तान्यशस्विनः
verses.transliteration: R^iShIMsteShAM pravakShyAmi puttrAn devagaNAMstathA | shR^iNu shaunaka suprItyA kramashastAnyashasvinaH
verses.translation: C) messenger, you speak the truth, not the lie. But I have taken a vow that I shall endeavour to make one alone as my husband who can shake off my pride, who can conquer me in the battle. None else.

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिरत्रिर्भगवानङ्गिराः पुलहः क्रतुः । पुलस्त्यश्च वसिष्ठश्च सप्तैते ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: marIchiratrirbhagavAna~NgirAH pulahaH kratuH | pulastyashcha vasiShThashcha saptaite brahmaNaH sutAH
verses.translation: Hence you convey my words to Sumbha and Niumbha. Let cither do whatever is proper in this matter.

verses.sanskrit: ५.३५ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 5\.35 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: On hearing the report of the messenger lumbha of stern rule angrily said to Dhumraksa, the foremost of his generals.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: On hearing the report of the messenger lumbha of stern rule angrily said to Dhumraksa, the foremost of his generals.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३५. पचत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । मन्वन्तरकीर्तने वैवस्वतवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । विवस्वान् कश्यपाज्जज्ञे दाक्षायण्यां महाऋषेः । तस्य भार्याभवत्संज्ञा त्वाष्ट्री देवी सुरेणुका
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.35\. pachatriMsho.adhyAyaH | manvantarakIrtane vaivasvatavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | vivasvAn kashyapAjjaj~ne dAkShAyaNyAM mahAR^iSheH | tasya bhAryAbhavatsa.nj~nA tvAShTrI devI sureNukA
verses.translation: O Dhumraksa, there is a beautiful lady on the snow-capped Himalaya mountain. Go quickly and fetch her here. O excellent Asura, do not be afraid of this expedition. If she wishes to fight, you shall fight strenuously.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्ता साऽगमद्देवी व्रीडिता सन्निधौ पितुः । पित्रा निर्भर्त्सिता तत्र नियुक्ता सा पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktA sA.agamaddevI vrIDitA sannidhau pituH | pitrA nirbhartsitA tatra niyuktA sA punaH punaH
verses.translation: Thus directed the Daitya Dhumraksa went to Himalaya and spoke to the goddess who was a part of Uma.

verses.sanskrit: अगच्छद्वडवा भूत्वाच्छाद्य रूपं ततः स्वकम् । कुरुंस्तदोत्तरान् प्राप्य नृणान्येव चचार ह
verses.transliteration: agachChadvaDavA bhUtvAchChAdya rUpaM tataH svakam | kuruMstadottarAn prApya nR^iNAnyeva chachAra ha
verses.translation: "O lady, approach my lord. Otherwise I shall kill you. I am accompanied by sixtythousand Asuras"

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञां तां तु रविर्मत्वा छायायां सुसुतं तदा । जनयामास सावर्णिं मनुं वै सविता किल
verses.transliteration: sa.nj~nAM tAM tu ravirmatvA ChAyAyAM susutaM tadA | janayAmAsa sAvarNiM manuM vai savitA kila
verses.translation: "O hero, you are commissioned by the king <if Daityas. If you kill rnc what can I do for you? But I consider it impoisiblc to go without a fight."

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञानु प्रार्थिता छाया सा स्वपुत्रेऽपि नित्यशः । चकाराभ्यधिकं स्नेहं न तथा पूर्वजे सुते
verses.transliteration: sa.nj~nAnu prArthitA ChAyA sA svaputre.api nityashaH | chakArAbhyadhikaM snehaM na tathA pUrvaje sute
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the Danava Dhumraksa rushed at her but was burnt with a mere Hunkara uttered by her.

verses.sanskrit: मनुस्तस्याक्षमत्तं यमस्तं नैव चक्षमे । स सरोषस्तु बाल्याच्च भाविनोऽर्थस्य गौरवात्
verses.transliteration: manustasyAkShamattaM yamastaM naiva chakShame | sa saroShastu bAlyAchcha bhAvino.arthasya gauravAt
verses.translation: He sent the Asuras-Ca, Munda and Raktabija in order. The Daityas, thus ordered, went to the spot where Ambika was stationed.

verses.sanskrit: छायां सन्तर्जयामास पदा वैवस्वतो यमः । तं शशाप ततः क्रोधाच्छाया तु कलुषीकृता
verses.transliteration: ChAyAM santarjayAmAsa padA vaivasvato yamaH | taM shashApa tataH krodhAchChAyA tu kaluShIkR^itA
verses.translation: On seeing the goddess seated on a lion, possessed of Anima®® and other Siddhis and dazzling the quarters with her brilliance, the leading Danavas said.

verses.sanskrit: चरणः पततामेष तवेति भृशरोषतः । यमस्ततः पितुः सर्वं प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: charaNaH patatAmeSha taveti bhR^isharoShataH | yamastataH pituH sarvaM prA~njaliH pratyavedayat
verses.translation: *'0 lady, hasten to approach Sumbha and Niumbha. Otherwise we shall kill you along with your Ganas and your lion.

verses.sanskrit: भृशं शापभयोद्विग्नः संज्ञावाक्यैर्विचेष्टितः । मात्रा स्नेहेन सर्वेषु वर्तितव्यं सुतेषु वै
verses.transliteration: bhR^ishaM shApabhayodvignaH sa.nj~nAvAkyairvicheShTitaH | mAtrA snehena sarveShu vartitavyaM suteShu vai
verses.translation: O lady, choose him as your husband. He is eu¬ logised by the guardians of the quarters and others. You will attain a great bliss rare to attain by the gods.**

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहमस्मास्वपाकृत्य कनीयांसं बिभर्ति सा । तस्मान्मयोद्यतः पादस्तद्भवान् क्षन्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: snehamasmAsvapAkR^itya kanIyAMsaM bibharti sA | tasmAnmayodyataH pAdastadbhavAn kShantumarhati
verses.translation: On hearing these words the goddess Amba smiled and spoke interesting and truthful words.

verses.sanskrit: मुनेऽसहिष्णुना तेन तेजसा दुस्सहेन च । भर्तृरूपेण नातुष्यद्रूपयौवनशालिनी
verses.transliteration: mune.asahiShNunA tena tejasA dussahena cha | bhartR^irUpeNa nAtuShyadrUpayauvanashAlinI
verses.translation: Lord Siva, the great Brahman, the eternal god is without a second. Even the Vedas do not understand his reality. What then of Visnu and others?

verses.sanskrit: सवितोवाच । असंशयं पुत्र महद्भविष्यत्यत्र कारणम् । येन त्वामाविशत्क्रोधो धर्मज्ञं सत्यवादिनम्
verses.transliteration: savitovAcha | asaMshayaM putra mahadbhaviShyatyatra kAraNam | yena tvAmAvishatkrodho dharmaj~naM satyavAdinam
verses.translation: I am His subtle Prakrti. How can I choose another as my husband? Even if she is overwhelmed by love does a lioness choose a jackal as her mate?

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यते तन्मिथ्या वै कर्तुं मातृवचस्तव । कृमयो मांसमादाय गमिष्यन्ति महीतले
verses.transliteration: na shakyate tanmithyA vai kartuM mAtR^ivachastava | kR^imayo mAMsamAdAya gamiShyanti mahItale
verses.translation: A female elephant does not take an ass nor does a leopardess take a hare. O Daityas, overcome by the Serpent of Death you speak in vain.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यं भविता सत्यं त्वं च त्रातौ भविष्यसि । कुरु तात न सन्देहं मनश्चाश्वास्य स्वं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tadvAkyaM bhavitA satyaM tvaM cha trAtau bhaviShyasi | kuru tAta na sandehaM manashchAshvAsya svaM prabho
verses.translation: Descend to Patala*® all of you. If you have the power, fight.'* On hearing her provocative words the Asuras said to one another.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा तनयं सूर्यो यमसंज्ञं मुनीश्वर । आदित्यश्चाब्रवीत्तान्त्तु छायां क्रोधसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA tanayaM sUryo yamasa.nj~naM munIshvara | AdityashchAbravIttAnttu ChAyAM krodhasamanvitaH
verses.translation: *'We do not kill you as you are a woman. But if you desire for battle be ready with your lion."

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य उवाच । हे प्रिये कुमते चण्डि किं त्वयाचरितं किल । किन्तु मेऽभ्यधिकः स्नेह एतदाख्यातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: sUrya uvAcha | he priye kumate chaNDi kiM tvayAcharitaM kila | kintu me.abhyadhikaH sneha etadAkhyAtumarhasi
verses.translation: While they spoke thus the fight ensued. The arrows rained in the battle, sharp arrows from either side.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । सा रवेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा यथातथ्यं न्यवेदयत् । निर्दग्धा कामरविणा सान्त्वयामास वै तदा
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | sA ravervachanaM shrutvA yathAtathyaM nyavedayat | nirdagdhA kAmaraviNA sAntvayAmAsa vai tadA
verses.translation: Thus fighting with them sportively the goddess slew the Asura along with Ganda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सूर्याऽगात्तवष्टुरन्तिकम् पप्रच्छ तं क्व संज्ञेति त्वष्टा सूर्यमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasyAstad vachanaM shrutvA sUryA.agAttavaShTurantikam paprachCha taM kva sa.nj~neti tvaShTA sUryamathAbravIt
verses.translation: Though they had an inimical feeling these enemies of the gods attained in the end that world which her followers go to.

verses.sanskrit: त्वष्टोवाच । तवातितेजसा दग्धा इदं रूपं न शोभते । असहन्ती च तत्संज्ञा वने वसति शाद्वले
verses.transliteration: tvaShTovAcha | tavAtitejasA dagdhA idaM rUpaM na shobhate | asahantI cha tatsa.nj~nA vane vasati shAdvale
verses.translation: According to the Puranic Mythology it is the seventh region esrending from the earth below.

verses.sanskrit: श्लाघ्या योगबलोपेता योगमासाद्य गोपते । अनुकूलस्तु देवेश सन्दिश्यात्ममयं मतम्
verses.transliteration: shlAghyA yogabalopetA yogamAsAdya gopate | anukUlastu devesha sandishyAtmamayaM matam
verses.translation: O holy lord, O brahmin, what did Kumbha, the suppressor of the gods, do on hearing that Dhumraka, Canca and Raktabija were killed by the goddess? Please tell me this now. I desire to hear the purifying tale of the goddess, the cause of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यस्य हि तद्रूपमसहिष्णुः सुतेजसः । दह्यमाना तदोद्वेगमकरोद्वरवर्णिनी
verses.transliteration: Adityasya hi tadrUpamasahiShNuH sutejasaH | dahyamAnA tadodvegamakarodvaravarNinI
verses.translation: O king, on hearing that the leading Daityas had been killed, the great Asura of commendable valour ordered his invincible followers who were thrilled at the very mention of the war.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमिमारोप्य तत्तेजः शातयामास वै मुनिः । ततो विभ्राजितं रूपं तेजसा संवृतेन च
verses.transliteration: bhramimAropya tattejaH shAtayAmAsa vai muniH | tato vibhrAjitaM rUpaM tejasA saMvR^itena cha
verses.translation: At my behest the Daityas born of the race of Kalaka®' have all assembled here with their armies and along with Kalakeyas,** Mauryas,** Daurhrdas*® and others. Let them march on with hopes of victory.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं कान्ततरं रूपं त्वष्ट्रा तच्छुशुभे तदा । ततोऽधियोगमास्थाय स्वां भार्यां हि ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: kR^itaM kAntataraM rUpaM tvaShTrA tachChushubhe tadA | tato.adhiyogamAsthAya svAM bhAryAM hi dadarsha ha
verses.translation: After ordering the demons, Sumbha and Nisumbha mounted on their chariots and set out. Their armies too followed them like swarms of moths rising up from a mountain definitely for their destruction.

verses.sanskrit: अधृष्यां सर्वभूतानां तेजसा नियमेन च । सोऽश्वरूपं समास्थाय गत्वा तां मैथुनेच्छया
verses.transliteration: adhR^iShyAM sarvabhUtAnAM tejasA niyamena cha | so.ashvarUpaM samAsthAya gatvA tAM maithunechChayA
verses.translation: Mrdafigas, Mardalas, Bherikas Dindimas, Jhar- jharas and Anakas were sounded. The warmongers rejoiced in the battle-ground. Those who were afraid fled away for their life.

verses.sanskrit: मैथुनाय विचेष्टन्तीं परपुंसोऽभिशङ्कया । मुखतो नासिकायां तु शुक्रं तद्व्यदधान्मुने
verses.transliteration: maithunAya vicheShTantIM parapuMso.abhisha~NkayA | mukhato nAsikAyAM tu shukraM tadvyadadhAnmune
verses.translation: Clad in their martial dress the soldiers came in their healthy spirits to the battleground. Holding various weapons and missiles they teased one another each eager for his victory.

verses.sanskrit: देवौ ततः प्रजायेतामश्विनौ भिषजां वरौ । नासत्यौ तौ च दस्रौ च स्मृतौ द्वावश्विनावपि
verses.transliteration: devau tataH prajAyetAmashvinau bhiShajAM varau | nAsatyau tau cha dasrau cha smR^itau dvAvashvinAvapi
verses.translation: Soldiers on elephants, looked at the enemy with

verses.sanskrit: तां तु कान्तेन रूपेण दर्शयामास भास्करः । आत्मानं सा तु तं दृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्टा पतिमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tAM tu kAntena rUpeNa darshayAmAsa bhAskaraH | AtmAnaM sA tu taM dR^iShTvA prahR^iShTA patimAdarAt
verses.translation: In respect of this Hiuse no detaiU are avjiilable either from the MB. or the Punirab.

verses.sanskrit: पत्या तेन गृहं प्रागात्स्वं सती मुदितानना । मुमुदातेऽथ तौ प्रीत्या दम्पती पूर्वतोधिकम्
verses.transliteration: patyA tena gR^ihaM prAgAtsvaM satI muditAnanA | mumudAte.atha tau prItyA dampatI pUrvatodhikam
verses.translation: Kalakeyas, d 'scendants of Kaiaka wife of Kasyapa, arc often mentioned as powerful di'mons in the MB. and the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: यमस्तु कर्मणा तेन भृशं पीडितमानसः । धर्मेण रञ्जयामास धर्मराज इमा प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: yamastu karmaNA tena bhR^ishaM pIDitamAnasaH | dharmeNa ra~njayAmAsa dharmarAja imA prajAH
verses.translation: Daurhfdas are the descendants of the Asura Durhfda.

verses.sanskrit: लेभे स कर्मणा तेन धर्मराजो महाद्युतिः । पितॄणामाधिपत्यं च लोकपालत्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: lebhe sa karmaNA tena dharmarAjo mahAdyutiH | pitR^INAmAdhipatyaM cha lokapAlatvameva cha
verses.translation: The sound arising from the guns rose up repeatedly making the gods tremble. A great darkne.ss enveloped the sky. Even the chariot of the sun was not visible.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषेऽस्यां त्रीण्यपत्यानि जनयामास भास्करः । संज्ञायां तु मनुः पूर्वं श्राद्धदेवः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: R^iShe.asyAM trINyapatyAni janayAmAsa bhAskaraH | sa.nj~nAyAM tu manuH pUrvaM shrAddhadevaH prajApatiH
verses.translation: Neighing horses hailing from exalted lands, with big ornaments round their necks, expert in the knowledge of their gaits planted their legs on the heads of elephants and flew like birds.

verses.sanskrit: मेरुपृष्ठे तपो घोरमद्यापि चरते प्रभुः । यवीयसी तयोर्या तु यमी कन्या यशस्विनी
verses.transliteration: merupR^iShThe tapo ghoramadyApi charate prabhuH | yavIyasI tayoryA tu yamI kanyA yashasvinI
verses.translation: On seeing the army of the enemy advancing thus, Ambika kept her bow well-strung. She sounded her bell that distressed the enemy. The lion too shook his manes and roared.

verses.sanskrit: अभवत्सा सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा यमुना लोकपा वनी । मनुरित्युच्यते लोके सावर्णिरिति चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: abhavatsA sarichChreShThA yamunA lokapA vanI | manurityuchyate loke sAvarNiriti chochyate
verses.translation: Seeing her bedecked in fine ornaments, holding weapons and stationed on the Himalaya mountain Nisumbha spoke words full of sentiments like a man clever in under¬ standing the emotions of beautiful women.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं जन्म देवानां शृणुयाद्धारयेत्तु वा । आपदं प्राप्य मुच्येत प्राप्नुयात्सुमहद्यशः
verses.transliteration: ya idaM janma devAnAM shR^iNuyAddhArayettu vA | ApadaM prApya muchyeta prApnuyAtsumahadyashaH
verses.translation: "Even a petal of the Malati (Jasmine) flower thrown on the beautiful body of women like you may distress you. O goddess, how will you carry on a terrible war with the self-same handsome body of yours?"

verses.sanskrit: यमश्च यमुना चैव यमलौ सम्बभूवतुः । एवं हि त्रीण्यपत्यानि तस्यां जातानि सूर्यतः
verses.transliteration: yamashcha yamunA chaiva yamalau sambabhUvatuH | evaM hi trINyapatyAni tasyAM jAtAni sUryataH
verses.translation: After saying thus the great Asura became silent. Ganiika spoke to him — "O foolish Asura, why do you prattle in vain? Either fight or else return to Patala.*

verses.sanskrit: छायोवाच । आकेशग्रहणाद्देवि सहिष्येऽहं सुदुष्कृतम् । नाख्यास्यामि मतं तुभ्यं गच्छ देवि यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: ChAyovAcha | AkeshagrahaNAddevi sahiShye.ahaM suduShkR^itam | nAkhyAsyAmi mataM tubhyaM gachCha devi yathAsukham
verses.translation: The heroic demon, becoming infuriated, made a wonderful shower of arrows on the battle-field just as masses of clouds shower water during rains.

verses.sanskrit: शप्तोऽहमस्मि देवेश जनन्या तपतांवर । तव प्रसादाच्चरणो न पतेन्मम गोपते
verses.transliteration: shapto.ahamasmi devesha jananyA tapatAMvara | tava prasAdAchcharaNo na patenmama gopate
verses.translation: Along with his arrogant followers the demon fought with sharp wxapons as spears, axes, iron clubs,

verses.sanskrit: रूपं निवर्तयाम्यद्य तव कान्तं करोम्यहम् । सूत उवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वापगतः क्रोधो मार्तण्डस्य विवस्वतः
verses.transliteration: rUpaM nivartayAmyadya tava kAntaM karomyaham | sUta uvAcha | tachChrutvApagataH krodho mArtaNDasya vivasvataH
verses.translation: In that war great elephants looking like black mountains with foreheads pierced ran here and there. Tlie banners of Sumbha and Nisumbha white like flying cranes fluttered here and there.

verses.sanskrit: मनुः प्रजापतिस्त्वासीत्सावर्णिः स तपोधनः । भाव्यः स कर्मणा तेन मनोः सावर्णिकेऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: manuH prajApatistvAsItsAvarNiH sa tapodhanaH | bhAvyaH sa karmaNA tena manoH sAvarNike.antare
verses.translation: The demons were shattered by Kalika like fishes. The dreadful horses were beheaded and killed in the battle. The other demons were devoured by the lion.

verses.sanskrit: संवर्तुलं तु तद्रूपं दृष्ट्वा संज्ञा विवस्वतः । असहन्ती ततश्छायामात्मनः सासृजच्छुभाम्
verses.transliteration: saMvartulaM tu tadrUpaM dR^iShTvA sa.nj~nA vivasvataH | asahantI tatashChAyAmAtmanaH sAsR^ijachChubhAm
verses.translation: In the battlefield streams of blood flowed. The dead soldiers floated. Their tresses of hair resembled the moss. Their upper cloths resembled the white foam.

verses.sanskrit: मायामयी तु सा संज्ञामवोचद्भक्तितः सुभे । किं करोमीह कार्यं ते कथयस्व शुचिस्मिते
verses.transliteration: mAyAmayI tu sA sa.nj~nAmavochadbhaktitaH subhe | kiM karomIha kAryaM te kathayasva shuchismite
verses.translation: A great fight ensued where soldiers of equal rank fought with one another. The cavalrymen fought their counterpart; the elephant-riders with those on elephants: the charioteers with those on chariots and the footsoldicrs with footsoldiers.

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञोवाच अहं यास्यामि भद्रं ते ममैव भवनं पितुः । त्वयैतद्भवने सत्यं वस्तव्यं निर्विकारतः
verses.transliteration: sa.nj~novAcha ahaM yAsyAmi bhadraM te mamaiva bhavanaM pituH | tvayaitadbhavane satyaM vastavyaM nirvikArataH
verses.translation: Then Nisumbha thought to himself — "A terrible period has set in now. Even a poor man may become rich and rich man poor if the time is adverse.

verses.sanskrit: इमौ मे बालकौ साधू कन्या चेयं सुमध्यमा । पालनीयाः सुखेनैव मम चेदिच्छसि प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: imau me bAlakau sAdhU kanyA cheyaM sumadhyamA | pAlanIyAH sukhenaiva mama chedichChasi priyam
verses.translation: A senseless fellow may become intelligent and an intelligent man dull. A wicked man may be praised by the noble. The great and the powerful may be vanquished. The weak may come out victorious in the war.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Heroes do not come to the battlefield for turning back. But how can I attain victory in a battle with this lady who has destroyed my entire host?

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Heroes do not come to the battlefield for turning back. But how can I attain victory in a battle with this lady who has destroyed my entire host?

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३६. षट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । मनुनवपुत्रवंशवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यासन्पुत्रा वै नव तत्समाः । पश्चान्महोन्नता धीराः क्षत्रधर्मपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.36\. ShaTtriMsho.adhyAyaH | manunavaputravaMshavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | manorvaivasvatasyAsanputrA vai nava tatsamAH | pashchAnmahonnatA dhIrAH kShatradharmaparAyaNAH
verses.translation: After thinking thus and sitting in a great chariot

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । तां तथावादिनीं साध्वीमिडां मन्वध्वरोद्भवाम् । मित्रावरुणनामानौ मुनी ऊचतुरादरात्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | tAM tathAvAdinIM sAdhvImiDAM manvadhvarodbhavAm | mitrAvaruNanAmAnau munI UchaturAdarAt
verses.translation: He addressed her thus — "O goddess, of what avail is it if the mercenary soldiers are killed? If you desire to fight, let both of us clad m martial dress fight with each other.

verses.sanskrit: मित्रावरुणावूचतुः । अनेन तव धर्मज्ञे प्रश्रयेण दमेन च । सत्येन चैव सुश्रोणि प्रीतौ द्वौ वरवर्णिनि
verses.transliteration: mitrAvaruNAvUchatuH | anena tava dharmaj~ne prashrayeNa damena cha | satyena chaiva sushroNi prItau dvau varavarNini
verses.translation: The goddess addressed Kli then — "Seethe foolish ambition of the two Asuras. Time the instigator of good and bad actions renders the mind work in a different way when adversity is imminent."

verses.sanskrit: आवयोस्त्वं महाभागे ख्यातिं चैव गमिष्यसि । मनोर्वंशकरः पुत्रस्त्वमेव च भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: AvayostvaM mahAbhAge khyAtiM chaiva gamiShyasi | manorvaMshakaraH putrastvameva cha bhaviShyasi
verses.translation: Then Nisumbha attacked Candika as well as Kali with thousands of arrows. With the volleys of her arrows Siva split into a thousand pieces the arrows discharged by the Asura.

verses.sanskrit: सुद्युम्न इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः । जगत्प्रियो धर्मशीलौ मनुवंशविवर्धनः
verses.transliteration: sudyumna iti vikhyAtastriShu lokeShu vishrutaH | jagatpriyo dharmashIlau manuvaMshavivardhanaH
verses.translation: He then lifted up his lustrous sword along with the shield and struck the lion on its head. With her g;reat sword she split it too as the woodcutters do to a tree with the axe.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । निवृत्ता सा तु तच्छ्रुत्वा गच्छन्ती पितुरन्तिके । बुधेनान्तरमासाद्य मैथुनायोपमन्त्रिता
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | nivR^ittA sA tu tachChrutvA gachChantI piturantike | budhenAntaramAsAdya maithunAyopamantritA
verses.translation: Prepared to die the heroic Asura seized a mace and rushed at her. She reduced the mace into powder with the edge of her trident. The demon shattered the trident with another mace.

verses.sanskrit: सोमपुत्रात्ततो जज्ञे तस्यां राजा पुरूरवाः । पुत्रोऽतिसुन्दरः प्राज्ञ उर्वशीपतिरुन्नतः
verses.transliteration: somaputrAttato jaj~ne tasyAM rAjA purUravAH | putro.atisundaraH prAj~na urvashIpatirunnataH
verses.translation: Then she struck Nisumbha with her sharp, terrible serpentine poisonous arrows that were accustomed to drink the blood of Asuras and brought him down to the earth.

verses.sanskrit: जनयित्वा च सा तत्र पुरूरवसमादरात् । पुत्रं शिवप्रसादात्तु पुनः सुद्युम्नतां गतः
verses.transliteration: janayitvA cha sA tatra purUravasamAdarAt | putraM shivaprasAdAttu punaH sudyumnatAM gataH
verses.translation: When his younger brother of great honour and strength fell Sumbha was furious. The eight-armed demon seated himself in a chariot and came to the place where Siva was present.

verses.sanskrit: सुद्युम्नस्य तु दायादास्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः । उत्कलश्च गयश्चापि विनताश्वश्च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: sudyumnasya tu dAyAdAstrayaH paramadhArmikAH | utkalashcha gayashchApi vinatAshvashcha vIryavAn
verses.translation: She blew the conch Arindama, produced unbear¬ able bow-twang; the lion shaking its manes roared. The whole sky reverberated with the threefold round.

verses.sanskrit: उत्कलस्योत्कला विप्रा विनताश्वस्य पश्चिमा । दिक्पूर्वा मुनिशार्दूल गयस्य तु गया स्मृता
verses.transliteration: utkalasyotkalA viprA vinatAshvasya pashchimA | dikpUrvA munishArdUla gayasya tu gayA smR^itA
verses.translation: Then the mother of the universe laughed bois¬ terously making all the demons tremble with fear. The gods shouted cries of "Victory" when she challenged the Asuras in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टे तु मनौ तात दिवाकरतनुं तदा । दशधा तत्र तत्क्षेत्रमकरोत्पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: praviShTe tu manau tAta divAkaratanuM tadA | dashadhA tatra tatkShetramakarotpR^ithivImimAm
verses.translation: The king of Daityas hurled a spear of shining flames which was struck down by a meteor. Siva shattered the arrows discharged by Sumbha. He too split the arrows discharged by Siva into a thousand pieces.

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुः शिबिनाभागौ धृष्टः शर्यातिरेव च । नरिष्यन्तोऽथ नाभागः करूषश्च प्रियव्रतः
verses.transliteration: ikShvAkuH shibinAbhAgau dhR^iShTaH sharyAtireva cha | nariShyanto.atha nAbhAgaH karUShashcha priyavrataH
verses.translation: She lifted up her trident and struck the great Asura. He fell down unconscious shaking heaven and earth along with the ocean like a mountain whose wings had been chopped off by Indra.**

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुः श्रेष्ठदायादो मध्यदेशमवाप्तवान् । वसिष्ठवचनादासीत्प्रतिष्ठानं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: ikShvAkuH shreShThadAyAdo madhyadeshamavAptavAn | vasiShThavachanAdAsItpratiShThAnaM mahAtmanaH
verses.translation: Suffering the pain arising from the trident, the powerful demon, the suppressor of the gods, created ten thousand hands and struck Kali and Candika along with the Hon, by means of his discus.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठां धर्मराज्यस्य सुद्युम्नोऽथ ततो ददौ । तत्पुरूरवसे प्रादाद् राज्यं प्राप्य महायशाः
verses.transliteration: pratiShThAM dharmarAjyasya sudyumno.atha tato dadau | tatpurUravase prAdAd rAjyaM prApya mahAyashAH
verses.translation: Splitting sportively the discus hurled by him, she hurt and struck the Asura with the trident. Thus both of them met their death at the lotus-hands of Siva that sanctify the universe and attained the great region.

verses.sanskrit: मानवो यो मुनिश्रेष्ठाः स्त्रीपुंसोर्लक्षणः प्रभुः । नरिष्यन्ताच्छकाः पुत्रा नभगस्य सुतोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: mAnavo yo munishreShThAH strIpuMsorlakShaNaH prabhuH | nariShyantAchChakAH putrA nabhagasya suto.abhavat
verses.translation: When the powerful Nisumbha, and Sumbha of terrible exploit were killed the Daityas entered Patala.®®

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषस्तु बाह्लेयो बाह्लकं क्षेत्रामाप्तवान् । शर्यातेर्मिथुनं त्वासीदानर्तो नाम विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: ambarIShastu bAhleyo bAhlakaM kShetrAmAptavAn | sharyAtermithunaM tvAsIdAnarto nAma vishrutaH
verses.translation: Others were devoured by Kali's lion. The remain¬ ing Asuras being excessively frightened fled in the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रः सुकन्या कन्या च या पत्नी च्यवनस्य हि । आनर्तस्य हि दायादो रैभ्यो नाम स रैवतः
verses.transliteration: putraH sukanyA kanyA cha yA patnI chyavanasya hi | Anartasya hi dAyAdo raibhyo nAma sa raivataH
verses.translation: The rivers with clear water flowed along their paths; the winds blew very gentle to the touch; the sky be¬ came clear,

verses.sanskrit: आनर्तविषये यस्य पुरी नाम कुशस्थली । महादिव्या सप्तपुरीमध्ये या सप्तमी मता
verses.transliteration: AnartaviShaye yasya purI nAma kushasthalI | mahAdivyA saptapurImadhye yA saptamI matA
verses.translation: Sacrifices were revived by the gods and the sages, Lord Indra and the gods felt blissful again,

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रशतं त्वासीत्ककुद्मी ज्येष्ठ उत्तमः । तेजस्वी सुबलः पारो धर्मिष्ठो ब्रह्मपालकः
verses.transliteration: tasya putrashataM tvAsItkakudmI jyeShTha uttamaH | tejasvI subalaH pAro dharmiShTho brahmapAlakaH
verses.translation: O lord, this story of Uma is holy and meri¬ torious. It describes the destruction of the king of Daityas. He who regularly reads this with faith enjoys all worldly pleasures inaccessible even to the gods and attains the abode of Uma hereafter by the very grace of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: ककुद्मिनस्तु सञ्जाता रेवती नाम कन्यका । महालावण्यसंयुक्ता दिव्यलक्ष्मीरिवापरा
verses.transliteration: kakudminastu sa~njAtA revatI nAma kanyakA | mahAlAvaNyasaMyuktA divyalakShmIrivAparA
verses.translation: See P. 643 note.

verses.sanskrit: प्रष्टुं कन्यावरं राजा ककुद्मी कन्यया सह । ब्रह्मलोके विधेः सम्यक्सर्वाधीशो जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: praShTuM kanyAvaraM rAjA kakudmI kanyayA saha | brahmaloke vidheH samyaksarvAdhIsho jagAma ha
verses.translation: O Suta, the most excellent among the omniscients please mention the incarnation of Uma, the goddess of all the worlds and the mother ofSarasvati.

verses.sanskrit: आवर्तमाने गान्धर्वे स्थितो लब्धक्षणः क्षणम् । शुश्राव तत्र गान्धर्वं नर्तने ब्रह्मणोऽन्तिके
verses.transliteration: AvartamAne gAndharve sthito labdhakShaNaH kShaNam | shushrAva tatra gAndharvaM nartane brahmaNo.antike
verses.translation: O sagos, listen lovingly to the great story, the per¬ fect knowledge of which alone helps man to attain the great goal.

verses.sanskrit: अकरोत्पुत्रकामस्तु मनुरिष्टिं प्रजापतिः । अनुत्पन्नेषु पुत्रेषु तत्रेष्ट्यां मुनिपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: akarotputrakAmastu manuriShTiM prajApatiH | anutpanneShu putreShu tatreShTyAM munipu~NgavaH
verses.translation: Then the gods were proud and haughty. They boasted — "We are blessed. What can the Asuras do to us

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तभूतं तत्काले गतं बहुयुगं तदा । न किञ्चिद् बुबुधे राजा ककुद्मी मुनयः स तु
verses.transliteration: muhUrtabhUtaM tatkAle gataM bahuyugaM tadA | na ki~nchid bubudhe rAjA kakudmI munayaH sa tu
verses.translation: Of our unbearable prowess, the Asuras are afraid. They have gone to Patala saying, "Run, run".

verses.sanskrit: तदासौ विधिमानम्य स्वाभिप्रायं कृताञ्जलिः । न्यवेदयद्विनीतात्मा ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: tadAsau vidhimAnamya svAbhiprAyaM kR^itA~njaliH | nyavedayadvinItAtmA brahmaNe paramAtmane
verses.translation: Then all of them proclaimed thus; "Wonderful is the strength, splendour and good luck of the gods that has redu( ed the race of the Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: तदभिप्रायमाकर्ण्य स प्रहस्य प्रजापतिः । ककुद्मिनं महाराजं समाभाष्य समब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tadabhiprAyamAkarNya sa prahasya prajApatiH | kakudminaM mahArAjaM samAbhAShya samabravIt
verses.translation: Then a mass of splendour appeared, at the unpre¬ cedented sight of which the gods were surpiised.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । शृणु राजन् रैभ्यसुत ककुद्मिन् पृथिवीपते । मद्वचः प्रीतितः सत्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | shR^iNu rAjan raibhyasuta kakudmin pR^ithivIpate | madvachaH prItitaH satyaM pravakShyAmi visheShataH
verses.translation: Ignorant of the real glory and the intention of the goddess to quell their arrogance, the Asuras said with choking throats "What is this? What is this?"

verses.sanskrit: कालेन संहृतास्ते वै वरा ये ते कृता हृदि । न तद्गोत्रं हि तत्रास्ति कालः सर्वस्य भक्षकः
verses.transliteration: kAlena saMhR^itAste vai varA ye te kR^itA hR^idi | na tadgotraM hi tatrAsti kAlaH sarvasya bhakShakaH
verses.translation: Then the lord Indra ordered the gods — "Go ye all and examine it and ascertain what it is."

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्पुर्यपि हता पुण्यजनैः सा राक्षसैर्नृप । अष्टाविंशद्वापरेऽद्य कृष्णेन निर्मिता पुनः
verses.transliteration: tvatpuryapi hatA puNyajanaiH sA rAkShasairnR^ipa | aShTAviMshadvApare.adya kR^iShNena nirmitA punaH
verses.translation: Urged by Indra, the wind-god approached splen¬ dour and addressed it, "Who are you?" The splendour too put the same question to him.

verses.sanskrit: कृता द्वारावती नाम्ना बहुद्वारा मनोरमा । भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकैर्गुप्ता वासुदेवपुरोगमैः
verses.transliteration: kR^itA dvArAvatI nAmnA bahudvArA manoramA | bhojavR^iShNyandhakairguptA vAsudevapurogamaiH
verses.translation: Thus asked by the big mass of splendour the

verses.sanskrit: तद्गच्छ तत्र प्रीतात्मा वासुदेवाय कन्यकाम् । बलदेवाय देहि त्वमिमां स्वतनयां नृप
verses.transliteration: tadgachCha tatra prItAtmA vAsudevAya kanyakAm | baladevAya dehi tvamimAM svatanayAM nR^ipa
verses.translation: Everything in the universe, mobile or immobile, is woven like warp and woof into me. I am the support of everything. I move the entire universe.'*

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्यादिष्टो नृपोऽयं तं नत्वा तां च पुरीं गतः । गतान् बहून्युगान् ज्ञात्वा विस्मितः कन्यया युतः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityAdiShTo nR^ipo.ayaM taM natvA tAM cha purIM gataH | gatAn bahUnyugAn j~nAtvA vismitaH kanyayA yutaH
verses.translation: Then the great splendour said; — ''If you are com¬ petent to move, O wind-god, please move this blade of grass I have set before you. Move it as you please."

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु युवतीं कन्यां तां च स्वां सुविधानतः । कृष्णभ्रात्रे बलायाशु प्रादात्तत्र स रेवतीम्
verses.transliteration: tatastu yuvatIM kanyAM tAM cha svAM suvidhAnataH | kR^iShNabhrAtre balAyAshu prAdAttatra sa revatIm
verses.translation: Then wind-god put forth all his efforts. But the blade of grass did not stir from its position. Then he was put to shame.

verses.sanskrit: सा हि दिव्याम्बरधरा दिव्याभरणभूषिता । दिव्यसंहनना चैवमिला जज्ञे हि विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: sA hi divyAmbaradharA divyAbharaNabhUShitA | divyasaMhananA chaivamilA jaj~ne hi vishrutA
verses.translation: The wind-god went silently to the assembly of Indi a. There he narrated the details of his discomfiture.

verses.sanskrit: ततो जगाम शिखरं मेरोर्दिव्यं महाप्रभुः । शिवमाराधयामास स नृपस्तपसि स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tato jagAma shikharaM merordivyaM mahAprabhuH | shivamArAdhayAmAsa sa nR^ipastapasi sthitaH
verses.translation: "False is our pride that we are the lords. In fact we are helpless, insignificant creatures."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । तत्र स्थितो बहुयुगं ब्रह्मलोके स रेवतः । युवैवागान्मर्त्यलोकमेतन्नः संशयो महान्
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | tatra sthito bahuyugaM brahmaloke sa revataH | yuvaivAgAnmartyalokametannaH saMshayo mahAn
verses.translation: Then Indra sent all the gods. When they could not realise anything Indra himself went there.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । न जरा क्षुत्पिपासा वा विकारास्तत्र सन्ति वै । अपमृत्युर्न केषाञ्चिन्मुनयो ब्रह्मणोंऽतिके
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | na jarA kShutpipAsA vA vikArAstatra santi vai | apamR^ityurna keShA~nchinmunayo brahmaNoM.atike
verses.translation: On seeing Indra come, the unbearable splendour vanished immediately. Indra was surprised.

verses.sanskrit: अतो न राजा सम्प्राप जरां मृत्युं च सा सुता । स युवैवागतस्तत्र सम्मन्त्र्य तनयावरम्
verses.transliteration: ato na rAjA samprApa jarAM mR^ityuM cha sA sutA | sa yuvaivAgatastatra sammantrya tanayAvaram
verses.translation: Then Indra thought to himself again and again — "I seek refuge in him alone whose conduct is such as this."

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा द्वारावतीं दिव्यां पुरीं कृष्णविनिर्मिताम् । विवाहं कारयामास कन्यायाः स बलेन हि
verses.transliteration: gatvA dvArAvatIM divyAM purIM kR^iShNavinirmitAm | vivAhaM kArayAmAsa kanyAyAH sa balena hi
verses.translation: In the meantime, in order to bless them am'* remove their arrogance, Siva, the embodied form of unde ceitful mercy, existence, knowledge and bliss, manifested her¬ self on the ninth day of the bright half of the month Caitra when the sun was in the middle of the day.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रशतं त्वासीद्धार्मिकस्य महाप्रभोः । कृष्णस्यापि सुता जाता बहुस्त्रीभ्योऽमितास्ततः
verses.transliteration: tasya putrashataM tvAsIddhArmikasya mahAprabhoH | kR^iShNasyApi sutA jAtA bahustrIbhyo.amitAstataH
verses.translation: Shining among the mass of.splendour she bright¬ ened the quarters with her brilliance. She enlightened the god.s, saying "I alone am Brahman."

verses.sanskrit: अन्ववायो महांस्तत्र द्वयोरपि महात्मनोः । क्षत्रिया दिक्षु सर्वासु गता हृष्टाः सुधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: anvavAyo mahAMstatra dvayorapi mahAtmanoH | kShatriyA dikShu sarvAsu gatA hR^iShTAH sudhArmikAH
verses.translation: In her four hands she held boons, noose, goad and the mystic gesture of protection. She was served by the Vedas and looked beautiful and proud of her blooming youth.

verses.sanskrit: इति प्रोक्तो हि शर्यातेर्वंशोऽन्येषां वदाम्यहम् । मानवानां हि सङ्क्षेपाच्छृणुतादरतो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: iti prokto hi sharyAtervaMsho.anyeShAM vadAmyaham | mAnavAnAM hi sa~NkShepAchChR^iNutAdarato dvijAH
verses.translation: She wore red garments and red garlands. Red sandal paste was smeared over her body. She was as dazzling as a crore of cupids. Her lustre was that of a crorc moons.

verses.sanskrit: नाभागो दिष्टपुत्रोऽभूत्स तु ब्राह्मणतां गतः । स्वक्षत्रवंशं संस्थाप्य ब्रह्मकर्मभिरावृतः
verses.transliteration: nAbhAgo diShTaputro.abhUtsa tu brAhmaNatAM gataH | svakShatravaMshaM saMsthApya brahmakarmabhirAvR^itaH
verses.translation: The great Maya, in the form of the immanent soul of all, the cosmic witness of all living beings, and the great Brahman, spoke.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टाद्धार्ष्टमभूत्क्षत्रं ब्रह्मभूयं गतं क्षितौ । करूषस्य तु कारूषाः क्षत्रिया युद्धदुर्मदाः
verses.transliteration: dhR^iShTAddhArShTamabhUtkShatraM brahmabhUyaM gataM kShitau | karUShasya tu kArUShAH kShatriyA yuddhadurmadAH
verses.translation: Neither Brahma nor Visnu nor $iva the slayer of

verses.sanskrit: तामिडेत्येव होवाच मनुर्दण्डधरस्तथा । अनुगच्छस्व मामेति तमिडा प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: tAmiDetyeva hovAcha manurdaNDadharastathA | anugachChasva mAmeti tamiDA pratyuvAcha ha
verses.translation: The great Brahman, the great light in the form of the two Pranavas, I alone am. I am all. There is none other beside me.

verses.sanskrit: नृगो यो मनुपुत्रस्तु महादाता विशेषतः । नानावसूनां सुप्रीत्या विप्रेभ्यश्च गवां तथा
verses.transliteration: nR^igo yo manuputrastu mahAdAtA visheShataH | nAnAvasUnAM suprItyA viprebhyashcha gavAM tathA
verses.translation: Though devoid of form 1 possess forms. I consti¬ tute all principles. I am eternal and my attributes cannot be disputed. I am both the cause and the effect.

verses.sanskrit: गोदानव्यत्ययाद्यस्तु स्वकुबुद्ध्या स्वपापतः । कृकलासत्वमापन्नः श्रीकृष्णेन समुद्धृतः
verses.transliteration: godAnavyatyayAdyastu svakubuddhyA svapApataH | kR^ikalAsatvamApannaH shrIkR^iShNena samuddhR^itaH
verses.translation: Sometimes I have the form of a woman, sometimes of a man. Sometimes both. I am goddess assuming all forms.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैकोऽभूत्सुतः श्रेष्ठः प्रयातिर्धर्मवित्तथा । इति श्रुतं मया व्यासात्तत्प्रोक्तं हि समासतः
verses.transliteration: tasyaiko.abhUtsutaH shreShThaH prayAtirdharmavittathA | iti shrutaM mayA vyAsAttatproktaM hi samAsataH
verses.translation: I am the creator, the protector and the destroyer of the world. I am the enchantress of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: वृषघ्नस्तु मनोः पुत्रो गोपालो गुरुणा कृतः । पालयामास गा यत्तो रात्र्यां वीरासनव्रतः
verses.transliteration: vR^iShaghnastu manoH putro gopAlo guruNA kR^itaH | pAlayAmAsa gA yatto rAtryAM vIrAsanavrataH
verses.translation: All the Saktis — Kali, Lak$mi and Sarasvati as well as others are born of my parts. So also the arts originate from me.

verses.sanskrit: स एकदागतं गोष्ठे व्याघ्रं गा हिंसितुं बली । श्रुत्वा गोक्रन्दनं बुद्धो हन्तुं तं खड्गधृग्ययौ
verses.transliteration: sa ekadAgataM goShThe vyAghraM gA hiMsituM balI | shrutvA gokrandanaM buddho hantuM taM khaDgadhR^igyayau
verses.translation: Just as a magician makes the wooden doll of a woman dance so also I the goddess make all living beings dance.

verses.sanskrit: अजानन्नहनद्बभ्रोः शिरः शार्दूलशङ्कया । निश्चक्राम सभीर्व्याघ्रो दृष्ट्वा तं खड्गिनं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: ajAnannahanadbabhroH shiraH shArdUlasha~NkayA | nishchakrAma sabhIrvyAghro dR^iShTvA taM khaDginaM prabhum
verses.translation: Being afraid of me the wind blows, the fire-god burns and the guardians of the quarters carry on their duties.

verses.sanskrit: मन्यमानो हतं व्याघ्रं स्वस्थानं स जगाम ह । रात्र्यां तस्यां भ्रमापन्नो वर्षवातविनष्टधीः
verses.transliteration: manyamAno hataM vyAghraM svasthAnaM sa jagAma ha | rAtryAM tasyAM bhramApanno varShavAtavinaShTadhIH
verses.translation: Independent that I am, I sportively bestow victory on the gods sometimes and on the Daily as sometimes.

verses.sanskrit: व्युष्टायां निशि चोत्थाय प्रगे तत्र गतो हि सः । अद्राक्षीत्स हतां बभ्रुं न व्याघ्रं दुःखितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: vyuShTAyAM nishi chotthAya prage tatra gato hi saH | adrAkShItsa hatAM babhruM na vyAghraM duHkhito.abhavat
verses.translation: O gods, endowed with devotion, realise this and eschew your arrogance, worship me, the eternal Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तद्वृत्तमाज्ञाय तं शशाप कृतागसम् । अकामतो विचार्येति शूद्रो भव न क्षत्रियः
verses.transliteration: shrutvA tadvR^ittamAj~nAya taM shashApa kR^itAgasam | akAmato vichAryeti shUdro bhava na kShatriyaH
verses.translation: On hearing the merciful words of the goddess, the gods eulogised her, with their shoulders drooping with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: एवं शप्तस्तु गुरुणा कुलाचार्येण कोपतः । निःसृतश्च पृषध्रस्तु जगाम विपिनं महत्
verses.transliteration: evaM shaptastu guruNA kulAchAryeNa kopataH | niHsR^itashcha pR^iShadhrastu jagAma vipinaM mahat
verses.translation: O goddess of the universe, forgive us. O goddess, be pleased. O mother, let us not be arrogant again. Please be merciful.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मयुक्तमिदं वाक्यं पुत्रकामं प्रजापतिम् । इडोवाच । मित्रावरुणयोरंशैर्जातास्मि वदतां वर
verses.transliteration: dharmayuktamidaM vAkyaM putrakAmaM prajApatim | iDovAcha | mitrAvaruNayoraMshairjAtAsmi vadatAM vara
verses.translation: Since then the gods began to propitiate her as

verses.sanskrit: निर्विण्णः स तु कष्टेन विरक्तोऽभूत्स योगवान् । वनाग्नौ दग्धदेहश्च जगाम परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: nirviNNaH sa tu kaShTena virakto.abhUtsa yogavAn | vanAgnau dagdhadehashcha jagAma paramAM gatim
verses.translation: O Brahmins, thus I have narrated to you the menifestation of Uma. By only hearing this men attain the great region.

verses.sanskrit: कविः पुत्रो मनोः प्राज्ञः शिवानुग्रहतोऽभवत् । इह भुक्त्वा सुखं दिव्यं मुक्तिं प्राप सुदुर्लभाम्
verses.transliteration: kaviH putro manoH prAj~naH shivAnugrahato.abhavat | iha bhuktvA sukhaM divyaM muktiM prApa sudurlabhAm
verses.translation: O intelligent one, all of us are anxious to hear the episode of Durga every day. Please tell us another wonderful tale of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः सकाशं यास्यामि न मेऽधर्मे रुचिर्भवेत् । एवमुक्त्वा सती सा तु मित्रावरुणयोस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tayoH sakAshaM yAsyAmi na me.adharme ruchirbhavet | evamuktvA satI sA tu mitrAvaruNayostataH
verses.translation: O Suta, the most excellent of the story-tellers, we are not satiated even as we hear different nectarine stories narrated by you.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वान्तिकं वरारोहा प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् । अंशैस्तु युवयोर्जाता मनुयज्ञे महामुनी
verses.transliteration: gatvAntikaM varArohA prA~njalirvAkyamabravIt | aMshaistu yuvayorjAtA manuyaj~ne mahAmunI
verses.translation: The most powerful son of Ruru, famous as Durgama secured the four Vedas as a result of the boon granted by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: आगता भवतोरन्ति ब्रूतं किं करवाणि वाम् । अन्यान् पुत्रान् सृज विभो तैर्वंशस्ते भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: AgatA bhavatoranti brUtaM kiM karavANi vAm | anyAn putrAn sR^ija vibho tairvaMshaste bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Securing this strength that cannot be thwarted even by the gods he wrought havoc on the earth, making the gods tremble in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: None offered charitable gifts; none performed penances; there was neither worship nor sacrifice. Then a great drought befell the earth extending to a period of a hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: None offered charitable gifts; none performed penances; there was neither worship nor sacrifice. Then a great drought befell the earth extending to a period of a hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३७. सप्तत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । मनुवंशवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । पूर्वतस्तु मनोर्जज्ञे इक्ष्वाकुर्घ्राणतः सुतः । तस्य पुत्रशतं त्वासीदिक्ष्वाकोर्भूरिदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.37\. saptatriMsho.adhyAyaH | manuvaMshavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | pUrvatastu manorjaj~ne ikShvAkurghrANataH sutaH | tasya putrashataM tvAsIdikShvAkorbhUridakShiNam
verses.translation: Rivers, oceans, tanks, wells and lakes dried. Trees and plants withered.

verses.sanskrit: कुवलाश्वस्य पुत्राणां शतमुत्तमधन्विनाम् । बभूवाथ पिता राज्ये कुवलाश्वं न्ययोजयत्
verses.transliteration: kuvalAshvasya putrANAM shatamuttamadhanvinAm | babhUvAtha pitA rAjye kuvalAshvaM nyayojayat
verses.translation: On seeing the misery of the distressed subjects the gods sought refuge in the Yogic Maya, Mahevari.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रसङ्क्रामितश्रीको वनं राजा समाविशत् । तमुत्तङ्कोऽथ राजर्षिः प्रयान्तं प्रत्यवारयत्
verses.transliteration: putrasa~NkrAmitashrIko vanaM rAjA samAvishat | tamutta~Nko.atha rAjarShiH prayAntaM pratyavArayat
verses.translation: O Mahamaya, save all your people. Check your fury or the worlds will be ruined.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तङ्क उवाच । भवता रक्षणं कार्यं पृथिव्या धर्मतः शृणु । त्वया हि पृथिवी राजन् रक्ष्यमाणा महात्मना
verses.transliteration: utta~Nka uvAcha | bhavatA rakShaNaM kAryaM pR^ithivyA dharmataH shR^iNu | tvayA hi pR^ithivI rAjan rakShyamANA mahAtmanA
verses.translation: O ocean of mercy, O suppor tress of the distress¬ ed, kill this demon too just as you have killed Sumbha, Nisumbha. Dhumraksa, Canda, Muncjla, Raktabija, Madhu, Kaiabha and Mahisa.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति निरुद्विग्ना नारण्यं गन्तुमर्हसि । ममाश्रमसमीपे तु समेषु मरुधन्वसु
verses.transliteration: bhaviShyati nirudvignA nAraNyaM gantumarhasi | mamAshramasamIpe tu sameShu marudhanvasu
verses.translation: Boys are guilty of offence at every step but who on earth brooks it except the mother?

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रवालुकापूर्णे दानवो बलदर्पितः । देवतानामवध्यो हि महाकायो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: samudravAlukApUrNe dAnavo baladarpitaH | devatAnAmavadhyo hi mahAkAyo mahAbalaH
verses.translation: When miseries afflict the gods and the brahmins you incarnate for the welfare of the people.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्भूमिगतस्तत्र वालुकान्तर्हितः स्थितः । राक्षसस्य मधोः पुत्रो धुन्धुनामा सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration: antarbhUmigatastatra vAlukAntarhitaH sthitaH | rAkShasasya madhoH putro dhundhunAmA sudAruNaH
verses.translation: On hearing the distress of the gods the merciful goddess revealed to them her form possessed of many eyes.

verses.sanskrit: शेते लोकविनाशाय तप आस्थाय दारुणम् । संवत्सरस्य पर्यन्ते स निश्वासं विमुञ्चति
verses.transliteration: shete lokavinAshAya tapa AsthAya dAruNam | saMvatsarasya paryante sa nishvAsaM vimu~nchati
verses.translation: The goddess w'ith her lotus-face beaming with delight held in her four hands the bow, the arrows, the lotus and different fruits and roots.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तदा भूश्चलति सशैलवनकानना । सविस्फुलिङ्गं साङ्गारं सधूममतिदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: yadA tadA bhUshchalati sashailavanakAnanA | savisphuli~NgaM sA~NgAraM sadhUmamatidAruNam
verses.translation: On seeing her people scorched and distressed, the goddess was dejected. With her eyes full of mercy she cried for nine days and nights.

verses.sanskrit: तेन रायन्न शक्नोमि तस्मिन्न् स्थातुं स्व आश्रमे । तं मारय महाबाहो लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tena rAyanna shaknomi tasminn sthAtuM sva Ashrame | taM mAraya mahAbAho lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
verses.translation: The tears took the forms of thousands of water- currents released from her eyes. The worlds, the plants and medicinal herbs were delighted by them.

verses.sanskrit: लोकाः स्वस्था भवन्त्वद्य तस्मिन् विनिहते त्वया । त्वं हि तस्य वधायैव समर्थः पृथिवीपते
verses.transliteration: lokAH svasthA bhavantvadya tasmin vinihate tvayA | tvaM hi tasya vadhAyaiva samarthaH pR^ithivIpate
verses.translation: They turned into the rivers and oceans of deep waters. Vegetables, roots and fruits grew on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुरस्तादभवन्नार्यावर्ते नृपा द्विजाः । तेषां विकुक्षिर्ज्येष्ठस्तु सोऽयोध्यायां नृपोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: teShAM purastAdabhavannAryAvarte nR^ipA dvijAH | teShAM vikukShirjyeShThastu so.ayodhyAyAM nR^ipo.abhavat
verses.translation: To the learned and the gods she distributed the

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुना च वरो दत्तो मह्य पूर्वयुगेऽनघ । तेजसा स्वेन ते विष्णुस्तेज आप्याययिष्यति
verses.transliteration: viShNunA cha varo datto mahya pUrvayuge.anagha | tejasA svena te viShNusteja ApyAyayiShyati
verses.translation: All including the gods, brahmins and men were satisiied. Then the goddess said — "What else shall I do for you?"

verses.sanskrit: पालने हि महान् धर्मः प्रजानामिह दृश्यते । न तथा दृश्यतेऽरण्ये मा तेऽभूद् बुद्धिरीदृशी
verses.transliteration: pAlane hi mahAn dharmaH prajAnAmiha dR^ishyate | na tathA dR^ishyate.araNye mA te.abhUd buddhirIdR^ishI
verses.translation: The gods then gathered together and said, "The people have been rendered happy and satisfied. O goddess, be pleased and redeem the Vedas taken by Durgama.'*

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशो न हि राजेन्द्र क्वचिद्धर्मः प्रविद्यते । प्रजानां पालने यादृक् पुरा राजर्षिभिः कृतः
verses.transliteration: IdR^isho na hi rAjendra kvachiddharmaH pravidyate | prajAnAM pAlane yAdR^ik purA rAjarShibhiH kR^itaH
verses.translation: After saying "So be it" she said. "Go ye all to yotir abodes. Ere long I shall give you the Vedas."

verses.sanskrit: स एवमुक्तो राजर्षिरुत्तङ्केन महात्मना । कुवलाश्वं सुतं प्रादात्तस्मै धुन्धुनिवारणे
verses.transliteration: sa evamukto rAjarShirutta~Nkena mahAtmanA | kuvalAshvaM sutaM prAdAttasmai dhundhunivAraNe
verses.translation: Then the joyous gods returned to their abodes after

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्न्यस्तशस्त्रोऽहमयं तु तनयो मम । भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ धुन्धुमारो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhagavannyastashastro.ahamayaM tu tanayo mama | bhaviShyati dvijashreShTha dhundhumAro na saMshayaH
verses.translation: V Then a great bustle arose in the three regions heaven, earth and sky. On hearing it the son of Ruru besieged the city immediately.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा पुत्रमादिश्य ययौ स तपसे नृपः । कुवलाश्वश्च सोत्तङ्को ययौ धुन्धुविनिग्रहे
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA putramAdishya yayau sa tapase nR^ipaH | kuvalAshvashcha sotta~Nko yayau dhundhuvinigrahe
verses.translation: Then after creating a big circle of splendour all round for the protection of the gods, Siva herself came out of it.

verses.sanskrit: तमाविशत्तदा विष्णुर्भगवांस्तेजसा प्रभुः । उत्तङ्कस्य नियोगाद्वै लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tamAvishattadA viShNurbhagavAMstejasA prabhuH | utta~Nkasya niyogAdvai lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
verses.translation: A great battle ensued between the goddess and the Daitya. Both showered arrows in the battle, piercing the armour of each other.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्प्रयाते दुर्धर्षे दिवि शब्दो महानभूत् । एष श्रीमान्नृपसुतो धुन्धुमारो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tasminprayAte durdharShe divi shabdo mahAnabhUt | eSha shrImAnnR^ipasuto dhundhumAro bhaviShyati
verses.translation: In the meantime ten beautiful forms came out of Kali Viz Tara, Ghinnamasta, Srividya, Bhuvanesvari, Bhairavi, Bagala, Dhumra, Srimattripurasundarl, Matahgi and Mahavidya with weapons in their hands.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यैर्माल्यैश्च तं देवाः समन्तात्समवारयन् । प्रशंसां चक्रिरे तस्य जय जीवेति वादिनः
verses.transliteration: divyairmAlyaishcha taM devAH samantAtsamavArayan | prashaMsAM chakrire tasya jaya jIveti vAdinaH
verses.translation: Then appeared innumerable mothers of divine forms, wearing the digit of the moon and with a lustre resembling the splendour of lightning.

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा जयतां श्रेष्ठस्तनयैः सह पार्थिवः । समुद्रं खनयामास वालुकार्णवमध्यतः
verses.transliteration: sa gatvA jayatAM shreShThastanayaiH saha pArthivaH | samudraM khanayAmAsa vAlukArNavamadhyataH
verses.translation: Then a terrible combat ensued between the Asuras and the mothers. The army of the son of Ruru, consisting of a hundred Aksauhinis was killed in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्म शृणु तत्प्रीत्या यज्जातं वंशतो विधेः । श्राद्धकर्मणि चोद्दिष्टो ह्यकृते श्राद्धकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: tatkarma shR^iNu tatprItyA yajjAtaM vaMshato vidheH | shrAddhakarmaNi choddiShTo hyakR^ite shrAddhakarmaNi
verses.translation: Then the goddess struck Durgama with the edge of her trident. He fell on the earth like an uprooted tree.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणस्य विप्रर्षेस्तेजसाप्यायितस्तु सः । बभूव सुमहातेजा भूयो बलसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: nArAyaNasya viprarShestejasApyAyitastu saH | babhUva sumahAtejA bhUyo balasamanvitaH
