verses.translation: Thus after killing him the goddess redeemed the four Vedas and gave them to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रैः खनद्भिस्तु वालुकान्तर्गतस्तु सः । धुन्धुरासादितो ब्रह्मन् दिशमाश्रित्य पश्चि माम्
verses.transliteration: tasya putraiH khanadbhistu vAlukAntargatastu saH | dhundhurAsAdito brahman dishamAshritya pashchi mAm
verses.translation: O Ambika, for our welfare that form of infinite eyes was assumed by you. Hence sages will glorify you as!atak.s!.

verses.sanskrit: मुखजेनाग्निना क्रोधाल्लोकान् संवर्तयन्निव । वारि सुस्राव वेगेन विधोः कधिरिवोदये
verses.transliteration: mukhajenAgninA krodhAllokAn saMvartayanniva | vAri susrAva vegena vidhoH kadhirivodaye
verses.translation: Since the worlds were sustained by you with vege¬ tables sprouting from your body, you will be famous as Sakambharl.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽनलैरभिहतं दग्धं पुत्रशतं हि तत् । त्रय एवावशिष्टाश्च तेषु मध्ये मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: tato.analairabhihataM dagdhaM putrashataM hi tat | traya evAvashiShTAshcha teShu madhye munIshvara
verses.translation: O Siva, since you killed the Daitya Durgama you will be known as Durga.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स राजा विप्रेन्द्र राक्षसं तं महाबलम् । आससाद महातेजा धुन्धुं विप्रविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa rAjA viprendra rAkShasaM taM mahAbalam | AsasAda mahAtejA dhundhuM vipravinAshanam
verses.translation: O Yogic slumber, O Mahabala, O bestower of knowledge, O the mother of the universe, Obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वारिमयं वेगमापीय स नराधिपः । वह्निबाणेन वह्निं तु शमयामास वारिणा
verses.transliteration: tasya vArimayaM vegamApIya sa narAdhipaH | vahnibANena vahniM tu shamayAmAsa vAriNA
verses.translation: Obeisance to the heroine of infinite universes known as the supreme goddess in the Mahavakyas as Tat- tvamasi.

verses.sanskrit: तं निहत्य महाकायं बलेनोदकराक्षसम् । उत्तङ्कस्येक्षयामास कृतं कर्म नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: taM nihatya mahAkAyaM balenodakarAkShasam | utta~NkasyekShayAmAsa kR^itaM karma narAdhipaH
verses.translation: O Mother, we who are unaware ot your power and greatness, cannot adequately eulogise you who are inaccessi¬ ble through words, mind or body and whose eyes are the sun and the moon.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तङ्कस्तु वरं प्रादात्तस्मै राज्ञे महामुने । अददच्चाक्षयं वित्तं शत्रुभिश्चापराजयम्
verses.transliteration: utta~Nkastu varaM prAdAttasmai rAj~ne mahAmune | adadachchAkShayaM vittaM shatrubhishchAparAjayam
verses.translation: Who else will bestow mercy on seeing us the gods except the great goddess Sataksi the mother?

verses.sanskrit: धर्मे मतिं च सततं स्वर्गे वासं तथाक्षयम् । पुत्राणां चाक्षयं लोकं रक्षसा ये तु संहताः
verses.transliteration: dharme matiM cha satataM svarge vAsaM tathAkShayam | putrANAM chAkShayaM lokaM rakShasA ye tu saMhatAH
verses.translation: Effort shall be made by you so that the three worlds will not be pestered continuously with obstacles and our enemies shall be destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रास्त्रयः शिष्टाः दृढाश्वः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते । हंसाश्वकपिलाश्वौ च कुमारौ तत्कनीयसौ
verses.transliteration: tasya putrAstrayaH shiShTAH dR^iDhAshvaH shreShTha uchyate | haMsAshvakapilAshvau cha kumArau tatkanIyasau
verses.translation: Just as the cows run about in excitement quickly on seeing their calves in distress, so also I, Sati, am excited on seeing you in distress and run about.

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयित्वा शशं शीघ्रं शशादत्वमतो गतः । इक्ष्वाकुणा परित्यक्तः शशादो वनमाविशत्
verses.transliteration: bhakShayitvA shashaM shIghraM shashAdatvamato gataH | ikShvAkuNA parityaktaH shashAdo vanamAvishat
verses.translation: Even a moment appears to be a Yuga if I do not see you since I look at you as my own children for whom I am ready even to lay down my life.

verses.sanskrit: धौन्धुमारिर्दृढाश्वो यो हर्यश्वस्तस्य चात्मजः । हर्यश्वस्य निकुम्भोऽभूत्पुत्रो धर्मरतः सदा
verses.transliteration: dhaundhumArirdR^iDhAshvo yo haryashvastasya chAtmajaH | haryashvasya nikumbho.abhUtputro dharmarataH sadA
verses.translation: No worry or anxious thought need be entertained by you endowed with devotion as long as I stand by you destroying your distress.

verses.sanskrit: संहताश्वो निकुम्भस्य पुत्रो रणविशारदः । अक्षाश्वश्च कृताश्वश्च संहताश्वसुतौ द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: saMhatAshvo nikumbhasya putro raNavishAradaH | akShAshvashcha kR^itAshvashcha saMhatAshvasutau dvijAH
verses.translation: In the manner I have killed the Daiiyas I shall kill the Asuras. You need not entertain any doubt in this regard. Truth, I am speaking the truth.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य हैमवती भार्या सतां मान्या दृषद्वती । विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु पुत्रस्तस्याः प्रसेनजित्
verses.transliteration: tasya haimavatI bhAryA satAM mAnyA dR^iShadvatI | vikhyAtA triShu lokeShu putrastasyAH prasenajit
verses.translation: I shall be born of the womb in the lamily of cowherds as the daughter of Yasoda wife of Nanda, when Sumbha and Nisumbha will be born as Daityas. I shall kill the demons and become famous. Men will therefore call me Nandaja.

verses.sanskrit: लेभे प्रसेनजिद्भार्यां गौरीं नाम पतिव्रताम् । अभिशप्ता तु सा भर्त्रा नदी सा बाहुदा कृता
verses.transliteration: lebhe prasenajidbhAryAM gaurIM nAma pativratAm | abhishaptA tu sA bhartrA nadI sA bAhudA kR^itA
verses.translation: Since I shall be taking the form of a bee and killing the demon Aruna, men will glorify me as Bhramari

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो महानासीद्युवनाश्वो महीपतिः । मान्धाता युवनाश्वस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: tasya putro mahAnAsIdyuvanAshvo mahIpatiH | mAndhAtA yuvanAshvasya triShu lokeShu vishrutaH
verses.translation: Again I shall take a terrible form and devour the Raksasas. I shall then be famous as Bhima Devi.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चैत्ररथी भार्या शशबिन्दुसुताऽभवत् । पतिव्रता च ज्येष्ठा च भ्रातॄणामयुतस्य सा
verses.transliteration: tasya chaitrarathI bhAryA shashabindusutA.abhavat | pativratA cha jyeShThA cha bhrAtR^INAmayutasya sA
verses.translation: The goddess Sataksi, Sakambhari and Durga are identical. In all the three the individual is the same.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यामुत्पादयामास मान्धाता द्वौ सुतौ तदा । पुरुकुत्सं च धर्मज्ञं मुचुकुन्दं च धार्मिकम्
verses.transliteration: tasyAmutpAdayAmAsa mAndhAtA dvau sutau tadA | purukutsaM cha dharmaj~naM muchukundaM cha dhArmikam
verses.translation: O blessed disciple of Vyasa, O Suta the most excellent among the knowers of the Puranas, we wish to hear some other story of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुकुत्ससुतस्त्वासीद्विद्वांस्त्रय्यारुणिः कविः । तस्य सत्यव्रतो नाम कुमारोऽभून्महाबली
verses.transliteration: purukutsasutastvAsIdvidvAMstrayyAruNiH kaviH | tasya satyavrato nAma kumAro.abhUnmahAbalI
verses.translation: We wish to hear the most excellent sacred rites of Uma, the mother of the universe, those which were narrated to Vyasa the great Atman by Sanatkumara

verses.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राणां विघ्रं चक्रे महात्मभिः । येन भार्या हृता पूर्वं कृतोद्वाहः परस्य वै
verses.transliteration: pANigrahaNamantrANAM vighraM chakre mahAtmabhiH | yena bhAryA hR^itA pUrvaM kR^itodvAhaH parasya vai
verses.translation: All of you are blessed great souls; steady in your devotional rites to the goddess. Now listen devotedly to the well-guarded secret of the great Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: बलात्कामाच्च मोहाच्च संहर्षाच्च यदोत्कटात् । जहार कन्यां कामाच्च कस्यचित्पुरवासिनः
verses.transliteration: balAtkAmAchcha mohAchcha saMharShAchcha yadotkaTAt | jahAra kanyAM kAmAchcha kasyachitpuravAsinaH
verses.translation: O omniscient Sanatkumara, O intelligent son of Brahma, I wish to hear the wonderful holy rites of Uma.

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकौ संस्थिते राजा वसिष्ठवचनादभूत् । शकुनिप्रमुखास्तस्य पुत्राः पञ्चदश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ikShvAkau saMsthite rAjA vasiShThavachanAdabhUt | shakunipramukhAstasya putrAH pa~nchadasha smR^itAH
verses.translation: O Dvaipayana of great intellect, listen to the full description I am going to give of the secret that you ask.

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मसङ्गिनं तं तु राजा त्रय्यारुणिस्त्यजन् । अपध्वंसेति बहुशोऽवदत्क्रोधसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: adharmasa~NginaM taM tu rAjA trayyAruNistyajan | apadhvaMseti bahusho.avadatkrodhasamanvitaH
verses.translation: Three paths of the glorious mother have been narrated which yield both worldly pleasures and salvation. They are paths of knowledge, holy rites and devotion.

verses.sanskrit: पितरं सोऽब्रवीन्द् दुष्टः क्व गच्छामीति वै तदा । वस श्वपाकनिकटे राजा प्राहेति तं तदा
verses.transliteration: pitaraM so.abravInd duShTaH kva gachChAmIti vai tadA | vasa shvapAkanikaTe rAjA prAheti taM tadA
verses.translation: O excellent sage, the chief reason of liberation is the Yoga. Kriyayoga is the greatest means of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: स हि सत्यव्रतस्तेन श्वपाकवसथान्तिके । पित्रा त्यक्तोऽवसद्वीरो धर्मपालेन भूभुजा
verses.transliteration: sa hi satyavratastena shvapAkavasathAntike | pitrA tyakto.avasadvIro dharmapAlena bhUbhujA
verses.translation: One shall know the Maya as Pralqrti and the wielder of Maya as the eternal Brahman. After realising the identity of the two one is released from the world by bondage.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्रय्यारुणी राजा विरक्तः पुत्रकर्मणा । स शङ्करतपः कर्तुं सर्वं त्यक्त्वा वनं ययौ
verses.transliteration: tatastrayyAruNI rAjA viraktaH putrakarmaNA | sa sha~NkaratapaH kartuM sarvaM tyaktvA vanaM yayau
verses.translation: O Vyasa, listen to the merit of the person who builds a temple to the goddess either of stone or of wood or of mud. He who builds a temple to the goddess attains the benefit which a person who worships every day through Yoga attains in plenty. That virtuous soul who builds the temple for the glorious mother enables a thousand past and a thousand future members of his family to attain liberation.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्य स्वविषये नावर्षत्पाकशासनः । समा द्वादश विप्रर्षे तेनाधर्मेण वै तदा
verses.transliteration: tatastasya svaviShaye nAvarShatpAkashAsanaH | samA dvAdasha viprarShe tenAdharmeNa vai tadA
verses.translation: The sins committed by a person in a crore of births, whether they be small or big, are quelled at the very moment when the foimdation for temple of the glorious mother is laid.

verses.sanskrit: दारांस्तस्य तु विषये विश्वामित्रो महातपाः । सन्त्यज्य सागरानूपे चचार विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: dArAMstasya tu viShaye vishvAmitro mahAtapAH | santyajya sAgarAnUpe chachAra vipulaM tapaH
verses.translation: The glorious great Amba is the most excellent among all the deities just as Ganga and Sona among the rivers, the earth in forbearance, the ocean in majesty and the sun among the planets.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पत्नी गले बद्ध्वा मध्यमं पुत्रमौरसम् । शेषस्य भरणार्थाय व्यक्रीणाद्गोशतेन च
verses.transliteration: tasya patnI gale baddhvA madhyamaM putramaurasam | sheShasya bharaNArthAya vyakrINAdgoshatena cha
verses.translation: Not identifijcd.

verses.sanskrit: तां तु दृष्ट्वा गले बद्धं विक्रीणन्तीं स्वमात्मजम् । महर्षिपुत्रं धर्मात्मा मोचयामास तं तदा
verses.transliteration: tAM tu dR^iShTvA gale baddhaM vikrINantIM svamAtmajam | maharShiputraM dharmAtmA mochayAmAsa taM tadA
verses.translation: He who makes idols with the full complement of characteristics fearlessly attains indeed the great, region of Uma.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यव्रतो महाबाहुर्भरणं तस्य चाकरोत् । विश्वामित्रस्य तुष्ट्यर्थमनुक्रोशार्थमेव च
verses.transliteration: satyavrato mahAbAhurbharaNaM tasya chAkarot | vishvAmitrasya tuShTyarthamanukroshArthameva cha
verses.translation: After installing the image of the goddess, in the auspicious stars, planets and the season, man becomes con¬ tented and blessed by the favour of the Yogamaya.

verses.sanskrit: तदारभ्य स पुत्रस्तु विश्वामित्रस्य वै मुनेः । अभवद्गालवो नाम गलबन्धान्महातपाः
verses.transliteration: tadArabhya sa putrastu vishvAmitrasya vai muneH | abhavadgAlavo nAma galabandhAnmahAtapAH
verses.translation: After installing an auspicious image of the goddess one can redeem the men of one's family both of the past and the future.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरापथदेशस्य रक्षितारो महीक्षितः । अयोधस्य तु दायादः ककुत्स्थो नाम वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: uttarApathadeshasya rakShitAro mahIkShitaH | ayodhasya tu dAyAdaH kakutstho nAma vIryavAn
verses.translation: O leading sage, by installing the goddess the merit derived is a crorc times mare than that derived by establish¬ ing the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अरिनाभः ककुत्स्थस्य पृथुरेतस्य वै सुतः । विष्टराश्वः पृथोः पुत्रस्तस्मादिन्द्रः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: arinAbhaH kakutsthasya pR^ithuretasya vai sutaH | viShTarAshvaH pR^ithoH putrastasmAdindraH prajApatiH
verses.translation: The merit cannot be calculated of the man who instals the Pari caya tana®® deities with Ambika in the centre and the other four in the four quarters.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य युवनाश्वस्तु श्रावस्तस्य प्रजापतिः । जज्ञे श्रावस्तकः प्राज्ञः श्रावस्ती येन निर्मिता । श्रावस्तस्य तु दायादो बृहदश्वो महायशाः
verses.transliteration: indrasya yuvanAshvastu shrAvastasya prajApatiH | jaj~ne shrAvastakaH prAj~naH shrAvastI yena nirmitA | shrAvastasya tu dAyAdo bR^ihadashvo mahAyashAH
verses.translation: One attains great merit by repeating the names ofVisnu a crore times during the solar and lunar eclipses, a hundred crore times by repeating the names of Siva, a crore times by repeating the names of Sridevi, a crore times by building the palace for the goddess. To the man who instals the image of the goddess, mother of the universe, identical with the three Vedas there is nothing inaccessible, thanks to the merit of the glorious mother. His sons, grandsons and others flourish. All his sins perish.

verses.sanskrit: युवनाश्वः सुतस्तस्य कुवलाश्वश्च तत्सुतः । स हि धुन्धुवधाद्भूतो धुन्धुमारो नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: yuvanAshvaH sutastasya kuvalAshvashcha tatsutaH | sa hi dhundhuvadhAdbhUto dhundhumAro nR^ipottamaH
verses.translation: Even those who desire mentally the installation of the excellent image attain the great region of Uma inaccessi¬ ble even to the sage.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Those who have resorted only to the goddess the cause of the universe, are not or4inary men. They are the Ganas of the Goddess herself.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Those who have resorted only to the goddess the cause of the universe, are not or4inary men. They are the Ganas of the Goddess herself.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३८. अष्टात्रिंशोऽध्यायः । सत्यव्रतादिसगरपर्यन्तवंशवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । सत्यव्रतस्तु तद्भक्त्या कृपया च प्रतिज्ञया । विश्वामित्रकलत्रं च पोषयामास वै तदा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.38\. aShTAtriMsho.adhyAyaH | satyavratAdisagaraparyantavaMshavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | satyavratastu tadbhaktyA kR^ipayA cha pratij~nayA | vishvAmitrakalatraM cha poShayAmAsa vai tadA
verses.translation: Those who repeat the two syllables "U-ma" day and night, sitting, sleeping or moving become Siva's Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामदुहां दोग्ध्रीं ददर्श स नृपात्मजः । तां वै क्रोधाच्च लोभाच्च श्रमाद्वै च क्षुधान्वितः
verses.transliteration: sarvakAmaduhAM dogdhrIM dadarsha sa nR^ipAtmajaH | tAM vai krodhAchcha lobhAchcha shramAdvai cha kShudhAnvitaH
verses.translation: The five deities referred to here are: Sun Ganea, Dnrga Rudra and Visnu. Seep i68 note 174.

verses.sanskrit: दाशधर्मगतो राजा तां जघान स वै मुने । स तं मांसं स्वयं चैव विश्वामित्रस्य चात्मजम्
verses.transliteration: dAshadharmagato rAjA tAM jaghAna sa vai mune | sa taM mAMsaM svayaM chaiva vishvAmitrasya chAtmajam
verses.translation: Those who worship the goddess Siva, with flowers, incense and lamps whether as daily routine or on special occasions due to certain reasons will attain Uma*s abode.

verses.sanskrit: भोजयामास तच्छ्रुत्वा वसिष्ठो ह्यस्य चुक्रुधे । उवाच च मुनिश्रेष्ठस्तं तदा क्रोधसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: bhojayAmAsa tachChrutvA vasiShTho hyasya chukrudhe | uvAcha cha munishreShThastaM tadA krodhasaMyutaH
verses.translation: Those who clean, scrub and smear the altar of the goddess with cowdung or clay will attain Um&*s abode.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच । पातयेयमहं क्रूर तव शङ्कुमशंसयम् । यदि ते द्वाविमौ शङ्कू नस्यातां वै कृतौ पुरा
verses.transliteration: vasiShTha uvAcha | pAtayeyamahaM krUra tava sha~NkumashaMsayam | yadi te dvAvimau sha~NkU nasyAtAM vai kR^itau purA
verses.translation: The goddess mother bestows her blessings on the family of the person who builds a beautiful temple for the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: पितुश्चापरितोषेण गुरोर्दोग्ध्रीवधेन च । अप्रोक्षितोपयोगाच्च त्रिविधस्ते व्यतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: pitushchAparitoSheNa gurordogdhrIvadhena cha | aprokShitopayogAchcha trividhaste vyatikramaH
verses.translation: The glorious mother repeats day and night: "May my devotees live for a hundred years. Let them not be the victims of adversities."

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशङ्कुरिति होवाच त्रिशङ्कुरिति स स्मृतः । विश्वामित्रस्तु दाराणामागतो भरणे कृते
verses.transliteration: trisha~Nkuriti hovAcha trisha~Nkuriti sa smR^itaH | vishvAmitrastu dArANAmAgato bharaNe kR^ite
verses.translation: Whatever an aspirant solicits after installing and worshipping the image of the goddess he attains that.

verses.sanskrit: तेन तस्मै वरं प्रादान्मुनिः प्रीतस्त्रिशङ्कवे । छन्द्यमानो वरेणाथ वरं वव्रे नृपात्मजः
verses.transliteration: tena tasmai varaM prAdAnmuniH prItastrisha~Nkave | ChandyamAno vareNAtha varaM vavre nR^ipAtmajaH
verses.translation: Who can calculate the merit of a person who performs the ablution of the installed image of the glorious mother, with clarified butter after smearing it with honey?

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्टिभये चास्मिञ्जाते द्वादशवार्षिके । अभिषिच्य पितू राज्ये याजयामास तं मुनिः
verses.transliteration: anAvR^iShTibhaye chAsmi~njAte dvAdashavArShike | abhiShichya pitU rAjye yAjayAmAsa taM muniH
verses.translation: The devotee shall perform the ablution of the godd¬ ess either with water scented with sandal, aguru, camphor maihsi, musta etc. or with the milk of single-coloured cows.

verses.sanskrit: मिषतां देवतानां च वसिष्ठस्य च कौशिकः । सशरीरं तदा तं तु दिवमारोहयत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: miShatAM devatAnAM cha vasiShThasya cha kaushikaH | sasharIraM tadA taM tu divamArohayatprabhuH
verses.translation: The excellent offering shall be made with the incense of eighteen ingredients. The waving of the light for the goddess shall consist of wicks soaked in ghee or camphor.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सत्यरथा नाम भार्या केकयवंशजा । कुमारं जनयामास हरिश्चन्द्रमकल्मषम्
verses.transliteration: tasya satyarathA nAma bhAryA kekayavaMshajA | kumAraM janayAmAsa harishchandramakalmaSham
verses.translation: On the fifth, eighth, ninth and tenth days of the dark lunar half and on new moon days the devotee shall worship the mother of the worlds with fragrant flowers.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा मृगान्वराहांश्च महिषांश्च वनेचरान् । विश्वामित्राश्रमाभ्याशे तन्मांसं चाक्षिपन्मुने
verses.transliteration: hatvA mR^igAnvarAhAMshcha mahiShAMshcha vanecharAn | vishvAmitrAshramAbhyAshe tanmAMsaM chAkShipanmune
verses.translation: Jananisukta, Srisukta or Devisukta shall be recited or Mulamantra shall be chanted.

verses.sanskrit: स वै राजा हरिश्चन्द्रो त्रैशङ्कव इति स्मृतः । आहर्ता राजसूयस्य सम्राडिति ह विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: sa vai rAjA harishchandro traisha~Nkava iti smR^itaH | AhartA rAjasUyasya samrADiti ha vishrutaH
verses.translation: All flowers except Visnukranta and Tulasi are pleasing to the goddess particularly the lotus.

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रस्य हि सुतो रोहितो नाम विश्रुतः । रोहितस्य वृकः पुत्रो वृकाद् बाहुस्तु जज्ञिवान्
verses.transliteration: harishchandrasya hi suto rohito nAma vishrutaH | rohitasya vR^ikaH putro vR^ikAd bAhustu jaj~nivAn
verses.translation: He who offers golden or silver flowers to the god¬ dess goes to the greatest abode where crores of Siddhas live.

verses.sanskrit: हैहयास्तालजङ्घाश्च निरस्यन्ति स्म तं नृपम् । नात्यर्थे धार्मिको विप्राः स हि धर्मयुगेऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: haihayAstAlaja~NghAshcha nirasyanti sma taM nR^ipam | nAtyarthe dhArmiko viprAH sa hi dharmayuge.abhavat
verses.translation: After the worship the rite of forgiveness shall be

verses.sanskrit: सगरं स सुतं बाहुर्जज्ञे सह गरेण वै । और्वस्याश्रममासाद्य भार्गवेणाभिरक्षितः
verses.transliteration: sagaraM sa sutaM bAhurjaj~ne saha gareNa vai | aurvasyAshramamAsAdya bhArgaveNAbhirakShitaH
verses.translation: After meditating on the goddess, the bestower of desires on the devotees he shall offer various ripe fruits as Naivedya.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयमस्त्रं लब्ध्वा च भार्गवात्सगरो नृपः । जिगाय पृथिवीं हत्वा तालजङ्घान्स हैहयान
verses.transliteration: AgneyamastraM labdhvA cha bhArgavAtsagaro nR^ipaH | jigAya pR^ithivIM hatvA tAlaja~NghAnsa haihayAna
verses.translation: The man who partakes of Naivedya of Siva Sakti shakes off all dirt and becomes pure.

verses.sanskrit: शकान्बहूदकांश्चैव पारदान्सगणान्खशान् । सुधर्मं स्थापयामास शशास वृषतः क्षितिम्
verses.transliteration: shakAnbahUdakAMshchaiva pAradAnsagaNAnkhashAn | sudharmaM sthApayAmAsa shashAsa vR^iShataH kShitim
verses.translation: He who performs the rite of the goddess on the third day of the bright half of Caitra is liberated from the I'ondage of worldly existence and attains the supreme goal.

verses.sanskrit: शौनक उवाच । स वै गरेण सहितः कथं जातस्तु क्षत्रियात् । जितवानेतदाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण हि सूतज
verses.transliteration: shaunaka uvAcha | sa vai gareNa sahitaH kathaM jAtastu kShatriyAt | jitavAnetadAchakShva vistareNa hi sUtaja
verses.translation: The learned devotee shall perform the festival of cne swing on the very day. He shall worship the mother of the worlds Uma and diva with flowers, vermilion, garments, camphor, aguru, sandal, incense, lights, naivedyas, garlands, scents and other things.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । पारीक्षितेन सम्पृष्टो वैशम्पायन एव च । यदाचष्ट स्म तद्वक्ष्ये शृणुष्वैकमना मुने
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | pArIkShitena sampR^iShTo vaishampAyana eva cha | yadAchaShTa sma tadvakShye shR^iNuShvaikamanA mune
verses.translation: He shall then serve the goddess Amba, the cause of all welfare along with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: परीक्षितोवाच । कथं स सगरो राजा गरेण सहितो मुने । जातः स जघ्निवान्भूपानेतदाख्यातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: parIkShitovAcha | kathaM sa sagaro rAjA gareNa sahito mune | jAtaH sa jaghnivAnbhUpAnetadAkhyAtumarhasi
verses.translation: Siva bestows all desires on him who performs the rites with due observances and the festival of swinging to the goddess every year.

verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । बाहोर्व्यसनिनस्तातहृतं राज्यमभूत्किल । हैहयैस्तालजङ्घैश्च शकैः सार्धं विशाम्पते
verses.transliteration: vaishampAyana uvAcha | bAhorvyasaninastAtahR^itaM rAjyamabhUtkila | haihayaistAlaja~Nghaishcha shakaiH sArdhaM vishAmpate
verses.translation: The third day of the bright half of the month of Vaisakha is called Aksayatrtiya. The devotee shall observe the holy rites of the mother of the universe on that day without lassitude. He shall worship Gauri and diva with the flowers of Mallika, Malat) Gampa, Japa, Bandhuka and lotus. He will be quelling the sins perpetrated in a crore of births mentally, verbally and physically. He will enjoy the four aims of life in an unmitigated manner.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं गां चैव गात्रं च तथैवान्तःपुरं मुनिः । याज्योपाध्यायसंयोगाद्वसिष्ठः पर्यरक्षत
verses.transliteration: tIrthaM gAM chaiva gAtraM cha tathaivAntaHpuraM muniH | yAjyopAdhyAyasaMyogAdvasiShThaH paryarakShata
verses.translation: In accordance with the wealth that one has, one shall perform the festival of chanoi which is extremely pleasing to the goddess, on the third day of the bright half of the month of Adha.

verses.sanskrit: यवनाः पारदाश्चैव काम्बोजाः पाह्लवास्तथा । बहूदकाश्च पञ्चैव गणाः प्रोक्ताश्च रक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration: yavanAH pAradAshchaiva kAmbojAH pAhlavAstathA | bahUdakAshcha pa~nchaiva gaNAH proktAshcha rakShasAm
verses.translation: The chariot is the earth. The two wheels arc

verses.sanskrit: एते पञ्च गणा राजन् हैहयार्थेषु रक्षसाम् । कृत्वा पराक्रमान् बाहो राज्यं तेभ्यो ददुर्बलात्
verses.transliteration: ete pa~ncha gaNA rAjan haihayArtheShu rakShasAm | kR^itvA parAkramAn bAho rAjyaM tebhyo dadurbalAt
verses.translation: The intelligent man shall imagine that the glorious Ambika is seated in the middle of the chariot surveying the world for protecting it.

verses.sanskrit: हतराज्यस्ततो राजा स वै बाहुर्वनं ययौ । पत्न्या चानुगतो दुःखी स वै प्राणानवासृजत्
verses.transliteration: hatarAjyastato rAjA sa vai bAhurvanaM yayau | patnyA chAnugato duHkhI sa vai prANAnavAsR^ijat
verses.translation: When the chariot moves the devotee shall shout cries of "Victory" with the words "O goddess, favourably disposed to the distressed, protect us who have resorted to you". The devotee shall propitiate the goddess with the playing of musical instruments. The chariot shall be taken up to the boundary of village and the deity worshipped in the chariot itself. After eulogising with various hymns the deity shall be brought home. After prostrating a hundred times the devotee shall pray to the mother of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: पत्नी या यादवी तस्य सगर्भा पृष्ठतो गता । सपत्न्या च गरस्तस्यै दत्तः पूर्वसुतेर्ष्यया
verses.transliteration: patnI yA yAdavI tasya sagarbhA pR^iShThato gatA | sapatnyA cha garastasyai dattaH pUrvasuterShyayA
verses.translation: The intelligent man who performs the worship, holy rites, the festival of the chariot, the worship of the Mother, on the third day of the bright half of the Sravana and Bhadrapada, rejoices with his family. In the end he goes to the region of Uma at the highest upper worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सा तु भर्तुश्चितां कृत्वा ज्वलनं चावरोहत । और्वस्तां भार्गवो राजन्कारुण्यात्समवारयत्
verses.transliteration: sA tu bhartushchitAM kR^itvA jvalanaM chAvarohata | aurvastAM bhArgavo rAjankAruNyAtsamavArayat
verses.translation: The devotee shall observe the holy rites of Navara- tra in the bright half of Asvina and realise his desires undoubtedly.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्रमे स्थिता राज्ञी गर्भरक्षणहेतवे । सिषेवे मुनिवर्यं तं स्मरन्ती शङ्करं हृदा
verses.transliteration: tasyAshrame sthitA rAj~nI garbharakShaNahetave | siSheve munivaryaM taM smarantI sha~NkaraM hR^idA
verses.translation: Neither Brahma nor Siva nor Karttikeya nor any one else can describe the efficacy of the rite ofNavaratra.

verses.sanskrit: एकदा खलु तद् गर्भो गरेणैव सह च्युतः । सुमुहूर्त्ते सुलग्ने च पञ्चोच्चग्रहसंयुते
verses.transliteration: ekadA khalu tad garbho gareNaiva saha chyutaH | sumuhUrtte sulagne cha pa~nchochchagrahasaMyute
verses.translation: O excellent sages, by p)erforming the Navaratra rite, king Suratha, son of Viratha, regained his lost kingdom. The intelligent king of Ayodhya, Sudarsana, son oi Dhruvasandhi secured the lost kingdom. Performing thi- great rite and propitiating the goddess the Vaisya Samadhi being liberated from worldly bondage attained salvation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिँल्लग्ने च बलिनि सर्वथा मुनिसत्तम । व्यजायत महाबाहुः सगरो नाम पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: tasmi.Nllagne cha balini sarvathA munisattama | vyajAyata mahAbAhuH sagaro nAma pArthivaH
verses.translation: Siva fulfils the mental desires of the person who performs the rites duly in the bright half of Asvina on the third, fifth, seventh, eighth, ninth, or the fourteenth day.

verses.sanskrit: और्वस्तु जातकर्मादि तस्य कृत्वा महात्मनः । अध्याप्य वेदशास्त्राणि ततोऽस्त्रं प्रत्यपादयत्
verses.transliteration: aurvastu jAtakarmAdi tasya kR^itvA mahAtmanaH | adhyApya vedashAstrANi tato.astraM pratyapAdayat
verses.translation: He who performs the holy rite on the third day in the bright half of Karttika, MargaSira, Pausa, Magha and Phalguna and worships the auspicious goddess with red flowers,

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयं तं महाभागो ह्यमरैरपि दुःसहम् । जग्राह विधिना प्रीत्या सगरोऽसौ नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: AgneyaM taM mahAbhAgo hyamarairapi duHsaham | jagrAha vidhinA prItyA sagaro.asau nR^ipottamaH
verses.translation: For acquiring blissful conjugal life this great Vrata shall be performed by women. It shall be performed by men also for the acquisition of learning, wealth and sons.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यव्रतस्य वाक्याद्वा भाविनोऽर्थस्य वै बलात् । वसिष्ठोऽभ्यधिकं मन्युं धारयामास नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: satyavratasya vAkyAdvA bhAvino.arthasya vai balAt | vasiShTho.abhyadhikaM manyuM dhArayAmAsa nityashaH
verses.translation: Rites such as Umaniahesvara and others are alsc pleasing to the goddess. They shall be performed devotedly by those who are desirous of salvation.

verses.sanskrit: स तेनास्त्रबलेनैव बलेन च समन्वितः । हैहयान्विजघानाशु सङ्क्रुद्धोऽस्त्रबलेन च
verses.transliteration: sa tenAstrabalenaiva balena cha samanvitaH | haihayAnvijaghAnAshu sa~Nkruddho.astrabalena cha
verses.translation: He who listens to this with devotion or narrates it piously or reads it himself or causes it to be read attains the supreme god.

verses.sanskrit: आजहार च लोकेषु कीर्तिं कीर्तिमतां वरः । धर्मं संस्थापयामास सगरोऽसौ महीतले
verses.transliteration: AjahAra cha lokeShu kIrtiM kIrtimatAM varaH | dharmaM saMsthApayAmAsa sagaro.asau mahItale
verses.translation: He who keeps this in his abode in the manuscript form written in beautiful hand and duly worships it attains all desires.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शकाः सयवनाः काम्बोजाः पाह्लवास्तथा । हन्यमानास्तदा ते तु वसिष्ठं शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: tataH shakAH sayavanAH kAmbojAH pAhlavAstathA | hanyamAnAstadA te tu vasiShThaM sharaNaM yayuH
verses.translation: There will be no fear from goblins, ghosts and other evil spirits at any place. Undoubtedly he will attain sons, grandsons aud riches.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठो वञ्चनां कृत्वा समयेन महाद्युतिः । सगरं वारयामास तेषां दत्वाभयं नृपम्
verses.transliteration: vasiShTho va~nchanAM kR^itvA samayena mahAdyutiH | sagaraM vArayAmAsa teShAM datvAbhayaM nR^ipam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सगरः स्वां प्रतिज्ञां तु गुरोर्वाक्यं निशम्य च । धर्मं जघान तेषां वै केशान्यत्वं चकार ह
verses.transliteration: sagaraH svAM pratij~nAM tu gurorvAkyaM nishamya cha | dharmaM jaghAna teShAM vai keshAnyatvaM chakAra ha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धं शकानां शिरसो मुण्डं कृत्वा व्यसर्जयत् । यवनानां शिरः सर्वं काम्बोजानां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: ardhaM shakAnAM shiraso muNDaM kR^itvA vyasarjayat | yavanAnAM shiraH sarvaM kAmbojAnAM tathaiva cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पारदा मुण्डकेशाश्च पाह्नवाश्श्मश्रुधारिणः । निःस्वाध्यायवषट्काराः कृतास्तेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration: pAradA muNDakeshAshcha pAhnavAshshmashrudhAriNaH | niHsvAdhyAyavaShaTkArAH kR^itAstena mahAtmanA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: जिता च सकला पृथ्वी धर्मतस्तेन भूभुजा । सर्वे ते क्षत्रियास्तात धर्महीनाः कृताः पुरा
verses.transliteration: jitA cha sakalA pR^ithvI dharmatastena bhUbhujA | sarve te kShatriyAstAta dharmahInAH kR^itAH purA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स धर्मविजयी राजा विजित्वेमां वसुन्धराम् । अश्वं संस्कारयामास वाजिमेधाय पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: sa dharmavijayI rAjA vijitvemAM vasundharAm | ashvaM saMskArayAmAsa vAjimedhAya pArthivaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चारयतः सोऽश्वः समुद्रे पूर्वदक्षिणे । गतः षष्टिसहस्रैस्तु तत्पुत्रैरन्वितो मुने
verses.transliteration: tasya chArayataH so.ashvaH samudre pUrvadakShiNe | gataH ShaShTisahasraistu tatputrairanvito mune
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पित्रा तु तं तदा राष्ट्रात्परित्यक्तं स्वमात्मजम् । न वारयामास मुनिर्वसिष्ठः कारणेन च
verses.transliteration: pitrA tu taM tadA rAShTrAtparityaktaM svamAtmajam | na vArayAmAsa munirvasiShThaH kAraNena cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: देवराजेन शक्रेण सोऽश्वो हि स्वार्थसाधिना । वेलासमीपेऽपहृतो भूमिं चैव प्रवेशितः
verses.transliteration: devarAjena shakreNa so.ashvo hi svArthasAdhinA | velAsamIpe.apahR^ito bhUmiM chaiva praveshitaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: महाराजोऽथ सगरस्तद्धयान्वेषणाय च । स तं देशं तदा पुत्रैः खानयामास सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: mahArAjo.atha sagarastaddhayAnveShaNAya cha | sa taM deshaM tadA putraiH khAnayAmAsa sarvataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आसेदुस्ते ततस्तत्र खन्यमाने महार्णवे । तमादिपुरुषं देवं कपिलं विश्वरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: Aseduste tatastatra khanyamAne mahArNave | tamAdipuruShaM devaM kapilaM vishvarUpiNam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चक्षुःसमुत्थेन वह्निना प्रतिबुध्यतः । दग्धाः षष्टिसहस्राणि चत्वारस्त्ववशेषिताः
verses.transliteration: tasya chakShuHsamutthena vahninA pratibudhyataH | dagdhAH ShaShTisahasrANi chatvArastvavasheShitAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: हर्षकेतुः सुकेतुश्च तथा धर्मरथोपरः । शूरः पञ्चजनश्चैव तस्य वंशकरा नृपाः
verses.transliteration: harShaketuH suketushcha tathA dharmarathoparaH | shUraH pa~nchajanashchaiva tasya vaMshakarA nR^ipAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादाच्च तस्मै भगवान् हरिः पञ्च वरान्स्वयम् । वंशं मेधां च कीर्तिं च समुद्रं तनयं धनम्
verses.transliteration: prAdAchcha tasmai bhagavAn hariH pa~ncha varAnsvayam | vaMshaM medhAM cha kIrtiM cha samudraM tanayaM dhanam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सागरत्वं च लेभे स कर्मणा तस्य तेन वै । तं चाश्वमेधिकं सोऽश्वं समुद्रादुपलब्धवान्
verses.transliteration: sAgaratvaM cha lebhe sa karmaNA tasya tena vai | taM chAshvamedhikaM so.ashvaM samudrAdupalabdhavAn
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आजहाराश्वमेधानां शतं स तु महायशाः । ईजे शम्भुविभूतीश्च देवतास्तत्र सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: AjahArAshvamedhAnAM shataM sa tu mahAyashAH | Ije shambhuvibhUtIshcha devatAstatra suvratAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राणां निष्ठा स्यात्सप्तमे पदे । न च सत्यव्रतस्तस्य तमुपांशुमबुद्ध्यत
verses.transliteration: pANigrahaNamantrANAM niShThA syAtsaptame pade | na cha satyavratastasya tamupAMshumabuddhyata
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्स परितोषाय पितुरासीन्महात्मनः । कुलस्य निष्कृतिर्विप्र कृता सा वै भवेदिति
verses.transliteration: tasminsa paritoShAya piturAsInmahAtmanaH | kulasya niShkR^itirvipra kR^itA sA vai bhavediti
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: न तं वसिष्ठो भगवान्पित्रा त्यक्तं न्यवारयत् । अभिषेक्ष्याम्यहं पुत्रमस्य नैवाब्रवीन्मुनिः
verses.transliteration: na taM vasiShTho bhagavAnpitrA tyaktaM nyavArayat | abhiShekShyAmyahaM putramasya naivAbravInmuniH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स तु द्वादश वर्षाणि दीक्षां तामुद्वहद् बली । अविद्यामाने मांसे तु वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sa tu dvAdasha varShANi dIkShAM tAmudvahad balI | avidyAmAne mAMse tu vasiShThasya mahAtmanaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.३९. एकोनचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । वैवस्वतवंशोद्भवराजवर्णनम् । शौनक उवाच । सगरस्यात्मजा वीराः कथं जाता महाबलाः । विक्रान्ताः षष्टिसाहस्रा विधना केन वा वद
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.39\. ekonachatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | vaivasvatavaMshodbhavarAjavarNanam | shaunaka uvAcha | sagarasyAtmajA vIrAH kathaM jAtA mahAbalAH | vikrAntAH ShaShTisAhasrA vidhanA kena vA vada
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषस्तु नाभागिः सिन्धुद्वीपस्ततोऽभवत् । अयुताजित्तु दायादः सिन्धुद्वीपस्य वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: ambarIShastu nAbhAgiH sindhudvIpastato.abhavat | ayutAjittu dAyAdaH sindhudvIpasya vIryavAn
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आयुताजित्सुतस्त्वासीद् ऋतुपर्णो महायशाः । दिव्याक्षहृदयज्ञोऽसौ राजा नलसखोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: AyutAjitsutastvAsId R^ituparNo mahAyashAH | divyAkShahR^idayaj~no.asau rAjA nalasakho.abhavat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुपर्णसुतस्त्वासीदनुपर्णो महाद्युतिः । तस्य कल्माषपादो वै नाम्ना मित्रसहस्तथा
verses.transliteration: R^ituparNasutastvAsIdanuparNo mahAdyutiH | tasya kalmAShapAdo vai nAmnA mitrasahastathA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कल्माषपादस्य सुतः सर्वकर्मेति विश्रुतः । अनरण्यस्तु पुत्रोऽभूद्विश्रुतः सर्वशर्मणः
verses.transliteration: kalmAShapAdasya sutaH sarvakarmeti vishrutaH | anaraNyastu putro.abhUdvishrutaH sarvasharmaNaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अनरण्यसुतो राजा विद्वान्मुण्डिद्रुहोऽभवत् । निषधस्तस्य तनयो रतिः खट्वाङ्ग इत्यपि
verses.transliteration: anaraNyasuto rAjA vidvAnmuNDidruho.abhavat | niShadhastasya tanayo ratiH khaTvA~Nga ityapi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: येन स्वर्गादिहागत्य मुहूर्तं प्राप्य जीवितम् । त्रयोऽपि सञ्चिता लोका बुद्ध्या सत्येन चानघ
verses.transliteration: yena svargAdihAgatya muhUrtaM prApya jIvitam | trayo.api sa~nchitA lokA buddhyA satyena chAnagha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घबाहुः सुतस्तस्य रघुस्तस्याभवत्सुतः । अजस्तस्य तु पुत्रोऽभूत्तस्माद्दशरथोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: dIrghabAhuH sutastasya raghustasyAbhavatsutaH | ajastasya tu putro.abhUttasmAddasharatho.abhavat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: रामो दशरथाज्जज्ञे धर्मात्मा यो महायशाः । स विष्ण्वंशो महाशैवः पौलस्त्यो येन घातितः
verses.transliteration: rAmo dasharathAjjaj~ne dharmAtmA yo mahAyashAH | sa viShNvaMsho mahAshaivaH paulastyo yena ghAtitaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तच्चरित्रं च बहुधा पुराणेषु प्रवर्णितम् । रामायणे प्रसिद्धं हि नातः प्रोक्तं तु विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: tachcharitraM cha bahudhA purANeShu pravarNitam | rAmAyaNe prasiddhaM hi nAtaH proktaM tu vistarAt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: रामस्य तनयो जज्ञे कुश इत्यपि विश्रुतः । अतिथिस्तु कुशाज्जज्ञे निषधस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: rAmasya tanayo jaj~ne kusha ityapi vishrutaH | atithistu kushAjjaj~ne niShadhastasya chAtmajaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । द्वे पत्न्यो सगरस्यास्तां तपसा दग्धकिल्विषे । और्वस्तयोर्वरं प्रादात्तोषितो मुनिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | dve patnyo sagarasyAstAM tapasA dagdhakilviShe | aurvastayorvaraM prAdAttoShito munisattamaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: निषधस्य नलः पुत्रो नभः पुत्रो नलस्य तु । नभसः पुण्डरीकश्च क्षेमधन्वा ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: niShadhasya nalaH putro nabhaH putro nalasya tu | nabhasaH puNDarIkashcha kShemadhanvA tataH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेमधन्वसुतस्त्वासीद्देवानीकः प्रतापवान् । आसीदहीनगुर्नाम देवानीकात्मजः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kShemadhanvasutastvAsIddevAnIkaH pratApavAn | AsIdahInagurnAma devAnIkAtmajaH prabhuH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अहीनगोस्तु दायादः सहस्वान्नाम वीर्यवान् । वीरसेनात्मजस्तस्य यश्चेक्ष्वाकुकुलोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: ahInagostu dAyAdaH sahasvAnnAma vIryavAn | vIrasenAtmajastasya yashchekShvAkukulodbhavaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वीरसेनस्य दायादः पारियात्रो बभूव ह । ततो बलाख्यस्तनयः स्थलस्तस्मादभूत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: vIrasenasya dAyAdaH pAriyAtro babhUva ha | tato balAkhyastanayaH sthalastasmAdabhUtsutaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अर्कांशसम्भवस्तस्मात्पुत्रो यक्षः प्रतापवान् । तत्सुतस्त्वगुणस्त्वासीत्तस्माद्विधृतिरात्मजः
verses.transliteration: arkAMshasambhavastasmAtputro yakShaH pratApavAn | tatsutastvaguNastvAsIttasmAdvidhR^itirAtmajaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यनाभस्तत्पुत्रो योगाचार्यो बभूव ह । स शिष्यो जैमिनिमुनेर्ह्यात्मविद्याविशारदः
verses.transliteration: hiraNyanAbhastatputro yogAchAryo babhUva ha | sa shiShyo jaiminimunerhyAtmavidyAvishAradaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कौशल्यो याज्ञवल्क्योऽथ योगमध्यात्मसंज्ञकम् । यतोऽध्यगान्नृपवराद् हृदयग्रन्थिभेदनम्
verses.transliteration: kaushalyo yAj~navalkyo.atha yogamadhyAtmasa.nj~nakam | yato.adhyagAnnR^ipavarAd hR^idayagranthibhedanam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सुतो पुष्यनामा हि ध्रुवसंज्ञस्तदात्मजः । अग्निवर्णः सुतस्तस्य शीघ्रनामा सुतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tatsuto puShyanAmA hi dhruvasa.nj~nastadAtmajaH | agnivarNaH sutastasya shIghranAmA sutastataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मरुन्नामा सुतस्तस्य योगसिद्धो बभूव ह । असावास्तेऽद्यापि प्रभुः कलापग्रामसंज्ञके
verses.transliteration: marunnAmA sutastasya yogasiddho babhUva ha | asAvAste.adyApi prabhuH kalApagrAmasa.nj~nake
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वासिभिश्च मुनिभिः कलेरन्ते स एव हि । पुनर्भावयिता नष्टं सूर्यवंशं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tadvAsibhishcha munibhiH kalerante sa eva hi | punarbhAvayitA naShTaM sUryavaMshaM visheShataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिपुत्रसहस्राणि एका वव्रे तरस्विनाम् । एकं वंशकरं त्वेका यथेष्टं वरशालिनी
verses.transliteration: ShaShTiputrasahasrANi ekA vavre tarasvinAm | ekaM vaMshakaraM tvekA yatheShTaM varashAlinI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पृथुश्रुतश्च तत्पुत्रः सन्धिस्तस्य सुतः स्मृतः । अमर्षणः सुतस्तस्य मरुत्वांस्तत्सुतोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: pR^ithushrutashcha tatputraH sandhistasya sutaH smR^itaH | amarShaNaH sutastasya marutvAMstatsuto.abhavat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वसाह्वः सुतस्तस्य तत्सुतोऽभूत्प्रसेनजित् । तक्षकस्तस्य तनयः तत्सुतो हि बृहद्बलः
verses.transliteration: vishvasAhvaH sutastasya tatsuto.abhUtprasenajit | takShakastasya tanayaH tatsuto hi bR^ihadbalaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एत इक्ष्वाकुवंशीया अतीताः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः । शृणुतानागतान्भूपांस्तद्वंश्यान्धर्मवित्तमान्
verses.transliteration: eta ikShvAkuvaMshIyA atItAH samprakIrtitAH | shR^iNutAnAgatAnbhUpAMstadvaMshyAndharmavittamAn
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्बलस्य तनयो भविता हि बृहद्रणः । बृहद्रणसुतस्तस्योरुक्रियो हि भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: bR^ihadbalasya tanayo bhavitA hi bR^ihadraNaH | bR^ihadraNasutastasyorukriyo hi bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वत्सवृद्धः सुतस्तस्य प्रतिव्योमा सुतस्ततः । भानुस्तत्तनयो भावी दिवाको वाहिनीपतिः
verses.transliteration: vatsavR^iddhaH sutastasya prativyomA sutastataH | bhAnustattanayo bhAvI divAko vAhinIpatiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सहदेवः सुतस्तस्य महावीरो भविष्यति । तत्सुतो बृहदश्वो हि भानुमांस्तत्सुतो बली
verses.transliteration: sahadevaH sutastasya mahAvIro bhaviShyati | tatsuto bR^ihadashvo hi bhAnumAMstatsuto balI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सुतो भानुमतो भावी प्रतीकाश्वश्च वीर्यवान् । सुप्रतीकः सुतस्तस्य भविष्यति नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: suto bhAnumato bhAvI pratIkAshvashcha vIryavAn | supratIkaH sutastasya bhaviShyati nR^ipottamaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मरुदेवः सुतस्तस्य सुनक्षत्रो भविष्यति । तत्सुतः पुष्करस्तस्यान्तरिक्षस्तत्सुतो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: marudevaH sutastasya sunakShatro bhaviShyati | tatsutaH puShkarastasyAntarikShastatsuto dvijAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सुतपास्तत्सुतो वीरो मित्रचित्तस्य चात्मजः । बृहद्भाजः सुतस्तस्य बर्हिनामा तदात्मजः
verses.transliteration: sutapAstatsuto vIro mitrachittasya chAtmajaH | bR^ihadbhAjaH sutastasya barhinAmA tadAtmajaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कृतञ्जयः सुतस्तस्य तत्सुतो हि रणञ्जयः । सञ्जयस्तु मयस्तस्य तस्य शाक्यो हि चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: kR^ita~njayaH sutastasya tatsuto hi raNa~njayaH | sa~njayastu mayastasya tasya shAkyo hi chAtmajaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैवागत्य तांल्लब्ध्वा पुत्रान् शूरान्बहूंस्तदा । सा चैव सुषुवे तुम्बं बीजपूर्वं पृथक् कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tatraivAgatya tAMllabdhvA putrAn shUrAnbahUMstadA | sA chaiva suShuve tumbaM bIjapUrvaM pR^ithak kR^itam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धोदस्तनयस्तस्य लाङ्गलस्तु तदात्मजः । तस्य प्रसेनजित्पुत्रस्तत्सुतः शूद्रकाह्वयः
verses.transliteration: shuddhodastanayastasya lA~Ngalastu tadAtmajaH | tasya prasenajitputrastatsutaH shUdrakAhvayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: रुणको भविता तस्य सुरथस्तत्सुतः स्मृतः । सुमित्रस्तत्सुतो भावी वंशनिष्ठान्त एव हि
verses.transliteration: ruNako bhavitA tasya surathastatsutaH smR^itaH | sumitrastatsuto bhAvI vaMshaniShThAnta eva hi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सुमित्रान्तोऽन्वयोऽयं वै इक्ष्वाकूणां भविष्यति । राज्ञां वैचित्रवीर्याणां धर्मिष्ठानां सुकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: sumitrAnto.anvayo.ayaM vai ikShvAkUNAM bhaviShyati | rAj~nAM vaichitravIryANAM dharmiShThAnAM sukarmaNAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सुमित्रं प्राप्य राजानं स तद्वंशः शुभः कलौ । संस्थां प्राप्स्यति तद्ब्राह्मे वर्धिष्यति पुनः कृते
verses.transliteration: sumitraM prApya rAjAnaM sa tadvaMshaH shubhaH kalau | saMsthAM prApsyati tadbrAhme vardhiShyati punaH kR^ite
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वैवस्वते वंशे राजानो भूरिदक्षिणाः । इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवाः प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: etadvaivasvate vaMshe rAjAno bhUridakShiNAH | ikShvAkuvaMshaprabhavAH prAdhAnyena prakIrtitAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्येयं परमा सृष्टिरादित्यस्य विवस्वतः । श्राद्धदेवस्य देवस्य प्रजानां पुष्टिदस्य च
verses.transliteration: puNyeyaM paramA sR^iShTirAdityasya vivasvataH | shrAddhadevasya devasya prajAnAM puShTidasya cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पठन् शृण्वन्निमां सृष्टिमादित्यस्य च मानवः । प्रजावानेति सायुज्यमिह भुक्त्वा सुखं परम्
verses.transliteration: paThan shR^iNvannimAM sR^iShTimAdityasya cha mAnavaH | prajAvAneti sAyujyamiha bhuktvA sukhaM param
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे हि स्वधात्रीभिर्ववृधुश्च यथाक्रमम् । घृतपूर्णेषु कुम्भेषु कुमाराः प्रीतिवर्द्धनाः
verses.transliteration: te sarve hi svadhAtrIbhirvavR^idhushcha yathAkramam | ghR^itapUrNeShu kumbheShu kumArAH prItivarddhanAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कपिलाग्निप्रदग्धानां तेषां तत्र महात्मनाम् । एकः पञ्चजनो नाम पुत्रो राजा बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: kapilAgnipradagdhAnAM teShAM tatra mahAtmanAm | ekaH pa~nchajano nAma putro rAjA babhUva ha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पञ्चजनस्यासीदंशुमान्नाम वीर्यवान् । दिलीपस्तनयस्तस्य पुत्रो यस्य भगीरथः
verses.transliteration: tataH pa~nchajanasyAsIdaMshumAnnAma vIryavAn | dilIpastanayastasya putro yasya bhagIrathaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु गङ्गा सरिच्छ्रेष्ठामवातारयत प्रभुः । समुद्रमानयच्चेमां दुहितृत्वमकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: yastu ga~NgA sarichChreShThAmavAtArayata prabhuH | samudramAnayachchemAM duhitR^itvamakalpayat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथसुतो राजा श्रुतसेन इति श्रुतः । नाभागस्तु सुतस्तस्य पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: bhagIrathasuto rAjA shrutasena iti shrutaH | nAbhAgastu sutastasya putraH paramadhArmikaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.४०. चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । पितृप्रभाववर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्य श्राद्धदेवसूर्यान्वयमनुत्तमम् । पर्यपृच्छन्मुनिश्रेष्ठः शौनकः सूतमादरात्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.40\. chatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | pitR^iprabhAvavarNanam | vyAsa uvAcha | ityAkarNya shrAddhadevasUryAnvayamanuttamam | paryapR^ichChanmunishreShThaH shaunakaH sUtamAdarAt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच । पुष्टिकामेन पुंसां वै कथं पुष्टिरवाप्यते । एतच्छ्रोतुं समिच्छामि किं कुर्वाणो न सीदति
verses.transliteration: yudhiShThira uvAcha | puShTikAmena puMsAM vai kathaM puShTiravApyate | etachChrotuM samichChAmi kiM kurvANo na sIdati
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । युधिष्ठिरेण सम्पृष्टं प्रश्नं श्रुत्वा स धर्मवित् । भीष्मः प्रोवाच सुप्रीत्या सर्वेषां शृण्वतां वचः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | yudhiShThireNa sampR^iShTaM prashnaM shrutvA sa dharmavit | bhIShmaH provAcha suprItyA sarveShAM shR^iNvatAM vachaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच । ये कुर्वन्ति नराः श्राद्धान्यपि प्रीत्या युधिष्ठिर । श्राद्धैः प्रीणाति तत्सर्वं पितॄणां हि प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: bhIShma uvAcha | ye kurvanti narAH shrAddhAnyapi prItyA yudhiShThira | shrAddhaiH prINAti tatsarvaM pitR^INAM hi prasAdataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धानि चैव कुर्वन्ति फलकामाः सदा नराः । अभिसन्धाय पितरं पितुश्च पितरं तथा
verses.transliteration: shrAddhAni chaiva kurvanti phalakAmAH sadA narAH | abhisandhAya pitaraM pitushcha pitaraM tathA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पितुः पितामहञ्चैव त्रिषु पिण्डेषु नित्यदा । पितरो धर्मकामस्य प्रजाकामस्य च प्रजाम्
verses.transliteration: pituH pitAmaha~nchaiva triShu piNDeShu nityadA | pitaro dharmakAmasya prajAkAmasya cha prajAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्टिकामस्य पुष्टिं च प्रयच्छन्ति युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: puShTikAmasya puShTiM cha prayachChanti yudhiShThira
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच । वर्तन्ते पितरः स्वर्गे केषाञ्चिन्नरके पुनः । प्राणिनां नियतं चापि कर्मजं फलमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yudhiShThira uvAcha | vartante pitaraH svarge keShA~nchinnarake punaH | prANinAM niyataM chApi karmajaM phalamuchyate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तानि श्राद्धानि दत्तानि कथं गच्छन्ति वै पितॄन् । कथं शक्तास्तमाहर्त्तुं नरकस्थाः फलं पुनः
verses.transliteration: tAni shrAddhAni dattAni kathaM gachChanti vai pitR^In | kathaM shaktAstamAharttuM narakasthAH phalaM punaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: देवा अपि पितृन्स्वर्गे यजन्त इति मे श्रुतम् । एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण ब्रवीहि मे
verses.transliteration: devA api pitR^insvarge yajanta iti me shrutam | etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vistareNa bravIhi me
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच । अत्र ते कीर्तयिष्यामि यथा श्रुतमरिन्दम । पित्रा मम पुरा गीतं लोकान्तरगतेन वै
verses.transliteration: bhIShma uvAcha | atra te kIrtayiShyAmi yathA shrutamarindama | pitrA mama purA gItaM lokAntaragatena vai
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शौनक उवाच । सूत सूत चिरञ्जीव व्यासशिष्य नमोऽस्तु ते । श्राविता परमा दिव्या कथा परमपावनी
verses.transliteration: shaunaka uvAcha | sUta sUta chira~njIva vyAsashiShya namo.astu te | shrAvitA paramA divyA kathA paramapAvanI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धकाले मम पितुर्मया पिण्डः समुद्यतः । मत्पिता मम हस्तेन भित्त्वा भूमिमयाचत
verses.transliteration: shrAddhakAle mama piturmayA piNDaH samudyataH | matpitA mama hastena bhittvA bhUmimayAchata
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नैष कल्पविधिर्दृष्ट इति निश्चित्य चाप्यहम् । कुशेष्वेव ततः पिण्डं दत्तवानविचारयन्
verses.transliteration: naiSha kalpavidhirdR^iShTa iti nishchitya chApyaham | kusheShveva tataH piNDaM dattavAnavichArayan
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पिता मे सन्तुष्टो वाचा मधुरया तदा । उवाच भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रीयमाणो मयानघ
verses.transliteration: tataH pitA me santuShTo vAchA madhurayA tadA | uvAcha bharatashreShTha prIyamANo mayAnagha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया दायादवानस्मि धर्मज्ञेन विपश्चिता । तारितोऽहं तु जिज्ञासा कृता मे पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: tvayA dAyAdavAnasmi dharmaj~nena vipashchitA | tArito.ahaM tu jij~nAsA kR^itA me puruShottama
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमाणं यद्धि कुरुते धर्माचारेण पार्थिवः । प्रजास्तदनुवर्तन्ते प्रमाणाचरितं सदा
verses.transliteration: pramANaM yaddhi kurute dharmAchAreNa pArthivaH | prajAstadanuvartante pramANAcharitaM sadA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शृणु त्वं भरतश्रेष्ठ वेदधर्मांश्च शाश्वतान् । प्रमाणं वेदधर्मस्य पुत्र निर्वर्त्तितं त्वया
verses.transliteration: shR^iNu tvaM bharatashreShTha vedadharmAMshcha shAshvatAn | pramANaM vedadharmasya putra nirvarttitaM tvayA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तवाहं सुप्रीतः प्रीत्या वरमनुत्तमम् । ददामि त्वं प्रतीच्छस्व त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAttavAhaM suprItaH prItyA varamanuttamam | dadAmi tvaM pratIchChasva triShu lokeShu durlabham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: न ते प्रभविता मृत्युर्यावज्जीवितुमिच्छसि । त्वत्तोऽभ्यनुज्ञां सम्प्राप्य मृत्युः प्रभविता पुनः
verses.transliteration: na te prabhavitA mR^ityuryAvajjIvitumichChasi | tvatto.abhyanuj~nAM samprApya mR^ityuH prabhavitA punaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: किं वा ते प्रार्थितं भूयो ददामि वरमुत्तमम् । तद् ब्रूहि भरतश्रेष्ठ यत्ते मनसि वर्तते
verses.transliteration: kiM vA te prArthitaM bhUyo dadAmi varamuttamam | tad brUhi bharatashreShTha yatte manasi vartate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तवति तस्मिंस्तु अभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः । अवोचं कृतकृत्योऽहं प्रसन्ने त्वयि मानद । प्रश्नं पृच्छामि वै कञ्चिद्वाच्यः स भवता स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktavati tasmiMstu abhivAdya kR^itA~njaliH | avochaM kR^itakR^ityo.ahaM prasanne tvayi mAnada | prashnaM pR^ichChAmi vai ka~nchidvAchyaH sa bhavatA svayam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया प्रोक्तः श्राद्धदेवः सूर्यः सद्वंशवर्धनः । संशयस्तत्र मे जातस्तं ब्रवीमि त्वदग्रतः
verses.transliteration: tvayA proktaH shrAddhadevaH sUryaH sadvaMshavardhanaH | saMshayastatra me jAtastaM bravImi tvadagrataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स मामुवाच तद् ब्रूहि यदीच्छसि वदामि ते । इत्युक्तेन मया तत्र पृष्टः प्रोवाच तं नृपः
verses.transliteration: sa mAmuvAcha tad brUhi yadIchChasi vadAmi te | ityuktena mayA tatra pR^iShTaH provAcha taM nR^ipaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शन्तनुरुवाच । शृणु तात प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रश्नं तेऽहं यथार्थतः । पितृकल्पं च निखिलं मार्कण्डेयेन मे श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: shantanuruvAcha | shR^iNu tAta pravakShyAmi prashnaM te.ahaM yathArthataH | pitR^ikalpaM cha nikhilaM mArkaNDeyena me shrutam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वं पृच्छसि मां तात तदेवाहं महामुनिम् । मार्कण्डेयमपृच्छं हि स मां प्रोवाच धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: yattvaM pR^ichChasi mAM tAta tadevAhaM mahAmunim | mArkaNDeyamapR^ichChaM hi sa mAM provAcha dharmavit
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच । शृणु राजन्मया दृष्टं कदाचित्पश्यता दिवम् । विमानं महदायान्तमन्तरेण गिरेस्तदा
verses.transliteration: mArkaNDeya uvAcha | shR^iNu rAjanmayA dR^iShTaM kadAchitpashyatA divam | vimAnaM mahadAyAntamantareNa girestadA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्विमाने पर्यक्षं ज्वलिताङ्गारवर्चसम् । महातेजः प्रज्वलन्तं निर्विशेषं मनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: tasminvimAne paryakShaM jvalitA~NgAravarchasam | mahAtejaH prajvalantaM nirvisheShaM manoharam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यं चैव तत्राहं शयानं दीप्ततेजसम् । अङ्गुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषमग्नावग्निमिवाहितम्
verses.transliteration: apashyaM chaiva tatrAhaM shayAnaM dIptatejasam | a~NguShThamAtraM puruShamagnAvagnimivAhitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहं तस्मै नमः कृत्वा प्रणम्य शिरसा प्रभुम् । अपृच्छं चैव तमहं विद्याम त्वां कथं विभो
verses.transliteration: so.ahaM tasmai namaH kR^itvA praNamya shirasA prabhum | apR^ichChaM chaiva tamahaM vidyAma tvAM kathaM vibho
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स मामुवाच धर्मात्मा ते न तद्विद्यते तपः । येन त्वं बुध्यसे मां हि मुने वै ब्रह्मणः सुतम्
verses.transliteration: sa mAmuvAcha dharmAtmA te na tadvidyate tapaH | yena tvaM budhyase mAM hi mune vai brahmaNaH sutam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारमिति मां विद्धि किं करवाणि ते । ये त्वन्ये ब्रह्मणः पुत्राः कनीयांसस्तु ते मम
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAramiti mAM viddhi kiM karavANi te | ye tvanye brahmaNaH putrAH kanIyAMsastu te mama
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातरः सप्त दुर्धर्षा येषां वंशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः । वयं तु यतिधर्माणः संयम्यात्मानमात्मनि
verses.transliteration: bhrAtaraH sapta durdharShA yeShAM vaMshAH pratiShThitAH | vayaM tu yatidharmANaH saMyamyAtmAnamAtmani
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कुतो वै श्राद्धदेवत्वमादित्यस्य विवस्वतः । श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्प्रीत्या छिन्धि मे संशयं त्विमम्
verses.transliteration: kuto vai shrAddhadevatvamAdityasya vivasvataH | shrotumichChAmi tatprItyA Chindhi me saMshayaM tvimam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यथोत्पन्नस्तथैवाहं कुमार इति विश्रुतः । तस्मात्सनत्कुमारं मे नामैतत्कथितं मुने
verses.transliteration: yathotpannastathaivAhaM kumAra iti vishrutaH | tasmAtsanatkumAraM me nAmaitatkathitaM mune
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यद्भक्त्या ते तपश्चीर्णं मम दर्शनकाङ्क्षया । एष दृष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते कं कामं करवाणि ते
verses.transliteration: yadbhaktyA te tapashchIrNaM mama darshanakA~NkShayA | eSha dR^iShTo.asmi bhadraM te kaM kAmaM karavANi te
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तवन्तं तं चाहं प्रावोचं त्वं शृणु प्रभो । पितॄणामादिसर्गं च कथयस्व यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktavantaM taM chAhaM prAvochaM tvaM shR^iNu prabho | pitR^INAmAdisargaM cha kathayasva yathAtatham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः स तु मां प्राह शृणु सर्वं यथातथम् । वच्मि ते तत्त्वतस्तात पितृसर्गं शुभावहम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktaH sa tu mAM prAha shR^iNu sarvaM yathAtatham | vachmi te tattvatastAta pitR^isargaM shubhAvaham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । देवान्पुरासृजद्ब्रह्मा मां यक्षध्वं स चाह तान् । तमुत्सृज्य तमात्मानमयजंस्ते फलार्थिनः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | devAnpurAsR^ijadbrahmA mAM yakShadhvaM sa chAha tAn | tamutsR^ijya tamAtmAnamayajaMste phalArthinaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ते शप्ता ब्रह्मणा मूढा नष्टसंज्ञा भविष्यथ । तस्मात्किञ्चिदजानन्तो नष्टसंज्ञाः पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: te shaptA brahmaNA mUDhA naShTasa.nj~nA bhaviShyatha | tasmAtki~nchidajAnanto naShTasa.nj~nAH pitAmaham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोचुस्तं प्रणताः सर्वे कुरुष्वानुग्रहं हि नः । इत्युक्तस्तानुवाचेदं प्रायश्चित्तार्थमेव हि
verses.transliteration: prochustaM praNatAH sarve kuruShvAnugrahaM hi naH | ityuktastAnuvAchedaM prAyashchittArthameva hi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रान्स्वान्परिपृच्छध्वं ततो ज्ञानमवाप्स्यथ । इत्युक्ता नष्टसंज्ञास्ते पुत्रान्पप्रच्छुरोजसा
verses.transliteration: putrAnsvAnparipR^ichChadhvaM tato j~nAnamavApsyatha | ityuktA naShTasa.nj~nAste putrAnpaprachChurojasA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तार्थमेवाधिलब्धसंज्ञा दिवौकसः । गम्यतां पुत्रका एवं पुत्रैरुक्ताश्च तेऽनघ
verses.transliteration: prAyashchittArthamevAdhilabdhasa.nj~nA divaukasaH | gamyatAM putrakA evaM putrairuktAshcha te.anagha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अभिशप्तास्तु ते देवाः पुत्रकामेन वेधसम् । पप्रच्छुरुक्ताः पुत्रैस्ते गतास्ते पुत्रका इति
verses.transliteration: abhishaptAstu te devAH putrakAmena vedhasam | paprachChuruktAH putraiste gatAste putrakA iti
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धस्यापि च माहात्म्यं तत्फलं च वद प्रभो । प्रीताश्च पितरो येन श्रेयसा योजयन्ति तम्
verses.transliteration: shrAddhasyApi cha mAhAtmyaM tatphalaM cha vada prabho | prItAshcha pitaro yena shreyasA yojayanti tam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तानब्रवीद्देवो देवान्ब्रह्मा ससंशयान् । शृणुध्वं निर्जराः सर्वे यूयं न ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: tatastAnabravIddevo devAnbrahmA sasaMshayAn | shR^iNudhvaM nirjarAH sarve yUyaM na brahmavAdinaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यदुक्तं युष्माकं पुत्रैस्तैर्ज्ञानिसत्तमैः । मन्तव्यं संशयं त्यक्त्वा तथा न च तदन्यथा
verses.transliteration: tasmAdyaduktaM yuShmAkaM putraistairj~nAnisattamaiH | mantavyaM saMshayaM tyaktvA tathA na cha tadanyathA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च पितरश्चैव यजध्वं त्रिदिवौकसः । परस्परं महाप्रीत्या सर्वकामफलप्रदाः
verses.transliteration: devAshcha pitarashchaiva yajadhvaM tridivaukasaH | parasparaM mahAprItyA sarvakAmaphalapradAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । ततस्ते छिन्नसन्देहाः प्रीतिमन्तः परस्परम् । बभूवुर्मुनिशार्दूल ब्रह्मवाक्यात्सुखप्रदाः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | tataste ChinnasandehAH prItimantaH parasparam | babhUvurmunishArdUla brahmavAkyAtsukhapradAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवा हि प्रोचुस्तान्यदुक्ताः पुत्रका वयम् । तस्माद्भवन्तः पितरो भविष्यथ न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tato devA hi prochustAnyaduktAH putrakA vayam | tasmAdbhavantaH pitaro bhaviShyatha na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पितृश्राद्धे क्रियां कश्चित्करिष्यति न संशयः । श्राद्धैराप्यायितः सोमो लोकानाप्याययिष्यति
verses.transliteration: pitR^ishrAddhe kriyAM kashchitkariShyati na saMshayaH | shrAddhairApyAyitaH somo lokAnApyAyayiShyati
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रं पर्वतवनं जङ्गमाजङ्गमैर्वृतम् । श्राद्धानि पुष्टिकामाश्च ये करिष्यन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: samudraM parvatavanaM ja~NgamAja~NgamairvR^itam | shrAddhAni puShTikAmAshcha ye kariShyanti mAnavAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यः पुष्टिप्रदाश्चैव पितरः प्रीणिताः सदा । श्राद्धे ये च प्रदास्यन्ति त्रीन्पिण्डान्नामगोत्रतः
verses.transliteration: tebhyaH puShTipradAshchaiva pitaraH prINitAH sadA | shrAddhe ye cha pradAsyanti trInpiNDAnnAmagotrataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र वर्तमानास्ते पितरः प्रपितामहाः । भावयिष्यन्ति सततं श्राद्धदानेन तर्पिताः
verses.transliteration: sarvatra vartamAnAste pitaraH prapitAmahAH | bhAvayiShyanti satataM shrAddhadAnena tarpitAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति तद्वचनं सत्यं भवत्वथ दिवौकसः । पुत्राश्च पितरश्चैव वयं सर्वे परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: iti tadvachanaM satyaM bhavatvatha divaukasaH | putrAshcha pitarashchaiva vayaM sarve parasparam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि पितृणां सर्गमुत्तमम् । कथय त्वं विशेषेण कृपां कुरु महामते
verses.transliteration: etachcha shrotumichChAmi pitR^iNAM sargamuttamam | kathaya tvaM visheSheNa kR^ipAM kuru mahAmate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ते पितरो देवा धर्मतः पुत्रतां गताः । अन्योऽन्यं पितरो वै ते प्रथिताः क्षितिमण्डले
verses.transliteration: evaM te pitaro devA dharmataH putratAM gatAH | anyo.anyaM pitaro vai te prathitAH kShitimaNDale
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । वच्मि तत्तेऽखिलं प्रीत्या पितृसर्गं तु शौनक । मार्कण्डेयेन कथितं भीष्माय परिपृच्छते
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | vachmi tatte.akhilaM prItyA pitR^isargaM tu shaunaka | mArkaNDeyena kathitaM bhIShmAya paripR^ichChate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: गीतं सनत्कुमारेण मार्कण्डेयाय धीमते । तत्तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: gItaM sanatkumAreNa mArkaNDeyAya dhImate | tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi sarvakAmaphalapradam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिरेण सम्पृष्टो भीष्मो धर्मभृतां वरः । शरशय्यास्थितः प्रोचे तच्छृणुष्व वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: yudhiShThireNa sampR^iShTo bhIShmo dharmabhR^itAM varaH | sharashayyAsthitaH proche tachChR^iNuShva vadAmi te
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.४१. एकचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । सप्तव्याधगतिवर्णनम् । सनत्कुमार उवाच । सप्त ते तपतां श्रेष्ठ स्वर्गे पितृगणाः स्मृताः । चत्वारो मूर्त्तिमन्तो वै त्रयश्चैव ह्यमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.41\. ekachatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | saptavyAdhagativarNanam | sanatkumAra uvAcha | sapta te tapatAM shreShTha svarge pitR^igaNAH smR^itAH | chatvAro mUrttimanto vai trayashchaiva hyamUrtayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शृणु भीष्म पुरा भूयो भारद्वाजात्मजा द्विजाः । योगधर्ममनुप्राप्य भ्रष्टा दुश्चरितेन वै
verses.transliteration: shR^iNu bhIShma purA bhUyo bhAradvAjAtmajA dvijAH | yogadharmamanuprApya bhraShTA dushcharitena vai
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वाग्दुष्टः क्रोधनो हिंस्रः पिशुनः कविरेव च । खसृषः पितृवर्ती च नामभिः कर्मभिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vAgduShTaH krodhano hiMsraH pishunaH kavireva cha | khasR^iShaH pitR^ivartI cha nAmabhiH karmabhistathA
