verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कौशिकस्य सुतास्तात शिष्या गर्गस्य चाभवन् । पितर्युपरते सर्वे प्रवसन्तस्तदाभवन्
verses.transliteration: kaushikasya sutAstAta shiShyA gargasya chAbhavan | pitaryuparate sarve pravasantastadAbhavan
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विनियोगाद् गुरोस्तस्य गां दोग्ध्रीं समकालयन् । समानवत्सां कपिलां सर्वेऽन्यायागतास्तदा
verses.transliteration: viniyogAd gurostasya gAM dogdhrIM samakAlayan | samAnavatsAM kapilAM sarve.anyAyAgatAstadA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पथि क्षुधार्तानां बाल्यान्मोहाच्च भारत । क्रूरा बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना तां गां वै हिंसितुं तदा
verses.transliteration: teShAM pathi kShudhArtAnAM bAlyAnmohAchcha bhArata | krUrA buddhiH samutpannA tAM gAM vai hiMsituM tadA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तां कविः खसृपश्चैव याचेते नैति वै तदा । न चाशक्यास्तु ताभ्यां वा तदा वारयितुं निजाः
verses.transliteration: tAM kaviH khasR^ipashchaiva yAchete naiti vai tadA | na chAshakyAstu tAbhyAM vA tadA vArayituM nijAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पितृवर्ती तु यस्तेषां नित्यं श्राद्धाह्निको द्विजः । स सर्वानब्रवीत्कोपात् पितृभक्तिसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: pitR^ivartI tu yasteShAM nityaM shrAddhAhniko dvijaH | sa sarvAnabravItkopAt pitR^ibhaktisamanvitaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यशक्यं प्रकर्तव्यं पितृनुद्दिश्य साध्यताम् । प्रकुर्वन्तो हि श्राद्धं तु सर्व एव समाहिताः
verses.transliteration: yadyashakyaM prakartavyaM pitR^inuddishya sAdhyatAm | prakurvanto hi shrAddhaM tu sarva eva samAhitAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेषा च गौर्धर्मं प्राप्स्यते नात्र संशयः । पितॄनभ्यर्च्य धर्मेण नाधर्मो नो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: evameShA cha gaurdharmaM prApsyate nAtra saMshayaH | pitR^Inabhyarchya dharmeNa nAdharmo no bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ताश्च ते सर्वे प्रोक्षयित्वा च गां तदा । पितृभ्यः कल्पयित्वा तु ह्युपायुञ्जत भारत
verses.transliteration: evamuktAshcha te sarve prokShayitvA cha gAM tadA | pitR^ibhyaH kalpayitvA tu hyupAyu~njata bhArata
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तान्यजन्ते देवगणा आद्या विप्रादयस्तथा । आप्याययन्ति ते पूर्वं सोमं योगबलेन वै
verses.transliteration: tAnyajante devagaNA AdyA viprAdayastathA | ApyAyayanti te pUrvaM somaM yogabalena vai
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: उपयुज्य च गां सर्वे गुरोस्तस्य न्यवेदयन् । शार्दूलेन हता धेनुर्वत्सा वै गृह्यतामिति
verses.transliteration: upayujya cha gAM sarve gurostasya nyavedayan | shArdUlena hatA dhenurvatsA vai gR^ihyatAmiti
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आर्जवात्स तु तं वत्सं प्रतिजग्राह वै द्विजः । मिथ्योपचारतः पापमभूत्तेषां च गोघ्नताम्
verses.transliteration: ArjavAtsa tu taM vatsaM pratijagrAha vai dvijaH | mithyopachArataH pApamabhUtteShAM cha goghnatAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन कियता कालधर्ममुपागताः । ते सप्त भ्रातरस्तात बभूवुः स्वायुषः क्षये
verses.transliteration: tataH kAlena kiyatA kAladharmamupAgatAH | te sapta bhrAtarastAta babhUvuH svAyuShaH kShaye
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ते वै क्रूरतया हैंस्त्र्यात्स्वानार्यत्वाद् गुरोस्तथा । उग्रहिंसाविहाराश्च जाताः सप्त सहोदराः
verses.transliteration: te vai krUratayA haiMstryAtsvAnAryatvAd gurostathA | ugrahiMsAvihArAshcha jAtAH sapta sahodarAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: लुब्धकस्य सुतास्तावद् बलवन्तो मनस्विनः । जाता व्याधा दशार्णेषु सप्त धर्मविचक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: lubdhakasya sutAstAvad balavanto manasvinaH | jAtA vyAdhA dashArNeShu sapta dharmavichakShaNAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मनिरताः सर्वे मृगा मोहविवर्जिताः । आसन्नुद्वेगसंविग्ना रम्ये कालञ्जरे गिरौ
verses.transliteration: svadharmaniratAH sarve mR^igA mohavivarjitAH | AsannudvegasaMvignA ramye kAla~njare girau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तमेवार्थमनुध्याय ज्ञातिस्मरणसम्भवम् । आसन्वनचराः क्षान्ता निर्द्वन्द्वा निष्परिग्रहाः
verses.transliteration: tamevArthamanudhyAya j~nAtismaraNasambhavam | AsanvanacharAH kShAntA nirdvandvA niShparigrahAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे शुभकर्माणः सद्धर्माणो वनेचराः । विधर्माचरणैर्हीना जातिस्मरणसिद्धयः
verses.transliteration: te sarve shubhakarmANaH saddharmANo vanecharAH | vidharmAcharaNairhInA jAtismaraNasiddhayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजातिषु यो धर्मः श्रुतो गुरुकुलेषु वै । तथैव चास्थिता बुद्धिः संसारेऽपि निवर्तने
verses.transliteration: pUrvajAtiShu yo dharmaH shruto gurukuleShu vai | tathaiva chAsthitA buddhiH saMsAre.api nivartane
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: गिरिमध्ये जहुः प्राणाँल्लब्धाहारास्तपस्विनः । तेषां तु पतितानां च यानि स्थानानि भारत
verses.transliteration: girimadhye jahuH prANA.NllabdhAhArAstapasvinaH | teShAM tu patitAnAM cha yAni sthAnAni bhArata
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छ्राद्धानि देयानि योगिनां तु विशेषतः । सर्वेषां राजतं पात्रमथवा रजतान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAchChrAddhAni deyAni yoginAM tu visheShataH | sarveShAM rAjataM pAtramathavA rajatAnvitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तथैवाद्यापि दृश्यन्ते गिरौ कालञ्जरे नृप । कर्मणा तेन ते जाताः शुभाशुभविवर्जकाः
verses.transliteration: tathaivAdyApi dR^ishyante girau kAla~njare nR^ipa | karmaNA tena te jAtAH shubhAshubhavivarjakAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शुभाच्छुभतरां योनिं चक्रवाकत्वमागताः । शुभे देशे शरद्वीपे सप्तैवासञ्जलौकसः
verses.transliteration: shubhAchChubhatarAM yoniM chakravAkatvamAgatAH | shubhe deshe sharadvIpe saptaivAsa~njalaukasaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा सहचरीधर्मं मुनयो धर्मधारिणः । निःसङ्गो निर्ममश्शान्तो निर्द्वन्द्वो निष्परिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: tyaktvA sahacharIdharmaM munayo dharmadhAriNaH | niHsa~Ngo nirmamashshAnto nirdvandvo niShparigrahaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तिनिर्वृतश्चैव शकुना नामतः स्मृताः । ते ब्रह्मचारिणः सर्वे शकुना धर्मचारिणः
verses.transliteration: nivR^ittinirvR^itashchaiva shakunA nAmataH smR^itAH | te brahmachAriNaH sarve shakunA dharmachAriNaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: जातिस्मराः सुसंवृद्धाः सप्तैव ब्रह्मचारिणः । स्थिता एकत्र सद्धर्मा विकाररहिताः सदा
verses.transliteration: jAtismarAH susaMvR^iddhAH saptaiva brahmachAriNaH | sthitA ekatra saddharmA vikArarahitAH sadA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रयोनौ तु यन्मोहान्मिथ्यापचरितं गुरौ । तिर्यग्योनौ तथा जन्म श्राद्धाज्ज्ञानं च लेभिरे
verses.transliteration: viprayonau tu yanmohAnmithyApacharitaM gurau | tiryagyonau tathA janma shrAddhAjj~nAnaM cha lebhire
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तु पितृकार्यार्थं कृतं श्राद्धं व्यवस्थितैः । तदा ज्ञानं च जातिं च क्रमात्प्राप्तं गुणोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tathA tu pitR^ikAryArthaM kR^itaM shrAddhaM vyavasthitaiH | tadA j~nAnaM cha jAtiM cha kramAtprAptaM guNottaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजातिषु यद्ब्रह्म श्रुतं गुरुकुलेषु वै । तथैव संस्थित ज्ञानं तस्माज्ज्ञानं समभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: pUrvajAtiShu yadbrahma shrutaM gurukuleShu vai | tathaiva saMsthita j~nAnaM tasmAjj~nAnaM samabhyaset
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सुमनाश्च सुवाक्छुद्धः पञ्चमश्छिद्रदर्शकः । स्वतन्त्रश्च सुयज्ञश्च कुलीङ्गा नामतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: sumanAshcha suvAkChuddhaH pa~nchamashChidradarshakaH | svatantrashcha suyaj~nashcha kulI~NgA nAmataH smR^itAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तत्र विहङ्गानां चरतां धर्मचारिणाम् । सुवृत्तमभवत्तत्र तच्छृणुष्व महामुने
verses.transliteration: teShAM tatra viha~NgAnAM charatAM dharmachAriNAm | suvR^ittamabhavattatra tachChR^iNuShva mahAmune
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तं स्वधां पुरोधाय श्राद्धं प्रीणाति वै पितृन् । वह्नेराप्यायनं कृत्वा सोमस्य तु यमस्य वै
verses.transliteration: dattaM svadhAM purodhAya shrAddhaM prINAti vai pitR^in | vahnerApyAyanaM kR^itvA somasya tu yamasya vai
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नीपानामीश्वरो राजा प्रभावेण समन्वितः । श्रीमानन्तःपुरवृतो वनं तत्राविवेश ह
verses.transliteration: nIpAnAmIshvaro rAjA prabhAveNa samanvitaH | shrImAnantaHpuravR^ito vanaM tatrAvivesha ha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स्वतन्त्रश्चक्रवाकः स स्पृहयामास तं नृपम् । दृष्ट्वा यान्तं सुखोपेतं राज्यशोभासमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: svatantrashchakravAkaH sa spR^ihayAmAsa taM nR^ipam | dR^iShTvA yAntaM sukhopetaM rAjyashobhAsamanvitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यस्ति सुकृतं किञ्चित्तपो वा नियमोऽपि वा । खिन्नोऽहमुपवासेन तपसा निश्चलेन च
verses.transliteration: yadyasti sukR^itaM ki~nchittapo vA niyamo.api vA | khinno.ahamupavAsena tapasA nishchalena cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सर्वस्य पूर्णेन फलेनापि कृतेन हि । सर्वसौभाग्यपात्रश्च भवेयमहमीदृशः
verses.transliteration: tasya sarvasya pUrNena phalenApi kR^itena hi | sarvasaubhAgyapAtrashcha bhaveyamahamIdR^ishaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच । ततस्तु चक्रवाकौ द्वावासतुः सहचारिणौ । आवां वै सचिवौ स्याव तव प्रियहितैषिणौ
verses.transliteration: mArkaNDeya uvAcha | tatastu chakravAkau dvAvAsatuH sahachAriNau | AvAM vai sachivau syAva tava priyahitaiShiNau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्युक्त्वा तु तस्यासीत्तदा योगात्मनो गतिः । एवं तौ चक्रवाकौ च स्ववाक्यं प्रत्यभाषताम्
verses.transliteration: tathetyuktvA tu tasyAsIttadA yogAtmano gatiH | evaM tau chakravAkau cha svavAkyaM pratyabhAShatAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्कर्म ब्रुवाणस्त्वं योगधर्ममवाप्य तम् । एवं वरं प्रार्थयसे तस्माद्वाक्यं निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: yasmAtkarma bruvANastvaM yogadharmamavApya tam | evaM varaM prArthayase tasmAdvAkyaM nibodha me
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: राजा त्वं भविता तात काम्पिल्ये नगरोत्तमे । एतौ ते सचिवौ स्यातां व्यभिचारप्रधर्षितौ
verses.transliteration: rAjA tvaM bhavitA tAta kAmpilye nagarottame | etau te sachivau syAtAM vyabhichArapradharShitau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: न तानूचुस्त्रयो राज्यं चतुरः सहचारिणः । स प्रसादं पुनश्चक्रे तन्मध्ये सुमनाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: na tAnUchustrayo rAjyaM chaturaH sahachAriNaH | sa prasAdaM punashchakre tanmadhye sumanAbravIt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तवान् भविता शापः पुनर्योगमवाप्स्यथ । सर्वसत्त्वरुतज्ञश्च स्वतन्त्रोऽयं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: antavAn bhavitA shApaH punaryogamavApsyatha | sarvasattvarutaj~nashcha svatantro.ayaM bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: उदगायनमप्यग्नावग्न्यभावेऽप्सु वा पुनः । पितॄन्प्रीणाति यो भक्त्या पितरः प्रीणयन्ति तम्
verses.transliteration: udagAyanamapyagnAvagnyabhAve.apsu vA punaH | pitR^InprINAti yo bhaktyA pitaraH prINayanti tam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पितृप्रसादाद्युष्माभिः सम्प्राप्तं सुकृतं भवेत् । गां प्रोक्षयित्वा धर्मेण पितृभ्यश्चोपकल्पिताः
verses.transliteration: pitR^iprasAdAdyuShmAbhiH samprAptaM sukR^itaM bhavet | gAM prokShayitvA dharmeNa pitR^ibhyashchopakalpitAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं ज्ञानसंयोगः सर्वेषां योगसाधनम् । इदं च वाक्यं संरब्धं श्लोकमेकमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: asmAkaM j~nAnasaMyogaH sarveShAM yogasAdhanam | idaM cha vAkyaM saMrabdhaM shlokamekamudAhR^itam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषान्तरितं श्रुत्वा ततो योगमवाप्स्यथ । इत्युक्त्वा स तु मौनोऽभूद्विहङ्गः सुमना बुधः
verses.transliteration: puruShAntaritaM shrutvA tato yogamavApsyatha | ityuktvA sa tu mauno.abhUdviha~NgaH sumanA budhaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच । लोकानां स्वस्तये तात शन्तनुप्रवरात्मज । इत्युक्तं तच्चरित्रं मे किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: mArkaNDeya uvAcha | lokAnAM svastaye tAta shantanupravarAtmaja | ityuktaM tachcharitraM me kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यच्छन्ति पितरः पुष्टिं प्रजाश्च विपुलास्तथा । स्वर्गमारोग्यवृद्धिं च यदन्यदपि चेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: yachChanti pitaraH puShTiM prajAshcha vipulAstathA | svargamArogyavR^iddhiM cha yadanyadapi chepsitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: देवकार्यादपि मुने पितृकार्यं विशिष्यते । पितृभक्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे तेन त्वमजरामरः
verses.transliteration: devakAryAdapi mune pitR^ikAryaM vishiShyate | pitR^ibhakto.asi viprarShe tena tvamajarAmaraH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: न योगेन गतिः सा तु पितृभक्तस्य या मुने । पितृभक्तिर्विशेषेण तस्मात्कार्या महामुने
verses.transliteration: na yogena gatiH sA tu pitR^ibhaktasya yA mune | pitR^ibhaktirvisheSheNa tasmAtkAryA mahAmune
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच । एवमुक्त्वाशु देवेशो देवानामपि दुर्लभम् । चक्षुर्दत्त्वा सविज्ञानं जगाम यौगिकीं गतिम्
verses.transliteration: mArkaNDeya uvAcha | evamuktvAshu devesho devAnAmapi durlabham | chakShurdattvA savij~nAnaM jagAma yaugikIM gatim
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.४२. द्विचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । पितृप्रभाववर्णनम् । भीष्म उवाच । मार्कण्डेय महाप्राज्ञ पितृभक्तिभृतां वर । किं जातं तु ततो ब्रूहि कृपया मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.42\. dvichatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | pitR^iprabhAvavarNanam | bhIShma uvAcha | mArkaNDeya mahAprAj~na pitR^ibhaktibhR^itAM vara | kiM jAtaM tu tato brUhi kR^ipayA munisattama
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: छिद्रदर्शी सुनेत्रस्तु वेदवेदाङ्गपारगौ । जातौ श्रोत्रियदायादौ पूर्वजातिसहोषितौ
verses.transliteration: ChidradarshI sunetrastu vedavedA~NgapAragau | jAtau shrotriyadAyAdau pUrvajAtisahoShitau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालो बह्वृचस्त्वासीदाचार्यत्वं चकार ह । द्विवेदः पुण्डरीकश्च छन्दोगोऽध्वर्युरेव च
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAlo bahvR^ichastvAsIdAchAryatvaM chakAra ha | dvivedaH puNDarIkashcha Chandogo.adhvaryureva cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो राजा सुतं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मदत्तमकल्मषम् । अभिषिच्य स्वराज्ये तु परां गतिमवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: tato rAjA sutaM dR^iShTvA brahmadattamakalmaSham | abhiShichya svarAjye tu parAM gatimavAptavAn
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालः पुण्डरीकस्तु पुत्रौ संस्थाप्य मन्दिरे । विविशतुर्वनं तत्र गतौ परमिकां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAlaH puNDarIkastu putrau saMsthApya mandire | vivishaturvanaM tatra gatau paramikAM gatim
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदत्तस्य भार्या तु सन्नितिर्नाम भारत । सा त्वेकभावसंयुक्ता रेमे भर्त्रा सहैव तु
verses.transliteration: brahmadattasya bhAryA tu sannitirnAma bhArata | sA tvekabhAvasaMyuktA reme bhartrA sahaiva tu
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शेषास्तु चक्रवाका वै काम्पिल्ये सहचारिणः । जाताः श्रोत्रियदायादा दरिद्रस्य कुले नृप
verses.transliteration: sheShAstu chakravAkA vai kAmpilye sahachAriNaH | jAtAH shrotriyadAyAdA daridrasya kule nR^ipa
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: धृतिमान्सुमहात्मा च तत्त्वदर्शीं निरुत्सुकः । वेदाध्ययन सम्पन्नाश्चत्वारश्छिद्रदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: dhR^itimAnsumahAtmA cha tattvadarshIM nirutsukaH | vedAdhyayana sampannAshchatvArashChidradarshinaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ते योगनिरताः सिद्धाः प्रस्थिताः सर्व एव हि । आमन्त्र्य च मिथः शम्भोः पदाम्भोजं प्रणम्य तु
verses.transliteration: te yoganiratAH siddhAH prasthitAH sarva eva hi | Amantrya cha mithaH shambhoH padAmbhojaM praNamya tu
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ते तमूचुर्द्विजाः सर्वे पितरं पुनरेव च । करिष्यामो विधानं ते येन त्वं वर्तयिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: te tamUchurdvijAH sarve pitaraM punareva cha | kariShyAmo vidhAnaM te yena tvaM vartayiShyasi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इमं श्लोकं महार्थं त्वं राजानं सहमन्त्रिणम् । श्रावयेथाः समागम्य ब्रह्मदत्तमकल्मषम्
verses.transliteration: imaM shlokaM mahArthaM tvaM rAjAnaM sahamantriNam | shrAvayethAH samAgamya brahmadattamakalmaSham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच । ते धर्मयोगनिरताः सप्त मानसचारिणः । वाय्वम्बुभक्षाः सततं शरीरमुपशोषयन्
verses.transliteration: mArkaNDeya uvAcha | te dharmayoganiratAH sapta mAnasachAriNaH | vAyvambubhakShAH satataM sharIramupashoShayan
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतात्मा दास्यति स ते ग्रामान् भोगांश्च पुष्कलान् । एतावदुक्त्वा ते सर्वे पूजयित्वा च तं गुरुम् । योगधर्ममनुप्राप्य परां निर्वृतिमाययुः
verses.transliteration: prItAtmA dAsyati sa te grAmAn bhogAMshcha puShkalAn | etAvaduktvA te sarve pUjayitvA cha taM gurum | yogadharmamanuprApya parAM nirvR^itimAyayuH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्णां तु पिता योऽसौ ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् । श्लोकं सोऽधीत्य पुत्रेभ्यः कृतकृत्य इवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: chaturNAM tu pitA yo.asau brAhmaNAnAM mahAtmanAm | shlokaM so.adhItya putrebhyaH kR^itakR^itya ivAbhavat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रावयामास राजानं स्लोकं तं सचिवौ च तौ । सप्तव्याधा दशार्णेषु मृगाः कालञ्जरे गिरौ
verses.transliteration: shrAvayAmAsa rAjAnaM slokaM taM sachivau cha tau | saptavyAdhA dashArNeShu mR^igAH kAla~njare girau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रवाकाः शरद्वीपे हंसाः सरसि मानसे । तेऽभिजाताः कुरुक्षेत्रे ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः
verses.transliteration: chakravAkAH sharadvIpe haMsAH sarasi mAnase | te.abhijAtAH kurukShetre brAhmaNA vedapAragAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्थिता दिर्घमध्वानं युयं किमवसीदथ । तच्छ्रुत्वा मोहमगमद्ब्रह्मदत्तो नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: prasthitA dirghamadhvAnaM yuyaM kimavasIdatha | tachChrutvA mohamagamadbrahmadatto narAdhipaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सचिवश्चास्य पाञ्चालः पुण्डरीकश्च भारत । ततस्ते तत्सरः स्मृत्वा योगं तमुपलभ्य च
verses.transliteration: sachivashchAsya pA~nchAlaH puNDarIkashcha bhArata | tataste tatsaraH smR^itvA yogaM tamupalabhya cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणं विपुलैरर्थैर्भोगैश्च समयोजयन् । अभिषिच्य स्वराज्ये तु विष्वक्सेनमरिन्दमम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNaM vipulairarthairbhogaishcha samayojayan | abhiShichya svarAjye tu viShvaksenamarindamam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम ब्रह्मदत्तो हि सदारो वनमेव ह । प्राप्य योगं बलादेव गतिं प्राप सुदुर्लभाम्
verses.transliteration: jagAma brahmadatto hi sadAro vanameva ha | prApya yogaM balAdeva gatiM prApa sudurlabhAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीकोऽपि धर्मात्मा साङ्ख्ययोगमनुत्तमम् । प्राप्य योगगतिः सिद्धो विशुद्धस्तेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: puNDarIko.api dharmAtmA sA~Nkhyayogamanuttamam | prApya yogagatiH siddho vishuddhastena karmaNA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: क्रमं प्रणीय पाञ्चाल्यः शिक्षां चोत्पाद्य केवलाम् । योगाचार्यगतिं प्राप यशश्चाग्र्यं महातपाः
verses.transliteration: kramaM praNIya pA~nchAlyaH shikShAM chotpAdya kevalAm | yogAchAryagatiM prApa yashashchAgryaM mahAtapAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स राजान्तःपुरवृतो नन्दने मघवा इव । क्रीडित्वा सुचिरं तत्र सभार्यः स्वपुरं ययौ
verses.transliteration: sa rAjAntaHpuravR^ito nandane maghavA iva | krIDitvA suchiraM tatra sabhAryaH svapuraM yayau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शूरा ये सम्प्रपद्यन्ते अपुनर्भवकाङ्क्षिणः । पापं प्रणाशयन्त्वद्य तच्छम्भोः परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: shUrA ye samprapadyante apunarbhavakA~NkShiNaH | pApaM praNAshayantvadya tachChambhoH paramaM padam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शारीरे मानसे चैव पापे वाग्जे महामुने । कृते सम्यगिदं भक्त्या पठेच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: shArIre mAnase chaiva pApe vAgje mahAmune | kR^ite samyagidaM bhaktyA paThechChraddhAsamanvitaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः शिवनामानुकीर्तनात् । उच्चार्यमाण एतस्मिन्देवदेवस्य तस्य वै
verses.transliteration: muchyate sarvapApebhyaH shivanAmAnukIrtanAt | uchchAryamANa etasmindevadevasya tasya vai
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विलयं पापमायाति ह्यामभाण्डमिवाम्भसि । तस्मात्तत्सञ्चिते पापे समानान्तरमेव च
verses.transliteration: vilayaM pApamAyAti hyAmabhANDamivAmbhasi | tasmAttatsa~nchite pApe samAnAntarameva cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: जप्तव्यमेतत्पापस्य प्रशमाय महामुने । नरैः श्रद्धालुभिभूर्यः सर्वकामफलाप्तये
verses.transliteration: japtavyametatpApasya prashamAya mahAmune | naraiH shraddhAlubhibhUryaH sarvakAmaphalAptaye
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्ट्यर्थमिममध्यायं पठेदेनं शृणोति वा । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षं याति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: puShTyarthamimamadhyAyaM paThedenaM shR^iNoti vA | muchyate sarvapApebhyo mokShaM yAti na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अनूहो नाम तस्यासीत्पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः । तं विभ्राजः सुतं राज्ये स्थापयित्वा वनं ययौ
verses.transliteration: anUho nAma tasyAsItputraH paramadhArmikaH | taM vibhrAjaH sutaM rAjye sthApayitvA vanaM yayau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तपः कर्तुं समारेभे यत्र ते सहचारिणः । स वै तत्र निराहारो वायुभक्षो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: tapaH kartuM samArebhe yatra te sahachAriNaH | sa vai tatra nirAhAro vAyubhakSho mahAtapAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विभ्राजितं तेन वैभ्राजं नाम तद्वनम् । बभूव सुप्रसिद्धं हि योगसिद्धिप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: tato vibhrAjitaM tena vaibhrAjaM nAma tadvanam | babhUva suprasiddhaM hi yogasiddhipradAyakam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव ते हि शकुनाश्चत्वारो योगधर्मिणः । योगभ्रष्टास्त्रयश्चैव देहत्यागकृतोऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: tatraiva te hi shakunAshchatvAro yogadharmiNaH | yogabhraShTAstrayashchaiva dehatyAgakR^ito.abhavan
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: काम्पिल्ये नगरे ते तु ब्रह्मदत्तपुरोगमाः । जाताः सप्त महात्मानः सर्वे विगतकल्मषाः
verses.transliteration: kAmpilye nagare te tu brahmadattapurogamAH | jAtAH sapta mahAtmAnaH sarve vigatakalmaShAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स्मृतिमन्तोऽत्र चत्वारस्त्रयस्तु परिमोहिताः । स्वतन्त्रस्त्वणुहाज्जातो ब्रह्मदत्तो महौजसः
verses.transliteration: smR^itimanto.atra chatvArastrayastu parimohitAH | svatantrastvaNuhAjjAto brahmadatto mahaujasaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.४३. त्रिचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । व्यासपूजनप्रकारः । शौनक उवाच । आचार्यपूजनं ब्रूहि सूत व्यासगुरोऽधुना । ग्रन्थस्य श्रवणान्ते हि किं कर्तव्यं तदप्यहो
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.43\. trichatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | vyAsapUjanaprakAraH | shaunaka uvAcha | AchAryapUjanaM brUhi sUta vyAsaguro.adhunA | granthasya shravaNAnte hi kiM kartavyaM tadapyaho
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । पूजयेद्विधिवद्भक्त्याचार्यं श्रुत्वा कथां पराम् । ग्रन्थान्ते विधिवद्दद्यादाचार्याय प्रसन्नधीः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | pUjayedvidhivadbhaktyAchAryaM shrutvA kathAM parAm | granthAnte vidhivaddadyAdAchAryAya prasannadhIH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वक्तारमानम्य सम्पूज्य च यथाविधि । भूषणैर्हस्तकर्णानां वस्त्रैः सौम्यादिभिः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tato vaktAramAnamya sampUjya cha yathAvidhi | bhUShaNairhastakarNAnAM vastraiH saumyAdibhiH sudhIH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शिवपूजासमाप्तौ तु दद्याद्धेनुं सवत्सिकाम् । कृत्वासनं सुवर्णस्य पलमानस्य साम्बरम्
verses.transliteration: shivapUjAsamAptau tu dadyAddhenuM savatsikAm | kR^itvAsanaM suvarNasya palamAnasya sAmbaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रास्थाप्य शुभं ग्रन्थं लिखितं ललिताक्षरैः । आचार्याय सुधीर्दद्यान्मुक्तः स्याद्भवबन्धनैः
verses.transliteration: tatrAsthApya shubhaM granthaM likhitaM lalitAkSharaiH | AchAryAya sudhIrdadyAnmuktaH syAdbhavabandhanaiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामो गजो हयश्चापि यथाशक्त्यपराणि च । मुने सर्वाणि देयानि वाचकाय महात्मने
verses.transliteration: grAmo gajo hayashchApi yathAshaktyaparANi cha | mune sarvANi deyAni vAchakAya mahAtmane
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विधानसहितं सम्यक् श्रुतं हि सफलं स्मृतम् । पुराणं शौनकमुने सत्यमेवोदितं मया
verses.transliteration: vidhAnasahitaM samyak shrutaM hi saphalaM smR^itam | purANaM shaunakamune satyamevoditaM mayA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विधानयुक्तं तु शृणुयाद्भक्तितो मुने । पुराणं निगमार्थाढ्यं पुण्यदं हृदयं श्रुतेः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdvidhAnayuktaM tu shR^iNuyAdbhaktito mune | purANaM nigamArthADhyaM puNyadaM hR^idayaM shruteH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.४४. चतुश्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । व्यासोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् । मुनय ऊचुः । व्यासोत्पत्तिं महाबुद्धे ब्रूहि सूत दयानिधे । कृपया परया स्वामिन् कृतार्थान्नः कुरु प्रभो
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.44\. chatushchatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | vyAsotpattivarNanam | munaya UchuH | vyAsotpattiM mahAbuddhe brUhi sUta dayAnidhe | kR^ipayA parayA svAmin kR^itArthAnnaH kuru prabho
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहीतुकामः स मुनिर्दाशकन्यां मनोहराम् । दक्षिणेन करेणैतामस्पृशद्दक्षिणे करे
verses.transliteration: grahItukAmaH sa munirdAshakanyAM manoharAm | dakShiNena kareNaitAmaspR^ishaddakShiNe kare
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: महिमानं न ते वेदा विदामासुरुमापते । त्वमेव जगतः कर्ता धर्ता हर्ता तथैव च
verses.transliteration: mahimAnaM na te vedA vidAmAsurumApate | tvameva jagataH kartA dhartA hartA tathaiva cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमाद्यः सर्वदेवानां सच्चिदानन्द ईश्वरः । नामगोत्रे न वा ते स्तः सर्वज्ञोऽसि सदाशिव
verses.transliteration: tvamAdyaH sarvadevAnAM sachchidAnanda IshvaraH | nAmagotre na vA te staH sarvaj~no.asi sadAshiva
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव परमं ब्रह्म मायापाशनिवर्तकः । गुणत्रयैर्न लिप्तस्त्वं पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा
verses.transliteration: tvameva paramaM brahma mAyApAshanivartakaH | guNatrayairna liptastvaM padmapatramivAmbhasA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: न ते जन्म न वा शीलं न देशो न कुलं च ते । इत्थम्भूतोऽपीश्वरस्त्वं त्रिलोक्याः काममावहेः
verses.transliteration: na te janma na vA shIlaM na desho na kulaM cha te | itthambhUto.apIshvarastvaM trilokyAH kAmamAvaheH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: न ब्रह्मा न च लक्ष्मीशो न च सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः । न योगीन्द्रा विदुस्तत्त्वं यस्य तं त्वामुपास्महे
verses.transliteration: na brahmA na cha lakShmIsho na cha sendrA divaukasaH | na yogIndrA vidustattvaM yasya taM tvAmupAsmahe
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तः सर्वं त्वं हि सर्वं गौरीशस्त्वं पुरान्तकः । त्वं बालस्त्वं युवा वृद्धस्तं त्वां हृदि युनज्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration: tvattaH sarvaM tvaM hi sarvaM gaurIshastvaM purAntakaH | tvaM bAlastvaM yuvA vR^iddhastaM tvAM hR^idi yunajmyaham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्तस्मै महेशाय भक्तध्येयाय शम्भवे । पुराणपुरुषायाद्धा शङ्कराय परात्मने
verses.transliteration: namastasmai maheshAya bhaktadhyeyAya shambhave | purANapuruShAyAddhA sha~NkarAya parAtmane
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुत्वा क्षितौ यावद्दण्डवन्निपपात सः । तावत्स बालो हृष्टात्मा वेदव्यासमभाषत
verses.transliteration: iti stutvA kShitau yAvaddaNDavannipapAta saH | tAvatsa bAlo hR^iShTAtmA vedavyAsamabhAShata
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वरं वृणीष्व भो योगिन्यस्ते मनसि वर्तते । नादेयं विद्यते किञ्चिद्भक्ताधीनो यतोऽस्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration: varaM vR^iNIShva bho yoginyaste manasi vartate | nAdeyaM vidyate ki~nchidbhaktAdhIno yato.asmyaham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्थाय हृष्टात्मा मुनिर्व्यासो महातपाः । प्रत्यब्रवीत्किमज्ञातं सर्वज्ञस्य तव प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tata utthAya hR^iShTAtmA munirvyAso mahAtapAH | pratyabravItkimaj~nAtaM sarvaj~nasya tava prabho
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाच विशालाक्षी वचनं स्मितपूर्वकम् । किमिदं क्रियते कर्म वाचंयमविगर्हितम्
verses.transliteration: tamuvAcha vishAlAkShI vachanaM smitapUrvakam | kimidaM kriyate karma vAchaMyamavigarhitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान्तरात्मा भगवान् शर्वः सर्वप्रदो भवान् । याञ्चां प्रतिनियुङ्क्ते मां किमीशो दैन्यकारिणीम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAntarAtmA bhagavAn sharvaH sarvaprado bhavAn | yA~nchAM pratiniyu~Nkte mAM kimIsho dainyakAriNIm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य व्यासस्यामलचेतसः । शुचि स्मित्वा महादेवो बालरूपधरोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: iti shrutvA vachastasya vyAsasyAmalachetasaH | shuchi smitvA mahAdevo bAlarUpadharo.abravIt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: बाल उवाच । त्वया ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठ योऽभिलाषः कृतो हृदि । अचिरेणैव कालेन स भविष्यत्यसंशयः
verses.transliteration: bAla uvAcha | tvayA brahmavidAM shreShTha yo.abhilAShaH kR^ito hR^idi | achireNaiva kAlena sa bhaviShyatyasaMshayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कण्ठे स्थित्वा तव ब्रह्मन्नन्तर्याम्यहमीश्वरः । सेतिहासपुराणानि सम्यङ्निर्मापयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: kaNThe sthitvA tava brahmannantaryAmyahamIshvaraH | setihAsapurANAni samya~NnirmApayAmyaham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अभिलाषाष्टकं पुण्यं स्तोत्रमेतत्त्वयेरितम् । वर्षं त्रिकालं पठनात्कामदं शम्भुसद्मनि
verses.transliteration: abhilAShAShTakaM puNyaM stotrametattvayeritam | varShaM trikAlaM paThanAtkAmadaM shambhusadmani
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्स्तोत्रस्य पठनं विद्याबुद्धिविवर्धनम् । सर्वसम्पत्करं प्रोक्तं धर्मदं मोक्षदं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: etatstotrasya paThanaM vidyAbuddhivivardhanam | sarvasampatkaraM proktaM dharmadaM mokShadaM nR^iNAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरुत्थाय सुस्नातो लिङ्गमभ्यर्च्य शाङ्करम् । वर्षं पठन्निदं स्तोत्रं मूर्खोऽपि स्याद् बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: prAtarutthAya susnAto li~Ngamabhyarchya shA~Nkaram | varShaM paThannidaM stotraM mUrkho.api syAd bR^ihaspatiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेणापि नियमाल्लिङ्गसन्निधौ । वर्षं जप्तमिदं स्तोत्रं बुद्धिं विद्यां च वर्धयेत्
verses.transliteration: striyA vA puruSheNApi niyamAlli~Ngasannidhau | varShaM japtamidaM stotraM buddhiM vidyAM cha vardhayet
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा स महादेवो बालो लिङ्गे न्यलीयत । व्यासोऽपि मुञ्चन्नश्रूणि शिवप्रेमाकुलोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA sa mahAdevo bAlo li~Nge nyalIyata | vyAso.api mu~nchannashrUNi shivapremAkulo.abhavat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं लब्धवरो व्यासो महेशान्मध्यमेश्वरात् । अष्टादश पुराणानि प्रणिनाय स्वलीलया
verses.transliteration: evaM labdhavaro vyAso maheshAnmadhyameshvarAt | aShTAdasha purANAni praNinAya svalIlayA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठस्य कुले रम्ये त्वं जातोऽसि महामते । निषादजा त्वहं ब्रह्मन् कथं सङ्गो घटेत नौ
verses.transliteration: vasiShThasya kule ramye tvaM jAto.asi mahAmate | niShAdajA tvahaM brahman kathaM sa~Ngo ghaTeta nau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं पाद्मं वैष्णवं च शैवं भागवतं तथा । भविष्यं नारदीयं च मार्कण्डेयमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaM pAdmaM vaiShNavaM cha shaivaM bhAgavataM tathA | bhaviShyaM nAradIyaM cha mArkaNDeyamataH param
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं लैङ्गं वाराहमेव च । वामनाख्यं ततः कौर्मं मात्स्यं गारुडमेव च
verses.transliteration: AgneyaM brahmavaivartaM lai~NgaM vArAhameva cha | vAmanAkhyaM tataH kaurmaM mAtsyaM gAruDameva cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स्कान्दं तथैव ब्रह्माण्डाख्यं पुराणं च कीर्तितम् । यशस्यं पुण्यदं नॄणां श्रोतॄणां शाङ्करं यशः
verses.transliteration: skAndaM tathaiva brahmANDAkhyaM purANaM cha kIrtitam | yashasyaM puNyadaM nR^INAM shrotR^INAM shA~NkaraM yashaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । अष्टादशपुराणानां पूर्वं नामोदितं त्वया । कुरु निर्वचनं तेषामिदानीं वेदवित्तम
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | aShTAdashapurANAnAM pUrvaM nAmoditaM tvayA | kuru nirvachanaM teShAmidAnIM vedavittama
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । अयमेव कृतः प्रश्नस्तण्डिना ब्रह्मयोनिना । नन्दिकेश्वरमुद्दिश्य स यदाह ब्रवीमि तत्
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | ayameva kR^itaH prashnastaNDinA brahmayoninA | nandikeshvaramuddishya sa yadAha bravImi tat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच । यत्र वक्ता स्वयं तण्डिन् ब्रह्मा साक्षाच्चतुर्मुखः ॥ तस्माद् ब्राह्मं समाख्यातं पुराणं प्रथमं मुने
verses.transliteration: nandikeshvara uvAcha | yatra vaktA svayaM taNDin brahmA sAkShAchchaturmukhaH || tasmAd brAhmaM samAkhyAtaM purANaM prathamaM mune
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मकल्पस्य माहात्म्यं तत्र यस्यामुदाहृतम् । तस्मात्पाद्मं समाख्यातं पुराणं च द्वितीयकम्
verses.transliteration: padmakalpasya mAhAtmyaM tatra yasyAmudAhR^itam | tasmAtpAdmaM samAkhyAtaM purANaM cha dvitIyakam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पराशरकृतं यत्तु पुराणं विष्णुबोधकम् । तदेव व्यासकथितं पुत्रपित्रोरभेदतः
verses.transliteration: parAsharakR^itaM yattu purANaM viShNubodhakam | tadeva vyAsakathitaM putrapitrorabhedataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र पूर्वोत्तरे खण्डे शिवस्य चरितं बहु । शैवमेतत्पुराणं हि पुराणज्ञा वदन्ति च
verses.transliteration: yatra pUrvottare khaNDe shivasya charitaM bahu | shaivametatpurANaM hi purANaj~nA vadanti cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भगवत्याश्च दुर्गायाश्चरितं यत्र विद्यते । तत्तु भागवतं प्रोक्तं ननु देवीपुराणकम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavatyAshcha durgAyAshcharitaM yatra vidyate | tattu bhAgavataM proktaM nanu devIpurANakam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभं मानुषं जन्म ब्राह्मणत्वं विशेषतः । तत्रापि तापसत्वं च दुर्लभं मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: durlabhaM mAnuShaM janma brAhmaNatvaM visheShataH | tatrApi tApasatvaM cha durlabhaM munisattama
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नारदोक्तं पुराणं तु नारदीयं प्रचक्षते । यत्र वक्ताभवत्तण्डिन् मार्कण्डेयो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: nAradoktaM purANaM tu nAradIyaM prachakShate | yatra vaktAbhavattaNDin mArkaNDeyo mahAmuniH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयपुराणं हि तदाख्यातं च सप्तमम् । अग्नियोगात्तदाग्नेयं भविष्योक्तेर्भविष्यकम्
verses.transliteration: mArkaNDeyapurANaM hi tadAkhyAtaM cha saptamam | agniyogAttadAgneyaM bhaviShyokterbhaviShyakam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विवर्तनाद् ब्रह्मणस्तु ब्रह्मवैवर्तमुच्यते । लिङ्गस्य चरितोक्तत्वात्पुराणं लिङ्गमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: vivartanAd brahmaNastu brahmavaivartamuchyate | li~Ngasya charitoktatvAtpurANaM li~Ngamuchyate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वराहस्य च वाराहं पुराणं द्वादशं मुने । यत्र स्कन्दः स्वयं श्रोता वक्ता साक्षान्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: varAhasya cha vArAhaM purANaM dvAdashaM mune | yatra skandaH svayaM shrotA vaktA sAkShAnmaheshvaraH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तु स्कान्दं समाख्यातं वामनस्य तु वामनम् । कौर्मं कूर्मस्य चरितं मात्स्यं मत्स्येन कीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: tattu skAndaM samAkhyAtaM vAmanasya tu vAmanam | kaurmaM kUrmasya charitaM mAtsyaM matsyena kIrtitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: गरुडस्तु स्वयं वक्ता यत्तद् गारुडसंज्ञकम् । ब्रह्माण्डचरितोक्तत्वाद् ब्रह्माण्डं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: garuDastu svayaM vaktA yattad gAruDasa.nj~nakam | brahmANDacharitoktatvAd brahmANDaM parikIrtitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । अयमेव मयाऽकारि प्रश्नो व्यासाय धीमते । ततः सर्वपुराणानां मया निर्वचनं श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ayameva mayA.akAri prashno vyAsAya dhImate | tataH sarvapurANAnAM mayA nirvachanaM shrutam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं व्यासः समुत्पन्नः सत्यवत्यां पराशरात् । पुराणसंहिताश्चक्रे महाभारतमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: evaM vyAsaH samutpannaH satyavatyAM parAsharAt | purANasaMhitAshchakre mahAbhAratamuttamam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पराशरेण संयोगः पुनः शन्तनुना यथा । सत्यवत्या इव ब्रह्मन्नः संशयितुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: parAshareNa saMyogaH punaH shantanunA yathA | satyavatyA iva brahmannaH saMshayitumarhasi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सकारणेयमुत्पत्तिः कथिताश्चर्यकारिणी । महतां चरिते चैव गुणा ग्राह्या विचक्षणैः
verses.transliteration: sakAraNeyamutpattiH kathitAshcharyakAriNI | mahatAM charite chaiva guNA grAhyA vichakShaNaiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यया वपुषा वाचा कुलशीलेन चान्वितः । कामबाणवशं यातो महदाश्चर्यमत्र हि
verses.transliteration: vidyayA vapuShA vAchA kulashIlena chAnvitaH | kAmabANavashaM yAto mahadAshcharyamatra hi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इदं रहस्यं परमं यः शृणोति पठत्यपि । स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्त ऋषिलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: idaM rahasyaM paramaM yaH shR^iNoti paThatyapi | sa sarvapApanirmukta R^iShiloke mahIyate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तमप्यसत्कर्म कर्तुमेनं न कोऽपि ह । भुवि वारयितुं शक्तः शापभीत्यास्य योगिनः
verses.transliteration: pravR^ittamapyasatkarma kartumenaM na ko.api ha | bhuvi vArayituM shaktaH shApabhItyAsya yoginaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति सञ्चिन्त्य हृदये निजगाद महामुनिम् । तावद्धैर्यं कुरु स्वामिन्यावत्त्वां पारयामि न
verses.transliteration: iti sa~nchintya hR^idaye nijagAda mahAmunim | tAvaddhairyaM kuru svAminyAvattvAM pArayAmi na
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या योगिराजः पराशरः । तत्याज पाणिं तरसा सिन्धोः पारं गतः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasyA yogirAjaH parAsharaH | tatyAja pANiM tarasA sindhoH pAraM gataH punaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्जग्राह तां बालां मुनिंः कामप्रपीडितः । कम्पमाना तु सा बाला तमुवाच दयानिधिम्
verses.transliteration: punarjagrAha tAM bAlAM muniMH kAmaprapIDitaH | kampamAnA tu sA bAlA tamuvAcha dayAnidhim
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गन्धाहं मुनिश्रेष्ठ कृष्णवर्णा निषादजा । भवांस्तु परमोदारविचारो योगिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: durgandhAhaM munishreShTha kR^iShNavarNA niShAdajA | bhavAMstu paramodAravichAro yogisattamaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासस्य जननी प्रोक्ता नाम्ना सत्यवती शुभा । विवाहिता तु सा देवी राज्ञा शन्तनुना किल
verses.transliteration: vyAsasya jananI proktA nAmnA satyavatI shubhA | vivAhitA tu sA devI rAj~nA shantanunA kila
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नावयोर्घटते सङ्गो काचकाञ्चनयोरिव । तुल्यजात्याकृतिकयोः सङ्गः सौख्यप्रदो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: nAvayorghaTate sa~Ngo kAchakA~nchanayoriva | tulyajAtyAkR^itikayoH sa~NgaH saukhyaprado bhavet
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तेन तया तेन क्षणमात्रेण कामिनी । कृता योजनगन्धा तु रम्यरूपा मनोरमा
verses.transliteration: ityuktena tayA tena kShaNamAtreNa kAminI | kR^itA yojanagandhA tu ramyarUpA manoramA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्जग्राह तां बालां स मुनिः कामपीडितः । ग्रहीतुकामं तं दृष्ट्वा पुनः प्रोवाच वासवी
verses.transliteration: punarjagrAha tAM bAlAM sa muniH kAmapIDitaH | grahItukAmaM taM dR^iShTvA punaH provAcha vAsavI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ व्यवायः कर्तव्यो न दिवेति श्रुतिर्जगौ । दिवासङ्गे महान्दोषो निन्दा चापि दुरासदा
verses.transliteration: rAtrau vyavAyaH kartavyo na diveti shrutirjagau | divAsa~Nge mahAndoSho nindA chApi durAsadA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तावत्प्रतीक्षस्व यावद्भवति यामिनी । पश्यन्ति मानवाश्चात्र पिता मे च तटे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasmAttAvatpratIkShasva yAvadbhavati yAminI | pashyanti mAnavAshchAtra pitA me cha taTe sthitaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तयोक्तमिदमाकर्ण्य वचनं मुनिपुङ्गवः । नीहारं कल्पयामास सद्यः पुण्यबलेन वै
verses.transliteration: tayoktamidamAkarNya vachanaM munipu~NgavaH | nIhAraM kalpayAmAsa sadyaH puNyabalena vai
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नीहारे च समुत्पन्ने तमसा रात्रिसन्निभे । व्यवायचकिता बाला पुनः प्रोवाच तं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: nIhAre cha samutpanne tamasA rAtrisannibhe | vyavAyachakitA bAlA punaH provAcha taM munim
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: योगिन्नमोघवीर्यस्त्वं भुक्त्वा गन्तासि मां यदि । सगर्भा स्यां तदा स्वामिन्का गतिर्मे भवेदिति
verses.transliteration: yoginnamoghavIryastvaM bhuktvA gantAsi mAM yadi | sagarbhA syAM tadA svAminkA gatirme bhavediti
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कन्याव्रतं महाबुद्धे मम नष्टं भविष्यति । हसिष्यन्ति तदा लोकाः पितरं किं ब्रवीम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: kanyAvrataM mahAbuddhe mama naShTaM bhaviShyati | hasiShyanti tadA lokAH pitaraM kiM bravImyaham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पराशर उवाच । रम बाले मया सार्धं स्वच्छन्दं कामजै रसैः । स्वीयाभिलाषमाख्याहि पूरयाम्यधुना प्रिये
verses.transliteration: parAshara uvAcha | rama bAle mayA sArdhaM svachChandaM kAmajai rasaiH | svIyAbhilAShamAkhyAhi pUrayAmyadhunA priye
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां जातो महायोगी कथं व्यासः पराशरात् । सन्देहोऽत्र महाञ्जातस्तं भवाञ्छेत्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: tasyAM jAto mahAyogI kathaM vyAsaH parAsharAt | sandeho.atra mahA~njAtastaM bhavA~nChettumarhati
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मदाज्ञासत्यकरणान्नाम्ना सत्यवती भव । वन्दनीया तथाशेषैर्योगिभिस्त्रिदशैरपि
verses.transliteration: madAj~nAsatyakaraNAnnAmnA satyavatI bhava | vandanIyA tathAsheShairyogibhistridashairapi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवत्युवाच । जानते न पिता माता न वान्ये भुवि मानवाः । कन्याधर्मो न मे हन्याद्यदि स्वीकुरु मां तदा
verses.transliteration: satyavatyuvAcha | jAnate na pitA mAtA na vAnye bhuvi mAnavAH | kanyAdharmo na me hanyAdyadi svIkuru mAM tadA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रश्च त्वत्समो नाथ भवेदद्भुतशक्तिमान् । सौगन्ध्यं सर्वदाङ्गे मे तारुण्यं च नवं नवम्
verses.transliteration: putrashcha tvatsamo nAtha bhavedadbhutashaktimAn | saugandhyaM sarvadA~Nge me tAruNyaM cha navaM navam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पराशर उवाच । शृणु प्रिये तवाभीष्टं सर्वं पूर्णं भविष्यति । विष्ण्वंशसम्भवः पुत्रो भविता ते महायशाः
verses.transliteration: parAshara uvAcha | shR^iNu priye tavAbhIShTaM sarvaM pUrNaM bhaviShyati | viShNvaMshasambhavaH putro bhavitA te mahAyashAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: किञ्चिद्वै कारणं विद्धि यतोऽहं कामपीडितः । दृष्ट्वा चाप्सरसां रूपं नामुह्यन्मे मनः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: ki~nchidvai kAraNaM viddhi yato.ahaM kAmapIDitaH | dR^iShTvA chApsarasAM rUpaM nAmuhyanme manaH kvachit
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मीनगन्धां समालक्ष्य त्वां मोहवशगोऽभवम् । न बाले भालपट्टस्थो ब्रह्मलेखोऽन्यथा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mInagandhAM samAlakShya tvAM mohavashago.abhavam | na bAle bhAlapaTTastho brahmalekho.anyathA bhavet
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणकर्ता पुत्रस्ते वेदशाखाविभागकृत् । भविष्यति वरारोहे ख्यातकीर्तिर्जगत्त्रये
verses.transliteration: purANakartA putraste vedashAkhAvibhAgakR^it | bhaviShyati varArohe khyAtakIrtirjagattraye
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा तां सुरम्याङ्गीं भुक्त्वा योगविशारदः । वव्राज शीघ्रं यमुनाजले स्नात्वा महामुने
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA tAM suramyA~NgIM bhuktvA yogavishAradaH | vavrAja shIghraM yamunAjale snAtvA mahAmune
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सापि गर्भं दधाराशु द्वादशात्मसमप्रभम् । असूत सूर्यजाद्वीपे कामदेवमिवात्मजम्
verses.transliteration: sApi garbhaM dadhArAshu dvAdashAtmasamaprabham | asUta sUryajAdvIpe kAmadevamivAtmajam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वामे कमण्डलुं बिभ्रद्दक्षिणे दण्डमुत्तमम् । पिशङ्गीभिर्जटाभिश्च राजितो महसां चयः
verses.transliteration: vAme kamaNDaluM bibhraddakShiNe daNDamuttamam | pisha~NgIbhirjaTAbhishcha rAjito mahasAM chayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एकदा तीर्थयात्रायां व्रजन्योगी पराशरः । यदृच्छयागतो रम्यं यमुनायास्तटं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ekadA tIrthayAtrAyAM vrajanyogI parAsharaH | yadR^ichChayAgato ramyaM yamunAyAstaTaM shubham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: जातमात्रस्तु तेजस्वी मातरं प्रत्यभाषत । गच्छ मातर्यथाकामं गच्छाम्यहमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: jAtamAtrastu tejasvI mAtaraM pratyabhAShata | gachCha mAtaryathAkAmaM gachChAmyahamataH param
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मातर्यदा भवेत्कार्यं तव किञ्चिद् हृदीप्सितम् । संस्मृतश्चागमिष्यामि त्वदिच्छापूर्तिहेतवे
verses.transliteration: mAtaryadA bhavetkAryaM tava ki~nchid hR^idIpsitam | saMsmR^itashchAgamiShyAmi tvadichChApUrtihetave
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा मातृचरणावभिवाद्य तपोनिधिः । जगाम च तपः कर्तुं तीर्थं पापविशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA mAtR^icharaNAvabhivAdya taponidhiH | jagAma cha tapaH kartuM tIrthaM pApavishodhanam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सापि पित्रन्तिकं याता पुत्रस्नेहाकुला सती । स्मरन्ती चरितं सूनोर्वर्णयन्ती स्वभाग्यकम्
verses.transliteration: sApi pitrantikaM yAtA putrasnehAkulA satI | smarantI charitaM sUnorvarNayantI svabhAgyakam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपे जातो यतो बालस्तेन द्वैपायनोऽभवत् । वेदशाखाविभजनाद्वेदव्यासः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: dvIpe jAto yato bAlastena dvaipAyano.abhavat | vedashAkhAvibhajanAdvedavyAsaH prakIrtitaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थराजं प्रथमतो धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम् । नैमिषं च कुरुक्षेत्रं गङ्गाद्वारमवन्तिकाम्
verses.transliteration: tIrtharAjaM prathamato dharmakAmArthamokShadam | naimiShaM cha kurukShetraM ga~NgAdvAramavantikAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अयोध्यां मथुरां चैव द्वारकाममरावतीम् । सरस्वतीं सिन्धुसङ्गं गङ्गासागरसङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: ayodhyAM mathurAM chaiva dvArakAmamarAvatIm | sarasvatIM sindhusa~NgaM ga~NgAsAgarasa~Ngamam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: काञ्चीं च त्र्यम्बकं चापि सप्तगोदावरीतटम् । कालञ्जरं प्रभासं च तथा बदरिकाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: kA~nchIM cha tryambakaM chApi saptagodAvarItaTam | kAla~njaraM prabhAsaM cha tathA badarikAshramam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: महालयं तथोङ्कारक्षेत्रं वै पुरुषोत्तमम् । गोकर्णं भृगुकच्छं च भृगुतुङ्गं च पुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: mahAlayaM tatho~NkArakShetraM vai puruShottamam | gokarNaM bhR^igukachChaM cha bhR^igutu~NgaM cha puShkaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीपर्वतादितीर्थानि धारातीर्थं तथैव च । गत्वावगाह्य विधिना चचार परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: shrIparvatAditIrthAni dhArAtIrthaM tathaiva cha | gatvAvagAhya vidhinA chachAra paramaM tapaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: निषादमाह धर्मात्मा कुर्वन्तं भोजनं तदा । नयस्व यमुनापारं जलयानेन मामरम्
verses.transliteration: niShAdamAha dharmAtmA kurvantaM bhojanaM tadA | nayasva yamunApAraM jalayAnena mAmaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तीर्थान्यनेकानि नानादेशस्थितानि ह । पर्यटन्कालिकासूनुः प्रापद्वाराणसीं पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: evaM tIrthAnyanekAni nAnAdeshasthitAni ha | paryaTankAlikAsUnuH prApadvArANasIM purIm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र विश्वेश्वरः साक्षादन्नपूर्णा महेश्वरी । भक्तानाममृतं दातुं विराजेते कृपानिधी
verses.transliteration: yatra vishveshvaraH sAkShAdannapUrNA maheshvarI | bhaktAnAmamR^itaM dAtuM virAjete kR^ipAnidhI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्य वाराणसीतीर्थं दृष्ट्वाथ मणिकर्णिकाम् । कोटिजन्मार्जितं पापं तत्याज स मुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: prApya vArANasItIrthaM dR^iShTvAtha maNikarNikAm | koTijanmArjitaM pApaM tatyAja sa munIshvaraH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा लिङ्गानि सर्वाणि विश्वेशप्रमुखानि च । स्नात्वा सर्वेषु कुण्डेषु वापीकूपसरःसु च
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA li~NgAni sarvANi vishveshapramukhAni cha | snAtvA sarveShu kuNDeShu vApIkUpasaraHsu cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डनायकमुख्यांश्च गणान्स्तुत्वा प्रयत्नतः । आदिकेशवमुख्यांश्च केशवान्परितोष्य च
verses.transliteration: daNDanAyakamukhyAMshcha gaNAnstutvA prayatnataH | AdikeshavamukhyAMshcha keshavAnparitoShya cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: लोलार्कमुख्यसूर्यांश्च प्रणम्य च पुनःपुनः । कृत्वा पिण्डप्रदानानि सर्वतीर्थेष्वतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: lolArkamukhyasUryAMshcha praNamya cha punaHpunaH | kR^itvA piNDapradAnAni sarvatIrtheShvatandritaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयामास पुण्यात्मा लिङ्गं व्यासेश्वराभिधम् । यद्दर्शनाद्भवेद्विप्रा नरो विद्यासु वाक्पतिः
verses.transliteration: sthApayAmAsa puNyAtmA li~NgaM vyAseshvarAbhidham | yaddarshanAdbhavedviprA naro vidyAsu vAkpatiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गान्यभ्यर्च्य विश्वेशप्रमुखानि सुभक्तितः । असकृच्चिन्तयामास किं लिङ्गं क्षिप्रसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: li~NgAnyabhyarchya vishveshapramukhAni subhaktitaH | asakR^ichchintayAmAsa kiM li~NgaM kShiprasiddhidam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यमाराध्य महादेवं विद्याः सर्वा लभेमहि । पुराणकर्तृताशक्तिर्ममास्तु यदनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: yamArAdhya mahAdevaM vidyAH sarvA labhemahi | purANakartR^itAshaktirmamAstu yadanugrahAt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो मुनिना तेन निषादः स्वसुतां जगौ । मत्स्यगन्धाममुं बाले पारं नावा नय द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: ityukto muninA tena niShAdaH svasutAM jagau | matsyagandhAmamuM bAle pAraM nAvA naya drutam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमदोङ्कारनाथं वा कृत्तिवासेश्वरं किमु । केदारेशं तु कामेशं चन्द्रेशं वा त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: shrImado~NkAranAthaM vA kR^ittivAseshvaraM kimu | kedAreshaM tu kAmeshaM chandreshaM vA trilochanam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कालेशं वृद्धकालेशं कलशेश्वरमेव वा । ज्येष्ठेशं जम्बुकेशं वा जैगीषव्येश्वरं तु वा
verses.transliteration: kAleshaM vR^iddhakAleshaM kalasheshvarameva vA | jyeShTheshaM jambukeshaM vA jaigIShavyeshvaraM tu vA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दशाश्वमेधमीशानं द्रुमचण्डेशमेव वा । दृक्केशं गरुडेशं वा गोकर्णेशं गणेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dashAshvamedhamIshAnaM drumachaNDeshameva vA | dR^ikkeshaM garuDeshaM vA gokarNeshaM gaNeshvaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नवदनेशं वा धर्मेशं तारकेश्वरम् । नन्दिकेशं निवासेशं पत्रीशं प्रीतिकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: prasannavadaneshaM vA dharmeshaM tArakeshvaram | nandikeshaM nivAseshaM patrIshaM prItikeshvaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतेशं पशुपतिं हाटकेश्वरमेव वा । बृहस्पतीश्वरं वाथ तिलभाण्डेशमेव वा
verses.transliteration: parvateshaM pashupatiM hATakeshvarameva vA | bR^ihaspatIshvaraM vAtha tilabhANDeshameva vA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भारभूतेश्वरं किं वा महालक्ष्मीश्वरं तु वा । मरुतेशं तु मोक्षेशं गङ्गेशं नर्मदेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: bhArabhUteshvaraM kiM vA mahAlakShmIshvaraM tu vA | maruteshaM tu mokSheshaM ga~NgeshaM narmadeshvaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णेशं परमेशानं रत्नेश्वरमथापि वा । यामुनेशं लाङ्गलीशं श्रीमद्विश्वेश्वरं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: kR^iShNeshaM parameshAnaM ratneshvaramathApi vA | yAmuneshaM lA~NgalIshaM shrImadvishveshvaraM vibhum
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्तेश्वरं वाथ विशालाक्षीशमेव वा । व्याघ्रेश्वरं वराहेशं विद्येश्वरमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: avimukteshvaraM vAtha vishAlAkShIshameva vA | vyAghreshvaraM varAheshaM vidyeshvaramathApi vA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणेशं विधीशं वा हरिकेशेश्वरं तु वा । भवानीशं कपर्दीशं कन्दुकेशमजेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: varuNeshaM vidhIshaM vA harikesheshvaraM tu vA | bhavAnIshaM kapardIshaM kandukeshamajeshvaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मेश्वरं वाथ वीरेश्वरमथापि वा । नादेशं कपिलेशं च भुवनेश्वरमेव वा
verses.transliteration: vishvakarmeshvaraM vAtha vIreshvaramathApi vA | nAdeshaM kapileshaM cha bhuvaneshvarameva vA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तापसोऽयं महाभागे दृश्यन्तीगर्भसम्भवः । तितीर्षुरस्ति धर्माब्धिश्चतुराम्नायपारगः
verses.transliteration: tApaso.ayaM mahAbhAge dR^ishyantIgarbhasambhavaH | titIrShurasti dharmAbdhishchaturAmnAyapAragaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वाष्कुलीशं महादेवं सिद्धीश्वरमथापि वा । विश्वेदेवेश्वरं वीरभद्रेशं भैरवेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vAShkulIshaM mahAdevaM siddhIshvaramathApi vA | vishvedeveshvaraM vIrabhadreshaM bhairaveshvaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतेशं सतीशं वा पार्वतीश्वरमेव वा । सिद्धेश्वरं मतङ्गेशं भूतीश्वरमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: amR^iteshaM satIshaM vA pArvatIshvarameva vA | siddheshvaraM mata~NgeshaM bhUtIshvaramathApi vA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आषाढीशं प्रकाशेशं कोटिरुद्रेश्वरं तथा । मदालसेश्वरं चैव तिलपर्णेश्वरं किमु
verses.transliteration: AShADhIshaM prakAsheshaM koTirudreshvaraM tathA | madAlaseshvaraM chaiva tilaparNeshvaraM kimu
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: किं वा हिरण्यगर्भेशं किं वा श्रीमध्यमेश्वरम् । इत्यादि कोटिलिङ्गानां मध्येऽहं किमुपाश्रये
verses.transliteration: kiM vA hiraNyagarbheshaM kiM vA shrImadhyameshvaram | ityAdi koTili~NgAnAM madhye.ahaM kimupAshraye
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति चिन्तातुरो व्यासः शिवभक्तिरतात्मवान् । क्षणं विचारयामास ध्यानसुस्थिरचेतसा
verses.transliteration: iti chintAturo vyAsaH shivabhaktiratAtmavAn | kShaNaM vichArayAmAsa dhyAnasusthirachetasA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आं ज्ञातं विस्मृतं तावन्निष्पन्नो मे मनोरथः । सिद्धैः सम्पूजितं लिङ्गं धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम्
verses.transliteration: AM j~nAtaM vismR^itaM tAvanniShpanno me manorathaH | siddhaiH sampUjitaM li~NgaM dharmakAmArthamokShadam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनात्स्पर्शनाद्यस्य चेतो निर्मलतामियात् । उद्घाटितं सदैवास्ति द्वारं स्वर्गस्य यत्र हि
verses.transliteration: darshanAtsparshanAdyasya cheto nirmalatAmiyAt | udghATitaM sadaivAsti dvAraM svargasya yatra hi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्ते महाक्षेत्रे सिद्धक्षेत्रे हि तत्परम् । यत्रास्ते परमं लिङ्गं मध्यमेश्वरसंज्ञकम्
verses.transliteration: avimukte mahAkShetre siddhakShetre hi tatparam | yatrAste paramaM li~NgaM madhyameshvarasa.nj~nakam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: न मध्यमेश्वरादन्याल्लिङ्गं काश्यां हि विद्यते । यद्दर्शनार्थमायान्ति देवाः पर्वणि पर्वणि
verses.transliteration: na madhyameshvarAdanyAlli~NgaM kAshyAM hi vidyate | yaddarshanArthamAyAnti devAH parvaNi parvaNi
