verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अतः सेव्यो महादेवो मध्यमेश्वरसंज्ञकः । अस्याराधनतो विप्रा बहवः सिद्धिमागताः
verses.transliteration: ataH sevyo mahAdevo madhyameshvarasa.nj~nakaH | asyArAdhanato viprA bahavaH siddhimAgatAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति विज्ञापिता पित्रा मत्स्यगन्धा महामुनिम् । संवाहयति नौकायामासीनं सूर्यरोचिषम्
verses.transliteration: iti vij~nApitA pitrA matsyagandhA mahAmunim | saMvAhayati naukAyAmAsInaM sUryarochiSham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यः प्रधानतया काश्यां मध्ये तिष्ठति शङ्करः । स्वपुरीजन सौख्यार्थमतोऽसौ मध्यमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yaH pradhAnatayA kAshyAM madhye tiShThati sha~NkaraH | svapurIjana saukhyArthamato.asau madhyameshvaraH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तुम्बुरुर्नाम गन्धर्वो देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा । अमुमाराध्य सम्पन्नो गानविद्याविशारदौ
verses.transliteration: tumbururnAma gandharvo devarShirnAradastathA | amumArAdhya sampanno gAnavidyAvishAradau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अमुमेव समाराध्य विष्णुर्मोक्षप्रदोऽभवत् । ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च सृष्टिपालकहारकाः
verses.transliteration: amumeva samArAdhya viShNurmokShaprado.abhavat | brahmA viShNushcha rudrashcha sR^iShTipAlakahArakAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: धनाधीशः कुबेरोऽपि वामदेवो हि शैवराट् । खट्वाङ्गो नाम भूपालोऽनपत्योऽपत्यवानभूत्
verses.transliteration: dhanAdhIshaH kubero.api vAmadevo hi shaivarAT | khaTvA~Ngo nAma bhUpAlo.anapatyo.apatyavAnabhUt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सराश्चन्द्रभामाख्या नृत्यन्ती निजभावतः । सदेहा कोकिलालापा लिङ्गमध्ये लयं गता
verses.transliteration: apsarAshchandrabhAmAkhyA nR^ityantI nijabhAvataH | sadehA kokilAlApA li~Ngamadhye layaM gatA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकरो गोपिकासूनुः सेवित्वा मध्यमेश्वरम् । गाणपत्यं समालेभे शिवस्य करुणात्मनः
verses.transliteration: shrIkaro gopikAsUnuH sevitvA madhyameshvaram | gANapatyaM samAlebhe shivasya karuNAtmanaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भार्गवो गीष्पतिश्चोभौ देवौ दैत्यसुरार्चितौ । विद्यापारङ्गतौ जातौ प्रसादान्मध्यमेशितुः
verses.transliteration: bhArgavo gIShpatishchobhau devau daityasurArchitau | vidyApAra~Ngatau jAtau prasAdAnmadhyameshituH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अहमप्यत्र सम्पूज्य मध्यमेश्वरमीश्वरम् । पुराणकर्तृताशक्तिं प्राप्स्यामि तरसा ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: ahamapyatra sampUjya madhyameshvaramIshvaram | purANakartR^itAshaktiM prApsyAmi tarasA dhruvam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति कृत्वा मतिं धीरो व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः । भागीरथ्यम्भसि स्नात्वा जग्राह नियमं व्रती
verses.transliteration: iti kR^itvA matiM dhIro vyAsaH satyavatIsutaH | bhAgIrathyambhasi snAtvA jagrAha niyamaM vratI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित्पर्णाशनो भूत्त्वा फलशाकाशनः क्वचित् । वातभुग्जलभुक् क्वापि क्वचिन्निरशनव्रती
verses.transliteration: kvachitparNAshano bhUttvA phalashAkAshanaH kvachit | vAtabhugjalabhuk kvApi kvachinnirashanavratI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कालयोगान्महायोगी तस्यां कामातुरोऽभवत् । दृष्ट्वा योऽप्सरसां रूपं न कदापि विमोहितः
verses.transliteration: kAlayogAnmahAyogI tasyAM kAmAturo.abhavat | dR^iShTvA yo.apsarasAM rUpaM na kadApi vimohitaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादिनियमैर्योगी त्रिकालं मध्यमेश्वरम् । पूजयामास धर्मात्मा नानावृक्षोद्भवैः फलैः
verses.transliteration: ityAdiniyamairyogI trikAlaM madhyameshvaram | pUjayAmAsa dharmAtmA nAnAvR^ikShodbhavaiH phalaiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं बहुतिथे काले व्यतीते कालिकासुतः । स्नात्वा त्रिपथगातोये यावदायाति स प्रगे
verses.transliteration: itthaM bahutithe kAle vyatIte kAlikAsutaH | snAtvA tripathagAtoye yAvadAyAti sa prage
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मध्यमेश्वरमीशानं भक्ताभीष्टवरप्रदम् । तावद्ददर्श पुण्यात्मा मध्ये लिङ्गं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: madhyameshvaramIshAnaM bhaktAbhIShTavarapradam | tAvaddadarsha puNyAtmA madhye li~NgaM maheshvaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: उमाभूषितवामाङ्गं व्याघ्रचर्मोत्तरीयकम् । जटाजूटचलद्गङ्गातरङ्गैश्चारुविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: umAbhUShitavAmA~NgaM vyAghracharmottarIyakam | jaTAjUTachaladga~NgAtara~NgaishchAruvigraham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नत्वा विनायकान्सर्वान्गौरीः सर्वाः प्रणम्य च । सम्पूज्य कालराजं च भैरवं पापभक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: natvA vinAyakAnsarvAngaurIH sarvAH praNamya cha | sampUjya kAlarAjaM cha bhairavaM pApabhakShaNam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: लसच्छारदबालेन्दुचन्द्रिकाचन्द्रितालकम् । भस्मोद्धूलितसर्वाङ्गं कर्पूरार्जुनविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: lasachChAradabAlenduchandrikAchandritAlakam | bhasmoddhUlitasarvA~NgaM karpUrArjunavigraham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णान्तायतनेत्रं च विद्रुमारुणदच्छदम् । पञ्चवर्षाकृतिं बालं बालकोचितभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: karNAntAyatanetraM cha vidrumAruNadachChadam | pa~nchavarShAkR^itiM bAlaM bAlakochitabhUShaNam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दधानं कोटिकन्दर्पदर्पहानिं तनुद्युतिम् । नग्रं प्रहसितास्याब्जं गायन्तं साम लीलया
verses.transliteration: dadhAnaM koTikandarpadarpahAniM tanudyutim | nagraM prahasitAsyAbjaM gAyantaM sAma lIlayA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: करुणापारपाथोधिं भक्तवत्सलनामकम् । आशुतोषमुमाकान्तं प्रसादसुमुखं हरम्
verses.transliteration: karuNApArapAthodhiM bhaktavatsalanAmakam | AshutoShamumAkAntaM prasAdasumukhaM haram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: समालोक्य स्तुतिं चक्रे प्रेमगद्गदया गिरा । योगिनामप्यगम्यं तं दीनबन्धुं चिदात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: samAlokya stutiM chakre premagadgadayA girA | yoginAmapyagamyaM taM dInabandhuM chidAtmakam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वेदव्यास उवाच । देवदेव महाभाग शरणागतवत्सल । वाङ्मनःकर्मदुष्प्राप योगिनामप्यगोचर
verses.transliteration: vedavyAsa uvAcha | devadeva mahAbhAga sharaNAgatavatsala | vA~NmanaHkarmaduShprApa yoginAmapyagochara
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.४५. पञ्चचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । महाकालिकावतारवर्णनम् । मुनय ऊचुः । श्रुता शम्भोः कथा रम्या नानाख्यानसमन्विता । नानावतारसंयुक्ता भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.45\. pa~nchachatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | mahAkAlikAvatAravarNanam | munaya UchuH | shrutA shambhoH kathA ramyA nAnAkhyAnasamanvitA | nAnAvatArasaMyuktA bhuktimuktipradA nR^iNAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: न भजन्ति महादेवीं करुणारससागराम् । अन्धकूपे पतन्त्येते घोरे संसाररूपिणि
verses.transliteration: na bhajanti mahAdevIM karuNArasasAgarAm | andhakUpe patantyete ghore saMsArarUpiNi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गां विहाय तृप्त्यर्थं मरुवारि यथा व्रजेत् । विहाय देवीं तद्भिन्नं तथा देवान्तरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAM vihAya tR^iptyarthaM maruvAri yathA vrajet | vihAya devIM tadbhinnaM tathA devAntaraM vrajet
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याः स्मरणमात्रेण पुरुषार्थचतुष्टयम् । अनायासेन लभते कस्त्यजेत्तां नरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: yasyAH smaraNamAtreNa puruShArthachatuShTayam | anAyAsena labhate kastyajettAM narottamaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पृष्टः पुरा मेधाः सुरथेन महात्मना । यदुक्तं मेधसा पूर्वं तच्छृणुष्व वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: etatpR^iShTaH purA medhAH surathena mahAtmanA | yaduktaM medhasA pUrvaM tachChR^iNuShva vadAmi te
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे पूर्वं विरथो नाम पार्थिवः । सुरथस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभून्महाबलपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: svArochiShe.antare pUrvaM viratho nAma pArthivaH | surathastasya putro.abhUnmahAbalaparAkramaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दानशौण्डः सत्यवादी स्वधर्मकुशलः कृती । देवीभक्तो दयासिन्धुः प्रजानां परिपालकः
verses.transliteration: dAnashauNDaH satyavAdI svadharmakushalaH kR^itI | devIbhakto dayAsindhuH prajAnAM paripAlakaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीं शासतस्तस्य पाकशासनतेजसः । बभूवुर्नव ये भूपाः पृथ्वीग्रहणतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: pR^ithivIM shAsatastasya pAkashAsanatejasaH | babhUvurnava ye bhUpAH pR^ithvIgrahaNatatparAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कोलानाम्नीं राजधानीं रुरुधुस्तस्य भूपतेः । तैः समं तुमुलं युद्धं समपद्यत दारुणम्
verses.transliteration: kolAnAmnIM rAjadhAnIM rurudhustasya bhUpateH | taiH samaM tumulaM yuddhaM samapadyata dAruNam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: युद्धे स निर्जितो भूपः प्रबलैस्तैर्द्विषद्गणैः । उज्जासितश्च कोलाया हृत्वा राज्यमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yuddhe sa nirjito bhUpaH prabalaistairdviShadgaNaiH | ujjAsitashcha kolAyA hR^itvA rAjyamasheShataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स राजा स्वपुरीमेत्याकरोद्राज्यं स्वमन्त्रिभिः । तत्रापि च महापक्षैर्विपक्षैः स पराजितः
verses.transliteration: sa rAjA svapurImetyAkarodrAjyaM svamantribhiH | tatrApi cha mahApakShairvipakShaiH sa parAjitaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामस्त्वत्तो ब्रह्मविदांवर । चरित्रं जगदम्बाया भगवत्या मनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: idAnIM shrotumichChAmastvatto brahmavidAMvara | charitraM jagadambAyA bhagavatyA manoharam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दैवाच्छत्रुत्वमापन्नैरमात्यप्रमुखैर्गणैः । कोशस्थितं च यद्वित्तं तत्सर्वं चात्मसात्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: daivAchChatrutvamApannairamAtyapramukhairgaNaiH | koshasthitaM cha yadvittaM tatsarvaM chAtmasAtkR^itam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स निर्गतो राजा नगरान्मृगयाछलात् । असहायोऽश्वमारुह्य जगाम गहनं वनम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa nirgato rAjA nagarAnmR^igayAChalAt | asahAyo.ashvamAruhya jagAma gahanaM vanam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इतस्ततस्तत्र गच्छन्राजा मुनिवराश्रमम् । ददर्श कुसुमारामभ्राजितं सर्वतोदिशम्
verses.transliteration: itastatastatra gachChanrAjA munivarAshramam | dadarsha kusumArAmabhrAjitaM sarvatodisham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वेदध्वनिसमाकीर्णं शान्तजन्तुसमाश्रितम् । शिष्यैः प्रशिष्यैस्तच्छिष्यैः समन्तात्परिवेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: vedadhvanisamAkIrNaM shAntajantusamAshritam | shiShyaiH prashiShyaistachChiShyaiH samantAtpariveShTitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रादयो महावीर्या अल्पवीर्यान्महामते । तदाश्रमे न बाधन्ते द्विजवर्यप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: vyAghrAdayo mahAvIryA alpavIryAnmahAmate | tadAshrame na bAdhante dvijavaryaprabhAvataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: उवास तत्र नृपतिर्महाकारुणिको बुधः । सत्कृतो मुनिनाथेन सुवचो भोजनासनैः
verses.transliteration: uvAsa tatra nR^ipatirmahAkAruNiko budhaH | satkR^ito muninAthena suvacho bhojanAsanaiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एकदा स महाराजश्चिन्तामाप दुरत्ययाम् । अहो मे हीनभाग्यस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्हीनतेजसः
verses.transliteration: ekadA sa mahArAjashchintAmApa duratyayAm | aho me hInabhAgyasya durbuddherhInatejasaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: हृतं राज्यमशेषेण शत्रुवर्गैर्मदोद्धतैः । मत्पूर्वै रक्षितं राज्यं शत्रुभिर्भुज्यतेऽधुना
verses.transliteration: hR^itaM rAjyamasheSheNa shatruvargairmadoddhataiH | matpUrvai rakShitaM rAjyaM shatrubhirbhujyate.adhunA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मादृशश्चैत्रवंशेऽस्मिन्न कोऽप्यासीन्महीपतिः । किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि कथं राज्यं लभेय हि
verses.transliteration: mAdR^ishashchaitravaMshe.asminna ko.apyAsInmahIpatiH | kiM karomi kva gachChAmi kathaM rAjyaM labheya hi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अमात्या मन्त्रिणश्चैव मामका ये सनातनाः । न जाने कं च नृपतिं समासाद्याधुनासते
verses.transliteration: amAtyA mantriNashchaiva mAmakA ye sanAtanAH | na jAne kaM cha nR^ipatiM samAsAdyAdhunAsate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: परब्रह्ममहेशस्य शक्तिराद्या सनातनी । उमा या समभिख्याता त्रैलोक्यजननी परा
verses.transliteration: parabrahmamaheshasya shaktirAdyA sanAtanI | umA yA samabhikhyAtA trailokyajananI parA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विनाश्य राज्यमधुना न जाने कां गतिं गताः । रणभूमिमहोत्साहा अरिवर्गनिकर्तनाः
verses.transliteration: vinAshya rAjyamadhunA na jAne kAM gatiM gatAH | raNabhUmimahotsAhA arivarganikartanAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मामका ये महाशूरा नृपमन्यं भजन्ति ते । पर्वताभा गजा अश्वा वातवद्वेगगामिनः
verses.transliteration: mAmakA ye mahAshUrA nR^ipamanyaM bhajanti te | parvatAbhA gajA ashvA vAtavadvegagAminaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वपूर्वार्जितः कोशः पाल्यते तैर्न वाधुना । एवं मोहवशं यातो राजा परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: pUrvapUrvArjitaH koshaH pAlyate tairna vAdhunA | evaM mohavashaM yAto rAjA paramadhArmikaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र वैश्यः कश्चित्समागतः । राजा पप्रच्छ कस्त्वं भोः किमर्थमिह चागतः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra vaishyaH kashchitsamAgataH | rAjA paprachCha kastvaM bhoH kimarthamiha chAgataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्मना लक्ष्यसे कस्मादेतन्मे ब्रूहि साम्प्रतम् । इत्याकर्ण्य वचो रम्यं नरपालेन भाषितम्
verses.transliteration: durmanA lakShyase kasmAdetanme brUhi sAmpratam | ityAkarNya vacho ramyaM narapAlena bhAShitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दृग्भ्यां विमुञ्चन्नश्रूणि समाधिर्वैश्यपुङ्गवः । प्रत्युवाच महीपालं प्रणयावनतां गिरम्
verses.transliteration: dR^igbhyAM vimu~nchannashrUNi samAdhirvaishyapu~NgavaH | pratyuvAcha mahIpAlaM praNayAvanatAM giram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्य उवाच । समाधिर्नाम वैश्योऽहं धनिवंशसमुद्भवः । पुत्रदारादिभिस्त्यक्तो धनलोभान्महीपते
verses.transliteration: vaishya uvAcha | samAdhirnAma vaishyo.ahaM dhanivaMshasamudbhavaH | putradArAdibhistyakto dhanalobhAnmahIpate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वनमभ्यागतो राजन्दुःखितः स्वेन कर्मणा । सोऽहं पुत्रप्रपौत्राणां कलत्राणां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vanamabhyAgato rAjanduHkhitaH svena karmaNA | so.ahaM putraprapautrANAM kalatrANAM tathaiva cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातृणां भ्रातृपुत्राणां परेषां सुहृदां तथा । न वेद्मि कुशलं सम्यक् करुणासागर प्रभो
verses.transliteration: bhrAtR^iNAM bhrAtR^iputrANAM pareShAM suhR^idAM tathA | na vedmi kushalaM samyak karuNAsAgara prabho
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच । निष्कासितो यैः पुत्राद्यैर्दुर्वृत्तैर्धनगर्धिभिः । तेषु किं भवता प्रीतिः क्रियते मूर्खजन्तुवत्
verses.transliteration: rAjovAcha | niShkAsito yaiH putrAdyairdurvR^ittairdhanagardhibhiH | teShu kiM bhavatA prItiH kriyate mUrkhajantuvat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सती हैमवती तस्या अवतारद्वयं श्रुतम् । अपरानवतारांस्त्वं ब्रूहि सूत महामते
verses.transliteration: satI haimavatI tasyA avatAradvayaM shrutam | aparAnavatArAMstvaM brUhi sUta mahAmate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्य उवाच । सम्यगुक्तं त्वया राजन्वचः सारार्थबृंहितम् । तथापि स्नेहपाशेन मोह्यतेऽतीव मे मनः
verses.transliteration: vaishya uvAcha | samyaguktaM tvayA rAjanvachaH sArArthabR^iMhitam | tathApi snehapAshena mohyate.atIva me manaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं मोहाकुलौ वैश्यपार्थिवौ मुनिसत्तम । जग्मतुर्मुनिवर्यस्य मेधसः सन्निधिं तदा
verses.transliteration: evaM mohAkulau vaishyapArthivau munisattama | jagmaturmunivaryasya medhasaH sannidhiM tadA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स वैश्यराजसहितो नरराजः प्रतापवान् । प्रणनाम महावीरः शिरसा योगिनां वरम्
verses.transliteration: sa vaishyarAjasahito nararAjaH pratApavAn | praNanAma mahAvIraH shirasA yoginAM varam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: बद्ध्वाञ्जलिमिमां वाचमुवाच नृपतिर्मुनिम् । भगवन्नावयोर्मोहं छेत्तुमर्हसि साम्प्रतम्
verses.transliteration: baddhvA~njalimimAM vAchamuvAcha nR^ipatirmunim | bhagavannAvayormohaM Chettumarhasi sAmpratam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अहं राजश्रिया त्यक्तो गहनं वनमाश्रितः । तथापि हृतराज्यस्य तोषो नैवाभिजायते
verses.transliteration: ahaM rAjashriyA tyakto gahanaM vanamAshritaH | tathApi hR^itarAjyasya toSho naivAbhijAyate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अयं च वैश्यः स्वजनैर्दाराद्यैर्निष्कृतो गृहात् । तथाप्येतस्य ममता न निवृत्तिं समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: ayaM cha vaishyaH svajanairdArAdyairniShkR^ito gR^ihAt | tathApyetasya mamatA na nivR^ittiM samashnute
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र कारणं ब्रूहि ज्ञानिनोरपि नो मनः । मोहेन व्याकुलं जातं महत्येषा हि मूर्खता
verses.transliteration: kimatra kAraNaM brUhi j~nAninorapi no manaH | mohena vyAkulaM jAtaM mahatyeShA hi mUrkhatA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच । महामाया जगद्धात्री शक्तिरूपा सनातनी । सा मोहयति सर्वेषां समाकृष्य मनांसि वै
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha | mahAmAyA jagaddhAtrI shaktirUpA sanAtanI | sA mohayati sarveShAM samAkR^iShya manAMsi vai
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादयः सुराः सर्वे यन्मायामोहिताः प्रभो । न जानन्ति परं तत्त्वं मनुष्याणां च का कथा
verses.transliteration: brahmAdayaH surAH sarve yanmAyAmohitAH prabho | na jAnanti paraM tattvaM manuShyANAM cha kA kathA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सा सृजत्यखिलं विश्वं सैव पालयतीति च । सैव संहरते काले त्रिगुणा परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: sA sR^ijatyakhilaM vishvaM saiva pAlayatIti cha | saiva saMharate kAle triguNA parameshvarI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: को विरज्येत मतिमान् गुणश्रवणकर्मणि । श्रीमातुर्ज्ञानिनो यानि न त्यजन्ति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: ko virajyeta matimAn guNashravaNakarmaNi | shrImAturj~nAnino yAni na tyajanti kadAchana
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यस्योपरि प्रसन्ना सा वरदा कामरूपिणी । स एव मोहमत्येति नान्यथा नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: yasyopari prasannA sA varadA kAmarUpiNI | sa eva mohamatyeti nAnyathA nR^ipasattama
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच । का सा देवी महामाया या च मोहयतेऽखिलान् । कथं जाता च सा देवी कृपया वद मे मुने
verses.transliteration: rAjovAcha | kA sA devI mahAmAyA yA cha mohayate.akhilAn | kathaM jAtA cha sA devI kR^ipayA vada me mune
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच । जगत्येकार्णवे जाते शेषमास्तीर्य योगराट् । योगनिद्रामुपाश्रित्य यदा सुष्वाप केशवः
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha | jagatyekArNave jAte sheShamAstIrya yogarAT | yoganidrAmupAshritya yadA suShvApa keshavaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तदा द्वावसुरौ जातौ विष्णोः कर्णमलेन वै । मधुकैटभनामानौ विख्यातौ पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration: tadA dvAvasurau jAtau viShNoH karNamalena vai | madhukaiTabhanAmAnau vikhyAtau pR^ithivItale
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रलयार्कप्रभौ घोरौ महाकायौ महाहनू । दंष्ट्राकरालवदनौ भक्षयन्तौ जगन्ति वा
verses.transliteration: pralayArkaprabhau ghorau mahAkAyau mahAhanU | daMShTrAkarAlavadanau bhakShayantau jaganti vA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तौ दृष्ट्वा भगवन्नाभिपङ्कजे कमलासनम् । हननायोद्यतावास्तां कस्त्वं भोरिति वादिनौ
verses.transliteration: tau dR^iShTvA bhagavannAbhipa~Nkaje kamalAsanam | hananAyodyatAvAstAM kastvaM bhoriti vAdinau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: समालोक्य तु तौ दैत्यौ सुरज्येष्ठो जनार्दनम् । शयानं च पयोम्भोधौ तुष्टाव परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: samAlokya tu tau daityau surajyeShTho janArdanam | shayAnaM cha payombhodhau tuShTAva parameshvarIm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । रक्ष रक्ष महामाये शरणागतवत्सले । एताभ्यां घोररूपाभ्यां दैत्याभ्यां जगदम्बिके
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | rakSha rakSha mahAmAye sharaNAgatavatsale | etAbhyAM ghorarUpAbhyAM daityAbhyAM jagadambike
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणमामि महामायां योगनिद्रामुमां सतीम् । कालरात्रिं महारात्रिं मोहरात्रिं परात्पराम्
verses.transliteration: praNamAmi mahAmAyAM yoganidrAmumAM satIm | kAlarAtriM mahArAtriM moharAtriM parAtparAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिदेवजननीं नित्यां भक्ताभीष्टफलप्रदाम् । पालिनीं सर्वदेवानां करुणावरुणालयाम्
verses.transliteration: tridevajananIM nityAM bhaktAbhIShTaphalapradAm | pAlinIM sarvadevAnAM karuNAvaruNAlayAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । धन्या यूयं महात्मानः कृतकृत्याः स्थ सर्वदा । यत्पृच्छथ पराम्बाया उमायाश्चरितं महत्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | dhanyA yUyaM mahAtmAnaH kR^itakR^ityAH stha sarvadA | yatpR^ichChatha parAmbAyA umAyAshcharitaM mahat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्प्रभावादहं ब्रह्मा माधवो गिरिजापतिः । सृजत्यवति संसारं काले संहरतीति च
verses.transliteration: tvatprabhAvAdahaM brahmA mAdhavo girijApatiH | sR^ijatyavati saMsAraM kAle saMharatIti cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं स्वाहा त्वं स्वधा त्वं ह्रीस्त्वं बुद्धिर्विमला मता । तुष्टिः पुष्टिस्त्वमेवाम्ब शान्तिः क्षान्तिः क्षुधा दया
verses.transliteration: tvaM svAhA tvaM svadhA tvaM hrIstvaM buddhirvimalA matA | tuShTiH puShTistvamevAmba shAntiH kShAntiH kShudhA dayA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुमाया त्वमेवाम्ब त्वमेव चेतना मता । त्वं शक्तिः परमा प्रोक्ता लज्जा तृष्णा त्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: viShNumAyA tvamevAmba tvameva chetanA matA | tvaM shaktiH paramA proktA lajjA tR^iShNA tvameva cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रान्तिस्त्वं स्मृतिरूपा त्वं मातृरूपेण संस्थिता । त्वं लक्ष्मीर्भवने पुंसां पुण्याचारप्रवर्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration: bhrAntistvaM smR^itirUpA tvaM mAtR^irUpeNa saMsthitA | tvaM lakShmIrbhavane puMsAM puNyAchArapravartinAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं जातिस्त्वं मता वृत्तिर्व्याप्तिरूपा त्वमेव हि । त्वमेव चित्तिरूपेण व्याप्य कृत्स्नं प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: tvaM jAtistvaM matA vR^ittirvyAptirUpA tvameva hi | tvameva chittirUpeNa vyApya kR^itsnaM pratiShThitA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सा त्वमेतौ दुराधर्षावसुरौ मोहयाम्बिके । प्रबोधय जगद्योने नारायणमजं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: sA tvametau durAdharShAvasurau mohayAmbike | prabodhaya jagadyone nArAyaNamajaM vibhum
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच । ब्रह्मणा प्रार्थिता सेयं मधुकैटभनाशने । महाविद्या जगद्धात्री सर्वविद्याधिदेवता
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha | brahmaNA prArthitA seyaM madhukaiTabhanAshane | mahAvidyA jagaddhAtrI sarvavidyAdhidevatA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादश्यां फाल्गुनस्यैव शुक्लायां समभून्नृप । महाकालीति विख्याता शक्तिस्त्रैलोक्यमोहिनी
verses.transliteration: dvAdashyAM phAlgunasyaiva shuklAyAM samabhUnnR^ipa | mahAkAlIti vikhyAtA shaktistrailokyamohinI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभवद्वियद्वाणी मा भैषीः कमलासन । कण्टकं नाशयाम्यद्य हत्वाजौ मधुकैटभौ
verses.transliteration: tato.abhavadviyadvANI mA bhaiShIH kamalAsana | kaNTakaM nAshayAmyadya hatvAjau madhukaiTabhau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा सा महामाया नेत्रवक्त्रादितो हरेः । निर्गम्य दर्शने तस्थौ ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA sA mahAmAyA netravaktrAdito hareH | nirgamya darshane tasthau brahmaNo.avyaktajanmanaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शृण्वतां पृच्छतां चैव तथा वाचयतां च तत् । पादाम्बुजरजांस्येव तीर्थानि मुनयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: shR^iNvatAM pR^ichChatAM chaiva tathA vAchayatAM cha tat | pAdAmbujarajAMsyeva tIrthAni munayo viduH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तस्थौ च हृषीकेशो देवदेवो जनार्दनः । स ददर्श पुरो दैत्यौ मधुकैटभसंज्ञकौ
verses.transliteration: uttasthau cha hR^iShIkesho devadevo janArdanaH | sa dadarsha puro daityau madhukaiTabhasa.nj~nakau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां प्रववृत्ते युद्धं विष्णोरतुलतेजसः । पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि बाहुयुद्धमभूत्तदा
verses.transliteration: tAbhyAM pravavR^itte yuddhaM viShNoratulatejasaH | pa~nchavarShasahasrANi bAhuyuddhamabhUttadA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: महामायाप्रभावेण मोहितौ दानवोत्तमौ । जजल्पतू रमाकान्तं गृहाण वरमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: mahAmAyAprabhAveNa mohitau dAnavottamau | jajalpatU ramAkAntaM gR^ihANa varamIpsitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नारायण उवाच । मयि प्रसन्नौ यदि वां दीयतामेष मे वरः । मम वध्यावुभौ नान्यं युवाभ्यां प्रार्थये वरम्
verses.transliteration: nArAyaNa uvAcha | mayi prasannau yadi vAM dIyatAmeSha me varaH | mama vadhyAvubhau nAnyaM yuvAbhyAM prArthaye varam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच । एकार्णवां महीं दृष्ट्वा प्रोचतुः केशवं वचः । आवां जहि न यत्रासौ धरणी पयसाप्लुता
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha | ekArNavAM mahIM dR^iShTvA prochatuH keshavaM vachaH | AvAM jahi na yatrAsau dharaNI payasAplutA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तथास्तु प्रोच्य भगवांश्चक्रमुत्थाप्य सूज्ज्वलम् । चिच्छेद शिरसी कृत्वा स्वकीयजघने तयोः
verses.transliteration: tathAstu prochya bhagavAMshchakramutthApya sUjjvalam | chichCheda shirasI kR^itvA svakIyajaghane tayoH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: निर्विकारादि साकारा निराकारापि देव्युमा । देवानां तापनाशार्थं प्रादुरासीद्युगे युगे
verses.transliteration: nirvikArAdi sAkArA nirAkArApi devyumA | devAnAM tApanAshArthaM prAdurAsIdyuge yuge
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ते कथितो राजन् कालिकायाः समुद्भवः । महालक्ष्म्यास्तथोत्पत्तिं निशामय महामते
verses.transliteration: evaM te kathito rAjan kAlikAyAH samudbhavaH | mahAlakShmyAstathotpattiM nishAmaya mahAmate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यदिच्छावैभवं सर्वं तस्या देहग्रहः स्मृतः । लीलया सापि भक्तानां गुणवर्णनहेतवे
verses.transliteration: yadichChAvaibhavaM sarvaM tasyA dehagrahaH smR^itaH | lIlayA sApi bhaktAnAM guNavarNanahetave
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ते धन्या कृतकृत्याः स्युर्धन्या तेषां प्रसूः कुलम् । येषां चित्तं भवेल्लीनं श्रीदेव्यां परसंविदि
verses.transliteration: te dhanyA kR^itakR^ityAH syurdhanyA teShAM prasUH kulam | yeShAM chittaM bhavellInaM shrIdevyAM parasaMvidi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ये न स्तुवन्ति देवेशीं सर्वकारणकारणाम् । मायागुणैर्मोहिताः स्युर्हतभाग्या न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ye na stuvanti deveshIM sarvakAraNakAraNAm | mAyAguNairmohitAH syurhatabhAgyA na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.४६. षट्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । महालक्ष्म्यवतारवर्णनम् । ऋषिरुवाच । आसीद्रम्भासुरो नाम दैत्यवंशशिरोमणिः । तस्माज्जातो महातेजा महिषो नाम दानवः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.46\. ShaTchatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | mahAlakShmyavatAravarNanam | R^iShiruvAcha | AsIdrambhAsuro nAma daityavaMshashiromaNiH | tasmAjjAto mahAtejA mahiSho nAma dAnavaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति देववचः श्रुत्वा दामोदरसतीश्वरौ । चक्रतुः परमं कोपं रोषाघूर्णितलोचनौ
verses.transliteration: iti devavachaH shrutvA dAmodarasatIshvarau | chakratuH paramaM kopaM roShAghUrNitalochanau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽतिकोपपूर्णस्य विष्णोः शम्भोश्च वक्त्रतः । तथान्येषां च देवानां शरीरान्निर्गतं महः
verses.transliteration: tato.atikopapUrNasya viShNoH shambhoshcha vaktrataH | tathAnyeShAM cha devAnAM sharIrAnnirgataM mahaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अतीव महसः पुञ्जं ज्वलन्तं दशदिक्षु च । अपश्यंस्त्रिदशाः सर्वे दुर्गाध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: atIva mahasaH pu~njaM jvalantaM dashadikShu cha | apashyaMstridashAH sarve durgAdhyAnaparAyaNAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेवशरीरोत्थं तेजस्तदतिभीषणम् । सङ्घीभूयाभवन्नारी साक्षान्महिषमर्दिनी
verses.transliteration: sarvadevasharIrotthaM tejastadatibhIShaNam | sa~NghIbhUyAbhavannArI sAkShAnmahiShamardinI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शम्भुतेजस उत्पन्नं मुखमस्याः सुभास्वरम् । याम्येन बाला अभवन्वैष्णवेन च बाहवः
verses.transliteration: shambhutejasa utpannaM mukhamasyAH subhAsvaram | yAmyena bAlA abhavanvaiShNavena cha bAhavaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रमस्तेजसा तस्याः स्तनयुग्मं व्यजायत । मध्यमैन्द्रेण जङ्घोरू वारुणेन बभूवतुः
verses.transliteration: chandramastejasA tasyAH stanayugmaM vyajAyata | madhyamaindreNa ja~NghorU vAruNena babhUvatuH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भूतेजसा नितम्बोऽभूद् ब्राह्मेण चरणद्वयम् । आर्केण चरणाङ्गुल्यः कराङ्गुल्यश्च वासवात्
verses.transliteration: bhUtejasA nitambo.abhUd brAhmeNa charaNadvayam | ArkeNa charaNA~NgulyaH karA~Ngulyashcha vAsavAt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कुबेरतेजसा नासा रदनाश्च प्रजापतेः । पावकीयेन नयनत्रयं सान्ध्येन भ्रूद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kuberatejasA nAsA radanAshcha prajApateH | pAvakIyena nayanatrayaM sAndhyena bhrUdvayam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आनिलेन श्रवोद्वन्द्वं तथान्येषां स्वरोकसाम् । तेजसा सम्भवा पद्मालया सा परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: Anilena shravodvandvaM tathAnyeShAM svarokasAm | tejasA sambhavA padmAlayA sA parameshvarI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निखिलदेवानां तेजोराशिसमुद्भवाम् । तामालोक्य सुराः सर्वे परं हर्षं प्रपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: tato nikhiladevAnAM tejorAshisamudbhavAm | tAmAlokya surAH sarve paraM harShaM prapedire
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स सङ्ग्रामे सुरान्सर्वान्निर्जित्य दनुजाधिपः । चकार राज्यं स्वर्लोके महेन्द्रासनसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: sa sa~NgrAme surAnsarvAnnirjitya danujAdhipaH | chakAra rAjyaM svarloke mahendrAsanasaMsthitaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: निरायुधां च तां दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्माद्यास्त्रिदिवेश्वराः । सायुधां तां शिवां कर्तुं मनः सन्दधिरे सुराः
verses.transliteration: nirAyudhAM cha tAM dR^iShTvA brahmAdyAstridiveshvarAH | sAyudhAM tAM shivAM kartuM manaH sandadhire surAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शूलं महेशानो महेशान्यै समर्पयत् । चक्रं च कृष्णो भगवान् शङ्खं पाशं च पाशभृत्
verses.transliteration: tataH shUlaM maheshAno maheshAnyai samarpayat | chakraM cha kR^iShNo bhagavAn sha~NkhaM pAshaM cha pAshabhR^it
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिं हुताशनोऽयच्छन्मारुतश्चापमेव च । बाणपूर्णेषुधी चैव वज्रघण्टे शचीपतिः
verses.transliteration: shaktiM hutAshano.ayachChanmArutashchApameva cha | bANapUrNeShudhI chaiva vajraghaNTe shachIpatiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यमो ददौ कालदण्डमक्षमालां प्रजापतिः । ब्रह्मा कमण्डलुं प्रादाद्रोमरश्मीन्दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: yamo dadau kAladaNDamakShamAlAM prajApatiH | brahmA kamaNDaluM prAdAdromarashmIndivAkaraH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कालः खड्गं ददौ तस्यै फलकं च समुज्वलम् । क्षीराब्धी रुचिरं हारमजरे च तथाम्बरे
verses.transliteration: kAlaH khaDgaM dadau tasyai phalakaM cha samujvalam | kShIrAbdhI ruchiraM hAramajare cha tathAmbare
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: चूडामणिं कुण्डले च कटकानि तथैव च । अर्द्धचन्द्रं च केयूरान्नूपुरौ च मनोहरौ
verses.transliteration: chUDAmaNiM kuNDale cha kaTakAni tathaiva cha | arddhachandraM cha keyUrAnnUpurau cha manoharau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रैवेयकमङ्गुलीषु समस्तास्वङ्गुलीयकम् । विश्वकर्मा च परशुं ददौ तस्यै मनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: graiveyakama~NgulIShu samastAsva~NgulIyakam | vishvakarmA cha parashuM dadau tasyai manoharam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्राण्यनेकानि तथाभेद्यं चैव तनुच्छदम् । सुरम्यसरसां मालां पङ्कजं चाम्बुधिर्ददौ
verses.transliteration: astrANyanekAni tathAbhedyaM chaiva tanuchChadam | suramyasarasAM mAlAM pa~NkajaM chAmbudhirdadau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ददौ सिंहं च हिमवान् रत्नानि विविधानि च । सुरया पूरितं पात्रं कुबेरोऽस्यै समर्पयत्
verses.transliteration: dadau siMhaM cha himavAn ratnAni vividhAni cha | surayA pUritaM pAtraM kubero.asyai samarpayat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शेषश्च भोगिनां नेता विचित्ररचनाञ्चितम् । ददौ तस्यै नागहारं नानासन्मणिगुम्फितम्
verses.transliteration: sheShashcha bhoginAM netA vichitrarachanA~nchitam | dadau tasyai nAgahAraM nAnAsanmaNigumphitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पराजितास्ततो देवा ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः । ब्रह्मापि तान्समादाय ययौ यत्र वृषाकपी
verses.transliteration: parAjitAstato devA brahmANaM sharaNaM yayuH | brahmApi tAnsamAdAya yayau yatra vR^iShAkapI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एतैश्चान्यैः सुरैर्देवी भूषणैरायुधैस्तथा । सत्कृतोच्चैर्ननादासौ साट्टहासं पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: etaishchAnyaiH surairdevI bhUShaNairAyudhaistathA | satkR^itochchairnanAdAsau sATTahAsaM punaHpunaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या भीषणनादेन पूरिता च नभःस्थली । प्रतिशब्दो महानासीच्चुक्षुभे भुवनत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: tasyA bhIShaNanAdena pUritA cha nabhaHsthalI | pratishabdo mahAnAsIchchukShubhe bhuvanatrayam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: चेलुः समुद्राश्चत्वारो वसुधा च चचाल ह । जयशब्दस्ततो देवैरकारि महिषार्दितैः
verses.transliteration: cheluH samudrAshchatvAro vasudhA cha chachAla ha | jayashabdastato devairakAri mahiShArditaiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽम्बिकां परां शक्तिं महालक्ष्मीस्वरूपिणीम् । तुष्टुवुस्ते सुराः सर्वे भक्तिगद्गदया गिरा
verses.transliteration: tato.ambikAM parAM shaktiM mahAlakShmIsvarUpiNIm | tuShTuvuste surAH sarve bhaktigadgadayA girA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: लोकं सङ्क्षुब्धमालोक्य देवतापरिपन्थिनः । सन्नद्धसैनिकास्ते च समुत्तस्थुरुदायुधाः
verses.transliteration: lokaM sa~NkShubdhamAlokya devatAparipanthinaH | sannaddhasainikAste cha samuttasthurudAyudhAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: महिषोऽपि च तं शब्दमभ्यधावद्रुषान्वितः । स ददर्श ततो देवीं व्याप्तलोकत्रयां रुचा
verses.transliteration: mahiSho.api cha taM shabdamabhyadhAvadruShAnvitaH | sa dadarsha tato devIM vyAptalokatrayAM ruchA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र महिषासुरपालिताः । समाजग्मुर्महावीराः कोटिशो धृतहेतयः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra mahiShAsurapAlitAH | samAjagmurmahAvIrAH koTisho dhR^itahetayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: चिक्षुरश्चामरोदग्रौ करालोद्धतवाष्कलाः । ताम्रोग्रास्योग्रवीर्याश्च बिडालोऽन्धक एव च
verses.transliteration: chikShurashchAmarodagrau karAloddhatavAShkalAH | tAmrogrAsyogravIryAshcha biDAlo.andhaka eva cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्धरो दुर्मुखश्चैव त्रिनेत्रश्च महाहनुः । एते चान्ये च बहवः शूरा युद्धविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: durdharo durmukhashchaiva trinetrashcha mahAhanuH | ete chAnye cha bahavaH shUrA yuddhavishAradAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: युयुधुः समरे देव्या सह शस्त्रास्त्रपारगाः । इत्थं कालो व्यतीयाय युध्यतोर्भीषणस्तयोः
verses.transliteration: yuyudhuH samare devyA saha shastrAstrapAragAH | itthaM kAlo vyatIyAya yudhyatorbhIShaNastayoH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा सुराः सर्वे नत्वा शङ्करकेशवौ । स्ववृत्तं कथायामासुर्यथावदनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvA surAH sarve natvA sha~Nkarakeshavau | svavR^ittaM kathAyAmAsuryathAvadanupUrvashaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अरिवर्गकरक्षिप्ता नानाशस्त्रास्त्रराशयः । महामायाप्रभावेण विफला अभवन् क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: arivargakarakShiptA nAnAshastrAstrarAshayaH | mahAmAyAprabhAveNa viphalA abhavan kShaNAt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो जघान सा देवी चिक्षुरप्रमुखानरीन् । सगणान्गदया बाणैः शूलशक्तिपरश्वधैः
verses.transliteration: tato jaghAna sA devI chikShurapramukhAnarIn | sagaNAngadayA bANaiH shUlashaktiparashvadhaiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्वीयेषु सैन्येषु हतेषु महिषासुरः । देवीनिःश्वाससम्भूतान्भावयामास तान्गणान्
verses.transliteration: evaM svIyeShu sainyeShu hateShu mahiShAsuraH | devIniHshvAsasambhUtAnbhAvayAmAsa tAngaNAn
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अताडयत्खुरैः काश्चित्काश्चिच्छृङ्गद्वयेन च । लाङ्गूलेन च तुण्डेन भिनत्ति स्म मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: atADayatkhuraiH kAshchitkAshchichChR^i~Ngadvayena cha | lA~NgUlena cha tuNDena bhinatti sma muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं देवीगणान्हत्वाभ्यधावत्सोऽसुराधिपः । सिंहं मारयितुं देव्यास्ततोऽसौ कुपितोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: itthaM devIgaNAnhatvAbhyadhAvatso.asurAdhipaH | siMhaM mArayituM devyAstato.asau kupito.abhavat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कोपात्सोऽपि महावीर्यः खुरकुट्टितभूतलः । शृङ्गाभ्यां शैलमुत्पाट्य चिक्षेप प्रणनाद च
verses.transliteration: kopAtso.api mahAvIryaH khurakuTTitabhUtalaH | shR^i~NgAbhyAM shailamutpATya chikShepa praNanAda cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वेगेन विष्वग् भ्रमता प्रक्षिप्ता गुरवोऽद्रयः । आकाशतो महीमध्ये निपेतुर्नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: vegena viShvag bhramatA prakShiptA guravo.adrayaH | AkAshato mahImadhye nipeturnR^ipasattama
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गभिन्नाः पयोवाहाः खण्डं खण्डमयासिषुः ॥ लाङ्गूलेनाहतश्चाब्धिर्विष्वगुद्वेलमस्पदत्
verses.transliteration: shR^i~NgabhinnAH payovAhAH khaNDaM khaNDamayAsiShuH || lA~NgUlenAhatashchAbdhirviShvagudvelamaspadat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं क्रुद्धं समालोक्य महिषासुरमम्बिका । विदधे तद्वधोपायं देवानामभयङ्करी
verses.transliteration: evaM kruddhaM samAlokya mahiShAsuramambikA | vidadhe tadvadhopAyaM devAnAmabhaya~NkarI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पाशं समुत्थाप्य क्षिप्त्वा तस्योपरीश्वरी । बबन्ध महिषं सोऽपि रूपं तत्याज माहिषम्
verses.transliteration: tataH pAshaM samutthApya kShiptvA tasyoparIshvarI | babandha mahiShaM so.api rUpaM tatyAja mAhiSham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्तौ वयं सर्वे महिषेण दुरात्मना । उज्जासिताश्च स्वर्लोकान्निर्जित्य समराङ्गणे
verses.transliteration: bhagavantau vayaM sarve mahiSheNa durAtmanA | ujjAsitAshcha svarlokAnnirjitya samarA~NgaNe
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सिंहो बभूवाशु मायावी तच्छिरोऽम्बिका । यावद्भिनत्ति तावत्स खङ्गपाणिर्बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: tataH siMho babhUvAshu mAyAvI tachChiro.ambikA | yAvadbhinatti tAvatsa kha~NgapANirbabhUva ha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सचर्मासिकरं तं च देवी बाणैरताडयत् । ततो गजवपुर्भूत्वा सिंहं चिच्छेद शुण्डया
verses.transliteration: sacharmAsikaraM taM cha devI bANairatADayat | tato gajavapurbhUtvA siMhaM chichCheda shuNDayA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽस्य च करं देवी चकर्त स्वमहासिना । अधारि च पुना रूपं स्वकीयं तेन रक्षसा
verses.transliteration: tato.asya cha karaM devI chakarta svamahAsinA | adhAri cha punA rUpaM svakIyaM tena rakShasA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तदैव क्षोभयामास त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । ततः क्रुद्धा महामाया चण्डिका मानविक्रमा
verses.transliteration: tadaiva kShobhayAmAsa trailokyaM sacharAcharam | tataH kruddhA mahAmAyA chaNDikA mAnavikramA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पपौ पुनः पुनः पानं जहासोद्भ्रान्तलोचना । जगर्ज चासुरः सोऽपि बलवीर्यमदोद्धतः
verses.transliteration: papau punaH punaH pAnaM jahAsodbhrAntalochanA | jagarja chAsuraH so.api balavIryamadoddhataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या उपरि चिक्षेप शैलानुत्पाट्य सोऽसुरः । सा च बाणावलीघातैश्चूर्णयामास सत्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tasyA upari chikShepa shailAnutpATya so.asuraH | sA cha bANAvalIghAtaishchUrNayAmAsa satvaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: वारुणीमदसञ्जातमुखरागाकुलेन्द्रिया । प्रोवाच परमेशानी मेघगम्भीरया गिरा
verses.transliteration: vAruNImadasa~njAtamukharAgAkulendriyA | provAcha parameshAnI meghagambhIrayA girA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । रे मूढ रे हतप्रज्ञ व्यर्थं किं कुरुषे हठम् । न मदग्रेऽसुराः केऽपि स्थास्नवो जगतीत्रये
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | re mUDha re hatapraj~na vyarthaM kiM kuruShe haTham | na madagre.asurAH ke.api sthAsnavo jagatItraye
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषि रुवाच । एकमाभाष्य कूर्दित्वा देवी सर्वकलामयी । पदाक्रम्यासुरं कण्ठे शूलेनोग्रेण साभिनत्
verses.transliteration: R^iShi ruvAcha | ekamAbhAShya kUrditvA devI sarvakalAmayI | padAkramyAsuraM kaNThe shUlenogreNa sAbhinat
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तच्चरणाक्रान्तः स स्वकीयमुखात्ततः । अर्धनिष्क्रान्त एवासीद्देव्या वीर्येण संवृतः
verses.transliteration: tatastachcharaNAkrAntaH sa svakIyamukhAttataH | ardhaniShkrAnta evAsIddevyA vIryeNa saMvR^itaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमामो मर्त्यलोकेऽस्मिन्न लभेमहिशं क्वचित् । कां कां न दुर्दशां नीता देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: bhramAmo martyaloke.asminna labhemahishaM kvachit | kAM kAM na durdashAM nItA devA indrapurogamAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धनिष्क्रान्त एवासौ युध्यमानो महाधमः । महासिना शिरो भित्त्वा न्यपाति धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: ardhaniShkrAnta evAsau yudhyamAno mahAdhamaH | mahAsinA shiro bhittvA nyapAti dharaNItale
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: हा हा शब्दं समुच्चार्यावाङ्मुखास्तद्गणास्ततः । पलायन्त रणाद्भीतास्त्राहि त्राहीति वादिनः
verses.transliteration: hA hA shabdaM samuchchAryAvA~NmukhAstadgaNAstataH | palAyanta raNAdbhItAstrAhi trAhIti vAdinaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टुवुश्च तदा देवीमिन्द्राद्याः सकलाः सुराः । गन्धर्वा गीतमुच्चेरुर्ननृतुर्नर्तकीजनाः
verses.transliteration: tuShTuvushcha tadA devImindrAdyAH sakalAH surAH | gandharvA gItamuchcherurnanR^iturnartakIjanAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ते कथितो राजन्महालक्ष्म्याः समुद्भवः । सरस्वत्यास्तथोत्पत्तिं शृणु सुस्थेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: evaM te kathito rAjanmahAlakShmyAH samudbhavaH | sarasvatyAstathotpattiM shR^iNu susthena chetasA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ पाशी कुबेरो यम एव च । इन्द्राग्निवातगन्धर्वा विद्याधरसुचारणाः
verses.transliteration: sUryAchandramasau pAshI kubero yama eva cha | indrAgnivAtagandharvA vidyAdharasuchAraNAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषामपरेषां च विधेयं कर्म सोऽसुरः । स्वयं करोति पापात्मा दैत्यपक्षाभयङ्कर
verses.transliteration: eteShAmapareShAM cha vidheyaM karma so.asuraH | svayaM karoti pApAtmA daityapakShAbhaya~Nkara
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छरणमापन्नान्देवान्नस्त्रातुमर्हथः । वधोपायं च तस्याशु चिन्तयेथां युवां प्रभू
verses.transliteration: tasmAchCharaNamApannAndevAnnastrAtumarhathaH | vadhopAyaM cha tasyAshu chintayethAM yuvAM prabhU
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ५.४७. सप्तचत्वरिंशोऽध्यायः । धूम्रलोचनचण्डमुण्डरक्तबीजवधः । ऋषिरुवाच । आसीच्छुम्भासुरो दैत्यो निशुम्भश्च प्रतापवान् । त्रैलोक्यमोजसाक्रान्तं भ्रातृभ्यां सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 5\.47\. saptachatvariMsho.adhyAyaH | dhUmralochanachaNDamuNDaraktabIjavadhaH | R^iShiruvAcha | AsIchChumbhAsuro daityo nishumbhashcha pratApavAn | trailokyamojasAkrAntaM bhrAtR^ibhyAM sacharAcharam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वेदान्तवेद्यायै नमस्ते परमात्मने । अनन्तकोटिब्रह्माण्डनायिकायै नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namo vedAntavedyAyai namaste paramAtmane | anantakoTibrahmANDanAyikAyai namo namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति देवैः स्तुता गौरी प्रसन्ना वरदा शिवा । प्रोवाच त्रिदशान्सर्वान्युष्माभिः स्तूयतेऽत्र का
verses.transliteration: iti devaiH stutA gaurI prasannA varadA shivA | provAcha tridashAnsarvAnyuShmAbhiH stUyate.atra kA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गौरीतनोरेका प्रादुरासीत्कुमारिका । सोवाच मिषतां तेषां शिवशक्तिं परादरात्
verses.transliteration: tato gaurItanorekA prAdurAsItkumArikA | sovAcha miShatAM teShAM shivashaktiM parAdarAt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रं मे क्रियते मातः समस्तैः स्वर्गवासिभिः । निशुम्भशुम्भदैत्याभ्यां प्रबलाभ्यां प्रपीडितैः
verses.transliteration: stotraM me kriyate mAtaH samastaiH svargavAsibhiH | nishumbhashumbhadaityAbhyAM prabalAbhyAM prapIDitaiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरकोशाद्यत्तस्या निर्गता तेन कौशिकी । नाम्ना सा गीयते साक्षाच्छुम्भासुरनिबर्हिणी
verses.transliteration: sharIrakoshAdyattasyA nirgatA tena kaushikI | nAmnA sA gIyate sAkShAchChumbhAsuranibarhiNI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: चैवोग्रतारिका प्रोक्ता महोग्रतारिकापि च । प्रादुर्भूता यतः सा वै मातङ्गीत्युच्यते भुवि
verses.transliteration: chaivogratArikA proktA mahogratArikApi cha | prAdurbhUtA yataH sA vai mAta~NgItyuchyate bhuvi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: बभाषे निखिलान्देवान्यूयं तिष्ठत निर्भयाः । कार्यं वः साधयिष्यामि स्वतन्त्राहं विनाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: babhAShe nikhilAndevAnyUyaM tiShThata nirbhayAH | kAryaM vaH sAdhayiShyAmi svatantrAhaM vinAshrayam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा सा तदा देवी तरसान्तर्हिताभवत् । चण्डमुण्डौ तु तां देवीमद्राष्टां सेवकौ तयोः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA sA tadA devI tarasAntarhitAbhavat | chaNDamuNDau tu tAM devImadrAShTAM sevakau tayoH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा मनोहरं तस्या रूपं नेत्रसुखावहम् । पेततुस्तौ धरामध्ये नष्टसंज्ञौ विमोहितौ
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA manoharaM tasyA rUpaM netrasukhAvaham | petatustau dharAmadhye naShTasa.nj~nau vimohitau
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा व्याजह्रतुः सर्वं राज्ञे वृत्तान्तमादितः । दृष्टा काचिन्मयापूर्वा नारी राजन्मनोहरा
verses.transliteration: gatvA vyAjahratuH sarvaM rAj~ne vR^ittAntamAditaH | dR^iShTA kAchinmayApUrvA nArI rAjanmanoharA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां प्रपीडिता देवा हिमवन्तं समाययुः । जननीं सर्वभूतानां कामदात्रीं ववन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: tAbhyAM prapIDitA devA himavantaM samAyayuH | jananIM sarvabhUtAnAM kAmadAtrIM vavandire
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये संस्थिता सिंहवाहिनी । समन्ताद्देवकन्याभिः सेविता बद्धपाणिभिः
verses.transliteration: himavachChikhare ramye saMsthitA siMhavAhinI | samantAddevakanyAbhiH sevitA baddhapANibhiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुते पादसंवाहं काचित्संस्कुरुते कचान् । पाणिसंवाहनं काचित्काचिन्नेत्राञ्जनं न्यधात्
verses.transliteration: kurute pAdasaMvAhaM kAchitsaMskurute kachAn | pANisaMvAhanaM kAchitkAchinnetrA~njanaM nyadhAt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: काचिद् गृहीत्वा हस्तेनादर्शं दर्शयते मुखम् । नागवल्लीं ददात्येका लवङ्गैलादिसंयुताम्
verses.transliteration: kAchid gR^ihItvA hastenAdarshaM darshayate mukham | nAgavallIM dadAtyekA lava~NgailAdisaMyutAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पतद्ग्रहं करे कृत्वा स्थिता काचित्सखी पुरः । भूषयत्यखिलाङ्गानि काचिद्भूषाम्बरादिभिः
verses.transliteration: patadgrahaM kare kR^itvA sthitA kAchitsakhI puraH | bhUShayatyakhilA~NgAni kAchidbhUShAmbarAdibhiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कदलीस्तम्भजङ्घोरुः कीरनासाहिदोर्लता । रणन्मञ्जीरचरणा रम्यमेखलया युता
verses.transliteration: kadalIstambhaja~NghoruH kIranAsAhidorlatA | raNanma~njIracharaNA ramyamekhalayA yutA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: लसत्कस्तूरिकामोदमुक्ताहारचलस्तनी । ग्रैवेयकलसद्ग्रीवा ललन्ती दाममण्डिता
verses.transliteration: lasatkastUrikAmodamuktAhArachalastanI | graiveyakalasadgrIvA lalantI dAmamaNDitA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धचन्द्रधरा देवी मणिकुण्डलधारिणी । रम्यवेणिर्विशालाक्षी लोचनत्रयभूषिता
verses.transliteration: ardhachandradharA devI maNikuNDaladhAriNI | ramyaveNirvishAlAkShI lochanatrayabhUShitA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षरा मालिकोपेता पाणिराजितकङ्कणा । स्वर्णोर्मिकाङ्गुलिर्भ्राजत्पारिहार्यलसत्करा
verses.transliteration: sAkSharA mAlikopetA pANirAjitaka~NkaNA | svarNormikA~NgulirbhrAjatpArihAryalasatkarA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शुभ्रवस्त्रावृता गौरी पद्मासनविराजिता । काश्मीरबिन्दुतिलका चन्द्रालङ्कृतमस्तका
verses.transliteration: shubhravastrAvR^itA gaurI padmAsanavirAjitA | kAshmIrabindutilakA chandrAla~NkR^itamastakA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तडिद्द्युतिर्महामूल्याम्बरचोलोन्नमत्कुचा । भुजैरष्टाभिरुत्तुङ्गैर्धारयन्ती वरायुधान्
verses.transliteration: taDiddyutirmahAmUlyAmbaracholonnamatkuchA | bhujairaShTAbhiruttu~NgairdhArayantI varAyudhAn
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । जय दुर्गे महेशानि जयात्मीयजनप्रिये । त्रैलोक्यत्राणकारिण्यै शिवायै ते नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH | jaya durge maheshAni jayAtmIyajanapriye | trailokyatrANakAriNyai shivAyai te namo namaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशी नासुरी नागी न गन्धर्वी न दानवी । विद्यते त्रिषु लोकेषु यादृशी सा मनोरमा
verses.transliteration: tAdR^ishI nAsurI nAgI na gandharvI na dAnavI | vidyate triShu lokeShu yAdR^ishI sA manoramA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सम्भोगयोग्यत्वं तस्यास्त्वय्येव शोभते । नारीरत्नं यतः सा वै पुंरत्नं च भवान्प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tasmAtsambhogayogyatvaM tasyAstvayyeva shobhate | nArIratnaM yataH sA vai puMratnaM cha bhavAnprabho
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तं चण्डमुण्डाभ्यां निशम्य स महासुरः । दूतं सुग्रीवनामानं प्रेषयामास तां प्रति
verses.transliteration: ityuktaM chaNDamuNDAbhyAM nishamya sa mahAsuraH | dUtaM sugrIvanAmAnaM preShayAmAsa tAM prati
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ दूत तुषाराद्रौ तत्रास्ते कापि सुन्दरी । सा नेतव्या प्रयत्नेन कथयित्वा वचो मम
verses.transliteration: gachCha dUta tuShArAdrau tatrAste kApi sundarI | sA netavyA prayatnena kathayitvA vacho mama
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति विज्ञापितस्तेन सुग्रीवो दानवोत्तमः । गत्वा हिमाचलं प्राह जगदम्बां महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: iti vij~nApitastena sugrIvo dAnavottamaH | gatvA himAchalaM prAha jagadambAM maheshvarIm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: दूत उवाच । देवि शुम्भासुरो दैत्यो निशुम्भस्तस्य चानुजः । विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु महाबलपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: dUta uvAcha | devi shumbhAsuro daityo nishumbhastasya chAnujaH | vikhyAtastriShu lokeShu mahAbalaparAkramaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: चारोऽहं प्रेषितस्तेन सन्निधिं ते समागमम् । स यज्जगौ सुरेशानि तत्समाकर्णयाधुना
verses.transliteration: chAro.ahaM preShitastena sannidhiM te samAgamam | sa yajjagau sureshAni tatsamAkarNayAdhunA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रादीन्समरे जित्वा तेषां रत्नान्यपाहरम् । देवभागं स्वयं भुञ्जे यागे दत्तं सुरादिभिः
verses.transliteration: indrAdInsamare jitvA teShAM ratnAnyapAharam | devabhAgaM svayaM bhu~nje yAge dattaM surAdibhiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीरत्नं त्वामहं मन्ये सर्वरत्नोपरिस्थितम् । सा त्वं ममानुजं मां वा भजतात्कामजै रसैः
verses.transliteration: strIratnaM tvAmahaM manye sarvaratnoparisthitam | sA tvaM mamAnujaM mAM vA bhajatAtkAmajai rasaiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति दूतोक्तमाकर्ण्य वचनं शुम्भभाषितम् । जगाद सा महामाया भूतेशप्राणवल्लभा
verses.transliteration: iti dUtoktamAkarNya vachanaM shumbhabhAShitam | jagAda sA mahAmAyA bhUteshaprANavallabhA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नमो मुक्तिप्रदायिन्यै पराम्बायै नमो नमः । नमः समस्तसंसारोत्पत्तिस्थित्यन्तकारिके
verses.transliteration: namo muktipradAyinyai parAmbAyai namo namaH | namaH samastasaMsArotpattisthityantakArike
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । सत्यं वदसि भो दूत नानृतं किञ्चिदुच्यते । परं त्वेका कृता पूर्वं प्रतिज्ञा तां निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | satyaM vadasi bho dUta nAnR^itaM ki~nchiduchyate | paraM tvekA kR^itA pUrvaM pratij~nA tAM nibodha me
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यो मे दर्पं विधुनुते यो मां जयति सङ्गरे । उत्सहे तमहं कर्तुं पतिं नान्यमिति ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: yo me darpaM vidhunute yo mAM jayati sa~Ngare | utsahe tamahaM kartuM patiM nAnyamiti dhruvam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं कथय शुम्भाय निशुम्भाय वचो मम । यथा युक्तं भवेदेवं विदधातु तथात्र सः
verses.transliteration: sa tvaM kathaya shumbhAya nishumbhAya vacho mama | yathA yuktaM bhavedevaM vidadhAtu tathAtra saH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं देवीवचः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो नाम दानवः । राज्ञे विज्ञापयामास गत्वा तत्र सविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: itthaM devIvachaH shrutvA sugrIvo nAma dAnavaH | rAj~ne vij~nApayAmAsa gatvA tatra savistaram
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अथ दूतोक्तमाकर्ण्य शुम्भो भैरवशासनः । धूम्राक्षं प्राह सक्रोधः सेनान्यं बलिनां वरम्
verses.transliteration: atha dUtoktamAkarNya shumbho bhairavashAsanaH | dhUmrAkShaM prAha sakrodhaH senAnyaM balinAM varam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: हे धूम्राक्ष तुषाराद्रौ वर्तते कापि सुन्दरी । तामानय द्रुतं गत्वा यथा यास्यति सात्र वै
verses.transliteration: he dhUmrAkSha tuShArAdrau vartate kApi sundarI | tAmAnaya drutaM gatvA yathA yAsyati sAtra vai
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या आनयने भीतिर्न कार्यासुरसत्तम । युद्धं कार्यं प्रयत्नेन यदि सा योद्धुमिच्छति
verses.transliteration: tasyA Anayane bhItirna kAryAsurasattama | yuddhaM kAryaM prayatnena yadi sA yoddhumichChati
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विज्ञापितो दैत्यो धूम्रलोचनसंज्ञकः । गत्वा हिमाचलं प्राह भुवनेशीमुमांशजाम्
verses.transliteration: evaM vij~nApito daityo dhUmralochanasa.nj~nakaH | gatvA himAchalaM prAha bhuvaneshImumAMshajAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भर्तुर्ममान्तिकं गच्छ नो चेत्त्वां घातयाम्यहम् । पुष्ट्यासुराणां सहितः सहस्राणां नितम्बिनि
verses.transliteration: bharturmamAntikaM gachCha no chettvAM ghAtayAmyaham | puShTyAsurANAM sahitaH sahasrANAM nitambini
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । दैत्यराट् प्रेषितो वीर हंसि चेत्किं करोमि ते । परन्त्वसाध्यं गमनं मन्ये सङ्ग्राममन्तरा
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | daityarAT preShito vIra haMsi chetkiM karomi te | parantvasAdhyaM gamanaM manye sa~NgrAmamantarA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कालिकारूपसम्पन्ने नमस्ताराकृते नमः । छिन्नमस्तास्वरूपायै श्रीविद्यायै नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: kAlikArUpasampanne namastArAkR^ite namaH | ChinnamastAsvarUpAyai shrIvidyAyai namo.astu te
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तामन्वधावद्दानवो धूम्रलोचनः । हुङ्कारोच्चारणेनैव तं ददाह महेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: ityuktastAmanvadhAvaddAnavo dhUmralochanaH | hu~NkArochchAraNenaiva taM dadAha maheshvarI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.
