verses.transliteration: kR^iShNAShTamyAM navamyAM vAmAyAM vA pa~nchadiktithau | pUjayejjagatAM dhAtrIM gandhapuShpairvisheShataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पठञ्जननीसूक्तं श्रीसूक्तमथवा पठन् । देवीसूक्तमथो वापि मूलमन्त्रमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: sampaTha~njananIsUktaM shrIsUktamathavA paThan | devIsUktamatho vApi mUlamantramathApi vA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुक्रान्तां च तुलसीं वर्जयित्वाखिलं सुमम् । देवीप्रीतिकरं ज्ञेयं कमलं तु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: viShNukrAntAM cha tulasIM varjayitvAkhilaM sumam | devIprItikaraM j~neyaM kamalaM tu visheShataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अर्पयेत्स्वर्णपुष्पं यो देव्यै राजतमेव वा । स याति परमं धाम सिद्धकोटिभिरन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: arpayetsvarNapuShpaM yo devyai rAjatameva vA | sa yAti paramaM dhAma siddhakoTibhiranvitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कीदृक्च लक्षणं तस्य किं कृते च फलं भवेत् । प्रियं यच्च पराम्बायास्तदशेषं वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: kIdR^ikcha lakShaNaM tasya kiM kR^ite cha phalaM bhavet | priyaM yachcha parAmbAyAstadasheShaM vadasva me
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा जायते भक्तिर्भक्त्या ज्ञानं प्रजायते । ज्ञानात्प्रजायते मुक्तिरिति शास्त्रेषु निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: karmaNA jAyate bhaktirbhaktyA j~nAnaM prajAyate | j~nAnAtprajAyate muktiriti shAstreShu nishchayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीपर्वते महापुण्ये गोकर्णे ज्ञानपर्वते । मथुरायामयोध्यायां द्वारावत्यां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: shrIparvate mahApuNye gokarNe j~nAnaparvate | mathurAyAmayodhyAyAM dvArAvatyAM tathaiva cha
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: देव्याः प्रासादकरणात्पुण्यं तु समवाप्यते । स्थापिता येन सा देवी जगन्माता त्रयीमयी
verses.transliteration: devyAH prAsAdakaraNAtpuNyaM tu samavApyate | sthApitA yena sA devI jaganmAtA trayImayI
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मदीयाः शतवर्षाणि जीवन्तु प्रेमभाजनाः । नापदामयनानीत्थं श्रीमाता वक्त्यहर्निशम्
verses.transliteration: madIyAH shatavarShANi jIvantu premabhAjanAH | nApadAmayanAnItthaM shrImAtA vaktyaharnisham
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: पूजनान्ते सदा कार्यं दासैरेनः क्षमापनम् । प्रसीद परमेशानि जगदानन्ददायिनि
verses.transliteration: pUjanAnte sadA kAryaM dAsairenaH kShamApanam | prasIda parameshAni jagadAnandadAyini
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मल्लिकामालतीचम्पाजपाबन्धूकपङ्कजैः । कुसुमैः पूजयेद्गौरीं शङ्करेण समन्विताम्
verses.transliteration: mallikAmAlatIchampAjapAbandhUkapa~NkajaiH | kusumaiH pUjayedgaurIM sha~NkareNa samanvitAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं यः कुरुते विद्वान्पूजाव्रतरथोत्सवम् । इह भुक्त्वाखिलान्भोगान्सोऽन्ते देवीपदं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM yaH kurute vidvAnpUjAvratarathotsavam | iha bhuktvAkhilAnbhogAnso.ante devIpadaM vrajet
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यः कार्त्तिकस्य मार्गस्य पौषस्य तपसस्तथा । तपस्यस्य सिते पक्षे तृतीयायां व्रतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: yaH kArttikasya mArgasya pauShasya tapasastathA | tapasyasya site pakShe tR^itIyAyAM vrataM charet
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति वाक्यैः ‍स्तुवन्मन्त्री देवीभक्तिपरायणः । ध्यायेत्कण्ठीरवारूढां वरदाभयपाणिकाम्
verses.transliteration: iti vAkyaiH {}stuvanmantrI devIbhaktiparAyaNaH | dhyAyetkaNThIravArUDhAM varadAbhayapANikAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं ध्यात्वा महेशानीं भक्ताभीष्टफलप्रदाम् । नानाफलानि पक्वानि नैवेद्यत्वे प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: itthaM dhyAtvA maheshAnIM bhaktAbhIShTaphalapradAm | nAnAphalAni pakvAni naivedyatve prakalpayet
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नैवेद्यं भक्षयेद्यस्तु शम्भुशक्तेः परात्मनः । स निर्धूयाखिलं पङ्कं निर्मलो मानवो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: naivedyaM bhakShayedyastu shambhushakteH parAtmanaH | sa nirdhUyAkhilaM pa~NkaM nirmalo mAnavo bhavet
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: चैत्रशुक्लतृतीयायां यो भवानीव्रतं चरेत् । भवबन्धननिर्मुक्तः प्राप्नुयात्परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: chaitrashuklatR^itIyAyAM yo bhavAnIvrataM charet | bhavabandhananirmuktaH prApnuyAtparamaM padam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: अस्यामेव तृतीयायां कुर्याद्दोलोत्सवं बुधः । पूजयेज्जगतां धात्रीमुमां शङ्करसंयुताम्
verses.transliteration: asyAmeva tR^itIyAyAM kuryAddolotsavaM budhaH | pUjayejjagatAM dhAtrImumAM sha~NkarasaMyutAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कुसुमैः कुङ्कुमैर्वस्त्रैः कर्पूरागुरुचन्दनैः । धूपैर्द्दीपैः सनैवेद्यैः स्रग्गन्धैरपरैरपि
verses.transliteration: kusumaiH ku~NkumairvastraiH karpUrAguruchandanaiH | dhUpairddIpaiH sanaivedyaiH sraggandhairaparairapi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आन्दोलयेत्ततो देवीं महामायां महेश्वरीम् । श्रीगौरीं शिवसंयुक्तां सर्वकल्याणकारिणीम्
verses.transliteration: Andolayettato devIM mahAmAyAM maheshvarIm | shrIgaurIM shivasaMyuktAM sarvakalyANakAriNIm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यब्दं कुरुते योऽस्यां व्रतमान्दोलनं तथा । नियमेन शिवा तस्मै सर्वमिष्टं प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: pratyabdaM kurute yo.asyAM vratamAndolanaM tathA | niyamena shivA tasmai sarvamiShTaM prayachChati
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: माधवस्य सिते पक्षे तृतीया याक्षयाभिधा । तस्यां यो जगदम्बाया व्रतं कुर्यादतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: mAdhavasya site pakShe tR^itIyA yAkShayAbhidhA | tasyAM yo jagadambAyA vrataM kuryAdatandritaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच । द्वैपायन यदेतत्त्वं रहस्यं परिपृच्छसि । तच्छृणुष्व महाबुद्धे सर्वं मे वर्णयिष्यतः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAra uvAcha | dvaipAyana yadetattvaM rahasyaM paripR^ichChasi | tachChR^iNuShva mahAbuddhe sarvaM me varNayiShyataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिजन्मकृतं पापं मनोवाक्कायसम्भवम् । निर्धूय चतुरो वर्गानक्षयानिह सोऽश्नुते
verses.transliteration: koTijanmakR^itaM pApaM manovAkkAyasambhavam | nirdhUya chaturo vargAnakShayAniha so.ashnute
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठे शुक्लतृतीयायां व्रतं कृत्वा महेश्वरीम् । योऽर्चयेत्परमप्रीत्या तस्यासाध्यं न किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: jyeShThe shuklatR^itIyAyAM vrataM kR^itvA maheshvarIm | yo.archayetparamaprItyA tasyAsAdhyaM na ki~nchana
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आषाढशुक्लपक्षीयतृतीयायां रथोत्सवम । देव्याः प्रियतमं कुर्याद्यथावित्तानुसारतः
verses.transliteration: AShADhashuklapakShIyatR^itIyAyAM rathotsavama | devyAH priyatamaM kuryAdyathAvittAnusArataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: रथं पृथ्वीं विजानीयाद्रथाङ्गे चन्द्रभास्करौ । वेदानश्वान्विजानीयात्सारथिं पद्मसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: rathaM pR^ithvIM vijAnIyAdrathA~Nge chandrabhAskarau | vedAnashvAnvijAnIyAtsArathiM padmasambhavam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नानामणिगणाकीर्णं पुष्पमालाविराजितम् । एवं रथं कल्पयित्वा तस्मिन् संस्थापयेच्छिवाम्
verses.transliteration: nAnAmaNigaNAkIrNaM puShpamAlAvirAjitam | evaM rathaM kalpayitvA tasmin saMsthApayechChivAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: लोकसंरक्षणार्थाय लोकं द्रष्टुं पराम्बिका । रथमध्ये संस्थितेति भावयेन्मतिमान्नरः
verses.transliteration: lokasaMrakShaNArthAya lokaM draShTuM parAmbikA | rathamadhye saMsthiteti bhAvayenmatimAnnaraH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: रथे प्रचलिते मन्दं जयशब्दमुदीरयेत् । पाहि देवि जनानस्मान्प्रपन्नान्दीनवत्सले
verses.transliteration: rathe prachalite mandaM jayashabdamudIrayet | pAhi devi janAnasmAnprapannAndInavatsale
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: इति वाक्यैस्तोषयेच्च नानावादित्रनिःस्वनैः । सीमान्ते तु रथं नीत्वा तत्र सम्पूजयेद्रथे
verses.transliteration: iti vAkyaistoShayechcha nAnAvAditraniHsvanaiH | sImAnte tu rathaM nItvA tatra sampUjayedrathe
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नानास्तोत्रैस्ततः स्तुत्वाप्यानयेत्तां स्ववेश्मनि । प्रणिपातशतं कृत्वा प्रार्थयेज्जगदम्बिकाम्
verses.transliteration: nAnAstotraistataH stutvApyAnayettAM svaveshmani | praNipAtashataM kR^itvA prArthayejjagadambikAm
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानयोगः क्रियायोगो भक्तियोगस्तथैव च । त्रयो मार्गाः समाख्याताः श्रीमातुर्भुक्तिमुक्तिदाः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnayogaH kriyAyogo bhaktiyogastathaiva cha | trayo mArgAH samAkhyAtAH shrImAturbhuktimuktidAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लायां तु तृतीयायामेवं श्रावणभाद्रयोः । यो व्रतं कुरुतेऽम्बायाः पूजनं च यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: shuklAyAM tu tR^itIyAyAmevaM shrAvaNabhAdrayoH | yo vrataM kurute.ambAyAH pUjanaM cha yathAvidhi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: मोदते पुत्रपौत्राद्यैर्धनाद्यैरिह सन्ततम् । सोऽन्ते गच्छेदुमालोकं सर्वलोकोपरि स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: modate putrapautrAdyairdhanAdyairiha santatam | so.ante gachChedumAlokaM sarvalokopari sthitam
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आश्विने धवले पक्षे नवरात्रव्रतं चरेत् । यत्कृते सकलाः कामाः सिद्ध्यन्त्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: Ashvine dhavale pakShe navarAtravrataM charet | yatkR^ite sakalAH kAmAH siddhyantyeva na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नवरात्रव्रतस्यास्य प्रभावं वक्तुमीश्वरः । चतुरास्यो न पञ्चास्यो न षडास्यो न कोऽपरः
verses.transliteration: navarAtravratasyAsya prabhAvaM vaktumIshvaraH | chaturAsyo na pa~nchAsyo na ShaDAsyo na ko.aparaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: नवरात्रव्रतं कृत्वा भूपालो विरथात्मजः । हृतं राज्यं निजं लेभे सुरथो मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: navarAtravrataM kR^itvA bhUpAlo virathAtmajaH | hR^itaM rAjyaM nijaM lebhe suratho munisattamAH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवसन्धिसुतो धीमानयोध्याधिपतिर्नृपः । सुदर्शनो हृतं राज्यं प्रापदस्य प्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: dhruvasandhisuto dhImAnayodhyAdhipatirnR^ipaH | sudarshano hR^itaM rAjyaM prApadasya prabhAvataH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतराजमिमं कृत्वा समाराध्य महेश्वरीम् । संसारबन्धनान्मुक्तः समाधिर्मुक्तिभागभूत्
verses.transliteration: vratarAjamimaM kR^itvA samArAdhya maheshvarIm | saMsArabandhanAnmuktaH samAdhirmuktibhAgabhUt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयायां च पञ्चम्यां सप्तम्यामष्टमीतिथौ । नवम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां यो देवी पूजयेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: tR^itIyAyAM cha pa~nchamyAM saptamyAmaShTamItithau | navamyAM vA chaturdashyAM yo devI pUjayennaraH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: आश्विनस्य सिते पक्षे व्रतं कृत्वा विधानतः । तस्य सर्वं मनोऽभीष्टं पूरयत्यनिशं शिवा
verses.transliteration: Ashvinasya site pakShe vrataM kR^itvA vidhAnataH | tasya sarvaM mano.abhIShTaM pUrayatyanishaM shivA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानयोगस्तु संयोगश्चित्तस्यैवात्मना तु यः । यस्तु बाह्यार्थसंयोगः क्रियायोगः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: j~nAnayogastu saMyogashchittasyaivAtmanA tu yaH | yastu bAhyArthasaMyogaH kriyAyogaH sa uchyate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: लोहितैः करवीराद्यैः पुष्पैर्धूपैः सुगन्धितैः । पूजयेन्मङ्गलां देवीं स सर्वं मङ्गलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: lohitaiH karavIrAdyaiH puShpairdhUpaiH sugandhitaiH | pUjayenma~NgalAM devIM sa sarvaM ma~NgalaM labhet
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: सौभाग्याय सदा स्त्रीभिः कार्यमेतन्महाव्रतम् । विद्याधनसुताप्त्यर्थं विधेयं पुरुषैरपि
verses.transliteration: saubhAgyAya sadA strIbhiH kAryametanmahAvratam | vidyAdhanasutAptyarthaM vidheyaM puruShairapi
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: उमामहेश्वरादीनि व्रतान्यन्यानि यान्यपि । देवीप्रियाणि कार्याणि स्वभक्त्यैवं मुमुक्षुभिः
verses.transliteration: umAmaheshvarAdIni vratAnyanyAni yAnyapi | devIpriyANi kAryANi svabhaktyaivaM mumukShubhiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: संहितेयं महापुण्या शिवभक्तिविवर्धिनी । नानाख्यानसमायुक्ता भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा शिवा
verses.transliteration: saMhiteyaM mahApuNyA shivabhaktivivardhinI | nAnAkhyAnasamAyuktA bhuktimuktipradA shivA
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: य एनां शृणुयाद्भक्त्या श्रावयेद्वा समाहितः । पठेद्वा पाठयेद्वापि स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ya enAM shR^iNuyAdbhaktyA shrAvayedvA samAhitaH | paThedvA pAThayedvApi sa yAti paramAM gatim
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य गेहे स्थिता चेयं लिखिता ललिताक्षरैः । सम्पूजिता च विधिवत्सर्वान्कामान्स आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: yasya gehe sthitA cheyaM likhitA lalitAkSharaiH | sampUjitA cha vidhivatsarvAnkAmAnsa ApnuyAt
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भूतप्रेतपिशाचादिदुष्टेभ्यो न भयं क्वचित् । पुत्रपौत्रादिसम्पत्तीर्लभत्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhUtapretapishAchAdiduShTebhyo na bhayaM kvachit | putrapautrAdisampattIrlabhatyeva na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादियं महापुण्या रम्योमासंहिता सदा । श्रोतव्या पठितव्या च शिवभक्तिमभीप्सुभिः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdiyaM mahApuNyA ramyomAsaMhitA sadA | shrotavyA paThitavyA cha shivabhaktimabhIpsubhiH
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तियोगो मतो देव्या आत्मनश्चैक्यभावनम् । त्रयाणामपि योगानां क्रियायोगः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: bhaktiyogo mato devyA AtmanashchaikyabhAvanam | trayANAmapi yogAnAM kriyAyogaH sa uchyate
verses.translation: Hence this charming and meritorious compendium Umasamhita shall always be heard and read by those who seek for devotion to 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.१. प्रथमोऽध्यायः । व्यासशौनकादिसंवादः । अथ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता प्रारभ्यते ॥ नमः शिवाय साम्बाय सगणाय ससूनवे । प्रधानपुरुषेशाय सर्गस्थितत्यन्तहेतवे
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.1\. prathamo.adhyAyaH | vyAsashaunakAdisaMvAdaH | atha ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA prArabhyate || namaH shivAya sAmbAya sagaNAya sasUnave | pradhAnapuruSheshAya sargasthitatyantahetave
verses.translation: O dear, now.listen with pleasure. Out of affection for you I shall narrate the divine Sarhhita Kailasa ex¬ pounding Siva's tenets.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि विश्वेश्वरं साक्षाद्देवदेवमुमापतिम् । नमस्कृत्याथ तैः साकं मुक्तिमण्डपमाविशत्
verses.transliteration: so.api vishveshvaraM sAkShAddevadevamumApatim | namaskR^ityAtha taiH sAkaM muktimaNDapamAvishat
verses.translation: Formerly the sages of great power and splendour performing penances on the summit of Himavat* desired to go to Varanasi** and decided accordingly.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासीनं महात्मानं सूतं पौराणिकोत्तमम् । अर्घ्यादिभिस्तदा सर्वे मुनयः समुपाचरन्
verses.transliteration: tatrAsInaM mahAtmAnaM sUtaM paurANikottamam | arghyAdibhistadA sarve munayaH samupAcharan
verses.translation: They started from the mountain and reached Kai. They decided to bathe there and saw Manikarnika.**

verses.sanskrit: ततः सूतः प्रसन्नात्मा मुनीनालोक्य सुव्रतान् । पप्रच्छ कुशलं तेऽपि प्रोचुः कुशलमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tataH sUtaH prasannAtmA munInAlokya suvratAn | paprachCha kushalaM te.api prochuH kushalamAtmanaH
verses.translation: The lordly sages bathed there and performed the Tarpana rites to the gods and others and to Gahga. They visited ViveiSa the lord of the gods, bowed and worshipked him with devotion The sages, the masters of the Vedas eulogised him with Satarudra and other mantras and thought "O, we are blessed. We are content." Due to Siva's pleasure they realised everything. They remained ever engaged in devotion to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ते तु संहृष्टहृदयं ज्ञात्वा तं वै मुनीश्वराः । प्रणवार्थावगत्यर्थमूचुः प्रास्ताविकं वचः
verses.transliteration: te tu saMhR^iShTahR^idayaM j~nAtvA taM vai munIshvarAH | praNavArthAvagatyarthamUchuH prAstAvikaM vachaH
verses.translation: This celebrated mountain extends from the Eastern to the Western Sea. is formed after the shape oi a bow-string and forms the northern bounds of Bharatavarsa.
verses.hindi: जञति श्रीजिवमहाएराणे पष्उ्यां कैलायसंहितायां व्यासशौनकादिसंवादो नाय प्रथमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । व्यासशिष्य महाभाग सूत पौराणिकोत्तम । धन्यस्त्वं शिवभक्तो हि सर्वविज्ञानसागरः
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | vyAsashiShya mahAbhAga sUta paurANikottama | dhanyastvaM shivabhakto hi sarvavij~nAnasAgaraH
verses.translation: In the meantime Suta who had left his hermitage to visit Paflcakrola*'** reached there. On seeing him the joyous sages paid obeisance to him.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तमेव भगवान्व्यासः सर्वजगद्गुरुः । अभिषिच्य पुराणानां गुरुत्वे समयोजयत्
verses.transliteration: bhavantameva bhagavAnvyAsaH sarvajagadguruH | abhiShichya purANAnAM gurutve samayojayat
verses.translation: After bowing to Viivevara, the lord of gods, the consort of Uma, Suta entered the Muktimacjapa along with diem.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पौराणिकी विद्या भवतो हृदि संस्थिता । पुराणानि च सर्वाणि वेदार्थं प्रवदन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: tasmAtpaurANikI vidyA bhavato hR^idi saMsthitA | purANAni cha sarvANi vedArthaM pravadanti hi
verses.translation: When Suta the great soul, the excellent of the Pauraikas took his seat, the sages paid respects to him with Arghya and other ingredients of worship.

verses.sanskrit: वेदाः प्रणवसम्भूताः प्रणवार्थो महेश्वरः । अतो महेश्वरस्थानं त्वयि धिष्ण्यं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: vedAH praNavasambhUtAH praNavArtho maheshvaraH | ato maheshvarasthAnaM tvayi dhiShNyaM pratiShThitam
verses.translation: The delighted Suta saw the sages of auspicious rites and enquired after their health and welfare. They replied suitably.

verses.sanskrit: त्वन्मुखाब्जपरिस्यन्दन्मकरन्देमनोहरम् । प्रणवार्थामृतं पीत्वा भविष्यामो गतज्वराः
verses.transliteration: tvanmukhAbjaparisyandanmakarandemanoharam | praNavArthAmR^itaM pItvA bhaviShyAmo gatajvarAH
verses.translation: O blessed disciple of Vyasa, O Suta the best among the Pauraikas, you are a great devotee of Siva, the ocean of perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषतो गुरुस्त्वं हि नान्योऽस्माकं महामते । परं भावं महेशस्य परया कृपया वद
verses.transliteration: visheShato gurustvaM hi nAnyo.asmAkaM mahAmate | paraM bhAvaM maheshasya parayA kR^ipayA vada
verses.translation: Lord Vyasa, the preceptor of the universe has crowned you as the chief of the Pauranikas and made you the propounder of the Puraias.
verses.hindi: की, तब वे प्रसन्‍नमनसे देवीसे कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । श्रुतोमासंहिता रम्या नानाख्यानसमन्विता । कैलाससंहितां ब्रूहि शिवतत्त्वविवर्धिनीम्
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | shrutomAsaMhitA ramyA nAnAkhyAnasamanvitA | kailAsasaMhitAM brUhi shivatattvavivardhinIm
verses.translation: Vedas arise from the Pranava. The Prapava is lord Siva. Hence you are the permanent abode of lord Siva*s stay.

verses.sanskrit: इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा सूतो व्यासप्रियः सुधीः । गणेशं षण्मुखं साक्षान्महेशानं महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: iti teShAM vachaH shrutvA sUto vyAsapriyaH sudhIH | gaNeshaM ShaNmukhaM sAkShAnmaheshAnaM maheshvarIm
verses.translation: We shall be free from illness after we have drunk the nectar of Pranava which is as sweet and pleasing as the honey oozing out of your lotus-mouth.

verses.sanskrit: शिलादतनयं देवं नन्दीशं सुयशापतिम् । सनत्कुमारं व्यासं च प्रणिपत्येदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: shilAdatanayaM devaM nandIshaM suyashApatim | sanatkumAraM vyAsaM cha praNipatyedamabravIt
verses.translation: O intelligent one, you alone are our preceptor, none else. Out of compassion please narrate the nature of lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । साधु साधु महाभागा मुनयः क्षीणकल्मषाः । मतिर्दृढतरा जाता दुर्लभा सापि दुष्कृताम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | sAdhu sAdhu mahAbhAgA munayaH kShINakalmaShAH | matirdR^iDhatarA jAtA durlabhA sApi duShkR^itAm
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the intelligent Suta, the beloved disciple of Vyasa, made obeisance to Gaela,
verses.hindi: प्रणबके निश्चित अर्थकों सुनना चाहती हूँ

verses.sanskrit: पाराशर्येण गुरुणा नैमिषारण्यवासिनाम् । मुनीनामुपदिष्टं यद् वक्ष्ये तन्मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: pArAsharyeNa guruNA naimiShAraNyavAsinAm | munInAmupadiShTaM yad vakShye tanmunipu~NgavAH
verses.translation: The region upto the distance of five Kronas round Varinasi is called Paficakroii. It is sacred to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण शिवभक्तिर्भवेन्नृणाम् । सावधाना भवन्तोऽद्य शृण्वन्तु परया मुदा
verses.transliteration: yasya shravaNamAtreNa shivabhaktirbhavennR^iNAm | sAvadhAnA bhavanto.adya shR^iNvantu parayA mudA
verses.translation: Well done, well done, O blessed sages, your sins have been quelled. Your minds are steadied. It is rare in persons of evil deeds.
verses.hindi: ड्र्ति “2226० हा केलाससंहितायां देवीदेवसंवादे देवीकृतप्रश्नवर्णन॑ नाम द्वितीयोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे पूर्वं तपस्यन्तो दृढव्रताः । ऋषयो नैमिषारण्ये सर्वसिद्धनिषेविते
verses.transliteration: svArochiShe.antare pUrvaM tapasyanto dR^iDhavratAH | R^iShayo naimiShAraNye sarvasiddhaniShevite
verses.translation: O leading sages, I shall narrate to you what was mentioned by my preceptor Vyasa to the sages in the Naimia forest. On hearing this alone men are blessed with devotion to Siva. You shall listen with attention and joy.
verses.hindi: प्रश्नवर्णन नामक दूसरा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घसत्रं वितन्वन्तो रुद्रमध्वरनायकम् । प्रीणयन्तः परं भावमैश्वर्यं ज्ञातुमिच्छवः
verses.transliteration: dIrghasatraM vitanvanto rudramadhvaranAyakam | prINayantaH paraM bhAvamaishvaryaM j~nAtumichChavaH
verses.translation: Formerly in the Svarocisa Manvantara, sages of steady rites performed penance in the Naimisa'® forest where all the Siddhas live. They conducted a sacrifice of long duration, propitiated Rudra the leader of sacrifices. They desired to know the supreme nature of the lord. They waited for Vyasa. They were engaged in devotion to Siva and wore Rudrak after smearing their bodies with the ashes.
verses.hindi: सुननेमात्रसे जीव साक्षात् शिव हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: निवसन्ति स्म ते सर्वे व्यासदर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः । शिवभक्तिरता नित्यं भस्मरुद्राक्षधारिणः
verses.transliteration: nivasanti sma te sarve vyAsadarshanakA~NkShiNaH | shivabhaktiratA nityaM bhasmarudrAkShadhAriNaH
verses.translation: Observing their eagerness, lord Badarayana, the soul of all, the fruit of the penance of Paraiara appeared before them.
verses.hindi: नामक वह मन्त्र सभी विद्याओंका बीज है

verses.sanskrit: तेषां भावं समालोक्य भगवान्बादरायणः । प्रादुर्बभूव सर्वात्मा पराशरतपःफलम्
verses.transliteration: teShAM bhAvaM samAlokya bhagavAnbAdarAyaNaH | prAdurbabhUva sarvAtmA parAsharatapaHphalam
verses.translation: On seeing him the sages were delighted with beaming eyes and faces. They stood up and welcomed him with reverence.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे प्रहृष्टवदनेक्षणाः । अभ्युत्थानादिभिः सर्वैरुपचारैरुपाचरन्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA munayaH sarve prahR^iShTavadanekShaNAH | abhyutthAnAdibhiH sarvairupachArairupAcharan
verses.translation: With due hospitality they offered him a golden seat. Seated cosily on the golden seat the sage Vyasa spoke majestically.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । शृणुत प्रीतितो वत्साः कैलासाख्यां हि संहिताम् । शिवतत्त्वपरां दिव्यां वक्ष्ये वः स्नेहतः पराम्
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | shR^iNuta prItito vatsAH kailAsAkhyAM hi saMhitAm | shivatattvaparAM divyAM vakShye vaH snehataH parAm
verses.translation: Hope you are quite well. Please say. Has the leader of the sacrifices been worshipped well by you in this sacrifice?

verses.sanskrit: सत्कृत्य प्रददुस्तस्मै सौवर्णं विष्टरं शुभम् । सुखोपविष्टः स तदा तस्मिन्सौवर्णविष्टरे । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा पाराशर्यो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: satkR^itya pradadustasmai sauvarNaM viShTaraM shubham | sukhopaviShTaH sa tadA tasminsauvarNaviShTare | prAha gambhIrayA vAchA pArAsharyo mahAmuniH
verses.translation: Why lord Siva accompanied by Amba, the lord who releases from worldly bondage has been worshipp>ed with due devotion by you all in this sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । कुशलं किं नु युष्माकं प्रब्रूतास्मिन्महामखे । अर्चितः किं नु युष्माभिः सम्यगध्वरनायकः
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | kushalaM kiM nu yuShmAkaM prabrUtAsminmahAmakhe | architaH kiM nu yuShmAbhiH samyagadhvaranAyakaH
verses.translation: Your activity seems to me to be the outcome of
verses.hindi: मन्हत्रोंमें श्रेष्ठ इसी प्रणणका उपदेश करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थमत्र युष्माभिरध्वरे परमेश्वरः । स्वर्चितो भक्तिभावेन साम्बः संसारमोचकः
verses.transliteration: kimarthamatra yuShmAbhiradhvare parameshvaraH | svarchito bhaktibhAvena sAmbaH saMsAramochakaH
verses.translation: Thus urged by the sage Vyiisa of great brilliance the great sages of the Naimisa forest bowed to him, the noble soul whose mind was delighted by his devotion to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: युष्मत्प्रवृत्तिर्मे भाति शुश्रूषापूर्वमेव हि । परभावे महेशस्य मुक्तिहेतोः शिवस्य च
verses.transliteration: yuShmatpravR^ittirme bhAti shushrUShApUrvameva hi | parabhAve maheshasya muktihetoH shivasya cha
verses.translation: O holy lord, O leading sage, born of Narayana's part, O storehouse of mercy, O intelligent one, O holy lord of all lores, you are the storehouse of the favours of
verses.hindi: करनेवालोंको सदा मुक्ति प्रदान करता है

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता मुनीन्द्रेण व्यासेनामिततेजसा । मुनयो नैमिषारण्यवासिनः परमौजसः
verses.transliteration: evamuktA munIndreNa vyAsenAmitatejasA | munayo naimiShAraNyavAsinaH paramaujasaH
verses.translation: Our minds have been yearning for the sight of your lotus feet even as the bees yearn for the touch of lotus flowers. We arc now satisfied by the vision of your loti:< feet.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपत्य महात्मानं पाराशशर्यं महामुनिम् । शिवानुरागसंहृष्टमानसं च तमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: praNipatya mahAtmAnaM pArAshasharyaM mahAmunim | shivAnurAgasaMhR^iShTamAnasaM cha tamabruvan
verses.translation: Inacrc'jsibir indeed the sight of your lotus feet to the sinners. Since now we have obtained it we are really fortunate.
verses.hindi: स्थित मकार अग्निकी भाँति तेजोमय है

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । भगवन्मुनिशार्दूल साक्षान्नारायणांशज । कृपानिधे महाप्राज्ञ सर्वविद्याधिप प्रभो
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | bhagavanmunishArdUla sAkShAnnArAyaNAMshaja | kR^ipAnidhe mahAprAj~na sarvavidyAdhipa prabho
verses.translation: O blessed one, we arc pei forming this long
verses.hindi: उसे तो ज्ञानीलोग ही जान सकते हैं

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सर्वजगद्भर्तुर्महादेवस्य वेधसः । साम्बस्य सगणस्यास्य प्रसादानां निधिः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tvaM hi sarvajagadbharturmahAdevasya vedhasaH | sAmbasya sagaNasyAsya prasAdAnAM nidhiH svayam
verses.translation: There is none else in the ihice *\oilds to clear
verses.hindi: हैं, इस प्रकारकी भावना सर्वत्र करनी चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्पादाब्जरसास्वादमधुपायितमानसाः । कृतार्था वयमद्यैव भवत्पादाब्जदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: tvatpAdAbjarasAsvAdamadhupAyitamAnasAH | kR^itArthA vayamadyaiva bhavatpAdAbjadarshanAt
verses.translation: Requested by the sages the master of the
verses.hindi: पर्यन्त पाँच ब्रह्म स्थित हैं, वे मेरी ही मूर्तियाँ हैं

verses.sanskrit: त्वदीयचरणाम्भोजदर्शनं खलु पापिनाम् । दुर्लभं लब्धमस्माभिस्तस्मात्सुकृतिनो वयम्
verses.transliteration: tvadIyacharaNAmbhojadarshanaM khalu pApinAm | durlabhaM labdhamasmAbhistasmAtsukR^itino vayam
verses.translation: O blessed brahmins, the question has been well put by you. The knowledge of Siva's principle that illumi¬ nates the meaning of Pranava 's incomprehensible. It can be obtained surely by those with whom the trident-bearing lord is pleased and not by others who are undoubtedly devoid of Siva's devotion. This is true.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवच्छिखरे पूर्वं तपस्यन्तो महौजसः । वाराणसीं गन्तुकामा मुनयः कृतसंविदः
verses.transliteration: himavachChikhare pUrvaM tapasyanto mahaujasaH | vArANasIM gantukAmA munayaH kR^itasaMvidaH
verses.translation: Lord Siva, consort of Amba, has been adored by you by long sacrifices. This I see actually.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्देशे महाभाग नैमिषारण्यसंज्ञके । दीर्घसत्रान्विताः सर्वे प्रणवार्थप्रकाशकाः
verses.transliteration: asmindeshe mahAbhAga naimiShAraNyasa.nj~nake | dIrghasatrAnvitAH sarve praNavArthaprakAshakAH
verses.translation: O devotees, I shall narrate to you an ancient story containing a wonderful dialogue between Uma and Siva.
verses.hindi: गर्भमें ही योगयुक्त हो गये थे

verses.sanskrit: श्रोतव्यः परमेशान इति कृत्वा विनिश्चिताः । परस्परं चिन्तयन्तः परं भावं महेशितुः
verses.transliteration: shrotavyaH parameshAna iti kR^itvA vinishchitAH | parasparaM chintayantaH paraM bhAvaM maheshituH
verses.translation: Formerly Sati, daughter of Daksa, the mother of the universe abandoned her body in the sacrifice of her father in view of the insult offered to Siva. As a result of the penance the goddess became the daughter of the Himavat. On the advice of Narada she performed a penance for Siva on that mountain. When lord Siva married her with Svayaihvara rites Parvati attained happiness.
verses.hindi: आलेहहह्ड  थक साथ मेरा स्मरण सदा करता रहे

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञातवन्त एवैते वयं तस्माद्भवान्प्रभो । छेत्तुमर्हति तान्सर्वान् संशयानल्पचेतसाम्
verses.transliteration: aj~nAtavanta evaite vayaM tasmAdbhavAnprabho | Chettumarhati tAnsarvAn saMshayAnalpachetasAm
verses.translation: O omniscient lord who hath ordained to himself the five-fold duties, O lord easily accessible through devotion, O lord of nectarine body, I was the daughter of Dak in my former birth. I abandoned my body because of the insult offered to you. I have now become the daughter of the mountain Himavat.
verses.hindi: मत्तो विज्ञानमासाद्य मत्सायुज्यफलं प्रिये॥ ७०  फल प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेता न हि जगत्त्रये । तस्मादपारगम्भीरव्यामोहाब्धौ निमज्जतः
verses.transliteration: tvadanyaH saMshayasyAsya ChetA na hi jagattraye | tasmAdapAragambhIravyAmohAbdhau nimajjataH
verses.translation: O lord, please make me merged in the principle of pure Atman by duly initiating me in the Mantras.
verses.hindi: गति श्रीशिवयहाएुराणे पष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायों संन्यासपद्धतिवर्णन॑ 7774: तृतीयो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तारयस्व शिवज्ञानपोतेनास्मान्दयानिधे । शिवसद्भक्तितत्त्वार्थं ज्ञातुं श्रद्धालवो वयम्
verses.transliteration: tArayasva shivaj~nAnapotenAsmAndayAnidhe | shivasadbhaktitattvArthaM j~nAtuM shraddhAlavo vayam
verses.translation: Thus requested by the goddess the moon-crested lord replied to the goddess with a delighted mind.

verses.sanskrit: एवमभ्यर्थितस्तत्र मुनिभिर्वेदपारगैः । सर्ववेदार्थविन्मुख्यः शुकतातो महामुनिः । वेदान्तसारसर्वस्वं प्रणवं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evamabhyarthitastatra munibhirvedapAragaiH | sarvavedArthavinmukhyaH shukatAto mahAmuniH | vedAntasArasarvasvaM praNavaM parameshvaram
verses.translation: Then after leaving Himavat and reaching Kailasa, the lord of mountains, liva, recited mantras Pranava and others in the proper order after duly initiating her.
verses.hindi: तब स्नेहान्महादेवि संप्रदायानुरोधत:॥ १  लेनेसे पूर्वके आहिक कर्मका वर्णन करूँगा

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा हृत्कर्णिकामध्ये साम्बं संसारमोचकम् । प्रहृष्टमानसो भूत्वा व्याजहार महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: dhyAtvA hR^itkarNikAmadhye sAmbaM saMsAramochakam | prahR^iShTamAnaso bhUtvA vyAjahAra mahAmuniH
verses.translation: Then making the goddess merged in the pure Atman, lord Siva went to his garden accompanied by the goddess.
verses.hindi: बाहर निकलकर सुविधानुरूप दूर चला जाय

verses.sanskrit: निर्गत्य तस्मात्सम्प्राप्य गिरेः काशीं समाहिताः । स्नातव्यमेवेति तदा ददृशुर्मणिकर्णिकाम्
verses.transliteration: nirgatya tasmAtsamprApya gireH kAshIM samAhitAH | snAtavyameveti tadA dadR^ishurmaNikarNikAm
verses.translation: Siva bedecked the goddess with the full¬ blown kalpa tree" flowers brought by the dearest friends of the goddess the chief of whom was Sumalini. He made her sit on his lap. Looking at her face he sat there with his face beaming with delight.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा सुसन्तर्प्य देवादीनथ जाह्नवीम् । दृष्ट्वा स्नात्वा मुनीशास्ते विश्वेशं त्रिदशेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snAtvA susantarpya devAdInatha jAhnavIm | dR^iShTvA snAtvA munIshAste vishveshaM tridasheshvaram
verses.translation: Then ensued the delightful discourse conformable to the Vedas between Parvatl and lord Siva. It was meant for the welfare of the world.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्याथ सम्पूज्य भक्त्या परमयान्विताः । शतरुद्रादिभिः स्तुत्वा स्तुतिभिर्वेदपारगाः
verses.transliteration: namaskR^ityAtha sampUjya bhaktyA paramayAnvitAH | shatarudrAdibhiH stutvA stutibhirvedapAragAH
verses.translation: O ascetics, then the mother of the universe seated on the lap of her husband looked at the lord's face and said.
verses.hindi: करे और वहाँ क्रमसे मण्डलकी रचना करे

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं मेनिरे सर्वे कृतार्था वयमित्युत । शिवप्रीत्या सुपूर्णार्थाः शिवभक्तिरताः सदा
verses.transliteration: AtmAnaM menire sarve kR^itArthA vayamityuta | shivaprItyA supUrNArthAH shivabhaktiratAH sadA
verses.translation: O lord, you have discoursed on the Mantras in¬ cluding the, Pranava. There at the outset I wish to know the meaning of the Pranava.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे वष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां संन्यासाचारवर्णन॑ नाम चतुर्थो3 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवसरे सूतं पञ्चक्रोशदिदृक्षया । गत्वा समागतं वीक्ष्य मुदा ते तं ववन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: tasminnavasare sUtaM pa~nchakroshadidR^ikShayA | gatvA samAgataM vIkShya mudA te taM vavandire
verses.translation: How many deities are mentioned? What is the concept of the Vedas thereto? What types of rites are men¬ tioned? What is their cause and what is their result?

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Thus implored, the moon-crested lord praised the goddess and began to. xplain.
verses.hindi: कक मनन चतुरस्त्र प्रकल्पयेत्॥ २  प्रमाणके चौकोर मण्डलका निर्माण करे

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Thus implored, the moon-crested lord praised the goddess and began to. xplain.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam
verses.translation: Thus implored, the moon-crested lord praised the goddess and began to. xplain.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.२. द्वितीयोऽध्यायः । देवीदेवसंवादे देवीकृतप्रश्नवर्णनम् । व्यास उवाच । साधु पृष्टमिदं विप्रा भवद्भिर्भाग्यवत्तमैः । दुर्लभं हि शिवज्ञानं प्रणवार्थप्रकाशकम्
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.2\. dvitIyo.adhyAyaH | devIdevasaMvAde devIkR^itaprashnavarNanam | vyAsa uvAcha | sAdhu pR^iShTamidaM viprA bhavadbhirbhAgyavattamaiH | durlabhaM hi shivaj~nAnaM praNavArthaprakAshakam
verses.translation: O goddess, listen. I shall explain what you have asked for. Merely by hearing this the individual soul becomes Siva himself.

verses.sanskrit: महादेव्युवाच । भगवन्परमेशान पञ्चकृत्यविधायक । सर्वज्ञ भक्तिसुलभ परमामृतविग्रह
verses.transliteration: mahAdevyuvAcha | bhagavanparameshAna pa~nchakR^ityavidhAyaka | sarvaj~na bhaktisulabha paramAmR^itavigraha
verses.translation: It shall be understood as very subtle but possessed of great meaning even as the seed of the Banyan tree though very small contains.i huge tree. It is the initial mantra and the essence of tlie Vedas. Particularly it has me for its form.
verses.hindi: इस श्रेष्ठ बीजमन्त्रको पद्मयके मध्यमें लिखे

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षायणीं तनुं त्यक्त्वा तव निन्दाप्रसङ्गतः । आसमद्य महेशान पुत्री हिमवतो गिरेः
verses.transliteration: dAkShAyaNIM tanuM tyaktvA tava nindAprasa~NgataH | Asamadya maheshAna putrI himavato gireH
verses.translation: I am the loid far beyond the attributes, the omnis¬ cient and the omnipotent. I am.'iva pervading all but

verses.sanskrit: कृपया परमेशान मन्त्रदीक्षाविधानतः । मां विशुद्धात्मतत्त्वस्थां कुरु नित्यं महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: kR^ipayA parameshAna mantradIkShAvidhAnataH | mAM vishuddhAtmatattvasthAM kuru nityaM maheshvara
verses.translation: The brahminical sages, the scholars who realize the identity between the sense and the sound know me as tho single-syllabled Om.

verses.sanskrit: इति सम्प्रार्थितो देव्या देवः शीतांशुभूषणः । प्रत्युवाच ततो देवीं प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: iti samprArthito devyA devaH shItAMshubhUShaNaH | pratyuvAcha tato devIM prahR^iShTenAntarAtmanA
verses.translation: Hence he who aspires for salvation and is free fronr aberration shall understand Pranava as the cause of all and me as the Nirguna Paramesvara.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां संन्यासमण्डलविधिवर्णनं नाम पश्चमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: महादेव उवाच । धन्या त्वं देवदेवशि यदि जातेदृशी मतिः । कैलासशिखरं गत्वा करिष्ये त्वां च तादृशीम्
verses.transliteration: mahAdeva uvAcha | dhanyA tvaM devadevashi yadi jAtedR^ishI matiH | kailAsashikharaM gatvA kariShye tvAM cha tAdR^ishIm
verses.translation: O goddess, I shall give this crest-jewel of mantras at Kasi for the liberation of all Individual souls.

verses.sanskrit: ततो हिमवतो गत्वा कैलासं भूधरेश्वरम् । जगौ दीक्षाविधानेन प्रणवादीन्मनून् क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tato himavato gatvA kailAsaM bhUdhareshvaram | jagau dIkShAvidhAnena praNavAdInmanUn kramAt
verses.translation: O Ainba, there at the outset I shall cxpLii' Pranavoddhara, the knowledge of which imparts the greatest achievement.
verses.hindi: उच्चारण करते हुए विश्विवत् प्राणायाम करे

verses.sanskrit: उक्त्वा मन्त्रांश्च तान्देवीं कृत्वा शुद्धात्मनि स्थिताम् । सार्धं देव्या महादेवो देवोद्यानं गतोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: uktvA mantrAMshcha tAndevIM kR^itvA shuddhAtmani sthitAm | sArdhaM devyA mahAdevo devodyAnaM gato.abhavat
verses.translation: Firstly the devotee shall extricate Nivrtti, then the the fuel, time, s. iff, and the lord.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुमालिनीमुख्यैर्देव्याः प्रियसखीजनैः । समाहृतैः प्रफुल्लैस्तैः पुष्पैः कल्पतरूद्भवैः
verses.transliteration: tataH sumAlinImukhyairdevyAH priyasakhIjanaiH | samAhR^itaiH praphullaistaiH puShpaiH kalpatarUdbhavaiH
verses.translation: It consists of A, U and M in the middle, Bindu and Nada at the end. That is Om.

verses.sanskrit: अलङ्कृत्य महादेवीं स्वाङ्कमारोप्य शङ्करः । प्रहृष्टवदनस्तस्थौ विलोक्य च तदाननम्
verses.transliteration: ala~NkR^itya mahAdevIM svA~NkamAropya sha~NkaraH | prahR^iShTavadanastasthau vilokya cha tadAnanam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, the first letter (A) is like water in the south, the second letter (U) is in the north; the letter M is like fire in the m>iddlc, before Nada and Bindu.
verses.hindi: है, इसे ग्रहणकर आप प्रसन्‍न होइये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रियकथा जाताः पार्वतीपरमेशयोः । हिताय सर्वलोकानां साक्षाच्छ्रुत्यर्थसम्मिताः
verses.transliteration: tataH priyakathA jAtAH pArvatIparameshayoH | hitAya sarvalokAnAM sAkShAchChrutyarthasammitAH
verses.translation: The three Matias arc thus mentioned in order: A. U. M. Half a mrura is beyond it.

verses.sanskrit: येषां प्रसन्नो भगवान्साक्षाच्छूलवरायुधः । तेषामेव शिवज्ञानं प्रणवार्थप्रकाशकम्
verses.transliteration: yeShAM prasanno bhagavAnsAkShAchChUlavarAyudhaH | teShAmeva shivaj~nAnaM praNavArthaprakAshakam
verses.translation: O beloved, the Vcdic texts beginning with **Xsanab Sarvavidyanam'*®* issue from me. The Vedas indeed speak the truth.

verses.sanskrit: तदा सर्वजगन्माता भर्तुरङ्कं समाश्रिता । विलोक्य वदनं भर्तुरिदमाहः तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: tadA sarvajaganmAtA bhartura~NkaM samAshritA | vilokya vadanaM bharturidamAhaH tapodhanAH
verses.translation: 1 am the source of the Vedas. Pranava expresses me. Since it expresses me the Pranava too is mentioned as Vedadi.

verses.sanskrit: कथं प्रणव उत्पन्नः कथं प्रणव उच्यते । मात्राः कति समाख्याताः कथं वेदादिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: kathaM praNava utpannaH kathaM praNava uchyate | mAtrAH kati samAkhyAtAH kathaM vedAdiruchyate
verses.translation: 'A* is the great BIja, Rajas, the four-faced creator. 'U' is the Prakrti, source, Sattva, the protector Vinu.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेव्युवाच । उपदिष्टास्त्वया देव मन्त्राः सप्रणवा मताः । तत्रादौ श्रोतुमिच्छामि प्रणवार्थं विनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: shrIdevyuvAcha | upadiShTAstvayA deva mantrAH sapraNavA matAH | tatrAdau shrotumichChAmi praNavArthaM vinishchitam
verses.translation: In the letters 'A' etc. the later one is pervasive of the earlier. The earlier one is the pervaded.

verses.sanskrit: देवताः कति च प्रोक्ताः कथं देवादिभावना । क्रियाः कतिविधाः प्रोक्ता व्याप्यव्यापकता कथम्
verses.transliteration: devatAH kati cha proktAH kathaM devAdibhAvanA | kriyAH katividhAH proktA vyApyavyApakatA katham
verses.translation: In the letters 'A' etc. the later one is pervasive of the earlier. The earlier one is the pervaded.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणि पञ्च मन्त्रेऽस्मिन्कथं तिष्ठन्त्यनुक्रमात् । कलाः कति समाख्याताः प्रपञ्चात्मकता कथम्
verses.transliteration: brahmANi pa~ncha mantre.asminkathaM tiShThantyanukramAt | kalAH kati samAkhyAtAH prapa~nchAtmakatA katham
verses.translation: The five Brahmans'®® beginning with Sadya and ending with Isana arc stationed in the five letters *A' etc. They are my very forms in order.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीश्िवमहाएुराणे, पष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां संन्यासपद्धतो न्यासवर्णन॑ नाम बच्छो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: वाच्यवाचकसम्बन्धस्थानानि च कथं शिव । कोऽत्राधिकारी विज्ञेयो विषयः क उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: vAchyavAchakasambandhasthAnAni cha kathaM shiva | ko.atrAdhikArI vij~neyo viShayaH ka udAhR^itaH
verses.translation: O Siva, in the syllable 'A' eight Kalas of the
verses.hindi: न्यासवर्णन नामक छठा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: सम्बन्धः कोऽत्र विज्ञेयः किं प्रयोजनमुच्यते । उपासकस्तु किंरूपः किं वा स्थानमुपासनम्
verses.transliteration: sambandhaH ko.atra vij~neyaH kiM prayojanamuchyate | upAsakastu kiMrUpaH kiM vA sthAnamupAsanam
verses.translation: The eight Kalas of the form of Aghora arc statio¬ ned in 'M'. In Bindu four Kalas of the form of Purusa exist.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यं वस्तु किंरूपं किं वा फलमुपासितुः । अनुष्ठानविधिः कोवा पूजास्थानं च किं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: upAsyaM vastu kiMrUpaM kiM vA phalamupAsituH | anuShThAnavidhiH kovA pUjAsthAnaM cha kiM prabho
verses.translation: In Nada five Kalas born of I.ana arc present.

verses.sanskrit: पूजायां मण्डलं किं वा किं वा ऋष्यादिकं हर । न्यासजापविधिः को वा को वा पूजाविधिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: pUjAyAM maNDalaM kiM vA kiM vA R^iShyAdikaM hara | nyAsajApavidhiH ko vA ko vA pUjAvidhikramaH
verses.translation: The sixfold objects constitute Mantra, Yantra,

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं महेशान समाचक्ष्व विशेषतः । श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन यद्यस्ति मयि ते कृपा
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaM maheshAna samAchakShva visheShataH | shrotumichChAmi tattvena yadyasti mayi te kR^ipA
verses.translation: The places of articulation, O goddess are'.Adhara (support) Manipura (jewel-refill) Hrdaya ( heart ) VHuddhi (purity) Ajfia (order) 8akti (power) Isanti. Beyond l§anti is the lord who is greater than the greatest. The authorised person is he whose non-attachment is firm and stable.

verses.sanskrit: जायते न हि सन्देहो नेतरेषामिति श्रुतिः । शिवभक्तिविहीनानामिति तत्त्वार्थनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: jAyate na hi sandeho netareShAmiti shrutiH | shivabhaktivihInAnAmiti tattvArthanishchayaH
verses.translation: O goddess, I shall be the theme, thanks to the concept of the identity of the individual and the universal soul. The subject has been clearly mentioned. O goddess, now listen. The link of the Jiva and the Atman with me and the Pranava is as between the word and its sense.
verses.hindi: ममावरणपूजां च॒ प्रारभेत विचक्षण:॥ ८०  आरम्भ करे

verses.sanskrit: इति देव्या समापृष्टो भगवानिन्दुभूषणः । सम्प्रशस्य महेशानीं वक्तुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: iti devyA samApR^iShTo bhagavAnindubhUShaNaH | samprashasya maheshAnIM vaktuM samupachakrame
verses.translation: A brahmin with the following characteristics shall approach the preceptor with the requisite qualifications. He shall be regularly engaged in holy rites, be calm, per¬ form penance, shall have self-control, be a brahmin well- versed in the Vedas and endowed with cleanliness and good conduct, unattached to the pleasures of this world and of the next and of the worlds of the gods. He shall per¬ form the holy rites of iSiva. The preceptor shall be one who has understood the tenets and the meanings of sacred texts; who has mastered Vedanta; who is an ascetic and the most excellent of intelligent men. After approaching him the intelligent brahmin shall prostrate before him and propi¬ tiate him by reverential deeds. That diseiple is the most excellent who possesses good behaviour and the qualities of peaceful calmness. The disciple shall realise that preceptor is Siva and Siva is the preceptor. *rhen he shall reveal his thought.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीजिवमहाएुराणे पष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां शिवध्यानपूजनवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घसत्रेण युष्माभिर्भगवानम्बिकापतिः । उपासित इतीदं मे दृष्टमद्य विनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: dIrghasatreNa yuShmAbhirbhagavAnambikApatiH | upAsita itIdaM me dR^iShTamadya vinishchitam
verses.translation: After being permitted by the preceptor the brahmin devotee shall perform holy rites without taking anything e.xcept milk, lor twelve days on the sea-shore, or on the banks of a river, or on a mountain oi in a temple of

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्वक्ष्यामि युष्माकमितिहासं पुरातनम् । उमामहेशसंवादरूपमद्भुतमास्तिकाः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdvakShyAmi yuShmAkamitihAsaM purAtanam | umAmaheshasaMvAdarUpamadbhutamAstikAH
verses.translation: Then he shall take bath and cook the Caru. He shall perform the sacrifice beginning with Purusa and ending with the Viraja suktas.

verses.sanskrit: पुराखिलजगन्माता सती दाक्षायणी तनुम् । शिवनिन्दाप्रसङ्गेन त्यक्त्वा च जनकाध्वरे
verses.transliteration: purAkhilajaganmAtA satI dAkShAyaNI tanum | shivanindAprasa~Ngena tyaktvA cha janakAdhvare
verses.translation: The procedure may follow the opinion of Viimadcva or of Sanaka and others. But the important one is that of Viimadeva because he was a liberated soul even while lu: was in the womb.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभावात्सा देवी सुताभूद्धिमवद्गिरेः । शिवार्थमतपत्सा वै नारदस्योपदेशतः
verses.transliteration: tataH prabhAvAtsA devI sutAbhUddhimavadgireH | shivArthamatapatsA vai nAradasyopadeshataH
verses.translation: After performing the remaining rites of the sacrifice he shall perform the Aupasana rites of the morning. Then he shall superimpose Agni in the Atman and perform the morning prayers.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्भूधरवर्ये तु स्वयंवरविधानतः । देवेशे च कृतोद्वाहे पार्वती सुखमाप सा
verses.transliteration: tasminbhUdharavarye tu svayaMvaravidhAnataH | deveshe cha kR^itodvAhe pArvatI sukhamApa sA
verses.translation: When the sun has arisen he shall recite Savitri. He shall eschew the three Esanas and repeat the Presa*®* mantras.

verses.sanskrit: तथैकस्मिन्महादेवी समये पतिना सह । सूपविष्टा महाशैले गौरी देवमभाषत
verses.transliteration: tathaikasminmahAdevI samaye patinA saha | sUpaviShTA mahAshaile gaurI devamabhAShata
verses.translation: He shall abandon the tuft, the sacred thread and the girdle too. He shall start to the cast or to the north.
verses.hindi: तथा सर्वेशकी पश्चिमदिशाके पत्रपर पूजा करे

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The teacher shall take the white ashes from the Viraja fire and smear it over the body of the disciple. Repeating the mantra "Agniriti" etc. he shall make the three marks Tripundra on his forehead. He shall think of me stationed in the lotus of the heart along with you.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The teacher shall take the white ashes from the Viraja fire and smear it over the body of the disciple. Repeating the mantra "Agniriti" etc. he shall make the three marks Tripundra on his forehead. He shall think of me stationed in the lotus of the heart along with you.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam
verses.translation: The teacher shall take the white ashes from the Viraja fire and smear it over the body of the disciple. Repeating the mantra "Agniriti" etc. he shall make the three marks Tripundra on his forehead. He shall think of me stationed in the lotus of the heart along with you.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.३. तृतीयोऽध्यायः । संन्यासपद्धतिवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि । तस्य श्रवणमात्रेण जीवः साक्षाच्छिवो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.3\. tR^itIyo.adhyAyaH | sa.nnyAsapaddhativarNanam | Ishvara uvAcha | shR^iNu devi pravakShyAmi yanmAM tvaM paripR^ichChasi | tasya shravaNamAtreNa jIvaH sAkShAchChivo bhavet
verses.translation: Then the teacher shall place his hand on the head of the disciple. With a delighted mind, the preceptor shall utter the Pranava mantra thrice in the right ear of the disciple mentioning the sage etc. Then ho shall tell him the sixfold meaning.
verses.hindi: शिवका '३» शिव' इस प्रकार स्मरण करे

verses.sanskrit: एनमेव हि देवेशि सर्वमन्त्रशिरोमणिम् । काश्यामहं प्रदास्यामि जीवानां मुक्तिहेतवे
verses.transliteration: enameva hi deveshi sarvamantrashiromaNim | kAshyAmahaM pradAsyAmi jIvAnAM muktihetave
verses.translation: The disciple shall bow prostrate before the precr- tor on the ground twelve tunes. He shall remain subser¬ vient to him and practise the study of the Vedanta strenuously.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रादौ सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रणवोद्धारमम्बिके । यस्य विज्ञानमात्रेण सिद्धिश्च परमा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatrAdau sampravakShyAmi praNavoddhAramambike | yasya vij~nAnamAtreNa siddhishcha paramA bhavet
verses.translation: He shall ponder and meditate in the pure Atman without aberrations, upon me the great Atman, the Saksin of Brahman, the unchanging.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे पष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायामावरणपूजावर्णन॑ नामाष्टमो ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तिमुद्धरेत्पूर्वमिन्धनं च ततः परम् । कालं समुद्धरेत्पश्चाद्दण्डमीश्वरमेव च
verses.transliteration: nivR^ittimuddharetpUrvamindhanaM cha tataH param | kAlaM samuddharetpashchAddaNDamIshvarameva cha
verses.translation: After thinking about the region from the Adhara- Sakti to the three Tattvas the Dahara Vyoman (the ether- heart) shall be imagined and conceived in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णपञ्चकरूपोऽयमेवं प्रणव उद्धृतः । त्रिमात्रबिन्दुनादात्मा मुक्तिदो जपतां सदा
verses.transliteration: varNapa~nchakarUpo.ayamevaM praNava uddhR^itaH | trimAtrabindunAdAtmA muktido japatAM sadA
verses.translation: Repeating the single-syllabled Brahman Om, he shall with alert mind think of me along with you in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिस्थावरान्तानां सर्वेषां प्राणिनां खलु । प्राणः प्रणव एवायं तस्मात्प्रणव ईरितः
verses.transliteration: brahmAdisthAvarAntAnAM sarveShAM prANinAM khalu | prANaH praNava evAyaM tasmAtpraNava IritaH
verses.translation: O beloved, he who performs the rite of this type attains my world. After securing the knowledge of my principles he will attain Sayujya salvation as the fruit.

verses.sanskrit: आद्यं वर्णमकारं च उकारमुत्तरे ततः । मकारं मध्यतश्चैव नादान्तं तस्य चोमिति
verses.transliteration: AdyaM varNamakAraM cha ukAramuttare tataH | makAraM madhyatashchaiva nAdAntaM tasya chomiti
verses.translation: O goddess, after this I shall mention the daily routine during the Sannyasa according to the convention. It is out of my affection for you that I am narrating the same.
verses.hindi: शिवतत्त्वके ज्ञाता पुरुष शिव कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: जलवद्वर्णमाद्यं तु दक्षिणे चोत्तरे तथा । मध्ये मकारं शुचिवदोङ्कारे मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: jalavadvarNamAdyaM tu dakShiNe chottare tathA | madhye makAraM shuchivado~NkAre munisattama
verses.translation: The ascetic shall get up in the Brahma Muhurta and think about the preceptor Siva seated in the thousand- petalled lotus on the head.
verses.hindi: भेद नहीं रहता, इसलिये वे शिव स्वयं परमात्मा हैं

verses.sanskrit: अकारश्चाप्युकारोऽयं मकारश्च त्रयं क्रमात् । तिस्रो मात्राः समाख्याता अर्धमात्रा ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: akArashchApyukAro.ayaM makArashcha trayaM kramAt | tisro mAtrAH samAkhyAtA ardhamAtrA tataH param
verses.translation: The preceptor resembling pure crystal, with two eyes and holding the mystic gestures of boon and protection in the hand is conceived as Siva of beautiful form in the soul.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धमात्रा महेशानि बिन्दुनादस्वरूपिणी । वर्णनीया न वै चाद्धा ज्ञेया ज्ञानिभिरेव सा
verses.transliteration: ardhamAtrA maheshAni bindunAdasvarUpiNI | varNanIyA na vai chAddhA j~neyA j~nAnibhireva sA
verses.translation: He shall bow to the preceptor with palms joined in reverence and worship him with scents, fragrant flowers etc. created by his imagination.
verses.hindi: लिंगको स्थापितकर सूर्य आदिका अर्चन करे

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः सर्वविद्यानामित्यद्याः श्रुतयः प्रिये । मत्त एव भवन्तीति वेदाः सत्यं वदन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: IshAnaH sarvavidyAnAmityadyAH shrutayaH priye | matta eva bhavantIti vedAH satyaM vadanti hi
verses.translation: He shall pray thus — "O lord, let whatever I do from morning till sunset and from sunset till daybreak be your worship."

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवार्थपरिज्ञानमेव ज्ञानं मदात्मकम् । बीजं तत्सर्वविद्यानां मन्त्रं प्रणवनामकम्
verses.transliteration: praNavArthaparij~nAnameva j~nAnaM madAtmakam | bIjaM tatsarvavidyAnAM mantraM praNavanAmakam
verses.translation: After intimating to the preceptor thus and securing the permission he shall retain the breath and sit down, with his mind and the sense-organs under full control.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् वेदादिरेवाहं प्रणवो मम वाचकः । वाचकत्वान्ममैषोऽपि वेदादिरिति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: tasmAd vedAdirevAhaM praNavo mama vAchakaH | vAchakatvAnmamaiSho.api vedAdiriti kathyate
verses.translation: He shall then meditate on the six-fold wheel*®® from the root to the Brahma Randhra. In the middle he shall think of me, the Nirguna Sadasiva, free from ailment, the great Brahman, with the lustre of crores of lightning, identi¬ cal with splendour, with the body of existence, knowledge and bliss.

verses.sanskrit: अकारस्तु महद् बीजं रजः स्रष्टा चतुर्मुखः । उकारः प्रकृतिर्योनिः सत्त्वं पालयिता हरिः
verses.transliteration: akArastu mahad bIjaM rajaH sraShTA chaturmukhaH | ukAraH prakR^itiryoniH sattvaM pAlayitA hariH
verses.translation: He shall realize identity with me in the form "I am he". The intelligent ascetic then shall go out far according to convenience.

verses.sanskrit: मकारः पुरुषो बीजी तमः संहारको हरः । बिन्दुर्महेश्वरो देवस्तिरोभाव उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: makAraH puruSho bIjI tamaH saMhArako haraH | bindurmaheshvaro devastirobhAva udAhR^itaH
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee shall cover the head along with the nose with a piece of cloth. He shall spread some grass on the ground and evacuate his bowels there duly.

verses.sanskrit: नादः सदाशिवः प्रोक्तः सर्वानुग्रहकारकः । नादमूर्द्धनि सञ्चिन्त्यः परात्परतरः शिवः
verses.transliteration: nAdaH sadAshivaH proktaH sarvAnugrahakArakaH | nAdamUrddhani sa~nchintyaH parAtparataraH shivaH
verses.translation: He shall stand up holding the penis and go to the water-pond. He shall take out water and use it for cleansing carefully.

verses.sanskrit: स सर्वज्ञः सर्वकर्त्ता सर्वेशो निर्मलोऽव्ययः । अनिर्देश्यः परब्रह्म साक्षात्सदसतः परः
verses.transliteration: sa sarvaj~naH sarvakarttA sarvesho nirmalo.avyayaH | anirdeshyaH parabrahma sAkShAtsadasataH paraH
verses.translation: He shall wash hands, feet and perform Acamana twice remembering Om. He shall face the north and clean his teeth always with leaves or grass except on the eleventh and the New-moon day. He shall rinse the mouth by gargling twelve times.

verses.sanskrit: अकारादिषु वर्णेषु व्यापकं चोत्तरोत्तरम् । व्याप्यं त्वधस्तनं वर्णमेवं सर्वत्र भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: akArAdiShu varNeShu vyApakaM chottarottaram | vyApyaM tvadhastanaM varNamevaM sarvatra bhAvayet
verses.translation: After performing Acamana twice he shall clean the hips with water and clay. At the time of dawn he shall take his bath using clay.
verses.hindi: तीर्थयात्राके प्रसंगसे पृथ्वीपर भ्रमण करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: सद्यादीशानपर्यन्तान्यकारादिषु पञ्चसु । स्थितानि पञ्च ब्रह्माणि तानि मन्मूर्त्तयः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sadyAdIshAnaparyantAnyakArAdiShu pa~nchasu | sthitAni pa~ncha brahmANi tAni manmUrttayaH kramAt
verses.translation: The bath and the Sandhya prayers shall be per- formed with thoughts on the preceptor and me. The pro¬ cedure of bath is not detailed here for fear of prolixity. That

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ कलाः समाख्याता अकारे सद्यजाः शिवे । उकारे वामरूपिण्यस्त्रयोदश समीरिताः
verses.transliteration: aShTau kalAH samAkhyAtA akAre sadyajAH shive | ukAre vAmarUpiNyastrayodasha samIritAH
verses.translation: Joining the palms so as to from the Sahkhamudra

verses.sanskrit: अष्टावघोररूपिण्यो मकारे संस्थिताः कलाः । बिन्दौ चतस्रः सम्भूताः कलाः पुरुषगोचराः
verses.transliteration: aShTAvaghorarUpiNyo makAre saMsthitAH kalAH | bindau chatasraH sambhUtAH kalAH puruShagocharAH
verses.translation: He shall go to the bank and wash the lom-cloth. He shall perform the Acamana twice. Repeating the Pranava he shall sprinkle water over the towel and wipe off the body.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नामक नौंवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: नादे पञ्च समाख्याताः कला ईशानसम्भवाः । षड्विधैक्यानुसन्धानात्प्रपञ्चात्मकतोच्यते
verses.transliteration: nAde pa~ncha samAkhyAtAH kalA IshAnasambhavAH | ShaDvidhaikyAnusandhAnAtprapa~nchAtmakatochyate
verses.translation: He shall wipe off his face first and then the head and other parts of the body standing by the side of the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: अतिसूक्ष्मं महार्थं च ज्ञेयं तद्वटबीजवत् । वेदादि वेदसारं च मद्रूपं च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: atisUkShmaM mahArthaM cha j~neyaM tadvaTabIjavat | vedAdi vedasAraM cha madrUpaM cha visheShataH
verses.translation: The six mystical circles of the body are

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रो यन्त्रं देवता च प्रपञ्चो गुरुरेव च । शिष्यश्च षट्पदार्थानामेषामर्थं शृणु प्रिये
verses.transliteration: mantro yantraM devatA cha prapa~ncho gurureva cha | shiShyashcha ShaTpadArthAnAmeShAmarthaM shR^iNu priye
verses.translation: A pure loin-cloth shall be tied with its string with the knot on the left side. Then he shall smear his body with the ashes. O daughter of the mountain, now I tell you the procedure thereof.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चवर्णसमष्टिः स्यान्मन्त्रः पूर्वमुदाहृतः । स एव यन्त्रतां प्राप्तो वक्ष्ये तन्मण्डलक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchavarNasamaShTiH syAnmantraH pUrvamudAhR^itaH | sa eva yantratAM prApto vakShye tanmaNDalakramam
verses.translation: After performing the Acamana twice he shall take the ashes repeating the Sadyadi mantra'®. Then repeating the mantras "Agniriti"* he shall touch the body.

verses.sanskrit: यन्त्रं तु देवतारूपं देवता विश्वरूपिणी । विश्वरूपो गुरुः प्रोक्तः शिष्यो गुरुवपुः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yantraM tu devatArUpaM devatA vishvarUpiNI | vishvarUpo guruH proktaH shiShyo guruvapuH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Repeating the mantra "Apo vai — he shall mix the ashes with water. He shall make two balls of the pasted ashes with the mantras "Om Apo Jyotl"® and "Ma Nastokc"' — He shall divide one of the balls into five, O goddess, and apply each respectively to the head, face, chest, private parts and the feet.
verses.hindi: उद्देश्यसे आया हूँ, उसका वृत्तान्त आपलोग सुनें

verses.sanskrit: ओमितीदं सर्वमिति सर्वं ब्रह्मेति च श्रुतेः । वाच्यवाचकसम्बन्धोऽप्ययमेवार्थ ईरितः
verses.transliteration: omitIdaM sarvamiti sarvaM brahmeti cha shruteH | vAchyavAchakasambandho.apyayamevArtha IritaH
verses.translation: He shall repeat the mantra beginning with "Isana* — " and ending with "Sadya." After applying the ashes he shall repeat Om touching all the parts of the body. He shall wash his hands, feet and take the other ball. Ador¬ ing as before he shall apply three parallel lines on the forehead repeating the mantra 'Tryayusa'* and the 'Tryambaka'.**' He shall apply the same on the chest with the Pranava and on the shoulders with "Orh Namah Sivaya."

verses.sanskrit: आधारो मणिपूरश्च हृदयं तु ततः परम् । विशुद्धिराज्ञा च ततः शक्तिः शान्तिरिति क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: AdhAro maNipUrashcha hR^idayaM tu tataH param | vishuddhirAj~nA cha tataH shaktiH shAntiriti kramAt
verses.translation: Uttering Paftrikarana mantra, the scholarly ascetic shall think of his preceptor. In the manner as explained hereafter he shall perform six Pranayamas.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानान्येतानि देवेशि शान्त्यतीतं परात्परम् । अधिकारी भवेद्यस्य वैराग्यं जायते दृढम्
verses.transliteration: sthAnAnyetAni deveshi shAntyatItaM parAtparam | adhikArI bhavedyasya vairAgyaM jAyate dR^iDham
verses.translation: Touching the navel, the joints of the arms and the back in order he shall wash both the hands duly and perform Acamana twice. He shall take some water in the right hand and cover it with the left hand. Pranava is then repeated twelve times.

verses.sanskrit: विषयः स्यामहं देवि जीवब्रह्मैक्यभावनात् । सम्बन्धं शृणु देवेशि विषयः सम्यगीरितः
verses.transliteration: viShayaH syAmahaM devi jIvabrahmaikyabhAvanAt | sambandhaM shR^iNu deveshi viShayaH samyagIritaH
verses.translation: Sprinkling this water thrice on the head he shall drink water thrice meditating on Ohkara — Siva with
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे षष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां सूतोपदेशो नाम दशमोउध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: जीवात्मनो मया सार्धमैक्यस्य प्रणवस्य च । वाच्यवाचकभावोऽत्र संवन्धः समुदीरितः
verses.transliteration: jIvAtmano mayA sArdhamaikyasya praNavasya cha | vAchyavAchakabhAvo.atra saMvandhaH samudIritaH
verses.translation: VS. iG. iG
verses.hindi: ॥इस प्रकार श्रीजशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत छठी कैलाससंहितामें सूतोपदेश नामक दसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: व्रतादिनिरतः शान्तस्तपस्वी विजितेन्द्रियः । शौचाचारसमायुक्तो भूदेवो वेदनिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: vratAdinirataH shAntastapasvI vijitendriyaH | shauchAchArasamAyukto bhUdevo vedaniShThitaH
verses.translation: VS. 3. 6j
verses.hindi: ऐसा आपने इस समय प्रदर्शित कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: विषयेषु विरक्तः सन्नैहिकामुष्मिकेषु च । देवानां ब्राह्मणानां च सद्भक्तश्च शिवव्रती
verses.transliteration: viShayeShu viraktaH sannaihikAmuShmikeShu cha | devAnAM brAhmaNAnAM cha sadbhaktashcha shivavratI
verses.translation: After performing the Japa of Gayatri hundred and eight times, he shall offer Tarpana twelve times. After per¬ forming the Acamana he shall perform Pranayama thrice.
verses.hindi: चाहते हैं, अत: आप प्रेमपूर्वक उसे कहिये

verses.sanskrit: देवो गुणत्रयातीतः सर्वज्ञः सर्वकृत्प्रभुः । ओमित्येकाक्षरे मन्त्रे स्थितोऽहं सर्वगः शिवः
verses.transliteration: devo guNatrayAtItaH sarvaj~naH sarvakR^itprabhuH | omityekAkShare mantre sthito.ahaM sarvagaH shivaH
verses.translation: Then he shall go to the hall of worship thinking on Siva. After reaching the door he shall wash his feet silently and perform Acamana twice.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञं वेदान्तज्ञानपारगम् । आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य यतिं मतिमतां वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvashAstrArthatattvaj~naM vedAntaj~nAnapAragam | AchAryamupasa~Ngamya yatiM matimatAM varam
verses.translation: He shall enter it duly placing the right foot at first. Inside the Mandapa there, he, the intelligent ascetic, shall draw the mystic diagram in due order.
verses.hindi: एवं प्रणवस्वरूप आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घदण्डप्रणामाद्यैस्तोषयेद्यत्नतः सुधीः । शान्त्यादिगुणसंयुक्तः शिष्यः सौशील्यवान्वरः
verses.transliteration: dIrghadaNDapraNAmAdyaistoShayedyatnataH sudhIH | shAntyAdiguNasaMyuktaH shiShyaH saushIlyavAnvaraH
verses.translation: The ground.shall be tested duly on the basis of smell, colour and taste. In a spot pleasing to the mind the space above shall be covered with a canopy, the ground below shall be scrubbed and cleaned so much as to appear like the surface of a mirror. A square of sides two Aratnis each shall be drawn.

verses.sanskrit: यो गुरुः स शिवः प्रोक्तो यः शिवः स गुरुः स्मृतः । इति निश्चित्य मनसा स्वविचारं निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: yo guruH sa shivaH prokto yaH shivaH sa guruH smR^itaH | iti nishchitya manasA svavichAraM nivedayet
verses.translation: Make small squares within the width of a palm-leaf each. Thus there shall be thirteen equal squares in each column.

verses.sanskrit: लब्धानुज्ञस्तु गुरुणा द्वादशाहं पयोव्रती । समुद्रतीरे नद्यां च पर्वते वा शिवालये
verses.transliteration: labdhAnuj~nastu guruNA dvAdashAhaM payovratI | samudratIre nadyAM cha parvate vA shivAlaye
verses.translation: The ascetic shall put the piece of palm leaf inside the square and sit facing the west. Towards the east a strong coloured thread shall be fixed. Threads shall be put in all the four directions. Thus there will be one hundred and sixtynine squares. The middle square is the pericarp. The squares adjoining it around in the outside, eight in number, are called eight petals.
verses.hindi: एवं बारह रूपोंवाले आपको नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लपक्षे तु पञ्चम्यामेकादश्यां तथापि वा । प्रातः स्नात्वा तु शुद्धात्मा कृतनित्यक्रियः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: shuklapakShe tu pa~nchamyAmekAdashyAM tathApi vA | prAtaH snAtvA tu shuddhAtmA kR^itanityakriyaH sudhIH
verses.translation: All the petals shall be made white completely. The pericarp shall be made yellow in colour and a red circle shall be drawn within. O goddess, beginning with the petal ofindra to the right hand side the bordering lines shall be coloured alternatively black and red.
verses.hindi: असुरोंका वध करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: गुरुमाहूय विधिना नान्दीश्राद्धं विधाय च । क्षौरं च कारयित्वाथ कक्षोपस्थविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: gurumAhUya vidhinA nAndIshrAddhaM vidhAya cha | kShauraM cha kArayitvAtha kakShopasthavivarjitam
verses.translation: The Yantra illuminating the meaning of the Pranava shall be written inside the pericarp. The pedestal shall be drawn beneath. Srikantha shall be drawn above it. Amaresa shall be drawn above it and Mahakala in the middle. On the top of it the staff and beyond that Isvara shall be drawn.

verses.sanskrit: केशश्मश्रुनखानां वै स्नात्वा नियतमानसः । सक्तुं प्राश्याथ सायाह्ने स्नात्वा सन्ध्यामुपास्य च
verses.transliteration: keshashmashrunakhAnAM vai snAtvA niyatamAnasaH | saktuM prAshyAtha sAyAhne snAtvA sandhyAmupAsya cha
verses.translation: The Piflia shall be coloured blue. 8rikantha ii yellow, Amaresa in red, and Mahakala in black.

verses.sanskrit: सायमौपासनं कृत्वा गुरुणा सहितो द्विजः । शास्त्रोक्तदक्षिणां दत्त्वा शिवाय गुरुरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: sAyamaupAsanaM kR^itvA guruNA sahito dvijaH | shAstroktadakShiNAM dattvA shivAya gururUpiNe
verses.translation: The scholarly ascetic shall make the staff smoky coloured and lvara white in colour. After di awing the Yantra the red one (Amaresa) shall be cnccnnpassed by Sadya.

verses.sanskrit: होमद्रव्याणि सम्पाद्य स्वसूत्रोक्तविधानतः । अग्निमाधाय विधिवल्लौकिकादिविभेदतः
verses.transliteration: homadravyANi sampAdya svasUtroktavidhAnataH | agnimAdhAya vidhivallaukikAdivibhedataH
verses.translation: O goddess, only through the Nada Isana shall be known. The rows of its residence shall be taken in order from the south-east one.
verses.hindi: कृपा है, जो आप मुझसे ऐसा कह रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: आहिताग्निस्तु यः कुर्यात्प्राजापत्येष्टिनाहिते । श्रौते वैश्वानरे सम्यक् सर्ववेदसदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: AhitAgnistu yaH kuryAtprAjApatyeShTinAhite | shraute vaishvAnare samyak sarvavedasadakShiNam
verses.translation: The four squares at the four corners, O beauti¬ ful lady, shall be painted white. The first four letters a, a i and i shall be written with red minerals and these four are conceived as doors. The two squares adjacent to each of these four shall be painted yellow.

verses.sanskrit: यदस्ति वस्तु तत्सर्वं गुणप्राधान्ययोगतः । समस्तं व्यस्तमपि च प्रणवार्थं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: yadasti vastu tatsarvaM guNaprAdhAnyayogataH | samastaM vyastamapi cha praNavArthaM prachakShate
verses.translation: In the yellow square in between the south-east squares a lotus of eight petals shall be drawn red in colour with yellow pericarp.
verses.hindi: प्रति वाचकता सिद्ध हो जाती है

verses.sanskrit: अथाग्निमात्मन्यारोप्य ब्राह्मणः प्रव्रजेद् गृहात् । श्रपयित्वा चरुं तस्मिन्समिदन्नाज्यभेदतः
verses.transliteration: athAgnimAtmanyAropya brAhmaNaH pravrajed gR^ihAt | shrapayitvA charuM tasminsamidannAjyabhedataH
verses.translation: With purity of mind he shall draw the letter 'ha* in the middle along with the Bindu. In the south-west square of this lotus he shall draw another red lotus with yellow filaments and pericarp. The third letter of the class of Sa along with the sixth vowel and the fouitcenlh vowel de¬ corated with Bindu and Nada is, O gentle lady, the excellent Bija which shall be written in the middle of the lotus.

verses.sanskrit: पौरुषेणैव सूक्तेन हुत्वा प्रत्यृचमात्मवान् । हुत्वा च सौविष्टकृतीं स्वसूत्रोक्तविधानतः
verses.transliteration: pauruSheNaiva sUktena hutvA pratyR^ichamAtmavAn | hutvA cha sauviShTakR^itIM svasUtroktavidhAnataH
verses.translation: In the north-east.square of the lotus another lotus shall be drawn with the third letter of the class of "ka'*
verses.hindi: धारण करनेवाले, व्यापक और सबके स्वामी हैं

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वोपरिष्टात्तन्त्रं च तेनाग्नेरुत्तरे बुधः । स्थित्वासने जपेन्मौनी चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरे । यावद् ब्राह्ममुहूर्त्तं तु गायत्रीं दृढमानसः
verses.transliteration: hutvopariShTAttantraM cha tenAgneruttare budhaH | sthitvAsane japenmaunI chailAjinakushottare | yAvad brAhmamuhUrttaM tu gAyatrIM dR^iDhamAnasaH
verses.translation: The most excellent of the knowers of the rules shall make the leaves red in colour. Outside the leaves the cavities shall be filled with black colour.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे प्रष्ठयां कैलाससंहितायां वामदेवब्रह्मवर्णन॑ नामैकादशो: ध्याय

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्नात्वा यथापूर्वं श्रपयित्वा चरुं ततः । पौरुषं सूक्तमारभ्य विरजान्तं हुनेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: tataH snAtvA yathApUrvaM shrapayitvA charuM tataH | pauruShaM sUktamArabhya virajAntaM huned budhaH
verses.translation: The south-east square and others, four in number, shall be filled with white paint. With six Hindus a six-sided figure shall be drawn in black in the east.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवमतेनापि शौनकादिमतेन वा । तत्र मुख्यं वामदेव्यं गर्भयुक्तो यतो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: vAmadevamatenApi shaunakAdimatena vA | tatra mukhyaM vAmadevyaM garbhayukto yato muniH
verses.translation: To the south it shall be painted red. In the north a triangle is painted in white. In the west a crescent moon is painted in yellow.
verses.hindi: परमभक्त हैं तथा शिवज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ हैं

verses.sanskrit: होमशेषं समाप्याथ प्रातरौपासनं हुनेत् । ततोऽग्निमात्मन्यारोप्य प्रातः सन्ध्यमुपास्य च
verses.transliteration: homasheShaM samApyAtha prAtaraupAsanaM hunet | tato.agnimAtmanyAropya prAtaH sandhyamupAsya cha
verses.translation: The four Bijas shall be written in the squares in order. The Hindu shall be drawn in the east in white. In the south is painted in black the letter U; in the north, letter ma' is painted in red; in the west letter 'a' is painted yellow; thus the four letters are written.

verses.sanskrit: सवितर्युदिते पश्चात्सावित्रीं प्राविशेत्क्रमात् । एषणानां त्रयं त्यक्त्वा प्रेषमुच्चार्य च क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: savitaryudite pashchAtsAvitrIM prAvishetkramAt | eShaNAnAM trayaM tyaktvA preShamuchchArya cha kramAt
verses.translation: In the second row from the top O beautiful lady, one shall begin. The first four squares are respectively pain¬ ted yellow, white, red and black. Below that the four arc painted white, blue, yellow and red respectively. O good-faced lady, below that in the triangle it shall be painted red white and yellow.

verses.sanskrit: शिखोपवीते सन्त्यज्य कटिसूत्रादिकं ततः । विसृज्य प्राङ्मुखो गच्छेदुत्तराशामुखोऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: shikhopavIte santyajya kaTisUtrAdikaM tataH | visR^ijya prA~Nmukho gachCheduttarAshAmukho.api vA
verses.translation: O goddess, from the south to the north the same procedure shall be adopted. In its external row it shall be painted from the east to the middle.

verses.sanskrit: गृह्णीयाद्दण्डकौपीनाद्युचितं लोकवर्तने । विरक्तश्चेन गृह्णीयाल्लोकवृत्तिविचारणे
verses.transliteration: gR^ihNIyAddaNDakaupInAdyuchitaM lokavartane | viraktashchena gR^ihNIyAllokavR^ittivichAraNe
verses.translation: The colours arc yellow, red, black, blue, white and yellow. O beloved, from the south-east onwards colours are red, blue, white, red, black and red. Thus the colours of the six squares are mentioned: from the south to the cast; from the south-west to the south-east; from the west to the south; from the north-west to the south-west; from the north to the west; from the north-east, to the north-west. O goddess, thus the procedure of the diagram has been men¬ tioned to you. Having drawn the diagram thus the ascetic with restrained mind shall worship the sun with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोः समीपं गत्वाथ दण्डवत्प्रणमेत्त्रयम् । समुत्थाय ततस्तिष्ठेद् गुरुपादसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: guroH samIpaM gatvAtha daNDavatpraNamettrayam | samutthAya tatastiShThed gurupAdasamIpataH
verses.translation: Outside he shall adore in order the diagrams of triangle circle and square repeating Om. He shall fill the conch with fragrant pure water repeating the Pranava. He shall place the conch on the diagrams and worship it with scents, flowers etc. repeating the Pranava seven times. After repeating the mantra he shall show the Dhenumudra and 6ahkhamudra. He shall sprinkle it with the Astra mantra.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वार्थसाधकं तस्मादेकं ब्रह्मैतदक्षरम् । तेनोमिति जगत्कृस्नं कुरुते प्रथमं शिवः
verses.transliteration: sarvArthasAdhakaM tasmAdekaM brahmaitadakSharam | tenomiti jagatkR^isnaM kurute prathamaM shivaH
verses.translation: He shall sprinkle himself and the scents, flowers and other materials of worship. After performing Pranayama thrice he shall utter the names of the sages etc.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गुरुः समादाय विरजानलजं सितम् । भस्म तेनैव तं शिष्यं समुद्धूत्य यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: tato guruH samAdAya virajAnalajaM sitam | bhasma tenaiva taM shiShyaM samuddhUtya yathAvidhi
verses.translation: Of this mantra of the glorious sun the sage is Devabhaga, the metre is Gayatri, the deity is the sun. The six-organed Nyasa shall be made with 'Hram' etc. Then he sprinkles the Padma not within the purview of Agni.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैस्त्रिपुण्ड्रं धारयेत्ततः । हृत्पङ्कजे समासीनं मां त्वया सह चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: agnirityAdibhirmantraistripuNDraM dhArayettataH | hR^itpa~Nkaje samAsInaM mAM tvayA saha chintayet
verses.translation: Th icjcl indicates the basic mantra of Siva: sff
