verses.hindi: करके उनसे अपना विचार प्रकट करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: हस्तं निधाय शिरसि शिष्यस्य प्रीतमानसः । ऋष्यादिसहितं तस्य दक्षकर्णे समुच्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: hastaM nidhAya shirasi shiShyasya prItamAnasaH | R^iShyAdisahitaM tasya dakShakarNe samuchcharet
verses.translation: He shall worship the lower lid of Maya and and the upper lid of Vidya. Thereafter Sattva, Rajas and Tamas shall be worshipped in order. In the quarters begin¬ ning with the east and in the middle he shall worship the following: — Dipta, Suksma, Jaya, Bhadra, Vibhuti, Vimala, Amogha, Vaidyuta, Sarvatomukhasahjfla, Kandanala, Susira, then Tantukanfakas, then the root lid, filament, (light) and Sakalatman, the five-knotted pericarp and the petals, then the filaments, Brahma, Visnu, Rudra and Atman. After worshipping the inner Atman in the great Atman of knowledge he shall worship the Yogapitha called the Saura. The knower of the root shall conceive the idol as stationed on the pedestal.
verses.hindi: बदेतां प्राप्नुयावेति तौ च ब्राह्मणपुद्भवौं॥ ५८  वाक्य कहना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवं त्रिःप्रकारं तु ततस्तस्यार्थमादिशेत् । षड्विधार्थं परिज्ञानसहितं गुरुसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: praNavaM triHprakAraM tu tatastasyArthamAdishet | ShaDvidhArthaM parij~nAnasahitaM gurusattamaH
verses.translation: The ascetic sits checking the vital breath with the root from the root. With the power of its splendour he raises the 6akti through the path of the Pingala nerve of the sun stationed in the circle. He causes it to come out with the handful of flowers. Of Siva whose body is as red as the Vermillion, who has his wife as his left half, who is wearing Rudraksa garland and holding a noose, a club called Khatvanga, a skull, a goad, a lotus a conch and a discus; who has four faces, twelve eyes and a spear within the lotus of his heart, he utters the Pranava first and then Hram, Hrim and Sah.
verses.hindi: ३ सत्यवसुसंज्ञका: विश्वेदेवा: नान्‍्दीमुखाः भूर्भुव: स्व: इदं वः पाद्यं पादावनेजनं पादप्रक्षालन वृद्धि:

verses.sanskrit: द्विषट्प्रकारं स गुरुं प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत् । तदधीनो भवेन्नित्यं वेदान्तं सम्यगभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: dviShaTprakAraM sa guruM praNamya bhuvi daNDavat | tadadhIno bhavennityaM vedAntaM samyagabhyaset
verses.translation: Thereafter he invokes the sun along with the light and power saying 'I invoke obeisance'. He shows the mystic signs of Sthapana etc. After performing the Nyiisa of the limbs with the mantra Hram, Hrim, Hrum and conceiv¬ ing the five services O great goddess, he shall worship thrice the six organs in the filaments of the lotus.
verses.hindi: स्व: इद वः पाद्य॑ पादावनेजनं पादप्रक्षालनं वृद्धि:

verses.sanskrit: मामेव चिन्तयेन्नित्यं परमात्मानमात्मनि । विशुद्धे निर्विकारे वै ब्रह्मसाक्षिणमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: mAmeva chintayennityaM paramAtmAnamAtmani | vishuddhe nirvikAre vai brahmasAkShiNamavyayam
verses.translation: In the second covering the four deities shall be worshipped in the south-east, north-east south-west and the north-west. O Parvati, from east to north at the roots of the petals Aditya, Bhaskara, Bhanu and-Ravi.shall be worshipped in order. O beloved, in the third covering, Arka, Brahma, Rudra and Visnu shall be worshipped in the north-cast and
verses.hindi: आप लोग मेरे ऊपर कृपा करें '

verses.sanskrit: शमादिधर्मनिरतो वेदान्तज्ञानपारगः । अत्राधिकारी स प्रोक्तो यतिर्विगतमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: shamAdidharmanirato vedAntaj~nAnapAragaH | atrAdhikArI sa prokto yatirvigatamatsaraH
verses.translation: In the middle of the leaves from the east onwards he shall worship the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupitre, Venus, Saturn and Rahu.

verses.sanskrit: हृत्पुण्डरीकं विरजं विशोकं विशदं परम् । अष्टपत्रं केशराढ्यं कर्णिकोपरि शोभितम्
verses.transliteration: hR^itpuNDarIkaM virajaM vishokaM vishadaM param | aShTapatraM kesharADhyaM karNikopari shobhitam
verses.translation: Or he shall worship the twelve Adityas in the second covering and worship the twelve signs of zodiac in the third covering.

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्तिमारभ्य त्रितत्वान्तमयं पदम् । विचिन्त्य मध्यतस्तस्य दहरं व्योम भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: AdhArashaktimArabhya tritatvAntamayaM padam | vichintya madhyatastasya daharaM vyoma bhAvayet
verses.translation: He shall worship the seven oceans*-* and seven Gahgas** on its outer side and then the sages, gods, gandharvas, serpents, celestial damsels, the village chiefs, the Yaksas, Yatudhanas, the seven horses in the form of the Vedas and the Balakhilyas.

verses.sanskrit: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मां त्वया सह । चिन्तयेन्मध्यतस्तस्य नित्यमुद्युक्तमानसः
verses.transliteration: omityekAkSharaM brahma vyAharanmAM tvayA saha | chintayenmadhyatastasya nityamudyuktamAnasaH
verses.translation: After worshipping the sun of three coverings and then arranging the square diagram with pious attention he shall place a copper vessel that can hold a prastha of water on its stand. He shall fill it with pure water rendered fragrant with flowers. He shall worship it with scents, flowers and kneel on the ground. The arghya vessel shall be lifted upto the middle of the eyebrows.

verses.sanskrit: शिवो वा प्रणवो ह्येष प्रणवो वा शिवः स्मृतः । वाच्यवाचकयोर्भेदो नात्यन्तं विद्यते यतः
verses.transliteration: shivo vA praNavo hyeSha praNavo vA shivaH smR^itaH | vAchyavAchakayorbhedo nAtyantaM vidyate yataH
verses.translation: He shall recite the hymn to the sun-god yielding all accoinplishrnenls. O goddess, it yields worldly pleasures and salvati(}n always.

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधोपासकस्य मल्लोकगतिमेव च । मत्तो विज्ञानमासाद्य मत्सायुज्यफलं प्रिये
verses.transliteration: evaMvidhopAsakasya mallokagatimeva cha | matto vij~nAnamAsAdya matsAyujyaphalaM priye
verses.translation: Obeisance to you of the colour of vcrmillion, of good disc wearing diamond for the ornament, having eyes resembling lotus, of good lotus and cause of Brahma, Indra and Visnu. O lord, be pleased to accept this holy arghya oflfered by me along with the red powder, cloured water, garland, vermilion, kusa grass, flowers and a golden pot.
verses.hindi: गयी है; इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेकाक्षरं देवं मां च ब्रह्मर्षयो विदुः । वाच्यवाचकयोरैक्यं मन्यमाना विपश्चितः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdekAkSharaM devaM mAM cha brahmarShayo viduH | vAchyavAchakayoraikyaM manyamAnA vipashchitaH
verses.translation: He shall recite this and offer the arghya to the sun-god and perform obeisance. He shall lecite the following piously.

verses.sanskrit: अतस्तदेव जानीयात्प्रणवं सर्वकारणम् । निर्विकारी मुमुक्षुर्मां निर्गुणं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: atastadeva jAnIyAtpraNavaM sarvakAraNam | nirvikArI mumukShurmAM nirguNaM parameshvaram
verses.translation: "Obeisance to Siva accompanied by Parvati and the Ganas. Obeisance to you the primordial cause, of the form of Trinity, Rudra, Visnu and Brahma".

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He shall meditate upon the Pranava consisting of five letters including the Binclu and fifth vowel 'U' with¬ out the fifth vowel and with the Bindu. After uttering this with Bindu he shall utter the composite unit.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He shall meditate upon the Pranava consisting of five letters including the Binclu and fifth vowel 'U' with¬ out the fifth vowel and with the Bindu. After uttering this with Bindu he shall utter the composite unit.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam
verses.translation: He shall meditate upon the Pranava consisting of five letters including the Binclu and fifth vowel 'U' with¬ out the fifth vowel and with the Bindu. After uttering this with Bindu he shall utter the composite unit.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न होकर उसीमें लीन होती हैं

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.४. चतुर्थोऽध्यायः । संन्यासाचारवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि संन्यासाह्निककर्म च । तव स्नेहान्महादेवि सम्प्रदायानुरोधतः
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.4\. chaturtho.adhyAyaH | sa.nnyAsAchAravarNanam | Ishvara uvAcha | ataH paraM pravakShyAmi sa.nnyAsAhnikakarma cha | tava snehAnmahAdevi sampradAyAnurodhataH
verses.translation: With these Bijas duly uttered the scholarly ascetic shall bow to the preceptor and the lord of Ganas stationed on the arms and thighs.

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्रेणाच्छाद्य मतिमाञ्छिरो नासिकया सह । विशोध्य देहं विधिवत्तृणमाधाय भूतले
verses.transliteration: vastreNAchChAdya matimA~nChiro nAsikayA saha | vishodhya dehaM vidhivattR^iNamAdhAya bhUtale
verses.translation: He shall bow to Durga and Ksctrapala also, with palms joined in reverence. He shall repeal "Orn Astraya Phat" six times and wipe olf his hands.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि वाचक और वाच्यमें कुछ भी भेद नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: गृहीतशिश्न उत्थाय ततो गच्छेज्जलाशयम् । उद्धृत्य वार्यथान्यायं शौचं कुर्यादतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: gR^ihItashishna utthAya tato gachChejjalAshayam | uddhR^itya vAryathAnyAyaM shauchaM kuryAdatandritaH
verses.translation: He shall recite the mentra "Apasai pantu"'-' and repeat "Astraya Pha," Clapping the palms tlirice and kicking thrice he shall remove the obstacle's; he shall ga/c at tlie heaven-dwellers, the skyfarers.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तौ पादौ च संशोध्य द्विराचम्योमिति स्मरन् । उत्तराभिमुखो मौनी दन्तधावनमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: hastau pAdau cha saMshodhya dvirAchamyomiti smaran | uttarAbhimukho maunI dantadhAvanamAcharet
verses.translation: He shall meditate on the supierne god of the form of cit in the middle of lunar sphere of cit wiihin the great lotus of thousand petals, full-blown and stationed in the twelve (?)

verses.sanskrit: तृणपर्णैः सदा कुर्यादमामेकादशीं विना । अपां द्वादशगण्डूषैर्मुखं संशोधयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: tR^iNaparNaiH sadA kuryAdamAmekAdashIM vinA | apAM dvAdashagaNDUShairmukhaM saMshodhayettataH
verses.translation: For sixteem, sixty-four and thiity-two seconds he shall perform Puraka, Kumbhaka and Recaka through Sosa Daha and Plava.

verses.sanskrit: द्विराचम्य मृदा तोयैः कटिशौचं विधाय च । अरुणोदयकाले तु स्नानं कुर्यान्मृदा सह
verses.transliteration: dvirAchamya mR^idA toyaiH kaTishauchaM vidhAya cha | aruNodayakAle tu snAnaM kuryAnmR^idA saha
verses.translation: After retaining the breath as mentioned in his particular Veda through wind, fire, water etc. he shall bring the nerve which is at the Mula to the cerebral aper-

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं संस्मृत्य मां चैव स्नानसन्ध्याद्यमाचरेत् । विस्तारभयतो नोक्तमत्र द्रष्टव्यमन्यतः
verses.transliteration: guruM saMsmR^itya mAM chaiva snAnasandhyAdyamAcharet | vistArabhayato noktamatra draShTavyamanyataH
verses.translation: The Yogin with mental concentration shall ponder over the Matrka. He shall fix the developed Matrka through the Pranava externally. He shall carry out nourish¬ ment etc. with restricted vital breath. Thinking upon Siva in the mind he shall dedicate himself quietly.
verses.hindi: उनकी आज्ञाके बिना अन्य कर्म न करे

verses.sanskrit: आबध्य शङ्खमुद्रां च प्रणवेनाभिषेचयेत् । शिरसि द्वादशावृत्त्या तदर्धं वा तदर्धकम्
verses.transliteration: Abadhya sha~NkhamudrAM cha praNavenAbhiShechayet | shirasi dvAdashAvR^ittyA tadardhaM vA tadardhakam
verses.translation: Beginning with the two thumbs and ending with the palms, the hands are wiped off. O goddess. Saying 'Om' he shall begin the Nyasa of the hands.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे परष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां संन्‍न्यासविधिनाम त्रयोदशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तीरमागत्य कौपीनं प्रक्षाल्याचम्य च द्विधा । प्रोक्षयेत्प्रणवेनैव वस्त्रमङ्गोपमार्जनम्
verses.transliteration: tIramAgatya kaupInaM prakShAlyAchamya cha dvidhA | prokShayetpraNavenaiva vastrama~NgopamArjanam
verses.translation: He shall perform the Nyasa starting with the thumb of the right hand and ending with the little finger of the left hand.

verses.sanskrit: मुखं प्रथमतो मृज्य शिर आरभ्य सर्वतः । तेनैव मार्जयेद्देहं स्थित्वा च गुरुसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: mukhaM prathamato mR^ijya shira Arabhya sarvataH | tenaiva mArjayeddehaM sthitvA cha gurusannidhau
verses.translation: Everywhere 'A', 'U', 'M' with the Bindu, and the mantra ending with Namah shall be uttered and the Nyasa of the hand in the heart etc. be performed.

verses.sanskrit: आबध्याद् वामतः शुद्धं कौपीनं च सडोरकम् । ततः सन्धारयेद्भस्म तद्विधिः प्रोच्यतेऽद्रिजे
verses.transliteration: AbadhyAd vAmataH shuddhaM kaupInaM cha saDorakam | tataH sandhArayedbhasma tadvidhiH prochyate.adrije
verses.translation: After uttering 'A' at the outset the identity of Brahman and Atman shall be practised. The mantras ending with 'De' and 'Namah' shall be utilised in the heart.
verses.hindi: महान् भय उत्पन्न करनेवाला वचन कहने लगे

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मे मुहूर्त्त उत्थाय शिरसि श्वेतपङ्कजे । सहस्रारे समासीनं गुरुं सञ्चिन्तयेद्यतिः
verses.transliteration: brAhme muhUrtta utthAya shirasi shvetapa~Nkaje | sahasrAre samAsInaM guruM sa~nchintayedyatiH
verses.translation: O Goddess, the sage practising the mantra shall make the Nyasa of the Kavaca in the eyes and the forehead with an attentive mind.

verses.sanskrit: द्विराचम्य समादाय भस्म सद्यादिमन्त्रतः । अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैरभिमन्त्र्य स्पृशेत्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: dvirAchamya samAdAya bhasma sadyAdimantrataH | agnirityAdibhirmantrairabhimantrya spR^ishettanum
verses.translation: The different organs, faces and digits shall be fixed in the five Brahmans. Isana's five digits shall be fixed in the head, face, heart, private parts and the feet. The four digits of the Purusa shall be fixed in the four faces.

verses.sanskrit: आपोवेत्यभिमन्त्र्याथ जलं तेनैव सेचयेत् । ओमापोज्योतिरित्युक्त्वा मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: ApovetyabhimantryAtha jalaM tenaiva sechayet | omApojyotirityuktvA mAnastoketi mantrataH
verses.translation: Thus making the Nyasa of the thirtycight Kalas the intelligent knower of Pranava shall proceed with the Nyasa of Pranava.

verses.sanskrit: सम्मर्द्य कवलद्वन्द्वं कुर्यादेकं तु पञ्चधा । शिरोवदनहृद्गुह्यपादेषु परमेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: sammardya kavaladvandvaM kuryAdekaM tu pa~nchadhA | shirovadanahR^idguhyapAdeShu parameshvari
verses.translation: After making the Nyasa in the arms, elbows, wrists, sides, belly, calves, feet and the back, the devotee, an expert in the Nyasa, shall perform Haihsanyasa, O lady enligh¬ tener of the great Atman.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानादि समारभ्य सद्यान्तं पञ्चभिः क्रमात् । उद्धूल्य कवलं पश्चात्प्रणवेनाभिषेचयेत्
verses.transliteration: IshAnAdi samArabhya sadyAntaM pa~nchabhiH kramAt | uddhUlya kavalaM pashchAtpraNavenAbhiShechayet
verses.translation: The ascetic devotee shall make the square 'diagram to his left and worship it with Om. He shall place the conch and the rni.ssile, with its stand and worship it with the Pranava after filling it with the water scented with the sandal paste. He ''hall worship it with the scents and flowers and repeat Pranava seven times. He shall show the mystic sign of the cow and the conch making a square diagram in front and a semicircle in the middle, a triangle, hexagon and a circle within each in order. After worshipping the diagram with scents, and flowers, he shall place within it the vessel of Arghya on its stand and worship it with scents, repeating the Pranava. He shall pour holy watci* and fill it.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गं च ततो हस्तौ प्रक्षाल्यान्यत्समाहरेत् सम्मर्द्य पूर्ववत्तत्तु त्रिपुण्ड्रांस्तेन धारयेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvA~NgaM cha tato hastau prakShAlyAnyatsamAharet sammardya pUrvavattattu tripuNDrAMstena dhArayet
verses.translation: In the vessel, O good-faced lady, tips of Kusa grass, raw i ice grains, barley, other grains, gingelly seeds, ghee- fried object, flowers and ashes too shall be put. It shall be
verses.hindi: परब्रह्मस्वरूप, सूक्ष्म, निर्विकार तथा अनामय है

verses.sanskrit: नाभौ बाह्वोः सन्धिषु च पृष्ठे चैव यथाक्रमम् । प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ च ततो द्विराचम्य यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: nAbhau bAhvoH sandhiShu cha pR^iShThe chaiva yathAkramam | prakShAlya hastau cha tato dvirAchamya yathAvidhi
verses.translation: After saying "Orh gum gurubhyah namah" he shall invoke the preceptor and meditate on him as seated facing the south, with a delightful face, looking gentle and cryjtal pure, showing the mystic gestures of boons and protection with his hands in the form and features of Iiva but with two eyes.
verses.hindi: होनेसे परम पद कहा जाता है

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चीकरणमुच्चार्य भावयेत्स्वगुरुं बुधः । वक्ष्यमाणप्रकारेण प्राणायामान्षडाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchIkaraNamuchchArya bhAvayetsvaguruM budhaH | vakShyamANaprakAreNa prANAyAmAnShaDAcharet
verses.translation: After meditating thus he shall w r.ship Ganapati with scents, flowers etc. in the proper order assigning him a.'•cat on the lotus to the south-west of the mystical diagram with the mantra "Gananantva"'25 After invoking the lord he shall meditate on him with concentration.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षहस्तेन सङ्गृह्य जलं वामेन पाणिना । समाच्छाद्य द्विषड्वारं प्रणवेनाभिमन्त्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: dakShahastena sa~NgR^ihya jalaM vAmena pANinA | samAchChAdya dviShaDvAraM praNavenAbhimantrayet
verses.translation: Ide shall be conceived as icd in complexion with a huge body bedecked in ornaments holding a noose, a goad, boons and teeth, with elephantine face destroying the hindrances and obstacles of his devotees. After meditating thus Jie shall Worship him with scents, flowers and other services. After ofTcring him the Naivedya of plantain fruits, coconuts, mango fruits and sweet balls he shall make obeisance to the god.

verses.sanskrit: त्रियायुषैस्त्र्यम्बकैश्च प्रणवेन शिवेन च । शिरस्यथ ललाटे च वक्षसि स्कन्ध एव च
verses.transliteration: triyAyuShaistryambakaishcha praNavena shivena cha | shirasyatha lalATe cha vakShasi skandha eva cha
verses.translation: Repeating Skandagayatri he shall meditate on Kumara shining as the rising sun, seated on the peacock, with four arms and splendid limbs, bedecked in coronet hol¬ ding mystic signs of boons and protection, a spear and a cock'"® as well.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे पष्ख्यां कैलाससंहितायां धिवरूपप्रणववर्णन॑ नाम चुर्दशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्रिवारं सम्प्रोक्ष्य शिरसि त्रिः पिबेत्ततः । समाहितेन मनसा ध्यायन्नोङ्कारमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evaM trivAraM samprokShya shirasi triH pibettataH | samAhitena manasA dhyAyanno~NkAramIshvaram
verses.translation: Repeating Skandagayatri he shall meditate on Kumara shining as the rising sun, seated on the peacock, with four arms and splendid limbs, bedecked in coronet hol¬ ding mystic signs of boons and protection, a spear and a cock'"® as well.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं द्विनेत्रं वरदाभये । दधानं शिवसद्भावमेवात्मनि मनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshaM dvinetraM varadAbhaye | dadhAnaM shivasadbhAvamevAtmani manoharam
verses.translation: After meditating thus and worshipping with scents and other services, he shall worship Nandin, the chief of the harem in the right wing of the eastern doors, with the lustre of the golden hill bedecked in ornaments with the crescent moon constituting his coronet, of gentle aspect, with three eyes and four arms, holding a trident, a hind, an axe and a golden staff, with his face lustrous as the moon's disc or as the face of a monkey. To his north he shall worship his wife Suyasa, the daughter of the Maruts of good riles, engaged in bedecking mother Siva's feet duly with scents, flowers and other services.

verses.sanskrit: सौरमण्डलमध्यस्थं सर्वतेजोमयं परम् । अष्टबाहुं चतुर्वक्त्रमर्द्धनारीकमद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: sauramaNDalamadhyasthaM sarvatejomayaM param | aShTabAhuM chaturvaktramarddhanArIkamadbhutam
verses.translation: He shall sprinkle the diagram with the water from the conch veiled by the Astrarnantra. Then the scat, stand etc. shall be conceived in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाश्चर्यगुणोपेतं सर्वालङ्कारशोभितम् । एवं ध्यात्वाथ विधिवद्दद्यादर्घ्यत्रयं ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvAshcharyaguNopetaM sarvAla~NkArashobhitam | evaM dhyAtvAtha vidhivaddadyAdarghyatrayaM tataH
verses.translation: Adharma etc. shall be conceived from the east to the north in due order. He.shall conceive its body with the lustre of the jewel Lajavarta.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टोत्तरशतं जप्त्वा द्विषड्वारं तु तर्पयेत् । पुनराचम्य विधिवत्प्राणायामत्रयं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: aShTottarashataM japtvA dviShaDvAraM tu tarpayet | punarAchamya vidhivatprANAyAmatrayaM charet
verses.translation: The lower and upper lids, the bulbous root, the stem, the neck, the petals and the pericarp shall be t onecived in order and worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: पूजासदनमागच्छेन्मनसा संस्मरन् शिवम् । द्वारमासाद्य प्रक्षाल्य पादौ मौनी द्विराचमेत्
verses.transliteration: pUjAsadanamAgachChenmanasA saMsmaran shivam | dvAramAsAdya prakShAlya pAdau maunI dvirAchamet
verses.translation: He shall conceive the eight Siddhis in the petals, the Saktis in the filaments, the eight Rudras, Varna and others from the east, all round in order; the Vaiiagya in the pericarp and the nine Saktis in the Bijas, Varna and others alone begin¬ ning with the cast and ending with ManonmanI, the Dharma of Liva in the bulbous root, the Saivite knowledge in the stem and the zones of fire, sun and the moon above the pericarp.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविशेद्विधिना तत्र दक्षपादपुरःसरम् । मण्डपान्तः सुधीस्तत्र मण्डलं रचयेत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: pravishedvidhinA tatra dakShapAdapuraHsaram | maNDapAntaH sudhIstatra maNDalaM rachayetkramAt
verses.translation: The science of the Atman, and the trio of principles named Siva shall be conceived thereafter. Above these seats he shall conceive the seat of the deity shining with

verses.sanskrit: भावोपनीतैः सम्पूज्य गन्धादिभिरनुक्रमात् । बद्धाञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा नमस्कुर्याद् गुरुं ततः
verses.transliteration: bhAvopanItaiH sampUjya gandhAdibhiranukramAt | baddhA~njalipuTo bhUtvA namaskuryAd guruM tataH

verses.sanskrit: प्रातःप्रभृति सायान्ते सायादि प्रातरन्ततः । यत्करोमि महादेव तदस्तु तव पूजनम्
verses.transliteration: prAtaHprabhR^iti sAyAnte sAyAdi prAtarantataH | yatkaromi mahAdeva tadastu tava pUjanam
verses.translation: From the Adhara Sakti to the seat of the sacred lore the devotee shall repeat the mantra. sfir:

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिविज्ञाप्य गुरवे लब्धानुज्ञस्ततो गुरोः । निरुद्धप्राण आसीनो विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: prativij~nApya gurave labdhAnuj~nastato guroH | niruddhaprANa AsIno vijitAtmA jitendriyaH
verses.translation: Uttering the mantra beginning with *'I rcson to Sadyojata" and ending with Om repeating the Nada arising from the Adhara and concluding at the Brahma- randhra, along with the twelve knots he shall meditate on the lord in Onkara, pure as crystal, the unsullied, the imperishable, the cause of creation, identical with the worlds, stationed within and without, pervading all, smaller than the smallest and greater than the greatest, visible to the devotees without strain, the unchanging incompre¬ hensible to the gods, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others, the essence of the Vedas, declared as invisible, by the learned devoid of beginning, middle and end and the panacea for all worldly ills.

verses.sanskrit: मूलादिब्रह्मरन्ध्रान्तं षट्चक्रं परिचिन्तयेत् । विद्युत्कोटिसमप्रख्यं सर्वतेजोमयं परम्
verses.transliteration: mUlAdibrahmarandhrAntaM ShaTchakraM parichintayet | vidyutkoTisamaprakhyaM sarvatejomayaM param
verses.translation: After meditating on him thus with concentra¬ tion, the devotee shall perform obeisance after showing different mystic signs and performing the rites of invocation, installation, concentration and observance. He shall meditate on lord Siva himself, of Sakala and Niskala forms.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भाद्यस्यैव व्यष्टिरूपं चुद ह चतुर्मुख, रक्तवर्ण तथा रजोगुणवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्ये चिन्तयेन्मां च सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहम् । निर्गुणं परमं ब्रह्म सदाशिवमनामयम्
verses.transliteration: tanmadhye chintayenmAM cha sachchidAnandavigraham | nirguNaM paramaM brahma sadAshivamanAmayam
verses.translation: After meditating thus, O goddess, he shall meditate on you as Manonmani to my left. Repeating the mantra "Gaurirmimiya"* preceded by the Pranava he shall invoke you as before and perform the rites ending with prostration. The sage of pious concentrated mind shall meditate on you, O goddess.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भ, विराट, पुरुष और काल नामवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहमस्मीति मतिमान्मदैक्यमनुभूय च । बहिर्निर्गत्य च ततो दूरं गच्छेद्यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: so.ahamasmIti matimAnmadaikyamanubhUya cha | bahirnirgatya cha tato dUraM gachChedyathAsukham
verses.translation: You have the lustre of the blooming lotus, eyes expansive and wide, face lustrous as the full moon, curly dark hair, complexion of the brilliant blue lotus, crest decorated with the semicircular moon, breasts rounded, plump protruding, smooth and stout, slender middle large buttocks and fine yellow garment. You arc endowed with ornaments. In your forehead you have a shining Tilaka. Flowers of various colours decorate your braid of hair. Your feature befits your nature. Your face is bent

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He shall offer a fresh piece of cloth saying Jyesthaya Namah" (obeisance to the eldest). He shall offer the sacred thread saying Sresthaya Namah (obeisance to the most excellent).
verses.hindi: है। यह सुन्दर पद पितामहसे अधिष्ठित है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He shall offer a fresh piece of cloth saying Jyesthaya Namah" (obeisance to the eldest). He shall offer the sacred thread saying Sresthaya Namah (obeisance to the most excellent).

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam
verses.translation: He shall offer a fresh piece of cloth saying Jyesthaya Namah" (obeisance to the eldest). He shall offer the sacred thread saying Sresthaya Namah (obeisance to the most excellent).
verses.hindi: होकर निरन्तर लीला करते रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.५. पञ्चमोऽध्यायः । संन्यासमण्डलविधिवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । परीक्ष्य विधिवद्भूमिं गन्धवर्णरसादिभिः । मनोभिलषिते तत्र वितानवितताम्बरे
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.5\. pa~nchamo.adhyAyaH | sa.nnyAsamaNDalavidhivarNanam | Ishvara uvAcha | parIkShya vidhivadbhUmiM gandhavarNarasAdibhiH | manobhilaShite tatra vitAnavitatAmbare
verses.translation: He shall offer water for Acamana once again saying "Rudraya Namah" (obeisance to Rudra). He shall offer well consecrated scent saying "Kalaya Namah.
verses.hindi: शक्तिमानू शिवरूप ही है--यह सुनिश्चित है

verses.sanskrit: तदुपर्यमरेशं च महाकालं च मध्यतः । तन्मस्तकस्थं दण्डं च तत ईश्वरमालिखेत्
verses.transliteration: taduparyamareshaM cha mahAkAlaM cha madhyataH | tanmastakasthaM daNDaM cha tata IshvaramAlikhet
verses.translation: He shall offer raw grains saying "Kalavikaranaya Namah". He.shall offer flowers, saying Balavikaranaya Namah"
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे परष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायागुप्रासनायूर्त्तिवर्णं नाम पञ्ञदशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: श्यामेन पीठं पीतेन श्रीकण्ठं च विचित्रयेत् । अमरेशं महाकालं रक्तं कृष्णं च तौ क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: shyAmena pIThaM pItena shrIkaNThaM cha vichitrayet | amareshaM mahAkAlaM raktaM kR^iShNaM cha tau kramAt
verses.translation: He shall offer incense assiduously saying "Balaya Namah". "He shall offer good lamp saying "Bala- pramathanaya Namah."

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात्सुधूम्रं दण्डं च धवलं चेश्वरं बुधः । एवं यन्त्रं समालिख्य रक्तं सद्येन वेष्टयेत्
verses.transliteration: kuryAtsudhUmraM daNDaM cha dhavalaM cheshvaraM budhaH | evaM yantraM samAlikhya raktaM sadyena veShTayet
verses.translation: Along with the Vedas including their six ancillarics, Matrka, Pranava and Siva joined with Siva, he shall show mystic signs to me and to you, O good-complexioned lady. First he shall render service to me, then to you.

verses.sanskrit: तदुत्थेनैव नादेन भिन्द्यादीशानमीश्वरि । तद्बाह्यपङ्क्तीर्गृह्णीयादाग्नेयादिक्रमेण वै
verses.transliteration: tadutthenaiva nAdena bhindyAdIshAnamIshvari | tadbAhyapa~NktIrgR^ihNIyAdAgneyAdikrameNa vai
verses.translation: When he offers things and performs rites to you he shall use the feminine gender. O Parvati, none but this is the difference. After performing meditation and worship duly in accordence with the rules the expert devotee shall begin the Avarana Puja.

verses.sanskrit: कोष्ठानि कोणभागेषु चत्वार्येतानि सुन्दरि । शुक्लेनापूर्य वर्णादि चतुष्कं रक्तधातुभिः
verses.transliteration: koShThAni koNabhAgeShu chatvAryetAni sundari | shuklenApUrya varNAdi chatuShkaM raktadhAtubhiH
verses.hindi: कृपातस्तव देवेश दृढज्ञानी भवाम्यहम्॥ १२  ज्ञानी हो जाऊँ

verses.sanskrit: आपूर्य तानि चत्वारि द्वाराणि परिकल्पयेत् । ततस्तत्पार्श्वयोर्द्वन्द्वं पीतेनैव प्रपूरयेत्
verses.transliteration: ApUrya tAni chatvAri dvArANi parikalpayet | tatastatpArshvayordvandvaM pItenaiva prapUrayet
verses.translation: O goddess, there are five Avarapas here. The five Avarana-worships shall be performed thus.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयकोष्ठमध्ये तु पीताभे चतुरस्रके । अष्टपत्रं लिखेत्पद्मं रक्ताभं पीतकर्णिकम्
verses.transliteration: AgneyakoShThamadhye tu pItAbhe chaturasrake | aShTapatraM likhetpadmaM raktAbhaM pItakarNikam
verses.translation: Where they had been previoushy worshipped, the lords GaneSa and Karttikeyu shall be worshipped in order.
verses.hindi: अत: उनकी बात नहीं सुननी चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: हकारं विलिखेन्मध्ये बिन्दुयुक्तं समाहितः । पद्मस्य नैरृते कोष्ठे चतुरस्रं तदा लिखेत्
verses.transliteration: hakAraM vilikhenmadhye binduyuktaM samAhitaH | padmasya nairR^ite koShThe chaturasraM tadA likhet
verses.translation: The five Brahmans shall be worshipped in order in the north-east, east, south, north and west. The devotee shall worship the six ancillaries then. He shall worship the eye and Astra in the southeast, northeast, southwest, north¬ west and in the middle. Thus the first Avarana is mentioned. Now listen to the second Avarana.

verses.sanskrit: पद्ममष्टदलं रक्तं पीतकिञ्जल्ककर्णिकम् । शवर्गस्य तृतीयं तु षष्ठस्वरसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: padmamaShTadalaM raktaM pItaki~njalkakarNikam | shavargasya tR^itIyaM tu ShaShThasvarasamanvitam
verses.translation: He shall worship Ananta in the petal in the east; the Suksma in the South; Sivottama in the west; Ekanetra in the north; Ekarudra in the northeast; the Trinity in the southeast; l§rikantha in the south-west and 6ikhan<iSa in the north-west.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशस्वरोपेतं बिन्दुनादविभूषितम् । एतद् बीजवरं भद्रे पद्ममध्ये समालिखेत्
verses.transliteration: chaturdashasvaropetaM bindunAdavibhUShitam | etad bIjavaraM bhadre padmamadhye samAlikhet
verses.translation: In the second Avarana he shall worship the Empe¬ rors. (Now the third Avarana). The devotee shall worship Vjreana in the middle of the eastern door.
verses.hindi: प्रकाश भी मलिन अर्थात् मन्द हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रलिप्ते महीपृष्ठे दर्पणोदरसन्निभे । अरत्नियुग्ममानेन चतुरस्रं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: supralipte mahIpR^iShThe darpaNodarasannibhe | aratniyugmamAnena chaturasraM prakalpayet
verses.translation: Nandin shall be worshipped to the south and Mahakala to the north of it, BhrngiSa to the west of the southern door. Vinayaka shall be worshipped in the square to the east of that with scents; Vrsabha in the northwest and Guha in the southern square. To the east of the northern door the following eight shall be worshipped in accordance with the rules of circumambulation. They are Bhava, l§arva, Isana, Rudra, Pasupati, Ugra, Bhima and Mahadeva. Such is the worship in the third Avarana.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मस्येशानकोष्ठे तु तथा पद्मं समालिखेत् । कवर्गस्य तृतीयं तु पञ्चमस्वरसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: padmasyeshAnakoShThe tu tathA padmaM samAlikhet | kavargasya tR^itIyaM tu pa~nchamasvarasaMyutam
verses.translation: After invoking Lord Siva with the mantra "Yo Vedadau Svarab"*® he shall worship.him in the lotus above the pericarp in the east.

verses.sanskrit: विलिखेन्मध्यतस्तस्य बिन्दुं कण्ठे स्वलङ्कृतम् । तद्बाह्यपङ्क्तित्रितये पूर्वादिपरितः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vilikhenmadhyatastasya binduM kaNThe svala~NkR^itam | tadbAhyapa~Nktitritaye pUrvAdiparitaH kramAt
verses.translation: He shall worship Lord Siva in the eastern, ViveSa in the southern, Parameiana in the northern and Sarvea in the western petal.

verses.sanskrit: कोष्ठानि पञ्च गृह्णीयाद्गिरिराजसुते शिवे । मध्ये तु कर्णिकां कुर्यात्पीतां रक्तं च वृत्तकम्
verses.transliteration: koShThAni pa~ncha gR^ihNIyAdgirirAjasute shive | madhye tu karNikAM kuryAtpItAM raktaM cha vR^ittakam
verses.translation: He shall worship Rudra in the south after invoking him with Rk "A vo rajanam*'*® in the petals and the pericarp with scents, flowers etc.

verses.sanskrit: दलानि रक्तवर्णानि कल्पयेत्कल्पवित्तमः । दलबाह्ये तु कृष्णेन रन्ध्राणि परिपूरयेत्
verses.transliteration: dalAni raktavarNAni kalpayetkalpavittamaH | dalabAhye tu kR^iShNena randhrANi paripUrayet
verses.translation: Siva shall be worshipped in the east; Hara in the south; Mfda in the north and Bhava in the petal in the western quarter. They shall be worshipped in this order.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयादीनि चत्वारि शुक्लेनैव प्रपूरयेत् । पूर्वे षड्बिन्दुसहितं षट्कोणं कृष्णमालिखेत्
verses.transliteration: AgneyAdIni chatvAri shuklenaiva prapUrayet | pUrve ShaDbindusahitaM ShaTkoNaM kR^iShNamAlikhet
verses.translation: He shall worship Vasudeva in the east; Aniruddha in the south; Samkarsana in the north and Pradyumna in the west.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तवर्णं दक्षिणतस्त्रिकोणं चोत्तरे ततः । श्वेताभमर्द्धचन्द्रं च पीतवर्णं च पश्चिमे
verses.transliteration: raktavarNaM dakShiNatastrikoNaM chottare tataH | shvetAbhamarddhachandraM cha pItavarNaM cha pashchime
verses.translation: The knower of Mantras shall invoke Brahma with the mantra "Hiranyagarbhah Samavartata"®® etc. and worship him in the lotus to the west.

verses.sanskrit: चतुरस्रं क्रमात्तेषु लिखेद्बीजं चतुष्टयम् । पूर्वे बिन्दुं समालिख्य शुभ्रं कृष्णं तु दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: chaturasraM kramAtteShu likhedbIjaM chatuShTayam | pUrve binduM samAlikhya shubhraM kR^iShNaM tu dakShiNe
verses.translation: He shall worship Hiranyagarbha in the east; Viraja in the south; Puskara in the north and Kala in the west.

verses.sanskrit: उकारमुत्तरे रक्तं मकारं पश्चिमे ततः । अकारं पीतमेवं तु कृत्वा वर्णचतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: ukAramuttare raktaM makAraM pashchime tataH | akAraM pItamevaM tu kR^itvA varNachatuShTayam
verses.translation: (Now the fifth Avarana). In the topmost row the Lokapalas shall be worshipped in different spots beginning with the last and proceeding in the manner of circumambula- tion. The following ten are the Bijas for the Lokapalas: — Ranta (ending with 'Ra'), Panta (ending with 'Pa'), Jflanta (ending with 'Jfta') Lanta (ending with 'La') twice, Apurvaka ( beginning with 'A'), Santa (ending with 'Sa'), Santa (ending with 'Sa') Vedadya (Pranava) and SriBija. He shall worship the Lokapalas with these Bijas. He shall worship Brahma and Visnu in accordance with the rules and proper means of service in the north, south-west, south and north-east. He shall worship Devesa in the outer lines of the fifth Avarana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोर्ध्वपङ्क्त्यधः पङ्क्तौ समारभ्य च सुन्दरि । पीतं श्वेतं च रक्तं च कृष्णं चेति चतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: sarvordhvapa~NktyadhaH pa~Nktau samArabhya cha sundari | pItaM shvetaM cha raktaM cha kR^iShNaM cheti chatuShTayam
verses.translation: He shall worship trident in the north-east, thunder¬ bolt in the east; axe in the south-east; arrow in the south; sword in the south-west; noose in the west; goad in the north¬ west and bow in the north.
verses.hindi: होनेपर भी ये सहैव भासित होती रहती हैं

verses.sanskrit: तदधो धवलं श्यामं पीतं रक्तं चतुष्टयम् । अधस्त्रिकोणके रक्तं शुक्लं पीतं वरानने
verses.transliteration: tadadho dhavalaM shyAmaM pItaM raktaM chatuShTayam | adhastrikoNake raktaM shuklaM pItaM varAnane
verses.hindi: करनेवाली है, उस कलाका नाम 'राग' है

verses.sanskrit: तालपत्रं समादाय तत्समायामविस्तरम् । तस्मिन्भागान्प्रकुर्वीत त्रयोदशसमां कलाम्
verses.transliteration: tAlapatraM samAdAya tatsamAyAmavistaram | tasminbhAgAnprakurvIta trayodashasamAM kalAm
verses.translation: Ibid. 13. 4.
verses.hindi: डति श्रीशिवमहाएराणे पष्ठ्या कैलाससंहितायां शिवतत्त्ववर्णं नाम षोडशो5 ध्यायः

verses.sanskrit: एवं दक्षिणमारभ्य कुर्यात्सोमान्तमीश्वरि । तद्बाह्यपङ्क्तौ पूर्वादिमध्यमान्तं विचित्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM dakShiNamArabhya kuryAtsomAntamIshvari | tadbAhyapa~Nktau pUrvAdimadhyamAntaM vichitrayet
verses.translation: For the satisfaction of Siva, the knower of the rules shall worship Ketrapala of Rudra facing the west, in accor¬ dance with the rules.

verses.sanskrit: पीतं रक्तं च कृष्णं च श्यामं श्वेतं च पीतकम् । आग्रेयादि समारभ्य रक्तं श्यामं सितं प्रिये
verses.transliteration: pItaM raktaM cha kR^iShNaM cha shyAmaM shvetaM cha pItakam | AgreyAdi samArabhya raktaM shyAmaM sitaM priye
verses.translation: All these shall be thought of as standing with palms joined in reverence, their faces beaming with smile and glan¬ cing at the lord and the goddess with devotion always.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तं कृष्णं च रक्तं च षट्कमेव प्रकीर्तितम् । दक्षिणाद्यं महेशानि पूर्वावधि समीरितम्
verses.transliteration: raktaM kR^iShNaM cha raktaM cha ShaTkameva prakIrtitam | dakShiNAdyaM maheshAni pUrvAvadhi samIritam
verses.translation: After performing the Avarana worship thus, the devotee shall worship the lord of the gods again for allaying his mental disturbance. He shall know Pranava as Siva.
verses.hindi: जनक, ब्रह्म एवं सच्चिदानन्द स्वरूपवाले हैं

verses.sanskrit: नैरृताद्यं तु विज्ञेयमाग्नेयावधि चेश्वरि । वारुणं तु समारभ्य दक्षिणावधि चेरितम्
verses.transliteration: nairR^itAdyaM tu vij~neyamAgneyAvadhi cheshvari | vAruNaM tu samArabhya dakShiNAvadhi cheritam
verses.translation: After worshipping duly thus with scents and other services he shall offer Naivedya prepared in the proper manner.
verses.hindi: मायासे संकुचितरूप धारणकर पुरुषरूप हो गये

verses.sanskrit: वायव्याद्यं महादेवि नैरृतावधि चेरितम् । सोमाद्यं परमेशानि वारुणावधि चेरितम्
verses.transliteration: vAyavyAdyaM mahAdevi nairR^itAvadhi cheritam | somAdyaM parameshAni vAruNAvadhi cheritam
verses.translation: He shall give water for Acamana and the Arghya as before, and then offer Tambula and water in accordance with the rules.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानाद्यं तु विज्ञेयं वायव्यावधि चाम्बिके । इत्युक्तो मण्डलविधिर्मया तुभ्यं च पार्वति
verses.transliteration: IshAnAdyaM tu vij~neyaM vAyavyAvadhi chAmbike | ityukto maNDalavidhirmayA tubhyaM cha pArvati
verses.translation: After performing Nirajana the balance of ihe worship shall be completed. After meditating on the lord and the goddess he shall repeat the mantra hundred and eight times.

verses.sanskrit: एवं मण्डलमालिख्य नियतात्मा यतिः स्वतः । सौरपूजां प्रकुर्वीत स हि तद्वस्तुतत्परः
verses.transliteration: evaM maNDalamAlikhya niyatAtmA yatiH svataH | saurapUjAM prakurvIta sa hi tadvastutatparaH
verses.translation: Then he shall stand up with a handful of flowers, O Goddess, meditate on lord Siva with the mantra beginning with "Yo devanam"®' and ending with "Yo vedadau svarah proktah". The handful of flowers shall be dedicated and he shall perform circumambulation thrice.
verses.hindi: कह रहा हूँ, उसे सावधान होकर आदरपूर्वक सुनें

verses.sanskrit: तत्पत्रं तत्र निःक्षिप्य पश्चिमाभिमुखः स्थितः । तत्पूर्वभागे सुदृढं सूत्रमादाय रञ्जितम्
verses.transliteration: tatpatraM tatra niHkShipya pashchimAbhimukhaH sthitaH | tatpUrvabhAge sudR^iDhaM sUtramAdAya ra~njitam
verses.translation: He shall prostrate with eight parts of the body touching the ground. Endowed with great devotion he shall perform circumambulation again, make obeisance once more.

verses.sanskrit: प्राक् प्रत्यग् दक्षिणोदक् च चतुर्दिशि निपातयेत् । सूत्राणि देवदेवेशि नवषष्ट्युत्तरं शतम्
verses.transliteration: prAk pratyag dakShiNodak cha chaturdishi nipAtayet | sUtrANi devadeveshi navaShaShTyuttaraM shatam
verses.translation: While sitting there, he shall adore the lord with the eight names. Then he shall pray thus: "O lord Siva, good or bad whatever I have done is your great service." After saying this, flowers shall be offered along with the water from the conch. After worshipping him who is worthy of worship he shall repeat the eight names with significant meaning. O goddess, I shall tell you the same because of your devotion to me.

verses.sanskrit: कोष्ठानि स्युस्ततस्तस्य मध्यकोष्ठं तु कर्णिका । कोष्ठाष्टकं बहिस्तस्य दलाष्टकमिहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: koShThAni syustatastasya madhyakoShThaM tu karNikA | koShThAShTakaM bahistasya dalAShTakamihochyate
verses.translation: VS. II. 39

verses.sanskrit: दलानि श्वेतवर्णात्रि समग्राणि प्रकल्पयेत् । पीतरूपां कर्णिकां च कृत्वारक्तं च वृत्तकम्
verses.transliteration: dalAni shvetavarNAtri samagrANi prakalpayet | pItarUpAM karNikAM cha kR^itvAraktaM cha vR^ittakam
verses.translation: The following eight names indicate Siva — Siva, Mahevara, Rudra, Visnu, Pitamaha, Sariisaravaidya, Saravajfia, Paramatman.
verses.hindi: रूपसे महान् आत्मावाला हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: वनभिद्दलदक्षं तु समारभ्य सुरेश्वरि । रक्तकृष्णाः क्रमेणैव दलसन्धीन्विचित्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: vanabhiddaladakShaM tu samArabhya sureshvari | raktakR^iShNAH krameNaiva dalasandhInvichitrayet
verses.translation: The five names of Sadaiiiva are dependent on their condition. If the condition alters the name too alters.
verses.hindi: शक्तिसे काट दूँगा, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: कर्णिकायां लिखेद् यन्त्रं प्रणवार्थप्रकाशकम् । अधः पीठं समालिख्य श्रीकण्ठं च तदूर्ध्वतः
verses.transliteration: karNikAyAM likhed yantraM praNavArthaprakAshakam | adhaH pIThaM samAlikhya shrIkaNThaM cha tadUrdhvataH
verses.translation: Even when words are transferred there are condi¬ tions again. The first five names denote things other than Atman.
verses.hindi: लोकोपकारकरणे विचरन्तीह लिये ही इस लोकमें विचरण करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads. As the enjoyer he becomes merged in Prakrti. He who is beyond this Purusa is named Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: विचरण करते हुए आप अक्षय सुख प्राप्त करें

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads. As the enjoyer he becomes merged in Prakrti. He who is beyond this Purusa is named Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: त्पादारविन्दविहरन्मधुपत्वमाप ॥ ४९  समान आस्वादन करते हुए तत्त्वज्ञ हो गये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam
verses.translation: Prakjrti is yonder than the twentythree principles Purusa, the twentyfifth principle is yonder than Prakrti. The Purua is called Svara as expressed in the Vedas. He becomes intelligible and recognizable only through the Vedas and the Upanisads. As the enjoyer he becomes merged in Prakrti. He who is beyond this Purusa is named Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । अन्न्यासपद्धतौ न्यासवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । दक्षिणे मण्डलस्याथ वैयाघ्रं चर्म शोभनम् । आस्तीर्य शुद्धतोयेन प्रोक्षयेदस्त्रमन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.6\. ShaShTho.adhyAyaH | annyAsapaddhatau nyAsavarNanam | Ishvara uvAcha | dakShiNe maNDalasyAtha vaiyAghraM charma shobhanam | AstIrya shuddhatoyena prokShayedastramantrataH
verses.translation: He is rightly termed Mahesvara because Prakfti and Purusa are subservient to him. Or Maya is the principle with the three attributes which is imperishable. Know that Maya is the Prakrti and Mayin ( the wielder of Maya) is Mahesvara who is eternal and the releaser from Maya. Hence the name MaheSvara is applicable to him.
verses.hindi: सृष्टिकथन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: देवता स्यात्षडङ्गानि ह्रामित्यादीनि विन्यसेत् । ततः सम्प्रोक्षयेत्पद्ममस्त्रेणाग्नेरगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: devatA syAtShaDa~NgAni hrAmityAdIni vinyaset | tataH samprokShayetpadmamastreNAgneragocharam
verses.translation: The word Rud means misery or cause of misery.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्समर्चयेद्विद्वान् प्रभूतां विमलामपि । सारां चाथ समाराध्य पूर्वादिपरतः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tasminsamarchayedvidvAn prabhUtAM vimalAmapi | sArAM chAtha samArAdhya pUrvAdiparataH kramAt
verses.translation: A pathologist diagnoses correctly and cures illness through medicines. Similarly Siva the cause of dissolu¬ tion, sustenance and origin of the world as well as the router of the gross is called the physician of the world by those who know the nature of the principles.
verses.hindi: पृततः प्राह प्रसन्‍तस्तान् शिवासक्तमना बुध:॥ ३  प्रसन्‍न होकर उनसे कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: अथ कालाग्निरुद्रं च शक्तिमाधारसंज्ञिताम् । अनन्तं पृथिवीं चैव रत्नद्वीपं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: atha kAlAgnirudraM cha shaktimAdhArasa.nj~nitAm | anantaM pR^ithivIM chaiva ratnadvIpaM tathaiva cha
verses.translation: Atoms enveloped by the dirt of the ocean of Maya do not know the gross and subtle things that occur in the three periods of time even when they have the sense- organs for imbibing the five-fold knowledge. But SadaSiva knows every existent object naturally, even though he has no sense-organs yielding the knowledge of all existent objects. Hence he is called omniscient.
verses.hindi: सभी “लोग उन दोनोंके संवादको पुन: सुनें

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्य वृक्षोद्यानं च गृहं मणिमयं ततः । रक्तपीठं च सम्पूज्य पादेषु प्रागुपक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sa~Nkalya vR^ikShodyAnaM cha gR^ihaM maNimayaM tataH | raktapIThaM cha sampUjya pAdeShu prAgupakramAt
verses.translation: After eulogising Mahadeva, identical with Pranava, the imperishable and offering gifts on the head of Isana, he worships the lord with the purity of mind, by means of the pranava. He shall then take a handful of flowers, join palms in reverence, inhale through the left nostril, identifying the inhaled air with Siva and exhale through the right nostril bidding the ritualistic adieu to the goddess. He shall realise the identity of Siva with himself. "I am Siva alone.** He shall make the ritualistic dismissal of the deities conceived in the heart.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं च चतुष्टयम् । अधर्माद्यग्निकोणादिकोणेषु च समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: dharmaM j~nAnaM cha vairAgyamaishvaryaM cha chatuShTayam | adharmAdyagnikoNAdikoNeShu cha samarchayet
verses.translation: After worshipping the lore and the preceptor he shall fix in the heart the mantras o the conch and the vessel of Arghya.
verses.hindi: इन्हें उपदेशमें अधिकार क्‍यों नहीं है ?

verses.sanskrit: मायाधश्छदनं पश्चाद्विद्योर्ध्वच्छदनं ततः । सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव समभ्यर्च्य यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: mAyAdhashChadanaM pashchAdvidyordhvachChadanaM tataH | sattvaM rajastamashchaiva samabhyarchya yathAkramam
verses.translation: After consigning the remnants of the floral offerings to Ganesa in the north-east quarter he shall restrain
verses.hindi: तथा पार्वतीका ध्यान करते हुए कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वादिदिक्षु मध्ये च दीप्तां सूक्ष्मां जयामपि । भद्रां विभूतिं विमलाममोघां वैद्युतामपि
verses.transliteration: pUrvAdidikShu madhye cha dIptAM sUkShmAM jayAmapi | bhadrAM vibhUtiM vimalAmamoghAM vaidyutAmapi
verses.translation: O beloved, he shall worship it, as mentiond above. He shall pour water from Argha above on the top of Linga.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतोमुखसंज्ञां च कन्दनालं तथैव च । सुषिरं च ततस्तं तु कण्टकांस्तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvatomukhasa.nj~nAM cha kandanAlaM tathaiva cha | suShiraM cha tatastaM tu kaNTakAMstadanantaram
verses.translation: After worshipping it with Pranava he shall offer incense and the lamp. After propitiating Ganda in the north*east he shall offer Nirmalya.

verses.sanskrit: मूलच्छदनकिञ्जल्कप्रकाशसकलात्मनः । पञ्चग्रन्थिकर्णिकां च दलानि तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: mUlachChadanaki~njalkaprakAshasakalAtmanaH | pa~nchagranthikarNikAM cha dalAni tadanantaram
verses.translation: The Linga and the altar shall be washed with the filtered water. Repeating the Pranava he shall put a flower on the top of the Liiiga. He shall mentally con¬ ceive everythig from the Adhara Sakti to the seat of the holy lore and install the supreme god.
verses.hindi: प्रवालगोमेदके चर पञ्ञरलमिदं स्मृतम्॥ २८  गया है

verses.sanskrit: केशरान् ब्रह्मविष्णू च रुद्रमात्मानमेव च । अन्तरात्मानमपि च ज्ञानात्मपरमात्मनि
verses.transliteration: kesharAn brahmaviShNU cha rudramAtmAnameva cha | antarAtmAnamapi cha j~nAnAtmaparamAtmani
verses.translation: He shall perform the ablution of the lord with Pafleagavya etc. or with holy water rendered fragrant with scented articles repeating the mantras from the Rg or Samaveda such as 'Pavamana' 'Rudra' 'Nila' or 'Tvarita' along with the five Brahmans. The Pranava or the name of Siva can be used as mantra. The ablution shall be made with the Arghya water repeating the Pranava.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य पश्चादाधारमुद्धरेत् । तत्पश्चाच्छक्तिकमलं चतुर्थ्यन्तं नमोऽन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: praNavaM pUrvamuddhR^itya pashchAdAdhAramuddharet | tatpashchAchChaktikamalaM chaturthyantaM namo.antakam
verses.translation: After wiping the Liiiga with a piece of cloth he shall put a flower on the top. After installing the Linga on the pedestal he shall perform the worship of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य पश्चात्सौराख्यं योगपीठं समर्चयेत् । पीठोपरि समाकल्प्य मूर्त्तिं मूलेन मूलवित्
verses.transliteration: sampUjya pashchAtsaurAkhyaM yogapIThaM samarchayet | pIThopari samAkalpya mUrttiM mUlena mUlavit
verses.translation: He shall worship the Adharasakti and Ananta beneath the pedestal. After worshipping the throne duly with the lower and upper lid he shall worship Skanda on the foot of the Pijha. After conceiving me in the Linga he shall worship me along with you.
verses.hindi: तानि धारय चित्ते हि स ब्रूयादिति संस्फुटम् ॥ ४७  करे

verses.sanskrit: निरुद्धप्राण आसीनो मूलेनैव स्वमूलतः । शक्तिमुत्थाप्य तत्तेन प्रभावात्पिङ्गलाध्वना
verses.transliteration: niruddhaprANa AsIno mUlenaiva svamUlataH | shaktimutthApya tattena prabhAvAtpi~NgalAdhvanA
verses.translation: The ascedc shall think on me with devotion in accordance with the rules. O beloved, thus I have narrated to you a great secret that shall be guarded assiduously. It shall not be imparted to any one and everyone. It shall be
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे परष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां संन्यासप्रद्धतों शिष्यकरणविधिनमाष्टादशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पाञ्जलौ निर्गमय्य मण्डलस्थस्य भास्वतः । सिन्दूरारुणदेहस्य वामार्धदयितस्य च
verses.transliteration: puShpA~njalau nirgamayya maNDalasthasya bhAsvataH | sindUrAruNadehasya vAmArdhadayitasya cha
verses.translation: It shall be given to a person devoted to his preceptor, who is calm and who engages in Yoga for attaining me. The foolish fellow who transgresses my directives and gives this away is my enemy. Surely he will go to hell. O goddess, imparting it to my devotee he will become my favourite. After enjoying all pleasures here he shall attain my presence.
verses.hindi: पिष्यकरणविधि नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अक्षस्रक्पाशखट्वाङ्गकपालाङ्कुशपङ्कजम् । शङ्खं चक्रं दधानस्य चतुर्वक्त्रस्य लोचनैः
verses.transliteration: akShasrakpAshakhaTvA~NgakapAlA~Nkushapa~Nkajam | sha~NkhaM chakraM dadhAnasya chaturvaktrasya lochanaiH
verses.translation: On hearing this speech of Siva, the goddess eulogised the lord with various hymns containing the purport of the Vcdic mantras. She bowed at the feet of her lord. O excellent sages, she rejoiced with a delighted heart.

verses.sanskrit: राजितस्य द्वादशभिस्तस्य हृत्पङ्कजोदरे । प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य ह्रां ह्रीं सस्तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: rAjitasya dvAdashabhistasya hR^itpa~Nkajodare | praNavaM pUrvamuddhR^itya hrAM hrIM sastadanantaram
verses.translation: After saying this, the excellent sage of great penance, the son of Parasara, worshipped and honoured with intent devotion by the sages and propounder of the Vedas, thought of the mount Kailasa and left that hermitage. Delighted in their hearts, at the end of the sacrifice they too worshipped the moon-crested god and the goddess Uma wi»h great devotion. They engaged themselves in Yogic practices of restraint etc. and continued to meditate on Siva.
verses.hindi: सर्वरूपता स्पष्ट ही सूचित होती है

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशशक्तिसहितं मार्तण्डं च ततः परम् । आवाहयामि नम इत्यावाह्यावाहनाख्यया
verses.transliteration: prakAshashaktisahitaM mArtaNDaM cha tataH param | AvAhayAmi nama ityAvAhyAvAhanAkhyayA
verses.translation: On knowing vonr love for the lord and realising that you are his favountc devotee, this secret of secrets has been narrated to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: मुद्रया स्थापनाद्याश्च मुद्राः सन्दर्शयेत्ततः । विन्यस्याङ्गानि ह्रां ह्रीं ह्रूं अन्तेन मनुना ततः
verses.transliteration: mudrayA sthApanAdyAshcha mudrAH sandarshayettataH | vinyasyA~NgAni hrAM hrIM hrUM antena manunA tataH
verses.translation: This secret lore dear to Siva shall be given by you only to ascetics of quiet minds, devotees of Siva's feet.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चोपचारान्सङ्कल्प्य मूलेनाभ्यर्चयेत् त्रिधा । केशरेषु च पद्मस्य षडङ्गानि महेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: pa~nchopachArAnsa~Nkalpya mUlenAbhyarchayet tridhA | keshareShu cha padmasya ShaDa~NgAni maheshvari
verses.translation: After saying this the blessed Suta, most excellent of Pauranikas, wandered over the earth, visiting the holy centres.
verses.hindi: अर्थ किया जाता है, वह औपचारिक है

verses.sanskrit: वह्नीशरक्षोवायूनां परितः क्रमतः सुधीः । द्वितीयावरणे पूज्याश्चतस्रो मूर्तयः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vahnIsharakShovAyUnAM paritaH kramataH sudhIH | dvitIyAvaraNe pUjyAshchatasro mUrtayaH kramAt
verses.translation: After securing this great secret from Suta, the sages remained in Kai and attained Siva's abode by attaining salvation.
verses.hindi: शिव ही सम्पूर्ण तत्त्वसमुदायका प्राण हूँ

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वाद्युत्तरपर्यन्तं दलमूलेषु पार्वति । आदित्यो भास्करो भानू रविश्चेत्यनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: pUrvAdyuttaraparyantaM dalamUleShu pArvati | Adityo bhAskaro bhAnU ravishchetyanupUrvashaH
verses.translation: When Suta had left, the wondering sages thought and spoke to one another — "What the great sage said about Vamadeva's opinion has been forgotten. This is indeed dis¬ tressing to us.

verses.sanskrit: मनुमेवं समुच्चार्य स्थित्वा तस्मिन्नुदङ्मुखः । प्राणानायम्य विधिवत्प्रणवोच्चारपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: manumevaM samuchchArya sthitvA tasminnuda~NmukhaH | prANAnAyamya vidhivatpraNavochchArapUrvakam
verses.translation: When shall we see the excellent sage again? His sight dispels the vast miseries of worldly existence. May the great sage appear again as a result of the merit accruing from the worship of lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अर्को ब्रह्मा तथा रुद्रो विष्णुश्चेति पुनः प्रिये । ईशानादिषु सम्पूज्यास्तृतीयावरणे पुनः
verses.transliteration: arko brahmA tathA rudro viShNushcheti punaH priye | IshAnAdiShu sampUjyAstR^itIyAvaraNe punaH
verses.translation: The sages who were worried with these thoughts worshipped Suta in the lotus of their heart and stayed there being eager to see him.

verses.sanskrit: सोमं कुजं बुधं जीवं कविं मन्दं तमस्तमः । समन्ततो यजेदेतान्पूर्वादिदलमध्यतः
verses.transliteration: somaM kujaM budhaM jIvaM kaviM mandaM tamastamaH | samantato yajedetAnpUrvAdidalamadhyataH
verses.translation: At the end of a year, the sage, engaged in devo¬ tional activities of Siva, the wise propounder of the meaning to the Puranas, came to Kasi again.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा द्वादशादित्यान्द्वितीयावरणे यजेत् । तृतीयावरणे चैव राशीन्द्वादश पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: athavA dvAdashAdityAndvitIyAvaraNe yajet | tR^itIyAvaraNe chaiva rAshIndvAdasha pUjayet
verses.translation: On seeing Suta coming, the sages delighted in their minds, worshipped him duly rising up and offering seat and Arghya.
verses.hindi: आश्रय ले सुखी रहो, सुखी रहो ।'

verses.sanskrit: सप्तसागरगङ्गाश्च बहिरस्य समन्ततः । ऋषीन्देवांश्च गन्धर्वान्पन्नगानप्सरोगणान्
verses.transliteration: saptasAgaraga~NgAshcha bahirasya samantataH | R^iShIndevAMshcha gandharvAnpannagAnapsarogaNAn
verses.translation: He too congratulated the sages with a smiling face. With pleasure he took the bath in the holy waters of the Gahga.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्‍न चित्तसे शिष्यको अपने समान बना दें

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामण्यश्च तथा यक्षान्यातुधानांस्तथा हयान् । सप्तच्छन्दोमयांश्चैव बालखिल्यांश्च पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: grAmaNyashcha tathA yakShAnyAtudhAnAMstathA hayAn | saptachChandomayAMshchaiva bAlakhilyAMshcha pUjayet
verses.translation: He propitiated the sages, the gods and the Pitrs with gingelly seeds and rice grains. He came to the bank and put on his dress after sprinkling it with water.
verses.hindi: जशति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे पष्ठ्यां कैलाससंहितायां योगपट्रविधिवर्णन नामैकोनविंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्र्यावरणं देवं समभ्यर्च्य दिवाकरम् । विरच्य मण्डलं पश्चाच्चतुरस्रं समाहितः
verses.transliteration: evaM tryAvaraNaM devaM samabhyarchya divAkaram | virachya maNDalaM pashchAchchaturasraM samAhitaH
verses.translation: He performed the Acamana twice and took the Bhasm i repeating the SadyMi mantras. Wearing the garland
verses.hindi: करनेसे यतिकी तत्क्षण परम शुद्धि होती है

verses.sanskrit: स्थाप्य साधारकं ताम्रपात्रं प्रस्थोदविस्तृतम् । पूरयित्वा जलैः शुद्धैर्वासितैः कुसुमादिभिः
verses.transliteration: sthApya sAdhArakaM tAmrapAtraM prasthodavistR^itam | pUrayitvA jalaiH shuddhairvAsitaiH kusumAdibhiH
verses.translation: With great devotion he eulogised, bowed to and worshipped lord Siva and Uma along with his sons and chief Ganas.
verses.hindi: वस्त्र पहने हुए ही क्षौरकर्म कराये

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्जानुभ्यामवनिं गतः । अर्घ्यपात्रं समादाय भ्रूमध्यान्तं समुद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: abhyarchya gandhapuShpAdyairjAnubhyAmavaniM gataH | arghyapAtraM samAdAya bhrUmadhyAntaM samuddharet
verses.translation: He worshipped Kalabhairava in accordance with the rules after circumambulating him thrice. He prostrated five times and circumambutaled again. Thinking upon his lotus-feet he eulogised him again with the great hymn.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ब्रूयादिमं मन्त्रं सावित्रं सर्वसिद्धिदम् । शृणु तच्च महादेवि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं सदा
verses.transliteration: tato brUyAdimaM mantraM sAvitraM sarvasiddhidam | shR^iNu tachcha mahAdevi bhuktimuktipradaM sadA
verses.translation: He performed the Japa of the sacred Pancak?ari lore one thousand and eight times. Standing in front of lord Siva's image he begged for forgiveness. After worship¬ ping him he took his seat in the the middle of Muktimandapa offered by the sages who had mastered the Vedas.
verses.hindi: हाथ-पैरके नाखून भी कटवा लेना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: सिन्दूरवर्णाय सुमण्डलाय नमोऽस्तु वज्राभरणाय तुभ्यम् । पद्माभनेत्राय सपङ्कजाय ब्रह्मेन्द्रनारायणकारणाय
verses.transliteration: sindUravarNAya sumaNDalAya namo.astu vajrAbharaNAya tubhyam | padmAbhanetrAya sapa~NkajAya brahmendranArAyaNakAraNAya
verses.translation: When all had taken their seats after due obeisance with the recital of the mantras he spoke in accents that in¬ creased the piety of the sages.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैर्भस्म सन्धारयेत्ततः । शिरसि श्रीगुरुं नत्वा मण्डलं रचयेत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: agnirityAdibhirmantrairbhasma sandhArayettataH | shirasi shrIguruM natvA maNDalaM rachayetpunaH
verses.translation: O intelligent sages, you all who have fulfilled your vows are blessed. I have come for your sake. Please listen in details.

verses.sanskrit: सरक्तचूर्णं ससुवर्णतोयं स्रक्कुङ्कुमाढ्यं सकुशं सपुष्पम् । प्रदत्तमादाय सहेमपात्रं प्रशस्तमर्घ्यं भगवन्प्रसीद
verses.transliteration: saraktachUrNaM sasuvarNatoyaM srakku~NkumADhyaM sakushaM sapuShpam | pradattamAdAya sahemapAtraM prashastamarghyaM bhagavanprasIda
verses.translation: After telling you the meaning of the Pranava I went on a pilgp'image. Now hear the details.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततो दत्त्वा तदर्घ्यं सूर्यमूर्तये । नमस्कुर्यादिमं मन्त्रं पठित्वा सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvA tato dattvA tadarghyaM sUryamUrtaye | namaskuryAdimaM mantraM paThitvA susamAhitaH
verses.translation: O leading brahmans, after starting from here I went to the southern ocean. I took bath therein and worshipped the goddess l§iva, Kanyakumari. On my return I came to the river Suvarnamukhari®.

verses.sanskrit: नमः शिवाय साम्बाय सगणायादिहेतवे । रुद्राय विष्णवे तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणे च त्रिमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: namaH shivAya sAmbAya sagaNAyAdihetave | rudrAya viShNave tubhyaM brahmaNe cha trimUrtaye
verses.translation: I reached the wonderful city on the Kalahasti!§aila. I took my bath in the waters of SuvarnamukharP®®and performed Tarpana to the gods and the sages. Remembering Siva with the mystic signs I worshipped Kalahastisa with the lustre of the lunar stone, the lord with the face directed to the west, the wonderful lord of five faces, the lord who
verses.hindi: करे, किंतु दूषित अन्न कभी ग्रहण न करे

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा नमस्कृत्य स्वासने समवस्थितः । ऋष्यादिकं पुनः कृत्वा करं संशोध्य वारिणा
verses.transliteration: evamuktvA namaskR^itya svAsane samavasthitaH | R^iShyAdikaM punaH kR^itvA karaM saMshodhya vAriNA
verses.translation: This sacred river of South India issues from the Agaslya mountain, flows in the North Arcot district near Kalahasti mountain and falls into the southern sea.

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च भस्म सन्धार्य पूर्वोक्तेनैव वर्त्मना । न्यासजातं प्रकुर्वीत शिवभावविवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: punashcha bhasma sandhArya pUrvoktenaiva vartmanA | nyAsajAtaM prakurvIta shivabhAvavivR^iddhaye
verses.translation: O great sages, I spent four months there by the favour of the goddess — the bud of the flower of knowledge.
verses.hindi: कर्म यतियोंके लिये सर्वथा वर्जित हैं

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चोपचारैः सम्पूज्य शिरसा श्रीगुरुं बुधः । प्रणवं श्रीचतुर्थ्यन्तं नमोऽन्तं प्रणमेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchopachAraiH sampUjya shirasA shrIguruM budhaH | praNavaM shrIchaturthyantaM namo.antaM praNamettataH
verses.translation: Once I spread the cloth, deerskin and the Kusa grass on the seat. Seated on it silently with restrained mind I entered into the mystic trance. "I am Siva the solidified knowledge and bliss, the perfect one for ever." This realisation dawned in my heart and I was free from agitation.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे षष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां क्षौरस्नानविधिवर्णन॑ नाम विंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चात्मकं बिन्दुयुतं पञ्चमस्वरसंयुतम् । तदेवं बिन्दुसहितं पञ्चमस्वरवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAtmakaM binduyutaM pa~nchamasvarasaMyutam | tadevaM bindusahitaM pa~nchamasvaravarjitam
verses.translation: Then my preceptor, the ocean of meicy, resem¬ bling the dark cloud, with matted tawny hair resembling the lightning, the tall sage bearing the water-pot and staff and wearing the antelope's skin, with the body turned white with the ashes having all auspicious marks with the Tripundra shining on the forehead, decorated with Rudraksa garlands and the two lotus-like wide eyes gleaming, appeared in the lotus of my heart. Thereafter I swooned soon, O theists, this was the wonderful incident indeed.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमस्वरसंयुक्तं मन्त्रीशं च सबिन्दुकम् । उद्धृत्य बिन्दुसहितं संवर्तकमथोद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchamasvarasaMyuktaM mantrIshaM cha sabindukam | uddhR^itya bindusahitaM saMvartakamathoddharet
verses.translation: Then I opened my eyes and cried. The tears I shed quashed out like a mountain stream.

verses.sanskrit: एतैरेवं क्रमाद्बीजैरुद्धृतैः प्रणमेद् बुधः । भुजयोरूरुयुग्मे च गुरुं गणपतिं तथा
verses.transliteration: etairevaM kramAdbIjairuddhR^itaiH praNamed budhaH | bhujayorUruyugme cha guruM gaNapatiM tathA
verses.translation: "O blessed.son of Suta, go to Varanasi; the sages whom you had instructed before, are desirous of the plca- •sure of your arrival. They are on fast theretoo." After saying this the voice stopped.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गां च क्षेत्रपालं च बद्धाञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः । ओमस्त्राय फडित्युक्त्वा करौ संशोध्य षट् क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: durgAM cha kShetrapAlaM cha baddhA~njalipuTaH sthitaH | omastrAya phaDityuktvA karau saMshodhya ShaT kramAt
verses.translation: I got up immediately and circumambulated the lord and the goddess with devotion. I bowed and prostrated for twelve times. Considering it the order of my preceptor

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकोणवृत्तं बाह्ये तु चतुरस्रात्मकं क्रमात् । अभ्यर्च्योमिति साधारं स्थाप्य शङ्खं समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: trikoNavR^ittaM bAhye tu chaturasrAtmakaM kramAt | abhyarchyomiti sAdhAraM sthApya sha~NkhaM samarchayet
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Suta, the sages were delighted in their minds. They bowed to the sage Vyasa again and again and said.

verses.sanskrit: अपसर्पन्त्विति प्रोच्य प्रणवं तदनन्तरम् । अस्त्राय फडिति प्रोच्य पार्ष्णिघातत्रयेण तु
verses.transliteration: apasarpantviti prochya praNavaM tadanantaram | astrAya phaDiti prochya pArShNighAtatrayeNa tu
verses.translation: O Siita, O blessed Suta, you are our excellent preceptor. We ask you if there be your blessing for us, your faithful disciples, as it has been shown by you who are always affectionate to us.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृत्य विघ्नान्भूयिष्ठान्करतालत्रयेण तु । अन्तरिक्षगतान्दृष्ट्वा विलोक्य दिवि संस्थितान्
verses.transliteration: uddhR^itya vighnAnbhUyiShThAnkaratAlatrayeNa tu | antarikShagatAndR^iShTvA vilokya divi saMsthitAn
verses.translation: Now we are eager to hear it reverentially and devotedly, O ocean of mercy. It behoves you to narrate it with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: निरुद्धप्राण आसीनो हंसमन्त्रमनुस्मरन् । हृदिस्थं जीवचैतन्यं ब्रह्मनाड्या समानयेत्
verses.transliteration: niruddhaprANa AsIno haMsamantramanusmaran | hR^idisthaM jIvachaitanyaM brahmanADyA samAnayet
verses.translation: On hearing this, Suta was thrilled with delight. After making obeisance to lord Siva, the preceptor of pre¬ ceptors, to the goddess-mother of the trio and to his preceptor Vya with devotion he spoke in a majestic tone delighting the sages.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशान्तः स्थविशदे सहस्रारमहाम्बुजे । चिच्चन्द्रमण्डलान्तःस्थं चिद्रूपं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dvAdashAntaH sthavishade sahasrAramahAmbuje | chichchandramaNDalAntaHsthaM chidrUpaM parameshvaram
verses.translation: O sages, hail to you. May you remain happy always; devotees of Siva steady-minded and propagators of devotion to Siva,

verses.sanskrit: शोषदाहप्लवान्कुर्याद्रेचकादि क्रमेण तु । सषोडशचतुष्षष्टिद्वात्रिंशद्गणनायुतैः
verses.transliteration: shoShadAhaplavAnkuryAdrechakAdi krameNa tu | saShoDashachatuShShaShTidvAtriMshadgaNanAyutaiH
verses.translation: That wonderful thing has been heard from the lotus-like mouth of the preceptor. This was not mentioned by me before, being afraid of revealing a secret.

verses.sanskrit: वाय्वग्निसलिलार्णैस्तैः स्ववेदाद्यैरनुक्रमात् । प्राणानायम्य मूलस्थां कुण्डलीं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रगाम्
verses.transliteration: vAyvagnisalilArNaistaiH svavedAdyairanukramAt | prANAnAyamya mUlasthAM kuNDalIM brahmarandhragAm
verses.translation: Indeed you arc highly fortunate devotees of Siva

verses.sanskrit: आनीय द्वादशान्तःस्थसहस्राराम्बुजोदरे । चिच्चन्द्रमण्डलोद्भूतपरमामृतधारया
verses.transliteration: AnIya dvAdashAntaHsthasahasrArAmbujodare | chichchandramaNDalodbhUtaparamAmR^itadhArayA
verses.translation: Formerly in the Rathantara kalpa the sage Vamadeva, roaming over the earth, entered KumaraSikhara,®' the southern summit of Meru where the peacock-vehicled lord Karttikeya, son of Siva, stays joyously. The sage was a liberated soul even while he was in the womb. He was the most-honoured among the knowers of Siva's cult. He knew the reality, and the principles of the Vedas, Agamas, Puranas and other sacred scriptures. He knew the births and activities of all living beings, gods, Asuras, mortals and others. The ashes made his body white. He was bedecked in the knots of matted hair. He had no permanent abode, no desire, no egotism and none of the mutually opposing feelings and emotions. He was unclad. He was very wise like Siva him¬ self. He was surrounded by the leading sages who were like him and who had become his disciples. He sanctified the earth by the pious touch of his feet. His heart dwelt in the great splendour.

verses.sanskrit: संसिक्तायां तनौ भूयः शुद्धदेहः सुभावनः । सोऽहमित्यवतीर्याथ स्वात्मानं हृदयाम्बुजे
verses.transliteration: saMsiktAyAM tanau bhUyaH shuddhadehaH subhAvanaH | so.ahamityavatIryAtha svAtmAnaM hR^idayAmbuje
verses.translation: Lord Karttikeya, the hero possessed of the power of knowledge, the suppressor of the Asuras, stays there along with Gajavalli and bowed to by all the gods.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मन्यावेश्य चात्मानममृतं सृतिधारया । प्राणप्रतिष्ठां विधिवत्कुर्यादत्र समाहितः
verses.transliteration: AtmanyAveshya chAtmAnamamR^itaM sR^itidhArayA | prANapratiShThAM vidhivatkuryAdatra samAhitaH
verses.translation: Near the lord there is a lake Skandasaras®* as vast as an ocean with plenty of deep, sweet, cool, clear water of wonderful attributes. The sage Vamadeva took his bath there along with his disciples. He saw Skanda seated on the summit attended by the sages, shining like the rising sun, with the peacock as his vehicle. He had four arms and splendid body. He was bedecked in coronet and other ornaments. He was reverentially attended by two excellent Saktis. He held Sakti and a cock. He showed the mystic gestures of boons and protection with his hands. On seeing Skanda the sage worshipped him with devotion and began to eulogise him.

verses.sanskrit: एकाग्रमानसो योगी विमृश्यात्तां च मातृकाम् । पुटितां प्रणवेनाथ न्यसेद्बाह्ये च मातृकाम्
verses.transliteration: ekAgramAnaso yogI vimR^ishyAttAM cha mAtR^ikAm | puTitAM praNavenAtha nyasedbAhye cha mAtR^ikAm
verses.translation: This lake formed of the waters of the Kumara hill lying to the south of Meru remains unidentified.
verses.hindi: भेदन करे  इसके बाद उस गड्ढेको पाट दे

verses.sanskrit: आपूर्य शुद्धतोयेन प्रणवेन सुगन्धिना । अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः प्रणवेन च सप्तधा
verses.transliteration: ApUrya shuddhatoyena praNavena sugandhinA | abhyarchya gandhapuShpAdyaiH praNavena cha saptadhA
verses.translation: Om, obeisance to the meaning of the Pranava, to the enterpreter of the Pranava, to the Bija of the letters of the Pranava.

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च संयतप्राणः कुर्याद् दृष्ट्यादिकं बुधः । शङ्करं संस्मरंश्चित्ते संन्यसेच्च विमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: punashcha saMyataprANaH kuryAd dR^iShTyAdikaM budhaH | sha~NkaraM saMsmaraMshchitte sa.nnyasechcha vimatsaraH
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord in the form of the purport of the Upanisad, to their enterpreter and the' knower of their purport.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवस्य ऋषिर्ब्रह्मा देवि गायत्रमीरितम् । छन्दोऽत्र देवताहं वै परमात्मा सदाशिवः
verses.transliteration: praNavasya R^iShirbrahmA devi gAyatramIritam | Chando.atra devatAhaM vai paramAtmA sadAshivaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to Guha, to the deity concealed in the cavities of the hearts of all living beings. Obeisance to the secret one of secret form. Obeisance to the knower of the secret sacred lore.

verses.sanskrit: अकारो बीजमाख्यातमुकारः शक्तिरुच्यते । मकारः कीलकं प्रोक्तं मोक्षार्थे विनियुज्यते
verses.transliteration: akAro bIjamAkhyAtamukAraH shaktiruchyate | makAraH kIlakaM proktaM mokShArthe viniyujyate
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the minutest of the minute, the greatest of the great, the knower of the greater and the lesser, the lord in the form of the great Atman.
verses.hindi: यतीनां मुनिवर्याथैकादशाहविधिं श्रूणु॥ ६६  यतियोंके एकादशाहकी विधि सुनो

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठद्वयमारभ्य तलान्तं परिमार्जयेत् । ओमित्युक्त्वाथ देवेशि करन्यासं समारभेत्
verses.transliteration: a~NguShThadvayamArabhya talAntaM parimArjayet | omityuktvAtha deveshi karanyAsaM samArabhet
verses.translation: Obeisance to Skanda; to the lord of splendour as red as tluit of the sun in the form of Skanda; to the lord who wears the coronets adorned with the garlands of the flowers of the divine Mandara tree.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे षष्ठ्यां केलाससंहितायां यतीनां मरणानन्तरदशाहपर्यन्तकृत्यवर्णन॑ नामैकविंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: दक्षहस्तस्थिताङ्गुष्ठं समारभ्य यथाक्रमम् । वामहस्तकनिष्ठान्तं विन्यसेत्पूर्ववत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: dakShahastasthitA~NguShThaM samArabhya yathAkramam | vAmahastakaniShThAntaM vinyasetpUrvavatkramAt
verses.translation: Obeisance to the disciple of Siva; to the son of Siva, to the bestower of bliss and happiness, to the beloved of Siva; to the storehouse of pleasure of Siva and Siva.
verses.hindi: कृत्यवर्णन नामक इक्कीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अकारमप्युकारं च मकारं बिन्दुसंयुतम् । नमोऽन्तं प्रोच्य सर्वत्र हृदयादौ न्यसेदथ
verses.transliteration: akAramapyukAraM cha makAraM bindusaMyutam | namo.antaM prochya sarvatra hR^idayAdau nyasedatha
verses.translation: Obeisance to the son of the Gahga, to the intelligent Karttikcya, to the noble son of Uma, lying in the grove of Sara plants.

verses.sanskrit: अकारं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य ब्रह्मात्मानमथाचरेत् । ङेऽन्तं नमोऽन्तं हृदये विनियुज्यात्तथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: akAraM pUrvamuddhR^itya brahmAtmAnamathAcharet | ~Ne.antaM namo.antaM hR^idaye viniyujyAttathA punaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to the six-faced god of siv imperishable bodies to the one who interprets in six ways, to the lord whose form is beyond the sixfold path.

verses.sanskrit: उकारं विष्णुसहितं शिरोदेशे प्रविन्यसेत् । मकारं रुद्रसहितं शिखायां तु प्रविन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: ukAraM viShNusahitaM shirodeshe pravinyaset | makAraM rudrasahitaM shikhAyAM tu pravinyaset
verses.translation: O soul of the twelve (?) obeisance be to you with twelve wide eyes, with twelve uplifted arms and twelve types of weapons.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा मुनिर्मन्त्री कवचं नेत्रमस्तके । विन्यसेद्देवदेवेशि सावधानेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: evamuktvA munirmantrI kavachaM netramastake | vinyaseddevadeveshi sAvadhAnena chetasA
verses.translation: Obeisance to the four-armed lord, to the calm lord who bears Sakii and a cock, to the bestower of boons; the learned or to one with a bird in his hand. Obeisance to the splitter of the Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गवक्त्रकलाभेदात्पञ्च ब्रह्माणि विन्यसेत् । शिरोवदनहृद्गुह्यपादेष्वेतानि विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: a~NgavaktrakalAbhedAtpa~ncha brahmANi vinyaset | shirovadanahR^idguhyapAdeShvetAni vinyaset
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this divine prayer to Skanda, uttered by Vamadeva, attains the supreme goal.

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्त्र्य ततस्तस्मिन्धेनुमुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत् । शङ्खमुद्रां च तेनैव प्रोक्षयेदस्त्रमन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: abhimantrya tatastasmindhenumudrAM pradarshayet | sha~NkhamudrAM cha tenaiva prokShayedastramantrataH
verses.translation: This prayer sharpens intelligence, enhances devotion to Siva, increases longevity, imparts health and affluence and yields all desires always.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे षष्ठयां कैलाससंहितायां यतीनामेकादशाहकृत्यवर्णन॑ नाम द्वार्विशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: ईशानस्य कलाः पञ्च पञ्चस्वेतेषु च क्रमात् । ततश्चतुर्षु वक्त्रेषु पुरुषस्य कला अपि
verses.transliteration: IshAnasya kalAH pa~ncha pa~nchasveteShu cha kramAt | tatashchaturShu vaktreShu puruShasya kalA api
verses.translation: O brahmins, after eulogising lord commander- in-chief of the gods thus, circumambulating him thrice and prostrating on the ground Vamadeva bowed to him once again and went round him. Then he stood bowing down with humility.

verses.sanskrit: चतस्रः प्रणिधातव्याः पूर्वादिक्रमयोगतः । हृत्कण्ठांसेषु नाभौ च कुक्षौ पृष्ठे च वक्षसि
verses.transliteration: chatasraH praNidhAtavyAH pUrvAdikramayogataH | hR^itkaNThAMseShu nAbhau cha kukShau pR^iShThe cha vakShasi
verses.translation: O sage, you are the chief of Yogins, perfect and free from avarice. There is nothing for people like you which has to be solicited.

verses.sanskrit: अघोरस्य कलाश्चाष्टौ पूजनीया यथाक्रमम् । पश्चात् त्रयोदशकलाः पायुमेढ्रोरुजानुषु
verses.transliteration: aghorasya kalAshchAShTau pUjanIyA yathAkramam | pashchAt trayodashakalAH pAyumeDhrorujAnuShu
verses.translation: Still saintly men like you move about in the world for upholding virtue and blessing the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: जङ्घास्फिक्कटिपार्श्वेषु वामदेवस्य भावयेत् । सद्यस्यापि कलाश्चाष्टौ नेत्रेषु च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: ja~NghAsphikkaTipArshveShu vAmadevasya bhAvayet | sadyasyApi kalAshchAShTau netreShu cha yathAkramam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Skanda, the sage Vamadeva, bowed with humility and spoke in a tone as majestic as the sound of clouds.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तितास्ताः कलाश्चैवं पादयोरपि हस्तयोः । प्राणे शिरसि बाह्वोश्च कल्पयेत्कल्पवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: kIrtitAstAH kalAshchaivaM pAdayorapi hastayoH | prANe shirasi bAhvoshcha kalpayetkalpavittamaH
verses.translation: O lord, you are the great Isa, the bestower of prosjjerity to all and sundry. You arc omniscient; creator of all and the lord bearing all Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टत्रिंशत्कलान्यासमेवं कृत्वा तु सर्वशः । पश्चात्प्रणवविद्धीमान्प्रणवन्यासमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: aShTatriMshatkalAnyAsamevaM kR^itvA tu sarvashaH | pashchAtpraNavaviddhImAnpraNavanyAsamAcharet
verses.translation: We are insignificant creatures to.speak before you who are  great lord. Still it is your blessing that you speak to me.

verses.sanskrit: बाहुद्वये कूर्परयोस्तथा च मणिबन्धयोः । पार्श्वतोदरजङ्घेषु पादयोः पृष्ठतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bAhudvaye kUrparayostathA cha maNibandhayoH | pArshvatodaraja~NgheShu pAdayoH pR^iShThatastathA
verses.translation: O intelligent one, I have but a particle of wisdom. Urged thus I ask you. My transgression must be excused.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं प्रणवविन्यासं कृत्वा न्यासविचक्षणः । हंसन्यासं प्रकुर्वीत परमात्मविबोधिनि
verses.transliteration: itthaM praNavavinyAsaM kR^itvA nyAsavichakShaNaH | haMsanyAsaM prakurvIta paramAtmavibodhini
verses.translation: Invoked with the mantra he releases the Jiva instantaneously. Hence siddhi is achieved with the mantra Om for Siva.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं गन्धपुष्पादिपूजोपकरणानि च । प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा ऋष्यादिकमथाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: AtmAnaM gandhapuShpAdipUjopakaraNAni cha | prANAyAmatrayaM kR^itvA R^iShyAdikamathAcharet
verses.translation: The eternal Sruti says, "Verily all this is Om; Om is Brahman. Everything is Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य श्रीसौरमन्त्रस्य देवभाग ऋषिस्ततः । छन्दो गायत्रमित्युक्तं देवः सूर्यो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: asya shrIsauramantrasya devabhAga R^iShistataH | Chando gAyatramityuktaM devaH sUryo maheshvaraH
verses.translation: O commander of the gods, obeisance to you, the lord of the gods and of ascetics. Obeisance to you the perfect one.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages. He then began to expound the path of welfare well guarded in the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages. He then began to expound the path of welfare well guarded in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गमिष्ये भवतां भूयः सत्सम्भाषणमस्तु मे॥ ४६  एवं सत्संगका अवसर प्राप्त हो

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam
