verses.translation: Thus requested by the sage, Skanda bowed to Sadasiva, the very pranava itself who is characterised by thirtyeight excellent digits, who is accompanied by Uma at his side and who is followed by the excellent sages. He then began to expound the path of welfare well guarded in the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । शिवध्यानपूजनवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । स्ववामे चतुरस्रं तु मण्डलं परिकल्पयेत् । ओमित्यभ्यर्च्य तस्मिंस्तु शङ्खमस्त्रोपशोधितम्
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.7\. saptamo.adhyAyaH | shivadhyAnapUjanavarNanam | Ishvara uvAcha | svavAme chaturasraM tu maNDalaM parikalpayet | omityabhyarchya tasmiMstu sha~Nkhamastropashodhitam
verses.translation: Well done, well done. O fortunate V'madcva, O great sage, you arc a great devotee of Siva and the most excellent of those who possess Siva's knowledge.
verses.hindi: व्यासादिशिष्यवर्गककथनवर्णन नामक ते्ईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मानं गन्धपुष्पादिपूजोपकरणान्यपि । पद्मस्येशानदिक्पद्मं प्रणवोच्चारपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: svAtmAnaM gandhapuShpAdipUjopakaraNAnyapi | padmasyeshAnadikpadmaM praNavochchArapUrvakam
verses.translation: All the individuals in the world are deceived by the Maya of Isa. They arc deceived by various sacred scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: गुर्वासनाय नम इत्यासनं परिकल्पयेत् । गुरोर्मूर्तिं च तत्रैव कल्पयेदुपदेशतः
verses.transliteration: gurvAsanAya nama ityAsanaM parikalpayet | gurormUrtiM cha tatraiva kalpayedupadeshataH
verses.translation: They do not know the great lord, the meaning of the Pranava, the Nirguna and Saguna Brahman, the great progenitor of trinity.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवं गुं गुरुभ्योऽन्ते नमः प्रोच्यापि देशिकम् । समावाह्य ततो ध्यायेद्दक्षिणाभिमुखं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: praNavaM guM gurubhyo.ante namaH prochyApi deshikam | samAvAhya tato dhyAyeddakShiNAbhimukhaM sthitam
verses.translation: I shall lift up my right hand and swear unto you truth again and again.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसन्नमुखं सौम्यं शुद्धस्फटिकनिर्मलम् । वरदाभयहस्तं च द्विनेत्रं शिवविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: suprasannamukhaM saumyaM shuddhasphaTikanirmalam | varadAbhayahastaM cha dvinetraM shivavigraham
verses.translation: Siva is declared as the purport of the Pranava in the Sruti and Smfti texts, Puranas and the Agamas; from whom words recede unable to reach him along with the mind; the knower of whose bliss does not have fear from anywhere from whom this entire universe, beginning with Brahma, Vinu and Indra is born at the outset with the groups of sense-organs and elements; that which has no cause anywhere at any time; which neither the lightning nor the sun nor the moon does illuminate; by whose splendour this entire universe is resplendent all round; he who is endowed with prosperity himself in the name of Sai- vesvara; who is worthy of being meditated upon by those who are desirous of salvation; he who is the cause of welfare; who is in the middle of the firmament; who is omnipresent, whose soul is light, who is in the form of splendour, knowledge and.consciousness; whose splendid!§akti is comprehensible only through emotion and who is both Nirguna and Saguna, unsullied and auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्यात्वा यजेद्गन्धपुष्पादिभिरनुक्रमात् । पद्मस्य नैरृते पद्मे गणपत्यासनोपरि
verses.transliteration: evaM dhyAtvA yajedgandhapuShpAdibhiranukramAt | padmasya nairR^ite padme gaNapatyAsanopari
verses.translation: Three types of his form — gross, subtle and causal

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तिं प्रकल्प्य तत्रैव गणानां त्वेति मन्त्रतः । समावाह्य ततो देवं ध्यायेदेकाग्रमानसः
verses.transliteration: mUrtiM prakalpya tatraiva gaNAnAM tveti mantrataH | samAvAhya tato devaM dhyAyedekAgramAnasaH

verses.sanskrit: रक्तवर्णं महाकायं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् । पाशाङ्कुशाक्षाभीष्टं च दधानं करपङ्कजैः
verses.transliteration: raktavarNaM mahAkAyaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam | pAshA~NkushAkShAbhIShTaM cha dadhAnaM karapa~NkajaiH
verses.translation: The unsullied being, the primordial and the eternal lord of all who is stated to be the supreme soul has knowledge and the ritual as his innate nature.

verses.sanskrit: गजाननं प्रभुं सर्वविघ्नौघघ्नमुपासितुः । एवं ध्यात्वा यजेद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरुपचारकैः
verses.transliteration: gajAnanaM prabhuM sarvavighnaughaghnamupAsituH | evaM dhyAtvA yajedgandhapuShpAdyairupachArakaiH
verses.translation: The image of the lord of the gods is Sadaiva himself, the lord with five mantras for his body and the five digits for his physical form. The lord is as bright as crystal, has cool lustre and is delightful. He has five faces, ten arms and fifteen eyes.

verses.sanskrit: कदलीनारिकेलाम्रफललड्डुकपूर्वकम् । नैवेद्यं च समर्प्याथ नमस्कुर्याद्गजाननम्
verses.transliteration: kadalInArikelAmraphalalaDDukapUrvakam | naivedyaM cha samarpyAtha namaskuryAdgajAnanam
verses.translation: He the ancient lord has Isana for his coronet; Purusa for his face; Aghora for his heart; Vamadeva for his private parts and Sadya for his foot, is both Sakala and Niskala. The six Saktis, omnisciend# etc. constitute his six limbs.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मस्य वायुदिक्पद्मे सङ्कल्प्य स्कान्दमासनम् । स्कन्दमूर्तिं प्रकल्प्याथ स्कन्दमावाहयेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: padmasya vAyudikpadme sa~Nkalpya skAndamAsanam | skandamUrtiM prakalpyAtha skandamAvAhayed budhaH
verses.translation: With reference to the six entities. Mantra, etc., I shall explain the Pranava-souled lord in his composite and personal nature.

verses.sanskrit: स्थाप्य साधारकं तं तु प्रणवेनार्चयेत्ततः । आपूर्य शुद्धतोयेन चन्दनादिसुगन्धिना
verses.transliteration: sthApya sAdhArakaM taM tu praNavenArchayettataH | ApUrya shuddhatoyena chandanAdisugandhinA
verses.translation: The order of instruction shall be mentioned at first. Please hear, O sage, indeed the four castes are well known in the world.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चार्य स्कन्दगायत्रीं ध्यायेदथ कुमारकम् । उद्यदादित्यसङ्काशं मयूरवरवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: uchchArya skandagAyatrIM dhyAyedatha kumArakam | udyadAdityasa~NkAshaM mayUravaravAhanam
verses.translation: The Vedas enjoin rituals for the first three castes. The Sudras arc excluded since their only activity is service.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं मुकुटादिविभूषितम् । वरदाभयहस्तं च शक्तिकुक्कुटधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: chaturbhujamudArA~NgaM mukuTAdivibhUShitam | varadAbhayahastaM cha shaktikukkuTadhAriNam
verses.translation: Nothing but the holy rites of the $rutis and Smrtis shall be performed by the first three castes in their respective stages of life. Following the conduct of life enjoined for difforent stages and castes, excellent sages have attained S.iyujya form of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्यात्वाथ गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैरनुक्रमात् । सम्पूज्य पूर्वद्वारस्य दक्षशाखामुपाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: evaM dhyAtvAtha gandhAdyairupachArairanukramAt | sampUjya pUrvadvArasya dakShashAkhAmupAshritam
verses.translation: The Sruti says that the sages arc satisfied by Brahmacarya; the gods by sacrifice; and the Pitrs by pro¬ geny.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःपुराधिपं साक्षान्नन्दिनं सम्यगर्चयेत् । चामीकराचलप्रख्यं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: antaHpurAdhipaM sAkShAnnandinaM samyagarchayet | chAmIkarAchalaprakhyaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam
verses.translation: Freed from this threefold debt and entering the Vanaprastha stage the devotee shall bear both pleasure and pain, chillness and heat; shall subjugate the senses, control the diet. The ascetic shall practise restraint and other

verses.sanskrit: बालेन्दुमुकुटं सौम्यं त्रिनेत्रं च चतुर्भुजम् । दीप्तशूलमृगीटङ्कं हेमवेत्रधरं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: bAlendumukuTaM saumyaM trinetraM cha chaturbhujam | dIptashUlamR^igITa~NkaM hemavetradharaM vibhum
verses.translation: Thus he becomes pious and free from activities. After eschewing all activites he shall be devoted to the pursuit of knowledge. That alone bestows the fruit of living liberation and identity with Siva. It is most excellent and renders free from aberrations those who have restrained their minds.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रबिम्बाभवदनं हरिवक्त्रमथापि वा । उत्तरस्यां तथा तस्य भार्यां च मरुतां सुताम्
verses.transliteration: chandrabimbAbhavadanaM harivaktramathApi vA | uttarasyAM tathA tasya bhAryAM cha marutAM sutAm
verses.translation: I shall explain different modes of the same with a desire for blessing the worlds. O intelligent one, it is out of affection for you that I do so. Please listen with attention.

verses.sanskrit: सुयशां सुव्रतामम्बापादमण्डनतत्पराम् । सम्पूज्य विधिवद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरुपचारकैः
verses.transliteration: suyashAM suvratAmambApAdamaNDanatatparAm | sampUjya vidhivadgandhapuShpAdyairupachArakaiH
verses.translation: The ascetic sha«. approach a preceptor, the most (excellent among intelligenfones; the preceptor who knows ihc principles of sacred scriptures and has mastered the 'edantic knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सम्प्रोक्षयेत्पद्मं सास्त्रशङ्खोदबिन्दुभिः । कल्पयेदासनं पश्चादाधारादि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tataH samprokShayetpadmaM sAstrasha~NkhodabindubhiH | kalpayedAsanaM pashchAdAdhArAdi yathAkramam
verses.translation: After approaching him in accordance with the tales, the ascetic devotee shall please him assiduously by obeisances, prostration etc.

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्तिं कल्याणीं श्यामां ध्यायेदधो भुवि । तस्याः पुरस्तादुत्कण्ठमनन्तं कुण्डलाकृतिम्
verses.transliteration: AdhArashaktiM kalyANIM shyAmAM dhyAyedadho bhuvi | tasyAH purastAdutkaNThamanantaM kuNDalAkR^itim
verses.translation: Permitted by the preceptor he shall subsist on milk diet and perform rites for twelve days. On the fourth or the tenth day in the bright lunar fortnight he shall take his early morning bath. With pious mind, he shall perform his routine. He shall invite the preceptor and begin the Nandi raddha.

verses.sanskrit: धवलं पञ्चफणिनं लेलिहानमिवाम्बरम् । तस्योपर्यासनं भद्रं कण्ठीरवचतुष्पदम्
verses.transliteration: dhavalaM pa~nchaphaNinaM lelihAnamivAmbaram | tasyoparyAsanaM bhadraM kaNThIravachatuShpadam
verses.translation: The Vivedevas are Satyavasus. In the Sraddha of the gods, Brahma, Vinu and Siva, in that of the sages, those born of celestial damsels from human beings, in that of the Pitfs, Vasu, Rudra and Aditya, in that of human beings, the four sages, Sanaka and others, in that of the Bhutas the five great elements are included.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः प्रणवेन च सप्तधा । अभिमन्त्र्य ततस्तस्मिन्धेनुमुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत्
verses.transliteration: abhyarchya gandhapuShpAdyaiH praNavena cha saptadhA | abhimantrya tatastasmindhenumudrAM pradarshayet
verses.translation: The group of sense-organs consists of the eye, etc; that of the Bhutas is of four types. In the Pitf Sraddha the fatfier, grandfather and greatgrandfather are included.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मो ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं च पदानि वै । आग्नेयादिश्वेतपीतरक्तश्यामानि वर्णतः
verses.transliteration: dharmo j~nAnaM cha vairAgyamaishvaryaM cha padAni vai | AgneyAdishvetapItaraktashyAmAni varNataH
verses.translation: In the Maqriraddha, the mother, grandmother and the greatgrandmother are mentioned. In the Sraddha of the Atman the four, viz. himself father, grandfather and

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मादीनि पूर्वादीन्युत्तरान्तान्यनुक्रमात् । राजावर्तमणिप्रख्यान्यस्य गात्राणि भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: adharmAdIni pUrvAdInyuttarAntAnyanukramAt | rAjAvartamaNiprakhyAnyasya gAtrANi bhAvayet
verses.translation: In every Sraddha a pair of brahmins shall be invited and their feet washed. He shall then perform the Acamana assiduously.

verses.sanskrit: अधोर्ध्वच्छदनं पश्चात्कन्दं नालं च कण्टकान् । दलादिकं कर्णिकां च विभाव्य क्रमशोऽर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: adhordhvachChadanaM pashchAtkandaM nAlaM cha kaNTakAn | dalAdikaM karNikAM cha vibhAvya kramasho.archayet
verses.translation: He shall pray thus: — "May the dust-particles from the feet of the brahmins sanctify me. They are the cause of prosperity. They destroy all adversities and constitute the bridge on the vast ocean of worldly existence. Like suns they remove the pitch darkness of distress. Like divine cows they meet the desired objects. They are the embodied holy waters in every pilgrim centre," After praying thus he shall bow and prostrate with eight limbs touching the ground. He shall then face the cast and remember the lotus-feet of iSiva.

verses.sanskrit: दलेषु सिद्धयश्चाष्टौ केसरेषु च शक्तिकाः । रुद्रा वामादयस्त्वष्टौ पूर्वादिपरितः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: daleShu siddhayashchAShTau kesareShu cha shaktikAH | rudrA vAmAdayastvaShTau pUrvAdiparitaH kramAt
verses.translation: Wearing the Pavitra in the finger and the sacred thread on the shoulders, being pure and steady he shall perform the Pranayama thrice. Mentioning the Tithi etc. he shall continue — ''As an ancillary rite to my formal renunciation I have to perform eight Sraddhas beginning with the Sraddha of Vivedevas and ending with the Sraddha of Matamaha. I shall perform these with the rules governing the festive rites, with >our permission." After proclaiming the intention he shall cast off the Darbha grass to the north.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णिकायां च वैराग्यं बीजेषु नव शक्तयः । वामाद्या एव पूर्वादि तदन्ते च मनोन्मनी
verses.transliteration: karNikAyAM cha vairAgyaM bIjeShu nava shaktayaH | vAmAdyA eva pUrvAdi tadante cha manonmanI
verses.translation: He shall touch water and stand up to begin the formal invitation to the brahmins. With the Pavitra in the hand he shall touch the hands of the brahmins and pro¬ claim:

verses.sanskrit: कन्दे शिवात्मको धर्मो नाले ज्ञानं शिवाश्रयम् । कर्णिकोपरि वाह्नेयं मण्डलं सौरमैन्दवम्
verses.transliteration: kande shivAtmako dharmo nAle j~nAnaM shivAshrayam | karNikopari vAhneyaM maNDalaM sauramaindavam
verses.translation: "For the sake of Visvedevas I invite you both and conclude. You shall favour me." This is the procedure throughout. After this he shall draw ten Mandalas beginning from the north. He shall worship these with Aksatas and ask the Brahmins to stand there-

verses.sanskrit: आत्मविद्या शिवाख्यं च तत्त्वत्रयमतः परम् । सर्वासनोपरि सुखं विचित्रकुसुमोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: AtmavidyA shivAkhyaM cha tattvatrayamataH param | sarvAsanopari sukhaM vichitrakusumojjvalam
verses.translation: He shall utter the names of Viivcdcvas in thr vocative case. "Here is water for washing the feet". Sayinj this, he shall offer water from the Darbha grass, flowers and

verses.sanskrit: परव्योमावकाशाख्यविद्ययातीव भास्वरम् । परिकल्प्यासनं मूर्त्तेः पुष्पविन्यासपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: paravyomAvakAshAkhyavidyayAtIva bhAsvaram | parikalpyAsanaM mUrtteH puShpavinyAsapUrvakam
verses.translation: "Here is the seat to the brahmin in the form of Visvedevas.'* Saying this he shall offer a few Darbha grass blades. He himself shall stand holding the Darbha grass and say, "In this Nandimukhasraddha for the sake of Visvedevas I invite both of you to be present."

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्तिमारभ्य शुद्धविद्यासनावधि । Oङ्कारादिचतुर्थ्यन्तं नाममन्त्रं नमोऽन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: AdhArashaktimArabhya shuddhavidyAsanAvadhi | O~NkArAdichaturthyantaM nAmamantraM namo.antakam
verses.translation: Then he shall say "Both of you shall accept my invitation." The two brahmins shall say "We accept."

verses.sanskrit: उच्चार्य पूजयेद्विद्वान्सर्वत्रैवं विधिक्रमः । अङ्गवक्त्रकलाभेदात्पञ्च ब्रह्माणि पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: uchchArya pUjayedvidvAnsarvatraivaM vidhikramaH | a~NgavaktrakalAbhedAtpa~ncha brahmANi pUrvavat
verses.translation: He shall request the brahmins — "May you bless me. Let the rite be complete. Let rnc attain my desires."

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खमुद्रां च पुरतश्चतुरस्रं प्रकल्पयेत् । तदन्तरेऽर्धचन्द्रं च त्रिकोणं च तदन्तरे
verses.transliteration: sha~NkhamudrAM cha puratashchaturasraM prakalpayet | tadantare.ardhachandraM cha trikoNaM cha tadantare
verses.translation: He shall then place cooked nee and othcj food¬ stuffs in well washed plantain leaf cups. I'liey shall be covered with Darbha grass. He shall sprinkle water over them. The leafeups shall be lifved up by the h.inds. He shall offer the food-stuffs into fire saying "Svfdia." The names of the deities shall be used in the dative case. The Mantras "the earth is your vessel,"*' etc. shall be repeated. After worship the devotee.shall say "Na Mama" (not for me). FAeiywherc this is the procedure.

verses.sanskrit: विन्यसेत्क्रमशो मूर्त्तौ तत्तन्मुद्राविचक्षणः । आवाहयेत्ततो देवं पुष्पाञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: vinyasetkramasho mUrttau tattanmudrAvichakShaNaH | AvAhayettato devaM puShpA~njalipuTaH sthitaH
verses.translation: After repeating the prayer he shall say. I have completed Nandimukhasraddha. Confirm that I have done it. He shall propitiate the leading brahmins, let some water drop from his hand, bow to them, stand up and say to them, let the food be even as nectar. Then with palms joined in reverence he shall pray with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातं प्रपद्यामीत्यारभ्योमन्तमुच्चरन् । आधारोत्थितनादं तु द्वादशग्रन्थिभेदतः
verses.transliteration: sadyojAtaM prapadyAmItyArabhyomantamuchcharan | AdhArotthitanAdaM tu dvAdashagranthibhedataH
verses.translation: He shall recite Srirudra, Camaka, and Purusa suktas duly. After meditating on Sadasiva he shall lepcat the Japas of the five Brahmans.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मरन्ध्रान्तमुच्चार्य ध्यायेदोङ्कारगोचरम् । शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं देवं निष्कलमक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: brahmarandhrAntamuchchArya dhyAyedo~NkAragocharam | shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshaM devaM niShkalamakSharam
verses.translation: At the end of the meal he.shall recite Rudia Shkta. He shall ask forgiveness of the brahmins. After food he shall offer water.

verses.sanskrit: कारणं सर्वलोकानां सर्वलोकमयं परम् । अन्तर्बहिः स्थितं व्याप्य ह्यणोरल्पं महत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kAraNaM sarvalokAnAM sarvalokamayaM param | antarbahiH sthitaM vyApya hyaNoralpaM mahattamam
verses.translation: Washing his fed and peifoiming the.Xc amana he

verses.sanskrit: भक्तानामप्रयत्नेन दृश्यमीश्वरमव्ययम् । ब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्णुरुद्राद्यैरपि देवैरगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktAnAmaprayatnena dR^ishyamIshvaramavyayam | brahmendraviShNurudrAdyairapi devairagocharam

verses.sanskrit: वेदसारं च विद्वद्भिरगोचरमिति श्रुतम् । आदिमध्यान्तरहितं भेषजं भवरोगिणाम्
verses.transliteration: vedasAraM cha vidvadbhiragocharamiti shrutam | AdimadhyAntarahitaM bheShajaM bhavarogiNAm
verses.translation: "I shall perform the rite of offering the Pis as an ancillary to the Nandimukhairaddha." After deciding thus he shall draw nine lines from south to north. He shall place twelve Darbhas with their tips to the east over the lines. These are the five places for the gods Daka and others.

verses.sanskrit: समाहितेन मनसा ध्यात्वैवं परमेश्वरम् । आवाहनं स्थापनं च सन्निरोधं निरीक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: samAhitena manasA dhyAtvaivaM parameshvaram | AvAhanaM sthApanaM cha sannirodhaM nirIkShaNam
verses.translation: In these places the aksata grains and water shall be offered silently. In the other places he shall sprinkle water with the mantra "Atra Pitarah",**® and offer the Aksata grains and water for worship. The names of different gods shall be mentioned with the dative case ending. Three Pinzas shall be offered to each in the five places.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कारं च कुर्वीत बद्ध्वा मुद्राः पृथक्पृथक् । ध्यायेत्सदाशिवं साक्षाद्देवं सकलनिष्कलम्
verses.transliteration: namaskAraM cha kurvIta baddhvA mudrAH pR^ithakpR^ithak | dhyAyetsadAshivaM sAkShAddevaM sakalaniShkalam
verses.translation: The Pindas shall be given separately along with Ak?atas for the full efficacy of the Pitrs as explained in the Grhyasutra.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं प्रसन्नं शीतलद्युतिम् । विद्युद्वलयसङ्काशं जटामुकुटभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshaM prasannaM shItaladyutim | vidyudvalayasa~NkAshaM jaTAmukuTabhUShitam
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Sadaiiiva in the lotus of the heart reciting the verse. By remembering his lotus-like feet he shall give fees to the Brahmins according to his ability. He shall ask forgiveness and bid them farewell. He shall give Pindas to the cows or cast off into running water. After performing "Punyahavacana** he shall take meals with his kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: शार्दूलचर्मवसनं किञ्चित्स्मितमुखाम्बुजम् । रक्तपद्मदलप्रख्यपाणिपादतलाधरम्
verses.transliteration: shArdUlacharmavasanaM ki~nchitsmitamukhAmbujam | raktapadmadalaprakhyapANipAdatalAdharam
verses.translation: After getting up early in the morning next day the devotee shall perform his routine. He shall observe fast, shave hair except in the armpits and the private parts. He shall cut the moustache, the nails and shave his head.

verses.sanskrit: षट्कोणं वृत्तमेवेदं मण्डलं परिकल्पयेत् । अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः प्रणवेनाथ मध्यतः
verses.transliteration: ShaTkoNaM vR^ittamevedaM maNDalaM parikalpayet | abhyarchya gandhapuShpAdyaiH praNavenAtha madhyataH
verses.translation: He shall take bath and wear a washed and dried cloth. He shall be pure in thought and body. Silently he shall perform Acamana twice and apply ashes duly and perform the Punyahavacana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् । दिव्यायुधकरैर्युक्तं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalakShaNasampannaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam | divyAyudhakarairyuktaM divyagandhAnulepanam
verses.translation: Except the materials for the homa and the articles of gift for the preceptor — because they are naturally pure, every other article shall be sprinkled with holy water.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चवक्त्रं दशभुजं चन्द्रखण्डशिखामणिम् । अस्य पूर्वमुखं सौम्यं बालार्कसदृशप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchavaktraM dashabhujaM chandrakhaNDashikhAmaNim | asya pUrvamukhaM saumyaM bAlArkasadR^ishaprabham
verses.translation: He shall make gift to brahmins especially to devotees and to Siva in the form of preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिलोचनारविन्दाढ्यं बालेन्दुकृतशेखरम् । दक्षिणं नीलजीमूतसमानरुचिरप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: trilochanAravindADhyaM bAlendukR^itashekharam | dakShiNaM nIlajImUtasamAnaruchiraprabham
verses.translation: He shall repeat Vedic mantras along with Orh and recite "Namo Brahmane"*** etc. thrice. Then he shall repeat the mantra "Agnimile purohitam'*,* perform the great rite and repeat. "Agnirvai"**® '*Ise tvorje tva", then repeat the Mantras "Agna ayahi vltaye",*® Sanno dcvirabh! taye"' along with Ma, Ya, Ra, Sa, Ta, Ja, Bha, Na, La, and Ga.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रुकुटीकुटिलं घोरं रक्तवृत्तत्रिलोचनम् । दंष्ट्राकरालं दुष्प्रेक्ष्यं स्फुरिताधरपल्लवम्
verses.transliteration: bhrukuTIkuTilaM ghoraM raktavR^ittatrilochanam | daMShTrAkarAlaM duShprekShyaM sphuritAdharapallavam
verses.translation: This shall continue for five years. This is the tradition. Then ho shall repeat the text of grammar, Mimarhsa and Vedanta. He shall repeat the names of the gods as well.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरं विद्रुमप्रख्यं नीलालकविभूषितम् । सद्विलासं त्रिनयनं चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: uttaraM vidrumaprakhyaM nIlAlakavibhUShitam | sadvilAsaM trinayanaM chandrArdhakR^itashekharam
verses.translation: He shall perform the Japa of Brahma, Indra, Sun, moon, Prajapati Jfianatman and Paramatman with Pranava in the beginning, namah in the end using the dative case. He shall take some flour of fried grain, eat it with Pranava, perform Acamana twice, wash his hands, repeat the mantras mentioned hereafter. He shall repeat the names of Atman, Antaratman, Jnanatman beginning with Pranava and ending with Namah. After repeating the mantra of Atman he shall repeat the mantra of Prajapati.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमं पूर्णचन्द्राभं लोचनत्रितयोज्ज्वलम् । चन्द्रलेखाधरं सौम्यं मन्दस्मितमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: pashchimaM pUrNachandrAbhaM lochanatritayojjvalam | chandralekhAdharaM saumyaM mandasmitamanoharam
verses.translation: He shall then perform the Japa ending with Svaha. Repeating Pranava he shall take in milk, curd and ghee separately thrice and perform Acamana twice. With the mind steady he shall sit firmly facing the east and perform pranayama thrice in accordance with the rules.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमं स्फटिकप्रख्यमिन्दुरेखासमुज्ज्वलम् । अतीव सौम्यमुत्फुल्ललोचनत्रितयोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchamaM sphaTikaprakhyamindurekhAsamujjvalam | atIva saumyamutphullalochanatritayojjvalam
verses.translation: AB.fl.ij. r>- 14}.. RV. i.i.i.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे शूलपरशुवज्रखड्गानलोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: dakShiNe shUlaparashuvajrakhaDgAnalojjvalam
verses.translation: Ibid i I. 4b.

verses.sanskrit: वामे पिनाकनाराचघण्टापाशाङ्कुशोज्ज्वलम् । निवृत्त्या जानुपर्यन्तमानाभि च प्रतिष्ठया
verses.transliteration: vAme pinAkanArAchaghaNTApAshA~Nkushojjvalam | nivR^ittyA jAnuparyantamAnAbhi cha pratiShThayA
verses.translation: Ibid 20 12.

verses.sanskrit: आकण्ठं विद्यया तद्वदाललाटं तु शान्तया । तदूर्ध्वं शान्त्यतीताख्यकलया परया तथा
verses.transliteration: AkaNThaM vidyayA tadvadAlalATaM tu shAntayA | tadUrdhvaM shAntyatItAkhyakalayA parayA tathA
verses.translation: Then at midday he shall take bath. With the mind fully controlled he shall gather materials for worship such as fragrant flowers, Aktas etc.

verses.sanskrit: साधारमर्घ्यपात्रं च स्थाप्य गन्धादिनार्चयेत् । आपूर्य शुद्धतोयेन तस्मिन्पात्रे विनिःक्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: sAdhAramarghyapAtraM cha sthApya gandhAdinArchayet | ApUrya shuddhatoyena tasminpAtre viniHkShipet
verses.translation: With the mentra, *'Gahanam tva" he shall as enjoined invoke lord Ganapati worshipped by the gods. He shall worship him in the south-west.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाध्वव्यापिनं तस्मात्कलापञ्चकविग्रहम् । ईशानमुकुटं देवं पुरुषास्यं पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAdhvavyApinaM tasmAtkalApa~nchakavigraham | IshAnamukuTaM devaM puruShAsyaM purAtanam
verses.translation: After invoking the elephant-faced lord Ganapati son of Siva, of red colour, huge body, bedecked in ornaments and holding noose, goad, Rudraksa and boon in his lotus-hand he shall worship him at dusk. He shall offer milk pudding (sweet pie), coconut jaggery and other things as Naivedya and also the leaf. After propitiating and bowing to him he shall pray for warding off evil.

verses.sanskrit: अघोरहृदयं तद्वद्वामगुह्यं महेश्वरम् । सद्यपादं च तन्मूर्तिमष्टत्रिंशत्कलामयम्
verses.transliteration: aghorahR^idayaM tadvadvAmaguhyaM maheshvaram | sadyapAdaM cha tanmUrtimaShTatriMshatkalAmayam
verses.translation: Thereafter the rites of sacrifice concluding with the sharing of clarified butter shall be performed in the Aupasana fire according to the rules of one's Grhyasutra.

verses.sanskrit: मातृकामयमीशानं पञ्चब्रह्ममयं तथा । Oङ्काराख्यमयं चैव हंसन्यासमयं तथा
verses.transliteration: mAtR^ikAmayamIshAnaM pa~nchabrahmamayaM tathA | O~NkArAkhyamayaM chaiva haMsanyAsamayaM tathA
verses.translation: After offering the Purnahuti with the three Rks "Bhuh Svaha® and concluding the rites he shall repeat Gayatri assiduously till late in the afternoon.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाक्षरमयं देवं षडक्षरमयं तथा । अङ्गषट्कमयं चैव जातिषट्कसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAkSharamayaM devaM ShaDakSharamayaM tathA | a~NgaShaTkamayaM chaiva jAtiShaTkasamanvitam
verses.translation: He shall perform the evening prayers after bath and the sacrificial rites and inform his preceptor accordingly.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्यात्वाथ मद्वामभागे त्वां च मनोन्मनीम् । गौरीमिमाय मन्त्रेण प्रणवाद्येन भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: evaM dhyAtvAtha madvAmabhAge tvAM cha manonmanIm | gaurImimAya mantreNa praNavAdyena bhaktitaH
verses.translation: After offering the Caru therein e shall perform Homa with different faggots of sticks, cooked rice and ghee repeating Rudrasukta. He shall conceive Lord Siva in the fire along with Amba and the five Brahmans —Sadyojata etc. He shall remember Gaurl and perform homa with the mantra "Gaurirmimaya*® etc.

verses.sanskrit: आवाह्य पूर्ववत्कुर्यान्नमस्कारान्तमीश्वरि । ध्यायेत्ततस्त्वां देवेशि समाहितमना मुनिः
verses.transliteration: AvAhya pUrvavatkuryAnnamaskArAntamIshvari | dhyAyettatastvAM deveshi samAhitamanA muniH
verses.translation: He shall perform sacrifice, repeat the mantra "Agnaye svistakrte svaha''®® and then show mystic gestures. Being of steady mind he shall sit on the, seat of cloth, deerskin or Darbha grass to the north of the fire and perform the Gayatri japa silently till the brahma muhurta.

verses.sanskrit: प्रफुल्लोत्पलपत्राभां विस्तीर्णायतलोचनाम् । पूर्णचन्द्राभवदनां नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजाम्
verses.transliteration: praphullotpalapatrAbhAM vistIrNAyatalochanAm | pUrNachandrAbhavadanAM nIlaku~nchitamUrdhajAm

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलदलप्रख्यां चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखराम् । अतिवृत्तघनोत्तुङ्गस्निग्धपीनपयोधराम्
verses.transliteration: nIlotpaladalaprakhyAM chandrArdhakR^itashekharAm | ativR^ittaghanottu~NgasnigdhapInapayodharAm

verses.sanskrit: तनुमध्यां पृथुश्रोणीं पीतसूक्ष्मतराम्बराम् । सर्वाभरणसम्पन्नां ललाटतिलकोज्ज्वलाम्
verses.transliteration: tanumadhyAM pR^ithushroNIM pItasUkShmatarAmbarAm | sarvAbharaNasampannAM lalATatilakojjvalAm

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रपुष्पसङ्कीर्णकेशपाशोपशोभिताम् । सर्वतोऽनुगुणाकारां किञ्चिल्लज्जानताननाम्
verses.transliteration: vichitrapuShpasa~NkIrNakeshapAshopashobhitAm | sarvato.anuguNAkArAM ki~nchillajjAnatAnanAm
verses.translation: He shall then take bath. If he is feeble he shall smear.Bhasma only. He shall cook Garu in the fire and pour ghee over it. Thus sanctifying it he shall consign it to the fire. He shall perform the Japa of the Vyahftis, •Rudra Sukta and the five Brahmans. He shall fix his mind in the lotus-feet of Siva. He shall perform the Japa of Prajapati, Indra, Vivedevas and Brahma also, with dative case-endings. Pranava and other mantras shall be repeated ending with Svaha. He shall perform Punyahavacana say Agnye svaha, show mystic gesture in front of the fire. Then he shall repeat Pranaya svaha and offer five Ahutis to Svista- kft fire. He shall repeat Rudrasukta, the five Bfahmans, the Caturvyuha mantras, Homa and mystic gestures in accordance with his Vedic branch.

verses.sanskrit: कुशाग्राण्यक्षतांश्चैव यवव्रीहितिलानपि । आज्यसिद्धार्थपुष्पाणि भसितं च वरानने
verses.transliteration: kushAgrANyakShatAMshchaiva yavavrIhitilAnapi | AjyasiddhArthapuShpANi bhasitaM cha varAnane
verses.translation: The same procedure he shall adopt for the other gods, along with their ancillary rites. After these rites beginning with the fire, the Viraja homa of the Atman shall be performed for the purification of the self in the form of twentysix principles.

verses.sanskrit: हेमारविन्दं विलसद्दधानां दक्षिणे करे । चण्डवच्चामरं हस्तं न्यस्यासीनां सुखासने
verses.transliteration: hemAravindaM vilasaddadhAnAM dakShiNe kare | chaNDavachchAmaraM hastaM nyasyAsInAM sukhAsane
verses.translation: He shall say "Let these Tattvas be purified.'* For the purity of the principle — Atman, the mantras 'Aruna- ketukas* shall be repeated. He shall silently perform the Homa with the Garu and ghee and remember the lotus-feet of 6iva. O sage, the principles begin with Prthivi and end with Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: एवं मां त्वां च देवेशि ध्यात्वा नियतमानसः । स्नापयेच्छङ्खतोयेन प्रणवप्रोक्षणक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: evaM mAM tvAM cha deveshi dhyAtvA niyatamAnasaH | snApayechCha~Nkhatoyena praNavaprokShaNakramAt
verses.translation: Prthivi, Sound, Speech, Ear — these are five each. The four head, sides, back, belly and the calves shall be added afterwards in the group — skin etc. The Dhatu group consists of seven. Pranas are five in number. Anna etc. are the five sheaths. Mind, Gitta, intellect, ego, Khyati come under Sankalpa. Gunas come after; Prakrti and Purusa follow these. Purusa is the only enjoyer and the five principles are the objects of his enjoyment.

verses.sanskrit: भवे भवे नातिभव इति पाद्यं प्रकल्पयेत् । वामाय नम इत्युक्त्वा दद्यादाचमनीयकम्
verses.transliteration: bhave bhave nAtibhava iti pAdyaM prakalpayet | vAmAya nama ityuktvA dadyAdAchamanIyakam
verses.translation: O great sage, destiny, time, attachment, Vidya, Kala — this set of five is born of Maya.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठाय नम इत्युक्त्वा शुभ्रवस्त्रं प्रकल्पयेत् । श्रेष्ठाय नम इत्युक्त्वा दद्याद्यज्ञोपवीतकम्
verses.transliteration: jyeShThAya nama ityuktvA shubhravastraM prakalpayet | shreShThAya nama ityuktvA dadyAdyaj~nopavItakam
verses.translation: Though sentient, the Purusa is confused in thought, not knowing the five principles. Though superior to nature he falls below Prakrti as the eye of the crow. This set of fie — the pure Vidya Mahesvara, Sadasiva, Sakti and Siva is cal'ed Vidyatattva or Sivatattva. This is implied in the Vedir text "Prajnanam Bi*ahma."

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राय नम इत्युक्त्वा पुनराचमनीयकम् । कालाय नम इत्युक्त्वा गन्धं दद्यात्सुसंस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: rudrAya nama ityuktvA punarAchamanIyakam | kAlAya nama ityuktvA gandhaM dadyAtsusaMskR^itam
verses.translation: O Sage, the purity of the principles from Prthivi to Siva is effected through the dissolution of its cause.

verses.sanskrit: कलविकरणाय नमोऽक्षतं च परिकल्पयेत् । बलविकरणाय नम इति पुष्पाणि दापयेत्
verses.transliteration: kalavikaraNAya namo.akShataM cha parikalpayet | balavikaraNAya nama iti puShpANi dApayet
verses.translation: With the eleven mantras he shall mention the god. The word Sivajyolis shall be used in the dative rase.

verses.sanskrit: बलाय नम इत्युक्त्वा धूपं दद्यात्प्रयत्नतः । बलप्रमथनायेति सुदीपं चैव दापयेत्
verses.transliteration: balAya nama ityuktvA dhUpaM dadyAtprayatnataH | balapramathanAyeti sudIpaM chaiva dApayet
verses.translation: After Svaha" he shall say "Na mama" (not to me). By this, renunciation of motive is indicatid. In the mantras "Vividya" ''Kasfapota" afiei the word Vyapakava the wf)id Paramatmanc shall be used. The words "Sivajyo- tis" "Visvabhula" and "Ghasauotsuka" shall be meutioned in dative case. After mentioning the god by name the w('rd Devaya shall be uttcied.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभिश्च षडङ्गैश्च ततो मातृकया सह । प्रणवेन शिवेनैव शक्तियुक्तेन च क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: brahmabhishcha ShaDa~Ngaishcha tato mAtR^ikayA saha | praNavena shivenaiva shaktiyuktena cha kramAt
verses.translation: After "Visv.u Cipaya" in the mantra "Utiislhasva" the word "Pnius.'iya" shall be uttered and the woids "Orn Svaha" shall be added.

verses.sanskrit: मुद्राः प्रदर्शयेन्मह्यं तुभ्यं च वरवर्णिनि । मयि प्रकल्पयेत्पूर्वमुपचारांस्ततस्त्वयि
verses.transliteration: mudrAH pradarshayenmahyaM tubhyaM cha varavarNini | mayi prakalpayetpUrvamupachArAMstatastvayi
verses.translation: At the end of the word "I.okatraya" the woids "Vyri|)ine Parain.'uinane Siv.lyedam Na Mama" sliall be added.

verses.sanskrit: यदा त्वयि प्रकुर्वीत स्त्रीलिङ्गं योजयेत्तदा । इयानेव हि भेदोऽस्ति नान्यः पार्वति कश्चन
verses.transliteration: yadA tvayi prakurvIta strIli~NgaM yojayettadA | iyAneva hi bhedo.asti nAnyaH pArvati kashchana
verses.translation: Me shall conclude the rite aecoiding to his own branch fif the Veda. He shall eat Caiu mixed with ghee and then give fee of gold etc. to the priest. Alter, the ritualistic dismissal of Brahma he shall perform the morning worship.

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातादिभिर्मन्त्रैः षडङ्गैः प्रणवेन च । अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरभिमन्त्र्य च वर्मणा
verses.transliteration: sadyojAtAdibhirmantraiH ShaDa~NgaiH praNavena cha | abhyarchya gandhapuShpAdyairabhimantrya cha varmaNA
verses.translation: He shall recite the mantra "Saiii mam sincantu Manita."''' He shall warm his hand over the fire repeating the mantra "Ya te Agne'*- and superimpose the fire in his own Atman, abode of the universal soul. He shall perform the morning prayers and pay respects to the sun. He shall enter water upto the navel, perform the Japa of the mantras with pleasure, devotion and steadiness.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्यानं पूजनं च कृत्वा सम्यग्विधानतः । ममावरणपूजां च प्रारभेत विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: evaM dhyAnaM pUjanaM cha kR^itvA samyagvidhAnataH | mamAvaraNapUjAM cha prArabheta vichakShaNaH
verses.translation: The devotee w'ho had been maintaining sacrificial

verses.sanskrit: अवगुण्ठ्यास्त्रमन्त्रेण संरक्षार्थं प्रदर्शयेत् । धेनुमुद्रां च तेनैव प्रोक्षयेदस्त्रमन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: avaguNThyAstramantreNa saMrakShArthaM pradarshayet | dhenumudrAM cha tenaiva prokShayedastramantrataH

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence good ascetics worship Siva the single-syllabled lord who being the cause of the universe is stationed in the lotus of the heart.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence good ascetics worship Siva the single-syllabled lord who being the cause of the universe is stationed in the lotus of the heart.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam
verses.translation: Hence good ascetics worship Siva the single-syllabled lord who being the cause of the universe is stationed in the lotus of the heart.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.८. अष्टमोऽध्यायः । आवरणपूजावर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । अत्रास्ति च महादेवि खल्वावरणपञ्चकम् । पञ्चावरणपूजां तु प्रारभेत यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.8\. aShTamo.adhyAyaH | AvaraNapUjAvarNanam | Ishvara uvAcha | atrAsti cha mahAdevi khalvAvaraNapa~nchakam | pa~nchAvaraNapUjAM tu prArabheta yathAkramam
verses.translation: Men desirous of salvation and unattached to

verses.sanskrit: तत्पूर्वकोष्ठे गन्धाद्यैः सम्प्रपूज्य विनायकम् । पश्चिमोत्तरकोष्ठे च वृषभं दक्षिणे गुहम्
verses.transliteration: tatpUrvakoShThe gandhAdyaiH samprapUjya vinAyakam | pashchimottarakoShThe cha vR^iShabhaM dakShiNe guham
verses.translation: After dissolving Gayatrl in the Pranava identical with Siva he shall recite the hymn "ahaih vrksasya re- riva."i53

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरद्वारपूर्वे तु प्रदक्षिणविधानतः । नामाष्टकविधानेन पूजयेदुच्यते हि तत्
verses.transliteration: uttaradvArapUrve tu pradakShiNavidhAnataH | nAmAShTakavidhAnena pUjayeduchyate hi tat
verses.translation: He shall repeat the hymn beginning with "Yah Chandasam Rsabhah"'®* and ending with "gopaya." Then he shall say 1 have got up.

verses.sanskrit: भवं शर्वं तथेशानं रुद्रं पशुपतिं पुनः । उग्रं भीमं महादेवं तृतीयावरणं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: bhavaM sharvaM tatheshAnaM rudraM pashupatiM punaH | ugraM bhImaM mahAdevaM tR^itIyAvaraNaM tvidam
verses.translation: O sage, he shall recite the mantras in the low, medium and high tone beginning with the Pranava in the order of creation, sustenance and dissolution.

verses.sanskrit: यो वेदादौ स्वर इति समावाह्य महेश्वरम् । पूजयेत्पूर्वदिग्भागे कमले कर्णिकोपरि
verses.transliteration: yo vedAdau svara iti samAvAhya maheshvaram | pUjayetpUrvadigbhAge kamale karNikopari
verses.translation: In this order he shall say Om Bhuh I have renounced. Om Bhuvah I have renounced. Om Suvah I have renounced. Then he shall say the composite Vyahrtis Orn Bhuh, Bhuvah, Suvah.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरं पूर्वदिक्पत्रे विश्वेशं दक्षिणे ततः । उत्तरे परमेशानं सर्वेशं पश्चिमे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: IshvaraM pUrvadikpatre vishveshaM dakShiNe tataH | uttare parameshAnaM sarveshaM pashchime yajet
verses.translation: O sage, he shall say "I have renounced after meditating on Sadasiva in the heart in th»* low, medium and high pitch gradually.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे तु यजेद् रुद्रमावोराजानमित्यृचा । आवाह्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः कर्णिकायां दलेषु च
verses.transliteration: dakShiNe tu yajed rudramAvorAjAnamityR^ichA | AvAhya gandhapuShpAdyaiH karNikAyAM daleShu cha
verses.translation: After muttering the Presa mantras with attentive mind he shall say "Let all living beings have fearlessness from me, Svaha."

verses.sanskrit: शिवः पूर्वे दक्षिणतो हर उत्तरतो मृडः । भवः पश्चिमदिक्पत्रे पूज्या एते यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: shivaH pUrve dakShiNato hara uttarato mR^iDaH | bhavaH pashchimadikpatre pUjyA ete yathAkramam
verses.translation: He shall take water in the cupped palms and pour it to the east. He shall uproot the tuft and take out the sacred thread.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे विष्णुमावाह्य गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत् । प्रतद्विष्णुरिति प्रोच्य कर्णिकायां दलेषु च
verses.transliteration: uttare viShNumAvAhya gandhapuShpAdibhiryajet | pratadviShNuriti prochya karNikAyAM daleShu cha
verses.translation: Taking the two in the cupped palms along with water he shall say Om Bhuh "Go thou to the ocean'* after uttering Suaha, the name of the wife of the fire. Along with the water in the palms he shall put the two in the water uttering Presa mantras. After performing Acamana thrice he shall come to the bank and cast oil all the clothes.

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेवं पूर्वभागे दक्षिणे चानिरुद्धकम् । सौम्ये सङ्कर्षणं चैव प्रद्युम्नं पश्चिमे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: vAsudevaM pUrvabhAge dakShiNe chAniruddhakam | saumye sa~NkarShaNaM chaiva pradyumnaM pashchime yajet

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं पश्चिमे पद्मे समावाह्य समर्चयेत् । हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तत इति मन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: brahmANaM pashchime padme samAvAhya samarchayet | hiraNyagarbhaH samavartata iti mantreNa mantravit

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं पूजितौ यत्र तत्रैव क्रमशः सुधीः । गन्धाद्यैरर्चयेत्पूर्वं देवौ हेरम्बषण्मुखौ
verses.transliteration: prathamaM pUjitau yatra tatraiva kramashaH sudhIH | gandhAdyairarchayetpUrvaM devau herambaShaNmukhau
verses.translation: He shall then foot a short distance more than seven paces facing north or the east. Then the preceptor shall ask him to stop saying, "for your stay and activity in the world, O holy one, accept this loin-cloth and staff." He shall band them over to him with his own hands.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भं पूर्वस्यां विराजं दक्षिणे ततः । उत्तरे पुष्करञ्चैव कालं पश्चिमतो यजेत्
verses.transliteration: hiraNyagarbhaM pUrvasyAM virAjaM dakShiNe tataH | uttare puShkara~nchaiva kAlaM pashchimato yajet
verses.translation: After giving the loin-cloth with its string, and the ochre-coloured robe he shall ask him to wear them. After performing Acamana twice he shall tell the disciple thus "You are the thunderbolt of Indra."®*. After praying and saying "A good companion", he shall take up thestaff.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोर्ध्वपङ्क्तौ पूर्वादिप्रदक्षिणविधानतः । तत्तत्स्थानेषु सम्पूज्य लोकपालाननुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sarvordhvapa~Nktau pUrvAdipradakShiNavidhAnataH | tattatsthAneShu sampUjya lokapAlAnanukramAt
verses.translation: He shall approach the preceptor remembering the lotus-like feet of Siva and fall at his feet thrice with fully restrained mind.

verses.sanskrit: रान्तं मान्तं तथा क्षान्तं लान्तं वान्तमपूर्वकम् । सान्तं हान्तं च वेदाद्यं श्रीबीजं च दश क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: rAntaM mAntaM tathA kShAntaM lAntaM vAntamapUrvakam | sAntaM hAntaM cha vedAdyaM shrIbIjaM cha dasha kramAt
verses.translation: Standing up again he shall approach the feet of the preceptor with palms joined in reverence, glancing at his preceptor with love.

verses.sanskrit: बीजानि लोकपालानामेतैरेतान्समर्चयेत् । नैरृत्ये चोत्तरे तद्वदीशानस्य च दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: bIjAni lokapAlAnAmetairetAnsamarchayet | nairR^itye chottare tadvadIshAnasya cha dakShiNe
verses.translation: Before the rites are begun he should collect cowdung and make them into balls of the size of a myroba- lan fruit and dry them in sunshine. The balls shall be placed in the sacrificial fire at the advent of homa. At the conclusion of the homa the ashes shall be collected and preserved.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णू च विधिना पूजयेदुपचारकैः । बाह्यरेखासु देवेशि पञ्चमावरणे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmaviShNU cha vidhinA pUjayedupachArakaiH | bAhyarekhAsu deveshi pa~nchamAvaraNe yajet
verses.translation: The preceptor shall take the white ashes of the Viraja fire. Repeating the mantras "Agniriti Bhasma"®' he shall apply the sacred ashes over the body of the disciple from head to foot. Repeating the five mantras "Isana"'®® Tryayusa"®® "Tryambakam Yjamahe®® he shall apply the Tripundra marks too beginning with head.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमत्त्रिशूलमीशाने वज्रं माहेन्द्रदिङ्मुखे । परशुं वह्निदिग्भागे याम्ये सायकमर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: shrImattrishUlamIshAne vajraM mAhendradi~Nmukhe | parashuM vahnidigbhAge yAmye sAyakamarchayet
verses.translation: Then the disciple shall meditate devotedly on Siva, the consort of Uma in the lotus of his heart.

verses.sanskrit: नैरृते तु यजेत्खड्गं पाशं वरुणगोचरे । अङ्कुशं मारुते भागे पिनाकं चोत्तरे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: nairR^ite tu yajetkhaDgaM pAshaM varuNagochare | a~NkushaM mArute bhAge pinAkaM chottare yajet
verses.translation: Putting his hand on the head of the disciple the preceptor shall utter the Pranava thrice into the right ear of the disciple along with the names of the sage etc.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमाभिमुखं रौद्रं क्षेत्रपालं समर्चयेत् । यथाविधि विधानज्ञः शिवप्रीत्यर्थमेव च
verses.transliteration: pashchimAbhimukhaM raudraM kShetrapAlaM samarchayet | yathAvidhi vidhAnaj~naH shivaprItyarthameva cha
verses.translation: The excellent preceptor shall be sympathetic and explain Pranava with the knowledge of the six-fold topics.

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे चिन्त्याः स्मितमुखाम्बुजाः । सादरं प्रेक्षमाणाश्च देवं देवीं च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: kR^itA~njalipuTAH sarve chintyAH smitamukhAmbujAH | sAdaraM prekShamANAshcha devaM devIM cha sarvadA
verses.translation: Siras U 5..

verses.sanskrit: इत्थमावरणाभ्यर्चां कृत्वा विक्षेपशान्तये । पुनरभ्यर्च्य देवेशं प्रणवं च शिवं वदेत्
verses.transliteration: itthamAvaraNAbhyarchAM kR^itvA vikShepashAntaye | punarabhyarchya deveshaM praNavaM cha shivaM vadet

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च ब्रह्माणि परितो वृत्तं सम्पूजयेत्क्रमात् । ईशानदेशे पूर्वे च दक्षिणे चोत्तरे तथा
verses.transliteration: pa~ncha brahmANi parito vR^ittaM sampUjayetkramAt | IshAnadeshe pUrve cha dakShiNe chottare tathA
verses.translation: Ibid 3. 60.

verses.sanskrit: एवमभ्यर्च्य विधिवद् गन्धाद्यैरुपचारकैः । उपचर्य ततो दद्यान्नैवेद्यं विधिसाधितम्
verses.transliteration: evamabhyarchya vidhivad gandhAdyairupachArakaiH | upacharya tato dadyAnnaivedyaM vidhisAdhitam
verses.translation: The disciple shall make obeisance to the pre¬ ceptor by prostrating twelve times. He shall remain subservient to him always. He shall not do anything else.

verses.sanskrit: पुनराचमनीयं च दद्यादर्घ्यं यथा पुरा । ततो निवेद्य पानीयं ताम्बूलं चोपदेशतः
verses.transliteration: punarAchamanIyaM cha dadyAdarghyaM yathA purA | tato nivedya pAnIyaM tAmbUlaM chopadeshataH
verses.translation: At his bidding the disciple shall pursue Saivite knowledge in conformity with the Upanisadic doctrine and based on the difference of Saguna and Nirguna.

verses.sanskrit: नीराजनादिकं कृत्वा पूजाशेषं समापयेत् । ध्यात्वा देवं च देवीं च मनुमष्टोत्तरं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: nIrAjanAdikaM kR^itvA pUjAsheShaM samApayet | dhyAtvA devaM cha devIM cha manumaShTottaraM japet
verses.translation: The preceptor shall make the disciple perform all the rites in the morning up to the Japa including the practice of hearing etc.

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्थाय रचितपुष्पाञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः । जपेद् ध्यात्वा महादेवं यो देवानामिति क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tata utthAya rachitapuShpA~njalipuTaH sthitaH | japed dhyAtvA mahAdevaM yo devAnAmiti kramAt
verses.translation: The disciple shall perform the worship in the manrlala Kailasaprastai a as enjoined by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: यो वेदादौ स्वरः प्रोक्त इत्यन्तं परमेश्वरि । पुष्पाञ्जलिं ततो दत्त्वा त्रिःप्रदक्षिणमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: yo vedAdau svaraH prokta ityantaM parameshvari | puShpA~njaliM tato dattvA triHpradakShiNamAcharet
verses.translation: If he cannot worship the deity worshipped by his preceptor he shall take up Sivalihga of crystal along with the pedestal.

verses.sanskrit: साष्टाङ्गं प्रणमेत्तं स भक्त्या परमयान्वितः । पुनः प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा प्रणमेत्पुनरेकधा
verses.transliteration: sAShTA~NgaM praNamettaM sa bhaktyA paramayAnvitaH | punaH pradakShiNAM kR^itvA praNametpunarekadhA
verses.translation: "I shall rather cast life and cut off my head than take meals without worshipping Siva."

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वासने समभ्यर्च्य देवं नामाष्टकेन च । साधु वासाधु वा कर्म यद्यदाचरितं मया
verses.transliteration: sthitvAsane samabhyarchya devaM nAmAShTakena cha | sAdhu vAsAdhu vA karma yadyadAcharitaM mayA
verses.translation: Thus shall the disciple devoted to Siva take vow in the presence of the preceptor which he shall repeat thrice with a steady mind.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं भगवञ्छम्भो भवदाराधनं परम् । इति शङ्खोदकेनैव सपुष्पेण समर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: tatsarvaM bhagava~nChambho bhavadArAdhanaM param | iti sha~Nkhodakenaiva sapuShpeNa samarpayet
verses.translation: Thus the disciple shall worship Lord Siva every day with devoted and diligent mind, following the path t)f five Avaranas.

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यं पुनः समभ्यर्च्य सार्थं नामाष्टकं जपेत् । तदेव शृणु देवेशि सम्ब्रुवे तव भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: pUjyaM punaH samabhyarchya sArthaM nAmAShTakaM japet | tadeva shR^iNu deveshi sambruve tava bhaktitaH
verses.translation: O Karttikeya, the nectarine ocean of perfect know¬ ledge, son of Siva the lord of gods and the dispeller of distress of the devotees what is perfect knowledge of the sixfold topics that bestows all desires? VVliat are the six topics? What is the perfect knowledge?

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे च ततस्तस्मिन्षडङ्गानि समर्चयेत् । आग्नेये च तथैशाने नैरृते वायुदेशके
verses.transliteration: pashchime cha tatastasminShaDa~NgAni samarchayet | Agneye cha tathaishAne nairR^ite vAyudeshake
verses.translation: Without knowing this I have been deluded by Siva's Maya. I am ignorant of the Pasupata Sastra.

verses.sanskrit: मध्ये नेत्रं तद्वदस्त्रं पूर्वादिपरितः क्रमात् । प्रथमावरणं प्रोक्तं द्वितीयावरणं शृणु
verses.transliteration: madhye netraM tadvadastraM pUrvAdiparitaH kramAt | prathamAvaraNaM proktaM dvitIyAvaraNaM shR^iNu
verses.translation: I have sought refuge in your lotus-feet. Glancing at me for a long time with your eyes drenched with the nectar of sympathy you shall bless me so that I shall I become free from delusion, drink in the nectarine potion of the knowledge of the feet of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तं पूर्वदिक्पत्रे सूक्ष्मं दक्षिणतस्तथा । शिवोत्तमं पश्चिमत एकनेत्रं तथोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: anantaM pUrvadikpatre sUkShmaM dakShiNatastathA | shivottamaM pashchimata ekanetraM tathottare
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the sage the lord bearing the trident of knowledge said words causing fears to other systems of theology.

verses.sanskrit: एकरुद्रं तथैशाने त्रिमूर्तिं वह्निदिग्दले । श्रीकण्ठं नैरृते वायौ शिखण्डीशं समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: ekarudraM tathaishAne trimUrtiM vahnidigdale | shrIkaNThaM nairR^ite vAyau shikhaNDIshaM samarchayet
verses.translation: O revered sage, you have enquired about the per¬ fect knowledge of Siva in his composite and individual state. O performer of good rites, I shall e.plain that in detail Perfect knowledge comprises the meaning of Pranava by reali¬ sing the unity of six topics.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयावरणे चैव पूज्यास्ते चक्रवर्तिनः । पूर्वद्वारस्य मध्ये तु वृषेशानं प्रपूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: dvitIyAvaraNe chaiva pUjyAste chakravartinaH | pUrvadvArasya madhye tu vR^iSheshAnaM prapUjayet
verses.translation: The first topic is the mantra; the second Yantra; the third deity; the fourth the cosmos; the fifth the preceptor; the si.xth the Atman of the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दक्षिणे नन्दिनं च महाकालं तदुत्तरे । भृङ्गीशं दक्षिणद्वारपश्चिमे सम्प्रपूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: taddakShiNe nandinaM cha mahAkAlaM taduttare | bhR^i~NgIshaM dakShiNadvArapashchime samprapUjayet
verses.translation: O excellent sage, I shall explain to you the form of the mantra which makes a man possessed of perfect know¬ ledge.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Beneath all, the pedestal shall be drawn; then the first vowel — A; then the letter U, the final letter of the class of Pa i e. Ma followed by Bindu and Nada. When the Yantra becomes perfect, all desires are achieved.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Beneath all, the pedestal shall be drawn; then the first vowel — A; then the letter U, the final letter of the class of Pa i e. Ma followed by Bindu and Nada. When the Yantra becomes perfect, all desires are achieved.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam
verses.translation: Beneath all, the pedestal shall be drawn; then the first vowel — A; then the letter U, the final letter of the class of Pa i e. Ma followed by Bindu and Nada. When the Yantra becomes perfect, all desires are achieved.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.९. नवमोऽध्यायः । प्रणवार्थपद्धतिवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । शिवो महेश्वरश्चैव रुद्रो विष्णुः पितामहः । संसारवैद्यः सर्वज्ञः परमात्मेति मुख्यतः
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.9\. navamo.adhyAyaH | praNavArthapaddhativarNanam | Ishvara uvAcha | shivo maheshvarashchaiva rudro viShNuH pitAmahaH | saMsAravaidyaH sarvaj~naH paramAtmeti mukhyataH
verses.translation: O sage, I shall now explain the secret topic of the deity. I shall mention it, out of my affection to you, in the manner explained by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वेदादौ स्वरं प्राहुर्वाच्यवाचकभावतः । वेदैकवेद्यं याथात्म्याद्वेदान्ते च प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: yadvedAdau svaraM prAhurvAchyavAchakabhAvataH | vedaikavedyaM yAthAtmyAdvedAnte cha pratiShThitam
verses.translation: Beginning with "I resort to the lord born  of a

verses.sanskrit: स एव प्रकृतौ लीनो भोक्ता यः प्रकृतेर्यतः । तस्य प्रकृतिलीनस्य यः परः स महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa eva prakR^itau lIno bhoktA yaH prakR^iteryataH | tasya prakR^itilInasya yaH paraH sa maheshvaraH
verses.translation: The five deities shall be known comprising the subtle form of Brahman. These are enlarged in the form of the idol of Siva too.

verses.sanskrit: तदधीनप्रवृत्तित्त्वात्प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च । अथवा त्रिगुणं तत्त्वं मायेयमिदमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: tadadhInapravR^ittittvAtprakR^iteH puruShasya cha | athavA triguNaM tattvaM mAyeyamidamavyayam
verses.translation: The Mantra that expresses Siva expresses his idol too, since there is not much of difFefence between the idol and the original.

verses.sanskrit: मायां तु प्रकृतिं विद्यान्मायिनं तु महेश्वरम् । मायाविमोचकोऽनन्तो महेश्वरसमन्वयात्
verses.transliteration: mAyAM tu prakR^itiM vidyAnmAyinaM tu maheshvaram | mAyAvimochako.ananto maheshvarasamanvayAt
verses.translation: I have already referred to the form of Siva with nana at the head. Now listen about his five faces.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्दुःखं दुःखहेतुर्वा तद् द्रावयति यः प्रभुः । रुद्र इत्युच्यते तस्माच्छिवः परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: rudduHkhaM duHkhaheturvA tad drAvayati yaH prabhuH | rudra ityuchyate tasmAchChivaH paramakAraNam
verses.translation: Beginning with the fifth one' the Sadyojata and proceeding till ISana upwards are the five faces.

verses.sanskrit: शिवतत्त्वादिभूम्यन्तं शरीरादि घटादि च । व्याप्याधितिष्ठति शिवस्तमाद्विष्णुरुदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: shivatattvAdibhUmyantaM sharIrAdi ghaTAdi cha | vyApyAdhitiShThati shivastamAdviShNurudAhR^itaH
verses.translation: The four Brahmans constitute a Caturvyuha for lord Tsana, the famous Brahman. These five together constitute the composite. O sage, from Purusa to Sadyojfita the four constitute the individual.

verses.sanskrit: जगतः पितृभूतानां शिवो मूर्त्यात्मनामपि । पितृभावेन सर्वेषां पितामह उदीरितः
verses.transliteration: jagataH pitR^ibhUtAnAM shivo mUrtyAtmanAmapi | pitR^ibhAvena sarveShAM pitAmaha udIritaH
verses.translation: O sage, there too the deities Sadya etc. are of the form of the great Brahman. The five always bestow happiness.

verses.sanskrit: निदानज्ञो यथा वैद्यो रोगस्य विनिवर्तकः । उपायैर्भेषजैस्तद्वल्लयभोगाधिकारकः
verses.transliteration: nidAnaj~no yathA vaidyo rogasya vinivartakaH | upAyairbheShajaistadvallayabhogAdhikArakaH
verses.translation: After attaining this region and enjoying vast pleasures along with the lord in the form of Brahman the sages attain equality with Siva at the advent of the great dissolution. They never fall again in the ocean of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: संसारस्येश्वरो नित्यं स्थूलस्य विनिवर्तकः । संसारवैद्य इत्युक्तः सर्वतत्त्वार्थवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: saMsArasyeshvaro nityaM sthUlasya vinivartakaH | saMsAravaidya ityuktaH sarvatattvArthavedibhiH
verses.translation: The eternal Veda says "Te brahmaloke"® etc. The glory of Siva is the composite form itself.

verses.sanskrit: दशार्द्धज्ञानसिद्ध्यर्थमिन्द्रियेषु च सत्स्वपि । त्रिकालभाविनो भावान्स्थूलान्सूक्ष्मानशेषतः
verses.transliteration: dashArddhaj~nAnasiddhyarthamindriyeShu cha satsvapi | trikAlabhAvino bhAvAnsthUlAnsUkShmAnasheShataH
verses.translation: The Vedic text Atharvairsa says "Equipped with

verses.sanskrit: नामाष्टकमिदं नित्यं शिवस्य प्रतिपादकम् । आद्यन्तपञ्चकं तत्र शान्त्यतीताद्यनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: nAmAShTakamidaM nityaM shivasya pratipAdakam | Adyantapa~nchakaM tatra shAntyatItAdyanukramAt
verses.translation: Nivftti and the Kalas are the offshoots of five Brahmans. They are in the form of subtle elements well known as causes.

verses.sanskrit: अणवो नैव जानन्ति मायार्णवमलावृताः । असत्स्वपि च सर्वेषु सिद्धसर्वार्थवेदिषु
verses.transliteration: aNavo naiva jAnanti mAyArNavamalAvR^itAH | asatsvapi cha sarveShu siddhasarvArthavediShu
verses.translation: O sage of good rites, the set of five Brahmans is the cause of gross cosmos.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यथावस्थितं वस्तु तत्तथैव सदाशिवः । अयत्नेनैव जानाति तस्मात्सर्वज्ञ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yadyathAvasthitaM vastu tattathaiva sadAshivaH | ayatnenaiva jAnAti tasmAtsarvaj~na uchyate
verses.translation: Puru, ear, speech, sound and ether, this set of five is pervaded, O excellent sage, by the Brahman in the form of liana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मा परमैरेभिर्गुणैर्नित्यसमन्वयात् । स्वस्मात्परात्मविरहात्परमात्मा शिवः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAtmA paramairebhirguNairnityasamanvayAt | svasmAtparAtmavirahAtparamAtmA shivaH svayam
verses.translation: The ego, eye, foot, colour and fire, this set of five is pervaded by Aghora Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुत्वा महादेवं प्रणवात्मानमव्ययम् । अर्घ्यं पाद्यं पुरो दत्त्वा पश्चादीशानमस्तके
verses.transliteration: iti stutvA mahAdevaM praNavAtmAnamavyayam | arghyaM pAdyaM puro dattvA pashchAdIshAnamastake
verses.translation: The intellect, tongue, arms, taste and water, this set of five is pervaded by the Brahman Vamadeva.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरभ्यर्च्य देवेशं प्रणवेन समाहितः । हस्तेन बद्धाञ्जलिना पूजापुष्पं प्रगृह्य च
verses.transliteration: punarabhyarchya deveshaM praNavena samAhitaH | hastena baddhA~njalinA pUjApuShpaM pragR^ihya cha
verses.translation: The mind, nose, organ of generation, smell and earth, this set of five is pervaded by the Brahman Sadya. The whole universe is identical with the five Brahmans.

verses.sanskrit: उन्मन्यन्तं शिवं नीत्वा वामनासापुटाध्वना । देवीमुद्वास्य च ततो दक्षनासापुटाध्वना
verses.transliteration: unmanyantaM shivaM nItvA vAmanAsApuTAdhvanA | devImudvAsya cha tato dakShanAsApuTAdhvanA
verses.translation: Pranava expressive of Siva is taught through yantra. It is the composite of five letters. The four viz, Bindu etc. constitute the form of yantra in the Saiva cult. Pranava is the highest Mantra — the very Siva himself.

verses.sanskrit: शिव एवाहमस्मीति तदैक्यमनुभूय च । सर्वावरणदेवांश्च पुनरुद्वासयेद् हृदि
verses.transliteration: shiva evAhamasmIti tadaikyamanubhUya cha | sarvAvaraNadevAMshcha punarudvAsayed hR^idi
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall explain, O good-faced lady, the mode of creation for the set of four, Mahesa etc. from Sadaiva.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यापूजां गुरोःपूजां कृत्वा पश्चाद्यथाक्रमम् । शङ्खार्घपात्रमन्त्रांश्च हृदये विन्यसेत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vidyApUjAM guroHpUjAM kR^itvA pashchAdyathAkramam | sha~NkhArghapAtramantrAMshcha hR^idaye vinyasetkramAt
verses.translation: This set of four comprising Hvara, Vivcivara, Para- meivara and Sarveivara is the excellent Tirobhavacakra.

verses.sanskrit: निर्माल्यं च समर्प्याथ चण्डीशायेशगोचरे । पुनश्च संयतप्राण ऋष्यादिकमथोच्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: nirmAlyaM cha samarpyAtha chaNDIshAyeshagochare | punashcha saMyataprANa R^iShyAdikamathochcharet
verses.translation: The latter remains till equality in activity is achieved. When this is achieved, there remains only the lord of the fcwm of blessing.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासप्रस्तरो नाम मण्डलं परिभाषितम् । अर्चयेन्नित्यमेवैतत्पक्षे वा मासि मासि वा
verses.transliteration: kailAsaprastaro nAma maNDalaM paribhAShitam | archayennityamevaitatpakShe vA mAsi mAsi vA
verses.translation: There all the ISvarais who are glorified as the deities, are identical with the great Brahman itself, free from alternatives and ailments.

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञा सदाशिवादीनां पञ्चोपाधिपरिग्रहात् । उपाधिविनिवृत्तौ तु यथास्वं विनिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: sa.nj~nA sadAshivAdInAM pa~nchopAdhiparigrahAt | upAdhivinivR^ittau tu yathAsvaM vinivartate
verses.translation: The Tirobhava Gakra consists of the Santikala. This excellent region is presided over by Maheivara.

verses.sanskrit: षण्मासे वत्सरे वापि चातुर्मास्यादिपर्वणि । अवश्यं च समभ्यर्चेन्नित्यं मल्लिङ्गमास्तिकः
verses.transliteration: ShaNmAse vatsare vApi chAturmAsyAdiparvaNi | avashyaM cha samabhyarchennityaM malli~NgamAstikaH
verses.translation: This set of four consists of Siva, Kara, Mrda and Bhava. This wheel of dissolution, O sage, is wonderful and divine.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्क्रमे महादेवि विशेषः कोऽपि कथ्यते । उपदेशदिने लिङ्गं पूजितं गुरुणा सह
verses.transliteration: tasminkrame mahAdevi visheShaH ko.api kathyate | upadeshadine li~NgaM pUjitaM guruNA saha
verses.translation: Dissolution has been classified into three. The first Nitya is the daily slumber of living beings. The second is the conditioned dissolution of Brahma. The third is the final dissolution. The three have been indicated by the Vedic texts. O excellent sage, the dissolution has been cla.ssified into three by the illustrious Rudra for the maturing of the activities of individual souls and for their rest. The souls released from their recurring births are ultimately placed in the great Atman itself.

verses.sanskrit: गृह्णीयादर्चयिष्यामि शिवमाप्राणसङ्क्षयम् । एवं त्रिवारमुच्चार्य शपथं गुरुसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: gR^ihNIyAdarchayiShyAmi shivamAprANasa~NkShayam | evaM trivAramuchchArya shapathaM gurusannidhau
verses.translation: Thus I have mentioned the three activities of

verses.sanskrit: ततः समर्चयेन्नित्यं पूर्वोक्तविधिना प्रिये । अर्घं समर्पयेल्लिङ्गमूर्द्धन्यर्घ्योदकेन च
verses.transliteration: tataH samarchayennityaM pUrvoktavidhinA priye | arghaM samarpayelli~NgamUrddhanyarghyodakena cha
verses.translation: O sage, the deities Bhava etc. are identical with the great Brahman, being the cause of bliss.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवेन समभ्यर्च्य धूपदीपौ समर्पयेत् । ऐशान्यां चण्डमाराध्य निर्माल्यं च निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: praNavena samabhyarchya dhUpadIpau samarpayet | aishAnyAM chaNDamArAdhya nirmAlyaM cha nivedayet
verses.translation: This wheel of dissolution has Vidyarupa Kala. This healthy region is presided over by Rudra himself.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य लिङ्गं वेदीं च वस्त्रपूतैर्जलैस्ततः । निःक्षिप्य पुष्पं शिरसि लिङ्गस्य प्रणवेन तु
verses.transliteration: prakShAlya li~NgaM vedIM cha vastrapUtairjalaistataH | niHkShipya puShpaM shirasi li~Ngasya praNavena tu
verses.translation: This set of four consists of Vasudeva, Aniruddha, Sarhkarsana and Pradyumna. This excellent wheel of sus¬ tenance is well known.

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्तिमारभ्य शुद्धविद्यासनावधि । विभाव्य सर्वं मनसा स्थापयेत्परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: AdhArashaktimArabhya shuddhavidyAsanAvadhi | vibhAvya sarvaM manasA sthApayetparameshvaram
verses.translation: Sustenance means the protection of the existing universe along with its creator until the completion of the pleasures of the souls, the reapers of the fruit.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चगव्यादिभिर्द्रव्यैर्यथाविभवसम्भृतैः । केवलैर्वा जलैः शुद्धैः सुरभिद्रव्यवासितैः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchagavyAdibhirdravyairyathAvibhavasambhR^itaiH | kevalairvA jalaiH shuddhaiH surabhidravyavAsitaiH
verses.translation: O Brahmin, this wheel of sustenance which is per¬ manent is presided over by Vi§nu. It is the highest abode.

verses.sanskrit: पावमानेन रुद्रेण नीलेन त्वरितेन च । ऋग्भिश्च सामभिर्वापि ब्रह्मभिश्चैव पञ्चभिः
verses.transliteration: pAvamAnena rudreNa nIlena tvaritena cha | R^igbhishcha sAmabhirvApi brahmabhishchaiva pa~nchabhiH
verses.translation: Hiranyagarbha, Virat, Purua and Kala, the four constitute his personal form.

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयेद्देवदेवेशं प्रणवेन शिवेन च । विशेषार्घ्योदकेनापि प्रणवेनाभिषेचयेत्
verses.transliteration: snApayeddevadeveshaM praNavena shivena cha | visheShArghyodakenApi praNavenAbhiShechayet
verses.translation: Those who have the knowledge of creation know this to be the function of Brahman. Creation is the process of re-unification of the soul with the body previously annihilated — the body which along with the means, ancillaries and results comes out of Prakrti for gradual enjoyment. It is pleasing as long as it holds good.

verses.sanskrit: पदमेव हि तं नित्यमनित्याः पदिनः स्मृताः । पदानां परिवृत्तिः स्यान्मुच्यन्ते पदिनो यतः
verses.transliteration: padameva hi taM nityamanityAH padinaH smR^itAH | padAnAM parivR^ittiH syAnmuchyante padino yataH
verses.translation: O sage, in the creation of the universe there are five functions of the lord. The present time etc. are the deities there.

verses.sanskrit: विशोध्य वाससा पुष्पं लिङ्गमूर्धनि विन्यसेत् । पीठे लिङ्गं समारोप्य सूर्याद्यर्चां समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: vishodhya vAsasA puShpaM li~NgamUrdhani vinyaset | pIThe li~NgaM samAropya sUryAdyarchAM samAcharet
verses.translation: Even in regard to the set of four wheels the Pranava indicates Mahea etc.

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्त्यनन्तौ द्वौ पीठाधस्तात्समर्चयेत् । सिंहासनं तदूर्ध्वं तु समभ्यर्च्य यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: AdhArashaktyanantau dvau pIThAdhastAtsamarchayet | siMhAsanaM tadUrdhvaM tu samabhyarchya yathAkramam
verses.translation: Although the wheel of the universe with its five constituents: creation etc. has five spokes, it develops and increases by Siva's energy.

verses.sanskrit: अथोर्ध्वच्छदनम्पीठपादे स्कन्दं समर्चयेत् । लिङ्गे मूर्तिं समाकल्प्य मां त्वया सह पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: athordhvachChadanampIThapAde skandaM samarchayet | li~Nge mUrtiM samAkalpya mAM tvayA saha pUjayet
verses.translation: Because of the immensity of creation it is called Prthu, the resultant of the Saktj of lord Siva of immense splendour and of golden features. The wheel is dependent on golden splendour and is surrounded by water encompassed by fire.

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग् भक्त्या विधानेन यतिर्मद्ध्यानतत्परः । एवं मया ते कथितमतिगुह्यमिदं प्रिये
verses.transliteration: samyag bhaktyA vidhAnena yatirmaddhyAnatatparaH | evaM mayA te kathitamatiguhyamidaM priye
verses.translation: Such are the seven sheaths which protect the universe. The expanse of water is ten times more massive than the wheel.

verses.sanskrit: गोपनीयं प्रयत्नेन न देयं यस्य कस्यचित् । मम भक्ताय दातव्यं यतये वीतरागिणे
verses.transliteration: gopanIyaM prayatnena na deyaM yasya kasyachit | mama bhaktAya dAtavyaM yataye vItarAgiNe
verses.translation: That 8iva alone accompanied by 8akti performs incessant sports through blessing, disappearance, dissolution, sustenance and creation.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुभक्ताय शान्ताय मदर्थे योगभागिने । ममाज्ञामतिलङ्घ्यैतद्यो ददाति विमूढधीः
verses.transliteration: gurubhaktAya shAntAya madarthe yogabhAgine | mamAj~nAmatila~Nghyaitadyo dadAti vimUDhadhIH
verses.translation: On hearing this truthful purport enunciated, by the preceptor the leading sage asked him about his doubt concerning the great Atman.

verses.sanskrit: स नारकी मम द्रोही भविष्यति न संशयः । मद्भक्तदानाद्देवेशि मत्प्रियश्च भवेद् ध्रुवम् । इह भुक्त्वाखिलान्भोगान्मत्सान्निध्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sa nArakI mama drohI bhaviShyati na saMshayaH | madbhaktadAnAddeveshi matpriyashcha bhaved dhruvam | iha bhuktvAkhilAnbhogAnmatsAnnidhyamavApnuyAt
verses.translation: Surely this universe from Sadaiiva to a worm is reflected in male and female forms everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । एतच्छ्रुत्वा महादेवी महादेवेन भाषितम् । स्तुत्वा तु विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्देवं वेदार्थगर्भितैः
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | etachChrutvA mahAdevI mahAdevena bhAShitam | stutvA tu vividhaiH stotrairdevaM vedArthagarbhitaiH
verses.translation: Is the eternal cause of the universe in the form of a woman, or of a man or a eunuch?

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमत्पादाब्जयोः पत्युः प्रणामं परमेश्वरी । अतिप्रहृष्टहृदया मुमोद मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: shrImatpAdAbjayoH patyuH praNAmaM parameshvarI | atiprahR^iShTahR^idayA mumoda munisattamAH
verses.translation: The Vedas expatiating on the creation of the universe itself, Visnu, Brahma and other gods and the Siddhas do not know it.

verses.sanskrit: अतिगुह्यमिदं विप्राः प्रणवार्थप्रकाशकम् । शिवज्ञानपरं ह्येतद्भवतामार्तिनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: atiguhyamidaM viprAH praNavArthaprakAshakam | shivaj~nAnaparaM hyetadbhavatAmArtinAshanam
verses.translation: Please explain so that the conflicting views may be resolved into one truthful interpretation. We say — "I know," "I do". This is accepted by all. There is no dispute about this. But I have some doubts. "Is there a form of the Atman or is the Atman identical with the body, sense- organs, mind, intellect and ego? The two are the points of dispute among many.

verses.sanskrit: परिवृत्त्यन्तरे त्वेवं भूयस्तस्याप्युपाधिना । आत्मान्तराभिधानं स्यात्यादाद्यं नामपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: parivR^ittyantare tvevaM bhUyastasyApyupAdhinA | AtmAntarAbhidhAnaM syAtyAdAdyaM nAmapa~nchakam
verses.translation: O lord, uproot this poisonous tree of doubt arising from ignorance. I shall be enlightened by you so that my mind may become the fertile ground for the growth of monistic knowledge of the Saivite cult. O lord of gods, by your benign favour I shall become wise.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्युक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलः पाराशर्यो महातपाः । पूजितः परया भक्त्या मुनिभिर्वेदवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityuktvA munishArdUlaH pArAsharyo mahAtapAH | pUjitaH parayA bhaktyA munibhirvedavAdibhiH
verses.translation: On hearing the enquiry of the sage full of Vedantic topics, the lord smiled a little and unfolded the secret.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासाद्रिमनुस्मृत्य ययौ तस्मात्तपोवनात् । तेऽपि प्रहृष्टहृदयाः सत्रान्ते परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kailAsAdrimanusmR^itya yayau tasmAttapovanAt | te.api prahR^iShTahR^idayAH satrAnte parameshvaram
verses.translation: O sage, I shall sympathetically explain the same to you. O son, it is the greatest secret. Please listen to it now.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य परया भक्त्या सोमं सोमार्धशेखरम् । यमादियोगनिरताः शिवध्यानपराभवन्
verses.transliteration: sampUjya parayA bhaktyA somaM somArdhashekharam | yamAdiyoganiratAH shivadhyAnaparAbhavan
verses.translation: The arguments in the philosof)hical text books arc extensive beginning with those on Karmans and the principle of existence. But O sage, those arguments shall be listened to with discrimination by a wise person. Then it may yield wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: गुहाय कथितं ह्येतद्देव्या तेनापि नन्दिने । सनत्कुमारमुनये प्रोवाच भगवान् हि सः
verses.transliteration: guhAya kathitaM hyetaddevyA tenApi nandine | sanatkumAramunaye provAcha bhagavAn hi saH
verses.translation: You have taught many disciples. But among them

verses.sanskrit: तस्माल्लब्धं मद्गुरुणा व्यासेनामिततेजसा । तस्माल्लब्धमिदं पुण्यं मयापि मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: tasmAllabdhaM madguruNA vyAsenAmitatejasA | tasmAllabdhamidaM puNyaM mayApi munipu~NgavAH
verses.translation: They indulged in insulting Siva and hence were cursed by the seven sages. Their views should not be heard because they explain false notions.

verses.sanskrit: मया वः श्रावितं ह्येतद् गुह्याद् गुह्यतरं परम् । ज्ञात्वा शिवप्रियान्भक्त्या भवतो गिरिशप्रियम्
verses.transliteration: mayA vaH shrAvitaM hyetad guhyAd guhyataraM param | j~nAtvA shivapriyAnbhaktyA bhavato girishapriyam
verses.translation: There is no scope for inference that consists of the five syllogisms. On seeing smoke they say that there is fire too. But here, O sage, the world is the object of per¬ ception. Its cause and support, the great Atman Siva must be known directly. The universe in the form of male and female is directly perceived.

verses.sanskrit: भवद्भिरपि दातव्यमेतद् गुह्यं शिवप्रियम् । यतिभ्यः शान्तचित्तेभ्यो भक्तेभ्यः शिवपादयोः
verses.transliteration: bhavadbhirapi dAtavyametad guhyaM shivapriyam | yatibhyaH shAntachittebhyo bhaktebhyaH shivapAdayoH
verses.translation: The physical body consists of six sheaths. The first three are born of the parts of the mother and the other three of the parts of the father. So says the.ruti.

verses.sanskrit: एतदुक्त्वा महाभागः सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः । तीर्थयात्राप्रसङ्गेन चचार पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: etaduktvA mahAbhAgaH sUtaH paurANikottamaH | tIrthayAtrAprasa~Ngena chachAra pR^ithivImimAm
verses.translation: The Sruti speaks of the Brahman as having the form of existence, knowledge and bliss. The word 'existence' is used in order to exclude the 'non-existent'.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्रहस्यं परमं लब्ध्वा सूतान्मुनीश्वराः । काश्यामेव समासीना मुक्ताः शिवपदं ययुः
verses.transliteration: etadrahasyaM paramaM labdhvA sUtAnmunIshvarAH | kAshyAmeva samAsInA muktAH shivapadaM yayuH
verses.translation: The exclusion of the insentient is effected by the word sentient. Of course the word Git is used in all the three genders but it signifies here a male being. The word Cit in the feminine gender is a synonym of the word knowledge. If it is taken to mean 'Light', it is clear that it illuminates.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्तु त्रितयं नाम्नामुपादानादिभेदतः । त्रिविधोपाधिरचनाच्छिव एव तु वर्तते
verses.transliteration: anyattu tritayaM nAmnAmupAdAnAdibhedataH | trividhopAdhirachanAchChiva eva tu vartate
verses.translation: In the self-same individual the feeling of Siva and Sakti exists. If there is dirt in the oil or the wick there may be dirt in the light too.

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमलसंश्लेषप्रागभावात्स्वभावतः । अत्यन्तपरिशुद्धात्मेत्यतोऽयं शिव उच्यते
verses.transliteration: anAdimalasaMshleShaprAgabhAvAtsvabhAvataH | atyantaparishuddhAtmetyato.ayaM shiva uchyate
verses.translation: O sage, people say in the world: he is strong, he ii powerful and in the Vedas too there is a similar expres.«ion.

verses.sanskrit: अथवाशेषकल्याणगुणैकघन ईश्वरः । शिव इत्युच्यते सद्भिः शिवतत्त्वार्थवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: athavAsheShakalyANaguNaikaghana IshvaraH | shiva ityuchyate sadbhiH shivatattvArthavedibhiH
verses.translation: Hence, O sage, sinless ascetics aiming at bliss fix their minds in Siva and attain untainted auspiciousness.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोविंशतितत्वेभ्यः परा प्रकृतिरुच्यते । प्रकृतेस्तु परं प्राहुः पुरुषं पञ्चविंशकम्
verses.transliteration: trayoviMshatitatvebhyaH parA prakR^itiruchyate | prakR^itestu paraM prAhuH puruShaM pa~nchaviMshakam
verses.translation: The word Brahman in the Upaniads signifies Atman collectively. It can be traced to the root Brh to in¬ crease or grow.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: It shall be known as the great Mantra by the expert sages. This great Mantra is subtle. I shall tell you its analysis.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: It shall be known as the great Mantra by the expert sages. This great Mantra is subtle. I shall tell you its analysis.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam
verses.translation: It shall be known as the great Mantra by the expert sages. This great Mantra is subtle. I shall tell you its analysis.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । सूतोपदेशः । व्यास उवाच । गतेऽथ सूते मुनयः सुविस्मिता विचिन्त्य चान्योऽन्यमिदं तु विस्मृतम् । यद्वामदेवस्य मतं मुनीश्वर प्रसूचितं तत्खलु कष्टमद्य नः
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.10\. dashamo.adhyAyaH | sUtopadeshaH | vyAsa uvAcha | gate.atha sUte munayaH suvismitA vichintya chAnyo.anyamidaM tu vismR^itam | yadvAmadevasya mataM munIshvara prasUchitaM tatkhalu kaShTamadya naH
verses.translation: At the instruction of the preceptor, the great mantra is Siva in the form of Sakti. Hence the great mantra is the individual soul too. The individual soul is in the form of Sakti and is a part of Siva. Due to the identity with Siva it attains equality with Siva. In the passage (of ihe Vedas) "Prajfianam Brahma" the meaning of "Prajfianam" is seen.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेश्वरमुमाकान्तं ससुतं सगणाधिपम् । पूजयामास सद्भक्त्या ह्यस्तौ नत्वा मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: vishveshvaramumAkAntaM sasutaM sagaNAdhipam | pUjayAmAsa sadbhaktyA hyastau natvA muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: Thus a gloss on the aphorisms of Siva has been mentioned by me. In another aphorism of Siva viz; "Jhanam Bandhah" the lord spe.nks of the nature of

verses.sanskrit: कालभैरवनाथं च सम्पूज्याथ विधानतः । प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य पुनस्त्रेधा नत्वा च पञ्चधा
verses.transliteration: kAlabhairavanAthaM cha sampUjyAtha vidhAnataH | pradakShiNIkR^itya punastredhA natvA cha pa~nchadhA
verses.translation: These two (knowledge and activity) are the first throbbing of the great Sakti. It is this Para Sakti that the Svetasvataras eulogised joyously saying "Power of knowledge and activity is natural" They know the three eyes of Siva constitute knowledge, will and activity.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत् । तुष्टाव परया स्तुत्या संस्मरंस्तत्पदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: punaH pradakShiNIkR^itya praNamya bhuvi daNDavat | tuShTAva parayA stutyA saMsmaraMstatpadAmbujam
verses.translation: When these reaching the centre of the mind become the object of perception on the part of sense-organs the individual soul enters these, then knows and acts.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमत्पञ्चाक्षरीं विद्यामष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् । सञ्जप्य पुरतः स्थित्वा क्षमापय्य महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: shrImatpa~nchAkSharIM vidyAmaShTottarasahasrakam | sa~njapya purataH sthitvA kShamApayya maheshvaram
verses.translation: Hence these are the features of the Atman alone. I shall now explain then meaning of the creation indicating the identity with the Pranava.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डीशं सम्प्रपूज्याऽथ मुक्तिमण्डपमध्यतः । निर्दिष्टमासनं भेजे मुनिभिर्वेदपारगैः
verses.transliteration: chaNDIshaM samprapUjyA.atha muktimaNDapamadhyataH | nirdiShTamAsanaM bheje munibhirvedapAragaiH
verses.translation: I shall mention the purport of the Vedic passage. Listen to that, O Vamadeva, due to affecion for you I say this. It is developed by the sense of discrimination.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्थितेषु सर्वेषु नमस्कृत्य समन्त्रकम् । अथ प्राह मुनीन्द्राणां भाववृद्धिकरं वच
verses.transliteration: evaM sthiteShu sarveShu namaskR^itya samantrakam | atha prAha munIndrANAM bhAvavR^iddhikaraM vacha
verses.translation: It is certain that the union of Siva and Sakti is the great-Atman From Paraakti is born the citsakti. Born of it is the power of bliss. The power of will is born of that. From this is born the power of knowledge and from this is born the power of activity, the fifth one. O sage, the Kalas— Nivrtti etc. are born of these Iraklis.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । धन्या यूयं महाप्राज्ञा मुनयः शंसितव्रताः । भवदर्थमिह प्राप्तोऽहं तद्वृत्तमिदं शृणु
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | dhanyA yUyaM mahAprAj~nA munayaH shaMsitavratAH | bhavadarthamiha prApto.ahaM tadvR^ittamidaM shR^iNu
verses.translation: Nada and Bindu are born of cit and Ananda Saktis. O sage, the letter 'ma' is born of Icchasakli. The fifth vowel *U' is born of Jnaiia Sakti and the letter 'A' is born of Kriyasakti. The origin of the Pranava has been mentioned thus. Now listen to the origin of the five Brahmans.

verses.sanskrit: यदाहमुपदिश्याथ भवतः प्रणवार्थकम् । गतस्तीर्थाटनार्थाय तद्वृत्तान्तं ब्रवीमि वः
