verses.transliteration: yadAhamupadishyAtha bhavataH praNavArthakam | gatastIrthATanArthAya tadvR^ittAntaM bravImi vaH
verses.translation: From these matras (of the pranava) are born the thirty eight Kalas, Santyatitakala is born of Isana; Santikala of Purusa; Vidyakala of Aghora; Pratistha and Nivrtti of Vamadeva and Sadyojata. There are five pairs such as Isana and cit-sakti etc.

verses.sanskrit: इतो निर्गत्य सम्प्राप्य तीरं दक्षपयोनिधेः । स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य विधिवद्देवीं कन्यामयीं शिवाम् । पुनरागत्य विप्रेन्द्राः सुवर्णमुखरीतटम्
verses.transliteration: ito nirgatya samprApya tIraM dakShapayonidheH | snAtvA sampUjya vidhivaddevIM kanyAmayIM shivAm | punarAgatya viprendrAH suvarNamukharItaTam
verses.translation: O sage, the five elements beginning with the ether are born of this set of five letters of the Pranava which constitute pairs based on the relationship of the word and its meaning.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकालहस्तिशैलाख्यनगरे परमाद्भुते । सुवर्णमुखरीतोये स्नात्वा देवानृषीनपि
verses.transliteration: shrIkAlahastishailAkhyanagare paramAdbhute | suvarNamukharItoye snAtvA devAnR^iShInapi
verses.translation: Akasa has the only attribute of sound. The wind has the two: sound and touch. The fire has three: sound, touch and colour.

verses.sanskrit: कदानुभूयान्मुनिवर्यदर्शनं भवाब्धिदुःखौघहरं परं हि तत् । महेश्वराराधनपुण्यतोऽधुना मुनीश्वरः सत्वरमाविरस्तु नः
verses.transliteration: kadAnubhUyAnmunivaryadarshanaM bhavAbdhiduHkhaughaharaM paraM hi tat | maheshvarArAdhanapuNyato.adhunA munIshvaraH satvaramAvirastu naH
verses.translation: The water has four: sound, touch, colour and taste. The earth has five: sound, touch, colour, taste and smell.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तर्प्य विधिवद्भक्त्या समुद्रं गिरिशं स्मरन् । समर्च्य कालहस्तीशं चन्द्रकान्तसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: santarpya vidhivadbhaktyA samudraM girishaM smaran | samarchya kAlahastIshaM chandrakAntasamaprabham
verses.translation: The five Bhutas constitute the universe. Virat is the composite form of all. The universe is thus created.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमाभिमुखं पञ्चशिरसं परमाद्भुतम् । सकृद्दर्शनमात्रेण सर्वाघक्षयकारणम्
verses.transliteration: pashchimAbhimukhaM pa~nchashirasaM paramAdbhutam | sakR^iddarshanamAtreNa sarvAghakShayakAraNam
verses.translation: It begins with the element of the earth and ends with the element of Siva. After merging with each other they merge in the individual soul ultimately.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं भुक्तिमुक्तिदं त्रिगुणेश्वरम् । ततश्च परया भक्त्या तस्य दक्षिणगां शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasiddhipradaM bhuktimuktidaM triguNeshvaram | tatashcha parayA bhaktyA tasya dakShiNagAM shivAm
verses.translation: Accompanied by the energy it comes out again for the purpose of creation. It appears in the form of the gross cosmos and functions till the period r)f dissolution.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानप्रसूनकलिकां समर्च्य हि जगत्प्रसूम् । श्रीमत्पञ्चाक्षरीं विद्यामष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: j~nAnaprasUnakalikAM samarchya hi jagatprasUm | shrImatpa~nchAkSharIM vidyAmaShTottarasahasrakam
verses.translation: The primeval oozing of Siva who attempts to create the universe at his will is called Sivataitva.

verses.sanskrit: जप्त्वा प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य स्तुत्वा नत्वा मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: japtvA pradakShiNIkR^itya stutvA natvA muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: In view of its conformity with the atlivilies this alone becomes the principle of his power of will. Between the two laktis of knowledge and activity if the knowledge predominates, the principle is Sadasiva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य गिरिं प्रत्यहमादरात् । आमोदतीव मनसि प्रत्यहं नियमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: tataH pradakShiNIkR^itya giriM pratyahamAdarAt | AmodatIva manasi pratyahaM niyamAsthitaH
verses.translation: O sage, know that as Mahesvara Tattva when the activity is predominant. If there is equality between the two Saktis know that as the form ol pure knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अनयन् चतुरो मासानेवं तत्र मुनीश्वराः । ज्ञानप्रसूनकलिकामहादेव्याः प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: anayan chaturo mAsAnevaM tatra munIshvarAH | j~nAnaprasUnakalikAmahAdevyAH prasAdataH
verses.translation: After withdrawing his form of great glory with the intellect comprehending the dilfercncc between the illusion and reality among various emotions in the form of his own part when Siva becomes the recipient of ail objects through illusion, he is called Purusa, the creator, I'he Vedic text says "Taisr.stva" (after creating it).

verses.sanskrit: एकदा तु समास्तीर्य चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् । आसनं परमं तस्मिन् स्थित्वा रुद्धेन्द्रियो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: ekadA tu samAstIrya chailAjinakushottaram | AsanaM paramaM tasmin sthitvA ruddhendriyo muniH
verses.translation: As the magician so also the Yogin has no illusion. Siva is of perfect knowledge and this is revealed by the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: समाधिमास्थाय सदा परमानन्दचिद्घनः । परिपूर्णः शिवोऽस्मीति निर्व्यग्रहृदयोऽभवम्
verses.transliteration: samAdhimAsthAya sadA paramAnandachidghanaH | paripUrNaH shivo.asmIti nirvyagrahR^idayo.abhavam
verses.translation: The five Saktis of Siva arc: activity, knowledge, completeness, elernality and pervasiveness. Even in their shrinking forms they shine always.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव समये मद्गुरुः करुणानिधिः । नीलजीमूतसङ्काशो विद्युत्पिङ्गजटाधरः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva samaye madguruH karuNAnidhiH | nIlajImUtasa~NkAsho vidyutpi~NgajaTAdharaH
verses.translation: There is a set of five Tattvas of the individual soul, viz, Kala, Vidya, Raga, Kala and Niyati. Kala is the cause of doing anything. Vidya is the means of certain Tattvas. Raga is the attachment to the sense-objects.

verses.sanskrit: इति चिन्तासमाविष्टा मुनयो मुनिपुङ्गवम् । व्यासं सम्पूज्य हृत्पद्मे तस्थुस्तद्दर्शनोत्सुकाः
verses.transliteration: iti chintAsamAviShTA munayo munipu~Ngavam | vyAsaM sampUjya hR^itpadme tasthustaddarshanotsukAH
verses.translation: Niyati means the factor that discriminates and ordains. "This shall be done and this.shall not be done by me.'* It is a §akti of the lord. Setting it at nought the individual soul falls.

verses.sanskrit: प्रांशुः कमण्डलूदण्डकृष्णाजिनधरः स्वयम् । भस्मावदातसर्वाङ्गः सर्वलक्षणलक्षितः
verses.transliteration: prAMshuH kamaNDalUdaNDakR^iShNAjinadharaH svayam | bhasmAvadAtasarvA~NgaH sarvalakShaNalakShitaH
verses.translation: You have mentioned before* that the Purusa is placed beneath the Niyati and is above Prakrii. How is it that you say now that it shrinks in form throtigh Maya and

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपुण्ड्रविलसद्भालो रुद्राक्षालङ्कृताकृतिः । पद्मपत्रारुणायामविस्तीर्णनयनद्वयः
verses.transliteration: tripuNDravilasadbhAlo rudrAkShAla~NkR^itAkR^itiH | padmapatrAruNAyAmavistIrNanayanadvayaH
verses.translation: Kailasa S. 13 31-

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्भूय हृदम्भोजे तदानीमेव सत्वरम् । विमोहितस्तदैवासमेतदद् भुतमास्तिकाः
verses.transliteration: prAdurbhUya hR^idambhoje tadAnImeva satvaram | vimohitastadaivAsametadad bhutamAstikAH
verses.translation: The omniscient, omnipotent, Siva, the Nirguna lord of all, the progenitor of the three deities, the Brahman, is formed of existence-knowledge-bliss.

verses.sanskrit: तत उन्मील्य नयने विलापं कृतवानहम् । आसीन्ममाश्रुपातश्च गिरिनिर्झरसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: tata unmIlya nayane vilApaM kR^itavAnaham | AsInmamAshrupAtashcha girinirjharasannibhaH
verses.translation: That lord Siva himself, out of his own will, through his own Maya appears shrinking in size and be¬ comes Puru§a.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव समये श्रुता वागशरीरिणी । व्योम्नो महाद्भुता विप्रास्तामेव शृणुतादरात्
verses.transliteration: etasminneva samaye shrutA vAgasharIriNI | vyomno mahAdbhutA viprAstAmeva shR^iNutAdarAt
verses.translation: The presence in two places of the Purusa is not incompatible. He is the composite of Jflana etc. of both shrinking and intrinsic forms.

verses.sanskrit: सूतपुत्र महाभाग गच्छ वाराणसीं पुरीम् । तत्रासन्मुनयः पूर्वमुपदिष्टास्त्वयाधुना
verses.transliteration: sUtaputra mahAbhAga gachCha vArANasIM purIm | tatrAsanmunayaH pUrvamupadiShTAstvayAdhunA
verses.translation: The principle of the mind Prakrti consists of Buddhi, Manas and Ahamkara achievable through the Gunas Sattva etc. The Gunas are born of the Prakrti, the Sattvaic from Sattva and so on. From the Gunas the intellect takes its origin. It is the cause of decisiveness in the objects.

verses.sanskrit: त्वदुपागमकल्याणं काङ्क्षन्ते विवशा भृशम् । तिष्ठन्ति ते निराहारा इत्युक्त्वा विरराम सा
verses.transliteration: tvadupAgamakalyANaM kA~NkShante vivashA bhR^isham | tiShThanti te nirAhArA ityuktvA virarAma sA
verses.translation: From Buddhi the principle of intellect is born and from it ego. From the ego the sense-organs of know¬ ledge. The mind has two aspects — thought and doubt.

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्थाय तरसा देवं देवीं च भक्तितः । प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य पुनः प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत्
verses.transliteration: tata utthAya tarasA devaM devIM cha bhaktitaH | pradakShiNIkR^itya punaH praNamya bhuvi daNDavat
verses.translation: The sense-organs are ears, skin, eyes, tongue and nose and the qualities particularly sensed through those organs are sound, touch, colour, taste and smell. The Tanmatras are born from the Vaikarika Aharhkara.

verses.sanskrit: द्विषड्वारं गुरोराज्ञां विज्ञाय शिवयोरथ । क्षेत्रान्निर्गत्य तरसा चत्वारिंशद्दिनान्तरे
verses.transliteration: dviShaDvAraM gurorAj~nAM vij~nAya shivayoratha | kShetrAnnirgatya tarasA chatvAriMshaddinAntare
verses.translation: They are called subtle principles by the sages. Now understand the organs of activity and their functions.

verses.sanskrit: आगतोऽस्मि मुनिश्रेष्ठा अनुगृह्णन्तु मामिह । मया किमद्य वक्तव्यं भवन्तस्तद् ब्रुवन्तु मे
verses.transliteration: Agato.asmi munishreShThA anugR^ihNantu mAmiha | mayA kimadya vaktavyaM bhavantastad bruvantu me
verses.translation: O sage, they are the organs of speech, hand, feet, anus, penis and the vaginal passage. Their functions are speaking, handling, moving, evacuation and the sexual pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरान्ते स पुनः काशीं प्राप महामुनिः । शिवभक्तिरतो ज्ञानी पुराणार्थप्रकाशकः
verses.transliteration: saMvatsarAnte sa punaH kAshIM prApa mahAmuniH | shivabhaktirato j~nAnI purANArthaprakAshakaH
verses.translation: The subtle elements originated in order from the

verses.sanskrit: इति सूतवचः श्रुत्वा ऋषयो हृष्टमानसाः । अवोचन्मुनिशार्दूलं व्यासं नत्वा मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: iti sUtavachaH shrutvA R^iShayo hR^iShTamAnasAH | avochanmunishArdUlaM vyAsaM natvA muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: From them arc born in order the ether, wind, fire, water and the earth, O sage, they are known as the five elements.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा सूतमायान्तं मुनयो हृष्टचेतसः । अभ्युत्थानासनार्घ्यादिपूजया समपूजयन्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA sUtamAyAntaM munayo hR^iShTachetasaH | abhyutthAnAsanArghyAdipUjayA samapUjayan
verses.translation: Their functions are giving space, blowing, cook¬ ing, force and supporting.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि तान्मुनिशार्दूलानभिनन्द्य स्मितोदरम् । प्रीत्या स्नात्वा जाह्नवीये जले परमपावने
verses.transliteration: so.api tAnmunishArdUlAnabhinandya smitodaram | prItyA snAtvA jAhnavIye jale paramapAvane
verses.translation: O Skanda, you have mentioned before that the elements were created from Kalas etc. How is it that it is

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीन्सन्तर्प्य च सुरान् पितॄंश्च तिलतण्डुलैः । तीरमागत्य सम्प्रोक्ष्य वाससी परिधाय च
verses.transliteration: R^iShInsantarpya cha surAn pitR^IMshcha tilataNDulaiH | tIramAgatya samprokShya vAsasI paridhAya cha
verses.translation: "The letter 'A' is the Atmatattva; the letter 'U' is 'Vidya; the letter 'Ma' is Sivatattva. O Vamadeva let this be thought over thus.

verses.sanskrit: द्विराचम्य समादाय भस्म सद्यादिमन्त्रतः । उद्धूलनादिक्रमतो विधार्याथ मुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: dvirAchamya samAdAya bhasma sadyAdimantrataH | uddhUlanAdikramato vidhAryAtha munIshvaraH
verses.translation: "The Bindu and Nada have essence of all the principles. O sage, listen now to what the deities therein are.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राक्षमालाभरणः कृतनित्यक्रियः सुधी । यथोक्ताङ्गेषु विधिना त्रिपुण्ड्रं रचति स्म ह
verses.transliteration: rudrAkShamAlAbharaNaH kR^itanityakriyaH sudhI | yathoktA~NgeShu vidhinA tripuNDraM rachati sma ha
verses.translation: They are Brahma, Visnu, Rudra, Mahesvara and Sadasiva. They are the images of Siva himself well known in the Vedas

verses.sanskrit: ६.११ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 6\.11 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O intelligent sage, listen with respect and attention. O sage, in accordance with the Vedic text "Tasmad Vai Etasmad" etc. it is certain that the five Bhutas are born of the Kalas. They are in the form of the gross cosmos. This explains the body of the lord ol Bhutas (Siva). In the order of the coming up of the Tattvas from Siva Tattva to the principle of the earth, O sage, they shall be mentioned as originating from the subtle elements in order.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O intelligent sage, listen with respect and attention. O sage, in accordance with the Vedic text "Tasmad Vai Etasmad" etc. it is certain that the five Bhutas are born of the Kalas. They are in the form of the gross cosmos. This explains the body of the lord ol Bhutas (Siva). In the order of the coming up of the Tattvas from Siva Tattva to the principle of the earth, O sage, they shall be mentioned as originating from the subtle elements in order.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ६.११. एकादशोऽयायः । वामदेवब्रह्मवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ सूत सूत महाभागः त्वमस्मद्गुरुरुत्तमः । अतस्त्वां परिपृच्छामो भवतोऽनुग्रहो यदि
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 6\.11\. ekAdasho.ayAyaH | vAmadevabrahmavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH || sUta sUta mahAbhAgaH tvamasmadgururuttamaH | atastvAM paripR^ichChAmo bhavato.anugraho yadi
verses.translation: There shall be identity between the subtle ele¬ ments and the Kalis as causes of the Bhutas. O excellent amAng those who know (he Brahman, know that there is no mutual antagonum here.

verses.sanskrit: वेदागमपुराणादिसर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्ववित् । देवासुरमनुष्यादिजीवानां जन्मकर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: vedAgamapurANAdisarvashAstrArthatattvavit | devAsuramanuShyAdijIvAnAM janmakarmavit
verses.translation: In the cosmos both subtle and gross are bom the planets: moon, sun stars, etc.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मावदातसर्वाङ्गो जटामण्डलमण्डितः । निराश्रयो निःस्पृहश्च निर्द्वन्द्वो निरहङ्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: bhasmAvadAtasarvA~Ngo jaTAmaNDalamaNDitaH | nirAshrayo niHspR^ihashcha nirdvandvo niraha~NkR^itiH
verses.translation: The deities Brahma, Vifhu, Mahe and others, the various living beings, Indra and other guardians of the quarters, gods, Pitfs Asuras, Rakfasas, human and other mobile beings, beasts, birds, worms, serpents, trees, hedges, creepers and herbs, the eight mountains,*** the seven rivers*** GaAgi and others, the oceans of great prosperity whatever object is there in the world all are established here.

verses.sanskrit: दिगम्बरो महाज्ञानी महेश्वर इवापरः । शिष्यभूतैर्मुनीन्द्रैश्च तादृशैः परिवारितः
verses.transliteration: digambaro mahAj~nAnI maheshvara ivAparaH | shiShyabhUtairmunIndraishcha tAdR^ishaiH parivAritaH
verses.translation: This universe of the form of female and male, of the form of iSiva and Sakti shall deserve attention of learned men like you, experts in the Saiva knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यटन्पृथिवीमेतां स्वपादस्पर्शपुण्यतः । पवित्रयन्परे धाम्नि निमग्नहृदयोऽन्वहम्
verses.transliteration: paryaTanpR^ithivImetAM svapAdasparshapuNyataH | pavitrayanpare dhAmni nimagnahR^idayo.anvaham
verses.translation: O sage, the Sruti says "Think that everything is Brahman, everything is Rudra." Thus Sadaiva is the Atman of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारशिखरं मेरोर्दक्षिणं प्राविशन्मुदा । यत्रास्ते भगवानीशतनयः शिखिवाहनः
verses.transliteration: kumArashikharaM merordakShiNaM prAvishanmudA | yatrAste bhagavAnIshatanayaH shikhivAhanaH
verses.translation: Due to the concept of thirty eight Kalas the concept of duality is ever present but he who has purified the Atman by the concept "I am Sadaiva" becomes the preceptor Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानशक्तिधरो वीरः सर्वासुरविमर्दनः । गजावल्लीसमायुक्तः सर्वैर्देवैर्नमस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnashaktidharo vIraH sarvAsuravimardanaH | gajAvallIsamAyuktaH sarvairdevairnamaskR^itaH
verses.translation: Such a disciple becomes the preceptor Siva himself. He attains the form of the Yantra, mantra and the cosmic deity itself.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्कन्दसरो नाम सरः सागरसन्निभम् । शिशिरस्वादुपानीयं स्वच्छागाधबहूदकम्
verses.transliteration: tatra skandasaro nAma saraH sAgarasannibham | shishirasvAdupAnIyaM svachChAgAdhabahUdakam
verses.translation: O Brahmin, the disciple whose bondage is severed due to the favour of the preceptor and who is engaged in Siva's worship becomes a lofty soul indeed.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाश्चर्यगुणोपेतं विद्यते स्वामिसन्निधौ । तत्र स्नात्वा वामदेवः सहशिष्यैर्महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: sarvAshcharyaguNopetaM vidyate svAmisannidhau | tatra snAtvA vAmadevaH sahashiShyairmahAmuniH
verses.translation: They say that whatever exists whether a composite unit or an analysed piece is the meaning of the Pranava in view of the predominence of the Guas.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारं शिखरासीनं मुनिवृन्दनिषेवितम् । उद्यदादित्यसङ्काशं मयूरवरवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: kumAraM shikharAsInaM munivR^indaniShevitam | udyadAdityasa~NkAshaM mayUravaravAhanam
verses.translation: Out of affection I have expiated the non-dualis-

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धालुषु च शिष्येषु त्वादृशा गुरवः सदा । स्निग्धभावा इतीदं नो दर्शितं भवताधुना
verses.transliteration: shraddhAluShu cha shiShyeShu tvAdR^ishA guravaH sadA | snigdhabhAvA itIdaM no darshitaM bhavatAdhunA
verses.translation: The eight principal mountains arc and 'TTfdrr I

verses.sanskrit: वरदाभयहस्तं च दृष्ट्वा स्कन्दं मुनीश्वरः । सम्पूज्य परया भक्त्या स्तोतुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: varadAbhayahastaM cha dR^iShTvA skandaM munIshvaraH | sampUjya parayA bhaktyA stotuM samupachakrame
verses.translation: If anyone whether a god or a human being, Siddha or Gandharva, out of arrogance considers this statement otherwise, I shall cut off his head evenly with my good trident which is like a black fire to the enemies.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेव उवाच । ॐ नमः प्रणवार्थाय प्रणवार्थविधायिने । प्रणवाक्षरबीजाय प्रण वाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: vAmadeva uvAcha | OM namaH praNavArthAya praNavArthavidhAyine | praNavAkSharabIjAya praNa vAya namo namaH
verses.translation: O sage, you yourself are the most excellent of tnose who know the non-dualistic nature of Siva. You are the guide for good behaviour on the occasion of the instruction of Saivite knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: वेदान्तार्थस्वरूपाय वेदान्तार्थविधायिने । वेदान्तार्थविदे नित्यं विदिताय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: vedAntArthasvarUpAya vedAntArthavidhAyine | vedAntArthavide nityaM viditAya namo namaH
verses.translation: An impious ghost got his sins removed by the contact with the ashes on your body. By your grace he attained the supreme goal.

verses.sanskrit: नमो गुहाय भूतानां गुहासु निहिताय च । गुह्याय गुह्यरूपाय गुह्यागमविदे नमः
verses.transliteration: namo guhAya bhUtAnAM guhAsu nihitAya cha | guhyAya guhyarUpAya guhyAgamavide namaH
verses.translation: You are a Siva yogin, an asset to the three worlds. At your benign glance even the individual soul becomes the supreme soul.

verses.sanskrit: अणोरणीयसे तुभ्यं महतोऽपि महीयसे । नमः परावरज्ञाय परमात्मस्वरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: aNoraNIyase tubhyaM mahato.api mahIyase | namaH parAvaraj~nAya paramAtmasvarUpiNe
verses.translation: This great secret is founded in you. You too, abide by the Pranavas alone with respect, faith and devotion and unite them with ParameSvara helping people grasp Saivite conduct including Bhasma and Rudraksa.

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दाय स्कन्दरूपाय मिहिरारुणतेजसे । नमो मन्दारमालोद्यन्मुकुटादिभृते सदा
verses.transliteration: skandAya skandarUpAya mihirAruNatejase | namo mandAramAlodyanmukuTAdibhR^ite sadA
verses.translation: You are iSiva indeed. You follow Saivite conduct and have understood the concept of non-dualism Wandering about for the welfare of the world you will attain an everlasting happiness.

verses.sanskrit: शिवशिष्याय पुत्राय शिवस्य शिवदायिने । शिवप्रियाय शिवयोरानन्दनिधये नमः
verses.transliteration: shivashiShyAya putrAya shivasya shivadAyine | shivapriyAya shivayorAnandanidhaye namaH
verses.translation: After hearing this wonderful cult of Vedanta, explained by Karttikeya the sage became very humble. He bowed many times and prostrated before him. He behaved like a bee hovering round his lotus-like feet.

verses.sanskrit: गाङ्गेयाय नमस्तुभ्यं कार्तिकेयाय धीमते । उमापुत्राय महते शरकाननशायिने
verses.transliteration: gA~NgeyAya namastubhyaM kArtikeyAya dhImate | umAputrAya mahate sharakAnanashAyine
verses.translation: On hearing these words, pregnant with love, of the sages, the delighted Suta, the scholar whose mind is attached to Siva, spoke to them.

verses.sanskrit: षडक्षरशरीराय षड्विधार्थविधायिने । षडध्वातीतरूपाय षण्मुखाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: ShaDakSharasharIrAya ShaDvidhArthavidhAyine | ShaDadhvAtItarUpAya ShaNmukhAya namo namaH
verses.translation: You are all blessed. You are the devotees of lord Siva You help all the worlds, O sages, you hear further their conversation.

verses.sanskrit: विरजाहोमसमये वामदेवमतं पुरा । सूचितं भवतास्माभिर्न श्रुतं विस्तरान्मुने
verses.transliteration: virajAhomasamaye vAmadevamataM purA | sUchitaM bhavatAsmAbhirna shrutaM vistarAnmune
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Karttikeya, that quell dualism and produce non-dualistic knowledge the sage be¬ came delighted.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजाय शान्ताय शक्तिकुक्कुटधारिणे । वरदाभयहस्ताय नमोऽसुरविदारिणे
verses.transliteration: chaturbhujAya shAntAya shaktikukkuTadhAriNe | varadAbhayahastAya namo.asuravidAriNe
verses.translation: After bowing to Karttikeya, son of Siva and eulogising him in various ways the great sage asked him again regarding the principles, with great humility.

verses.sanskrit: गजावल्लीकुचालिप्तकुङ्कुमाङ्कितवक्षसे । नमो गजाननानन्दमहिमानन्दितात्मने
verses.transliteration: gajAvallIkuchAliptaku~NkumA~NkitavakShase | namo gajAnanAnandamahimAnanditAtmane
verses.translation: O lord Karttikeya, O ocean of nectar, O knower of all principles, how can the ascetics ot purified souls attain the position of a preceptor?

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिदेवमुनिकिन्नरगीयमान-गाथाविशेषशुचिचिन्तितकीर्त्तिधाम्ने । वृन्दारकामलकिरीटविभूषणस्रक्-पूज्याभिरामपदपङ्कज ते नमोऽस्तु
verses.transliteration: brahmAdidevamunikinnaragIyamAna\-gAthAvisheShashuchichintitakIrttidhAmne | vR^indArakAmalakirITavibhUShaNasrak\-pUjyAbhirAmapadapa~Nkaja te namo.astu
verses.translation: They cannot have the authority to instruct with¬ out a tradition following which the individual souls attain worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: इति स्कन्दस्तवं दिव्यं वामदेवेन भाषितम् । यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: iti skandastavaM divyaM vAmadevena bhAShitam | yaH paThechChR^iNuyAdvApi sa yAti paramAM gatim
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vamadeva Karttikeya began to explain after thinking upon Siva and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: महाप्रज्ञाकरं ह्येतच्छिवभक्तिविवर्द्धनम् । आयुरारोग्यधनकृत्सर्व्वकामप्रदं सदा
verses.transliteration: mahApraj~nAkaraM hyetachChivabhaktivivarddhanam | AyurArogyadhanakR^itsarvvakAmapradaM sadA
verses.translation: I shall explain Yogapa((a whereby one attains the state of a preceptor. It is a great secret that yields salvation and O Vamadeva, it is due to my affection to you that I mention it to you.

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुत्वा वामदेवो देवं सेनापतिं प्रभुम् । प्रदक्षिणात्रयं कृत्वा प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत्
verses.transliteration: iti stutvA vAmadevo devaM senApatiM prabhum | pradakShiNAtrayaM kR^itvA praNamya bhuvi daNDavat
verses.translation: O sage, the preceptor shall grasp the disciple with his hands and make him sit facing east on a well deco¬ rated platform on a pure excellent seat — a cloth, a deerskin or Darbha grass. The disciple shall be wrapped in the cloth.

verses.sanskrit: साष्टाङ्गं च पुनः कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणनमस्कृतम् । अभवत्पार्श्वतस्तस्य विनयावनतो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sAShTA~NgaM cha punaH kR^itvA pradakShiNanamaskR^itam | abhavatpArshvatastasya vinayAvanato dvijAH
verses.translation: Then he shall take a conch with its stand and purify it with Astra mantra. He shall then place it in front of him on a favourable position.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवकृतं स्तोत्रं परमार्थविजृम्भितम् । श्रुत्वाभवत्प्रसन्नो हि महेश्वरसुतः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: vAmadevakR^itaM stotraM paramArthavijR^imbhitam | shrutvAbhavatprasanno hi maheshvarasutaH prabhuH
verses.translation: After worshipping the conch with its pedestal with flowers he shall pour pure water into it sanctified by Astra and Varma mantras.

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाच महासेनः प्रीतोऽस्मि तव पूजया । भक्त्या स्तुत्या च भद्रं ते किमद्य करवाण्यहम्
verses.transliteration: tamuvAcha mahAsenaH prIto.asmi tava pUjayA | bhaktyA stutyA cha bhadraM te kimadya karavANyaham
verses.translation: After filling it, it shall be worshipped again in the manner mentioned in Saaiiga Puja. Then he shall repeat the Pranava seven times.

verses.sanskrit: तदिदानीं श्रोतुकामाः श्रद्धया परमादरात् । वयं सर्वे कृपासिन्धो प्रीत्या तद्वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tadidAnIM shrotukAmAH shraddhayA paramAdarAt | vayaM sarve kR^ipAsindho prItyA tadvaktumarhasi
verses.translation: He shall worship it with scents and flowers and show lights and incense. He shall then cover up the conch with Astra and Varma mantras.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि धर्मरक्षायै लोकानुग्रहकाङ्क्षया । त्वादृशाः साधवः सन्तो विचरन्ति महीतले
verses.transliteration: tathApi dharmarakShAyai lokAnugrahakA~NkShayA | tvAdR^ishAH sAdhavaH santo vicharanti mahItale
verses.translation: He shall then show the mystic gestures of the cow and conch. In a pvire spot to the south of the conch and in front of him he shall make a beautiful and auspi¬ cious Mandala according to the rules of worship and worship it with sweet scents and flowers.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोतव्यमस्ति चेद् ब्रह्मन् वक्तुमर्हसि साम्प्रतम् । तदिदानीमहं वक्ष्ये लोकानुग्रहहेतवे
verses.transliteration: shrotavyamasti ched brahman vaktumarhasi sAmpratam | tadidAnImahaM vakShye lokAnugrahahetave
verses.translation: Sec P. 1688 ncte no.

verses.sanskrit: इति स्कन्दवचः श्रुत्वा वामदेवो महामुनिः । प्रश्रयावनतः प्राह मेघगम्भीरया गिरा
verses.transliteration: iti skandavachaH shrutvA vAmadevo mahAmuniH | prashrayAvanataH prAha meghagambhIrayA girA
verses.translation: That pot shall be decorated and embellished with cloths, mango leaves, Durva grass, coconut flowers and other articles.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेव उवाच । भगवन्परमेशस्त्वं परापरविभूतिदः । सर्वज्ञः सर्वकर्त्ता च सर्वशक्तिधरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: vAmadeva uvAcha | bhagavanparameshastvaM parAparavibhUtidaH | sarvaj~naH sarvakarttA cha sarvashaktidharaH prabhuH
verses.translation: O great sage, he shall put five gems into the pot or if they are not available he shall put gold into it.

verses.sanskrit: जीवा वयं तु ते वक्तुं सन्निधौ परमेशितुः । तथाप्यनुग्रहोऽयं ते यत्त्वं वदसि मां प्रति
verses.transliteration: jIvA vayaM tu te vaktuM sannidhau parameshituH | tathApyanugraho.ayaM te yattvaM vadasi mAM prati
verses.translation: The five gems are: amethyst, ruby, gold ingot, coral and onyx.

verses.sanskrit: कृतार्थोऽहं महाप्राज्ञ विज्ञानकणमात्रतः । प्रेरितः परिपृच्छामि क्षन्तव्योऽतिक्रमो मम
verses.transliteration: kR^itArtho.ahaM mahAprAj~na vij~nAnakaNamAtrataH | preritaH paripR^ichChAmi kShantavyo.atikramo mama
verses.translation: After uttering the mystic syllables 'Nrmlaskam'* and "Glum" in the end he shall perform worship in a favour¬ able manner in accordance with the rules.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवो हि परः साक्षात्परमेश्वरवाचकः । वाच्यः पशुपतिर्देवः पशूनां पाशमोचकः
verses.transliteration: praNavo hi paraH sAkShAtparameshvaravAchakaH | vAchyaH pashupatirdevaH pashUnAM pAshamochakaH
verses.translation: He shall invoke the lord along the path of five coverings in the manner prescribed for sacrifices, beginning with Adhara l§akti and then worship.

verses.sanskrit: वाचकेन समाहूतः पशून्मोचयते क्षणात् । तस्माद्वाचकतासिद्धिः प्रणवेन शिवम्प्रति
verses.transliteration: vAchakena samAhUtaH pashUnmochayate kShaNAt | tasmAdvAchakatAsiddhiH praNavena shivamprati
verses.translation: He shall offer milk pudding and cooked rice as Naivedya and the betel leaves as before. After the adoration with the repetitions of eight names, the other mantras shall be chanted.

verses.sanskrit: ओमितीदं सर्वमिति श्रुतिराह सनातनी । ओमिति ब्रह्म सर्वं हि ब्रह्मेति च समब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: omitIdaM sarvamiti shrutirAha sanAtanI | omiti brahma sarvaM hi brahmeti cha samabravIt
verses.translation: Pranava shall be repeated hundred and eight times. The five Brahmans beginning with Sadyojata and ending with Iana shall be meditated upon. It shall be covered with Astra and Varma mantras. Incense and lights shall be waved with devotion. He shall then show the mystic gestures of cow and the vaginal passage clearly.

verses.sanskrit: इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा सूतो हृष्टतनूरुहः । नमस्कृत्य महादेवं गुरोः परतरं गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: iti teShAM vachaH shrutvA sUto hR^iShTatanUruhaH | namaskR^itya mahAdevaM guroH parataraM gurum
verses.translation: The preceptor shall then cover the vessel on the top with the Darbha grass. He shall then make a square to the northeast of the Mandala.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्थिते जगत्यस्मिन् शिवादन्यन्न विद्यते । सर्वरूपधरः स्वामी शिवो व्यापी महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evaM sthite jagatyasmin shivAdanyanna vidyate | sarvarUpadharaH svAmI shivo vyApI maheshvaraH
verses.translation: Then a beautiful seat shall be put over the square in accordance with the rules. He shall then make the boy disciple sit on it in a comfortable posture.

verses.sanskrit: समष्टिव्यष्टिभावेन प्रणवार्थः श्रुतो मया । न जातुचिन्महासेन सम्प्राप्तस्त्वादृशो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: samaShTivyaShTibhAvena praNavArthaH shruto mayA | na jAtuchinmahAsena samprAptastvAdR^isho guruH
verses.translation: The preceptor shall raise the vessel. Repeating "Svasti" he shall pour water on the head of the disciple making a circle with the inverted pot.

verses.sanskrit: अतः कृत्वानुकम्पां वै तमर्थं वक्तुमर्हसि । उपदेशविधानेन सदाचारक्रमेण च
verses.transliteration: ataH kR^itvAnukampAM vai tamarthaM vaktumarhasi | upadeshavidhAnena sadAchArakrameNa cha
verses.translation: After uttering the Pranava once first and then seven times with the names of five Brahmans he shall en¬ circle him at the end of the ablution with the water from the conch.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाम्येकः सर्वजन्तूनां पाशच्छेदकरो गुरुः । अतस्त्वत्कृपया सोऽर्थः श्रोतव्यो हि मया गुरो
verses.transliteration: svAmyekaH sarvajantUnAM pAshachChedakaro guruH | atastvatkR^ipayA so.arthaH shrotavyo hi mayA guro
verses.translation: After the rite of waving the charming light he shall wipe him with a towel The disciple shall be made

verses.sanskrit: इति स मुनिना पृष्टः स्कन्दः प्रणम्य सदाशिवं-प्रणववपुषं साष्टत्रिंशत्कलावरलक्षितम् । सहितमुमया शश्वत्पार्श्वे मुनिप्रवरान्वितं-गदितुमुपचक्राम श्रेयः श्रुतिष्वपि गोपितम्
verses.transliteration: iti sa muninA pR^iShTaH skandaH praNamya sadAshivaM\-praNavavapuShaM sAShTatriMshatkalAvaralakShitam | sahitamumayA shashvatpArshve munipravarAnvitaM\-gaditumupachakrAma shreyaH shrutiShvapi gopitam
verses.translation: The feet shall be washed and Acamana per¬ formed twice. Holding the ashes in his hands the preceptor shall smear it over the body of the disciple who is led into the Mancjiapa and comfortably seated.

verses.sanskrit: महादेवीं त्रिजननीं गुरुं व्यासं च भक्तितः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा मुनीनाह्लादयन्निदम्
verses.transliteration: mahAdevIM trijananIM guruM vyAsaM cha bhaktitaH | prAha gambhIrayA vAchA munInAhlAdayannidam
verses.translation: The precep or shall be seated with the disciple facing the cast and desirous of spiritual knowledge. The preceptor shall tell him — "Be pure in soul."

verses.sanskrit: पुरा रथन्तरे कल्पे वामदेवो महामुनिः । गर्भमुक्तः शिवज्ञानविदां गुरुतमः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: purA rathantare kalpe vAmadevo mahAmuniH | garbhamuktaH shivaj~nAnavidAM gurutamaH svayam
verses.translation: He shall sit steady in a trance for a short while thinking "I am the preceptor — Siva. He shall open his eyes with the mind favourably disposed towards him and without xcitement glance at the pupil who is sitting with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं मुकुटादिविभूषितम् । शक्तिरत्नद्वयोपास्यं शक्तिकुक्कुटधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: chaturbhujamudArA~NgaM mukuTAdivibhUShitam | shaktiratnadvayopAsyaM shaktikukkuTadhAriNam
verses.translation: With his hand smeared with the ashes he shall touch the head of the pupil and instruct in his right ear clearly "Hamsah Soham.*'

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशायतनेत्राय द्वादशोद्यतबाहवे । द्वादशायुधधाराय द्वादशात्मन्नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: dvAdashAyatanetrAya dvAdashodyatabAhave | dvAdashAyudhadhArAya dvAdashAtmannamo.astu te
verses.translation: "The first Ham means Sakti-Soul. Sail means Siva. I am he alone." Thus he shall reveal the meaning.

verses.sanskrit: मुने त्वं योगिनां मुख्यः परिपूर्णश्च निःस्पृहः । भवादृशां हि लोकेस्मिप्रार्थनीयं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: mune tvaM yoginAM mukhyaH paripUrNashcha niHspR^ihaH | bhavAdR^ishAM hi lokesmiprArthanIyaM na vidyate
verses.translation: After instructing him in the meaning of 'Yah Anu* he shall express clearly the meaning and purport of the statements in the middle. He shall tell him clearly, "O Brahmin, I shall tell you the statements. Listen and retain them in your mind."

verses.sanskrit: देवसेनापते तुभ्यं देवानाम्पतये नमः । नमो यतीनां पतये परिपूर्णाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: devasenApate tubhyaM devAnAmpataye namaH | namo yatInAM pataye paripUrNAya te namaH
verses.translation: The meaning of the statement — "Perfect knowledge is Brahman" has already been made known. Paramesvara the Sakti-soul is the meaning of the word Aham.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । स्वस्त्यस्तु मुनयः सर्वे सुखिनः सन्तु सर्वदा । शिवभक्ताः स्थिरात्मानः शिवभक्तिप्रवर्तकाः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | svastyastu munayaH sarve sukhinaH santu sarvadA | shivabhaktAH sthirAtmAnaH shivabhaktipravartakAH
verses.translation: 'A' is the foremost among all letters. It is the greatest splendour 'Siva'. The letter Ha is of the form of firmament. It is glorified as the akti-soul.

verses.sanskrit: तदतीव विचित्रं हि श्रुतं गुरुमुखाम्बुजात् । इतः पूर्वं मया नोक्तं गुह्यप्राकट्यशङ्कया
verses.transliteration: tadatIva vichitraM hi shrutaM gurumukhAmbujAt | itaH pUrvaM mayA noktaM guhyaprAkaTyasha~NkayA
verses.translation: That has been taught before. The devotee shall meditate "I am he" "That you arc;" in this the meaning of "That" has already been explained.

verses.sanskrit: यूयं खलु महाभागाः शिवभक्ता दृढव्रताः । इति निश्चित्य युष्माकं वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां मुदा
verses.transliteration: yUyaM khalu mahAbhAgAH shivabhaktA dR^iDhavratAH | iti nishchitya yuShmAkaM vakShyAmi shrUyatAM mudA
verses.translation: Otherwise there is a likelihood of opposite con¬ ception in "I am he" whereas the word "I" is in the mascu¬ line, the word "That" is in the neuter. Hence due to the in¬ compatibility they cannot be interpreted together. The cause of the universe, of male and female forms, cannot be otherwise. The concept of the meaning of the instruction is: "Thou art that."

verses.sanskrit: ६.१२ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 6\.12 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: In the statement "It is other than what is

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: In the statement "It is other than what is

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ६.१२. द्वादशोऽध्यायः । संन्यासविधिवर्णनम् । श्रीब्रह्मण्य उवाच । साधुसाधु महाभाग वामदेव मुनीश्वर । त्वमतीव शिवे भक्तः शिवज्ञानवतां वरः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 6\.12\. dvAdasho.adhyAyaH | sa.nnyAsavidhivarNanam | shrIbrahmaNya uvAcha | sAdhusAdhu mahAbhAga vAmadeva munIshvara | tvamatIva shive bhaktaH shivaj~nAnavatAM varaH
verses.translation: ' This is your soul, the immanent, and the imm¬

verses.sanskrit: यो वै मुमुक्षुभिर्ध्येयः शम्भुराकाशमध्यगः । सर्वव्यापी प्रकाशात्मा भासरूपो हि चिन्मयः
verses.transliteration: yo vai mumukShubhirdhyeyaH shambhurAkAshamadhyagaH | sarvavyApI prakAshAtmA bhAsarUpo hi chinmayaH
verses.translation: Verily the Vedas mention lord Siva as golden. "Goldcn-armcd" refers to his limbs being golden. Otherwise the lordship cannot be his. In the Chandogya also in the passage "He who is in Jiiva" is mentioned with golden moustache, golden tresses. Everywhere from the nail till the hair he is golden.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य पुंसः परा शक्तिर्भावगम्या मनोहरा । निर्गुणा स्वगुणैरेव निगूढा निष्कला शिवा
verses.transliteration: yasya puMsaH parA shaktirbhAvagamyA manoharA | nirguNA svaguNaireva nigUDhA niShkalA shivA
verses.translation: I shall tell you me purport of the statement "I am the great Brahman". Please listen.

verses.sanskrit: तदीयं त्रिविधं रूपं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं परं ततः । ध्येयं मुमुक्षुभिर्नित्यं क्रमतो योगिभिर्मुने
verses.transliteration: tadIyaM trividhaM rUpaM sthUlaM sUkShmaM paraM tataH | dhyeyaM mumukShubhirnityaM kramato yogibhirmune
verses.translation: He is mentioned as the great Brahman, most sublime and the soul of all: "Para, Apara, Paratpara." The words Rudra, Brahma and Visnu arc mentioned in the Vedas. The lord is greater than these. This is indicated by the word 'Para'.

verses.sanskrit: निष्कलः सर्वदेवानामादिदेवः सनातनः । ज्ञानक्रियास्वभावो यः परमात्मेति गीयते
verses.transliteration: niShkalaH sarvadevAnAmAdidevaH sanAtanaH | j~nAnakriyAsvabhAvo yaH paramAtmeti gIyate
verses.translation: By pondering over and practising the words of the Vedas, Sastras and the preceptor, Siva, the blissful lord appears in the heart of the pupil.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवाधिदेवस्य मूर्त्तिः साक्षात्सदाशिवः । पञ्चमन्त्रतनुर्देवः कलापञ्चकविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: tasya devAdhidevasya mUrttiH sAkShAtsadAshivaH | pa~nchamantratanurdevaH kalApa~nchakavigrahaH
verses.translation: O sage, the §ruti says that it has originated from Siva's mouth. am the soul of all", because the great qualities are ever present in me.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशः प्रसन्नः शीतलद्युतिः । पञ्चवक्त्रो दशभुजस्त्रिपञ्चनयनः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshaH prasannaH shItaladyutiH | pa~nchavaktro dashabhujastripa~nchanayanaH prabhuH
verses.translation: "I am without a second" because there is no other Atman distinct from the self. The statement "indeed all this is Brahman" has been explained before.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानमुकुटोपेतः पुरुषास्यः पुरातनः । अघोरहृदयो वामदेवगुह्यप्रदेशवान्
verses.transliteration: IshAnamukuTopetaH puruShAsyaH purAtanaH | aghorahR^idayo vAmadevaguhyapradeshavAn
verses.translation: I am complete because of my positive aspect. I am ever liberated. All the souls resorting to my nature are liberated due to my grace.

verses.sanskrit: सद्यपादश्च तन्मूर्त्तिः साक्षात्सकलनिष्कलः । सर्व्वज्ञत्वादिषट्शक्तिषडङ्गीकृतविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: sadyapAdashcha tanmUrttiH sAkShAtsakalaniShkalaH | sarvvaj~natvAdiShaTshaktiShaDa~NgIkR^itavigrahaH
verses.translation: "I am he who is Siva, the soul of all and identical with all. I am Harhsa. I am Siva.** This is the meaning of all statements, O Vamadeva, as mentioned by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दादिशक्तिस्फुरितहृत्पङ्कजविराजितः । स्वशक्त्या वामभागे तु मनोन्मन्या विभूषितः
verses.transliteration: shabdAdishaktisphuritahR^itpa~NkajavirAjitaH | svashaktyA vAmabhAge tu manonmanyA vibhUShitaH
verses.translation: The preceptor shall communicate to the pupil the meaning as declared by Siva and explained in the Vedic passages. It establishes the identity of men with Siva Himself.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया त्वविदितं किञ्चिन्नास्ति लोकेषु कुत्रचित् । तथापि तव वक्ष्यामि लोकानुग्रहकारिणः
verses.transliteration: tvayA tvaviditaM ki~nchinnAsti lokeShu kutrachit | tathApi tava vakShyAmi lokAnugrahakAriNaH
verses.translation: He shall then take the conch with the pedestal and purify it with Bhasma and the Astra mantra. He shall put it before the disciple on the square and worship it.

verses.sanskrit: उपदेशक्रमो ह्यादौ वक्तव्यः श्रूयतामयम् । चातुर्व्वर्ण्यं हि लोकेस्मिन्प्रसिद्धम्मानुषे मुने
verses.transliteration: upadeshakramo hyAdau vaktavyaH shrUyatAmayam | chAturvvarNyaM hi lokesminprasiddhammAnuShe mune
verses.translation: He shall worship it with scents repeating Om. It shall be filled with scented water invoked by Astra mantra and filtered with a cloth. It shall be worshipped with the Pranava Om.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैवर्णिकानामेवात्र श्रुत्याचारसमन्वयः । शुश्रूषामात्रसारा हि शूद्राः श्रुतिबहिष्कृताः
verses.transliteration: traivarNikAnAmevAtra shrutyAchArasamanvayaH | shushrUShAmAtrasArA hi shUdrAH shrutibahiShkR^itAH
verses.translation: It shall be worshipped repeating Om seven times. He who makes the slightest slip has to face the greatest terror. So says the Sruti. He shall then address the disciple himself, "Be steady-minded and fearless". Medita¬ ting on the lord he shall continue the worship.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैवर्णिकानां सर्वेषां स्वस्वाश्रमरतात्मनाम् । श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितो धर्मोऽनुष्ठेयो नापरः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: traivarNikAnAM sarveShAM svasvAshramaratAtmanAm | shrutismR^ityudito dharmo.anuShTheyo nAparaH kvachit
verses.translation: He shall worship the seat, of the disciple with the rite of "Sadutthapana." After conceiving Siva's seat he shall instal an idol of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं कर्म कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यति । इत्युक्तं परमेशेन वेदमार्गप्रदर्शिना
verses.transliteration: shrutismR^ityuditaM karma kurvansiddhimavApsyati | ityuktaM parameshena vedamArgapradarshinA
verses.translation: He shall fix on the head and the body of the disciple, the five Brahmans, beginning with the head and

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाचारपुण्यैरभ्यर्च्य परमेश्वरम् । तत्सायुज्यं गताः सर्वे बहवो मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: varNAshramAchArapuNyairabhyarchya parameshvaram | tatsAyujyaM gatAH sarve bahavo munisattamAH
verses.translation: He shall then jjerform the Nyasa of the limbs. The sixteen forms'** of ancillary services beginning with the offer¬ ing of the scat shall also be performed.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्येण मुनयो देवा यज्ञक्रियाध्वना । पितरः प्रजया तृप्ता इति हि श्रुतिरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: brahmacharyeNa munayo devA yaj~nakriyAdhvanA | pitaraH prajayA tR^iptA iti hi shrutirabravIt
verses.translation: Milk pudding shall be offered as Naivedya repeat¬ ing Om Svaha. The rites of offering water for gargling and Acamana, Arghya, incense, lights etc. shall also be performed.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ऋणत्रयान्मुक्तो वानप्रस्थाश्रमं गतः । शीतोष्णसुखदुःखादिसहिष्णुर्विजितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: evaM R^iNatrayAnmukto vAnaprasthAshramaM gataH | shItoShNasukhaduHkhAdisahiShNurvijitendriyaH
verses.translation: After worshipping with the eight names he shall perform the Japa along with brahmins well-versed in the Vedas. Passages from the Srutis: "The knower of Brah¬ man attains.." "Bhrgu the son of Varuna" "He who of gods"'*' and ending with ''He who is the greatest is Mahes- vara" shall be recited. Taking a garland of Kalhara flowers he shall stand up and recite the "Siddhi Skandha" section in the Paficasika Text of Srivirupak$a. Thereafter thinking thus "This is my fame. I am complete" and feeling favourably disposed towards him the preceptor shall put the garland round the neck of the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: तपस्वी विजिताहारो यमाद्यं योगमभ्यसेत् । यथा दृढतरा बुद्धिरविचाल्या भवेत्तथा
verses.transliteration: tapasvI vijitAhAro yamAdyaM yogamabhyaset | yathA dR^iDhatarA buddhiravichAlyA bhavettathA
verses.translation: The caste mark on the forehead and the appli¬ cation of the unguent over the body shall be carried out in accordance with his cultural custom.

verses.sanskrit: एवं क्रमेण शुद्धात्मा सर्वकर्म्माणि विन्यसेत् । संन्यस्य सर्वकर्म्माणि ज्ञानपूजापरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM krameNa shuddhAtmA sarvakarmmANi vinyaset | sa.nnyasya sarvakarmmANi j~nAnapUjAparo bhavet
verses.translation: The preceptor shall assign a name to him prefixed with the title iSripada. He shall offer him an umbrella and sandals. He shall delegate to him the power of oratory, authorise him to accept scat in front since the disciple has now become Siva himself. He shall tell him to be conscious that he is §iva. The preceptor shall make obeisance in accordance with the tradition in the cult.

verses.sanskrit: लोकेऽस्मिन्पशवः सर्वे नानाशास्त्रविमोहिताः । वञ्चिताः परमेशस्य माययातिविचित्रया
verses.transliteration: loke.asminpashavaH sarve nAnAshAstravimohitAH | va~nchitAH parameshasya mAyayAtivichitrayA
verses.translation: When the disciple has finished the customary obeisance he shall stand humbly and silently like a well be¬ haved disciple. The preceptor shall tell him like this.

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रकारमहं वक्ष्ये लोकानुग्रहकाम्यया । तव स्तेहान्महाप्राज्ञ सावधानतया शृणु
verses.transliteration: tatprakAramahaM vakShye lokAnugrahakAmyayA | tava stehAnmahAprAj~na sAvadhAnatayA shR^iNu
verses.translation: *'From now onwards be engaged in blessing the worlds. Accept a disciple only after testing him for a year. Accept him duly.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञं वेदान्तज्ञानपारगम् । आचार्यमुपगच्छेत्स यतिर्मतिमतां वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvashAstrArthatattvaj~naM vedAntaj~nAnapAragam | AchAryamupagachChetsa yatirmatimatAM varam
verses.translation: Eschew the faults of lust etc. and be devoted to meditation on Siva. Associate with those who have inherited good tradition and not with others.

verses.sanskrit: तत्समीपमुपव्रज्य यथाविधि विचक्षणः । दीर्घदण्डप्रणामाद्यैस्तोषयेद्यत्नतः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tatsamIpamupavrajya yathAvidhi vichakShaNaH | dIrghadaNDapraNAmAdyaistoShayedyatnataH sudhIH
verses.translation: Till the end of your life never take food without worshipping Siva. Abiding by your devotion to the precep¬ tor be happy, be happy."

verses.sanskrit: यो गुरुः स शिवः प्रोक्तो यः शिवः स गुरुः स्मृतः । इति निश्चित्य मनसा स्वविचारं निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: yo guruH sa shivaH prokto yaH shivaH sa guruH smR^itaH | iti nishchitya manasA svavichAraM nivedayet
verses.translation: In this manner the excellent preceptor, sympathetic and scholarly, shall be favourably inclined towards the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: लब्धानुज्ञस्तु गुरुणा द्वादशाहं पयोव्रती । शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्थ्यां वा दशम्यां वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: labdhAnuj~nastu guruNA dvAdashAhaM payovratI | shuklapakShe chaturthyAM vA dashamyAM vA vidhAnataH
verses.translation: O Vamadeva, O great sage, out of affection for you the mode of the consecration of the disciple has been mentioned to you though it is a great secret.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः स्नात्वा विशुद्धात्मा कृतनित्यक्रियः सुधीः । गुरुमाहूय विधिना नान्दीश्राद्धं समारभेत्
verses.transliteration: prAtaH snAtvA vishuddhAtmA kR^itanityakriyaH sudhIH | gurumAhUya vidhinA nAndIshrAddhaM samArabhet
verses.translation: After saying this Karttikeya narrated the procedure of hair-cutting and ablution in detail intending to favour the ascetics (anxious to hear him).

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवाः सत्यवसुसंज्ञावन्तः प्रकीर्तिताः । देवश्राद्धे ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाः कथितास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: vishvedevAH satyavasusa.nj~nAvantaH prakIrtitAH | devashrAddhe brahmaviShNumaheshAH kathitAstrayaH
verses.translation: O sage Vamadeva I shall now explain the rules of hair-cutting and ablution. These if performed immediately are conducive to great purity of the ascetic.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिश्राद्धे तु सम्प्रोक्ता देवक्षेत्रमनुष्यजाः । देवश्राद्धे तु वसुरुद्रादित्याः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: R^iShishrAddhe tu samproktA devakShetramanuShyajAH | devashrAddhe tu vasurudrAdityAH samprakIrtitAH
verses.translation: O sage, after the consecration as a disciple he shall observe the other rites and get ready for the tonsorial ceremony.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारो मानुषश्राद्धे सनकाद्या मुनीश्वराः । भूतश्राद्धे पञ्च महाभूतानि च ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: chatvAro mAnuShashrAddhe sanakAdyA munIshvarAH | bhUtashrAddhe pa~ncha mahAbhUtAni cha tataH param
verses.translation: He shall bow to the preceptor and secure permission

verses.sanskrit: न जानति परं साक्षात्प्रणवार्थं महेश्वरम् । सगुणं निर्गुणं ब्रह्म त्रिदेवजनकं परम्
verses.transliteration: na jAnati paraM sAkShAtpraNavArthaM maheshvaram | saguNaM nirguNaM brahma tridevajanakaM param
verses.translation: After that he shall wash the cloth, the razor etc. with water and clay. The barber also shall be given clay and asked to wash his hands.

verses.sanskrit: मातृश्राद्धे मातृपितामह्यौ च प्रपितामही । आत्मश्राद्धे तु चत्वार आत्मा पितृपितामहौ
verses.transliteration: mAtR^ishrAddhe mAtR^ipitAmahyau cha prapitAmahI | AtmashrAddhe tu chatvAra AtmA pitR^ipitAmahau
verses.translation: Repeating "Sivam** *'l§ivam" he shall sprinkle every object with water. He shall then close his eyes with the ring-finger and the thumb. Repeating the Astra mantra he shall open his eyes and look at the razor and other imp¬ lements of tonsorial rite. Repeating the mantra twelve times he shall sprinkle them with the Astra mantra.

verses.sanskrit: प्रपितामहनामा च सपत्नीकाः प्रकीर्तिताः । मातामहात्मकश्राद्धे त्रयो मातामहादयः
verses.transliteration: prapitAmahanAmA cha sapatnIkAH prakIrtitAH | mAtAmahAtmakashrAddhe trayo mAtAmahAdayaH
verses.translation: He shall take the razor and cut off a patch of hair on the right side. Then a few hair on the front, then the entire hair shall be shaved off.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिश्राद्धं ब्राह्मणानां युग्मं कृत्वोपकल्पितान् । आहूय पादौ प्रक्षाल्य स्वयमाचम्य यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: pratishrAddhaM brAhmaNAnAM yugmaM kR^itvopakalpitAn | AhUya pAdau prakShAlya svayamAchamya yatnataH
verses.translation: The hair shaven off shall be put on a leaf and not allowed to fall on the ground. The beards, the moustache also shall be shaven. Nails of the hands and feet shall be pared.

verses.sanskrit: समस्तसम्पत्समवाप्तिहेतवः, समुत्थितापत्कुलधूमकेतवः । अपारसंसारसमुद्रसेतवः, पुनन्तु मां ब्राह्मणपादरेणवः
verses.transliteration: samastasampatsamavAptihetavaH, samutthitApatkuladhUmaketavaH | apArasaMsArasamudrasetavaH, punantu mAM brAhmaNapAdareNavaH
verses.translation: He shall take clay from the root of Bilva, Asvattha or Tulasi. He shall plunge into water twelve times and come to the bank. He shall place the clay on a pure spot of ground and divide it into three parts. Each part shall be divided into three. It shall be sprinkled with water with the Astra mantra.

verses.sanskrit: आपद्धनध्वान्तसहस्रभानवः, समीहितार्थार्पणकामधेनवः । समस्ततीर्थाम्बुपवित्रमूर्त्तयो, रक्षन्तु मां ब्राह्मणपादपांसवः
verses.transliteration: ApaddhanadhvAntasahasrabhAnavaH, samIhitArthArpaNakAmadhenavaH | samastatIrthAmbupavitramUrttayo, rakShantu mAM brAhmaNapAdapAMsavaH
verses.translation: Taking a lump of claiy he shall wipe off his hands with it twelve times. Each of the hands shall be separately washed with water.

verses.sanskrit: इति जप्त्वा नमस्कृत्य साष्टाङ्गं भुवि दण्डवत् । स्थित्वा तु प्राङ्मुखः शम्भोः पादाब्जयुगलं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: iti japtvA namaskR^itya sAShTA~NgaM bhuvi daNDavat | sthitvA tu prA~NmukhaH shambhoH pAdAbjayugalaM smaran
verses.translation: Another lump of clay shall be used similarly for the feet, another lump for the face, another for the arms and so on. After smearing and washing he shall enter water again.

verses.sanskrit: सपवित्रकरः शुद्ध उपवीती दृढासनः । प्राणायामत्रयं कुर्याच्छ्रुत्वा तिथ्यादिकं पुनः
verses.transliteration: sapavitrakaraH shuddha upavItI dR^iDhAsanaH | prANAyAmatrayaM kuryAchChrutvA tithyAdikaM punaH
verses.translation: Another lump of clay shall be divided into twelve and applied over the beard. He shall then plunge into the water again.

verses.sanskrit: मत्संन्यासाङ्गभूतं यद्विश्वेदेवादिकं तथा । श्राद्धमष्टविधं मातामहान्तं पार्वणेन वै
verses.transliteration: matsa.nnyAsA~NgabhUtaM yadvishvedevAdikaM tathA | shrAddhamaShTavidhaM mAtAmahAntaM pArvaNena vai
verses.translation: He shall come to the bank, gargle sixteen times, perforn Acamana twice and Pranayama sixteen times re¬ peating the Pranava.

verses.sanskrit: विधानेन करिष्यामि युष्मदाज्ञापुरःसरम् । एवं विधाय सङ्कल्पं दर्भानुत्तरतस्त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: vidhAnena kariShyAmi yuShmadAj~nApuraHsaram | evaM vidhAya sa~NkalpaM darbhAnuttaratastyajet
verses.translation: He shall divide another lump of clay into three. With one part he shall purify the hips and feet and perform Acamana twice.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणं बाहुमुद्धृत्य शपथं प्रब्रवीमि ते । सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यं सत्यं सत्यं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: dakShiNaM bAhumuddhR^itya shapathaM prabravImi te | satyaM satyaM punaH satyaM satyaM satyaM punaH punaH
verses.translation: He shall sprinkle water over it repeating Om seven times. * He shall apply the clay on the palms once in the beginning and thrice afterwards. Then he shall glance at the holy disc of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवार्थ इत्यादि भवद्भ्यां क्षण इत्यपि
verses.transliteration: vishvedevArtha ityAdi bhavadbhyAM kShaNa ityapi
verses.translation: With another lump of clay he shall purify the armpits by means of the hands on the opposite sides. With steady and pure mind the disciple shall take another lump of pure clay and smear his body fromhead to foot with devotion to. the preceptor and eyes fixed in the sun.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादनीय इत्यन्तं सर्वत्रैवं विधिक्रमः । एवं समाप्य वरणं मण्डलानि प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: prasAdanIya ityantaM sarvatraivaM vidhikramaH | evaM samApya varaNaM maNDalAni prakalpayet
verses.translation: Fixing the staff on the ground he shall stand up and remember his preceptor who has taught him the mantra with devotion strengthened by wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: उदगारभ्य दश च कृत्वाभ्यर्चनमक्षतैः । तेषु क्रमेण संस्थाप्य ब्राह्मणान् पादयोः पुनः
verses.transliteration: udagArabhya dasha cha kR^itvAbhyarchanamakShataiH | teShu krameNa saMsthApya brAhmaNAn pAdayoH punaH
verses.translation: He shall devoutly remember Samba, Mahesana, l§ahkara, the moon-crested Siva, the lord of prosperity and glory.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवादिनामानि ससंवबोधनमुच्चरेत् । इदं वः पाद्यमिति सकुशपुष्पाक्षतोदकैः
verses.transliteration: vishvedevAdinAmAni sasaMvabodhanamuchcharet | idaM vaH pAdyamiti sakushapuShpAkShatodakaiH
verses.translation: He shall prostrate before the preceptor Siva thrice with eight limbs and once with five limbs touching the ground and stand up making obeisance.

verses.sanskrit: पाद्यं दत्त्वा स्वयमपि क्षालिताङ्घ्रिरुदङ्मुखः । आचम्य युग्मक्लृप्तांस्तानासनेषूपवेश्य च
verses.transliteration: pAdyaM dattvA svayamapi kShAlitA~Nghriruda~NmukhaH | Achamya yugmaklR^iptAMstAnAsaneShUpaveshya cha
verses.translation: He shall enter the river again and plunge once. Coming up he shall apply the clay on the shoulders in the manner mentioned before.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवस्वरूपस्य ब्राह्मणस्येदमासनम् । इति दर्भासनं दत्त्वा दर्भपाणिः स्वयं स्थितः
verses.transliteration: vishvedevasvarUpasya brAhmaNasyedamAsanam | iti darbhAsanaM dattvA darbhapANiH svayaM sthitaH
verses.translation: The remaining clay he shall take up and dissolve it in the water and then apply it all over his body.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्नान्दीमुखश्राद्धे विश्वेदेवार्थ इत्यपि । भवद्भ्यां क्षण इत्युक्त्वा क्रियतामिति संवदेत्
verses.transliteration: asminnAndImukhashrAddhe vishvedevArtha ityapi | bhavadbhyAM kShaNa ityuktvA kriyatAmiti saMvadet
verses.translation: He shall repeat 'Om' thrice and remember the lotus-likc feet of Siva which enable him to cross the ocean of worldly existence.*®®

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नुतामिति सम्प्रोच्य भवन्ताविति संवदेत् । वदेतां प्राप्नुयावेति तौ च ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवौ
verses.transliteration: prApnutAmiti samprochya bhavantAviti saMvadet | vadetAM prApnuyAveti tau cha brAhmaNapu~Ngavau
verses.translation: Repeating Om he shall pour water over his body besmeared with the Bhasma of the Vi raja Homa. He.shall wipe the body, take his bath and apply Bha'ma.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूर्णमस्तु सङ्कल्पसिद्धिरस्त्विति तान् प्रति । भवन्तोऽनुगृह्णन्त्विति प्रार्थयेद् द्विजपुङ्गवान्
verses.transliteration: sampUrNamastu sa~Nkalpasiddhirastviti tAn prati | bhavanto.anugR^ihNantviti prArthayed dvijapu~NgavAn
verses.translation: O sage, then he shall carefully apply Tripundra in accordance with the rules.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवार्थः शिवः साक्षात्प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तितः । श्रुतिषु स्मृतिशास्त्रेषु पुराणेष्वागमेषु च
verses.transliteration: praNavArthaH shivaH sAkShAtprAdhAnyena prakIrtitaH | shrutiShu smR^itishAstreShu purANeShvAgameShu cha
verses.translation: After paying obeisance to Mahesvara, the precep¬ tors, holy centres and others he shall perform the midday rites.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य भासा विभातीदं जगत्सर्वं समन्ततः । सर्वैश्वर्येण सम्पन्नो नाम्ना सर्वेश्वरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: yasya bhAsA vibhAtIdaM jagatsarvaM samantataH | sarvaishvaryeNa sampanno nAmnA sarveshvaraH svayam
verses.translation: O sage, with great devotion he shall worship $iva accompanied b/ Siva and the bestower of perfect knowledge, the protector of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रादिषड्विधार्थानामर्थोपन्यासमार्गतः । सा - मा समष्टिव्यष्टिभावार्थं वक्ष्यामि प्रणवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: mantrAdiShaDvidhArthAnAmarthopanyAsamArgataH | sA \- mA samaShTivyaShTibhAvArthaM vakShyAmi praNavAtmakam
verses.translation: With steady mind, abiding by his virtuous duties and pure in body, he shall go to good brahmin householders for alms.

verses.sanskrit: सा हि साक्षाच्छिवैक्येन जीवन्मुक्तिफलप्रदा । सर्वोत्तमा हि विज्ञेया निर्विकारा यतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: sA hi sAkShAchChivaikyena jIvanmuktiphalapradA | sarvottamA hi vij~neyA nirvikArA yatAtmanAm
verses.translation: He shall divide the alms into five parts and do with them as proper. He shall avoid defiled food.

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुरादीन्द्रियग्रामो भूतग्रामश्चतुर्विधः । पितृश्राद्धे पिता तस्य पिता तस्य पिता त्रयः
verses.transliteration: chakShurAdIndriyagrAmo bhUtagrAmashchaturvidhaH | pitR^ishrAddhe pitA tasya pitA tasya pitA trayaH
verses.translation: A mendicant shall perform four activities: Purifi¬ catory rites, ablution, begging for alms and resorting to isolated places for meditation. He has no fifth rite.

verses.sanskrit: उपस्पृश्याप उत्थाय वरणक्रममारभेत् । पवित्रपाणिः संस्पृश्य पाणी ब्राह्मणयोर्वदेत्
verses.transliteration: upaspR^ishyApa utthAya varaNakramamArabhet | pavitrapANiH saMspR^ishya pANI brAhmaNayorvadet
verses.translation: He shall use only four types of begging bowls, that made of dried gourd, or of bamboo, or of wood or of clay. He shall not take any other type of bowl.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शुद्धकदल्यादिपात्रेषु क्षालितेषु च । अन्नादिभोज्यद्रव्याणि दत्त्वा दर्भैः पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tataH shuddhakadalyAdipAtreShu kShAliteShu cha | annAdibhojyadravyANi dattvA darbhaiH pR^ithak pR^ithak
verses.translation: Six things are forbidden to the ascetics: chewing the betel, using the metallic vessel, emission of semen, white cloth, sleeping during the day and taking meal at night.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षालिताङ्घ्रिराचम्य पिण्डस्थानं व्रजेत्ततः । आसीनः प्राङ्मुखो मौनी प्राणायामत्रयं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: prakShAlitA~NghrirAchamya piNDasthAnaM vrajettataH | AsInaH prA~Nmukho maunI prANAyAmatrayaM charet
verses.translation: If they observe the rules they are wise. If they do not they are Raksasas. The ascetic shall never indulge in activities contrary to the rules.

verses.sanskrit: अन्येद्युः प्रातरुत्थाय कृतनित्यक्रियः सुधीः । उपोष्य क्षौरकर्मादि कक्षोपस्थविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: anyedyuH prAtarutthAya kR^itanityakriyaH sudhIH | upoShya kShaurakarmAdi kakShopasthavivarjitam
verses.translation: He shall perform the post-shaving ablution assi¬ duously for purity, remembering mentally the supreme Brahman Sada§iva.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न आयाहि वीतये शन्नो देवीरभिष्टये । पश्चात्प्रोच्य मयरसतजभनलगैः सह
verses.transliteration: agna AyAhi vItaye shanno devIrabhiShTaye | pashchAtprochya mayarasatajabhanalagaiH saha
verses.translation: O sage, thus out of aflfection for you, the rites of post-shaving ablution I have explained to you. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: परिस्तीर्य स्वयं तत्र परिषिच्योदकेन च । हस्ताभ्यामवलम्ब्याथ पात्रं प्रत्येकमादरात्
verses.transliteration: paristIrya svayaM tatra pariShichyodakena cha | hastAbhyAmavalambyAtha pAtraM pratyekamAdarAt
verses.translation: There are no crematory rites for the liberated ascetics. I have heard that they arc buried. O Karttikeya, my preceptor, please mention that rite lovingly. There is none in the three worlds who can explain the same.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी ते पात्रमित्यादि कृत्वा तत्र व्यवस्थितान् । देवादींश्च चतुर्थ्यन्ताननूद्याक्षतसंयुतान्
verses.transliteration: pR^ithivI te pAtramityAdi kR^itvA tatra vyavasthitAn | devAdIMshcha chaturthyantAnanUdyAkShatasaMyutAn
verses.translation: O lord, son of 6iva, considering me as your disciple please tell me lovingly the mode of departure for those who arc liberated from the corporal cage after rea¬ lising perfect identity with the Brahman and who have attained their goal after liberation through the path of Upasana.

verses.sanskrit: उदग्गृहीत्वा स्वाहेति देवार्थेऽन्नं यजेत्पुनः । न ममेति वदेदन्ते सर्वत्रायं विधिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: udaggR^ihItvA svAheti devArthe.annaM yajetpunaH | na mameti vadedante sarvatrAyaM vidhikramaH
verses.translation: On hearing the request of the sage, the son of!§akti, destroyer of demons spoke about the great secret which had been heard from iva. by Bhrgu.

verses.sanskrit: यत्पादपद्मस्मरणाद्यस्य नामजपादपि । न्यूनं कर्म भवेत्पूर्णं तं वन्दे साम्बमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yatpAdapadmasmaraNAdyasya nAmajapAdapi | nyUnaM karma bhavetpUrNaM taM vande sAmbamIshvaram
verses.translation: O Brahmin, I shall explain it to you. It shall not be given to any or every one indiscriminately. It shall be given to a calm disciple equipped with devotion to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: इति जप्त्वा ततो ब्रूयान्मया कृतमिदं पुनः । नान्दीमुखश्राद्धमिति यथोक्तं च वदेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: iti japtvA tato brUyAnmayA kR^itamidaM punaH | nAndImukhashrAddhamiti yathoktaM cha vadettataH
verses.translation: On hearing fiom his preceptor the lore of Ved¬ anta and Agamas along with the explanation he shall practise Yoga by means of Yama, Niyama etc.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्विति ब्रूतेति च तान्प्रसाद्य द्विजपुङ्गवान् । विसृज्य स्वकरस्थोदं प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत्
verses.transliteration: astviti brUteti cha tAnprasAdya dvijapu~NgavAn | visR^ijya svakarasthodaM praNamya bhuvi daNDavat
verses.translation: O sage, practising it regularly the ascetic shall be attached to Pranava and be well-engaged in the meditation on Siva

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाय च ततो ब्रूयादमृतं भवतु द्विजान् । प्रार्थयेच्च परं प्रीत्या कृताञ्जलिरुदारधीः
verses.transliteration: utthAya cha tato brUyAdamR^itaM bhavatu dvijAn | prArthayechcha paraM prItyA kR^itA~njalirudAradhIH
verses.translation: O sage, there are five deities in the forms of messengers who by the favour of Sadasiva are put in the charge of Nandin.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीरुद्रं चमकं सूक्तं पौरुषं च यथाविधि । चित्ते सदाशिवं ध्यात्वा जपेद् ब्रह्माणि पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: shrIrudraM chamakaM sUktaM pauruShaM cha yathAvidhi | chitte sadAshivaM dhyAtvA japed brahmANi pa~ncha cha
verses.translation: The five deities, O sage, take the souls interested in performing holy rites to the heaven by their merit.

verses.sanskrit: भोजनान्ते रुद्रसूक्तं क्षमापय द्विजान् पुनः । तन्मन्त्रेण ततो दद्यादुत्तरापोशणं पुरः
verses.transliteration: bhojanAnte rudrasUktaM kShamApaya dvijAn punaH | tanmantreNa tato dadyAduttarAposhaNaM puraH
verses.translation: After enjoying the pleasures in heaven as men¬ tioned, at the diminution of the merit they return to the human realm and take births as before.

verses.sanskrit: यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह । आनन्दं यस्य वै विद्वान्न बिभेति कुतश्चन
verses.transliteration: yato vAcho nivartante aprApya manasA saha | AnandaM yasya vai vidvAnna bibheti kutashchana
verses.translation: The deities employed in activities divide the sphere beginning with the earth into five in the order of fire etc. They then take the ascetic to Sadaiiva's region. Having led him to the honoured feet of the lord, the deities of blessing stand behind the lord.

verses.sanskrit: नान्दीमुखोक्तश्राद्धाङ्गं करिष्ये पिण्डदानकम् । इति सङ्कल्प्य दक्षादि समारभ्योदकान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: nAndImukhoktashrAddhA~NgaM kariShye piNDadAnakam | iti sa~Nkalpya dakShAdi samArabhyodakAntikam
verses.translation: On seeing him come, if he is unattached, Sada- iSiva lord of the gods teaches him the purport of the great mantra; crowns him as the chief of the Ganas and gives him a body similar to his. §iva lord of all, leader of all, blesses him thus.

verses.sanskrit: नव रेखाः समालिख्य प्रागग्रान्द्वादश क्रमात् । संस्तीर्य दर्भान्दक्षादिदेवादिस्थानपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: nava rekhAH samAlikhya prAgagrAndvAdasha kramAt | saMstIrya darbhAndakShAdidevAdisthAnapa~nchakam
verses.translation: The ascetic is decorated with the deer-skin, axe, trident and the gesture of offering boons. It has three eyes. His matted locks shine by the splendour of Ganga and the crescent moon. He is seated on a splendid aerial chariot. He is delegated the power of bestowing all desires. If he is attached the lord blesses him with an aerial chariot having the speed of the mind, capable of going everywhere, shining like a crore of suns, cool like a crore of moons, full of vessels with celestial nector and divine water, decorated with divine garments, garlands, unguents and ornaments charming with the sounds of dance, music, Mrdahga and other instruments and surrounded by Rudra virgins. When he has enjoyed all pleasures, when his eagerness for enjoyment subsides lord Siva blesses him imparting to him the purport of the great mantra. He blesses him with immovable trance in the forfn "I am Siva, I am perfect.'' He blesses him with unres¬ tricted Siddhis capable of creating the sun etc. The Siddhis arc in the form of throbbings arising from realisation that he is the slave ol Siva. The preceptor of the world bestows on him the greatest salvation devoid of return even when the life of the lotus-born deity comes to an end.

verses.sanskrit: तूष्णीं दद्यात्साक्षतोदं त्रिषु स्थानेषु च क्रमात् । स्थानेष्वन्येषु मातृषु मार्ज्जयन्तास्ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: tUShNIM dadyAtsAkShatodaM triShu sthAneShu cha kramAt | sthAneShvanyeShu mAtR^iShu mArjjayantAstataH param
verses.translation: They shall recite the statements beginning with Pranava and explain their purport with the pious mind. They shall remind him of Siva.the great Nirguna splendour and make obeisance to him till he expires.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेति पितरः पश्चात्साक्षतोदं समर्च्य च । दद्यात्ततः क्रमेणैव देवादिस्थानपञ्चके
verses.transliteration: atreti pitaraH pashchAtsAkShatodaM samarchya cha | dadyAttataH krameNaiva devAdisthAnapa~nchake
verses.translation: The procedure of obsequies shall be followed. If their bodies are not cremated they are likely to miss the good goal.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तद्देवादिनामानि चतुर्थ्यन्तान्युदीर्य च । पिण्डत्रयं ततो दद्यात्प्रत्येकं स्थानपञ्चके
verses.transliteration: tattaddevAdinAmAni chaturthyantAnyudIrya cha | piNDatrayaM tato dadyAtpratyekaM sthAnapa~nchake
verses.translation: Since they have renounced all their activities and have resorted to Siva, if the king defiles their bodies his kingdom will be ruined.

verses.sanskrit: स्वगृह्योक्तेन मार्गेण दद्यात्पिण्डान्पृथक्पृथक् । दद्यादिदं साक्षतं च पितृसाद्गुण्यहेतवे
verses.transliteration: svagR^ihyoktena mArgeNa dadyAtpiNDAnpR^ithakpR^ithak | dadyAdidaM sAkShataM cha pitR^isAdguNyahetave
verses.translation: The people of that village too will suffer distress. The following procedure shall be taken up to avoid that default.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायेत्सदाशिवं देवं हृदयाम्भोजमध्यतः । तत्पादपद्मस्मरणादिति श्लोकं पठन् पुनः
verses.transliteration: dhyAyetsadAshivaM devaM hR^idayAmbhojamadhyataH | tatpAdapadmasmaraNAditi shlokaM paThan punaH
verses.translation: Humbly the king shall begin with "obeisance to Irinya'**® and recite the mantra ending with "obeisance to Amlvatkas".'®

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्य ब्राह्मणेभ्यो दक्षिणां च स्वशक्तितः । दत्त्वा क्षमापय च तान् विसृज्य च ततः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: namaskR^itya brAhmaNebhyo dakShiNAM cha svashaktitaH | dattvA kShamApaya cha tAn visR^ijya cha tataH kramAt
verses.translation: Repeating Om in the end he shall complete the worship of the lord. O great sage, this procedure will quell the defect.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डानुत्सृज्य गोग्रासं दद्यान्नो चेज्जले क्षिपेत् । पुण्याहवाचनं कृत्वा भुञ्जीत स्वजनैः सह
verses.transliteration: piNDAnutsR^ijya gogrAsaM dadyAnno chejjale kShipet | puNyAhavAchanaM kR^itvA bhu~njIta svajanaiH saha
verses.translation: His sons and relatives shall perform the obsequies according to the rules.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माज्जगदिदं सर्वं विधिविष्ण्विन्द्रपूर्वकम् । सह भूतेन्द्रियग्रामैः प्रथमं सम्प्रसूयते
verses.transliteration: yasmAjjagadidaM sarvaM vidhiviShNvindrapUrvakam | saha bhUtendriyagrAmaiH prathamaM samprasUyate
verses.translation: He shall be bathed with water and worshipped with flowers etc. repeating the mantras of Srirudra, Camaka and Rudrasukta in order. The conch shall be placed before him and he shall be sprinkled with the water there¬ in. A flower shall be placed on the head and his body shall be wiped repeating the Pranava. *

verses.sanskrit: केशश्मश्रुनखानेव कर्मावधि विसृज्य च । समाष्टिकेशान्विधिवत्कारयित्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: keshashmashrunakhAneva karmAvadhi visR^ijya cha | samAShTikeshAnvidhivatkArayitvA vidhAnataH
verses.translation: The loin-cloth shall be taken off and fresh one shall be tied. His body shall be dusted with the ashes in accordance with the rules.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा धौतपटः शुद्धो द्विराचम्याथ वाग्यतः । भस्म सन्धार्य विधिना कृत्वा पुण्याहवाचनम्
verses.transliteration: snAtvA dhautapaTaH shuddho dvirAchamyAtha vAgyataH | bhasma sandhArya vidhinA kR^itvA puNyAhavAchanam

verses.sanskrit: तेन सम्प्रोक्ष्य सम्प्राप्य शुद्धदेहस्वभावतः । होमद्रव्यार्थमाचार्यदक्षिणार्थं विहाय च
verses.transliteration: tena samprokShya samprApya shuddhadehasvabhAvataH | homadravyArthamAchAryadakShiNArthaM vihAya cha
verses.translation: Repeating the requisite mantras Rudrak$a garlands shall be worn over the chest, neck, head, arms, wrists and ears in order.

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्यजातं महेशाय द्विजेभ्यश्च विशेषतः । भक्तेभ्यश्च प्रदायाथ शिवाय गुरुरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: dravyajAtaM maheshAya dvijebhyashcha visheShataH | bhaktebhyashcha pradAyAtha shivAya gururUpiNe
verses.translation: After fumigating with incense the body shall be lifted and placed on a rope-swing. It shall be placed on a charming chariot of the form of five Bahmans.

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्रादि दक्षिणां दत्त्वा प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत् । दोरकौपीनवसनं दण्डाद्यं क्षालितं भुवि
verses.transliteration: vastrAdi dakShiNAM dattvA praNamya bhuvi daNDavat | dorakaupInavasanaM daNDAdyaM kShAlitaM bhuvi
verses.translation: The chariot shall be decorated with fragrant flowers and garlands with the five Brahma mantras beginning with Sadyojata preceded by Om.

verses.sanskrit: आदाय होमद्रव्याणि समिधादीनि च क्रमात् । समुद्रतीरे नद्यां वा पर्वते वा शिवालये
verses.transliteration: AdAya homadravyANi samidhAdIni cha kramAt | samudratIre nadyAM vA parvate vA shivAlaye
verses.translation: The body shall be taken round in procession around the village to the accompaniment of dances, music and chanting of Vedic mantras.

verses.sanskrit: अरण्ये चापी गोष्ठे वा विचार्य स्थानमुत्तमम् । स्थित्वाचम्य ततः पूर्वं कृत्वा मानसमञ्जरीम्
verses.transliteration: araNye chApI goShThe vA vichArya sthAnamuttamam | sthitvAchamya tataH pUrvaM kR^itvA mAnasama~njarIm
verses.translation: The ascetics shall dig a ditch as deep as the staff in a holy spot near a holy tree on the eastern or northern side. They shall sprinkle it with water repeating the Pranava and the Vyahrtis. They shall spread the leaves of the Sami tree and flowers with their tips pointing to the north. Above them Darbha grass shall be spread. His seat whether cloth, deerskin or mat of Darbha grass shall be placed over them. The body shall be sprinkled with Paficagavya with Pranava and Brahma mantras. It shall be bathed with the water from the conch repeating Rudrasukta and the Pranava. A flower shall be placed on the head. Repeating the Svastivacana mantras and Om the body shall be lifted and placed inside the ditch in the Yogic pose facing the cast. It shall be decorated with fragrant flowers and fumigated with incense and fragrant gum resin repeating the mantra ' O Visnu, protect the Havya".

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्ममोङ्कारसहितं नमो ब्रह्मण इत्यपि । जपित्वा त्रिस्ततो ब्रूयादग्निमीले पुरोहितम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmamo~NkArasahitaM namo brahmaNa ityapi | japitvA tristato brUyAdagnimIle purohitam
verses.translation: The staff shall be placed in his right hand and the vessel full of water in the left, repeating the mantra "Prajapate natvadeta".' With the mantra *'Brahmaja jflanam Prathamam"'* etc. his head and with the Rudra Sukta the middle of the eyebrow shall be touched.

verses.sanskrit: अथ महाव्रतमिति अग्निर्वै देवनामतः । तथैतस्य समाम्नायमिषे त्वोर्ज्जेत्वा वेति तत्
verses.transliteration: atha mahAvratamiti agnirvai devanAmataH | tathaitasya samAmnAyamiShe tvorjjetvA veti tat
verses.translation: Ibid. 13. 3.

verses.sanskrit: न सम्प्रसूयते यो वै कुतश्चन कदाचन । यस्मिन्न भासते विद्युन्न च सूर्यो न चन्द्रमाः
verses.transliteration: na samprasUyate yo vai kutashchana kadAchana | yasminna bhAsate vidyunna cha sUryo na chandramAH
verses.translation: The skull shall be split with a coconut repeating the four mantras beginning with "Ma no Mahantam'" etc. Then the ditch shall be filled.

verses.sanskrit: सम्मितं च ततः पञ्चसंवत्सरमयं ततः । समाम्नायः समाम्नातः अथ शिक्षां वदेत्पुनः । प्रवक्ष्यामीत्युदीर्याथ वृद्धिरादैच्च संवदेत्
verses.transliteration: sammitaM cha tataH pa~nchasaMvatsaramayaM tataH | samAmnAyaH samAmnAtaH atha shikShAM vadetpunaH | pravakShyAmItyudIryAtha vR^iddhirAdaichcha saMvadet
verses.translation: Touching the place, with the mind dwelling on nothing else, the performer of the obsecpjies shall repeat the five Brahma mantras and the mantra beginning with "Yo devanam"' and ending with "Yah parah sa Mahe'>varah" he shall worship Mahadeva, Samba, the panacea for the ills of the world, the omniscient, the non-dependent and the blesscr of all.

verses.sanskrit: अथातो धर्मजिज्ञासेत्युच्चार्य पुनरञ्जसा । अथातो ब्रह्मजिज्ञासा वेदादीनपि सञ्जपेत्
verses.transliteration: athAto dharmajij~nAsetyuchchArya punara~njasA | athAto brahmajij~nAsA vedAdInapi sa~njapet
verses.translation: Then a mud platform, two Aratuis.square and one Aratni high, ihall be erected and smeared with cow-

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणमिन्द्रं सूर्यं च सोमं चैव प्रजापतिम् । आत्मानमन्तरात्मानं ज्ञानात्मानमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: brahmANamindraM sUryaM cha somaM chaiva prajApatim | AtmAnamantarAtmAnaM j~nAnAtmAnamataH param
verses.translation: A mystic diagram shall be inscribed in the middle and worshipped with fragrant flowers, Bilva leaves and Tulasi along with scented raw grains.

verses.sanskrit: परमात्मानमपि च प्रणवाद्यं नमोन्तकम् । चतुर्थ्यन्तं जपित्वाऽथ सक्तुमुष्टिं प्रगृह्य च
verses.transliteration: paramAtmAnamapi cha praNavAdyaM namontakam | chaturthyantaM japitvA.atha saktumuShTiM pragR^ihya cha
verses.translation: The waving of the lights fumigating with incense, milk and the food olTering shall be offered with Pranava. The grave shall be circumambulated. They shall them pros¬ trate five times.

verses.sanskrit: प्राश्याथ प्रणवेनैव द्विराचम्याथ संस्पृशेत् । नाभिं मन्त्रान्वक्ष्यमाणं प्रणवाद्यान्नमोऽन्तकान्
verses.transliteration: prAshyAtha praNavenaiva dvirAchamyAtha saMspR^ishet | nAbhiM mantrAnvakShyamANaM praNavAdyAnnamo.antakAn
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated the rites up t<j the tenth day. O great sage, now li.stcn to the rites of the eleventh day for ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानमन्तरात्मानं ज्ञानात्मानं पुरं पुनः । आत्मानं च समुच्चार्य प्रजापतिमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: AtmAnamantarAtmAnaM j~nAnAtmAnaM puraM punaH | AtmAnaM cha samuchchArya prajApatimataH param
verses.translation: Ibid iG. ij.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहान्तान्प्रजपेत्पश्चात्पयोदधिघृतं पृथक् । त्रिवारं प्रणवेनैव प्राश्याचम्य द्विधा पुनः
verses.transliteration: svAhAntAnprajapetpashchAtpayodadhighR^itaM pR^ithak | trivAraM praNavenaiva prAshyAchamya dvidhA punaH
verses.translation: See P. 17(15 note.

verses.sanskrit: प्रागास्य उपविश्याथ दृढचित्तः स्थिरासनः । यथोक्तविधिना सम्यक्प्राणायामत्रयं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: prAgAsya upavishyAtha dR^iDhachittaH sthirAsanaH | yathoktavidhinA samyakprANAyAmatrayaM charet
verses.translation: O sage, out of affection for you I shall explain the rite for ascetics on the eleventh day after death.

verses.sanskrit: ६.१३ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: 6\.13 || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The Bindu, triangle, hexagon and circle shall be drawn in order. The conch shall be placed in front in accordance with the rules of worship.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The Bindu, triangle, hexagon and circle shall be drawn in order. The conch shall be placed in front in accordance with the rules of worship.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ६.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । सुब्रह्मण्य उवाच । अथ मध्याह्नसमये स्नात्वा नियतमानसः ॥ गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादीनि पूजाद्रव्याण्युपाहरेत
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 6\.13\. trayodasho.adhyAyaH | subrahmaNya uvAcha | atha madhyAhnasamaye snAtvA niyatamAnasaH || gandhapuShpAkShatAdIni pUjAdravyANyupAhareta
verses.translation: He shall perform the Pranayama and after due Sarhkalpa rite, he shall worship the five deities mentioned as messengers before.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽग्नये स्विष्टकृते स्वाहेति जुहुयात्सकृत् । हुत्वोपरिष्टात्तन्त्रं तु ततोऽग्नेरुत्तरे बुधः
verses.transliteration: tato.agnaye sviShTakR^ite svAheti juhuyAtsakR^it | hutvopariShTAttantraM tu tato.agneruttare budhaH
verses.translation: He shall cast olT Darbha grass to the north and not touch it again. Beginning with the west the Mandalas shall be worshipped according to the rules for the rite of "Sadutthapana." Flowers shall be stacked within them like a pedestal with ' Om Hrlrn. I invoke the messenger god¬ dess in the form of fire, obeisance.'' This latter portion is common to the five. The gestures of installation shall be shown severally to each.

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वासने जपेन्मौनी चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरे । आब्राह्मं च मुहूर्ते तु गायत्री दृढमानसः
verses.transliteration: sthitvAsane japenmaunI chailAjinakushottare | AbrAhmaM cha muhUrte tu gAyatrI dR^iDhamAnasaH
verses.translation: The Aiiganyasas for the deities shall be performed with Hram, Hrim etc. The messenger goddesses shall have the noose, goad, gestures of fearlessness and wish in their hands. They are as lustrous as the lunar stone.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्नात्वा त्वशक्तश्चेद्भस्मना वा विधानतः । श्रपयित्वा चरुं तस्मिन्नग्नावेवाभिधारितम्
verses.transliteration: tataH snAtvA tvashaktashchedbhasmanA vA vidhAnataH | shrapayitvA charuM tasminnagnAvevAbhidhAritam
verses.translation: They have changed (or enhanced) the hue of the quarters by the lustre of their gemset rings. They wear red garments and shine with lotus-like hands and feet.

verses.sanskrit: उदगुद्वास्य बर्हिष्यासाद्याज्येन चरुं ततः । अभिघार्य व्याहृतीश्च रौद्रसूक्तं च पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: udagudvAsya barhiShyAsAdyAjyena charuM tataH | abhighArya vyAhR^itIshcha raudrasUktaM cha pa~ncha cha
