verses.translation: They look charming with their faces resembling * the full moon and brilliant with three eyes. They are

verses.sanskrit: जपेद् ब्रह्माणि सन्धार्य चित्तं शिवपदाम्बुजे । प्रजापतिमथेन्द्रं च विश्वेदेवास्ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: japed brahmANi sandhArya chittaM shivapadAmbuje | prajApatimathendraM cha vishvedevAstataH param
verses.translation: Their waists arc slender and buttocks large. They wear divine red garments. The ruby-scl anklets jingle and

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं सचतुर्थ्यन्तं स्वाहान्तान् प्रणवादिकान् । सञ्जप्य वाचयित्वाथ पुण्याहं च ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: brahmANaM sachaturthyantaM svAhAntAn praNavAdikAn | sa~njapya vAchayitvAtha puNyAhaM cha tataH param
verses.translation: What blessing can be secured from a departed soul? Only from a powerful soul can everything be achieved as from Mahesa.

verses.sanskrit: परस्तात्तन्त्रमग्नये स्वाहेत्यग्निमुखावधि । निर्वर्त्य पश्चात्प्राणाय स्वाहेत्यारभ्य पञ्चभिः
verses.transliteration: parastAttantramagnaye svAhetyagnimukhAvadhi | nirvartya pashchAtprANAya svAhetyArabhya pa~nchabhiH
verses.translation: The five deities capable of all activities and eager to bless others arc accepted by the lord as the bestowers of bliss.

verses.sanskrit: साज्येन चरुणा पश्चादग्निं स्विष्टकृतं हुनेत् । पुनश्च प्रजपेत्सूक्तं रौद्रं ब्रह्माणि पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: sAjyena charuNA pashchAdagniM sviShTakR^itaM hunet | punashcha prajapetsUktaM raudraM brahmANi pa~ncha cha
verses.translation: After meditating on the auspicious deities eager to bless he shall olfcr Padya at their feet with drops of water from the conch.

verses.sanskrit: महेशादि चतुर्व्यूहमन्त्रांश्च प्रजपेत्पुनः । हुत्वोपरिष्टात्तन्त्रं तु स्वशाखोक्तेन वर्त्मना
verses.transliteration: maheshAdi chaturvyUhamantrAMshcha prajapetpunaH | hutvopariShTAttantraM tu svashAkhoktena vartmanA
verses.translation: The water for Acamana shall be offered in their hands and Arghya on their heads. He shall conceive of their ritualistic ablution with the drops of water from the conch.

verses.sanskrit: नैरृत्ये पूजयेद्देवं विघ्नेशं देवपूजितम् । गणानां त्वेति मन्त्रेणावाहयेत्सुविधानतः
verses.transliteration: nairR^itye pUjayeddevaM vighneshaM devapUjitam | gaNAnAM tveti mantreNAvAhayetsuvidhAnataH
verses.translation: Beautiful garments red in colour shall be offered along with upper cloths. Coronets and ornaments shall also be offered.

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रजुहुयाद्विरजाहोममात्मनः । षड्विंशतत्त्वरूपेस्मिन्देहे लीनस्य शुद्धये
verses.transliteration: ataH paraM prajuhuyAdvirajAhomamAtmanaH | ShaDviMshatattvarUpesmindehe lInasya shuddhaye
verses.translation: Fragrant sandal wood, auspicious.\ksatas and charming fragrant flowers shall also be offered.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वान्येतानि मद्देहे शुध्यन्तामित्यनुस्मरन् । तत्रात्मतत्त्वशुद्ध्यर्थं मन्त्रैरारुणकेतुकैः
verses.transliteration: tattvAnyetAni maddehe shudhyantAmityanusmaran | tatrAtmatattvashuddhyarthaM mantrairAruNaketukaiH
verses.translation: Fragrant incense and lamp with wicks soaked in ghee shall be offered saying "I dedicate everything." Om should be uttered in the beginning and Namah at the end. Then milk pudding with honey shall be offered along with ghee, sugar, sweet pie and plantain fruits stuffed with jag¬ gery.

verses.sanskrit: पठ्यमानैः पृथिव्यादिपुरुषान्तं क्रमान्मुने । साज्येन चरुणा मौनी शिवपादाम्बुजं स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: paThyamAnaiH pR^ithivyAdipuruShAntaM kramAnmune | sAjyena charuNA maunI shivapAdAmbujaM smaran
verses.translation: Different articles shall be heaped on separate plantain leaves and rendered fragrant. They shall be sprinkled with water uttering "Bhuh Bhuvah Svah."

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यादि च शब्दादि वागाद्यं पञ्चकं पुनः । श्रोत्राद्यं च शिरः पार्श्वपृष्ठोदरचतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: pR^ithivyAdi cha shabdAdi vAgAdyaM pa~nchakaM punaH | shrotrAdyaM cha shiraH pArshvapR^iShThodarachatuShTayam
verses.translation: Naivedya shall be offered with; "Om Hrim Svaha". With "Namah" water shall be offered with great devotion.

verses.sanskrit: जङ्घां च योजयेत्पश्चात्त्वगाद्यं धातुसप्तकम् । प्राणाद्यं पञ्चकं पश्चादन्नाद्यं कोशपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: ja~NghAM cha yojayetpashchAttvagAdyaM dhAtusaptakam | prANAdyaM pa~nchakaM pashchAdannAdyaM koshapa~nchakam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, thereafter the  rite of Udvasana shall be performed with devotion. The place shall be mopped clean beginning with the east. Then water for gargling and Acamana shall be offered with Arghya.

verses.sanskrit: मनश्चित्तं च बुद्धिश्चाहङ्कृतिः ख्यातिरेव च । सङ्कल्पं तु गुणाः पश्चात्प्रकृतिः पुरुषस्ततः
verses.transliteration: manashchittaM cha buddhishchAha~NkR^itiH khyAtireva cha | sa~NkalpaM tu guNAH pashchAtprakR^itiH puruShastataH
verses.translation: After offering Tambida, incense and lights, the circumambulation and obeisance shall be performed. The

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषस्य तु भोक्तृत्वं प्रतिपन्नस्य भोजने । अन्तरङ्गतया तत्त्वपञ्चकं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: puruShasya tu bhoktR^itvaM pratipannasya bhojane | antara~NgatayA tattvapa~nchakaM parikIrtitam
verses.translation: "May the glorious mothers be delighted. At the lotus-like feet of Paramesa let them recommend the pro¬ tection of the deceased ascetic who is desirous of attaining the region of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नियतिः कालरागश्च विद्या च तदनन्तरम् । कला च पञ्चकमिदं मयोत्पन्नं मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: niyatiH kAlarAgashcha vidyA cha tadanantaram | kalA cha pa~nchakamidaM mayotpannaM munIshvara
verses.translation: After ritualistically dismissing them along the way they had come, the remanents of the Naivedya shall be distributed among the virgins.

verses.sanskrit: मायां तु प्रकृतिं विद्यादिति माया श्रुतीरिता । तज्जान्येतानि तत्त्वानि श्रुत्युक्तानि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: mAyAM tu prakR^itiM vidyAditi mAyA shrutIritA | tajjAnyetAni tattvAni shrutyuktAni na saMshayaH
verses.translation: It shall be given to the cows or cast off into water: There is no other way of disposal. Parvana and not Ekoddista Sraddha shall be performed for an ascetic.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तवर्णं महाकायं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् । पाशाङ्कुशाक्षाभीष्टं च दधानं करपङ्कजैः
verses.transliteration: raktavarNaM mahAkAyaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam | pAshA~NkushAkShAbhIShTaM cha dadhAnaM karapa~NkajaiH
verses.translation: I shall now tell you the rules for the Parvana for your welfare. O sage, listen.

verses.sanskrit: अजानन्पञ्चतत्त्वानि विद्वानपि च मूढधीः । निपत्याधस्तात्प्रकृतेरुपरिष्टात्पुमानयम्
verses.transliteration: ajAnanpa~nchatattvAni vidvAnapi cha mUDhadhIH | nipatyAdhastAtprakR^iterupariShTAtpumAnayam
verses.translation: The performer of the Parvana shall take his bath, perform Pranayama with pious mind wearing the sacred thread as usual. Wearing the Darbha ring he shall say "On this auspicious Tithi I shall perform the Parvana Jra- ddha." In the place of Asana Darbha grass shall be placed. After Saihkalpa Darbhas shall be cast off to the north. Water shall be touched. He shall invite four 6aiva brahmins who are steady in their rites. The brahmins shall take oil bath after which they shall be made to sit.

verses.sanskrit: काकाक्षिन्यायमाश्रित्य वर्तते पार्श्वतोऽन्वहम् । विद्यातत्त्वमिदं प्रोक्तं शुद्धविद्यामहेश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: kAkAkShinyAyamAshritya vartate pArshvato.anvaham | vidyAtattvamidaM proktaM shuddhavidyAmaheshvarau
verses.translation: "Ye all shall represent the Visvedevas." After saying this he shall say "obeisance to Atman, Antaratman and Paramatman." Then he shall touch their feet with devo¬ tion.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवश्च शक्तिश्च शिवश्चेदं तु पञ्चकम् । शिवतत्त्वमिदं ब्रह्मन् प्रज्ञानं ब्रह्म वाग्यतः
verses.transliteration: sadAshivashcha shaktishcha shivashchedaM tu pa~nchakam | shivatattvamidaM brahman praj~nAnaM brahma vAgyataH
verses.translation: The feet of the brahmins shall be washed and they shall be made to sit facing the east. After decorating them with scents, sandal paste etc., they shall be led in front of Siva

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यादिशिवान्तं यत्तत्त्वजातं मुनीश्वर । स्वकारणलयद्वारा शुद्धिरस्य विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: pR^ithivyAdishivAntaM yattattvajAtaM munIshvara | svakAraNalayadvArA shuddhirasya vidhIyatAm
verses.translation: The ground shall be smeared with cowdung. Darbha grass shall be spread with their tips to the east. He shall perform P» anayama and the rite of saihkalpa "I shall offer the Pinda." He shall then worship the Mantjala Atman, Antaratman and the Paramatman turning the face back. "I am giving these Pindas," saying this he shall offer the Pindas with devotion. Water from the Darbha grass shall be offered. Getting up he shall perform circumambul- ation and the Namaskara.

verses.sanskrit: एकादशानां मन्त्राणां परस्मैपदपूर्वकम् । शिवज्योतिश्चतुर्थ्यन्तमिदं पदमथोच्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: ekAdashAnAM mantrANAM parasmaipadapUrvakam | shivajyotishchaturthyantamidaM padamathochcharet
verses.translation: After giving gifts to the Brahmins according to the rules he shall offer Narayana Bali at the same spot on the same day.

verses.sanskrit: न ममेति वदेत्पश्चादुद्देशत्याग ईरितः । अतः परं विविद्यैति कर्षोत्कायेति मन्त्रयोः
verses.transliteration: na mameti vadetpashchAduddeshatyAga IritaH | ataH paraM vividyaiti karShotkAyeti mantrayoH
verses.translation: Everywhere Visnu shall be worshipped for protec¬ tion. He shall perform the worship of Visnu and offer milk pudding as Naivcdya.

verses.sanskrit: व्यापकाय पदस्यान्ते परमात्मन इत्यपि । शिवज्योतिश्चतुर्थ्यन्तं विश्वभूतपदं पुनः
verses.transliteration: vyApakAya padasyAnte paramAtmana ityapi | shivajyotishchaturthyantaM vishvabhUtapadaM punaH
verses.translation: He shall invite twelve brahmins who are masters of the Vedas. He shall worship them in the names of Keava etc. with scents, flowers and Aksatas. He shall propitiate them and offer them shoes, umbrella, cloth, accor¬ ding to the rules. He shall speak to them sweet, auspicious words.

verses.sanskrit: घसनोत्सुकशब्दश्च चतुर्थ्यन्तमथो वदेत् । परस्मैपदमुच्चार्य देवाय पदमुच्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: ghasanotsukashabdashcha chaturthyantamatho vadet | parasmaipadamuchchArya devAya padamuchcharet
verses.translation: He shall spread Darbha grass on the ground with their tips to the east. After saying "Bhuh Svaha, Bhuvah Svaha, Suvah Svaha, Om." He shall offer milk pudding as oblation.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठस्वेति मन्त्रस्य विश्वरूपाय शब्दतः । पुरुषाय पदं ब्रूयादोंस्वाहेत्यस्य संवदेत्
verses.transliteration: uttiShThasveti mantrasya vishvarUpAya shabdataH | puruShAya padaM brUyAdoMsvAhetyasya saMvadet
verses.translation: O great sage, the rite of the eleventh day has been mentioned by me. O brahmin, I shall now explain the twelfthday rites.

verses.sanskrit: एवमावाह्य सन्ध्याय शम्भुपुत्रं गजाननम् । अभ्यर्च्य पायसापूपनालिकेरगुडादिभिः
verses.transliteration: evamAvAhya sandhyAya shambhuputraM gajAnanam | abhyarchya pAyasApUpanAlikeraguDAdibhiH
verses.translation: He shall get up early in the morning on the twelfth day, take his bath and perform his daily rites. He shall invite some Saiva ascetics or brahmin devotees of Siva. After they had taken their baths they shall be fed at midday in accordance with the rules, offering them sweet and auspicious foodstuffs of various sorts.

verses.sanskrit: स्वशाखोक्तप्रकारेण पुरस्तात्तन्त्रकर्म च । निर्वर्त्य सर्पिषा मिश्रं चरुं प्राश्य पुरोधसे
verses.transliteration: svashAkhoktaprakAreNa purastAttantrakarma cha | nirvartya sarpiShA mishraM charuM prAshya purodhase
verses.translation: In the presence of Paramea they shall be worship¬ ped in accordance with the Paficavarana rites after perfor¬ ming Pranayama. As in the case of Mahasamkalpa he shall perform the Samkalpa rite thus, "I shall perform the worship of the pcrceptor." He shall then touch the Darbhas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदद्याद् दक्षिणां तस्मै हेमादिपरिबृंहिताम् । ब्रह्माणमुद्वास्य ततः प्रातरौपासनं हुनेत्
verses.transliteration: pradadyAd dakShiNAM tasmai hemAdiparibR^iMhitAm | brahmANamudvAsya tataH prAtaraupAsanaM hunet
verses.translation: After washing his feet and performing Acamana he shall make them sit facing east. Ashes shall be smeared all over the body.

verses.sanskrit: सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुत इति मन्त्रं जपेन्नरः । याते अग्न इत्यनेन मन्त्रेणाग्नौ प्रताप्य च
verses.transliteration: saM mA si~nchantu maruta iti mantraM japennaraH | yAte agna ityanena mantreNAgnau pratApya cha
verses.translation: O sage, the eight — Sadasiva etc. shall be meditated upon and the brahmins shall be treated with respect.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तमग्नौ समारोप्य स्वात्मन्यद्वैतधामनि । प्राभातिकीं ततः सन्ध्यामुपास्यादित्यमप्यथ
verses.transliteration: hastamagnau samAropya svAtmanyadvaitadhAmani | prAbhAtikIM tataH sandhyAmupAsyAdityamapyatha
verses.translation: He shall then meditate on Paramesthi Guru as Samba with his own name. Paramaguru and Parat Paraguru shall also be meditated upon.

verses.sanskrit: उपस्थाय प्रविश्याप्सु नाभिदघ्नं प्रवेशयन् । तन्मन्त्रां पेरजपेत्प्रीत्या निश्चलात्मा समुत्सुकः
verses.transliteration: upasthAya pravishyApsu nAbhidaghnaM praveshayan | tanmantrAM perajapetprItyA nishchalAtmA samutsukaH
verses.translation: He shall say "Here is the seat" and offer seat. With Om as prefix his name shall be mentioned in the accus¬ ative case with the addition '*1 invoke, obeisance". He shall then offer Padya, Acamana, Arghya, cloth, scents and Aksatas. They shall be decorated with flowers. Their names shall be mentioned in the Dative case with Om prefixed and wor¬ shipped with fragrant flowers. After fumigating with the incense and offering lights he shall say, ' The entire rites of propitiation are over. May they be perfect and complete" and perform obeisance and get up.

verses.sanskrit: आहिताग्निस्तु यः कुर्यात्प्राजापत्येष्टिमाहिते । श्रौते वैश्वानरे सम्यक् सर्ववेदसदक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: AhitAgnistu yaH kuryAtprAjApatyeShTimAhite | shraute vaishvAnare samyak sarvavedasadakShiNAm
verses.translation: Plantain leaves shall be spread and cleaned with water. Pure cooked nice, milk pudding, sweet pies, cooked dal, vegetable dishes, and other food stuffs shall be placed over them along with plantain fruits, coconuts and jaggery. Darbha grass is put under each leaf. These shall be sprinkled and the Parisecana, the sprinkling of foodstuffs shall be performed, lie shall then say "Protect the Havya of Visnu" and make them touch the articles.

verses.sanskrit: अथाग्निमात्मन्यारोप्य ब्राह्मणः प्रव्रजेद् गुहात् । सावित्रीप्रथमं पादं सावित्रीमित्युदीर्य च
verses.transliteration: athAgnimAtmanyAropya brAhmaNaH pravrajed guhAt | sAvitrIprathamaM pAdaM sAvitrImityudIrya cha
verses.translation: He shall stand up and offer giving water for drinking he shall request them thus, "May Sadauva and others be delighted with me and bestow boons on me".

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते भूरोमिति च संवदेत् । द्वितीयं पादमुच्चार्य सावित्रीमिति पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: praveshayAmi shabdAnte bhUromiti cha saMvadet | dvitIyaM pAdamuchchArya sAvitrImiti pUrvavat
verses.translation: He shall then recite the mantra "Ye deva"" etc. and scatter Aksatas. He shall prostrate, stand up and say "Everywhere may there be nectar''.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते भूरोमिति च संवदेत् । तृतीयं पादमुच्चार्य सावित्रीमित्यतः परम्
verses.transliteration: praveshayAmi shabdAnte bhUromiti cha saMvadet | tR^itIyaM pAdamuchchArya sAvitrImityataH param
verses.translation: After saying this to Vamadeva his discij)le blessed by himself, the wise lord Subrahmauya delighted in mind said: —

verses.sanskrit: नैवेद्यमुत्तमं दद्यात्ताम्बूलादिमथापरम् । परितोष्य नमस्कृत्य निर्विघ्नं प्रार्थयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: naivedyamuttamaM dadyAttAmbUlAdimathAparam | paritoShya namaskR^itya nirvighnaM prArthayettataH
verses.translation: Hearing this from the lf)(u-.-like mouth of yours the great sage Sanatkumara, full of devotion to Siva, shall mention this to Vyasa. That excellent devotee of Siva will mention this to Suka.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते भूर्भुवः सुवरोमिति । उदीरयेत्परं प्रीत्या निश्चलात्मा मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: praveshayAmi shabdAnte bhUrbhuvaH suvaromiti | udIrayetparaM prItyA nishchalAtmA munIshvara
verses.translation: For every leading sage there will be four disciples. They will be masters of Vedic study and establish virtuous sacred rites.

verses.sanskrit: इयं भगवती साक्षाच्छङ्करार्द्धशरीरिणी । पञ्चवक्त्रा दशभुजा त्रिपञ्चनयनोज्ज्वला
verses.transliteration: iyaM bhagavatI sAkShAchCha~NkarArddhasharIriNI | pa~nchavaktrA dashabhujA tripa~nchanayanojjvalA
verses.translation: The four disciples of Vyasa are Vaihiinpayana, Paila, Jaimini and Sumantu.

verses.sanskrit: नवरत्नकिरीटोद्यच्चन्द्रलेखावतंसिनी । शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशा दशायुधधरा शुभा
verses.transliteration: navaratnakirITodyachchandralekhAvataMsinI | shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshA dashAyudhadharA shubhA
verses.translation: O sage Vamadeva, your disciples are Agasi ya, Pulastya, Pulaha and Kratu.

verses.sanskrit: हारकेयूरकटककिङ्किणीनूपुरादिभिः । भूषितावयवा दिव्यवसना रत्नभूषणा
verses.transliteration: hArakeyUrakaTakaki~NkiNInUpurAdibhiH | bhUShitAvayavA divyavasanA ratnabhUShaNA
verses.translation: Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatanamuni, and Sanatsu- j.lta, these great yogins, favourites of Siva, the knowers of the Vedas are the disciples of Sanatkumara. Thus the.se pre¬ ceptors, great preceptors etc. are worthy of being worshipped by the yogin Suka.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुना विधिना देवऋषिगन्धर्वदानवैः । मानवैश्च सदा सेव्या सर्वात्मव्यापिनी शिवा
verses.transliteration: viShNunA vidhinA devaR^iShigandharvadAnavaiH | mAnavaishcha sadA sevyA sarvAtmavyApinI shivA
verses.translation: This Manala as the seat of the great Jsiva is wonder¬ ful. It is worshipped by the great sages conversant with the essence of Vedanta. It is enveloped by the ether as mentioned in the Vedas. May it be conducive to your satisfaction and the welfare of the world. May it yield glory and prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवस्य देवस्य धर्मपत्नी मनोहरा । जगदम्बा त्रिजननी त्रिगुणा निर्गुणाप्यजा
verses.transliteration: sadAshivasya devasya dharmapatnI manoharA | jagadambA trijananI triguNA nirguNApyajA
verses.translation: Hence an ascetic who treads along this path attains Siva like the rivers that fall into the sea. By the repeated practice of the meditation "I am Siva", the ascetic becomes Siva. He can grant salvation even to the class of beings Brahma etc.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं संविचार्याथ गायत्रीं प्रजपेत्सुधीः । आदिदेवीं च त्रिपदां ब्राह्मणत्वादिदामजाम्
verses.transliteration: ityevaM saMvichAryAtha gAyatrIM prajapetsudhIH | AdidevIM cha tripadAM brAhmaNatvAdidAmajAm
verses.translation: After teaching this to. the sage the lord of gods remembered the lotus-like feet of his parents worshipped by the gods. Kumara reached Kailasa of many peaks, Kumara the preceptor who bestows perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: यो ह्यन्यथा जपेत्पापो गायत्रीं शिवरूपिणीम् । स पच्यते महाघोरे नरके कल्पसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: yo hyanyathA japetpApo gAyatrIM shivarUpiNIm | sa pachyate mahAghore narake kalpasa~NkhyayA
verses.translation: Accompanied by his disciples and making obei¬ sance to the peacock-vehicled lord, Vamadeva too immediately left for the wonderful mountain Kailasa.

verses.sanskrit: सा व्याहृतिभ्यः सञ्जाता तास्वेव विलयं गता । ताश्च प्रणवसम्भूता प्रणवे विलयं गताः
verses.transliteration: sA vyAhR^itibhyaH sa~njAtA tAsveva vilayaM gatA | tAshcha praNavasambhUtA praNave vilayaM gatAH
verses.translation: After reaching the summit of Kailasa the sage approached Siva. He saw the feet of the lord and the godd¬ ess— the feet that bestow salvation and destroy illusion.

verses.sanskrit: औपासनाग्नौ कर्त्तव्यं स्वगृह्योक्तविधानतः । आज्यभागान्तमाग्नेयं मखतन्त्रमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: aupAsanAgnau karttavyaM svagR^ihyoktavidhAnataH | AjyabhAgAntamAgneyaM makhatantramataH param
verses.translation: With great devotion he dedicated himself to him. He prostrated again and again and then got up.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभिश्च महादेवं साम्बं वह्नौ विभावयेत् । गौरीर्मिमाय मन्त्रेण हुत्वा गौरीमनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: brahmabhishcha mahAdevaM sAmbaM vahnau vibhAvayet | gaurIrmimAya mantreNa hutvA gaurImanusmaran
verses.translation: Then the sage, with various Vedic and Sastric hymns eulogised Siva together with Amba and their sons.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तद्देवान्समुद्दिश्य साङ्गं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः । एवमग्निमुखाद्यं यत्कर्मतन्त्रं प्रवर्त्तितम्
verses.transliteration: tattaddevAnsamuddishya sA~NgaM kuryAdvichakShaNaH | evamagnimukhAdyaM yatkarmatantraM pravarttitam
verses.translation: He put the lotus-likc feet of the lord and the god¬ dess on his head. With their blessings he stayed there comfortably.

verses.sanskrit: कालस्वभावो नियतिरिति च श्रुतिरब्रवीत् । एतत्पञ्चकमेवास्य पञ्चकञ्चुकमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: kAlasvabhAvo niyatiriti cha shrutirabravIt | etatpa~nchakamevAsya pa~nchaka~nchukamuchyate
verses.translation: All of you too shall learn the meaning of the Pranava Mahe.svara, the secret of the Vedas, of the Taraka Brahman, the bcsiower ol salvation. Remaining here itself

verses.sanskrit: लोकत्रयपदस्यान्ते व्यापिने परमात्मने । शिवायेदं न मम च पदं ब्रूयादतः परम्
verses.transliteration: lokatrayapadasyAnte vyApine paramAtmane | shivAyedaM na mama cha padaM brUyAdataH param
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशयामि शब्दान्ते सुवरोमित्युदीरयेत् । त्रिपादमुच्चरेत्पूर्वं सावित्रीमित्यतः परम्
verses.transliteration: praveshayAmi shabdAnte suvaromityudIrayet | tripAdamuchcharetpUrvaM sAvitrImityataH param
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवः सर्ववेदादिः प्रणवः शिववाचकः । मन्त्राधिराजराजश्च महाबीजं मनुः परः
verses.transliteration: praNavaH sarvavedAdiH praNavaH shivavAchakaH | mantrAdhirAjarAjashcha mahAbIjaM manuH paraH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: समस्तमित्यतो ब्रूयान्मयेति च समब्रवीत् । सदाशिवं हृदि ध्यात्वा मन्दादीति ततो मुने
verses.transliteration: samastamityato brUyAnmayeti cha samabravIt | sadAshivaM hR^idi dhyAtvA mandAdIti tato mune
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरुत्थाय च शनैः प्रेम्णा पश्यन्गुरुं निजम् । कृताञ्जलिपुटस्तिष्ठेद्गुरुपाद समीपतः
verses.transliteration: punarutthAya cha shanaiH premNA pashyanguruM nijam | kR^itA~njalipuTastiShThedgurupAda samIpataH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: तदाज्ञया ततः शिष्यो वेदान्तार्थानुसारतः । शिवज्ञानपरो भूयात्सगुणागुणभेदतः
verses.transliteration: tadAj~nayA tataH shiShyo vedAntArthAnusArataH | shivaj~nAnaparo bhUyAtsaguNAguNabhedataH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: शिवो वा प्रणवो ह्येष प्रणवो वा शिवः स्मृतः । वाच्यवाचकयोर्भेदो नात्यन्तं विद्यते यतः
verses.transliteration: shivo vA praNavo hyeSha praNavo vA shivaH smR^itaH | vAchyavAchakayorbhedo nAtyantaM vidyate yataH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: एनमेव महामन्त्रं जीवानां च तनुत्यजाम् । काश्यां संश्राव्य मरणे दत्ते मुक्तिं परां शिवः
verses.transliteration: enameva mahAmantraM jIvAnAM cha tanutyajAm | kAshyAM saMshrAvya maraNe datte muktiM parAM shivaH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेकाक्षरं देवं शिवं परमकारणम् । उपासते यतिश्रेष्ठा हृदयाम्भोजमध्यगम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAdekAkSharaM devaM shivaM paramakAraNam | upAsate yatishreShThA hR^idayAmbhojamadhyagam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: मुमुक्षवोऽपरे धीरा विरक्ता लौकिका नराः । विषयान्मनसा ज्ञात्वोपासते परमं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: mumukShavo.apare dhIrA viraktA laukikA narAH | viShayAnmanasA j~nAtvopAsate paramaM shivam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विलाप्य गायत्रीं प्रणवे शिववाचके । अहं वृक्षस्य रेरिवेत्यनुवाकं जपेत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: evaM vilApya gAyatrIM praNave shivavAchake | ahaM vR^ikShasya rerivetyanuvAkaM japetpunaH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: यश्छन्दसामामृषभ इत्यनुवाकमुपक्रमात् । गोपायान्तं जपन्पश्चादुत्थितोहमितीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: yashChandasAmAmR^iShabha ityanuvAkamupakramAt | gopAyAntaM japanpashchAdutthitohamitIrayet
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: वदेज्जपेत् त्रिधा मन्दमध्योच्छ्रायक्रमान्मुने । प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धत्य सृष्टिस्थितिलयक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vadejjapet tridhA mandamadhyochChrAyakramAnmune | praNavaM pUrvamuddhatya sR^iShTisthitilayakramAt
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामथ क्रमाद्भूयाद्भूः संन्यस्तम्भुवस्तथा । संन्यस्तं सुवरित्युक्त्वा सन्न्यस्तं पदमुच्चरम्
verses.transliteration: teShAmatha kramAdbhUyAdbhUH sa.nnyastambhuvastathA | sa.nnyastaM suvarityuktvA sannyastaM padamuchcharam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमन्त्रान्त प्रदेशे मयेति च पदं वदेत् । प्रणवं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य समष्टिव्याहृतीर्वदेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvamantrAnta pradeshe mayeti cha padaM vadet | praNavaM pUrvamuddhR^itya samaShTivyAhR^itIrvadet
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: भूःस्वाहेति त्र्यृचा पूर्णाहुतिं हुत्वा समाप्य च । गायत्रीं प्रजपेद्यावदपराह्णमतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: bhUHsvAheti tryR^ichA pUrNAhutiM hutvA samApya cha | gAyatrIM prajapedyAvadaparAhNamatandritaH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: प्रैषमन्त्रांस्तु जप्त्वैवं सावधानेन चेतसा । अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो मत्तः स्वाहेति सञ्जपन्
verses.transliteration: praiShamantrAMstu japtvaivaM sAvadhAnena chetasA | abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo mattaH svAheti sa~njapan
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: प्राच्यां दिश्यप उद्धृत्य प्रक्षिपेदजलिं ततः । शिखां यज्ञोपवीतं च यत्रोत्पाट्य च पाणिना
verses.transliteration: prAchyAM dishyapa uddhR^itya prakShipedajaliM tataH | shikhAM yaj~nopavItaM cha yatrotpATya cha pANinA
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा प्रणवं भूश्च समुद्रं गच्छ संवदेत् । वह्निजायां समुच्चार्य्य सोदकाञ्जलिना ततः
verses.transliteration: gR^ihItvA praNavaM bhUshcha samudraM gachCha saMvadet | vahnijAyAM samuchchAryya sodakA~njalinA tataH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु हूयादथ प्रेषैरभिमन्त्र्य त्रिधा त्वपः । प्राश्य तीरे समागत्य भूमौ वस्त्रादिकं त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: apsu hUyAdatha preShairabhimantrya tridhA tvapaH | prAshya tIre samAgatya bhUmau vastrAdikaM tyajet
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्मुखो वा गच्छेस्सप्तपदाधिकम् । किञ्चिद्दूरमथाचार्यस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति संवदेत्
verses.transliteration: uda~NmukhaH prA~Nmukho vA gachChessaptapadAdhikam | ki~nchiddUramathAchAryastiShTha tiShTheti saMvadet
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: लोकस्य व्यवहारार्थं कौपीनं दण्डमेव च । भगवन्स्वीकुरुष्वेति दद्यात्स्वेनैव पाणिना
verses.transliteration: lokasya vyavahArArthaM kaupInaM daNDameva cha | bhagavansvIkuruShveti dadyAtsvenaiva pANinA
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा सुदोरं कौपीनं काषायवसनं ततः । आच्छाद्याचम्य च द्वेधा त शिष्यमिति संवदेत्
verses.transliteration: dattvA sudoraM kaupInaM kAShAyavasanaM tataH | AchChAdyAchamya cha dvedhA ta shiShyamiti saMvadet
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वज्रोऽसि तत इति मन्त्रमुदाहरेत् । सम्प्रार्थ्य दण्डं गृह्णीयात्सखाय इति सञ्जपन्
verses.transliteration: indrasya vajro.asi tata iti mantramudAharet | samprArthya daNDaM gR^ihNIyAtsakhAya iti sa~njapan
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: अथ गत्वा गुरोः पार्श्वं शिवपादाम्बुजं स्मरन् । प्रणमेद्दण्डवद्भूमौ त्रिवारं संयतात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: atha gatvA guroH pArshvaM shivapAdAmbujaM smaran | praNameddaNDavadbhUmau trivAraM saMyatAtmavAn
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सायन्तनीं सन्ध्यामुपास्य स्नानपूर्वकम् । सायमौपासनं हुत्वा मौनी विज्ञापयेद् गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: atha sAyantanIM sandhyAmupAsya snAnapUrvakam | sAyamaupAsanaM hutvA maunI vij~nApayed gurum
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: कर्म्मारम्भात्पूर्वमेव गृहीत्वा गोमयं शुभम् । स्थूलामलकमात्रेण कृत्वा पिण्डान्विशोषयेत
verses.transliteration: karmmArambhAtpUrvameva gR^ihItvA gomayaM shubham | sthUlAmalakamAtreNa kR^itvA piNDAnvishoShayeta
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सौरैस्तु किरणैरेव होमारम्भाग्निमध्यगान् । निक्षिप्य होमसम्पूर्त्तौ भस्म सङ्गृह्य गोपयेत्
verses.transliteration: sauraistu kiraNaireva homArambhAgnimadhyagAn | nikShipya homasampUrttau bhasma sa~NgR^ihya gopayet
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गुरुस्समादाय विरजानलजं सितम् । भस्म तेनैव तं शिष्यमग्निरित्यादिभिः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tato gurussamAdAya virajAnalajaM sitam | bhasma tenaiva taM shiShyamagnirityAdibhiH kramAt
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रैरङ्गानि संस्पृश्य मूर्द्धादिचरणान्ततः । ईशानाद्यैः पञ्चमन्त्रै शिर आरभ्य सर्वतः

verses.sanskrit: ते शप्ता मुनिभिः षड्भिः शिवनिन्दापराः पुरा । न श्रोतव्या हि तद्वार्त्ता तेऽन्यथावादिनो यतः
verses.transliteration: te shaptA munibhiH ShaDbhiH shivanindAparAH purA | na shrotavyA hi tadvArttA te.anyathAvAdino yataH

verses.sanskrit: वामदेव उवाच । ज्ञानशक्तिधर स्वामिन्परमानन्दविग्रह । प्रणवार्थामृतं पीतं श्रीमुखाब्जात्परिस्रुतम्

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतस्याग्निमद्भावं वदन्त्यत्रापि सुव्रत । प्रत्यक्षस्य प्रपञ्चस्य दर्शनालम्बनं त्वतः
verses.transliteration: parvatasyAgnimadbhAvaM vadantyatrApi suvrata | pratyakShasya prapa~nchasya darshanAlambanaM tvataH

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातव्यः परमेशानः परमात्मा न संशयः । स्त्रीपुंरूपमयं विश्वं प्रत्यक्षेणैव दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: j~nAtavyaH parameshAnaH paramAtmA na saMshayaH | strIpuMrUpamayaM vishvaM pratyakSheNaiva dR^ishyate

verses.sanskrit: षट्कोशरूपः पिण्डो हि तत्र चाद्यत्रयं भवेत् । मात्रंशजं पुनश्चान्यत्पित्रंशजमिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: ShaTkosharUpaH piNDo hi tatra chAdyatrayaM bhavet | mAtraMshajaM punashchAnyatpitraMshajamiti shrutiH

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वशरीरेषु स्त्रीपुम्भावविदो जनाः । परमात्मन्यपि मुने स्त्रीपुम्भावं विदुर्बुधाः
verses.transliteration: evaM sarvasharIreShu strIpumbhAvavido janAH | paramAtmanyapi mune strIpumbhAvaM vidurbudhAH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सच्चिदानदरूपत्वं वदति ब्रह्मणः श्रुतिः । असन्निवर्तकः शब्दः सदात्मेति निगद्यते
verses.transliteration: sachchidAnadarUpatvaM vadati brahmaNaH shrutiH | asannivartakaH shabdaH sadAtmeti nigadyate
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: निवर्तनं जडत्वस्य चिच्छब्देन विधीयते । त्रिलिङ्गवर्ती सच्छब्दः पुरुषोऽत्र विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: nivartanaM jaDatvasya chichChabdena vidhIyate | trili~NgavartI sachChabdaH puruSho.atra vidhIyatAm

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशवाची स भवेत्सत्प्रकाश इति स्फुटम् । ज्ञानशब्दस्य पर्यायश्चिच्छब्दः स्त्रीत्वमागतः
verses.transliteration: prakAshavAchI sa bhavetsatprakAsha iti sphuTam | j~nAnashabdasya paryAyashchichChabdaH strItvamAgataH

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशश्चिच्च मिथुनं जगत्कारणतां गतम् । सच्चिदात्मन्यपि तथा जगत्कारणतां गते
verses.transliteration: prakAshashchichcha mithunaM jagatkAraNatAM gatam | sachchidAtmanyapi tathA jagatkAraNatAM gate

verses.sanskrit: एकत्रैव शिवः शक्तिरिति भावो विधीयते । तैलवर्त्त्यादिमालिन्यात्प्रकाशस्यापि वर्तते
verses.transliteration: ekatraiva shivaH shaktiriti bhAvo vidhIyate | tailavarttyAdimAlinyAtprakAshasyApi vartate

verses.sanskrit: दृढप्रज्ञश्च जातोऽस्मि सन्देहो विगतो मम । किञ्चिदन्यन्महासेन पृच्छामि त्वां शृणु प्रभो
verses.transliteration: dR^iDhapraj~nashcha jAto.asmi sandeho vigato mama | ki~nchidanyanmahAsena pR^ichChAmi tvAM shR^iNu prabho

verses.sanskrit: जीवाश्रितायाश्चिच्छक्तेर्दौर्बल्यं विद्यते सदा । तन्निवृत्त्यर्थमेवात्र शक्तित्वं सार्वकालिकम्
verses.transliteration: jIvAshritAyAshchichChakterdaurbalyaM vidyate sadA | tannivR^ittyarthamevAtra shaktitvaM sArvakAlikam

verses.sanskrit: बलवान् शक्तिमांश्चेति व्यवहारः प्रदृश्यते । लोके वेदे च सततं वामदेव महामुने
verses.transliteration: balavAn shaktimAMshcheti vyavahAraH pradR^ishyate | loke vede cha satataM vAmadeva mahAmune

verses.sanskrit: एवं शिवत्वं शक्तित्वं परमात्मनि दर्शितम् । शिवशक्त्योस्तु संयोगादानन्दः सततोदितः
verses.transliteration: evaM shivatvaM shaktitvaM paramAtmani darshitam | shivashaktyostu saMyogAdAnandaH satatoditaH

verses.sanskrit: अतो मुने तमुद्दिश्य मुनयः क्षीणकल्मषाः । शिवे मनः समाधाय प्राप्ताः शिवमनामयम्
verses.transliteration: ato mune tamuddishya munayaH kShINakalmaShAH | shive manaH samAdhAya prAptAH shivamanAmayam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मत्वं तयोरेवं ब्रह्मेत्युपनिषत्सु च । गीयते ब्रह्मशब्देन बृंहिधात्वर्थगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAtmatvaM tayorevaM brahmetyupaniShatsu cha | gIyate brahmashabdena bR^iMhidhAtvarthagocharam

verses.sanskrit: बृंहणत्वं बृहत्वं च शम्भ्वाख्यविग्रहे । पञ्चब्रह्ममये विश्वप्रतीतिर्ब्रह्मशब्दिता
verses.transliteration: bR^iMhaNatvaM bR^ihatvaM cha shambhvAkhyavigrahe | pa~nchabrahmamaye vishvapratItirbrahmashabditA

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिलोमात्मकं हंसे वक्ष्यामि प्रणवोद्भवम् । तव स्नेहाद्वामदेव सावधानतया शृणु
verses.transliteration: pratilomAtmakaM haMse vakShyAmi praNavodbhavam | tava snehAdvAmadeva sAvadhAnatayA shR^iNu
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: व्यञ्जनस्य सकारस्य हकारस्य च वर्जनात् । ओमित्येव भवेत्स्थूलो वाचकः परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: vya~njanasya sakArasya hakArasya cha varjanAt | omityeva bhavetsthUlo vAchakaH paramAtmanaH

verses.sanskrit: महामन्त्रः स विज्ञेयो मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः । तत्र सूक्ष्मो महामन्त्रस्तदुद्धारं वदामि ते

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवादिकीटान्तरूपस्य जगतः स्थितिः । स्त्रीपुंरूपेण सर्वत्र दृश्यते न हि संशयः
verses.transliteration: sadAshivAdikITAntarUpasya jagataH sthitiH | strIpuMrUpeNa sarvatra dR^ishyate na hi saMshayaH

verses.sanskrit: हंसस्य प्रतिलोमः स्यात्सकारार्थः शिवः स्मृतः । शक्त्यात्मको महामन्त्रवाच्यः स्यादिति निर्णयः
verses.transliteration: haMsasya pratilomaH syAtsakArArthaH shivaH smR^itaH | shaktyAtmako mahAmantravAchyaH syAditi nirNayaH

verses.sanskrit: गुरूपदेशकाले तु सोऽहंशक्त्यात्मकः शिवः । इति जीवपरो भूयान्महामन्त्रस्तदा पशुः

verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादिशिवसूत्राणां वार्तिकं कथितं मया । ज्ञानं बन्ध इतीदं तु द्वितीयं सूत्रमीशितुः

verses.sanskrit: एतद् द्वयं पराशक्तेः प्रथमं स्पन्दतां गतम् । एतामेव परां शक्तिं श्वेताश्वतरशाखिनः
verses.transliteration: etad dvayaM parAshakteH prathamaM spandatAM gatam | etAmeva parAM shaktiM shvetAshvatarashAkhinaH

verses.sanskrit: स्वाभाविकी ज्ञानबलक्रिया चेत्यस्तुवन्मुदा । ज्ञानक्रियेच्छारूपं हि शम्भोर्दृष्टित्रयं विदुः
verses.transliteration: svAbhAvikI j~nAnabalakriyA chetyastuvanmudA | j~nAnakriyechChArUpaM hi shambhordR^iShTitrayaM viduH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: एवं रूपस्य जगतः कारणं यत्सनातनम् । स्त्रीरूपं तत्किमाहोस्वित्पुरुषो वा नपुंसकम्
verses.transliteration: evaM rUpasya jagataH kAraNaM yatsanAtanam | strIrUpaM tatkimAhosvitpuruSho vA napuMsakam

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादात्मन एवेदं रूपमित्येव निश्चितम् । प्रपञ्चार्थं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रणवैक्यप्रदर्शनम्

verses.sanskrit: ओमितीदं सर्वमिति श्रुतिराह सनातनी । तस्माद्वेतीत्युपक्रम्य जगत्सृष्टिः प्रकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: omitIdaM sarvamiti shrutirAha sanAtanI | tasmAdvetItyupakramya jagatsR^iShTiH prakIrtitA

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः श्रुतेस्तु तात्पर्यं वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतामिदम् । तव स्नेहाद्वामदेव विवेकार्थविजृम्भितम्
verses.transliteration: tasyAH shrutestu tAtparyaM vakShyAmi shrUyatAmidam | tava snehAdvAmadeva vivekArthavijR^imbhitam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: शिवशक्तिसमायोगः परमात्मेति निश्चितम् । पराशक्तेस्तु सञ्जाता चिच्छक्तिस्तु तदुद्भवा
verses.transliteration: shivashaktisamAyogaH paramAtmeti nishchitam | parAshaktestu sa~njAtA chichChaktistu tadudbhavA

verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: चिदानन्दसमुत्पन्नौ नादबिन्दू प्रकीर्तितौ । इच्छाशक्तेर्मकारस्तु ज्ञानशक्तेस्तु पञ्चमः

verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: स्वरः क्रियाशक्तिजातो ह्यकारस्तु मुनीश्वर । इत्युक्ता प्रणवोत्पत्तिः पञ्चब्रह्मोद्भवं शृणु

verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: शिवादीशान उत्पन्नस्ततस्तत्पुरुषोद्भवः । ततोऽघोरस्ततो वामः सद्योजातोद्भवस्ततः

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.१९. एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः । योगपट्टविधिवर्णनम् । सुब्रह्मण्य उवाच । (१) प्रज्ञानं ब्रह्म (२) अहं ब्रह्मास्मि (३) तत्त्वमसि (४) अयामात्मा ब्रह्म (५) ईशा वास्यमिदं सर्वं (६) प्राणोऽस्मि (७) प्रज्ञानात्मा (८) यदेवेह तदमुत्र यदमुत्र तदन्विह (९) अन्यदेव तद्विदितादथो अविदितादधि (१०) एष न आत्मान्तर्याम्यमृतः (११) स यश्चायं पुरुषे यश्चासावादित्ये स एकः (१२) अहमस्मि परं ब्रह्म परापरपरात्परम् (१३) वेदशास्त्रगुरुत्वात्तु स्वयमानन्दलक्षणम् (१४) सर्वभूतस्थितं ब्रह्म तदेवाहं न संशयः (१५) तत्त्वस्य प्राणोऽहमस्मि पृथिव्याः प्राणोऽहमस्मि (१६) अपां च प्राणोऽहमस्मि तेजसश्च प्राणोऽहमस्मि (१७) वायोश्च प्राणोऽहमस्मि आकाशस्य प्राणोऽहमस्मि (१८) त्रिगुणस्य प्राणोऽहमस्मि (१९) सर्वोऽहं सर्वात्मकोऽहं संसारी यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यं यद्वर्तमानं सर्वात्मकत्वादद्वितीयोऽहम् (२०) सर्वं खल्विदं ब्रह्म (२१) सर्वोऽहं विमुक्तोऽहम् (२२) योऽसौ सोऽहं हंसः सोऽहमस्मि

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता ६.२०. विंशोऽध्यायः । क्षौरस्नानविधिवर्णनम् । सुब्रह्मण्य उवाच । क्षौरस्नानविधिं वक्ष्ये वामदेव महामुने । यस्य सद्यो विधानेन शुद्धिः स्याद्यतिनः परा
verses.transliteration: OM namaH shivAya || ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA 6\.20\. viMsho.adhyAyaH | kShaurasnAnavidhivarNanam | subrahmaNya uvAcha | kShaurasnAnavidhiM vakShye vAmadeva mahAmune | yasya sadyo vidhAnena shuddhiH syAdyatinaH parA

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैकां मृदमादाय दापयित्वान्यपाणिना । करौ द्वादशधालिप्य प्रत्येकं केन क्षालयेत्

verses.sanskrit: पुनरेकां पादयोश्च मुखे चान्यां करे क्रमात् । संलिप्याक्षाल्य चाम्भोभिः पुनश्च जलमाविशेत्

verses.sanskrit: अन्यां मृदं भागयित्वा शिरसि द्वादश क्रमात् । आलिप्य मृदमास्यान्तं निमज्य च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: anyAM mR^idaM bhAgayitvA shirasi dvAdasha kramAt | Alipya mR^idamAsyAntaM nimajya cha punaH punaH

verses.sanskrit: तीरं गत्वा तु गण्डूषान् षोडशाचमनं द्विधा । प्राणानायम्य च पुनः प्रणवं द्व्यष्टसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: tIraM gatvA tu gaNDUShAn ShoDashAchamanaM dvidhA | prANAnAyamya cha punaH praNavaM dvyaShTasa~NkhyayA

verses.sanskrit: मृदमन्यां पुनस्त्रेधा विभज्य च तदेकया । कटिशौचं पादशौचं विधायाचम्य च द्विधा

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवेनाथ षोडश प्राणानायम्य वाग्यतः । पुनरन्यां स्वोरुदेशे त्रिधा विन्यस्य चोमिति

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्ष्याभिमन्त्रयेत्सप्त स्वपाण्योस्तलमेकधा । त्रिधालिप्याथ सम्पश्येत्सूर्यमूर्तिं च पावनीम्
verses.transliteration: prokShyAbhimantrayetsapta svapANyostalamekadhA | tridhAlipyAtha sampashyetsUryamUrtiM cha pAvanIm

verses.sanskrit: स्वकक्षयोः समालिप्य व्यत्यस्ताभ्यामथान्यया । पाणिभ्यां च मृदा शिष्यः सुमतिर्दृढमानसः
verses.transliteration: svakakShayoH samAlipya vyatyastAbhyAmathAnyayA | pANibhyAM cha mR^idA shiShyaH sumatirdR^iDhamAnasaH

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वान्यां मृदं शुद्धां तथासौ गुरुभक्तिमान् । शिर आरभ्य पादान्तं विलिप्यादित्यदृष्टया
verses.transliteration: gR^ihItvAnyAM mR^idaM shuddhAM tathAsau gurubhaktimAn | shira Arabhya pAdAntaM vilipyAdityadR^iShTayA

verses.sanskrit: योगपट्टप्रकारस्य विधिं प्राप्य मुनीश्वर । स शिष्यः स्याद् व्रती पूर्णः क्षौरकर्मोद्यतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yogapaTTaprakArasya vidhiM prApya munIshvara | sa shiShyaH syAd vratI pUrNaH kShaurakarmodyato bhavet

verses.sanskrit: ततः साम्बं महेशानं शङ्करं चन्द्रशेखरम् । संस्मरेद्भक्तितः शिष्य सर्वैश्वर्यपतिं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sAmbaM maheshAnaM sha~NkaraM chandrashekharam | saMsmaredbhaktitaH shiShya sarvaishvaryapatiM shivam

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवारं प्रणमेत्प्रीत्या साष्टाङ्गं च गुरुं शिवम् । पञ्चाङ्गेनैकवारं च समुत्थाय च वन्दयेत्

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं प्रविश्य तन्मध्ये निमज्योन्मज्य तां मृदम् । स्कन्धे संस्थाप्य पूर्वोक्तप्रकारेण विलेपयेत्

verses.sanskrit: तत्रावशिष्टं सङ्गृह्य जलमध्ये प्रविश्य च । विलोड्य सम्यक् तां तत्र सर्वाङ्गेषु विलिप्य च
verses.transliteration: tatrAvashiShTaM sa~NgR^ihya jalamadhye pravishya cha | viloDya samyak tAM tatra sarvA~NgeShu vilipya cha

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवारमोमिति प्रोच्य शिवपादाम्बुजं स्मरन् । संसाराम्बुधिसन्तारं सदा यद्विधितो हि सः

verses.sanskrit: समुत्थाय ततोऽसौ वै दण्डमादाय भूतले । स्वगुरुं मन्त्रदं भक्त्या संस्मरेज्ज्ञाननिष्ठया

verses.sanskrit: आपोशनं समर्प्याथ प्रार्थयेत्तानिदं प्रति । सदाशिवादयः प्रीता वरदाश्च भवन्तु मे

verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: ये देवा इति च ततो जप्त्वेदं साक्षतं त्यजेत् । नमस्कृत्य समुत्थाय सर्वत्रामृतमस्त्विति
verses.transliteration: ye devA iti cha tato japtvedaM sAkShataM tyajet | namaskR^itya samutthAya sarvatrAmR^itamastviti
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: उक्त्वा प्रसाद्य च जपन् गणानां त्वेत्युपक्रमात् । वेदादीन् रुद्रचमकौ रुद्रसूक्तं च पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: uktvA prasAdya cha japan gaNAnAM tvetyupakramAt | vedAdIn rudrachamakau rudrasUktaM cha pa~ncha cha
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: विप्राणां भोजनान्ते तु यावन्मन्त्रांश्च साक्षतान् । दत्त्वोत्तरापोशनं च हस्ताङ्घ्रिमुखशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: viprANAM bhojanAnte tu yAvanmantrAMshcha sAkShatAn | dattvottarAposhanaM cha hastA~Nghrimukhashodhanam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाचान्तान् स्वासनेषु स्थापयित्वा यथासुखम् । शुद्धोदकं प्रदायाथ कर्पूरादि यथोदितम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvAchAntAn svAsaneShu sthApayitvA yathAsukham | shuddhodakaM pradAyAtha karpUrAdi yathoditam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: निमन्त्र्य तान्समाहूय मध्याह्ने चाप्लुताञ्छुचीन् । विधिवद्भोजयेद्भक्त्या स्वाद्वन्नैर्विविधैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: nimantrya tAnsamAhUya madhyAhne chAplutA~nChuchIn | vidhivadbhojayedbhaktyA svAdvannairvividhaiH shubhaiH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणनमस्कारैः सन्तोष्याशिषमा वहेत । पुनः प्रणम्य सम्प्रार्थ्य गुरुभक्तिमचञ्चलाम्
verses.transliteration: pradakShiNanamaskAraiH santoShyAshiShamA vaheta | punaH praNamya samprArthya gurubhaktimacha~nchalAm
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवादयः प्रीता गच्छन्तु च यथासुखम् । इत्युद्वास्य द्वारदेशावधि सम्यगनुव्रजन्
verses.transliteration: sadAshivAdayaH prItA gachChantu cha yathAsukham | ityudvAsya dvAradeshAvadhi samyaganuvrajan
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: निरुद्धस्तैः परावृत्य द्वाःस्थैर्विप्रैश्च बन्धुभिः । दीनानाथैश्च सहितो भुक्त्वा तिष्ठेद्यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: niruddhastaiH parAvR^itya dvAHsthairvipraishcha bandhubhiH | dInAnAthaishcha sahito bhuktvA tiShThedyathAsukham
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: विकृतं न भवेत्क्वापि सत्यं सत्यं पुनः पुनः । प्रत्यब्दमेवं कुर्वाणो गुर्वाराधनमुत्तमम् । इह भुक्त्वा महाभोगान् शिवलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: vikR^itaM na bhavetkvApi satyaM satyaM punaH punaH | pratyabdamevaM kurvANo gurvArAdhanamuttamam | iha bhuktvA mahAbhogAn shivalokamavApnuyAt
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं कृतानुग्रहमात्मशिष्यं, श्रीवामदेवं मुनिवर्यमुक्त्वा । प्रसन्नधीर्ज्ञानिवरो महात्मा, कृत्वा परानुग्रहमाशु देवः
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM kR^itAnugrahamAtmashiShyaM, shrIvAmadevaM munivaryamuktvA | prasannadhIrj~nAnivaro mahAtmA, kR^itvA parAnugrahamAshu devaH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: यन्नैमिषारण्यमुनीश्वराणां, प्रोक्तं पुरा व्यासमुनीश्वरेण । तस्मादसावादिगुरुर्भवांस्तु, द्वितीय आर्यो भुवने प्रसिद्धः
verses.transliteration: yannaimiShAraNyamunIshvarANAM, proktaM purA vyAsamunIshvareNa | tasmAdasAvAdigururbhavAMstu, dvitIya Aryo bhuvane prasiddhaH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा मुनीन्द्रो भवतो मुखाज्जात्, सनत्कुमारः शिवभक्तिपूर्णः । व्यासाय वक्ता स च शैववर्यः शुकाय वक्ता भविता च पूर्णः
verses.transliteration: shrutvA munIndro bhavato mukhAjjAt, sanatkumAraH shivabhaktipUrNaH | vyAsAya vaktA sa cha shaivavaryaH shukAya vaktA bhavitA cha pUrNaH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्येकं मुनिशार्दूल शिष्यवर्गचतुष्टयम् । वेदाध्ययनसंवृत्तं धर्मस्थापनपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: pratyekaM munishArdUla shiShyavargachatuShTayam | vedAdhyayanasaMvR^ittaM dharmasthApanapUrvakam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन एव स्यात्पैलो जैमिनिरेव च । सुमन्तुश्चेति चत्वारो व्यासशिष्या महौजसः
verses.transliteration: vaishampAyana eva syAtpailo jaiminireva cha | sumantushcheti chatvAro vyAsashiShyA mahaujasaH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सन्निधौ परमेशस्य पञ्चावरणमार्गतः । पूजयेत्तत्र संस्थाप्य प्राणानायम्य वाग्यतः
verses.transliteration: sannidhau parameshasya pa~nchAvaraNamArgataH | pUjayettatra saMsthApya prANAnAyamya vAgyataH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सनकश्च सनन्दश्च सनातनमुनिस्ततः । सनत्सुजात इत्येते योगिवर्याः शिवप्रियाः
verses.transliteration: sanakashcha sanandashcha sanAtanamunistataH | sanatsujAta ityete yogivaryAH shivapriyAH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारशिष्यास्ते सर्ववेदार्थवित्तमाः । गुरुश्च परमश्चैव परात्परगुरुस्ततः । परमेष्ठिगुरुश्चैते पूज्याः स्युः शुकयोगिनः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumArashiShyAste sarvavedArthavittamAH | gurushcha paramashchaiva parAtparagurustataH | parameShThigurushchaite pUjyAH syuH shukayoginaH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: इदं प्रणवविज्ञानं स्थितं वर्गचतुष्टये । सर्वोत्कृष्टनिदानं च काश्यां सन्मुक्तिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: idaM praNavavij~nAnaM sthitaM vargachatuShTaye | sarvotkR^iShTanidAnaM cha kAshyAM sanmuktikAraNam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: एतन्मण्डलमद्भुतं परशिवाधिष्ठान रूपं सदा, वेदान्तार्थविचारपूर्णमतिभिः पूज्यं यतीन्द्रैः परम् । वेदादिप्रविभागकल्पितमहाकाशादिनाप्यावृतं, त्वत्सन्तोषकरं तथास्तु जगतां श्रेयस्करं श्रीप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: etanmaNDalamadbhutaM parashivAdhiShThAna rUpaM sadA, vedAntArthavichArapUrNamatibhiH pUjyaM yatIndraiH param | vedAdipravibhAgakalpitamahAkAshAdinApyAvR^itaM, tvatsantoShakaraM tathAstu jagatAM shreyaskaraM shrIpradam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: इदं रहस्यं परमं शिवोदितं, वेदान्तसिद्धान्तविनिश्चितं परम् । मत्तः श्रुतं यद्भवता ततो मुने, भवन्मतं प्राज्ञतमा वदन्ति
verses.transliteration: idaM rahasyaM paramaM shivoditaM, vedAntasiddhAntavinishchitaM param | mattaH shrutaM yadbhavatA tato mune, bhavanmataM prAj~natamA vadanti
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनेनैव पथा गतः शिवं, शिवोऽहमस्मीति शिवो भवेद्यतिः । पितामहादिप्रविभागमुक्तये, नद्यो यथा सिन्धुमिमाः प्रयान्ति
verses.transliteration: tasmAdanenaiva pathA gataH shivaM, shivo.ahamasmIti shivo bhavedyatiH | pitAmahAdipravibhAgamuktaye, nadyo yathA sindhumimAH prayAnti
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं मुनीश्वरायैतदुपदिश्य सुरेश्वरः । संस्मृत्य चरणाम्भोजे पित्रोः सर्वसुरार्चिते
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM munIshvarAyaitadupadishya sureshvaraH | saMsmR^itya charaNAmbhoje pitroH sarvasurArchite
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासशिखरं पराप कुमारः शिखरावृतम् । राजितं परमाश्चर्यं दिव्यज्ञानप्रदो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: kailAsashikharaM parApa kumAraH shikharAvR^itam | rAjitaM paramAshcharyaM divyaj~nAnaprado guruH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवोऽपि सच्छिष्यैः संवृतः शिखिवाहनम् । सम्प्रणम्य जगामाशु कैलासं परमाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: vAmadevo.api sachChiShyaiH saMvR^itaH shikhivAhanam | sampraNamya jagAmAshu kailAsaM paramAdbhutam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: महासङ्कल्पमार्गेण सङ्कल्प्यास्मद्गुरोरिह । पूजां करिष्य इत्युक्त्वा ततो दर्भानुपस्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: mahAsa~NkalpamArgeNa sa~NkalpyAsmadguroriha | pUjAM kariShya ityuktvA tato darbhAnupaspR^ishet
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या चार्पितसर्वाङ्गो विस्मृत्य स्वकलेवरम् । पपात सन्निधौ भूयो भूयो नत्वा समुत्थितः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyA chArpitasarvA~Ngo vismR^itya svakalevaram | papAta sannidhau bhUyo bhUyo natvA samutthitaH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: ततो बहुविधैः स्तोत्रैर्वेदागमरसोत्कटैः । तुष्टाव परमेशानं साम्बिकं ससुतं मुनिः
verses.transliteration: tato bahuvidhaiH stotrairvedAgamarasotkaTaiH | tuShTAva parameshAnaM sAmbikaM sasutaM muniH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: निधाय चरणाम्भोजं देवदेव्योः स्वमूर्द्धनि । पूर्णानुग्रहमासाद्य तत्रैव न्यवसत्सुखम्
verses.transliteration: nidhAya charaNAmbhojaM devadevyoH svamUrddhani | pUrNAnugrahamAsAdya tatraiva nyavasatsukham
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तोऽपि विदित्वैवं प्रपणवार्थं महेश्वरम् । वेदगुह्यं च सर्वस्वं तारकं ब्रह्म मुक्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: bhavanto.api viditvaivaM prapaNavArthaM maheshvaram | vedaguhyaM cha sarvasvaM tArakaM brahma muktidam
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रैव सुखमासीनाः श्रीविश्वेश्वरपादयोः । सायुज्यरूपामतुलां भजध्वं मुक्तिमुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: atraiva sukhamAsInAH shrIvishveshvarapAdayoH | sAyujyarUpAmatulAM bhajadhvaM muktimuttamAm
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: अहं गुरुपदाम्भोजसेवायै बादराश्रमम् । गमिष्ये भवतां भूयः सत्सम्भाषणमस्तु मे
verses.transliteration: ahaM gurupadAmbhojasevAyai bAdarAshramam | gamiShye bhavatAM bhUyaH satsambhAShaNamastu me
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: पादौ प्रक्षाल्य चाचम्य स्वयं कर्ता च वाग्यतः । स्थापयेदासने तान्वै प्राङ्मुखान्भस्मभूषितान्
verses.transliteration: pAdau prakShAlya chAchamya svayaM kartA cha vAgyataH | sthApayedAsane tAnvai prA~NmukhAnbhasmabhUShitAn
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवादिक्रमतो ध्यायेदष्टौ च तत्र तान् । परया सम्भावनयेतरानपि मुने द्विजान्
verses.transliteration: sadAshivAdikramato dhyAyedaShTau cha tatra tAn | parayA sambhAvanayetarAnapi mune dvijAn
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा पुष्पैरलङ्कृत्य प्रणवाद्यष्टनामभिः । सचतुर्थीनमोऽन्तैश्च सुगन्धकुसुमैस्ततः
verses.transliteration: dattvA puShpairala~NkR^itya praNavAdyaShTanAmabhiH | sachaturthInamo.antaishcha sugandhakusumaistataH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: मुखवासं दक्षिणां च पादुकासनपत्रकम् । व्यजनं फलकं दण्डं वैणवं च प्रदाय तान्
verses.transliteration: mukhavAsaM dakShiNAM cha pAdukAsanapatrakam | vyajanaM phalakaM daNDaM vaiNavaM cha pradAya tAn
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यश्च पुलस्त्यश्च पुलहः क्रतुरेव च । तव शिष्या महात्मानो वामदेव महामुने
verses.transliteration: agastyashcha pulastyashcha pulahaH kratureva cha | tava shiShyA mahAtmAno vAmadeva mahAmune
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा कैलासशिखरं प्राप्येशनिकटं मुनिः । ददर्श मोक्षदं मायानाशं चरणमीशयोः
verses.transliteration: gatvA kailAsashikharaM prApyeshanikaTaM muniH | dadarsha mokShadaM mAyAnAshaM charaNamIshayoH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: परमेष्ठिगुरुं ध्यायेत्साम्बबुद्ध्या स्वनामतः । गुरुं च परमं तस्मात्परापरगुरुं ततः
verses.transliteration: parameShThiguruM dhyAyetsAmbabuddhyA svanAmataH | guruM cha paramaM tasmAtparAparaguruM tataH
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: इदमासनमित्युक्त्वा चासनानि प्रकल्पयेत् । प्रणवादिद्वितीयान्ते स्वस्य नाम समुच्चरन्
verses.transliteration: idamAsanamityuktvA chAsanAni prakalpayet | praNavAdidvitIyAnte svasya nAma samuchcharan
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: आवाहयामि नम इत्यावाह्यार्घोदकेन तु । पाद्यमाचमनं चार्घ्यं वस्त्रगन्धाक्षतानपि
verses.transliteration: AvAhayAmi nama ityAvAhyArghodakena tu | pAdyamAchamanaM chArghyaM vastragandhAkShatAnapi
verses.translation: I shall go to Badarikarama''' for serving the lotus like feet of my preceptor. Let us aspire for the opportunity of having excellent talk again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ सप्तमी वायवीयसंहिता अथ सप्तमी वायवीयसंहिता पूर्वखण्डः । ७.१.१. प्रथमोऽध्यायः । विद्यावतारकथनम् । व्यास उवाच । नमः शिवाय सोमाय सगणाय ससूनवे । प्रधानपुरुषेशाय सर्गस्थित्यन्तहेतवे
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || saptamI vAyavIyasaMhitA atha saptamI vAyavIyasaMhitA pUrvakhaNDaH | 7\.1\.1\. prathamo.adhyAyaH | vidyAvatArakathanam | vyAsa uvAcha | namaH shivAya somAya sagaNAya sasUnave | pradhAnapuruSheshAya sargasthityantahetave
verses.translation: On sei'ing Suta come, the sages were delighted

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा सूतमायान्तं मुनयो हृष्टमानसाः । तस्मै साम च पूजां च यथावत्प्रत्यपादयन्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA sUtamAyAntaM munayo hR^iShTamAnasAH | tasmai sAma cha pUjAM cha yathAvatpratyapAdayan
verses.translation: A piiticular iegi<in ia iiucnded to be meant here.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर उनके मुखसे सभी शास्त्र उत्पन्न हुएु

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य स तां पूजां मुनिभिः प्रतिपादिताम् । उद्दिष्टमासनं भेजे नियुक्तो युक्तमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: pratigR^ihya sa tAM pUjAM munibhiH pratipAditAm | uddiShTamAsanaM bheje niyukto yuktamAtmanaH
verses.translation: Accepting their welcome and worship he took the proper seat offered by them.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तत्सङ्गमादेव मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् । सोत्कण्ठमभवच्चित्तं श्रोतुं पौराणिकीं कथाम्
verses.transliteration: tatastatsa~NgamAdeva munInAM bhAvitAtmanAm | sotkaNThamabhavachchittaM shrotuM paurANikIM kathAm
verses.translation: By their contact with him the sages of pious souls became eager and impatient to hear the Puranic lore.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तमनुकूलाभिर्वाग्भिः पूज्य महर्षयः । अतीवाभिमुखं कृत्वा वचनं चेदमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tadA tamanukUlAbhirvAgbhiH pUjya maharShayaH | atIvAbhimukhaM kR^itvA vachanaM chedamabruvan
verses.translation: Worshipping him with words of praise the sages sat in front of him and spoke.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । रोमहर्षण सर्वज्ञ भवान्नो भाग्यगौरवात् । सम्प्राप्तोऽद्य महाभाग शैवराज महामते
verses.transliteration: R^iShaya UchuH | romaharShaNa sarvaj~na bhavAnno bhAgyagauravAt | samprApto.adya mahAbhAga shaivarAja mahAmate
verses.translation: O omniscient Romaharsana, the principal devotees of Siva of great fortune and keen intellect, it is due to the weightincss of our good luck that you have come here now.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणविद्यामखिलां व्यासात्प्रत्यक्षमीयिवान् । तस्मादाश्चर्यभूतानां कथानां त्वं हि भाजनम्
verses.transliteration: purANavidyAmakhilAM vyAsAtpratyakShamIyivAn | tasmAdAshcharyabhUtAnAM kathAnAM tvaM hi bhAjanam
verses.translation: You liave directly acquired the Puranic lore from Vyasa, Hence you are a repository ol' wondeiful tales, even as the ocean of precious gems. There is nothing in the three worlds past, picscnt or future, which is not known (o you. Fortunately you have come here to visit us. It docs not behove you to go in vain without conferring blessing on us.
verses.hindi: किया है, इसमें साक्षात् धर्म प्रतिष्ठित है

verses.sanskrit: रत्नानामुरुसाराणां रत्नाकर इवार्णवः । यच्च भूतं यच्च भव्यं यच्चान्यद्वस्तु वर्तते
verses.transliteration: ratnAnAmurusArANAM ratnAkara ivArNavaH | yachcha bhUtaM yachcha bhavyaM yachchAnyadvastu vartate
verses.translation: Please narrate to us the holy Parana the storehouse of good stories and the essence of the Vedanta.

verses.sanskrit: न तवाविदितं किञ्चित् त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते । त्वमदृष्टवशादस्मद्दर्शनार्थमिहागतः । अकुर्वन्किमपि श्रेयो न वृथा गन्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: na tavAviditaM ki~nchit triShu lokeShu vidyate | tvamadR^iShTavashAdasmaddarshanArthamihAgataH | akurvankimapi shreyo na vR^ithA gantumarhasi
verses.translation: Thus lequested by the sages, the habltu.il reciters of the Vcdic texts, Suta spoke auspicious words full of sweet and rational meaning.
verses.hindi: विद्यावतारकथधन नामक पहला अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छ्राव्यतरं पुण्यं सत्कथाज्ञानसंहितम् । वेदान्तसारसर्वस्वं पुराणं श्रावयाशु नः
verses.transliteration: tasmAchChrAvyataraM puNyaM satkathAj~nAnasaMhitam | vedAntasArasarvasvaM purANaM shrAvayAshu naH
verses.translation: T have been honoured, blessed and urged by you all. Why shall I not then expound clearly the Purana, held in esteem by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: एवमभ्यर्थितः सूतो मुनिभिर्वेदवादिभिः । श्लक्ष्णां च न्यायसंयुक्तां प्रत्युवाच शुभां गिरम्
verses.transliteration: evamabhyarthitaH sUto munibhirvedavAdibhiH | shlakShNAM cha nyAyasaMyuktAM pratyuvAcha shubhAM giram
verses.translation: After saluting Siva, Paivati, Skanda, Genesa, Nandin and Vyasa the son of Satyavati, I shall narrate the extremely meritorious Purana which is on a par with ilic Vedas, which being an ocean of Saivitc knowledge directly yields worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिरप्रतिमा यस्य ह्यैश्वर्यं चापि सर्वगम् । स्वामित्वं च विभुत्वं च स्वभावं सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: shaktirapratimA yasya hyaishvaryaM chApi sarvagam | svAmitvaM cha vibhutvaM cha svabhAvaM samprachakShate
verses.translation: Understand well even as t narrate the various.sacred lores, the due order of the Puranas and their origin.
verses.hindi: वरुणादित्यसंकाशं सुन्दर एवं पुष्पित वृक्षोंसे युक्त था

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । पूजितोऽनुगृहीतश्च भवद्भिरिति चोदितः । कस्मात्सम्यङ् न विब्रूयां पुराणमृषिपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | pUjito.anugR^ihItashcha bhavadbhiriti choditaH | kasmAtsamya~N na vibrUyAM purANamR^iShipUjitam
verses.translation: The sacred lore consists of fourteen texts viz., the

verses.sanskrit: अभिवन्द्य महादेवं देवीं स्कन्दं विनायकम् । नन्दिनं च तथा व्यासं साक्षात्सत्यवतीसुतम्
verses.transliteration: abhivandya mahAdevaM devIM skandaM vinAyakam | nandinaM cha tathA vyAsaM sAkShAtsatyavatIsutam
verses.translation: On Kalpa see P. 1070 note.
verses.hindi: मुनिप्रस्ताववर्णन नामक दूसरा अध्याय पूरा हुआ

verses.sanskrit: वक्ष्यामि परमं पुण्यं पुराणं वेदसम्मितम् । शिवज्ञानार्णवं साक्षाद् भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: vakShyAmi paramaM puNyaM purANaM vedasammitam | shivaj~nAnArNavaM sAkShAd bhuktimuktiphalapradam
verses.translation: There are eighteen secular Vidyas — Ayurveda Dhanurveda, Gandharvaveda etc. ending with Arthasastra.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दार्थन्यायसंयुक्तैरागमार्थैर्विभूषितम् । श्वेतकल्पप्रसङ्गेन वायुना कथितं पुरा
verses.transliteration: shabdArthanyAyasaMyuktairAgamArthairvibhUShitam | shvetakalpaprasa~Ngena vAyunA kathitaM purA
verses.translation: Sruti mentions that the original exponent and poet of the eighteen Vidyas, each having its own individual path, is the trident-bearing lord himself.
verses.hindi: एक साथ यहाँ क्‍यों आये हैं 2

verses.sanskrit: विद्यास्थानानि सर्वाणि पुराणानुक्रमं तथा । तत्पुराणस्य चोत्पत्तिं ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: vidyAsthAnAni sarvANi purANAnukramaM tathA | tatpurANasya chotpattiM bruvato me nibodhata
verses.translation: To his eldest son Brahma, the cause of the universe, Siva gave these lores in the beginning in order to facilitate the creation of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गानि वेदाश्चत्वारो मीमांसा न्यायविस्तरः । पुराणं धर्मशास्त्रं च विद्याश्चैताश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: a~NgAni vedAshchatvAro mImAMsA nyAyavistaraH | purANaM dharmashAstraM cha vidyAshchaitAshchaturdasha
verses.translation: He created Visnu for the protection, of even Brah¬ ma himself and endowed him with the power of protection.
verses.hindi: जगतूमें कुछ भी अविदित नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्वेदो धनुर्वेदो गान्धर्वश्चेत्यनुक्रमात् । अर्थशास्त्रं परं तस्माद्विद्या ह्यष्टादश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: Ayurvedo dhanurvedo gAndharvashchetyanukramAt | arthashAstraM paraM tasmAdvidyA hyaShTAdasha smR^itAH
verses.translation: The Vedas came out of his mouths. The Sastras too had their origin from him.
verses.hindi: विशुद्ध, परिपूर्ण, शाश्वत तथा परमेश्वर है

verses.sanskrit: अष्टादशानां विद्यानामेतासां भिन्नवर्त्मनाम् । आदिकर्त्ता कविः साक्षाच्छूलपाणिरिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: aShTAdashAnAM vidyAnAmetAsAM bhinnavartmanAm | AdikarttA kaviH sAkShAchChUlapANiriti shrutiH
verses.translation: When the people could not follow the big sacred texts, at th'e instance of Visvesvara, lord Visnu the sustaincr and the soul of the universe incarnated on the earth at the end of Dvapara Yuga, in order to abridge them. He walked about the earth in the name of Vyasa.
verses.hindi: सन्देहकों दूर करनेके लिये आप इसे कहिये

verses.sanskrit: स हि सर्वजगन्नाथः सिसृक्षुरखिलं जगत् । ब्रह्माणं विदधे साक्षात्पुत्रमग्रे सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: sa hi sarvajagannAthaH sisR^ikShurakhilaM jagat | brahmANaM vidadhe sAkShAtputramagre sanAtanam
verses.translation: O Brahmins, in every Dvapara Yuga the Vedas are classified by him. The Puranas and other texts are written by him.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै प्रथमपुत्राय ब्रह्मणे विश्वयोनये । विद्याश्चेमा ददौ पूर्वं विश्वसृष्ट्यर्थमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tasmai prathamaputrAya brahmaNe vishvayonaye | vidyAshchemA dadau pUrvaM vishvasR^iShTyarthamIshvaraH
verses.translation: He abridged and classified the Vedas into four groups. He is known as Vedavyasa.
verses.hindi: कृपासे मैंने इस प्रजापतिपदको प्राप्त किया है

verses.sanskrit: तमजं विश्वकर्माणं शाश्वतं शिवमव्ययम् । महादेवं महात्मानं व्रजामि शरणं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: tamajaM vishvakarmANaM shAshvataM shivamavyayam | mahAdevaM mahAtmAnaM vrajAmi sharaNaM shivam
verses.translation: Puranas extending to a hundred crore Slokas were condensed by him into four hundred thousand Slokas. Even now in the Devaloka they have the original number.

verses.sanskrit: पालनाय हरिं देवं रक्षाशक्तिं ददौ ततः । मध्यमं तनयं विष्णुं पातारं ब्रह्मणोऽपि हि
verses.transliteration: pAlanAya hariM devaM rakShAshaktiM dadau tataH | madhyamaM tanayaM viShNuM pAtAraM brahmaNo.api hi
verses.translation: Even if a brahmin knows the four Vedas with their Angas and the Upanisads he is not an expert if he does not know the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: लब्धविद्येन विधिना प्रजासृष्टिं वितन्वता । प्रथमं सर्वशास्त्राणां पुराणं ब्रह्मणा स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: labdhavidyena vidhinA prajAsR^iShTiM vitanvatA | prathamaM sarvashAstrANAM purANaM brahmaNA smR^itam
verses.translation: The knowledge of the Vedas shall he enlarged by
verses.hindi: विश्वको अपने अधीन किये हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तरं तु वक्त्रेभ्यो वेदास्तस्य विनिर्गताः । प्रवृत्तिः सर्वशास्त्राणां तन्मुखादभवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: anantaraM tu vaktrebhyo vedAstasya vinirgatAH | pravR^ittiH sarvashAstrANAM tanmukhAdabhavattataH
verses.translation: Puranas have five characteristics'* — creation, subsi¬ diary creation, genealogy, manvantaras and the chronological account of kings, these are described in every Purina.

verses.sanskrit: यदास्य विस्तरं शक्ता नाधिगन्तुं प्रजा भुवि । तदा विद्यासमासार्थं विश्वेश्वरनियोगतः
verses.transliteration: yadAsya vistaraM shaktA nAdhigantuM prajA bhuvi | tadA vidyAsamAsArthaM vishveshvaraniyogataH
verses.translation: The sages reckon ten Puranas and eight big Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरान्तेषु विश्वात्मा विष्णुर्विश्वम्भरः प्रभुः । व्यासनाम्ना चरत्यस्मिन्नवतीर्य महीतले
verses.transliteration: dvAparAnteShu vishvAtmA viShNurvishvambharaH prabhuH | vyAsanAmnA charatyasminnavatIrya mahItale
verses.translation: Brahma, Padma, Vaisnava, Saiva, Bhagavata, Bhavisya. Naradlya and Markandeya are the eight big Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं व्यस्ताश्च वेदाश्च द्वापरे द्वापरे द्विजाः । निर्मितानि पुराणानि अन्यानि च ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: evaM vyastAshcha vedAshcha dvApare dvApare dvijAH | nirmitAni purANAni anyAni cha tataH param
verses.translation: Agneya, Brahmavaivarta, Liiiga, Varaha, Skanda, Vamana, Kurma, Matsya, Garuda and Brahmanda are the ten small Puranas. These are the eighteen Puranas in order. Sivapurana, the fourth in the list belongs to Siva and is conducive to the achievement of all objects.

verses.sanskrit: स पुनर्द्वापरे चास्मिन्कृष्णद्वैपायनाख्यया । अरण्यामिव हव्याशी सत्यवत्यामजायत
verses.transliteration: sa punardvApare chAsminkR^iShNadvaipAyanAkhyayA | araNyAmiva havyAshI satyavatyAmajAyata
verses.translation: It contains a hundred thousand verses. It is divided into twelve Sarhhitas. It is created by Siva. All sacred rites are mentioned therein.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्क्षिप्य स पुनर्वेदांश्चतुर्द्धा कृतवान्मुनिः । सङ्क्षिप्तान् स पुनर्देदान् चक्रेऽष्टादशधा मुनिः । व्यस्तवेदतया लोके वेदव्यास इति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: sa~NkShipya sa punarvedAMshchaturddhA kR^itavAnmuniH | sa~NkShiptAn sa punardedAn chakre.aShTAdashadhA muniH | vyastavedatayA loke vedavyAsa iti shrutaH
verses.translation: Men are classified under three castes in accor¬ dance with their duties. Hence he who wishes for liberation shall resort to Siva alone.
verses.hindi: यद्यपि भक्त स्वरूपत: कर्म करता रहता है

verses.sanskrit: पुराणानां च सङ्क्षिप्तं चतुर्लक्षप्रमाणतः । अद्यापि देवलोके तच्छतकोटिप्रविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: purANAnAM cha sa~NkShiptaM chaturlakShapramANataH | adyApi devaloke tachChatakoTipravistaram
verses.translation: Even the gods can attain liberation by resorting to him alone and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: यो विद्याच्चतुरो वेदान् साङ्गोपनिषदो द्विजः । न चेत्पुराणं संविद्यान्नैव स स्याद्विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: yo vidyAchchaturo vedAn sA~NgopaniShado dvijaH | na chetpurANaM saMvidyAnnaiva sa syAdvichakShaNaH
verses.translation: What I mentioned as the Sivapurana on a par with the Vedas, know its creations as I briefly explain.
verses.hindi: ही शिव-ज्ञानकी प्राप्ति कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: धर्मक्षेत्रे महातीर्थे गङ्गाकालिन्दिसङ्गमे । प्रयागे नैमिषारण्ये ब्रह्मलोकस्य वर्त्मनि
verses.transliteration: dharmakShetre mahAtIrthe ga~NgAkAlindisa~Ngame | prayAge naimiShAraNye brahmalokasya vartmani
verses.translation: There arc twelve Sarhhitas: Vidyesvara, Rudra. Vainayaka, Auma, Matr, Rudraikadasaka, Kailasa, Satarudra, Koti rudra, Sahasi akotirudra, Vayaviya and Dharmapurana. Vidyesvara contains ten thousand verses. There are eight thousand verses in each of the four — Raudra, Vainayaka, Auma and Matrpurana. Rudraikadasa contains thirteen thousand verses; Kailasa six thousand; iSatarudra three thousand; Koprudra nine thousand; Sahasrakoirudra elejren thousand; Vayaviya four thousand and Dharma contains twelve thousand verses.

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां वेदं समुपबृंहयेत् । बिभेत्यल्पश्रुताद्वेदो मामयं प्रहरिष्यति
verses.transliteration: itihAsapurANAbhyAM vedaM samupabR^iMhayet | bibhetyalpashrutAdvedo mAmayaM prahariShyati
verses.translation: Thus Sivapurana contains a thousand verses.
verses.hindi: हो जानेपर वह शिवके समान हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च । वंशानुचरितं चैव पुराणं पञ्चलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: sargashcha pratisargashcha vaMsho manvantarANi cha | vaMshAnucharitaM chaiva purANaM pa~nchalakShaNam
verses.translation: On till: rhavacU'iistics. nomcnclaturr and number of the Puranas see Irtroduction to Vol. I.

verses.sanskrit: दशधा चाष्टधा चैतत्पुराणमुपदिश्यते । बृहत्सूक्ष्मप्रभेदेन मुनिभिस्तत्त्ववित्तमैः
verses.transliteration: dashadhA chAShTadhA chaitatpurANamupadishyate | bR^ihatsUkShmaprabhedena munibhistattvavittamaiH
verses.translation: The first Samhita is Vid yes vara; the second Rudrasarhhita; the third Satanidia. Kotirudra is the fourth. Umasariihita is the fifth; the sixtli is Kailasa. The seventh is Vayavlya. These are only seven conipendiiuns.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं पाद्मं वैष्णवं च शैवं भागवतं तथा । भविष्यं नारदीयं च मार्कण्डेयमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaM pAdmaM vaiShNavaM cha shaivaM bhAgavataM tathA | bhaviShyaM nAradIyaM cha mArkaNDeyamataH param
verses.translation: Vidyesvara contains two thousand verses, Rudra ten thousand five hundred; Satarudra two thousand one hundred and eighty; Kotirudra two thousand two hun¬ dred and forty; Uma one thousand eight hundred and forty; Kailasa one thousand two hundred and forty and the Vayaviya four thousand verses. Thus is the holy text of Sivapurana.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं लैङ्गं वाराहमेव च । स्कान्दं च वामनं चैव कौर्मं मात्स्यं च गारुडम्
verses.transliteration: AgneyaM brahmavaivartaM lai~NgaM vArAhameva cha | skAndaM cha vAmanaM chaiva kaurmaM mAtsyaM cha gAruDam
verses.translation: I shall now begin the Vayaviya containing four thousand veises and consisting of two parts.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डं चेति पुण्योऽयं पुराणानामनुक्रमः । तत्र शैवं तुरीयं यच्छार्वं सर्वार्थसाधकम्
verses.transliteration: brahmANDaM cheti puNyo.ayaM purANAnAmanukramaH | tatra shaivaM turIyaM yachChArvaM sarvArthasAdhakam
verses.translation: This excellent Sastra shall not be uicntiouefl to one who is not conversant with the Vedas nor to one who has no faith noi to one who does not know the Puriinas.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रन्थो लक्षप्रमाणं तद्व्यस्तं द्वादशसंहितम् । निर्मितं तच्छिवेनैव तत्र धर्मः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: grantho lakShapramANaM tadvyastaM dvAdashasaMhitam | nirmitaM tachChivenaiva tatra dharmaH pratiShThitaH
verses.translation: It shalL be given to a tested virtuous disciple un- conlaininatcd by malice. He shall be a devotee of Siva and a follower of the Saiva cult.

verses.sanskrit: तदुक्तेनैव धर्मेण शैवास्त्रैवर्णिका नराः । तस्माद्विमुक्तिमन्विच्छन् शिवमेव समाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: taduktenaiva dharmeNa shaivAstraivarNikA narAH | tasmAdvimuktimanvichChan shivameva samAshrayet
verses.translation: Obeisance to the holy sigc Vyasa of brilliant splendour whoso grace has endowed me with the Puranic lore.
verses.hindi: :. नैमिषोपाख्यान नामक तीसरा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तमाश्रित्यैव देवानामपि मुक्तिर्न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: tamAshrityaiva devAnAmapi muktirna chAnyathA
verses.translation: In oi'der to see the eternal creator they went where the lord was staying eulogised by gods and Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: यदिदं शैवमाख्यातं पुराणं वेदसम्मितम् । तस्य भेदान्समासेन ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: yadidaM shaivamAkhyAtaM purANaM vedasammitam | tasya bhedAnsamAsena bruvato me nibodhata
verses.translation: It was on the auspicious and charming peak of Meru," where there were plenty of gods and Asuras where Siddhas and Garanas thronged, where Yaksas and Gandharvas freqiuMited, where flocks of birds chirped and crew, which was embellished by jewels and corals and which shone due to streams and rivulets, caves and crevices, bushes and hedges.

verses.sanskrit: मुनयः शंसितात्मानः सत्यव्रतपरायणाः । महौजसो महाभागा महासत्रं वितेनिरे
verses.transliteration: munayaH shaMsitAtmAnaH satyavrataparAyaNAH | mahaujaso mahAbhAgA mahAsatraM vitenire
verses.translation: There was a forest Brahmavana®' which abounded in different species of deer. It was ten Yojanas wide and hundred Yojanas long. There were beautiful lakes full of sweet and clean water. It had plenty of trees in full bloom where swarms of bees hummed and hovered.
