verses.sanskrit: विद्येश्वरं तथा रौद्रं वैनायकमनुत्तमम् । औमं मातृपुराणं च रुद्रैकादशकं तथा
verses.transliteration: vidyeshvaraM tathA raudraM vainAyakamanuttamam | aumaM mAtR^ipurANaM cha rudraikAdashakaM tathA
verses.translation: It had lofty ramparts and portals made of molten gold. It was embellished by hundreds of main streets, turrets and wooden ceilincrs.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासं शतरुद्रं च कोटिरुद्राख्यमेव च । सहस्रकोटिरुद्राख्यं वायवीयं ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: kailAsaM shatarudraM cha koTirudrAkhyameva cha | sahasrakoTirudrAkhyaM vAyavIyaM tataH param
verses.translation: It appeared to lick the sky with crorcs of huge mansions set with precious gems of variegated colours. It was decorated with many such mansions.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मसंज्ञं पुराणं चेत्येवं द्वादश संहिताः । विद्येशं दशसाहस्रमुदितं ग्रन्थसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: dharmasa.nj~naM purANaM chetyevaM dvAdasha saMhitAH | vidyeshaM dashasAhasramuditaM granthasa~NkhyayA
verses.translation: Lord Brahma resides tlicre along with his coun¬ cillors. Going there the sages.saw the lord, the noble Atman served by the groups of gods and sages. He was shining like pure gold. He was bedecked in all ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रं वैनायकं चौमं मातृकाख्यं ततः परम् । प्रत्येकमष्टसाहस्रं त्रयोदशसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: raudraM vainAyakaM chaumaM mAtR^ikAkhyaM tataH param | pratyekamaShTasAhasraM trayodashasahasrakam
verses.translation: Accompanied by Sarasvati 'whose body had all auspicious marks who held the chowrics in her hands, he shone a- the sun with his dazzling light.

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रकादशकाख्यं यत् कैलासं षट्सहस्रकम् । शतरुद्रं त्रिसाहस्रं कोटिरुद्रं ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: raudrakAdashakAkhyaM yat kailAsaM ShaTsahasrakam | shatarudraM trisAhasraM koTirudraM tataH param
verses.translation: On seeing him the sages were delighted and their eyes and faces shone. With palms joined in reverence and held over their heads they eulogised the leading god.
verses.hindi: वायुसमागम नामक चौथा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रैर्नवभिर्युक्तं सर्वार्थज्ञानसंयुतम् । सहस्रकोटिरुद्राख्यमेकादशसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrairnavabhiryuktaM sarvArthaj~nAnasaMyutam | sahasrakoTirudrAkhyamekAdashasahasrakam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you in the form of Trinity, the cause of creation, sustenance and annihilation, the ancient Purusa, Brahma the great Atman.

verses.sanskrit: चतुस्सहस्रसङ्ख्येयं वायवीयमनुत्तमम् । धर्मसंज्ञं पुराणं यत्तद् द्वादशसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: chatussahasrasa~NkhyeyaM vAyavIyamanuttamam | dharmasa.nj~naM purANaM yattad dvAdashasahasrakam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity who has Prakrti for his body, who is the cause of quickening Pradhana, who though trans¬ formed into twentythree principles is yet free from aberration.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्तजन्मा ब्रह्माजीके शिष्य किस प्रकार हुए ?

verses.sanskrit: तदेवं लक्षमुद्दिष्टं शैवं शाखाविभेदतः । पुराणं वेदसारं तद् भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tadevaM lakShamuddiShTaM shaivaM shAkhAvibhedataH | purANaM vedasAraM tad bhuktimuktiphalapradam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity who has universe for his body, who is stationed within the belly of the universe, who has accomplished his task and whose body is perfectly accom¬ plished.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासेन तत्तु सङ्क्षिप्तं चतुर्विंशत्सहस्रकम् । शैवं तत्र पुराणं वै चतुर्थं सप्तसंहितम्
verses.transliteration: vyAsena tattu sa~NkShiptaM chaturviMshatsahasrakam | shaivaM tatra purANaM vai chaturthaM saptasaMhitam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity identical with the world, the creator, the sustainer and the annihilator of the world.

verses.sanskrit: विद्येश्वराख्या तत्राद्या द्वितीया रुद्रसंहिता । तृतीया शतरुद्राख्या कोटिरुद्रा चतुर्थिका
verses.transliteration: vidyeshvarAkhyA tatrAdyA dvitIyA rudrasaMhitA | tR^itIyA shatarudrAkhyA koTirudrA chaturthikA
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by the fortunate sages, Brahma spoke to the sages in a majestic tone delighting them.
verses.hindi: क्षराक्षससे परे क्या है ? उसका वर्णन कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सत्रं समाकर्ण्य तेषामक्लिष्टकर्मणाम् । साक्षात्सत्यवतीसूनोर्वेदव्यासस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: tatra satraM samAkarNya teShAmakliShTakarmaNAm | sAkShAtsatyavatIsUnorvedavyAsasya dhImataH
verses.translation: O blessed sages of great splendour and strength, why have you come here all together?
verses.hindi: भिन्‍न तत्त्व ही परमेश्वर कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमी कथिता चोमा षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता । सप्तमी वायवीयाख्या सप्तैवं संहिता इह
verses.transliteration: pa~nchamI kathitA chomA ShaShThI kailAsasaMhitA | saptamI vAyavIyAkhyA saptaivaM saMhitA iha
verses.translation: The sages foremost of those who know Brahman spoke with palms joined in reverence, with words couched in humility to lord Brahma who spoke thus.

verses.sanskrit: विद्येश्वरं द्विसाहस्रं रौद्रं पञ्चशतायुतम् । त्रिंशत्तथा द्विसाहस्रं सार्द्धैकशतमीरितम्
verses.transliteration: vidyeshvaraM dvisAhasraM raudraM pa~nchashatAyutam | triMshattathA dvisAhasraM sArddhaikashatamIritam
verses.translation: O lord, we have been encompassed in deep dark¬ ness. We are distressed. Unable to understand the greatest being we are arguing among ourselves.

verses.sanskrit: शतरुद्रं तथा कोटिरुद्रं व्योमयुगाधिकम् । द्विसाहस्रं च द्विशतं तथौमं भूसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: shatarudraM tathA koTirudraM vyomayugAdhikam | dvisAhasraM cha dvishataM tathaumaM bhUsahasrakam
verses.translation: Indeed you are the creator of the universe. You are the cause of all causes. O lord, there is nothing here not known to you.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशत्साष्टशतं कैलासं भूसहस्रकम् । चत्वारिंशच्च द्विशतं वायवीयमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: chatvAriMshatsAShTashataM kailAsaM bhUsahasrakam | chatvAriMshachcha dvishataM vAyavIyamataH param
verses.translation: Who by indulging in wonderful activities has created the universe? O intelligent lord, please mention it and quell our doubts.
verses.hindi: शिव हो जाता है। वह विशुद्धता ही शिवत्व है

verses.sanskrit: चतुस्साहस्रसङ्ख्याकमेवं सङ्ख्याविभेदतः । श्रुतं परमपुण्यं तु पुराणं शिवसंज्ञकम्
verses.transliteration: chatussAhasrasa~NkhyAkamevaM sa~NkhyAvibhedataH | shrutaM paramapuNyaM tu purANaM shivasa.nj~nakam
verses.translation: 8iva stationed in the middle of the ether shall be meditated upon by those desirous of salvation; Siva from whom the words recede not approaching him along with the mind;'** knowing and realising whose bliss-form one has no fear from anywhere; from whom every thing inclusive of Brahma, Visnu, Rudra, Indra, the elements, the sense- organs, is born at first, who is the creator, meditator and ultimate cause of all causes; who is not born from anything else at any time; who is endowed with glory and prosperity and who is known as SarveSvara.

verses.sanskrit: चतुःसहस्रकं यत्तु वायवीयमुदीरितम् । तदिदं वर्त्तयिष्यामि भागद्वयसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: chatuHsahasrakaM yattu vAyavIyamudIritam | tadidaM varttayiShyAmi bhAgadvayasamanvitam
verses.translation: He rules over all the worlds through the Jivas. He is the only lord Rudra. There is none second to him.
verses.hindi: है और उसका फल तथा आश्रय क्‍या है ?

verses.sanskrit: नावेदविदुषे वाच्यमिदं शास्त्रमनुत्तमम् । न चैवाश्रद्दधानाय नापुराणविदे तथा
verses.transliteration: nAvedaviduShe vAchyamidaM shAstramanuttamam | na chaivAshraddadhAnAya nApurANavide tathA
verses.translation: He has neither day nor night; neither equals nor superiors. The great knowledge and activity is innate in him.

verses.sanskrit: परीक्षिताय शिष्याय धार्मिकायानसूयवे । प्रदेयं शिवभक्ताय शिवधर्मानुसारिणे
verses.transliteration: parIkShitAya shiShyAya dhArmikAyAnasUyave | pradeyaM shivabhaktAya shivadharmAnusAriNe
verses.translation: By concentrating on him, the person of attvaic feelings becomes the lord himself. At the end the universal illusion recedes from him.
verses.hindi: स्तुतो5पि कु: स्थिति: ॥ ४२  वास्तविक स्थिति कहाँ है?

verses.sanskrit: पुराणसंहिता यस्य प्रसादान्मयि वर्तते । नमो भगवते तस्मै व्यासायामिततेजसे
verses.transliteration: purANasaMhitA yasya prasAdAnmayi vartate | namo bhagavate tasmai vyAsAyAmitatejase
verses.translation: The eternal Sruti says "In whom neither the lightn¬ ing flashes nor the sun blazes nor (he moon sheds light and by whose brilliance this universe comes in the limelight."

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यो महात्मा मेधावी त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः । पञ्चावयवयुक्तस्य वाक्यस्य गुणदोषवित्
verses.transliteration: shiShyo mahAtmA medhAvI triShu lokeShu vishrutaH | pa~nchAvayavayuktasya vAkyasya guNadoShavit
verses.translation: That lord Siva shall be realised. There is no other region greater than his worthy of attainment.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरोत्तरवक्ता च ब्रुवतोऽपि बृहस्पतेः । मधुरश्रवणानां च मनोज्ञपदपर्वणाम्
verses.transliteration: uttarottaravaktA cha bruvato.api bR^ihaspateH | madhurashravaNAnAM cha manoj~napadaparvaNAm
verses.translation: He has taken up vc.sidencc above all. He is the repository of all. He is the knower of all. He is the lord of the universe comprising the sixfold path.
verses.hindi: प्रोचु: प्रणम्य त॑ वायुं शैवागमविचक्षणम्॥ ६४ वायुदेवको प्रणाम करके कहने लगे

verses.sanskrit: कथानां निपुणो वक्ता कालविन्नयवित्कविः । आजगाम स तं देशं सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kathAnAM nipuNo vaktA kAlavinnayavitkaviH | AjagAma sa taM deshaM sUtaH paurANikottamaH
verses.translation: The living beings are under his control. He is the employer of all. He is seen by great devotion and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: शिवतत्त्वज्ञानवर्णन नामक पाँचवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Visnu, I, Rudra, gods and Asiiras are desirous of seeing him even today by performing great penances.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Visnu, I, Rudra, gods and Asiiras are desirous of seeing him even today by performing great penances.
verses.hindi: ही हो सकता है, पशु और पाश नहीं

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२. द्वितीयोऽध्यायः । मुनिप्रस्ताववर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । पुरा कालेन महता कल्पेऽतीते पुनः पुनः । अस्मिन्नुपस्थिते कल्पे प्रवृत्ते सृष्टिकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.2\. dvitIyo.adhyAyaH | muniprastAvavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | purA kAlena mahatA kalpe.atIte punaH punaH | asminnupasthite kalpe pravR^itte sR^iShTikarmaNi
verses.translation: Forms in the universe are threefold— the gross, subtle and that \vhi(:h is beyond. The gross is s*>cn by us, the gods and others. The subtle is seen by iht' \og'.r.;. That which is beyond the two, is eternal, knowledge, bliss and the unchanging can be seen by those who dwell in it, are devoted to it and are engaged in the riles concerning it.

verses.sanskrit: तप्तजाम्बूनदमयं प्रांशुप्राकारतोरणम् । निर्यूहवलभीकूटप्रतोलीशतमण्डितम्
verses.transliteration: taptajAmbUnadamayaM prAMshuprAkAratoraNam | niryUhavalabhIkUTapratolIshatamaNDitam
verses.translation: The achievements of the individual are due to the grace of God. Lord alone is achieved in the end through all the means.

verses.sanskrit: महार्हमणिचित्राभिर्लेलिहानमिवाम्बरम् । महाभवनकोटीभिरनेकाभिरलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: mahArhamaNichitrAbhirlelihAnamivAmbaram | mahAbhavanakoTIbhiranekAbhirala~NkR^itam
verses.translation: Viitue and holy rites constitute the means for the attainment of giace. That is indicated by the Vedas. By practising Dharma the sins and merits are levelled to equality.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्निवसति ब्रह्मा सभ्यैः सार्द्धं प्रजापतिः । तत्र गत्वा महात्मानं साक्षाल्लोकपितामहम्
verses.transliteration: tasminnivasati brahmA sabhyaiH sArddhaM prajApatiH | tatra gatvA mahAtmAnaM sAkShAllokapitAmaham
verses.translation: Contact with grace yields cxtcllence of Dharma. After attaining this excellence the sins of tht individual decline.

verses.sanskrit: ददृशुर्मुनयो देवा देवर्षिगणसेवितम् । शुद्धचामीकरप्रख्यं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: dadR^ishurmunayo devA devarShigaNasevitam | shuddhachAmIkaraprakhyaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam
verses.translation: When his sins decline through succession of births the devotion to Sarvesvara and Amba is ncrated along with knowledge.
verses.hindi: करते हैं तथा उनकी अभिवृद्धि करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नवदनं सौम्यं पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणम् । दिव्यकान्तिसमायुक्तं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: prasannavadanaM saumyaM padmapatrAyatekShaNam | divyakAntisamAyuktaM divyagandhAnulepanam
verses.translation: The grace of the lord varies in accordance with the purity of emotions. Due to grace, cschewment of rites results. Here the eschewment is of the fruits of rites and not the rites themselves.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यशुक्लाम्बरधरं दिव्यमालाविभूषितम् । सुरासुरेन्द्रयोगीन्द्रवन्द्यमानपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: divyashuklAmbaradharaM divyamAlAvibhUShitam | surAsurendrayogIndravandyamAnapadAmbujam
verses.translation: As a result of the abandonment of the desire for the fruits of holy rites, the auspicious Saivite virtues are attai¬ ned. This is twofold: that dependent on the preceptor and that which is not.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणयुक्ताङ्ग्या लब्धचामरहस्तया । भ्राजमानं सरस्वत्या प्रभयेव दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalakShaNayuktA~NgyA labdhachAmarahastayA | bhrAjamAnaM sarasvatyA prabhayeva divAkaram
verses.translation: In view of the knowledge the man sees the defects in the worldly existence. Thereafter arises non-attachment to the sensual objects and thence Bhava is attained.
verses.hindi: शोकरहित हुआ पुरुष देख पाता है

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणाः । शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय तुष्टुवुः सुरपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA munayaH sarve prasannavadanekShaNAH | shirasya~njalimAdhAya tuShTuvuH surapu~Ngavam
verses.translation: Throiigh Yoga arises the great devotion and then grace of God. By means of the grace the creature is liberated and becomes equal to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं सर्गस्थित्यन्तहेतवे । पुरुषाय पुराणाय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | namastrimUrtaye tubhyaM sargasthityantahetave | puruShAya purANAya brahmaNe paramAtmane
verses.translation: The different modes of blessings may not be in the order mentioned. The blessing is based on the ability of the man.
verses.hindi: उरुप परमानन्दमय अमृतका अनुभव करता है

verses.sanskrit: नमः प्रधानदेहाय प्रधानक्षोभकारिणे । त्रयोविंशतिभेदेन विकृतायाविकारिणे
verses.transliteration: namaH pradhAnadehAya pradhAnakShobhakAriNe | trayoviMshatibhedena vikR^itAyAvikAriNe
verses.translation: A soul born as a lower species, a soul undergoing torture in hell, a soul achieving a heavenly region may be liberated when the tenure is over.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठितायां वार्तायां प्रबुद्धासु प्रजासु च । मुनीनां षट्कुलीयानां ब्रुवतामितरेतरम्
verses.transliteration: pratiShThitAyAM vArtAyAM prabuddhAsu prajAsu cha | munInAM ShaTkulIyAnAM bruvatAmitaretaram
verses.translation: Some soul may return after the enjoyment of heavenly region and then liberated. Still another soul may be liberated on its way.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ब्रह्माण्डदेहाय ब्रह्माण्डोदरवर्तिने । तत्र संसिद्धकार्याय संसिद्धकरणाय च
verses.transliteration: namo brahmANDadehAya brahmANDodaravartine | tatra saMsiddhakAryAya saMsiddhakaraNAya cha
verses.translation: He will tell you what is good for you along with the means. Then you shall go to the holy and auspi¬ cious city of Varanasi where the glorious trident-bearing lord sports about with the goddess for blessing his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: नमोऽस्तु सर्वलोकाय सर्वलोकविधायिने । सर्वात्मदेहसंयोगवियोगविधिहेतवे
verses.transliteration: namo.astu sarvalokAya sarvalokavidhAyine | sarvAtmadehasaMyogaviyogavidhihetave
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after seeing the great wonder therein you come to me again. Then I shall tell you the means of salvation.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैव निखिलं सृष्टं संहृतं पालितं जगत् । तथापि मायया नाथ न विद्मस्त्वां पितामह
verses.transliteration: tvayaiva nikhilaM sR^iShTaM saMhR^itaM pAlitaM jagat | tathApi mAyayA nAtha na vidmastvAM pitAmaha
verses.translation: Thereby in a single birth, salvation comes within your reach, salvation which sets you free from the bondage of births and transmigrations.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । एवं ब्रह्मा महाभागैर्महर्षिभिरभिष्टुतः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा मुनीन् प्रह्लादयन्निव
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | evaM brahmA mahAbhAgairmaharShibhirabhiShTutaH | prAha gambhIrayA vAchA munIn prahlAdayanniva
verses.translation: Now I am releasing this mentally created wheel. The place where its rim gets shattered is auspicious for your penance.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । ऋषयो हे महाभागा महासत्त्वा महौजसः । किमर्थं सहिताः सर्वे यूयमत्र समागताः
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | R^iShayo he mahAbhAgA mahAsattvA mahaujasaH | kimarthaM sahitAH sarve yUyamatra samAgatAH
verses.translation: After saying this Brahma created a mental wheel as bright as the sun. After bowing to lord 8iva he released it.

verses.sanskrit: तमेवंवादिनं देवं ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मवित्तमाः । वाग्भिर्विनयगर्भाभिः सर्वे प्राञ्जलयोऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tamevaMvAdinaM devaM brahmANaM brahmavittamAH | vAgbhirvinayagarbhAbhiH sarve prA~njalayo.abruvan
verses.translation: Those delighted brahmins bowed to the lord and pursued the wheel to the place where its rim got shattered.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । भगवन्नन्धकारेण महता वयमावृताः । खिन्ना विवदमानाश्च न पश्यामोऽत्र यत्परम्
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | bhagavannandhakAreNa mahatA vayamAvR^itAH | khinnA vivadamAnAshcha na pashyAmo.atra yatparam
verses.translation: The wheel thus hurled fell on a smooth charming rock in a certain forest where the water was sweet and clear.
verses.hindi: पुनराददाति॥ ७६  सबको आत्मसात् कर लेते हैं

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सर्वजगद्धाता सर्वकारणकारणम् । त्वया ह्यविदितं नाथ नेह किञ्चन विद्यते
verses.transliteration: tvaM hi sarvajagaddhAtA sarvakAraNakAraNam | tvayA hyaviditaM nAtha neha ki~nchana vidyate
verses.translation: That forest became famous as Naimi§a. It is worshipped by the sages. It abounds in Yaksas, Gandharvas, and Vidyadharas.

verses.sanskrit: कः पुमान् सर्वसत्त्वेभ्यः पुराणः पुरुषः परः । विशुद्धः परिपूर्णश्च शाश्वतः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kaH pumAn sarvasattvebhyaH purANaH puruShaH paraH | vishuddhaH paripUrNashcha shAshvataH parameshvaraH
verses.translation: Indulging in sexual dalliance with Urvasi, Pururavas was moving about in the eighteen islands in the ocean. Urged by fate he came to this place and foolishly spoiled the golden sacrificial altar here. The infuriated sages hurled Kusa grass at him which had the power of thunderbolt and felled him to the ground.

verses.sanskrit: केनैव चित्रकृत्येन प्रथमं सृज्यते जगत् । तत्त्वं वद महाप्राज्ञ स्वसन्देहापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: kenaiva chitrakR^ityena prathamaM sR^ijyate jagat | tattvaM vada mahAprAj~na svasandehApanuttaye
verses.translation: Formerly the Visvasrja Brahmesa householders desirous of creating the universe began a divine sacrifice here.
verses.hindi: न कालनिरपेक्षं हि क्वचित्किंचन विद्यते॥ ९  कालके बिना कहीं कुछ भी नहीं होता है

verses.sanskrit: इदं परमिदं नेति विवादः सुमहानभूत् । परस्य दुर्निरूपत्वान्न जातस्तत्र निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: idaM paramidaM neti vivAdaH sumahAnabhUt | parasya durnirUpatvAnna jAtastatra nishchayaH
verses.translation: There had been many scholarly sages here experts

verses.sanskrit: एवं पृष्टस्तदा ब्रह्मा विस्मयस्मेरवीक्षणः । देवानां दानवानां च मुनीनामपि सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: evaM pR^iShTastadA brahmA vismayasmeravIkShaNaH | devAnAM dAnavAnAM cha munInAmapi sannidhau
verses.translation: Here persons well-versed in the Vedas refute those who are excluded from Vedic path by their power of argu¬ ments. They speak eloquently.

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाय सुचिरं ध्यात्वा रुद्र इत्युच्चरन् गिरिम् । आनन्दक्लिन्नसर्वाङ्गः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.transliteration: utthAya suchiraM dhyAtvA rudra ityuchcharan girim | AnandaklinnasarvA~NgaH kR^itA~njalirabhAShata
verses.translation: The fortunate sages of devout rites worshipped lord Siva and began their sacrifice there.
verses.hindi: किये गये कर्मको नहीं मिटा सकता है

verses.sanskrit: तेऽभिजग्मुर्विधातारं द्रष्टुं ब्रह्माणमव्ययम् । यत्रास्ते भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्तूयमानः सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: te.abhijagmurvidhAtAraM draShTuM brahmANamavyayam | yatrAste bhagavAn brahmA stUyamAnaH surAsuraiH
verses.translation: The sacrifice of the sages functioned evoking wonder in everyone like that of the Vivasrjas formerly who were desirous of creating the universe.
verses.hindi: बलपूर्वक कुछ “और ही कर देता है

verses.sanskrit: मेरुशृङ्गे शुभे रम्ये देवदानवसङ्कुले । सिद्धचारणसम्बादे यक्षगन्धर्वसेविते
verses.transliteration: merushR^i~Nge shubhe ramye devadAnavasa~Nkule | siddhachAraNasambAde yakShagandharvasevite
verses.translation: After sometime when the Satra had concluded with the distribution of manifold gifts Vayu himself came there at the instance of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: विहङ्गसङ्घसङ्घुष्टेमणिविद्रुमभूषिते । निकुञ्जकन्दरदरीगृहानिर्झरशोभिते
verses.transliteration: viha~Ngasa~Nghasa~NghuShTemaNividrumabhUShite | niku~njakandaradarIgR^ihAnirjharashobhite
verses.translation: On seeing him at the hermitage the sages who were busy in a long Satra remembered the words of Brahma and felt unequalled pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ब्रह्मवनं नाम नानामृगसमाकुलम् । दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं शतयोजनमायतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra brahmavanaM nAma nAnAmR^igasamAkulam | dashayojanavistIrNaM shatayojanamAyatam
verses.translation: According to the V«'dic concept they are sons of Rudra but a legend represents their origin in an unborn son of Diti whom Indra dashed in the womb into fortynine pieces and gave the name Maruts.

verses.sanskrit: सुरसामलपानीयपूर्णरम्यसरोवरम् । मत्तभ्रमरसञ्छन्नरम्यपुष्पितपादपम्
verses.transliteration: surasAmalapAnIyapUrNaramyasarovaram | mattabhramarasa~nChannaramyapuShpitapAdapam
verses.translation: Standing up they welcomed and bowed to him. They offered him a golden seat.
verses.hindi: कालसे ही सब लोग जीवित रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: तरुणादित्यसङ्काशं तत्र चारु महत्पुरम् । दुर्द्धर्षबलदृप्तानां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration: taruNAdityasa~NkAshaM tatra chAru mahatpuram | durddharShabaladR^iptAnAM daityadAnavarakShasAm
verses.translation: O brahmins, hope you are all quite well, now that this great sacrifice has concluded. Hope that the Asuras, the enemies of the gods, the destroyers of sacrifices do not harass you.
verses.hindi: न अस्थ कालो न च बंधमुक्ती दर्शन कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: When addressed thus by Vayu, the meditator on Siva, the sages were delighted in their minds. They considered themselves sanctified. They replied thus humbly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: When addressed thus by Vayu, the meditator on Siva, the sages were delighted in their minds. They considered themselves sanctified. They replied thus humbly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३. तृतीयोऽध्यायः । नैमिषोपाख्यानम् । ब्रह्मोवाच । यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह । आनन्दं यस्य वै विद्वान्न बिभेति कुतश्चन
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.3\. tR^itIyo.adhyAyaH | naimiShopAkhyAnam | brahmovAcha | yato vAcho nivartante aprApya manasA saha | AnandaM yasya vai vidvAnna bibheti kutashchana
verses.translation: Today we have attained bliss; our penances are rendered fruitful since you have come for the increase of our welfare.
verses.hindi: कालमहिमवर्णन नामक सातवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु कालात्प्रमुक्तानि कारणान्यखिलान्यपि । अनन्तशक्तिरेवैको भगवानधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: yastu kAlAtpramuktAni kAraNAnyakhilAnyapi | anantashaktirevaiko bhagavAnadhitiShThati
verses.translation: Listen to an old anecdote. Formerly we meditated on Prajapati when we were overwhelmed by darkness. We wanted to acquire perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: संख्यारूपस्य कालस्य कः पुनः परमो5वधि:॥ १  संख्यारूप कालकी परम अवधि क्या है ?

verses.sanskrit: न यस्य दिवसो रात्रिर्न समानो न चाधिकः । स्वाभाविकी पराशक्तिर्नित्या ज्ञानक्रिये अपि
verses.transliteration: na yasya divaso rAtrirna samAno na chAdhikaH | svAbhAvikI parAshaktirnityA j~nAnakriye api
verses.translation: The lord Brahma worthy of being sought refuge in, blessed us as we sought refuge in him and 3aid, "O brahmins, Lord Rudra is superior to all. He is the ultimate cause.
verses.hindi: तादृशानां निमेषाणां काष्ठा दश च पञ्ञ च॥ ३  निमेषोंकी एक काष्ठा होती है

verses.sanskrit: यदिदं क्षरमव्यक्तं यदप्यमृतमक्षरम् । तावुभावक्षरात्मानावेको देवः स्वयं हरः
verses.transliteration: yadidaM kSharamavyaktaM yadapyamR^itamakSharam | tAvubhAvakSharAtmAnAveko devaH svayaM haraH
verses.translation: Only the devotee sees the lord whose real nature cannot be reflected upon or argued over. Devotion is ac¬ quired through grace and through grace is bliss attained.
verses.hindi: दक्षिणं चायनं रात्रिस्तथोदगय् दिनम्॥ «८  दिन होता है

verses.sanskrit: ईशते तदभिध्यानाद् योजनात्तत्वभावनः । भूयो ह्यस्य पशोरन्ते विश्वमाया निवर्तते
verses.transliteration: Ishate tadabhidhyAnAd yojanAttatvabhAvanaH | bhUyo hyasya pashorante vishvamAyA nivartate
verses.translation: Hence, in order to propitiate him perform the Satra. Worship him who is the ultirpate cause, perform Satra in Naimisa extending over a long period.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार कुल ये ही चार युग हैं

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्न भासते विद्युन्न सूर्यो न च चन्द्रमाः । यस्य भासा विभातीदमित्येषा शाश्वती श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: yasminna bhAsate vidyunna sUryo na cha chandramAH | yasya bhAsA vibhAtIdamityeShA shAshvatI shrutiH
verses.translation: At the end of the Satra, by means of his grace Vayu will come there. You will acquire perfect knowledge from his mouth and attain welfare.
verses.hindi: इतने ही वर्षोका सन्ध्यांश होता है

verses.sanskrit: एको देवो महादेवो विज्ञेयस्तु महेश्वरः । न तस्य परमं किञ्चित्पदं समधिगम्यते
verses.transliteration: eko devo mahAdevo vij~neyastu maheshvaraH | na tasya paramaM ki~nchitpadaM samadhigamyate
verses.translation: Commanding thus Brahma sent us all to this place. O fortunate one, we were eagerly awaiting your arrival.
verses.hindi: सत् नामक शिवके एक दिनपर्यन्त रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: अयमादिरनाद्यन्तः स्वभावादेव निर्मलः । स्वतन्त्रः परिपूर्णश्च स्वेच्छाधीनश्चराचरः
verses.transliteration: ayamAdiranAdyantaH svabhAvAdeva nirmalaH | svatantraH paripUrNashcha svechChAdhInashcharAcharaH
verses.translation: Wc sat and performed the Satra for a thousand divine years. Wc had nothing to wish for except your advent.
verses.hindi: अन्तमें पुनः विश्वकी उत्पत्ति होती है

verses.sanskrit: अप्राकृतवपुः श्रीमांल्लक्ष्यलक्षणवर्जितः । अयं मुक्तो मोचकश्च ह्यकालः कालचोदकः
verses.transliteration: aprAkR^itavapuH shrImAMllakShyalakShaNavarjitaH | ayaM mukto mochakashcha hyakAlaH kAlachodakaH
verses.translation: On hearing thus this story of the sages who had performed the satra for a long time Vayu was delighted in his mind and stayed there surrounded by the sages.
verses.hindi: अहस्ते प्रलीयन्ते रात्यन्ते विश्वसंभव:॥ ३९ है, उन महान् शंकरकों नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपरिकृतावासः सर्वावासश्च सर्ववित् । षड्विधाध्वमयस्यास्य सर्वस्य जगतः पतिः
verses.transliteration: sarvoparikR^itAvAsaH sarvAvAsashcha sarvavit | ShaDvidhAdhvamayasyAsya sarvasya jagataH patiH
verses.translation: On being implored by the sages, the lord succinctly narrated the glory of Jiva beginning with creation in order to enhance their piety.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सम्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायां पूर्वखण्डे कालप्रभावे त्रिदेवायुर्वर्णन॑ नामाष्टमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरोत्तरभूतानामुत्तरश्च निरुत्तरः । अनन्तानन्तसन्दोहमकरन्दमध्रुव्रतः
verses.transliteration: uttarottarabhUtAnAmuttarashcha niruttaraH | anantAnantasandohamakarandamadhruvrataH
verses.translation: There at the outset the fortunate residents of the Naiinisa bowed duly to lord Vayu and asked him.
verses.hindi: त्रिदेवोंका आयुवर्णन नामक आठवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्सर्वमिदं ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्रेन्द्रपूर्वकम् । सह भूतेन्द्रियैः सर्वैः प्रथमं सम्प्रसूयते
verses.transliteration: yasmAtsarvamidaM brahmaviShNurudrendrapUrvakam | saha bhUtendriyaiH sarvaiH prathamaM samprasUyate
verses.translation: How did you, sir, acquire the knowledge of Siva? Wherefore is your devotion to Siva, the Brahman whose birth is unnianifest.

verses.sanskrit: अखण्डजगदण्डानां पिण्डीकरणपण्डितः । औदार्यवीर्यगाम्भीर्यमाधुर्यमकरालयः
verses.transliteration: akhaNDajagadaNDAnAM piNDIkaraNapaNDitaH | audAryavIryagAmbhIryamAdhuryamakarAlayaH
verses.translation: The twenty-first kalpa shall be known as Svctalohita. In that kalpa the four-faced lord, desirous of creative activity performed a penance.

verses.sanskrit: नैवास्य सदृशं वस्तु नाधिकं चापि किञ्चन । अतुलः सर्वभूतानां राजराजश्च तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: naivAsya sadR^ishaM vastu nAdhikaM chApi ki~nchana | atulaH sarvabhUtAnAM rAjarAjashcha tiShThati
verses.translation: Delighted by his austere penance his father lord Siva, foremost among the handsome assumed the divine form ofabechelor. He became a sage Jveta and uttering divine.words appeared in front of him.
verses.hindi: और सबसे पृथक् तथा अन्वयरहित हैं

verses.sanskrit: अनेन चित्रकृत्येन प्रथमं सृज्यते जगत् । अन्तकाले पुनश्चेदं तस्मिन्प्रलयमेष्यति
verses.transliteration: anena chitrakR^ityena prathamaM sR^ijyate jagat | antakAle punashchedaM tasminpralayameShyati
verses.translation: Having acquired knowledge, the four-faced lord created all living beings — the mobile and immobile.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य भूतानि वश्यानि अयं सर्वनियोजकः । अयं तु परया भक्त्या दृश्यते नान्यथा क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: asya bhUtAni vashyAni ayaM sarvaniyojakaH | ayaM tu parayA bhaktyA dR^ishyate nAnyathA kvachit
verses.translation: Great and steady devotion shall be applied by a man who wishes for happiness, for the perfect knowledge of the individual soul, illusion and the lord who releases from the bondage.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतानि सर्वदानानि तपांसि नियमास्तथा । कथितानि पुरा सद्भिर्भावार्थं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: vratAni sarvadAnAni tapAMsi niyamAstathA | kathitAni purA sadbhirbhAvArthaM nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: Misery arises from ignorance. It is removed by knowledge that is a correct and precise comprehension of objects. Obj(T,t is twofold: sentient and non-sentient. 'riiere is a controller of the two. The three arc called Pasu, PaSa and Pati.
verses.hindi: होकर परस्पर चेष्टाशून्य ओत-प्रोत रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चाहं च रुद्रश्च तथान्ये च सुरासुराः । तपोभिरुग्रैरद्यापि तस्य दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: harishchAhaM cha rudrashcha tathAnye cha surAsurAH | tapobhirugrairadyApi tasya darshanakA~NkShiNaH
verses.translation: On many occasions knoweis of reality call the three by.Aksara, Ksara and Ksaraksarapaia.
verses.hindi: तस्मै नमः सकललोकविलक्षणाय॥ २४  विलक्षण परमेश्वर-को नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यः पतितैर्मूढैर्दुर्जनैरपि कुत्सितैः । भक्तैरन्तर्बहिश्चापि पूज्यः सम्भाष्य एव च
verses.transliteration: adR^ishyaH patitairmUDhairdurjanairapi kutsitaiH | bhaktairantarbahishchApi pUjyaH sambhAShya eva cha
verses.translation: How does the Maya cover up the pervading one? What for? Why is this covering up of the Purusa? By what is it made tf) recede?
verses.hindi: तथा प्रलयकर्त॒त्ववर्णन नामक नवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तदिदं त्रिविधं रूपं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं ततः परम् । अस्मदाद्यमरैर्दृश्यं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं तु योगिभिः
verses.transliteration: tadidaM trividhaM rUpaM sthUlaM sUkShmaM tataH param | asmadAdyamarairdR^ishyaM sthUlaM sUkShmaM tu yogibhiH
verses.translation: Even a pervasive can be covered just as Kala etc. that arc pervasive. The cause is Karman alone. The purpose is enjoyment. It recedes when dirt is quelled.
verses.hindi: बुद्धयादयो विशेषान्ता विकाराश्चाभवन् क्रमात्॥ १  सभी विकार क्रमश: उत्पन्न हुए

verses.sanskrit: ततः परं तु यन्नित्यं ज्ञानमानन्दमव्ययम् । तन्निष्ठैस्तत्परैर्भक्तैर्दृश्यं तद् व्रतमाश्रितैः
verses.transliteration: tataH paraM tu yannityaM j~nAnamAnandamavyayam | tanniShThaistatparairbhaktairdR^ishyaM tad vratamAshritaiH
verses.translation: Vidya (learning) that reveals the place and acti¬ vity, time and passion these arc the inducing agents. Time is the conditioning factor there; destiny is the controlling factor.
verses.hindi: पितामह--ये तीन जगत्कारणभूत देवता उत्पन्न हुए

verses.sanskrit: बहुनाऽत्र किमुक्तेन गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं परम् । शिवे भक्तिर्न सन्देहस्तया युक्तो विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: bahunA.atra kimuktena guhyAdguhyataraM param | shive bhaktirna sandehastayA yukto vimuchyate
verses.translation: Characteristically unmanifest it becomes manifest through Kalas. It is of the form and content of happiness, misery and delusion while being enjoyed. It has the three Gunas.
verses.hindi: अनुवर्तन करते हुए वृद्धिको प्राप्त होते रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: कारणानां च यो धाता ध्याता परमकारणम् । न सम्प्रसूयतेऽन्यस्मात्कुतश्चन कदाचन
verses.transliteration: kAraNAnAM cha yo dhAtA dhyAtA paramakAraNam | na samprasUyate.anyasmAtkutashchana kadAchana
verses.translation: The Gunas Sativa, R.ijas and Tamas, originate from Prakrti. Like oil in the gingclly seed they are present in the latest form in Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादादेव सा भक्तिः प्रसादो भक्तिसम्भवः । यथा चाङ्कुरतो बीजं बीजतो वा यथाङ्कुरः
verses.transliteration: prasAdAdeva sA bhaktiH prasAdo bhaktisambhavaH | yathA chA~Nkurato bIjaM bIjato vA yathA~NkuraH
verses.translation: Happiness and its cause constitute briefly the Satttvaic trait. The Rajasaic trait is its opposite. Stun¬ ned state and delusion are Tamasic tiaits. The Sattvaic movement is upward progress; the Tamasic one is downfall; the middle course is cited as Rajasaic.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादपूर्विका एव पशोः सर्वत्र सिद्धयः । स एव साधनैरन्ते सर्वैरपि च साध्यते
verses.transliteration: prasAdapUrvikA eva pashoH sarvatra siddhayaH | sa eva sAdhanairante sarvairapi cha sAdhyate
verses.translation: The separateness of all-pervading lord from the intellect, sense-organs and the body is definite. There is something called Atman. A reason thereof is difficult to understand.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादसाधनं धर्मः स च वेदेन दर्शितः । तदभ्यासवशात्साम्यं पूर्वयोः पुण्यपापयोः
verses.transliteration: prasAdasAdhanaM dharmaH sa cha vedena darshitaH | tadabhyAsavashAtsAmyaM pUrvayoH puNyapApayoH
verses.translation: The intellect, the sense-organs and the bodies are not the Atman due to indefinite knowledge and non- eternality.
verses.hindi: विभक्त होनेके कारण बे चतुर्व्यूह कहे जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: साम्यात्प्रसादसम्पर्को धर्मस्यातिशयस्ततः । धर्मातिशयमासाद्य पशोः पापपरिक्षयः
verses.transliteration: sAmyAtprasAdasamparko dharmasyAtishayastataH | dharmAtishayamAsAdya pashoH pApaparikShayaH
verses.translation: Hence the one who has the cognition of expe¬ rienced objects and comprehends the entire knowables, is sung about in the Vedas and Upanisads as the immanent soul.
verses.hindi: करते हैं, अतः प्रजापति कहे गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रक्षीणपापस्य बहुभिर्जन्मभिः क्रमात् । साम्बे सर्वेश्वरे भक्तिर्ज्ञानपूर्वा प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: evaM prakShINapApasya bahubhirjanmabhiH kramAt | sAmbe sarveshvare bhaktirj~nAnapUrvA prajAyate
verses.translation: This Atman cannot be perceived by the eye nor by any other sense-organ. The great Atman is comprehended only by the enlightened mind.

verses.sanskrit: भावानुगुणमीशस्य प्रसादो व्यतिरिच्यते । प्रसादात्कर्मसन्त्यागः फलतो न स्वरूपतः
verses.transliteration: bhAvAnuguNamIshasya prasAdo vyatirichyate | prasAdAtkarmasantyAgaH phalato na svarUpataH
verses.translation: It remains unembodied in the unsteady bodies. It is stable and steady like a stump. It is unchanging. Only the sober, self-pos.scsscd and bold can perceive it by means 01" reflection.
verses.hindi: विकारोंकी सृष्टिकर उन्हें पुन: समेट लेता है

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्कर्मफलत्यागाच्छिवधर्मान्वयः शुभः । स च गुर्वनपेक्षश्च तदपेक्ष इति द्विधा
verses.transliteration: tasmAtkarmaphalatyAgAchChivadharmAnvayaH shubhaH | sa cha gurvanapekShashcha tadapekSha iti dvidhA
verses.translation: The Purusa becomes happy, mi.serable or delu d on becoming associated with the body — the seed of all adversities caused by his own activities.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रानपेक्षात्सापेक्षो मुख्यः शतगुणाधिकः । शिवधर्मान्वयस्यास्य शिवज्ञानसमन्वयः
verses.transliteration: tatrAnapekShAtsApekSho mukhyaH shataguNAdhikaH | shivadharmAnvayasyAsya shivaj~nAnasamanvayaH
verses.translation: As the field flooded with water generates sprouts so, also the action flooded with ignorance generates the man.
verses.hindi: और वैषम्यकी स्थितिमें सृष्टि कही जाती है

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानान्वयवशात्पुंसः संसारे दोषदर्शनम् । ततो विषयवैराग्यं वैराग्याद्भावसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: j~nAnAnvayavashAtpuMsaH saMsAre doShadarshanam | tato viShayavairAgyaM vairAgyAdbhAvasAdhanam
verses.translation: Thousands in number arc his bodies both of the past and the future. These arc mortals, abodes of excessive distress.
verses.hindi: प्रधानके द्वारा सृजित किये गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: भावसिद्ध्युपपन्नस्य ध्याने निष्ठा न कर्मणि । ज्ञानध्यानाभियुक्तस्य पुंसो योगः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: bhAvasiddhyupapannasya dhyAne niShThA na karmaNi | j~nAnadhyAnAbhiyuktasya puMso yogaH pravartate
verses.translation: A perpetual stay in the bodies that successively
verses.hindi: और उन्होंने ही इन लोकोंकी रचना की है

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैश्वर्येण सम्पन्नो नाम्ना सर्वेश्वरः स्वयम् । सर्वैर्मुमुक्षुभिर्ध्येयः शम्भुराकाशमध्यगः
verses.transliteration: sarvaishvaryeNa sampanno nAmnA sarveshvaraH svayam | sarvairmumukShubhirdhyeyaH shambhurAkAshamadhyagaH
verses.translation: Covered by and.separated from these bodies this soul resembles tlic disc of the moon in the sky that is covered by and separated from the passing clouds.

verses.sanskrit: योगेन तु परा भक्तिः प्रसादस्तदनन्तरम् । प्रसादान्मुच्यते जन्तुर्मुक्तः शिवसमो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yogena tu parA bhaktiH prasAdastadanantaram | prasAdAnmuchyate janturmuktaH shivasamo bhavet
verses.translation: The different activities of the.soul in the different bodies resemble the motion of the die in the different squares in the chess-board.

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहप्रकारस्य क्रमोऽयमविवक्षितः । यादृशी योग्यता पुंसस्तस्य तादृगनुग्रहः
verses.transliteration: anugrahaprakArasya kramo.ayamavivakShitaH | yAdR^ishI yogyatA puMsastasya tAdR^iganugrahaH
verses.translation: None belongs to him. He does not belong to anyone. The contact with wives, sons and kinsmen is but a chance meeting on the way.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माण्डस्थितिवर्णन नामक दसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थो मुच्यते कश्चिज्जायमानस्तथापरः । बालो वा तरुणो वाथ वृद्धो वा मुच्यते परः
verses.transliteration: garbhastho muchyate kashchijjAyamAnastathAparaH | bAlo vA taruNo vAtha vR^iddho vA muchyate paraH
verses.translation: He sees the body but the body does not see him. A certain other being, the great Atman secs both but both of them do not see him.

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यग्योनिगतः कश्चिन्मुच्यते नारकोऽपरः । अपरस्तु पदं प्राप्तो मुच्यते स्वपदक्षये
verses.transliteration: tiryagyonigataH kashchinmuchyate nArako.aparaH | aparastu padaM prApto muchyate svapadakShaye
verses.translation: All living beings beginning with Biahma and ending widi the immobile are tctincd Pasus. Examples cited relate to these Pasus.
verses.hindi: चल रहा है, इसमें भी चौदह मनु हैं

verses.sanskrit: कश्चित्क्षीणपदो भूत्वा पुनरावर्त्य मुच्यते । कश्चिदध्वगतस्तस्मिन् स्थित्वा स्थित्वा विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: kashchitkShINapado bhUtvA punarAvartya muchyate | kashchidadhvagatastasmin sthitvA sthitvA vimuchyate
verses.translation: These Pasus arc b(»und with Pasa (noose) and are fed upon joy and misery as their fodder. The wise say that these are but instruments of games and sports of lord Siva.
verses.hindi: अंजनपर्वतके समान शोभायमान हो रहा था

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्नैकप्रकारेण नराणां मुक्तिरिष्यते । ज्ञानभावानुरूपेण प्रसादेनैव निर्वृतिः
verses.transliteration: tasmAnnaikaprakAreNa narANAM muktiriShyate | j~nAnabhAvAnurUpeNa prasAdenaiva nirvR^itiH
verses.translation: The ignorant creature cannot effect and prevent his htippiness and misery. Induced by the lord he goes up cO the heaven or falls into the deep ditch.
verses.hindi: चरमचरं च जगत्ससर्ज भूयः॥ ३६  चराचर जगत्की रचना की

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादस्य प्रसादार्थं वाङ्मनोदोषवर्जिताः । ध्यायन्तश्शिवमेवैकं सदारतनयाग्नयः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdasya prasAdArthaM vA~NmanodoShavarjitAH | dhyAyantashshivamevaikaM sadAratanayAgnayaH
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Vayu, the sages were delighted in their minds. After bowing to him who was expert in the Salvitc Agama they spoke: —

verses.sanskrit: तन्निष्ठास्तत्पराः सर्वे तद्युक्तास्तदुपाश्रयाः । सर्वक्रियाः प्रकुर्वाणास्तमेव मनसा गताः
verses.transliteration: tanniShThAstatparAH sarve tadyuktAstadupAshrayAH | sarvakriyAH prakurvANAstameva manasA gatAH
verses.translation: In his absence how could the tiniversc have been created, since Pasa is insentient and the Pasu is ignorant?
verses.hindi: आदिवर्णन नामक ग्यारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घसूत्रसमारब्धं दिव्यवर्षसहस्रकम् । सत्रान्ते मन्त्रयोगेन वायुस्तत्र गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: dIrghasUtrasamArabdhaM divyavarShasahasrakam | satrAnte mantrayogena vAyustatra gamiShyati
verses.translation: Without an intelligent cause nothing has ever been seen anywhere created by Pradhana, Parainanu or any?uch insentient being.
verses.hindi: अविद्या पञ्ञमी चैषा प्रादुर्भूता महात्मतः॥ २  अविद्या उत्पन्न हुई

verses.sanskrit: स एव भवतां श्रेयः सोपायं कथयिष्यति । ततो वाराणसी पुण्या पुरी परमशोभना
verses.transliteration: sa eva bhavatAM shreyaH sopAyaM kathayiShyati | tato vArANasI puNyA purI paramashobhanA
verses.translation: Creativity of Pasu without the knowledge of creation like the going of a blind man is due to the inducement of his lord.
verses.hindi: कुम्भ बीजको आवृत किये रहता है

verses.sanskrit: योऽग्रे मां विदधे पुत्रं ज्ञानं च प्रहिणोति मे । तत्प्रसादान्मया लब्धं प्राजापत्यमिदं पदम्
verses.transliteration: yo.agre mAM vidadhe putraM j~nAnaM cha prahiNoti me | tatprasAdAnmayA labdhaM prAjApatyamidaM padam
verses.translation: Realising distinction between him and himself and being gratified after resorting to him Pasu can attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: गन्तव्या यत्र विश्वेशो देव्या सह पिनाकधृक् । सदा विहरति श्रीमान् भक्तानुग्रहकारणात्
verses.transliteration: gantavyA yatra vishvesho devyA saha pinAkadhR^ik | sadA viharati shrImAn bhaktAnugrahakAraNAt
verses.translation: Lord the redeemer of the universe sustains the universe of Ksara and Aksara, the two in unison, the mani¬ fest and the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: छठा सर्ग है, वह देवसर्ग कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: तत्राश्चर्यं महद् दृष्ट्वा मत्समीपं गमिष्यथ । ततो वः कथयिष्यामि मोक्षोपायं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tatrAshcharyaM mahad dR^iShTvA matsamIpaM gamiShyatha | tato vaH kathayiShyAmi mokShopAyaM dvijottamAH
verses.translation: The enjoyer, the enjoyed and the instigator — the three alone shall be distinguished. There is nothing else to be known by the seekers of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: येनैकजन्मना मुक्तिर्युष्मत्करतले स्थिता । अनेकजन्मसंसारबन्धनिर्मोक्षकारिणी
verses.transliteration: yenaikajanmanA muktiryuShmatkaratale sthitA | anekajanmasaMsArabandhanirmokShakAriNI
verses.translation: The man endowed with truth and penance sees in his Atman the great Atman like the oil in the gingelly
verses.hindi: करनेवाले हैं, जो रुद्रके साथ उत्पन्न हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: एतन्मनोमयं चक्रं मया सृष्टं विसृज्यते । यत्रास्य शीर्यते नेमिः स देशस्तपसः शुभः
verses.transliteration: etanmanomayaM chakraM mayA sR^iShTaM visR^ijyate | yatrAsya shIryate nemiH sa deshastapasaH shubhaH
verses.translation: He has eyes, faces and feet all round.'*®

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा सूर्यसङ्काशं चक्रं दृष्ट्वा मनोमयम् । प्रणिपत्य महादेवं विससर्ज पितामहः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA sUryasa~NkAshaM chakraM dR^iShTvA manomayam | praNipatya mahAdevaM visasarja pitAmahaH
verses.translation: The sole lord and creator of the heaven and earth is Maheiivara. He is the origin and the place of merger of all the gods.'*'

verses.sanskrit: तेऽपि हृष्टतरा विप्राः प्रणम्य जगतां प्रभुम् । प्रययुस्तस्य चक्रस्य यत्र नेमिरशीर्यत
verses.transliteration: te.api hR^iShTatarA viprAH praNamya jagatAM prabhum | prayayustasya chakrasya yatra nemirashIryata
verses.translation: The Sruti says that Rudra the great sage is superior to all; he creates Hiranyagarbha the first among the deities.'®*
verses.hindi: सर्वे वर्णा गात्रतः संप्रसूता:॥ ७७ प्रादुर्भाव हुआ है

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं तदपि सङ्क्षिप्तं श्लक्ष्णं चारुशिलातले । विमलस्वादुपानीये निपपात वने क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: chakraM tadapi sa~NkShiptaM shlakShNaM chArushilAtale | vimalasvAdupAnIye nipapAta vane kvachit
verses.translation: I know this great Purua, the undying, steady, having the colour of the sun, the lord stationed beyond darkness.'*®
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायां पूर्वखण्डे सृष्टिवर्णन॑ नाम द्वादशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तद्वनं तेन विख्यातं नैमिषं मुनिपूजितम् । अनेकयक्षगन्धर्वविद्याधरसमाकुलम्
verses.transliteration: tadvanaM tena vikhyAtaM naimiShaM munipUjitam | anekayakShagandharvavidyAdharasamAkulam
verses.translation: He has all faces, heads and necks. He lies in the cavity of the heart of all. He is all-pervading and present everywhere.
verses.hindi: सृष्टिवर्णन नामक बारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अष्टादश समुद्रस्य द्वीपानश्नन्पुरूरवाः । विलासवशमुर्वश्या यातो दैवेन चोदितः
verses.transliteration: aShTAdasha samudrasya dvIpAnashnanpurUravAH | vilAsavashamurvashyA yAto daivena choditaH
verses.translation: He has hands, feet, eyes, heads, ears and faces all around. He stands enveloping everything in the world.

verses.sanskrit: अक्रमेणाहरन्मोहाद्यज्ञवाटं हिरण्मयम् । मुनिभिर्यत्र सङ्क्रुद्धैः कुशवज्रैर्निपातितः
verses.transliteration: akrameNAharanmohAdyaj~navATaM hiraNmayam | munibhiryatra sa~NkruddhaiH kushavajrairnipAtitaH
verses.translation: They call him the great Purusa — who sees without eyes, hears without ears and comprehends all and whom no one knows.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा और विष्णु एक-एक करके उत्पन्न हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: ईशो वृक्ष इव स्तब्धो य एको दिवि तिष्ठति । येनेदमखिलं पूर्णं पुरुषेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration: Isho vR^ikSha iva stabdho ya eko divi tiShThati | yenedamakhilaM pUrNaM puruSheNa mahAtmanA
verses.translation: Ibid. 17.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वं सिसृक्षमाणा वै यत्र विश्वसृजः पुरा । सत्रमारेभिरे दिव्यं ब्रह्मज्ञा गार्हपत्यगाः
verses.transliteration: vishvaM sisR^ikShamANA vai yatra vishvasR^ijaH purA | satramArebhire divyaM brahmaj~nA gArhapatyagAH
verses.hindi: सभी बातें आपको स्मरण भी हैं

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्यत्र विद्वद्भिः शब्दार्थन्यायकोविदैः । शक्तिप्रज्ञाक्रियायोगैर्विधिरासीदनुष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: R^iShibhiryatra vidvadbhiH shabdArthanyAyakovidaiH | shaktipraj~nAkriyAyogairvidhirAsIdanuShThitaH
verses.translation: Ibid 31. 18.
verses.hindi: उत्तम चरित्र सुननेके लिये श्रद्धायुक्त हैं

verses.sanskrit: यत्र वेदविदो नित्यं वेदवादबहिष्कृतान् । वादजल्पबलैर्घ्नन्ति वचोभिरतिवादिनः
verses.transliteration: yatra vedavido nityaM vedavAdabahiShkR^itAn | vAdajalpabalairghnanti vachobhirativAdinaH

verses.sanskrit: स्फटिकमयमहीभृत्पादजाभ्यश्शिलाभ्यः प्रसरदमृतकल्पस्वच्छपानीयरम्यम् । अतिरसफलवृक्षप्रायमव्यालसत्त्वं तपस उचितमासीन्नैमिषं तन्मुनीनाम्
verses.transliteration: sphaTikamayamahIbhR^itpAdajAbhyashshilAbhyaH prasaradamR^itakalpasvachChapAnIyaramyam | atirasaphalavR^ikShaprAyamavyAlasattvaM tapasa uchitamAsInnaimiShaM tanmunInAm
verses.translation: By the grace of the creator, one devoid of sorrows perceives him who is endowed with the excellence of greatness and who does not possess intelligence but is intelli¬ gence itself.

verses.sanskrit: एको बहूनां जन्तूनां निष्क्रियाणां च सक्रियः । य एको बहुधा बीजं करोति स महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: eko bahUnAM jantUnAM niShkriyANAM cha sakriyaH | ya eko bahudhA bIjaM karoti sa maheshvaraH
verses.translation: I know the unaging ancient omnipresent lord whose birth is denied by those who can expound the know¬ ledge of the Brahman.**®

verses.sanskrit: जीवैरेभिरिमांल्लोकान्सर्वानीशो य ईशते । य एको भागवान् रुद्रो न द्वितीयोऽस्ति कश्चन
verses.transliteration: jIvairebhirimAMllokAnsarvAnIsho ya Ishate | ya eko bhAgavAn rudro na dvitIyo.asti kashchana
verses.translation: After annihilating in the end, the lord creates the universe again from the beginning in association with his manifold l§aktis.

verses.sanskrit: सदा जनानां हृदये सन्निविष्टोऽपि यः परैः । अलक्ष्यो लक्षयन्विश्वमधितिष्ठति सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: sadA janAnAM hR^idaye sanniviShTo.api yaH paraiH | alakShyo lakShayanvishvamadhitiShThati sarvadA
verses.translation: The Maya of Siva is the unborn mother of the universe and has variegated colours and shapes. It is white, red and black. She, the unborn, gives birth to man. He, the unborn, resorts to it and gets involved in distress Another Aja, the liberated soul, eschews her after she has been enjoyed.***
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मकी ओर देखा और थोड़ा-सा मुसकराने लगे

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The great Atman, the Mayin entering this, creates the universe by his Maya. Maya shall be known as Prakrti and Mahesvara as Mayin.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The great Atman, the Mayin entering this, creates the universe by his Maya. Maya shall be known as Prakrti and Mahesvara as Mayin.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.४. चतुर्थोऽध्यायः । वायुसमागमः । सूत उवाच । तस्मिन्देशे महाभागा मुनयः शंसितव्रताः । अर्चयन्तो महादेवं सत्रमारेभिरे तदा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.4\. chaturtho.adhyAyaH | vAyusamAgamaH | sUta uvAcha | tasmindeshe mahAbhAgA munayaH shaMsitavratAH | archayanto mahAdevaM satramArebhire tadA
verses.translation: The universe is permeated by his parts. The Purusa attains perpetual peace and calmness on realising lord Siva the creator and enveloper of the universe and the subtler of the subtlest, from his very inception in the foetus.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि तत्र समासीनो मुनिभिः सम्यगर्चितः । प्रतिनन्द्य च तान् सर्वान् पप्रच्छ कुशलं ततः
verses.transliteration: so.api tatra samAsIno munibhiH samyagarchitaH | pratinandya cha tAn sarvAn paprachCha kushalaM tataH
verses.translation: On realising the lord pervading all living beings like the subtle cream over the ghee, one is freed from sins.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माविष्णुस॒ष्टिकधन नामक तेरहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । अत्र वः कुशलं विप्राः कच्चिद्वृत्ते महाक्रतौ । कच्चिद्यज्ञहनो दैत्या न बाधेरन्सुरद्विषः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | atra vaH kushalaM viprAH kachchidvR^itte mahAkratau | kachchidyaj~nahano daityA na bAdheransuradviShaH

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं दुरिष्टं वा न कश्चित्समजायत । स्तोत्रमन्त्रजपैर्देवान् पितृन् पित्र्यैश्च कर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: prAyashchittaM duriShTaM vA na kashchitsamajAyata | stotramantrajapairdevAn pitR^in pitryaishcha karmabhiH

verses.sanskrit: कच्चिदभ्यर्च्य युष्माभिर्विधिरासीत्स्वनुष्ठितः । निवृत्ते च महासत्रे पश्चात्किं वश्चिकीर्षितम्
verses.transliteration: kachchidabhyarchya yuShmAbhirvidhirAsItsvanuShThitaH | nivR^itte cha mahAsatre pashchAtkiM vashchikIrShitam
verses.translation: None can grasp his top, sides or middle. There is nothing resembling him. His is the great fame."*®

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ता मुनयः सर्वे वायुना शिवभाविना । प्रहृष्टमनसः पूताः प्रत्यूचुर्विनयान्विताः
verses.transliteration: ityuktA munayaH sarve vAyunA shivabhAvinA | prahR^iShTamanasaH pUtAH pratyUchurvinayAnvitAH
verses.translation: Those who are frightened of rebirths meditate on the unborn. For the sake of succour they resoi t to the front face of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । अद्य नः कुशलं सर्वमद्य साधु भवेत्तपः । अस्मच्छ्रेयोऽभिवृद्ध्यर्थं भवानत्रागतो यतः
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | adya naH kushalaM sarvamadya sAdhu bhavettapaH | asmachChreyo.abhivR^iddhyarthaM bhavAnatrAgato yataH
verses.translation: The two Vid>a and Avidya lie hidden in the imperishable, infinite great Brahman.
verses.hindi: ऊर्ध्वरेता: स्थित: स्थाणुर्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम्॥ २९  लिये स्थाणुरूपमें स्थित हो गये

verses.sanskrit: शृणु चेदं पुरावृत्तं तमसाक्रान्तमानसैः । उपासितः पुरास्माभिर्विज्ञानार्थं प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: shR^iNu chedaM purAvR^ittaM tamasAkrAntamAnasaiH | upAsitaH purAsmAbhirvij~nAnArthaM prajApatiH
verses.translation: He illuminates the quarters above, below and to the sides, shining himself. He is innately alone, foremost of all who presides over all.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽप्यस्माननुगृह्याह शरण्यः शरणागतान् । सर्वस्मादधिको रुद्रो विप्राः परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: so.apyasmAnanugR^ihyAha sharaNyaH sharaNAgatAn | sarvasmAdadhiko rudro viprAH paramakAraNam
verses.translation: Transforming the attributes, the expressions of nature and expressed ones into what is enjoyed and the one that enjoys, he occupies the universe.
verses.hindi: रुद्राविर्भाववर्णन नामक चौदहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तमप्रतर्क्यं याथात्म्यं भक्तिमानेव पश्यति । भक्तिश्चास्य प्रसादेन प्रसादादेव निर्वृतिः
verses.transliteration: tamapratarkyaM yAthAtmyaM bhaktimAneva pashyati | bhaktishchAsya prasAdena prasAdAdeva nirvR^itiH
verses.translation: The gods and the sages know him as hidden i/i the secret Upani$ad, who is Brahman, greater than the greatest, the progenitor of Brahma and the cause of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादस्य प्रसादार्थं नैमिषे सत्रयोगतः । यजध्वं दीर्घसत्रेण रुद्रं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAdasya prasAdArthaM naimiShe satrayogataH | yajadhvaM dIrghasatreNa rudraM paramakAraNam
verses.translation: Those who knew the lord eschewed their bodies. The lord can be realised only through piety. He is wishless, (he cause of positive and negative substances and the creator of Kalas.
verses.hindi: जय हो, है प्रकृतिसुन्दरि! आपकी जय हो

verses.sanskrit: तच्च सत्रं प्रववृते सर्वाश्चर्यं महर्षिणाम् । विश्वं सिसृक्षमाणानां पुरा विश्वसृजामिव
verses.transliteration: tachcha satraM pravavR^ite sarvAshcharyaM maharShiNAm | vishvaM sisR^ikShamANAnAM purA vishvasR^ijAmiva

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रसादेन सत्रान्ते वायुस्तत्रागमिष्यति । तन्मुखाज्ज्ञानलाभो वस्तत्र श्रेयो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tatprasAdena satrAnte vAyustatrAgamiShyati | tanmukhAjj~nAnalAbho vastatra shreyo bhaviShyati
verses.translation: When these are quelled he goes to another world. This is the cause of union of the two— the enjoyer and the
verses.hindi: जय हो, है त्रिगुणमर्दिनि! आपकी जय हो

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादिश्य वयं सर्वे प्रेषिताः परमेष्ठिना । अस्मिन्देशे महाभाग तवागमनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: ityAdishya vayaM sarve preShitAH parameShThinA | asmindeshe mahAbhAga tavAgamanakA~NkShiNaH
verses.translation: We worship and meditate upon the lord of manifold forms, the unborn, lord of people, object of worship and meditation by the entire universe. He is stationed in our minds.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घसत्रं समासीना दिव्यवर्षसहस्रकम् । अतस्तवागमादन्यत्प्रार्थ्यं नो नास्ति किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: dIrghasatraM samAsInA divyavarShasahasrakam | atastavAgamAdanyatprArthyaM no nAsti ki~nchana
verses.translation: We know him as the greatest of lords, the greatest of deities, the lord of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: इत्याकर्ण्य पुरावृत्तमृषीणां दीर्घसत्रिणाम् । वायुः प्रीतमना भूत्वा तत्रासीन्मुनिसंवृतः
verses.transliteration: ityAkarNya purAvR^ittamR^iShINAM dIrghasatriNAm | vAyuH prItamanA bhUtvA tatrAsInmunisaMvR^itaH
verses.translation: He has neither cause nor effect. Nowhere in the universe there is anyone equal or superior to him.
verses.hindi: शिवश्िवास्तुतिवर्णन नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तैर्मुनिभिः पृष्टस्तेषां भावविवृद्धये । सर्गादि शार्वमैश्वर्यं समासादवदद् विभुः
verses.transliteration: tatastairmunibhiH pR^iShTasteShAM bhAvavivR^iddhaye | sargAdi shArvamaishvaryaM samAsAdavadad vibhuH
verses.translation: He has no lord, no sex and no ruler. He is the cause of causes and the lord of lords.
verses.hindi: तुम्हें अभीष्ट वर प्रदान करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: अथ काले गते सत्रे समाप्ते भूरिदक्षिणे । पितामहनियोगेन वायुस्तत्रागमत्स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: atha kAle gate satre samApte bhUridakShiNe | pitAmahaniyogena vAyustatrAgamatsvayam
verses.translation: He has no progenitor nor does he take birth from anywhere. He has no causes of birth such as Dirt, Maya etc.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यः स्वयम्भुवो देवः सर्वप्रत्यक्षदृग्वशी । आज्ञायां मरुतो यस्य संस्थिताः सप्तसप्तकाः
verses.transliteration: shiShyaH svayambhuvo devaH sarvapratyakShadR^igvashI | Aj~nAyAM maruto yasya saMsthitAH saptasaptakAH
verses.translation: On realising the lord of the universe, comprehensible through Sahkhya and Yoga, the cause of the universe the
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मापि प्राप सानन्दं सन्‍्तोष॑ मुनिपुड्रवाः॥ २६  सन्तोष प्राप्त हुआ

verses.sanskrit: प्रेरयञ्छश्वदङ्गानि प्राणाद्याभिः स्ववृत्तिभिः । सर्वभूतशरीराणां कुरुते यश्च धारणम्
verses.transliteration: preraya~nChashvada~NgAni prANAdyAbhiH svavR^ittibhiH | sarvabhUtasharIrANAM kurute yashcha dhAraNam
verses.translation: Sveta 4. 6. 11
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायां पूर्वखवण्डे देवीशक्त्युद्धभगो नाम षोडशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: अणिमादिभिरष्टाभिरैश्वर्यैश्च समन्वितः । तिर्यक् करादिभिर्मेध्यैर्भुवनानि बिभर्ति यः
verses.transliteration: aNimAdibhiraShTAbhiraishvaryaishcha samanvitaH | tiryak karAdibhirmedhyairbhuvanAni bibharti yaH
verses.translation: After realising the lord who at the outset created Brahma and taught him the Vedas, through the clarity of my intellect, 1 shall be desirous of salvation from this worldly cxi.s- tence. 1 take refuge in &va who is devoid of attributes and activities, who is quiescent, the undespicable and the unsullied.
verses.hindi: शक्तिका उद्धव नामक सोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: आकाशयोनिर्द्विगुणः स्पर्शशब्दसमन्वयात् । तेजसां प्रकृतिश्चेति यमाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: AkAshayonirdviguNaH sparshashabdasamanvayAt | tejasAM prakR^itishcheti yamAhustattvachintakAH
verses.translation: After realising the great bridge that takes to immortality I shall be quiescent like the fire that has consumed fuel. When men wear the ether as they wear a hide they will realise the end of miseries before they have realisrd Siva.
verses.hindi: चाहिए तथा दूसरी प्रसूति कही गयी है

verses.sanskrit: तमाश्रमगतं दृष्ट्वा मुनयो दीर्घसत्रिणः । पितामहवचः स्मृत्वा प्रहर्षमतुलं ययुः
verses.transliteration: tamAshramagataM dR^iShTvA munayo dIrghasatriNaH | pitAmahavachaH smR^itvA praharShamatulaM yayuH
verses.translation: O sages, due to the power of penance, the grace of the lord and the result of my good fortune I secured the holy knowledge straight from the mouth of Brahma, the know¬ ledge that quells sins, lies hidden in the Upanisads and was enunciated in a previous Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्युत्थाय ततः सर्वे प्रणम्याम्बरसम्भवम् । चामीकरमयं तस्मै विष्टरं समकल्पयन्
verses.transliteration: abhyutthAya tataH sarve praNamyAmbarasambhavam | chAmIkaramayaM tasmai viShTaraM samakalpayan
verses.translation: This excellent knowledge shall not be delivered to one who is not quiet, nor to a son who is not well behaved nor to one who is not one's own disciple.
verses.hindi: इसका वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: By his control, Brahma, Vinu, Rudra, gods and Asuras cannot transgress the laws of propriety

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: By his control, Brahma, Vinu, Rudra, gods and Asuras cannot transgress the laws of propriety
verses.hindi: इन लोकप्रसिद्ध तीन कन्‍्याओंको जन्म दिया

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.५. पञ्चमोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्वज्ञानवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । तत्र पूर्वं महाभागा नैमिषारण्यवासिनः । प्रणिपत्य यथान्यायं पप्रच्छुः पवनं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.5\. pa~nchamo.adhyAyaH | shivatattvaj~nAnavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | tatra pUrvaM mahAbhAgA naimiShAraNyavAsinaH | praNipatya yathAnyAyaM paprachChuH pavanaM prabhum
verses.translation: It classiBes itself in the factors of past, present and future and makes people grow old. Thus freely lording over all it is extremely terrible.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । पशुपाशपतिज्ञानं यल्लब्धं तु मया पुरा । तत्र निष्ठा परा कार्या पुरुषेण सुखार्थिना
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | pashupAshapatij~nAnaM yallabdhaM tu mayA purA | tatra niShThA parA kAryA puruSheNa sukhArthinA
verses.translation: The Energy in the form of Kala consists of its various parts. It comes out of it and permeates it like the piece of steel that sheds sparks of fire.
verses.hindi: सर्गादयो5पि कथिता हत्यत्र तत्प्रविस्तरैः॥ ६५  प्रयोजन व्यर्थ है

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानप्रभवं दुःखं ज्ञानेनैव निवर्त्तते । ज्ञानं वस्तुपरिच्छेदो वस्तु च त्रिविधं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: aj~nAnaprabhavaM duHkhaM j~nAnenaiva nivarttate | j~nAnaM vastuparichChedo vastu cha trividhaM smR^itam
verses.translation: Since the unobstructed splendour of Siva is firmly fixed in Kala the limit of Kala is extensive and is untrans- eressable.

verses.sanskrit: अजडं च जडं चैव नियन्तृ च तयोरपि । पशुः पाशः पतिश्चेति कथ्यते तत्त्रयं क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ajaDaM cha jaDaM chaiva niyantR^i cha tayorapi | pashuH pAshaH patishcheti kathyate tattrayaM kramAt
verses.translation: Even those who attack the earth and rule it under a single umbrella cannot step beyond Kala like the oceans that do not overflow the shore.
verses.hindi: सृष्टिकथन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अक्षरं च क्षरं चैव क्षराक्षरपरं तथा । तदेतत्त्रितयं भूम्ना कथ्यते तत्त्ववेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: akSharaM cha kSharaM chaiva kSharAkSharaparaM tathA | tadetattritayaM bhUmnA kathyate tattvavedibhiH
verses.translation: Even those who restrain their sense-organs and conquer the universe cannot conquer Kala. Kala over¬ whelms them.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षरं पशुरित्युक्तः क्षरं पाश उदाहृतः । क्षराक्षरपरं यत्तत् पतिरित्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: akSharaM pashurityuktaH kSharaM pAsha udAhR^itaH | kSharAkSharaparaM yattat patirityabhidhIyate
verses.translation: Physicians well-versed in medicines regularly taking in elixirs and aphrodisiacs do not thwart death. Indeed Kala is untransgressable.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । किं तच्च क्षरमित्युक्तं किं चाक्षरमुदाहृतम् । तयोश्च परमं किं वा तदेतद् ब्रूहि मारुत
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | kiM tachcha kSharamityuktaM kiM chAkSharamudAhR^itam | tayoshcha paramaM kiM vA tadetad brUhi mAruta
verses.translation: The individual soul proposes something on the basis of its glory, beauty, conduct, strength and pedigree but Kfila disposes it.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । प्रकृतिः क्षरमित्युक्तं पुरुषोऽक्षर उच्यते । ताविमौ प्रेरयत्यन्यः स परः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | prakR^itiH kSharamityuktaM puruSho.akShara uchyate | tAvimau prerayatyanyaH sa paraH parameshvaraH
verses.translation: By means of pleasing, displeasing and imexpected contacts, Kala unites and separates the living beings.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । कैषा प्रकृतिरित्युक्ता क एष पुरुषो मतः । अनयोः केन सम्बन्धः कोऽयं प्रेरक ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | kaiShA prakR^itirityuktA ka eSha puruSho mataH | anayoH kena sambandhaH ko.ayaM preraka IshvaraH
verses.translation: A young man changes into a feeble aged man. A powerful man becomes weak. A rich man becomes deprived of prosperity. O brahmins, the ways of Kala are wonderful.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । मायाप्रकृतिरुद्दिष्टा पुरुषो माययाऽऽवृतः । सम्बन्धो मलकर्मभ्यां शिवः प्रेरक ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | mAyAprakR^itiruddiShTA puruSho mAyayA.a.avR^itaH | sambandho malakarmabhyAM shivaH preraka IshvaraH
verses.translation: Neither nobility of birth, nor good conduct nor strength nor skill is of any avail. Kala is unthwartable.
verses.hindi: धर्मार्थ प्रवृत्त होनेपर महादेवने विघ्न किया

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । केयं माया समाख्याता किंरूपो मायया वृतः । मलं कीदृक् कुतो वास्य किं शिवत्वं कुतश्शिवः
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | keyaM mAyA samAkhyAtA kiMrUpo mAyayA vR^itaH | malaM kIdR^ik kuto vAsya kiM shivatvaM kutashshivaH
verses.translation: Even elixirs, panaceas and well administered medicines do not have any effect if the time is not oppor¬ tune. Those very things brought into use at the proper time are efficacious and yield happiness.

verses.sanskrit: नैमिषीया ऊचुः । भवान् कथमनुप्राप्तो ज्ञानमीश्वरगोचरम् । कथं च शिष्यभावस्ते ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: naimiShIyA UchuH | bhavAn kathamanuprApto j~nAnamIshvaragocharam | kathaM cha shiShyabhAvaste brahmaNo.avyaktajanmanaH
verses.translation: At the proper time the cool wind blows, the rain falls; the heat subsides and every thing grows.
verses.hindi: सतीदेहत्याग नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । माया माहेश्वरी शक्तिश्चिद्रूपो मायया वृतः । मलश्चिच्छादको नैजो विशुद्धिः शिवता स्वतः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | mAyA mAheshvarI shaktishchidrUpo mAyayA vR^itaH | malashchichChAdako naijo vishuddhiH shivatA svataH
verses.translation: He who thus correctly understands the principle of Kala goes beyond it and sees that which is beyond Kala.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । आवृणोति कथं माया व्यापिनं केन हेतुना । किमर्थं चावृतिः पुंसः केन वा विनिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | AvR^iNoti kathaM mAyA vyApinaM kena hetunA | kimarthaM chAvR^itiH puMsaH kena vA vinivartate
verses.translation: Obeisance to the great. Obeisance to Siva of wonderful form who has no Kala to influence him, no bondage and liberation and is identical neither with Purusa nor Prakrti nor the universe.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । आवृतिर्व्यापिनोऽपि स्याद्व्यापि यस्मात्कलाद्यपि । हेतुः कर्मैव भोगार्थं निवर्तेत मलक्षयात्
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | AvR^itirvyApino.api syAdvyApi yasmAtkalAdyapi | hetuH karmaiva bhogArthaM nivarteta malakShayAt
verses.translation: The time taken for the winking of an eye is Nimea, Fifteen such Nime$as constitute one Kiftha.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । कलादि कथ्यते किं तत्कर्म वा किमुदाहृतम् । तत्किमादि किमन्तं वा किम्फलं वा किमाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | kalAdi kathyate kiM tatkarma vA kimudAhR^itam | tatkimAdi kimantaM vA kimphalaM vA kimAshrayam
verses.translation: Thirty such Kasthas make one Kala. Thirty Kalas make one Muhurta. Thirty Miihurtas make one day.

verses.sanskrit: कस्मै भोगेश्च किं भोग्यं किं वा तद्भोगसाधनम् । मलक्षयस्य को हेतुः कीदृक् क्षीणमलः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: kasmai bhogeshcha kiM bhogyaM kiM vA tadbhogasAdhanam | malakShayasya ko hetuH kIdR^ik kShINamalaH pumAn
verses.translation: Thirty days constitute one month of two fortnights. A month constituting the bright and dark halves is one day of the manes.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । कला विद्या च रागश्च कालो नियतिरेव च । कलादयः समाख्याता यो भोक्ता पुरुषो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | kalA vidyA cha rAgashcha kAlo niyatireva cha | kalAdayaH samAkhyAtA yo bhoktA puruSho bhavet
verses.translation: Six Masas constitute one Ayana. Two Ayanas make a year. One human year constitutes one day and night for the celestials, Uttarayana being the day and Daksinayana the night.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यपापात्मकं कर्म सुखदुःखफलं तु यत् । अनादिमलभोगान्तमज्ञानात्मसमाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: puNyapApAtmakaM karma sukhaduHkhaphalaM tu yat | anAdimalabhogAntamaj~nAnAtmasamAshrayam
verses.translation: The divine month like the human month constitutes thirty days. The year of the gods constitutes twelve months.

verses.sanskrit: भोगः कर्मविनाशाय भोग्यमव्यक्तमुच्यते । बाह्यान्तःकरणद्वारं शरीरं भोगसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: bhogaH karmavinAshAya bhogyamavyaktamuchyate | bAhyAntaHkaraNadvAraM sharIraM bhogasAdhanam
verses.translation: Three hundred and sixty human years make one divine year.

verses.sanskrit: भावातिशयलब्धेन प्रसादेन मलक्षयः । क्षीणे चात्ममले तस्मिन् शिवसमो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: bhAvAtishayalabdhena prasAdena malakShayaH | kShINe chAtmamale tasmin shivasamo bhavet
verses.translation: Four thousand years constitute the Kftayuga. The period of four hundred years constitutes the intervening junc¬ tion and a hundred year period constitutes Sandhyaiiisa (a subdivision of the junction).

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । कलादिपञ्चतत्त्वानां किं कर्म पृथगुच्यते । भोक्तेति पुरुषश्चेति येनात्मा व्यपदिश्यते
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | kalAdipa~nchatattvAnAM kiM karma pR^ithaguchyate | bhokteti puruShashcheti yenAtmA vyapadishyate
verses.translation: In the three other yugas, their Sandhyas and

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । एकोनविंशतिः कल्पो विज्ञेयः श्वेतलोहितः । तस्मिन्कल्पे चतुर्वक्त्रः स्रष्टुकामोऽतपत्तपः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | ekonaviMshatiH kalpo vij~neyaH shvetalohitaH | tasminkalpe chaturvaktraH sraShTukAmo.atapattapaH
verses.translation: Thus the twelve thousand years and the surplus period constitute a Gaturyuga. A thousand Gaturyugas constitute a Kalpa.
verses.hindi: वीरभद्रोत्यत्तिवर्णन नामक उन्‍नीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: किमात्मकं तदव्यक्तं केनाकारेण भुज्यते । किं तस्य शरणं भुक्तौ शरीरं च किमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: kimAtmakaM tadavyaktaM kenAkAreNa bhujyate | kiM tasya sharaNaM bhuktau sharIraM cha kimuchyate
verses.translation: Seventyone Gaturyugas constitute a Manvantara. In a Kalpa there are fourteen such Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । दिक्क्रियाव्यञ्जिका विद्याकलो रागः प्रवर्तकः । कालोऽवच्छेदकस्तत्र नियतिस्तु नियामिका
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | dikkriyAvya~njikA vidyAkalo rAgaH pravartakaH | kAlo.avachChedakastatra niyatistu niyAmikA
verses.translation: In this order, hundreds and thousands of such Kalpas and Manvantaras have passed by this time.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्तत्त्रिगुणप्रभवाप्ययम् । प्रधानं प्रकृतिश्चेति यदाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: avyaktaM kAraNaM yattattriguNaprabhavApyayam | pradhAnaM prakR^itishcheti yadAhustattvachintakAH
verses.translation: They are innumerable and hard to be known precisely. It is impossible to mention them in detail in the precise order.

verses.sanskrit: कलातस्तदभिव्यक्तमनभिव्यक्तलक्षणम् । सुखदुःखविमोहात्मा भुज्यते गुणवांस्त्रिधा
verses.transliteration: kalAtastadabhivyaktamanabhivyaktalakShaNam | sukhaduHkhavimohAtmA bhujyate guNavAMstridhA
verses.translation: A Kalpa constitutes a day of Brahma of unmani¬ fest origin. A thousand Kalpas make a year of Brahma.
verses.hindi: योग्य महेश्वरका यजन नहीं कर रहे हैं

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः । प्रकृतौ सूक्ष्मरूपेण तिले तैलमिव स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: sattvaM rajastama iti guNAH prakR^itisambhavAH | prakR^itau sUkShmarUpeNa tile tailamiva sthitAH
verses.translation: Eight thousand Brahma years make one Brahma Yuga. A thousand Brahma Yugas make one Savana of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: सुखं च सुखहेतुश्च समासात्सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् । राजसं तद्विपर्यासात् स्तम्भमोहौ तु तामसौ
verses.transliteration: sukhaM cha sukhahetushcha samAsAtsAttvikaM smR^itam | rAjasaM tadviparyAsAt stambhamohau tu tAmasau
verses.translation: Three thousand and three Savanas make the life time of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विक्यूर्ध्वगतिः प्रोक्ता तामसी स्यादधोगतिः । मध्यमा तु गतिर्या सा राजसी परिपठ्यते
verses.transliteration: sAttvikyUrdhvagatiH proktA tAmasI syAdadhogatiH | madhyamA tu gatiryA sA rAjasI paripaThyate
verses.translation: A day of Brahma's life constitutes the life of fourteen Indras, a month of his life constitutes a four hundred and twenty Indras; a year of his life five thousand and forty Indras; his whole life five hundred and forty thousand Indras.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मात्रापञ्चकं चैव भूतपञ्चकमेव च । ज्ञानेन्द्रियाणि पञ्चैव पञ्चकर्मेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.transliteration: tanmAtrApa~nchakaM chaiva bhUtapa~nchakameva cha | j~nAnendriyANi pa~nchaiva pa~nchakarmendriyANi cha
verses.translation: A day of Vi?nu is the life-time of Brahma. A day of Rudra is equal to the life-time of Vipu. A day of Siva is equal to the life-period of one Rudra. A day of Sadasiva is the life-period of Siva. A day of Sakat livd is the life-period of Sadasiva. The life-time of the latter is equal to the life-period of five hundred and forty thousand previous deities.
verses.hindi: प्रचक्र: ॥ ४३  शब्दोंको बार-बार बोल रही थीं

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानबुद्ध्यहङ्कारमनांसि च चतुष्टयम् । समासादेवमव्यक्तं सविकारमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: pradhAnabuddhyaha~NkAramanAMsi cha chatuShTayam | samAsAdevamavyaktaM savikAramudAhR^itam
verses.translation: This Kala functions as directed by Sakatsiva.
verses.hindi: ड्ति जल सतस्यां वायवीयसंहितायां पूर्वखण्डे यज्ञविध्वंसनों नाम विंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तत्कारणदशापन्नमव्यक्तमिति कथ्यते । व्यक्तं कार्यदशापन्नं शरीरादिघटादिवत्
verses.transliteration: tatkAraNadashApannamavyaktamiti kathyate | vyaktaM kAryadashApannaM sharIrAdighaTAdivat
verses.translation: This Kalantara shall be known as a day of Paramesvara. Paramevara's night shall be known to extend so long.
verses.hindi: यज्विध्वंसन नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तपसा तेन तीव्रेण तुष्टस्तस्य पिता स्वयम् । दिव्यं कौमारमास्थाय रूपं रूपवतां वरः
verses.transliteration: tapasA tena tIvreNa tuShTastasya pitA svayam | divyaM kaumAramAsthAya rUpaM rUpavatAM varaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to the great Siva, the soul of the uni¬ verse, whose energy in respect of activity, time and innate nature is untransgressable and under whose command the whole universe functions.
verses.hindi: जानकर गणगश्रेष्ठ वीरभद्र क्रोधित हो उठे

verses.sanskrit: यथा घटादिकं कार्यं मृदादेर्नातिभिद्यते । शरीरादि तथा व्यक्तमव्यक्तान्नातिभिद्यते
verses.transliteration: yathA ghaTAdikaM kAryaM mR^idAdernAtibhidyate | sharIrAdi tathA vyaktamavyaktAnnAtibhidyate
verses.translation: Sakti came into being at the outset; with Sautya- titapada following. From iva in association with iSakti Maya came into being and then the unmanifest from it.
verses.hindi: कमलके समान बड़े-बड़े नेत्रोंकी निकाल लिया

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादव्यक्तमेवैकं कारणं करणानि च । शरीरं च तदाधारं तद्भोग्यं चापि नेतरत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAdavyaktamevaikaM kAraNaM karaNAni cha | sharIraM cha tadAdhAraM tadbhogyaM chApi netarat
verses.translation: Santyatitapada originated from Sakti and from it Sntipada; then the Vidyapada; from it the Pratisthapada came into being.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । बुद्धीन्द्रियशरीरेभ्यो व्यतिरेकस्य कस्यचित् । आत्मशब्दाभिधेयस्य वस्तुतोऽपि कुतः स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | buddhIndriyasharIrebhyo vyatirekasya kasyachit | AtmashabdAbhidheyasya vastuto.api kutaH sthitiH
verses.translation: Nivfttipada originated from Pratisthapada. Thus has been briefly described the creation induced by the lord.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वा जहास भूतेन्द्रो मृगेन्द्र इब विव्यथ:॥ ४९  हो उनका उपहास करता है

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । बुद्धीन्द्रियशरीरेभ्यो व्यतिरेको विभोर्ध्रुवम् । अस्त्येव कश्चिदात्मेति हेतुस्तत्र सुदुर्गमः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | buddhIndriyasharIrebhyo vyatireko vibhordhruvam | astyeva kashchidAtmeti hetustatra sudurgamaH
verses.translation: It is agreed that everything begins with intellect and ends with Visesa but the makership is neither of the Avyakta nor of the Purua since Prakrti is insentient and Purusa ignorant. Without an intelligent cause nothing is created by the insentient beings — Pradhana, Paramanu etc. But the universe is dependent on a maker since it is an effect composed of parts.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धीन्द्रियशरीराणां नात्मता सद्भिरिष्यते । स्मृतेरनियतज्ञानादयावद्देहवेदनात्
verses.transliteration: buddhIndriyasharIrANAM nAtmatA sadbhiriShyate | smR^iteraniyataj~nAnAdayAvaddehavedanAt
verses.translation: Hence the creator must be powerful, independent, omnipotent and omniscient with no beginning, no end and endowed with lordly qualities. He is the maker of the universe, Mahadeva, Mahesvara, the protector and annihilator of every¬ thing. He is separate from it.
verses.hindi: पहले त्रिपुरसंग्राममें शिवजीके रथमें स्थित हुए थे

verses.sanskrit: अतः स्मर्तानुभूतानामशेषज्ञेयगोचरः । अन्तर्यामीति वेदेषु वेदान्तेषु च गीयते
verses.transliteration: ataH smartAnubhUtAnAmasheShaj~neyagocharaH | antaryAmIti vedeShu vedAnteShu cha gIyate
verses.translation: Hundred Brahma years constitute the span of Brahma born of unmanifest It is termed Para. Its half is Par.irdha. At the advent of Dissolution the Avyakta with¬ draws to itself all its effects and abides in Atman.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तत्र स सर्वत्र व्याप्य तिष्ठति शाश्वतः । तथापि क्वापि केनापि व्यक्तमेष न दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvaM tatra sa sarvatra vyApya tiShThati shAshvataH | tathApi kvApi kenApi vyaktameSha na dR^ishyate
verses.translation: When the Avyakta abides in Atman, when the effects have been withdrawn, Pradhana and Purusa stand on an equal footing.

verses.sanskrit: नैवायं चक्षुषा ग्राह्यो नापरैरिन्द्रियैरपि । मनसैव प्रदीप्तेन महानात्मावसीयते
verses.transliteration: naivAyaM chakShuShA grAhyo nAparairindriyairapi | manasaiva pradIptena mahAnAtmAvasIyate
verses.translation: The two have the Gunas of Tamas and Sattva, remaining on a par with each other. The two without the Gunas being predominant are mutually interwoven.
verses.hindi: दोनोंमें रोमांचकारी घोर युद्ध होने लगा

verses.sanskrit: न च स्त्री न पुमानेष नैव चापि नपुंसकः । नैवोर्ध्वं नापि तिर्यक् च नाधस्तान्न कुतश्चन
verses.transliteration: na cha strI na pumAneSha naiva chApi napuMsakaH | naivordhvaM nApi tiryak cha nAdhastAnna kutashchana
verses.translation: In the equal and undivided state of Gunas in the
verses.hindi: आकाशगामी देवताओंमें महान् हाहाकार होने लगा

verses.sanskrit: अशरीरं शरीरेषु चलेषु स्थाणुमव्ययम् । सदा पश्यति तं धीरो नरः प्रत्यवमर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: asharIraM sharIreShu chaleShu sthANumavyayam | sadA pashyati taM dhIro naraH pratyavamarshanAt
verses.translation: When the universe was unmanifest the lord meditated upon the great Sakti throughout the night. When it dawned the lord in contact with Maya entered Pradhana and Purusa and set them to motion.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतो नाम मुनिर्भूत्वा दिव्यां वाचमुदीरयन् । दर्शनं प्रददौ तस्मै देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: shveto nAma munirbhUtvA divyAM vAchamudIrayan | darshanaM pradadau tasmai devadevo maheshvaraH
verses.translation: Then at the bidding of Brahma, the creation evolved out the unmanifest that is the source of origin and the spot of merger for all living creatures.
verses.hindi: सृष्टि करते हुए ब्रह्माजी शोभित होते हैं

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन पुरुषो देहतः पृथक् । अपृथग्ये तु पश्यन्ति ह्यसम्यक् तेषु दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: kimatra bahunoktena puruSho dehataH pR^ithak | apR^ithagye tu pashyanti hyasamyak teShu darshanam
verses.translation: Then from these, the three deities Rudra, Visnu and Brahma were born as the cause of all.

verses.sanskrit: यच्छरीरमिदं प्रोक्तं पुरुषस्य ततः परम् । अशुद्धमवशं दुःखमध्रुवं न च विद्यते
verses.transliteration: yachCharIramidaM proktaM puruShasya tataH param | ashuddhamavashaM duHkhamadhruvaM na cha vidyate
verses.translation: Mahesvara bestows on these the power to pervade all the worlds unobstructed anywhere, unequalled perfect wisdom, the perpetual Siddhis*of Anima etc; and the state of being the cause of activities of creation, sustenance and dissolu¬ tion.
verses.hindi: मध्ये स्थित: सिंह इवर्षभाणाम्॥ ७२  शोभित होता है

verses.sanskrit: विपदां बीजभूतेन पुरुषस्तेन संयुतः । सुखी दुःखी च मूढश्च भवति स्वेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: vipadAM bIjabhUtena puruShastena saMyutaH | sukhI duHkhI cha mUDhashcha bhavati svena karmaNA
verses.translation: In another Kalpa he conferred on each the activities of creation, sustenance and dissolution in order that they may not have any mutual rivalry due to delusion of intellect.

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिराप्लावितं क्षेत्रं जनयत्यङ्कुरं यथा । अज्ञानात्प्लावितं कर्म देहं जनयते तथा
verses.transliteration: adbhirAplAvitaM kShetraM janayatya~NkuraM yathA | aj~nAnAtplAvitaM karma dehaM janayate tathA
