verses.translation: These three are born from one another, sustain one another, flourish one another, respect and follow one another.
verses.hindi: दक्षयज़विध्वंसवर्णन नामक बाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तमसुखावासाः स्मृताश्चैकान्तमृत्यवः । अनागता अतीताश्च तनवोऽस्य सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: atyantamasukhAvAsAH smR^itAshchaikAntamR^ityavaH | anAgatA atItAshcha tanavo.asya sahasrashaH
verses.translation: Somewhere Brahma, somewhere Visnu and somewhere Rudra are praised. However their glory does not diminish.
verses.hindi: गणोंके साथ आप इन सभीको क्षमा कौजिये

verses.sanskrit: आगत्यागत्य शीर्णेषु शरीरेषु शरीरिणः । अत्यन्तवसतिः क्वापि न केनापि च लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: AgatyAgatya shIrNeShu sharIreShu sharIriNaH | atyantavasatiH kvApi na kenApi cha labhyate
verses.translation: Only impetuous fools censure them. Undoubtedly they become demons and ghosts.

verses.sanskrit: छादितश्च वियुक्तश्च शरीरैरेषु लक्ष्यते । चन्द्रबिम्बवदाकाशे तरलैरभ्रसञ्चयैः
verses.transliteration: ChAditashcha viyuktashcha sharIraireShu lakShyate | chandrabimbavadAkAshe taralairabhrasa~nchayaiH
verses.translation: The Atman who has created the universe sportively remains as the lord of three deities as >vell as of Prakrti and Purua.
verses.hindi: देवताओंसे हँसते हुए यह कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: अनेकदेहभेदेन भिन्ना वृत्तिरिहात्मनः । अष्टापदपरिक्षेपे ह्यक्षमुद्रेव लक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: anekadehabhedena bhinnA vR^ittirihAtmanaH | aShTApadaparikShepe hyakShamudreva lakShyate
verses.translation: The ego split into the gross and subtle elements and the sense-organs. Wlien the ego had the Sattva predomin¬ ant the Sattvika creation took place.

verses.sanskrit: नैवास्य भविता कश्चिन्नासौ भवति कस्यचित् । पथि सङ्गम एवायं दारैः पुत्रैश्च बन्धुभिः
verses.transliteration: naivAsya bhavitA kashchinnAsau bhavati kasyachit | pathi sa~Ngama evAyaM dAraiH putraishcha bandhubhiH
verses.translation: The secondary creation took place simultaneously. The five sense-organs, the five organs of activity and the eleventh the mind, originated. The mind is both an organ ol' knowledge and of activity. When the ego becomes associated with Tamas, the Bhutatanmatras are born.

verses.sanskrit: यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महोदधौ । समेत्य च व्यपेयातां तद्वद् भूतसमागमः
verses.transliteration: yathA kAShThaM cha kAShThaM cha sameyAtAM mahodadhau | sametya cha vyapeyAtAM tadvad bhUtasamAgamaH
verses.translation: From the ether the Sparsatanmatra, from it Vayu, from Vayu the Rupatanmatra, from this the Tejas, from I'ejas the Rasa tanmatra is born.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पितरं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मणोऽधिपतिं पतिम् । प्रणम्य परमज्ञानं गायत्र्या सह लब्धवान्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA pitaraM brahmA brahmaNo.adhipatiM patim | praNamya paramaj~nAnaM gAyatryA saha labdhavAn
verses.translation: From Rasa the water; from this the Gandha I'anmatra is born, from this the Pythivi, from these elements the mobile and immobile beings are created.
verses.hindi: किया और राजाओंके भयसे सुदर्शनकी रक्षा की

verses.sanskrit: स पश्यति शरीरं तच्छरीरं तन्न पश्यति । तौ पश्यति परः कश्चित्तावुभौ तं न पश्यतः
verses.transliteration: sa pashyati sharIraM tachCharIraM tanna pashyati | tau pashyati paraH kashchittAvubhau taM na pashyataH
verses.translation: Since they arc presided over by Purusa and blessed by Avyakta the principles beginning with Mahat and ending with Visesa generate the cosmic egg. 2®

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माद्याः स्थावरान्ताश्च पशवः परिकीर्तिताः । पशूनामेव सर्वेषां प्रोक्तमेतन्निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: brahmAdyAH sthAvarAntAshcha pashavaH parikIrtitAH | pashUnAmeva sarveShAM proktametannidarshanam
verses.translation: When thus the activities <jf Brahma are fulfilled Brahma becomes flourished in that Egg.
verses.hindi: उत्पत्ति, पालन तथा संहार करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: स एष बध्यते पाशैः सुखदुःखाशनः पशुः । लीलासाधनभूतो य ईश्वरस्येति सूरयः
verses.transliteration: sa eSha badhyate pAshaiH sukhaduHkhAshanaH pashuH | lIlAsAdhanabhUto ya Ishvarasyeti sUrayaH
verses.translation: He IS the firsi.t embodied soul, called Puru$a. He is the first creator of living beings, brahma thus existed in the beginning.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञो जन्तुरनीशोऽयमात्मनः सुखदुःखयोः । ईश्वरप्रेरितो गच्छेत्स्वर्गं वा श्वभ्रमेव वा
verses.transliteration: aj~no janturanIsho.ayamAtmanaH sukhaduHkhayoH | Ishvaraprerito gachChetsvargaM vA shvabhrameva vA
verses.translation: On the scheme of creation seeP. 107a note.
verses.hindi: कौजिये और हमारे अपराधको क्षमा कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच । इत्याकर्ण्यानिलवचो मुनयः प्रीतमानसाः । प्रोचुः प्रणम्य तं वायुं शैवागमविचक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: sUta uvAcha | ityAkarNyAnilavacho munayaH prItamAnasAH | prochuH praNamya taM vAyuM shaivAgamavichakShaNam
verses.translation: See P. 246 note 208.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स लब्धविज्ञानो विश्वकर्मा चतुर्मुखः । असृजत्सर्वभूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च
verses.transliteration: tataH sa labdhavij~nAno vishvakarmA chaturmukhaH | asR^ijatsarvabhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha
verses.translation: Whatever is wished for by the mind is bom of Avyakta. He functions in the three worlds, dividing himself into three because he has all in his control, possesses all the attributes and is dependent on Avyakta. In these three forms he creates, supports and annihilates.
verses.hindi: गये हैं, उन्हें क्षमा कर दीजिये

verses.sanskrit: यतः श्रुत्वाऽमृतं लब्धं ब्रह्मणा परमेश्वरात् । ततस्तद्वदनादेव मया लब्धं तपोबलात्
verses.transliteration: yataH shrutvA.amR^itaM labdhaM brahmaNA parameshvarAt | tatastadvadanAdeva mayA labdhaM tapobalAt
verses.translation: As Brahma he has Sattva and Rajas, as Klla Tamas and Rajas, as Visnu he has Sattva alone. Thus the increase of Gunas in the lord is threefold.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । किं तज्ज्ञानं त्वया लब्धं तथ्यात्तथ्यतरं शुभम् । यत्र कृत्वा परां निष्ठां पुरुषः सुखमृच्छति
verses.transliteration: munaya UchuH | kiM tajj~nAnaM tvayA labdhaM tathyAttathyataraM shubham | yatra kR^itvA parAM niShThAM puruShaH sukhamR^ichChati
verses.translation: As Brahma he creates the worlds, as Kala he con¬ denses; as Purusa he sustains; he is indifferent. Thus the activity of the lord is threefold.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, eight Prakrds, the causes of creation, sustenance and destruction arc stationed covering each of these.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, eight Prakrds, the causes of creation, sustenance and destruction arc stationed covering each of these.
verses.hindi: गिरिशानुनय नामक तेईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्वज्ञानवर्णनम् । मुनय ऊचुः । योऽयं पशुरिति प्रोक्तो यश्च पाश उदाहृतः । आभ्यां विलक्षणः कश्चित्कोऽयमस्ति तयोः पतिः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.6\. ShaShTho.adhyAyaH | shivatattvaj~nAnavarNanam | munaya UchuH | yo.ayaM pashuriti prokto yashcha pAsha udAhR^itaH | AbhyAM vilakShaNaH kashchitko.ayamasti tayoH patiH
verses.translation: Thus bom of one another, the effects and their causes sustain one another supporting and being supported.
verses.hindi: गये, कहाँ रहे और क्‍या करके विरत हुए ?

verses.sanskrit: भोक्ता भोग्यं प्रेरयिता मन्तव्यं त्रिविधं स्मृतम् । नातः परं विजानद्भिर्वेदितव्यं हि किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: bhoktA bhogyaM prerayitA mantavyaM trividhaM smR^itam | nAtaH paraM vijAnadbhirveditavyaM hi ki~nchana
verses.translation: Just as the tortoise spreads its limbs first and then withdraws them, so the Avyakta creates the beings and then withdraws them.

verses.sanskrit: तिलेषु वा यथा तैलं दध्नि वा सर्पिरर्पितम् । यथापः स्रोतसि व्याप्ता यथारण्यां हुताशनः
verses.transliteration: tileShu vA yathA tailaM dadhni vA sarpirarpitam | yathApaH srotasi vyAptA yathAraNyAM hutAshanaH
verses.translation: The Gunas become equal and unequal due to Kala. Dissolution takes place when there is equilibrium of the Gunas. When this is upset, creation takes place.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेव महात्मानमात्मन्यात्मविलक्षणम् । सत्येन तपसा चैव नित्ययुक्तोऽनुपश्यति
verses.transliteration: evameva mahAtmAnamAtmanyAtmavilakShaNam | satyena tapasA chaiva nityayukto.anupashyati
verses.translation: There are thousands and crores of such eggs stationed at the sides, above and below since Pradhana is present everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: य एको जालवानीश ईशानीभिः स्वशक्तिभिः । सर्वांल्लोकानिमान् कृत्वा एक एव स ईशते
verses.transliteration: ya eko jAlavAnIsha IshAnIbhiH svashaktibhiH | sarvAMllokAnimAn kR^itvA eka eva sa Ishate
verses.translation: In the different places there are four-faced Brahmas, Visnus and Rudras created by Pradhana with the presence of l3iva.
verses.hindi: इच्छाका आप दमन क्‍यों करते रहे हैं ?

verses.sanskrit: एक एव सदा रुद्रो न द्वितीयोऽस्ति कश्चन । संसृज्य विश्वभुवनं गोप्ता ते सञ्चुकोच यः
verses.transliteration: eka eva sadA rudro na dvitIyo.asti kashchana | saMsR^ijya vishvabhuvanaM goptA te sa~nchukocha yaH
verses.translation: When the Rajas predominates it becomes genera¬ tive. It creates the eight secondary tattvas in the beginning, which cause flourishing of the worlds. In the end it devours them.
verses.hindi: करके ही मैं शीघ्र गौरी हो जाऊँगी

verses.sanskrit: विश्वतश्चक्षुरेवायमुतायं विश्वतोमुखः । तथैव विश्वतोबाहुर्विश्वतः पादसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: vishvatashchakShurevAyamutAyaM vishvatomukhaH | tathaiva vishvatobAhurvishvataH pAdasaMyutaH
verses.translation: The stability and the subsequent operation of the causes projected by Prakrti take place by the thought of supreme lord whose prowess is not effected by Prakrti.
verses.hindi: तपस्यद्वारा उन्हें बुलाकर तुम क्या करोगी 2

verses.sanskrit: द्यावाभूमी च जनयन् देव एको महेश्वरः । स एव सर्वदेवानां प्रभवश्चोद्भवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: dyAvAbhUmI cha janayan deva eko maheshvaraH | sa eva sarvadevAnAM prabhavashchodbhavastathA
verses.translation: Please narrate the Manvantaras, the Kalpas, the subsidiary creations and the re-creation after dissolution.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भं देवानां प्रथमं जनयेदयम् । विश्वस्मादधिको रुद्रो महर्षिरिति हि श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: hiraNyagarbhaM devAnAM prathamaM janayedayam | vishvasmAdadhiko rudro maharShiriti hi shrutiH
verses.translation: The tenure of Brahma who comes and goes accor¬ ding to the calculation of time is first a Parardha and another Parardha thereafter. At the end of the latter the re-creation takes place.
verses.hindi: क्रीडोक्तिवर्ण नामक चौबीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्तममृतं ध्रुवम् । आदित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्संस्थितं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: vedAhametaM puruShaM mahAntamamR^itaM dhruvam | AdityavarNaM tamasaH parastAtsaMsthitaM prabhum
verses.translation: In each day in the life of Brahma, the fourteen Manus come and go.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मान्नास्ति परं किञ्चिदपरं परमात्मनः । नाणीयोऽस्ति न च ज्यायस्तेन पूर्णमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: asmAnnAsti paraM ki~nchidaparaM paramAtmanaH | nANIyo.asti na cha jyAyastena pUrNamidaM jagat
verses.translation: The Manvantaras and Kalpas have no beginning or end. Being unknowable they cannot be narrated separately.
verses.hindi: किया; जो उनके साथ ही आया था

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । अस्ति कश्चिदपर्यन्तरमणीयगुणाश्रयः । पतिर्विश्वस्य निर्माता पशुपाशविमोचनः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | asti kashchidaparyantaramaNIyaguNAshrayaH | patirvishvasya nirmAtA pashupAshavimochanaH
verses.translation: Even if they be knowable, of what avail is it to you to know them. Hence I do not attempt to narrate them separately.
verses.hindi: ऊहनीय॑ परस्माच्च प्रस्तुतं वर्णयामि वः॥ ४८  मैं प्रस्तुत प्रसंगका वर्णन करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाननशिरोग्रीवः सर्वभूतगुहाशयः । सर्वव्यापी च भगवांस्तस्मात्सर्वगतश्शिवः
verses.transliteration: sarvAnanashirogrIvaH sarvabhUtaguhAshayaH | sarvavyApI cha bhagavAMstasmAtsarvagatashshivaH
verses.translation: Among these Kalpas, I describe the creation and re-creation of this Kaipa.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादोऽयं सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखः । सर्वतः श्रुतिमांल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: sarvataH pANipAdo.ayaM sarvato.akShishiromukhaH | sarvataH shrutimAMlloke sarvamAvR^itya tiShThati
verses.translation: Among the Manus, Svayambhuva and others constitute the first seven Manus, Savarnika and others constitute the next seven. Among them Vaivasvata Manu is the seventh.
verses.hindi: देवीगारत्व-प्राप्ति नायक पच्चीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासः सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितः । सर्वस्य प्रभुरीशानः सर्वस्य शरणं सुहृत्
verses.transliteration: sarvendriyaguNAbhAsaH sarvendriyavivarjitaH | sarvasya prabhurIshAnaH sarvasya sharaNaM suhR^it
verses.translation: It shall be known that in all the Manvantaras, the creation, sustenance and annihilation are more or less of the same nature.
verses.hindi: है। अत: मुझे इसका त्याग नहीं करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: अचक्षुरपि यः पश्यत्यकर्णोऽपि शृणोति यः । सर्वं वेत्ति न वेत्तास्य तमाहुः पुरुषं परम्
verses.transliteration: achakShurapi yaH pashyatyakarNo.api shR^iNoti yaH | sarvaM vetti na vettAsya tamAhuH puruShaM param
verses.translation: When the previous Kaipa had ceased, the storni had burst, the forest and trees had been uprooted, the fire-god had consumed the worlds like diy grass, the earth had been drenched, oceans had overflowed their shores, the quarters had been sunk in deep sheet of water and the waters of dissolution had started their fierce devil dances with the waves for their arms showing movements of gestures by means of the water, Brahma assumed the form of Visnu, slept soundlv in that vast expanse of water.

verses.sanskrit: अणोरणीयान्महतो महीयानयमव्ययः । गुहायां निहितश्चापि जन्तोरस्य महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: aNoraNIyAnmahato mahIyAnayamavyayaH | guhAyAM nihitashchApi jantorasya maheshvaraH
verses.translation: One shall cite this mantra, a 8loka, regarding Nara- yana. O excellent sages, listen to the mantra as well as the actual meaning of the words.

verses.sanskrit: तमक्रतुं क्रतुप्रायं महिमातिशयान्वितम् । धातुः प्रसादादीशानं वीतशोकः प्रपश्यति
verses.transliteration: tamakratuM kratuprAyaM mahimAtishayAnvitam | dhAtuH prasAdAdIshAnaM vItashokaH prapashyati
verses.translation: Waters are called 'Nara'. Waters are sons ofNara. He is called Narayana because waters constitute his abode.*®"

verses.sanskrit: वेदाहमेनमजरं पुराणं सर्वगं विभुम् । निरोधं जन्मनो यस्य वदन्ति ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: vedAhamenamajaraM purANaM sarvagaM vibhum | nirodhaM janmano yasya vadanti brahmavAdinaH
verses.translation: With their palms joined in reverence the Siddha residents of Janaloka and the gods awakened the lord of gods who was in Yogic slumber, with hymns, in the morning as the 8rutis had done formerly at the beginning of creation.
verses.hindi: व्याप्रगतिवर्णन नामक छब्बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: एकोऽपि त्रीनिमांल्लोकान् बहुधा शक्तियोगतः । विदधाति विचेत्यन्ते विश्वमादौ महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: eko.api trInimAMllokAn bahudhA shaktiyogataH | vidadhAti vichetyante vishvamAdau maheshvaraH
verses.translation: The lord woke up, got up from his bed and came to the water. He looked all round at the quarters with the Yogic slumber still lingering in the eyes idly.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वधात्रीत्यजाख्या च शैवी चित्राकृतिः परा । तामजां लोहितां शुक्लां कृष्णामेकां त्वजः प्रजाम्
verses.transliteration: vishvadhAtrItyajAkhyA cha shaivI chitrAkR^itiH parA | tAmajAM lohitAM shuklAM kR^iShNAmekAM tvajaH prajAm
verses.translation: He did not see anything except himself He sat up like a wonderstruck person and began to ponder deeply.

verses.sanskrit: जनित्रीमनुशेतेऽन्योजुषमाणः स्वरूपिणीम् । तामेवाजामजोऽन्यस्तु भक्तभोगां जहाति च
verses.transliteration: janitrImanushete.anyojuShamANaH svarUpiNIm | tAmevAjAmajo.anyastu bhaktabhogAM jahAti cha
verses.translation: ''Where is that charming goddess the great Earth, with her lofty mountains, rivers, cities and forests."

verses.sanskrit: अभावे तस्य विश्वस्य सृष्टिरेषा कथं भवेत् । अचेतनत्वादज्ञानादनयोः पशुपाशयोः
verses.transliteration: abhAve tasya vishvasya sR^iShTireShA kathaM bhavet | achetanatvAdaj~nAnAdanayoH pashupAshayoH
verses.translation: Thinking thus Brahma could not locate the earth. Then he thought of his father, the three-eyed lord.
verses.hindi: वह अत्यन्त गौरवपूर्ण आज्ञा तुम्हीं हो

verses.sanskrit: द्वौ सुपर्णौ च सयुजौ समानं वृक्षमास्थितौ । एकोऽत्ति पिप्पलं स्वादु परोऽनश्नन् प्रपश्यति
verses.transliteration: dvau suparNau cha sayujau samAnaM vR^ikShamAsthitau | eko.atti pippalaM svAdu paro.anashnan prapashyati
verses.translation: By meditating on the lord of gods, of immeasur¬ able.splendour, Brahma tinderstood that the earth had sunk under water.
verses.hindi: दिन लीलापूर्वक व्यंग्य वचन कहा था

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षेऽस्मिन् पुरुषो मग्नो गुह्यमानश्च शोचति । जुष्टमन्यं यदा पश्येदीशं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: vR^ikShe.asmin puruSho magno guhyamAnashcha shochati | juShTamanyaM yadA pashyedIshaM paramakAraNam
verses.translation: Then Brahma desirous of lifting up the Earth, thou¬ ght of the divine Boar supporting about and diving into the waters.

verses.sanskrit: तदास्य महिमानं च वीतशोकः सुखी भवेत् । छन्दांसि यज्ञाः क्रतवो यद्भूतं भव्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: tadAsya mahimAnaM cha vItashokaH sukhI bhavet | ChandAMsi yaj~nAH kratavo yadbhUtaM bhavyameva cha
verses.translation: He then assumed the form of a Boar and entered the nether worlds in order to lift up the Earth. His body was like a huge mountain. His snorting sound was like thun¬ der. He had the lustre of a blue cloud. He was terrible with his snorting sound. His shoulders were thick, heavy and rounded. His buttocks were plump and raised. The tips of his calves were short and rounded. The hoofs were sharp. His eyes were round and terrible having the brilliance of rubies. The huge body was oval-shaped. The stiff ears shone brilliantly. Inhaling and exhaling his breath he stirred up the waters of dissolution. The shining manes covered his beautiful cheeks and shoulders. He was embellished in gemset
verses.hindi: मिलनवर्णन नामक सत्ताईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: मायी विश्वं सृजत्यस्मिन्निविष्टो मायया परः । मायां तु प्रकृतिं विद्यान्मायिनं तु महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: mAyI vishvaM sR^ijatyasminniviShTo mAyayA paraH | mAyAM tu prakR^itiM vidyAnmAyinaM tu maheshvaram
verses.translation: Then the boar that resembled a mountain shone well as if he had reached the foot of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्त्ववयवैरेव व्याप्तं सर्वमिदं जगत् । सूक्ष्मातिसूक्ष्ममीशानं कललस्यापि मध्यतः
verses.transliteration: tasyAstvavayavaireva vyAptaM sarvamidaM jagat | sUkShmAtisUkShmamIshAnaM kalalasyApi madhyataH
verses.translation: Then he lifted the Earth sunk under water and held it on his curved fangs. He rose up from the nether worlds,
verses.hindi: इस चराचर जगत्को धारण कर रखा है

verses.sanskrit: स्रष्टारमपि विश्वस्य चेष्टितारं च तस्य तु । शिवमेवेश्वरं ज्ञात्वा शान्तिमत्यन्तमृच्छति
verses.transliteration: sraShTAramapi vishvasya cheShTitAraM cha tasya tu | shivameveshvaraM j~nAtvA shAntimatyantamR^ichChati
verses.translation: On seeing him, the Siddhas, sages and other human beings rejoiced and danced- They scattered flowers on his head.

verses.sanskrit: स एव कालो गोप्ता च विश्वस्याधिपतिः प्रभुः । तं विश्वाधिपतिं ज्ञात्वा मृत्युपाशात्प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: sa eva kAlo goptA cha vishvasyAdhipatiH prabhuH | taM vishvAdhipatiM j~nAtvA mR^ityupAshAtpramuchyate
verses.translation: The body of the Boar covered up with flowers shone like the mountain of collyrium with glow-worms falling on it.

verses.sanskrit: घृतात्परं मण्डमिव सूक्ष्मं ज्ञात्वा स्थितं प्रभुम् । सर्वभूतेषु गूढं च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ghR^itAtparaM maNDamiva sUkShmaM j~nAtvA sthitaM prabhum | sarvabhUteShu gUDhaM cha sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
verses.translation: The Boar brought the earth to its own place. If then assumed his natural form and fixed it there.

verses.sanskrit: एष एव परो देवो विश्वकर्मा महेश्वरः । हृदये सन्निविष्टं तं ज्ञात्वैवामृतमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: eSha eva paro devo vishvakarmA maheshvaraH | hR^idaye sanniviShTaM taM j~nAtvaivAmR^itamashnute
verses.translation: He levelled the earth, fixed the mountains and set up the four worlds on the earth as before.

verses.sanskrit: यदा समस्तं न दिवा न रात्रिर्न सदप्यसत् । केवलश्शिव एवैको यतः प्रज्ञा पुरातनी
verses.transliteration: yadA samastaM na divA na rAtrirna sadapyasat | kevalashshiva evaiko yataH praj~nA purAtanI
verses.translation: Thus after lifting the earth along with the mountains from the midst of the vast sea of dissolution the lord created the universe — the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: भस्मतत्त्ववर्णन नामक अद्गाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानपरमाण्वादि यावत्किञ्चिदचेतनम् । तत्कर्तृकं स्वयं दृष्टं बुद्धिमत्कारणं विना
verses.transliteration: pradhAnaparamANvAdi yAvatki~nchidachetanam | tatkartR^ikaM svayaM dR^iShTaM buddhimatkAraNaM vinA
verses.translation: Darkness, delusion, great delusion, blinding darkness and ignorance; the five appeared before the noble lord.
verses.hindi: शिव तथा पार्वतीकी प्राकृत मूर्ति कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: नैनमूर्ध्वं न तिर्यक्च न मध्यं पर्यजिग्रहत् । न तस्य प्रतिमा चास्ति यस्य नाम महद्यशः
verses.transliteration: nainamUrdhvaM na tiryakcha na madhyaM paryajigrahat | na tasya pratimA chAsti yasya nAma mahadyashaH
verses.translation: These animals had light within but not without.

verses.sanskrit: अजातमिममेवैकं बुद्ध्वा जन्मनि भीरवः । रुद्रस्यास्य प्रपद्यन्ते रक्षार्थं दक्षिणं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: ajAtamimamevaikaM buddhvA janmani bhIravaH | rudrasyAsya prapadyante rakShArthaM dakShiNaM sukham
verses.translation: When this creation too proved ineffective the creation of the godi of the Sattvika type took place.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे अक्षरे ब्रह्मपरे त्वनन्ते समुदाहृते । विद्याविद्ये समाख्याते निहिते यत्र गूढवत्
verses.transliteration: dve akShare brahmapare tvanante samudAhR^ite | vidyAvidye samAkhyAte nihite yatra gUDhavat
verses.translation: Men had plenty of pleasure, were not concealed but had light within and light without. They had innate consci¬ ousness too.

verses.sanskrit: क्षरं त्वविद्या ह्यमृतं विद्येति परिगीयते । ते उभे ईशते यस्तु सोऽन्यः खलु महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kSharaM tvavidyA hyamR^itaM vidyeti parigIyate | te ubhe Ishate yastu so.anyaH khalu maheshvaraH
verses.translation: Again he meditated and from the unmanifest evolved the human creation which had a downward trend. Though effective it was full of misery.

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं बहुधा जालं विकुर्वन्नेकवच्च यः । सर्वाधिपत्यं कुरुते सृष्ट्वा सर्वान् प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: ekaikaM bahudhA jAlaM vikurvannekavachcha yaH | sarvAdhipatyaM kurute sR^iShTvA sarvAn pratApavAn
verses.translation: The human beings had light within and light without. They had Tamas and Rajas in abundance. The fifth creation appeared in four forms in respect ofViparyaya, Sakti, Tusti and Siddhi. These had no possessions, being of different species, prone to eating and drinking, were known as Bhutas etc.

verses.sanskrit: दिश ऊर्ध्वमधस्तिर्यक् भासयन् भ्राजते स्वयम् । यो निःस्वभावादप्येको वरेण्यस्त्वधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: disha Urdhvamadhastiryak bhAsayan bhrAjate svayam | yo niHsvabhAvAdapyeko vareNyastvadhitiShThati
verses.translation: The primary creation took place without the inter¬ vention of intellect. The fourth was the creation o'' immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावं वाचकान् सर्वान् वाच्यांश्च परिणामयन् । गुणांश्च भोग्यभोक्तृत्वे तद्विश्वमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: svabhAvaM vAchakAn sarvAn vAchyAMshcha pariNAmayan | guNAMshcha bhogyabhoktR^itve tadvishvamadhitiShThati
verses.translation: The fifth was the creation of animal kingdom; the sixth of gods; the seventh of human beings. The eighth is called Anugraha and the ninth Kumara.

verses.sanskrit: तं वै गुह्योपनिषदि गूढं ब्रह्म परात्परम् । ब्रह्मयोनिं जगत्पूर्वं विदुर्देवा महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: taM vai guhyopaniShadi gUDhaM brahma parAtparam | brahmayoniM jagatpUrvaM vidurdevA maharShayaH
verses.translation: The first three creations are primary. They work without intelligence. The five secondary creations function intelligently.
verses.hindi: वागर्धात्मकतत्त्ववर्णनः नामक उनतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: भावग्राह्यमनीहाख्यं भावाभावकरं शिवम् । कलासर्गकरं देवं ये विदुस्ते जहुस्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: bhAvagrAhyamanIhAkhyaM bhAvAbhAvakaraM shivam | kalAsargakaraM devaM ye viduste jahustanum
verses.translation: Brahma had in the beginning* created four sons: Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatana and Sanatkumara. These arc known as yogins free from passion and jealousy.
verses.hindi: हम सभीके मनको मोहित कर देते हैं

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावमेके मन्यन्ते कालमेके विमोहिताः । देवस्य महिमा ह्येष येनेदं भ्राम्यते जगत्
verses.transliteration: svabhAvameke manyante kAlameke vimohitAH | devasya mahimA hyeSha yenedaM bhrAmyate jagat
verses.translation: They were not interested in the activity of creation because their minds were drawn towards the lord. When Sanaka and others disinterested in creation had left the world,

verses.sanskrit: जगच्च कर्तृसापेक्षं कार्यं सावयवं यतः । तस्मात्कार्यस्य कर्तृत्वं पत्युर्न पशुपाशयोः
verses.transliteration: jagachcha kartR^isApekShaM kAryaM sAvayavaM yataH | tasmAtkAryasya kartR^itvaM patyurna pashupAshayoH
verses.translation: From these goblins and ghosts emerged. On seeing these born of tears Brahma censured himself.

verses.sanskrit: येनेदमावृतं नित्यं कालकालात्मना यतः । तेनेरितमिदं कर्म भूतैः सह विवर्तते
verses.transliteration: yenedamAvR^itaM nityaM kAlakAlAtmanA yataH | teneritamidaM karma bhUtaiH saha vivartate
verses.translation: As a result of anger and annoyance he fell into swoon. Then the enraged Brahma cast off his breath.
verses.hindi: मूर्तिको भी हेतुरहित या नित्य मानना पड़ेगा

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्म भूयशः कृत्वा विनिवर्त्य च भूयशः । तत्त्वस्य सह सत्त्वेन योगं चापि समेत्य वै
verses.transliteration: tatkarma bhUyashaH kR^itvA vinivartya cha bhUyashaH | tattvasya saha sattvena yogaM chApi sametya vai
verses.translation: Then Rudra, the lord of vital breaths, appeared through the mouth of Brahma in order to confer unequalled favour.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाभिश्च त्रिभिश्चैव द्वाभ्यां चैकेन वा पुनः । कालेनात्मगुणैश्चापि कृत्स्नमेव जगत् स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: aShTAbhishcha tribhishchaiva dvAbhyAM chaikena vA punaH | kAlenAtmaguNaishchApi kR^itsnameva jagat svayam
verses.translation: Lord Rudra divided himself into eleven Atmans. When these appeared they were addressed by him.
verses.hindi: तथा अनित्यको नित्य क्‍यों नहीं बना देता ?

verses.sanskrit: गुणैरारभ्य कर्माणि स्वभावादीनि योजयेत् । तेषामभावे नाशः स्यात्कृतस्यापि च कर्मणः
verses.transliteration: guNairArabhya karmANi svabhAvAdIni yojayet | teShAmabhAve nAshaH syAtkR^itasyApi cha karmaNaH
verses.translation: O dear, you have been created by me for bless¬ ing the worlds. Hence endeavour assiduously for the establish¬ ment and benefit of the world and for its progeny. Thus spoken to, they cried and ran all round.
verses.hindi: भिन किसी अन्य तत्त्वकी अधिष्ठान सत्ता नहीं है 2

verses.sanskrit: कर्मक्षये पुनश्चान्यत्ततो याति स तत्त्वतः । स एवादिः स्वयं योगनिमित्तं भोक्तृभोगयोः
verses.transliteration: karmakShaye punashchAnyattato yAti sa tattvataH | sa evAdiH svayaM yoganimittaM bhoktR^ibhogayoH
verses.translation: In view of their crying and flight they are called Rudras. Rudras are vital breaths and vital breaths are Rudras.

verses.sanskrit: परस्त्रिकालादकलः स एव परमेश्वरः । सर्ववित् त्रिगुणाधीशो ब्रह्म साक्षात् परात्परः
verses.transliteration: parastrikAlAdakalaH sa eva parameshvaraH | sarvavit triguNAdhIsho brahma sAkShAt parAtparaH
verses.translation: Then Rudra, the merciful son of Brahma, bestowed vital breaths on Brahma.
verses.hindi: करनेवाली वैसी ही स्वेच्छा देखी जाती है ?

verses.sanskrit: तं विश्वरूपमभवं भवमीड्यं प्रजापतिम् । देवदेवं जगत्पूज्यं स्वचित्तस्थमुपास्महे
verses.transliteration: taM vishvarUpamabhavaM bhavamIDyaM prajApatim | devadevaM jagatpUjyaM svachittasthamupAsmahe
verses.translation: O Brahma, preceptor of the worlds, do not be afraid. Your vital breaths have been resuscitated by me. O one of good rites, get up comfortably.

verses.sanskrit: कालादिभिः परो यस्मात् प्रपञ्चः परिवर्तते । धर्मावहं पापनुदं भोगेशं विश्वधाम च
verses.transliteration: kAlAdibhiH paro yasmAt prapa~nchaH parivartate | dharmAvahaM pApanudaM bhogeshaM vishvadhAma cha
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Siva lord of the gods touched Brahma with his pleasing hands and spoke.

verses.sanskrit: तमीश्वराणां परमं महेश्वरं तं देवतानां परमं च दैवतम् । पतिं पतीनां परमं परस्ताद् विदाम देवं भुवनेश्वरेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tamIshvarANAM paramaM maheshvaraM taM devatAnAM paramaM cha daivatam | patiM patInAM paramaM parastAd vidAma devaM bhuvaneshvareshvaram
verses.translation: Know me as the great Atman, born as your son. The eleven Rudras have come to protect you well.
verses.hindi: विष्णुका रूप धारणकर उनकी वंचना को

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य विद्येत कार्यं कारणं च न विद्यते । न तत्समोऽधिकश्चापि क्वचिज्जगति दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: na tasya vidyeta kAryaM kAraNaM cha na vidyate | na tatsamo.adhikashchApi kvachijjagati dR^ishyate
verses.translation: Hence shake off this lethargy through my blessing. Be wakeful. It behoves you to create beings as before.
verses.hindi: फिर वे सबपर अनुग्रह करनेवाले कैसे हैं ?

verses.sanskrit: पशोरपि च कर्तृत्वं पत्युः प्रेरणपूर्वकम् । अयथाकरणज्ञानमन्धस्य गमनं यथा
verses.transliteration: pashorapi cha kartR^itvaM patyuH preraNapUrvakam | ayathAkaraNaj~nAnamandhasya gamanaM yathA
verses.translation: (i) Obeisance O lord Rudra, with the splen¬
verses.hindi: द्वारा दण्डित नहीं किया गया हो

verses.sanskrit: परास्य विविधा शक्तिः श्रुतौ स्वाभाविकी श्रुता । ज्ञानं बलं क्रियां चैव याभ्यो विश्वमिदं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: parAsya vividhA shaktiH shrutau svAbhAvikI shrutA | j~nAnaM balaM kriyAM chaiva yAbhyo vishvamidaM kR^itam
verses.translation: After eulogising Mahadeva, Brahma, the grand¬ father of the worlds requested the lord after due homage.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्यास्ति पतिः कश्चिन्नैव लिङ्गं न चेशिता । कारणं कारणानां च स तेषामधिपाधिपः
verses.transliteration: na tasyAsti patiH kashchinnaiva li~NgaM na cheshitA | kAraNaM kAraNAnAM cha sa teShAmadhipAdhipaH
verses.translation: O lord of the past and the future, O Rudra, my son, it was for the creation that you the destroyer of the cupid were born out of my limbs.

verses.sanskrit: न चास्य जनिता कश्चिन्न च जन्म कुतश्चन । न जन्महेतवस्तद्वन्मलमायादिसंज्ञकाः
verses.transliteration: na chAsya janitA kashchinna cha janma kutashchana | na janmahetavastadvanmalamAyAdisa.nj~nakAH
verses.translation: Hence, O lord of the universe, help me in this task. It behoves you to create beings everywhere.
verses.hindi: मसल दिया गया और भूमिमें चला गया

verses.sanskrit: स एकः सर्वभूतेषु गूढो व्याप्तश्च विश्वतः । सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा च धर्माध्यक्षः स कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: sa ekaH sarvabhUteShu gUDho vyAptashcha vishvataH | sarvabhUtAntarAtmA cha dharmAdhyakShaH sa kathyate
verses.translation: Thus requested by him Rudra, the suppressor of the Tripuras, consented to his proposal.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूताधिवासश्च साक्षी चेता च निर्गुणः । एको वशी निष्क्रियाणां बहूनां विवशात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: sarvabhUtAdhivAsashcha sAkShI chetA cha nirguNaH | eko vashI niShkriyANAM bahUnAM vivashAtmanAm
verses.translation: Then Brahma congratulated him. Permitted by him Brahma created people.
verses.hindi: शिवतत्त्वविषयक प्रश्न नामक तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: नित्यानामप्यसौ नित्यश्चेतनानां च चेतनः । एको बहूनां चाकामः कामानीशः प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: nityAnAmapyasau nityashchetanAnAM cha chetanaH | eko bahUnAM chAkAmaH kAmAnIshaH prayachChati
verses.translation: He mentally created Marici, Bhygu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Daka, Atri and Vasitha. He created Dharma and Saihkalpa too.
verses.hindi: शिवकी कृपाका अभाव ही कारण है

verses.sanskrit: साङ्ख्ययोगाधिगम्यं यत् कारणं जगतां पतिम् । ज्ञात्वा देवं पशुः पाशैः सर्वैरेव विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: sA~NkhyayogAdhigamyaM yat kAraNaM jagatAM patim | j~nAtvA devaM pashuH pAshaiH sarvaireva vimuchyate
verses.translation: These are the twelve sons of Brahma including Rudra. They are the ancient householders.
verses.hindi: बात तो उपचारसे कही जाती है

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकृद् विश्ववित् स्वात्मयोनिज्ञः कालकृद् गुणी । प्रधानः क्षेत्रज्ञपतिर्गुणेशः पाशमोचकः
verses.transliteration: vishvakR^id vishvavit svAtmayonij~naH kAlakR^id guNI | pradhAnaH kShetraj~napatirguNeshaH pAshamochakaH
verses.translation: Their families are twelve including the gods. Endowed with progeny and holy rites they are embellished by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं विदधे पूर्वं वेदांश्चोपादिशत्स्वयम् । यो देवस्तमहं बुद्ध्वा स्वात्मबुद्धिप्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: brahmANaM vidadhe pUrvaM vedAMshchopAdishatsvayam | yo devastamahaM buddhvA svAtmabuddhiprasAdataH
verses.translation: Then he created the four— -the gods, Asuras, Pitfs and the human beings. Desirous of creating these.

verses.sanskrit: मुमुक्षुरस्मात् संसारात् प्रपद्ये शरणं शिवम् । निष्कलं निष्क्रियं शान्तं निरवद्यं निरञ्जनम्
verses.transliteration: mumukShurasmAt saMsArAt prapadye sharaNaM shivam | niShkalaM niShkriyaM shAntaM niravadyaM nira~njanam
verses.translation: From his loins he created the Asuras; from the organ of generation the human beings. The Rakasas over¬ whelmed by hunger were born of his privities.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं च पृथङ्मत्वा प्रेरितारं ततः पृथक् । असौ जुष्टस्ततस्तेन ह्यमृतत्वाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: AtmAnaM cha pR^itha~NmatvA preritAraM tataH pR^ithak | asau juShTastatastena hyamR^itatvAya kalpate
verses.translation: Strong night-prowlers with Tamas and Rajas prominent were born as his sons. The serpents, Yakas, Bhutas and Gandharvas were born.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतस्य परं सेतुं दग्धेन्धनमिवानलम्
verses.transliteration: amR^itasya paraM setuM dagdhendhanamivAnalam
verses.translation: The crows were created from the sides, birds from his chest, goats from the face and serpents from the sides.

verses.sanskrit: यदा चर्मवदाकाशं वेष्टयिष्यन्ति मानवाः । तदा शिवमविज्ञाय दुःखस्यान्तो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: yadA charmavadAkAshaM veShTayiShyanti mAnavAH | tadA shivamavij~nAya duHkhasyAnto bhaviShyati
verses.translation: From his feet were born the horses, elephants, 8arabhas, wild oxen, deer, camels, mules, stags and other animals.

verses.sanskrit: तपःप्रभावाद्देवस्य प्रसादाच्च महर्षयः । आत्माश्रमोचितज्ञानं पवित्रं पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tapaHprabhAvAddevasya prasAdAchcha maharShayaH | AtmAshramochitaj~nAnaM pavitraM pApanAshanam
verses.translation: Medicinal herbs, fruits and roots were born of his hairs. From his eastern face he created Gayatri, Rks, Trivftsama, Rathantara, Agnistoma and other sacrifices. From his southern face he created Yajus Traistubha Ghandas, the fifteen Stomas, Brhatsama and Uktha. From his western face he created Saman, Jagati Ghandas, the seventeen Stomas, Vairupya and Atiratra mantras. From his northern face he created the Atharva Veda, the twentyone Aptorva- man, Anustubh Ghandas and the Vairaja. High and low animals and Jiving beings were born of his different limbs.

verses.sanskrit: वेदान्ते परमं गुह्यं पुरा कल्पप्रचोदितम् । ब्रह्मणो वदनाल्लब्धं मयेदं भाग्यगौरवात्
verses.transliteration: vedAnte paramaM guhyaM purA kalpaprachoditam | brahmaNo vadanAllabdhaM mayedaM bhAgyagauravAt
verses.translation: Yaksas, Pisacas, Gandharvas, Apsaras, human beings, Kinnaras, Raksasas, birds, deer and other animals, serpents etc. were born.

verses.sanskrit: नाप्रशान्ताय दातव्यमेतज्ज्ञानमनुत्तमम् । न पुत्रायासुवृत्ताय नाशिष्याय च सर्वथा
verses.transliteration: nAprashAntAya dAtavyametajj~nAnamanuttamam | na putrAyAsuvR^ittAya nAshiShyAya cha sarvathA
verses.translation: The mobile and immobile beings which were perish¬ able and imperishable attained their activities.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य देवे पराभक्तिर्यथा देवे तथा गुरौ । तस्यैते कथिता ह्यर्थाः प्रकाशन्ते महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yasya deve parAbhaktiryathA deve tathA gurau | tasyaite kathitA hyarthAH prakAshante mahAtmanaH
verses.translation: Greated again and again the beings retain their previous nature, violent or non-violent, soft or ruthless, virtuous or evil, true or false.

verses.sanskrit: अतश्च सङ्क्षेपमिदं शृणुध्वं शिवः परस्तात्प्रकृतेश्च पुंसः । स सर्गकाले च करोति सर्वं संहारकाले पुनराददाति
verses.transliteration: atashcha sa~NkShepamidaM shR^iNudhvaM shivaH parastAtprakR^iteshcha puMsaH | sa sargakAle cha karoti sarvaM saMhArakAle punarAdadAti
verses.translation: They attain birth with the impressions of their previous traits. The creator himself has assigned the variety and diversity to the elements, the sensual objects etc. He himself has assigned them names and forms through the Vedic texts. He has bestowed the names of the sages and the

verses.sanskrit: पशोः पाशस्य पत्युश्च तत्त्वतोऽस्ति पदं परम् । ब्रह्मवित् तद्विदित्वैव योनिमुक्तो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: pashoH pAshasya patyushcha tattvato.asti padaM param | brahmavit tadviditvaiva yonimukto bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Beginning with intellect and ending with Viiea this secondary creation is derived from Prakrti itself. There in the Brahmavana which has the light of the moon and the sun, which is embellished by planets, stars, rivers, oceans, mountains and abounds in beautiful cities and countries the unmanifest Brahma, having his source in the seed of Avyakta and blessed with the benign favour of the lord, the knower of all, moves about.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानोपदेश नामक इकतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: संयुक्तमेतद् द्वितयं क्षरमक्षरमेव च । व्यक्ताव्यक्तं बिभर्तीशो विश्वं विश्वविमोचकः
verses.transliteration: saMyuktametad dvitayaM kSharamakSharameva cha | vyaktAvyaktaM bibhartIsho vishvaM vishvavimochakaH
verses.translation: The eternal tree in the form of Brahma shall be resorted to by all. The cosmic intellect is its main stem as well as its branch; the sense-organs its inner hollows; the great elements characterize its size; the Visesa is its tender sprout; Dharma and Adharma its good flowers; happiness and misery its fruits.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Sir, you have narrated the creation of the great Atman through the mouth of the four-faced lord. There we have a doubt.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Sir, you have narrated the creation of the great Atman through the mouth of the four-faced lord. There we have a doubt.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । कालमहिमवर्णनम् । मुनय ऊचुः । कालादुत्पद्यते सर्वं कालादेव विपद्यते । न कालनिरपेक्षं हि क्वचित्किञ्चन विद्यते
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.7\. saptamo.adhyAyaH | kAlamahimavarNanam | munaya UchuH | kAlAdutpadyate sarvaM kAlAdeva vipadyate | na kAlanirapekShaM hi kvachitki~nchana vidyate
verses.translation: The Odd-eyed liva is the foremost among the gods. The trident-bearing 8iva is brilliant. Lord Rudra the Kalatman is Kapardin and Nilalohita. When the end of the yuga arrives he becomes infuriated and annihilates this universe including Brahma, Viu and the fire-god. He makes the worlds shrink. Brahma and Vinu are under his control. They make obeisance to him out of fright. He is the lord who formerly created Brahma and Vi?nu from his limbs. He alone is the cause of acquisition and retention. He is the primordial and ancient god. How did such a lord become the son of Brahma who is born of Avyakta?

verses.sanskrit: यतोऽप्रतिहतं शार्वं तेजः काले प्रतिष्ठितम् । महती तेन कालस्य मर्यादा हि दुरत्यया
verses.transliteration: yato.apratihataM shArvaM tejaH kAle pratiShThitam | mahatI tena kAlasya maryAdA hi duratyayA
verses.translation: We have also heard that Brahma and Vinu were born of Rudra and created Rudra. Thus they mutually created each other.

verses.sanskrit: कालं प्रज्ञाविशेषेण कोऽतिवर्तितुमर्हति । कालेन तु कृतं कर्म न कश्चिदतिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: kAlaM praj~nAvisheSheNa ko.ativartitumarhati | kAlena tu kR^itaM karma na kashchidativartate
verses.translation: How could the two, progenitors of the living beings, come out of each other thereby possessing both prominence or otherwise?

verses.sanskrit: एकच्छत्रां महीं कृत्स्नां ये पराक्रम्य शासति । तेऽपि नैवातिवर्तन्ते कालं वेलामिवाब्धयः
verses.transliteration: ekachChatrAM mahIM kR^itsnAM ye parAkramya shAsati | te.api naivAtivartante kAlaM velAmivAbdhayaH
verses.translation: Please narrate how Brahma became the lord of all sages. O dear, we are faithful and eager to hear the great glory of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: ये निगृह्येन्द्रियग्रामं जयन्ति सकलं जगत् । न जयन्त्यपि ते कालं कालो जयति तानपि
verses.transliteration: ye nigR^ihyendriyagrAmaM jayanti sakalaM jagat | na jayantyapi te kAlaM kAlo jayati tAnapi
verses.translation: O Brahmins, this question has been well put by you, experts in the art of queries. 1 had put the same query to Brahma who replied suitably.

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्वेदविदो वैद्याः त्वनुष्ठितरसायनाः । न मृत्युमतिवर्तन्ते कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: Ayurvedavido vaidyAH tvanuShThitarasAyanAH | na mR^ityumativartante kAlo hi duratikramaH
verses.translation: The three are the Atmans as causes born of Mahcsvara; they are the causes of ci cation, sustenance and annihilation of the universe consisting of the mobile and.immobile beings. Endowed with great qualities they are sanctified by the great lord. Presided over by his Sakti they can always perform their activities. Brahma can create; Viipnu can protect; Rudra can annihilate.

verses.sanskrit: श्रिया रूपेण शीलेन बलेन च कुलेन च । अन्यच्चिन्तयते जन्तुः कालोऽन्यत्कुरुते बलात्
verses.transliteration: shriyA rUpeNa shIlena balena cha kulena cha | anyachchintayate jantuH kAlo.anyatkurute balAt
verses.translation: But they rivalled with one another. Desirous of excelling one another they propitiated their father, the
verses.hindi: जय द्धिः शि व कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: अप्रियैश्च प्रियैश्चैव ह्यचिन्तितसमागमैः । संयोजयति भूतानि वियोजयति चेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: apriyaishcha priyaishchaiva hyachintitasamAgamaiH | saMyojayati bhUtAni viyojayati cheshvaraH
verses.translation: I too shall propitiate Rudra, the leader of gods, by means of penance and shall create the entire universe along with you. There is no doubt in this.

verses.sanskrit: यदैव दुःखितः कश्चित्तदैव सुखितः परः । दुर्विज्ञेयस्वभावस्य कालास्याहो विचित्रता
verses.transliteration: yadaiva duHkhitaH kashchittadaiva sukhitaH paraH | durvij~neyasvabhAvasya kAlAsyAho vichitratA
verses.translation: Slighting Vi§nu thus, Brahma attained Siva by means of penance and submitted to him thus.

verses.sanskrit: यो युवा स भवेद् वृद्धो यो बलीयान्स दुर्बलः । यः श्रीमान्सोऽपि निःश्रीकः कालश्चित्रगतिर्द्विजा
verses.transliteration: yo yuvA sa bhaved vR^iddho yo balIyAnsa durbalaH | yaH shrImAnso.api niHshrIkaH kAlashchitragatirdvijA
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, O lord of the universe, Visnu is born of your left and 1 am born of your righll side.
verses.hindi: योगं चर परम॑ लब्ध्वा मुच्यते नात्र संशय: ॥ ५६  है, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: नाभिजात्यं न वै शीलं न बलं न च नैपुणम् । भवेत्कार्याय पर्याप्तं कालश्चत् प्रतिरोधकः
verses.transliteration: nAbhijAtyaM na vai shIlaM na balaM na cha naipuNam | bhavetkAryAya paryAptaM kAlashchat pratirodhakaH
verses.translation: Still V4nu created the universe along with me. Due to rivalry he was taunted by me depending on the strength of your support.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायां पूर्वखण्डे श्रेष्ठनुष्टानवर्णन॑ नाम द्वात्रिंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: यदास्यान्तर्गतं विश्वं शश्वत्संसारमण्डलम् । सर्गसंहृतिमुद्राभ्यां चक्रवत्परिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: yadAsyAntargataM vishvaM shashvatsaMsAramaNDalam | sargasaMhR^itimudrAbhyAM chakravatparivartate
verses.translation: "O Visnu, your piety towards the lord is not more than that of mine" (I told him) because our origin from you is on the same footing.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठानुष्ठानवर्णन नामक बत्तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ये सनाथाश्च दातारो गीतवाद्यैरुपस्थिताः । ये चानाथाः परान्नादाः कालस्तेषु समक्रियः
verses.transliteration: ye sanAthAshcha dAtAro gItavAdyairupasthitAH | ye chAnAthAH parAnnAdAH kAlasteShu samakriyaH
verses.translation: O Siva, it behoves you to give all that to me also in the manner you bestowed on him before due to his devotion.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मादयो5पि यत्कृत्वा सर्वे पाशुपता: स्मृता:॥ १  आदि सब देवता पाशुपत माने गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: फलन्त्यकाले न रसायनानि सम्यक् प्रयुक्तान्यपि चौषधानि । तान्येव कालेन समाहृतानि सिद्धिं प्रयान्त्याशु सुखं दिशन्ति
verses.transliteration: phalantyakAle na rasAyanAni samyak prayuktAnyapi chauShadhAni | tAnyeva kAlena samAhR^itAni siddhiM prayAntyAshu sukhaM dishanti
verses.translation: Thus implored by him the merciful lord Siva gave all to him as justifiable.

verses.sanskrit: नाकालतोऽयं म्रियते जायते वा नाकालतः पुष्टिमग्र्यामुपैति । नाकालतः सुखितं दुःखितं वा नाकालिकं वस्तु समस्ति किञ्चित्
verses.transliteration: nAkAlato.ayaM mriyate jAyate vA nAkAlataH puShTimagryAmupaiti | nAkAlataH sukhitaM duHkhitaM vA nAkAlikaM vastu samasti ki~nchit
verses.translation: Thus obtaining the state of being the Atman of all in a trice, from Siva, Brahma hastened to and saw Vi?nu.
verses.hindi: तो केवल भावनामय कमल समर्पित करे

verses.sanskrit: कालेन शीतः प्रतिवाति वातः कालेन वृष्टिर्जलदानुपैति । कालेन चोष्मा प्रशमं प्रयाति कालेन सर्वं सफलत्वमेति
verses.transliteration: kAlena shItaH prativAti vAtaH kAlena vR^iShTirjaladAnupaiti | kAlena choShmA prashamaM prayAti kAlena sarvaM saphalatvameti
verses.translation: He saw Vi§riu lying on Sea*® in his abode in the milk-ocean.*®* A white canopy resembling the sun was spread. It was created by him mentally. It was set with gold and gems. Lord Vinu had eyes resembling lotus. He had splendid body with four arms. He was bedecked in ornaments. He was holding conch and discus. His lace shone like the disc of the moon. The scar Srivatsa marked his chest. He was smiling sweetly. His lotus-like feet attained red hue due to the contact of the lotu.s-like Laksmi. In Yogic slumber he appeared lying in the nectarine milky ocean. By the Guna of Tamas he was Kalarudra; by that of Rajas he was Brahma; by that of Sattva he was Visnu. In Nirguna state he was lord liva. On seeing him Brahma spoke seriously — "O Visnu, I am going to devour you as you did me formerly."

verses.sanskrit: कालश्च सर्वस्य भवस्य हेतुः कालेन सस्यानि भवन्ति नित्यम् । कालेन सस्यानि लयं प्रयान्ति कालेन सञ्जीवति जीवलोकः
verses.transliteration: kAlashcha sarvasya bhavasya hetuH kAlena sasyAni bhavanti nityam | kAlena sasyAni layaM prayAnti kAlena sa~njIvati jIvalokaH
verses.translation: On hearing this Visnu woke up, saw Brahma and smiled slightly.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं कालात्मनस्तत्त्वं यो विजानाति तत्त्वतः । कालात्मानमतिक्रम्य कालातीतं स पश्यति
verses.transliteration: itthaM kAlAtmanastattvaM yo vijAnAti tattvataH | kAlAtmAnamatikramya kAlAtItaM sa pashyati
verses.translation: In the meantime the moon-crested lord came to the place to test their akti. Though devoid of form he assumed a form in order to bless them as he had previously done. Both of them were delighted and frightened and so eulogised the lord and bowed to him with respect from a dis¬ tance. The trident-bearing lord blessed them and vanished even as they watched him with respect.
verses.hindi: वस्तुएँ निवेदन करके अपना कल्याण करे

verses.sanskrit: न यस्य कालो न च बन्धमुक्ती न यः पुमान्न प्रकृतिर्न विश्वम् । विचित्ररूपाय शिवाय तस्मै नमःपरस्मै परमेश्वराय
verses.transliteration: na yasya kAlo na cha bandhamuktI na yaH pumAnna prakR^itirna vishvam | vichitrarUpAya shivAya tasmai namaHparasmai parameshvarAya
verses.translation: Skt texts abound in descriptions of Visnu reclining on Serpent Se?a. In this context, it may be noted that there is a vivid picture of Sesai&yt V'ipu on the outer wall of the UasSvatira temple at Oeogarh (c. 5th cent. A,D)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा हरिश्च रुद्रश्च तथान्ये च सुरासुराः । यत्कृतां नियतिं प्राप्य प्रभवो नातिवर्तितुम्
verses.transliteration: brahmA harishcha rudrashcha tathAnye cha surAsurAH | yatkR^itAM niyatiM prApya prabhavo nAtivartitum
verses.translation: After creating the subjert.s in every Kalpa, Brahma born of the cosmic egg felt excessively distressed. He was deluded.

verses.sanskrit: भूतभव्यभविष्याद्यैर्विभज्य जरयन् प्रजाः । अतिप्रभुरिति स्वैरं वर्ततेऽतिभयङ्करः
verses.transliteration: bhUtabhavyabhaviShyAdyairvibhajya jarayan prajAH | atiprabhuriti svairaM vartate.atibhaya~NkaraH
verses.translation: In order to pacify his misery and to multiply his subjects, in the various Kalpas, Rudra, Brahma's younger brother, becomes the son of Brahma and blesses him.

verses.sanskrit: क एष भगवान् कालः कस्य वा वशवर्त्ययम् । क एवास्य वशे न स्यात्कथयैतद्विचक्षण
verses.transliteration: ka eSha bhagavAn kAlaH kasya vA vashavartyayam | ka evAsya vashe na syAtkathayaitadvichakShaNa
verses.translation: He has the same name, the same form; he can perform his task; he has.same function as he maintains and abides by his commands.
verses.hindi: निष्ठासम्पन्न पुरुषोंमें उत्तम कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । कालकाष्ठानिमेषादिकलाकलितविग्रहम् । कालात्मेति समाख्यातं तेजो माहेश्वरं परम्
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | kAlakAShThAnimeShAdikalAkalitavigraham | kAlAtmeti samAkhyAtaM tejo mAheshvaraM param
verses.translation: His lips shine with the tips being hit by the sharp- pointed curved fangs; his ear-rings make a halo around his left ear.
verses.hindi: छूट जाता है, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: यदलङ्घ्यमशेषस्य स्थावरस्य चरस्य च । नियोगरूपमीशस्य बलं विश्वनियामकम्
verses.transliteration: yadala~NghyamasheShasya sthAvarasya charasya cha | niyogarUpamIshasya balaM vishvaniyAmakam
verses.translation: He whose features are hideous in this manner and who is born as the son af Brahma bestows wisdom on him and co-operates with him in the activity of creation.
verses.hindi: भागते हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: तस्यांशांशमयी शक्तिः कालात्मनि महात्मनि । ततो निष्क्रम्य सङ्क्रान्ता विसृष्टाग्रेरिवायसी
verses.transliteration: tasyAMshAMshamayI shaktiH kAlAtmani mahAtmani | tato niShkramya sa~NkrAntA visR^iShTAgrerivAyasI
verses.translation: Once, when requested by Brahma to create, he mentally created all beings exactly like himself.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्कालवशे विश्वं न स विश्ववशे स्थितः । शिवस्य तु वशे कालो न कालस्य वशे शिवः
verses.transliteration: tasmAtkAlavashe vishvaM na sa vishvavashe sthitaH | shivasya tu vashe kAlo na kAlasya vashe shivaH
verses.translation: All of them had matted hair; they were free from fear and distress, had blue necks and three eyes, were free from decaying age and death; they had shining tridents as their excellent weapons.
verses.hindi: पशुपतिब्रतविधानवर्णन नामक तैंतीसवाँ अध्याय यूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you, O lord of gods, do not create such subjects. Welfare to you. Create other subjects that may be endowed with death."
verses.hindi: स्वपदप्रच्युतो दिष्टया प्राप्त मुनिकुमारताम्॥ ५  मुनिकुमार हुए

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you, O lord of gods, do not create such subjects. Welfare to you. Create other subjects that may be endowed with death."
verses.hindi: अनुग्रहमें मानो द्वार अर्थात् माध्यम बन गयी

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.८. अष्टमोऽध्यायः । कालप्रभावे त्रिदेवायुर्वर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । केन मानेन कालेऽस्मिन्नायुः सङ्ख्या प्रकल्प्यते । सङ्ख्यारूपस्य कालस्य कः पुनः परमोऽवधिः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.8\. aShTamo.adhyAyaH | kAlaprabhAve tridevAyurvarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | kena mAnena kAle.asminnAyuH sa~NkhyA prakalpyate | sa~NkhyArUpasya kAlasya kaH punaH paramo.avadhiH
verses.translation: When told thus, the lord replied to Brahma, "Such a creation Js not iny task. You alone create inauspicious beings.;
verses.hindi: और शाश्वत कुमारभाव भी प्रदान किया

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि वर्षशतान्येव षष्टिवर्षयुतान्यपि । दिव्यः संवत्सरो ज्ञेयो मानुषेण प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: trINi varShashatAnyeva ShaShTivarShayutAnyapi | divyaH saMvatsaro j~neyo mAnuSheNa prakIrtitaH
verses.translation: The noble beings of great strength created by me mentally will walk about in my company. They will regulate the sacrifices."

verses.sanskrit: दिव्येनैव प्रमाणेन युगसङ्ख्या प्रवर्तते । चत्वारि भारते वर्षे युगानि कवयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: divyenaiva pramANena yugasa~NkhyA pravartate | chatvAri bhArate varShe yugAni kavayo viduH
verses.translation: After saying thus to the creator, Siva the lord of living beings desisted from creation and remained in the com¬ pany of Rudras.
verses.hindi: उनकी शिवज्ञानप्राप्तिमें कारण प्रतीत होती है

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं कृतयुगं नाम ततस्त्रेता विधीयते । द्वापरं च कलिश्चैव युगान्येतानि कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: pUrvaM kR^itayugaM nAma tatastretA vidhIyate | dvAparaM cha kalishchaiva yugAnyetAni kR^itsnashaH
verses.translation: From that time onwards the lord docs not pro¬ create auspicious beings. He stands in Yogic trance till the dissolution of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारि तु सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तत्कृतं युगम् । तस्य तावच्छती सन्ध्या सन्ध्यांशश्च तथाविधः
verses.transliteration: chatvAri tu sahasrANi varShANAM tatkR^itaM yugam | tasya tAvachChatI sandhyA sandhyAMshashcha tathAvidhaH
verses.translation: When the creation of Brahma did not multiply Brahma thought of creation by the pi oeess of sexual inter¬ course.

verses.sanskrit: इतरेषु ससन्ध्येषु ससन्ध्यांशेषु च त्रिषु । एकापायेन वर्तन्ते सहस्राणि शतानि च
verses.transliteration: itareShu sasandhyeShu sasandhyAMsheShu cha triShu | ekApAyena vartante sahasrANi shatAni cha
verses.translation: Since the race of women had not emanated from the loid foiinerly, Brahma could not produce creation through sexual intercourse.
verses.hindi: आनेसे वह दुखी हो विलाप करने लगी

verses.sanskrit: एतद्द्वादशसाहस्रं साधिकं च चतुर्युगम् । चतुर्युगसहस्रं यत्सङ्कल्प इति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: etaddvAdashasAhasraM sAdhikaM cha chaturyugam | chaturyugasahasraM yatsa~Nkalpa iti kathyate
verses.translation: Then he finally resolved that the lord should be asked in respect of multiplying the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्युगैकसप्तत्या मनोरन्तरमुच्यते । कल्पे चतुर्दशैकस्मिन्मनूनां परिवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: chaturyugaikasaptatyA manorantaramuchyate | kalpe chaturdashaikasminmanUnAM parivR^ittayaH
verses.translation: Thinking that without his grace the subjects will not increase, Brahma began to perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: एतेन क्रमयोगेन कल्पमन्वन्तराणि च । सप्रजानि व्यतीतानि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: etena kramayogena kalpamanvantarANi cha | saprajAni vyatItAni shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
verses.translation: His primordial eternal Sakti is subtle, pure, pleasant and intelligible only through piety; it is devoid of attributes, unsullied, unramified unruffled, perpetual and it ever remains with Isvara. Thus Brahma pondered over the lord and his great iakti and performed penance.
verses.hindi: बिना तुम्हारे लिये कहीं दूध नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञेयत्वाच्च सर्वेषामसङ्ख्येयतया पुनः । शक्यो नैवानुपूर्व्याद्वै तेषां वक्तुं सुविस्तरः
verses.transliteration: aj~neyatvAchcha sarveShAmasa~NkhyeyatayA punaH | shakyo naivAnupUrvyAdvai teShAM vaktuM suvistaraH
verses.translation: Becoming half-female®®* after introducing certain parts into a certain image, the lord himself came there.
verses.hindi: करता हुआ यह गम्भीर वचन कहने लगा

verses.sanskrit: कल्पो नाम दिवा प्रोक्तो ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः । कल्पानां वै सहस्रं च ब्राह्मं वर्षमिहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: kalpo nAma divA prokto brahmaNo.avyaktajanmanaH | kalpAnAM vai sahasraM cha brAhmaM varShamihochyate
verses.translation: On seeing the lord, Brahma eulogised him as well as the goddess, with hymns full of subtle meaning — the lord who is beyond darkness, is eternal, without a second, incomprehensible, invisible to the libertine, the creator, overlord, endowed with the creative power, who is beyond arguments, has no fallacious appearance, is immeasurable, unaging, stable, unmoving, devoid of attributes, quiescent, possessed of infinity, omnipresent, bestower of boons, devoid of difference between the Existent and the non-Existent, incomparable, worthy of being sought refuge and permanent. He prostrated before him and then stood up with palms joined with reverence. He eulogised him with faith and humility by means of hymns of subtle, sweet, refined and pious meanings that explained the Vedic texts.
verses.hindi: उस समय बहुत प्रसन्‍न हुई और यों बोली--

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । आयुषोऽत्र निमेषाख्यमाद्यमानं प्रचक्षते । सङ्ख्यारूपस्य कालस्य शान्त्यतीतकलावधि
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | AyuSho.atra nimeShAkhyamAdyamAnaM prachakShate | sa~NkhyArUpasya kAlasya shAntyatItakalAvadhi
verses.translation: O lord, be victorious. O Isvara, O Maheivara, splendid with attributes, be victorious.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाणामष्टसाहस्रं यच्च तद्ब्रह्मणो युगम् । सवनं युगसाहस्रं ब्रह्मणः पद्मजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: varShANAmaShTasAhasraM yachcha tadbrahmaNo yugam | savanaM yugasAhasraM brahmaNaH padmajanmanaH
verses.translation: O auspicious goddess, O heroine of Prakrti and the one beyond Prakrti and naturally beautiful, be victorious.

verses.sanskrit: सवनानां सहस्रं च त्रिगुणं त्रिवृतं तथा । कल्प्यते सकलः कालो ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: savanAnAM sahasraM cha triguNaM trivR^itaM tathA | kalpyate sakalaH kAlo brahmaNaH parameShThinaH
verses.translation: O lord of fruitful Maya, of fruitful will, of great sports and of fruitful strength, be victorious.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वै दिवसे यान्ति चतुर्दश पुरन्दराः । शतानि मासे चत्वारि विंशत्या सहितानि च
verses.transliteration: tasya vai divase yAnti chaturdasha purandarAH | shatAni mAse chatvAri viMshatyA sahitAni cha
verses.translation: O mother of the universe, O goddess identical with the universe, O creator and companion of the universe, be victorious.

verses.sanskrit: अब्दे पञ्च सहस्राणि चत्वारिंशद्युतानि च । चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि पञ्च लक्षाणि चायुषि
verses.transliteration: abde pa~ncha sahasrANi chatvAriMshadyutAni cha | chatvAriMshatsahasrANi pa~ncha lakShANi chAyuShi
verses.translation: Be victorious, O lord of eternal prosperity and permanent abode. Be victorious, O lord of eternal form. Be victorious, O lord of permanent devotees.
verses.hindi: कहा--' सब देवता तुम्हारा मंगल करें'

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विष्णोर्दिने चैको विष्णू रुद्रदिने तथा । ईश्वरस्य दिने रुद्रः सदाख्यस्य तथेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: brahmA viShNordine chaiko viShNU rudradine tathA | Ishvarasya dine rudraH sadAkhyasya tatheshvaraH
verses.translation: Be victorious O creatress, protectress, annihilatress and the heroine of the three Atmans.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षाच्छिवस्य तत्सङ्ख्यस्तथा सोऽपि सदाशिवः । चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि पञ्चलक्षाणि चायुषि
verses.transliteration: sAkShAchChivasya tatsa~NkhyastathA so.api sadAshivaH | chatvAriMshatsahasrANi pa~nchalakShANi chAyuShi
verses.translation: Be victorious, O lord ready to survey, enlarge the universe. Be victorious, O lord from whose terrible glance rises the fire that consumes all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्साक्षाच्छिवेनैष कालात्मा सम्प्रवर्तते । यत्तत्सृष्टेः समाख्यातं कालान्तरमिह द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tasminsAkShAchChivenaiSha kAlAtmA sampravartate | yattatsR^iShTeH samAkhyAtaM kAlAntaramiha dvijAH
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess incomprehensible to the gods and others, O goddess that shinest brilliantly with your subtle vision. Be victorious, O goddess the part of the gross Sakti of the Atman. Be victorious, O goddess pervading the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: उपमन्युतपोवर्णन नामक चाँतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: एतत्कालान्तरं ज्ञेयमहर्वै पारमेश्वरम् । रात्रिश्च तावती ज्ञेया परमेशस्य कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: etatkAlAntaraM j~neyamaharvai pArameshvaram | rAtrishcha tAvatI j~neyA parameshasya kR^itsnashaH
verses.translation: Be victorious. O lord merging various principles of the universe into one. Be victorious, O lord the groups of whose followers have stepped on the heads ol Asiiras.
verses.hindi: क्षीरार्थभद्हत्सव॑ तपसा तत्निवारय॥ ४  सबको जला रहा है, उसे रोकिये

verses.sanskrit: अहस्तस्य तु या सृष्टी रात्रिश्च प्रलयः स्मृतः । अहर्न विद्यते तस्य न रात्रिरिति धारयेत्
verses.transliteration: ahastasya tu yA sR^iShTI rAtrishcha pralayaH smR^itaH | aharna vidyate tasya na rAtririti dhArayet
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess affording protection to those who resort to you. Be victorious, O goddess who uproot the spirits of the poisonous tree of worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: एषोपचारः क्रियते लोकानां हितकाम्यया । प्रजाः प्रजानां पतयो मूर्तयश्च सुरासुराः
verses.transliteration: eShopachAraH kriyate lokAnAM hitakAmyayA | prajAH prajAnAM patayo mUrtayashcha surAsurAH
verses.translation: Be victorious, O lord enhancing prosperity, prowess and heroism. Be victorious, O lord, stationed beyond the universe, O lord who hast quelled the might of the enemies.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षिपक्ष्मपरिक्षेपो निमेषः परिकल्पितः । तादृशानां निमेषाणां काष्ठा दश च पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: akShipakShmaparikShepo nimeShaH parikalpitaH | tAdR^ishAnAM nimeShANAM kAShThA dasha cha pa~ncha cha
verses.translation: Be victorious, O immortal lord who hast laid the rite of "five objects," Be victorious, O goddess having the form of the hymn with the knowledge of the "five objects."

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थाश्च महाभूतानि पञ्च च । तन्मात्राण्यथ भूतादिर्बुद्धिश्च सह दैवतैः
verses.transliteration: indriyANIndriyArthAshcha mahAbhUtAni pa~ncha cha | tanmAtrANyatha bhUtAdirbuddhishcha saha daivataiH
verses.translation: Be victorious, O lord, the physician par excellence for the great suffering of the terrible worldly existence. Be victorious, O goddess the moon-light for the layers of darkness of ignorance, the primordial dirt.

verses.sanskrit: अहस्तिष्ठन्ति सर्वाणि परमेशस्य धीमतः । अहरन्ते प्रलीयन्ते रात्र्यन्ते विश्वसम्भवः
verses.transliteration: ahastiShThanti sarvANi parameshasya dhImataH | aharante pralIyante rAtryante vishvasambhavaH
verses.translation: Be victorious, O black fire that consumed the Tripuras, Be victorious, O goddess Tripurabhairavi, Be victorious, O lord devoid of three attributes. Be victorious Q goddess, the possessor of three attributes.
verses.hindi: प्राह गंभीरया वाचा शक्ररूपधरों हरः॥ ९१४  गम्भीर वाणीमें कहने लगे--

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठास्त्रिंशत्कला नाम कलास्त्रिंशन्मुहूर्तकः । मुहूर्त्तानामपि त्रिंशदहोरात्रं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: kAShThAstriMshatkalA nAma kalAstriMshanmuhUrtakaH | muhUrttAnAmapi triMshadahorAtraM prachakShate
verses.translation: Be victorious, O omniscient one. Be victorious, O goddess enlightening every one. Be victorious O lord having prolific divine limbs. Be victorious, O goddess bestowing all desires.
verses.hindi: मैं तुम्हें सम्पूर्ण अभीष्ट वस्तुएँ प्रदान करूँगा

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशत्सङ्ख्यैरहोरात्रैर्मासः पक्षद्वयात्मकः
verses.transliteration: triMshatsa~NkhyairahorAtrairmAsaH pakShadvayAtmakaH
verses.translation: After eulogising with these and similar hymns the four-faced lord, the creator of the universe bowed again and again fo Rudra and Rudrani.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञेयं पित्र्यमहोरात्रं मासः कृष्णसितात्मकः
verses.transliteration: j~neyaM pitryamahorAtraM mAsaH kR^iShNasitAtmakaH
verses.translation: This holy and excellent hymn '*ArdhanarIsvara Stotra" uttered by Brahma enhances the delight of 8iva and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: मासैस्तैरयनं षड्भिर्वर्षं द्वे चायनं मतम् । लौकिकेनैव मानेन ह्यब्दो यो मानुषः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: mAsaistairayanaM ShaDbhirvarShaM dve chAyanaM matam | laukikenaiva mAnena hyabdo yo mAnuShaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: He who recites this with devotion or teaches to anyone whatsoever reaps the fruit thereof as a result of the pleasure ofSiva and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दिव्यमहोरात्रमिति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः । दक्षिणं चायनं रात्रिस्तथोदगयनं दिनम्
verses.transliteration: etaddivyamahorAtramiti shAstrasya nishchayaH | dakShiNaM chAyanaM rAtristathodagayanaM dinam
verses.translation: I bow to Siva and Siva the sanctifiers of living beings in the entire universe; the couple whose bodies are devoid of birth and death aud who have taken the bodies of an excellent man and a youthful maiden.

verses.sanskrit: मासस्त्रिंशदहोरात्रैर्दिव्यो मानुषवत्स्मृतः । संवत्सरोऽपि देवानां मासैर्द्वादशभिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: mAsastriMshadahorAtrairdivyo mAnuShavatsmR^itaH | saMvatsaro.api devAnAM mAsairdvAdashabhistathA
verses.translation: Then the delighted god Siva spoke to Brahma with a benign and sweet smile. His voice sounded like thunder. All the letters were sweet, majestic, soft, clear, full and rich in meanings. They had royal qualities being pure and efficient in the protection of all subjects.
verses.hindi: उनका मस्तक सूँघकर अनेक वर दिये

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: After this sweet and liberal speech the excellent lord created the goddess from a part of his body.
verses.hindi: मेरे प्रति भक्ति सदा बनी रहे

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: After this sweet and liberal speech the excellent lord created the goddess from a part of his body.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.९. नवमोऽध्यायः । सृष्टिपालनप्रलयकर्तृत्ववर्णनम् । मुनय ऊचुः । कथं जगदिदं कृत्स्नं विधाय च निधाय च । आज्ञया परमां क्रीडां करोति परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.9\. navamo.adhyAyaH | sR^iShTipAlanapralayakartR^itvavarNanam | munaya UchuH | kathaM jagadidaM kR^itsnaM vidhAya cha nidhAya cha | Aj~nayA paramAM krIDAM karoti parameshvaraH
verses.translation: She from whom words recede along with the mind and the sense-organs,*®® appeared to be born of a part of the body of her husband.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्तृकं स्वयं दृष्टं बुद्धिमत्कारणं विना । जगच्च कर्तृसापेक्षं कार्यं सावयवं यतः
verses.transliteration: tatkartR^ikaM svayaM dR^iShTaM buddhimatkAraNaM vinA | jagachcha kartR^isApekShaM kAryaM sAvayavaM yataH
verses.translation: The goddess who pervades everything through her greatness was seen like a wonderfully embodied being.
verses.hindi: उपमन्युने देवदेव महेश्वरसे यह वर माँगा

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छक्तः स्वतन्त्रो यः सर्वशक्तिश्च सर्ववित् । अनादिनिधनश्चायं महदैश्वर्यसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: tasmAchChaktaH svatantro yaH sarvashaktishcha sarvavit | anAdinidhanashchAyaM mahadaishvaryasaMyutaH
verses.translation: On seeing the great omniscient, omnipresent subtle goddess, devoid of the dilTeicnce between Sat and Asat, the goddess who illuminates the universe with her brilliance, Brahma bowed and prayed.

verses.sanskrit: स एव जगतः कर्ता महादेवो महेश्वरः । पाता हर्ता च सर्वस्य ततः पृथगनन्वयः
verses.transliteration: sa eva jagataH kartA mahAdevo maheshvaraH | pAtA hartA cha sarvasya tataH pR^ithagananvayaH
verses.translation: O Goddess, the gods and others arc mentally created by me. Though they are created again and again they do not increase in number.

verses.sanskrit: परिणामः प्रधानस्य प्रवृत्तिः पुरुषस्य च । सर्वं सत्यव्रतस्यैव शासनेन प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: pariNAmaH pradhAnasya pravR^ittiH puruShasya cha | sarvaM satyavratasyaiva shAsanena pravartate
verses.translation: Hereafter I wish to increase the number through copulation.

verses.sanskrit: इतीयं शाश्वती निष्ठा सतां मनसि वर्तते । न चैनं पक्षमाश्रित्य वर्तते स्वल्पचेतनः
verses.transliteration: itIyaM shAshvatI niShThA satAM manasi vartate | na chainaM pakShamAshritya vartate svalpachetanaH
verses.translation: The race of women has not emerged from you. Hence I cannot create an cvcrlastijig race of women.®®'
verses.hindi: तेजस्वी और दिव्य ज्ञानसे सम्पन्न होओ

verses.sanskrit: यावदादिसमारम्भो यावद्यः प्रलयो महान् । तावदप्येति सकलं ब्रह्मणः शारदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: yAvadAdisamArambho yAvadyaH pralayo mahAn | tAvadapyeti sakalaM brahmaNaH shAradAM shatam
verses.translation: iSaktis originate from you. Hence I worship you alone who bestow Saktis upon everyone everywhere, who grant boons and who arc Maya and the goddess of the gods. O omnipresent goddess for the increase of the mobile
verses.hindi: करूँगा। तुम मेरे पास सानन्द विचरोगे

verses.sanskrit: परमित्यायुषो नाम ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः । तत्पराख्यं तदर्द्धं च परार्धमभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: paramityAyuSho nAma brahmaNo.avyaktajanmanaH | tatparAkhyaM tadarddhaM cha parArdhamabhidhIyate
verses.translation: "After propitiating Brahma with penance you shall carry out what he desires**. The Sakti obeyed the lord. At the instance of Brahma she became the daughter of Daka. After giving the incomparable SaKti in the form of Brahman to Brahma, the goddess re-entered the body of the lord. The lord vanished. Since that time the enjoyment of sexual pleasures in women was established.
verses.hindi: जगाम जननीस्थानं सुखं प्रापाधिकं च सः॥ ६५  स्थानपर चले गये

verses.sanskrit: परार्द्धद्वयकालान्ते प्रलये समुपस्थिते । अव्यक्तमात्मनः कार्यमादायात्मनि तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: parArddhadvayakAlAnte pralaye samupasthite | avyaktamAtmanaH kAryamAdAyAtmani tiShThati
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, procreation functions through copulation. O leading sages, Brahma too was satisfied.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मन्यवस्थितेऽव्यक्ते विकारे प्रतिसंहृते । साधर्म्येणाधितिष्ठेते प्रधानपुरुषावुभौ
verses.transliteration: Atmanyavasthite.avyakte vikAre pratisaMhR^ite | sAdharmyeNAdhitiShThete pradhAnapuruShAvubhau
verses.translation: Thus the manifestation of Sakti has been narrated to you. It enhances merit. It shall be narrated with the story of creation.
verses.hindi: पूर्वखण्डमें उपमन्युचरितवर्णन नामक पँंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तमः सत्त्वगुणावेतौ समत्वेन व्यवस्थितौ । अनुद्रिक्तावनूनौ तावोतप्रोतौ परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: tamaH sattvaguNAvetau samatvena vyavasthitau | anudriktAvanUnau tAvotaprotau parasparam
verses.translation: He who recites this every day attains merits and obtains worthy sons.

verses.sanskrit: किं तत्प्रथमसम्भूतं केनेदमखिलं ततम् । केन वा पुनरेवेदं ग्रस्यते पृथुकुक्षिणा
verses.transliteration: kiM tatprathamasambhUtaM kenedamakhilaM tatam | kena vA punarevedaM grasyate pR^ithukukShiNA
verses.translation: Securing the great and eternal Sakti from the lord and desiring to initiate the process of procreation by copulation, Brahma became a wondrous man in one half and a woman in one half. From the woman-half was born Satai upa.2®®

verses.sanskrit: गुणसाम्ये तदा तस्मिन्नविभागे तमोदये । शान्तवातैकनीरे च न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: guNasAmye tadA tasminnavibhAge tamodaye | shAntavAtaikanIre cha na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
verses.translation: The man-half created Viraja, • called Svayambhnva Manu, the first creation.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रज्ञाते जगत्यस्मिन्नेक एव महेश्वरः । उपास्य रजनीं कृत्स्नां परां माहेश्वरीं ततः
verses.transliteration: apraj~nAte jagatyasminneka eva maheshvaraH | upAsya rajanIM kR^itsnAM parAM mAheshvarIM tataH
verses.translation: Performing a difficult penance the gentle I§atarup2 got the Manu of bright fame as her husband.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां प्रधानपुरुषावुभौ । प्रविश्य क्षोभयामास मायायोगान्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: prabhAtAyAM tu sharvaryAM pradhAnapuruShAvubhau | pravishya kShobhayAmAsa mAyAyogAnmaheshvaraH
verses.translation: Satarupa bore him two sons, priyavrata and Uttanapada.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् मुनिने उन्हें उत्तम ज्ञान प्रदान किया

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुनरशेषाणां भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययात् । अव्यक्तादभवत्सृष्टिराज्ञया परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: tataH punarasheShANAM bhUtAnAM prabhavApyayAt | avyaktAdabhavatsR^iShTirAj~nayA parameShThinaH
verses.translation: She bore two daughters of great fortune from whom emanates all creation. They were Akuti and Prasuti.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वोत्तरोत्तरविचित्रमनोरथस्य यस्यैकशक्तिशकले सकलः समाप्तः । आत्मानमध्वपतिमध्वविदो वदन्ति तस्मै नमः सकललोकविलक्षणाय
verses.transliteration: vishvottarottaravichitramanorathasya yasyaikashaktishakale sakalaH samAptaH | AtmAnamadhvapatimadhvavido vadanti tasmai namaH sakalalokavilakShaNAya
verses.translation: Lord Manu gave Prasuti to Daksa. Brahma gave Akuti to Ruci.
verses.hindi: स्॒ विष्णोरज्ञनमासाद्य तेनेव सह मोदते॥ २७  आनन्दित होता है

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । शक्तिः प्रथमसम्भूता शान्त्यतीतपदोत्तरा । ततो माया ततोऽव्यक्तं शिवाच्छक्तिमतः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | shaktiH prathamasambhUtA shAntyatItapadottarA | tato mAyA tato.avyaktaM shivAchChaktimataH prabhoH
verses.translation: The mental son Ruci begot of Akuti a son Yajfla and a daughter Daksina. The two make the universe whirl.
verses.hindi: हति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे कुष्णपृत्रप्राप्तिवर्णन॑ नाम प्रथमो ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: शान्त्यतीतपदं शक्तेस्ततः शान्तिपदं क्रमात् । ततो विद्यापदं तस्मात्प्रतिष्ठापदसम्भवः
verses.transliteration: shAntyatItapadaM shaktestataH shAntipadaM kramAt | tato vidyApadaM tasmAtpratiShThApadasambhavaH
verses.translation: Lord Daksa begot of Prasuti, the daughter of Svayambhuva, tweniyfour daughters called the mothers of the world.
verses.hindi: कृष्णपुत्रप्राप्तिवर्णण नामक पहला अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तिपदमुत्पन्नं प्रतिष्ठापदतः क्रमात् । एवमुक्ता समासेन सृष्टिरीश्वरचोदिता
verses.transliteration: nivR^ittipadamutpannaM pratiShThApadataH kramAt | evamuktA samAsena sR^iShTirIshvarachoditA
verses.translation: Lord Dharma took thirteen of his daughters as his wives. They were Sraddha, LaksrnI, Dlirti, Pu?ti, Tuti) Mcdha, Kriya, Buddhi, Lajja, Vapu, Isanti, Siddhi and Kirti the thirteenth. The other eleven were Khyati, Sati, Asambhuti, Smrti, Priti, Ksama, Sannati, Anasuya, Crja, Svaha and Svadha. O sages, the sages Bhrgu, Sarva, Marici, Ahgiras, Pulaha, Kratu, Pulastya, Atri, Vasistha, Pavaka and the Pitfs married them. Thirteen sons beginn¬ ing with Kama and ending with Yasas were begotten by Dharrna of Sraddha and others happy and conducive to happiness. Nikrti and others were begotten of Himsa by Adharma. They bore the traits of Adharma and were con¬ ducive to unhappiness. They had no wives or sons. They practised no virtue.

verses.sanskrit: आनुलोम्यात्तथैतेषां प्रातिलोम्येन संहृतिः । अस्मात्पञ्चपदोद्दिष्टात्परः स्रष्टा समिष्यते
verses.transliteration: AnulomyAttathaiteShAM prAtilomyena saMhR^itiH | asmAtpa~nchapadoddiShTAtparaH sraShTA samiShyate
verses.translation: The Tamasa creation was controlled by Dharma. Daksa*s daughter Sati, wife of Rudra cast off her body as daughter of Daksa in the context of the insult offered to her husband. She rebuked Daksa and Daksa's wife and their kinsmen. She was born as the daughter of Mena and Hiraavat. On seeing Sati how Rudra created many Rudras with lustres similar to his, has already been narrated, Bhrgu begot of Khyati the daughter Lakmi who became the wife of Vi§nu.He begot two sons Dhatr and Vidhatr who became the founders of Manvantara. Their progeny is nume¬ rous, in hundreds and thousands.
verses.hindi: फिर किस प्रकार उनसे मुक्त होते हैं ?

verses.sanskrit: कलाभिः पञ्चभिर्व्याप्तं तस्माद्विश्वमिदं जगत् । अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्तदात्मना समनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: kalAbhiH pa~nchabhirvyAptaM tasmAdvishvamidaM jagat | avyaktaM kAraNaM yattadAtmanA samanuShThitam
verses.translation: The descendants of Bhrgu lived in the Svayam¬ bhuva Manvantara. Sambhuti, son of Marici, gave birth to a son Paurnamasa.
verses.hindi: उनके प्रश्नके अनुसार उत्तर देना आरम्भ किया

verses.sanskrit: महदादिविशेषान्तं सृजतीत्यपि सम्मतम् । किं तु तत्रापि कर्तृत्वं नाव्यक्तस्य न चात्मनः
verses.transliteration: mahadAdivisheShAntaM sR^ijatItyapi sammatam | kiM tu tatrApi kartR^itvaM nAvyaktasya na chAtmanaH
verses.translation: He had four daughters and descendants large in number. In that family was bom Kayapa who had many sons.
verses.hindi: और बोलना आदि कर्म किये जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: अचेतनत्वात्प्रकृतेरज्ञत्वात्पुरुषस्य च । प्रधानपरमाण्वादि यावत्किञ्चिदचेतनम्
verses.transliteration: achetanatvAtprakR^iteraj~natvAtpuruShasya cha | pradhAnaparamANvAdi yAvatki~nchidachetanam
verses.translation: Smrti, wife of Angiras, bore two sons Agnidhra and 8arabha and four daughters. Their prceny continued in thousands. Dantogi was bom as the son of Priti the wife of Pulastya. He was Agastya in the previous birth in the Svayambhuva Manvantara.
verses.hindi: अथवा जड और चेतन--सबकी स्थिति है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Sannati, wife of Kratu, bore him sons who were equal to Kratu. They did not marry and hence were issueless.
verses.hindi: इस तृणको उठानेका उद्योग करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Sannati, wife of Kratu, bore him sons who were equal to Kratu. They did not marry and hence were issueless.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । ब्रह्माण्डस्थितिवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । पुरुषाधिष्ठितात्पूर्वमव्यक्तादीश्वराज्ञया । बुद्ध्यादयो विशेषान्ता विकाराश्चाभवन् क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.10\. dashamo.adhyAyaH | brahmANDasthitivarNanam | vAyuruvAcha | puruShAdhiShThitAtpUrvamavyaktAdIshvarAj~nayA | buddhyAdayo visheShAntA vikArAshchAbhavan kramAt
verses.translation: They were sixty thousand in number and kno%vn as Valakhilyas. They surround the sun and go ahead of his charioteer.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽयमात्मा त्रयस्यास्य प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च । लीलाकृतजगत्सृष्टिरीश्वरत्वे व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: so.ayamAtmA trayasyAsya prakR^iteH puruShasya cha | lIlAkR^itajagatsR^iShTirIshvaratve vyavasthitaH
verses.translation: Atri's wife Anasuya bore five sons the Atreyas and a daughter §ruti, the mother of 8ankhapada.

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वस्मात्परो नित्यो निष्कलः परमेश्वरः । स एव च तदाधारस्तदात्मा तदधिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: yaH sarvasmAtparo nityo niShkalaH parameshvaraH | sa eva cha tadAdhArastadAtmA tadadhiShThitaH
verses.translation: The glorified five Atreyas are Satyanetra, Havya, Apomurti, lanaicara and Soma.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्महेश्वरश्चैव प्रकृतिः पुरुषस्तथा । सदाशिवो भवो विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा सर्वं शिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAnmaheshvarashchaiva prakR^itiH puruShastathA | sadAshivo bhavo viShNurbrahmA sarvaM shivAtmakam
verses.translation: The sons and grandsons of the noble Atreyas are in hundreds and thousands. They lived in the Svfiyambhuva Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानात्प्रथमं जज्ञे बुद्धिः ख्यातिर्मतिर्महान् । महत्तत्त्वस्य सङ्क्षोभादहङ्कारस्त्रिधाऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: pradhAnAtprathamaM jaj~ne buddhiH khyAtirmatirmahAn | mahattattvasya sa~NkShobhAdaha~NkArastridhA.abhavat
verses.translation: Seven sons were born to Vasitha in Orja and a daughter Puncjiariki. They were Rajas, Gatra, Ordhva- bahu, Savana, Anaya, Sutapas and Sukra.

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारश्च भूतानि तन्मात्राणीन्द्रियाणि च । वैकारिकादहङ्कारात्सत्त्वोद्रिक्तात्तु सात्त्विकः
verses.transliteration: aha~NkArashcha bhUtAni tanmAtrANIndriyANi cha | vaikArikAdaha~NkArAtsattvodriktAttu sAttvikaH
verses.translation: Their descendants with the names of Vasiftha were in hundreds and hundred millions all in Svayambhuva Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: वैकारिकः स सर्गस्तु युगपत्सम्प्रवर्तते । बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि पञ्चैव पञ्चकर्मेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.transliteration: vaikArikaH sa sargastu yugapatsampravartate | buddhIndriyANi pa~nchaiva pa~nchakarmendriyANi cha
verses.translation: Svaha, wife of the fire-god the mental son ot Brahma in the form of Rudra, bore thr(!e sons of unmeasured splendour.
verses.hindi: सब बातें तो तुमको स्मरण ही हैं

verses.sanskrit: एकादशं मनस्तत्र स्वगुणेनोभयात्मकम् । तमोयुक्तादहङ्काराद्भूततन्मात्रसम्भवः
