verses.transliteration: ekAdashaM manastatra svaguNenobhayAtmakam | tamoyuktAdaha~NkArAdbhUtatanmAtrasambhavaH
verses.translation: They arc Pavaka, Pavamfina and Suci. Pavamina is the fire kindled by attrition. PSvaka is the fire produced by lightning.
verses.hindi: यह सम्पूर्ण विश्व विस्तारको प्राप्त हुआ है

verses.sanskrit: भूतानामादिभूतत्वाद् भूतादिः कथ्यते तु सः । भूतादेः शब्दमात्रं स्यात्तत्र चाकाशसम्भवः
verses.transliteration: bhUtAnAmAdibhUtatvAd bhUtAdiH kathyate tu saH | bhUtAdeH shabdamAtraM syAttatra chAkAshasambhavaH
verses.translation: The solar fire is called Suci. Their sons in order are:— Havyavaha, Kavyavaha and Saharakas. They are the deities, manes and gods. Their sons and grandsons are fortynine.
verses.hindi: ऐसी वस्तु नहीं है, जो उन मूर्तियोंसे व्याप्त न हो

verses.sanskrit: आकाशात्स्पर्श उत्पन्नः स्पर्शाद्वायुसमुद्भवः । वायो रूपं ततस्तेजस्तेजसो रससम्भवः
verses.transliteration: AkAshAtsparsha utpannaH sparshAdvAyusamudbhavaH | vAyo rUpaM tatastejastejaso rasasambhavaH
verses.translation: They are propitiated in the three rites Kamya, Naimittika and Nitya. They shall be known as saintly observing holy rites.
verses.hindi: ये महादेवजीकी विख्यात पाँच ब्रह्ममूर्तियाँ हैं

verses.sanskrit: रसादापः समुत्पन्नास्ताभ्यो गन्धसमुद्भवः । गन्धाच्च पृथिवी जाता भूतेभ्योऽन्यच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: rasAdApaH samutpannAstAbhyo gandhasamudbhavaH | gandhAchcha pR^ithivI jAtA bhUtebhyo.anyachcharAcharam
verses.translation: O Brahmins, I shall describe the manes now but not in detail. The manes preside over the seasons. Hence the Vedas declare "The seasons are the Pitrs". The mobile and immobile beings are created in the seasons. Hence it is mentioned in the Sruti, "The things produced in the seasons are the Pitrs. "2®® Noble persons derive prosperity from the Pitfs who preside over the seasons. They stand in contact with the clouds. The Pitrs are of two types: Agni§va- ttas and Barhisads.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेभ्यो विकारेभ्यो रुद्रो विष्णुः पितामहः । कारणत्वेन सर्वेषां त्रयो देवाः प्रजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: tatastebhyo vikArebhyo rudro viShNuH pitAmahaH | kAraNatvena sarveShAM trayo devAH prajaj~nire
verses.translation: Householders are also of two types: Non- sacrificcrs, and Sacrificers. Svadha bore the Pitrs two daugh¬ ters: Mena and Dharani who uphold the universe. Mena was the daughter of Agnivattas and Dharani the daughter of Barhisads.
verses.hindi: युक्त बुद्धितत्तको अपना अधिष्ठान बनाती है

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषाधिष्ठितत्वाच्च अव्यक्तानुग्रहेण च । महदादिविशेषान्ता ह्यण्डमुत्पादयन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: puruShAdhiShThitatvAchcha avyaktAnugraheNa cha | mahadAdivisheShAntA hyaNDamutpAdayanti te
verses.translation: Mena, wife of Himavat, gave birth to Mainaka, Kraufica, Ganga and Gauri sanctified by the embrace of $iva*s body.
verses.hindi: वेत्ता विद्वान अहंकारकी अधिष्ठात्री बताते हैं

verses.sanskrit: तत्र कार्यं च करणं संसिद्धं ब्रह्मणो यदा । तदण्डे सुप्रवृद्धोऽभूत् क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्मसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: tatra kAryaM cha karaNaM saMsiddhaM brahmaNo yadA | tadaNDe supravR^iddho.abhUt kShetraj~no brahmasa.nj~nitaH
verses.translation: Dharani, wife of Meru, gave birth to Mandara abounding in divine herbs and beautiful peaks of variegated forms.
verses.hindi: पैर, रूप और अग्नि-तत्त्वकी अधिष्ठात्री बताते हैं

verses.sanskrit: स वै शरीरी प्रथमः स वै पुरुष उच्यते । आदिकर्ता स भूतानां ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तत
verses.transliteration: sa vai sharIrI prathamaH sa vai puruSha uchyate | AdikartA sa bhUtAnAM brahmAgre samavartata
verses.translation: Mandara the glorious son of Meru became the abode of Siva due to the strength of penance.

verses.sanskrit: तस्येश्वरस्याप्रतिमा ज्ञानवैराग्यलक्षणा । धर्मैश्वर्यकरी बुद्धिर्ब्राह्मी यज्ञेऽभिमानिनः
verses.transliteration: tasyeshvarasyApratimA j~nAnavairAgyalakShaNA | dharmaishvaryakarI buddhirbrAhmI yaj~ne.abhimAninaH
verses.translation: Dharani gave birth to three famous daughters yela, Niyati and Ayati.
verses.hindi: है, जैसे सूतमें मनके पिरोये होते हैं

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्ताज्जायते तस्य मनसा यद्यदीप्सितम् । वशीकृतत्वात्त्रैगुण्यात्सापेक्षत्वात्स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: avyaktAjjAyate tasya manasA yadyadIpsitam | vashIkR^itatvAttraiguNyAtsApekShatvAtsvabhAvataH
verses.translation: Ayati and Niyati became the wives of the sons of Bhrgu. I have mentioned to you about their race in Svayambhuva Manvantara.
verses.hindi: महादेव--ये शिवकी विख्यात आठ मूर्तियाँ हैं

verses.sanskrit: त्रिधा विभज्य चात्मानं त्रैलोक्ये सम्प्रवर्त्तते । सृजते ग्रसते चैव वीक्षते च त्रिभिः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tridhA vibhajya chAtmAnaM trailokye sampravarttate | sR^ijate grasate chaiva vIkShate cha tribhiH svayam
verses.translation: Vela bore Sagara the holy daughter Savarna who became the wife of Pracinabarhi?.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्मुखस्तु ब्रह्मत्वे कालत्वे चान्तकः स्मृतः । सहस्रमूर्द्धा पुरुषस्तिस्रोऽवस्थास्स्वयम्भुवः
verses.transliteration: chaturmukhastu brahmatve kAlatve chAntakaH smR^itaH | sahasramUrddhA puruShastisro.avasthAssvayambhuvaH
verses.translation: Samudri bore Pracinabarhis ten sons who were called Pracetasas. They were the masters of the science of archery.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजश्च ब्रह्मत्वे च कालत्वे च तमो रजः । विष्णुत्वे केवलं सत्त्वं गुणवृद्धिस्त्रिधा विभोः
verses.transliteration: sattvaM rajashcha brahmatve cha kAlatve cha tamo rajaH | viShNutve kevalaM sattvaM guNavR^iddhistridhA vibhoH
verses.translation: Dak?a in Svayambhuva Manvantara became the son of the Pracetasas in the Cakusa Manvantara due to the curse of Siva.
verses.hindi: इसलिये साधु पुरुष इसे ' औग्री' कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मत्वे सृजते लोकान् कालत्वे सङ्क्षिपत्यपि । पुरुषत्वेऽत्युदासीनः कर्म च त्रिविधं विभोः
verses.transliteration: brahmatve sR^ijate lokAn kAlatve sa~NkShipatyapi | puruShatve.atyudAsInaH karma cha trividhaM vibhoH
verses.translation: Thus the divine families, attended upon by the devas, of the noblc-souled sons of Brahma, Dharma and others, have been described by me, O Brahmins. They observed holy rites. They had progenies and were embellished by great prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्रिधा विभिन्नत्वाद् ब्रह्मा त्रिगुण उच्यते । चतुर्द्धा प्रविभक्तत्वाच्चातुर्व्यूहः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: evaM tridhA vibhinnatvAd brahmA triguNa uchyate | chaturddhA pravibhaktatvAchchAturvyUhaH prakIrtitaH
verses.translation: This creation born of the Prajapatis cannot be enumerated even in hundreds of crores of years.
verses.hindi: प्रकाशित करती हुई आकाशमें विचरती है

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतो भुवनव्याप्तिशक्तिमव्याहतां क्वचित् । ज्ञानमप्रतिमं शश्वदैश्वर्यं चाणिमादिकम्
verses.transliteration: sarvato bhuvanavyAptishaktimavyAhatAM kvachit | j~nAnamapratimaM shashvadaishvaryaM chANimAdikam
verses.translation: Holy royal families function in two different lines viz. the solar and the lunar.
verses.hindi: करो; क्योंकि रुद्रदेव सबके परम कारण हैं

verses.sanskrit: आदित्वादादिदेवोऽसावजातत्वादजः स्मृतः । पाति यस्मात्प्रजाः सर्वाः प्रजापतिरिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: AditvAdAdidevo.asAvajAtatvAdajaH smR^itaH | pAti yasmAtprajAH sarvAH prajApatiriti smR^itaH
verses.translation: Iksvaku, Ambaria, Yayati, Nahusa and others belong to those families well known and reputed.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्मयस्तु यो मेरुस्तस्योल्बं सुमहात्मनः । गर्भोदकं समुद्राश्च जरायुश्चाऽपि पर्वताः
verses.transliteration: hiraNmayastu yo merustasyolbaM sumahAtmanaH | garbhodakaM samudrAshcha jarAyushchA.api parvatAH
verses.translation: There are several other saintly kings of different exploits. Of what avail is their detailed enuneration.?
verses.hindi: विषयका वर्णन तो भगवान् शिव भी नहीं कर सकते

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नण्डे त्विमे लोका अन्तर्विश्वमिदं जगत् । चन्द्रादित्यौ सनक्षत्रौ सग्रहौ सह वायुना
verses.transliteration: tasminnaNDe tvime lokA antarvishvamidaM jagat | chandrAdityau sanakShatrau sagrahau saha vAyunA
verses.translation: Moreover, in the context of the story of lord 8iva, the eulogy of royal families is not approved of by good men. Thus I do not attempt to speak much.
verses.hindi: ईश्वर या विश्वेश्वर कहे गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिर्दशगुणाभिस्तु बाह्यतोऽण्डं समावृतम् । आपो दशगुणेनैव तेजसा बहिरावृताः
verses.transliteration: adbhirdashaguNAbhistu bAhyato.aNDaM samAvR^itam | Apo dashaguNenaiva tejasA bahirAvR^itAH
verses.translation: Being relevant so far as it implies the greatness of lord 8iva, I have mentioned creation. Enough of those details too.

verses.sanskrit: तेजो दशगुणेनैव वायुना बहिरावृतम् । आकाशेनावृतो वायुः खं च भूतादिनाऽऽवृतम्
verses.transliteration: tejo dashaguNenaiva vAyunA bahirAvR^itam | AkAshenAvR^ito vAyuH khaM cha bhUtAdinA.a.avR^itam
verses.translation: O wind-god, formerly in the Gakfua Manvantara how was Dak$a born due to the curse of Siva? Please narrate.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणी और इन्द्रकी इन्द्राणी कहलाती है

verses.sanskrit: भूतादिर्महता तद्वदव्यक्तेनावृतो महान् । एतैरावरणैरण्डं सप्तभिर्बहिरावृतम्
verses.transliteration: bhUtAdirmahatA tadvadavyaktenAvR^ito mahAn | etairAvaraNairaNDaM saptabhirbahirAvR^itam
verses.translation: Please listen. I shall narrate the activity of the mean Daka resulting in his insult to all gods due to his sinful blunder.

verses.sanskrit: एतदावृत्य चान्योऽन्यमष्टौ प्रकृतयः स्थिताः । सृष्टिपालनविध्वंसकर्मकर्त्र्यो द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: etadAvR^itya chAnyo.anyamaShTau prakR^itayaH sthitAH | sR^iShTipAlanavidhvaMsakarmakartryo dvijottamAH
verses.translation: Once formerly, all the gods, Asuras, Siddhas and the sages went to the summit of Himavat iq order to see the lord.

verses.sanskrit: एवं परस्परोत्पन्ना धारयन्ति परस्परम् । आधाराधेयभावेन विकारास्तु विकारिषु
verses.transliteration: evaM parasparotpannA dhArayanti parasparam | AdhArAdheyabhAvena vikArAstu vikAriShu
verses.translation: O Brahmins, the lord and the goddess were seated on a divine seat as they granted interview to the gods and others.

verses.sanskrit: कूर्मोऽङ्गानि यथा पूर्वं प्रसार्य्य विनियच्छति । विकारांश्च तथाऽव्यक्तं सृष्ट्वा भूयो नियच्छति
verses.transliteration: kUrmo.a~NgAni yathA pUrvaM prasAryya viniyachChati | vikArAMshcha tathA.avyaktaM sR^iShTvA bhUyo niyachChati
verses.translation: At the same time Dak$a too had accompanied the gods in order to see Siva his son-in-law and the goddess his own daughter.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तप्रभवं सर्वमानुलोम्येन जायते । प्राप्ते प्रलयकाले तु प्रातिलोम्येऽनुलीयते
verses.transliteration: avyaktaprabhavaM sarvamAnulomyena jAyate | prApte pralayakAle tu prAtilomye.anulIyate
verses.translation: In view of their dignity, the lord and the Goddess did not give any special preferential treatment to Daksa.
verses.hindi: पूजन, नमन एवं चिन्तन करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टिस्थितिलयाख्येषु कर्मसु त्रिषु हेतुताम् । प्रभुत्वेन सहैतेषां प्रसीदति महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sR^iShTisthitilayAkhyeShu karmasu triShu hetutAm | prabhutvena sahaiteShAM prasIdati maheshvaraH
verses.translation: But deluded that he was, Daksa did not realise the greatness of the lord and the goddess. Thinking her to be his daughter he began to nurse a grudge and hatred against her.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि इनके स्वरूपकी इयत्ता (सीमा) नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: गुणाः कालवशादेव भवन्ति विषमाः समाः । गुणसाम्ये लयो ज्ञेयो वैषम्ये सृष्टिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: guNAH kAlavashAdeva bhavanti viShamAH samAH | guNasAmye layo j~neyo vaiShamye sR^iShTiruchyate
verses.translation: Due to this enmity and further incited by Brahma, Daksa after initiation did not invite them in the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: वर्णन कैसे किया जा सकता है।

verses.sanskrit: तदिदं ब्रह्मणो योनिरेतदण्डं घनं महत् । ब्रह्मणः क्षेत्रमुद्दिष्टं ब्रह्मा क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tadidaM brahmaNo yoniretadaNDaM ghanaM mahat | brahmaNaH kShetramuddiShTaM brahmA kShetraj~na uchyate
verses.translation: He invited the other sons-in-law and honoured them severally.
verses.hindi: दूसरोंकी बुद्धिमें वे आरूढ़ नहीं होते

verses.sanskrit: इतीदृशानामण्डानां कोट्यो ज्ञेयाः सहस्रशः । सर्वगत्वात्प्रधानस्य तिर्य्यगूर्ध्वमधः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: itIdR^ishAnAmaNDAnAM koTyo j~neyAH sahasrashaH | sarvagatvAtpradhAnasya tiryyagUrdhvamadhaH sthitAH
verses.translation: On hearing from Narada that they had assembled there, Sati went to her father's abode after informing Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्र चतुर्वक्त्रा ब्रह्माणो हरयो भवाः । सृष्टा प्रधानेन तथा लब्ध्वा शम्भोस्तु सन्निधिम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tatra chaturvaktrA brahmANo harayo bhavAH | sR^iShTA pradhAnena tathA labdhvA shambhostu sannidhim
verses.translation: She stepped into the aeroplane along with her dear friends. It was a divine plane with doors on all sides; had good conditions; could be easily mounted. It was very charming. It shed golden lustre. It was studded with jewels of various sorts and had a canopy covered with pearls. It was decorated with stringed flower garlands. It had been wrought in molten gold; hundreds of be-jewelled pillars supported it all round. The adamantine steps were neatly built. The columns and festoons were decorated with corals. The chief seat therein was studded with gems and
verses.hindi: हों, उन्हींसे कहना; अन्यथा मौन ही रहना

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरः परोव्यक्तादण्डमव्यक्तसम्भवम् । अण्डाज्जज्ञे विभुर्ब्रह्मा लोकास्तेन कृतास्त्विमे
verses.transliteration: maheshvaraH parovyaktAdaNDamavyaktasambhavam | aNDAjjaj~ne vibhurbrahmA lokAstena kR^itAstvime
verses.translation: Two Rudra virgins held the auspicious chowries and fans beautiful in their handles set with diamonds, and fanned the goddess. In the middle of the chowries the face of the goddess shone like a lotus in the midst of two fighting swans.
verses.hindi: इृति श्रीध्िवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे गौरीशडुरविभूवियोगो हि ्थो ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: अबुद्धिपूर्वः कथितो मयैषः प्रधानसर्गः प्रथमः प्रवृत्तः । आत्यन्तिकश्च प्रलयोऽन्तकाले लीलाकृतः केवलमीश्वरस्य
verses.transliteration: abuddhipUrvaH kathito mayaiShaH pradhAnasargaH prathamaH pravR^ittaH | Atyantikashcha pralayo.antakAle lIlAkR^itaH kevalamIshvarasya
verses.translation: Sumalini held over her head a pearl-stringed umbrella as white as the moon. The splendid umbrella shone above the face of the goddess as the moon's disc above the vessel of nectar.
verses.hindi: विभूतियोग नामक चौथा अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: यत्तत्स्मृतं कारणमप्रमेयं ब्रह्म प्रधानं प्रकृतेः प्रसूतिः । अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्यं शुक्लं सुरक्तं पुरुषेण युक्तम्
verses.transliteration: yattatsmR^itaM kAraNamaprameyaM brahma pradhAnaM prakR^iteH prasUtiH | anAdimadhyAntamanantavIryaM shuklaM suraktaM puruSheNa yuktam
verses.translation: Subhavati of sweet smiling face sat in front of Satl and delighted her by playing at the game of dice. Suyaias held the auspicious sandals of the goddess, studded with gems, in the middle of her breasts and served the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पादकत्वाद्रजसोऽतिरेका ल्लोकस्य सन्तानविवृद्धिहेतून् । अष्टौ विकारानपि चादिकाले सृष्ट्वा समश्नाति तथान्तकाले
verses.transliteration: utpAdakatvAdrajaso.atirekA llokasya santAnavivR^iddhihetUn | aShTau vikArAnapi chAdikAle sR^iShTvA samashnAti tathAntakAle
verses.translation: Another lady held the glistening mirror. Another held the fan. Another held the betelbox. Another held the charming parrot.
verses.hindi: अन्तसे रहित उत्कृष्ट महादेवस्वरूप कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृत्यवस्थापितकारणानां या च स्थितिर्या च पुनः प्रवृत्तिः । तत्सर्वमप्राकृतवैभवस्य सङ्कल्पमात्रेण महेश्वरस्य
verses.transliteration: prakR^ityavasthApitakAraNAnAM yA cha sthitiryA cha punaH pravR^ittiH | tatsarvamaprAkR^itavaibhavasya sa~NkalpamAtreNa maheshvarasya
verses.translation: A certain lady held charming fragrant flowers. Another lotus-eyed lady held the repository of ornaments.
verses.hindi: भिन्‍न समष्टि चैतन्यका नाम परब्रह्म है

verses.sanskrit: कल्पान्तरे पुनस्तेषामस्पर्द्धाबुद्धिमोहिनाम् । सर्गरक्षालयाचारं प्रत्येकं प्रददौ च सः
verses.transliteration: kalpAntare punasteShAmasparddhAbuddhimohinAm | sargarakShAlayAchAraM pratyekaM pradadau cha saH
verses.translation: A certain lady held the unguent, good flowers and the auspicious collyrium. Other ladies did their respec¬ tive duties. They sat around serving her. In their midst the goddess shone like the moon in the Autumn in the midst of a galaxy of stars.
verses.hindi: लोग महेश्वर शिवको विद्याविद्यास्वरूपी कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: एते परस्परोत्पन्ना धारयन्ति परस्परम् । परस्परेण वर्द्धन्ते परस्परमनुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: ete parasparotpannA dhArayanti parasparam | paraspareNa varddhante parasparamanuvratAH
verses.translation: Then after the blowing of the conch the great wardrum was sounded indicating the tirtie of departure. Then hundreds of bugles and sweet-toned instruments sounded with¬ out being beaten (obstructed) along with the sounds of clapping the hands.
verses.hindi: तीन उत्कृष्ट रूप माने गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्ब्रह्मा क्वचिद्विष्णुः क्वचिद् रुद्रः प्रशस्यते । नानेन तेषामाधिक्यमैश्वर्यं चातिरिच्यते
verses.transliteration: kvachidbrahmA kvachidviShNuH kvachid rudraH prashasyate | nAnena teShAmAdhikyamaishvaryaM chAtirichyate
verses.translation: Then eight hundred groups of the thousand strong-

verses.sanskrit: मूर्खा निन्दन्ति तान्वाग्भिः संरम्भाभिनिवेशिनः । यातुधाना भवन्त्येव पिशाचाश्च न संशयः
verses.transliteration: mUrkhA nindanti tAnvAgbhiH saMrambhAbhiniveshinaH | yAtudhAnA bhavantyeva pishAchAshcha na saMshayaH
verses.translation: The divine drums were sounded in heaven. Clouds were divinely pleasing. The sages danced. Siddhas and Yogins rejoiced. Everywhere on the way the clouds in association with the gods and others made showers of flowers above the canopy. The goddess entered her father's house as if in a moment.

verses.sanskrit: देवो गुणत्रयातीतश्चतुर्व्यूहो महेश्वरः । सकलः सकलाधारः शक्तेरुत्पत्तिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: devo guNatrayAtItashchaturvyUho maheshvaraH | sakalaH sakalAdhAraH shakterutpattikAraNam
verses.translation: On seeing her Daka became infuriated which subsequently became the cause of his destruction. He worshipped her younger sisters too in an insulting manner(?)
verses.hindi: गाड़ीके पहियेकी नेमिके समान घूमता रहता है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: O father, the lord at whose bidding everyone from Brahma to the Pi:acas becomes subservient has not been duly worshipped.
verses.hindi: निरक्चननः परममुपेति साम्यम्॥ ३७  समताको. प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: O father, the lord at whose bidding everyone from Brahma to the Pi:acas becomes subservient has not been duly worshipped.
verses.hindi: हति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे पशुपतित्वज्ञानयोगो नाम पञ्ञमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.११. एकादशोऽध्यायः । सृष्ट्यादिवर्णनम् । मुनय ऊचुः । मन्वन्तराणि सर्वाणि कल्पभेदांश्च सर्वशः । तेष्वेवान्तरसर्गं च प्रतिसर्गं च नो वद
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.11\. ekAdasho.adhyAyaH | sR^iShTyAdivarNanam | munaya UchuH | manvantarANi sarvANi kalpabhedAMshcha sarvashaH | teShvevAntarasargaM cha pratisargaM cha no vada
verses.translation: Let that alone. Why did you slight me your eldest daughter in a despicable manner?
verses.hindi: पशुपतित्वज्ञानयोग नामक पाँचवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वकल्पे परावृत्ते प्रवृत्ते कालमारुते । समुन्मूलितमूलेषु वृक्षेषु च वनेषु च
verses.transliteration: pUrvakalpe parAvR^itte pravR^itte kAlamArute | samunmUlitamUleShu vR^ikSheShu cha vaneShu cha
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the infuriated Daksa replied angrily "The younger daughters are better than you. They deserve my special reverence.

verses.sanskrit: जगन्ति तृणवक्त्रीणि देवे दहति पावके । वृष्ट्या भुवि निषिक्तायां विवेलेष्वर्णवेषु च
verses.transliteration: jaganti tR^iNavaktrINi deve dahati pAvake | vR^iShTyA bhuvi niShiktAyAM viveleShvarNaveShu cha
verses.translation: Their husbands evoke my respect and joy, for they are superior to your husband lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: दिक्षु सर्वासु मग्नासु वारिपूरे महीयसि । तदद्भिश्चटुलाक्षेपैस्तरङ्गभुजमण्डलैः
verses.transliteration: dikShu sarvAsu magnAsu vAripUre mahIyasi | tadadbhishchaTulAkShepaistara~NgabhujamaNDalaiH
verses.translation: Thus insulted the infuriated goddess spoke to her father within the hearing of all present there.

verses.sanskrit: प्रारब्धचण्डनृत्येषु ततः प्रलयवारिषु । ब्रह्मा नारायणो भूत्वा सुष्वाप सलिले सुखम्
verses.transliteration: prArabdhachaNDanR^ityeShu tataH pralayavAriShu | brahmA nArAyaNo bhUtvA suShvApa salile sukham
verses.translation: O Dakfa, you insult my husband the lord of the world, whose insult no one has hitherto made.
verses.hindi: ज़िवतत्त्ववर्णन नामक छठाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: इमं चोदाहरन्मन्त्रं श्लोकं नारायणं प्रति । तं शृणुध्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तदर्थं चाक्षराश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: imaM chodAharanmantraM shlokaM nArAyaNaM prati | taM shR^iNudhvaM munishreShThAstadarthaM chAkSharAshrayam
verses.translation: The Sruti says that these are great sinners — viz. a stealer of learning, a traitor to the preceptor and an insulter of the Vedas and of the god. They deserve to be punished.
verses.hindi: होकर भी अनेक रूपमें प्रकाशित होती है

verses.sanskrit: आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नरसूनवः । अयनं तस्य ता यस्मात्तेन नारायणः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: Apo nArA iti proktA Apo vai narasUnavaH | ayanaM tasya tA yasmAttena nArAyaNaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Therefore a terrible punishment befitting the great sin shall be meted out to you by divine intercession.

verses.sanskrit: शिवयोगमयीं निद्रां कुर्वन्तं त्रिदशेश्वरम् । बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः सिद्धा जनलोकनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: shivayogamayIM nidrAM kurvantaM tridasheshvaram | baddhA~njalipuTAH siddhA janalokanivAsinaH
verses.translation: Since the lord of gods has not been worshipped by you, know that your family is defiled and ruined.

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रैः प्रबोधयामासुः प्रभातसमये सुराः । यथा सृष्ट्यादिसमये ईश्वरं श्रुतयः पुरा
verses.transliteration: stotraiH prabodhayAmAsuH prabhAtasamaye surAH | yathA sR^iShTyAdisamaye IshvaraM shrutayaH purA
verses.translation: After saying thus to her father Sati abandoned her body and without fear went to mountain Himavat.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रबुद्ध उत्थाय शयनात्तोयमध्यगात् । उदैक्षत दिशः सर्वा योगनिद्रालसेक्षणः
verses.transliteration: tataH prabuddha utthAya shayanAttoyamadhyagAt | udaikShata dishaH sarvA yoganidrAlasekShaNaH
verses.translation: The glorious leader of mountains attained the fruit of his merits. It was for her that he had performed penance for a long time.
verses.hindi: भी उनकी कृपासे मुक्त हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: नापश्यत्स तदा किञ्चित्स्वात्मनो व्यतिरेकि यत् । सविस्मय इवासीनः परां चिन्तामुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: nApashyatsa tadA ki~nchitsvAtmano vyatireki yat | savismaya ivAsInaH parAM chintAmupAgamat
verses.translation: The goddess blessed the lord of mountains. Through her Yogic Maya and at her own will, she made him her father.
verses.hindi: मुक्त हो जाते हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । कालसङ्ख्याविवृत्तस्य परार्द्धो ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः । तावांश्चैवास्य कालोऽन्यस्तस्यान्ते प्रतिसृज्यते
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | kAlasa~NkhyAvivR^ittasya parArddho brahmaNaH smR^itaH | tAvAMshchaivAsya kAlo.anyastasyAnte pratisR^ijyate
verses.translation: When Sati rebuked Dak$a and went away, the frightened and agitated Mantras too vanished. The sacrifice became hindered.

verses.sanskrit: क्व सा भगवती या तु मनोज्ञा महती मही । नानाविधमहाशैलनदीनगरकानना
verses.transliteration: kva sA bhagavatI yA tu manoj~nA mahatI mahI | nAnAvidhamahAshailanadInagarakAnanA
verses.translation: On hearing about the departure of the goddess, Siva was angry with Daksa and the sages and cursed them.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सञ्चिन्तयन्ब्रह्मा बुबुधे नैव भूस्थितिम् । तदा सस्मार पितरं भगवन्तं त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: evaM sa~nchintayanbrahmA bubudhe naiva bhUsthitim | tadA sasmAra pitaraM bhagavantaM trilochanam
verses.translation: O Daksa, since for my sake the sinless Sati had been dishonoured and the other daughters worshipped along with their husbands, these sons-in-law of yours will be born but not of a womb in the sacrifices of Brahma in the Vaivasvata Manvantara. In the Gakusa Manvantara you will become a king as the grandson of Pracinabarhi? and the son of Pracetas.

verses.sanskrit: स्मरणाद्देवदेवस्य भवस्यामिततेजसः । ज्ञातवान्सलिले मग्नां धरणीं धरणीपतिः
verses.transliteration: smaraNAddevadevasya bhavasyAmitatejasaH | j~nAtavAnsalile magnAM dharaNIM dharaNIpatiH
verses.translation: O wicked one, there also I shall put up obstacles before you in all activities regarding virtue, wealth and love.

verses.sanskrit: ततो भूमेः समुद्धारं कर्तुकामः प्रजापतिः । जलक्रीडोचितं दिव्यं वाराहं रूपमस्मरत्
verses.transliteration: tato bhUmeH samuddhAraM kartukAmaH prajApatiH | jalakrIDochitaM divyaM vArAhaM rUpamasmarat
verses.translation: Thus addressed by Rudra of unmeasured splen¬ dour, Daksa abandoned the body and fell on the ground.
verses.hindi: ज़िवतत्त्वकथन नामक सातवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: महापर्वतवर्ष्माणं महाजलदनिःस्वनम् । नीलमेघप्रतीकाशं दीप्तशब्दं भयानकम्
verses.transliteration: mahAparvatavarShmANaM mahAjaladaniHsvanam | nIlameghapratIkAshaM dIptashabdaM bhayAnakam
verses.translation: Bhrgu and others were born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara in the sacrifice of Brahma bearing the bodies of Varuna.
verses.hindi: मुनीश्वर ! ये सब बातें विस्तारपूर्वक बताइये

verses.sanskrit: पीनवृत्तघनस्कन्धं पीनोन्नतकटीतटम् । ह्रस्ववृत्तोरुजङ्घाग्रं सुतीक्ष्णखुरमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: pInavR^ittaghanaskandhaM pInonnatakaTItaTam | hrasvavR^ittoruja~NghAgraM sutIkShNakhuramaNDalam
verses.translation: Then in the Vaivasvata Manvantara in the virtuous sacrifice of the wicked Daksa the lord created obstacles

verses.sanskrit: पद्मरागमणिप्रख्यं वृत्तभीषणलोचनम् । वृत्तदीर्घमहागात्रं स्तब्धकर्णस्थलोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: padmarAgamaNiprakhyaM vR^ittabhIShaNalochanam | vR^ittadIrghamahAgAtraM stabdhakarNasthalojjvalam
verses.translation: When Himavat was delighted by becoming the father of the mother of the universe by the strength of his penance, when Siva married her and sported with her in his abode on the peak of Himavat when a long time elapsed, in the Vaivasvata Manvantara Daka as the son of Pracetas wanted to perform a horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: उदीर्णोच्छ्वासनिःश्वासघूर्णितप्रलयार्णवम् । विस्फुरत्सुसटाच्छन्नकपोलस्कन्धबन्धुरम्
verses.transliteration: udIrNochChvAsaniHshvAsaghUrNitapralayArNavam | visphuratsusaTAchChannakapolaskandhabandhuram
verses.translation: On the top of Himavat in an auspicious spot at the source of Ganga, frequented by the sages and the Siddhas Dak began his sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: मणिभिर्भूषणैश्चित्रैर्महारत्नैः परिष्कृतम् । विराजमानं विद्युद्भिर्मेघसङ्घमिवोन्नतम्
verses.transliteration: maNibhirbhUShaNaishchitrairmahAratnaiH pariShkR^itam | virAjamAnaM vidyudbhirmeghasa~Nghamivonnatam
verses.translation: All the gods Indra and others gathered there and thought of going to attend the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: आस्थाय विपुलं रूपं वाराहममितं विधिः । पृथिव्युद्धरणार्थाय प्रविवेश रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: AsthAya vipulaM rUpaM vArAhamamitaM vidhiH | pR^ithivyuddharaNArthAya pravivesha rasAtalam
verses.translation: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, SMhyas, Maruts, Ofmapas, Somapas, Ajyapas, Dhumapas, Alvins, Pitrs, and the other sages came there along with Viu to take part in the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: भगवान् रुद्र वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: दिवसे दिवसे तस्य ब्रह्मणः पूर्वजन्मनः । चतुर्दश महाभागा मनूनां परिवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: divase divase tasya brahmaNaH pUrvajanmanaH | chaturdasha mahAbhAgA manUnAM parivR^ittayaH
verses.translation: On seeing all the gods assembled there without Siva, Dadhica became angry. He spoke to Dak$a thus.

verses.sanskrit: स तदा शुशुभेऽतीव सूकरो गिरिसन्निभः । लिङ्गाकृतेर्महेशस्य पादमूलं गतो यथा
verses.transliteration: sa tadA shushubhe.atIva sUkaro girisannibhaH | li~NgAkR^itermaheshasya pAdamUlaM gato yathA
verses.translation: Indeed that man incurs great sin who docs not worship those who deserve worship and worships those who do not befit it.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स सलिले मग्नां पृथिवीं पृथिवीन्धरः । उद्धृत्यालिङ्ग्य दंष्ट्राभ्यामुन्ममज्ज रसातलात्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa salile magnAM pR^ithivIM pR^ithivIndharaH | uddhR^ityAli~Ngya daMShTrAbhyAmunmamajja rasAtalAt
verses.translation: After saying this the sage spoke again to Daka

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सिद्धा जनलोकनिवासिनः । मुमुदुर्ननृतुर्मूर्ध्नि तस्य पुष्पैरवाकिरन्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA munayaH siddhA janalokanivAsinaH | mumudurnanR^iturmUrdhni tasya puShpairavAkiran
verses.translation: I see eleven Rudras armed with tridents and having matted hair. I do not know anyone else as the lord.
verses.hindi: महेश्वरी शिवाने पतिदेवसे उसके विषयमें पूछा

verses.sanskrit: वपुर्महावराहस्य शुशुभे पुष्पसंवृतम् । पतद्भिरिव खद्योतैः प्राशुरञ्जनपर्वतः
verses.transliteration: vapurmahAvarAhasya shushubhe puShpasaMvR^itam | patadbhiriva khadyotaiH prAshura~njanaparvataH
verses.translation: What avails worshipping the gods in the sacrifice if the king of sacrifice, Rudra, is not worshipped by you?
verses.hindi: शिष्यास्तेषां प्रशिष्याश्ष शतशो3थ सहस्रशः॥ ५०  « प्रशिष्य हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ततः संस्थानमानीय वराहो महतीं महीम् । स्वमेव रूपमास्थाय स्थापयामास वै विभुः
verses.transliteration: tataH saMsthAnamAnIya varAho mahatIM mahIm | svameva rUpamAsthAya sthApayAmAsa vai vibhuH
verses.translation: I offer this Caru in the golden vessel, sanctified by mantras, after assigning the share to Vi§nu the lord of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: भाग्यवन्तो विमुच्यन्ते भक्त्या चात्यन्नभाविता: ॥ ५१  भावित हो भाग्यवान् पुरुष मुक्त हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीं च समीकृत्य पृथिव्यां स्थापयन् गिरीन् । भूराद्यांश्चतुरो लोकान् कल्पयामास पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: pR^ithivIM cha samIkR^itya pR^ithivyAM sthApayan girIn | bhUrAdyAMshchaturo lokAn kalpayAmAsa pUrvavat
verses.translation: "O Daka, since Rudra the lord of the chief of the gods is not propitiated your sacrifice will not be efficacious."
verses.hindi: जति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयरसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवतत्तवज्ञाने व्यासावतारवर्णन नामाष्टमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: इति सह महतीं महीं महीध्रैः प्रलयमहाजलधेरधःस्थमध्यात् । उपरि च विनिवेश्य विश्वकर्मा चरमचरं च जगत्ससर्ज भूयः
verses.transliteration: iti saha mahatIM mahIM mahIdhraiH pralayamahAjaladheradhaHsthamadhyAt | upari cha viniveshya vishvakarmA charamacharaM cha jagatsasarja bhUyaH
verses.translation: After saying this, the infuriated sage Dadhica left
verses.hindi: प्रसंगमें व्यासावतारवर्णन नामक आठवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अनादित्वादनन्तत्वादज्ञेयत्वाच्च कृत्स्नशः । मन्वन्तराणि कल्पाश्च न शक्या वचनात्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: anAditvAdanantatvAdaj~neyatvAchcha kR^itsnashaH | manvantarANi kalpAshcha na shakyA vachanAtpR^ithak
verses.translation: Even when the sage walked out, the gods did not leave Daksa in view of the inevitability of the disaster that was to take place.

verses.sanskrit: उक्तेष्वपि च सर्वेषु शृण्वतां वो वचो मम । किमिहास्ति फलं तस्मान्न पृथग वक्तुमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration: ukteShvapi cha sarveShu shR^iNvatAM vo vacho mama | kimihAsti phalaM tasmAnna pR^ithaga vaktumutsahe
verses.translation: O brahmins, in the meantime knowing about all this from Siva the goddess urged the lord to destroy the sacri¬ fice of Dak?a.
verses.hindi: स याति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥ २८  करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: य एव खलु कल्पेषु कल्पः सम्प्रति वर्तते । तत्र सङ्क्षिप्य वर्तन्ते सृष्टयः प्रतिसृष्टयः
verses.transliteration: ya eva khalu kalpeShu kalpaH samprati vartate | tatra sa~NkShipya vartante sR^iShTayaH pratisR^iShTayaH
verses.translation: Urged by the goddess the lord created the heroic Virabhadra the chief of Ganas, intending to destroy the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीजिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवस्य योगावतारवर्णन॑ नाम नवमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वयं वर्तते कल्पो वाराहो नाम नामतः । अस्मिन्नपि द्विजश्रेष्ठा मनवस्तु चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: yastvayaM vartate kalpo vArAho nAma nAmataH | asminnapi dvijashreShThA manavastu chaturdasha
verses.translation: He had a thousand faces, a thousand lotus-like eyes. He was holding a thousand iron clubs, thousands of arrows, spear, axe, mace, bow, discus and the thunderbolt. He looked fierce and terrible. The crescent moon adorned his crest; the thunderbolt illuminated his hands. His hair shone like lightning. He had a huge mouth terrible with the curved fangs and a huge belly. His tongue was like lightnings His lips hung down. His voice sounded like the cloud and th. ocean. He wore the tiger's hide dripping with blood. He car-rings formed circles close to his cheeks. He had adorned his crest with the garlands from the heads of leading gods. He was bedecked in golden shoulderlets and jingling anklets. He was shining with heaps of gems. His chest was covered by necklaces. He was equal in exploit to the great fabulous animal Sarabha, tigers and lions. His gait was gentle and majestic as that of a stately elephant in lut. His lustre was white like conch, cliowrie, Kunda flower, moon and the lotus-stalk. He was.like the snow-capped lord of mountains who had become mobile. Flames surrounded him. Wearing pearl ornaments he shone brilliantly as the fire at the dissolu¬ tion of the world.
verses.hindi: योगावतारवर्णन नामक नौवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवादयः सप्त सप्त सावर्णिकादयः । तेषु वैवस्वतो नाम सप्तमो वर्तते मनुः
verses.transliteration: svAyambhuvAdayaH sapta sapta sAvarNikAdayaH | teShu vaivasvato nAma saptamo vartate manuH
verses.translation: That chief of Ganas knelt and bowed. With palms joined in reverence he stood beside the lord of gods.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु सर्गसंहारवृत्तयः । प्रायः समा भवन्तीति तर्कः कार्यो विजानता
verses.transliteration: manvantareShu sarveShu sargasaMhAravR^ittayaH | prAyaH samA bhavantIti tarkaH kAryo vijAnatA
verses.translation: With his anger he created Bhadra the goddess Kali as a witness of his activities and his companion.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He submitted to the lord in the company of the goddess. "Please command what task shall I carry out?"

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He submitted to the lord in the company of the goddess. "Please command what task shall I carry out?"

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१२. द्वादशोऽध्यायः । सृष्टिवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । सर्गं चिन्तयतस्तस्य तदा वै बुद्धिपूर्वकम् । प्रध्यानकाले मोहस्तु प्रादुर्भूतस्तमोमयः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.12\. dvAdasho.adhyAyaH | sR^iShTivarNanam | vAyuruvAcha | sargaM chintayatastasya tadA vai buddhipUrvakam | pradhyAnakAle mohastu prAdurbhUtastamomayaH
verses.translation: Then with a desire to please Parvatl, Siva spoke to the huge-armed Virabhadra in raised sound.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभिध्यायतोऽव्यक्तादर्वाक्स्रोतस्तु साधकः । मनुष्यनामा सञ्जातः सर्गो दुःखसमुत्कटः
verses.transliteration: tato.abhidhyAyato.avyaktAdarvAksrotastu sAdhakaH | manuShyanAmA sa~njAtaH sargo duHkhasamutkaTaH
verses.translation: O chief of Ganas, accompanied by Bhadrakali, destroy the sacrifice of Daksa the son of Pracetas.
verses.hindi: नाम हैं--ज्ञान, क्रिया, चर्या और योग

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशा बहिरन्तस्ते तमोद्रिक्ता रजोऽधिकाः । पञ्चमोऽनुग्रहः सर्गश्चतुर्धा संव्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: prakAshA bahirantaste tamodriktA rajo.adhikAH | pa~nchamo.anugrahaH sargashchaturdhA saMvyavasthitaH
verses.translation: O chief of Ganas, I shall witness your exploit staying near Raibhya's*" hermitage along with the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: विपर्य्येण शक्त्या च तुष्ट्या सिद्ध्या तथैव च । तेऽपरिग्राहिणः सर्वे संविभागरताः पुनः
verses.transliteration: viparyyeNa shaktyA cha tuShTyA siddhyA tathaiva cha | te.aparigrAhiNaH sarve saMvibhAgaratAH punaH
verses.translation: In the place Kanakhala there are huge trees near Gahgadvara«« resembling the mountain with the golden peaks like Meru* and Mandara.**® Daksa is holding sacrifice there. Immediately create obstacles in that sacrifice too. Do not delay.

verses.sanskrit: खादनाश्चाप्यशीलाश्च भूताद्याः परिकीर्तिताः । प्रथमो महतः सर्गो ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: khAdanAshchApyashIlAshcha bhUtAdyAH parikIrtitAH | prathamo mahataH sargo brahmaNaH parameShThinaH
verses.translation: When this was mentioned by the lord, the goddess, daughter of Himavat looked at Virabhadra and Bhadrakal! as does a cow at her calf Embracing him and sniffing at his head as at the head of Subrahmanya-** she smiled and spoke in sweet voic'*

verses.sanskrit: तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयस्तु भूतसर्गः स उच्यते । वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु सर्ग ऐन्द्रियकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tanmAtrANAM dvitIyastu bhUtasargaH sa uchyate | vaikArikastR^itIyastu sarga aindriyakaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: O dear Bhadra, O blessed one, of great strength and exploit, you are born to carry out the task that pleases me. Wipe off my anger and sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष प्रकृतेः सर्गः सम्भृतोऽबुद्धिपूर्वकः । मुख्यसर्गश्चतुर्थस्तु मुख्या वै स्थावराः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ityeSha prakR^iteH sargaH sambhR^ito.abuddhipUrvakaH | mukhyasargashchaturthastu mukhyA vai sthAvarAH smR^itAH
verses.translation: At my bidding O dear, inflict violence in the company of Bhadra. Kill the sacrificer. Let the holy sacrifice be turned into non-sacrifice.
verses.hindi: दूसरी किसी वस्तुके अर्थकों समझना नहीं

verses.sanskrit: तिर्य्यक्स्रोतस्तु यः प्रोक्तस्तिर्यग्योनिः स पञ्चमः । तदूर्ध्वस्रोतसः षष्ठो देवसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tiryyaksrotastu yaH proktastiryagyoniH sa pa~nchamaH | tadUrdhvasrotasaH ShaShTho devasargastu sa smR^itaH
verses.translation: At the behest of Siva and Siva of wonderful activities, with bent head, as if it was their blessing, Bhadra bowed to them and left.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽर्वाक् स्रोतसां सर्गः सप्तमः स तु मानुषः । अष्टमोऽनुग्रहः सर्गः कौमारो नवमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tato.arvAk srotasAM sargaH saptamaH sa tu mAnuShaH | aShTamo.anugrahaH sargaH kaumAro navamaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: The infuriated lord Virabhadra, fond of crema¬ tion ground, created from his skin-pores chiefs of Ganas, and from his right hand hundred crores others.

verses.sanskrit: प्राकृताश्च त्रयः पूर्वे सर्गास्तेऽबुद्धिपूर्वकाः । बुद्धिपूर्वं प्रवर्त्तन्ते मुख्याद्याः पञ्च वैकृताः
verses.transliteration: prAkR^itAshcha trayaH pUrve sargAste.abuddhipUrvakAH | buddhipUrvaM pravarttante mukhyAdyAH pa~ncha vaikR^itAH
verses.translation: See PP. 3 lO note, 693 note. *
verses.hindi: चाहने लगे हों, वे भक्त भी मुझे प्रिय हैं

verses.sanskrit: अग्रे ससर्ज वै ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान् । सनन्दं सनकं चैव विद्वांसञ्च सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: agre sasarja vai brahmA mAnasAnAtmanaH samAn | sanandaM sanakaM chaiva vidvAMsa~ncha sanAtanam
verses.translation: Then the universe with all its open spaces and crevices was covered with the chiefs of ganas equal in exploit to Bhadra.

verses.sanskrit: तमोमोहो महामोहस्तामिस्रश्चान्धसंज्ञितः । अविद्या पञ्चमी चैषा प्रादुर्भूता महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tamomoho mahAmohastAmisrashchAndhasa.nj~nitaH | avidyA pa~nchamI chaiShA prAdurbhUtA mahAtmanaH
verses.translation: These had thousand hands holding thousands of weapons and had the lustre of Rudra.
verses.hindi: अष्टधा लक्षण प्राह बताये गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च पूर्वमेव प्रजापतिः । सर्वे ते योगिनो ज्ञेया वीतरागा विमत्सराः
verses.transliteration: R^ibhuM sanatkumAraM cha pUrvameva prajApatiH | sarve te yogino j~neyA vItarAgA vimatsarAH
verses.translation: They had spears, tridents and maces, axes, stones and rocks. They resembled deadly fire and Rudra. They had three eyes and matted hair.
verses.hindi: तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति॥ ७२  कभी ओझल नहीं होता है

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरासक्तमनसो न चक्रुः सृष्टये मतिम् । तेषु सृष्ट्यनपेक्षेषु गतेषु सनकादिषु
verses.transliteration: IshvarAsaktamanaso na chakruH sR^iShTaye matim | teShu sR^iShTyanapekSheShu gateShu sanakAdiShu
verses.translation: They flew in hundreds and seated on lions roared loudly like clouds.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तखण्डे शिवभक्तिवर्णं नाम दशमोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: स्रष्टुकामः पुनर्ब्रह्मा तताप परमं तपः । तस्यैवं तप्यमानस्य न किञ्चित्समवर्त्तत
verses.transliteration: sraShTukAmaH punarbrahmA tatApa paramaM tapaH | tasyaivaM tapyamAnasya na ki~nchitsamavarttata
verses.translation: Lord Bhadra surrounded by the Bhadras shone like Kalabhairava surrounded by hundreds of deadly fires at the time of dissolution.
verses.hindi: शिवभक्तिवर्णन नामक दसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुःखात्क्रोधो व्यजायत । क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रुबिन्दवः
verses.transliteration: tato dIrgheNa kAlena duHkhAtkrodho vyajAyata | krodhAviShTasya netrAbhyAM prApatannashrubindavaH
verses.translation: In their midst, mounted on a lordly bull and with a bull-emblem, lord Bhadra went ahead like Siva seated on Nandin.
verses.hindi: विदुषां द्विजमुख्यानां वर्णधर्मसमासत:॥ १  संक्षेपसे वर्णधर्मका वर्णन करता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेभ्योऽश्रुबिन्दुभ्यो भूताः प्रेतास्तदाभवन् । सर्वांस्तानश्रुजान्दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मात्मानमनिन्दत
verses.transliteration: tatastebhyo.ashrubindubhyo bhUtAH pretAstadAbhavan | sarvAMstAnashrujAndR^iShTvA brahmAtmAnamanindata
verses.translation: Bhasita shone by the side of Bhadra like the lord of mountains by the side of Siva.
verses.hindi: लिप्त नहीं होते, जैसे जलसे कमलका पत्ता

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तीव्राऽभवन्मूर्छा क्रोधामर्षसमुद्भवा । मूर्च्छितस्तु जहौ प्राणान्क्रोधाविष्टः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tasya tIvrA.abhavanmUrChA krodhAmarShasamudbhavA | mUrchChitastu jahau prANAnkrodhAviShTaH prajApatiH
verses.translation: Bhadra too shone in his company as he held the white chowries like the lord with the trident weapon and the crescent moon.
verses.hindi: वैसे ही उनके लिये भी नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राणेश्वरो रुद्रो भगवान्नीललोहितः । प्रसादमतुलं कर्त्तुं प्रादुरासीत्प्रभोर्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: tataH prANeshvaro rudro bhagavAnnIlalohitaH | prasAdamatulaM karttuM prAdurAsItprabhormukhAt
verses.translation: Bhanukampa of great splendour bedecked in gold and jewels blew on the auspicious white conch Bhadra in front of Bhadra.
verses.hindi: समझना चाहिए; इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: दशधा चैकधा चक्रे स्वात्मानं प्रभुरीश्वरः । ते तेनोक्ता महात्मानो दशधा चैकधा कृताः
verses.transliteration: dashadhA chaikadhA chakre svAtmAnaM prabhurIshvaraH | te tenoktA mahAtmAno dashadhA chaikadhA kR^itAH
verses.translation: The divine drums were sounded with divine tumultuous tone. The clouds in hundreds made showers of flowers on his head.
verses.hindi: र ्टटकको ज्ञानसारार्थसं ग्रह: ॥ सारभूत अर्थका संग्रह प्रकट किया है

verses.sanskrit: यूयं सृष्टा मया वत्सा लोकानुग्रहकारणात् । तस्मात्सर्वस्य लोकस्य स्थापनाय हिताय च
verses.transliteration: yUyaM sR^iShTA mayA vatsA lokAnugrahakAraNAt | tasmAtsarvasya lokasya sthApanAya hitAya cha
verses.translation: Winds taking up the fragrance of full blown flowers pregnant with honey blew favourbly on their way.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजासन्तानहेतोश्च प्रयतध्वमतन्द्रिताः । एवमुक्ताश्च रुरुदुर्दुद्रुवुश्च समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: prajAsantAnahetoshcha prayatadhvamatandritAH | evamuktAshcha rurudurdudruvushcha samantataH
verses.translation: Then the elated chiefs proud of their strength danced, rejoiced, cried, laughed, spoke and sang.
verses.hindi: हि श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयरसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवज्ञानवर्णन॑ नामैकादशोध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चधाऽवस्थितः सर्गो ध्यायतस्त्वभिमानिनः । सर्वतस्तमसातीव बीजकुम्भवदावृतः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchadhA.avasthitaH sargo dhyAyatastvabhimAninaH | sarvatastamasAtIva bIjakumbhavadAvR^itaH
verses.translation: Then Bhadra stationed in the midst of the Bhadra- ganas in the company of Bhadra shone like Siva in the. midst of Rudraganas in the company of Parvatl.
verses.hindi: शिवज्ञानवर्णन नामक ग्यारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: रोदनाद् द्रावणाच्चैव ते रुद्रा नामतः स्मृताः । येरुद्रास्ते खलु प्राणा ये प्राणास्ते महात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: rodanAd drAvaNAchchaiva te rudrA nAmataH smR^itAH | yerudrAste khalu prANA ye prANAste mahAtmakAH
verses.translation: In a moment the strong \rabhadra with his
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण अर्थका साधक कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: ततो मृतस्य देवस्य ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः । घृणी ददौ पुनः प्राणान् ब्रह्मपुत्रो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tato mR^itasya devasya brahmaNaH parameShThinaH | ghR^iNI dadau punaH prANAn brahmaputro maheshvaraH
verses.translation: Then the chief of Ganas Bhadra entered like Rudra desirous of burning the worlds at the time of dissolution.

verses.sanskrit: प्रहृष्टवदनो रुद्रः प्राणप्रत्यागमाद्विभोः । अभ्यभाषत विश्वेशो ब्रह्माणं परमं वचः
verses.transliteration: prahR^iShTavadano rudraH prANapratyAgamAdvibhoH | abhyabhAShata vishvesho brahmANaM paramaM vachaH
verses.translation: Then he saw the great Satra of the gods of great splendour the chief of whom was Visnu. The satra had all the paraphernalia — the flags of various colours etc.

verses.sanskrit: मा भैर्माभैर्महाभाग विरिञ्चे जगतां गुरो । मया ते प्राणिताः प्राणाः सुखमुत्तिष्ठ सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: mA bhairmAbhairmahAbhAga viri~nche jagatAM guro | mayA te prANitAH prANAH sukhamuttiShTha suvrata
verses.translation: The rites were performed neatly in accordance with the rules found in the Vedas by the sages who were experts in sacrifices and who performed the rites properly,

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्नानुभूतमिव तच्छ्रुत्वा वाक्यं मनोहरम् । हरं निरीक्ष्य शनकैर्नेत्रैः फुल्लाम्बुजप्रभैः
verses.transliteration: svapnAnubhUtamiva tachChrutvA vAkyaM manoharam | haraM nirIkShya shanakairnetraiH phullAmbujaprabhaiH
verses.translation: Thousands of celestial damsels were there. The Satra was attended by the Apsaras. The sweet sound of flutes and lutes spread and was enhanced by the sound of Vedic hymns.
verses.hindi: बचनोंपर श्रद्धा न करनेवाला पुरुष नरकमें जाता है

verses.sanskrit: तथा प्रत्यागतप्राणः स्निग्धगम्भीरया गिरा । उवाच वचनं ब्रह्मा तमुद्दिश्य कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: tathA pratyAgataprANaH snigdhagambhIrayA girA | uvAcha vachanaM brahmA tamuddishya kR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: On seeing all this, the heroic Virabhadra of great exploits roared like a lion or a majestic rumbling cloud.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि दर्शनमात्रेण चानन्दयसि मे मनः । को भवान् विश्वमूर्त्या वा स्थित एकादशात्मकः
verses.transliteration: tvaM hi darshanamAtreNa chAnandayasi me manaH | ko bhavAn vishvamUrtyA vA sthita ekAdashAtmakaH
verses.translation: Then a hurrah of joy, filling the sky and superseding the sound of the ocean was produced by the lords of ganas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा व्याजहार महेश्वरः । स्पृशन् कराभ्यां ब्रह्माणं सुसुखाभ्यां सुरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA vyAjahAra maheshvaraH | spR^ishan karAbhyAM brahmANaM susukhAbhyAM sureshvaraH
verses.translation: Overwhelmed by the great sound the frightened heaven-dwellers ran helter-skelter dropping their garments and ornaments.
verses.hindi: समान कहीं कोई दूसरा मन्त्र नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: मां विद्धि परमात्मानं तव पुत्रत्वमागतम् । एते चैकादश रुद्रास्त्वां सुरक्षितुमागताः
verses.transliteration: mAM viddhi paramAtmAnaM tava putratvamAgatam | ete chaikAdasha rudrAstvAM surakShitumAgatAH
verses.translation: "Has the great Meru been burst? Is the earth pierced through? What is this?" the gods# began to scream and shout.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तीव्रामिमां मूर्च्छां विधूय मदनुग्रहात् । प्रबुद्धस्व यथापूर्वं प्रजा वै स्रष्टुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tasmAttIvrAmimAM mUrchChAM vidhUya madanugrahAt | prabuddhasva yathApUrvaM prajA vai sraShTumarhasi
verses.translation: Some abandoned their lives due to fear like lordly elephants in a thick forest on hearing the roar of the lion.
verses.hindi: हिताय सर्वमर्त्यानां द्विजानां तु विशेषत:॥ ३८  द्विजोंक हितके लिये इसे कहा था

verses.sanskrit: बहिरन्तश्चाप्रकाशः स्तब्धो निःसंज्ञ एव च । तस्मात्तेषां वृता बुद्धिर्मुखानि करणानि च
verses.transliteration: bahirantashchAprakAshaH stabdho niHsa.nj~na eva cha | tasmAtteShAM vR^itA buddhirmukhAni karaNAni cha
verses.translation: Mountains crumbled. The earth quaked. Winds rolled and reeled. The ocean was agitated.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्योां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे पंचाक्षरमाहात्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम द्वादशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: एवं भगवता प्रोक्तो ब्रह्मा प्रीतमना ह्यभूत् । नामाष्टकेन विश्वात्मा तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evaM bhagavatA prokto brahmA prItamanA hyabhUt | nAmAShTakena vishvAtmA tuShTAva parameshvaram
verses.translation: In the meantime lord Bhadra in the company of Bhadras and the goddess Bhadra reached the brilliant sacri¬ ficial altar.
verses.hindi: पंचाक्षरमाहात्म्यवर्णन नामक बारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । नमस्ते भगवन् रुद्र भास्करामिततेजसे । नमो भवाय देवाय रसायाम्बुमयात्मने । शर्वाय क्षितिरूपाय सदासुरभये नमः
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | namaste bhagavan rudra bhAskarAmitatejase | namo bhavAya devAya rasAyAmbumayAtmane | sharvAya kShitirUpAya sadAsurabhaye namaH
verses.translation: On seeing him, Daksa stood steady and firm though he was frightened. He spoke angrily "Who are you? What do you wish?"
verses.hindi: भावितचित्त होकर संसार-बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ईशाय वसवे तुभ्यं नमः स्पर्शमयात्मने । पशूनां पतये चैव पावकायातितेजसे । भीमाय व्योमरूपाय शब्दमात्राय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: IshAya vasave tubhyaM namaH sparshamayAtmane | pashUnAM pataye chaiva pAvakAyAtitejase | bhImAya vyomarUpAya shabdamAtrAya te namaH
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the wicked Daksa, Virabhadra of great splendour and of majestically rumbling sound like the cloud smilingly looked at Daksa, the gods and the Rtviks. He spoke the relevent words full of meaning without the least excitement.
verses.hindi: मानव इस विद्याद्वारा कैसे मुक्त हो सकता है ?

verses.sanskrit: उग्रायोग्रस्वरूपाय यजमानात्मने नमः । महाशिवाय सोमाय नमोऽस्त्वमृतमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: ugrAyograsvarUpAya yajamAnAtmane namaH | mahAshivAya somAya namo.astvamR^itamUrtaye
verses.translation: If the share has not been allotted to us in the sacrifice let the reason be mentioned or let the gods fight with me.
verses.hindi: पूजयेन्मां स मुच्येत सात कार्या विचारणा॥ १४  जाता है

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । प्रार्थयामास विश्वेशं गिरा प्रणतिपूर्वया
verses.transliteration: evaM stutvA mahAdevaM brahmA lokapitAmahaH | prArthayAmAsa vishveshaM girA praNatipUrvayA
verses.translation: When they were told thus by the chief of Ganas the gods headed by Daksa said — "The mantras are our authorities. We are not the lords."
verses.hindi: मेरा पूजन करता है, वह मुक्त हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् भूतभव्येश मम पुत्र महेश्वर । सृष्टिहेतोस्त्वमुत्पन्नो ममाङ्गेऽनङ्गनाशन
verses.transliteration: bhagavan bhUtabhavyesha mama putra maheshvara | sR^iShTihetostvamutpanno mamA~Nge.ana~NganAshana
verses.translation: The Mantras said — "O gods, your minds are oppressed by Tamas. Hence you do not deserve the first share. Worship lord Siva."

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्महति कार्येऽस्मिन् व्यापृतस्य जगत्प्रभो । सहायं कुरु सर्वत्र स्रष्टुमर्हसि सुप्रजाः
verses.transliteration: tasmAnmahati kArye.asmin vyApR^itasya jagatprabho | sahAyaM kuru sarvatra sraShTumarhasi suprajAH
verses.translation: Though advised by the Mantras the gods with deluded minds did not offer the share to Bhadra. They desired to drop him out.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैवं प्रार्थितो देवो रुद्रस्त्रिपुरमर्दनः । बाढमित्येव तां वाणीं प्रतिजग्राह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: tenaivaM prArthito devo rudrastripuramardanaH | bADhamityeva tAM vANIM pratijagrAha sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: When their truthful and wholesome words went in, vain the Mantras turned away from that place and went to the eternal Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् ब्रह्मा हृष्टं तमभिनन्द्य च । स्रष्टुं तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातस्तथान्याश्चासृजत्प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: tataH sa bhagavAn brahmA hR^iShTaM tamabhinandya cha | sraShTuM tenAbhyanuj~nAtastathAnyAshchAsR^ijatprajAH
verses.translation: Then the chief of Ganas  spoke to the gods headed by Visnu, "You have not accepted the mantras being proud of your strength. Since we have been dishonoured

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसः पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् । दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च सोऽसृजन्मनसैव च । पुरस्तादसृजद् ब्रह्मा धर्मं सङ्कल्पमेव च
verses.transliteration: marIchibhR^igva~NgirasaH pulastyaM pulahaM kratum | dakShamatriM vasiShThaM cha so.asR^ijanmanasaiva cha | purastAdasR^ijad brahmA dharmaM sa~Nkalpameva cha
verses.translation: After saying thus the infuriated lord burnt the sacri¬ ficial altar with the fire of his eyes as Siva had burnt the three Puras.*'

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्ते संवृतात्मानो नगा मुख्याः प्रकीर्तिताः । तं दृष्ट्वासाधकं ब्रह्मा प्रथमं सर्गमीदृशम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAtte saMvR^itAtmAno nagA mukhyAH prakIrtitAH | taM dR^iShTvAsAdhakaM brahmA prathamaM sargamIdR^isham
verses.translation: Then the lords of ganas of mountain-like huge bodies uprooted the sacrificial posts and tied them to the necks of the Hotr priests by means of ropes. They broke and powdered the sacrificial vessels of various shapes and sizes dissolved them in water and hurled all the appendages of the sacrifice In the currents of the Gahga river.
verses.hindi: इवति श्रीजिवमहाएुरणे सप्तम्यां गया पद 34027 दम '॥। कक 'दशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा द्वादशादौ प्रकीर्तिताः । सह रुद्रेण सम्भूताः पुराणा गृहमेधिनः
verses.transliteration: ityete brahmaNaH putrA dvAdashAdau prakIrtitAH | saha rudreNa sambhUtAH purANA gR^ihamedhinaH
verses.translation: There were heaps of foodstuffs and beverages; milk flowed like rivers exuding nectar; curds formed smooth slimy slush. Sweet smelling meat and foodstuffs lay in heaps high and low. There were juicy beverages, and foodstuffs to be lapped up. The heroes ate, chewed and scattered them.
verses.hindi: माहात्य्यवर्णन नामक तेरहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तेषां द्वादश वंशाः स्युर्दिव्या देवगणान्विताः । प्रजावन्तः क्रियावन्तो महर्षिभिरलङ्कृताः
verses.transliteration: teShAM dvAdasha vaMshAH syurdivyA devagaNAnvitAH | prajAvantaH kriyAvanto maharShibhirala~NkR^itAH
verses.translation: The heroic Bhadras born of Virabhadra's body hit and split the haughty gods including the guardians oi the quarters by means of discus, thunderbolts, spears, S iktis, nooses, iron clubs, iron rods, swords, axes, Bhindipalas and huge battle-axes
verses.hindi: जाता है, वह सदा निष्फल होता है

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवासुरान् पितृन् मनुष्यांश्च चतुष्टयम् । सह रुद्रेण सिसृक्षुरम्भस्येतानि वै विधिः
verses.transliteration: atha devAsurAn pitR^in manuShyAMshcha chatuShTayam | saha rudreNa sisR^ikShurambhasyetAni vai vidhiH
verses.translation: "Chop olf and split" "Hurl quickly" "Let him be killed" "Take away and strike" "Peel and tear off" such ruthless words full of excitement, usual in wars and jarring to the ears arose from the lords of Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: स सृष्ट्यर्थं समाधाय ब्रह्मात्मानमयूयुजत् । मुखादजनयद्देवान् पितॄंश्चैवोपपक्षतः
verses.transliteration: sa sR^iShTyarthaM samAdhAya brahmAtmAnamayUyujat | mukhAdajanayaddevAn pitR^IMshchaivopapakShataH
verses.translation: Some rolled their eyes, gnashed their fanglike teeth and bit their lips and palates. They pulled out the sages in the hermitages and killed them. They took away.sacrificial ladles and spoons and hurled them into fire and water. They broke domes, gemset platforms. They sang, shouted and laughed again and again drinking blood-like wine. The leading Ganas danced.

verses.sanskrit: जघनादसुरान् सर्वान् प्रजनादपि मानुषान् । अवस्करे क्षुधाविष्टा राक्षसास्तस्य जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: jaghanAdasurAn sarvAn prajanAdapi mAnuShAn | avaskare kShudhAviShTA rAkShasAstasya jaj~nire
verses.translation: Pounding up the gods including Indra, the leading Ganas, strong like lordly bulls, elephants and lions, of unriva¬ lled glory, perpetrated hair-raising deeds of destruction.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रास्तमोरजःप्राया बलिनस्ते निशाचराः । सर्पा यक्षास्तथा भूता गन्धर्वाः सम्प्रजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: putrAstamorajaHprAyA balinaste nishAcharAH | sarpA yakShAstathA bhUtA gandharvAH samprajaj~nire
verses.translation: The three cities or castles of the Asuras T&raka, VidyunmSli and Maya were received as gifts from Brahma pleased by their prnance. These were destroyed with a single shaft by Siva who was annoyed at their savage activities. I rof Agrawal considers the burnings of Tripur as as historical event.

verses.sanskrit: वयांसि पक्षतः सृष्टाः पक्षिणो वक्षसोऽसृजत् । मुखतोऽजांस्तथा पार्श्वादुरगांश्च विनिर्ममे
verses.transliteration: vayAMsi pakShataH sR^iShTAH pakShiNo vakShaso.asR^ijat | mukhato.ajAMstathA pArshvAduragAMshcha vinirmame
verses.translation: The Pramathas rejoiced, struck, ran, prattled, danced, laughed and jumped about.
verses.hindi: करता है, उसका यह जप 'वाचिक ' कहलाता है

verses.sanskrit: पद्भ्यां चाश्वान्समातङ्गान् शरभान् गवयान् मृगान् । उष्ट्रानश्वतरांश्चैव न्यङ्कूनन्याश्च जातयः
verses.transliteration: padbhyAM chAshvAnsamAta~NgAn sharabhAn gavayAn mR^igAn | uShTrAnashvatarAMshchaiva nya~NkUnanyAshcha jAtayaH
verses.translation: Some of them evinced a desire to seize the watery clouds, some jumped up to seize the sun; others wished to blow along with the wind.

verses.sanskrit: औषध्यः फलमूलानि रोमभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे । गायत्रीं च ऋचं चैव त्रिवृत्साम रथन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: auShadhyaH phalamUlAni romabhyastasya jaj~nire | gAyatrIM cha R^ichaM chaiva trivR^itsAma rathantaram
verses.translation: Some wielded weapons and rushed through the sky like peaks of mountains; tossed the gods like the Garua toss* ing huge pythons.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमं च यज्ञानां निर्ममे प्रथमान्मुखात् । यजूंषि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दः स्तोमं पञ्चदशं तथा
verses.transliteration: agniShTomaM cha yaj~nAnAM nirmame prathamAnmukhAt | yajUMShi traiShTubhaM ChandaH stomaM pa~nchadashaM tathA
verses.translation: The doors, door-frames and walls of the sacrifi¬ cial mansion were upset; the windows, ceiling frames, the halls were destroyed utterly. The complete edifice of sacrifice crumbled helplessly like a statement without foundation.
verses.hindi: उससे सौगुना अधिक फल देनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: अप्रसन्नमना भूत्वा द्वितीयं सोऽभ्यमन्यत । तस्याभिधायतः सर्गं तिर्य्यक्स्रोतोऽभ्यवर्त्तत
verses.transliteration: aprasannamanA bhUtvA dvitIyaM so.abhyamanyata | tasyAbhidhAyataH sargaM tiryyaksroto.abhyavarttata
verses.translation: While houses were being dismantled, the women shrieked and cried helplessly "O husband" "O Qhild" "O father" "O brother" "O mother" "O uncle.'*
verses.hindi: आणायाम कर लेना श्रेष्ठ बताया गया है

verses.sanskrit: बृहत्साम तथोक्थं च दक्षिणादसृजन्मुखात् । सामानि जगतीछन्दः स्तोमं सप्तदशं तथा
verses.transliteration: bR^ihatsAma tathokthaM cha dakShiNAdasR^ijanmukhAt | sAmAni jagatIChandaH stomaM saptadashaM tathA
verses.translation: The chiefs of gods headed by V:?nu and Indra were terribly afraid. They fled in excessive fright.

verses.sanskrit: वैरूप्यमतिरात्रं च पश्चिमादसृजन् मुखात् । एकविंशमथर्वाणमाप्तोर्यामाणमेव च
verses.transliteration: vairUpyamatirAtraM cha pashchimAdasR^ijan mukhAt | ekaviMshamatharvANamAptoryAmANameva cha
verses.translation: Seeing that the gods had fled uninjured and think¬ ing that those who deserved to be punished remained unpu¬ nished the leading Gana became angry.

verses.sanskrit: अनुष्टुभं स वैराजमुत्तरादसृजन्मुखात् । उच्चावचानि भूतानि गात्रेभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: anuShTubhaM sa vairAjamuttarAdasR^ijanmukhAt | uchchAvachAni bhUtAni gAtrebhyastasya jaj~nire
verses.translation: He took up the all-destroying trident and looked up. He vomittcd flames from his mouth, chased the gods as the lion chases the elephants. His gait as he pursued them resembled that of an elephant in its rut.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाः पिशाचा गन्धर्वास्तथैवाप्सरसां गणाः । नरकिन्नररक्षांसि वयःपशुमृगोरगाः
verses.transliteration: yakShAH pishAchA gandharvAstathaivApsarasAM gaNAH | narakinnararakShAMsi vayaHpashumR^igoragAH
verses.translation: Then he agitated the army of the gods as the lord of elephants in rut stirs up a lake, shedding different hues blue, grey and red. He wore a tiger's skin as his cloth which was inlaid with excellent gold and pearls. Cutting, piercing.
verses.hindi: अथवा पशुतुल्य प्राणीको इसे नहीं बताना

verses.sanskrit: अव्ययं चैव यदिदं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम् । तेषां वै यानि कर्माणि प्राक्सृष्टानि प्रपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: avyayaM chaiva yadidaM jagat sthAvaraja~Ngamam | teShAM vai yAni karmANi prAksR^iShTAni prapedire
verses.translation: As he walked about speedily armed with a spear all alone, the gods thought him to be numbering a thousand. The infuriated Bhadrakali excited by the fight pierced through the gods in the war holding spears shedding flames.
verses.hindi: उनके लिये भी यह मन्त्र निष्फल नहीं होता है

verses.sanskrit: तान्येव ते प्रपद्यन्ते सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः । हिंस्राहिंस्रे मृदु क्रूरे धर्माधर्मावृतानृते
verses.transliteration: tAnyeva te prapadyante sR^ijyamAnAH punaH punaH | hiMsrAhiMsre mR^idu krUre dharmAdharmAvR^itAnR^ite
verses.translation: Bhadra born of Rudra's anger shone in her company as the fire at the time of dissolution with a lustre pale and smoky due to smoke. Pursuing the gods in the course of war, Bhadrakali shone as the flame of fire at the end of the Kalpa that burns the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तद्भाविताः प्रपद्यन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्य रोचते । महाभूतेषु नानात्वमिन्द्रियार्थेषु मुक्तिषु
verses.transliteration: tadbhAvitAH prapadyante tasmAttattasya rochate | mahAbhUteShu nAnAtvamindriyArtheShu muktiShu
verses.translation: Bhadra the leader of Rudragaas angrily kicked the sun and his horse on the head sportively with his left leg. The heroic Ganesvara, Bhadra with self-control hit Pavaka with his swords, Yama with iron-clubs, Rudras with his spear and Varuna with iron clubs. Holding the axe he hit Vayu with it and Nirti with big clubs. The war was a sportive game for him. He attacked the gods and the sages antagonistic to 8iva.
verses.hindi: है ऑशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीय्संहितायामुत्तरखण्ड परमगतिको प्राप्त होता है

verses.sanskrit: विनियोगं च भूतानां धातैव व्यदधत्स्वयम् । नामरूपं च भूतानां प्राकृतानां प्रपञ्चनम्
verses.transliteration: viniyogaM cha bhUtAnAM dhAtaiva vyadadhatsvayam | nAmarUpaM cha bhUtAnAM prAkR^itAnAM prapa~nchanam
verses.translation: Then the lord cut off the tip of the nose of Sarasvati as well as of the mother of the gods with the tip of his nail.
verses.hindi: रे ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके उत्तरखण्डे पंचाक्षमहिमवर्णन॑ नाम चतुर्दशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: वेदशब्देभ्य एवादौ निर्ममेऽसौ पितामहः । आर्षाणि चैव नामानि याश्च वेदेषु वृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: vedashabdebhya evAdau nirmame.asau pitAmahaH | ArShANi chaiva nAmAni yAshcha vedeShu vR^ittayaH
verses.translation: The lord nipped off the right nostril and the nipple of the left breast of Svaha with his nail-end.
verses.hindi: महिमवर्णन न नामक चोदवहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: शर्वर्य्यन्ते प्रसूतानां तान्येवैभ्यो ददावजः । यथर्तावृतुलिङ्गानि नानारूपाणि पर्य्यये
verses.transliteration: sharvaryyante prasUtAnAM tAnyevaibhyo dadAvajaH | yathartAvR^ituli~NgAni nAnArUpANi paryyaye
verses.translation: The impetuous Bhadra uprooted the eyes of Bhaga large and lustrous like the lotus.
verses.hindi: मन्रसंग्रहणे किज्चित्सूचितं न तु विस्तृतम्॥ २  उसका विस्तृत वर्णन नहीं किया था

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःप्रकाशास्तिर्य्यञ्च आवृताश्च बहिः पुनः । पश्वात्मानस्ततो जाता उत्पथग्राहिणश्च ते
verses.transliteration: antaHprakAshAstiryya~ncha AvR^itAshcha bahiH punaH | pashvAtmAnastato jAtA utpathagrAhiNashcha te
verses.translation: With the end of bk bow he hit Pusan's pearl like row of teeth. Thereafter Pusan could not utter words clearly.
verses.hindi: संस्कार परम पुण्यं शिवेन परिभाषितम्॥ ३  समस्त पापोंका शोधन करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यन्ते तानि तान्येव तथा भावा युगादिषु । इत्येष करणोद्भूतो लोकसर्गः स्वयम्भुवः
verses.transliteration: dR^ishyante tAni tAnyeva tathA bhAvA yugAdiShu | ityeSha karaNodbhUto lokasargaH svayambhuvaH
verses.translation: Then the lord stamped the moon with his toe, as though he was only a worm and ground *him on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: महदाद्यो विशेषान्तो विकारः प्रकृतेः स्वयम् । चन्द्रसूर्यप्रभाजुष्टो ग्रहनक्षत्रमण्डितः
verses.transliteration: mahadAdyo visheShAnto vikAraH prakR^iteH svayam | chandrasUryaprabhAjuShTo grahanakShatramaNDitaH
verses.translation: The infuriated Bhadra cut off the head of Daka and handed it over to Bhadrakali even as Virini, wife of Daksa was lamenting.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्संस्कार एवायं दीक्षेत्यपि च कथ्यते॥ ५  है।इसलिये इस संस्कारको ही दीक्षा भी कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: नदीभिश्च समुद्रैश्च पर्वतैश्च स मण्डितः । परैश्च विविधै रम्यैः स्फीतैर्जनपदैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nadIbhishcha samudraishcha parvataishcha sa maNDitaH | paraishcha vividhai ramyaiH sphItairjanapadaistathA
verses.translation: Taking up the head resembling the fruit of a

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् ब्रह्मवनेऽव्यक्तो ब्रह्मा चरति सर्ववित् । अव्यक्तबीजप्रभव ईश्वरानुग्रहे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasmin brahmavane.avyakto brahmA charati sarvavit | avyaktabIjaprabhava IshvarAnugrahe sthitaH
verses.translation: Catching hold of by the neck, Aristanemi, Soma, Dharma, Prajapati Angiras, father of many sons, Krsasva and KaSyapa, the powerful chiefs of Ganas of leonine exploits rebuked and hit them on the heads with fists.
verses.hindi: जा बाय ग शिय्य तिशोनवत। १४  + याके द्वारा शिष्यका शोधन करे

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिस्कन्धमहाशाख इन्द्रियान्तरकोटरः । महाभूतप्रमाणश्च विशेषामलपल्लवः
verses.transliteration: buddhiskandhamahAshAkha indriyAntarakoTaraH | mahAbhUtapramANashcha visheShAmalapallavaH
verses.translation: Just as in Kaliyuga women of noble families are molested and defiled by paramours forcibly so also the women and the daughters-in-law were molested by Bhutas and Vetalas.
verses.hindi: करे, जो गुरुके गौरवके अनुरूप हो

verses.sanskrit: धर्माधर्मसुपुष्पाढ्यः सुखदुःखफलोदयः । आजीव्यः सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्मवृक्षः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: dharmAdharmasupuShpADhyaH sukhaduHkhaphalodayaH | AjIvyaH sarvabhUtAnAM brahmavR^ikShaH sanAtanaH
verses.translation: Thus the sacrificial spot appeared like a deso¬ late forest. The domes were smashed. The posts were broken. The festivities ended. The hall was burnt. The portals and festoons had crumbled. The army of the gods was uprooted. The sages were killed. The Vedic chant had subsided. The population had dwindled. The distressed women shrieked. The appendages were spoiled.
verses.hindi: गुरुके पूजनसे ही अर क. सगान फल मिलता है॥ २०२१ फल मिलता है

verses.sanskrit: द्यां मूर्द्धानं तस्य विप्रा वदन्ति खं वै नाभिं चन्द्रसूर्यौ च नेत्रे । दिशः श्रोत्रे चरणौ च क्षितिं च सोऽचिन्त्यात्मा सर्वभूतप्रणेता
verses.transliteration: dyAM mUrddhAnaM tasya viprA vadanti khaM vai nAbhiM chandrasUryau cha netre | dishaH shrotre charaNau cha kShitiM cha so.achintyAtmA sarvabhUtapraNetA
verses.translation: When thousands of gods were killed and their bodies lay sprawled on the ground, the chief of Ganas entered the place of sacrificial fires.

verses.sanskrit: वक्त्रात्तस्य ब्राह्मणाः सम्प्रसूताः तद्वक्षसः क्षत्रियाः पूर्वभागात् । वैश्या उरुभ्यां तस्य पद्भ्यां च शूद्राः सर्वे वर्णा गात्रतः सम्प्रसूताः
verses.transliteration: vaktrAttasya brAhmaNAH samprasUtAH tadvakShasaH kShatriyAH pUrvabhAgAt | vaishyA urubhyAM tasya padbhyAM cha shUdrAH sarve varNA gAtrataH samprasUtAH
verses.translation: On seeing that Bhadra resembling the deadly fire had come the sacrifice was afraid of death and fled assuming the form of a deer.

verses.sanskrit: तमप्यसाधकं ज्ञात्वा सर्गमन्यममन्यत । तदोर्ध्वस्रोतसो वृत्तो देवसर्गस्तु सात्त्विकः
verses.transliteration: tamapyasAdhakaM j~nAtvA sargamanyamamanyata | tadordhvasrotaso vR^itto devasargastu sAttvikaH
verses.translation: Bhadra pursued him drawing his great bow, terrible due to the twanging sound of the firm bow-string, and dis¬ charging the arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ते सुखप्रीतिबहुला बहिरन्तश्च नावृताः । प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च स्वभावादेव संज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: te sukhaprItibahulA bahirantashcha nAvR^itAH | prakAshA bahirantashcha svabhAvAdeva sa.nj~nitAH
verses.translation: He sounded the bow by drawing the string to the ears like the thundering cloud. The bowstring, heaven, sky and earth reverberated.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: On seeing the sacrifice thus insulted, Visu was infuriated and got ready for a fight.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: On seeing the sacrifice thus insulted, Visu was infuriated and got ready for a fight.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । ब्रह्मविष्णुसृष्टिकथनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । भवता कथिता सृष्टिर्भवस्य परमात्मनः । चतुर्मुखमुखात्तस्य संशयो नः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.13\. trayodasho.adhyAyaH | brahmaviShNusR^iShTikathanam | R^iShaya UchuH | bhavatA kathitA sR^iShTirbhavasya paramAtmanaH | chaturmukhamukhAttasya saMshayo naH prajAyate
verses.translation: At that time a chariot resembling a thousand suns and with the emblem of a bull on the banner cloth appeared in the sky.
verses.hindi: दो वर्ष और वैश्यकी तीन वर्षतक परीक्षा करे

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वं वद यथा ब्रह्मा मुनीनामवदद्विभुः । वयं श्रद्धालवस्तात श्रोतुमीश्वरसद्यशः
verses.transliteration: tattvaM vada yathA brahmA munInAmavadadvibhuH | vayaM shraddhAlavastAta shrotumIshvarasadyashaH
verses.translation: The splendid chariot had two horses and four wheels. Several divine weapons and missiles had been kept ready therein. It was embellished with jewels.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । स्थाने पृष्टमिदं विप्रा भवद्भिः प्रश्नकोविदैः । इदमेव पुरा पृष्टो मम प्राह पितामहः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | sthAne pR^iShTamidaM viprA bhavadbhiH prashnakovidaiH | idameva purA pR^iShTo mama prAha pitAmahaH
verses.translation: At the bidding of Siva, Brahma brought the ex¬ cellent chariot to Virabhadra and spoke with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: तदहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा रुद्रसमुद्भवः । यथा च पुनरुत्पत्तिर्ब्रह्मविष्ण्वोः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: tadahaM sampravakShyAmi yathA rudrasamudbhavaH | yathA cha punarutpattirbrahmaviShNvoH parasparam
verses.translation: "O lord Virabhadra the eternal moon-crested lord commands you to mount the chariot.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे दीक्षाविधाने गुरुमाहत्म्यवर्णन॑ नाम पञ्चदशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: त्रयस्ते कारणात्मानो जाताः साक्षान्महेश्वरात् । चराचरस्य विश्वस्य सर्गस्थित्यन्तहेतवः
verses.transliteration: trayaste kAraNAtmAno jAtAH sAkShAnmaheshvarAt | charAcharasya vishvasya sargasthityantahetavaH
verses.translation: O great-armed one, Siva, stationed near the hermitage of R'libhya along with Siva, is witnessing your unbearable exploit.
verses.hindi: गुरुमाहात्म्यवर्णन नामक पत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: परमैश्वर्यसंयुक्ताः परमेश्वरभाविताः । तच्छक्त्याधिष्ठिता नित्यं तत्कार्यकरणक्षमाः
verses.transliteration: paramaishvaryasaMyuktAH parameshvarabhAvitAH | tachChaktyAdhiShThitA nityaM tatkAryakaraNakShamAH
verses.translation: On hearing his words and blessing BrahmS, the heroic leading Gana mounted the divine chariot.

verses.sanskrit: पित्रा नियमिताः पूर्वं त्रयोऽपि त्रिषु कर्मसु । ब्रह्मा सर्गे हरिस्त्राणे रुद्रः संहरणे तथा
verses.transliteration: pitrA niyamitAH pUrvaM trayo.api triShu karmasu | brahmA sarge haristrANe rudraH saMharaNe tathA
verses.translation: In the excellent chariot where Brahmi sat as the charioteer the splendour of Bhadra increased like that of Rudra, the enemy of the Tripuras.

verses.sanskrit: तथाप्यन्योऽन्यमात्सर्यादन्योऽन्यातिशयाशिनः । तपसा तोषयित्वा स्वं पितरं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tathApyanyo.anyamAtsaryAdanyo.anyAtishayAshinaH | tapasA toShayitvA svaM pitaraM parameshvaram
verses.translation: Then keeping an excellent conch shining like the

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा सर्वात्मना तस्य प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः । ब्रह्मनारायणौ पूर्वं रुद्रः कल्पान्तरेऽसृजत्
verses.transliteration: labdhvA sarvAtmanA tasya prasAdAtparameShThinaH | brahmanArAyaNau pUrvaM rudraH kalpAntare.asR^ijat
verses.translation: At the sound of the conch resembling that of the swan, the fire in the belly of the gods blazed with fear.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पान्तरे पुनर्ब्रह्मा रुद्रविष्णू जगन्मयः । विष्णुश्च भगवान् रुद्रं ब्रह्माणमसृजत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: kalpAntare punarbrahmA rudraviShNU jaganmayaH | viShNushcha bhagavAn rudraM brahmANamasR^ijatpunaH
verses.translation: In an instant the quarters including open spaces and crevices were filled up and thronged with leading Yaksas Vidyadharas, serpents and Siddhas who desired to witness the battle.
verses.hindi: शुभ लक्षणसे युक्त शिवकलशकी स्थापना करे

verses.sanskrit: नारायणं पुनर्ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माणं च पुनर्भवः । एवं कल्पेषु कल्पेषु ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: nArAyaNaM punarbrahmA brahmANaM cha punarbhavaH | evaM kalpeShu kalpeShu brahmaviShNumaheshvarAH
verses.translation: Then Narayana as the cloud inflicted pain on the Ganas as the cattle, through a geat shower of arrows from his bow.

verses.sanskrit: देवश्रेष्ठो विरूपाक्षो दीप्तः शूलधरो हरः । कालात्मा भगवान् रुद्रः कपर्दी नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: devashreShTho virUpAkSho dIptaH shUladharo haraH | kAlAtmA bhagavAn rudraH kapardI nIlalohitaH
verses.translation: On seeing Visnu coming and discharging arrows Bhadra took up his bow and showered thousands of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परेण जायन्ते परस्परहितैषिणः । तत्तत्कल्पान्तवृत्तान्तमधिकृत्य महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: paraspareNa jAyante parasparahitaiShiNaH | tattatkalpAntavR^ittAntamadhikR^itya maharShibhiH
verses.translation: He took up the divine bow and slowly drew it like Siva who drew the bow Meru.
verses.hindi: ताड़न करनेके पश्चात् नेत्र-बन्धन खोल दे

verses.sanskrit: प्रभावः कथ्यते तेषां परस्परसमुद्भवात् । शृणु तेषां कथां चित्रां पुण्यां पापप्रमोचिनीम्
verses.transliteration: prabhAvaH kathyate teShAM parasparasamudbhavAt | shR^iNu teShAM kathAM chitrAM puNyAM pApapramochinIm
verses.translation: Then the chief of Ganas, of fierce valour and glory took an excellent arrow blazing like a serpent.
verses.hindi: उसके मस्तकपर शिवका वरद हाथ रखे

verses.sanskrit: कल्पे तत्पुरुषे वृत्तां ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः । पुरा नारायणो नाम कल्पे वै मेघवाहने
verses.transliteration: kalpe tatpuruShe vR^ittAM brahmaNaH parameShThinaH | purA nArAyaNo nAma kalpe vai meghavAhane
verses.translation: His hand in contact with the opening of the quiver for taking up the arrows appeared like a serpent wishing to enter an anthill.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु मेघो भूत्वावहद्धराम् । तस्य भावं समालक्ष्य विष्णोर्विश्वजगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: divyaM varShasahasraM tu megho bhUtvAvahaddharAm | tasya bhAvaM samAlakShya viShNorvishvajagadguruH
verses.translation: The arrow lifted and held in the hand shone like the young one of a serpent held within the mouth of a great serpent.
verses.hindi: साथ ही मन्त्रोंका तर्पण भी करे

verses.sanskrit: सर्वः सर्वात्मभावेन प्रददौ शक्तिमव्ययाम् । शक्तिं लब्ध्वा तु सर्वात्मा शिवात्सर्वेश्वरात्तदा
verses.transliteration: sarvaH sarvAtmabhAvena pradadau shaktimavyayAm | shaktiM labdhvA tu sarvAtmA shivAtsarveshvarAttadA
verses.translation: With his stout and sharp arrow, the infuriated Bhadra who resembled Rudra, hit the unchanging Visnu on his forehead.

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज भगावन् विष्णुर्विश्वं विश्वसृजा सह । विष्णोस्तद्वैभवं दृष्ट्वा सृष्टस्तेन पितामहः
verses.transliteration: sasarja bhagAvan viShNurvishvaM vishvasR^ijA saha | viShNostadvaibhavaM dR^iShTvA sR^iShTastena pitAmahaH
verses.translation: Vinu thus insulted and hit on the forehead became angry with the chief of Ganas like a cow or bull becoming angry with the lion.

verses.sanskrit: ईर्ष्यया परया ग्रस्तः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत् । गच्छ विष्णो मया ज्ञातं तव सर्गस्य कारणम् । आवयोरधिकश्चास्ति स रुद्रो नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: IrShyayA parayA grastaH prahasannidamabravIt | gachCha viShNo mayA j~nAtaM tava sargasya kAraNam | AvayoradhikashchAsti sa rudro nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: Then he hit the serpent like arm of the chief of Gapas, with a cruel, pointed great arrow resembling the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवाधिदेवस्य प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः । स्रष्टा त्वं भगवानाद्यः पालकः परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: tasya devAdhidevasya prasAdAtparameShThinaH | sraShTA tvaM bhagavAnAdyaH pAlakaH paramArthataH
verses.translation: The powerful Virabhadra too, with a great velo¬ city discharged an arrow brilliant like ten thousand suns again at his arm.
verses.hindi: यह पूर्णतः प्रकाशित हो रहा है

verses.sanskrit: अहं च तपसाराध्य रुद्रं त्रिदशनायकम् । त्वया सह जगत्सर्वं स्रक्ष्याम्यत्र न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ahaM cha tapasArAdhya rudraM tridashanAyakam | tvayA saha jagatsarvaM srakShyAmyatra na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Visnu hit Bhadra. Bhadra hit Visnu. O brahmins both of them hit each other.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विष्णुमुपालभ्य भगवानब्जसम्भवः । एवं विज्ञापयामास तपसा प्राप्य शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: evaM viShNumupAlabhya bhagavAnabjasambhavaH | evaM vij~nApayAmAsa tapasA prApya sha~Nkaram
verses.translation: The tumultuous hair-raising fight between the two discharging the arrows on each other in quick success¬ ion then ensued.

verses.sanskrit: सब्रह्मकमिमं लोकं सविष्णुमपि पावकम् । यः संहरति सङ्क्रुद्धो युगान्ते समुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: sabrahmakamimaM lokaM saviShNumapi pAvakam | yaH saMharati sa~Nkruddho yugAnte samupasthite
verses.translation: On seeing their mutual noisy battle the sounds of •Ha-Ha* raised by the aerial wanderers rose in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् देवदेवेश विश्वेश्वर महेश्वर । तव वामाङ्गजो विष्णुर्दक्षिणाङ्गभवो ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavan devadevesha vishveshvara maheshvara | tava vAmA~Ngajo viShNurdakShiNA~Ngabhavo hyaham
verses.translation: Then Bhadra hit in the broad chest of Vijjriu with an arrow that shone like the sun and the tip of which blazed like fire.

verses.sanskrit: मया सह जगत्सर्वं तथाप्यसृजदच्युतः । स मत्सरादुपालब्धस्त्वदाश्रयबलान्मया
verses.transliteration: mayA saha jagatsarvaM tathApyasR^ijadachyutaH | sa matsarAdupAlabdhastvadAshrayabalAnmayA
verses.translation: Acutely hit by the arrow that fell sharply, Vi?ju suffered great pain and fell into swoon.

verses.sanskrit: मद्भावान्नाधिकस्तेऽतिभावस्त्वयि महेश्वरे । त्वत्त एव समुत्पत्तिरावयोः सदृशी यतः
verses.transliteration: madbhAvAnnAdhikaste.atibhAvastvayi maheshvare | tvatta eva samutpattirAvayoH sadR^ishI yataH
verses.translation: He regained consciousness instantaneously and got up. He discharged his weapons against Bhadra.
verses.hindi: शिष्य-संस्कारवर्णन नामक सोलहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भक्त्या यथापूर्वं प्रसादं कृतवानसि । तथा ममापि तत्सर्वं दातुमर्हसि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: tasya bhaktyA yathApUrvaM prasAdaM kR^itavAnasi | tathA mamApi tatsarvaM dAtumarhasi sha~Nkara
verses.translation: The chief of the army of Siva stopped all the missiles discharged from Vignu's bow by means of terrible anti-missiles.

verses.sanskrit: इति विज्ञापितस्तेन भगवान् भगनेत्रहा । न्यायेन वै ददौ सर्वं तस्यापि स घृणानिधिः
verses.transliteration: iti vij~nApitastena bhagavAn bhaganetrahA | nyAyena vai dadau sarvaM tasyApi sa ghR^iNAnidhiH
verses.translation: Then Visnu with eyes reddened by anger dischar¬ ged an arrow in which his name had been engraved and which had never been obstructed anywhere, against the Gana chief. Showering arrows, lord Bhadra split the arrow into pieces on the way before it reached him.
verses.hindi: संक्षेपसे छः अध्वा कहे गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वैवमीश्वरादेव ब्रह्मा सर्वात्मतां क्षणात् । त्वरमाणोऽथ सङ्गम्य ददर्श पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: labdhvaivamIshvarAdeva brahmA sarvAtmatAM kShaNAt | tvaramANo.atha sa~Ngamya dadarsha puruShottamam
