verses.translation: Then within an instant he split the bow with a single arrow and the wings of Garua with the two arrows. This was a wonderful feat. Then by his Yogic powers Vi?9u let loose from his body thousands of terrific gods holding conch, discus and the club. But the mighty Bhadra burnt all of them instantaneously by means of the fire of his eyes like iva who burnt the Tripuras.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरार्णवालये शुभ्रे विमाने सूर्यसन्निभे । हेमरत्नान्विते दिव्ये मनसा तेन निर्मिते
verses.transliteration: kShIrArNavAlaye shubhre vimAne sUryasannibhe | hemaratnAnvite divye manasA tena nirmite
verses.translation: Thus infuriated Visnu raised his discus in a hurry and attempted to hurl it on the hero. On seeing him in front with the discus lifted up, the chief of the Ganas smiled and without any strain made his hand stiff and benumbed. With his limbs turned numb, Vinu became incapable though he was desirous of hurling the unequalled and terrible discus.
verses.hindi: और अशुद्धके भेदसे दो प्रकारका है

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तभोगशय्यायां शयानं पङ्कजेक्षणम् । चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: anantabhogashayyAyAM shayAnaM pa~NkajekShaNam | chaturbhujamudArA~NgaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam
verses.translation: Gasping for breath with a hand holding the discus he stood idly, immobile like a stone, like the soul without a body, like a bull without a horn or like a lion without its fangs. So stood Vi?nu. On seeing Visnu in a miserable plight the infuriated Indra and other gods took up their wea-
verses.hindi: है। यह भेद और उपभेदोंको छोड़कर साठ है

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रधरं सौम्यं चन्द्रबिम्बसमाननम् । श्रीवत्सवक्षसं देवं प्रसन्नमधुरस्मितम्
verses.transliteration: sha~NkhachakradharaM saumyaM chandrabimbasamAnanam | shrIvatsavakShasaM devaM prasannamadhurasmitam
verses.translation: On glancing at them as a lion glances at the deer, Bhadra of Rudra's body, the hero surrounded by ex¬ cellent heroes, benumbed them with a boisterous laugh.

verses.sanskrit: धरामृदुकराम्भोजस्पर्शरक्तपदाम्बुजम् । क्षीरार्णवामृतमिव शयानं योगनिद्रया
verses.transliteration: dharAmR^idukarAmbhojasparsharaktapadAmbujam | kShIrArNavAmR^itamiva shayAnaM yoganidrayA
verses.translation: The right hand of Indra who desired to release the thunderbolt it held remained steady as painted in a picture.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च प्रणामं कुरुतो भयात् । लोकसङ्कोचकस्यास्य यस्य तौ वशवर्तिनौ
verses.transliteration: yasya brahmA cha viShNushcha praNAmaM kuruto bhayAt | lokasa~NkochakasyAsya yasya tau vashavartinau
verses.translation: The hands of others too became fixed, as the activities of idle men at the start remain unprogressive.

verses.sanskrit: तमसा कालरुद्राख्यं रजसा कनकाण्डजम् । सत्त्वेन सर्वगं विष्णुं निर्गुणत्वे महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tamasA kAlarudrAkhyaM rajasA kanakANDajam | sattvena sarvagaM viShNuM nirguNatve maheshvaram
verses.translation: Thus the gods with their efficacy thwarted in the battle were rendered incapable of standing in front of him.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पुरुषं ब्रह्मा प्रगल्भमिदमब्रवीत् । ग्रसामि त्वामहं विष्णो त्वमात्मानं यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA puruShaM brahmA pragalbhamidamabravIt | grasAmi tvAmahaM viShNo tvamAtmAnaM yathA purA
verses.translation: Frightened by the splendour of Virabhadra they could not stay further in the battle. In that fierce battle they fled even with their benumbed limbs.
verses.hindi: बार आचमन करके शिवमन्त्रका उच्चारण करे

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रतिबुद्ध्य पितामहम् । उदैक्षत महाबाहुः स्मितमीषच्चकार च
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA pratibuddhya pitAmaham | udaikShata mahAbAhuH smitamIShachchakAra cha
verses.translation: The mighty Virabhadra hit the fleeing warriors, with sharp arrows like the cloud hitting the mountains with sharp showers.
verses.hindi: बार आचमन करके शिवका स्मरण करे

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवसरे विष्णुर्ग्रस्तस्तेन महात्मना । सृष्टश्च ब्रह्मणा सद्यो भ्रुवोर्मध्यादयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tasminnavasare viShNurgrastastena mahAtmanA | sR^iShTashcha brahmaNA sadyo bhruvormadhyAdayatnataH
verses.translation: The multitudinous arms of Virabhadra, resembling iron clubs, shone with their various shining weapons like serpents with fiery flames.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नवसरे साक्षाद्भगवानिन्दुभूषणः । शक्तिं तयोरपि द्रष्टुमरूपो रूपमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasminnavasare sAkShAdbhagavAnindubhUShaNaH | shaktiM tayorapi draShTumarUpo rUpamAsthitaH
verses.translation: The hero discharging weapons and missiles shone like Brahma discharging (creating) ail living beings.
verses.hindi: आठ या चौवन आहुतियोंका होम करे

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादमतुलं कर्तुं पुरा दत्तवरस्तयोः । आगच्छत्तत्र यत्रेमौ ब्रह्मनारायणौ स्थितौ
verses.transliteration: prasAdamatulaM kartuM purA dattavarastayoH | AgachChattatra yatremau brahmanArAyaNau sthitau
verses.translation: Just as the sun covers the earth by his rays so the hero enveloped the quarters by means of his arrows.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तुष्टुवतुर्देवं प्रीतौ भीतौ च कौतुकात् । प्रणेमतुश्च बहुशो बहुमानेन दूरतः
verses.transliteration: atha tuShTuvaturdevaM prItau bhItau cha kautukAt | praNematushcha bahusho bahumAnena dUrataH
verses.translation: The arrows of the Gana chieftains embellished with gold and flying in the firmament like lightning became the standard of comparison.
verses.hindi: प्रबुध्योत्थाय गुरुवे स्वप्नं दृष्टं निवेदयेत्॥ ४५  बताये

verses.sanskrit: भवोऽपि भगवानेतावनुगृह्य पिनाकधृक् । सादरं पश्यतोरेव तयोरन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: bhavo.api bhagavAnetAvanugR^ihya pinAkadhR^ik | sAdaraM pashyatoreva tayorantaradhIyata
verses.translation: The great arrows took away the lives of the gods even as the water snakes squeeze the lives out of the frogs. They drank their blood as though that were wine.
verses.hindi: जति श्रीशिवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयर्सहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवदीक्षाविधानवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तदशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: योऽयं देवः स्वकादङ्गाद् ब्रह्मविष्णू पुरासृजत् । स एव हि तयोर्नित्यं योगक्षेमकरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: yo.ayaM devaH svakAda~NgAd brahmaviShNU purAsR^ijat | sa eva hi tayornityaM yogakShemakaraH prabhuH
verses.translation: With the gods with their limbs cut off, the hero shone like Bhairava who had seized people and like Siva who had burnt the three cities.
verses.hindi: विधानवर्णन नामक सत्रहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: स कथं भगवान् रुद्र आदिदेवः पुरातनः । पुत्रत्वमगमच्छम्भुर्ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: sa kathaM bhagavAn rudra AdidevaH purAtanaH | putratvamagamachChambhurbrahmaNo.avyaktajanmanaH
verses.translation: Then a terrible stream of flood from the bodies of the warriors began to flow striking terror in the living beings.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिश्च विष्णुश्च रुद्रस्यैतौ परस्परम् । सृष्टौ परस्परस्याङ्गादिति प्रागपि शुश्रुम
verses.transliteration: prajApatishcha viShNushcha rudrasyaitau parasparam | sR^iShTau parasparasyA~NgAditi prAgapi shushruma
verses.translation: The ground of the sacrificial rites drenched with the blood shone like the goddess Kausiki who had killed Sumbha with her garments wet with the blood.

verses.sanskrit: कथं पुनरशेषाणां भूतानां हेतुभूतयोः । गुणप्रधानभावेन प्रादुर्भावः परस्परात्
verses.transliteration: kathaM punarasheShANAM bhUtAnAM hetubhUtayoH | guNapradhAnabhAvena prAdurbhAvaH parasparAt
verses.translation: The quarters looked gloomy. Inauspicious wind blew. Ah, the adverse working of the fate. This is a horse- sacrificc. The sacrificer is Daksa himself. Dharma and others are the councillors. The Garuda-bannered deity is the patron. Indra and other gods take their shares directly. Still the sacri¬ ficer, the sacrifice and the priests are beheaded immediately.
verses.hindi: पूजयेद्देवमीशानं॑ जुहुयाच्च शिवानले॥ ४ पूजा कराये और शिवाग्निमें हवन करे

verses.sanskrit: नापृष्टं भवता किञ्चिन्नाश्रुतं च कथञ्चन । भगवच्छिष्यभूतेन भवता सकलं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: nApR^iShTaM bhavatA ki~nchinnAshrutaM cha katha~nchana | bhagavachChiShyabhUtena bhavatA sakalaM smR^itam
verses.translation: Hence no such action shall be performed that i.s not indicated in the Vedas, and that which excludes Siva and is taken up by the wicked.
verses.hindi: ही साथ सम्पूर्ण योनियोंमें संयुक्त करे

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Even after committing great sin, if any one worships Siva with devotion he is liberated from the sin. No hesitation need be made in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Even after committing great sin, if any one worships Siva with devotion he is liberated from the sin. No hesitation need be made in this respect.
verses.hindi: भोगप्राप्ति और परा प्रीतिका चिन्तन करे

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१४. चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः । रुद्राविर्भाववर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । प्रतिकल्पं प्रवक्ष्यामि रुद्राविर्भावकारणम् । यतोऽविच्छिन्नसन्ताना ब्रह्मसृष्टिः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.14\. chaturdasho.adhyAyaH | rudrAvirbhAvavarNanam | vAyuruvAcha | pratikalpaM pravakShyAmi rudrAvirbhAvakAraNam | yato.avichChinnasantAnA brahmasR^iShTiH pravartate
verses.translation: Then the gods including Visnu and the guardians of the quarters pierced by the arrows discharged from the bow of the chief of Ganas and overwhelmed by great pain fled from the battle.

verses.sanskrit: भग्नदंष्ट्राङ्कुराक्रान्तप्रान्तकान्तधराधरः । सव्यश्रवणपार्श्वान्तमण्डलीकृतकुण्डलः
verses.transliteration: bhagnadaMShTrA~NkurAkrAntaprAntakAntadharAdharaH | savyashravaNapArshvAntamaNDalIkR^itakuNDalaH
verses.translation: The warriors of the gods with their hair dishevelled
verses.hindi: प्रतिष्ठामनुसन्‍्धाय तस्यां चापि यथा पुरा॥ २६ उसमें भी पूर्ववत् सब कार्य करे

verses.sanskrit: महावृषभनिर्याणो महाजलदनिःस्वनः । महानलसमप्रख्यो महाबलपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: mahAvR^iShabhaniryANo mahAjaladaniHsvanaH | mahAnalasamaprakhyo mahAbalaparAkramaH
verses.translation: Some fell in adversity with their garments, orna¬ ments, weapons and missiles scattered. Eschewing their pride, arrcance and strength they fell evincing signs of dejection.

verses.sanskrit: एवं घोरमहारूपो ब्रह्मपुत्रो महेश्वरः । विज्ञानं ब्रह्मणे दत्त्वा सर्गं सह करोति च
verses.transliteration: evaM ghoramahArUpo brahmaputro maheshvaraH | vij~nAnaM brahmaNe dattvA sargaM saha karoti cha
verses.translation: Destroying Daka's sacrifice, performed in the wrong way, by means of weapons the invincible lord of Ganas shone amidst the leading Gaas like the lion in the midst of bulls.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् रुद्रप्रसादेन प्रतिकल्पं प्रजापतेः । प्रवाहरूपतो नित्या प्रजासृष्टिः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: tasmAd rudraprasAdena pratikalpaM prajApateH | pravAharUpato nityA prajAsR^iShTiH pravartate
verses.translation: Thus the gods headed by Visnu with their bodies split and mutilated attained a miserable plight and trembled. Only a few of them servived.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्प्रार्थितः स्रष्टुं ब्रह्मणा नीललोहितः । स्वात्मना सदृशान् सर्वान् ससर्ज मनसा विभुः
verses.transliteration: kadAchitprArthitaH sraShTuM brahmaNA nIlalohitaH | svAtmanA sadR^ishAn sarvAn sasarja manasA vibhuH
verses.translation: The excessively infuriated Pramathas and Gaas urged by Virabhadra seized the warriors frightened of the battle tying their hands, feet, shoulders and bellies by means of strong iron fetters.

verses.sanskrit: कपर्दिनो निरातङ्कान्नीलग्रीवाँस्त्रिलोचनान् । जरामरणनिर्मुक्तान् दीप्तशूलवरायुधान्
verses.transliteration: kapardino nirAta~NkAnnIlagrIvA.NstrilochanAn | jarAmaraNanirmuktAn dIptashUlavarAyudhAn
verses.translation: In the meantime Brahma who had secured his favour due to his charioteership, implored Bhadra, the devotee of the daughter of Himavat.

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तु सञ्छादितं सर्वं चतुर्दशविधं जगत् । तान्दृष्ट्वा विविधान् रुद्रान् रुद्रमाह पितामहः
verses.transliteration: taistu sa~nChAditaM sarvaM chaturdashavidhaM jagat | tAndR^iShTvA vividhAn rudrAn rudramAha pitAmahaH
verses.translation: "O lord, enough of this fury. The gods arc ruined. Please forgive their faults. O you of auspicious rites.**

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते देवदेवेश मास्राक्षीरीदृशीः प्रजाः । अन्याः सृज त्वं भद्रं ते प्रजा मृत्युसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: namaste devadevesha mAsrAkShIrIdR^ishIH prajAH | anyAH sR^ija tvaM bhadraM te prajA mR^ityusamanvitAH
verses.translation: Implored thus by Brahma the delighted chief of Gaas became calm.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः प्रहसन्प्राह ब्रह्माणं परमेश्वरः । नास्ति मे तादृशः सर्गः सृज त्वमशुभाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: ityuktaH prahasanprAha brahmANaM parameshvaraH | nAsti me tAdR^ishaH sargaH sR^ija tvamashubhAH prajAH
verses.translation: Getting the opportunity through Brahma the gods joined their palms in reverence above their heads and eulogised him by various hymns.

verses.sanskrit: ये त्विमे मनसा सृष्टा महात्मानो महाबलाः । चरिष्यन्ति मया सार्द्धं सर्व एव हि याज्ञिकाः
verses.transliteration: ye tvime manasA sR^iShTA mahAtmAno mahAbalAH | chariShyanti mayA sArddhaM sarva eva hi yAj~nikAH
verses.translation: Obeisance to Siva the quiescent. Obeisance to the trident-bearing destroyer of sacrifice. Obeisance to Bhadra, the lord of Rudras, the wealth and prosperity of Rudras.
verses.hindi: वित्तशाठ्य॑ न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत् शिवमात्मन: ॥ ६३  करे

verses.sanskrit: कल्पे कल्पे प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माण्डसम्भवः । अवृद्धिहेतोर्भूतानां मुमोह भृशदुःखितः
verses.transliteration: kalpe kalpe prajAH sR^iShTvA brahmA brahmANDasambhavaH | avR^iddhihetorbhUtAnAM mumoha bhR^ishaduHkhitaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to Rudra the deity of deadly fire; to the slayer of death and Kama; the remover of the heads of the gods and of the wicked-souled Daka.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे षडध्वशुद्धयादिकथन नामाष्टादशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा विश्वकर्माणं विश्वभूतेश्वरो हरः । सह रुद्रैः प्रजासर्गान्निवृत्तात्माध्यतिष्ठत
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA vishvakarmANaM vishvabhUteshvaro haraH | saha rudraiH prajAsargAnnivR^ittAtmAdhyatiShThata
verses.translation: O hero, incensurable though we are we have been chastised by you in the war due to our association with this sinner Daka.
verses.hindi: आदिका कथन नामक अठारहवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति देवोऽसौ न प्रसूते प्रजाः शुभाः । ऊर्ध्वरेताः स्थितः स्थाणुर्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tataH prabhR^iti devo.asau na prasUte prajAH shubhAH | UrdhvaretAH sthitaH sthANuryAvadAbhUtasamplavam
verses.translation: Siva, the omnipresent lord of the worlds, was stand¬ ing in the firmament along with the Ganas.
verses.hindi: इस बातकी सूचना मैं पहले दे चुका हूँ

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दुःखप्रशान्त्यर्थं प्रजानां च विवृद्धये । तत्तत्कल्पेषु कालात्मा रुद्रो रुद्रगणाधिपः
verses.transliteration: tasya duHkhaprashAntyarthaM prajAnAM cha vivR^iddhaye | tattatkalpeShu kAlAtmA rudro rudragaNAdhipaH
verses.translation: On seeing him the gods headed by Vi?nu were pleased and awe-struck. They bowed to him.

verses.sanskrit: निर्दिष्टः परमेशेन महेशो नीललोहितः । पुत्रो भूत्वानुगृह्णाति ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मणोऽनुजः
verses.transliteration: nirdiShTaH parameshena mahesho nIlalohitaH | putro bhUtvAnugR^ihNAti brahmANaM brahmaNo.anujaH
verses.translation: Seeing them frightened, 8iva the destroyer of the distress of his devotees said laughingly after glancing at Parvati.

verses.sanskrit: स एव भगवानीशस्तेजोराशिरनामयः । अनादिनिधनो धाता भूतसङ्कोचको विभुः
verses.transliteration: sa eva bhagavAnIshastejorAshiranAmayaH | anAdinidhano dhAtA bhUtasa~Nkochako vibhuH
verses.translation: O gods, do not be afraid. You are my own subjects. It is only to bless you that the punishment has been meted out to you by the merciful lord.
verses.hindi: विधान किया है, जो उत्तरोत्तर श्रेष्ठ हैं

verses.sanskrit: परमैश्वर्यसंयुक्तः परमेश्वरभावितः । तच्छक्त्याधिष्ठितः शश्वत्तच्चिह्नैरपि चिह्नितः
verses.transliteration: paramaishvaryasaMyuktaH parameshvarabhAvitaH | tachChaktyAdhiShThitaH shashvattachchihnairapi chihnitaH
verses.translation: The transgression of you the gods has been forgiven by us. When we are infuriated you have neither sustenance nor life.
verses.hindi: मूल, फल और जल--ये आहारके लिये विहित हैं

verses.sanskrit: तन्नामनामा तद्रूपस्तत्कार्यकरणक्षमः । तत्तुल्यव्यवहारश्च तदाज्ञापरिपालकः
verses.transliteration: tannAmanAmA tadrUpastatkAryakaraNakShamaH | tattulyavyavahArashcha tadAj~nAparipAlakaH
verses.translation: Thus spoken to by Siva of unmeasured splendour the gods immediately had their doubts cleared. The gods danced joyously.
verses.hindi: इस साधनमें विशेषरूपसे ऐसा करनेका विधान है

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रादित्यसङ्काशश्चन्द्रावयवभूषणः । भुजङ्गहारकेयूरवलयो मुञ्जमेखलः
verses.transliteration: sahasrAdityasa~NkAshashchandrAvayavabhUShaNaH | bhuja~NgahArakeyUravalayo mu~njamekhalaH
verses.translation: Becoming delighted and excited in their minds with bliss, the gods began to eulogise Siva.'

verses.sanskrit: जलन्धरविरिञ्चेन्द्रकपालशकलोज्ज्वलः । गङ्गातुङ्गतरङ्गार्द्रपिङ्गलाननमूर्द्धजः
verses.transliteration: jalandharaviri~nchendrakapAlashakalojjvalaH | ga~NgAtu~Ngatara~NgArdrapi~NgalAnanamUrddhajaH
verses.translation: O lord assuming the forms of Brahma, Vi mu and Rudra through Rajas, Tamas and Sattva you are the creator, protector and the annihilator of the worlds.
verses.hindi: इहलोक और परलोकमें कुछ भी दुर्लभ नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Simantini whose husband had died, O lord, attained unequalled marital bliss by worshipping you. By performing the holy rites on Mondays she bore sons.
verses.hindi: पाकर अन्तमें मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Simantini whose husband had died, O lord, attained unequalled marital bliss by worshipping you. By performing the holy rites on Mondays she bore sons.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१५. पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः । शिवशिवास्तुतिवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । यदा पुनः प्रजाः सृष्टा न व्यवर्द्धन्त वेधसः । तदा मैथुनजां सृष्टिं ब्रह्मा कर्तुममन्यत
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.15\. pa~nchadasho.adhyAyaH | shivashivAstutivarNanam | vAyuruvAcha | yadA punaH prajAH sR^iShTA na vyavarddhanta vedhasaH | tadA maithunajAM sR^iShTiM brahmA kartumamanyata
verses.translation: The lord gave excellent region to Ankara. You protected Sudarsana from the fear of danger from the hosts of kings.
verses.hindi: बी 040७० माहात्य्य नामक उनीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा परमं देवं तमसः परमव्ययम् । अद्वितीयमनिर्देश्यमदृश्यमकृतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA paramaM devaM tamasaH paramavyayam | advitIyamanirdeshyamadR^ishyamakR^itAtmabhiH
verses.translation: The storehouse of mercy enabled Medura to cross the ocean of worldly existence. By your miraculous activity you enlivened the husband of iSarada.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकविधातारं सर्वलोकेश्वरेश्वरम् । सर्वलोकविधायिन्या शक्त्या परमया युतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalokavidhAtAraM sarvalokeshvareshvaram | sarvalokavidhAyinyA shaktyA paramayA yutam
verses.translation: Destroying the calamity of Bhadrayus you conferred happiness on him. By serving you SauminI became free from worldly bondage.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रतर्क्यमनाभासममेयमजरं ध्रुवम् । अचलं निर्गुणं शान्तमनन्तमहिमास्पदम्
verses.transliteration: apratarkyamanAbhAsamameyamajaraM dhruvam | achalaM nirguNaM shAntamanantamahimAspadam
verses.translation: O iJiiva you are Brahma, Visnu and Siva by means of the Gunas Rajas, Sattva and Tanias. With the desire to bless the people you became the creator, sustainer and the annihilator.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगं सर्वदं सर्वसदसद्व्यक्तिवर्जितम् । सर्वोपमाननिर्मुक्तं शरण्यं शाश्वतं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: sarvagaM sarvadaM sarvasadasadvyaktivarjitam | sarvopamAnanirmuktaM sharaNyaM shAshvataM shivam
verses.translation: You are the destroyer of the arrogance and the brilliance of everyone. You are the hidden secret of all lores, the cause of blessings for all.
verses.hindi: एक सौ आठ मनन कट एव पूर्णाहुति दे॥९-१०॥ एवं पूर्णाहुति दे

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य दण्डवद् ब्रह्मा समुत्थाय कृताञ्जलिः । श्रद्धाविनयसम्पन्नैः श्राव्यैः संस्कारसंयुतैः
verses.transliteration: praNamya daNDavad brahmA samutthAya kR^itA~njaliH | shraddhAvinayasampannaiH shrAvyaiH saMskArasaMyutaiH
verses.translation: O lord, everything originates from you. You are all. Everything is in you. Save us again Please be merci¬ ful on me.

verses.sanskrit: यथार्थयुक्तसर्वार्थैर्वेदार्थपरिबृंहितैः । तुष्टाव देवं देवीं च सूक्तैः सूक्ष्मार्थगोचरैः
verses.transliteration: yathArthayuktasarvArthairvedArthaparibR^iMhitaiH | tuShTAva devaM devIM cha sUktaiH sUkShmArthagocharaiH
verses.translation: In the meantime, getting the opportunity Brahma bowed to him with palms joined in reverence and informed the trident-bearing lord.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । जय देव महादेव जयेश्वर महेश्वर । जय सर्वगुणश्रेष्ठ जय सर्वसुराधिप
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | jaya deva mahAdeva jayeshvara maheshvara | jaya sarvaguNashreShTha jaya sarvasurAdhipa
verses.translation: O lord, be victorious. O destroyer of the distress of your devotees, who else other than you becomes pleased when offences are of this nature?

verses.sanskrit: जय प्रकृतिकल्याणि जय प्रकृतिनायिके । जय प्रकृतिदूरे त्वं जय प्रकृतिसुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: jaya prakR^itikalyANi jaya prakR^itinAyike | jaya prakR^itidUre tvaM jaya prakR^itisundari
verses.translation: Those who are killed in battle will regain their souls. When the lord is delighted who will not revive?

verses.sanskrit: जयामोघमहामाय जयामोघमनोरथ । जयामोघमहालील जयामोघमहाबल
verses.transliteration: jayAmoghamahAmAya jayAmoghamanoratha | jayAmoghamahAlIla jayAmoghamahAbala
verses.translation: The fault in the offences committed by the gods, O lord, is actually a blessing because of the weightiness of your acceptance. I consider so.

verses.sanskrit: जय विश्वजगन्मातर्जय विश्वजगन्मयि । जय विश्वजगद्धात्रि जय विश्वजगत्सखि
verses.transliteration: jaya vishvajaganmAtarjaya vishvajaganmayi | jaya vishvajagaddhAtri jaya vishvajagatsakhi
verses.translation: When Brahma implored thus, the lord smiled and glanced at the face of the goddess. As a result of his affection to Brahma who was like a son unto him, the lord revived the gods to life.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तस्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे विशेषादिसंस्कृतिनाम विंशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: न निर्गतं पुरा यस्मान्नारीणां कुलमीश्वरात् । तेन मैथुनजां सृष्टिं न शशाक पितामहः
verses.transliteration: na nirgataM purA yasmAnnArINAM kulamIshvarAt | tena maithunajAM sR^iShTiM na shashAka pitAmahaH
verses.translation: He restored the goddesses — mothers of the gods who had been punished by the Pramathas and others.
verses.hindi: विशेषादिसंस्कृति नामक बीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: जय शाश्वतिकैश्वर्य जय शाश्वतिकालय । जय शाश्वतिकाकार जय शाश्वतिकानुग
verses.transliteration: jaya shAshvatikaishvarya jaya shAshvatikAlaya | jaya shAshvatikAkAra jaya shAshvatikAnuga
verses.translation: Lord Brahma made the face of Dak 9a look like the the face of an old goat as a befitting punishment for his sins.
verses.hindi: शिवशास्त्रोदितं कर्म नित्यनैमित्तिकं तथा॥ ९ सुनना चाहता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: जयात्मत्रयनिर्मात्रि जयात्मत्रयपालिनि । जयात्मत्रयसंहर्त्रि जयात्मत्रयनायिके
verses.transliteration: jayAtmatrayanirmAtri jayAtmatrayapAlini | jayAtmatrayasaMhartri jayAtmatrayanAyike
verses.translation: O lord of the universe, O cause of the blessing for the worlds, O lord, be merciful. Forgive my guilt.

verses.sanskrit: जयावलोकनायत्तजगत्कारणबृंहण । जयोपेक्षाकटाक्षोत्थहुतभुग्भुक्तभौतिक
verses.transliteration: jayAvalokanAyattajagatkAraNabR^iMhaNa | jayopekShAkaTAkShotthahutabhugbhuktabhautika
verses.translation: You are the creator, protector and the annihilator of the worlds. This has been known by me particularly. You are the lord of Visnu and all others.

verses.sanskrit: जय देवाद्यविज्ञेये स्वात्मसूक्ष्मदृशोज्ज्वले । जय स्थूलात्मशक्त्येशे जय व्याप्तचराचरे
verses.transliteration: jaya devAdyavij~neye svAtmasUkShmadR^ishojjvale | jaya sthUlAtmashaktyeshe jaya vyAptacharAchare
verses.translation: The lord, the storehouse of mercy glanced at the guilty one who was emotionally distressed and smilingly said "Do not fear".

verses.sanskrit: जय नानैकविन्यस्तविश्वतत्त्वसमुच्चय । जयासुरशिरोनिष्ठश्रेष्ठानुगकदम्बक
verses.transliteration: jaya nAnaikavinyastavishvatattvasamuchchaya | jayAsurashironiShThashreShThAnugakadambaka
verses.translation: Saying so and with a desire to please his father Brahma, the lord bestowed on Daksa the imperishable chief- tancy of the Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: जयोपाश्रितसंरक्षासंविधानपटीयसि । जयोन्मूलितसंसारविषवृक्षाङ्कुरोद्गमे
verses.transliteration: jayopAshritasaMrakShAsaMvidhAnapaTIyasi | jayonmUlitasaMsAraviShavR^ikShA~Nkurodgame
verses.translation: Then Brahma and other gods saluted the lord with palms joined in reverence. In words of humility they eulogised the lord.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सत्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे वि न उततरखणड :

verses.sanskrit: जय प्रादेशिकैश्वर्यवीर्यशौर्यविजृम्भण । जय विश्वबहिर्भूत निरस्तपरवैभव
verses.transliteration: jaya prAdeshikaishvaryavIryashauryavijR^imbhaNa | jaya vishvabahirbhUta nirastaparavaibhava
verses.translation: O Siva, O lord of the gods of the distressed and the helpless, O great lord, be merciful, forgive our guilt.
verses.hindi: कर्मवर्णन नामक इक्कीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: जय प्रणीतपञ्चार्थप्रयोगपरमामृत । जय पञ्चार्थविज्ञानसुधास्रोतःस्वरूपिणि
verses.transliteration: jaya praNItapa~nchArthaprayogaparamAmR^ita | jaya pa~nchArthavij~nAnasudhAsrotaHsvarUpiNi
verses.translation: O protector of sacrifices, O lord of sacrifices, O destroyer of sacrifices, O MaheSana, forgive our guilt.

verses.sanskrit: जयातिघोरसंसारमहारोगभिषग्वर । जयानादिमलाज्ञानतमःपटलचन्द्रिके
verses.transliteration: jayAtighorasaMsAramahArogabhiShagvara | jayAnAdimalAj~nAnatamaHpaTalachandrike
verses.translation: O lord of the gods, O great lord, O nourisher of the vital breath of your devotees, O lord, bestower of punish¬ ment on the wicked, be merciful. Obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: जय त्रिपुरकालाग्ने जय त्रिपुरभैरवि । जय त्रिगुणनिर्मुक्ते जय त्रिगुणमर्दिनि
verses.transliteration: jaya tripurakAlAgne jaya tripurabhairavi | jaya triguNanirmukte jaya triguNamardini
verses.translation: O lord, you remove the arrogance of the wicked who do not know you. You arc the protector of the good whose minds are devoted to you.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स विदधे बुद्धिमर्थनिश्चयगामिनीम् । प्रजानमेव वृद्ध्यर्थं प्रष्टव्यः परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: tataH sa vidadhe buddhimarthanishchayagAminIm | prajAnameva vR^iddhyarthaM praShTavyaH parameshvara
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by Brahma and other gods lord iva, the ocean of mercy, favourably disposed towards the devotees was pleased.

verses.sanskrit: जय प्रथमसर्वज्ञ जय सर्वप्रबोधिके । जय प्रचुरदिव्याङ्ग जय प्रार्थितदायिनि
verses.transliteration: jaya prathamasarvaj~na jaya sarvaprabodhike | jaya prachuradivyA~Nga jaya prArthitadAyini
verses.translation: Siva favourably disposed to the distressed blessed Brahma and other gods and delightedly granted them boons.
verses.hindi: नित्य-नैमित्तिककर्मवर्णन नामक बाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: क्व देव ते परं धाम क्व च तुच्छं च नो वचः । तथापि भगवन् भक्त्या प्रलपन्तं क्षमस्व माम्
verses.transliteration: kva deva te paraM dhAma kva cha tuchChaM cha no vachaH | tathApi bhagavan bhaktyA pralapantaM kShamasva mAm
verses.translation: Then the merciful lord who made their fear subside addressed the gods who had sought refuge in him, with words characterised by smile.
verses.hindi: है पप्ड हि आसनकी कल्पना करे

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाप्यैवंविधैः सूक्तैर्विश्वकर्मा चतुर्मुखः । नमश्चकार रुद्राय रद्राण्यै च मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: vij~nApyaivaMvidhaiH sUktairvishvakarmA chaturmukhaH | namashchakAra rudrAya radrANyai cha muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: On seeing you all seeking refuge in me your entire guilt and sin committed as if urged by fate, has been excused by us.
verses.hindi: षड्विंशकाभिधानां वा श्रीकंठाख्यामथापि वा॥ १८ षड्विंशका अथवा “श्रीकण्ठ' हो

verses.sanskrit: इदं स्तोत्रवरं पुण्यं ब्रह्मणा समुदीरितम् । अर्द्धनारीश्वरं नाम शिवयोर्हर्षवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: idaM stotravaraM puNyaM brahmaNA samudIritam | arddhanArIshvaraM nAma shivayorharShavarddhanam
verses.translation: O gods headed by Visnu, Brahma and Indra return happily to Devapura* unmindful of the present suppression and without the sense of shame in your minds.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं कीर्त्तयेद्भक्त्या यस्य कस्यापि काङ्क्षया । स तत्फलमवाप्नोति शिवयोः प्रीतिकारणात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM kIrttayedbhaktyA yasya kasyApi kA~NkShayA | sa tatphalamavApnoti shivayoH prItikAraNAt
verses.translation: Saying this to the gods lord Siva the destroyer of jthe sacrifice performed by Daksa, along with Siva, his attendants and followers disappeared even as he stood in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: सकलभुवनभूतभावनाभ्यां जननविनाशविहीनविग्रहाभ्याम् । नरवरयुवतीवपुर्द्धराभ्यां सततमहं प्रणतोऽस्मि शङ्कराभ्याम्
verses.transliteration: sakalabhuvanabhUtabhAvanAbhyAM jananavinAshavihInavigrahAbhyAm | naravarayuvatIvapurddharAbhyAM satatamahaM praNato.asmi sha~NkarAbhyAm
verses.translation: The gods loo returned through the aerial path, free

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादेन विना तस्य न वर्द्धेरन्निमाः प्रजाः । एवं सञ्चिन्त्य विश्वात्मा तपः कर्तुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: prasAdena vinA tasya na varddherannimAH prajAH | evaM sa~nchintya vishvAtmA tapaH kartuM prachakrame
verses.translation: Where did Siva who vanished along with the goddess and his attendants go? Where did he stay? W'hat did he do and not do?

verses.sanskrit: तदाद्या परमा शक्तिरनन्ता लोकभाविनी । आद्या सूक्ष्मतरा शुद्धा भावगम्या मनोहरा
verses.transliteration: tadAdyA paramA shaktiranantA lokabhAvinI | AdyA sUkShmatarA shuddhA bhAvagamyA manoharA
verses.translation: The excellent mountain Mandara*® with different caves became the pleasing spot of penance for lord l§iva.
verses.hindi: उन सभी पवित्र द्र॒व्योंको उनमें डाले

verses.sanskrit: निर्गुणा निष्प्रपञ्चा च निष्कला निरुपप्लवा । निरन्तररता नित्या नित्यमीश्वरपार्श्वगा
verses.transliteration: nirguNA niShprapa~nchA cha niShkalA nirupaplavA | nirantararatA nityA nityamIshvarapArshvagA
verses.translation: He had performed a great penance for the previlege to support Siva and Siva on his head. After a long time he felt the pleasure of contact with their lotus like feet..
verses.hindi: आदि एवं शीतल मनोज्ञ पुष्प आदि छोड़े

verses.sanskrit: तया परमया शक्त्या भगवन्तं त्रियम्बकम् । सञ्चिन्त्य हृदये ब्रह्मा तताप परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: tayA paramayA shaktyA bhagavantaM triyambakam | sa~nchintya hR^idaye brahmA tatApa paramaM tapaH
verses.translation: The beauty of the mountain canmjt be mentioned in detail by persons with thousand faces even in hundreds of crores of years.

verses.sanskrit: तीव्रेण तपसा तस्य युक्तस्य परमेष्ठिनः । अचिरेणैव कालेन पिता सम्प्रतुतोष ह
verses.transliteration: tIvreNa tapasA tasya yuktasya parameShThinaH | achireNaiva kAlena pitA sampratutoSha ha
verses.translation: The slopes of the mountain abounding in rocks and trees humiliate the universe due to the' perpetual presence of 8iva and Siva.
verses.hindi: आराधना करके उन्हें पूर्वोक्त निर्माल्य अर्पित करे

verses.sanskrit: ततः केनचिदंशेन मूर्तिमाविश्य कामपि । अर्द्धनारीश्वरो भूत्वा ययौ देवः स्वयं हरः
verses.transliteration: tataH kenachidaMshena mUrtimAvishya kAmapi | arddhanArIshvaro bhUtvA yayau devaH svayaM haraH
verses.translation: The mountain renders help to the parents of the worlds with light and clean waters of the streams cool to
verses.hindi: जो शुद्ध विद्यासे अत्यन्त प्रकाशमान हो

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: In the morning when the sun rises, the mountain embellished with jewels and gems appears to be eager for observing the beauty of his body in a mirror.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: In the morning when the sun rises, the mountain embellished with jewels and gems appears to be eager for observing the beauty of his body in a mirror.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१६. षोडशोऽध्यायः । देवीशक्त्युद्भवः । वायुरुवाच । अथ देवो महादेवो महाजलदनादया । वाचा मधुरगम्भीरशिवदश्लक्ष्णवर्णया
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.16\. ShoDasho.adhyAyaH | devIshaktyudbhavaH | vAyuruvAcha | atha devo mahAdevo mahAjaladanAdayA | vAchA madhuragambhIrashivadashlakShNavarNayA
verses.translation: This king of mountains appears to be honoured with benedictions of victory by the trees that seem to be sages with the twining growths of creepers for the matted hair; through the chirping of vociferous birds, by extending their arms in the form of creepers shaken by the breeze and shedding flowers and tender sprouts.
verses.hindi: संस्नाप्यालिप्य पिष्टाद्ये: स्नापयेदुष्णवारिभि: ॥ ४९ जलसे शिवलिंगको नहलाये

verses.sanskrit: या सा जगदिदं कृत्स्नं महिम्ना व्याप्य तिष्ठति । शरीरिणीव स देवी विचित्रं समलक्ष्यत
verses.transliteration: yA sA jagadidaM kR^itsnaM mahimnA vyApya tiShThati | sharIriNIva sa devI vichitraM samalakShyata
verses.translation: With the various peaks.some facing down, some shooting up and some projecting sideways he appears to jump into the nether worlds, jump up from the ground, fly through the sky in all directions. Through the vast caves he appears to have kept his mouth gaping. He appears to see the universe and dance continuously. His beauty never fades nor wears out. He appears to stretch himself to devour the universe, to drink the ocean; to vomit the darkness within and to cover up the sky with clouds.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं जगदिदं चैषा सम्मोहयति मायया । ईश्वरात्सैव जाताऽभूदजाता परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: sarvaM jagadidaM chaiShA sammohayati mAyayA | IshvarAtsaiva jAtA.abhUdajAtA paramArthataH
verses.translation: The different abodes have mirror-like surface. The tall shady trees in the hermitages set the blazing sunshine at nought.

verses.sanskrit: न यस्याः परमो भावः सुराणामपि गोचरः । विश्वामरेश्वरी चैव विभक्ता भर्तुरङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: na yasyAH paramo bhAvaH surANAmapi gocharaH | vishvAmareshvarI chaiva vibhaktA bhartura~NgataH
verses.translation: The breezes made cool by their contact with the rivers, tanks and lakes are rendered fruitful by Siva and Siva who roam here and there and enjoy them.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा परमेशानीं सर्वलोकमहेश्वरीम् । सर्वज्ञां सर्वगां सूक्ष्मां सदसद्व्यक्तिवर्जिताम्
verses.transliteration: tAM dR^iShTvA parameshAnIM sarvalokamaheshvarIm | sarvaj~nAM sarvagAM sUkShmAM sadasadvyaktivarjitAm
verses.translation: Reaching the garden there along with the goddess, lord iSiva sported about in the divine harem grounds.

verses.sanskrit: परमां निखिलं भासा भासयन्तीमिदं जगत् । प्रणिपत्य महादेवीं प्रार्थयामास वै विराट्
verses.transliteration: paramAM nikhilaM bhAsA bhAsayantImidaM jagat | praNipatya mahAdevIM prArthayAmAsa vai virAT
verses.translation: As time elapsed and population increased, two demons were born. They were two brothers Sumbha and Niumbha.
verses.hindi: ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अन्त सातवा- ललए नाम चतुर्विशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । देवि देवेन सृष्टोऽहमादौ सर्वजगन्मयि । प्रजासर्गे नियुक्तश्च सृजामि सकलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | devi devena sR^iShTo.ahamAdau sarvajaganmayi | prajAsarge niyuktashcha sR^ijAmi sakalaM jagat
verses.translation: As a result of the power of their penance Brahma granted them the boon that they would not be killed by any man in the universe.

verses.sanskrit: मनसा निर्मिताः सर्वे देवि देवादयो मया । न वृद्धिमुपगच्छन्ति सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: manasA nirmitAH sarve devi devAdayo mayA | na vR^iddhimupagachChanti sR^ijyamAnAH punaH punaH
verses.translation: Brahma vas requested by them thus — "Our death may take place in a battle with the lady with whom we fall passionately in love. She shall be a virgin born of Siva's part, not from any womb. She should not have ex¬ perienced the sexual contact with any man. Her exploit shall be unthwartable." Brahma had consented to their request.

verses.sanskrit: मिथुनप्रभवामेव कृत्वा सृष्टिमतः परम् । संवर्धयितुमिच्छामि सर्वा एव मम प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: mithunaprabhavAmeva kR^itvA sR^iShTimataH param | saMvardhayitumichChAmi sarvA eva mama prajAH
verses.translation: Ever since, the two demons wrought havoc in the universe. They defeated Indra and other gods in war. They abolished the study of the Vedas and offering to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: न निर्गतं पुरा त्वत्तो नारीणां कुलमव्ययम् । तेन नारीकुलं स्रष्टुं शक्तिर्मम न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: na nirgataM purA tvatto nArINAM kulamavyayam | tena nArIkulaM sraShTuM shaktirmama na vidyate
verses.translation: Then Brahma requested Siva, the lord of the gods for killing them — "It behoves you to bestow on the gods the goddess who will kill l§umbha and Nisumbha. She shall be the Sakti born of the sheath of Siva's colour. She shall be in the form of a virgin devoid of passion. By rebuking her secretly or by infuriating her this shall be arranged.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासामेव शक्तीनां त्वत्तः खलु समुद्भवः । तस्मात्सर्वत्र सर्वेषां सर्वशक्तिप्रदायिनीम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAsAmeva shaktInAM tvattaH khalu samudbhavaH | tasmAtsarvatra sarveShAM sarvashaktipradAyinIm
verses.translation: Thui icquested by Brahma, the lord Nilalohita called Kali in secret outwardly rebuking her while smiling within. The goddess Kali was angry by her allusion to the colour. Derisively and forcibly she spoke to her husband thus.
verses.hindi: दरवाजेके फाटक सोनेके बने हुए हों

verses.sanskrit: अर्थसम्पन्नपदया राजलक्षणयुक्तया । अशेषविषयारम्भरक्षाविमलयदक्षया
verses.transliteration: arthasampannapadayA rAjalakShaNayuktayA | asheShaviShayArambharakShAvimalayadakShayA
verses.translation: "If my lord has no pleasure in my complexion Imw is it that I have been held up here so long.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामेव वरदां मायां प्रार्थयामि सुरेश्वरीम् । चराचरविवृद्ध्यर्थमंशेनैकेन सर्वगे
verses.transliteration: tvAmeva varadAM mAyAM prArthayAmi sureshvarIm | charAcharavivR^iddhyarthamaMshenaikena sarvage
verses.translation: The life of the lady most beautiful in limbs is in vain though she may possess all other qualities if her husband is not delighted with her.
verses.hindi: उसे शिवका पूजन नहीं करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: दक्षस्य मम पुत्रस्य पुत्री भव भवार्दिनि । एवं सा याचिता देवी ब्रह्मणा ब्रह्मयोनिना
verses.transliteration: dakShasya mama putrasya putrI bhava bhavArdini | evaM sA yAchitA devI brahmaNA brahmayoninA
verses.translation: The creation of women rests solely in the enjoyment of her husband. That being the case, where can a woman who is contrary to that be used?

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिमेकां भ्रुवोर्मध्यात् ससर्जात्मसमप्रभाम् । तामाह प्रहसन् प्रेक्ष्य देवदेववरो हरः
verses.transliteration: shaktimekAM bhruvormadhyAt sasarjAtmasamaprabhAm | tAmAha prahasan prekShya devadevavaro haraH
verses.translation: Hence, eschewing this colour censured by you in secret I shall attain another colour or I shall cease to exist myself."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं तपसाराध्य कुरु तस्य यथेप्सितम् । तामाज्ञां परमेशस्य शिरसा प्रतिगृह्य सा
verses.transliteration: brahmANaM tapasArAdhya kuru tasya yathepsitam | tAmAj~nAM parameshasya shirasA pratigR^ihya sA
verses.translation: After saying this she stood up from the bed. Bent upon ijenance she requested for the permission of her lord in words choked with emotion.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीश्िवमहाएुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे शिवशास्त्रेक्तए॒जनवर्णन नाम पञ्मविंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो वचनाद्देवी दक्षस्य दुहिताऽभवत् । दत्त्वैवमतुलां शक्तिं ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaNo vachanAddevI dakShasya duhitA.abhavat | dattvaivamatulAM shaktiM brahmaNe brahmarUpiNIm
verses.translation: Then lord Siva, afraid of a rupture in love, replied to her falling at her feet.
verses.hindi: पूजनवर्णन नामक पचीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: विवेश देहं देवस्य देवश्चान्तरधीयत । तदाप्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन् स्त्रियां भोगः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: vivesha dehaM devasya devashchAntaradhIyata | tadAprabhR^iti loke.asmin striyAM bhogaH pratiShThitaH
verses.translation: "O beloved, why are you angry with me, not know¬ ing that this was only a jocular remark of mine. If I am not delighted with you, where else can I seek delight?

verses.sanskrit: प्रजासृष्टिश्च विप्रेन्द्रा मैथुनेन प्रवर्तते । ब्रह्मापि प्राप सानन्दं सन्तोषं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: prajAsR^iShTishcha viprendrA maithunena pravartate | brahmApi prApa sAnandaM santoShaM munipu~NgavAH
verses.translation: If I am not delighted with you how can it be proper since you are mother of this universe and I am its father and lord?

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं देव्याः शक्तिसमुद्भवम् । पुण्यवृद्धिकरं श्राव्यं भूतसर्गानुषङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: etadvaH sarvamAkhyAtaM devyAH shaktisamudbhavam | puNyavR^iddhikaraM shrAvyaM bhUtasargAnuSha~NgataH
verses.translation: Is our mutual love generated by Kama? Even before the birth of Kama the universe existed.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं कीर्तयेन्नित्यं देव्याः शक्तिसमुद्भवम् । पुण्यं सर्वमवाप्नोति पुत्रांश्च लभते शुभान्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM kIrtayennityaM devyAH shaktisamudbhavam | puNyaM sarvamavApnoti putrAMshcha labhate shubhAn
verses.translation: The mind- born Kama considered me on a par with the gods. While he attempted to tease me I reduced him to ashes.

verses.sanskrit: मनोहरतरोदारमधुरस्मितपूर्वया । सम्बभाषेसुसम्प्रीतो विश्वकर्माणमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: manoharatarodAramadhurasmitapUrvayA | sambabhAShesusamprIto vishvakarmANamIshvaraH
verses.translation: That purpose ere long will be revealed to you." On hearing this the goddess, remembered the remark that caused her annoyance and said.
verses.hindi: करता है तो उसे मोक्ष प्राप्त होता है

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । वत्स वत्स महाभाग मम पुत्र पितामह । ज्ञातमेव मया सर्वं तव वाक्यस्य गौरवम्
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | vatsa vatsa mahAbhAga mama putra pitAmaha | j~nAtameva mayA sarvaM tava vAkyasya gauravam
verses.translation: Even an auspicious lady of a noble family who does not abandon her life incurs the displeasure of her husband and is held despicable by good men.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानामेव वृद्ध्यर्थं तपस्तप्तं त्वयाधुना । तपसानेन तुष्टोऽस्मि ददामि च तवेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: prajAnAmeva vR^iddhyarthaM tapastaptaM tvayAdhunA | tapasAnena tuShTo.asmi dadAmi cha tavepsitam
verses.translation: I do not wish to have any other colour either at your will or at my choice. I shall propitiate Brahma by penance and become Gauri.
verses.hindi: आदिके। द्वारा मनुष्य मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा परमोदारं स्वभावमधुरं वचः । ससर्ज वपुषो भागाद्देवीं देववरो हरः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA paramodAraM svabhAvamadhuraM vachaH | sasarja vapuSho bhAgAddevIM devavaro haraH
verses.translation: O goddess, Brahma attained his status formerly by my grace. What will you do by invoking him through your pen?'nce?

verses.sanskrit: यामाहुर्ब्रह्मविद्वांसो देवीं दिव्यगुणान्विताम् । परस्य परमां शक्तिं भवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yAmAhurbrahmavidvAMso devIM divyaguNAnvitAm | parasya paramAM shaktiM bhavasya paramAtmanaH
verses.translation: True that Brahma and other gods acquired their status only from you. Still at your bidding I propitiated Brahma formerly and in the name of Sati I became Dakfa's daughter and attained you, the lord of the worlds, as my husband.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यां न खलु विद्यन्ते जन्ममृत्युजरादयः । या भवानी भवस्याङ्गात्समाविरभवत्किल
verses.transliteration: yasyAM na khalu vidyante janmamR^ityujarAdayaH | yA bhavAnI bhavasyA~NgAtsamAvirabhavatkila
verses.translation: Thus replied to by the goddess, Siva did not insist on his point as he desired to carry out the task of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: यस्या वाचो निवर्तन्ते मनसा चेन्द्रियैः सह । सा भर्तुर्वपुषो भागाज्जातेव समदृश्यत
verses.transliteration: yasyA vAcho nivartante manasA chendriyaiH saha | sA bharturvapuSho bhAgAjjAteva samadR^ishyata
verses.translation: Then circumambulating the lord and restraining the pangs of separation she went to the mountain Himavat.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: She visited her parents at their house and bowed to them. Informing them of her intention and securing their permission she went to the penance-grove and discarded her ornaments. She took her bath and assumed the holy dress and features of ascetics. She performed the very difficult penance. She meditated upon the lotus-like feet of her lord. She conceived the same in Siva's external phallic emblem in accordance with the injunctions. In the three junctions of time every day she worshipped the same with the flowers and fruits of the forest. Thinking thus — "He alone, after assuming the form of Brahma, will grant me the fruit of this penance", she conducted the penance.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: She visited her parents at their house and bowed to them. Informing them of her intention and securing their permission she went to the penance-grove and discarded her ornaments. She took her bath and assumed the holy dress and features of ascetics. She performed the very difficult penance. She meditated upon the lotus-like feet of her lord. She conceived the same in Siva's external phallic emblem in accordance with the injunctions. In the three junctions of time every day she worshipped the same with the flowers and fruits of the forest. Thinking thus — "He alone, after assuming the form of Brahma, will grant me the fruit of this penance", she conducted the penance.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१७. सप्तदशोऽध्यायः । सृष्टिकथनम् । वायुरुवाच । एवं लब्ध्वा परां शक्तिमीश्वरादेव शाश्वतीम् । मैथुनप्रभवां सृष्टिं कर्तृकामः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.17\. saptadasho.adhyAyaH | sR^iShTikathanam | vAyuruvAcha | evaM labdhvA parAM shaktimIshvarAdeva shAshvatIm | maithunaprabhavAM sR^iShTiM kartR^ikAmaH prajApatiH
verses.translation: After some time had elapsed, seeing her performing the penance a huge tiger approached her with wicked inten¬ tion.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धा लक्ष्मीर्धृतिः पुष्टिस्तुष्टिर्मेधा क्रिया तथा । बुद्धिर्लज्जा वपुः शान्तिस्सिद्धिः कीर्तिस्त्रयोदशी
verses.transliteration: shraddhA lakShmIrdhR^itiH puShTistuShTirmedhA kriyA tathA | buddhirlajjA vapuH shAntissiddhiH kIrtistrayodashI
verses.translation: The body of that animal of wicked soul became stiff and benumbed when he approached her.
verses.hindi: अग्निमें मण्डलाकार होकर लीन हुए हैं

verses.sanskrit: पत्न्यर्थं प्रतिजग्राह धर्मो दाक्षायणीः प्रभुः । ताभ्यः शिष्टा यवीयस्य एकादश सुलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: patnyarthaM pratijagrAha dharmo dAkShAyaNIH prabhuH | tAbhyaH shiShTA yavIyasya ekAdasha sulochanAH
verses.translation: Even after seeing the tiger that approached her with wicked intention the goddess did not turn away from her pious thoughts like ordinary people.
verses.hindi: देनेके पश्चात् अग्निमें जलका सेचन करे

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातिः सत्यथ सम्भूतिः स्मृतिः प्रीतिः क्षमा तथा । सन्नतिश्चानसूया च ऊर्जा स्वाहा स्वधा तथा
verses.transliteration: khyAtiH satyatha sambhUtiH smR^itiH prItiH kShamA tathA | sannatishchAnasUyA cha UrjA svAhA svadhA tathA
verses.translation: The animal with his body stunned and overwhelmed with hunger, stood there in front of her glancing perpetually at the goddess and thought, "My prey is nothing else.*' Virtually this became his cherished goal.
verses.hindi: जौके तुल्य घीकी धाराकी आहुति दे

verses.sanskrit: भृगुः शर्वो मरीचिश्च अङ्गिराः पुलहः क्रतुः । पुलस्त्योऽत्रिर्वशिष्ठश्च पावकः पितरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhR^iguH sharvo marIchishcha a~NgirAH pulahaH kratuH | pulastyo.atrirvashiShThashcha pAvakaH pitarastathA
verses.translation: By this feeling of mercy the threefold dirt of the tiger perished and he realised the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: ख्यात्याद्या जगृहुः कन्या मुनयो मुनिसत्तमाः । कामाद्यास्तु यशोऽन्ता ये ते त्रयोदश सूनवः
verses.transliteration: khyAtyAdyA jagR^ihuH kanyA munayo munisattamAH | kAmAdyAstu yasho.antA ye te trayodasha sUnavaH
verses.translation: His hunger receded. The benumbed stiflhess subsided. His congenital wickedness disappeared. Content¬ ment set in.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्य जज्ञिरे तास्तु श्रद्धाद्याः सुसुखोत्तराः । दुःखोत्तराश्च हिंसायामधर्मस्य च सन्ततौ
verses.transliteration: dharmasya jaj~nire tAstu shraddhAdyAH susukhottarAH | duHkhottarAshcha hiMsAyAmadharmasya cha santatau
verses.translation: Realising his contentment with great piety he waited upon the goddess as a sudden devotee.

verses.sanskrit: निकृत्यादय उत्पन्नाः पुत्राश्च धर्मलक्षणाः । नैषां भार्याश्च पुत्रा वा सर्वे त्वनियमाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: nikR^ityAdaya utpannAH putrAshcha dharmalakShaNAH | naiShAM bhAryAshcha putrA vA sarve tvaniyamAH smR^itAH
verses.translation: He roamed about the penance-grove as a router of wicked animals and wicked souls.
verses.hindi: पुरुष 'मैं ही शिव हूँ” ऐसी बुद्धि न करे

verses.sanskrit: स एष तामसः सर्गो जज्ञे धर्मनियामकः । या सा दक्षस्य दुहिता रुद्रस्य दयिता सती
verses.transliteration: sa eSha tAmasaH sargo jaj~ne dharmaniyAmakaH | yA sA dakShasya duhitA rudrasya dayitA satI
verses.translation: The penance of the goddess increased and became gradually acute. Meanwhile the gods sought refuge in Brahma due to the pressure of the Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: भर्तृनिन्दाप्रसङ्गेन त्यक्त्वा दाक्षायिणीं तनुम् । दक्षं च दक्षभार्य्यां च विनिन्द्य सह बन्धुभिः
verses.transliteration: bhartR^inindAprasa~Ngena tyaktvA dAkShAyiNIM tanum | dakShaM cha dakShabhAryyAM cha vinindya saha bandhubhiH
verses.translation: The gods submitted to him how 8umbha and Nisumbha inflicted pain on them due to their strength derived from the boons.
verses.hindi: हि हम 7याम॒त्तखण्डे अग्रिकार्यवर्णन॑ नाम सप्तविशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: सा मेनायामाविरभूत्पुत्री हिमवतो गिरेः । रुद्रस्तु तां सतीं दृष्ट्वा रुद्रांस्त्वात्मसमप्रभान्
verses.transliteration: sA menAyAmAvirabhUtputrI himavato gireH | rudrastu tAM satIM dR^iShTvA rudrAMstvAtmasamaprabhAn
verses.translation: Brahma saw the goddess, the mother of this universe, the mother of Trinity, the daughter of the lord of mountains, the foundation of the universe, firmly engaged in penance. On seeing her he was delighted.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयमप्यर्द्धतो नारी चार्द्धेन पुरुषोऽभवत् । यार्द्धेन नारी सा तस्माच्छतरूपा व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: svayamapyarddhato nArI chArddhena puruSho.abhavat | yArddhena nArI sA tasmAchChatarUpA vyajAyata
verses.translation: On seeing that Brahma had come along with the gods, the goddess offered him Arghya and received him with words of welcome.

verses.sanskrit: यथाऽसृजदसङ्ख्यातांस्तथा कथितमेव च । भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुत्पन्ना लक्ष्मीर्नारायणप्रिया
verses.transliteration: yathA.asR^ijadasa~NkhyAtAMstathA kathitameva cha | bhR^igoH khyAtyAM samutpannA lakShmIrnArAyaNapriyA
verses.translation: Replying suitably and congratulating her the lotus-born Brahma asked her the purpose of her penance as though he did not know.
verses.hindi: कर्तव्या महती पूजा हाधिका वापि शक्तितः॥ ३  जा शिवकी महापूजा करनी चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: देवौ धातृविधातारौ मन्वन्तरविधारिणौ । तयोर्वै पुत्रपौत्राद्याः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: devau dhAtR^ividhAtArau manvantaravidhAriNau | tayorvai putrapautrAdyAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
verses.translation: The fruit of the penance has been obtained by you in having obtained lord Siva as your husband, who alone is the lord of all worlds.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे नीताः सर्वे ते भार्गवा मताः । मरीचेरपि सम्भूतिः पौर्णमासमसूयत
verses.transliteration: svAyambhuve.antare nItAH sarve te bhArgavA matAH | marIcherapi sambhUtiH paurNamAsamasUyata
verses.translation: When at the beginning of creation as men¬ tioned in the Vedas you are born of lord Siva you are the first of my creation, my first-born son.
verses.hindi: ति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे तित्यनैमित्तिकर्वि: 225 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: कन्याचतुष्टयं चैव महीयांसस्तदन्वयाः । येषां वंशे समुत्पन्नो बहुपुत्रस्य कश्यपः
verses.transliteration: kanyAchatuShTayaM chaiva mahIyAMsastadanvayAH | yeShAM vaMshe samutpanno bahuputrasya kashyapaH
verses.translation: When for multiplying the subjects, Siva was born of your forehead you became my father-in-law and so elder to me.
verses.hindi: नित्यनैमित्तिकविधिवर्णन नामक अद्डाईसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: स्मृतिश्चाङ्गिरसः पत्नी जनयामास वै सुतौ । आग्नीध्रं शरभञ्चैव तथा कन्याचतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: smR^itishchA~NgirasaH patnI janayAmAsa vai sutau | AgnIdhraM sharabha~nchaiva tathA kanyAchatuShTayam
verses.translation: When the lord of mountains, my father became your son you became my grandfather, O grandfather of the worlds!
verses.hindi: मन्द मुसकानकी छटा छा रही है

verses.sanskrit: तदीयाः पुत्रपौत्राश्च येऽतीतास्ते सहस्रशः । प्रीत्यां पुलस्त्यभार्यायां दन्तोऽग्निरभवत्सुतः । पूर्वजन्मनि योऽगस्त्यः स्मृतः स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: tadIyAH putrapautrAshcha ye.atItAste sahasrashaH | prItyAM pulastyabhAryAyAM danto.agnirabhavatsutaH | pUrvajanmani yo.agastyaH smR^itaH svAyambhuve.antare
verses.translation: How can I inform you, the arranger of worldly existence what happened at the harem with my husband?
verses.hindi: पाश तथा अंकुश उनकी शोभा बढ़ाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: तत्सन्ततीया बहवः पौलस्त्या इति विश्रुताः । क्षमा तु सुषुवे पुत्रान् पुलहस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: tatsantatIyA bahavaH paulastyA iti vishrutAH | kShamA tu suShuve putrAn pulahasya prajApateH
verses.translation: O goddess, why did you perform a severe penance for this purpose? Was not your wish alone sufficient for that? Indeed this is only your sport

verses.sanskrit: कर्दमश्चासुरिश्चैव सहिष्णुश्चेति ते त्रयः । त्रेताग्निवर्चसः सर्वे येषां वंशः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: kardamashchAsurishchaiva sahiShNushcheti te trayaH | tretAgnivarchasaH sarve yeShAM vaMshaH pratiShThitaH
verses.translation: O mother of the universe, your play too benefits the worlds. Hence some benefit pleasing to me may be sought through it.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामुत्तरखण्डे काम्यकर्मवर्णन॑ नामेकोनत्रिंशत्तमो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: क्रतोः क्रतुसमान्भार्या सन्नतिः सुषुवे सुतान् । नैषां भार्याश्च पुत्राश्च सर्वे ते ह्यूर्ध्वरेतसः
verses.transliteration: kratoH kratusamAnbhAryA sannatiH suShuve sutAn | naiShAM bhAryAshcha putrAshcha sarve te hyUrdhvaretasaH
verses.translation: Two Daityas, 6umbha and Nisumbha to whom I had granted boons have turned arrogant. They are harassing the gods. Their destruction is only through you.
verses.hindi: काम्यकर्मवर्णन नामक उनतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिस्तानि सहस्राणि वालखिल्या इति स्मृताः । अनूरोरग्रतो यान्ति परिवार्य्य दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration: ShaShTistAni sahasrANi vAlakhilyA iti smR^itAH | anUroragrato yAnti parivAryya divAkaram
verses.translation: Do not delay. For a short while be steady. The Sakti that is to be released now shall be their death.
verses.hindi: गन्धाद्यैर्चयेत् पूर्व देवों हेरंबषण्मुखो॥ ९  पजन करे

verses.sanskrit: विराजमसृजद्ब्रह्मा सोऽर्द्धेन पुरुषोऽभवत् । स वै स्वायम्भुवः पूर्वं पुरुषो मनुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: virAjamasR^ijadbrahmA so.arddhena puruSho.abhavat | sa vai svAyambhuvaH pUrvaM puruSho manuruchyate
verses.translation: Thus requested by Brahma, the goddess, daughter of the mountain, cast off her outer skin and became white.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेर्भार्यानसूया च पञ्चात्रेयानसूयत । कन्यकां च श्रुतिं नाम माता शङ्खपदस्य च
verses.transliteration: atrerbhAryAnasUyA cha pa~nchAtreyAnasUyata | kanyakAM cha shrutiM nAma mAtA sha~Nkhapadasya cha
verses.translation: The outer sheath thus cast off became Kauliki who is known as Kali, the virgin with the lustre of the black cloud.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यनेत्रश्च हव्यश्च आपोमूर्तिः शनैश्चरः । सोमश्च पञ्चमस्त्वेते पञ्चात्रेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: satyanetrashcha havyashcha ApomUrtiH shanaishcharaH | somashcha pa~nchamastvete pa~nchAtreyAH prakIrtitAH
verses.translation: She had three traits: gentle, terrible and a mixture of the two. She ha4 three eyes. She was moon-crested. She
verses.hindi: चतुर्थ आवरणका चिन्तन एवं पूजन करे

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च ह्यात्रेयाणां महात्मनाम् । स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरेऽतीताः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: teShAM putrAshcha pautrAshcha hyAtreyANAM mahAtmanAm | svAyambhuve.antare.atItAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
verses.translation: A very powerful lion that came there, was given to her as vehicle by the delighted Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जायां तु वसिष्ठस्य पुत्रा वै सप्त जज्ञिरे । ज्यायसी च स्वसा तेषां पुण्डरीका सुमध्यमा
verses.transliteration: UrjAyAM tu vasiShThasya putrA vai sapta jaj~nire | jyAyasI cha svasA teShAM puNDarIkA sumadhyamA
verses.translation: He fixed her abode on the Vindhya mountain. He ordained her worship by the gift of meat, fish, pies and wine.

verses.sanskrit: रजोगात्रोर्ध्वबाहू च सवनश्चानयश्च यः । सुतपाः शुक्र इत्येते सप्त सप्तर्षयः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: rajogAtrordhvabAhU cha savanashchAnayashcha yaH | sutapAH shukra ityete sapta saptarShayaH smR^itAH
verses.translation: That Sakti, approved of by Brahma, the creator of the universe, bowed to her mother Gauri and Brahma in due order. Surrounded by many Saktis equal to her and born of her she proceeded to the Vindhya*®' ready to slay the leading Daityas.
verses.hindi: विद्याओंका सब ओर पूजन करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: गोत्राणि नामभिस्तेषां वासिष्ठानां महात्मनाम् । स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरेऽतीतान्यर्बुदानि शतानि च
verses.transliteration: gotrANi nAmabhisteShAM vAsiShThAnAM mahAtmanAm | svAyambhuve.antare.atItAnyarbudAni shatAni cha
verses.translation: The leading Daityas were killed by her in battle, the Daityas whom the arrows of Kama pierced in the minds and her own arrows split and pierced in the bodies. That battle is not described here as it has been described elsewhere. It can be guessed through other sources as well. I shall resume the present description.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष ऋषिसर्गस्तु सानुबन्धः प्रकीर्तितः । समासाद्विस्तराद्वक्तुमशक्योऽयमिति द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ityeSha R^iShisargastu sAnubandhaH prakIrtitaH | samAsAdvistarAdvaktumashakyo.ayamiti dvijAH
verses.translation: After creating Kauiki and handing her over to Brahma, Gauri spoke to Brahma demanding the recompense.

verses.sanskrit: योऽसौ रुद्रात्मको वह्निब्रह्मणो मानसः सुतः । स्वाहा तस्य प्रिया लेभे पुत्रांस्त्रीनमितौजसः
verses.transliteration: yo.asau rudrAtmako vahnibrahmaNo mAnasaH sutaH | svAhA tasya priyA lebhe putrAMstrInamitaujasaH
verses.translation: Is this tiger that has resorted* to me seen by you? He has guarded my penance grove from wicked animals.

verses.sanskrit: पावकः पवमानश्च शुचिरित्येष ते त्रयः । निर्मन्थ्यः पवमानः स्याद्वैद्युतः पावकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pAvakaH pavamAnashcha shuchirityeSha te trayaH | nirmanthyaH pavamAnaH syAdvaidyutaH pAvakaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Dedicating his mind to me he worships me without thinking of anything else. There is nothing more pleasing to me than his protection.
verses.hindi: समध्यच्चोत्ते पाश्वें ततो बैकुंठमर्चयेत्॥ ५५  करना चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: सूर्ये तपति यश्चासौ शुचिः सौर उदाहृतः । हव्यवाहः कव्यवाहः सहरक्षा इति त्रयः
verses.transliteration: sUrye tapati yashchAsau shuchiH saura udAhR^itaH | havyavAhaH kavyavAhaH saharakShA iti trayaH
verses.translation: He shall be appointed as an official in my harem. Out of pleasure Siva will grant him the post of Ganevara.

verses.sanskrit: सा देवी शतरूपा तु तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम् । भर्त्तारं दीप्तयशसं मनुमेवान्वपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sA devI shatarUpA tu tapaH kR^itvA sudushcharam | bharttAraM dIptayashasaM manumevAnvapadyata
verses.translation: I wish to return with my friends keeping him ahead. I seek permission from you the lord of the subjects.
verses.hindi: वैत्तशाल्यं न कुर्वीत भक्तिमान्विभवे सति॥ ८ ९ कंजूसी में करे

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणां क्रमशः पुत्रा देवपितृसुराश्च ते । एतेषां पुत्रपौत्राश्च चत्वारिंशन्नवैव ते
verses.transliteration: trayANAM kramashaH putrA devapitR^isurAshcha te | eteShAM putrapautrAshcha chatvAriMshannavaiva te
verses.translation: Thus addressed, Brahma smiled and told the goddess describing the lion's wicked antecedents as though the goddess was unaware.

verses.sanskrit: काम्यनैमित्तिकाजस्रकर्मसु त्रिषु संस्थिताः । सर्वे तपस्विनो ज्ञेयाः सर्वे व्रतभृतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kAmyanaimittikAjasrakarmasu triShu saMsthitAH | sarve tapasvino j~neyAH sarve vratabhR^itastathA
verses.translation: O Goddess, animals are cruel. How can your blissful thought be directed to these? Why do you sprinkle nectar in the mouth of the serpent?

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे रुद्रात्मकाश्चैव सर्वे रुद्रपरायणाः । तस्मादग्निमुखे यत्तद् हुतं स्यादेव केनचित्
verses.transliteration: sarve rudrAtmakAshchaiva sarve rudraparAyaNAH | tasmAdagnimukhe yattad hutaM syAdeva kenachit
verses.translation: Why shall mercy be shown to wicked souls like this? What is the purpose served by one innately sinful?

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं रुद्रमुद्दिश्य दत्तं स्यान्नात्र संशयः । इत्येवं निश्चयोऽग्नीनामनुक्रान्तो यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: tatsarvaM rudramuddishya dattaM syAnnAtra saMshayaH | ityevaM nishchayo.agnInAmanukrAnto yathAtatham
verses.translation: I narrated his antecedents without realising his devotion. If there be devotion, sins are not effective? Your devotee never perishes.

verses.sanskrit: नातिविस्तरतो विप्राः पितृन्वक्ष्याम्यतः परम् । यस्मात्षड् ऋतवस्तेषां स्थानं स्थानाभिमानिनाम्
verses.transliteration: nAtivistarato viprAH pitR^invakShyAmyataH param | yasmAtShaD R^itavasteShAM sthAnaM sthAnAbhimAninAm
verses.translation: What can a man of virtuous rites achieve without depending on your behest? You alone are the unborn, intelligent, ancient goddess.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतवः पितरस्तस्मादित्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः । युष्माद् ऋतुषु सर्वे हि जायन्ते स्थास्नुजङ्गमाः
verses.transliteration: R^itavaH pitarastasmAdityeShA vaidikI shrutiH | yuShmAd R^ituShu sarve hi jAyante sthAsnuja~NgamAH
verses.translation: You alone constitute Sakti of living beings. Him¬ self incompetent to do anything what will a mere agent do?

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेते हि पितर आर्तवा इति च श्रुतम् । एवं पितॄणामेतेषामृतुकालाभिमानिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAdete hi pitara ArtavA iti cha shrutam | evaM pitR^INAmeteShAmR^itukAlAbhimAninAm
verses.translation: Innumerable Brahma, Vi§nus and Sivas have passed by. Such innumerable ones are yet to be born, these carry out your behests.
verses.hindi: शैवोंका काम्यकर्मवर्णन नामक तीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: आत्मैश्वर्या महात्मानस्तिष्ठन्तीहाभ्रसङ्गमात् । आग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषदः पितरो द्विविधाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: AtmaishvaryA mahAtmAnastiShThantIhAbhrasa~NgamAt | AgniShvAttA barhiShadaH pitaro dvividhAH smR^itAH
verses.translation: O goddess of the gods without propitiating you the fourfold arms of life cannot be acquired by all of us.
verses.hindi: पेगेश्नरपिद पुण्य कर्म येन समाप्यते॥ १  नामक पुण्यकर्म पूर्णरूपसे सम्पन्न होता है

verses.sanskrit: अयज्वानश्च यज्वानः क्रमात्ते गृहमेधिनः । स्वधाऽसूत पितृभ्यश्च द्वे कन्ये लोकविश्रुते
verses.transliteration: ayajvAnashcha yajvAnaH kramAtte gR^ihamedhinaH | svadhA.asUta pitR^ibhyashcha dve kanye lokavishrute
verses.translation: Since merit and evil have been established by you the mobile and immobile may even be inter-changed.

verses.sanskrit: मेनां च धरणीं चैव याभ्यां विश्वमिदं धृतम् । अग्निष्वात्तसुता मेना धरणी बर्हिषत्सुता
verses.transliteration: menAM cha dharaNIM chaiva yAbhyAM vishvamidaM dhR^itam | agniShvAttasutA menA dharaNI barhiShatsutA
verses.translation: You are the primordial and eternal Sakti of Siva the great soul, the lord of the universe, the Sakti without beginning, middle or death.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तु शतरूपा सा पुत्रद्वयमसूयत । प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ पुत्रौ पुत्रवतां वरौ
verses.transliteration: tasmAttu shatarUpA sA putradvayamasUyata | priyavratottAnapAdau putrau putravatAM varau
verses.translation: For the functioning of the universe you assume some form or other and play about in different aspects. Who knows you factually?
verses.hindi: समता नहीं है; आपकी जय हो, जय हो

verses.sanskrit: मेना हिमवतः पत्नी मैनाकं क्रौञ्चमेव च । गौरीं गङ्गां च सुषुवे भवाङ्गाश्लेषपावनीम्
verses.transliteration: menA himavataH patnI mainAkaM krau~nchameva cha | gaurIM ga~NgAM cha suShuve bhavA~NgAshleShapAvanIm
verses.translation: Hence let this wicked tiger too attain the great Siddhi by your blessings. Nothing can prevent it?"
verses.hindi: कोई नहीं है। आपकी जय हो, जय हो

verses.sanskrit: मेरोस्तु धरणी पत्नी दिव्यौषधिसमन्वितम् । मन्दरं सुषुवे पुत्रं चित्रिसुन्दरकन्धरम्
verses.transliteration: merostu dharaNI patnI divyauShadhisamanvitam | mandaraM suShuve putraM chitrisundarakandharam
verses.translation: Thus requested by Brahma after duly reminding her of her great aspect the goddess ceased from her penance.
verses.hindi: जय हो। निर्मल शंकर! आपकी जय हो

verses.sanskrit: स एव मन्दरः श्रीमान्मेरुपुत्रस्तपोबलात् । साक्षाच्छ्रीकण्ठनाथस्य शिवस्यावसथं गतः
verses.transliteration: sa eva mandaraH shrImAnmeruputrastapobalAt | sAkShAchChrIkaNThanAthasya shivasyAvasathaM gataH
verses.translation: Then taking leave of the goddess Brahma vanished. The goddess visited her parents Mena, Himavat. She bowed to them and alleviated the pangs of her parents due to her absence. The goddess then proceeded to Mandara talking to her friends about the trees in the penance-grove who had been her loving companions. "They are shedding tears due to their grief at separation, by their scattering flowers, they are crying in distress by the chirping sound of birds seated on their boughs." The goddess was impatient to see her lord. She kept the tiger ahead thinking him as son born of herself, out of affection. With the brilliant lustre of her body she illuminated the quarters. Thus Gauri reached Mandara where lord Siva was staying — the lord who is the creator, protector and annihilator of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: साऽसूता धरणी भूयस्तिस्रः कन्याश्च विश्रुताः । वेलां च नियतिं चैव तृतीयामपि चायतिम्
verses.transliteration: sA.asUtA dharaNI bhUyastisraH kanyAshcha vishrutAH | velAM cha niyatiM chaiva tR^itIyAmapi chAyatim
verses.translation: After assuming fair co'nplexion how did the goddess, the daughter of the excellent mountain look at her husband on entering the mansion?

verses.sanskrit: आयतिर्नियतिश्चैव पत्न्यौ द्वे भृगुपुत्रयोः । स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे पूर्वं कथितस्ते तदन्वयः
verses.transliteration: Ayatirniyatishchaiva patnyau dve bhR^iguputrayoH | svAyambhuve.antare pUrvaM kathitaste tadanvayaH
verses.translation: After bowing ho sooner did she get up than the lord seized her with his hands, embraced her and joyously walked her round. Even when he attempted to make her sit on his lap she sat on the couch. Smilingly he seized her from the couch and made her sit on his lap. Smilingly gazing at her with his wide open eyes as if he would drink her in, the lord initiated the conversation with her by speaking him¬ self first.

verses.sanskrit: सुषुवे सागराद्वेला कन्यामेकामनिन्दिताम् । सवर्णां नाम सामुद्रीं पत्नीं प्राचीनबर्हिषः
verses.transliteration: suShuve sAgarAdvelA kanyAmekAmaninditAm | savarNAM nAma sAmudrIM patnIM prAchInabarhiShaH
verses.translation: Should there be any cause for our mutual dis¬ pleasure as in the case of ignorant fellows, the whole world consisting of the mobile and immobile beings would cease to exist.

verses.sanskrit: सामुद्री सुषुवे पुत्रान्दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः । सर्वे प्राचेतसा नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः
verses.transliteration: sAmudrI suShuve putrAndasha prAchInabarhiShaH | sarve prAchetasA nAma dhanurvedasya pAragAH
verses.translation: I am stationed on the head of Agni. You are stationed on the head of Soma. This universe in the form of "Agni soma" is presided over by us both.
verses.hindi: है, अत: आपमें ही लीन होगा

verses.sanskrit: येषां स्वायम्भुवे दक्षः पुत्रत्वमगमत्पुरा । त्रियम्बकस्य शापेन चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: yeShAM svAyambhuve dakShaH putratvamagamatpurA | triyambakasya shApena chAkShuShasyAntare manoH
verses.translation: We move about for the welfare of the universe. We have taken up physical bodies out of our free will. At our separation the universe is left without support.
verses.hindi: आप मुझे प्रार्थित कल्याण प्रदान करें

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते ब्रह्मपुत्राणां धर्मादीनां महात्मनाम् । नातिसङ्क्षेपतो विप्रा नातिविस्तरतः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ityete brahmaputrANAM dharmAdInAM mahAtmanAm | nAtisa~NkShepato viprA nAtivistarataH kramAt
verses.translation: There is another reason based on Scriptural texts and independent arguments. The universe comprising the mobile and immobile beings is integrated as words to their meaning. You are the nectarine word. I am the nectarine meaning. How can the two nectars become disjointed?

verses.sanskrit: वर्णिता वै मया वंशा दिव्या देवगणान्विताः । क्रियावन्तः प्रजावन्तो महर्द्धिभिरलङ्कृताः
verses.transliteration: varNitA vai mayA vaMshA divyA devagaNAnvitAH | kriyAvantaH prajAvanto maharddhibhirala~NkR^itAH
verses.translation: You are the lore that makes my conviction possible. I am the object of knowledge on the basis of your conviction. How can we separate in asmuch as we are in the forms of knowledge and object of knowledge?
verses.hindi: मुझे मेरी अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करें

verses.sanskrit: कन्ये द्वे च महाभागे याभ्यां जातास्त्विमाः प्रजाः । आकूतिरेका विज्ञेया प्रसूतिरपरा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: kanye dve cha mahAbhAge yAbhyAM jAtAstvimAH prajAH | AkUtirekA vij~neyA prasUtiraparA smR^itA
verses.translation: I am not creating and re-creating this universe merely by rny activity since everything gets evolved through command or behest. You arc the great command.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानां सन्निवेशोऽयं प्रजापतिसमुद्भवः । न हि शक्यः प्रसङ्ख्यातुं वर्षकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: prajAnAM sannivesho.ayaM prajApatisamudbhavaH | na hi shakyaH prasa~NkhyAtuM varShakoTishatairapi
verses.translation: Lordship has behest as its core because it is the symbol of freedom. How can there be lordship in me if I am deprived of command?

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञामपि च यो वंशो द्विधा सोऽपि प्रवर्तते । सूर्यवंशः सोमवंश इति पुण्यतमः क्षितौ
verses.transliteration: rAj~nAmapi cha yo vaMsho dvidhA so.api pravartate | sUryavaMshaH somavaMsha iti puNyatamaH kShitau
verses.translation: We can never stay apart from each other. It was for accomplishing the task of the gods that I made that joke.
verses.hindi: हुई मुझे मेरी अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करें

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुरम्बरीषश्च ययातिर्नाहुषादयः । पुण्यश्लोकाः श्रुता येऽत्र तेऽपि तद्वंशसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: ikShvAkurambarIShashcha yayAtirnAhuShAdayaH | puNyashlokAH shrutA ye.atra te.api tadvaMshasambhavAH
verses.translation: What is harmful to the living beings does not find room in you. When lord himself spoke thus the goddess, the natural source of love, smiled but did not reply to her hus¬ band. Out of bashfuliiess she did not say anything but gave an accormt, of Kaujiki.
verses.hindi: शासनसे मुझे प्रार्थित वस्तु प्रदान करें

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च राजऋषयो नानावीर्यसमन्विताः । किं तैः फलमनुत्क्रान्तैरुक्तपूर्वैः पुरातनैः
verses.transliteration: anye cha rAjaR^iShayo nAnAvIryasamanvitAH | kiM taiH phalamanutkrAntairuktapUrvaiH purAtanaiH
verses.translation: Was not Kau4iki, created by me seen by my lord? Such a girl has never been before in the world nor will ever be.

verses.sanskrit: किं चेश्वरकथावृत्तौ यत्र तत्रान्यकीर्तनम् । न सद्भिः सम्मतं मत्वा नोत्सहे बहुभाषितुम्
verses.transliteration: kiM cheshvarakathAvR^ittau yatra tatrAnyakIrtanam | na sadbhiH sammataM matvA notsahe bahubhAShitum
verses.translation: Brahma will tell you about her prowess, strength, residence on the Vindhya, her victory in the battle with Sumbha and Nisumbha, their death, her blessing to the devotees and her protection of the worlds.
verses.hindi: प्राथितं मे प्रयच्छन्तु परमेश्ररशासनात्॥ ६६  आदेशसे मुझे मेरी प्रार्थित वस्तु प्रदान करें

verses.sanskrit: प्रसङ्गादीश्वरस्यैव प्रभावद्योतनादपि । सर्गादयोऽपि कथिता इत्यत्र तत्प्रविस्तरैः
verses.transliteration: prasa~NgAdIshvarasyaiva prabhAvadyotanAdapi | sargAdayo.api kathitA ityatra tatpravistaraiH
verses.translation: At the behest of the goddess who spoke thus tic? friends brought the tiger in their presence.
verses.hindi: आदर करके मुझे अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करें

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवः प्रसूतिं च ददौ दक्षाय तां प्रभुः । रुचेः प्रजापतेश्चैव चाकूतिं समपादयत्
verses.transliteration: svAyambhuvaH prasUtiM cha dadau dakShAya tAM prabhuH | rucheH prajApateshchaiva chAkUtiM samapAdayat
verses.translation: On seeing him the goddess spoke again — "O lord, see this tiger. There is no other devotee of mine like him.

verses.sanskrit: आकूत्यां मिथुनं जज्ञे मानसस्य रुचेः शुभम् । यज्ञश्च दक्षिणा चैव याभ्यां संवर्तितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: AkUtyAM mithunaM jaj~ne mAnasasya rucheH shubham | yaj~nashcha dakShiNA chaiva yAbhyAM saMvartitaM jagat
verses.translation: My penance-grove was guarded by him from wicked hosts. He is greatly devoted to me. In view of his protecting me he is trustworthy. He has left his native place and come here for your favour. If you are pleased with him and if you love me, O god, let him stay at the door of the harem along with the other guards and under the charge of Nandin himself."

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवसुतायां तु प्रसूत्यां लोकमातरः । चतस्रो विंशतिः कन्या दक्षस्त्वजनयत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: svAyambhuvasutAyAM tu prasUtyAM lokamAtaraH | chatasro viMshatiH kanyA dakShastvajanayatprabhuH
verses.translation: On hearing the auspicious, loving and sweet words of the goddess the lord said to him "I am pleased". Immediately he was seen like Ganesa wearing the dress and features of a watchman, holding the cane made of gold and a dagger of serpentine lustre and wearing a bodice set with various gems.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Then lord Siva with the moon as his ornament made the majestic beautiful Gauri the daughter of the lord of Himavat sit on the conch and embellished her with ornaments.
verses.hindi: फेककृत्य य शिव त प्त ; मझे मंगल प्रदान करे

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Then lord Siva with the moon as his ornament made the majestic beautiful Gauri the daughter of the lord of Himavat sit on the conch and embellished her with ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१८. अष्टादशोऽध्यायः । सतीदेहत्यागः । ऋषय ऊचुः । देवी दक्षस्य तनया त्यक्त्वा दाक्षायणीं तनुम् । कथं हिमवतः पुत्री मेनायामभवत्पुरा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.18\. aShTAdasho.adhyAyaH | satIdehatyAgaH | R^iShaya UchuH | devI dakShasya tanayA tyaktvA dAkShAyaNIM tanum | kathaM himavataH putrI menAyAmabhavatpurA
verses.translation: We wish to hear these things in the proper order. What was it mentioned by the lord while pacifying the goddess? He had said that the universe is in the form of Agnisoma. He had said that it was in the form of words and their meanings. He also mentioned lordship has com¬ mand as its core. You are that command.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेनैव वैरेण विधिना च प्रचोदितः । नाजुवाह भवं दक्षो दीक्षितस्तामपि द्विषन्
verses.transliteration: tatastenaiva vaireNa vidhinA cha prachoditaH | nAjuvAha bhavaM dakSho dIkShitastAmapi dviShan
verses.translation: Tejas functions in two ways, in the form of the sun and of fire. Rasa too functions in the form of the moon and of water.
verses.hindi: आदेशसे ही मेरी इच्छाकी पूर्ति करें

verses.sanskrit: अन्याञ्जामातरः सर्वानाहूय स यथाक्रमम् । शतशः पुष्कलामर्चाञ्चकार च पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: anyA~njAmAtaraH sarvAnAhUya sa yathAkramam | shatashaH puShkalAmarchA~nchakAra cha pR^ithak pR^ithak
verses.translation: Amrta issues from Agni. Agni increases through Amrta. The powerful Agnisoma is beneficent to the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तान्सङ्गतान् श्रुत्वा नारदस्य मुखात्तदा । ययौ रुद्राय रुद्राणी विज्ञाप्य भवनं पितुः
verses.transliteration: tathA tAnsa~NgatAn shrutvA nAradasya mukhAttadA | yayau rudrAya rudrANI vij~nApya bhavanaM pituH
verses.translation: The Agni blazes upwards as far as the great Amrta of Soma. The Amrta of Soma flows as far as the support of Agni.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सन्निहितं दिव्यं विमानं विश्वतोमुखम् । लक्षणाढ्यं सुखारोहमतिमात्रं मनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: atha sannihitaM divyaM vimAnaM vishvatomukham | lakShaNADhyaM sukhArohamatimAtraM manoharam
verses.translation: The Kalagni supported by Adhara Sakti proceeds upwards. Similarly Soma having its region in Siva-Sakti flows downwards.

verses.sanskrit: तप्तजाम्बूनदप्रख्यं चित्ररत्नपरिष्कृतम् । मुक्तामयवितानाग्न्यं स्रग्दामसमलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: taptajAmbUnadaprakhyaM chitraratnapariShkR^itam | muktAmayavitAnAgnyaM sragdAmasamala~NkR^itam
verses.translation: Siva sustains lakti from below and Siva is Sakti- dhara (upholder of Sakti) above. Thus there is nothing not pervaded by Siva and Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: तप्तकञ्चननिर्व्यूहं रत्नस्तम्भशतावृतम् । वज्रकल्पितसोपानं विद्रुमस्तम्भतोरणम्
verses.transliteration: taptaka~nchananirvyUhaM ratnastambhashatAvR^itam | vajrakalpitasopAnaM vidrumastambhatoraNam
verses.translation: He who dusts himself with Bhasma repeating the mantra "Agniriii"* etc., if bound becomes free from bondage.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पपट्टपरिस्तीर्णं चित्ररत्नमहासनम् । वज्रजालकिरच्छिद्रमच्छिद्रमणिकुट्टिमम्
verses.transliteration: puShpapaTTaparistIrNaM chitraratnamahAsanam | vajrajAlakirachChidramachChidramaNikuTTimam
verses.translation: But being drenched all round by having recourse to Yogic union the Bhasma may turn one back from lordship by the shower of Amrta belonging to Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: मणिदण्डमनोज्ञेन महावृषभलक्ष्मणा । अलङ्कृतपुरोभागमभ्रशुभ्रेण केतुना
verses.transliteration: maNidaNDamanoj~nena mahAvR^iShabhalakShmaNA | ala~NkR^itapurobhAgamabhrashubhreNa ketunA
verses.translation: Hence for the conquest of death the drenching with Amrta shall be perpetual. How and wherefore shall one die if the nectarine contact of Siva and Sakti is acquired?
verses.hindi: कदापि अनर्थका भागी नहीं हो सकता

verses.sanskrit: रत्नकञ्चुकगुप्ताङ्गैश्चित्रवेत्रैकपाणिभिः । अधिष्ठितमहाद्वारमप्रधृष्यैर्गणेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: ratnaka~nchukaguptA~NgaishchitravetraikapANibhiH | adhiShThitamahAdvAramapradhR^iShyairgaNeshvaraiH
verses.translation: He who knows the secret of burning and drenching as mentioned is never reborn after leaving the world, the region of Agnisoma.
verses.hindi: संलग्न रहनेवाला पुरुष प्राप्त कर लेता है

verses.sanskrit: मृदङ्गतालगीतादिवेणुवीणाविशारदैः । विदग्धवेषभूषैश्च बहुभिः स्त्रीजनैर्वृतम्
verses.transliteration: mR^ida~NgatAlagItAdiveNuvINAvishAradaiH | vidagdhaveShabhUShaishcha bahubhiH strIjanairvR^itam
verses.translation: He who burns his body with Saivite lire and dren¬ ches it with the nectar of Sakti and Soma attains immortality.

verses.sanskrit: कथं च निन्दितो रुद्रो दक्षेण च महात्मना । निमित्तमपि किं तत्र येन स्यान्निन्दितो भवः
verses.transliteration: kathaM cha nindito rudro dakSheNa cha mahAtmanA | nimittamapi kiM tatra yena syAnnindito bhavaH
verses.translation: I shall mention briefly how the universe in the form of 'Vag-Artha' can be known through the six pathways.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीशिवमहापुराणे सप्तम्यां वायवीयसंहितायामृत्तरखण्डे शिवमहास्तोत्रवर्णन॑ नामैकत्रिंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: आरुरोह महादेवी सह प्रियसखीजनैः । चामारव्यजने तस्या वज्रदण्डमनोहरे
verses.transliteration: Aruroha mahAdevI saha priyasakhIjanaiH | chAmAravyajane tasyA vajradaNDamanohare
verses.translation: The two words and their meanings arc the trans¬ formations of Prakrti which is form of Siva and Siva.
verses.hindi: शिवमहास्तोत्रवर्णण ' नामक इकतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
