verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा रुद्रकन्ये द्वे विवीजतुरुभे शुभे । तदा चामरयोर्मध्ये देव्या वदनमाबभौ
verses.transliteration: gR^ihItvA rudrakanye dve vivIjaturubhe shubhe | tadA chAmarayormadhye devyA vadanamAbabhau
verses.translation: The magnificence in the form of word is men¬ tioned as threefold by scholars — gross, subtle and the great. The gross one is what we hear with our ears.
verses.hindi: इष्टसिद्धिकारक कर्म भी फलद नहीं होता

verses.sanskrit: अन्योऽन्यं युध्यतोर्मध्ये हंसयोरिव पङ्कजम् । छत्रं शशिनिभं तस्याश्चूडोपरि सुमालिनी
verses.transliteration: anyo.anyaM yudhyatormadhye haMsayoriva pa~Nkajam | ChatraM shashinibhaM tasyAshchUDopari sumAlinI
verses.translation: The subtle one is in the form of thought, the one beyond is devoid of thought. The Sakti based on the principle of Siva is Parasakti. In the name of "Sakti Tattva" it is the root cause of all effects. It is the composite unit (Samasti) of all Saktis because it is in association with Juana Sakti and is supported by Iccha sakti. The same is called KundalinI Maya and Suddhadhvaparama. This Sakti is ramified into six paths. The three paths pertain to words and the three pertain to their meanings.
verses.hindi: पता लगनेपर उसे दूर करनेका प्रयत्न करे

verses.sanskrit: धृतमुक्तापरिक्षिप्तं बभार प्रेमनिर्भरा । तच्छत्रमुज्ज्वलं देव्या रुरुचे वदनोपरि
verses.transliteration: dhR^itamuktAparikShiptaM babhAra premanirbharA | tachChatramujjvalaM devyA ruruche vadanopari
verses.translation: The capacity for merging and enjoyment is posse¬ ssed by all men in accordance with their purity based on the divisions of all Principles. The principles are pervaded by Kalas suitably as in the beginning the great Prakrti is trans¬ formed into five. They are Kala, Nivrtti and others.

verses.sanskrit: उपर्यमृतभाण्डस्य मण्डलं शशिनो यथा । अथ चाग्रे समासीना सुस्मितास्या शुभावती
verses.transliteration: uparyamR^itabhANDasya maNDalaM shashino yathA | atha chAgre samAsInA susmitAsyA shubhAvatI
verses.translation: The three paths based on words arc: the path of mantras, the path of words, the path of letters. The three paths based on meanings are the path of universe, the path of principles, the path of Kalas. These are mutually pervaded and pervading.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षद्यूतविनोदेन रमयामास वै सतीम् । सुयशाः पादुके देव्याः शुभे रत्नपरिष्कृते
verses.transliteration: akShadyUtavinodena ramayAmAsa vai satIm | suyashAH pAduke devyAH shubhe ratnapariShkR^ite
verses.translation: The mantras are pervaded by the words consti¬ tuting the statement. The words are pervaded by letters. Learned men call the group of letters a word.

verses.sanskrit: स्तनयोरन्तरे कृत्वा तदा देवीमसेवत । अन्या काञ्चनचार्वङ्गी दीप्तं जग्राह दर्पणम्
verses.transliteration: stanayorantare kR^itvA tadA devImasevata | anyA kA~nchanachArva~NgI dIptaM jagrAha darpaNam
verses.translation: The letters are pervaded by the words because they are obtained there. The words are pervaded by the Tattvas because of their origin from within and without. They are effected by the Tattvas in various ways. Some of the words have cropped up from the middle, some from the §aiva Agamas. Some of Tattvas are those famous in the Sankhya and Yoga systems of Philosophy. Others arc famous in the sacred texts of Siva. The Tattvas arc duly pervaded by Kalas.
verses.hindi: पवित्र वेषभूषा धारण करे और पवित्र रहे

verses.sanskrit: अपरा तालवृन्तं च परा ताम्बूलपेटिकाम् । काचित्क्रीडाशुकं चारु करेऽकुरुत भामिनी
verses.transliteration: aparA tAlavR^intaM cha parA tAmbUlapeTikAm | kAchitkrIDAshukaM chAru kare.akuruta bhAminI
verses.translation: Since in the beginning the primordial Prakrti i?

verses.sanskrit: काचित्तु सुमनोज्ञानि पुष्पाणि सुरभीणि च । काचिदाभरणाधारं बभार कमलेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: kAchittu sumanoj~nAni puShpANi surabhINi cha | kAchidAbharaNAdhAraM babhAra kamalekShaNA
verses.translation: The undivided Sakti pervades the six paths. She is pervaded by Sivatattva.

verses.sanskrit: काचिच्च पुनरालेपं सुप्रसूनं शुभाञ्जनम् । अन्याश्च सदृशास्तास्ता यथास्वमुचितक्रियाः
verses.transliteration: kAchichcha punarAlepaM suprasUnaM shubhA~njanam | anyAshcha sadR^ishAstAstA yathAsvamuchitakriyAH
verses.translation: The situation of the cosmic egg upto Rudra is purified by Nivrtti. Above that upto the sphere of Avyakta It is purified by Pratisfha.
verses.hindi: वाद्य और कीर्तन आदि भी करने चाहिए

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नश्च कथं दक्षो ह्यभिशापाद्भवस्य तु । चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वं मनोः प्रब्रूहि मारुत
verses.transliteration: utpannashcha kathaM dakSho hyabhishApAdbhavasya tu | chAkShuShasyAntare pUrvaM manoH prabrUhi mAruta
verses.translation: All this could be seen only there by the nspirants. He who wishes to purify without realising the mode of pervasion of the paths is a deceiver of purity. He cannot achieve the fruit. His effort is wasted and leads him to hell.

verses.sanskrit: आवृत्य तां महादेवीमसेवन्त समन्ततः । अतीव शुशुभे तासामन्तरे परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: AvR^itya tAM mahAdevImasevanta samantataH | atIva shushubhe tAsAmantare parameshvarI
verses.translation: Some declare that their difference consists in their genders: man and woman. Others say that she is undeta- chably associated with him as the light of the sun. But in the form of cit she is different. The arrangement is that Siva is the great cause and his behest is the great goddess.
verses.hindi: बात और क्या हो सकती है 2

verses.sanskrit: तारापरिषदो मध्ये चन्द्रलेखेव शारदी । ततः शङ्खसमुत्थस्य नादस्य समनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tArApariShado madhye chandralekheva shAradI | tataH sha~Nkhasamutthasya nAdasya samanantaram
verses.translation: Urged by his behest the original unchanging Prakrti becomes threefold in accordance with the three types of effects. It is called Mahamaya, Maya and Triguna Prakfti. It produces the six paths in the form of words and their meanings. The entire universe is thus sixfold. The whole collection of scriptural text is only an extension of this.

verses.sanskrit: प्रास्थानिको महानादः पटहः समताड्यत । ततो मधुरवाद्यानि सह तालोद्यतैः स्वनैः
verses.transliteration: prAsthAniko mahAnAdaH paTahaH samatADyata | tato madhuravAdyAni saha tAlodyataiH svanaiH
verses.translation: The activities of deities of domestic nature arc curious, dense and inscrutable, even to the gods. They delude our minds.
verses.hindi: ... सिद्धिकर्मवर्णन नामक बत्तीसवाँ अध्यांय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अनाहतानि सन्नेदुः काहलानां शतानि च । सायुधानां गणेशानां महेशसमतेजसाम्
verses.transliteration: anAhatAni sanneduH kAhalAnAM shatAni cha | sAyudhAnAM gaNeshAnAM maheshasamatejasAm
verses.translation: In the union of the principles of Siva and Siva no defect is noticeable. However in their activities the Prakfta feeling is rather prominent.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणि शतान्यष्टौ तदानीं पुरतो ययुः । तेषां मध्ये वृषारूढो गजारूढो यथा गुरुः
verses.transliteration: sahasrANi shatAnyaShTau tadAnIM purato yayuH | teShAM madhye vR^iShArUDho gajArUDho yathA guruH
verses.translation: Brahma and others the causes of creation, sustenance and annihilation attain restraint and blessing from Siva and are subservient to him.
verses.hindi: इस लिंग-में शिव किस कारणसे पूजे जाते हैं 2

verses.sanskrit: जगाम गणपः श्रीमान् सोमनन्दीश्वरार्चितः । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुर्दिवि दिव्यसुखा घनाः
verses.transliteration: jagAma gaNapaH shrImAn somanandIshvarArchitaH | devadundubhayo nedurdivi divyasukhA ghanAH
verses.translation: Matsya P. 3. 3« I In the
verses.hindi: मेरी कृपासे शीघ्र ही दूर हो जायगी

verses.sanskrit: ननृतुर्मुनयः सर्वे मुमुदुः सिद्धयोगिनः । ससृजुः पुष्पवृष्टिं च वितानोपरि वारिदाः
verses.transliteration: nanR^iturmunayaH sarve mumuduH siddhayoginaH | sasR^ijuH puShpavR^iShTiM cha vitAnopari vAridAH
verses.translation: But a physical form docs not fit in with a free being for this basic reason. But the form is an effect of some cause. Lordship has no cause for its being.
verses.hindi: हूँ, मेरे समान ऐश्वर्यशाली कोई नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: तदा देवगणैश्चान्यैः पथि सर्वत्र सङ्गताः । क्षणादिव पितुर्गेहं प्रविवेश महेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: tadA devagaNaishchAnyaiH pathi sarvatra sa~NgatAH | kShaNAdiva piturgehaM pravivesha maheshvarI
verses.translation: Everywhere the greater and the lower Bhavas are mentioned. How can these two be relevant in one place?

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा कुपितो दक्षश्चात्मनः क्षयकारणात् । तस्या यवीयसीभ्योऽपि चक्रे पूजामसत्कृताम्
verses.transliteration: tAM dR^iShTvA kupito dakShashchAtmanaH kShayakAraNAt | tasyA yavIyasIbhyo.api chakre pUjAmasatkR^itAm
verses.translation: The wise have said that the embodied Atman is Sakala; the unembodied Siva is Niskala. The embodied Atman is presided over by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तदा शशिमुखी देवी पितरं सदसि स्थितम् । अम्बिका युक्तमव्यग्रमुवाचाकृपणं वचः
verses.transliteration: tadA shashimukhI devI pitaraM sadasi sthitam | ambikA yuktamavyagramuvAchAkR^ipaNaM vachaH
verses.translation: The assuming of physical bodies out of wish is not consistent with freedom. Such a wish too follows the activities of men.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाव शृण्वन्तु कथयिष्यामि दक्षस्य लघुचेतसः । वृत्तं पापात् प्रमादाच्च विश्वामरविदूषणम्
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAva shR^iNvantu kathayiShyAmi dakShasya laghuchetasaH | vR^ittaM pApAt pramAdAchcha vishvAmaravidUShaNam
verses.translation: Even beings including Brahma and PiSacas can assume or cast off their bodies out of their wish. But don't they come under the scope of Karmans?

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ता यस्याज्ञावशवर्तिनः । स देवः साम्प्रतं तात विधिना नार्चितः किल
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | brahmAdayaH pishAchAntA yasyAj~nAvashavartinaH | sa devaH sAmprataM tAta vidhinA nArchitaH kila
verses.translation: They consider the assumption of bodies at one's choice on a par with jugglery. It is not beyond the achieve¬ ments derived from Anima and other powers.
verses.hindi: हरिविधिमोहवर्णन नामक चाँंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तदास्तां मम ज्यायस्याः पुत्र्याः पूजां किमीदृशीम् । असत्कृतामवज्ञाय कृतवानसि गर्हितम्
verses.transliteration: tadAstAM mama jyAyasyAH putryAH pUjAM kimIdR^ishIm | asatkR^itAmavaj~nAya kR^itavAnasi garhitam
verses.translation: While Visnu who had assumed the cosmic form was fighting with Dadhica the latter assumed the cosmic form of Visnu.***

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तोऽब्रवीदेनां दक्षः क्रोधादमर्षितः । त्वत्तः श्रेष्ठा विशिष्टाश्च पूज्या बालाः सुता मम
verses.transliteration: evamukto.abravIdenAM dakShaH krodhAdamarShitaH | tvattaH shreShThA vishiShTAshcha pUjyA bAlAH sutA mama
verses.translation: They say that Siva the supreme cause blesses us all. He curbs and kills the gods. How can he be a blesser of all?

verses.sanskrit: तासां तु ये च भर्त्तारस्ते मे बहुमता मुदा । गुणैश्चाप्यधिकाः सर्वे भर्तुस्ते त्र्यम्बकादपि
verses.transliteration: tAsAM tu ye cha bharttAraste me bahumatA mudA | guNaishchApyadhikAH sarve bhartuste tryambakAdapi
verses.translation: The lord cut off the fifth head*®® of Brahma who stubbornly and repeatedly censured Siva calling him "O son."

verses.sanskrit: स्तब्धात्मा तामसः शर्वः त्वमिमं समुपाश्रिता । तेन त्वामवमन्येऽहं प्रतिकूलो हि मे भवः
verses.transliteration: stabdhAtmA tAmasaH sharvaH tvamimaM samupAshritA | tena tvAmavamanye.ahaM pratikUlo hi me bhavaH
verses.translation: In the form of a Sarabha he forcefully attacked Visnu the man-lion. Pressing him with his feet he tore off his heart by his sharp claws.

verses.sanskrit: तथोक्ता पितरं दक्षं क्रुद्धा देवी तमब्रवीत् । शृण्वतामेव सर्वेषां ये यज्ञसदसि स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tathoktA pitaraM dakShaM kruddhA devI tamabravIt | shR^iNvatAmeva sarveShAM ye yaj~nasadasi sthitAH
verses.translation: With the sacrifice of Daksa for a pretext none among the gods or their womenfolk was spared from punish¬ ment by the heroic Vlrabhadra.
verses.hindi: ॥ इस प्रकार पैंतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मान्मम भर्तारमजाताशेषदूषणम् । वाचा दूषयसे दक्ष साक्षाल्लोकमहेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: akasmAnmama bhartAramajAtAsheShadUShaNam | vAchA dUShayase dakSha sAkShAllokamaheshvaram
verses.translation: The three cities® along with the Dailyas, their womenfolk and chilclivn were made the fuel for the fire from his eyes in an instant by him.
verses.hindi: लिड्डस्यापि च बेरस्थ शिवेन विहित॑ यथा॥ ९ शिवजीने कहा था

verses.sanskrit: विद्याचौरो गुरुद्रोही वेदेश्वरविदूषकः । त एते बहुपाप्मानः सर्वे दण्ड्या इति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: vidyAchauro gurudrohI vedeshvaravidUShakaH | ta ete bahupApmAnaH sarve daNDyA iti shrutiH
verses.translation: Kama the husband of Rati, the cause of the sexual pleasure of the people was consigned to the fire from his eyes even as the gods were lamenting.
verses.hindi: रात अथवा एक राततक अधिवासन कराये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादत्युत्कटस्यास्य पापस्य सदृशो भृशम् । सहसा दारुणो दण्डस्तव दैवाद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmAdatyutkaTasyAsya pApasya sadR^isho bhR^isham | sahasA dAruNo daNDastava daivAdbhaviShyati
verses.translation: Angrily glancing at some cows walking along the sky and.shedding milk over his head he reduced them to ashes immediately.
verses.hindi: और हा करते हुए उसे शयनस्थानपर ले जाय

verses.sanskrit: त्वया न पूजितो यस्माद्देवदेवस्त्रियम्बकः । तस्मात्तव कुलं दुष्टं नष्टमित्यवधारय
verses.transliteration: tvayA na pUjito yasmAddevadevastriyambakaH | tasmAttava kulaM duShTaM naShTamityavadhAraya
verses.translation: The family of cruel demons who desired to kill him was scorched in fire. The chest of Andhaka was pierced with the trident.
verses.hindi: शुद्ध जलसे लिंगको स्नान कराकर क्रमसे पूजन करे

verses.sanskrit: पुरा सुरासुराः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः । कदाचिद् द्रष्टुमीशानं हिमवच्छिखरं ययुः
verses.transliteration: purA surAsurAH sarve siddhAshcha paramarShayaH | kadAchid draShTumIshAnaM himavachChikharaM yayuH
verses.translation: After creating a dark woman from his neck he killed Daraka. After creating Kausiki out of the outer skin of Gauri, Sumbha and Nisumbha were killed. xhe narrative cn Skanda is found in the Skanda Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा पितरं रुष्टा सती सन्त्यक्तसाध्वसा । तदीयां च तनुं त्यक्त्वा हिमवन्तं ययौ गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA pitaraM ruShTA satI santyaktasAdhvasA | tadIyAM cha tanuM tyaktvA himavantaM yayau girim
verses.translation: The detaiU of this episode reir.nin untraced.

verses.sanskrit: स पर्वतपरः श्रीमाँल्लब्धपुण्यफलोदयः । तदर्थमेव कृतवान् सुचिरं दुश्चरं तपः
verses.transliteration: sa parvataparaH shrImA.NllabdhapuNyaphalodayaH | tadarthameva kR^itavAn suchiraM dushcharaM tapaH
verses.translation: The lord, requested by Brahma for the destruction of the leading Daitya Taraka*** the enemy of Indra, went to his harem on the Mandara mountion.
verses.hindi: ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अन्तर्गत रख सारा दपय पाम वदतरिंशोउ ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तमनुगृह्णाति भूधरेश्वरमीश्वरी । स्वेच्छया पितरं चक्रे स्वात्मनो योगमायया
verses.transliteration: tasmAttamanugR^ihNAti bhUdhareshvaramIshvarI | svechChayA pitaraM chakre svAtmano yogamAyayA
verses.translation: The lord indulged in sexual dalliance with the goddess for a long time. -Due to the excessive sport the earth appeared to sink - into the nether worlds. He deceived his own name and the goddess by withholding the discharge of semen in her. The unbearable semen was discharged into the fire like nectar or the sanctified Havis.

verses.sanskrit: यदा गता सती दक्षं विनिन्द्य भयविह्वलम् । तदा तिरोहिता मन्त्रा विहतश्च ततोऽध्वरः
verses.transliteration: yadA gatA satI dakShaM vinindya bhayavihvalam | tadA tirohitA mantrA vihatashcha tato.adhvaraH
verses.translation: The fire cast it off into Ganga and other places. Svaha who assumed the form of the Krttikas and sported with her husband gathered the parts and deposited them in the Sara plants somewhere on the Meru. Svaha was turned into gold in the process.

verses.sanskrit: तदुपश्रुत्य गमनं देव्यास्त्रिपुरुमर्दनः । दक्षाय च ऋषिभ्यश्च चुकोप च शशाप तान्
verses.transliteration: tadupashrutya gamanaM devyAstripurumardanaH | dakShAya cha R^iShibhyashcha chukopa cha shashApa tAn
verses.translation: After some time her lustre illuminated quarters and the mountains. Meru itself was turned into gold.
verses.hindi: परम दुर्लभ योगका वर्णन सुनना चाहता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादवमता दक्षमत्कृतेऽनागसा सती । पूजिताश्चेतराः सर्वाः स्वसुता भर्तृभिः सह
verses.transliteration: yasmAdavamatA dakShamatkR^ite.anAgasA satI | pUjitAshchetarAH sarvAH svasutA bhartR^ibhiH saha
verses.translation: After a long time the splendour grew into a boy of beautiful and tender limbs, a model for all boys.

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे तस्मात्तव जामातरस्त्वमी । उत्पत्स्यन्ते समं सर्वे ब्रह्मयज्ञेष्वयोनिजाः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvate.antare tasmAttava jAmAtarastvamI | utpatsyante samaM sarve brahmayaj~neShvayonijAH
verses.translation: On seeing him of charming features, the world of the gods, Asuras and mankind was surprised and fascinated.

verses.sanskrit: भविता मानुषो राजा चाक्षुषस्य त्वमन्वये । प्राचीनबर्हिषः पौत्रः पुत्रश्चापि प्रचेतसः
verses.transliteration: bhavitA mAnuSho rAjA chAkShuShasya tvamanvaye | prAchInabarhiShaH pautraH putrashchApi prachetasaH
verses.translation: The lord himself came there along with the goddess to sec his son. He took the boy on his lap. The gods and the sages though averse to worldly pleasures glanced at his smiling face. The lord made him play on his chest and enjoyed the fun. The lord and the goddess congratulated each other.

verses.sanskrit: अहं तत्रापि ते विघ्नमाचरिष्यामि दुर्मते । धर्मार्थकामयुक्तेषु कर्मस्वपि पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: ahaM tatrApi te vighnamAchariShyAmi durmate | dharmArthakAmayukteShu karmasvapi punaH punaH
verses.translation: RS iv.chs. 1-1(1

verses.sanskrit: तेनैवं व्याहृतो दक्षो रुद्रेणामिततेजसा । स्वायम्भुवीं तनुं त्यक्त्वा पपात भुवि दुःखितः
verses.transliteration: tenaivaM vyAhR^ito dakSho rudreNAmitatejasA | svAyambhuvIM tanuM tyaktvA papAta bhuvi duHkhitaH
verses.translation: For a brahmin boy whose life came to an end and who sought refuge in him, the lord came there hurriedly and kicked Yama with his foot.

verses.sanskrit: तदा देवश्च देवी च दिव्यासनगतावुभौ । दर्शनं ददतुस्तेषां देवादीनां द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tadA devashcha devI cha divyAsanagatAvubhau | darshanaM dadatusteShAM devAdInAM dvijottamAH
verses.translation: The submarine fire, not knowing the bull as the lord's vehicle swallowed him. Thereafter the universe be¬ came a vast sheet of water.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राचेतसो दक्षो जज्ञे वै चाक्षुषेऽन्तरे । प्राचीनबर्हिषः पौत्रः पुत्रश्चैव प्रचेतसाम्
verses.transliteration: tataH prAchetaso dakSho jaj~ne vai chAkShuShe.antare | prAchInabarhiShaH pautraH putrashchaiva prachetasAm
verses.translation: By means of different activities blissfully beautiful and unknown to the people, the universe has been set to motion frequently.
verses.hindi: वातनर उत्तखण्डे योगगतिवर्णन॑ नाम सम्रत्रिशो5 ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वादयोऽपि जाता वै मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य तु । अन्तरे ब्रह्मणो यज्ञे वारुणीं बिभ्रतस्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: bhR^igvAdayo.api jAtA vai manorvaivasvatasya tu | antare brahmaNo yaj~ne vAruNIM bibhratastanum
verses.translation: The variety of beginningless Karmans cannot be the restraining factor here. The Karman that is the cause is also effected by the lord.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंके संवादमें योगगतिवर्णन नामक सँतीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तदा दक्षस्य धर्मार्थं प्रवृत्तस्य दुरात्मनः । महेशः कृतवान् विघ्नं मनौ वैवस्वते सति
verses.transliteration: tadA dakShasya dharmArthaM pravR^ittasya durAtmanaH | maheshaH kR^itavAn vighnaM manau vaivasvate sati
verses.translation: I shall mention authoritative testimonies in this context quelling your delusions. The wickedness of the wicked is due to the absence of the grace of the lord.
verses.hindi: दशते युझ्ञतां पुंसामन्तराया: प्रकीर्तिता:॥ २  योगमार्गके विष्न कहे गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: तदानीमेव दक्षोऽपि गतस्तत्र सहामरैः । जामातरं हरं द्रष्टुं देवीं चात्मसुतां सतीम्
verses.transliteration: tadAnImeva dakSho.api gatastatra sahAmaraiH | jAmAtaraM haraM draShTuM devIM chAtmasutAM satIm
verses.translation: The universe in the form of Pasu and Paa, has to be blessed. The lord endowed with the authority blesses the universe.
verses.hindi: अर्थात् मोक्ष भी हो सकता है

verses.sanskrit: तदात्मगौरवाद्देवो देव्या दक्षे समागते । देवादिभ्यो विशेषेण न कदाचिदभूत्स्मृतिः
verses.transliteration: tadAtmagauravAddevo devyA dakShe samAgate | devAdibhyo visheSheNa na kadAchidabhUtsmR^itiH
verses.translation: The lord, the commander blesses everything always. If a means is adopted for that, how does Siva become dependant?

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तस्याः परं भावमज्ञातुश्चापि केवलम् । पुत्रीत्येवं विमूढस्य तस्यां वैरमजायत
verses.transliteration: tasya tasyAH paraM bhAvamaj~nAtushchApi kevalam | putrItyevaM vimUDhasya tasyAM vairamajAyata
verses.translation: No blessing can be independent of one that is blessed. Hence the meaning of the word freedom is not characterised by 'not depending on another*.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Siva in the form of the idol, whereby despite its beings Saguna the Niskala is realised, is called Saivamurti only in a figurative use.
verses.hindi: श्राप्त होती हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Siva in the form of the idol, whereby despite its beings Saguna the Niskala is realised, is called Saivamurti only in a figurative use.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.१९. एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः । वीरभद्रोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । कथं दक्षस्य धर्मार्थं प्रवृत्तस्य दुरात्मनः । महेशः कृतवान् विघ्नमेतदिच्छाम वेदितुम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.19\. ekonaviMsho.adhyAyaH | vIrabhadrotpattivarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | kathaM dakShasya dharmArthaM pravR^ittasya durAtmanaH | maheshaH kR^itavAn vighnametadichChAma veditum
verses.translation: The state of being understood through the testimonies alone indicates his nature. Merely on acco mt of this it should not be treated with indifference without the implication.

verses.sanskrit: दधीच उवाच । अप्यपूज्ये चैव पूजा पूज्यानां चाप्यपूजने । नरः पापमवाप्नोति महद्वै नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: dadhIcha uvAcha | apyapUjye chaiva pUjA pUjyAnAM chApyapUjane | naraH pApamavApnoti mahadvai nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: Some form, intense with the similarity of Atman, is l§iva*s idol. The other, the great one, the Atman of the Murti is its implication.
verses.hindi: ही कोई प्रवाहरूपा संतति ' ध्यान' कहलाती है

verses.sanskrit: असतां सम्मतिर्यत्र सतामवमतिस्तथा । दण्डो देवकृतस्तत्र सद्यः पतति दारुणः
verses.transliteration: asatAM sammatiryatra satAmavamatistathA | daNDo devakR^itastatra sadyaH patati dAruNaH
verses.translation: Just as fire cannot be obtained without its being r mounted in the twigs so also Siva is not known or under¬ stood without its being superimposed in the idol.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु विप्रर्षिः पुनर्दक्षमभाषत । पूज्यं तु पशुभर्तारं कस्मान्नार्चयसे प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvA tu viprarShiH punardakShamabhAShata | pUjyaM tu pashubhartAraM kasmAnnArchayase prabhum
verses.translation: If some ohe says "Bring fire," only the burning twig is brought. The fire by itself is not brought. In the same way Siva is to be worshipped in the form of the idol.

verses.sanskrit: दक्ष उवाच । सन्ति मे बहवो रुद्राः शूलहस्ताः कपर्दिनः । एकादशावस्थिता ये नान्यं वेद्मि महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dakSha uvAcha | santi me bahavo rudrAH shUlahastAH kapardinaH | ekAdashAvasthitA ye nAnyaM vedmi maheshvaram
verses.translation: In the form of different idols, phallic etc. and particularly in Area (offerings of flowers etc. ) Siva is worshipped by us.

verses.sanskrit: दधीच उवाच । किमेभिरमरैरन्यैः पूजितैरध्वरे फलम् । राजा चेदध्वरस्यास्य न रुद्रः पूज्यते त्वया
verses.transliteration: dadhIcha uvAcha | kimebhiramarairanyaiH pUjitairadhvare phalam | rAjA chedadhvarasyAsya na rudraH pUjyate tvayA
verses.translation: The Murtyatmans, Sadasiva and others are presided over by Siva for blessing the worlds.
verses.hindi: सपदि वियति वायु: सायमन्तहिंतो5भूत्॥ १  आकाशमें अन्तर्धान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां स्रष्टा यः प्रभुरव्ययः । ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ता यस्य कैङ्कर्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviShNumaheshAnAM sraShTA yaH prabhuravyayaH | brahmAdayaH pishAchAntA yasya kai~NkaryavAdinaH
verses.translation: Siva blessess every one. He does not curb any. It is impossible to attribute to Siva those faults which are ysually present in those who kill.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतीनां परश्चैव पुरुषस्य च यः परः । चिन्त्यते योगविद्वद्भिरृषिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: prakR^itInAM parashchaiva puruShasya cha yaH paraH | chintyate yogavidvadbhirR^iShibhistattvadarshibhiH
verses.translation: Surely Srikantha has the overlordship of the universe. Siva presides over the Murti Srikantha in the course of his divine sport.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षरं परमं ब्रह्म ह्यसच्च सदसच्च यत् । अनादिमध्यनिधनमप्रतर्क्यं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: akSharaM paramaM brahma hyasachcha sadasachcha yat | anAdimadhyanidhanamapratarkyaM sanAtanam
verses.translation: Only the gods and others who were faulty were restrained or slain by him as described above. Thereby the gods became sinners and the people free from ailments.

verses.sanskrit: यः स्रष्टा चैव संहर्ता भर्ता चैव महेश्वरः । तस्मादन्यं न पश्यामि शङ्करात्मानमध्वरे
verses.transliteration: yaH sraShTA chaiva saMhartA bhartA chaiva maheshvaraH | tasmAdanyaM na pashyAmi sha~NkarAtmAnamadhvare
verses.translation: The wish of the lord comprises the establishment of rules and conditions. Brahma is the commandment. His order is the mode of direction such as, "This shall be done. This shall not be done."
verses.hindi: सपदि वियति वायु: सायमन्तर्हितो5भूत्॥ ९१ आकाशमें अन्तर्धान हो गये

verses.sanskrit: दक्ष उवाच । एतन्मखेशस्य सुवर्णपात्रे हविः समस्तं विधिमन्त्रपूतम् । विष्णोर्नयाम्यप्रतिमस्य भागं प्रभोर्विभज्याहवनीयमद्य
verses.transliteration: dakSha uvAcha | etanmakheshasya suvarNapAtre haviH samastaM vidhimantrapUtam | viShNornayAmyapratimasya bhAgaM prabhorvibhajyAhavanIyamadya
verses.translation: The characteristic of a man of good nature is the strict adherence to his directives; the opposite thereof is that of the non-saintly one.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । विश्वस्य जगतो मातुरपि देव्यास्तपोबलात् । पितृभावमुपागम्य मुदिते हिमवद्गिरौ
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | vishvasya jagato mAturapi devyAstapobalAt | pitR^ibhAvamupAgamya mudite himavadgirau
verses.translation: Perpetrators of improper actions arc to be decried and despised by a judicious person. Improper action is that which afflicts and harasses the world.
verses.hindi: ॥ इस प्रकार श्रीशिवमहापुराणके अत मल ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: दधीच उवाच । यस्मान्नाराधितो रुद्रः सर्वदेवेश्वरेश्वरः । तस्माद्दक्ष तवाशेषो यज्ञोऽयं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: dadhIcha uvAcha | yasmAnnArAdhito rudraH sarvadeveshvareshvaraH | tasmAddakSha tavAsheSho yaj~no.ayaM na bhaviShyati
verses.translation: The lord does not injure others though guilty, otherwise. Of course, he injures the ignorant by adopting neutrality.
verses.hindi: भरे हुए वृक्ष उसे आच्छादित किये रहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा वचनं क्रुद्धो दधीचो मुनिसत्तमः । निर्गम्य च ततो देशाज्जगाम स्वकमाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA vachanaM kruddho dadhIcho munisattamaH | nirgamya cha tato deshAjjagAma svakamAshramam
verses.translation: Hence we shall say that he who inflicts injury
verses.hindi: देकर वे फिर महादेवजीके पास चले गये

verses.sanskrit: निर्गतेऽपि मुनौ तस्मिन्देवा दक्षं न तत्यजुः । अवश्यमनुभावित्वादनर्थस्य तु भाविनः
verses.transliteration: nirgate.api munau tasmindevA dakShaM na tatyajuH | avashyamanubhAvitvAdanarthasya tu bhAvinaH
verses.translation: Ruthlcssness cannot be attributed to the surgeon who operates upon the patient. The inducing factor is kind¬ ness alone.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ज्ञात्वैतत्सर्वमीश्वरात् । दग्धुं दक्षाध्वरं विप्रा देवी देवमचोदयत्
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kAle tu j~nAtvaitatsarvamIshvarAt | dagdhuM dakShAdhvaraM viprA devI devamachodayat
verses.translation: Even neglect and indifference for the opponents who ought to he protected, results in default. He who ought to be protected perishes immediately if neglected despite the capacity of the protector.
verses.hindi: अन्तमें निश्चय ही मोक्ष देता है

verses.sanskrit: देव्या सञ्चोदितो देवो दक्षाध्वरजिघांसया । ससर्ज सहसा वीरं वीरभद्रं गणेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: devyA sa~nchodito devo dakShAdhvarajighAMsayA | sasarja sahasA vIraM vIrabhadraM gaNeshvaram
verses.translation: He wno neglects the man worthy of being protected

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रवदनं देवं सहस्रकमलेक्षणम् । सहस्रमुद्गरधरं सहस्रशरपाणिकम्
verses.transliteration: sahasravadanaM devaM sahasrakamalekShaNam | sahasramudgaradharaM sahasrasharapANikam
verses.translation: In reality there are the defects of passion, etc., in the Murtyatmans (Sadaiiva, Brahma and others). Still the defects belong to them alone and not to Siva. There may be flaw in the copper put in fire but due to its contact fire does not fade. If impure things are consigned to fire they do not make the fire impure. Some impure things become pure due to their contact with fire. Similarly Siva does not become impure due to the contact with the Atmans that are to be purified.

verses.sanskrit: शूलटङ्कगदाहस्तं दीप्तकार्मुकधारिणम् । चक्रवज्रधरं घोरं चन्द्रार्द्धकृतशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: shUlaTa~NkagadAhastaM dIptakArmukadhAriNam | chakravajradharaM ghoraM chandrArddhakR^itashekharam
verses.translation: The prosperity, glory etc. of the Murtyatmans is really that of lord Siva and not of the Atmans. It is the fire, not the fuel, that blazes upwards.

verses.sanskrit: कुलिशोद्योतितकरं तडिज्ज्वलितमूर्द्धजम् । दंष्ट्राकरालं बिभ्राणं महावक्त्रं महोदरम्
verses.transliteration: kulishodyotitakaraM taDijjvalitamUrddhajam | daMShTrAkarAlaM bibhrANaM mahAvaktraM mahodaram
verses.translation: The state of being the coal belongs to the wood and not to the fire. Similarly Sivatva is imposed on wood, stone and clay. But the attributes Maitri, etc., are secondary and they act differently. They are conducive to both good and evil to those who are endowed with qualities. What is both secondary and non- secondary is not wholly conducive to good or evil.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युज्जिह्वं प्रलम्बोष्ठं मेघसागरनिःस्वनम् । वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं महद्रुधिरनिस्रवम्
verses.transliteration: vidyujjihvaM pralamboShThaM meghasAgaraniHsvanam | vasAnaM charma vaiyAghraM mahadrudhiranisravam
verses.translation: The sense of the word Upakara ( benevolence) is also Anughraha. Since that too is of beneficent nature Siva is all-benevolent.

verses.sanskrit: गण्डद्वितयसंसृष्टमण्डलीकृतकुण्डलम् । वरामरशिरोमालावलीकलितशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: gaNDadvitayasaMsR^iShTamaNDalIkR^itakuNDalam | varAmarashiromAlAvalIkalitashekharam
verses.translation: Everything in the form of sentient and non- sentient is engaged in what is beneficent? But obstructed by
verses.hindi: श्रीजिवमहापुराणमाहात्म्यवर्णण नामक इकतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण डक

verses.sanskrit: देवेऽपि तत्कृतोद्वाहे हिमवच्छिखरालये । सङ्क्रीडति तया सार्द्धं काले बहुतरे गते
verses.transliteration: deve.api tatkR^itodvAhe himavachChikharAlaye | sa~NkrIDati tayA sArddhaM kAle bahutare gate
verses.translation: Even the innate nature of the entities is the cause of what is destined to be. The innate nature does not transform that what perishes. The contact with fire melts only gold and not the coal. Siva liberates those whose ignorance is ripe and not the others.

verses.sanskrit: रणन्नूपुरकेयूरमहाकनकभूषितम् । रत्नसञ्चयसन्दीप्तं तारहारावृतोरसम्
verses.transliteration: raNannUpurakeyUramahAkanakabhUShitam | ratnasa~nchayasandIptaM tArahArAvR^itorasam
verses.translation: Should it be extraneous it may happen to anyone through any cause. But this cause is single due to its nature not being variegated.
verses.hindi: समान धवल वर्णवाले, जटाधारी और दरिद्रतारूपी दुःखके विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: महाशरभशार्दूलसिंहैः सदृशविक्रमम् । प्रशस्तमत्तमातङ्गसमानगमनालसम्
verses.transliteration: mahAsharabhashArdUlasiMhaiH sadR^ishavikramam | prashastamattamAta~NgasamAnagamanAlasam
verses.translation: Though the Atman-hood is common some are bound and some liberated. Among those in bondage some have differing degrees of knowledge and eminence due to their being inclined towards abstinence and enjoyment. Some attain the status of identicality with the lord. Some attain the state of nearness.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचामरकुन्देन्दुमृणालसदृशप्रभम् । सतुषारमिवाद्रीन्द्रं साक्षाज्जङ्गमतां गतम्
verses.transliteration: sha~NkhachAmarakundendumR^iNAlasadR^ishaprabham | satuShAramivAdrIndraM sAkShAjja~NgamatAM gatam
verses.translation: Among those who have attained identicality, some are Sivas. They are stationed on the top of the Adhvas (pathways). Mahesvaras are stationed in the middle; Rudras in the lower region.
verses.hindi: विनाशक' भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालापरिक्षिप्तं दीप्तमौक्तिकभूषणम् । तेजसा चैव दीव्यन्तं युगान्त इव पावकम्
verses.transliteration: jvAlAmAlAparikShiptaM dIptamauktikabhUShaNam | tejasA chaiva dIvyantaM yugAnta iva pAvakam
verses.translation: In the vicinity too the three are stationed beyond Maya: the Atman is stationed below; the Antarat- man i'* stationed 'n the middle and the Paramatman is stationed beyond. They are Brahma, Vi§nu and Mahesvara. Some Vasus too are stationed in the region of Paramatman.

verses.sanskrit: स जानुभ्यां महीं गत्वा प्रणतः प्राञ्जलिस्ततः । पार्श्वतो देवदेवस्य पर्यतिष्ठद् गणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa jAnubhyAM mahIM gatvA praNataH prA~njalistataH | pArshvato devadevasya paryatiShThad gaNeshvaraH
verses.translation: Some are stationed in the region of Antaratman, some in the region of Atman. In the region of Santyatita Saivas are stationed and in the iSanta region the Mahesvaras are stationed.

verses.sanskrit: मन्युना चासृजद्भद्रां भद्रकालीं महेश्वरीम् । आत्मनः कर्मसाक्षित्वे तेन गन्तुं सहैव तु
verses.transliteration: manyunA chAsR^ijadbhadrAM bhadrakAlIM maheshvarIm | AtmanaH karmasAkShitve tena gantuM sahaiva tu
verses.translation: Just as Raudras are stationed in Vidya and the Vaisnavas in Pratistha, so also the Atmans. Brahma and Brahma-born are stationed in Nivrlti.
verses.hindi: लिये तमोगुणाविष्ट होनेवाले तथा दरिद्रतारूपी दुःखके विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वावस्थितं वीरभद्रं कालाग्निसन्निभम् । भद्रया सहितं प्राह भद्रमस्त्विति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvAvasthitaM vIrabhadraM kAlAgnisannibham | bhadrayA sahitaM prAha bhadramastviti sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: The eight groups of Deva-Beings are the chief ones. The human beings constitute the middling. The five Beings birdes etc. constitute the lower ones. Thus there are fourteen Beings.

verses.sanskrit: स च विज्ञापयामास सह देव्या महेश्वरम् । आज्ञापय महादेव किं कार्यं करवाण्यहम्
verses.transliteration: sa cha vij~nApayAmAsa saha devyA maheshvaram | Aj~nApaya mahAdeva kiM kAryaM karavANyaham
verses.translation: The state of being chief or subsidiary shall be known as the dirt of the worldly being. Just as the food we take in has two states, the undigested and the digested, so the dirt too. When it is undigested the men go lower down; when it is digested they go up. Thus the dirt plays its part in the worldly existence.
verses.hindi: विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्रिपुरहा प्राह हैमवत्याः प्रियेच्छया । वीरभद्रं महाबाहुं वाचा विपुलनादया
verses.transliteration: tatastripurahA prAha haimavatyAH priyechChayA | vIrabhadraM mahAbAhuM vAchA vipulanAdayA
verses.translation: The individual souls are threefold: those with single dirt, with two dirts and with three dirts. Those with single dirt are the higher ones, those with two dirts the middlings and those with three dirts shall be known as-Uu" meanest. Thus they are stationed in order,
verses.hindi: पुण्येषु. पुण्यभरिताय सुराचिताय दारिद्यदुःखदहनाय नम: शिवाय

verses.sanskrit: महादेव उवाच । प्राचेतसस्य दक्षस्य यज्ञं सद्यो विनाशय । भद्रकाल्या सहासि त्वमेतत्कृत्यं गणेश्वर
verses.transliteration: mahAdeva uvAcha | prAchetasasya dakShasya yaj~naM sadyo vinAshaya | bhadrakAlyA sahAsi tvametatkR^ityaM gaNeshvara
verses.translation: Those with three dirts are presided over by those with two dirts and those in turn are presided over by those with single dirt. Thus is the conditioned difference in the universe.
verses.hindi: तथा दरिद्रतारूपी दुःखके विनाशक भगवान् शिवको मेरा नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे प्राप्ते दक्षः प्राचेतसः स्वयम् । अश्वमेधेन यज्ञेन यक्ष्यमाणोऽन्वपद्यत
verses.transliteration: vaivasvate.antare prApte dakShaH prAchetasaH svayam | ashvamedhena yaj~nena yakShyamANo.anvapadyata
verses.translation: Siva presides over all these, those with single, two and three dirts. Though they arc of non-iva nature they are presided over by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अहमप्यनया सार्द्धं रैभ्याश्रमसपीपतः । स्थित्वा वीक्षे गणेशान विक्रमं तव दुःसहम्
verses.transliteration: ahamapyanayA sArddhaM raibhyAshramasapIpataH | sthitvA vIkShe gaNeshAna vikramaM tava duHsaham
verses.translation: They are the squatters in heaven, atmosphere and earth. They are the gods observing the rites of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षाः कनखले ये तु गङ्गाद्वारसमीपगाः । सुवर्णशृङ्गस्य गिरेर्मेरुमन्दरसन्निभाः
verses.transliteration: vR^ikShAH kanakhale ye tu ga~NgAdvArasamIpagAH | suvarNashR^i~Ngasya girermerumandarasannibhAH
verses.translation: Thus functions the ailment of worldly existence with the three dirts and their pathological reasons separately, whether ripe or unripe.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे दक्षस्य युज्ञः सम्प्रति वर्तते । सहसा तस्य यज्ञस्य विघातं कुरु मा चिरम्
verses.transliteration: tasminpradeshe dakShasya yuj~naH samprati vartate | sahasA tasya yaj~nasya vighAtaM kuru mA chiram
verses.translation: In this regard no doubt need be entertained — "Siva can liberate the souls without subjecting them to misery. Why does he then subject them to misery?"

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते सति देवेन देवी हिमगिरीन्द्रजा । भद्रं भद्रां च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वत्सं धेनुरिवौरसम्
verses.transliteration: ityukte sati devena devI himagirIndrajA | bhadraM bhadrAM cha samprekShya vatsaM dhenurivaurasam
verses.translation: A patient does not become non-patient merely be¬ cause the physician administers medicine. The physician redeems the patient from the sickness through the medicines.

verses.sanskrit: आलिङ्ग्य च समाघ्राय मूर्ध्नि षड्वदनं यथा । सस्मिता वचनं प्राह मधुरं मधुरं स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: Ali~Ngya cha samAghrAya mUrdhni ShaDvadanaM yathA | sasmitA vachanaM prAha madhuraM madhuraM svayam
verses.translation: Similarly, through the administration of the medi¬ cine in the form of his Ajfia, Siva liberates the souls from misery — the souls innately dirty and innately miserable.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । वत्स भद्र महाभाग महाबलपराक्रम । मत्प्रियार्थं त्वमुत्पन्नो मम मन्युं प्रमार्जय
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | vatsa bhadra mahAbhAga mahAbalaparAkrama | matpriyArthaM tvamutpanno mama manyuM pramArjaya
verses.translation: The wise say just as the magnetic stone causes the movement of the iron filings by its mere proximity, so also Siva causes the movement of the world.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञेश्वरमनाहूय यज्ञकर्मरतोऽभवत् । दक्षं वैरेण तं तस्माद्भिन्धि यज्ञं गणेश्वर
verses.transliteration: yaj~neshvaramanAhUya yaj~nakarmarato.abhavat | dakShaM vaireNa taM tasmAdbhindhi yaj~naM gaNeshvara
verses.translation: Nothing functions without Siva. Everything is induced by him. Still he is not deluded.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञलक्ष्मीमलक्ष्मीं त्वं भद्र कृत्वा ममाज्ञया । यजमानं च तं हत्वा वत्स हिंसय भद्रया
verses.transliteration: yaj~nalakShmImalakShmIM tvaM bhadra kR^itvA mamAj~nayA | yajamAnaM cha taM hatvA vatsa hiMsaya bhadrayA
verses.translation: He who considers otherwise due to delusion is evil- minded. He perishes and that too due to the power of his Sakti. Still he is not defiled.

verses.sanskrit: अशेषामिव तामाज्ञां शिवयोश्चित्रकृत्ययोः । मूर्ध्नि कृत्वा नमस्कृत्य भद्रो गन्तुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: asheShAmiva tAmAj~nAM shivayoshchitrakR^ityayoH | mUrdhni kR^itvA namaskR^itya bhadro gantuM prachakrame
verses.translation: Then the sages were surprised and delighted; their doubts were quelled. They bowed to the lord, the wind-god.

verses.sanskrit: अथैष भगवान्क्रुद्धः प्रेतावासकृतालयः । वीरभद्रो महादेवो देव्या मन्युप्रमार्जकः
verses.transliteration: athaiSha bhagavAnkruddhaH pretAvAsakR^itAlayaH | vIrabhadro mahAdevo devyA manyupramArjakaH
verses.translation: Although he had cleared their doubts he thought that their knowledge was not firmly established. So he said:

verses.sanskrit: ततो हिमवतः पृष्ठे दक्षो वै यज्ञमाहरत् । गङ्गाद्वारे शुभे देशे ऋषिसिद्धनिषेविते
verses.transliteration: tato himavataH pR^iShThe dakSho vai yaj~namAharat | ga~NgAdvAre shubhe deshe R^iShisiddhaniShevite
verses.translation: Coming to the conclusion that salvation is not possible without direct knowledge, strive assiduously for the acquisition of practice.

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज रोमकूपेभ्यो रोमजाख्यान् गणेश्वरान् । दक्षिणाद्भुजदेशात्तु शतकोटिगणेश्वरान्
verses.transliteration: sasarja romakUpebhyo romajAkhyAn gaNeshvarAn | dakShiNAdbhujadeshAttu shatakoTigaNeshvarAn
verses.translation: The five activities along with attendant virtuous rites constitute the greatest Dharma. Thereby one attains the direct and indirect knowledge that bestows salvation.

verses.sanskrit: पादात्तथोरुदेशाच्च पृष्ठात्पार्श्वान्मुखाद्गलात् । गुह्याद् गुल्फाच्छिरोमध्यात्कण्ठादास्यात्तथोदरात्
verses.transliteration: pAdAttathorudeshAchcha pR^iShThAtpArshvAnmukhAdgalAt | guhyAd gulphAchChiromadhyAtkaNThAdAsyAttathodarAt
verses.translation: The two Dharmas the higher and secondary are mentioned in the Vedas. In the matter of Dharma the Vedas constitute the final authority for us.

verses.sanskrit: तदा गणेश्वरैर्भद्रैर्भद्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः । सञ्छादितमभूत्सर्वं साकाशविवरं जगत्
verses.transliteration: tadA gaNeshvarairbhadrairbhadratulyaparAkramaiH | sa~nChAditamabhUtsarvaM sAkAshavivaraM jagat
verses.translation: The higher dharma upto the practice of Yoga is mentioned in the Vedantic section of the Vedas. The secondary Dharma is mentioned in the Karmakanda section of the same.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे सहस्रहस्तास्ते सहस्रायुधपाणयः । रुद्रस्यानुचराः सर्वे सर्वे रुद्रसमप्रभाः
verses.transliteration: sarve sahasrahastAste sahasrAyudhapANayaH | rudrasyAnucharAH sarve sarve rudrasamaprabhAH
verses.translation: The Atmans freed from Pasa are authorised in the higher Dharma and in the other one, every one is authorised.

verses.sanskrit: शूलशक्तिगदाहस्ताष्टङ्कोपलशिलाधराः । कालाग्निरुद्रसदृशास्त्रिनेत्राश्च जटाधराः
verses.transliteration: shUlashaktigadAhastAShTa~NkopalashilAdharAH | kAlAgnirudrasadR^ishAstrinetrAshcha jaTAdharAH
verses.translation: The greatest Dharma of Siva termed the excellent practice is explained in the Itihasas and the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: निपेतुर्भृशमाकाशे शतशः सिंहवाहनाः । विनेदुश्च महानादाञ्जलदा इव भद्रजाः
verses.transliteration: nipeturbhR^ishamAkAshe shatashaH siMhavAhanAH | vinedushcha mahAnAdA~njaladA iva bhadrajAH
verses.translation: In the Saiva Agamas a detailed explanation of every thing including the consecratory rites is given.

verses.sanskrit: तैर्भद्रैर्भगवान् भद्रस्तथा परिवृतो बभौ । कालानलशतैर्युक्तो यथान्ते कालभैरवः
verses.transliteration: tairbhadrairbhagavAn bhadrastathA parivR^ito babhau | kAlAnalashatairyukto yathAnte kAlabhairavaH
verses.translation: The independent texts were originally ten but supplemented subsequently by eight more so as to constitute eighteen texts. They are called Kamika etc., and the entire literature is called "Saiva Siddhanta"

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मध्ये समारुह्य वृषेन्द्रं वृषभध्वजः । जगाम भगवान् भद्रः शुभ्रमभ्रं यथा भवः
verses.transliteration: teShAM madhye samAruhya vR^iShendraM vR^iShabhadhvajaH | jagAma bhagavAn bhadraH shubhramabhraM yathA bhavaH
verses.translation: The Srauta literature consists of a billion verses. In it the Paiupata Vrata and Jfiana are explained.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्वृषभमारूढे भद्रे तु भसितप्रभः । बभार मौक्तिकं छत्रं गृहीतसितचामरः
verses.transliteration: tasminvR^iShabhamArUDhe bhadre tu bhasitaprabhaH | babhAra mauktikaM ChatraM gR^ihItasitachAmaraH
verses.translation: In every circle of Yugas, §iva incarnates as Yogacarya in different places and propagates yoga.

verses.sanskrit: स तदा शुशुभे पार्श्वे भद्रस्य भसितप्रभः । भगवानिव शैलेन्द्रः पार्श्वे विश्वजगद्गुरोः
verses.transliteration: sa tadA shushubhe pArshve bhadrasya bhasitaprabhaH | bhagavAniva shailendraH pArshve vishvajagadguroH
verses.translation: The four great sages Ruru, Dadhica, Agastya and the renowned Upamanyu have condensed these principles and propagated them.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तस्मिन्मखे देवाः सर्वे शक्रपुरोगमाः । गमनाय समागम्य बुद्धिमापेदिरे तदा
verses.transliteration: tasya tasminmakhe devAH sarve shakrapurogamAH | gamanAya samAgamya buddhimApedire tadA
verses.translation: They are all Pasupatas and exponents of the Samhitas. Hundreds and thousands of their descendants have been the pi eceptors of their principles.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि तेन बभौ भद्रः श्वेतचामरपाणिना । बालसोमेन सौम्येन यथा शूलवरायुधः
verses.transliteration: so.api tena babhau bhadraH shvetachAmarapANinA | bAlasomena saumyena yathA shUlavarAyudhaH
verses.translation: The great virtue of Siva mentioned before is four-

verses.sanskrit: दध्मौ शङ्खं सितं भद्रं भद्रस्य पुरतः शुभम् । भानुकम्पो महातेजा हेमरत्नैरलङ्कृतः
verses.transliteration: dadhmau sha~NkhaM sitaM bhadraM bhadrasya purataH shubham | bhAnukampo mahAtejA hemaratnairala~NkR^itaH
verses.translation: Through this discernment the stable and perfect knowledge is attained ere long. Siva is delighted with him whose knowledge is well-founded.

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुर्दिव्यसङ्कुलनिःस्वनाः । ववृषुः शतशो मूर्ध्नि पुष्पवर्षं बलाहकाः
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayo nedurdivyasa~NkulaniHsvanAH | vavR^iShuH shatasho mUrdhni puShpavarShaM balAhakAH
verses.translation: Siva, Mahesvara, Rudra, Visnu, Pitamaha, Samsaravaidya, Sarvajfta and Paramatman — these eight names mainly indicate Siva. The first five are the names of the deities presiding over the Kalas, Santyatita etc.®

verses.sanskrit: फुल्लानां मधुगर्भाणां पुष्पाणां गन्धबन्धवः । मार्गानुकूलसंवाहा ववुश्च पथि मारुताः
verses.transliteration: phullAnAM madhugarbhANAM puShpANAM gandhabandhavaH | mArgAnukUlasaMvAhA vavushcha pathi mArutAH
verses.translation: He who is naturally pure is called Siva. He has the antecedent non-existence of the contact of the primordial dirt. Or, he who is full of good attributes and is Isvara is called Siva by good men who propound the Saivite principles.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गणेश्वराः सर्वे मत्ता युद्धबलोद्धताः । ननृतुर्मुमुदुर्नेदुर्जहसुर्जगदुर्जगुः
verses.transliteration: tato gaNeshvarAH sarve mattA yuddhabaloddhatAH | nanR^iturmumudurnedurjahasurjagadurjaguH
verses.translation: The name MaheSvara is explained thus: Prakrti is greater than the twenty-three principles. Purusa the twenty fifth principle is greater than Prakrti. Purusa is Pranava the

verses.sanskrit: तदा भद्रगणान्तःस्थो बभौ भद्रः सभद्रया । यथा रुद्रगणान्तः स्थस्त्र्यम्बकोऽम्बिकया सह
verses.transliteration: tadA bhadragaNAntaHstho babhau bhadraH sabhadrayA | yathA rudragaNAntaH sthastryambako.ambikayA saha
verses.translation: The twentytwo verses (23-44) of this chapter are the same a> the versrs 1-22 of Kailasa S. Gh. r|.

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षणादेव दक्षस्य यज्ञवाटं हिरण्मयम् । प्रविवेश महाबाहुर्वीरभद्रो महानुगः
verses.transliteration: tatkShaNAdeva dakShasya yaj~navATaM hiraNmayam | pravivesha mahAbAhurvIrabhadro mahAnugaH
verses.translation: See P. 1072 note

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु दक्षप्रतिपादितस्य क्रतुप्रधानस्य गणप्रधानः । प्रयोगभूमिं प्रविवेश भद्रो रुद्रो यथान्ते भुवनं दिधक्षुः
verses.transliteration: tatastu dakShapratipAditasya kratupradhAnasya gaNapradhAnaH | prayogabhUmiM pravivesha bhadro rudro yathAnte bhuvanaM didhakShuH
verses.translation: The explanation of the word Rudra: — 'Rud' means misery and 'Dravayati' means 'routs'. Since the lord quells our misery he is called Rudra.*®* He is Siva, the great cause.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्याः सह मरुद्गणैः । ऊष्मपाः सोमपाश्चैव आज्यपा धूमपास्तथा
verses.transliteration: AdityA vasavo rudrAH sAdhyAH saha marudgaNaiH | UShmapAH somapAshchaiva AjyapA dhUmapAstathA
verses.translation: Siva pervades all living beings, the principles and elements. He is wakefully present in the bodies and presides over them. Hence he is called Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: अश्विनौ पितरश्चैव तथा चान्ये महर्षयः । विष्णुना सहिताः सर्वे स्वागता यज्ञभागिनः
verses.transliteration: ashvinau pitarashchaiva tathA chAnye maharShayaH | viShNunA sahitAH sarve svAgatA yaj~nabhAginaH
verses.translation: Siva is called the physician of the universe. Just as the physician who is conversant with the pathology diagnoses and cures the ailment with medicines so also the lord anni¬ hilates the worldly existence along with its roots. He is so called by all those who understand the nature of principles.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा देवकुलं सर्वमीश्वरेण विना गतम् । दधीचो मन्युनाविष्टो दक्षमेवमभाषत
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA devakulaM sarvamIshvareNa vinA gatam | dadhIcho manyunAviShTo dakShamevamabhAShata
verses.translation: Even when they have the sense-organs for compre¬ hending the ten objects of sensual perception, the atoms do not know the beings gross and subtle, present in the three periods of time, in their entirety because they arc hidden by the particles of dirt in the form of Maya, whereas Sadaiva has not these causes of perception. Even when they are not present, he knows without any strain every object as it is. Hence, he is Sarvajna (omniscient).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The Atman shall be taken above to the splendour of Siva beyond the moon stationed in the twelve-petal led lotus of the heart. The mouth is shrunk in size. The body is drenched with the shower of the nectar of the Sakti and merged in their reasons. The Atman is then let down into the heart.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The Atman shall be taken above to the splendour of Siva beyond the moon stationed in the twelve-petal led lotus of the heart. The mouth is shrunk in size. The body is drenched with the shower of the nectar of the Sakti and merged in their reasons. The Atman is then let down into the heart.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२०. विंशोऽध्यायः । यज्ञविध्वंसनः । वायुरुवाच । ततो विष्णुप्रधानानां सुराणाममितौजसाम् । ददर्श च महत्सत्रं चित्रध्वजपरिच्छदम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.20\. viMsho.adhyAyaH | yaj~navidhvaMsanaH | vAyuruvAcha | tato viShNupradhAnAnAM surANAmamitaujasAm | dadarsha cha mahatsatraM chitradhvajaparichChadam
verses.translation: The devotee then meditates on the great god Siva, favourably disposed to his devotees who is conceived as sitting in the white twelve-petalled lotus beyond the moon, who in the sweet crystal-pure, delighted, cool, lustrous form of Ardhanarisvara, shall be meditated upon. The devotee shall have the mind in normal state. He shall then worship the lord with the eight names of Siva and the sacred flowers.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वताश्च व्यशीर्यन्त चकम्पे च वसुन्धरा । मरुतश्च व्यघूर्णन्त चुक्षुभे मकरालयः
verses.transliteration: parvatAshcha vyashIryanta chakampe cha vasundharA | marutashcha vyaghUrNanta chukShubhe makarAlayaH
verses.translation: At the end of the worship the devotee shall perform Pranayama and concentrate the mind well. He shall perform the japa of the eight names of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नयो नैव दीप्यन्ते न च दीप्यति भास्करः । ग्रहाश्च न प्रकाशन्ते नक्षत्राणि च तारकाः
verses.transliteration: agnayo naiva dIpyante na cha dIpyati bhAskaraH | grahAshcha na prakAshante nakShatrANi cha tArakAH
verses.translation: He shall perform eight Ahutis in the navel and repeat "Namah" alope with the Purnahuti, offering eight flowers and conclude worship. With a palmful of water he shall dedicate his Atman. By doing this, ere long, the auspi¬ cious knowledge of Pasupata cult is obtained. He acquires its magnificent status and the excellent conduct. Then securing the great Yoga he is liberated. There is no doubt in this.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु यज्ञवाटं तदुज्ज्वलम् । सम्प्राप भगवान्भद्रो भद्रैश्च सह भद्रया
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kAle tu yaj~navATaM tadujjvalam | samprApa bhagavAnbhadro bhadraishcha saha bhadrayA
verses.translation: O holy lord, we wish to hear of the great Pasupata vrata on performing which Brahma and others have become Palupatas.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा भीतभीतोऽपि दक्षो दृढ इव स्थितः । क्रुद्धवद् वचनं प्राह को भवान् किमिहेच्छसि
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA bhItabhIto.api dakSho dR^iDha iva sthitaH | kruddhavad vachanaM prAha ko bhavAn kimihechChasi
verses.translation: I shall tell you the great secret, Pasupata vrata

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दक्षस्य च दुरात्मनः । वीरभद्रो महातेजा मेघगम्भीरनिःस्वनः
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA dakShasya cha durAtmanaH | vIrabhadro mahAtejA meghagambhIraniHsvanaH
verses.translation: .The time is the month of Ghaitra and the full-moon- day therein. The place is anywhere acceptable to Siva having good characteristics. It shall be auspicious, say, the garden in a holy centre or a forest.

verses.sanskrit: स्मयन्निव तमालोक्य दक्षं देवांश्च ऋत्विजः । अर्थगर्भमसम्भ्रान्तमवोचदुचितं वचः
verses.transliteration: smayanniva tamAlokya dakShaM devAMshcha R^itvijaH | arthagarbhamasambhrAntamavochaduchitaM vachaH
verses.translation: There, first of all, on the thirteenth day he shall perform the special worship after taking his bath and performing the daily rites. He shall take the formal per¬ mission of the preceptor after bowing to him and honouring him. He shall wear pure white cloths. The sacred thread shall be white. He shall wear a garland of white flowers. White unguent shall be measured over the body. He shall be seated on Darbha grass. He shall hold a handful of Darbha grass, sit facing east or the north. After performing the Pranayama three times he shall meditate on the lord and the goddess. By way of submitting to them he shall perform the Sahkalpa saying, 'T am perfoiming this Vrata (of Pasupata) ". The time limit for this Vrata is till death, or twelve years or six years, or three years or twelve months, or six months or three months or a month or twelve days or six days or three days or one day.

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्र उवाच । वयं ह्यनुचराः सर्वे शर्वस्यामिततेजसः । भागाभिलिप्सया प्राप्ता भागो नः सम्प्रदीयताम्
verses.transliteration: vIrabhadra uvAcha | vayaM hyanucharAH sarve sharvasyAmitatejasaH | bhAgAbhilipsayA prAptA bhAgo naH sampradIyatAm
verses.translation: He shall arrange the sacrificial fire duly as in the Virajahoma. He shall make the offerings of ghee, sacrificial twigs and caru and perform homa. After the Purnahuti, deserving the purity of the Tattvas, he shall perform the homa with the five-syllabled mantra and the sacrificial twigs.

verses.sanskrit: अथ चेदध्वरेऽस्माकं न भागः परिकल्पितः । कथ्यतां कारणं तत्र युध्यतां वा मयामरैः
verses.transliteration: atha chedadhvare.asmAkaM na bhAgaH parikalpitaH | kathyatAM kAraNaM tatra yudhyatAM vA mayAmaraiH
verses.translation: In the course of the sacrifice -he shall think thus — ''Let the Tat vas in my body be purified." The Tattvas are:— The five elements, the five Tanmatras, the five sense-organs of knowledge, the five organs of activity, the seven Dhatus beginning with the skin, the five vital airs beginning with Prana, mind, intellect, ego, the three Gunas, Prakrti, Puru?a, Raga (passion), Vidya, Kala,'Niyati, Time, Maya, pure Vidya, Mahesvara, Sadasiva, l§akti and Siva Tattva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तास्ते गणेन्द्रेण देवा दक्षपुरोगमाः । ऊचुर्मन्त्राः प्रमाणं नो न वयं प्रभवस्त्विति
verses.transliteration: ityuktAste gaNendreNa devA dakShapurogamAH | UchurmantrAH pramANaM no na vayaM prabhavastviti
verses.translation: After performing the Homa with the Viraja

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रा ऊचुस्सुरा यूयं मोहोपहतचेतसः । येन प्रथमभागार्हं न यजध्वं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: mantrA UchussurA yUyaM mohopahatachetasaH | yena prathamabhAgArhaM na yajadhvaM maheshvaram
verses.translation: On the morning of the fourteenth day he shall perform everything as mentioned before. On that day he shall observe fast and thus spend the latter part of the day.

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्भऋतुसंस्तीर्णं सुसमिद्धहुताशनम् । काञ्चनैर्यज्ञभाण्डैश्च भ्राजिष्णुभिरलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: sudarbhaR^itusaMstIrNaM susamiddhahutAshanam | kA~nchanairyaj~nabhANDaishcha bhrAjiShNubhirala~NkR^itam
verses.translation: On the full moon day also he shall perform similar rites. At the conclusion of the sacrifice the sacred fire shall be extinguished and the ashes gathered assiduously.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रोक्ता अपि ते देवाः सर्वे सम्मूढचेतसः । भद्राय न ददुर्भागं तत्प्रहाणमभीप्सवः
verses.transliteration: mantroktA api te devAH sarve sammUDhachetasaH | bhadrAya na dadurbhAgaM tatprahANamabhIpsavaH
verses.translation: Thereafter he shall keep matted hair or shave off the hair completely or keep one matted tuft of hair. He shall take bath then. If he is not extremely bashful he shall remain naked thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तथ्यं च पथ्यं च स्ववाक्यं तद्वृथाऽभवत् । तदा ततो ययुर्मन्त्रा ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: yadA tathyaM cha pathyaM cha svavAkyaM tadvR^ithA.abhavat | tadA tato yayurmantrA brahmalokaM sanAtanam
verses.translation: Or he can wear ochre robes, hide or barks of trees. Only a single cloth or a single bark garment shall be worn. He shall have the staff and the girdle.

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच गणाध्यक्षो देवान् विष्णुपुरोगमान् । मन्त्राः प्रमाणं न कृता युष्माभिर्बलगर्वितैः
verses.transliteration: athovAcha gaNAdhyakSho devAn viShNupurogamAn | mantrAH pramANaM na kR^itA yuShmAbhirbalagarvitaiH
verses.translation: He shall wash the feet and perform Acamana twice. He shall apply the ashes taken out of the Viraja fire all over his body from head to foot repeating the six mantras beginning with "Agniriti"*®® from the Atharvana texts.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादस्मिन् मखे देवैरित्थं वयमसत्कृताः । तस्माद्वो जीवितैस्सार्द्धमपनेष्यामि गर्वितम्
verses.transliteration: yasmAdasmin makhe devairitthaM vayamasatkR^itAH | tasmAdvo jIvitaissArddhamapaneShyAmi garvitam
verses.translation: Then in the same way he shall dust the body entirely repeating the Pranava Oih and 'Siva'.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् क्रुद्धो व्यदहन्नेत्रवह्निना । यज्ञवाटं महाकूटं यथा तिस्रः पुरो हरः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA bhagavAn kruddho vyadahannetravahninA | yaj~navATaM mahAkUTaM yathA tisraH puro haraH
verses.translation: Then repeating the mantra 'Triyayusam' he shall wear Tripunra marks. He shall realise his own Siva-hood and perform 'Sivayoga*.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गणेश्वराः सर्वे पर्वतोदग्रविग्रहाः । यूपानुत्पाट्य होतॄणां कण्ठेष्वाबध्य रज्जुभिः
verses.transliteration: tato gaNeshvarAH sarve parvatodagravigrahAH | yUpAnutpATya hotR^INAM kaNTheShvAbadhya rajjubhiH
verses.translation: He shall act thus during all the three Sandhyas. This Paupata Vrata yields worldly pleasures and salvation dispelling Pasu-hood.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञपात्राणि चित्राणि भित्त्वा सञ्चूर्ण्य वारिणि । गृहीत्वा चैव यज्ञाङ्गं गङ्गास्रोतसि चिक्षिपुः
verses.transliteration: yaj~napAtrANi chitrANi bhittvA sa~nchUrNya vAriNi | gR^ihItvA chaiva yaj~nA~NgaM ga~NgAsrotasi chikShipuH
verses.translation: Freed from Pau-hood, the devotee shall worship the phallic image of l§iva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दिव्यान्नपानानां राशयः पर्वतोपमाः । क्षीरनद्योऽमृतस्रावाः सुस्निग्धदधिकर्दमाः
verses.transliteration: tatra divyAnnapAnAnAM rAshayaH parvatopamAH | kShIranadyo.amR^itasrAvAH susnigdhadadhikardamAH
verses.translation: If capacity permits, an eight-petalled Padma shall be made in gold embellished with the nine precious gems. The pericarp and the filaments shall be furnished.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चावचानि मांसानि भक्ष्याणि सुरभीणि च । रसवन्ति च पानानि लेह्यचोष्याणि तानि वै
verses.transliteration: uchchAvachAni mAMsAni bhakShyANi surabhINi cha | rasavanti cha pAnAni lehyachoShyANi tAni vai
verses.translation: In the middle of the pericarp a small crystal phallic image along with its pedestal shall be kept and worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: वीरास्तद्भुञ्जते वक्त्रैर्विलुम्पन्ति क्षिपन्ति च । वज्रैश्चक्रैर्महाशूलैः शक्तिभिः पाशपट्टिशैः
verses.transliteration: vIrAstadbhu~njate vaktrairvilumpanti kShipanti cha | vajraishchakrairmahAshUlaiH shaktibhiH pAshapaTTishaiH
verses.translation: After installing the phallic image in accordance with the rules with due consecrations the pedestal shall be conceived along with the idol of five faces.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्यज्ञपटुभिर्यथावत्कर्मकर्तृभिः । विधिना वेददृष्टेन स्वनुष्ठितबहुक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: R^iShibhiryaj~napaTubhiryathAvatkarmakartR^ibhiH | vidhinA vedadR^iShTena svanuShThitabahukramam
verses.translation: The ablution shall be performed with golden vessels, filled with Paftcagavya*® collected in accordance with one's capacity.

verses.sanskrit: मुसलैरसिभिष्टङ्कैर्भिन्दिपालैः परश्वधैः । उद्धतांस्त्रिदशान्सर्वांल्लोकपालपुरस्सरान्
verses.transliteration: musalairasibhiShTa~NkairbhindipAlaiH parashvadhaiH | uddhatAMstridashAnsarvAMllokapAlapurassarAn
verses.translation: The vessels shall contain scents along with cam¬ phor, sandal and saffron and these shall be smeared over the phallic image bedecked in ornaments. He shall worship it with Bilva leaves, red, white and blue lotuses, other fragrant flowers, holy and auspicious leaves, Durva grass of various types, in accordance with their availability and the rules of worship.

verses.sanskrit: बिभिदुर्बलिनो वीरा वीरभद्राङ्गसम्भवाः । छिन्धि भिन्धि क्षिप क्षिप्रं मार्यतां दार्यतामिति
verses.transliteration: bibhidurbalino vIrA vIrabhadrA~NgasambhavAH | Chindhi bhindhi kShipa kShipraM mAryatAM dAryatAmiti
verses.translation: Showing of lights, incense and the food offerings shall be made to the deity. After offering it to the deity the devotee shall be engaged in auspicious activities.

verses.sanskrit: हरस्व प्रहरस्वेति पाटयोत्पाटयेति च । संरम्भप्रभवाः क्रूराः शब्दाः श्रवणशङ्कवः
verses.transliteration: harasva praharasveti pATayotpATayeti cha | saMrambhaprabhavAH krUrAH shabdAH shravaNasha~NkavaH
verses.translation: In this Vrata exquisite and pleasing things acquired legitimately, whatever they may be, shall be offered to the deity.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तत्र गणेशानां जज्ञिरे समरोचिताः । विवृत्तनयनाः केचिद् दष्टदंष्ट्रोष्ठतालवः
verses.transliteration: yatra tatra gaNeshAnAM jaj~nire samarochitAH | vivR^ittanayanAH kechid daShTadaMShTroShThatAlavaH
verses.translation: The leaf of the Bilva tree shall never be excluded. A gold lotus is greater than a thousand lotuses. The case of blue lotuses is also on a par with that of Bilva leaves. With regard to the other flowers there is no restriction. They shall be offered just as they are available.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमस्थान् समाकृष्य मारयन्ति तपोधनान् । स्रुवानपहरन्तश्च क्षिपन्तोऽग्निं जलेषु च
verses.transliteration: AshramasthAn samAkR^iShya mArayanti tapodhanAn | sruvAnapaharantashcha kShipanto.agniM jaleShu cha
verses.translation: Sandal, Aguru, etc., along with sugar candy, honey, camphor and the ghee of a tawny-coloured cow can be offered to all.

verses.sanskrit: कलशानपि भिन्दन्तश्छिन्दन्तो मणिवेदिकाः । गायन्तश्च नदन्तश्च हसन्तश्च मुहुर्मुहुः । रक्तासवं पिबन्तश्च ननृतुर्गणपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: kalashAnapi bhindantashChindanto maNivedikAH | gAyantashcha nadantashcha hasantashcha muhurmuhuH | raktAsavaM pibantashcha nanR^iturgaNapu~NgavAH
verses.translation: Thereafter series of lights with camphor and wick soaked in ghee shall be offered. Arghya and Acamana shall be offered to every face.

verses.sanskrit: निर्मथ्य सेन्द्रानमरान् गणेन्द्रा वृषेन्द्रनागेन्द्रमृगेन्द्रसाराः । चक्रुर्बहून्यप्रतिमभावाः सहर्षरोमाणि विचेष्टितानि
verses.transliteration: nirmathya sendrAnamarAn gaNendrA vR^iShendranAgendramR^igendrasArAH | chakrurbahUnyapratimabhAvAH saharSharomANi vicheShTitAni
verses.translation: In the first (outer column of the mystic diagram) Ganeiia and Karttikeya shall be worshipped. Brahma's body shall also be worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दन्ति केचित्प्रहरन्ति केचित् धावन्ति केचित्प्रलपन्ति केचित्
verses.transliteration: nandanti kechitpraharanti kechit dhAvanti kechitpralapanti kechit
verses.translation: In the second Avarana shall be worshipped Vighnesas the Gakravartins. The eight deities*** Bhava and others shall be worshioped in the third Avarana.

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यन्ति केचिद्विहसन्ति केचित् वल्गन्ति केचित्प्रमथा बलेन
verses.transliteration: nR^ityanti kechidvihasanti kechit valganti kechitpramathA balena
verses.translation: There the eleven deities*** Mahadeva and others shall be worshipped. All the Ganevaras shall be worshipped in the fourth Avarana.

verses.sanskrit: केचिज्जिघृक्षन्ति घनान्स तोयान् केचिद्ग्रहीतुं रविमुत्पतन्ति । केचित्प्रसर्तुं पवनेन सार्द्ध- मिच्छन्ति भीमाः प्रमथा वियत्स्थाः
verses.transliteration: kechijjighR^ikShanti ghanAnsa toyAn kechidgrahItuM ravimutpatanti | kechitprasartuM pavanena sArddha\- michChanti bhImAH pramathA viyatsthAH
verses.translation: Outside the lotus the mystic diagram and in the fifth Avarana shall be worshipped the lords of the ten quarters along with their weapons and followers, the mental sons of Brahma, the luminary bodies, the goddesses and ods, the heaven-walkers, the residents of the netherworlds, the other sages, Yogins, the sacrifices, the birds, the mothers, the Ketrapalas with their Ganas and the universe including the mobile and immobile beings. These shall be worshipped, as they are possessed of Siva's pre-eminence. They shall be worshipped for the pleasure of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: देवाङ्गनासहस्राढ्यमप्सरोगणसेवितम् । वेणुवीणारवैर्जुष्टं वेदघोषैश्च बृंहितम्
verses.transliteration: devA~NganAsahasrADhyamapsarogaNasevitam | veNuvINAravairjuShTaM vedaghoShaishcha bR^iMhitam
verses.translation: Then at the end of the worship of the Avaraas, after worsliipping the supreme lord, delicious Havis shall be offered as Naivedya along with ghee and side-dishc.<».

verses.sanskrit: आक्षिप्य केचिच्च वरायुधानि महाभुजङ्गानिव वैनतेयाः । भ्रमन्ति देवानपि विद्रवन्तः खमण्डले पर्वतकूटकल्पाः
verses.transliteration: AkShipya kechichcha varAyudhAni mahAbhuja~NgAniva vainateyAH | bhramanti devAnapi vidravantaH khamaNDale parvatakUTakalpAH
verses.translation: The betel with something to chew with to render the mouth fragrant shall be given. After bedecking bnce again with different flowers and ornaments the detailed

verses.sanskrit: उत्पाट्य चोत्पाट्य गृहाणि केचित् सजालवातायनवेदिकानि । विक्षिप्य विक्षिप्य जलस्य मध्ये कालाम्बुदाभाः प्रमथा निनेदुः
verses.transliteration: utpATya chotpATya gR^ihANi kechit sajAlavAtAyanavedikAni | vikShipya vikShipya jalasya madhye kAlAmbudAbhAH pramathA nineduH
verses.translation: A moon-like necklace shall be dedicated to the bedding. Everything done or caused to be done shall be royal in its quality, very pleasing and befitting. The contrary worship shall be avoided. After reciting the Vyapohana hymns the Japa of the five-syllabled Mantra shall be performed.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वर्तितद्वारकपाटकुड्यं विध्वस्तशालावलभीगवाक्षम् । अहो बताभज्यत यज्ञवाट- मनाप्तवद्वाक्यमिवायथार्थम्
verses.transliteration: udvartitadvArakapATakuDyaM vidhvastashAlAvalabhIgavAkSham | aho batAbhajyata yaj~navATa\- manAptavadvAkyamivAyathArtham
verses.translation: After circumambulation and obeisance the devotee shall dedicate himself. 'Then in front of lord he shall worship two brahmin preceptors.

verses.sanskrit: हा नाथ तातेति पितुः सुतेति भ्रातर्ममाम्बेति च मातुलेति । उत्पाट्यमानेषु गृहेषु नार्यो ह्यनाथशब्दान्बहुशः प्रचक्रुः
verses.transliteration: hA nAtha tAteti pituH suteti bhrAtarmamAmbeti cha mAtuleti | utpATyamAneShu gR^iheShu nAryo hyanAthashabdAnbahushaH prachakruH
verses.translation: After offering Arghya and eight flowers the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed from the phallic idol. After restraining the fire from the fire and ritualistically removing that also, the devotee shall perform the service everyday. Then he shall hand over the phallic idol with the insignia and lotuses to the preceptor. Or he shall install it in the temple of Siva After worshipping the elders, brahmins, Vrata -performers in particular, he shall propitiate brahmin devotees and if possible poor and helpless people also. If he is competent he shall observe fast or take to a diet of fruits and roots. Or he shall have milk for his diet, or live on alms or take single meal everyday only in the night. He shall be pure in body and mind and lie on the bare ground or ashes or grass. He shall wear deerskin or bark garment and observe celibacy. Thus he shall perform the holy rite.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा दक्षाध्वरं वीरो वीरभद्रः प्रतापवान् । सिंहनादं तदा चक्रे गम्भीरो जलदो यथा
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA dakShAdhvaraM vIro vIrabhadraH pratApavAn | siMhanAdaM tadA chakre gambhIro jalado yathA
verses.translation: Mentally, verbally and physically he shall avoid contact with heretics, fallen men, pointed women in their

verses.sanskrit: ततः किलकिलाशब्द आकाशं पूरयन्निव । गणेश्वरैः कृतो जज्ञे महान्न्यक्कृतसागरः
verses.transliteration: tataH kilakilAshabda AkAshaM pUrayanniva | gaNeshvaraiH kR^ito jaj~ne mahAnnyakkR^itasAgaraH
verses.translation: He shall always practise forgiveness, charity, mercy non-violence to all living beings. He shall remain content, calm and engaged in meditation and Japa.

verses.sanskrit: तेन शब्देन महता ग्रस्ताः सर्वे दिवौकसः । दुद्रुवुः परितो भीताः स्रस्तवस्त्रविभूषणाः
verses.transliteration: tena shabdena mahatA grastAH sarve divaukasaH | dudruvuH parito bhItAH srastavastravibhUShaNAH
verses.translation: He shall bathe thrice a day or he shall dust with the ashes instead. He shall perform special worship mentally, verbally and physically.

verses.sanskrit: किंस्विद्भग्नो महामेरुः किंस्वित्सन्दीर्यते मही । किमिदं किमिदं वेति जजल्पुस्त्रिदशा भृशम्
verses.transliteration: kiMsvidbhagno mahAmeruH kiMsvitsandIryate mahI | kimidaM kimidaM veti jajalpustridashA bhR^isham
verses.translation: Of what avail is much talk? A performer of the rite shall not commit any misdeed. If inadvertently he does commit, he shall consider its seriousness or otherwise and perform adequate expiatory rites in the form of worship, sacrifice, Japas etc. Till the conclusion of the Vrata he shall not repeat the mistake.

verses.sanskrit: मृगेन्द्राणां यथा नादं गजेन्द्रा गहने वने । श्रुत्वा तथाविधं केचित्तत्यजुर्जीवितं भयात्
verses.transliteration: mR^igendrANAM yathA nAdaM gajendrA gahane vane | shrutvA tathAvidhaM kechittatyajurjIvitaM bhayAt
verses.translation: He shall make charitable gifts of cows and oxen, perform worship in accordance with her wealth and capacity devoutly and free from any specific desire, for the pleasure of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: In Vaiakha the phallic idol of adamant, in Jye?tha that of an emerald, in A?adha that of pearl, in Sravana that of Sapphire, in Bhadrapada that of ruby, in Alvina that of onyx, in Karttika that of a coral, in Margairia that of lapis lazuli, in Pau$a that of topaz in Maeha that of the sun-stone; in Phalguna that of the moon-stone and in Gaitra that of sun-lone is auspicious. If gems are not available gold shall be substituted in every month.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: In Vaiakha the phallic idol of adamant, in Jye?tha that of an emerald, in A?adha that of pearl, in Sravana that of Sapphire, in Bhadrapada that of ruby, in Alvina that of onyx, in Karttika that of a coral, in Margairia that of lapis lazuli, in Pau$a that of topaz in Maeha that of the sun-stone; in Phalguna that of the moon-stone and in Gaitra that of sun-lone is auspicious. If gems are not available gold shall be substituted in every month.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२१. एकविंशोऽध्यायः । देवदण्डवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । ततस्त्रिदशमुख्यास्ते विष्णुशक्रपुरोगमाः । सर्वे भयपरित्रस्ता दुद्रुवुर्भयविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.21\. ekaviMsho.adhyAyaH | devadaNDavarNanam | vAyuruvAcha | tatastridashamukhyAste viShNushakrapurogamAH | sarve bhayaparitrastA dudruvurbhayavihvalAH
verses.translation: Or he can make the idol as he pleases having all types of flowers. At the conclusion of Vrata after perform¬ ing the daily rites he shall perform the special worship and sacrifice as before. After worshipping the preceptor and the Vratins in particular he shall take the permission from his instructor. Sitting facing the east or the north on a Darbha seat holding Darbha grass in the hands he shall restrain Prana and Apana. He shall make the Japa of the Mula mantra to the extent of his ability; he shall meditate on Siva and Siva. Taking permission and bowing as before he shall say with palms joined in reverence: *'0 lord, at your behest, 1 am concluding this Vrata." After saying thus he shall cast off the Darbhas at the root of the idol towards the north.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तज्वालेन शूलेन निर्बिभेद रणे सुरान् । स तया रुरुचे भद्रो रुद्रकोपसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: muktajvAlena shUlena nirbibheda raNe surAn | sa tayA ruruche bhadro rudrakopasamudbhavaH
verses.translation: Then he shall eschew the staff, the matted hair,

verses.sanskrit: प्रभयेव युगान्ताग्निश्चलया धूमधूम्रया । भद्रकाली तदा युद्धे विद्रुतत्रिदशा बभौ
verses.transliteration: prabhayeva yugAntAgnishchalayA dhUmadhUmrayA | bhadrakAlI tadA yuddhe vidrutatridashA babhau
verses.translation: He who has resolved to perform this Vrata till death and takes the initiation according'y and performs the rata undistrcssedly is a Naishika.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पे शेषानलज्वाला दग्धाविश्वजगद्यथा । तदा सवाजिनं सूर्यं रुद्रान् रुद्रगणाग्रणीः
verses.transliteration: kalpe sheShAnalajvAlA dagdhAvishvajagadyathA | tadA savAjinaM sUryaM rudrAn rudragaNAgraNIH
verses.translation: Among those desirous of salvation there is none like him who is so content. The Naisthika who becomes an ascetic is called the excellent Naisthika.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रो मूर्ध्नि जघानाशु वामपादेन लीलया । असिभिः पावकं भद्रः पट्टिशैस्तु यमं यमीम्
verses.transliteration: bhadro mUrdhni jaghAnAshu vAmapAdena lIlayA | asibhiH pAvakaM bhadraH paTTishaistu yamaM yamIm
verses.translation: He who performs this rite for twelve days or every day is on a par with the Naisthika, his Vrata being too severe.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रान् दृढेन शूलेन मुद्गरैर्वरुणं दृढैः । परिघैर्निरृतिं वायुं टङ्कैष्टङ्कधरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: rudrAn dR^iDhena shUlena mudgarairvaruNaM dR^iDhaiH | parighairnirR^itiM vAyuM Ta~NkaiShTa~NkadharaH svayam
verses.translation: A person who applies ghee over his body and performs the rite with devout feelings even for two or three days is also a Naisthika.

verses.sanskrit: निर्बिभेद रणे वीरो लीलयैव गणेश्वरः । सर्वान्देवगणान्सद्यो मुनीन् शम्भोर्विरोधिनः
verses.transliteration: nirbibheda raNe vIro lIlayaiva gaNeshvaraH | sarvAndevagaNAnsadyo munIn shambhorvirodhinaH
verses.translation: He who performs the excellent Vrata without a rlesiie for the fruit feeling that it is his duty, always dedicating his Arman to l§iva has no one equal to him.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवः सरस्वत्या नासिकाग्रं सुशोभनम् । चिच्छेद करजाग्रेण देवमातुस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tato devaH sarasvatyA nAsikAgraM sushobhanam | chichCheda karajAgreNa devamAtustathaiva cha
verses.translation: A person who has bathed with the ashes is called Bhasmanistha. His faults perish due to the contact of Rhasma fire.

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद च कुठारेण बाहुदण्डं विभावसोः । अग्रतो द्व्यङ्गुलां जिह्वामात्तहव्यां लुलाव च
verses.transliteration: chichCheda cha kuThAreNa bAhudaNDaM vibhAvasoH | agrato dvya~NgulAM jihvAmAttahavyAM lulAva cha
verses.translation: He who has smeared his body with the ashes, wears Tripundraka with Bhasma and has a Bha.sma bath is Bhasmanistha.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहादेव्यास्तथा देवो दक्षिणं नासिकापुटम् । चकर्त करजाग्रेण वामं च स्तनचूचुकम्
verses.transliteration: svAhAdevyAstathA devo dakShiNaM nAsikApuTam | chakarta karajAgreNa vAmaM cha stanachUchukam
verses.translation: Surely the evil spirits, ghosts and goblins and rf'p\ignant diseases flee at the very proximity of a Bhasma-

verses.sanskrit: भगस्य विपुले नेत्रे शतपत्रसमप्रभे । प्रसह्योत्पाटयामास भद्रः परमवेगवान्
verses.transliteration: bhagasya vipule netre shatapatrasamaprabhe | prasahyotpATayAmAsa bhadraH paramavegavAn
verses.translation: Hence one should endeavour in all possible ways to collect Bhasma like wealth after performing the Pasupata vrata and be engaged in Bhasma-bath.

verses.sanskrit: निजैरदूषितैरङ्गैर्दृष्ट्वा देवानुपद्रुतान् । दण्ड्यानदण्डितान् मत्वा चुकोप गणपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: nijairadUShitaira~NgairdR^iShTvA devAnupadrutAn | daNDyAnadaNDitAn matvA chukopa gaNapu~NgavaH
verses.translation: How could that infant attain power to propound the sacred doctrine of Siva? How could he realise the existence of Siva and perform the penance?

verses.sanskrit: पूष्णो दशनरेखां च दीप्तां मुक्तावलीमिव । जघान धनुषः कोट्या स तेनास्पष्टवागभूत्
verses.transliteration: pUShNo dashanarekhAM cha dIptAM muktAvalImiva | jaghAna dhanuShaH koTyA sa tenAspaShTavAgabhUt
verses.translation: How could he attain the perfect knowledge in the course of his observance of penance? How did he secure the protective ashes the virile element of the Rudra fire.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चन्द्रमसं देवः पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया । क्षणं कृमिवदाक्रम्य घर्षयामास भूतले
verses.transliteration: tatashchandramasaM devaH pAdA~NguShThena lIlayA | kShaNaM kR^imivadAkramya gharShayAmAsa bhUtale
verses.translation: His penance for the sake of obtaining milk became the gateway to the future grace of lord Siva obtained due to good luck.

verses.sanskrit: शिरश्चिच्छेद दक्षस्य भद्रः परमकोपतः । क्रोशन्त्यामेव वैरिण्यां भद्रकाल्यै ददौ च तत्
verses.transliteration: shirashchichCheda dakShasya bhadraH paramakopataH | kroshantyAmeva vairiNyAM bhadrakAlyai dadau cha tat
verses.translation: For the similarity of expression and contents of this and the following chapter, see Li Aga P. 1. 1 07

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रहृष्टा समादाय शिरस्तालफलोपमम् । सा देवी कन्दुकक्रीडां चकार समराङ्गणे
verses.transliteration: tatprahR^iShTA samAdAya shirastAlaphalopamam | sA devI kandukakrIDAM chakAra samarA~NgaNe
verses.translation: Siva granted him perpetual bachelorhood, lord- ship of all the Gaas along with an ocean of milk.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दक्षस्य यज्ञस्त्री कुशीला भर्तृभिर्यथा । पादाभ्यां चैव हस्ताभ्यां हन्यते स्म गणेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: tato dakShasya yaj~nastrI kushIlA bhartR^ibhiryathA | pAdAbhyAM chaiva hastAbhyAM hanyate sma gaNeshvaraiH
verses.translation: His ability to propound the Sivaiistra was also derived from the lord. He rejoiced in attaining the ocean of knowledge from the sage.

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टनेमिनं सोमं धर्मं चैव प्रजापतिम् । बहुपुत्रं चाङ्गिरसं कृशाश्वं काश्यपं तथा
verses.transliteration: ariShTaneminaM somaM dharmaM chaiva prajApatim | bahuputraM chA~NgirasaM kR^ishAshvaM kAshyapaM tathA
verses.translation: Once the boy had tasted some quantity of milk in the hermi age of his uncle. His uncle's son had drunk ample milk to his satiety. The jealous Upamanyu affectionately told his mother thus.

verses.sanskrit: गले प्रगृह्य बलिनो गणपाः सिंहविक्रमाः । भर्त्सयन्तो भृशं वाग्भिर्निजघ्नुर्मूर्ध्नि मुष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration: gale pragR^ihya balino gaNapAH siMhavikramAH | bhartsayanto bhR^ishaM vAgbhirnijaghnurmUrdhni muShTibhiH
verses.translation: O mother, my blessed mother, O saintly woman, please give me sweet cow's milk. I shall drink it very hot.
