verses.sanskrit: पुरा किल सती नाम्ना दक्षस्य दुहिताऽभवम् । जगतां पतिमेव त्वां पतिं प्राप्तवती तथा
verses.transliteration: purA kila satI nAmnA dakShasya duhitA.abhavam | jagatAM patimeva tvAM patiM prAptavatI tathA
verses.translation: By some Siva is called Pradljana-Purusa-Vyakta- Kalatman. Pradhana is Prakrti. Purusa is the individual soul. The twenty three principles constitute the Vyakta (manifest) Prakrti. Kala is the sole cause of the transformation of the effected creation. Siva is the lord, creator, activisor, router, and the cause of evolution and dissolution of all these, He is one, the emperor, the unborn.

verses.sanskrit: एवमद्यापि तपसा तोषयित्वा द्विजं विधिम् । गौरी भवितुमिच्छामि को दोषः कथ्यतामिह
verses.transliteration: evamadyApi tapasA toShayitvA dvijaM vidhim | gaurI bhavitumichChAmi ko doShaH kathyatAmiha
verses.translation: Some call him the fourth one or the being beyond the fourth one. Some call him devoid of Gunas or possessing Gunas.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो महादेव्या वामदेवः स्मयन्निव । न तां निर्बन्धयामास देवकार्यचिकीर्षया
verses.transliteration: evamukto mahAdevyA vAmadevaH smayanniva | na tAM nirbandhayAmAsa devakAryachikIrShayA
verses.translation: Some call him having worldly existence; Others having no worldly existence. Still others call him free, not free, terrible, gentle, passionate, passionless, inactive, active, possessed or devoid of sense-organs, stable, not stable, with colour or no colour, visible, invisible, expressible, inexpressi¬ ble, in the form of word and sound or beyond that, possessed or devoid of thought and knowledge, comprehensible or incomprehensible, great and not great.

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु शक्यते वक्तुमस्मिन्पर्वतसुन्दरे । ऋद्ध्या कयापि सौन्दर्यमीश्वरावासयोग्यता
verses.transliteration: idaM tu shakyate vaktumasminparvatasundare | R^iddhyA kayApi saundaryamIshvarAvAsayogyatA
verses.translation: Thus his innate nature, the true form, is being doubted. The sages are unable to determine the true nature of the lord due to the presence of different ideas and beliefs.

verses.sanskrit: अत एव हि देवेन देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षया । अतीव रमणीयोऽयं गिरिरन्तःपुरीकृतः
verses.transliteration: ata eva hi devena devyAH priyachikIrShayA | atIva ramaNIyo.ayaM girirantaHpurIkR^itaH
verses.translation: On the other hand, only those who have resorted to the lord in all piety know Siva, the great cause, without any strain.**'

verses.sanskrit: मेखलाभूमयस्तस्य विमलोपलपादपाः । शिवयोर्नित्यसान्निध्यान्न्यक्कुर्वन्त्यखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: mekhalAbhUmayastasya vimalopalapAdapAH | shivayornityasAnnidhyAnnyakkurvantyakhilaM jagat
verses.translation: As long as the individual does not achieve the realization of the primordial lord who has no lord above him and who is the ruler of the worlds, he remains in misery

verses.sanskrit: पितृभ्यां जगतो नित्यं स्नानपानोपयोगतः । अवाप्तपुण्यसंस्कारः प्रसरद्भिरितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: pitR^ibhyAM jagato nityaM snAnapAnopayogataH | avAptapuNyasaMskAraH prasaradbhiritastataH
verses.translation: Siva has no bondage due to the atoms, effects, Maya, Prakrti, cosmic intellect, ego, mind, sens-eorgans, Tanmatras or the elements,

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: He has no keen desire. He has neither happiness nor unhappiness; neither Karmans nor their after-effects; neither pleasure nor misery as a result of those Karmans.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: He has no keen desire. He has neither happiness nor unhappiness; neither Karmans nor their after-effects; neither pleasure nor misery as a result of those Karmans.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२५. पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः । देवीगौरत्वप्राप्तिः । वायुरुवाच । ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य पतिमम्बा पतिव्रता । नियम्य च वियोगार्तिं जगाम हिमवद्गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.25\. pa~nchaviMsho.adhyAyaH | devIgauratvaprAptiH | vAyuruvAcha | tataH pradakShiNIkR^itya patimambA pativratA | niyamya cha viyogArtiM jagAma himavadgirim
verses.translation: He has no connection with the seats of feelings nor with the impressions of actions. He has no contact with enjoyments of pleasures nor with their impressions of the three units of lime — past, present, future

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वापि तथा व्याघ्रं दुष्टभावादुपागतम् । न पृथग्जनवद्देवी स्वभावेन विविच्यते
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvApi tathA vyAghraM duShTabhAvAdupAgatam | na pR^ithagjanavaddevI svabhAvena vivichyate
verses.translation: He has no cause or maker; he has no beginning no end nor the intervening space. He has no activity or ins¬ trument. He has neither Akarya nor Karya.

verses.sanskrit: स तु विष्टब्धसर्वाङ्गो बुभुक्षापरिपीडितः । ममामिषं ततो नान्यदिति मत्वा निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sa tu viShTabdhasarvA~Ngo bubhukShAparipIDitaH | mamAmiShaM tato nAnyaditi matvA nirantaram
verses.translation: He has neither kinsman nor non-kinsman; he has no one to check or to urge. He has no lord, preceptor or protector. He has no superior or equal.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्यमाणः सततं देवीमेव तदाऽनिशम् । अतिष्ठदग्रतस्तस्या उपासनमिवाचरत्
verses.transliteration: nirIkShyamANaH satataM devImeva tadA.anisham | atiShThadagratastasyA upAsanamivAcharat
verses.translation: He has neither birth nor death; neither expectation nor disinclination. He is not subject to injunctions or prohibitions; he has neither liberation nor bondage.

verses.sanskrit: देव्याश्च हृदये नित्यं ममैवायमुपासकः । त्राता च दुष्टसत्त्वेभ्य इति प्रववृते कृपा
verses.transliteration: devyAshcha hR^idaye nityaM mamaivAyamupAsakaH | trAtA cha duShTasattvebhya iti pravavR^ite kR^ipA
verses.translation: He never has anything not conducive to welfare or inauspicious. He has everything auspicious since Siva is the great Atman.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या एव कृपायोगात्सद्यो नष्टमलत्रयः । बभूव सहसा व्याघ्रो देवीं च बुबुधे तदा
verses.transliteration: tasyA eva kR^ipAyogAtsadyo naShTamalatrayaH | babhUva sahasA vyAghro devIM cha bubudhe tadA
verses.translation: Presiding over everything by means of his Saktis, he is stationed without dropping his intrinsic nature. Hence he is known as Siva.

verses.sanskrit: न्यवर्तत बुभुक्षा च तस्याङ्गस्तम्भनं तथा । दौरात्म्यं जन्मसिद्धं च तृप्तिश्च समजायत
verses.transliteration: nyavartata bubhukShA cha tasyA~NgastambhanaM tathA | daurAtmyaM janmasiddhaM cha tR^iptishcha samajAyata
verses.translation: Since the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by Siva, he is known as

verses.sanskrit: तदा परमभावेन ज्ञात्वा कार्तार्थ्यमात्मनः । सद्योपासक एवैष सिषेवे परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: tadA paramabhAvena j~nAtvA kArtArthyamAtmanaH | sadyopAsaka evaiSha siSheve parameshvarIm
verses.translation: He shall be meditated upon in the cavity within the heart as minute as the tip of a hair, with golden hair, and lotus eyes. He is pink and copper-coloured.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्टानामपि सत्त्वानां तथान्येषां दुरात्मनाम् । स एव द्रावको भूत्वा विचचार तपोवने
verses.transliteration: duShTAnAmapi sattvAnAM tathAnyeShAM durAtmanAm | sa eva drAvako bhUtvA vichachAra tapovane
verses.translation: He moves about golden in colour, blue-nccked, both gentle and terrible and a mixure of the both, imperishable, deathless and unchangeable. Such is the great lord, the slayer of the god of death. He is liberated from the sentient and non-sentient. He is greater than the great universe.

verses.sanskrit: तपश्च ववृधे देव्यास्तीव्रं तीव्रतरात्मकम् । देवाश्च दैत्यनिर्बन्धाद् ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: tapashcha vavR^idhe devyAstIvraM tIvratarAtmakam | devAshcha daityanirbandhAd brahmANaM sharaNaM gatAH
verses.translation: Since the knowledge and supremacy of Siva excels those of others he excels all the lords of the worlds so say the intelligent persons.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रुर्निवेदनं देवाः स्वदुःखस्यारिपीडनात् । यथा च ददतुः शुम्भनिशुम्भौ वरसम्मदात्
verses.transliteration: chakrurnivedanaM devAH svaduHkhasyAripIDanAt | yathA cha dadatuH shumbhanishumbhau varasammadAt
verses.translation: Undoubtedly the great Siddhi can be acquired by meditation on Pranava that is expressive of Siva and by the performance of its Japa.

verses.sanskrit: तपः कृतवती पूर्वं देशे यस्मिन्सखीजनैः । तमेव देशमवृणोत्तपसे प्रणयात्पुनः
verses.transliteration: tapaH kR^itavatI pUrvaM deshe yasminsakhIjanaiH | tameva deshamavR^iNottapase praNayAtpunaH
verses.translation: Hence intelligent men well-versed in the Agamas considering identity between the word and its meaning call the lord as single-syllabled.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि श्रुत्वा विधिर्दुःखं सुराणां कृपयान्वितः । आसीद्दैत्यवधायैव स्मृत्वा हेत्वाश्रयां कथाम्
verses.transliteration: so.api shrutvA vidhirduHkhaM surANAM kR^ipayAnvitaH | AsIddaityavadhAyaiva smR^itvA hetvAshrayAM kathAm
verses.translation: In the Upanisads its Matras are four A,U, M and nada.

verses.sanskrit: सामरः प्रार्थितो ब्रह्मा ययौ देव्यास्तपोवनम् । संस्मरन्मनसा देवदुःखमोक्षं स्वयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: sAmaraH prArthito brahmA yayau devyAstapovanam | saMsmaranmanasA devaduHkhamokShaM svayatnataH
verses.translation: Pranava expresses everything through the three Matras in three ways and indicates Sivatman through half a Matra.

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श च सुरश्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठे तपसि निष्ठिताम् । प्रतिष्ठामिव विश्वस्य भवानीं परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: dadarsha cha surashreShThaH shreShThe tapasi niShThitAm | pratiShThAmiva vishvasya bhavAnIM parameshvarIm
verses.translation: His Sakti shall be known as natural and dissimilar to the universe in its characteristics. It is single but appears in many forms like the light of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: ननाम चास्य जगतो मातरं स्वस्य वै हरेः । रुद्रस्य च पितुर्भार्यामार्यामद्रीश्वरात्मजाम्
verses.transliteration: nanAma chAsya jagato mAtaraM svasya vai hareH | rudrasya cha piturbhAryAmAryAmadrIshvarAtmajAm
verses.translation: Endless arc the Saktis, viz, wiish, knowledge, activity and Maya etc. just like the flames of fire.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणमागतं दृष्ट्वा देवी देवगणैः सहः । अर्घ्यं तदर्हं दत्त्वाऽस्मै स्वागताद्यैरुपाचरत्
verses.transliteration: brahmANamAgataM dR^iShTvA devI devagaNaiH sahaH | arghyaM tadarhaM dattvA.asmai svAgatAdyairupAcharat
verses.translation: The Purusas — Sadasiva, Ivaraaud others, Vidyevara Avidyc'ivara and others and Prakrti — greater than the greatest were born of this Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: तां च प्रत्युपचारोक्तिं पुरस्कृत्याभिनन्द्य च । पप्रच्छ तपसो हेतुमजानन्निव पद्मजः
verses.transliteration: tAM cha pratyupachAroktiM puraskR^ityAbhinandya cha | paprachCha tapaso hetumajAnanniva padmajaH
verses.translation: The goddess enchants and deludes the universe with¬ out any strain through Maya. She releases the Jivas sportively.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । तीव्रेण तपसानेन देव्या किमिह साध्यते । तपःफलानां सर्वेषां त्वदधीना हि सिद्धयः
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | tIvreNa tapasAnena devyA kimiha sAdhyate | tapaHphalAnAM sarveShAM tvadadhInA hi siddhayaH
verses.translation: With her ramified into twentyseven forms, the lord stands pervading the universe.®** Hence the process of liberation functions.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैव जगतां भर्ता तमेव परमेश्वरम् । भर्तारमात्मना प्राप्य प्राप्तं च तपसः फलम्
verses.transliteration: yashchaiva jagatAM bhartA tameva parameshvaram | bhartAramAtmanA prApya prAptaM cha tapasaH phalam
verses.translation: Formerly some sages desirous of salvation held a discourse on Brahman. Their minds were pestered by doubts. They began to reflect and ponder. "What is the ultimate

verses.sanskrit: अथवा सर्वमेवैतत्क्रीडाविलसितं तव । इदं तु चित्रं देवस्य विरहं सहसे कथम्
verses.transliteration: athavA sarvamevaitatkrIDAvilasitaM tava | idaM tu chitraM devasya virahaM sahase katham
verses.translation: Then through his grace, the great Yoga and the path of devotion they -can attaih. the supreme divine goal.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । सर्गादौ भवतो देवादुत्पत्तिः श्रूयते यदा । तदा प्रजानां प्रथमस्त्वं मे प्रथमजः सुतः
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | sargAdau bhavato devAdutpattiH shrUyate yadA | tadA prajAnAM prathamastvaM me prathamajaH sutaH
verses.translation: In regard to salvation the sequence of knowledge and activity \s not intended because if there is divine grace s'alvation is accessible to everyone.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वपितरं दृष्ट्वा मातरं च तयोर्गृहे । प्रणम्य वृत्तं विज्ञाप्य ताभ्यां चानुमता सती
verses.transliteration: tataH svapitaraM dR^iShTvA mAtaraM cha tayorgR^ihe | praNamya vR^ittaM vij~nApya tAbhyAM chAnumatA satI
verses.translation: There is no doubt that a child' in the womb, a nascent child, a boy, a young,, old or 'a dying man, a soul in heayen or hell, a fallen or a pious, or a wise man or a fool is immediately released if there is divine grace.

verses.sanskrit: यदा पुनः प्रजावृद्ध्यै ललाटाद्भवतो भवः । उत्पन्नोऽभूत्तदा त्वं मे गुरुः श्वशुरभावतः
verses.transliteration: yadA punaH prajAvR^iddhyai lalATAdbhavato bhavaH | utpanno.abhUttadA tvaM me guruH shvashurabhAvataH
verses.translation: The merciful lord quells different dirts of his devotees though they may be unqualified. He is pleased with their devotion.

verses.sanskrit: यदाभवद्गिरीन्द्रस्ते पुत्रो मम पिता स्वयम् । तदा पितामहस्त्वं मे जातो लोकपितामह
verses.transliteration: yadAbhavadgirIndraste putro mama pitA svayam | tadA pitAmahastvaM me jAto lokapitAmaha
verses.translation: This devotion with grace as its antecedent and causing worldly pleasures and salvation cannot be acquired in a single birth.

verses.sanskrit: तदीदृशस्य भवतो लोकयात्राविधायिनः । वृत्तमन्तःपुरे भर्त्रा कथयिष्ये कथं पुनः
verses.transliteration: tadIdR^ishasya bhavato lokayAtrAvidhAyinaH | vR^ittamantaHpure bhartrA kathayiShye kathaM punaH
verses.translation: When the lord of gods is delighted a modicum of devotion is generated in the individual with the conscious¬ ness, "My lord exists". Then he begins to be associated with penance and various Saivite holy rites. After their performance and their frequent practice the devotion becomes greater.

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र बहुना देहे यश्चायं मम कालिमा । त्यक्त्वा सत्त्वविधानेन गौरी भवितुमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration: kimatra bahunA dehe yashchAyaM mama kAlimA | tyaktvA sattvavidhAnena gaurI bhavitumutsahe
verses.translation: As a result of that a greater grace is acquired. As a result of the grace liberation is attained. A liberated soul enjoys bliss.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । एतावता किमर्थेन तीव्रं देवि तपः कृतम् । स्वेच्छैव किमपर्याप्ता क्रीडेयं हि तवेदृशी
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | etAvatA kimarthena tIvraM devi tapaH kR^itam | svechChaiva kimaparyAptA krIDeyaM hi tavedR^ishI
verses.translation: Service with or without the ancillaries is called devotion. It is threefold due to the three means of mind speech and body.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडाऽपि च जगन्मातस्तव लोकहिताय वै । अतो ममेष्टमनया फलं किमपि साध्यताम्
verses.transliteration: krIDA.api cha jaganmAtastava lokahitAya vai | ato mameShTamanayA phalaM kimapi sAdhyatAm
verses.translation: In brief they are penance, holy rites, repetition of mantras, meditation and knowledge. Penance is the rite of Gandrayana, etc. What is termed holy rite is the worship of Siva's phallic image. Japa is the repetition of the names of Siva in three ways. Meditation is pondering over Siva. What is mentioned in the Saivite Agamas as perfect knowledge is meant by the word knowledge here.

verses.sanskrit: निशुम्भशुम्भनामानौ दैत्यौ दत्तवरौ मया । दृप्तौ देवान्प्रबाधेते त्वत्तो लब्धस्तयोर्वधः
verses.transliteration: nishumbhashumbhanAmAnau daityau dattavarau mayA | dR^iptau devAnprabAdhete tvatto labdhastayorvadhaH
verses.translation: An intelligent man seeking welfare shall avoid too

verses.sanskrit: अलं विलम्बनेनात्र त्वं क्षणेन स्थिरा भव । शक्तिर्विसृज्यमानाद्य तयोर्मृत्युर्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: alaM vilambanenAtra tvaM kShaNena sthirA bhava | shaktirvisR^ijyamAnAdya tayormR^ityurbhaviShyati
verses.translation: O lord, r wish to hear about Siva's knowledge expounded by Siva in the Vedasara for the salvation of his devotees. It is incomprehensible to non-devotees, the unintelligent and those who do not practise Yoga. It consists of five topics. It is censured by the unwise stupid persons.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाऽभ्यर्थिता चैव देवी गिरिवरात्मजा । त्वक्कोशं सहसोत्सृज्य गौरी सा समजायत
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNA.abhyarthitA chaiva devI girivarAtmajA | tvakkoshaM sahasotsR^ijya gaurI sA samajAyata
verses.translation: It extends to a hundred crores of verses as narra¬ ted by lord Siva. How shall the worship be performed, O lord? Who is authorised in the worship? What are the practices of Jnanayoga etc.? O sage of good rites, it hoves you to narrate all these things in detail.

verses.sanskrit: सा त्वक्कोशात्मनोत्सृष्टा कौशिकी नाम नामतः । काली कालाम्बुदप्रख्या कन्यका समपद्यत
verses.transliteration: sA tvakkoshAtmanotsR^iShTA kaushikI nAma nAmataH | kAlI kAlAmbudaprakhyA kanyakA samapadyata
verses.translation: I shall succinctly narrate the lore of Siva con¬ densed from the Vedas as narrated by Siva. I shall avoid its praises or condemnations. It is convincing and divine. It can be acquired only by the grace of the preceptor. It is conducive to salvation without any strain. A detailed explanation of the same is impossible.

verses.sanskrit: पुनस्तपोवनं गत्वा भूषणानि विसृज्य च । स्नात्वा तपस्विनो वेषं कृत्वा परमपावनम्
verses.transliteration: punastapovanaM gatvA bhUShaNAni visR^ijya cha | snAtvA tapasvino veShaM kR^itvA paramapAvanam
verses.translation: Then the lord, the sage, superior to  procreated the first of the gods Brahma, the Brahmanaspati.

verses.sanskrit: सा तु मायात्मिका शक्तिर्योगनिद्रा च वैष्णवी । शङ्खचक्रत्रिशूलादिसायुधाष्टमहाभुजा
verses.transliteration: sA tu mAyAtmikA shaktiryoganidrA cha vaiShNavI | sha~NkhachakratrishUlAdisAyudhAShTamahAbhujA
verses.translation: While being born, Brahma saw the lord liis>father. The lord saw and commanded him.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्या घोरा च मिश्रा च त्रिनेत्रा चन्द्रशेखरा । अजातपुंस्पर्शरतिरधृष्या चातिसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: saumyA ghorA cha mishrA cha trinetrA chandrashekharA | ajAtapuMsparsharatiradhR^iShyA chAtisundarI
verses.translation: For the sake of sacrifice he. created Soma. From Soma was born the heaven, earth, tire, sun, sacriiR:e,v Visnu' and Indra.

verses.sanskrit: दत्ता च ब्रह्मणे देव्या शक्तिरेषा सनातनी । निशुम्भस्य च शुम्भस्य निहन्त्री दैत्यसिंहयोः
verses.transliteration: dattA cha brahmaNe devyA shaktireShA sanAtanI | nishumbhasya cha shumbhasya nihantrI daityasiMhayoH
verses.translation: They and the gods eulogised  Rudra with the hymns dedicated to him. The lord stood before the gods with his face beaming with delight.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणाऽपि प्रहृष्टेन तस्यै परमशक्तये । प्रबलः केसरी दत्तो वाहनत्वे समागतः
verses.transliteration: brahmaNA.api prahR^iShTena tasyai paramashaktaye | prabalaH kesarI datto vAhanatve samAgataH
verses.translation: The lord took away their knowledge, sportively. The deluded gods asked him, 'Who are youv.Siix?'

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्ये च वसतिं तस्याः पूजामासवपूर्वकैः । मांसैर्मत्स्यैरपूपैश्च निर्वर्त्यासौ समादिशत्
verses.transliteration: vindhye cha vasatiM tasyAH pUjAmAsavapUrvakaiH | mAMsairmatsyairapUpaishcha nirvartyAsau samAdishat
verses.translation: Lord Rudra said: — "T had been the only primeval being, O gods, I am and I shall be 'There is none except me or separate from me. I alone satisfy the universe through my splendour. There is none supejlior to or equal to me. He who knows me is liberated." After saying, this the lord vanished there itself. Unable to see him the gods began to eulogise him with Samans. They performed the holy rites of Pasupata as prescribed in the Atharvairas Upaniads. They smeared Bhasma all over their bodies.

verses.sanskrit: सा चैव सम्मता शक्तिर्ब्रह्मणो विश्वकर्मणः । प्रणम्य मातरं गौरीं ब्रह्माणं चानुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: sA chaiva sammatA shaktirbrahmaNo vishvakarmaNaH | praNamya mAtaraM gaurIM brahmANaM chAnupUrvashaH
verses.translation: In order to please them the lord came there witli the Ganas and Uma. The leading. gods saw the lord whom the awakened sinless Yogins of restrained brealh see within their hearts. To the left of lord Siva they saw the beautiful goddess, the greatest akti who followed the wish of the lord. The chiefs of the ganas who had forsaken worldiness and acquired the region of Siva and the Siddhas were also seen. Then the gods eulogised the lord and the goddess with the divine hymns from the Vedas and the Puranas. The delighted bull-bannered lord saw the gods with mercy and spoke sweetly, 'I am delighted.' Ihen, bowing to him the gods asked him about this important topic.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिभिश्चापि तुल्याभिः स्वात्मजाभिरनेकशः । परीता प्रययौ विन्ध्यं दैत्येन्द्रौ हन्तुमुद्यता
verses.transliteration: shaktibhishchApi tulyAbhiH svAtmajAbhiranekashaH | parItA prayayau vindhyaM daityendrau hantumudyatA
verses.translation: O lord, ho«v shall they worship you on the earth? What is the path? Who is authorised in the worship?

verses.sanskrit: निहतौ च तया तत्र समरे दैत्यपुङ्गवौ । तद्बाणैः कामबाणैश्च च्छिन्नभिन्नाङ्गमानसौ
verses.transliteration: nihatau cha tayA tatra samare daityapu~Ngavau | tadbANaiH kAmabANaishcha chChinnabhinnA~NgamAnasau
verses.translation: Glancing smilipgly at the goddess, Siva the chief of the gods revealed his terrible form brilliant as the sun.

verses.sanskrit: तद्युद्धविस्तरश्चात्र न कृतोऽन्यत्र वर्णनात् । ऊहनीयं परस्माच्च प्रस्तुतं वर्णयामि वः
verses.transliteration: tadyuddhavistarashchAtra na kR^ito.anyatra varNanAt | UhanIyaM parasmAchcha prastutaM varNayAmi vaH
verses.translation: The lord had eight arms and four faces. Half of that form was female. On seeing this wondrous form, Vi?9u and other gods understood the lord as the sun and the goddess as the moon and the remaining parts as elements. They realised the universe of the mobile and immobile beings identical with him. Then they worshipped the lord a«id made obeisance to him.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्प्य च महातीव्रं तपः परमदुश्चरम् । सदा मनसि सन्धाय भर्तुश्चरणपङ्कजम्
verses.transliteration: sa~Nkalpya cha mahAtIvraM tapaH paramadushcharam | sadA manasi sandhAya bhartushcharaNapa~Nkajam
verses.translation: O lord, be pleased to accept our worship. You have the colour of the saffron, the excellent disc and the colourful ornaments of gold. Your eyes resemble the lotus; you hold a lotus and you are the cause of Brahma, Indra and Narayana. The golden vessel is filled with excellent gems and water of brilliant hue. Vermilion and other things, Kusa grass and flowers too are offered.

verses.sanskrit: तमेव क्षणिके लिङ्गे ध्यात्वा बाह्यविधानतः । त्रिसन्ध्यमभ्यर्चयन्ती वन्यैः पुष्पैः फलादिभिः
verses.transliteration: tameva kShaNike li~Nge dhyAtvA bAhyavidhAnataH | trisandhyamabhyarchayantI vanyaiH puShpaiH phalAdibhiH
verses.translation: Obeisance to &va the quiescent, the primordial cause, to Rudra accompanied by the Ganas; obeisance to him in the form of the sun, to Visnu, to Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: स एव ब्रह्मणो मूर्तिमास्थाय तपसः फलम् । प्रदास्यति ममेत्येवं नित्यं कृत्वाऽकरोत्तपः
verses.transliteration: sa eva brahmaNo mUrtimAsthAya tapasaH phalam | pradAsyati mametyevaM nityaM kR^itvA.akarottapaH
verses.translation: He who worships Siva thus in the solar disc with pure mind, in the morning, midday and at dusk and offers the excellent Arghya, or bows and reads the verses plea¬ sing to the ears does not find anything inaccessible. If he is a devotee he is certainly liberated.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तपश्चरन्तीं तां काले बहुतिथे गते । दृष्टः कश्चिन्महाव्याघ्रो दुष्टभावादुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: tathA tapashcharantIM tAM kAle bahutithe gate | dR^iShTaH kashchinmahAvyAghro duShTabhAvAdupAgamat
verses.translation: Hence for the sake of virtue, wealth, love and sal¬ vation, one shall mentally verbally and physically worship Siva in the form of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: तथैवोपगतस्यापि तस्यातीव दुरात्मनः । गात्रं चित्रार्पितमिव स्तब्धं तस्याः सकाशतः
verses.transliteration: tathaivopagatasyApi tasyAtIva durAtmanaH | gAtraM chitrArpitamiva stabdhaM tasyAH sakAshataH
verses.translation: Then the lord stationed in the disc glanced at the gods, revealed the sacred scripture, the sequel to all the Aga- mas and vanished.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: After a pretty long interval the sacred scripture was forgotten. The goddess seated in the lap of her husband asked him about it.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: After a pretty long interval the sacred scripture was forgotten. The goddess seated in the lap of her husband asked him about it.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२६. षड्विंशोऽध्यायः । व्याघ्रगतिवर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । उत्पाद्य कौशिकीं गौरी ब्रह्मणे प्रतिपाद्य ताम् । तस्य प्रत्युपकाराय पितामहमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.26\. ShaDviMsho.adhyAyaH | vyAghragativarNanam | vAyuruvAcha | utpAdya kaushikIM gaurI brahmaNe pratipAdya tAm | tasya pratyupakArAya pitAmahamathAbravIt
verses.translation: Urged by her, the moon-crested lord narrated to her the sacred scripture — the sequel to all Agamas.

verses.sanskrit: अतः किं कृपया कृत्यमीदृशेषु दुरात्मसु । अनेन देव्याः किं कृत्यं प्रकृत्या कलुषात्मना
verses.transliteration: ataH kiM kR^ipayA kR^ityamIdR^isheShu durAtmasu | anena devyAH kiM kR^ityaM prakR^ityA kaluShAtmanA
verses.translation: In the revolution of Yugas the trident- bearing lord incarnates himself on the earth and propagates the knowledge for the salvation of his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । यदुक्तं भवता सर्वं तथ्यमस्त्वयमीदृशः । तथापि मां प्रपन्नोऽभून्न त्याज्यो मामुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | yaduktaM bhavatA sarvaM tathyamastvayamIdR^ishaH | tathApi mAM prapanno.abhUnna tyAjyo mAmupAshritaH
verses.translation: Now listen to the incarnations of Vyasa who were masters of Yoga in the different Kalpas: — Rbhu, Satya, Bhargava, Ahgiras, the brahmin Savitr, Satatejas, Dharma as Narayana, Svaraksa, the intelligent Aruni, Krtanjaya, Krtafi- jaya ( the second), Bharadvaja, the wise Gautama, sage Vaca- hsravas, the pious Suksmayani, sage Trnabindu, Ksna, Sakti akteya, Uttara, Jatukarnya, Hari and sage Kr§nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । अस्य भक्तिमविज्ञाय प्राग्वृत्तं ते निवेदितम् । भक्तिश्चेदस्य किं पापैर्न ते भक्तः प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | asya bhaktimavij~nAya prAgvR^ittaM te niveditam | bhaktishchedasya kiM pApairna te bhaktaH praNashyati
verses.translation: These incarnations of Vyasa are up to the -.end of Dyapara. There are the incarnations as Yogacarya of Siva and their disciples. In different yugas the lord's disciples are four. Their disciples and future disciples are in hundreds and thousands. By their endeavour, these are purified by their devotion and are liberated by their carrying out the behests of Siva in the world.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यकर्मापि किं कुर्य्यात्त्वदीयाज्ञानपेक्षया । अजा प्रज्ञा पुराणी च त्वमेव परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: puNyakarmApi kiM kuryyAttvadIyAj~nAnapekShayA | ajA praj~nA purANI cha tvameva parameshvarI
verses.translation: O lord, please enumerate the incarnations ol §iva as Yogacarya and his disciples in the different circles of Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: त्वदधीना हि सर्वेषां बन्धमोक्षव्यवस्थितिः । त्वदृते परमा शक्तिः संसिद्धिः कस्य कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: tvadadhInA hi sarveShAM bandhamokShavyavasthitiH | tvadR^ite paramA shaktiH saMsiddhiH kasya karmaNA
verses.translation: The following twentyeight are the Yogacaryas in the seventh Manvantara, in the Varaha Kalpa;— Sveta, Sutara, Madana, Suhotra, Kanka, Laugaksi, Mahamaya, Jaigisavya, Dadhivaha, Rsabha, sage Ugra, Atri, Supalaka, Gautama, sage Vedasiras, Gokama, Guhavasin, Sikhanin, Langulin, Maha-

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव विविधा शक्तिः भवानामथ वा स्वयम् । अशक्तः कर्मकरणे कर्ता वा किं करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: tvameva vividhA shaktiH bhavAnAmatha vA svayam | ashaktaH karmakaraNe kartA vA kiM kariShyati
verses.translation: Eaeh of these had four disciples of quiet minds. They are from Sveta to Rusya. I shall enumerate them in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोश्च मम चान्येषां देवदानवरक्षसाम् । तत्तदैश्वर्यसम्प्राप्त्यै तवैवाज्ञा हि कारणम्
verses.transliteration: viShNoshcha mama chAnyeShAM devadAnavarakShasAm | tattadaishvaryasamprAptyai tavaivAj~nA hi kAraNam
verses.translation: Sveta, Svetasikha, Svetasva, Svetalohiia, Dundu- bhi, Satarupa, Rcika, Ketuman, Vikosa, Vikesa, Vipa5a, Paa- nasana, Sumukha, Durmukha, Durgama, Duratikrama, Sanat, Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatana, Sudhaman, Virajas, Sahkha, And- aja, Sarasvata, Mcgha, Meghavaha, Survahaka, Kapila, Asuri, Paficasikha, Baskala, Parasara, Garga, Bhargava, Angiras, Balabandhu, Niramitra, Ketusrhga, Tapodhana, Lambodara, Lamba, Lambatman, Lambakesaka, Sarvajna, Samabuddhi Sadhyasiddhi, Sudhaman, Kasyapa, Vasistha, Virajas, Atri, Ugra, Gurusrestha, Sravana, Sravisthaka, Kuni, Kunibahu, Kuarlra, Kunetraka, Kasyapa, Usanas, Cyavana, Brhaspati, Utathya, Vamadeva, Mahakala, Mahanila, Vacahsravas, Suvira, Syavaka, Yatisvara, Hiranyanabha, Kausalya, Lokaksi, Kuthumi, Sumantu, Jaimini, Kubandha, Kusakandhara, Plaksa, Darbhayani, Ketuman, Gautama, Bhallavi, Madhu- pihga, Svetaketu, UMja, Brhadasva, Devala, Kavi, Salihotra, Suvesa, Yuvanava, Saradvasu, Aksapada, Kanuda, Uluka, Vatsa, Kulika, Garga, Mitraka and Rusya.

verses.sanskrit: अतीताः खल्वसङ्ख्याता ब्रह्माणो हरयो भवाः । अनागतास्त्वसङ्ख्यातास्त्वदाज्ञानुविधायिनः
verses.transliteration: atItAH khalvasa~NkhyAtA brahmANo harayo bhavAH | anAgatAstvasa~NkhyAtAstvadAj~nAnuvidhAyinaH
verses.translation: These are the disciples of the lord, the Yogacarya. Their number is hundred and twelve.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामनाराध्य देवेशि पुरुषार्थचतुष्टयम् । लब्धुं न शक्यमस्माभिरपि सर्वैः सुरोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: tvAmanArAdhya deveshi puruShArthachatuShTayam | labdhuM na shakyamasmAbhirapi sarvaiH surottamaiH
verses.translation: These had become Siddhas by Pasupata rites. They used to dust their bodies with Bhasma. They knew the principles and meanings of the sacred texts. They were masters of the Vedas and Vedahgas.

verses.sanskrit: व्यत्यासोऽपि भवेत्सद्यो ब्रह्मत्वस्थावरत्वयोः । सुकृतं दुष्कृतं चापि त्वयैव स्थापितं यतः
verses.transliteration: vyatyAso.api bhavetsadyo brahmatvasthAvaratvayoH | sukR^itaM duShkR^itaM chApi tvayaiva sthApitaM yataH
verses.translation: They were engaged in Siva's hermitage. They were devoted to Siva's lore. They were free from attach¬ ments. Their minds were attached to Siva alone.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । दृष्टः किमेष भवता शार्दूलो मदुपाश्रयः । अनेन दुष्टसत्त्वेभ्यो रक्षितं मत्तपोवनम्
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | dR^iShTaH kimeSha bhavatA shArdUlo madupAshrayaH | anena duShTasattvebhyo rakShitaM mattapovanam
verses.translation: They could bear the mutually clashing pairs — extreme cold, heat etc. They were self-possessed and engaged in the benefit of living beings. They were straightforward,

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सर्वजगद्भर्तुः शिवस्य परमात्मनः । अनादिमध्यनिधना शक्तिराद्या सनातनी
verses.transliteration: tvaM hi sarvajagadbhartuH shivasya paramAtmanaH | anAdimadhyanidhanA shaktirAdyA sanAtanI
verses.translation: They, had strings of Rudraksa - beads for their ornaments. Their foreheads were marked by

verses.sanskrit: समस्तलोकयात्रार्थं मूर्तिमाविश्य कामपि । क्रीडसे विविधैर्भावैः कस्त्वां जानाति तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: samastalokayAtrArthaM mUrtimAvishya kAmapi | krIDase vividhairbhAvaiH kastvAM jAnAti tattvataH
verses.translation: They had destroyed even the seeds of the poisonous tree of worldly existence. They were ready to proceed to the city of l§iva.2®2

verses.sanskrit: अतो दुष्कृतकर्मापि व्याघ्रोऽयं त्वदनुग्रहात् । प्राप्नोतु परमां सिद्धिमत्र कः प्रतिबन्धकः
verses.transliteration: ato duShkR^itakarmApi vyAghro.ayaM tvadanugrahAt | prApnotu paramAM siddhimatra kaH pratibandhakaH
verses.translation: He who worships Siva everyday after thinking about these and their preceptors attains Sayujya with Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यात्मनः परं भावं स्मारयित्वानुरूपतः । ब्रह्मणाभ्यर्थिता गौरी तपसोऽपि न्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration: ityAtmanaH paraM bhAvaM smArayitvAnurUpataH | brahmaNAbhyarthitA gaurI tapaso.api nyavartata
verses.translation: O lord, foremost of all Yogins, O leader of the Ganas, O excellent sage, O preceptor having the lustre equal to that of the six-faced deity, O storehouse of knowledge, you have assumed the form of a sage but arc really the supreme lord. You have incarnated on the earth for breaking the binding cords of men,

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवीमनुज्ञाप्य ब्रह्मण्यन्तर्हिते सति । देवीं च मातरं दृष्ट्वा मेनां हिमवता सह
verses.transliteration: tato devImanuj~nApya brahmaNyantarhite sati | devIM cha mAtaraM dR^iShTvA menAM himavatA saha
verses.translation: You have very pertinently put the question O Krsna. I shall explain it precisely to you of auspicious mind. You as the devotee of Siva arc the person fit to hear it.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्याश्वास्य बहुधा पितरौ विरहासहौ । तपः प्रणयिनो देवी तपोवनमहीरुहान्
verses.transliteration: praNamyAshvAsya bahudhA pitarau virahAsahau | tapaH praNayino devI tapovanamahIruhAn
verses.translation: Accompanied by the goddess, the lord went to his beautiful garden on the beautiful mountain Mandara abounding in beautiful caves.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रयोगशुचेवाग्रे पुष्पबाष्पं विमुञ्चतः । तत्तच्छाखासमारूढविहगोदीरितै रुतैः
verses.transliteration: viprayogashuchevAgre puShpabAShpaM vimu~nchataH | tattachChAkhAsamArUDhavihagodIritai rutaiH
verses.translation: Then Subhavati, the beloved friend of the goddess with a smiling face, brought many full-blown flowers of great beauty.

verses.sanskrit: व्याकुलं बहुधा दीनं विलापमिव कुर्वतः । सखीभ्यः कथयन्त्वेवं सत्त्वरा भर्तृदर्शने
verses.transliteration: vyAkulaM bahudhA dInaM vilApamiva kurvataH | sakhIbhyaH kathayantvevaM sattvarA bhartR^idarshane
verses.translation: Thereupon §iva, the chief of the gods, seated the goddess on his lap and bedecked her with the flowers. He was much pleased with himself.

verses.sanskrit: पुरस्कृत्य च तं व्याघ्रं स्नेहात्पुत्रमिवौरसम् । देहस्य प्रभया चैव दीपयन्ती दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: puraskR^itya cha taM vyAghraM snehAtputramivaurasam | dehasya prabhayA chaiva dIpayantI disho dasha
verses.translation: The gentle ladies bedecked in glittering orna¬ ments working in the harem and the confidential attendants, the chiefs of Ganas served the goddess and the lord, with chowrics in their hands.

verses.sanskrit: प्रययौ मन्दरं गौरी यत्र भर्ता महेश्वरः । सर्वेषां जगतां धाता कर्ता पाता विनाशकृत्
verses.transliteration: prayayau mandaraM gaurI yatra bhartA maheshvaraH | sarveShAM jagatAM dhAtA kartA pAtA vinAshakR^it
verses.translation: Then pleasing discourses ensued for the diversion of the lord and the goddess and for the succour of the devotees who sought refuge in him.

verses.sanskrit: मय्यर्पितमना एष भजते मामनन्यधीः । अस्य संरक्षणादन्यत्प्रियं मम न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: mayyarpitamanA eSha bhajate mAmananyadhIH | asya saMrakShaNAdanyatpriyaM mama na vidyate
verses.translation: Then seeing an opportune moment the goddess asked Siva, the lord of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: भवितव्यमनेनातो ममान्तःपुरचारिणा । गणेश्वरपदं चास्मै प्रीत्या दास्यति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: bhavitavyamanenAto mamAntaHpurachAriNA | gaNeshvarapadaM chAsmai prItyA dAsyati sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: How can the lord be brought under control by slow-witted men who arc not interested in spiritual principles and who do not have self-control?

verses.sanskrit: एनमग्रेसरं कृत्वा सखीभिर्गन्तुमुत्सहे । प्रदीयतामनुज्ञा मे प्रजानां पतिना त्वया
verses.transliteration: enamagresaraM kR^itvA sakhIbhirgantumutsahe | pradIyatAmanuj~nA me prajAnAM patinA tvayA
verses.translation: I cannot be enticed either by holy rites or pcnanct or Japas or postures or knowledge or by any other means except faith.*®®

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः प्रहसन्ब्रह्मा देवीं मुग्धामिव स्मयन् । तस्य तीव्रैः पुरावृत्तैर्दौरात्म्यं समवर्णयत्
verses.transliteration: ityuktaH prahasanbrahmA devIM mugdhAmiva smayan | tasya tIvraiH purAvR^ittairdaurAtmyaM samavarNayat
verses.translation: If men have faith in me I can be brought under

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच । पशौ देवि मृगाः क्रूराः क्व च तेऽनुग्रहः शुभः । आशीविषमुखे साक्षादमृतं किं निषिच्यते
verses.transliteration: brahmovAcha | pashau devi mR^igAH krUrAH kva cha te.anugrahaH shubhaH | AshIviShamukhe sAkShAdamR^itaM kiM niShichyate
verses.translation: Hence faith shall be sought and acquired by him who desires to subject me to his control. Faith supports the duties of the different castes and is generated in him alone who abides by all duties of the castes and stages of life. No one else has faith in me.

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रमात्रेण सन्नेष दुष्टः कोऽपि निशाचरः । अनेन भक्षिता गावो ब्राह्मणाश्च तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: vyAghramAtreNa sanneSha duShTaH ko.api nishAcharaH | anena bhakShitA gAvo brAhmaNAshcha tapodhanAH
verses.translation: At my bidding, the duties as derived from the Vedas of the various stages in life were mentioned formerly by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयंस्तान् यथाकामं कामरूपी चरत्यसौ । अवश्यं खलु भोक्तव्यं फलं पापस्य कर्मणः
verses.transliteration: tarpayaMstAn yathAkAmaM kAmarUpI charatyasau | avashyaM khalu bhoktavyaM phalaM pApasya karmaNaH
verses.translation: That compendium of duties is called Brahma's Dharma. It consists of expensive rites, and is attended with great stress and strain. The fruits are not comparatively plentiful. By resorting to this great Dharma it is possible for those persons of different castes who resort to me without seeking the support of others, and who have attained the rare faith, to attain virtue, love, wealth and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Hence, after securing or not securing the duties mentioned by me if my devotee lifts himself up by his efforts, it is an acquisition of what is not acquired supe¬ rior in qualities crores and crores of times. Hence, one shall practise the duties mentioned by me.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Hence, after securing or not securing the duties mentioned by me if my devotee lifts himself up by his efforts, it is an acquisition of what is not acquired supe¬ rior in qualities crores and crores of times. Hence, one shall practise the duties mentioned by me.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२७. सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः । देवीशिवमिलनवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । कृत्वा गौरं वपुर्दिव्यं देवी गिरिवरात्मजा । कथं ददर्श भर्तारं प्रविष्टा मन्दिरं सती
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.27\. saptaviMsho.adhyAyaH | devIshivamilanavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | kR^itvA gauraM vapurdivyaM devI girivarAtmajA | kathaM dadarsha bhartAraM praviShTA mandiraM satI
verses.translation: O noble lady, these are my incarnations as Yoga- carya*®® in all the Manvantaras and thousands of generations.

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छयापि न कालीति नान्यवर्णवतीति च । त्वत्स्वभावहृतं चित्तं सुभ्रु चिन्तावहं मम
verses.transliteration: svechChayApi na kAlIti nAnyavarNavatIti cha | tvatsvabhAvahR^itaM chittaM subhru chintAvahaM mama
verses.translation: O goddess, the knowledge of generations is in¬ accessible to those who are not my devotees, who are devoid of

verses.sanskrit: विस्मृतः परमो भावः कथं स्वेच्छाङ्गयोगतः । न सम्भवन्ति ये तत्र चित्तकालुष्यहेतवः
verses.transliteration: vismR^itaH paramo bhAvaH kathaM svechChA~NgayogataH | na sambhavanti ye tatra chittakAluShyahetavaH
verses.translation: The YogSearya incarnations of iiva arc recounted in the previous chapter.

verses.sanskrit: पृथग्जनवदन्योऽन्यं विप्रियस्यापि कारणम् । आवयोरपि यद्यस्ति नास्त्येवैतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: pR^ithagjanavadanyo.anyaM vipriyasyApi kAraNam | Avayorapi yadyasti nAstyevaitachcharAcharam
verses.translation: The Yoga that removes previous sins, belongs only to the unattached who has conquered the group of sense- organs by restraints and observances.

verses.sanskrit: अहमग्निशिरोनिष्ठस्त्वं सोमशिरसि स्थिता । अग्नीषोमात्मकं विश्वमावाभ्यां समधिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: ahamagnishironiShThastvaM somashirasi sthitA | agnIShomAtmakaM vishvamAvAbhyAM samadhiShThitam
verses.translation: Detachment gives birth to knowledge. Knowledge facilitates the functioning of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: जगद्धिताय चरतोः स्वेच्छाधृतशरीरयोः । आवयोर्विप्रयोगे हि स्यान्निरालम्बनं जगत्
verses.transliteration: jagaddhitAya charatoH svechChAdhR^itasharIrayoH | Avayorviprayoge hi syAnnirAlambanaM jagat
verses.translation: One conversant with Yoga, though fallen, is surely liberated. The following shall be carefully maintained. Mercy shall be practised along with non-violence. Knowledge shall be acquired. Truth, non-stealing, faith in scriptures and God, self-restraint, teaching, studying, performing sacrifice, presiding over sacrifice, meditation, piety towards God and practice of knowledge. A brahmin who follows all these for the acquisition of the path of knowledge, attains perfect knowledge ere long and secures Yoga top. O beloved, the wise devotee burns the physical body in a trice with the fire of knowledge. Due to my grace, the devotee conversant with Yoga eschews the bondage of the Karmans. Karman is in the nature of both merit and demerit. Both these are hindrances to liberation. The Yogin shall eschew both the merit and demerit.

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति हेत्वन्तरं चात्र शास्त्रयुक्तिविनिश्चितम् । वागर्थमिव चैवैतज्जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: asti hetvantaraM chAtra shAstrayuktivinishchitam | vAgarthamiva chaivaitajjagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam
verses.translation: O beloved, at the outset the devotee shall worship me externally by means of Karmayajfia. Then he shall resort to the path of knowledge. Afterwards he shall practise Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि वागमृतं साक्षादहमर्थामृतं परम् । द्वयमप्यमृतं कस्माद्वियुक्तमुपपद्यते
verses.transliteration: tvaM hi vAgamR^itaM sAkShAdahamarthAmR^itaM param | dvayamapyamR^itaM kasmAdviyuktamupapadyate
verses.translation: The Yogins who have understood my innate nature by karma-yajfia and who view a clod of earth, a pebble and a gold ingot all alike do not worship me further.

verses.sanskrit: विद्याप्रत्यायिका त्वं मे वेद्योऽहं प्रत्ययात्तव । विद्यावेद्यात्मनोरेव विश्लेषः कथमावयोः
verses.transliteration: vidyApratyAyikA tvaM me vedyo.ahaM pratyayAttava | vidyAvedyAtmanoreva vishleShaH kathamAvayoH
verses.translation: A Yogin engaged in the path of knowledge, an excellent sage permanently engaged in Yoga, my devotee enriched by purity of mind, shall attain my Sayujya.

verses.sanskrit: न कर्मणा सृजामीदं जगत्प्रतिसृजामि च । सर्वस्याज्ञैकलभ्यत्वादाज्ञात्वं हि गरीयसी
verses.transliteration: na karmaNA sR^ijAmIdaM jagatpratisR^ijAmi cha | sarvasyAj~naikalabhyatvAdAj~nAtvaM hi garIyasI
verses.translation: Those who have not had sufficient detachment in their minds but have resorted to me are authorised only in Jfiana, Carya and Kriya according to their deserts.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञैकसारमैश्वर्यं यस्मात्स्वातन्त्र्यलक्षणम् । आज्ञया विप्रयुक्तस्य चैश्वर्यं मम कीदृशम्
verses.transliteration: Aj~naikasAramaishvaryaM yasmAtsvAtantryalakShaNam | Aj~nayA viprayuktasya chaishvaryaM mama kIdR^isham
verses.translation: My worship shall be known to be two-fold: ex¬ ternal and internal. My adorative service is three-fold, differ¬ ing in view of speech, mind and body.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेशसमये तस्या भवनद्वारगोचरैः । गणेशैः किं कृतं देवस्तां दृष्ट्वा किं तदाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: praveshasamaye tasyA bhavanadvAragocharaiH | gaNeshaiH kiM kR^itaM devastAM dR^iShTvA kiM tadAkarot
verses.translation: By Karman my worship shall be understood and 'not such extraneous rites as sacrifice, etc. Tapas or penance is the withering of physical body for my sake and not the rites Kfcchra, etc.

verses.sanskrit: न कदाचिदवस्थानमावयोर्विप्रयुक्तयोः । देवानां कार्यमुद्दिश्य लीलोक्तिं कृतवानहम्
verses.transliteration: na kadAchidavasthAnamAvayorviprayuktayoH | devAnAM kAryamuddishya lIloktiM kR^itavAnaham
verses.translation: O gentle lady, stability in the Tattvas shall be practised beginning with an external or internal object where the mind feels interested urged by previous impressions.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयाप्यविदितं नास्ति कथं कुपितवत्यसि । ततस्त्रिलोकरक्षार्थे कोपो मय्यपि ते कृतः
verses.transliteration: tvayApyaviditaM nAsti kathaM kupitavatyasi | tatastrilokarakShArthe kopo mayyapi te kR^itaH
verses.translation: O gentle lady, the adorative service whether ex¬ ternal or internal shall be attended with devotion. If devoid of devotion, it is the cause of deceit.

verses.sanskrit: यदनर्थाय भूतानां न तदस्ति खलु त्वयि । इति प्रियंवदे साक्षादीश्वरे परमेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: yadanarthAya bhUtAnAM na tadasti khalu tvayi | iti priyaMvade sAkShAdIshvare parameshvare
verses.translation: I am content and pure. What shall be done unto me by men? Externally or internally only devotion is taken into consideration by me.

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गारभावसाराणां जन्मभूमिरकृत्रिमा । स्वभर्त्रा ललितं तथ्यमुक्तं मत्वा स्मितोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: shR^i~NgArabhAvasArANAM janmabhUmirakR^itrimA | svabhartrA lalitaM tathyamuktaM matvA smitottaram
verses.translation: O goddess, resorting to me with the fruit in view is easily feasible since the seeker of the fruit can abandon me in case there is no desired fruit.

verses.sanskrit: लज्जया न किमप्यूचे कौशिकी वर्णनात्परम् । तदेव वर्णयाम्यद्य शृणु देव्याश्च वर्णनम्
verses.transliteration: lajjayA na kimapyUche kaushikI varNanAtparam | tadeva varNayAmyadya shR^iNu devyAshcha varNanam
verses.translation: O pious lady, I am the bestower of fruits in accor¬ dance with the extent of devotion even to him who, though seeking fruits, keeps his mind well established in me.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । किं देवेन न सा दृष्टा या सृष्टा कौशिकी मया । तादृशी कन्यका लोके न भूता न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | kiM devena na sA dR^iShTA yA sR^iShTA kaushikI mayA | tAdR^ishI kanyakA loke na bhUtA na bhaviShyati
verses.translation: Those devotees are dearer to me whose minds are attached to me without reference to fruits but who may later on solicit for favours.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या वीर्यं बलं विन्ध्यनिलयं विजयं तथा । शुम्भस्य च निशुम्भस्य मारणे च रणे तयोः
verses.transliteration: tasyA vIryaM balaM vindhyanilayaM vijayaM tathA | shumbhasya cha nishumbhasya mAraNe cha raNe tayoH
verses.translation: Dearer unto me are those who resort to me with abject helplessness, unmindful of fruition or otherwise due to the impressions of previous actions.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षफलदानं च लोकाय भजते सदा । लोकानां रक्षणं शश्वद् ब्रह्मा विज्ञापयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: pratyakShaphaladAnaM cha lokAya bhajate sadA | lokAnAM rakShaNaM shashvad brahmA vij~nApayiShyati
verses.translation: Verily, they do not acquire any further gain than acquiring me. O goddess, my gain too is nothing else but acquiring them into my fold.

verses.sanskrit: इति सम्भाषमाणाया देव्या एवाज्ञया तदा । व्याघ्रः सख्या समानीय पुरोऽवस्थापितस्तदा
verses.transliteration: iti sambhAShamANAyA devyA evAj~nayA tadA | vyAghraH sakhyA samAnIya puro.avasthApitastadA
verses.translation: Their piety dedicated unto me due to my blessing is compelled to bestow the fruit on them, the fruit being the great beatitude.

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रेक्ष्याह पुनर्देवी देवानीतमुपायतम् । व्याघ्रं पश्य न चानेन सदृशो मदुपासकः
verses.transliteration: taM prekShyAha punardevI devAnItamupAyatam | vyAghraM pashya na chAnena sadR^isho madupAsakaH
verses.translation: They mention %bout eight traits for those authorised in Dharma, the noble souls who have dedicated their minds unto me without having recourse to anyone else, those who have favourable disposition to my devotees, who encourage my worship, or offer worship to me themselves or perform all activities of the body for my sake or have interest in listening to my stories, flutter in tones, eyes and limbs, remember me perpetually or surrender to me completely.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । प्रवक्तुमञ्जसाशक्यः तादृशः परमो रसः । येन प्रणयगर्भेण भावो भाववतां हृतः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | pravaktuma~njasAshakyaH tAdR^ishaH paramo rasaH | yena praNayagarbheNa bhAvo bhAvavatAM hR^itaH
verses.translation: If these eight traits are present even in an out- caste he is equal to a leading brahmin, a sage, a glorious ascetic and a learned scholar. A master of four Vedas is not dearer to me than a Candala''® devoted to me. Things can be given to and taken from him. He shall be worshipped like me. I am not lost to him nor is he lost to me who offers unto me with devotion, even a leaf, a flower, a fruit or mere water.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन दुष्टसङ्घेभ्यो रक्षितं मत्तपोवनम् । अतीव मम भक्तश्च विश्रब्धश्च स्वरक्षणात्
verses.transliteration: anena duShTasa~Nghebhyo rakShitaM mattapovanam | atIva mama bhaktashcha vishrabdhashcha svarakShaNAt
verses.translation: O goddes!5, I shall now succinctly mention the duties stipulated on the basis of caste for my authorised devotees, the learned brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: स्वदेशं च परित्यज्य प्रसादार्थं समागतः । यदि प्रीतिरभून्मत्तः परां प्रीतिं करोषि मे
verses.transliteration: svadeshaM cha parityajya prasAdArthaM samAgataH | yadi prItirabhUnmattaH parAM prItiM karoShi me
verses.translation: Daily bath thrice, rites in the holy fire, worship of the Lihga, charitable gifts, pious feelings for the lord, mer¬ cifulness everywhere at all times, truthfulness, contentedness, belief in scriptures and God, non-violence to all living beings, bashful modesty, faith, study of scriptures, Yoga, imparting of knowledge to others, commenting on scriptures, celibacy, listening to spiritual topics, austerities, forbearance, purity, wearing of the sacred thread, upper garment and turban,

verses.sanskrit: नित्यमन्तःपुरद्वारि नियोगान्नन्दिनः स्वयम् । रक्षिभिः सह तच्चिह्नैर्वर्ततामयमीश्वर
verses.transliteration: nityamantaHpuradvAri niyogAnnandinaH svayam | rakShibhiH saha tachchihnairvartatAmayamIshvara
verses.translation: The avoidance of wine and even its smell or of Naivedya is applicable to all castes, especially the Brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । मधुरं प्रणयोदर्कं श्रुत्वा देव्याः शुभं वचः । प्रीतोऽस्मीत्याह तं देवः स चादृश्यत तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | madhuraM praNayodarkaM shrutvA devyAH shubhaM vachaH | prIto.asmItyAha taM devaH sa chAdR^ishyata tatkShaNAt
verses.translation: The traits of Yogins are ten viz: — forbearance, quietude, contentment, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, my knowledge, non-attachment to worldly objects, using Bhasma and refraining from too much adherence to all. The Vanaprasthas have all these traits as also the partaking of alms during the day. The Brahmacarins shall not take food during the nights.

verses.sanskrit: बिभ्रद्वेत्रलतां हैमीं रत्नचित्रं च कञ्चुकम् । छुरिकामुरगप्रख्यां गणेशो रक्षवेषधृक्
verses.transliteration: bibhradvetralatAM haimIM ratnachitraM cha ka~nchukam | ChurikAmuragaprakhyAM gaNesho rakShaveShadhR^ik
verses.translation: Teaching, presiding over sacrifices and acceptance of monetary gifts are not prescribed by me for the Ksatriya and the Vaisya class.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्सोमो महादेवो नन्दी चानेन नन्दितः । सोमनन्दीति विख्यातस्तस्मादेष समाख्यया
verses.transliteration: yasmAtsomo mahAdevo nandI chAnena nanditaH | somanandIti vikhyAtastasmAdeSha samAkhyayA
verses.translation: The following are the duties and traits of kings — protection of the people of all castes, slaying of the enemies in battle, chastisement of the wicked and hunting of harmful birds and animals, distrusting everyone everywhere but belief in my Yogins, intercourse with women on proper occasions, maintenance of armies, keeping themselves well informed about the activities of the people through spies spread every¬ where always, wearing weapons, armour dusted with Bhasma. These are in brief the duties of kings following my instruc¬ tions. The characteristics of a Vaisya are cattle-breeding, trad¬ ing and agriculture.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं देव्याः प्रियं कृत्वा देवश्चार्द्धेन्दुभूषणः । भूषयामास तं दिव्यैर्भूषणै रत्नभूषितैः
verses.transliteration: itthaM devyAH priyaM kR^itvA devashchArddhendubhUShaNaH | bhUShayAmAsa taM divyairbhUShaNai ratnabhUShitaiH
verses.translation: Sexual approach only to one's own wife duly wed is prescribed for a householder and celibacy for all the other three, viz. Brahmacarins, Vanaprasthas and Sannyasins.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स गौरीं गिरिशो गिरीन्द्रजां सगौरवां सर्वमनोहरां हरः । पर्यङ्कमारोप्य वराङ्गभूषणै- र्विभूषयामास शशाङ्कभूषणः
verses.transliteration: tataH sa gaurIM girisho girIndrajAM sagauravAM sarvamanoharAM haraH | parya~NkamAropya varA~NgabhUShaNai\- rvibhUShayAmAsa shashA~NkabhUShaNaH
verses.translation: If a woman engages herself in holy rites thereby prejudicing her service to her husband she goes to hell un¬ doubtedly.

verses.sanskrit: द्वाःस्थैः ससम्भ्रमैरेव देवो देव्यागमोत्सुकः । शङ्कमाना प्रविष्टान्तस्तं च सा समपश्यत
verses.transliteration: dvAHsthaiH sasambhramaireva devo devyAgamotsukaH | sha~NkamAnA praviShTAntastaM cha sA samapashyata
verses.translation: Now I shall mention the eternal Dharma of widows. Holy rites, charitable gifts, penance, purity, lying on the bare ground, taking food only at night, celibacy, ash- bath, water-bath, quietness, silence, forbearance, self-composure in accordance with injunctions, observance of fasts on the eighth, eleventh and fourteenth days and on the full moon days and worship to me. Thus I have succinctly mentioned the eternal virtues of persons of diiferen stages and castes, of brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, ascetics, Brahmacarins, vanaprasthas, householders, iSudras and women, O gentle lady.

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तैः प्रणयभावैश्च भवनान्तरवर्तिभिः । गणेन्द्रैर्वन्दिता वाचा प्रणनाम त्रियम्बकम्
verses.transliteration: taistaiH praNayabhAvaishcha bhavanAntaravartibhiH | gaNendrairvanditA vAchA praNanAma triyambakam
verses.translation: O goddess, I shall be meditated upon along with you for ever. The Japa of six syllables'' shall be performed always. This is the brief compendium of duties as mentioned in the Vedas. 2®*

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य नोत्थिता यावत्तावत्तां परमेश्वरः । प्रगृह्य दोर्भ्यामाश्लिष्य परितः परया मुदा
verses.transliteration: praNamya notthitA yAvattAvattAM parameshvaraH | pragR^ihya dorbhyAmAshliShya paritaH parayA mudA
verses.translation: Those who possess excellent devotion as a result of good impressions in their souls of previous actions, who possess the physical bodies assumed by themselves, who are purified by the essence of my perfect knowledge and who have become holy due to my grace are not effected by sins as the lotus-leaves are not effected by water whether they be attached to it or not. It may not be possible for them to maintain the duties of the different stages in life. They have neither duties to be performed nor evils to be avoided. They have no trance to be practised, no great goal to be attained. They are not subject to do's and dont's like me.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाङ्के धर्तुं प्रवृत्तोऽपि सा पर्यङ्के न्यषीदत । पर्यङ्कतो बलाद्देवीं सोऽङ्कमारोप्य सुस्मिताम्
verses.transliteration: svA~Nke dhartuM pravR^itto.api sA parya~Nke nyaShIdata | parya~Nkato balAddevIM so.a~NkamAropya susmitAm
verses.translation: Just as I have nothing to be achieved since I am perfect, so also they have nothing to be attained because they are contented. It is undoubtedly so.

verses.sanskrit: सस्मितो विवृतैर्नेत्रैस्तद्वक्त्रं प्रपिबन्निव । तया सम्भाषणायेशः पूर्वभाषितमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sasmito vivR^itairnetraistadvaktraM prapibanniva | tayA sambhAShaNAyeshaH pUrvabhAShitamabravIt
verses.translation: Just as my injunctions make Brahma and others act so also their injunctions make other men act.

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव उवाच । सा दशा च व्यतीता किं तव सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि । यस्यामनुनयोपायः कोऽपि कोपान्न लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: devadeva uvAcha | sA dashA cha vyatItA kiM tava sarvA~Ngasundari | yasyAmanunayopAyaH ko.api kopAnna labhyate
verses.translation: Their sins are quelled by their very vision in view of their excellence of good piety and in view of their carrying out my behests.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Suddenly their bodies may throb and tremble; they may perspire, shed tears; their voice may grow hoarse or cracked; they may have a sensation of great bliss. This may recur again and again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Suddenly their bodies may throb and tremble; they may perspire, shed tears; their voice may grow hoarse or cracked; they may have a sensation of great bliss. This may recur again and again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२८. अष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः । भस्मतत्त्ववर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । देवीं समादधानेन देवेनेदं किमीरितम् । अग्निषोमात्मकं विश्वं वागर्थात्मकमित्यपि
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.28\. aShTAviMsho.adhyAyaH | bhasmatattvavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | devIM samAdadhAnena devenedaM kimIritam | agniShomAtmakaM vishvaM vAgarthAtmakamityapi
verses.translation: The excellent men can be understood by these never- failing indications severally or collectively or by means of the pious feelings of the low, excellent and the middling types.

verses.sanskrit: अत एव हि कालाग्निरधस्ताच्छक्तिरूर्ध्वतः । यावदादहनं चोर्ध्वमधश्चाप्लावनं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ata eva hi kAlAgniradhastAchChaktirUrdhvataH | yAvadAdahanaM chordhvamadhashchAplAvanaM bhavet
verses.translation: Just as anir on piece in conjunction with the fire is no mere iron piece so also they arc not mere human beings. Thanks to my grace.

verses.sanskrit: आधारशक्त्यैव धृतः कालाग्निरयमूर्ध्वगः । तथैव निम्नगः सोमः शिवशक्तिपदास्पदः
verses.transliteration: AdhArashaktyaiva dhR^itaH kAlAgnirayamUrdhvagaH | tathaiva nimnagaH somaH shivashaktipadAspadaH
verses.translation: A learned man shall not treat these Rudras with

verses.sanskrit: शिवश्चोर्ध्वमधः शक्तिरूर्ध्वं शक्तिरधः शिवः । तदित्थं शिवशक्तिभ्यां नाव्याप्तमिह किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: shivashchordhvamadhaH shaktirUrdhvaM shaktiradhaH shivaH | taditthaM shivashaktibhyAM nAvyAptamiha ki~nchana
verses.translation: Insult offered to them by men of confusixl intellect quells glory, longevity, family and conduct and may cause their fall into hell.

verses.sanskrit: असकृच्चाग्निना दग्धं जगद्यद्भस्मसात्कृतम् । अग्नेर्वीर्यमिदं चाहुस्तद्वीर्यं भस्म यत्ततः
verses.transliteration: asakR^ichchAgninA dagdhaM jagadyadbhasmasAtkR^itam | agnervIryamidaM chAhustadvIryaM bhasma yattataH
verses.translation: All those regions except mine, i.e. those of Brahma, Visnu, Indra, and others who have been uprooted though they may be great souls, are easily to be destroyed like cotton. The prosperity of Buddhi, Prakrti, and Purusa is impure. Hence it shall be eschewed by those who are desi¬ rous of the region beyond Gunas. Of what avail is this talk? By whatever means it may be, fixing of the mind in

verses.sanskrit: यश्चेत्थं भस्मसद्भावं ज्ञात्वा स्नाति च भस्मना । अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैर्बद्धः पाशात्प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yashchetthaM bhasmasadbhAvaM j~nAtvA snAti cha bhasmanA | agnirityAdibhirmantrairbaddhaH pAshAtpramuchyate
verses.translation: Thus the brief resume of essential knowledge has been expounded by lord Siva, the great Atman, for the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेर्वीर्यं तु यद्भस्म सोमेनाप्लावितं पुनः । अयोगयुक्त्या प्रकृतेरधिकाराय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: agnervIryaM tu yadbhasma somenAplAvitaM punaH | ayogayuktyA prakR^iteradhikArAya kalpate
verses.translation: T.'he Vedas, Sastras, Itihasas, Puranas and other

verses.sanskrit: योगयुक्त्या तु तद्भस्म प्लाव्यमानं समन्ततः । शाक्तेनामृतवर्षेण चाधिकारान्निवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: yogayuktyA tu tadbhasma plAvyamAnaM samantataH | shAktenAmR^itavarSheNa chAdhikArAnnivartayet
verses.translation: This succinct account contains the six topics, viz., Jfiana, Jheya, Anustheya, Adhikara, Sadhana and Sadhya.

verses.sanskrit: अतो मृत्युञ्जयायेत्थममृतप्लावनं सदा । शिवशक्त्यमृतस्पर्शे लब्धं येन कुतो मृतिः
verses.transliteration: ato mR^ityu~njayAyetthamamR^itaplAvanaM sadA | shivashaktyamR^itasparshe labdhaM yena kuto mR^itiH
verses.translation: Jnana is the knowledge acquired from the preceptor. Jneya is the Pasa, Pasu and Pati. The Anustheya is the worship of the Lihga. It is the devotee who is autho¬ rised. Sadhana is liva's mantra and Sadhya is the equality with Siva. If one has the knowledge of the epitome of the six topics one has attained omniscience.

verses.sanskrit: यो वेद दहनं गुह्यं प्लावनं च यथोदितम् । अग्नीषोमपदं हित्वा न स भूयोऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration: yo veda dahanaM guhyaM plAvanaM cha yathoditam | agnIShomapadaM hitvA na sa bhUyo.abhijAyate
verses.translation: After worshipping Siva externally at the outset by means of Karmayajfia with devotion and in accordance with one's affluence, the devotee shall afterwards be engaged in inner sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाग्निना तनुं दग्ध्वा शक्तिसौम्यामृतेन यः । प्लावयेद्योगमार्गेण सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: shivAgninA tanuM dagdhvA shaktisaumyAmR^itena yaH | plAvayedyogamArgeNa so.amR^itatvAya kalpate
verses.translation: O Krsna, neither within nor without has he ever any duty, he who is contented with the nectar of knowledge and who has identified his Atman with Siva by means of his devotion.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञैकसारमैश्वर्यमाज्ञात्वमिति चोदितम् । तदिदं श्रोतुमिच्छामो यथावदनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: Aj~naikasAramaishvaryamAj~nAtvamiti choditam | tadidaM shrotumichChAmo yathAvadanupUrvashaH
verses.translation: The devotee shall eschew in order the external and internal worships. Through Jnana he shall see the Jneya and then eschew the Jflana also.

verses.sanskrit: हृदि कृत्वेममर्थं वै देवेन समुदाहृतम् । अग्नीषोमात्मकं विश्वं जगदित्यनुरूपतः
verses.transliteration: hR^idi kR^itvemamarthaM vai devena samudAhR^itam | agnIShomAtmakaM vishvaM jagadityanurUpataH
verses.translation: Hence one shall fix the mind in Siva by some means or other without performing the rites or performing them internally or externally in order.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । अग्निरित्युच्यते रौद्री घोरा या तैजसी तनुः । सोमः शाक्तोऽमृतमयः शक्तेः शान्तिकरी तनुः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | agnirityuchyate raudrI ghorA yA taijasI tanuH | somaH shAkto.amR^itamayaH shakteH shAntikarI tanuH
verses.translation: Persons who have fixed their minds in Siva, good men who have stabilised their intellect will have the great¬ est bliss everywhere both here and hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतं यत्प्रतिष्ठा सा तेजो विद्या कला स्वयम् । भूतसूक्ष्मेषु सर्वेषु त एव रसतेजसी
verses.transliteration: amR^itaM yatpratiShThA sA tejo vidyA kalA svayam | bhUtasUkShmeShu sarveShu ta eva rasatejasI
verses.translation: The six-syllabled mantra is found in the Veda and Sivagama. It facilitates the understanding of all topics by the devotees of Siva. It consists of very few syllables but is pregnant with meaning. It is the essence of the Vedas. It is conducive to salvation. This expression of auspicious nature is devoid of doubts. It is achieved by the order of Siva. It is attended by many Siddhis. It is divine and delightful to the mind. That expression 'lord Siva' is majestic and deci¬ sive in meaning.

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधा तेजसो वृत्तिः सूर्यात्मा चानलात्मिका । तथैव रसवृत्तिश्च सोमात्मा च जलात्मिका
verses.transliteration: dvividhA tejaso vR^ittiH sUryAtmA chAnalAtmikA | tathaiva rasavR^ittishcha somAtmA cha jalAtmikA
verses.translation: The omniscient lord Siva mentioned the mantra, "Om Namah Sivaya" for the acquisition of all topics and mean¬ ings by the embodied beings since it can be easily uttered through the mouth.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युदादिमयं तेजो मधुरादिमयो रसः । तेजोरसविभेदैस्तु धृतमेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: vidyudAdimayaM tejo madhurAdimayo rasaH | tejorasavibhedaistu dhR^itametachcharAcharam
verses.translation: The first mantra consisting of six syllables is the seed of all lores. It is very subtle but serves a great purpose. It shall be known like the seed of the banyan tree.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेरमृतनिष्पत्तिरमृतेनाग्निरेधते । अत एव हि विक्रान्तमग्नीषोमं जगद्धितम्
verses.transliteration: agneramR^itaniShpattiramR^itenAgniredhate | ata eva hi vikrAntamagnIShomaM jagaddhitam
verses.translation: The omniscient lord, the creator of everything, the all-pervasive Siva who is beyond the three attributes, is statio¬ ned in the single-syllabled mantra Om.

verses.sanskrit: हविषे सस्यसम्पत्तिर्वृष्टिः सस्याभिवृद्धये । वृष्टेरेव हविस्तस्मादग्नीषोमधृतं जगत्
verses.transliteration: haviShe sasyasampattirvR^iShTiH sasyAbhivR^iddhaye | vR^iShTereva havistasmAdagnIShomadhR^itaM jagat
verses.translation: The five subtle Brahmans arc stationed in the mantra "Namah Sivaya" occupying one syllable each. Thus in the six-syllabled subtle mantra, Siva in the form of Pafica Brahmans®* is stationed in the way of Expressed and Expressive. Innately Siva is 'Expressed' and the mantra is 'Expressive* due to its comprehensibility.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरूर्ध्वं ज्वलत्येष यावत्सौम्यं परामृतम् । यावदग्न्यास्पदं सौम्यममृतं च स्रवत्यधः
verses.transliteration: agnirUrdhvaM jvalatyeSha yAvatsaumyaM parAmR^itam | yAvadagnyAspadaM saumyamamR^itaM cha sravatyadhaH
verses.translation: See Vayu II. 3. 5.; SRS i. 36.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Siva too is beginningless and he is the releaser of persons from the worldly existence. Just as the medicine is naturally antagonistic to ailments so also Siva is antagoni¬ stic to the ills of worldly existence. If the lord of the uni¬ verse had not been in existence, the whole universe would have been gloomy, since the Prakrti is insentient and the Purusa is ignorant. Pradhana, the atom etc. are insentient. They never function as the makers themselves without an in¬ telligent cause. The instruction in virtue and evil, the bond¬ age and salvation, the activity of reflection — in view of all these things the first creation of men would not have been possible without the omniscient lord. Just as the patients will be devoid of joy and be distressed without the physician so also the people would be in distress without the lord.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Siva too is beginningless and he is the releaser of persons from the worldly existence. Just as the medicine is naturally antagonistic to ailments so also Siva is antagoni¬ stic to the ills of worldly existence. If the lord of the uni¬ verse had not been in existence, the whole universe would have been gloomy, since the Prakrti is insentient and the Purusa is ignorant. Pradhana, the atom etc. are insentient. They never function as the makers themselves without an in¬ telligent cause. The instruction in virtue and evil, the bond¬ age and salvation, the activity of reflection — in view of all these things the first creation of men would not have been possible without the omniscient lord. Just as the patients will be devoid of joy and be distressed without the physician so also the people would be in distress without the lord.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.२९. एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । वागर्थात्मकतत्त्ववर्णनम् । वायुरुवाच । निवेदयामि जगतो वागर्थात्म्यं कृतं यथा । षडध्ववेदनं सम्यक् समासान्न तु विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.29\. ekonatriMsho.adhyAyaH | vAgarthAtmakatattvavarNanam | vAyuruvAcha | nivedayAmi jagato vAgarthAtmyaM kR^itaM yathA | ShaDadhvavedanaM samyak samAsAnna tu vistarAt
verses.translation: iva is devoid of beginning, middle and end. He is the lord innately pure, omniscient and perfect as mentioned in Saivite Agamas.

verses.sanskrit: कलाभिस्तानि तत्त्वानि व्याप्तान्येव यथातथम् । परस्याः प्रकृतेरादौ पञ्चधा परिणामतः
verses.transliteration: kalAbhistAni tattvAni vyAptAnyeva yathAtatham | parasyAH prakR^iterAdau pa~nchadhA pariNAmataH
verses.translation: This mantra is a positive statement and not a parable. How can Siva, who is all-perfect, all-perva¬ sive, innately pure and who blesses the worlds, mention a false theory? As things stand by nature along with their virtues and flaws, and the fruits they are capable of producing, ow can the omniscient being mention untruth? Only one influenced )>y passion, ignorance and other flaws will speak untruth.

verses.sanskrit: कलाश्च ता निवृत्त्याद्याः पर्य्याप्ता इति निश्चयः । मन्त्राध्वा च पदाध्वा च वर्णाध्वा चेति शब्दतः
verses.transliteration: kalAshcha tA nivR^ittyAdyAH paryyAptA iti nishchayaH | mantrAdhvA cha padAdhvA cha varNAdhvA cheti shabdataH
verses.translation: Those two faults are not present in the lord. How can he then make a wrong statement? Surely therefore the expression that is uttered by iiva, the omniscient without any flaw, is authoritative.

verses.sanskrit: भुवनाध्वा च तत्त्वाध्वा कलाध्वा चार्थतः क्रमात् । अत्रान्योऽन्यं च सर्वेषां व्याप्यव्यापकतोच्यते
verses.transliteration: bhuvanAdhvA cha tattvAdhvA kalAdhvA chArthataH kramAt | atrAnyo.anyaM cha sarveShAM vyApyavyApakatochyate
verses.translation: Hence, the statements of lord Siva shall be faith¬ fully considered by a learned man. In regard to merits and sins as they are, a person having no faith i' him falls.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्राः सर्वे पदैर्व्याप्ता वाक्यभावात्पदानि च । वर्णैर्वर्णसमूहं हि पदमाहुर्विपश्चितः
verses.transliteration: mantrAH sarve padairvyAptA vAkyabhAvAtpadAni cha | varNairvarNasamUhaM hi padamAhurvipashchitaH
verses.translation: The good statements uttered by the sages quiet and calm for the achievement of heaven and salvation shall be considered 'sacred utterances,'

verses.sanskrit: वर्णास्तु भुवनैर्व्याप्तास्तेषां तेषूपलम्भनात् । भुवनान्यपि तत्त्वौघैरुत्पत्त्यान्तर्बहिष्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: varNAstu bhuvanairvyAptAsteShAM teShUpalambhanAt | bhuvanAnyapi tattvaughairutpattyAntarbahiShkramAt
verses.translation: The utterances that are actuated by passion, hatred, falsehood, anger, lust and greediness are bad. They cause one's fall into hell.

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्तानि कारणैस्तत्त्वैरारब्धत्वादनेकशः । अन्तरादुत्थितानीह भुवनानि तु कानिचित्
verses.transliteration: vyAptAni kAraNaistattvairArabdhatvAdanekashaH | antarAdutthitAnIha bhuvanAni tu kAnichit
verses.translation: Even that ugly statement which on being heard brings in welfare and the destruction of lust etc,, should be considered auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: पौराणिकानि चान्यानि विज्ञेयानि शिवागमे । साङ्ख्ययोगप्रसिद्धानि तत्त्वान्यपि च कानिचित्
verses.transliteration: paurANikAni chAnyAni vij~neyAni shivAgame | sA~NkhyayogaprasiddhAni tattvAnyapi cha kAnichit
verses.translation: Although there ar many mantras, there is nothing like the holy mantra utteied by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: शिवशास्त्रप्रसिद्धानि ततोऽन्यान्यपि कृत्स्नशः । कलाभिस्तानि तत्त्वानि व्याप्तान्येव यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: shivashAstraprasiddhAni tato.anyAnyapi kR^itsnashaH | kalAbhistAni tattvAni vyAptAnyeva yathAtatham
verses.translation: The Vedas and Sastras along with their ancillaries are present in the six syllables. Hence there is no other mantra equal to this.

verses.sanskrit: परस्याः प्रकृतेरादौ पञ्चधा परिणामतः । कलाश्च ता निवृत्त्याद्या व्याप्ताः पञ्च यथोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: parasyAH prakR^iterAdau pa~nchadhA pariNAmataH | kalAshcha tA nivR^ittyAdyA vyAptAH pa~ncha yathottaram
verses.translation: Whatever texts there are, the texts expounding Siva's knowledge, the repositories of lore, they are the com¬ mentaries of the succinct aphorism, the six-syllabled mantra.

verses.sanskrit: व्यापिकातः पराशक्तिरविभक्ता षडध्वनाम् । परप्रकृतिभावस्य तत्सत्त्वाच्छिवतत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: vyApikAtaH parAshaktiravibhaktA ShaDadhvanAm | paraprakR^itibhAvasya tatsattvAchChivatattvataH
verses.translation: Of what avail are many mantras and Sastras full of details to one whose heart is firmly established in the mantra "Orii Namah Sivaya?"

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति कश्चिदशब्दार्थो नापि शब्दो निरर्थकः । ततो हि समये शब्दः सर्वः सर्वार्थबोधकः
verses.transliteration: nAsti kashchidashabdArtho nApi shabdo nirarthakaH | tato hi samaye shabdaH sarvaH sarvArthabodhakaH
verses.translation: If anyone has stabilised the Mantra "Oiii Namab Sivaya" by frequent practice, he has learnt all, heard all and performed all.

verses.sanskrit: शक्त्यादि च पृथिव्यन्तं शिवतत्त्वसमुद्भवम् । व्याप्तमेकेन तेनैव मृदा कुम्भादिकं यथा
verses.transliteration: shaktyAdi cha pR^ithivyantaM shivatattvasamudbhavam | vyAptamekena tenaiva mR^idA kumbhAdikaM yathA
verses.translation: A person steady in the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra is released from the cage of sins whether he be a l3udra, base-born, fool or a learned man.

verses.sanskrit: शैवं तत्परमं धाम यत्प्राप्यं षड्भिरध्वभिः । व्यापिकाऽव्यापिका शक्तिः पञ्चतत्त्वविशोधनात्
verses.transliteration: shaivaM tatparamaM dhAma yatprApyaM ShaDbhiradhvabhiH | vyApikA.avyApikA shaktiH pa~nchatattvavishodhanAt
verses.translation: O great lord, how are your devotees liberated in the defiled period of Kali, invincible and untransgressable, when the world is enveloped by the darkness of sin, when people are averse to the practice of holy rites, when the legitimate activities of different castes and stages in life have declined, when great danger is imminent, when the question of the rights of the people is involved in doubts, when deviation from duty is certain, when the continuity of spiri¬ tual instructions is broken and when the order of preceptors and disciples has disappeared?

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्त्या रुद्रपर्यन्तं स्थितिरण्डस्य शोध्यते । प्रतिष्ठया तदूर्ध्वं तु यावदव्यक्तगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: nivR^ittyA rudraparyantaM sthitiraNDasya shodhyate | pratiShThayA tadUrdhvaM tu yAvadavyaktagocharam
verses.translation: Men of the Kali age are liberated when their souls are purified by devotion after resorting to my pleasing Mantra of five syllables.

verses.sanskrit: तदूर्ध्वं विद्यया मध्ये यावद्विश्वेश्वरावधि । शान्त्या तदूर्ध्वम्मध्वान्ते विशुद्धिः शान्त्यतीतया
verses.transliteration: tadUrdhvaM vidyayA madhye yAvadvishveshvarAvadhi | shAntyA tadUrdhvammadhvAnte vishuddhiH shAntyatItayA
verses.translation: My five-syllabled Mantra affords protection from the fear of worldly existence to those whose minds are inclined towards me although they may be of distorted outlook, greedy, deceitful, ruthless, ungrateful and defiled by unimagi¬ nable and inexpressible faults, mental, verbal and physical.

verses.sanskrit: यामाहुः परमं व्योम परप्रकृतियोगतः । एतानि पञ्चतत्त्वानि यैर्व्याप्तमखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: yAmAhuH paramaM vyoma paraprakR^itiyogataH | etAni pa~nchatattvAni yairvyAptamakhilaM jagat
verses.translation: O goddess, often I have promised that in this world even a fallen man may become liberated through this Mantra if he happens to be my devotee.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रैव सर्वमेवेदं द्रष्टव्यं खलु साधकैः । अध्वव्याप्तिमविज्ञाय शुद्धिं यः कर्तुमिच्छति
verses.transliteration: atraiva sarvamevedaM draShTavyaM khalu sAdhakaiH | adhvavyAptimavij~nAya shuddhiM yaH kartumichChati
verses.translation: If a fallen man does not deserve holy rites in any respect, the rites performed by him are conducive to hell.

verses.sanskrit: स विप्रलम्भकः शुद्धेर्नालं प्रापयितुं फलम् । वृथा परिश्रमस्तस्य निरयायैव केवलम्
verses.transliteration: sa vipralambhakaH shuddhernAlaM prApayituM phalam | vR^ithA parishramastasya nirayAyaiva kevalam
verses.translation: Yes, surely, if the fallen man, under delusion, were to worship me with other mantras, excluding the five-syllabled one, he is sure to fall into hell.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिपातसमायोगादृते तत्त्वानि तत्त्वतः । तद्व्याप्तिस्तद्विवृद्धिश्च ज्ञातुमेवं न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: shaktipAtasamAyogAdR^ite tattvAni tattvataH | tadvyAptistadvivR^iddhishcha j~nAtumevaM na shakyate
verses.translation: Persons who live on water or air and those whose bodies are emaciated due to holy rites do not attain my region through those holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिराज्ञा परा शैवी चिद्रूपा परमेश्वरी । शिवोऽधितिष्ठत्यखिलं यया कारणभूतया
verses.transliteration: shaktirAj~nA parA shaivI chidrUpA parameshvarI | shivo.adhitiShThatyakhilaM yayA kAraNabhUtayA
verses.translation: But he who worships me even once with devotion repeating the hve-syllabled mantra, attains my region through the weightiness of this Mantra alone.

verses.sanskrit: नात्मनो नैव मायैषा न विकारो विचारतः । न बन्धो नापि मुक्तिश्च बन्धमुक्तिविधायिनी
verses.transliteration: nAtmano naiva mAyaiShA na vikAro vichArataH | na bandho nApi muktishcha bandhamuktividhAyinI
verses.translation: Hence, penances, sacrifices, observances and holy rites are not equal to even a croreth part of the worship with the five-syllabled mantra.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतेः परिणामोऽयं द्विधा शब्दार्थभावना । तामाहुः प्राकृतीं मूर्तिं शिवयोः परमात्मनोः
verses.transliteration: prakR^iteH pariNAmo.ayaM dvidhA shabdArthabhAvanA | tAmAhuH prAkR^itIM mUrtiM shivayoH paramAtmanoH
verses.translation: Indeed he who worships me with the five-syllabled mantra becomes liberated if he is in bondage.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैश्वर्यपराकाष्ठा शिवस्याव्यभिचारिणी । समानधर्मिणी तस्य तैस्तैर्भावैर्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sarvaishvaryaparAkAShThA shivasyAvyabhichAriNI | samAnadharmiNI tasya taistairbhAvairvisheShataH
verses.translation: He who worships me even once with the five- syllabled mantra with or without the Rudra mantra is libe¬ rated even if he is a fallen or a foolish man.

verses.sanskrit: स तयैव गृही सापि तेनैव गृहिणी सदा । तयोरपत्यं यत्कार्यं परप्रकृतिजं जगत्
verses.transliteration: sa tayaiva gR^ihI sApi tenaiva gR^ihiNI sadA | tayorapatyaM yatkAryaM paraprakR^itijaM jagat
verses.translation: O goddess, he who worships me with the six- syllabled or with the five-syllabled mantra, with the Vedic mantra as its ancillary, with devotion to me, is liberated.

verses.sanskrit: स कर्ता कारणं सेति तयोर्भेदो व्यवस्थितः । एक एव शिवः साक्षाद् द्विधाऽसौ समवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: sa kartA kAraNaM seti tayorbhedo vyavasthitaH | eka eva shivaH sAkShAd dvidhA.asau samavasthitaH
verses.translation: A fallen man or one not fallen can worship with this mantra. My devotee who has conquered anger may or may not be one who has attained me. One who has attained me is a billion times superior to one who has not attained. Hence one should try to attain me by worshipping me with this mantra.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुंसभावेन तयोर्भेद इत्यपि केचन । अपरे तु परा शक्तिः शिवस्य समवायिनी
verses.transliteration: strIpuMsabhAvena tayorbheda ityapi kechana | apare tu parA shaktiH shivasya samavAyinI
verses.translation: He who worships me with this Mantra, being equipped with friendship and other attributes with devotion and celibacy attains similarity to me.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभेव भानोश्चिद्रूपा भिन्नैवेति व्यवस्थितः । तस्माच्छिवः परो हेतुस्तस्याज्ञा परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: prabheva bhAnoshchidrUpA bhinnaiveti vyavasthitaH | tasmAchChivaH paro hetustasyAj~nA parameshvarI
verses.translation: At the advent of dissolution when the mobile and immobile beings perish, everything becomes merged in its cause.

verses.sanskrit: तयैव प्रेरिता शैवी मूलप्रकृतिरव्यया । महामाया च माया च प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणेति च
verses.transliteration: tayaiva preritA shaivI mUlaprakR^itiravyayA | mahAmAyA cha mAyA cha prakR^itistriguNeti cha
verses.translation: O goddess, I am the only one staying then. There is no second one anywhere. Then all the Vedas, scriptures etc. are stationed in the five-syllabled mantra.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविधा कार्यभेदेन सा प्रसूते षडध्वनः । स वागर्थमयश्चाध्वा षड्विधो निखिलं जगत्
