verses.transliteration: trividhA kAryabhedena sA prasUte ShaDadhvanaH | sa vAgarthamayashchAdhvA ShaDvidho nikhilaM jagat
verses.translation: Protected by my Sakti they do not perish. The creation is evolved out of me differently through the Prakrti and the Atman.

verses.sanskrit: अस्यैव विस्तरं प्राहुः शास्त्रजातमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: asyaiva vistaraM prAhuH shAstrajAtamasheShataH
verses.translation: Then comes a subsidiary dissolution of the forms and attributes. Then lord Narayana assumes the physical body of Maya and lies on the serpent couch in the midst of the water. The five-faced lord Brahma born of his umbilical lotus becomes desirous of creating the three worlds. But having none to assist him he becomes incapable. Hence he creates at the outset the ten sages of unmeasured splendour, his mental sons.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दात्मिका विभूतिर्या सा त्रिधा कथ्यते बुधैः । स्थूला सूक्ष्मा परा चेति स्थूला या श्रुतिगोचरा
verses.transliteration: shabdAtmikA vibhUtiryA sA tridhA kathyate budhaiH | sthUlA sUkShmA parA cheti sthUlA yA shrutigocharA
verses.translation: In order to enhance their achievement Brahma said to me 'O great lord, please bestow the power on my sons.'

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मा चिन्तामयी प्रोक्ता चिन्तया रहिता परा । या शक्तिः सा परा शक्तिः शिवतत्त्वसमाश्रया
verses.transliteration: sUkShmA chintAmayI proktA chintayA rahitA parA | yA shaktiH sA parA shaktiH shivatattvasamAshrayA
verses.translation: Thus requested by him, I who had assumed five faces, mentioned the five syllables, to the lotus-born one.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानशक्तिसमायोगादिच्छोपोद्बलिका तथा । सर्वशक्तिसमष्ट्यात्मा शक्तितत्त्वसमाख्यया
verses.transliteration: j~nAnashaktisamAyogAdichChopodbalikA tathA | sarvashaktisamaShTyAtmA shaktitattvasamAkhyayA
verses.translation: Accepting them with his five faces, the grandfather of the worlds understood me as the great lord, the expressive of great meaning.

verses.sanskrit: समस्तकार्यजातस्य मूलप्रकृतितां गता । सैव कुण्डलिनी माया शुद्धाध्वपरमा सती
verses.transliteration: samastakAryajAtasya mUlaprakR^ititAM gatA | saiva kuNDalinI mAyA shuddhAdhvaparamA satI
verses.translation: After understanding the process of its application in accordance with the rules, the patriarch who achieved the Mantra imparted it along with its meaning to his sons in the exact manner.

verses.sanskrit: सा विभागस्वरूपैव षडध्वात्मा विजृम्भते । तत्र शब्दास्त्रयोऽध्वानस्त्रयश्चार्थाः समीरिताः
verses.transliteration: sA vibhAgasvarUpaiva ShaDadhvAtmA vijR^imbhate | tatra shabdAstrayo.adhvAnastrayashchArthAH samIritAH
verses.translation: After securing the excellent Mantra from him, they desired to propitiate me along the way indicated by him. There is a mountain Mujavat on the beautiful peak of Meru. It is my favourite resort, ever glorious and always guarded by my devotees. Eager to create the world they per¬ formed penance there for a thousand years according to the calculation of the gods, taking in only air.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामपि वै पुंसां नैजशुद्ध्यनुरूपतः । लयभोगाधिकाराः स्युः सर्वतत्त्वविभागतः
verses.transliteration: sarveShAmapi vai puMsAM naijashuddhyanurUpataH | layabhogAdhikArAH syuH sarvatattvavibhAgataH
verses.translation: On seeing their devotion I appeared before them immediately and explained to them all the details, viz., the sage, metre, Kilaka, Bljaakti, deity, Nyasa, the six ancillaries, the limits of the quarters and their application. The aim was to multiply creation through the sages.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Now I mention the form of this great mantra. The word 'Namah* shall be uttered at first. It shall be followed by the word 'Sivaya*.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Now I mention the form of this great mantra. The word 'Namah* shall be uttered at first. It shall be followed by the word 'Sivaya*.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३०. त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्वप्रश्नः । ऋषय ऊचुः । चरितानि विचित्राणि गृह्याणि गहनानि च । दुर्विज्ञेयानि देवैश्च मोहयन्ति मनांसि नः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.30\. triMsho.adhyAyaH | shivatattvaprashnaH | R^iShaya UchuH | charitAni vichitrANi gR^ihyANi gahanAni cha | durvij~neyAni devaishcha mohayanti manAMsi naH
verses.translation: It is the goddess, my own expression coming out of my mouth at first. The goddess having the splendour of molten gold, plump, lifted-up breasts, four arms, three arees, and the crescent moon as the crest-jewel. Her hands are as tender as lotuses. She is gentle with the gestures of boon and protection; she is possessed of all characteristics. She is bedecked in ornaments. She is seated on a white lotus. Her tresses are blue and curly.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तात्मा सकलः कश्चित्स चान्यो निष्फलः शिवः । शिवेनाधिष्ठितश्चेति सर्वत्र लघु कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: mUrtAtmA sakalaH kashchitsa chAnyo niShphalaH shivaH | shivenAdhiShThitashcheti sarvatra laghu kathyate
verses.translation: She has five colours with beaming discs, viz., yellow, black, smoky, golden and red.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्त्यात्मैव तदा मूर्तिः शिवस्यास्य भवेदिति । तस्यां मूर्तौ मूर्तिमतोः पारतन्त्र्यं हि निश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: mUrtyAtmaiva tadA mUrtiH shivasyAsya bhavediti | tasyAM mUrtau mUrtimatoH pAratantryaM hi nishchitam
verses.translation: O good-faced lady, the sage of this mantra is Vamadeva; the metre is Pankti; the deity, I am myself.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा निरपेक्षेण मूर्तिः स्वीक्रियते कथम् । मूर्तिस्वीकरणं तस्मान्मूर्तौ साध्यफलेप्सया
verses.transliteration: anyathA nirapekSheNa mUrtiH svIkriyate katham | mUrtisvIkaraNaM tasmAnmUrtau sAdhyaphalepsayA
verses.translation: The several individual sages of the letters are, O good lady, Gautama, Atri, Visvamitra, Angiras and Bharadvaja.

verses.sanskrit: न हि स्वेच्छाशरीरत्वं स्वातन्त्र्यायोपपद्यते । स्वेच्छैव तादृशी पुंसां यस्मात्कर्मानुसारिणी
verses.transliteration: na hi svechChAsharIratvaM svAtantryAyopapadyate | svechChaiva tAdR^ishI puMsAM yasmAtkarmAnusAriNI
verses.translation: The metres severally arc Gayatri, Anustup, Tristup, Brhati and Virat. The deities severally are Indra, Rudra, Visnu, Brahma and Skanda.

verses.sanskrit: स्वीकर्तुं स्वेच्छया देहं हातुं च प्रभवन्त्युत । ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ताः किं ते कर्मातिवर्तिनः
verses.transliteration: svIkartuM svechChayA dehaM hAtuM cha prabhavantyuta | brahmAdayaH pishAchAntAH kiM te karmAtivartinaH
verses.translation: As their places, my faces benning with the one in the east and ending with the one above are taken. They are identiHed with the letters **Na*' etc. in order.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छया देहनिर्माणमिन्द्रजालोपमं विदुः । अणिमादिगुणैश्वर्यवशीकारानतिक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ichChayA dehanirmANamindrajAlopamaM viduH | aNimAdiguNaishvaryavashIkArAnatikramAt
verses.translation: The first, second and the fourth letters are Udatta. The fifth is Svarita and the third is Anudatta.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपं दधद्विष्णुर्दधीचेन महर्षिणा । युध्यता समुपालब्धस्तद्रूपं दधता स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: vishvarUpaM dadhadviShNurdadhIchena maharShiNA | yudhyatA samupAlabdhastadrUpaM dadhatA svayam
verses.translation: The letter "Na" is the head; **Mab" the tuft; "Si" the armour; "Va" the eye; **Ya" the missile. At the end of each letter shall be uttered — Namah, Svaha, Vaat, Hurh, Vauat, Phat.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्मादधिकस्यापि शिवस्य परमात्मनः । शरीरवत्तयान्यात्मसाधर्म्यं प्रतिभाति नः
verses.transliteration: sarvasmAdadhikasyApi shivasya paramAtmanaH | sharIravattayAnyAtmasAdharmyaM pratibhAti naH
verses.translation: The devotee shall worship me with Japa, Homa, etc., mentally, verbally and physically through this Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वानुग्राहकं प्राहुः शिवं परमकारणम् । स निर्गृह्णाति देवानां सर्वानुग्राहकः कथम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAnugrAhakaM prAhuH shivaM paramakAraNam | sa nirgR^ihNAti devAnAM sarvAnugrAhakaH katham
verses.translation: Let it be in accordance with their intellect, in¬ junction in the scripture, time, inclination, capacity, wealth and their taste.

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद बहुशो देवो ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः । शिवनिन्दां प्रकुर्वन्तं पुत्रेति कुमतेर्हठात्
verses.transliteration: chichCheda bahusho devo brahmaNaH pa~nchamaM shiraH | shivanindAM prakurvantaM putreti kumaterhaThAt
verses.translation: O Goddess, my worship will lead to salvation when¬ ever, wherever and by whomsover it may be done if it is with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: शिवयोस्तत्त्वसम्बन्धे न दोष उपलभ्यते । चरितैः प्राकृतो भावस्तयोरपि विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: shivayostattvasambandhe na doSha upalabhyate | charitaiH prAkR^ito bhAvastayorapi vibhAvyate
verses.translation: I have made certain rules governing my devotees who are not unduly helpless in regard to all sacred scrip¬ tures.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोरपि नृसिंहस्य रभसा शरभाकृतिः । बिभेद पद्भ्यामाक्रम्य हृदयं नखरैः खरैः
verses.transliteration: viShNorapi nR^isiMhasya rabhasA sharabhAkR^itiH | bibheda padbhyAmAkramya hR^idayaM nakharaiH kharaiH
verses.translation: There at the outset, I shall explain the procedure of practising the mantra without which the Japa is futile and with which it is fruitful.

verses.sanskrit: देवस्त्रीषु च देवेषु दक्षस्याध्वरकारणात् । वीरेण वीरभद्रेण न हि कश्चिददण्डितः
verses.transliteration: devastrIShu cha deveShu dakShasyAdhvarakAraNAt | vIreNa vIrabhadreNa na hi kashchidadaNDitaH
verses.translation: O good-faced lady, a Japa without the behest of the preceptor, holy rites, faith and the prescribed fees is fruitless though the behest might have been secured.

verses.sanskrit: पुरत्रयं च सस्त्रीकं सदैत्यं सह बालकैः । क्षणेनैकेन देवेन नेत्राग्नेरिन्धनीकृतम्
verses.transliteration: puratrayaM cha sastrIkaM sadaityaM saha bAlakaiH | kShaNenaikena devena netrAgnerindhanIkR^itam
verses.translation: The devotee shall approach the brahmin preceptor who knows the principles, performs Japa, is devoted to meditation and endowed with virtues. He shall strenuously propitiate him mentally, verbally, physically and monetarily. He shall possess the purity of piety.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजानां रतिहेतुश्च कामो रतिपतिः स्वयम् । क्रोशतामेव देवानां हुतो नेत्रहुताशने
verses.transliteration: prajAnAM ratihetushcha kAmo ratipatiH svayam | kroshatAmeva devAnAM huto netrahutAshane
verses.translation: /V brahmin devotee shall worship the preceptor always strenuously. If he is affluent he shall present devoutly to his preceptor excellent horses, elephants chariots, ornaments, garments, grain and riches.

verses.sanskrit: गावश्च कश्चिद्दुग्धौघं स्रवन्त्यो मूर्ध्नि खेचराः । सरुषा प्रेक्ष्य देवेन तत्क्षणे भस्मसात्कृताः
verses.transliteration: gAvashcha kashchiddugdhaughaM sravantyo mUrdhni khecharAH | saruShA prekShya devena tatkShaNe bhasmasAtkR^itAH
verses.translation: He shall not be stringent about money if he desires to achieve Siddhi for himself. Dedicating himself thereafter along with his possessions to the preceptor and after undeceit- fully worshipping him to his capacity, he shall learn the mantra and derive knowledge in due order.

verses.sanskrit: जलन्धरासुरो दीर्णश्चक्रीकृत्य जलं पदा । बद्ध्वानन्तेन यो विष्णुं चिक्षेप शतयोजनम्
verses.transliteration: jalandharAsuro dIrNashchakrIkR^itya jalaM padA | baddhvAnantena yo viShNuM chikShepa shatayojanam
verses.translation: When the preceptor is satisfied he shall let him stay for a year serving him without arrogance. On an auspicious day thereafter he shall make him take his bath after observing fast. For the sake of purity he shall again be subjected to ablution with vessels full of ghee and sacred water wherein holy materials shall be put. He shall dress him well and bedeck him with fragrant garlands, ornaments and garments. The Puiyaha mantras shall be recited and brahmins worshipped. Then in a holy spot, near the seashore, river bank, cowpen temple or in the house itself, at an auspici¬ ous hour when the day is conducive to achievement, when the conjunctions of stars are devoid of defects, he shall bless him and impart to him my knowledge duly.

verses.sanskrit: तमेव जलसन्धायी शूलेनैव जघान सः । तच्चक्रं तपसा लब्ध्वा लब्धवीर्यो हरिः सदा
verses.transliteration: tameva jalasandhAyI shUlenaiva jaghAna saH | tachchakraM tapasA labdhvA labdhavIryo hariH sadA
verses.translation: In a secluded spot the preceptor delighted in

verses.sanskrit: जिघांसतां सुरारीणां कुलं निर्घृणचेतसाम् । त्रिशूलेनान्धकस्योरः शिखिनैवोपतापितम्
verses.transliteration: jighAMsatAM surArINAM kulaM nirghR^iNachetasAm | trishUlenAndhakasyoraH shikhinaivopatApitam
verses.translation: Getting thus the mantra and the permission from the preceptor the disciple shall perform the Sarhkalpa with pure mind and repeat the mantra with the rite of initiation.

verses.sanskrit: कण्ठात्कालाङ्गनां सृष्ट्वा दारकोऽपि निपातितः । कौशिकीं जनयित्वा तु गौर्य्यास्त्वक्कोशगोचराम्
verses.transliteration: kaNThAtkAlA~NganAM sR^iShTvA dArako.api nipAtitaH | kaushikIM janayitvA tu gauryyAstvakkoshagocharAm
verses.translation: As long as he lives he shall repeat the mantra one thousand and eight times everyday without thinking of anything else and devotedly attached to it alone. He attains the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: शुम्भः सह निशुम्भेन प्रापितो मरणं रणे । श्रुतं च महदाख्यानं स्कान्दे स्कन्दसमाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: shumbhaH saha nishumbhena prApito maraNaM raNe | shrutaM cha mahadAkhyAnaM skAnde skandasamAshrayam
verses.translation: He who completes the Japa four hundred thousand times with great devotion, taking food only in the nights with full self-control, is said to be a Paurascaranika.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादयोऽपि लोकानां सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तहेतवः । निग्रहानुग्रहौ प्राप्य शिवस्य वशवर्तिनः
verses.transliteration: brahmAdayo.api lokAnAM sR^iShTisthityantahetavaH | nigrahAnugrahau prApya shivasya vashavartinaH
verses.translation: He shall take bath, sit in a pleasing posture in a sacred spot. He shall meditate on me in his heart along with you and shall remember his preceptor. He shall sit facing the north or the east, observe silence and concentra¬ tion of the mind, purify the five principles by means of Dahana and Plavana rituals. He shall perform the Mantranyasa, make his body worthy and pure, meditate on us restraining Prana and Apana. He shall remember the respective place, form, sage, metre, the presiding deity, BIja, Sakti and the statement. Then he shall perform the Japa of the five-syllab¬ led mantra.

verses.sanskrit: वधार्थे तारकाख्यस्य दैत्येन्द्रस्येन्द्रविद्विषः । ब्रह्मणाभ्यर्थितो देवो मन्दरान्तःपुरं गतः
verses.transliteration: vadhArthe tArakAkhyasya daityendrasyendravidviShaH | brahmaNAbhyarthito devo mandarAntaHpuraM gataH
verses.translation: Experts in the meanings of Agama texts say that the mental Japa is excellent, the Upaihsu Japa (in a low voice) is the middling. The verbal Japa is of the lowest quality.

verses.sanskrit: विहृत्य सुचिरं देव्या विहारातिप्रसङ्गतः । रसां रसातलं नीतामिव कृत्वाभिधां ततः
verses.transliteration: vihR^itya suchiraM devyA vihArAtiprasa~NgataH | rasAM rasAtalaM nItAmiva kR^itvAbhidhAM tataH
verses.translation: The Japa with Rudra as the presiding deity is the most excellent, that with Visnu as the presiding deity is the middling and that with Brahma as the presiding deity is of '■he lowest quality.

verses.sanskrit: देवीं च वञ्चयंस्तस्यां स्ववीर्यमतिदुर्वहम् । अविसृज्य विसृज्याग्नौ हविः पूतमिवामृतम्
verses.transliteration: devIM cha va~nchayaMstasyAM svavIryamatidurvaham | avisR^ijya visR^ijyAgnau haviH pUtamivAmR^itam
verses.translation: 'rhe muttering of the mantra with high, low or middle accentuation, the words and the letters being clear or otherwise, is called the verbal japa.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गादिष्वपि निक्षिप्य वह्निद्वारा तदंशतः । तत्समाहृत्य शनकैस्तोकं स्तोकमितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAdiShvapi nikShipya vahnidvArA tadaMshataH | tatsamAhR^itya shanakaistokaM stokamitastataH
verses.translation: The Japa performed with the pranayama is Sagarbha Japa. In the first and the last even Agarbha Pranayama is commended.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहया कृत्तिकारूपात्स्वभर्त्रा रममाणया । सुवर्णीभूतया न्यस्तं मेरौ शरवणे क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: svAhayA kR^ittikArUpAtsvabhartrA ramamANayA | suvarNIbhUtayA nyastaM merau sharavaNe kvachit
verses.translation: After performing the Pranayama forty times, the intelligent devotee, knowing the meaning of the mantra, shall remember the mantra. If he is unable to repeat so many times he shall repeat as many times as his physical strength permits him.

verses.sanskrit: सन्दीपयित्वा कालेन तस्य भासा दिशो दश । रञ्जयित्वा गिरीन्सर्वान् काञ्चनीकृत्य मेरुणा
verses.transliteration: sandIpayitvA kAlena tasya bhAsA disho dasha | ra~njayitvA girInsarvAn kA~nchanIkR^itya meruNA
verses.translation: He shall perform five, three or one Pranayama

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चिरेण कालेन सञ्जाते तत्र तेजसि । कुमारे सुकुमाराङ्गे कुमाराणां निदर्शने
verses.transliteration: tatashchireNa kAlena sa~njAte tatra tejasi | kumAre sukumArA~Nge kumArANAM nidarshane
verses.translation: A rosary containing thirty beads ol' Rudraksa for Japa bestows wealth, containing twentyseven beads yields nourishment, containing twentyfive beads bestows salvation, containing fifteen beads bestows the fruits of black magic.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छैशवं स्वरूपं च तस्य दृष्ट्वा मनोहरम् । सह देवासुरैर्लोकैर्विस्मिते च विमोहिते
verses.transliteration: tachChaishavaM svarUpaM cha tasya dR^iShTvA manoharam | saha devAsurairlokairvismite cha vimohite
verses.translation: The thumb used in counting the number bestows salvation. The index finger destroys enemies. The middle finger bestows wealth. The ring finger brings about calmness and peace.

verses.sanskrit: देवोऽपि स्वयमायातः पुत्रदर्शनलालसः । सह देव्याङ्कमारोप्य ततोऽस्य स्मेरमाननम्
verses.transliteration: devo.api svayamAyAtaH putradarshanalAlasaH | saha devyA~NkamAropya tato.asya smeramAnanam
verses.translation: If there are hundred and eight beads that rosary is the most excellent. If it has hundred beads it is excellent. If it has fifty beads it is the middling. With fifty- four beads it is good. The Japa shall be performed with these different rosaries. They must not be exhibited to anyone.

verses.sanskrit: पीतामृतमिव स्नेहविवशेनान्तरात्मना । देवेष्वपि च पश्यत्सु वीतरागैस्तपस्विभिः
verses.transliteration: pItAmR^itamiva snehavivashenAntarAtmanA | deveShvapi cha pashyatsu vItarAgaistapasvibhiH
verses.translation: The use of little finger in the Japa shall be avoided. In the act ot Japa it is held to be auspicious. The Japa shall be performed by means of the thumb in contact with other fingers.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः पुनर्न कस्यापि निग्रहानुग्रहास्पदम् । अतोऽनायत्तमैश्वर्यं तस्यैवेति विनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: shivaH punarna kasyApi nigrahAnugrahAspadam | ato.anAyattamaishvaryaM tasyaiveti vinishchitam
verses.translation: They say that the Japa performed in a temple is a crore of times more efficacious. That performed in my presence is infinite number of times more efficacious. Japa in the presence of the sun, fire, preceptor, moon, lamp, water, brahmins and cows is commended. Sitting east of these is conducive to favourable control; south of these is of the same nature as black magic.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्य वक्षःस्थले स्वैरं नर्तयित्वा कुमारकम् । अनुभूय च तत्क्रीडां सम्भाव्य च परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: svasya vakShaHsthale svairaM nartayitvA kumArakam | anubhUya cha tatkrIDAM sambhAvya cha parasparam
verses.translation: West of these is conducive to riches and north of these is peace-bestowing. If Japa is performed in the pre¬ sence of sun, fire, brahmins, gods, preceptors and others one should not turn the face away from them. One should never perform Japa with the turban on, or wearing an armour or a bodice, in the nude, or with the hair dishevelled, or the neck covered, or without the Pavitra in the hand or while impure or while lamenting. While performing Japa the following must be avoided — anger, intoxication sneezing, spitting, yawning and seeing a dog or a lowborn person. If they happen, Acamana shall be performed or I shall be remembered along with you,

verses.sanskrit: स्तन्यमाज्ञापयन्देव्याः पाययित्वामृतोपमम् । तवावतारो जगतां हितायेत्यनुशास्य च
verses.transliteration: stanyamAj~nApayandevyAH pAyayitvAmR^itopamam | tavAvatAro jagatAM hitAyetyanushAsya cha
verses.translation: Or he shall see the luminary bodies or he shall

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं देवश्च देवी च न तृप्तिमुपजग्मतुः । ततः शक्रेण सन्धाय बिभ्यता तारकासुरात्
verses.transliteration: svayaM devashcha devI cha na tR^iptimupajagmatuH | tataH shakreNa sandhAya bibhyatA tArakAsurAt
verses.translation: Doing the duties prescribed by the Vedas, Sastras and the followers of the Vedas is meant by the word good conduct, nothing else.

verses.sanskrit: कारयित्वाऽभिषेकं च सेनापत्ये दिवौकसाम् । पुत्रमन्तरतः कृत्वा देवेन त्रिपुरद्विषः
verses.transliteration: kArayitvA.abhiShekaM cha senApatye divaukasAm | putramantarataH kR^itvA devena tripuradviShaH
verses.translation: O beloved, I shall tell you another secret which shall be guarded well. It shall not be mentioned to any one and every one or to an atheist brute.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयमन्तर्हितेनैव स्कन्दमिन्द्रादिरक्षितम् । तच्छक्त्या क्रौञ्चभेदिन्या युधि कालाग्निकल्पया
verses.transliteration: svayamantarhitenaiva skandamindrAdirakShitam | tachChaktyA krau~nchabhedinyA yudhi kAlAgnikalpayA
verses.translation: O beloved, in the case of this mantra, the auspi¬ cious hour, date, star, day of the week etc. heed not be taken into consideration too much. It is ever wakeful, not slumbering.

verses.sanskrit: छेदितं तारकस्यापि शिरः शक्रभिया सह । स्तुतिं चक्रुर्विशेषेण हरिधातृमुखाः सुराः
verses.transliteration: CheditaM tArakasyApi shiraH shakrabhiyA saha | stutiM chakrurvisheSheNa haridhAtR^imukhAH surAH
verses.translation: If one has faith in me, the mantra and the preceptor, the mantra will undoubtedly be achieved whether it is Asadhita or Sadhita.

verses.sanskrit: तथा रक्षोऽधिपः साक्षाद्रावणो बलगर्वितः । उद्धरन्स्वभुजैर्दीर्घैः कैलासं गिरिमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tathA rakSho.adhipaH sAkShAdrAvaNo balagarvitaH | uddharansvabhujairdIrghaiH kailAsaM girimAtmanaH
verses.translation: Hence a scholarly devotee shall resort to the five- syllabled mantra eschewing other mantras attended with risks in the matter of authorisation.

verses.sanskrit: तदागोऽसहमानस्य देवदेवस्य शूलिनः । पदाङ्गुष्ठपरिस्पन्दान्ममज्ज मृदितो भुवि
verses.transliteration: tadAgo.asahamAnasya devadevasya shUlinaH | padA~NguShThaparispandAnmamajja mR^idito bhuvi
verses.translation: Just as, O goddess, I am not achieved even if the other gods are attained but if I am attained the other gods too are attained so also is the case with the Mantras.

verses.sanskrit: बटोः केनचिदर्थेन स्वाश्रितस्य गतायुषः । त्वरयागत्य देवेन पादान्तं गमितोऽन्तकः
verses.transliteration: baToH kenachidarthena svAshritasya gatAyuShaH | tvarayAgatya devena pAdAntaM gamito.antakaH
verses.translation: Since this mantra functions without reference to castes, the defects found in the other mantras are not found in this mantra.

verses.sanskrit: स्ववाहनमविज्ञाय वृषेन्द्रं वडवानलः । सगलग्रहमानीतस्ततोऽस्त्येकोदकं जगत्
verses.transliteration: svavAhanamavij~nAya vR^iShendraM vaDavAnalaH | sagalagrahamAnItastato.astyekodakaM jagat
verses.translation: Still this mantra shall not be used for the trivial benefits or against insignificant opponents. Then alone this is very efficacious.

verses.sanskrit: यद्येवमीदृशैश्वर्यं तत्तु स्वातन्त्र्यलक्षणम् । स्वभावसिद्धं चैतस्य मूर्तिमत्तास्पदं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yadyevamIdR^ishaishvaryaM tattu svAtantryalakShaNam | svabhAvasiddhaM chaitasya mUrtimattAspadaM bhavet
verses.translation: Thus the mode of repeating this mantra of five syllables was explained to the goddess by lord Siva himself for the benefit of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अलोकविदितैस्तैस्तैर्वृत्तैरानन्दसुन्दरैः । अङ्गहारक्रमेणेदमसकृच्चालितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: alokaviditaistaistairvR^ittairAnandasundaraiH | a~NgahArakrameNedamasakR^ichchAlitaM jagat
verses.translation: He who glorifies this with devotion or listens to it with a pious mind is liberated from all sins and attains the gpreatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: शान्त एव सदा सर्वमनुगृह्णाति चेच्छिवः । सर्वाणि पूरयेदेव कथं शक्तेन मोचयेत्
verses.transliteration: shAnta eva sadA sarvamanugR^ihNAti chechChivaH | sarvANi pUrayedeva kathaM shaktena mochayet
verses.translation: O holy lord, the greatness of the mantra has been mentioned by you as well as the rules governing its practice as found in the Sruti itself. Now I wish to hear the details of Sivasarhskara. While explaining the mode of accepting the mantra it has been slightly indicated.

verses.sanskrit: अनादिकर्मवैचित्र्यमपि नात्र नियामकम् । कारणं खलु कर्मापि भवेदीश्वरकारितम्
verses.transliteration: anAdikarmavaichitryamapi nAtra niyAmakam | kAraNaM khalu karmApi bhavedIshvarakAritam
verses.translation: Well, I shall mention to you the holy and sin-des¬ troying details of consecration as explained by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन नास्तिक्यं हेतुकारकम् । यथा ह्याशु निवर्तेत तथा कथय मारुत
verses.transliteration: kimatra bahunoktena nAstikyaM hetukArakam | yathA hyAshu nivarteta tathA kathaya mAruta
verses.translation: The initiation as ordained by Siva the great Atman in the Sivagama is threefold — pertaining to liva, Sakti and mantra.

verses.sanskrit: न मूर्तिश्च स्वतन्त्रस्य घटते मूलहेतुना । मूर्तेरपि च कार्यत्वात्तत्सिद्धिः स्यादहैतुकी
verses.transliteration: na mUrtishcha svatantrasya ghaTate mUlahetunA | mUrterapi cha kAryatvAttatsiddhiH syAdahaitukI
verses.translation: The initiation of Siva is that whereby at the mere sight, touch and talk of the preceptor the individual soul gains immediately the consciousness quelling the bondage. It is twofold in view of the difference in the destruction of bondage, viz. acute and more acute.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र परमो भावोऽपरमश्चान्य उच्यते । परमापरमौ भावौ कथमेकत्र सङ्गतौ
verses.transliteration: sarvatra paramo bhAvo.aparamashchAnya uchyate | paramAparamau bhAvau kathamekatra sa~Ngatau
verses.translation: The Sakti form of initiation coupled with know¬ ledge is performed by the preceptor with knowledge for his vision, after entering the body of the disciple along the path of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: निष्फलो हि स्वभावोऽस्य परमः परमात्मनः । स एव सकलः कस्मात्स्वभावो ह्यविपर्ययः
verses.transliteration: niShphalo hi svabhAvo.asya paramaH paramAtmanaH | sa eva sakalaH kasmAtsvabhAvo hyaviparyayaH
verses.translation: The disciple receives blessing in respect of his lakti,* because the pursuit of Saivite virtue has that as the condition in brief.

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावो विपरीतश्चेत्स्वतन्त्रः स्वेच्छया यदि । न करोति किमीशानो नित्यानित्यविपर्ययम्
verses.transliteration: svabhAvo viparItashchetsvatantraH svechChayA yadi | na karoti kimIshAno nityAnityaviparyayam
verses.translation: Hence, observing the symbols for securing Sakti, the preceptor shall purify and consecrate the disciple either by knowledge or by means of rites.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The disciple too shall carry out the test of the preceptor through these characteristic symbols and contacts with him during the worship of Siva or through those associated with him or resorting to him.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The disciple too shall carry out the test of the preceptor through these characteristic symbols and contacts with him during the worship of Siva or through those associated with him or resorting to him.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३१. एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । ज्ञानोपदेशः । वायुरुवाच । स्थने संशयितं विप्रा भवद्भिर्हेतुचोदितैः । जिज्ञासा हि न नास्तिक्यं साधयेत्साधुबुद्धिषु
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.31\. ekatriMsho.adhyAyaH | j~nAnopadeshaH | vAyuruvAcha | sthane saMshayitaM viprA bhavadbhirhetuchoditaiH | jij~nAsA hi na nAstikyaM sAdhayetsAdhubuddhiShu
verses.translation: The test for the disciple has in view his worthiness of being taught and for the preceptor the gravity of his pursuit. Hence the disciple shall endeavour in every respect to honour the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: येनोपलभ्यतेऽस्माभिः सकलेनापि निष्कलः । स मूर्त्यात्मा शिवः शैवमूर्तिरित्युपचर्यते
verses.transliteration: yenopalabhyate.asmAbhiH sakalenApi niShkalaH | sa mUrtyAtmA shivaH shaivamUrtirityupacharyate
verses.translation: The Saktipata doctrine of the iSaivas is concerned with the recep¬ tivity of the disciple or the communicability of the preceptor in receiving or imparting instructions in the principles oi aiva cult.

verses.sanskrit: नापरोक्षादृते मोक्ष इति कृत्वा विनिश्चयम् । श्रेष्ठानुष्ठानसिद्ध्यर्थं प्रयतध्वमतन्द्रिताः
verses.transliteration: nAparokShAdR^ite mokSha iti kR^itvA vinishchayam | shreShThAnuShThAnasiddhyarthaM prayatadhvamatandritAH
verses.translation: The seeker of welfare shall never even think of transgressing the commands of the preceptor, because only he who carries out the behests of the preceptor attains the wealth of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: न ह्यसौ निष्कलः साक्षाच्छिवः परमकारणम् । साकारेणानुभावेन केनाप्यनुपलक्षितः
verses.transliteration: na hyasau niShkalaH sAkShAchChivaH paramakAraNam | sAkAreNAnubhAvena kenApyanupalakShitaH
verses.translation: He shall not do any thing without the permission of the preceptor, nor even walk, stand, sleep or eat. Espe¬ cially if the work is performed in the presence of the precep¬ tor it must ncce.ssarily be with his permission.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमाणगम्यतामात्रं तत्स्वभावोपपादकम् । न तावतात्रोपेक्षाधीरुपलक्षणमन्तरा
verses.transliteration: pramANagamyatAmAtraM tatsvabhAvopapAdakam | na tAvatAtropekShAdhIrupalakShaNamantarA
verses.translation: He becomes a fallen man due to his sins as due to the contact with the sinners. As the price of gold sheds off its impurities when put in fire so also the disciple sheds off his sins due to the contact with the preceptor. As the ghee melts when kept near the fire, so also the sin melts in the presence of the preceptor. As the blazing fire burns the twig whether dry or damp, so also the delighted preceptor burns off his sins.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मोपमोल्बणं साक्षान्मूर्तिरेव हि काचन । शिवस्य मूर्तिर्मूर्त्यात्मा परस्तस्योपलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: AtmopamolbaNaM sAkShAnmUrtireva hi kAchana | shivasya mUrtirmUrtyAtmA parastasyopalakShaNam
verses.translation: The disciple shall never incite the anger of the preceptor mentally, verbally or physically. Due to his anger the longevity, prosperity, knowledge and sacred rites all these are burnt. The sacrifices of those who incite his anger are futile as also their restraints and observances. No doubt need be entertained in this respect. No man* shall ever make any statement against the preceptor. If out of delusion he were to make such statements he will fall into the Raurava hell.

verses.sanskrit: यथा काष्ठेष्वनारूढो न वह्निरुपलभ्यते । एवं शिवोऽपि मूर्त्यात्मन्यनारूढ इति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: yathA kAShTheShvanArUDho na vahnirupalabhyate | evaM shivo.api mUrtyAtmanyanArUDha iti sthitiH
verses.translation: If the man is intelligent and seeks welfare he shall not act falsely to the preceptor mentally, verbally or

verses.sanskrit: यथाग्निमानयेत्युक्ते ज्वलत्काष्ठादृते स्वयम् । नाग्निरानीयते तद्वत्पूज्यो मूर्त्यात्मना शिवः
verses.transliteration: yathAgnimAnayetyukte jvalatkAShThAdR^ite svayam | nAgnirAnIyate tadvatpUjyo mUrtyAtmanA shivaH
verses.translation: Two boats can carry each other across the river. A piece of rock cannot take another piece of rock across the river. If the preceptor is nominal, the liberation too is nominal.

verses.sanskrit: अत एव हि पूजादौ मूर्त्यात्मपरिकल्पनम् । मूर्त्यात्मनि कृतं साक्षाच्छिव एव कृतं यतः
verses.transliteration: ata eva hi pUjAdau mUrtyAtmaparikalpanam | mUrtyAtmani kR^itaM sAkShAchChiva eva kR^itaM yataH
verses.translation: One devoid of principles is inefficient though he may know all means and rules of procedure. The greatest bliss is generated by the sight of the preceptor whose intellect extending upto personal realisation functions in the principle. Hence an intelligent person shall choose one as his preceptor who can impart enlightenment and bliss.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गादावपि तत्कृत्यमर्चायां च विशेषतः । तत्तन्मूर्त्यात्मभावेन शिवोऽस्माभिरुपास्यते
verses.transliteration: li~NgAdAvapi tatkR^ityamarchAyAM cha visheShataH | tattanmUrtyAtmabhAvena shivo.asmAbhirupAsyate
verses.translation: The right preceptor shall be.served by the disciples who desire salvation and who are expert in humble conduct to that end. When reali.sation dawns upon him he shall abide in him with stable devotion. He shall never eschew the principles nor neglect them. If neither enlighten¬ ment nor bli.ss is obtained by the disciple even after a year, even slightly, the disciple shall resort to another preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: यथानुगृह्यते सोऽपि मूर्त्यात्मा पारमेष्ठिना । तथा मूर्त्यात्मनिष्ठेन शिवेन पशवो वयम्
verses.transliteration: yathAnugR^ihyate so.api mUrtyAtmA pArameShThinA | tathA mUrtyAtmaniShThena shivena pashavo vayam
verses.translation: Even though he may resort to another preceptor

verses.sanskrit: लोकानुग्रहणायैव शिवेन परमेष्ठिना । सदाशिवादयः सर्वे मूर्त्यात्मनोऽप्यधिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: lokAnugrahaNAyaiva shivena parameShThinA | sadAshivAdayaH sarve mUrtyAtmano.apyadhiShThitAH
verses.translation: Having at the outset approached the brahmin preceptor who has mastered the Vedas, who is intelligent, handsome, of pleasant sight, the bestower of protection and merciful, he shall propitiate him and endeavour to delight him mentally, verbally and physically.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमणमत्र वक्ष्यामि सतां मोहनिवर्तकम् । असतां त्वन्यथाभावः प्रसादेन विना प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: pramaNamatra vakShyAmi satAM mohanivartakam | asatAM tvanyathAbhAvaH prasAdena vinA prabhoH
verses.translation: He shall continue to propitiate him till he is pleased. If the preceptor is pleased the sins of the disciple are immediately quelled.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनामेव भोगाय मोक्षाय च विशेषतः । तत्त्वातत्त्वस्वरूपेषु मूर्त्यात्मसु शिवान्वयः
verses.transliteration: AtmanAmeva bhogAya mokShAya cha visheShataH | tattvAtattvasvarUpeShu mUrtyAtmasu shivAnvayaH
verses.translation: Hence he shall give the preceptor coins, gems fields, houses, ornaments, garments, vehicles, beds, seats etc. in accordance with his wealth and resources. If he wishes for the great goal he shall not be stringent with regard to wealth.

verses.sanskrit: भोगः कर्मविपाकात्मा सुखदुःखात्मको मतः । न च कर्म शिवेऽस्तीति तस्य भोगः किमात्मकः
verses.transliteration: bhogaH karmavipAkAtmA sukhaduHkhAtmako mataH | na cha karma shive.astIti tasya bhogaH kimAtmakaH
verses.translation: After offering these, he shall dedicate to him, himself, his family and all his possessions along with water and remain subservient to him for ever.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं शिवोऽनुगृह्णाति न निगृह्णाति किञ्चन । निगृह्णतां तु ये दोषाश्शिवे तेषामसम्भवात्
verses.transliteration: sarvaM shivo.anugR^ihNAti na nigR^ihNAti ki~nchana | nigR^ihNatAM tu ye doShAshshive teShAmasambhavAt
verses.translation: Since he has offered himself to Siva as his devotee he shall ever remain so. He will have no rebirth thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनर्निग्रहाः केचिद् ब्रह्मादिषु निदर्शिताः । तेऽपि लोकहितायैव कृताः श्रीकण्ठमूर्तिना
verses.transliteration: ye punarnigrahAH kechid brahmAdiShu nidarshitAH | te.api lokahitAyaiva kR^itAH shrIkaNThamUrtinA
verses.translation: The teacher shall test the brahmin disciple for a year, the ksatriya for two years and the vaiya for three years.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डस्याधिपत्यं हि श्रीकण्ठस्य न संशयः । श्रीकण्ठाख्यां शिवो मूर्तिं क्रीडतीमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: brahmANDasyAdhipatyaM hi shrIkaNThasya na saMshayaH | shrIkaNThAkhyAM shivo mUrtiM krIDatImadhitiShThati
verses.translation: He shall test the disciples, with commands to give up life and wealth or by engaging the superior devotees in mean tasks and the inferior ones in noble tasks.

verses.sanskrit: सदोषा एव देवाद्या निगृहीता यथोदितम् । ततस्तेऽपि विपाप्मानः प्रजाश्चापि गतज्वराः
verses.transliteration: sadoShA eva devAdyA nigR^ihItA yathoditam | tataste.api vipApmAnaH prajAshchApi gatajvarAH
verses.translation: Even when rebuked or beaten if they do not feel distressed they shall be considered self-controlled and pure and hence deserving consecration in Saiva rituals.

verses.sanskrit: निग्रहोऽपि स्वरूपेण विदुषां न जुगुप्सितः । अत एव हि दण्ड्येषु दण्डो राज्ञां प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: nigraho.api svarUpeNa viduShAM na jugupsitaH | ata eva hi daNDyeShu daNDo rAj~nAM prashasyate
verses.translation: The decision of the sacred texts is this that brahmin devotees with -the following 'qualifications shall be consecrated properly and enlightened. They shall be non¬ violent, merciful, ever active and alert in mind, free from arrogance, intelligent, devoid of rivalry sweet-tongued, straightforward, soft-hearted, pure, humble, steady, endowed with purity of conduct, and well-behaved in every respect.

verses.sanskrit: यत्सिद्धिरीश्वरत्वेन कार्यवर्गस्य कृत्स्नशः । न स चेदीशतां कुर्याज्जगतः कथमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yatsiddhirIshvaratvena kAryavargasya kR^itsnashaH | na sa chedIshatAM kuryAjjagataH kathamIshvaraH
verses.translation: Women by themselves are not authorised in Saivite consecration. If they are devoted to the lord they can be consecrated at the instance of their husbands.

verses.sanskrit: ईशेच्छा च विधातृत्वं विधेराज्ञापनं परम् । आज्ञावश्यमिदं कुर्यान्न कुर्यादिति शासनम्
verses.transliteration: IshechChA cha vidhAtR^itvaM vidherAj~nApanaM param | Aj~nAvashyamidaM kuryAnna kuryAditi shAsanam
verses.translation: A widow can be consecrated with the permission of her sons; a virgin with the permission of her father. The purificatory rite for the pathways is not prescribed for Sudra men, particularly the fallen ones and the intercastes. If they have pious feelings for Siva, the purification of sins shall be performed by administering holy washings of his feet.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छासनानुवर्तित्वं साधुभावस्य लक्षणम् । विपरीतमसाधोः स्यान्न सर्वं तत्तु दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: tachChAsanAnuvartitvaM sAdhubhAvasya lakShaNam | viparItamasAdhoH syAnna sarvaM tattu dR^ishyate
verses.translation: The consccratory rite for people born of Anuloma marriage shall be performed in the manner custo- maiy to the family of the mother. The girl who is authorised in Saivite rites by her father shall be given in marriage only to a devotee of Siva and not to a non-devotee. If inadverten¬ tly she is given in marriage to a non-devotee she shall try to convince her husband about the Saivite faith. If she is unable to do so she shall leave him off and perform holy rites mentally.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य परिपूर्णस्य परानुग्रहमन्तरा । न किञ्चिदपि कर्तव्यमिति साधु विनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: shivasya paripUrNasya parAnugrahamantarA | na ki~nchidapi kartavyamiti sAdhu vinishchitam
verses.translation: The chaste lady Anasuya abandoned her hus¬ band Atri the excellent sage and propitiated Siva by penance; Draupad! who was not engaged in holy rites of the elders propitiated Narayana by penance and attained the Pantavas as her husbands. In view of the weightiness of Siva's behest, the woman engaged in Saivite virtue does not incur sin as she has no choice of freedom.

verses.sanskrit: साधु संरक्षणीयं चेद्विनिवर्त्यमसाधु यत् । निवर्तते च सामादेरन्ते दण्डो हि साधनम्
verses.transliteration: sAdhu saMrakShaNIyaM chedvinivartyamasAdhu yat | nivartate cha sAmAderante daNDo hi sAdhanam
verses.translation: Of what avail is much talk? Whoever solely resorts to Siva shall be purified if he is subservient to the preceptor. The rite of consecration does not differ. He who develops consciousness by the mere sight, touch or talk of the preceptor is not faced with failure.

verses.sanskrit: हितार्थलक्षणं चेदं दण्डान्तमनुशासनम् । अतो यद्विपरीतं तदहितं सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: hitArthalakShaNaM chedaM daNDAntamanushAsanam | ato yadviparItaM tadahitaM samprachakShate
verses.translation: The mental consccratory rite which is perfor¬ med along the path of Yoga is not mentioned here. It is a great secret and shall be known straight from the mouth of the preceptor. The consccratory rite with holy rites shall now be mentioned briefly. Its detailed explanation is not possible.

verses.sanskrit: हिते सदा निषण्णानामीश्वरस्य निदर्शनम् । स कथं दुष्यते सद्भिरसतामेव निग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: hite sadA niShaNNAnAmIshvarasya nidarshanam | sa kathaM duShyate sadbhirasatAmeva nigrahAt
verses.translation: On an auspicious day, in a pure spot devoid of major defects, the preceptor shall at the outset perform the consecration *Samaya.*

verses.sanskrit: अयुक्तकारिणो लोके गर्हणीया विवेकिता । यदुद्वेजयते लोकं तदयुक्तं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: ayuktakAriNo loke garhaNIyA vivekitA | yadudvejayate lokaM tadayuktaM prachakShate
verses.translation: After testing the ground duly by way of smell, colour, taste etc., he shall cause a platform to be constructed along the path mentioned in the science of architecture.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोऽपि निग्रहो लोके न च विद्वेषपूर्वकः । न हि द्वेष्टि पिता पुत्रं यो निगृह्याति शिक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvo.api nigraho loke na cha vidveShapUrvakaH | na hi dveShTi pitA putraM yo nigR^ihyAti shikShayet
verses.translation: After making the altar, he shall make eight pits in the eight quarters making the chief one in the north-east. It may also be in the west when only the important pit need be dug. It shall be beautified by smearing it with powder.

verses.sanskrit: माध्यस्थेनापि निग्राह्यान्यो निगृह्णाति मार्गतः । तस्याप्यवश्यं यत्किञ्चिन्नैर्घृण्यमनुवर्तते
verses.transliteration: mAdhyasthenApi nigrAhyAnyo nigR^ihNAti mArgataH | tasyApyavashyaM yatki~nchinnairghR^iNyamanuvartate
verses.translation: It shall be decorated with garlands, festoons, banners and canopy. In the middle of the altar a mystic diagram shall be drawn. It shall have auspicious characteristics.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा न हिनस्त्येव सदोषानप्यसौ परान् । हिनस्ति चायमप्यज्ञान्परं माध्यस्थ्यमाचरन्
verses.transliteration: anyathA na hinastyeva sadoShAnapyasau parAn | hinasti chAyamapyaj~nAnparaM mAdhyasthyamAcharan
verses.translation: The powder used for the mystic diagram shall be gold dust mixed with saffron so as to befit for the invoca¬ tion of the lord. If the devotee is poor he can use the powdered Nivara grain mixed with saffron.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्दुःखात्मिकां हिंसां कुर्वाणो यः स निर्घृणः । इति निर्बन्धयन्त्येके नियमो नेति चापरे
verses.transliteration: tasmAdduHkhAtmikAM hiMsAM kurvANo yaH sa nirghR^iNaH | iti nirbandhayantyeke niyamo neti chApare
verses.translation: The width of the mystic lotus diagram may be one hand or two hands. It may be white or red in colour. The pericarp of the lotus of a hand's width shall be eight angulas.

verses.sanskrit: निदानज्ञस्य भिषजो रुग्णे हिंसां प्रयुञ्जतः । न किञ्चिदपि नैर्घृण्यं घृणैवात्र प्रयोजिका
verses.transliteration: nidAnaj~nasya bhiShajo rugNe hiMsAM prayu~njataH | na ki~nchidapi nairghR^iNyaM ghR^iNaivAtra prayojikA
verses.translation: The filaments shall be half that length. The rem¬ aining portion is occupied by the eight petals. If the width of the lotus is two hands, the measurements will be doubled.

verses.sanskrit: घृणापि न गुणायैव हिंस्रेषु प्रतियोगिषु । तादृशेषु घृणी भ्रान्त्या घृणान्तरितनिर्घृणः
verses.transliteration: ghR^iNApi na guNAyaiva hiMsreShu pratiyogiShu | tAdR^isheShu ghR^iNI bhrAntyA ghR^iNAntaritanirghR^iNaH
verses.translation: Another diagram shall be made on the altar one hand in width or half of it, to the north-east of the previous one and decorated well.

verses.sanskrit: स्वभाव एव पर्याप्तः परानुग्रहकर्मणि । अन्यथा निःस्वभावेन न किमप्यनुगृह्यते
verses.transliteration: svabhAva eva paryAptaH parAnugrahakarmaNi | anyathA niHsvabhAvena na kimapyanugR^ihyate
verses.translation: Paddy or rice grains mixed 'with gingelly seeds and flowers shall be strewn on it and covered with Darbha grass. The water-jar with the necessary characteristics shall be placed thereon.

verses.sanskrit: उपेक्षापीह दोषाय रक्ष्येषु प्रतियोगिषु । शक्तौ सत्यामुपेक्षातो रक्ष्यः सद्यो विपद्यते
verses.transliteration: upekShApIha doShAya rakShyeShu pratiyogiShu | shaktau satyAmupekShAto rakShyaH sadyo vipadyate
verses.translation: The water-jar shall be made of gold, silver or copper or it may be earthen. It shall contain scents,flower$.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पस्यास्यगतं पश्यन् यस्तु रक्ष्यमुपेक्षते । दोषाभासान्समुत्प्रेक्ष्य फलतः सोऽपि निर्घृणः
verses.transliteration: sarpasyAsyagataM pashyan yastu rakShyamupekShate | doShAbhAsAnsamutprekShya phalataH so.api nirghR^iNaH
verses.translation: The vessels Bhrngara and Vardhani as well as Sankha and Cakra shall also be put. Except the thread the other thing may consist of lotus petals and leaves. On the northern petal of the lotus conceived as seat shall be placed the Vardhani of the Astraraja (?) with sandal paste and water.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् घृणा गुणायैव सर्वथेति न सम्मतम् । सम्मतं प्राप्तकामित्वं सर्वं त्वन्यदसम्मतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAd ghR^iNA guNAyaiva sarvatheti na sammatam | sammataM prAptakAmitvaM sarvaM tvanyadasammatam
verses.translation: To the east of the diagram the great worship of the lord shall start on the consecrated jar.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्त्यात्मस्वपि रागाद्या दोषाः सन्त्येव वस्तुतः । तथापि तेषामेवैते न शिवस्य तु सर्वथा
verses.transliteration: mUrtyAtmasvapi rAgAdyA doShAH santyeva vastutaH | tathApi teShAmevaite na shivasya tu sarvathA
verses.translation: What has been mentioned before can be per¬ formed on the seashore, or river-bank, or in the cowpen or on a mountain, or in a temple or in the house or in any other charming place, except the platform. After making the diagram as before and the raised ground for fire the preceptor shall enter the worship chamber with a delighted face. He shall invoke all auspicious things about him. He shall have completed all the daily rites. He shall perform the great worship in the middle of the mystical diagram. He shall invoke Siva again in the water-jar and worship.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नावपि समाविष्टं ताम्रं खलु सकालिकम् । इति नाग्निरसौ दुष्येत्ताम्रसंसर्गकारणात्
verses.transliteration: agnAvapi samAviShTaM tAmraM khalu sakAlikam | iti nAgnirasau duShyettAmrasaMsargakAraNAt
verses.translation: He shall meditate upon the lord the protector of sacrifice facing the west. In the vessel Astravardhani he shall worship the weapon of the lord on 'he south. He shall place the Mantra in the Mantra vessel. Expert in the mantras he shall exhibit the mystic gestures and begin the sacrifice with the mantra.

verses.sanskrit: नाग्नेरशुचिसंसर्गादशुचित्वमपेक्षते । अशुचेस्त्वग्निसंयोगाच्छुचित्वमपि जायते
verses.transliteration: nAgnerashuchisaMsargAdashuchitvamapekShate | ashuchestvagnisaMyogAchChuchitvamapi jAyate
verses.translation: The excellent preceptor shall perform the sacrifice in the sacred fire in the main pit. The other brahmins shall perform the sacrifice all round in the other pits.

verses.sanskrit: एवं शोध्यात्मसंसर्गान्न ह्यशुद्धः शिवो भवेत् । शिवसंसर्गतस्त्वेष शोध्यात्मैव हि शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: evaM shodhyAtmasaMsargAnna hyashuddhaH shivo bhavet | shivasaMsargatastveSha shodhyAtmaiva hi shuddhyati
verses.translation: The excellent preceptor shall perform the sacrifice only in the main pit. The number of sacrifices nlade by the others is half or one fourth of those of the chief priest.

verses.sanskrit: अयस्यग्नौ समाविष्टे दाहोऽग्नेरेव नायसः । मूर्त्तात्मन्येवमैश्वर्यमीश्वरस्यैव नात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: ayasyagnau samAviShTe dAho.agnereva nAyasaH | mUrttAtmanyevamaishvaryamIshvarasyaiva nAtmanAm
verses.translation: Some shall recite the Vedic mantras or auspicious hymns. Some shall perform the Japa duly.

verses.sanskrit: न हि काष्ठं ज्वलत्यूर्ध्वमग्निरेव ज्वलत्यसौ । काष्ठस्याङ्गारता नाग्नेरेवमत्रापि योज्यताम् । अत एव जगत्यस्मिन्काष्ठपाषाणमृत्स्वपि
verses.transliteration: na hi kAShThaM jvalatyUrdhvamagnireva jvalatyasau | kAShThasyA~NgAratA nAgnerevamatrApi yojyatAm | ata eva jagatyasminkAShThapAShANamR^itsvapi
verses.translation: Dance, music, instrumental as well as vocal, and other auspicious conventional rites shall be performed.

verses.sanskrit: शिवावेशवशादेव शिवत्वमुपचर्यते । मैत्र्यादयो गुणा गौणास्तस्मात्ते भिन्नवृत्तयः । तैर्गुणैरुपरक्तानां दोषाय च गुणाय च
verses.transliteration: shivAveshavashAdeva shivatvamupacharyate | maitryAdayo guNA gauNAstasmAtte bhinnavR^ittayaH | tairguNairuparaktAnAM doShAya cha guNAya cha
verses.translation: 'O lord of the chief of gods be pleased. O lord, ocean of mercy, please enter my body mercifully and release me from the bondage*.

verses.sanskrit: परं सर्वमनुग्राह्यं पशुपाशात्मकं जगत् । परस्यानुग्रहार्थं तु पत्युराज्ञासमन्वयः
verses.transliteration: paraM sarvamanugrAhyaM pashupAshAtmakaM jagat | parasyAnugrahArthaM tu patyurAj~nAsamanvayaH
verses.translation: The preceptor shall perform the Sarhkalp 'I shall do thus' and with the formal permission, he shall bring the disciple who had been observing fast taking only Havi$ya once and who had taken bath and performed daily rites. The disciple shall continue the Japa of Pranava and meditate on the lord. Auspicious rites shall then be perfor¬ med for him. In the Mandala in front of the western or the southern door he shall be made to sit on the Darbha grass. The disciple shall sit facing the north.

verses.sanskrit: यत्तु गौणमगौणं च तत्सर्वमनुगृह्णतः । न गुणाय न दोषाय शिवस्य गुणवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: yattu gauNamagauNaM cha tatsarvamanugR^ihNataH | na guNAya na doShAya shivasya guNavR^ittayaH
verses.translation: The preceptor shall stand facing the cast and sprinkle the water from the vessel Proksani, on his haed as the disciple sits straight with palms joined in reverence. He shall lightly touch with flowers the eyes of the disciple and bind them with a strip of new silk cloth repeating the mantras.

verses.sanskrit: न चानुग्रहशब्दार्थं गौणमाहुर्विपश्चितः । संसारमोचनं किं तु शैवमाज्ञामयं हितम्
verses.transliteration: na chAnugrahashabdArthaM gauNamAhurvipashchitaH | saMsAramochanaM kiM tu shaivamAj~nAmayaM hitam
verses.translation: Then he shall make the disciple enter the Manapa through the door and circumambulate thrice.

verses.sanskrit: हितं तदाज्ञाकरणं यद्धितं तदनुग्रहः । सर्वं हिते नियुञ्जानः सर्वानुग्रहकारकः
verses.transliteration: hitaM tadAj~nAkaraNaM yaddhitaM tadanugrahaH | sarvaM hite niyu~njAnaH sarvAnugrahakArakaH
verses.translation: Then after offering a handful of flowers with a piece of gold to the lord he shall prostrate on the ground facing the cast or the north.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तूपकारशब्दार्थस्तमप्याहुरनुग्रहम् । तस्यापि हितरूपत्वाच्छिवः सर्वोपकारकः
verses.transliteration: yastUpakArashabdArthastamapyAhuranugraham | tasyApi hitarUpatvAchChivaH sarvopakArakaH
verses.translation: Then as before, the preceptor shall sprinkle the water on his head and strew flowers. The bandage around his eyes shall be removed.

verses.sanskrit: हिते सदा नियुक्तं तु सर्वं चिदचिदात्मकम् । स्वभावप्रतिबन्धं तत्समं न लभते हितम्
verses.transliteration: hite sadA niyuktaM tu sarvaM chidachidAtmakam | svabhAvapratibandhaM tatsamaM na labhate hitam
verses.translation: After seeing the Mandala, he shall bow to the lord again with palms joined in reverence. The preceptor shall make the disciple sit to the south of the Mandala and to his left on a Darbha grass seat. After propitiating the lord, the preceptor shall place his auspicious hand over his head.

verses.sanskrit: यथा विकासयत्येव रविः पद्मानि भानुभिः । समं न विकसन्त्येव स्वस्वभावानुरोधतः
verses.transliteration: yathA vikAsayatyeva raviH padmAni bhAnubhiH | samaM na vikasantyeva svasvabhAvAnurodhataH
verses.translation: Uttering the mantra of Siva, the preceptor, identical with iSiva, shall place his hand refulgent with l§aivite splendour, on the head of the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावोऽपि हि भावानां भाविनोऽर्थस्य कारणम् । न हि स्वभावो नश्यन्तमर्थं कर्तृषु साधयेत्
verses.transliteration: svabhAvo.api hi bhAvAnAM bhAvino.arthasya kAraNam | na hi svabhAvo nashyantamarthaM kartR^iShu sAdhayet
verses.translation: With the same hand the preceptor shall touch

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णमेव नाङ्गारं द्रावयत्यग्निसङ्गमः । एवं पक्वमलानेव मोचयेन्न शिवः परान्
verses.transliteration: suvarNameva nA~NgAraM drAvayatyagnisa~NgamaH | evaM pakvamalAneva mochayenna shivaH parAn
verses.translation: He shall worship the lord duly and perform three Ahutis. He shall sit as before. The preceptor shall touch the disciple with the tips of the Darbha grass. By means of his Vidya he shall enter the Atman. After bowing to the lord he shall perform the rite of Nadisandhan?.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यथा भवितुं योग्यं तत्तथा न भवेत्स्वयम् । विना भावनया कर्ता स्वतन्त्रः सन्ततो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yadyathA bhavituM yogyaM tattathA na bhavetsvayam | vinA bhAvanayA kartA svatantraH santato bhavet
verses.translation: He shall perform the rite of Prananirgama as mentioned in Siva Sastras. Remembering the mystical entry into the body of the disciple he shall perform the Tarpana rite with the mantras. For the Tarpana he shall offer thrice the ten Ahutis with the ancillary mantras. After offering the Purnahuti, the expert preceptor shall offer again ten Ahutis repeating the Mulamantra, by way of expiation.

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावविमलो यद्वत्सर्वानुग्राहकः शिवः । स्वभावमलिनास्तद्वदात्मनो जीवसंज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: svabhAvavimalo yadvatsarvAnugrAhakaH shivaH | svabhAvamalinAstadvadAtmano jIvasa.nj~nitAH
verses.translation: Worshipping the lord of the gods again and per¬ forming the Acamana the preceptor shall perform Homa duly and uplift the disciple from his caste. If he is a vaiya he is first lifted into a katriya. Then performing these rites the preceptor shall lift him into a brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: पतिराज्ञापकः सर्वमनुगृह्णाति सर्वदा । तदर्थमर्थस्वीकारे परतन्त्रः कथं शिवः
verses.transliteration: patirAj~nApakaH sarvamanugR^ihNAti sarvadA | tadarthamarthasvIkAre paratantraH kathaM shivaH
verses.translation: After sprinkling and striking lightly the disciple and remembering the Atman of the disciple in his own, the preceptor shall drain out the wind that throbs like a flame, through the veins as mentioned. He shall then enter the vein and the heart of the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा संसरन्त्येते नियमान्न शिवः कथम् । कर्ममायानुबन्धोऽस्य संसारः कथ्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration: anyathA saMsarantyete niyamAnna shivaH katham | karmamAyAnubandho.asya saMsAraH kathyate budhaiH
verses.translation: After entering his consciousness that appears to him like a blue spot he shall meditate on it as blazing with its brilliance free from dirt.

verses.sanskrit: अनुबन्धोऽयमस्यैव न शिवस्येति हेतुमान् । स हेतुरात्मनामेव निजो नागन्तुको मलः
verses.transliteration: anubandho.ayamasyaiva na shivasyeti hetumAn | sa heturAtmanAmeva nijo nAgantuko malaH
verses.translation: After breathing in the vein repeating the mantra and showing the Saihhara mudra ( the gesture of annihilation ) he shall refill it with Puraka for uniting the Atmans. Now ' taking it again with Kumbhaka as with Recaka before, he shall place it in the heart of the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: आगन्तुकत्वे कस्यापि भाव्यं केनापि हेतुना । योऽयं हेतुरसावेकस्त्वविचित्रस्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: Agantukatve kasyApi bhAvyaM kenApi hetunA | yo.ayaM heturasAvekastvavichitrasvabhAvataH
verses.translation: After touching him and giving him the sacred thread secured from Siva he shall offer three Ahutis and the Purnahuti thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मतायाः समत्वेऽपि बद्धा मुक्ताः परे यतः । बद्धेष्वेव पुनः केचिल्लयभोगाधिकारतः
verses.transliteration: AtmatAyAH samatve.api baddhA muktAH pare yataH | baddheShveva punaH kechillayabhogAdhikArataH
verses.translation: Wiping off the water over his body and wearing a white cloth, he shall perform the Acamana. Fully bedecked he shall go to the Mandapa with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानैश्वर्यादिवैषम्यं भजन्ते सोत्तराधराः । केचिन्मूर्त्यात्मतां यान्ति केचिदासन्नगोचराः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnaishvaryAdivaiShamyaM bhajante sottarAdharAH | kechinmUrtyAtmatAM yAnti kechidAsannagocharAH
verses.translation: He shall make him sit as before on the Kua seat and worship the lord in the Mandala. He shall perform the Karanyasa rite.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्त्यात्मसु शिवाः केचिदध्वनां मूर्द्धसु स्थिताः । मध्ये महेश्वरा रुद्रास्त्वर्वाचीनपदे स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: mUrtyAtmasu shivAH kechidadhvanAM mUrddhasu sthitAH | madhye maheshvarA rudrAstvarvAchInapade sthitAH
verses.translation: Meditating on the lord he shall take Bhasma in both the hands and smear it over the body of the disciple repeating Siva's names.

verses.sanskrit: आसन्नेऽपि च मायायाः परस्मात्कारणात्त्रयम् । तत्राप्यात्मा स्थितोऽधस्तादन्तरात्मा च मध्यतः
verses.transliteration: Asanne.api cha mAyAyAH parasmAtkAraNAttrayam | tatrApyAtmA sthito.adhastAdantarAtmA cha madhyataH
verses.translation: He shall then perform the rites of Dahana and Plavana and conclude with the rite of Matrkanyasa. Medi¬ tating on Siva's seat and invoking him on the head of the disciple he shall mentally worship him in the prescribed manner.

verses.sanskrit: परस्तात्परमात्मेति ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । वर्तन्ते वसवः केचित्परमात्मपदाश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: parastAtparamAtmeti brahmaviShNumaheshvarAH | vartante vasavaH kechitparamAtmapadAshrayAH
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence he shall pray to the lord. 'Stay here permanently'. After submitting this he shall remember him shining with refulgent splendour.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरात्मपदे केचित्केचिदात्मपदे तथा । शान्त्यतीतपदे शैवाः शान्ते माहेश्वरे ततः
verses.transliteration: antarAtmapade kechitkechidAtmapade tathA | shAntyatItapade shaivAH shAnte mAheshvare tataH
verses.translation: After worshipping Siva and securing his behest in the form of Siva he shall slowly mutter Siva's Mantra into the ear of the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यायां तु यथा रौद्राः प्रतिष्ठायां तु वैष्णवाः । निवृत्तौ च तथात्मानो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माङ्गयोनयः
verses.transliteration: vidyAyAM tu yathA raudrAH pratiShThAyAM tu vaiShNavAH | nivR^ittau cha tathAtmAno brahmA brahmA~NgayonayaH
verses.translation: At the behest of the preceptor he shall repeat the mantra with palms joined in reverence and mind con¬ centrating on it.

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्राह्यानपेक्षोऽस्ति न हि कश्चिदनुग्रहः । अतः स्वातन्त्र्यशब्दार्थाननपेक्षत्वलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: anugrAhyAnapekSho.asti na hi kashchidanugrahaH | ataH svAtantryashabdArthAnanapekShatvalakShaNaH
verses.translation: Then after instructing him in the §akti mantra,

verses.sanskrit: देवयोन्यष्टकं मुख्यं मानुष्यमथ मध्यमम् । पक्ष्यादयोऽधमाः पञ्च योनयस्ताश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: devayonyaShTakaM mukhyaM mAnuShyamatha madhyamam | pakShyAdayo.adhamAH pa~ncha yonayastAshchaturdasha
verses.translation: After briefly explaining to him the syllabic mean¬ ing of the mantra, the preceptor shall advise him about the form of the lord and instruct him in different postures.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तराधरभावोऽपि ज्ञेयः संसारिणो मलः । यथाऽऽमभावो मुक्तस्य पूर्वं पश्चात्तु पक्वता
verses.transliteration: uttarAdharabhAvo.api j~neyaH saMsAriNo malaH | yathA.a.amabhAvo muktasya pUrvaM pashchAttu pakvatA
verses.translation: Then at the behest of the preceptor, in the presence of aivite fire and the preceptor, the disciple shall think with devotion and repeat the statement of initiation.

verses.sanskrit: मलोऽप्यामश्च पक्वश्च भवेत्संसारकारणम् । आमे त्वधरता पुंसां पक्वे तूत्तरता क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: malo.apyAmashcha pakvashcha bhavetsaMsArakAraNam | Ame tvadharatA puMsAM pakve tUttaratA kramAt
verses.translation: 'Better to abandon life, better to cut off the head than to take food without worshipping the threc-cycd lord.*

verses.sanskrit: पश्वात्मानस्त्रिधा भिन्ना एकद्वित्रिमलाः क्रमात् । अत्रोत्तरा एकमला द्विमला मध्यमा मताः । त्रिमलास्त्वधमा ज्ञेया यथोत्तरमधिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: pashvAtmAnastridhA bhinnA ekadvitrimalAH kramAt | atrottarA ekamalA dvimalA madhyamA matAH | trimalAstvadhamA j~neyA yathottaramadhiShThitAH
verses.translation: The lord alone will invariably give till the delusion is removed. The disciple shall propitiate the lord with con¬ centrated devotion till delusion is quelled.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिमलानधितिष्ठन्ति द्विमलैकमलाः क्रमात् । इत्थमौपाधिको भेदो विश्वस्य परिकल्पितः
verses.transliteration: trimalAnadhitiShThanti dvimalaikamalAH kramAt | itthamaupAdhiko bhedo vishvasya parikalpitaH
verses.translation: Thereafter the disciple will be known as Samaya in the preceptor's hermitage. He shall carry out the behests of the preceptor and remain subservient to him.

verses.sanskrit: एकद्वित्रिमलान्सर्वाञ्छिव एकोऽधितिष्ठति । अशिवात्मकमप्येतच्छिवेनाधिष्ठितं यथा
verses.transliteration: ekadvitrimalAnsarvA~nChiva eko.adhitiShThati | ashivAtmakamapyetachChivenAdhiShThitaM yathA
verses.translation: Then after performing the rite of Karanyasa the preceptor shall take the Bhasma with his own hand and hand it over to the disciple along with the Mulamantra and the Rudrak$a over which the mantra has been repeated.

verses.sanskrit: अरुद्रात्मकमित्येवं रुद्रैर्जगदधिष्ठितम् । अण्डान्ता हि महाभूमिः शतरुद्राद्यधिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: arudrAtmakamityevaM rudrairjagadadhiShThitam | aNDAntA hi mahAbhUmiH shatarudrAdyadhiShThitA
verses.translation: The disciple shall take these things from the Saiva preceptor with great respect only at the behest of his family preceptor. Not otherwise,

verses.sanskrit: मायान्तमन्तरिक्षं तु ह्यमरेशादिभिः क्रमात् । अङ्गुष्ठमात्रपर्यन्तैः समन्तात्सन्ततं ततम्
verses.transliteration: mAyAntamantarikShaM tu hyamareshAdibhiH kramAt | a~NguShThamAtraparyantaiH samantAtsantataM tatam
verses.translation: He shall keep on his head everything obtained from the preceptor, with great devotion and preserve it care¬ fully. He shall worship Siva in the hermitage or in his own house.

verses.sanskrit: महामायावसाना द्यौर्वाय्वाद्यैर्भुवनाधिपैः । अनाश्रितान्तैरध्वान्तर्वर्त्तिभिः समधिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: mahAmAyAvasAnA dyaurvAyvAdyairbhuvanAdhipaiH | anAshritAntairadhvAntarvarttibhiH samadhiShThitAH
verses.translation: The preceptor shall impart to him the 6aivite conduct of life in proportion to his devotion and faith as well as his grasping capacity.

verses.sanskrit: ते हि साक्षाद्दिविषदस्त्वन्तरिक्षसदस्तथा । पृथिवीपद इत्येवं देवा देवव्रतैः स्तुताः
verses.transliteration: te hi sAkShAddiviShadastvantarikShasadastathA | pR^ithivIpada ityevaM devA devavrataiH stutAH
verses.translation: Understanding of Saivite Agama, reading it and listening to it shall be done at the behest of the preceptor. Not by himself at his will nor from anyone else.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुनरनुग्राह्यं परतन्त्रं तदिष्यते । अनुग्रहाद् ऋते तस्य भुक्तिमुक्त्योरनन्वयात्
verses.transliteration: etatpunaranugrAhyaM paratantraM tadiShyate | anugrahAd R^ite tasya bhuktimuktyorananvayAt
verses.translation: Thus the consecration 'Samaya* has been briefly explained to you. It is the greatest means in attaining the city of Siva himself.

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्रिभिर्मलैरामैः पक्वैरेव पृथक्पृथक् । निदानभूतैः संसाररोगः पुंसां प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: evaM tribhirmalairAmaiH pakvaireva pR^ithakpR^ithak | nidAnabhUtaiH saMsArarogaH puMsAM pravartate
verses.translation: Before re-creation after dissolution, the universe remains un¬ manifest in the phallic form of iiva Hence ivais Gudhadeha.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य रोगस्य भैषज्यं ज्ञानमेव न चापरम् । भिषगाज्ञापकः शम्भुः शिवः परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: asya rogasya bhaiShajyaM j~nAnameva na chAparam | bhiShagAj~nApakaH shambhuH shivaH paramakAraNam
verses.translation: Hereafter the preceptor shall perform the purifica¬ tion of the six pathways after understanding the disciple's capacity, for the sake of liberation from bondage.

verses.sanskrit: अदुःखेनाऽपि शक्तोऽसौ पशून्मोचयितुं शिवः । कथं दुःखं करोतीति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: aduHkhenA.api shakto.asau pashUnmochayituM shivaH | kathaM duHkhaM karotIti nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: The six paths*®® are Kala, Tattva, Bhuvana, Varna, Pada and Mantra in brief.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखमेव हि सर्वोऽपि संसार इति निश्चितम् । कथं दुःखमदुःखं स्यात्स्वभावो ह्यविपर्ययः
verses.transliteration: duHkhameva hi sarvo.api saMsAra iti nishchitam | kathaM duHkhamaduHkhaM syAtsvabhAvo hyaviparyayaH
verses.translation: The five Kalas, Nivrtti etc. are the pathway of Kala. The five Kalas pervade the five paths.

verses.sanskrit: न हि रोगी ह्यरोगी स्याद्भिषग्भैषज्यकारणात् । रोगार्तं तु भिषग्रोगाद्भैषजैः सुखमुद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: na hi rogI hyarogI syAdbhiShagbhaiShajyakAraNAt | rogArtaM tu bhiShagrogAdbhaiShajaiH sukhamuddharet
verses.translation: The principles from Sivatattva to the earth cons¬ titute the paths of principles. They are twcntysix, both pure and impure.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्वभावमलिनान्स्वभावाद्दुःखिनः पशून् । स्वाज्ञौषधविधानेन दुःखान्मोचयते शिवः
verses.transliteration: evaM svabhAvamalinAnsvabhAvAdduHkhinaH pashUn | svAj~nauShadhavidhAnena duHkhAnmochayate shivaH
verses.translation: Those beginning with Adhara and ending with Unmana constitute the paths of worlds. They are sixty in number without difference and subsidiary divisions.

verses.sanskrit: न भिषक् कारणं रोगे शिवः संसारकारणम् । इत्येतदपि वैषम्यं न दोषायास्य कल्पते
verses.transliteration: na bhiShak kAraNaM roge shivaH saMsArakAraNam | ityetadapi vaiShamyaM na doShAyAsya kalpate
verses.translation: The fifty letters in the form of Rudras constitute the path of letters. The path of words has many varieties.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखे स्वभावसंसिद्धे कथं तत्कारणं शिवः । स्वाभाविको मलः पुंसां स हि संसारयत्यमून्
verses.transliteration: duHkhe svabhAvasaMsiddhe kathaM tatkAraNaM shivaH | svAbhAviko malaH puMsAM sa hi saMsArayatyamUn
verses.translation: The path of mantras consisting of subsidiary Mantras is pervaded by the excellent mantra. Just as Siva, the leader of Tattvas, is not included among Tattvas so also the leader of Mantras is not included in the path of Mantra. The Kaladhva pervades and the other Adhvas are pervaded.

verses.sanskrit: संसारकारणं यत्तु मलं मायाद्यचेतनम् । तत्स्वयं न प्रवर्तेत शिवसान्निध्यमन्तरा
verses.transliteration: saMsArakAraNaM yattu malaM mAyAdyachetanam | tatsvayaM na pravarteta shivasAnnidhyamantarA
verses.translation: He who does not know that factually should not perform the rite of the six Adhvas. He who has not under¬ stood the form of the six paths cannot understand the order of pervasiveness and is incompetent to perform the rite.

verses.sanskrit: यथा मणिरयस्कान्तः सान्निध्यादुपकारकः । अयसश्चलतस्तद्वच्छिवोऽप्यस्येति सूरयः
verses.transliteration: yathA maNirayaskAntaH sAnnidhyAdupakArakaH | ayasashchalatastadvachChivo.apyasyeti sUrayaH
verses.translation: After making the pits and the Mandapa as before, to the east he shall make the mystic diagram measuring two hastas for keeping the water-jar on. The preceptor shall perform his routine rites and enter the Mandapa with his dis¬ ciples to begin the worship of Siva as before. Milk pudding shall be made with rice measuring not less than one Adhaka. Half of that shall be offered to the lord as Naivedya and the remaining shall be kept reserved for Homa. In the

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तात्मनोऽप्यनुग्राह्या शिवाज्ञाननिवर्तनात् । अज्ञानाधिष्ठितं शम्भोर्न किञ्चिदिह विद्यते
verses.transliteration: mUrtAtmano.apyanugrAhyA shivAj~nAnanivartanAt | aj~nAnAdhiShThitaM shambhorna ki~nchidiha vidyate
verses.translation: The preceptor, most expert in the procedural code, shall invoke the five Brahmans** on them, repeating the Mulavaras along with Hindu and Nada, and the letters beginning with Namali and ending with Ya. Iana is invoked in the middle jar, Purusa in the eastern, Aghora in the southern, Varna in thfc northern and Sadyojata in the western jar. After performing the rites of protection, mystic gestures and invocation of the jar he shall sacrifice in the Siva fire as before.

verses.sanskrit: न निवर्तयितुं शक्यं सान्निध्यं सदकारणम् । अधिष्ठाता ततो नित्यमज्ञातो जगतः शिवः
verses.transliteration: na nivartayituM shakyaM sAnnidhyaM sadakAraNam | adhiShThAtA tato nityamaj~nAto jagataH shivaH
verses.translation: In this rite three Ahutis shall be given. With the specific mantras the refulgent deities shall be meditated upon. He shall then take the thrice-spun white threads made by brahmin girls, strung into three and with these bind the tip of the tuft of the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: न शिवेन विना किञ्चित्प्रवृत्तमिह विद्यते । तत्प्रेरितमिदं सर्वं तथापि न स मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: na shivena vinA ki~nchitpravR^ittamiha vidyate | tatpreritamidaM sarvaM tathApi na sa muhyati
verses.translation: The thread shall be let loose till the tip of the toe of the disciple standing straight. The Susumna ( the nerve of the backbone) shall be joined with it. The con¬ sciousness shall be invoked with the basic mantra and he shall offer three Ahutis to create its presence. With the flowers he shall strike the chest of the disciple as before and invoke consciousness. It shall then be conceived as placed in the twclve-petalled lotus. The thread shall be joined with the other thread (?) with the Astra and Varma mantras. After veiling the body of the disciple the thread shall be meditated upon (?)

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिराज्ञात्मिका तस्य नियन्त्री विश्वतोमुखी । तया ततमिदं शश्वत्तथापि स न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: shaktirAj~nAtmikA tasya niyantrI vishvatomukhI | tayA tatamidaM shashvattathApi sa na duShyati
verses.translation: It shall then be imagined that the three strings

verses.sanskrit: अनिदं प्रथमं सर्वमीशितव्यं स ईश्वरः । ईशनाच्च तदीयाज्ञा तथापि स न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: anidaM prathamaM sarvamIshitavyaM sa IshvaraH | IshanAchcha tadIyAj~nA tathApi sa na duShyati
verses.translation: After striking the disciple on the head and the thread worne on the body he shall bedeck the sutra in the Santyatita Pada, repeating the mantra.

verses.sanskrit: योऽन्यथा मन्यते मोहात्स विनश्यति दुर्मतिः । तच्छक्तिवैभवादेव तथापि स न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: yo.anyathA manyate mohAtsa vinashyati durmatiH | tachChaktivaibhavAdeva tathApi sa na duShyati
verses.translation: In this manner after offering the Ahutis of Sarftyatita upto the end of Nivftti he shall perform three Ahutis and worship Siva in the Mandala.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे व्योम्नः श्रुता वागशरीरिणी । सत्यमोममृतं सौम्यमित्याविरभवत्स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vyomnaH shrutA vAgasharIriNI | satyamomamR^itaM saumyamityAvirabhavatsphuTam
verses.translation: The preceptor shall make the disciple sit to the south of the lord facing the north, on the Mandala strewn with Darbha grass. He shall give him the rice soaked in ghee left after the Homa.

verses.sanskrit: ततो हृष्टतराः सर्वे विनष्टाशेषसंशयाः । मुनयो विस्मयाविष्टाः प्रणेमुः पवनं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tato hR^iShTatarAH sarve vinaShTAsheShasaMshayAH | munayo vismayAviShTAH praNemuH pavanaM prabhum
verses.translation: The disciple shall take the Caru offered by the preceptor, and eat it repeating the name Siva. After per¬ forming the Acamana twice he shall repeat the mantra of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तथा विगतसन्देहान्कृत्वापि पवनो मुनीन् । नैते प्रतिष्ठितज्ञाना इति मत्वैवमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tathA vigatasandehAnkR^itvApi pavano munIn | naite pratiShThitaj~nAnA iti matvaivamabravIt
verses.translation: The preceptor shall give him the Paftcagavya on the other Mandala. The disciple shall drink it upto his capacity, perform the Acamana twice and remember §iva.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच परोक्षमपरोक्षं च द्विविधं ज्ञानमिष्यते । परोक्षमस्थिरं प्राहुरपरोक्षं तु सुस्थिरम्
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha parokShamaparokShaM cha dvividhaM j~nAnamiShyate | parokShamasthiraM prAhuraparokShaM tu susthiram
verses.translation: He shall make the disciple sit on a third Mandala as before, and hand over a tooth brush twig having the characteristics mentioned in the scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: हेतूपदेशगम्यं यत्तत्परोक्षं प्रचक्षते । अपरोक्षं पुनः श्रेष्ठादनुष्ठानाद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: hetUpadeshagamyaM yattatparokShaM prachakShate | aparokShaM punaH shreShThAdanuShThAnAdbhaviShyati
verses.translation: The disciple shall sit silently facing the east or the north and clean his teeth with its soft tip.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: If the cast-off tooth brush is seen by the

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: If the cast-off tooth brush is seen by the

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३२. द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः । श्रेष्ठानुष्ठानवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । किं तच्छ्रेष्ठमनुष्ठानं मोक्षो येनापरोक्षितः । तत्तस्य साधनं चाद्य वक्तुमर्हसि मारुत
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.32\. dvAtriMsho.adhyAyaH | shreShThAnuShThAnavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | kiM tachChreShThamanuShThAnaM mokSho yenAparokShitaH | tattasya sAdhanaM chAdya vaktumarhasi mAruta
verses.translation: Then he shall strike the disciple and whisper the name of Siva into his ears. He shall make him settle to the south of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: शैवागमैस्तु सम्पन्नः सहाङ्गोपाङ्गविस्तरः । तत्संस्काराधिकारैश्च सम्यगेवोपबृंहितः
verses.transliteration: shaivAgamaistu sampannaH sahA~NgopA~NgavistaraH | tatsaMskArAdhikAraishcha samyagevopabR^iMhitaH
verses.translation: During the night the disciple shall lie on a Darbha mattress covered with an unwashed bed-sheet and consecrated with mantra. While lying he shall meditate on Siva and keep his head to the east.

verses.sanskrit: शैवागमो हि द्विविधः श्रौतोऽश्रौतश्च संस्कृतः । श्रुतिसारमयः श्रौतः स्वतन्त्र इतरो मतः
verses.transliteration: shaivAgamo hi dvividhaH shrauto.ashrautashcha saMskR^itaH | shrutisAramayaH shrautaH svatantra itaro mataH
verses.translation: To his tuft the thread has already been tied. Along with that tuft the preceptor shall tie the unwashed bed- sheet. With Varma mantra he shall cover him up. All round him he shall make three lines with gingelly seeds and mustard fully consecrated by Astra mantra. Outside the lines he shall offer oblations to the guardians of the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: स्वतन्त्रो दशधा पूर्वं तथाष्टादशधा पुनः । कामिकादिसमाख्याभिः सिद्धः सिद्धान्तसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: svatantro dashadhA pUrvaM tathAShTAdashadhA punaH | kAmikAdisamAkhyAbhiH siddhaH siddhAntasa.nj~nitaH
verses.translation: The disciple shall not take anything in after sett¬ ling down like this. After getting up the next day he shall intimate to the preceptor if he had any dream.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिसारमयो यस्तु शतकोटिप्रविस्तरः । परं पाशुपतं यत्र व्रतं ज्ञानं च कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: shrutisAramayo yastu shatakoTipravistaraH | paraM pAshupataM yatra vrataM j~nAnaM cha kathyate
verses.translation: After completing ablution and other rites the dis¬ ciple shall, at the bidding of the preceptor, go near the Mancjlala of Siva meditating on Siva, with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: युगावर्तेषु शिष्येत योगाचार्यस्वरूपिणा । तत्र तत्रावतीर्णेन शिवेनैव प्रवर्त्यते
verses.transliteration: yugAvarteShu shiShyeta yogAchAryasvarUpiNA | tatra tatrAvatIrNena shivenaiva pravartyate
verses.translation: All rites upto the binding of the eyes shall be

verses.sanskrit: सङ्क्षिप्यास्य प्रवक्तारश्चत्वारः परमर्षयः । रुरुर्दधीचोऽगस्त्यश्च उपमन्युर्महायशाः
verses.transliteration: sa~NkShipyAsya pravaktArashchatvAraH paramarShayaH | rururdadhIcho.agastyashcha upamanyurmahAyashAH
verses.translation: When flowers are strewn by the disciple whose eyes are tied, the preceptor shall tell him the places where the flowers fell.

verses.sanskrit: ते च पाशुपता ज्ञेयाः संहितानां प्रवर्तकाः । तत्सन्ततीया गुरवः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: te cha pAshupatA j~neyAH saMhitAnAM pravartakAH | tatsantatIyA guravaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
verses.translation: The preceptor shall take him to the Mandala where worship had already been performed. As before he shall worship lord Hana and perform homa in the fire.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोक्तः परमो धर्मश्चर्याद्यात्मा चतुर्विधः । तेषु पाशुपतो योगः शिवं प्रत्यक्षयेद् दृढम्
verses.transliteration: tatroktaH paramo dharmashcharyAdyAtmA chaturvidhaH | teShu pAshupato yogaH shivaM pratyakShayed dR^iDham
verses.translation: If any bad dream had been seen by the disciple,

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठमनुष्ठानं योगः पाशुपतो मतः । तत्राप्युपायको युक्तो ब्रह्मणा स तु कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: tasmAchChreShThamanuShThAnaM yogaH pAshupato mataH | tatrApyupAyako yukto brahmaNA sa tu kathyate
verses.translation: The thread tied to the tuft sliall be loosened to hang down as. before, He shall perform the worship of Adhara* based on Nivrttikala and conclude with the worship of Vagisvari with* due homas. He shall bow to Vagina and Satl who pervade Nivftii. He shall worship the lord •in the.. Mandala and make three Ahutis Then the mystical rite of making the simultaneous entry into all types of living beings, shall be pc'formed.

verses.sanskrit: नामाष्टकमयो योगः शिवेन परिकल्पितः । तेन योगेन सहसा शैवी प्रज्ञा प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: nAmAShTakamayo yogaH shivena parikalpitaH | tena yogena sahasA shaivI praj~nA prajAyate
verses.translation: In order to facilitate the simultaneous entry into all of them, he shall deposit the Atman of the disciple along with his mind into Vagisani duly.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । शैवो हि परमो धर्मः श्रेष्ठानुष्ठानशब्दितः । यत्रापरोक्षो लक्ष्येत साक्षान्मोक्षप्रदः शिवः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | shaivo hi paramo dharmaH shreShThAnuShThAnashabditaH | yatrAparokSho lakShyeta sAkShAnmokShapradaH shivaH
verses.translation: For the accomplishment of the spiritual knowledge he shall worship and bow to the lord. After performing the homa he shall remember it as developed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्ञया परमं ज्ञानमचिराल्लभते स्थिरम् । प्रसीदति शिवस्तस्य यस्य ज्ञानं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: praj~nayA paramaM j~nAnamachirAllabhate sthiram | prasIdati shivastasya yasya j~nAnaM pratiShThitam
verses.translation: He shall duly perform the mystical rites of nativity, the pursuit of previous actions, straightforwardness and the great pleasure of enjoyment.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादात्परमो योगो यः शिवं चापरोक्षयेत् । शिवापरोक्षात्संसारकारणेन वियुज्यते
verses.transliteration: prasAdAtparamo yogo yaH shivaM chAparokShayet | shivAparokShAtsaMsArakAraNena viyujyate
verses.translation: For the sake of redemption and the achievement of birth, longevity, enjoyment and purificatory impressions, the preceptor shall perform three Ahutis and pray to the lord.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्यान्मुक्तसंसारो मुक्तः शिवसमो भवेत् । ब्रह्मप्रोक्त इत्युपायः स एव पृथगुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tataH syAnmuktasaMsAro muktaH shivasamo bhavet | brahmaprokta ityupAyaH sa eva pR^ithaguchyate
verses.translation: Thus he shall purify his 'body that contains the dirt of enjoyment of pleasures and contact with sensual objects. He shall cut off the three bondages of the disciple,

verses.sanskrit: शिवो महेश्वरश्चैव रुद्रो विष्णुः पितामहः । संसारवैद्यः सर्वज्ञः परमात्मेति मुख्यतः
verses.transliteration: shivo maheshvarashchaiva rudro viShNuH pitAmahaH | saMsAravaidyaH sarvaj~naH paramAtmeti mukhyataH
verses.translation: By the complete splitting of the bondage he shall make the disciple clean.

verses.sanskrit: नामाष्टकमिदं मुख्यं शिवस्य प्रतिपादकम् । आद्यं तु पञ्चकं ज्ञेयं शान्त्यतीताद्यनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: nAmAShTakamidaM mukhyaM shivasya pratipAdakam | AdyaM tu pa~nchakaM j~neyaM shAntyatItAdyanukramAt
verses.translation: After making the Purnahuti in the fire he shall worship Brahma. After performing three Ahutis for him he shall submit to him the behest of Siva.
