verses.sanskrit: संज्ञा सदाशिवादीनां पञ्चोपाधिपरिग्रहात् । उपाधिविनिवृत्तौ तु यथास्वं विनिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: sa.nj~nA sadAshivAdInAM pa~nchopAdhiparigrahAt | upAdhivinivR^ittau tu yathAsvaM vinivartate
verses.translation: 'O Pitamaha, no hindrance shall be placed for this disciple who is going to the great region of Siva. This is the behest of Siva'.

verses.sanskrit: पदमेव हि तं नित्यमनित्याः पदिनः स्मृताः । पदानां परिवृत्तौ तु मुच्यन्ते पदिनो यतः
verses.transliteration: padameva hi taM nityamanityAH padinaH smR^itAH | padAnAM parivR^ittau tu muchyante padino yataH
verses.translation: Thus imploring him, he shall worship and ritualistically dismiss him. He shall worship Mahadeva and perform three Ahutis.

verses.sanskrit: परिवृत्त्यन्तरे भूयस्तत्पदप्राप्तिरुच्यते । आत्मान्तराभिधानं स्याद्यदाद्यं नामपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: parivR^ittyantare bhUyastatpadaprAptiruchyate | AtmAntarAbhidhAnaM syAdyadAdyaM nAmapa~nchakam
verses.translation: Uplifting the Atman of the disciple, as before, when it has been purified by Nivrttikala he shall deposit it in his own Atman. He shall then worship Vagisa.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्तु त्रितयं नाम्नामुपादानादियोगतः । त्रिविधोपाधिवचनाच्छिव एवानुवर्तते
verses.transliteration: anyattu tritayaM nAmnAmupAdAnAdiyogataH | trividhopAdhivachanAchChiva evAnuvartate
verses.translation: He shall perform three Ahutis now and ritualistically dismiss him. Returning he shall make it united with Prati$thakala.

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमलसंश्लेषः प्रागभावात्स्वभावतः । अत्यन्तं परिशुद्धात्मेत्यतोऽयं शिव उच्यते
verses.transliteration: anAdimalasaMshleShaH prAgabhAvAtsvabhAvataH | atyantaM parishuddhAtmetyato.ayaM shiva uchyate
verses.translation: Performing the worship and the three Ahutis simultaneously he shall imagine the entry of the Atman of the disciple into the Pratistha Kala.

verses.sanskrit: स तु पञ्चविधो ज्ञेयः पञ्चभिः पर्वभिः क्रमात् । क्रियातपोजपध्यानज्ञानात्मभिरनुत्तरैः
verses.transliteration: sa tu pa~nchavidho j~neyaH pa~nchabhiH parvabhiH kramAt | kriyAtapojapadhyAnaj~nAnAtmabhiranuttaraiH
verses.translation: Then after invoking Pratistha and performing everything as previously mentioned he shall conceive its pervasion and the pervading Vagisani.

verses.sanskrit: अथवाशेषकल्याणगुणैकधन ईश्वरः । शिव इत्युच्यते सद्भिः शिवतत्त्वार्थवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: athavAsheShakalyANaguNaikadhana IshvaraH | shiva ityuchyate sadbhiH shivatattvArthavAdibhiH
verses.translation: He shall imagine Vagisani as lustrous as the disc of the full moon. After doing everything as before he shall submit to Visnu the behest of Siva the great Atman.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोविंशतितत्त्वेभ्यः प्रकृतिर्हि परा मता । प्रकृतेस्तु परं प्राहुः पुरुषं पञ्चविंशकम्
verses.transliteration: trayoviMshatitattvebhyaH prakR^itirhi parA matA | prakR^itestu paraM prAhuH puruShaM pa~nchaviMshakam
verses.translation: Performing everything like the ritualistic dismissal of Visnu by means of Vidya he shall think of Prati$(ha and its pervasion and Vagisa too in order. He shall then perform everything concluding with the Purnahuti in the blazing fire as before. Nilarudra shall be invoked and its worship performed. As mentioned before, the behest of the lord shall be carried out.

verses.sanskrit: यं वेदादौ स्वरं प्राहुर्वाच्यवाचकभावतः । वेदैकवेद्ययाथात्म्याद्वेदान्ते च प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: yaM vedAdau svaraM prAhurvAchyavAchakabhAvataH | vedaikavedyayAthAtmyAdvedAnte cha pratiShThitaH
verses.translation: Then the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed. For the purpose of quietening him, Vidyakala shall be conceived and its pervasion surveyed.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रकृतिलीनस्य यः परः स महेश्वरः । तदधीनप्रवृत्तित्वात्प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च
verses.transliteration: tasya prakR^itilInasya yaH paraH sa maheshvaraH | tadadhInapravR^ittitvAtprakR^iteH puruShasya cha
verses.translation: He shall then as before invoke Vagisi that pervades his Atman, that has the form and features of the early morning sun and that illuminates the ten quarters.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा त्रिगुणं तत्त्वमुपेयमिदमव्ययम् । मायां तु प्रकृतिं विद्यान्मायिनं तु महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: athavA triguNaM tattvamupeyamidamavyayam | mAyAM tu prakR^itiM vidyAnmAyinaM tu maheshvaram
verses.translation: He shall perform the remaining rites as before. He shall invoke lord iva and propitiate him. After

verses.sanskrit: मायाविक्षोभकोऽनन्तो महेश्वरसमन्वयात् । कालात्मा परमात्मादिः स्थूलः सूक्ष्मः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: mAyAvikShobhako.ananto maheshvarasamanvayAt | kAlAtmA paramAtmAdiH sthUlaH sUkShmaH prakIrtitaH
verses.translation: After ritualistically dismissing the lord he shall lead another Kala to SantyatTtakala and survey its pervasion.

verses.sanskrit: रुद् दुःखं दुःखहेतुर्वा तद्रावयति नः प्रभुः । रुद्र इत्युच्यते सद्भिः शिवः परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: rud duHkhaM duHkhaheturvA tadrAvayati naH prabhuH | rudra ityuchyate sadbhiH shivaH paramakAraNam
verses.translation: As before he shall meditate on Vilgisa that pervades the Atman as resembling the permanent. Upto the final offering (Purnahuti) everything is as before.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वादिभूतपर्यन्तं शरीरादिष्वतन्द्रितः । व्याप्याधितिष्ठति शिवस्ततो रुद्र इतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tattvAdibhUtaparyantaM sharIrAdiShvatandritaH | vyApyAdhitiShThati shivastato rudra itastataH
verses.translation: After doing everything in accordance with injunc¬ tions and worshipping Sadasiva he shall submit to him the behest of Siva of unmeasured activity.

verses.sanskrit: जगतः पितृभूतानां शिवो मूर्त्यात्मनामपि । पितृभावेन सर्वेषां पितामह उदीरितः
verses.transliteration: jagataH pitR^ibhUtAnAM shivo mUrtyAtmanAmapi | pitR^ibhAvena sarveShAM pitAmaha udIritaH
verses.translation: There too, after worshipping iva as before on the head and bowing to Vagisa he shall ritualistically dismiss him.

verses.sanskrit: निदानज्ञो यथा वैद्यो रोगस्य विनिवर्तकः । उपायैर्भेषजैस्तद्वल्लयभोगाधिकारतः
verses.transliteration: nidAnaj~no yathA vaidyo rogasya vinivartakaH | upAyairbheShajaistadvallayabhogAdhikArataH
verses.translation: Sprinkling then the disciple on the head as before with Siva mantra he shall think of the merging of iSantyati- takala in the lakti Tattva.

verses.sanskrit: तैरेव सोत्तरैः सिद्धो धर्मस्तु परमो मतः । परोक्षमपरोक्षं च ज्ञानं यत्र च मोक्षदम्
verses.transliteration: taireva sottaraiH siddho dharmastu paramo mataH | parokShamaparokShaM cha j~nAnaM yatra cha mokShadam
verses.translation: On the other side beyond the six pathways he shall think of the greatest Iakti of iva that pervades the pathways and that" equals a crore of suns.

verses.sanskrit: संसारस्येश्वरो नित्यं समूलस्य निवर्तकः । संसारवैद्य इत्युक्तः सर्वतत्त्वार्थवेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: saMsArasyeshvaro nityaM samUlasya nivartakaH | saMsAravaidya ityuktaH sarvatattvArthavedibhiH
verses.translation: He shall bring the disciple as ptire as the crystal in front of it. After washing the scissors, the preceptor shall cut off the tuft of the disciple as well as his thread in the manner mentioned in the Saivite Scriptures. He shall place it in cowdung and consign it to Siva fire.

verses.sanskrit: दशार्थज्ञानसिद्ध्यर्थमिन्द्रियेष्वेषु सत्स्वपि । त्रिकालभाविनो भावान्स्थूलान्सूक्ष्मानशेषतः
verses.transliteration: dashArthaj~nAnasiddhyarthamindriyeShveShu satsvapi | trikAlabhAvino bhAvAnsthUlAnsUkShmAnasheShataH
verses.translation: Then with the basic mantra ending with Vausat he shall wash the scissors and hands. He shall restore the consciousness of the disciple to his body.

verses.sanskrit: अणवो नैव जानन्ति माययैव मलावृताः । असत्स्वपि च सर्वेषु सर्वार्थज्ञानहेतुषु
verses.transliteration: aNavo naiva jAnanti mAyayaiva malAvR^itAH | asatsvapi cha sarveShu sarvArthaj~nAnahetuShu
verses.translation: The disciple shall take bath and perform Acamana. Good wishes and blessings shall be conferred on him. He shall be brought to the Mandala and made to prostrate. In order to expiate for the shortcomings in the rites due worship shall be performed. The preceptor shall pour three Ahutis by reciting the mantra.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यथावस्थितं वस्तु तत्तथैव सदाशिवः । अयत्नेनैव जानाति तस्मात्सर्वज्ञ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yadyathAvasthitaM vastu tattathaiva sadAshivaH | ayatnenaiva jAnAti tasmAtsarvaj~na uchyate
verses.translation: In order to expiate for the shortcomings in the Mantra he shall worship the lord of the gods and pour three Ahutis by muttering the mantra.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मा परमैरेभिर्गुणैर्नित्यसमन्वयात् । स्वस्मात्परात्मविरहात्परमात्मा शिवः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAtmA paramairebhirguNairnityasamanvayAt | svasmAtparAtmavirahAtparamAtmA shivaH svayam
verses.translation: He shall pour three Ahutis by repeating the mantra ineiitally. After propitiating Siva there, in the

verses.sanskrit: नामाष्टकमिदं चैव लब्ध्वाचार्यप्रसादतः । निवृत्त्यादिकलाग्रन्थिं शिवाद्यैः पञ्चनामभिः
verses.transliteration: nAmAShTakamidaM chaiva labdhvAchAryaprasAdataH | nivR^ittyAdikalAgranthiM shivAdyaiH pa~nchanAmabhiH
verses.translation: 'O lord, due to your grace the, purity of the six pathways of the disciple has been completed. Now, O lord, lead him unto your imperishable abode.'

verses.sanskrit: यथास्वं क्रमशश्छित्वा शोधयित्वा यथागुणम् । गुणितैरेव सोद्धातैः निरुद्धैरथापि वा
verses.transliteration: yathAsvaM kramashashChitvA shodhayitvA yathAguNam | guNitaireva soddhAtaiH niruddhairathApi vA
verses.translation: After submitting thus to the lord he shall perform every thing as before, from Nadisandhana to the Purnahuti. Then he shall purify the elements

verses.sanskrit: हृत्कण्ठतालुभ्रूमध्यब्रह्मरन्ध्रसमन्विताम् । छित्त्वा पर्यष्टकाकारं स्वात्मानं च सुषुम्णया
verses.transliteration: hR^itkaNThatAlubhrUmadhyabrahmarandhrasamanvitAm | ChittvA paryaShTakAkAraM svAtmAnaM cha suShumNayA
verses.translation: Then, for conducting purity he shall 'meditate on the regions stable or unstable,. hot or cold in the puri¬ ficatory rite of the Bhutas in the form of. unity that is pervaded.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशान्तः स्थितस्येन्दोर्नीत्वोपरि शिवौजसि । संहृत्य वदनं पश्चाद्यथासंस्करणं लयात्
verses.transliteration: dvAdashAntaH sthitasyendornItvopari shivaujasi | saMhR^itya vadanaM pashchAdyathAsaMskaraNaM layAt
verses.translation: After cutting off the knot of the Bhutas he shall join the Bhutas on to the great lord Siva, by the path of steady concentration.

verses.sanskrit: शाक्तेनामृतवर्षेण संसिक्तायां तनौ पुनः । अवतार्य स्वमात्मानममृतात्माकृतिं हृदि
verses.transliteration: shAktenAmR^itavarSheNa saMsiktAyAM tanau punaH | avatArya svamAtmAnamamR^itAtmAkR^itiM hR^idi
verses.translation: He shall purify his body, burn it, and drench it with drops of nectar. Steadying the Atman he shall make his body in consonance with the pure pathways.

verses.sanskrit: परमोऽपरमश्चोभौ धर्मौ हि श्रुतिचोदितौ । धर्मशब्दाभिधेयेऽर्थे प्रमाणं श्रुतिरेव नः
verses.transliteration: paramo.aparamashchobhau dharmau hi shrutichoditau | dharmashabdAbhidheye.arthe pramANaM shrutireva naH
verses.translation: There at the outset he shall place on the he.ad of the disciple the Santyatita kala. that pervades the pathways; the Santikala on the face; Vidya kala in the spot beginning with the throat and ending with the navel; Pratisfha kala upto the knees; Nivrtti kala beneath it. Thereafter he shall meditate on it.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशान्तःस्थितस्येन्दोः परस्ताच्छ्वेतपङ्कजे । समासीनं महादेवं शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम्
verses.transliteration: dvAdashAntaHsthitasyendoH parastAchChvetapa~Nkaje | samAsInaM mahAdevaM sha~NkaraM bhaktavatsalam
verses.translation: With the basic mantra, its Bijas and ancillaries he shall meditate on him in the form of Siva. He shall invoke the lord in the lotus of the heart and worship him.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धनारीश्वरं देवं निर्मलं मधुराकृतिम् । शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं प्रसन्नं शीतलद्युतिम्
verses.transliteration: ardhanArIshvaraM devaM nirmalaM madhurAkR^itim | shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshaM prasannaM shItaladyutim
verses.translation: The teacher shall pray for the perpetual presence of iSiva in the disciple. He shall impose good qualities on the disciple posses.sed of Saivite splendour.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा हि मानसे देवं स्वस्थचित्तोऽथ मानवः । शिवनामाष्टकेनैव भावपुष्पैः समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: dhyAtvA hi mAnase devaM svasthachitto.atha mAnavaH | shivanAmAShTakenaiva bhAvapuShpaiH samarchayet
verses.translation: He shall perform three Ahutis praying — 'O lord, be pleased to bestow on him the attributes Anima, etc.*®** Likewise he shall invoke the lord for the presence of these qualities in him, viz: — omniscience, contentment, eternal enlightenment, unviolated 8akti, freedom and infinite power.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्चनान्ते तु पुनः प्राणानायम्य मानवः । सम्यक् चित्तं समाधाय शार्वं नामाष्टकं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: abhyarchchanAnte tu punaH prANAnAyamya mAnavaH | samyak chittaM samAdhAya shArvaM nAmAShTakaM japet
verses.translation: Then securing permission from the lord and meditating on him in the heart he shall pour water over the disciple from the vessels®®® of Sadyojata etc. in order.

verses.sanskrit: नाभौ चाष्टाहुतीर्हुत्वा पूर्णाहुत्या नमस्ततः । अष्टपुष्पप्रदानेन कृत्वाभ्यर्च्चनमन्तिमम्
verses.transliteration: nAbhau chAShTAhutIrhutvA pUrNAhutyA namastataH | aShTapuShpapradAnena kR^itvAbhyarchchanamantimam
verses.translation: Then after making the disciple sit and worship Siva as before he shall secure permission from the lord and impart Siva's knowledge to him.

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयेत्स्वमात्मानं चुलुकोदकवर्त्मना । एवं कृत्वाचिरादेव ज्ञानं पाशुपतं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: nivedayetsvamAtmAnaM chulukodakavartmanA | evaM kR^itvAchirAdeva j~nAnaM pAshupataM shubham
verses.translation: He shall impart also the plicated Mantra®'® beginning with Om and ending with Namah and the Saktividya of a similar nature, accompanied by Siva and Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: लभते तत्प्रतिष्ठां च वृत्तं चानुत्तमं तथा । योगं च परमं लब्ध्वा मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: labhate tatpratiShThAM cha vR^ittaM chAnuttamaM tathA | yogaM cha paramaM labdhvA muchyate nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: He shall instruct him in the name of the sage, metre, deity and the efficacy of Siva and Siva, the worship of Siva, his Avarana and the postures.

verses.sanskrit: परमो योगपर्यन्तो धर्मः श्रुतिशिरोगतः । धर्मस्त्वपरमस्तद्वदधः श्रुतिमुखोत्थितः
verses.transliteration: paramo yogaparyanto dharmaH shrutishirogataH | dharmastvaparamastadvadadhaH shrutimukhotthitaH
verses.translation: Worshipping the lord of the gods again he shall submit to Siva — 'Please make whatever has been performed by me a well accomplished thing*.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्वात्माधिकारत्वाद्यो धर्मः परमो मतः । साधारणस्ततोऽन्यस्तु सर्वेषामधिकारतः
verses.transliteration: apashvAtmAdhikAratvAdyo dharmaH paramo mataH | sAdhAraNastato.anyastu sarveShAmadhikArataH
verses.translation: Followed by his disciple the preceptor shall pros¬ trate before the lord on the ground. Thereafter he shall ritualistically dismiss him from the Mandala and the fire.

verses.sanskrit: स चायं परमो धर्मः परधर्मस्य साधनम् । धर्मशास्त्रादिभिः सम्यक् साङ्ग एवोपबृंहितः
verses.transliteration: sa chAyaM paramo dharmaH paradharmasya sAdhanam | dharmashAstrAdibhiH samyak sA~Nga evopabR^iMhitaH
verses.translation: Then those assembled there and worthy of worship shall be duly worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: शैवो यः परमो धर्मः श्रेष्ठानुष्ठानशब्दितः । इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां कथञ्चिदुपबृंहितः
verses.transliteration: shaivo yaH paramo dharmaH shreShThAnuShThAnashabditaH | itihAsapurANAbhyAM katha~nchidupabR^iMhitaH
verses.translation: The members of the assembly including the Rtviks shall be honoured with the gifts. He who desires his welfare shall not be niggardly.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: There, after imparting the I&aivitc lore in detail, he shall place this in the disciple's hand with water from the flowers.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: There, after imparting the I&aivitc lore in detail, he shall place this in the disciple's hand with water from the flowers.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३३. त्रयस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । पशुपतिव्रतविधानवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामो व्रतं पाशुपतं परम् । ब्रह्मादयोऽपि यत्कृत्वा सर्वे पाशुपताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.33\. trayastriMsho.adhyAyaH | pashupativratavidhAnavarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | bhagava~nChrotumichChAmo vrataM pAshupataM param | brahmAdayo.api yatkR^itvA sarve pAshupatAH smR^itAH
verses.translation: 'By the grace of the supreme lord this great Mantra shall certainly confer on you the Siddhis both of this world and the next one.'

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमाधाय विधिवद्विरजाहोमकारणात् । हुत्वाज्येन समिद्भिश्च चरुणा च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: agnimAdhAya vidhivadvirajAhomakAraNAt | hutvAjyena samidbhishcha charuNA cha yathAkramam
verses.translation: After saying this, the preceptor shall worship lord l§iva and secure his formal permission. He shall then impart to the aspirant the Yoga of Siva, the means of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णामापूर्य तां भूयस्तत्त्वानां शुद्धिमुद्दिशन् । जुहुयान्मूलमन्त्रेण तैरेव समिदादिभिः
verses.transliteration: pUrNAmApUrya tAM bhUyastattvAnAM shuddhimuddishan | juhuyAnmUlamantreNa taireva samidAdibhiH
verses.translation: On hearing the instructions of the preceptor, the aspirant disciple shall practise the Mantra before utilising it. This practice of the Mulamantra is called Purascarana since it has to be practised before the rite Viniyoga.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वान्येतानि मद्देहे शुद्ध्यन्तामित्यनुस्मरन् । पञ्चभूतानि तन्मात्राः पञ्चकर्मेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.transliteration: tattvAnyetAni maddehe shuddhyantAmityanusmaran | pa~nchabhUtAni tanmAtrAH pa~nchakarmendriyANi cha
verses.translation: A devotee who desires salvation need not practise the mantra too often. If practised moderately it is auspicious here and hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानकर्मविभेदेन पञ्चकर्मविभागशः । त्वगादिधातवः सप्त पञ्च प्राणादिवायवः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnakarmavibhedena pa~nchakarmavibhAgashaH | tvagAdidhAtavaH sapta pa~ncha prANAdivAyavaH
verses.translation: On an auspicious day, in a holy spot, in the favour¬ able season, the devotee shall take bath and perform the rites of the forenoon scrupulously keeping the teeth and the nails sparkling white in colour. He shall bedeck himself in scented flowers, garlands and ornaments readily available. He shall wear a white head-dress and a white upper cloth. His dress shall be white and pure. He shall sit comfortably in the I manner to which he is accustomed either in the temple or in his own house or in any charming place. He shall make his body worthy of Saivite rites along the path mentioned in the Saivite scriptures. He shall worship the lord Nakul- lvara. He shall offer milk pudding as Naivedya and con¬ clude the rite of propitiation. After bowing to him he shall

verses.sanskrit: मनोबुद्धिरहङ्ख्यातिर्गुणाः प्रकृतिपूरुषौ । रागो विद्याकले चैव नियतिः काल एव च
verses.transliteration: manobuddhiraha~NkhyAtirguNAH prakR^itipUruShau | rAgo vidyAkale chaiva niyatiH kAla eva cha
verses.translation: Thereafter his diet shall be limited in quantity and confined to milk pudding and such other as is devoid of salt and acidity. He shall not be violent. He shall be forbearing, quiet and self-possessed for ever.

verses.sanskrit: माया च शुद्धिविद्या च महेश्वरसदाशिवौ । शक्तिश्च शिवतत्त्वं च तत्त्वानि क्रमशो विदुः
verses.transliteration: mAyA cha shuddhividyA cha maheshvarasadAshivau | shaktishcha shivatattvaM cha tattvAni kramasho viduH
verses.translation: Whatever he eats daily whether, Caru, ground flour of fried grains, gruel, vegetables, milk, curd, ghee, roots, fruits and water he shall take in only after consecrating it with the mantras while the practice of the mantra is being kept up. He shall remain silent too.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रैस्तु विरजैर्हुत्वा होतासौ विरजा भवेत् । शिवानुग्रहमासाद्य ज्ञानवान्स हि जायते
verses.transliteration: mantraistu virajairhutvA hotAsau virajA bhavet | shivAnugrahamAsAdya j~nAnavAnsa hi jAyate
verses.translation: He shall take bath in the water from east-flowing or west- flowing rivers and purify himscif by repeating hun¬ dred and eight mantras or sprinkle himself as strength permits him.

verses.sanskrit: अथ गोमयमादाय पिण्डीकृत्याभिमन्त्र्य च । विन्यस्याग्नौ च सम्प्रोक्ष्य दिने तस्मिन्हविष्यभुक्
verses.transliteration: atha gomayamAdAya piNDIkR^ityAbhimantrya cha | vinyasyAgnau cha samprokShya dine tasminhaviShyabhuk
verses.translation: He shall perform the rites of Tarpana and homa in the Saivite fire with seven, five or three materials of wor¬ ship or with ghee alone.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभाते तु चतुर्दश्यां कृत्वा सर्वं पुरोदितम् । दिने तस्मिन्निराहारः कालं शेषं समापयेत्
verses.transliteration: prabhAte tu chaturdashyAM kR^itvA sarvaM puroditam | dine tasminnirAhAraH kAlaM sheShaM samApayet
verses.translation: Or he shall perform the Japa of the mantra a

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः पर्वणि चाप्येवं कृत्वा होमावसानतः । उपसंहृत्य रुद्राग्निं गृह्णीयाद्भस्म यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: prAtaH parvaNi chApyevaM kR^itvA homAvasAnataH | upasaMhR^itya rudrAgniM gR^ihNIyAdbhasma yatnataH
verses.translation: Whether in the course oFpractice or application,

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । रहस्यं वः प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपापनिकृन्तनम् । व्रतं पाशुपतं श्रौतमथर्वशिरसि श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | rahasyaM vaH pravakShyAmi sarvapApanikR^intanam | vrataM pAshupataM shrautamatharvashirasi shrutam
verses.translation: He shall perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra, pure in person and mind, with the tuft tied up,

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च जटिलो मुण्डी शिखैकजट एव वा । भूत्वा स्नात्वा ततो वीतलज्जश्चेत्स्याद्दिगम्बरः
verses.transliteration: tatashcha jaTilo muNDI shikhaikajaTa eva vA | bhUtvA snAtvA tato vItalajjashchetsyAddigambaraH
verses.translation: The MarKala shall be made as before and after wor¬ shipping the lord he shall, as before, place five water-jars one in each of the four quarters and one in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: अपि काषायवसनश्चर्मचीराम्बरोऽथ वा । एकाम्बरो वल्कली वा भवेद्दण्डी च मेखली
verses.transliteration: api kAShAyavasanashcharmachIrAmbaro.atha vA | ekAmbaro valkalI vA bhaveddaNDI cha mekhalI
verses.translation: Nivrtti Kala shall be installed in the vessel in the east, Piatistha Kala in the vessel in the west; Vidya Kala in the south. Santi Kala in the north and the Para Kala in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ पश्चाद् द्विराचम्यात्मनस्तनुम् । सङ्कुलीकृत्य तद्भस्म विरजानलसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: prakShAlya charaNau pashchAd dvirAchamyAtmanastanum | sa~NkulIkR^itya tadbhasma virajAnalasambhavam
verses.translation: The following rites shall be performed as before, viz. those of Raksa, the Mudrabandha or the gesture of the cow, repetition of mantra over the vessels and the homa till the Purriahuti.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरित्यादिभिर्मन्त्रैः षड्भिराथर्वणैः क्रमात् । विमृज्याङ्गानि मूर्द्धादिचरणान्तानि तैः स्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: agnirityAdibhirmantraiH ShaDbhirAtharvaNaiH kramAt | vimR^ijyA~NgAni mUrddhAdicharaNAntAni taiH spR^ishet
verses.translation: Then the lord shall be worshipped and his permiss¬ ion obtained ritualislically. He shall make the disciple sit on the seat for the pouring of water.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेन क्रमेणैव समुद्धृत्य च भस्मना । सर्वाङ्गोद्धूलनं कुर्यात्प्रणवेन शिवेन वा
verses.transliteration: tatastena krameNaiva samuddhR^itya cha bhasmanA | sarvA~NgoddhUlanaM kuryAtpraNavena shivena vA
verses.translation: The disciple imagined as the five-fold offering of fruits shall be united with the Kalas and conceived as Siva inasmuch as the mantra has been installed on his body; he shall be worshipped then.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्रिपुण्ड्रं रचयेत्त्रियायुषसमाह्वयम् । शिवभावं समागम्य शिवयोगमथाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: tatastripuNDraM rachayettriyAyuShasamAhvayam | shivabhAvaM samAgamya shivayogamathAcharet
verses.translation: Then the water from the vessels beginning with Nivrtti Kumbha and ending with the middle shall be poured over the disciple repeating the names of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात् त्रिसन्ध्यमप्येवमेतत्पाशुपतं व्रतम् । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं चैतत्पशुत्वं विनिवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: kuryAt trisandhyamapyevametatpAshupataM vratam | bhuktimuktipradaM chaitatpashutvaM vinivartayet
verses.translation: Then the preceptor shall place his hand, repeating the Siva mantra on the head of the disciple. The preceptor equipped with the piety towards Siva shall call him Sivacarya.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पशुत्वं परित्यज्य कृत्वा पाशुपतं व्रतम् । पूजनीयो महादेवो लिङ्गमूर्तिः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: tatpashutvaM parityajya kR^itvA pAshupataM vratam | pUjanIyo mahAdevo li~NgamUrtiH sanAtanaH
verses.translation: He shall be adorned. Then the preceptor shall propitiate him in Sivaman<;j[ala. After performing hundred and eight Ahutis he shall offer the Purnahuti.

verses.sanskrit: पद्ममष्टदलं हैमं नवरत्नैरलङ्कृतम् । कर्णिकाकेशरोपेतमासनं परिकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: padmamaShTadalaM haimaM navaratnairala~NkR^itam | karNikAkesharopetamAsanaM parikalpayet
verses.translation: The preceptor shall worship the lord and pros¬ trate on the ground with palms joined in reverence over the head. He shall submit to the lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: विभवे तदभावे तु रक्तं सितमथापि वा । पद्मं तस्याप्यभावे तु केवलं भावनामयम्
verses.transliteration: vibhave tadabhAve tu raktaM sitamathApi vA | padmaM tasyApyabhAve tu kevalaM bhAvanAmayam
verses.translation: ''O lord, by your grace this disciple has been made a preceptor by me. O lord, after blessing him, may the divine behest be bestowed on him.

verses.sanskrit: कालश्चैत्री पौर्णमासी देशः शिवपरिग्रहः । क्षेत्रारामाद्यरण्यं वा प्रशस्तः शुभलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: kAlashchaitrI paurNamAsI deshaH shivaparigrahaH | kShetrArAmAdyaraNyaM vA prashastaH shubhalakShaNaH
verses.translation: After submitting thus, the preceptor shall bow to Siva again along with the disciple. He shall worship the divine Siva-Agama in the same manner as Siva himself.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पद्मकर्णिकामध्ये कृत्वा लिङ्गं कनीयसम् । स्फीटिकं पीठिकोपेतं पूजयेद्विधिवत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tatpadmakarNikAmadhye kR^itvA li~NgaM kanIyasam | sphITikaM pIThikopetaM pUjayedvidhivatkramAt
verses.translation: Then he shall take the ritualistic permission from Siva. The preceptor shall take the book '*Sivajflana" with both the hands and hand it over to the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठाप्य विधानेन तल्लिङ्गं कृतशोधनम् । परिकल्प्यासनं मूर्तिं पञ्चवक्त्रप्रकारतः
verses.transliteration: pratiShThApya vidhAnena talli~NgaM kR^itashodhanam | parikalpyAsanaM mUrtiM pa~nchavaktraprakArataH
verses.translation: The preceptor shall give him royal paraphernalia since one who has attained the status of Acarya deserves even a kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चगव्यादिभिः पूर्णैर्यथाविभवसम्भृतैः । स्नापयेत्कलशैः पूर्णैरष्टापदसमुद्भवैः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchagavyAdibhiH pUrNairyathAvibhavasambhR^itaiH | snApayetkalashaiH pUrNairaShTApadasamudbhavaiH
verses.translation: Then he shall impart to him the modes of dis¬ cipline followed by elders as mentioned in Saivite sacred literature and as honoured amongst the people.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धद्रव्यैः सकर्पूरैश्चन्दनाद्यैः सकुङ्कुमैः । सवेदिकं समालिप्य लिङ्गं भूषणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: gandhadravyaiH sakarpUraishchandanAdyaiH saku~NkumaiH | savedikaM samAlipya li~NgaM bhUShaNabhUShitam
verses.translation: The preceptor shall test the disciples assiduously through the characteristics mentioned in Saivite scriptures. He shall consecrate them and impart to them the Saivite knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: बिल्वपत्रैश्च पद्मैश्च रक्तैः श्वेतैस्तथोत्पलैः । नीलोत्पलैस्तथान्यैश्च पुष्पैस्तैस्तैस्सुगन्धिभिः
verses.transliteration: bilvapatraishcha padmaishcha raktaiH shvetaistathotpalaiH | nIlotpalaistathAnyaishcha puShpaistaistaissugandhibhiH
verses.translation: He shall infuse in him all these qualities without difficulty, viz. purity, forbearance, niercifulness, non-covet¬ ousness and absence of jealousy even strenuously.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यैः प्रशस्तैः पत्रैश्च चित्रैर्दूर्वाक्षतादिभिः । समभ्यर्च्य यथालाभं महापूजाविधानतः
verses.transliteration: puNyaiH prashastaiH patraishcha chitrairdUrvAkShatAdibhiH | samabhyarchya yathAlAbhaM mahApUjAvidhAnataH
verses.translation: After thus urging the disciple he shall ritualistically dismiss Siva from the Mainala. He shall worship the Siva- kumbha, fire and otheis who had been invited there.

verses.sanskrit: धूपं दीपं तथा चापि नैवेद्यं च समादिशेत् । निवेदयित्वा विभवे कल्याणं च समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: dhUpaM dIpaM tathA chApi naivedyaM cha samAdishet | nivedayitvA vibhave kalyANaM cha samAcharet
verses.translation: Or the preceptor accompanied by his atten-

verses.sanskrit: इष्टानि च विशिष्टानि न्यायेनोपार्जितानि च । सर्वद्रव्याणि देयानि व्रते तस्मिन्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: iShTAni cha vishiShTAni nyAyenopArjitAni cha | sarvadravyANi deyAni vrate tasminvisheShataH
verses.translation: After homa the Tarpana rite of the mantra shall be performed. After the blessing of the lord the mantra shall be placed in the hand of the disciple and the remaining rites concluded.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीपत्रोत्पलपद्मानां सङ्ख्या साहस्रिकी मता । प्रत्येकमपरा सङ्ख्या शतमष्टोत्तरं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: shrIpatrotpalapadmAnAM sa~NkhyA sAhasrikI matA | pratyekamaparA sa~NkhyA shatamaShTottaraM dvijAH
verses.translation: Or beginning with the consecration of the Mantra and concluding with the rite of Abhiseka the rites of the purification of the path shall be performed by the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि च विशेषेण न त्यजेद्बिल्वपत्रकम् । हैममेकं परं प्राहुः पद्मं पद्मसहस्रकात्
verses.transliteration: tatrApi cha visheSheNa na tyajedbilvapatrakam | haimamekaM paraM prAhuH padmaM padmasahasrakAt
verses.translation: In the purificatory rite of the three Tattvas the rites mentioned for the Kalas l§antyatita and others shall be performed.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पूर्वं त्रयोदश्यां सुस्नातः सुकृताह्निकः । अनुज्ञाप्य स्वमाचार्यं सम्पूज्य प्रणिपत्य च
verses.transliteration: tatra pUrvaM trayodashyAM susnAtaH sukR^itAhnikaH | anuj~nApya svamAchAryaM sampUjya praNipatya cha
verses.translation: Siva, Vidya and Atmatattva — these are the three Tattvas. Siva came out of.*akti and from Siva the Vidya and from Vidya the Atman.

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलादिष्वप्येतत्समानं बिल्बपत्रकैः । पुष्पान्तरे न नियमो यथालाभं निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: nIlotpalAdiShvapyetatsamAnaM bilbapatrakaiH | puShpAntare na niyamo yathAlAbhaM nivedayet
verses.translation: Intelligent persons who have mastered Saivite Scrip¬ tures laud the consecration through Sakti after considering that the consecration through Siva is very difficult of access.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाङ्गमर्घ्यमुत्कृष्टं धूपालेपौ विशेषतः । चन्दनं वामदेवाख्ये हरितालं च पौरुषे
verses.transliteration: aShTA~NgamarghyamutkR^iShTaM dhUpAlepau visheShataH | chandanaM vAmadevAkhye haritAlaM cha pauruShe
verses.translation: O Kr§ua, thus the four types of consecratory rites have been narrated to you. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: ईशाने भसितं केचिदालेपनमितीदृशम् । न धूपमिति मन्यन्ते धूपान्तरविधानतः । सितागुरुमघोराख्ये मुखे कृष्णागुरुं पुनः
verses.transliteration: IshAne bhasitaM kechidAlepanamitIdR^isham | na dhUpamiti manyante dhUpAntaravidhAnataH | sitAgurumaghorAkhye mukhe kR^iShNAguruM punaH
verses.translation: O holy lord, I wish to hear the compulsory and optional rites of those who follow iSaivite conduct of life, as mentioned in Saivite scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: पौरुषे गुग्गुलं सद्ये सौम्ये सौगन्धिकं मुखे । ईशानेऽपि ह्युशीरादि देयाद् धूपं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: pauruShe guggulaM sadye saumye saugandhikaM mukhe | IshAne.api hyushIrAdi deyAd dhUpaM visheShataH
verses.translation: He shall rise early in the morning and meditate on the lord and the goddess For performing necessaries he shall go out of the house when the sun has risen.

verses.sanskrit: शर्करामधुकर्पूरकपिलाघृतसंयुतम् । चन्दनागरुकाष्ठाद्यं सामान्यं सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: sharkarAmadhukarpUrakapilAghR^itasaMyutam | chandanAgarukAShThAdyaM sAmAnyaM samprachakShate
verses.translation: On the eighth and other days whenever tooth-brush twig is not available he shall gargle twelve times and clean the teeth.

verses.sanskrit: कर्पूरवर्तिराज्याढ्या देया दीपावलिस्ततः । अर्घ्यमाचमनं देयं प्रतिवक्त्रमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: karpUravartirAjyADhyA deyA dIpAvalistataH | arghyamAchamanaM deyaM prativaktramataH param
verses.translation: After performing Acamana he shall take bath either in a river or in a pond or in an eddy or in the house itself.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमावरणे पूज्यौ क्रमाद्धेरम्बषण्मुखौ । ब्रह्माङ्गानि ततश्चैव प्रथमावरणेऽर्चिते
verses.transliteration: prathamAvaraNe pUjyau kramAddherambaShaNmukhau | brahmA~NgAni tatashchaiva prathamAvaraNe.archite
verses.translation: The toilet articles shall be kept on the bank. The dirt of the body shall be washed off. The clay shall be app¬ lied over the body. After taking bath he shall apply cow- dung over the body.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयावरणे पूज्या विघ्नेशाश्चक्रवर्तिनः । तृतीयावरणे पूज्या भवाद्या अष्टमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: dvitIyAvaraNe pUjyA vighneshAshchakravartinaH | tR^itIyAvaraNe pUjyA bhavAdyA aShTamUrtayaH
verses.translation: He shall take bath again and abandon the old cloth. Like a king he shall put on new dress.

verses.sanskrit: महादेवादयस्तत्र तथैकादशमूर्तयः । चतुर्थावरणे पूज्याः सर्व एव गणेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: mahAdevAdayastatra tathaikAdashamUrtayaH | chaturthAvaraNe pUjyAH sarva eva gaNeshvarAH
verses.translation: Neither a Brahmacarin nor an ascetic nor a widow shall take bath with the scented soaps. They shall not use tooth-brush twig for cleaning the teeth.

verses.sanskrit: बहिरेव तु पद्मस्य पञ्चमावरणे क्रमात् । दशदिक्पतयः पूज्याः सास्त्राः सानुचरास्तथा
verses.transliteration: bahireva tu padmasya pa~nchamAvaraNe kramAt | dashadikpatayaH pUjyAH sAstrAH sAnucharAstathA
verses.translation: He shall tie his tuft and have the sacred thread in the normal way. He shall enter water and plunge therein. After performing the Acamana he shall take plunge thrice in the water.

verses.sanskrit: पूजां वैशेषिकीं कृत्वा शुक्लाम्बरधरः स्वयम् । शुक्लयज्ञोपवीती च शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनः
verses.transliteration: pUjAM vaisheShikIM kR^itvA shuklAmbaradharaH svayam | shuklayaj~nopavItI cha shuklamAlyAnulepanaH
verses.translation: After plunging in, he shall repeat the mantra and think on Siva and l§akti. He shall get up and perform Aca¬ mana. Then he shall pour water over the body with the cow- horn along with Darbha, or with the leaf of a Palana tree, or the lotus leaf or with both the hands, five or three times.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो मानसाः पुत्राः सर्वेऽपि ज्योतिषां गणाः । सर्वा देव्यश्च देवाश्च सर्वे सर्वे च खेचराः
verses.transliteration: brahmaNo mAnasAH putrAH sarve.api jyotiShAM gaNAH | sarvA devyashcha devAshcha sarve sarve cha khecharAH
verses.translation: Or he shall take the self-bath. That is, one shal' repeat the name Siva. That bath wherein Siva is remem¬ bered is called the self-bath of a Yogin.

verses.sanskrit: पातालवासिनश्चान्ये सर्वे मुनिगणा अपि । योगिनो हि मखाः सर्वे पतङ्गा मातरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: pAtAlavAsinashchAnye sarve munigaNA api | yogino hi makhAH sarve pata~NgA mAtarastathA
verses.translation: In accordance with the rules prescribed in one's code he shall perform the rites of Tarpana for the gods beginning with Acamana and ending with Brahmayajfia.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रपालाश्च सगणाः सर्वं चैतच्चराचरम् । पूजनीयं शिवप्रीत्या मत्वा शम्भुविभूतिमत्
verses.transliteration: kShetrapAlAshcha sagaNAH sarvaM chaitachcharAcharam | pUjanIyaM shivaprItyA matvA shambhuvibhUtimat
verses.translation: Meditating on lord Siva stationed in the Mani;iala and worshipping him duly he shall offer Arghya to Siva in the form of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: अथावरणपूजान्ते सम्पूज्य परमेश्वरम् । साज्यं सव्यजनं हृद्यं हविर्भक्त्या निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: athAvaraNapUjAnte sampUjya parameshvaram | sAjyaM savyajanaM hR^idyaM havirbhaktyA nivedayet
verses.translation: Or after performing what is prescribed in one's own Sutra he shall wash his hands and perform the rite of Karanyasa. He shall make his body united with the Kalas through water taken in the left palm and containing scents and white mustard. He shall then sprinkle water over him through the bunch of Kusa grass repeating the mantras 'Apo hi §tha'*' etc. accompanied by the basic mantra. Sniffing at the water remaining in the left nostril he shall think on lord Siva again.

verses.sanskrit: मुखवासादिकं दत्त्वा ताम्बूलं सोपदंशकम् । अलङ्कृत्य च भूयोऽपि नानापुष्पविभूषणैः
verses.transliteration: mukhavAsAdikaM dattvA tAmbUlaM sopadaMshakam | ala~NkR^itya cha bhUyo.api nAnApuShpavibhUShaNaiH
verses.translation: Taking off the dark-complexioned sin of the body through the left nostril and that outside, he shall conceive it as gone to the rock.

verses.sanskrit: नीराजनान्ते विस्तीर्य पूजाशेषं समापयेत् । चषकं सोपकारं च शयनं च समर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: nIrAjanAnte vistIrya pUjAsheShaM samApayet | chaShakaM sopakAraM cha shayanaM cha samarpayet
verses.translation: With a handful of red sandal water he shall make a circular Mandala on the ground and embellish it with red powder.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रसङ्काशहारं च शयनीयं समर्पयेत् । आद्यं नृपोचितं हृद्यं तत्सर्वमनुरूपतः
verses.transliteration: chandrasa~NkAshahAraM cha shayanIyaM samarpayet | AdyaM nR^ipochitaM hR^idyaM tatsarvamanurUpataH
verses.translation: There he shall worship the sun with the covers along with his ancillaries repeating the mantra "Khakholkaya" for securing happiness.*'®

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा च कारयित्वा च हुत्वा च प्रतिपूजनम् । व्योमेशस्तवं जप्त्वा विद्यां पञ्चाक्षरीं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA cha kArayitvA cha hutvA cha pratipUjanam | vyomeshastavaM japtvA vidyAM pa~nchAkSharIM japet
verses.translation: VS. II. 50

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणां प्रणामं च कृत्वात्मानं समर्पयेत् । ततः पुरस्ताद्देवस्य गुरुविप्रौ च पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: pradakShiNAM praNAmaM cha kR^itvAtmAnaM samarpayet | tataH purastAddevasya guruviprau cha pUjayet
verses.translation: Khakholk&ya svihi. MahSn. U. 2u. 23.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वार्घ्यमष्टौ पुष्पाणि देवमुद्वास्य लिङ्गतः । अग्नेश्चाग्निं सुसंयम्य ह्युद्वास्य च तमप्युत
verses.transliteration: dattvArghyamaShTau puShpANi devamudvAsya li~NgataH | agneshchAgniM susaMyamya hyudvAsya cha tamapyuta
verses.translation: He shall make another Maijiala and worship it with its ancillaries. He shall place there a gold-vessel of the size' of the Prastha*'* current in the Magadha land. He shall fill it with scented water and red sandal along with red fldwers, gingelly seeds, Akatas and Kua grass.

verses.sanskrit: दर्भासने समासीनो दर्भमुष्टिं प्रगृह्य च । प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा प्राङ्मुखो वाप्युदङ्मुखः । ध्यात्वा देवं च देवीं च तद्विज्ञापनवर्त्मना
verses.transliteration: darbhAsane samAsIno darbhamuShTiM pragR^ihya cha | prANAyAmatrayaM kR^itvA prA~Nmukho vApyuda~NmukhaH | dhyAtvA devaM cha devIM cha tadvij~nApanavartmanA
verses.translation: Or it can contain Durva, Apamarga and other articles or mere water. He shall keep that pot over his head. Kneeling down he shall bow to the lord in the tid

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यहं च जनस्त्वेवं कुर्यात्सेवां पुरोदिताम् । ततस्तत्साम्बुजं लिङ्गं सर्वोपकरणान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: pratyahaM cha janastvevaM kuryAtsevAM puroditAm | tatastatsAmbujaM li~NgaM sarvopakaraNAnvitam
verses.translation: Then repeating the basic mantra he shall touch all parts of the body and wear another cloth. After perfor¬ ming Acamana twice he shall sprinkle water over himself eleven times repeating the mantra. He shall wear another cloth, perform Acamana twice and remember Siva.

verses.sanskrit: समर्पयेत्स्वगुरवे स्थापयेद्वा शिवालये । सम्पूज्य च गुरून्विप्रान् व्रतिनश्च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: samarpayetsvagurave sthApayedvA shivAlaye | sampUjya cha gurUnviprAn vratinashcha visheShataH
verses.translation: He shall perform Karanyasa again and repeating the mantra he shall apply the Tripundra marks. On the fore¬ head the marks shall be clear, broad and straight. Scented water shall be used to paste the Bhasma.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तान्द्विजांश्च शक्तश्चेद्दीनानाथांश्च तोषयेत् । स्वयं चानशने शक्तः फलमूलाशनोऽथ वा
verses.transliteration: bhaktAndvijAMshcha shaktashcheddInAnAthAMshcha toShayet | svayaM chAnashane shaktaH phalamUlAshano.atha vA
verses.translation: The Rudraka bead with the lustre of gold is excellent. It shall not be cut. What is not worn by others is the most auspicious. To the three castes the colours yellow, red and black are respectively excellent.

verses.sanskrit: पयोव्रतो वा भिक्षाशी भवेदेकाशनस्तथा । नक्तं युक्ताशनो नित्यं भूशय्यानिरतः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: payovrato vA bhikShAshI bhavedekAshanastathA | naktaM yuktAshano nityaM bhUshayyAnirataH shuchiH
verses.translation: Impure men shall not wear the Rudrak$a bead. Everyone shall take bath twice, twice or once a day accor¬ ding to his strength, and worship the lord seated in a char¬ ming pose in the pedestal.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मशायी तृणेशायी चीराजिनधृतोऽथ वा । ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतो नित्यं व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: bhasmashAyI tR^iNeshAyI chIrAjinadhR^ito.atha vA | brahmacharyavrato nityaM vratametatsamAcharet
verses.translation: He shall face the east or the north while meditat¬ ing on the lord and the goddess. He shall worship the pre¬ ceptor and the disciples from Sveta to Nakulia.*'*

verses.sanskrit: अर्कवारे तथार्द्रायां पञ्चदश्यां च पक्षयोः । अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां शक्तस्तूपवसेदपि
verses.transliteration: arkavAre tathArdrAyAM pa~nchadashyAM cha pakShayoH | aShTamyAM cha chaturdashyAM shaktastUpavasedapi
verses.translation: Again he shall bow to the lord and repeat his eight*" names, viz. Siva, Mahesvara, Rudra, Vi9nu, Pitamaha Samsaravaidya, SarvajAa and Paramatman. Or he shall repeat the name Siva eleven times or more.

verses.sanskrit: पाखण्डिपतितोदक्याः सूतकान्त्यजपूर्वकान् । वर्जयेत्सर्वयत्नेन मनसा कर्मणा गिरा
verses.transliteration: pAkhaNDipatitodakyAH sUtakAntyajapUrvakAn | varjayetsarvayatnena manasA karmaNA girA
verses.translation: For the removal of sickness he shall meditate on the mass of splendour at the tip of his tongue. He shall wash his feet and apply sandal paste on his hands. He shall perform Karanyasa after wiping off his hands.

verses.sanskrit: क्षमादानदयासत्याहिंसाशीलः सदा भवेत् । सन्तुष्टश्च प्रशान्तश्च जपध्यानरतस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kShamAdAnadayAsatyAhiMsAshIlaH sadA bhavet | santuShTashcha prashAntashcha japadhyAnaratastathA

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात्त्रिषवणस्नानं भस्मस्नानमथापि वा । पूजां वैशेषिकीं चैव मनसा वचसा गिरा
verses.transliteration: kuryAttriShavaNasnAnaM bhasmasnAnamathApi vA | pUjAM vaisheShikIM chaiva manasA vachasA girA
verses.translation: Nyasa*'* is of thfee types: Sthiti, Utpatti and Laya. The first is for householders, the second for Brahmaca- rins, the third for ascetics, forest-dwellers and widows. For housewives the Sthitinyasa is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन नाचरेदशिवं व्रती । प्रमादात्तु तथाचारे निरूप्य गुरुलाघवे
verses.transliteration: bahunAtra kimuktena nAcharedashivaM vratI | pramAdAttu tathAchAre nirUpya gurulAghave
verses.translation: For a virgin Utpatti Nyasa is praiseworthy. I shall now mention the characteristics of the Nyasas. The procedure from the thumb to the little finger is the Sthiti- nyasa. The procedure from the right thumb to the left little finger is the Utpattinya. The reverse is Samhrti(Laya).

verses.sanskrit: व्रतमेतत्करोमीति भवेत्सङ्कल्प्य दीक्षितः । यावच्छरीरपातं वा द्वादशाब्दमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: vratametatkaromIti bhavetsa~Nkalpya dIkShitaH | yAvachCharIrapAtaM vA dvAdashAbdamathApi vA
verses.translation: The letters "Na'* etc. along with the Hindus shall be fixed in order in the fingers. Siva shall be fixed on the palms and on the little fingers.

verses.sanskrit: उचितां निष्कृतिं कुर्यात्पूजाहोमजपादिभिः । आसमाप्तेर्व्रतस्यैवमाचरेन्न प्रमादतः
verses.transliteration: uchitAM niShkR^itiM kuryAtpUjAhomajapAdibhiH | AsamAptervratasyaivamAcharenna pramAdataH
verses.translation: The Astranyasa shall be made in the ten quarters by means of the Astramantra. The five Kalas — Nivrtti etc. in the form of the five elements along with the lords of the elements and accompanied by their respective symbols shall be fixed in the chest, neck, palate, middle of the eye-brows and the Brahmarandhra. One shall conceive them in the different Bijas.

verses.sanskrit: गोदानं च वृषोत्सर्गं कुर्यात्पूजां च सम्पदा । भक्तश्च शिवप्रीत्यर्थं सर्वकामविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: godAnaM cha vR^iShotsargaM kuryAtpUjAM cha sampadA | bhaktashcha shivaprItyarthaM sarvakAmavivarjitaH
verses.translation: In order to purify them one shall perform the Japa of the five-.syllabled mantra. Restraining the vital breath thrice he shall cut off the knot of the elements lepeating the Astra mantra and showing the mystic gesture of Astra. The Atman urged by the vital breath through the Su$umna vein and going out through the Brahmarandhra shall be united with the l§aivite splendour.

verses.sanskrit: सामान्यमेतत्कथितं व्रतस्यास्य समासतः । प्रतिमासं विशेषं च प्रवदामि यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sAmAnyametatkathitaM vratasyAsya samAsataH | pratimAsaM visheShaM cha pravadAmi yathAshrutam
verses.translation: Afterwards the body is withered up by the wind burnt by the deadly fire. Then upwardly the Kalas are dissolved through the wind. Dissolviqg the burnt body and touching the Kalas with the ocean he shall drench and flood the body through Amftas and keep it in its normal

verses.sanskrit: वैशाखे वज्रलिङ्गं तु ज्येष्ठे मारकतं शुभम् । आषाढे मौक्तिकं विद्याच्छ्रावणे नीलनिर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: vaishAkhe vajrali~NgaM tu jyeShThe mArakataM shubham | AShADhe mauktikaM vidyAchChrAvaNe nIlanirmitam
verses.translation: In the body consisting of Vidya, he shall join the Atman that has come out of liva in the form of the flame of a lamp. He shall join it through the Brahmarandhra.

verses.sanskrit: मासे भाद्रपदे चैव पद्मरागमयं परम् । आश्विने मासि विद्याद्वै लिङ्गं गोमेदकं वरम्
verses.transliteration: mAse bhAdrapade chaiva padmarAgamayaM param | Ashvine mAsi vidyAdvai li~NgaM gomedakaM varam
verses.translation: After meditating on the Atman that has entered the body, in the lotus of the heart, he shall sprinkle with the shower of nectar the body consisting of Vidya.

verses.sanskrit: कार्तिक्यां वैद्रुमं लिङ्गं वैदूर्यं मार्गशीर्षके । पुष्परागमयं पौषे माघे द्युमणिजं तथा
verses.transliteration: kArtikyAM vaidrumaM li~NgaM vaidUryaM mArgashIrShake | puShparAgamayaM pauShe mAghe dyumaNijaM tathA
verses.translation: Then he shall perform the rite of Karanyasa after duly purifying it. Thereafter he shall perform the Dehanya by means of the great Mudra.

verses.sanskrit: फाल्गुणे चन्द्रकान्तोत्थं चैत्रे तद्व्यत्ययोऽथवा । सर्वमासेषु रत्नानामलाभे हैममेव वा
verses.transliteration: phAlguNe chandrakAntotthaM chaitre tadvyatyayo.athavA | sarvamAseShu ratnAnAmalAbhe haimameva vA
verses.translation: After performing the rite of Ahganyasa in the manner mentioned by Siva, he shall perform the Varnanyasa in the joints of hands, feet and other parts of the body.

verses.sanskrit: हैमाभावे राजतं वा ताम्रजं शैलजं तथा । मृण्मयं वा यथालाभं जातुषं चान्यदेव वा
verses.transliteration: haimAbhAve rAjataM vA tAmrajaM shailajaM tathA | mR^iNmayaM vA yathAlAbhaM jAtuShaM chAnyadeva vA
verses.translation: After the Nyasa of the six limbs accompanied by six types, he shall bind the quarters from the south-east onwards.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगन्धमयं वाथ लिङ्गं कुर्याद्यथारुचि । व्रतावसानसमये समाचरितनित्यकः
verses.transliteration: sarvagandhamayaM vAtha li~NgaM kuryAdyathAruchi | vratAvasAnasamaye samAcharitanityakaH
verses.translation: Or he need p>erform only the Nyasa of the five limbs beginning with the head. Similarly the Nyasa of six limbs without the rites of purification etc. of the Bhutas shall be i>erformcd.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा वैशेषिकीं पूजां हुत्वा चैव यथा पुरा । सम्पूज्य च तथाचार्यं व्रतिनश्च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA vaisheShikIM pUjAM hutvA chaiva yathA purA | sampUjya cha tathAchAryaM vratinashcha visheShataH
verses.translation: Thus he shall succinctly perform the purification of the body and Atman. Attaining the status of Siva he shall worship Parameivara.

verses.sanskrit: तदर्धं वा तदर्धं वा मासद्वादशकं तु वा । तदर्धं वा तदर्धं वा मासमेकमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: tadardhaM vA tadardhaM vA mAsadvAdashakaM tu vA | tadardhaM vA tadardhaM vA mAsamekamathApi vA
verses.translation: The first is Matfkanyasa; the next is Brahma- nyasa; Prapavanyasa is the third; the next is Hamsa Nyasa and the fifth Nyasa is mentioned as Paftcak§aratmaka (consisting of the five-syllabled mantra).

verses.sanskrit: देशिकेनाप्यनुज्ञातः प्राङ्मुखो वाप्युदङ्मुखः । दर्भासनो दर्भपाणिः प्राणापानौ नियम्य च
verses.transliteration: deshikenApyanuj~nAtaH prA~Nmukho vApyuda~NmukhaH | darbhAsano darbhapANiH prANApAnau niyamya cha
verses.translation: The Nyasa of the various letters is as follows: — the letter A in the head; A in the forehead; 'I' and 1 in the eyes; "U" and "U" in the ears; "R" and "R." in the cheek; 'Ir' and 'Ir' in the nostrils; 'e' and "ai" in the lips; o and '*au" in the rows of teeth; 'arh" in the tougue and '*al>" in the palate; the gutturals are in the five joints of the right hand; the palatals in the joints of the left hand; The hnguals and the Dentals in the legs; Pa and Pha in the sides; 'Ba" in the back and «'Bha*' in the navel; *'Ma" in the heart; "Ya" to "Sa" in the seven constituent elements,

verses.sanskrit: जपित्वा शक्तितो मूलं ध्यात्वा साम्बं त्रियम्बकम् । अनुज्ञाप्य यथापूर्वं नमस्कृत्य कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: japitvA shaktito mUlaM dhyAtvA sAmbaM triyambakam | anuj~nApya yathApUrvaM namaskR^itya kR^itA~njaliH
verses.translation: After performing the Nyasa of the letters in the manner of fifty Rudras the five Brahmans shall be fixed in the limbs, face etc. and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: समुत्सृजामि भगवन् व्रतमेतत्त्वदाज्ञया । इत्युक्त्वा लिङ्गमूलस्थान्दर्भानुत्तरतस्त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: samutsR^ijAmi bhagavan vratametattvadAj~nayA | ityuktvA li~NgamUlasthAndarbhAnuttaratastyajet
verses.translation: The Karanyasa may or may not be performed through them. The Brahmans shall be fixed in the head, face, chest, private parts and legs.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दण्डजटाचीरमेखला अपि चोत्सृजेत् । पुनराचम्य विधिवत्पञ्चाक्षरमुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: tato daNDajaTAchIramekhalA api chotsR^ijet | punarAchamya vidhivatpa~nchAkSharamudIrayet
verses.translation: The Kalas of liana are five; these are fixed in the five faces beginning with the one above and ending with the one in the west.

verses.sanskrit: यः कृत्वात्यन्तिकीं दीक्षामादेहान्तमनाकुलः । व्रतमेतत्प्रकुर्वीत स तु वै नैष्ठिकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yaH kR^itvAtyantikIM dIkShAmAdehAntamanAkulaH | vratametatprakurvIta sa tu vai naiShThikaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Then the four Kalas of Puru$a shall be fixed in the four faces beginning with the' one in the east.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽत्याश्रमी च विज्ञेयो महापाशुपतस्तथा । स एव तपतां श्रेष्ठः स एव च महाव्रती
verses.transliteration: so.atyAshramI cha vij~neyo mahApAshupatastathA | sa eva tapatAM shreShThaH sa eva cha mahAvratI
verses.translation: Th" eight Kalas of Aghora shall be fixed in the heart, neck, shoulders, navel, belly, back and the chest; then the thirteen Kalas of Vamadeva are fixed in the anus, penis, thighs, knees, calves, hips, buttocks, side», nose, head and the arms. Thus the experts perform the Nyasa of the thirtyeight Kalas in due order.

verses.sanskrit: न तेन सदृशः कश्चित्कृतकृत्यो मुमुक्षुषु । यो यतिर्नैष्ठिको जातस्तमाहुर्नैष्ठिकोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: na tena sadR^ishaH kashchitkR^itakR^ityo mumukShuShu | yo yatirnaiShThiko jAtastamAhurnaiShThikottamam
verses.translation: Afterwards the experts ofPranava shall per¬ form the Pranavanyasa in the arms, elbows wrists, sides, belly, thighs, calves and the back. After performing the Pranavanyasa thus, the expert devotee shall perform the Hamsanya as mentioned in Saivite scriptures, in the eyes, nostrils, arms, eyes, face, forehead, armpits sides, breasts, hips, hands and heels. Or in the manner of five limbs the Nyasa shall be performed. Then he shall perform the Nyasa of the five-syllabled mantra.

verses.sanskrit: योऽन्वहं द्वादशाहं वा व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत् । सोऽपि नैष्ठिकतुल्यः स्यात्तीव्रव्रतसमन्वयात्
verses.transliteration: yo.anvahaM dvAdashAhaM vA vratametatsamAcharet | so.api naiShThikatulyaH syAttIvravratasamanvayAt
verses.translation: A person with a desire, even when he enjoys those pleasures becomes more and more attached to lust. If he is without desire he enjoys pleasures in Rudra's abode and after a descent therefrom is reborn as a person engaged in Tapoyajfia. There is no doubt in this. An ascetic enjoys pleasures in Rudra's abode and after a fall therefrom is reborn in the world as a man devoted to Japa and Dhyana. Such a man devoted to Japa and Dhyana, thanks to heir excellence, attains knowledge ere long, and thereby attains Siva*s Sayujya. Hence he becomes a liberated soul even when he is devoted to Karmayajfia at the behest of Siva, if he is without desire. But a person with lust will always be in bondage. Hence one shall be devoted to Dhyana and Jfiana among the five Yajfias.

verses.sanskrit: घृताक्तो यश्चरेदेतद् व्रतं व्रतपरायणः । द्वित्रैकदिवसं वापि स च कश्चन नैष्ठिकः
verses.transliteration: ghR^itAkto yashcharedetad vrataM vrataparAyaNaH | dvitraikadivasaM vApi sa cha kashchana naiShThikaH
verses.translation: He who has meditation and knowledge crosses the ocean of worldly existence. Dhyanayajfia which is freedom from the defects of violence etc. is a pure mental process for salvation and is therefore the greatest means. Just as the persons working outside the palace are seen not enjoying much of the benefits within the royal palace so also the Karmins. To those who meditate, the subtle body of Ivara becomes visible. But to the Karmins, only the clay, wood etc. are visible. Hence those who are devoted to Dhya¬ nayajfia do not accept deities in the form of stone and day, since they know the reality of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्यमित्येव निष्कामो यश्चरेद् व्रतमुत्तमम् । शिवार्पितात्मा सततं न तेन सदृशः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: kR^ityamityeva niShkAmo yashchared vratamuttamam | shivArpitAtmA satataM na tena sadR^ishaH kvachit
verses.translation: The man who eschews Siva stationed in the Atman and w'orships him externally, resigns the fruit in his hand and licks his elbow. From knowledge, meditation is generated and from meditation knowledge functions better. Through these two, one attains liberation. Hence one shall be devoted to meditation.

verses.sanskrit: दिनद्वादशकं वाथ दिनषट्कमथापि वा । तदर्धं दिनमेकं वा व्रतसङ्कल्पनावधि
verses.transliteration: dinadvAdashakaM vAtha dinaShaTkamathApi vA | tadardhaM dinamekaM vA vratasa~NkalpanAvadhi
verses.translation: One shall worship the lord and the goddess by • means of external service, or with the mind full of faith meditate on them in the twelve-petalied lotus, head, forehead, the middle of the eyebrows, the tip of the nose, face, neck, heart, navel or in any permanent spot. Or he shall worship in a phallic image or an embodied idol or in an

verses.sanskrit: भस्मच्छन्नो द्विजो विद्वान्महापातकसम्भवैः । पापैः सुदारुणैः सद्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhasmachChanno dvijo vidvAnmahApAtakasambhavaiH | pApaiH sudAruNaiH sadyo muchyate nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: I shall briefly give a commentary to the rules governing worships mentioned by Siva to Siva in the Saivite scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राग्निर्यत्परं वीर्यं तद्भस्म परिकीर्तितम् । तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु वीर्यवान्भस्मसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: rudrAgniryatparaM vIryaM tadbhasma parikIrtitam | tasmAtsarveShu kAleShu vIryavAnbhasmasaMyutaH
verses.translation: With or without performing the internal worship which is its ancillary and which concludes with the rites in fire, one shall perform the external worship.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मनिष्ठस्य नश्यन्ति देषा भस्माग्निसङ्गमात् । भस्मस्नानविशुद्धात्मा भस्मनिष्ठ इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: bhasmaniShThasya nashyanti deShA bhasmAgnisa~NgamAt | bhasmasnAnavishuddhAtmA bhasmaniShTha iti smR^itaH
verses.translation: The materials arc mentally conceived and purified. After meditating on Vinayaka and worshipping the lord in accordance with the injunctions, the learned devotee shall propitiate Nandisa and Suyasa in the south and the north and ofier mentally well-conceived seat.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मना दिग्धसर्वाङ्गो भस्मदीप्तत्रिपुण्ड्रकः । भस्मस्नायी च पुरुषो भस्मनिष्ठ इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: bhasmanA digdhasarvA~Ngo bhasmadIptatripuNDrakaH | bhasmasnAyI cha puruSho bhasmaniShTha iti smR^itaH
verses.translation: It may be a throne or a yogic scat or lotus-seat equipped with the three principles."*

verses.sanskrit: भूतप्रेतपिशासाश्च रोगाश्चातीव दुस्सहाः । भस्मनिष्ठस्य सान्निध्याद् विद्रवन्ति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhUtapretapishAsAshcha rogAshchAtIva dussahAH | bhasmaniShThasya sAnnidhyAd vidravanti na saMshayaH
verses.translation: His hands show the gestures of granting the boon and protection. He holds the deer and an axe. He Kas serpents for necklaces and bangles. His neck is chnnpSlgly blue.

verses.sanskrit: भासनाद्भसितं प्रोक्तं भस्म कल्मषभक्षणात् । भूतिः भूतिकरी चैव रक्षा रक्षाकरी परम्
verses.transliteration: bhAsanAdbhasitaM proktaM bhasma kalmaShabhakShaNAt | bhUtiH bhUtikarI chaiva rakShA rakShAkarI param
verses.translation: Her complexion has the lustre of the petals of a blue lotus. She has the half modn for her coronet. Her breasts are round, weighty, lifted up, smooth nad plump.

verses.sanskrit: किमन्यदिह वक्तव्यं भस्ममाहात्म्यकारणम् । व्रती च भस्मना स्नातः स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kimanyadiha vaktavyaM bhasmamAhAtmyakAraNam | vratI cha bhasmanA snAtaH svayaM devo maheshvaraH
verses.translation: She shines with flowers of various colours embellish¬ ing her braid of hair. In fevery respect her features are in consonance with her qualities. Due to bashfulness her face is slightly lowered.

verses.sanskrit: परमास्त्रं च शैवानां भस्मैतत्पारमेश्वरम् । धौम्याग्रजस्य तपसि व्यापदो यन्निवारिताः
verses.transliteration: paramAstraM cha shaivAnAM bhasmaitatpArameshvaram | dhaumyAgrajasya tapasi vyApado yannivAritAH
verses.translation: In her right hand she bears a shining golden lotus. She is seated on a splendid seat with the other hand placed on it like a supporting staff.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कृत्वा पाशुपतव्रतम् । धनवद्भस्म सङ्गृह्य भस्मस्नानरतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAtsarvaprayatnena kR^itvA pAshupatavratam | dhanavadbhasma sa~NgR^ihya bhasmasnAnarato bhavet
verses.translation: She splits the Pala. She is in the form of exis¬ tence, knowledge and bliss. After conceiving the lord and the goddess thus and meditating on them in an excellent auspicious seat, the devotee shall worship with piety as flowers along with all types of service. Or he can conceive the form of the lord in any of the following ways: — as $iva, Sadasiva, Mahesvara, or as one havihg the name of twenty- six principles or as rikantha. Just as Mantra Nyasa is performed in the body so also in this form the devotee can meditate on embodied iiva who is beyond Sat and Asat as in the manner of external worship. He shall complete the wor¬ ship mentally.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The obstacles shall be warded off. The place shall be veiled with Varma mantra. After performing the rite of Astranyasa in the quarters, the place of worship shall be ar¬ ranged.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The obstacles shall be warded off. The place shall be veiled with Varma mantra. After performing the rite of Astranyasa in the quarters, the place of worship shall be ar¬ ranged.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.१.३४. चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । उपमन्युतपोवर्णनम् । ऋषय ऊचुः । धौम्याग्रजेन शिशुना क्षीरार्थं हि तपः कृतम् । तस्मात् क्षीरार्णवो दत्तस्तस्मै देवेन शूलिना
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.1\.34\. chatustriMsho.adhyAyaH | upamanyutapovarNanam | R^iShaya UchuH | dhaumyAgrajena shishunA kShIrArthaM hi tapaH kR^itam | tasmAt kShIrArNavo dattastasmai devena shUlinA
verses.translation: Darbha grass shall be strewn over and washed by means of sprinkling. After cleaning the vessels he shall sanctify the materials.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टं तु कारणं तस्य शिवज्ञानसमन्वये । स्वमातृवचनं साक्षाच्छोकजं क्षीरकारणात्
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTaM tu kAraNaM tasya shivaj~nAnasamanvaye | svamAtR^ivachanaM sAkShAchChokajaM kShIrakAraNAt
verses.translation: He shall wash and sprinkle the vessels®®® of Prok§ani Arghya, Padya and Acamanlya. After examining them he shall pour auspicious water therein. He shall place holy materials of worship there to the extent of their availability.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित्क्षीरमत्यल्पं पीतवान्मातुलाश्रमे । ईर्ष्यया मातुलसुतं सन्तृप्तक्षीरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kadAchitkShIramatyalpaM pItavAnmAtulAshrame | IrShyayA mAtulasutaM santR^iptakShIramuttamam
verses.translation: The holy materials of worship are many such as gems, silver, gold, scents, flowers, Aksatas, fruits, sprouts and Darbha grass.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा स्थितं यथाकामं दृष्ट्वा वै मातुलात्मजम् । उपमन्युर्व्याघ्रपादिः प्रीत्या प्रोवाच मातरम्
verses.transliteration: pItvA sthitaM yathAkAmaM dR^iShTvA vai mAtulAtmajam | upamanyurvyAghrapAdiH prItyA provAcha mAtaram
verses.translation: In the water for ablutiop and particularly in that

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । मातर्मातर्महाभागे मम देहि तपस्विनि । गव्यं क्षीरमतिस्वादु नाल्पमुष्णं पिबाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | mAtarmAtarmahAbhAge mama dehi tapasvini | gavyaM kShIramatisvAdu nAlpamuShNaM pibAmyaham
verses.translation: Prok;aol, Arghya, P&dya and Acamanlya are the vessels con¬ taining holy water to be used in the religious ceremonies. Prokanl contains water used for sprinkling or consecrating, Arghya for respectful ofTcring, Padya for washing the feet and Acamanlya for supping.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । तच्छ्रुत्वा पुत्रवचनं तन्माता च तपस्विनी । व्याघ्रपादस्य महिषी दुःखमापत्तदा च सा
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | tachChrutvA putravachanaM tanmAtA cha tapasvinI | vyAghrapAdasya mahiShI duHkhamApattadA cha sA
verses.translation: Sandal and Uira shall be put in the Padya water. In the Acamsmiya, nutmeg, berry, camphor, Bahumflla, and Tamalaka shall be put, preferably powdered* Cardamom seeds, camphor and sandal can be put in the vessels.

verses.sanskrit: उपलाल्याथ सुप्रीत्या पुत्रमालिङ्ग्य सादरम् । दुःखिता विललापाथ स्मृत्वा नैर्धन्यमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: upalAlyAtha suprItyA putramAli~Ngya sAdaram | duHkhitA vilalApAtha smR^itvA nairdhanyamAtmanaH
verses.translation: The following materials shall be put in the Prokani vessel: — KuSa, flowers, Yava grains, Bahumula and Tamalaka along with Bhasma.

verses.sanskrit: स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वा पुनः क्षीरमुपमन्युः स बालकः । देहि देहीति तामाह रुद्रन्भूयो महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: smR^itvA smR^itvA punaH kShIramupamanyuH sa bAlakaH | dehi dehIti tAmAha rudranbhUyo mahAdyutiH
verses.translation: Every vessel shall be blessed by chanting the mantras; externally covered by the Varma mantra and protected by Astra mantra. He shall show the Mudra of cow.

verses.sanskrit: तद् हठं सा परिज्ञाय द्विजपत्नी तपस्विनी । शान्तये तद् हठस्याथ शुभोपायमरीरचत्
verses.transliteration: tad haThaM sA parij~nAya dvijapatnI tapasvinI | shAntaye tad haThasyAtha shubhopAyamarIrachat
verses.translation: He shall purify the materials of worship by means of the water from the vessel ProksanI sprinkled on them repeating the basic mantra.

verses.sanskrit: उञ्छवृत्त्यार्जितान्बीजान्स्वयं दृष्ट्वा च सा तदा । बीजपिष्टमथालोड्य तोयेन कलभाषिणी
verses.transliteration: u~nChavR^ittyArjitAnbIjAnsvayaM dR^iShTvA cha sA tadA | bIjapiShTamathAloDya toyena kalabhAShiNI
verses.translation: If all the vessels are not available the excellent aspirant shall arrange the vessel Prokani in every holy rite. Arghya etc. shall be performed by the water therefrom.

verses.sanskrit: एह्येहि मम पुत्रेति सामपूर्वं ततः सुतम् । आलिङ्ग्यादाय दुःखार्ता प्रददौ कृत्रिमं पयः
verses.transliteration: ehyehi mama putreti sAmapUrvaM tataH sutam | Ali~NgyAdAya duHkhArtA pradadau kR^itrimaM payaH
verses.translation: Lord Vinayaka shall be worshipped with various foodstuffs. After that, near the southern doorway he shall duly worship the chief of harem Nandin himself. He resem¬ bles the golden mountain in lustre. He is bedecked in all ornaments. The crescent moon is his coronet. He is gentle. He has three eyes and four arms. He is:he lord bearing shining trident, deer, axe and sharp-pointed baton. His face

verses.sanskrit: स कथं शिशुको लेभे शिवशास्त्रप्रवक्तृताम् । कथं वा शिवसद्भावं ज्ञात्वा तपसि निष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: sa kathaM shishuko lebhe shivashAstrapravaktR^itAm | kathaM vA shivasadbhAvaM j~nAtvA tapasi niShThitaH
verses.translation: In the north the wife of the doorkeeper, the daughter of the Maruts, Suya who bedecks the feet of Amba shall be worshipped. He shall enter the sanctum sanctorum of Brahma and worship the Lihga. The remnants of the previous worship shall be removed. It shall be washed..The flower shall be worn on the head for the sake of purity.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा च कृत्रिमं क्षीरं मात्रां दत्तं स बालकः । नैतत्क्षीरमिति प्राह मातरं चातिविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: pItvA cha kR^itrimaM kShIraM mAtrAM dattaM sa bAlakaH | naitatkShIramiti prAha mAtaraM chAtivihvalaH
verses.translation: With the flower in the hand he shall perform the Japa of the mantra up to the extent of his ability for the purity; through the Mantra Caneja shall be worshipped in the north-east and the Nirmalya given over to him

verses.sanskrit: दुःखिता सा तदा प्राह सम्प्रेक्ष्याघ्राय मूर्द्धनि । सम्मार्ज्य नेत्र पुत्रस्य कराभ्यां कमलायते
verses.transliteration: duHkhitA sA tadA prAha samprekShyAghrAya mUrddhani | sammArjya netra putrasya karAbhyAM kamalAyate
verses.translation: Thereafter the seats Adhara etc. shall be conceived. The Adhara §akti shall be meditated upon as dark-complexioned and auspicious resting on the ground. In front of Adhara &ikti the serpent of curly form with uplifted neck shall be conceived. He is white in colour with five hoods seeming to lick the sky. Above that is the seat in the form of a lion of four feet. The feet are virtue, knowledge, absence of attachment, glory and prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: जनन्युवाच । तटिनी रत्नपूर्णास्ताः स्वर्गपातालगोचराः । भाग्यहीना न पश्यन्ति भक्तिहीनाश्च ये शिवे
verses.transliteration: jananyuvAcha | taTinI ratnapUrNAstAH svargapAtAlagocharAH | bhAgyahInA na pashyanti bhaktihInAshcha ye shive
verses.translation: They are respectively in the south-east, south¬ west, north-west and north-east and are coloured white, red yellow and black. Adharma etc. are in the directions east etc. ending with the north. His bodies shall be conceived resembling the jewel Rajavarta. * Covering for him is the pure white lotus seat.

verses.sanskrit: राज्यं स्वर्गं च मोक्षं च भोजनं क्षीरसम्भवम् । न लभन्ते प्रियाण्येषां न तुष्यति यदा शिवः
verses.transliteration: rAjyaM svargaM cha mokShaM cha bhojanaM kShIrasambhavam | na labhante priyANyeShAM na tuShyati yadA shivaH
verses.translation: Its petals are eight in number representing the eight attributes, Anima etc. The filaments are the Rudras Varna etc. in the company of Varna and other Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: भवप्रसादजं सर्वं नान्यद्देवप्रसादजम् । अन्यदेवेषु निरता दुःखार्ता विभ्रमन्ति च
verses.transliteration: bhavaprasAdajaM sarvaM nAnyaddevaprasAdajam | anyadeveShu niratA duHkhArtA vibhramanti cha
verses.translation: The seeds too are those Saktis alone Manonmani etc. within. The pericarp is the greatest detachment and the stalk is the Saivite knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरं तत्र कुतोऽस्माकं वने निवसतां सदा । क्व दुग्धसाधनं वत्स क्व वयं वनवासिनः
verses.transliteration: kShIraM tatra kuto.asmAkaM vane nivasatAM sadA | kva dugdhasAdhanaM vatsa kva vayaM vanavAsinaH
verses.translation: The bulbous root at the extremity of the pericarp with the three zones shall be used in the iSaivite rites. Over the three zones the three Tattvas, Atman etc. are the seats.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्स्नाभावेन दारिद्र्यान्मया ते भाग्यहीनया । मिथ्यादुग्धमिदं दत्तं पिष्टमालोड्य वारिणा
verses.transliteration: kR^itsnAbhAvena dAridryAnmayA te bhAgyahInayA | mithyAdugdhamidaM dattaM piShTamAloDya vAriNA
verses.translation: Above the seats shall be conceived the divine seat refulgent with the pure learning or knowledge, very comfor¬ table and covered over by a covering sheet of colours.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं मातुलगृहे स्वल्पं पीत्वा स्वादु पयः श्रुतम् । ज्ञात्वा स्वादु त्वया पीतं तज्जातीयमनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: tvaM mAtulagR^ihe svalpaM pItvA svAdu payaH shrutam | j~nAtvA svAdu tvayA pItaM tajjAtIyamanusmaran
verses.translation: He shall perform the rites of invocation, installation prevention, surveying and obeisance showing separate Mudras for each.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तं न पय इत्युक्त्वा रुदन् दुःखीकरोषि माम् । प्रसादेन विना शम्भोः पयस्तव न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: dattaM na paya ityuktvA rudan duHkhIkaroShi mAm | prasAdena vinA shambhoH payastava na vidyate
verses.translation: After offering Padya, Acamana, Arghya, scents, flowers, incense, light and Tambula, the devotee shall perform the ablution of l§iva and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: पादपङ्कजयोस्तस्य साम्बस्य सगणस्य च । भक्त्या समर्पितं यत्तत्कारणं सर्वसम्पदाम्
verses.transliteration: pAdapa~Nkajayostasya sAmbasya sagaNasya cha | bhaktyA samarpitaM yattatkAraNaM sarvasampadAm
verses.translation: Or after conceiving the seat and the deity thus and uniting it into a complete unit with the five Brahmans and others, repeating the basic mantra, the devotee shall in¬ voke Siva the great cause along with the goddess. The lord is as pure as the crystal, steady and imperishable. He is the

verses.sanskrit: कथं च लब्धविज्ञानस्तपश्चरणपर्वणि । रुद्राग्नेर्यत्परं वीर्यं लभे भस्म स्वरक्षकम्
verses.transliteration: kathaM cha labdhavij~nAnastapashcharaNaparvaNi | rudrAgneryatparaM vIryaM labhe bhasma svarakShakam
verses.translation: The devotee shall rub the idol with the leaves of Bilva etc. for the removal of the smell. Again he shall bathe it with water. Royal service shall be rendered, such as the appliances of scents myrobalan or turmeric paste. Again the phallic and the embodied image shall be washed with scented water, sprinkled with Kusa grass and flowers or with the water from gold and gemset vessels purified by the chanting of mantras.

verses.sanskrit: अधुना वसुदोऽस्माभिर्महादेवो न पूजितः । सकामानां यथाकामं यथोक्तफलदायकः
verses.transliteration: adhunA vasudo.asmAbhirmahAdevo na pUjitaH | sakAmAnAM yathAkAmaM yathoktaphaladAyakaH
verses.translation: If the materials are not available whatever is available shall be used. Mere water with chantings of mantra can also be used for the ablution of Siva. The devotee shall faithfully perform the rite.

verses.sanskrit: धनान्युद्दिश्य नास्माभिरितः प्रागर्चितः शिवः । अतो दरिद्राः सञ्जाता वयं तस्मान्न ते पयः
verses.transliteration: dhanAnyuddishya nAsmAbhiritaH prAgarchitaH shivaH | ato daridrAH sa~njAtA vayaM tasmAnna te payaH
verses.translation: The water shall be poured with a pot, or couch, or Vardhani or with the hand holding Kua grass and flowers all the time repeating the mantras.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजन्मनि यद्दत्तं शिवमुद्दिश्य वै सुतः । तदेव लभ्यते नान्यद् विष्णुमुद्दिश्य वा प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: pUrvajanmani yaddattaM shivamuddishya vai sutaH | tadeva labhyate nAnyad viShNumuddishya vA prabhum
verses.translation: The hymns of Pavamana, Rudra, Nila and Tvarita or the hymns of Linga Sukta or the hymns from Athar'aiiras Upanisad or the hymns from the Rgveda or Samaveda relating to Siva or the five Brahmans be used

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । इति मातृवचः श्रुत्वा तथ्यं शोकादिसूचकम् । बालोऽप्यनुतपन्नन्तः प्रगल्भमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | iti mAtR^ivachaH shrutvA tathyaM shokAdisUchakam | bAlo.apyanutapannantaH pragalbhamidamabravIt
verses.translation: After performing the rites of ablution to the lord those to the goddess shall be performed. This is what the lord of the gods has ordained.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । शोकेनालमितो मतः साम्बो यद्यस्ति शङ्करः । त्यज शोकं महाभागे सर्वं भद्रं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | shokenAlamito mataH sAmbo yadyasti sha~NkaraH | tyaja shokaM mahAbhAge sarvaM bhadraM bhaviShyati
verses.translation: When the half*female form of the lord is to be worshipped, no serial order in the performance of rites shall be observed. Similarly in regard to the services rendered to the phallic or the embodied image.

verses.sanskrit: शृणु मातर्वचो मेऽद्य महादेवोऽस्ति चेत् क्वचित् । चिराद्वा ह्यचिराद्वापि क्षीरोदं साधयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: shR^iNu mAtarvacho me.adya mahAdevo.asti chet kvachit | chirAdvA hyachirAdvApi kShIrodaM sAdhayAmyaham
verses.translation: After performing the ablution of the phallic idol it shall be wiped with a pure fragrant cloth. The devotee shall then offer garment and the sacred thread.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य बालकस्य महामतेः । प्रत्युवाच तदा माता सुप्रसन्ना मनस्विनी
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | iti shrutvA vachastasya bAlakasya mahAmateH | pratyuvAcha tadA mAtA suprasannA manasvinI
verses.translation: In a big flat vessel made of gold, silver, copper or clay he shall worship the lord with lotuses, seeds, flowers, curd, Akatas, Nandyavarta flowers etc. in the forms of Srivatsa, Svastika, mirror, Vajra, fire etc. Eight lamps shall be lighted all round and one lamp shall be kept in the middle. In these the nine laktis Varna etc. shall be meditated upon and worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: मातोवाच । शुभं विचारितं तात त्वया मत्प्रीतिवर्द्धनम् । विलम्बं मा कथास्त्वं हि भज साम्बं सदाशिवम्
verses.transliteration: mAtovAcha | shubhaM vichAritaM tAta tvayA matprItivarddhanam | vilambaM mA kathAstvaM hi bhaja sAmbaM sadAshivam
verses.translation: After covering with Kavaca mantra and protec¬ ting with the Astra mantra he shall show the Mudra of cow and lift the vessel with both the hands.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्मादधिकोऽस्त्येव शिवः परमकारणम् । तत्कृतं हि जगत्सर्वं ब्रह्माद्यास्तस्य किङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: sarvasmAdadhiko.astyeva shivaH paramakAraNam | tatkR^itaM hi jagatsarvaM brahmAdyAstasya ki~NkarAH
verses.translation: Or only five lamps shall be kept, four in the four quarters and one in the middle, or only one lamp need be lit.

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रसादकृतैश्वर्या दासास्तस्य वयं प्रभोः । तं विनान्यं न जानीमः शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: tatprasAdakR^itaishvaryA dAsAstasya vayaM prabhoH | taM vinAnyaM na jAnImaH sha~NkaraM lokasha~Nkaram
verses.translation: Lifting the vessel, the devotee shall whirl it thrice

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । न ह्येष शिशुकः कश्चित्प्राकृतः कृतवांस्तपः । मुनिवर्यस्य तनयो व्याघ्रपादस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: vAyuruvAcha | na hyeSha shishukaH kashchitprAkR^itaH kR^itavAMstapaH | munivaryasya tanayo vyAghrapAdasya dhImataH
verses.translation: After offering water for drinking he shall offer Acamana once again. Tambula with five-scented*" spices shall be offered.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यान् देवान्न् परित्यज्य कर्मणा मनसा गिरा । तमेव साम्बं सगणं भज भावपुरस्सरम्
verses.transliteration: anyAn devAnn parityajya karmaNA manasA girA | tameva sAmbaM sagaNaM bhaja bhAvapurassaram
verses.translation: All materials of worship shall be sprinkled with water. Music and dances shall go on. Conceiving the presence of Siva and Siva in the phallic image he shall perform the Japa of Siva according to his ability.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवाधिदेवस्य शिवस्य वरदायिनः । साक्षान्नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रोऽयं वाचकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tasya devAdhidevasya shivasya varadAyinaH | sAkShAnnamaH shivAyeti mantro.ayaM vAchakaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Circumambulation, obeisance, eulogy, dedication of the self and submission of one's wish shall be humbly made.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तकोटिमहामन्त्राः सर्वे सप्रणवाः परे । तस्मिन्नेव विलीयन्ते पुनस्तस्माद्विनिर्गताः
verses.transliteration: saptakoTimahAmantrAH sarve sapraNavAH pare | tasminneva vilIyante punastasmAdvinirgatAH
verses.translation: Arghya and handful of flowers shall be offered and Mudra shall be shown in accordance with injunctions. Forgiveness shall be prayed and the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed. The devotee shall meditate on the lord only in his Atman.

verses.sanskrit: सप्रसादाश्च ते मन्त्राः स्वाधिकाराद्यपेक्षया । सर्वाधिकारस्त्वेकोऽयं मन्त्र एवेश्वराज्ञया
verses.transliteration: saprasAdAshcha te mantrAH svAdhikArAdyapekShayA | sarvAdhikArastveko.ayaM mantra eveshvarAj~nayA
verses.translation: In distress the offerings are restricted to those beginning with Padya and ending with Tambula, or to those beginning with Arghya, or to mere offering of flowers, but with pious feelings.

verses.sanskrit: यथा निकृष्टानुत्कृष्टान्सर्वानप्यात्मनः शिवः । क्षमते रक्षितुं तद्वन्मन्त्रोऽयमपि सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: yathA nikR^iShTAnutkR^iShTAnsarvAnapyAtmanaH shivaH | kShamate rakShituM tadvanmantro.ayamapi sarvadA
verses.translation: If a sinner takes meals freely there is no atone¬ ment for him. If he takes in anything inadvertently he shall vomit it off, take bath and worship the lord and the goddess twice. He shall observe fast thereafter and repeat the names of Siva ten thousand times. He shall observe celibacy also. The next day he shall make a charitable gift of gold to a devotee of Siva. Then he shall perform great worship and sanctify himself.

verses.sanskrit: प्रबलश्च तथा ह्येष मन्त्रो मन्त्रान्तरादपि । सर्वरक्षाक्षमोऽप्येष नापरः कश्चिदिष्यते
verses.transliteration: prabalashcha tathA hyeSha mantro mantrAntarAdapi | sarvarakShAkShamo.apyeSha nAparaH kashchidiShyate
verses.translation: What has not been mentioned because I was afraid of losing the sequence of worship, I shall now mention briefly,

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मन्त्रान्तरांस्त्यक्त्वा पञ्चाक्षरपरो भव । तस्मिन् जिह्वान्तरगते न किञ्चिदिह दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAnmantrAntarAMstyaktvA pa~nchAkSharaparo bhava | tasmin jihvAntaragate na ki~nchidiha durlabham
verses.translation: After offering the light but before offering the Havis, the devotee shall perform the worship of the Avarana; or just when the time of Nirajana has arrived.

verses.sanskrit: अघोरास्त्रं च शैवानां रक्षाहेतुरनुत्तमम् । तच्च तत्प्रभवं मत्वा तत्परो भव नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: aghorAstraM cha shaivAnAM rakShAheturanuttamam | tachcha tatprabhavaM matvA tatparo bhava nAnyathA
verses.translation: Iji the first Avarana of Siva and Siva, the mantra of Rudra etc. upto the Astra shall be used for Japa. The five Brahmans from Isana to Sadyojata shall be meditated upon in the north-east, east, south and north or in the west, south-east, north-east and south-west or in the north-west north-east and in the four quarters. Beyond that he shall perform the Garbhavarana and repeat the mantras.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मेदं तु मया लब्धं पितुरेव तवोत्तमम् । विरजानलसंसिद्धं महाव्यापन्निवारणम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmedaM tu mayA labdhaM pitureva tavottamam | virajAnalasaMsiddhaM mahAvyApannivAraNam
verses.translation: Or he shall worship everything from the heart to the Astra.
