verses.translation: After performing the Avarana Puja thus, he shall worship the lord again for quietening distraction and per¬ plexity and utter the five-syllabled mantra.

verses.sanskrit: रमनायाश्च पायोश्च रसस्यापां तथैव च । ईश्वरीं वामदेवाख्यां मूर्तिं तन्निरतां विदुः
verses.transliteration: ramanAyAshcha pAyoshcha rasasyApAM tathaiva cha | IshvarIM vAmadevAkhyAM mUrtiM tanniratAM viduH
verses.translation: He shall then offer to Siva and Siva as Nai- vedya the sweet and charming Mahacaru, nectarlike and accompanied by side dishes and vegetables. The Naivedya prepared fjom thirtytwo A<haka measures of grains is com¬ mendable and that prepared with less than one Adhaka measure is the meanest one. After collecting and preparing the Naivedya to the extent of one's affluence he shall offer it with faith.

verses.sanskrit: घ्राणस्य चैवोपस्थस्य गन्धस्य च भुवस्तथा । सद्योज्ञाताह्वयां मूर्तिमीश्वरीं सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: ghrANasya chaivopasthasya gandhasya cha bhuvastathA | sadyoj~nAtAhvayAM mUrtimIshvarIM samprachakShate
verses.translation: After offering water for drinking, pickles, Tambula and performing the rite of Nirajana he shall conclude the remaining rites of worship.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तयः पञ्च देवस्य वन्दनीयाः प्रयत्नतः । श्रेयोऽर्थिभिर्नरैर्नित्यं श्रेयसामेकहेतवः
verses.transliteration: mUrtayaH pa~ncha devasya vandanIyAH prayatnataH | shreyo.arthibhirnarairnityaM shreyasAmekahetavaH
verses.translation: Articles intended for the enjoyment of pleasures shall be excellent ones. The devotee shall not be stingy in spending money for this if he is fairly well to do.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवादिदेवस्य मूर्त्यष्टकमयं जगत् । तस्मिन् व्याप्य स्थितं विश्वं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
verses.transliteration: tasya devAdidevasya mUrtyaShTakamayaM jagat | tasmin vyApya sthitaM vishvaM sUtre maNigaNA iva
verses.translation: Good men say that the Kamya rites of the stingy and the stubborn, the indifferent and the defaulter in some items do not yield the benefits.

verses.sanskrit: शर्वो भवस्तथा रुद्र उग्रो भीमः पशोः पतिः । ईशानश्च महादेवो मूर्तयश्चाष्ट विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: sharvo bhavastathA rudra ugro bhImaH pashoH patiH | IshAnashcha mahAdevo mUrtayashchAShTa vishrutAH
verses.translation: Hence if he wishes for the achievement of proper benefits he shall perform the Kamya rites attending to all the items scrupulously and avoiding indifference.

verses.sanskrit: भूम्यम्भोऽग्निमरुद्व्योमक्षेत्रज्ञार्कनिशाकराः । अधिष्ठिता महेशस्य शर्वाद्यैरष्टमूर्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: bhUmyambho.agnimarudvyomakShetraj~nArkanishAkarAH | adhiShThitA maheshasya sharvAdyairaShTamUrtibhiH
verses.translation: After concluding worship thus and bowing to the lord and the goddess he shall concentrate his mind with devo¬ tion and repeat eulogical hymns.

verses.sanskrit: स शिवः सर्वमेवेदं स्वकीयाभिश्च मूर्तिभिः । अधितिष्ठत्यमेयात्मा ह्येतत्सर्वमनुस्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sa shivaH sarvamevedaM svakIyAbhishcha mUrtibhiH | adhitiShThatyameyAtmA hyetatsarvamanusmR^itam
verses.translation: After the eulogy he shall perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra not less than hundred and eight times. An eager devotee shall perform the Japa more than a thou¬ sand times.

verses.sanskrit: चराचरात्मकं विश्वं धत्ते विश्वम्भरात्मिका । शार्वी र्शिवाह्वया मूर्तिरिति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: charAcharAtmakaM vishvaM dhatte vishvambharAtmikA | shArvI rshivAhvayA mUrtiriti shAstrasya nishchayaH
verses.translation: After performing the worship of Vidya and of the preceptor he shall perform the members assembled in the proper order in accordance with prosperity and purity.

verses.sanskrit: सञ्जीवनं समस्तस्य जगतः सलिलात्मिकाज् । भावीति गीयते मूर्तिभवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sa~njIvanaM samastasya jagataH salilAtmikAj | bhAvIti gIyate mUrtibhavasya paramAtmanaH
verses.translation: Then he shall perform the rite of ritualistic bid¬ ding of farewell to the lord along with Avaranas. He shall give the Man(ala to the preceptor along with the articles used in the rite.

verses.sanskrit: बहिरन्तर्गता विश्वं व्याप्य तेजोमयी शुभा । रौद्री रुद्राव्यया मूर्तिरास्थिता घोररूपिणी
verses.transliteration: bahirantargatA vishvaM vyApya tejomayI shubhA | raudrI rudrAvyayA mUrtirAsthitA ghorarUpiNI
verses.translation: He can give them to the devotees of Siva or hand them over to the temple,;&vl.

verses.sanskrit: स्पन्दयत्यनिलात्मेदं बिभर्ति स्पन्दते स्वयम् । औग्रीति कथ्यते सद्भिर्मूर्तिरुग्रस्य वेधसः
verses.transliteration: spandayatyanilAtmedaM bibharti spandate svayam | augrIti kathyate sadbhirmUrtirugrasya vedhasaH
verses.translation: Or he shall worship the lord in the Siva-fire with the seven articles of sacrifice after duly worshipping the Avarana deities.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वावकाशदा सर्वव्यापिका गगनात्मिका । मूर्तिर्भीमस्य भीमाख्या भूतवृन्दस्य भेदिका
verses.transliteration: sarvAvakAshadA sarvavyApikA gaganAtmikA | mUrtirbhImasya bhImAkhyA bhUtavR^indasya bhedikA
verses.translation: A benefit of this world or the nc.xt unattainable through this does not exist anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मनामधिष्ठात्री सर्वक्षेत्रनिवासिनी । मूर्तिः पशुपतेर्ज्ञेया पशुपाशनिकृन्तनी
verses.transliteration: sarvAtmanAmadhiShThAtrI sarvakShetranivAsinI | mUrtiH pashupaterj~neyA pashupAshanikR^intanI
verses.translation: Still none shall perform this rite for trivial benefits. A man praying for a small help from a great man demeans himself.

verses.sanskrit: दीपयन्ती जगत्सर्वं दिवाकरसमाह्वया । ईशानाख्या महेशस्य मूर्तिर्दिवि विसर्पति
verses.transliteration: dIpayantI jagatsarvaM divAkarasamAhvayA | IshAnAkhyA maheshasya mUrtirdivi visarpati
verses.translation: Hence, an expert man shall perform this rite for the conquests of his enemy or death even if those fruits are not to be secured from any one else whether those fruits are seen or unseen.

verses.sanskrit: आप्याययति यो विश्वममृतांशुर्निशाकरः । महादेवस्य सा मूर्तिर्महादेवसमाह्वया
verses.transliteration: ApyAyayati yo vishvamamR^itAMshurnishAkaraH | mahAdevasya sA mUrtirmahAdevasamAhvayA
verses.translation: When great sins are committed, when there is a terror of great epidemics, famine or any other calamity, this rite shall be performed for the pacification of the evil.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा तस्याष्टमी मूर्तिः शिवस्य परमात्मनः । व्यापिकेतरमूर्तीनां विश्वं तस्मात् शिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: AtmA tasyAShTamI mUrtiH shivasya paramAtmanaH | vyApiketaramUrtInAM vishvaM tasmAt shivAtmakam
verses.translation: Hence, a person performing this rite with the conviction that there is no greater protection for the Atman enjoys the benefit.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षस्य मूलसेकेन शाखाः पुष्यन्ति वै यथा । शिवस्य पूजया तद्वत्पुष्यत्यस्य वपुर्जगत्
verses.transliteration: vR^ikShasya mUlasekena shAkhAH puShyanti vai yathA | shivasya pUjayA tadvatpuShyatyasya vapurjagat
verses.translation: He who reads the hymn with purity of body and mind attains an eighth of the benefit desired.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा रुद्रो महेशानः सदाशिवः । मूर्तयस्तस्य विज्ञेया याभिर्विश्वमिदं ततम्
verses.transliteration: brahmA viShNustathA rudro maheshAnaH sadAshivaH | mUrtayastasya vij~neyA yAbhirvishvamidaM tatam
verses.translation: If any one thinks into the hymn, observes fast on the full moon and the new moon days and recites it on those days or on the eighth or fourteenth day, he.shall derive half the benefit.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाभयप्रदानं च सर्वानुग्रहणं तथा । सर्वोपकारकरणं शिवस्याराधनं विदुः
verses.transliteration: sarvAbhayapradAnaM cha sarvAnugrahaNaM tathA | sarvopakArakaraNaM shivasyArAdhanaM viduH
verses.translation: He who thinks over the meaning, observes rites on Parvan and other days and performs the Japa of this stotra for a month derives full benefit.

verses.sanskrit: यथेह पुत्रपौत्रादेः प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवेत्पिता । तथा सर्वस्य सम्प्रीत्या प्रीतो भवति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: yatheha putrapautrAdeH prItyA prIto bhavetpitA | tathA sarvasya samprItyA prIto bhavati sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: O Kr?na, I shall tell you the hymn whereby this holy fite of Yogesvara is concluded along the pa h of five Avaranas.

verses.sanskrit: देहिनो यस्य कस्यापि क्रियते यदि निग्रहः । अनिष्टमष्टमूर्तेस्तत्कृतमेव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: dehino yasya kasyApi kriyate yadi nigrahaH | aniShTamaShTamUrtestatkR^itameva na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Be victorious, O Siva, the sole lord of the universe, naturally charming one, of the nature of eternal knowledge. You are the principle beyond the region of words and minds O lord, who have transcended the confused universe.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमूर्त्यात्मना विश्वमधिष्ठाय स्थितं शिवम् । भजस्व सर्वभावेन रुद्रं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: aShTamUrtyAtmanA vishvamadhiShThAya sthitaM shivam | bhajasva sarvabhAvena rudraM paramakAraNam
verses.translation: O lord, of a naturally pure physical body, O lord of charming activities. O lord, having a great l3akti on a par with yourself, O ocean of pure attributes.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्याश्चापि तनवः पञ्च ब्रह्मसमाह्वयाः । तनूभिस्ताभिराव्याप्तमिह किञ्चिन्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: athAnyAshchApi tanavaH pa~ncha brahmasamAhvayAH | tanUbhistAbhirAvyAptamiha ki~nchinna vidyate
verses.translation: O one endowed with infinite splendour, O one of incomparable physical body, the support, and of unarguable greatness, be victorious O one of undisturbed auspiciousness.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः पुरुषोऽघोरो वामः सद्यस्तथैव च । ब्रह्माण्येतानि देवस्य मूर्तयः पञ्च विश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: IshAnaH puruSho.aghoro vAmaH sadyastathaiva cha | brahmANyetAni devasya mUrtayaH pa~ncha vishrutAH
verses.translation: O Unsullied one, O one having no other support, O one rising up without cause and of incessantly great bliss, be victorious, O cause of extreme delight.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानाख्या तु या तस्य मूर्तिराद्या गरीयसी । भोक्तारं प्रकृतेः साक्षात् क्षेत्रज्ञमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: IshAnAkhyA tu yA tasya mUrtirAdyA garIyasI | bhoktAraM prakR^iteH sAkShAt kShetraj~namadhitiShThati
verses.translation: Be victorious, O one of excessively great prosperity. O receptacle of excessive mercy, O the sole possession of the free, O one of unequalled affluence.

verses.sanskrit: स्थाणोस्तत्पुरुषाख्या या मूर्तिर्मूर्तिमतः प्रभोः । गुणाश्रयात्मकं भोग्यमव्यक्तमधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: sthANostatpuruShAkhyA yA mUrtirmUrtimataH prabhoH | guNAshrayAtmakaM bhogyamavyaktamadhitiShThati
verses.translation: O lord who have enveloped the universe, O one not enveloped by any one, O one standing superior to all, O one to whom there is no one at all who is superior.

verses.sanskrit: धर्माद्यष्टाङ्गसंयुक्तं बुद्धितत्त्वं पिनाकिनः । अधितिष्ठत्यघोराख्या मूर्तिरत्यन्तपूजिता
verses.transliteration: dharmAdyaShTA~NgasaMyuktaM buddhitattvaM pinAkinaH | adhitiShThatyaghorAkhyA mUrtiratyantapUjitA
verses.translation: Be victorious, O wonderful one, who are by no means insignificant. O unwounded one: O unchanging one. O immeasurable one, O one uninfluenced by Maya, O one having no emotions, O one devoid of dirt, be victorious.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवाह्वयां मूर्तिं महादेवस्य वेधसः । अहङ्कृतेरधिष्ठात्रीमाहुरागमवेदिनः
verses.transliteration: vAmadevAhvayAM mUrtiM mahAdevasya vedhasaH | aha~NkR^iteradhiShThAtrImAhurAgamavedinaH
verses.translation: O one of great arms, O one of great essence, O one of great attributes, O one of great narratives, O one of great strength, O one of great Maya, O one of great taste, O one of great chariot.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to the great lord, the great cause, the quiescent one, more auspicious than any one else.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥ ७.२.४. चतुर्थोऽध्यायः । गौरीशङ्करविभूतियोगः । श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । भगवन् परमेशस्य शर्वस्यामिततेजसः । मूर्तिभिर्विश्वमेवेदं यथा व्याप्तं तथा श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH || 7\.2\.4\. chaturtho.adhyAyaH | gaurIsha~NkaravibhUtiyogaH | shrIkR^iShNa uvAcha | bhagavan parameshasya sharvasyAmitatejasaH | mUrtibhirvishvamevedaM yathA vyAptaM tathA shrutam
verses.translation: The entire universe including the gods and Asuras is subservient into you. Hence who is competent to transgress the behest ordained by you? This devotee is solely dependent on you. Hence, O sir, bless me and bestow on me what I have prayed for.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रो न खलु भात्येष यथा चन्द्रिकया विना । न भाति विद्यमानोऽपि तथा शक्त्या विना शिवः
verses.transliteration: chandro na khalu bhAtyeSha yathA chandrikayA vinA | na bhAti vidyamAno.api tathA shaktyA vinA shivaH
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess, the mother of the universe identical with the universe, and of unlimited prosperity. Be victorious, O goddess of incomparable beautiful person.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभया हि विना यद्वद्भानुरेष न विद्यते । प्रभा च भानुना तेन सुतरां तदुपाश्रया
verses.transliteration: prabhayA hi vinA yadvadbhAnureSha na vidyate | prabhA cha bhAnunA tena sutarAM tadupAshrayA
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess transcending speech and mind annihilating the darkness of ignorance, devoid of birth and old age, O one superior to that which is superior to Kala.

verses.sanskrit: एवं परस्परापेक्षा शक्तिशक्तिमतोः स्थिता । न शिवेन विना शक्तिर्न शक्त्या च विना शिवः
verses.transliteration: evaM parasparApekShA shaktishaktimatoH sthitA | na shivena vinA shaktirna shaktyA cha vinA shivaH
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess stationed in many riles,

verses.sanskrit: शक्तौ यया शिवो नित्यं भक्तौ मुक्तौ च देहिनाम् । आद्या सैका परा शक्तिश्चिन्मयी शिवसंश्रया
verses.transliteration: shaktau yayA shivo nityaM bhaktau muktau cha dehinAm | AdyA saikA parA shaktishchinmayI shivasaMshrayA
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess endowed with divine and auspicious body of auspicious light, O one of auspicious conduct. Be victorious, O goddess, bestowing auspiciousness.

verses.sanskrit: यामाहुरखिलेशस्य तैस्तैरनुगुणैर्गुणैः । समानधर्मिणीमेव शिवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yAmAhurakhileshasya taistairanuguNairguNaiH | samAnadharmiNImeva shivasya paramAtmanaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to the goddess possessed of great and auspicious attributes. The universe born from you merges into you alone.

verses.sanskrit: सैका परा च चिद्रूपा शक्तिः प्रसवधर्मिणी । विभज्य बहुधा विश्वं विदधाति शिवेच्छया
verses.transliteration: saikA parA cha chidrUpA shaktiH prasavadharmiNI | vibhajya bahudhA vishvaM vidadhAti shivechChayA
verses.translation: Without you even the lord is not competent to bestow the benefats. O goddess of the gods, ever since birth this person has sought refuge in you. Hence, please fulfil the desire of this devotee of yours. Sadasiva, of five faces, ten arms, resembling the pure crystal, having the physical body constituted by the letters, the five Brahmans and the Kalis, the lord who is both Sakala and Niskala, who is endowed with devotion to Siva and who is beyond the Santi Kali, has been worshipped by me with devotion. May he bestow on me what is prayed for by me.

verses.sanskrit: सा मूलप्रकृतिर्माया त्रिगुणा च त्रिधा स्मृता । शिवया च विपर्यस्तं यया ततमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: sA mUlaprakR^itirmAyA triguNA cha tridhA smR^itA | shivayA cha viparyastaM yayA tatamidaM jagat
verses.translation: May the Iccha lakti named Sivi seated on the lap of Sadasiva, the mother of all the worlds, grant me what I desire.

verses.sanskrit: एकधा च द्विधा चैव तथा शतसहस्रधा । शक्तयः खलु भिद्यन्ते बहुधा व्यवहारतः
verses.transliteration: ekadhA cha dvidhA chaiva tathA shatasahasradhA | shaktayaH khalu bhidyante bahudhA vyavahArataH
verses.translation: Lords Heramba and Sanmukha arc the beloved sons of Siva and Siva. Their accomplishments are auspicious. They are omniscient. They imbibe the nectar of knowledge. Being content they are mutually aftectionate. They are perpetually honoured by Siva and Siva. They are always respected and revered by Brahma and other gods. They are always ready to protect the worlds. Out of their will they take incarnations with their many different parts. They have been always worshipped thus by me on either side of Siva and Siva. May they grant me what I have prayed for with due deference for their behest.

verses.sanskrit: शिवेच्छया पराशक्तिः शिवतत्त्वैकतां गता । ततः परिस्फुरत्यादौ सर्गे तैलं तिलादिव
verses.transliteration: shivechChayA parAshaktiH shivatattvaikatAM gatA | tataH parisphuratyAdau sarge tailaM tilAdiva
verses.translation: May the lord grant me what I have prayed for — the lord who resembles the pure crystal, who is called Isana, Sada'iva, the great Atman, who is quiescent, who occupies the firmament transcending the Santikala, who is the final Bija of the five-syllabled mantra equipped with five Kalas

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रियाख्यया शक्त्या शक्तौ शक्तिमदुत्थया । तस्यां विक्षोभ्यमाणायामादौ नादः समुद्बभौ
verses.transliteration: tataH kriyAkhyayA shaktyA shaktau shaktimadutthayA | tasyAM vikShobhyamANAyAmAdau nAdaH samudbabhau
verses.translation: May the lord grant me whai I have prayed for — the lord who is ancient, who is named Purusa, who resembles the rising sun, who is identified with the eastern face of fiva Farame§thin, who is in the form of Santi stationed in the wind, who is engaged in worshipping the feet of Siva, who is the first among Siva-Bijas, who has four Kalas and who has been worshipped by me with devo¬ tion in the east along with Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: अथैतत् ज्ञातुमिच्छामि याथात्म्यं परमेशयोः । स्त्रीपुम्भावात्मकं चेदं ताभ्यां कथमधिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: athaitat j~nAtumichChAmi yAthAtmyaM parameshayoH | strIpumbhAvAtmakaM chedaM tAbhyAM kathamadhiShThitam
verses.translation: May the holy middle Brahman grant me what I have prayed for — he who is named Aghora resembling colly- rium, who has a terrible physical body, who is identified with the southern face of the lord, who is engaged in the worship of Siva's feet, who abides in the Vidya region and is stationed in the middle of fire, who is the second among Siva's Bijas, who has eight Kalas and has been worshipped along with Sakti to the south of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नादाद्विनिःसृतो बिन्दुर्बिन्दोदेवः सदाशिवः । तस्मान् महेश्वरो जातः शुद्धविद्या महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: nAdAdviniHsR^ito bindurbindodevaH sadAshivaH | tasmAn maheshvaro jAtaH shuddhavidyA maheshvarAt
verses.translation: May the holy Brahman grant me what I have prayed for — he who is Varna, who has an excellent dress resem¬ bling saffron powder, who is identified with the northern face of Siva and who is well established in Pratitha, who is stationed in the middle of the zone of water. He is engaged in worshipping the lord. He is the fourth one among Siva- Bijas. He has thirteen Kalas. He has been worshipped along with Sakti to the north of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: सा वाचामीश्वरी शक्तिर्वागीशाख्या हि शूलिनः । या सा वर्णस्वरूपेण मातृकेऽपि विजृम्भते
verses.transliteration: sA vAchAmIshvarI shaktirvAgIshAkhyA hi shUlinaH | yA sA varNasvarUpeNa mAtR^ike.api vijR^imbhate
verses.translation: May the great Brahman grant me what I have prayed for— he who is named Sadya having gentle character¬ istics, who is as white as the conch, Kunda flower and the full moon. He is the western face of Siva that is engaged in worshipping Siva's feet, who is established in the Nivrtti region and is stationed in the earth, who is the third one among Siva-Bijas and is endowed with eight Kalas, and who has been worshipped along with* Sakti to the west of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: अथानन्तसमावेशान्माया कालमवासृजत् । नियतिं च कलां विद्यां कलातो रागपूरुषौ
verses.transliteration: athAnantasamAveshAnmAyA kAlamavAsR^ijat | niyatiM cha kalAM vidyAM kalAto rAgapUruShau
verses.translation: May the two heart-forms of Siva and Siva purified by Siva grant my desire at the behest of the two — Siva and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: मायातः पुनरेवाभूदव्यक्तं त्रिगुणात्मकम् । त्रिगुणाच्च ततोऽव्यक्ताद्विभक्ताः स्युस्त्रयो गुणाः
verses.transliteration: mAyAtaH punarevAbhUdavyaktaM triguNAtmakam | triguNAchcha tato.avyaktAdvibhaktAH syustrayo guNAH
verses.translation: May the two tuft-forms of Siva and Siva, depend* ing on Siva, grant my desire after honouring the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चेति यैर्व्याप्तमखिलं जगत् । गुणेभ्यः क्षोभ्यमाणेभ्यो गुणेशाख्यास्त्रिमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: sattvaM rajastamashcheti yairvyAptamakhilaM jagat | guNebhyaH kShobhyamANebhyo guNeshAkhyAstrimUrtayaH
verses.translation: May the two coats of mail of Siva and Siva

verses.sanskrit: अभवन् महदादीनि तत्त्वानि च यथाक्रमम् । तेभ्यः स्युरण्डपिण्डानि त्वसङ्ख्यानि शिवाज्ञया । अधिष्ठितान्यनन्ताद्यैर्विद्येशैश्चक्रवर्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: abhavan mahadAdIni tattvAni cha yathAkramam | tebhyaH syuraNDapiNDAni tvasa~NkhyAni shivAj~nayA | adhiShThitAnyanantAdyairvidyeshaishchakravartibhiH
verses.translation: May the two eye-forms of Siva and Siva depen¬

verses.sanskrit: शरीरान्तरभेदेन शक्तेर्भेदाः प्रकीर्तिताः । नानारूपास्तु विज्ञेयाः स्थूलसूक्ष्मविभेदतः
verses.transliteration: sharIrAntarabhedena shakterbhedAH prakIrtitAH | nAnArUpAstu vij~neyAH sthUlasUkShmavibhedataH
verses.translation: May the missile forms of Siva and Siva always

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रस्य रौद्री सा शक्तिर्विष्णौर्वै वैष्णवी मता । ब्रह्माणी ब्रह्मणः प्रोक्ता चेन्द्रस्यैन्द्रीति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: rudrasya raudrI sA shaktirviShNaurvai vaiShNavI matA | brahmANI brahmaNaH proktA chendrasyaindrIti kathyate
verses.translation: Let these deities Varna, Jyestha, Rudra, Kala, Vikarana, Balavikarana, Balapramathana and Sarvabhutada- mana grant me what I desire, at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन यद्विश्वमिति कीर्तितम् । शक्यात्मनैव तद्व्याप्तं यथा देहेऽन्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: kimatra bahunoktena yadvishvamiti kIrtitam | shakyAtmanaiva tadvyAptaM yathA dehe.antarAtmanA
verses.translation: May the eight deities Ananta, Suksma, Siva, Ekanetra, Ekarudra, Trimuiti, Srikantha and Sikhandaka and their Saktis, worshipped in the second Avarana grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छक्तिमयं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् । कला या परमा शक्तिः कथिता परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tasmAchChaktimayaM sarvaM jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam | kalA yA paramA shaktiH kathitA paramAtmanaH
verses.translation: May the e'ght Murtis Bhava and others and their Saktis as well as the eleven Murtis Mahadeva and others accompanied by their Saktis, all stationed in the third Avarana confer the desired benefit after honouring the behest of Siva and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । श्रीमद्विभूतिं शिवयोर्याथात्म्यं च समासतः । वक्ष्ये तद्विस्तराद्वक्तुं भवेनापि न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | shrImadvibhUtiM shivayoryAthAtmyaM cha samAsataH | vakShye tadvistarAdvaktuM bhavenApi na shakyate
verses.translation: Nandi4vara of great splendour, the son ofParvatl is worshipped and revered every day by the gods including

verses.sanskrit: एवमेषा परा शक्तिरीश्वरेच्छानुयायिनी । स्थिरं चरं च यद्विश्वं सृजतीति विनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: evameShA parA shaktirIshvarechChAnuyAyinI | sthiraM charaM cha yadvishvaM sR^ijatIti vinishchayaH
verses.translation: May the seven mothers — Brahmani, Mahesi, Kaumari, Vainavi, Varahi, Mahendri and Camuna of fierce valour, mothers of all the worlds, grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानक्रिया चिकीर्षाभिस्तिसृभिः स्वात्मशक्तिभिः । शक्तिमानीश्वरः शश्वत् विश्वं व्याप्याधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: j~nAnakriyA chikIrShAbhistisR^ibhiH svAtmashaktibhiH | shaktimAnIshvaraH shashvat vishvaM vyApyAdhitiShThati
verses.translation: He has the face of the elephant in rut. He is the son of Gahga, Uma and Siva. The firmament is his body; the quarters his arms; the moon, the sun and the fire his eyes. He is worshipped by the elephants of the quarters, Airavata and others. The ichor of Saivite knowledge comes out of him. He wards the obstacles of gods. He causes obstacles to the Asuras and others. He is sanctified by Siva. May he grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: इदमित्थमिदं नेत्थं भवेदित्येवमात्मिका । इच्छाशक्तिर्महेशस्य नित्या कार्यनियामिका
verses.transliteration: idamitthamidaM netthaM bhavedityevamAtmikA | ichChAshaktirmaheshasya nityA kAryaniyAmikA
verses.translation: $anmukha is bom of Siva. He holds Sakti and thunderbolt. He is the son of fire. He is also the son of Ganga, Ganamba and Kfttikas. Hd is surrounded by Viakha, Sakha and Naigameya. He is the conqueror of Indra and the demon Taraka. He is the Generalissimo of Indra's armies. He pierced the important mountains Meru and others with his splendour. He resembles molten gold. He has eyes resembling petals of lotuses. He is Kumara and the model for all tender beings. He is the favourite of Siva and

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानशक्तिस्तु तत्कार्यं करणं कारणं तथा । प्रयोजनं च तत्त्वेन बुद्धिरूपाध्यवस्यति
verses.transliteration: j~nAnashaktistu tatkAryaM karaNaM kAraNaM tathA | prayojanaM cha tattvena buddhirUpAdhyavasyati
verses.translation: Jyestha, the excellent deity granting boons, is always engaged in worshipping them. May she grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: यथेप्सितं क्रियाशक्तिर्यथाध्यवसितं जगत् । कल्पयत्यखिलं कार्यं क्षणात्सङ्कल्परूपिणी
verses.transliteration: yathepsitaM kriyAshaktiryathAdhyavasitaM jagat | kalpayatyakhilaM kAryaM kShaNAtsa~NkalparUpiNI
verses.translation: The goddess is saluted by the three worlds in the form of Ulka (meteor, comet ). She is requested by Brahma to multiply the creation th*'ough Siva. She came out from the middle of the eyebrows of Siva who divided herself into DaksayanI, Satl, Mena, Haimavati, Uma. she is the mother of Kauiki, Bhadrakali, Aparna and Patala. She is Rudrani the beloved of Rudra. She is always engaged in worshipping Siva. May she grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: यथाशक्ति त्रयोत्थानं शक्तिप्रसवधर्मिणी । शक्त्या परमया नुन्ना प्रसूते सकलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: yathAshakti trayotthAnaM shaktiprasavadharmiNI | shaktyA paramayA nunnA prasUte sakalaM jagat
verses.translation: May Pingala the chief of Ganas, the pros¬ perous one, fondly attached to Siva and a favourite of Siva, grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: एवं शक्तिसमायोगात् शक्तिमानुच्यते शिवः । शक्तिशक्तिमदुत्थं तु शाक्तं शैवमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: evaM shaktisamAyogAt shaktimAnuchyate shivaH | shaktishaktimadutthaM tu shAktaM shaivamidaM jagat
verses.translation: Virabhadra is of great splendour. He resembles snow, Kunda flower and the moon. He is the beloved of Bhadrakali. He is the perpetual protector of mothers. He re¬ moved the head of Yajfla and of Daksa of wicked soul, he pared the limbs of Visnu, India, Yama and other gods. He is a follower of Siva. He is a glorious executor of Siva's behests. May he grant my desire at the behest of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: यथा न जायते पुत्रः पितरं मातरं विना । तथा भवं भवानीं च विना नैतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: yathA na jAyate putraH pitaraM mAtaraM vinA | tathA bhavaM bhavAnIM cha vinA naitachcharAcharam
verses.translation: Sarasvati born of the lotus-like speech of Mahesa is interested in worshipping Siva and Siva. May she grant rny desire.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुंसप्रभवं विश्वं स्त्रीपुंसात्मकमेव च स्त्रीपुंसयोर्विभूतिश्च स्त्रीपुंसाभ्यामधिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: strIpuMsaprabhavaM vishvaM strIpuMsAtmakameva cha strIpuMsayorvibhUtishcha strIpuMsAbhyAmadhiShThitam
verses.translation: KausikI is the daughter of Parvati, She rides on a lion. She is the great Maya, the slumber of Visnu. She is the suppressor of the demon Mahi§a. She destroyed Surnbha

verses.sanskrit: परमात्मा शिवः प्रोक्तः शिवा सा च प्रकीर्तिता शिवः सदाशिवः प्रोक्तः शिवा सा च मनोन्मनी । शिवो महेश्वरो ज्ञेयः शिवा मायेति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: paramAtmA shivaH proktaH shivA sA cha prakIrtitA shivaH sadAshivaH proktaH shivA sA cha manonmanI | shivo maheshvaro j~neyaH shivA mAyeti kathyate
verses.translation: Rudras have the lustre of Rudra. Pramathas arc famous for their prowess. The Bhutas have great virility. They have the lustre of Mahadeva. They are perpetual Yogins. They are uncomparable and devoid of conflicting pairs of defaults. They are free from dangers. They are accompanied by their laktis and followers. They are bowed to by the world. They are competent to create and anni¬ hilate the worlds. They are mutually loving and accommo¬ dating. They are very affectionate and respectful to one another. They are favourites of Siva and are marked by his traits. They are gentle, terrible and mixture of both. They are in the midway between the two. They are ugly, good- featured and multi featured. May they grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: शक्ति साक्षान्महादेवी महादेवश्च शक्तिमान् । तयोर्विभूतिलेशो वै सर्वमेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: shakti sAkShAnmahAdevI mahAdevashcha shaktimAn | tayorvibhUtilesho vai sarvametachcharAcharam
verses.translation: The group of the friends of the goddess has all the characteristics of the goddess. They are accompanied by the daughters of Rudras and Saktis many in number. They have been worshipped in the third Avarana of Siva with great devotion. Let them grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषः परमेशानः प्रकृतिः परमेश्वरी । रुद्रो महेश्वरः साक्षाद् रुद्राणी रुद्रवल्लभा
verses.transliteration: puruShaH parameshAnaH prakR^itiH parameshvarI | rudro maheshvaraH sAkShAd rudrANI rudravallabhA
verses.translation: The sun is the Murti with illuminated disc of Mahesa. He is Nirguna, Gunasahkirna, Gunakevala, and Avikaratmaka. The first one is single with general variations. He is of extraordinary activity in creation, sustenance and annihilation. Thus he is divided into three, four or five ways. He is worshipped in the fourth Avarana of Siva along with the followers. He is a favourite of Siva and fondly attached to SivJi. He is engaged in worshipping the feet of Siva. May he grant my desire at the behest of the two.=®

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुर्विश्वेश्वरो देवो लक्ष्मीर्विश्वेश्वरप्रिया । ब्रह्मा शिवो यदा स्रष्टा ब्रह्माणी ब्रह्मणः प्रिया
verses.transliteration: viShNurvishveshvaro devo lakShmIrvishveshvarapriyA | brahmA shivo yadA sraShTA brahmANI brahmaNaH priyA
verses.translation: The eight Murtis of the sun viz. Aditya, Bhaskara, Bhanu, Ravi, Arka, Brahma, Rudra, and Visnu, the eight Saktis Dipta"* etc., the six Angas of the sun-god, the

verses.sanskrit: भास्करो भगवान् शम्भुः प्रभा भगवती शिवा । महेन्द्रो मन्मथारातिः शची शैलेन्द्रकन्यका
verses.transliteration: bhAskaro bhagavAn shambhuH prabhA bhagavatI shivA | mahendro manmathArAtiH shachI shailendrakanyakA
verses.translation: May the twelve Adityas, and the twelve Saktis, sages, Gandharvas, serpents, Apsaras, Gramanis, Yaksas Raksasas, Asuras, the seven sets of seven, the seven horses identical with the Vedas and Valakhilya and others, the worshippers of Siva's feet, grant me everything at the behest of Siva and Siva. Brahma the chief of the universe, a form of the lord of gods, having sixtyfour attributes and achieve¬ ments, and established in the principle of Buddhi, shall be worshipped in the fourth Avarana of Siva. He is a favou¬ rite of Siva, fondly attached to Siva and is engaged in wor¬ shipping the feet of Siva. May he grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: जातवेदा महादेवः स्वाहा शर्वार्धदेहिनी । यमस्त्रियम्बको देवस्तत्प्रिया गिरिकन्यका
verses.transliteration: jAtavedA mahAdevaH svAhA sharvArdhadehinI | yamastriyambako devastatpriyA girikanyakA
verses.translation: Hiranyagarbha the lord of the worlds, the Virat, Kala, Purua, Sanat, Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatana, the Prajapatis, the sons of Brahma, Daksa and others, eleven in number with their wives, Dharma and Sariikalpa — all these are engrossed in their devotion to Siva being subservient to the behests of Siva. May these grant my desire.

verses.sanskrit: निरृतिर्भगवानीशो नैरृती नगनन्दिनी । वरुणो भगवान् रुद्रो वारुणी भूधरात्मजा
verses.transliteration: nirR^itirbhagavAnIsho nairR^itI naganandinI | varuNo bhagavAn rudro vAruNI bhUdharAtmajA
verses.translation: May the four Vedas, the Itihasas, Puranas, Dharma-Sastras accompanied by the Vedic lore, although mutually disagreeing but based on the nature of Siva, grant my desire at the behest of Siva and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: बालेन्दुशेखरो वायुः शिवा शिवमनोहरा । यक्षो यज्ञशिरोहर्ता ऋद्धिर्हिमगिरीन्द्रजा
verses.transliteration: bAlendushekharo vAyuH shivA shivamanoharA | yakSho yaj~nashirohartA R^iddhirhimagirIndrajA
verses.translation: Then the great lord Rudra, the important form of lord Siva, is the lord of the zone of Fire and possesses all Aisvaryas. He is enriched with the identity with Siva. He is devoid as well as possessed of attributes. He is Sattvic, Rajasic and Tamasic. Basically he is not prone to aberra¬ tions. Then outwardly he assumes aberrations. He is of extra¬ ordinary activity apart from the activity of creation etc. He cut off the head of Brahma. He is his father as well as his son. He is the progenitor and son of Vi§nu to whom he con¬ trols. He is the enlightener of both. The lord blesses them for ever. Rudra is stationed within and without the cosmos. He is the lord of the worlds. He is fond of Siva to whom

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रार्धशेखरश्चन्द्रो रोहिणी रुद्रवल्लभा । ईशानः परमेशानस्तदार्या परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: chandrArdhashekharashchandro rohiNI rudravallabhA | IshAnaH parameshAnastadAryA parameshvarI
verses.translation: His six ancillaries Brahman etc. and the eight deities ending with VidyeSa, the four different Murtis devotel to Siva, with Siva as their cause, Siva, Bfiava, Hara and Mfda — may these grant my desire at the behest of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तवलयोऽनन्तो ह्यनन्तानन्तवल्लभा । कालाग्निरुद्रः कालारिः काली कालान्तकप्रिया
verses.transliteration: anantavalayo.ananto hyanantAnantavallabhA | kAlAgnirudraH kAlAriH kAlI kAlAntakapriyA
verses.translation: Vinu is another form of the great lord Siva himself. He is the lord of the principle of water. He is sta¬ tioned in the region of the unmanifcst. He is Nirguna. He is predominantly Sattvic as well as possessed of single Guna. He does not identify himself with the created things. He has the three general aberrations. He is of extraordinary activity apart form that of creation. He compares with Brahma though he is born of the right part of Siva. He is created by the first Brahma and he is his creator too. Vi§nu abides within and without the universe. He is the lord of the

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषाख्यो मनुः शम्भुः शतरूपा शिवप्रिया । दक्षः साक्षान्महादेवः प्रसूतिः परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: puruShAkhyo manuH shambhuH shatarUpA shivapriyA | dakShaH sAkShAnmahAdevaH prasUtiH parameshvarI
verses.translation: The four Murtis of Vinu, viz Vasudeva, Aniruddha, Pradyumna, and Saihkarsana, the ten Avataras viz— the fish, tortoise, boar, man-lion, dwarf, Rama trio, Kr§na and the horse-faced Kalki, his discus Paflcajanya and

verses.sanskrit: रुचिर्भवो भवानी च बुधैराकूतिरुच्यते । भृगुर्भगाक्षिहा देवः ख्यातिस्त्रिनयनप्रिया
verses.transliteration: ruchirbhavo bhavAnI cha budhairAkUtiruchyate | bhR^igurbhagAkShihA devaH khyAtistrinayanapriyA
verses.translation: May Indra, Agni, Yama, Nirrti, Vanina, ag6. The Verse is repeated. See Vayaviya S, 30. =.

verses.sanskrit: वस्तु किञ्चिदचिद्रूपं किञ्चिद्वस्तु चिदात्मकम् । द्वयं शुद्धमशुद्धं च परं चापरमेव च
verses.transliteration: vastu ki~nchidachidrUpaM ki~nchidvastu chidAtmakam | dvayaM shuddhamashuddhaM cha paraM chAparameva cha
verses.translation: May the divine weapons of the lord and the goddess — viz — the trident, thunderbolt, axe, arrow, sword, noose, goad and the excellent weapon Pin aka protect me always at behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिर्भगवान् रुद्रः सम्भूतिः शर्ववल्लभा । गङ्गाधरोऽङ्गिरा ज्ञेयः स्मृतिः साक्षादुमा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: marIchirbhagavAn rudraH sambhUtiH sharvavallabhA | ga~NgAdharo.a~NgirA j~neyaH smR^itiH sAkShAdumA smR^itA
verses.translation: May the bull, the powerful son of Kamadhenu, rivalling with the submarine fire Varava, surrounded by five mother-cows*®' who has attained the state being the vehicle of the lord and the goddess, grant my desire, at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यः शशभृन्मौलिः प्रीतिः कान्ता पिनाकिनः । पुलहस्त्रिपुरध्वंसी तत्प्रिया तु शिवप्रिया
verses.transliteration: pulastyaH shashabhR^inmauliH prItiH kAntA pinAkinaH | pulahastripuradhvaMsI tatpriyA tu shivapriyA
verses.translation: The five mother- cows stationed in Siva's region are Nanda, Sunanda, Surabhi, Susila and Sumanas.

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुध्वंसी क्रतुः प्रोक्तः सन्नतिर्दयिता विभोः । त्रिनेत्रोऽत्रिरुमा साक्षादनसूया स्मृता बुधैः
verses.transliteration: kratudhvaMsI kratuH proktaH sannatirdayitA vibhoH | trinetro.atrirumA sAkShAdanasUyA smR^itA budhaiH
verses.translation: They are engaged in devotion to Siva and are engrossed in his worship. May these grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपः कालहा देवो देवमाता महेश्वरी । वसिष्ठो मन्मथारातिर्देवी साक्षादरुन्धती
verses.transliteration: kashyapaH kAlahA devo devamAtA maheshvarI | vasiShTho manmathArAtirdevI sAkShAdarundhatI
verses.translation: Ksetrapala of great splendour resembling the blue cloud with his face terrible due to the curved fangs, refulgent with throbbing red lips, with red hairs lifted up, with the crooked, eyebrows, three circular red eyes, with the moon and the serpents as ornaments, being in nude form holds the trident noose, sword and the skull in his hands, of terrible aspect, surrounded by Bhairavas, Siddhas and Yoginis, is seated in every temple. He is the protector of the good. Bowing to lord Siva is his great interest. He is purified by pious feelings towards Siva. He protects those who seek re¬ fuge in him particularly as his own sons. May he grant my desire at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्करः पुरुषाः सर्वे स्त्रियः सर्वा महेश्वरी । सर्वे स्त्रीपुरुषास्तस्मात्तयोरेव विभूतयः
verses.transliteration: sha~NkaraH puruShAH sarve striyaH sarvA maheshvarI | sarve strIpuruShAstasmAttayoreva vibhUtayaH
verses.translation: May the four deities Talajahgha and others wor¬ shipped in the first Avarana protect me at the behest of Siva and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: विषयी भगवानीशो विषयः परमेश्वरी । श्राव्यं सर्वमुमारूपं श्रोता शूलवरायुधः
verses.transliteration: viShayI bhagavAnIsho viShayaH parameshvarI | shrAvyaM sarvamumArUpaM shrotA shUlavarAyudhaH
verses.translation: May Bhairava and others who surround him all round bless me at the behest of the two.

verses.sanskrit: प्रष्टव्यं वस्तुजातं तु धत्ते शङ्करवल्लभा । प्रष्टा स एव विश्वात्मा बालचन्द्रावतंसकः
verses.transliteration: praShTavyaM vastujAtaM tu dhatte sha~NkaravallabhA | praShTA sa eva vishvAtmA bAlachandrAvataMsakaH
verses.translation: For the names of the mother-cows, see below verse 144*

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टव्यं वस्तुरूपं तु बिभर्ति भववल्लभा । द्रष्टा विश्वेश्वरो देवः शशिखण्डशिखामणिः
verses.transliteration: draShTavyaM vasturUpaM tu bibharti bhavavallabhA | draShTA vishveshvaro devaH shashikhaNDashikhAmaNiH
verses.translation: The great lore of Siva capable of releasing the individual soul from the fivefold bondage is different from Pasuvidya. The scripture of Saivite virtue and the Dharma, the Purana of Siva approved of by Srutis, and the Saivitc scriptures Kamika and others of four types honoured by iSiva and Siva and worshipped by me may all these make this holy rite accomplished well and fruitful.

verses.sanskrit: रसजातं महादेवी देवो रसयिता शिवः । प्रेयजातं च गिरिजा प्रेयांश्चैव गराशनः
verses.transliteration: rasajAtaM mahAdevI devo rasayitA shivaH | preyajAtaM cha girijA preyAMshchaiva garAshanaH
verses.translation: May the early preceptors from iSveta to NakulTsa along with their disciples, the preceptors born as member? of their families, especially my preceptors, both Saivas and Mahesvaras engrossed in Siva's knowledge and holy rites, permit this holy rite to be fruitful and well accomplis¬ hed.

verses.sanskrit: मन्तव्यवस्तुतां धत्ते सदा देवी महेश्वरी । मन्ता स एव विश्वात्मा महादेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: mantavyavastutAM dhatte sadA devI maheshvarI | mantA sa eva vishvAtmA mahAdevo maheshvaraH
verses.translation: May the, lay brahmins, Ksatriyas.. those who are experts in the knowledge of the Vedas and the ancillaries together with their tenets in the lines of Saivite virtue, those who are well-versed in all sacred scriptures, the followers of Sarhkhya, Vaisesika, Nyaya and other systems of philosophy, the followers of the sun, Brahma, Rudra and Visnu and all

verses.sanskrit: यत्संसरति चिच्चक्रमचिच्चक्रसमन्वितम् । तदेवाशुद्धमपरमितरं तु परं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: yatsaMsarati chichchakramachichchakrasamanvitam | tadevAshuddhamaparamitaraM tu paraM shubham
verses.translation: The followers of Siva who adhere to the philosophical path, those who perform the Pasupata rites those who observe the holy rites and the Saivite holy men such as Kapalikas — all these are adherents and executors of iSiva's behests. I'hey shall be worshipped by me at the behest of Siva. May these bless me. Let them praise the successful holy rite.

verses.sanskrit: बोद्धव्यवस्तुरूपं तु बिभर्ति भववल्लभा । देवः स एव भगवान् बोद्धा मुग्धेन्दुशेखरः
verses.transliteration: boddhavyavasturUpaM tu bibharti bhavavallabhA | devaH sa eva bhagavAn boddhA mugdhendushekharaH
verses.translation: Those who adhere to the path of knowledge according to the southerners, those who follow the southern cult and the northern cult abide by me. without mutual clash since I wish and seek the welfare through the mantras. »

verses.sanskrit: प्राणः पिनाकी सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भगवान् प्रभुः । प्राणस्थितिस्तु सर्वेषामम्बिका चाम्बुरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: prANaH pinAkI sarveShAM prANinAM bhagavAn prabhuH | prANasthitistu sarveShAmambikA chAmburUpiNI
verses.translation: May the atheists, tenacious rogues, ungrateful and Tamasic heretics and great sinners be far aXvay from me.

verses.sanskrit: बिभर्ति क्षेत्रतां देवी त्रिपुरान्तकवल्लभा । क्षेत्रज्ञत्वं तदा धत्ते भगवानन्तकान्तकः
verses.transliteration: bibharti kShetratAM devI tripurAntakavallabhA | kShetraj~natvaM tadA dhatte bhagavAnantakAntakaH
verses.translation: Obeisance to Siva accompanied by $iva. Obeis¬ ance to you the primordial cause accompanied by your son. Obeisance to you encircled by the universe in the form of five A varan as.

verses.sanskrit: अहः शूलायुधो देवः शूलपाणिप्रिया निशा । आकाशः शङ्करो देवः पृथिवी शङ्करप्रिया
verses.transliteration: ahaH shUlAyudho devaH shUlapANipriyA nishA | AkAshaH sha~Nkaro devaH pR^ithivI sha~NkarapriyA
verses.translation: After saying this he shall prostrate before Siva and $iva and perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra not les.s than hundred and eight times.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रो भगवानीशो वेला शैलेन्द्रकन्यका । वृक्षो वृषध्वजो देवो लता विश्वेश्वरप्रिया
verses.transliteration: samudro bhagavAnIsho velA shailendrakanyakA | vR^ikSho vR^iShadhvajo devo latA vishveshvarapriyA
verses.translation: Similarly he shall perform the Japa of iSakti man¬ tra, dedicate it to Siva and crave forgiveness. He shall thus conclude the remaining rites of worship.

verses.sanskrit: पुँल्लिङ्गमखिलं धत्ते भगवान् पुरशासनः । स्त्रिलिङ्गं चाखिलं धत्ते देवी देवमनोरमा
verses.transliteration: pu.Nlli~NgamakhilaM dhatte bhagavAn purashAsanaH | strili~NgaM chAkhilaM dhatte devI devamanoramA
verses.translation: He who repeats this everyday or listens to this with mental purity shakes off sins and attains Sivasayujya soon.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दजालमशेषं तु धत्ते सर्वस्य वल्लभा । अर्थस्वरूपमखिलं धत्ते मुग्धेन्दुशेखरः
verses.transliteration: shabdajAlamasheShaM tu dhatte sarvasya vallabhA | arthasvarUpamakhilaM dhatte mugdhendushekharaH
verses.translation: Slayers of cows, ungrateful wretches, murderers of heroes, those who slay children in the womb, murderers of those who seek refuge, those who kill

verses.sanskrit: यस्य यस्य पदार्थस्य या या शक्तिरुदाहृता । सा सा विश्वेश्वरी देवी स स सर्वो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yasya yasya padArthasya yA yA shaktirudAhR^itA | sA sA vishveshvarI devI sa sa sarvo maheshvaraH
verses.translation: When bad dreams and evil portents occur in¬ dicating terror and danger this hymn shall be repeated. Then those dangers do not befall.

verses.sanskrit: यत्परं यत्पवित्रं च यत्पुण्यं यच्च मङ्गलम् । तत्तदाह महाभागास्तयोस्तेजोविजृम्भितम्
verses.transliteration: yatparaM yatpavitraM cha yatpuNyaM yachcha ma~Ngalam | tattadAha mahAbhAgAstayostejovijR^imbhitam
verses.translation: Let the accruing of the benefit stand alone.

verses.sanskrit: यथा दीपस्य दीप्तस्य शिखा दीपयते गृहम् । तथा तेजस्तयोरेतद् व्याप्य दीपयते जगत्
verses.transliteration: yathA dIpasya dIptasya shikhA dIpayate gR^iham | tathA tejastayoretad vyApya dIpayate jagat
verses.translation: Hence after worshipping the lord and Uma in the heaven the devotee shall siand with palms joined in rever¬ ence and repeat the hymn.

verses.sanskrit: अपरं च परं चैव द्वयं चिदचिदात्मकम् । शिवस्य च शिवायाश्च स्वाम्यं चैतत्स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: aparaM cha paraM chaiva dvayaM chidachidAtmakam | shivasya cha shivAyAshcha svAmyaM chaitatsvabhAvataH
verses.translation: O Kr§na, what has been mentioned to you is the site which yields benefit here and hereafter. It is a great synthesis of physical rites, penance, Japas and meditation.

verses.sanskrit: तृणादिशिवमूर्त्यन्तं विश्वख्यातिशयक्रमः । सन्निकर्षक्रमवशात्तयोरिति परा श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: tR^iNAdishivamUrtyantaM vishvakhyAtishayakramaH | sannikarShakramavashAttayoriti parA shrutiH
verses.translation: Now I shall mention that great rite of worship, Homa, Japa, meditation, penance and charitable gifts, which yields benefits here itself to men who follow Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाकारात्मकावेतौ सर्वश्रेयोविधायिनौ । पूजनीयौ नमस्कार्यौ चिन्तनीयौ च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: sarvAkArAtmakAvetau sarvashreyovidhAyinau | pUjanIyau namaskAryau chintanIyau cha sarvadA
verses.translation: The devotee expert in the meaning of mantras shall at the outset practise mantras since the rites of visible bene¬ fits here itself are not fruitful otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: यथाप्रज्ञमिदं कृष्ण याथात्म्यं परमेशयोः । कथितं हि मया तेऽद्य न तु तावदियत्तया
verses.transliteration: yathApraj~namidaM kR^iShNa yAthAtmyaM parameshayoH | kathitaM hi mayA te.adya na tu tAvadiyattayA
verses.translation: A learned and sensible devotee, even after the mantra has been achieved, shall not haphazardly perform any rite the fruit whereof has been thwarted by some un¬ seen powerful obstacle.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कथं शक्यते वक्तुं याथात्म्यं परमेशयोः । महतामपि सर्वेषां मनसोऽपि बहिर्गतम्
verses.transliteration: tatkathaM shakyate vaktuM yAthAtmyaM parameshayoH | mahatAmapi sarveShAM manaso.api bahirgatam
verses.translation: He who due to delusion performs the rite yield¬ ing the benefit here itself does not attain the fruit thereof and becomes the laughing stock.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्गतमनन्यानामीश्वरार्पितचेतसाम् । अन्येषां बुद्ध्यनारूढमारूढं च यथैव तत्
verses.transliteration: antargatamananyAnAmIshvarArpitachetasAm | anyeShAM buddhyanArUDhamArUDhaM cha yathaiva tat
verses.translation: Without faith and devotion no one shall perform the rite intended to yield direct benefit. He becomes an unbeliever and an unbeliever does not attain fruit.

verses.sanskrit: येयमुक्ता विभूतिर्वै प्राकृती सा परा मता । अप्राकृतां परामन्यां गुह्यां गुह्यविदो विदुः
verses.transliteration: yeyamuktA vibhUtirvai prAkR^itI sA parA matA | aprAkR^itAM parAmanyAM guhyAM guhyavido viduH
verses.translation: An aspirant who has mastered the mantras over¬ coming the obstacles and who performs the rite with full confidence and conviction attains the fruit.

verses.sanskrit: यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते मनसा चेन्द्रियैः सह । अप्राकृती परा चैषा विभूतिः पारमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: yato vAcho nivartante manasA chendriyaiH saha | aprAkR^itI parA chaiShA vibhUtiH pArameshvarI
verses.translation: Or, for the attainment of the benefit let him be scrupulously celibate, eating only the Havisya, milk-pudding or fruits.

verses.sanskrit: सैवेह परमं धाम सैवेह परमा गतिः । सैवेह परमा काष्ठा विभूतिः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: saiveha paramaM dhAma saiveha paramA gatiH | saiveha paramA kAShThA vibhUtiH parameShThinaH
verses.translation: He shall not even think of, much less physically do, such prohibited actions as violence. He shall be pure always with clear dress and smear the body with Bhasma always.

verses.sanskrit: तां प्राप्तुं प्रयतन्तेऽत्र जितश्वासा जितेन्द्रियाः । गर्भकारागृहद्वारं निश्छिद्रं घटितं यथा
verses.transliteration: tAM prAptuM prayatante.atra jitashvAsA jitendriyAH | garbhakArAgR^ihadvAraM nishChidraM ghaTitaM yathA
verses.translation: After observing the rules of conduct, the devotee shall on an auspicious and favourable day with the char¬ acteristics mentioned before, smear the ground with cowdung in a spot bedecked with garlands of flowers and draw the auspicious lotus shining with its own refiilgence. It shall be of molten gold with eight petals and filaments, with the peri¬ carp in the middle set with all gems. It shall be not less than a Hasta in width and must have a stalk befitting its size. He shall conceive Anima etc. in the bulbous root made of gold, in accordance with the injunctions. He shall instal the phallic idol with its pedestal, made of gems, gold or crystal with the requisite characteristics. He shall invoke

verses.sanskrit: संसाराशीविषालीढमृतसञ्जीवनौषधम् । विभूतिं शिवयोर्विद्वान्न बिभेति कुतश्चन
verses.transliteration: saMsArAshIviShAlIDhamR^itasa~njIvanauShadham | vibhUtiM shivayorvidvAnna bibheti kutashchana
verses.translation: It shall have four arms and four faces. It shall be bedecked in all ornaments. It shall wear the tiger's hide with the smiling face and the gestures of granting boons and of protection to the devotee. Other hands shall hold the deer and the axe. Or if the conceiver desires he can conceive of the Murti as having eight arms.

verses.sanskrit: शिवयोर्वै वशे विश्वं न विश्वस्य वशे शिवौ । ईशितव्यमिदं यस्मात्तस्माद्विश्वेश्वरौ शिवौ
verses.transliteration: shivayorvai vashe vishvaM na vishvasya vashe shivau | IshitavyamidaM yasmAttasmAdvishveshvarau shivau
verses.translation: Then the right hand holds the trident, axe, sword and the thunderbolt. The left hands hold the noose, goad, iron club and the serpent.

verses.sanskrit: यः परामपरां चैव विभूतिं वेत्ति तत्त्वतः । सोऽपरां भूतिमुल्लङ्घ्य परां भूतिं समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: yaH parAmaparAM chaiva vibhUtiM vetti tattvataH | so.aparAM bhUtimulla~Nghya parAM bhUtiM samashnute
verses.translation: The Murti shall have the lustre of the rising sun. It shall have three eyes in every face. The face towards the east is gentle and has the refulgence befitting its size and features.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं कृष्ण याथात्म्यं परमात्मनोः । रहस्यमपि योग्योऽसि भर्गभक्तो भवानिति
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaM kR^iShNa yAthAtmyaM paramAtmanoH | rahasyamapi yogyo.asi bhargabhakto bhavAniti
verses.translation: The southern face resembles the blue cloud and has a terrific appearance. The northern face has the lustre of coral and is bedecked with dark forelocks.

verses.sanskrit: नाशिष्येभ्योऽप्यशैवेभ्यो नाभक्तेभ्यः कदाचन । व्याहरेदीशयोर्भूतिमिति वेदानुशासनम्
verses.transliteration: nAshiShyebhyo.apyashaivebhyo nAbhaktebhyaH kadAchana | vyAharedIshayorbhUtimiti vedAnushAsanam
verses.translation: She is famous as Mahalaksmi dark coloured and wholly charming. After conceiving the Murti thus and unifying it into a whole he shall invoke the embodied lord and worship him. For the purpose of ablution he shall arrange for Paricagavya prepared from a tawny cow.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वमतिकल्याण परेभ्यः कथयेन्न हि । त्वादृशेभ्योऽनुरूपेभ्यः कथयैतन्न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: tasmAttvamatikalyANa parebhyaH kathayenna hi | tvAdR^ishebhyo.anurUpebhyaH kathayaitanna chAnyathA
verses.translation: There shall be Paftcamrta and particularly the full seeds. He shall prepare the Mandala ahead decorated with gem-dust. The water-pot of Isana shall be put in the pericarp. The water-pots of Sadyojata shall be placed around, afterwards.®**

verses.sanskrit: विभूतिमेतां शिवयोर्योग्येभ्यो यः प्रदापयेत् । संसारसागरान् मुक्तः शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: vibhUtimetAM shivayoryogyebhyo yaH pradApayet | saMsArasAgarAn muktaH shivasAyujyamApnuyAt
verses.translation: Eight pots of Vidyea shall be filled with the waters of holy centres and threads shall be tied round them. Sacred articles of worship shall be dropped therein with due incantations in accordance with the injunctions. They shall be completely covered into the silken cloth with the mantras. When the proper time arrives he shall perform the ablution of the lord with Paricagavya.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तनादस्य नश्यन्ति महान्त्यः पापकोटयः । त्रिश्चतुर्धा समभ्यस्तैर्विनश्यन्ति ततोऽधिकाः
verses.transliteration: kIrtanAdasya nashyanti mahAntyaH pApakoTayaH | trishchaturdhA samabhyastairvinashyanti tato.adhikAH
verses.translation: Waters dropped from the Darbha grass, golden and gemset vessels, scented and flowery waters purified with the mantras shall be taken from the vessels and Mahevara shall be bathed. Scents and flowers shall be offered, lights shown and the worship performed. The unguent shall be not less than a Pala by weight and the maximum shall be eleven Palas.

verses.sanskrit: नश्यन्त्यनिष्टरिपवो वर्धन्ते सुहृदस्तथा । विद्या च वर्धते शैवी मतिः सत्ये प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: nashyantyaniShTaripavo vardhante suhR^idastathA | vidyA cha vardhate shaivI matiH satye pravartate
verses.translation: Auspicious and charming flowers of good colour and fragrance blue and other lilies, plenty of Bilva leaves, red lotuses and white lotuses if available shall be used. The incense shall be offered with the black Aguru. The gum-resin shall be used with the camphor and ghee. The ghee used for lamps shall be of the milk of tawny cows. The five Brahmans, the six Angas and the Avaranas shall be worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तिः पराः शिवे साम्बे सानुगे सपरिच्छिदे । यद्यदिष्टतमं चान्यत्तत्तदाप्नोत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktiH parAH shive sAmbe sAnuge saparichChide | yadyadiShTatamaM chAnyattattadApnotyasaMshayam
verses.translation: The Naivedya shall be made of Caru prepared in ghee and milk with jaggery. The water shall be rendered fragrant with the Patala flowers, lilies and lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःशुचिः शिवे भक्तो विस्रब्धः कीर्तयेद्यदि । प्रबलैः कर्मभिः पूर्वैः फलं चेत्प्रतिबध्यते । पुनः पुनः समभ्यस्येत्तस्य नास्तीह दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: antaHshuchiH shive bhakto visrabdhaH kIrtayedyadi | prabalaiH karmabhiH pUrvaiH phalaM chetpratibadhyate | punaH punaH samabhyasyettasya nAstIha durlabham
verses.translation: Freshly woven cloths of various colours and of fine fabric attractive to the sight shall be offered with songs and instrumental music.

verses.sanskrit: यथा शिवस्तथा देवी यथा देवी तथा शिवः । नानयोरन्तरं विद्याच्चन्द्रचन्द्रिकयोरिव
verses.transliteration: yathA shivastathA devI yathA devI tathA shivaH | nAnayorantaraM vidyAchchandrachandrikayoriva
verses.translation: The maximum number of times for Japa is hun¬ dred thousand. According to the benefit desired the number of worship varies from one to three.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: When quiescent or nourishing rites are being per¬ formed, Siva shall be thought of as gentle in the phallicimage in the Siva -fire and in other idols as well.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥ ७.२.५. पञ्चमोऽध्यायः । पशुपतित्वज्ञानयोगः । उपमन्युरुवाच । विग्रहं देवदेवस्य विश्वमेतत् चराचरम् । तदेवं न विजानन्ति पशवः पाशगौरवात्
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH || 7\.2\.5\. pa~nchamo.adhyAyaH | pashupatitvaj~nAnayogaH | upamanyuruvAcha | vigrahaM devadevasya vishvametat charAcharam | tadevaM na vijAnanti pashavaH pAshagauravAt
verses.translation: In Marana and other rites the Sruk and lruva shall be made of iron. In all other rites such as quiescent these shall be made of gold.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः पतित्वात्तु शिवः सदसत्पतिरुच्यते । क्षराक्षरात्मकं प्राहुः क्षराक्षरपरं परे
verses.transliteration: tayoH patitvAttu shivaH sadasatpatiruchyate | kSharAkSharAtmakaM prAhuH kSharAkSharaparaM pare
verses.translation: In the rite of Mrtyufijaya the Hotna is perfor¬ med with Dui'va mixed with ghee and cow's milk, or honey or with Garu along with ghee, or milk alone. For the rites intended to quell ailments to attain prosperity and subdue poverty, gingelly seeds, ghee, milk or lotus-flowers shall be used. Persons seeking to bring persons undei control shall perform Homa with Jati flowers and ghee,

verses.sanskrit: क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते । उभे ते परमेशस्य रूपे तस्य वशे यतः
verses.transliteration: kSharaH sarvANi bhUtAni kUTastho.akShara uchyate | ubhe te parameshasya rUpe tasya vashe yataH
verses.translation: A Brahman shall perform the rite of Akarsana with ghee and Karavira flowers, Uccatana with oil and Slambhana with honey.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः परः शिवः शान्तः क्षराक्षरापरः स्मृतः । समष्टिव्यष्ठिरूपं च समष्टिव्यष्टिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: tayoH paraH shivaH shAntaH kSharAkSharAparaH smR^itaH | samaShTivyaShThirUpaM cha samaShTivyaShTikAraNam
verses.translation: Stambhana rite can be performed with mustard also; Patana with garlic; Tadana with the blood of mule, camel or of both.

verses.sanskrit: वदन्ति मुनयः केचित् शिवं परमकारणम् । समष्टिमाहुरव्यक्तं व्यष्टिं व्यक्तं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vadanti munayaH kechit shivaM paramakAraNam | samaShTimAhuravyaktaM vyaShTiM vyaktaM tathaiva cha
verses.translation: Marana and Uccatana shall be performed with Rohi and gingelly seeds. Vidvesana rite shall be pcrfoimed with the oil of Lahgala.

verses.sanskrit: ते रूपे परमेशस्य तदिच्छायाः प्रवर्तनात् । तयोः कारणभावेन शिवं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: te rUpe parameshasya tadichChAyAH pravartanAt | tayoH kAraNabhAvena shivaM paramakAraNam
verses.translation: Bandhana rites and the rite of paralysing of a vast army shall be performed with the seeds of Rohi. In Abhicarika rites the articles of Homa shall be used with the red mustard and the Homa shall be performed with oils extracted from manually operated machines. It can also be performed with seeds of cotton in combination with KatukI and husk. In Abhicarika rites the devotee shall perform Homa with mustard seeds mixed with oil. Milk yields the subdual of fevers and is conducive to good fortune.

verses.sanskrit: कारणार्थविदः प्राहुः समष्टिव्यष्टिकारणम् । जातिव्यक्तिस्वरूपीति कथ्यते कैश्चिदीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kAraNArthavidaH prAhuH samaShTivyaShTikAraNam | jAtivyaktisvarUpIti kathyate kaishchidIshvaraH
verses.translation: Homa offered with honey, ghee, curds, milk and rice-grains or with Garu grants all desires.

verses.sanskrit: या पिण्डेऽप्यनुवर्तेत सा जातिरिति कथ्यते । व्यक्तिर्व्यावृत्तिरूपं तं पिण्डजातं समाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: yA piNDe.apyanuvarteta sA jAtiriti kathyate | vyaktirvyAvR^ittirUpaM taM piNDajAtaM samAshrayam
verses.translation: Quiescent, nourishing, Vasya and Akarsana rites shall be performed with the seven articles of worship sacrificial twigs etc.

verses.sanskrit: जातयो व्यक्तयश्चैव तदाज्ञापरिपालिताः । यतस्ततो महादेवो जातिव्यक्तिवपुः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: jAtayo vyaktayashchaiva tadAj~nAparipAlitAH | yatastato mahAdevo jAtivyaktivapuH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Vaya..Akarsana and Sripada (glorious position) rites shall be performed with the leaves of Bilva for Havana. It yields conquest over the enemies.,

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानपुरुषव्यक्तकालात्मा कथ्यते शिवः । प्रधानं प्रकृतिं प्राहुःक्षेत्रज्ञं पुरुषं तथा
verses.transliteration: pradhAnapuruShavyaktakAlAtmA kathyate shivaH | pradhAnaM prakR^itiM prAhuHkShetraj~naM puruShaM tathA
verses.translation: In quiescent rites the twigs of Palasa, Khadira etc. shall be used. In rites of cruelty the twigs of Karavira and

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोविंशतितत्त्वानि व्यक्तमाहुर्मनीषिणः । कालः कार्यप्रपञ्चस्य परिणामैककारणम्
verses.transliteration: trayoviMshatitattvAni vyaktamAhurmanIShiNaH | kAlaH kAryaprapa~nchasya pariNAmaikakAraNam
verses.translation: No virtuous man, occupying honourable position or otherwise shall perform the Abhicarika rite against the ruler of his country.

verses.sanskrit: तमेकमेव बहुधा वदन्ति यदुनन्दन । अजानन्तः परं भावमविकल्पं महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: tamekameva bahudhA vadanti yadunandana | ajAnantaH paraM bhAvamavikalpaM maharShayaH
verses.translation: Even if he happens to be a desperado one shall not perform Abhicarika rile against a person who has sought refuge in Siva, mentally, verbally or physically.

verses.sanskrit: एषामीशोऽधिपो धाता प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः । आविर्भावतिरोभावहेतुरेकः स्वराडजः
verses.transliteration: eShAmIsho.adhipo dhAtA pravartakanivartakaH | AvirbhAvatirobhAvaheturekaH svarADajaH
verses.translation: A man performing Abhicarika rite against the ruler of his country whether he be a devotee of Siva or not, shall have a fall immediately.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् प्रधानपुरुषव्यक्तकालस्वरूपवान् । हेतुर्नेताधिपस्तेषां धाता चोक्तो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tasmAt pradhAnapuruShavyaktakAlasvarUpavAn | heturnetAdhipasteShAM dhAtA chokto maheshvaraH
verses.translation: If he wishes for his own happinness he shall not perform Abhicarika rite against the protector of his country or against any devotee of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: विराड् हिरण्यगर्भात्मा कैश्चिदीशो निगद्यते । हिरण्यगर्भो लोकानां हेतुर्विश्वात्मको विराट्
verses.transliteration: virAD hiraNyagarbhAtmA kaishchidIsho nigadyate | hiraNyagarbho lokAnAM heturvishvAtmako virAT
verses.translation: If he performs the rite of Marana etc. against any other person he shall perform expiatory rites after due repen tence.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्यामी परश्चेति कथ्यते कविभिः शिवः । प्राज्ञस्तैजसविश्वात्मेत्यपरे सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: antaryAmI parashcheti kathyate kavibhiH shivaH | prAj~nastaijasavishvAtmetyapare samprachakShate
verses.translation: Iflihgas of gold and gems are not available or if he is unable to possess them he shall perform the worship mentally or with substitute articles.

verses.sanskrit: तुरीयमपरे प्राहुः सौम्यमेव परे विदुः । माता मानं च मेयं च मतिं चाहुरथापरे
verses.transliteration: turIyamapare prAhuH saumyameva pare viduH | mAtA mAnaM cha meyaM cha matiM chAhurathApare
verses.translation: If a devotee can perform worship in some part he too derives the benefit of that part in accordance with his ability.

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता क्रिया च कार्यं च करणं कारणं परे । जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्त्यात्मेत्यपरे सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: kartA kriyA cha kAryaM cha karaNaM kAraNaM pare | jAgratsvapnasuShuptyAtmetyapare samprachakShate
verses.translation: If the preceptor does not wish to receive, the entire gift shall be given to Siva or the devotees of Siva. It shall not be given to any other.

verses.sanskrit: तुरीयमपरे प्राहुस्तुर्यातीतमितीतरे । तमाहुर्विगुणं केचिद्गुणवन्तं परे विदुः
verses.transliteration: turIyamapare prAhusturyAtItamitItare | tamAhurviguNaM kechidguNavantaM pare viduH
verses.translation: If any one performs the rite him.self without

verses.sanskrit: केचित्संसारिणं प्राहुस्तमसंसारिणं परे । स्वतन्त्रमपरे प्राहुरस्वतन्त्रं परे विदुः
verses.transliteration: kechitsaMsAriNaM prAhustamasaMsAriNaM pare | svatantramapare prAhurasvatantraM pare viduH
verses.translation: The lihga used for worship may be taken by him¬ self or given to others. If he takes that himself he shall worship it everyday or cause it to be worshipped on. his be¬ half.

verses.sanskrit: घोरमित्यपरे प्राहुः सौम्यमेव परे विदुः । रागवन्तं परे प्राहुर्वीतरागं तथा परे
verses.transliteration: ghoramityapare prAhuH saumyameva pare viduH | rAgavantaM pare prAhurvItarAgaM tathA pare
verses.translation: If he performs the rite as ordained he cannot but have the benefit. What other inducement for worship shall there be?

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रियं च परे प्राहुः सक्रियं चेतरे जनाः । निरिन्द्रियं परे प्राहुः सेन्द्रियं च तथा परे
verses.transliteration: niShkriyaM cha pare prAhuH sakriyaM chetare janAH | nirindriyaM pare prAhuH sendriyaM cha tathA pare
verses.translation: Still I shall mention about the excellent achievement through the rite. Even if he is attacked by the enemy or tormented by ailments, even if he falls into the jaws of death he will be freed without danger. Even the worst miserly fellow will become worthy of respect. The poor will become Kuvera,® god of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: अपरं ब्रह्मरूपं च परं ब्रह्मात्मकं तथा । केचिदाहुर्महादेवमनादिनिधनं परम्
verses.transliteration: aparaM brahmarUpaM cha paraM brahmAtmakaM tathA | kechidAhurmahAdevamanAdinidhanaM param
verses.translation: The ugly man will become beautiful, the aged will become young. The enemy will turn a friend, the op¬ ponent will grow subordinate.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवमित्यपरे प्राहुस्तमध्रुवमितीतरे । अरूपं केचिदाहुर्वै रूपवन्तं परे विदुः
verses.transliteration: dhruvamityapare prAhustamadhruvamitItare | arUpaM kechidAhurvai rUpavantaM pare viduH
verses.translation: The nectar that may have turned into poison shall become nectar again. The ground may turn into ocean and ocean into ground; the ditch into a mountain and the mountain into a ditch; fire into a lotus lake and the lotus lake into fire; the park into a forest and the forest into a garden; the animal into a lion and the lion into an animal.

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यमपरे प्राहुर्दृश्यमित्यपरे विदुः । वाच्यमित्यपरे प्राहुरवाच्यमिति चापरे । शब्दात्मकं परे प्राहुश्शब्दातीतमथापरे
verses.transliteration: adR^ishyamapare prAhurdR^ishyamityapare viduH | vAchyamityapare prAhuravAchyamiti chApare | shabdAtmakaM pare prAhushshabdAtItamathApare
verses.translation: Women will run after him voluntarily. Prosperity will behave like a chaste lady and will not leave him. The goddess of speech will be his slave girl, fame a prostitute.

verses.sanskrit: केचित् चिन्तामयं प्राहुश्चिन्तया रहितं परे । ज्ञानात्मकं परे प्राहुर्विज्ञानमिति चापरे
verses.transliteration: kechit chintAmayaM prAhushchintayA rahitaM pare | j~nAnAtmakaM pare prAhurvij~nAnamiti chApare
verses.translation: The intelligence will roam about as it pleases. His mind will be pure like a diamond. Hi', strength will be like a violent gust of wind or like an elephant in rut.

verses.sanskrit: केचित् ज्ञेयमिति प्राहुरज्ञेयमिति केचन । परमेके तमेवाहुरपरं च तथा परे
verses.transliteration: kechit j~neyamiti prAhuraj~neyamiti kechana | parameke tamevAhuraparaM cha tathA pare
verses.translation: His activities on the side of the enemies will be paralysed in their effort. The friends of enemies wiill be¬ come their enemies.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विकल्प्यमानं तु याथात्म्यं परमेष्ठिनः । नाध्यवस्यन्ति मुनयो नानाप्रत्ययकारणात्
verses.transliteration: evaM vikalpyamAnaM tu yAthAtmyaM parameShThinaH | nAdhyavasyanti munayo nAnApratyayakAraNAt
verses.translation: The enemies along with their kinsmen will be no better than corpses though physically alive. Though faced

verses.sanskrit: येः पुनः सर्वभावेन प्रपन्नाः परमेश्वरम् । ते हि जानन्त्ययत्नेन शिवं परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: yeH punaH sarvabhAvena prapannAH parameshvaram | te hi jAnantyayatnena shivaM paramakAraNam
verses.translation: Even if he takes unwholesome food it will act as aphrodisiac. Even if he indulges in sexual intercourse every¬ day it will give him fresh thrills.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्पशुर्नैव पश्यत्यनीशं कविं पुराणं भुवनस्येशितारम् । तावद्दुःखे वर्तते बद्धपाशः संसारेऽस्मिञ्चक्रनेमिक्रमेण
verses.transliteration: yAvatpashurnaiva pashyatyanIshaM kaviM purANaM bhuvanasyeshitAram | tAvadduHkhe vartate baddhapAshaH saMsAre.asmi~nchakranemikrameNa
verses.translation: Everything hitherto inaccessible to him will be¬ come accessible like the myrobalan in the palm. Even Siddhis anima etc. will become available at his will.

verses.sanskrit: यदा पश्यः पश्यते रुक्मवर्णं कर्तारमीशं पुरुषं ब्रह्मयोनिम् । तदा विद्वान्पुण्यपापे विधूय निरञ्जनः परममुपैति साम्यम्
verses.transliteration: yadA pashyaH pashyate rukmavarNaM kartAramIshaM puruShaM brahmayonim | tadA vidvAnpuNyapApe vidhUya nira~njanaH paramamupaiti sAmyam
verses.translation: Now I shall mention the rite for the benefits attain¬ able solely after death. There is nothing like this rite in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: भूतेन्द्रियान्तःकरणप्रधानविषयात्मकम् । अपरं ब्रह्म निर्दिष्टं परं ब्रह्म चिदात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: bhUtendriyAntaHkaraNapradhAnaviShayAtmakam | aparaM brahma nirdiShTaM paraM brahma chidAtmakam
verses.translation: The rite is attended with the excellence of merits. It has been performed by all the gods, particularly by Brahma, Visnu, Rudra, Indra, the guardians of the quarters, the nine planets — sun-god and others, by Visvamitra, Vasistha and other sages who know Brahman, by Iveta, Agastya, Dadhica and others, by us seeking refuge in Iiva, by Nandi- svara, Mahakala, Bhrhgisa and other Ganesvaras, by the Daityas residing in the nether worlds, by §esa and other serpents, by Siddhas, Yaksas, Gandharvas, Raksasa.s, Bhutas, Pisacas and practically by every one who has attained his respective position. It is by means of this rite that the gods have attained their godhood.

verses.sanskrit: बृहत्त्वाद् बृंहणत्वाद्वा ब्रह्म चेत्यभिधीयते । उभे ते ब्रह्मणो रूपे ब्रह्मणोऽधिपतेः प्रभोः । विद्याविद्यास्वरूपीति कैश्चिदीशो निगद्यते
verses.transliteration: bR^ihattvAd bR^iMhaNatvAdvA brahma chetyabhidhIyate | ubhe te brahmaNo rUpe brahmaNo.adhipateH prabhoH | vidyAvidyAsvarUpIti kaishchidIsho nigadyate
verses.translation: Brahma attained his Brahmahood, Visnu his Vi$nu- hood, Rudra his Rudrahood and Indra his Indrahood. It is by means of this rite that Ganesa attained his Ganesahood.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यां तु चेतनां प्राहुस्तथाविद्यामचेतनाम् । विद्याविद्यात्मकं चैव विश्वं विश्वगुरोर्विभोः
verses.transliteration: vidyAM tu chetanAM prAhustathAvidyAmachetanAm | vidyAvidyAtmakaM chaiva vishvaM vishvagurorvibhoH
verses.translation: The lihga shall be bathed with white sandal water. Therein Siva and Siva shall be worshipped with

verses.sanskrit: रूपमेव न सन्देहो विश्वं तस्य वशे यतः । भ्रान्तिर्विद्या परा चेति शार्वं रूपं परं विदुः
verses.transliteration: rUpameva na sandeho vishvaM tasya vashe yataH | bhrAntirvidyA parA cheti shArvaM rUpaM paraM viduH
verses.translation: To the south he shall apply Aguru. To the west he shall apply red arsenic. To the north he shall apply sandal and to the east he shall apply yellow orpiment. He shall then worship with charming fragrant flowers of various colours.

verses.sanskrit: अयथाबुद्धिरर्थेषु बहुधा भ्रान्तिरुच्यते । यथार्थाकारसंवित्तिर्विद्येति परिकीर्त्यते
verses.transliteration: ayathAbuddhirartheShu bahudhA bhrAntiruchyate | yathArthAkArasaMvittirvidyeti parikIrtyate
verses.translation: The black Aguru shall be used for incense and fumigation along with Guggulu. Fine cloths bright in colours shall be offered-

verses.sanskrit: विकल्परहितं तत्त्वं परमित्यभिधीयते । वैपरीत्यादसत् शब्दः कथ्यते वेदवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: vikalparahitaM tattvaM paramityabhidhIyate | vaiparItyAdasat shabdaH kathyate vedavAdibhiH
verses.translation: After bowing with devotion to the lord of the gods he shall eulogise the lord and crave forgiveness. Naivedya consisting of all offerings shall be offered to the Liiiga.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: This has been mentioned to you since you are a great devotee. This shall not be given to any one and every¬ one. It shall be given to devotees of Siva as mentioned by Siva formerly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: This has been mentioned to you since you are a great devotee. This shall not be given to any one and every¬ one. It shall be given to devotees of Siva as mentioned by Siva formerly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.६. षष्ठोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्ववर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । न शिवस्याणवो बन्धः कार्यो मायेय एव वा । प्राकृतो वाथ बोद्धा वा ह्यहङ्कारात्मकस्तथा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.6\. ShaShTho.adhyAyaH | shivatattvavarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | na shivasyANavo bandhaH kAryo mAyeya eva vA | prAkR^ito vAtha boddhA vA hyaha~NkArAtmakastathA
verses.translation: The achievement of benefit that has been mentioned here from the Nitya, Naimittika and Kamya rites can entirely be secured immediately by installing the phallic and the bodily image of iSiva.

verses.sanskrit: स शिवः सर्वमेवेदमधिष्ठाय स्वशक्तिभिः । अप्रच्युतः स्वतो भावः स्थितः स्थाणुरतः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: sa shivaH sarvamevedamadhiShThAya svashaktibhiH | aprachyutaH svato bhAvaH sthitaH sthANurataH smR^itaH
verses.translation: What more reason can be advanced for the installa¬ tion of Linga than that Linga of Vis ves vara has been installed by Siva too?

verses.sanskrit: शिवेनाधिष्ठितं यस्मात् जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् । सर्वरूपः स्मृतः शर्वस्तथा ज्ञात्वा न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: shivenAdhiShThitaM yasmAt jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam | sarvarUpaH smR^itaH sharvastathA j~nAtvA na muhyati
verses.translation: Hence by all means one shall instal the phallic or the bodily image of Siva for his welfare here and hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: शर्वो रुद्रो नमस्तस्मै पुरुषः सत्परो महान् । हिरण्यबाहुर्भगवान् हिरण्यपतिरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sharvo rudro namastasmai puruShaH satparo mahAn | hiraNyabAhurbhagavAn hiraNyapatirIshvaraH
verses.translation: The Bhutas with the sense-organs merge into this at the bidding of Siva, He is Lingin since he commands the

verses.sanskrit: अम्बिकापतिरीशानः पिनाकी वृषवाहनः । एको रुद्रः परं ब्रह्म पुरुषः कृष्णपिङ्गलः
verses.transliteration: ambikApatirIshAnaH pinAkI vR^iShavAhanaH | eko rudraH paraM brahma puruShaH kR^iShNapi~NgalaH
verses.translation: Since the Linga can do nothing by itself with¬ out being commanded by Siva, since the dissolution of the universe born of it is only within it, this constitutes the state of being Linga in Siva and not due to any other reason. The Linga is the body of Siva and Siva because it is presided over by them.

verses.sanskrit: बालाग्रमात्रो हृन्मध्ये विचिन्त्यो दहरान्तरे । हिरण्यकेशः पद्माक्षो ह्यरुणस्ताम्र एव च
verses.transliteration: bAlAgramAtro hR^inmadhye vichintyo daharAntare | hiraNyakeshaH padmAkSho hyaruNastAmra eva cha
verses.translation: Since they arc pure it is their body only in a secondary sense. That is the great Sakti of Siva the great Atman. Sakti at the behest of Siva gives birth to mobile and immobile beings. One cannot describe the glory of the Linga, even in hundreds of years, by which Brahma and Visnu were deluded at the outset.

verses.sanskrit: योऽवसर्पत्यसौ देवो नीलग्रीवो हिरण्मयः । सौम्योऽघोरस्तथा मिश्रश्चाक्षारश्चामृतोऽव्ययः
verses.transliteration: yo.avasarpatyasau devo nIlagrIvo hiraNmayaH | saumyo.aghorastathA mishrashchAkShArashchAmR^ito.avyayaH
verses.translation: Formerly when the universe was in the state of dissolution, Visnu lying on his couch in the waters went into deep slumber. He lay comfoi tably asleep. Brahma the grandfather of the worlds casually went there. He saw the lotus-eyed Visnu sleeping undisturbedly. Deluded by the Maya of Siva, Brahma said to Vi?nu.

verses.sanskrit: स पुंविशेषः परमो भगवानन्तकान्तकः । चेतनाचेतनोन्मुक्तः प्रपञ्चाच्च परात्परः
verses.transliteration: sa puMvisheShaH paramo bhagavAnantakAntakaH | chetanAchetanonmuktaH prapa~nchAchcha parAtparaH
verses.translation: "Who are you? Tell me". o saying he hit Vinu angrily and wakened him. Struck by the blow of his hand Vinu woke up in a trice and got up from his bed. He saw Brahma there. Vinu though infuriated within addressed him politely.

verses.sanskrit: शिवेनातिशयत्वेन ज्ञानैश्वर्ये विलोकिते । लोकेशातिशयत्वेन स्थितं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: shivenAtishayatvena j~nAnaishvarye vilokite | lokeshAtishayatvena sthitaM prAhurmanIShiNaH
verses.translation: "O dear son, whence have you come? Why are you agitated? Tell me." On hearing the words of Vi?nu, in¬ dicative of his lordly attitude Brahma felt irritated due to his Rajasic qualities and spoke again. "Why do you address me as "dear son" like a preceptor calling his disciple? Don't you know that I am the lord. This universe is my creation. After dividing myself into three, I create, protect and annihi¬ late. There is none in the universe who has created me." When thus addressed Visnu said to Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिसर्गप्रसूतानां ब्रह्मणां शास्त्रविस्तरम् । उपदेष्टा स एवादौ कालावच्छेदवर्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration: pratisargaprasUtAnAM brahmaNAM shAstravistaram | upadeShTA sa evAdau kAlAvachChedavartinAm
verses.translation: *T am the primordial creator of this universe,

verses.sanskrit: कालावच्छेदयुक्तानां गुरूणामप्यसौ गुरुः । सर्वेषामेव सर्वेशः कालावच्छेदवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: kAlAvachChedayuktAnAM gurUNAmapyasau guruH | sarveShAmeva sarveshaH kAlAvachChedavarjitaH
verses.translation: A verbal dispute between Brahma and Visnu arose thus. Thereafter a terrible fight ensued causing horripilation.

verses.sanskrit: नैवास्य मानसो बन्धो न चैत्तो नेन्द्रियात्मकः । न च तन्मात्रबन्धोऽपि भूतबन्धो न कश्चन
verses.transliteration: naivAsya mAnaso bandho na chaitto nendriyAtmakaH | na cha tanmAtrabandho.api bhUtabandho na kashchana
verses.translation: Due to Rajasic quality they fought and hit each other with fists. In order to dispel their arrogance and to enlighten them, the wonderful Lihga of the lord appeared in between them. It had thousands of flames. It was incomprehensible and incomparable. It did not increase or decrease. It had no beginning, no middle, no end. Brahma and Visnu were enchanted by thousands of flames. Ceasing from their fight they began to think "What is this?" When they could not understand the reality they attempted to survey its beginning and end.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धा स्वाभाविकी तस्य शक्तिः सर्वातिशायिनी । ज्ञानमप्रतिमं नित्यं वपुरत्यन्तनिर्मिलम्
verses.transliteration: shuddhA svAbhAvikI tasya shaktiH sarvAtishAyinI | j~nAnamapratimaM nityaM vapuratyantanirmilam
verses.translation: Brahma took the form of a swan with wings all round and went up assiduously with the speed of the mind or wind.

verses.sanskrit: ऐश्वर्यमप्रतिद्वन्द्वं सुखमात्यन्तिकं बलम् । तेजःप्रभावो वीर्यं च क्षमा कारुण्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: aishvaryamapratidvandvaM sukhamAtyantikaM balam | tejaHprabhAvo vIryaM cha kShamA kAruNyameva cha
verses.translation: Vijnu, the Atman of the universe, assumed the form of a Boar resembling a mass of coHyrium and went downwards.

verses.sanskrit: परिपूर्णस्य सर्गाद्यैर्नात्मनोऽस्ति प्रयोजनम् । परानुग्रह एवास्य फलं सर्वस्य कर्मणः
verses.transliteration: paripUrNasya sargAdyairnAtmano.asti prayojanam | parAnugraha evAsya phalaM sarvasya karmaNaH
verses.translation: Thus hastening down for a thousand years he did not have even a glimpse of the root of Linga.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवो वाचकस्तस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः । शिवरुद्रादिशब्दानां प्रणवो हि परः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: praNavo vAchakastasya shivasya paramAtmanaH | shivarudrAdishabdAnAM praNavo hi paraH smR^itaH
verses.translation: Similarly the weary Vi§nu with dejected mind due to the great distress quickly rose up from below.

verses.sanskrit: शम्भोः प्रणववाच्यस्य भवनात्तज्जपादपि । या सिद्धिः सा परा प्राप्या भवत्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: shambhoH praNavavAchyasya bhavanAttajjapAdapi | yA siddhiH sA parA prApyA bhavatyeva na saMshayaH
verses.translation: When they met each other again they were com¬ pletely perplexed and stared at each other with a smile of shame. Deluded by the Maya of Siva they did not know whtt to do or what not to do.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेकाक्षरं देवमाहुरागमपारगाः । वाच्यवाचकयोरैक्यं मन्यमाना मनस्विनः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdekAkSharaM devamAhurAgamapAragAH | vAchyavAchakayoraikyaM manyamAnA manasvinaH
verses.translation: They stood in front, at the back and on cither side of it and bowed. They began to think "Of what nature is this?"
