verses.sanskrit: अस्य मात्राः समाख्याताश्चतस्रो वेदमूर्द्धनि । अकारश्चाप्युकारश्च मकारो नाद इत्यपि
verses.transliteration: asya mAtrAH samAkhyAtAshchatasro vedamUrddhani | akArashchApyukArashcha makAro nAda ityapi
verses.translation: Then there manifested the single-syllabled Brahman in the characteristic way o a word with its sound *Om*. It expressed the Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: अकारं बह्वृचं प्राहुरुकारो यजुरुच्यते । मकारः सामनादोऽस्य श्रुतिराथर्वणी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: akAraM bahvR^ichaM prAhurukAro yajuruchyate | makAraH sAmanAdo.asya shrutirAtharvaNI smR^itA
verses.translation: Then that syllable divided itself into four, the three Matras — A, U, Ma and half the Matra thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अकारश्च महाबीजं रजः स्रष्टा चतुर्मुखः । उकारः प्रकृतिर्योनिः सत्त्वं पालयिता हरिः
verses.transliteration: akArashcha mahAbIjaM rajaH sraShTA chaturmukhaH | ukAraH prakR^itiryoniH sattvaM pAlayitA hariH
verses.translation: The letter 'a' attached itself to the southern side of the blazing Lihga, the letter "u" to the north and the letter "ma" to its middle.

verses.sanskrit: मकारः पुरुषो बीजं तमः संहारको हरः । नादः परः पुमानीशो निर्गुणो निष्क्रियः शिवः
verses.transliteration: makAraH puruSho bIjaM tamaH saMhArako haraH | nAdaH paraH pumAnIsho nirguNo niShkriyaH shivaH
verses.translation: The half a Matra sound was heard on the head of the Lihga. Even when the great syllable Pranava was divided, the two gods did not understand the purpose of division. I'hc unrnanifest Pranava then underwent the change into the Veda.

verses.sanskrit: न च कालः कला चैव नाविद्या नियतिस्तथा । न रागो न च विद्वेषः शम्भोरमिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: na cha kAlaH kalA chaiva nAvidyA niyatistathA | na rAgo na cha vidveShaH shambhoramitatejasaH
verses.translation: There the letter "a" became the Rgveda, the letter "u" the Yajurveda, the letter "ma" the Samaveda and the Nada the Atharvaveda.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तिसृभिरेवेदं मात्राभिर्निखिलं त्रिधा । अभिधाय शिवात्मानं बोधयत्यर्धमात्रया
verses.transliteration: sarvaM tisR^ibhirevedaM mAtrAbhirnikhilaM tridhA | abhidhAya shivAtmAnaM bodhayatyardhamAtrayA
verses.translation: The Rgveda established half of itself succinctly. Thus Brahma possessed of the Rajas, the first among the deities in rites also, the creator of the* worlds and the prin¬ ciples as well as the unchanging Atman; Nivrtti in the path of Kala and Sadyojata in the five ferahmans, the lower portion in the parts of Linga and the source in the three reasons. It established the sixtyfour Gunas and AiiSvarya of the cosmic intellect Anima etc. Thus with the ten topics the universe was pervaded by the Rgveda.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्परं नापरमस्ति किञ्चिद्- यस्मान्नाणीयो न ज्यायोऽस्ति किञ्चित् । वृक्ष इव स्तब्धो दिवि तिष्ठत्येक- स्तेनेदं पूर्णं पुरुषेण सर्वम्
verses.transliteration: yasmAtparaM nAparamasti ki~nchid\- yasmAnnANIyo na jyAyo.asti ki~nchit | vR^ikSha iva stabdho divi tiShThatyeka\- stenedaM pUrNaM puruSheNa sarvam
verses.translation: Then the Yajurveda established itself in the ten ways: Sattva among the attributes, Visnu the first among the deities in the rites also, sustenance in the worlds and the firmament, Vidya in the three principles, Prati§tha in the paths of Kala and Vamadeva in the five Brahmans, the parts of Liiiga and Yoni in the three causes. The Prakfta was established in accordance with the Aisvarya. Hence the universe is of the form of the Yajurveda.

verses.sanskrit: न चास्त्यभिनिवेशोऽस्य कुशलाकुशलान्यपि । कर्माणि तद्विपाकश्च सुखदुःखे च तत्फले
verses.transliteration: na chAstyabhinivesho.asya kushalAkushalAnyapi | karmANi tadvipAkashcha sukhaduHkhe cha tatphale
verses.translation: Similarly the Samaveda established itself in ten ways. It established Tamas and Rudra the first among the deities in the rites, annihilation in the three worlds and the excellent Siva in the Tattvas, Aghora in the five Brahmans and Vidya among the Kalas, the upper seat in the parts of the Lihga and the source in the three causes. So also the Aisvarya of the Purusa. Thus the universe is pervaded by the Saman.

verses.sanskrit: आशयैर्नापि सम्बन्धः संस्कारैः कर्मणामपि । भोगैश्च भोगसंस्कारैः कालत्रितयगोचरैः
verses.transliteration: AshayairnApi sambandhaH saMskAraiH karmaNAmapi | bhogaishcha bhogasaMskAraiH kAlatritayagocharaiH
verses.translation: Then the Atharvaveda established itself thus. It was devoid of Gunas. It placed Mahesvara, Sadasiva as the first among the deities. Though the great Atman, Siva is devoid of activities. It established Sadasiva for the purpase of activities. It created pure blessing whereby the creatures are liberated. Above the worlds, where the words recede along with the mind are the Unmana worlds over which is the divine Somaloka where the lord stays with Uma.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य कारणं कर्ता नादिरन्तस्तथान्तरम् । न कर्म करणं वापि नाकार्यं कार्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: na tasya kAraNaM kartA nAdirantastathAntaram | na karma karaNaM vApi nAkAryaM kAryameva cha
verses.translation: He who reaches above there in the Unmana world does not return. Sand and Santyatita are all-pervasive among the Kalas. Among the five Brahmans it is Purusa and Isana. There is the head of the Linga, the most excellent among the parts, where the sole Niskala Siva shall be invoked

verses.sanskrit: नास्य बन्धुरबन्धुर्वा नियन्ता प्रेरकोऽपि वा । न पतिर्न गुरुस्त्राता नाधिको न समस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nAsya bandhurabandhurvA niyantA prerako.api vA | na patirna gurustrAtA nAdhiko na samastathA
verses.translation: Among the Tattvas it is the greater Tattva than Bindu, Nada and Sakti. It is greater than the greatest and in reality a non-Tattva. It transcends the three causes..It is beyond Maya the cause of agitation. It is beyond Ananta, the Suddhavidya, Mahesvara, Sadasiva the great lord of all lores. It is beyond the lord who has mantras for his body, who is accompanied by all Saktis, who has five faces and ten arms and who is both Sakala and Niskala. Beyond even that, beyond the Bindu, the half moon, the moon, the

verses.sanskrit: न जन्ममरणे तस्य न काङ्क्षितमकाङ्क्षितम् । न विधिर्न निषेधश्च न मुक्तिर्न च बन्धनम्
verses.transliteration: na janmamaraNe tasya na kA~NkShitamakA~NkShitam | na vidhirna niShedhashcha na muktirna cha bandhanam
verses.translation: Rgveda said again — "The state of wakefulness is being mentioned by me whereby I perpetually express the Atmatattva". Yajurveda said— "The state of dream is being mentioned by me because the Vidya that has transformed itself into objects of enjoyments is to be known through me." Samaveda said: — ''What is called sound slumber is being mentioned wholly by me through Siva that is my meaning and Tamasic in form. Atharvaveda said:--"What is called the fourth stage and what is beyond the fourth is expressed by me." The three which are of the nature of the path are ter¬ med Siva, Vidya, Atman. Their state of three attributes is attainable through the Vedas and shall be purified by him who wishes for Siva's region. What is called Turiya, beyond the path is the greatest region of salvation. That which is beyond it is the purifier of this path because of its attribute¬ less state. The Nada is the measurer of both. The end of Nada has me for its Atman. Hence the supreme lord is the chief in view of freedom from my topics. Whatever object is there whether compounded or separated, they call as the meaning of Pranava in view of the association of the Gunas. Therefore, this single-syllabled Brahman is the expression of all meanings.

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति यद्यदकल्याणं तत्तदस्य कदाचन । कल्याणं सकलं चास्ति परमात्मा शिवो यतः
verses.transliteration: nAsti yadyadakalyANaM tattadasya kadAchana | kalyANaM sakalaM chAsti paramAtmA shivo yataH
verses.translation: Therefore, at the outset Siva creates the universe saying "Om". Siva is Pranava and Pranava is Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The deity Brahmatman is born of the right limb of Mahesa. Visnu came out of the left. So he is termed Vidya. Nilarudra came out of the heart of Siva and is called Siva. Brahmii is the activiser of creation, Visnu the enchanter maintains sustenance. Rudra who controls both is the initiator of annihilation. The three are the causes of the universe. Siva, the source of the three, is the great cause.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The deity Brahmatman is born of the right limb of Mahesa. Visnu came out of the left. So he is termed Vidya. Nilarudra came out of the heart of Siva and is called Siva. Brahmii is the activiser of creation, Visnu the enchanter maintains sustenance. Rudra who controls both is the initiator of annihilation. The three are the causes of the universe. Siva, the source of the three, is the great cause.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.७. सप्तमोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्वकथनम् । उपमन्युरुवच । शक्तिः स्वाभविकी तस्य विद्या विश्वविलक्षणा । एकानेकस्य रूपेण भाति भानोरिव प्रभा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.7\. saptamo.adhyAyaH | shivatattvakathanam | upamanyuruvacha | shaktiH svAbhavikI tasya vidyA vishvavilakShaNA | ekAnekasya rUpeNa bhAti bhAnoriva prabhA
verses.translation: The Liiiga stood in between you two in order to enlighten you when you became mutually inimical due to ■your Rajasic quality and could not understand this meaning.

verses.sanskrit: अनया सह सर्वेशः सप्तविंशप्रकारया । विश्वं व्याप्य स्थितस्तस्मात् मुक्तिरत्र प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: anayA saha sarveshaH saptaviMshaprakArayA | vishvaM vyApya sthitastasmAt muktiratra pravartate
verses.translation: Thus they call me "Om". What was thus mentioned by the Atharva was repeated by the Rgveda, Yajurveda, S-imaveda and thousands of their Sakhas. Even when the Vcdiis themselves declaied thus clearly through their own mouths it was not comprehended by the two who thought it were a dream.

verses.sanskrit: मुमुक्षवः पुरा केचिन्मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः । संशयाविष्टमनसो विस्मृशन्ति यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: mumukShavaH purA kechinmunayo brahmavAdinaH | saMshayAviShTamanaso vismR^ishanti yathAtatham
verses.translation: In order to enlighten them and to remove their ignorance the statement of the Vedas was inscribed in the Lihga too.

verses.sanskrit: किं कारणं कुतो जाता जीवामः केन वा वयम् । कुत्रास्माकं सम्प्रतिष्ठा केन वाधिष्ठिता वयम्
verses.transliteration: kiM kAraNaM kuto jAtA jIvAmaH kena vA vayam | kutrAsmAkaM sampratiShThA kena vAdhiShThitA vayam
verses.translation: On seeing that inscribed in the Lihga due to the favour of iSiva the deities were pacified and enlightened.

verses.sanskrit: केन वर्तामहे शश्वत्सुखेष्वन्येषु चानिशम् । अविलङ्घ्या च विश्वस्य व्यवस्था केन वा कृता
verses.transliteration: kena vartAmahe shashvatsukheShvanyeShu chAnisham | avila~NghyA cha vishvasya vyavasthA kena vA kR^itA
verses.translation: On realising the mode of evolution and dissolu¬ tion, the nature of the six pathways and the splendour be¬ yond the Purusa possessing brilliance, the Brahman than whom there is nothing greater, Niskala Siva Isvara, who is the perpetual lord of this universe consisting of Pasu and Pasa who has no fear from any quarter, who is stable without in¬ crease or decrease who pervades within and without who has neither inside nor outside, who is unsurpassable, who is different from all the worlds, who is indefinable, incompre¬ hensible, inexpressible, who is essentially in the form of brilliance, who is quite delighted and ever ri.sing, who is the abode of auspiciousness and who is accompanied by a

verses.sanskrit: कालस्य भावो नियतिर्यदृच्छा नात्र युज्यते । भूतानि योनिः पुरुषो योगी चैषां परोऽथवा
verses.transliteration: kAlasya bhAvo niyatiryadR^ichChA nAtra yujyate | bhUtAni yoniH puruSho yogI chaiShAM paro.athavA
verses.translation: VVhether 1 am ignorant or not, O lord, I was created by you at the beginning. Whose fault is it that 1 have been under such a delusion?

verses.sanskrit: अचेतनत्वात्कालादेश्चेतनत्वेऽपि चात्मनः । सुखदुःखानि भूतत्वादनीशत्वाद्विचार्यते
verses.transliteration: achetanatvAtkAlAdeshchetanatve.api chAtmanaH | sukhaduHkhAni bhUtatvAdanIshatvAdvichAryate
verses.translation: Let my ignorance alone. O lord, when you are near who can fearlessly talk about his duty or that of' others.

verses.sanskrit: तद्ध्यानयोगानुगताः प्रपश्यन् शक्तिमैश्वरीम् । पाशविच्छेदिकां साक्षान्निगूढां स्वगुणैर्भृशम्
verses.transliteration: taddhyAnayogAnugatAH prapashyan shaktimaishvarIm | pAshavichChedikAM sAkShAnnigUDhAM svaguNairbhR^isham
verses.translation: O lord of gods, our mutual wrangle too is splen¬ didly auspicious since it has yielded us the benefit of paying our homage to the feet of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: तया विच्छिन्नपाशास्ते सर्वकारणकारणम् । शक्तिमन्तं महादेवमपश्यन्दिव्यचक्षुषा
verses.transliteration: tayA vichChinnapAshAste sarvakAraNakAraNam | shaktimantaM mahAdevamapashyandivyachakShuShA
verses.translation: O lord, I do not have the power of eulogising you in the manner befitting your greatness. On the other hand if the devotees keep quiet in front of the lord it is merely a transgression of virtue.

verses.sanskrit: यः कारणान्यशेषाणि कालात्मसहितानि च । अप्रमेयोऽनया शक्त्या सकलं योऽधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: yaH kAraNAnyasheShANi kAlAtmasahitAni cha | aprameyo.anayA shaktyA sakalaM yo.adhitiShThati
verses.translation: That you were the primordial cause we forgot due to your Maya. I am deluded, puffed up and have hence been chastised by you.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसादयोगेन योगेन परमेण च । दृष्टेन भक्तियोगेन दिव्यां गतिमवाप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: tataH prasAdayogena yogena parameNa cha | dR^iShTena bhaktiyogena divyAM gatimavApnuyuH
verses.translation: O Siva, they call you a great lord, the destroyer of the distress of the frightened. I entreat you to forgive my transgression thus.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ताः शक्तयो यस्या इच्छाज्ञानक्रियादयः । मायाद्याश्चाभवन्वह्नोर्विस्फुलिङ्गा यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: anantAH shaktayo yasyA ichChAj~nAnakriyAdayaH | mAyAdyAshchAbhavanvahnorvisphuli~NgA yathA tathA
verses.translation: When thus implored lord Siva became highly delighted. He blessed the two deities and spoke to them smilingly.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सह तथा शक्त्या हृदि पश्यन्ति ये शिवम् । तेषां शाश्वतिकी शान्तिर्नैतरेषामिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: tasmAtsaha tathA shaktyA hR^idi pashyanti ye shivam | teShAM shAshvatikI shAntirnaitareShAmiti shrutiH
verses.translation: Dear Brahma, dear Visnu, you had been deluded by my Maya. You were proud of yoifr lordship and became mutually inimical.

verses.sanskrit: न हि शक्तिमतः शक्त्या विप्रयोगोऽस्ति जातुचित् । तस्मात् शक्तेः शक्तिमतस्तादात्म्यान्निर्वृतिर्द्वयोः
verses.transliteration: na hi shaktimataH shaktyA viprayogo.asti jAtuchit | tasmAt shakteH shaktimatastAdAtmyAnnirvR^itirdvayoH
verses.translation: You did not cease even when the wrangle turned into an actual fight. Therefore the creative activity of you both, the cause of the universe, was broken in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: क्रमो विवक्षितो नूनं विमुक्तौ ज्ञानकर्मणोः । प्रसादे सति सा मूर्तिर्यस्मात्करतले स्थिता
verses.transliteration: kramo vivakShito nUnaM vimuktau j~nAnakarmaNoH | prasAde sati sA mUrtiryasmAtkaratale sthitA
verses.translation: In order to turn you back fiom your mutual

verses.sanskrit: देवो वा दानवो वापि पशुर्वा विहगोऽपि वा । कीरो वाथ कृमिर्वापि मुच्यते तत्प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: devo vA dAnavo vApi pashurvA vihago.api vA | kIro vAtha kR^imirvApi muchyate tatprasAdataH
verses.translation: Formerly at my command the compendiums on knowledge were given to you in order to proclaim your causal nature. The jewel of Mantras consisting of five syllab¬ les has been imparted to you. But you forgot all this. I shall give you everything as before together with my behest since without that you cannot create or sustain.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्थो जायमानो वा बालो वा तरुणोऽपि वा । वृद्धो वा म्रियमाणो वा स्वर्गस्थो वाथ नारकी
verses.transliteration: garbhastho jAyamAno vA bAlo vA taruNo.api vA | vR^iddho vA mriyamANo vA svargastho vAtha nArakI
verses.translation: After telling Visnu and Brahma thus, the lord gave them the principal mantra along with the Jnanasarii- hita. After obtaining the divine order of the lord, the jewel of Mantra pregnant with meaning, and the Kalas, they prostrated at tlie feet of the lord. They stood without fear, rhey were overpowered by joy.

verses.sanskrit: पतितो वापि धर्मात्मा पण्डितो मूढ एव वा । प्रसादे तत्क्षणादेव मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: patito vApi dharmAtmA paNDito mUDha eva vA | prasAde tatkShaNAdeva muchyate nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: In the meantime there was a great wonder. As if by magic the Liiiga of the god became invisible. Due to the sudden snapping of love they lamented and cried loudly, saying to each other 'O what a false thing has befal¬ len us, Pondering over the unimaginable prowess of Siva they became free from pain.

verses.sanskrit: अयोग्यानां च कारुण्याद्भक्तानां परमेश्वरः । प्रसीदति न सन्देहो विगृह्य विविधान् मलान्
verses.transliteration: ayogyAnAM cha kAruNyAdbhaktAnAM parameshvaraH | prasIdati na sandeho vigR^ihya vividhAn malAn
verses.translation: Becoming great friends once again and embracing each other the leading deities returned to their duties in the universe.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसदादेव सा भक्तिः प्रसादो भक्तिसम्भवः । अवस्थाभेदमुत्प्रेक्ष्य विद्वांस्तत्र न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: prasadAdeva sA bhaktiH prasAdo bhaktisambhavaH | avasthAbhedamutprekShya vidvAMstatra na muhyati
verses.translation: Ever since that Indra and other gods, Asuras, sages, men, serpents as well as women instal Lihgas in accordance with the injunctions and worship him in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादपूर्विका येयं भुक्तिमुक्तिविधायिनी । नैव सा शक्यते प्राप्तुं नरैरेकेन जन्मना
verses.transliteration: prasAdapUrvikA yeyaM bhuktimuktividhAyinI | naiva sA shakyate prAptuM narairekena janmanA
verses.translation: O lord, I wish to hear the rules governing the installation of the phallic and the embodied image of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकजन्मसिद्धानां श्रौतस्मार्तानुवर्तिनाम् । विरक्तानां प्रबुद्धानां प्रसीदति महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: anekajanmasiddhAnAM shrautasmArtAnuvartinAm | viraktAnAM prabuddhAnAM prasIdati maheshvaraH
verses.translation: On a day in the bright half of the month not un¬ favourable to him, the devotee shall make the Lihga of the proper size in the manner prescribed in the Saivite scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवेश्वराद्या हि विद्याविद्येश्वरादयः । अभवन् पुरुषाश्चास्याः प्रकृतिश्च परात्परा
verses.transliteration: sadAshiveshvarAdyA hi vidyAvidyeshvarAdayaH | abhavan puruShAshchAsyAH prakR^itishcha parAtparA
verses.translation: Selecting an auspicious spot he shall test the ground. He shall perform the ten forms of service.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ने सति देवेशे पशौ तस्मिन् प्रवर्तते । अस्ति नाथो ममेत्यल्पा भक्तिर्बुद्धिपुरःसरा
verses.transliteration: prasanne sati deveshe pashau tasmin pravartate | asti nAtho mametyalpA bhaktirbuddhipuraHsarA
verses.translation: But before the actual performance of this service Vinayaka shall be worshipped. After purifying the spot and other rites he shall take the Lihga to the ablution chamber.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा विविधैः शैवैर्धर्मैः संयुज्यते नरः । तत्त्रयोगे तदभ्यासस्ततो भक्तिः परा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tapasA vividhaiH shaivairdharmaiH saMyujyate naraH | tattrayoge tadabhyAsastato bhaktiH parA bhavet
verses.translation: With a gold rod dipped into the solution of saffron he shall draw the characteristic signs in the prescribed manner.

verses.sanskrit: परया च तया भक्त्या प्रसादो लभ्यते परः । प्रसादात्सर्वपाशेभ्यो मुक्तिर्मुक्तस्य निर्वृतिः
verses.transliteration: parayA cha tayA bhaktyA prasAdo labhyate paraH | prasAdAtsarvapAshebhyo muktirmuktasya nirvR^itiH
verses.translation: He shall purify the Lihga along with its axle or nave with a solution of eight or five types of clay as well as with Paheagavya.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पभावोऽपि यो मर्त्यः सोऽपि जन्मत्रयात्परम् । न योनियन्त्रपीडायै भवेन्नैवात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: alpabhAvo.api yo martyaH so.api janmatrayAtparam | na yoniyantrapIDAyai bhavennaivAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: After worshipping the Lihga along with its pedestal he shall take it to the water-receptacle and keep the Lihga immersed in water.

verses.sanskrit: साङ्गानङ्गा च या सेवा सा भक्तिरिति कथ्यते । सा पुनर्भिद्यते त्रेधा मनोवाक्कायसाधनैः
verses.transliteration: sA~NgAna~NgA cha yA sevA sA bhaktiriti kathyate | sA punarbhidyate tredhA manovAkkAyasAdhanaiH
verses.translation: In a well-constructed shed for the immersion of Lihga, pure and well-embellished with festoons and screens all round, surrounded by garlands of Darbha grass, an inner shed for the seat shall be arranged in the middle. The seat may be metallic or wooden in the shape of a lotus. On the eight quarters the representations of the eight elephants of the quarters shall be made. Eight pots shall be kept for the eight quardians of the guarters. Eight auspicious things shall be kept ready. The guardians of the quarters shall be duly worshipped. Subhadra, Vibhadra,.Sunanda and Vinanda the gatekeepers of the lord shall be worshipped in the four quarters. The Linga shall be bathed and worshipped with the pedestal. It shall be tied with two cloths and bunches of Kusa grass. It.shall be brought to the Pitha and laid

verses.sanskrit: शिवरूपादिचिन्ता या सा सेवा मानसी स्मृता । जपादिर्वाचिकी सेवा कर्मपूजादि कायिकी
verses.transliteration: shivarUpAdichintA yA sA sevA mAnasI smR^itA | japAdirvAchikI sevA karmapUjAdi kAyikI
verses.translation: Thereafter the linga shall be worshipped after due ceremonies as before. After worship it shall be carried along the path of festivities to the place of rest.

verses.sanskrit: सेयं त्रिसाधना सेवा शिवधर्मश्च कथ्यते । स तु पञ्चविधः प्रोक्तः शिवेन परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: seyaM trisAdhanA sevA shivadharmashcha kathyate | sa tu pa~nchavidhaH proktaH shivena paramAtmanA
verses.translation: A mystical lotus-diagram shall be drawn in the north-east on a spot of ground well-smeared. The water vessel of Siva shall be purified. Siva shall be invoked and worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: तपः कर्म जपो ध्यानं ज्ञानं चेति समासतः । कर्म लिङ्गार्चनाद्यं च तपश्चान्द्रायणादिकम्
verses.transliteration: tapaH karma japo dhyAnaM j~nAnaM cheti samAsataH | karma li~NgArchanAdyaM cha tapashchAndrAyaNAdikam
verses.translation: In the middle of the altar he shall make a dia¬ gram of white lotus in accordance with injunctions and to the west of it he shall draw the lotus of Gandika.

verses.sanskrit: जपस्त्रिधा शिवाभ्यासश्चिन्ता ध्यानं शिवस्य तु । शिवागमोक्तं यज्ज्ञानं तदत्र ज्ञानमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: japastridhA shivAbhyAsashchintA dhyAnaM shivasya tu | shivAgamoktaM yajj~nAnaM tadatra j~nAnamuchyate
verses.translation: The bed shall be made of silken cloth or other cloth fresh from the loom, before being washed or of flowers or Darbha grass. After making it up he shall put golden flower in it.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकण्ठेन शिवेनोक्तं शिवायै च शिवागमः । शिवाश्रितानां कारुण्याच्छ्रेयसामेकसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: shrIkaNThena shivenoktaM shivAyai cha shivAgamaH | shivAshritAnAM kAruNyAchChreyasAmekasAdhanam
verses.translation: The Linga shall be brought there with the songs and music vocal and instrumental. It shall be wrapped in two red cloths and a bunch of Kusa grass along with the nave and laid down as before. A lotus shall be drawn in front and in its petals he shall place the water-pots of Vidyesa and the vessel VardhanI of Siva. The excellent brahmins shall perform Homa all round the three lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: महदादिविशेषान्तास्त्वजाद्याश्चापि मूर्तयः । यच्चान्यदस्ति तत्सर्वं तस्याः कार्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: mahadAdivisheShAntAstvajAdyAshchApi mUrtayaH | yachchAnyadasti tatsarvaM tasyAH kAryaM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: Beginning with the east, the eight Murtis shall be placed all round or only the four Murtis Brahma and others in the four quarters. The conductors of the Homa shall possess good mastery of the Vedas. They shall be accompa¬ nied by those who can repeat the mantras well. The pre¬ ceptor shall perform the main Homa either in the north-east or in the west. He shall use all tlie seven materials in order. The other branmins shall perform half or one-fourth of the number of sacrifices that the preceptor performs.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विवर्धयेद्भक्तिं शिवे परमकारणे । त्यजेच्च विषयासङ्गं श्रेयोऽर्थी मतिमान्नरः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdvivardhayedbhaktiM shive paramakAraNe | tyajechcha viShayAsa~NgaM shreyo.arthI matimAnnaraH
verses.translation: Or the preceptor alone shall perform the main sacrifice. He ahall perform the Purnahuti and then

verses.sanskrit: सा शक्तिः सर्वगा सूक्ष्मा प्रबोधानन्दरूपिणी । शक्तिमानुच्यते देवः शिवः शीतांशुभूषणः
verses.transliteration: sA shaktiH sarvagA sUkShmA prabodhAnandarUpiNI | shaktimAnuchyate devaH shivaH shItAMshubhUShaNaH
verses.translation: The priest and the sculptor shall be given half or one-fourth of what the preceptor is given and half of that shall be given to the other brahmins in accordance with one's capacity.

verses.sanskrit: वेद्यः शिवः शिवा विद्या प्रज्ञा चैव श्रुतिः स्मृतिः । धृतिरेषा स्थितिर्निष्ठा ज्ञानेच्छाकर्मशक्तयः
verses.transliteration: vedyaH shivaH shivA vidyA praj~nA chaiva shrutiH smR^itiH | dhR^itireShA sthitirniShThA j~nAnechChAkarmashaktayaH
verses.translation: Then either an image of the bull made of gold or a bunch of KiKa grass shall be placed in the pit. Brahma- Sila shall be purified with water and clay, also with Pafica- gavya, with pure water. It shall be placed in the pit after smearing it with sandal. Repeating the names of the nine Saktis, the rite of Karanyasa shall be performed. Then in accordance with the injunctions prescribed in Saivite scriptures he shall strew the minerals — Haritala and others along with scents, seeds and medicinal herbs.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञा चैव परं ब्रह्म द्वे विद्ये च परापरे । शुद्धविद्या शुद्धकला सर्वं शक्तिकृतं यतः
verses.transliteration: Aj~nA chaiva paraM brahma dve vidye cha parApare | shuddhavidyA shuddhakalA sarvaM shaktikR^itaM yataH
verses.translation: The Lihga shall be installed on the Brahmasila and dripped in the exudations of trees. To the east and the north the aloe wood shall be placed repeating the basic mantra. Repeating the basic mantra of iSakti the nave shall be joined to the articles of fixation and joining. The place shall be purified. Arghya shall be given and flowers offered. Thereafter the screen shall be drawn all round.

verses.sanskrit: माया च प्रकृतिर्जीवो विकारो विकृतिस्तथा । असच्च सच्च यत्किञ्चित्तया सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.transliteration: mAyA cha prakR^itirjIvo vikAro vikR^itistathA | asachcha sachcha yatki~nchittayA sarvamidaM tatam
verses.translation: The ablution and other rites of the Lihga shall be performed in a befitting manner. After taking it away from the place of rest the Kalasas shall be placed in order.

verses.sanskrit: सा देवी मायया सर्वं ब्रह्माण्डं सचराचरम् । मोहयत्यप्रयत्नेन मोचयत्यपि लीलया
verses.transliteration: sA devI mAyayA sarvaM brahmANDaM sacharAcharam | mohayatyaprayatnena mochayatyapi lIlayA
verses.translation: The great worship begins with the worship of the ten water-jars. In the water inside the Sivakumbha, the thumb and the ring-finger shall be jointly inserted with the Siva mantras. Water thu» taken shall be sprinkled. The knower of mantra shall touch the north-east side of the Lihga. He shall perform the Nyasas of lakti, Vidya and Vidyesas in order at the root of the lahga. He shall perform the ablution of the Linga with auspicious water.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: After performing the Nyasa rite of the five Kalas he shall meditate on the blazing Linga. Facing the east or north with palms joined in reverence he shall invoke §iva and liva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: After performing the Nyasa rite of the five Kalas he shall meditate on the blazing Linga. Facing the east or north with palms joined in reverence he shall invoke §iva and liva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.८. अष्टमोऽध्यायः । शिवतत्त्वज्ञाने व्यासावतारवर्णनम् । कृष्ण उवाच । भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छामि शिवेन परिभाषितम् । वेदसारं शिवज्ञानं स्वाश्रितानां विमुक्तये
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.8\. aShTamo.adhyAyaH | shivatattvaj~nAne vyAsAvatAravarNanam | kR^iShNa uvAcha | bhagavan shrotumichChAmi shivena paribhAShitam | vedasAraM shivaj~nAnaM svAshritAnAM vimuktaye
verses.translation: At the rite of Laksanoddhara the eyes shall be shut. The immersion shall be performed with the idols placed prone on the bed.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मापि पितरं देवं जायमानं न्यवैक्षत । तं जायमानं जनको देवः प्रापश्यदाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: brahmApi pitaraM devaM jAyamAnaM nyavaikShata | taM jAyamAnaM janako devaH prApashyadAj~nayA
verses.translation: The installation of the idol with the rites for the temple is better than without those rites. If the idols are immersed in the water of the vessel the mantras shall be repeated touching the chest.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टो रुद्रेण देवोऽसावसृजद्विश्वमीश्वरः । वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थां च चकार स पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTo rudreNa devo.asAvasR^ijadvishvamIshvaraH | varNAshramavyavasthAM cha chakAra sa pR^ithak pR^ithak
verses.translation: Affluent people shall first build the temple and then perform the installation. If the devotee is not affluent he shall perform the installation of the phallic or the em¬ bodied image and shall afterwards build the Siva temple in accordance with his capacity. Now I shall mention the mode of worship at the house and the excellent installation rite.

verses.sanskrit: सोमं ससर्ज यज्ञार्थे सोमाद् घौः समजायत । धरा च वह्निः सूर्यश्च यज्ञो विष्णुः शचीपतिः
verses.transliteration: somaM sasarja yaj~nArthe somAd ghauH samajAyata | dharA cha vahniH sUryashcha yaj~no viShNuH shachIpatiH
verses.translation: The idol shall be small in size but endowed with all traits. In the northern transit of the sun ( Jan-July) on an auspicious day in the bright half of the month, the altar shall be made in an auspicious spot. He shall draw the diagram of the lotus in as before. The idol shall be purified with water and clay as before. An auspicious scat shall be kept in the north. Covering the Liiiga with flowers he shall place it on the seat. Flowers and leaves shall be strewn and

verses.sanskrit: ते चान्ये च सुरा रुद्रं रुद्राध्यायेन तुष्टुवुः । प्रसन्नवदनस्तस्थौ देवानामग्रतः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: te chAnye cha surA rudraM rudrAdhyAyena tuShTuvuH | prasannavadanastasthau devAnAmagrataH prabhuH
verses.translation: After placing the flower on its top it shall be sprinkled with the water from the Proksani vessel. Again it shall be worshipped along with the proclamation of victory. With the water from the vessels of the four deities from Iana to Vidya he shall bathe the Linga with the basic mantra.

verses.sanskrit: अपहृत्य स्वलीलार्थं तेषां ज्ञानं महेश्वरः । तमपृच्छंस्ततो देवाः को भवानिति मोहिताः
verses.transliteration: apahR^itya svalIlArthaM teShAM j~nAnaM maheshvaraH | tamapR^ichChaMstato devAH ko bhavAniti mohitAH
verses.translation: The rite of the Nyasa of the five Kalas shall be performed and the worship too as before. The devotee shall worship the lord and the goddess there everyday.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽब्रवीद्भगवान् रुद्रो ह्यहमेकः पुरातनः । आसं प्रथममेवाहं वर्तामि च सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: so.abravIdbhagavAn rudro hyahamekaH purAtanaH | AsaM prathamamevAhaM vartAmi cha surottamAH
verses.translation: Or only one vessel shall be placed with the basic mantra and everything fixed therein. Every other rite shall be performed as before.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यामि च मत्तोऽन्यो व्यतिरिक्तो न कश्चन । अहमेव जगत् सर्वं तर्पयामि स्वतेजसा
verses.transliteration: bhaviShyAmi cha matto.anyo vyatirikto na kashchana | ahameva jagat sarvaM tarpayAmi svatejasA
verses.translation: Too much unclean Linga shall at first be puri¬ fied and reinstalled. Unclean Lingas shall be sprinkled with holy water. Slightly unclean Lingas too shall be worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: मत्तोऽधिकः समो नास्ति मां यो वेद स मुच्यते । इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् रुद्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधत्त सः
verses.transliteration: matto.adhikaH samo nAsti mAM yo veda sa muchyate | ityuktvA bhagavAn rudrastatraivAntaradhatta saH
verses.translation: Bana Lingas may be installed at will, for they have been already consecrated by Siva himself.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यन्तस्तमीशानं स्तुवन्तश्चैव सामभिः । व्रतं पाशुपतं कृत्वा त्वथर्वशिरसि स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: apashyantastamIshAnaM stuvantashchaiva sAmabhiH | vrataM pAshupataM kR^itvA tvatharvashirasi sthitam
verses.translation: Such other Lingas may also be installed. In regard to a Svayambhu, a divine or a sage Linga the same is the procedure. If there is no pedestal, a pedestal shall be assigned and the rite of Proksana performed.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मसञ्छन्नसर्वाङ्गा बभूवुरमरास्तदा । अथ तेषां प्रसादार्थं पशूनां पतिरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bhasmasa~nChannasarvA~NgA babhUvuramarAstadA | atha teShAM prasAdArthaM pashUnAM patirIshvaraH
verses.translation: Burnt, weakened or partially broken Linga shall be thrown in a pond or a river. That which can be joined shall be joined and installed.

verses.sanskrit: अभक्तानामबुद्धीनामयुक्तानामगोचरम् । अर्थैर्दशर्धैः संयुक्तं गूढमप्राज्ञनिन्दितम्
verses.transliteration: abhaktAnAmabuddhInAmayuktAnAmagocharam | arthairdashardhaiH saMyuktaM gUDhamaprAj~naninditam
verses.translation: The lord shall be dismissed ritualistically from the idol that is mutilated, after due worship but retained in the heart.

verses.sanskrit: सगणश्चोमया सार्धं सान्निध्यमकरोत्प्रभुः । यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासा योगिनो दग्धकिल्बिषाः
verses.transliteration: sagaNashchomayA sArdhaM sAnnidhyamakarotprabhuH | yaM vinidrA jitashvAsA yogino dagdhakilbiShAH
verses.translation: Samproksana rite is as follows: — The lord is ritualistically dismissed from the Linga as before, bathed

verses.sanskrit: हृदि पश्यन्ति तं देवं ददृशुर्देवपुङ्गवाः । यामाहुः परमां शक्तिमीश्वरेच्छानुवर्तिनीम्
verses.transliteration: hR^idi pashyanti taM devaM dadR^ishurdevapu~NgavAH | yAmAhuH paramAM shaktimIshvarechChAnuvartinIm
verses.translation: Holding flowers and Darbha, the hand shall be placed on the top of the Linga five times and the basic mantra shall be repeated hundred and eight times.

verses.sanskrit: तामपश्यन् महेशस्य वामतो वामलोचनाम् । ये विनिर्धूतसंसाराः प्राप्ताः शैवं परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tAmapashyan maheshasya vAmato vAmalochanAm | ye vinirdhUtasaMsArAH prAptAH shaivaM paraM padam
verses.translation: Beginning from the head and ending with the pedestal, the Linga shall be touched repeating the basic mantra. The great worship shall be performed after invoking the lord as before.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यसिद्धाश्च ये वान्ये ते च दृष्टा गणेश्वराः । अथ तं तुष्टुवुर्देवा देव्या सह महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nityasiddhAshcha ye vAnye te cha dR^iShTA gaNeshvarAH | atha taM tuShTuvurdevA devyA saha maheshvaram
verses.translation: Everything mentioned succinctly by your holiness with regard to knowledge, rites and activities, after taking out the essence, has been heard by me. It is as sacred as the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रैर्माहेश्वरैर्दिव्यैः श्रोतैः पौराणिकैरपि । देवोऽपि देवानालोक्य घृणया वृषभध्वजः
verses.transliteration: stotrairmAheshvarairdivyaiH shrotaiH paurANikairapi | devo.api devAnAlokya ghR^iNayA vR^iShabhadhvajaH
verses.translation: Now I wish to hear about Yoga which is very diffi¬ cult to achieve along with its authorisation, ancillaries, injunc¬ tions and purpose.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टोऽस्मीत्याह सुप्रीतः स्वभावमधुरां गिरम् । अथ सुप्रीतमनसं प्रणिपत्य वृषध्वजम् । अर्थमहत्तमं देवाः पप्रच्छुरिममादरात्
verses.transliteration: tuShTo.asmItyAha suprItaH svabhAvamadhurAM giram | atha suprItamanasaM praNipatya vR^iShadhvajam | arthamahattamaM devAH paprachChurimamAdarAt
verses.translation: If death were to overtake before, it can be averted without resorting to the practices of penance, by taking recourse to Yoga whereby the man avoids becoming a self- » killer. Hence it behoves you to mention factually the different types of Yoga and their relative importance, cause, time and procedure.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । भगवन् केन मार्गेण पूजनीयोऽसि भूतले । कस्याधिकारः पूजायां वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH | bhagavan kena mArgeNa pUjanIyo.asi bhUtale | kasyAdhikAraH pUjAyAM vaktumarhasi tattvataH
verses.translation: O Krfna, the question has been pertinently put by you

verses.sanskrit: ततः सस्मितमालोक्य देवीं देववरो हरः । स्वरूपं दर्शयामास घोरं सूर्यात्मकं परम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sasmitamAlokya devIM devavaro haraH | svarUpaM darshayAmAsa ghoraM sUryAtmakaM param
verses.translation: The concentration of the mind without disturbances, on the expressed meaning of the mantra along with the practice of the mantra is mantrayoga.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैश्वर्यगुणोपेतं सर्वतेजोमयं परम् । शक्तिभिर्मूर्तिभिश्चाङ्गैर्ग्रहैर्देवैश्च संवृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaishvaryaguNopetaM sarvatejomayaM param | shaktibhirmUrtibhishchA~Ngairgrahairdevaishcha saMvR^itam
verses.translation: Wherein the universe with all its parts is medi¬ tated upon it is called Abhavayoga since in that the existent object is not seen.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टबाहुं चतुर्वक्त्रमर्द्धनारीकमद्भुतम् । दृष्ट्वैवमद्भुताकारं देवा विष्णुपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: aShTabAhuM chaturvaktramarddhanArIkamadbhutam | dR^iShTvaivamadbhutAkAraM devA viShNupurogamAH
verses.translation: In brief the Yoga is of eight or six ancillaries. The eight ancillaries are Yama, Niyama, Asana Pranayama, Pratyahara, Dharana, Dhyana and Samadhi as mentioned by the wise.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमकृतैर्धर्मैर्विपरीतं क्वचित्समम् । वेदात् षडङ्गादुद्धृत्य साङ्ख्याद्योगाच्च कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: varNAshramakR^itairdharmairviparItaM kvachitsamam | vedAt ShaDa~NgAduddhR^itya sA~NkhyAdyogAchcha kR^itsnashaH
verses.translation: The six Angas are in brief Asana, Pranasarhrodha, Pratyahara, Dharana, Dhyana and Samadhi.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्वा दिवाकरं देवं देवीं चैव निशाकरम् । पञ्चभूतानि शेषाणि तन्मयं च चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: buddhvA divAkaraM devaM devIM chaiva nishAkaram | pa~nchabhUtAni sheShANi tanmayaM cha charAcharam
verses.translation: The definitions of all these separately have been mentioned in SivaSastra and other Saivite scriptures, especially K.amika etc. They are mentioned in YogaSastras and Puranas also. Yama is the observance of restraints such as non¬ violence, non-stealing, abstention from sexual intercourse and non-acceptance of monetary gifts. The five constitute the subdivisions of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा नमश्चक्रुस्तस्मै चार्घ्यं प्रदाय वै
verses.transliteration: evamuktvA namashchakrustasmai chArghyaM pradAya vai
verses.translation: Then through the other nostril the external air is inhaled and the body is filled up like the bellows. It is Puraka (Inhaling).

verses.sanskrit: सिन्दूरवर्णाय सुमण्डलाय सुवर्णवर्णाभरणाय तुभ्यम् । पद्माभनेत्राय सपङ्कजाय ब्रह्मेन्द्रनारायणकारणाय
verses.transliteration: sindUravarNAya sumaNDalAya suvarNavarNAbharaNAya tubhyam | padmAbhanetrAya sapa~NkajAya brahmendranArAyaNakAraNAya
verses.translation: He does not breathe out the internal or breathe in the external air. He remains steady like the filled-up jar. It is called Kumbhaka (Retention).

verses.sanskrit: सुरत्नपूर्णं ससुवर्णतोयं सुकुङ्कुमाद्यं सकुशं सपुष्पम् । प्रदत्तमादाय सहेमपात्रं प्रशस्तमर्घ्यं भगवन् प्रसीद
verses.transliteration: suratnapUrNaM sasuvarNatoyaM suku~NkumAdyaM sakushaM sapuShpam | pradattamAdAya sahemapAtraM prashastamarghyaM bhagavan prasIda
verses.translation: The three, Recaka etc. shall not be done hurriedly or slowly. The practiser of Yoga shall adopt them grad¬ ually with restraint.

verses.sanskrit: नमः शिवाय शान्ताय सगणायादिहेतवे । रुद्राय विष्णवे तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणे सूर्यमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: namaH shivAya shAntAya sagaNAyAdihetave | rudrAya viShNave tubhyaM brahmaNe sUryamUrtaye
verses.translation: The practice of Recaka shall begin with the purification of the veins and conclude with its voluntary exit as mentioned in the Yoganuasana.

verses.sanskrit: यः शिवं मण्डले सौरे सम्पूज्यैव समाहितः । प्रातर्मध्याह्नसायाह्ने प्रदद्यादर्घ्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yaH shivaM maNDale saure sampUjyaiva samAhitaH | prAtarmadhyAhnasAyAhne pradadyAdarghyamuttamam
verses.translation: Uttama has three strokes and its duration is thirty- six Matras. Uttara is the Pranayama that causes perspiration and trembling of the body.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणमेद्वा पठेदेतान् शलोकान् श्रुतिमुखानिमान् । न तस्य दुर्ल्लभं किञ्चिद्भक्तश्चेन्मुच्यते दृढम्
verses.transliteration: praNamedvA paThedetAn shalokAn shrutimukhAnimAn | na tasya durllabhaM ki~nchidbhaktashchenmuchyate dR^iDham
verses.translation: The yogin has experiences — the thrill of bliss, horri¬ pilation and shedding of tears. He may prattle. There may be vertigo and senselessness.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादभ्यर्चयेनित्यं शिवमादित्यरूपिणम् । धर्मकामार्थमुक्त्यर्थं मनसा कर्मणा गिरा
verses.transliteration: tasmAdabhyarchayenityaM shivamAdityarUpiNam | dharmakAmArthamuktyarthaM manasA karmaNA girA
verses.translation: The duration of Pranfiyama shall be increased in accordance with the Matras and strokes. The veins shall be necessarily purified.

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवान् समालोक्य मण्डलस्थो महेश्वरः । सर्वागमोत्तरं दत्त्वा शास्त्रमन्तरधाद्धरः
verses.transliteration: atha devAn samAlokya maNDalastho maheshvaraH | sarvAgamottaraM dattvA shAstramantaradhAddharaH
verses.translation: The vital breaths of the body can be conquered through the mastery over Prana. The vital breaths arc Prana, Apana, Samana, Udana, Vyana, Naga, Kurma, Kykara, Devadatta and Dhanahjaya. That which causes the move¬ ment is called Praa.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पूजाधिकारोऽयं ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशामिति । ज्ञात्वा प्रणम्य देवेशं देवा जग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra pUjAdhikAro.ayaM brahmakShatravishAmiti | j~nAtvA praNamya deveshaM devA jagmuryathAgatam
verses.translation: It burns off all defects. It preserves the body of practisers. When the Prana is mastered the symptoms arc manifest.

verses.sanskrit: शतकोटिप्रमाणेन विस्तीर्णं ग्रन्थसङ्ख्यया । कथितं परमेशेन तत्र पूजा कथं प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: shatakoTipramANena vistIrNaM granthasa~NkhyayA | kathitaM parameshena tatra pUjA kathaM prabhoH
verses.translation: Urine, phlegm and faeces are reduced in quan¬ tity. Ability to eat much and to breathe slowly, lightness of the body, ability to walk fast, enthusiasm, clearness of voice and tone, destruction of ailments, strength, brilliance, comeli¬ ness of features, courage, intelligence, youthfulness, firmness and all round pleasure these are the symptoms. All forms of

verses.sanskrit: अथ कालेन महता तस्मिन् शास्त्रे तिरोहिते । भर्तारं परिपप्रच्छ तदङ्कस्था महेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: atha kAlena mahatA tasmin shAstre tirohite | bhartAraM paripaprachCha tada~NkasthA maheshvarI
verses.translation: The vital airs of the body, PrSna, ApSna and others, ten in number, play a distinct role in the general yogic exercises. The practices of these airs constitute an important feature of Sivayoga too. The present context describes the various processes in regulating the function of vital airs as a part of Sivayoga.

verses.sanskrit: तया सञ्चोदितो देवो देव्या चन्द्रविभूषणः । अवदत्करमुद्धृत्य शास्त्रं सर्वागमोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tayA sa~nchodito devo devyA chandravibhUShaNaH | avadatkaramuddhR^itya shAstraM sarvAgamottaram
verses.translation: The total withdrawal of the sense-organs operat¬ ing in their respective objects is called Pratyahara. The sense-organs are the mind etc. They are capable of accord¬ ing heaven and hell. When restrained they yield heaven, when let loose they are hellish. Hence the intelligent man who seeks happiness shall have recourse to perfect knowledge and detachment, and lift up his soul through his own soul after carefully restraining the horses of his sense- organs.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तितं च तल्लोके नियोगात्परमेष्ठिनः । मयागस्त्येन गुरुणा दधीचेन महर्षिणा
verses.transliteration: pravartitaM cha talloke niyogAtparameShThinaH | mayAgastyena guruNA dadhIchena maharShiNA
verses.translation: In brief, what is called Dharana is the fixation of the mind in a spot. The spot is Siva alone and nothing else. The Dharana shall take place when the mind is establi¬ shed in the spot for a stipulated duration and when it does not swerve from the target. The initial stability of the mind is generated through Dharana. Hence one shall endow the mind with fortitude by the practice of Dharana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयमप्यवतीर्योर्व्यां युगावर्तेषु शूलधृक् । स्वाश्रितानां विमुक्त्यर्थं कुरुते ज्ञानसन्ततिम्
verses.transliteration: svayamapyavatIryorvyAM yugAvarteShu shUladhR^ik | svAshritAnAM vimuktyarthaM kurute j~nAnasantatim
verses.translation: The root 'Dhyai' means to contemplate. Frequ¬ ent contemplation of Siva with an unconfounded mind is called Dhyana. It is a series of visions in the mind that is fixed on the object of meditation to the exclusion of other visions. Eschewing everything else, Siva, the cause of auspici¬ ousness, the great lord of the gods, shall be meditated upon. Thus concludes the Atharvaveda. Similarly the great god¬ dess Siva shall be meditated upon. In the Vedas Siva and Siva are mentioned as pervading all living beings. In the Smrtis and Sastras they are mentioned as present everywhere and awakened always. They are omniscient. They shall always be meditated upon in different forms. There are two benefits accruing from meditation, the first one being freedom from other visions and the second one the acquisition of Siddhis, Anima etc.

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुः सत्यो भार्गवश्च ह्यङ्गिराः सविता द्विजाः । मृत्युः शतक्रतुर्धीमान् वसिष्ठो मुनिपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: R^ibhuH satyo bhArgavashcha hya~NgirAH savitA dvijAH | mR^ityuH shatakraturdhImAn vasiShTho munipu~NgavaH
verses.translation: The knower of Yoga shall practise Yoga with the know¬ ledge of four things — the meditator, the meditation, the ob¬ ject of meditation and the benefit of meditation.

verses.sanskrit: सारस्वतस्त्रिधामा च त्रिवृतो मुनिपुङ्गवः । शततेजाः स्वयं धर्मो नारायण इति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: sArasvatastridhAmA cha trivR^ito munipu~NgavaH | shatatejAH svayaM dharmo nArAyaNa iti shrutaH
verses.translation: Dharana extends upto the twclve-petalled lotus of the heart. Dhyana is the fixation of the Dharana in the twelve-petalled lotus. When Dhyana extends to the twelvc- petalled lotus it is called Samadhi.

verses.sanskrit: स्वरक्षश्चारुणिर्धीमांस्तथा चैव कृतञ्जयः । मामतेयो भरद्वाजो गौतमः कविरुत्तमः
verses.transliteration: svarakShashchAruNirdhImAMstathA chaiva kR^ita~njayaH | mAmateyo bharadvAjo gautamaH kaviruttamaH
verses.translation: Fixing the mind in the object of meditation he shall see it steadily. The Yogin thus like the fire extinguished is absorbed in Samadhi.

verses.sanskrit: वाचःस्रवा मुनिस्साक्षात्तथा सूक्ष्मायणिः शुचिः । तृणबिन्दुर्मुनिः कृष्णः शक्तिः शाक्तेय उत्तरः
verses.transliteration: vAchaHsravA munissAkShAttathA sUkShmAyaNiH shuchiH | tR^iNabindurmuniH kR^iShNaH shaktiH shAkteya uttaraH
verses.translation: He neither hears nor smells nor prattles nor sees nor feels the touch. The mind does not think.

verses.sanskrit: जातूकर्ण्यो हरिः साक्षात् कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः । व्यासावतारान् शृण्वन्तु कल्पयोगेश्वरान् क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: jAtUkarNyo hariH sAkShAt kR^iShNadvaipAyano muniH | vyAsAvatArAn shR^iNvantu kalpayogeshvarAn kramAt
verses.translation: Nor does he identify with anything external. Nor is it bound like the inanimate log of wood. A person whose Atman has thus merged into Siva is called Samadhistha.

verses.sanskrit: लैङ्गे व्यासावतारा हि द्वापरान्तेषु सुव्रताः । योगाचार्यावताराश्च तथा शिष्येषु शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: lai~Nge vyAsAvatArA hi dvAparAnteShu suvratAH | yogAchAryAvatArAshcha tathA shiShyeShu shUlinaH
verses.translation: Just as the lamp in a windless spot never flickers so also is the Yogin who is Samadhistha, An intelligent man shall not swerve. He shall be steady.

verses.sanskrit: कस्याधिकारः पूजादौ ज्ञानयोगादयः कथम् । तत्सर्वं विस्तरादेव वक्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: kasyAdhikAraH pUjAdau j~nAnayogAdayaH katham | tatsarvaM vistarAdeva vaktumarhasi suvrata
verses.translation: All his obstacles and hindrances perish gradually if the Yogin practises the excellent Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्र विभोः शिष्याश्चत्वारः स्युर्महौजसः । शिष्यास्तेषां प्रशिष्याश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: tatra tatra vibhoH shiShyAshchatvAraH syurmahaujasaH | shiShyAsteShAM prashiShyAshcha shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
verses.translation: There are ten obstacles in the path of those who practise Yoga; — Idleness, acute ailments, blunder, doubtful¬ ness about the spot, unsteady mind, lack of faith, illusions, miseries, dejectedness and indulgence in sensual objecs.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां सम्भावनाल्लोके शैवाज्ञाकरणादिभिः । भाग्यवन्तो विमुच्यन्ते भक्त्या चात्यन्तभाविताः
verses.transliteration: teShAM sambhAvanAlloke shaivAj~nAkaraNAdibhiH | bhAgyavanto vimuchyante bhaktyA chAtyantabhAvitAH
verses.translation: Idleness affects the body and the mind. Ailments are caused by the imbalance of the Dhatus. They are also due to the defective previous Karmans.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । शैवं सङ्क्षिप्य वेदोक्तं शिवेन परिभाषितम् । स्तुतिनिन्दादिरहितं सद्यः प्रत्ययकारकम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | shaivaM sa~NkShipya vedoktaM shivena paribhAShitam | stutinindAdirahitaM sadyaH pratyayakArakam
verses.translation: Illusion is misconception. Misery is of three types. That due to ignorance is spiritual misery. The misery that affects the body due to previous actions is the corporal misery. Thunderbolt, missiles, poisons are the miseries caused by divine intercession.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुप्रसादजं दिव्यमनायासेन मुक्तिदम् । कथयिष्ये समासेन तस्य शक्यो न विस्तरः
verses.transliteration: guruprasAdajaM divyamanAyAsena muktidam | kathayiShye samAsena tasya shakyo na vistaraH
verses.translation: When the obstacles subside and the Yogin is absor¬ bed in Yoga the signs begin to appear. They are divine in¬ dications of the imminent success.

verses.sanskrit: सिसृक्षया पुराव्यक्ताच्छिवः स्थाणुर्महेश्वरः । सत्कार्यकारणोपेतः स्वयमाविरभूत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sisR^ikShayA purAvyaktAchChivaH sthANurmaheshvaraH | satkAryakAraNopetaH svayamAvirabhUtprabhuH
verses.translation: The Upasargas are — Pratibha, Sravana, Varta, Darsana, Asvada and Vedana. They are the Siddhis at the expense of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: जनयामास च तदा ऋषिर्विश्वाधिकः प्रभुः । देवानां प्रथमं देवं ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: janayAmAsa cha tadA R^iShirvishvAdhikaH prabhuH | devAnAM prathamaM devaM brahmANaM brahmaNaspatim
verses.translation: The correct perception of objects whether they be subtle, hidden by other objects, or of bygone days, or situated far off, or not yet born is called Pratibha.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: Vedana is the ability to know the divine touch and the divine smell. All the lords of the worlds beginning with Brahma stand before him and give him many gems and jewels. Words naturally sweet and eloquent function through his mouth.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: Vedana is the ability to know the divine touch and the divine smell. All the lords of the worlds beginning with Brahma stand before him and give him many gems and jewels. Words naturally sweet and eloquent function through his mouth.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.९. नवमोऽध्यायः । शिवस्य योगावतारवर्णनम् । कृष्ण उवाच । युगावर्तेषु सर्वेषु योगाचार्यच्छलेन तु । अवतारान्हि शर्वस्य शिष्यांश्च भगवन् वद
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.9\. navamo.adhyAyaH | shivasya yogAvatAravarNanam | kR^iShNa uvAcha | yugAvarteShu sarveShu yogAchAryachChalena tu | avatArAnhi sharvasya shiShyAMshcha bhagavan vada
verses.translation: The Yogic Siddhi pertaining to the earth named 'Pai4aca Pada' consists of eight types of powers, viz., lean¬ ness, bulkiness, infancy, old age, youthfulness, the ability to assume different forms and the ability to collect sveet- smelling scents without any earthly part.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारः सनकः सनन्दश्च सनातनः । सुधामा विरजाश्चैव शङ्खश्चाण्डज एव च
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAraH sanakaH sanandashcha sanAtanaH | sudhAmA virajAshchaiva sha~NkhashchANDaja eva cha
verses.translation: The wonderful Yogic Siddhi pertaining to water consists of sixteen powers, viz: — he can stay under water, he can come out of the earth, at his will he can drink up even the ocean and be none the worse for it, wherever he wishes he can let water spring up or he can hold water in the palm of his hand. Whatever he wishes to eat he can transform into juicy substance, he can assume these forms, he can have the body free from cuts and wounds. Over and above these powers he can have the eight powers of the Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: सारस्वतश्च मेघश्च मेघवाहः सुवाहकः । कपिलश्चासुरिः पञ्चशिखो बाष्कल एव च
verses.transliteration: sArasvatashcha meghashcha meghavAhaH suvAhakaH | kapilashchAsuriH pa~nchashikho bAShkala eva cha
verses.translation: The Yogic Siddhi called Taijasa consists of twenty- four types of powers viz: — the ability to create fire from the body, absence of fear of being scorched by the fire, the ability to burn the universe without difficulty, placing of fire in water or in the palms, re-create things burnt in fire, cook food in the mouth, create bodies with the fire and wind and above all these are the sixteen powers of the Apya Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: पराशराश्च गर्गश्च भार्गवश्चाङ्गिरास्तथा । बलबन्धुर्निरामित्राः केतुशृङ्गस्तपोधनः
verses.transliteration: parAsharAshcha gargashcha bhArgavashchA~NgirAstathA | balabandhurnirAmitrAH ketushR^i~NgastapodhanaH
verses.translation: The wise know that the Yogic Siddhi called Maruta consists of thirtytwo types of powers viz: — the speed of the mind, the ability to enter the bodies of living beings, to hold weighty things like mountains etc. without difficulty, weightiness, weightlessness, holding the wind within the palms, ability to shake even the earth with the tip of the finger, to produce bodies with the wind and apart frtjm these the twenty- four powers of the Taijasa Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: लम्बोदरश्च लम्बश्च लम्बात्मा लम्बकेशकः । सर्वज्ञः समबुद्धिश्च साध्यसिद्धिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: lambodarashcha lambashcha lambAtmA lambakeshakaH | sarvaj~naH samabuddhishcha sAdhyasiddhistathaiva cha
verses.translation: The Yogic Siddhi called Aindra pertaining to the ether consists of forty powers: — Shadowlessness, absence of the sense-organs, ability to walk over the ether, to have the sense-objects at will, to transgress the ether, to instil the ether into the body, to solidify ether, having no body and

verses.sanskrit: सुधामा कश्यपश्चैव वसिष्ठो विरजास्तथा । अत्रिरुग्रो गुरुश्रेष्ठः श्रवनोऽथ श्रविष्टकः
verses.transliteration: sudhAmA kashyapashchaiva vasiShTho virajAstathA | atrirugro gurushreShThaH shravano.atha shraviShTakaH
verses.translation: Ability to acquire whatever is desired, to wander as he pleases, to attack all, to sec all the hidden secrets of others, to create bodies according to the task, to bring others under control, to appear pleasing, and to see the world, these powers along with those of the Aindra Yogins constitute the candramasa type of yogin. The powers are mainly mental and the number of powers is fortyeight.

verses.sanskrit: कुणिश्च कुणिबाहुश्च कुशरीरः कुनेत्रकः । काश्यपो ह्युशनाश्चैव च्यवनश्च बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: kuNishcha kuNibAhushcha kusharIraH kunetrakaH | kAshyapo hyushanAshchaiva chyavanashcha bR^ihaspatiH
verses.translation: Ability to cut, to strike, to bind and to release, seizure of all living beings under the influence of worldly existence, ability to delight all, mastery over death and time these arc the** special powers of the Prajapatya Yogins. These powers along with those of Candramasa Yogins are fiftysix in number.

verses.sanskrit: उतथ्यो वामदेवश्च महाकालो महानिलः । वाचःश्रवाः सुवीरश्च श्यावकश्च यतीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: utathyo vAmadevashcha mahAkAlo mahAnilaH | vAchaHshravAH suvIrashcha shyAvakashcha yatIshvaraH
verses.translation: Creation by mere conception, protection, and annihilation, ability to exercise authority to make minds function, dissimilarity with all, creation of a separate uni¬ verse doing auspicious and inauspicious things — these powers along with the Prajapatya powers, altogether numbering sixtyfour, constitute the powers of the Yogin of the Brahma type.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यनाभः कौशल्यो लोकाक्षिः कुथुमिस्तथा । सुमन्तुर्जैमिनिश्चैव कुबन्धः कुशकन्धरः
verses.transliteration: hiraNyanAbhaH kaushalyo lokAkShiH kuthumistathA | sumanturjaiminishchaiva kubandhaH kushakandharaH
verses.translation: This Aivarya functions through intellect. The power greater than and beyond this is the Prakrta Aisvarya called Vainava. The sustenance of the universe is his alone. Only Brahma can explain that region wholly and not others.

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षो दार्भायणिश्चैव केतुमान् गौतमस्तथा । भल्लवी मधुपिङ्गश्च श्वेतकेतुस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: plakSho dArbhAyaNishchaiva ketumAn gautamastathA | bhallavI madhupi~Ngashcha shvetaketustathaiva cha
verses.translation: All the Siddhis due to knowledge and the Upasargas shall be checked assiduously by means of great detachment.

verses.sanskrit: उशिजो बृहदश्वश्च देवलः कविरेव च । शालिहोत्रः सुवेषश्च युवनाश्वः शरद्वसुः
verses.transliteration: ushijo bR^ihadashvashcha devalaH kavireva cha | shAlihotraH suveShashcha yuvanAshvaH sharadvasuH
verses.translation: The great Aisvarya that affords protection and is coveted by all cannot by acquired if the mind is attached to false appearances, forms and attributes.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । श्वेतः सुतारो मदनः सुहोत्रः कङ्क एव च । लौगाक्षिश्च महामायो जैगीषव्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | shvetaH sutAro madanaH suhotraH ka~Nka eva cha | laugAkShishcha mahAmAyo jaigIShavyastathaiva cha
verses.translation: Hence he who abandons the attributes and the pleasures of the gods, Asuras and kings, considering them as worthless as blades of grass acquires the greatest Yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षपादः कणादश्च उलूको वत्स एव च । कुलिकश्चैव गर्गश्च मित्रको रुष्य एव च
verses.transliteration: akShapAdaH kaNAdashcha ulUko vatsa eva cha | kulikashchaiva gargashcha mitrako ruShya eva cha
verses.translation: Or the sage with Yogic powers shall move about with a desire to bless the universe. He can then enjoy the pleasures at his will and attain salvation.

verses.sanskrit: एते शिष्या महेशस्य योगाचार्यस्वरूपिणः । सङ्ख्या च शतमेतेषां सह द्वादशसङ्ख्यया
verses.transliteration: ete shiShyA maheshasya yogAchAryasvarUpiNaH | sa~NkhyA cha shatameteShAM saha dvAdashasa~NkhyayA
verses.translation: Now I shall explain the practice of Yoga. Listen attentively. The time and the spot shall be auspicious; it may be the temple of Siva and or other clean place; it shall be a secluded spot devoid of people, creatures, noises and other disturbances. It shall be well-scrubbed and smeared. •It shall be rendered fragrant with scents and incense. Flo¬ wers shall be strewn..There shall be canopies etc. above. The place shall be abounding in Kusa grass, flowers, sacrifi¬ cial twigs, water, fruits, roots, etc. It shall not be near fire or water-receptacles. There shall not be too many dry leaves. The place shall not be infested by flies, mosquitoes, serpents and beasts of prey. There shall not be harmful beasts or wicked men instilling terror. It shall not be the cremation ground, monastery, anthill, dilapidated house, meeting-place of high¬ ways, banks and shores of rivers and oCeans nor should it be the middle of streets. It shall not be a park in disrepair nor a dilapidated cowshed. It shall not be displeasing nor repulsive. It shall not have been defiled by vomited material or undigested foul smell or faeces and urine. The Yogin shall not practise when he has vomiting or when he suffers from diarrhoea, when he has taken too much of food, or when he has exhausted himself. If he is too hungry or too thirsty or too much worried he shall not practise Yoga. If he is enga¬ ged in any of the tasks set by his preceptor he shall not practise Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे पाशुपताः सिद्धा भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः । सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञा वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः
verses.transliteration: sarve pAshupatAH siddhA bhasmoddhUlitavigrahAH | sarvashAstrArthatattvaj~nA vedavedA~NgapAragAH
verses.translation: He shall have proper food and activity. He shall be sober in recreation and rest. Both his sleep and wakefulness shall be of the normal proper nature. He shall eschew all tiresomeness. The seat shall be soft, pleasant, sufficiently wide, level and pure. He shall practise one of the poses Padmaka, Svastika and others.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाश्रमरताः सर्वे शिवज्ञानपरायणाः । सर्वे सङ्गविनिर्मुक्ताः शिवैकासक्तचेतसः
verses.transliteration: shivAshramaratAH sarve shivaj~nAnaparAyaNAH | sarve sa~NgavinirmuktAH shivaikAsaktachetasaH
verses.translation: He shall pay homage to all those venerable persons who reside with his' preceptors. He shall keep his head and chest erect. The head shall be lifted up a little. The teeth should not gnash one another. The tongue should be kept well within the teeth and motionless. The scrotum

verses.sanskrit: सर्वद्वन्द्वसहा धीराः सर्वभूतहिते रताः । ऋजवो मृदवः स्वस्था जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः
verses.transliteration: sarvadvandvasahA dhIrAH sarvabhUtahite ratAH | R^ijavo mR^idavaH svasthA jitakrodhA jitendriyAH
verses.translation: He shall remember the lord at the root or tip of the nose, or in the umbilicus, or neck, or in the palate or the gullet or in the middle of the eyebrows or at the jiostrils or in the forehead or on the head. After conceiving a suitable seat to Siva and Siva he shall remember Siva with or without Avarana in the two-petalled, or twelve-pe tailed lotus in accordance with injunction. Or it may be in the ten-petalled six-cornered or four-cornered lotus.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राक्षमालाभरणास्त्रिपुण्ड्राङ्कितमस्तकाः । शिखाजटाः सर्वजटा अजटा मुण्डशीर्षकाः
verses.transliteration: rudrAkShamAlAbharaNAstripuNDrA~NkitamastakAH | shikhAjaTAH sarvajaTA ajaTA muNDashIrShakAH
verses.translation: The lotus shall be conceived in the middle of the eye-brows as having two petals and as brilliant as light¬ ning. To the south and north of the lotus in the middle of the eyebrow two leaves shall be conceived with the colour of lightning ending with letters. The leaves of the sixteen- petalled lotus are the sixteen vowels. They shall be conceived beginning from the petal to the east and proceeding in order.

verses.sanskrit: फलमूलाशनप्रायाः प्राणायामपरायणाः । शिवाभिमानसम्पन्नाः शिवध्यानैकतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: phalamUlAshanaprAyAH prANAyAmaparAyaNAH | shivAbhimAnasampannAH shivadhyAnaikatatparAH
verses.translation: The twelve letters beginning with 'Ka' and ending with 'Tha' are the leaves. The lotus of the colour of the sun, which is meditated inside the heart and which is of the colour of the cow's milk has ten letters from "Da" to "Pha" for its petals. The letters upto the letter "La'* (i.e Ba, Bha, Ma, Ya, Ra and La) constitute the six petals of the lotus with petals facing down and having the colour of the smoke- * less burning coal. The letters from "Va" to "Sa" consti¬ tute the petals of the lotus at the Muladhara, having the colour of gold.

verses.sanskrit: समुन्मथितसंसारविषवृक्षाङ्कुरोद्गमाः । प्रयातुमेव सन्नद्धाः परं शिवपुरं प्रति
verses.transliteration: samunmathitasaMsAraviShavR^ikShA~NkurodgamAH | prayAtumeva sannaddhAH paraM shivapuraM prati
verses.translation: He shall meditate on the lord and the goddess in any of these lotuses according to his taste. The mind shall be steady.

verses.sanskrit: सदेशिकानिमान् मत्वा नित्यं यः शिवमर्चयेत् । स याति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: sadeshikAnimAn matvA nityaM yaH shivamarchayet | sa yAti shivasAyujyaM nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: He shall conceive him in any of the following forms — of the size of the thumb, pure, brilliant and illuminat¬ ing all round, of the form of pure lamp, endowed with its Sakti completely, of the size of the digit of the moon, of the form of the star, the awn of Nivara grain and the stalk of the lotus, of the circular shape of the Kadamba, of the form of the dewdrop. He shall contemplate on him as the lord of different Tattvas of the earth and others of which the meditator wishes the mastery.

verses.sanskrit: दधिवाहश्च ऋषभो मुनिरुग्रोऽत्रिरेव च । सुपालको गौतमश्च तथा वेदशिरा मुनिः
verses.transliteration: dadhivAhashcha R^iShabho munirugro.atrireva cha | supAlako gautamashcha tathA vedashirA muniH
verses.translation: The Mortis beginning with Brahma and ending with Sadaiva, the eight Murtis beginning with Bhava, the gross Murtis of Siva prescribed in the Saivite scriptures, the terrible, the quiet or the mixture of both shall be meditated upon by the sages without the desire for fruits, and by the experts in meditation.

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णश्च गुहावासी शिखण्डी चापरः स्मृतः । जटामाली चाट्टहासो दारुको लाङ्गुली तथा
verses.transliteration: gokarNashcha guhAvAsI shikhaNDI chAparaH smR^itaH | jaTAmAlI chATTahAso dAruko lA~NgulI tathA
verses.translation: If the terrible forms of the lord are meditated upon they shall dispel sins and ailments. If the mixtures of the form are contemplated upon, the effect is often delayed. If the calm and the gentle form is contemplated upon, the effect is neither immediate nor delayed. But the special benefit in the gentle form is salvation, peace and intellect. The Siddhis are achieved gradually. There is no doubt about this.

verses.sanskrit: महाकालश्च शूली च दण्डी मुण्डीश एव च । सहिष्णुः सोमशर्मा च लकुलीश्वर एव च
verses.transliteration: mahAkAlashcha shUlI cha daNDI muNDIsha eva cha | sahiShNuH somasharmA cha lakulIshvara eva cha
verses.translation: Some Yogins perform meditation with the full con¬ viction that Siddhis are immediately acquired by those who remember the lord.

verses.sanskrit: एते वाराहकल्पेऽस्मिन् सप्तमस्यान्तरो मनोः । अष्टाविंशतिसङ्ख्याता योगाचार्या युगक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ete vArAhakalpe.asmin saptamasyAntaro manoH | aShTAviMshatisa~NkhyAtA yogAchAryA yugakramAt
verses.translation: In order to steady the mind some perform medita¬ tion on the gross form. The mind that is fixed on the gross form becomes stable in the subtle form.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्याः प्रत्येकमेतेषां चत्वारः शान्तचेतसः । श्वेतादयश्च रुष्यान्तांस्तान् ब्रवीमि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: shiShyAH pratyekameteShAM chatvAraH shAntachetasaH | shvetAdayashcha ruShyAntAMstAn bravImi yathAkramam
verses.translation: He shall observe the steadiness of the mind and frequently meditate. This meditation, they say, has at the

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतः श्वेतशिखश्चैव श्वेताश्वः श्वेतलोहितः । दुन्दुभिः शतरूपश्च ऋचीकः केतुमांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: shvetaH shvetashikhashchaiva shvetAshvaH shvetalohitaH | dundubhiH shatarUpashcha R^ichIkaH ketumAMstathA
verses.translation: But the intellectual vision by itself without an object shall also function. Therefore the fact is — the Savisaya meditation is on the lord who is conceived as brilliant as the sun. The meditation on the subtle form is Nirvisaya. Savisaya meditation has a definite form in view. Meditation of the formless is the Nirvisaya meditation. The two are called Nirbija and Sabija also. Hence the practiser shall at the outset perform the Savisaya or Sabija meditation and in the end perform Nirbija or Nirvisaya meditation.

verses.sanskrit: विकोशश्च विकेशश्च विपाशः पाशनाशनः । सुमुखो दुर्मुखश्चैव दुर्गमो दुरतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: vikoshashcha vikeshashcha vipAshaH pAshanAshanaH | sumukho durmukhashchaiva durgamo duratikramaH
verses.translation: The benefits derived from Pranayama are Santi, Prasanti, DIpti and Prasada. When adversities subside it is called Sunti. Prasanti is the destruction of ignorance both ex¬ ternal and internal. The external and internal illumination is called DIpti. The normal and the healthy state of the intellect is called Prasada. When the intellect is in healthy normal state the internal and external sense-organs too acquire healthy and normal state,

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: The object of meditation on the form of intellect¬ ual visions is Dhyeya and that is Siva himself accompanied by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: The object of meditation on the form of intellect¬ ual visions is Dhyeya and that is Siva himself accompanied by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१०. दशमोऽध्यायः । शिवभक्तिवर्णनम् । कृष्ण उवाच । भगवन् सर्वयोगीन्द्र गणेश्वर मुनीश्वर । षडाननसमप्रख्य सर्वज्ञाननिधे गुरो
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.10\. dashamo.adhyAyaH | shivabhaktivarNanam | kR^iShNa uvAcha | bhagavan sarvayogIndra gaNeshvara munIshvara | ShaDAnanasamaprakhya sarvaj~nAnanidhe guro
verses.translation: The experience of salvation and the perfect Ani ma etc. is the direct fruit of meditation on Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्तःपुरचारिण्यो देव्यो दिव्यविभूषणाः । अन्तरङ्गा गणेन्द्राश्च सर्वलोकमहेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: athAntaHpurachAriNyo devyo divyavibhUShaNAH | antara~NgA gaNendrAshcha sarvalokamaheshvarIm
verses.translation: Man shall eschew everything and be engaged in meditation since he will be having both happiness and salva¬ tion from the practice of meditation.

verses.sanskrit: भर्तारं परिपूर्णं च सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् । चामरासक्तहस्ताश्च देवीं देवं सिषेविरे
verses.transliteration: bhartAraM paripUrNaM cha sarvalokamaheshvaram | chAmarAsaktahastAshcha devIM devaM siShevire
verses.translation: Knowledge cannot be attained without meditation. A non-yogin cannot have meditation. The ocean of worldly existence is crossed by the person who has both meditation and knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रियाः कथा वृत्ता विनोदाय महेशयोः । त्राणाय च नृणां लोके ये शिवं शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: tataH priyAH kathA vR^ittA vinodAya maheshayoH | trANAya cha nR^iNAM loke ye shivaM sharaNaM gatAH
verses.translation: The clear and single-centred knowledge devoid of all conditioning factors can be achieved only by a Yogin who regularly practises Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: तदावसरमालोक्य सर्वलोकमहेश्वरी । भर्तारं परिपप्रच्छ सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tadAvasaramAlokya sarvalokamaheshvarI | bhartAraM paripaprachCha sarvalokamaheshvaram
verses.translation: The minds of only those whose sins have been en¬ tirely quelled become inclined towards knowledge and medita¬ tion. Those whose intellects have been defiled by sins find it wholly inaccessible.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । केन वश्यो महादेवो मर्त्यानां मन्दचेतसाम् । आत्मतत्त्वाद्यशक्तानामात्मनामकृतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | kena vashyo mahAdevo martyAnAM mandachetasAm | AtmatattvAdyashaktAnAmAtmanAmakR^itAtmanAm
verses.translation: Just as the blazing fire burns both the dry and the wet twigs, so also the fire of meditation burns in a trice both the auspicious and the inauspicious Karmans.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । न कर्मणा न तपसा न जपैर्नासनादिभिः । न ज्ञानेन न चान्येन वश्योऽहं श्रद्धया विना
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | na karmaNA na tapasA na japairnAsanAdibhiH | na j~nAnena na chAnyena vashyo.ahaM shraddhayA vinA
verses.translation: Just as even a modicum of light dispels darkness so also even the slightest practice of Yoga destroys great sins.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धा मय्यस्ति चेत्पुंसां येन केनापि हेतुना । वश्यः स्पृश्यश्च दृश्यश्च पूज्यस्सम्भाष्य एव च
verses.transliteration: shraddhA mayyasti chetpuMsAM yena kenApi hetunA | vashyaH spR^ishyashcha dR^ishyashcha pUjyassambhAShya eva cha
verses.translation: Yogins do not resort to holy centres full of waters nor to deities made of stone or clay because they have belief only in their Atmans.

verses.sanskrit: साध्या तस्मान् मयि शद्धा मां वशीकर्तुमिच्छता । श्रद्धा हेतुः स्वधर्मस्य रक्षणं वर्णिनामिह
verses.transliteration: sAdhyA tasmAn mayi shaddhA mAM vashIkartumichChatA | shraddhA hetuH svadharmasya rakShaNaM varNinAmiha
verses.translation: Just as the gross form of the lord fashioned out of clay or wood is observed by the non-yogins so also his subtle form can be perceived by the Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: स्ववर्णाश्रमधर्मेऽथ वर्तते यस्तु मानवः । तस्यैव भवति श्रद्धा मयि नान्यस्य कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: svavarNAshramadharme.atha vartate yastu mAnavaH | tasyaiva bhavati shraddhA mayi nAnyasya kasyachit
verses.translation: Just as in the Royal household, the interior officials not the workers outside are the favourites of kings so also those who are engaged in inner meditation are the favourites of lord Siva and not those who perform holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: आम्नायसिद्धमखिलं धर्ममाश्रमिणामिह । ब्रह्मणा कथितं पूर्वं ममैवाज्ञापुरः सरम्
verses.transliteration: AmnAyasiddhamakhilaM dharmamAshramiNAmiha | brahmaNA kathitaM pUrvaM mamaivAj~nApuraH saram
verses.translation: Just as the exterior workers do not enjoy the pleasures in the royal palace, the same is the case with the Karmins.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायस्त्वमवतीर्योर्व्यां पाशविच्छित्तये नृणाम् । महर्षिवपुरास्थाय स्थितोऽसि परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: prAyastvamavatIryorvyAM pAshavichChittaye nR^iNAm | maharShivapurAsthAya sthito.asi parameshvara
verses.translation: If a person in his attempt for knowledge and

verses.sanskrit: स तु पैतामहो धर्मो बहुवित्तक्रियान्वितः । नात्यन्तफलभूयिष्ठः क्लेशायाससमन्वितः । तेन धर्मेण महता श्रद्धां प्राप्य सुदुर्ल्लभाम्
verses.transliteration: sa tu paitAmaho dharmo bahuvittakriyAnvitaH | nAtyantaphalabhUyiShThaH kleshAyAsasamanvitaH | tena dharmeNa mahatA shraddhAM prApya sudurllabhAm
verses.translation: Even by performing sacrifices, that goal is not obtained which a man with the desire for the knowledge of Yoga attains.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णिनो ये प्रपद्यन्ते मामनन्यसमाश्रयाः । तेषां सुखेन मार्गेण धर्मकामार्थमुक्तयः
verses.transliteration: varNino ye prapadyante mAmananyasamAshrayAH | teShAM sukhena mArgeNa dharmakAmArthamuktayaH
verses.translation: The fruit derivable by worshipping a crore of brahmins can be attained by giving alms alone to a Siva Yogin.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमसमाचारो मया भूयः प्रकल्पितः । तस्मिन् भक्तिमतामेव मदीयानां तु वर्णिनाम्
verses.transliteration: varNAshramasamAchAro mayA bhUyaH prakalpitaH | tasmin bhaktimatAmeva madIyAnAM tu varNinAm
verses.translation: By giving cooked rice to him the benefits of sacri¬ fices, Agnihotras, charitable gifts and pilgrimages can be secured.

verses.sanskrit: अधिकारो न चान्येषामित्याज्ञा नैष्ठिकी मम । तदाज्ञप्तेन मार्गेण वर्णिनो मदुपाश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: adhikAro na chAnyeShAmityAj~nA naiShThikI mama | tadAj~naptena mArgeNa varNino madupAshrayAH
verses.translation: Those who disparage Bivayogins under delusion undergo sufferings in hells along with those who listen, till the dissolution of the world,

verses.sanskrit: मलमायादिपाशेभ्यो विमुक्ता मत्प्रसादतः । परं मदीयमासाद्य पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् । परमं मम साधर्म्यं प्राप्य निर्वृतिमाययुः
verses.transliteration: malamAyAdipAshebhyo vimuktA matprasAdataH | paraM madIyamAsAdya punarAvR^ittidurlabham | paramaM mama sAdharmyaM prApya nirvR^itimAyayuH
verses.translation: Only when there is some listener, does a person disparage the Yogin. Hence the listener too is a sinner. Those who worship Sivayogins attain pleasures here and salva¬ tion hereafter. Hence, Sivayogins shall be honoured and revered' by those who seek worldly pleasures, giving them asylum, food stuffs and drinks, beds and blankets. The Yogic virtue cannot be smashed by the iron clubs of sins. It is very strong and shall be considered to possess adaman¬ tine fibres. Yogins are not smeared by sins like the lotus leaf not affected by water.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् लब्ध्वाप्यलब्ध्वा वा वर्णधर्मं मयेरितम् । आश्रित्य मम भक्तश्चेत्स्वात्मनात्मानमुद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAt labdhvApyalabdhvA vA varNadharmaM mayeritam | Ashritya mama bhaktashchetsvAtmanAtmAnamuddharet
verses.translation: Even the land where the sage engaged in Sivayoga resides is hallowed and sacred, let alone Sivayogin himself.

verses.sanskrit: अलब्धलाभ एवैष कोटिकोटिगुणाधिकः । तस्मान्मे मुखतो लब्धं वर्णधर्मं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: alabdhalAbha evaiSha koTikoTiguNAdhikaH | tasmAnme mukhato labdhaM varNadharmaM samAcharet
verses.translation: Hence a shrewd and efficient man shall eschew all activities and practise livayoga in order to quell miseries.

verses.sanskrit: ममावतारा हि शुभे योगाचार्यच्छलेन तु । सर्वान्तरेषु सन्त्यार्ये सन्ततिश्च सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: mamAvatArA hi shubhe yogAchAryachChalena tu | sarvAntareShu santyArye santatishcha sahasrashaH
verses.translation: A Yogin who has achieved the fruits of Yoga may sport about after enjoying the pleasures as he wishes or shall remain here performing the requisite services.

verses.sanskrit: अयुक्तानामबुद्धीनामभक्तानां सुरेश्वरि । दुर्लभं सन्ततिज्ञानं ततो यत्नात्समाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: ayuktAnAmabuddhInAmabhaktAnAM sureshvari | durlabhaM santatij~nAnaM tato yatnAtsamAshrayet
verses.translation: Or let him consider worldly pleasures worthless and eschew them. Due to detachment let him abandon rites and be liberated.

verses.sanskrit: सा हानिस्तन्महच्छिद्रं स मोहस्सान्धमूकता । यदन्यत्र श्रमं कुर्यान्मोक्षमार्गबहिष्कृतः
verses.transliteration: sA hAnistanmahachChidraM sa mohassAndhamUkatA | yadanyatra shramaM kuryAnmokShamArgabahiShkR^itaH
verses.translation: Or seeing evil portents and realising death as im¬ minent the Yogin engaged in the practice of Yoga shall resort to a Saivitc holy centre or temple.*®*

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा हि जगत्यस्मिन् देवो वा दानवोऽपि वा । त्वत्तोऽन्यः परमं भावं को जानीयात् शिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: anyathA hi jagatyasmin devo vA dAnavo.api vA | tvatto.anyaH paramaM bhAvaM ko jAnIyAt shivAtmakam
verses.translation: If he has courage enough he shall abandon his life there voluntarily even without ailments.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं क्रिया च चर्या च योगश्चेति सुरेश्वरि । चतुष्पादः समाख्यातो मम धर्मः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnaM kriyA cha charyA cha yogashcheti sureshvari | chatuShpAdaH samAkhyAto mama dharmaH sanAtanaH
verses.translation: He who voluntarily forsakes his life as prescribed in $aivite scriptures, by observing fast, or by consigning his body to Siva- fire, or by plunging into Saivite holy rivers, shall immediately be liberated.

verses.sanskrit: पशुपाशपतिज्ञानं ज्ञानमित्यभिधीयते । षडध्वशुद्धिर्विधिना गुर्वधीना क्रियोच्यते
verses.transliteration: pashupAshapatij~nAnaM j~nAnamityabhidhIyate | ShaDadhvashuddhirvidhinA gurvadhInA kriyochyate
verses.translation: Since voluntary death by means of fasts etc. is sought with a mind full of confidence and devotion, they say that this death is commendable.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमप्रयुक्तस्य मयैव विहितस्य च । ममार्चनादिधर्मस्य चर्या चर्येति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: varNAshramaprayuktasya mayaiva vihitasya cha | mamArchanAdidharmasya charyA charyeti kathyate
verses.translation: After killing a person engaged in disparaging Siva or being afflicted himself, if a devotee eschews his life, not ordinarily possible to forsake, he is not reborn.

verses.sanskrit: मदुक्तेनैव मार्गेण मय्यवस्थितचेतसः । वृत्त्यन्तरनिरोधो यो योग इत्यभिधीयते
