verses.transliteration: maduktenaiva mArgeNa mayyavasthitachetasaH | vR^ittyantaranirodho yo yoga ityabhidhIyate
verses.translation: He who dies after fighting being incapable of killing a disparager of Siva shall be liberated with the mem¬ bers of his family for twentyone generations.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधगणात् श्रेष्ठं देवि चित्तप्रसाधनम् । मुक्तिदं च तथा ह्येतद्दुष्प्राप्यं विषयैषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: ashvamedhagaNAt shreShThaM devi chittaprasAdhanam | muktidaM cha tathA hyetadduShprApyaM viShayaiShiNAm
verses.translation: No man treading the path of salvation is equal to one who eschews his life for Siva or for a devotee of §iva.

verses.sanskrit: विजितेन्द्रियवर्गस्य यमेन नियमेन च । पूर्वपापहरो योगो विरक्तस्यैव कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: vijitendriyavargasya yamena niyamena cha | pUrvapApaharo yogo viraktasyaiva kathyate
verses.translation: His descendants shall not observe post-mortem pollution. His body shall be buried under ground or burnt in fire, or cast off in Saivite holy waters or left abandoned like a log of wood or a clod of clay. Or if at all some post-mortem holy rite has to be performed let it be • some auspicious rite. The descendant shall propitiate devotees. Only a devotee

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्याज्जायते ज्ञानं ज्ञानाद्योगः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: vairAgyAjjAyate j~nAnaM j~nAnAdyogaH pravartate
verses.translation: After explaining to the sages, who honoured and exalted him, the path of knowledge that had been previously imparted by the sage Upamanyu of restrained senses to Sri Kfsna, Vayu vanished in the air at sunset.

verses.sanskrit: योगज्ञः पतितो वापि मुच्यते नात्र संशयः । दया कार्याथ सततमहिंसा ज्ञानसङ्ग्रहः
verses.transliteration: yogaj~naH patito vApi muchyate nAtra saMshayaH | dayA kAryAtha satatamahiMsA j~nAnasa~NgrahaH
verses.translation: The next day in the morning the sages of Naimifa set out to perform the holy rite of ablution at the end of their Sattra.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमस्तेयमास्तिक्यं श्रद्धा चेन्द्रियनिग्रहः । अध्यापनं चाध्ययनं यजनं याजनं तथा
verses.transliteration: satyamasteyamAstikyaM shraddhA chendriyanigrahaH | adhyApanaM chAdhyayanaM yajanaM yAjanaM tathA
verses.translation: Then at the behest of Brahma the delighted goddess Sarasvatl herself flowed as an auspicious river of sweet water.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानमीश्वरभावश्च सततं ज्ञानशीलता । य एवं वर्तते विप्रो ज्ञानयोगस्य सिद्धये
verses.transliteration: dhyAnamIshvarabhAvashcha satataM j~nAnashIlatA | ya evaM vartate vipro j~nAnayogasya siddhaye
verses.translation: On seeing her the sages were delighted in their minds. They concluded the Sattra they had begun and plunged into the river.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तव मुखोद्गीर्णं साक्षादिव पिनाकिनः । शिवज्ञानामृतं पीत्वा न मे तृप्तमभून्मनः
verses.transliteration: tasmAttava mukhodgIrNaM sAkShAdiva pinAkinaH | shivaj~nAnAmR^itaM pItvA na me tR^iptamabhUnmanaH
verses.translation: After performing the rite of Tarpana to the gods with her auspicious waters they remembered the previous events and went to Varwasl.

verses.sanskrit: अचिरादेव विज्ञानं लब्ध्वा योगं च विन्दति । दग्ध्वा देहमिमं ज्ञानी क्षणात् ज्ञानाग्निना प्रिये । प्रसादान्मम योगज्ञः कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यति
verses.transliteration: achirAdeva vij~nAnaM labdhvA yogaM cha vindati | dagdhvA dehamimaM j~nAnI kShaNAt j~nAnAgninA priye | prasAdAnmama yogaj~naH karmabandhaM prahAsyati
verses.translation: There they saw the holy river Ganga descending from the Him&layan ridges and flowing to the south. They took their bath there and went along the bank.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यःपुण्यात्मकं कर्म मुक्तेस्तत्प्रतिबन्धकम् । तस्मान्नियोगतो योगी पुण्यापुण्यं विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: puNyaHpuNyAtmakaM karma muktestatpratibandhakam | tasmAnniyogato yogI puNyApuNyaM vivarjayet
verses.translation: After reaching Varanasi they rejoiced much. They plunged into the north-flowing waters of the Ganga. They visited Avimuktesvara*®* and worshipped it. They were about to start when they saw a brilliant splendour in the sky that resembled a crore of sons. Its spreading lustre pervaded all the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: फलकामनया कर्मकरणात्प्रतिबध्यते । न कर्ममात्रकरणात्तस्मात्कर्मफलं त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: phalakAmanayA karmakaraNAtpratibadhyate | na karmamAtrakaraNAttasmAtkarmaphalaM tyajet
verses.translation: Then the Siddhas and sages who had performed Paupata rites with their bodies covered with Bhasma came there in hundreds and merged into that splendour.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं कर्मयज्ञेन बहिः सम्पूज्य मां प्रिये । ज्ञानयोगरतो भूत्वा पश्चाद्योगं समभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: prathamaM karmayaj~nena bahiH sampUjya mAM priye | j~nAnayogarato bhUtvA pashchAdyogaM samabhyaset
verses.translation: When those noble saints merged in it, the splen¬ dour suddenly vanished. It was highly mysterious.

verses.sanskrit: विदिते मम याथात्म्ये कर्मयज्ञेन देहिनः । न यजन्ति हि मां युक्ताः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनाः
verses.transliteration: vidite mama yAthAtmye karmayaj~nena dehinaH | na yajanti hi mAM yuktAH samaloShTAshmakA~nchanAH
verses.translation: On seeing that great mystery the sages from Naimi$a could not know what it was. They went to the forest Brahma vana.*®®

verses.sanskrit: नित्ययुक्तो मुनिः श्रेष्ठो मद्भक्तश्च समाहितः । ज्ञानयोगरतो योगी मम सायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: nityayukto muniH shreShTho madbhaktashcha samAhitaH | j~nAnayogarato yogI mama sAyujyamApnuyAt
verses.translation: Even before they arrived there, the wind-god, the purifier of the worlds, had mentioned to Brahma the creator of the worlds and the source of the Vedas how he visited the sages of Naimisa, what he talked to them, how they were inclined to Siva, his attendants and Siva and how they had concluded their Sattra of long duration. When permitted by Brahma, the wind-god left for his own city.

verses.sanskrit: अथाविरक्तचित्ता ये वर्णिनो मदुपाश्रिताः । ज्ञानचर्या क्रियास्वेव तेऽधिकुर्युस्तदर्हकाः
verses.transliteration: athAviraktachittA ye varNino madupAshritAH | j~nAnacharyA kriyAsveva te.adhikuryustadarhakAH
verses.translation: Brahma was comfortably seated in his abode acting as an umpire when Tumburu and Narada had their mutual rivalry in regard to their musical performance. He was taking a keen interest in their performance while Gandh- arvas and Apsaras waited onim.

verses.sanskrit: द्विधा मत्पूजनं ज्ञेयं बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं तथा । वाङ्मनःकायभेदाच्च त्रिधा मद्भजनं विदुः
verses.transliteration: dvidhA matpUjanaM j~neyaM bAhyamAbhyantaraM tathA | vA~NmanaHkAyabhedAchcha tridhA madbhajanaM viduH
verses.translation: That being inopportune time the sages were stopped at the threshold by the gate-keepers and they sat outside the palace of Brahma towards a side.

verses.sanskrit: तपः कर्म जपो ध्यानं ज्ञानं वेत्यनुपूर्वशः । पञ्चधा कथ्यते सद्भिस्तदेव भजनं पुनः
verses.transliteration: tapaH karma japo dhyAnaM j~nAnaM vetyanupUrvashaH | pa~nchadhA kathyate sadbhistadeva bhajanaM punaH
verses.translation: Narada was pronounced equal to Tumburu ■®® in musical skill. Permitted by Brahma to act in collaboration with him he eschewed mutual rivalry and quarrd and contracted friendship with Tumburu. With him and the other Gandharvas and Apsaras, be started from the palace of Brahma like the sun coming out of the clouds, in order to sing and play on his Vina before lord Nakulivara.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यात्मविदितं बाह्यमस्मदभ्यर्चनादिकम् । तदेव तु स्वसंवेद्यमाभ्यन्तरमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: anyAtmaviditaM bAhyamasmadabhyarchanAdikam | tadeva tu svasaMvedyamAbhyantaramudAhR^itam
verses.translation: On seeing Narada the sages bowed to him and asked him wh<ither that time was suitable to see the lord.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षात्सर्वजगत्कर्तुर्भर्तुरङ्कं समाश्रिता । भगवन्किन्नु पप्रच्छ भर्तारं परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: sAkShAtsarvajagatkarturbhartura~NkaM samAshritA | bhagavankinnu paprachCha bhartAraM parameshvarI
verses.translation: Not identified.

verses.sanskrit: मनोमत्प्रवणं चित्तं न मनोमात्रमुच्यते । मन्नामनिरता वाणी वाङ्मता खलु नेतरा
verses.transliteration: manomatpravaNaM chittaM na manomAtramuchyate | mannAmaniratA vANI vA~NmatA khalu netarA
verses.translation: The gatekeepers intimated to Brahma and the party entered the abode.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गैर्मच्छासनादिष्टैस्त्रिपुण्ड्रादिभिरङ्कितः । ममोपचारनिरतः कायः कायो न चेतरः
verses.transliteration: li~NgairmachChAsanAdiShTaistripuNDrAdibhira~NkitaH | mamopachAranirataH kAyaH kAyo na chetaraH
verses.translation: After entering, the party prostrated to the lord from distance. Or being permitted by Brahma, the party stood there respectfully.

verses.sanskrit: मदर्चा कर्म विज्ञेयं बाह्ये यागादिनोच्यते । मदर्थे देहसंशोषस्तपः कृच्छ्रादि नो मतम्
verses.transliteration: madarchA karma vij~neyaM bAhye yAgAdinochyate | madarthe dehasaMshoShastapaH kR^ichChrAdi no matam
verses.translation: On hearing what was mentioned by the sages the four-faced creator of the universe shook his head and spoke in a majestic tone — -'A great Siddhi in the next world awaits you all."

verses.sanskrit: जपः पञ्चाक्षराभ्यासः प्रणवाभ्यास एव च । रुद्राध्यायादिकाभ्यासो न वेदाध्ययनादिकम्
verses.transliteration: japaH pa~nchAkSharAbhyAsaH praNavAbhyAsa eva cha | rudrAdhyAyAdikAbhyAso na vedAdhyayanAdikam
verses.translation: The lord has been propitiated by you through the protracted Sattra. The fact that the lord is delighted has been indicated.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं मद्रूपचिन्ताद्यं नात्माद्यर्थसमाधयः । ममागमार्थविज्ञानं ज्ञानं नान्यार्थवेदनम्
verses.transliteration: dhyAnaM madrUpachintAdyaM nAtmAdyarthasamAdhayaH | mamAgamArthavij~nAnaM j~nAnaM nAnyArthavedanam
verses.translation: The refulgence in the air seen by you in Varanasi is the splendour of Mahesvara Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्ये वाभ्यन्तरे वाथ यत्र स्यान्मनसो रतिः । प्राग्वासनावशाद्देवि तत्त्वनिष्ठां समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: bAhye vAbhyantare vAtha yatra syAnmanaso ratiH | prAgvAsanAvashAddevi tattvaniShThAM samAcharet
verses.translation: The sages who were merged therein are those who had performed the Pasupata rites in accordance with the Vcdic injunctions. They have become liberated. Their sins have been washed in view of their stable piety.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यादाभ्यन्तरं श्रेष्ठं भवेच्छतगुणाधिकम् । असङ्करत्वाद्दोषाणां दृष्टानामप्यसम्भवात्
verses.transliteration: bAhyAdAbhyantaraM shreShThaM bhavechChataguNAdhikam | asa~NkaratvAddoShANAM dR^iShTAnAmapyasambhavAt
verses.translation: Just as they achieved salvation by means of Pasupata rite, so also, ere long, you too will achieve liberation. This fact is indicated by the splendour seen by you.

verses.sanskrit: शौचमाभ्यन्तरं विद्यान्न बाह्यं शौचमुच्यते । अन्तः शौचविमुक्तात्मा शुचिरप्यशुचिर्यतः
verses.transliteration: shauchamAbhyantaraM vidyAnna bAhyaM shauchamuchyate | antaH shauchavimuktAtmA shuchirapyashuchiryataH
verses.translation: Fortunately your time has come up now. You go to the southern summit ofMeru resorted to by the gods.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यमाभ्यंर्तरं चैव भजनं भवपूर्वकम् । न भावरहितं देवि विप्रलम्भैककारणम्
verses.transliteration: bAhyamAbhyaMrtaraM chaiva bhajanaM bhavapUrvakam | na bhAvarahitaM devi vipralambhaikakAraNam
verses.translation: Formerly, on seeing Lord liva, Sanatkumara did not pay homage due to his ignorance or arrogance of being a Yogin or carelessness or lack of humility. Due.to this offence Nandin was infuriated and he made him a camel.

verses.sanskrit: कृतकृत्यस्य पूतस्य मम किं क्रियते नरैः । बहिर्वाभ्यन्तरं वाथ मया भावो हि गृह्यते
verses.transliteration: kR^itakR^ityasya pUtasya mama kiM kriyate naraiH | bahirvAbhyantaraM vAtha mayA bhAvo hi gR^ihyate
verses.translation: I bewailed this for a long time. I worshipped the lord and the goddess and craved forgiveness. With great difficulty I atoned for his wickedness. Sanatkumara was restored to his previous form.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । स्थाने पृष्टं त्वया कृष्ण तद्वक्ष्यामि यथातथम् । भवभक्तस्य युक्तस्य तव कल्याणचेतसः
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | sthAne pR^iShTaM tvayA kR^iShNa tadvakShyAmi yathAtatham | bhavabhaktasya yuktasya tava kalyANachetasaH
verses.translation: Lord iSiva smiled and spoke to the chief of Ganas. This sage was arrogant and he insulted me. Hence O sinless one, explain my true nature to him. The eldest son of Brahma who took me for a fool is given to you as your disciple. He will be the protagonist of my knowledge. He will perform your coronation as the presiding deity of virtue.

verses.sanskrit: भावैकात्मा क्रिया देवि मम धर्मः सनातनः । मनसा कर्मणा वाचा ह्यनपेक्ष्य फलं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: bhAvaikAtmA kriyA devi mama dharmaH sanAtanaH | manasA karmaNA vAchA hyanapekShya phalaM kvachit
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the leader of the Bhutas was plea¬ sed to accept the behest.

verses.sanskrit: फलोद्देशेन देवेशि लघुर्मम समाश्रयः । फलार्थी तदभावे मां परित्यक्तुं क्षमो यतः
verses.transliteration: phaloddeshena deveshi laghurmama samAshrayaH | phalArthI tadabhAve mAM parityaktuM kShamo yataH
verses.translation: He shall be seen by you all before the lord of the Ganas meets him. Ere long, Nandin will come there to delight him.

verses.sanskrit: फलार्थिनोऽपि यस्यैव मयि चित्तं प्रतिष्ठितम् । भावानुरूपफलदस्तस्याप्यहमनिन्दिते
verses.transliteration: phalArthino.api yasyaiva mayi chittaM pratiShThitam | bhAvAnurUpaphaladastasyApyahamanindite
verses.translation: After bidding thus the Vivayogin sent the sages to Kumarasikhara,*®' the southern peak of Meru.

verses.sanskrit: फलानपेक्षया येषां मनो मत्प्रवणं भवेत् । प्रार्थयेयुः फलं पश्चाद्भक्तास्तेऽपि मम प्रियाः
verses.transliteration: phalAnapekShayA yeShAM mano matpravaNaM bhavet | prArthayeyuH phalaM pashchAdbhaktAste.api mama priyAH
verses.translation: Ciystal slabs are neatly,fbted all around. The place abounds in blooming flowers in tiie seasons throughout.

verses.sanskrit: प्राक् संस्कारवशादेव ये विचिन्त्य फलाफले । विवशा मां प्रपद्यन्ते मम प्रियतमा मताः
verses.transliteration: prAk saMskAravashAdeva ye vichintya phalAphale | vivashA mAM prapadyante mama priyatamA matAH
verses.translation: Not identified According to the context this hill can be placed to the south of mount Meru.

verses.sanskrit: मल्लाभान्न परो लाभस्तेषामस्ति यथातथम् । ममापि लाभस्तल्लाभान्नापरः परमेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: mallAbhAnna paro lAbhasteShAmasti yathAtatham | mamApi lAbhastallAbhAnnAparaH parameshvari
verses.translation: Not identified

verses.sanskrit: मदनुग्रहतस्तेषां भावो मयि समर्पितः । फलं परमनिर्वाणं प्रयच्छति बलादिव
verses.transliteration: madanugrahatasteShAM bhAvo mayi samarpitaH | phalaM paramanirvANaM prayachChati balAdiva
verses.translation: Lilies, lotuses and other aquatic plants resemble the Stan. The waves are like clouds. The sky itself appears to have come to the earth.

verses.sanskrit: महात्मनामनन्यानां मयि संन्यस्तचेतसाम् । अष्टधा लक्षणं प्राहुर्मम धर्माधिकारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: mahAtmanAmananyAnAM mayi sa.nnyastachetasAm | aShTadhA lakShaNaM prAhurmama dharmAdhikAriNAm
verses.translation: The steps that lead to it consist of blue stones and arc beautiful. People can ascend and descend comfortably. Through these the lake brightens all the eight quarters.

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तजनवात्सल्यं पूजायां चानुमोदनम् । स्वयमभ्यर्चनं चैव मदर्थे चाङ्गचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: madbhaktajanavAtsalyaM pUjAyAM chAnumodanam | svayamabhyarchanaM chaiva madarthe chA~NgacheShTitam
verses.translation: Some stand on rocks submerged in water as if avoiding, contact with the low-born people. They observe good conduct and their bodies are grey with Bhasma. They plunge into the water here and there. On the rock are seen the remnants of worship — gingelly seeds, raw rice-grains, flowers, Darbhas, Pavitras These indicate that the brahmins who come here for bath perform worship and Tarpanas to the gods, sages and the manes.

verses.sanskrit: मत्कथाश्रवणे भक्तिः स्वरनेत्राङ्गविक्रियाः । ममानुस्मरणं नित्यं यश्च मामुपजीवति
verses.transliteration: matkathAshravaNe bhaktiH svaranetrA~NgavikriyAH | mamAnusmaraNaM nityaM yashcha mAmupajIvati
verses.translation: At places people perform worship on dry banks after performing Arghya to the sun as indicated by the scattered oblations and flowers. At places leaders of elephant herds are merging in and emerging out of water. At places the deer, the hind and die horses have come to quench thirst. At places peacocks and elephants are drinking water. At places oxen and hostile bulls are butting against the banks.

verses.sanskrit: महीधरवरे दिव्ये मन्दरे चारुकन्दरे । देव्या सह महादेवो दिव्यो ध्यानगतोऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: mahIdharavare divye mandare chArukandare | devyA saha mahAdevo divyo dhyAnagato.abhavat
verses.translation: In some places the sound of the Karaidava is heard. In some places there is the chirping sound of the Sarasa. In some places the ruddy goose. cackles. In some places the bees hum. The lake appears to be holding a loving conversation perpetually with the birds and animals living on the trees and taking bath therein or drinking its water. Through the cooing sound of the cuckoos lying hid¬ den on the trees on its banks it appears to invite all those who are oppressed by the sun.

verses.sanskrit: एवमष्टविधं चिह्नं यस्मिन् म्लेच्छेऽपि वर्तते । स विप्रेन्द्रो मुनिः श्रीमान् स यतिः स च पण्डितः
verses.transliteration: evamaShTavidhaM chihnaM yasmin mlechChe.api vartate | sa viprendro muniH shrImAn sa yatiH sa cha paNDitaH
verses.translation: On the northern bank of the lake under the Kalpa tree, on a platform of adamantine rock, the sages from Naimia saw Sanatkumara seated on a soft deer-skin. He had just woken up from his trance. He was being worship¬ ped by the sages and the leading Yogins. On seeing him they bowed to him and stood in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: न मे प्रियश्चतुर्वेदी मद्भक्तो श्वपचोऽपि यः । तस्मै देयं ततो ग्राह्यं स च पूज्यो यथा ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration: na me priyashchaturvedI madbhakto shvapacho.api yaH | tasmai deyaM tato grAhyaM sa cha pUjyo yathA hyaham
verses.translation: On being asked they told him the purpose of their visit. The tumultuous sound of Dundubhi was heard in the heaven immediately.

verses.sanskrit: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति । तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: patraM puShpaM phalaM toyaM yo me bhaktyA prayachChati | tasyAhaM na praNashyAmi sa cha me na praNashyati
verses.translation: At the same time an aerial chariot brilliant as the sun was visible. All round, it was surrounded by leading Ganas, numerous and countless. It was thronged by the celestial damsels and surrounded by Rudra girls. Sounds of Mfdahga, lute and flute were heard. It had canopies set with gems of various colours. It shone with strings of pearls. It was encircled by sages, Siddhas, Gandharvas, Yakas, Caranas, Kinnaras dancing, or playing on instruments. A banner marked by the sign of a heroic bull was fluttering from a post set with corals. The aerial chariot had a gabled front.

verses.sanskrit: तदा देव्याः प्रियसखी सुस्मितास्या शुभावती । फुल्लान्यतिमनोज्ञानि पुष्पाणि समुदाहरत्
verses.transliteration: tadA devyAH priyasakhI susmitAsyA shubhAvatI | phullAnyatimanoj~nAni puShpANi samudAharat
verses.translation: In the middle of the aerial chariot the son of Brahma accompanied by the sages saw the son of Silada seated in a divine throne with Suyaa, brilliant as the goddess Lakml. On either side there was a chowrie. He sat under a royal umbrella with a gemset handle, resembling the pure mooiK He had three eyes. Even by his gestures he remin¬ ded one of the lord. He appeared like the untransgressable behest of the creator. He was one who blessed all. He stood directly in front of Siva. He held an excellent trident. As the commander of the Ganas he looked like another Visve- vara. He could curb and bless the rulers of the universe. He had four arms, a splendid body embellished with the digit of the moon. A serpent adorned his neck and the moon his head. He was the embodied form of Aivarya. He appeared like active cflSciency. It seemed that the very salvation or the omniscient lord had come there. On seeing him the son of Brahina was highly delighted. He stood up with palms joined in reverence. He seemed to dedicate himself to him.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वमङ्कमारोप्य देवीं देववरोहरः । अलङ्कृत्य च तैः पुष्पैरास्ते हृष्टतरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tataH svama~NkamAropya devIM devavaroharaH | ala~NkR^itya cha taiH puShpairAste hR^iShTataraH svayam
verses.translation: In the meantime when the aerial chariot reached

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: You and I have helped each other through this path. I have realised my desire. I shall go now. Let everything be auspicious to you always.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: You and I have helped each other through this path. I have realised my desire. I shall go now. Let everything be auspicious to you always.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.११. एकादशोऽध्यायः । शिवज्ञानवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । अथ वक्ष्यामि देवेशि भक्तानामधिकारिणाम् । विदुषां द्विजमुख्यानां वर्णधर्मसमासतः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.11\. ekAdasho.adhyAyaH | shivaj~nAnavarNanam | Ishvara uvAcha | atha vakShyAmi deveshi bhaktAnAmadhikAriNAm | viduShAM dvijamukhyAnAM varNadharmasamAsataH
verses.translation: Then Suta blessed them and left. The righteous sages fixed their abode permanently at the outskirts of Varanasi after performing the sattra at Prayaga when they perceived that everything was being defiled by the advent of the Kali age.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसङ्गनिवृत्तिश्च दशैतानि विशेषतः । लिङ्गानि योगिनां भूयो दिवा भिक्षाशनं तथा
verses.transliteration: sarvasa~NganivR^ittishcha dashaitAni visheShataH | li~NgAni yoginAM bhUyo divA bhikShAshanaM tathA
verses.translation: Then the sages performed the Pasupata rites with the. desire to get released from the bondage. They attained enlightenment. They learnt modes of Samadhi and achieved the greatest Bliss.

verses.sanskrit: वानप्रस्थाश्रमस्थानां समानमिदमिष्यते । रात्रौ न भोजनं कार्यं सर्वेषां ब्रह्मचारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: vAnaprasthAshramasthAnAM samAnamidamiShyate | rAtrau na bhojanaM kAryaM sarveShAM brahmachAriNAm
verses.translation: It shall not be mentioned to an atheist nor to one lacking in faith nor to a stubborn rogue nor to one who is not a devotee of Siva nor to a religious hypocrite.

verses.sanskrit: अध्यापनं याजनं च क्षत्रियस्याप्रतिग्रहः । वैश्यस्य च विशेषेण मया नात्र विधीयते
verses.transliteration: adhyApanaM yAjanaM cha kShatriyasyApratigrahaH | vaishyasya cha visheSheNa mayA nAtra vidhIyate
verses.translation: On hearing this once, the sins are reduced to ashes. A non-devotee attains devotion and a devotee attains more devotion.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षणं सर्ववर्णानां युद्धे शत्रुवधस्तथा । दुष्टपक्षिमृगाणां च दुष्टानां शातनं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: rakShaNaM sarvavarNAnAM yuddhe shatruvadhastathA | duShTapakShimR^igANAM cha duShTAnAM shAtanaM nR^iNAm
verses.translation: If one aims at some big benefit one shall read or hear this Purana hve times with a pious mind. He is sure to achieve the desired result.

verses.sanskrit: अविश्वासश्च सर्वत्र विश्वासो मम योगिषु । स्त्रीसंसर्गश्च कालेषु चमूरक्षणमेव च
verses.transliteration: avishvAsashcha sarvatra vishvAso mama yogiShu | strIsaMsargashcha kAleShu chamUrakShaNameva cha
verses.translation: K?atriyas of yore, excellent brahmins and Vaisyas repeated it seven times and attained the vision of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सदा सञ्चारितैश्चारैर्लोकवृत्तान्तवेदनम् । सदास्त्रधारणं चैव भस्मकञ्चुकधारणम्
verses.transliteration: sadA sa~nchAritaishchArairlokavR^ittAntavedanam | sadAstradhAraNaM chaiva bhasmaka~nchukadhAraNam
verses.translation: If a man with devotion hears it, he enjoys all pleasures here and secures liberation hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञां ममाश्रमस्थानामेष धर्मस्य सङ्ग्रहः । गोरक्षणं च वाणिज्यं कृषिर्वैश्यस्य कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: rAj~nAM mamAshramasthAnAmeSha dharmasya sa~NgrahaH | gorakShaNaM cha vANijyaM kR^iShirvaishyasya kathyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रूषेतरवर्णानां धर्मः शूद्रस्य कथ्यते । उद्यानकरणं चैव मम क्षेत्रसमाश्रयः
verses.transliteration: shushrUShetaravarNAnAM dharmaH shUdrasya kathyate | udyAnakaraNaM chaiva mama kShetrasamAshrayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मपत्न्यास्तु गमनं गृहस्थस्य विधीयते । ब्रह्मचर्यं वनस्थानां यतीनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: dharmapatnyAstu gamanaM gR^ihasthasya vidhIyate | brahmacharyaM vanasthAnAM yatInAM brahmachAriNAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीणां तु भर्तृशुश्रूषा धर्मो नान्यः सनातनः । ममार्चनं च कल्याणि नियोगो भर्तुरस्ति चेत्
verses.transliteration: strINAM tu bhartR^ishushrUShA dharmo nAnyaH sanAtanaH | mamArchanaM cha kalyANi niyogo bharturasti chet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिःस्नानं चाग्निकार्यं च लिङ्गार्चनमनुक्रमम् । दानमीश्वरभावश्च दया सर्वत्र सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: triHsnAnaM chAgnikAryaM cha li~NgArchanamanukramam | dAnamIshvarabhAvashcha dayA sarvatra sarvadA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: या नारी भर्तृशुश्रूषां विहाय व्रततत्परा । सा नारी नरकं याति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: yA nArI bhartR^ishushrUShAM vihAya vratatatparA | sA nArI narakaM yAti nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ भर्तृविहीनाया वक्ष्ये धर्मं सनातनम् । व्रतं दानं तपः शौचं भूशय्यानक्तभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: atha bhartR^ivihInAyA vakShye dharmaM sanAtanam | vrataM dAnaM tapaH shauchaM bhUshayyAnaktabhojanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यं सदा स्नानं भस्मना सलिलेन वा । शान्तिर्मौनं क्षमा नित्यं संविभागो यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: brahmacharyaM sadA snAnaM bhasmanA salilena vA | shAntirmaunaM kShamA nityaM saMvibhAgo yathAvidhi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाभ्यां च चतुर्दश्यां पौर्णमास्यां विशेषतः । एकादश्यां च विधिवदुपवासो ममार्चनम्
verses.transliteration: aShTAbhyAM cha chaturdashyAM paurNamAsyAM visheShataH | ekAdashyAM cha vidhivadupavAso mamArchanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इति सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तो मयाश्रमनिषेविणाम् । ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां देवि यतीनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: iti sa~NkShepataH prokto mayAshramaniSheviNAm | brahmakShatravishAM devi yatInAM brahmachAriNAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव वानप्रस्थानां गृहस्थानां च सुन्दरि । शूद्राणामथ नारीणां धर्म एष सनातनः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva vAnaprasthAnAM gR^ihasthAnAM cha sundari | shUdrANAmatha nArINAM dharma eSha sanAtanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ध्येयस्त्वयाऽहं देवेशि सदा जाप्यः षडक्षरः । वेदोक्तमखिलं धर्ममिति धर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहः
verses.transliteration: dhyeyastvayA.ahaM deveshi sadA jApyaH ShaDakSharaH | vedoktamakhilaM dharmamiti dharmArthasa~NgrahaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ये मानवा लोके स्वेच्छया धृतविग्रहाः । भावातिशयसम्पन्नाः पूर्वसंस्कारसंयुताः
verses.transliteration: atha ye mAnavA loke svechChayA dhR^itavigrahAH | bhAvAtishayasampannAH pUrvasaMskArasaMyutAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विरक्ता वानुरक्ता वा स्त्र्यादीनां विषयेष्वपि । पापैर्न ते विलिम्पन्ते पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा
verses.transliteration: viraktA vAnuraktA vA stryAdInAM viShayeShvapi | pApairna te vilimpante padmapatramivAmbhasA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां ममात्मविज्ञानं विशुद्धानां विवेकिनाम् । मत्प्रसादाद्विशुद्धानां दुःखमाश्रमरक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: teShAM mamAtmavij~nAnaM vishuddhAnAM vivekinAm | matprasAdAdvishuddhAnAM duHkhamAshramarakShaNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं सन्तोषमास्तिक्यमहिंसा सर्वजन्तुषु । ह्रीःश्रद्धाध्ययनं योगः सदाध्यापनमेव च
verses.transliteration: satyaM santoShamAstikyamahiMsA sarvajantuShu | hrIHshraddhAdhyayanaM yogaH sadAdhyApanameva cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति कृत्यमकृत्यं च समाधिर्वा परायणम् । न विधिर्न निषेधश्च तेषां मम यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: nAsti kR^ityamakR^ityaM cha samAdhirvA parAyaNam | na vidhirna niShedhashcha teShAM mama yathA tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथेह परिपूर्णस्य साध्यं मम न विद्यते । तथैव कृतकृत्यानां तेषामपि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatheha paripUrNasya sAdhyaM mama na vidyate | tathaiva kR^itakR^ityAnAM teShAmapi na saMshayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तानां हितार्थाय मानुषं भावमाश्रिताः । रुद्रलोकात्परिभ्रष्टास्ते रुद्रा नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: madbhaktAnAM hitArthAya mAnuShaM bhAvamAshritAH | rudralokAtparibhraShTAste rudrA nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ममानुशासनं यद्वद् ब्रह्मादीनां प्रवर्तकम् । तथा नराणामन्येषां तन्नियोगः प्रवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: mamAnushAsanaM yadvad brahmAdInAM pravartakam | tathA narANAmanyeShAM tanniyogaH pravartakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ममाज्ञाधारभावेन सद्भावातिशयेन च । मदालोकनमात्रेण सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mamAj~nAdhArabhAvena sadbhAvAtishayena cha | madAlokanamAtreNa sarvapApakShayo bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्ययाश्च प्रवर्तन्ते प्रशस्तफलसूचकाः । मयि भाववतां पुंसां प्रागदृष्टार्थगोचराः
verses.transliteration: pratyayAshcha pravartante prashastaphalasUchakAH | mayi bhAvavatAM puMsAM prAgadR^iShTArthagocharAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कम्पस्वेदोऽश्रुपातश्च कण्ठे च स्वरविक्रिया । आनन्दाद्युपलब्धिश्च भवेदाकस्मिकी मुहुः
verses.transliteration: kampasvedo.ashrupAtashcha kaNThe cha svaravikriyA | AnandAdyupalabdhishcha bhavedAkasmikI muhuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स तैर्व्यस्तैः समस्तैर्वा लिङ्गैरव्यभिचारिभिः । मन्दमध्योत्तमैर्भावैर्विज्ञेयास्ते नरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sa tairvyastaiH samastairvA li~NgairavyabhichAribhiH | mandamadhyottamairbhAvairvij~neyAste narottamAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथायोऽग्निसमावेशान्नायो भवति केवलम् । तथैव मम सान्निध्यान्न ते केवलमानुषाः
verses.transliteration: yathAyo.agnisamAveshAnnAyo bhavati kevalam | tathaiva mama sAnnidhyAnna te kevalamAnuShAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तपादादिसाधर्म्याद् रुद्रान् मर्त्यवपुर्धरान् । प्राकृतानिव मन्वानो नावजानीत पण्डितः
verses.transliteration: hastapAdAdisAdharmyAd rudrAn martyavapurdharAn | prAkR^itAniva manvAno nAvajAnIta paNDitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: व्याख्यानं ब्रह्मचर्यं च श्रवणं च तपः क्षमा । शौचं शिखोपवीतं च उष्णीषं चोत्तरीयकम्
verses.transliteration: vyAkhyAnaM brahmacharyaM cha shravaNaM cha tapaH kShamA | shauchaM shikhopavItaM cha uShNIShaM chottarIyakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अवज्ञानं कृतं तेषु नरैर्व्यामूढचेतनैः । आयुः श्रियं कुलं शीलं हित्वा निरयमावहेत्
verses.transliteration: avaj~nAnaM kR^itaM teShu narairvyAmUDhachetanaiH | AyuH shriyaM kulaM shIlaM hitvA nirayamAvahet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुसुरेशानामपि तूलायते पदम् । मत्तोऽन्यदनपेक्षाणामुद्धृतानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaviShNusureshAnAmapi tUlAyate padam | matto.anyadanapekShANAmuddhR^itAnAM mahAtmanAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अशुद्धं बौद्धमैश्वर्यं प्राकृतं पौरुषं तथा । गुणेशानामतस्त्याज्यं गुणातीतपदैषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: ashuddhaM bauddhamaishvaryaM prAkR^itaM pauruShaM tathA | guNeshAnAmatastyAjyaM guNAtItapadaiShiNAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ किं बहुनोक्तेन श्रेयः प्राप्त्यैकसाधनम् । मयि चित्तसमासङ्गो येन केनापि हेतुना
verses.transliteration: atha kiM bahunoktena shreyaH prAptyaikasAdhanam | mayi chittasamAsa~Ngo yena kenApi hetunA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । इत्थं श्रीकण्ठनाथेन शिवेन परमात्मना । हिताय जगतामुक्तो ज्ञानसारार्थसङ्ग्रहः
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | itthaM shrIkaNThanAthena shivena paramAtmanA | hitAya jagatAmukto j~nAnasArArthasa~NgrahaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञानसङ्ग्रहस्यास्य वेदशास्त्राणि कृत्स्नशः । सेतिहासपुराणानि विद्या व्याख्यानविस्तरः
verses.transliteration: vij~nAnasa~NgrahasyAsya vedashAstrANi kR^itsnashaH | setihAsapurANAni vidyA vyAkhyAnavistaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयमनुष्ठेयमधिकारोऽथ साधनम् । साध्यं चेति षडर्थानां सङ्ग्रहत्वेष सङ्ग्रहः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnaM j~neyamanuShTheyamadhikAro.atha sAdhanam | sAdhyaM cheti ShaDarthAnAM sa~NgrahatveSha sa~NgrahaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोरधिकृतं ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं पाशः पशुः पतिः । लिङ्गार्चनाद्यनुष्ठेयं भक्तस्त्वधिकृतोऽपि यः
verses.transliteration: guroradhikR^itaM j~nAnaM j~neyaM pAshaH pashuH patiH | li~NgArchanAdyanuShTheyaM bhaktastvadhikR^ito.api yaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: साधनं शिवमन्त्राद्यं साध्यं शिवसमानता । षडर्थसङ्ग्रहस्यास्य ज्ञानात्सर्वज्ञतोच्यते
verses.transliteration: sAdhanaM shivamantrAdyaM sAdhyaM shivasamAnatA | ShaDarthasa~NgrahasyAsya j~nAnAtsarvaj~natochyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं कर्मयज्ञादेर्भक्त्या वित्तानुसारतः । बाह्येऽभ्यर्च्य शिवं पश्चादन्तर्यागरतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: prathamaM karmayaj~nAderbhaktyA vittAnusArataH | bAhye.abhyarchya shivaM pashchAdantaryAgarato bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निषिद्धासेवनं चैव भस्मरुद्राक्षधारणम् । पर्वण्यभ्यर्चनं देवि चतुर्दश्यां विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: niShiddhAsevanaM chaiva bhasmarudrAkShadhAraNam | parvaNyabhyarchanaM devi chaturdashyAM visheShataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रतिरभ्यन्तरे यस्य न बाह्ये पुण्यगौरवात् । न कर्म करणीयं हि बहिस्तस्य महात्मना
verses.transliteration: ratirabhyantare yasya na bAhye puNyagauravAt | na karma karaNIyaM hi bahistasya mahAtmanA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानामृतेन तृप्तस्य भक्त्या शैवशिवात्मनः । नान्तर्न च बहिः कृष्ण कृत्यमस्ति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: j~nAnAmR^itena tR^iptasya bhaktyA shaivashivAtmanaH | nAntarna cha bahiH kR^iShNa kR^ityamasti kadAchana
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् क्रमेण सन्त्यज्य बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं तथा । ज्ञानेन ज्ञेयमालोक्य ज्ञानं चापि परित्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAt krameNa santyajya bAhyamAbhyantaraM tathA | j~nAnena j~neyamAlokya j~nAnaM chApi parityajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नैकाग्रं चेच्छिवे चित्तं किं कृतेनापि कर्मणा । एकाग्रमेव चेच्चित्तं किं कृतेनापि कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: naikAgraM chechChive chittaM kiM kR^itenApi karmaNA | ekAgrameva chechchittaM kiM kR^itenApi karmaNA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्कर्माण्यकृत्वा वा कृत्वा वान्तर्बहिःक्रमात् । येन केनाप्युपायेन शिवे चित्तं निवेशयेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAtkarmANyakR^itvA vA kR^itvA vAntarbahiHkramAt | yena kenApyupAyena shive chittaM niveshayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवे निविष्टचित्तानां प्रतिष्ठितधियां सताम् । परत्रेह च सर्वत्र निर्वृतिः परमा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: shive niviShTachittAnAM pratiShThitadhiyAM satAm | paratreha cha sarvatra nirvR^itiH paramA bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इहोन्नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रेणानेन सिद्धयः । स तस्मादधिगन्तव्यः परावरविभूतये
verses.transliteration: ihonnamaH shivAyeti mantreNAnena siddhayaH | sa tasmAdadhigantavyaH parAvaravibhUtaye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पानं च ब्रह्मकूर्चस्य मासि मासि यथाविधि । अभ्यर्चनं विशेषेण तेनैव स्नाप्य मां प्रिये
verses.transliteration: pAnaM cha brahmakUrchasya mAsi mAsi yathAvidhi | abhyarchanaM visheSheNa tenaiva snApya mAM priye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वक्रियान्नसन्त्यागः श्राद्धान्नस्य च वर्जनम् । तथा पर्युषितान्नस्य यावकस्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sarvakriyAnnasantyAgaH shrAddhAnnasya cha varjanam | tathA paryuShitAnnasya yAvakasya visheShataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मद्यस्य मद्यगन्धस्य नैवेद्यस्य च वर्जनम् । सामान्यं सर्ववर्णानां ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: madyasya madyagandhasya naivedyasya cha varjanam | sAmAnyaM sarvavarNAnAM brAhmaNAnAM visheShataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्षमा शान्तिश्च सन्तोषः सत्यमस्तेयमेव च । ब्रह्मचर्यं मम ज्ञानं वैराग्यं भस्मसेवनम्
verses.transliteration: kShamA shAntishcha santoShaH satyamasteyameva cha | brahmacharyaM mama j~nAnaM vairAgyaM bhasmasevanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१२. द्वादशोऽध्यायः । पञ्चाक्षरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । महर्षिवर सर्वज्ञ सर्वज्ञानमहोदधे । पञ्चाक्षरस्य माहात्म्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.12\. dvAdasho.adhyAyaH | pa~nchAkSharamAhAtmyavarNanam | shrIkR^iShNa uvAcha | maharShivara sarvaj~na sarvaj~nAnamahodadhe | pa~nchAkSharasya mAhAtmyaM shrotumichChAmi tattvataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वाच्यवाचकभावेन स्थितः साक्षात्स्वभावतः । वाच्यः शिवोऽप्रमेयत्वात् मन्त्रस्तद्वाचकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: vAchyavAchakabhAvena sthitaH sAkShAtsvabhAvataH | vAchyaH shivo.aprameyatvAt mantrastadvAchakaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वाच्यवाचकभावोऽयमनादिः संस्थितस्तयोः । यथानादिप्रवृत्तोऽयं घोरसंसारसागरः
verses.transliteration: vAchyavAchakabhAvo.ayamanAdiH saMsthitastayoH | yathAnAdipravR^itto.ayaM ghorasaMsArasAgaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवोऽपि हि तथानादिः संसारान्मोचकः स्थितः । व्याधीनां भेषजं यद्वत्प्रतिपक्षः स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: shivo.api hi tathAnAdiH saMsArAnmochakaH sthitaH | vyAdhInAM bheShajaM yadvatpratipakShaH svabhAvataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वत्संसारदोषाणां प्रतिपक्षः शिवः स्मृतः । असत्यस्मिन् जगन्नाथे तमोभूतमिदं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tadvatsaMsAradoShANAM pratipakShaH shivaH smR^itaH | asatyasmin jagannAthe tamobhUtamidaM bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अचेतनत्वात्प्रकृतेरज्ञत्वात्पुरषस्य च । प्रधानपरमाण्वादि यावत्किञ्चिदचेतनम्
verses.transliteration: achetanatvAtprakR^iteraj~natvAtpuraShasya cha | pradhAnaparamANvAdi yAvatki~nchidachetanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्कर्तृ स्वयं दृष्टं बुद्धिमत्कारणं विना । धर्माधर्मोपदेशश्च बन्धमोक्षौ विचारणात्
verses.transliteration: na tatkartR^i svayaM dR^iShTaM buddhimatkAraNaM vinA | dharmAdharmopadeshashcha bandhamokShau vichAraNAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न सर्वज्ञं विना पुंसामादिसर्गः प्रसिद्ध्यति । वैद्यं विना निरानन्दाः क्लिश्यन्ते रोगिणो यथा
verses.transliteration: na sarvaj~naM vinA puMsAmAdisargaH prasiddhyati | vaidyaM vinA nirAnandAH klishyante rogiNo yathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनादिः सर्वज्ञः परिपूर्णः सदाशिवः । अस्ति नाथः परित्राता पुंसां संसारसागरात्
verses.transliteration: tasmAdanAdiH sarvaj~naH paripUrNaH sadAshivaH | asti nAthaH paritrAtA puMsAM saMsArasAgarAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आदिमध्यान्तनिर्मुक्तः स्वभावविमलः प्रभुः । सर्वज्ञः परिपूर्णश्च शिवो ज्ञेयः शिवागमे
verses.transliteration: AdimadhyAntanirmuktaH svabhAvavimalaH prabhuH | sarvaj~naH paripUrNashcha shivo j~neyaH shivAgame
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याभिधानमन्त्रोऽयमभिधेयश्च स स्मृतः । अभिधानाभिधेयत्वात् मन्त्रः सिद्धः परः शिवः
verses.transliteration: tasyAbhidhAnamantro.ayamabhidheyashcha sa smR^itaH | abhidhAnAbhidheyatvAt mantraH siddhaH paraH shivaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । पञ्चाक्षरस्य माहात्म्यं वर्षकोटिशतैरपि । अशक्यं विस्तराद्वक्तुं तस्मात्सङ्क्षेपतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | pa~nchAkSharasya mAhAtmyaM varShakoTishatairapi | ashakyaM vistarAdvaktuM tasmAtsa~NkShepataH shR^iNu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एतावत्तु शिवज्ञानमेतावत्परमं पदम् । यदोन्नमः शिवायेति शिववाक्यं षडक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: etAvattu shivaj~nAnametAvatparamaM padam | yadonnamaH shivAyeti shivavAkyaM ShaDakSharam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विधिवाक्यमिदं शैवं नार्थवादं शिवात्मकम् । यः सर्वज्ञः सुसम्पूर्णः स्वभावविमलः शिवः
verses.transliteration: vidhivAkyamidaM shaivaM nArthavAdaM shivAtmakam | yaH sarvaj~naH susampUrNaH svabhAvavimalaH shivaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लोकानुग्रहकर्त्ता च स मृषार्थं कथं वदेत् । यद्यथावस्थितं वस्तु गुणदोषैः स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: lokAnugrahakarttA cha sa mR^iShArthaM kathaM vadet | yadyathAvasthitaM vastu guNadoShaiH svabhAvataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्फलं च तत्पूर्णं सर्वज्ञस्तु यथा वदेत् । रागाज्ञानादिभिर्दोषैर्ग्रस्तत्वादनृतं वदेत्
verses.transliteration: yAvatphalaM cha tatpUrNaM sarvaj~nastu yathA vadet | rAgAj~nAnAdibhirdoShairgrastatvAdanR^itaM vadet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ते चेश्वरे न विद्येते ब्रूयात्स कथमन्यथा । अज्ञाताशेषदोषेण सर्वज्ञेय शिवेन यत् । प्रणीतममलं वाक्यं तत्प्रमाणं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: te cheshvare na vidyete brUyAtsa kathamanyathA | aj~nAtAsheShadoSheNa sarvaj~neya shivena yat | praNItamamalaM vAkyaM tatpramANaM na saMshayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादीश्वरवाक्यानि श्रद्धेयानि विपश्चिता । यथार्थपुण्यपापेषु तदश्रद्धो व्रजत्यधः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdIshvaravAkyAni shraddheyAni vipashchitA | yathArthapuNyapApeShu tadashraddho vrajatyadhaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गापवर्गसिद्ध्यर्थं भाषितं यत्सुशोभनम् । वाक्यं मुनिवरैः शान्तैस्तद्विज्ञेयं सुभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: svargApavargasiddhyarthaM bhAShitaM yatsushobhanam | vAkyaM munivaraiH shAntaistadvij~neyaM subhAShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रागद्वेषानृतक्रोधकामतृष्णानुसारि यत् । वाक्यं निरयहेतुत्वात्तद्दुर्भाषितमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: rAgadveShAnR^itakrodhakAmatR^iShNAnusAri yat | vAkyaM nirayahetutvAttaddurbhAShitamuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: संस्कृतेनाऽपि किं तेन मृदुना ललितेन वा । अविद्यारागवाक्येन संसारक्लेशहेतुना
verses.transliteration: saMskR^itenA.api kiM tena mR^idunA lalitena vA | avidyArAgavAkyena saMsArakleshahetunA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यच्छ्रुत्वा जायते श्रेयो रागादीनां च सङ्क्षयः । विरूपमपि तद्वाक्यं विज्ञेयमिति शोभनम्
verses.transliteration: yachChrutvA jAyate shreyo rAgAdInAM cha sa~NkShayaH | virUpamapi tadvAkyaM vij~neyamiti shobhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वेदे शिवागमे चायमुभयत्र षडक्षरः । सर्वेषां शिवभक्तानामशेषार्थप्रसाधकः
verses.transliteration: vede shivAgame chAyamubhayatra ShaDakSharaH | sarveShAM shivabhaktAnAmasheShArthaprasAdhakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बहुत्वेऽपि हि मन्त्राणां सर्वज्ञेन शिवेन यः । प्रणीतो विमलो मन्त्रो न तेन सदृशः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: bahutve.api hi mantrANAM sarvaj~nena shivena yaH | praNIto vimalo mantro na tena sadR^ishaH kvachit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: साङ्गानि वेदशास्त्राणि संस्थितानि षडक्षरे । न तेन सदृशस्तस्मान्मन्त्रोऽप्यस्त्यपरः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: sA~NgAni vedashAstrANi saMsthitAni ShaDakShare | na tena sadR^ishastasmAnmantro.apyastyaparaH kvachit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तकोटिमहामन्त्रैरुपमन्त्रैरनेकधा । मन्त्रः षडक्षरो भिन्नः सूत्रं वृत्त्यात्मना यथा
verses.transliteration: saptakoTimahAmantrairupamantrairanekadhA | mantraH ShaDakSharo bhinnaH sUtraM vR^ittyAtmanA yathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवज्ञानानि यावन्ति विद्यास्थानानि यानि च । षडक्षरस्य सूत्रस्य तानि भाष्यं समासतः
verses.transliteration: shivaj~nAnAni yAvanti vidyAsthAnAni yAni cha | ShaDakSharasya sUtrasya tAni bhAShyaM samAsataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: किं तस्य बहुभिर्मन्त्रैः शास्त्रैर्वा बहुविस्तरैः । यस्योन्नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रोऽयं हृदि संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: kiM tasya bahubhirmantraiH shAstrairvA bahuvistaraiH | yasyonnamaH shivAyeti mantro.ayaM hR^idi saMsthitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाधीतं श्रुतं तेन कृतं सर्वमनुष्ठितम् । येनोन्नमः शिवायेति मन्त्राभ्यासः स्थिरीकृतः
verses.transliteration: tenAdhItaM shrutaM tena kR^itaM sarvamanuShThitam | yenonnamaH shivAyeti mantrAbhyAsaH sthirIkR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कारादिसंयुक्तं शिवायेत्यक्षरत्रयम् । जिह्वाग्रे वर्तते यस्य सफलं तस्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: namaskArAdisaMyuktaM shivAyetyakSharatrayam | jihvAgre vartate yasya saphalaM tasya jIvitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अन्त्यजो वाधमो वापि मूर्खो वा पण्डितोऽपि वा । पञ्चाक्षरजपे निष्ठो मुच्यते पापपञ्जरात्
verses.transliteration: antyajo vAdhamo vApi mUrkho vA paNDito.api vA | pa~nchAkSharajape niShTho muchyate pApapa~njarAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तं परमेशेन देव्या पृष्टेन शूलिना । हिताय सर्वमर्त्यानां द्विजानां तु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: ityuktaM parameshena devyA pR^iShTena shUlinA | hitAya sarvamartyAnAM dvijAnAM tu visheShataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदल्पाक्षरमर्थाढ्यं वेदसारं विमुक्तिदम् । आज्ञासिद्धमसन्दिग्धं वाक्यमेतत् शिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: tadalpAkSharamarthADhyaM vedasAraM vimuktidam | Aj~nAsiddhamasandigdhaM vAkyametat shivAtmakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नानासिद्धियुतं दिव्यं लोकचित्तानुरञ्जकम् । सुनिश्चितार्थं गम्भीरं वाक्यं तत्पारमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nAnAsiddhiyutaM divyaM lokachittAnura~njakam | sunishchitArthaM gambhIraM vAkyaM tatpArameshvaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रं सुखमुखोच्चार्यमशेषार्थप्रसिद्धये । प्राहोन्नमः शिवायेति सर्वज्ञः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: mantraM sukhamukhochchAryamasheShArthaprasiddhaye | prAhonnamaH shivAyeti sarvaj~naH sarvadehinAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तद्बीजं सर्वविद्यानां मन्त्रमाद्यं षडक्षरम् । अतिसूक्ष्मं महार्थं च ज्ञेयं तद्वटबीजवत्
verses.transliteration: tadbIjaM sarvavidyAnAM mantramAdyaM ShaDakSharam | atisUkShmaM mahArthaM cha j~neyaM tadvaTabIjavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देवो गुणत्रयातीतः सर्वज्ञः सर्वकृत्प्रभुः । ओमित्येकाक्षरे मन्त्रे स्थितः सर्वगतः शिवः
verses.transliteration: devo guNatrayAtItaH sarvaj~naH sarvakR^itprabhuH | omityekAkShare mantre sthitaH sarvagataH shivaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इशानाद्यानि सूक्ष्माणि ब्रह्माण्येकाक्षराणि तु । मन्त्रे नमः शिवायेति संस्थितानि यथाक्रमम् । मन्त्रे षडक्षरे सूक्ष्मे पञ्चब्रह्मतनुः शिवः
verses.transliteration: ishAnAdyAni sUkShmANi brahmANyekAkSharANi tu | mantre namaH shivAyeti saMsthitAni yathAkramam | mantre ShaDakShare sUkShme pa~nchabrahmatanuH shivaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१३. त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः । पञ्चाक्षरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । देव्युवाच । कलौ कलुषिते काले दुर्जये दुरतिक्रमे । अपुण्यतमसाच्छन्ने लोके धर्मपराङ्मुखे
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.13\. trayodasho.adhyAyaH | pa~nchAkSharamAhAtmyavarNanam | devyuvAcha | kalau kaluShite kAle durjaye duratikrame | apuNyatamasAchChanne loke dharmaparA~Nmukhe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: समन्त्रकं मां पतितः पूजयेद्यदि मोहितः । नारकी स्यान्न सन्देहो मम पञ्चाक्षरं विना
verses.transliteration: samantrakaM mAM patitaH pUjayedyadi mohitaH | nArakI syAnna sandeho mama pa~nchAkSharaM vinA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अब्भक्षा वायुभक्षाश्च ये चान्ये व्रतकर्शिताः । तेषामेतैर्व्रतैर्नास्ति मम लोकसमागमः
verses.transliteration: abbhakShA vAyubhakShAshcha ye chAnye vratakarshitAH | teShAmetairvratairnAsti mama lokasamAgamaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या पञ्चाक्षरेणैव यो हि मां सकृदर्चयेत् । सोऽपि गच्छेन्मम स्थानं मन्त्रस्यास्यैव गौरवात्
verses.transliteration: bhaktyA pa~nchAkShareNaiva yo hi mAM sakR^idarchayet | so.api gachChenmama sthAnaM mantrasyAsyaiva gauravAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तपांसि यज्ञाश्च व्रतानि नियमास्तथा । पञ्चाक्षरार्चनस्यैते कोट्यंशेनापि नो समः
verses.transliteration: tasmAttapAMsi yaj~nAshcha vratAni niyamAstathA | pa~nchAkSharArchanasyaite koTyaMshenApi no samaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बद्धो वाप्यथ मुक्तो वा पाशात्पञ्चाक्षरेण यः । पूजयेन्मां स मुच्येत नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: baddho vApyatha mukto vA pAshAtpa~nchAkShareNa yaH | pUjayenmAM sa muchyeta nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अरुद्रो वा सरुद्रो वा सकृत्पञ्चाक्षरेण यः । पूजयेत्पतितो वापि मूढो वा मुच्यते नरः
verses.transliteration: arudro vA sarudro vA sakR^itpa~nchAkShareNa yaH | pUjayetpatito vApi mUDho vA muchyate naraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: षडक्षरेण वा देवि तथा पञ्चाक्षरेण वा । स ब्रह्माङ्गेन मां भक्त्या पूजयेद्यदि मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ShaDakShareNa vA devi tathA pa~nchAkShareNa vA | sa brahmA~Ngena mAM bhaktyA pUjayedyadi muchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पतितोऽपतितो वापि मन्त्रेणानेन पूजयेत् । मम भक्तो जितक्रोधो सलब्धोऽलब्ध एव वा
verses.transliteration: patito.apatito vApi mantreNAnena pUjayet | mama bhakto jitakrodho salabdho.alabdha eva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अलब्धाल्लब्ध एवेह कोटिकोटिगुणाधिकः । तस्मात् लब्ध्वैव मां देवि मन्त्रेणानेन पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: alabdhAllabdha eveha koTikoTiguNAdhikaH | tasmAt labdhvaiva mAM devi mantreNAnena pUjayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा सम्पूजयेद्यस्तु मैत्र्यादिगुणसंयुतः । ब्रह्मचर्यरतो भक्त्या मत्सादृश्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: labdhvA sampUjayedyastu maitryAdiguNasaMyutaH | brahmacharyarato bhaktyA matsAdR^ishyamavApnuyAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीणे वर्णाश्रमाचारे सङ्कटे समुपस्थिते । सर्वाधिकारे सन्दिग्धे निश्चिते वापि पर्यये
verses.transliteration: kShINe varNAshramAchAre sa~NkaTe samupasthite | sarvAdhikAre sandigdhe nishchite vApi paryaye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन भक्ताः सर्वेऽधिकारिणः । मम पञ्चाक्षरे मन्त्रे तस्मात् श्रेष्ठतरो हि सः
verses.transliteration: kimatra bahunoktena bhaktAH sarve.adhikAriNaH | mama pa~nchAkShare mantre tasmAt shreShThataro hi saH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाक्षरप्रभावेण लोकवेदमहर्षयः । तिष्ठन्ति शाश्वता धर्मा देवाः सर्वमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAkSharaprabhAveNa lokavedamaharShayaH | tiShThanti shAshvatA dharmA devAH sarvamidaM jagat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रलये समनुप्राप्ते नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे । सर्वं प्रकृतिमापन्नं तत्र संलयमेष्यति
verses.transliteration: pralaye samanuprApte naShTe sthAvaraja~Ngame | sarvaM prakR^itimApannaM tatra saMlayameShyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एकोऽहं संस्थितो देवि न द्वितीयोऽस्ति कुत्रचित् । तदा वेदाश्च शास्त्राणि सर्वे पञ्चाक्षरे स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: eko.ahaM saMsthito devi na dvitIyo.asti kutrachit | tadA vedAshcha shAstrANi sarve pa~nchAkShare sthitAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ते नाशं नैव सम्प्राप्ता मच्छक्त्या ह्यनुपालिताः । ततः सृष्टिरभून्मत्तः प्रकृत्यात्मप्रभेदतः
verses.transliteration: te nAshaM naiva samprAptA machChaktyA hyanupAlitAH | tataH sR^iShTirabhUnmattaH prakR^ityAtmaprabhedataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गुणमूर्त्यात्मनां चैव ततोऽवान्तरसंहृतिः । तदा नारायणः शेते देवो मायामयीं तनुम्
verses.transliteration: guNamUrtyAtmanAM chaiva tato.avAntarasaMhR^itiH | tadA nArAyaNaH shete devo mAyAmayIM tanum
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आस्थाय भोगिपर्यङ्कशयने तोयमध्यगः । तन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पञ्चवक्त्रः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: AsthAya bhogiparya~Nkashayane toyamadhyagaH | tannAbhipa~NkajAjjAtaH pa~nchavaktraH pitAmahaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सिसृक्षमाणो लोकांस्त्रीन्न सक्तो ह्यसहायवान् । मुनीन्दश ससर्जादौ मानसानमितौजसः
verses.transliteration: sisR^ikShamANo lokAMstrInna sakto hyasahAyavAn | munIndasha sasarjAdau mAnasAnamitaujasaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां सिद्धिविवृद्ध्यर्थं मां प्रोवाच पितामहः । मत्पुत्राणां महादेव शक्तिं देहि महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: teShAM siddhivivR^iddhyarthaM mAM provAcha pitAmahaH | matputrANAM mahAdeva shaktiM dehi maheshvara
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं प्रार्थितस्तेन पञ्चवक्त्रधरो ह्यहम् । पञ्चाक्षराणि क्रमशः प्रोक्तवान् पद्मयोनये
verses.transliteration: ityevaM prArthitastena pa~nchavaktradharo hyaham | pa~nchAkSharANi kramashaH proktavAn padmayonaye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदोपदेशे विहते गुरुशिष्यक्रमे गते । केनोपायेन मुच्यन्ते भक्तास्तव महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: tadopadeshe vihate gurushiShyakrame gate | kenopAyena muchyante bhaktAstava maheshvara
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स पञ्चवदनैस्तानि गृह्णँल्लोकपितामहः । वाच्यवाचकभावेन ज्ञातवान्मां महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sa pa~nchavadanaistAni gR^ihNa.NllokapitAmahaH | vAchyavAchakabhAvena j~nAtavAnmAM maheshvaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा प्रयोगं विधिवत् सिद्धमन्त्रः प्रजापतिः । पुत्रेभ्यः प्रददौ मन्त्रं मन्त्रार्थं च यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: j~nAtvA prayogaM vidhivat siddhamantraH prajApatiH | putrebhyaH pradadau mantraM mantrArthaM cha yathAtatham
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ते च लब्ध्वा मन्त्ररत्नं साक्षात् लोकपितामहात् । तदाज्ञप्तेन मार्गेण मदाराधनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: te cha labdhvA mantraratnaM sAkShAt lokapitAmahAt | tadAj~naptena mArgeNa madArAdhanakA~NkShiNaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मेरोस्तु शिखरे रम्ये मुञ्जवान्नाम पर्वतः । मत्प्रियः सततं श्रीमान्मद्भक्तै रक्षितः सदा
verses.transliteration: merostu shikhare ramye mu~njavAnnAma parvataH | matpriyaH satataM shrImAnmadbhaktai rakShitaH sadA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याभ्याशे तपस्तीव्रं लोकं स्रष्टुं समुत्सुकाः । दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु वायुभक्षाः समाचरन्
verses.transliteration: tasyAbhyAshe tapastIvraM lokaM sraShTuM samutsukAH | divyaM varShasahasraM tu vAyubhakShAH samAcharan
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां भक्तिमहं दृष्ट्वा सद्यः प्रत्यक्षतामियाम् । ऋषिं छन्दश्च कीलं च बीजशक्तिं च दैवतम्
verses.transliteration: teShAM bhaktimahaM dR^iShTvA sadyaH pratyakShatAmiyAm | R^iShiM Chandashcha kIlaM cha bIjashaktiM cha daivatam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न्यासं षडङ्गं दिग्बन्धं विनियोगमशेषतः । प्रोक्तवानहमार्याणां जगत्सृष्टिविवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: nyAsaM ShaDa~NgaM digbandhaM viniyogamasheShataH | proktavAnahamAryANAM jagatsR^iShTivivR^iddhaye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते मन्त्रमाहात्म्याद् ऋषयस्तपसौधिताः । सृष्टिं वितन्वते सम्यक् सदेवासुरमानुषीम्
verses.transliteration: tataste mantramAhAtmyAd R^iShayastapasaudhitAH | sR^iShTiM vitanvate samyak sadevAsuramAnuShIm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अस्याः परमविद्यायाः स्वरूपमधुनोच्यते । आदौ नमः प्रयोक्तव्यं शिवाय तु ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: asyAH paramavidyAyAH svarUpamadhunochyate | Adau namaH prayoktavyaM shivAya tu tataH param
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सैषा पञ्चाक्षरी विद्या सर्वश्रुतिशिरोगता । सर्वजातस्य सर्वस्य बीजभूता सनातनी
verses.transliteration: saiShA pa~nchAkSharI vidyA sarvashrutishirogatA | sarvajAtasya sarvasya bIjabhUtA sanAtanI
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । आश्रित्य परमां विद्यां हृद्यां पञ्चाक्षरीं मम । भक्त्या च भावितात्मानो मुच्यन्ते कलिजा नराः
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | Ashritya paramAM vidyAM hR^idyAM pa~nchAkSharIM mama | bhaktyA cha bhAvitAtmAno muchyante kalijA narAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं मन्मुखोद्गीर्णा सा ममैवास्ति वाचिका । तप्तचामीकरप्रख्या पीनोन्नतपयोधरा
verses.transliteration: prathamaM manmukhodgIrNA sA mamaivAsti vAchikA | taptachAmIkaraprakhyA pInonnatapayodharA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजा त्रिनयना बालेन्दुकृतशेखरा । पद्मोत्पलकरा सौम्या वरदाभयपाणिका
verses.transliteration: chaturbhujA trinayanA bAlendukR^itashekharA | padmotpalakarA saumyA varadAbhayapANikA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्ना सर्वाभरणभूषिता । सितपद्मासनासीना नीलकुञ्चितीमूर्द्धजा
verses.transliteration: sarvalakShaNasampannA sarvAbharaNabhUShitA | sitapadmAsanAsInA nIlaku~nchitImUrddhajA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अस्याः पञ्चविधा वर्णाः प्रस्फुरद् रश्मिमण्डलाः । पीतः कृष्णस्तथा धूम्रः स्वर्णाभो रक्त एव च
verses.transliteration: asyAH pa~nchavidhA varNAH prasphurad rashmimaNDalAH | pItaH kR^iShNastathA dhUmraH svarNAbho rakta eva cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पृथक् प्रयोज्या यद्येते बिन्दुनादविभूषिताः । अर्द्धचन्द्रनिभो बिन्दुर्नादो दीपशिखाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: pR^ithak prayojyA yadyete bindunAdavibhUShitAH | arddhachandranibho bindurnAdo dIpashikhAkR^itiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बीजं द्वितीयं बीजेषु मन्त्रस्यास्य वरानने । दीर्घपूर्वं तुरीयस्य पञ्चमं शक्तिमादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: bIjaM dvitIyaM bIjeShu mantrasyAsya varAnane | dIrghapUrvaM turIyasya pa~nchamaM shaktimAdishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवो नाम ऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्द उदाहृतम् । देवता शिव एवाहं मन्त्रस्यास्य वरानने
verses.transliteration: vAmadevo nAma R^iShiH pa~NktishChanda udAhR^itam | devatA shiva evAhaM mantrasyAsya varAnane
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमोऽत्रिर्वरारोहे विश्वामित्रस्तथाङ्गिराः । भरद्वाजश्च वर्णानां क्रमशश्चर्षयः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: gautamo.atrirvarArohe vishvAmitrastathA~NgirAH | bharadvAjashcha varNAnAM kramashashcharShayaH smR^itAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्र्यनुष्टुप् त्रिष्टुप् च छन्दांसि बृहती विराट् । इन्द्रो रुद्रो हरिर्ब्रह्मा स्कन्दस्तेषां च देवताः
verses.transliteration: gAyatryanuShTup triShTup cha ChandAMsi bR^ihatI virAT | indro rudro harirbrahmA skandasteShAM cha devatAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मम पञ्चमुखान्याहुः स्थाने तेषां वरानने । पूर्वादेश्चोर्ध्वपर्यन्तं नकारादि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: mama pa~nchamukhAnyAhuH sthAne teShAM varAnane | pUrvAdeshchordhvaparyantaM nakArAdi yathAkramam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मनोवाक्कायजैर्दोषैर्वक्तुं स्मर्तुमगोचरैः । दूषितानां कृतघ्नानां निन्दकानां छलात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: manovAkkAyajairdoShairvaktuM smartumagocharaiH | dUShitAnAM kR^itaghnAnAM nindakAnAM ChalAtmanAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उदात्तः प्रथमो वर्णश्चतुर्थश्च द्वितीयकः । पञ्चमः स्वरितश्चैव तृतीयो निहितः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: udAttaH prathamo varNashchaturthashcha dvitIyakaH | pa~nchamaH svaritashchaiva tR^itIyo nihitaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मूलविद्या शिवं शैवं सूत्रं पञ्चाक्षरं तथा । नामान्यस्य विजानीयाच्छैवं मे हृदयं महत्
verses.transliteration: mUlavidyA shivaM shaivaM sUtraM pa~nchAkSharaM tathA | nAmAnyasya vijAnIyAchChaivaM me hR^idayaM mahat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नकारः शिर उच्येत मकारस्तु शिखोच्यते । शिकारः कवचं तद्वद्वकारो नेत्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: nakAraH shira uchyeta makArastu shikhochyate | shikAraH kavachaM tadvadvakAro netramuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यकारोऽस्त्रं नमः स्वाहा वषट् हुं वौषडित्यपि । फडित्यपि च वर्णानामन्तेऽङ्गत्वं यदा तदा
verses.transliteration: yakAro.astraM namaH svAhA vaShaT huM vauShaDityapi | phaDityapi cha varNAnAmante.a~NgatvaM yadA tadA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि मूलमन्त्रोऽयं किञ्चिद्भेदसमन्वयात् । तत्रापि पञ्चमो वर्णो द्वादशस्वरभूषितः
verses.transliteration: tatrApi mUlamantro.ayaM ki~nchidbhedasamanvayAt | tatrApi pa~nchamo varNo dvAdashasvarabhUShitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनेन मन्त्रेण मनोवाक्कायभेदतः । आवयोरर्चनं कुर्य्याज्जपहोमादिकं तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmAdanena mantreNa manovAkkAyabhedataH | AvayorarchanaM kuryyAjjapahomAdikaM tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथाप्रज्ञं यथाकालं यथाशास्त्रं यथामति । यथाशक्ति यथासम्पद्यथायोगं यथारति
verses.transliteration: yathApraj~naM yathAkAlaM yathAshAstraM yathAmati | yathAshakti yathAsampadyathAyogaM yathArati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यदा कदापि वा भक्त्या यत्र कुत्रापि वा कृता । येन केनापि वा देवि पूजा मुक्तिं नयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yadA kadApi vA bhaktyA yatra kutrApi vA kR^itA | yena kenApi vA devi pUjA muktiM nayiShyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मय्यासक्तेन मनसा यत्कृतं मम सुन्दरि । मत्प्रियं च शिवं चैव क्रमेणाप्यक्रमेण वा
verses.transliteration: mayyAsaktena manasA yatkR^itaM mama sundari | matpriyaM cha shivaM chaiva krameNApyakrameNa vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि मम भक्ता ये नात्यन्तविवशाः पुनः । तेषां सर्वेषु शास्त्रेषु मयैव नियमः कृतः
verses.transliteration: tathApi mama bhaktA ye nAtyantavivashAH punaH | teShAM sarveShu shAstreShu mayaiva niyamaH kR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लुब्धानां वक्रमनसामपि मत्प्रवणात्मनाम् । मम पञ्चाक्षरी विद्या संसारभयतारिणी
verses.transliteration: lubdhAnAM vakramanasAmapi matpravaNAtmanAm | mama pa~nchAkSharI vidyA saMsArabhayatAriNI
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रादौ सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि मन्त्रसङ्ग्रहणं शुभम् । यं विना निष्फलं जाप्यं येन वा सफलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatrAdau sampravakShyAmi mantrasa~NgrahaNaM shubham | yaM vinA niShphalaM jApyaM yena vA saphalaM bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मयैवमसकृद्देवि प्रतिज्ञातं धरातले । पतितोऽपि विमुच्येत मद्भक्तो विद्ययाऽनया
verses.transliteration: mayaivamasakR^iddevi pratij~nAtaM dharAtale | patito.api vimuchyeta madbhakto vidyayA.anayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच । कर्मायोग्यो भवेन्मर्त्यः पतितो यदि सर्वथा । कर्मायोगेन यत्कर्म कृतं च नरकाय हि । ततः कथं विमुच्येत पतितो विद्ययाऽनया
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha | karmAyogyo bhavenmartyaH patito yadi sarvathA | karmAyogena yatkarma kR^itaM cha narakAya hi | tataH kathaM vimuchyeta patito vidyayA.anayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । तथ्यमेतत्त्वया प्रोक्तं तथा हि शृणु सुन्दरि । रहस्यमिति मत्वैतद्गोपितं यन्मया पुरा
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | tathyametattvayA proktaM tathA hi shR^iNu sundari | rahasyamiti matvaitadgopitaM yanmayA purA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१४. चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः । पञ्चाक्षरमहिमवर्णनम् । ईश्वर उवाच । आज्ञाहीनं क्रियाहीनं श्रद्धाहीनं वरानने । आज्ञार्थं दक्षिणाहीनं सदा जप्तं च निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.14\. chaturdasho.adhyAyaH | pa~nchAkSharamahimavarNanam | Ishvara uvAcha | Aj~nAhInaM kriyAhInaM shraddhAhInaM varAnane | Aj~nArthaM dakShiNAhInaM sadA japtaM cha niShphalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयित्वा विशुद्ध्यर्थं पूर्णकुम्भघृतेन वै । जलेन मन्त्रशुद्धेन पुण्यद्रव्ययुतेन च
verses.transliteration: snApayitvA vishuddhyarthaM pUrNakumbhaghR^itena vai | jalena mantrashuddhena puNyadravyayutena cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अलङ्कृत्य सुवेषं च गन्धस्रग्वस्त्रभूषणैः । पुण्याहं वाचयित्वा च ब्राह्मणानभिपूज्य च
verses.transliteration: ala~NkR^itya suveShaM cha gandhasragvastrabhUShaNaiH | puNyAhaM vAchayitvA cha brAhmaNAnabhipUjya cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रतीरे नद्यां च गोष्ठे देवालयेऽपि वा । शुचौ देशे गृहे वापि काले सिद्धिकरे तिथौ
verses.transliteration: samudratIre nadyAM cha goShThe devAlaye.api vA | shuchau deshe gR^ihe vApi kAle siddhikare tithau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्रे शुभयोगे च सर्वदोषविवर्जिते । अनुगृह्य ततो दद्याज्ज्ञानं मम यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: nakShatre shubhayoge cha sarvadoShavivarjite | anugR^ihya tato dadyAjj~nAnaM mama yathAvidhi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वरेणोच्चारयेत्सम्यगेकान्तेऽतिप्रसन्नधीः । उच्चार्योच्चारयित्वा तमावयोर्मन्त्रमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: svareNochchArayetsamyagekAnte.atiprasannadhIH | uchchAryochchArayitvA tamAvayormantramuttamam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवं चास्तु शुभं चास्तु शोभनोऽस्तु प्रियोऽस्त्विति । एवं दद्याद् गुरुर्मन्त्रमाज्ञां चैव ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: shivaM chAstu shubhaM chAstu shobhano.astu priyo.astviti | evaM dadyAd gururmantramAj~nAM chaiva tataH param
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं लब्ध्वा गुरोर्मन्त्रमाज्ञां चैव समाहितः । सङ्कल्प्य च जपेन्नित्यं पुरश्चरणपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: evaM labdhvA gurormantramAj~nAM chaiva samAhitaH | sa~Nkalpya cha japennityaM purashcharaNapUrvakam
