verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यावज्जीवं जपेन्नित्यमष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् । अनन्यस्तत्परो भूत्वा स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yAvajjIvaM japennityamaShTottarasahasrakam | ananyastatparo bhUtvA sa yAti paramAM gatim
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जपेदक्षरलक्षं वै चतुर्गुणितमादरात् । नक्ताशी संयमी यः स पौरश्चरणिकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: japedakSharalakShaM vai chaturguNitamAdarAt | naktAshI saMyamI yaH sa paurashcharaNikaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यः पुरश्चरणं कृत्वा नित्यजापी भवेत्पुनः । तस्य नास्ति समो लोके स सिद्धः सिद्धिदो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yaH purashcharaNaM kR^itvA nityajApI bhavetpunaH | tasya nAsti samo loke sa siddhaH siddhido bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञासिद्धं क्रियासिद्धं श्रद्धासिद्धं ममात्मकम् । एवं चेद्दक्षिणायुक्तं मन्त्रसिद्धिर्महत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: Aj~nAsiddhaM kriyAsiddhaM shraddhAsiddhaM mamAtmakam | evaM cheddakShiNAyuktaM mantrasiddhirmahatphalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं कृत्वा शुचौ देशे बद्ध्वा रुचिरमासनम् । त्वया मां हृदि सञ्चिन्त्य सञ्चिन्त्य स्वगुरुं ततः
verses.transliteration: snAnaM kR^itvA shuchau deshe baddhvA ruchiramAsanam | tvayA mAM hR^idi sa~nchintya sa~nchintya svaguruM tataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्मुखो वा मौनी चैकाग्रमानसः । विशोध्य पञ्चतत्त्वानि दहनप्लावनादिभिः
verses.transliteration: uda~NmukhaH prA~Nmukho vA maunI chaikAgramAnasaH | vishodhya pa~nchatattvAni dahanaplAvanAdibhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रन्यासादिकं कृत्वा सफलीकृतविग्रहः । आवयोर्विग्रहौ ध्यायन्प्राणापानौ नियम्य च
verses.transliteration: mantranyAsAdikaM kR^itvA saphalIkR^itavigrahaH | Avayorvigrahau dhyAyanprANApAnau niyamya cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यास्थानं स्वकं रूपं ऋषिं छन्दोऽधिदैवतम् । बीजं शक्तिं तथा वाक्यं स्मृत्वा पञ्चाक्षरीं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: vidyAsthAnaM svakaM rUpaM R^iShiM Chando.adhidaivatam | bIjaM shaktiM tathA vAkyaM smR^itvA pa~nchAkSharIM japet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं मानसं जाप्यमुपांशुं चैव मध्यमम् । अधमं वाचिकं प्राहुरागमार्थविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: uttamaM mAnasaM jApyamupAMshuM chaiva madhyamam | adhamaM vAchikaM prAhurAgamArthavishAradAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं रुद्रदैवत्यं मध्यमं विष्णुदैवतम् । अधमं ब्रह्मदैवत्यमित्याहुरनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: uttamaM rudradaivatyaM madhyamaM viShNudaivatam | adhamaM brahmadaivatyamityAhuranupUrvashaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यदुच्चनीचस्वरितैः स्पष्टास्पष्टपदाक्षरैः । मन्त्रमुच्चारयेद्वाचा वाचिकोऽयं जपः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yaduchchanIchasvaritaiH spaShTAspaShTapadAkSharaiH | mantramuchchArayedvAchA vAchiko.ayaM japaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जिह्वामात्रपरिस्पन्दादीषदुच्चारितोऽपि वा । अपरैरश्रुतः किञ्चिच्छ्रुतो वोपांशुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: jihvAmAtraparispandAdIShaduchchArito.api vA | aparairashrutaH ki~nchichChruto vopAMshuruchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: धिया यदक्षरश्रेण्या वर्णाद्वर्णं पदात्पदम् । शब्दार्थचिन्तनं भूयः कथ्यते मानसो जपः
verses.transliteration: dhiyA yadakSharashreNyA varNAdvarNaM padAtpadam | shabdArthachintanaM bhUyaH kathyate mAnaso japaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वाचिकस्त्वेक एव स्यादुपांशुः शतमुच्यते । साहस्रं मानसः प्रोक्तः सगर्भस्तु शताधिकः
verses.transliteration: vAchikastveka eva syAdupAMshuH shatamuchyate | sAhasraM mAnasaH proktaH sagarbhastu shatAdhikaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपगम्य गुरुं विप्रमाचार्यं तत्त्ववेदिनम् । जापिनं सद्गुणोपेतं ध्यानयोगपरायणम्
verses.transliteration: upagamya guruM vipramAchAryaM tattvavedinam | jApinaM sadguNopetaM dhyAnayogaparAyaNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामसमायुक्तः सगर्भो जप उच्यते । आद्यन्तयोरगर्भोऽपि प्राणायामः प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: prANAyAmasamAyuktaH sagarbho japa uchyate | Adyantayoragarbho.api prANAyAmaH prashasyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशत्समावृत्तीः प्राणानायम्य संस्मरेत् । मन्त्रं मन्त्रार्थविद्धीमानशक्तः शक्तितो जपेत्
verses.transliteration: chatvAriMshatsamAvR^ittIH prANAnAyamya saMsmaret | mantraM mantrArthaviddhImAnashaktaH shaktito japet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चकं त्रिकमेकं वा प्राणायामं समाचरेत् । अगर्भं वा सगर्भं वा सगर्भस्तत्र शस्यते
verses.transliteration: pa~nchakaM trikamekaM vA prANAyAmaM samAcharet | agarbhaM vA sagarbhaM vA sagarbhastatra shasyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सगर्भादपि साहस्रं सध्यानो जप उच्यते । एषु पञ्चविधेष्वेकः कर्त्तव्यः शक्तितो जपः
verses.transliteration: sagarbhAdapi sAhasraM sadhyAno japa uchyate | eShu pa~nchavidheShvekaH karttavyaH shaktito japaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुल्या जपसङ्ख्यानमेकमेवमुदाहृतम् । रेखयाष्टगुणं विद्यात्पुत्रजीवैर्दशाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: a~NgulyA japasa~NkhyAnamekamevamudAhR^itam | rekhayAShTaguNaM vidyAtputrajIvairdashAdhikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शतं स्याच्छङ्खमणिभिः प्रवालैस्तु सहस्रकम् । स्फटिकैर्दशसाहस्रं मौक्तिकैर्लक्षमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: shataM syAchCha~NkhamaNibhiH pravAlaistu sahasrakam | sphaTikairdashasAhasraM mauktikairlakShamuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पद्माक्षैर्दशलक्षं तु सौवर्णैः कोटिरुच्यते । कुशग्रन्थ्या च रुद्राक्षैरनन्तगुणितं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: padmAkShairdashalakShaM tu sauvarNaiH koTiruchyate | kushagranthyA cha rudrAkShairanantaguNitaM bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशदक्षैः कृता माला धनदा जपकर्मणि । सप्तविंशतिसङ्ख्यातैरक्षैः पुष्टिप्रदा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: triMshadakShaiH kR^itA mAlA dhanadA japakarmaNi | saptaviMshatisa~NkhyAtairakShaiH puShTipradA bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशतिसङ्ख्यातैः कृता मुक्तिं प्रयच्छति । अक्षैस्तु पञ्चदशभिरभिचारफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: pa~nchaviMshatisa~NkhyAtaiH kR^itA muktiM prayachChati | akShaistu pa~nchadashabhirabhichAraphalapradA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठं मोक्षदं विद्यात्तर्ज्जनीं शत्रुनाशिनीम् । मध्यमां धनदां शान्तिं करोत्येषा ह्यनामिका
verses.transliteration: a~NguShThaM mokShadaM vidyAttarjjanIM shatrunAshinIm | madhyamAM dhanadAM shAntiM karotyeShA hyanAmikA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तोषयेत्तं प्रयत्नेन भावशुद्धिसमन्वितः । वाचा च मनसा चैव कायेन द्रविणेन च
verses.transliteration: toShayettaM prayatnena bhAvashuddhisamanvitaH | vAchA cha manasA chaiva kAyena draviNena cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टोत्तरशतं माला तत्र स्यादुत्तमोत्तमा । शतसङ्ख्योत्तमा माला पञ्चाशद्भिस्तु मध्यमा
verses.transliteration: aShTottarashataM mAlA tatra syAduttamottamA | shatasa~NkhyottamA mAlA pa~nchAshadbhistu madhyamA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चतुःपञ्चाशदक्षैस्तु हृच्छ्रेष्ठा हि प्रकीर्तिता । इत्येवं मालया कुर्याज्जपं कस्मै न दर्शयेत्
verses.transliteration: chatuHpa~nchAshadakShaistu hR^ichChreShThA hi prakIrtitA | ityevaM mAlayA kuryAjjapaM kasmai na darshayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कनिष्ठा क्षरिणी प्रोक्ता जपकर्मणि शोभना । अङ्गुष्ठेन जपेज्जप्यमन्यैरङ्गुलिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: kaniShThA kShariNI proktA japakarmaNi shobhanA | a~NguShThena japejjapyamanyaira~NgulibhiH saha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठेन विना जप्यं कृतं तदफलं यतः । गृहे जपं समं विद्याद् गोष्ठे शतगुणं विदुः
verses.transliteration: a~NguShThena vinA japyaM kR^itaM tadaphalaM yataH | gR^ihe japaM samaM vidyAd goShThe shataguNaM viduH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यारण्ये तथारामे सहस्रगुणमुच्यते । अयुतं पर्वते पुण्ये नद्यां लक्षमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: puNyAraNye tathArAme sahasraguNamuchyate | ayutaM parvate puNye nadyAM lakShamudAhR^itam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिं देवालये प्राहुरनन्तं मम सन्निधौ । सूर्यस्याग्नेर्गुरोरिन्दोर्दीपस्य च जलस्य च
verses.transliteration: koTiM devAlaye prAhuranantaM mama sannidhau | sUryasyAgnergurorindordIpasya cha jalasya cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विप्राणां च गवां चैव सन्निधौ शस्यते जपः । तत्पूर्वाभिमुखं वश्यं दक्षिणं चाभिचारिकम्
verses.transliteration: viprANAM cha gavAM chaiva sannidhau shasyate japaH | tatpUrvAbhimukhaM vashyaM dakShiNaM chAbhichArikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमं धनदं विद्यादौत्तरं शान्तिदं भवेत् । सूर्य्याग्निविप्रदेवानां गुरूणामपि सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: pashchimaM dhanadaM vidyAdauttaraM shAntidaM bhavet | sUryyAgnivipradevAnAM gurUNAmapi sannidhau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अन्येषां च प्रसक्तानां मन्त्रं न विमुखो जपेत् । उष्णीषी कञ्चुकी नग्नो मुक्तकेशो गलावृतः
verses.transliteration: anyeShAM cha prasaktAnAM mantraM na vimukho japet | uShNIShI ka~nchukI nagno muktakesho galAvR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अपवित्रकरोऽशुद्धो विलपन्न जपेत् क्वचित् । क्रोधं मदं क्षुतं त्रीणि निष्ठीवनविजृम्भणे
verses.transliteration: apavitrakaro.ashuddho vilapanna japet kvachit | krodhaM madaM kShutaM trINi niShThIvanavijR^imbhaNe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आचार्यं पूजयेद्विप्रः सर्वदातिप्रयत्नतः । हस्त्यश्वरथरत्नानि क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च
verses.transliteration: AchAryaM pUjayedvipraH sarvadAtiprayatnataH | hastyashvaratharatnAni kShetrANi cha gR^ihANi cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनं च श्वनीचानां वर्जयेज्जपकर्मणि । आचमेत्सम्भवे तेषां स्मरेद्वा मां त्वया सह
verses.transliteration: darshanaM cha shvanIchAnAM varjayejjapakarmaNi | Achametsambhave teShAM smaredvA mAM tvayA saha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतींषि च प्रपश्येद्वा कुर्याद् वा प्राणसंयमम् । अनासनः शयानो वा गच्छन्नुत्थित एव वा
verses.transliteration: jyotIMShi cha prapashyedvA kuryAd vA prANasaMyamam | anAsanaH shayAno vA gachChannutthita eva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रथ्यायामशिवे स्थाने न जपेत्तिमिरान्तरे । प्रसार्य्य न जपेत्पादौ कुक्कुटासन एव वा
verses.transliteration: rathyAyAmashive sthAne na japettimirAntare | prasAryya na japetpAdau kukkuTAsana eva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यानशय्याधिरूढो वा चिन्ताव्याकुलितोऽथवा । शक्तश्चेत्सर्वमेवैतदशक्तः शक्तितो जपेत्
verses.transliteration: yAnashayyAdhirUDho vA chintAvyAkulito.athavA | shaktashchetsarvamevaitadashaktaH shaktito japet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन समासेन वचः शृणु । सदाचारो जपन् शुद्धं ध्यायन्भद्रं समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: kimatra bahunoktena samAsena vachaH shR^iNu | sadAchAro japan shuddhaM dhyAyanbhadraM samashnute
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आचारः परमो धर्म आचारः परमं धनम् । आचारः परमा विद्या आचारः परमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: AchAraH paramo dharma AchAraH paramaM dhanam | AchAraH paramA vidyA AchAraH paramA gatiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आचारहीनः पुरुषो लोके भवति निन्दितः । परत्र च सुखी न स्यात्तस्मादाचारवान्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: AchArahInaH puruSho loke bhavati ninditaH | paratra cha sukhI na syAttasmAdAchAravAnbhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य यद्विहितं कर्म वेदे शास्त्रे च वैदिकैः । तस्य तेन समाचारः सदाचारो न चेतरः
verses.transliteration: yasya yadvihitaM karma vede shAstre cha vaidikaiH | tasya tena samAchAraH sadAchAro na chetaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सद्भिराचरितत्वाच्च सदाचारः स उच्यते । सदाचारस्य तस्याहुरास्तिक्यं मूलकारणम्
verses.transliteration: sadbhirAcharitatvAchcha sadAchAraH sa uchyate | sadAchArasya tasyAhurAstikyaM mUlakAraNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आस्तिकश्चेत्प्रमादाद्यैः सदाचारादविच्युतः । न दुष्यति नरो नित्यं तस्मादास्तिकतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: AstikashchetpramAdAdyaiH sadAchArAdavichyutaH | na duShyati naro nityaM tasmAdAstikatAM vrajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भूषणानि च वासांसि धान्यानि च धनानि च । एतानि गुरवे दद्याद्भक्त्या च विभवे सति
verses.transliteration: bhUShaNAni cha vAsAMsi dhAnyAni cha dhanAni cha | etAni gurave dadyAdbhaktyA cha vibhave sati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथेहास्ति सुखं दुःखं सुकृतैर्दुष्कृतैरपि । तथा परत्र चास्तीति मतिरास्तिक्यमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yathehAsti sukhaM duHkhaM sukR^itairduShkR^itairapi | tathA paratra chAstIti matirAstikyamuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रहस्यमन्यद्वक्ष्यामि गोपनीयमिदं प्रिये । न वाच्यं यस्य कस्यापि नास्तिकस्याथ वा पशोः
verses.transliteration: rahasyamanyadvakShyAmi gopanIyamidaM priye | na vAchyaM yasya kasyApi nAstikasyAtha vA pashoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सदाचारविहीनस्य पतितस्यान्त्यजस्य च । पञ्चाक्षरात्परं नास्ति परित्राणं कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: sadAchAravihInasya patitasyAntyajasya cha | pa~nchAkSharAtparaM nAsti paritrANaM kalau yuge
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छतस्तिष्ठतो वापि स्वेच्छया कर्म कुर्वतः । अशुचेर्वा शुचेर्वापि मन्त्रोऽयं न च निष्फलः
verses.transliteration: gachChatastiShThato vApi svechChayA karma kurvataH | ashuchervA shuchervApi mantro.ayaM na cha niShphalaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अनाचारवतां पुंसामविशुद्धषडध्वनाम् । अनादिष्टोऽपि गुरुणा मन्त्रोऽयं न च निष्फलः
verses.transliteration: anAchAravatAM puMsAmavishuddhaShaDadhvanAm | anAdiShTo.api guruNA mantro.ayaM na cha niShphalaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अन्त्यजस्यापि मूर्खस्य मूढस्य पतितस्य च । निर्मर्यादस्य नीचस्य मन्त्रोऽयं न च निष्फलः
verses.transliteration: antyajasyApi mUrkhasya mUDhasya patitasya cha | nirmaryAdasya nIchasya mantro.ayaM na cha niShphalaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वावस्थां गतस्यापि मयि भक्तिमतः परम् । सिध्यत्येव न सन्देहो नापरस्य तु कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: sarvAvasthAM gatasyApi mayi bhaktimataH param | sidhyatyeva na sandeho nAparasya tu kasyachit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न लग्नतिथिनक्षत्रवारयोगादयः प्रिये । अस्यात्यन्तमवेक्ष्याः स्युर्नैष सप्तः सदोदितः
verses.transliteration: na lagnatithinakShatravArayogAdayaH priye | asyAtyantamavekShyAH syurnaiSha saptaH sadoditaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न कदाचिन्न कस्यापि रिपुरेष महामनुः । सुसिद्धो वापि सिद्धो वा साध्यो वापि भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: na kadAchinna kasyApi ripureSha mahAmanuH | susiddho vApi siddho vA sAdhyo vApi bhaviShyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धेन गुरुणादिष्टः सुसिद्ध इति कथ्यते । असिद्धेनापि वा दत्तः सिद्धसाध्यस्तु केवलः
verses.transliteration: siddhena guruNAdiShTaH susiddha iti kathyate | asiddhenApi vA dattaH siddhasAdhyastu kevalaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत्सिद्धिमात्मनः । पश्चान्निवेद्य स्वात्मानं गुरवे सपरिच्छदम्
verses.transliteration: vittashAThyaM na kurvIta yadIchChetsiddhimAtmanaH | pashchAnnivedya svAtmAnaM gurave saparichChadam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असाधितः साधितो वा सिध्यत्वेन न संशयः । श्रद्धातिशययुक्तस्य मयि मन्त्रे तथा गुरौ
verses.transliteration: asAdhitaH sAdhito vA sidhyatvena na saMshayaH | shraddhAtishayayuktasya mayi mantre tathA gurau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मन्त्रान्तरांस्त्यक्त्वा सापायानधिकारतः । आश्रयेत्परमां विद्यां साक्षात्पञ्चाक्षरीं बुधः
verses.transliteration: tasmAnmantrAntarAMstyaktvA sApAyAnadhikArataH | AshrayetparamAM vidyAM sAkShAtpa~nchAkSharIM budhaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रान्तरेषु सिद्धेषु मन्त्र एष न सिध्यति । सिद्धे त्वस्मिन्महामन्त्रे ते च सिद्धा भवन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: mantrAntareShu siddheShu mantra eSha na sidhyati | siddhe tvasminmahAmantre te cha siddhA bhavantyuta
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथा देवेष्वलब्धोऽस्मि लब्धेष्वपि महेश्वरि । मयि लब्धे तु ते लब्धा मन्त्रेष्वेषु समो विधिः
verses.transliteration: yathA deveShvalabdho.asmi labdheShvapi maheshvari | mayi labdhe tu te labdhA mantreShveShu samo vidhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ये दोषाः सर्वमन्त्राणां न तेऽस्मिन् सम्भवन्त्यपि । अस्य मन्त्रस्य जात्यादीननपेक्ष्य प्रवर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: ye doShAH sarvamantrANAM na te.asmin sambhavantyapi | asya mantrasya jAtyAdInanapekShya pravartanAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि नैव क्षुद्रेषु फलेषु प्रतियोगिषु । सहसा विनियुञ्जीत तस्मादेष महाबलः
verses.transliteration: tathApi naiva kShudreShu phaleShu pratiyogiShu | sahasA viniyu~njIta tasmAdeSha mahAbalaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । एवं साक्षान्महादेव्यै महादेवेन शूलिना । हिताय जगतामुक्तः पञ्चाक्षरविधिर्यथा
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | evaM sAkShAnmahAdevyai mahAdevena shUlinA | hitAya jagatAmuktaH pa~nchAkSharavidhiryathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं कीर्तयेद्भक्त्या शृणुयाद्वा समाहितः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः प्रयाति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM kIrtayedbhaktyA shR^iNuyAdvA samAhitaH | sarvapApavinirmuktaH prayAti paramAM gatim
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सम्पूज्य विधिवद्यथाशक्ति त्ववञ्चयन् । आददीत गुरोर्मन्त्रं ज्ञानं चैव क्रमेण तु
verses.transliteration: evaM sampUjya vidhivadyathAshakti tvava~nchayan | AdadIta gurormantraM j~nAnaM chaiva krameNa tu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तुष्टो गुरुः शिष्यं पूजकं वत्सरोषितम् । शुश्रूषुमनहङ्कारं स्नातं शुचिमुपोषितम्
verses.transliteration: evaM tuShTo guruH shiShyaM pUjakaM vatsaroShitam | shushrUShumanaha~NkAraM snAtaM shuchimupoShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१५. पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः । दीक्षाविधाने गुरुमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । भगवन्मन्त्रमाहात्म्यं भवता कथितं प्रभो । तत्प्रयोगविधानं च साक्षाच्छ्रुतिसमं यथा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.15\. pa~nchadasho.adhyAyaH | dIkShAvidhAne gurumAhAtmyavarNanam | shrIkR^iShNa uvAcha | bhagavanmantramAhAtmyaM bhavatA kathitaM prabho | tatprayogavidhAnaM cha sAkShAchChrutisamaM yathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शाक्ती ज्ञानवती दीक्षा शिष्यदेहं प्रविश्य तु । गुरुणा योगमार्गेण क्रियते ज्ञानचक्षुषा
verses.transliteration: shAktI j~nAnavatI dIkShA shiShyadehaM pravishya tu | guruNA yogamArgeNa kriyate j~nAnachakShuShA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मान्त्री क्रियावती दीक्षा कुण्डमण्डलपूर्विका । मन्दमन्दतरोद्देशात्कर्तव्या गुरुणा बहिः
verses.transliteration: mAntrI kriyAvatI dIkShA kuNDamaNDalapUrvikA | mandamandataroddeshAtkartavyA guruNA bahiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिपातानुसारेण शिष्योऽनुग्रहमर्हति । शैवधर्मानुसारस्य तन्मूलत्वात्समासतः
verses.transliteration: shaktipAtAnusAreNa shiShyo.anugrahamarhati | shaivadharmAnusArasya tanmUlatvAtsamAsataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र शक्तिर्न पतिता तत्र शुद्धिर्न जायते । न विद्या न शिवाचारो न मुक्तिर्न च सिद्धयः
verses.transliteration: yatra shaktirna patitA tatra shuddhirna jAyate | na vidyA na shivAchAro na muktirna cha siddhayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् लिङ्गानि संवीक्ष्य शक्तिपातस्य भूयसः । ज्ञानेन क्रियया वाथ गुरुः शिष्यं विशोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAt li~NgAni saMvIkShya shaktipAtasya bhUyasaH | j~nAnena kriyayA vAtha guruH shiShyaM vishodhayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: योऽन्यथा कुरुते मोहात् स विनश्यति दुर्मतिः । तस्मात्सर्वप्रकारेण गुरुः शिष्यं परीक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: yo.anyathA kurute mohAt sa vinashyati durmatiH | tasmAtsarvaprakAreNa guruH shiShyaM parIkShayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षणं शक्तिपातस्य प्रबोधानन्दसम्भवः । सा यस्मात्परमा शक्तिः प्रबोधानन्दरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: lakShaNaM shaktipAtasya prabodhAnandasambhavaH | sA yasmAtparamA shaktiH prabodhAnandarUpiNI
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दबोधयोर्लिङ्गमन्तःकरणविक्रियाः । यथा स्यात्कम्परोमाञ्चस्वरनेत्राङ्गविक्रियाः
verses.transliteration: Anandabodhayorli~NgamantaHkaraNavikriyAH | yathA syAtkamparomA~nchasvaranetrA~NgavikriyAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्योऽपि लक्षणैरेभिः कुर्याद्गुरुपरीक्षणम् । तत्सम्पर्कैः शिवार्चादौ सङ्गतैर्वाथ तद्गतैः
verses.transliteration: shiShyo.api lakShaNairebhiH kuryAdguruparIkShaNam | tatsamparkaiH shivArchAdau sa~NgatairvAtha tadgataiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यस्तु शिक्षणीयत्वाद्गुरोर्गौरवकारणात् । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन गुरोर्गौरवमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: shiShyastu shikShaNIyatvAdgurorgauravakAraNAt | tasmAt sarvaprayatnena gurorgauravamAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि शिवसंस्कारमुत्तमम् । मन्त्रसङ्ग्रहणे किञ्चित्सूचितं न तु विस्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: idAnIM shrotumichChAmi shivasaMskAramuttamam | mantrasa~NgrahaNe ki~nchitsUchitaM na tu vismR^itam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यो गुरुः स शिवः प्रोक्तो यः शिवः स गुरुः स्मृतः । गुरुर्वा शिव एवाथ विद्याकारेण संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: yo guruH sa shivaH prokto yaH shivaH sa guruH smR^itaH | gururvA shiva evAtha vidyAkAreNa saMsthitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथा शिवस्तथा विद्या यथा विद्या तथा गुरुः । शिवविद्या गुरूणां च पूजया सदृशं फलम्
verses.transliteration: yathA shivastathA vidyA yathA vidyA tathA guruH | shivavidyA gurUNAM cha pUjayA sadR^ishaM phalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेवात्मकश्चासौ सर्वमन्त्रमयो गुरुः । तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन यस्याज्ञां शिरसा वहेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvadevAtmakashchAsau sarvamantramayo guruH | tasmAtsarvaprayatnena yasyAj~nAM shirasA vahet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयोऽर्थी यदि गुर्वाज्ञां मनसापि न लङ्घयेत् । गुर्वाज्ञापालको यस्मात् ज्ञानसम्पत्तिमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: shreyo.arthI yadi gurvAj~nAM manasApi na la~Nghayet | gurvAj~nApAlako yasmAt j~nAnasampattimashnute
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छंस्तिष्ठन् स्वपन् भुञ्जन्नान्यत्कर्म समाचरेत् । समक्षं यदि कुर्वीत सर्वं चानुज्ञया गुरोः
verses.transliteration: gachChaMstiShThan svapan bhu~njannAnyatkarma samAcharet | samakShaM yadi kurvIta sarvaM chAnuj~nayA guroH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोर्गृहे समक्षं वा न यथेष्टासनो भवेत् । गुरुर्देवो यतः साक्षात्तद्गृहं देवमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: gurorgR^ihe samakShaM vA na yatheShTAsano bhavet | gururdevo yataH sAkShAttadgR^ihaM devamandiram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पापिनां च यथा सङ्गात्तत्पापात्पतितो भवेत् । यथेह वह्निसम्पर्कात् मलं त्यजति काञ्चनम् । तथैव गुरुसम्पर्कात् पापं त्यजति मानवः
verses.transliteration: pApinAM cha yathA sa~NgAttatpApAtpatito bhavet | yatheha vahnisamparkAt malaM tyajati kA~nchanam | tathaiva gurusamparkAt pApaM tyajati mAnavaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथा वह्निसमीपस्थो घृतकुम्भो विलीयते तथा पापं विलीयेत ह्याचार्यस्य समीपतः
verses.transliteration: yathA vahnisamIpastho ghR^itakumbho vilIyate tathA pApaM vilIyeta hyAchAryasya samIpataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रज्वलितो वह्निः शुष्कमार्द्रं च निर्दहेत् । तथायमपि सन्तुष्टो गुरुः पापं क्षणाद्दहेत्
verses.transliteration: yathA prajvalito vahniH shuShkamArdraM cha nirdahet | tathAyamapi santuShTo guruH pApaM kShaNAddahet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा गुरोः क्रोधं न कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: manasA karmaNA vAchA guroH krodhaM na kArayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि सर्वपापविशोधनम् । संस्कारं परमं पुण्यं शिवेन पतिभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | hanta te kathayiShyAmi sarvapApavishodhanam | saMskAraM paramaM puNyaM shivena patibhAShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य क्रोधेन दह्यन्ते ह्यायुः श्रीज्ञानसत्क्रियाः । तत्क्रोधकारिणो ये स्युस्तेषां यज्ञाश्च निष्फलाः
verses.transliteration: tasya krodhena dahyante hyAyuH shrIj~nAnasatkriyAH | tatkrodhakAriNo ye syusteShAM yaj~nAshcha niShphalAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यमश्च नियमाश्चैव नात्र कार्या विचारणा । गुरोर्विरुद्धं यद्वाक्यं न वदेज्जातुचिन्नरः
verses.transliteration: yamashcha niyamAshchaiva nAtra kAryA vichAraNA | gurorviruddhaM yadvAkyaM na vadejjAtuchinnaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वदेद्यदि महामोहाद्रौरवं नरकं व्रजेत् । मनसा कर्मणा वाचा गुरुमुद्दिश्य यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: vadedyadi mahAmohAdrauravaM narakaM vrajet | manasA karmaNA vAchA gurumuddishya yatnataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयोऽर्थी चेन्नरो धीमान्न मिथ्याचारमाचरेत् । गुरोर्हितं प्रियं कुर्यादादिष्टो वा न वा सदा
verses.transliteration: shreyo.arthI chennaro dhImAnna mithyAchAramAcharet | gurorhitaM priyaM kuryAdAdiShTo vA na vA sadA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असमक्षं समक्षं वा तस्य कार्यं समाचरेत् । इत्थमाचारवान्भक्तो नित्यमुद्युक्तमानसः
verses.transliteration: asamakShaM samakShaM vA tasya kAryaM samAcharet | itthamAchAravAnbhakto nityamudyuktamAnasaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुप्रियकरः शिष्यः शैवधर्मांस्ततोऽर्हति । गुरुश्चेद्गुणवान् प्राज्ञः परमानन्दभासकः
verses.transliteration: gurupriyakaraH shiShyaH shaivadharmAMstato.arhati | gurushchedguNavAn prAj~naH paramAnandabhAsakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वविच्छिवसंसक्तो मुक्तिदो न तु चापरः । संवित्सञ्जननं तत्त्वं परमानन्दसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: tattvavichChivasaMsakto muktido na tu chAparaH | saMvitsa~njananaM tattvaM paramAnandasambhavam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तत्त्वं विदितं येन स एवानन्ददर्शकः । न पुनर्नाममात्रेण संविदारहितस्तु यः
verses.transliteration: tattattvaM viditaM yena sa evAnandadarshakaH | na punarnAmamAtreNa saMvidArahitastu yaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योऽन्यं तारयेन्नौका किं शिला तारयेच्छिलाम् । एतस्य नाममात्रेण मुक्तिर्वै नाममात्रिका
verses.transliteration: anyo.anyaM tArayennaukA kiM shilA tArayechChilAm | etasya nAmamAtreNa muktirvai nAmamAtrikA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यैः पुनर्विदितं तत्त्वं ते मुक्ता मोचयन्त्यपि । तत्त्वहीने कुतो बोधः कुतो ह्यात्मपरिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: yaiH punarviditaM tattvaM te muktA mochayantyapi | tattvahIne kuto bodhaH kuto hyAtmaparigrahaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सम्यक् कृताधिकारः स्यात्पूजादिषु नरो यतः । संस्कारः कथ्यते तेन षडध्वपरिशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: samyak kR^itAdhikAraH syAtpUjAdiShu naro yataH | saMskAraH kathyate tena ShaDadhvaparishodhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: परिग्रहविनिर्मुक्तः पशुरित्यभिधीयते । पशुभिः प्रेरितश्चापि पशुत्वं नातिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: parigrahavinirmuktaH pashurityabhidhIyate | pashubhiH preritashchApi pashutvaM nAtivartate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तत्त्वविदेवेह मुक्तो मोचक इष्यते । सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तः सर्वशास्त्रविदप्ययम्
verses.transliteration: tasmAttattvavideveha mukto mochaka iShyate | sarvalakShaNasaMyuktaH sarvashAstravidapyayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपायविधिज्ञोऽपि तत्त्वहीनस्तु निष्फलः । यस्यानुभवपर्यन्ता बुद्धिस्तत्त्वे प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: sarvopAyavidhij~no.api tattvahInastu niShphalaH | yasyAnubhavaparyantA buddhistattve pravartate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यावलोकनाद्यैश्च परानन्दोऽभिजायते । तस्माद्यस्यैव सम्पर्कात्प्रबोधानन्दसम्भवः
verses.transliteration: tasyAvalokanAdyaishcha parAnando.abhijAyate | tasmAdyasyaiva samparkAtprabodhAnandasambhavaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं तमेव वृणुयान्नापरं मतिमान्नरः । स शिष्यैर्विनयाचारचतुरैरुचितो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: guruM tameva vR^iNuyAnnAparaM matimAnnaraH | sa shiShyairvinayAchArachaturairuchito guruH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यावद्विज्ञायते तावत्सेवनीयो मुमुक्षुभिः । ज्ञाते तस्मिन्स्थिरा भक्तिर्यावत्तत्त्वं समाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: yAvadvij~nAyate tAvatsevanIyo mumukShubhiH | j~nAte tasminsthirA bhaktiryAvattattvaM samAshrayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न तु तत्त्वं त्यजेज्जातु नोपेक्षेत कथञ्चन । यत्रानन्दः प्रबोधो वा नाल्पमप्युपलभ्यते
verses.transliteration: na tu tattvaM tyajejjAtu nopekSheta katha~nchana | yatrAnandaH prabodho vA nAlpamapyupalabhyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वत्सरादपि शिष्येण सोऽन्यं गुरुमुपाश्रयेत् । गुरुमन्यं प्रपन्नेऽपि नावमन्येत पौर्विकम् । गुरोर्भ्रातॄंस्तथा पुत्रान् बोधकान् प्रेरकानपि
verses.transliteration: vatsarAdapi shiShyeNa so.anyaM gurumupAshrayet | gurumanyaM prapanne.api nAvamanyeta paurvikam | gurorbhrAtR^IMstathA putrAn bodhakAn prerakAnapi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रादावुपसङ्गम्य ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् । गुरुमाराधयेत्प्राज्ञं शुभगं प्रियदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: tatrAdAvupasa~Ngamya brAhmaNaM vedapAragam | gurumArAdhayetprAj~naM shubhagaM priyadarshanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाभयप्रदातारं करुणाक्रान्तमानसम् । तोषयेत्तं प्रयत्नेन मनसा कर्मणा गिरा
verses.transliteration: sarvAbhayapradAtAraM karuNAkrAntamAnasam | toShayettaM prayatnena manasA karmaNA girA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दीयते येन विज्ञानं क्षीयते पाशबन्धनम् । तस्मात्संस्कार एवायं दीक्षेत्यपि च कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: dIyate yena vij~nAnaM kShIyate pAshabandhanam | tasmAtsaMskAra evAyaM dIkShetyapi cha kathyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तावदाराधयेच्छिष्यः प्रसन्नोऽसौ भवेद्यथा । तस्मिन् प्रसन्ने शिष्यस्य सद्यः पापक्षयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tAvadArAdhayechChiShyaH prasanno.asau bhavedyathA | tasmin prasanne shiShyasya sadyaH pApakShayo bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्धनानि रत्नानि क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च । भूषणानि च वासांसि यानशय्यासनानि च
verses.transliteration: tasmAddhanAni ratnAni kShetrANi cha gR^ihANi cha | bhUShaNAni cha vAsAMsi yAnashayyAsanAni cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एतानि गुरवे दद्याद्भक्त्या वित्तानुसारतः । वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत्परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: etAni gurave dadyAdbhaktyA vittAnusArataH | vittashAThyaM na kurvIta yadIchChetparamAM gatim
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स एव जनको माता भर्ता बन्धुर्धनं सुखम् । सखा मित्रं च यत्तस्मात्सर्वं तस्मै निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: sa eva janako mAtA bhartA bandhurdhanaM sukham | sakhA mitraM cha yattasmAtsarvaM tasmai nivedayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निवेद्य पश्चात्स्वात्मानं सान्वयं सपरिग्रहम् । समर्प्य सोदकं तस्मै नित्यं तद्वशगो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: nivedya pashchAtsvAtmAnaM sAnvayaM saparigraham | samarpya sodakaM tasmai nityaM tadvashago bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यदा शिवाय स्वात्मानं दत्तवान् देशिकात्मने । तदा शैवो भवेद्देही न ततोऽस्ति पुनर्भवः
verses.transliteration: yadA shivAya svAtmAnaM dattavAn deshikAtmane | tadA shaivo bhaveddehI na tato.asti punarbhavaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुश्च स्वाश्रितं शिष्यं वर्षमेकं परीक्षयेत् । ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियं वैश्यं द्विवर्षं च त्रिवर्षकम्
verses.transliteration: gurushcha svAshritaM shiShyaM varShamekaM parIkShayet | brAhmaNaM kShatriyaM vaishyaM dvivarShaM cha trivarShakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणद्रव्यप्रदानाद्यैरादेशैश्च समासमैः । उत्तमांश्चाधमे कृत्वा नीचानुत्तमकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: prANadravyapradAnAdyairAdeshaishcha samAsamaiH | uttamAMshchAdhame kR^itvA nIchAnuttamakarmaNi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आक्रुष्टास्ताडिता वापि ये विषादं न यान्त्यपि । ते योग्याः संयताः शुद्धाः शिवसंस्कारकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: AkruShTAstADitA vApi ye viShAdaM na yAntyapi | te yogyAH saMyatAH shuddhAH shivasaMskArakarmaNi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसका दयावन्तो नित्यमुद्युक्तचेतसः । अमानिनो बुद्धिमन्तः त्यक्तस्पर्द्धाः प्रियंवदाः
verses.transliteration: ahiMsakA dayAvanto nityamudyuktachetasaH | amAnino buddhimantaH tyaktasparddhAH priyaMvadAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शाम्भवी चैव शाक्ती च मान्त्री चैव शिवागमे । दीक्षोपदिश्यते त्रेधा शिवेन परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: shAmbhavI chaiva shAktI cha mAntrI chaiva shivAgame | dIkShopadishyate tredhA shivena paramAtmanA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऋजवो मृदवः स्वच्छा विनीताः स्थिरचेतसः । शौचाचारसमायुक्ताः शिवभक्ता द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: R^ijavo mR^idavaH svachChA vinItAH sthirachetasaH | shauchAchArasamAyuktAH shivabhaktA dvijAtayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वृत्तसमोपेता वाङ्मनःकायकर्मभिः । शोध्या बोध्या यथान्यायमिति शास्त्रेषु निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: evaM vR^ittasamopetA vA~NmanaHkAyakarmabhiH | shodhyA bodhyA yathAnyAyamiti shAstreShu nishchayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नाधिकारः स्वतो नार्याः शिवसंस्कारकर्मणि । नियोगाद्भर्तुरस्त्येव भक्तियुक्ता यदीश्वरे
verses.transliteration: nAdhikAraH svato nAryAH shivasaMskArakarmaNi | niyogAdbharturastyeva bhaktiyuktA yadIshvare
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव भर्तृहीनाया पुत्रादेरभ्यनुज्ञया । अधिकारो भवत्येव कन्यायाः पितुराज्ञया । शूद्राणां मर्त्यजातीनां पतितानां विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva bhartR^ihInAyA putrAderabhyanuj~nayA | adhikAro bhavatyeva kanyAyAH piturAj~nayA | shUdrANAM martyajAtInAM patitAnAM visheShataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथा सङ्करजातीनां नाध्वशुद्धिर्विधीयते । तैऽप्यकृत्रिमभावाश्चेच्छिवे परमकारणे
verses.transliteration: tathA sa~NkarajAtInAM nAdhvashuddhirvidhIyate | tai.apyakR^itrimabhAvAshchechChive paramakAraNe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पादोदकप्रदानाद्यैः कुर्युः पापविशोधनम् । अत्रानुलोमजाता ये युक्ता एव द्विजातिषु
verses.transliteration: pAdodakapradAnAdyaiH kuryuH pApavishodhanam | atrAnulomajAtA ye yuktA eva dvijAtiShu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामध्वविशुद्ध्यादि कुर्यान्मातृकुलोचितम् । या तु कन्या स्वपित्राद्यैः शिवधर्मे नियोजिता
verses.transliteration: teShAmadhvavishuddhyAdi kuryAnmAtR^ikulochitam | yA tu kanyA svapitrAdyaiH shivadharme niyojitA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सा भक्ताय प्रदातव्या नापराय विरोधिने । दत्ता चेत्प्रतिकूलाय प्रमादाद्बोधयेत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: sA bhaktAya pradAtavyA nAparAya virodhine | dattA chetpratikUlAya pramAdAdbodhayetpatim
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अशक्ता तं परित्यज्य मनसा धर्ममाचरेत् । यथा मुनिवरं त्यक्त्वा पतिमत्रिं पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: ashaktA taM parityajya manasA dharmamAcharet | yathA munivaraM tyaktvA patimatriM pativratA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृतकृत्याभवत्पूर्वं तपसाराध्य शङ्करम् । यथा नारायणं देवं तपसाराध्य पाण्डवाः
verses.transliteration: kR^itakR^ityAbhavatpUrvaM tapasArAdhya sha~Nkaram | yathA nArAyaNaM devaM tapasArAdhya pANDavAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोरालोकमात्रेण स्पर्शात्सम्भाषणादपि । सद्यः संज्ञा भवेज्जन्तोः पाशोपक्षयकारिणी
verses.transliteration: gurorAlokamAtreNa sparshAtsambhAShaNAdapi | sadyaH sa.nj~nA bhavejjantoH pAshopakShayakAriNI
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पततीँल्लब्धवती धर्मे गुरुभिर्न नियोजिता । अस्वातन्त्र्यकृतो दोषो नेहास्ति परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: patatI.NllabdhavatI dharme gurubhirna niyojitA | asvAtantryakR^ito doSho nehAsti paramArthataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवधर्मे नियुक्तायाः शिवशासनगौरवात् । बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन योऽपि कोऽपि शिवाश्रयः
verses.transliteration: shivadharme niyuktAyAH shivashAsanagauravAt | bahunAtra kimuktena yo.api ko.api shivAshrayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: संस्कार्यो गुर्वधीनश्चेत्संस्क्रिया न प्रभिद्यते । गुरोरालोकनादेव स्पर्शात्सम्भाषणादपि
verses.transliteration: saMskAryo gurvadhInashchetsaMskriyA na prabhidyate | gurorAlokanAdeva sparshAtsambhAShaNAdapi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य सञ्जायते प्रज्ञा तस्य नास्ति पराजयः । मनसा यस्तु संस्कारः क्रियते योगवर्त्मना
verses.transliteration: yasya sa~njAyate praj~nA tasya nAsti parAjayaH | manasA yastu saMskAraH kriyate yogavartmanA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स नेह कथितो गुह्यो गुरुवक्त्रैकगोचरः । क्रियावान् यस्तु संस्कारः कुण्डमण्डपपूर्वकः । स वक्ष्यते समासेन तस्य शक्यो न विस्तरः
verses.transliteration: sa neha kathito guhyo guruvaktraikagocharaH | kriyAvAn yastu saMskAraH kuNDamaNDapapUrvakaH | sa vakShyate samAsena tasya shakyo na vistaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सा दीक्षा शाम्भवी प्रोक्ता सा पुनर्भिद्यते द्विधा । तीव्रा तीव्रतरा चेति पाशोपक्षयभेदतः
verses.transliteration: sA dIkShA shAmbhavI proktA sA punarbhidyate dvidhA | tIvrA tIvratarA cheti pAshopakShayabhedataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यया स्यान्निर्वृतिः सद्यः सैव तीव्रतरा मता । तीव्रा तु जीवतोऽत्यन्तं पुंसः पापविशोधिका
verses.transliteration: yayA syAnnirvR^itiH sadyaH saiva tIvratarA matA | tIvrA tu jIvato.atyantaM puMsaH pApavishodhikA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१६. षोडशोऽध्यायः । शिष्यसंस्कारवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । पुण्येऽहनि शुचौ देशे बहुदोषविवर्जिते । देशिकः प्रथमं कुर्यात्संस्कारं समयाह्वयम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.16\. ShoDasho.adhyAyaH | shiShyasaMskAravarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | puNye.ahani shuchau deshe bahudoShavivarjite | deshikaH prathamaM kuryAtsaMskAraM samayAhvayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: व्रीहितन्दुलसिद्धार्थतिलपुष्पकुशास्तृते । तत्र लक्षणसंयुक्तं शिवकुम्भं प्रसाधयेत्
verses.transliteration: vrIhitandulasiddhArthatilapuShpakushAstR^ite | tatra lakShaNasaMyuktaM shivakumbhaM prasAdhayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सौवर्णं राजतं वापि ताम्रजं मृन्मयं तु वा । गन्धपुष्पाक्षताकीर्णं कुशदूर्वाङ्कुराचितम्
verses.transliteration: sauvarNaM rAjataM vApi tAmrajaM mR^inmayaM tu vA | gandhapuShpAkShatAkIrNaM kushadUrvA~NkurAchitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सितसूत्रावृतं कण्ठे नववस्त्रयुगावृतम् । शुद्धाम्बुपूर्णमुत्कूर्चं सद्रव्यं सपिधानकम्
verses.transliteration: sitasUtrAvR^itaM kaNThe navavastrayugAvR^itam | shuddhAmbupUrNamutkUrchaM sadravyaM sapidhAnakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भृङ्गारं वर्धनीं चापि शङ्खं च चक्रमेव वा । विना सूत्रादिकं सर्वं पद्मपत्रमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: bhR^i~NgAraM vardhanIM chApi sha~NkhaM cha chakrameva vA | vinA sUtrAdikaM sarvaM padmapatramathApi vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यासनारविन्दस्य कल्पयेदुत्तरे दले । अग्रतश्चन्दनाम्भोभिरस्त्रराजस्य वर्धनीम्
verses.transliteration: tasyAsanAravindasya kalpayeduttare dale | agratashchandanAmbhobhirastrarAjasya vardhanIm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मण्डलस्य ततः प्राच्यां मन्त्रकुम्भे च पूर्ववत् । कृत्वा विधिवदीशस्य महापूजां समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: maNDalasya tataH prAchyAM mantrakumbhe cha pUrvavat | kR^itvA vidhivadIshasya mahApUjAM samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथार्णवस्य तीरे वा नद्यां गोष्ठेऽपि वा गिरौ । देवागरे गृहे वापि देशेऽन्यस्मिन्मनोहरे
verses.transliteration: athArNavasya tIre vA nadyAM goShThe.api vA girau | devAgare gR^ihe vApi deshe.anyasminmanohare
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पूर्वोदितं सर्वं विना वा मण्डपादिकम् । मण्डलं पूर्ववत्कृत्वा स्थण्डिलं च विभावसोः
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA pUrvoditaM sarvaM vinA vA maNDapAdikam | maNDalaM pUrvavatkR^itvA sthaNDilaM cha vibhAvasoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य पूजाभवनं प्रहृष्टवदनो गुरुः । सर्वमङ्गलसंयुक्तः समाचरितनैत्यकः
verses.transliteration: pravishya pUjAbhavanaM prahR^iShTavadano guruH | sarvama~NgalasaMyuktaH samAcharitanaityakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: महापूजां महेशस्य कृत्वा मण्डलमध्यतः । शिवकुम्भे तथा भूयः शिवमावाह्य पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: mahApUjAM maheshasya kR^itvA maNDalamadhyataH | shivakumbhe tathA bhUyaH shivamAvAhya pUjayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: परीक्ष्य भूमिं विधिवद् गन्धवर्णरसादिभिः । शिल्पिशास्त्रोक्तमार्गेण मण्डपं तत्र कल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: parIkShya bhUmiM vidhivad gandhavarNarasAdibhiH | shilpishAstroktamArgeNa maNDapaM tatra kalpayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमाभिमुखं ध्यात्वा यज्ञरक्षकमीश्वरम् । अर्चयेदस्त्रवर्द्धन्यामस्त्रमीशस्य दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: pashchimAbhimukhaM dhyAtvA yaj~narakShakamIshvaram | archayedastravarddhanyAmastramIshasya dakShiNe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रकुम्भे च विन्यस्य मन्त्रं मन्त्रविशारदः । कृत्वा मुद्रादिकं सर्वं मन्त्रयागं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: mantrakumbhe cha vinyasya mantraM mantravishAradaH | kR^itvA mudrAdikaM sarvaM mantrayAgaM samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिवानले होमं कुर्याद्देशिकसत्तमः । प्रधानकुण्डे परितो जुहुयुश्चापरे द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tataH shivAnale homaM kuryAddeshikasattamaH | pradhAnakuNDe parito juhuyushchApare dvijAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आचार्यात्पादमर्द्धं वा होमस्तेषां विधीयते । प्रधानकुण्ड एवाथ जुहुयाद्देशिकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: AchAryAtpAdamarddhaM vA homasteShAM vidhIyate | pradhAnakuNDa evAtha juhuyAddeshikottamaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायमपरे कुर्युः स्तोत्रं मङ्गलवाचनम् । जपं च विधिवच्चान्ये शिवभक्तिपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: svAdhyAyamapare kuryuH stotraM ma~NgalavAchanam | japaM cha vidhivachchAnye shivabhaktiparAyaNAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यं गीतं च वाद्यं च मङ्गलान्यपराणि च । पूजनं च सदस्यानां कृत्वा सम्यग्विधानतः
verses.transliteration: nR^ityaM gItaM cha vAdyaM cha ma~NgalAnyaparANi cha | pUjanaM cha sadasyAnAM kR^itvA samyagvidhAnataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्याहं कारयित्वाथ पुनः सम्पूज्य शङ्करम् । प्रार्थयेद्देशिको देवं शिष्यानुग्रहकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: puNyAhaM kArayitvAtha punaH sampUjya sha~Nkaram | prArthayeddeshiko devaM shiShyAnugrahakAmyayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद देवदेवेश देहमाविश्य मामकम् । विमोचयैनं विश्वेश घृणया च घृणानिधे
verses.transliteration: prasIda devadevesha dehamAvishya mAmakam | vimochayainaM vishvesha ghR^iNayA cha ghR^iNAnidhe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ चैवं करोमीति लब्धानुज्ञस्तु देशिकः । आनीयोपोषितं शिष्यं हविष्याशिनमेव वा
verses.transliteration: atha chaivaM karomIti labdhAnuj~nastu deshikaH | AnIyopoShitaM shiShyaM haviShyAshinameva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एकाशनं वा विरतं स्नातं प्रातःकृतक्रियम् । जपन्तं प्रणवं देवं ध्यायन्तं कृतमङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration: ekAshanaM vA virataM snAtaM prAtaHkR^itakriyam | japantaM praNavaM devaM dhyAyantaM kR^itama~Ngalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा वेदिं च तन्मध्ये कुण्डानि परिकल्पयेत् । अष्टदिक्षु तथा दिक्षु तत्रैशान्यां पुनः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA vediM cha tanmadhye kuNDAni parikalpayet | aShTadikShu tathA dikShu tatraishAnyAM punaH kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: द्वारस्य पश्चिमस्याग्रमण्डले दक्षिणस्य वा । दर्भासने समासीनं विधायोदङ्मुखं शिशुम्
verses.transliteration: dvArasya pashchimasyAgramaNDale dakShiNasya vA | darbhAsane samAsInaM vidhAyoda~NmukhaM shishum
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं प्राग्वदनस्तिष्ठन्नूर्ध्वकायं कृताञ्जलिम् । सम्प्रोक्ष्य प्रोक्षणीतोयैर्मूर्द्धन्यस्त्रेण मुद्रया
verses.transliteration: svayaM prAgvadanastiShThannUrdhvakAyaM kR^itA~njalim | samprokShya prokShaNItoyairmUrddhanyastreNa mudrayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पक्षेपेण सन्ताड्य बध्नीयाल्लोचनं गुरुः । दुकूलार्द्धेन वस्त्रेण मन्त्रितेन नवेन च
verses.transliteration: puShpakShepeNa santADya badhnIyAllochanaM guruH | dukUlArddhena vastreNa mantritena navena cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रवेशयेच्छिष्यं गुरुर्द्वारेण मण्डलम् । सोऽपि तेनेरितः शम्भोराचरेत् त्रिःप्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: tataH praveshayechChiShyaM gururdvAreNa maNDalam | so.api teneritaH shambhorAcharet triHpradakShiNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुवर्णसम्मिश्रं दत्त्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं प्रभोः । प्राङ्मुखश्चोदङ्मुखो वा प्रणमेद्दण्डवत्क्षितौ
verses.transliteration: tataH suvarNasammishraM dattvA puShpA~njaliM prabhoH | prA~Nmukhashchoda~Nmukho vA praNameddaNDavatkShitau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सम्प्रोक्ष्य मूलेन शिरस्यस्त्रेण पूर्ववत् । सन्ताड्य देशिकस्तस्य मोचयेन्नेत्रबन्धनम्
verses.transliteration: tataH samprokShya mUlena shirasyastreNa pUrvavat | santADya deshikastasya mochayennetrabandhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा मण्डलं भूयः प्रणमेत्साञ्जलिः प्रभुम् । अथासीनं शिवाचार्यो मण्डलस्य तु दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: sa dR^iShTvA maNDalaM bhUyaH praNametsA~njaliH prabhum | athAsInaM shivAchAryo maNDalasya tu dakShiNe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपवेश्यात्मनः सव्ये शिष्यं दर्भासने गुरुः । आराध्य च महादेवं शिवहस्तं प्रविन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: upaveshyAtmanaH savye shiShyaM darbhAsane guruH | ArAdhya cha mahAdevaM shivahastaM pravinyaset
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवतेजोमयं पाणिं शिवमन्त्रमुदीरयेत् । शिवाभिमानसम्पन्नो न्यसेच्छिष्यस्य मस्तके
verses.transliteration: shivatejomayaM pANiM shivamantramudIrayet | shivAbhimAnasampanno nyasechChiShyasya mastake
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गालम्बनं चैव कुर्यात्तेनैव देशिकः । शिष्योऽपि प्रणमेद्भूमौ देशिकाकृतिमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvA~NgAlambanaM chaiva kuryAttenaiva deshikaH | shiShyo.api praNamedbhUmau deshikAkR^itimIshvaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानकुण्डं कुर्वीत यद्वा पश्चिमभागतः । प्रधानमेकमेवाथ कृत्वा शोभां प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: pradhAnakuNDaM kurvIta yadvA pashchimabhAgataH | pradhAnamekamevAtha kR^itvA shobhAM prakalpayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिवानले देवं समभ्यर्च्य यथाविधि । हुताहुतित्रयं शिष्यमुपवेश्य यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: tataH shivAnale devaM samabhyarchya yathAvidhi | hutAhutitrayaM shiShyamupaveshya yathA purA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दर्भाग्रैः संस्पृशंस्तं च विद्ययात्मानमाविशेत् । नमस्कृत्य महादेवं नाडीसन्धानमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: darbhAgraiH saMspR^ishaMstaM cha vidyayAtmAnamAvishet | namaskR^itya mahAdevaM nADIsandhAnamAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवशास्त्रोक्तमार्गेण कृत्वा प्राणस्य निर्गमम् । शिष्यदेहप्रवेशं च स्मृत्वा मन्त्रांस्तु तर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: shivashAstroktamArgeNa kR^itvA prANasya nirgamam | shiShyadehapraveshaM cha smR^itvA mantrAMstu tarpayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तर्पणाय मूलस्य तेनैवाहुतयो दश । देयास्तिस्रस्तथाङ्गानामङ्गैरेव यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: santarpaNAya mUlasya tenaivAhutayo dasha | deyAstisrastathA~NgAnAma~Ngaireva yathAkramam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पूर्णाहुतिं दत्त्वा प्रायश्चित्ताय देशिकः । पुनर्दशाहुतीः कुर्यान्मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: tataH pUrNAhutiM dattvA prAyashchittAya deshikaH | punardashAhutIH kuryAnmUlamantreNa mantravit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः सम्पूज्य देवेशं सम्यगाचम्य देशिकः । हुत्वा चैव यथान्यायं स्वजात्या वैश्यमुद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: punaH sampUjya deveshaM samyagAchamya deshikaH | hutvA chaiva yathAnyAyaM svajAtyA vaishyamuddharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं जनयेत्क्षात्रमुद्धारं च ततः पुनः । कृत्वा तथैव विप्रत्वं जनयेदस्य देशिकः
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaM janayetkShAtramuddhAraM cha tataH punaH | kR^itvA tathaiva vipratvaM janayedasya deshikaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: राजन्यं चैवमुद्धृत्य कृत्वा विप्रं पुनस्तयोः । रुद्रत्वं जनयेद्विप्रे रुद्रनामैव साधयेत्
verses.transliteration: rAjanyaM chaivamuddhR^itya kR^itvA vipraM punastayoH | rudratvaM janayedvipre rudranAmaiva sAdhayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्षणं ताडनं कृत्वा शिशोः स्वात्मानमात्मनि । शिवात्मकमनुस्मृत्य स्फुरन्तं विस्फुलिङ्गवत्
verses.transliteration: prokShaNaM tADanaM kR^itvA shishoH svAtmAnamAtmani | shivAtmakamanusmR^itya sphurantaM visphuli~Ngavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नाड्या यथोक्तया वायुं रेचयेन्मन्त्रतो गुरुः । निर्गम्य प्रविशेन्नाड्यां शिष्यस्य हृदयं तथा
verses.transliteration: nADyA yathoktayA vAyuM rechayenmantrato guruH | nirgamya pravishennADyAM shiShyasya hR^idayaM tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वितानध्वजमालाभिर्विविधाभिरनेकशः । वेदिमध्ये ततः कुर्यान्मण्डलं शुभलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: vitAnadhvajamAlAbhirvividhAbhiranekashaH | vedimadhye tataH kuryAnmaNDalaM shubhalakShaNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य तस्य चैतन्यं नीलबिन्दुनिभं स्मरन् । स्वतेजसापास्तमलं ज्वलन्तमनुचिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: pravishya tasya chaitanyaM nIlabindunibhaM smaran | svatejasApAstamalaM jvalantamanuchintayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तमादाय तया नाड्या मन्त्री संहारमुद्रया । न पूरकेण निवेश्यैनमेकीभावार्थमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tamAdAya tayA nADyA mantrI saMhAramudrayA | na pUrakeNa niveshyainamekIbhAvArthamAtmanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भकेन तथा नाड्या रेचकेन यथा पुरा । तस्मादादाय शिष्यस्य हृदये तं निवेशयेत्
verses.transliteration: kumbhakena tathA nADyA rechakena yathA purA | tasmAdAdAya shiShyasya hR^idaye taM niveshayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तमालभ्य शिवाल्लब्धं तस्मै दत्त्वोपवीतकम् । हुत्वाऽऽहुतित्रयं पश्चाद्दद्यात्पूर्णाहुतिं ततः
verses.transliteration: tamAlabhya shivAllabdhaM tasmai dattvopavItakam | hutvA.a.ahutitrayaM pashchAddadyAtpUrNAhutiM tataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य दक्षिणे शिष्यमुपवेश्य वरासने । कुशपुष्पपरिस्तीर्णे बद्धाञ्जलिरुदङ्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: devasya dakShiNe shiShyamupaveshya varAsane | kushapuShpaparistIrNe baddhA~njaliruda~Nmukham
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्तिकासनमारूढं विधाय प्राङ्मुखः स्वयम् । वरासनस्थितो मन्त्रैर्महामङ्गलनिःस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: svastikAsanamArUDhaM vidhAya prA~NmukhaH svayam | varAsanasthito mantrairmahAma~NgalaniHsvanaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: समादाय घटं पूर्णं पूर्णमेव प्रसाधितम् । ध्यायमानः शिवं शिष्यमभिषिञ्चेत देशिकः
verses.transliteration: samAdAya ghaTaM pUrNaM pUrNameva prasAdhitam | dhyAyamAnaH shivaM shiShyamabhiShi~ncheta deshikaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथापनुद्य स्नानाम्बु परिधाय सिताम्बरम् । आचान्तोऽलङ्कृतः शिष्यः प्राञ्जलिर्मण्डपं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: athApanudya snAnAmbu paridhAya sitAmbaram | AchAnto.ala~NkR^itaH shiShyaH prA~njalirmaNDapaM vrajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपवेश्य यथापूर्वं तं गुरुर्दर्भविष्टरे । सम्पूज्य मण्डले देवं करन्यासं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: upaveshya yathApUrvaM taM gururdarbhaviShTare | sampUjya maNDale devaM karanyAsaM samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु भस्मना देवं ध्यायेन्मनसि देशिकः । समालभेत पाणिभ्यां शिशुं शिवमुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: tatastu bhasmanA devaM dhyAyenmanasi deshikaH | samAlabheta pANibhyAM shishuM shivamudIrayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तहेमादिभिश्चूर्णैरीश्वरावाहनोचितम् । सिन्दूरशालिनीवारचूर्णैरेवाथ निर्धनः
verses.transliteration: raktahemAdibhishchUrNairIshvarAvAhanochitam | sindUrashAlinIvArachUrNairevAtha nirdhanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्य शिवाचार्यो दहनप्लावनादिकम् । सकलीकरणं कृत्वा मातृकान्यासवर्त्मना
verses.transliteration: atha tasya shivAchAryo dahanaplAvanAdikam | sakalIkaraNaM kR^itvA mAtR^ikAnyAsavartmanA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिवासनं ध्यात्वा शिष्यमूर्द्धनि देशिकः । तत्रावाह्य यथान्यायमर्चयेन्मनसा शिवम्
verses.transliteration: tataH shivAsanaM dhyAtvA shiShyamUrddhani deshikaH | tatrAvAhya yathAnyAyamarchayenmanasA shivam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थयेत्प्राञ्जलिर्देवं नित्यमत्र स्थितो भव । इति विज्ञाप्य तं शम्भोस्तेजसा भासुरं स्मरेत्
verses.transliteration: prArthayetprA~njalirdevaM nityamatra sthito bhava | iti vij~nApya taM shambhostejasA bhAsuraM smaret
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्याथ शिवं शैवीमाज्ञां प्राप्य शिवात्मिकाम् । कर्णे शिष्यस्य शनकैः शिवमन्त्रमुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: sampUjyAtha shivaM shaivImAj~nAM prApya shivAtmikAm | karNe shiShyasya shanakaiH shivamantramudIrayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स तु बद्धाञ्जलिः श्रुत्वा मन्त्रं तद्गतमानसः । शनैस्तं व्याहरेच्छिष्यः शिवाचार्यस्य शासनात्
verses.transliteration: sa tu baddhA~njaliH shrutvA mantraM tadgatamAnasaH | shanaistaM vyAharechChiShyaH shivAchAryasya shAsanAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शाक्तं च सन्दिश्य मन्त्रं मन्त्रविचक्षणः । उच्चारयित्वा च सुखं तस्मै मङ्गलमादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH shAktaM cha sandishya mantraM mantravichakShaNaH | uchchArayitvA cha sukhaM tasmai ma~NgalamAdishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समासान्मन्त्रार्थं वाच्यवाचकयोगतः । समादिश्येश्वरं रूपं योगमासनमादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH samAsAnmantrArthaM vAchyavAchakayogataH | samAdishyeshvaraM rUpaM yogamAsanamAdishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ गुर्वाज्ञया शिष्यः शिवाग्निगुरुसन्निधौ । भक्त्यैवमभिसन्धाय दीक्षावाक्यमुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: atha gurvAj~nayA shiShyaH shivAgnigurusannidhau | bhaktyaivamabhisandhAya dIkShAvAkyamudIrayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वरं प्राणपरित्यागश्छेदनं शिरसोऽपि वा । न त्वनभ्यर्च्य भुञ्जीय भगवन्तं त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: varaM prANaparityAgashChedanaM shiraso.api vA | na tvanabhyarchya bhu~njIya bhagavantaM trilochanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स एव दद्यान्नियतो यावन्मोहविपर्ययः । तावदाराधयेद्देवं तन्निष्ठस्तत्परायणः
verses.transliteration: sa eva dadyAnniyato yAvanmohaviparyayaH | tAvadArAdhayeddevaM tanniShThastatparAyaNaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एकहस्तं द्विहस्तं वा सितं वा रक्तमेव वा । एकहस्तस्य पद्मस्य कर्णिकाष्टाङ्गुला मता
verses.transliteration: ekahastaM dvihastaM vA sitaM vA raktameva vA | ekahastasya padmasya karNikAShTA~NgulA matA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स समयो नाम भविष्यति शिवाश्रमे । लब्धाधिकारो गुर्वाज्ञापालकस्तद्वशो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH sa samayo nAma bhaviShyati shivAshrame | labdhAdhikAro gurvAj~nApAlakastadvasho bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं न्यस्तकरो भस्मादाय स्वहस्ततः । दद्याच्छिष्याय मूलेन रुद्राक्षं चाभिमन्त्रितम्
verses.transliteration: ataH paraM nyastakaro bhasmAdAya svahastataH | dadyAchChiShyAya mUlena rudrAkShaM chAbhimantritam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिमा वापि देवस्य गूढदेहमथापि वा । पूजाहोमजपध्यानसाधनानि च सम्भवे
verses.transliteration: pratimA vApi devasya gUDhadehamathApi vA | pUjAhomajapadhyAnasAdhanAni cha sambhave
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि शिष्यः शिवाचार्याल्लब्धानि बहुमानतः । आददीताज्ञया तस्य देशिकस्य न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: so.api shiShyaH shivAchAryAllabdhAni bahumAnataH | AdadItAj~nayA tasya deshikasya na chAnyathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आचार्यादाप्तमखिलं शिरस्याधाय भक्तितः । रक्षयेत्पूजयेच्छम्भुं मठे वा गृह एव वा
verses.transliteration: AchAryAdAptamakhilaM shirasyAdhAya bhaktitaH | rakShayetpUjayechChambhuM maThe vA gR^iha eva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं शिवाचारमादिशेदस्य देशिकः । भक्तिश्रद्धानुसारेण प्रज्ञायाश्चानुसारतः
verses.transliteration: ataH paraM shivAchAramAdishedasya deshikaH | bhaktishraddhAnusAreNa praj~nAyAshchAnusArataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यदुक्तं यत्समाज्ञातं यच्चैवान्यत्प्रकीर्तितम् । शिवाचार्येण समये तत्सर्वं शिरसा वहेत्
verses.transliteration: yaduktaM yatsamAj~nAtaM yachchaivAnyatprakIrtitam | shivAchAryeNa samaye tatsarvaM shirasA vahet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवागमस्य ग्रहणं वाचनं श्रवणं तथा । देशिकदेशतः कुर्यान्न स्वेच्छातो न चान्यतः
verses.transliteration: shivAgamasya grahaNaM vAchanaM shravaNaM tathA | deshikadeshataH kuryAnna svechChAto na chAnyataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इति सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तः संस्कारः समयाह्वयः । साक्षाच्छिवपुरप्राप्तौ नृणां परमसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: iti sa~NkShepataH proktaH saMskAraH samayAhvayaH | sAkShAchChivapuraprAptau nR^iNAM paramasAdhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: केसराणि तदर्धानि शेषं चाष्टदलादिकम् । द्विहस्तस्य तु पद्मस्य द्विगुणं कर्णिकादिकम्
verses.transliteration: kesarANi tadardhAni sheShaM chAShTadalAdikam | dvihastasya tu padmasya dviguNaM karNikAdikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा शोभोपशोभाढ्य मैशान्यां तस्य कल्पयेत् । एकहस्तं तदर्द्धं वा पुनर्वेद्यां तु मण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA shobhopashobhADhya maishAnyAM tasya kalpayet | ekahastaM tadarddhaM vA punarvedyAM tu maNDalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१७. सप्तदशोऽध्यायः । शिवदीक्षाविधानवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । अतः परं समावेक्ष्य गुरुः शिष्यस्य योग्यताम् । षडध्वशुद्धिं कुर्वीत सर्वबन्धविमुक्तये
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.17\. saptadasho.adhyAyaH | shivadIkShAvidhAnavarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | ataH paraM samAvekShya guruH shiShyasya yogyatAm | ShaDadhvashuddhiM kurvIta sarvabandhavimuktaye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्यव्यापकता तेन ज्ञातुमेव न शक्यते । तस्मादध्वस्वरूपं च व्याप्यव्यापकतां तथा
verses.transliteration: vyApyavyApakatA tena j~nAtumeva na shakyate | tasmAdadhvasvarUpaM cha vyApyavyApakatAM tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथावदवगम्यैव कुर्यादध्वविशोधनम् । कुण्डमण्डलपर्यन्तं तत्र कृत्वा यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: yathAvadavagamyaiva kuryAdadhvavishodhanam | kuNDamaNDalaparyantaM tatra kR^itvA yathA purA
