verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: द्विहस्तमानं कुर्वीत प्राच्यां कलशमण्डलम् । ततः स्नातः शिवाचार्यः सशिष्यः कृतनैत्यकः
verses.transliteration: dvihastamAnaM kurvIta prAchyAM kalashamaNDalam | tataH snAtaH shivAchAryaH sashiShyaH kR^itanaityakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य मण्डलं शम्भोः पूजां पूर्ववदाचरेत् । तत्राढकावरैः सिद्धं तन्दुलैः पायसं प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: pravishya maNDalaM shambhoH pUjAM pUrvavadAcharet | tatrADhakAvaraiH siddhaM tandulaiH pAyasaM prabhoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अर्द्धं निवेद्य होमार्थं शेषं समुपकल्पयेत् । पुरतः कल्पिते वाथ मण्डले वर्णिमण्डिते
verses.transliteration: arddhaM nivedya homArthaM sheShaM samupakalpayet | purataH kalpite vAtha maNDale varNimaNDite
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयेत्पञ्चकलशान्दिक्षु मध्ये च देशिकः । तेषु ब्रह्माणि मूलार्णैर्बिन्दुनादसमन्वितैः
verses.transliteration: sthApayetpa~nchakalashAndikShu madhye cha deshikaH | teShu brahmANi mUlArNairbindunAdasamanvitaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नम आद्यैर्यकरान्तैः कल्पयेत्कल्पवित्तमः । ईशानं मध्यमे कुम्भे पुरुषं पुरतः स्थिते
verses.transliteration: nama AdyairyakarAntaiH kalpayetkalpavittamaH | IshAnaM madhyame kumbhe puruShaM purataH sthite
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अघोरं दक्षिणे वामे वामं सद्यं च पश्चिमे । रक्षां विधाय मुद्रां च बद्धा कुम्भाभिमन्त्रणम्
verses.transliteration: aghoraM dakShiNe vAme vAmaM sadyaM cha pashchime | rakShAM vidhAya mudrAM cha baddhA kumbhAbhimantraNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा शिवानलैर्होमं प्रारभेत यथा पुरा । यदर्द्धं पायसं पूर्वं होमार्थं परिकल्पितम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA shivAnalairhomaM prArabheta yathA purA | yadarddhaM pAyasaM pUrvaM homArthaM parikalpitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा शिष्यस्य तच्छेषं भोक्तुं समुपकल्पयेत् । तर्पणान्तं च मन्त्राणां कृत्वा कर्म यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: hutvA shiShyasya tachCheShaM bhoktuM samupakalpayet | tarpaNAntaM cha mantrANAM kR^itvA karma yathA purA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कलां तत्त्वं च भुवनं वर्णं पदमतः परम् । मन्त्रश्चेति समासेन षडध्वा परिपठ्यते
verses.transliteration: kalAM tattvaM cha bhuvanaM varNaM padamataH param | mantrashcheti samAsena ShaDadhvA paripaThyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा पूर्णाहुतिं तेषां ततः कुर्यात्प्रदीपनम् । ऊँ कारादनु हुङ्कारं ततो मूलं फडन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: hutvA pUrNAhutiM teShAM tataH kuryAtpradIpanam | U.N kArAdanu hu~NkAraM tato mUlaM phaDantakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहान्तं दीपने प्राहुरङ्गानि च यथाक्रमम् । तेषामाहुतयस्तिस्रो देया दीपनकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: svAhAntaM dIpane prAhura~NgAni cha yathAkramam | teShAmAhutayastisro deyA dIpanakarmaNi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रैरेकैकशस्तैस्तु विचिन्त्या दीप्तमूर्तयः । त्रिगुणं त्रिगुणीकृत्य द्विजकन्याकृतं सितम्
verses.transliteration: mantrairekaikashastaistu vichintyA dIptamUrtayaH | triguNaM triguNIkR^itya dvijakanyAkR^itaM sitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सूत्रं सूत्रेण सम्मन्त्र्य शिखाग्रे बन्धयेच्छिशोः । चरणाङ्गुष्ठपर्यन्तमूर्ध्वकायस्य तिष्ठतः
verses.transliteration: sUtraM sUtreNa sammantrya shikhAgre bandhayechChishoH | charaNA~NguShThaparyantamUrdhvakAyasya tiShThataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लम्बयित्वा तु तत्सूत्रं सुषुम्णां तत्र योजयेत् । शान्तया मुद्रयादाय मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: lambayitvA tu tatsUtraM suShumNAM tatra yojayet | shAntayA mudrayAdAya mUlamantreNa mantravit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वाहुतित्रयं तस्याः सान्निध्यमुपकल्पयेत् । हृदि सन्ताड्य शिष्यस्य पुष्पक्षेपेण पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: hutvAhutitrayaM tasyAH sAnnidhyamupakalpayet | hR^idi santADya shiShyasya puShpakShepeNa pUrvavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चैतन्यं समुपादाय द्वादशान्ते निवेद्य च । सूत्रं सूत्रेण संयोज्य संरक्ष्यास्त्रेण वर्मणा
verses.transliteration: chaitanyaM samupAdAya dvAdashAnte nivedya cha | sUtraM sUtreNa saMyojya saMrakShyAstreNa varmaNA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अवगुण्ठ्याथ तत्सूत्रं शिष्यदेहं विचिन्तयेत् । मूलत्रयमयं पाशं भोगभोग्यत्वलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: avaguNThyAtha tatsUtraM shiShyadehaM vichintayet | mUlatrayamayaM pAshaM bhogabhogyatvalakShaNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विषयेन्द्रियदेहादिजनकं तस्य भावयेत् । व्योमादिभूतरूपिण्यः शान्त्यतीतादयः कलाः
verses.transliteration: viShayendriyadehAdijanakaM tasya bhAvayet | vyomAdibhUtarUpiNyaH shAntyatItAdayaH kalAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सूत्रे स्वनामभिर्योज्यः पूज्यश्चैव नमोयुतैः । अथवा बीजभूतैस्तत्कृत्वा पूर्वोदितं क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sUtre svanAmabhiryojyaH pUjyashchaiva namoyutaiH | athavA bIjabhUtaistatkR^itvA pUrvoditaM kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्त्याद्याः कलाः पञ्च कलाध्वा कथ्यते बुधैः । व्याप्ताः कलाभिरितरे त्वध्वानः पञ्च पञ्चभिः
verses.transliteration: nivR^ittyAdyAH kalAH pa~ncha kalAdhvA kathyate budhaiH | vyAptAH kalAbhiritare tvadhvAnaH pa~ncha pa~nchabhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मलादेस्तत्त्वादौ व्याप्तिं समवलोकयेत् । कलाव्याप्तिं मलादौ च हुत्वा सन्दीपयेत्कलाः
verses.transliteration: tato malAdestattvAdau vyAptiM samavalokayet | kalAvyAptiM malAdau cha hutvA sandIpayetkalAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यं शिरसि सन्ताड्य सूत्रं देहे यथाक्रमम् । शान्त्यतीतपदे सूत्रं लाञ्छयेन्मन्त्रमुच्चरन्
verses.transliteration: shiShyaM shirasi santADya sUtraM dehe yathAkramam | shAntyatItapade sUtraM lA~nChayenmantramuchcharan
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा निवृत्त्यन्तं शान्त्यतीतमनुक्रमात् । हुत्वाहुतित्रयं पश्चान्मण्डले च शिवं यजेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM kR^itvA nivR^ittyantaM shAntyatItamanukramAt | hutvAhutitrayaM pashchAnmaNDale cha shivaM yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य दक्षिणे शिष्यमुपवेश्योत्तरामुखम् । सदर्भे मण्डले दद्याद्धोमशिष्टं चरुं गुरुः
verses.transliteration: devasya dakShiNe shiShyamupaveshyottarAmukham | sadarbhe maNDale dadyAddhomashiShTaM charuM guruH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यस्तद्गुरुणा दत्तं सत्कृत्य शिवपूर्वकम् । भुक्त्वा पश्चाद् द्विराचम्य शिवमन्त्रमुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: shiShyastadguruNA dattaM satkR^itya shivapUrvakam | bhuktvA pashchAd dvirAchamya shivamantramudIrayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अपरे मण्डले दद्यात् पञ्चगव्यं तथा गुरुः । सोऽपि तच्छक्तितः पीत्वा द्विराचम्य शिवं स्मरेत्
verses.transliteration: apare maNDale dadyAt pa~nchagavyaM tathA guruH | so.api tachChaktitaH pItvA dvirAchamya shivaM smaret
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीये मण्डले शिष्यमुपवेश्य यथा पुरा । प्रदद्याद्दन्तपवनं यथाशास्त्रोक्तलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tR^itIye maNDale shiShyamupaveshya yathA purA | pradadyAddantapavanaM yathAshAstroktalakShaNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रेण तस्य मृदुना प्राङ्मुखो वाप्युदङ्मुखः । वाचं नियम्य चासीनः शिष्यो दन्तान्विशोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: agreNa tasya mR^idunA prA~Nmukho vApyuda~NmukhaH | vAchaM niyamya chAsInaH shiShyo dantAnvishodhayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य दन्तपवनं त्यक्त्वाचम्य शिवं स्मरेत् । प्रविशेद्देशिकादिष्टः प्राञ्जलिः शिवमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: prakShAlya dantapavanaM tyaktvAchamya shivaM smaret | pravisheddeshikAdiShTaH prA~njaliH shivamaNDalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्तं तद्दन्तपवनं दृश्यते गुरुणा यदि । प्रागुदक्पश्चिमे वाग्रे शिवमन्यच्छिवेतरम्
verses.transliteration: tyaktaM taddantapavanaM dR^ishyate guruNA yadi | prAgudakpashchime vAgre shivamanyachChivetaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवतत्त्वादिभूम्यन्तं तत्त्वाध्वा समुदाहृतः । षड्विंशत्सङ्ख्ययोपेतः शुद्धाशुद्धोभयात्मकः
verses.transliteration: shivatattvAdibhUmyantaM tattvAdhvA samudAhR^itaH | ShaDviMshatsa~NkhyayopetaH shuddhAshuddhobhayAtmakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अशस्ताशामुखे तस्मिन् गुरुस्तद्दोषशान्तये । शतमर्द्धं तदर्द्धं वा जुहुयान्मूलमन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: ashastAshAmukhe tasmin gurustaddoShashAntaye | shatamarddhaM tadarddhaM vA juhuyAnmUlamantrataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिष्यं समालभ्य जपित्वा कर्णयोः शिवम् । देवस्य दक्षिणे भागे तं शिष्यमधिवासयेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH shiShyaM samAlabhya japitvA karNayoH shivam | devasya dakShiNe bhAge taM shiShyamadhivAsayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अहतास्तरणास्तीर्णे स दर्भशयने शुचिः । मन्त्रितेऽन्तः शिवं ध्यायन् शयीत प्राक् शिरा निशि
verses.transliteration: ahatAstaraNAstIrNe sa darbhashayane shuchiH | mantrite.antaH shivaM dhyAyan shayIta prAk shirA nishi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिखायां बद्धसूत्रस्य शिखया तच्छिखां गुरुः । आबध्याहतवस्त्रेण तमाच्छाद्य च वर्मणा
verses.transliteration: shikhAyAM baddhasUtrasya shikhayA tachChikhAM guruH | AbadhyAhatavastreNa tamAchChAdya cha varmaNA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रेखात्रयं च परितो भस्मना तिलसर्षपैः । कृत्वास्त्रजप्तैस्तद् बाह्ये दिगीशानां बलिं हरेत्
verses.transliteration: rekhAtrayaM cha parito bhasmanA tilasarShapaiH | kR^itvAstrajaptaistad bAhye digIshAnAM baliM haret
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्योऽपि परतोऽनश्नन्कृत्वैवमधिवासनम् । प्रबुध्योत्थाय गुरवे स्वप्नं दृष्टं निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: shiShyo.api parato.anashnankR^itvaivamadhivAsanam | prabudhyotthAya gurave svapnaM dR^iShTaM nivedayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आधाराद्युन्मनान्तश्च भुवनाध्वा प्रकीर्तितः । विना भेदोपभेदाभ्यां षष्टिसङ्ख्यासमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: AdhArAdyunmanAntashcha bhuvanAdhvA prakIrtitaH | vinA bhedopabhedAbhyAM ShaShTisa~NkhyAsamanvitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशद् रुद्ररूपास्तु वर्णा वर्णाध्वसंज्ञिताः । अनेकभेदसम्पन्नः पदाध्वा समुदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAshad rudrarUpAstu varNA varNAdhvasa.nj~nitAH | anekabhedasampannaH padAdhvA samudAhR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपमन्त्रैर्मन्त्राध्वा व्याप्तः परमविद्यया । यथा शिवो न तत्त्वेषु गण्यते तत्त्वनायकः
verses.transliteration: sarvopamantrairmantrAdhvA vyAptaH paramavidyayA | yathA shivo na tattveShu gaNyate tattvanAyakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्राध्वनि न गण्येत तथासौ मन्त्रनायकः । कलाध्वनो व्यापकत्वं व्याप्यत्वं चेतराध्वनाम्
verses.transliteration: mantrAdhvani na gaNyeta tathAsau mantranAyakaH | kalAdhvano vyApakatvaM vyApyatvaM chetarAdhvanAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न वेत्ति तत्त्वतो यः स नैवार्हत्यध्वशोधनम् । षड्विधस्याध्वनो रूपं न येन विदितं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: na vetti tattvato yaH sa naivArhatyadhvashodhanam | ShaDvidhasyAdhvano rUpaM na yena viditaM bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१८. अष्टादशोऽध्यायः । षडध्वशुद्ध्यादिकथनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । ततः स्नानादिकं सर्वं समाप्याचार्यचोदितः । गच्छेद्बद्धाञ्जलिर्ध्यायन् शिवमण्डलपार्श्वतः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.18\. aShTAdasho.adhyAyaH | ShaDadhvashuddhyAdikathanam | upamanyuruvAcha | tataH snAnAdikaM sarvaM samApyAchAryachoditaH | gachChedbaddhA~njalirdhyAyan shivamaNDalapArshvataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽप्यादाय मूलेन मुद्रया शास्त्रदृष्टया । योजयेन्मनसाचार्यो युगपत्सर्वयोनिषु
verses.transliteration: tato.apyAdAya mUlena mudrayA shAstradR^iShTayA | yojayenmanasAchAryo yugapatsarvayoniShu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देवानां जातयश्चाष्टौ तिरश्चां पञ्च जातयः । जात्यैकया च मानुष्या योनयश्च चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: devAnAM jAtayashchAShTau tirashchAM pa~ncha jAtayaH | jAtyaikayA cha mAnuShyA yonayashcha chaturdasha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तासु सर्वासु युगपत्प्रवेशाय शिशोर्द्धिया । वागीशान्यां यथान्यायं शिष्यात्मानं निवेशयेत्
verses.transliteration: tAsu sarvAsu yugapatpraveshAya shishorddhiyA | vAgIshAnyAM yathAnyAyaM shiShyAtmAnaM niveshayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भनिष्पत्तये देवं सम्पूज्य प्रणिपत्य च । हुत्वा चैव यथान्यायं निष्पन्नं तदनुस्मरेत्
verses.transliteration: garbhaniShpattaye devaM sampUjya praNipatya cha | hutvA chaiva yathAnyAyaM niShpannaM tadanusmaret
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निष्पन्नस्यैवमुत्पत्तिमनुवृत्तिं च कर्मणा । आर्जवं भोगनिष्पत्तिः कुर्यात् प्रीतिं परां तथा
verses.transliteration: niShpannasyaivamutpattimanuvR^ittiM cha karmaNA | ArjavaM bhoganiShpattiH kuryAt prItiM parAM tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निष्कृत्यर्थं च जात्यायुर्भोगसंस्कारसिद्धये । हुत्वाहुतित्रयं देवं प्रार्थयेद्देशिकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: niShkR^ityarthaM cha jAtyAyurbhogasaMskArasiddhaye | hutvAhutitrayaM devaM prArthayeddeshikottamaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भोक्तृत्वविषयासङ्गमलं तत्कायशोधनम् । कृत्वैवमेव शिष्यस्य छिन्द्यात्पाशत्रयं ततः
verses.transliteration: bhoktR^itvaviShayAsa~NgamalaM tatkAyashodhanam | kR^itvaivameva shiShyasya ChindyAtpAshatrayaM tataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निकृत्या परिबद्धस्य पाशस्यात्यन्तभेदतः । कृत्वा शिष्यस्य चैतन्यं स्वच्छं मन्येत केवलम्
verses.transliteration: nikR^ityA paribaddhasya pAshasyAtyantabhedataH | kR^itvA shiShyasya chaitanyaM svachChaM manyeta kevalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा पूर्णाहुतिं वह्नौ ब्रह्माणं पूजयेत्ततः । हुत्वाहुतित्रयं तस्मै शिवाज्ञामनुसन्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: hutvA pUrNAhutiM vahnau brahmANaM pUjayettataH | hutvAhutitrayaM tasmai shivAj~nAmanusandishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पितामह त्वया नास्य यातुः शैवं परं पदम् । प्रतिबन्धो विधातव्यः शैवाज्ञैषा गरीयसी
verses.transliteration: pitAmaha tvayA nAsya yAtuH shaivaM paraM padam | pratibandho vidhAtavyaH shaivAj~naiShA garIyasI
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ पूजां विना सर्वं कृत्वा पूर्वदिने यथा । नेत्रबन्धनपर्यन्तं दर्शयेत् मण्डलं गुरुः
verses.transliteration: atha pUjAM vinA sarvaM kR^itvA pUrvadine yathA | netrabandhanaparyantaM darshayet maNDalaM guruH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादिश्य तमभ्यर्च्य विसृज च विधानतः । समभ्यर्च्य महादेवं जुहुयादाहुतित्रयम्
verses.transliteration: ityAdishya tamabhyarchya visR^ija cha vidhAnataH | samabhyarchya mahAdevaM juhuyAdAhutitrayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्त्या शुद्धमुद्धृत्य शिष्यात्मानं यथा पुरा । निवेश्यात्मनि सूत्रे च वागीशं पूजयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: nivR^ittyA shuddhamuddhR^itya shiShyAtmAnaM yathA purA | niveshyAtmani sUtre cha vAgIshaM pUjayettataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वाहुतित्रयं तस्मै प्रणम्य च विसृज्य ताम् । कुर्यान्निवृत्तः सन्धानं प्रतिष्ठां कलया सह
verses.transliteration: hutvAhutitrayaM tasmai praNamya cha visR^ijya tAm | kuryAnnivR^ittaH sandhAnaM pratiShThAM kalayA saha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सन्धाने युगपत्पूजां कृत्वा हुत्वाहुतित्रयम् । शिष्यात्मनः प्रतिष्ठायां प्रवेशं त्वथ भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: sandhAne yugapatpUjAM kR^itvA hutvAhutitrayam | shiShyAtmanaH pratiShThAyAM praveshaM tvatha bhAvayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रतिष्ठामावाह्य कृत्वाशेषं पुरोदितम् । तद्व्याप्तिं व्यापिकां तस्य वागीशानीं च भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH pratiShThAmAvAhya kR^itvAsheShaM puroditam | tadvyAptiM vyApikAM tasya vAgIshAnIM cha bhAvayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णेन्दुमण्डलप्रख्यां कृत्वा शेषं च पूर्ववत् । विष्णवे संविशेदाज्ञां शिवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: pUrNendumaNDalaprakhyAM kR^itvA sheShaM cha pUrvavat | viShNave saMvishedAj~nAM shivasya paramAtmanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोर्विसर्जनाद्यं च कृत्वा शेषं च विद्यया । प्रतिष्ठामनुसन्धाय तस्यां चापि यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: viShNorvisarjanAdyaM cha kR^itvA sheShaM cha vidyayA | pratiShThAmanusandhAya tasyAM chApi yathA purA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वानुचिन्त्य तद्व्याप्तिं वागीशां च यथाक्रमम् । दीप्ताग्नौ पूर्णहोमान्तं कृत्वा शेषं च पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvAnuchintya tadvyAptiM vAgIshAM cha yathAkramam | dIptAgnau pUrNahomAntaM kR^itvA sheShaM cha pUrvavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नीलरुद्रमुपस्थाप्य तस्मै पूजादिकं तथा । कृत्वा कर्म शिवाज्ञां च दद्यात्पूर्वोक्तवर्त्मना
verses.transliteration: nIlarudramupasthApya tasmai pUjAdikaM tathA | kR^itvA karma shivAj~nAM cha dadyAtpUrvoktavartmanA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तपस्तमपि चोद्वास्य कृत्वा तस्याथ शान्तये । विद्याकलां समाधाय तद्व्याप्तिं चावलोकयेत्
verses.transliteration: tapastamapi chodvAsya kR^itvA tasyAtha shAntaye | vidyAkalAM samAdhAya tadvyAptiM chAvalokayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बद्धनेत्रेण शिष्येण पुष्पावकिरणे कृते । यत्रापतन्ति पुष्पाणि तस्य नामाऽस्य सन्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: baddhanetreNa shiShyeNa puShpAvakiraNe kR^ite | yatrApatanti puShpANi tasya nAmA.asya sandishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मनो व्यापिकां तद्वद्वागीशीं च यथा पुरा । बालार्कसदृशाकारां भासयन्तीं दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: svAtmano vyApikAM tadvadvAgIshIM cha yathA purA | bAlArkasadR^ishAkArAM bhAsayantIM disho dasha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शेषं यथापूर्वं कृत्वा देवं महेश्वरम् । आवाह्याराध्य हुत्वास्मै शिवाज्ञां मनसा दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH sheShaM yathApUrvaM kR^itvA devaM maheshvaram | AvAhyArAdhya hutvAsmai shivAj~nAM manasA dishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरं तथोत्सृज्य कृत्वान्यां च कलामिमाम् । शान्त्यतीतां कलां नीत्वा तद्व्याप्तिमवलोकयेत्
verses.transliteration: maheshvaraM tathotsR^ijya kR^itvAnyAM cha kalAmimAm | shAntyatItAM kalAM nItvA tadvyAptimavalokayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मनो व्यापिकां तद्वद्वागीशीं च विचिन्तयेत् । नभोमण्डलसङ्काशां पूर्णान्तं चापि पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: svAtmano vyApikAM tadvadvAgIshIM cha vichintayet | nabhomaNDalasa~NkAshAM pUrNAntaM chApi pUrvavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा शेषविधानेन समभ्यर्च्य सदाशिवम् । तस्मै समादिशेदाज्ञां शम्भोरमितकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA sheShavidhAnena samabhyarchya sadAshivam | tasmai samAdishedAj~nAM shambhoramitakarmaNaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि च यथापूर्वं शिवं शिरसि पूर्ववत् । समभ्यर्च्य च वागीशं प्रणम्य च विसर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: tatrApi cha yathApUrvaM shivaM shirasi pUrvavat | samabhyarchya cha vAgIshaM praNamya cha visarjayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिवेन सम्प्रोक्ष्य शिष्यं शिरसि पूर्ववत् । विलयं शान्त्यतीतायाः शक्तितत्त्वेऽथ चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH shivena samprokShya shiShyaM shirasi pUrvavat | vilayaM shAntyatItAyAH shaktitattve.atha chintayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: षडध्वनः परे पारे सर्वाध्वव्यापिनीं पराम् । कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशां शैवीं शक्तिं च चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: ShaDadhvanaH pare pAre sarvAdhvavyApinIM parAm | koTisUryapratIkAshAM shaivIM shaktiM cha chintayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदग्रे शिष्यमानीय शुद्धस्फटिकनिर्मलम् । प्रक्षाल्य कर्त्तरीं पश्चात् शिवशास्त्रोक्तमार्गतः
verses.transliteration: tadagre shiShyamAnIya shuddhasphaTikanirmalam | prakShAlya karttarIM pashchAt shivashAstroktamArgataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यात्तस्य शिखाच्छेदं सह सूत्रेण देशिकः । ततस्तां गोमये न्यस्य शिवाग्नौ जुहुयाच्छिखाम्
verses.transliteration: kuryAttasya shikhAchChedaM saha sUtreNa deshikaH | tatastAM gomaye nyasya shivAgnau juhuyAchChikhAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तं चोपनीय निर्माल्यमण्डलेऽस्मिन्यथा पुरा । पूजयेद्देवमीशानं जुहुयाच्च शिवानले
verses.transliteration: taM chopanIya nirmAlyamaNDale.asminyathA purA | pUjayeddevamIshAnaM juhuyAchcha shivAnale
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वौषडन्तेन मूलेन पुनः प्रक्षाल्य कर्तरीम् । हस्ते शिष्यस्य चैतन्यं तद्देहे विनिवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: vauShaDantena mUlena punaH prakShAlya kartarIm | haste shiShyasya chaitanyaM taddehe vinivartayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्नातं समाचान्तं कृतस्वस्त्ययनं शिशुम् । प्रवेश्य मण्डलाभ्यासं प्रणिपत्य च दण्डवत्
verses.transliteration: tataH snAtaM samAchAntaM kR^itasvastyayanaM shishum | praveshya maNDalAbhyAsaM praNipatya cha daNDavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पूजां कृत्वा यथान्यायं क्रियावैकल्यशुद्धये । वाचकेनैव मन्त्रेण जुहुयादाहुतित्रयम्
verses.transliteration: pUjAM kR^itvA yathAnyAyaM kriyAvaikalyashuddhaye | vAchakenaiva mantreNa juhuyAdAhutitrayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपांशूच्चारयोगेन जुहुयादाहुतित्रयम् । पुनः सम्पूज्य देवेशं मन्त्रवैकल्यशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: upAMshUchchArayogena juhuyAdAhutitrayam | punaH sampUjya deveshaM mantravaikalyashuddhaye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मानसोच्चारयोगेन जुहुयादाहुतित्रयम् । तत्र शम्भुं समाराध्य मण्डलस्थं सहाम्बया । हुत्वाहुतित्रयं पश्चात्प्रार्थयेत्प्राञ्जलिर्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: mAnasochchArayogena juhuyAdAhutitrayam | tatra shambhuM samArAdhya maNDalasthaM sahAmbayA | hutvAhutitrayaM pashchAtprArthayetprA~njalirguruH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन शुद्धिरस्य षडध्वनः । कृता तस्मात्परं धाम गमयैनं तवाव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavaMstvatprasAdena shuddhirasya ShaDadhvanaH | kR^itA tasmAtparaM dhAma gamayainaM tavAvyayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इति विज्ञाप्य देवाय नाडीसन्धानपूर्वकम् । पूर्णान्तं पूर्ववत्कृत्वा ततो भूतानि शोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: iti vij~nApya devAya nADIsandhAnapUrvakam | pUrNAntaM pUrvavatkR^itvA tato bhUtAni shodhayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्थिरास्थिरे ततः शुद्ध्यै शीतोष्णे च ततः पदे । ध्यायेद्व्याप्त्यैकताकारे भूतशोधनकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: sthirAsthire tataH shuddhyai shItoShNe cha tataH pade | dhyAyedvyAptyaikatAkAre bhUtashodhanakarmaNi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भूतानां ग्रन्थिविच्छेदं कृत्वा त्यक्त्वा सहाधिपैः । भूतानि स्थितियोगेन यो जपेत्परमे शिवे
verses.transliteration: bhUtAnAM granthivichChedaM kR^itvA tyaktvA sahAdhipaiH | bhUtAni sthitiyogena yo japetparame shive
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विशोध्यास्यं तनुं दग्ध्वा प्लावयित्वा सुधाकणैः । स्थाप्यात्मानं ततः कुर्याद्विशुद्धाध्वमयं वपुः
verses.transliteration: vishodhyAsyaM tanuM dagdhvA plAvayitvA sudhAkaNaiH | sthApyAtmAnaM tataH kuryAdvishuddhAdhvamayaM vapuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्येण यदि दुःस्वप्नो दृष्टस्तद्दोषशान्तये । शतमर्द्धं तदर्द्धं वा जुहुयान्मूलविद्यया
verses.transliteration: shiShyeNa yadi duHsvapno dR^iShTastaddoShashAntaye | shatamarddhaM tadarddhaM vA juhuyAnmUlavidyayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रादौ शान्त्यतीतां तु व्यापिकां स्वाध्वनः कलाम् । शुद्धामेव शिशोर्मूर्ध्नि न्यसेच्छान्तिमुखे तथा
verses.transliteration: tatrAdau shAntyatItAM tu vyApikAM svAdhvanaH kalAm | shuddhAmeva shishormUrdhni nyasechChAntimukhe tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यां गलादिनाभ्यन्तं प्रतिष्ठां तदधः क्रमात् । जान्वन्तं तदधो न्यस्येन्निवृत्तिं चानुचिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: vidyAM galAdinAbhyantaM pratiShThAM tadadhaH kramAt | jAnvantaM tadadho nyasyennivR^ittiM chAnuchintayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वबीजैः सूत्रमन्त्रं च न्यस्याङ्गैस्तं शिवात्मकम् । बुद्ध्वा तं हृदयाम्भोजे देवमावाह्य पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: svabIjaiH sUtramantraM cha nyasyA~NgaistaM shivAtmakam | buddhvA taM hR^idayAmbhoje devamAvAhya pUjayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आशास्य नित्यसान्निध्यं शिवस्वात्म्यं शिशौ गुरुः । शिवतेजोमयस्यास्य शिशोरापादयेद्गुणान्
verses.transliteration: AshAsya nityasAnnidhyaM shivasvAtmyaM shishau guruH | shivatejomayasyAsya shishorApAdayedguNAn
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अणिमादीन्प्रसीदेति प्रदद्यादाहुतित्रयम् । तथैव तु गुणानेव पुनरस्योपपादयेत्
verses.transliteration: aNimAdInprasIdeti pradadyAdAhutitrayam | tathaiva tu guNAneva punarasyopapAdayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञतां तथा तृप्तिं बोधं चाद्यन्तवर्जितम् । अलुप्तशक्तिं स्वातन्त्र्यमनन्तां शक्तिमेव च
verses.transliteration: sarvaj~natAM tathA tR^iptiM bodhaM chAdyantavarjitam | aluptashaktiM svAtantryamanantAM shaktimeva cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवमनुज्ञाप्य सद्यादिकलशैस्तु तम् । अभिषिञ्चेत देवेशं ध्यायन्हृदि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tato devamanuj~nApya sadyAdikalashaistu tam | abhiShi~ncheta deveshaM dhyAyanhR^idi yathAkramam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथोपवेश्य तं शिष्यं शिवमभ्यर्च्य पूर्ववत् । लब्धानुज्ञः शिवाच्छैवीं विद्यामस्मै समादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: athopaveshya taM shiShyaM shivamabhyarchya pUrvavat | labdhAnuj~naH shivAchChaivIM vidyAmasmai samAdishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारपूर्विकां तत्र सम्पुटां तु नमोऽन्तगाम् । शिवशक्तियुताञ्चैव शक्तिविद्यां च तादृशीम्
verses.transliteration: o~NkArapUrvikAM tatra sampuTAM tu namo.antagAm | shivashaktiyutA~nchaiva shaktividyAM cha tAdR^ishIm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिं छन्दश्च देवं च शिवतां शिवयोस्तथा । पूजां सावरणां शम्भोरासनानि च सन्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: R^iShiM Chandashcha devaM cha shivatAM shivayostathA | pUjAM sAvaraNAM shambhorAsanAni cha sandishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सूत्रं शिखाबद्धं लम्बयित्वा यथा पुरा । आधारपूजाप्रभृति यन्निवृत्तिकलाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: tataH sUtraM shikhAbaddhaM lambayitvA yathA purA | AdhArapUjAprabhR^iti yannivR^ittikalAshrayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः सम्पूज्य देवेशं यन्मया समनुष्ठितम् । सुकृतं कुरु तत्सर्वमिति विज्ञापयेत् शिवम्
verses.transliteration: punaH sampUjya deveshaM yanmayA samanuShThitam | sukR^itaM kuru tatsarvamiti vij~nApayet shivam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सहशिष्यो गुरुर्देवं दण्डवत्क्षितिमण्डले । प्रणम्योद्वासयेत्तस्मात् मण्डलात्पावकादपि
verses.transliteration: sahashiShyo gururdevaM daNDavatkShitimaNDale | praNamyodvAsayettasmAt maNDalAtpAvakAdapi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सदसिकाः सर्वे पूज्याः पूजार्हकाः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tataH sadasikAH sarve pUjyAH pUjArhakAH kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सेव्या वित्तानुसारेण सदस्याश्च सहर्त्विजः । वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत् शिवमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sevyA vittAnusAreNa sadasyAshcha sahartvijaH | vittashAThyaM na kurvIta yadIchChet shivamAtmanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वागीश्वरीपूजनान्तं कुर्याद्धोमपुरःसरम् । अथ प्रणम्य वागीशं निवृत्तेर्व्यापिकां सतीम्
verses.transliteration: vAgIshvarIpUjanAntaM kuryAddhomapuraHsaram | atha praNamya vAgIshaM nivR^ittervyApikAM satIm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मण्डले देवमभ्यर्च्य हुत्वा चैवाहुतित्रयम् । प्रापयेच्च शिशोः प्राप्तिं युगपत्सर्वयोनिषु
verses.transliteration: maNDale devamabhyarchya hutvA chaivAhutitrayam | prApayechcha shishoH prAptiM yugapatsarvayoniShu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सूत्रदेहेऽथ शिष्यस्य ताडनप्रोक्षणादिकम् । कृत्वात्मानं समादाय द्वादशान्ते निवेद्य च
verses.transliteration: sUtradehe.atha shiShyasya tADanaprokShaNAdikam | kR^itvAtmAnaM samAdAya dvAdashAnte nivedya cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१९. एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः । साधकसंस्कारमन्त्रमाहात्म्यम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि साधकं नाम नामतः । संस्कारमन्त्रमाहात्म्यं कथने सूचितं मया
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.19\. ekonaviMsho.adhyAyaH | sAdhakasaMskAramantramAhAtmyam | upamanyuruvAcha | ataH paraM pravakShyAmi sAdhakaM nAma nAmataH | saMskAramantramAhAtmyaM kathane sUchitaM mayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नात्यन्तं करणीयं तु मुमुक्षोर्मन्त्रसाधनम् । कृतं तु तदिहान्यत्र तस्यापि शुभदं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: nAtyantaM karaNIyaM tu mumukShormantrasAdhanam | kR^itaM tu tadihAnyatra tasyApi shubhadaM bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शुभेऽहनि शुभे देशे काले वा दोषवर्जिते । शुक्लदन्तनखः स्नातः कृतपूर्वाह्निकक्रियः
verses.transliteration: shubhe.ahani shubhe deshe kAle vA doShavarjite | shukladantanakhaH snAtaH kR^itapUrvAhnikakriyaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अलङ्कृत्य यथा लब्धैर्गन्धमाल्यविभूषणैः । सोष्णीषः सोत्तरासङ्गः सर्वशुक्लसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: ala~NkR^itya yathA labdhairgandhamAlyavibhUShaNaiH | soShNIShaH sottarAsa~NgaH sarvashuklasamAhitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देवालये गृहेऽन्यस्मिन् देशे वा सुमनोहरे । सुखेनाभ्यस्तपूर्वेण त्वासनेन कृतासनः
verses.transliteration: devAlaye gR^ihe.anyasmin deshe vA sumanohare | sukhenAbhyastapUrveNa tvAsanena kR^itAsanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तनुं कृत्वात्मनः शैवीं शिवशास्त्रोक्तवर्त्मना । सम्पूज्य देवदेवेशं नकुलीश्वरमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tanuM kR^itvAtmanaH shaivIM shivashAstroktavartmanA | sampUjya devadeveshaM nakulIshvaramIshvaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निवेद्य पायसं तस्मै समाप्याराधनं क्रमात् । प्रणिपत्य च तं देवं प्राप्तानुज्ञाश्च तन्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: nivedya pAyasaM tasmai samApyArAdhanaM kramAt | praNipatya cha taM devaM prAptAnuj~nAshcha tanmukhAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिवारं तदर्द्धं वा तदर्द्धं वा जपेत् शिवम् । लक्षविंशतिकं वापि दशलक्षमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: koTivAraM tadarddhaM vA tadarddhaM vA japet shivam | lakShaviMshatikaM vApi dashalakShamathApi vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च पायसाक्षारलवणैकमिताशनः । अहिंसकः क्षमी शान्तो दान्तश्चैव सदा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatashcha pAyasAkShAralavaNaikamitAshanaH | ahiMsakaH kShamI shAnto dAntashchaiva sadA bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अलाभे पायसस्याश्नन्फलमूलादिकानि वा । विहितानि शिवेनैव विशिष्टान्युत्तरोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: alAbhe pAyasasyAshnanphalamUlAdikAni vA | vihitAni shivenaiva vishiShTAnyuttarottaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चरुं भक्ष्यमथो सक्तुकणान्यावकमेव च । शाकं पयो दधि घृतं मूलं फलमथोदकम्
verses.transliteration: charuM bhakShyamatho saktukaNAnyAvakameva cha | shAkaM payo dadhi ghR^itaM mUlaM phalamathodakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य मण्डले देवं स्थाप्य कुम्भे च पूर्ववत् । हुत्वा शिष्यमनुष्णीषं प्रापयेद्भुवि मण्डले
verses.transliteration: sampUjya maNDale devaM sthApya kumbhe cha pUrvavat | hutvA shiShyamanuShNIShaM prApayedbhuvi maNDale
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्त्र्य च मन्त्रेण भक्ष्यभोज्यादिकानि च । साधनेऽस्मिन् विशेषेण नित्यं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः
verses.transliteration: abhimantrya cha mantreNa bhakShyabhojyAdikAni cha | sAdhane.asmin visheSheNa nityaM bhu~njIta vAgyataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्राष्टशतपूतेन जलेन शुचिना व्रती । स्नायान्नदीनदोत्थेन प्रोक्षयेद्वाथ शक्तितः
verses.transliteration: mantrAShTashatapUtena jalena shuchinA vratI | snAyAnnadInadotthena prokShayedvAtha shaktitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयेच्च तथा नित्यं जुहुयाच्च शिवानले । सप्तभिः पञ्चभिर्द्रव्यैस्त्रिभिर्वाथ घृतेन वा
verses.transliteration: tarpayechcha tathA nityaM juhuyAchcha shivAnale | saptabhiH pa~nchabhirdravyaistribhirvAtha ghR^itena vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं भक्त्या शिवं शैवो यः साधयति साधकः । तस्येहामुत्र दुष्प्रापं न किञ्चिदपि विद्यते
verses.transliteration: itthaM bhaktyA shivaM shaivo yaH sAdhayati sAdhakaH | tasyehAmutra duShprApaM na ki~nchidapi vidyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथवाहरहर्मन्त्रं जपेदेकाग्रमानसः । अनश्नन्नेव साहस्रं विना मन्त्रस्य साधनम्
verses.transliteration: athavAharaharmantraM japedekAgramAnasaH | anashnanneva sAhasraM vinA mantrasya sAdhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य दुर्लभं किञ्चिन्न तस्यास्त्यशुभं क्वचित् । इह विद्यां श्रियं सौख्यं लब्ध्वा मुक्तिं च विन्दति
verses.transliteration: na tasya durlabhaM ki~nchinna tasyAstyashubhaM kvachit | iha vidyAM shriyaM saukhyaM labdhvA muktiM cha vindati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: साधने विनियोगे च नित्ये नैमित्तिके तथा । जपेज्जलैर्भस्मना च स्नात्वा मन्त्रेण च क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sAdhane viniyoge cha nitye naimittike tathA | japejjalairbhasmanA cha snAtvA mantreNa cha kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शुचिर्बद्धशिखः सूत्री सपवित्रकरस्तथा । धृतत्रिपुण्ड्ररुद्राक्षो विद्यां पञ्चाक्षरीं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: shuchirbaddhashikhaH sUtrI sapavitrakarastathA | dhR^itatripuNDrarudrAkSho vidyAM pa~nchAkSharIM japet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णान्तं पूर्ववत्कृत्वा हुत्वाऽऽहुतिशतं तथा । सन्तर्प्य मूलमन्त्रेण कलशैर्देशिकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: pUrNAntaM pUrvavatkR^itvA hutvA.a.ahutishataM tathA | santarpya mUlamantreNa kalashairdeshikottamaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सन्दीप्य च यथापूर्वं कृत्वा पूर्वोदितं क्रमात् । अभिषिच्य यथापूर्वं प्रदद्यान्मन्त्रमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sandIpya cha yathApUrvaM kR^itvA pUrvoditaM kramAt | abhiShichya yathApUrvaM pradadyAnmantramuttamam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र विद्योपदेशान्तं कृत्वा विस्तरशः क्रमात् । पुष्पाम्बुना शिशोः पाणौ विद्यां शैवीं समर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra vidyopadeshAntaM kR^itvA vistarashaH kramAt | puShpAmbunA shishoH pANau vidyAM shaivIM samarpayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तवैहिकामुष्मिकयोः सर्वसिद्धिफलप्रदः । भवत्येव महामन्त्रः प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: tavaihikAmuShmikayoH sarvasiddhiphalapradaH | bhavatyeva mahAmantraH prasAdAtparameShThinaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युत्वा देवमभ्यर्च्य लब्धानुज्ञः शिवाद्गुरुः । साधनं शिवयोगं च साधकाय समादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: ityutvA devamabhyarchya labdhAnuj~naH shivAdguruH | sAdhanaM shivayogaM cha sAdhakAya samAdishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा गुरुसन्देशं क्रमशो मन्त्रसाधकः । पुरतो विनियोगस्य मन्त्रसाधनमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: tachChrutvA gurusandeshaM kramasho mantrasAdhakaH | purato viniyogasya mantrasAdhanamAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: साधनं मूलमन्त्रस्य पुरश्चरणमुच्यते । पुरतश्चरणीयत्वाद्विनियोगाख्यकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: sAdhanaM mUlamantrasya purashcharaNamuchyate | puratashcharaNIyatvAdviniyogAkhyakarmaNaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.२०. विंशोऽध्यायः । विशेषादिसंस्कृतिः । उपमन्युरुवाच । अथैवं संस्कृतं शिष्यं कृतपाशुपतव्रतम् । आचार्यत्वेऽभिषिञ्चेत तद्योगत्वेन चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.20\. viMsho.adhyAyaH | visheShAdisaMskR^itiH | upamanyuruvAcha | athaivaM saMskR^itaM shiShyaM kR^itapAshupatavratam | AchAryatve.abhiShi~ncheta tadyogatvena chAnyathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथालङ्कृत्य तं देवमाराध्य शिवमण्डले । शतमष्टोत्तरं हुत्वा दद्यात्पूर्णाहुतिं ततः
verses.transliteration: athAla~NkR^itya taM devamArAdhya shivamaNDale | shatamaShTottaraM hutvA dadyAtpUrNAhutiM tataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः सम्पूज्य देवेशं प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत् । शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय शिवं विज्ञापयेद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: punaH sampUjya deveshaM praNamya bhuvi daNDavat | shirasya~njalimAdhAya shivaM vij~nApayedguruH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन देशिकोऽयं मया कृतः । अनुगृह्य त्वया देव दिव्याज्ञास्मै प्रदीयताम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavaMstvatprasAdena deshiko.ayaM mayA kR^itaH | anugR^ihya tvayA deva divyAj~nAsmai pradIyatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विज्ञाप्य शिष्येण सह भूयः प्रणम्य च । शिवं शिवागमं दिव्यं पूजयेत् शिववद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: evaM vij~nApya shiShyeNa saha bhUyaH praNamya cha | shivaM shivAgamaM divyaM pUjayet shivavadguruH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः शिवमनुज्ञाप्य शिवज्ञानस्य पुस्तकम् । उभाभ्यामथ पाणिभ्यां दद्याच्छिष्याय देशिकः
verses.transliteration: punaH shivamanuj~nApya shivaj~nAnasya pustakam | ubhAbhyAmatha pANibhyAM dadyAchChiShyAya deshikaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स तां मूर्ध्नि समाधाय विद्यां विद्यासनोपरि । अधिरोप्य यथान्यायमभिवन्द्य समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: sa tAM mUrdhni samAdhAya vidyAM vidyAsanopari | adhiropya yathAnyAyamabhivandya samarchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्मै गुरुर्दद्याद्राजोपकरणान्यपि । आचार्यपदवीं प्राप्तो राज्यं चापि यतोऽर्हति
verses.transliteration: atha tasmai gururdadyAdrAjopakaraNAnyapi | AchAryapadavIM prApto rAjyaM chApi yato.arhati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथानुशासनं कुर्यात्पूर्वैराचरितं यथा । यथा च शिवशास्त्रोक्तं यथा लोकेषु पूज्यते
verses.transliteration: athAnushAsanaM kuryAtpUrvairAcharitaM yathA | yathA cha shivashAstroktaM yathA lokeShu pUjyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यान् परीक्ष्य यत्नेन शिवशास्त्रोक्तलक्षणैः । संस्कृत्य च शिवज्ञानं तेभ्यो दद्याच्च देशिकः
verses.transliteration: shiShyAn parIkShya yatnena shivashAstroktalakShaNaiH | saMskR^itya cha shivaj~nAnaM tebhyo dadyAchcha deshikaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वमनायासं शौचं क्षान्तिं दयां तथा । अस्पृहामप्यसूयां च यत्नेन च विभावयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM sarvamanAyAsaM shauchaM kShAntiM dayAM tathA | aspR^ihAmapyasUyAM cha yatnena cha vibhAvayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मण्डलं पूर्ववत्कृत्त्वा सम्पूज्य परमेश्वरम् । स्थापयत्पञ्चकलशान्दिक्षु मध्ये च पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: maNDalaM pUrvavatkR^ittvA sampUjya parameshvaram | sthApayatpa~nchakalashAndikShu madhye cha pUrvavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थमादिश्य तं शिष्यं शिवमुद्वास्य मण्डलात् । शिवकुम्भानलादींश्च सदस्यानपि पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: itthamAdishya taM shiShyaM shivamudvAsya maNDalAt | shivakumbhAnalAdIMshcha sadasyAnapi pUjayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: युगपद्वाथ संस्कारान् कुर्वीत सगणो गुरुः । तत्र त्रयं द्वयं वापि प्रयोगस्योपदिश्यते
verses.transliteration: yugapadvAtha saMskArAn kurvIta sagaNo guruH | tatra trayaM dvayaM vApi prayogasyopadishyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदादावेव कलशान्कल्पयेदध्वशुद्धिवत् । कृत्वा समयसंस्कारमभिषेकं विनाऽखिलम्
verses.transliteration: tadAdAveva kalashAnkalpayedadhvashuddhivat | kR^itvA samayasaMskAramabhiShekaM vinA.akhilam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: समभ्यर्च्य शिवं भूयः कृत्वा चाध्वविशोधनम् । तस्मिन् परिसमाप्ते तु पुनर्देवं प्रपूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: samabhyarchya shivaM bhUyaH kR^itvA chAdhvavishodhanam | tasmin parisamApte tu punardevaM prapUjayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा मन्त्रं तु सन्तर्प्य सन्दीप्याशास्य चेश्वरम् । समर्प्य मन्त्रं शिष्यस्य पाणौ शेषं समापयेत्
verses.transliteration: hutvA mantraM tu santarpya sandIpyAshAsya cheshvaram | samarpya mantraM shiShyasya pANau sheShaM samApayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा मन्त्रसंस्कारमनुचिन्त्याखिलं क्रमात् । अध्वशुद्धिं गुरुः कुर्यादभिषेकावसानिकम्
verses.transliteration: athavA mantrasaMskAramanuchintyAkhilaM kramAt | adhvashuddhiM guruH kuryAdabhiShekAvasAnikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यः शान्त्यतीतादिकलासु विहितो विधिः । स सर्वोऽपि विधातव्यस्तत्त्वत्रयविशोधने
verses.transliteration: tatra yaH shAntyatItAdikalAsu vihito vidhiH | sa sarvo.api vidhAtavyastattvatrayavishodhane
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवविद्यात्मतत्त्वाख्यं तत्त्वत्रयमुदाहृतम् । शक्तौ शिवस्ततो विद्यात्तस्यास्त्वात्मा समुद्बभौ
verses.transliteration: shivavidyAtmatattvAkhyaM tattvatrayamudAhR^itam | shaktau shivastato vidyAttasyAstvAtmA samudbabhau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवेन शान्त्यतीताध्वा व्याप्तस्तदपरः परः । विद्यया परिशिष्टोऽध्वा ह्यात्मना निखिलः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: shivena shAntyatItAdhvA vyAptastadaparaH paraH | vidyayA parishiShTo.adhvA hyAtmanA nikhilaH kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभं शाम्भवं मत्वा मन्त्रमूलं मनीषिणः । शाक्तं शंसीत संस्कारं शिवशास्त्रार्थपारगाः
verses.transliteration: durlabhaM shAmbhavaM matvA mantramUlaM manIShiNaH | shAktaM shaMsIta saMskAraM shivashAstrArthapAragAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तिं पुरतो न्यस्य प्रतिष्ठां पश्चिमे घटे । विद्यां दक्षिणतः शान्तिमुत्तरे मध्यतः पराम्
verses.transliteration: nivR^ittiM purato nyasya pratiShThAM pashchime ghaTe | vidyAM dakShiNataH shAntimuttare madhyataH parAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इति ते सर्वमाख्यातं संस्काराख्यस्य कर्मणः । चातुर्विध्यमिदं कृष्ण किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: iti te sarvamAkhyAtaM saMskArAkhyasya karmaNaH | chAturvidhyamidaM kR^iShNa kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा रक्षादिकं तत्र बद्ध्वा मुद्रां च धैनवीम् । अभिमन्त्र्य घटान्हुत्वा पूर्णान्तं च यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA rakShAdikaM tatra baddhvA mudrAM cha dhainavIm | abhimantrya ghaTAnhutvA pUrNAntaM cha yathA purA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवेश्य मण्डले शिष्यमनुष्णीषं च देशिकः । तर्पणाद्यं तु मन्त्राणां कुर्यात्पूर्वावसानकम्
verses.transliteration: praveshya maNDale shiShyamanuShNIShaM cha deshikaH | tarpaNAdyaM tu mantrANAM kuryAtpUrvAvasAnakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सम्पूज्य देवेशमनुज्ञाप्य च पूर्ववत् । अभिषेकाय तं शिष्यमासनं त्वधिरोहयेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH sampUjya deveshamanuj~nApya cha pUrvavat | abhiShekAya taM shiShyamAsanaM tvadhirohayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सकलीकृत्य तं पश्चात्कलापञ्चकरूपिणम् । न्यस्तमन्त्रतनुं बद्ध्वा शिवं शिष्यं समर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: sakalIkR^itya taM pashchAtkalApa~nchakarUpiNam | nyastamantratanuM baddhvA shivaM shiShyaM samarpayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निवृत्तिकुम्भादिघटानुद्धृत्य वै क्रमात् । मध्यमान्ताच्छिवेनैव शिष्यं तमभिषेचयत्
verses.transliteration: tato nivR^ittikumbhAdighaTAnuddhR^itya vai kramAt | madhyamAntAchChivenaiva shiShyaM tamabhiShechayat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवहस्तं समर्प्याथ शिशोः शिरसि देशिकः । शिवभावसमापन्नः शिवाचार्यं तमादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: shivahastaM samarpyAtha shishoH shirasi deshikaH | shivabhAvasamApannaH shivAchAryaM tamAdishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.२१. एकविंशोऽध्यायः । नित्यनैमित्तिककर्मवर्णनम् । कृष्ण उवाच । भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छामि शिवाश्रमनिषेविणाम् । शिवशास्त्रोदितं कर्म नित्यनैमित्तिकं तथा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.21\. ekaviMsho.adhyAyaH | nityanaimittikakarmavarNanam | kR^iShNa uvAcha | bhagavan shrotumichChAmi shivAshramaniSheviNAm | shivashAstroditaM karma nityanaimittikaM tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तोये मग्नः पुनर्मन्त्रं जपेच्छक्त्या शिवं स्मरेत् । उत्थायाचम्य तेनैव स्वात्मानमभिषेचयेत्
verses.transliteration: toye magnaH punarmantraM japechChaktyA shivaM smaret | utthAyAchamya tenaiva svAtmAnamabhiShechayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गोशृङ्गेण सदर्भेण पालाशेन दलेन वा । पाद्मेन वाथ पाणिभ्यां पञ्चकृत्वस्त्रिरेव वा
verses.transliteration: goshR^i~NgeNa sadarbheNa pAlAshena dalena vA | pAdmena vAtha pANibhyAM pa~nchakR^itvastrireva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उद्यानादौ गृहे चैव वर्द्धन्या कलशेन वा । अवगाहनकालेऽद्भिर्मन्त्रितैरभिषेचयेत्
verses.transliteration: udyAnAdau gR^ihe chaiva varddhanyA kalashena vA | avagAhanakAle.adbhirmantritairabhiShechayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ चेद्वारुणं कर्तुमशक्तः शुद्धवाससा । आर्द्रेण शोधयेद्देहमापादतलमस्तकम्
verses.transliteration: atha chedvAruNaM kartumashaktaH shuddhavAsasA | ArdreNa shodhayeddehamApAdatalamastakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयं वाथ वा मान्त्रं कुर्यात् स्नानं शिवेन वा । शिवचिन्तापरं स्नानं युक्तस्यात्मीयमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: AgneyaM vAtha vA mAntraM kuryAt snAnaM shivena vA | shivachintAparaM snAnaM yuktasyAtmIyamuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वसूत्रोक्तविधानेन मन्त्राचमनपूर्वकम् । आचरेद् ब्रह्मयज्ञान्तं कृत्वा देवादितर्पणम्
verses.transliteration: svasUtroktavidhAnena mantrAchamanapUrvakam | Achared brahmayaj~nAntaM kR^itvA devAditarpaNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मण्डलस्थं महादेवं ध्यात्वाभ्यर्च्य यथाविधि । दद्यादर्घ्यं ततस्तस्मै शिवायादित्यरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: maNDalasthaM mahAdevaM dhyAtvAbhyarchya yathAvidhi | dadyAdarghyaM tatastasmai shivAyAdityarUpiNe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथवैतत्स्वसूत्रोक्तं कृत्वा हस्तौ विशोधयेत् । करन्यासं ततः कृत्वा सकलीकृतविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: athavaitatsvasUtroktaM kR^itvA hastau vishodhayet | karanyAsaM tataH kR^itvA sakalIkR^itavigrahaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वामहस्तगताम्भोभिर्गन्धसिद्धार्थकान्वितैः । कुशपुञ्जेन वाऽभ्युक्ष्य मूलमन्त्रसमन्वितैः
verses.transliteration: vAmahastagatAmbhobhirgandhasiddhArthakAnvitaiH | kushapu~njena vA.abhyukShya mUlamantrasamanvitaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आपोहिष्ठादिभिर्मन्त्रैः शेषमाघ्राय वै जलम् । वामनासापुटेनैव देवं सम्भावयेत्सितम्
verses.transliteration: ApohiShThAdibhirmantraiH sheShamAghrAya vai jalam | vAmanAsApuTenaiva devaM sambhAvayetsitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । प्रातरुत्थाय शयनाद्ध्यात्वा देवं सहाम्बया । विचार्य कार्यं निर्गच्छेद् गृहादभ्युदितेऽरुणे
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | prAtarutthAya shayanAddhyAtvA devaM sahAmbayA | vichArya kAryaM nirgachChed gR^ihAdabhyudite.aruNe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अर्घमादाय देहस्थं सव्यनासापुटेन च । कृष्णवर्णेन बाह्यस्थं भावयेच्च शिलागतम्
verses.transliteration: arghamAdAya dehasthaM savyanAsApuTena cha | kR^iShNavarNena bAhyasthaM bhAvayechcha shilAgatam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयेदथ देवेभ्य ऋषिभ्यश्च विशेषतः । भूतेभ्यश्च पितृभ्यश्च दद्यादर्घ्यं यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: tarpayedatha devebhya R^iShibhyashcha visheShataH | bhUtebhyashcha pitR^ibhyashcha dadyAdarghyaM yathAvidhi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तचन्दनतोयेन हस्तमात्रेण मण्डलम् । सुवृत्तं कल्पयेद्भूमौ रक्तचूर्णाद्यलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: raktachandanatoyena hastamAtreNa maNDalam | suvR^ittaM kalpayedbhUmau raktachUrNAdyala~NkR^itam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सम्पूजयेद्भानुं स्वकीयावरणैः सह । खखोल्कायेति मन्त्रेण साङ्गतः सुखसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: tatra sampUjayedbhAnuM svakIyAvaraNaiH saha | khakholkAyeti mantreNa sA~NgataH sukhasiddhaye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च मण्डलं कृत्वा तदङ्गैः परिपूज्य च । तत्र स्थाप्य हेमपात्रं मागधप्रस्थसम्मितम्
verses.transliteration: punashcha maNDalaM kR^itvA tada~NgaiH paripUjya cha | tatra sthApya hemapAtraM mAgadhaprasthasammitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पूरयेत् गन्धतोयेन रक्तचन्दनयोगिना । रक्तपुष्पैस्तिलैश्चैव कुशाक्षतसमन्वितैः
verses.transliteration: pUrayet gandhatoyena raktachandanayoginA | raktapuShpaistilaishchaiva kushAkShatasamanvitaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दूर्वापामार्गगव्यैश्च केवलेन जलेन वा । जानुभ्यां धरणीं गत्वा नत्वा देवं च मण्डले
verses.transliteration: dUrvApAmArgagavyaishcha kevalena jalena vA | jAnubhyAM dharaNIM gatvA natvA devaM cha maNDale
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा शिरसि तत्पात्रं दद्यादर्घ्यं शिवाय तत् । अथवाञ्जलिना तोयं सदर्भं मूलविद्यया
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA shirasi tatpAtraM dadyAdarghyaM shivAya tat | athavA~njalinA toyaM sadarbhaM mUlavidyayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उत्क्षिपेदम्बरस्थाय शिवायादित्यमूर्तये । कृत्वा पुनः करन्यासं करशोधनपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: utkShipedambarasthAya shivAyAdityamUrtaye | kR^itvA punaH karanyAsaM karashodhanapUrvakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्वेशानादि सद्यान्तं पञ्चब्रह्ममयं शिवम् । गृहीत्वा भसितं मन्त्रैर्विमृज्याङ्गानि संस्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: buddhveshAnAdi sadyAntaM pa~nchabrahmamayaM shivam | gR^ihItvA bhasitaM mantrairvimR^ijyA~NgAni saMspR^ishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अबाधे विजने देशे कुर्यादावश्यकं ततः । कृत्वा शौचं विधानेन दन्तधावनमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: abAdhe vijane deshe kuryAdAvashyakaM tataH | kR^itvA shauchaM vidhAnena dantadhAvanamAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आपादान्तैः शिरोवक्त्रहृद्गुह्यचरणान् क्रमात् । ततो मूलेन सर्वाङ्गमालभ्य वसनान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: ApAdAntaiH shirovaktrahR^idguhyacharaNAn kramAt | tato mUlena sarvA~NgamAlabhya vasanAntaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: परिधाय द्विराचम्य प्रोक्ष्यैकादशमन्त्रितैः । जलैराच्छाद्य वासोऽयद् द्विराचम्य शिवं स्मरेत्
verses.transliteration: paridhAya dvirAchamya prokShyaikAdashamantritaiH | jalairAchChAdya vAso.ayad dvirAchamya shivaM smaret
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्न्यस्तकरो मन्त्री त्रिपुण्ड्रं भस्मना लिखेत् । अवक्रमाय तं व्यक्तं ललाटे गन्धवारिणा
verses.transliteration: punarnyastakaro mantrI tripuNDraM bhasmanA likhet | avakramAya taM vyaktaM lalATe gandhavAriNA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्तं वा चतुरस्रं वा बिन्दुमर्द्धेन्दुमेव वा । ललाटे यादृशं पुण्ड्रं लिखितं भस्मना पुनः
verses.transliteration: vR^ittaM vA chaturasraM vA bindumarddhendumeva vA | lalATe yAdR^ishaM puNDraM likhitaM bhasmanA punaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशं भुजयोर्मूर्ध्नि स्तनयोरन्तरे लिखेत् । सर्वाङ्गोद्धूलनं चैव न समानं त्रिपुण्ड्रकैः
verses.transliteration: tAdR^ishaM bhujayormUrdhni stanayorantare likhet | sarvA~NgoddhUlanaM chaiva na samAnaM tripuNDrakaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्रिपुण्ड्रमेवैकं लिखेदुद्धूलनं विना । रुद्राक्षान्धारयेन्मूर्ध्नि कण्ठे श्रोते करे तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmAt tripuNDramevaikaM likheduddhUlanaM vinA | rudrAkShAndhArayenmUrdhni kaNThe shrote kare tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णवर्णमच्छिन्नं शुभं नान्यैर्धृतं शुभम् । विप्रादीनां क्रमात् श्रेष्ठं पीतं रक्तमथासितम्
verses.transliteration: suvarNavarNamachChinnaM shubhaM nAnyairdhR^itaM shubham | viprAdInAM kramAt shreShThaM pItaM raktamathAsitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदलाभे यथालाभं धारणीयमदूषितम् । तत्रापि नोत्तरं नीचैर्धार्यं नीचमथोत्तरैः
verses.transliteration: tadalAbhe yathAlAbhaM dhAraNIyamadUShitam | tatrApi nottaraM nIchairdhAryaM nIchamathottaraiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नाशुचिर्द्धारयेदक्षं सदा कालेषु धारयेत् । इत्थं त्रिसन्ध्यमथवा द्विसन्ध्यं सकृदेव वा
verses.transliteration: nAshuchirddhArayedakShaM sadA kAleShu dhArayet | itthaM trisandhyamathavA dvisandhyaM sakR^ideva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा स्नानादिकं शक्त्या पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् । पूजास्थानं समासाद्य बद्ध्वा रुचिरमासनम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA snAnAdikaM shaktyA pUjayetparameshvaram | pUjAsthAnaM samAsAdya baddhvA ruchiramAsanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अलाभे दन्तकाष्ठानामष्टम्यादिदिनेषु च । अपां द्वादशगण्डूषैः कुर्यादास्यविशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: alAbhe dantakAShThAnAmaShTamyAdidineShu cha | apAM dvAdashagaNDUShaiH kuryAdAsyavishodhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायेद्देवं च देवीं च प्राङ्मुखो वाप्युदङ्मुखः । श्वेतादीन्नकुलीशान्तांस्तच्छिष्यान्प्रणमेद्गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: dhyAyeddevaM cha devIM cha prA~Nmukho vApyuda~NmukhaH | shvetAdInnakulIshAntAMstachChiShyAnpraNamedgurum
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्देवं शिवं नत्वा ततो नामाष्टकं जपेत् । शिवो महेश्वरश्चैव रुद्रो विष्णुः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: punardevaM shivaM natvA tato nAmAShTakaM japet | shivo maheshvarashchaiva rudro viShNuH pitAmahaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: संसारवैद्यः सर्वज्ञः परमात्मेति चाष्टकम् । अथवा शिवमेवैकं जपित्वैकादशाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: saMsAravaidyaH sarvaj~naH paramAtmeti chAShTakam | athavA shivamevaikaM japitvaikAdashAdhikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जिह्वाग्रे तेजसो राशिं ध्यात्वा व्याध्यादिशान्तये । प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ कृत्वा करौ चन्दनचर्चितौ । प्रकुर्वीत करन्यासं करशोधनपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: jihvAgre tejaso rAshiM dhyAtvA vyAdhyAdishAntaye | prakShAlya charaNau kR^itvA karau chandanacharchitau | prakurvIta karanyAsaM karashodhanapUrvakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आचम्य विधिवत्पश्चाद्वारुणं स्नानमाचरेत् । नद्यां वा देवखाते वा ह्रदे वाथ गृहेऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: Achamya vidhivatpashchAdvAruNaM snAnamAcharet | nadyAM vA devakhAte vA hrade vAtha gR^ihe.api vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानद्रव्याणि तत्तीरे स्थापयित्वा बहिर्मलम् । व्यापोह्य मृदमालिप्य स्नात्वा गोमयमालिपेत्
verses.transliteration: snAnadravyANi tattIre sthApayitvA bahirmalam | vyApohya mR^idamAlipya snAtvA gomayamAlipet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा पुनः पुनर्वस्त्रं त्यक्त्वा वाथ विशोध्य च । सुस्नातो नृपवद्भूयः शुद्धं वासो वसीत च
verses.transliteration: snAtvA punaH punarvastraM tyaktvA vAtha vishodhya cha | susnAto nR^ipavadbhUyaH shuddhaM vAso vasIta cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मलस्नानं सुगन्धाद्यैः स्नानं दन्तविशोधनम् । न कुर्याद् ब्रह्मचारी च तपस्वी विधवा तथा
verses.transliteration: malasnAnaM sugandhAdyaiH snAnaM dantavishodhanam | na kuryAd brahmachArI cha tapasvI vidhavA tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सोपवीतः शिखां बद्ध्वा प्रविश्य च जलान्तरम् । अवगाह्य समाचान्तो जले न्यस्येत् त्रिमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: sopavItaH shikhAM baddhvA pravishya cha jalAntaram | avagAhya samAchAnto jale nyasyet trimaNDalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.२२. द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः । शिवशास्त्रोक्तनित्यनैमित्तिककर्मवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । न्यासस्तु त्रिविधः प्रोक्तः स्थित्युत्पत्तिलयक्रमात् । स्थितिर्न्यासो गृहस्थानामुत्पत्तिर्ब्रह्मचारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.22\. dvAviMsho.adhyAyaH | shivashAstroktanityanaimittikakarmavarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | nyAsastu trividhaH proktaH sthityutpattilayakramAt | sthitirnyAso gR^ihasthAnAmutpattirbrahmachAriNAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नाड्याः सुषुम्णयात्मानं प्रेरितं प्राणवायुना । निर्गतं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण योजयेत् शिवतेजसा
verses.transliteration: nADyAH suShumNayAtmAnaM preritaM prANavAyunA | nirgataM brahmarandhreNa yojayet shivatejasA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विशोष्य वायुना पश्चाद्देहं कालाग्निना दहेत् । ततश्चोपरिभावेन कलाः संहृत्य वायुना
verses.transliteration: vishoShya vAyunA pashchAddehaM kAlAgninA dahet | tatashchoparibhAvena kalAH saMhR^itya vAyunA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देहं संहृत्य वै दग्धं कलाः स्पृष्ट्वा सहाधिपम् । प्लावयित्वामृतैर्देहं यथास्थानं निवेशयेत्
verses.transliteration: dehaM saMhR^itya vai dagdhaM kalAH spR^iShTvA sahAdhipam | plAvayitvAmR^itairdehaM yathAsthAnaM niveshayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ संहृत्य वै दग्धः कलासर्गं विनैव तु । अमृतप्लावनं कुर्याद् भस्मीभूतस्य वै ततः
verses.transliteration: atha saMhR^itya vai dagdhaH kalAsargaM vinaiva tu | amR^itaplAvanaM kuryAd bhasmIbhUtasya vai tataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विद्यामये तस्मिन् देहे दीपशिखाकृतिम् । शिवान्निर्गतमात्मानं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण योजयेत्
verses.transliteration: tato vidyAmaye tasmin dehe dIpashikhAkR^itim | shivAnnirgatamAtmAnaM brahmarandhreNa yojayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देहस्यान्तः प्रविष्टं तं ध्यात्वा हृदयपङ्कजे । पुनश्चामृतवर्षेण सिञ्चेद् विद्यामयं वपुः
verses.transliteration: dehasyAntaH praviShTaM taM dhyAtvA hR^idayapa~Nkaje | punashchAmR^itavarSheNa si~nched vidyAmayaM vapuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कुर्यात् करन्यासं करशोधनपूर्वकम् । देहन्यासं ततः पश्चान्महत्या मुद्रया चरेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH kuryAt karanyAsaM karashodhanapUrvakam | dehanyAsaM tataH pashchAnmahatyA mudrayA charet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गन्यासं ततः कृत्वा शिवोक्तेन तु वर्त्मना । वर्णन्यासं ततः कुर्याद्धस्तपादादिसन्धिषु
verses.transliteration: a~NganyAsaM tataH kR^itvA shivoktena tu vartmanA | varNanyAsaM tataH kuryAddhastapAdAdisandhiShu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: षडङ्गानि ततो न्यस्य जातिषट्कयुतानि च । दिग्बन्धमाचरेत्पश्चादाग्नेयादि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: ShaDa~NgAni tato nyasya jAtiShaTkayutAni cha | digbandhamAcharetpashchAdAgneyAdi yathAkramam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा मूर्द्धादिपञ्चाङ्गं न्यासमेव समाचरेत् । तथा षडङ्गन्यासं च भूतशुद्ध्यादिकं विना
verses.transliteration: yadvA mUrddhAdipa~nchA~NgaM nyAsameva samAcharet | tathA ShaDa~NganyAsaM cha bhUtashuddhyAdikaM vinA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यतीनां संहृतिन्यासो वनस्थानां तथैव च । स एव भर्तृहीनायाः कुटुम्बिन्याः स्थितिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yatInAM saMhR^itinyAso vanasthAnAM tathaiva cha | sa eva bhartR^ihInAyAH kuTumbinyAH sthitirbhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं समासरूपेण कृत्वा देहात्मशोधनम् । शिवभावमुपागम्य पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evaM samAsarUpeNa kR^itvA dehAtmashodhanam | shivabhAvamupAgamya pUjayetparameshvaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ यस्यास्त्यवसरो नास्ति वा मतिविभ्रमः । स विस्तीर्णेन कल्पेन न्यासकर्म समाचरेत्
