verses.transliteration: atha yasyAstyavasaro nAsti vA mativibhramaH | sa vistIrNena kalpena nyAsakarma samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राद्यो मातृकान्यासो ब्रह्मन्यासस्ततः परः । तृतीयः प्रणवन्यासो हंसन्यासस्तदुत्तरः
verses.transliteration: tatrAdyo mAtR^ikAnyAso brahmanyAsastataH paraH | tR^itIyaH praNavanyAso haMsanyAsastaduttaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमः कथ्यते सद्भिर्न्यासः पञ्चाक्षरात्मकः । एतेष्वेकमनेकं वा कुर्यात् पूजादिकर्मसु
verses.transliteration: pa~nchamaH kathyate sadbhirnyAsaH pa~nchAkSharAtmakaH | eteShvekamanekaM vA kuryAt pUjAdikarmasu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अकारं मूर्ध्नि विन्यस्य आकारं च ललाटके । इं ईं च नेत्रयोस्तद्वत् उं ऊं श्रवणयोस्तथा
verses.transliteration: akAraM mUrdhni vinyasya AkAraM cha lalATake | iM IM cha netrayostadvat uM UM shravaNayostathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऋं ॠं कपोलयोश्चैव लृं ॡं नासापुटद्वये । एमैम्मोष्ठद्वयोरोमौं दन्तपङ्क्तिद्वयोः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: R^iM R^IM kapolayoshchaiva lR^iM LLIM nAsApuTadvaye | emaimmoShThadvayoromauM dantapa~NktidvayoH kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अं जिह्वायामथो तालुन्यः प्रयोज्यो यथाक्रमम् । कवर्गं दक्षिणे हस्ते न्यसेत्पञ्चसु सन्धिषु
verses.transliteration: aM jihvAyAmatho tAlunyaH prayojyo yathAkramam | kavargaM dakShiNe haste nyasetpa~nchasu sandhiShu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चवर्गं च तथा वामहस्तसन्धिषु विन्यसेत् । टवर्गं च तवर्गं च पादयोरुभयोरपि
verses.transliteration: chavargaM cha tathA vAmahastasandhiShu vinyaset | TavargaM cha tavargaM cha pAdayorubhayorapi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पफौ तु पार्श्वयोः पृष्ठे नाभौ चापि बभौ ततः । न्यसेन्मकारं हृदये त्वगादिषु यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: paphau tu pArshvayoH pR^iShThe nAbhau chApi babhau tataH | nyasenmakAraM hR^idaye tvagAdiShu yathAkramam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यकारादिसकारान्तान् न्यसेत्सप्तसु धातुषु । हङ्कारं हृदयस्यान्तः क्षकारं भ्रूयुगान्तरे
verses.transliteration: yakArAdisakArAntAn nyasetsaptasu dhAtuShu | ha~NkAraM hR^idayasyAntaH kShakAraM bhrUyugAntare
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यायाः पुनरुत्पत्तिं वक्ष्ये न्यासस्य लक्षणम् । अङ्गुष्ठादिकनिष्ठान्तं स्थितिन्यास उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: kanyAyAH punarutpattiM vakShye nyAsasya lakShaNam | a~NguShThAdikaniShThAntaM sthitinyAsa udAhR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वर्णान् प्रविन्यस्य पञ्चाशत् रुद्रवर्त्मना । अङ्गवक्त्रकलाभेदात् पञ्च ब्रह्माणि विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM varNAn pravinyasya pa~nchAshat rudravartmanA | a~NgavaktrakalAbhedAt pa~ncha brahmANi vinyaset
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: करन्यासाद्यमपि तैः कृत्वा वाथ न वा क्रमात् । शिरोवदनहृद्गुह्यपादेष्वेतानि कल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: karanyAsAdyamapi taiH kR^itvA vAtha na vA kramAt | shirovadanahR^idguhyapAdeShvetAni kalpayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चोर्ध्वादिवक्त्राणि पश्चिमान्तानि कल्पयेत् । ईशानस्य कलाः पञ्च पञ्चस्वेतेषु च क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tatashchordhvAdivaktrANi pashchimAntAni kalpayet | IshAnasya kalAH pa~ncha pa~nchasveteShu cha kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चतुर्षु वक्त्रेषु पुरुषस्य कला अपि । चतस्रः प्रणिधातव्याः पूर्वादिक्रमयोगतः
verses.transliteration: tatashchaturShu vaktreShu puruShasya kalA api | chatasraH praNidhAtavyAH pUrvAdikramayogataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हृत्कण्ठांसेषु नाभौ च कुक्षौ पृष्ठे च वक्षसि । अघोरस्य कलाश्चाष्टौ पादयोरपि हस्तयोः
verses.transliteration: hR^itkaNThAMseShu nAbhau cha kukShau pR^iShThe cha vakShasi | aghorasya kalAshchAShTau pAdayorapi hastayoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात् त्रयोदशकलाः पायुमेढ्रोरुजानुषु । जङ्घास्फिक्कटिपार्श्वेषु वामदेवस्य भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: pashchAt trayodashakalAH pAyumeDhrorujAnuShu | ja~NghAsphikkaTipArshveShu vAmadevasya bhAvayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सद्यस्याऽपि कलाश्चाष्टौ पादयोरपि हस्तयोः । घ्राणे शिरसि बाह्वोश्च कल्पयेत्कल्पवित्तमः । अष्टत्रिंशत्कलान्यासमेवं कृत्वानुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: sadyasyA.api kalAshchAShTau pAdayorapi hastayoH | ghrANe shirasi bAhvoshcha kalpayetkalpavittamaH | aShTatriMshatkalAnyAsamevaM kR^itvAnupUrvashaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात् प्रणवविद्धीमान् प्रणवन्यासमाचरेत् । बाहुद्वये कूर्परयोस्तथा च मणिबन्धयोः
verses.transliteration: pashchAt praNavaviddhImAn praNavanyAsamAcharet | bAhudvaye kUrparayostathA cha maNibandhayoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पार्श्वोदरोरुजङ्घेषु पादयोः पृष्ठतस्तथा । इत्थं प्रणवविन्यासं कृत्वा न्यासविचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: pArshvodaroruja~NgheShu pAdayoH pR^iShThatastathA | itthaM praNavavinyAsaM kR^itvA nyAsavichakShaNaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हंसन्यासं प्रकुर्वीत शिवशास्त्रे यथोदितम् । बीजं विभज्य हंसस्य नेत्रयोर्घ्राणयोरपि
verses.transliteration: haMsanyAsaM prakurvIta shivashAstre yathoditam | bIjaM vibhajya haMsasya netrayorghrANayorapi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठमारभ्य वामाङ्गुष्ठान्तमेव च । उत्पत्तिन्यास आख्यातो विपरीतस्तु संहृतिः
verses.transliteration: dakShiNA~NguShThamArabhya vAmA~NguShThAntameva cha | utpattinyAsa AkhyAto viparItastu saMhR^itiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विभज्य बाहुनेत्रास्यललाटे कर्णयोरपि । कक्षयोः स्कन्धयोश्चैव पार्श्वयोः स्तनयोस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vibhajya bAhunetrAsyalalATe karNayorapi | kakShayoH skandhayoshchaiva pArshvayoH stanayostathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कट्यां पाण्योर्गुल्फयोश्च यद्वा पञ्चाङ्गवर्त्मना । हंसन्यासमिमं कृत्वा न्यसेत् पञ्चाक्षरीं ततः
verses.transliteration: kaTyAM pANyorgulphayoshcha yadvA pa~nchA~NgavartmanA | haMsanyAsamimaM kR^itvA nyaset pa~nchAkSharIM tataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथा पूर्वोक्तमार्गेण शिवत्वं येन जायते । नाशिवः शिवमभ्यस्येन्नाशिवः शिवमर्चयेत् । नाशिवस्तु शिवं ध्यायेन्नाशिवः प्राप्नुयात् शिवम्
verses.transliteration: yathA pUrvoktamArgeNa shivatvaM yena jAyate | nAshivaH shivamabhyasyennAshivaH shivamarchayet | nAshivastu shivaM dhyAyennAshivaH prApnuyAt shivam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् शैवीं तनुं कृत्वा त्यक्त्वा च पशुभावनाम् । शिवोऽहमिति सञ्चिन्त्य शैवं कर्म समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAt shaivIM tanuM kR^itvA tyaktvA cha pashubhAvanAm | shivo.ahamiti sa~nchintya shaivaM karma samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मयज्ञस्तपोयज्ञो जपयज्ञस्तदुत्तरः । ध्यानयज्ञो ज्ञानयज्ञः पञ्च यज्ञाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: karmayaj~nastapoyaj~no japayaj~nastaduttaraH | dhyAnayaj~no j~nAnayaj~naH pa~ncha yaj~nAH prakIrtitAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मयज्ञरताः केचित्तपोयज्ञरताः परे । जपयज्ञरताश्चान्ये ध्यानयज्ञरतास्तथा
verses.transliteration: karmayaj~naratAH kechittapoyaj~naratAH pare | japayaj~naratAshchAnye dhyAnayaj~naratAstathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानयज्ञरताश्चान्ये विशिष्टाश्चोत्तरोत्तरम् । कर्मयज्ञो द्विधा प्रोक्तः कामाकामविभेदतः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnayaj~naratAshchAnye vishiShTAshchottarottaram | karmayaj~no dvidhA proktaH kAmAkAmavibhedataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कामान् कामी ततो भुक्त्वा कामासक्तः पुनर्भवेत् । अकामो रुद्रभवने भोगान् भुक्त्वा ततश्च्युतः
verses.transliteration: kAmAn kAmI tato bhuktvA kAmAsaktaH punarbhavet | akAmo rudrabhavane bhogAn bhuktvA tatashchyutaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तपोयज्ञरतो भूत्वा जायते नात्र संशयः । तपस्वी च पुनस्तस्मिन् भोगान् भुक्त्वा ततश्च्युतः
verses.transliteration: tapoyaj~narato bhUtvA jAyate nAtra saMshayaH | tapasvI cha punastasmin bhogAn bhuktvA tatashchyutaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जपध्यानरतो भूत्वा जायते भुवि मानवः । जपध्यानरतो मर्त्यस्तद्वैशिष्ट्यवशादिह
verses.transliteration: japadhyAnarato bhUtvA jAyate bhuvi mAnavaH | japadhyAnarato martyastadvaishiShTyavashAdiha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सबिन्दुकान्नकारादीन् वर्णान् न्यस्येदनुक्रमात् । अङ्गुलीषु शिवं न्यस्येत् तलयोरप्यनामयोः
verses.transliteration: sabindukAnnakArAdIn varNAn nyasyedanukramAt | a~NgulIShu shivaM nyasyet talayorapyanAmayoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं लब्ध्वाचिरादेव शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् । तस्मान्मुक्तो शिवाज्ञप्तः कर्मयज्ञोऽपि देहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: j~nAnaM labdhvAchirAdeva shivasAyujyamApnuyAt | tasmAnmukto shivAj~naptaH karmayaj~no.api dehinAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अकामः कामसंयुक्तो बन्धायैव भविष्यति । तस्मात्पञ्चसु यज्ञेषु ध्यानज्ञानपरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: akAmaH kAmasaMyukto bandhAyaiva bhaviShyati | tasmAtpa~nchasu yaj~neShu dhyAnaj~nAnaparo bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं ज्ञानं च यस्यास्ति तीर्णस्तेन भवार्णवः । हिंसादिदोषनिर्मुक्तो विशुद्धश्चित्तसाधनः
verses.transliteration: dhyAnaM j~nAnaM cha yasyAsti tIrNastena bhavArNavaH | hiMsAdidoShanirmukto vishuddhashchittasAdhanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानयज्ञः परस्तस्मादपवर्गफलप्रदः । बहिः कर्मिकरा यद्वन्नातीव फलभागिनः
verses.transliteration: dhyAnayaj~naH parastasmAdapavargaphalapradaH | bahiH karmikarA yadvannAtIva phalabhAginaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा नरेन्द्रभवने तद्वदत्रापि कर्मिणः । ध्यानिनां हि वपुः सूक्ष्मं भवेत्प्रत्यक्षमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA narendrabhavane tadvadatrApi karmiNaH | dhyAninAM hi vapuH sUkShmaM bhavetpratyakShamaishvaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथेह कर्मिणां स्थूलं मृत्काष्ठाद्यैः प्रकल्पितम् । ध्यानयज्ञरतास्तस्माद्देवान्पाषाणमृण्मयान्
verses.transliteration: yatheha karmiNAM sthUlaM mR^itkAShThAdyaiH prakalpitam | dhyAnayaj~naratAstasmAddevAnpAShANamR^iNmayAn
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नात्यन्तं प्रतिपद्यन्ते शिवयाथात्म्यवेदनात् । आत्मस्थं यः शिवं त्यक्त्वा बहिरभ्यर्चयेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: nAtyantaM pratipadyante shivayAthAtmyavedanAt | AtmasthaM yaH shivaM tyaktvA bahirabhyarchayennaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तस्थं फलमुत्सृज्य लिहेत्कूर्परमात्मनः । ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं भवेद्ध्यानाज्ज्ञानं भूयः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: hastasthaM phalamutsR^ijya lihetkUrparamAtmanaH | j~nAnAddhyAnaM bhaveddhyAnAjj~nAnaM bhUyaH pravartate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदुभाभ्यां भवेन्मुक्तिस्तस्माद्ध्यानरतो भवेत् । द्वादशान्ते तथा मूर्ध्नि ललाटे भ्रूयुगान्तरे
verses.transliteration: tadubhAbhyAM bhavenmuktistasmAddhyAnarato bhavet | dvAdashAnte tathA mUrdhni lalATe bhrUyugAntare
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नासाग्रे वा तथास्ये वा कन्धरे हृदये तथा । नाभौ वा शाश्वतस्थाने श्रद्धाविद्धेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: nAsAgre vA tathAsye vA kandhare hR^idaye tathA | nAbhau vA shAshvatasthAne shraddhAviddhena chetasA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रन्यासं ततः कृत्वा दशदिक्ष्वस्त्रमन्त्रतः । निवृत्त्यादिकलाः पञ्च पञ्चभूतस्वरूपिणीः
verses.transliteration: astranyAsaM tataH kR^itvA dashadikShvastramantrataH | nivR^ittyAdikalAH pa~ncha pa~nchabhUtasvarUpiNIH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बहिर्यागोपचारेण देवं देवीं च पूजयेत् । अथवा पूजयेन्नित्यं लिङ्गे वा कृतकेऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: bahiryAgopachAreNa devaM devIM cha pUjayet | athavA pUjayennityaM li~Nge vA kR^itake.api vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वह्नौ वा स्थण्डिले वाथ भक्त्या वित्तानुसारतः । अथवान्तर्बहिश्चैव पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् । अन्तर्यागरतः पूजां बहिः कुर्वीत वा न वा
verses.transliteration: vahnau vA sthaNDile vAtha bhaktyA vittAnusArataH | athavAntarbahishchaiva pUjayetparameshvaram | antaryAgarataH pUjAM bahiH kurvIta vA na vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चभूताधिपैः सार्द्धं तत्तच्चिह्नसमन्विताः । हृत्कण्ठतालुभ्रूमध्यब्रह्मरन्ध्रसमाश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchabhUtAdhipaiH sArddhaM tattachchihnasamanvitAH | hR^itkaNThatAlubhrUmadhyabrahmarandhrasamAshrayAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तद्बीजेन सङ्ग्रन्थींस्तत्तद्बीजेषु भावयेत् । तासां विशोधनार्थाय विद्यां पञ्चाक्षरीं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: tattadbIjena sa~NgranthIMstattadbIjeShu bhAvayet | tAsAM vishodhanArthAya vidyAM pa~nchAkSharIM japet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निरुद्ध्वा प्राणवायुं च गुणसङ्ख्यानुसारतः । भूतग्रन्थिं ततः छिन्द्यादस्त्रेणैवास्त्रमुद्रया
verses.transliteration: niruddhvA prANavAyuM cha guNasa~NkhyAnusArataH | bhUtagranthiM tataH ChindyAdastreNaivAstramudrayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.२३. त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः । पूजाविधान व्याख्यानवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । व्याख्यां पूजाविधानस्य प्रवदामि समासतः । शिवशास्त्रे शिवेनैव शिवायै कथितस्य तु
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.23\. trayoviMsho.adhyAyaH | pUjAvidhAna vyAkhyAnavarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | vyAkhyAM pUjAvidhAnasya pravadAmi samAsataH | shivashAstre shivenaiva shivAyai kathitasya tu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपमानरहितं सानुगं सपरिच्छदम् । ततः सञ्चिन्तयेत्तस्य वामभागे महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: sarvopamAnarahitaM sAnugaM saparichChadam | tataH sa~nchintayettasya vAmabhAge maheshvarIm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रफुल्लोत्पलपत्राभां विस्तीर्णायतलोचनाम् । पूर्णचन्द्राभवदनां नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजाम्
verses.transliteration: praphullotpalapatrAbhAM vistIrNAyatalochanAm | pUrNachandrAbhavadanAM nIlaku~nchitamUrdhajAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलदलप्रख्यां चन्द्रार्द्धकृतशेखराम् । अतिवृत्तघनोत्तुङ्गस्निग्धपीनपयोधराम्
verses.transliteration: nIlotpaladalaprakhyAM chandrArddhakR^itashekharAm | ativR^ittaghanottu~NgasnigdhapInapayodharAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तनुमध्यां पृथुश्रोणीं पीतसूक्ष्मवराम्बराम् । सर्वाभरणसम्पन्नां ललाटतिलकोज्ज्वलाम्
verses.transliteration: tanumadhyAM pR^ithushroNIM pItasUkShmavarAmbarAm | sarvAbharaNasampannAM lalATatilakojjvalAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रपुष्पसङ्कीर्णकेशपाशोपशोभिताम् । सर्वतोऽनुगुणाकारां किञ्चिल्लज्जानताननाम्
verses.transliteration: vichitrapuShpasa~NkIrNakeshapAshopashobhitAm | sarvato.anuguNAkArAM ki~nchillajjAnatAnanAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हेमारविन्दं विलसद्दधानां दक्षिणे करे । दण्डवच्चापरं हस्तं न्यस्यासीनां महासने
verses.transliteration: hemAravindaM vilasaddadhAnAM dakShiNe kare | daNDavachchAparaM hastaM nyasyAsInAM mahAsane
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पाशविच्छेदिकां साक्षात्सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणीम् । एवं देवं च देवीं च ध्यात्वासनवरे शुभे
verses.transliteration: pAshavichChedikAM sAkShAtsachchidAnandarUpiNIm | evaM devaM cha devIM cha dhyAtvAsanavare shubhe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपचारवद् भक्त्या भावपुष्पैः समर्चयेत् । अथवा परिकल्प्यैवं मूर्तिमन्यतमां विभोः
verses.transliteration: sarvopachAravad bhaktyA bhAvapuShpaiH samarchayet | athavA parikalpyaivaM mUrtimanyatamAM vibhoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शैवीं सदाशिवाख्यां वा तथा माहेश्वरीं पराम् । षड्विंशकाभिधानां वा श्रीकण्ठाख्यामथापि वा
verses.transliteration: shaivIM sadAshivAkhyAM vA tathA mAheshvarIM parAm | ShaDviMshakAbhidhAnAM vA shrIkaNThAkhyAmathApi vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रन्यासादिकांश्चापि कृत्वा स्वस्यां तनौ यथा । अस्यां मूर्तौ मूर्तिमन्तं शिवं सदसतः परम्
verses.transliteration: mantranyAsAdikAMshchApi kR^itvA svasyAM tanau yathA | asyAM mUrtau mUrtimantaM shivaM sadasataH param
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गमभ्यन्तरं यागमग्निकार्यावसानकम् । विधाय वा न वा पश्चाद् बहिर्यागं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: a~NgamabhyantaraM yAgamagnikAryAvasAnakam | vidhAya vA na vA pashchAd bahiryAgaM samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा बाह्यक्रमेणैव पूजां निर्वर्त्तयेद्धिया । समिदाज्यादिभिः पश्चान्नाभौ होमं च भावयेत्
verses.transliteration: dhyAtvA bAhyakrameNaiva pUjAM nirvarttayeddhiyA | samidAjyAdibhiH pashchAnnAbhau homaM cha bhAvayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूमध्ये च शिवं ध्यायेच्छुद्धदीपशिखाकृतिम् । इत्थमङ्गे स्वतन्त्रे वा योगे ध्यानमये शुभे
verses.transliteration: bhrUmadhye cha shivaM dhyAyechChuddhadIpashikhAkR^itim | itthama~Nge svatantre vA yoge dhyAnamaye shubhe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निकार्यावसानं च सर्वत्रैव समो विधिः । अथ चिन्तामयं सर्वं समाप्याराधनक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: agnikAryAvasAnaM cha sarvatraiva samo vidhiH | atha chintAmayaM sarvaM samApyArAdhanakramam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गे च पूजयेद्देवं स्थण्डिले वानलेऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: li~Nge cha pUjayeddevaM sthaNDile vAnale.api vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र द्रव्याणि मनसा कल्पयित्वा विशोध्य च । ध्यात्वा विनायकं देवं पूजयित्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: tatra dravyANi manasA kalpayitvA vishodhya cha | dhyAtvA vinAyakaM devaM pUjayitvA vidhAnataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे चोत्तरे चैव नन्दीशं सुयशां तथा । आराध्य मनसा सम्यगासनं कल्पयेद्बुधः
verses.transliteration: dakShiNe chottare chaiva nandIshaM suyashAM tathA | ArAdhya manasA samyagAsanaM kalpayedbudhaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आराधनादिकैर्युक्तः सिंहयोगासनादिकम् । पद्मासनं वा विमलं तत्त्वत्रयसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: ArAdhanAdikairyuktaH siMhayogAsanAdikam | padmAsanaM vA vimalaM tattvatrayasamanvitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्योपरि शिवं ध्यायेत् साम्बं सर्वमनोहरम् । सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नं सर्वावयवशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: tasyopari shivaM dhyAyet sAmbaM sarvamanoharam | sarvalakShaNasampannaM sarvAvayavashobhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वातिशयसंयुक्तं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् । रक्तास्यपाणिचरणं कुन्दचन्द्रस्मिताननम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAtishayasaMyuktaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam | raktAsyapANicharaNaM kundachandrasmitAnanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं फुल्लपद्मत्रिलोचनम् । चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं चारुचन्द्रकलाधरम्
verses.transliteration: shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshaM phullapadmatrilochanam | chaturbhujamudArA~NgaM chAruchandrakalAdharam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वरदाभयहस्तं च मृगटङ्कधरं हरम् । भुजङ्गहारवलयं चारुनीलगलान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: varadAbhayahastaM cha mR^igaTa~NkadharaM haram | bhuja~NgahAravalayaM chArunIlagalAntaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.२४. चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः । शास्त्रोक्तशिवपूजनवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । प्रोक्षयेन्मूलमन्त्रेण पूजास्थानं विशुद्धये । गन्धचन्दनतोयेन पुष्पं तत्र विनिक्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.24\. chaturviMsho.adhyAyaH | shAstroktashivapUjanavarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | prokShayenmUlamantreNa pUjAsthAnaM vishuddhaye | gandhachandanatoyena puShpaM tatra vinikShipet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कुशाग्राण्यक्षतांश्चैव यवव्रीहितिलानपि । आज्यसिद्धार्थपुष्पाणि भसितं चार्घ्यपात्रके
verses.transliteration: kushAgrANyakShatAMshchaiva yavavrIhitilAnapi | AjyasiddhArthapuShpANi bhasitaM chArghyapAtrake
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कुशपुष्पयवव्रीहिबहुमूलतमालकान् । प्रक्षिपेत् प्रोक्षणीपात्रे भसितं च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: kushapuShpayavavrIhibahumUlatamAlakAn | prakShipet prokShaNIpAtre bhasitaM cha yathAkramam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र मन्त्रं विन्यस्य वर्मणावेष्ट्य बाह्यतः । पश्चादस्त्रेण संरक्ष्य धेनुमुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvatra mantraM vinyasya varmaNAveShTya bAhyataH | pashchAdastreNa saMrakShya dhenumudrAM pradarshayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पूजाद्रव्याणि सर्वाणि प्रोक्षणीपात्रवारिणा । सम्प्रोक्ष्य मूलमन्त्रेण शोधयेद्विधिवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: pUjAdravyANi sarvANi prokShaNIpAtravAriNA | samprokShya mUlamantreNa shodhayedvidhivattataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पात्राणां प्रोक्षणीमेकामलाभे सर्वकर्मसु । साधयेदर्घ्यमद्भिस्तत्सामान्यं साधकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: pAtrANAM prokShaNImekAmalAbhe sarvakarmasu | sAdhayedarghyamadbhistatsAmAnyaM sAdhakottamaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विनायकं देवं भक्ष्यभोज्यादिभिः क्रमात् । पूजयित्वा विधानेन द्वारपार्श्वेऽथ दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: tato vinAyakaM devaM bhakShyabhojyAdibhiH kramAt | pUjayitvA vidhAnena dvArapArshve.atha dakShiNe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःपुराधिपं साक्षान्नन्दिनं सम्यगर्चयेत् । चामीकराचलप्रख्यं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: antaHpurAdhipaM sAkShAnnandinaM samyagarchayet | chAmIkarAchalaprakhyaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बालेन्दुमुकुटं सौम्यं त्रिनेत्रं च चतुर्भुजम् । दीप्तशूलमृगीटङ्कतिग्मवेत्रधरं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: bAlendumukuTaM saumyaM trinetraM cha chaturbhujam | dIptashUlamR^igITa~NkatigmavetradharaM prabhum
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रबिम्बाभवदनं हरिवक्त्रमथापि वा । उत्तरे द्वारपार्श्वस्य भार्यां च मरुतां सुताम्
verses.transliteration: chandrabimbAbhavadanaM harivaktramathApi vA | uttare dvArapArshvasya bhAryAM cha marutAM sutAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सुयशां सुव्रतामम्बां पादमण्डनतत्पराम् । पूजयित्वा प्रविश्यान्तर्भवनं परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: suyashAM suvratAmambAM pAdamaNDanatatparAm | pUjayitvA pravishyAntarbhavanaM parameShThinaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रेणोत्सार्य वै विघ्नानवगुण्ठ्य च वर्मणा । अस्त्रं दिक्षु प्रविन्यस्य कल्पयेदर्चनाभुवम्
verses.transliteration: astreNotsArya vai vighnAnavaguNThya cha varmaNA | astraM dikShu pravinyasya kalpayedarchanAbhuvam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य लिङ्गं तैर्द्रव्यैर्निर्माल्यमपनोदयेत् । प्रक्षाल्य पुष्पं शिरसि न्यसेत्तस्य विशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: sampUjya li~NgaM tairdravyairnirmAlyamapanodayet | prakShAlya puShpaM shirasi nyasettasya vishuddhaye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पहस्तो जपेत् शक्त्या मन्त्रं मन्त्रविशुद्धये । ऐशान्यां चण्दमाराध्य निर्माल्यं तस्य दापयेत्
verses.transliteration: puShpahasto japet shaktyA mantraM mantravishuddhaye | aishAnyAM chaNdamArAdhya nirmAlyaM tasya dApayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पयेदासनं पश्चादाधारादि यथाक्रमम् । आधारशक्तिं कल्याणीं श्यामां ध्यायेदथो भुवि
verses.transliteration: kalpayedAsanaM pashchAdAdhArAdi yathAkramam | AdhArashaktiM kalyANIM shyAmAM dhyAyedatho bhuvi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पुरस्तादुत्कण्ठमनन्तं कुण्डलाकृतिम् । धवलं पञ्चफणिनं लेलिहानमिवाम्बरम्
verses.transliteration: tasyAH purastAdutkaNThamanantaM kuNDalAkR^itim | dhavalaM pa~nchaphaNinaM lelihAnamivAmbaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्योपर्यासनं भद्रं कण्ठीरवचतुष्पदम् । धर्मो ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं च पदानि वै
verses.transliteration: tasyoparyAsanaM bhadraM kaNThIravachatuShpadam | dharmo j~nAnaM cha vairAgyamaishvaryaM cha padAni vai
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयादिश्वेतरक्तपीतश्यामानि वर्णतः । अधर्मादीनि पूर्वादीन्युत्तरान्तान्यनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: AgneyAdishvetaraktapItashyAmAni varNataH | adharmAdIni pUrvAdInyuttarAntAnyanukramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: राजावर्तमणिप्रख्यान्न्यस्य गात्राणि भावयेत् । अस्योर्ध्वच्छादनं पद्ममासनं विमलं सितम्
verses.transliteration: rAjAvartamaNiprakhyAnnyasya gAtrANi bhAvayet | asyordhvachChAdanaM padmamAsanaM vimalaM sitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टपत्राणि तस्याहुरणिमादिगुणाष्टकम् । केसराणि च वामाद्या रुद्रा वामादिशक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: aShTapatrANi tasyAhuraNimAdiguNAShTakam | kesarANi cha vAmAdyA rudrA vAmAdishaktibhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बीजान्यपि च ता एव शक्तयोन्तर्मनोन्मनीः । कर्णिकापरवैराग्यं नालं ज्ञानं शिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: bIjAnyapi cha tA eva shaktayontarmanonmanIH | karNikAparavairAgyaM nAlaM j~nAnaM shivAtmakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कन्दश्च शिवधर्मात्मा कर्णिकान्ते त्रिमण्डले । त्रिमण्डलोपर्यात्मादितत्त्वत्रितयमासनम्
verses.transliteration: kandashcha shivadharmAtmA karNikAnte trimaNDale | trimaNDaloparyAtmAditattvatritayamAsanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दर्भान्परिस्तीर्य क्षालयेत्प्रोक्षणादिभिः । संशोध्य सर्वपात्राणि द्रव्यशुद्धिं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra darbhAnparistIrya kShAlayetprokShaNAdibhiH | saMshodhya sarvapAtrANi dravyashuddhiM samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासनोपरि सुखं विचित्रास्तरणास्तृतम् । आसनं कल्पयेद्दिव्यं शुद्धविद्यासमुज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAsanopari sukhaM vichitrAstaraNAstR^itam | AsanaM kalpayeddivyaM shuddhavidyAsamujjvalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आवाहनं स्थापनं च सन्निरोधं निरीक्षणम् । नमस्कारं च कुर्वीत बध्वा मुद्राः पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: AvAhanaM sthApanaM cha sannirodhaM nirIkShaNam | namaskAraM cha kurvIta badhvA mudrAH pR^ithakpR^ithak
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पाद्यमाचमनं चार्घ्यं गन्धं पुष्पं ततः परम् । धूपं दीपं च ताम्बूलं दत्त्वाथ स्नापयेत् शिवौ
verses.transliteration: pAdyamAchamanaM chArghyaM gandhaM puShpaM tataH param | dhUpaM dIpaM cha tAmbUlaM dattvAtha snApayet shivau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा परिकल्प्यैवमासनं मूर्तिमेव च । सकलीकृत्य मूलेन ब्रह्मभिश्चापरैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: athavA parikalpyaivamAsanaM mUrtimeva cha | sakalIkR^itya mUlena brahmabhishchAparaistathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आवाहयेत्ततो देव्या शिवं परमकारणम् । शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं देवं निश्चलमक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: AvAhayettato devyA shivaM paramakAraNam | shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshaM devaM nishchalamakSharam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कारणं सर्वलोकानां सर्वलोकमयं परम् । अन्तर्बहिःस्थितं व्याप्य ह्यणोरणु महत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: kAraNaM sarvalokAnAM sarvalokamayaM param | antarbahiHsthitaM vyApya hyaNoraNu mahattaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तानामप्रयत्नेन दृश्यमीश्वरमव्ययम् । ब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्णुरुद्राद्यैरपि देवैरगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktAnAmaprayatnena dR^ishyamIshvaramavyayam | brahmendraviShNurudrAdyairapi devairagocharam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देवसारं च विद्वद्भिरगोचरमिति श्रुतम् । आदिमध्यान्तरहितं भेषजं भवरोगिणाम्
verses.transliteration: devasAraM cha vidvadbhiragocharamiti shrutam | AdimadhyAntarahitaM bheShajaM bhavarogiNAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवतत्त्वमिति ख्यातं शिवार्थं जगति स्थिरम् । पञ्चोपचारवद्भक्त्या पूजयेल्लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shivatattvamiti khyAtaM shivArthaM jagati sthiram | pa~nchopachAravadbhaktyA pUjayelli~Ngamuttamam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गमूर्त्तिर्महेशस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः । स्नानकाले प्रकुर्वीत जयशब्दादिमङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration: li~NgamUrttirmaheshasya shivasya paramAtmanaH | snAnakAle prakurvIta jayashabdAdima~Ngalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्षणीमर्घ्यपात्रं च पाद्यपात्रमतः परम् । तथैवाचमनीयस्य पात्रं चेति चतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: prokShaNImarghyapAtraM cha pAdyapAtramataH param | tathaivAchamanIyasya pAtraM cheti chatuShTayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चगव्यघृतक्षीरदधिमध्वादिपूर्वकैः । मूलैः फलानां सारैश्च तिलसर्षपसक्तुभिः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchagavyaghR^itakShIradadhimadhvAdipUrvakaiH | mUlaiH phalAnAM sAraishcha tilasarShapasaktubhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बीजैर्यवादिभिश्शस्तैश्चूर्णैर्माषादिसम्भवैः । संस्नाप्यालिप्य पिष्टाद्यैः स्नापयेदुष्णवारिभिः
verses.transliteration: bIjairyavAdibhishshastaishchUrNairmAShAdisambhavaiH | saMsnApyAlipya piShTAdyaiH snApayeduShNavAribhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: घर्षयेद्बिल्वपत्राद्यैर्लेपगन्धापनुत्तये । पुनः संस्नाप्य सलिलैश्चक्रवर्त्त्युपचारतः
verses.transliteration: gharShayedbilvapatrAdyairlepagandhApanuttaye | punaH saMsnApya salilaishchakravarttyupachArataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सुगन्धामलकं दद्याद् हरिद्रां च यथाक्रमम् । ततः संशोध्य सलिलैर्लिङ्गं बेरमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: sugandhAmalakaM dadyAd haridrAM cha yathAkramam | tataH saMshodhya salilairli~NgaM beramathApi vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयेद्गन्धतोयेन कुशपुष्पोदकेन च । हिरण्यरत्नतोयैश्च मन्त्रसिद्धैर्यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: snApayedgandhatoyena kushapuShpodakena cha | hiraNyaratnatoyaishcha mantrasiddhairyathAkramam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असम्भवे तु द्रव्याणां यथासम्भवसम्भृतैः । केवलैर्मन्त्रतोयैर्वा स्नापयेच्छ्रद्धया शिवम्
verses.transliteration: asambhave tu dravyANAM yathAsambhavasambhR^itaiH | kevalairmantratoyairvA snApayechChraddhayA shivam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कलशेनाथ शङ्खेन वर्द्धन्या पाणिना तथा । सकुशेन सपुष्पेण स्नापयेन्मन्त्रपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: kalashenAtha sha~Nkhena varddhanyA pANinA tathA | sakushena sapuShpeNa snApayenmantrapUrvakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पवमानेन रुद्रेण नीलेन त्वरितेन च । लिङ्गसूक्तादिसूक्तैश्च शिरसाथर्वणेन च
verses.transliteration: pavamAnena rudreNa nIlena tvaritena cha | li~NgasUktAdisUktaishcha shirasAtharvaNena cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्भिश्च सामभिः शैवैर्ब्रह्मभिश्चापि पञ्चभिः । स्नापयेद्देवदेवेशं शिवेन प्रणवेन च
verses.transliteration: R^igbhishcha sAmabhiH shaivairbrahmabhishchApi pa~nchabhiH | snApayeddevadeveshaM shivena praNavena cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथा देवस्य देव्याश्च कुर्यात्स्नानादिकं तथा । न तु कश्चिद्विशेषोऽस्ति तत्र तौ सदृशौ यतः
verses.transliteration: yathA devasya devyAshcha kuryAtsnAnAdikaM tathA | na tu kashchidvisheSho.asti tatra tau sadR^ishau yataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य प्रोक्ष्य वीक्ष्याथ क्षिपेत्तेषु जलं शिवम् । पुण्यद्रव्याणि सर्वाणि यथालाभं विनिक्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: prakShAlya prokShya vIkShyAtha kShipetteShu jalaM shivam | puNyadravyANi sarvANi yathAlAbhaM vinikShipet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं देवमुद्दिश्य कृत्वा स्नानादिकाः क्रियाः । देव्यै प्रश्चात्प्रकुर्वीत देवदेवस्य शासनात्
verses.transliteration: prathamaM devamuddishya kR^itvA snAnAdikAH kriyAH | devyai prashchAtprakurvIta devadevasya shAsanAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अर्द्धनारीश्वरे पूज्ये पौर्वापर्यं न विद्यते । तत्र तत्रोपचाराणां लिङ्गे वान्यत्र वा क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: arddhanArIshvare pUjye paurvAparyaM na vidyate | tatra tatropachArANAM li~Nge vAnyatra vA kvachit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाऽभिषेकं लिङ्गस्य शुचिना च सुगन्धिना । सम्मृज्य वाससा दद्यादम्बरं चोपवीतकम्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA.abhiShekaM li~Ngasya shuchinA cha sugandhinA | sammR^ijya vAsasA dadyAdambaraM chopavItakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पाद्यमाचमनं चार्घ्यं गन्धं पुष्पं च भूषणम् । धूपं दीपं च नैवेद्यं पानीयं मुखशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: pAdyamAchamanaM chArghyaM gandhaM puShpaM cha bhUShaNam | dhUpaM dIpaM cha naivedyaM pAnIyaM mukhashodhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्चाचमनीयं च मुखवासं ततः परम् । मुकुटं च शुभं भद्रं सर्वरत्नैरलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: punashchAchamanIyaM cha mukhavAsaM tataH param | mukuTaM cha shubhaM bhadraM sarvaratnairala~NkR^itam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भूषणानि पवित्राणि माल्यानि विविधानि च । व्यजने चामरे छत्रं तालवृन्तं च दर्पणम्
verses.transliteration: bhUShaNAni pavitrANi mAlyAni vividhAni cha | vyajane chAmare ChatraM tAlavR^intaM cha darpaNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा नीराजनं कुर्यात्सर्वमङ्गलनिःस्वनैः । गीतनृत्यादिभिश्चैव जयशब्दसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: dattvA nIrAjanaM kuryAtsarvama~NgalaniHsvanaiH | gItanR^ityAdibhishchaiva jayashabdasamanvitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हैमे च राजते ताम्रे पात्रे वा मृण्मये शुभे । पद्मकैः शोभितैः पुष्पैर्बीजैर्दध्यक्षतादिभिः
verses.transliteration: haime cha rAjate tAmre pAtre vA mR^iNmaye shubhe | padmakaiH shobhitaiH puShpairbIjairdadhyakShatAdibhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलशङ्खयुग्माब्जनन्द्यावर्तैः करीषजैः । श्रीवत्सस्वस्तिकादर्शवज्रैर्वह्न्यादिचिह्नितैः
verses.transliteration: trishUlasha~NkhayugmAbjanandyAvartaiH karIShajaiH | shrIvatsasvastikAdarshavajrairvahnyAdichihnitaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ प्रदीपान्परितो विधायैकं तु मध्यमे । तेषु वामादिकाश्चिन्त्याः पूज्याश्च नव शक्तयः
verses.transliteration: aShTau pradIpAnparito vidhAyaikaM tu madhyame | teShu vAmAdikAshchintyAH pUjyAshcha nava shaktayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रत्नानि रजतं हेम गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादयः । फलपल्लवदर्भांश्च पुण्यद्रव्याण्यनेकधा
verses.transliteration: ratnAni rajataM hema gandhapuShpAkShatAdayaH | phalapallavadarbhAMshcha puNyadravyANyanekadhA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कवचेन समाच्छाद्य संरक्ष्यास्त्रेण सर्वतः । धेनुमुद्रां च सन्दर्श्य पाणिभ्यां पात्रमुद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: kavachena samAchChAdya saMrakShyAstreNa sarvataH | dhenumudrAM cha sandarshya pANibhyAM pAtramuddharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथवारोपयेत्पात्रे पञ्चदीपान्यथाक्रमम् । विदिक्ष्वपि च मध्ये च दीपमेकमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: athavAropayetpAtre pa~nchadIpAnyathAkramam | vidikShvapi cha madhye cha dIpamekamathApi vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तत्पात्रमुद्धृत्य लिङ्गादेरुपरि क्रमात् । त्रिःप्रदक्षिणयोगेन भ्रामयेन्मूलविद्यया
verses.transliteration: tatastatpAtramuddhR^itya li~NgAderupari kramAt | triHpradakShiNayogena bhrAmayenmUlavidyayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दद्यादर्घ्यं ततो मूर्ध्नि भसितं च सुगन्धितम् । कृत्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं पश्चादुपहारान्निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: dadyAdarghyaM tato mUrdhni bhasitaM cha sugandhitam | kR^itvA puShpA~njaliM pashchAdupahArAnnivedayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पानीयं च ततो दद्याद्दत्त्वा वाचमनं पुनः । पञ्च सौगन्धिकोपेतं ताम्बूलं च निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: pAnIyaM cha tato dadyAddattvA vAchamanaM punaH | pa~ncha saugandhikopetaM tAmbUlaM cha nivedayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्षयेत्प्रोक्षणीयानि गाननाट्यानि कारयेत् । लिङ्गादौ शिवयोश्चिन्तां कृत्वा शक्त्या जपेत् शिवम्
verses.transliteration: prokShayetprokShaNIyAni gAnanATyAni kArayet | li~NgAdau shivayoshchintAM kR^itvA shaktyA japet shivam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणं प्रणामं च स्तवं चात्मसमर्पणम् । विज्ञापनं च कार्याणां कुर्याद्विनयपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: pradakShiNaM praNAmaM cha stavaM chAtmasamarpaNam | vij~nApanaM cha kAryANAM kuryAdvinayapUrvakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अर्घ्यं पुष्पाञ्जलिं दत्त्वा बद्ध्वा मुद्रां यथाविधि । पश्चात्क्षमापयेद्देवमुद्वास्यात्मनि चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: arghyaM puShpA~njaliM dattvA baddhvA mudrAM yathAvidhi | pashchAtkShamApayeddevamudvAsyAtmani chintayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पाद्यादिमुखवासान्तमर्घ्याद्यं चातिसङ्कटे । पुष्पविक्षेपमात्रं वा कुर्याद्भावपुरःसरम्
verses.transliteration: pAdyAdimukhavAsAntamarghyAdyaM chAtisa~NkaTe | puShpavikShepamAtraM vA kuryAdbhAvapuraHsaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तावतैव परो धर्मो भावने सुकृतो भवेत् । असम्पूज्य न भुञ्जीत शिवमाप्राणसञ्चरात्
verses.transliteration: tAvataiva paro dharmo bhAvane sukR^ito bhavet | asampUjya na bhu~njIta shivamAprANasa~ncharAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानोदके सुगन्धादि पानीये च विशेषतः । शीतलानि मनोज्ञानी कुसुमादीनि निक्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: snAnodake sugandhAdi pAnIye cha visheShataH | shItalAni manoj~nAnI kusumAdIni nikShipet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यदि पापस्तु भुञ्जीत स्वैरं तस्य न निष्कृतिः । प्रमादेन तु भुङ्क्ते चेत्तदुद्गीर्य प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: yadi pApastu bhu~njIta svairaM tasya na niShkR^itiH | pramAdena tu bhu~Nkte chettadudgIrya prayatnataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा द्विगुणमभ्यर्च्य देवं देवीमुपोष्य च । शिवस्यायुतमभ्यस्येद् ब्रह्मचर्यपुरःसरम्
verses.transliteration: snAtvA dviguNamabhyarchya devaM devImupoShya cha | shivasyAyutamabhyasyed brahmacharyapuraHsaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: परेद्युः शक्तितो दत्त्वा सुवर्णाद्यं शिवाय च । शिवभक्ताय वा कृत्वा महापूजां शुचिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: paredyuH shaktito dattvA suvarNAdyaM shivAya cha | shivabhaktAya vA kR^itvA mahApUjAM shuchirbhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उशीरं चन्दनं चैव पाद्ये तु परिकल्पयेत् । जातिकङ्कोलकर्पूरबहुमूलतमालकान्
verses.transliteration: ushIraM chandanaM chaiva pAdye tu parikalpayet | jAtika~NkolakarpUrabahumUlatamAlakAn
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्षिपेदाचमनीये च चूर्णयित्वा विशेषतः । एलां पात्रेषु सर्वेषु कर्पूरं चन्दनं तथा
verses.transliteration: kShipedAchamanIye cha chUrNayitvA visheShataH | elAM pAtreShu sarveShu karpUraM chandanaM tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.२५. पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः । शिवशास्त्रोक्तपूजनवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । अनुक्तं चात्र पूजायाः क्रमलोपभयादिव । यत्तदन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि समासान्न तु विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.25\. pa~nchaviMsho.adhyAyaH | shivashAstroktapUjanavarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | anuktaM chAtra pUjAyAH kramalopabhayAdiva | yattadanyatpravakShyAmi samAsAnna tu vistarAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा ध्येयाः समासीना यथासुखम् । सर्वावरणदेवानां स्वाभिधानैर्नमोयुतैः
verses.transliteration: baddhA~njalipuTA dhyeyAH samAsInA yathAsukham | sarvAvaraNadevAnAM svAbhidhAnairnamoyutaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैः सम्पूजनं कुर्यान्नत्वा सर्वान्यथाक्रमम् । गर्भावरणमेवापि यजेत्स्वावरणेन वा
verses.transliteration: puShpaiH sampUjanaM kuryAnnatvA sarvAnyathAkramam | garbhAvaraNamevApi yajetsvAvaraNena vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: योगे ध्याने जपे होमे बाह्ये वाभ्यन्तरेऽपि वा । हविश्च षड्विधं देयं शुद्धं मुद्गान्नमेव च
verses.transliteration: yoge dhyAne jape home bAhye vAbhyantare.api vA | havishcha ShaDvidhaM deyaM shuddhaM mudgAnnameva cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पायसं दधिसम्मिश्रं गौडं च मधुनाप्लुतम् । एतेष्वेकमनेकं वा नानाव्यञ्जनसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: pAyasaM dadhisammishraM gauDaM cha madhunAplutam | eteShvekamanekaM vA nAnAvya~njanasaMyutam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गुडखण्डान्वितं दद्यान्मथितं दधि चोत्तमम् । भक्ष्याण्यपूपमुख्यानि स्वादुमन्ति फलानि च
verses.transliteration: guDakhaNDAnvitaM dadyAnmathitaM dadhi chottamam | bhakShyANyapUpamukhyAni svAdumanti phalAni cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तचन्दनपुष्पाढ्यं पानीयं चातिशीतलम् । मृदु एलारसाक्तं च खण्डं पूगफलस्य च
verses.transliteration: raktachandanapuShpADhyaM pAnIyaM chAtishItalam | mR^idu elArasAktaM cha khaNDaM pUgaphalasya cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दलानि नागवल्ल्याश्च युक्तानि खदिरादिभिः । गौराणि स्वर्णवर्णानि विहितानि शिवानि च । शैलमेव सितं चूर्णं नातिरूक्षं न दूषितम्
verses.transliteration: dalAni nAgavallyAshcha yuktAni khadirAdibhiH | gaurANi svarNavarNAni vihitAni shivAni cha | shailameva sitaM chUrNaM nAtirUkShaM na dUShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कर्पूरं चाथ कङ्कोलं जात्यादि च नवं शुभम् । आलेपनं चन्दनं स्यान्मूलकाष्ठं रजोमयम्
verses.transliteration: karpUraM chAtha ka~NkolaM jAtyAdi cha navaM shubham | AlepanaM chandanaM syAnmUlakAShThaM rajomayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कस्तूरिका कुङ्कुमं च रसो मृगमदात्मकः । पुष्पाणि सुरभीण्येव पवित्राणि शुभानि च
verses.transliteration: kastUrikA ku~NkumaM cha raso mR^igamadAtmakaH | puShpANi surabhINyeva pavitrANi shubhAni cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गन्धान्युग्रगन्धानि दूषितान्युषितानि च । स्वयमेव विशीर्णानि न देयानि शिवार्चने
verses.transliteration: nirgandhAnyugragandhAni dUShitAnyuShitAni cha | svayameva vishIrNAni na deyAni shivArchane
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हविर्निवेदनात्पूर्वं दीपदानादनन्तरम् । कुर्यादावरणाभ्यर्चां प्राप्ते नीराजनेऽथवा
verses.transliteration: havirnivedanAtpUrvaM dIpadAnAdanantaram | kuryAdAvaraNAbhyarchAM prApte nIrAjane.athavA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वासांसि च मृदून्येव तपनीयमयानि च । विद्युद्वलयकल्पानि भूषणानि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: vAsAMsi cha mR^idUnyeva tapanIyamayAni cha | vidyudvalayakalpAni bhUShaNAni visheShataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाण्येतानि कर्पूरनिर्यासागुरुचन्दनैः । आधूपितानि पुष्पौघैर्वासितानि समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvANyetAni karpUraniryAsAguruchandanaiH | AdhUpitAni puShpaughairvAsitAni samantataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरकाष्ठगुग्गुलुचूर्णकैः । घृतेन मधुना चैव सिद्धो धूपः प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: chandanAgurukarpUrakAShThagugguluchUrNakaiH | ghR^itena madhunA chaiva siddho dhUpaH prashasyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कपिलासम्भवेनैव घृतेनातिसुगन्धिना । नित्यं प्रदीपिता दीपाः शस्ताः कर्पूरसंयुताः
verses.transliteration: kapilAsambhavenaiva ghR^itenAtisugandhinA | nityaM pradIpitA dIpAH shastAH karpUrasaMyutAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चगव्यं च मधुरं पयो दधि घृतं तथा । कपिलासम्भवं शम्भोरिष्टं स्नाने च पानके
verses.transliteration: pa~nchagavyaM cha madhuraM payo dadhi ghR^itaM tathA | kapilAsambhavaM shambhoriShTaM snAne cha pAnake
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आसनानि च भद्राणि गजदन्तमयानि च । सुवर्णरत्नयुक्तानि चित्राण्यास्तरणानि च
verses.transliteration: AsanAni cha bhadrANi gajadantamayAni cha | suvarNaratnayuktAni chitrANyAstaraNAni cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मृदूपधानयुक्तानि सूक्ष्मतूलमयानि च । उच्चावचानि रम्याणि शयनानि सुखानि च
verses.transliteration: mR^idUpadhAnayuktAni sUkShmatUlamayAni cha | uchchAvachAni ramyANi shayanAni sukhAni cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नद्यः समुद्रगामिन्या नदाद्वाम्भः समाहृतम् । शीतञ्च वस्त्रपूतं तद्विशिष्टं स्नानपानयोः
verses.transliteration: nadyaH samudragAminyA nadAdvAmbhaH samAhR^itam | shIta~ncha vastrapUtaM tadvishiShTaM snAnapAnayoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: छत्रं शशिनिभं चारु मुक्तादामविराजितम् । नवरत्नचितं दिव्यं हेमदण्डमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: ChatraM shashinibhaM chAru muktAdAmavirAjitam | navaratnachitaM divyaM hemadaNDamanoharam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चामरे च सिते सूक्ष्मे चामीकरपरिष्कृते । राजहंसद्वयाकारे रत्नदण्डोपशोभिते
verses.transliteration: chAmare cha site sUkShme chAmIkarapariShkR^ite | rAjahaMsadvayAkAre ratnadaNDopashobhite
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेशानादिसद्यान्तं रुद्राद्यस्त्रान्तमेव च । शिवस्य वा शिवायाश्च प्रथमावरणे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: tatreshAnAdisadyAntaM rudrAdyastrAntameva cha | shivasya vA shivAyAshcha prathamAvaraNe yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दर्पणं चापि सुस्निग्धं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् । समन्ताद्रत्नसञ्छन्नं स्रग्वरैश्चापि भूषितम्
verses.transliteration: darpaNaM chApi susnigdhaM divyagandhAnulepanam | samantAdratnasa~nChannaM sragvaraishchApi bhUShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गम्भीरनिनदः शङ्खो हंसकुन्देन्दुसन्निभः । आस्यपृष्ठादिदेशेषु रत्नचामीकराचितः
verses.transliteration: gambhIraninadaH sha~Nkho haMsakundendusannibhaH | AsyapR^iShThAdidesheShu ratnachAmIkarAchitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: काहलानि च रम्याणि नानानादकराणि च । सुवर्णनिर्मितान्येव मौक्तिकालङ्कृतानि च
verses.transliteration: kAhalAni cha ramyANi nAnAnAdakarANi cha | suvarNanirmitAnyeva mauktikAla~NkR^itAni cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भेरीमृदङ्गमुरजतिमिच्छपटहादयः । समुद्रकल्पसन्नादाः कल्पनीयाः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: bherImR^ida~NgamurajatimichChapaTahAdayaH | samudrakalpasannAdAH kalpanIyAH prayatnataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भाण्डान्यपि च रम्याणि पात्राण्यपि च कृत्स्नशः । तदाधाराणि सर्वाणि सौवर्णान्येव साधयेत्
verses.transliteration: bhANDAnyapi cha ramyANi pAtrANyapi cha kR^itsnashaH | tadAdhArANi sarvANi sauvarNAnyeva sAdhayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आलयं च महेशस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः । राजावसथवत्कल्प्यं शिल्पशास्त्रोक्तलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: AlayaM cha maheshasya shivasya paramAtmanaH | rAjAvasathavatkalpyaM shilpashAstroktalakShaNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चप्राकारसम्भिन्नं भूधराकारगोपुरम् । अनेकरत्नसञ्च्छन्नं हेमद्वारकपाटकम्
verses.transliteration: uchchaprAkArasambhinnaM bhUdharAkAragopuram | anekaratnasa~nchChannaM hemadvArakapATakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तप्तजाम्बूनदमयं रत्नस्तम्भशतावृतम् । मुक्तादामवितानाढ्यं विद्रुमद्वारतोरणम्
verses.transliteration: taptajAmbUnadamayaM ratnastambhashatAvR^itam | muktAdAmavitAnADhyaM vidrumadvAratoraNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चामीकरमयैर्दिव्यैर्मुकुटैः कुम्भलक्षणैः । अलङ्कृतशिरोभागमस्त्रराजेन चिह्नितम्
verses.transliteration: chAmIkaramayairdivyairmukuTaiH kumbhalakShaNaiH | ala~NkR^itashirobhAgamastrarAjena chihnitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: राजन्यार्हनिवासैश्च राजवीथ्यादिशोभितैः । प्रोच्छ्रितप्रांशुशिखरैः प्रासादैश्च समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: rAjanyArhanivAsaishcha rAjavIthyAdishobhitaiH | prochChritaprAMshushikharaiH prAsAdaishcha samantataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऐशान्यां पूर्वभागे च दक्षिणे चोत्तरे तथा । पश्चिमे च तथाग्नेय्यामैशान्यां नैरृते तथा
verses.transliteration: aishAnyAM pUrvabhAge cha dakShiNe chottare tathA | pashchime cha tathAgneyyAmaishAnyAM nairR^ite tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आस्थानस्थानवर्यैश्च स्थितैर्दिक्षु विदिक्षु च । अत्यन्तालङ्कृतप्रान्तमन्तरावरणैरिव
verses.transliteration: AsthAnasthAnavaryaishcha sthitairdikShu vidikShu cha | atyantAla~NkR^itaprAntamantarAvaraNairiva
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमस्त्रीसहस्रैश्च नृत्यगेयविशारदैः । वेणुवीणाविदग्धैश्च पुरुषैर्बहुभिर्युतम्
verses.transliteration: uttamastrIsahasraishcha nR^ityageyavishAradaiH | veNuvINAvidagdhaishcha puruShairbahubhiryutam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षितं रक्षिभिर्वीरैर्गजवाजिरथान्वितैः । अनेकपुष्पवाटीभिरनेकैश्च सरोवरैः
verses.transliteration: rakShitaM rakShibhirvIrairgajavAjirathAnvitaiH | anekapuShpavATIbhiranekaishcha sarovaraiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घिकाभिरनेकाभिर्दिग्विदिक्षु विराजितम् । वेदवेदान्ततत्त्वज्ञैः शिवशास्त्रपरायणैः
verses.transliteration: dIrghikAbhiranekAbhirdigvidikShu virAjitam | vedavedAntatattvaj~naiH shivashAstraparAyaNaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाश्रमरतैर्भक्तैः शिवशास्त्रोक्तलक्षणैः । शान्तैः स्मितमुखैः स्फीतैः सदाचारपरायणैः
verses.transliteration: shivAshramaratairbhaktaiH shivashAstroktalakShaNaiH | shAntaiH smitamukhaiH sphItaiH sadAchAraparAyaNaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शैवैर्माहेश्वरैश्चैव श्रीमद्भिः सेवितं द्विजैः । एवमन्तर्बहिर्वाथ यथाशक्तिविनिर्मितैः
verses.transliteration: shaivairmAheshvaraishchaiva shrImadbhiH sevitaM dvijaiH | evamantarbahirvAtha yathAshaktivinirmitaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्थाने शिलामये दान्ते दारवे चेष्टकामये । केवलं मृण्मये वापि पुण्यारण्येऽथवा गिरौ
verses.transliteration: sthAne shilAmaye dAnte dArave cheShTakAmaye | kevalaM mR^iNmaye vApi puNyAraNye.athavA girau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नद्यां देवालयेऽन्यत्र देशे वाथ गृहे शुभे । आढ्यो वाथ दरिद्रो वा स्वकां शक्तिमवञ्चयन् । द्रव्यैर्न्यायार्जितैरेव भक्त्या देवं समर्च्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: nadyAM devAlaye.anyatra deshe vAtha gR^ihe shubhe | ADhyo vAtha daridro vA svakAM shaktimava~nchayan | dravyairnyAyArjitaireva bhaktyA devaM samarchchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यायार्जितैश्चापि भक्त्या चेच्छिवमर्च्चयेत् । न तस्य प्रत्यवायोऽस्ति भाववश्यो यतः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: athAnyAyArjitaishchApi bhaktyA chechChivamarchchayet | na tasya pratyavAyo.asti bhAvavashyo yataH prabhuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न्यायार्जितैरपि द्रव्यैरभक्त्या पूजयेद्यदि । न तत्फलमवाप्नोति भक्तिरेवात्र कारणम्
verses.transliteration: nyAyArjitairapi dravyairabhaktyA pUjayedyadi | na tatphalamavApnoti bhaktirevAtra kAraNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वायव्यां पुनरैशान्यां चतुर्दिक्षु ततः परम् । गर्भावरणमाख्यातं मन्त्रसङ्घातमेव वा
verses.transliteration: vAyavyAM punaraishAnyAM chaturdikShu tataH param | garbhAvaraNamAkhyAtaM mantrasa~NghAtameva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या वित्तानुसारेण शिवमुद्दिश्य यत्कृतम् । अल्पे महति वा तुल्यं फलमाढ्यदरिद्रयोः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyA vittAnusAreNa shivamuddishya yatkR^itam | alpe mahati vA tulyaM phalamADhyadaridrayoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या प्रचोदितः कुर्यादल्पवित्तोऽपि मानवः । महाविभवसारोऽपि न कुर्याद् भक्तिवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyA prachoditaH kuryAdalpavitto.api mAnavaH | mahAvibhavasAro.api na kuryAd bhaktivarjitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्वमपि यो दद्याच्छिवे भक्तिविवर्जितः । न तेन फलभाक् स स्याद् भक्तिरेवात्र कारणम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasvamapi yo dadyAchChive bhaktivivarjitaH | na tena phalabhAk sa syAd bhaktirevAtra kAraNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्तपोभिरत्युग्रैर्न च सर्वैर्महामखैः । गच्छेच्छिवपुरं दिव्यं मुक्त्वा भक्तिं शिवात्मिकाम्
verses.transliteration: na tattapobhiratyugrairna cha sarvairmahAmakhaiH | gachChechChivapuraM divyaM muktvA bhaktiM shivAtmikAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं कृष्ण सर्वत्र परमेश्वरे । शिवे भक्तिर्न सन्देहस्तया युक्तो विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: guhyAdguhyataraM kR^iShNa sarvatra parameshvare | shive bhaktirna sandehastayA yukto vimuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवमन्त्रजपो ध्यानं होमो यज्ञस्तपःश्रुतम् । दानमध्ययनं सर्वे भावार्थं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: shivamantrajapo dhyAnaM homo yaj~nastapaHshrutam | dAnamadhyayanaM sarve bhAvArthaM nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भावहीनो नरः सर्वं कृत्वापि न विमुच्यते । भावयुक्तः पुनः सर्वमकृत्वापि विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: bhAvahIno naraH sarvaM kR^itvApi na vimuchyate | bhAvayuktaH punaH sarvamakR^itvApi vimuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणसहस्रैश्च प्राजापत्यशतैस्तथा । मासोपवासैश्चान्यैश्च शिवभक्तस्य किं पुनः
verses.transliteration: chAndrAyaNasahasraishcha prAjApatyashataistathA | mAsopavAsaishchAnyaishcha shivabhaktasya kiM punaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अभक्ता मानवाश्चास्मिंल्लोके गिरिगुहासु च । तपन्ति चाल्पभोगार्थं भक्तो भावेन मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: abhaktA mAnavAshchAsmiMlloke giriguhAsu cha | tapanti chAlpabhogArthaM bhakto bhAvena muchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकं मुक्तिदं कर्म सत्त्वे वै योगिनः स्थिताः । राजसं सिद्धिदं कुर्युः कर्मिणो रजसावृताः
verses.transliteration: sAttvikaM muktidaM karma sattve vai yoginaH sthitAH | rAjasaM siddhidaM kuryuH karmiNo rajasAvR^itAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हृदयाद्यस्त्रपर्यन्तमथवापि समर्चयेत् । तद्बहिः पूर्वतः शक्रं यमं दक्षिणतो यजेत्
verses.transliteration: hR^idayAdyastraparyantamathavApi samarchayet | tadbahiH pUrvataH shakraM yamaM dakShiNato yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असुरा राक्षसाश्चैव तमोगुणसमन्विताः । ऐहिकार्थं यजन्तीशं नराश्चान्येऽपि तादृशाः
verses.transliteration: asurA rAkShasAshchaiva tamoguNasamanvitAH | aihikArthaM yajantIshaM narAshchAnye.api tAdR^ishAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तामसं राजसं वापि सात्त्विकं भावमेव च । आश्रित्य भक्त्या पूजाद्यं कुर्वन् भद्रं समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: tAmasaM rAjasaM vApi sAttvikaM bhAvameva cha | Ashritya bhaktyA pUjAdyaM kurvan bhadraM samashnute
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यतः पापार्णवात् त्रातुं भक्तिर्नौरिव निर्मिता । तस्माद्भक्त्युपपन्नस्य रजसा तमसा च किम्
verses.transliteration: yataH pApArNavAt trAtuM bhaktirnauriva nirmitA | tasmAdbhaktyupapannasya rajasA tamasA cha kim
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अन्त्यजो वाधमो वापि मूर्खो वा पतितोऽपि वा । शिवं प्रपन्नश्चेत् कृष्ण पूज्यः सर्वसुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: antyajo vAdhamo vApi mUrkho vA patito.api vA | shivaM prapannashchet kR^iShNa pUjyaH sarvasurAsuraiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन भक्त्यैव शिवमर्चयेत् । अभुक्तानां क्वचिदपि फलं नास्ति यतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tasmAt sarvaprayatnena bhaktyaiva shivamarchayet | abhuktAnAM kvachidapi phalaM nAsti yatastataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वक्ष्याम्यतिरहस्यं ते शृणु कृष्ण वचो मम । वेदैः शास्त्रैर्वेदविद्भिर्विचार्य सुविनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: vakShyAmyatirahasyaM te shR^iNu kR^iShNa vacho mama | vedaiH shAstrairvedavidbhirvichArya suvinishchitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणं वारुणे भागे धनदं चोत्तरे बुधः । ईशमैशेऽनलं स्वीये नैरृते निरृतिं यजेत्
verses.transliteration: varuNaM vAruNe bhAge dhanadaM chottare budhaH | Ishamaishe.analaM svIye nairR^ite nirR^itiM yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मारुते मारुतं विष्णुं नैरृते विधिमैश्वरे । बहिःपद्मस्य वज्राद्यान्याब्जान्तान्यायुधान्यपि
verses.transliteration: mArute mArutaM viShNuM nairR^ite vidhimaishvare | bahiHpadmasya vajrAdyAnyAbjAntAnyAyudhAnyapi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसिद्धरूपाण्याशासु लोकेशानां क्रमाद्यजेत् । देवं देवीं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य सर्वावरणदेवताः
verses.transliteration: prasiddharUpANyAshAsu lokeshAnAM kramAdyajet | devaM devIM cha samprekShya sarvAvaraNadevatAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.१६. षड्विंशोऽध्यायः । साङ्गोपाङ्गपूजाविधानवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । ब्रह्मघ्नो वा सुरापो वा स्तेयी वा गुरुतल्पगः । मातृहा पितृहा वापि वीरहा भ्रूणहापि वा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.16\. ShaDviMsho.adhyAyaH | sA~NgopA~NgapUjAvidhAnavarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | brahmaghno vA surApo vA steyI vA gurutalpagaH | mAtR^ihA pitR^ihA vApi vIrahA bhrUNahApi vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: षडक्षरेण वा देवं सूक्तमन्त्रेण पूजयेत् । शिवभक्तो जितक्रोधो ह्यलब्धो लब्ध एव च
verses.transliteration: ShaDakShareNa vA devaM sUktamantreNa pUjayet | shivabhakto jitakrodho hyalabdho labdha eva cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अलब्धाल्लब्ध एवात्र विशिष्टो नात्र संशयः । सब्रह्माङ्गेन वा तेन सहंसेन विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: alabdhAllabdha evAtra vishiShTo nAtra saMshayaH | sabrahmA~Ngena vA tena sahaMsena vimuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्नित्यं शिवं भक्त्या सूक्तमन्त्रेण पूजयेत् । एककालं द्विकालं वा त्रिकालं नित्यमेव वा
verses.transliteration: tasmAnnityaM shivaM bhaktyA sUktamantreNa pUjayet | ekakAlaM dvikAlaM vA trikAlaM nityameva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: येऽर्चयन्ति महादेवं विज्ञेयास्ते महेश्वराः । ज्ञानेनात्मसहायेन नार्चितो भगवान् शिवः
verses.transliteration: ye.archayanti mahAdevaM vij~neyAste maheshvarAH | j~nAnenAtmasahAyena nArchito bhagavAn shivaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स चिरं संसरत्यस्मिन् संसारे दुःखसागरे । दुर्लभं प्राप्य मानुष्यं मूढो नार्चयते शिवम्
verses.transliteration: sa chiraM saMsaratyasmin saMsAre duHkhasAgare | durlabhaM prApya mAnuShyaM mUDho nArchayate shivam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निष्फलं तस्य तज्जन्म मोक्षाय न भवेद्यतः । दुर्लभं प्राप्य मानुष्यं येऽर्चयन्ति पिनाकिनम्
verses.transliteration: niShphalaM tasya tajjanma mokShAya na bhavedyataH | durlabhaM prApya mAnuShyaM ye.archayanti pinAkinam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां हि सफलं जन्म कृतार्थास्ते नरोत्तमाः । भवभक्तिपरा ये च भवप्रणतचेतसः
verses.transliteration: teShAM hi saphalaM janma kR^itArthAste narottamAH | bhavabhaktiparA ye cha bhavapraNatachetasaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भवसंस्मरणोद्युक्ता न ते दुःखस्य भागिनः । भवनानि मनोज्ञानि विभ्रमाभरणाः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: bhavasaMsmaraNodyuktA na te duHkhasya bhAginaH | bhavanAni manoj~nAni vibhramAbharaNAH striyaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: धनं चातृप्तिपर्यन्तं शिवपूजाविधेः फलम् । ये वाञ्छन्ति महाभोगान् राज्यं च त्रिदशालये
verses.transliteration: dhanaM chAtR^iptiparyantaM shivapUjAvidheH phalam | ye vA~nChanti mahAbhogAn rAjyaM cha tridashAlaye
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ते वाञ्छन्ति सदाकालं हरस्य चरणाम्बुजम् । सौभाग्यं कान्तिमद्रूपं सत्त्वं त्यागार्द्रभावता
verses.transliteration: te vA~nChanti sadAkAlaM harasya charaNAmbujam | saubhAgyaM kAntimadrUpaM sattvaM tyAgArdrabhAvatA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्यामन्त्रकं भक्त्या शिवं परमकारणम् । तैस्तैः पापैः प्रमुच्येत वर्षैर्द्वादशभिः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sampUjyAmantrakaM bhaktyA shivaM paramakAraNam | taistaiH pApaiH pramuchyeta varShairdvAdashabhiH kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शौर्यं वै जगति ख्यातिः शिवमर्चयतो भवेत् । तस्मात् सर्वं परित्यज्य शिवैकाहितमानसः
verses.transliteration: shauryaM vai jagati khyAtiH shivamarchayato bhavet | tasmAt sarvaM parityajya shivaikAhitamAnasaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवपूजाविधिं कुर्याद्यदीच्छेत् शिवमात्मनः । त्वरितं जीवितं याति त्वरितं याति यौवनम्
verses.transliteration: shivapUjAvidhiM kuryAdyadIchChet shivamAtmanaH | tvaritaM jIvitaM yAti tvaritaM yAti yauvanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरितं व्याधिरभ्येति तस्मात् पूज्यः पिनाकधृक् । यावन्नायाति मरणं यावन्नाक्रमते जरा
