verses.sanskrit: तृतीयावरणे भेदो विद्यते स तु कथ्यते । चतस्रो मूर्तयस्तस्य पूज्याः पूर्वादितः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tR^itIyAvaraNe bhedo vidyate sa tu kathyate | chatasro mUrtayastasya pUjyAH pUrvAditaH kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिगुणाः सकलो देवः पुरस्ताच्छिवसंज्ञकः । राजसो दक्षिणे ब्रह्मा सृष्टिकृत्पूज्यते भवः
verses.transliteration: triguNAH sakalo devaH purastAchChivasa.nj~nakaH | rAjaso dakShiNe brahmA sR^iShTikR^itpUjyate bhavaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तामसः पश्चिमे चाग्निः पूज्यः संहारको हरः । सात्त्विकः सुखकृत्सौम्ये विष्णुर्विश्वपतिर्मृडः
verses.transliteration: tAmasaH pashchime chAgniH pUjyaH saMhArako haraH | sAttvikaH sukhakR^itsaumye viShNurvishvapatirmR^iDaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पश्चिमदिग्भागे शम्भोः षड्विंशकं शिवम् । समभ्यर्च्योत्तरे पार्श्वे ततो वैकुण्ठमर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM pashchimadigbhAge shambhoH ShaDviMshakaM shivam | samabhyarchyottare pArshve tato vaikuNThamarchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेवं पुरस्कृत्वा प्रथमावरणे यजेत् । अनिरुद्धं दक्षिणतः प्रद्युम्नं पश्चिमे ततः
verses.transliteration: vAsudevaM puraskR^itvA prathamAvaraNe yajet | aniruddhaM dakShiNataH pradyumnaM pashchime tataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्ये सङ्कर्षणं पश्चाद् व्यत्यस्तौ वा यजेदिमौ । प्रथमावरणं प्रोक्तं द्वितीयावरणं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: saumye sa~NkarShaNaM pashchAd vyatyastau vA yajedimau | prathamAvaraNaM proktaM dvitIyAvaraNaM shubham
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यः कूर्मो वराहश्च नरसिंहोऽथ वामनः । रामश्चान्यतमः कृष्णो भवानश्वमुखोऽपि च
verses.transliteration: matsyaH kUrmo varAhashcha narasiMho.atha vAmanaH | rAmashchAnyatamaH kR^iShNo bhavAnashvamukho.api cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयावरणे चक्रं पूर्वभागे समर्चयेत् । नारायणाख्यां याम्येऽस्त्रं क्वचिदव्याहतं यजेत्
verses.transliteration: tR^itIyAvaraNe chakraM pUrvabhAge samarchayet | nArAyaNAkhyAM yAmye.astraM kvachidavyAhataM yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तं पूर्वदिक्पत्रे तच्छक्तिं तस्य वामतः । सूक्ष्मं दक्षिणदिक्पत्रे सह शक्त्या समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: anantaM pUrvadikpatre tachChaktiM tasya vAmataH | sUkShmaM dakShiNadikpatre saha shaktyA samarchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे पाञ्चजन्यं च शार्ङ्गं धनुरथोत्तरे । एवं त्र्यावरणैः साक्षाद्विश्वाख्यां परमं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: pashchime pA~nchajanyaM cha shAr~NgaM dhanurathottare | evaM tryAvaraNaiH sAkShAdvishvAkhyAM paramaM harim
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: महाविष्णुं सदाविष्णुं मूर्त्तीकृत्य समर्चयेत् । इत्थं विष्णोश्चतुर्व्यूहक्रमान्मूर्तिचतुष्टयम् । पूजयित्वा च तच्छक्तीश्चतस्रः पुजयेत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: mahAviShNuM sadAviShNuM mUrttIkR^itya samarchayet | itthaM viShNoshchaturvyUhakramAnmUrtichatuShTayam | pUjayitvA cha tachChaktIshchatasraH pujayetkramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभामाग्नेयदिग्भागे नैरृते तु सरस्वतीम् । गणाम्बिकां च वायव्ये लक्ष्मीं रौद्रे समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: prabhAmAgneyadigbhAge nairR^ite tu sarasvatIm | gaNAmbikAM cha vAyavye lakShmIM raudre samarchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं भान्वादिमूर्त्तीनां तच्छक्तीनामनन्तरम् । पूजां विधाय लोकेशांस्तत्रैवावरणे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM bhAnvAdimUrttInAM tachChaktInAmanantaram | pUjAM vidhAya lokeshAMstatraivAvaraNe yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रमग्निं यमं चैव निरृतिं वरुणं तथा । वायुं सोमं कुबेरं च पश्चादीशानमर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: indramagniM yamaM chaiva nirR^itiM varuNaM tathA | vAyuM somaM kuberaM cha pashchAdIshAnamarchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं चतुर्थावरणं पूजयित्वा विधानतः । आयुधानि महेशस्य पश्चाद् ब्राह्ये समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaM chaturthAvaraNaM pUjayitvA vidhAnataH | AyudhAni maheshasya pashchAd brAhye samarchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमत् त्रिशूलमैशाने वज्रं माहेन्द्रदिङ्मुखे । परशुं वह्निदिग्भागे याम्ये सायकमर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: shrImat trishUlamaishAne vajraM mAhendradi~Nmukhe | parashuM vahnidigbhAge yAmye sAyakamarchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नैरृते तु यजेत्खड्गं पाशं वारुणगोचरे । अङ्कुशं मारुते भागे पिनाकं चोत्तरे यजेत्
verses.transliteration: nairR^ite tu yajetkhaDgaM pAshaM vAruNagochare | a~NkushaM mArute bhAge pinAkaM chottare yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमाभिमुखं रौद्रं क्षेत्रपालं समर्चयेत् । पञ्चमावरणं चैव सम्पूज्यानन्तरं बहिः
verses.transliteration: pashchimAbhimukhaM raudraM kShetrapAlaM samarchayet | pa~nchamAvaraNaM chaiva sampUjyAnantaraM bahiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वावरणदेवानां बहिर्वा पञ्चमेऽथवा । पञ्चमे मातृभिः सार्द्धं महोक्षं पुरतो यजेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvAvaraNadevAnAM bahirvA pa~nchame.athavA | pa~nchame mAtR^ibhiH sArddhaM mahokShaM purato yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पश्चिमदिक्पत्रे सह शक्त्या शिवोत्तमम् । तथैवोत्तरदिक्पत्रे चैकनेत्रं समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: tataH pashchimadikpatre saha shaktyA shivottamam | tathaivottaradikpatre chaikanetraM samarchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समन्ततः पूज्याः सर्वा वै देवयोनयः । खेचरा ऋषयः सिद्धा दैत्या यक्षाश्च राक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: tataH samantataH pUjyAH sarvA vai devayonayaH | khecharA R^iShayaH siddhA daityA yakShAshcha rAkShasAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ताद्याश्च नागेन्द्रा नागैस्तत्तत्कुलोद्भवैः । डाकिनी भूतवेतालप्रेतभैरवनायकाः
verses.transliteration: anantAdyAshcha nAgendrA nAgaistattatkulodbhavaiH | DAkinI bhUtavetAlapretabhairavanAyakAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पातालवासिनश्चान्ये नानायोनिसमुद्भवाः । नद्यः समुद्रा गिरयः काननानि सरांसि च
verses.transliteration: pAtAlavAsinashchAnye nAnAyonisamudbhavAH | nadyaH samudrA girayaH kAnanAni sarAMsi cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पशवः पक्षिणो वृक्षाः कीटाद्याः क्षुद्रयोनयः । नराश्च विविधाकारा मृगाश्च क्षुद्रयोनयः
verses.transliteration: pashavaH pakShiNo vR^ikShAH kITAdyAH kShudrayonayaH | narAshcha vividhAkArA mR^igAshcha kShudrayonayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भुवनान्यन्तरण्डस्य ततो ब्रह्माण्डकोटयः । बहिरण्डान्यसङ्ख्यानि भुवनानि सहाधिपैः
verses.transliteration: bhuvanAnyantaraNDasya tato brahmANDakoTayaH | bahiraNDAnyasa~NkhyAni bhuvanAni sahAdhipaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डाधारका रुद्रा दशदिक्षु व्यवस्थिताः । यद्गौणं यच्च मामेयं यद्वा शाक्तं ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: brahmANDAdhArakA rudrA dashadikShu vyavasthitAH | yadgauNaM yachcha mAmeyaM yadvA shAktaM tataH param
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यत्किञ्चिदस्ति शब्दस्य वाच्यं चिदचिदात्मकम् । तत्सर्वं शिवयोः पार्श्वे बुद्ध्वा सामान्यतो यजेत्
verses.transliteration: yatki~nchidasti shabdasya vAchyaM chidachidAtmakam | tatsarvaM shivayoH pArshve buddhvA sAmAnyato yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वेऽचिन्त्याः स्मितमुखास्तथा । प्रीत्या सम्प्रेक्षमाणाश्च देवं देवीं च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: kR^itA~njalipuTAH sarve.achintyAH smitamukhAstathA | prItyA samprekShamANAshcha devaM devIM cha sarvadA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थमावरणाभ्यर्चां कृत्वा विक्षेपशान्तये । पुनरभ्यर्च्य देवेशं पञ्चाक्षरमुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: itthamAvaraNAbhyarchAM kR^itvA vikShepashAntaye | punarabhyarchya deveshaM pa~nchAkSharamudIrayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयेत्ततः पश्चाच्छिवयोरमृतोपमम् । सुव्यञ्जनसमायुक्तं शुद्धं चारु महाचरुम्
verses.transliteration: nivedayettataH pashchAchChivayoramR^itopamam | suvya~njanasamAyuktaM shuddhaM chAru mahAcharum
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एकरुद्रं च तच्छक्तिं पश्चादीशदलेऽर्चयेत् । त्रिमूर्तिं तस्य शक्तिं च पूजयेदग्निदिग्दले
verses.transliteration: ekarudraM cha tachChaktiM pashchAdIshadale.archayet | trimUrtiM tasya shaktiM cha pUjayedagnidigdale
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: द्वात्रिंशदाढकैर्मुख्यमधमं त्वाढकावरम् । साधयित्वा यथासम्पच्छ्रद्धया विनिवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: dvAtriMshadADhakairmukhyamadhamaM tvADhakAvaram | sAdhayitvA yathAsampachChraddhayA vinivedayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निवेद्य पानीयं ताम्बूलं चोपदंशकैः । नीराजनादिकं कृत्वा पूजाशेषं समापयेत्
verses.transliteration: tato nivedya pAnIyaM tAmbUlaM chopadaMshakaiH | nIrAjanAdikaM kR^itvA pUjAsheShaM samApayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भोगोपयोग्यद्रव्याणि विशिष्टान्येव साधयेत् । वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत भक्तिमान्विभवे सति
verses.transliteration: bhogopayogyadravyANi vishiShTAnyeva sAdhayet | vittashAThyaM na kurvIta bhaktimAnvibhave sati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शठस्योपेक्षकस्यापि व्यङ्गं चैवानुतिष्ठतः । न फलन्त्येव कर्माणि काम्यानीति सतां कथा
verses.transliteration: shaThasyopekShakasyApi vya~NgaM chaivAnutiShThataH | na phalantyeva karmANi kAmyAnIti satAM kathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सम्यगुपेक्षां च त्यक्त्वा सर्वाङ्गयोगतः । कुर्यात्काम्यानि कर्माणि फलसिद्धिं यदीच्छति
verses.transliteration: tasmAtsamyagupekShAM cha tyaktvA sarvA~NgayogataH | kuryAtkAmyAni karmANi phalasiddhiM yadIchChati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं पूजां समाप्याथ देवं देवीं प्रणम्य च । भक्त्या मनः समाधाय पश्चात्स्तोत्रमुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: itthaM pUjAM samApyAtha devaM devIM praNamya cha | bhaktyA manaH samAdhAya pashchAtstotramudIrayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्तोत्रमुपास्यान्ते त्वष्टोत्तरशतावराम् । जपेत्पञ्चाक्षरीं विद्यां सहस्रोत्तरमुत्सुकः
verses.transliteration: tataH stotramupAsyAnte tvaShTottarashatAvarAm | japetpa~nchAkSharIM vidyAM sahasrottaramutsukaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यापूजां गुरोः पूजां कृत्वा पश्चाद्यथाक्रमम् । यथोदयं यथाश्रद्धं सदस्यानपि पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: vidyApUjAM guroH pUjAM kR^itvA pashchAdyathAkramam | yathodayaM yathAshraddhaM sadasyAnapi pUjayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत उद्वास्य देवेशं सर्वैरावरणैः सह । मण्डलं गुरवे दद्याद्यागोपकरणैः सह
verses.transliteration: tata udvAsya deveshaM sarvairAvaraNaiH saha | maNDalaM gurave dadyAdyAgopakaraNaiH saha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाश्रितेभ्यो वा दद्यात्सर्वमेवानुपूर्वशः । अथवा तच्छिवायैव शिवक्षेत्रे समर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: shivAshritebhyo vA dadyAtsarvamevAnupUrvashaH | athavA tachChivAyaiva shivakShetre samarpayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकण्ठं नैरृते पत्रे तच्छक्तिं तस्य वामतः । तथैव मारुते पत्रे शिखण्डीशं समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: shrIkaNThaM nairR^ite patre tachChaktiM tasya vAmataH | tathaiva mArute patre shikhaNDIshaM samarchayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाग्नौ वा यजेद्देवं होमद्रव्यैश्च सप्तभिः । समभ्यर्च्य यथान्यायं सर्वावरणदेवताः
verses.transliteration: shivAgnau vA yajeddevaM homadravyaishcha saptabhiH | samabhyarchya yathAnyAyaM sarvAvaraNadevatAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एष योगेश्वरो नाम त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः । न तस्मादधिकः कश्चिद्यागोऽस्ति भुवने क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: eSha yogeshvaro nAma triShu lokeShu vishrutaH | na tasmAdadhikaH kashchidyAgo.asti bhuvane kvachit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न तदस्ति जगत्यस्मिन्नसाध्यं यदनेन तु । ऐहिकं वा फलं किञ्चिदामुष्मिकफलं तु वा
verses.transliteration: na tadasti jagatyasminnasAdhyaM yadanena tu | aihikaM vA phalaM ki~nchidAmuShmikaphalaM tu vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इदमस्य फलं नेदमिति नैव नियम्यते । श्रेयोरूपस्य कृत्स्नस्य तदिदं श्रेष्टसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: idamasya phalaM nedamiti naiva niyamyate | shreyorUpasya kR^itsnasya tadidaM shreShTasAdhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इदं न शक्यते वक्तुं पुरुषेण यदर्च्यते । चिन्तामणेरिवैतस्मात्तत्तेन प्राप्यते फलम्
verses.transliteration: idaM na shakyate vaktuM puruSheNa yadarchyate | chintAmaNerivaitasmAttattena prApyate phalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि क्षुद्रमुद्दिश्य फलं नैतत्प्रयोजयेत् । लघ्वर्थी महतो यस्मात्स्वयं लघुतरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tathApi kShudramuddishya phalaM naitatprayojayet | laghvarthI mahato yasmAtsvayaM laghutaro bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: महद्वा फलमल्पं वा कृतं चेत्कर्म सिध्यति । महादेवं समुद्दिश्य कृतं कर्म प्रयुज्यताम्
verses.transliteration: mahadvA phalamalpaM vA kR^itaM chetkarma sidhyati | mahAdevaM samuddishya kR^itaM karma prayujyatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनन्यलभ्येषु शत्रुमृत्युञ्जयादिषु । फलेषु दृष्टादृष्टेषु कुर्य्यादेतद्विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: tasmAdananyalabhyeShu shatrumR^ityu~njayAdiShu | phaleShu dR^iShTAdR^iShTeShu kuryyAdetadvichakShaNaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: महत्स्वपि च पापेषु महारोगभयादिषु । दुर्भिक्षादिषु शान्त्यर्थं शान्तिं कुर्य्यादनेन तु
verses.transliteration: mahatsvapi cha pApeShu mahArogabhayAdiShu | durbhikShAdiShu shAntyarthaM shAntiM kuryyAdanena tu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बहुना किं प्रलापेन महाव्यापन्निवारकम् । आत्मीयमस्त्रं शैवानामिदमाह महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bahunA kiM pralApena mahAvyApannivArakam | AtmIyamastraM shaivAnAmidamAha maheshvaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.३१. एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । शिवमहास्तोत्रवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । स्तोत्रं वक्ष्यामि ते कृष्ण पञ्चावरणमार्गतः । योगेश्वरमिदं पुण्यं कर्म येन समाप्यते
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.31\. ekatriMsho.adhyAyaH | shivamahAstotravarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | stotraM vakShyAmi te kR^iShNa pa~nchAvaraNamArgataH | yogeshvaramidaM puNyaM karma yena samApyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नमः परमदेवाय नमः परमहेतवे । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय नमः शिवतराय ते
verses.transliteration: namaH paramadevAya namaH paramahetave | namaH shivAya shAntAya namaH shivatarAya te
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असाधारणकर्मा च सृष्टिस्थितिलयक्रमात् । एवं त्रिधा चतुर्धा च विभक्ताः पञ्चधा पुनः
verses.transliteration: asAdhAraNakarmA cha sR^iShTisthitilayakramAt | evaM tridhA chaturdhA cha vibhaktAH pa~nchadhA punaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थावरणे शम्भोः पूजितश्चानुगैः सह । शिवप्रियः शिवासक्तः शिवपादार्चने रतः
verses.transliteration: chaturthAvaraNe shambhoH pUjitashchAnugaiH saha | shivapriyaH shivAsaktaH shivapAdArchane rataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां स मे दिशतु मङ्गलम् । दिवाकरषडङ्गानि दीप्ताद्याश्चाष्टशक्तयः
verses.transliteration: satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM sa me dishatu ma~Ngalam | divAkaraShaDa~NgAni dIptAdyAshchAShTashaktayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यो भास्करो भानू रविश्चेत्यनुपूर्वशः । अर्को ब्रह्मा तथा रुद्रो विष्नुश्चादित्यमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: Adityo bhAskaro bhAnU ravishchetyanupUrvashaH | arko brahmA tathA rudro viShnushchAdityamUrtayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विस्तरा सुतरा बोधिन्याप्यायिन्यपराः पुनः । उषा प्रभा तथा प्राज्ञा सन्ध्या चेत्यपि शक्तयः
verses.transliteration: vistarA sutarA bodhinyApyAyinyaparAH punaH | uShA prabhA tathA prAj~nA sandhyA chetyapi shaktayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सोमादिकेतुपर्यन्ता ग्रहाश्च शिवभाविताः । शिवयोराज्ञया नुन्ना मङ्गलं प्रदिशन्तु मे
verses.transliteration: somAdiketuparyantA grahAshcha shivabhAvitAH | shivayorAj~nayA nunnA ma~NgalaM pradishantu me
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा द्वादशादित्यास्तथा द्वादश शक्तयः । ऋषयो देवगन्धर्वाः पन्नगाप्सरसां गणाः
verses.transliteration: athavA dvAdashAdityAstathA dvAdasha shaktayaH | R^iShayo devagandharvAH pannagApsarasAM gaNAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामण्यश्च तथा यक्षा राक्षसाश्च सुरास्तथा । सप्त सप्तगणाश्चैते सप्तच्छन्दोमया हयाः
verses.transliteration: grAmaNyashcha tathA yakShA rAkShasAshcha surAstathA | sapta saptagaNAshchaite saptachChandomayA hayAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वालखिल्यादयश्चैव सर्वे शिवपदार्चकाः । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां मङ्गलं प्रदिशन्तु मे
verses.transliteration: vAlakhilyAdayashchaiva sarve shivapadArchakAH | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM ma~NgalaM pradishantu me
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माथ देवदेवस्य मूर्तिर्भूमण्डलाधिपः । चतुःषष्टिगुणैश्वर्यो बुद्धितत्त्वे प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: brahmAtha devadevasya mUrtirbhUmaNDalAdhipaH | chatuHShaShTiguNaishvaryo buddhitattve pratiShThitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्वदधीनमिदं कृत्स्नं जगद्धि ससुरासुरम्
verses.transliteration: tvadadhInamidaM kR^itsnaM jagaddhi sasurAsuram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गुणो गुणसङ्कीर्णस्तथैव गुणकेवलः । अविकारात्मको देवस्ततः साधारणः पुरः
verses.transliteration: nirguNo guNasa~NkIrNastathaiva guNakevalaH | avikArAtmako devastataH sAdhAraNaH puraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असाधारणकर्मा च सृष्टिस्थितिलयक्रमात् । एवं त्रिधा चतुर्धा च विभक्तः पञ्चधा पुनः
verses.transliteration: asAdhAraNakarmA cha sR^iShTisthitilayakramAt | evaM tridhA chaturdhA cha vibhaktaH pa~nchadhA punaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थावरणे शम्भोः पूजितश्च सहानुगैः । शिवप्रियः शिवासक्तः शिवपादार्चने रतः
verses.transliteration: chaturthAvaraNe shambhoH pUjitashcha sahAnugaiH | shivapriyaH shivAsaktaH shivapAdArchane rataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां स मे दिशतु मङ्गलम् । हिरण्यगर्भो लोकेशो विराट् कालश्च पूरुषः
verses.transliteration: satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM sa me dishatu ma~Ngalam | hiraNyagarbho lokesho virAT kAlashcha pUruShaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारः सनकः सनन्दश्च सनातनः । प्रजानां पतयश्चैव दक्षाद्या ब्रह्मसूनवः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAraH sanakaH sanandashcha sanAtanaH | prajAnAM patayashchaiva dakShAdyA brahmasUnavaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एकादश सपत्नीका धर्मः सङ्कल्प एव च । शिवार्चनरताश्चैते शिवभक्तिपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: ekAdasha sapatnIkA dharmaH sa~Nkalpa eva cha | shivArchanaratAshchaite shivabhaktiparAyaNAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाज्ञावशगाः सर्वे दिशन्तु मम मङ्गलम् । चत्वारश्च तथा वेदाः सेतिहासपुराणकाः
verses.transliteration: shivAj~nAvashagAH sarve dishantu mama ma~Ngalam | chatvArashcha tathA vedAH setihAsapurANakAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मशास्त्राणि विद्याभिर्वैदिकीभिः समन्विताः । परस्पराविरुद्धार्थाः शिवप्रकृतिपादकाः
verses.transliteration: dharmashAstrANi vidyAbhirvaidikIbhiH samanvitAH | parasparAviruddhArthAH shivaprakR^itipAdakAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां मङ्गलं प्रदिशन्तु मे । अथ रुद्रो महादेवः शम्भोर्मूर्तिर्गरीयसी
verses.transliteration: satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM ma~NgalaM pradishantu me | atha rudro mahAdevaH shambhormUrtirgarIyasI
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वाह्नेयमण्डलाधीशः पौरुषैश्वर्यवान् प्रभुः । शिवाभिमानसम्पन्नो निर्गुणस्त्रिगुणात्मकः
verses.transliteration: vAhneyamaNDalAdhIshaH pauruShaishvaryavAn prabhuH | shivAbhimAnasampanno nirguNastriguNAtmakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अतस्त्वद्विहितामाज्ञां क्षमते कोऽतिवर्तितुम्
verses.transliteration: atastvadvihitAmAj~nAM kShamate ko.ativartitum
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: केवलं सात्त्विकश्चापि राजसश्चैव तामसः । अविकाररतः पूर्वं ततस्तु समविक्रियः
verses.transliteration: kevalaM sAttvikashchApi rAjasashchaiva tAmasaH | avikArarataH pUrvaM tatastu samavikriyaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असाधारणकर्मा च सृष्ट्यादिकरणात्पृथक् । ब्रह्मणोऽपि शिरश्छेत्ता जनकस्तस्य तत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: asAdhAraNakarmA cha sR^iShTyAdikaraNAtpR^ithak | brahmaNo.api shirashChettA janakastasya tatsutaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जनकस्तनयश्चापि विष्णोरपि नियामकः । बोधकश्च तयोर्नित्यमनुग्रहकरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: janakastanayashchApi viShNorapi niyAmakaH | bodhakashcha tayornityamanugrahakaraH prabhuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अण्डस्यान्तर्बहिर्वर्ती रुद्रो लोकद्वयाधिपः । शिवप्रियः शिवासक्तः शिवपादार्चने रतः
verses.transliteration: aNDasyAntarbahirvartI rudro lokadvayAdhipaH | shivapriyaH shivAsaktaH shivapAdArchane rataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्याज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य स मे दिशतु मङ्गलम् । तस्य ब्रह्म षडङ्गानि विद्येशानां तथाष्टकम्
verses.transliteration: shivasyAj~nAM puraskR^itya sa me dishatu ma~Ngalam | tasya brahma ShaDa~NgAni vidyeshAnAM tathAShTakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारो मूर्तिभेदाश्च शिवपूर्वाः शिवार्चकाः । शिवो भवो हरश्चैव मृडश्चैव तथापरः । शिवस्याज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य मङ्गलं प्रदिशन्तु मे
verses.transliteration: chatvAro mUrtibhedAshcha shivapUrvAH shivArchakAH | shivo bhavo harashchaiva mR^iDashchaiva tathAparaH | shivasyAj~nAM puraskR^itya ma~NgalaM pradishantu me
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ विष्णुर्महेशस्य शिवस्यैव परा तनुः । वारितत्त्वाधिपः साक्षादव्यक्तपदसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: atha viShNurmaheshasya shivasyaiva parA tanuH | vAritattvAdhipaH sAkShAdavyaktapadasaMsthitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गुणः सत्त्वबहुलस्तथैव गुणकेवलः । अविकाराभिमानी च त्रिसाधारणविक्रियः
verses.transliteration: nirguNaH sattvabahulastathaiva guNakevalaH | avikArAbhimAnI cha trisAdhAraNavikriyaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असाधारणकर्मा च सृष्ट्यादिकरणात्पृथक् । दक्षिणाङ्गभवेनापि स्पर्धमानः स्वयम्भुवा
verses.transliteration: asAdhAraNakarmA cha sR^iShTyAdikaraNAtpR^ithak | dakShiNA~NgabhavenApi spardhamAnaH svayambhuvA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आद्येन ब्रह्मणा साक्षात्सृष्टः स्रष्टा च तस्य तु । अण्डस्यान्तर्बहिर्वर्ती विष्णुर्लोकद्वयाधिपः
verses.transliteration: Adyena brahmaNA sAkShAtsR^iShTaH sraShTA cha tasya tu | aNDasyAntarbahirvartI viShNurlokadvayAdhipaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अयं पुनर्जनो नित्यं भवदेकसमाश्रयः । भवानतोऽनुगृह्यास्मै प्रार्थितं सम्प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: ayaM punarjano nityaM bhavadekasamAshrayaH | bhavAnato.anugR^ihyAsmai prArthitaM samprayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असुरान्तकरश्चक्री शक्रस्यापि तथानुजः । प्रादुर्भूतश्च दशधा भृगुशापच्छलादिह
verses.transliteration: asurAntakarashchakrI shakrasyApi tathAnujaH | prAdurbhUtashcha dashadhA bhR^igushApachChalAdiha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भूभारनिग्रहार्थाय स्वेच्छयावातरत् क्षितौ । अप्रमेयबलो मायी मायया मोहयन् जगत्
verses.transliteration: bhUbhAranigrahArthAya svechChayAvAtarat kShitau | aprameyabalo mAyI mAyayA mohayan jagat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तिं कृत्वा महाविष्णुं सदाशिष्णुमथापि वा । वैष्णवैः पूजितो नित्यं मूर्तित्रयमयासने
verses.transliteration: mUrtiM kR^itvA mahAviShNuM sadAshiShNumathApi vA | vaiShNavaiH pUjito nityaM mUrtitrayamayAsane
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवप्रियः शिवासक्तः शिवपादार्चने रतः । शिवस्याज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य स मे दिशतु मङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration: shivapriyaH shivAsaktaH shivapAdArchane rataH | shivasyAj~nAM puraskR^itya sa me dishatu ma~Ngalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेवोऽनिरुद्धश्च प्रद्युम्नश्च ततः परः । सङ्कर्षणः समाख्याताश्चतस्रो मूर्तयो हरेः
verses.transliteration: vAsudevo.aniruddhashcha pradyumnashcha tataH paraH | sa~NkarShaNaH samAkhyAtAshchatasro mUrtayo hareH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यः कूर्मो वराहश्च नारसिंहोऽथ वामनः । रामत्रयं तथा कृष्णो विष्णुस्तुरगवक्त्रकः
verses.transliteration: matsyaH kUrmo varAhashcha nArasiMho.atha vAmanaH | rAmatrayaM tathA kR^iShNo viShNusturagavaktrakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं नारायणस्यास्त्रं पाञ्चजन्यं च शार्ङ्गकम् । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां मङ्गलं प्रदिशन्तु मे
verses.transliteration: chakraM nArAyaNasyAstraM pA~nchajanyaM cha shAr~Ngakam | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM ma~NgalaM pradishantu me
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभा सरस्वती गौरी लक्ष्मीश्च शिवभाविता । शिवयोः शासनादेता मङ्गलं प्रदिशन्तु मे
verses.transliteration: prabhA sarasvatI gaurI lakShmIshcha shivabhAvitA | shivayoH shAsanAdetA ma~NgalaM pradishantu me
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रोऽग्निश्च यमश्चैव निरृतिर्वरुणस्तथा । वायुः सोमः कुबेरश्च तथेशानस्त्रिशूलधृक्
verses.transliteration: indro.agnishcha yamashchaiva nirR^itirvaruNastathA | vAyuH somaH kuberashcha tatheshAnastrishUladhR^ik
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे शिवार्चनरताः शिवसद्भावभाविताः । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां मङ्गलं प्रदिशन्तु मे
verses.transliteration: sarve shivArchanaratAH shivasadbhAvabhAvitAH | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM ma~NgalaM pradishantu me
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जयाम्बिके जगन्मातर्जय सर्वजगन्मयि । जयानवधिकैश्वर्ये जयानुपमविग्रहे
verses.transliteration: jayAmbike jaganmAtarjaya sarvajaganmayi | jayAnavadhikaishvarye jayAnupamavigrahe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलमथ वज्रं च तथा परशुसायकौ । खड्गपाशाङ्कुशाश्चैव पिनाकश्चायुधोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: trishUlamatha vajraM cha tathA parashusAyakau | khaDgapAshA~NkushAshchaiva pinAkashchAyudhottamaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यायुधानि देवस्य देव्याश्चैतानि नित्यशः । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां रक्षां कुर्वन्तु मे सदा
verses.transliteration: divyAyudhAni devasya devyAshchaitAni nityashaH | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM rakShAM kurvantu me sadA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वृषरूपधरो देवः सौरभेयो महाबलः । वडवाख्यानलस्पर्द्धी पञ्चगोमातृभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: vR^iSharUpadharo devaH saurabheyo mahAbalaH | vaDavAkhyAnalasparddhI pa~nchagomAtR^ibhirvR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वाहनत्वमनुप्राप्तस्तपसा परमेशयोः । तयोराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य स मे कामं प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: vAhanatvamanuprAptastapasA parameshayoH | tayorAj~nAM puraskR^itya sa me kAmaM prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दा सुनन्दा सुरभिः सुशीला सुमनास्तथा । पञ्च गोमातरस्त्वेताः शिवलोके व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: nandA sunandA surabhiH sushIlA sumanAstathA | pa~ncha gomAtarastvetAH shivaloke vyavasthitAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवभक्तिपरा नित्यं शिवार्चनपरायणाः । शिवयोः शासनादेव दिशन्तु मम वाञ्छितम्
verses.transliteration: shivabhaktiparA nityaM shivArchanaparAyaNAH | shivayoH shAsanAdeva dishantu mama vA~nChitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रपालो महातेजा नीलजीमूतसन्निभः । दंष्ट्राकरालवदनः स्फुरद्रक्ताधरोज्ज्वलः
verses.transliteration: kShetrapAlo mahAtejA nIlajImUtasannibhaH | daMShTrAkarAlavadanaH sphuradraktAdharojjvalaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तोर्ध्वमूर्धजः श्रीमान् भृकुटीकुटिलेक्षणः । रक्तवृत्तत्रिनयनः शशिपन्नगभूषणः
verses.transliteration: raktordhvamUrdhajaH shrImAn bhR^ikuTIkuTilekShaNaH | raktavR^ittatrinayanaH shashipannagabhUShaNaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नग्नस्त्रिशूलपाशासिकपालोद्यतपाणिकः । भैरवो भैरवैः सिद्धैर्योगिनीभिश्च संवृतः
verses.transliteration: nagnastrishUlapAshAsikapAlodyatapANikaH | bhairavo bhairavaiH siddhairyoginIbhishcha saMvR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रे क्षेत्रे समासीनः स्थितो यो रक्षकः सताम् । शिवप्रणामपरमः शिवसद्भावभावितः
verses.transliteration: kShetre kShetre samAsInaH sthito yo rakShakaH satAm | shivapraNAmaparamaH shivasadbhAvabhAvitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जय वाङ्मनसातीते जयाचिद्ध्वान्तभञ्जिके । जय जन्मजराहीने जय कालोत्तरोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: jaya vA~NmanasAtIte jayAchiddhvAntabha~njike | jaya janmajarAhIne jaya kAlottarottare
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाश्रितान् विशेषेण रक्षन् पुत्रानिवौरसान् । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां स मे दिशतु मङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration: shivAshritAn visheSheNa rakShan putrAnivaurasAn | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM sa me dishatu ma~Ngalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तालजङ्घादयस्तस्य प्रथमावरणेऽर्चिताः । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां चत्वारः समवन्तु माम्
verses.transliteration: tAlaja~NghAdayastasya prathamAvaraNe.architAH | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM chatvAraH samavantu mAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भैरवाद्याश्च ये चान्ये समन्तात्तस्य वेष्टिताः । तेऽपि मामनुगृह्णन्तु शिवशासनगौरवात्
verses.transliteration: bhairavAdyAshcha ye chAnye samantAttasya veShTitAH | te.api mAmanugR^ihNantu shivashAsanagauravAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नारदाद्याश्च मुनयो दिव्या देवैश्च पूजिताः । साध्या नागाश्च ये देवा जनलोकनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: nAradAdyAshcha munayo divyA devaishcha pUjitAH | sAdhyA nAgAshcha ye devA janalokanivAsinaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विनिवृत्ताधिकाराश्च महर्लोकनिवासिनः । सप्तर्षयस्तथान्ये वै वैमानिकगुणैः सह
verses.transliteration: vinivR^ittAdhikArAshcha maharlokanivAsinaH | saptarShayastathAnye vai vaimAnikaguNaiH saha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे शिवार्चनरताः शिवाज्ञावशवर्तिनः । शिवयोराज्ञया मह्यं दिशन्तु समकाङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: sarve shivArchanaratAH shivAj~nAvashavartinaH | shivayorAj~nayA mahyaM dishantu samakA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाद्याः पिशाचान्ताश्चतस्रो देवयोनयः । सिद्धा विद्याधराद्याश्च येऽपि चान्ये नभश्चराः
verses.transliteration: gandharvAdyAH pishAchAntAshchatasro devayonayaH | siddhA vidyAdharAdyAshcha ye.api chAnye nabhashcharAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असुरा राक्षसाश्चैव पातालतलवासिनः । अनन्ताद्याश्च नागेन्द्रा वैनतेयादयो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: asurA rAkShasAshchaiva pAtAlatalavAsinaH | anantAdyAshcha nAgendrA vainateyAdayo dvijAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कूष्माण्डाः प्रेतवेताला ग्रहा भूतगणाः परे । डाकिन्यश्चापि योगिन्यः शाकिन्यश्चापि तादृशाः
verses.transliteration: kUShmANDAH pretavetAlA grahA bhUtagaNAH pare | DAkinyashchApi yoginyaH shAkinyashchApi tAdR^ishAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रारामगृहादीनि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च । द्वीपाः समुद्रा नद्यश्च नदाश्चान्ये सरांसि च
verses.transliteration: kShetrArAmagR^ihAdIni tIrthAnyAyatanAni cha | dvIpAH samudrA nadyashcha nadAshchAnye sarAMsi cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जयानेकविधानस्थे जय विश्वेश्वरप्रिये । जय विश्वसुराराध्ये जय विश्वविजृम्भिणि
verses.transliteration: jayAnekavidhAnasthe jaya vishveshvarapriye | jaya vishvasurArAdhye jaya vishvavijR^imbhiNi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गिरयश्च सुमेर्वाद्याः काननानि समन्ततः । पशवः पक्षिणो वृक्षाः कृमिकीटादयो मृगाः
verses.transliteration: girayashcha sumervAdyAH kAnanAni samantataH | pashavaH pakShiNo vR^ikShAH kR^imikITAdayo mR^igAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भुवनान्यपि सर्वाणि भुवनानामधीश्वराः । अण्डान्यावरणैः सार्धमासाश्च दश दिग्गजाः
verses.transliteration: bhuvanAnyapi sarvANi bhuvanAnAmadhIshvarAH | aNDAnyAvaraNaiH sArdhamAsAshcha dasha diggajAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाः पदानि मन्त्राश्च तत्त्वान्यपि सहाधिपैः । ब्रह्माण्डधारका रुद्रा रुद्राश्चान्ये सशक्तिकाः
verses.transliteration: varNAH padAni mantrAshcha tattvAnyapi sahAdhipaiH | brahmANDadhArakA rudrA rudrAshchAnye sashaktikAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यच्च किञ्चिज्जगत्यस्मिन्दृष्टं चानुमितं श्रुतम् । सर्वे कामं प्रयच्छन्तु शिवयोरेव शासनात्
verses.transliteration: yachcha ki~nchijjagatyasmindR^iShTaM chAnumitaM shrutam | sarve kAmaM prayachChantu shivayoreva shAsanAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ विद्या परा शैवी पशुपाशविमोचिनी । पञ्चार्थसंज्ञिता दिव्या पशुविद्याबहिष्कृता
verses.transliteration: atha vidyA parA shaivI pashupAshavimochinI | pa~nchArthasa.nj~nitA divyA pashuvidyAbahiShkR^itA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शास्त्रं च शिवधर्माख्यं धर्माख्यं च तदुत्तरम् । शैवाख्यं शिवधर्माख्यं पुराणं श्रुतिसम्मितम्
verses.transliteration: shAstraM cha shivadharmAkhyaM dharmAkhyaM cha taduttaram | shaivAkhyaM shivadharmAkhyaM purANaM shrutisammitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शैवागमाश्च ये चान्ये कामिकाद्याश्चतुर्विधाः । शिवाभ्यामविशेषेण सत्कृत्येह समर्चिताः
verses.transliteration: shaivAgamAshcha ye chAnye kAmikAdyAshchaturvidhAH | shivAbhyAmavisheSheNa satkR^ityeha samarchitAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यामेव समाज्ञाता ममाभिप्रेतसिद्धये । कर्मेदमनुमन्यन्तां सफलं साध्वनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: tAbhyAmeva samAj~nAtA mamAbhipretasiddhaye | karmedamanumanyantAM saphalaM sAdhvanuShThitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेताद्या नकुलीशान्ताः सशिष्याश्चापि देशिकाः । तत्सन्ततीया गुरवो विशेषाद् गुरवो मम
verses.transliteration: shvetAdyA nakulIshAntAH sashiShyAshchApi deshikAH | tatsantatIyA guravo visheShAd guravo mama
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शैवा माहेश्वराश्चैव ज्ञानकर्मपरायणाः । कर्मेदमनुमन्यन्तां सफलं साध्वनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: shaivA mAheshvarAshchaiva j~nAnakarmaparAyaNAH | karmedamanumanyantAM saphalaM sAdhvanuShThitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जय मङ्गलदिव्याङ्गि जय मङ्गलदीपिके । जय मङ्गलचारित्रे जय मङ्गलदायिनि
verses.transliteration: jaya ma~NgaladivyA~Ngi jaya ma~NgaladIpike | jaya ma~NgalachAritre jaya ma~NgaladAyini
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लौकिका ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे क्षत्रियाश्च विशः क्रमात् । वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञाः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: laukikA brAhmaNAH sarve kShatriyAshcha vishaH kramAt | vedavedA~Ngatattvaj~nAH sarvashAstravishAradAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: साङ्ख्या वैशेषिकाश्चैव यौगा नैयायिका नराः । सौरा ब्रह्मास्तथा रौद्रा वैष्णवाश्चापरे नराः
verses.transliteration: sA~NkhyA vaisheShikAshchaiva yaugA naiyAyikA narAH | saurA brahmAstathA raudrA vaiShNavAshchApare narAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्टाः सर्वे विशिष्टाश्च शिवशासनयन्त्रिताः । कर्मेदमनुमन्यन्तां ममाभिप्रेतसाधकम्
verses.transliteration: shiShTAH sarve vishiShTAshcha shivashAsanayantritAH | karmedamanumanyantAM mamAbhipretasAdhakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शैवाः सिद्धान्तमार्गस्थाः शैवाः पाशुपतास्तथा । शैवा महाव्रतधराः शैवाः कापालिकाः परे
verses.transliteration: shaivAH siddhAntamArgasthAH shaivAH pAshupatAstathA | shaivA mahAvratadharAH shaivAH kApAlikAH pare
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाज्ञापालकाः पूज्या ममापि शिवशासनात् । सर्वे ममानुगृह्णन्तु शंसन्तु सफलक्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: shivAj~nApAlakAH pUjyA mamApi shivashAsanAt | sarve mamAnugR^ihNantu shaMsantu saphalakriyAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणज्ञाननिष्ठाश्च दक्षिणोत्तरमार्गगाः । अविरोधेन वर्तन्तां मन्त्रं श्रेयोऽर्थिनो मम
verses.transliteration: dakShiNaj~nAnaniShThAshcha dakShiNottaramArgagAH | avirodhena vartantAM mantraM shreyo.arthino mama
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नास्तिकाश्च शठाश्चैव कृतघ्नाश्चैव तामसाः । पाषण्डाश्चातिपापाश्च वर्तन्तां दूरतो मम
verses.transliteration: nAstikAshcha shaThAshchaiva kR^itaghnAshchaiva tAmasAH | pAShaNDAshchAtipApAshcha vartantAM dUrato mama
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बहुभिः किं स्तुतैरत्र येऽपि केऽपि चिदास्तिकाः । सर्वे मामनुगृह्णन्तु सन्तः शंसन्तु मङ्गलम्
verses.transliteration: bahubhiH kiM stutairatra ye.api ke.api chidAstikAH | sarve mAmanugR^ihNantu santaH shaMsantu ma~Ngalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नमः शिवाय साम्बाय ससुतायादिहेतवे । पञ्चावरणरूपेण प्रपञ्चेनावृताय ते
verses.transliteration: namaH shivAya sAmbAya sasutAyAdihetave | pa~nchAvaraNarUpeNa prapa~nchenAvR^itAya te
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा दण्डवद् भूमौ प्रणिपत्य शिवं शिवाम् । जपेत्पञ्चाक्षरीं विद्यामष्टोत्तरशतावराम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA daNDavad bhUmau praNipatya shivaM shivAm | japetpa~nchAkSharIM vidyAmaShTottarashatAvarAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नमः परमकल्याणगुणसञ्चयमूर्तये । त्वत्तः खलु समुत्पन्नं जगत्त्वय्येव लीयते
verses.transliteration: namaH paramakalyANaguNasa~nchayamUrtaye | tvattaH khalu samutpannaM jagattvayyeva lIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव शक्तिविद्यां च जपित्वा तत्समर्पणम् । कृत्वा तं क्षमयित्वेशं पूजाशेषं समापयेत्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva shaktividyAM cha japitvA tatsamarpaNam | kR^itvA taM kShamayitveshaM pUjAsheShaM samApayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुण्यतमं स्तोत्रं शिवयोर्हृदयङ्गमम् । सर्वाभीष्टप्रदं साक्षाद्भुक्तिमुक्त्यैकसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: etatpuNyatamaM stotraM shivayorhR^idaya~Ngamam | sarvAbhIShTapradaM sAkShAdbhuktimuktyaikasAdhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं कीर्तयेन्नित्यं शृणुयाद्वा समाहितः । स विधूयाशु पापानि शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaM kIrtayennityaM shR^iNuyAdvA samAhitaH | sa vidhUyAshu pApAni shivasAyujyamApnuyAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गोघ्नश्चैव कृतघ्नश्च वीरहा भ्रूणहापि वा । शरणागतघाती च मित्रविश्रम्भघातकः
verses.transliteration: goghnashchaiva kR^itaghnashcha vIrahA bhrUNahApi vA | sharaNAgataghAtI cha mitravishrambhaghAtakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्टपापसमाचारो मातृहा पितृहापि वा । स्तवेनानेन जप्तेन तत्तत्पापात् प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: duShTapApasamAchAro mAtR^ihA pitR^ihApi vA | stavenAnena japtena tattatpApAt pramuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दुःस्वप्नादिमहानर्थसूचकेषु भयेषु च । यदि सङ्कीर्तयेदेतन्न ततोऽनर्थभाग्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: duHsvapnAdimahAnarthasUchakeShu bhayeShu cha | yadi sa~NkIrtayedetanna tato.anarthabhAgbhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यं यच्चान्यदपि वाञ्छितम् । स्तोत्रस्यास्य जपे तिष्ठंस्तत्सर्वं लभते नरः
verses.transliteration: AyurArogyamaishvaryaM yachchAnyadapi vA~nChitam | stotrasyAsya jape tiShThaMstatsarvaM labhate naraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: असम्पूज्य शिवस्तोत्रं जपात्फलमुदाहृतम् । सम्पूज्य च जपे तस्य फलं वक्तुं न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: asampUjya shivastotraM japAtphalamudAhR^itam | sampUjya cha jape tasya phalaM vaktuM na shakyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आस्तामियं फलावाप्तिरस्मिन् सङ्कीर्तिते सति । सार्धमम्बिकया देवः श्रुत्यैवं दिवि तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: AstAmiyaM phalAvAptirasmin sa~NkIrtite sati | sArdhamambikayA devaH shrutyaivaM divi tiShThati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्नभसि सम्पूज्य देवदेवं सहोमया । कृताञ्जलिपुटस्तिष्ठन् स्तोत्रमेतदुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAnnabhasi sampUjya devadevaM sahomayA | kR^itA~njalipuTastiShThan stotrametadudIrayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्विनातः फलं दातुमीश्वरोऽपि न शक्नुयात् । जन्मप्रभृति देवेशि जनोऽयं त्वदुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: tvadvinAtaH phalaM dAtumIshvaro.api na shaknuyAt | janmaprabhR^iti deveshi jano.ayaM tvadupAshritaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जय जय जगदेकनाथ शम्भो, प्रकृतिमनोहर नित्यचित्स्वभाव । अतिगतकलुषप्रपञ्चवाचामपि मनसां पदवीमतीततत्त्वम्
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya jagadekanAtha shambho, prakR^itimanohara nityachitsvabhAva | atigatakaluShaprapa~nchavAchAmapi manasAM padavImatItatattvam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अतोऽस्य तव भक्तस्य निर्वर्तय मनोरथम् । पञ्चवक्त्रो दशभुजः शुद्धस्फटिकसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: ato.asya tava bhaktasya nirvartaya manoratham | pa~nchavaktro dashabhujaH shuddhasphaTikasannibhaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णब्रह्मकलादेहो देवः सकलनिष्कलः । शिवमूर्तिसमारूढः शान्त्यतीतः सदाशिवः । भक्त्या मयार्चितो मह्यं प्रार्थितं शं प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: varNabrahmakalAdeho devaH sakalaniShkalaH | shivamUrtisamArUDhaH shAntyatItaH sadAshivaH | bhaktyA mayArchito mahyaM prArthitaM shaM prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवाङ्कमारूढा शक्तिरिच्छा शिवाह्वया । जननी सर्वलोकानां प्रयच्छतु मनोरथम्
verses.transliteration: sadAshivA~NkamArUDhA shaktirichChA shivAhvayA | jananI sarvalokAnAM prayachChatu manoratham
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवयोर्दयितौ पुत्रौ देवौ हेरम्बषण्मुखौ । शिवानुभावौ सर्वज्ञौ शिवज्ञानामृताशिनौ
verses.transliteration: shivayordayitau putrau devau herambaShaNmukhau | shivAnubhAvau sarvaj~nau shivaj~nAnAmR^itAshinau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तृप्तौ परस्परं स्निग्धौ शिवाभ्यां नित्यसत्कृतौ । सत्कृतौ च सदा देवौ ब्रह्माद्यैस्त्रिदशैरपि
verses.transliteration: tR^iptau parasparaM snigdhau shivAbhyAM nityasatkR^itau | satkR^itau cha sadA devau brahmAdyaistridashairapi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकपरित्राणं कर्तुमभ्युदितौ सदा । स्वेच्छावतारं कुर्वन्तौ स्वांशभेदैरनेकशः
verses.transliteration: sarvalokaparitrANaM kartumabhyuditau sadA | svechChAvatAraM kurvantau svAMshabhedairanekashaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ताविमौ शिवयोः पार्श्वे नित्यमित्थं मयार्चितौ । तयोराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य प्रार्थितं मे प्रयच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: tAvimau shivayoH pArshve nityamitthaM mayArchitau | tayorAj~nAM puraskR^itya prArthitaM me prayachChatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशमीशानाख्यं सदाशिवम् । मूर्धाभिमानिनी मूर्तिः शिवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: shuddhasphaTikasa~NkAshamIshAnAkhyaM sadAshivam | mUrdhAbhimAninI mUrtiH shivasya paramAtmanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवार्चनरतं शान्तं शान्त्यतीतं खमास्थितम् । पञ्चाक्षरान्तिमं बीजं कलाभिः पञ्चभिर्युतम्
verses.transliteration: shivArchanarataM shAntaM shAntyatItaM khamAsthitam | pa~nchAkSharAntimaM bIjaM kalAbhiH pa~nchabhiryutam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमावरणे पूर्वं शक्त्या सह समर्चितम् । पवित्रं परमं ब्रह्म प्रार्थितं मे प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: prathamAvaraNe pUrvaM shaktyA saha samarchitam | pavitraM paramaM brahma prArthitaM me prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावनिर्मलाभोग जय सुन्दरचेष्टित । स्वात्मतुल्यमहाशक्ते जय शुद्धगुणार्णव
verses.transliteration: svabhAvanirmalAbhoga jaya sundaracheShTita | svAtmatulyamahAshakte jaya shuddhaguNArNava
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बालसूर्यप्रतीकाशं पुरुषाख्यं पुरातनम् । पूर्ववक्त्राभिमानं च शिवस्य परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: bAlasUryapratIkAshaM puruShAkhyaM purAtanam | pUrvavaktrAbhimAnaM cha shivasya parameShThinaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शान्त्यात्मकं मरुत्संस्थं शम्भोः पादार्चने रतम् । प्रथमं शिवबीजेषु कलासु च चतुष्कलम्
verses.transliteration: shAntyAtmakaM marutsaMsthaM shambhoH pAdArchane ratam | prathamaM shivabIjeShu kalAsu cha chatuShkalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वभागे मया भक्त्या शक्त्या सह समर्चितम् । पवित्रं परमं ब्रह्म प्रार्थितं मे प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: pUrvabhAge mayA bhaktyA shaktyA saha samarchitam | pavitraM paramaM brahma prArthitaM me prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जनादिप्रतीकाशमघोरं घोरविग्रहम् । देवस्य दक्षिणं वक्त्रं देवदेवपदार्चकम्
verses.transliteration: a~njanAdipratIkAshamaghoraM ghoravigraham | devasya dakShiNaM vaktraM devadevapadArchakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यापादं समारूढं वह्निमण्डलमध्यगम् । द्वितीयं शिवबीजेषु कलास्वष्टकलान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: vidyApAdaM samArUDhaM vahnimaNDalamadhyagam | dvitIyaM shivabIjeShu kalAsvaShTakalAnvitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शम्भोर्दक्षिणदिग्भागे शक्त्या सह समर्चितम् । पवित्रं परमं ब्रह्म प्रार्थितं मे प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: shambhordakShiNadigbhAge shaktyA saha samarchitam | pavitraM paramaM brahma prArthitaM me prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कुङ्कुमक्षोदसङ्काशं वामाख्यं वरवेषधृक् । वक्त्रमुत्तरमीशस्य प्रतिष्ठायां प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: ku~NkumakShodasa~NkAshaM vAmAkhyaM varaveShadhR^ik | vaktramuttaramIshasya pratiShThAyAM pratiShThitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वारिमण्डलमध्यस्थं महादेवार्चने रतम् । तुरीयं शिवबीजेषु त्रयोदशकलान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: vArimaNDalamadhyasthaM mahAdevArchane ratam | turIyaM shivabIjeShu trayodashakalAnvitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देवस्योत्तरदिग्भागे शक्त्या सह समर्चितम् । पवित्रं परमं ब्रह्म प्रार्थितं मे प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: devasyottaradigbhAge shaktyA saha samarchitam | pavitraM paramaM brahma prArthitaM me prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खकुन्देन्दुधवलं सद्याख्यं सौम्यलक्षणम् । शिवस्य पश्चिमं वक्त्रं शिवपादार्चने रतम्
verses.transliteration: sha~NkhakundendudhavalaM sadyAkhyaM saumyalakShaNam | shivasya pashchimaM vaktraM shivapAdArchane ratam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तकान्तिसम्पन्न जयासदृशविग्रह । अतर्क्यमहिमाधार जयानाकुलमङ्गल
verses.transliteration: anantakAntisampanna jayAsadR^ishavigraha | atarkyamahimAdhAra jayAnAkulama~Ngala
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तिपदनिष्ठं च पृथिव्यां समवस्थितम् । तृतीयं शिवबीजेषु कलाभिश्चाष्टभिर्युतम्
verses.transliteration: nivR^ittipadaniShThaM cha pR^ithivyAM samavasthitam | tR^itIyaM shivabIjeShu kalAbhishchAShTabhiryutam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य पश्चिमे भागे शक्त्या सह समर्चितम् । पवित्रं परमं ब्रह्म प्रार्थितं मे प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: devasya pashchime bhAge shaktyA saha samarchitam | pavitraM paramaM brahma prArthitaM me prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य तु शिवायाश्च हृन्मूर्त्ती शिवभाविते । तयोराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य ते मे कामं प्रयच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: shivasya tu shivAyAshcha hR^inmUrttI shivabhAvite | tayorAj~nAM puraskR^itya te me kAmaM prayachChatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य च शिवायाश्च शिवामूर्त्ती शिवाश्रिते । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां ते मे कामं प्रयच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: shivasya cha shivAyAshcha shivAmUrttI shivAshrite | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM te me kAmaM prayachChatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य च शिवायाश्च वर्मणी शिवभाविते । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां ते मे कामं प्रयच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: shivasya cha shivAyAshcha varmaNI shivabhAvite | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM te me kAmaM prayachChatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य च शिवायाश्च नेत्रमूर्त्ती शिवाश्रिते । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां ते मे कामं प्रयच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: shivasya cha shivAyAshcha netramUrttI shivAshrite | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM te me kAmaM prayachChatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रमूर्ती च शिवयोर्नित्यमर्चनतत्परे । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां ते मे कामं प्रयच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: astramUrtI cha shivayornityamarchanatatpare | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM te me kAmaM prayachChatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वामो ज्येष्ठस्तथा रुद्रः कालो विकरणस्तथा । बलो विकरणश्चैव बलप्रमथनः परः
verses.transliteration: vAmo jyeShThastathA rudraH kAlo vikaraNastathA | balo vikaraNashchaiva balapramathanaH paraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतस्य दमनस्तादृशाश्चाष्टशक्तयः । प्रार्थितं मे प्रयच्छन्तु शिवयोरेव शासनात्
verses.transliteration: sarvabhUtasya damanastAdR^ishAshchAShTashaktayaH | prArthitaM me prayachChantu shivayoreva shAsanAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथानन्तश्च सूक्ष्मश्च शिवश्चाप्येकनेत्रकः । एकरुद्रस्त्रिमूर्तिश्च श्रीकण्ठश्च शिखण्डिकः
verses.transliteration: athAnantashcha sUkShmashcha shivashchApyekanetrakaH | ekarudrastrimUrtishcha shrIkaNThashcha shikhaNDikaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निरञ्जन निराधार जय निष्कारणोदय । निरन्तरपरानन्द जय निर्वृतिकारण
verses.transliteration: nira~njana nirAdhAra jaya niShkAraNodaya | nirantaraparAnanda jaya nirvR^itikAraNa
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथाष्टौ शक्तयस्तेषां द्वितीयावरणेऽर्चिताः । ते मे कामं प्रयच्छन्तु शिवयोरेव शासनात्
verses.transliteration: tathAShTau shaktayasteShAM dvitIyAvaraNe.architAH | te me kAmaM prayachChantu shivayoreva shAsanAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भवाद्या मूर्तयश्चाष्टौ तासामपि च शक्तयः । महादेवादयश्चान्ये तथैकादशमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: bhavAdyA mUrtayashchAShTau tAsAmapi cha shaktayaH | mahAdevAdayashchAnye tathaikAdashamUrtayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिभिः सहिताः सर्वे तृतीयावरणे स्थिताः । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां दिशन्तु फलमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: shaktibhiH sahitAH sarve tR^itIyAvaraNe sthitAH | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM dishantu phalamIpsitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वृषराजो महातेजा महामेघसमस्वनः । मेरुमन्दरकैलासहिमाद्रिशिखरोपमः
verses.transliteration: vR^iSharAjo mahAtejA mahAmeghasamasvanaH | merumandarakailAsahimAdrishikharopamaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सिताभ्रशिखराकारः ककुदा परिशोभितः । महाभोगीन्द्रकल्पेन वालेन च विराजितः
verses.transliteration: sitAbhrashikharAkAraH kakudA parishobhitaH | mahAbhogIndrakalpena vAlena cha virAjitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तास्यशृङ्गचरणो रक्तप्रायविलोचनः । पीवरोन्नतसर्वाङ्गः सुचारुगमनोज्ज्वलः
verses.transliteration: raktAsyashR^i~NgacharaNo raktaprAyavilochanaH | pIvaronnatasarvA~NgaH suchArugamanojjvalaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रशस्तलक्षणः श्रीमान् प्रज्वलन्मणिभूषणः । शिवप्रियः शिवासक्तः शिवयोर्ध्वजवाहनः
verses.transliteration: prashastalakShaNaH shrImAn prajvalanmaNibhUShaNaH | shivapriyaH shivAsaktaH shivayordhvajavAhanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तच्चरणन्यासपावितापरविग्रहः । गोराजपुरुषः श्रीमान् श्रीमच्छूलवरायुधः । तयोराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य स मे कामं प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: tathA tachcharaNanyAsapAvitAparavigrahaH | gorAjapuruShaH shrImAn shrImachChUlavarAyudhaH | tayorAj~nAM puraskR^itya sa me kAmaM prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वरो महातेजा नगेन्द्रतनयात्मजः । सनारायणकैर्देवैर्नित्यमभ्यर्च्य वन्दितः
verses.transliteration: nandIshvaro mahAtejA nagendratanayAtmajaH | sanArAyaNakairdevairnityamabhyarchya vanditaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शर्वस्यान्तःपुरद्वारि सार्धं परिजनैः स्थितः । सर्वेश्वरसमप्रख्यः सर्वासुरविमर्दनः
verses.transliteration: sharvasyAntaHpuradvAri sArdhaM parijanaiH sthitaH | sarveshvarasamaprakhyaH sarvAsuravimardanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जयातिपरमैश्वर्य जयातिकरुणास्पद । जय स्वतन्त्रसर्वस्व जयासदृशवैभव
verses.transliteration: jayAtiparamaishvarya jayAtikaruNAspada | jaya svatantrasarvasva jayAsadR^ishavaibhava
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां शिवधर्माणामध्यक्षत्वेऽभिषेचितः । शिवप्रियः शिवासक्तः श्रीमच्छूलवरायुधः
verses.transliteration: sarveShAM shivadharmANAmadhyakShatve.abhiShechitaH | shivapriyaH shivAsaktaH shrImachChUlavarAyudhaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाश्रितेषु संसक्तस्त्वनुरक्तश्च तैरपि । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां स मे कामं प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: shivAshriteShu saMsaktastvanuraktashcha tairapi | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM sa me kAmaM prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: महाकालो महाबाहुर्महादेव इवापरः । महादेवाश्रितानां तु नित्यमेवाभिरक्षतु
verses.transliteration: mahAkAlo mahAbAhurmahAdeva ivAparaH | mahAdevAshritAnAM tu nityamevAbhirakShatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवप्रियः शिवासक्तः शिवयोरर्चकः सदा । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां स मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: shivapriyaH shivAsaktaH shivayorarchakaH sadA | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM sa me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञः शास्ता विष्णोः परा तनुः । महामोहात्मतनयो मधुमांसासवप्रियः । तयोराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य स मे कामं प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: sarvashAstrArthatattvaj~naH shAstA viShNoH parA tanuH | mahAmohAtmatanayo madhumAMsAsavapriyaH | tayorAj~nAM puraskR^itya sa me kAmaM prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणी चैव माहेशी कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा । वाराही चैव माहेन्द्री चामुण्डा चण्डविक्रमा
verses.transliteration: brahmANI chaiva mAheshI kaumArI vaiShNavI tathA | vArAhI chaiva mAhendrI chAmuNDA chaNDavikramA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एता वै मातरः सप्त सर्वलोकस्य मातरः । प्रार्थितं मे प्रयच्छन्तु परमेश्वरशासनात्
verses.transliteration: etA vai mAtaraH sapta sarvalokasya mAtaraH | prArthitaM me prayachChantu parameshvarashAsanAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मत्तमातङ्गवदनो गङ्गोमाशङ्करात्मजः । आकाशदेहो दिग्बाहुः सोमसूर्याग्निलोचनः
verses.transliteration: mattamAta~Ngavadano ga~NgomAsha~NkarAtmajaH | AkAshadeho digbAhuH somasUryAgnilochanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऐरावतादिभिर्दिव्यैर्दिग्गजैर्नित्यमर्चितः । शिवज्ञानमदोद्भिन्नस्त्रिदशानामविघ्नकृत्
verses.transliteration: airAvatAdibhirdivyairdiggajairnityamarchitaH | shivaj~nAnamadodbhinnastridashAnAmavighnakR^it
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नकृच्चासुरादीनां विघ्नेशः शिवभावितः । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां स मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: vighnakR^ichchAsurAdInAM vighneshaH shivabhAvitaH | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM sa me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जयावृतमहाविश्व जयानावृत केनचित् । जयोत्तर समस्तस्य जयात्यन्तनिरुत्तर
verses.transliteration: jayAvR^itamahAvishva jayAnAvR^ita kenachit | jayottara samastasya jayAtyantaniruttara
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: षण्मुखः शिवसम्भूतः शक्तिवज्रधरः प्रभुः । अग्नेश्च तनयो देवो ह्यपर्णातनयः पुनः
verses.transliteration: ShaNmukhaH shivasambhUtaH shaktivajradharaH prabhuH | agneshcha tanayo devo hyaparNAtanayaH punaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायाश्च गणाम्बायाः कृत्तिकानां तथैव च । विशाखेन च शाखेन नैगमेयेन चावृतः
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAyAshcha gaNAmbAyAH kR^ittikAnAM tathaiva cha | vishAkhena cha shAkhena naigameyena chAvR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रजिच्चन्द्रसेनानीस्तारकासुरजित्तथा । शैलानां मेरुमुख्यानां वेधकश्च स्वतेजसा
verses.transliteration: indrajichchandrasenAnIstArakAsurajittathA | shailAnAM merumukhyAnAM vedhakashcha svatejasA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तप्तचामीकरप्रख्यः शतपत्रदलेक्षणः । कुमारः सुकुमाराणां रूपोदाहरणं महत्
verses.transliteration: taptachAmIkaraprakhyaH shatapatradalekShaNaH | kumAraH sukumArANAM rUpodAharaNaM mahat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवप्रियः शिवासक्तः शिवपदार्चकः सदा । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां स मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: shivapriyaH shivAsaktaH shivapadArchakaH sadA | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM sa me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठा वरिष्ठा वरदा शिवयोर्यजने रता । तयोराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य सा मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: jyeShThA variShThA varadA shivayoryajane ratA | tayorAj~nAM puraskR^itya sA me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यवन्दिता साक्षादुल्काकारा गणाम्बिका । जगत्सृष्टिविवृद्ध्यर्थं ब्रह्मणाभ्यर्थिता शिवात्
verses.transliteration: trailokyavanditA sAkShAdulkAkArA gaNAmbikA | jagatsR^iShTivivR^iddhyarthaM brahmaNAbhyarthitA shivAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवायाः प्रविभक्ताया भ्रुवोरन्तरनिःसृताः । दाक्षायणी सती मेना तथा हैमवती ह्युमा
verses.transliteration: shivAyAH pravibhaktAyA bhruvorantaraniHsR^itAH | dAkShAyaNI satI menA tathA haimavatI hyumA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कौशिक्याश्चैव जननी भद्रकाल्यास्तथैव च । अपर्णायाश्च जननी पाटलायास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kaushikyAshchaiva jananI bhadrakAlyAstathaiva cha | aparNAyAshcha jananI pATalAyAstathaiva cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवार्चनरता नित्यं रुद्राणी रुद्रवल्लभा । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां सा मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: shivArchanaratA nityaM rudrANI rudravallabhA | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM sA me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जयाद्भुत जयाक्षुद्र जयाक्षत जयाव्यय । जयामेय जयामाय जयाभाव जयामल
verses.transliteration: jayAdbhuta jayAkShudra jayAkShata jayAvyaya | jayAmeya jayAmAya jayAbhAva jayAmala
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डः सर्वगणेशानः शम्भोर्वदनसम्भवः । सत्कृत्य शिवयोराज्ञां स मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: chaNDaH sarvagaNeshAnaH shambhorvadanasambhavaH | satkR^itya shivayorAj~nAM sa me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पिङ्गलो गणपः श्रीमान् शिवासक्तः शिवप्रियः । आज्ञया शिवयोरेव स मे कामं प्रयच्छतु
verses.transliteration: pi~Ngalo gaNapaH shrImAn shivAsaktaH shivapriyaH | Aj~nayA shivayoreva sa me kAmaM prayachChatu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भृङ्गीशो नाम गणपः शिवराधनतत्परः । प्रयच्छतु स मे कामं पत्युराज्ञापुरःसरम्
verses.transliteration: bhR^i~NgIsho nAma gaNapaH shivarAdhanatatparaH | prayachChatu sa me kAmaM patyurAj~nApuraHsaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्रो महातेजा हिमकुन्देन्दुसन्निभः । भद्रकालीप्रियो नित्यं मातृणां चाभिरक्षिता
verses.transliteration: vIrabhadro mahAtejA himakundendusannibhaH | bhadrakAlIpriyo nityaM mAtR^iNAM chAbhirakShitA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य च शिरोहर्ता दक्षस्य च दुरात्मनः । उपेन्द्रेन्द्रयमादीनां देवानामङ्गतक्षकः
verses.transliteration: yaj~nasya cha shirohartA dakShasya cha durAtmanaH | upendrendrayamAdInAM devAnAma~NgatakShakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्यानुचरः श्रीमान् शिवशासनपालकः । शिवयोः शासनादेव स मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: shivasyAnucharaH shrImAn shivashAsanapAlakaH | shivayoH shAsanAdeva sa me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वती महेशस्य वाक्सरोजसमुद्भवा । शिवयोः पूजने सक्ता स मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatI maheshasya vAksarojasamudbhavA | shivayoH pUjane saktA sa me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोर्वक्षःस्थिता लक्ष्मीः शिवयोः पूजने रता । शिवयोः शासनादेव सा मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: viShNorvakShaHsthitA lakShmIH shivayoH pUjane ratA | shivayoH shAsanAdeva sA me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: महामोटी महादेव्याः पादपूजापरायणा । तस्या एव नियोगेन सा मे दिशतु काङ्क्षितम्
verses.transliteration: mahAmoTI mahAdevyAH pAdapUjAparAyaNA | tasyA eva niyogena sA me dishatu kA~NkShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.
