verses.sanskrit: त्वामुशन्ति महादेवं भीतानामार्तिनाशनम् । अतो व्यतिक्रमं मेऽद्य क्षन्तुमर्हसि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: tvAmushanti mahAdevaM bhItAnAmArtinAshanam | ato vyatikramaM me.adya kShantumarhasi sha~Nkara
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राकारो ऋगभवदुकारो यजुरव्ययः । मकारः साम सञ्जातो नादस्त्वाथर्वणी श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: tatrAkAro R^igabhavadukAro yajuravyayaH | makAraH sAma sa~njAto nAdastvAtharvaNI shrutiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इति विज्ञापितस्ताभ्यामीश्वराभ्यां महेश्वरः । प्रीतोऽनुगृह्य तौ देवौ स्मितपूर्वमभाषत
verses.transliteration: iti vij~nApitastAbhyAmIshvarAbhyAM maheshvaraH | prIto.anugR^ihya tau devau smitapUrvamabhAShata
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच । वत्स वत्स विधे विष्णो मायया मम मोहितौ । युवां प्रभुत्वेऽहङ्कृत्य बुद्धवैरौ परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: Ishvara uvAcha | vatsa vatsa vidhe viShNo mAyayA mama mohitau | yuvAM prabhutve.aha~NkR^itya buddhavairau parasparam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विवादं युद्धपर्यन्तं कृत्वा नोपरतौ किल । ततश्च्छिन्ना प्रजासृष्टिर्जगत्कारणभूतयोः
verses.transliteration: vivAdaM yuddhaparyantaM kR^itvA noparatau kila | tatashchChinnA prajAsR^iShTirjagatkAraNabhUtayoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानमानप्रभवाद्वैमत्याद्युवयोरपि । तन्निवर्तयितुं युष्मद्दर्पमोहौ मयैव तु
verses.transliteration: aj~nAnamAnaprabhavAdvaimatyAdyuvayorapi | tannivartayituM yuShmaddarpamohau mayaiva tu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं निवारितावद्यलिङ्गाविर्भावलीलया । तस्माद्भूयो विवादं च व्रीडां चोत्सृज्य कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: evaM nivAritAvadyali~NgAvirbhAvalIlayA | tasmAdbhUyo vivAdaM cha vrIDAM chotsR^ijya kR^itsnashaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथास्वं कर्म कुर्यातां भवन्तौ वीतमत्सरौ । पुरा ममाज्ञया सार्द्धं समस्तज्ञानसंहिताः
verses.transliteration: yathAsvaM karma kuryAtAM bhavantau vItamatsarau | purA mamAj~nayA sArddhaM samastaj~nAnasaMhitAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: युवाभ्यां हि मया दत्ताः कारणत्वप्रसिद्धये । मन्त्ररत्नं च सूत्राख्यं पञ्चाक्षरमयं परम्
verses.transliteration: yuvAbhyAM hi mayA dattAH kAraNatvaprasiddhaye | mantraratnaM cha sUtrAkhyaM pa~nchAkSharamayaM param
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मयोपदिष्टं सर्वं तद्युवयोरद्य विस्मृतम् । ददामि च पुनः सर्वं यथापूर्वं ममाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: mayopadiShTaM sarvaM tadyuvayoradya vismR^itam | dadAmi cha punaH sarvaM yathApUrvaM mamAj~nayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यतो विना युवां तेन न क्षमौ सृष्टिरक्षणे । एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो नारायणपितामहौ
verses.transliteration: yato vinA yuvAM tena na kShamau sR^iShTirakShaNe | evamuktvA mahAdevo nArAyaNapitAmahau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रराजं ददौ ताभ्यां ज्ञानसंहितया सह । तौ लब्ध्वा महतीं दिव्यामाज्ञां माहेश्वरीं पराम्
verses.transliteration: mantrarAjaM dadau tAbhyAM j~nAnasaMhitayA saha | tau labdhvA mahatIM divyAmAj~nAM mAheshvarIM parAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऋगयं स्थापयामास समासात्त्वर्थमात्मनः । रजोगुणेषु ब्रह्माणं मूर्तिष्वाद्यं क्रियास्वपि
verses.transliteration: R^igayaM sthApayAmAsa samAsAttvarthamAtmanaH | rajoguNeShu brahmANaM mUrtiShvAdyaM kriyAsvapi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: महार्थं मन्त्ररत्नं च तथैव सकलाः कलाः । दण्डवत्प्रणतिं कृत्वा देवदेवस्य पादयोः
verses.transliteration: mahArthaM mantraratnaM cha tathaiva sakalAH kalAH | daNDavatpraNatiM kR^itvA devadevasya pAdayoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अतिष्ठतां वीतभयावानन्दास्तिमितौ तदा । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चित्रमिन्द्रजालवदैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: atiShThatAM vItabhayAvAnandAstimitau tadA | etasminnantare chitramindrajAlavadaishvaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गं क्वापि तिरोभूतं न ताभ्यामुपलभ्यते । ततो विलप्य हाहेति सद्यःप्रणयभङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: li~NgaM kvApi tirobhUtaM na tAbhyAmupalabhyate | tato vilapya hAheti sadyaHpraNayabha~NgataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: किमद्भुतमिदं वृत्तमिति चोक्त्वा परस्परम् । अचिन्त्यवैभवं शम्भोर्विचिन्त्य च गतव्यथौ
verses.transliteration: kimadbhutamidaM vR^ittamiti choktvA parasparam | achintyavaibhavaM shambhorvichintya cha gatavyathau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्युपेत्य परां मैत्रीमालिङ्ग्य च परस्परम् । जगद्व्यापारमुद्दिश्य जग्मतुर्देवपुङ्गवौ
verses.transliteration: abhyupetya parAM maitrImAli~Ngya cha parasparam | jagadvyApAramuddishya jagmaturdevapu~Ngavau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति शक्राद्याः सर्व एव सुरासुराः । ऋषयश्च नरा नागा नार्यश्चापि विधानतः । लिङ्गप्रतिष्ठां कुर्वन्ति लिङ्गे तं पूजयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: tataH prabhR^iti shakrAdyAH sarva eva surAsurAH | R^iShayashcha narA nAgA nAryashchApi vidhAnataH | li~NgapratiShThAM kurvanti li~Nge taM pUjayanti cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टिं लोकेषु पृथिवीं तत्त्वेष्वात्मानमव्ययम् । कलाध्वनि निवृत्तिं च सद्यं ब्रह्मसु पञ्चसु
verses.transliteration: sR^iShTiM lokeShu pR^ithivIM tattveShvAtmAnamavyayam | kalAdhvani nivR^ittiM cha sadyaM brahmasu pa~nchasu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.३६. षट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः । प्रतिष्ठाविधिवर्णनम् । श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छामि प्रतिष्ठाविधिमुत्तमम् । लिङ्गस्यापि च बेरस्य शिवेन विहितं यथा
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.36\. ShaTtriMsho.adhyAyaH | pratiShThAvidhivarNanam | shrIkR^iShNa uvAcha | bhagavan shrotumichChAmi pratiShThAvidhimuttamam | li~NgasyApi cha berasya shivena vihitaM yathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तैजसं दारवं वापि कृत्वा पद्मासनाङ्कितम् । विन्यसेन्मध्यतस्तत्र विपुलं पीठकालयम्
verses.transliteration: taijasaM dAravaM vApi kR^itvA padmAsanA~Nkitam | vinyasenmadhyatastatra vipulaM pIThakAlayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: द्वारपालान् समभ्यर्च्य भद्रादींश्चतुरःक्रमात् । सुभद्रश्च विभद्रश्च सुनन्दश्च विनन्दकः
verses.transliteration: dvArapAlAn samabhyarchya bhadrAdIMshchaturaHkramAt | subhadrashcha vibhadrashcha sunandashcha vinandakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयित्वा समभ्यर्च्य लिङ्गं वेदिकया सह । सकूर्चाभ्यां तु वस्त्राभ्यां समावेष्ट्य समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: snApayitvA samabhyarchya li~NgaM vedikayA saha | sakUrchAbhyAM tu vastrAbhyAM samAveShTya samantataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रापय्य शनकैस्तोयं पीठिकोपरि शाययेत् । प्राक् शिरस्कमधः सूत्रं पिण्डिकां चास्य पश्चिमे
verses.transliteration: prApayya shanakaistoyaM pIThikopari shAyayet | prAk shiraskamadhaH sUtraM piNDikAM chAsya pashchime
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमङ्गलसंयुक्तं लिङ्गं तत्राधिवासयेत् । पञ्चरात्रं त्रिरात्रं वाप्येकरात्रमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: sarvama~NgalasaMyuktaM li~NgaM tatrAdhivAsayet | pa~ncharAtraM trirAtraM vApyekarAtramathApi vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विसृज्य पूजितं तत्र शोधयित्वा च पूर्ववत् । सम्पूज्योत्सवमार्गेण शयनालयमानयेत्
verses.transliteration: visR^ijya pUjitaM tatra shodhayitvA cha pUrvavat | sampUjyotsavamArgeNa shayanAlayamAnayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि शयनस्थानं कुर्यात् मण्डलमध्यतः । शुद्धैर्जलैः स्नापयित्वा लिङ्गमभ्यर्चयेत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tatrApi shayanasthAnaM kuryAt maNDalamadhyataH | shuddhairjalaiH snApayitvA li~NgamabhyarchayetkramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऐशान्यां पद्ममालिख्य शुद्धलिप्ते महीतले । शिवकुम्भं शोधयित्वा तत्रावाह्य शिवं यजेत्
verses.transliteration: aishAnyAM padmamAlikhya shuddhalipte mahItale | shivakumbhaM shodhayitvA tatrAvAhya shivaM yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वेदीमध्ये सितं पद्मं परिकल्प्य विधानतः । तस्य पश्चिमतश्चापि चण्डिकापद्ममालिखेत्
verses.transliteration: vedImadhye sitaM padmaM parikalpya vidhAnataH | tasya pashchimatashchApi chaNDikApadmamAlikhet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्षौमाद्यैर्वाहतैर्वस्त्रैः पुष्पैर्दर्भैरथापि वा । प्रकल्प्य शयनं तस्मिन् हेमपुष्पं विनिक्षिपेत्
verses.transliteration: kShaumAdyairvAhatairvastraiH puShpairdarbhairathApi vA | prakalpya shayanaM tasmin hemapuShpaM vinikShipet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । अनात्मप्रतिकूले तु दिवसे शुक्लपक्षके । शिवशास्त्रोक्तमार्गेण कुर्याल्लिङ्गं प्रमाणवत्
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | anAtmapratikUle tu divase shuklapakShake | shivashAstroktamArgeNa kuryAlli~NgaM pramANavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र लिङ्गं समानीय सर्वमङ्गलनिःस्वनैः । रक्तेन वस्त्रयुग्मेन सकूर्चेन समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: tatra li~NgaM samAnIya sarvama~NgalaniHsvanaiH | raktena vastrayugmena sakUrchena samantataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सह पिण्डिकयावेष्ट्य शाययेच्च यथा पुरा । पुरस्तात्पद्ममालिख्य तद्दलेषु यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: saha piNDikayAveShTya shAyayechcha yathA purA | purastAtpadmamAlikhya taddaleShu yathAkramam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विद्येशकलशान्न्यस्येन्मध्ये शैवीं च वर्द्धनीम् । परीत्य पद्मत्रितयं जुहुयुर्द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: vidyeshakalashAnnyasyenmadhye shaivIM cha varddhanIm | parItya padmatritayaM juhuyurdvijasattamAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ते चाष्टमूर्त्तयः कल्प्याः पूर्वादिपरितः स्थिताः । चत्वारश्चाथ वा दिक्षु स्वध्येतारः सजापकाः
verses.transliteration: te chAShTamUrttayaH kalpyAH pUrvAdiparitaH sthitAH | chatvArashchAtha vA dikShu svadhyetAraH sajApakAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जुहुयुस्ते विरञ्च्याद्याश्चतस्रो मूर्तयः स्मृताः । देशिकः प्रथमं तेषामैशान्यां पश्चिमेऽथ वा
verses.transliteration: juhuyuste vira~nchyAdyAshchatasro mUrtayaH smR^itAH | deshikaH prathamaM teShAmaishAnyAM pashchime.atha vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानहोमं कुर्वीत सप्तद्रव्यैर्यथाक्रमम् । आचार्यात् पादमर्द्धं वा जुहुयुश्चापरे द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: pradhAnahomaM kurvIta saptadravyairyathAkramam | AchAryAt pAdamarddhaM vA juhuyushchApare dvijAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानमेकमेवात्र जुहुयादथ वा गुरुः । पूर्वं पूर्णाहुतिं हुत्वा घृतेनाष्टोत्तरं शतम्
verses.transliteration: pradhAnamekamevAtra juhuyAdatha vA guruH | pUrvaM pUrNAhutiM hutvA ghR^itenAShTottaraM shatam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्ध्नि मूलेन लिङ्गस्य शिवहस्तं प्रविन्यसेत् । शतमर्द्धं तदर्द्धं वा क्रमाद् द्रव्यैश्च सप्तभिः
verses.transliteration: mUrdhni mUlena li~Ngasya shivahastaM pravinyaset | shatamarddhaM tadarddhaM vA kramAd dravyaishcha saptabhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा हुत्वा स्पृशेल्लिङ्गं वेदिकां च पुनः पुनः । पूर्णाहुतिं ततो हुत्वा क्रमाद्दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: hutvA hutvA spR^ishelli~NgaM vedikAM cha punaH punaH | pUrNAhutiM tato hutvA kramAddadyAchcha dakShiNAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आचार्यात् पादमर्द्धं वा होतृणां स्थपतेरपि । तदर्द्धं देयमन्येभ्यः सदस्येभ्यश्च शक्तितः
verses.transliteration: AchAryAt pAdamarddhaM vA hotR^iNAM sthapaterapi | tadarddhaM deyamanyebhyaH sadasyebhyashcha shaktitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वीकृत्याथ शुभस्थानं भूपरीक्षां विधाय च । दशोपचारान्कुर्वीत लक्षणोद्धारपूर्वकान्
verses.transliteration: svIkR^ityAtha shubhasthAnaM bhUparIkShAM vidhAya cha | dashopachArAnkurvIta lakShaNoddhArapUrvakAn
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः श्वभ्रे वृषं हैमं कूर्चं वापि निवेश्य च । मृदम्भसा पञ्चगव्यैः पुनः शुद्धजलेन च
verses.transliteration: tataH shvabhre vR^iShaM haimaM kUrchaM vApi niveshya cha | mR^idambhasA pa~nchagavyaiH punaH shuddhajalena cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शोधितां चन्दनालिप्तां श्वभ्रे ब्रह्मशिलां क्षिपेत् । करन्यासं ततः कृत्वा नवभिः शक्तिनामभिः
verses.transliteration: shodhitAM chandanAliptAM shvabhre brahmashilAM kShipet | karanyAsaM tataH kR^itvA navabhiH shaktinAmabhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हरितालादिधातूंश्च बीजगन्धौषधैरपि । शिवशास्त्रोक्तविधिना क्षिपेद् ब्रह्मशिलोपरि
verses.transliteration: haritAlAdidhAtUMshcha bIjagandhauShadhairapi | shivashAstroktavidhinA kShiped brahmashilopari
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिलिङ्गं तु संस्थाप्य क्षीरवृक्षसमुद्भवम् । स्थितं बुद्ध्वा तदुत्सृज्य लिङ्गं ब्रह्मशिलापरि
verses.transliteration: pratili~NgaM tu saMsthApya kShIravR^ikShasamudbhavam | sthitaM buddhvA tadutsR^ijya li~NgaM brahmashilApari
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रागुदक्प्रवरां किञ्चित् स्थापयेन्मूलविद्यया । पिण्डिकां चाथ संयोज्य शाक्तं मूलमनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: prAgudakpravarAM ki~nchit sthApayenmUlavidyayA | piNDikAM chAtha saMyojya shAktaM mUlamanusmaran
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बन्धनं बन्धकद्रव्यैः कृत्वा स्थानं विशोध्य च । दत्त्वा चार्घ्यं च पुष्पाणि कुर्युर्यवनिकां पुनः
verses.transliteration: bandhanaM bandhakadravyaiH kR^itvA sthAnaM vishodhya cha | dattvA chArghyaM cha puShpANi kuryuryavanikAM punaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथायोग्यं निषेकादि लिङ्गस्य पुरतस्तदा । आनीय शयनस्थानात्कलशान्विन्यसेत्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: yathAyogyaM niShekAdi li~Ngasya puratastadA | AnIya shayanasthAnAtkalashAnvinyasetkramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: महापूजामथारभ्य सम्पूज्य कलशान्दश । शिवमन्त्रमनुस्मृत्य शिवकुम्भजलान्तरे
verses.transliteration: mahApUjAmathArabhya sampUjya kalashAndasha | shivamantramanusmR^itya shivakumbhajalAntare
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठानामिकायोगादादाय तमुदीरयेत् । न्यसेदीशानभागस्य मध्ये लिङ्गस्य मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: a~NguShThAnAmikAyogAdAdAya tamudIrayet | nyasedIshAnabhAgasya madhye li~Ngasya mantravit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिं न्यसेत्तथा विद्यां विद्येशांश्च यथाक्रमम् । लिङ्गमूले शिवजलैस्ततो लिङ्गं निषेचयेत्
verses.transliteration: shaktiM nyasettathA vidyAM vidyeshAMshcha yathAkramam | li~NgamUle shivajalaistato li~NgaM niShechayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां दशोपचाराणां पूर्वं पूज्य विनायकम् । स्थानशुद्ध्यादिकं कृत्वा लिङ्गं स्नानालयं नयेत्
verses.transliteration: teShAM dashopachArANAM pUrvaM pUjya vinAyakam | sthAnashuddhyAdikaM kR^itvA li~NgaM snAnAlayaM nayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वर्द्धन्या पिण्डिकां लिङ्गं विद्येशकलशैः पुनः । अभिषिच्यासनं पश्चादाधाराद्यं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: varddhanyA piNDikAM li~NgaM vidyeshakalashaiH punaH | abhiShichyAsanaM pashchAdAdhArAdyaM prakalpayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पञ्चकलान्यासं दीप्तं लिङ्गमनुस्मरेत् । आवाहयेत् शिवौ साक्षात् प्राञ्जलिः प्रागुदङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA pa~nchakalAnyAsaM dIptaM li~Ngamanusmaret | AvAhayet shivau sAkShAt prA~njaliH prAguda~NmukhaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वृषाधिराजमारुह्य विमानं वा नभस्तलात् । अलङ्कृतं सहायान्तं देव्या देवमनुस्मरन् । सर्वाभरणशोभाढ्यं सर्वमङ्गलनिःस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: vR^iShAdhirAjamAruhya vimAnaM vA nabhastalAt | ala~NkR^itaM sahAyAntaM devyA devamanusmaran | sarvAbharaNashobhADhyaM sarvama~NgalaniHsvanaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशार्कशक्राद्यैर्देवदानवैः । आनन्दक्लिन्नसर्वाङ्गैर्विन्यस्ताञ्जलिमस्तकैः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviShNumaheshArkashakrAdyairdevadAnavaiH | AnandaklinnasarvA~NgairvinyastA~njalimastakaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवद्भिरेव नृत्यद्भिर्नमद्भिरभितो वृतम् । ततः पञ्चोपचारैश्च कृत्वा पूजां समापयेत्
verses.transliteration: stuvadbhireva nR^ityadbhirnamadbhirabhito vR^itam | tataH pa~nchopachAraishcha kR^itvA pUjAM samApayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नातः परतरः कश्चिद्विधिः पञ्चोपचारकात् । प्रतिष्ठां लिङ्गवत्कुर्यात् प्रतिमास्वपि सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: nAtaH parataraH kashchidvidhiH pa~nchopachArakAt | pratiShThAM li~NgavatkuryAt pratimAsvapi sarvataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षणोद्धारसमये कार्यं नयनमोचनम् । जलाधिवासे शयने शाययेत्तांस्त्वधोमुखीम्
verses.transliteration: lakShaNoddhArasamaye kAryaM nayanamochanam | jalAdhivAse shayane shAyayettAMstvadhomukhIm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भोदशायितां मन्त्रैर्हृदि तां सन्नियोजयेत् । कृतालयां परामाहुः प्रतिष्ठामकृतालयात्
verses.transliteration: kumbhodashAyitAM mantrairhR^idi tAM sanniyojayet | kR^itAlayAM parAmAhuH pratiShThAmakR^itAlayAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तः कृतालयः पश्चात् प्रतिष्ठाविधिमाचरेत् । अशक्तश्चेत्प्रतिष्ठाप्य लिङ्गं बेरमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: shaktaH kR^itAlayaH pashchAt pratiShThAvidhimAcharet | ashaktashchetpratiShThApya li~NgaM beramathApi vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तेरनुगुणं पश्चात् प्रकुर्वीत शिवालयम् । गृहार्चां च पुनर्वक्ष्ये प्रतिष्ठाविधिमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: shakteranuguNaM pashchAt prakurvIta shivAlayam | gR^ihArchAM cha punarvakShye pratiShThAvidhimuttamam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शलाकया काञ्चनया कुङ्कुमादिरसाक्तया । लक्षितं लक्षणं शिल्पशास्त्रेण विलिखेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: shalAkayA kA~nchanayA ku~NkumAdirasAktayA | lakShitaM lakShaNaM shilpashAstreNa vilikhettataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा कनीयसं बेरं लिङ्गं वा लक्षणान्वितम् । अयने चोत्तरे प्राप्ते शुक्लपक्षे शुभे दिने
verses.transliteration: kR^itvA kanIyasaM beraM li~NgaM vA lakShaNAnvitam | ayane chottare prApte shuklapakShe shubhe dine
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वेदीं कृत्वा शुभे देशे तत्राब्जं पूर्ववल्लिखेत् । विकीर्य पत्रपुष्पाद्यैर्मध्ये कुम्भं निधाय च
verses.transliteration: vedIM kR^itvA shubhe deshe tatrAbjaM pUrvavallikhet | vikIrya patrapuShpAdyairmadhye kumbhaM nidhAya cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: परितस्तस्य चतुरः कलशान् दिक्षु विन्यसेत् । पञ्च ब्रह्माणि तद्बीजैस्तेषु पञ्चसु पञ्चभिः
verses.transliteration: paritastasya chaturaH kalashAn dikShu vinyaset | pa~ncha brahmANi tadbIjaisteShu pa~nchasu pa~nchabhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न्यस्य सम्पूज्य मुद्रादि दर्शयित्वाभिरक्ष्य च । विशोध्य लिङ्गं बेरं वा मृत्तोयाद्यैर्यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: nyasya sampUjya mudrAdi darshayitvAbhirakShya cha | vishodhya li~NgaM beraM vA mR^ittoyAdyairyathA purA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयेत्पुष्पसञ्छन्नमुत्तरस्थे वरासने । निधाय पुष्पं शिरसि प्रोक्षयेत् प्रोक्षणीजलैः
verses.transliteration: sthApayetpuShpasa~nChannamuttarasthe varAsane | nidhAya puShpaM shirasi prokShayet prokShaNIjalaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: समभ्यर्च्य पुनः पुष्पैर्जयशब्दादिपूर्वकम् । कुम्भैरीशानविद्यान्तैः स्नापयेन्मूलविद्यया
verses.transliteration: samabhyarchya punaH puShpairjayashabdAdipUrvakam | kumbhairIshAnavidyAntaiH snApayenmUlavidyayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पञ्चकलान्यासं कृत्वा पूजां च पूर्ववत् । नित्यमाराधयेत्तत्र देव्या देवं त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: tataH pa~nchakalAnyAsaM kR^itvA pUjAM cha pUrvavat | nityamArAdhayettatra devyA devaM trilochanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एकमेवाथ वा कुम्भं मूर्तिमन्त्रसमन्वितम् । न्यस्य पद्मान्तरे सर्वं शेषं पूर्ववदाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: ekamevAtha vA kumbhaM mUrtimantrasamanvitam | nyasya padmAntare sarvaM sheShaM pUrvavadAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तोपहतं लिङ्गं विशोध्य स्थापयेत्पुनः । सम्प्रोक्षयेदुपहतं मनागुपहतं यजेत्
verses.transliteration: atyantopahataM li~NgaM vishodhya sthApayetpunaH | samprokShayedupahataM manAgupahataM yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गानि बाणसंज्ञानि स्थापनीयानि वा न वा । तानि पूर्वं शिवेनैव संस्कृतानि यतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: li~NgAni bANasa.nj~nAni sthApanIyAni vA na vA | tAni pUrvaM shivenaiva saMskR^itAni yatastataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमृत्सलिलैर्वाथ पञ्चमृत्सलिलैस्तथा । लिङ्गं पिण्डिकया सार्द्धं पञ्चगव्यैश्च शोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: aShTamR^itsalilairvAtha pa~nchamR^itsalilaistathA | li~NgaM piNDikayA sArddhaM pa~nchagavyaishcha shodhayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शेषाणि स्थापनीयानि यानि दृष्टानि बाणवत् । स्वयमुद्भूतलिङ्गे च दिव्ये चार्षे तथैव च
verses.transliteration: sheShANi sthApanIyAni yAni dR^iShTAni bANavat | svayamudbhUtali~Nge cha divye chArShe tathaiva cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अपीठे पीठमावेश्य कृत्वा सम्प्रोक्षणं विधिम् । यजेत्तत्र शिवं तेषां प्रतिष्ठा न विधीयते
verses.transliteration: apIThe pIThamAveshya kR^itvA samprokShaNaM vidhim | yajettatra shivaM teShAM pratiShThA na vidhIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दग्धं श्लथं क्षताङ्गं च क्षिपेल्लिङ्गं जलाशये । सन्धानयोग्यं सन्धाय प्रतिष्ठाविधिमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: dagdhaM shlathaM kShatA~NgaM cha kShipelli~NgaM jalAshaye | sandhAnayogyaM sandhAya pratiShThAvidhimAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बेराद्वा विकलाल्लिङ्गाद्देवपूजापुरःसरम् । उद्वास्य हृदि सन्धानं त्यागं वा युक्तमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: berAdvA vikalAlli~NgAddevapUjApuraHsaram | udvAsya hR^idi sandhAnaM tyAgaM vA yuktamAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एकाहपूजाविहतौ कुर्याद् द्विगुणमर्चनम् । द्विरात्रे च महापूजां सम्प्रोक्षणमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: ekAhapUjAvihatau kuryAd dviguNamarchanam | dvirAtre cha mahApUjAM samprokShaNamataH param
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मासादूर्ध्वमनेकाहं पूजा यदि विहन्यते । प्रतिष्ठा प्रोच्यते कैश्चित्कैश्चित्सम्प्रोक्षणक्रमः
verses.transliteration: mAsAdUrdhvamanekAhaM pUjA yadi vihanyate | pratiShThA prochyate kaishchitkaishchitsamprokShaNakramaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्रोक्षणे तु लिङ्गादेर्देवमुद्वास्य पूर्ववत् । अष्टपञ्चक्रमेणैव स्नापयित्वा मृदम्भसा
verses.transliteration: samprokShaNe tu li~NgAderdevamudvAsya pUrvavat | aShTapa~nchakrameNaiva snApayitvA mR^idambhasA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गवां रसैश्च संस्नाप्य दर्भतोयैर्विशोध्य च । प्रोक्षयेत्प्रोक्षणीतोयैर्मूलेनाष्टोत्तरं शतम्
verses.transliteration: gavAM rasaishcha saMsnApya darbhatoyairvishodhya cha | prokShayetprokShaNItoyairmUlenAShTottaraM shatam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सपुष्पं सकुशं पाणिं न्यस्य लिङ्गस्य मस्तके । पञ्चवारं जपेन्मूलमष्टोत्तरशतोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sapuShpaM sakushaM pANiM nyasya li~Ngasya mastake | pa~nchavAraM japenmUlamaShTottarashatottaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मूलेन मूर्द्धादिपीठान्तं संस्पृशेदपि । पूजां च महतीं कुर्याद्देवमावाह्य पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: tato mUlena mUrddhAdipIThAntaM saMspR^ishedapi | pUjAM cha mahatIM kuryAddevamAvAhya pUrvavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सवेदिकं समभ्यर्च्य दिव्याद्यं तु जलाशयम् । नीत्वाधिवासयेत्तत्र लिङ्गं पिण्डिकया सह
verses.transliteration: savedikaM samabhyarchya divyAdyaM tu jalAshayam | nItvAdhivAsayettatra li~NgaM piNDikayA saha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अलब्धे स्थापिते लिङ्गे शिवस्थाने जलेऽथ वा । वह्नौ रवौ तथा व्योम्नि भगवन्तं शिवं यजेत्
verses.transliteration: alabdhe sthApite li~Nge shivasthAne jale.atha vA | vahnau ravau tathA vyomni bhagavantaM shivaM yajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अधिवासालये शुद्धे सर्वशोभासमन्विते । सतोरणे सावरणे दर्भमालासमावृते
verses.transliteration: adhivAsAlaye shuddhe sarvashobhAsamanvite | satoraNe sAvaraNe darbhamAlAsamAvR^ite
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दिग्गजाष्टकसम्पन्ने दिक्पालाष्टघटान्विते । अष्टमङ्गलकैर्युक्ते कृतदिक्पालकार्चिते
verses.transliteration: diggajAShTakasampanne dikpAlAShTaghaTAnvite | aShTama~Ngalakairyukte kR^itadikpAlakArchite
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.३७. सप्तत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । योगगतिवर्णनम् । श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । ज्ञाने क्रियायां चर्यायां सारमुद्धृत्य सङ्ग्रहात् । उक्तं भगवता सर्वं श्रुतं श्रुतिसमं मया
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.37\. saptatriMsho.adhyAyaH | yogagativarNanam | shrIkR^iShNa uvAcha | j~nAne kriyAyAM charyAyAM sAramuddhR^itya sa~NgrahAt | uktaM bhagavatA sarvaM shrutaM shrutisamaM mayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विलीनावयवं विश्वं रूपं सम्भाव्यते यतः । अभावयोगः सम्प्रोक्तोऽनाभासाद्वस्तुनः सतः
verses.transliteration: vilInAvayavaM vishvaM rUpaM sambhAvyate yataH | abhAvayogaH samprokto.anAbhAsAdvastunaH sataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्वभाव एवैकश्चिन्त्यते निरुपाधिकः । यथा शैवमनोवृत्तिर्महायोग इहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: shivasvabhAva evaikashchintyate nirupAdhikaH | yathA shaivamanovR^ittirmahAyoga ihochyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टे तथानुश्रविके विरक्तं विषये मनः । यस्य तस्याधिकारोऽस्ति योगे नान्यस्य कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTe tathAnushravike viraktaM viShaye manaH | yasya tasyAdhikAro.asti yoge nAnyasya kasyachit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विषयद्वयदोषाणां गुणानामीश्वरस्य च । दर्शनादेव सततं विरक्तं जायते मनः
verses.transliteration: viShayadvayadoShANAM guNAnAmIshvarasya cha | darshanAdeva satataM viraktaM jAyate manaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाङ्गो वा षडङ्गो वा सर्वयोगः समासतः । यमश्च नियमश्चैव स्वस्तिकाद्यं तथासनम्
verses.transliteration: aShTA~Ngo vA ShaDa~Ngo vA sarvayogaH samAsataH | yamashcha niyamashchaiva svastikAdyaM tathAsanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामः प्रत्याहारो धारणा ध्यानमेव च । समाधिरिति योगाङ्गान्यष्टावुक्तानि सूरिभिः
verses.transliteration: prANAyAmaH pratyAhAro dhAraNA dhyAnameva cha | samAdhiriti yogA~NgAnyaShTAvuktAni sUribhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आसनं प्राणसंरोधः प्रत्याहारोऽथ धारणा । ध्यानं समाधिर्योगस्य षडङ्गानि समासतः
verses.transliteration: AsanaM prANasaMrodhaH pratyAhAro.atha dhAraNA | dhyAnaM samAdhiryogasya ShaDa~NgAni samAsataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पृथग्लक्षणमेतेषां शिवशास्त्रे समीरितम् । शिवागमेषु चान्येषु विशेषात् कामिकादिषु
verses.transliteration: pR^ithaglakShaNameteShAM shivashAstre samIritam | shivAgameShu chAnyeShu visheShAt kAmikAdiShu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: योगशास्त्रेष्वपि तथा पुराणेष्वपि केषु च । अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहः । यम इत्युच्यते सद्भिः पञ्चावयवयोगतः
verses.transliteration: yogashAstreShvapi tathA purANeShvapi keShu cha | ahiMsA satyamasteyaM brahmacharyAparigrahaH | yama ityuchyate sadbhiH pa~nchAvayavayogataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शौचं तुष्टिस्तपश्चैव जपः प्रणिधिरेव च । इति पञ्च प्रभेदः स्यान्नियमः स्वांशभेदतः
verses.transliteration: shauchaM tuShTistapashchaiva japaH praNidhireva cha | iti pa~ncha prabhedaH syAnniyamaH svAMshabhedataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि योगं परमदुर्लभम् । साधिकारं च साङ्गं च सविधिं सप्रयोजनम्
verses.transliteration: idAnIM shrotumichChAmi yogaM paramadurlabham | sAdhikAraM cha sA~NgaM cha savidhiM saprayojanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्तिकं पद्ममध्येन्दुं वीरं योगं प्रसाधितम् । पर्यङ्कं च यथेष्टं च प्रोक्तमासनमष्टधा
verses.transliteration: svastikaM padmamadhyenduM vIraM yogaM prasAdhitam | parya~NkaM cha yatheShTaM cha proktamAsanamaShTadhA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणः स्वदेहजो वायुस्तस्यायामो निरोधनम् । तद्रोचकं पूरकं च कुम्भकं च त्रिधोच्यते
verses.transliteration: prANaH svadehajo vAyustasyAyAmo nirodhanam | tadrochakaM pUrakaM cha kumbhakaM cha tridhochyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नासिकापुटमङ्गुल्या पीड्यैकमपरेण तु । औदरं रेचयेद्वायुं तथायं रेचकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nAsikApuTama~NgulyA pIDyaikamapareNa tu | audaraM rechayedvAyuM tathAyaM rechakaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्येन मरुता देहं दृतिवत्परिपूरयेत् । नासापुटेनापरेण पूरणात्पूरकं मतम्
verses.transliteration: bAhyena marutA dehaM dR^itivatparipUrayet | nAsApuTenApareNa pUraNAtpUrakaM matam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न मुञ्चति न गृह्णाति वायुमन्तर्बहिः स्थितम् । सम्पूर्णं कुम्भवत्तिष्ठेदचलः स तु कुम्भकः
verses.transliteration: na mu~nchati na gR^ihNAti vAyumantarbahiH sthitam | sampUrNaM kumbhavattiShThedachalaH sa tu kumbhakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रेचकाद्यं त्रयमिदं न द्रुतं न विलम्बितम् । तद्यतः क्रमयोगेन त्वभ्यसेद्योगसाधकः
verses.transliteration: rechakAdyaM trayamidaM na drutaM na vilambitam | tadyataH kramayogena tvabhyasedyogasAdhakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रेचकादिषु योऽभ्यासो नाडीशोधनपूर्वकः । स्वेच्छोत्क्रमणपर्यन्तः प्रोक्तो योगानुशासने
verses.transliteration: rechakAdiShu yo.abhyAso nADIshodhanapUrvakaH | svechChotkramaNaparyantaH prokto yogAnushAsane
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यकादिक्रमवशात् प्राणायामनिरोधनम् । तच्चतुर्द्धोपदिष्टं स्यान्मात्रागुणविभागतः
verses.transliteration: kanyakAdikramavashAt prANAyAmanirodhanam | tachchaturddhopadiShTaM syAnmAtrAguNavibhAgataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यकस्तु चतुर्द्धा स्यात्स च द्वादशमात्रकः । मध्यमस्तु द्विरुद्धातश्चतुर्विंशतिमात्रकः
verses.transliteration: kanyakastu chaturddhA syAtsa cha dvAdashamAtrakaH | madhyamastu dviruddhAtashchaturviMshatimAtrakaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमस्तु त्रिरुद्धातः षड्विंशन् मात्रकः परः । स्वेदकम्पादिजनकः प्राणायामस्तदुत्तरः
verses.transliteration: uttamastu triruddhAtaH ShaDviMshan mAtrakaH paraH | svedakampAdijanakaH prANAyAmastaduttaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यस्ति मरणं पूर्वं योगाद्यनुपमर्दतः । सद्यः साधयितुं शक्यं येन स्यान्नात्महा नरः
verses.transliteration: yadyasti maraNaM pUrvaM yogAdyanupamardataH | sadyaH sAdhayituM shakyaM yena syAnnAtmahA naraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दोद्भवरोमाञ्चनेत्राश्रूणां विमोचनम् । जल्पभ्रमणमूर्छाद्यं जायते योगिनः परम्
verses.transliteration: AnandodbhavaromA~nchanetrAshrUNAM vimochanam | jalpabhramaNamUrChAdyaM jAyate yoginaH param
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जानुं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य न द्रुतं न विलम्बितम् । अङ्गुलीस्फोटनं कुर्यात्सा मात्रेति प्रकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: jAnuM pradakShiNIkR^itya na drutaM na vilambitam | a~NgulIsphoTanaM kuryAtsA mAtreti prakIrtitA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मात्रा क्रमेण विज्ञेयाश्चोद्घातक्रमयोगतः । नाडीविशुद्धिपूर्वं तु प्राणायामं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: mAtrA krameNa vij~neyAshchodghAtakramayogataH | nADIvishuddhipUrvaM tu prANAyAmaM samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अगर्भश्च सगर्भश्च प्राणायामो द्विधा स्मृतः । जपं ध्यानं विनागर्भः सगर्भस्तत्समन्वयात्
verses.transliteration: agarbhashcha sagarbhashcha prANAyAmo dvidhA smR^itaH | japaM dhyAnaM vinAgarbhaH sagarbhastatsamanvayAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अगर्भाद्गर्भसंयुक्तः प्राणायामः शताधिकः । तस्मात्सगर्भं कुर्वन्ति योगिनः प्राणसंयमम्
verses.transliteration: agarbhAdgarbhasaMyuktaH prANAyAmaH shatAdhikaH | tasmAtsagarbhaM kurvanti yoginaH prANasaMyamam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणस्य विजयादेव जीयन्ते देहवायवः । प्राणोऽपानः समानश्च ह्युदानो व्यान एव च
verses.transliteration: prANasya vijayAdeva jIyante dehavAyavaH | prANo.apAnaH samAnashcha hyudAno vyAna eva cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नागः कूर्मश्च कृकलो देवदत्तो धनञ्जयः । प्रयाणं कुरुते यस्मात्तस्मात्प्राणोऽभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: nAgaH kUrmashcha kR^ikalo devadatto dhana~njayaH | prayANaM kurute yasmAttasmAtprANo.abhidhIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अवाङ्नयत्यपानाख्यो यदाहारादि भुज्यते । व्यानो व्यान शयत्यङ्गान्यशेषाणि विवर्धयन्
verses.transliteration: avA~NnayatyapAnAkhyo yadAhArAdi bhujyate | vyAno vyAna shayatya~NgAnyasheShANi vivardhayan
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वेजयति मर्माणीत्युदानो वायुरीरितः । समं नयति सर्वाङ्गं समानस्तेन गीयते
verses.transliteration: udvejayati marmANItyudAno vAyurIritaH | samaM nayati sarvA~NgaM samAnastena gIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उद्गारे नाग आख्यातः कूर्म उन्मीलने स्थितः । कृकलः क्षवथौ ज्ञेयो देवदत्तो विजृम्भणे
verses.transliteration: udgAre nAga AkhyAtaH kUrma unmIlane sthitaH | kR^ikalaH kShavathau j~neyo devadatto vijR^imbhaNe
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तच्च तत्कारणं चैव तत्कालकरणानि च । तद्भेदतारतम्यं च वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: tachcha tatkAraNaM chaiva tatkAlakaraNAni cha | tadbhedatAratamyaM cha vaktumarhasi tattvataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न जहाति मृतं चापि सर्वव्यापी धनञ्जयः । क्रमेणाभ्यस्यमानोऽयं प्राणायामः प्रमाणवान्
verses.transliteration: na jahAti mR^itaM chApi sarvavyApI dhana~njayaH | krameNAbhyasyamAno.ayaM prANAyAmaH pramANavAn
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निर्दहत्यखिलं दोषं कर्तुर्देहं च रक्षति । प्राणे तु विजिते सम्यक् तच्चिह्नान्युपलक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: nirdahatyakhilaM doShaM karturdehaM cha rakShati | prANe tu vijite samyak tachchihnAnyupalakShayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विण्मूत्रश्लेष्मणां तावदल्पभावः प्रजायते । बहुभोजनसामर्थ्यं चिरादुच्छ्वासनं तथा
verses.transliteration: viNmUtrashleShmaNAM tAvadalpabhAvaH prajAyate | bahubhojanasAmarthyaM chirAduchChvAsanaM tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लघुत्वं शीघ्रगामित्वमुत्साहः स्वरसौष्ठवम् । सर्वरोगक्षयश्चैव बलं तेजः सुरूपता
verses.transliteration: laghutvaM shIghragAmitvamutsAhaH svarasauShThavam | sarvarogakShayashchaiva balaM tejaH surUpatA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: धृतिर्मेधा युवत्वं च स्थिरता च प्रसन्नता । तपांसि पापक्षयता यज्ञदानव्रतादयः
verses.transliteration: dhR^itirmedhA yuvatvaM cha sthiratA cha prasannatA | tapAMsi pApakShayatA yaj~nadAnavratAdayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामस्य तस्यैते कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् । इन्द्रियाणि प्रसक्तानि यथास्वं विषयेष्विह
verses.transliteration: prANAyAmasya tasyaite kalAM nArhanti ShoDashIm | indriyANi prasaktAni yathAsvaM viShayeShviha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आहत्य यन्निगृह्णाति स प्रत्याहार उच्यते । मनःपूर्वाणीन्द्रियाणि स्वर्गं नरकमेव च
verses.transliteration: Ahatya yannigR^ihNAti sa pratyAhAra uchyate | manaHpUrvANIndriyANi svargaM narakameva cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निगृहीतनिसृष्टानि स्वर्गाय नरकाय च । तस्मात्सुखार्थी मतिमान् ज्ञानवैराग्यमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: nigR^ihItanisR^iShTAni svargAya narakAya cha | tasmAtsukhArthI matimAn j~nAnavairAgyamAsthitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाश्वान्निगृह्याशु स्वात्मनात्मानमुद्धरेत् । धारणा नाम चित्तस्य स्थानबन्धः समासतः
verses.transliteration: indriyAshvAnnigR^ihyAshu svAtmanAtmAnamuddharet | dhAraNA nAma chittasya sthAnabandhaH samAsataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानं च शिव एवैको नान्यद्दोषत्रयं यतः । कालं कं चावधीकृत्य स्थानेऽवस्थापितं मनः
verses.transliteration: sthAnaM cha shiva evaiko nAnyaddoShatrayaM yataH | kAlaM kaM chAvadhIkR^itya sthAne.avasthApitaM manaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । स्थाने पृष्टं त्वया कृष्ण सर्वप्रश्नार्थवेदिना । ततः क्रमेण तत्सर्वं वक्ष्ये शृणु समाहितः
verses.transliteration: upamanyuruvAcha | sthAne pR^iShTaM tvayA kR^iShNa sarvaprashnArthavedinA | tataH krameNa tatsarvaM vakShye shR^iNu samAhitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न तु प्रच्यवते लक्ष्याद्धारणा स्यान्न चान्यथा । मनसः प्रथमं स्थैर्यं धारणातः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: na tu prachyavate lakShyAddhAraNA syAnna chAnyathA | manasaH prathamaM sthairyaM dhAraNAtaH prajAyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्धीरं मनः कुर्याद्धारणाभ्यासयोगतः । ध्यै चिन्तायां स्मृतो धातुः शिवचिन्ता मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: tasmAddhIraM manaH kuryAddhAraNAbhyAsayogataH | dhyai chintAyAM smR^ito dhAtuH shivachintA muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अव्याक्षिप्तेन मनसा ध्यानं नाम तदुच्यते । ध्येयावस्थितचित्तस्य सदृशः प्रत्ययश्च यः
verses.transliteration: avyAkShiptena manasA dhyAnaM nAma taduchyate | dhyeyAvasthitachittasya sadR^ishaH pratyayashcha yaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्ययान्तरनिर्मुक्तः प्रवाहो ध्यानमुच्यते । सर्वमन्यत्परित्यज्य शिव एव शिवङ्करः
verses.transliteration: pratyayAntaranirmuktaH pravAho dhyAnamuchyate | sarvamanyatparityajya shiva eva shiva~NkaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: परो ध्येयोऽधिदेवेशः समाप्ताथर्वणी श्रुतिः । तथा शिवा परा ध्येया सर्वभूतगतौ शिवौ
verses.transliteration: paro dhyeyo.adhideveshaH samAptAtharvaNI shrutiH | tathA shivA parA dhyeyA sarvabhUtagatau shivau
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तौ श्रुतौ स्मृतिशास्त्रेभ्यः सर्वगौ सर्वदोदितौ । सर्वज्ञौ सततं ध्येयौ नानारूपविभेदतः
verses.transliteration: tau shrutau smR^itishAstrebhyaH sarvagau sarvadoditau | sarvaj~nau satataM dhyeyau nAnArUpavibhedataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तिः प्रत्ययः पूर्वः प्रत्ययश्चाणिमादिकम् । इत्येतद् द्विविधं ज्ञेयं ध्यानस्यास्य प्रयोजनम्
verses.transliteration: vimuktiH pratyayaH pUrvaH pratyayashchANimAdikam | ityetad dvividhaM j~neyaM dhyAnasyAsya prayojanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ध्याता ध्यानं तथा ध्येयं यच्च ध्यानप्रयोजनम् । एतच्चतुष्टयं ज्ञात्वा योगं युञ्जीत योगवित्
verses.transliteration: dhyAtA dhyAnaM tathA dhyeyaM yachcha dhyAnaprayojanam | etachchatuShTayaM j~nAtvA yogaM yu~njIta yogavit
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानवैराग्यसम्पन्नः श्रद्दधानः क्षमान्वितः । निर्ममश्च सदोत्साही ध्यातेत्थं पुरुषः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnavairAgyasampannaH shraddadhAnaH kShamAnvitaH | nirmamashcha sadotsAhI dhyAtetthaM puruShaH smR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जपाच्छ्रान्तः पुनर्ध्यायेद्ध्यानाच्छ्रान्तः पुनर्जपेत् । जपध्यनाभियुक्तस्य क्षिप्रं योगः प्रसिद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: japAchChrAntaH punardhyAyeddhyAnAchChrAntaH punarjapet | japadhyanAbhiyuktasya kShipraM yogaH prasiddhyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निरुद्धवृत्त्यन्तरस्य शिवे चित्तस्य निश्चला । या वृत्तिः सा समासेन योगः स खलु पञ्चधा
verses.transliteration: niruddhavR^ittyantarasya shive chittasya nishchalA | yA vR^ittiH sA samAsena yogaH sa khalu pa~nchadhA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: धारणा द्वादशायामा ध्यानं द्वादशधारणम् । ध्यानद्वादशकं यावत्समाधिरभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: dhAraNA dvAdashAyAmA dhyAnaM dvAdashadhAraNam | dhyAnadvAdashakaM yAvatsamAdhirabhidhIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: समाधिर्नाम योगाङ्गमन्तिमं परिकीर्तितम् । समाधिना च सर्वत्र प्रज्ञालोकः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: samAdhirnAma yogA~NgamantimaM parikIrtitam | samAdhinA cha sarvatra praj~nAlokaH pravartate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थमात्रनिर्भासं स्तिमितोदधिवत्स्थितम् । स्वरूपशून्यवद्भानं समाधिरभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: yadarthamAtranirbhAsaM stimitodadhivatsthitam | svarUpashUnyavadbhAnaM samAdhirabhidhIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ध्येये मनः समावेश्य पश्येदपि च सुस्थिरम् । निर्वाणानलवद्योगी समाधिस्थः प्रगीयते
verses.transliteration: dhyeye manaH samAveshya pashyedapi cha susthiram | nirvANAnalavadyogI samAdhisthaH pragIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न शृणोति न चाघ्राति न जल्पति न पश्यति । न च स्पर्शं विजानाति न सङ्कल्पयते मनः
verses.transliteration: na shR^iNoti na chAghrAti na jalpati na pashyati | na cha sparshaM vijAnAti na sa~Nkalpayate manaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न वाभिमन्यते किञ्चिद् बध्यते न च काष्ठवत् । एवं शिवे विलीनात्मा समाधिस्थ इहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: na vAbhimanyate ki~nchid badhyate na cha kAShThavat | evaM shive vilInAtmA samAdhistha ihochyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथा दीपो निवातस्थः स्पन्दते न कदाचन । तथा समाधिनिष्ठोऽपि तस्मान्न विचलेत्सुधीः
verses.transliteration: yathA dIpo nivAtasthaH spandate na kadAchana | tathA samAdhiniShTho.api tasmAnna vichaletsudhIH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एवमभ्यसतश्चारं योगिनो योगमुत्तमम् । तदन्तराया नश्यन्ति विज्ञाः सर्वे शनैःशनैः
verses.transliteration: evamabhyasatashchAraM yogino yogamuttamam | tadantarAyA nashyanti vij~nAH sarve shanaiHshanaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रयोगः स्पर्शयोगो भावयोगस्तथापरः । अभावयोगः सर्वेभ्यो महायोगः परो मतः
verses.transliteration: mantrayogaH sparshayogo bhAvayogastathAparaH | abhAvayogaH sarvebhyo mahAyogaH paro mataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्राभ्यासवशेनैव मन्त्रवाच्यार्थगोचरः । अव्याक्षेपा मनोवृत्तिर्मन्त्रयोग उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: mantrAbhyAsavashenaiva mantravAchyArthagocharaH | avyAkShepA manovR^ittirmantrayoga udAhR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायाममुखा सैव स्पर्शेयोगोऽभिधीयते । स मन्त्रस्पर्शनिर्मुक्तो भावयोगः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: prANAyAmamukhA saiva sparsheyogo.abhidhIyate | sa mantrasparshanirmukto bhAvayogaH prakIrtitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.३८. अष्टत्रिंशोऽध्यायः । योगगतौ विघ्नोत्पत्तिवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । आलस्यं व्याधयस्तीव्राः प्रमादः स्थानसंशयः । अनवस्थितचित्तत्वमश्रद्धा भ्रान्तिदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.38\. aShTatriMsho.adhyAyaH | yogagatau vighnotpattivarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | AlasyaM vyAdhayastIvrAH pramAdaH sthAnasaMshayaH | anavasthitachittatvamashraddhA bhrAntidarshanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिभा श्रवणं वार्ता दर्शनास्वादवेदनाः । उपसर्गाः षडित्येते व्यये योगस्य सिद्धयः
verses.transliteration: pratibhA shravaNaM vArtA darshanAsvAdavedanAH | upasargAH ShaDityete vyaye yogasya siddhayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मे व्यवहितेऽतीते विप्रकृष्टे त्वनागते । प्रतिभा कथ्यते योऽर्थे प्रतिभासो यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: sUkShme vyavahite.atIte viprakR^iShTe tvanAgate | pratibhA kathyate yo.arthe pratibhAso yathAtatham
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रवणं सर्वशब्दानां श्रवणे चाप्रयत्नतः । वार्त्ता वार्त्तासु विज्ञानं सर्वेषामेव देहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: shravaNaM sarvashabdAnAM shravaNe chAprayatnataH | vArttA vArttAsu vij~nAnaM sarveShAmeva dehinAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनं नाम दिव्यानां दर्शनं चाप्रयत्नतः । तथास्वादश्च दिव्येषु रसेष्वास्वाद उच्यते
verses.transliteration: darshanaM nAma divyAnAM darshanaM chAprayatnataH | tathAsvAdashcha divyeShu raseShvAsvAda uchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्शनाधिगमस्तद्वद् वेदना नाम विश्रुता । गन्धादीनां च दिव्यानामाब्रह्मभुवनाधिपाः
verses.transliteration: sparshanAdhigamastadvad vedanA nAma vishrutA | gandhAdInAM cha divyAnAmAbrahmabhuvanAdhipAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तिष्ठन्ते च रत्नानि प्रयच्छन्ति बहूनि च । स्वच्छन्दमधुरा वाणी विविधा स्यात्प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: santiShThante cha ratnAni prayachChanti bahUni cha | svachChandamadhurA vANI vividhA syAtpravartate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रसायनानि सर्वाणि दिव्याश्चौषधयस्तथा । सिध्यन्ति प्रणिपत्यैनं दिशन्ति सुरयोषितः
verses.transliteration: rasAyanAni sarvANi divyAshchauShadhayastathA | sidhyanti praNipatyainaM dishanti surayoShitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: योगसिद्ध्यैकदेशेऽपि दृष्टे मोक्षे भवेन्मतिः । दृष्टमेतन्मया यद्वत् तद्वन्मोक्षो भवेदिति
verses.transliteration: yogasiddhyaikadeshe.api dR^iShTe mokShe bhavenmatiH | dR^iShTametanmayA yadvat tadvanmokSho bhavediti
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृशता स्थूलता बाल्यं वार्द्धक्यं चैव यौवनम् । नानाजातिस्वरूपं च चतुर्णां देहधारणम्
verses.transliteration: kR^ishatA sthUlatA bAlyaM vArddhakyaM chaiva yauvanam | nAnAjAtisvarUpaM cha chaturNAM dehadhAraNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवांशं विना नित्यं सुरभिर्गन्धसङ्ग्रहः । एवमष्टगुणं प्राहुः पैशाचं पार्थिवं पदम्
verses.transliteration: pArthivAMshaM vinA nityaM surabhirgandhasa~NgrahaH | evamaShTaguNaM prAhuH paishAchaM pArthivaM padam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखानि दौर्मनस्यं च विषयेषु च लोलता । दशैते युञ्जतां पुंसामन्तरायाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: duHkhAni daurmanasyaM cha viShayeShu cha lolatA | dashaite yu~njatAM puMsAmantarAyAH prakIrtitAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जले निवसनं चैव भूम्यामेवं विनिर्गमः । इच्छेच्छक्तः स्वयं पातुं समुद्रमपि नातुरः
verses.transliteration: jale nivasanaM chaiva bhUmyAmevaM vinirgamaH | ichChechChaktaH svayaM pAtuM samudramapi nAturaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रेच्छति जगत्यस्मिंस्तत्रैव जलदर्शनम् । विना कुम्भादिकं पाणौ जलसञ्चयधारणम्
verses.transliteration: yatrechChati jagatyasmiMstatraiva jaladarshanam | vinA kumbhAdikaM pANau jalasa~nchayadhAraNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वस्तु विरसञ्चापि भोक्तुमिच्छति तत्क्षणात् । रसादिकं भवेच्चान्यत् त्रयाणां देहधारणम्
verses.transliteration: yadvastu virasa~nchApi bhoktumichChati tatkShaNAt | rasAdikaM bhavechchAnyat trayANAM dehadhAraNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निर्व्रणत्वं शरीरस्य पार्थिवैश्च समन्वितम् । तदिदं षोडशगुणमाप्यमैश्वर्यमद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: nirvraNatvaM sharIrasya pArthivaishcha samanvitam | tadidaM ShoDashaguNamApyamaishvaryamadbhutam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरादग्निनिर्माणं तत्तापभयवर्ज्जनम् । शक्तिर्जगदिदं दग्धुं यदीच्छेदप्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: sharIrAdagninirmANaM tattApabhayavarjjanam | shaktirjagadidaM dagdhuM yadIchChedaprayatnataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापनं वानलस्याऽप्सु पाणौ पावकधारणम् । दग्धे सर्गे यथापूर्वं मुखे चान्नादिपाचनम् । द्वाभ्यां देहविनिर्माणमाप्यैश्वर्यसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: sthApanaM vAnalasyA.apsu pANau pAvakadhAraNam | dagdhe sarge yathApUrvaM mukhe chAnnAdipAchanam | dvAbhyAM dehavinirmANamApyaishvaryasamanvitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्चतुर्विंशतिधा तैजसं परिचक्षते । मनोजवत्वं भूतानां क्षणादन्तः प्रवेशनम्
verses.transliteration: etachchaturviMshatidhA taijasaM parichakShate | manojavatvaM bhUtAnAM kShaNAdantaH praveshanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतादिमहाभारधारणं चाप्रयत्नतः । गुरुत्वं च लघुत्वं च पाणावनिलधारणम्
verses.transliteration: parvatAdimahAbhAradhAraNaM chAprayatnataH | gurutvaM cha laghutvaM cha pANAvaniladhAraNam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुल्यग्रनिपाताद्यैर्भूमेरपि च कम्पनम् । एकेन देहनिष्पत्तिर्युक्तं भोगैश्च तेजसैः
verses.transliteration: a~NgulyagranipAtAdyairbhUmerapi cha kampanam | ekena dehaniShpattiryuktaM bhogaishcha tejasaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: द्वात्रिंशद्गुणमैश्वर्यं मारुतं कवयो विदुः । छायाहीनविनिष्पत्तिरिन्द्रियाणामदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: dvAtriMshadguNamaishvaryaM mArutaM kavayo viduH | ChAyAhInaviniShpattirindriyANAmadarshanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आलस्यमलसत्त्वं तु योगिनां देहचेतसोः । धातुवैषम्यजा दोषा व्याधयः कर्मदोषजाः
verses.transliteration: AlasyamalasattvaM tu yoginAM dehachetasoH | dhAtuvaiShamyajA doShA vyAdhayaH karmadoShajAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: खेचरत्वं यथाकाममिन्द्रियार्थसमन्वयः । आकाशलङ्घनं चैव स्वदेहे तन्निवेशनम्
verses.transliteration: khecharatvaM yathAkAmamindriyArthasamanvayaH | AkAshala~NghanaM chaiva svadehe tanniveshanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशपिण्डीकरणमशरीरत्वमेव च । अनिलैश्वर्यसंयुक्तं चत्वारिंशद्गुणं महत्
verses.transliteration: AkAshapiNDIkaraNamasharIratvameva cha | anilaishvaryasaMyuktaM chatvAriMshadguNaM mahat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्रमैश्वर्यमाख्यातमाम्बरं तत्प्रचक्षते । यथाकामोपलब्धिश्च यथाकामविनिर्गमः
verses.transliteration: aindramaishvaryamAkhyAtamAmbaraM tatprachakShate | yathAkAmopalabdhishcha yathAkAmavinirgamaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्याभिभवश्चैव सर्वगुह्यार्थदर्शनम् । कर्मानुरूपनिर्माणं वशित्वं प्रियदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasyAbhibhavashchaiva sarvaguhyArthadarshanam | karmAnurUpanirmANaM vashitvaM priyadarshanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: संसारदर्शनं चैव भोगैरैन्द्रैः समन्वितम् । एतच्चान्द्रमसैश्वर्यं मानसं गुणतोऽधिकम्
verses.transliteration: saMsAradarshanaM chaiva bhogairaindraiH samanvitam | etachchAndramasaishvaryaM mAnasaM guNato.adhikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: छेदनं ताडनं चैव बन्धनं मोचनं तथा । ग्रहणं सर्वभूतानां संसारवशवर्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration: ChedanaM tADanaM chaiva bandhanaM mochanaM tathA | grahaNaM sarvabhUtAnAM saMsAravashavartinAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादश्चापि सर्वेषां मृत्युकालजयस्तथा । आभिमानिकमैश्वर्यं प्राजापत्यं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: prasAdashchApi sarveShAM mR^ityukAlajayastathA | AbhimAnikamaishvaryaM prAjApatyaM prachakShate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्चान्द्रमसैर्भोगैः षट्पञ्चाशद्गुणं महत् । सर्गः सङ्कल्पमात्रेण त्राणं संहरणं तथा
verses.transliteration: etachchAndramasairbhogaiH ShaTpa~nchAshadguNaM mahat | sargaH sa~NkalpamAtreNa trANaM saMharaNaM tathA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाधिकारश्च सर्वेषां भूतचित्तप्रवर्तनम् । असादृश्यं च सर्वस्य निर्माणं जगतः पृथक्
verses.transliteration: svAdhikArashcha sarveShAM bhUtachittapravartanam | asAdR^ishyaM cha sarvasya nirmANaM jagataH pR^ithak
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शुभाशुभस्य करणं प्राजापत्यैश्च संयुतम् । चतुःषष्टिगुणं ब्राह्ममैश्वर्यं च प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: shubhAshubhasya karaNaM prAjApatyaishcha saMyutam | chatuHShaShTiguNaM brAhmamaishvaryaM cha prachakShate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमादो नाम योगस्य साधना नाम भावना । इदं वेत्युभयाक्रान्तं विज्ञानं स्थानसंशयः
verses.transliteration: pramAdo nAma yogasya sAdhanA nAma bhAvanA | idaM vetyubhayAkrAntaM vij~nAnaM sthAnasaMshayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बौद्धादस्मात्परं गौणमैश्वर्यं प्राकृतं विदुः । वैष्णवं तत्समाख्यातं तस्यैव भुवनस्थितिः । ब्रह्मणा तत्पदं सर्वं वक्तुमन्यैर्न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: bauddhAdasmAtparaM gauNamaishvaryaM prAkR^itaM viduH | vaiShNavaM tatsamAkhyAtaM tasyaiva bhuvanasthitiH | brahmaNA tatpadaM sarvaM vaktumanyairna shakyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पौरुषं च गौणं च गाणेशं पदमैश्वरम् । विष्णुना तत्पदं किञ्चिज्ज्ञातुमन्यैर्न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: tatpauruShaM cha gauNaM cha gANeshaM padamaishvaram | viShNunA tatpadaM ki~nchijj~nAtumanyairna shakyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञानसिद्धयश्चैव सर्वा एवौपसर्गिकाः । निरोद्धव्याः प्रयत्नेन वैराग्येण परेण तु
verses.transliteration: vij~nAnasiddhayashchaiva sarvA evaupasargikAH | niroddhavyAH prayatnena vairAgyeNa pareNa tu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिभासेष्वशुद्धेषु गुणेष्वासक्तचेतसः । न सिध्येत्परमैश्वर्यमभयं सार्वकामिकम्
verses.transliteration: pratibhAseShvashuddheShu guNeShvAsaktachetasaH | na sidhyetparamaishvaryamabhayaM sArvakAmikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्गुणांश्च भोगांश्च देवासुरमहीभृताम् । तृणवद्यस्त्यजेत्तस्य योगसिद्धिः परा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAdguNAMshcha bhogAMshcha devAsuramahIbhR^itAm | tR^iNavadyastyajettasya yogasiddhiH parA bhavet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथवानुग्रहेच्छायां जगतो विचरेन्मुनिः । यथाकामं गुणान्भोगान्भुक्त्वा मुक्तिं प्रयास्यति
verses.transliteration: athavAnugrahechChAyAM jagato vicharenmuniH | yathAkAmaM guNAnbhogAnbhuktvA muktiM prayAsyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रयोगं योगस्य वक्ष्ये शृणु समाहितः । शुभे काले शुभे देशे शिवक्षेत्रादिके पुनः । विजने जन्तुरहिते निःशब्दे बाधवर्जिते
verses.transliteration: atha prayogaM yogasya vakShye shR^iNu samAhitaH | shubhe kAle shubhe deshe shivakShetrAdike punaH | vijane janturahite niHshabde bAdhavarjite
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रलिप्ते स्थले सौम्ये गन्धधूपादिवासिते । मुक्तपुष्पसमाकीर्णे वितानादिविचित्रिते
verses.transliteration: supralipte sthale saumye gandhadhUpAdivAsite | muktapuShpasamAkIrNe vitAnAdivichitrite
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कुशपुष्पसमित्तोयफलमूलसमन्विते । नाग्न्यभ्याशे जलाभ्याशे शुष्कपर्णचयेऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: kushapuShpasamittoyaphalamUlasamanvite | nAgnyabhyAshe jalAbhyAshe shuShkaparNachaye.api vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न दंशमशकाकीर्णे सर्पश्वापदसङ्कुले । न च दुष्टमृगाकीर्णे न भये दुर्जनावृते
verses.transliteration: na daMshamashakAkIrNe sarpashvApadasa~Nkule | na cha duShTamR^igAkIrNe na bhaye durjanAvR^ite
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रतिष्ठा हि मनसस्त्वनवस्थितिरुच्यते । अश्रद्धा भावरहिता वृत्तिर्वै योगवर्त्मनि
verses.transliteration: apratiShThA hi manasastvanavasthitiruchyate | ashraddhA bhAvarahitA vR^ittirvai yogavartmani
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्मशाने चैत्यवल्मीके जीर्णागारे चतुष्पथे । नदीनदसमुद्राणां तीरे रथ्यान्तरेऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: shmashAne chaityavalmIke jIrNAgAre chatuShpathe | nadInadasamudrANAM tIre rathyAntare.api vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न जीर्णोद्यानगोष्ठादौ नानिष्टे न च निन्दिते । नाजीर्णाम्लरसोद्गारे न च विण्मूत्रदूषिते
verses.transliteration: na jIrNodyAnagoShThAdau nAniShTe na cha nindite | nAjIrNAmlarasodgAre na cha viNmUtradUShite
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: न च्छर्द्यामातिसारे वा नातिभुक्तौ श्रमान्विते । न चातिचिन्ताकुलितो न चातिक्षुत्पिपासितः
verses.transliteration: na chChardyAmAtisAre vA nAtibhuktau shramAnvite | na chAtichintAkulito na chAtikShutpipAsitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नापि स्वगुरुकर्मादौ प्रसक्तो योगमाचरेत् । युक्ताहारविहारश्च युक्तचेष्टश्च कर्मसु
verses.transliteration: nApi svagurukarmAdau prasakto yogamAcharet | yuktAhAravihArashcha yuktacheShTashcha karmasu
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: युक्तनिद्राप्रबोधश्च सर्वायासविवर्जितः । आसनं मृदुलं रम्यं विपुलं सुसमं शुचि
verses.transliteration: yuktanidrAprabodhashcha sarvAyAsavivarjitaH | AsanaM mR^idulaM ramyaM vipulaM susamaM shuchi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मकस्वस्तिकादीनामभ्यसेदासनेषु च । अभिवन्द्य स्वगुर्वन्तानभिवाद्याननुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: padmakasvastikAdInAmabhyasedAsaneShu cha | abhivandya svagurvantAnabhivAdyAnanukramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऋजुग्रीवशिरोवक्षा नातिष्ठेच्छ्लिष्टलोचनः । किञ्चिदुन्नामितशिरा दन्तैर्दन्तान्न संस्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: R^ijugrIvashirovakShA nAtiShThechChliShTalochanaH | ki~nchidunnAmitashirA dantairdantAnna saMspR^ishet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दन्ताग्रसंस्थितां जिह्वामचलां सन्निवेश्य च । पार्ष्णिभ्यां वृषणौ रक्षंस्तथा प्रजननं पुनः
verses.transliteration: dantAgrasaMsthitAM jihvAmachalAM sanniveshya cha | pArShNibhyAM vR^iShaNau rakShaMstathA prajananaM punaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्वोरुपरि संस्थाप्य बाहू तिर्यगयत्नतः । दक्षिणं करपृष्ठं तु न्यस्य वामतलोपरि
verses.transliteration: Urvorupari saMsthApya bAhU tiryagayatnataH | dakShiNaM karapR^iShThaM tu nyasya vAmatalopari
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उन्नाम्य शनकैः पृष्ठमुरो विष्टभ्य चाग्रतः । सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्
verses.transliteration: unnAmya shanakaiH pR^iShThamuro viShTabhya chAgrataH | samprekShya nAsikAgraM svaM dishashchAnavalokayan
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विपर्यस्ता मतिर्या सा भ्रान्तिरित्यभिधीयते । दुःखमज्ञानजं पुंसां चित्तस्याध्यात्मिकं विदुः
verses.transliteration: viparyastA matiryA sA bhrAntirityabhidhIyate | duHkhamaj~nAnajaM puMsAM chittasyAdhyAtmikaM viduH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सम्भृतप्राणसञ्चारः पाषाण इव निश्चलः । स्वदेहायतनस्यान्तर्विचिन्त्य शिवमम्बया
verses.transliteration: sambhR^itaprANasa~nchAraH pAShANa iva nishchalaH | svadehAyatanasyAntarvichintya shivamambayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हृत्पद्मपीठिकामध्ये ध्यानयज्ञेन पूजयेत् । मूले नासाग्रतो नाभौ कण्ठे वा तालुरन्ध्रयोः
verses.transliteration: hR^itpadmapIThikAmadhye dhyAnayaj~nena pUjayet | mUle nAsAgrato nAbhau kaNThe vA tAlurandhrayoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूमध्ये द्वारदेशे वा ललाटे मूर्ध्नि वा स्मरेत् । परिकल्प्य यथान्यायं शिवयोः परमासनम्
verses.transliteration: bhrUmadhye dvAradeshe vA lalATe mUrdhni vA smaret | parikalpya yathAnyAyaM shivayoH paramAsanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सावरणं वापि निरावरणमेव वा । द्विदले षोडशारे वा द्वादशारे यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: tatra sAvaraNaM vApi nirAvaraNameva vA | dvidale ShoDashAre vA dvAdashAre yathAvidhi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दशारे वा षडस्रे वा चतुरस्रे शिवं स्मरेत् । भ्रुवोरन्तरतः पद्मं द्विदलं तडिदुज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: dashAre vA ShaDasre vA chaturasre shivaM smaret | bhruvorantarataH padmaM dvidalaM taDidujjvalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूमध्यस्थारविन्दस्य क्रमाद्वै दक्षिणोत्तरे । विद्युत्समानवर्णे च पर्णे वर्णावसानके
verses.transliteration: bhrUmadhyasthAravindasya kramAdvai dakShiNottare | vidyutsamAnavarNe cha parNe varNAvasAnake
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: षोडशारस्य पत्राणि स्वराः षोडश तानि वै । पूर्वादीनि क्रमादेतत्पद्मं कन्दस्य मूलतः
verses.transliteration: ShoDashArasya patrANi svarAH ShoDasha tAni vai | pUrvAdIni kramAdetatpadmaM kandasya mUlataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ककारादिठकारान्ता वर्णाः पर्णान्यनुक्रमात् । भानुवर्णस्य पद्मस्य ध्येयं तधृदयान्तरे
verses.transliteration: kakArAdiThakArAntA varNAH parNAnyanukramAt | bhAnuvarNasya padmasya dhyeyaM tadhR^idayAntare
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाः पर्णानि पक्षस्य नाभेरुपरि पृष्ठतः । गोक्षीरधवलस्योक्ता डादिफान्ता यथाक्रमम् । अधो दलस्याम्बुजस्य एतस्य च दलानि षट्
verses.transliteration: varNAH parNAni pakShasya nAbherupari pR^iShThataH | gokShIradhavalasyoktA DAdiphAntA yathAkramam | adho dalasyAmbujasya etasya cha dalAni ShaT
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विधूमाङ्गारवर्णस्य वर्णा वाद्याश्च लान्तिमाः । मूलाधारारविन्दस्य हेमाभस्य यथाक्रमम् । वकारादिसकारान्ता वर्णाः पर्णमयाः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: vidhUmA~NgAravarNasya varNA vAdyAshcha lAntimAH | mUlAdhArAravindasya hemAbhasya yathAkramam | vakArAdisakArAntA varNAH parNamayAH sthitAH
