verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आधिभौतिकमङ्गोत्थं यच्च दुःखं पुरा कृतैः । आधिदैविकमाख्यातमशन्यस्त्रविषादिकम्
verses.transliteration: Adhibhautikama~NgotthaM yachcha duHkhaM purA kR^itaiH | AdhidaivikamAkhyAtamashanyastraviShAdikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एतेष्वथारविन्देषु यत्रैवाभिरतं मनः । तत्रैव देवं देवीं च चिन्तयेद्धीरया धिया
verses.transliteration: eteShvathAravindeShu yatraivAbhirataM manaH | tatraiva devaM devIM cha chintayeddhIrayA dhiyA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठमात्रममलं दीप्यमानं समन्ततः । शुद्धदीपशिखाकारं स्वशक्त्या पूर्णमण्डितम्
verses.transliteration: a~NguShThamAtramamalaM dIpyamAnaM samantataH | shuddhadIpashikhAkAraM svashaktyA pUrNamaNDitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इन्दुरेखासमाकारं तारारूपमथापि वा । नीवारशूकसदृशं बिससुत्राभमेव वा
verses.transliteration: indurekhAsamAkAraM tArArUpamathApi vA | nIvArashUkasadR^ishaM bisasutrAbhameva vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कदम्बगोलकाकारं तुषारकणिकोपमम् । क्षित्यादितत्त्वविजयं ध्याता यद्यपि वाञ्छति
verses.transliteration: kadambagolakAkAraM tuShArakaNikopamam | kShityAditattvavijayaM dhyAtA yadyapi vA~nChati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तत्तत्त्वाधिपामेव मूर्तिं स्थूलां विचिन्तयेत् । सदाशिवान्ता ब्रह्माद्या भवाद्याश्चाष्टमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: tattattattvAdhipAmeva mUrtiM sthUlAM vichintayet | sadAshivAntA brahmAdyA bhavAdyAshchAShTamUrtayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य मूर्तयः स्थूलाः शिवशास्त्रे विनिश्चिताः । घोरा मिश्राः प्रशान्ताश्च मूर्तयस्ता मुनीश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: shivasya mUrtayaH sthUlAH shivashAstre vinishchitAH | ghorA mishrAH prashAntAshcha mUrtayastA munIshvaraiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: फलाभिलाषरहितैश्चिन्त्याश्चिन्ताविशारदैः । घोराश्चेच्चिन्तिताः कुर्युः पापरोगपरिक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: phalAbhilASharahitaishchintyAshchintAvishAradaiH | ghorAshchechchintitAH kuryuH pAparogaparikShayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चिरेण मिश्रे सौम्ये तु न सद्यो न चिरादपि । सौम्ये मुक्तिर्विशेषेण शान्तिः प्रज्ञा प्रसिध्यति
verses.transliteration: chireNa mishre saumye tu na sadyo na chirAdapi | saumye muktirvisheSheNa shAntiH praj~nA prasidhyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सिध्यन्ति सिद्धयश्चात्र क्रमशो नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: sidhyanti siddhayashchAtra kramasho nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छाविघातजं क्षोभं दौर्मनस्यं प्रचक्षते । विषयेषु विचित्रेषु विभ्रमस्तत्र लोलता
verses.transliteration: ichChAvighAtajaM kShobhaM daurmanasyaM prachakShate | viShayeShu vichitreShu vibhramastatra lolatA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तेष्वेतेषु विघ्नेषु योगासक्तस्य योगिनः । उपसर्गाः प्रवर्तन्ते दिव्यास्ते सिद्धिसूचकाः
verses.transliteration: shAnteShveteShu vighneShu yogAsaktasya yoginaH | upasargAH pravartante divyAste siddhisUchakAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.३९. एकोनचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । शैवयोगवर्णनम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । श्रीकण्ठनाथं स्मरतां सद्यः सर्वार्थसिद्धयः । प्रसिध्यन्तीति मत्वैके तं वै ध्यायन्ति योगिनः
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.39\. ekonachatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | shaivayogavarNanam | upamanyuruvAcha | shrIkaNThanAthaM smaratAM sadyaH sarvArthasiddhayaH | prasidhyantIti matvaike taM vai dhyAyanti yoginaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ते निर्विषयं कुर्यान्निर्बीजं सर्वसिद्धये । प्राणायामेन सिध्यन्ति देव्याः शान्त्यादयः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ante nirviShayaM kuryAnnirbIjaM sarvasiddhaye | prANAyAmena sidhyanti devyAH shAntyAdayaH kramAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तिः प्रशान्तिर्दीप्तिश्च प्रसादश्च ततः परम् । शमः सर्वापदां चैव शान्तिरित्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: shAntiH prashAntirdIptishcha prasAdashcha tataH param | shamaH sarvApadAM chaiva shAntirityabhidhIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तमसोऽन्तर्बहिर्नाशः प्रशान्तिः परिगीयते । बहिरन्तःप्रकाशो यो दीप्तिरित्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: tamaso.antarbahirnAshaH prashAntiH parigIyate | bahirantaHprakAsho yo dIptirityabhidhIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्थता या तु सा बुद्धेः प्रसादः परिकीर्तितः । कारणानि च सर्वाणि सबाह्याभ्यन्तराणि च
verses.transliteration: svasthatA yA tu sA buddheH prasAdaH parikIrtitaH | kAraNAni cha sarvANi sabAhyAbhyantarANi cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धेः प्रसादतः क्षिप्रं प्रसन्नानि भवन्त्युत । ध्याता ध्यानं तथा ध्येयं यद्वा ध्यानप्रयोजनम् । एतच्चतुष्टयं ज्ञात्वा ध्याता ध्यानं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: buddheH prasAdataH kShipraM prasannAni bhavantyuta | dhyAtA dhyAnaM tathA dhyeyaM yadvA dhyAnaprayojanam | etachchatuShTayaM j~nAtvA dhyAtA dhyAnaM samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानवैराग्यसम्पन्नो नित्यमव्यग्रमानसः । श्रद्दधानः प्रसन्नात्मा ध्याता सद्भिरुदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: j~nAnavairAgyasampanno nityamavyagramAnasaH | shraddadhAnaH prasannAtmA dhyAtA sadbhirudAhR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यै चिन्तायां स्मृतो धातुः शिवचिन्ता मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: dhyai chintAyAM smR^ito dhAtuH shivachintA muhurmuhuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: योगाभ्यासस्तथाल्पोऽपि यथा पापं विनाशयेत् । ध्यायतः क्षणमात्रं वा श्रद्धया परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yogAbhyAsastathAlpo.api yathA pApaM vinAshayet | dhyAyataH kShaNamAtraM vA shraddhayA parameshvaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अव्याक्षिप्तेन मनसा ध्यानमित्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: avyAkShiptena manasA dhyAnamityabhidhIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिप्रवाहरूपस्य ध्यानस्यास्यावलम्बनम् । ध्येयमित्युच्यते सद्भिस्तच्च साम्बः स्वयं शिवः
verses.transliteration: buddhipravAharUpasya dhyAnasyAsyAvalambanam | dhyeyamityuchyate sadbhistachcha sAmbaH svayaM shivaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्यर्थं मनसः केचित्स्थूलध्यानं प्रकुर्वते । स्थूले तु निश्चलं चेतो भवेत्सूक्ष्मे तु तत्स्थिरम्
verses.transliteration: sthityarthaM manasaH kechitsthUladhyAnaM prakurvate | sthUle tu nishchalaM cheto bhavetsUkShme tu tatsthiram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तिप्रत्ययं पूर्णमैश्वर्यं चाणिमादिकम् । शिवध्यानस्य पूर्णस्य साक्षादुक्तं प्रयोजनम्
verses.transliteration: vimuktipratyayaM pUrNamaishvaryaM chANimAdikam | shivadhyAnasya pUrNasya sAkShAduktaM prayojanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्सौख्यं च मोक्षं च ध्यानादुभयमाप्नुयात् । तस्मात्सर्वं परित्यज्य ध्यानयुक्तो भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: yasmAtsaukhyaM cha mokShaM cha dhyAnAdubhayamApnuyAt | tasmAtsarvaM parityajya dhyAnayukto bhavennaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति ध्यानं विना ज्ञानं नास्ति ध्यानमयोगिनः । ध्यानं ज्ञानं च यस्यास्ति तीर्णस्तेन भवार्णवः
verses.transliteration: nAsti dhyAnaM vinA j~nAnaM nAsti dhyAnamayoginaH | dhyAnaM j~nAnaM cha yasyAsti tIrNastena bhavArNavaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं प्रसन्नमेकाग्रमशेषोपाधिवर्जितम् । योगाभ्यासेन युक्तस्य योगिनस्वेव सिध्यति
verses.transliteration: j~nAnaM prasannamekAgramasheShopAdhivarjitam | yogAbhyAsena yuktasya yoginasveva sidhyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षीणाशेषपापानां ज्ञाने ध्याने भवेन्मतिः । पापोपहतबुद्धीनां तद्वार्तापि सुदुर्लभा
verses.transliteration: prakShINAsheShapApAnAM j~nAne dhyAne bhavenmatiH | pApopahatabuddhInAM tadvArtApi sudurlabhA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथा वह्निर्महादीप्तः शुष्कमार्द्रं च निर्दहेत् । तथा शुभाशुभं कर्म ध्यानाग्निर्दहते क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: yathA vahnirmahAdIptaH shuShkamArdraM cha nirdahet | tathA shubhAshubhaM karma dhyAnAgnirdahate kShaNAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यल्पोऽपि यथा दीपः सुमहन्नाशयेत्तमः । योगाभ्यासस्तथाल्पोऽपि महापापं विनाशयेत्
verses.transliteration: atyalpo.api yathA dIpaH sumahannAshayettamaH | yogAbhyAsastathAlpo.api mahApApaM vinAshayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतः क्षणमात्रं वा श्रद्धया परमेश्वरम् । यद्भवेत् सुमहच्छ्रेयस्तस्यान्तो नैव विद्यते
verses.transliteration: dhyAyataH kShaNamAtraM vA shraddhayA parameshvaram | yadbhavet sumahachChreyastasyAnto naiva vidyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति ध्यानसमं तीर्थं नास्ति ध्यानसमं तपः । नास्ति ध्यानसमो यज्ञस्तस्माद्ध्यानं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: nAsti dhyAnasamaM tIrthaM nAsti dhyAnasamaM tapaH | nAsti dhyAnasamo yaj~nastasmAddhyAnaM samAcharet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानि तोयपूर्णानि देवान्पाषाणमृण्मयान् । योगिनो न प्रपद्यन्ते स्वात्मप्रत्ययकारणात्
verses.transliteration: tIrthAni toyapUrNAni devAnpAShANamR^iNmayAn | yogino na prapadyante svAtmapratyayakAraNAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवे तु चिन्तिते साक्षात्सर्वाः सिध्यन्ति सिद्धयः । मूर्त्यन्तरेषु ध्यातेषु शिवरूपं विचिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: shive tu chintite sAkShAtsarvAH sidhyanti siddhayaH | mUrtyantareShu dhyAteShu shivarUpaM vichintayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनां च वपुः सूक्ष्मं भवेत्प्रत्यक्षमैश्वरम् । यथा स्थूलमयुक्तानां मृत्काष्ठाद्यैः प्रकल्पितम्
verses.transliteration: yoginAM cha vapuH sUkShmaM bhavetpratyakShamaishvaram | yathA sthUlamayuktAnAM mR^itkAShThAdyaiH prakalpitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथेहान्तश्चरा राज्ञः प्रियाः स्युर्न बहिश्चराः । तथान्तर्ध्याननिरताः प्रियाश्शम्भोर्न कर्मिणः
verses.transliteration: yathehAntashcharA rAj~naH priyAH syurna bahishcharAH | tathAntardhyAnaniratAH priyAshshambhorna karmiNaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: बहिष्करा यथा लोके नातीव फलभोगिनः । दृष्ट्वा नरेन्द्रभवने तद्वदत्रापि कर्मिणः
verses.transliteration: bahiShkarA yathA loke nAtIva phalabhoginaH | dR^iShTvA narendrabhavane tadvadatrApi karmiNaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यन्तरा विपद्यन्ते ज्ञानयोगार्थमुद्यतः । योगस्योद्योगमात्रेण रुद्रलोकं गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yadyantarA vipadyante j~nAnayogArthamudyataH | yogasyodyogamAtreNa rudralokaM gamiShyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अनुभूय सुखं तत्र स जातो योगिनां कुले । ज्ञानयोगं पुनर्लब्ध्वा संसारमतिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: anubhUya sukhaM tatra sa jAto yoginAM kule | j~nAnayogaM punarlabdhvA saMsAramativartate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य यां गतिं लभते नरः । न तां गतिमवाप्नोति सर्वैरपि महामखैः
verses.transliteration: jij~nAsurapi yogasya yAM gatiM labhate naraH | na tAM gatimavApnoti sarvairapi mahAmakhaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजानां वेदविदुषां कोटिं सम्पूज्य यत्फलम् । भिक्षामात्रप्रदानेन तत्फलं शिवयोगिने
verses.transliteration: dvijAnAM vedaviduShAM koTiM sampUjya yatphalam | bhikShAmAtrapradAnena tatphalaM shivayogine
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञाग्निहोत्रदानेषु तीर्थहोमेषु यत्फलम् । योगिनामन्नदानेन तत्समस्तं फलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: yaj~nAgnihotradAneShu tIrthahomeShu yatphalam | yoginAmannadAnena tatsamastaM phalaM labhet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ये चापवादं कुर्वन्ति विमूढाः शिवयोगिनाम् । श्रोतृभिस्ते प्रपद्यन्ते नरकेष्वामहीक्षयात्
verses.transliteration: ye chApavAdaM kurvanti vimUDhAH shivayoginAm | shrotR^ibhiste prapadyante narakeShvAmahIkShayAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सति श्रोतरि वक्ता स्यादपवादस्य योगिनाम् । तस्माच्छ्रोता च पापीयान्दण्ड्यः सुमहतां मतः । ये पुनः सततं भक्त्या भजन्ति शवयोगिनः
verses.transliteration: sati shrotari vaktA syAdapavAdasya yoginAm | tasmAchChrotA cha pApIyAndaNDyaH sumahatAM mataH | ye punaH satataM bhaktyA bhajanti shavayoginaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षयेन्मनसः स्थैर्यं तत्तद्ध्यायेत्पुनः पुनः । ध्यानमादौ सविषयं ततो निर्विषयं जगुः
verses.transliteration: lakShayenmanasaH sthairyaM tattaddhyAyetpunaH punaH | dhyAnamAdau saviShayaM tato nirviShayaM jaguH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ते विदन्ति महाभोगानन्ते योगं च शाङ्करम् । भोगार्थिभिर्नरैस्तस्मात्सम्पूज्याः शिवयोगिनः
verses.transliteration: te vidanti mahAbhogAnante yogaM cha shA~Nkaram | bhogArthibhirnaraistasmAtsampUjyAH shivayoginaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिश्रयान्नपानाद्यैः शय्याप्रावरणादिभिः । योगधर्मः ससारत्वादभेद्यः पापमुद्गरैः
verses.transliteration: pratishrayAnnapAnAdyaiH shayyAprAvaraNAdibhiH | yogadharmaH sasAratvAdabhedyaH pApamudgaraiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रतन्दुलवज्ज्ञेयं तथा पापेन योगिनः । न लिप्यन्ते च तापौघैः पद्मपत्रं यथाम्भसा
verses.transliteration: vajratandulavajj~neyaM tathA pApena yoginaH | na lipyante cha tApaughaiH padmapatraM yathAmbhasA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्देशे वसेन्नित्यं शिवयोगरतो मुनिः । सोऽपि देशो भवेत्पूतः स पूत इति किं पुनः
verses.transliteration: yasmindeshe vasennityaM shivayogarato muniH | so.api desho bhavetpUtaH sa pUta iti kiM punaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वं परित्यज्य कृत्यमन्यद्विचक्षणः । सर्वदुःखप्रहाणाय शिवयोगं समभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAtsarvaM parityajya kR^ityamanyadvichakShaNaH | sarvaduHkhaprahANAya shivayogaM samabhyaset
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धयोगफलो योगी लोकानां हितकाम्यया । भोगान्भुक्त्वा यथाकामं विहरेद्वात्र वर्तताम्
verses.transliteration: siddhayogaphalo yogI lokAnAM hitakAmyayA | bhogAnbhuktvA yathAkAmaM viharedvAtra vartatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा क्षुद्रमित्येव मत्वा वैषयिकं सुखम् । त्यक्त्वा विरागयोगेन स्वेच्छया कर्म मुच्यताम्
verses.transliteration: athavA kShudramityeva matvA vaiShayikaM sukham | tyaktvA virAgayogena svechChayA karma muchyatAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वासन्नां मृतिं मर्त्यो दृष्ट्वारिष्टं च भूयसा । स योगारम्भनिरतः शिवक्षेत्रं समाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: yastvAsannAM mR^itiM martyo dR^iShTvAriShTaM cha bhUyasA | sa yogArambhanirataH shivakShetraM samAshrayet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स तत्र निवसन्नेव यदि धीरमना नरः । प्राणान् विनापि रोगाद्यैः स्वयमेव परित्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: sa tatra nivasanneva yadi dhIramanA naraH | prANAn vinApi rogAdyaiH svayameva parityajet
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाप्यनशनं चैव हुत्वा चाङ्गं शिवानले । क्षिप्त्वा वा शिवतीर्थेषु स्वदेहमवगाहनात्
verses.transliteration: kR^itvApyanashanaM chaiva hutvA chA~NgaM shivAnale | kShiptvA vA shivatIrtheShu svadehamavagAhanAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र निर्विषयं ध्यानं नास्तीत्येव सतां मतम् । बुद्धेर्हि सन्ततिः काचिद्ध्यानमित्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: tatra nirviShayaM dhyAnaM nAstItyeva satAM matam | buddherhi santatiH kAchiddhyAnamityabhidhIyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवशास्त्रोक्तविधिवत्प्राणान्यस्तु परित्यजेत् । सद्य एव विमुच्येत नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: shivashAstroktavidhivatprANAnyastu parityajet | sadya eva vimuchyeta nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: रोगाद्यैर्वाथ विवशः शिवक्षेत्रं समाश्रितः । म्रियते यदि सोऽप्येवं मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: rogAdyairvAtha vivashaH shivakShetraM samAshritaH | mriyate yadi so.apyevaM muchyate nAtra saMshayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यथा हि मरणं श्रेष्ठमुशन्त्यनशनादिभिः । शास्त्रविश्रम्भधीरेण मनसा क्रियते यतः
verses.transliteration: yathA hi maraNaM shreShThamushantyanashanAdibhiH | shAstravishrambhadhIreNa manasA kriyate yataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवनिन्दारतं हत्वा पीडितः स्वयमेव वा । यस्त्यजेद्दुस्त्यजान्प्राणान्न स भूयः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: shivanindArataM hatvA pIDitaH svayameva vA | yastyajeddustyajAnprANAnna sa bhUyaH prajAyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवनिन्दारतं हन्तुमशक्तो यः स्वयं मृतः । सद्य एव प्रमुच्येत त्रिःसप्तकुलसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: shivanindArataM hantumashakto yaH svayaM mR^itaH | sadya eva pramuchyeta triHsaptakulasaMyutaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवार्थे यस्त्यजेत्प्राणान् शिवभक्तार्थमेव वा । न तेन सदृशः कश्चिन्मुक्तिमार्गस्थितो नरः
verses.transliteration: shivArthe yastyajetprANAn shivabhaktArthameva vA | na tena sadR^ishaH kashchinmuktimArgasthito naraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छीघ्रतरा मुक्तिस्तस्य संसारमण्डलात् । एतेष्वन्यतमोपायं कथमप्यवलम्ब्य वा
verses.transliteration: tasmAchChIghratarA muktistasya saMsAramaNDalAt | eteShvanyatamopAyaM kathamapyavalambya vA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: षडध्वशुद्धिं विधिवत्प्राप्तो वा म्रियते यदि । पशूनामिव तस्येह न कुर्यादौर्ध्वदैहिकम्
verses.transliteration: ShaDadhvashuddhiM vidhivatprApto vA mriyate yadi | pashUnAmiva tasyeha na kuryAdaurdhvadaihikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नैवाशौचं प्रपद्येत तत्पुत्रादिर्विशेषतः । शिवचारार्थमथवा शिवविद्यार्थमेव वा । खनेद्वा भुवि तद्देहं दहेद्वा शुचिनाग्निना
verses.transliteration: naivAshauchaM prapadyeta tatputrAdirvisheShataH | shivachArArthamathavA shivavidyArthameva vA | khanedvA bhuvi taddehaM dahedvA shuchinAgninA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्षिपेद्वाप्सु शिवास्वेव त्यजेद्वा काष्ठलोष्टवत् । अथैनमपि चोद्दिश्य कर्म चेत्कर्तुमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: kShipedvApsu shivAsveva tyajedvA kAShThaloShTavat | athainamapi choddishya karma chetkartumIpsitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तेन निर्विषया बुद्धिः केवलेह प्रवर्तते । तस्मात्सविषयं ध्यानं बालार्ककिरणाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: tena nirviShayA buddhiH kevaleha pravartate | tasmAtsaviShayaM dhyAnaM bAlArkakiraNAshrayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कल्याणमेव कुर्वीत शक्त्या भक्तांश्च तर्पयेत् । धनं तस्य भजेच्छैवः शैवी चेत्तस्य सन्ततिः । नास्ति चेत्तच्छिवे दद्यान्नदद्यात्पशुसन्ततिः
verses.transliteration: kalyANameva kurvIta shaktyA bhaktAMshcha tarpayet | dhanaM tasya bhajechChaivaH shaivI chettasya santatiH | nAsti chettachChive dadyAnnadadyAtpashusantatiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्माश्रयं निर्विषयं नापरं परमार्थतः । यद्वा सविषयं ध्यानं तत्साकारसमाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: sUkShmAshrayaM nirviShayaM nAparaM paramArthataH | yadvA saviShayaM dhyAnaM tatsAkArasamAshrayam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निराकारात्मसंवित्तिर्ध्यानं निर्विषयं मतम् । निर्बीजं च सबीजं च तदेव ध्यानमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: nirAkArAtmasaMvittirdhyAnaM nirviShayaM matam | nirbIjaM cha sabIjaM cha tadeva dhyAnamuchyate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: निराकारश्रयत्वेन साकाराश्रयतस्तथा । तस्मात्सविषयं ध्यानमादौ कृत्वा सबीजकम्
verses.transliteration: nirAkArashrayatvena sAkArAshrayatastathA | tasmAtsaviShayaM dhyAnamAdau kR^itvA sabIjakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.४०. चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । नैमिषर्षियात्रावर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । इति स विजितमन्योर्यादवेनोपमन्यो- रधिगतमभिधाय ज्ञानयोगं मुनिभ्यः । प्रणतिमुपगतेभ्यस्तेभ्य उद्भावितात्मा सपदि वियति वायुः सायमन्तर्हितोऽभूत्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.40\. chatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | naimiSharShiyAtrAvarNanam | sUta uvAcha | iti sa vijitamanyoryAdavenopamanyo\- radhigatamabhidhAya j~nAnayogaM munibhyaH | praNatimupagatebhyastebhya udbhAvitAtmA sapadi viyati vAyuH sAyamantarhito.abhUt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ पाशुपताः सिद्धाः भस्मसञ्छन्नविग्रहाः । मुनयोऽभ्येत्य शतशो लीनाः स्युस्तत्र तेजसि
verses.transliteration: atha pAshupatAH siddhAH bhasmasa~nChannavigrahAH | munayo.abhyetya shatasho lInAH syustatra tejasi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथा विलीयमानेषु तपस्विषु महात्मसु । सद्यस्तिरोदधे तेजस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: tathA vilIyamAneShu tapasviShu mahAtmasu | sadyastirodadhe tejastadadbhutamivAbhavat
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तद् दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं नैमिषीया महर्षयः । किमेतदित्यजानन्तो ययुर्ब्रह्मवनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: tad dR^iShTvA mahadAshcharyaM naimiShIyA maharShayaH | kimetadityajAnanto yayurbrahmavanaM prati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रागेवैषां तु गमनात्पवनो लोकपावनः । दर्शनं नैमिषीयाणां संवादस्तैर्महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: prAgevaiShAM tu gamanAtpavano lokapAvanaH | darshanaM naimiShIyANAM saMvAdastairmahAtmanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धां बुद्धिं ततस्तेषां साम्बे सानुचरे शिवे । समाप्तिं चापि सत्रस्य दीर्घपूर्वस्य सत्रिणाम्
verses.transliteration: shuddhAM buddhiM tatasteShAM sAmbe sAnuchare shive | samAptiM chApi satrasya dIrghapUrvasya satriNAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाप्य जगतां धात्रे ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मयोनये । स्वकार्ये तदनुज्ञातो जगाम स्वपुरं प्रति
verses.transliteration: vij~nApya jagatAM dhAtre brahmaNe brahmayonaye | svakArye tadanuj~nAto jagAma svapuraM prati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ स्थानगतो ब्रह्मा तुम्बुरोर्नारदस्य च । परस्परं स्पर्द्धितयोर्गाने विवदमानयोः
verses.transliteration: atha sthAnagato brahmA tumburornAradasya cha | parasparaM sparddhitayorgAne vivadamAnayoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदुद्भावितगानोत्थरसैर्माध्यस्थमाचरन् । गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च सुखमास्ते निषेवितः
verses.transliteration: tadudbhAvitagAnottharasairmAdhyasthamAcharan | gandharvairapsarobhishcha sukhamAste niShevitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदानवसरादेव द्वाःस्थैर्द्वारि निवारिताः । मुनयो ब्रह्मभवनाद्बहिः पार्श्वमुपाविशन्
verses.transliteration: tadAnavasarAdeva dvAHsthairdvAri nivAritAH | munayo brahmabhavanAdbahiH pArshvamupAvishan
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तुम्बुरुणा गाने समतां प्राप्य नारदः । साहचर्येष्वनुज्ञातो ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: atha tumburuNA gAne samatAM prApya nAradaH | sAhacharyeShvanuj~nAto brahmaNA parameShThinA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभातसमये नैमिषीयास्तपोधनाः । सत्रान्तेऽवभृथं कर्तुं सर्व एव समुद्ययुः
verses.transliteration: tataH prabhAtasamaye naimiShIyAstapodhanAH | satrAnte.avabhR^ithaM kartuM sarva eva samudyayuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा परस्परस्पर्द्धां मैत्रीं च परमां गतः । सह तेनाप्सरोभिश्च गन्धर्वैश्च समावृतः
verses.transliteration: tyaktvA parasparasparddhAM maitrIM cha paramAM gataH | saha tenApsarobhishcha gandharvaishcha samAvR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपवीणयितुं देवं नकुलीश्वरमीश्वरम् । भवनान्निर्ययौ धातुर्जलदादंशुमानिव
verses.transliteration: upavINayituM devaM nakulIshvaramIshvaram | bhavanAnniryayau dhAturjaladAdaMshumAniva
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा षट्कुलीयास्ते नारदं मुनिगोवृषम् । प्रणम्यावसरं शम्भोः पप्रच्छुः परमादरात्
verses.transliteration: taM dR^iShTvA ShaTkulIyAste nAradaM munigovR^iSham | praNamyAvasaraM shambhoH paprachChuH paramAdarAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स चावसर एवायमितोऽन्तर्गम्यतामिति । वदन्ययावन्यपरस्त्वरया परया युतः
verses.transliteration: sa chAvasara evAyamito.antargamyatAmiti | vadanyayAvanyaparastvarayA parayA yutaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्वारि स्थिता ये वै ब्रह्मणे तान्न्यवेदयन् । तेन ते विविशुर्वेश्म पिण्डीभूयाण्डजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: tato dvAri sthitA ye vai brahmaNe tAnnyavedayan | tena te vivishurveshma piNDIbhUyANDajanmanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य दूरतो देवं प्रणम्य भुवि दण्डवत् । समीपे तदनुज्ञाताः परिवृत्योपतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration: pravishya dUrato devaM praNamya bhuvi daNDavat | samIpe tadanuj~nAtAH parivR^ityopatasthire
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तत्रावस्थितान् पृष्ट्वा कुशलं कमलासनः । वृत्तान्तं वो मया ज्ञातं वायुरेवाह नो यतः
verses.transliteration: tAMstatrAvasthitAn pR^iShTvA kushalaM kamalAsanaH | vR^ittAntaM vo mayA j~nAtaM vAyurevAha no yataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भवद्भिः किं कृतं पश्चान्मारुतेऽन्तर्हिते सति । इत्युक्तवति देवेशे मुनयोऽवभृथात्परम्
verses.transliteration: bhavadbhiH kiM kR^itaM pashchAnmArute.antarhite sati | ityuktavati deveshe munayo.avabhR^ithAtparam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गातीर्थेऽस्य गमनं यात्रां वाराणसीं प्रति । दर्शनं तत्र लिङ्गानां स्थापितानां सुरेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: ga~NgAtIrthe.asya gamanaM yAtrAM vArANasIM prati | darshanaM tatra li~NgAnAM sthApitAnAM sureshvaraiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्तेश्वरस्यापि लिङ्गस्याभ्यर्चनं सकृत् । आकाशे महतस्तस्य तेजोराशेश्च दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: avimukteshvarasyApi li~NgasyAbhyarchanaM sakR^it | AkAshe mahatastasya tejorAsheshcha darshanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदा ब्रह्मसमादेशाद्देवी साक्षात्सरस्वती । प्रसन्ना स्वादुसलिला प्रावर्तत नदी शुभा
verses.transliteration: tadA brahmasamAdeshAddevI sAkShAtsarasvatI | prasannA svAdusalilA prAvartata nadI shubhA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मुनीनां विलयं तत्र निरोधं तेजसस्ततः । याथात्म्यवेदनं तस्य चिन्तितस्यापि चात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: munInAM vilayaM tatra nirodhaM tejasastataH | yAthAtmyavedanaM tasya chintitasyApi chAtmabhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं सविस्तरं तस्मै प्रणम्याहुर्मुहुर्मुहुः । मुनिभिः कथितं श्रुत्वा विश्वकर्मा चतुर्मुखः
verses.transliteration: sarvaM savistaraM tasmai praNamyAhurmuhurmuhuH | munibhiH kathitaM shrutvA vishvakarmA chaturmukhaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कम्पयित्वा शिरः किञ्चित्प्राह गम्भीरया गिरा । प्रत्यासीदति युष्माकं सिद्धिरामुष्मिकी परा
verses.transliteration: kampayitvA shiraH ki~nchitprAha gambhIrayA girA | pratyAsIdati yuShmAkaM siddhirAmuShmikI parA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: भवद्भिर्दीर्घसत्रेण चिरमाराधितः प्रभुः । प्रसादाभिमुखो भूत इति भूतार्थसूचितम्
verses.transliteration: bhavadbhirdIrghasatreNa chiramArAdhitaH prabhuH | prasAdAbhimukho bhUta iti bhUtArthasUchitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणस्यां तु युष्माभिर्यद् दृष्टं दिवि दीप्तिमत् । तल्लिङ्गसंज्ञितं साक्षात्तेजो माहेश्वरं परम्
verses.transliteration: vArANasyAM tu yuShmAbhiryad dR^iShTaM divi dIptimat | talli~Ngasa.nj~nitaM sAkShAttejo mAheshvaraM param
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र लीनाश्च मुनयः श्रौतपाशुपतव्रताः । मुक्ता बभूवुः स्वस्थाश्च नैष्ठिका दग्धकिल्बिषाः
verses.transliteration: tatra lInAshcha munayaH shrautapAshupatavratAH | muktA babhUvuH svasthAshcha naiShThikA dagdhakilbiShAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्यानेन यथा मुक्तिरचिराद्भवतामपि । स चायमर्थः सूच्येत युष्मद्दृष्टेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration: prApyAnena yathA muktirachirAdbhavatAmapi | sa chAyamarthaH sUchyeta yuShmaddR^iShTena tejasA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वः काल एवैष दैवादुपनतः स्वयम् । प्रयात दक्षिणं मेरोः शिखरं देवसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra vaH kAla evaiSha daivAdupanataH svayam | prayAta dakShiNaM meroH shikharaM devasevitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारो यत्रास्ते मम पुत्रः परो मुनिः । प्रतीक्ष्यागमनं साक्षाद्भूतनाथस्य नन्दिनः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAro yatrAste mama putraH paro muniH | pratIkShyAgamanaM sAkShAdbhUtanAthasya nandinaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा सनत्कुमारोऽपि दृष्ट्वापि परमेश्वरम् । अज्ञानात्सर्वयोगीन्द्रमानी विनयदूषितः
verses.transliteration: purA sanatkumAro.api dR^iShTvApi parameshvaram | aj~nAnAtsarvayogIndramAnI vinayadUShitaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वतीं नदीं दृष्ट्वा मुनयो हृष्टमानसाः । समाप्य सत्रं प्रारब्धं चक्रुस्तत्रावगाहनम्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatIM nadIM dR^iShTvA munayo hR^iShTamAnasAH | samApya satraM prArabdhaM chakrustatrAvagAhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्युत्थानादिकं युक्तमकुर्वन्नतिनिर्भयः । ततोऽपराधात्क्रुद्धेन महोष्ट्रो नन्दिना कृतः
verses.transliteration: abhyutthAnAdikaM yuktamakurvannatinirbhayaH | tato.aparAdhAtkruddhena mahoShTro nandinA kR^itaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ कालेन महता तदर्थे शोचता मया । उपास्य देवं देवीं च नन्दिनं चानुनीय वै
verses.transliteration: atha kAlena mahatA tadarthe shochatA mayA | upAsya devaM devIM cha nandinaM chAnunIya vai
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कथञ्चिद् दुष्टता तस्य प्रयत्नेन निवारिता । प्रापितो हि यथापूर्वं सनत्पूर्वां कुमारताम्
verses.transliteration: katha~nchid duShTatA tasya prayatnena nivAritA | prApito hi yathApUrvaM sanatpUrvAM kumAratAm
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदाह च महादेवः स्मयन्निव गणाधिपम् । अवज्ञाय हि मामेव तथाहङ्कृतवान्मुनिः
verses.transliteration: tadAha cha mahAdevaH smayanniva gaNAdhipam | avaj~nAya hi mAmeva tathAha~NkR^itavAnmuniH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अतस्त्वमेव याथात्म्यं ममास्मै कथयानघ । ब्रह्मणः पूर्वजः पुत्रो मां मूढमिव संस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: atastvameva yAthAtmyaM mamAsmai kathayAnagha | brahmaNaH pUrvajaH putro mAM mUDhamiva saMsmaran
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मयैव शिष्यस्ते दत्तो मम ज्ञानप्रवर्तकः । धर्माध्यक्षाभिषेकं च तव निर्वर्त्तयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: mayaiva shiShyaste datto mama j~nAnapravartakaH | dharmAdhyakShAbhiShekaM cha tava nirvarttayiShyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स एवं व्याहृतो भूयः सर्वभूतगणाग्रणीः । यत्पुराज्ञापनं मूर्ध्ना प्राप्य प्रतिगृहीतवान्
verses.transliteration: sa evaM vyAhR^ito bhUyaH sarvabhUtagaNAgraNIH | yatpurAj~nApanaM mUrdhnA prApya pratigR^ihItavAn
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तथा सनत्कुमारोऽपि मेरौ मदनुशासनात् । प्रसादार्थं गणस्यास्य तपश्चरति दुश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: tathA sanatkumAro.api merau madanushAsanAt | prasAdArthaM gaNasyAsya tapashcharati dushcharam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टव्यश्चेति युष्माभिः प्राग्गणेशसमागमात् । तत्प्रसादार्थमचिरान्नन्दी तत्रागमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: draShTavyashcheti yuShmAbhiH prAggaNeshasamAgamAt | tatprasAdArthamachirAnnandI tatrAgamiShyati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इति सत्वरमादिश्य प्रेषिता विश्वयोगिना । कुमारशिखरं मेरोर्दक्षिणं मुनयो ययुः
verses.transliteration: iti satvaramAdishya preShitA vishvayoginA | kumArashikharaM merordakShiNaM munayo yayuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सन्तर्प्य देवादींस्तदीयैः सलिलैः शिवैः । स्मरन्तः पूर्ववृत्तान्तं ययुर्वाराणसीं प्रति
verses.transliteration: atha santarpya devAdIMstadIyaiH salilaiH shivaiH | smarantaH pUrvavR^ittAntaM yayurvArANasIM prati
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तदा ते हिमवत्पादात्पन्ततीं दक्षिणामुखीम् । दृष्ट्वा भागीरथीं तत्र स्नात्वा तत्तीरतो ययुः
verses.transliteration: tadA te himavatpAdAtpantatIM dakShiNAmukhIm | dR^iShTvA bhAgIrathIM tatra snAtvA tattIrato yayuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वाराणसीं प्राप्य मुदिताः सर्व एव ते । तदोत्तरप्रवाहायां गङ्गायामवगाह्य च
verses.transliteration: tato vArANasIM prApya muditAH sarva eva te | tadottarapravAhAyAM ga~NgAyAmavagAhya cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं दृष्ट्वाभ्यर्च्य विधानतः । प्रयातुमुद्यतास्तत्र ददृशुर्दिवि भास्वरम्
verses.transliteration: avimukteshvaraM li~NgaM dR^iShTvAbhyarchya vidhAnataH | prayAtumudyatAstatra dadR^ishurdivi bhAsvaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशं तेजोदिव्यं महाद्भुतम् । आत्मप्रभावितानेन व्याप्तसर्वदिगन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sUryakoTipratIkAshaM tejodivyaM mahAdbhutam | AtmaprabhAvitAnena vyAptasarvadigantaram
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः
verses.transliteration: || shrIgaNeshAya namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः
verses.transliteration: shrIgaurIsha~NkarAbhyAM namaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥ ७.२.४१. एकचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः । श्रीशिवमहापुराणमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् । सूत उवाच । तत्र स्कन्दसरो नाम सरः सागरसन्निभम् । अमृतस्वादुशिशिरस्वच्छागाधलघूदकम्
verses.transliteration: shrIshivamahApurANam || 7\.2\.41\. ekachatvAriMsho.adhyAyaH | shrIshivamahApurANamAhAtmyavarNanam | sUta uvAcha | tatra skandasaro nAma saraH sAgarasannibham | amR^itasvAdushishirasvachChAgAdhalaghUdakam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: इतस्ततोऽप्सु मज्जद्भिरिष्टशिष्टैः शिलागतैः । तिलैश्च साक्षतैः पुष्पैस्त्यक्तदर्भपवित्रकैः
verses.transliteration: itastato.apsu majjadbhiriShTashiShTaiH shilAgataiH | tilaishcha sAkShataiH puShpaistyaktadarbhapavitrakaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: देवाद्यमृषिमध्यं च निर्वर्त्य पितृतर्पणम् । निवेदयेदभिज्ञेभ्यो नित्यस्नानगतान् द्विजान्
verses.transliteration: devAdyamR^iShimadhyaM cha nirvartya pitR^itarpaNam | nivedayedabhij~nebhyo nityasnAnagatAn dvijAn
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्थाने स्थाने कृतानेकबलिपुष्पसमीरणैः । सौरार्घ्यपूर्वं कुर्वद्भिः स्थण्डलेभ्यर्चनादिकम्
verses.transliteration: sthAne sthAne kR^itAnekabalipuShpasamIraNaiH | saurArghyapUrvaM kurvadbhiH sthaNDalebhyarchanAdikam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिन्निमज्जदुन्मज्जत्प्रस्रस्तगजयूथपम् । क्वचिच्च तृषयायातमृगीमृगतुरङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: kvachinnimajjadunmajjatprasrastagajayUthapam | kvachichcha tR^iShayAyAtamR^igImR^igatura~Ngamam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित्पीतजनोत्तीर्णमयूरवरवारणम् । क्वचित्कृततटाघातवृषप्रतिवृषोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: kvachitpItajanottIrNamayUravaravAraNam | kvachitkR^itataTAghAtavR^iShaprativR^iShojjvalam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित्कारण्डवरवैः क्वचित्सारसकूजितैः । क्वचिच्च कोकनिनदैः क्वचिद्भ्रमरगीतिभिः
verses.transliteration: kvachitkAraNDavaravaiH kvachitsArasakUjitaiH | kvachichcha kokaninadaiH kvachidbhramaragItibhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानपानादिकरणैः स्वसम्पद्द्रुमजीविभिः । प्रणयात्प्राणिभिस्तैस्तैर्भाषमाणमिवासकृत्
verses.transliteration: snAnapAnAdikaraNaiH svasampaddrumajIvibhiH | praNayAtprANibhistaistairbhAShamANamivAsakR^it
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कूलशाखिशिखालीनकोकिलाकुलकूजितैः । आतपोपहतान् सर्वान्नामन्त्रयदिवानिशम्
verses.transliteration: kUlashAkhishikhAlInakokilAkulakUjitaiH | AtapopahatAn sarvAnnAmantrayadivAnisham
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे तस्य सरसस्तीरे कल्पतरोरधः । वेद्यां वज्रशिलामय्यां मृदुले मृगचर्मणि
verses.transliteration: uttare tasya sarasastIre kalpataroradhaH | vedyAM vajrashilAmayyAM mR^idule mR^igacharmaNi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारमासीनं शश्वद्बालवपुर्धरम् । तत्कालमात्रोपरतं समाधेरचलात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAramAsInaM shashvadbAlavapurdharam | tatkAlamAtroparataM samAdherachalAtmanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: समन्ततः सङ्घटितं स्फटिकोपलसञ्चयैः । सर्वर्तुकुसुमैः फुल्लैश्छादिताखिलदिङ्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: samantataH sa~NghaTitaM sphaTikopalasa~nchayaiH | sarvartukusumaiH phullaishChAditAkhiladi~Nmukham
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यमानं मुनिभिर्योगीन्द्रैरपि पूजितम् । ददृशुर्नैमिषेयास्ते प्रणताश्चोपतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration: upAsyamAnaM munibhiryogIndrairapi pUjitam | dadR^ishurnaimiSheyAste praNatAshchopatasthire
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्पृष्टवते तस्मै प्रोचुः स्वागतकारणम् । तुमुलः शुश्रुवे तावद्दिवि दुन्दुभिनिःस्वनः
verses.transliteration: yAvatpR^iShTavate tasmai prochuH svAgatakAraNam | tumulaH shushruve tAvaddivi dundubhiniHsvanaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: ददृशे तत्क्षणे तस्मिन् विमानं भानुसन्निभम् । गणेश्वरैरसङ्ख्येयैः संवृतं च समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: dadR^ishe tatkShaNe tasmin vimAnaM bhAnusannibham | gaNeshvarairasa~NkhyeyaiH saMvR^itaM cha samantataH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोगणसङ्कीर्णं रुद्रकन्याभिरावृतम् । मृदङ्गमुरजोद्घुष्टं वेणुवीणारवान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: apsarogaNasa~NkIrNaM rudrakanyAbhirAvR^itam | mR^ida~NgamurajodghuShTaM veNuvINAravAnvitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: चित्ररत्नवितानाढ्यं मुक्तादामविराजितम् । मुनिभिः सिद्धगन्धर्वैर्यक्षचारणकिन्नरैः
verses.transliteration: chitraratnavitAnADhyaM muktAdAmavirAjitam | munibhiH siddhagandharvairyakShachAraNakinnaraiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यद्भिश्चैव गायद्भिर्वादयद्भिश्च संवृतम् । वीरगोवृषचिह्नेन विद्रमद्रुमयष्टिना
verses.transliteration: nR^ityadbhishchaiva gAyadbhirvAdayadbhishcha saMvR^itam | vIragovR^iShachihnena vidramadrumayaShTinA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कृतगोपुरसत्कारं केतुना मान्यहेतुना । तस्य मध्ये विमानस्य चामरद्वितयान्तरे
verses.transliteration: kR^itagopurasatkAraM ketunA mAnyahetunA | tasya madhye vimAnasya chAmaradvitayAntare
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: छत्त्रस्य मणिदण्डस्य चन्द्रस्येव शुचेरधः । दिव्यसिंहासनारूढं देव्या सुयशया सह
verses.transliteration: Chattrasya maNidaNDasya chandrasyeva shucheradhaH | divyasiMhAsanArUDhaM devyA suyashayA saha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रिया च वपुषा चैव त्रिभिश्चापि विलोचनैः । प्राकारैरभिकृत्यानां प्रत्यभिज्ञापकं प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: shriyA cha vapuShA chaiva tribhishchApi vilochanaiH | prAkArairabhikR^ityAnAM pratyabhij~nApakaM prabhoH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अविलङ्घ्य जगत्कर्तुराज्ञापनमिवागतम् । सर्वानुग्रहणं शम्भोः साक्षादिव पुरःस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: avila~Nghya jagatkarturAj~nApanamivAgatam | sarvAnugrahaNaM shambhoH sAkShAdiva puraHsthitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शैवलैरुत्पलैः पद्मैः कुमुदैस्तारकोपमैः । तरङ्गैरभ्रसङ्काशैराकाशमिव भूमिगम्
verses.transliteration: shaivalairutpalaiH padmaiH kumudaistArakopamaiH | tara~Ngairabhrasa~NkAshairAkAshamiva bhUmigam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: शिलादतनयं साक्षाच्छ्रीमच्छूलवरायुधम् । विश्वेश्वरगणाध्यक्षं विश्वेश्वरमिवापरम्
verses.transliteration: shilAdatanayaM sAkShAchChrImachChUlavarAyudham | vishveshvaragaNAdhyakShaM vishveshvaramivAparam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्यापि विधातॄणां निग्रहानुग्रहक्षमम् । चतुर्बाहुमुदाराङ्गं चन्द्ररेखाविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: vishvasyApi vidhAtR^INAM nigrahAnugrahakShamam | chaturbAhumudArA~NgaM chandrarekhAvibhUShitam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: कण्ठे नागेन मौलौ च शशाङ्केनाप्यलङ्कृतम् । सविग्रहमिवैश्वर्यं सामर्थ्यमिव सक्रियम्
verses.transliteration: kaNThe nAgena maulau cha shashA~NkenApyala~NkR^itam | savigrahamivaishvaryaM sAmarthyamiva sakriyam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: समाप्तमिव निर्वाणं सर्वज्ञमिव सङ्गतम् । दृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्टवदनो ब्रह्मपुत्रः सहर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: samAptamiva nirvANaM sarvaj~namiva sa~Ngatam | dR^iShTvA prahR^iShTavadano brahmaputraH saharShibhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्थौ प्राञ्जलिरुत्थाय तस्यात्मानमिवार्पयन् । अथ तत्रान्तरे तस्मिन्विमाने चावनिं गते
verses.transliteration: tasthau prA~njalirutthAya tasyAtmAnamivArpayan | atha tatrAntare tasminvimAne chAvaniM gate
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य दण्डवद्देवं स्तुत्वा व्यज्ञापयन्मुनीम् । षट्कुलीया इमे दीर्घं नैमिषे सत्रमास्थिताः । आगता ब्रह्मणादिष्टाः पूर्वमेवाभिकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration: praNamya daNDavaddevaM stutvA vyaj~nApayanmunIm | ShaTkulIyA ime dIrghaM naimiShe satramAsthitAH | AgatA brahmaNAdiShTAH pUrvamevAbhikA~NkShayA
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाक्यं ब्रह्मपुत्रस्य नन्दी छित्त्वा पाशान्दृष्टिपातेन सद्यः । शैवं धर्मं चैश्वरं ज्ञानयोगं दत्त्वा भूयो देवपार्श्वं जगाम
verses.transliteration: shrutvA vAkyaM brahmaputrasya nandI ChittvA pAshAndR^iShTipAtena sadyaH | shaivaM dharmaM chaishvaraM j~nAnayogaM dattvA bhUyo devapArshvaM jagAma
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारेण च तत्समस्तं व्यासाय साक्षाद्गुरवे ममोक्तम् । व्यासेन चोक्तं महितेन मह्यं मया च तद्वः कथितं समासात्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumAreNa cha tatsamastaM vyAsAya sAkShAdgurave mamoktam | vyAsena choktaM mahitena mahyaM mayA cha tadvaH kathitaM samAsAt
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नावेदविद्भ्यः कथनीयमेतत् पुराणरत्नं पुरशासनस्य । नाभक्तशिष्याय च नास्तिकेभ्यो दत्तं हि मोहान्निरयं ददाति
verses.transliteration: nAvedavidbhyaH kathanIyametat purANaratnaM purashAsanasya | nAbhaktashiShyAya cha nAstikebhyo dattaM hi mohAnnirayaM dadAti
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: मार्गेण सेवानुगतेन यैस्तद् दत्तं गृहीतं पठितं श्रुतं वा । तेभ्यः सुखं धर्ममुखं त्रिवर्गं निर्वाणमन्ते नियतं ददाति
verses.transliteration: mArgeNa sevAnugatena yaistad dattaM gR^ihItaM paThitaM shrutaM vA | tebhyaH sukhaM dharmamukhaM trivargaM nirvANamante niyataM dadAti
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सुखावतरणारोहैः स्थलैर्नीलशिलामयैः । सोपानमार्गौ रुचिरैः शोभमानाष्टदिङ्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: sukhAvataraNArohaiH sthalairnIlashilAmayaiH | sopAnamArgau ruchiraiH shobhamAnAShTadi~Nmukham
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परस्योपकृतं भवद्भि र्मया च पौराणिकमार्गयोगात् । अतो गमिष्येऽहमवाप्तकामः समस्तमेवास्तु शिवं सदा नः
verses.transliteration: parasparasyopakR^itaM bhavadbhi rmayA cha paurANikamArgayogAt | ato gamiShye.ahamavAptakAmaH samastamevAstu shivaM sadA naH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: सूते कृताशिषि गते मुनयः सुवृत्ता यागे च पर्यवसिते महति प्रयोगे । काले कलौ च विषयैः कलुषायमाणे वाराणसीपरिसरे वसतिं विनेतुः
verses.transliteration: sUte kR^itAshiShi gate munayaH suvR^ittA yAge cha paryavasite mahati prayoge | kAle kalau cha viShayaiH kaluShAyamANe vArANasIparisare vasatiM vinetuH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ च ते पशुपाशमुमुक्षया- खिलतया कृतपाशुपतव्रताः । अधिकृताखिलबोधसमाधयः परमनिर्वृतिमापुरनिन्दिताः
verses.transliteration: atha cha te pashupAshamumukShayA\- khilatayA kR^itapAshupatavratAH | adhikR^itAkhilabodhasamAdhayaH paramanirvR^itimApuraninditAH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच । एतच्छिवपुराणं हि समाप्तं हितमादरात् । पठितव्यं प्रयत्नेन श्रोतव्यं च तथैव हि
verses.transliteration: vyAsa uvAcha | etachChivapurANaM hi samAptaM hitamAdarAt | paThitavyaM prayatnena shrotavyaM cha tathaiva hi
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: नास्तिकाय न वक्तव्यमश्रद्धाय शठाय च । अभक्ताय महेशस्य तथा धर्मध्वजाय च
verses.transliteration: nAstikAya na vaktavyamashraddhAya shaThAya cha | abhaktAya maheshasya tathA dharmadhvajAya cha
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्या ह्येकवारं भवेत् पापं हि भस्मसात् । अभक्तो भक्तिमाप्नोति भक्तो भक्तिसमृद्धिभाक्
verses.transliteration: etachChrutyA hyekavAraM bhavet pApaM hi bhasmasAt | abhakto bhaktimApnoti bhakto bhaktisamR^iddhibhAk
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः श्रुते च सद्भक्तिर्मुक्तिः स्याच्च श्रुतेः पुनः । तस्मात् पुनःपुनश्चैव श्रोतव्यं हि मुमुक्षुभिः
verses.transliteration: punaH shrute cha sadbhaktirmuktiH syAchcha shruteH punaH | tasmAt punaHpunashchaiva shrotavyaM hi mumukShubhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चावृत्तिः प्रकर्तव्या पुराणस्यास्य सद्धिया । परं फलं समुद्दिश्य तत्प्राप्नोति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: pa~nchAvR^ittiH prakartavyA purANasyAsya saddhiyA | paraM phalaM samuddishya tatprApnoti na saMshayaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: पुरातनाश्च राजानो विप्रा वैश्याश्च सत्तमाः । सप्तकृत्वस्तदावृत्त्यालभन्त शिवदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: purAtanAshcha rAjAno viprA vaishyAshcha sattamAH | saptakR^itvastadAvR^ittyAlabhanta shivadarshanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोष्यत्यथापि यश्चेदं मानवो भक्तितत्परः । इहभुक्त्वाखिलान् भोगानन्ते मुक्तिंलभेच्च सः
verses.transliteration: shroShyatyathApi yashchedaM mAnavo bhaktitatparaH | ihabhuktvAkhilAn bhogAnante muktiMlabhechcha saH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रावतीर्णैश्च यथा तत्रोत्तीर्णैश्च भूयसा । स्नातैः सितोपवीतैश्च शुक्लाकौपीनवल्कलैः
verses.transliteration: tatrAvatIrNaishcha yathA tatrottIrNaishcha bhUyasA | snAtaiH sitopavItaishcha shuklAkaupInavalkalaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छिवपुराणं हि शिवस्यातिप्रियं परम् । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं ब्रह्मसम्मितं भक्तिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: etachChivapurANaM hi shivasyAtipriyaM param | bhuktimuktipradaM brahmasammitaM bhaktivardhanam
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छिवपुराणस्य वक्तुः श्रोतुश्च सर्वदा । सगणः ससुतः साम्बः शं करोतु स शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: etachChivapurANasya vaktuH shrotushcha sarvadA | sagaNaH sasutaH sAmbaH shaM karotu sa sha~NkaraH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: जटाशिखायनैर्मुण्डैस्त्रिपुण्ड्रकृतमण्डनैः । विरागविवशस्मेरमुखैर्मुनिकुमारकैः
verses.transliteration: jaTAshikhAyanairmuNDaistripuNDrakR^itamaNDanaiH | virAgavivashasmeramukhairmunikumArakaiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: घटैः कमलिनीपत्रपुटैश्च कलशैः शिवैः । कमण्डलुभिरन्यैश्च तादृशैः करकादिभिः
verses.transliteration: ghaTaiH kamalinIpatrapuTaishcha kalashaiH shivaiH | kamaNDalubhiranyaishcha tAdR^ishaiH karakAdibhiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मार्थं च परार्थं च देवतार्थं विशेषतः । आनीयमानसलिलमात्तपुष्पं च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: AtmArthaM cha parArthaM cha devatArthaM visheShataH | AnIyamAnasalilamAttapuShpaM cha nityashaH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्जलशिलारूढैर्नीचानां स्पर्शशङ्कया । आचारवद्भिर्मुनिभिः कृतभस्माङ्गधूसरैः
verses.transliteration: antarjalashilArUDhairnIchAnAM sparshasha~NkayA | AchAravadbhirmunibhiH kR^itabhasmA~NgadhUsaraiH
verses.translation: May Siva with his Ganas, sons and Amba bestow blessings upon those who explain or listen to this Purana.
